explanation_cn: 曾用名DADE，为橙黄色晶体，室温下基本不挥发，可溶于二甲基亚砜、福马酸二甲酯、丁内酯、甲基吡啶烷酮，微溶于丙酮，不溶于水。
explanation_en: Formerly known as DADE, it is an orange crystal, which is basically nonvolatile at room temperature, soluble in dimethyl sulfoxide, dimethyl fumarate, butyrolactone, methyl pyridine ketone, slightly soluble in acetone, and insoluble in water.

explanation_cn: 这是一种白色针状晶体，不吸湿。它溶解于丙酮、甲醇、四氯化碳、环己酮、乙酸乙酯、二甲基甲酰胺、乙腈，微溶于乙醇、二氯甲烷、氯仿，但不溶于水、乙醚、甲苯。由于该化合物的蒸气压较高，从熔融液冷却为固态时，体积变小并且会形成孔隙，孔隙率为10%到12%。它属于氮杂环丁烷硝基衍生物，是四元环化合物，具有很大的分子张力（154.8kJ/mol），赋予含能化合物出色的性能。其密度较大（1.84g/cm3），氧平衡为16.7%，熔点较低（101°C），热安定性良好（大于240°C不分解），生成热为280kJ/kg。爆发点较高（238°C），其热点起爆临界温度也很高（641.5°C)。在真空下的热安定性一般，在110°C到120°C（真空度小于0.133Pa，48小时）下热失重为10%到20%。在密度为1.84g/cm3时，爆速为8730到8800m/s，爆热为1900kJ/kg，爆功率为150%（TNT当量），撞击感度为44%（10kg，25mm），静电感度为8.76J。NAZ具有低的熔点和感度、高能量、液相稳定性良好、易与其他含能材料形成共熔物等优点，因此适用于用作同体推进剂、炸药、发射药等的组分，同时也成功应用于民用安全气囊。另外，对于"斯蒂芬酸铅"的部分，您提到的信息已经相对完整，没有需要修正的内容。如有其他问题或需要进一步的信息，请随时提出。
explanation_en: This is a white needle like crystal, which does not absorb moisture. It is soluble in acetone, methanol, carbon tetrachloride, cyclohexanone, ethyl acetate, dimethylformamide, and acetonitrile, slightly soluble in ethanol, dichloromethane, and chloroform, but insoluble in water, ether, and toluene. Due to the high vapor pressure of this compound, when it cools from the molten liquid to a solid state, its volume decreases and pores form, with a porosity of 10% to 12%. It belongs to the nitro derivative of nitrogen heterocyclic butane and is a quaternary cyclic compound with a high molecular tension (154.8 kJ/mol), endowing energetic compounds with excellent performance. Its density is large (1.84g/cm3), oxygen balance is 16.7%, melting point is low (101 ° C), thermal stability is good (no decomposition above 240 ° C), and heat generated is 280kJ/kg. The explosion tcmperature is high (238 ° C), and the critical temperature of hot spot initiation is also high (641.5 ° C). The thermal stability under vacuum is generally good, with a thermal weight loss of 10% to 20% at 110 ° C to 120 ° C (vacuum degree less than 0.133Pa, 48 hours). When the density is 1.84g/cm3, the detonation velocity is 8730 to 8800m/s, the explosion heat is 1900kJ/kg, the detonation power is 150% (TNT equivalent), the impact sensitivity is 44% (10kg, 25mm), and the electrostatic sensitivity is 8.76J. NAZ has the advantages of low melting point and sensitivity, high energy, good liquid phase stability, and easy to form eutectic with other energetic materials. Therefore, it is suitable for use as a component of homogeneous propellants, explosive, gun propellant, etc., and also successfully used in civil airbags. In addition, for the part of "lead styphnate", the information you mentioned has been relatively complete, and there is no content that needs to be corrected. If you have any other questions or need further information, please feel free to raise them.

explanation_cn: 这是一种有机化合物，通常用于爆炸装置或火药的制备。它的分子结构包括硝基基团，因此具有爆炸性质。
explanation_en: This is an organic compound, usually used for the preparation of explosion devices or propellant. Its molecular structure includes nitro groups, so it has explosion properties.

explanation_cn: 特点是硬度较高，其中以铜元素含量最高，在3%-5%。2xxx系列铝棒属于航空铝材，是航空材料发展史上最早发明的、应用历史最长的中等强度、可热处理强化铝合金，经过长期的不断改进和完善，至今仍广泛用在军民机上。2xxx系铝合金的一个主要特点，即在遭受疲劳、腐蚀、意外或离散源引起的定量损伤后，在一定的使用期内.结构保持其剩余强度的能力就是耐损伤容限性能较好，许多飞机结构件如机翼、机身蒙皮、框、肋以及螺旋桨桨叶等都采用了2xxx系合金。另外，所有2xxx系列铝合金都可以热处理强化，其中不少合金既可人工时效，也可进行自然时效。目前在常规工业中不常应用。
explanation_en: It is characterized by high hardness, among which copper content is the highest, ranging from 3% to 5%. 2xxx series aluminum bars belong to aviation aluminum. They are medium strength, heat treatable and strengthened aluminum alloys that were first invented in the development history of aviation materials and have the longest application history. After long-term continuous improvement and improvement, they are still widely used in military and civilian aircraft. One of the main characteristics of 2xxx series aluminium alloy is that after suffering quantitative damage caused by fatigue, corrosion, accidents or discrete sources, the ability of the structure to maintain its residual strength within a certain service life is good damage tolerance. Many aircraft structural parts such as wings, fuselage skins, frames, ribs and propeller blades use 2xxx series alloy. In addition, all 2xxx series aluminum alloy can be strengthened by heat treatment, and many of them can be artificial aging or naturally aging. Currently, it is not commonly used in conventional industries.

explanation_cn: 无色晶体，但在含有杂质时可能呈白色或淡黄色。它可以溶解在多种有机溶剂中，如丙酮、乙腈、乙酸乙酯、硝基乙烷和二甲基亚砜，但在水中只微溶。它的密度相当高，熔点较低，有较高的爆炸性能。
explanation_en: Colorless crystal, but it may be white or light yellow when containing impurities. It can be dissolved in various organic solvents, such as acetone, acetonitrile, ethyl acetate, nitroethane, and dimethyl sulfoxide, but only slightly soluble in water. Its density is quite high, its melting point is low, and it has high explosion performance.

explanation_cn: 是由锰元素为主要成分，含量在1.0%-1.5%之间.是一款防锈功能较好的系列。3xxx系列铝合金代表3003、3A21为主。
explanation_en: It is mainly composed of manganese element, with a content between 1.0% -1.5%. It is a series with good rust prevention function. The 3xxx series of aluminum alloys mainly represent 3003 and 3A21.

explanation_cn: Fe基超导体家族中的一种，超导转变温度18-19K。
explanation_en: One of the family of Fe based superconductors, with a superconducting transition temperature of 18-19K.

explanation_cn: 属于含硅量较高的系列通常硅含量在4.5%-6.0%之间。属建筑用材料、机械零件锻造用材、焊接材料;低熔点、耐蚀性好。产品描述：具有耐热、耐磨的特性。4xxx系列铝棒代表为4A01。
explanation_en: Belonging to the series with high silicon content, the silicon content is usually between 4.5% -6.0%. It is a building materials, a forging material for mechanical parts, and a welding materials; Low melting point, good corrosion resistance. Product Description: It has characteristics of heat resistance and wear resistance. The representative of the 4xxx series aluminum rod is 4A01.

explanation_cn: 又称铝镁合金。属于较常用的合金铝板系列，主要元素为镁，含镁量在3%-5%之间。主要特点为密度低，抗拉强度高，伸长率高，疲劳强度好.但不可做热处理强化。在相同面积下铝镁合金的质量低于其他系列，在常规工业中应用也较为广泛。在我国5000系列铝板属于较为成熟的铝板系列之一。5xxx系列铝合金代表5052、5005、5083、5A05系列。
explanation_en: Also known as aluminum magnesium alloy. It belongs to the commonly used alloy aluminum plate series. The main element is magnesium, and the magnesium content is between 3% and 5%. The main characteristics are low density, high tensile strength, high elongation and good fatigue strength, but heat treatment strengthening is not allowed. In the same area, the quality of aluminum magnesium alloy is lower than other series, and it is also widely used in conventional industry. The 5000 series aluminum plate is one of the more mature aluminum plate series in China. The 5xxx series aluminum alloy represents the 5052, 5005, 5083, and 5A05 series.

explanation_cn: 主要含有镁和硅两种元素，集中了4xxx系列和5xxx系列的优点。6xxx系列铝合金代表6061是一种冷处理铝锻造产品，适用于对抗腐蚀性、氧化性要求高的应用。可使用性好，容易涂层，加工性好。
explanation_en: Mainly containing magnesium and silicon, it combines the advantages of the 4xxx and 5xxx series. 6xxx series aluminum alloy representative 6061 is a sub-zero treatment aluminum forging product, which is suitable for applications requiring high corrosion resistance and oxidation resistance. Good usability, easy coating, and good processability.

explanation_cn: 是铝镁锌铜合金，是可热处理合金.属于超硬铝合金，有良好的耐磨性，也有良好的焊接性，但耐腐蚀性较差。7xxx系列铝合金代表7075主要含有锌元素。
explanation_en: It is an aluminum magnesium zinc copper alloy and a heat treatable alloy. It is a super-hard aluminium alloy with good wear resistance and weldability, but poor corrosion resistance. The 7xxx series aluminum alloy represents 7075, which mainly contains zinc.

explanation_cn: 该材料含有骨灰石（apatite）和沃拉斐石（wollastonite）两种结晶相的特定组成的玻璃陶瓷磷灰石微晶赋予其生物活性，使其能与自然骨形成骨键合，其界面结合强度达13MPa,显示了较好的生物活性。A-W生物活性玻璃已用于骨缺损修复以及人工关节、人工齿根、椎骨、颅骨和颌骨等修复体。
explanation_en: The materials contains glass-ceramics apatite microcrystals with specific composition of two crystalline phases, namely, apatite and wollastonite, which endow it with bioactivity and enable it to form bone bonding with natural bone. Its interfacial bonding strength reaches 13MPa, showing good bioactivity. A-W bioactive glass has been used to repair bone defects and prosthesis such as artificial joint, artificial tooth root, vertebra, skull and jaw.

explanation_cn: 又称 A-W 生物活性微晶玻璃，该材料含有骨灰石（apatite）和沃拉斐石（wollastonite）两种结晶相的特定组成的玻璃陶瓷磷灰石微晶赋予其生物活性，使其能与自然骨形成骨键合，其界面结合强度达13MPa,显示了较好的生物活性。A-W生物活性玻璃已用于骨缺损修复以及人工关节、人工齿根、椎骨、颅骨和颌骨等修复体。
explanation_en: Also known as A-W bioactive crystallite glass, this materials contains glass-ceramics apatite microcrystals with specific composition of two crystalline phases, namely, apatite and wollastonite, which endow it with bioactivity and enable it to form bone bonding with natural bone. Its interfacial bonding strength reaches 13MPa, showing good bioactivity. A-W bioactive glass has been used to repair bone defects and prosthesis such as artificial joint, artificial tooth root, vertebra, skull and jaw.

explanation_cn: A15结构超导体，具有类似A15（A3B）型化合物的晶体结构，典型的A15结构超导体包括Nb3Sn、NbAl、Nb3Ge、V3Si和V3Ga等。这些材料是重要的低温超导体，特别适用于强磁场应用。它们具有典型的晶界磁通钉扎特性，但通常在加工性能方面存在一些问题，而且超导性能对应力和应变的敏感性较高。
explanation_en: A15-structure superconductor has a crystal structure similar to A15 (A3B) compound. Typical A15-structure superconductor include Nb3Sn, NbAl, Nb3Ge, V3Si and V3Ga. These materials are important low-temperature superconductors, especially suitable for high magnetic field applications. They have typical grain boundary flux pinning characteristics, but there are usually some problems in processing performance, and superconductivity is highly sensitive to stress and strain.

explanation_cn: A2B7型Laves相合金是一类由两种不同元素组成的金属间化合物，其化学式通常为A2B7。这类Laves相合金具有特定的晶体结构，属于金属间化合物，通常具有良好的高温热稳定性和机械性能。这些合金的化学成分使它们在高温高压下表现出卓越的性能，因此在高温应用中具有潜在的用途。在A2B7型Laves相合金中，A和B代表不同的金属元素。这些合金的晶体结构通常是六角晶系的，并且具有复杂的原胞结构。这使得它们在高温下具有稳定的性能，因此在高温应用中非常有价值。总的来说，A2B7型Laves相合金是一类重要的金属间化合物，它们的独特结构和性能使它们在高温高压环境下具有广泛的应用前景，例如在航空航天、能源、化工等领域。
explanation_en: A2B7 type Laves phase alloy is a kind of imermetallif compound composed of two different elements, and its chemical formula is usually A2B7. These Laves phase alloys have specific crystal structure, belong to imermetallif compound, and generally have good high-temperature thermal stability and mechanical properties. The chemical composition of these alloy makes them exhibit excellent performance under high temperature and pressure, so they have potential applications in high temperature applications. In A2B7 type Laves phase alloy, A and B represent different metal elements. The crystal structure of these alloy is usually hexagonal system, and has complex cell structure. This enables them to have stable performance at high temperatures, making them highly valuable in high-temperature applications. In general, A2B7 type Laves phase alloy are a class of important imermetallif compound. Their unique structure and properties make them have broad application prospects in high-temperature and high-pressure environments, such as aerospace, energy, chemical and other fields.

explanation_cn: Laves相合金是一类储氢合金，其化学式通常为AB2型或ABz型，分为钛基和锆基两大类。这些合金具有不同的晶体结构，主要为MgZn型（C14）和C15型（C15）结构。在锆基AB2型Laves相储氢合金中，主要包括以下几个系列：Zr-V系：含锆和钒的组合，用于氢储存。Zr-Cr系：含锆和铬的组合，也可用于氢储存。Zr-Mn系：含锆和锰的组合，适用于储氢合金。在钛基AB2型Laves相储氢合金中，主要包括以下两个系列：TiMn基储氢合金：含钛和锰的组合，用于氢储存。TiCr基储氢合金：含钛和铬的组合，同样适用于储氢合金。这些AB2型Laves相储氢合金通常具有一些优点，如较高的放电容量（储氢量约1.8%）和良好的电化学循环稳定性。然而，它们也存在一些缺点，包括初期活化性能较差、自放电较大和制备成本较高。因此，研究工作主要集中在改善其活化性能、提高高倍率放电能力、提高综合性能等方面。这些改进可以通过多元合金化、非化学计量、表面处理、制备工艺和复合化等方法来实现。
explanation_en: Laves phase alloy is a kind of hydrogen storage alloy. Its chemical formula is usually AB2 or ABz, which can be divided into titanium based and zirconium based. These alloy have different crystal structure, mainly MgZn type (C14) and C15 type (C15) structures. In zirconium based AB2 Laves phase hydrogen storage alloys, there are mainly the following series: Zr-V series: combinations containing zirconium and vanadium, used for hydrogen storage. Zr Cr system: a combination of zirconium and chromium, which can also be used for hydrogen storage. Zr Mn system: a combination of zirconium and manganese, suitable for hydrogen storage alloy. In titanium based AB2 Laves phase hydrogen storage alloys, there are mainly two series: TiMn based hydrogen storage alloys: a combination containing titanium and manganese, used for hydrogen storage. TiCr based hydrogen storage alloy: the combination of titanium and chromium is also applicable to hydrogen storage alloy. These AB2 Laves phase hydrogen storage alloy usually have some advantages, such as high discharge capacity (about 1.8% hydrogen storage) and good electrochemical cycle stability. However, they also have some disadvantages, including poor initial activation or conditioning performance, large self-discharge and high preparation cost. Therefore, the research work mainly focuses on improving its activation or conditioning performance, enhancing its high rate discharge capability, and improving its comprehensive performance. These improvements can be achieved by multi element alloy, non stoichiometry, surface treatment, preparation process and composite methods.

explanation_cn: 有TiFe系与TiNi系合金两类，TiFe合金是其典型代表。TiFe合金活化后在室温下即能可逆吸放大量的氢，理论储氢量为1.86%,室温下的平衡氢压为0.3MPa.很接近工业应用，且价格便宜、资源丰富，在工业生产中占有一定优势。但也存在活化困难、抗杂质气体中毒能力差、反复吸放氢后性能下降等缺点。AB型TiNi系合金主要用作电池负极材料，但可逆容量小、循环寿命偏低，因而没有得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: There are two types of TiFe system and TiNi system alloy, and TiFe alloy is a typical representative. After activation or conditioning, TiFe alloy can absorb and release a large amount of hydrogen reversibly at room temperature. The theoretical hydrogen storage capacity is 1.86%, and the equilibrium hydrogen pressure at room temperature is 0.3MPa. It is very close to industrial application, cheap, rich in resources, and has certain advantages in industrial production. But there are also some shortcomings such as difficulty in activation or conditioning, poor resistance to impurity gas poisoning, and performance degradation after repeated hydrogen absorption and desorption. AB type TiNi series alloy is mainly used as the anode materials of batteries, but its small reversible capacity and low cycle life have not been widely used.

explanation_cn: 又称原子层沉积源。原子层沉积是一种最近在超大规模集成电路器件制备中广泛使用的生长薄膜新技术。原子层沉积源和MOCVD源有很多相似之处，同属于高纯电子材料，纯度高达6N甚至7N。主要有无机源、金属有机源及有机金属源。通常经过化学合成、纯化、分析和包装等步骤制备.需要使用光洁度很高的不锈钢包装容器。大多数具有腐蚀性，遇空气、遇水分解、甚至爆炸、自燃。必须具备一定的挥发性。
explanation_en: It is also called atomic layer deposition source. Atomic layer deposition is a new technology for growing thin films that has been widely used in the preparation of ultra large scale integrated circuit devices recently. Atomic layer deposition source and metal organic chemical vapor deposition sources have many similarities, both belong to high-purity electronic materials, with purity as high as 6N or even 7N. There are mainly inorganic sources, metal organic sources, and organic metal sources. It is usually prepared through chemical synthesis, purification, analysis, packaging and other steps, and needs to use stainless steel packaging containers with high finish. Most of them are corrosive, decomposing in case of air or water, or even explosion or spontaneous combustion. Must have a certain degree of volatility.

explanation_cn: 快速凝固Al-FeV-Si合金是由美国Allied-Signal铝业公司采用平面流铸造法研究开发的，是目前研制最为成熟的高性能耐热铝合金，其中FVS0611、FVS0812和FVS1212合金，已应用于航空航天领域，可满足先进航天航空飞行器对高比强、高比刚、耐高温轻质结构材料提出的需求。
explanation_en: Rapid solidification Al FeV Si alloy was developed by Allied Signal Aluminum Company in the United States by using the plane flow foundry method. It is the most mature high-performance heat-resistant aluminum alloy currently developed. FVS0611, FVS0812 and FVS1212 alloy have been applied in the aerospace field, and can meet the requirements of advanced aerospace vehicles for high specific strength, high specific rigidity, high temperature resistant and lightweight structural materials.

explanation_cn: Mg作为主要合金元素.含量在4%-11%的铸造铝合金。Mg的加入使合金具有良好的力学性能，最好的抗腐蚀性能和机械加工性能，加工后表面光亮美观;由于Mg的密度小，故这类合金的密度较其他系铸造铝合金的密度小;该系合金具有自然时效倾向。由于Mg极易氧化烧损，该合金熔炼和铸造工艺较复杂，除用作耐腐蚀合金外，也用于做装饰合金。
explanation_en: As the main alloy element, Mg is a cast aluminium alloy with the content of 4% -11%. The addition of Mg makes the alloy have good mechanical properties, the best corrosion resistance and machining performance, and the surface is bright and beautiful after processing; Because the density of Mg is small, the density of this kind of alloy is smaller than the density of other cast aluminium alloy; This alloy has a natural aging tendency. Because Mg is very easy to be oxidized and burned, the melting and foundry processes of this alloy are more complex. It is used as a corrosion resistant alloy and also as a decorative alloy.

explanation_cn: 析出硬比型永磁体，主要包括Fe-Ni-Al和Fe-Ni-Al-Co合金系。该类磁体靠析出相的形状各向异性产生矫顽力。因合金含有少量钴或不含钴，磁场热处理无效，磁体为磁各向同性的，性能较低。铝镍钴磁体温度稳定性和时效稳定性均好，适于制作仪器仪表、电机、电声器件、磁力机械等。
explanation_en: Precipitated hard ratio permanent magnets mainly include Fe Ni Al and Fe Ni Al Co alloy systems. This kind of magnet produces coercive force by the shape anisotropy of precipitated phase. Since alloy contains a small amount of cobalt or no cobalt, the magnetic field heat treatment is invalid, and the magnet is magnetic isotropic with low performance. Al Ni Co magnets have good temperature stability and aging stability, and are suitable for making instruments, motors, electroacoustic devices, magnetic machinery, etc.

explanation_cn: 用微量Sc(0.07%-0.35%，质量分数）合金化的铝合金称为Al-Sc合金或含Sc的铝合金。与不含Sc的同类合金相比，Al-Sc合金强度高、塑韧性好、耐蚀性能和焊接性能优异，是继Al-Li合金之后的新一代航天、航空、舰船用轻质结构材料。产品主要为航天、航空、舰船的焊接荷重结构件以及碱性腐浊介质环境用的铝合金管材、铁路油罐、高速列车关键结构件等。
explanation_en: Aluminum alloy alloy with trace Sc (0.07% -0.35%, mass fraction) is called Al Sc alloy or aluminum alloy containing Sc. Compared with similar alloy without Sc, Al SC alloy has high strength, good plasticity and toughness, excellent corrosion resistance and weld performance. It is a new generation of lightweight structural materials for aerospace, aviation and naval ships after Al Li alloy. The products are mainly weld load structural parts for aerospace, aviation and naval ships, as well as aluminum alloy tube for alkaline corrosive medium environment, railway oil tanks, key structural parts for high-speed trains, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称硅铝明，Si含量一般在4%-22%。该合金中由于加入了大量的Si而具有优良的铸造工艺性能和气密性，经过变质处理和热处理之后，具有良好的力学性能、物理性能、耐腐蚀性能和中等的切削加工性能，是铸造铝合金中品种最多、用途最广的合金系。
explanation_en: Also known as silicoaluminate, the Si content is generally between 4% -22%. This alloy has excellent foundry process performance and air tightness due to the addition of a large amount of Si. After modification treatment and heat treatment, it has good mechanical properties, physical properties, corrosion resistance and medium cutting processing performance. It is the alloy series with the most varieties and most widely used cast aluminium alloy.

explanation_cn: 是开发应用最早的第一代铸造铝合金，Zn在Al中的溶解度大（在共晶温度382°C时可达到82%)。当A1中加人Zn元素大于10%时，能显著提高合金的强度，该类合金有自然时效的倾向，铸造后不需要热处理能得到较高的强度。该系合金具有很好的室温性能，好的强度和初性;缺点是耐热性差、耐腐蚀性能差、易产生比重偏析、密度大，铸造时易产生热裂缺陷。主要用于压铸仪表壳体类铸件。
explanation_en: It is the first generation of cast aluminium alloy that was first developed and applied. The water solubility of Zn in Al is large (82% at eutectic temperature of 382 ° C). When the addition of Zn element in A1 is more than 10%, the strength of alloy can be significantly improved. This kind of alloy has the tendency of natural aging, and can obtain higher strength without heat treatment after foundry. This series of alloy have good room temperature properties, good strength and initial properties; The disadvantages are poor heat resistance, poor corrosion resistance, easy to produce specific gravity segregation, high density, and easy to produce hot tear defects when foundry. Mainly used for die-casting instrument shell castings.

explanation_cn: 由黑索今与少量钝感剂组成的混合炸药，即钝化黑索金。有A、A-2、A-3、A-4、A-5数种，其组成的区别在于钝感剂的种类和用量不同，如A系蜂蜡钝感的黑索今，A-3、A-4均为石蜡钝化的黑索金，但前者的石蜡含量为9%±0.7%,后者的石蜡含量为3.0%±0.5%。中国的钝化黑索今含有5%-6%的钝感剂（蜡类）及少量染色剂。机械感度显著低于黑索今，便于压制成型，并具有良好的爆炸性能，是一种应用十分广泛的军用混合炸药，常用于装填碎甲弹和破甲弹，也用作传爆药，还用于制造含铝混合炸药。
explanation_en: Composite explosive composed of RDX and a small amount of deterrent, namely passivation hexogen. There are A, A-2, A-3, A-4, A-5. The difference in composition lies in the different types and amounts of deterrent. For example, A-3, A-4 are both hexogen, which is insensitive to beeswax. A-3 and A-4 are both paraffin passivation RDX, but the paraffin content of the former is 9% ± 0.7%, and the paraffin content of the latter is 3.0% ± 0.5%. I-RDX in China contains 5% -6% deterrent (wax) and a small amount of dye. The mechanical sensitivity is significantly lower than that of RDX, which is convenient for pressing and forming, and has good explosion performance. It is a very widely used military composite explosive, commonly used for loading armour breakers and armour breakers, also used as booster explosive, and also used to manufacture aluminized composite explosive.

explanation_cn: BCS理论是以近自由电子模型为基础，是在电子－声子作用很弱的前提下建立起来的理论。BCS理论是解释常规超导体的超导电性的微观理论。
explanation_en: BCS theory is based on the near free electron model, which is established on the premise of weak electron phonon interaction. BCS theory is a microscopic theory to explain the superconductivity of conventional superconductors.

explanation_cn: 由黑索今和梯恩梯组成的熔铸混合炸药，美国分为和赛克洛托儿（cy-clotol)两种类型，俄罗斯的TT炸药和中国的黑梯炸药即。其既保持了黑索今髙能量的特点，又保持有梯恩梯可用蒸汽熔化浇铸的良好成型性，是常规武器最重要的炸药装药。其缺点是药柱脆性大，易缩孔、裂纹和渗油，同时产生不可逆膨胀。用于装填杀伤弹、爆破弹、破甲弹、导弹战斗部、航空炸弹和水中兵器。
explanation_en: The melting and casting composite explosive composed of RDX and 2,4,6-trinitrotoluene is divided into two types in the United States, namely, TT explosive from Russia and black ladder explosive explosive from China. It not only maintains the characteristics of Hexogen's high energy, but also maintains the good formability of 2,4,6-trinitrotoluene's steam melting casting. It is the most important explosive charge for conventional weapons. Its disadvantage is that the grain is brittle, easy to shrinkage hole, crack and oil seepage, and irreversible expansion occurs at the same time. Used for loading anti-personnel shells, explosive shells, armor piercing shells, missile warheads, aerial bombs, and underwater weapons.

explanation_cn: 由单质猛炸药.如黑索今、奥克托今及太安，及适量增塑剂和黏结剂组成的塑性炸药。采用溶液水悬浮法、捏合法、聚合法、挥发法混合或造粒。主要用于反坦克破甲弹、漂雷及爆破工程。
explanation_en: Plastic explosive composed of simple explosive such as RDX, octogen and penthrite, and appropriate plasticizer and adhesive. Solution water suspension method, kneading method, polymerization method and volatilization method are used for mixing or granulation. Mainly used in anti tank armor piercing shells, drift mines, and blasting engineering.

name_en: densified system containing homogeneous arranged ultra-fine particle cement
explanation_cn: 它是一种由70%至80%水泥和20%至30%平均尺寸仅为0.1至0.2微米的超细颗粒组成的高密度致密材料，其抗压强度高达270MPa，抗张强度为30MPa。通常用作建筑材料和模具材料。
explanation_en: It is a high density dense materials composed of 70% to 80% cement and 20% to 30% ultra-fine particles with an average size of only 0.1 to 0.2 microns. Its compressive strength is up to 270MPa, and its tensile strength is 30MPa. It is usually used as building materials and mold materials.

explanation_cn: DU材料是指以塑料为固体润滑剂的滑动减摩材料。将粗铜颗粒烧结在镀铜钢板上，用粉未轧制方法将氟塑料PTFE压入在钢板上的铜颗粒间的孔隙内，经固化处理后，即制成了具有自润滑性能的DU材料。
explanation_en: DU materials refers to sliding antifriction materials with plastics as solid lubricant. The coarse copper particles are sintering on the copper plated steel plate, and the fluorine plastics PTFE is pressed into the pores between the copper particles on the steel plate by the powder rolling method. After curing, the DU materials with self-lubricating property is made.

explanation_cn: 是一种特殊类型的钛合金。它以其低杂质含量和高纯度而著称，通常用于医疗和生物工程领域，其中高纯度和低杂质对于生物相容性至关重要。
explanation_en: It is a special type of titanium alloy. It is famous for its low impurity content and high purity, and is usually used in medical and bioengineering fields. High purity and low impurity are critical for biocompatibility.

explanation_cn: 又名乙烯-醋酸乙烯共聚（EVA)胶黏剂。主体树脂EVA是由乙烯和醋酸乙烯高压本体聚合法或溶液聚合法聚合而成的，它的物理性能中树脂分子量、分子量分布、醋酸乙烯的含量等因素决定。其特点是对各种材料有良好的粘接性、柔软性和低温性，而且EVA与各种配方组成的混溶性良好。通过配合技术，可制得各种性能的胶黏剂。EVA胶黏剂已使用于聚丙烯管、聚乙烯钙塑管、薄膜、注塑件、聚丙烯编织覆膜机、洗衣机、聚丙烯洗衣桶与ABS排水阀粘接、书籍无线装订、扬声器引出线、放灰罩和小纸盆、冷库密封、冷藏食品包装、蓄电池壳密封、陶器文物修复、塑料铭牌粘贴、纸板箱包装等。
explanation_en: Also known as ethylene vinyl acetate copolymer (EVA) adhesive. The main resin EVA is polymerization by high-pressure bulk polymerization or solution polymerization of ethylene and vinyl acetate. Its physical properties are determined by resin molecular weight, molecular weight distribution, vinyl acetate content and other factors. It is characterized by good adhesiveness, softness and low-temperature performance to various materials, and good miscibility of EVA and various formulations. Adhesive with various properties can be prepared by matching technology. EVA adhesives has been used in polypropylene pipes, polyethylene calcium plastic pipes, films, injection molded parts, polypropylene woven film covering machines, washing machines, bonding polypropylene washing buckets with ABS drain valves, wireless book binding, speaker leads, ash hoods and small paper basins, cold storage sealing, refrigerated food packaging, battery case sealing, pottery cultural relics restoration, plastics nameplate pasting, carton packaging, etc.

explanation_cn: 涤纶切片培体过滤器商品名。它由球化的铜基合金粉末经过混合、成形和烧结而制成。这些过滤器具有规则孔隙形状，球形颗粒，孔径相近，以及连通孔道较多。由于这些特点，它们表现出低过滤阻力和长寿命。FC合金过滤介质的主要特性包括最高使用温度小于700°C，连通孔率高于90%，以及孔径均匀度在5到10微米之间。过滤精度可在R25（25微米）至R100（100微米）范围内变化，而其形状和尺寸的变化与过滤精度无关。这些过滤器通常分为短管状滤芯和圆片状滤片两种类型。短管状滤芯主要用于直接去除熔体中的杂质。而圆片状滤片则用于支承海砂（SC砂）等颗粒物质，并且可以用于过滤已经去除大颗粒杂质的熔体。涤纶切片熔体滤芯采用FC合金滤芯和过滤器，使用球形颗粒作为原料。这种材料解决了不锈钢过滤器所面临的问题，因为球形不锈钢粉末的塑性较差，难以成形和烧结。因此，FC合金滤芯和滤片对抗高温熔体的腐蚀具有独特的性能，过滤效果优于不锈钢制品。
explanation_en: Trade name of polyester slice culture filter. It is made of spheroidized copper base alloy powder through mixing, forming and sintering. These filters have regular pore shapes, spherical particles, similar pore sizes, and many connected channels. Due to these characteristics, they exhibit low filtration resistance and long lifespan. The main characteristics of FC alloy filter media include that the maximum operating temperature is less than 700 ° C, the connected porosity is higher than 90%, and the aperture uniformity is between 5 and 10 microns. The filtration accuracy can vary from R25 (25 microns) to R100 (100 microns), and the changes in shape and size are independent of the filtration accuracy. These filters are usually divided into two types: short tube shaped filter elements and circular filter discs. Short tube filter elements are mainly used to directly remove impurities from the melt. The disc filter is used to support sea sand (SC sand) and other granular materials, and can be used to filter the melt that has removed large particle impurities. Polyester chip melt filter element adopts FC alloy filter element and filter, and uses spherical particles as raw materials. This materials solves the problems faced by stainless steel filters because spherical stainless steel powder has poor plasticity and is difficult to form and sintering. Therefore, FC alloy filter element and filter piece have unique performance against corrosion of high-temperature melt, and the filtering effect is superior to stainless steel products.

explanation_cn: 在Fe-Al二元相图中包含了5个金属间化合物，其中Fe3Al和FeAl是备受关注的。Fe3Al具有面心立方有序结构，高熔点，相对较低的密度，能够在高温、氧化和硫化环境中形成保护层，并且在强度和抗腐蚀性能方面优于耐热不锈钢。研究表明，添加合金元素可以显著改善Fe3Al的机械性能。例如，适量的Nb元素可以沉淀析出t'相结构，提高屈服强度约50%。此外，微量的Mg添加可以明显改善Fe3Al合金的室温塑性，这使得它在汽车工业和能源行业等领域具有实际应用前景。另一方面，FeAl合金具有B2有序结构，具有较宽的成分和温度范围，可以固溶适量的第三元素以改善其机械性能。1990年首次观察到FeAl合金具有反常屈服行为，其机理与滑移方向的变化有关，低温条件下滑移方向（U11）占主导地位，而在较高温度下发生U00相变。进一步研究证实了FeAl合金的反常屈服行为，同时提出了在中温范围内发生的空位强化和在高温下发生的空位促使位错蠕变这两种机制，从而产生了反常屈服行为。由于FeAl合金具有高强度、优异的抗腐蚀性能、低密度和经济的特点，它有望在航空航天工业、汽车工业以及煤的气化、液化和燃烧系统等领域得到应用。
explanation_en: Five imermetallif compound are included in the Fe Al binary phase diagram, of which Fe3Al and FeAl are of great concern. Fe3Al has a face centered cubic ordered structure, high melting point and relatively low density. It can form a protective layer in high temperature, oxidation and vulcanization environments, and is superior to heat-resistant stainless steel in strength and corrosion resistance. The results show that the addition of alloy elements can significantly improve the mechanical properties of Fe3Al. For example, an appropriate amount of Nb element can precipitation and precipitate t 'phase structure, which increases the yield strength by about 50%. In addition, trace Mg addition can significantly improve the room temperature plasticity of Fe3Al alloy, which makes it have practical application prospects in the automotive industry and energy industry. On the other hand, FeAl alloy has B2 ordered structure, has a wide range of composition and temperature, and can solve appropriate amount of the third element to improve its mechanical properties. The abnormal yield behavior of FeAl alloy was observed for the first time in 1990, and its mechanism is related to the change of slip direction. The slip direction (U11) is dominant at low temperature, and U00 phase transformation occurs at high temperature. Further research confirmed the abnormal yield behavior of FeAl alloy, and proposed two mechanisms: vacancy strengthening in the middle temperature range and vacancy promoting dislocation creep at high temperature, which resulted in the abnormal yield behavior. Due to its high strength, excellent corrosion resistance, low density and economic characteristics, FeAl alloy is expected to be applied in aerospace industry, automobile industry, coal gasification, liquefaction and combustion systems.

explanation_cn: 碱金属卤化物中负离子空位俘获一个电子所形成的一种典型色心。例如将氯化钠晶体在钠蒸气中加热，原来透明晶体在透射光下呈黄色，即在接近可见光谱的蓝端产生了吸收，称为F带。这些光学吸收中心便是F心，由一个负卤素离子空位俘获一个电子构成。F带的宽度和精确位置随温度变化。这是F心周围离子热运动的结果。对F带形状的细致研究表明，F心具有多个在晶体导带以下的激发态。一些F心详细资料来自电子自旋共振和电子-核双共振实验。由此得到被俘电子波函数的范围和性质。结果表明，即使电子处于基态，其波函数也会扩展到邻近六个正离子甚至更远区域，
explanation_en: A typical color centers formed by the capture of an electron by a negative ion vacancy in an alkali halide. For example, when sodium chloride crystal is heated in sodium vapor, the original transparent crystal is yellow under transmission light, that is, absorption occurs at the blue end close to the visible spectrum, which is called F-band. These optical absorption centers are F-centre, which are composed of an electron captured by a negative halogen ion vacancy. The width and precise position of the F-band vary with temperature. This is the result of the thermal movement of ions around the F-centre. The detailed study of the shape of the F-band shows that the F-centre has several excited states below the conduction band of the crystal. Some detailed information about F-centre comes from electron spin resonance and electron nuclear double resonance experiments. From this, the range and properties of the captured electron wave function are obtained. The results indicate that even if the electron is in the ground state, its wave function will extend to the adjacent six positive ions or even further regions,

explanation_cn: 某些合金系的过饱和固溶体白发生脱溶之始，在某些特定晶面上形成的溶质原子偏聚区。如Al-Cu合金自然时效和低温（<150°C)入丁。时效形成的锏原子的偏聚区。Al-Cu合金在低温时效。过饱和固溶体分解的第一步是铜原子（溶质）在（001)面上偏聚。形成一个由纯铜原子组成的单原子平面-其直径随时效温度而异。
explanation_en: The atomic segregation region of solute formed on certain specific crystal planes at the beginning of the supersaturated solid solution of some alloy. For example, Al Cu alloy is naturally aging and inserted at low temperature (<150 ° C). The segregation region of mace atoms formed by aging. Al Cu alloy is aging at low temperature. The first step of supersaturated solid solution decomposition is the segregation of copper atoms (solutes) on the (001) surface. A monatomic plane composed of pure copper atoms is formed - its diameter varies with aging temperature.

explanation_cn: Hall-Petch关系是指表示低碳钢的下屈服点与铁素体晶粒大小的关系。用位错受晶界阻挡形成塞积群，当塞积群中领头位错受到的应力达到某一数值可将相邻晶粒中的位错源开动时即构成屈服条件，与此应力对应的外力即屈服点，由此模型出发导出了屈服强度与晶粒直经的平方根成反比的关系此关系不仅适用于下屈服点，也适用于流变应力，断裂应力。
explanation_en: The Hall-Petch relationship refers to the relationship between the lower yield point of low carbon steel and the ferrite grain size. The dislocation is blocked by the grain boundary to form a pileup group. When the stress on the leading dislocation in the pileup group reaches a certain value, the dislocation source in the adjacent grain can be activated to form a yield condition. The external force corresponding to this stress is the yield point. From this model, the relationship between the yield strength and the square root of the straight diameter of the grain is inversely proportional. This relationship is not only applicable to the lower yield point, but also to the flow stress and fracture stress.

explanation_cn: 合金相的形成规律，主要涉及的是固溶体和电子化合物。由英国冶金学家休姆-罗瑟里（W.Hum^Rothery)根据实验建立的一些经验规律，后经能带理论进行一定的阐明及适当的修正与补充，可概述为：①当组元原子尺寸差小于14%?15%时，有利于形成较大固溶度（溶解度极限）的固溶体；大于15%时则不利于固溶；大于41%时.有利于形成填隙固溶体；②高价组元在低价组元中的固溶度大于低价组元在高价组元中的固溶度，此规律通称为相对价效应（relativevalenceeffect);③在以一价金属为溶剂的[S|溶体中，溶质的价数越高，则其固溶度越小；④当合金系出现中间相时，中间相的稳定性越大，则与之共存的固溶体的固溶度越小；⑤固溶体的稳定性主要取决于其电子浓度。平均每个原子所具有的价电数超过一定的电子浓度后，即不能再溶入溶质了；⑥一些中间相的形成主要取决于电子浓度，这些相即称为电子化合物。只有当电子浓度达到一定值后，它们才会形成，并与一定的晶体结构相对应。
explanation_en: The formation law of alloy phase mainly involves solid solution and electron compound. According to some empirical laws established by British metallurgist W. Hum ^ Rothery based on experiments, and further clarified and appropriately corrected and supplemented by energy band theory, it can be summarized as follows: ① When the difference in atomic size of a component is less than 14%? 15% is favorable for forming solid solution with larger solid solubility (water solubility limit); When it is greater than 15%, it is not conducive to solid solution; When it is greater than 41%, it is conducive to the formation of interstitial solid solution; ② The solid solubility of the high valence component in the low valence component is greater than the solid solubility of the low valence component in the high valence component, which is generally called the relative valence effect; ③ In the solvent of monovalent metal [S | In the solution, the higher the valence number of the solute, the smaller its solid solubility; ④ When the alloy system appears intermediate phase, the greater the stability of intermediate phase, the smaller the solid solubility of the solid solution coexisting with it; ⑤ The stability of solid solution mainly depends on its electron concentration. After the average valence number of each atom exceeds a certain electron concentration, the solute can no longer be dissolved; ⑥ The formation of some intermediate phase mainly depends on the electron concentration, which The phase is called electron compound. Only when the electron concentration reaches a certain value can they form and correspond to a certain crystal structure.

explanation_cn: 断面形状为H形的型钢。截面模数较大，相同截面积条件下可承受较大的弯扭载荷和复杂载荷，用于工程结构可明显节约材料并降低自重。与I型钢的主要区别是其翼缘内外侧相互平行且各个部位均成直角拼装连接成各种构件较为方便，可节约焊接或铆接工作量。（GB/T1 1263-2010)可分为宽翼缘(HW)、中翼缘（HM)、窄翼缘（HN)、薄壁(HT)和桩类（HP)。的钢种为非合金结构钢和低合金高强度钢.主要采用专门的轧机生产。常用于要求承载较大、截面稳定性高的大型桥梁、高层建筑、重型设备、高速公路、机场、基础桩、支架等工程结构。
explanation_en: The section shape is H-shaped section steel. With large section modulus, it can bear large bending and torsion loads and complex loads under the same section area. It can obviously save materials and reduce self weight when used in engineering structures. The main difference from I section steel is that the inner and outer sides of its flange are parallel to each other and all parts are assembled at right angles to form various components, which is convenient and can save weld or riveting workload. (GB/T11263-2010) can be divided into wide flange (HW), medium flange (HM), narrow flange (HN), thin-walled (HT), and pile type (HP). The steel grades of the steel are non alloy structural steel and low alloy high strength steel, which are mainly produced by special rolling mill. It is often used in large bridges, high-rise buildings, heavy equipment, highways, airports, foundation piles, stem and other engineering structures that require large bearing capacity and high section stability.

explanation_cn: 将帘线两端按规定长度埋入两橡胶块中，测定把单根帘线从硫化胶块中抽出时所需要的力。其原理是通过测定单根帘线从硫化橡胶块中抽出所需要的力来评估纤维帘线与橡胶之间的黏结性能。试验中所测得的黏合力是作用在橡胶与帘线之间的剪切力值，因为两侧的橡胶试块与中间连接的帘线构成的试样形似字母"H".试验方法故此得名。
explanation_en: Bury both ends of the cord into two rubber blocks according to the specified length, and measure the force required to extract a single cord from the vulcanized rubber block. The principle is to evaluate the adhesion between fiber cord and rubber by measuring the force required for a single cord to be pulled out of the vulcanized rubber block. The adhesive force measured in the test is the shear force acting between rubber and cord, because the test sample formed by the rubber test blocks on both sides and the cord connected in the middle is like the letter "H". The test method is named for this reason.

explanation_cn: 镍-镉和镍-氢电池标准循环寿命测试。
explanation_en: Standard cycle life test for nickel cadmium and nickel hydrogen batteries.

name_en: liquid crystal for IPS (in plane switching)
explanation_cn: 平面转换技术（In-Plane Switching，IPS）是一种液晶面板技术，最早由日立制作所于1995年发布，1996年进入实际生产阶段。随着技术的不断革新，IPS技术经历了多个改进版本，包括SuperIPS、Advanced-SuperIPS，直到2004年推出了最新一代IPS液晶面板技术。IPS面板的最显著特点是其两极电极位于同一平面上，而不像其他液晶模式，它们的电极位于上下两个不同的平面上，呈立体排列。由于电极位于同一平面上，液晶分子在任何状态下都与屏幕平行，这可以降低开口率，减少透光率。因此，在使用IPS技术的LCD电视上，通常需要更多的背光灯来实现足够的亮度。总的来说，IPS技术在提供更广泛的视角和更好的色彩准确性方面具有优势，但也需要更多的背光灯来弥补透光率的降低。这种技术在液晶显示领域有广泛的应用，尤其在要求高色彩准确性和视角稳定性的应用中表现出色。
explanation_en: In Plane Switching (IPS) is a liquid crystal panel technology that was first released by Hitachi in 1995 and entered the actual production phase in 1996. With the continuous innovation of technology, IPS technology has experienced several improved versions, including SuperIPS and Advanced SuperIPS, until the latest generation of liquid crystal for IPS (in plane switching) LCD panel technology was introduced in 2004. The most prominent feature of IPS panels is that their two electrodes are located on the same plane, unlike other liquid crystal modes where their electrodes are arranged in a three-dimensional manner on two different planes. Since the electrodes are on the same plane, the liquid crystal molecules are parallel to the screen in any state, which can reduce the opening rate and transmittance. Therefore, on LCD TVs using IPS technology, more backlights are usually required to achieve sufficient brightness. In general, IPS technology has advantages in providing a broader perspective and better color accuracy, but it also needs more backlights to compensate for the reduction of transmittance. This technology has a wide range of applications in the field of liquid crystal displays, especially in applications that require high color accuracy and perspective stability.

explanation_cn: 是指在表面镀制有ITO透明导电膜的玻璃，是透明导电氧化物玻璃的一个重要分支。
explanation_en: It refers to glass coated with ITO transparent conductive film, and is an important branch of transparent conductive oxide glass.

explanation_cn: ITO薄膜是一种n型半导体材料，具有高的导电率、高的可见光透过率、高的机械硬度和良好的化学稳定性。它是液晶显示器（LCD）、等离子显示器（PDP）、电致发光显示器（EL/OLED）、触摸屏（TouchPanel）、太阳能电池以及其他电子仪表的透明电极最常用的薄膜材料。
explanation_en: ITO film is an n-type semiconductor materials with high conductivity, high visible light transmittance, high mechanical hardness and good chemical stability. It is the most commonly used film materials for transparent electrode of LCD, PDP, electroluminescence, TouchPanel, solar cell and other electronic instruments.

explanation_cn: 参见软模。
explanation_en: See soft mode.

explanation_cn: 超晶格材料是指由两种不同组分的薄层，每一层都在纳米到几十纳米的尺度上交替生长，并保持严格的周期性多层结构。在U-Mg-Ni系储氢合金中，其主要晶体结构单元可以看作是AB5结构（CaCu5型结构）的亚结构单元和AB2结构（Laves相）的亚结构单元的交替层叠排列。这种组合结构构成了AB13（3<3<4）型结构，因此这种合金被称为超晶格储氢合金。AB13（3<3<4）结构单元具有相同的B原子排列方式，即由CaCu5结构中3g位置的Cu原子组成的Kagome格子。这些结构单元通过共享Kagome格子的有序堆叠而形成组合结构。超晶格型La-Mg-Ni系储氢合金具有高容量（400mA·h/g）和易于活化的特点。但该合金的充放电循环寿命较短，这一缺点限制了其商业应用。
explanation_en: Superlattice materials refers to a thin layer of two different components, each of which grows alternately on the scale of nanometer to tens of nanometers, and maintains a strict periodic multilayer structure. In U-Mg Ni series hydrogen storage alloy, the main crystal structure units can be seen as the alternating stacking arrangement of the sub structure units of AB5 structure (CaCu5 type structure) and AB2 structure (Laves phase). This combined structure forms AB13 (3<3<4) type structure, so this alloy is called superlattice hydrogen storage alloy. The AB13 (3<3<4) structural unit has the same arrangement of B atoms, which is a Kagome lattice composed of Cu atoms at the 3g position in the CaCu5 structure. These structural units form a composite structure through the orderly stacking of shared Kagome lattices. The superlattice La Mg Ni system hydrogen storage alloy has the characteristics of high capacity (400mA · h/g) and easy activation or conditioning. However, the short charge discharge cycle life of the alloy limits its commercial application.

explanation_cn: 译作拉弗斯相。属拓扑密堆结构的一类。由原子半径比为1.05-1.68范围内的大小不同的原子配合排列而成的密排堆垛结构,大多为二元化合物，只有少数三元化合物。其晶体结构的特点是：致密度高，原子配位数大(大原子16,小原子12)。B为小原子，以四面体形式按一定规律在空间形成网络结构;A为大原子，配置在各四面体之间的大空隙中。
explanation_en: Translated as Laphus phase. It belongs to a class of topological dense heap structures. A densely packed stack structure composed of atoms with different sizes in the atomic radius ratio range of 1.05-1.68, mostly consisting of binary compounds and only a few ternary compounds. Its crystal structure is characterized by high efficiency of spare filling and large atomic coordination number (16 for large atoms and 12 for small atoms). B is a small atom that forms a network structure in space in the form of a tetrahedron according to certain laws; A is a large atom located in large gaps between tetrahedrons.

explanation_cn: 是法国法玛通公司开发的元锆合金，该合金采用真空自耗电弧熔炼制备铸锭，采用常规压力加工方法进行塑性加工。
explanation_en: It is a meta zirconium alloy developed by French Framatome. The alloy is produced by vacuum consumable arc melting, and plastic forming is carried out by conventional pressure processing.

explanation_cn: 指缺乏经常存在于材料中极大限制强度发展的大孔或宏观缺陷的一类新型聚合物无机基复合材料。主要成分是水泥和水溶性聚合物，其中水泥是基材.可以用硅酸盐水泥，也可用铝酸盐水泥,水溶性聚合物包括聚丙基甲基纤维素、聚丙烯酰胺和聚乙烯醇等，可单独使用，也可复合使用。通过双辊幵炼机、硫化机等加工制备，使复合材料具有极低孔隙率、异常好的力学性能（抗压强度高达300MPa，抗折强度更高达的200MPa,在电学、磁学、声学和低温使用性能方面也有某些应用优势。
explanation_en: It refers to a new type of polymer inorganic matrix composite materials lacking macropores or macro defects that often exist in materials and greatly limit strength development. The main components are cement and water-soluble polymer, of which cement is the base material. Portland cement or aluminate cement can be used. The water-soluble polymer includes polypropylene ethyl cellulose, polyacrylamide and polyvinyl alcohol, which can be used alone or composition. The composite materials has extremely low porosity and exceptionally good mechanical properties (compressive strength up to 300MPa, bending strength up to 200MPa, and some application advantages in electrical, magnetic, acoustic and low-temperature performance) through processing and preparation by double roll refiners, vulcanizers, etc.

name_en: metal organic chemical vapor deposition sources
explanation_cn: 又称金属有机化学气相沉积源，属于高纯电子材料。MOCVD源的纯度高达6N(99.9999%)甚至7N(99.99999%)。MOCVD源属于金属有机化合物类，通常经过化学合成、纯化、分析和包装等步骤制备高纯MOCVD源.需要使用光洁度很髙的不锈钢包装容器。大多数具有腐蚀性，遇空气、遇水分解.甚至爆炸、自燃。的挥发性高，在MOCVD薄膜生长工艺中，通常把的蒸气输送到CVD反应炉腔（chamber)中，蒸气在炉腔中同衬底（substrate)表面接触，发生化学反应，生长出高纯金属、金属氧化物、金属氮化物等薄膜材料。
explanation_en: Also known as metal organic chemical vapor deposition source, it belongs to high-purity electronic materials. The purity of metal organic chemical vapor deposition sources is as high as 6N (99.9999%) or even 7N (99.9999%). The metal organic chemical vapor deposition sources belongs to the category of organometallic compounds. High purity metal organic chemical vapor deposition sources is usually prepared through chemical synthesis, purification, analysis, packaging and other steps. stainless steel packaging containers with high finish are required. Most of them are corrosive and decompose in case of air or water, even explosion or spontaneous combustion. High volatility. In the MOCVD film growth process, the steam is usually transported to the CVD reactor chamber, where the steam contacts the substrate surface, causing chemical reaction, and growing high-purity metal, metal oxide, metal nitride and other film materials.

explanation_cn: 又名端硅烷基聚醚密封胶。是以端硅烷基聚氧化丙烯为基料的密封胶，广泛用于大型建筑和高层建筑密封。该密封胶的各种性能优良，特别是既具有良好的耐候性、耐久性、耐热性、耐寒性、粘接性和涂饰性，又具有独特的环境友好性、优良的低黏流性和良好的低温作业性等性能。
explanation_en: Also known as silyl terminated polyether sealant. It is a sealant based on silane terminated polyoxypropylene, widely used for sealing of large buildings and high-rise buildings. The sealant has excellent properties, especially good weather resistance, durability, heat resistance, cold resistance, adhesion and finishing, as well as unique environmental friendliness, excellent low viscosity and good low-temperature operation.

explanation_cn: MVA面板（多象限垂直配向技术，Multi-DomainVerticalAlignment）是一种用于液晶显示器的面板技术。MVA面板通过使用多个区域或象限的垂直配向来实现。与传统的液晶面板不同，MVA面板中的液晶分子并非垂直排列，而是倾斜或偏向某个角度。施加电压时，液晶分子可以更快地水平排列以允许背光透过，从而大大缩短了响应时间，通常在20毫秒以内。MVA技术的多象限配向使其在广泛的视角下具有更宽广的可视性，可达到160度以上的视野角度。这意味着即使从不同的角度观看，画面的质量和可见性也得到了提高。这使MVA面板成为一种响应时间较短且可在不同视角下提供高质量图像的显示技术。
explanation_en: MVA panel (Multi Domain Vertical Alignment) is a panel technology used for liquid crystal displays. The MVA panel is achieved by using vertical alignment of multiple regions or quadrants. Unlike traditional liquid crystal panels, the liquid crystal molecules in MVA panels are not vertically arranged, but tilt or tilt towards a certain angle. When applying voltage, liquid crystal molecules can be arranged horizontally faster to allow backlight to pass through, greatly reducing the response time, usually within 20 milliseconds. The multi quadrant alignment of MVA technology provides wider visibility from a wide range of perspectives, reaching a field of view angle of over 160 degrees. This means that even when viewed from different angles, the quality and visibility of the image have been improved. This makes the MVA panel a display technology that has a shorter response time and can provide high-quality images from different perspectives.

explanation_cn: 加人3%-8%铝作为主要合金化元素的变形镁合金。随铝含量增加，合金强度增加，耐腐蚀性改善，但韧性降低。铝在固态镁中具有较大的固溶度，其极限同溶度为12.7%，且随温度降低显著减少，室温时的同溶度为2.0%(质量分数）左右。Mg-Al系合金除具有铝的固溶强化效果外，在时效过程中.过饱和的同溶体不经过任何中间阶段直接析出非共格的平衡相Mg17Al12，对合金起到一定的析出强化作用。
explanation_en: Wrought magnesium alloy with addition of 3% -8% aluminum as the main alloy element. With the increase of aluminum content, the strength of alloy increases, the corrosion resistance improves, but the toughness decreases. Aluminum has a large solid solubility in solid magnesium, and its limit is 12.7%, which decreases significantly with the decrease of temperature. The same solubility at room temperature is about 2.0% (mass fraction). In addition to the solution strengthening effect of aluminum, the Mg Al system alloy directly precipitates the non coherent equilibrium phase Mg17Al12 from the supersaturated homosolution without any intermediate stage during aging, which plays a certain role in precipitation strengthening of alloy.

explanation_cn: 以Al为主要合金元素的铸造镁合金，是目前牌号最多、应用最广的镁合金系列。Mg-Al合金共晶温度较低（437°C)，随A1含量增加合金的铸造性能也相应提高，并且具有优异的室温力学性能和良好的抗蚀性。Mg-Al系铸造镁合金的铝含量范围一般在3%-10%之间，简单的Mg-Al二元合金很少使用，工业中通过添加其他合金元素提高Mg-Al合金的强度、耐热及耐腐蚀性能。按照化学成分可分为Mg-Al-Zn、Mg-Al-Mn、Mg-Al-Si、Mg-Al-RE、Mg-Al-Ca和Mg-Al-Sr等多元合金。其中少量Zn(约1%）元素的加入可显著增加室温下Al在镁基体中的固溶度，增加合金固溶强化作用;少量的Mn(0.5%以下）可提高合金耐蚀性能;Si、RE、Ca、Sr等元素加入可提高合金高温强度和抗蠕变能力。
explanation_en: The cast magnesium alloy with Al as the main alloy element is the magnesium alloy series with the most brands and the most widely used at present. The eutectic temperature of Mg Al alloy is low (437 ° C), and with the increase of A1 content, the castability of alloy also increases, and it has excellent room temperature mechanical properties and good corrosion resistance. The aluminum content of Mg-Al cast magnesium alloy is generally between 3% and 10%. Simple Mg Al binary alloy are rarely used. The strength, heat resistance and corrosion resistance of Mg Al alloy are improved by adding other alloy elements in industry. According to chemical composition, it can be divided into Mg Al Zn, Mg Al Mn, Mg Al Si, Mg Al RE, Mg Al Ca, Mg Al Sr and other multi-component alloy. The addition of a small amount of Zn (about 1%) can significantly increase the solid solubility of Al in magnesium matrix at room temperature, and increase the solution strengthening effect of alloy; A small amount of Mn (below 0.5%) can improve the corrosion resistance of alloy; The addition of Si, RE, Ca, Sr and other elements can improve the high temperature strength and creep resistance of alloy.

explanation_cn: 以Li为主要合金元素的镁合金。锂的相对密度只有0.53g/cm3，以锂合金化的Mg-Li系合金是目前最轻的合金材料，具有高的比强度和比刚度。由于Mg-Li系合金存在化学活性极高和腐蚀抗力很低等问题，其目前的应用非常有限。
explanation_en: A magnesium alloy with Li as the main alloy element. The relative density of lithium is only 0.53g/cm3. The Mg Li alloy based on lithium alloy is the lightest alloy materials at present, with high specific strength and specific stiffness. Due to the high chemical activity and low corrosion resistance of Mg Li series alloy, their current applications are very limited.

explanation_cn: 单独的Mg-Mn合金应用较少，锰的加入对合金的力学性能影响不大，但降低塑性。锰主要作为工业镁合金常见的辅助元素，可改善合金的应力腐浊倾向和焊接性能。锰在镁中的室温固溶度很小。
explanation_en: The application of Mg Mn alloy alone is less, and the addition of manganese has little effect on the mechanical properties of alloy, but reduces the plasticity. As a common auxiliary element of industrial magnesium alloy, manganese can improve the stress corrosion tendency and weld performance of alloy. The room temperature solid solubility of manganese in magnesium is very small.

explanation_cn: 加入2%-8%锌作为主要合金化元素的变形镁合金，随锌含量增加，合金强度增加，但韧性降低，焊接性能下降。锌在固态镁中的极限固溶度为6.2%，随温度降低显著减少，室温时的固溶度为3.0%左右。锌对镁合金的强化效果要大于铝.特别是通过适当的固溶时效工艺处理，可调作和控制这些析出相的种类、形貌和分布。
explanation_en: Wrought magnesium alloy with 2% -8% zinc as the main alloying element of alloy, with the increase of zinc content, the strength of alloy increases, but the toughness decreases, and the weld performance decreases. The limiting solid solubility of zinc in solid magnesium is 6.2%, which decreases significantly with the decrease of temperature. The solid solubility at room temperature is about 3.0%. The strengthening effect of zinc on magnesium alloy is greater than that of aluminum. Especially through proper solution aging treatment, the type, morphology and distribution of these precipitated phase can be adjusted and controlled.

explanation_cn: 以Zn为主要合金元素的铸造镁合金。Zn在镁中的最大固溶度为6.2%,Mg-Zn系合金可通过时效硬化来显著地改善合金的强度，工业用Mg-Zn系合金的Zn含量一般在3.5%-6.5%范围以内。Mg-Zn系合金的结晶温度区间宽.在铸造镁合金中其热裂倾向最大，因此Mg-Zn二元合金的铸造性能较差。Zn元素的加入可以有效细化Mg-Zn合金晶粒，同时缩小合金结晶温度间隔.提高合金铸造和力学性能。
explanation_en: Cast magnesium alloy with Zn as the main alloy element. The maximum solid solubility of Zn in magnesium is 6.2%. Mg Zn alloy can significantly improve the strength of alloy through age hardening. The content of Zn in industrial Mg Zn alloy is generally in the range of 3.5% -6.5%. The crystallization temperature range of Mg Zn alloy system is wide, and its hot tear tendency is the largest in cast magnesium alloy, so the castability of Mg Zn binary alloy is poor. The addition of Zn can effectively refine the grains of Mg Zn alloy, reduce the crystallization temperature interval of alloy, and improve the foundry and mechanical properties of alloy.

explanation_cn: 一种二元合金生成焓的唯象模型-最初旨在研究过渡金属二元化合物形成热所提出，是基于Wigner~Seiu模型改进得到的。Miedema的具体构想是:当金属A句B形成合金时，它们各自的Wigner-Seitz元胞基本保持原来体积-而在合金中依其结构有序的几何形式拼凑起来，仅形状稍有变化，以满足充填整个实空间的要求。对于如此构成的二元合金，其形成热由异类原子WS元i胞(A、B)接触部分的边界条件变化导出。
explanation_en: A phenomenological model for enthalpy of formation of binary alloy originally proposed to study the heat of formation of binary transition metal compounds was based on the improved Wigner~Seiu model. Miedema's specific idea is that when metal A sentence B forms alloy, their respective Wigner Seitz cells basically maintain their original volume - while in alloy, they are pieced together according to their orderly geometric form of structure, with only a slight change in shape to meet the requirements of filling the entire real space. For the binary alloy thus formed, its heat of formation is derived from the change of boundary conditions at the contact part of the heterogeneous atomic WS cell i (A, B).

explanation_cn: Mn和Al原子构成比1:1的金属间化合物型永磁体，典型成分为70%Mn-29.5%Al-0.5%C(质量分数）。通过塑形变形可制成各向异性磁体。由于不含钻、铬、镍，原材料价格低廉，具有发展前途。
explanation_en: The typical composition of imermetallif compound type permanent magnet with the atomic composition ratio of Mn and Al of 1:1 is 70% Mn-29.5% Al-0.5% C (mass fraction). Anisotropic magnets can be made by shaping and deformation. Due to the absence of diamond, chromium, and nickel, the raw materials are cheap and have a promising future.

explanation_cn: MoSi2及其复合材料具有出色的性能，包括高熔点（2030°C）、高使用温度、良好的高温抗氧化性、适中的密度（6.24g/cm3）、优异的导热性和导电性等。它们被认为是一类具有极强竞争力的新型高温结构材料，继镍基高温合金之后的材料选择。MoSi2存在两种不同的晶体结构。在1900°C以下，它呈现出稳定的C11b型长程有序四方晶体结构。而在1900°C至2030°C之间，会发生相变，转变为亚稳的C40型六方晶体结构。多晶MoSi2的强度通常受硅含量和材料的晶粒尺寸影响。它在室温下的断裂模式主要以晶间断裂为主，这是由四方MoSi2晶体结构的各向异性和解理性能所控制的。为了改善MoSi2的低温脆性和提高高温强度，可以采用合金化的方法，与其他硅化物合金化，或通过与热力学上相容的增强剂进行复合化等方式。另一种Mo-Si化合物，Mo5Si3，作为高温结构材料也备受关注。Mo5Si3复相合金不仅在800°C到1450°C范围内具有与MoSi2相当的抗氧化性，还比MoSi2基的复合材料具有更高的抗蠕变性能。Mo5Si3对许多合金元素都有一定的固溶度，这使得通过原子置换来调整晶体结构的对称性和原子间键合的方向成为可能。
explanation_en: MoSi2 and its composite materials have excellent properties, including high melting point (2030 ° C), high service temperature, good high-temperature oxidation resistance, moderate density (6.24g/cm3), excellent thermal conductivity and conductivity. They are considered to be a new type of high temperature structural materials with strong competitiveness, and the choice of materials after nickel-base superalloy. MoSi2 has two different crystal structure. Below 1900 ° C, it shows a stable C11b long range ordered tetragonal crystal structure. However, between 1900 ° C and 2030 ° C, a phase transition will occur, transformation into a metastable C40 hexagonal crystal structure. The strength of polycrystal MoSi2 is usually affected by the silicon content and the grain size of the materials. Its fracture mode at room temperature is mainly intergranular fracture, which is controlled by the anisotropy and cleavage properties of the tetragonal MoSi2 crystal structure. In order to improve the low temperature brittleness and high temperature strength of MoSi2, alloy can be used, alloy with other silicides, or compounding with reinforcing agents compatible with thermodynamics. Another Mo Si compound, Mo5Si3, has also attracted much attention as a high-temperature structural materials. Mo5Si3 multiphase alloy not only has the same oxidation resistance as MoSi2 in the range of 800 ° C to 1450 ° C, but also has higher creep resistance than MoSi2 based composite materials. Mo5Si3 has a certain solid solubility for many alloy elements, which makes it possible to adjust the symmetry of crystal structure and the direction of bonding between atoms through atom replacement.

explanation_cn: FOX-12曾用名GUDN，浅黄色固体。不吸湿。溶于热水。不溶于冷水。熔点214°C，标准摩尔生成焓为一355kJ/mol。合成可以双氰胺为原料。酸性条件下水解成中间体脒基脲盐酸盐，然后与二硝酰胺铵(ADN)进行复分解反应得到。高能、低感、不溶于水、不吸潮、稳定性好，可用于钝感、低特征信号推进剂及不敏感炸药推进剂添加剂，也可用于燃气发生器中。
explanation_en: FOX-12, formerly known as GUDN, is a light yellow solid. Not hygroscopic. Soluble in hot water. Insoluble in cold water. The melting point is 214 ° C, and the standard molar formation enthalpy is -355kJ/mol. Synthesis can use dicyandiamide as the raw material. Under acidic conditions, the intermediate guanylurea hydrochloride is hydrolyzed into water, and then undergoes a double decomposition reaction with ammonium dinitramide (ADN) to obtain it. High energy, low sensitivity, insoluble in water, non hygroscopic, good stability, can be used for insensitive, low characteristic signal propellant and insensitive explosive propellant additive, also can be used in gas generator.

explanation_en: The superconductor with crystal structure similar to NaCl is called NaCl-structure superconductor. Typical NaCl-structure superconductor.

explanation_cn: Nb5Si3在Nb-Si二元相图中具有高熔点（2520°C）、低密度（7.19g/cm3）和高温强度的潜力，因此引起了广泛的关注，有望成为下一代高温结构材料。然而，它的室温塑性非常有限，而且高温下的抗氧化性能也不理想，这严重制约了它的实际应用。一种改进的方法是引入塑性Nb相，制备Nb/Nb5Si3原位复合材料，以显著提高它的室温塑性和断裂韧性。然而，这种方法明显降低了高温强度。另一种改进的方法是通过添加Hf、Ti、Cr、Al、Mo、W、V等合金元素来调整合金的组织和性能，但这些元素可能对合金产生有益或有害的影响。在2007年到2008年间，研究发现适量的稀土元素Dy和Ho可以显著提高Nb5Si3基共晶合金的屈服强度和断裂韧性。这种强化效应归因于固溶强化、界面强化和细晶强化。与此同时，塑性得到改善，这是由于组织细化和界面净化所引起的。这些改进方法有望克服Nb5Si3的局限性，使其更适合高温结构材料的应用。
explanation_en: Nb5Si3 has the potential of high melting point (2520 ° C), low density (7.19 g/cm3) and high temperature strength in the Nb Si binary phase diagram, so it has attracted wide attention and is expected to become the next generation of high-temperature structural materials. However, its room temperature plasticity is very limited, and its oxidation resistance at high temperatures is not ideal, which seriously restricts its practical application. An improved method is to introduce plastic Nb phase to prepare Nb/Nb5Si3 in-situ composite to significantly improve its room temperature plasticity and fracture toughness. However, this method significantly reduces the high-temperature strength. Another improvement method is to adjust the structure and properties of alloy by adding Hf, Ti, Cr, Al, Mo, W, V and other elements, but these elements may have beneficial or harmful effects on alloy. From 2007 to 2008, the research found that appropriate rare earth elements Dy and Ho can significantly improve the yield strength and fracture toughness of Nb5Si3 based eutectic alloy. This strengthening effect is attributed to solid solution strengthening, interface strengthening, and fine grain strengthening. At the same time, plasticity has been improved, which is caused by microstructure refinement and interface purification. These improved methods are expected to overcome the limitations of Nb5Si3 and make it more suitable for the application of high-temperature structural materials.

explanation_cn: 是由钕、铁、硼（Nd2Fe14B）形成的四方晶系晶体。于1982年，住友特殊金属的佐川真人发现钕磁铁。这种磁铁的磁能积（BHmax）大于钐钴磁铁，是当时全世界磁能积最大的物质。后来，住友特殊金属成功发展粉末冶金法（powder metallurgy process），通用汽车公司成功发展旋喷熔炼法（melt-spinning process），能够制备钕铁硼磁铁。这种磁铁是现今磁性仅次于绝对零度钬磁铁的永久磁铁，也是最常使用的稀土磁铁。钕铁硼磁铁被广泛地应用于电子产品，例如硬盘、手机、耳机以及用电池供电的工具等。
explanation_en: It is a tetragonal crystal formed by neodymium, iron and boron (Nd2Fe14B). In 1982, Sumitomo Special Metal's Sagawa Shinzo discovered neodymium magnets. The magnetic energy product (BHmax) of this magnet was larger than that of samarium cobalt magnets, and it was the largest magnetic energy product in the world at that time. Later, Sumitomo Special Metals successfully developed the powder metallurgy process, and General Motors successfully developed the melt spinning process, which can produce Nd-Fe-B magnets. This type of magnet is a permanent magnet with magnetic properties second only to absolute zero degree holmium magnets, and is also the most commonly used rare earth magnet. Neodymium iron boron magnets are widely used in electronic products, such as hard drives, mobile phones, headphones, and battery powered tools.

explanation_cn: 在Ni-Al二元相图中，只有NiAl和Ni3Al作为高温结构材料有应用和发展价值。Ni3Al具有面心立方长程有序结构，单晶Ni3Al塑性良好。Ni3Al是键基高温合金中最重要的强化相。多晶Ni3Al属脆性材料，添加适量硼可韧化Ni3Al。1989年，发现Zr可以韧化无硼Ni3Al合金，使其强度和塑性都明显提高。Ni3Al合金已达到较满意综合性能，在军用和民用领域都已得到肯定的应用结果，例如成分为Ni-20at.%Al-0.02B的Ni3Al定向凝固柱晶合金，是第一个成功用于制作航空发动机涡轮导向叶片的金属间化合物材料。NiAl具有长程有序体心立方B2结构，熔点高，密度低，同时具有良好的抗氧化腐蚀性能，是一种较为理想的航空航天材料。但由于室温脆性及高温强度低影响了其实用化。可利用Ni3Al合金具有的超塑性而成形制备零件。也可用机械合金化制成纳米晶Ni3Al及其复合材料，大幅度提高其强度和塑性，其晶粒组织在1000°C的高温下稳定。发现Ni3Al合金具有良好的耐高温摩擦摩损性能及其自润滑机理，为Ni3Al合金在航空航天领域的应用，开辟了一条新途径。
explanation_en: In the Ni Al binary phase diagram, only NiAl and Ni3Al have application and development value as high-temperature structural materials. Ni3Al has a face centered cubic long range ordered structure, and single crystal Ni3Al has good plasticity. Ni3Al is the most important strengthening phase in bond based high temperature alloy. Polycrystal Ni3Al is a brittle materials, which can be toughened by adding appropriate amount of boron. In 1989, it was found that Zr could toughen boron free Ni3Al alloy, which significantly improved its strength and plasticity. Ni3Al alloy has achieved satisfactory comprehensive properties, and has obtained positive application results in both military and civil fields, such as Ni-20at.% Al-0.02B Ni3Al directional solidification columnar alloy is the first imermetallif compound materials successfully used to make aeroengine turbine guide blades. NiAl has a long range ordered body centered cubic B2 structure, high melting point, low density, and good oxidation resistance and corrosion properties. It is an ideal aerospace materials. However, the brittleness at room temperature and low high-temperature strength have affected its practicality. The superplasticity of Ni3Al alloy can be used to form parts. Nanocrystal Ni3Al and its composite materials can also be made by mechanical alloy, which can greatly improve its strength and plasticity, and its grain structure is stable at a high temperature of 1000 ° C. It is found that Ni3Al alloy has good friction and friction resistance at high temperature and its self-lubricating mechanism, which opens a new way for the application of Ni3Al alloy in the aerospace field.

explanation_cn: 作为正极，与NSiMgu负极组成热电偶的NiCnu合金。镩铬硅-镍硅热电偶（N型热电偶）为廉金属热电偶，是一种最新国际标准化的热电偶，它克服了K型热电偶的两个重要缺点：K型热电偶在300-500°C间由于镍铬合金的晶格短程有序而引起的热电动势不稳定；在800°C左右由于镍铬合金发生择优氧化引起的热电动势不稳定。
explanation_en: NiCnu alloy used as positive pole to form thermocouple with NSiMgu negative pole. ?¤ Chromium silicon nickel silicon thermocouple (N-type thermocouple) is a base metal thermocouple, which is the latest internationally standardized thermocouple. It overcomes two important shortcomings of K-type thermocouple: the thermoelectric electromotive force of K-type thermocouple is unstable due to the short-range order of nickel chromium alloy lattice between 300-500 ° C; Thermoelectric EMF instability caused by preferential oxidation of Ni Cr alloy at about 800 ° C.

explanation_cn: 作为正极，与AuFe、CuNU5等负极组成热电偶的NiCru合金。正K型热电偶具有线性度好，热电动势较大，灵敏度高，稳定性和均匀性较好，抗氧化性能强，价格便宜等优点，能用于氧化性惰性气氛中。K型热电偶不能直接在高温下用于硫，还原性或还原/氧化交替的气氛，真空以及弱氧化气氛环境中。
explanation_en: NiCru alloy used as positive pole to form thermocouple with AuFe, CuNU5 and other negative poles. Positive K-type thermocouples have the advantages of good linearity, large thermoelectric electromotive force, high sensitivity, good stability and uniformity, strong antioxidant performance, and low price, making them suitable for use in oxidizing inert atmospheres. K-type thermocouples cannot be directly used at high temperatures in sulfur, reducing or alternating reducing/oxidizing atmospheres, vacuum, and weakly oxidizing atmospheres.

explanation_cn: Si-Al-O-N 平面内，由Al2O3固溶于Si2N2中形成的间溶体。结构与Si2N2相同，为正交晶体结构。化学通式为Si6-zAlzOzN8-z，在 Si2N2中 Al 取代 Si-N，固溶量通常为0.0-0.2。随着固溶度的增加，点阵常数也略有增加。氧化硅氮陶瓷的抗氧化性能优越，在高温下（1600°C）仍然保持良好。维氏硬度HV10 = 16 GPa，断裂韧性KIC = 5.5 MPa·m^1/2，弯曲强度通常在MPa级别。氧化硅氮通常由Si3N4、AlN和Al2O3混合粉末采用热压或无压工艺在1800°C烧结而成，添加Y2O3可降低烧结温度。它可用作金属连续浇铸的分流环及喷嘴、热电偶保护套管、坩埚、合金管的拉拔芯棒和压铸模具等。
explanation_en: In the Si Al O-N plane, an intermediate solution formed by the solid solution of Al2O3 in Si2N2. The structure is the same as Si2N2, which is an orthogonal crystal structure. The general chemical formula is Si6-zAlzOzN8-z, where Al replaces Si-N in Si2N2, with a solid solution typically ranging from 0.0 to 0.2. With the increase of solid solubility, the lattice constant also increases slightly. The oxidation resistance of silicon nitride ceramics is superior, and it remains good at high temperature (1600 ° C). Vikers hardness HV10=16 GPa, fracture toughness KIC=5.5 MPa · m ^ 1/2, and bending strength is usually at the MPa level. Si3N4, AlN and Al2O3 mixed powder are usually sintering at 1800 ° C by hot pressing or pressureless process. Adding Y2O3 can reduce the sintering temperature. It can be used as a shunt ring and nozzle for continuous casting of metal, a thermocouple protective sleeve, a crucible, a drawing mandrel for alloy pipes, a die-casting die, etc.

explanation_cn: 移动位错在遇到析出相颗粒处发生弯曲，当外加切应力增大时.位错被充分弯曲并使位错的主耍部分从绕成的环状区脱离，称为Orowan过程。
explanation_en: The moving dislocation bends when it encounters the precipitated phase particles. When the external shear stress increases, the dislocation is fully bent and the main part of the dislocation is separated from the looped area, which is called the Orowan process.

explanation_cn: 聚合物分散液晶是将低分子液晶与预聚物KuerUV65胶相混合，在一定条件下经聚合反应，形成微米级的液晶微滴均匀地分散在高分子网络中.再利用液晶分子的介电各向异性获得具有电光响应特性的材料。它主要用作在散射态和透明态之间并具有一定的灰度。聚合物分散液晶膜是将液晶和聚合物结合得到的一种综合性能优异的膜材料。PNLC，即聚合物网络液晶的模式。与PDLC相比，PNLC中的液晶不是成球形（或椭球形）微滴，而是分布在聚合物三维网络中，形成连续性的通道网。
explanation_en: The polymer dispersed liquid crystal is to mix the low molecular liquid crystal with the prepolymer KuerUV65 glue phase, under certain conditions, through polymerization reaction, form micron liquid crystal droplets that are evenly dispersed in the macromolecule network. Then use the dielectric anisotropy of the liquid crystal molecule to obtain materials with electro-optic response characteristics. It is mainly used between scattered and transparent states and has a certain grayscale. Polymer dispersed liquid crystal (pdlc) film is a kind of film materials with excellent comprehensive performance which combines liquid crystal and polymer. PNLC is the mode of polymer network liquid crystal. Compared with PDLC, the liquid crystals in PNLC are not spherical (or ellipsoidal) droplets, but distributed in the polymer three-dimensional network, forming a continuous channel network.

name_en: precursor infiltration and pyrolysis (PIP) process of C/SiC ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 该PIP工艺是指先驱体浸渍/裂解工艺。其工艺过程包括：纤维预制件的成型、先驱体浸渍液的制备及其对纤维预制件的浸溃、先驱体在预制件中的原位交联间化、先驱体高温裂解和重复先驱体浸溃/裂解的材料致密化过程。该工艺是制备C/Si复合材料最有效的方法之一，具有传统工艺无法比拟的优点。
explanation_en: This PIP process refers to the precursor impregnation/cracking process. The technological process includes: forming of fiber preforms, preparation of precursor impregnating solution and its immersion in fiber preforms, in-situ crosslinking and intermediation of precursors in preforms, high-temperature pyrolysis of precursors and densification of materials by repeated precursor immersion/pyrolysis. This process is one of the most effective methods to prepare C/Si composite materials, and has advantages that traditional processes cannot match.

explanation_cn: PMN-PT-PZ压电陶瓷是一种压电材料，其化学组成包括铅镁铌酸钛钡钙锆酸盐。这种陶瓷材料在电场作用下可以发生机械应变，反之亦然，因此在传感器、换能器和振动设备等领域具有广泛应用。
explanation_en: PMN-PT-PZ piezoelectric1 ceramics is a piezoelectric materials, and its chemical composition includes lead magnesium titanium barium niobate calcium zirconate. This ceramics materials can produce mechanical strain under the action of electric field, and vice versa, so it is widely used in sensors, transducers, vibration equipment and other fields.

Similar to PMN-PT-PZ ceramics, it also has piezoelectric properties and can be used to manufacture sensors, transducers and other electroacoustic equipment.

explanation_en: A solid solution consisting of lead silver zincate and lead silver magnesium. Relaxor ferroelectric ceramics with frequency dispersion and dispersion phase transition characteristics.

explanation_en: Relaxor ferroelectric ceramics with frequency dispersion and dispersion phase transition characteristics. Appropriate addition of MnO can reduce diekctric loss.

explanation_cn: PZT（铅锆钛）压电陶瓷是一类广泛应用的压电陶瓷材料，具有铅、锆、钛等元素的化学成分。它在电子设备、声学传感器、振动装置等方面具有重要作用，因为它在电场作用下可以发生机械变形。
explanation_en: PZT (Lead Zirconium Titanium) piezoelectric ceramics are a kind of widely used piezoelectric ceramics materials, which have the chemical composition of lead, zirconium, titanium and other elements. It plays an important role in electronic devices, acoustic sensors, vibration devices, etc., as it can undergo mechanical deformation under the action of an electric field.

explanation_cn: 锆钛酸铅薄膜材料的简称。具有优越的铁电性、压电性和热释电性。
explanation_en: The abbreviation of lead zirconate titanate film materials. It has superior ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity and pyroelectricity.

explanation_en: The critical shear stress required to move a single dislocation in an ideal crystal. First, the dislocation energy between two planes on both sides of the slip surface should be calculated, and then the change law of the dislocation energy when the dislocation moves from one equilibrium position to another equilibrium position should be examined.

explanation_en: Read only storage media. The main materials are plastics and photoinduced polymer, which are produced by replication. That is, a stamp is used to copy read-only optical information on plastics or photoinduced polymer.

explanation_en: Also known as residual resistivity, it is used to measure the parameter index of metal purity.

explanation_cn: 由苯乙烯/丁二烯/苯乙烯共聚成的三嵌段共聚物。热塑性弹性体的一种。通常以丁基锂为引发剂、环己烷为溶剂、氢呋喃为活化剂。采用步加料法依次加入苯乙烯、丁二烯、苯乙烯单体。在80°C下进行阴离子聚合根抿合成方法不同，SRS具备线型结构和M形结构SHS具有优电性能。屈挠和回弹性好，可溶于甲笨、二氯甲烷、二氯乙烷等，不溶于水、乙醇、溶剂f'C油。醋酸乙酯、丙酮、环己烷等。
explanation_en: A tri block copolymer formed by copolymerization of styrene/butadiene/styrene. A thermoplastic elastomers. Butyl lithium is usually used as initiator, cyclohexane as solvent and hydrofuran as activamr. The styrene, butadiene and styrene monomer are added successively by the step feeding method. Different synthesis methods of anion polymerization at 80 ° C, SRS has linear structure and M-shaped structure SHS has excellent electrical properties. Good flexibility and elasticity, soluble in methylbenzene, dichloromethane, dichloroethane, etc., insoluble in water, ethanol, solvent f'C oil. Ethyl acetate, acetone, cyclohexane, etc.

explanation_cn: 裂解有机硅树脂聚硅氮烷得到的硅氮碳氧复合化合物无机陶瓷.粒度lOOnm的粉末。氯硅烷树脂与氮反应生成聚硅氮烷.经部分交联，得到玻璃体树脂--前驱体。在真空或H2、N2任一种保护气氛中，于1000°C以上裂解.得到黑体蜂窝体，研磨后得到非晶态超细黑色粉末。
explanation_en: Silicone nitrogen carbon oxygen composition inorganic ceramics obtained by pyrolysis of organic silicone resin polysilazane. powder with particle size of lOOnm. Chloro silane resin reacts with nitrogen to form poly silazane. After partial crosslinking, vitreous resin - precursor is obtained. In vacuum or H2, N2, any kind of protective atmosphere, the black body honeycomb is obtained by cracking above 1000 ° C, and amorphous ultra-fine black powder is obtained after grinding.

explanation_cn: 由聚苯乙烯_聚异戊二烯-聚笨乙烯组成的二嵌段共聚物，热塑性弹件体的一种。有线型及星形两种结构。通常以丁基俾为引发剂、环己烷为溶剂、少量四氢呋喃为活化剂。主要用于与其他树脂、助剂等配合。制备热熔压敏胶，可作为包装袋、遮盖带、双面带、耐用标签等日用品的制备材料，性能优良。
explanation_en: Made of polystyrene_ A di block copolymer composed of polyisoprene and polystyrene, which is a kind of thermoplastic elastomer body. There are two types of structures: wired and star. Butyl bisphenol is usually used as initiator, cyclohexane as solvent, and a small amount of tetrahydrofuran as activamr. It is mainly used to cooperate with other resin, additive, etc. The hot-melt pressure-sensitive adhesive can be used as the materials for packaging bags, masking tapes, double-sided tapes, durable labels and other daily necessities with excellent performance.

explanation_cn: 又名端硅烷基聚氨酯密封胶。是以端硅烷基聚氨酯预聚体为基料的密封胶，其结构特点是通过官能基硅烷与通用的端NCO基聚氨酯预聚体反应，使聚氨酯预聚体的端NCO基被官能基硅烷取代，变成一种端硅烷基聚氨酯预聚体。具有室温下快速同化，良好的耐候、耐水、耐热、耐老化，对基材适应性广以及不含游离的异氰酸基等特点。
explanation_en: Also known as silyl terminated polyurethime sealant. It is a sealant based on silyl terminated polyurethime prepolymer as base material. Its structural feature is that through the reaction of functional silane and general NCO terminated polyurethime prepolymer, the NCO terminated group of polyurethime prepolymer is replaced by functional silane to become a silyl terminated polyurethime prepolymer. It has the characteristics of rapid assimilation at room temperature, good weather resistance, water resistance, heat resistance, aging resistance, wide adaptability to the substrate and free isocyanate group.

explanation_cn: 这是一种兼具Si3N4陶瓷和BN纤维的优异特性的复合纤维。Si3N4陶瓷提供出色的力学性能和耐高温性能，而BN纤维则提供卓越的介电性能。通过调节陶瓷纤维中Si3N4与BN的原子比例，可以调整纤维的力学性能和介电性能。例如，增加Si3N4的相组分可以改善纤维的力学性能，增加BN的相组分可以提高纤维的介电性能。Si3N4陶瓷纤维不含碳元素和其他可能导致电磁损耗的组分或物相，因此可用于制备新型天线罩，具有出色的力学性能、更高温度耐受性、更低的烧蚀率以及更稳定的电性能。这种纤维在新型高速精导武器和高超声速飞行器等领域具有广泛的应用前景。
explanation_en: This is a composite fiber that combines the excellent characteristics of Si3N4 ceramics and BN fiber. Si3N4 ceramics provide excellent mechanical properties and high temperature resistance, while BN fibers provide excellent dielectric properties. The mechanical and dielectric properties of ceramics fiber can be adjusted by adjusting the atomic ratio of Si3N4 and BN in the fiber. For example, increasing the phase composition of Si3N4 can improve the mechanical properties of fibers, while increasing the phase composition of BN can improve the dielectric properties of fibers. Si3N4 ceramics fiber does not contain carbon elements and other components or phases that may cause electromagnetic losses, so it can be used to prepare new radomes with excellent mechanical properties, higher temperature resistance, lower ablation rate and more stable electrical properties. This fiber has broad application prospects in fields such as new high-speed precision guided weapons and hypersonic aircraft.

explanation_cn: 即透明导电氧化物镀膜玻璃，在平板玻璃表面通过物理或者化学镀膜的方法均匀镀上一层透明的导电氧化物薄膜，主要包括In、Sn、Zn和Cd的氧化物及其复合多元氧化物薄膜材料。具有透过率高，膜层牢固，导电性好等特点。TCO玻璃应用在透明导电电极、高温电子器件等领域，如太阳能电池、液晶显示器、光i探测器、窗口涂层等。
explanation_en: That is, transparent conductive oxide coating glass. A layer of transparent conductive oxide film is evenly coated on the surface of flat glass by physical or chemical coating methods, mainly including the oxides of In, Sn, Zn and Cd and their composition polyoxide film materials. It has the characteristics of high transmittance, firm film layer, and good conductivity. Transparent conducting oxideglass is used in transparent conductive electrodes, high-temperature electronic devices and other fields, such as solar cell, liquid crystal displays, photo i detectors, window coatings, etc.

explanation_cn: 在Ti-Al二元相图中有四个金属间化合物，其中Ti3Al、TiAl和TiAl3得到了广泛研究。O2相Ti3Al具有DO22超点阵结构。在1180°C无序转变为六方的c"相，成分范围较宽，可以进行合金化。TiAl基合金主要基于Ti-Al-Nb三元系，再加入少量其他元素。Ti3Al基合金密度低，模量高，具有良好的高温性能，适于制作航空航天飞行器在600°C至750°C工作的结构件，较镍基合金可减轻40%。γ-TiAl具有L10有序正方点阵结构，具有很宽的成分范围。γ-TiAl基合金都是富Ti的双相合金，成分为Ti-(40%至50%)(原子百分比）Al-(1%至10%)M，M为V、Cr、Mn、Nb、Ta、W和Mo等。TiAl合金的特点是低密度、较高弹性模量及良好高温强度、抗蠕变和抗氧化性能。在700°C至950°C可广泛用于制作航空发动机的高温零部件涡轮盘、涡轮叶片等，例如GE-90发动机用TiAl合金制作5级和6级低压涡轮叶片，取得了实际应用。TiAl3具有D022超点阵结构，有较低的熔点和密度。其抗氧化性能更好，但其成分范围非常窄，室温塑性差。企图通过微合金化改善塑性尚未成功，通过加入适量的Fe、Ni、Cu、Zn、Mn、Cr、Co、Nb、Rh、Pb、W、Au等元素可以把TiAl3变成高对称性的L12结构，但合金的塑性几乎仍然是零。
explanation_en: There are four imermetallif compound in the Ti Al binary phase diagram, among which Ti3Al, TiAl and TiAl3 have been extensively studied. The O2 phase Ti3Al has a DO22 superlattice structure. At 1180 ° C, the disorderly transformation into hexagonal c "phase has a wide composition range and can be alloy. The TiAl based alloy is mainly based on the Ti Al Nb ternary system, with a small amount of other elements added. The Ti3Al based alloy has low density, high modulus, and good high-temperature performance, which is suitable for making structural parts of aerospace vehicles operating at 600 ° C to 750 ° C, 40% less than the nickel based alloy. γ- TiAl has an L10 ordered square lattice structure and a wide range of components. γ- TiAl based alloys are all Ti rich dual phase alloys, with a composition of Ti - (40% to 50%) (atomic percentage) Al - (1% to 10%) M, and M consisting of V, Cr, Mn, Nb, Ta, W, and Mo. TiAl alloy is characterized by low density, high elastic modulus, good high temperature strength, creep resistance and oxidation resistance. At 700 ° C to 950 ° C, it can be widely used to manufacture high-temperature parts such as turbine disks and turbine blades of aeroengines. For example, the GE-90 engine uses TiAl alloy to manufacture 5-stage and 6-stage low-pressure turbine blades, which has achieved practical application. TiAl3 has D022 superlattice structure with low melting point and density. Its antioxidant performance is better, but its composition range is very narrow and its room temperature plasticity is poor. Attempts to improve the plasticity by microalloying have not been successful. By adding appropriate amounts of Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Mn, Cr, Co, Nb, Rh, Pb, W, Au and other elements, TiAl3 can be transformed into a highly symmetrical L12 structure, but the plasticity of alloy is almost zero.

explanation_cn: 根据美国ASTM D3960-98标准，VOC被定义为任何能够参与大气光化学反应的有机化合物。美国环境保护署（EPA）的定义是，挥发性有机化合物是指除了一些特定物质（如CO，CO2，H2CO3，金属碳化物，金属碳酸盐和碳酸铵）外，任何有机化合物，它们具有挥发性并能参与大气光化学反应。世界卫生组织（WHO，1989）对总挥发性有机化合物（TVOC）的定义是那些在常温下熔点较低且在50°C到250°C之间沸点的挥发性有机化合物的总和。国际标准ISO 4618/1-1998和德国标准DIN 55649-2000通常将VOC定义为在常温常压下能够自发挥发的有机液体和/或固体。此外，DIN 55649-2000标准在测定VOC含量时对VOC进行了一定的限定，要求它们的沸点或初馏点低于或等于250°C。
explanation_en: According to the American ASTM D3960-98 standard, VOC is defined as any organic compound that can participate in atmospheric photochemical reactions. The US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) defines volatile organic compounds as any organic compound that is volatile and can participate in atmospheric photochemical reaction, except for some specific substances (such as CO, CO2, H2CO3, metal carbide, metal carbonate and ammonium carbonate). The World Health Organization (WHO, 1989) defines total volatile organic compounds (TVOC) as the sum of those volatile organic compounds with low melting point at room temperature and boiling point between 50 ° C and 250 ° C. The international standard ISO 4618/1-1998 and the German standard DIN 55649-2000 usually define VOC as an organic liquid and/or solid that can spontaneously evaporate at room temperature and pressure. In addition, DIN 55649-2000 standard has a certain limit on volatile organic compound content, requiring their boiling point or initial boiling point to be lower than or equal to 250 ° C.

explanation_cn: 代位式固溶体的点阵常数随着溶质原子的成分呈线性变化。Vegard首先指出：在离子晶体固溶体中，点阵常数与固溶体成分r之间呈线性关系。
explanation_en: The lattice constant of substitutional solid solution varies linearly with the composition of solute atoms. Vegard first pointed out that in the solid solution of ionic crystal, there is a linear relationship between the lattice constant and the composition r of solid solution.

explanation_cn: 主要指具有体心立方（BCC)结构的钒基固溶体合金，包括V-Ti-Fe、V-Ti-Mn、V-Ti-Co、V-Ti-Cr、V-Ti-Ni等。具有室温下储氢量大（3.8%)、抗粉化性能好、氢在氢化物中的扩散速度较快等优点.但缺点是价格贵，且对环境有毒害影响。钒基合金实际可利用的储氢量为1.9%左右，其二氢化物通常都形成面心立方结构。
explanation_en: It mainly refers to vanadium based solid solution alloy with body centered cubic (BCC) structure, including V-Ti Fe, V-Ti Mn, V-Ti Co, V-Ti Cr, V-Ti Ni, etc. It has the advantages of large hydrogen storage capacity (3.8%) at room temperature, good resistance to pulverization, and fast diffusion of hydrogen in hydride, but its disadvantage is that it is expensive and has toxic effects on the environment. The actual available hydrogen storage capacity of vanadium based alloy is about 1.9%, and its hydride usually forms face-centered cubic structure.

explanation_cn: 具有高于纯钨的热电势。热电极丝熔点高（3300°C)。蒸气压低。极易氧化；在非氧化性气氛中化学稳定性好，电动势大，灵敏度高，其热电势与温度的依从性呈线性。钨铼热电偶温度-电势线性关系好，热稳定性可靠，测温上限高，在冶金、建材、航天、航空及核能等行业都得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: Having a thermoelectric potential higher than pure tungsten. The melting point of the thermoelectric electrode wire is high (3300 ° C). Low vapor pressure. Extremely prone to oxidation; In non oxidizing atmospheres, it has good chemical stability, high electromotive force, high sensitivity, and a linear dependence of its thermoelectric potential on temperature. Tungsten rhenium thermocouples have good temperature potential linear relationship, reliable thermal stability, high temperature measurement upper limit, and are widely used in metallurgy, building materials, aerospace, aviation, nuclear energy and other industries.
