explanation_en: Particle size can only be observed using an electron microscope. It was prepared by chemical precipitation and carbonyl method. With high sintering activity, it is the preferred powder for preparing high-performance fine and ultra-fine powder materials.

explanation_cn: 亚共析钢加热到Au之间的温度保温后保留一部分铁素体，然后快速冷却的热处理工艺。可获得马氏体加铁素体双相组织，具有良好的均匀塑性和钿性，在双相钢生产中广泛采用。机械零件采用，由于加热温度低可使奥氏体晶粒细化，并使磷等有害杂质的偏聚现象减轻，可提高钢的韧性，减小回火脆性。亚温淬火可先加热到Au以上完全奥氏体化后降温进入亚温区适当保温后淬火，也可从低温加热升温进人亚温区适当保温后淬火，前者先共析铁素体沿奥氏体晶界析出的尺寸较为粗大，而后者得到的未溶铁素体呈细小均匀分布，因而后者的韧化效果更佳。
explanation_en: A heat treatment process in which hypo-eutectoid steel is heated to the temperature between Au, and a part of ferrite is retained after holding, and then rapidly cooled. It can obtain a dual phase structure of martensite and ferrite, with good uniform plasticity and ductility, and is widely used in the production of dual phase steel. As for mechanical parts, low heating temperature can refine austenite grains, reduce segregation of harmful impurities such as phosphorus, improve toughness of steel and reduce temper brittleness. Subthermal quenching can be heated to above Au and completely austenitized before cooling into the subtemperature zone for proper heat preservation before quenching, or it can be heated from low temperature to the subtemperature zone for proper heat preservation before quenching. The size of the first eutectoid ferrite precipitated along the austenite grain boundary is relatively large in the former, while the undissolved ferrite obtained in the latter is fine and evenly distributed, so the toughening effect of the latter is better.

explanation_cn: 一种氟橡胶。按结构分有和竣基亚硝基氟橡胶两种。①亚硝基氟橡胶由三氟亚硝基甲烷与四氣乙烯或添加亚硝基全氟丁酸经本体或溶液共聚而成，聚合时加入链调节剂如乙醚可得液体橡胶用作密封、耐介质的防护材料;接触火箭燃料N2O4的密封垫圈、胶囊、阀门密封圈;其溶液和液体胶用喷涂、浸溃、烧铸等方法制造宇航服、手套、管、袋等。②羧基亚硝基氟橡胶，羧基亚硝基氟橡胶的竣基含量为0.5%-20%(摩尔分数）.其低温性能优于氟橡胶，耐热性较多数通用橡胶好;耐强氧化剂如硝酸、四氧化二氮，对一般溶剂稳定;耐燃性特别优异，在高压氧（8.2MPa)中不燃烧。三元胶体积电阻率,相对介电常数（1MHz)2.0,介电强度25kV/mm，介质损耗因子（60Hz)0.05。
explanation_en: A fluoro rubber. According to structure, there are two types of fluororubber: nitroso fluororubber and nitroso fluororubber Nitroso fluoro-rubber is made by copolymerization of trifluoro nitroso methane with tetragaseous ethylene or adding nitroso perfluorobutyric acid through bulk or solution. When adding chain regulators such as ether during polymerization, liquid rubber can be obtained as a sealing and media resistant protective materials; Sealing gaskets, capsules, and valve sealing rings in contact with rocket fuel N2O4; The solution and liquid adhesive are used to manufacture aerospace suits, gloves, tubes, bags, etc. by spraying, soaking, burning and casting methods Carboxyl nitroso fluoro rubber, carboxyl nitroso fluoro rubber with 0.5% -20% (mole fraction) end group content, its low-temperature performance is better than fluoro rubber, and its heat resistance is better than most general rubber; Resistant to strong oxidizer, such as nitric acid, nitrogen tetroxide, and stable to general solvents; The flame resistance is particularly excellent, and it will not combustion in high-pressure oxygen (8.2MPa). The coefficient of volume resistance of the ternary adhesive, the relative dielectric constant (1MHz) 2.0, the dielectric strength 25kV/mm, and the dielectric loss factor (60Hz) 0.05.

explanation_en: Metastable β Titanium alloy is a kind of alloy, which is mainly composed of titanium and other metal elements. Its structure under normal temperature and pressure is in a metastable state, which means that it has certain plasticity and toughness, and can be used in aerospace, medical device and other applications.

explanation_en: The condensed energetic igniter composed of nanometer combustibles and oxidizer through self-assembly has molecular contact between its components, which can greatly reduce the migration distance of reaction groups, significantly improve the reaction speed, and promote the complete reaction, thus having a high energy density, belonging to the category of high energy ignition composition.

explanation_cn: 不稳定相（失稳相）与稳定相（平衡相）之间的过渡相。相的稳定性是以其自由能的数值来判定的，平衡相（具有一定的化学成分及晶体结构）的自由能最小，失稳相的自由能最大，的自由能介于两者之间。自由能亦对应自由能的极小值，但不是最小值，平衡相是最小值。相变过程中的出现是一个动力学自发优化的结果。形成稳定平衡相，相变的驱动力最大，形成的驱动力较形成平衡相者虽小，但形成亚稳相的速度可能快。在很多情况下，的形核率远远大于平衡相的形核率，导致先于平衡相形成，并且有些可不发生继续转变。
explanation_en: Transition phase between unstable phase (unstable phase) and stable phase (balanced phase). The stability of phase is determined by the value of its free energy. The free energy of the balanced phase (with certain chemical composition and crystal structure) is the smallest, the free energy of the unstable phase is the largest, and the free energy of is between the two. The free energy also corresponds to the minimum value of free energy, but not the minimum value. The equilibrium phase is the minimum value. The appearance of phase transformation is the result of spontaneous optimization of dynamics. To form a stable equilibrium phase, the driving force of phase transformation is the largest. Although the driving force is smaller than that of the equilibrium phase, the speed of forming metastable phase may be faster. In many cases, the nucleation rate of is far greater than the nucleation rate of the equilibrium phase, leading to the formation of the equilibrium phase before, and some may not continue transformation.

explanation_cn: 又称铁氧体磁性。亚铁磁性现象通常发生在铁氧化物和铁素体材料中。在法国科学家路易奈尔于1948年发现|材料的以前，人们常常将亚铁磁材料和铁磁!材料混为一谈。在亚铁磁材料中存在许多有着相反磁矩的原子。但是这些互为相反的磁矩数值并不相等，从而使材料表现出整体自发磁化现象。与铁磁材料类似亚铁磁材料的磁化强度也随着环境温度变化。温度低于居里温度时呈现出自发磁化强度，在居里温度以上自发磁化消失。与铁磁材料不同的是，亚铁磁材料！在居里温度以下还可能出现一个称为磁化补偿点的温度临界点。在此温度下两种自旋的磁矩正好相等，使得材料的总磁矩为零。对于有些材料，还可能存在另外一个磁化补偿点，在该温度下材料的系统净角动量变为零。存在这种补偿点的亚铁磁材料具有高速磁反转效应，它们对于磁性记忆器件的制备意义重大。
explanation_en: Also called ferrite magnetism. Ferrimagnetism usually occurs in iron oxides and ferritic materials. Before French scientist Louis Nair discovered | materials in 1948, people often regarded ferromagnetic materials and ferromagnetism! Materials are confused. There are many atoms with opposite magnetic moment in ferromagnetic materials. However, these mutually opposite magnetic moment are not equal, which makes the materials show the phenomenon of overall spontaneous magnetize. Similar to ferromagnetic materials, the magnetization of ferromagnetic materials also changes with the ambient temperature. When the temperature is lower than the Curie temperature, the spontaneous magnetize appears, and when the temperature is higher than the Curie temperature, the spontaneous magnetize disappears. Different from ferromagnetic materials, ferromagnetic materials! Below the Curie temperature, there may also be a temperature critical point called magnetize compensation point. At this temperature, the magnetic moment of the two spins are exactly equal, making the total magnetic moment of the materials zero. For some materials, there may also be another magnetize compensation point, and the net angular momentum of the materials system becomes zero at this temperature. Ferromagnetic materials with such compensation points have high-speed magnetic reversal effect, which is of great significance for the preparation of magnetic memory devices.

explanation_cn: 一个量子力学概念，是指将两个不可区分的微观全同粒子发生交换产生的量子效应。基于量子力学全同粒子不可区分原 则.量子系统的波函数对于其中两个全同粒子的交换 (位置坐标交换或自旋状态交换）应当具有明确的对称性。
explanation_en: A concept of quantum mechanics refers to the quantum effect produced by exchanging two indistinguishable microscopic identical particles. Based on the principle that identical particles cannot be distinguished in quantum mechanics, the wave function of a quantum system should have clear symmetry for the exchange of two identical particles (position coordinate exchange or spin state exchange).

explanation_en: Including energy density and power density. Energy density refers to the amount of energy stored by the battery of unit mass, and power density refers to the rate at which the battery of unit mass can output energy when discharged.

explanation_cn: 一种由丙烯腈和丁二烯交替共聚制备的橡胶。其单体结构单元之间的交替程度通常达到96%到98%。这种橡胶中丙烯腈结构单元的含量大约为49%。丁二烯单体结构单元主要采用反式-1.3-布伦斯结构，占比超过97%。交替丁腈橡胶的制备方法通常是通过在亚铁氯化铝催化剂的作用下，将丙烯腈和丁二烯在0°C的条件下进行悬浮聚合而成。相对于普通的丁腈橡胶，交替丁腈橡胶的分子链序列结构更加规则，丁二烯和丙烯腈单元均匀地分布在分子链中，这增加了其柔性。该橡胶的玻璃化转变温度通常在-15°C左右。与含有相同丙烯腈含量的普通丁腈橡胶相比，交替丁腈橡胶具有更高的拉伸强度、断裂伸长率以及回弹性。交替丁腈橡胶是一种在耐油性能方面表现出色的橡胶，通常用于制造各种耐油制品，包括耐油胶管、耐油衬里、耐油垫圈、耐油膜片、耐油胶辊以及耐油吸振器表面盖等应用领域。它的性能使其能够替代丙烯酸酯橡胶，并在特定应用中得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: The invention relates to a rubber prepared by alternating copolymerization of acrylonitrile and butadiene. The degree of alternation between monomer structural units usually reaches 96% to 98%. The content of acrylonitrile structural units in the rubber is about 49%. The structural unit of butadiene monomer mainly adopts trans-1.3-Bruns structure, accounting for more than 97%. The preparation method of nitrile-butadiene alternating copolymer rubber is usually through suspension polymerization of acrylonitrile and butadiene at 0 ° C under the action of ferrous aluminum chloride catalyst. Compared with ordinary acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber, the molecular chain sequence structure of nitrile-butadiene alternating copolymer rubber is more regular, and butadiene and acrylonitrile units are evenly distributed in the molecular chain, which increases its flexibility. The glass transition temperature of the rubber is usually about -15 ° C. Compared with ordinary acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber with the same acrylonitrile content, nitrile-butadiene alternating copolymer rubber has higher tensile strength, percentage elongation after fracture and resilience. Nitrile-butadiene alternating copolymer rubber is a kind of rubber with excellent oil resistance performance. It is usually used to manufacture various oil resistant products, including oil resistant hose, oil resistant lining, oil resistant gasket, oil resistant diaphragm, oil resistant rubber roller, oil resistant vibration absorber surface cover and other application fields. Its properties enable it to replace acrylic rubber and be widely used in specific applications.

According to whether chemical reaction occurs in the crosslinking process, it can be divided into chemical crosslinking and physical crosslinking.

Or it can be expressed as the density of crosslinking point. The density of crosslinking point is defined as the number of crosslinking points per unit volume. explanation_cn: 经交联而形成的具有网络结构的一类聚乙烯塑料。有以下两种类型的交联结构网络结构的形成提高了原料聚乙烯的强度、抗冲击性、耐热性、耐候性、耐化学腐蚀性、耐环境应力开裂性、抗蠕变性、耐磨性，此外还具有优异的电绝缘性和良好的耐低温性、耐辐射性等。一般釆用辐照交联或化学交联法制备，化学交联分为过氧化物交联剂和硅烷交联剂。主要用于电线电缆包覆层，高电压、高频耐热绝缘材料，化工设备的耐腐蚀零部件及容器，泡沫塑料，耐热管材，热收缩薄膜及套管等。
explanation_en: A class of polyethylene plastics with network structure formed by crosslinking. The formation of the following two types of crosslinking structure network structure improves the strength, impact resistance, heat resistance, weather resistance, chemical corrosion resistance, environmental stress cracking resistance, creep resistance, wear resistance of raw polyethylene. In addition, it also has excellent electrical insulation, good low temperature resistance, radiation resistance, etc. Generally, it is prepared by irradiation crosslinking or chemical crosslinking. chemical crosslinking is divided into peroxide cross linking agent and silane cross linking agent. It is mainly used for wire and cable coating, high voltage and high frequency heat-resistant insulation materials, corrosion resistant parts and containers of chemical equipment, foamed plastics, heat-resistant tube, heat shrinkable film and sleeve, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称桃花石、桃花玉、玫瑰石、粉翠。是以蔷薇辉石为主要成分的致密块状集合体。主要产地为北京昌平。参见蔷薇辉石。
explanation_en: Also known as peach blossom stone, Peach Blossom Jade, rose stone and pink emerald. It is a dense massive aggregate mainly composed of rhodonite. The main origin is Changping, Beijing. See rhodonite.

explanation_cn: 亮度是指发光体(反光体)表面发光(反光)强弱的物理量。人眼从一个方向观察光源，在这个方向上的光强与人眼所"见到"的光源面积之比，定义为该光源单位的亮度，即单位投影面积上的发光强度。亮度的单位是坎德拉/平方米(cd/m2)亮度是人对光的强度的感受。
explanation_en: Brightness refers to the physical quantity of luminescence (reflection) intensity on the surface of luminescence (reflector). The human eye observes the light source from one direction, and the ratio of the light intensity in this direction to the light source area "seen" by the human eye is defined as the brightness of the light source unit, that is, the luminous intensity of the unit projection area. The unit of brightness is candela/square meter (cd/m2) brightness is the person's perception of light intensity.

explanation_cn: 指表面带有极性基团的分子。对水有大的亲和能力，可以吸引水分子的复合材料。这类复合材料的表面易被水所润湿。具有这种特性都是物质的亲水性。
explanation_en: Refers to molecules with polar groups on their surface. Composite materials with great affinity for water and can attract water molecules. The surface of such composite materials is easily wetted by water. Having this characteristic is the hydrophilicity of substances.

explanation_cn: 指模拟人体关节功能，替代病变或受损关节的植入性假体。对人工关节材料的基本要求是：生物相容性好；力学性能优异；耐磨、耐蚀；质量轻、弹性模量合适。由于单一材料往往难以同时满足上述要求。故临床应用时。常选用不同材料来组合使用。人工关节材料常见的有不锈钢、钴基合金、钛及钛合金；氧化铝、氧化锆、羟基磷灰石、生物活性玻璃陶瓷、碳素材料等生物材料：聚酯、硅橡胶及超高分子量聚乙烯塑料等。人工关节可分为半关节和全关节两类。半关节是只置换关节的一部分。即一个关节面；全关节是整个关节的置换。所有人工关节结构都是由关节体与柄两部分组成的。关节体部的设计必须符合原关节的解剖特点，表层光滑以利活动。而柄部呈杆状，便于插入骨髓腔白固定，两者相互连接成为一整体。人工关节已广泛应用于四肢所有关节及脊柱的椎体置换，应注意防止术中和术后早期并发症发生，但长期使用也发现有不良结果。
explanation_en: It refers to an implanted prosthesis that simulates the function of human joints and replaces diseased or damaged joints. The basic requirements for artificial joint materials are: good biocompatibility; Excellent mechanical properties; Wear and corrosion resistance; Light weight and suitable elastic modulus. Because a single materials is often difficult to meet the above requirements at the same time. Therefore, in clinical application. Different materials are often used in combination. The common materials of artificial joint are stainless steel, cobalt based alloy, titanium and titanium alloy; Alumina, zirconia, hydroxyapatite, bioactive glass-ceramics, carbon materials and other biological materials: polyester, silicone rubber and ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene plastics. Artificial joint can be divided into half joint and whole joint. Half joint is only a part of the replacement joint. A joint surface; Total joint replacement is the replacement of the entire joint. All artificial joint are composed of joint body and handle. The design of the joint body must conform to the anatomical characteristics of the original joint, with a smooth surface to facilitate movement. The handle is rod-shaped, making it easy to insert into the bone marrow cavity for fixation, and the two are connected to form a whole. Artificial joint has been widely used in all joints of limbs and vertebral body replacement of spine. Attention should be paid to prevent early complications during and after surgery, but long-term use has also found adverse results.

explanation_cn: 能部分或全部替代人体某一器官功能的医疗设备和装置.可整体或部分植入体内.也可以是一种体外辅助装置如人工人心脏、人工肾、人工肝、人工胰和人工肺等。
explanation_en: Medical equipment and devices that can partially or completely replace the function of a certain organ of the human body. They can be wholly or partially implanted into the body. They can also be external auxiliary devices, such as artificial human heart, artificial kidney, artificial liver, artificial pancreas, artificial lung, etc.

explanation_cn: 是用生物或机械手段，部分或完全替代心脏的泵血功能、维持全身的血液循环的装置。
explanation_en: It is a device that uses biological or mechanical means to partially or completely replace the pumping function of the heart and maintain blood circulation throughout the body.

explanation_cn: 能替代心脏瓣膜功能的人造器件，用于病变心脏瓣膜的置换物，以拯救患者生命或提高生活质量。人的心脏有四个瓣膜以控制血液经心脏向单一方向流动。当瓣膜发生病变.如瓣狭窄或.闭锁不全，需用人工瓣膜进行替换。
explanation_en: Artificial devices that can replace the function of heart valves, used as replacements for diseased heart valves, to save patients' lives or improve their quality of life. The human heart has four valves to control the flow of blood through the heart in a single direction. When valve disease occurs, such as valve stenosis or incomplete closure, an artificial valve needs to be replaced.

explanation_cn: 将工件加热到适当温度保温适当时间.使时效过程快速进行的T艺过程。原则上时效处理、马氏体回火处理、去应力退火等均属于人工时效.但因为都有专门的工艺名称，故人工时效往往特指铸件加热到适当温度保温消除内应力而稳定的处理工艺。
explanation_en: The process of heating the workpiece to an appropriate temperature and holding it for an appropriate time to make the aging process fast. In principle, aging treatment, martensite tempering treatment, stress-relief annealing, etc. are all artificial aging. However, because they all have special process names, artificial aging often refers to the stable treatment process of casting heating to appropriate temperature to eliminate inner stress.

explanation_cn: 为较快获得材料气候曝露结果.在特定的实验宰条件下进行的加速老化。为了取得加速老化效果，实验室的曝露条件比实际曝露在室外的条件要强烈得多。
explanation_en: Accelerated aging conducted under specific experimental conditions in order to quickly obtain the results of climate exposure of materials. In order to achieve the effect of accelerated aging, the exposure conditions in the laboratory are much stronger than the actual outdoor exposure conditions.

explanation_cn: 是指用人工方法培育的透明石英晶体。用水溶液温差法或提拉法生长。生长过程中常见的宏观缺陷有包裹物，裂隙及双晶。
explanation_en: It refers to transparent quartze crystal artificially cultivated. Water solution temperature difference method or pulling method method. The common macroscopic defects in the growth process are inclusions, cracks and twin.

explanation_cn: 能用于替换眼球白玻璃体并具有维持眼球的形状及屈光功能的透明材料。在某些眼外科手术时。因致患者眼白玻璃体泄漏或玻璃体发生变件，如玻璃体结晶、液化、萎缩，为提高玻璃体透明度，需要用玻璃体来替换或填充。研发的材料有葡聚糖、海藻酸盐、甲基纤维素、硅油、胶原、软脂酸（紫外线交联）、聚乙烯醇（交联）等。上述材料只能用于暂时性替代物。13前临床长期使用的唯一玻璃体是高黏度硅油（1000-5000cP)。这只是最后的选择，因为眼白注入硅油，由于它不够稳定，可能引发并发症。如青光眼、角膜浑浊、油乳化及视网膜毒性。目前尚无长期完美无缺的产品。聚合物在长期使用时，即便是交联的也会发生降解吸收和透明度下降等问题。
explanation_en: Transparent materials that can be used to replace the white vitreous body of the eyeball and has the function of maintaining the shape and refraction of the eyeball. During certain eye surgery procedures. To improve the transparency of the vitreous body, it is necessary to replace or fill it with a vitreous body due to leakage or deformation of the vitreous body, such as crystallization, liquefaction, or atrophy. The materials developed include dextran, alginate, ethyl cellulose, silicone oil, collagen, palmitic acid (UV crosslinking), polyvinyl alcohol (crosslinking), etc. The above materials can only be used as temporary substitutes. The only vitreous used for a long time in clinical practice was silicone oil with high viscosity (1000-5000cP). This is only the last choice, because the injection of silicone oil into the eye white may cause complications because it is not stable enough. Such as glaucoma, corneal opacity, oil emulsification, and retinal toxicity. There is currently no long-term flawless product available. When polymer is used for a long time, even if it is crosslinking, degradation, absorption, transparency and other problems will occur.

explanation_cn: 用高分子半透膜包裹生物活性物质（酶、辅酶、蛋ft质、氨基酸等）模拟人体细胞功能的微囊,，半透膜具有隔离作用，它可使包裹仵囊内的生物大分子（酶、抗原、抗体等）免受外界环境的污染或破坏.而小分子营养物（葡萄糖等）、电解质4自由地跨膜进行交换.这一隔离体系可以保证旗内活性生物反应的顺利进行。
explanation_en: The polymeric semipermeable membrane is used to wrap the microcapsules with bioactivity substances (enzymes, coenzymes, egg yolks, amino acids, etc.) that mimic the function of human cells. The semipermeable membrane has the function of isolation, which can protect the biomacromolecule (enzymes, antigens, antibodies, etc.) wrapped in the microcapsules from the pollution or damage of the external environment. The small molecule nutrients (glucose, etc.) Elonrolyte 4 freely exchanges across the membrane. This isolation system can ensure the smooth progress of the active biological reaction in the flag.

explanation_cn: 是植入中耳替换损坏的生物耳听骨的植入体。以恢复传导性耳聋症患者的听力。人工耳听骨的基本形态是与轴杆连接的盘状物，其轴杆为中空杆或实心扞。前者与耳蹬骨头部连接，后者直接与耳蹬骨底板连接。制作人工耳听骨的材料主要是生物陶瓷及金属材料。早期有高分子材料如高密度聚乙烯海绵、多孔聚甲基丙烯酸酯等。但具有一定的排异反应。采用多孔结构是为了使组织长入孔隙而实现生物固定。生物陶瓷有磷酸钙基生物陶瓷。其可与组织形成键合，从而可牢固地同定植入体。具有优良的生物相容性。研究结果表明，羟基磷灰石与骨形态发生蛋白复合物能诱导骨生长。优于单纯的羟基磷灰石。20世纪80年代后，钛质耳听骨进入临床使用，因为它相容性好、质轻、塑性强、声导功能佳、与蹬骨连接牢固。而且钛表面氧化层有利于细胞生长。目前国内已广泛用于临床。
explanation_en: It is a implantation to replace the damaged biological ear ossicles in the middle ear. To restore hearing in patients with conductive hearing loss. The basic form of the ossicular replacement prosthesis is a disc connected with an axis rod, which is a hollow rod or a solid shield. The former is connected to the head of the ear pedal, while the latter is directly connected to the base plate of the ear pedal. The materials used to make artificial ear ossicles are mainly biological cemmics and metallic materials. In the early days, there were macromolecule materials, such as high density polyethylene sponge, porous polymethacrylate, etc. But it has a certain degree of rejection reaction. The use of porous structure is to achieve biological fixation by allowing tissue to grow into pores. Biological cemmics include bioceramics based on calcium phosphate. It can form a bond with the tissue, thereby firmly anchoring the implant. It has excellent biocompatibility. The results showed that hydroxyapatite and bone morphogenetic protein complex could induce bone growth. It is superior to pure hydroxyapatite. After the 1980s, titanium ear ossicles came into clinical use because of its good compatibility, light weight, strong plasticity, good sound conduction function, and firm connection with the pedal bone. Moreover, the oxide layer on the surface of titanium is beneficial for cell growth. Currently, it has been widely used in clinical practice in China.

explanation_cn: 一种电子装置，由体外言语处理器将声音转换为一定编码形式的电信号，通过植入体内的电极系统直接兴奋听神经来恢复或重建聋人的听觉功能。近年来，随着电子技术、计算机技术、语音学、电生理学、材料学、耳显微外科学的发展，人工耳蜗已经从实验研究进入临床应用。
explanation_en: An electronic device that converts sound into a certain coded electrical signal by an external speech processor, and directly excites the auditory nerve through an electrode system implanted in the body to restore or reconstruct the hearing function of the deaf. In recent years, with the development of electronic technology, computer technology, phonetics, electrophysiology, materials, and otomicrosurgery, cochlear implant has entered clinical application from experimental research.

explanation_cn: 用于替代或修复因疾病、外伤或先天性畸形而损坏的生物耳鼓膜的植入体。生物耳鼓膜对进入外耳道的声波产生共振，并将其通过听小骨等传递至听觉神经。临床上对耳鼓膜的修复通常采用自体（颞肌筋膜、软骨及软骨膜）或异体（异体角膜、羊膜、脑膜、心包膜）组织移植。用组织T程构建的膜（脱细胞真皮质黏膜）进行修复取得了较好的结果。入工耳鼓膜可由生物降解的聚羟基乙酸、丝素蛋白、骨胶原、硅橡胶等制作，但尚未进入临床应用。上述各种修复鼓膜的方法各有自身的缺点。需要进一步改进和发展。
explanation_en: The implant is used to replace or repair the biological eardrum damaged by disease, trauma or congenital malformation. The biological eardrum membrane resonates with sound waves entering the external auditory canal and transmits them to the auditory nerve through the auditory ossicles. In clinical practice, the repair of the eardrum membrane usually involves autologous (temporal muscle fascia, cartilage, and perichondrium) or allogeneic (allogeneic cornea, amnion, meninges, and pericardium) tissue transplantation. The membrane constructed using tissue T pathway (acellular true cortical mucosa) has achieved good results in repair. The tympanic membrane can be made of biodegradation polyglycolic acid, silk fibroin, bone collagen, silicone rubber, etc., but it has not yet entered clinical application. Each of the above methods for repairing the eardrum has its own drawbacks. Further improvement and development are needed.

explanation_cn: 又称人工肝支持系统（artificialliversupportsystem)-。能替代肝脏的解毒、合成、代谢等功能的装置。肝脏是人体中极其重要且复杂的器官。具有化学工厂之称。急性肝衰竭是医学疑难病症，人工肝可暂时替代患者肝功能（部分），使受损肝脏得以修复或为进行肝移植创造时间。按其功能可分为非生物型和生物型两种。前者有血液透析(MARS肝透析）、血液滤过、血液置换以及血液灌流（吸附剂）。这些技术和装置具有肝脏的解毒功能，已获临床应用。另一类是生物型人工肝。它将体外培养的肝细胞置于生物反应器，利用体外循环装置，将肝衰竭患者的血液引入反应器，通过半透膜（中空纤维）与细胞进行物质交换和生物相互作用。从而实现肝脏的全部生理功能。反应器可分为以下类型，即中空纤维型。平板和单层型及灌流床型/微载体支架等型。反应器白的半透膜由醋酸纤维素、聚砜、聚丙烯腈、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯、聚乙烯-乙烯醇等制成。能允许100000分子量以下物质通过。阻止细胞及免疫球蛋甶等通透。起到隔离作用。反应器白常用细胞包括原代猪肝细胞、人肝细胞、C3A细胞和人胚胎干细胞等。
explanation_en: It is also called artificial liver support system. A device that can replace the detoxification, synthesis, metabolism and other functions of the liver. The liver is an extremely important and complex organ in the human body. It is known as a chemical factory. Acute liver failure is a difficult medical disease. artificial liver can temporarily replace the liver function (part) of patients, so that the damaged liver can be repaired or create time for liver transplantation. According to its function, it can be divided into two types: non biological and biological. The former includes hemodialysis (MARS liver dialysis), hemofiltration, blood exchange and hemoperfusion (adsorbent). These technologies and devices have detoxification functions of the liver and have been clinically applied. The other is biological artificial liver. It places the cultured hepatocytes in vitro in a bioreactor, uses the extracorporeal circulation device to introduce the blood of patients with liver failure into the reactor, and conducts material exchange and biological interaction with cells through the semipermeable membrane (hollow fiber). Thus achieving all physiological functions of the liver. Reactors can be divided into the following types, namely hollow fiber type. Flat and single-layer type, perfusion bed type/micro carrier stem, etc. The semi permeable membrane of the reactor white is made of cellulose acetate, polysulfone, polyacrylonitrile, polymethyl methacrylate, polyethylene vinyl alcohol, etc. Can allow substances with a molecular weight of less than 100000 to pass through. Prevent cells and immune globules from spreading and penetrating. It serves as an isolation function. The commonly used cells in the reactor include primary pig liver cells, human liver cells, C3A cells, and human embryonic stem cells.

explanation_cn: 能够使循环的液体、氧、二氧化碳进行可控交换的装置。入工肺是一项生命支持技术。在自身肿功能出现衰竭。不能提供入体器官充分氧时使用，植入入体后，部分或完全替代入体肺功能，。入:肺自从1953年首次应用于临床以来已经历了半个世纪的发展。技术日趋成熟。使用范围也越来越广。
explanation_en: A device that enables controlled exchange of circulating liquids, oxygen, and carbon dioxide. Occupational lung is a life support technology. Failure in self swelling function. It is used when sufficient oxygen cannot be provided for the implanted organ. After implantation, it will partially or completely replace the implanted lung function,. Lung has undergone half a century of development since its first clinical application in 1953. Technology is becoming increasingly mature. The scope of use is also becoming wider and wider.

explanation_cn: 是一种能替代（部分）肾脏功能的装置。主要用于治疗肾功能衰竭和尿毒症。将血液引出体外利用透析、过滤、吸附、膜分离等技术，将体内毒物如尿素、肌酐、尿酸、β-微球蛋白等新陈代谢产物及逾量药物排出体外（俗称洗血）。
explanation_en: It is a device that can replace (partially) kidney function. Mainly used for the treatment of renal failure and uremia. Using techniques such as dialysis, filtration, adsorption, and membrane separation to extract blood from the body, toxins such as urea, creatinine, uric acid β- Metabolites such as microglobulin and excess drugs are excreted from the body (commonly known as blood washing).

explanation_cn: 能模拟人体胰腺分泌生理胰岛素的一种植入装置。糖尿病患者闲胰脏受损.导致胰岛素分泌过少，血糖远高于正常范围，如得不到控制会导致并发症，如失明和心率衰竭。
explanation_en: It is an implantation device that can simulate the secretion of physiological insulin by human pancreas. The idle pancreas of diabetes patients is damaged, resulting in too little insulin secretion and blood sugar far above the normal range. If not controlled, it will lead to complications, such as blindness and heart failure.

explanation_cn: 用于修复或替换人体肌腱以恢复关节活动功能的一种软组织修复体。人体肌腱可视为是一种高分子复合材料。由高度取向排列的胶原包埋亍黏多糖和无定形弹性形成的基质中构成，其中胶原含量（干重）达75%以上，其应力松弛行为在低应变区类似于聚乙烯等高分子材料，高应变区则很快松弛。人工肌腱常由高分子及其复合材料配合硅橡胶等隔离膜构成，如硅橡胶与涤纶复合材料-碳纤维与聚乳酸等可生物降解高分子复合材料。人丁肌腱材料在体白诱导胶原定向排列沉积形成类似生物肌瞇的组织，硅橡胶体白植入后在弹件的植入体表面形成新的柔软、光滑的结缔组织鞘管，促进滑膜细胞增生和分泌少量滑膜液，可作为预防肌腱移植后发生粘连的隔离膜。此外可用于人工腱的高分子还有尼龙、聚氯乙烯、聚四氟乙烯等。近年来。人们开始尝试二维和三维细胞模型修复肌腱。可望实现肌腱的再生。如具有应变特性的纤维蛋白凝胶与维细胞培养的联合应用。在这个体系中，细胞从骨髓进入具有生物相容性的纤维蛋白凝胶并得到拉伸。调整细胞的生长，随着细胞的成长，延伸形成类似于肌腱组织中的纤维蛋白束。通过改变施加的应力可以控制细胞的生长和增殖。
explanation_en: A soft tissue prosthesis used to repair or replace human tendons to restore the function of joint movement. Human tendon can be regarded as a macromolecule composite materials. It is composed of highly orientation collagen embedded in the matrix formed by mucopolysaccharide and amorphous elasticity, in which the content of collagen (dry weight) is more than 75%. Its stress release behavior is similar to that of macromolecule materials such as polyethylene in the low strain zone, and it relaxes quickly in the high strain zone. Artificial tendons are often composed of macromolecule and their composite materials with silicone rubber and other isolation membranes, such as silicone rubber and polyester composite materials - carbon fibers and polylactic acid and other biodegradation macromolecule composite materials. Human tendon materials induces collagen directional arrangement and deposition in vivo to form a tissue similar to biological muscle squint. After silicone rubber body white implantation, new soft and smooth connective tissue sheath tubes are formed on the surface of the implant of the projectile, promoting synovial cell proliferation and secreting a small amount of synovial fluid, which can be used as an isolation membrane to prevent adhesion after tendon transplantation. In addition, macromolecule that can be used for artificial tendon include nylon resin, polyvinyl chloride, polylctrafluorocthylone, etc. In recent years. People began to try two-dimensional and three-dimensional cell model to repair tendons. It is expected to achieve tendon regeneration. For example, the combination of fibrin gel with strain characteristics and vascular cell culture. In this system, cells from bone marrow enter the fibrin gel with biocompatibility and are stretched. Adjust the growth of cells and as they grow, extend to form fibrin bundles similar to those in tendon tissue. By changing the applied stress, cell growth and proliferation can be controlled.

explanation_cn: 可替代人体血管的管形植人物。由于血管与血液直接接触.必须具有优良的血液相容性，即具有抗凝血性和不影响血液组成的性能。
explanation_en: A tubular implant that can replace human blood vessels. Due to the direct contact between blood vessels and blood, it must have excellent Wood compatibility, that is, it has anticoagulant properties and does not affect the blood composition.

explanation_cn: 是指具有类似天然骨结构和/或功能的，用人工材料制造的骨缺损填充或替代材料。主要包括：高分子合成材料人工骨，如聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯、高密度聚乙烯、聚砜、聚左旋乳酸、乙醇酸共聚物、液晶向增强聚乳酸、自增强聚乙醇酸等；无机非金属材料人工骨，如氧化铝、氧化锆生物陶瓷、羟基磷灰石、磷酸三钙、生物活性玻璃等；高分子/生物陶瓷（玻璃）复合人骨，如聚乳酸/羟基磷灰石（生物玻璃）、聚己白酯/羟基磷灰石（圭物玻璃〉等复合材料。
explanation_en: It refers to the bone defect made of artificial materials that has similar structure and/or function to natural bone and is filled or replaced with materials. It mainly includes: macromolecule synthetic materials artificial bone, such as polymethyl methacrylate, high density polyethylene, polysulfone, poly (L-lactic acid), glycolic acid copolymer, liquid crystal reinforced poly (lactic acid), self reinforced poly (glycolic acid), etc; Inorganic nonmetallic materials artificial bone, such as alumina, zirconia bioceramics, hydroxyapatite, tricalcium phosphate, bioactive glass, etc; Macromolecule/biological cemmics (glass) composition human bones, such as composite materials such as polylactic acid/hydroxyapatite (bioglass), polyhexyl white ester/hydroxyapatite (Guiwu glass).

explanation_cn: 以木材或非木材植物纤维材料为主要原料.加工成各种材料单元.施加(或不施加）胶黏剂和其他添加剂，组坯胶合而成的板材或成型制品，主要包括胶合板、刨花板、纤维板及其表面装饰板等。
explanation_en: With wood or non wood plant fiber materials as the main raw material, it is processed into various materials units. With (or without) adhesive and other additive, the panels or molded products, mainly including plywood, particleboard, fiberboard and its surface decoration board, are glued together.

explanation_cn: 指由人工方法制得的石墨材料。主要包括用易石墨化性的焦粒作填料、沥青作黏合剂，混合固化后的成型物烧结炭化，再经石墨化处理得到的石墨材料；非石墨化炭融人到金属熔融体中.再析出形成的具有高度结晶的集结石墨，烃类化合物化学气相沉积析出的热解石墨等。
explanation_en: It refers to graphite materials made by artificial method. It mainly includes the use of coke particles easy to graphitization as filler, pitch as adhesive, sintering and carbonization of curing molded products, and then graphitization treatment to obtain graphite materials; The non graphitization carbon is melted into the molten metal, and then precipitated to form highly crystallized agglomerated graphite, and pyrolytic graphite from chemical vapor deposition of hydrocarbon compounds.

explanation_cn: 用人工方法使非金刚石结构的石墨或气相碳原子发生相变转化而成的金刚石。人造金刚石的合成方法多达十几种。
explanation_en: Diamond is formed by artificially transforming non diamond graphite or gaseous carbon atoms into phase change. There are more than ten synthetic methods for synthetic diamond.

explanation_cn: 介入材料指介入诊断和治疗中的配件、导管、导丝以及植入人体管腔内的专用器械。介入材料的发展.赋予了传统意义上的内科诊疗与外科诊疗崭新的内涵。
explanation_en: Intervention materials refer to accessories, catheter, guide wire and special devices implantation into human lumens during interventional diagnosis and treatment. The development of intervention materials has endowed the traditional medical diagnosis and surgical treatment with new connotation.

explanation_cn: 根据国际纯粹与应用化学联合会（the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry; IUPA?)的规定，介孔材料是指孔径介于2-50nm的一类多孔材料。
explanation_en: According to the provisions of the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry; IUPA?, mesoporous materials refer to a class of porous materials with pore diameters between 2-50nm.

explanation_cn: 电介质在电场作用下，介质由介电状态变为导电状态的现象。相应的临界电场强度称为介电强度、电气强度或击穿电场强度。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that dielectric changes from dielectric state to conductive state under the action of electric field. The corresponding critical electric field strength is called dielectric strength, electrical strength, or breakdown electric field strength.

explanation_cn: 介电相位角的正弦值。实际上也是反映介电损耗的物理量。在计算一个平板电容器的能量损耗时，当施加交变电压，将产生一个周期性的交变电场。
explanation_en: The sine value of the dielectric phase angle. In fact, it is also a physical quantity reflecting diekctric loss. When calculating the energy loss of a flat capacitor, applying alternating voltage will generate a periodic alternating electric field.

explanation_cn: 介电常数反映了在电场作用下介质极化的程度。液晶分子长轴方 向的介电常数e/和短轴方向的介电常数是不一样的。
explanation_en: The dielectric constant reflects the degree of dielectric polarization under the action of electric field. The dielectric constant e/in the long axis direction of liquid crystal molecules is different from the dielectric constant in the short axis direction.

explanation_cn: 反映电介质在交变电场作用下，介电性质随频率而变化的现象。
explanation_en: It reflects the phenomenon that the dielectric property of dielectric changes with frequency under the action of alternating electric field.

explanation_cn: 表征介质材料的 电性质或极化性质的物理参数。使用某种电介质的电容器的电容量与同样几何尺寸的真空电容器的电容量的比值?称为该电介质的相对介电常数h.无量纲.。
explanation_en: Physical parameters that characterize the electrical properties or polarization properties of the dielectric materials. What is the ratio of the capacitance of a capacitor using a certain dielectric to the capacitance of a vacuum capacitor with the same geometric size? It is called the relative dielectric constant h. dimensionless of the dielectric.

explanation_cn: 见介电谱。
explanation_en: See dielectric spectrum.

explanation_cn: 电介质在电场作用下，由于带电质点之间的库仑力、电致伸缩效应或诱导极化产生应变等原因所引起的应力现象。有些脆性材料（如陶瓷）在远低于击穿强度时，在电场造成的机械应力作用下.介质也可能破坏。对于压电体，在外电场作用下，通过逆压电效应产生应变及应力，应力的大小与压电效应的强弱，外电场及边界条件有关。
explanation_en: Under the action of electric field, the stress phenomenon of dielectric is caused by coulomb force between charged particles, electrostriction effect or induced polarization strain. Some brittle materials (such as ceramics) may also be damaged under the mechanical stress caused by electric field when they are far below the breakdown strength. For piezoelectric body, strain and stress are generated by inverse piezoelectric effect under the action of external electric field. The magnitude of stress is related to the strength of piezoelectric effect, external electric field and boundary conditions.

explanation_cn: 电介质在电场作用下，由于电致伸缩效应或逆压电效应（对压电体而言）产生应变的现象。作为弹性介质，在外力作用下 也会产生应变.但作为电介质材料，介电应变主要指电场作用下的应变现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that dielectric produces strain due to electrostriction effect or inverse piezoelectric effect (for piezoelectric body) under the action of electric field. As a elasticity medium, it will also produce strain under the external force. But as a dielectric materials, the dielectric strain mainly refers to the strain phenomenon under the electric field.

explanation_cn: 电介质在电场作用下，单位时间内消耗的能量包括漏电损耗、电离损耗、极化损耗和结构损耗等。这种能量损耗表现为介质发 热。介质损耗与材料组成、工作频率、环境温度、湿度、载荷大小和作用时间有关。
explanation_en: Under the action of electric field, the energy consumed by dielectric in unit time includes leakage loss, ionization loss, polarization loss and structure loss. This energy loss is manifested as medium heating. Dielectric loss is related to materials composition, operating frequency, ambient temperature, humidity, load size and action time.

explanation_cn: 指电介质在交变电场作用下有功功率与无功功率的比值，是表征电介质损耗大小的一个无量纲物理量。
explanation_en: It refers to the ratio of active power and reactive power of dielectric under the action of alternating electric field. It is a dimensionless physical quantity representing the loss of dielectric.

explanation_cn: 又称电介质.是具有电极化特性的一类材料。介电材料内部没有可以自由移动的电荷，但当受到外电场作用时.正负电荷 发生位移.偏离对称中心，产生极化.或已有的自发极化偶极子沿电场方向进行重排.形成电偶极矩。
explanation_en: Also known as dielectric, it is a kind of materials with electric polarization characteristics. There is no charge that can move freely inside the dielectric materials, but when subjected to the external electric field, the positive and negative charges will shift and deviate from the symmetry center, resulting in polarization, or the existing spontaneous polarization dipoles will rearrange along the direction of the electric field to form the electric dipole moment.

explanation_cn: 在外电场作用下，电介质内部质点（原子、离子、分子和其他荷电 质点）沿电场方向呈现微观尺度的相对位移而产生诱导电偶极矩的现象。
explanation_en: Under the action of external electric field, the particles (atoms, ions, molecules and other charged particles) inside dielectric show micro scale relative displacement along the direction of electric field, resulting in the phenomenon of induced electric dipole moment.

explanation_cn: 又称电介质损耗角。反映电介质在交变电场作用下，电位移与电 场强度的位相差。在交变电场作用下.根据电场频率，介质种类的不同，其介电行为可能产生两种情况。一种是电位移与电场强度在时间上没有位相差，此时极化强度与交变电场同位相。对正弦交变电场而言，介质电容器的充电电流刚好超前电压Π/2。另一 种情况是电位移与电场强度存在位相差。对于正弦交 变电场来说，电容电流超前于电压的相角小于Π/2。
explanation_en: Also called dielectric loss angle. It reflects the phase difference between electric displacement and electric field strength of dielectric under the action of alternating electric field. Under the action of an alternating electric field, the dielectric behavior may vary depending on the frequency of the electric field and the type of medium. One is that there is no phase difference between the electric displacement and the electric field intensity in time, and the polarization intensity is in phase with the alternating electric field. For sinusoidal alternating electric fields, the charging current of dielectric capacitors is just ahead of the voltage Π/ 2. Another situation is that there is a potential difference between the potential shift and the electric field strength. For a sinusoidal alternating electric field, the phase angle of the capacitor current leading the voltage is less than Π/ 2.

explanation_cn: 电介质在交变电场作用下，介电常数随频率而变化的一种物理现象。电介质的色散频率与极化机制有关。当频率为零或很 低时（例如lkHz).离子位移极化、电子位移极化和固有电矩的转向极化对其都有贡献.此时的介电常数 e(0)对于一定的电介质而言为常数。
explanation_en: A physical phenomenon that the dielectric constant of dielectric changes with frequency under the action of alternating electric field. The dispersion frequency of dielectric is related to the polarization mechanism. When the frequency is zero or very low (such as lkHz), ion displacement polarization, electronic displacement polarization and the turning of the intrinsic electric moment polarization all contribute to it. At this time, the dielectric constant e (0) is a constant for a certain dielectric.

explanation_cn: 又称介电常数频谱。复介电常数随电磁场频率而变化的现象，一般分别做出实部，频谱和虚部介电谱可以给出有关极化机制和晶格振动等重要信息。
explanation_en: Also called dielectric constant spectrum. For the phenomenon that the complex dielectric constant changes with the frequency of the electromagnetic field, the real part, the spectrum and the imaginary part dielectric spectrum can give important information about the polarization mechanism and lattice vibration.

explanation_cn: 表征电介质因电导和极化滞后效应而在其内部引起能量损耗程度 的因数，一般用介电损耗角正切来表示。
explanation_en: The factor representing the degree of energy loss caused by dielectric due to the hysteresis effect of conductivity and polarization is generally expressed as the tangent of dielectric loss angle.

explanation_cn: 基于量子理论，不引入任何来自实验测定的经验参数，利用计算机对材料进行的计算和预测的一类方法。在化学计算中：指基于量子力学基本原理直接求解薛定谔方程的量子化学计算方法。从头计算法的特点是没有经验参数，并且对体系不作过多的简化。对各种不同的化学体系采用基本枏同的方法进行计算。目前的从头计算法包括基于哈特里-福克方程的哈特里福克方法，在哈特里-福克基础上引入电子相关作用校正而发展起来的后哈特里-福克方法，以及多组态多参考态方法等。与半经验方法相比.从头计算法精度高，但耗时长。计算时若加人一些经验参数，可以大大加快计算速度，当然也会不可避免的牺牲计算结果精度。
explanation_en: Based on quantum theory, without introducing any empirical parameters from experimental measurements, it is a kind of method that uses computers to calculate and predict materials. In chemical calculation: refers to the quantum chemistry calculation method based on the basic principles of quantum mechanics to directly solve the Schrodinger equation. The characteristic of ab initio calculation method is that it has no empirical parameters and does not make too many simplifications to the system. Calculate various chemical systems using the same basic method. The current ab initio methods include the Hartley Fogg method based on the Hartley Fogg equation, the post Hartley Fogg method developed by introducing electron correlation correction on the basis of Hartley Fogg, and the multi configuration multi reference state method. Compared with semi empirical methods, ab initio calculation method has higher accuracy but longer time consumption. Adding some empirical parameters during calculation can greatly accelerate the calculation speed, but of course, it will inevitably sacrifice the accuracy of the calculation results.

explanation_cn: 半导体中处于化学键（如共价键）中的电子所处的能带。价带是由成键电子的所有量子态组成的。在理想的热力学零度下，价带 中填满了成键电子。在一定温度或受外界激发时，价带中的电子可被激发到导带或禁带中的能级而留下电子的空位，这些电子的空位可用假想粒子"空穴"来描述。空穴带正电，可看成有效质量为的粒子。
explanation_en: The energy band of the electrons in the chemical bond (such as covalent bond) in a semiconductor. The valence band is composed of all the quantum states of the bonding electrons. At ideal thermodynamics zero, the valence band is filled with bonding electrons. At a certain temperature or under external excitation, the electrons in the valence band can be excited to the energy level in the conduction band or forbidden band, leaving vacancy of electrons. The vacancy of these electrons can be described by imaginary particle "holes". The hole is positively charged and can be regarded as a particle with effective mass.

explanation_cn: 原子由共价键结合的化合物。假定原子组成分子时，在未化合前原子含有未成对电子，如其电子自旋相反，可两两偶合配成电子对，从而生成共价键。价键化合物可分为四类：正常价键化合物、多阴或多阳离子化合物 (一般价键化合物）、正四面体结构化合物、缺陷四面体结构化合物。
explanation_en: Compounds whose atoms are bound by covalent bond. It is assumed that when atoms are composed of molecules, they contain unpaired electrons before they are combined. If the spin of the electrons is opposite, they can couple to form an electron pair, thus forming a covalent bond. Valence bond compound can be divided into four categories: normal valence bond compound, multi anion or multi cation compounds (general valence bond compound), tetrahedral structure compounds and defective tetrahedral structure compounds.

explanation_cn: 用物理或化学改性方法，制成外观和穿着性能具有真丝风格的合成纤维。仿丝型纤维还只能在风格上取得类似于丝绸的效果。追求的风格主要是光泽感和宇感的仿真，仿丝型纤维原料，主要是涤纶长丝，其次是醋酯长丝，锦纶以短纤维纱为主。
explanation_en: The synthetic fiber with silk style in appearance and wearability is made by physical or chemical modification. Silk like fibers can only achieve a style similar to silk. The style pursued is mainly the simulation of gloss and cosmology. Silk like fiber materials are mainly polyester filamem, followed by acetate filamem, and nylon is mainly staple fiber yarn.

explanation_cn: 在发生宏观变形时，物体内部的体元或微观结构的形变和物体外形的变化是相似的。
explanation_en: When macro deformation occurs, the deformation of the volume element or microstructure inside the object is similar to the change of the object shape.

explanation_cn: 用物理或化学方法，制成在形态结构、观感及性能方面类似动物毛的合成纤维。主要是模仿羊毛纤维的形态结构和性能的化学纤维，使其各种物理化学性能，特别是纤维物理性能方面达到或接近羊毛纤维的性能要求。该类纤维经后续加工成的织物具有类似毛织物的风格。
explanation_en: Synthetic fiber similar to animal hair in morphology, structure, appearance and performance is made by physical or chemical methods. It is mainly a man-made fiber that imitates the morphological structure and performance of wool fiber to make its various physical chemistry properties, especially the physical properties of the fiber meet or approach the performance requirements of wool fiber. The fabric made from this type of fiber after subsequent processing has a style similar to wool fabric.

explanation_cn: 是借助人工敏感元件或生物敏感元件（微生物、酶、细胞、组织或其他生物活性物质）能够对来自环境的刺激（光、电、生化、热、力学等）做出快速响应的特性，通过换能器将这些响应转换成可以检测的电信号来模拟生物的感知功能（嗅觉、味觉、听觉、触觉等〉的传感器。
explanation_en: It is a sensor that can make rapid response to irritation from the environment (light, electricity, biochemistry, heat, mechanics, etc.) with the help of artificial sensors or biosensors (microorganisms, enzymes, cells, tissues, or other bioactivity substances), and convert these responses into detectable electrical signals through transducers to simulate biological perception functions (smell, taste, hearing, touch, etc.).

explanation_cn: 参照生物材料的规律设计并制造的复合材料。天然生物材料大都为复合材料，经过长时间进化为最优化的材料，即以最少的消耗达到最高的效能。从材料科学的观点对生物材料进行观察、测试、分析、计算、归纳、抽象，找出有用的规律来指导复合材料的设计和研制。通过研究天然复合材料诸如木材、密质骨骼结构、贝壳珍珠层、昆虫外骨骼和前后翅等的细观结构、组织层次和力学机理等对复合材料前沿的开拓和发展提供新的视角。仿生复合材料不仅可以参照生物体的结构来设计优良的结构用材料，同时也可以仿效其功能发展功能复合材料。
explanation_en: Composite materials designed and manufactured according to the laws of biological materials. Most of natural biomaterials are composite materials, which have evolved into optimized materials over a long period of time, that is, to achieve the highest efficiency with the least consumption. From the perspective of materials science, biological materials are observed, tested, analyzed, calculated, summarized and abstracted, and useful rules are found to guide the design and development of composite materials. The research on the microstructure, organizational level and mechanical mechanism of natural composite materials such as wood, dense skeleton structure, shell pearl layer, insect exoskeleton and front and rear wings provides a new perspective for the development of composite materials. Biomimetic composite can not only refer to the structure of organisms to design excellent structural materials, but also imitate their functions to develop functional composite materials.

explanation_cn: 指从自然界获得灵感而制备出的材料，包括受自然界存在的物质和结构、发生的现象以及相关的形成机理的启发.通过材料组成和结构的设计，借助常规的或新颖的加工或合成方法得到的具有特定或突出功能的材料。
explanation_en: It refers to materials prepared from the inspiration of nature, including materials with special or prominent functions, which are inspired by the substances and structures existing in nature, the phenomena occurring in nature and the relevant formation mechanism, through the design of the composition and structure of materials, and by conventional or novel processing or synthesis methods.

explanation_cn: 在形态结构、观感及性能方面类似天然纤维的化学纤维，或模仿天然纤维和人的皮肤的接触感而制造的化学纤维。
explanation_en: Man-made fiber similar to natural fiber in shape, structure, appearance and performance, or man-made fiber manufactured by imitating the contact between natural fiber and human skin.

name_cn: 仿生结构设计陶瓷基复合材料
name_en: bionic structure design ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 根据自然界材料的增韧构建原理设计的强韧化的陶瓷材料。如从贝壳珍珠等生物材料结构启发而提出的增韧机制，设计出由高模量和低模量两种陶瓷组分构建的复合材料。高模量陶瓷起承载并增强作用，低模量陶瓷起裂纹偏转作用。根据两种陶瓷相的分布方式，分为层状结构增钿陶瓷基复合材料和纤维独石结构增韧陶瓷基复合材料。
explanation_en: The strengthened and toughened ceramics materials is designed according to the toughening construction principle of natural materials. For example, inspired by the structure of biological materials such as shell pearl, a toughening mechanism was proposed, and a composite materials composed of two ceramics components with high modulus and low modulus was designed. High modulus ceramics play the role of bearing and strengthening, and low modulus ceramics play the role of crack deflection. According to the distribution mode of the two ceramics phase, they are divided into layered structure mother of pearl ceramic matrix composite and fiber monolith structure toughened ceramic matrix composite.

explanation_cn: 用物理或化学改性方法，制成在外观和穿着性能上具有天然麻风格的合成纤维。仿麻型纤维原料有涤纶、腈纶、醋酯纤维和黏胶纤维等。
explanation_en: The synthetic fiber with natural hemp style in appearance and wearability is made by physical or chemical modification. Hemp like fiber materials include polyester, acrylic, cellulose acetate fiber fiber and viscose fiber.

explanation_cn: 又称水白云母。一种含水富钾的层状结构硅酸盐矿物。单斜晶系。呈鳞片状细小晶体，粒径通常在12pm以下。呈白色、浅绿色、浅黄色等。无膨胀性和可塑性。是白云母或钾长石风化的产物。可作为陶器原料。无色或白色者可用作涂料的填料。也可用于制备钾肥。
explanation_en: Also known as water white mica. A layered silicate mineral containing water and rich in potassium. Monoclinic system. It is a small scale like crystal, and the particle size is usually below 12pm. It is white, light green, light yellow, etc. No swelling and plasticity. It is the product of weathering of muscovilte or potassium feldspar. It can be used as raw material for pottery. Colorless or white can be used as filler of coatings. It can also be used to prepare potassium fertilizer.

explanation_cn: 一种以伊利石矿物为主的黏土，外观常呈灰绿、黄绿、灰黄、灰白或灰黑色等多种颜色。具油脂光泽，有油腻感，硬度低.一般为1左右，干燥后会自行碎裂成为小块和粉末。一般为泥质结构或粉砂泥质结构，主要矿物成分为伊利石，其他有绢云母、石英、叶蜡石、高岭石和黄铁矿，有时含有少量的绿泥石、绿帘石等。可在大陆或海洋温暖或寒冷地区的各种酸碱度介质中经风化、沉积或热液蚀变作用形成。由于含钾、铝成分较高，可用在陶瓷烧制及制取钾氯肥、硫酸铝、钾钙肥、磷钾钙肥、三氯化铝、氯化钾等方面和作为造纸原料含杂质较多的不纯.只要有足够的可塑性和黏结性，不含或少含粗大岩块，黏土粒级成分达15%以上，都能用作一般砖瓦的烧制原料。中国主要分布在东部沿海地区。
explanation_en: A kind of clay mainly composed of illite mineral, which is often gray green, yellow green, gray yellow, gray white or gray black in appearance. It has grease luster, greasy feeling, low hardness, generally about 1, and will break into small pieces and powder after drying. It is generally argillaceous texture or silty argillaceous texture, and the main mineral composition is illite. Other minerals include sericite mica, quartze, pyrophyllite, kadinite and pyrite, and sometimes contain a small amount of chlorite, epidote, etc. It can be formed through weathering, sedimentation, or hydrothermal alteration in various pH media in warm or cold regions of the continent or ocean. Due to the high content of potassium and aluminum, it can be used in ceramics firing and making potassium chloride fertilizer, aluminum sulfate, potassium calcium fertilizer, phosphorus potassium calcium fertilizer, aluminum trichloride, potassium chloride and other aspects, as well as as as paper making raw materials containing impurities. As long as it has sufficient plasticity and cohesiveness, does not contain or contains less coarse rock blocks, and clay particle size composition reaches more than 15%, it can be used as the firing raw materials for ordinary bricks and tiles. China is mainly distributed in the eastern coastal areas.

explanation_cn: 以德国科学家伊辛命名的描述物质结构变化的一种统计性模型，基于此模型，可以通过存在于任意晶格点上的粒子自旋变量（取值1或-1)的随机翻转引起的能量变化，模拟研究固体中分子磁矩铁磁性有序化、晶粒长大等问题。
explanation_en: A statistical model named after German scientist Ising to describe the change of material structure. Based on this model, we can simulate and study the molecular magnetic moment ferromagnetism ordering, grain growth and other problems in solids through the energy change caused by the random reversal of the particle spin variable (value 1 or -1) existing at any lattice point.

explanation_cn: 以金属铋为基的一类低熔点合金。
explanation_en: A class of fusible alloy based on bismuth.

explanation_cn: 硫、鳞等杂质及微量残存元素含量的控制要求较高的优等质量钢。我国优质非合金结构钢的硫、磷含量分别不得大于0.040%、0.035%;优质非合金工具钢的硫、磷含量分别不得大于0.030%、0.035%;同时对碳含量的波动范围及镍、铬、铜等残存元素及非金属夹杂的含量也有比普通质量钢更严格的要求。
explanation_en: High quality steel with high requirements for the control of sulfur, scale and other impurities and trace residual elements. The sulfur and phosphorus content of high-quality non alloy structural steel in China shall not exceed 0.040% and 0.035% respectively; The sulfur and phosphorus content of high-quality non alloy tool steel shall not be greater than 0.030% and 0.035% respectively; At the same time, the fluctuation range of carbon content and the content of residual elements such as nickel, chromium, copper and non-metallic inclusions are also more stringent than those of ordinary quality steel.

explanation_cn: 一种具有粗粒、巨粒结构的岩石。常呈脉状产出，有时成群出现。大多呈块状.有时具有带状构造。主要组成矿物为长石、石英和黑云母、白云母，也可有辉石、角闪石等。按矿物组成.可分为花岗、辉长、正长但以花岗为常见。粗大的矿物晶体是的特征，有少数的矿物晶体可达数吨.如中国新疆阿尔泰地区花岗中的绿柱石巨大晶体重达50t左右。与有关的主要矿产是Nb、Ta、Be、Li等稀有金属元素和稀土元素矿床。一些重要的非金属矿床与关系也极为密切。如白云母、水晶、黄玉、刚玉和长石矿床。某些富含钾长石的伟晶岩可作为陶瓷原料;富含钾质的正长伟晶岩是提取钾的原料;具有特殊文象结构的伟晶岩可用作装饰石材。新疆阿尔泰地区近年发现一种含锂云母花岗伟晶i岩，是一种以锂云母集合体为主的岩石，质地细腻，颜色艳丽.是较名贵的紫丁香玉石料。
explanation_en: A rock with coarse and giant grain structure. Often occurring in a vein like manner, sometimes appearing in groups. Most of them are blocky and sometimes have banded structures. The main minerals are feldspar, quartze, biotite, muscovilte, pyroxene, hornblende, etc. According to mineral composition, it can be divided into granite, gabbro, and orthoclase, but granite is common. Coarse mineral crystal are characteristic, and a few mineral crystal can reach several tons. For example, the huge beryl crystal in the granite of Altai region in Xinjiang, China, weighs about 50 tons. The main minerals related to this are rare metal elements such as Nb, Ta, Be, Li, and rare earth element deposits. Some important non-metallic deposits are also closely related. Such as muscovilte, crystal, topaz, corundum and feldspar deposits. Some pegmatite rich in potassium feldspar can be used as raw materials for ceramics; The potassium rich syenite pegmatite is the raw material for extracting potassium; Pegmatite with special graphic texture can be used as decorative stone. In recent years, a lepidolite bearing granitic pegmatite i rock was found in Altai, Xinjiang. It is a rock mainly composed of lepidolite aggregates, fine in texture and bright in color. It is a precious lilac jade material.
