explanation_en: See nucleic acid biosensor (page 305).

explanation_cn: 由一组引燃火工品元件，按激发感度递减和输出能量递增的次序，分级有序地完成燃烧型能量转换、能量控制和能量放大功能的组合体。在弹药和火箭发动机装药中，传火序列第一级首发火工品为敏感元件，在接受电的或非电的激发能量后，火工药剂被激发，由机械能或电能转换成化学能，能量迅速放大，形成火焰冲能，引燃下一级火工品装药，其输出能量再激发下一级火工品，使能量进一步增强并逐级向下传递，直至输出能量能可靠地引燃药筒发射药或火箭推进剂主装药。弹药装置的传火序列能量转换、能量放大和时间控制的分级设计应满足安全、可靠以及适应主装发射药或火箭推进剂在最佳时间内点火和引燃的要求。一般传火序列由点火具或火帽、延期元件、加强药柱、传火元件、引燃药柱、发射装药或推进剂等组成。特定传火序列的组成，应根据点火、引燃装药要求而定。
explanation_en: It is a combination of combustion type energy conversion, energy control and energy amplification functions, which is completed by a group of initiating explosive device elements in order of decreasing excitation sensitivity and increasing output energy. In ammunition and rocket engine charges, the first initiating explosive device in the first stage of the low explosive train is a sensitive element. After receiving electric or non electric excitation energy, the initiating explosives and relative compositions is excited, and the mechanical energy or electrical energy is converted into chemical energy. The energy is rapidly amplified to form flame energy, which ignites the next level of initiating explosive device charge. Its output energy will then excite the next level of initiating explosive device, further enhancing the energy and gradually transmitting it downward, Until the output energy can reliably ignite the cartridge gun propellant or rocket propellant main charge. The graded design of energy conversion, energy amplification and time control of the low explosive train of the ammunition device should meet the requirements of safety, reliability and adaptability to the ignition and ignition of the main gun propellant or rocket propellant in the best time. Generally, low explosive train consists of igniter or cap, delay element, reinforced grain, fire transmission element, pilot grain, propellant charge or propellant, etc. The composition of specific low explosive train shall be determined according to the requirements of ignition and pilot charge.

explanation_cn: 具有一定发展历史、技术成熟的、应用非常广泛的最常见的材料。
explanation_en: The most common materials with certain development history, mature technology and wide application.

explanation_cn: 在传爆序列中用以扩大或传递爆轰波，保证主装药可靠、完全爆轰的一种炸药，是武器弹药中被广泛使用的火工药剂。其对外i界刺激的敏感度介于起爆药和主装药之间，而爆速或爆压高于主装药。通常传爆药可以为单质炸药，如tetryl、HNS，或为添加一定量黏结剂純化和成型的混合炸药，如A-5、CH-6、JH-14、JO-9等。一般传爆药为粉体或制备为造型粉，然后根据需要压制为药柱或装人壳体中使用。在武器弹药爆炸序列中传爆药将起爆药或雷管的输出能量经过传递、放大输出到主装药，从而引爆战斗部，具有承上启下的作用。在民用爆破器材中传爆药用于将雷管的能量放大并可靠起爆主体爆破装药。传爆药在武器弹药和爆破器材中的地位决定了其在性能方面的要求为感度适宜、输出威力高、安全性好。传爆药不仅在常规兵器和爆破器材中使用，而且在航天、导弹、核武器等尖端武器装备方面也不可或缺。其用途包括如下几方面：①在常规弹药引信系统和民用爆破器材中用作导爆管、传爆管及扩爆管装药；②在导弹、原子弹及宇宙飞船中用作传爆装置、同步起爆装置及做功火工品中的装药;③在直列式传爆序列中用作无起爆药雷管装药以取代敏感起爆药；④在爆炸逻辑网络中用作微尺寸导爆索或沟槽装药。
explanation_en: A explosive used in high explosives train to expand or transmit detonation waves and ensure reliable and complete detonation of the main charge. It is a widely used initiating explosives and relative compositions in weapons and ammunition. Its sensitivity to external irritation of I boundary is between the primary explosive and the main charge, while the detonation velocity or pressure is higher than that of the main charge. Generally, booster explosive can be single explosive, such as tetryl and HNS, or composite explosive purified and shaped by adding a certain amount of adhesive, such as A-5, CH-6, JH-14, JO-9, etc. Generally, booster explosive is powder or mould powder, which is then pressing or loaded into the shell for use as required. In the explosion sequence of weapons and ammunition, the booster will transmit and amplify the output energy of primary explosive or detonator to the main charge, thus detonating the warhead, which has a connecting role. In civil blasting equipment, booster explosives are used to amplify the energy of detonators and reliably initiate the main blasting charge. The position of booster explosives in weapons, ammunition, and explosive materials determines their performance requirements in terms of appropriate sensitivity, high output power, and good safety. Booster explosive are not only used in conventional weapons and explosive materials, but also indispensable in sophisticated weapons and equipment such as aerospace, missiles, nuclear weapons, etc. Its uses include the following aspects: ① as a detonating tube, booster tube, and expansion tube charge in conventional ammunition fuse systems and civilian blasting equipment; ② Used as explosive devices, synchronous initiation devices, and explosives in missiles, atomic bombs, and spacecraft; ③ In the in-line high explosives train, it is used as primary explosive free detonator charge to replace sensitive primary explosive; ④ It is used as micro detonating cord or trench charge in explosion logic network.

explanation_cn: 测定传爆药安全性或感度的试验，主要用于评定传爆药受外界刺激，如摩擦、撞击、热、热丝、静电、冲击波等而发生爆轰的难易程度。包括摩擦感度、撞击感度、撞击易损性、篝火、热丝感度、静电感度、真空安定性、冲击波安全性等8项试验。
explanation_en: The test to determine the safety or sensitivity of booster explosive is mainly used to assess the difficulty of detonation of booster explosive caused by external irritation, such as friction, impact, heat, hot wire, static electricity, shock wave, etc. It includes 8 tests, including friction sensitivity, impact sensitivity, impact vulnerability, bonfire, hot wire sensitivity, electrostatic sensitivity, vacuum stability, shock wave safety, etc.

explanation_cn: 用于传感技术的特种光纤的统称。光纤传感器包括了各种物理量、化学量和生物量的测试，其重要性正与日倶增。由于传感不同的被测量，光纤焦也有所不同，例如利用光的偏振态或相位变化进行传感的干涉型传感器.多使用单模光纤或高双折射光纤。用光时域反射法进行温度、形变、压力等测量，则在光纤中适当掺入某些离子，以增强光纤的散射能力。用于磁场测量，常将某鸣顺磁稀土离子掺人光纤以增强这种光纤的法拉第旋光能力。为探测核辐射用的传感光纤则加入某些如铅之类的离子，以增强其探测灵敏度。这些都是传感用的掺杂光纤。利用光纤的外包层也可以改变光纤的传感性能。如在光纤外部镀镍使其产生磁致伸缩效应来对磁场敏感.镀钯以增强对氢气的敏感等。也用某些塑料或涂料来做外包皮，以减少外部声振动的敏感性。这种光纤称为增敏或减敏光纤。
explanation_en: A general term for special optical fiber used in sensing technology. The optical fiber sensor includes the testing of various physical quantities, chemical quantities and biomass, and its importance is increasing day by day. Due to different sensors being measured, the focus of optical fiber is also different. For example, interference sensors that use the polarization state or phase change of light for sensing are usually single mode optical filler or high binefrigence optical fiber. When temperature, deformation and pressure are measured by optical time domain reflection method, some ions are properly doped into optical fiber to enhance the scattering ability of optical fiber. For magnetic field measurement, a certain paramagnetic rare earth ion is often doped into the optical fiber to enhance the Faraday rotation ability of this optical fiber. Some ions such as lead are added to the sensor fiber for detecting nuclear radiation to enhance its detection sensitivity. These are doped optical fiber for sensing. Using the outer layer of optical fiber can also change the sensing performance of optical fiber. For example, nickel plating on the outside of optical fiber makes it produce magnetostriction effect to be sensitive to magnetic field, palladium plating to enhance the sensitivity to hydrogen, etc. Some plastics or coatings are also used as the outer sheath to reduce the sensitivity of external acoustic vibration. This optical fiber is called sensitized or desensitized optical fiber.

explanation_cn: 指以天然硅酸盐矿物为主要原料制成的材料。硅酸盐是地壳中储量最多的一种矿物，分布广.容易采集折合成O2占造岩氧化物总量的60%。同SO2结合组成的氧化物主要有：Al2O3、Mgo、FeO、K2O、TIO2,这些氧化物加在一起约占地壳成分的98%以上。以硅酸盐为主要成分的天然矿物，由于分布广容易采集，很早即被人们作为材料使用。在石器时代直接用以制成工具，史前时代用它作原料制成陶器，随后又发展到用它制成玻璃、瓷器、水泥等各种硅酸盐材料。随着冶金和化学工业的发展，传统硅酸盐材料乂扩大到耐火材料和耐酸材料。目前陶瓷、水泥、玻璃以及耐火材料是传统硅酸盐材料的四大类，用硅酸盐作原料加工制造各种产品时.其加工制作都需进行高温烧成.因此传统硅酸盐材料的制造又被称为窑业。另外，硅酸盐材料在发展过程中，使用原料除以硅酸盐为主要成分的天然硅石、长石和黏土外，也采用了不含氧化硅（SiO2)成分的氧化物和以碳为主的石墨等.按同样的1艺方法也制成了各种制品。虽然其成分不是硅酸盐，但因其制备方法相同，通常也把这些归属于传统硅酸盐材料。传统硅酸盐材料占无机非金属材料的大部分，目前已广泛用于国民经济各个领域。
explanation_en: It refers to materials made from natural silicate mineral. Silicate is the most abundant mineral in the Earth's crust, with a wide distribution and easy collection. It accounts for 60% of the total amount of rock forming oxides, equivalent to O2. The oxides combined with SO2 mainly include Al2O3, Mgo, FeO, K2O, and TiO2, which together account for over 98% of the crustal composition. The natural minerals with silicate as the main component have been used as materials for a long time due to their wide distribution and easy collection. In the Stone Age, it was directly used to make tools. In prehistoric times, it was used as raw material to make pottery. Later, it was used to make glass, porcelain, cement and other silicate materials. With the development of metallurgy and chemical industry, traditional silicate materials are expanded to refractory and acid resistant materials. At present, ceramics, cement, glass and refractory are the four major categories of traditional silicate materials. When using silicate as raw materials to process and manufacture various products, their processing and production need to be fired at high temperature. Therefore, the manufacturing of traditional silicate materials is also called kiln industry. In addition, in the development process of silicate materials, in addition to natural silica, feldspar and clay with silicate as the main component, oxides without silicon oxide (SiO2) and graphite with carbon as the main component are also used. Various products are also made according to the same process. Although its composition is not silicate, it is usually attributed to traditional silicate materials because of the same preparation method. Traditional silicate materials account for the majority of inorganic nonmetallic materials and have been widely used in various fields of the national economy.

explanation_cn: 采用长石、石英、高岭土、瓷石等无机非金属天然矿物为主要原料，添加少量化工原料，经混合、粉碎、磨细、成型、干燥、烧成等工艺制成的产品。分陶器和瓷器两大类，主要用作日用器皿、艺术陈设、建筑和卫生制品等。
explanation_en: The product is made of feldspar, quartze, kaolin, china stone and other inorganic non-metallic natural minerals as the main raw materials, with a small amount of chemical raw materials added, through mixing, crushing, grinding, molding, drying, firing and other processes. It is divided into two major categories: pottery and porcelain, which are mainly used for daily utensils, artistic furnishings, construction and sanitary products.

explanation_cn: 将原料经混合均匀后，放人耐火材料制成的坩埚或池窑中，可用多种方式加热.在氧化或中性气氛中完成粉料的分解、反应、互溶等一系列化学反应和物理作用达到熔融，并在常规条件下进行冷却而制成玻璃。冷却速度102~103Ks，大量的玻璃及绝大部分品种那是通过这种方法获得的。该方法适合多种固体材料的制备，但因冷却速度低，不能使金属、合金或一些离子化合物制成非晶态材料。
explanation_en: After the raw materials are mixed evenly, they are put into a crucible or tank furnace made of refractory materials, which can be heated in various ways. A series of chemical reactions and physical actions such as powder decomposition, reaction, mutual dissolution are completed in an oxidizing or neutral atmosphere to achieve melting, and glass is made by cooling under normal conditions. The cooling rate is 102~103Ks. A large number of glass and most varieties are obtained by this method. This method is suitable for the preparation of a variety of solid materials, but because of the low cooling rate, metals, alloy or some ionic compounds cannot be made into amorphous materials.

explanation_cn: 用于制造远洋、沿海和内河航行的船舶的船体结构的结构钢.主要为板材，也包括部分型钢和管材。船舶钢要求具有较高的强度、较高的韧性、良好的焊接性能和较高的耐海水腐蚀性能。由于船舶制造时整个船体就是一个大型的焊接结构，为了降低焊接工作量缩短建造周期并提高船体结构的整体刚度，大型船舶用钢多采用宽厚板且要求具备大线能量焊接能力（焊接热输人大于50kJcm,最高可达500kJcm).其碳当量不得大于0.45。船舶用结构钢（GB712-2011)主要采用优质低碳结构钢，其牌号采用国际通行表示方法，先用英文字母表示质量等级，目前已大量生产使用要求保证60°C冲击韧性的F级钢；字母后的数字表示屈服强度级别（但数值单位为kgfmm2,lkgfmm2约等于9.8MRi)，目前主要生产使用315~390MPa级；更高强度级别的船舶钢则采用质量等级字母加屈服强度数值（MPa)表示。舰船用钢则多采用合金结构钢(采用性能钢号或代号）.屈服强度级别可达到lOOOMPa以上。
explanation_en: The structural steel used to manufacture the hull structure of ocean going, coastal and inland navigation ships is mainly plate, and also includes some section steel and tube. Hull steel requires high strength, high toughness, good weld performance and high seawater corrosion resistance. Since the whole hull is a large weld structure during ship manufacturing, in order to reduce the weld workload, shorten the construction period and improve the overall stiffness of the hull structure, steel for large ships mostly uses wide and thick plates and requires high heat input welding welding capability (weld heat input is greater than 50kJcm, up to 500kJcm). Its carbon equivalent should not be greater than 0.45. The structural steel for ships (GB712-2011) is mainly made of high-quality low-carbon structural steel, and its grades are internationally accepted. First, English letters are used to indicate the quality grade. At present, a large number of F grade steel with impact toughness of 60 ° C has been produced and used; The number after the letter indicates the yield strength grade (but the unit of value is kgfmm2, and lkgfmm2 is about 9.8MRi). Currently, 315~390MPa grade is mainly used in production; Hull steel of higher strength level is represented by quality grade letter plus yield strength value (MPa). The steel used for ships is mostly alloy structural steel (with performance steel designation or code). The yield strength grade can reach above lOOOMPa.

explanation_cn: 伦敦方程是由德国物理学家弗里茨.伦敦(Fritz London)和海因茨.伦敦(Heinz London)兄弟于1935年提出的关于超导体电流与其内部电场和磁场关系的如下两个唯象方程，伦敦方程是超导现象最简单的有效描述。伦敦方程无法采用严格的数学手段推导出来，而是伦敦兄弟凭借直觉和逻辑思考得出的结论。伦敦方程对于超导研究的最大贡献是它成功地解释了迈斯纳效应的物理机理。
explanation_en: The London equation is the following two phenomenological equations about the relationship between superconductor current and its internal electric and magnetic fields, which were proposed by the German physicists Fritz London and Heinz London brothers in 1935. The London equation is the simplest and most effective description of superconductivity. The London equation cannot be deduced by strict mathematical means, but is the conclusion drawn by the London brothers by virtue of intuition and logical thinking. The biggest contribution of London equation to the study of superconductivity is that it successfully explains the physical mechanism of Meissner effect.

explanation_cn: 伯格斯矢量是伯格斯提出了用晶体的滑移矢量表示位错引起的晶体畸变的方法。当位错在晶体内滑动时，原子沿着某一特定的方向，相对于其邻近原子切变了某一特定的距离，表示这种原子位移的矢量定义为位错的伯格斯矢量。
explanation_en: Burgers vector is a method proposed by Bogs to use the slip vector of crystal to express the distortion of crystal caused by dislocation. When a dislocation slides in a crystal, the atom shears a certain distance in a certain direction relative to its neighboring atoms. The vector representing this atomic displacement is defined as the Burgers vector of the dislocation.

explanation_cn: 一个链状分子的最大末端距。
explanation_en: The maximum end toend clistanct of a chain molecule.

explanation_cn: 变形丝的一种，又称假捻变形丝，弹力丝。即以伸缩性为主要性能的变形丝。变形工艺即是将原来平直的丝条通过机械方法产生经久不变的卷曲变形。
explanation_en: A kind of textured yarn, also known as false twisted textured yarn, elastic silk. Namely, the deformation wire with elasticity as its main performance. The deformation process refers to the mechanical method of generating long-lasting and unchanging curling deformation on the originally straight wire.

explanation_cn: 又称“硅铍石”，成分Be2[SiO4]，BeO含量为45.5%。三方晶系，晶体呈扁菱面体或短六方柱状；集合体呈粒状、放射状或晶簇出现。颜色为无色、黄白或淡红色
explanation_en: Also known as "phenakhe", it is composed of Be2 [SiO4] and contains 45.5% BeO. The crystal is in the shape of rhombohedron or short hexagonal column; Aggregates appear in granular, radial, or crystalline clusters. The color is colorless, yellow white, or light red

explanation_cn: 又称副长石。化学组成与长石相似，是金属阳离子为钾、钠或钙，无水架状结构铝硅酸盐矿物的总称。因与长石族矿物化学组成相似而得名。包括霞石、内榴石、方柱石、钙霞石和方钠石等，但以霞石和白榴石最为重要且常见。与长石族矿物相比，这类矿物的铝和钾、钠含量更高.但二氧化硅不饱和.故不与石英平衡共生。是碱性火成岩的主要造岩矿物。可以作为陶瓷和玻璃原料以及涂料、油漆的填料：色泽美观者可作宝石：富钾种属可作为生产钾盐的原料.综合利用前景广阔。
explanation_en: Also known as foid. Similar to feldspar in chemical composition, it is the general name of aluminum silicate mineral with anhydrous framework structure and metal cations of potassium, sodium or calcium. It is named after its similarity in chemical composition to feldspar minerals. It includes nepheline, garnet, scapolite, calcium nepheline and sodalite, but nepheline and leucite are the most important and common. Compared with feldspar group minerals, these minerals have higher aluminum, potassium and sodium contents, but silica is not saturated, so they do not coexist in equilibrium with quartze. It is the main rock forming mineral of alkaline igneous rocks. It can be used as raw materials for ceramics and glass, as well as fillers for coatings and paints. Those with beautiful color can be used as gemstones. Potassium rich species can be used as raw materials for the production of potassium salt. It has a broad prospect for comprehensive utilization.

explanation_cn: 相变分类中的一类.相变时原子的结合键不被拆开.只是键的长度、键与键之间的角度发生变化。可细分为一级配位位移相变、二级配位位移相变和转动产生的无序。
explanation_en: One of the classification of phase transformation. During phase transformation, the bonding bonds of atoms are not disconnected, but the length of bonds and the angle between bonds change. It can be subdivided into first-order coordinated displacive transformation, second-order coordinated displacive transformation and disorder caused by rotation.

explanation_cn: 晶体中的一类典型的线缺陷，沿线近旁甚小的区域内发生了严重的原子错排。它是已滑移地区与未滑移地区之间的分界。围绕线原子的位移距离称为滑移矢量或伯格斯矢量。可分为三类：刃型、螺型和混合型。
explanation_en: A typical type of line defect in crystal, serious atomic dislocation occurs in a very small area near the line. It is the boundary between areas that have already slipped and areas that have not. The displacement distance around a linear atom is called the slip vector or Burgers vector. It can be divided into three types: blade type, screw type, and mixed type.

explanation_cn: 见林位错。
explanation_en: See dislocation forest.

explanation_cn: 见位错攀移。
explanation_en: See dislocation climb.

explanation_cn: 在一滑移面上有许多位错被迫堆积在某一障碍物前面而形成的群。这些位错由于来自同一位错源，所以具有相同的伯格斯矢量.而晶粒间界是常见的障碍物。
explanation_en: A group formed by many dislocations forced to pile up in front of an obstacle on a slip surface. These dislocation have the same Burgers vector because they come from the same dislocation source. The grain boundary is a common obstacle.

explanation_cn: 单位体积中所包含位错线的总长度。
explanation_en: The total length of dislocation lines contained in a unit volume.

explanation_cn: 处于平行滑移面上的两个异号刃型位错。当它们的滑移面间距30~lOnm时，由于位错吸力场使得一个位错位于另一个的上方，达到某种平衡而形成一整体的位错组态。是一个重要的形态，由于它造成了局部应力场，因此不但在力学性质上对晶体有影响，而且在物理、化学方面都有着不可忽视的作用。
explanation_en: Two different sign blade type dislocation on the parallel slip plane. When the distance between their slip plane is 30~lOnm, because of the dislocation suction field, one dislocation is located above the other, reaching some equilibrium and forming a whole dislocation configuration. It is an important form. Because it creates a local stress field, it not only affects the mechanical properties of crystal, but also plays an important role in physical and chemical aspects.

explanation_cn: 两位错交割产生的小段位错。它位于所属位错的滑移面上，其长度可能只有几个原子间距。
explanation_en: A small segment error generated by the delivery of two dislocations. It is located on the slip plane of the dislocation to which it belongs, and its length may be only a few atoms apart.

explanation_cn: 刃型位错在垂直于滑移方向的运动。对于一个正刃型位错.当原子从多于半原子面边缘跳入点阵间隙位置或位错近旁的空位上，都能使位错向上攀移。反之.若有间隙原子扩散到位错线上，或者位错旁边点阵位置上的原子进入多余半原子面，都会使位错向下攀移。位错的攀移一般不能使位错线整体的移动。
explanation_en: The movement of edge dislocation in the direction perpendicular to the slip direction. For a positive edge dislocation, when the atom jumps from the edge of more than half atomic plane to the lattice gap position or the vacancy near the dislocation, the dislocation can climb upward. Conversely, if the interstitial atoms diffusion to the dislocation line, or the atoms on the lattice position next to the dislocation enter the redundant half atomic plane, the dislocation will climb downward. Generally, the climbing of dislocation cannot make the dislocation line move as a whole.

explanation_cn: 在变形过程中，晶体中增殖（产生）位错的地方。
explanation_en: The place in crystal where dislocation are propagated (produced) during deformation.

explanation_cn: 位错线与其伯格斯矢量组成的面称为滑移面，位错在滑移面上的运动。对于刃型位错，伯格斯矢量与位错线垂直，所以只有唯一的滑移面;而螺型位错与其伯格斯矢量平行，通过位错线的晶面同时也就包含它的伯格斯矢量，都可以成为它的滑移面，这使得螺型位错在滑移运动时有可能从一个晶面转到另一个晶面上去，这一过程称为交滑移。位错移动一个原子间距时，只需周围原子有很小的位移，位移滑移过程被传递的是一特殊的原子组态，对刃型位错，它是一个多余的半原子面，对螺型位错，它是一个螺旋面的轴线。
explanation_en: The plane composed of dislocation line and its Bogs vector is called slip plane, and the motion of dislocation on slip plane. For edge dislocation, the Burgers vector is perpendicular to the dislocation line, so there is only one slip plane; While the screw dislocation is parallel to its Burgers vector, and the crystal plane passing through the dislocation line also contains its Burgers vector, which can be its slip plane, which makes it possible for the screw dislocation to move from one crystal plane to another crystal plane during the slip movement, a process called cross-slip. When a dislocation moves an atomic distance, only a small displacement of the surrounding atoms is required. The displacement sliding process is transferred to a special atomic configuration. For a edge dislocation, it is an extra half atomic surface, and for a screw dislocation, it is the axis of a helical surface.

explanation_cn: 位错是晶体中已滑移区域与未滑移区域的分界，这两个区域的分界线（即位错线）在晶体中形成的一个封闭的环圆。
explanation_en: Dislocation is the boundary between the slip region and the non slip region in a crystal. The boundary between the two regions (dislocation line) forms a closed circle in a crystal.

explanation_cn: 位错线长度增加一个单位时所做的功。位错能量与其长度成正比.所以它有尽量缩短真长度的趋势；与液体的表面张力相似，这种趋势可以用T来描述。
explanation_en: The work done when the length of the dislocation line increases by one unit. The dislocation energy is proportional to its length, so it tends to shorten the true length as much as possible; Similar to the surface tension of liquids, this trend can be described by T.

explanation_cn: 金属变形初期，位错线开始缠结，这些缠结的位错分布并不均匀?逐步形成明显的胞状亚结构。对面心立方金属，大多数位错聚集在一起组成胞壁。对层错能高易发生交滑移的金属，胞壁易形成，随着形变量的增加，位错密度不断增加，胞状结构日益明显，胞的尺寸也越来越小。
explanation_en: At the initial stage of metal deformation, dislocation lines begin to tangle, and the distribution of these tangled dislocation is uneven? Gradually forming distinct cellular substructures. For the face centered cubic metal, most of the dislocation gather together to form the cell wall. For the metal with high stacking fault energy and prone to cross-slip, the cell wall is easy to form. With the increase of deformation, the density of dislocation increases, the cellular structure becomes increasingly obvious, and the cell size becomes smaller and smaller.

explanation_cn: 位错在晶体中引起畸变，使晶体的内能增加的能量。它包括两部分：一是位错核心的能量;二是核心外的能量.一般称为位错的应变能。
explanation_en: The energy that dislocation causes distortion in crystal and increases internal energy of crystal. It includes two parts: one is the energy of the dislocation core; The other is the energy outside the core, which is generally called the strain energy of dislocation.

explanation_cn: 在一定的侵蚀条件下.金属被侵蚀表面用以妞示位错在晶体表面的露头而形成的蚀坑。这种蚀坑往往呈现多面的锥体状，锥体的表面具有一定的结晶学取向，有的侵蚀剂只能在低指数晶面上产主蚀坑。位错蚀坑用以研究小角晶界上蚀坑的排列与位错之间的对应关系。
explanation_en: Under certain erosion conditions, the eroded surface of metal is used to show the outcrop of dislocation on the surface of crystal. This kind of etch pit often presents a multi-faceted cone shape, and the surface of the cone has certain crystallographic orientation. Some etchants can only produce main etch pits on the low index crystal plane. Dislocation etch pit are used to study the corresponding relationship between the arrangement of etch pits on the small angle grain boundary and dislocation.

explanation_cn: 采用低介电常数材料作为介质的浆料。低介电常数介质浆料用于制作小容量电容也i可用来制作多层布线的介质。
explanation_en: Low dielectric constant materials is used as the slurry of medium. The lowdielectricconstantpaste can be used to make small capacitance and also can be used to make multilayer wiring media.

explanation_cn: 采用先进的冶炼工艺和超纯冶炼技术，使镍基铸造高温合金P含量大幅度降低.控制其含量<0.001%,最好<0.0005%；使Si含量控制在0.05%以下；不加Zr；并把现有合金的B含量适当往下控制，可使合金的凝固温度区间缩小100-150℃，这样就可以大幅度降低高温合金的偏析程度，增加合金的组织稳定性，相应可适当提高现有高温合金的合金化程度。
explanation_en: Advanced smelting process and ultra pure smelting technology are adopted to greatly reduce the P content of nickel-base cast superalloy. The content should be controlled to<0.001%, preferably<0.0005%; Control the Si content below 0.05%; No Zr added; The proper downward control of the B content of the existing alloy can reduce the solidification temperature range of the alloy by 100-150 ℃, so that the segregation degree of the high temperature alloy can be greatly reduced, the structural stability of the alloy can be increased, and the alloy degree of the existing high temperature alloy can be appropriately improved.

explanation_cn: 溶点低于组分结构单元相应均聚物的熔点的二元无规共聚物。
explanation_en: A binary random copolymer whose melting point is lower than the melting point of the corresponding homopolymer of the component structural unit.

explanation_cn: 冰点低于-20°C的推进剂。低冰点单组元推进剂，如单推-3单组元推进剂、HPB推进剂。低冰点氧化剂，如绿色四氧化二氮，冰点-22.7°C。
explanation_en: Propellants with a freezing point below -20 ° C. Low freezing point monopropellant, such as monopropellant-3 monopropellant and HPB propellant. Low freezing point oxidizer, such as green nitrogen tetroxide, freezing point -22.7 ° C.

explanation_cn: 一种在低压下利用化学反应进行外延生长的方法。其突出的优点是外延生长室为低压，此时载气流速增大，反应物质在表面的扩散系数增大，可减少反应物之间的寄生反应，以及外延生长对反应室的记忆效应，增大纵向均匀性。对于表面扩散动力学控制的外延生长，可增大外延层的均匀性(对于大面积大规模外延生长是必要的，例如大规模Si器件工艺中的介质膜外延生长）。对于由质量输送控制的外延生长，上述效应并不明显
explanation_en: The invention relates to a method for epitaxial growth by chemical reaction under low pressure. Its outstanding advantage is that the epitaxial growth chamber is low pressure, at this time, the carrier gas flow rate increases, and the diffusion coefficient of reactants on the surface increases, which can reduce the parasitic reaction between reactants, and the memory effect of epitaxial growth on the reaction chamber, and increase the longitudinal uniformity. For epitaxial growth controlled by surface diffusion dynamics, the uniformity of the epitaxial layer can be increased (necessary for large-scale epitaxial growth, such as epitaxial growth of dielectric film in large-scale Si device technology). For epitaxial growth controlled by mass transport, the above effects are not obvious

explanation_cn: 用于交流350V以下的电瓷为低压电瓷。
explanation_en: The electric porcelain used for AC below 350V is low-vohage electric porcelain.

explanation_cn: 见真空等离子喷涂。
explanation_en: See vacuum plasma spraying.

explanation_cn: 参见第一壁表面覆盖层材料。
explanation_en: See first-wall coating.

explanation_cn: 一种单模光纤。
explanation_en: A single mode optical filler.

explanation_cn: 在低碳钢中添加少量合金化元素使轧制状态或正火状态的钢材屈服强度超过345MPa的低合金工程结构钢（GB/T 5216-2004)。低合金高强度钢比轧制状态的非合金低碳结构钢钢具有更高的力学性能，部分品种还具有较高的耐候性和耐蚀性。低合金高强度钢可以在碳含量较低的条件下得到高的强度，因此焊接性相当于或优于普通非合金低碳钢。
explanation_en: Low alloy engineering structural steel (GB/T 5216-2004) in which a small amount of alloy elements are added to low-carbon steel to make the yield strength of steel product in rolling state or normalizing state exceed 345MPa. High strength lowr alloy steel has higher mechanical properties than rolling non alloy low-carbon structural steel steel, and some varieties also have higher weather resistance and corrosion resistance. Low alloy high-strength steel can obtain high strength under the condition of low carbon content, so the weldability is equivalent to or better than ordinary non alloy low-carbon steel.

explanation_cn: 见聚乙烯。
explanation_en: See polyethylene.

explanation_cn: 屈强比明显低于常规钢种的钢称为低屈强比钢。材料的屈强比即屈服强度Rel与拉伸强度Rm之比是衡量金属材料冲压性能和抗塑性变形的重要指标。通常认为非合金钢的屈强比不大于0.7,低合金钢的屈强比不大于0.8，才属于低屈强比钢。
explanation_en: Steel whose yield ratio is obviously lower than that of conventional steel is called low yield ratio steel. The yield ratio of materials, that is, the ratio of yield strength Rel to tensile strength Rm, is an important index to measure the stamping performance and plastic deformation resistance of metallic materials. It is generally considered that the yield ratio of non-alloy steel is not more than 0.7, and that of low alloy steel is not more than 0.8, which is considered as low yield ratio steel.

explanation_cn: 屈服强度很低同时具有很高均匀塑性的钢。这类钢一般为超低碳钢，具有优良的深冲性能和深拉延性能，容易变形加工制造形状复杂的制品。
explanation_en: Steel with low yield strength and high homogeneous plasticity. This kind of steel is generally ultra-low-carhon steel, which has excellent deep drawing and deep drawing properties, and is easy to deform to manufacture products with complex shapes.

explanation_cn: 又称低弹丝，假捻定型变形丝。伸缩性变形丝的一种。制造方法中最常用的为双区加热的假捻法。
explanation_en: Also known as low stretch yarn, false twist stabilized textured yam. A kind of stretch textured yarn. The most commonly used manufacturing method is the double zone heating false twisting method.

explanation_cn: 具有低弹性模量的混凝土，其弹性模量可低到0.3×10^4-10×10^4MPa。一般用于水利工程结构土石围堰中的防渗墙以抵抗侧面载荷引起的变形而开裂。
explanation_en: The elastic modulus of concrete with low elastic modulus can be as low as 0.3 × 10 ^ 4-10 × 10 ^ 4MPa. Generally used in hydraulic engineering structures, the anti-seepage wall in earth-rock cofferdams cracks due to deformation caused by lateral loads.

explanation_cn: 室温拉伸强度低于800MPa的钛合金。主要包括工业纯钛以及铝、锡和锆等α稳定元素含量较低的近α钛合金。
explanation_en: Titanium alloys with room temperature tensile strength lower than 800MPa. Mainly including commercial pure titanium, aluminum, tin and zirconium α Near with low stable element content α Titanium alloy.

explanation_cn: 推进剂或其装填的弹药受到快速烤燃、慢速烤燃、枪击(弹丸撞击）、碎片撞击、感应爆轰、静电或电磁影响等外界刺激时，所产生的危险性响应和接着发生二次损害小的推进剂，称为低易损（LOVA)推进剂。该类推进剂主要由钝感性能好的氧化剂和具有良好柔韧性的高分子聚合物（如嵌段型端羟基聚醚）作为黏合剂制成。
explanation_en: When the propellant or its loaded ammunition is subjected to external irritation such as rapid cook off, slow cook off, gunfire (projectile impact), debris impact, induced detonation, electrostatic or electromagnetic effects, the dangerous response generated and then the propellant with small secondary damage are called low vulnerability (LOVA) propellant. This kind of propellant is mainly made of oxidizer with good insensitivity and macromolecule polymer with good flexibility (such as block type hydroxyl terminated polyether) as adhesive.

explanation_cn: 简称LOVA火药。使用和勤务处理中安全性好、具有较高生存能力的一类火药。是一种工作性能满足武器要求，在外界机械撞击、摩擦、热和火焰等作用下不易引起意外爆炸、不易烤燃、不易殉爆的安全性良好的火药。配方如下：黏合剂（如聚氨酯、端羟基聚丁二烯等）20%-30%、固体填料（如黑索今、奥克托今等）80%-70%，火药力为917-1090kJ/kg，爆温为2250-2594K。用作火炮发射装药和其他特殊用途装药。
explanation_en: It is called LOVA propellant for short. It is a kind of propellant with good safety and high viability in use and service handling. It is a kind of propellant with good safety, whose working performance meets the requirements of weapons, and is not easy to cause accidental explosion, bake out, and martyrdom explosion under the action of external mechanical impact, friction, heat and flame. The formula is as follows: adhesive (such as polyurethime, hydroxyl terminated polybutadiene, etc.) 20% -30%, solid filler (such as RDX, octogen, etc.) 80% -70%, gunpowder force 917-1090kJ/kg, explosion temperature 2250-2594K. Used as propellant for artillery firing and other special purpose charges.

explanation_cn: 对外部作用不敏感、安全性高的炸药。对撞击、摩擦的感度低，不易烤燃，不易殉爆，也不易由燃烧转爆轰，在生产、运输、储存，特别是作战条件下都较安全。采用不敏感的单质炸药，往分子中引入不同的官能团以提高原有单质炸药的安全水平及采用分子间炸药和某些可降低炸药感度的弹性高聚物黏结剂等方法，均有助于降低炸药的易损性。
explanation_en: Explosive that are insensitive to external effects and have high safety. Low sensitivity to impact and friction, not easy to cook, not easy to martyr explosion, not easy to switch from combustion to detonation, and safe in production, transportation, storage, especially under combat conditions. The use of insensitive single explosive, the introduction of different functional groups into the molecules to improve the safety level of the original single explosive, and the use of intermolecular explosive and some elasticity polymers adhesive that can reduce the sensitivity of explosive, all contribute to reducing the vulnerability of explosive.

explanation_cn: 中子照射后，感生放射性水平低的材料。其目标是降低材料经中子活化后的总放射性水平，特别是避免生成长半衰期放射性同位素(即限制材料中Ni、Mo和Nb的含量），但仍有合适的机械、物理、化学和辐照性能。
explanation_en: After neutron irradiation, materials with low radioactivity level is induced. Its goal is to reduce the total radioactivity level of materials after neutron activation or conditioning, especially to avoid the generation of radioisotope with half life (that is, to limit the content of Ni, Mo and Nb in materials), but still have appropriate mechanical, physical, chemical and irradiation properties.

explanation_cn: 淬透性较低的钢。钢号后加D表示低淬透性钢。在高频感应穿透加热条件下淬火时，仅使表面层淬火成马氏体组织，表面具有高硬度和耐磨性而心部具有适当的塑性和韧性。这类钢碳含量为0.5%-0.7%,严格限制钢中提高淬透性元素的含量，加人强碳化物形成元素Ti并使之以碳化物形式存在从而有效降低钢的淬透性。主要钢号有55TiD、60TiD和70T1D。采用低淬透性钢制作齿轮等零件，可明显简化热处理工艺。
explanation_en: Steel with lower hardenabilhy. Steel designation followed by D indicates low hardenabilhy steel. When quenching under the condition of high-frequency induction penetration heating, only the surface layer is quenching into martensite structure, the surface has high hardness and wear resistance, and the center has appropriate plasticity and toughness. This kind of steel has a carbon content of 0.5% -0.7%, which strictly limits the content of elements that can improve hardenabilhy in steel, and adds strong carbide to form element Ti and make it exist in the form of carbide, thus effectively reducing the hardenabilhy of steel. The main steel designation are 55TiD, 60TiD and 70T1D. Using low hardenability steel to make gear and other parts can obviously simplify the heat treatment process.

explanation_cn: 又称为LTCC材料。低温共烧陶瓷材料实现的方法主要有4种：①掺入适量的烧结助剂进行液相活性烧结，即陶瓷+玻璃复合体系；②采用化学法制取表面活性高的粉体；③尽可能采用颗粒度细、主晶相合成温度低的材料：④采用微晶玻璃或非晶玻璃。
explanation_en: Also known as LTCC materials. There are four main ways to realize low-temperature co fired ceramics materials: ① add appropriate sintering additive for liquid phase active sintering, that is, ceramics+glass composition system; ② Using chemical methods to prepare powders with high surface activity; ③ Materials with fine particle size and low synthesis temperature of main crystal phase shall be used as far as possible: ④ glass-ceramics or amorphous glass shall be used.

explanation_cn: 钢中的显微组织主要由两种相组成，且每种相都占有较大的体积比，一般分为铁素体-奥氏体型、铁素体-马氏体型和奥氏体-马氏体型等。在低温下有实用意义的大部分是指铁素体-奥氏体型双相钢，它在化工、石油、能源、海洋等工业方面都得到了广泛的应用，它的特点是兼备奥氏体和铁素体两者的优点、屈服强度较高、有良好的韧性、耐应力腐蚀、晶间腐蚀、点腐蚀和缝隙腐蚀，可焊性好。为提高低温性能，在复相组织中：①由于铁素体的存在提高了屈服强度；②通过控轧处理可进一步细化晶粒，改善性能；③降低间隙杂质，以提高低温韧性。
explanation_en: The microstructure in steel is mainly composed of two phase, and each phase has a large volume ratio, which is generally divided into ferrite austenite, ferrite martensite and austenite martensite. The most practical steel at low temperature is ferrite austenite dual-phase steel, which has been widely used in chemical, petroleum, energy, marine and other industries. Its characteristics are that it has both the advantages of austenite and ferrite, high yield strength, good toughness, stress corrosion resistance, intergranular corrosion, spot corrosion and crevice corrosion, and good weldability. In order to improve the low-temperature properties, in the multiphase structure: ① the existence of ferrite improves the yield strength; ② By controlling rolling treatment, grain size can be further refined and performance can be improved; ③ Reduce interstitial impurities to improve low-temperature toughness.

explanation_cn: 含有相当量铬镍锰元素的不锈钢。面心立方结构，一般没有冷脆转变温度，广泛应用于低温领域。按成分和组织结构的稳定性可分为：①铁铬镍系(AISI300系列不锈钢），18-8是铬镍奥氏体不锈钢中有代表性的钢种；②铁铬镍锰与铁铬镍锰氮系，锰可以扩大奥氏体相区，氮作为间隙元素有显著的固溶强化作用，21-6-9低温无磁钢是一个典型代表，该钢在4.2K下强度高（σ0.2>1300MPa)，塑性韧性好，用作超导磁体框架、超导电动机转子、液氮杜瓦等构件材料；③铁锰铝系，这是一种节约镍铬的新钢种(Mn：24%-32%,Al:4%-8%），其中15Mn26A14具有很高的低温韧性，组织稳定，低的低温磁导率，管、板、丝材，可用于77-4.2K的各种低温工程上；④铁镍基与镍基超合金系在低温下具有高强度高韧性，强度比18-8型不锈钢高2.5-5倍，适合用于航天器中的低温部件。
explanation_en: Stainless steel containing a considerable amount of chromium, nickel and manganese. The face-centered cubic structure generally has no cold brittle transformation temperature, and is widely used in the low-temperature field. According to the stability of composition and structure, it can be divided into: ① Fe Cr Ni series (AISI300 series stainless steel), 18-8 is the representative steel of Cr Ni austenilic stainless steel; ② Fe Cr Ni Mn and Fe Cr Ni Mn nitrogen systems, manganese can expand the austenite phase area, nitrogen as a interstitial element has a significant solid solution strengthening effect, 21-6-9 low temperature non-magnetic steel is a typical representative, this steel has high strength at 4.2K（ σ 0.2>1300MPa), good plasticity and toughness, used as materials for superconducting magnet frame, superconducting motor rotor, liquid nitrogen dewar and other components; ③ Iron manganese aluminum series is a new type of steel that saves nickel and chromium (Mn: 24% -32%, Al: 4% -8%). Among them, 15Mn26A14 has high low-temperature toughness, stable structure, low low-temperature magnetic permeability, and can be used in various low-temperature engineering projects at 77-4.2K for pipes, plates, and wires; ④ Iron nickel base and nickel base superaalloy series have high strength and toughness at low temperature, and the strength is 2.5-5 times higher than 18-8 stainless steel, which is suitable for cryogenic components in spacecraft.

name_en: NdFeB magnet with low temperature coefficient
explanation_cn: 指具有低温度系数、高温度稳定性的NdFeB磁休。可通过提高磁体的居里温度、添加替代型元素来提高材料的内禀磁性，添加掺杂型丨元素和调整工艺参数来改善材料的微结构，提高钦铁硼材料的矫顽力、降低磁通不可逆损失和矫顽力温度系数来提高其温度稳定性和抗退磁能力。
explanation_en: NdFeB magnetic material with low temperature coefficient and high temperature stability. The intrinsic magnetism of materials can be improved by increasing the Curie temperature of magnets, adding alternative elements, improving the microstructure of materials by adding doped elements and adjusting process parameters, improving the coercive force of iron boron materials, reducing the irreversible loss of magnetic flux and the temperature coefficient of coercive force, and improving their temperature stability and anti demagnetization ability.

explanation_cn: 随环境温度变化燃气生成速率变化较小的发射药。环境随温度变化改变了发射药的温度和发射药的燃烧速度，并随温度的增加，燃烧速度呈指数规律上升，明显地影响发射药燃气生成速率。
explanation_en: Gun propellant whose gas generation rate changes little with ambient temperature. The environment changes the temperature of gun propellant and the combustion speed of gun propellant with the change of temperature, and the combustion speed increases exponentially with the increase of temperature, which obviously affects the gas generation rate of gun propellant.

explanation_cn: 在标准大气压下沸点低于200K的液体推进剂。燃料有液氢、液态甲烷等；氧化剂有液氧、一氧化二氮等；常温下为气体，在深冷或高压条件下可使其液化。储存在特殊材料的容器中，并有保温绝热措施。所用材料应具有良好的相容性，其物理性质如延性、展性等应能承受温度变化所引起的热应力变化。具有能量高等特点。常用作双组元液体推进剂的组分，如液氢可与液氧等组成双组元高能推进剂，液氧可与煤油等组成双组元液体推进剂，通常用于大型运载火箭中。
explanation_en: Liquid propellant with a boiling point below 200K at standard atmospheric pressure. The fuels include liquid hydrogen, liquid methane, etc; Oxidizer includes liquid oxygen, nitrous oxide, etc; It is a gas at room temperature and can be liquefied under deep cold or high pressure conditions. It shall be stored in containers made of special materials and provided with thermal insulation measures. The materials used shall have good compatibility, and their physical properties such as ductility and ductility shall be able to withstand the thermal stress changes caused by temperature changes. It has the characteristics of high energy. It is often used as a component of bipropellant liquid propellant. For example, liquid hydrogen can form a bipropellant high-energy propellant with liquid oxygen, and liquid oxygen can form a bipropellant liquid propellant with kerosene, which is usually used in large launch vehicles.

explanation_cn: 指在低温下具有非常稳定的奥氏体基体组织而没有磁性的奥氏体不锈钢。
explanation_en: It refers to austenilic stainless steel with very stable austenitic matrix structure but no magnetism at low temperature.

explanation_cn: 又称深冷液化储氢，指的是在低温状态下将氢气以液态储存起来的储氢方式。液氢储存的质量最小，储存体积也比高压气态储氢小得多。从质量和体积上考虑，液态储氢是一种极为理想的储氢方式。
explanation_en: Also known as cryogenic liquefied hydrogen storage, it refers to the hydrogen storage mode in which hydrogen is stored in liquid state at low temperature. The mass of liquid hydrogen is the smallest, and the storage volume is much smaller than that of high-pressure gaseous hydrogen storage. From the perspective of mass and volume, liquid hydrogen storage is an extremely ideal hydrogen storage method.

explanation_cn: 超高碳、高硅钢在T=0.25Tm(Tm代表以热力学温度表示的熔点温度）的低温进行长时间的等温转变可以获得极细小的贝氏体组织，其由厚度仅为20-40nm的极薄的贝氏体铁素体板条和板条间富碳的残余奥氏体傅膜组成，称为低温贝氏体组织（lowtümperaturefinite)。
explanation_en: Ultra high carbon and high silicon steel can obtain extremely fine bainite structure by long-term isothermal transformation at a low temperature of T=0.25Tm (Tm represents the melting point temperature expressed by thermodynamics temperature), which is composed of extremely thin bainite ferrite Flat noodles with a thickness of only 20-40nm and carbon rich residual austenite film between Flat noodles, called low temperature bainite structure (low ü temperature bainite).

explanation_cn: 具有低临界转变温度（Tr<30K),在液氦温度条件下工作的超导材料。分为金属、合金和化合物。
explanation_en: Superconducting materials with low critical transformation temperature (Tr<30K) and operating at liquid helium temperature. It is divided into metal, alloy and compound.

explanation_cn: 适合低温下（O℃以下至热力学零度）使用的金属及合金材料。主要包括奥氏体不锈钢、镍钢、低合金铁素体钢、铝合金、铜及铜合金、钛及钛合金、铁镍基超合金、双相钢等。广泛应用于石油化工、制冷等行业，如石油、天然气深冷分离设备；储存、处理及输运液化气的设备与装置，低温冷却装置，空分设备.冷冻设备；寒冷地区户外作业的机械设备与工程结构；采用液氦作冷却介质的超导磁体、超导机械；航天飞机、火箭及飞船的液体燃料储箱；磁悬浮列车；超低温储能环等工程及高技术领域。在273-173K范围，天然气、液化丙烷等能源输送和储存用的构造物需要大量低温金属材必然要求价格低廉，所以采用低镍钢或其他铁素体钢。在173-77K范围，比如液化天然气和液氮等产业用的低温装置，就需采用奥氏体不锈钢或含镍较高的镍钢。77-0K是各种高技术应用广泛的温度范围，需采用稳定的奥氏体不锈钢、奥氏体合金或其他新合金。宇航飞行器的低温装置多采用铝合金、钛合金及特殊奥氏体合金。具有bcc结构的低温合金在低温下强度升高，而韧性及塑性降低较多，它们只能在脆性转变温度以上的范围使用。而具有fcc结构的低温合金，低温下强度升高的同时还能保持高韧性及塑性，屈服后的加工硬化也很显著.当温度很低时大多出现锯齿形变现象。低温下用的奥氏体合金，要求奥氏体组织稳定，不发生低温马氏体转变，Ms点越低越好。深冲用的低温合金要求Md点尽可能低。超低温技术多在磁场下利用，要求低温合金无磁性。
explanation_en: Metal and alloy materials suitable for low temperature (below O ℃ to thermodynamics zero). It mainly includes austenilic stainless steel, nickel steel, low alloy iron steel, aluminum alloy, copper and copper alloy, titanium and titanium alloy, iron nickel base superaalloy, dual-phase steel, etc. Widely used in industries such as petrochemical and refrigeration, such as oil and natural gas cryogenic separation equipment; Equipment and devices for storing, processing, and transporting liquefied gas, low-temperature cooling devices, air separation equipment, and refrigeration equipment; Mechanical equipment and engineering structures for outdoor operations in cold regions; Superconducting magnet and superconducting machinery using liquid helium as cooling medium; Liquid fuel storage tanks for space shuttles, rockets, and spacecraft; Maglev train; Engineering and high-tech fields such as ultra-low temperature energy storage rings. In the range of 273-173K, a large number of low-temperature metal materials are required for structures used for energy transmission and storage such as natural gas and liquefied propane, which must be cheap, so low nickel steel or other ferritic steel is used. Austenilic stainless steel or nickel steel with high nickel content is required for cryogenic devices used in 173-77K, such as liquefied natural gas and liquid nitrogen industries. 77-0K is a temperature range widely used in various high-tech applications. Stable austenilic stainless steel, austenitic alloy or other new alloy are required. Aluminum alloy, titanium alloy and special austenitic alloy are mostly used as cryogenic devices of aerospace vehicles. Low temperature alloy with bcc structure have higher strength at low temperature, but lower toughness and plasticity. they can only be used above the brittle transformation temperature. The low temperature alloy with fcc structure can maintain high toughness and plasticity while its strength increases at low temperature, and work hardening after yielding is also very significant. When the temperature is very low, serration deformation mostly occurs. Austenitic alloy used at low temperature shall have stable austenite structure and no low-temperature martensite transformation. The lower Ms point, the better. Low temperature alloy used for deep drawing requires Md point to be as low as possible. Ultra low temperature technology is mostly used under magnetic field, which requires low temperature alloy to be non-magnetic.

explanation_cn: 适合低温下使用的α和α-β钛合金。该类合金强度随温度的降低而增加、钿性很少下降，有良好的可焊性，高比强度，耐腐蚀性好，热导率低，可作低温结构件，特别是宇航飞行器中的低温容器。按组织状态钛合金可分为三类：α(hcp结构）、β(bcc结构）及α-β钛合金。
explanation_en: Suitable for use at low temperatures α and α-β Titanium alloy. This kind of alloy has good weldability, high specific strength, good corrosion resistance, low thermal conductivity, and can be used as cryogenic structural parts, especially cryogenic containers in aerospace vehicles. Titanium alloys can be divided into three categories according to their organizational state: α (hcp structure) β (BCC structure) and α-β Titanium alloy.

explanation_cn: 在0℃以下温度范围使用仍具有良好韧性而不发生冷脆现象的钢。一般把在273-77K温度范围使用的钢称为低温钢，而把77K以下的温度范围使用的钢称为超低温钢。低温钢可分为：低温铁素体钢；低温镍钢；低温不锈钢。
explanation_en: The steel with good toughness and no cold brittleness can be used below 0 ℃. Generally, steel used in the temperature range of 273-77K is called cryogenic steel, and steel used in the temperature range below 77K is called ultra cryogenic steel. Cryogenic steel can be divided into: cryogenic ferritic steel; Cryogenic nickel steel; Cryogenic stainless steel.

explanation_cn: 适于深冷条件使用的沉淀强化型铁镍基奥氏体超合金，含铬（15%-20%)或钻，适量的Ti、Al及Nb,有的含钼；靠析出γ'相强化奥氏体基体。这类合金在常温及低温下都具有高强度及好的塑性。
explanation_en: Precipitation strengthened iron nickel base austenitic superaalloy suitable for cryogenic conditions, containing chromium (15% -20%) or diamond, appropriate amount of Ti, Al and Nb, and some containing molybdenum; By precipitation γ' Phase strengthening austenite matrix. This kind of alloy has high strength and good plasticity at room temperature and low temperature.

explanation_cn: 适用于低温环境使用的铜合金。铜及大多数铜合金都具有fcc晶体结构，低温韧性及塑性很好，可用于各种低温。除少数沉淀强化型铜合金外，铜和铜合金的强化机制只限于冷加工及晶粒细化。
explanation_en: Copper alloy suitable for use in low-temperature environments. Copper and most copper alloys have fcc crystal structure, which has good toughness and plasticity at low temperature and can be used for various low temperatures. Except for a few precipitation strengthened copper alloys, the strengthening mechanism of copper and copper alloys is limited to cold working and grain refinement.

explanation_cn: 适合于低温环境使用的大多数同溶强化铝合金（含Mg6%、Mnl.5%、Cr0.35%或它们的组合）及一些沉淀硬化铝合金（含Cu或Mg6.5%、含SU%或含Zn8%)。该类合金具有fcc晶体结构、密度低、无磁性、比强度高，低温下能保持较高的强度、塑性及韧性。
explanation_en: Most of the solution strengthening aluminum alloys (containing Mg6%, Mnl. 5%, Cr0.35% or their combination) and some precipitation hardening aluminum alloys (containing Cu or Mg6.5%, SU% or Zn8%) suitable for low temperature environment use. This kind of alloy has fcc crystal structure, low density, non-magnetic, high specific strength, and can maintain high strength, plasticity and toughness at low temperature.

name_cn: 低温马氏体时效不锈钢
explanation_cn: 指碳含量很低（<0.03%)镍含量较高经固溶处理后在20-70K的低温下仍具有很高冲击钿性的马氏体时效不锈钢。
explanation_en: It refers to martensitic aging stainless steel with low carbon content (<0.03%) and high nickel content, which still has high impact resistance at low temperature of 20-70K after solution treatment.

explanation_cn: 火箭发动机排气羽流的烟（一次烟和二次烟）和羽流的二次燃烧火焰（可见光、红外线和紫外线）的辐射特征信号较低，对导弹制导信号衰减低的推进剂。是战术导弹武器系统实现"可靠制导、精确打击"的关键技术，是同体推进剂研究发展的方向之一。
explanation_en: Propellant with low radiation characteristic signal of smoke (primary smoke and secondary smoke) of rocket engine exhaust plume and secondary combustion flame (visible light, infrared ray and ultraviolet ray) of plume, and low attenuation of missile guidance signal. It is a key technology for achieving "reliable guidance and precise strike" in tactical missile weapon systems, and is one of the research and development directions for homogeneous propellants.

explanation_cn: 碳含量小于0.25%的钢。狭义的低碳钢则是指碳含量小于0.25%的非合金钢。低碳钢的特点是高塑性、高韧性及良好的加工成形性和焊接性能，但强度相对较低。
explanation_en: Steel with carbon content less than 0.25%. In the narrow sense, low-cardon steel refers to non-alloy steel with carbon content less than 0.25%. Low-cardon steel is characterized by high plasticity, high toughness, good processing formability and weld performance, but its strength is relatively low.

explanation_cn: 总含碳量不超过8%的镁炭砖。为了提高抗剥落性，常使用超细石墨或纳米炭黑。主要用于冶炼低碳钢的炉衬。
explanation_en: Magnesium carbon brick with total carbon content not exceeding 8%. In order to improve the anti stripping property, ultra-fine graphite or nano carbon black is often used. It is mainly used as furnace lining for smelting low-cardon steel.

explanation_cn: 维数低于三维的材料的统称。包括零维、一维和二维材料。
explanation_en: Materials whose dimensions are lower than three dimensions. It includes zero dimensional, one-dimensional and two-dimensional materials.

explanation_cn: 研究表面晶体结构的一种分析技术。电子衍射研究表明，为了分析表面层的二维晶体结构，要求电子束满足：①波长足够短，足以分清单个原子；②与物质有强烈的相互作用，其逸出深度为几个原子层。低能(50-500eV)电子束最能满足上述要求。以低能电子束作为表层结构分析的微探针从晶体物质表面所产生的电子衍射称为低能电子衍射。主要设备是由真空分析室、电子枪和采用后加速技术的电子衍射记录装置等组成。与其他衍射技术比较，具有以下特点：①能产生介于二维和三维之间的衍射花样；②能研究任何晶态材料，结果很容易与质谱数据比较；③分析的最小选区尺寸为lpm。因此，低能电子衍射技术是获得表面原子结构排列信息的主要分析方法，主要用于研究界面化学反应。此外在气相沉积表面生成、氧化膜生长、表面扩散、气体吸附和催化过程等方面也得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: An analytical technique for studying surface crystal structure. The electron diffraction study shows that in order to analyze the two-dimensional crystal structure of the surface layer, the electron beam is required to meet the following requirements: ① the wavelength is short enough to distinguish a single atom; ② There is a strong interaction with matter, and its escape depth is several atomic layers. Low energy (50-500eV) electron beams can best meet the above requirements. The electron diffraction generated from the surface of crystal material by using low-energy electron beam as the microprobe for surface structure analysis is called low-energy electron diffraction. The main equipment is composed of vacuum analysis chamber, electron gun and electron diffraction recording device with post acceleration technology. Compared with other diffraction techniques, it has the following characteristics: ① it can generate diffraction patterns between two-dimensional and three-dimensional; ② It can study any crystalline materials, and the results can be easily compared with the mass spectrometry data; ③ The minimum selection size analyzed is lpm. Therefore, low-energy electron diffraction technology is the main analytical method to obtain the surface atomic structure arrangement information, which is mainly used to study the interface chemical reaction. In addition, it is also widely used in vapor deposition surface formation, oxide film growth, surface diffusion, gas adsorption and catalytic processes.

explanation_cn: 又称因瓦合金，在一定温度范围内尺寸几乎不随温度变化的合金。按应用和特性可分为不锈因瓦、高强度因瓦、易切削因瓦、高温因瓦、非铁磁性因瓦合金等。按组成分为Fe-Ni系、Fe-Ni-Co系、F-Co-Cr系、Fe-Pt系、Fe-Pd系和非晶态Fe-B系等。
explanation_en: Also known as Invar alloy, it is a alloy whose size almost does not change with temperature within a certain temperature range. According to application and characteristics, it can be divided into stainless invar, high-strength invar, free cutting invar, high-temperature invar, non iron Invar alloy, etc. According to composition, it can be divided into Fe Ni system, Fe Ni Co system, F-Co Cr system, Fe Pt system, Fe Pd system, and amorphous Fe B system.

explanation_en: See ultra-low thermal expansion quartz glass.

explanation_cn: 是膨胀系数很低的高温合金。它同时具有低膨胀合金和高温合金的特性。典型的低膨胀合金是含有36%Ni的Fe-Ni合金即因瓦合金。此外，低膨胀高温合金还具有热疲劳性能良好，热加工塑性高，弹性模量几乎恒定不变等特点。
explanation_en: It is a high temperature alloy with very low expansion coefficient. It has the characteristics of both low expansion alloy and high temperature alloy. A typical low expansion alloy is a Fe Ni alloy containing 36% Ni, namely Invar alloy. In addition, low thermal expansion superalloy has good thermal fatigue performance, high hot working plasticity, and almost constant elastic modulus.

explanation_cn: 采用真空磁控溅射方法在玻璃表面上镀上含有一层或两层甚至三层极细薄的金属氧化膜而成的透明玻璃。这种膜层具有极低的表面辐射率，容许波长380-780nm的可见光波通过，但对波长780-3000nm以及3000nm以上的远红外线热辐射的反射率相当高，因此有方向性的阻挡热的穿透，在寒带地区可以隔热保温，在热带或亚热带地区可以减少室外阳光所传递的热能，减轻空调负荷。
explanation_en: Transparent glass is made by coating one or two or even three extremely thin metal oxide films on the surface of glass by vacuum magnetron sputtering. This kind of film has extremely low surface emittance, which allows visible light waves with wavelengths of 380-780nm to pass through. However, its reflectivity to far-infrared heat radiation with wavelengths of 780-3000nm and above is quite high, so it can block heat penetration directionally. It can be used for heat insulation in cold regions, and can reduce the heat energy transferred by outdoor sunlight and reduce air conditioning load in tropical or subtropical regions.

explanation_en: Porcelain dielectric, known as "strong dielectric", has a dielectric constant as high as 4000-8000 and is widely used in filtering, bypass, flood control, rectification and AC circuit breakers. This type of porcelain material not only requires ε High value and good temperature stability are required. The Curie point should be within the working temperature range and can be easily adjusted.

explanation_en: It is one of the cubic crystal system structures and one of the 11 types of translational lattice (Bravais lattice) structures. If the structural particles (atoms, ions, molecules or other atomic groups) of a specific substance are configured on each array, the specific crystal structure 3 of the substance has a structural particle in its unit cell of crystal at each vertex and in the center of the cube. The efficiency of spare filling of the body-centered cubic structure, which is made up of simple matter atoms, is slightly lower than that of the face centered cubic structure.

explanation_en: The mass per unit volume of refractory containing openings and closed pores is called bulk density.

explanation_cn: 又称体积弹性模量。一个材料常数，是材料在等静力作用下，在弹性变形范围内，外加等静压力与体积应变的比值。它表征材料抵抗压缩的能力。其数值由B = -PΔV/V?计算，其中P为外加等静压力，ΔV为体积减小量，V?为原始体积。体积模量是材料力学性能中最稳定的指标之一，它反映内部原子间结合力的大小。体积模量B的倒数（1/B）称为材料的压缩率（compressibility）。对于各向同性材料，抗拉模量E、剪切模量G、泊松比ν和体积模量B之间符合E = 2G(1+ν) = 3K(1-2ν)的关系，由于等静压下材料总是缩小，所以B值永远为正数。定义式不仅适用于固体，也适用于液体和气体
explanation_en: Also called modulus of volume elasticity. A materials constant is the ratio of the applied isostatic pressure to the volume strain of materials in the range of elastic deformation under the isostatic action. It represents the ability of materials to resist compression. Its value is determined by B=- P Δ V/V ? calculation, where P is the applied isostatic pressure, Δ V is the reduction in volume, and V ? is the original volume. Bulk modulus is one of the most stable indexes in the mechanical properties of materials. The reciprocal (1/B) of bulk modulus B is called the compressibility of materials. For isotropic materials, tensile modulus E, shear modulus G, Poisson's ratio ν Compliance between E=2G (1) and bulk modulus B+ ν) = 3K (1-2 ν) Because materials always shrinks under isostatic pressing, B value is always positive. The definition formula is not only applicable to solids, but also to liquids and gases

explanation_cn: 又称惰性颜料。指在涂料体系中应用时，不起遮盖和着色作用、不影响涂层的性质.但可增加体积、降低成本的一类颜料。惰性颜料是相对活性颜料而言。活性颜料一方面可着色方面具备防腐、防锈等功能。体积颜料在涂料中主要有以下作用：①调节涂料的颜料体枳浓度，降低成本：②改善聚合物分子间相互作用力，降低分子内应力.增强漆膜的机械强度和附费力；③使漆膜表面粗糙，起消光作用；④调节漆膜的水、气渗透性等。体积颜料一般为无机颜料.常用的有碳酸钙、硅酸盐、滑石粉等"这些颜料广泛存在于大自然中，价格低廉，已广泛应用于各类印刷油墨、建筑涂料、橡胶、塑料填充等行业中。
explanation_en: Also called inert pigment. It refers to a kind of pigment that does not cover and stain, and does not affect the properties of the coating when applied in the coatings system, but can increase the volume and reduce the cost. Inert pigment is relative to active pigment. Active pigment, on the one hand, can be colored, and has the functions of anti-corrosion and rust prevention. Bulk pigment mainly has the following functions in coatings: ① adjust the pigment body concentration of coatings to reduce costs; ② improve the intermolecular interaction of polymer, reduce the intramolecular stress, and enhance the mechanical strength and adhesion of the paint film; ③ Make the surface of the paint film rough and have a matting effect; ④ Adjust the water and air permeability of the paint film. Bulk pigment are generally inorganic pigment. Common pigment include calcium carbonate, silicate, talcum powder, etc. "These pigment are widely found in nature at low prices and have been widely used in various printing ink, architectural coatings, rubber, plastics filling and other industries.

explanation_en: In the non ideal type II superconductor, the interaction between the magnetic flux quantum wire and the bulk defect (such as the second phase impurity) inside the superconductor results in the obstruction of the movement of the magnetic flux quantum wire, which is called bulk pinning.

explanation_cn: 即激发停止后的发光。有些光致发光材料如ZnS:Cu在紫外线甚至阳光照射后，发光可延续较长时间，最长可达几个小时，这些材料称为长发光材料。余辉的长短对阴极射线致发光材料极为重要，常把衰减到初始亮度10%的时间称为时间。时间小于lμs的称作超短，1-10μs间的称为短，10μs-lms间的称为中短，1-100ms间的称为中，100ms-1s间的称为长，大于ls的称为极长。电视用荧光粉需要中，雷达用荧光粉要长或极长，飞点扫描管中用的要超短。②材料经引燃离开点火源后，材料保持的辉光固相燃烧，有时也称为无焰燃烧。
explanation_en: That is, luminescence after excitation stops. Some luminescence materials, such as ZnS: Cu, can emit luminescence for a long time, up to several hours, after being exposed to ultraviolet and even sunlight. These materials are called long luminescence materials. The length of afterglow is very important for cathode ray luminescent powder, and the time when it decays to 10% of the initial brightness is often called time. Time less than l μ S is called ultra short, 1-10 μ The distance between s is called short, 10 μ The values between s-lms are called medium short, those between 1-100ms are called medium, those between 100ms and 1s are called long, and those greater than ls are called extremely long. The phosphor for TV should be medium, the phosphor for radar should be long or extremely long, and the one for flying spot scanning tube should be ultra short. ② After the materials is ignited and leaves the ignition source, the glow solid phase combustion maintained by materials is sometimes called after glow.

explanation_en: Igneous rock formed by magma intrusion into the crust and white condensation crystallization. Appearing in the form of rock foundation, rock stock, rock nodule, and rock branch. There are many types of rock with complex lithology, including basic, neutral, intermediate acid and acid rocks.

explanation_cn: 便于携带到不同地方使用的燃料电池系统，这类燃料电池系统主要为移动式电子设备（如手机、计算机、手提电子设备）供电，其功率一般在几瓦到几百瓦范围内。
explanation_en: Fuel cell systems that are easy to carry to different places for use. These fuel cell systems mainly supply power for mobile electronic devices (such as mobile phones, computers, portable electronic devices), and their power is generally in the range of several to several hundred watts.

explanation_cn: 半导体中电子和空穴复合释放的能量传递给其他载流子，增加它们的动能，这种复合称为俄歇复合，主要发生在窄带隙半导体或重掺半导体中。
explanation_en: The energy released by composition of electrons and holes in semiconductors is transferred to other carriers to increase their kinetic energy. This composition is called Auger recombination, which mainly occurs in narrow band gap semiconductors or heavily doped semiconductors.

explanation_cn: 一种来自固体表面几个原子层的信息，以法国人Auger于1925年发现的俄歇效应为基础而得名。俄歇电子能谱仪是重要的表面分析技术，它由一次电子发射系统、电子能量分析和探测系统、信号显示及处理系统和超高真空系统组成。
explanation_en: A type of information from several atomic layers on the surface of a solid, named after the Auger effect discovered by the Frenchman Auger in 1925. Auger electron spectroscopy is an important surface analysis technology, consisting of a primary electron emission system, an electron energy analysis and detection system, a signal display and processing system, and an ultra-high vacuum system.

explanation_cn: 见俄歇跃迁。
explanation_en: See the Auger transition.

explanation_cn: 又称俄歇衰变。当X射线或γ射线辐射到物体上时，由于光子能量很高，能穿入物体，使原子内壳层上的束缚电子发射出来。当原子的内层电子被激发形成空穴后，原子处于较高能量的激发态，这一状态是不稳定的，它将自发跃迁到能量较低的状态——辐射退激发过程。存在两种退激发过程：一种是以特征X射线形式向外辐射能量--辐射退激发（辐射跃迁）。另一种通过原子内部的转换过程把能量交给较外层的另一电子使它克服结合能而向外发射——无辐射退激发过程（Auger过程）（无辐射跃迁）。
explanation_en: Also known as Auger decay. When X-rays or γ When rays radiate onto an object, due to the high energy of photons, they can penetrate the object, causing the bound electrons on the inner shell of the atom to be emitted. When the inner electrons of an atom are excited to form holes, the atom is in a higher energy excited state, which is unstable and will spontaneously transition to a lower energy state - the radiative de excitation process. There are two types of de excitation processes: one is to radiate energy outward in the form of characteristic X-rays - radiation de excitation (radiation transition). The other is to transfer the energy to another electron in the outer layer through the conversion process inside the atom, so that it can overcome the binding energy and emit outward - the non radiative de excitation process (Auger process) (nonradiative transition).

explanation_cn: 对于非理想第二类超导体，由于超导体内存在晶体缺陷而呈现不可逆的特性。

explanation_en: The powder or granular material mixed by base material, flux and melting rate control agent added to the continuous casting mold will form a three-layer structure of original slag layer, sintering layer and liquid slag layer under the effect of high temperature of liquid steel, which plays the role of insulation and heat preservation, isolation of air to prevent secondary oxidation of liquid steel, purification of slag interface to absorb inclusions in liquid steel, lubrication of solidified billet shell and improvement of solidification heat transfer.

explanation_cn: 利用光子作为信息的载体，以光的形式传递信息的光纤。相比电缆，光纤具有衰减小、频带宽、抗干扰性强、安全性能高、体积小、质量轻、使用寿命长等优点，在长距离传输和特殊环境等方面具有无法比拟的优势。在通信领域有重要应用，可用来传输模拟信号和数字信号甚至视频。
explanation_en: A optical fiber that uses photons as a carrier of information and transmits information in the form of light. Compared with cable, optical fiber has the advantages of small attenuation, wide frequency band, strong anti-interference, high safety performance, small size, light weight, long service life, etc. It has incomparable advantages in long-distance transmission and special environment. It has important applications in the field of communication, which can be used to transmit analog signals, digital signals, and even videos.

explanation_cn: 用于实现传输、探测、存储、运算、处理和显示信息的材料。根据其在信息技术中功能可分为：敏感材料、信息存储材料、信息运算与处理器件材料、信息传输材料、信息显示材料等。发展的主要特点是质量要求高、技术发展快、材料更新快。
explanation_en: Materials used to transmit, detect, store, calculate, process and display information. According to its functions in information technology, it can be divided into: sensitive materials, information storage materials, information computing and processor materials, information transmission materials, information display materials, etc. The main characteristics of the development are high quality requirements, rapid technological development and rapid materials update.

explanation_cn: 又称假体，是一种替代人体某个肢体、器官或组织的医疗器械。这里的"替代"主要是形体替代，或形体和功能的同时替代。只有在形体上也替代了人体中某一部分的医疗器械，才称为。又可将其分为体外和植入性两类。体外是附着或固定在人体体表，有形地替换了肢体或组织等的，如假牙、假肢和义眼等;体内是全部植人人体内部，替换了器官或组织的，如人关节、人工韧带、人骨、人工肌腱和人工心瓣膜等。有些情况下，或器械仅部分穿过了皮肤或黏膜，并在穿过位置保持相当长的时间，而一部分却保持在体外，如穿过皮肤并在那里保留相当长的一段时间的医疗器械称为经皮器械。同样，穿过黏膜的医疗器械称为经黏膜器械等。
explanation_en: Also known as prosthesis, it is a medical device that replaces a limb, organ or tissue of the human body. The "substitution" here mainly refers to the substitution of form, or the simultaneous substitution of form and function. Only medical device that physically replace a part of the human body are called. It can also be divided into two categories: in vitro and implantable. The external body is attached or fixed on the body surface of the human body, which has physically replaced limbs or tissues, such as false teeth, artificial limbs and artificial eyes; The body is completely implanted into the human body, replacing organs or tissues, such as human joints, artificial ligaments, human bones, artificial tendons, and artificial heart valves. In some cases, or the device only partially passes through the skin or mucous membrane and remains at the crossing position for a long time, while a part remains outside the body, such as the medical device that passes through the skin and remains there for a long time is called a percutaneous device. Similarly, medical device that pass through the mucosa are called transmucosal devices.

explanation_cn: 倒逆过程是指两个波矢的x分量为正的声子碰撞生成一个波矢的x分量为负的声子散射过程。三声子的相互作用，对于声子合并，动量守恒表示为 k1+k2-k3=G，倒格矢G可以为零或是倒格矢的线性组合。如果k1+k2落在第一布里渊区的波矢中，则G=0，否则G≠0。G=0的声子散射过程称为正态过程，G≠0为倒逆过程。没有倒逆过程，晶体的热导率仍将是无限的，因为在正态散射中，生成的第三个声子保留了原来两个声子的能量和方向。在倒逆过程中，多余的倒格波矢改变了声子的传播净方向，造成了热流的阻力。
explanation_en: The umklapp process refers to the process of phonon scattering in which two wave vectors with positive x components collide to generate a phonon scattering scattering in which one wave vector with negative x components. For the interaction of three phonon, for phonon merging, the momentum conservation is expressed as k1+k2-k3=G, and the reciprocal lattice vector G can be zero or a linear combination of reciprocal lattice vectors. If k1+k2 fall in the wave vector of the first Brillouin zone, then G=0, otherwise G ≠ 0. The phonon scattering process with G=0 is called a normal process, and G ≠ 0 is a umklapp process. Without inverse process, the thermal conductivity of crystal will still be infinite, because in normal scattering, the generated third phonon retains the energy and direction of the original two phonon. In the umklapp process, the superfluous inverse lattice wave vector changes the net propagation direction of phonon, resulting in the resistance of heat flow.

explanation_cn: 使用偏振光作为光源的光学显微镜。利用偏振光的干涉原理研究材料的晶相显微结构。若与补偿器联用，也可以测定材料的取向度。在类似明场的条件下可以区分各向同性和各向异性的物质，吸收光和光程界限，材料的结构和组成。观察尺寸范围0.2-100fim。偏光显微镜有两个偏振镜。一个装置在光源与被检物体之间的叫"起偏镜"；另一个装置在物镜与目镜之间的叫"检偏镜'利用偏光显微镜的各部件可以组合成单偏光、正交偏光、锥光等光学分析系统，用来鉴定晶体的光学性质。利用单偏光镜鉴定晶体光学性质时。仅使用偏光显微镜中的下偏光镜，可观察的白容有：晶体形态、晶体颗粒大小、百分含量、解理、突起，糙面、贝克线以及颜色和多色性等。而正交偏光镜-就是下偏光镜和上偏光镜联合使用。并且两偏光镜的振动面处于互相垂直位置。由于晶体的性质和切片方向不同。将出现消光和干涉等光学现象。
explanation_en: An optical microscope that uses polarized light as the light source. The crystal phase microstructure of materials is studied by the interference principle of polarized light. If combined with compensator, the degree of orientation of materials can also be measured. Under conditions similar to bright field, isotropic and anisotropic materials can be distinguished, absorption light and optical path limit, and structure and composition of materials. Observe the size range of 0.2-100fim. The polarized light microscopy has two polarizers. A device located between the light source and the object being tested is called a "polarizing mirror"; Another device between the objective and eyepiece is called The "polarizer" can be combined into a single polarized light, orthogonal polarized light, cone light and other optical analysis systems by using various parts of the polarized light microscopy to identify the optical properties of crystal. When using the single polarizing lens to identify the optical properties of crystal, only the lower polarizing lens in the polarized light microscopy can be used to observe the white content: crystal shape, crystal particle size, percentage content, cleavage, protrusion, rough surface, beck line, color and polychromaticity Light mirror - refers to the combination of a lower polarizer and an upper polarizer. And the vibration surfaces of the two polarizers are in perpendicular positions to each other. Because the properties of crystal and the direction of slicing are different. Optical phenomena such as extinction and interference will occur.

In the structure of liquid crystal display device, polorizer (also called polarizer) only allows light waves vibrating in one direction to pass through, while light waves vibrating in other directions will be blocked completely or partially.

explanation_cn: 只能传输一个线偏振光的光纤。在阶跃光纤中，曾指出阶跃型的单模光纤传输LPm模，用更严格的电磁理论来分析将发现1上;1模是由两个互相垂直的线偏振HEux和iHE"Y简并而成的。偏振光纤就是要求在光纤中只传输一个偏振模。另一个偏振模在传输中耗尽或被截止。所以，这种光纤又称为单模单偏光纤（singlemodesingle_polarizationfiber)。形成单模单偏传输，有两个方法：①在光纤芯子旁边形成一个隧道将一个线偏振模漏掉；②选择适当的条件使两个偏振模的截止波长分离，在一定的波长下，一个偏振模被截I止。另一个在传输。严格地说■只有偏振光纤才是真正的单模光纤。单模偏光纤在光纤通信与光纤传感技术中有许多重要的应用。
explanation_en: A optical fiber that can transmit only one linearly polarized light. In the step index optical fiber, it has been pointed out that the step single mode optical filler transmits LPm mode, and it will be found that 1; Mode 1 is formed by the degeneracy of two mutually perpendicular linear polarization HEux and iHE "Y. polarized optical fiber is required to transmit only one polarization mode in the optical fiber. The other polarization mode is depleted or cut off in transmission. Therefore, this kind of optical fiber is also called single mode single polarization fiber . There are two ways to form single mode single polarization transmission: ① form a tunnel beside the optical fiber core to leak a linear polarization mode; ② Select appropriate conditions to separate the cutoff wavelengths of two polarization modes, and at a certain wavelength, one polarization mode is truncated. The other is transmitting. Strictly speaking, only polarized optical fiber is a real single mode optical filler. Single mode polarized fiber has many important applications in optical fiber communication and optical fiber sensing technology.

explanation_cn: 由于凝固、固态相变以及元素密度差异、晶体缺陷与完整晶体的能量差异等原因引起的在多组元合金中的成分不均匀现象。按偏析产生的原因可将其分为凝固偏析（也称一次偏析）、同态相变偏析（也称二次偏析>、密度偏析、晶体缺陷偏析等。按偏析分布的范围大小可分为宏观偏析和微观偏析。按偏析前后系统能量的高低可分为非平衡偏析和平衡偏析，按偏析分布特征可分为晶白偏析、晶界偏析、枝晶偏析等。
explanation_en: The compositional inhomogeneity in multi-component alloy is caused by solidification, solid phase transformation, difference in element density, and energy difference between crystal defect and complete crystal. According to the causes of segregation, it can be divided into solidification segregation (also called primary segregation), homomorphic phase transformation segregation (also called secondary segregation>, density segregation, crystal defect segregation, etc. segregation can be divided into macro segregation and micro segregation. According to the level of system energy before and after segregation, it can be divided into nonequilibrium segregation and equilibrium segregation, and according to the distribution characteristics of segregation, it can be divided into crystal white segregation, segregation in grain boundary, dendritic segregation, etc.
