explanation_cn: 指具有一个或多个偶氮基（一N=N—)为发色团，且通常由羟基或氨基作为助色团的一类染料，是品种最多且最重要的一类合成染料"根据分子白偶氮基的数目，偶氮染料可分为单偶氮、双偶氮及多偶氮染料。按应用性质可分为酸性染料、媒介染料、直接染料、显色染料（主要指冰染染料）、分散染料、反应性染料以及溶剂染料等。生产偶氮染料最常用的方法是将芳香烃（或其杂环化合物）用亚硝酸盐处理生成重氮盐（重氮化），然后将该重氮盐与酚类或者芳胺等进行偶合作用。与酚类的偶合通常在碱性条件下进行；与芳胺的偶合通常在酸性条件下进行。偶氮染料因合成工艺简单、成本低廉、染色性能突出等优点。使其无论在品种或在数量上均为最大的一类工业染料。不仅用于各类纤维的染色和印花，还用于化学纤维、皮革、纸张、肥皂、蜡烛、木材、麦秆、羽毛等染色以及油漆、油墨、塑料、橡胶、食品、化妆品等的着色。有一部分含有偶氮结构的染料在经过裂解后可能产生致癌的芳香胺。是被禁止使用的。例如最常用的苏丹红（主要包括苏丹红1号、苏丹红2号、苏丹红3号和苏丹红4号），主要用于溶剂、油、蜡、汽油增色以及鞋和地板等的增光，具有强致癌性，2012年已被禁止使用。
explanation_en: Refers to a class of dye or dyestuffc with one or more azo groups (one N=N -) as chromophores, and usually with hydroxyl or amino groups as color groups, According to the number of molecular white azo groups, azobenzene dye can be divided into single azo, double azo and multi azobenzene dye. According to the application properties, they can be divided into acid dye or dyestuffc, media dye or dyestuffc, direct dye or dyestuffc, color dye or dyestuffc (mainly ice dyed dye or dyestuffc), disperse dye or dyestuffc, reactive dye or dyestuffc and solvent dye or dyestuffc. The most common method of producing azobenzene dye is to use aromatic hydrocarbons (or their heterocyclic compounds) Nitrite treatment is used to generate diazonium salt (diazotization), and then the diazonium salt is coupled with phenols or aromatic amines. Coupling with phenols is usually carried out under alkaline conditions; The coupling with aromatic amines is usually carried out under acidic conditions. Azobenzene dye have many advantages such as simple synthetic process, low cost and outstanding dyeing properties. It is the largest industrial dye or dyestuffc in terms of variety and quantity. It is not only used for dyeing and printing of various fibers, but also for dyeing of chemical fibers, leather, paper, soap, candles, wood, straw, feathers, paint, ink, plastics, rubber, food, cosmetics, etc. Some dye or dyestuffc containing azo structure may produce carcinogenic aromatic amine after pyrolysis. It is prohibited to use. For example, the most commonly used Sudan Red (mainly including Sudan Red No. 1, Sudan Red No. 2, Sudan Red No. 3 and Sudan Red No. 4) is mainly used for brightening of solvents, oils, waxes, gasoline, shoes and floors, which is strongly carcinogenicity and has been banned from use in 2012.

explanation_cn: 分子结构中含有偶氮基（一N==N-)并与两个烷基（R、R')相连的化合物（通式为R-N=N-W)，在光和热作用下分解而放出氮气，同时生成自由基，用于引发自由基聚合的化合物。偶氮类引发剂分解属单分子一级反应。引发反应释放氮气可兼作发泡剂，引发活性不髙，使用温度一般在60°C以上。常用油溶性的偶氮类引发剂有偶氮二异丁腈、偶氮二异庚腈等，多用于本体聚合、悬浮聚合和溶液聚合。常用水溶性的引发剂有偶氮二异丁脒盐酸盐、偶氮二异丁咪唑啉盐酸盐等，应用于乳液聚合和水溶液聚合等。水油两性的偶氮类引发剂有偶氮异丁腈基甲酰胺。
explanation_en: The compound containing azo group (one N==N -) in its molecular structure and connected with two alkyl groups (R, R ') (the general formula is R-N=N-W), decomposes under the action of light and heat to release nitrogen, and generates free radicals, which are used to initiate free radical polymerization compounds. The decomposition of azo initiators belongs to the first order reaction of a single molecule. The nitrogen released from the initiation reaction can also be used as a blowing agent. The initiation activity is not high, and the service temperature is generally above 60 ° C. The commonly used oil soluble azo initiators include azodiisobutyronitrile, azodiioheptronitrile, etc., which are mostly used in bulk polymerization, suspension polymerization and solution polymerization. The commonly used water-soluble initiators are azodiisobutymidine hydrochloride, azodiisobutymidazoline hydrochloride, etc., which are used in emulsion polymerization and aqueous solution polymerization. Azo based initiators for water oil amphotericity include azoisobutyronitrile formamide.

explanation_cn: 通常是指用于改善聚合物基体和填料之间界面相互作用或相容性的一类物质。通过偶联剂的使用可改善填料在聚合物基体中的分散性以及界面相容性，可获得改善的表观质量、物理机械性能、电性能、热性能、光性能等。其用量一般为填料用量的0.5%-2%。按偶联剂的化学结构及组成分为硅烷类、钛酸酯类、铝酸锆类偶联剂等，其中硅烷类、钛酸酯类偶联剂使用最为广泛。硅烷偶联剂是目前品种最多，用量最大的一类偶联剂，其通式为RSiX3，式中R代表氨基、巯基、乙烯基、环氧基、氰基及甲基丙烯酰氧基等基团，这些基团和不同的基体树脂均具有较强的反应能力，X代表能够水解的烷氧基（如甲氧基、乙氧基等）。主要用于玻璃纤维增强塑料，还可以用于聚烯烃交联和直接用于塑料、橡胶共混改性或增黏用。
explanation_en: It usually refers to a kind of material used to improve the interface interaction or compatibility between polymer matrix and filler. The use of coupling agent can improve the dispersion of filler in polymer matrix and interface compatibility, and improve the apparent quality, physical and mechanical properties, electrical properties, thermal properties, optical properties, etc. Its dosage is generally 0.5% -2% of the filler dosage. According to the chemical structure and composition of coupling agent, it can be divided into silane, titanate, zirconium aluminate coupling agent, etc., of which silane and titanate coupling agent are most widely used. Silicone coupling agent is a kind of coupling agent with the largest variety and amount of use at present. Its general formula is RSiX3, in which R represents amino, mercapto, vinyl, epoxy, cyano and methacryloyloxy groups. These groups have strong reactivity with different matrix resin, and X represents alkoxy groups that can be hydrolyzed (such as methoxy, ethoxy, etc.). It is mainly used for glass fiber reinforced plastics, polyolefin crosslinking and directly used for plastics, rubber polymer blending modification or tackifying.

explanation_cn: 指能使液体物料在低剪切作用下具有高黏度，而在高剪切作用下黏度却很低的一类添加剂物质，广泛应用于建筑、涂料行业。触变性亦称摇变，是凝胶体在振荡、压迫等机械力的作用下发生的逆溶胶现象。涂料在受到剪切力时.稠度下降，剪切力越大，下降的幅度也大，当剪切力撤除后.稠度又慢慢恢复到原来的状态，这种现象称为触变。涂料中使用触变剂后，在施T时的高剪切速率下有较低黏度.有助于涂料流动并易于施工；在施I.前后的低剪切速率下冇较高黏度，可防止颜料沉降和湿膜流挂。目前普遍使用的触变剂有四大类，包括气相二氧化硅、有机膨润土、氢化蓖麻油、聚酰胺蜡.但其在使用上又有很大区别，对涂料触变性的影响从大到小依次为：聚酰胺蜡、二氧化硅、有机膨润土、氢化蓖麻油。触变剂还可用于食品、药品、化妆品、乳胶和乳化油配方中。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of additive that can make liquid materials have high viscosity under low shear, but low viscosity under high shear. It is widely used in building and coatings industries. Thixotropy, also known as shake, is the reverse sol phenomenon of gel under the action of mechanical forces such as vibration and compression. When the coatings is subjected to the shear force, the consistency decreases. The greater the shear force, the greater the decrease. When the shear force is removed, the consistency slowly returns to the original state. This phenomenon is called thixotropy. When thixotropic agent is used in coatings, it has a lower viscosity at the high shear rate when T is applied, which helps coatings flow and is easy to apply; High viscosity at low shear rate before and after applying I. It can prevent pigment sedimentation and wet film sagging. At present, there are four types of thixotropic agent commonly used, including fumed silica, organic bentonite, hydrogenated castor oil, and polyamide wax. However, their use is very different, and their effects on the thixotropy of coatings are in descending order: polyamide wax, silica, organic bentonite, and hydrogenated castor oil. Thixotropic agent can also be used in food, medicine, cosmetics, latex and emulsified oil formulations.

explanation_cn: 指在一定条件下（温度、压力、催化剂等）储氢材料释放出的氢气含量，即储氢材料储存氢的容量。通常以质量分数、体积百分比和氢、金属原子比为单位（分别用％、gL和HM表示）.是衡量储氢材料性能的主要指标之一。氢的储存方式可分为物理法和化学法。物理储存方法主要有高压氢气储存、液氢储存、活性炭吸附储存等，其储氢容量由容器的大小决定；化学储存方法有金属氢化物、化学氢化物储存等，其储氢容量由储氢材料的性质决定。利用化学氢化物储氢时.储氢容量的测试方法一般分为气态氢化实验和电化学实验。
explanation_en: It refers to the hydrogen content released by the hydrogen storage materials under certain conditions (temperature, pressure, catalyst, etc.), i.e. the hydrogen storage capacity of the hydrogen storage materials. It is usually expressed in mass fraction, volume percentage and atomic ratio of hydrogen and metal (respectively expressed in%, gL and HM). It is one of the main indicators to measure the performance of hydrogen storage materials. The storage methods of hydrogen can be divided into physical and chemical methods. Physical storage methods mainly include high-pressure hydrogen storage, liquid hydrogen storage, activated carbon adsorption storage, etc. Its hydrogen storage capacity is determined by the size of the container; Chemical storage methods include metal hydride, chemical hydride storage, etc. Its hydrogen storage capacity is determined by the nature of hydrogen storage materials. When using chemical hydride hydrogen storage to store hydrogen, the test methods of hydrogen storage capacity are generally divided into gaseous hydrogenation experiment and electrochemical experiment.

explanation_cn: 简称催化。催化剂在化学反应过程中所起的作用和发生的有关现象的总称。催化剂指能够提高反应速率、加快到达化学平衡而本身在反应终了时并不消耗的物质。在催化反应中，催化剂与反应物发生化学作用，改变了反应途径，从而降低了反应的活化能。催化有均相和多相两种。前者是催化剂和反应物处于同一物相，如溶液中有机金属化合物的催化作用；后者是催化剂和反应物处于不同物相，如气相或液相反应物与固体催化剂形成气同或液固界面的催化作用。
explanation_en: It is abbreviated as catalysis. The general term for the role and related phenomena of catalysts in chemical reactions. Catalyst refers to the substance that can increase the reaction rate and speed up the process of reaching chemical equilibrium, but does not consume itself at the end of the reaction. In the catalytic reaction, the catalyst and reactants react chemically, changing the reaction path, thus reducing the activation or conditioning energy of the reaction. There are two types of catalysis, homogeneous and heterogeneous. The former is that the catalyst and reactant are in the same phase, such as the catalysis of organometallic compounds in solution; The latter refers to the catalysis in which the catalyst and reactants are in different phases, such as the gas-phase or liquid-phase reactants and solid catalysts form the gas-phase or liquid-solid interface.

explanation_cn: 催化剂表面因被其他物质覆盖而减少了可被反应物所用催化剂表面的过程或现象。其他物质可能是吸附在催化剂表面上，如CO吸附在Pt的表面上；其他物质也可能是在催化剂表面形成一个覆盖层，如S在Pt的表面上形成一个原子层。
explanation_en: The process or phenomenon of reducing the surface of a catalyst that can be used by reactants due to being covered by other substances. Other substances may be adsorbed on the surface of the catalyst, such as CO adsorbed on the surface of Pt; Other substances may also form a covering layer on the surface of the catalyst, such as S forming an atomic layer on the surface of Pt.

explanation_cn: 单位质量催化剂的催化能力。一般用其在动力学控制区间某一指定电压下所能支持的电流表示。由于电流的大小和电压有关，电压一般是被业界所指定或所公认一个值。如，对于氧气的还原反应，业界一般选用0.90V时的氧气还原电流除以催化剂的质量来计算催化剂对氧气还原反应的质量活性。催化剂质量活性主要取决于催化剂本身的特殊。催化活性较高的催化剂将会有较大的质量活性。对于同一种催化剂，一般来讲，粒度越小的颗粒单位质量的表面积越大，质量活性应该越高。但当催化剂颗粒过小时，容易吸附杂质且其表面原子的氧化态容易发生变化，反而导致其质量活性降低。
explanation_en: The catalytic capacity of a unit mass catalyst. It is generally represented by the current it can support at a specified voltage within the dynamic control range. Due to the relationship between the magnitude of current and voltage, voltage is generally a value specified or recognized by the industry. For example, for the reduction reaction of oxygen, the industry generally uses the oxygen reduction current at 0.90V divided by the mass of the catalyst to calculate the mass activity of the catalyst for the oxygen reduction reaction. The quality and activity of specific catalyst activity mainly depend on the particularity of the catalyst itself. Catalysts with higher catalytic activity will have greater mass activity. For the same catalyst, generally speaking, the smaller the particle size, the larger the surface area per unit mass, and the higher the mass activity. But when the catalyst particle is too small, it is easy to adsorb impurities and the oxidation state of its surface atoms is prone to change, which actually leads to a decrease in its mass activity.

explanation_cn: 催干剂是一种能够加速涂膜干燥的物质,对干性油膜的吸氧、聚合起着催化作用。有实用价值的催干剂是钴、锰、铅、铁、锌和钙等金属的氧化物、盐类及其有机酸皂。催干机理有几种解释: 第一，催干剂中金属被还原到低原子价,而将抗氧物氧化，从而加速油的氧化;第二，催干剂能加速油膜吸氧所形成的氢过氧化键破坏,形成稳定的氧键，油的其它不饱和键就进行直接聚合，减少了所需要的氧量;第三，催干剂能够吸收空气中的氧给予油膜,减少油膜吸氧的困难。催干剂混合使用比单独使用效力要高。
explanation_en: Drier is a kind of material that can accelerate the drying of coating film, and plays a catalysis in oxygen absorption and polymerization of dry oil film. The driers with practical value are oxides, salts and organic acid soaps of cobalt, manganese, lead, iron, zinc, calcium and other metals. There are several explanations for the drying mechanism: first, the metal in the dryer is reduced to low valence, and the antioxidant is oxidized, thus accelerating the oxidation of oil; Secondly, dryer can accelerate the destruction of hydrogen peroxide bond formed by oxygen absorption of oil film to form stable oxygen bond, and other unsaturated bonds of oil will be directly polymerization to reduce the required amount of oxygen; Third, dryer can absorb oxygen in the air and give it to the oil film, reducing the difficulty of oxygen absorption by the oil film. The mixed use of dryer is more effective than the single use.

explanation_cn: 距自由表面深处为L处有一右旋螺型位错A，为使自由表面处的应力为零，设想和A的位置呈镜像对称关系而出现的一左旋螺型位错B。B的伯格斯矢量和位错A的伯格斯矢量大小相等但方向相反（±b)，对位错A来自位错B的吸引力为F;F一般称为位错的像力。对于刃型位错的所产生的像力计算比较复杂。位错的像力是使位错倾向于接近于自由表面以松弛其弹性应变能。
explanation_en: There is a right-handed screw dislocation A at the depth L from the free surface. In order to make the stress at the free surface zero, a left-handed screw dislocation B appears by assuming a mirror symmetry relationship with the position of A. The Burgers vector of B and the Burgers vector of dislocation A are equal in size but opposite in direction (± b), and the attraction of dislocation A to dislocation B is F; F is generally called the image force of dislocation. It is complicated to calculate the image force generated by edge dislocation. The image force of dislocation is to make dislocation close to the free surface to relax its elasticity strain energy.

explanation_cn: 像素限定层，另有几种其他称谓bank,pillar以及separator。位于TFT与OLED中间，OLED材料蒸渡时，直接接触OLED shadow mask，第一可以保护电路，避免shadow mask造成刮伤，第二避免RGB混色现象的发生。常用的PDL材料类型有聚酰亚胺（polyimide)、亚克力（acrylic)。从感光性来区别，分为感光性与非感光性，分別使用光刻与喷墨打印的方式来制作。
explanation_en: Pixel limiting layer, also known as bank, pillar, and separator. It is located between TFT and OLED. When OLED materials are steamed, they directly contact the OLED shadow mask. The first is to protect the circuit from scratches caused by the shadow mask, and the second is to avoid RGB color mixing. Commonly used PDL materials include polyimide and acrylic. From the perspective of photosensitivity, it can be divided into photosensitivity and non photosensitivity, which are respectively produced using photolithography and inkjet printing methods.

explanation_cn: 又称元素高分子。高分子主链不含有碳原子，全部由硅、氧、氮、硫和硼等非碳元素的原子组成，但主链上的取代基可以含有有机基团，如甲基等。具有无机物的耐热性、耐燃性和有机物的热塑性和可熔性。可用作耐高温的涂料、塑料、润滑剂等。
explanation_en: Also known as elemental polymer. The main chain of the macromolecule does not contain carbon atoms, but consists of atoms of non carbon elements such as silicon, oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur and boron. However, the substituents on the main chain can contain organic groups, such as methyl. It has the heat resistance and flame resistance of inorganic substances, as well as the thermoplasticity and fusibility of organic substances. It can be used as high temperature resistant coatings, plastics, lubricant, etc.

explanation_cn: 仅由一种元素成分构成的粉末。
explanation_en: A powder consisting of only one element.

explanation_cn: 具有超导特性的单质元素物质，称为典型的元素超导体有Nb、In和Tl等。
explanation_en: Simple elemental substances with superconducting properties are called typical element superconductor, such as Nb, In and Tl.

explanation_cn: 是处理复杂系统在离散空间-时间上演化规律的算法，通常采用对晶格结点的局域或整体的确定性和概率变换规则进行具体操作。由每个晶格结点代表有限个可能的离散状态中的一个态，将某些变换规则应用于每个结点状态，由此发生自动机的演化的一种微观组织模拟方法。
explanation_en: It is an algorithm that deals with the evolution laws of complex systems in discrete space time, usually using local or global determinacy and probability transformation rules for specific operations of lattice nodes. A microstructural simulation method in which each lattice node represents a finite number of possible discrete states, and certain transformation rules are applied to each node state, resulting in the evolution of the automaton.

explanation_cn: 炸药在冲击波作用下发生爆炸的难易程度。冲击波起爆是炸药起爆的主要形式，所以冲击波感度对评价炸药的引爆和安全性能两方面都具有十分重要的意义.它反映炸药是否具有良好的战地生存能力（即不易发生意外引爆）和准确、可靠的起爆性能。测定方法有隔板试j验、楔形试验及殉爆试验等。隔板试验是最常用的方法，此法系在主发炸药（用以产生冲击波）和被发炸药（被冲击波引爆）间放置惰性隔板（金属板或塑料片），用升降法测定使被发炸药发生50%爆炸的临界隔板厚度，作为评价冲击波感度的指标。楔形试验系将楔形试样引爆，测定爆轰中止传播处试样的厚度(即熄爆厚度或失败厚度），以评价炸药的冲击波感度。
explanation_en: The difficulty of explosive explosion under the action of shock wave. Shock wave initiation is the main form of explosive initiation, so sensitivity to shock wave is of great significance in evaluating both the initiation and safety performance of explosive. It reflects whether explosive have good battlefield viability (that is, they are not prone to accidental initiation) and accurate and reliable initiation performance. The measurement methods include partition test, wedge test, and burst test. Diaphragm test is the most commonly used method. In this method, inert diaphragms (metal plates or plastic sheets) are placed between the main explosive (used to generate shock waves) and the sent explosive (detonated by shock waves), and the critical thickness of the diaphragms that cause 50% explosion of the sent explosive is measured by the lifting method as an index for evaluating sensitivity to shock wave. Wedge test is to detonate the wedge sample and measure the thickness of the sample at the stop of detonation propagation (i.e. the quenching thickness or failure thickness) to evaluate the shock wave sensitivity of explosive.

explanation_cn: 义齿基托树脂在面团形成期内填塞型腔的性能。将进人面团形成期的义齿基托树脂放在特制的带孔黄铜板上.在规定的温度下加一定的载荷并保持一定的时间，以树脂进入孔的数量及深度反映其充填性能。
explanation_en: The performance of denture base resin in filling cavity during dough formation. Place the denture base resin in the dough formation stage on a special perforated brass plate. Apply a certain load at the specified temperature and keep it for a certain time. The number and depth of resin entering the holes reflect its packing characteristics.

name_cn: 充电态内阻和放电态内阻
name_en: the internal resistance of the charge state and the internal resistance of the state of discharge
explanation_cn: 又称安时效率。指电池在一定放电条件下放电至某一截止电位时放出的容与充电时输人电池的容W的比值，它可按照以下公式汁算：充电效率=[放电电流X放电时间八充电电流X充电时间）]X100%。之所以有充电效率是因为电池充人的电量不能完全转化为放电容量。首先电池充电时输入的能量部分用来将活性物质转换为充电态，部分会消耗在副反应上来产生氧气；其次电池不可能充多少电量进去就能储存有多少电量.一定会有所耗损，任何材料都不能无瑕地储存所有电量；最后，电池有一定的自放电率。
explanation_en: It is also called ampere-hour efficiency. It refers to the ratio of the capacity released when the battery discharges to a certain cut-off potential under certain discharge conditions to the capacity W input into the battery during charging. It can be calculated according to the following formula: charging efficiency=[discharge current x discharge time 8 charging current x charging time] X100%. The reason for charging efficiency is that the charge of the battery can not be fully converted into discharge capacity. Firstly, some of the energy input during battery charging is used to convert the active substance into a charged state, while some is consumed by side reactions to produce oxygen; Secondly, it is impossible for the battery to store as much power as it can be charged. It must be consumed, and no materials can store all power flawlessly; Finally, the battery has a certain self-discharge rate.

explanation_cn: 将全部电池容M的电荷充（放）完所需的时间作为充放电时的标准速度.即充放电率。
explanation_en: The time required to charge (discharge) all the battery capacity M is used as the standard speed for charging and discharging, which is the charging and discharging rate.

explanation_cn: 具有优异的力学性能或特定功能的复合材料，采用较高强度和模量的硼纤维、碳纤维和芳纶纤维等增强的复合材料，后又把金属基、碳基、陶瓷基复合材料纳人的范围。但从技术成熟程度与应用范围看，碳纤维复合材料，尤其是树脂基碳纤维复合材料最为突出。ACM具有质量轻，较高的比强度、比模量，较好的延展性、抗腐蚀、隔热、隔声、减震、耐高（低）温等特点。先进复合材料已在航天、航空工业中成为关键的结构和功能材料。另外如新能源、信息、生物工程及海洋开发等高技术也都需要先进复合材料。
explanation_en: The composite materials with excellent mechanical properties or specific functions uses boron fiber, carbon fiber, aramid fiber and other reinforced composite materials with high strength and modulus, and then includes metal matrix, carbon matrix and ceramic matrix composite. However, from the perspective of technology maturity and application scope, carbon fiber composite materials, especially resin based carbon fiber composite materials, are the most prominent. ACM is characterized by light weight, high specific strength, specific modulus, good ductility, corrosion resistance, heat insulation, sound insulation, shock absorption, high (low) temperature resistance, etc. Advanced composite materials have become key structural and functional materials in aerospace and aviation industries. In addition, high technologies such as new energy, information, bioengineering and marine development also need advanced composite materials.

explanation_cn: 又称高性能陶瓷、技术陶瓷、新型陶瓷、高技术陶瓷、工程陶瓷、精细陶瓷和现代陶瓷。通常以精制的高纯、超细人工合成的无机化合物为原料，通过组成与结构设计，采用精确化学计量和精密控制的新型制备技术制成的赋予明确特定性能的陶瓷材料，其性能不仅远胜于传统陶瓷，且具有许多传统陶瓷所不具备的新的物理化学性能。区别于传统陶瓷（traditional ceramics)或工业陶瓷（industrial ceramics)，广义的包括人工单晶、非晶、陶瓷及其复合材料、半导体、耐火材料及水泥。按功能和用途可分为三类：①功能陶瓷(又称电子陶瓷），指利用其电、磁、声、光、热、弹、化等性质或其耦合效应，以实现某种使用功能的，以民用为主，亦可用于高新技术和军用技术。如水声、光电子、红外技术等;②结构陶瓷（又称工程陶瓷），指发挥其机械、热、化学等功能的用于各种结构部件的，主要用于要求耐高温、耐腐蚀、耐磨损的部件，如机械密封、陶瓷轴承、球阀、缸套、飞行器的天线罩等;③生物陶瓷，指发挥其生物和化学等功能的，主要用于人造骨、人工关节、固定酶载体、催化剂等，具有良好的生物相容性和化学稳定性。
explanation_en: It is also called high performance ceramics, technical ceramics, new ceramics, high technology ceramics, engineering ceramics, fine ceramics and moden ceramics. Generally, ceramics materials with specific properties are made from refined high-purity, ultra-fine synthetic inorganic compounds through composition and structure design, using new preparation technologies of precise stoichiometry and precise control. Their properties are not only far superior to traditional ceramics, but also have many new physical chemistry properties that traditional ceramics do not have. Different from traditional ceramics or industrial ceramics, it broadly includes artificial single crystal, amorphous, ceramics and their composite materials, semiconductors, refractory and cement. It can be divided into three categories according to functions and uses: ① functional ceramics (also called electronic ceramics), which refers to the use of their electrical, magnetic, acoustic, optical, thermal, elastic, chemical and other properties or their coupling effects to achieve a certain use function, mainly for civil use, but also for high-tech and military technology. Such as underwater sound, optoelectronics, infrared technology, etc.; ② Structural ceramics (also known as engineering ceramics), which are used for various structural parts to play their mechanical, thermal, chemical and other functions, are mainly used for parts that require high temperature resistance, corrosion resistance and wear resistance, such as mechanical seals, ceramics bearings, ball valves, cylinder liners, aircraft radomes, etc.; ③ Biological cemmics, which play their biological and chemical functions, are mainly used for artificial bones, artificial joint, immobilized enzyme carriers, catalysts, etc., and have good biocompatibility and chemical stability.

explanation_cn: 光作用下使线型聚合物变成体型聚合物的变化过程。
explanation_en: The process of changing linear polymer into somatotype polymer under the action of light.

explanation_cn: 又称固化型光敏高分子材料，和一般光敏高分子材料的不同之处是它在光照后可形成立体网状结构的产物。该类材料要求有多官能度的低聚物作为原料组分之一。多官能度低聚物的品种很多.但作为光聚合用的低聚物其官能团主要选用不饱和烯烃如丙烯酸酯或屮基丙烯酸酯等基闭，它们可通过高分子反应或缩聚反应引人形成多官能度低聚物。
explanation_en: Also known as curing type photosensitive polymer materials, it is different from the general photosensitive macromolecule materials in that it can form a three-dimensional network structure after illumination. This kind of materials requires multifunctional oligomer as one of the raw material components. There are many kinds of multifunctional oligomer. However, the functional groups of oligomer used for photopolymerization mainly use unsaturated olefins such as acrylate or mesoacrylate, which can be introduced to form multifunctional oligomer through macromolecule reaction or polycondensation reaction reaction.

explanation_cn: 将由镶嵌边框形成的非晶硅太阳能电池条框架，安装在中空玻璃夹层内，实现一次性解决中空玻璃既能够作为建筑材料使用，既透明、隔声、隔热、廉价、减小太阳能辐射，又能电能供使用的一种中空玻璃。
explanation_en: The amorphous silicon solar cell strip frame formed by the mosaic frame is installed in the insulating glass interlayer to realize a one-time solution to the problem that insulating glass can be used as a building materials, which is transparent, sound insulation, heat insulation, cheap, reduces solar radiation, and can also be used as electrical energy.

explanation_cn: 由玻璃、太阳电池、汇流条、绝缘胶带引出端等组成，用中间层分隔并通过处理使其黏结为一体，且具有发电功能的产品统称为太阳能光伏夹层玻璃，俗称双玻组件或三玻组件。
explanation_en: The products that are composed of glass, solar cell, bus bars, insulating tape leads, etc., separated by an intermediate layer and treated to bond them into a whole, and have the power generation function are collectively referred to as solar photovoltaic laminated glass, commonly known as double glass module or three glass module.

explanation_cn: 一种通过层压入太阳电池，能够利用太阳辐射发电，并具有相关电流引出装置以及电缆的特种玻璃。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a special glass which is laminated into solar cell, can generate electricity by using solar radiation, and is equipped with relevant current leading out devices and cables.

explanation_cn: 将真空玻璃技术、导电玻璃技术与太阳能电池技术相结合的一种玻璃深加工制品，即将由一片真空玻璃和一片钢化玻璃组合成真空结构，两片玻璃中间复合太阳能电池片组成复合层，电池片之间由导线串联或并联汇集引线端。
explanation_en: A glass deep processing product combining vacuum glass technology, conductive glass technology and solar cell technology phase, that is, a piece of vacuum glass and a piece of strengthened glass are combined into a vacuum structure, two pieces of glass are composition solar cell sheets in the middle to form a composition layer, and wires are connected in series or parallel between the battery sheets to collect leads ends.

explanation_cn: 指在光作用下可以诱发光氧化-还原反应的一类复合材料。半导体在光激发下，电子从价带跃迁到导带位置，以此?在导带形成光生电子，在价带形成光生空穴。利i用光生电子-空穴对的还原氧化性能，可以降解周围I环境中的有机污染物以及光解水制备H2和O2。几乎可分解所有对人体和环境有害的有机物质及部分无机物质，不仅能加速反应，亦能运用自然界的定侓，不造成资源浪费与附加污染形成。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of composite materials that can induce light oxidation reduction reaction under the action of light. When semiconductor is excited by light, the electron transitions from the valence band to the conduction band? Photogenerated electrons are formed in the conduction band and photogenerated holes are formed in the valence band. The reduction and oxidation properties of photogenerated electron hole pairs can be used to degradation organic pollutants in the surrounding I environment and prepare H2 and O2 by photolysis of water. It can decompose almost all organic and some inorganic substances that are harmful to the human body and environment, not only accelerating reactions, but also utilizing natural laws, without causing resource waste and additional pollution.

explanation_cn: 在光全息存储中记录物体图像或数字信息的光介质材料。在光全息存储中（也称全息照相），光介质记录来"再现"出原物的三维图像。
explanation_en: Optical medium materials for recording object images or digital information in optical holographic storage. In optical holographic storage (also known as holography), an optical medium is recorded to "reproduce" a three-dimensional image of the original object.

explanation_cn: 含水的配位型氧化物矿物。化学式为KMg(H20)6C12。
explanation_en: Water-containing coordination type oxide minerals. The chemical formula is KMg (H20) 6C12.

explanation_cn: 又称原子发射光谱。分析材料化学成分的一种方法。由于只涉及原子或离子的外层电子或价电子的能级跃迁，产生谱线的波长在紫外、可见光到红外辐射的范围内,故简称为光发射谱。
explanation_en: It is also called atomic emission spectroscopy. A method for analyzing the chemical composition of materials. Since only the energy level transition of the outer layer electron or valence electron of the atom or ion is involved, the wavelength of the spectral line generated is in the range of ultraviolet, visible light and infrared radiation, so it is called light emission spectrum for short.

explanation_cn: 是指由液态的单体或预聚物受紫外线或可见光的照射经聚合反应转化为固化聚合物的过程。光固化属于辐射固化中最常见的一类。该反应所需要的活化能低.可以在很大的温度范围内进行.特别易于进行低温固化，光固化体系具有"适时固化"的特点，即加入引发剂的固化体系在黑暗环境里仍保持稳定.可根据需要随时进行光照固化，避免了其他固化方式为防止过早固化而在使用前才将引发剂加人的缺点。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of transforming liquid monomer or prepolymer into curing polymer through polymerization reaction under ultraviolet or visible light irradiation. Light curing is the most common type of radiation curing. The activation or conditioning energy required for this reaction is low. It can be carried out in a wide temperature range. It is particularly easy to carry out low temperature curing. The light curing system has the characteristics of "timely curing", that is, the curing system with initiator still remains stable in dark environments. Light curing can be carried out at any time as required, avoiding the disadvantage of other curing methods that initiator is added before use to prevent premature curing.

explanation_cn: 是材料连续吸收两个或多个光子而发射一个光子的现象，所发射光波长要比所吸收光波长短。
explanation_en: It refers to the phenomenon that a materials absorbs two or more photons continuously and emits one photon. The wavelength of the emitted light is shorter than that of the absorbed light.

explanation_cn: 见量子剪裁。
explanation_en: See quantum cutting.

explanation_cn: 光子晶体是指介电常数（或折射率）不同的材料在空间周期性排列，在其中传播的光波的色散曲线将成带状分布，当这种空间有序排列的周期与光的波长相比位于同一量级而折射率的变化反差较大时，带与带之间有可能会出现类似于半导体禁带的"光子禁带"（phmonicbandgap;PBG)，能量落在"光子禁带"中的电磁波被禁止传播。
explanation_en: Photonic crystal refers to the periodic arrangement of materials with different dielectric constant (or refractive index) in space, in which the dispersion curve of the light wave propagated will be banded. When the period of this spatial orderly arrangement is at the same order of magnitude compared with the wavelength of light, and the contrast of refractive index changes is large, "photonic band gap" (PBG) similar to semiconductor band gap may appear between bands, Electromagnetic waves with energy falling within the "photonic bandgap" are prohibited from propagating.

explanation_cn: 又称微结构光纤（micro-structuredfibers;MSF)，它的横截面上有较复杂的折射率分布，通常含有不同排列形式的气孔，这些气孔的尺度与光波波长大致在同一量级且贯穿器件的整个长度.光波能以被限制在低折射率的光纤芯区传播。
explanation_en: Also known as microstructure fiber (MSF), it has a complex refractive index distribution on its cross section, and usually contains pores of different arrangement forms. The size of these pores is about the same order of magnitude as the wavelength of the light wave and runs through the entire length of the device. The light wave can be limited to the core area of the low refractive index optical fiber.

explanation_cn: 参见光学材料。
explanation_en: See optical materials.

explanation_cn: 沉积在金属或其他软性易侵蚀的材料或薄膜表面.增加其牢固性和稳定性.改进其光学性质的一类光学薄膜。最常用的是金属保护膜.它可以保护金属镜面不受外界侵蚀而降低质量，又可增加镜面的机械强度。常见的金属镜保护膜材料有SiO%八12():<和MgF2等。保护膜不仅可以增加镜面的牢固性和稳定性，还可以与被保护的材料或薄膜进行光学匹配.以改进其光学性质。光存储材料的保护膜不仅可以隔绝空气和基体材料对存储材料的侵蚀.提高光盘的稳定性和寿命?而且通过匹配设计，提高它的写人灵敏度和载噪比。介质保护膜不仅用于金属、半导体，而且还用f介质膜本身。激光薄膜中的保护膜.可以用来提高薄膜的抗激光强度。
explanation_en: It is a kind of optical coating deposited on the surface of metal or other soft and erodible materials or films to increase their firmness and stability and improve their optical properties. The most commonly used is a metal protective film. It can protect the metal mirror surface from external erosion and reduce quality, while also increasing the mechanical strength of the mirror surface. Common metal mirror protective film materials include SiO% 8 12 ():<and MgF2, etc. The protective film can not only increase the firmness and stability of the mirror surface, but also match the protected materials or film optically to improve its optical properties. The protective film of optical storage materials can not only isolate the air and matrix materials from the erosion of storage materials, but also improve the stability and life of optical disks? And through matching design, its writing sensitivity and carrier to noise ratio are improved. Dielectric protective films are not only used for metals and semiconductors, but also for the dielectric film itself. The protective film in laser thin films can be used to improve the laser resistance of the film.

explanation_cn: 用来产生偏振光或抑制薄膜偏振效应的一类光学薄膜，又称薄膜偏振片。按几何结构的不同.可分为棱镜型偏振膜和平板型偏振膜。棱镜型偏振膜一般位于两个对称的直角棱镜的中间.并且使光束在膜层的界面上实现布鲁斯特角入射。这时，平行人射面的光（P分量）高透过，而垂直入射面的光（S分量）高反射，从而实现偏振分光。
explanation_en: A kind of optical coating used to produce polarized light or suppress the polarization effect of thin films, also known as thin film polarizer. According to different geometric structures, it can be divided into prismatic polarization films and flat polarization films. Prismatic polarizing films are generally located in the middle of two symmetrical right angle prisms, and enable the beam to achieve Brewster angle incidence at the interface of the film layer. At this point, the light from the parallel incident plane (P component) is highly transmitted, while the light from the perpendicular incident plane (S component) is highly reflected, thus achieving polarization splitting.

explanation_cn: 具有非线性光学效应，在光、电或载流子注人等方式的调制下.能产生光学双稳性的材料。光学双稳材料的非线性系数大、响应阈值低、频谱范围宽、响应速度快、稳定性好。
explanation_en: A materials that has nonlinear optical effects and can produce optical bistability under the modulation of light, electricity or carrier injection. Optical bistable materials have large nonlinear coefficient, low response threshold, wide spectrum range, fast response speed and good stability.

explanation_cn: 增加光学表面镜面反射率的一类光学薄膜。在光学仪器和光学系统中，反射膜和增透膜同样重要.常用于反射、折射和共振腔元件。按薄膜材料的不同，可分为金属反射膜、电介质反射膜和金属电介质反射膜；按工作波段，可分为红外反射膜、可见近红外反射膜、紫外反射膜和X射线反射膜；按使用要求，分为部分反射膜、高反射膜和全反射膜；按反射带的宽窄.分为单波长反射膜、多波长反射膜和宽带反射膜。
explanation_en: A type of optical coating that increases the specular reflectance of an optical surface. In optical instruments and optical systems, optical reflection film and antireflective coatings are equally important. They are commonly used for reflection, refraction and resonant cavity components. According to the different materials of the film, it can be divided into metal optical reflection film, dielectric optical reflection film and metal dielectric optical reflection film; According to the working wave band, it can be divided into infrared optical reflection film, visible near infrared optical reflection film, ultraviolet optical reflection film and X-ray optical reflection film; According to the use requirements, it can be divided into partial optical reflection film, high reflecting film and full optical reflection film; According to the width of reflection band, it can be divided into single wavelength optical reflection film, multi wavelength optical reflection film and broadband optical reflection film.

explanation_cn: 广义上指在光学仪器和装置中起光学作用（效应）的材料，包含线性和非线性光学材料两类。狭义的光学材料是指利用线性光学效应，传输光线的材料，也称为光学介质材料。它以折射、反射和透射的方式，改变光线的方向、强度和相位等，使光线按预定的要求传输。光学材料可分为五类：光学玻璃、光学晶体、光学塑料、光学薄膜和光学纤维。每种光学材料都有特定的透过率和光学色散，由此应用于各种光学仪器和装置中的不同光学元件。
explanation_en: Broadly speaking, it refers to materials that play an optical role (effect) in optical instruments and devices, including linear and nonlinear optical materials. In a narrow sense, optical materials refer to materials that use linear optical effects to transmit light, also known as optical dielectric mau'rials. It changes the direction, intensity, and phase of light through refraction, reflection, and transmission, so that it can transmit according to predetermined requirements. Optical materials can be divided into five categories: optical glass, optical crystal, optical plastics, optical coating and optical fiber. Each optical materials has a specific transmissivity and optical dispersion, so it is applied to different optical elements in various optical instruments and devices.

explanation_cn: 用于制造光学仪器或机械系统的透镜、棱镜、反射镜、窗口等的玻璃材料。通过折射、反射、透过方式传递光线或通过吸收改变光的强度或光谱分布，具有稳定的光学性质和高度光学均匀性。
explanation_en: Glass materials used for manufacturing lenses, prisms, mirrors, windows, etc. of optical instruments or mechanical systems. Transmitting light through refraction, reflection, transmission, or changing the intensity or spectral distribution of light through absorption, possessing stable optical properties and high optical uniformity.

explanation_cn: 一种厚度远小于直径的板状光学纤维传像元件。由很多根玻璃纤维（单纤维或复合纤维）经相关排列、加热、加压使包皮玻璃软化熔合成整体.然后在垂直于纤维轴方向切片、研磨、抛光制成的真空气密性良好的元件。
explanation_en: A plate shaped optical fiber image transmission element with a thickness much smaller than the diameter. The components with good vacuum tightness are made of many glass fibers (single fiber or composite fiber) which are arranged, heated and pressurized to soften and melt the wrapped glass into a whole, and then sliced, grinding and polished in the direction perpendicular to the fiber axis.

explanation_cn: 液晶薄膜试样在正交偏光显微镜下呈现的形貌。
explanation_en: Morphology of liquid crystal film samples under orthogonal polarized light microscopy.

explanation_cn: 用于光学、光电子学的平板玻璃。对光学透过、电学性能有特殊的要求.厚度小于建筑玻璃.表面平整度要求较高，主要用于手机面板、光掩模板、液晶显示器面板、光盘等方面。
explanation_en: Flat glass for optics and optoelectronics. There are special requirements for optical transmission and electrical performance. The thickness is less than that of building glass. The requirement for surface flatness is high. It is mainly used for mobile phone panels, photomask panels, LCD panels, discs, etc.

explanation_cn: 由薄的多层膜组合而成的、能够实现特定光学功能的一类光学材料。光学薄膜的种类很多，按应用来分，主要有反射膜、增透(亮）膜、吸收膜、偏振膜、分光膜、千涉滤光膜、位相膜和光学保护膜等。光学薄膜的光学性质建立在光的干涉基础之上，对于一个沉积在光学表面上的单层膜.当它的折射率低于基休折射率时，干涉叠加的结果.可使表面反射率降低。反之.当薄膜折射率高于基体时.反射率增加。改变膜层的光学常数和光学厚度.增加或减少薄膜的层数.可以得到不同的光学效果。
explanation_en: A class of optical materials composed of thin multilayer films and capable of realizing specific optical functions. There are many kinds of optical coating. According to their applications, they mainly include optical reflection film, antireflective (bright) film, absorption film, polarizing film, spectroscopic film, Qiandang filter film, phase film and optical protecting coating. The optical properties of optical coating are based on the interference of light. For a single layer film deposited on the optical surface, when its refractive index is lower than the fundamental refractive index, the result of interference superposition can reduce the surface reflectivity. On the contrary, when the refractive index of the film is higher than that of the matrix, the reflectivity increases. Changing the optical constant and thickness of the film layer, increasing or decreasing the number of layers of the film, can achieve different optical effects.

explanation_cn: 用光学显微镜观察和研究金属材料显微组织的传统技术。其基本方法是：将金属表面磨光、抛光为镜面，然后放在一定的介质中浸蚀。
explanation_en: The traditional technology of observing and studying the microstructure of metallic materials with optical microscope. The basic method is to polish and polish the metal surface to a mirror surface, and then etch it in a certain medium.

explanation_cn: 采用陶瓷制备工艺制备的具有一定透光性的多品材料。包括透明铁电陶瓷、透明激光陶瓷、透明闪烁陶瓷、窗口材料等。
explanation_en: Multi product materials with certain light transmittance prepared by ceramics preparation process. It includes transparent ferroelectric ceramics, transparent laser ceramics, transparent scintillating ceramics, window materials, etc.

name_cn: 光寻址电位细胞传感器
explanation_cn: 是一种具有电解质(electrolyte)-绝缘膜（insulator)-半导体（semiconductor)结构的光电敏感电容型生物传感器。
explanation_en: It is a photoelectric sensitive capacitive biosensor with a elonrolyte insulator semiconductor structure.

explanation_cn: 用作光全息存储介质的、涂布在导电基片上的、掺有光敏剂的塑料薄膜。在入射光下，薄膜表面产生光生电荷载流子，形成静电场。受均匀加热、成流体状的塑料薄层在电场作用下发生形变.构成位相全息图的浮雕像。塑料膜层均匀冷却形变中断.浮雕像被固定下来。由基片、导电涂层与光导热塑层组成。
explanation_en: A plastics film used as a holographic storage medium, coated on a conductive substrate, and doped with photosensitizer. Under incident light, photo generated charge carriers are generated on the surface of the thin film, forming an electrostatic field. The thin layer of plastics, which is heated uniformly and becomes fluid, will deformation under the action of electric field to form the relief image of phase hologram. The plastics film is cooled evenly and deformation is interrupted. The relief statue is fixed. It is composed of substrate, conductive coating and photo thermal conductive plastic layer.

explanation_cn: 是一类能够吸收、屏蔽或反射紫外线的物质，如炭黑、二氧化钛(金红石型）、氧化锌等。它的作用就像在聚合物和光辐射之间设置了一道屏障，使光不能直接辐射到聚合物的内部，令聚合物内部不受紫外线的危害.从而有效抑制光氧化降解。光屏蔽剂有炭黑、氧化钛等无机颜料和酞菁蓝、酞菁绿等有机颜料，其中炭黑屏蔽效果最好。炭黑的光屏蔽效果与其粒度、分散性和用量等因素有关。
explanation_en: It is a kind of substance that can absorb, shield or reflect ultraviolet light, such as carbon black, titanium dioxide (rutile type), zinc oxide, etc. It acts as a barrier between polymer and light radiation, preventing light from radiating directly to the inside of polymer, preventing the inside of polymer from being damaged by ultraviolet rays, thus effectively inhibiting photo-oxiclative degradation. Light screening agent includes carbon black, titanium oxide and other inorganic pigment, and phthalocyanine blue, phthalocyanine green and other organic pigment, of which carbon black has the best shielding effect. The light shielding effect of carbon black is related to its particle size, dispersion and dosage.

explanation_cn: 在紫外或可见光照下，直接引发单体聚合或使用能生成向由基或阳离子的光引发剂引发单体聚合的过程。
explanation_en: The process of directly initiating monomer polymerization or initiating monomer polymerization with a photo initiator capable of generating radical or cation under ultraviolet or visible light.

explanation_cn: 某些透明材料（主要是塑料、玻璃、环氧树脂等非晶体）在承受载荷出现应变的状态下由各向同性变成各向异性并展现出对光的双折射的现象.这种性质叫作光弹性。具冇光弹性的聚合物叫光弹性聚合物。光弹性效应是可逆的，光弹性聚合物已广泛用于应力分析。
explanation_en: Some transparent materials (mainly plastics, glass, epoxy resin and other amorphous materials) change from isotropy to anisotropy and show birefringence of light under the state of strain under load. This property is called photoelasticity. The polymer with photoelasticity is called photoelastic polymer. Photoelastic effect is reversible, and photoelastic polymer has been widely used in stress analysis.

explanation_cn: 又称发光强度，简称光强。是一光源所发出的在给定方向上单位立体角内的光通量。用于表示光源给定方向上单位立体角内发光强弱程度的物理量，国际单位为坎德拉，符号：cd，以前又称烛光。
explanation_en: It is also called luminous intensity, or light intensity for short. It is the luminous flux emitted by a light source within a unit solid angle in a given direction. The physical quantity used to indicate the intensity of luminescence within the unit solid angle in the given direction of the light source. The international unit is candela, and the symbol is cd, formerly known as candela.

name_cn: 光折变型光全息存储材料
explanation_cn: 利用光致折射率变化进行光全息存储的材料。它们是一类在内部结构上无中心对称的电光晶体。在晶体内引人微量添加元素（如Fe)或缺陷后形成感光电子陷阱。当晶体在相干光下曝光时，陷阱中的电子受激成为自由电子，电子的迁移运动形成一幅空间电荷图案.即在晶体中存在一个与人射光干涉分布相对应的静电场。在这电场的作用下，电光晶体的折射率发生相应的改变.从而在晶体内构成一幅相位调制型全息图。
explanation_en: A materials that makes use of light induced refractive index changes for optical holographic storage. They are a kind of electro-optic crystal without central symmetry in internal structure. A photosensitive electron trap is formed by introducing trace elements (such as Fe) or defects into the crystal. When the crystal is exposed to coherent light, the electrons in the trap are stimulated to become free electrons, and the migration of electrons forms a space charge pattern, that is, there is an electrostatic field in the crystal corresponding to the interference distribution of human light. Under the action of this electric field, the refractive index of the electro-optic crystal changes correspondingly, thus forming a phase modulated hologram in the crystal.

explanation_cn: 具有光折变效应的晶体。对光有吸收.且在晶体中存在自由电荷和具有非零电光系数。
explanation_en: Crystal with photorefractive effect. It has absorption of light, free charge in crystal and non-zero electro-optic coefficient.

explanation_cn: 有机记录介质在光的作用下发生化学反应，引起结构改变，导致折射率变化.从而实现记录物体图像的非银光敏材料。常用的光折变有机记录材料分两类：一是丙烯酸类单体的光聚合型材料；另一类是丙烯酸酯类聚合物的光热交联型材料。前者依据单体的光引发聚合，后者依赖光引发交联和热收缩导致折光性能变化，而获取图像。光折变记录材料也可用于全息图像记录，其记录过程是由激光器产生的相干光照射被记录物体，产生衍射光波。然后与参比光波发生相干.使具有一定强度分布的干涉光波作用在记录介质上，引发聚合或交联作用.导致折光性能变化，记录物体的全息图。
explanation_en: The organic recording medium undergoes chemical reaction under the action of light, causing structural change and refractive index change, thus realizing the non silver photosensitive materials for recording object images. The commonly used photorefractive organic recording materials can be divided into two categories: one is the photopolymerization materials of acrylic monomer; The other is the photothermal crosslinking materials of acrylate polymer. The former is based on photo-initiated polymerization of monomer, while the latter relies on photoinitiated crosslinking and thermal shrinkage to change the refractive properties and obtain images. The photo-refractive recording materials can also be used for holographic image recording. The recording process is that the coherent light generated by the laser irradiates the recorded object to generate diffracted light waves. Then it is coherent with the reference light wave, so that the interference light wave with a certain intensity distribution acts on the recording medium, causing polymerization or crosslinking, leading to changes in refractive properties, and recording the hologram of the object.

explanation_cn: 纤芯区域掺人能产生激光的稀土族元素（如铒、镨、铌等）后得到的光纤。制作光纤时，采用特殊工艺，在光纤芯层沉积中掺人极小浓度的稀土元素如铒、镨或铷等离子作为激光活性物质，可制作出相应的掺铒、掺镨或掺铷光纤。
explanation_en: The optical fiber is obtained by doping laser generating rare earth group elements (such as erbium, praseodymium, niobium, etc.) into the core area. When making optical fiber, special process is adopted to mix rare earth elements of very small concentration such as erbium, praseodymium or rubidium plasma in the deposition of optical fiber core layer as laser active substances, and corresponding erbium doped, praseodymium doped or rubidium doped optical fiber can be made.

explanation_cn: 又称增感剂、敏化剂。有些物质不能直接吸收某波长的光.即对光不敏感，但若在体系中加人另外一种物质，该物质能吸收这种光辐射，并把光的能量传递给反应物.使反应物能够发生化学反应，所加人的这种物质就称为光敏剂.所引发的光化学反应称为光敏化反应。
explanation_en: It is also called sensitizer and sensitizer. Some substances cannot directly absorb light of a certain wavelength, that is, they are not sensitive to light. However, if another substance is added to the system, the substance can absorb this light radiation and transfer the energy of light to the reactant, so that the reactant can have a chemical reaction. The added substance is called a photosensitizer. The photochemical reaction initiated is called a photosensitization reaction.

explanation_cn: 材料的电参量随环境光学参量变化而变化的陶瓷材料。按
explanation_en: Ceramics materials whose electrical parameters of materials change with environmental optical parameters. according to

explanation_cn: 指随外界光照度的变化而能发生色泽可逆变化的纤维，其色泽变化往往与温度和湿度变化也有一定关系。例如用这种纤维做的衣料，在阳光照射下，有的呈橙色、灰色或青色，而置入室内则各变为蓝灰、青色和无色。
explanation_en: Fibers that undergo reversible color changes with changes in external light intensity, and their color changes are often related to changes in temperature and humidity. For example, clothing materials made of this fiber may appear orange, gray, or cyan when exposed to sunlight, while when placed indoors, they may each turn blue gray, cyan, or colorless.

explanation_cn: 在紫外或可见光照射下能形成自由基或阳离子用于引发单体聚合的物质。光引发剂按光解机理分为自由基聚合光引发剂和阳离子聚合光引发剂两大类。自由基型光引发剂按产生自由基的作用机理分为裂解型光引发剂和夺氢型光引发剂，按分子结构特点分为苯偶姻及衍生物、苯偶酰类、烷基苯酮类、酰基磷氧化物、二苯甲酮类、硫杂蒽酮类。阳离子型光引发剂包括二芳基碘锡盐、三芳基碘镐盐、烷基碘镨盐、异丙苯茂铁六氟磷酸盐等。
explanation_en: A substance that can form free radicals or cations to initiate monomer polymerization under ultraviolet or visible light irradiation. According to the photolysis mechanism, photoneneneba initiators can be divided into free radical polymerization photonenenebc initiators and cationic polymerization photonenenebe initiators. Free radical photoneneneba initiators can be divided into splitting photonenenebb initiators and hydrogen withdrawing photonenenebc initiators according to the mechanism of generating free radicals, and can be divided into benzoin and derivatives, benzoyl, alkyl benzophenones, acyl phosphorus oxides, benzophenones, and thioxanthones according to the characteristics of molecular structure. Cationic photo initiator include diaryltin iodide salt, triaryl iodide salt, alkyl praseodymium iodide salt, isopropyl ferrocene hexafluorophosphate, etc.

explanation_cn: 具有光敏感性能的传递系统。在药物与基因传递领域.利用光照（紫外、可见、近红外等）可改变药物及基因的释放速率及传递模式，实现在病灶部位的释放。光敏感载体材料中常见的光敏基团有在光照条件下能发生构型变化的偶氮苯等、发生分子内光致成键和断裂的螺吡喃等、发生光致断裂的邻硝基苄酯等。光敏感传递系统与光动力疗法结合，在肿瘤治疗方面有广泛的应用。由于紫外线易引起组织损伤，目前，这一领域的研究热点是可深入组织且不会对组织造成伤害的近红外线的敏感材料，以及能深入组织并具有良好的空间选择性的双光子的吸收材料。
explanation_en: A transmission system with photosensitive performance. In the field of drug and gene delivery, the use of light (ultraviolet, visible, near-infrared, etc.) can change the release rate and delivery mode of drugs and genes, achieving release at the lesion site. The common photosensitive groups in photosensitive carrier materials include azobenzene which can change its configuration under light conditions, spiropyran which can undergo intramolecular photoinduced bonding and fracture, and o-nitrobenzyl ester which can undergo photoinduced fracture. The combination of photo/light sensitive delivery system and photodynamic therapy has been widely used in tumor treatment. Because ultraviolet light is easy to cause tissue damage, at present, the research focus in this field is near-infrared sensitive materials that can go deep into tissues and will not cause damage to tissues, and two-photon absorption materials that can go deep into tissues and have good spatial selectivity.

explanation_cn: 在光照（可见光、紫外线）下会发生变性，或是变换颜色.或是改变折射率，或是析出晶体等的玻璃被成为光敏玻璃。
explanation_en: Glass that will undergo denaturation, color change, refractive index change, or crystal precipitation under light (visible light, ultraviolet light) is called photosensitive glass.

explanation_cn: 在光敏剂存在下，将其激发能传递给反应分子并促进光反应进行的光聚合。光敏剂是只吸收光子并将能量传递给那些不能吸收光子的分子，促其发生化学反应，而本身则不参与化学反应，恢复到原先的状态。常用光敏试剂是芳香族酮类和安息香醚类：如苯甲酮、安息香二甲醚等。光敏聚合广泛应用于光固性涂料、油墨、制版和其他固化技术。
explanation_en: In the presence of photosensitizer, its excitation energy is transferred to reaction molecules and promotes photopolymerization. Photosensitizer only absorbs photons and transfers energy to those molecules that cannot absorb photons to promote their chemical reaction, but does not participate in the chemical reaction itself and returns to the original state. Commonly used photosensitizers are aromatic ketones and benzoin ethers, such as benzophenone, benzoin dimethyl ether, etc. Photosensitized polymerization is widely used in photosetting coatings, inks, plate making and other curing technologies.

explanation_cn: 对紫外/可见光具有特殊响应，包括改变分子形貌的光响应型高分子、改变化学组成的光反应型高分子和改变颜色的光致变色高分子等，在光的作用下发生聚合、交联、；分解、变色、收缩等物理和化学变化的一类聚合物。光敏聚合物主要包括：聚合物本身含有感光基团的体系，如不饱和聚酯、聚乙烯醇月桂酸酯等；聚合物中加人感光性化合物的体系.如聚乙烯醇中加入重铬酸盐等；乙烯基单体直接进行光聚合体系.如丙烯酸酯等。该类聚合物主要应用于大规模集成电路、印刷X业的制版、电子束胶、医用材料、紫外固化涂料、光敏油墨及光固化黏合剂等。
explanation_en: It has special response to UV/visible light, including photoresponsive macromolecule that change molecular morphology, photoresponsive macromolecule that change chemical composition, and photochromie polymer that change color. polymerization, crosslinking; A class of polymer that undergo physical and chemical changes such as decomposition, discoloration, and shrinkage. Photosensitive polymer mainly include: polymer containing photosensitive groups, such as unsaturated polyester, polyvinyl alcohol laurate, etc; The system of adding photosensitive compounds into polymer, such as adding dichromate into polyvinyl alcohol; The vinyl monomer is directly used for photo polymerization system, such as acrylate, etc. This kind of polymer is mainly used in large-scale integrated circuits, plate making in the printing X industry, electron beam glue, medical materials, UV curing coatings, photosensitive inks and photo curing adhesive.

explanation_cn: 又称光固化胶黏剂、感光胶黏剂或光敏抗蚀胶等。一种依靠光能引发固化的胶黏剂。其中紫外光固化型光敏胶黏剂，由含不饱和键的单体或者预聚物加上光敏剂及改性剂组成。适用于透光材料或者金属、塑料、陶瓷、光学透镜等粘接，尤宜于自动化流水线的装配工艺，在电子工业中用于光刻制造微型电路板等。
explanation_en: Also known as light curing adhesive, photosensitive adhesive or photosensitive anti-corrosion adhesive. A adhesive that relies on light energy to initiate curing. The UV curable photosensitive adhesive is composed of monomer or prepolymer containing unsaturated bond, photosensitizer and modifier. It is suitable for bonding transparent materials or metals, plastics, ceramics, optical lenses, etc., especially for the assembly process of automated assembly lines, and used in the electronic industry for photolithography to manufacture micro circuit boards, etc.

explanation_cn: 是测定聚合物分子量的一种绝对方法。
explanation_en: It is an absolute method for determining the molecular weight of polymer.

explanation_cn: 聚合物在光和氧的作用下发生的降解。聚合物制品在含氧气的氛围里，受到光照射而发生光降解和光氧化降解.从而使材料老化。
explanation_en: Degradation of polymer under the action of light and oxygen. In the atmosphere containing oxygen, polymer products will undergo photodegradation and photooxidation degradation when exposed to light, thus aging materials.

explanation_cn: 光激励发光（PSL)是一些荧光粉经X射线、放射线、阴极射线或紫外线辐照后.吸收穿过物体或物体本身发射出的辐射能，并将部分能量存储起来.辐照停止后，再用可见光、红外光或紫外线等电磁波激励，将所存储的能量以荧光发射的形式释放出来?这种发光现象称光激励发光。具有这种发光性能的材料又称信息存储发光材料。
explanation_en: Light stimulated luminescence (PSL) is that some phosphor absorb the radiant energy emitted through the object or the object itself after being irradiated by X-rays, radioactive rays, cathode-ray or ultraviolet rays, and store some of the energy. After the irradiation stops, they are stimulated by electromagnetic waves such as visible light, infrared light or ultraviolet light to release the stored energy in the form of fluorescence emission? This luminescence phenomenon is called light excited luminescence. Materials with such luminescence properties are also called information storage luminescence materials.

explanation_cn: 应用于光电子技术的材料的总称。主要是光子和电子的产生、转换和传输的材料。
explanation_en: Materials used in optoelectronic technology. It is mainly a materials for the generation, conversion and transmission of photons and electrons.

explanation_cn: 简称PCD。合适波长的光照在半导体上将产生非平衡载流子.从而引起半导体电导率的增加。当撤去光照后，电导率和其他与电导率相关的物理量将随时间变化，其变化规律与非平衡载流子寿命有关。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as PCD. The light of appropriate wavelength will produce unbalanced carriers on the semiconductor, which will cause the increase of electric conductivity of the semiconductor. When the light is removed, the electric conductivity and other physical quantities related to electric conductivity will change with time, and the change rule is related to the excessive carrier lifetime.

explanation_cn: 对光波段（可见光、红外光、紫外光、激光）能量具有吸收、散射、反射、折射作用的材料的总称。可以是金属材料，如铜粉；也可以是非金属材料.如炭黑、石墨粉.纤维、箔条、镀铜微球等。干扰效能与材料组分、粒度、形状等有关。
explanation_en: The general name of materials that can absorb, scatter, reflect and refract the energy of light bands (visible light, infrared light, ultraviolet light, laser). It can be metallic materials, such as copper powder; It can also be non metallic materials, such as carbon black, graphite powder, fiber, chaff, copper plated microsphere, etc. The interference efficiency is related to materials composition, particle size, shape, etc.

explanation_cn: 指能够将光能转化为电能、化学能或其他形式能量的纳米材料。以半导体光电纳米材料为例.其进行光电转化的原理是在能量等于或大于半导体带隙的光照射下.材料内部电子受激发由价带跃迁到导带.并在价带上留下空穴，使电子与空穴有效分离，从而实现了光电转化。光电纳米材料按用途分类可分为光电转换纳米材料、光电催化纳米材料；按组成可分有机光电纳米材料、无机光电纳米材料、有机与无机光电配合物纳米材料。光电纳米材料在光探测、光电开关、太阳能电池、光存储.以及光催化合成、环境保护等各方面有着广泛应用。
explanation_en: It refers to nanomaterials that can convert light energy into electrical energy, chemical energy or other forms of energy. Take the semiconductor photoelectric nanomaterials as an example. The principle of photoelectric conversion is that under the irradiation of light with energy equal to or greater than the semiconductor band gap, the electrons in the materials are excited to transition from the valence band to the conduction band, leaving holes in the valence band, so that the electrons and holes can be effectively separated, thus realizing photoelectric conversion. Photoelectric nanomaterials can be classified into photoelectric conversion nanomaterials and photoelectric catalysis nanomaterials according to their uses; According to composition, it can be divided into organic optoelectronic nanomaterials, inorganic optoelectronic nanomaterials, and organic and inorganic optoelectronic complex nanomaterials. Photoelectric nanomaterials are widely used in light detection, photoelectric switches, solar cell, optical storage, photocatalytic synthesis, environmental protection and other aspects.

explanation_cn: 一类在受到光照以后，会引发某些电性质的变化的薄膜材料。包括Ge和Si单晶和以它们为基础的掺杂体，以及CdS、ZnSe、GaAs等化合物半导体。
explanation_en: A kind of thin film materials that will cause some changes in electrical properties after being exposed to light. It includes Ge and Si single crystal and their based dopants, as well as CdS, ZnSe, GaAs and other compound semiconductors.

explanation_cn: 具有光电效应的复合材料称为光电转换功能复合材料。物质在受到光照以后，往往会引发某些电性质的变化，这一现象称为光电效应。
explanation_en: Composite materials with photoelectric effect are called photoelectric conversion functional composite materials. After being exposed to light, substances often cause changes in certain electrical properties, which is called the photoelectric effect.

explanation_cn: 指受光照的单体电池的最大输出电功率与入射到该电池受光平面有效工作面积上的全部光功率的百分比。
explanation_en: It refers to the percentage between the maximum output electric power of the illuminated monomer battery and the total optical power incident on the effective working area of the solar plane of the battery.

explanation_cn: 光电高分子多具有Π共轭主链骨架.并有良好的半导体性质，能够实现高效的光电转换功能.作为光电信息和能源相关的功能材料研究发展十分迅速。
explanation_en: Most optoelectronic polymer have Π Conjugated backbone, with good semiconductor properties, can achieve efficient photoelectric conversion function. As a photoelectric information and energy related functional materials, the research development is very rapid.

explanation_cn: 一种具有记录（写入）、存储和读出功能的材料。光盘的存储介质，它与聚焦的激光束相互作用，产生物理和化学反应，形成记录点，其性质与周围介质不同.产生一个反差，由此可以读出信号。
explanation_en: A materials with recording (writing), storage and reading functions. The storage medium of an optical disc interacts with a focused laser beam to generate physical and chemical reactions, forming recording points. Its properties are different from those of the surrounding medium, creating a contrast, which allows for signal readout.

explanation_cn: 指凡能抑制或减缓由于光氧化作用而使高分子材料发生降解而加入的物质，光稳定剂能屏蔽、反射或者吸收紫外线并将其转化为无害的热能，使降解产物过氧化物进行非自由基分解；可使被紫外线激发的分子或基团的激发态捽灭回复到稳定基态，排除或减缓发生光氧化还原反应的可能性；可钝化金属离子：能有效地捕捉紫外线引发的自由基.从而可使高分子材料免受紫外线破坏按照稳定机理。
explanation_en: The light stabilizer refers to any substance added to inhibit or slow down the degradation of macromolecule materials due to photooxidation, which can shield, reflect or absorb ultraviolet rays and convert them into harmless heat energy, so that the peroxide of degradation product can undergo non free radical decomposition; It can make the excited state of molecules or groups excited by ultraviolet ray recovery to a stable ground state, and eliminate or slow down the possibility of photooxidation and reduction reaction; Passivation metal ions: It can effectively capture the free radicals triggered by ultraviolet light, so as to prevent macromolecule materials from being damaged by ultraviolet light according to the stability mechanism.

explanation_cn: 见通信光纤。
explanation_en: See optical fiber for communication.

explanation_cn: 是指用掺稀土元素玻璃光纤作为增益介质的激光器。光纤激光器叶在光纤放大器的基础上开发出来：在激励光的作用下光纤内极易形成高功率密度，造成激光工作物质的激光能级粒子数反转。适当加入正反馈回路（构成谐振腔）便吋形成激光振荡输出。
explanation_en: It refers to the laser with rare earth element doped glass optical fiber as the gain medium. The optical fiber laser blade is developed on the basis of optical fiber amplifier: high power density is easily formed in the optical fiber under the action of the excitation light, resulting in the inversion of the laser energy level particle number of the laser working material. Properly adding a positive feedback loop (to form a resonant cavity) can quickly form a laser oscillation output.

explanation_cn: 是利用附着在光纤一端的生物活性物质（酶，抗体，抗原.激素.神经质.蛋白质和核酸）对光的全内反射或折射等效应定量分析生物分子的识别类型和数量的一类光学传感器。根据在光纤中固定生物敏感元件（生物活性物）位置的不同，光纤生物传感器可分为光极式和消逝波式两种。光极式是将生物敏感元件固定在光纤芯的顶端，而消逝波式则是直接将生物分子覆盖在光纤芯表面。两者都是利用光在光导纤维中的全内反射特性，以及全内反射产生的向周围介质呈指数衰减传播的消逝波的穿透厚度（约l0nm)刚好是生物分子发生识别作用的范围。
explanation_en: It is a kind of optical sensor that uses the total internal reflection or refraction of light and other effects of bioactivity substances (enzymes, antibodies, antigens, hormones, neuroticism, proteins and nucleic acids) attached to one end of optical fiber to quantitatively analyze the recognition type and quantity of biomolecules. According to the different positions of the fixed biosensors (bioactivity substances) in optical fiber, opiic fiber biosensor can be divided into two types: optical pole type and evanescent wave type. The optical pole type fixes the biosensor on the top of the optical fiber core, while the evanescent wave type directly covers the biomolecule on the surface of the optical fiber core. Both utilize the total internal reflection characteristics of light in optical fibers, as well as the penetration thickness (about 10nm) of the evanescent wave generated by total internal reflection that propagates exponentially towards the surrounding medium, which is precisely within the range of recognition of biomolecules.

name_cn: 光纤通信用半导体激光材料
name_en: semiconductor laser materials for optical fiber communication
explanation_cn: 激射波长位于通信光纤传输损耗和色散最低波段的半导体激光材料。不同光纤通信用的激光器选择不同的半导体激光材料。
explanation_en: The lasing wavelength is located in the semiconductor laser materials with the lowest transmission loss and dispersion of optical fiber for communication. Different semiconductor laser materials are selected for lasers used in different optical fiber communications.

explanation_cn: 材料在光照下性能随时间的变化现象。在材料的使用过程中，日光照射是一种常见的环境。塑料、涂层等高分子材料在受到日光照射的长期使用过程中，经常出现变色、气泡、粉化、裂纹、脱落等现象.这都属于光老化的范畴。光老化本质上是一种降解反应，当辐照的光能大于化学键键能的时候，化学键会发生断裂.从而导致物理化学性质发生变化。大多数高分子材料在波长为230-447nm，光源照射下都会出现不同程度的老化，在新材料的研发中.常常采用人工加速光老化的方法，包括利用碳弧灯、荧光紫外灯、氙弧灯、金属卤素灯等人造光源.模拟日光照射环境，研究材料性质的变化。
explanation_en: The change of materials properties with time under light. During the use of materials, sunlight is a common environment. During the long-term use of macromolecule materials such as plastics and coatings exposed to sunlight, discoloration, bubbles, pulverization, cracks, shedding and other phenomena often occur, which belong to the category of light aging. Light aging is essentially a degradation reaction. When the irradiated light energy is greater than the bond energy of the chemical bond, the chemical bond will fracture, leading to changes in physical chemistry properties. Most macromolecule materials will experience different degrees of aging under the irradiation of light sources at the wavelength of 230-447nm. In the research and development of new materials, the methods of artificially accelerating light aging are often used, including the use of artificial light sources such as carbon arc lamps, fluorescence ultraviolet lamps, xenon arc lamps, metal halide lamps, etc. to simulate the sunlight environment and study the changes in the properties of materials.

explanation_cn: 被选定波长光激发的材料所发射的光强度随波长或能量的分布。
explanation_en: The distribution of luminous intensity emitted by the materials excited by the selected wavelength light with the wavelength or energy.

name_cn: 光致发光功能复合材料
explanation_cn: 指以能产生荧光的物质与透明的高聚物、纸张等基体组合成的一类功能复合材料。光致发光指以外来光作为激发源使物质的原子（或分子）成为激发态，当在一定的条件下回到基态时，将以电磁波的形式释放多余的能量即发出不同频率的二次光。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of functional composite materials composed of fluorescence material, transparent polymer, paper and other matrices. Photoluminescence refers to the use of external light as the excitation source to make the atoms (or molecules) of the substance become excited states. When returning to the ground state under certain conditions, it will release excess energy in the form of electromagnetic waves, that is, emit secondary light of different frequencies.

explanation_cn: 光致变色指的是某些化合物在一定的波长和强度的光作用下分子结构会发生变化，从而导致其对光的吸收峰值即颜色的相应改变，且这种改变一般是可逆的。典型无机体系的光致变色效应伴随着可逆的氧化-还原反应，有机体系的光致变色也往往伴随着许多与光化反应有关的过程同时发生，从而导致分子构的某种改变。
explanation_en: Photochromism refers to the change in molecular structure of certain compounds under the action of a certain wavelength and intensity of light, resulting in a corresponding change in their absorption peak of light, i.e. color, and this change is generally reversible. The photochromic effect of typical inorganic systems is accompanied by reversible oxidation-reduction reactions, and the photochromic effect of organic systems often occurs simultaneously with many processes related to photochemical reactions, leading to a certain change in molecular structure.

explanation_cn: 以光致变色物质为光敏组分，有机高分子材料为成膜剂，添加其他各种功能助剂制备而成的材料。光致变色材料的最主要特性就是光敏组分的光致变色性质。
explanation_en: The materials is prepared with photochromic substances as photosensitive components, organic macromolecule materials as film forming agent, and other functional additive. The most important characteristic of photochromie materials is the photochromic properties of photosensitive components.

explanation_cn: 简称光色玻璃。在一定波长的激活辐射能量作用下产生着色生成色心，而在激活辐射终止后又退色色心破坏的玻璃即为光致变色玻璃。
explanation_en: It is called light colored glass for short. The color centers is generated by coloring under the action of a certain wavelength of activation radiation energy, and the glass with fading color centers destroyed after the termination of activation radiation is called photochromic glass.

explanation_cn: 是一类在光或其他电磁波作用下能产生变色现象的高分子化合物。导致变色高分子结构中通常包含光异构化反应类、光分解反应类或光氧化还原反应类基元。
explanation_en: It is a kind of macromolecule compound that can produce color change under the action of light or other electromagnetic waves. The structure of color changing macromolecule usually contains photoisomerization reaction, photodecomposition reaction or photo redox reaction.

explanation_cn: 一种光子和电子相互作用的物理现象在此过程中?材料通过吸收可见光、紫外线、红外线或x射线等电磁辐射使其变得导电性更好。在光子被诸如半导体之类材料吸收的过程中.材料中自由电子和正电子空穴的数量会增加；这些增加的载流子浓度提高了材料的导电性。
explanation_en: A physical phenomenon in which photons and electrons interact during this process? Materials become more conductive by absorbing electromagnetic radiation such as visible light, ultraviolet, infrared or x-ray. When photons are absorbed by materials such as semiconductors, the number of free electrons and positron holes in materials will increase; These increased carrier concentrations improve the conductivity of materials.

name_cn: 光色型光全息存储材料
explanation_cn: 利用光致颜色的可逆变化进行光全息存储的材料。光色材料中存在两种不同能量的电子陷阱（含微量掺杂物），它们之间将发生光致可逆电荷转移，在材料中形成A、B两个吸收光谱带。记录信息时，材料在A带内曝光，形成光密度变化的吸收光栅。把已着色的材料在B带内曝光，颜色便消除。
explanation_en: A materials that makes use of the reversible change of light induced color for optical holographic storage. There are two kinds of electron trap with different energies (including a small amount of dopants) in photochromic materials, which will undergo photo induced reversible charge transfer and form two absorption spectrum bands A and B in materials. When recording information, materials is exposed in A-band to form an absorption grating with light density change. Expose the colored materials in the B band, and the color will be eliminated.

explanation_cn: 光记录复合材料中含有光激活组分，光激发激活中心使其发生电子跃迁而达到光记录存储的目的。光记录复合材料主要有=.种光子存储方式：全息存储、光谱烧孔的频率存储和双光子双光束三维光子存储。含有痕量铁的铌酸锂晶体是最早用于全息存储的光电转换复合材料：另一类全息存储复合材料是含光敏化合物的聚合物基复合材料。用于光谱烧孔存储方式的复合材料体系主要集中在两类：稀土离子掺杂的无机或有机聚合物基材料体系
explanation_en: The optical recording composite contains light activated components, and the light excited activation center makes it undergo electronic transition to achieve the purpose of optical recording and storage. Optical recording composite mainly have three photon storage modes: holographic storage, spectral hole burning frequency storage and two-photon two beam three-dimensional photon storage. The lithium niobate crystal containing trace iron is the first photoelectric conversion com- posite used for holographic storage; the other type of holographic storage composite materials is a polymer matrix composite containing photosensitive compounds. The composite materials systems used for spectral hole burning storage mainly focus on two types: rare earth ion doped inorganic or organic polymer based materials systems

explanation_en: Polymer that can undergo fracture of molecular chain and degradation under the action of light (usually visible light and ultraviolet light).

explanation_cn: 在外电场作用下各向同性材料会呈现双折射，从而导致折射率的改变，而且折射率的改变和电场强度的平方成正比关系。此效应称克尔效应或二次电光效应。具有这种效应的材料称克尔材料。理论上所有电介质，不论其为固体或液体，都有可能在高的外电场作用下呈现克尔效应。早期的克尔材料为有机液体，其中以硝基苯、间硝基甲苯、苯基腈等克尔效应最为明显。后来发现立方钙钛矿型晶体钛酸钡、钛酸锶等呈现更强的克尔效应，而且使用和保存方便，于是在许多用途上晶体克尔材料代替了液体克尔材料。然而，这些晶体材料居里温度低，难以生长出在尺寸和质量上符合使用要求的材料而且价格昂贵。因此总的来说，克尔材料作为一种电光材料的应用，远不及铌酸锂、磷酸二氘钾等泡克耳斯材料那样普遍.
explanation_en: The isotropic materials will show birefringence under the external electric field, which will lead to the change of refractive index, and the change of refractive index is proportional to the square of the electric field strength. This effect is called Kerr effect or secondary electrophoto effect. The materials with this effect is called Kerr materials. Theoretically, all dielectric, whether solid or liquid, may exhibit Kerr effect under the action of high external electric field. The early Kerr material were organic liquids, among which nitrobenzene, m-nitrotoluene, phenylnitrile and other Kerr effects were the most obvious. Later, it was found that cubic perovskite type crystals such as barium titanate and strontium titanate had stronger Kerr effect, and were easy to use and store. Therefore, crystal Kerr materials replaced liquid Kerr materials in many applications. However, these crystalline materials have low Curie temperature, which makes it difficult to grow materials that meet the use requirements in size and quality and are expensive. Therefore, in general, the application of Kerr material as a electro-optical materials is far less common than that of Pockels materials such as lithium niobate and potassium deuterium phosphate

explanation_cn: 在互扩散过程中，由于异类组元扩散速度的差异，在界面上引起标记移动现象。Smigelskas和Kirkendall通过实验指出：在代位式固溶体Cu-Zn合金中，锌的扩散速度比铜快。在面心立方的Cu-Ni、Cu-Al、Cu-Ag、Au-Ni以及体心立方的Ti-Mo等合金系中，都发现有Kirkendall效应，从而确信这是一普遍现象。同时它表明异类原子通过直接互换的机制进行扩散是不可能的。
explanation_en: In the process of mutual diffusion, due to the difference in the diffusion speed of heterogeneous components, the marks move on the interface. Smigelskas and Kirkendall pointed out through experiments that in the substitutional solid solution Cu Zn alloy, the diffusion speed of zinc is faster than that of copper. Kirkendall effect is found in face centered cubic alloy systems such as Cu Ni, Cu Al, Cu Ag, Au Ni and body centered cubic Ti Mo, which is believed to be a common phenomenon. At the same time, it shows that it is impossible for heterogeneous atoms to diffusion through the mechanism of direct exchange.

explanation_cn: 是利用免疫分子(抗体、抗原)之间特有的识別和结合特性。以免疫分子作为敏感元件，通过光谱、压电振动或电化学等技术将免疫分子识别所引起的变化转换成电倍号来确定待测抗体或抗原浓度的传感器。根据换能器类型的不同，免疫生物传感器主要有大类:电化学免疫传感器、光学免疫传感器和微重量免疫传感器。
explanation_en: It utilizes the unique recognition and binding characteristics between immune molecules (antibodies, antigens). A sensor that uses immune molecules as sensitive elements and converts the changes caused by immune molecule recognition into electrical signals through techniques such as spectroscopy, piezoelectric vibration, or electrochemistry to determine the concentration of the antibody or antigen to be tested. According to the different types of transducers, immune biosensor mainly include electrochemical immunosensors, optical immunosensors and micro weight immunosensors.

explanation_cn: 利用抗原与抗体的免疫识别与结合功能制成的电极。免疫电极的测定是以免疫学原理为基础的，可分为非标记免疫电极与标记免疫电极两类。非标记免疫电极是在受体表面上形成抗原抗体复合物，将免疫反应引起的物理变化直接转换为电信号。迄今已提出两种方式:①在高分子膜表面结合抗体(或抗原)作为受体，测定抗原抗体反应前后的膜电位；常用的高分子膜有醋酸纤维素膜、聚氯乙烯膜等。根据这一原理已设计出判别血型、检测梅毒及B型肝炎的免疫传感器:②在固体电极表面结合抗体(或抗原）作为受体，测定伴随抗原、抗体反应引起的电极电位的变化。常用的固体电极有玻碳电极、Pt电极、半导体电极等。例如，将人绒毛膜促件腺激素(HCG）抗体共价结合在TiO2电极表面，可制成检测HCG的传感器。标记免疫电极是以酶、红细胞及核糖核蛋白体等作为标记物，将自的最终变化用电化学变换器转换成电信号的免疫电极。由于利用了标记物的化学放大作用，因而其检测灵敏度比非标记免疫电极有显著提高，迄今已设计出测定人绒毛膜促性腺激素(HCG)，免疫球蛋IgG、IgA、IgM、a-甲胎蛋白(TFP)等标记免疫电极。免疫电极在临床诊断、药物检定、生物工程等领域都有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: An electrode made by utilizing the immune recognition and binding functions of antigens and antibodies. The determination of immunoelectrode is based on immunological principles, and can be divided into two categories: non labeled immunoelectrode and labeled immunoelectrode. Non labeled immunoelectrode is to form antigen antibody complex on the surface of the receptor, which directly converts the physical changes caused by the immune reaction into electrical signals. So far, two methods have been proposed: ① binding antibodies (or antigens) on the surface of tnacromolecular film as receptors to measure the membrane potential before and after antigen antibody reaction; Common tnacromolecular film include cellulose acetate membrane, polyvinyl chloride membrane, etc. Based on this principle, immunosensors have been designed to distinguish blood types, detect syphilis and hepatitis B. ② Antibodies (or antigens) are bound to the surface of the solid electrode as receptors, and changes in electrode potential caused by antigen and antibody reactions are measured. Commonly used solid electrodes include glassy carbon electrodes, Pt electrodes, semiconductor electrodes, etc. For example, covalently binding human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) antibodies to the surface of TiO2 electrodes can be used as sensors for detecting HCG. Labeled immunoelectrode is a immunoelectrode that uses enzymes, red blood cells and ribonucleosomes as markers to convert the final change of self into electrical signals with an electrochemical converter. Because of the chemical amplification of the marker, its detection sensitivity is significantly improved than that of the non labeled immunoelectrode. So far, a immunoelectrode has been designed to detect human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG), immunoglobulin IgG, IgA, IgM, a-alpha fetoprotein (TFP) and other labeled immune electrodes. Immunoelectrode has broad application prospects in clinical diagnosis, drug detection, bioengineering and other fields.

explanation_cn: 是以免疫细胞为敏感元件，利用免疫细胞特异的免疫识別和免疫应答功能，将免疫细胞遇到的生物化学信号(酶、微生物、免疫体和蛋内质等抗原体)有选择性地转换成光、电、热、力学等信号，用相应的换能器检测这些信号来获取免疫抗原的种类和浓度的装置。
explanation_en: It is a device that uses immune cells as sensitive elements and utilizes their specific immune recognition and response functions to selectively convert biochemical signals encountered by immune cells (such as enzymes, microorganisms, immune bodies, and egg endosomes) into signals such as light, electricity, heat, and mechanics. Corresponding transducers are used to detect these signals to obtain the type and concentration of immune antigens.

explanation_cn: 由超高速纺丝得到具有高取向度和高结晶度的化纤长丝，简称FOY丝。与常规拉伸丝相比有一定差别，其不能满足服用性能的要求。必须将FOY进行适当的后拉伸，或在超高速纺丝过程中。在纺程上对纤维进行热处理。才能满足服用性能的要求。全取向丝品质指标稳定、不匀率低、卷装大，有利于后序纺织加工。

There is a certain difference compared to conventional stretch yarn, as it cannot meet the requirements of wearability. FOY must be subjected to appropriate post stretching or during the ultra high speed spinning process. Carry out heat treatment on the spinning process. To meet the requirements for performance. Fully oriented silk has stable quality indicators, low unevenness, and large package size, which is beneficial for subsequent textile processing.

explanation_cn: 一种用建立任意形状漫反射体完整图像即维图像的两维成像术进行检测的方法。先将物体发射出的相干波记艰成全息图。然后用一相干光再现全息图以反映物体的真实形状。全息检测将图像用作二维样板。通过对比，可量测物体在形状和尺寸上的任何偏差。有两种全息检测技术，即光学全息术和声学全息术。光学全息采用激光光源。并用附加的方法来使材料处于受力或其他受激状态。它的优点是能用于各种材料-任意尺寸和形状。灵敏度高；缺点是对加载源的应力传递机构要求较高。工件壁厚有限制。对缺陷只能定性而不能定量。声学全息的原理与光学全息相同。不同之处是在声学全息中关于材料白部缺陷的信息直接取自物体白部的图像。有两种声学全息术，即液面型和扫描型。都采用超声换能器为声源。液面型的优点是可提供实时阁像。适用于快速检查。扫描型的优点是能对缺陷正确定位和定量。其灵敏度比液面型高。设备可以移动，适用于检测大件。
explanation_en: A method for detection using two-dimensional imaging techniques that establish a complete image of an arbitrarily shaped diffuse reflector. First, record the coherent waves emitted by the object into a hologram. Then, a coherent light is used to reproduce the hologram to reflect the true shape of the object. Holographic testing uses the image as a two-dimensional template. By comparison, any deviation in the shape and size of an object can be measured. There are two kinds of holographic testing technologies, namely optical holography and acoustic holography. Optical holography uses a laser light source. And use additional methods to make materials under stress or other excitations. Its advantage is that it can be used for all kinds of materials - any size and shape. High sensitivity; The disadvantage is that there is a high requirement for the stress transmission mechanism of the loading source. The wall thickness of the workpiece is limited. Defects can only be qualitative rather than quantitative. The principle of acoustic holography is the same as that of optical holography. The difference is that the information about the white part defect of materials in acoustic holography is directly taken from the image of the white part of the object. There are two types of acoustic holography, namely liquid surface holography and scanning holography. Both use ultrasonic transducers as sound sources. The advantage of liquid level type is that it can provide real-time imaging. Suitable for quick inspection. The advantage of scanning type is that it can accurately locate and quantify defects. Its sensitivity is higher than that of liquid level type. The device can be moved and is suitable for detecting large items.

explanation_cn: 由纺丝-拉伸一步法得到具有高取向度和中等结晶度的化纤长丝，简称FDY丝。纺丝和拉伸在一台纺丝拉伸联合机上完成。全拉伸丝品质均匀、稳定性好、毛丝断头少，可以直接用于进行纺织加工。还能提髙纺织品质量，降低成本。
explanation_en: The chemical fiber filamem with high degree of orientation and medium crystallinity, FDY for short, is obtained by the one-step spinning drawing method. Spinning and stretching are completed on a spinning and stretching combined machine. Fully drawn yarn has uniform quality, good stability and few broken ends, and can be directly used for textile processing. It can also improve the quality of textiles and reduce costs.

explanation_cn: 是氟碳化物（PFC)中的一种。它具有优良的化学稳定性和热稳定性，生物相容性好，具有大量溶解氧和二氧化碳的能力，可作为红细胞的代用品。将氧传送到体白的各组织与器官，在新陈代谢完成后，又可将二氧化碳经呼吸作用自肺排出，因此适合于用作入工血液。因其不溶于水，若作为入工血液必须制成乳剂。它在血管白只能暂时而不是永久替代自然血，而且它不能输送养分，无凝血性，缺乏免疫能力，但这种暂时性取代对机体造血功能的恢复不产生太大影响。它在血液循环系统中分解后，通过肝脏和肾脏从血液中除去，并通过肺呼出体外。目前可将其用于脏器灌流(代替血液、血浆及营养液来灌流离体脏器以维持其生存）、液体呼吸和入工鳃（将生物体浸在液体中，依靠溶解在液体中的氧进行呼吸）、交换输血、急救输血、一氧化碳中毒的解救等方面。全氟化醚共聚物的代表性品种是FreonE4(氟利昂E4)。
explanation_en: It is a type of fluorocarbon (PFC). It has excellent chemical stability and thermal stability, good biocompatibility, and the ability to dissolve a large amount of oxygen and carbon dioxide. It can be used as a substitute for red blood cells. Oxygen is transported to various tissues and organs of the body, and after metabolism is completed, carbon dioxide can be expelled from the lungs through respiration, making it suitable for use as input blood. Due to its insolubility in water, it must be made into an emulsion if used as a working blood. It can only temporarily instead of permanently replace natural blood in vascular white blood, and it cannot transport nutrients, lacks coagulation, and lacks immune ability. However, this temporary replacement does not have a significant impact on the recovery of the body's hematopoietic function. After decomposition in the blood circulation system, it is removed from the blood through the liver and kidneys, and exhaled out of the body through the lungs. At present, it can be used for organ perfusion (replacing blood, plasma, and nutrient solution to perfuse isolated organs to maintain their survival), liquid respiration and entry gills (immersing organisms in liquid and relying on dissolved oxygen for respiration), exchange transfusion, emergency blood transfusion, rescue of carbon monoxide poisoning, and other aspects. The representative variety of polyfluoroether copolymer is FreonE4 (Freon E4).
