explanation_en: The ion exchange membrane is composed of perfluorinated sulfonic acid and perfluorinated carboxylic acid ion exchange resin. Consisting of a supporting membrane and a dense membrane. It has excellent ionic conductivity and ion selective permeability.

explanation_cn: 由全氟甲基乙稀基醚、四氣乙烯与全氣烯丙基醚H元共聚得到的一类弹性体。]兼具有弹性和聚四氟乙烯的热稳定性与化学稳定性；在低于脆化温度下仍具有一定塑性，硬而不脆，可弯曲除了在氟代溶剂中溶胀外。对所有化学药品都稳定。全氟醚橡胶是由全氣（甲基乙烯基〉醚、四氟乙烯和少量全氟烯醚经乳液聚合而得的。且用二胺或2，2-双（4-苯羟基丙烷）与全氟苯环上的氟发生双亲核取代而硫化。其加工性能较差，应用于氟橡胶不能胜任、条件苛刻的场合。制作耐各种介质，如火箭燃料、肼、氧化剂、四氧化二氮、发烟硝酸等的密封件，用于航天、航空、化工、石油、核能等工业部门。
explanation_en: A type of elastomer obtained by H-membered copolymerization of perfluoromethylethyl ether, tetraethylene, and perfluoroallyl ether It also has thermal stability and chemical stability of elasticity and polytetrafluoroethylene; It is still plastic below the embrittlement temperature, hard but not brittle, and can be bent except for swelling in fluorinated solvents. Stable for all chemicals. Fluoroether rubber is made by emulsion polymerization of full gas (methyl vinyl) ether, tetrafluoroethylene and a small amount of perfluoroethylene ether. It is vulcanization by amphiphilic substitution of diamine or 2,2-bis (4-phenylhydroxypropane) with fluorine on perfluoroethylene ring. Its processing performance is poor, and it is used in occasions where fluoro rubber is not competent and the conditions are harsh. Make seals resistant to various media, such as rocket fuel, hydrazine, oxidizer, nitrogen tetroxide, fuming nitric acid, etc., for aerospace, aviation, chemical, petroleum, nuclear and other industrial sectors.

explanation_cn: 天然粒面保持整。天然毛孔和粒纹清晰可见的皮革。真皮的主要构成部分是胶原纤维。根据胶原纤维的结构特点。真皮可分为两层：下层是粗壮胶原纤维组成的网状层；上层是纤细的胶原纤维组成的呈细乳头状起伏的乳头层制革时，表皮随毛被脱去后，即露出乳头层而使革面具有真皮天然粒面的外观。表面伤残少、质量好的原料皮才能用于全粒面革的生产。
explanation_en: The natural grain surface is kept intact. Leather with natural pore and grain clearly visible. The main component of dermis is collagen fiber. According to the structural characteristics of collagen fiber. The dermis can be divided into two layers: the lower layer is a reticular layer composed of thick collagen fiber; In leather making, the upper layer is a thin, papillary papillary layer composed of fine collagen fiber. When the epidermis is removed with the hair, the papillary layer is exposed, making the leather surface have the appearance of the natural grain of the dermis. Only raw skin with less surface damage and good quality can be used in the production of full grain leather.

explanation_cn: 它的骨架是一个立方体形，在这个立方体的每个角上有一个碳原子并带一个氢原子，当所有的氢原子被硝基取代，形成八硝基立方烷。八硝基立方烷是白色固体，性质稳定，样品保存14个月不会发生变化，微溶于己烷，易溶于极性有机溶剂。八硝基立方烷合成极其烦琐复杂并且条件苛刻，产率也不高，基本上只限于实验室合成，实际应用不多。
explanation_en: Its skeleton is a cube, with one carbon atom and one hydrogen atom on each corner of the cube. When all hydrogen atoms are replaced by nitro, octanitrocubane is formed. Octanitrocubane is a white solid with stable properties. The sample will not change after 14 months of storage. It is slightly soluble in hexane and easily soluble in polar organic solvents. The synthesis of octanitrocubane is extremely complicated, the conditions are harsh, and the yield is not high, which is basically limited to laboratory synthesis, and the practical application is not much.

explanation_cn: 白色粉末。在253.7nm紫外线激发下发出蓝绿色荧光，峰值波长为480nm，量子效率达90%,合成方法与十铝酸钡镁：铕(II)相似。该荧光粉用作高显色荧光粉中的蓝绿色成分。它在X射线照射下发出蓝色荧光，又可作X射线增感屏用荧光粉f.铝酸盐奕光粉可因所含铝物质的量不同而形成许多相类似的荧光粉，报道的有：BaAl2O:Eu2+, BaAlO16:Eu2-等。
explanation_en: White powder. It emits blue-green fluorescence under the excitation of 253.7 nm ultraviolet light, with a peak-emission wavelength of 480 nm and a quantum efficiency of 90%. The synthesis method is similar to that of barium magnesium aluminate: europium (II). The phosphor is used as a blue-green component in the high color phosphor. It emits blue fluorescence under X-ray irradiation, and can also be used as phosphor for X-ray intensifying screen f. Aluminate polishing powder can form many phase phosphor due to the different amount of aluminum contained. BaAl2O:Eu2+, BaAlO16:Eu2-are reported.

explanation_cn: 又名纤锌矿结构。是一类以六方ZnS为代表的AB型化合物的晶体结构。属六方晶系。简单六方点阵。空间群为P6mC。Zn2+和S2周围都由4个异号离子呈四面体方式配位；这种结构也可看作较大的负离子B(如S2)作六方最密堆积，而A离子(如Zn2+)填入其中一半的四面体空隙中。
explanation_en: Also known as wurtzite structure. It is the crystal structure of a class of AB type compounds represented by hexagonal ZnS. It belongs to the hexagonal crystal system. Simple hexagonal lattice. The space group is P6mC. Both Zn2+and S2 are coordinated by four heterologous ions in a tetrahedral manner; This structure can also be seen as the hexagonal densest packing of larger negative ions B (such as S2), while A ions (such as Zn2+) fill half of the tetrahedral voids.

explanation_cn: 又称朗斯代尔石，属于六方晶系。单轴正光性，具有双折射性，折射率2.41-2.42,理论密度3.51g/cm3,与金刚石相同。其硬度接近金刚石，但脆性大，粒度细。以爆炸法或静压法沿石墨C轴加13GPa以上的压力及1000°C以上的温度，可以使石墨转变成六方金刚石。在自然界的某些陨石中，发现少量六方金刚石与金刚石共生。用很强的淬火方法也可以使结晶态的石墨变成六方金刚石。
explanation_en: Also known as Langsdale, it belongs to the hexagonal crystal system. Uniaxial positive light, birefringence, refractive index 2.41-2.42, theoretical density 3.51g/cm3, the same as diamond. Its hardness is close to that of diamond, but its brittleness is large and its particle size is fine. The pressure of more than 13GPa and the temperature of more than 1000 ° C along the C axis of graphite can be applied by explosion or static pressure to make graphite transformation into hexagonal diamond. In some meteorites in nature, a small amount of hexagonal diamond is found to coexist with diamond. The crystalline graphite can also be transformed into hexagonal diamond by a strong quenching method.

explanation_cn: 铀的一种氟化物，化学式为UF6。生产富集铀的原料。六氟化铀热稳定性很高，在常温常压下为透明结晶状固体，外观呈白色。在高温高压下为无色透明液体，不与干燥空气、氯、溴和氮起作用，与水及空气中的水分反应剧烈，生成氧化物白色烟雾。它与有机物几乎都能起反应，因此生产用设备的密封只能用金属(如镍):和聚四氟乙烯等。利用元素或气态氟化氢可把四氟化铀、氧化铀或金属铀等转变成六氟化铀，目前多采用元素氟在高温下与四氟化铀起反应的方法。六氟化铀是唯一的易挥发的铀化合物，是目前工业规模分离铀同位素的工作介质。
explanation_en: A fluoride of uranium, chemical formula UF6. Raw materials for enriched uranium production. Uranium hexafluoride has high thermal stability. It is a transparent crystalline solid with white appearance under normal temperature and pressure. Under high temperature and pressure, it is a colorless transparent liquid that does not react with dry air, chlorine, bromine, and nitrogen. It reacts violently with water and moisture in the air, generating oxide white smoke. It can almost react with organics, so only metal (such as nickel) and polylctrafluorocthylone can be used for sealing production equipment. Transformation by using elements or gaseous hydrogen fluoride. At present, element fluorine reacts with uranium tetrafluoride at high temperature. Uranium hexafluoride is the only volatile uranium compound, and it is the working medium for separating uranium isotopes on an industrial scale at present.

name_cn: 六硝基六氮杂异伍尔兹烷
explanation_cn: 是具有笼型多环硝胺结构的一个高能密度化合物。为白色结晶体，其属于多晶形炸药，常温常压下存在有四种晶形，其中e晶形的密度最大、稳定性最高，最有使用价值。但是由于结晶时易发生晶形转变，形成混合晶形晶体，影响炸药性能。
explanation_en: It is a high-energy density compound with cage type polycyclic nitramine structure. It is a white crystal, which belongs to polycrystalline explosive. There are four crystal forms under normal temperature and pressure, of which the e crystal form has the largest density, the highest stability, and the most useful. However, the crystal transformation is easy to occur during crystallization, forming mixed crystal crystal, which affects the performance of explosive.

explanation_cn: 从二氯乙烧中重结晶所得产品为绿色或淡黄色六面体结晶，溶于苯、二氯乙烷。难溶于氯仿、四氯化碳，在潮湿空气中很快被水解。密度2.01g/cm3，熔点254-258℃。爆发点282℃(5s)，爆速9.33km/s(密度1.95.6g/cm3时)，撞击感度56%(10kg.25cm),120℃l2h失重1.8%。爆速是已知芳香族硝基化合物炸药中最高的，但安定性差，吸水后变成黄色粉末，目前尚无使用价值。将三硝基苯部分还原为二硝基苯胺，后者先以硝硫混酸处理得五硝基苯胺，再用过硫酸氧化即制得六硝基苯。
explanation_en: The product obtained from recrystallization from dichloroethylene is a green or light yellow hexahedral crystal, soluble in benzene and dichloroethane. It is insoluble in chloroform and carbon tetrachloride and quickly hydrolyzes in humid air. Density 2.01g/cm3, melting point 254-258 ℃. The explosion point is 282 ℃ (5s), the detonation velocity is 9.33km/s (when the density is 1.95.6g/cm3), the impact sensitivity is 56% (10kg. 25cm), and the weight loss is 1.8% at 120 ℃ for 12h. The detonation velocity is the highest among known aromatic nitrocompound explosive, but its stability is poor. It becomes yellow powder after absorbing water, and has no use value at present. The trinitrobenzene is partially reduced to dinitroaniline, the latter is first treated with nitric sulfur mixed acid to obtain pentanitroaniline, and then oxidized with persulfuric acid to obtain hexanitrobenzene.

explanation_cn: 化学式SrB6O1工Pb，白色粉末。在253.7nm紫外线激发下发出峰值波长为313nm的紫外线，半宽度26nm在医疗上可用于冶疗皮肤病和作保健用的紫外灯，还可用于催化光化学反应。
explanation_en: Chemical formula SrB6O1 industrial Pb, white powder. Under the excitation of 253.7 nm ultraviolet light, it emits ultraviolet light with a peak-emission wavelength of 313 nm. The half width 26 nm ultraviolet light can be used for medical treatment of skin diseases and health care, and can also be used to catalyze photochemical reactions.

explanation_cn: 化学式BaAl12O19:Mn2+，激发峰位于120-240nm的宽带激发，在147nm激发下，BaAl12O19:Mn2+的发射光谱是一个峰值位于515nm的宽带组成。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is BaAl12O19: Mn2+. The excitation peak is in the 120-240nm broadband excitation. Under the 147nm excitation, the emission spectrum of BaAl12O19: Mn2+is a broadband composition with the peak at 515nm.

explanation_cn: 化学式Sr2Al6O1工Eu2+[SAL]。白色粉末。在253.7nm紫外线激发下可发出蓝色荧光，峰值波长460nm，量子效率为90%。主要用作基色荧光粉中的蓝色荧光粉:合成方法详见十四铝酸锶:铕(II)。
explanation_en: The chemical formula Sr2Al6O1 is Eu2+[SAL]. White powder. Under the excitation of 253.7 nm ultraviolet light, it can emit blue fluorescence with a peak-emission wavelength of 460 nm and a quantum efficiency of 90%. It is mainly used as the blue phosphor in the primary color phosphor: see strontium tetraaluminate: europium (II) for the synthesis method.

explanation_cn: 在水平放置的磨盘上，垂直安放一个圆盘形试样。试样由马达驱动，由于摩擦力带动磨盘转动，经预磨和运行1000m后，计算试样的磨耗体积。兰伯恩磨耗试验机的磨耗变化行为与轮胎有相关之处，所以兰伯恩磨耗试验机相对其他类型的磨耗试验机而言，在检丧轮胎、皮带及鞋底等橡胶的耐磨性试验机器中，与产品试验结果的相关性和再现性好。ISO23337:2007(硫化胶或热塑性橡胶——磨性的测定改进兰伯恩式磨耗测试机法）对试验方法和设备进行了进一步的优化。其主要的改进为：测试试片和砂轮分别由不同的设备驱动，因此倾斜角度是可变的，而砂轮和试片的转速由专门的伺服设备控制，所以较精确地控制二者的转速。
explanation_en: Place a disc shaped specimen vertically on a horizontally placed grinding disc. The sample is driven by a motor, and the friction force drives the grinding disc to rotate. After pre grinding and running for 1000m, the wear volume of the sample is calculated. The wear change behavior of the Lambern wear tester is related to the tire. Therefore, compared with other types of wear testers, the Lambern wear tester has a good correlation and reproducibility with the product test results in the wear resistance test machines for inspecting tires, belts, soles and other rubber. ISO23337:2007 (vulcanized rubher or thermoplastic rubber - Determination of abradability - Modified Lambern abrasion tester method) further optimized the test method and equipment. The main improvement is that the test specimen and grinding wheel are driven by different devices, so the tilt angle is variable, and the rotational speed of the grinding wheel and test specimen is controlled by a specialized servo device, so the rotational speed of the two is more accurately controlled.

explanation_cn: 共价有机骨架是一类晶态的纯有机孔隙聚合物。它们可以在原子层面上精确控制骨架结构和纳米孔隙。共价有机骨架材料通常由较轻的元素通过强共价键连接起来.它们具有较低的质量密度、高的热稳定性和永久性的孔隙结构。
explanation_en: Covalent-organic framework is a kind of pure organic porous polymer in crystalline state. They can precisely control the skeleton structure and nanopores at the atomic level. Covalent-organic framework materials are usually connected by lighter elements through strong covalent bond. They have low mass density, high thermal stability and permanent pore structure.

explanation_cn: 相邻原子共有一对自旋反平行的电子而结合的键。共价键具有饱和性和方向性。前者指以共价键结合的原子所形成的键数目有一个最大值（等于未配对价电子数）；后者指各共价键之间有确定的取向。许多非金属单质分子（如H2,N2,O2等），两原子间形成非极性共价键.分子是非极性分子。另一类为非金属的原子晶体或共价晶体。例如金刚石由碳组成，每个碳原子与近邻的四个碳形成共价键，键角109°28.
explanation_en: A bond in which adjacent atoms share a pair of electrons with antiparallel spin. Covalent bond has saturation and directivity. The former means that the number of bonds formed by atoms bound by covalent bond has a maximum (equal to the number of unpaired valence electrons); The latter refers to the definite orientation between covalent bond. Many non-metallic simple molecules (such as H2, N2, O2, etc.) form nonpolar covalent bond between two atoms. Molecules are nonpolar molecules. The other is non-metallic atomic crystal or covalent crystal. For example, diamond is composed of carbon. Each carbon atom forms covalent bond with four adjacent carbons, and the bond angle is 109 ° 28

explanation_cn: 又称喷射共沉积复合工艺等。将基体金属或合金熔化后用惰性气体雾化，同时向雾化的液流中喷人陶瓷增强体颗粒，共同沉积到收集器上制取金属基复合材料的工艺方法。
explanation_en: Also known as spray co deposition composite process, etc. The process of preparing metal matrix composite by melting matrix metal or alloy and atomizing it with inert gas, spraying ceramics reinforcement particles into the atomized liquid stream, and depositing them on the collector together.

explanation_cn: 将两个或两个以上可单独成型但又有连接或装配关系的复合材料制件，用一个工艺过程同时完成固化成型和胶接成一个整体制件的工艺方法。对于夹层结构而言，是指复合材料蒙皮同化的同时与夹层芯子黏结在一起的工艺。该技术是热压罐工艺常用的整体成型技术之一，主要用热压罐配合弹性膨胀模、橡胶模块和金属模块形成对制件各成型面的均匀加压，成型固化后脱模得到整体制件。也用于树脂传递模塑成型等其他成型工艺中。共固化技术可减少零件及紧固件数量和装配程序，降低成本.提高生产效率，减少钻孔等机械加工数量，减轻结构重量，改善和提高结构的整体性能.是能充分体现复合材料优异性能和工艺可设计性的一种先进成型技术。但该技术对材料工艺性能要求高.模具复杂，无损检测难度增大.制造风险增加。常用在成型尺寸较大而又零件较多的飞机、卫星、火箭等的部件制造。
explanation_en: The process method of combining two or more composite materials parts that can be separately formed but have connection or assembly relationship with one process to simultaneously complete curing molding and bonding into a whole part. For sandwich structure, it refers to the process of bonding the composite materials skin with the sandwich core while assimilating it. This technology is one of the commonly used integral forming technologies in the autoclave process. It mainly uses the autoclave to cooperate with the elasticity expansion mold, rubber module and metal module to form a uniform pressure on each forming surface of the part, and demoulds the whole part after curing. It is also used in other molding processes such as resin transfer molding. Co-curing technology can reduce the number of parts and fasteners and assembly procedures, reduce costs, improve production efficiency, reduce the number of machining such as drilling, reduce the weight of the structure, improve and improve the overall performance of the structure. It is an advanced molding technology that can fully reflect the excellent performance and process designability of composite materials. However, this technology has high requirements for the technological performance of materials, complex molds, increased difficulty in nondestructive testing, and increased manufacturing risks. Commonly used in the manufacturing of aircraft, satellites, rockets, and other components with larger forming sizes and more components.

explanation_cn: 是生产多层复合聚合物制品的一种加工方法。使用两台或多台挤出机挤出不同品种的聚合物及其共混复合材料熔体，通过一个公用机头（汇流器）使各层熔体料流的界面接触黏连汇集到一起，形成层数与挤出机台数相当的多层复合材料。
explanation_en: It is a processing method for producing multi-layer composition polymer products. Two or more extruders are used to extrude different kinds of polymer and its polymer blending composite materials melts, and a common die (combiner) is used to make the interface of each layer of melt flow contact and stick together, forming a multi-layer composite materials with the same number of layers as the number of extruders.

explanation_cn: 指含有故意掺入的除n型或者p型掺杂剂以外的杂质的硅单晶。共掺杂的目的是调控硅单晶中的缺陷、改善硅单晶的性能。最著名的共掺硅单晶是掺氮硅单晶.共掺氮具有如下优点：提高硅单晶的力学性能；减小空洞型缺陷的尺寸并改变其微结构，使空洞型缺陷更易被高温热处理消除；增强直拉硅单晶的氧沉淀，提高硅片的内吸杂能力。近年来.还出现了共掺锗、共掺碳及共掺碳和氮的硅单晶，研究表明这些共掺硅单晶也具有掺氮硅单晶的某些优点。
explanation_en: Refers to siliconcrystalline containing impurities other than n-type or p-type dopants intentionally doped. The purpose of co doping is to control the defects in siliconcrystalline and improve the performance of siliconcrystalline. The most famous co-doped silicon is nitrogen doped siliconcrystalline. Co doped nitrogen has the following advantages: improving the mechanical properties of siliconcrystalline; Reducing the size of void defect and changing its microstructure make void defect easier to be eliminated by high temperature heat treatment; Enhance the oxygen precipitation of Czochralski silicon single crystal and improve the internal gettering ability of silicon wafer. In recent years, siliconcrystalline co doped with germanium, co doped with carbon, co doped with carbon and nitrogen have also appeared. Research shows that these co-doped silicon also have some advantages of nitrogen doped siliconcrystalline.

explanation_cn: 又称协同敏化。指采用两种或两种以上的染料来拓宽宽禁带半导体电极光谱响应。
explanation_en: Also known as synergistic sensitization. It refers to the use of two or more dye or dyestuffc to broaden the spectral response of wide bandgap semiconductor electrode.

explanation_cn: 又称低熔点合金焊接。其基本特点是几种不同的材料在远低于各自的熔点温度下按一定质量比例形成合金。以"金-硅共晶焊"为例，金的熔点l063°C,硅的熔点为1414°C，但是按照质量分数为2.85%的硅和97.15%的金组合，就形成熔点为363°C的共晶合金体。金-硅共晶焊的焊接过程为：在一定的温度（高于363°C)和一定的压力下.将硅材料在镀金的底座上轻轻揉动摩擦.擦去界面不稳定的氧化层，使接触表面之间形成晶粒形式互相结合的混合物即"金-桂共镕晶体"，从而使硅芯片牢固地焊接在底座上，并形成良好的电学性能。
explanation_en: Also known as low melting point alloy welding. Its basic feature is that several different materials form alloy at a certain mass ratio at a temperature far below their respective melting point. Take the "gold silicon eutectic welding" as an example, the melting point of gold is l063 ° C, and the melting point of silicon is 1414 ° C. But according to the combination of 2.85% silicon and 97.15% gold, a eutectic alloy body with a melting point of 363 ° C is formed. The weld process of gold silicon eutectic welding is: under a certain temperature (higher than 363 ° C) and pressure, gently rub the silicon material on the gold-plated base, wipe off the unstable oxide layer at the interface, and form a mixture of grain forms and mutual combination between the contact surfaces, namely "gold Guangxi Gongrong crystal", so that the silicon chip can be firmly weld on the base and form good electrical properties.

explanation_cn: 固态转变中一个固相对另两个或两个以上的固相同时过饱和，两相或多相同时由过饱和相中析出的反应。钢中的珠光体转变是共析反应的典型例子，奥氏体对铁素体与渗碳体同时过饱和，转变成铁素体与渗碳体片层状近于平行交替排列的两相混合物，此组织称为珠光体。
explanation_en: In solid transformation, one solid phase is supersaturated to two or more other solid phases at the same time, and two or more phases are precipitated from the supersaturated phase at the same time. Pearlite transformation in steel is a typical example of eutectoid reaction. Austenite is supersaturated with ferrite and carburizing at the same time, and transformation into a two-phase mixture of ferrite and carburizing lamellar nearly in parallel alternating arrangement. This structure is called pearlite.

explanation_cn: 具有共析成分的钢。室温平衡组织全部为珠光体，即铁素体与渗碳体的机械混合物，一个珠光体团内铁素体和渗碳体一般为片状且交替成层状平行排列，随片层间距的减小其强度和硬度明显提高。非合金共析钢的碳含量约为0.77%，合金钢的共析碳含量多小于0.77%。
explanation_en: Steel with eutectoid composition. The equilibrium structure at room temperature is all pearlite, that is, the mechanical mixture of ferrite and carburizing. The ferrite and carburizing in a pearlite group are generally lamellar and alternately arranged in parallel layers, and their strength and hardness increase significantly with the decrease of lamellar spacing. The carbon content of non alloy eutectoid steel is about 0.77%, while that of alloy steel is mostly less than 0.77%.

explanation_cn: 沉淀相的点阵平面与基体点阵平面在界面上一一对应、匹配，两相在界面上保持连续性和贯通性，称为共格界面，保持这种界面的沉淀为共格沉淀。
explanation_en: The lattice plane of the precipitation phase corresponds and matches with the lattice plane of the matrix one by one on the interface. The two phases maintain continuity and continuity on the interface, which is called the coherent interface. The precipitation that maintains this interface is called coherent precipitation.

explanation_cn: 由共格应变场与位错应变场之间的相互作用产生的硬化。
explanation_en: Hardening caused by the interaction between the coherent strain field and the dislocation strain field.

explanation_cn: 通过化学合成的办法和一定的结晶控制手段.使得两种或两种以上起爆药在反应过程中同时结晶并相互团聚而形成规整的混合晶粒，具有性能互补或优化的一种起爆药剂。
explanation_en: Through chemical synthesis and certain crystallization control means, two or more primary explosives can crystallize simultaneously and agglomeration with each other in the reaction process to form regular mixed grains, which is a kind of primary explosive with complementary or optimized performance.

explanation_en: Polymer blending is the common mixing of several materials. According to the mixing principle, it can be divided into physical blending and chemical polymer blending. It refers to the method of using a physical or chemical method to uniformly mix several materials to improve the performance of materials.

explanation_cn: 由环氧氯丙烷、环氧乙烷或它们和烯丙基缩水甘油醚二元或三元共聚而成的弹性体材料，一般采用溶液聚合法。共聚氯醚橡胶是耐油、耐寒、耐候、耐热性良好的橡胶，同时与树脂的共混性也良好。作为一种特种橡胶，由于其综合性能较好，故用途很广，可用作汽车、飞机及各种机械的配件，如垫圈、密封圈、O形圈、隔膜等；也可用作耐油胶管、印刷胶辊、胶板、衬里、充气房屋及其他充气制品等。
explanation_en: The solution polymerization method is generally adopted for the elastomeric materials made of epichlorohydrin, ethylene oxide or their binary or ternary copolymerization with allyl glycidyl ether. Copolychloroether rubber is a kind of rubber with good oil resistance, cold resistance, weather resistance and heat resistance, and also has good compatibility with resin. As a special rubber, it has a wide range of applications due to its good comprehensive performance, and can be used as accessories of automobiles, aircraft and various machines, such as gaskets, sealing rings, O-rings, separator, etc; It can also be used as oil resistant hose, printing roller, rubber plate, lining, inflatable housing, and other inflatable products.

explanation_cn: 由两种或两种以上不同单体共聚生成的聚合物，按照参加聚合单体的种类数可分为二元、三元、四元、多元共聚物；根据单体在共聚物分子链上的序列分布可分为交替、无规、嵌段和接枝共聚物。
explanation_en: Polymer produced by copolymerization of two or more different monomer can be divided into binary, ternary, quaternary and multi-component copolymer according to the number of monomer participating in polymerization; According to the sequence distribution of monomer on the molecular chain of copolymer, it can be divided into alternating, random, block and graft copolymer.

explanation_cn: 一种分子链中以氧化亚甲基（一CH2O-〉重复结构单元为主，夹杂少量一CH2-CH2-O-结构单元的线型、高密度、高结晶性聚合物。通常由三聚甲醛与共聚单体二氧戊环在阳离子型催化剂（如BF3-乙醚络合物）催化下共聚所制得。
explanation_en: A linear, high density, highly crystalline polymer in which the molecular chain is mainly composed of methylene oxide (- CH2O -) repeating structural unit and a small amount of CH2-CH2-O - structural unit. It is usually prepared by the copolymerization of trioxane and copolymer monomer dioxane under the catalysis of cationic catalysts (such as BF3 ether complex).

explanation_cn: 泛指含结构单元的共聚物。以二元酚（双酚A、对苯二酚、邻甲基对苯二酚、4,4-联苯酚等）、芳香族二元酸(间/对苯二甲酸、邻甲基对苯二甲酸、4,4-联苯二甲酸等）、芳香族羟基酸（羟基苯甲酸等）等通过界面缩聚、高/低温溶液聚合、熔融缩聚等方法聚合形成的芳香族共聚酰。由于共聚芳酯的结构单元容易以直线排列.链段的有序性增加.容易形成结晶。主链中苯基含量大刚性好、聚合物强度高、模量大且具有优异的电绝缘性能和耐溶剂腐蚀性能。在电子电气、机械等领域应用广泛，可用来制成涂料、薄膜、纤维等。最常见的共聚芳酯是以4,4-联苯酚、间苯二甲酸/对苯二甲酸（及其衍生物）、羟基苯甲酸为原料，界面缩聚生成线型无规芳香族聚酯。
explanation_en: It generally refers to copolymer containing structural units. Aromatic copolyacyls are formed by polymerization of binary phenols (bisphenol A, hydroquinone, o-methylhydroquinone, 4,4-diphenylphenol, etc.), aromatic dicarboxylic acids (m/terephthalic acid, o-methylterephthalic acid, 4,4-biphenyldicarboxylic acid, etc.), aromatic hydroxyl acids (hydroxybenzoic acid, etc.) through interfacial polycondensation, high/low temperature solution polymerization, meltphase polycondensation, etc. Because the structural units of copolyarylate are easy to be arranged in a straight line, the order of chain segment is increased, and crystallization is easy to form. The main chain has high phenyl content, good rigidity, high polymer strength, high modulus, and excellent electrical insulation and solvent corrosion resistance. It is widely used in electronic, electrical, mechanical and other fields, and can be used to make coatings, films, fibers, etc. The most common copolyarylate is a linear random aromatic polyester produced by interfacial polycondensation with 4,4-biphenol, isophthalic acid/terephthalic acid (and its derivatives), and hydroxybenzoic acid as raw materials.

explanation_cn: 把一个或多个已经固化成型与另一个或多个未固化的制件通过胶黏剂（一般为胶膜）在一次固化中将它们固化并胶接成一个整体制件的工艺方法，是共同化技术与二次胶接技术的结合，是热压罐工艺常用的整体成型技术之一。
explanation_en: The process method of curing and bonding one or more curing parts and one or more non curing parts into a whole part through adhesive (generally adhesive film) in a single curing is the combination of joint technology and secondary bonding technology, and is one of the commonly used integral molding technologies in the autoclave process.

explanation_cn: 是一类多孔的含刚性骨架的髙分子材料。有别于传统的共轭聚合物和多孔材料，它们内在的共轭骨架赋予其永久性纳米孔隙。它们是不含长程有序分子排列的无定形材料，由各种刚性共轭基元（例如稠环芳烃、苯乙炔基衍生物、杂环体系和大环体系等）构成。岗代芳烃、芳香硼酸、氰基取代芳烃、芳香醛、乙烯基取代芳烃和氨基取代芳烃等被广泛用于构筑共轭微孔聚合物。各种各样的化学反应、构筑单元和合成方法用于制备具有不同结构和性质的共轭微孔聚合物。作为一个新的材料平台，共轭微孔聚合物的特殊之处在于它们结构设计上的灵活性和可调控性。通过对聚合物共轭骨架的选择，可以对材料纳米孔隙的形貌、大小、表面功能闭进行精确控制，并给材料带来崭新的物理和化学功能。这类材料在解决能源和环境问题上表现出极大的潜力，包括它们在气体吸附、非均相催化、发光材料、光富集和电储能材料等领域的应用。
explanation_en: It is a kind of porous high molecular materials with rigid skeleton. Different from traditional conjugated polymer and porous materials, their inherent conjugated skeletons endow them with permanent nano pores. They are amorphous materials without long-range ordered molecular arrangement, and are composed of various rigid conjugated units (such as fused aromatic hydrocarbons, phenylethynyl derivatives, heterocyclic systems and macrocyclic systems). Gangdai aromatics, aromatic boric acids, cyano substituted aromatics, aromatic aldehydes, vinyl substituted aromatics and amino substituted aromatics are widely used to construct conjugated microporous polymer. Various chemical reactions, building blocks and synthesis methods are used to prepare conjugated microporous polymer with different structures and properties. As a new materials platform, conjugated microporous polymer are unique in their structural design flexibility and controllability. By selecting the conjugated skeleton of polymer, the morphology, size and surface function of nano pores in materials can be precisely controlled, and new physical and chemical functions can be brought to materials. Such materials show great potential in solving energy and environmental problems, including their applications in gas adsorption, heterogeneous phase catalysis, luminescence materials, photo enrichment and electric energy storage materials.

name_cn: 具记忆功能的薄膜电致发光器件
name_en: thin-film eletroluminesct'nt device with memory function
explanation_cn: 双绝缘层结构的ZnS:Mn薄膜电致发光器件用电压脉冲序列驱动时，每一脉冲下器件的亮度强烈地受到前一脉冲极性的影响。当相继脉冲的极性相反时，器件亮度显著地增高。反过来，当相继脉冲的极性相同时，则亮度明显降低。因此这种薄膜电致发光器件具有记忆功能。这种薄膜电致发光屏的记忆功能已应用在信息显示上，如发光字符显示屏。
explanation_en: When the ZnS: Mn thin film electroluminescence device with double insulating layer structure is driven by a voltage pulse sequence, the brightness of the device under each pulse is strongly affected by the polarity of the previous pulse. When the polarity of successive pulses is opposite, the brightness of the device increases significantly. Conversely, when the polarity of successive pulses is the same, the brightness decreases significantly. Therefore, the thin film electroluminescence device has a memory function. The memory function of this thin film electroluminescence screen has been applied to information display, such as luminescence character display screen.

explanation_cn: 一般装修用的乳胶漆。乳胶漆即是乳液性涂料，按照基材的不同，分为聚醋酸乙烯乳液和丙烯酸乳液两大类。乳胶漆以水为稀释剂，是一种施工方便、安全、耐水洗、透气性好的涂料，它可根据不同的配色方案调配出不同的色泽。种类:水性内墙漆、油性内墙漆、干粉型内墙漆，属水性涂料，主要由水、乳液、颜料、填料、添加剂五种成分构成。
explanation_en: Latex paint for general decoration. Latex paint is a lotion based coatings, which can be divided into two categories: polyvinyl acetate lotion and acrylic lotion according to the different substrates. With water as the diluents, emulsion paint is a kind of coatings with convenient construction, safety, water resistance and good air permeability. It can be mixed with different colors according to different color schemes. Category: water-based interior wall paint, oil-based interior wall paint, dry powder interior wall paint, belonging to water-borne coating, mainly composed of water, lotion, pigment, filler and additive.

explanation_cn: 通过共聚、接枝、嵌段等化学方法在大分子链上引入其他取代基，或者在分子链上引人短的链段，从而减弱大分子链之间的作用力、破坏链结构的规整性、降低结晶度，从而提高树脂的柔软性、改善加工性、取得类似于外加增塑剂的效果所产生的增塑作用。内增塑作用可克服采用外增塑时常发生的增塑剂迁移现象。例如，氯乙烯与乙酸乙烯酯共聚可以降低聚氯乙烯的刚性、拉伸强度及模量.提高柔软性和加工性。内增塑必须在聚合过程中加人第二改性单体或支链，且得到的树脂使用温度一般较窄。
explanation_en: Through chemical methods such as copolymerization, grafting, block, etc., other substituents are introduced into the macromolecule chain, or short chain segment are introduced into the molecular chain, so as to reduce the force between macromolecule chains, destroy the regularity of chain structure, reduce crystallinity, thereby improving the flexibility of resin, improving the processability, and achieving the effect similar to that of adding plasticizer. Internal plasticization can overcome the migration of plasticizer that often occurs when external plasticization is used. For example, the copolymerization of vinyl chloride and vinyl acetate can reduce the rigidity, tensile strength and modulus of polyvinyl chloride, and improve the flexibility and processability. The second modified monomer or branch chain must be added in the process of polymerization for internal plasticization, and the service temperature of the obtained resin is generally narrow.

explanation_cn: 存在于材料内部.不依赖外加载荷的应力。根据作用范围的大小可分为微观内应力和宏观内应力两类。晶体内存在各种微观缺陷，如点缺陷(空位，间隙原子)、线缺陷(位错)和面缺陷(层错、晶界和孪晶界)。对其周围材料引起弹性畸变，与此相应存在一个内应力场。由于这类畸变存在的范围较小，故这类内应力作用范围小，称为微观内应力。夹杂和第二相周围也存在畸变，故也能产生微观内应力。试样或构件经过不均匀塑性变形后卸载，就会在内部残留有内应力，这类残余应力作用范围较大，称宏观内应力。多种表面加工工艺能在表层产生很高的压缩残余应力，而在试样内部产生较小的拉伸残余应力。焊接也能产生残余应力。构件受热不均匀或各部分热膨胀系数不同，在温度变化时就会在内部产生热应力，它也是一种内应力。加载时内应力和外应力同时起作用。如符号和外应力相反就能抵消一部分外应力从而起好作用，如表面残余压应力能提高疲劳寿命。而拉伸内应力能和外加拉应力叠加，从而促进构件的失效和破坏。
explanation_en: The stress that exists inside the materials and does not depend on the external load. According to the scope of action, it can be divided into micro inner stress and macro inner stress. There are various micro defects in crystal, such as point defect (vacancy, interstitial atom), line defect (dislocation) and plane defect (stacking fault, grain boundary and twin boundary). There is an internal stress field corresponding to the elasticity distortion caused by the surrounding materials. Due to the small range of such distortions, the range of internal stress action is called microscopic internal stress. Distortion also exists around the inclusion and the second phase, so micro internal stress can also be generated. After unloading the sample or component after uneven plastic deformation, there will be residual inner stress in it. This kind of residual stress has a large scope of action, which is called macro inner stress. Multiple surface processing techniques can generate high compressive residual stresses on the surface layer, while generating smaller tensile residual stresses inside the specimen. Weld can also produce residual stress. When the component is heated unevenly or the coefficient of thermal expansion of each part is different, thermal stress will be generated inside when the temperature changes, which is also a inner stress. During loading, both internal and external stresses act simultaneously. If the sign is opposite to the external stress, it can offset part of the external stress and play a good role. For example, the surface residual compressive stress can improve the fatigue life. The internal tensile stress can be superimposed with the external tensile stress, thereby promoting the failure and failure of the component.

explanation_cn: 本质是加热介质的氧势还不足以使基体金属氧化，但氧被工件表面吸收且能溶解在基体金属中，它在向内扩散过程中，遇到与氧的亲和力强的合金元素时，形成氧化物质点，分散地分布基体.形成氧化物弥散强化材料。
explanation_en: Essentially, the oxygen potential of the heating medium is not enough to oxidize the matrix metal, but the oxygen is absorbed by the surface of the workpiece and can be dissolved in the matrix metal. During its inward diffusion, when it encounters alloy elements with strong affinity for oxygen, it forms oxidized material points and dispersedly distributes the matrix, forming oxide dispersion strengthened materials.

explanation_cn: 在垂直板面的拉伸载荷作用下，试件破坏时的最大荷载与试件截面积的比值。
explanation_en: The ratio of the maximum load at the time of specimen failure to the cross-sectional area of the specimen under the tensile load acting on the vertical plate surface.

explanation_cn: 一个非理想弹性固体，它的应力应变不相同，在应力应变循环中有能量耗散，称为内耗。内耗的固体，弹性能的耗散会使振动逐渐衰减而最终终止，此过程成为与时间有关的弛豫现象。
explanation_en: A non ideal elasticity solid, whose stress and strain are different, has energy dissipation in the stress and strain cycle, which is called internal friction. For internal friction solid, the dissipation of elastic energy will make the vibration gradually attenuate and finally terminate, which becomes a time-dependent relaxation phenomenon.

explanation_cn: 胶黏剂或被粘物中发生的目视可见的破坏现象。
explanation_en: Visual damage in adhesive or adherend.

explanation_cn: 又称热力学能。热力学体系内部所包含的一切微观粒子的动能和粒子之间相互作用势能的总和，不包括系统整体机械运动的动能和在外场中的势能。内能为热力学系统的状态函数，与中间经历的过程无关。
explanation_en: Also called thermodynamic energy. The sum of the kinetic energy of all microscopic particles and the potential energy of interaction between particles contained in the thermodynamics system, excluding the kinetic energy of the overall mechanical movement of the system and the potential energy in the external field. Internal energy is the state function of thermodynamics system, independent of the process experienced in the middle.

explanation_cn: 发生在电堆内部的重整。只有高温燃料电池如熔融盐燃料电池和同体氧化物燃料电池才能进行内部重整，因为其电堆的温度足以使重整反应发生。在电堆的燃料流道上涂覆有重整所需催化剂，当燃料进入该流道后与水蒸气反应生成富氢气态化合物，进而为电堆提供所需反应气。除氢气外，富氢气态化合物中的一氧化碳(CO)也可以作为燃料直接在这些燃料电池的阳极被氧化，
explanation_en: Reforming that takes place inside the stack. Only high-temperature fuel cells such as molten salt fuel cells and homogeneous oxide fuel cells can undergo internal reforming, as the temperature of their stacks is sufficient to cause the reforming reaction to occur. The fuel flow fields or flow channels of the stack is coated with the catalyst required for reforming. When the fuel enters the flow fields or flow channels, it reacts with water vapor to generate hydrogen rich gaseous compounds, which then provides the stack with the required reaction gas. In addition to hydrogen, carbon monoxide (CO) in hydrogen rich gaseous compounds can also be directly oxidized on the anode of these fuel cell as fuel,

explanation_cn: 一种Nb3Sn超导线材的制作方法;该方法是预先制备Cu-Nb复合棒材，中心为Cu;在中心Cu位置钻孔，并将Sn棒插人到该孔洞中，然后加工成Cu/Nb-Sn复合棒材。在热处理时，Sn融化后先渗透进Cu中，形成Sn-CU合金，然后通过Sn-Cu合金与Nb反应生成Nb3Sn超导体。利用这种方法制作的超导线材，称为内锡法Nb3Sn超导线材。
explanation_en: A method for making Nb3Sn superconducting wire rod; The method is to pre prepare Cu Nb composition bar with Cu as the center; Drill holes at the central Cu position, insert the Sn bar into the hole, and then process it into Cu/Nb Sn composition bar. During heat treatment, Sn first infiltrates into Cu after melting to form Sn Cu alloy, and then reacts with Nb through Sn Cu alloy to form Nb3Sn superconductor. The superconducting wire rod made by this method is called the internal Tin method Nb3Sn superconducting wire rod.

explanation_cn: 又称返工液。用于去除玻璃基板上的光阻或金属氧化层，从而使玻璃基板可以重新用于使用。要求既能有效去除光阻或氧化物层，又要避免损失其下的玻璃基板。根据去除对象的不同，可分为彩胶和ITO。彩胶一般为含有机溶剂的碱性水溶液，可进一步含有表面活性剂。ITO常用的有以氯化铁为主成分和以王水为主成分的两种。氯化铁为主成分的1TO再生条件温和，腐蚀性小，但易造成铁离子超标;王水为主成分的再生速度快，但对设备腐蚀性大。
explanation_en: Also called rework fluid. It is used to remove the photoresistance or metal oxide layer on the glass substrate, so that the glass substrate can be reused. It is required that the photoresistance or oxide layer can be effectively removed while avoiding the loss of the glass substrate under it. According to the different removal objects, it can be divided into color glue and ITO. Color glue is generally an alkaline aqueous solution containing organic solvents, which can further contain surfactants. There are two commonly used components in ITO: iron chloride as the main component and aqua regia as the main component. The 1TO regeneration conditions with iron chloride as the main component are mild and less corrosive, but it is easy to cause excessive iron ions; The regeneration speed of aqua regia as the main component is fast, but it is highly corrosive to equipment.

explanation_cn: 以天然聚合物为原料，经化学加工制成的、与原聚合物的组成基本相同，而物理结构不完全相同的纤维，属"天然改性人造纤维"。主要品种有：①素纤维。以天然纤维素为原料加工制成的黏胶纤维、铜氨纤维、新溶剂法纤维素纤维，以及以醋酸纤维素酯为原料，经高倍拉伸并经皂化处理的高强度素纤维，商名为福蒂森。②再生蛋白质纤维。以乳酪、大豆、玉米和花生中提取的蛋白质为原料、经湿法纺丝成型的纤维。③甲壳素纤维。以虾、蟹类壳体提取的甲壳素为原料、经湿法纺丝成型的纤维。④海藻纤维。以海藻酸为原料纺制成的纤维。
explanation_en: The fiber made from natural polymer through chemical machining, which has basically the same composition as the original polymer but not completely the same physical structure, belongs to "natural modified man-made fiber". The main varieties include: ① plain fiber. Viscose fiber, cuprammonia fiber, new flux growth method cellulose fiber made from natural cellulose as raw material, and high-strength plain fiber made from cellulose acetate ester, which is highly stretched and saponified, are called Fortison. ② Regenerated protein fiber. The fiber is made from protein extracted from cheese, soybean, corn and peanut by wet spinning. ③ Chitin fiber. The fiber is made from chitin extracted from shrimp and crab shells by wet spinning. ④ Alginmefiber. Fibers made from alginate as raw material.

explanation_cn: 天然改性人造纤维的一类。从木材、棉短绒、植物蒿杆中提取的精制纤维素为原料制得的纤维，其化学组分与使用的原料相同。主要品种有黏胶纤维与铜氨纤维。其有些基本性能（如染色性等）与天然纤维素纤维如棉花、麻类相似。有些（如长丝的外观形状）与天然纤维素纤维不同。纤维的力学性能可随加工工艺的不同在相当宽的范围内进行调节。制造时精制的纤维素原料直接溶解，或生成衍生物纤维素磺酸酯后再用溶剂溶解以制得纺丝液，在从喷丝头细孔中压出后，进入凝固浴中固化成丝经后加工即得成品纤维。所得纤维中纤维素分子的超分子结构和形态结构与原始结构有所不同。这类纤维主要用于制作各种衣着用品、室内装饰用品、轮胎帘子线和医疗用渗析膜等。
explanation_en: A type of natural modified artificial fibers. The chemical composition of the fiber made from refined cellulose extracted from wood, cotton linter and plant artemisia stem is the same as that of the raw material used. The main varieties are viscose fiber and cuprammonia fiber. Some of its basic properties (such as dyeing) are similar to those of natural cellulose fibers such as cotton and hemp. Some (such as the appearance and shape of filamem) are different from natural cellulose fibers. The mechanical properties of fibers can be adjusted over a wide range depending on the processing technology. During manufacturing, the refined cellulose raw material is directly dissolved, or the derivative cellulose sulfonate is generated and then dissolved with solvent to produce spinning solution. After being pressed out of the spinneret pores, it enters the coagulation bath to curing and become silk. After processing, the finished fiber is obtained. The supermolecular structure and morphological structure of cellulose molecule in the obtained fiber are different from the original structure. This type of fiber is mainly used for making various clothing products, indoor decoration products, tire cord, and medical dialysis membranes.

explanation_cn: 废橡胶经化学、热及机械加工处理后，因交联网状结构被破坏而重新形成的可塑化成型的弹性体材料。按照废橡胶分类，再生胶可分为胎类、鞋类、杂胶类。废橡胶的再生方法有：水油法、油法、高压蒸汽法、密炼机法、压出法、动态高温蒸汽法。能部分替代生胶用于橡胶制品，降低成本，缩短混炼时间，降低动力消耗，改善压延、压出半成品的收缩性，改进制品的耐自然老化、耐油、耐酸碱等性能。但再生胶弹性差，抗撕裂性能差，屈挠龟裂大。可用于轮胎、胶管、输送带、自行车胎、胶鞋、胶板等,也可用于油毡、冷贴卷材、防水涂料、密封胶泥等。
explanation_en: After chemical, thermal and mechanical processing of waste rubber, it is a plasticizing elastomer materials that can be re formed due to the destruction of crosslinking network structure. According to the classification of waste rubber, reclaimed rubber can be divided into tire, footwear and miscellaneous rubber. The regeneration methods of waste rubber include water oil method, oil method, high-pressure steam method, internal mixer method, extrusion method and dynamic high-temperature steam method. It can partially replace raw rubber for rubber products, reduce costs, shorten mixing time, reduce power consumption, improve the shrinkage of calendering and pressing semi-finished products, and improve the natural aging resistance, oil resistance, acid and alkali resistance of products. However, the reclaimed rubber has poor elasticity, poor tear resistance, and large flexion and cracking. It can be used for tires, rubber hoses, conveyor belts, bicycle tires, rubber shoes, rubber plates, etc., as well as linoleum, cold bonded coil, water-proof coating, sealing mastic, etc.

explanation_cn: 再生纤维的一个类别。指由从牛奶、大豆等自然物中提取到的蛋白质为原料，溶解于适当溶剂中所制得的纤维，该纤维在20世纪30年代开始实现工业化生产，随着众多合成纤维的问世，其相继停止生产。20世纪90年代又有生产者从牛奶中提取乳酪蛋白，生产"新一代蛋白质纤维"一一酩素纤维。例如，日本东洋纺公司以牛奶为原料与丙烯腈接枝制成再生蛋白纤维。该纤维具有蚕丝般光泽和柔软手感，有较好的吸湿和导湿性、较好的强度和延伸性，是制作内衣的优良材料。国内也开发了大豆蛋白纤维，属于再生蛋白纤维类。采用化学、生物化学的方法从榨掉油脂的大豆渣中提取球状蛋白，通过添加助剂，改变蛋白质空间结构，与聚乙烯醇（PVA)共混制成纺丝原液，经湿法纺丝而成。该纤维单丝纤度细、密度小、强度较高、耐酸耐碱性较好，具有羊绒般的柔软手感、蚕丝般的优雅光泽、棉纤维的吸湿和导湿性及穿着舒适性、羊毛的保暖性。此外，还有蚕蛹蛋白纤维、再生丝素蛋白纤维等。
explanation_en: A category of regenerated fiber. It refers to the fiber made from protein extracted from milk, soybeans and other natural substances as raw materials and dissolved in appropriate solvents. The fiber began to realize industrial production in the 1930s. With the advent of many synthetic fiber, its production stopped one after another. In the 1990s, another producer extracted casein from milk and produced "a new generation of protein fiber" - Moksu fiber. For example, Toyo Textile Company in Japan uses milk as raw material to graft acrylonitrile into regenerated protein fibers. The fiber has silk like luster and soft feel, good moisture absorption and conductivity, good strength and extensibility, and is an excellent materials for making underwear. Soybean protein fibers have also been developed domestically, belonging to the category of regenerated protein fibers. Spherical protein was extracted from soybean dregs with oil extracted by chemical and biochemical methods. By adding additive, the spatial structure of protein was changed, and it was polymer blending with polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) to make spinning stock solution, which was made by wet spinning. The monofilament has fine size, low density, high strength, good acid and alkali resistance, cashmere like soft feel, silk like elegant luster, moisture absorption and moisture conductivity of cotton fiber fiber, wearing comfort and warmth retention of wool. In addition, there are also silkworm pupa protein fibers, regenerated silk fibroin protein fibers, etc.

explanation_cn: 冷加工后的金属在退火时形成新晶粒并长大取代形变组织的现象。再结晶的驱动力是形变储存能，主要结构形式是高密度位错和点缺陷。形成的新晶粒完全取代变形后的晶粒之后，继续加热保温，晶界仍可继续移动，其结果是晶粒的平均尺寸变大，单位体积中的晶粒数目减小。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that the metal after cold working forms new grains and grows up to replace the deformation structure during annealing. The driving force of recrystallization is deformation storage energy, and the main structural forms are high density dislocations and point defects. After the formed new grains completely replace the deformed grains, continue heating and holding, and the grain boundary can still continue to move. As a result, the average size of grains becomes larger, and the number of grains in unit volume decreases.

explanation_cn: 在形变奥氏体完全再结晶温度以上的温度范围进行轧制变形，使形变奥氏体在每一轧制道次变形过程中或道次间传搁过程中发生完全再结晶从而使奥氏体晶粒细化。由于各轧制道次均发生再结晶细化从而可得到十分细小的奧氏体晶粒组织，特别是发生动态再结晶可使再结晶晶粒显著细化，由此使钢材性能明显提高的轧制工艺称为再结晶控制轧制。压低形变奥氏体完全再结晶温度、均热时控制初始奥氏体晶粒的长大、控制每道次的形变量和形变速率以保证发生再结晶特别是动态再结晶、终轧后加速冷却以避免奥氏体晶粒长大，是再结晶控制轧制工艺的重要控制内容。
explanation_en: Rolling deformation shall be carried out in the temperature range above the full recrystallization temperature of deformation austenite, so that the full recrystallization of deformation austenite occurs in the deformation process of each rolling pass or the transfer process between passes, thus refining the austenite grain. Because recrystallization refinement occurs in each rolling pass, very fine austenite grain structure can be obtained. Especially, dynamic recfystallization can significantly refine recrystallization grain, and the rolling process that significantly improves the performance of steel product is called recrystallization controlled rolling. It is an important control content of recrystallization controlled rolling process to reduce the complete recrystallization temperature of deformation austenite, control the growth of initial austenite grains during soaking, control the deformation and deformation rate of each pass to ensure recrystallization, especially dynamic recfystallization, and accelerate cooling after final rolling to avoid grain growth of austenite.

explanation_cn: 具有形变织构的金属（合金）退火经再结晶后形成具有择优取向的新组织，例如体心立方金属线材的为<110>,面心立方为<100>+<111>等。再结晶织构的先决条件是原材料中存在有形变织构，再结晶开始后，迁移速率快的晶界，改变了原形变织构中的局部取向，这些局部取向变化的总和产生再结晶织构。
explanation_en: After annealing and recrystallization, the metal (alloy) with deformation texture forms a new structure with preferred orientation, such as body centered cubic metal wire rod with<110>and face centered cubic metal wire rod with<100>+<111>. The precondition of recrystallization texture is that there is a visible texture in the raw material. After recrystallization starts, the grain boundary with fast migration rate changes the local orientation in the protomorphic texture. The sum of these local orientation changes produces a recrystallization texture.

explanation_cn: 将经冷变形的金属加热到高于再结晶的温度保温适当时间的热处理工艺。其目的是使冷加工产生加工硬化的金厲通过再结晶使晶粒重新成核并长大，成为细小的无形变储能的等轴晶粒，从而消除加工硬化。恢复其冷加工变形能力。金属的温度主要取决于冷变形程度。冷变形程度越小，金属中存在的形变储能越低，再结晶的推动力就越小，因而再结晶温度就越高。金属中含有的第二相及溶质原子有阻碍晶界迁移的作用，故一般会使再结晶温度升高。金属原始晶粒粗大也可使再结晶温度略有升高。由于影响再结晶温度的因素较多，所以再结晶退火的温度通常比理论再结晶温度高100-150°C。
explanation_en: A heat treatment process in which the cold deformed metal is heated to a temperature higher than that of recrystallization for an appropriate period of time. Its purpose is to make the work hardening metal produced by cold work nucleate and grow up again through recrystallization to become small equiaxed grains with invisible change and energy storage, thus eliminating work hardening. Restore its cold working deformability. The temperature of a metal mainly depends on the degree of cold deformation. The smaller the degree of cold deformation, the lower the deformation energy storage in the metal, the smaller the driving force of recrystallization, and therefore the higher the recrystallization temperature. The second phase and solute atoms contained in the metal have the effect of hindering grain boundary migration, so they generally raise the recrystallization temperature. The coarse original grain of metal can also slightly increase the recrystallization temperature. Because there are many factors affecting the recrystallization temperature, the temperature of recrystallization annealing is usually 100-150 ° C higher than the theoretical recrystallization temperature.

explanation_cn: 将聚合物解聚形成的可聚合产物再次进行聚合的反应。
explanation_en: The polymerization product formed by depolymerization of polymer is subjected to polymerization again.

explanation_cn: 军用常规炸药和核炸药的统称。常指前者，即用于军事目的的单体炸药及混合炸药。军用炸药多为同体混合炸药。
explanation_en: Military conventional explosive and nuclear explosive. The former is often referred to as monomer explosive and composite explosive used for military purposes. Military explosive are mostly homogeneous composite explosive.

explanation_cn: 能够使农药在特定的时间白按必要剂持续稳定地到达需要场所。以保证足够持效期的控释材料。一般分为物理咽和化学型两类。物理魁控释材料主要包括四种。一是微胶囊剂。指将原药微粒包裹和固定起来且具有一定包覆强度、能控制释放原药的高分子化合物书透膜胶;二是包结化合物。与原药分子通过氢键、范德华力、偶极矩感应、极化等作用形成不同空间结构的新分子化合物的包结材料;三是吸附性制品。指无机、有机或天然吸附忭载体作为储存体。然后涂以控制件外膜。常用的吸附忭栽体有氧化铝、膨润土、沸石、硅藻土、锯末、离子交换树脂或合成的粒状载体。而外膜或阻滞性物质有聚烯烃类、蜡类或蜡质乳剂等。将原药均匀地分散或溶解于高分子聚合物中，形成固溶体、凝胶体或分散体。化学型控释材料主要是利用原药本身的活性基。在不破坏原化学结构的条件下。与天然或合成高分子化合物直接结合或通过桥联(交联)结合生成络合物或分子化合物。
explanation_en: It can ensure that pesticides can continuously and stably arrive at the required location at a specific time according to the necessary dosage. To ensure that the controlled release materials have sufficient duration. It is generally divided into two types: physical throat and chemical throat. There are four kinds of physical controlled release materials. One is microcapsules. It refers to the macromolecule compound film sealant that wraps and fixes the particles of the original drug and has a certain covering strength and can control the release of the original drug; The second is the inclusion compound. The inclusion materials of new molecular compounds with different spatial structures are formed by hydrogen bond, van der Waals force, dipole moment induction, polarization and other actions with the technical drug molecules; The third is adsorptive products. Refers to inorganic, organic, or natural adsorption carriers as storage materials. Then apply the outer film of the control component. Commonly used adsorptive carriers are aluminum oxide, bentonite, zeolite, diatomite, sawdust, ion exchange resin or synthetic granular carriers. The outer membrane or blocking substances include polyolefins, waxes or waxy emulsions. The technical drug is evenly dispersed or dissolved in macromolecule polymer to form solid solution, gel or dispersion. Chemical controlled release materials mainly use the active groups of the original drug itself. Without damaging the original chemical structure. It can be combined with natural or synthetic macromolecule compounds directly or through bridging (crosslinking) to generate complexes or molecular compounds.

explanation_cn: 冰晶石主要成分为六氟合铝酸钠或氟化铝钠，白色细小的结晶体，无气味，比重为3，硬度2~3，熔点1009摄氏度，易吸水受潮。冰晶石主要用作铝电解的助熔剂，橡胶、砂轮的耐磨填充剂，搪瓷乳白剂，玻璃遮光剂和金属熔剂，农作物的杀虫剂等。Hall—Heroult法是用冰晶石为基的氟化物熔体作溶剂的以生产金属铝的方法，迄今为止还没有发现另一种化合物可以代替冰晶石的。这是因为冰晶石除了能够溶解氧化铝以外还具有其它一些不可缺少的性质，如不含比铝更正电性的元素，稳定性好，在一般条件下不分解、不挥发、不潮解，熔点高于铝，导电性好，节约电量等。可以说，如果没有冰晶石，全世界也许就没有如此大规模的铝工业，价格也就没有这么低，应用也就没有这么广泛。格陵兰西海岸是冰晶石的主要产地，此矿于1987年开采完毕。现时多以萤石人工合成六氟铝酸钠供工业使用。西班牙、俄罗斯和美国也有产出。
explanation_en: Cryolite is mainly composed of sodium hexafluoroaluminate or sodium aluminum fluoride. It is a small white crystal, odorless, with a specific gravity of 3, a hardness of 2-3, and a melting point of 1009 ℃. It is easy to absorb water and moisture. Cryolite is mainly used as flux for aluminum electrolysis, wear-resistant filler for rubber and grinding wheel, enamel opacifying agent, glass shading agent and metal flux, pesticide for crops, etc. The Hall Heroult process is a method of producing metal aluminum with cryolite based fluoride melt as solvent. So far, no other compound has been found that can replace cryolite. This is because cryolite not only can dissolve aluminum oxide, but also has some other indispensable properties. For example, it does not contain elements that are more conductive than aluminum, has good stability, does not decompose, volatilize, or deliquescence under general conditions, has a melting point higher than aluminum, has good conductivity, and saves electricity. It can be said that without cryolite, the world might not have such a large-scale aluminum industry, the price would not be so low, and the application would not be so widespread. The west coast of Greenland is the main source of cryolite, which was mined in 1987. At present, fluorite is mostly used to synthesize sodium hexafluoroaluminate for industrial use. Spain, Russia, and the United States also have output.

explanation_cn: 见方解石。
explanation_en: See Fang Jieshi.

explanation_cn: 测定材料冲击韧性的力学性能试验。是最常规的力学性能试验之一。冲击试验必须按有关标准进行。将单边开V形或U形缺口、表面光洁的10mmX10mmX55mm的长方体试样置于摆锤式冲击试验机上，将摆锤举高，然后释放摆锤冲断试样。则冲断试样所消耗的能量为KV(或KU)。摆锤刀刃半径有2mm和8mm两种，强度高和塑性好的材料?值也高。KV(或KU)是一个对组织非常敏感的性能指标。利用冲击试验评定材料冶金质量和热加工艺质量、评定材料变温脆化倾向等得到了广泛应用。KV(或KU)也是保证构件安全、防止脆断的重要评价指标。但KV(或KU)要求过高必然减小材料强度的使用范围，难以充分发挥材料潜力。KV(或KU)值本身的物理意义也有待进一步研究。
explanation_en: Mechanical property test to determine the impact toughness of materials. It is one of the most conventional mechanical performance tests. Impact test must be carried out according to relevant standards. Place a 10mmX10mmX55mm rectangular sample with a V-shaped or U-shaped notch on one side and a smooth surface on the pendulum impact test machine, lift the pendulum, and then release the pendulum to break the sample. The energy consumed by punching the sample is KV (or KU). There are two kinds of pendulum blade radii: 2mm and 8mm. materials with high strength and good plasticity? The value is also high. KV (or KU) is a highly sensitive performance indicator for organizations. The impact test is widely used to evaluate the metallurgical quality of materials and the quality of hot processing technology, and to evaluate the embrittlement tendency of materials at variable temperature. KV (or KU) is also an important evaluation indicator to ensure component safety and prevent brittle fracture. However, too high KV (or KU) requirements will inevitably reduce the use range of materials strength, and it is difficult to give full play to the potential of materials. The physical significance of the KV (or KU) value itself also needs further research.

explanation_cn: 见冲击强度。
explanation_en: See impact strength.

explanation_cn: 测量复合材料层合板受冲击后剩余强度的试验方法。大多数为测量冲击后的压缩强度。复合材料层合板经受冲击后，不同程度地会出现基体开裂、纤维断裂或分层等损伤，并丧失部分强度，将冲击后的试样再进行压缩试验，测出其剩余强度，以此来估算复合材料的剩余使用寿命，这对确定复合材料的损伤容限和进行损伤容限设计都将提供有价值的参考数据。
explanation_en: Test method for measuring the residual strength of composite materials laminate after impact. Most of them measure the compressive strength after impact. After the impact of composite materials laminate, matrix cracking, fiber fracture or delamination and other damages will occur to varying degrees, and some strength will be lost. The impacted samples will be subjected to compression tests to measure their residual strength, so as to estimate the remaining service life of composite materials, which will provide valuable reference data for determining the damage tolerance of composite materials and conducting damage tolerance design.

explanation_cn: 又称冲击初性。材料力学性能的一个指标.它表征材料（或构件）抵抗冲击破坏的能力，用表示。在一次性冲击试验中，用试样受冲击而破坏时单位面积破断所吸收的能量(klm2)来表示。常用的Charpy试验用^B=Eh[B(W-a)]计算冲击强度，其中Eb是断裂过程吸收的能量，i3、W分别为试样宽度、厚度及缺口深度。材料的冲击强度是一个结构敏感的性能，受材料的成分、工艺、热加工历史、组织结构及其方向性影响，它对于材料内部缺陷状况反应更为敏感，因此可作为判定材料质量，估价材料脆断趋势的指标。但由于测量值与试样尺寸及形状，机械加工精度，冲击加载速度以及试验机特性等均有关，因此实测值波动较大，要同样条件下多次试验取平均值。材料抗冲击能力与环境温度密切相关，在某一温度以下，会出现冲击强度大幅度下降的冷脆现象.体心或密排六方金属中冷脆现象更明显。此外.由于冲击断裂过程包括材料弹性.塑性变形及裂纹扩展三个阶段、因此相同冲击强度的不同材料其实际性能会有很大差别，常需要同时测定冲击载荷-变形曲线以便合理选材。按实际受载情况，常用冲击试验分拉力冲击，扭转冲击和弯曲冲击几类。中国还发展了适用于动载下工作构件的小能量多次冲击试验法.
explanation_en: Also known as initial impact. An indicator of the mechanical properties of materials. It represents the ability of materials (or components) to resist impact damage. In the one-time impact test, it is expressed by the energy absorbed by the unit area breaking when the sample is damaged by impact (klm2). The commonly used Charpy test uses ^ B=Eh [B (W-a)] to calculate the impact strength, where Eb is the energy absorbed in the fracture process, and i3 and W are respectively the width, thickness and notch depth of the sample. The impact strength of materials is a structure sensitive property. Influenced by the composition, process, hot working history, organizational structure and directionality of materials, it is more sensitive to the internal defects of materials, so it can be used as an indicator to judge the quality of materials and evaluate the brittle fracture trend of materials. However, due to the correlation between the measured values and the size and shape of the sample, machining accuracy, impact loading speed, and characteristics of the testing machine, the measured values fluctuate greatly and require multiple tests under the same conditions to take the average value. The impact resistance of materials is closely related to the ambient temperature. Below a certain temperature, the cold brittleness of impact strength will decrease significantly. The cold brittleness is more obvious in body core or closely packed hexagonal metal. In addition, since the impact fracture process includes three stages of materials elasticity, plastic deformation and crack propagation, the actual performance of different materials with the same impact strength will be very different, and it is often necessary to measure the impact load deformation curve at the same time for reasonable material selection. According to the actual loading conditions, the commonly used impact test is divided into tensile impact, torsional impact and bending impact. China has also developed a small energy multiple impact test method suitable for working components under dynamic loads

explanation_cn: 材料表面与腐蚀流体之间由于高速相对运动引起的金属损伤，是流体的冲刷与腐蚀协同作用的结果。
explanation_en: The metal damage caused by high-speed relative movement between surface of materials and corrosion fluid is the result of the synergistic effect of fluid erosion and corrosion.

explanation_cn: 一类正件光敏成像材料。其典型产品是用作正性光致抗浊剂的AZ系列和用作正性胶印版（PS版）的zasd系列等。成像基本原理是通过光照使重氮化合物分解释出氮气.再经分子重排.在有水条件下形成羧酸.因而光照部分可溶解于弱的碱水溶液而成像。实际应州的重氮萘醌类光敏材料是由重氮醌类化合物与线塑酚醛树脂或其他碱溶性高分子反应而成的。由于曝光部分发生了上述光化学反应，增大了碱溶性.因而光照部分会连同高分子一起在显影时溶解。重氮萘醌类光敏材料广泛应用于光致抗蚀剂、PS印刷版材料、全息模压感光材料等。
explanation_en: A kind of positive photosensitive imaging materials. Its typical products are the AZ series used as a positive photo induced anti turbidity agent and the zasd series used as a positive offset printing plate (PS plate). The basic principle of imaging is to decompose diazo compounds into nitrogen gas through light, which is then rearranged by molecules to form carboxylic acids under water conditions. Therefore, the illuminated part can be dissolved in a weak alkaline aqueous solution for imaging. The actual naphthoquinonediazide photosensitive materials in Yingzhou is formed by the reaction of diazo naphthoquinone compounds with linear phenolic resin or other alkali soluble macromolecule. Due to the above photochemical reaction in the exposed part, the alkali solubility is increased, so the light part will be dissolved together with the macromolecule during development. Naphthoquinonediazide photosensitive materials are widely used in photoresist, PS printing plate materials, holographic molding photographic materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 由含有固体粒子的流体冲击（冲刷）而造成固体表面物质流失的磨损现象。根据固体粒子及其携带介质的不同冲蚀磨损可分为气-固冲蚀磨损、液-固冲蚀磨损（或浆体冲蚀磨损）、液滴冲蚀磨损和气蚀磨损等。在自然界和工业、矿山生产中，存在着大量的冲蚀磨损现象。例如物料输送管道中物料对管道的冲蚀、锅炉管道被燃烧的粉尘冲蚀、喷砂机喷嘴受砂粒的冲蚀、泥浆泵中泥浆对泵体和叶轮的冲蚀、直升飞机螺旋桨受空气中灰尘.冲蚀、火箭发动机尾部受燃气冲蚀等同时也可应用冲蚀磨损的原理对机器零件表面进行淸理和强化.如喷砂、喷丸等。影响冲蚀磨损的主要W素有：被冲蚀材料的成分、组织与性能、磨粒的形状、尺寸与性能、磨粒的冲蚀速度、冲蚀角度以及环境因素等。
explanation_en: The wear phenomenon of solid surface material loss caused by the impact (scouring) of fluid containing solid particles. Erosive wear can be divided into gas-solid erosive wear, liquid-solid erosive wear (or slurry erosive wear), liquid drop erosive wear and cavitation wear according to different solid particles and their carrying media. In nature, industry and mine production, there are a lot of erosive wear phenomenon. For example, the erosion of materials in the material conveying pipeline to the pipeline, the erosion of boiler pipes by combustion dust, the erosion of grit blasting machine nozzles by sand particles, the erosion of mud in the mud pump to the pump body and impeller, the dust and erosion of helicopter propellers in the air, and the erosion of rocket engine tail by combustion gas can also be used to clean and strengthen the surface of machine parts, such as grit blasting, shot blasting, etc. The main W factors affecting erosive wear are: the composition, structure and properties of erosion materials, the shape, size and properties of abrasive particles, erosion speed of abrasive particles, erosion angle and environmental factors.

explanation_cn: 又称化铁炉.一种培炼铸铁的圆筒形竖炉。III炉体支撑部分（炉基、炉腿、炉底门）、炉体（炉底、炉缸.炉身)、炉顶（烟囱、除尘器）、送风系统（鼓风机、风管、风带、风口及前炉等组成。与电弧炉、感应电炉、反射炉等设备相比，冲天炉具有结构简单、操作方便、熔化迅速、适应性强、可连续生产和成本低廉等优点；ff_l用冲天炉熔炼铸铁提温和调整化学成分较为闲难.合金烧损较大，故有吋也采用冲天炉和电炉双联熔炼，使其优势互补。冲天炉熔炼铸铁可分为三个过程：焦炭燃烧过程；金属炉料的预热、熔化及铁水过热过程；炉气、炉渣、铁水、焦炭的相互作用过程。冲天炉的公称吨位为每小时熔化铁水的吨数.名义直径为熔化带的炉膛内径。
explanation_en: Also called cupola, it is a cylindrical shaft furnace for smelting cast iron. III Furnace body support part (furnace base, furnace legs, furnace bottom door), furnace body (furnace bottom, furnace hearth, furnace body), furnace top (chimney, dust collector) Air supply system (Composed of blower, air duct, air belt, tuyere and front furnace, etc. Compared with electric arc furnace, induction electric furnace, reverberatory furnace and other equipment, the cupola has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, rapid melting, strong adaptability, continuous production and low cost; it is more difficult to improve the temperature of cast iron and adjust the chemical composition with cupola melting, and alloy burning loss is large, so the cupola and electric furnace double melting are also used to complement each other's advantages The melting of cast iron in the furnace can be divided into three processes: coke combustion process; Preheating and melting of metal charge and overheating of molten iron; Interaction process of furnace gas, slag, molten iron and coke. The nominal tonnage of the cupola is the tonnage of molten iron per hour. The nominal diameter is the inner diameter of the furnace of the melting zone.

explanation_cn: 研究从矿石中提取金属或金|属化合物，以不同加工方法制成具有一定性能的金属材料的学科。的领域一般可分为两种：①提取或称化学;②物理。前者用不同的化学方法，从金属矿石中提取金属，还包括金属精炼成工业可用的纯度。后者研究金属本身或金属化合物的由来，通过合金化、形变和热处理生产新产品或改进产品性能包括机械加工、轧制、弯曲、拉拔、铸造和粉末黑色金属冶金和非铁冶金（有色冶金)。
explanation_en: The discipline of extracting metals or gold compounds from ores and making metallic materials with certain properties by different processing methods. The fields can generally be divided into two types: ① extraction or chemistry; ② Physics. The former uses different chemical methods to extract metals from metal ores, and also includes refining metals to industrial purity. The latter studies the origin of metal itself or metal compounds, and produces new products or improves product properties through alloy, deformation and heat treatment, including machining, rolling, bending, drawing, foundry and powder ferrous metallurgy and non iron metallurgy (non-ferrous metallurgy).

explanation_cn: 用化学动力学原理及宏观动力学方法研究冶金过程中的反应机理和速率，分析冶金反应路径及控制环节的学科。它是冶金过程物理化学的一个分支。其内容包括：①微观动力学。从分子理论角度研究冶金反应速率理论，以及吸附、催化、扩散等唯象定律在冶金中的应用。②宏观动力学。研究伴随有物质、热能及动量传递现象存在下的反应速率和机理。当结合反应器研究冶金反应的热力学和宏观动力学时，则形成冶金反应工程学。研究是提高冶金过程的冶炼强度、缩短冶炼时间、提高冶金产品质量、促进冶金工业自动化、探讨和开发冶金新技术及新流程的重要手段。
explanation_en: The discipline of studying the reaction mechanism and rate in metallurgical process, analyzing the metallurgical reaction path and control link by using chemical kinetics principle and macro dynamics method. It is a branch of physical chemistry of metallurgy process. Its content includes: ① Microdynamics. The theory of metallurgical reaction rate and the application of phenomenological laws such as adsorption, catalysis and diffusion in metallurgy are studied from the perspective of molecular theory. ② Macrodynamics. Study the reaction rate and mechanism in the presence of material, thermal energy, and momentum transfer phenomena. When thermodynamics and macro kinetics of metallurgical reaction are studied in combination with reactor, metallurgical reaction engineering is formed. Research is an important means to improve the smelting intensity of metallurgical process, shorten the smelting time, improve the quality of metallurgical products, promote the automation of metallurgical industry, and explore and develop new metallurgical technologies and processes.

explanation_cn: 应用热力学基本原理.研究冶金过程中宏观变化规律的学科。它是冶金过程物理化学的一个分支，其主要内容包括：确定冶金体系状态变化前后能量的变化关系;确定冶金反应进行的条件和方向；确定冶金反应达到平衡的条件，反应进行的影响因素和限度，计算反应的最大产出率等。
explanation_en: The discipline of applying the basic principles of thermodynamics to study the macro change laws in metallurgical processes. It is a branch of physical chemistry of metallurgy process. Its main contents include: determining the change relationship of energy before and after the change of metallurgical system state; Determine the conditions and direction of metallurgical reactions; Determine the conditions for achieving equilibrium in metallurgical reactions, the influencing factors and limits of the reaction, and calculate the maximum output rate of the reaction.

explanation_cn: 简称冶金物化。应用物理化学的原理和方法，研究冶金过程（包括从矿石转变成金属或其化合物产品的全部冶炼过程）中的物理变化和化学反应规律的学科。研究目的在于指导冶金过程.探讨改进现有工艺和建立新工艺的理论基础最终达到提高金属材料的质量、产出率以及获得创新品种。主要研究内容有：冶金过程热力学、冶金过程动力学、冶金与材料电化学、冶金熔体（溶液）理论、计算冶金物理化学和材料物理化学等。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as metallurgical physicochemical. The discipline of applying the principles and methods of physical chemistry to study the laws of physical changes and chemical reactions in metallurgical processes (including all smelting processes of transformation ore into metal or its compound products). The purpose of the research is to guide the metallurgical process, explore the theoretical basis for improving the existing process and establishing a new process, so as to ultimately improve the quality and yield of metallic materials and obtain innovative varieties. The main research contents include: thermodynamics of metallurgyprocess, kinetics of metallurgy process, metallurgy and materials electrochemistry, metallurgical melt (solution) theory, computational metallurgy physical chemistry and materials physical chemistry, etc.

explanation_cn: 适合于制作在常温（即不与热金属接触）下对钢及其他金属合金进行变形加工的模具（如下料模、冲裁模、弯曲模、剪切模、冷镦模、冷挤压模等）用的工具钢。冷作模具钢要求具有高的硬度和耐磨性、高的强度和疲劳强度以及足够的韧性，还要具有良好的工艺性能。如锻造性、切削加工性、淬透性、淬硬性等，且热处理变形小以保证模具尺寸精度。非合金工具钢如T10A、T12A可用于制作形状简单、承载不大的小型模具，以及要求硬化层深度不大的冷镦模；合金工具钢用于制作形状复杂、承载较大的大中型模具。
explanation_en: It is suitable for making tool steel for deformation processing of steel and other metal alloy at room temperature (i.e. not contacting with hot metal) (such as the following material die, blanking die, bending die, shear die, cold heading die, cold extrusion die, etc.). Cold working die steel is required to have high hardness and wear resistance, high strength and fatigue strength, sufficient toughness, and good process performance. Such as forging, machinability, hardenabilhy, hardenability, etc., and heat treatment deformation is small to ensure the dimensional accuracy of the mold. Non alloy tool steel such as T10A and T12A can be used to make small dies with simple shape and small bearing capacity, as well as cold heading dies requiring a small depth of hardening layer; Alloy tool steel is used to make large and medium-sized molds with complex shapes and large loads.

explanation_cn: 参见荧光和磷光。
explanation_en: See Fluorescence and phosphorescence.

explanation_cn: 指在粉末冶金工艺中，将由颗粒组成的松散粉末在室温下在一定压力下压制成具有一定形状、尺寸、强度、密度的坯体。冷压有单向、双向两种单轴向力加载方式。
explanation_en: In the powder metallurgy process, loose powder composed of particles is pressed into a green body with a certain shape, size, strength and density under a certain pressure at room temperature. There are two single axial force loading modes of one-way and two-way in cold pressing.

explanation_cn: 当燃料电池系统中各部件和外界环境达到热平衡时启动燃料电池系统。
explanation_en: Start the fuel cell system when the components in the fuel cell system reach the thermal balance with the external environment.

explanation_cn: 又称冷气动力喷涂，它是一种以压缩空气加速金属粒子到临界速度(超声速），金属粒子直击到基体表面后发生物理形变形成涂层的工艺。与各种热喷涂技术相比，冷喷涂作为一种低温喷涂方式，具有适用范围广；喷涂温度低：涂层结合力高、致密、孔隙率低：送粉速度快，喷涂效率高，沉积效率高；无辐射的噪声危害，操作简便安全等优点。
explanation_en: Also known as cold air power spraying, it is a process that uses compressed air to accelerate the metal particles to a critical speed (ultrasonic speed), and the metal particles directly hit the surface of the matrix to form a coating after physical deformation. Compared with various thermal spraying technologies, gas dynamic cold spray, as a low-temperature spraying method, has a wide range of applications; Low spraying temperature: high adhesion, density, and low porosity of the coating; fast powder feeding speed, high spraying efficiency, and high deposition efficiency; The advantages of no radiation noise hazards, easy and safe operation, etc.

explanation_cn: 是用稀释剂(汽油、柴油、煤油、苯等）对沥青进行稀释的产物。其多在常温下用于防水工程的底层，故称冷底子油。
explanation_en: It is the product of diluting pitch with diluents (gasoline, diesel, kerosene, benzene, etc.). It is mostly used as the bottom layer of waterproof works under normal temperature, so it is called adhesive hitumen primer.

explanation_cn: 以超过屈服强度而又小于极限强度的拉应力拉伸金属或高分子材料，使其在成颈后形产生塑性变形的过程叫冷拉。冷拉过程中，试样的伸长表现为一个截面尺寸稳定的颈缩段沿试样不断扩展，直至整个试样成为颈缩状态。
explanation_en: The process of stretching a metal or macromolecule materials with a tensile stress that exceeds the yield strength but is less than the ultimate strength to produce plastic deformation after necking is called cold drawing. In the process of cold drawing, the elongation of the sample shows that a necking section with stable section size expands continuously along the sample until the whole sample becomes necking.

explanation_cn: 在常温或低于材料的黏流温度下，塑料、橡胶、金属等固体在低应力或自重作用下随时间而发展形变，且去除应力后不能恢复原形的变形现象。其本质是分子间的黏性滑动。塑料在玻璃化转变温度以下的蠕变也属冷流，在使用塑料时需充分考虑这一点。聚四氟乙烯的冷流较为明显。冷加工是利用材料冷流性质的成型方法。
explanation_en: At room temperature or lower than the viscous flow temperature of materials, plastics, rubber, metal and other solids develop deformation with time under the action of low stress or self weight, and can not restore the original shape after stress removal. Its essence is the viscous sliding between molecules. The creep of plastics below the glass transition temperature also belongs to cold flow, which should be fully considered when using plastics. The cold flow of polylctrafluorocthylone is obvious. Cold working is a forming method that utilizes the cold flow property of materials.

explanation_cn: 由对欲遮蔽/干扰电磁波有吸收、散射等作用的材料组成，布撒在空中形成气溶胶烟幕的过程中，冷烟幕剂不发生化学变化，无热量放出。典型的冷烟幕剂有鳞片状黄铜粉、各种碳材料、镀金属的鳞片、空心微球或碳纤维等。特点为烟幕材料无毒，副作用小。使用时根据欲干扰电磁波的波长制成一定尺寸的烟幕材料，用爆炸或喷气的方式将其分散在空中形成烟幕，用以遮蔽或干扰可见光、红外光、激光、雷达等对目标的探测。
explanation_en: It is composed of materials that can absorb and scatter electromagnetic waves to be shielded/interfered with. During the process of spreading in the air to form aerosol smoke screen, cool smoke composition does not undergo chemical changes and does not emit heat. Typical cool smoke composition includes scaly copper powder, various carbon materials, metal plated scales, hollow microsphere or carbon fibers. It is characterized by non-toxic smoke materials and small side effects. When in use, smoke materials of certain size are made according to the wavelength of the electromagnetic wave to be interfered with, and they are dispersed in the air by explosion or air jet to form smoke screens, which are used to shield or interfere with the detection of targets by visible light, infrared light, laser, radar, etc.

explanation_cn: 通过控制绕注后的冷却速度，使其表层快冷而形成一定深度的白口组织，而心部则保持灰口组织，中间过渡层为麻口组织的耐磨铸铁。表层白口组织具有较高的硬度和耐磨性，而心部灰口组织提供了适当的韧性和减震性能。化学成分对冷硬铸铁的硬度和白口层深度影响较大，提高碳含量可使白口层硬度提高但降低白口层深度，而升高硅含量则降低白口层深度，冷硬铸铁多采用高碳低硅成分，并加入适当合金元素调整白口层硬度、深度及整体强韧性。根据化学成分的不同，可分为普通冷硬铸铁、镍铬钼冷硬铸铁、铬钼稀土冷硬铸铁、硼冷硬铸铁等。冷硬铸铁属于耐磨铸铁，适于制作工作表面要求具有高硬度和耐磨性、其余部分则需要具有一定强度和韧性的零件，如轧辊、车轮、犁铧等。
explanation_en: By controlling the cooling rate after coiling injection, the surface layer is rapidly cooled to form a certain depth of white structure, while the center part maintains a gray structure, and the middle transition layer is a wear resistance cast iron with a pockmarked structure. The white structure in the surface layer has higher hardness and wear resistance, while the gray structure in the center provides appropriate toughness and shock absorption performance. The chemical composition has a greater impact on the hardness and the depth of the white layer of chilled cast iron. Increasing the carbon content can increase the hardness of the white layer but reduce the depth of the white layer, while increasing the silicon content will reduce the depth of the white layer. chilled cast iron mostly uses high carbon and low silicon composition, and adds appropriate alloy elements to adjust the hardness, depth and overall strength and toughness of the white layer. According to the different chemical composition, it can be divided into ordinary chilled cast iron, nickel chromium molybdenum chilled cast iron, chromium molybdenum rare earth chilled cast iron, boron chilled cast iron, etc. Chilled cast iron belongs to wear resistance cast iron, which is suitable for making work surfaces that require high hardness and wear resistance, while the rest of the parts need to have certain strength and toughness, such as roll, wheels, plowshares, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称铆螺钢。适宜于采用冷镦加工成型工艺生产互换性较高的标准件的结构钢棒材或线材。冷镦钢生产零件时，需承受很大的压缩比，故要求具有非常良好的塑性及表面质量和冶金质量。冷镦钢丝（GB/T 6478-2001，GB/T 5953.1-2009)分为热处理型（表面硬化型和调质型）、非热处理型及非调质型，冷镦不锈钢丝（GB/T 4232-2009)则分为软态和轻拉态。冷镦钢采用成分钢号前加字母ML(表示铆螺），多采用优质非合金结构钢和优质合金结构钢，需要较高耐蚀性的零件则采用不锈钢。在汽车、机床等机械制造部门广泛采用冷镦钢生产标准件及其他零件，如铆钉、螺栓、销钉和螺母等。
explanation_en: It is also called riveted screw steel. It is suitable for structural steel bar or wire rod with high interchangeability produced by cold heading process. When cold heading steel is used to produce parts, it needs to bear a large compression ratio, so it is required to have very good plasticity, surface quality and metallurgical quality. Cold heading wire (GB/T 6478-2001, GB/T 5953.1-2009) is divided into heat treatment type (surface hardening type and quenching and tempering type), non heat treatment type and non quenching and tempering type, and cold heading stainless steel wire (GB/T 4232-2009) is divided into soft state and light drawing state. The cold heading steel is composed of steel designation preceded by the letter ML (for rivet bolt). High quality non alloy structural steel and high quality alloy structural steel are mostly used. Parts requiring high corrosion resistance are made of stainless steel. Cold heading steel is widely used to produce standard parts and other parts, such as rivets, bolts, pins and nuts, in machinery manufacturing departments such as automobiles and machine tools.

explanation_cn: 理想的场发射冷阴极材料应具有低的开启电压、高的发射电流密度、抗辐射、温度稳定性好等特点。最初的场发射冷阴极是由金属（如Mo、W)以及半导体(如Si)做成场发射体阵列（FEA)而制成的，但是由于它们都存在以下的缺陷：①大面积制备均匀的发射体尖端阵列工艺较为复杂；②材料本身的高逸出功导致了高的工作电压；③阵列尖端在高电容易受损伤；④工作时的真空度要求高，否则阴极的寿命会大大缩短，使得应用性受到限制。目前场发射冷阴极的研究与应用主要集中在碳基材料包括金刚石和类金刚石（DLC)、碳纳米管（CNTs)等领域，尤其是CNTs由于其独特的纳米结构表现出优良的场发射性能。
explanation_en: The ideal field emission cold cathode materials should have the characteristics of low opening voltage, high emission current density, radiation resistance and good temperature stability. The initial field emission cold cathode was made of metal (such as Mo, W) and semiconductor (such as Si) as field emitter arrays (FEA), but they all had the following defects: ① the process of preparing uniform emitter tip arrays on a large area was relatively complex; ② The high output power of materials itself leads to high working voltage; ③ The array tip is prone to damage at high electricity levels; ④ The vacuum requirement during operation is high, otherwise the lifespan of the cathode will be greatly shortened, limiting its applicability. At present, the research and application of field emission cold cathode are mainly focused on carbon based materials, including diamond, diamond like carbon (DLC), carbon nanotube (CNTs) and other fields, especially CNTs because of their unique nanostructures show excellent field emission properties.

explanation_cn: 金属铸件中在金属液流汇合处产生的熔合不完善或不连续的一种铸造缺陷。其特征为铸件上出现穿透或不穿透的接缝，铸件中多出现在远离浇口的宽大上平面和薄壁处或激冷部位，而在水平连铸坯表面上则呈现周期性、等距离的环状痕迹。冷隔处凝固组织呈树枝状，并与相邻组织呈直角方向生长。
explanation_en: A casting defect in a metal casting, which is caused by incomplete or discontinuous fusion at the junction of liquid metal flow. Its characteristic is the presence of penetrating or non penetrating joints on the casting, which often occur in the wide upper plane and thin-walled areas or chilled areas far from the gate, while periodic and equidistant circular marks appear on the surface of horizontal continuous casting billets. The solidified tissue at the cold junction is dendritic and grows at right angles to adjacent tissues.

explanation_cn: 通过物理相互作用将高分子链间彼此交联形成的可逆网络，在溶剂中可以溶解、加热可以熔融。高分子物质由溶胶转成凝胶（亦称冻胶）的过程，亦称胶凝作用。凝胶是一种特殊的分散体系，其中高分子分子胶体颗粒相互连接，形成空间网状结构，形成凝胶可使用适当浓度的凝结剂，胶凝粒子有一定的去溶剂化程度，使溶质形成有一定网状结构的凝晈代替不规则的凝胶。
explanation_en: The reversible network formed by crosslinking between macromolecule chains through physical interaction can be dissolved in solvent, heated and melted. The process of macromolecule material changing from sol to gel (also called jelly) is also called gelation. Gel is a special dispersion system, in which macromolecule molecular colloidal particles are interconnected to form a spatial network structure. Appropriate concentration of coagulant can be used to form gel, and the gelled particles have a certain degree of desolvation, so that the solute can form a certain network structure to replace the irregular gel.

explanation_cn: 准固态电解质是指添加到液态电解质中的凝胶剂（胶凝剂）分子在一定条件下互相联结并形成空间网络结构，液态电解质作为介质填充在该网络结构中，所形成的物质形态介于同态和液态之间的凝胶态电解质。准间态电解质的形态可以在黏稠胶状到具有一定硬度的同体之间变化，其兼具液态和固态电解质的性质，不流动，具有一定形状。导电机制类似液态电解质。凝胶剂（胶凝剂）的种类目前有高分子聚合物、有机小分子化合物和纳米粒子等。凝胶剂（胶凝剂）能够在液体电解质体系中通过物理相互作用或者通过化学反应交联形成空间网络结构，根椐凝胶剂（胶凝剂）的种类不同，通常可以将准固态电解质分为三类，即聚合物凝胶电解质、有机小分子凝胶电解质和添加纳米粒子的凝胶电解质；根据凝胶剂（胶凝剂）的交联方式可分为物理交联凝胶电解质和化学交联凝胶电解质。
explanation_en: Quasi solid elonrolyte refers to the gel agent (gelling agent) molecules added to the liquid elonrolyte under certain conditions connect with each other and form a spatial network structure. The liquid elonrolyte is filled in the network structure as a medium, forming a gelled elonrolyte with a material form between the homomorphic and liquid state. The morphology of quasi interstitial electrolyte can change from viscous gel to the same body with a certain hardness. It has the properties of both liquid and solid electrolyte, does not flow, and has a certain shape. The conduction mechanism is similar to that of liquid elonrolyte. At present, the types of gel (gelling agents) include macromolecule polymer, organic small molecular compounds and nanoparticles. Gel agent (gelling agent) can form a spatial network structure in the liquid elonrolyte system through physical interaction or chemical reaction crosslinking. According to the different types of gel agent (gelling agent), quasi solid elonrolyte can generally be divided into three categories, namely polymer gel elonrolyte, organic small molecule gel elonrolyte and gel elonrolyte with nano particles added; According to the crosslinking mode of gel agent (gelling agent), it can be divided into physical crosslinking gel elonrolyte and chemical crosslinking gel elonrolyte.

explanation_cn: 准晶是准周期性晶体的简称，它比非晶态有序性要高，但它具有晶体所不具有的二十面体为基的对称点群。对急冷的Al6Mn合金进行电子衍射研究，发现它具有二十面体的对称性（包含有五重轴）。目前已在Al-Fe、A1-Cr和Ti-Ni-V等数十个合金体系中用快冷、铸造、喷涂、离子轰击等多种方法获得准晶。实验表明，用淬火制备准晶材料时冷却速度必须合适，如冷却过慢，很难得到准晶的二十面体相;如冷却速度太慢，则形成一般晶体结构。
explanation_en: Quasicrystal is the abbreviation of quasi periodic crystal, which has higher order than amorphous state, but it has an icosahedral based symmetric point group that crystal does not have. The quenched Al6Mn alloy has been studied by electron diffraction. It is found that it has icosahedral symmetry (including five fold axis). At present, quasicrystals have been obtained in dozens of alloy systems such as Al Fe, A1 Cr and Ti-Ni-V by various methods such as rapid cooling, foundry, spraying, ion bombardment, etc. The experimental results show that the cooling rate must be appropriate when preparing quasicrystalline materials by quenching. If the cooling rate is too slow, it is difficult to obtain the icosahedral phase of quasicrystals; If the cooling rate is too slow, a general crystal structure will be formed.

explanation_cn: 原子结构不同于晶态和非晶态的一种新迆镁基材料。因其独特的结构而具有特殊的性能。纯的材料在室温下特别的脆而硬，很难单独作为结构材料使用，但它们具有的高硬度、低热膨胀系数、低界面能、超低摩擦系数、良好耐蚀性能以及与镁合金基体润湿性好的特性使其特别适合作为镁合金基体材料中的强化相。研究表明，利用镁基准晶相强化镁合金可以提高镁合金的力学、耐热和耐浊性能，开发各种含准晶的高性能镁基材料。
explanation_en: A new Mg based materials whose atomic structure is different from that of crystalline and amorphous states. Due to its unique structure, it has special performance. Pure materials are particularly brittle and hard at room temperature, and it is difficult to use them as structural materials alone. However, their high hardness, low coefficient of thermal expansion, low interface energy, ultra-low friction coefficient, good corrosion resistance and good wettability with the matrix of magnesium alloy make them particularly suitable as strengthening phase in the materials of magnesium alloy matrix.
