The research shows that strengthening alloy with magnesium reference crystal phase can improve the mechanical, heat and turbidity resistance of alloy, and develop various high-performance magnesium based materials containing quasicrystals.

explanation_cn: 准粒子的概念是为简化多体问题而引入的方法之一。它把系统中具有一定能量、动量，并且能量和动量满足某种色散律的稳定激发称为准粒子，把有强相互作用的系统简化成由准粒子组成的系统，如固体被视为声子系统（声子气体），金属中的自由电子被视为电子系统（电子气体），平衡辐射场被视为光子系统（光子气体）。准粒子类似于在相互作用粒子系统中的一个实体，当实体中的一个粒子在系统中穿行并朝着一定方向运动，环绕该粒子的其他粒子云闪为其间的相互作用而脱离原有的运动轨迹，或者"被拖拽着向某个方向运动"，从宏观上看来，这一系统就像一个自由运动着的整体。也就是一个"准粒子"。在物理学中，准粒子或称集体激发，即相互作用多体系统的类粒子集体激发。准粒子也可以称为元激发。朗道（Landau)的费米(Fermi)液体理论指出，有相互作用的系统的能级可以按照与无相互作用粒子同样的量子数加以分类。相互作用粒子态称为准粒子态或元激发态。
explanation_en: The concept of quasi particle is one of the methods introduced to simplify many body problems. It calls the stable excitation with certain energy and momentum in the system, and the energy and momentum meet a certain dispersion law as quasi particle. It simplifies the system with strong interaction into a system composed of quasi particle. For example, the solid is regarded as a phonon system (phonon gas), the free electrons in the metal are regarded as an electronic system (electronic gas), and the balanced radiation field is regarded as a photon system (photonic gas). Quasi particle is similar to an entity in an interacting particle system. When a particle in the entity passes through the system and moves in a certain direction, other particle clouds around the particle flash away from the original motion track for the interaction between them, or are "dragged to move in a certain direction". From a macro perspective, this system is like a free moving whole. That is, a "quasi particle". In physics, quasi particle or collective excitation refers to the collective excitation of quasi particles in interacting multi body systems. Quasi particle can also be called meta excitation. Landau's Fermi liquid theory points out that the energy level of the interacting system can be classified according to the same quantum number as the non interacting particles. The interacting particle state is called a quasi particle state or a meta excited state.

explanation_cn: 采用一定的方法在光伏玻璃表面镀制一层带宽小于400nm的减反射膜。其特性是该玻璃表面具有比较低的反射率，高的光透过率。
explanation_en: A anti reflecting film with a bandwidth of less than 400 nm is coated on the surface of solar photovoltaic glass by a certain method. Its characteristic is that the glass surface has relatively low reflectivity and high light transmittance.

explanation_cn: 又称增透膜。根据薄膜干涉原理制成的减弱或消除反射光的光学薄膜。
explanation_en: Also known as antireflective film. A optical coating made according to the film interference principle to weaken or eliminate reflected light.

explanation_cn: 见减振阻尼材料。
explanation_en: See vibration damping materials.

explanation_cn: 又称固化理论，研究物质从液态转变为同态的相变过程的理论。通常情况下，从液态转变为晶态物质的过程称为凝固或结晶;从液态转变为非晶态物质的过程称为固化或玻璃态转变。
explanation_en: Also known as consolidation theory, it studies the phase transformation process of substances from liquid transformation to homomorphism. Generally, the process of transforming from liquid transformation crystalline material is called solidification or crystallization; The process of changing from a liquid transformation to an amorphous substance is called curing or glassy state transformation.

explanation_cn: 由火山喷发时形成的粒径<2mm的晶屑、玻屑、岩屑等火山碎屑物经压实固结形成的一种岩石火山碎屑岩。胶结物主要是更细的火山灰》具多种颜色.常见有灰白、灰、灰绿、黄白、白、浅紫、灰紫、灰黑色等。外观多具粗糙感。按碎屑成分分为晶屑凝灰岩、玻屑凝灰岩、岩屑凝灰岩和复屑凝灰岩。按化学成分为玄武质凝灰岩、安山质凝灰岩、英安质凝灰岩、流纹质凝灰岩和粗面质凝灰岩。与凝灰岩有关的矿产有铜、铁、黄铁矿、铀和钾、硼、沸石等。有些凝灰岩由于孔隙较多，是很好的轻质而坚硬的建筑材料。一些富玻屑的酸性凝灰岩是很好的水泥混合原料。少数坚硬度适中(硬度3-4),粒度细而均匀(<0.01mm),致密细腻裂隙少的蚀变凝灰岩是名贵玉石的材料。如浙江有名的青田石，昌化的鸡血石，主要是蚀变的流纹质凝灰岩，因颜色多彩.硬度适中，可加工性好，质地均匀细腻，并含有叶蜡石、绢云母、硬铝石等矿物.是玉雕业的上等原料。凝灰岩蚀变后还可以形成高岭土、膨润土等多种黏土矿床。中国凝灰岩丰富，主要分布在东部地区。
explanation_en: It is a rock pyroclastic rock formed by compaction and consolidation of crystal chips, glass chips, rock chips and other pyroclastic materials with particle size less than 2mm formed during volcanic eruption. The cementitious material mainly consists of finer volcanic ash, which has various colors. Common colors include gray white, gray, gray green, yellow white, white, light purple, gray purple, gray black, etc. The appearance is often rough. According to the detrital composition, it can be divided into crystalline tuff, glassy tuff, lithic tuff and complex tuff. According to chemical composition, it is basaltic tuff, andesitic tuff, dacitic tuff, rhyolitic tuff and trachytic tuff. The minerals related to tuff include copper, iron, pyrite, uranium, potassium, boron, zeolite, etc. Some tuff is a good light and hard building materials due to its many pores. Some acid tuff rich in glass chips is a good raw material for cement mixing. A few altered tuff with moderate hardness (hardness 3-4), fine and uniform particle size (<0.01mm) and few dense and fine cracks is the materials of precious jade. For example, the famous Qingtian stone in Zhejiang Province and the chicken-bloodstone in Changhua are mainly altered rhyolitic tuff. Because of their colorful color, moderate hardness, good processability, uniform and fine texture, and containing pyrophyllite, seridte, diaspore and other minerals, they are superior raw materials for jade carving industry. After alteration of tuff, various clay deposits such as kaolin and bentonite can also be formed. China is rich in tuff, which is mainly distributed in the east.

explanation_cn: 凝聚态物理是研究物质在其凝聚态（包括固态和液态）下的物理性质的学科。它涵盖了多个子领域，其中主要包括晶体学、金属物理、半导体物理、磁学、电介质物理、低温物理、高压物理、发光学、表面物理、非晶态物理、液晶物理、低维体系物理、强关联系统物理以及软物质物理等。凝聚态物理的研究范围包括实验和理论两个方面，以深入了解物质性能与微观结构之间的内在联系，以及外界条件对物质性质的影响。这一学科在材料科学领域发挥着重要作用，为众多材料的发明和技术突破提供了关键支持。
explanation_en: Condensed matter physics is a subject that studies the physical properties of matter in its condensed state (including solid and liquid). It covers a number of sub fields, including crystallography, metal physics, semiconductor physics, magnetism, dielectric physics, low-temperature physics, high-pressure physics, luminescence, surface physics, amorphous physics, liquid crystal physics, low dimensional system physics, strongly correlated system physics and soft matter physics. The research scope of condensed matter physics includes both experimental and theoretical aspects to deeply understand the internal relationship between material properties and microstructure, as well as the influence of external conditions on material properties. This discipline plays an important role in the field of materials science, providing key support for the invention and technological breakthrough of many materials.

explanation_cn: 柔软而具有一定强度，在溶剂中不溶解、加热不熔融的轻度交联的高分子。
explanation_en: A soft, slightly crosslinking macromolecule with certain strength, insoluble in solvent and non melting when heated.

explanation_cn: 是指在氯丁二烯单体乳液聚合过程中不使用分子量调节剂，得到分子量较大、支链较多且无法溶于有机溶剂的凝胶型氯丁橡胶。分为S型和AG型两种。S型氯丁橡胶是外观透明的非晶橡胶-主要表现为高弹性、高韧性、耐热性、耐油性、耐老化性以及耐磨性良好，主要用于鞋底及其他氯丁橡胶加工助剂，能够增加硬度、减少收缩等;AG型氯丁橡胶是完全的凝胶型聚合物-结晶速率极慢，生胶塑炼无法将其转变为溶胶型氯丁橡胶，在有机溶剂中分散困难。由于其凝胶含量多，可以进行低压喷涂，适于喷涂胶黏剂。
explanation_en: It refers to the gel-chloroprene rubber with large molecular weight, many branched chains and insoluble in organic solvents, which is obtained without the use of molecular weight regulator in the process of chloroprene monomer emulsion polymerization. It is divided into two types: S-type and AG type. S-type chloroprene rubber is a transparent amorphous rubber - mainly characterized by high elasticity, high toughness, heat resistance, oil resistance, aging resistance and good wear resistance. It is mainly used for shoe soles and other chloroprene rubber processing additive, which can increase hardness and reduce shrinkage; AG type chloroprene rubber is a complete gel type polymer - the crystallization rate is extremely slow, crude rubber mastication can not transformation it into sol type chloroprene rubber, and it is difficult to disperse in organic solvents. Due to its high gel content, it can be sprayed at low pressure, and is suitable for spraying adhesive.

explanation_cn: 具有外观透明均匀的高分子凝胶结构。这些树脂因其珠状结构而得名。与大孔型树脂的主要区别在于珠体内部没有毛细孔，因此在干燥状态下，交联骨架没有孔隙，呈均匀透明的状态。当处于湿态时，由于大分子骨架膨胀，形成许多微孔，这些微孔的大小取决于共聚物中交联剂的种类和用量。同一种交联剂用量较低时，微孔的尺寸较大，通常伴有较高的水分含量。在苯乙烯系列树脂中，最常见的交联剂是二乙烯基苯。在丙烯酸系列树脂中，常用的交联剂包括甲基丙烯酸、甲基丙烯酸衣康酸酯等。这些交联剂改进了树脂的性能，目前得到广泛应用。这类树脂的制备工艺相对简单，成本较低，具有较高的工作容量等优点，因此在离子交换树脂中应用广泛，产量也最大
explanation_en: It has a transparent and uniform polymeric gel structure. These resin are named for their bead like structure. The main difference from macroporous resin is that there are no pores in the bead body, so in the dry state, the crosslinking skeleton has no pores, and it is in a uniform and transparent state. When in the wet state, many micropores are formed due to the expansion of the macromolecule skeleton. The size of these micropores depends on the type and amount of cross linking agent in the copolymer. When the amount of the same crosslinking agent is low, the size of micropores is large, usually accompanied by high moisture content. Among the styrene series resin, the most common cross linking agent is divinylbenzene. Among the acrylic resin, the commonly used cross linking agent include methacrylic acid, itaconate methacrylate, etc. These cross linking agent improve the performance of resin and are widely used at present. This kind of resin has the advantages of relatively simple preparation process, low cost, high working capacity, etc., so it is widely used in ion exchange resin and has the largest output

explanation_cn: 又称体积排除色谱(sizeexclusionchroma-torapy;SEC)。它是一种液相色谱凝胶渗透色谱。对聚合物分子量分级的原理是体积排除理论，让被测量的聚合物溶液通过一根白装不同孔径凝胶的色谱柱，柱中可供分子通行的路径有粒子间的间隙(较大)和粒子白的通孔(较小)。当聚合物溶液流经色谱柱时，较大的分子被排除在粒子的小孔之外，只能从粒子间通过。速度较快;而较小的分子可以进入粒子中的小孔。通过的速度要慢得多。经过一定长度的色谱柱后。分子根据其大小被分开，相对分子质量大的最先被淋洗出来(淋洗时间短)。相对分子质量小的最后被淋洗出来(淋洗时间长)。用已知相对分子质量的单分散标准聚合物预先作一条淋洗体积或淋洗时间与I相对分子质量对应关系曲线。即"校正曲线"，通过校正曲线即可求得试样的分子量的分布。对于没有标准样的聚合物可使用普适校正原理。不仅町给出聚合物的相对分子质量和相对分子质量分布，还可给出聚合物组成、形态、构型等多方面的信息。
explanation_en: It is also called volume exclusion chromatography (SEC). It is a liquid chromatography gel permeation chromatography. The principle of molecular weight grading of polymer is volume exclusion theory, which allows the measured polymer solution to pass through a chromatographic column filled with gel with different pore sizes. The paths available for molecules to pass through the column are the gap between particles (larger) and the through hole with white particles (smaller). When polymer solution flows through the chromatographic column, larger molecules are excluded from the pores of particles and can only pass through the particles. Fast speed; Smaller molecules can enter small pores in the particles. The speed of passage is much slower. After passing through a certain length of chromatographic column. Molecules are separated according to their size, and those with higher relative molecular weight are eluted first (with shorter elution time). The ones with low relative molecular weight are finally washed out (with a long washing time). The monodisperse standard polymer with known relative molecular weight is used to draw a corresponding curve between the washing volume or washing time and the relative molecular weight of I. The "calibration curve" is used to obtain the molecular weight distribution of the sample. Universal correction principle can be used for polymer without standard sample. Not only can the relative molecular weight and relative molecular mass distribution of polymer be given, but also the composition, morphology, configuration and other information of polymer can be given.

explanation_cn: 在体型缩聚体系中，多官能团单体聚合到某一程度时开始交联，黏度突增，出现凝胶化现象。这时的反应程度称作凝胶点。凝胶点是开始出现凝胶瞬间的临界反应程度，或者开始出现凝胶化现象时对应的温度、时间等参数的值。在凝胶阶段，微观上聚合物分子链间的交联点迅速增加，宏观上树脂黏度开始迅速增大，因此凝胶点可由黏度-时间（或温度）曲线的转折点测得。凝胶时间取决于树脂的化学成分、反应程度以及固化条件，它是制定复合材料制品成型工艺参数的一个重要指标，尤其是确定复合材料固化成型加压时间的关键依据。
explanation_en: In the three-dimensional polycondensation system, the multi-functional monomer starts crosslinking when polymerization reaches a certain degree, viscosity suddenly increases, and gel occurs. The degree of reaction at this time is called gel point. The gel point is the critical reaction degree at the moment when gel begins to appear, or the corresponding temperature, time and other parameters when gel begins to appear. In the gel stage, the crosslinking point between the polymer molecular chains increases rapidly on the micro level, and the viscosity of the resin starts to increase rapidly on the macro level, so the gel point can be measured by the turning point of the viscosity time (or temperature) curve. The gel time depends on the chemical composition, reaction degree and curing conditions of resin. It is an important indicator for formulating the molding process parameters of composite materials products, especially the key basis for determining the pressure time of composite materials curing molding.

explanation_cn: 描述高压条件下火药燃烧规律的几何燃烧模型。假定单一装药的每颗药粒都冇相同的几何尺寸和理化性能，所有药粒表面同时着火，燃烧中同一瞬间各燃烧表面的燃烧线速度都相同，则所有药粒都按平行层或圆心层的规律逐层燃烧。
explanation_en: Geometric combustion model describing the combustion law of propellant under high pressure. Assuming that each grain of a single charge has the same geometric size and physical and chemical properties, all grain surfaces are ignited at the same time, and the combustion linear velocity of each combustion surface is the same at the same moment in combustion, all grains are combustion layer by layer according to the rule of parallel layer or center layer.

explanation_cn: 单晶在形变过程中试样轴发也移动，因此滑移系统的取向因子也 跟着发生变化，在正在运作的滑移系统由硬取向变为软取向时其系统流变应力自然降低。若在滑移过程中发生孪生，孪生也会改变动作滑移系统的取向而软化。
explanation_en: In the process of deformation of single crystal, the axial hair of the sample also moves, so the orientation factor of the slip system also changes. When the slip system in operation changes from hard orientation to soft orientation, the flow stress of the system naturally decreases. If twinning occurs in the sliding process, twinning will also change the orientation of the action sliding system and bating.

explanation_cn: 参见坡缕石。
explanation_en: See palygorskite.

explanation_cn: 参见坡缕右黏土。
explanation_en: See clay on the right of slope.

explanation_cn: 又称錾胎珐琅、剔花珐琅。在金属坯件表面錾刻、凿槽、挖穴，剔成凹坑.留出凸露金属丝，或用模型铸出凹坑图案，然后于凹坑内填入珐琅釉，经烧成、磨光而成。
explanation_en: It is also called chiseled enamel and patterned enamel. Carve, gouge and dig holes on the surface of metal blanks to form pits, leave exposed metal wires, or cast pit patterns with model, and then fill the pits with enamel glaze, which are fired and polished.

explanation_cn: 以机械撞击或绝热压缩气泡作用为激发能而产生爆燃的混合药剂。击发药是各种引信火帽、炮弹发射药筒底火火帽和枪弹底火火帽等的主要装药。它由起爆药、可燃剂和氧化剂组成。根据工艺或性能要求，可以加入钝感剂、敏感剂或黏合剂等。击发药是混合起爆药的最主要品种之一。其作用是接受初始冲能（机械撞击或冲击波等）激发后输出火焰能，引燃弹药的发火序列。
explanation_en: A mixed agent that produces deflagration through mechanical impact or adiabatic compression of bubbles as the excitation energy. Percussion composition is the main charge of various fuze caps, cartridge case primer caps and cartridge primer caps. It consists of primary explosive, combustible agent and oxidizer. According to process or performance requirements, deterrent, sensitizer or adhesive can be added. Percussion composition is one of the most important varieties of mixing primary explosive. Its function is to receive initial impulse energy (mechanical impact or shock wave, etc.) and output flame energy, igniting the firing sequence of the ammunition.

explanation_cn: 磨粒在磨损中压入材料表面并因切向运动而造成材料流失的一种磨料磨损形式。凿削过程的特征是严重的冲击载荷和材料流失，此时磨粒也受到高应力而发生碎裂，故称其为高应力凿削研磨式磨损。在颚式破碎机齿板、球磨机衬板、岡徘破碎机轧臼壁以及挖掘机斗齿上经常出现这类磨损。用于工况下的材料首先应有较高的冲击韧性，还应具备强的加工硬化能力，因此高锰钢是最佳材料。凿削式磨损多发生在三体磨料磨损的工况中。
explanation_en: A form of abrasive wear in which abrasive particles are pressed into surface of materials during wear and materials is lost due to tangential movement. The chiseling process is characterized by severe impact load and materials loss. At this time, the abrasive grains are also subject to high stress and break, so it is called high stress chiseling abrasive wear. This kind of wear often occurs on jaw crusher tooth plate, ball mill lining plate, Gangpai crusher rolling mortar wall and excavator bucket tooth. The materials used under working conditions should first have high impact toughness and strong work hardening capability, so high manganese steel is the best materials. Chisel type wear mostly occurs in the working condition of three-body abrasion.

explanation_cn: 适合于制作各种刃具的工具钢。刃具钢要求具有高的强度、硬度和耐磨性，还应具有良好的工艺性能.如良好的冷、热加工性，低脱碳倾向以及高淬透性等。金属切削用刃具和石材切削刀具还要求具有较高的红硬性，而生物切割刀具则还要求具有良好的刃口锋利性和一定的耐浊性。非合金刃具钢碳含量为0.65%?1.35%.价格低廉.刃口锋利性良好，可用于农作物切割刀具、木工工具及简单手工具。
explanation_en: Tool steel suitable for making various cutting tools. Cutting tool steel is required to have high strength, hardness, wear resistance and good process properties, such as good cold and hot workability, low decarburization tendency and high hardenability. Metal cutting tools and stone cutting tools also require high red hardness, while biological cutting tools also require good edge sharpness and a certain degree of turbidity resistance. The carbon content of non alloy cutting tool steel is 0.65%? 1.35%. Low in price, with good sharpness of the blade, it can be used for crop cutting tools, woodworking tools, and simple hand tools.

explanation_cn: 伯格斯矢量与位错线垂直的位错。它可描述为晶体结构中多余半原子面的刃口，晶体中压缩区和拉伸区总是伴随着刃型位错而出现，所以沿位错原子所具有的能量总是增加的。
explanation_en: Burgers vector is a dislocation perpendicular to the dislocation line. It can be described as the edge of the superfluous semi atomic plane in the crystal structure. The compressed and stretched regions in the crystal always appear with the edge dislocation, so the energy of the atoms along the dislocation always increases.

explanation_cn: 将待升华有机化合物放置于升华管的加热区，在真空状态下对材料进行加热升华。因材料升华温度不同，通过调整加热的温度以及温区长度和不同温度的温区设置，富集提纯需要的材料主成分，将微量的杂质同目标产品进行分离的过程。
explanation_en: The organic compound to be sublimated is placed in the heating zone of the sublimation tube, and the materials is heated and sublimated under vacuum. Due to different sublimation temperatures of materials, the process of enriching and purifying the main components of materials and separating trace impurities from target products by adjusting the heating temperature, the length of the temperature zone and the temperature zone settings at different temperatures.

explanation_cn: 通过允许原子和分子在一段时间内交互作用，根据已知的物理近似求解系统中所有粒子的运动方程，获知原子运动过程的图像的一种计算机模拟方法。
explanation_en: A computer simulation method that allows atoms and molecules to interact over a period of time, solving the motion equations of all particles in the system based on known physical approximations, and obtaining images of the atomic motion process.

explanation_cn: 电介质极性分子或极性基团在电场作用下定向排列，使其偶极矩不为零的现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that polar molecules or polar groups of dielectric are directionally arranged under the action of electric field so that their dipole moment is not zero.

explanation_cn: 分子器件的概念涉及两方面的内涵：基于分子材料的器件和基于分子尺度的器件。基于分子材料的器件涉及各种薄膜器件、单晶器件、自组装器件等。
explanation_en: The concept of molecular device involves two aspects: devices based on molecular materials and devices based on molecular scales. The devices based on molecular materials involve various thin film devices, single crystal devices, self-assembly devices, etc.

explanation_cn: 分子复合材料是指刚性高分子链（段）聚合物与柔性链聚合物(树脂）共混，刚性链高分子聚合物作为增强相在接近分子水平上均匀分散在柔性链（段）树脂基体中，达到最佳分子增强效应，形成的高强度、高模量的复合材料。
explanation_en: Molecular composite refers to the polymer blending of rigid macromolecule chain (segment) polymer and flexible chain polymer (resin). The rigid chain macromolecule polymer, as a reinforcing phase, is evenly dispersed in the matrix of flexible chain (segment) resin at a molecular level to achieve the best molecular reinforcement effect and form a composite materials with high strength and high modulus.

explanation_cn: 是指分子生物学或化学中利用一组原子或分子而研究其它分子或结构的性质。其原理可实现对无法直接研究的化合物和结构而间接地开展研究。如何选择分子探针的类型依赖于要研究哪种化合物和结构以及所感兴趣的性质。
explanation_en: It refers to the use of a group of atoms or molecules in molecular biology or chemistry to study the properties of other molecules or structures. Its principle enables indirect research on compounds and structures that cannot be directly studied. How to choose the type of molecular probe depends on which compound and structure to study and the properties of interest.

explanation_cn: 在超高真空条件下，精确控制蒸发源给出的中性分子束流强，在基片上外延成膜的技术。MBE属于真空蒸镀范畴，但由于它实现了严格控制按照原子层逐层生长的工艺，又是一种全新的晶体生长方法。
explanation_en: The technology of accurately controlling the neutral molecular beam intensity provided by the evaporation source under ultra-high vacuum conditions and epitaxial film formation on the substrate. MBE belongs to vacuum vapor exposition, but it is also a new crystal growth method because it realizes the process of strictly controlling the layer by layer growth according to the atomic layer.

explanation_cn: 指材料与机体在分子水平上的相互作用的能力，材料对细胞的DNA和RNA复制、表达及细胞外基质活性等的影响。随着分子生物学的迅速发展，生物材料生物相容性研究手段逐渐多样化，其评价已从整体、细胞水平进入了分子水平。
explanation_en: It refers to the ability of materials to interact with the body at the molecular level, and the influence of materials on DNA and RNA replication, expression and extracellular matrix activity of cells. With the rapid development of molecular biology, the research methods of biocompatibility of biological materials have gradually diversified, and their evaluation has entered the molecular level from the overall and cellular level.

explanation_cn: 以分子筛为活性组分或主要活性组分之一的催化材料。分子筛按骨架元素组成可分为硅铝类分子筛、磷铝类分子筛和骨架杂原子分子筛。分子筛催化材料中通常只含有5%~15%的分子筛，其余部分为基质，基质由难熔性无机氧化物或其混合物和黏土组成。分子筛具有规整的晶体结构、尺寸均匀的微孔结构、巨大的比表面积、平衡骨架负电荷的阳离子可被一些具催化特性的金属离子所交换，以及非骨架组分等特殊的结构性质。在有机合成反应中多以负载型分子筛为催化材料，它以分子筛为载体，将杂多酸、胺类、金属氧化物和过渡金属络合物等催化材料负载到孔道中。分子筛的活性中心主要分布在晶体内部，且催化性能随反应物分子、产物分子或反应中间物的几何尺寸的变化而显著变化。催化材料反应的选择性常取决于分子与孔径的大小，共有四种不同的形式，包括反应物的择形催化、产物的择形催化、过渡状态限制的择形催化、分子交通控制的择形催化。分子筛催化材料结构稳定，机械强度高，热稳定性好，活化再生后可重复使用，对设备无腐蚀，且容易与反应产物分离，生产过程中基本不产生"三废"，废催化材料处理简单，不污染环境。
explanation_en: A catalytic materials with molecular sieve as the active component or one of the main active components. Molecular sieves can be divided into silicon aluminum molecular sieves, phosphorus aluminum molecular sieves, and skeleton heteroatom molecular sieves based on their composition of skeleton elements. Molecular sieve catalysts usually only contain 5%~15% molecular sieve, and the rest is matrix, which is composed of refractory inorganic oxide or its mixture and clay. Molecular sieves have regular crystal structure, uniform microporous structure, huge specific surface, cations that balance the negative charge of the skeleton can be exchanged by some metal ions with catalytic properties, and special structural properties such as non skeleton components. In organic synthesis reactions, supported molecular sieves are often used as catalytic materials, which use molecular sieves as carriers to load heteropoly acids, amines, metal oxides and transition metal complexes and other catalytic materials into the pores. The active centers of molecular sieves are mainly distributed in the crystal, and the catalytic performance changes significantly with the change of the geometric size of reactant molecules, product molecules or reaction intermediates. The selectivity of catalytic materials response often depends on the size of molecule and pore diameter, and there are four different forms, including shape selective catalysis of reactants, shape selective catalysis of products, shape selective catalysis limited by transition state, and shape selective catalysis controlled by molecular traffic. Molecular sieve catalysts has stable structure, high mechanical strength, and good thermal stability. It can be reused after activation or conditioning and regeneration. It has no corrosion to equipment and is easy to separate from reaction products. There is basically no "three wastes" generated in the production process. Waste catalytic materials is simple to treat and does not pollute the environment.

explanation_cn: 在分子间范德华力、氢键、疏水相互作用等非化学键相互作用下，若干分子形成某种有序结构聚集体的过程。
explanation_en: Under the non chemical bond interactions such as intermolecular van der Waals force, hydrogen bond, hydrophobic interaction and so on, some molecules form an ordered structure aggregate.

explanation_cn: 由超细的氧化剂组分和可燃剂组分均匀混合而成的炸药。爆轰反应在可燃剂和氧化剂两种颗粒（或两相）间进行，与单质炸药（单质炸药的氧化基团与可燃基团含于同一个分子内）相比，反应速度低，反应区较宽。
explanation_en: Explosive made of superfine oxidizer component and combustible component. Detonation reaction is carried out between combustible and oxidizer particles (or two phases). Compared with single explosive (the oxidation group and combustible group of single explosive are contained in the same molecule), the reaction speed is low and the reaction zone is wide.

explanation_cn: 又称分子发动机，是分布于细胞内部或细胞表面的一类蛋白质、DNA和RNA等生物分子，分子结构处在纳米尺度，它负责细胞内的一部分物质或者整个细胞的宏观运动。
explanation_en: Also known as molecular engine, it is a class of biological molecules, such as proteins, DNA and RNA, which are distributed inside or on the surface of cells. The molecular structure is at the nanoscale, and it is responsible for the macro movement of some substances in cells or the whole cell.

explanation_cn: 是混合的一种形式。混合是一种趋向于减少混合物非均匀性的操作过程，是在整个系统的全部体积内，各组分在其基本单元内没有本质变化的情况下重新进行的细化和分布。
explanation_en: It is a form of mixing. Mixing is an operational process that tends to reduce the non-uniformity of a mixture. It is the refinement and distribution of each component throughout the entire volume of the system without any essential changes within its basic unit.

explanation_cn: 可以促使物料颗粒均匀分散于介质中，形成稳定悬浮体的试剂，多数是各种类型的表面活性剂，以阴离子表面活性剂为主，其次是非离子表面活性剂。它广泛应用于染料、颜料、水泥、造纸、陶瓷等行业。
explanation_en: Reagents that can promote the uniform dispersion of material particles in the medium and form stable suspensions are mostly various types of surfactants, mainly anionic surfactants, followed by non ionic surfactants. It is widely used in dye or dyestuffc, pigment, cement, paper making, ceramics and other industries.

explanation_cn: 混合包括分布混合与分散混合，分散混合即是在混合过程中，通过外力使材料的粒度减小，并且使不同组成的原料分布均一化。混合中既有粒子粒度的减小，也有位置的变化。
explanation_en: Mixing includes distribution-mixing and dispersion-mixing. dispersion-mixing is to reduce the particle size of materials and homogenize the distribution of raw materials with different compositions through external forces during the mixing process. There is a decrease in particle size and a change in position in the mixing process.

explanation_cn: 样品被高能电子束照射时，收集、测定和分析从样品局部区域发射出的各种不同信号的理论和技术。高空间分辨率分析电子显微术是一种研究物质超显微尺度的原子排列、原子种类、原子位置、元素价态的方法。分析电子显微镜能将聚焦到很细的电子束打到试样上一个微小的区域中，产生各种不同的信号，经过分析处理，给出试样的微观形貌、结构和成分等综合信息。
explanation_en: The theory and technology of collecting, measuring, and analyzing various different signals emitted from local areas of the sample when it is irradiated by high-energy electron beams. High spatial resolution analytical electron microscopy is a method to study the atomic arrangement, atomic type, atomic position, and valence state of elements at ultramicroscopic scale. An analytical electron microscope can focus a very fine electron beam onto a small area of the sample, generating various signals. After analysis and processing, it provides comprehensive information such as the microstructure, structure, and composition of the sample.

explanation_cn: 将钢加热奥氏体化后先淬入温度略高于Ms点的冷却介质中，在工件温度基本达到均匀而组织仍保持为奥氏体时，迅速转入另一冷却介质中冷却至室温，使奥氏体转变为马氏体的热处理工艺。
explanation_en: The steel is quenched into cooling medium whose temperature is slightly higher than Ms point after being heated and austenitized. When the workpiece temperature is basically uniform and the structure is still retained as austenite, it is quickly transferred to another cooling medium to cool to room temperature, which is a heat treatment process to transformation austenite into martensite.

explanation_cn: 分辨率可以分为显示分辨率和图像分辨率。显示分辨率（屏幕分辨率）是屏幕图像的精密度，是指显示器所能显示的像素有多少。
explanation_en: Resolution can be divided into display resolution and image resolution. Display resolution (screen resolution) is the precision of screen image, which refers to the number of pixels that can be displayed on the display.

explanation_cn: 指一定温度下，某一溶质在两种互不相溶的溶剂中达到分配平衡时在两相中的活度（常近似为浓度）之比。在固体凝同的情况下又称分凝系数，指某一杂质在界面处附近的固体和熔体中的浓度之比。
explanation_en: It refers to the ratio of activity (usually approximate to concentration) of a solute in two phases when it reaches distribution equilibrium in two immiscible solvents at a certain temperature. In the case of solid solidification, it is also known as the segregation coefficient, which refers to the ratio of the concentration of a certain impurity in the solid and melt near the interface.

explanation_cn: 指可在室温下通过机械切削工艺（CAD/CAM)进行加工制作牙修复体的陶瓷材料。目前牙科可切削陶主要有以下4类：①可切削长石基陶瓷。以长石为增强基相的烤瓷，晶粒小、分散均匀，有良好的抛光性能；②二硅酸铝基切削陶瓷，瓷块由压铸方式制作，增强相为二硅酸铝晶体，晶粒细小，切削性能好；③玻璃渗透切削陶瓷，包括尖晶石基、氧化铝基和氧化锆基等几种玻璃渗透切削陶瓷，其瓷块由热等静压方式制成，切削后在烧结时完成玻璃渗透；(c)烧结切削陶瓷，常用的包括氧化钇稳定的氧化锆陶瓷和氧化铝烧结切削陶瓷，瓷块也由压铸方式制作。
explanation_en: It refers to ceramics materials that can be processed to make tooth prosthesis at room temperature through mechanical cutting process (CAD/CAM). At present, there are four types of dental machinable ceramics: ① machinable feldspar based ceramics. Porcelain with feldspar as the reinforced matrix has small grains, uniform dispersion and good polishing performance; ② Aluminum disilicate based cutting ceramics, the ceramic block is made by die casting, and the reinforcing phase is aluminum disilicate crystal, with fine grains and good cutting performance; ③ Glass infiltration cutting ceramics, including spinel based, alumina based and zirconia based glass infiltration cutting ceramics, whose ceramic blocks are made by hot isostatic pressing, and glass infiltration is completed during sintering after cutting; (c) Sintering cutting ceramics, commonly including yttria stabilized zirconia ceramics ceramics and alumina sintering cutting ceramics, ceramic blocks are also made by die casting.

explanation_cn: 外表面轴向装有小型刀片的球囊。用于球囊扩张的同时可对血管病变部位的斑块进行切割。
explanation_en: A balloon with a small blade installed axially on the outer surface. Used for balloon dilation while cutting plaques at vascular lesion sites.

explanation_cn: 参见表面膜结合强度测试。
explanation_en: See test of bond strength (adhesion strength) of surface film.

explanation_cn: 在第二类超导体进入混合态后，超导体内部会形成一定数量的磁通涡旋线；这种磁通涡旋线在洛伦兹力的作用下会运动，同时这种磁通涡旋线也受到磁通钉扎中心（如：点钉扎）的作用，当这种涡旋线不可以弯曲，在洛伦兹力的作用下直接造成。脱钉即脱离钉扎中心的作用时，称这种涡旋线为刚性涡旋线。
explanation_en: After the type II superconductor enters the mixed state, a certain number of magnetic vortex lines will be formed inside the superconductor; This flux vortex line will move under the action of Lorentz force, and this flux vortex line is also affected by the flux pinning center (such as point pinning). When this vortex line cannot be bent, it is directly caused under the action of Lorentz force. This vortex line is called hard vortex line when the nail is detached from the action of the nail binding center.

explanation_cn: 配位型氧化物矿物。化学式为Al2O3。一般有微量的Cr、Ti、Fe、Mn、V以类质同象代替铝，常含金红石、赤铁矿、钛铁矿包体。
explanation_en: Coordination type oxide minerals. The chemical formula is Al2O3. Generally, trace amounts of Cr, Ti, Fe, Mn and V replace aluminum with isomorphism, often containing rutile, hematite and ilmenite inclusions.

explanation_cn: 以刚玉和莫来石为主晶相的耐火材料。
explanation_en: Refractory with corundum and mullite as main crystal phases.

explanation_cn: 以α-Al2O3为代表的A2B3型化合物的主要结构类型。属三方晶系，空间群为R3c。氧离子作ABAB......立方密堆积，Al3+占据2/3的氧八面体空隙，另外的1/3八面体空隙空着。
explanation_en: with α- Al2O3 represents the main structural type of A2B3 type compounds. It belongs to the tripartite system, and the space group is R3c. Oxygen ions as ABAB Cubically packed, Al3+occupies 2/3 of the oxygen octahedral voids, while the other 1/3 octahedral voids are empty.

explanation_cn: Al2O3含量大于90%，以刚玉为主晶相的耐火制品。刚玉砖的机械强度高、荷重软化温度髙、化学稳定性好、抗渣侵蚀能力强.但热震稳定性较差。主要用于石化工业炉、高温窑炉内衬及窑具等。
explanation_en: Refractory products with Al2O3 content more than 90% and corundum as the main crystal phase. Corundum brick Al has high mechanical strength, high refractoriness under load, good chemical stability, strong resistance to slag erosion, but poor thermal shock stability. Mainly used for lining and kiln furniture in petrochemical industrial furnaces, high-temperature kilns, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称开坯。在初轧机上把金属铸锭轧制成板坯、方坯或异型坯，同时改变铸锭的铸造组织的轧制过程称为初轧。由于连铸技术的发展，大部分钢材生产中已不需要进行初轧.故初轧仅用于不能连铸生产的某些钢种或规格的产品。
explanation_en: Also known as blooming. The rolling process of rolling metal ingots into slabs, square billets or profiled blanks on the blooming mill, while changing the foundry structure of the ingots, is called blooming. Due to the development of continuous casting technology, blooming is no longer required in most steel product production, so blooming is only used for certain steel grades or specifications that cannot be produced by continuous casting.

explanation_cn: 在胶黏剂完全间化产生最大粘接强度之前.使两个被粘物叠合在一起时的粘接强度。
explanation_en: The adhesive strength when two adherends are overlapped before the adhesive is completely interbedded to produce the maximum adhesive strength.

explanation_cn: 利用施加或未施加胶料和辅料的木材刨花或木材植物制成的刨花或纤维衬料(如木片、锯屑、亚麻等）压制的板材。刨花板的分类有多种。按制造方法分为平压法刨花板、辊压法刨花板、挤压法刨花板（空心挤压刨花板、实心挤压刨花板）；按表面状况分为加压刨花板、砂光或刨光刨花板、饰面刨花板、单板贴面刨花板；按形状分为平面刨花板、模压刨花板；根据施加的胶黏剂分为有机胶黏剂刨花板、无机胶黏剂刨花板、无机胶合刨花板；按原料分为木材刨花板、非木材刨板。不同类型刨花板的性能相差很大，如平压法刨花板板面各方向的强度和刚度均相同，所以可以在板面任何方向上加工部件。挤压法刨花板中刨花垂直于板表面，因此板的弯曲强度较低，表面必须贴木单板或其他材料。平乐普通刨花板的制造工艺为：原料、削片、再碎、干燥、施胶、预压、热压、裁边、砂光、分等。刨花板可用亍家具、建筑、室内装饰、车厢、船舶、音乐器材、模板。
explanation_en: Pressing board made of wood shavings or wood plant shavings or fiber linings (such as wood chips, sawdust, flax, etc.) with or without glue and auxiliary materials. There are many classifications of particleboard. According to the manufacturing method, it can be divided into flat pressing particleboard, rolling particleboard, extrusion particleboard (hollow extrusion particleboard, solid extrusion particleboard); According to the surface condition, it can be divided into pressurized particleboard, sand or polished particleboard, decorative particleboard, veneer faced particleboard; According to shape, it can be divided into plane particleboard and molded particleboard; According to the applied adhesive, it can be divided into organic adhesive particleboard, inorganic adhesive particleboard and inorganic bonded particleboard; It is divided into wood particleboard and non wood particleboard according to raw materials. The performance of different types of particleboard varies greatly. For example, the strength and stiffness of particleboard in all directions are the same, so the parts can be processed in any direction of the board surface. In extrusion particleboard, the particle is perpendicular to the board surface, so the bending strength of the board is low, and the surface must be pasted with wood veneer or other materials. The manufacturing process of Pingle ordinary particleboard is: raw materials, chipping, re crushing, drying, sizing, pre pressing, hot pressing, trimming, sanding, grading, etc. Particleboard can be used for furniture, architecture, interior decoration, carriages, ships, music equipment and templates.

explanation_cn: 供铅笔、墨线绘图用的纸,通常以漂白化学木浆和棉浆为原料制造。具有不透明、无斑点和高耐擦性。
explanation_en: Paper used for drawing pencils and ink lines, usually made from bleached chemical wood pulp and cotton pulp. It is opaque, spotless, and highly resistant to rubbing.

explanation_cn: 制取氢气的过程。制氢的过程和方法很多包括水的电解或热裂解、碳氢化合物的重整、化学储氢材料的分解或与水反应，及在酶或细菌作用下的一些生化过程。
explanation_en: The process of producing hydrogen gas. Many processes and methods of hydrogen generation production include electrolysis or pyrolysis of water, reforming of hydrocarbons, decomposition of chemical hydrogen storage materials or reaction with water, and some biochemical processes under the action of enzymes or bacteria.

explanation_cn: 是指没有免疫系统参与，且能为人体感受并引起组织细胞、器官和机体发生反应的内外环境变化.统称为刺激。按刺激性质的不同可以划分为：①物理性刺激，如电、磁、机械、温度、声波、光等；②化学性刺激，如酸、碱、药物等；③生物性刺激，如细菌、病毒等；④社会心理性刺激，如情绪激动、社会变革等。在生物材料研究领域.刺激通常是指不涉及免疫学机制的.一次、多次或持续与一种材料接触所引起的机体局部非特异性炎症反应-
explanation_en: It refers to the changes in the internal and external environment that are not involved by the immune system and can be felt by the human body and cause the reaction of tissue cells, organs and the body. It is collectively called irritation. According to the nature of irritation, it can be divided into: ① physical irritation, such as electricity, magnetism, machinery, temperature, sound wave, light, etc.; ② Chemical irritation, such as acid, alkali, drug, etc.; ③ Biological irritation, such as bacteria and viruses; ④ Social psychological irritation, such as emotional excitement, social change, etc. In the field of biological materials research, irritation usually refers to the nonspecific inflammatory reaction in the body caused by one, multiple or continuous contact with a materials-

explanation_cn: 是指一类在受到如光、温度、电压、pH值、分子、机械力等外界环境刺激时产生特异性响应的功能性聚合物。其中，特异性响应包括聚合物形态、形貌、颜色以及发光波长等的变化。这类聚合物在化学检测、生物传感和药物控释等领域得以广泛应用。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of functional polymer that produces specific response when subjected to irritation from external environment such as light, temperature, voltage, pH value, molecule, mechanical force, etc. Among them, the specific response includes the changes of polymer morphology, morphology, color and luminescence wavelength. Such polymer have been widely used in chemical detection, biosensors, drug controlled release and other fields.

explanation_cn: 双层或多层膜结构中，刻蚀工艺进行到该膜层时刻蚀速率将显著降低，这层材料称为刻浊阻挡材料。在相同的刻蚀条件下，刻蚀阻挡材料通常具有较低的刻蚀速率。工艺中，通常利用刻蚀阻挡层具有低刻蚀速率的特点来达到自动侦测刻蚀终点，并且有效控制过刻蚀量的目的。
explanation_en: In the double-layer or multilayer structure, the etching rate will be significantly reduced when the etching process reaches this layer, and this layer of materials is called the etching turbidity barrier materials. Under the same etching conditions, the etch stop materials usually has a lower etching rate. In the process, the characteristic of low etching rate in the etching barrier layer is usually utilized to achieve automatic detection of the etching endpoint and effectively control the amount of etching.

explanation_cn: 在规定的剥离条件下，使粘接件分离时单位宽度所需的最大负荷。它反映材料的粘结强度。如安全膜与玻璃、手机贴膜。
explanation_en: The maximum load required per unit width to separate the adhesive component under specified peeling conditions. It reflects the bonding strength of materials. Such as safety film, glass and mobile phone film.

explanation_cn: 又称去膜液。一种光刻制程助剂。用于蚀刻制程后去除光阻和残留材料。除了要求能快速有效去除光阻和残留物外，还要求避免损伤其下的基板。
explanation_en: It is also called demembrane solution. A lithography process additive. It is used to remove photoresistance and residual materials after etching process. In addition to rapid and effective removal of photoresistance and residues, it is also required to avoid damaging the substrate under it.

explanation_cn: 铁电体经极化后，当撤除外电场作用时所具有的极化强度被称为剩余极化强度。与铁磁体具有磁滞回线相似，铁电体也具有电滞回线。当起始态处于无外电场作用时，晶体的总极化强度为零。随着外电场增加，极化强度沿着一个线段增大。当电场由图中的C处开始降低，晶体的极化强度也随之减小。但当电场减至零时，仍然存在一个非零的剩余极化强度，这被称为剩余极化强度。剩余极化强度是铁电体的一个重要性质，它是铁电陶瓷经极化后具有极化效应的物理基础。
explanation_en: After polarization, the polarization of ferroelectrics when the external electric field is removed is called remanent polarization. Similar to the magnetic hysteresis of ferromagnets, ferroelectric body also have hysteresis loops. When the initial state is in the absence of external electric field, the total polarization of crystal is zero. With the increase of external electric field, the polarization intensity increases along a line segment. When the electric field starts to decrease from C in the figure, the polarization of the crystal also decreases. But when the electric field is reduced to zero, there is still a non-zero remanent polarization, which is called remanent polarization. Remanent polarization is an important property of ferroelectric body, which is the physical basis of ferroelectric ceramics having polarization effect after polarization.

explanation_cn: 通常指的是在电路中的元件或部分的电阻值。它表示在电路中特定元件或部分上剩余的电阻，即不考虑元件的理论电阻值，而是考虑实际电路中的附加电阻。
explanation_en: Usually refers to the resistance value of a component or part in a circuit. It represents the remaining resistance on a specific component or part of a circuit, that is, it does not consider the theoretical resistance value of the component, but rather considers the additional resistance in the actual circuit.

explanation_cn: 一个材料常数，是材料在剪切应力作用下，在弹性变形比例极限范围内，切应力与切应变的比值。它表征材料抵抗切应变的能 力，有时又称它为切变模量或刚性模量。
explanation_en: A materials constant is the ratio of shear stress to shear strain of materials under the action of shear stress within the limit of elastic deformation ratio. It characterizes the ability of materials to resist shear strain, sometimes called shear modulus or rigidity modulus.

explanation_cn: 聚合物在机械外力作用下发生的降解，也叫机械降解。多发生在塑炼或熔融挤出成型等加工过程中，以及聚合物溶液在强力搅拌作用下大分子链发生断裂。超声波降解是机械降解的一种特例。
explanation_en: The degradation of polymer under the action of external mechanical force is also called mechanical degradation. It usually occurs in the process of mastication or melting extrusion molding, and fracture of macromolecular chain occurs under the strong stirring of polymer solution. Ultrasonic degradation is a special case of mechanical degradation.

explanation_cn: 研究在力或力和其他外界因素共同作用下的材料行为和变化的一门学科。研究内容可分为宏观和微观强度理论，两者从不同层次上、采用不同研究方法来解决力学冶金领域中不同的问题并相互补充。力学冶金在某些场合也指金属材料的成形加工。
explanation_en: A subject that studies the behavior and change of materials under the joint action of force or force and other external factors. The research contents can be divided into macro strength theory and micro strength theory, which solve different problems in the field of mechanical metallurgy from different levels and adopt different research methods and complement each other. Mechanical metallurgy also refers to the forming of metallic materials on some occasions.

explanation_cn: 将一个电子从材料的费米能级移到真空能级所需要的最小能量。单位是eV。
explanation_en: The minimum energy required to move an electron from the Fermi level of a materials to the vacuum energy level. The unit is eV.

explanation_cn: 功率密度是指电池能输出的最大功率除以整个电池系统的质量或体积，单位是W/kg或W/cm3。比功率密度描述的是电池在瞬间能放出较大能量的能力，比如说.一个电池的比能不太高，但可以在短时间内放出较大的能量，那么这个电池的比功率密度就大。
explanation_en: Power density refers to the maximum power output by the battery divided by the mass or volume of the whole battery system, in W/kg or W/cm3. The specific power density describes the ability of the battery to emit greater energy in a moment. For example, if the specific energy of a battery is not too high, but it can emit greater energy in a short time, the specific power density of the battery will be greater.

explanation_cn: 具有某种特定功能的人造板，如具有阻燃、防腐、抗菌、抗静电、隔热保温、吸声等功能的人造板。
explanation_en: Wood based-panel with a specific function, such as wood based-panel with flame retardant, anti-corrosion, antibacterial, anti-static, thermal insulation, sound absorption and other functions.

explanation_cn: 指具有除力学性能以外其他物理性能（包括部分化学性能和生物性能）的复合材料，即具有各种电学性能(如导电、超导、压电等）、磁学性能（如永磁、软磁、磁致伸缩等）、光学性能（如透光、选择吸收、光致变色等）、热学性能（如绝热、导热、低热膨胀系数等）、声学性能（如吸声、消声呐等），另外还有摩擦性能、阻尼性能以及化学分离性能等。功能复合材料主要由功能体和基体组成，或由两种（或两种以上）功能体组成。一般功能材料很难用一种物理量来衡量其性能，而需要用材料的优值来进行综合评价，即几个物性参数组合起来对材料使用性构成的影响。功能复合材料已经在航空航天（如隐身机身、雷达、整流罩）、机械电气（如各种转换器、磁性部件等）等领域获得应用。
explanation_en: It refers to composite materials with physical properties (including some chemical properties and biological properties) other than mechanical properties, namely, various electrical properties (such as conductivity, superconductivity, piezoelectricity, etc.), magnetic properties (such as permanent magnetism, soft magnetism, magnetostriction, etc.), optical properties (such as light transmission, selective absorption, photochromism, etc.), thermal properties (such as heat insulation, heat conduction, low thermal expansion coefficient, etc.) Acoustic performance (such as sound absorption, noise reduction, etc.), as well as friction performance, damping performance, and chemical separation performance. Functional composite materials are mainly composed of functional body and matrix, or two (or more) functional bodies. Generally, it is difficult to measure the performance of functional materials with one physical quantity, but it is necessary to conduct comprehensive evaluation with the superior value of materials, that is, the combination of several physical parameters affects the usability of materials. Functional composite materials have been applied in aerospace (such as stealth fuselage, radar, fairing), mechanical and electrical (such as various converters, magnetic components, etc.) and other fields.

explanation_cn: 主要利用力学性能以外的其他特殊的物理、化学或生物医学等功能的材料的统称。即指在电、磁、声、光、热等方面具有特殊性质，或者在其作用下表现出特殊功能的材料。例如：磁性材料、电子材料、信息记录材料、光学材料、敏感材料、能源材料、阻尼材料、形状记忆材料、生物技术材料、催化材料、特种功能薄膜材料等。与结构材料不同，功能材料常用于制造各种装备中具有独特功能的核心部件，在自动控制、电子、通信、能源、交通、冶金、化工、精密机械、仪器仪表、航空航天、国防等部门均有重要的用途。
explanation_en: A general term for materials that mainly use other special physical, chemical or biomedical functions other than mechanical properties. It refers to materials that have special properties in electricity, magnetism, sound, light, heat, etc., or show special functions under their action. For example: magnetic materials, electronic materials, information recording materials, optical materials, sensitive materials, energy materials, damping material, shape memory materials, biotechnology materials, catalytic materials, special function film materials, etc. Different from structural materials, functional materials are commonly used to manufacture core components with unique functions in various equipment, and have important applications in automatic control, electronics, communication, energy, transportation, metallurgy, chemical industry, precision machinery, instrumentation, aerospace, national defense and other departments.

explanation_cn: 指具有特殊功能的纤维，包括高效过滤、离子交换、选择性吸附和分离、反渗透、超滤、微滤、透析、血浆分离、吸油、高吸湿、超吸水、水溶、导光、导电、变色、发光和各种医学功能的纤维。其制备方法各异，超细纤维片材(非织造布或毡等）是熔（或溶）喷法制成的，中空纤维分离膜多用干-湿法纺丝制成，离子交换纤维多依靠功能团反应制得，其他主要依靠选择具有上述特定功能的聚合物进行熔纺或溶液纺等方法成纤。功能纤维本身就可组合成各种分离装置或催化剂及固化酶的固定载体，也可制成光导或导电元件、生物体及光和微生物分解材料、溶剂回收装置、除湿和除臭机及具有吸收毒气、水溶、发光和光敏、热敏变色的特种服装等，应用范围涉及石油化工、海水综合利用、生物医学工程、农业、轻工、电子、通信及环保等领域。
explanation_en: It refers to fibers with special functions, including fibers with high efficiency filtration, ion exchange, selective adsorption and separation, reverse osmosis, ultrafiltration, microfiltration, dialysis, plasma separation, oil absorption, high moisture absorption, super water absorption, water solubility, light conduction, conductivity, color change, luminescence and various medical functions. The preparation methods are different. Ultrafine fiber sheet (nonwoven cloth or felt, etc.) is made by melt (or solution) spraying, hollow fiber membrane separation materials is mostly made by dry wet spinning, ion exchange fiber is mostly made by functional group reaction, and other fibers are mainly made by selecting polymer with the above specific functions for melt spinning or solution spinning. The functional fiber itself can be combined into various separation devices or catalysts and fixed carriers of solidified enzymes, and can also be made into photoconductive or conductive elements, organisms and light and microbial decomposition materials, solvent recovery devices, dehumidification and deodorization machines, and special clothing with toxic gas absorption, water solubility, luminescence, light sensitivity, heat sensitivity and color change. Its application range involves petrochemical industry, comprehensive utilization of seawater, biomedical engineering, agriculture, light industry, electronics Communication and environmental protection fields.

explanation_cn: 指由两种以纳米尺寸的晶粒进行复合或两种以上纳米厚薄的薄膜交替叠层或纳米粒子和薄膜复合的复合材料，并具备一定热、电、光、磁、声等功能。这些复合材料由于存在纳米尺寸将就可望明显改善复合材料的韧性和耐温性。另外在纳米尺度上形成的无机/无机和无机/有机复合材料则有可能形成性能优异的新一代功能复合材料。
explanation_en: It refers to the composite materials that is composition by two kinds of nanocrystalline grains or alternatively laminated by more than two kinds of nano thick and thin films or composition by nano particles and films, and has certain thermal, electrical, optical, magnetic, acoustic and other functions. These composite materials are expected to significantly improve the toughness and temperature resistance of composite materials due to the existence of nano size. In addition, inorganic/inorganic and inorganic/organic composite materials formed on the nanoscale are likely to form a new generation of functional composite materials with excellent performance.

explanation_cn: 由较复杂工艺制备的能满足某些特殊功能的耐火材料，如转炉、电炉用供气元件；连铸用水口、滑板；直流电弧炉炉底导电砖等。
explanation_en: Refractory prepared by more complicated process that can meet some special functions, such as gas supply elements for converter and electric furnace; Water inlet and sliding plate for continuous casting; Conductive bricks at the bottom of DC electric arc furnace, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称电子陶瓷。指那些具有特定的固有性能和自身功能的先进陶瓷。是利用其电、磁、声、光、热、弹、化等直接效应及其耦合效应所提供的一种或多种性质来实现某种使用功能的先进陶瓷。其特点是品种多、产量大、价格低、应用广、功能全、技术高、更新快。通过对复杂多元氧化物系统的化学、物理学及组成、结构、性能和使用效能间关系的研究，发现了大批具有优异性能或特殊功能的功能陶瓷，并借助离子置换、掺杂等方法调节、优化其性能。功能陶瓷新材料的研究已开始从经验式探索逐步走向按所需性能进行材料设计。为提高烧结性、均勻性和可靠性，发展了以溶胶一凝胶法等化学方法制备粉体原料及烧结新技术，研究了原料与陶瓷制备过程中的反应过程、表面与界面科学、显微结构的形成与变化及其对陶瓷性能的影响。纳米功能陶瓷的出现表明其研究已开始深入到介于宏观与原子尺度之间的纳米层次，对深人了解功能陶瓷的性能以及开拓其新应用，无疑将起重要的作用。近年来，功能陶瓷在薄膜、多层结构、超晶格材料、复合材料、机敏材料、智能材料等新材料领域获得迅速发展的同时，对陶瓷薄膜制备技术、表面与界面的结构与性质、陶瓷的集成、复合与微加工技术等研究正在日益受到重视。
explanation_en: Also known as electronic ceramics. It refers to those advanced ceramics with specific inherent properties and functions. It is an advanced advanced ceramics that uses one or more properties provided by its direct effects such as electricity, magnetism, sound, light, heat, elasticity, chemistry and its coupling effects to achieve a certain use function. Its characteristics include a wide variety, high yield, low price, wide application, full functionality, high technology, and fast update. A large number of functional ceramics with excellent performance or special functions have been found by studying the chemistry, physics, composition, structure, performance and use efficiency of complex multi oxide system, and their performance has been adjusted and optimized by means of ion replacement, doping and other methods. The research on new materials of functional ceramics has gradually moved from empirical exploration to materials design based on required properties. In order to improve the sintering property, uniformity and reliability, a new technology of preparing powder raw materials by chemical methods such as sol gel method and sintering was developed. The emergence of nano functional ceramics shows that their research has begun to go deep into the nano level between the macro and atomic scales, which will undoubtedly play an important role in understanding the properties of functional ceramics and exploring their new applications. In recent years, while functional ceramics have achieved rapid development in the field of new materials such as thin films, multilayer structures, superlattice materials, composite materials, smart materials, intelligent materials, and so on, research on ceramics film preparation technology, surface and interface structures and properties, ceramics integration, composition and micro processing technology is increasingly receiving attention.

explanation_cn: 一类能感知光线，或能区分气味，或能储存信息、能表现出特殊功能的陶瓷薄膜。
explanation_en: A kind of ceramics film that can sense light, distinguish smell, store information and perform special functions.

explanation_cn: 在先前加工形变的基础上继续加工时，流变强度降低的现象。泛指的加工软化包括几何软化和物理软化两方面，几何软化指单晶在形变过程中试样轴发生移动，因此滑移系统的取向因子也跟着发生变化，在正在运作的滑移系统由硬取向变为软取向时其系统流变应力自然降低。若在滑移过程中发生孪生，孪生也会改变动作滑移系统的取向而软化。动态再结晶也可看成是周期性的加工软 化。物理软化常指亚稳奥氏体在应力诱发马氏体相变 温度以下加工时诱发马氏体转变造成材料流变应力降低的现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that the rheological strength decreases when processing is continued on the basis of the deformation of the previous processing. The general work softening includes geometrical softening and physical softening. geometrical softening refers to the movement of the sample axis of single crystal during deformation, so the orientation factor of the slip system changes accordingly. When the slip system in operation changes from hard orientation to soft orientation, the flow stress of the system naturally decreases. If twinning occurs in the sliding process, twinning will also change the orientation of the action sliding system and bating. Dynamic recfystallization can also be regarded as periodic processing softening. Physical softening usually refers to the phenomenon that metastable austenite induces martensitic transformation when processing below the stress induced transformation transformation temperature, resulting in the reduction of flow stress of materials.

explanation_cn: 一种合成橡胶，属于有机硅。该种硅橡胶有弹性硅凝胶和硅橡胶之分，前者强度较低，后者强度较高。加成型硅橡胶硫化前胶料的黏度较低，便于灌注，硫化时不放热，无低分子副产物放出，收缩率小，能深度硫化。
explanation_en: A type of synthetic rubber belonging to organosilicon. This kind of silicone rubber can be divided into elasticity silica gel and silicone rubber. The former has lower strength, while the latter has higher strength. The viscosity of addition lype silicone rubber compound before vulcanization is low, so it is easy to pour. No heat is released during vulcanization, no low molecular by-products are released, the shrinkage is small, and it can be deeply vulcanization.

explanation_cn: 以硅质材料（如砂、粉煤灰、含硅尾矿等）和钙质材料（如水泥、石灰等）为主要原料，加入发气剂，经配料、搅拌、浇注、预养、切割、蒸压、养护等工艺制成的轻质多孔硅酸盐制品。
explanation_en: The light porous silicate products are made of siliceous materials (such as sand, fly ash, silicon containing tailings, etc.) and calcareous materials (such as cement, lime, etc.) as the main raw materials, added with air entraining agent, and processed by batching, mixing, pouring, pre curing, cutting, autoclaving, curing, etc.

explanation_cn: 将油脂类物质引入到皮革在制品中，使胶原纤维表面覆盖一层油脂材料以起到润滑纤维和增加皮革柔软性能的作用的操作。
explanation_en: The operation of introducing grease substances into leather work in progress to cover the surface of collagen fiber with a layer of grease materials to lubricate fibers and increase softness of leather.

explanation_cn: 是用人工的方法，在室内或设备内模拟近似于大气环境条件或某种特定的环境条件，并强化某些因素，模拟材料在长期使用中发生的特性改变，使老化实验可以在短期内获得较为可靠的结果。
explanation_en: It is to simulate the atmospheric environmental conditions or some specific environmental conditions in the room or equipment by artificial methods, and strengthen some factors to simulate the characteristic changes of materials in long-term use, so that aging experiments can obtain more reliable results in a short time.

explanation_en: It refers to the ratio of the value of an operating parameter tightened by an electromechanical luminescence display (OLED) in the accelerated life test to the value of the parameter in actual use.

explanation_cn: 在更加严酷环境下，在大为减少的时间内进行估算实际工作寿命的实验。
explanation_en: Conduct experiments to estimate the actual working life in a significantly reduced amount of time in more severe environments.
