explanation_cn: 见光发射谱。
explanation_en: See light emission spectrum.

explanation_cn: 用固氢颗粒储存原子氢;固氢颗粒储存在液氦温度下;用液氦使固氢流动。采用，有效载荷可提高264%-360%。例如，火箭采用含有50%(质量分数）原子硼的推进剂，有效载荷可以从96000kg增加到170000kg;火箭采用含有50%原子氢的推进剂，有效载荷可以从96000kg增加到475000kg。
explanation_en: Storing atomic hydrogen using solid hydrogen particles; Solid hydrogen particles are stored at liquid helium temperature; Use liquid helium to make solid hydrogen flow. By adopting, the payload can be increased by 264% -360%. For example, rockets using propellants containing 50% (mass fraction) atomic boron can increase their payload from 96000kg to 170000kg; The rocket uses a propellant containing 50% atomic hydrogen, and the payload can be increased from 96000kg to 475000kg.

explanation_cn: 一般指载能粒子射入靶物质中所引起的粒子与靶原子、靶原子与靶原子之间相互作用的过程。在多种条件下发生，所谓载能带电粒子在靶物质中的慢化过程，即是指带电粒子与靶物质原子中的电子和与耙原子核发生的各种相互作用。分为弹性碰撞过程和非弹性碰撞过程。弹性部分用来移动靶原子的质心，即不辐射光子，也不激发或电离原子核，入射粒子损失一部分动能使核得到反冲。同时受核外电子的库仑作用，入射粒子改变运动方向。非弹性部分用来激发原子内部自由度，使电子激发或电离。当带有正电荷或负电荷的载能粒子从靶物质原子近旁掠过时，入射粒子和靶原子的核外电子之间的库仑力作用，使电子受到吸引或排斥，从而使电子获得一部分能量。如果传递给电子的能量足以使电子克服原子的束缚.那么这电子就脱离原子，成为自由电子。这时靶原子就分离成一个自由电子和一个失去了一个电子的原子--正离子，这种过程称为电离。如果人射带电粒子传递给电子的能量较小，不足以使电子摆脱原子核的束缚成为自由电子，但可以使电子从低能级状态跃迁到高能级状态（使原子处于激发状态），这种过程称为激发。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to the process of interaction between particles and target atoms, as well as between target atoms, caused by the injection of energetic particles into the target material. The slowing down process of charged particles in the target material occurs under various conditions, which refers to the various interactions between charged particles and electrons in the target material atoms and with the rake nucleus. It can be divided into elasticity collision process and non elasticity collision process. The elasticity part is used to move the center of mass of the target atom, that is, it does not radiate photons, nor excite or ionize the atomic nucleus. The incident particles lose part of the kinetic energy to recoil the nucleus. Simultaneously affected by the Coulomb effect of electrons outside the nucleus, the incident particle changes its direction of motion. The non elasticity part is used to excite the internal degree of freedom of the atom to excite or ionize the electron. When energetic particles with positive or negative charges pass near the target material atom, the Coulombic force between the incident particle and the extranuclear electrons of the target atom attracts or repels the electrons, thereby allowing them to obtain a portion of their energy. If the energy transmitted to the electron is sufficient to enable it to overcome the binding of the atom, then the electron detaches from the atom and becomes a free electron. At this point, the target atom separates into a free electron and an atom that has lost one electron - a positive ion, a process called ionization. If the energy transmitted from charged particles to electrons is small enough to free electrons from the bondage of atomic nuclei, but it can make electrons transition from low-energy state to high-energy state (making atoms excited), this process is called excitation.

explanation_cn: 原子中未填满电子壳层的电子轨道磁矩.自旋磁矩及原子核磁矩的总和。根据量子力学的结果，原子核磁矩很小，可忽略不计，原子磁矩只是那些未满壳层电子磁矩的总和。
explanation_en: The sum of the magnetic moment of the electron orbit, the spin magnetic moment and the magnetic moment of the atomic nucleus that are not filled with the electron shell in the atom. According to the results of quantum mechanics, the magnetic moment of the atomic nucleus is very small and can be ignored. The magnetic moment of an atom is just the sum of the magnetic moment of those electrons whose shell is not full.

explanation_cn: 又称原子偏聚溶体内在与某一组元原子相近邻的小范围内出现的同种原子的数目大于溶体中该组元原子平均值的现象。原子偏聚与溶体中原子的短程有序化正好相反。一般间溶体都会或多或少地显示出与理想的完全无序状态相偏离的现象，即若不出现短程有序，便会出现原子偏聚;反之亦然。原子偏聚的结果会在溶体中形成"原子团簇"，即由几个乃至上千个原子、分子或离子通过物理或化学结合力组成的相对稳定的微观或亚微观聚集体。是介于原子和分子与宏观间体之间的物质结构的一个层次。
explanation_en: It is also called the phenomenon that the number of the same kind of atoms in the solution is larger than the average value of the atoms of a component in the solution in a small range adjacent to the atoms of a component. Atomic segregation is the opposite of the short-range ordering of atoms in the solution. Generally, metasolvent will more or less show a deviation from the ideal completely disordered phase, that is, if there is no short-range order, atomic segregation will occur; The reverse is also true. The result of atomic segregation will form "atomic clusters" in the solution, that is, relatively stable microscopic or submicroscopic aggregates composed of several or even thousands of atoms, molecules or ions through physical or chemical binding force. It is a level of material structure between atoms and molecules and macroscopic intermediates.

explanation_cn: 符合核工业应用的锆。其主要要求是锆中铪元素的含量小于0.010%(质量分数），此外，对于镉、硼、铀、钍等元素也必须严格控制。
explanation_en: Zirconium suitable for nuclear industry applications. The main requirement is that the content of hafnium in zirconium is less than 0.010% (mass fraction). In addition, cadmium, boron, uranium, thorium and other elements must also be strictly controlled.

explanation_cn: 以有机卤化物为引发剂、过渡金属为催化剂。通过卤原子的可逆转移，实现反应活性种和大分子有机卤化物休眠种之间的可逆动态平衡反应，保持自由基活性种在较低的浓度，减少链增长自由基之间的不可逆双基终止副反应，使聚合反应得到有效控制的一种可控自由基聚合。大多数单体如甲基丙烯酸酯、丙烯酸酯、苯乙烯和电荷转移络合物等均可顺利地进行ATRP反应，实现可控均聚物、嵌段共聚物、接枝共聚物和梯度共聚物的合成。适用于众多工业聚合方法，如本体聚合、溶液聚合和乳液聚合等。ATRP的最大缺点是过渡金属络合物在聚合过程中不消耗，难以提纯，残留在聚合物中容易导致聚合物老化和其他副作用。
explanation_en: Organic halides were used as initiator and transition metals as catalysts. Through the reversible transfer of halogen atoms, the reversible dynamic equilibrium reaction between the reaction reactive species and the macromolecular organic halide dormant species is realized, the free radical reactive species is kept at a lower concentration, the irreversible double radical termination side reaction between the chain growth free radicals is reduced, so that the polymerization reaction can be effectively controlled as a controlled/living radical polymerization. Most monomer, such as methacrylate, acrylate, styrene and charge transfer complex, can successfully carry out ATRP reaction to realize the synthesis of controllable homopolymer, block copolymer, graft copolymer and gradient copolymer. It is applicable to many industrial polymerization methods, such as bulk polymerization, solution polymerization and emulsion polymerization. The biggest disadvantage of ATRP is that transition metal complexes are not consumed in the polymerization process, and it is difficult to purify them. The residues in polymer are easy to lead to aging of polymer and other side effects.

explanation_cn: 凝聚态物质中原子与原子间相互作用的势，它依赖于整个原子集合体系统的位形。最简单形式是粒子对势。只有先定出函数，才能计算凝聚态物质的各种（原子）静力学（平衡）和动力学性质，例如晶格动力学计算或晶体缺陷原子结构（位形）的计算等。确定可采用量子论方法(例如贋势法），也可以采用半经验法，后者的效果并不亚于前者。通常根据原子间势所作的计算结果都要与实验对比，以确定其待定系数。
explanation_en: The potential of the interaction between atoms in condensed matter depends on the configuration of the entire atomic assembly system. The simplest form is the particle pair potential. Only when the function is determined first can various (atomic) static (equilibrium) and dynamic properties of condensed matter be calculated, such as lattice dynamics calculation or calculation of atomic structure (configuration) of crystal defect, etc. Quantum theory methods (such as pseudopotential methods) or semi empirical methods can be used to determine the effectiveness of the latter, which is not inferior to the former. Generally, the calculated results based on the interatomic potential should be compared with the experiment to determine its undetermined coefficient.

explanation_cn: 从屠宰后动物身上剥离下来的动物皮，是制革或毛皮生产的对象，包括牛皮、猪皮、羊皮、马皮、驴皮、鱼皮、袋鼠皮、鸵鸟皮和鳄鱼皮等。哺乳动物的皮一般由表皮层、真皮层和皮下组织层三部分组成。除去皮下组织层，保留表皮层的毛被，经鞣制，即得毛皮。若将表皮层（包括毛被）也除去而鞣制，则产品为皮革。就本质而言，皮革与毛皮都是生皮真皮层中胶原纤维和鞣质相结合的产物。
explanation_en: The animal skins stripped from slaughtered animals are the objects of leather making or fur production, including cow skins, pig skins, sheep skins, horse skins, donkey skins, fish skins, kangaroo skins, ostrich skins and crocodile skins. Mammalian skin generally consists of the epidermis, corium layer and subcutaneous tissue layer. Remove the subcutaneous tissue layer, retain the coat of the epidermal layer, and obtain fur after tanning. If the epidermis (including the fur coat) is also removed and tanning, the product is leather. In essence, leather and fur are the combination products of collagen fiber and tannin in raw corium layer.

explanation_cn: 使原料皮吸收水分并使其结构基本回复到生皮状态的工序，同时除去原料皮上粪便、血迹等污物和防腐用的盐和防腐剂等。
explanation_en: The process of making raw skin absorb water and basically recovery its structure to the raw skin state, while removing feces, blood stains and other dirt on the raw skin, as well as salt and preservative for anti-corrosion.

explanation_cn: 利用物理或化学方法除去原料皮中的天然油脂的操作。包括去肉方法、皂化方法、乳化方法和干洗方法等。
explanation_en: The operation of removing natural grease from raw skin by physical or chemical methods. This includes methods such as meat removal, saponification, emulsification, and dry cleaning.

explanation_en: The defect of raw skin caused by the scratch of the grass spur attached to the animal fur during the growth process.

explanation_en: The classification of raw skin is based on different animal origins, different growth environments, different areas of raw skin with different hair properties such as size, fiber weaving and surface conditions.

explanation_cn: 原条经过造材后得到的带有树皮或不带树皮的圆木段。根据其用途分为直接使用、加工用和特级。直接使用指在使用过程中保持原来圆形木段的形状，不经过加工而直接使用的，如坑木、桩木、檩材、椽材、电柱等;加工原木指进一步加工才能使用的，按用途可进一步细分为建筑用材、家具用材、胶合板用材、车辆用材、纺织用材、乐器用材等;特级指可用于高级建筑装修、装饰及各种特殊需要的优质，如我国常用树种红松、水曲柳、核桃楸、樟木、楠木等。原木作为木材工业主要产品，必须符合国家木材标准，在标准中对每一种规定有树种、用途、尺寸及尺寸进级、公差、木材缺陷限度、尺寸检量及材质评定办法等。
explanation_en: A round wood segment with or without bark obtained from the production of raw wood. According to its purpose, it can be divided into direct use, processing use, and special grade. Direct use refers to the use of circular wood segments that remain in their original shape during use and are not processed, such as pit wood, pile wood, purlins, rafters, electrical columns, etc; Processed log refer to those that can be used only after further processing, and can be further subdivided into building materials, furniture materials, plywood materials, vehicle materials, textile materials, musical instrument materials, etc. according to their uses; Special grade refers to high-quality trees that can be used for high-end building decoration, decoration, and various special needs, such as commonly used tree species in China, such as Korean pine, water ash, walnut, camphor wood, nanmu, etc. As the main product of wood industry, log must comply with the national wood standard, which stipulates tree species, use, size and size grading, tolerance, wood defect limit, size inspection and material evaluation methods for each type.

explanation_cn: 纤维微细结构的基本组成单元，直径一般为10-30nm。在天然纤维中，指由若干微原纤按一定的有序结构结合在一起的更粗的大分子束。存在比微中更大的缝隙、孔洞和非晶区。合成纤维的层状结构比较简单，泛指纤维大分子平行有序排列的层状结构。
explanation_en: The basic constituent unit of fiber microstructure, with a diameter generally of 10-30nm. In natural fiber, it refers to larger molecular bundles that are combined by several micro fibrils according to a certain ordered structure. There are larger gaps, pores, and amorphous regions than in the micro. The layered structure of synthetic fiber is relatively simple, which generally refers to the layered structure of parallel and orderly arrangement of fiber macromolecule.

explanation_cn: 将钢件在略低于再结晶温度下加热以消除白应力的热处理工艺。通过再结晶之前的回复，在基本不改变组织状态仍保留加工强化作用的条件下，消除冷加工或焊接白应力。对于厚截面零件或大型焊接部件，为了避免在去应力退火处理过程中再次产生热应力以及可能发生的开裂，加热和冷却都必须缓慢进行。
explanation_en: Heat treatment in which steel parts are heated at a temperature slightly lower than recrystallization temperature to eliminate white stress. Through the recovery before recrystallization, the white stress of cold working or weld can be eliminated under the condition that the processing strengthening effect remains basically unchanged. For thick section parts or large weld parts, heating and cooling must be carried out slowly in order to avoid re generation of thermal stress and possible cracking during stress-relief annealing treatment.

explanation_cn: 又名褪漆剂或洗漆剂。指利用溶剂对覆盖物具有渗透溶胀作用，能有效去除各种基材表面油漆、涂层等旧漆膜，且不会损伤基材的一类工业助剂。脱漆剂的脱漆作用是通过溶解、渗透、溶胀、剥离和反应等一系列物理、化学过程实现的。国外的脱漆剂种类繁多，就有机脱漆剂而言，主要有三嗯烷类、甲基-2-吡咯烷酮类、卤代烃类、y-丁白酯类、有机酸类等。三嗯烷类脱漆剂只能脱除醇酸漆、聚氨酯漆等；N-甲基-2-吡咯烷酮类脱漆剂能脱除丙烯酸漆和聚氨酯漆；卤代烃类脱漆剂能脱除环氧漆、氨基漆、醇酸漆、丙烯酸漆、聚氨酯漆等，所需时间为5min-2h;y-丁白酯类及有机酸类脱漆剂能脱除双组分环氧漆和聚氨酯漆；有机酸类脱漆剂能脱除建筑涂料。国白有机脱漆剂中的主溶剂一般为二氯甲烷、二氯乙烷等低分子氯代烷烃有机物。
explanation_en: Also known as paint remover or paint cleaner. It refers to a class of industrial additive that use solvents to penetrate and swelling the covering, effectively remove old paint films such as paints and coatings on various substrate surfaces, and do not damage the substrate. The depainting effect of the paint remover is achieved through a series of physical and chemical processes such as dissolution, penetration, swelling, stripping and reaction. There are various types of paint removers abroad, and in terms of organic paint removers, there are mainly trialkanes, methyl-2-pyrrolidone ketones, halogenated hydrocarbons, y-butyrate esters, organic acids, etc. Trialkane paint removers can only remove alkyd paint, polyurethime paint, etc; N-methyl-2-pyrrolidone paint remover can remove acrylic paint and polyurethime paint; Halogenated hydrocarbon paint remover can remove epoxy paint, amino paint, alkyd paint, acrylic paint, polyurethime paint, etc., and the required time is 5min-2h; Y-Butadiene white ester and organic acid paint remover can remove two-component epoxy paint and polyurethime paint; Organic acid paint removers can remove architectural coatings. The main solvent in the organic paint remover of Guobai is generally low molecular weight chlorinated alkanes such as dichloromethane and dichloroethane.

name_en: optical parametric oscillation and amplification materials
explanation_cn: 参量振荡和放大材料，是材料学术语，指利用光学参量作用对透过激光进行放大或产生可调谐的激光参量振荡的非线性光学材料。要求材料有大的参量放大能力和宽的波长调谐能力，具有大的非线性光学系数，并且其相位匹配条件允许通过角度或温度的变化实现较大波长范围的参量作用。
explanation_en: Optical parametric oscillation and amplification materials is the academic term of materials, which refers to the nonlinear optical materials that amplifies or produces tunable laser parametric oscillation by using the effect of optical parameters. It is required that materials have large parametric amplification capability, wide wavelength tuning capability, large nonlinear optical coefficient, and their phase matching conditions allow the parametric effect in a large wavelength range to be realized through the change of angle or temperature.

explanation_cn: 在粉末压制中，阴模固定不动.上、下模冲从两端同时加压，称为双向压制。双向压制时.若两向压力相等，则低密度层位于压坯中部；反之，低密度层向低压端移动。双向压制的压坯密度分布较单向?制的均匀，密度差减小，适用于高径比大于2的零件。
explanation_en: In powder pressing, the female die is fixed and the upper and lower die punches are pressurized from both ends simultaneously, which is called double-action pressing. In double-action pressing, if the pressure in both directions is equal, the low density layer is located in the middle of compact; On the contrary, the low density layer moves to the low pressure end. The density distribution of double-action pressing compact is more than that of one-way pressing? It is uniform, and the density difference is reduced. It is suitable for parts with height diameter ratio greater than 2.

explanation_cn: 通常指的是一种药物或化合物，它包含两种不同类型的活性成分，这两种成分通常具有不同的药理作用。双基药旨在通过联合作用，同时针对多个病理过程或症状，提供更全面的治疗效果。
explanation_en: Usually refers to a drug or compound that contains two different types of active ingredients, which typically have different pharmacological effects. The purpose of double base propellant is to provide a more comprehensive therapeutic effect through combined action and at the same time for multiple pathological processes or symptoms.

explanation_cn: 俗称"D单元"。硅原子上带有二个有机基团并与二个氧原子键合的硅氧烷结构单元。
explanation_en: Commonly known as "Unit D". A siloxane structural unit with two organic groups on silicon atoms and bonded to two oxygen atoms.

explanation_cn: 通常发生在各向异性的材料中，如某些晶体或取向聚合物。当自然光束射入这些材料时，光波以不同速度沿着不同方向传播，导致折射光的出现。在取向聚合物中，这种现象可以通过测量光的双折射来分析材料的取向度。光波在聚合物中传播时，由于其各向异性特性，会导致不同方向上的折射率不同。这导致光波的折射方向也不同，从而产生双折射现象。双折射法是一种用于测量聚合物取向度的常见方法。在这个方法中，通过将聚合物置于浸液中，然后在偏光显微镜下观察其光学行为，可以直接测量其主折射率（沿取向方向）和副折射率（垂直于取向方向）。这些值可以用于计算双折射度，通常表示为Δn = n⊥ - n‖，其中n⊥表示垂直于取向方向的折射率，n‖表示平行于取向方向的折射率。
explanation_en: It usually occurs in anisotropic materials, such as some crystal or orientation polymer. When the natural light beam enters these materials, the light wave propagates in different directions at different speeds, leading to the appearance of refracted light. In orientation polymer, this phenomenon can be measured by the birefringence of light to analyze the degree of orientation of materials. When light wave propagates in polymer, because of its anisotropy, it will lead to different refractive index in different directions. This leads to different refractive directions of light waves, resulting in birefringence. Birefringence is a common method for measuring the degree of orientation of polymer. In this method, the main refractive index (along the orientation direction) and secondary refractive index (perpendicular to the orientation direction) of a polymer can be directly measured by placing the polymer in an immersion solution and observing its optical behavior under a polarized light microscopy. These values can be used to calculate birefringence, typically represented as Δ N=n ∨ - n ‖, where n ∨ represents the refractive index perpendicular to the orientation direction, and n ‖ represents the refractive index parallel to the orientation direction.

explanation_cn: 又称孪晶是两个或两个以上冋种晶体按一定的对称规律形成的规则连生体。相邻的两个单晶体相应的晶面、晶棱、角顶等要素并不完全平行，但可以通过某一反映、旋转或反伸（倒反）等对称操作使两个单体彼此重合或完全平行。对一些常呈现双晶的矿物，如长石类矿物，双晶类型是鉴定它们的重要依据之一。双晶对于某些晶体的应用也有很大影响，如压电石英、光学冰洲石等。
explanation_en: Also called twin is a regular continuum formed by two or more crystal according to a certain symmetry law. The corresponding crystal plane, crystal edge, corner top and other elements of the two adjacent single crystals are not completely parallel, but the two monomer can overlap or be completely parallel to each other through a certain reflection, rotation, backward extension (inversion) and other symmetrical operations. For some minerals that often present twin, such as feldspar minerals, twin type is one of the important basis for identifying them. Twin also has a great influence on the application of some crystal, such as piezoelectric quartze, optical iceland spar, etc.

explanation_cn: 将钢加热奥氏体化后先淬人冷却能力较强的介质（如水）中使之快速冷却.再转人冷却能力较弱的介质（如油或空气）中继续冷却，最终获得马氏体组织的热处理工艺。选择的冷却介质种类很多，如水-油、水-空、油-空、油-硝盐、水-硝盐、硝盐-油等，可根据钢的淬透性，形状、尺寸及变形要求来选定。T.件在第一种介质中的停留时间是双液淬火时非常重要的参数，若停留时间过长.起不到减少变形防止开裂的作用；若过早淬人第二种介质中，则由于工件温度尚高，介质冷却速度慢.在冷却过程中会发生非马氏体型组织转变而降低T件的使用性能。双液淬火的优点是可减小工件的内应力以及由此而引起的变形和开裂倾向》
explanation_en: After heating and austenitizing, the steel shall be quenched in a medium with strong cooling capacity (such as water) for rapid cooling, and then transferred to a medium with weak cooling capacity (such as oil or air) for further cooling, finally obtaining the heat treatment process of martensite structure. There are many kinds of cooling medium selected, such as water oil, water air, oil air, oil nitrate, water nitrate, nitrate oil, etc., which can be selected according to the hardenabilhy, shape, size and deformation requirements of steel. T. The residence time of the part in the first medium is a very important parameter during two-liquid quenching. If the residence time is too long, it can not reduce deformation and prevent cracking; If the workpiece is quenched into the second medium too early, the cooling rate of the medium is slow due to the high temperature of the workpiece. During the cooling process, the non martensite structure transformation will occur, which will reduce the service performance of the T-piece. The advantage of two-liquid quenching is that it can reduce the internal stress of the workpiece and the resulting deformation and cracking tendency

explanation_cn: 具有不同氢磷灰石（HA）和β-磷酸三钙（β-TCP）配比的陶瓷材料。最初，Nery等人提出了双相磷酸钙生物陶瓷的概念，用以描述他们制备的含有20% HA和80% β-TCP的复合陶瓷。这些双相磷酸钙生物陶瓷是通过在高于700°C的温度下烧结预备的，通常包括制备或生物来源的钙磷灰石。双相磷酸钙生物陶瓷的医用性能受多个因素的影响，包括宏观孔隙率、微观孔隙率、抗压强度、生物活性、降解性和电导率。其中，生物活性和降解性与HA/β-TCP比例以及结晶性有关。通常情况下，当HA/β-TCP比例较高且结晶性较好时，生物活性和降解性较差。双相磷酸钙生物陶瓷的一些常见产品包括Ceratite、MBCP、Triosite、HATRIC、TriboncSO和Osteosynt。这些材料主要用于整形外科手术、牙科修复、组织工程、药物负载和生长因子的负载等医疗应用。
explanation_en: Having different types of hydroxyapatite (HA) and β- Tricalcium phosphate（ β- TCP) proportioned ceramics materials. At first, Nery et al. put forward the concept of dual phase calcium phosphate biological cemmics to describe their preparations containing 20% HA and 80% β- TCP composition ceramics. These biphasic calcium phosphate biological cemmics are prepared by sintering at a temperature higher than 700 ° C, usually including calcium apatite from preparation or biological sources. The medical properties of biphase calcium phosphate biological cemmics are affected by many factors, including macro porosity, micro porosity, compressive strength, bioactivity, degradability and electric conductivity. Among them, bioactivity and degradability are related to HA/ β- TCP ratio and crystallinity are related. Usually, when HA/ β- When TCP proportion is high and crystallinity is good, bioactivity and degradability are poor. Some common products of two-phase calcium phosphate biological cemmics include Ceratite, MBCP, Triosite, HATRIC, TriboncSO and Osteosynt. These materials are mainly used in plastic surgery, dental repair, tissue engineering, drug loading, growth factors loading and other medical applications.

explanation_cn: 特指基体纟II织为10%?20%的岛状马氏体或贝氏体强化相以及80%?90%的铁素体相的低碳钢，也称DP钢。其软相铁素体确定了钢的屈服强度很低.而双相发生f!忭变形时相互约束而必须适当协调使得其加工硬化速韦很高.因而双相钢是抗拉强度较髙、冷成型性良好的冲版用钢。热轧双相钢终轧后控制冷却得到大M铁索体组织（需抑制珠光丨本转变）再快速冷却使剩余的奥氏体转变为马氏体；大最使用的冷轧双相钢则通过临界区退火后快速冷却而得到双相组织。双相钢广泛用于制作冷冲或深拉成型的复杂构件.如汽车大梁、轮穀、框架、抗大变形油气管线等。
explanation_en: Specifically, the substrate is woven at 10%? 20% island martensite or bainite strengthening phase and 80%? 90% ferrite phase low-cardon steel, also known as DP steel. The soft phase ferrite determines that the yield strength of steel is very low, while the dual phase occurs f! Due to mutual restraint and proper coordination during deformation, the work hardening velocity is very high. Therefore, dual-phase steel is a steel for stamping with high tensile strength and good cold formability. After finishing rolling of hot rolled dual-phase steel, control cooling to obtain large M ferrite structure (need to restrain pearlite transformation), and then rapid cooling to make the remaining austenite transformation into martensite; The most commonly used cold rolled dual-phase steel gets dual phase structure through rapid cooling after annealing in the critical zone. Dual phase steel is widely used to make complex components formed by cold punching or deep drawing, such as automobile girders, wheel valleys, frames, anti large deformation oil and gas pipelines, etc.

explanation_cn: 晶体中空位之间结合可以形成空位群，包括双空位。空位与溶质组元相似，在其周围存在有应变场，从而有应变能。两个空位作为近邻时.则可彼此松弛一部分应变能，因而体系的总能量下降。
explanation_en: The combination of vacancy in crystal can form vacancy groups, including divacancy. The vacancy is similar to the solute component, and there is a strain field around it, so there is strain energy. When two vacancy are near neighbors, they can relax part of the strain energy of each other, so the total energy of the system decreases.

explanation_cn: 又称双轴取向膜，是指在适当温度区间下对聚合物薄膜进行同步或分步沿着纵横两个方向进行一定倍数的拉伸，使聚合物分子链或结晶面在平行于薄膜平面方向上产生取向.然后热定型固定取向而制备得到的聚合物薄膜。与未双向拉伸膜相比，双轴拉伸膜的力学性能显著提高。常见的双轴拉伸膜的种类有聚烯烃类、聚酯类、聚酰胺类和聚苯乙烯类等，主要应用于食品及日用品的包装材料、产品的标签、与其他材料复合的基材以及电容器薄膜等。
explanation_en: Also known as biaxial oriented film, it refers to the preparation of polymer film by synchronously or step by step stretching a certain number of times in both vertical and horizontal directions at an appropriate temperature range, so that the polymer molecular chain or crystal plane produces orientation in the direction parallel to the film plane, and then heat setting and fixing orientation. Compared with the non biaxially stretched film, the mechanical properties of the biaxially oriented film were significantly improved. The common types of biaxially oriented film include polyolefin, polyester, polyamide and polystyrene, which are mainly used as packaging materials for food and daily necessities, product labels, composition substrates with other materials, and capacitor films.

explanation_cn: 指在主链中含有砜基和亚芳基的高分子化合物.代表性的有双酚-A聚砜、聚芳砜和聚醚砜三类.通.常把双酚-A聚砜简称为聚砜.它是将双酚A钠盐与4.4二氯二苯基砜在二甲基亚砜溶剂中缩聚而得的.树脂为琥珀色透明体，相对密度1.24.有突出的耐热、耐氧化、耐辐射、尺寸稳定性及介电性能，热稳定性优于聚碳酸酯，但耐候性、耐紫外线、耐有机溶剂性能较差，不宜在沸水中长期使用，难燃，离火后熄灭.可采用注射、挤出等热塑性塑料加工方法加工.用来制造有精密公差、热稳定、刚性和电绝缘的电子、电气元件和耐热、高刚性、高强度、持久的机械零件.与pmma、abs共混的改性聚砜加工性能得到改善.
explanation_en: It refers to macromolecule compounds containing sulfonyl group and arylene group in the main chain. The representative ones are bisphenol-A polysulfone, polyarysulfone and polyether sulphone. Generally, bisphenol-A polysulfone is called polysulfone for short. It is obtained by condensation of bisphenol-A sodium salt and 4.4 dichlorodiphenyl sulfone in dimethyl sulfoxide solvent. resin is amber transparent, with relative density of 1.24. It has outstanding heat resistance, oxidation resistance, radiation resistance, dimensional stability and dielectric properties, Thermal stability is better than that of polycarbonate, but its weather resistance, ultraviolet resistance and organic solvent resistance are poor. It is not suitable for long-term use in boiling water. It is difficult to ignite and extinguished after ignition. It can be processed by injection, extrusion and other thermoplastic plastics processing methods. It is used to manufacture electronic and electrical components with precise tolerance, thermal stability, rigidity and electrical insulation, and mechanical parts with heat resistance, high rigidity, high strength and durability The processability of modified polysulfone of ABS polymer blending was improved

name_cn: 双酚A二缩水甘油醚型乙烯酯树脂
name_en: diglycidyl ether of bisphenol A type vinyl ester resin
explanation_cn: 又称双酚A环氧乙烯酯不饱和聚酯.是由双酚A二缩水甘油醚(即E型环氧树脂)与丙烯酸或甲基丙烯酸反应所得的浅黄色固体或半固体树脂.也可以由苯乙烯稀释得棕黄色透明黏树脂溶液.可用过氧化苯甲酰-二甲基苯胺或过氧化环已酮蔡酸钴引发体系进行冷固化，后者固化速率较慢.采用苯乙烯或甲基丙烯酸甲酯作交联剂.它兼有环氧树脂的耐蚀性、可挠性和黏结性，又具有不饱和聚酯良好的成型工艺性.较双酚A不饱和聚酯有更好的耐酸(除铬酸外)、碱、热水等耐蚀性和更低的固化收缩率.在醛化浴(每升醛化浴介质中含硫酸315 g±4G，硫酸钠200 g±10g，甲醛32g±2g)、25%H2SO、15%HCl，5%HNO 3中80°C经168 h后的弯曲强度保留率均超过90%适用于制备手糊成型冷固化耐蚀性玻璃钢，制作大型塔槽类和玻纤含量大的纤维缠绕制品，以及防腐工程用涂料和黏结剂.在电气、交通运输、结构件等方面也有广泛应用.由该树脂为基体的高强度片状模塑料hmc可用于制造汽车轮箍、保险杠等，可减轻整车重量.
explanation_en: Also known as bisphenol A epoxy vinyl ester unsaturated polyester, it is a light yellow solid or semi-solid resin obtained by the reaction of bisphenol A diglycidyl ether (i.e. E-type epoxy resin) with acrylic acid or methacrylic acid. It can also be a brown yellow transparent resin solution diluted by styrene. It can be cold cured with benzoyl peroxide dimethylaniline or cobalt peroxide cyclohexanone cairate initiator system, The latter has a slower curing rate. Styrene or methyl methacrylate is used as a cross linking agent. It has both the corrosion resistance, flexibility and bonding properties of epoxy resin, and has good molding processability of unsaturated polyester. Compared with bisphenol A unsaturated polyester, it has better corrosion resistance (except chromic acid), alkali, hot water and other corrosion resistance and lower curing shrinkage. In the formaldehyde bath (each liter of formaldehyde bath medium contains 315 g ± 4G of sulfuric acid, 200 g ± 10 g of sodium sulfate, and 32 g ± 2 g of formaldehyde) The retention rate of bending strength after 168 h at 80 ° C in 25% H2SO, 15% HCl, and 5% HNO 3 is more than 90%. It is suitable for preparing hand lay-up cold curing corrosion resistant glass fiber reinforced plastics, making large tower troughs and fiber winding products with large glass fiber content, as well as coatings and adhesive for anti-corrosion engineering. It is also widely used in electrical, transportation, structural parts, etc. The high-strength sheet molding plastics hmc based on this resin can be used to manufacture automobile tires, bumpers, etc, It can reduce the weight of the entire vehicle

name_cn: 双酚A型不饱和聚酯树脂
name_en: bisphenol A type unsaturated polyester resin
explanation_cn: 一类大分子链含有双酚A重复单元的线型不饱和聚酯树脂，由双酚A与环氧乙(丙)烷加成，再与顺(反)丁烯二酸(酐)、乙二醇或丙二醇进行缩聚制得.见不饱和聚酯树脂.
explanation_en: A kind of linear unsaturated polyester resin with bisphenol A repeating unit in macromolecule chain is prepared by addition of bisphenol A with ethylene (propylene) oxide, and polycondensation with maleic (trans) butanedioic acid (anhydride), ethylene glycol or propylene glycol. See unsaturated polyester resin

explanation_cn: 含二酚基丙烷结构的缩水甘油醚通用型环氧树脂，国内称E型环氧树脂.随分子量和聚合度(N)的不同,其性状呈黏稠液体至脆性固体.常用脂肪族或芳香族多元胺及其改性物、低分子量聚酰胺、咪唑类化合物、酸酐作固化剂，固化树脂具有优良的黏结性、电气绝缘性、耐化学药品性、耐热性和物理机械性能.固化收缩率低，收缩率0.1%-0.4%，相对密度1.11-1.40，拉伸强度29.4-88.3 MPa，伸长率3.6%-6.0%，拉伸弹性模量1.96×103 MPa，压缩强度108-147 MPa，弯曲强度93.2-147 MPa，冲击强度(缺口)0.88-4.2kJ/m2，洛氏硬度M80-110，线胀系数(4-7)X10-5K-1，热变形温度50-120 C，体积电阻率1011-1042cm，相对介电常数(1 MHz)3.3-4.0，介质损耗因子(1MHz) 0.03-0.05，介电强度10- 20MV/m，耐电弧性45-120 s。树脂双酚A与环氧氯丙烷在碱存在下缩聚而成，原料配比和反应条件不同，树脂的分子量不同.该环氧树脂也存在耐候性差、冲击强度低及不太耐高温等缺点.高分子量环氧树脂主要是制作保护涂层，如罐头内壁涂料、汽车和船舶底漆、管道内外涂层.低分子量环氧树脂多用于配制.胶黏剂、包装和灌封料、玻璃纤维增强材料以及泡沫塑料.
explanation_en: Glycidyl ether general-purpose epoxy resin containing diphenylpropane structure is called E-type epoxy resin in China. With different molecular weight and polymerization degree (N), its properties are viscous liquid to brittle solid. Aliphatic or aromatic polyamines and their modifiers, low molecular weight polyamides, imidazole compounds, and acid anhydride are commonly used as curing agent. curing resin has excellent adhesion, electrical insulation, chemical resistance Heat resistance and physical and mechanical properties. Low curing shrinkage, shrinkage 0.1% -0.4%, relative density 1.11-1.40, tensile strength 29.4-88.3 MPa, elongation 3.6% -6.0%, tensile elastic modulus 1.96 × 103 MPa, compressive strength 108-147 MPa, bending strength 93.2-147 MPa, impact strength (notch) 0.88-4.2kJ/m2, Rockwell hardness M80-110, linear expansion coefficient (4-7) X10-5K-1, heat deflection temperature 50-120 C, coefficient of volume resistance 1011-1042cm, relative dielectric constant (1 MHz) 3.3-4.0, dielectric loss factor (1MHz) 0.03-0.05, dielectric strength 10-20MV/m, arc resistance 45-120 s. The resin bisphenol A and epichlorohydrin are polycondensated in the presence of alkali. The raw material ratio and reaction conditions are different, and the molecular weight of the resin is different. The epoxy resin also has the disadvantages of poor weather resistance, low impact strength, and low temperature resistance. The macromolecule weight epoxy resin is mainly used to make protective coatings, such as coatings for the inner wall of cans, primer for automobiles and ships, and internal and external coatings for pipes. The low molecular weight epoxy resin is mostly used for preparation. adhesive, packaging and potting materials Glass fiber reinforcement materials and foamed plastics

name_cn: 双酚A环氧乙烯酯不饱和聚酯
name_en: bisphenol A epoxy vinyl ester unsaturated polyester
explanation_cn: 一种特殊类型的聚酯树脂，通常用于复合材料和涂料等应用。成分：这种聚酯树脂的主要成分包括双酚A（Bisphenol A）和环氧乙烯酯（epoxy ethyl ester）。不饱和聚酯通常还包含不饱和单体，如甲基丙烯酸、苯乙烯等，以增加其交联性和固化能力。性质：双酚A环氧乙烯酯不饱和聚酯具有出色的耐化学腐蚀性、耐溶剂性和耐热性。它们还具有优良的机械性能、绝缘性能和耐候性。这种聚酯通常是不透明的，呈固体或半固体形态。用途：这种聚酯树脂常用于制备复合材料，如玻璃纤维增强聚合物（通常是玻璃纤维增强不饱和聚酯），用于制造玻璃钢（或称玻璃纤维增强塑料，GRP）。它们还用于生产各种复杂形状的零件，如船体、储罐、水槽、管道、风力发电叶片等。此外，这种不饱和聚酯也用于涂料和印刷油墨等应用。固化：这种聚酯树脂通常需要与固化剂一起使用，以在制备过程中实现交联和固化。典型的固化方法包括热固化和光固化。环境和健康考虑：由于双酚A是这种聚酯的成分之一，一些研究和担忧与双酚A的潜在环境和健康风险有关。因此，在使用这种材料时，需要遵循相关法规和安全操作规程。
explanation_en: A special type of polyester resin, usually used in applications such as composite materials and coatings. Ingredients: The main components of this polyester resin include bisphenol A and epoxy ethylene ester. Unsaturated polyester usually also contains unsaturated monomer, such as methacrylic acid, styrene, etc., to increase its crosslinking and curing ability. Property: Bisphenol A epoxy vinyl ester unsaturated polyester has excellent chemical corrosion resistance, solvent resistance, and heat resistance. They also have excellent mechanical properties, insulation properties, and weather resistance. This type of polyester is usually opaque and appears in a solid or semi solid form. Use: This polyester resin is commonly used to prepare composite materials, such as glass fiber reinforced polymer (usually glass fiber reinforced unsaturated polyester), and is used to manufacture glass fiber reinforced plastics (or glass fiber reinforced plastics, GRP). They are also used to produce various complex shaped parts, such as hulls, tanks, tanks, pipelines, wind turbine blades, etc. In addition, this unsaturated polyester is also used in applications such as coatings and printing ink. Curing: This polyester resin usually needs to be used together with curing agent to achieve crosslinking and curing in the preparation process. Typical curing methods include thermal curing and light curing. Environmental and health considerations: As bisphenol A is one of the components of this polyester, some studies and concerns are related to the potential environmental and health risks of bisphenol A. Therefore, when using this materials, it is necessary to follow the relevant regulations and safe operation procedures.

explanation_cn: 芳香族聚碳酸酯，是--种高抗冲、透明、热塑性聚合物，是五大通用工程塑料之一·.工业中通常采用光气法和酯交换法制备.光气法利用光气和双酚A为原料，常温、常压下经碱催化，双酚钠盐与光气进行界面缩聚生成聚碳酸酯.酯交换法是先通过苯酚与光气反应，生成碳酸二苯酯，然后在高温、高真空下进行酯交换反应，生成聚碳酸酯.前者分子量高，占国外产量90%，详见聚碳酸酯。
explanation_en: Aromatic polycarbonate is a kind of high impact resistant, transparent, thermoplastic polymer, and one of the five general engineering plastics. It is usually prepared by phosgene method and transesterification method in industry. Phosgene method uses phosgene and bisphenol A as raw materials, and generates polycarbonate through interfacial polycondensation of bisphenol sodium salt and phosgene under normal temperature and pressure. The transesterification method is to first react phenol and phosgene to generate diphenyl carbonate, and then, at high temperature Transesterification reaction is carried out under high vacuum to generate polycarbonate. The former has high molecular weight, accounting for 90% of the foreign output. See polycarbonate for details.

explanation_cn: 是指将两种或者两种以上不同的金属用铸造、熔炼等方法制造成完整的工件.使工件具有良好的耐磨性能。通常一种金属具有良好的力学性能，另外一种或几种金属或合金具有优异的耐磨性能，以达到使用要求。
explanation_en: It refers to making two or more different metals into complete workpieces by foundry, melting and other methods, so that the workpieces have good wear resistance. Generally, one metal has good mechanical properties, and another or several metals or alloy have excellent wear resistance to meet the use requirements.

name_cn: 双马来酰亚胺树脂基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以双马来酰亚胺树脂为基体的复合材料。双马来酰亚胺（BM1)是由马来酸酐和芳香二胺经缩合反应得到的热固性树脂.分子量小，分子两端带有活泼双键.单体在催化剂或热作用下可发生自聚反应，或与二元胺、酰肼、酰胺、硫氢基和羟基等含活泼氢的化合物发生加成反应，也吋与环氧树脂、含不饱和键化合物及其他BM1单体发生共聚反应。双马来酰亚胺树脂具有优异的耐热性（可在180?200°C下长期使用）、电绝缘性、透波性、阻燃性、耐候性.兼具良好的力学性能和尺寸稳定性原材料来源广、成本低。但存在着熔点高、溶解性差、成型温度高、固化物脆性大、断裂应变低等缺点，用于高性能复合材料基体必须增韧改性。增强体主要有碳纤维、玻璃纤维及甘-织物等。工艺性良好，同化时无小分子排出，不需较高压力，成型中预浸料黏度变化小。其成型工艺类似于环氧树脂.适用于热压（真空袋、模压、热压罐）成型、缠绕成型、拉挤成型、液体成型等方法。目前这类复合材料作为绝缘材料、耐高温、湿热的主承力或次承力结构材料，被广泛应用于航空航天、机械制造、电子电气等领域.如碳纤维增强双马来酰亚胺树脂基复合材料机身、主翼、垂尾翼、平尾翼及蒙皮等。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on bismaleimide resin. Bismaleimide (BM1) is a thermosetting resin obtained by condensation reaction of maleic anhydride and aromatic diamine. Its molecular weight is small and there are active double bonds at both ends of the molecule. monomer can undergo self polymerization under catalyst or thermal action, or addition reaction with binary amine, hydrazide, amide, sulfhydryl, hydroxyl and other compounds containing active hydrogen, or copolymerization reaction with epoxy resin, compounds containing unsaturated bonds and other BM1 monomer. Bismaleimide resin has excellent heat resistance (long-term use at 180? 200 ° C), electrical insulation, wave transmission, flame retardancy, weather resistance, good mechanical properties and dimensional stability. Raw materials are widely sourced and cost is low. However, there are some shortcomings, such as high melting point, poor solubility, high molding temperature, high brittleness of cured materials, low fracture strain, etc., so matrix used for high-performance composite materials must be toughened. Reinforcement mainly includes carbon fiber, glass fiber and Gan fabric. Good processability, no small molecules are discharged during assimilation, no higher pressure is required, and the viscosity of prepreg changes little during molding. Its molding process is similar to that of epoxy resin. It is suitable for hot pressing (vacuum bag, molding, autoclave) molding, filament winding, pultrusion process, liquid molding and other methods. At present, such composite materials are widely used in aerospace, machinery manufacturing, electronics and electrical fields as insulation materials, high temperature resistant, hygrothermal main bearing or secondary bearing structural materials, such as carbon fiber reinforced bismaleimide resin matrix composite fuselage, main wing, vertical tail wing, flat tail wing and skin.

name_cn: 双（2,2-硝基丙基）缩乙醛及缩甲醛混合物
name_en: mixture of bis (2,2-dinitro propyl) formal and bis (2,2-dinitro propyl) acetal
explanation_cn: 简称BDNPF/A,A3，低感度偕二硝基类含能增塑剂的一种.是双（2.2-硝基丙基）缩乙醛和双缩甲醛等质ft比的混合物,，BDNPF/A的合成方法主要冇硝酸银氣化硝化法、氯化法和环境友好的氧化硝化法。4种方法均以硝基乙烷为起始原料.经主要的羟甲基化反应和硝化反应制得关键中间体2,2-二硝基丙醇后再分别与乙醛和甲醛进行缩合。该混合物为淡黄色液体.具有非常低的蒸气压和适宜的黏度，与推进剂和炸药组分相容性良好，为B级爆炸物。BDNPF/A主要用于双基推进剂、改性双基推进剂等推进剂配方和聚合物黏结炸药等混合炸药配方。丨
explanation_en: It is referred to as BDNPF/A, A3, a kind of low sensitivity gemini dinitro energetic plasticizer. It is a mixture of bis (2.2-nitropropyl) acetaldehyde and formaldehyde with the same mass ratio. The synthesis methods of BDNPF/A mainly include silver nitrate gasification and nitration, chlorination and environmentally friendly oxidation and nitration. All four methods use nitroethane as the starting material. The key intermediate, 2,2-dinitropanol, is synthesized through the main hydroxymethylation and nitration reactions, and then condensed with acetaldehyde and formaldehyde, respectively. The mixture is light yellow liquid, with very low vapor pressure and suitable viscosity, and good compatibility with propellant and explosive components. It is a Class B explosive. BDNPF/A is mainly used in propellant formulations such as double base propellant and modified double base propellant, and composite explosive formulations such as polymer bonded explosive. |

explanation_cn: 化合物半导体中一种原子占据了另一种原子的晶格位置而形成的缺陷。以GaAs为例，Ga原子占据了As原子格点位置称之为As反位缺陷。
explanation_en: A defect formed in a compound semiconductor when one atom occupies the lattice position of another atom. Taking GaAs as an example, Ga atoms occupy the lattice position of As atoms, which is called as As anti-site defect.

explanation_cn: 通常指在高分子中加入少量增塑剂时，不仅没有起到降低高分子的玻璃化转变温度和流动温度、提高树脂流动性和柔软性的作用，反而因大分子链活动能力增大使分子有序化产生微晶，或者通过增塑剂桥接增加分子间相互作用力，最终导致树脂产生硬化的效应。
explanation_en: Usually, when a small amount of plasticizer is added to macromolecule, it does not reduce the glass transition temperature and flowing temperature of macromolecule, and improve the flow ability and flexibility of resin. Instead, because the activity ability of macromolecular chain increases, molecules will be ordered to produce microcrystals, or the intermolecular interaction force will be increased through plasticizer bridging, which will eventually lead to the hardening effect of resin.

explanation_cn: 为减少漏出堆芯的中子数量，在堆芯周围设置反射层所用的材料。对反射层材料的要求与慢化剂相同，要求其散射截面要大，吸收截面要小。
explanation_en: In order to reduce the number of neutrons leaking out of the core, the materials used for the reflector is set around the core. The requirements for reflector materials are the same as those for moderators, which require a large scattering cross section and a small absorption cross section.

explanation_cn: 能反射屏蔽电磁波，从而衰减其辐射的织物。电磁屏蔽织物主要有喷涂型电磁波屏蔽织物、金属纤维混编或混纺型电磁波屏蔽织物、金属镀化型电磁波屏蔽织物、纳米型电磁波屏蔽织物等。
explanation_en: A fabric that can reflect and shield electromagnetic waves, thereby attenuating their radiation. Electromagnetic shielding fabric mainly include spraying electromagnetic shielding fabrics, metal fiber blended or blended electromagnetic shielding fabrics, metal plated electromagnetic shielding fabrics, nano electromagnetic shielding fabrics, etc.

explanation_cn: 反射膜可分为两大类，一类是金属反射膜，一类是全电介质反射膜。此外，还有把两者结合起来的金属电介质反射膜。
explanation_en: The optical reflection film can be divided into two categories, one is metal optical reflection film, the other is all dielectric optical reflection film. In addition, there is a metal dielectric optical reflection film that combines the two.

explanation_cn: 指在大分子主链或侧链上含有反应性基团的纤维。这种反应性基团可与染料、稳定剂或其他功能化合物起反应而得到稳定的体系以改善纤维的性能（如染料固着性等）。
explanation_en: It refers to the fiber containing reactive groups on the main chain or side chain of macromolecule. This reactive group can react with dye or dyestuffc, stabilizer or other functional compounds to obtain a stable system to improve the performance of the fiber (such as the fixation of dye or dyestuffc, etc.).

explanation_cn: 以含有活性基团的线型聚合物或者低分子量的聚合物为基料的胶黏剂，在一定的条件下发生化学反应，聚合或者交联成线型或者体型结构的固化物胶接层，故亦称为化学反应固化胶黏剂。
explanation_en: The adhesive with linear polymer containing active groups or low molecular weight polymer as the base material is also called chemical reaction curing adhesive because it can undergo chemical reaction, polymerization or cross-linking to form a linear or body structure curing adhesive layer under certain conditions.

explanation_cn: 将反应堆中产生的热量带出堆外的介质，又称载热剂。冷却剂的主要功能是载出裂变能使反应堆部件不致温度过高而失效，把裂变能转换成有用的能量形式。
explanation_en: The medium that takes the heat generated in the reactor out of the reactor is also called heat carrier. The main function of coolant is to carry fission energy to prevent reactor components from overheating and failure, and to convert fission energy into useful forms of energy.

explanation_cn: 容纳反应堆堆芯及一回路冷却剂，防止放射性外逸，构成一回路边界的材料。由于核反应堆要求高度的安全性，其压力容器除应满足常规压力容器要求外，还要求：①辐射损伤小，在设计使用寿命之前不应引起脆性破坏转变温度急速上升；②对失稳破坏具有高度的抵抗能力；③不因焊接及热处理而引起热脆化。
explanation_en: It is used to contain the reactor core and primary coolant, prevent radioactive escape, and constitute the materials of the primary boundary. As nuclear reactor requires high safety, its pressure vessel shall not only meet the requirements of conventional pressure vessel, but also: ① irmdiatiem damage is small, and brittle failure transformation temperature shall not rise sharply before the design service life; ② Highly resistant to instability and damage; ③ No heat embrittlement due to weld and heat treatment.

explanation_cn: 又称RIM尼龙。由低黏度高活性的聚酰胺原料流体经过高压碰撞混合后，注入模具，在阴离子催化剂以及聚合引发剂的作用下发生聚合反应，直接固化成聚合物部件。
explanation_en: Also known as rim nylon. The polyamide raw material fluid with low viscosity and high activity is mixed by high pressure collision, then injected into the mold. Under the action of anionic catalyst and polymerization initiator, polymerization reaction takes place and polymer components are directly curing.

explanation_cn: 成型过程中有化学反应的一种注射成型方法，该工艺所用原料不是聚合物，而是将两种或两种以上液态单体或预聚物，以一定比例分别加到混合头中，在加压下高速混合均匀，立即注射到闭合模具中，在模具内完成聚合、交联、固化等化学反应并形成制品的工艺过程。
explanation_en: A injection molding method with chemical reaction in the process of molding. The raw material used in this process is not polymer, but two or more liquid monomer or prepolymer are added to the mixing head in a certain proportion, mixed evenly at a high speed under pressure, immediately injected into a closed mold, and the process of polymerization, crosslinking, curing and other chemical reactions are completed in the mold to form products.

name_en: reaction sintered silicon car bide ceramics
explanation_cn: 又称反应结合碳化硅陶瓷或自结合碳化硅陶瓷。以碳化硅、硅和碳为原料，经成型后在高温下硅与碳反应生成碳化硅，将坯体中的碳化硅结合在一起，得到碳化硅陶瓷材料。
explanation_en: It is also called reaction bonded silicon carbide ceramic or self-bonded silicon carbide ceramic. With silicon carbide, silicon and carbon as raw materials, after forming, silicon and carbon react to form silicon carbide at high temperature, and then combine the silicon carbide in the green body to obtain silicon carbide ceramics ceramic materials.

explanation_cn: 把粉末混合料装在压模中，同时加热加压，引起燃烧反应并利用粉末之间的反应和放热，使成形、合成和烧结在同一工序中完成，在较低温度和较较短时间内即可获得致密制品的技术。反应热压可在较低压力下使产物迅速获得冷压加反应烧结所达不到的密度，并可在比普通热压低的温度和短的时间内完成致密化，也容易得到细小晶粒组织。
explanation_en: The technology of loading powder mixture into the die, heating and pressurizing at the same time, causing combustion reaction, and making use of the reaction and exothermic between powder, so that forming, synthesis and sintering can be completed in the same process, and dense products can be obtained at a lower temperature and in a shorter time. Reactive hot pressing can rapidly obtain density that can not be achieved by cold pressing plus reactive sintering under lower pressure, and can complete densification at a lower temperature and in a shorter time than ordinary hot pressing, and it is also easy to obtain fine grain structure.

explanation_cn: 以传统等静压为基础，把粉末混合物或压坯真空封装于密闭包套内并置于高压容器中，同时施加高温高压，进行材料合成并完成烧结致密化。
explanation_en: On the basis of traditional isostatic pressing, powder mixture or compact is vacuum sealed in an airtight can and placed in a high-pressure container. At the same time, high temperature and high pressure are applied to synthesize materials and complete sintering densification.

explanation_cn: 利用爆炸产生的冲击波实现不同粉末间的反应合成新材料并致密化。特点是借爆炸产生的高压高温直接合成致密材料。
explanation_en: The reaction between different powder is realized by using the shock wave generated by explosion to synthesize new materials and densification them. It is characterized by direct synthesis of dense materials under high pressure and temperature generated by explosion.

explanation_cn: 指反式1,4-结构含量达80%以上的聚丁二烯。反式1,4聚丁二烯是一种结晶高聚物，结晶熔点在135~150°C之间，在室温时即已结晶，成为树脂状。与杜仲橡胶、巴拉塔橡胶等具有相似的性质，其特点是：定伸应力大、硬度高、耐磨性能好.具有耐酸、碱及各种溶剂的特点，加工性能较好。反式1，4-聚丁二烯橡胶可用于制造鞋底、地板、垫圈、电气制品等"
explanation_en: Refers to polybutadiene with a trans 1,4-structure content of over 80%. Trans 1,4 polybutadiene is a crystalline polymer with a crystallization melting point of 135~150 ° C. It has crystallized at room temperature and becomes resin. It has similar properties with Eucommia rubber, Balata rubber, etc. It is characterized by high constant tensile stress, high hardness, good wear resistance, acid resistance, alkali resistance and various solvents, and good processing performance. Trans 1,4- polybutadiene rubber rubber can be used to manufacture shoe soles, floors, gaskets, electrical products, etc“

explanation_cn: 反式1,4结构含量98%左右的异戊橡胶.与巴拉塔胶一致.结晶度高，链规整度高，玻璃化温度60~53°C；,熔点55~60°C,抗臭氧，对酸或碱、脂肪酸、酮类稳定，溶于大多数芳烃、醚、二硫化碳、卤代烃等，抗屈挠强度高，加工性、电绝缘性、耐水性都好，并有优良的成膜性能。合成方法采用钒-铝或钒-钛-铝催化体系在烃类溶剂中生产。分子链中的双键结构与顺式聚异戊二烯橡胶相反，因而两者的性能有很大差异。具有以下特点：①反式1,4-聚异戊二烯橡胶的反式链节等同周期短，室温下易以折叠结晶存在，当它未硫化时，是一种热塑性塑料，是制作医用"石膏"绷带、夹板、假肢的理想材料；②反式1，4-聚异戊二烯橡胶含有大量双键，当中度硫化交联时，交联点间的链段仍能热运动结晶，表现为结晶性网络结构高分子，即热致弹性体性质.是一种性能优异的形状记忆功能材料，当硫化达到一个临界交联密度即成为无定形交联网络.即普通橡胶弹性体，其耐疲劳性能优异、定伸应力高、滚动阻力小.可用于制造子午线轮胎。
explanation_en: Isoprene rubber with trans 1,4 structure content of about 98% is consistent with balata rubber. It has high crystallinity, high chain regularity, and glass transition temperature of 60~53 ° C;, Melting point 55~60 ° C, ozone resistant, stable to acids or bases, fatty acids, ketones, soluble in most aromatics, ethers, carbon disulfide, halocarbons, etc., high flexural strength, good processability, electrical insulation, water resistance, and excellent film forming performance. The synthesis method uses a vanadium aluminum or vanadium titanium aluminum catalytic system to produce in hydrocarbon solvents. The double bond structure in the molecular chain is opposite to that of cis polyisoprene rubber, so the properties of the two are very different. It has the following characteristics: ① The trans link of trans-1,4-polyisoprene rubber has a short equivalent period and is easy to exist in folded crystals at room temperature. When it is not vulcanization, it is a thermoplastic plastics and an ideal materials for making medical "gypsum" bandages, splints and artificial limbs; ② Trans 1,4-neneneba polyisoprene rubber contains a large number of double bonds. When crosslinking is moderately vulcanization, the chain segment between crosslinking points can still crystallize in thermal motion, which is characterized by crystalline network structure macromolecule, that is, thermally induced elasticity properties. It is a shape memory functional materials with excellent performance. When vulcanization reaches a critical crosslinking density, it becomes an amorphous crosslinking network. That is, ordinary rubber elasticity, which has excellent fatigue resistance, high constant tensile stress Low rolling resistance, suitable for manufacturing radial tires.

explanation_cn: 即物质的发射光波长短于激发光波长的反常现象。如上转换发光以及多光子发光都属于反斯托克斯效应。
explanation_en: The abnormal phenomenon where the emission wavelength of a substance is longer than the excitation wavelength. The above conversion luminescence and multiphoton luminescence belong to anti Stokes effect.

explanation_cn: 参见长石。
explanation_en: See feldspar.

explanation_cn: 表示被测多晶材料各晶粒的平行某特征外观方向的晶向在晶体学空间中分布的维极射赤道平面投影图。即以晶体学方向为参照坐标系，特别是以晶体的重要的低指数晶向为此坐标系的三个坐标轴，而将多晶材料中各晶粒平行于材料的特征外观方向的晶向均标示出来，因而表现出该特征外观方向在晶体空间中的分布。
explanation_en: The projection diagram of the dimensional polar equatorial plane showing the distribution of the crystal directions of each grain of the tested polycrystal materials parallel to a characteristic appearance direction in the crystallographic space. That is, the crystallographic direction is taken as the reference coordinate system, especially the important low index crystal direction of crystal is taken as the three coordinate axes of the coordinate system, and the crystal directions of each grain in polycrystal materials parallel to the characteristic appearance direction of materials are marked, thus showing the distribution of the characteristic appearance direction in the crystal space.

explanation_cn: 又称为RO膜，是一种模拟生物半透膜制成的额度孔径范围为0.1-l.Onm的、以压力为推动力的人工半透分离膜。当膜料液端的压力高于料液的渗透压时，料液中的溶剂在压力作用下逆着自然渗透的方向反向渗透通过膜到达低压侧，使溶剂从料液中分离。
explanation_en: Also known as ro membrane, it is an artificial semi permeable separation membrane with a quota pore size of 0.1-l.Onm, which is made by simulating biological semi permeable membrane and is driven by pressure. When the pressure at the liquid end of the membrane material is higher than the osmotic pressure of the material liquid, the solvent in the material liquid reverses the direction of natural permeation through the membrane to the low-pressure side under pressure, causing the solvent to separate from the material liquid.

explanation_cn: 以水溶性单体的水溶液作为分散相、与水不混溶的有机溶剂作为连续相，在乳化剂作用下形成油包水型乳液而进行的乳液聚合。
explanation_en: The emulsion polymerization is carried out by taking the aqueous solution of water-soluble monomer as the dispersion phase, and the organic solvent that is not miscible with water as the continuous phase to form a water in oil lotion under the action of emulsifier.

explanation_cn: 将水相反应物分散在油溶性介质中，单体水溶液作为水相液滴或粒子，水溶性引发剂溶解于水相中引发聚合的方法。
explanation_en: The method of dispersing aqueous reactants in oil soluble medium, taking monomer aqueous solution as aqueous droplets or particles, and dissolving water-soluble initiator in aqueous phase to initiate polymerization.

explanation_cn: 有序固溶体晶内出现的一些组元原子所占点阵位置正好相反的区域组成的亚组织。相邻区域之间的界面称反相畴界。
explanation_en: A sub organization composed of regions where the lattice positions of some component atoms in ordered solid solution crystals are exactly opposite. The interface between adjacent regions is called antiphase domain boundary.

explanation_cn: 参见反相畴。
explanation_en: See antiphase domain.

explanation_cn: 正负离子位置恰好与萤石型结构相反的一类A2B型化合物的晶体结构。它属立方晶系，面心立方点阵，空间群为F3m3。
explanation_en: The crystal structure of a class of A2B type compounds whose positron and anion positions are exactly opposite to the fluorite structure. It belongs to cubic crystal system, face centered cubic lattice, and the space group is F3m3.

explanation_cn: 某些材料由极化强度相等而极性相反的两个子晶格组成，宏观上不呈现净电偶极矩现象；具有这种性质的材料称反铁电体。宏观上反铁电体的自发极化强度为零，因此无电滞回线。
explanation_en: Some materials are composed of two sublattices with equal polarization but opposite polarity, and do not show the phenomenon of net electric dipole moment on the macro scale; Materials with this property are called antiferroelectrics. Macroscopically, the spontaneous polarization intensity of the anti ferroelectric body is zero, so there is no hysteresis loop.

explanation_cn: 在一定温度范围内偶极子呈反平行排列，宏观上不呈现净电偶极矩，具有这种性质的材料称为反铁电体材料。常见的反铁电材料有锆酸铅、铪酸铅、铌酸钠、磷酸二氢铵、碘酸铵及三氧化钨等。
explanation_en: In a certain temperature range, the dipoles are in an antiparallel arrangement, and do not show a net electric dipole moment on the macro scale. materials with this property are called antiferroelectric materials. Common antiferroelwtric materials include lead zirconate, lead hafnate, sodium niobate, ammonium dihydrogen phosphate, ammonium iodate and tungsten trioxide.

explanation_cn: 在足够的外部电场作用下，能够由反铁电状态转变为铁电状态的铁电液晶分子。其响应速度快，能实现微秒量级的响应，可用于制备反铁电液晶器件的材料。
explanation_en: Ferroelectric liquid crystal molecules that can change from antiferroelectric state to ferroelectric state under sufficient external electric field. Its fast response speed and microsecond response can be achieved, which can be used to prepare materials for anti ferroelectric liquid crystal devices.

explanation_cn: 主晶相为反铁电体的陶瓷。反铁电材料主要用作储能器和电压调节元件。
explanation_en: Ceramics whose main crystal phase is anti ferroelectric body. Antiferroelwtric materials is mainly used as energy storage device and voltage regulating element.

explanation_cn: 一种独特的磁有序现象。在反铁磁性材料中，原子或分子磁矩严格按照近邻自旋方向相反的规律排列。因此，反铁磁性与铁磁性和亚铁磁性一样是一种磁有序现象。
explanation_en: A unique magnetic ordering phenomenon. In amiferromagnetifim materials, the magnetic moment of atoms or molecules is arranged in strict accordance with the law that the spin direction of the nearest neighbor is opposite. Therefore, anti ferromagnetism, like ferromagnetism and ferrimagnetism, is a phenomenon of magnetic order.

explanation_cn: 物体内部以某种方式吸收能量后转化为光辐射的过程。光辐射按照其能量的转化过程可分为平衡辐射和非平衡辐射。发光是指光辐射中非平衡辐射的部分。任何物体只要具有一定的温度，则该物体必定具有与此温度下处于热平衡状态的热辐射。
explanation_en: The process in which an object absorbs energy in a certain way and converts it into light radiation. Light radiation can be divided into equilibrium radiation and non equilibrium radiation according to its energy conversion process. Luminescence refers to the non-equilibrium part of light radiation. Any object that has a certain temperature must have thermal radiation that is in thermal equilibrium with that temperature.

explanation_cn: 燃烧时产生有色光信号的烟火药剂。常用的有红、黄、绿、蓝四种色光。装填信号器材中，用来联络和识别目标。
explanation_en: Pyrotechnic composition that produces colored light signals during combustion. There are four commonly used colors of light: red, yellow, green, and blue. Used to connect and identify targets in signal equipment.

explanation_cn: 在搪瓷釉中渗入发光物质，以各种激发能源致使发光的一类搪瓷。致使发光的激发能源有放射性元素、光线和电场等。
explanation_en: Enamel glaze is a kind of enamel in which luminescence substances are infiltrated into enamel glaze to cause luminescence with various excitation energies. The excitation energy that causes luminescence includes radioactive elements, light and electric field.

explanation_cn: 是用发光材料做成的具有发出可见光功能的纤维。发光纤维中的发光物质需要可见光、紫外线、X射线、高能粒子激发后发光。
explanation_en: It is made of luminescence materials and has the function of emitting visible light. The luminescence material in the luminescent fiber needs luminescence after being excited by visible light, ultraviolet light, X-ray and high-energy particles.

explanation_cn: 发光材料在某一特定波长光的激发下，所发射的不同波长光的强度或能量分布。许多发光材料的发射光谱是连续谱带，但它常常由几个或可分解成几个峰状曲线所组成。
explanation_en: The intensity or energy distribution of light of different wavelengths emitted by luminescence materials under the excitation of light of a certain wavelength. The emission spectrum of many luminescence materials is continuous, but it is often composed of several or decomposable peak curves.

explanation_cn: 用来发射枪、炮弹丸的一类火药。在枪、炮药室内被引燃后，迅速产生大量高温高压气体推动弹丸沿枪、炮身管高速运动，直至离开身管到达射击目标。
explanation_en: A class of propellant used to launch guns and shells. After being ignited in the gun and propellant chamber, a large amount of high-temperature and high-pressure gas is rapidly generated to propel the projectile along the gun and barrel at high speed, until it leaves the barrel and reaches the shooting target.

explanation_cn: 又称发散冷却。是新发展的一种涡轮冷却技术。发散冷却叶片由骨架和金属丝网制成。高温合金骨架承担叶片所受的应力，而由高温合金材料编织成的多层致密的丝网形成叶片所需的气动力外形。
explanation_en: Also called divergent cooling. It is a newly developed turbine cooling technology. The divergent cooling blade is made of a skeleton and a metal wire mesh. The high temperature alloy framework bears the stress on the blade, while the multi-layer dense wire mesh woven from high temperature alloy materials forms the aerodynamic shape required by the blade.

explanation_cn: 高培点金属等烧结或预烧成多孔骨架基体，熔渗低熔点金属所得的材料。在瞬间达到几千度高温的条件下，借助于低熔点金属蒸发吸热，降低基体的温度。犹如人体毛孔出汗降温一样，达到经受超高温度的目的。
explanation_en: Materials obtained by sintering or presintering porous framework matrix such as high melting point metal and infiltrating low melting point metal. Under the condition of instantaneous high temperature of several thousand degrees, the temperature of matrix can be reduced by means of the evaporation and heat absorption of low melting point metal. It is like sweating in human pore to cool down, so as to withstand ultra-high temperature.

explanation_cn: 又称起泡剂或泡沫剂，指能使塑料和橡胶形成泡孔结构而添加的一类助剂，它们能在特定条件下产生大量气体，使塑料和橡胶形成多孔结构。其形成的泡沫制品具有轻量化、隔热性好、隔声性好、机械阻尼性好等特征，主要包括物理发泡剂和化学发泡剂。
explanation_en: Also called foaming agent or foam agent, it refers to a kind of additive that can make plastics and rubber form a cellular structure. They can produce a large amount of gas under specific conditions, making plastics and rubber form a porous structure. The foam products formed by it have the characteristics of light weight, good heat insulation, sound insulation and good mechanical damping, mainly including physical foaming agent and chemical foaming agent.

explanation_cn: 是生产泡沫塑料制品的成型加工方法。主要可以分为三种方法，化学发泡、物理发泡和机械发泡。
explanation_en: It is a molding and processing method for producing foamed plastics products. There are three main methods available: chemical foaming, physical foaming, and mechanical foaming.

explanation_cn: 一种气孔率在90%以上由均匀的气孔组成的隔热玻璃，具有不透气、不燃烧、不变形、不变质、不污染食品等特点。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a heat insulation glass composed of uniform pores with a porosity of more than 90%, which is air tight, non combustion, non deformation, non deterioration, and non food pollution.

explanation_cn: 燃烧时能在大气中生成气溶胶的烟火药剂。是生成遮蔽、迷盲、干扰、信号烟幕物质的统称。发烟剂可以是一种单组分的物质，也可以是多组分的物质。
explanation_en: Pyrotechnic composition that can generate aerosols in the atmosphere during combustion. It is a general term for generating masking, blinding, interfering, and signal smoke materials. Smoke composition/smoke agent can be a single component substance or a multi-component substance.

explanation_cn: 又称发蓝，使钢铁工件表面形成四氧化三铁致密薄膜的表面处理工艺。该四氧化三铁致密薄膜的厚度为数微米，色泽呈深蓝、黑、紫或褐等颜色，使之浸入防锈油进行封闭处理后将明显提高工件耐腐蚀性。广泛用于在200℃以下的油中工作的零件和要求具有黑、蓝色外观的零件，以提高耐蚀性和产生装饰效果。
explanation_en: Also called bluish, it is a surface treatment process to form a dense Fe3O4 film on the surface of steel workpiece. The thickness of the compact Fe3O4 film is several microns, and the color is dark blue, black, purple or brown. Immersing it in antirust oil for sealing treatment will significantly improve the corrosion resistance of the workpiece. Widely used for parts that work in oil below 200 ℃ and require a black and blue appearance to improve corrosion resistance and produce decorative effects.

explanation_cn: 在外场作用下高分子中几何形状不对称的单元如分子链、链段、晶体或相区等沿外场方向作某种方式和某种程度的择优有序排列的过程。
explanation_en: Under the action of external field, the geometrically asymmetric units in macromolecule, such as molecular chain, chain segment, crystal or phase region, are arranged in a certain way and to a certain extent along the direction of external field.

explanation_cn: 取向分布函数表示用欧拉角定义的某一晶体取向的概率。试样轴与晶体轴之间的关系用三个欧拉角心来表示，对欧拉角采取不同规定，计算取向分布函数有相应的不同方法。取向分布函数的分析结果，通常是在欧拉空间作图表示，所谓欧拉空间就是以三个欧拉角为轴的正交坐标空间。用取向分布函数描写织构的优点是它可提供取向分布的定量信息。计算有织构试样的与无规取向试样的取向的分布函数之间的标准偏差可得出织构存在的程度。
explanation_en: The orientation distribution function represents the probability of orientation of a crystal defined by Euler angle. The relationship between the sample axis and the crystal axis is expressed by three Euler angle centers. Different Euler angles are defined, and different methods are used to calculate the orientation distribution function. The analysis results of orientation distribution function are usually expressed in Euler space, which is an orthogonal coordinate space with three Euler angles as the axis. The advantage of using orientation distribution function to describe texture is that it can provide quantitative information of orientation distribution. The degree of texture can be obtained by calculating the standard deviation between the distribution function of orientation of the sample with texture and the sample with random orientation.

explanation_cn: 高分子中分子链、链段、晶体或相区等单元有序排列的程度。
explanation_en: The degree of orderly arrangement of molecular chain, chain segment, crystal or phase region in macromolecule.

explanation_cn: 又称取向连生或取向附生。由Penn和Banfield合作提出，用于描述纳米材料的合成过程中，初级纳米颗粒为减小自身的表面自由能和晶界自由能，而自发组织、连接，并旋转至一共同晶面取向形成共格晶界。进而生成具有一致晶体取向的较大晶体的过程。在此过程中纳米颗粒和相邻晶粒通过消除其共有边界而成线性生长或聚结。不同于基本结构单元为原子或离子的奥斯特瓦尔德熟化过程（Ostwaldripeningprocess)，取向搭接的基本结构单元是预先形成的初级纳米颗粒。这一生长机制主要发生在可自由移动的纳米颗粒之间，如溶液中的胶体颗粒或衬底上相互邻近成核的颗粒。取向搭接的局部特性是使得纳米粒子能以不规则形态形成。研究表明取向搭接机制极为重要，尤其是在纳米晶粒的早期生长阶段。该项机制已经进行r相应的理论研究，并在微观金属系统和氧化物系统的研究中得到了实验的验证。近年来-作为一种重要的纳米材料生长机制，取向搭接已被广泛用来制备形貌和性能可控的功能纳米材料，在基础研究和应用研究领域都具有重要意义。
explanation_en: It is also called orientation adhesion or orientation epiphyte. It was proposed jointly by Penn and Banfield to describe the process of synthesis of nanomaterials. In order to reduce its own surface free energy and grain boundary energy, the primary nanoparticle spontaneously organize, connect, and rotate to the orientation of the common crystal plane to form a coherent grain boundary. The process of producing larger crystal with uniform orientation. In this process, nanoparticle and adjacent grains grow or coalesce linearly by eliminating their common boundaries. Unlike the Ostwald ripening process in which the basic structural unit is atoms or ions, the basic structural unit of oriented attachment is the pre formed primary nanoparticle. This growth mechanism mainly occurs between freely movable nanoparticle, such as colloidal particles in solution or particles nucleating adjacent to each other on the substrate. The local characteristic of oriented attachment is that nanoparticles can form in an irregular form. The research shows that the mechanism of oriented attachment is very important, especially in the early growth stage of nanocrystals. This mechanism has been theoretically studied and experimentally validated in the study of micro metal and oxide systems. In recent years, as an important growth mechanism of nanomaterials, oriented attachment has been widely used to prepare functional nanomaterials with controllable morphology and properties, which is of great significance in both basic research and application research fields.

explanation_cn: 部分结晶高分子中非晶相内分子运动受相邻晶相限制的部分。
explanation_en: The part of partially crystalline polymer in which the molecular movement in the amorphous phase is restricted by the adjacent crystalline phase.

explanation_cn: 残留结构。指变质岩中，由于重结晶作用不完全，仍然部分或全部保留原岩的结构特征。依据原岩结构，可进一步划分变余砾状结构、变余砂状结构、变余斑状结构、变余辉绿结构、变余火山碎屑结构、变余花岗结构等。依据变余结构，可以恢复变质岩的原岩类型。
explanation_en: Relict structure. It refers to that in metamorphic rock, due to incomplete recrystallization, some or all of the structural characteristics of the original rock remain. According to the original rock structure, it can be further divided into meta residual gravel structure, meta residual sand structure, meta residual porphyritic texture, meta residual green structure, meta residual pyroclastic structure, meta residual granite structure, etc. According to the palimpsest texture, the original rock type of metamorphic rock can be restored.

explanation_cn: 变形丝分为两类。一类是以蓬松性为主的，外观体积蓬松。以腈纶为主要原料的变形丝，叫做膨体纱，用于生产绒线和针织内外衣。另一类是以弹性为主的，叫做弹力丝。弹力丝分高弹和低弹两种。高弹丝以锦纶为主，多用于生产弹力衫裤、弹力袜等。低弹丝以涤纶为主，主要用于生产外衣和室内装饰布。丙纶低弹丝常用于制作地毯。
explanation_en: Deformed silk is divided into two categories. One type is mainly fluffy, with a fluffy appearance and volume. The textured yarn with acrylic fiber as the main raw material, called bulk yarn, is used to produce woolen yarn and knitted inner and outer garments. The other is based on elasticity, called elastic silk. Elastic silk is divided into high elasticity and low elasticity. High elasticity silk is mainly made of nylon and is mainly used in the production of stretch shirts, pants, elastic socks, etc. Low elasticity silk is mainly made of polyester and is mainly used for producing outerwear and interior decorative fabrics. Polypropylene low elastic silk is commonly used in making carpets.

explanation_cn: 用来生产各种形状铅材的铅合金叫做变形铅合金。铅合金的变形抗力小，铸锭不需加热即可用轧制、挤压等工艺制成板材、带材、管材、棒材和线材，且不须中间退火处理。由于铅合金的剪切、蠕变强度低，在一定的载荷和滚动切变作用下，铅合金易于变形并减薄成为箔状：且铅合金的自润性、磨合性和减振性好，噪声小。
explanation_en: The lead alloy used to produce lead materials of various shapes is called wrought lead alloy. The deformation resistance of lead alloy is small. The ingot can be made into plates, strips, tube, bar and wire rod by rolling, extrusion and other processes without heating, and no intermediate annealing treatment is required. Due to the low shear and creep strength of lead alloy, under certain load and rolling shear, lead alloy is easy to deform and thin into foil shape; moreover, lead alloy has good self lubrication, running in and vibration damping properties, and low noise.

explanation_cn: 可加工成型的铜合金。
explanation_en: Machinable copper alloy.

explanation_cn: 变形铝合金是通过冲压、弯曲、轧、挤压等工艺使其组织、形状发生变化的铝合金。熔融法制锭，再经受金属塑性变形加工，制成各种形态的铝合金。有热处理可强化铝合金：包括硬铝合金、超硬铝合金、锻造铝合金；还有热处理不可强化的铝合金。主要是各种防锈铝合金。在航空、汽车、造船、建筑、化工、机械等各工业部门有广泛应用。
explanation_en: Wrought aluminium alloy is an aluminum alloy that changes its structure and shape through stamping, bending, rolling, extrusion and other processes. Melting ingots are processed by metal plastic deformation to make aluminum alloys of various forms. Aluminum alloy that can be strengthened by heat treatment: including hard aluminium alloy, super-hard aluminium alloy and forged aluminum alloy; There are also aluminum alloys that cannot be strengthened by heat treatment. Mainly various stain resistant aluminium alloy. It is widely used in various industrial sectors such as aviation, automotive, shipbuilding, construction, chemical engineering, and machinery.

explanation_cn: 用来生产各种形状锌材的锌合金。常加入镉、铅、铁、钛、铜等元素，合金元素含量很少。
explanation_en: It is used to produce zinc alloy of various shapes. Cadmium, lead, iron, titanium, copper and other elements are often added, and the content of alloy elements is small.

explanation_cn: 锡合金以锡为甚加入其他合金元素组成的有色合金，主要合金元素苻铅、锑、铜等。锡合金熔点低，强度和硬度均低，它有较高的导热性和较低的热膨胀系数耐大气腐蚀。
explanation_en: Tin alloy A nonferrous alloy consisting of tin as well as other alloy elements. The main alloy elements are lead, antimony, copper, etc. Tin alloy has low melting point, low strength and hardness. it has high thermal conductivity and low coefficient of thermal expansion and is resistant to atmospheric corrosion.

explanation_cn: 镁合金具有比强度和比刚度高、导热导电性好、阻尼减震、电磁屏蔽、易于加工成形和容易回收等优点，在汽车、电子通信、航空航天和国防军事等领域具有极其重要的应用价值和广阔的应用前景，被誉为“21世纪绿色工程材料”。变形镁合金是相比于铸造镁合金具有更大的发展潜力，通过材料结构的控制、热处理工艺的应用，变形镁合金可获得更高的强度、更好的延展性和更多样化的力学性能，从而满足多样化工程结构件的应用需求。变形镁合金往往需要加热到一定温度并通过挤压、轧制及锻造等热成形技术加工而成。
explanation_en: Magnesium alloy has the advantages of high specific strength and stiffness, good thermal conductivity, damping and shock absorption, electromagnetic shielding, easy processing and recycling, etc. It has extremely important application value and broad application prospects in automobile, electronic communication, aerospace, national defense and military and other fields, and is known as the "21st century green engineering materials". Compared with cast magnesium alloy, wrought magnesium alloy has greater development potential. Through the control of materials structure and the application of heat treatment process, wrought magnesium alloy can obtain higher strength, better ductility and more diversified mechanical properties, so as to meet the application requirements of diversified engineering structural parts. Wrought magnesium alloy is often heated to a certain temperature and processed by hot forming technologies such as extrusion, rolling and forging.

name_en: heat treatment of wrought magnesium alloy
explanation_cn: 是可改善材料的组织结构和应力状态等的技术，调控其力学性能和加工成形性能，其使用规范与铝合金类同
explanation_en: It is a technology that can improve the structure and stress state of materials, regulate their mechanical properties and processing and forming properties, and its use specifications are similar to those of aluminum alloys

name_cn: 变形镁合金的非/弱基面织构
name_en: non/weak basal texture of wrought magnesium alloy
explanation_cn: 这种织构有利于镁合金在室温变形时促进基面滑移和拉伸孪生，提高变形镁合金的室温塑性、应变硬化能力和成形性能。
explanation_en: This texture is conducive to promoting base plane slip and tensile twinning of magnesium alloys during room temperature deformation, and improving room temperature plasticity, strain hardening ability and formability of wrought magnesium alloys.

explanation_cn: 变形高温合金是指以铁、镍、钴为基，能在600℃以上的高温环境下抗氧化或耐腐蚀，并能在一定应力作用下长期工作的一类金属材料。
explanation_en: Wrought superalloy is a kind of metallic materials based on iron, nickel and cobalt, which can resist oxidation or corrosion at high temperature above 600 ℃ and can work for a long time under certain stress.

explanation_cn: 变晶结构指矿物在固态下重结晶的晶体在岩石中所形成的结晶质结构。是变质岩的典型结构之一。
explanation_en: Balastic texture refers to the crystalline structure formed in rock by crystal recrystallized from minerals in solid state. It is one of the typical structures of metamorphic rock.

explanation_cn: 变色釉，异光变彩釉。釉色随光源不同而变化。变色釉以高级细瓷的白釉釉料作基釉，以金属氧化物、非金属氧化物及铈、镨、镱等混合稀土氧化物为着色元素，经一定工艺处理，制成釉浆，施于坯体表面，在适当的烧成温度下，产生物理与化学变化，生成一种新的固溶体。能在不同的光源照射下改变颜色，如在太阳光下呈淡紫色，在日光灯下显天青色，在水银灯下是深绿色，在高压钠灯下呈橙红色等。
explanation_en: Photochromie glaze, different light color changing glaze. The glaze color varies with the light source. The photochromie glaze takes the white glaze glaze of high-grade fine porcelain as the base glaze, and takes metal oxides, non-metallic oxides and mixed rare earth oxides such as cerium, praseodymium, ytterbium as the coloring elements. After a certain process, it is made into glaze slurry, which is applied to the surface of the body. Under the appropriate firing temperature, physical and chemical changes are generated to generate a new solid solution. Can change color under different light sources, such as light purple under sunlight, sky blue under fluorescent lamps, deep green under mercury lamps, and orange red under high-pressure sodium lamps.

explanation_cn: 变色革是一种特殊工艺制作的高级皮革，手感舒适，有一定阻尼。
explanation_en: Pull-up leather is a kind of advanced leather made by special technology, which is comfortable to handle and has certain damping.

explanation_cn: 在溶融金属中添加少量变质剂，使其结晶组织和性能得到明显改善的工艺。变质的机理主要是改变合金的晶体成核和长大过程。
explanation_en: A process in which a small amount of modifier is added to the molten metal to obviously improve its crystalline structure and properties. The mechanism of modification is mainly to change the crystal nucleation and growth process of alloy.

explanation_cn: 由变质作用所形成的岩石。是由地壳中先形成的岩浆岩或沉积岩，在环境条件改变的影响下，矿物成分、化学成分以及结构构造发生变化而形成的。它的岩性特征，既受原岩的控制，具有一定的继承性，又因经受了不同的变质作用，在矿物成分和结构构造上又具有新生性（如含有变质矿物和定向构造等）。通常，由岩浆岩经变质作用形成的变质岩称为“正变质岩”，由沉积岩经变质作用形成的变质岩称为 “副变质岩”。根据变质形成条件，可分为热接触变质岩、区域变质岩和动力变质岩。变质岩在中国和世界各地分布很广。前寒武纪的地层绝大部分由变质岩组成；古生代以后，在各个地质时期的地壳活动带（如地槽区），在一些侵入体的周围以及断裂带内，均有变质岩的分布。
explanation_en: Rock formed by metamorphism. It is formed by magmatic rocks or sedimentary rock formed first in the crust, under the influence of environmental conditions, mineral composition, chemical composition, structure and structure change. Its lithological characteristics are not only controlled by the original rock and have a certain degree of inheritance, but also have neogenesis in mineral composition and structural structure due to different metamorphic processes (such as containing metamorphic minerals and directional structures). Generally, metamorphic rock formed by metamorphism of magmatic rocks is called "orthometamorphic rock", and metamorphic rock formed by metamorphism of sedimentary rock is called "paranenenebe metamorphic rock". According to the metamorphic formation conditions, it can be divided into thermal contact metamorphic rock, regional metamorphic rock and dynamic metamorphic rock. Metamorphic rock are widely distributed in China and all over the world. Precambrian strata are mostly composed of metamorphic rock; After the Paleozoic era, metamorphic rock were distributed in crustal active zones (such as geosyncline areas) in various geological periods, around some intrusions and in fracture zones.

explanation_cn: 参见铜铀云母。
explanation_en: See torbernite.

explanation_cn: 简称氮化铅，代号LA。分子式为Pb(N3)2，分子量为291。叠氮化铅是目前使用最广的单质起爆药之一。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as lead nitride, code LA. The molecular formula is Pb (N3) 2, with a molecular weight of 291. Lead azide is one of the most widely used single compound primary explosive.

name_cn: 叠氮基氧丁烷-四氢呋喃共聚醚推进剂
explanation_cn: 简称PBT推进剂，叠氮类推进剂的一种，是固体推进剂。PBT黏合剂中的聚合单元BAMO具有较高的正生成热，另一聚合单元THF具有较好的柔軔性，调节两种聚合单元的比例可改变黏合剂的柔顺性和叠氮基团含量。聚合比为50/50的PBT黏合剂的玻璃化温度为一641°C,远低于GAP黏合剂。PBT推进剂能量稍低于GAP推进剂，但具有更好的低温力学性能，特别适用于有宽使1用温度范围要求的固体发动机。
explanation_en: PBT propellant, a kind of azide propellant, is solid propellant for short. The polymerization unit BAMO in the PBT adhesive has a high positive heat of formation, and the other polymerization unit THF has a good flexibility. Adjusting the ratio of the two polymerization units can change the flexibility and azide group content of the adhesive. The glass transition temperature of PBT adhesive with a polymerization ratio of 50/50 is 641 ° C, which is far lower than that of GAP adhesive. The energy of PBT propellant is slightly lower than that of GAP propellant, but it has better low-temperature mechanical properties, especially suitable for solid motors with wide temperature range requirements.

explanation_cn: 以分子上含有叠氮基的聚醚预聚物作为黏合剂成分的一类推进剂。叠氮聚醚的特点是有较高的正生成热、密度大、氮含量高、分解温度低、易点火、燃烧时耗氧量少等。
explanation_en: A kind of propellant with polyether prepolymer containing azide group on the molecule as the component of adhesive. Azide polyether is characterized by high positive heat of formation, high density, high nitrogen content, low decomposition temperature, easy ignition, low oxygen consumption during combustion, etc.

explanation_cn: 将几层板材叠在一起热轧成薄板的轧制工艺。轧机布置方式有横列式和纵列式。分粗轧、精轧两道工序，分别在两架轧机上进行；也有采用一架-辊劳特式轧机粗轧，两架二辊轧机精轧。
explanation_en: The rolling process of rolling several layers of plates together into thin plates. The layout of rolling mill includes horizontal type and vertical type. There are two processes of rough rolling and finish rolling, which are carried out on two rolling mill respectively; There are also one - roll Lauter type rolling mill for roughing and two two roll rolling mill for finish rolling.

explanation_cn: 指植入到口腔组织内，通过替代或支撑方式直接或辅助修复人体颌面部组织或器官缺损、缺失的一类生物材料。口腔植入材料按其类别有：①金属及其合金植入材料，常用的有纯钛（TA1、TA2、TA3)和钛合金(Ti-6Al-4V、Ti-5Al-2.5Fe、Ti-Zr、Ti-Mo、Ti-Ni合金等），此外还有钴铬合金（CO-Cr、Co-Cr-Pd、Co-Ir、Co-Cr-Mo合金等）以及纯钽金属、镍铬不锈钢、镍钛记忆合金等；②陶瓷植人材料，主要有生物惰性陶瓷、生物活性陶瓷、生物可降解陶瓷和生物压电陶瓷等，生物惰性陶瓷包括单晶或多晶氧化铝陶瓷、碳素陶瓷、氧化锆陶瓷、氮化硅陶瓷等，生物可降解陶瓷包括可溶性铝酸钙陶瓷、可溶性磷酸三钙陶瓷等，生物压电陶瓷是一种含磷酸钙的压电陶瓷材料；③高分子植入材料，可分为天然高分子材料和人工合成高分子材料两大类，天然高分子植入材料主要有胶原、甲壳素、丝蛋白、明胶等，人工合成高分子植人材料主要有聚乳酸、聚乙醇酸、超高分子量聚乙烯、聚四氟乙烯、聚砜、聚硅树脂等；④复合植入材料，有生物陶瓷与金属的复合材料、生物陶瓷与生物陶瓷的复合材料、有机与无机的复合材料。复合材料兼有各种材料的优点，更适合于人体的需要。
explanation_en: It refers to a class of biomaterials that are implanted into oral tissues and directly or auxiliary to repair the defects or missing of human maxillofacial tissues or organs through replacement or support. Dental imblam materials are classified as: ① metals and their alloy implantation materials, commonly pure titanium (TA1, TA2, TA3) and titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4V, Ti-5Al-2.5Fe, Ti Zr, Ti Mo, Ti Ni alloy, etc.), in addition to cobalt chromium alloy (CO Cr, Co Cr Pd, Co Ir, Co Cr Mo alloy, etc.), pure tantalum, nickel chromium stainless steel, nickel titanium memory alloy, etc.; ② Ceramics are implanted into materials, mainly including bioinert ceramics, bioactiw ceramics, biodegradable ceramics and biological piezoelectric ceramics. bioinert ceramics include single crystal or polycrystalline alumina ceramics, carbon ceramics, zirconia ceramics, silicon nitride ceramics, etc., and biodegradable ceramics include soluble calcium aluminate ceramics, soluble tricalcium phosphate ceramics, etc., and biological piezoelectric ceramics is a piezoelectric ceramics materials containing calcium phosphate; ③ Macromolecule implantation materials can be divided into natural polymer materials and synthetic macromolecule materials. natural polymer implantation materials mainly include collagen, chitin, silk protein, gelatin, etc., and synthetic macromolecule implant materials mainly include polylactic acid, polyglycolic acid, ultra high molecular weight polyethylene, polylctrafluorocthylone, polysulfone, poly silicone resin, etc.; ④ Composition implantation materials include composite materials of biological cemmics and metals, composite materials of biological cemmics and biological cemmics, and organic and inorganic composite materials. Composite materials has the advantages of various materials and is more suitable for human needs.

explanation_cn: 高分子类的齿科材料在口腔环境中，由于受到冷热交替变化的作用，性能逐渐下降，以致最后丧失使用价值的现象。
explanation_en: In the oral environment, the performance of macromolecule dental materials gradually declines due to the alternating changes of cold and heat, resulting in the loss of use value.

explanation_cn: 指应用于口腔医疗领域，与口腔及牙、颌、面组织有一定时间的直接接触。以达到对这些组织的形态修复、功能恢复和组织替代等作用的人工材料，口腔生物材料是牙科材料和生物材料的重要组成部分，它包括相关的金属材料、陶瓷材料、天然和人工合成的高分子材料以及一些复合材料等。例如，以金属材料为基础的牙种植体和颌骨固定用钛夹板，以陶瓷材料为基础的人工颌骨材料和全瓷牙冠材料，以有机高分子为基础的牙科树脂材料及根管充填材料，以及各类牙体修复和充填材料等。都属于口腔生物材料的范畴。由于牙科材料种类繁多、来源复杂、特性各异和用途不同。不少牙科材料并不一定具备生物材料所定义的特征。如牙科材料中包含着的一些短期非植入性材料，以及辅助口腔生物材料的制作和稳定的材料等。这些材料虽然也属于医用材料的范畴，但是否也可以被认为属于口腔生物材料尚未有最后定论。
explanation_en: Refers to direct contact with the oral cavity, teeth, jaw, and facial tissues for a certain period of time, which is applied in the field of oral medicine. Dental biomaterials are important components of dental materials and biological materials, including related metallic materials, ceramics materials, natural and synthetic macromolecule materials and some composite materials. For example, dental implant and titanium splints for jaw fixation based on metallic materials, artificial jaw materials and all ceramic crowns materials based on ceramics materials, dental resin materials and root canal filling materials based on organic macromolecule, and various dental restoration and filling materials. Both belong to the category of oral biomaterials. Dental materials have various types, complex sources, different characteristics and different uses. Many dental materials do not necessarily have the characteristics defined by biological materials. For example, some short-term non implantable materials included in dental materials, as well as materials assisting in the production and stability of oral biological materials. Although these materials also belong to the category of medical materials, whether they can also be considered as dental biomaterials has not been finalized.

explanation_cn: 是从原产于东南亚及北澳大利亚热带雨林中古塔波树的胶乳中提取出来的天然高分子材料，分子结构为反式-1，4-聚异戊二烯，与产自我国的杜仲胶属于同一种物质，是三叶橡胶的同分异构体.为一种反式天然橡胶。
