explanation_en: It is a natural polymer materials extracted from the latex of Guthabo tree in the tropical rainforest of Southeast Asia and North Australia. Its molecular structure is trans-1,4-polyisoprene. It belongs to the same substance as eucommia ulmoides gum produced in China. It is an isomer of trefoil rubber. It is a trans natural rubber.

explanation_cn: 又称硬彩，一般称明代五彩和清代康熙五彩为古彩。五彩，是以红、黄，绿、蓝、紫等各种带玻璃质的彩料.按图案纹饰需要施于袖在瓷胎上用生料、钒红勾线.用单线平涂的方法，再在"彩炉"中经800-900°C二次焙烧而成。由于它红绿分明，层次较少，彩色鲜明透彻.故称硬彩。古彩的色彩明净晶莹.色调对比强烈.形象概括夸张，线条刚劲有力，笔画简练生动.具有浓厚的民族艺术风格。古彩是景德镇陶瓷技术的优秀传统之一。就年代说.包括大明彩和康熙彩；就色彩说，有三彩、五彩和红绿彩。当今，古彩绘画在装饰手法和题材内容更为丰富多变。古彩的烧成温度较高（指与釉上各彩类比较）.色彩坚硬耐磨.经久不变，特别是矾红彩料，使用年代愈长则愈红亮可爱。
explanation_en: Also known as hard color, it is generally called antique colors, which is the five colors of Ming Dynasty and Kangxi in Qing Dynasty. Multicolor is made of red, yellow, green, blue, purple and other glass colored materials. It is applied to the sleeve according to the need of pattern decoration. The raw material and vanadium red are used to draw lines on the porcelain body. The method of single line flat coating is used, and then it is baked twice in the "color furnace" at 800-900 ° C. Because it has clear red and green, fewer layers and bright and thorough colors, it is called hard color. The antique colors has bright and clear colors, strong contrast of colors, exaggerated images, strong lines, simple and vivid strokes, and a strong national artistic style. Antique colors is one of the outstanding traditions of Jingdezhen ceramics technology. Speaking of the era, including the Da Ming and Kangxi colors; In terms of color, there are three colors, five colors, and red green colors. Nowadays, antique colors painting is more abundant and changeable in decorative techniques and subject matter. The firing temperature of antique colors is high (compared with glaze colors). The color is hard, wear-resistant, and durable. Especially the alum red color, the longer it is used, the redder it will be.

explanation_cn: 煤焦油和石油中140~185℃馏分的茚和苯并呋喃(氧茚)等混合物，经聚合而得的低分子量物质。其中聚茚的含量占大多数，聚氧茚质量百分比含量通常不到10%。
explanation_en: Low molecular weight substance obtained by polymerization of mixture of indene and benzofuran (oxyindene) from coal tar and 140~185 ℃ fraction of petroleum. The content of polyindene accounts for the majority, and the mass percentage of polyoxyindene is usually less than 10%.

explanation_cn: 既可以作为燃料电池发电又可以作为电解池制备化学物质（如氢气和氧气）的燃料电池。电解过程中的正极是燃料电池发电过程中的阴极，电解过程中的负极是燃料电池发电过程中的阳极。如电解水池和氢氧燃料电池是两个正好相反的过程。由于水电解过程中电解池的正极电压可高达1..8V,正极中所用材料如催化剂和催化剂载体，甚至气体扩散层和极板必须能够承受这么高的电压。
explanation_en: The fuel cell can be used as both a fuel cell to generate electricity and an electrolytic cell to prepare chemicals (such as hydrogen and oxygen). The positive pole in the electrolysis process is the cathode in the fuel cell power generation process, and the negative pole in the electrolysis process is the anode in the fuel cell power generation process. For example, electrolytic pool and hydrogen oxygen fuel cell are two opposite processes. Since the positive voltage of the electrolytic cell in the process of water electrolysis can be as high as 1.8 V, the materials used in the positive electrode, such as catalyst and catalyst support, and even the gas diffusion medium and plate must be able to withstand such a high voltage.

explanation_cn: 是指那些经使用、消耗、加工、燃烧、废弃等程序后，能在一定周期内重复形成的，具有自我更新、复原的特性，并可持续被利用或可以循环使用的一类自然资源。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of natural resources that can be formed repeatedly in a certain period after use, consumption, processing, combustion, abandonment and other procedures, have the characteristics of self renewal and recovery, and can be used or recycled continuously.

explanation_cn: 主晶相为氟金云母、锂云母、锂镁云母等云母型微晶玻璃，具有金属切削加工性能。
explanation_en: The main crystal phase is fluorophlogopite mica, lepidolite, lithium magnesium mica and other mica type glass ceramics, which have metal cutting properties.

explanation_cn: 可在热状态或冷状态下通过塑性变形和机械加工制成的磁体，这类磁体合金种类、牌号繁多，但生产量仅为永磁材料总量的1%。各种磁体性能差异很大，并各有特点。磁钢是人类最早使用的商业磁体，磁性能低，加之热稳定性差、老化现象严重，实际上已很少使用。在可加工磁体中，Ft-Cr-Co磁体是应用较广的一种，其成分范围和性能分布都很宽，供不同场合选择。可加工永磁一般经过冶炼、锻造、热轧、冷乳、挤压、拉拔等工序制成棒、线、带、管等各种形状产品，随后需经过热处理才能获得所需要的性能。可加工永磁适于制作小尺寸元件.用于各种仪表、磁滞电机、电话受话器等。
explanation_en: Magnets that can be made by plastic deformation and mechanical processing in hot or cold state have a wide variety of alloy, but the production is only 1% of the total amount of permanent magnet material. The performance of various magnets varies greatly and each has its own characteristics. Magnet steel is the first commercial magnet used by human beings. In fact, it is rarely used because of its low magnetic properties, poor thermal stability and serious aging. Among machinable magnets, Ft Cr Co magnets are widely used, with a wide range of components and performance distribution, making them suitable for different occasions to choose from. Processable permanent magnets are generally made into bars, wires, strips, tubes and other products in various shapes through smelting, forging, hot rolling, cold emulsion, extrusion, drawing and other processes, and then require heat treatment to obtain the required performance. Machinable permanent magnet is suitable for making small-sized components. It is used for various instruments, hysteresis motors, telephone receivers, etc.

explanation_cn: 可被机体吸收、利用或参与机体代谢的可降解生物材料。可吸收生物材料主要包括可吸收高分子材料、可吸收生物陶瓷、可吸收金属材料等。
explanation_en: Degradation biomaterials that can be absorbed, utilized or involved in metabolism of the body. Absorbable biological materials mainly include absorbable macromolecule materials, absorbable bioceramics, bioaksorbable metallic materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 是在生理环境中可被逐步降解和吸收，并随之为新生组织所替代，从而达到修复或替换被损坏组织的目的的一类生物陶瓷。石膏是最早应用的生物可吸收陶瓷。其生物相容性好。但其吸收速度过快，和新生骨生长速度不能匹配，在骨缺损修复方面已经比较少用。目前应用和研究最多的可吸收陶瓷是磷酸钙陶瓷，其中钙磷比从1:1(CaHP04)到1.5:1(TCP)的一系列磷酸钙盐均（特别是磷酸三钙）可作为可吸收生物陶瓷。可吸收生物陶瓷主要用作骨缺损修复材料和药物载体材料等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of biological cemmics that can be gradually degradation and absorbed in the physiological environment, and then replaced by new tissue to repair or replace damaged tissue. Gypsum is the earliest bioabsorbable ceramics. Its biocompatibility is good. However, its absorption rate is too fast to match the growth rate of newly formed bone, and it is relatively less used in bone defect repair. At present, the most widely used and studied absorbable ceramics are calcium phosphate ceramics, in which a series of calcium phosphate salts (especially tricalcium phosphate) with calcium phosphorus ratio from 1:1 (CaHP04) to 1.5:1 (TCP) can be used as absorbable bioceramics. Absorbable bioceramics are mainly used as materials for bone defect repair and drug carrier materials.

explanation_cn: 在指在植入人类或动物的机体一定时间内，经过降解、链分解或解聚等作用，能被植人处的组织完全吸收的纤维。具体品种可分两类，早期由自然物中提取得到，如肠衣手术缝合线、骨胶原手术缝合线；另一类为目前常用的合成的可吸收纤维，如聚乙交酯纤维、聚乙交酯-丙交酯纤维、聚对二氧杂环己烷纤维等。可吸收纤维主要用于制作可吸收手术缝合线、人造皮肤、组织再生骨架材料。
explanation_en: It refers to the fiber that can be completely absorbed by the tissue at the place of implantation after degradation, chain decomposition or depolymerization within a certain period of time in the body of human or animal. The specific varieties can be divided into two categories, which are extracted from natural materials in the early stage, such as intestinal surgical sutures and bone collagen surgical sutures; The other is synthetic absorbable fiber commonly used at present, such as polyglycolide fiber, polyglycolide lactide fiber, poly (p-dioxane) fiber, etc. Absorbable fiber is mainly used to make absorbable surgical suture, artificial skin and tissue regeneration skeleton materials.

explanation_cn: 在人体生理环境中可腐蚀/降解，其降解产物为对人体无害的金属离子，并可被机体吸收、利用或参与机体代谢的一类新型医用金属材料，主要包括镁及其合金等。利用镁及其合金可被机体组织降解吸收的特性发展而成的新型医用金属植人物，既能在一定时间内发挥其金属材料的高强度特点完成植入体功能（如诱导新骨组织形成或荇支撑狹窄的血管），又能在人体病变部位自身修复的同时逐渐被人体腐蚀降解，溶出的金属离子能被生物体吸收，多余的金属离子可通过人体排泄系统排出体外，最终在人体结束自身修复时金属材料"异体"完全降解消失。虽然其降解机制与医用高分子材料完全不同，但它克服了医用高分子材料强度低和医用金属材料不可降解的弱点，做到兼具有"可降解吸收特性"和"较高的支撑强度特性"。目前研究的可吸收镁合金主要包括Mg-Ca、Mg-Zn、Mg-Sr等体系，广泛应用于骨科、心血管及牙科等各个医疗领域。目前可吸收金属材料在应用上面临的挑战为对金属离子在体内的降解吸收机理尚不明确，需要进一步的深人研究。
explanation_en: It can be corrosion/degradation in the physiological environment of human body, and its degradation product is a kind of new medical metallic materials that is harmless to human body and can be absorbed, utilized or involved in the metabolism of the body, mainly including magnesium and its alloy. A new type of medical metal implant developed by using the characteristic that magnesium and its alloy can be degradation and absorbed by body tissues can not only give play to the high strength characteristics of its metallic materials to complete the implant function (such as inducing the formation of new bone tissue or not supporting narrow blood vessels) within a certain time, but also can be gradually corrosion and degradation by the human body while self repairing the diseased parts of the human body, and the dissolved metal ions can be absorbed by the organism, Excess metal ions can be discharged from the body through the human excretory system, and finally the "allogeneic" metallic materials will completely degradation and disappear when the body finishes self repair. Although its degradation mechanism is completely different from that of biomedical polymer, it overcomes the weakness of low strength of biomedical polymer and non degradation medical metallic materials, and achieves both "degradation absorption characteristics" and "high support strength characteristics". The currently studied absorbable magnesium alloys mainly include Mg-Ca, Mg-Zn, Mg-Sr and other systems, which are widely used in various medical fields such as orthopedics, cardiovascular, and dentistry. At present, the challenge faced by bioaksorbable metallic materials in application is that the absorption mechanism of degradation of metal ions in vivo is still unclear, and further in-depth research is needed.

explanation_cn: 未硫化的橡胶试样在恒定力作用下产生变形，当外力解除且经规定时间恢复后，试样永久形变的度量值。可塑度表示胶料塑性的大小，表征胶料的加工性能和流动性。测定橡胶可塑度的仪器分为压缩型、转动型和压出型三大类，三类仪器的剪切速率不同。威氏塑性计、快速塑性计和德弗塑性计属压缩型，这类塑性计结构简单，操作方便，适用于工厂控制生产使用。常用威氏可塑度P来表示胶料的流动性及快速确定生胶的塑炼程度及评价加工性能的好坏，威氏可塑度越高（P=O-1)，胶料的流动性越好。
explanation_en: The measurement value of permanent deformation of rubber sample without vulcanization under the action of constant force when the external force is relieved and the sample is recovered after the specified time. Plasticity refers to the size of plastic of rubber compound, and represents the processing property and flow ability of rubber compound. The instruments for measuring rubber plasticity can be divided into three types: compression type, rotation type and extrusion type. The shear rates of the three types of instruments are different. Williams'parallel plate plastometer, Rapid Plastimeter and Deval Plastimeter belong to the compression type. These plastimeters are simple in structure and easy to operate, and are suitable for factory control production. Wechsler plasticity P is often used to express the flow ability of rubber compound, quickly determine the mastication degree of crude rubber and evaluate the processing performance. The higher the Wechsler plasticity (P=O-1), the better the flow ability of rubber compound.

explanation_cn: 除去外力后应变能逐渐恢复到零的蠕变。很显然，这种可恢复的蠕变应当是弹性应变。在恒定的弹性应力作用下，弹性应变随时间而缓慢增加。最后达到一个和虎克定律所对应的平衡值，这种现象称滞弹性蠕变。除去外应力，一部分应变瞬时恢复，剩余部分则要经过一段时间后才能恢复到零，这个过程称为弹性后效或滞弹性蠕变的恢复。故可恢复蠕变就是滞弹性蠕变。
explanation_en: After removing the external force, the strain energy gradually recovers to zero creep. Obviously, this recoverable creep should be elasticity strain. Under the action of constant elasticity stress, elasticity strain increases slowly with time. Finally, an equilibrium value corresponding to Hooke's Law is reached, which is called anelasticity creep. In addition to the external stress, some strains recover instantaneously, and the rest can recover to zero after a period of time. This process is called the recovery of elasticity aftereffect or anelasticity creep. Therefore, recoverable creep is anelasticity creep.

explanation_cn: 工件在加热过程中与炉内气体直接接触，炉气的性质对工件的表面质量有显著影响，正确地选择炉内气氛并进行严格控制，从而达到无氧化、无脱碳的光亮退火、正火、淬火、回火和粉末冶金烧结的热处理工艺称为可控气氛热处理。炉内的气氛应根据工件的成分和对工件表面质量的要求来选择。常用的保护气氛有：放热式气氛、吸热式气氛、氨分解（包括燃烧）气氛以及氮气氛、纯氢、纯氩和纯氦气氛等。吸热式气氛的制备过程是将气体燃料（天然气、液化石油气、城市煤气等）与空气混合，在催化剂作用下，通过外部加热反应生成的气体气氛。吸热式气氛可用来进行各种金属表面氧化物还原以及不锈钢、硅钢、高镍铬合金的光亮退火。放热式气氛是气体燃料与空气以一定的比例混合后部分燃烧而成。放热式气氛分为以氮为基和以氮、氢为基的气氛，可用于各种碳钢、不锈钢和高铬钢的光亮处理，以及粉末冶金的烧结等工艺过程。应用可控气氛进行热处理操作时，只要精确地控制炉内气氛的碳势，也就是控制炉气组分间的相对量，把炉气的成分调整到与被处理工件的碳含量相平衡，就能达到无氧化、脱碳、增碳的目的。可控气氛发生装置和可控气氛热处理炉一般均采用自动控制，依靠各种分析仪器对炉内气体施行监测和分析，并通过控制仪表和相应的执行机构来实现炉气控制。
explanation_en: The workpiece is in direct contact with the gas in the furnace during heating. The nature of the furnace gas has a significant impact on the surface quality of the workpiece. The atmosphere in the furnace is correctly selected and strictly controlled, so as to achieve the heat treatment process of bright annealing, normalizing, quenching, tempering and powder metallurgy sintering without oxidation and decarburization, which is called controlled atmosphere heal treatment. The atmosphere inside the furnace should be selected based on the composition of the workpiece and the requirements for the surface quality of the workpiece. The commonly used protective atmosphere includes exothermic atmosphere, endothermic atmosphere, ammonia decomposition (including combustion) atmosphere, nitrogen atmosphere, pure hydrogen, pure argon and pure helium atmosphere. The preparation process of endothermic atmosphere is to mix gas fuels (natural gas, liquefied petroleum gas, city gas, etc.) with air, and generate a gas atmosphere through external heating reaction under the action of a catalyst. The endothermic atmosphere can be used for reduction of various metal surface oxides and bright annealing of stainless steel, silicon steel and high nickel chromium alloy. The exothermic atmosphere is formed by partial combustion of gaseous fuel and air after mixing in a certain proportion. The exothermic atmosphere can be divided into nitrogen based and nitrogen and hydrogen based atmospheres, which can be used for the bright treatment of various carbon steels, stainless steel and high chromium steels, as well as the sintering process of powder metallurgy. When using controllable atmosphere for heat treatment, as long as the carbon potential of the atmosphere in the furnace is accurately controlled, that is, the relative amount of furnace gas components is controlled, and the composition of furnace gas is adjusted to balance with the carbon content of the workpiece to be treated phase, the purpose of no oxidation, decarburization, and carburization can be achieved. Controllable atmosphere generation devices and controllable atmosphere heat treatment furnaces generally adopt automatic control, relying on various analytical instruments to monitor and analyze the gas inside the furnace, and achieving furnace gas control through control instruments and corresponding executing mechanisms.

explanation_cn: 在自由基聚合体系中，链增长自由基与引入体系的特殊化合物进行可逆的链终止或链转移反应，使链增长自由基失活变成无增长活性的休眠种，利用链增长自由基与各类休眠种之间的快速动态平衡，降低聚合体系中的自由基浓度，抑制不可逆的双基终止反应，从而实现对反应速率、聚合物分子量、分子量分布和末端功能性控制的自由基聚合反应。
explanation_en: In the free radical polymerization system, chain growth radicals and special compounds introduced into the system undergo reversible chain termination or chain transfer reactions, which inactivate chain growth radicals into dormant species with no growth activity. The rapid dynamic balance between chain growth radicals and various dormant species is used to reduce the concentration of free radicals in the polymerization system and inhibit the irreversible double radical termination reaction, so as to realize the determination of reaction rate, molecular weight of polymer Free radical polymerization controlled by molecular weight distribution and end functionality.

name_cn: 可机械加工生物活性玻璃陶瓷
explanation_cn: 又称可切削生物活性微晶玻璃，是含有大量云母和磷灰石微晶的玻璃。其片状的云母微晶随机地分布在玻璃基质中，构成相互交错的微结构。而磷灰石微晶分布在云母微晶的周围。当材料受到加工应力而产生裂纹时，裂纹沿着云母晶体的薄弱面进行快速传播，而相互交错的云母晶体微结构又抑制了裂纹的自由扩展，避免破坏性扩展，使裂纹只是产生微小区域的云母片层脱落，控制裂纹只是在刃具周围微小区域扩展，使其可以切削而不致破碎，可实现精密加工。材料中含有的磷灰石微晶则赋予其一定的生物活性，使材料能够同宿主骨形成牢固地结合。由于此类微晶玻璃具有良好的可加工性能、生物活性，以及较好的力学强度，被用于制作人工椎板等骨修复体。
explanation_en: Also known as machinable bioactive microcrystalline glass, it is glass containing a large number of mica and apatite microcrystals. The lamellar mica microcrystals are randomly distributed in the glass matrix, forming interlaced microstructures. Apatite microcrystals are distributed around mica microcrystals. When the materials is subject to processing stress and cracks are generated, the cracks quickly propagate along the weak surface of mica crystal, while the crisscross mica crystal microstructure inhibits the free propagation of the cracks to avoid destructive propagation, so that the cracks only produce tiny areas of mica flakes fall off, and control the cracks only to expand in the small areas around the cutting tool, so that it can be cut without breaking, and precision machining can be achieved. The apatite microcrystals contained in the materials endow it with certain bioactivity, so that the materials can form a firm bond with the host bone. Because this kind of glass-ceramics has good processability, bioactivity and good mechanical strength, it is used to make artificial vertebral lamina and other bone prosthesis.

explanation_cn: 又称天然气水合物。一种以水和甲烷为主要组成的白色固体。外形似冰，有极强的燃烧力。形成于高压低温条件下，主要分布在深海沉积物或陆域的永久冻土中。极具开采价值，被誉为"未来能源"、"21世纪能源"。
explanation_en: It is also called natural gas hydrate. A white solid mainly composed of water and methane. It looks like ice and has strong combustion power. Formed under high-pressure and low-temperature conditions, it is mainly distributed in deep-sea sediments or permafrost on land. Extremely valuable for mining, known as "future energy" and "21st century energy".

explanation_cn: 材料在火焰中可以被点燃并持续燃烧的性质。通常用可燃性等级来标识物质燃烧的难易程度。材料在作为建筑材料等用途时，必须明确材料的可燃性等级。可燃性UL94等级是应用最广泛的塑料材料的可燃性标准，它用来评价材料在被点燃后熄灭的能力，根据燃烧速度、燃烧时间、抗滴能力以及滴珠是否燃烧可有多种评判方法。塑料的阻燃等级有HB、V-2、V-1和V-0,测试方法包括水平燃烧法和垂直燃烧法。
explanation_en: The property that materials can be ignited in the flame and continue to combustion. Flammability grade is usually used to identify the difficulty of combustion of substances. When materials are used as building materials, the flammability grade of materials must be specified. Flammability UL94 is the most widely used flammability standard for plastics materials. It is used to evaluate the ability of materials to extinguish after being ignited. There are many evaluation methods according to combustion speed, combustion time, anti dripping ability and whether droplets combustion. The flame retardant grades of plastics include HB, V-2, V-1 and V-0, and the test methods include horizontal burning method and vertical burning method.

explanation_cn: 一种主要能量成分为硝化棉，辅以黏合剂及其素硼在人体中具有积累作用，人体中积累一定量的硼时对人的健康会造成损害，因而硅硼玻璃抗菌剂的使用范围受到限制，不能应用于市政用水等一些与人体直接接触的水源中。
explanation_en: One of the main energy components is nitrocellulose, supplemented by adhesive and its element boron, which can accumulate in the human body. When a certain amount of boron accumulates in the human body, it will cause damage to human health. Therefore, the use scope of silicon boron glass antibacterial agent is limited and cannot be used in municipal water and other water sources that directly contact with human body.

explanation_cn: 指以木纤维、竹纤维、亚麻纤维、洋麻纤维、黄麻纤维、揶壳纤维、谷壳纤维和甘蔗渣纤维等可再生的天然植物纤维为增强材料，以聚羟基丁酯（PHB)、聚丁二酸丁二醇酯（PBS)、聚乳酸（PLA)等生物可降解树脂为基体，经模压、注射或挤压等成型工艺制备而成的复合材料。该材料不仅具有较好的机械强度，而且在自然或特定条件下能够降解生成CO2和H2O,不会给环境带来任何污染。可生物降解复合材料广泛应用于汽车内部装饰件、建筑结构部件及室内装修材料等领域。
explanation_en: It refers to a composite materials made of renewable natural plant fiber such as wood fiber, bamboo fiber, flax fiber, kenaf fiber, jute fiber, chaff fiber, sugarcane slag fiber as reinforcement materials, and biodegradable resin such as polyhydroxybutyrate (PHB), polybutylene succinate (PBS), polylactic acid (PLA) as the matrix through molding processes such as molding, injection or extrusion. The materials not only has good mechanical strength, but also can degradation to generate CO2 and H2O under natural or specific conditions, without any pollution to the environment. Biodegradable composite are widely used in automotive interior decoration parts, building structural parts, interior decoration materials and other fields.

explanation_cn: 在化学纤维生产中，可纺性是指纺丝流体承受稳定的拉伸操作所具有的形变能力，即纺丝流体在拉伸作用下形成细长丝条的能力，实质上是一个单轴拉伸流动的流变学问题。它是成纤聚合物的必要条件，但不是唯一条件。在纺织加工中，可纺性是指纤维成纱的难易性和所得成纱综合性能等的反映。
explanation_en: In the production of man-made fiber, spinnability refers to the deformation ability of spinning fluid to withstand stable stretching operation, that is, the ability of spinning fluid to form slender filaments under the effect of stretching, which is essentially a rheological problem of uniaxial elongationai flow. It is a necessary condition for fiber forming polymer, but not the only condition. In textile processing, spinnability refers to the difficulty of fiber spinning and the comprehensive performance of the resulting yarn.

name_cn: 可见光半导体激光材料
explanation_cn: 用于制作发光波长位于可见光波段的半导体激光器材料。最早是采用SiC材料制成的，但这种材料合成温度很高，难以获得单晶。目前研究最多的是红光波段和蓝绿光波段的半导体材料，大多采用MBE及MOVPE等先进薄膜生长技术制备的量子阱材料。635-670nm波段采用Iri-GaAIP/GaAs材料。目前采用这种材料制成的红光半导体激光器已投人市场。除了红光、蓝绿光可见光激光器外，还有黄光激光器。
explanation_en: It is used to make semiconductor laser materials with luminescence wavelength in visible light band. It was first made of SiC materials, but this materials is difficult to obtain single crystal because of its high synthesis temperature. At present, the most studied semiconductor materials are in the red and blue green light bands, and most of them are quantum well materials prepared by advanced film growth technologies such as MBE and MOVPE. Iri GaAIP/GaAs materials is used for 635-670nm wave band. At present, red semiconductor lasers made of this materials have been put into the market. In addition to red and blue green visible light lasers, there are also yellow light lasers.

explanation_cn: 借助于计算机及相关软件，实现材料建模、仿真和科学计算的可视化输出，将材料工艺、组织结构演变、使用场景等各种材料相关动态过程及瞬态图像直观显现出来的模拟技术。
explanation_en: With the help of computers and related software, the visual output of materials modeling, simulation and scientific calculation can be realized, and the simulation technology can directly show the dynamic processes and transient images related to materials, such as the evolution of organizational structure, use scenarios, etc.

explanation_cn: 构成可调谐激光器的晶体。在改变谐振腔中调谐元件从而改变谐振腔的谐振频率时能连续改变激光的输出波长。色心晶体可用提拉法、区熔法和下降法生长。由可调谐激光晶体构成的可调谐激光器比染料调谐激光器的可调谐范围更广，系统结构紧凑牢固，工作寿命长，无流动部分，更适于携带，并在宇宙环境的遥感、测距、雷达、通信及在医疗、生物和化学方面有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: A crystal that forms a tunable laser. The output wavelength of the laser can be continuously changed when the resonant frequency of the resonator is changed by changing the tuning element in the resonator. Color centers crystal can be grown by pulling method method, zone-melting method method and descent method. The tunable laser composed of tunable laser crystal has a wider tunable range than the dye or dyestuffc tunable laser. The system has a compact and firm structure, long working life, no flowing parts, and is more suitable for carrying. It has a wide range of applications in remote sensing, ranging, radar, communications, and medical, biological, and chemical aspects of the cosmic environment.

explanation_cn: 液体（染料）激光器的工作物质。染料溶于某些溶剂中，在特定波长光激发下，可产生一定带宽的激光。通过谐振腔内色散元件的调谐作用，能获得不同输出波长的可调谐激光。染料是由天然或人工合成的芳香和杂环化合物组成的。按结构分为三类：①染料，有菁染料、部花菁染料、酞菁染料、咕吨染料、三芳基甲烷染料及叶绿素等；②芳香族化合物，有稠环化合物、对三联笨类和共轭双烯类等；③杂环化合物.有乔豆素、呋喃、吡唑啉、酞酰亚胺和蝶啶的衍生物。它们溶于有机醇类、岗代烃、芳烃及其衍生物.并显示很强的荧光.在溶剂中其吸收波长范围在310-1285nm之间。除作激光器的激活介质外，还可作纤维染料、涂料、颜料、传感材料、光电池材料、光信息存储介质材料等。
explanation_en: Working substance of liquid (dye or dyestuffc) laser. Dye or dyestuffc dissolved in some solvents can produce laser with certain bandwidth under the excitation of light with specific wavelength. Tunable lasers with different output wavelengths can be obtained through the tuning effect of dispersion elements in the resonant cavity. Dye or dyestuffc are composed of natural or synthetic aromatic and heterocyclic compounds. It can be divided into three categories according to the structure: ① dye or dyestuffc, including cyanine dye or dyestuffc, partial cyanine dye or dyestuffc, phthalocyanine dye, gooton dye or dyestuffc, triarylmethane dye or dyestuffc and chlorophyll; ② Aromatic compounds, including polycyclic compounds, para terpenoids, and conjugated dienes; ③ Heterocyclic compounds include derivatives of coumarin, furan, pyrazoline, phthalimide, and pteridine. They are soluble in organic alcohols, substituted hydrocarbons, aromatic hydrocarbons and their derivatives, and show strong fluorescence. Their absorption wavelength ranges from 310-1285nm in solvents. In addition to being the activation medium of lasers, it can also be used as fiber dye or dyestuffc, coatings, pigment, sensing materials, materials of photocells, materials of optical information storage media, etc.

explanation_cn: 俘获中子后能直接或间接地转变为易裂变材料的材料。在核裂变领域，典型的可转换材料为238U和232Th这两种材料本身吸收热中子后都不发生裂变，释放出核能。但经过两次β衰变后，分别转换成易裂核239Pu和233U(参看铀-钚循环，钍-铀循环），前者是最好的快中子裂变的燃料，后者是最好的热中子裂变的燃料。在核聚变领域，聚变燃料氚在自然界中储量极微，它是由锂吸收中子后发生（n，α)反应制造出来的（参见氚增殖材料），锂是可转换材料，习惯上也称为增殖材料(breeding materials)。
explanation_en: Materials that can be directly or indirectly transformation into fissile materials after neutron capture. In the field of nuclear fission, the typical fertile materials are 238U and 232Th, two materials that do not undergo fission after absorbing thermal neutrons, releasing nuclear energy. But after two attempts β After decay, they are converted into fissile nuclei 239Pu and 233U respectively (see uranium plutonium cycle and thorium uranium cycle). The former is the best fuel for fast neutron fission, and the latter is the best fuel for thermal neutron fission. In the field of nuclear fusion, tritium, a fusion fuel, has very little reserves in nature. It is produced after lithium absorbs neutrons (n, α) It is produced by reaction (see tritium-breeding materials). Lithium is a fertile materials, which is also traditionally called breeder materials.

name_cn: 可逆加成断裂链转移聚合
name_en: reversible addition fragmentation chain transfer polymerization
explanation_cn: 在自由基聚合反应中引入二硫酯类化合物，传统链引发产生的链增长自由基进攻硫原子生成休眠种，休眠种两臂中的任何一个均可以发生裂解，再次释放出二硫酯类化合物和一个链增长自由基，实现聚合物增长链与二硫酯类化合物的可逆加成、加成物的可逆断裂以及链转移反应，从而保持自由基活性种在较低的浓度，减少增长链自由基之间的不可逆双基终止副反应，使聚合反应得到有效控制的一种可控自由基聚合。
explanation_en: The introduction of disulfide ester compounds in the free radical polymerization reaction, the chain growth free radicals generated by the traditional chain initiation attack the sulfur atoms to generate dormant species, and any one of the two arms of the dormant species can be cracked, releasing disulfide ester compounds and a chain growth free radical again, realizing the reversible addition of polymer growth chain and disulfide ester compounds, the reversible fracture of the adduct, and the chain transfer reaction, So as to keep the free radical reactive species at a lower concentration, reduce the irreversible double radical termination side reaction between the growing chain radicals, and effectively control the polymerization reaction, which is a controlled/living radical polymerization.

explanation_cn: 热力学系统的状态随时间的变化称为热力学过程。若一个过程其每一步都可以沿相反方向进行，而又不在外界引起其他变化，该过程称为可逆过程。在可逆过程中，不存在摩擦生热所引起的机械能的损失，也不存在热量由高温物体直接传入低温物体所引起的做功能力的损失。可逆过程是无耗散效应的准静态过程。自然界并不存在这样理想的可逆过程。实际过程如果进行得足够缓慢，使过程中每一个状态都可近似地看作平衡态，且可忽略过程中的耗散阻力，则该过程可视为可逆过程。可逆过程在热力学中占有重要的特殊地位。
explanation_en: The change of state of thermodynamics system with time is called thermodynamic process. If each step of a process can be carried out in the opposite direction without causing other changes in the outside world, the process is called reversible process. In the reversible process, there is no loss of mechanical energy caused by friction heat generation, nor the loss of work ability caused by heat directly transferred from high-temperature objects to low-temperature objects. Reversible process is a quasi-static process without dissipation effect. There is no such ideal reversible process in nature. If the actual process is carried out slowly enough so that each state in the process can be approximately regarded as a balanced state, and the dissipative resistance in the process can be ignored, the process can be regarded as a reversible process. Reversible process plays an important role in thermodynamics.

explanation_cn: 可用铸造工艺成型的玻璃陶瓷。其主要结晶相是偏磷酸钙、磷灰石或云母。云母相的存在可使其便于机械加工（见可机械加工生物活性玻璃陶瓷）。制备方法类似于微晶玻璃工艺。对植入体的铸造成型可以采用传统的失蜡铸造法。可铸造玻璃陶瓷的物理性能随其组成不同而有差异，有的甚至可优于牙柚质。临床使用中主要用于制作人工牙冠。但其制作工艺复杂，打磨量大，牙体与牙冠黏结有一定难度，且在水溶液中的机械强度和性能还有待进一步改善。
explanation_en: Glass-ceramics that can be molded by foundry process. The main crystalline phases are calcium metaphosphate, apatite or mica. The presence of mica phase makes it easy to machine (see machinable bioactive glass ceramics). The preparation method is similar to the glass-ceramics process. The traditional wax losing foundry method can be used for foundry of implant. The physical properties of castable glass ceramics vary with their composition, and some are even better than tartarin. In clinical use, it is mainly used to make artificial crowns. However, its manufacturing process is complex, with a large amount of polishing, making it difficult to bond between the tooth body and the crown, and its mechanical strength and performance in aqueous solution still need further improvement.

explanation_cn: 指在人体生理环境中易发生腐蚀/降解的一类新型医用金属材料，主要包括镁及其合金等。另外，铁及铁合金和钨作为可降解金属材料应用的研究也有一些报道。可降解金属材料自21世纪初开始迅速发展，这类新型医用金属材料的应用使人们摒弃了通常将金属植人物作为生物惰性材料使用的传统思想，巧妙地利用可降解金属在人体环境（含氯离子）中容易发生腐蚀/降解的特性，以可控方式实现金属植入物在体内的修复功能，并最终在人体组织完成重建/功能修复之后完全降解为对人体无害的金属离子和其他产物。相对于传统的医用金属材料，如316L不锈钢、Co-Cr合金、钛及钛合金等。由可降解金属材料制备的医疗器械有效避免了惰性内植物长期留存体内可能带来的组织过敏或炎症反应，并免去了二次手术取出的风险。目前采用可降解金属材料制备出的新一代的医疗器械，广泛应用于心血管及外科等各个领域的研究，主要体现在心血管支架、骨钉、骨板、组织闭合夹、多孔骨修复支架等方面。可降解金属材料应用于医疗领域的局限性主要体现在：一方面，目前尚缺乏有效的手段实现对可降解金属材料腐蚀速度的良好控制；另一方面，对可降解金属材料生物安全性的评价缺乏一套完善的评价标准。
explanation_en: It refers to a new class of medical metallic materials that are prone to corrosion/degradation in the human physiological environment, mainly including magnesium and its alloy. In addition, there are also some reports on the application of iron, ferroalloy and tungsten as biodegradable metallic materials. Biodegradable metallic materials have developed rapidly since the beginning of the 21st century. The application of this new type of medical metallic materials has made people abandon the traditional idea of using metal implants as bioinert materials, skillfully use the characteristics of degradation metals that are prone to corrosion/degradation in the human environment (containing chloride ions), and achieve the repair function of metal implants in vivo in a controllable way, And finally, after the reconstruction/functional repair of human tissues, they will be completely degradation into harmless metal ions and other products. Compared with traditional medical metallic materials, such as 316L stainless steel, Co Cr alloy, titanium and titanium alloy. The medical device made of biodegradable metallic materials effectively avoids the possible tissue allergy or inflammatory reaction caused by the long-term retention of inert endophytes in the body, and avoids the risk of secondary surgical removal. At present, the new generation of medical device made of biodegradable metallic materials are widely used in the research of cardiovascular and surgical fields, mainly in cardiovascular stem, bone nail, bone plate, tissue closure clips, porous bone repair stem, etc. The limitations of biodegradable metallic materials in the medical field are mainly reflected in: on the one hand, there is still no effective means to control the corrosion rate of biodegradable metallic materials; On the other hand, there is a lack of a complete set of evaluation criteria for the biosafety of biodegradable metallic materials.

explanation_cn: 又叫双头磨耗试验.其工作原理是在水平放置的圆片试样上.安放两个平行的碳化钨磨轮.磨轮在一定的负荷作用下压在试片上，转动试样，带动两个磨轮以彼此相反方向转动.测定一定转数后的质量损耗。可用于织物、塑料、橡胶金属和涂料的磨耗实验。
explanation_en: It is also called double head wear test. Its working principle is to place two parallel carbonization grinding wheels on a horizontally placed circular sample. The grinding wheels press on the test piece under a certain load, rotate the sample, and drive the two grinding wheels to rotate in opposite directions. Measure the mass loss after a certain number of revolutions. It can be used for abrasion test of fabric, plastics, rubber metal and coatings.

explanation_cn: 见麻纤维。
explanation_en: See hemp fiber.

explanation_cn: 从石墨（炭）材料的三个方向（方形材料）或两个方向（圆柱形材料）取试验样品测定其各种特性（如热膨胀系数、固有电阻、弯曲强度等），用最小值和最大值的比值作为判定其各向异性的大小，将各向异性比值为1.0~1.1的石墨（炭）称为各向同性石墨（炭），比值在1.1以上称为各向异性石墨（炭）。
explanation_en: Take test samples from three directions (square materials) or two directions (cylindrical materials) of graphite (carbon) materials to measure its various characteristics (such as coefficient of thermcal expansion, inherent resistance, bending strength, etc.), use the ratio of the minimum value to the maximum value to determine the size of its anisotropy, and call graphite (carbon) with an anisotropy ratio of 1.0~1.1 isotropic carbon, Anisotropic graphite (carbon) with a ratio above 1.1.

explanation_cn: 由人工合成的一类高分子聚合物。合成树脂的生产方法采用本体聚合、悬浮聚合、乳液聚合、溶液聚合、熔融聚合和界面缩聚等。一般为黏稠液体或加热可软化的固体，受热时通常有熔融或软化的温度范围，在外力作用下可呈塑性流动状态，某些性质与天然树脂相似。
explanation_en: A kind of macromolecule polymer synthesized artificially. The production methods of synthetic resin include bulk polymerization, suspension polymerization, emulsion polymerization, solution polymerization, melt polymerization and interfacial polycondensation. Generally, it is a viscous liquid or a solid that can be bating when heated. When heated, it usually has a melting or bating temperature range. Under the action of external force, it can be in a plastic flow state, and some properties are similar to natural resin.

explanation_cn: 又称塑料牙、树脂牙。指义齿修复时使用的由合成树脂预制的人造牙冠。常见的合成树脂牙有聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯塑料牙，工程塑料牙和复合树脂牙。
explanation_en: Also known as plastic teeth, resin teeth. It refers to the artificial crown prefabricated by synthetic resin used in demure restoration. Common synthetic resin tooth include polymethyl methacrylate plastic teeth, engineering plastics teeth and composition resin teeth.

explanation_cn: 以煤、石油、天然气或农副产品等为原料，经化学反应，制成成纤聚合物，再经纺丝及后加工制成的化学纤维。其特点是强度较好、吸湿率较小，耐酸耐碱性比天然纤维好，并可制成有某种特定性能的纤维织物，但染色较难。
explanation_en: With coal, oil, natural gas or agricultural and sideline products as raw materials, the fiber forming polymer is produced through chemical reaction, and then is spun and processed into man-made fiber. It is characterized by good strength, low moisture absorption, better acid and alkali resistance than natural fiber, and can be made into fiber fabrics with certain properties, but it is difficult to dye.

explanation_cn: 从海水、卤水或其他天然含镁矿物中人工提取的或根据使用性能要求，再配入其他原料，经高温煅烧制得的以 MgO为主要成分的耐火原料。有海水镁砂、卤水镁砂、冶金镁砂等。
explanation_en: Refractory raw materials with MgO as the main component are artificially extracted from seawater, brine, or other natural magnesium containing minerals, or mixed with other raw materials according to performance requirements, and calcined at high temperature. There are sea-water magnesia, brine magnesite, metallurgical magnesia, etc.

explanation_cn: 由两种或多种化学组分（至少含有一种金属元素）构成的固溶体或化合物形式的材料或物质。
explanation_en: Materials or substance in the form of solid solution or compound consisting of two or more chemical components (at least one metal element).

explanation_cn: 含有 Si、Mn、Ni、Cr、W、Mo、V等合金元素的适合于制作各种工具、 模具和量具的合金钢。添加不同的合金元素可明显提高钢的淬透性、抗回火稳定性、耐磨性或红硬性等， 使得工具钢的性能明显改善，适用范围非常广泛。
explanation_en: Alloy steel containing alloy elements such as Si, Mn, Ni, Cr, W, Mo, V, etc., suitable for making various tools, dies and measuring tools. The addition of different alloy elements can significantly improve the hardenabilhy, tempering resistance, wear resistance or red hardness of steel, so that the performance of tool steel can be significantly improved, and the application range is very wide.

explanation_cn: 填隙固溶体中溶质原子（间隙原子）分布在一些特定方向的间隙位置。填隙有序会引起晶体结构的变化，从而引起性能发生相应的改变。
explanation_en: The solute atoms (interstitial atoms) in interstitial solid solution are distributed in some interstitial positions in specific directions. The interstitial ordering will cause changes in the crystal structure, which will cause corresponding changes in the properties.

explanation_cn: 由两种以上成分组成的金属粉末。在每个粉末颗粒中，这些成分彼此是部分或完全合金化的。前者称部分合金化粉.后者称预合金 粉。
explanation_en: A metal powder consisting of more than two components. In each powder particle, these components are partially or completely alloy with each other. The former is called partial alloy powder, and the latter is called pre alloy powder.

explanation_cn: 在非合金结构钢的基础上，加入适量的一种或数种合金元素，使其 性能明显提高，主要用于制造截面尺寸较大的机械零件和各种工程构件的钢。
explanation_en: On the basis of non alloy structural steel, an appropriate amount of one or more alloy elements are added to significantly improve its performance. It is mainly used to manufacture steel for mechanical parts and various engineering components with large section sizes.

explanation_cn: 具有超导特性的金属合金材料称为合金超导体；典型的合金超导 体.如NbTi、NbZr等。由于具有很好的实用超导特性和加工性能，合金超导体是非常重要的低温超导材料，目前在超导磁体领域有广泛的应用。NbTi超导线材仍然占据超导领域80%以上的市场。
explanation_en: The metal alloy materials with superconductivity is called alloy superconductor; Typical alloy superconductors, such as NbTi, NbZr, etc. Alloy superconductor is a very important low temperature superconducting material due to its good practical superconducting properties and processing properties, and it is widely used in the field of superconducting magnet. NbTi superconducting wire rod still occupy more than 80% of the superconducting market.

explanation_cn: 为得到或改善某些性能，在非合金钢的基础上加入适量的一种或多种合金元素的钢.常见的合金元素有Si、Mn、Cr、Ni、Mo、W、V、Nb、Ti、B、Cu、Co、N等。
explanation_en: In order to obtain or improve some properties, an appropriate amount of one or more alloy elements are added to non-alloy steel. Common alloy elements include Si, Mn, Cr, Ni, Mo, W, V, Nb, Ti, B, Cu, Co, N, etc.

explanation_cn: 在普通铸铁中加入合金元素使其具有特殊的力学性能和耐磨、耐蚀、耐热、无磁等物理或化学性能的铸铁，也称特殊性能铸铁。常用的合金元素有Si、Mn、P、O、Ni、Mo、B、Al、V、TU Cu、RE等。
explanation_en: Adding alloy elements to ordinary cast iron to make it have special mechanical properties and physical or chemical properties such as wear resistance, corrosion resistance, heat resistance, non-magnetic, etc. cast iron is also called special cast iron. Common alloy elements include Si, Mn, P, O, Ni, Mo, B, Al, V, TU Cu, RE, etc.

explanation_cn: 见相律。
explanation_en: See phase rhythm.

explanation_cn: 同种元素或化合物随温度和压力的不同而形成两种或多种晶体结构。
explanation_en: The same element or compound forms two or more crystal structure with different temperature and pressure.

explanation_cn: 是一种通过利用同一元素的不同同位素之间微小质量差异来分离它们的过程。这种分离过程在原子能领域和核工业中具有重要应用，通常用于生产富集同位素，如浓缩铀、氘、氚等。
explanation_en: It is a process of separating different isotopes of the same element by utilizing small mass differences between them. This separation process has important applications in the field of atomic energy and nuclear industry, and is usually used to produce enriched isotopes, such as enriched uranium, deuterium, tritium, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称超导体同位素效应。1950年，麦克斯韦和雷诺兹、塞林同时发现超导体的临界温度和同位素质量有关系。即同一种元素，所选的同位素质量越高，临界温度越低。超导体的同位素效应表明，公有化电子向超导电子有序态转变的过程反映了晶格点阵运动性质的影响。因此.必须顾及晶格点阵运动以及公有化电子两个方面。这个发现给后来的BCS理论很多启发。
explanation_en: It is also called superconductor isotope effect. In 1950, Maxwell, Reynolds, and Selin simultaneously discovered a relationship between the critical temperature of superconductors and isotopic mass. The higher the mass of the selected isotope for the same element, the lower the critical temperature. The isotope effect of superconductors shows that the process of transformation from the publicly owned electrons to the ordered state of superconducting electrons reflects the influence of lattice lattice motion properties. Therefore, it is necessary to consider two aspects: lattice lattice motion and public electrons. This discovery gave a lot of inspiration to the later BCS theory.

explanation_cn: 指用外延法生长单晶时，采用的衬底与薄膜是同一种材料的方法。如从被还原分解的硅化物蒸气中在硅衬底上生长硅单晶片。同质外延不仅用于气相外延生长，也常用于液相外延生长之中。在生长过程中，除衬底的质量和清洁度外，衬底的取向对晶体的生长过程和质量影响明显。
explanation_en: It refers to the method that the substrate and film are the same materials when the single crystal is grown by epitaxy. Growth of silicon single crystal wafers on a silicon substrate from reduced and decomposed silicide vapor. Homogeneous epitaxy is not only used for vapor phase epitaxy growth, but also commonly used for liquid phase epitaxy growth. In addition to the quality and cleanliness of the substrate, the orientation of the substrate has an obvious effect on the growth process and quality of crystal.

explanation_cn: 同一种高分子形成数种不同晶型的现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that the same macromolecule forms several different crystal forms.

explanation_cn: 通过测定在一个固定和另一个在力矩作用下可旋转的两个同轴圆筒间隙内的聚合物流体的剪切速率与力矩之间的关系来计算聚合物流体切黏度的方法。同轴圆筒测黏法通常采用两种仪器类型：一类是内筒以一定的转速旋转，用传感器测定作用在外筒或内筒上的转矩，简称内旋式或上旋式黏度计。另一类是使外筒旋转，而用传感器测定作用在内筒轴上的转矩.称为外旋式或下旋式黏度计。在旋转速度等条件相同的情况下.这个转矩将随流体的黏度而变化.黏度越大转矩越大，因此测定转矩就可以知道流体的黏度。同轴圆筒旋转黏度计的优点是.当内外筒间隙很小时，被测流体各部分的切变速度接近均一。但是由于仪器构造的限制，即便操作上正确无误，也会使受测试样的实际流动状态和测量的假设条件不完全相符，造成一定的测量误差。单就消除端面效应来讲.如果加长圆筒.并且将圆筒底面间的距离加大，就可以缩小这个影响.如圆筒相当长时可忽略这个影响。
explanation_en: A method for calculating the shear viscosity of polymer fluid by measuring the relationship between the shear rate and the torque of polymer fluid in the gap between two coaxial cylinders, one fixed and the other rotatable under the action of torque. The coaxial cylinder viscosity measurement method usually uses two types of instruments: one is the inner cylinder rotating at a certain speed, and the torque acting on the outer or inner cylinder is measured by a sensor, abbreviated as the inner or upper rotation viscometer. Another type is to rotate the outer cylinder and use a sensor to measure the torque acting on the inner cylinder shaft. It is called an external or downward rotation viscometer. Under the same rotating speed and other conditions, the torque will change with the viscosity of the fluid. The greater the viscosity, the greater the torque. Therefore, the viscosity of the fluid can be known by measuring the torque. The advantage of a coaxial cylinder rotational viscometer is that when the gap between the inner and outer cylinders is small, the shear velocity of each part of the measured fluid is close to uniform. However, due to the limitations of instrument construction, even if the operation is correct, it can cause the actual flow state of the tested sample to not fully match the assumed measurement conditions, resulting in certain measurement errors. In terms of eliminating the end effect alone, if the cylinder is lengthened and the distance between the bottom surfaces of the cylinder is increased, this effect can be reduced. If the cylinder is quite long, this effect can be ignored.

explanation_cn: 是指直径为纳米级的电缆，芯部通常为半导体或导体的纳米丝，外面包敷异质纳米壳体（导体、半导体或绝缘体），外部的壳体和芯部的丝是共轴的。制备方法主要有水热合成法、溶胶-凝胶法、激光烧蚀法等。水热合成法主要先形成芯部的纳米线.然后以此为模板在其外层长出皮层。溶胶-凝胶法一般需要多步水解、还原或溶剂热法逐步形成皮芯结构.纳米电缆的制备是先通过以Pt纳米晶为种子进行种子合成银纳米线.然后将其分散到正硅酸乙酯中，通过氨水催化生成二氧化硅沉积到银线上而成皮层。其他方法还有模板法、化学气相沉积法、气-液-同生长法、激光剥蚀法、碳源氧化还原法等.可以获得很多不同成分和结构的纳米电缆。这类纳米材料由于其独特的结构和取向，在未来的纳米光电子器件的信号传输部件上具有不可取代的用途
explanation_en: It refers to a cable with a diameter of nanometers, typically consisting of nanowires of semiconductors or conductors at the core, coated with heterogeneous nanoshells (conductors, semiconductors, or insulators). The outer shell and core wires are coaxial. The main preparation methods include hydrothermal synthesis, sol-gel method method, laser ablation method, etc. The hydrothermal synthesis method mainly forms nanowires at the core first, and then uses them as a template to grow a cortex on its outer layer. Sol-gel method generally requires multi-step hydrolysis, reduction or solvothermal method to gradually form the skin core structure. The preparation of nano cable is to first use Pt nanocrystal as seeds to synthesize silver nanowires, then disperse them into tetraethyl orthosilicate, and generate silicon dioxide through ammonia catalysis to deposit on the silver wires to form the cortex. Other methods include template method, chemical vapor deposition method, gas-liquid co growth method, laser ablation method, carbon source redox method, etc. Many nano cables with different compositions and structures can be obtained. Because of its unique structure and orientation, this kind of nanomaterials has irreplaceable applications in the signal transmission components of future nano optoelectronic devices

explanation_cn: 模塑后的塑料样品或产品在后处理、储存或使用期间的收缩率。
explanation_en: Shrinkage of molded plastics samples or products during post-processing, storage or use.

explanation_cn: 硫化达到预定的程度之后或去除硫化热源后继续进行的硫化。后硫化有两种：①硫化结束后，用余热进行的硫化或硫化制品在储存过程中产生的硫化。也指制品在使用过程中由于生热而使硫化程度加深，或在动态使用下产生的交联密度提高的现象。②两段硫化制品中的后一段硫化，又称二段硫化。如尼龙轮胎的充气后硫化、硬质胶的硫化罐后硫化以及硅、氟橡胶的烘箱二段硫化等都属于后硫化，高温硫化硅橡胶制品在一段硫化后，要在鼓风干燥箱中进行二段硫化，以除去制品中的低分子物质和过氧化物的分解产物。使制品的物理机械性能和耐高温性能稳定，并改善压缩永久变形。
explanation_en: The vulcanization continues after vulcanization reaches a predetermined level or after the vulcanization heat source is removed. There are two kinds of post cure: ① vulcanization with residual heat or vulcanization of vulcanization products during storage after vulcanization. It also refers to the phenomenon that the curing degree of the product is deepened due to heat generation during use, or the crosslinking density is increased under dynamic use. ② The latter vulcanization of two-stage vulcanization products is also called two-stage vulcanization. For example, inflation post cure of nylon resin tires, post cure of hard rubber in vulcanization cans, and two-stage vulcanization of silicon and fluoro rubber in ovens all belong to post cure. After primary vulcanization of high temperature vulcanization silicone rubber products, two-stage vulcanization should be carried out in an air drying oven to remove low molecular substances and peroxide decomposition products from the products. Stabilize the physical and mechanical properties and high-temperature resistance of the product, and improve compression permanent deformation.

explanation_cn: 通常指低温辐照聚合中，停止辐照后继续进行的聚合反应。
explanation_en: It usually refers to the polymerization reaction that continues after the irradiation is stopped in the low-temperature irradiation polymerization.

explanation_cn: 由元素周期表VIII族中的Fe、Ni、Ru、Rh、Pd等金属络合物组成的催化剂。利用适当的配体，可使元素周 期表《族金属的配合物用来引发烯烃聚合，从而获得高分子量的、有各种支化度的聚合物，实现烯烃与极性单体的共聚。
explanation_en: A catalyst composed of metal complexes such as Fe, Ni, Ru, Rh, Pd in the VIII group of the periodic table of elements. With proper ligands, the complexes of metal groups in the periodic table of elements can be used to initiate polymerization of olefins, thus obtaining macromolecule weight polymer with various degrees of branching, and realizing copolymerization of olefins and polar monomer.

explanation_cn: 根据温度和液晶的物质特性的不同，液晶可以处于众多液晶相中的一种相态，而向列相是液晶的最常见的相态之一。一定温度和浓度范围下呈现向列相的物质称为向列相液晶。在向列相中，棒状分子并没有一定的位置顺序，但是它们通过其长轴的大致平行方向自我调整形成一种长程的有序。因此，虽然棒状分子重心的排列是无序的，可以在液晶里自由地流动，但是它们之间仍是保持基本上互相平行排列的状态。在外界磁场或电场作用下，分子很容易受到作用而产生一定的排列。大多数的是单轴的：分子只有一个比较长的轴和其他两个比较短但是相平等的轴。但也有少数向列相液晶是双轴的：这种分子除了定向于它们的长轴，同时也定向于它们的次长轴。
explanation_en: According to temperature and the material properties of liquid crystals, liquid crystals can be in one of the many liquid crystal phases, and nematic phase is one of the most common phase states of liquid crystals. The substance that presents nematic phase at a certain temperature and concentration range is called nematic liquid crystal. In the nematic phase, rod-shaped molecules do not have a certain positional order, but they self adjust to form a long-range order through the roughly parallel direction of their long axis. Therefore, although the arrangement of the barycentres of rod-shaped molecules is disordered and can flow freely in the liquid crystal, they still maintain a basically parallel arrangement with each other. Under the action of external magnetic or electric fields, molecules are easily affected and form a certain arrangement. Most are uniaxial: molecules have only one longer axis and two other shorter but phase axes. However, a few nematic liquid crystal are biaxial: such molecules are oriented not only to their long axis, but also to their secondary long axis.

explanation_cn: 含氟丙稀酸酯橡胶是一种由含氟丙稀酸酯单体经乳液聚合制备而成的弹性体。这种橡胶主要由高分子量的聚合物构成，其氟含量通常高于50%。例如，含氟丙烯酸酯橡胶（1F4）的氟含量为52.3%。它的外观呈白色橡胶状固体，相对密度为1.54，玻璃化温度为-30°C，分子量在(5-10) x 10^5范围内。目前，工业化生产的含氟丙烯酸酯橡胶种类较少。美国的3M公司生产两种主要类型的含氟丙烯酸酯橡胶，分别为聚1,1-二氢全氟丁基丙烯酸酯（商品名为Poly-FBA或1F4）和聚3-全氟甲氧基-1,1-二氢全氟丙基丙烯酸酯（商品名为Poly-FMFPA或2F4K）。这些含氟丙烯酸酯橡胶在航空、军工和火箭等领域的部件制造中具有重要应用。它们属于关键的军工产品。
explanation_en: Fluorinated acrylate rubber is an elastomer prepared by emulsion polymerization of fluorinated acrylate monomer. This rubber is mainly composed of macromolecule weight polymer, and its fluorine content is usually higher than 50%. For example, the fluorine content of fluoroacrylate rubber (1F4) is 52.3%. Its appearance is white rubber like solid, its relative density is 1.54, its glass transition temperature is -30 ° C, and its molecular weight is in the range of (5-10) x 10 ^ 5. At present, there are few types of fluoroacrylate rubber produced industrially. 3M Company in the United States produces two main types of fluoroacrylate rubber, namely, poly1,1-dihydrofluorobutyl acrylate (trade name: Poly-FBA or 1F4) and poly-3-perfluoromethoxy-1,1-dihydrofluoropropyl acrylate (trade name: Poly-FMFPA or 2F4K). These fluoroacrylate rubber have important applications in the manufacturing of components in aviation, military and rocket industries. They are key military products.

explanation_cn: 通过物理、化学作用吸收含有气态氟化氢、四氟化硅的工业废气，将其转变成氢氟酸或相应含氟盐类化合物的材料。常用的净化含氟废气的方法有湿法和干法两种。湿法吸收剂主要有水、碱性溶液等。水吸收含氟废气时可生成氢氟酸、氟硅酸及硅胶。可作为原料制取冰晶石、氟硅脲、氟硅酸钠等产品，该法吸收剂易得、成本低，但对设备有腐蚀作用。目前主要应用于磷肥生产中含氟废气的净化；碱性溶液主要有氨水、石灰乳、纯碱、烧碱溶液，脱氟效率较高，可生成氟硅酸盐或氣的其它盐类化合物，生成的氟化物溶解于洗液中或沉淀出来，吸收液可再生循环使用。湿法适用于排气量较小、废气中含氟量低的废气，优点是可减少氟对吸收设备的腐蚀，原料价廉易得。干法主吸收剂主要有氧化铝、氧化钙、氢氧化钠等。利用细粒状的氧化铝的两性化合物的特性吸收酸性HF，生成A1F3;氧化钙、氢氧化钙可与含氣废气生成氣化钙或其他盐类物质。干法没有湿法的严重腐蚀设备和废水处理问题.脱氟效率高、工艺流程简单。含氟废气吸附剂主要应用于电解铝厂、水泥厂、火电厂、磷酸及磷肥厂等含氟废气的处理。
explanation_en: Absorb industrial waste gas containing gaseous hydrogen fluoride and silicon tetrafluoride through physical and chemical action, and transformation it into hydrofluoric acid or materials containing corresponding fluoride salt compounds. There are two commonly used methods for purifying fluoride containing waste gas: wet method and dry method. Wet absorbents mainly include water, alkaline solutions, etc. When water absorbs fluorine containing waste gas, hydrofluoric acid, fluorosilicic acid and silicone gel can be generated. It can be used as raw material to produce cryolite, fluorosilicone urea, sodium fluorosilicate and other products. This method is easy to obtain absorbent with low cost, but it has corrosion effect on equipment. Currently, it is mainly used for the purification of fluorine containing waste gas in phosphate fertilizer production; Alkaline solutions mainly include ammonia water, lime milk, soda ash, and caustic soda solutions. The efficiency of defluorination is high, which can generate fluorosilicates or other salt compounds of gas. The generated fluoride is dissolved in the washing solution or precipitation, and the absorption solution is renewable and recycled. The wet method is applicable to the waste gas with small exhaust volume and low fluorine content in the waste gas. The advantage is that it can reduce the corrosion of fluorine to the absorption equipment, and the raw materials are cheap and easy to obtain. The main absorbents for dry process include alumina, calcium oxide, sodium hydroxide, etc. Utilizing the characteristics of the amphoteric compound of fine-grained alumina to absorb acidic HF and generate A1F3; Calcium oxide and calcium hydroxide can form gasification calcium or other salt substances with gas-containing waste gas. Dry process has no serious corrosion equipment and waste water treatment problem of wet process, high defluorination efficiency and simple process flow. Fluorine containing waste gas adsorbent is mainly used for the treatment of fluoride containing waste gas in electrolytic aluminum plants, cement plants, thermal power plants, phosphoric acid and phosphate fertilizer plants.

explanation_cn: 主要指聚烯烃类的含氟纤维.包括聚四氟乙烯、四氟乙烯-六氟丙烯共聚纤维、 三氟氯乙烯-乙烯共聚纤维、氟乙烯-六氟丙烯共聚纤 维、四氟乙烯-偏二氟乙烯共聚纤维、四氟乙烯-乙烯 共聚纤维、四氟乙烯-全氣烷基乙烯基醚、聚偏二氟乙烯和聚氟乙烯等纤维。
explanation_en: It mainly refers to fluorofibrc of polyolefins, including polylctrafluorocthylone, tetrafluoroethylenehexafluoropropylene copolymer fiber, trifluoroethylene ethylene copolymer fiber, fluoroethylene hexafluoropropylene copolymer fiber, tetrafluoroethylene vinylidene fluoride copolymer fiber, tetrafluoroethylene ethylene copolymer fiber, tetrafluoroethylene full gas alkyl vinyl ether, polyvinylidene fluoride and polyfluoroethylene.

explanation_cn: 具有较高氮含量的铁合金。由于氮元素在铁基体中的平衡固溶度很小，通常的炼钢工艺很难得到高氮含量的钢，而经济型不锈钢及钒氮微合金钢中大多需要钢中，含有比常规冶炼条件下更高的氮.这时往往可在炼钢 时加入含氮铁合金或采用高压熔炼工艺。
explanation_en: Ferroalloy with high nitrogen content. Because the equilibrium solid solubility of nitrogen element in iron matrix is very small, it is difficult to obtain steel with high nitrogen content in the normal steelmaking process. Most of the economic stainless steel and vanadium nitrogen microalloyed steel need steel, which contains higher nitrogen than the conventional smelting conditions. At this time, it is often possible to add nitrogen-containing ferroalloy or use high-pressure melting process in steelmaking.

explanation_cn: 以氯乙烯和偏氯乙烯为基本原料的一系列含有氯元素的合成纤维，包括聚氯乙烯纤维、偏氯乙烯纤维、氯乙烯-丙烯腈共聚纤维、 偏氯乙烯-丙烯腈共聚纤维、偏氯乙烯氯乙烯-丙烯腈 (少量）三元共聚纤维、氯乙烯-醋酸乙烯共聚纤维等。
explanation_en: A series of synthetic fiber containing chlorine based on vinyl chloride and vinylidene chloride, including poly (vinyl chloride) fiber, vinylidene chloride fiber, vinyl chloride acrylonitrile copolymer fiber, vinylidene chloride acrylonitrile copolymer fiber, vinylidene chloride vinyl chloride acrylonitrile (a small amount) terpolymer fiber, vinyl chloride vinyl acetate copolymer fiber, etc.

explanation_cn: 一种用液体润滑剂（如硅油、机油、压缩机油、汽缸油等）共混改性的聚甲醛树脂，具有良好的自润滑性和耐磨耗性。
explanation_en: A polyoxymethylene resin modified by blending liquid lubricant (such as silicone oil, engine oil, compressor oil, cylinder oil, etc.) has good self-lubricating and wear resistance.

explanation_cn: 浸油的粉末冶金多孔轴承。烧结多孔轴承浸入润滑油，并使油储存在轴承空隙内，当机器运转时，轴与轴承摩擦发热.孔内润滑油受热即能自动流向轴承表面.形成润滑油膜，起润滑作用。
explanation_en: Oil immersed powder metallurgy porous bearing. Sintering porous bearing is immersed in lubricating oil, and the oil is stored in the bearing gap. When the machine is running, the shaft and bearing friction heat. When the lubricating oil in the hole is heated, it can automatically flow to the bearing surface to form a lubricating oil film for lubrication.

explanation_cn: 含碳量较高（>2%)的耐火材料。由耐火氧化物、含碳原材料与结合剂等.在较高压力下成型制备。其具有优良的抗渣性和热震稳定性，弱点是抗氧化能力差。
explanation_en: Refractory with high carbon content (>2%). Made by forming refractory oxides, carbon containing raw materials, and binders under high pressure. It has excellent slag resistance and thermal shock resistance, but its weakness is poor antioxidant capacity.

explanation_cn: 同体推进剂中 一类分子内既含有含能基团又可以对黏合剂基体产生 增塑作用的低分子有机化合物。其主要作用是通过增塑作用降低黏合剂的玻璃化温度，同时提高推进剂的 能量并降低制药过程中药浆的黏度。
explanation_en: In homopropellant, a kind of low molecular organic compounds that contain energetic groups and can plasticize the matrix of adhesive. Its main function is to reduce the glass transition temperature of adhesive through plasticization, increase the energy of propellant and reduce the viscosity of Chinese medicine slurry in the pharmaceutical process.

explanation_cn: 含萘共聚芳酯是一种共聚芳酯，通常包括萘环结构。它是通过将含有萘环的单体（如2,7-萘二酚、2,6-萘二甲酸、羟基萘甲酸等）与不含萘环的芳香族单体（如羟基苯甲酸、对/间苯二甲酸等）进行随机共聚而制得。这个过程生成了含有萘环结构的芳香族共聚酯。由于这些含有萘环的结构，分子链具有很高的化学惰性，因此这些共聚物通常表现出出色的热稳定性。其熔点通常低于300°C，其中萘含量越高，熔点越低，可以降至230°C左右。这些共聚物的分解温度通常高于500°C，使其适用于熔融纺丝等应用。其中最常见的含萘共聚芳酯是通过以羟基苯甲酸和羟基萘甲酸为原料，通过熔融聚合制备的，商用代号为Vectra。Vectra是一种热致液晶聚合物，具有密度范围为1.4到1.9g/cm3，拉伸强度通常在170到210MPa之间，伸长率介于2.0%到6.0%之间。此外，它的线胀系数较低，与金属材料相当，因此制品可以达到高尺寸精度。这种材料在精密成型方面非常适用，具有出色的耐化学药品性能。Vectra广泛应用于多个领域，包括电子电气（如连接器、线圈绕线管、间歇式开关等）、化工、机械（如吸收塔的填料、扬声器振动板等）以及其他领域，如薄膜和纤维等。
explanation_en: Naphthalene-containing copolyarylate is a kind of copolyarylate, which usually includes the structure of naphthalene ring. It is prepared by random copolymerization of monomer containing naphthalene ring (such as 2,7-naphthalene diphenol, 2,6-naphthalene dicarboxylic acid, hydroxynaphthalic acid, etc.) and aromatic monomer without naphthalene ring (such as hydroxybenzoic acid, p/isophthalic acid, etc.). This process generates aromatic copolyesters containing naphthalene ring structures. These copolymer usually exhibit excellent thermal stability due to the high chemical inertness of their molecular chains due to the structure containing naphthalene rings. Its melting point is generally lower than 300 ° C. The higher the naphthalene content, the lower the melting point, which can be reduced to about 230 ° C. The decomposition temperature of these copolymer is usually higher than 500 ° C, making them suitable for melt spinning and other applications. The most common naphthalene-containing copolyarylate is prepared by melt polymerization with hydroxybenzoic acid and hydroxynaphthalic acid as raw materials, and the commercial code is Vectra. Vectra is a thermotropic liquid crystals polymer with density ranging from 1.4 to 1.9 g/cm 3， The tensile strength is usually between 170 and 210MPa, and the elongation is between 2.0% and 6.0%. In addition, its coefficient of linear expansion is low, which is equivalent to that of metallic materials, so the products can achieve high dimensional accuracy. This materials is very suitable for precision forming and has excellent chemical resistance. Vectra is widely used in multiple fields, including electronic and electrical (such as connectors, coil coils, intermittent switches, etc.), chemical, mechanical (such as fillers for absorption towers, speaker vibration plates, etc.), as well as other fields, such as film and fiber.

explanation_cn: 由猛炸药与铝粉组成的混合炸药，又称铝化炸药。主要成分为猛炸药及铝粉，有的也含少量其他添加剂（钝感剂和黏合剂等）。铝粉能与爆炸产物产生二次反应生成三氧化二铝，放出大量热，使爆热和做功能力大幅度提高，作用时间延长，作用范围扩大，破片温度提高，并有利于水中气泡的扩张和增压。
explanation_en: The composite explosive, which is composed of explosive and aluminium powder, is also called aluminized explosive. The main ingredients are explosive and aluminium powder, and some also contain a small amount of other additive (deterrent, adhesive, etc.). Aluminium powder can react with explosion products to produce aluminum oxide, which gives off a lot of heat, greatly improving the explosion heat and work ability, prolonging the action time, expanding the action range, increasing the fragment temperature, and facilitating the expansion and pressurization of bubbles in water.

explanation_cn: 通常指含有1%-2%Hf的镍基铸造高温合金，包括等轴晶和定向凝固柱晶高温合金。随着高温合金高温强度的不断提高，发现其中温塑性不断降低，特别是中温蠕变断裂（持久）塑性存在明显低谷，甚至中温蠕变过程中不出现第三阶段蠕变。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to nickel-base cast superalloy containing 1% -2% Hf, including equiaxed and directional solidification columnar high temperature alloy. With the continuous improvement of high temperature strength of high temperature alloy, it is found that the plasticity at intermediate temperature decreases continuously, especially the fracture (rupture) plasticity at intermediate temperature creep has an obvious trough, and even the third stage creep does not occur in the process of intermediate temperature creep.

explanation_cn: 多孔金属中浸人液体香料，并储存在空隙中的粉末冶金工艺品。空隙中的含香物的挥发受空隙中金属颗粒的阻挡，而挥发缓慢。因而含香金属能够在较长时期内（1-2年）具有香味。配以纪念性图案.成为一种有纪念意义的工艺品。用以制作含香金属纪念品的金属有金、银、铜、不锈钢等粉末。在带有图案和文字的模具中加压成多孔金属压坯，经烧结、抛光，压花形成所需阁案后，浸香完成制造过程。青铜的色泽经调整后得到近似黄金颜色，其压花变形性好，烧结温度较低成为含香金属的主要金属。还由于青铜或黄铜随氧化程度不同而颜色变化很大，经过适当的调整，可成为仿古铜币或颜色鲜艳的纪念币。
explanation_en: A powder metallurgy handicraft made of porous metal impregnated with liquid spices and stored in voids. The volatilization of aromatic substances in the gaps is hindered by metal particles in the gaps, and the volatilization is slow. Therefore, scented porous metal can have fragrance for a long time (1-2 years). Accompanied with commemorative patterns, it becomes a handicraft with commemorative significance. The metals used to make scented porous metal souvenirs include gold, silver, copper, stainless steel and other powder. It is pressed into a porous metal compact in a mold with patterns and characters, then sintering, polished, embossed to form the required cabinet, and then dipped into incense to complete the manufacturing process. The color of bronze is adjusted to approximate the golden color, its embossed deformation is good, and the lower sintering temperature becomes the main metal of scented porous metal. Also, because the color of bronze or brass varies greatly with the degree of oxidation, it can become an antique copper coin or a brightly colored commemorative coin after appropriate adjustment.

explanation_cn: 具有较强的吸收声能、减低噪声性能的材料。材料的吸声频率特性多以125Hz、250Hz、500Hz、1000Hz、2000Hz和4000Hz六个频率下混响实验室测定的吸声系数表示，也有规定减噪系数（250-2000HZ）四个倍频程下混响实验室测定的吸声系数的算术平均值，或是低频（125-500Hz)吸声系数不低于0.2;中频（500-2000Hz)不低于0.4。因吸声机理的不同可分为两类：一类是多孔材料，依靠表面至内部许多细小的敞幵孔道使声波衰减（吸声机理见多孔），以吸收中高频声波为主，主要是纤维质和开孔结构的材料;另一类是靠共振作用吸声的柔性材料（吸收中频）、膜状材料（低中频）、板状材料（低频）和穿孔板（中频）。上述材料复合使用，可以扩大吸声范围，提高吸声系数。与隔声材料作用不同，常用于减少声波在室内的反射，吸收部分混响声（声波在室内壁多次反射形成）的声能，降低室内声级，改善混响声对人的影响;用于降低喧闹场所的噪声，以改善生活环境和劳动条件;还广泛用于降低通风空调管道的噪声。
explanation_en: Materials with strong sound energy absorption and noise reduction performance. The sound absorption frequency characteristics of materials are mostly expressed by the sound absorption coefficient measured by the reverberation laboratory at six frequencies of 125Hz, 250Hz, 500Hz, 1000Hz, 2000Hz and 4000Hz, and there are also the arithmetic mean of the sound absorption coefficient measured by the reverberation laboratory at four octaves of the specified noise reduction coefficient (250-2000HZ), or the sound absorption coefficient at low frequencies (125-500Hz) is not less than 0.2; The intermediate frequency (500-2000Hz) shall not be less than 0.4. Due to different sound absorption mechanisms, it can be divided into two categories: one is porous materials, which rely on many small open channels from the surface to the interior to attenuate sound waves (see porous for sound absorption mechanism), mainly absorbing medium and high frequency sound waves, mainly fiber and materials with open hole structure; The other is flexible materials (absorbing intermediate frequency), membrane materials (low intermediate frequency), plate materials (low frequency) and perforated plates (intermediate frequency) that absorb sound by resonance. The composition use of the above materials can expand the sound absorption range and improve the sound absorption coefficient. Different from acoustic insulation materials, it is often used to reduce the reflection of sound waves in the room, absorb the sound energy of some mixed sound (formed by multiple reflections of sound waves on the indoor wall), reduce the indoor sound level, and improve the impact of reverberation on people; Used to reduce noise in noisy places and improve living environment and working conditions; It is also widely used to reduce the noise of ventilation and air conditioning pipelines.

explanation_cn: 当一束光照射到发光材料上时，一部分被反射、散射，一部分透射?其余的被吸收?只有被吸收的这部分光才能对发光材料的发光起作用?当然不是所苻被吸收的各种波长光都能对发光有贡献的。发光材料的吸收光谱首先决定于材料的基质，而激活剂和其他杂质也起一定的作用。
explanation_en: When a beam of light shines on the luminescence materials, part of it is reflected, scattered, and part of it is transmitted? Is the rest absorbed? Only the absorbed light can play a role in the luminescence of luminescence materials? Of course, not all wavelengths of light absorbed can contribute to luminescence. The absorption spectrum of luminescence materials is first determined by the matrix of materials, while activators and other impurities also play a role.

explanation_cn: 能吸收、衰减电磁波.并将电磁能转换成热能耗散掉或使电磁波因干涉而消失的一类织物"吸收电磁波织物由吸收剂、基体材料、黏结剂、辅料等复合而成。吸收剂起着主要作用，主要有非金属类（碳纤维、碳化硅纤维、导电性石墨粉、钛酸钡陶瓷）、金属类（包括金属纤维和金属粉）、导电高聚物（聚乙炔、聚吡咯、聚噻吩、聚苯胺）等。吸收电磁波织物可分为涂敷型和结构型吸波材料两大类。涂敷型吸波材料是将吸收剂与黏结剂混合后涂敷于目标表面形成吸波涂层，主要有铁氧体吸波涂层、超微磁性金属粉吸波涂层、碳纤维吸波涂层、导电高聚物手性吸波涂层（在基体树脂中掺和一种或多种具有不同特性参数的手性媒质构成，其电场与磁场耦合）;结构型吸波材料是将吸收剂分散在由特种纤维（如石英纤维、玻璃纤维等）增强的结构材料中所形成的结构复合材料，具有承载和吸收电磁波的双重功能，如混杂纱吸波材料、陶瓷型吸波材料、碳碳吸波材料。吸收电磁波织物主要应用于安全防护用品，包括防护工作服、防护工作帽、护腕、护肘、手套和乳罩等;工作环境防护用品（各类电子仪器屏蔽罩、屏蔽墙布和窗帘）以及军用伪装网等。
explanation_en: Able to absorb Attenuating electromagnetic wave. It is a kind of fabric that converts electromagnetic energy into heat energy to dissipate or make electromagnetic wave disappear due to interference. "electromagnetic wave absorption fabric is made of composition of absorbent, matrix materials, adhesive, auxiliary materials, etc. Absorbent plays a major role, mainly including non-metallic (carbon fiber, silicon carbide fiber, conductive graphite powder, BaTiO3 ceramics), metal (including metal fiber and metal powder), conductive polymer (polyacetylene, polypyrrole, polythiophene, polyanilene), etc. Electromagnetic wave absorption fabric can be divided into two categories: coated and structural absorbing material. The coated absorbing material is a kind of wave absorbing coating formed by mixing the absorbent and adhesive on the target surface, mainly including ferrite wave absorbing coating, ultramicro magnetic metal powder wave absorbing coating, carbon fiber wave absorbing coating, conductive polymer chiral wave absorbing coating (mixed with one or more chiral media with different characteristic parameters in the matrix resin, and its electric field and magnetic field are coupled); Structural absorbing material is a structural composite materials formed by dispersing absorbers in structural materials reinforced by special fiber (such as quartze fiber, glass fiber, etc.), which has dual functions of carrying and absorbing electromagnetic waves, such as hybrid yarn absorbing material, ceramics absorbing material, carbon carbon absorbing material. Electromagnetic wave absorption fabric is mainly used for safety protection articles, including protective work clothes, protective work caps, wrist guards, elbow protectors, gloves and bras; Work environment protective equipment (various electronic instrument shielding covers, shielding wall coverings, and curtains), as well as military camouflage nets, etc.

name_en: kinetics of hydrogen absorption and desorption
explanation_cn: 研究各种物理因素、化学因素（如温度、压力、浓度、颗粒尺寸、元素种类、晶体结构、催化剂等）对吸放氢速率的影响以及相应的反应机理和动力学模型的一门学科。储氢材料的性能是制约其大规模储氢应用的重要因素。许多学者根据各自的实验结果，建立了不同的方程。
explanation_en: It is a discipline to study the effects of various physical and chemical factors (such as temperature, pressure, concentration, particle size, element type, crystal structure, catalyst, etc.) on the rate of hydrogen absorption and desorption, as well as the corresponding reaction mechanism and kinetic model. The performance of hydrogen storage materials is an important factor restricting its large-scale application of hydrogen storage. Many scholars have established different equations based on their own experimental results.

name_en: thermodynamics of hydrogen absorption and desorption
explanation_cn: 研究储氢材料在吸收和释放氢气的过程中所伴随着的能量之间的相互转化的规律及其应用，从而对反应的进行程度作出准确的判断。
explanation_en: To study the law and application of energy conversion between hydrogen storage materials in the process of absorbing and releasing hydrogen, so as to accurately judge the degree of reaction.

explanation_cn: 研究表明，在Ni-MH（镍氢）电池的充电和放电过程中，正极和负极上发生的电化学电极反应如下：正极（正极反应）：Ni(OH)2 + H2O → NiO(OH) + H2O + e-放电负极（负极反应）：M + H2O → MH + OH- + e-电池总反应：Ni(OH)2 + M + H2O → NiO(OH) + MH + OH-在这些反应中，正极上的材料是氢氧化镍（Ni(OH)2），负极上的材料是储氢合金（M），而电解液中的氢离子（H+)则参与这些反应。在充电过程中，电解液中的氢离子会吸收一个电子并变成氢原子，这是负极储氢合金M与氢气反应生成氢化物MH的过程，也就是吸氢电极的反应。这些反应使得Ni-MH电池能够在充电和放电过程中储存和释放氢气，实现能量的转化，从而提供电力。这种电池类型在许多应用中得到广泛使用，因为它们具有较高的能量密度和较长的寿命。
explanation_en: The research shows that during the charging and discharging process of the Ni MH battery, the electrochemical electrode reactions on the positive and negative electrodes are as follows: positive (positive reaction): Ni (OH) 2+H2O → NiO (OH)+H2O+e-discharge negative (negative reaction): M+H2O → MH+OH -+e-total battery reaction: Ni (OH) 2+M+H2O → NiO (OH)+MH+OH - In these reactions, the materials on the positive electrode is nickel hydroxide (Ni (OH) 2), The materials on the negative electrode is a hydrogen storage alloy (M), and the hydrogen ion (H+) in the electrolyte participates in these reactions. During the charging process, hydrogen ions in the electrolyte absorb an electron and transform into hydrogen atoms. This is the process of the negative electrode hydrogen storage alloy M reacting with hydrogen to generate hydride MH, which is the reaction of the hydrogen absorbing electrode. These reactions enable Ni-MH batteries to store and release hydrogen gas during charging and discharging, achieving energy conversion and providing electricity. This type of battery is widely used in many applications because of its high energy density and long life.

explanation_cn: 试件在一定温度的水中浸泡规定的时间后，其厚度增加量与原厚度的百分比。
explanation_en: The percentage increase in thickness of a specimen after immersion in water at a certain temperature for a specified time compared to its original thickness.

explanation_cn: 材料在室温、0.1MPa下自然吸水饱和的能力。以质量或体积表示。即绝干材料饱水后增加的质量与绝干材料的质量或体积的百分数。用于测定材料的开口气孔（与试件表面连通）所占的体积百分比。它对制品的机械强度、电性能、化学稳定性以及热稳定性都有很大影响。
explanation_en: The ability of materials to naturally absorb water and saturate at room temperature and 0.1MPa. Expressed in terms of mass or volume. That is, the percentage of the increased mass of the dehydrated materials after saturation and the mass or volume of the dehydrated materials. It is used to measure the volume percentage of open pores (connected with the surface of the test piece) of materials. It has a great impact on the mechanical strength, electrical properties, chemical stability and thermal stability of products.

explanation_cn: 指能吸油量是自身质量好几倍的功能纤维。100%的等规聚丙烯纤维其吸油功能不受油的品种限制，无论黑油或白油类均可吸收（包括动植物油）.而且可在瞬间完成，纤维本身具有疏水亲油性，只吸收水中的油类而几乎不吸水，选择性优良，而且不会沉人水中，不溶于汽油及芳族油类，可反复使用。吸油后能长时间保持原状，不变形，用后回收简便，该材料无毒性，不会污染水产品，通常保管时也不会变质，可随时进行焚烧处理而不会产生有害气体。聚笨乙烯类的特点是吸油能力极大，但对油的品种有其选择性和制约性，其只能吸收重油.对含有大量汽油、冲淡剂、苯和甲笨等芳族类溶剂的废水，在处理过程有其本身被溶解掉的危险。这些吸油纤维大都制成非织造布或毡使用，因此制备方法主要采用熔喷法、纺黏法和干法气流成网并进行针刺而得。具有吸油面积大、易回收，可根据需要加工成各种形态制品等优点。用途主要是海洋，港湾和河川等各种漏油的捕集，工厂排水中浮油的吸收处理，养殖场或浴场防油类入侵的防护围材，油水分离装置的填充滤材，某些有机溶剂吸收剂及脱臭剂等。
explanation_en: It refers to functional fiber that can absorb oil several times of its own quality. The oil absorption function of 100% isotactic polypropylene fiber is not limited by the type of oil. It can be absorbed by black oil or white oil (including animal and vegetable oil). It can also be completed in an instant. The fiber itself is hydrophobic and lipophilic. It only absorbs oil in water but hardly absorbs water. It has excellent selectivity and will not sink into water. It is insoluble in gasoline and aromatic oils. It can be used repeatedly. After oil absorption, it can be kept intact for a long time without deformation. After use, it is easy to recover. The materials is non-toxic, does not pollute aquatic products, and usually does not deteriorate when kept. It can be incinerated at any time without producing harmful gases. The characteristic of polybenzenes is their great oil absorption ability, but they have selectivity and constraints on the variety of oil. They can only absorb heavy oil. For wastewater containing a large amount of aromatic solvents such as gasoline, diluents, benzene, and methyl benzene, there is a risk of their own dissolution during the treatment process. Most of these oil absorbent fiber are made into nonwovens or felt for use, so the preparation methods are mainly melt blowing, spinning and sticking, and dry air flow to form a mesh and then acupuncture. It has the advantages of large oil absorption area, easy recycling, and can be processed into various forms of products according to needs. The main purpose is to capture various oil spills in the ocean, harbors, rivers, and other areas, absorb and treat floating oil in factory drainage, use protective enclosure materials to prevent oil invasion in breeding or bathing grounds, fill filter materials for oil-water separation devices, and use certain organic solvent absorbents and deodorants.

explanation_cn: 高吸湿合成纤维是一种合成纤维，具有较高的吸湿能力，通常要求其标准回潮率达到6%或更高。这些纤维在吸附水分时可以分为结合水和游离水两部分。结合水是由纤维中的极性基团极化作用而吸附的水，属于化学吸附；而游离水则是通过范德华力在纤维毛细孔和表面起作用而吸附的水，属于物理吸附。在主要的合成纤维中，吸湿量通常不高。例如，聚酯纤维的吸湿率约为0.4%到0.5%，聚丙烯腈纤维为1.2%到2%，聚丙烯纤维约为0，而吸湿性较高的聚酰胺6和聚酰胺66的吸湿率为3.5%到4.5%，聚乙烯醇纤维为4.5%到5.0%。这些数值都低于棉花的吸湿率，后者通常在7%到8%之间。提高合成纤维吸湿率的方法包括引入亲水基团，共聚合亲水性单体，纤维接枝共聚亲水性单体，以及与亲水性物质共混纺丝。这些方法可以导致纤维形成微孔和表面沟槽结构，从而提高比表面积，以及将合成纤维中的基团转变为亲水基团。高吸湿纤维主要用于制造内衣、运动服等，具有穿着舒适的特点。此外，它们还用于制造外套和室内装饰材料，因为这些纤维不容易产生静电，从而减少吸附尘埃和污染物的问题。
explanation_en: High hygroscopic synthetic fiber is a kind of synthetic fiber with high hygroscopic capacity, and its standard moisture regain is usually required to reach 6% or higher. These fibers can be divided into two parts when adsorbing water: bound water and free water. The bound water is the water adsorbed by the polarization of the polar group in the fiber, which belongs to chemical adsorption; The free water is the water adsorbed by van der Waals force acting on the pores and surface of fiber wool, which belongs to physical adsorption. In the main synthetic fiber, moisture absorption is usually not high. For example, the moisture absorption of polyester fiber is about 0.4% to 0.5%, polyacrylonitrile fiber is 1.2% to 2%, polypropylene fiber is about 0, while the moisture absorption of polyamide 6 and polyamide 66 with high moisture absorption is 3.5% to 4.5%, and polyvinyl alcohol fiber is 4.5% to 5.0%. These values are lower than the moisture absorption rate of cotton, which is usually between 7% and 8%. The methods to improve the moisture absorption of synthetic fiber include introducing hydrophilic groups, copolymerization of hydrophilic monomer, fiber graft copolymerization of hydrophilic monomer, and blending with hydrophilic substances. These methods can lead to the formation of micropores and surface grooves on the fiber, thus increasing the specific surface area, and transformation the groups in the synthetic fiber into hydrophilic groups. High hydroscopic fiber is mainly used to manufacture underwear, sportswear, etc., with the characteristics of comfortable wearing. In addition, they are also used to make coats and interior decoration materials, because these fibers are not easy to generate static electricity, thus reducing the problem of absorbing dust and pollutants.

explanation_cn: 多孔陶瓷埋体或袖陶的多孔胎等，在潮湿环境中因吸收空气中的水分而发生体枳膨胀的现象。
explanation_en: The porous body of porous ceramics or sleeve ceramics will expand due to absorption of moisture in the air in a humid environment.

explanation_cn: 橡胶与炭黑共混过程中，部分橡胶分子填充至炭黑凝聚体表面的孔洞中，形成部分吸附橡胶，称为吸留胶。
explanation_en: In the process of rubber and carbon black polymer blending, part of rubber molecules are filled into the holes on the surface of carbon black condensate to form part of the adsorbed rubber, which is called retention rubber.

explanation_cn: 主要属于物理吸附，它是吸附质和吸附剂以分子间作用力为主的吸附。物理吸附的原理是：电荷分布的共振波动是气体分子吸附在固体表面的物理吸附的根源，被称作范德华作用。材料与氢分子的相互作用很弱，在室温及更高温度下氢气很容易脱附，但是，如果材料有很大的比表面，还是可以表现出较好储氢性能的。为增大其表面积，人们倾向于将其颗粒缩小至纳米尺度。材料主要有碳纳米材料、沸石、金属有机骨架化合物等。
explanation_en: It mainly belongs to physical adsorption, which is the adsorption of adsorbate and adsorbent based on intermolecular force. The principle of physical adsorption is that the resonant fluctuation of charge distribution is the source of physical adsorption of gas molecules on the solid surface, which is called van der Waals effect. The interaction between materials and hydrogen molecules is very weak, and hydrogen is easily desorbed at room temperature and higher temperatures. However, if materials have a large specific surface area, they can still show good hydrogen storage performance. In order to increase its surface area, people tend to reduce its particles to the nanoscale. Materials mainly include carbon nanomaterials, zeolite, metal organic framework compounds, etc.

explanation_cn: 让一种吸附质分子吸附在待测粉末样品（吸附剂）表面，根据吸附量的多少来评价待测粉末样品比表面大小的方法。使用最广的为以氮分子作为吸附质的氮吸附法，氮吸附法由于需要在液氮温度下进行吸附，又叫低温氮吸附法，这种方法中使用的吸附质--氮分子性质稳定、分子直径小、安全无毒、来源广泛，是理想的且是目前主要的吸附法比表面测试吸附质。
explanation_en: A method of adsorbing adsorbate molecules on the surface of the powder sample (adsorbent) to be tested, and evaluating the specific surface size of the powder sample to be tested according to the amount of adsorption. The most widely used nitrogen adsorption method is the nitrogen adsorption method, which uses nitrogen molecules as the adsorbate. Due to the need to adsorb at liquid nitrogen temperature, the nitrogen adsorption method is also called low-temperature nitrogen adsorption method. The adsorbate used in this method - nitrogen molecules with stable properties, small molecular diameter, safe and non-toxic, and a wide range of sources - is ideal and currently the main adsorption method compared to surface testing adsorbate.

explanation_cn: 指吸附过程产生的热效应。吸附热的大小可以衡量吸附强弱的程度?吸附热越大，吸附越强。物理吸附没有选择性，吸附热小，吸附不稳定，容易脱附;化学吸附则相反。参见物理吸附和化学吸附。
explanation_en: Refers to the thermal effect generated by the adsorption process. Can the heat of adsorption measure the degree of adsorption? The greater the heat of adsorption, the stronger the adsorption. Physical adsorption has no selectivity, low heat of adsorption, unstable adsorption and easy desorption; Chemical adsorption is the opposite. See physical adsorption and chemical adsorption.

explanation_cn: 由于表面粗植、内部有许多具有渗透性和迁移性的微孔，能吸着气体或液体的纤维。一般可通过对天然纤维或化学纤维进行化学的和物理改性而制成，主要方法是增进纤维吸附气体和液体的能力和增加内部吸附气体、液体的空间。如改性的再生纤维素纤维（如合金型再生纤维素纤维）和改性的合成纤维（如高吸湿合成纤维）等。
explanation_en: Due to its rough surface and numerous permeable and migratory micropores inside, it is a fiber that can absorb gases or liquids. Generally, it can be made by chemical and physical modification of natural fiber or man-made fiber. The main method is to improve the ability of the fiber to absorb gas and liquid and increase the space for the internal absorption of gas and liquid. Such as modified regenerated cellulose fiber (such as alloy regenerated cellulose fiber) and modified synthetic fiber (such as high moisture absorption synthetic fiber).

explanation_cn: 用吸附的方法测定的粉末比表面积。利用气体在固体表面的物理吸附测定物质比表面的原理是：测量吸附在固体表面上气体单分子层的质量或体积，再由气体分子的横截I面积计算lg物质的总表面积，即得克比表面。
explanation_en: Specific surface of powder measured by adsorption method. The principle of using physical adsorption of gas on the solid surface to measure the specific surface of a substance is to measure the mass or volume of the gas monolayer adsorbed on the solid surface, and then calculate the total surface area of lg substance from the cross sectional I area of the gas molecule, which is the gram specific surface.

explanation_cn: 以糠醛或糠醇为主要原料制得的主链以呋喃环为主的热固性树脂。主要品种有糠醛树脂、糠醇树脂、糠醛丙酮树脂、糠醛丙酮甲醛树脂、糠酮环氧树脂等。
explanation_en: The thermosetting resin with furan ring as the main chain is prepared from furfural or furfuryl alcohol. The main varieties include furalresin, furfuryl alcohol resin, furfural acetone resin, furfural acetone formaldehyde resin, furfural ketone epoxy resin, etc.

explanation_cn: 为耐盐酸腐蚀而发展出一类Ni-Mo基合金系列。Ni-Mo-Fe系合金 (HastelloyA)可耐7CTC以下盐酸腐蚀。在此基础上提高Mo含量（19%-28%),降低Fe含量（20%-5%)发展的HastelloyB合金，则可用于沸腾的任何浓度的盐酸，同时在硫酸甚至氢氟酸中也有良好的耐蚀性。
explanation_en: A series of Ni Mo based alloy have been developed to resist hydrochloric acid corrosion. Ni Mo Fe alloy (HastelloyA) can resist hydrochloric acid corrosion below 7CTC. On this basis, Hastelloy B alloy developed by increasing Mo content (19% -28%) and reducing Fe content (20% -5%) can be used for boiling hydrochloric acid of any concentration, and has good corrosion resistance in sulfuric acid and even hydrofluoric acid.

explanation_cn: 又称弗洛利-哈金斯作用参数、弗洛利作用参数、X12参数或相互作用参数。表示溶剂同高分子混合或高分子共混时相互作用能变化的无量纲数值。通过测量高分子溶液蒸气压和溶剂蒸气压可计算出高分子溶剂相互作用参数。
explanation_en: It is also called flory hawkins interaction parameter, flori action parameter, X12 parameter or interaction parameters.
