Dimensionless value representing the change of interaction energy between solvent and macromolecule or when macromolecule is polymer blending. The interaction parameters of macromolecule solvent can be calculated by measuring the vapor pressure of macromolecule solution and solvent.

explanation_cn: 一种成分与霞石正长岩相当的喷出岩。因敲击这种岩石的板状节理时发出一种独特响声而得名。主要矿物成分是碱性长石、似长石和碱性辉石、碱性角闪石。多为斑状结构，基质常为隐晶质。岩石常呈灰白色或深灰色。根据似长石的种类和含量，可分成霞石、白榴石等。常呈小的岩流或岩钟产出，分布在碱性岩区。与其有关的矿产为金和铜。可作建筑装饰材料。
explanation_en: A extrusive rock with composition equivalent to nepheline syenite. It is named after a unique sound when striking the plate joints of rock. The main mineral components are alkaline feldspar, feldspathoid, alkaline pyroxene and alkaline amphibole. Most are porphyritic texture, and the matrix is often aphanitic. Rock is usually gray white or dark gray. According to the type and content of feldspathoid, it can be divided into nepheline, leucite, etc. Often occurring as small rock flows or rock clocks, distributed in alkaline rock areas. The minerals related to it are gold and copper. It can be used as building decoration materials.

explanation_cn: 又叫平光漆、平光涂料、哑光涂料。见半光漆。
explanation_en: Also called flat paint, flat coatings, matte coatings. See semi-gloss paint.

explanation_cn: 哥窑是宋代"五大名窑"之一。哥窑瓷的胎色有黑、深灰、浅灰及土黄多种，其釉均为失透的乳浊釉，釉色以灰青为主。哥窑瓷的主要特征：①哥窑釉属无光釉，犹如"酥油"般的光泽，色调丰富多彩.有米黄、粉青、奶白诸色。②"金丝铁线"的纹样.哥窑釉面有网状开片，或重叠犹如冰裂纹，或成细密小开片，俗成"百圾碎"或"龟子纹"，以"金丝铁线"为典型，即较粗疏的黑色裂纹交织着细密的红、黄色裂纹。③"攒珠聚球"般的釉中气泡.哥窑器通常釉层很厚，最厚处甚至与胎的厚度相等，釉内含有气泡，如珠隐现.犹如"聚沫攒珠"般的美韵。④"紫口铁足"的风致，哥窑器坯体大都是紫黑色或棕黄色.器皿口部边缘釉薄处由于隐纹露出胎色而呈黄褐色，同时在底足未挂釉处呈现铁黑色。
explanation_en: Ge Kiln is one of the "Five Famous Kilns" of the Song Dynasty. The body color of Ge ware includes black, dark grey, light grey and earth yellow. The glaze is opaque opaque glaze, and the glaze color is mainly gray blue. Main features of Ge ware: ① Ge Kiln glaze belongs to matte glaze, with luster like "butter", rich and colorful colors, including beige, powder blue, and milk white. ② The pattern of "golden wire and iron wire". The glaze of Ge kiln has a network of open pieces, or overlaps like ice cracks, or forms fine and small open pieces, commonly known as "hundred garbage fragments" or "turtle pattern", with "golden wire and iron wire" as a typical example, that is, thicker black cracks are interwoven with fine red and yellow cracks Bubbles in glaze like "gathering beads and gathering balls". Generally, the glaze layer of Ge ware is very thick, and the thickest part is even the same as the thickness of the body. Bubbles are contained in glaze, like hidden beads. It is like a beautiful charm like "gathering foam and gathering beads". ④ Due to the style of "purple mouth and iron foot", the bodies of Ge ware are mostly purple black or brown yellow. The thin glaze on the edge of the mouth of the ware is yellowish brown because hidden lines expose the color of the embryo, and at the same time, the iron black is shown where the bottom foot is not hung with glaze.

explanation_cn: 唐代彩色铅釉陶的简称，用白色黏土作胎.以含Cu、Fe、Co、Mn等元素的矿物作铅釉的着色剂。其彩色并不仅限于5色，一般有黄、绿、白、蓝、紫等多种颜色，但以黄、绿、白丨为主，唐三彩的袖一般都直接施于陶胎上。唐三彩一般采用二次烧成，第一次素烧生坯.烧成温度在1050X:左右。第二次釉烧采用氧化焰。各种色调的袖在烧成过程中相互浸润，组成变幻莫测.绚丽多彩的装饰罔案和色彩。三彩陶着重表现造型和釉色.对胎的质量要求不高。中国古代唐彩颜色釉制作的高度成就.对后来辽、宋三彩及明、清景德镇釉上彩的发展有重要影响》
explanation_en: The abbreviation of colored lead glazed pottery in the Tang Dynasty uses white clay as the body and minerals containing elements such as Cu, Fe, Co, Mn as the colorant of lead glaze. Its color is not limited to 5 colors, generally including yellow, green, white, blue, purple, and other colors, but mainly yellow, green, and white. The sleeves of the Tang tricolor are generally directly applied to the pottery body. Tang sancai is usually fired twice, and the first time is plain fired. The firing temperature is about 1050X:. The second glaze firing uses an oxide flame. During the firing process, the sleeves of various colors infiltrate each other, forming an unpredictable and colorful decorative pattern and color. Three color pottery focuses on molding and glaze color, and has low requirements on the quality of the body. The high achievement in the production of colored glaze in ancient China's Tang Dynasty has an important influence on the development of the later Liao and Song tri colored glaze and the glaze color in Jingdezhen during the Ming and Qing Dynasties

explanation_cn: 岩浆喷出地表冷凝而形成的火成岩的总称，包括各种熔岩和火山碎屑岩。由于岩浆快速冷凝。多形成细粒至玻璃质岩石，通常具斑状结构。
explanation_en: The general term for igneous rocks formed by eject of magma and condensation on the surface, including various lavas and pyroclastic rock. Due to the rapid condensation of magma. It mostly forms fine-grained to glass rock, usually with porphyritic texture.

explanation_cn: 可接收并保持喷墨打印影像的专用纸张。在基纸表面经特殊涂布处理。或经涂塑涂布处理。得到吸墨性好、有一定光泽、耐水、耐光，用于喷墨打印机的纸。
explanation_en: A specialized paper that can receive and maintain inkjet printed images. Special coating treatment is applied to the surface of the base paper. Or treated with plastic coating. Paper with good ink absorption, certain gloss, water resistance, and light resistance, suitable for inkjet printers.

explanation_cn: 利用气流输送办法。将用于冶炼的粉料通过喷枪直接吹入金属熔池白部或冶金反应区。达到某种冶金的工艺过程。其主要特点是：①喷入粉料具有较大的比表面积，大大加快熔体白组分与粉料间的反应速率；②输送气流强烈地搅拃熔池。使熔池和喷入粉料或反应区白的反应物料能在很短时间白均匀混合；③喷入粉料与金属熔体组分或反应物料之间的相互反应发生在熔体白部或反应区，减轻了炉衬、炉渣和大气对反应过程的影响。喷射冶金技术广泛应用于冶金各领域。如钢铁冶金的高炉喷煤、铁水预处理、钢包冶金、熔融还原等过程。
explanation_en: Utilize airflow transportation methods. The powder used for smelting is directly blown into the white part of the metal bath or the metallurgical reaction zone through the spray gun. To achieve a certain metallurgical process. Its main characteristics are: ① the powder injected has a large specific surface, which greatly accelerates the reaction rate between the white component of the melt and the powder; ② The conveying airflow strongly agitates the molten pool. Ensure that the molten pool and reaction materials sprayed with powder or reaction zone white can be uniformly mixed in a short period of time; ③ The interaction between the injected powder and metal melt components or reaction materials occurs in the white part or reaction zone of the melt, which reduces the influence of furnace lining, slag and atmosphere on the reaction process. Injection metallurgy technology is widely used in various fields of metallurgy. Such as blast furnace coal injection, hot metal pretreatment, ladle metallurgy, smelting reduction and other processes in iron and steel metallurgy.

explanation_cn: 将培化的金属液流用高速气体（氨气或氮气）雾化后直接喷射到一定形状的收集器上-使之沉积成密实的块状材料。金属液流通过雾化喷嘴时，被高速气流雾化成不同大小的液滴，这些液滴被气流加速冲向收集器，在到达收集器时。较小的液滴已凝固。大的液滴仍保持液相。而大多数中间尺寸的液滴则处于半固半液状态或过冷状态。这些粒子撞击到收集器表面时。半同/芈液态粒子会破碎，大的液态粒子变成扁平状将小的固相粒子及半固态粒子碎片黏合在一起，凝间后形成密实的块状材料。这种喷射成形的材料具有快速凝固加粉末冶金的特征。喷射成形可方便地生产各种合金材料制品，如圆锭、管坯和板坯及成型件。也很方便地生产颗粒增强金属基复合材料和多层复合材料。
explanation_en: The cultivated metal liquid flow is atomized with high-speed gas (ammonia or nitrogen) and then directly sprayed onto a collector of a certain shape to deposit into a dense block materials. When the metal liquid flows through the atomizing nozzle, it is atomized into droplets of different sizes by high-speed airflow. These droplets are accelerated by the airflow and rush towards the collector before reaching the collector. The smaller droplets have solidified. Large droplets remain in the liquid phase. Most intermediate sized droplets are in a semi solid and semi liquid state or supercooled state. When these particles collide with the surface of the collector. Semi identical/Mi liquid particles will be broken, large liquid particles will become flat, small solid particles and semi-solid particle fragments will be bonded together, and dense blocky materials will be formed after coagulation. The spray forming materials has the characteristics of rapid solidification and powder metallurgy. Spray forming can easily produce various alloy materials products, such as round ingot, tube blank, slab and formed parts. It is also very convenient to produce particle reinforced metal matrix composite and multi-layer composite materials.

explanation_cn: 用喷射法施工混凝土。有干拌和湿拌两种施T法。千拌法是将水泥、砂及最大粒径小于25mtn的石子按一定比例拌合后，装入喷射机，用压缩空气将干混合料沿管路输送至喷头处，与水混合并以40-60m/S的高速喷射至作业面上。湿拌法则是将原材料顶先加水拌合后喷射。为了改善喷射混凝土的性能，通常掺入占水泥重2.5%-4.0%的速凝剂。可使其在3min白初凝、10min白终凝，有利于提高早期强度、增大喷层厚度、减少回弹损失。喷射混凝土中加入一定数量（一般为混凝土质量的3%-5%)的钢纤维（直径0.3-0.5mm，长度20-30mm)，能显著提高其抗拉、抗剪、抗冲击和抗疲劳强度以及韧性指数。主要用于岩石峒库、隧道或地下工程和矿井巷道的衬砌和支护。
explanation_en: Concrete shall be constructed by spraying method. There are two application methods: dry mixing and wet mixing. The thousand mixing method is to mix cement, sand and stones with the maximum particle size less than 25mtn in a certain proportion, load them into the sprayer, use compressed air to transport the dry mixture along the pipeline to the nozzle, mix it with water and spray it to the working face at a high speed of 40-60m/S. The wet mixing method is to mix the raw materials with water before spraying. In order to improve the performance of sprayed concrete, accelerating agent accounting for 2.5% -4.0% of cement weight is usually added. It can achieve initial white setting in 3 minutes and final white setting in 10 minutes, which is beneficial for improving early strength, increasing spray layer thickness, and reducing rebound loss. Adding a certain amount of steel fibre (0.3-0.5mm in diameter and 20-30mm in length) (generally 3% -5% of the quality of concrete) to sprayed concrete can significantly improve its tensile, shear, impact and fatigue strength and toughness index. It is mainly used for lining and support of rock caverns, tunnels or underground works and mine tunnels.

explanation_cn: 是指在聚合物注塑成型过程中。当充模速率很髙时。聚合物熔体注入模腔时会不接触浇口附近的模壁，直接形成一股射流。然后快速前进的一种现象。发生喷射现象时。通常会存在两种不同的充模方式：第一种是浇口正对着型腔壁面或粗大型芯。在射流端部撞电到对面的壁面之后，喷射就停止了。然后开始规则地向前充模；第二种是小浇口对着一个空腔，当射流端部已经接触到对面的壁面之后，喷射还在继续。后进入的射流就会叠合很多次。然后充模方向就会从撞击表面开始向浇口方向连续填充，造成充模逆向进行。当模腔几乎被叠合的熔体射流充满时，存在的叠合射流就会有规则地充满和压紧模腔。喷射现象往往伴随着非常复杂的熔接线。造成制品白部缺陷和表面疵癍。通常采用如下：方法消除喷射现象：一是合理设计浇口位置使正对型腔壁；二是改变浇口的形状如设计成扇形等或者采用大的浇口。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of polymer injection molding. When the filling rate is very high. When the polymer melt is injected into the mold cavity, it will not contact the mold wall near the gate, and directly form a jet. A phenomenon of rapid progress. When jetting phenomena occurs. There are usually two different filling methods: the first is the gate facing the cavity wall or the thick core. After the end of the jet collides with the opposite wall, the jet stops. Then start filling the mold forward in a regular manner; The second type is when the small gate is facing a cavity, and after the end of the jet has already touched the opposite wall, the jet continues. The incoming jet will overlap many times. Then the filling direction will continue to fill from the impact surface towards the gate direction, causing the filling to proceed in the opposite direction. When the mold cavity is almost filled with stacked melt jets, the existing stacked jets will regularly fill and compress the mold cavity. The jetting phenomena is often accompanied by very complex weld lines. Causing white part defects and surface defects in the product. Generally, the following methods are used to eliminate the jetting phenomena: first, reasonably design the gate position to face the cavity wall; The second is to change the shape of the gate, such as designing it as a fan or using a large gate.

explanation_cn: 在惰性气体的保护下，将金属液流雾化成液滴。以一定速度沉积到收集器（或基体）上并快速凝固的铸造工艺。
explanation_en: Under the protection of inert gas, atomize the metal liquid into droplets. Foundry process that is deposited on the collector (or matrix) at a certain speed and rapid solidification.

explanation_cn: 利用气动工具以机械喷射方法施工的不定形耐火材料。由耐火骨料、粉料、结合剂（或加外加剂）组成。由于在喷涂过程中水泥与骨料等组成材料反复连续冲击促使喷射出的物料压实，因而喷涂层具有较好的致密度和力学强度。
explanation_en: Unshaped refractory constructed by mechanical spraying with pneumatic tools. Composed of refractory aggregate, powder, and binder (or with additives). As the materials composed of cement and aggregate are repeatedly and continuously impacted during the spraying process to promote the compaction of the sprayed materials, the spraying layer has good efficiency of spare filling and mechanical strength.

explanation_cn: 又称喷出，是指硫化胶或混炼胶白部的液体或同体配合剂迁移至制品或胶片表面的现象。橡胶喷霜的形式大体有三种：①喷粉。硫化剂、促进剂、活性剂、防老剂、填充剂等粉状配合剂析出，在橡胶表面形成--层粉状物的现象。②喷蜡。石蜡、地蜡等蜡状物析出，在橡胶表面形成一层蜡膜的现象。③喷油。软化剂、增黏剂、润滑剂等液态配合剂析出。在橡胶表面形成一层油状物的现象。橡胶表面喷霜的形式有时以一种形式出现，有时以两种或种形式出现。橡胶喷霜是卜:1于橡胶白部配合剂含M达到饱和后，接近表层的配合剂先析出，再由白层向表层迁移析出，当配合剂在橡胶中的含量低至其饱和含量时，析出过程才告结束。导致喷霜的原因有很多。沾如胶料配方设计不当。工艺操作不妥、储存条件差、制品欠硫、制品老化等。喷霜不仅严重地影响了产品的外观质M。在一定程度上也影响着橡胶制品的使用性能、寿命、胶料的工艺性能及物理机械性能》
explanation_en: Also known as eject, it refers to the phenomenon that the liquid or homologous compound in the white part of vulcanized rubher or compound migrates to the surface of products or films. There are three types of rubber blooming: ① powder spraying. Vulcanizing agent, accelerator, activator, antiager, filler and other powder coordination agents precipitate, forming a layer of powder on the surface of rubber. ② Spray wax. Paraffin wax, paraffin wax and other waxy substances precipitate and form a wax film on the surface of rubber. ③ Fuel injection. Liquid coordination agents such as softening agent, tackifier and lubricant are separated out. A layer of oil is formed on the surface of rubber. The blooming on the rubber surface sometimes appears in one form, sometimes in two or more forms. Rubber blooming is as follows: 1 After the content of M in the white part of rubber reaches saturation, the compound close to the surface layer will first precipitate, and then migrate from the white layer to the surface layer to precipitate. When the content of the compound in rubber is low to its saturation content, the precipitation process will end. There are many reasons for blooming. Improper design of adhesive formula. Improper process operation, poor storage conditions, product sulfur deficiency, product aging, etc. Blooming not only seriously affects the appearance quality of the product M. To some extent, it also affects the service performance, service life, processing performance and physical and mechanical properties of rubber products

explanation_cn: 具有封闭结构的分子有序组合体。构成囊泡的材料通常是脂质和高分子，如脂质形成的脂质体，高分子形成的聚合物囊泡。在药物控制释放领域.囊泡可作为药物载体。
explanation_en: An ordered combination of molecules with a closed structure. The materials that constitute vesicle are usually lipids and macromolecule, such as liposome formed by lipids and polymersome formed by macromolecule. In the field of controlled drug release, vesicle can be used as drug carrier.

explanation_cn: 由四氟乙烯与丙烯通过乳液共聚得到的弹性体，是一种无毒、无味、无黏性、茶褐色至深棕色、密度为1.55g/m3、玻璃化转变温度为-15-0°C的无定形聚合物，具有优异的耐高温（200°C以上）和耐油性能。一般采用过氧化物硫化剂a,双（叔丁氧基过氧）对二异丙苯和硫化促进剂异氰酸三烯丙基酯进行硫化。硫化胶拉伸强度14.7-21.6MPa.硬度(邵氏A)70,脆化温度-40T,相对介电常数（1kHz)6;对各类车用燃油、润滑油、刹车油、矿物油和硅油等具有良好的稳定性，耐化学药品性，特别是耐高浓度、碱、强氧化剂性能优异，耐高压水蒸气、耐水以及电绝缘性能优良.透气性小，使用温度-40-200T：。广泛用于汽车、石油、纺织、化工及食品工业领域。
explanation_en: The elastomer obtained by copolymerization of tetrafluoroethylene and propylene through lotion is a nontoxic, tasteless, non viscous, tea brown to dark brown, amorphous polymer with a density of 1.55g/m3 and a glass transition temperature of -15-0 ° C, and has excellent high temperature resistance (above 200 ° C) and oil resistance. Generally, peroxide vulcanizing agent a, bis (tert butoxy peroxide) are used to vulcanization diisopropylbenzene and vulcanization accelerator triallyl isocyanate. The tensile strength of vulcanized rubher is 14.7-21.6MPa. The hardness (Shore A) is 70, the embrittlement temperature is -40T, and the relative dielectric constant (1kHz) is 6; It has good stability and chemical resistance to various vehicle fuels, lubricating oils, brake oils, mineral oils and silicone oil, especially excellent resistance to high concentrations, alkalis, strong oxidants, high pressure steam, water and electrical insulation. It has low air permeability and service temperature of -40-200T. Widely used in the automotive, petroleum, textile, chemical, and food industries.

explanation_cn: 具有起爆药特性的四唑（tetrazole)的衍生物。四唑又称四氮茂、五元杂环化合物.是一元酸.为针状或片状白色品体，熔点155-156°C.慢慢加热即升华，易溶于水及乙醇，难溶于苯及醚，对机械作用不敏感.是制造炸药的重要原料.四唑的碳原子与氮原子结合或与重金属化合物反应而生成的衍生物对机械作用敏感.具有强烈爆炸性。近年研制了许多四唑有机和重金属衍生物，特别是四唑的铅盐、铜盐和汞盐，其起爆忭能有的比叠氮化铅好.有的火焰感度比斯蒂芬酸铅优越。四唑类起爆药是有发展前途的起爆药.国内外对这类起爆药研究比较多。
explanation_en: Derivatives of tetrazole with primary explosive characteristics. Tetrazole, also known as tetraazacene and five membered heterocyclic compounds, is a monobasic acid. It is a white acicular or flaky substance with a melting point of 155-156 ° C. It sublimates when heated slowly. It is easily soluble in water and ethanol, and difficult to dissolve in benzene and ether. It is not sensitive to mechanical action. It is an important raw material for the manufacture of explosive. Derivatives generated by the combination of carbon atoms and nitrogen atoms of tetrazole or the reaction with heavy metal compounds are sensitive to mechanical action and have strong explosiveness. In recent years, many organic and heavy metal derivatives of tetrazole have been developed, especially the lead salt, copper salt and mercury salt of tetrazole. Some of them have better initiation performance than lead azide, and some have better flame sensitivity than lead styphnate. Tetrazole primary erplosive is a promising primary explosive, and there are many studies on this kind of primary explosive at home and abroad.

explanation_cn: 指排成一直线、间距相等的四根金属探针垂直压在半导体表面上，使直流电流从两根外探针间通过，测量两根内探针间的电位差，然后依据一定的公式和修正方法，获得半导体电阻率的测量方法。对半无限大半导体材料，可推导出等探针间距情况下电阻率公式，称为探针系数，对于间定间距的探针而言，探针系数为常数。实际应用中，只要半导体样品厚度以及样品边缘与四探针中任一探针的距离大于四倍的探针间距，应用上述公式便可以获得足够的测量精度。而对于厚度有限、尺寸略小的样品需在上述公式中加人几何尺寸修正因子。利用四探针法，不仅可以测量半导体材料的体电阻率.而且可以测量半导体薄膜和金属薄膜的方块电阻。四探针法是测量半导体电阻率的标准方法。
explanation_en: Four metal probes arranged in a straight line with equal spacing are pressed vertically on the semiconductor surface to make DC current pass through two external probes, measure the potential difference between two internal probes, and then obtain the measurement method of semiconductor resistivity according to certain formula and correction method. For semi infinite semiconductor materials, the formula of resistivity under the condition of equal probe spacing can be derived, which is called probe coefficient. For probes with fixed spacing, the probe coefficient is constant. In practical applications, as long as the thickness of the semiconductor sample and the distance between the sample edge and any of the four probes is greater than four times the probe spacing, the above formula can be used to obtain sufficient measurement accuracy. For samples with limited thickness and slightly smaller dimensions, a geometric size correction factor needs to be added to the above formula. The four probe method can be used to measure not only the volume resistivity of semiconductor materials, but also the block resistance of semiconductor films and metal films. The four probe method is the standard method for measuring semiconductor resistivity.

name_cn: 四氟乙烯-全氟烷基乙烯基醚共聚纤维
explanation_cn: 指共聚有少量全氟烷基乙烯基醚的可熔聚四氟乙烯纤维。一般只作单丝，其密度为2.2g/cm3,单丝直径为30=60pm,断裂伸长率9%-12%,环扣强度比为95%,结节强度比为90%,沸水收缩率为12%-15%.回潮率为0,在220°C经250h热处理后的强度保持率为85%,热稳定性、耐酸碱性等与聚四氟乙烯纤维基本相同。其制备方法是将四氟乙烯和4.4%?7.0%(摩尔分数）的全氟烷基全氟乙烯基醚进行自由基聚合，制得树脂，树脂再在340-36CTC熔融挤出和拉伸而得PPS纤维。PPS纤维主要用于制作离子交换膜的补强织物，这种纤维主要可应用于氯碱工业，此外可应用于要求强度较高而其他性能接近于聚四氟乙烯纤维的领域.
explanation_en: Refers to a fusible polytetrafluoroethylene fiber copolymerized with a small amount of perfluoroalkyl vinyl ether. Generally, only monofilament is used. Its density is 2.2g/cm3, monofilament diameter is 30=60pm, percentage elongation after fracture is 9% -12%, loop strength ratio is 95%, knot tendency ratio is 90%, boiling water shrinkage rate is 12% -15%, moisture regain is 0, strength retention rate after 250 h heat treatment at 220 ° C is 85%, thermal stability, acid and alkali resistance are basically the same as PTFE fiber. The preparation method is to combine tetrafluoroethylene with 4.4%? 7.0% (mole fraction) of perfluoroalkyl perfluorovinyl ether was subjected to free radical polymerization to obtain resin, and then the resin was melt extruded and stretched at 340-36CTC to obtain PPS fiber. PPS fiber is mainly used to make reinforcement fabric of ion exchange membrane. This fiber can be mainly used in chlor alkali industry. In addition, it can be used in fields requiring high strength and other properties close to polytetrafluoroethylenf fiber

explanation_cn: 分子式N2O4,分子量92.016。沸点21.15T：，冰点-11.23°C,生产浓硝酸的流程中取得NOS，经冷凝和蒸馏制得液体。可储存氧化剂之一。
explanation_en: Molecular formula N2O4, molecular weight 92.016. Boiling point 21.15T:, freezing point -11.23 ° C, in the process of producing concentrated nitric acid, NOS is obtained, and a liquid is obtained through condensation and distillation. It can store one of oxidizer.

explanation_cn: 分子式LiNdP4O12，简称LNP。是继五磷酸钕之后，发现的另一种自激活激光晶体。属单斜晶系，空间群C2/c。LNP在晶体中的浓度高达1.37×1021cm^-3，对泵浦波长799nm辐射的吸收系数达30cm^-1，晶体的荧光寿命120μs，荧光线宽17?，激光波长1048nm。与五磷酸钛晶体相似，若用Y、La、Gd等元素稀释，随着钕离子浓度的减少，荧光寿命将从120μs增长到320μs。由于这种晶体的荧光线宽比五磷酸钕窄（在五磷酸钕中荧光线宽是30?），所以它的激光跃迁截面较五磷酸钕大。在利用高钕浓度的自激活晶体设计激光器时，必须要考虑激活的共振吸收。因为在这种晶体中，激光终态上的粒子已不能忽略，由-跃迁吸收产生的共振损耗，在确定激光阈值和斜率效率时必须考虑。
explanation_en: The molecular formula LiNdP4O12, abbreviated as LNP. It is another self-activation laser crystal discovered after neodymium pentaphosphate. It belongs to monoclinic system, space group C2/c. The concentration of LNP in crystal is up to 1.37 × 1021cm ^ -3, absorption coefficient of 799nm radiation reaches 30cm ^ -1, fluorescence lifetime of crystal is 120 μ s. The fluorescence linewidth is 17 ∨, and the laser wavelength is 1048 nm. Similar to titanium pentaphosphate crystal, if diluted with Y, La, Gd and other elements, with the decrease of neodymium ion concentration, the fluorescence lifetime will change from 120 μ S grew to 320 μ S. Since the fluorescence linewidth of this crystal is narrower than neodymium pentaphosphate (in neodymium pentaphosphate, the fluorescence linewidth is 30 ∨), its laser transition cross section is larger than neodymium pentaphosphate. Active resonance absorption must be considered when designing lasers with self-activation crystal with high Nd concentration. Because in this kind of crystal, the particles on the final state of the laser can no longer be ignored, and the resonance loss caused by the - transition absorption must be considered when determining the laser threshold value and slope efficiency.

explanation_cn: 一种主晶相为四钛酸钡的微波介质陶瓷。静态弯曲强度>950kg/cm2，用干高频电容器、微波集成电路基板、集成电路滤波器、微波介质、谐振滤波器和移相器等。
explanation_en: The invention relates to a microwave dielectric ceramics whose main crystal phase is barium tetratitanate. Static bending strength>950kg/cm2, dry high-frequency capacitor, microwave integrated circuit substrate, integrated circuit filter, microwave dielectric, resonant filter and phase shifter are used.

explanation_cn: 冷加工后的金属材料在退火时其性能朝着原来的水平作某种程度的回复。
explanation_en: The metallic materials after cold working has a certain degree of recovery in its performance towards the original level during annealing.

explanation_cn: 物体受外力作用变形后，外力撤除，物体迅速恢复其原来形状的能力。物体除去作用力时能恢复原来形状的性质叫作弹性；回弹性则是用来描述弹性大小的量值。以在规定条件对物体施加作用力后，物体恢复原来形状的时间，或者反弹力的大小表示。通常用应变的试样在应力除去后快速回复时的输出能与使试样应变时的输入能的比值来量度。
explanation_en: The ability of an object to quickly restore its original shape after being deformed by external forces and the removal of external forces. The property that an object can restore its original shape when the force is removed is called elasticity; Resilience is a quantity used to describe the size of elasticity. Expressed as the time it takes for an object to regain its original shape after applying a force under specified conditions, or the magnitude of its rebound force. It is usually measured by the ratio of the output energy of the strained specimen when it recovers quickly after stress removal to the input energy when the specimen is strained.

explanation_cn: 固体在一定外加静磁场下对微波能量的共振吸收。
explanation_en: The resonance absorption of microwave energy by a solid under a certain external static magnetic field.

explanation_cn: 使干燥后的皮革重新吸收一定量的水分，从而使皮革中的水分分布均匀并使其水分含量符合后续的机械做软需要的操作。
explanation_en: Make the dried leather absorb a certain amount of water again, so as to make the water in leather evenly distributed and make its moisture content meet the subsequent mechanical softening needs.

explanation_cn: 将粹火成马氏体得到硬化后的钢铁材料加热到Ac1点以下的规定温度保温，随后以适当的冷速冷却到室温，可以使其组织向平衡组织过渡，松弛淬火应力，改善材料的塑性和韧性，这样的热处理工艺称为回火。
explanation_en: The hardened steel materials obtained from the refined martensite is heated to the specified temperature below Ac1 for heat preservation, and then cooled to room temperature at an appropriate cooling rate, which can make its structure transition to equilibrium structure, relax the quenching stress, and improve the plasticity and toughness of materials. Such heat treatment process is called tempering.

explanation_cn: 淬硬的钢在一定温度区间回火保温后或回火冷却过程中缓慢通过某一温度区间后引起室温韧性明显降低的现象。
explanation_en: The room temperature toughness of hardened steel is obviously reduced after tempering and holding in a certain temperature range or after slowly passing through a certain temperature range during tempering and cooling.

explanation_cn: 钢铁生产过程中炉渣中的磷重新进入钢液，引起钢中磷含量增加的现象称为回磷。而对硫元素而言则称为回硫。
explanation_en: In the process of steel production, the phosphorus in slag re enters into the steel liquid, which causes the increase of phosphorus content in steel. For sulfur elements, it is called sulfur recovery.

explanation_cn: 高分子链的质量中心到各个链单元的矢量长度，用r表示。通常用高分子链回转半径的均方值.即均方回转半径表征高分子的分子尺寸。
explanation_en: The vector length from the mass center of the macromolecule chain to each chain unit, expressed in r. Generally, the mean square value of radius of gyratio of macromolecule chain, i.e. mean square radius of gyration, is used to characterize the molecular size of macromolecule.

explanation_cn: 将圆柱状橡胶试样夹在两个夹持板之间，其中一边夹持板 可轴向移动对试样进行压缩，另一边夹持板旋转.带动试样和轴向夹持板转动，测定试样的温升和达到破坏时的转数。
explanation_en: Clamp the cylindrical rubber sample between two clamping plates, one of which can be moved axially to compress the sample, and the other can rotate to drive the sample and the axial clamping plate to rotate, and measure the temperature rise of the sample and the number of revolutions when it reaches failure.

explanation_cn: 又称返黏。涂膜干燥后又软化黏指的现象。涂料在气温高的环境下使用，特别是在湿热条件下，高温促使漆膜表层下未干硬的组分渗出膜面，最易产生回黏。底层处理不彻底也是造成回黏的一个原因。
explanation_en: It is also called refluxing. The phenomenon that the film bating after drying. When coatings is used in high temperature environment, especially in hot and humid conditions, high temperature will cause the components not dry and hard under the surface of the paint film to seep out of the film surface, which is most likely to produce after tack. Incomplete bottom treatment is also a reason for after tack.

explanation_cn: 见低膨胀合金。
explanation_en: See low expansion alloy.

explanation_cn: 在粉末体中，常会有一定数量的一次颗粒通过表面张力或固体的键桥作用形成更大的颗粒，即团聚体，这种粉末颗粒聚集成团的现象称为团聚。团聚的种类按作用力的性质分为两种形式：一是硬闭聚.二是软团聚。硬团聚一般是指颗粒之间通过化学键力或氢键作用力等强作用力连接形成的团聚体。这种团聚体内部作用力大，颗粒间结合紧密，不易重新分散.粉体的活性差，烧结性能差，在纳米粉体材料制备过程中应该尽量避免产生这种硬团聚。软闭聚一般是指颗粒之间通过分子之间的作用力以及颗粒间的毛细管作用力等连接产生的团聚体。这种团聚体内部作用力相对较小，粉体比较疏松，比较容易重新分散。
explanation_en: In powder, a certain number of primary particles often form larger particles through surface tension or solid bond bridging, that is, agglomerates. This phenomenon of powder particle gathering into clusters is called agglomeration. The type of agglomeration can be divided into two forms according to the nature of the force: hard closed agglomeration and soft agglomeration. Hard agglomeration generally refers to the agglomeration formed by the connection between particles through strong forces such as chemical bonding force or hydrogen bond force. This kind of aggregate has large internal force, tight combination between particles, and is not easy to re disperse. The activity of the powder is poor, and the sintering performance is poor. This hard agglomeration should be avoided as far as possible during the preparation of nano powder materials. Soft agglomeration generally refers to the agglomeration produced by the connection between particles through the force between molecules and the capillary tube force between particles. The internal force of this aggregate is relatively small, the powder is relatively porosity, and it is easier to re disperse.

explanation_cn: 又称同态化学。从化学的角度研究固体物质的制备、组成、结构、性质及其应用的化学分支学科。它与间体物理以及材料科学等相互交叉渗透、相互补充，构成现代固体科学。研究对象包括各种金属、非金属、非晶体、有机物、聚合物等固体材料。固体化学利用化学体系的性质和规律从固体中的缺陷平衡、同体中的扩散、间相化学反应等方面研究实际固体物质的化学反应、合成方法、晶体生长、化学组成、晶体结构、缺陷结构及其对性能的影响，探索固态物质的应用前景等。
explanation_en: Also known as homomorphic chemistry. The branch of chemistry that studies the preparation, composition, structure, properties, and applications of solid substances from a chemical perspective. It intersects and supplements with interstitial physics and materials science, forming modern solid science. The research objects include all kinds of solid materials such as metal, nonmetal, amorphous, organic matter, polymer, etc. Solid state chemistry studies the chemical reaction, synthesis method, crystal growth, chemical composition, crystal structure, defect structure and their effects on properties of practical solid substances from the aspects of defect balance in solids, diffusion in the same body, interphase chemical reaction, etc. by using the properties and laws of chemical systems, and explores the application prospects of solid substances.

explanation_cn: 在火箭发动机内为获得设计规定的燃烧状态而制成的推进剂药柱，由一定几何形状的推进剂及其衬层组成。几何形状的选择取决于所需要的推力-时间曲线的设计，衬层的作用是限定燃面的大小和消除药柱的各种应力。
explanation_en: The propellant grain made in the rocket engine to obtain the combustion state specified in the design is composed of propellant and its liner with a certain geometric shape. The choice of geometry depends on the design of the required thrust time curve. The role of the liner is to limit the size of the burning surface and eliminate various stresses in the grain.

explanation_cn: 属于第三代燃料电池，是一种在中高温下直接将储存在燃料和氧化剂中的化学能高效环保地转化成电能的全固态化学发电装置。电池单体主要组成部分由电解质、阳极或燃料极、阴极或空气极和连接体或双极板组成，广泛采用耐高温、耐腐蚀的陶瓷材料制作电解质、阴极和阳极。其工作原理与其他燃料电池相同.具有燃料适应性广、能量转换效率高、全固态、模块化组装、零污染等优点.可以直接使用氢气、一氧化碳，天然气、液化气、煤气及生物质气等多种碳氢燃料。在大型集中供电、中型分电和小型家用热电联供等民用领域作为固定电站.以及作为船舶动力电源、交通车辆动力电源等移动电源的领域，都有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: It belongs to the third generation fuel cell, and is a full solid state chemical power generation device that directly converts chemical energy stored in fuel and oxidizer into electrical energy in an efficient and environmentally friendly manner at medium and high temperatures. The main components of the battery monomer are composed of elonrolyte, anode or fuel electrode, cathode or air electrode and connector or bipolar plate. ceramics materials that are resistant to high temperature and corrosion are widely used to make elonrolyte, cathode and anode. Its working principle is the same as other fuel cell. It has the advantages of wide fuel adaptability, high energy conversion efficiency, all solid state, modular assembly, zero pollution, etc. It can directly use hydrogen, carbon monoxide, natural gas, liquefied gas, coal gas, biomass gas and other hydrocarbon fuels. It has broad application prospects as a fixed power station in civil fields such as large-scale centralized power supply, medium-sized power distribution, and small household cogeneration, as well as as as as a mobile power source for ships and transportation vehicles.

explanation_cn: 又称固体推进剂。是同体火箭发动机产生推力的能源。由氧化剂、燃烧剂及添加剂组成。
explanation_en: Also called solid propellant. It is the energy source used by the same body rocket engine to generate thrust. It is composed of oxidizer, incendiary composition and additive.

explanation_cn: 在非均匀受热的同体中热能传递的现象。同体的热传导可以用傅里叶（Fourier)方程描述。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of heat transfer in homogeneous bodies with non-uniform heating. The heat conduction of the same body can be described by the Fourier equation.

explanation_cn: 研究固体材料物理本质和性能的一个物理学科。最初主要是研究近完整晶体，后来又扩展到非晶态物质，高分子聚合物，以及固体表面等。同体物理重要的研究领域包括：晶体结构、晶格动力学、能带理论、弹性与塑性性质，内聚力性质，热导，电导，离子输运，磁性，介电性，铁电性，光学性质，各种共振现象，以及表面物理等。随着学科的发展，一些极端条件下的物性受到.重视，如高压.强磁场，高温和低温，强辐射.微重力.以及低温下的超导电现象等。目前固体物理已经成为材料科学的重要基础之一。
explanation_en: A physical discipline that studies the physical nature and properties of solid materials. At first, it mainly studied near complete crystal, and later expanded to amorphous substances, macromolecule polymer, and solid surfaces. The important research fields of homophysics include: crystal structure, lattice dynamics, energy band theory, elasticity and plastic properties, cohesive force properties, thermal conductivity, conductivity, ion transport, magnetism, permittivity, ferroelectricity, optical properties, various resonance phenomena, and surface physics. With the development of the discipline, some extreme conditions of physical properties have received attention, such as high pressure, strong magnetic field, high and low temperatures, strong radiation, microgravity, and superconducting phenomena at low temperatures. At present, solid state physics has become one of the important foundations of materials science.

explanation_cn: 固体中电子在点阵离子周期场中运动的单粒子量子力学理论。它的基本假定有：绝热近似，将离子点阵与电子运动分开处理：单粒子近似，将多个电子约化为对单电子的处理。
explanation_en: A single particle quantum mechanics theory of the motion of electrons in a solid in a periodic field of lattice ions. Its basic assumptions include the adiabatic approximation, which separates the ion lattice from the electron motion, and the single particle approximation, which reduces multiple electrons to the treatment of a single electron.

explanation_cn: 以同态天然或合成的脂质如卵磷脂、三酰甘油等为原料制成的固体颗粒.通常粒径在10-lOOOnm。作为药物载体，固体脂质纳米粒具有毒性低、生物相容性好、可生物降解的特点。固体脂质纳米粒可通过高压乳匀法进行大规模生产，其他制备方法包括乳化沉淀法、微乳法等。
explanation_en: Solid particles made from homomorphic natural or synthetic lipids such as lecithin and triacylglycerol, usually with a particle size of 10-lOOOnm. As a drug carrier, solid lipid nanopartide have the characteristics of low toxicity, good biocompatibility and biodegradation. Solid lipid nanopartide can be produced in large scale by high-pressure homogenization, and other preparation methods include emulsification precipitation method, microemulsion method, etc.

explanation_cn: 计算同体结合能，说明粒子间键合的物理本质?预言固体的晶体结构的理论。它可分为两类，即第一性原理（firstprinciple)和粗略计算的经验理论。
explanation_en: Calculate the homologous cohesive energy to explain the physical nature of bonding between particles? A theory that predicts the crystal structure of solids. It can be divided into two categories, namely first principles and rough empirical theories.

explanation_cn: 指聚合物（树脂）通过化学添加剂（固化剂、催化剂）、热、光、辐射等的作用，交联形成不溶不熔间体物质的过程。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of polymer (resin) crosslinking to form insoluble and immiscible intermediates through the action of chemical additive (curing agent, catalyst), heat, light, radiation, etc.

explanation_cn: 能使热固性树脂发生化学交联形成不溶不熔网络结构的化合物或混合物。不同类型的热固性树脂所采用的固化剂不同。例如，环氧树脂常用的固化剂有胺类、酸酐类、低聚物、含氮化合物（咪唑类）以及二氣化硼及其络合物等。固化剂对热固外:树脂的固化温度、交联反应机理和同化产物的耐热性等有直接影响采用固化温度高的间化剂所制备的复合材料力学性能和耐热性好，也冇利于延长其树脂体系的适用期。固化剂的用量会直接影响到复合材料质量，用量过多，间化反应剧烈.固化产物脆性增加.用量过少，交联程度低，同化产物性能较差。
explanation_en: Compounds or mixtures that can cause chemical crosslinking of thermosetting resin to form insoluble and fusible network structure. Different types of thermosetting resin use different curing agent. For example, the commonly used curing agent for epoxy resin include amine, anhydride, oligomer, nitrogen-containing compound (imidazole), boron dioxide and its complex, etc. Curing agent has a direct impact on the curing temperature of resin, crosslinking reaction mechanism and heat resistance of assimilation products, etc. of the thermosetting agent: the composite materials prepared with the intermediation agent with high curing temperature has good mechanical properties and heat resistance, and is also conducive to extending the pot life of its resin system. The amount of curing agent will directly affect the quality of composite materials. If the amount is too much, the intermediation reaction will be intense. The brittleness of curing products will increase. If the amount is too little, the degree of crosslinking will be low, and the performance of assimilation products will be poor.

explanation_cn: 见光交联聚合物。
