explanation_en: See solidification theory.

explanation_cn: 将活性物质束缚或隔离于同相内，使它与整体相分离、隔汗，同时还能与间相外物质（分子、离子等）交换的过程。固定化方法主要有：非共价结合法，如物理吸附、离子结合法等；共价结合法，如交联法以及包埋法（微胶囊法、网格法等）。固定化材料（载体）有天然或合成材料，如多糖、蛋白质、陶瓷、聚酯、聚酰胺、尼龙、海藻酸、壳聚糖等。被同定化的物质广义上包栝气休、液体和同体：在生物医学领域中主要有可溶性酶、蛋内、组织和细胞"固定化的优点是产物活性提高、稳定性增长、可在恶劣环境中使用、储存和使用寿命延长等。
explanation_en: The process of binding or isolating the active substance in the same phase, separating it from the whole phase, separating sweat, and exchanging with substances (molecules, ions, etc.) outside the phase. Immobilization methods mainly include: non covalent combination method, such as physical adsorption, ion combination method, etc; Covalent combination methods, such as crosslinking method and embedding method (microcapsule method, grid method, etc.). Immobilized materials (carriers) include natural or synthetic materials, such as polysaccharide, protein, ceramics, polyester, polyamide, nylon resin, alginate, chitosan, etc. In a broad sense, the assimilated substances include gas, liquid and homologous substances: in the field of biomedicine, there are mainly soluble enzymes, eggs, tissues and cells. "Immobilization has the advantages of improved product activity, increased stability, use in harsh environments, storage and service life extension.

explanation_cn: 固定在一个地方使用的燃料电池系统。它的应用包括备用电源（backuppower)和首位电源（primarypower)。由于质子交换膜燃料电池可以瞬间动，备用电源燃料电池一般均采用质子交换膜燃料电池。
explanation_en: A fuel cell system that is fixed in one place for use. Its applications include backup power and primary power. Since proton exchange membrane fuel cell can be operated instantaneously, proton exchange membrane fuel cell is generally used as standby power supply for fuel cell.

explanation_cn: 指使用固体电子元件，例如发光二极管（LED）、有机发光二极管(OUED)、高分子发光二极管（PLED)等作为光源的照明技术。在现代物理中将利用固体内部电子运动变化原理制成的具有一定功能的电子器件称为固态电子器件，以区别于传统的电真空器件。发光二极管是一种通过半导体内部载流子复合产生光的半导体器件，属固态器件。因此，可将以半导体发光二极管为光源的照明称为固态照明，以区别于采用电真空光源（如白炽灯和日光灯）的传统照明。也因为上述原因，同态照明也可称为半导体照明，或LED照明。同态照明具有节能、环保、寿命长等优点。半导体间态电子器件在电子学方面完成了一次很好的革命，第二次革命正发生在照明领域，LED将取代白炽灯、荧光灯等所有传统电光源，实现节能、环保的同态照明。
explanation_en: It refers to the lighting technology using solid electronic components, such as luminescence diodes (LEDs), organic light emitting diode (OUED), macromolecule luminescence diodes (PLED), etc. as light sources. In modern physics, electronic devices with certain functions made using the principle of internal electronic motion changes in solids are called solid-state electronic devices to distinguish them from traditional vacuum devices. Luminescence diode is a semiconductor device that generates light through composition of carriers inside the semiconductor, which belongs to solid state device. Therefore, the lighting with semiconductor luminescence diodes as light sources can be called solid state lighting, which is different from the traditional lighting with electric vacuum light sources (such as incandescent lamps and fluorescent lamps). Because of the above reasons, homomorphic lighting can also be called semiconductor lighting or LED lighting. Homomorphic lighting has the advantages of energy conservation, environmental protection, and long service life. Semiconductor interstate electronic devices have achieved a great revolution in electronics, and the second revolution is happening in the field of lighting. LED will replace all traditional light sources such as incandescent lamps and fluorescent lamps, achieving energy-saving and environmentally friendly homomorphic lighting.

name_cn: 固态物质烧结传质机理
name_en: mechanisms of solid slate sintering and mass transfer
explanation_cn: 在没有液相存在的固态物质烧结时的物质传递规律。包括蒸发一凝聚传质机理和扩散传质机理。蒸发仅在高温下蒸气压较大的体系内存在，如氧化铝、氧化铍和氧化铁的烧结。在大多固体材料中由于高温下蒸气压低.则传质更易通过固态内质点扩散来进行。整个烧结过程按烧结温度及传质的不同可分为：①烧结初期，表面扩散作用十分显著，开始烧结时坯体中有大量连通气孔，表面扩散使颈部充填.并促使孔隙表面光滑和气孔球化；②烧结中期，颗粒开始黏结，颈部扩大，气孔相互连通，晶界开始移动，这一阶段以晶界和晶格扩散为主；③烧结后期，气孔已完全孤立，气孔位于晶粒包围的顶点，晶粒已明显长大。
explanation_en: The mass transfer law during sintering of solid materials without liquid phase. It includes evaporation condensation mass transfer mechanism and diffusion mechanism of mass transfer. Evaporation only exists in systems with high vapor pressure at high temperature, such as sintering of alumina, beryllia and iron oxide. In most solid materials, due to the low vapor pressure at high temperature, mass transfer is easier to be carried out through the diffusion of solid internal particle. According to sintering temperature and mass transfer, the whole sintering process can be divided into: ① At the initial stage of sintering, the surface diffusion effect is very significant. At the beginning of sintering, there are a large number of connected pores in the green body, and surface diffusion fills the neck, and promotes the smooth surface of pores and the spheroidization of pores; ② In the middle stage of sintering, the particles begin to bond, the neck expands, the pores are interconnected, and the grain boundary starts to move. This stage is dominated by grain boundary and lattice diffusion; ③ At the later stage of sintering, the pores have been completely isolated, and the pores are located at the vertex surrounded by the grains, and the grains have grown significantly.

explanation_cn: 固沙材料分为植物固沙材料和化学同沙材料两大类。植物间沙材料主要为梭梭、沙拐枣、怪柳、胡杨、沙枣、老鼠瓜等沙区易生植物。化学固沙材料是为解决局部严重沙化而提出的有机同沙材料以及有机-无机复合间砂材料。有机固沙材料一方面采用植物拷胶高分子固沙浆材，LVA、LVP、WBS、STB固沙材料等水溶性或油溶性化学胶结物.其施工简便，效果较好；另一方面利用石油副产品（如沥青）、棉籽酚树脂（棉籽榨油厂废料）、纸浆或草浆废液、T.业废料（废塑料）、工业酒糟液等溶解、乳化或添加改性剂制备而成的固沙树脂.其成本较低，固沙层坚实。
explanation_en: Sand-fixing materials/sand fixation materials are divided into two categories: plant sand-fixing materials/sand fixation materials and chemical sand materials. The materials of sand among plants is mainly Haloxylon ammodendron, Calligonum, Willow, Populus euphratica, Elaeagnus angustifolia, mouse melon and other easily growing plants in the sand area. Chemical sand-fixing materials/sand fixation materials is an organic sand materials and an organic-inorganic composite sand materials proposed to solve local severe desertification. On the one hand, organic sand-fixing materials/sand fixation materials use plant rubber macromolecule sand fixation slurry, water soluble or oil soluble chemical cements such as LVA, LVP, WBS, STB sand-fixing materials/sand fixation materials, which are easy to construct and have good effects; On the other hand, the sand fixing resin is prepared by dissolving, emulsifying or adding modifiers to petroleum by-products (such as pitch), cottonseed phenol resin (waste of cottonseed oil mill), pulp or straw pulp waste liquid, T. industrial waste (waste plastics), industrial distiller's grains liquid, etc. Its cost is low and the sand fixing layer is solid.

explanation_cn: 一种或多种溶质组元溶人溶剂（纯组元或中间相）的晶格中且仍保持溶剂晶格类型的一类固态物质（固体相）。以纯组元为溶剂者，称一次固溶体；以中间相为溶剂者，称二次固溶体。根据溶质组元在点阵中的分布特征可将同溶体分为三大类：代位固溶体、填隙固溶体、缺位固溶体。
explanation_en: A class of solid substances (solid phase) in which one or more solute components dissolve into the lattice of solvent (pure component or intermediate phase) and still maintain the type of solvent lattice. The pure component as solvent is called primary solid solution; The second solid solution is called when the intermediate phase is used as the solvent. According to the distribution characteristics of solute components in the lattice, synsolution can be divided into three categories: substitutional solid solution, interstitial solid solution, and absent solid solution.

explanation_cn: 又称混晶半导体和合金半导体，是指由两个或两个以上的元素所构成的具有半导体性质的间溶体，其禁带宽度和晶格常数随材料的组分不同连续可调。按组成元素的多少可分为二元、三元、四元以及多元固溶体。
explanation_en: Also known as mixed crystal semiconductor and alloy semiconductor, it refers to the intersolution with semiconductor properties composed of two or more elements, whose band gap width and lattice constant can be continuously adjusted with the composition of materials. According to the number of constituent elements, it can be divided into binary, ternary, quaternary and multi-component solid solution.

explanation_cn: 将合金材料加热到适当温度，保持足够长的时间，使第二相溶入基体固溶体中.得到成分和组织均匀的固溶体，然后快速冷却到室温的热处理。加热温度足够高可得到单相同溶体时称为完全固溶处理；反之，若还有部分第二相未固溶，则称为不完全固溶处理。经过固溶处理的合金.其在室温下的组织往往是亚稳平衡的，在适当的温度或应力条件下会发生第二相的脱溶析出相变。固溶处理通常是一种预先热处理.可为进一步的热处理作好组织准备。
explanation_en: Heat the alloy materials to an appropriate temperature and keep it for a long enough time to make the second phase dissolve into the matrix solid solution to obtain solid solution with uniform composition and structure, and then rapidly cool it to room temperature for heat treatment. When the heating temperature is high enough to obtain the same single solution, it is called complete solution treatment; On the contrary, if some of the second phase is not solid solution, it is called incomplete solution treatment. After solution treatment, the structure of alloy at room temperature is usually metastable equilibrium, and the second phase will be desolvated and precipitated under appropriate temperature or stress conditions. Solution treatment is usually a kind of pre heat treatment, which can prepare for further heat treatment.

explanation_cn: 溶质在固溶体中的极限溶解度，亦即溶质固溶于溶剂内所形成的饱和固溶体内溶质的浓度。固溶度的大小及其随温度的变化直接关系到合金的性能和热处理行为。
explanation_en: Limit water solubility of solute in solid solution, that is, the concentration of solute in saturated solid solution formed by solute solution in solvent. The solid solubility and its change with temperature directly affect the properties and heat treatment behavior of alloy.

explanation_cn: 镍基、铁基和钴基高温合金中加入适量的合金元素.如W、Mo、Ta等，其原子均匀地分布在奥氏体基体中，形成内应力场，同时，当奥氏体基体中出现溶质原子非均匀分布或存在短程有序，都构成位错运动的障碍。
explanation_en: An appropriate amount of alloy elements, such as W, Mo, Ta, etc., are added to nickel base, iron base and cobalt-base superalloy, and their atoms are evenly distributed in the austenitic matrix, forming an internal stress field. At the same time, when the solute atoms in the austenitic matrix are unevenly distributed or have short-range order, they all constitute an obstacle to the movement of dislocation.

explanation_cn: 通过固相间反应制取固态化合物或固溶体粉料的方法。固相反应时.常伴随出现烧结和重结晶.从而降低粉料的活性.增加质点扩散的难度，不利于固相反应的进行。为加速固相反应的速率，可使原始粉料粒度尽量细化.或适当增加反应物接触的表面，或通过搅拌及合理提高反应温度.使反应容易完成。固相反应制备陶瓷粉体首先将各种原料按准确比例配料并均匀混合。为强化混合可加人助磨剂（水、乙二醇或其他极性物质）；均匀混合后可通过压滤、烘烤、喷雾或冷冻以去除液体.最后通过锻烧完成反应。采用滚筒式回转窑转动搅拌锻烧，既可使反应迅速、均匀、完全，又可连续生产。固相反应后粉料一般需用机械粉碎方法（球磨、砂磨）使之进一步细化。反应良好的粉料.通常还要经适当的造粒、存储，以备后续成形、烧结工艺使用。
explanation_en: A method for preparing solid compound or solid solution powder through solid phase reaction. During solid state reaction, sintering and recrystallization often occur, which reduces the activity of powder and increases the difficulty of particle diffusion, which is not conducive to the solid state reaction. To accelerate the rate of solid-phase reaction, the original powder particle size can be refined as much as possible, or the contact surface of reactants can be appropriately increased, or the reaction can be easily completed by stirring and reasonably increasing the reaction temperature. The preparation of ceramic powder by solid-state reaction involves accurately proportioning various raw materials and uniformly mixing them. To strengthen the mixing, grinding aids (water, ethylene glycol, or other polar substances) can be added; After uniform mixing, the liquid can be removed by pressure filtration, baking, spray or freezing, and finally the reaction is completed by calcination. Adopting a drum type rotary kiln to rotate, stir, and calcine can not only make the reaction rapid, uniform, and complete, but also continuously produce. After solid-phase reaction, the powder generally needs to be further refined using mechanical crushing methods (ball milling, sand milling). The powder with good reaction is usually subject to proper granulation and storage for subsequent forming and sintering process.

explanation_cn: 在某一材料的单晶衬底上的薄膜从非晶相向晶体相的转变。通常先在某一材料的单晶衬底上沉积非晶薄膜，然后加热衬底至一定温度.使非晶薄膜晶化，衬底则起着籽晶的作用.要使非晶薄膜转换成单晶，需要足够高的晶化温度、衬底表面的质量和洁净度以及晶化条件提出了很髙的要求.如有些情况下需要在超高真空的条件下晶化。通常情况下.固相外延很难获得髙质量的外延层。在硅片的离子注人掺杂中，硅片近表面形成的非晶层可在后续的退火工艺中重结晶为完整的单晶层。
explanation_en: The transformation of a thin film on a single crystal substrate of a materials from an amorphous phase to a crystal phase. Generally, an amorphous film is deposited on a single crystal substrate of a certain materials first, and then the substrate is heated to a certain temperature to crystallize the amorphous film, and the substrate plays the role of seed crystal. To convert the amorphous film into a single crystal, a sufficiently high crystallization temperature, the quality and cleanliness of the substrate surface, and the crystallization conditions put forward very high requirements. In some cases, crystallization is required under ultra-high vacuum conditions. Generally, it is difficult to obtain high-quality epitaxial layers by solid phase epitaxy. In the ion implantation doping of silicon wafer, the amorphous layer formed near the surface of silicon wafer can be recrystallized into a complete single crystal layer in the subsequent annealing process.

explanation_cn: 指一种或多种粉末的烧结.并且在烧结过程中不出现液相。固相烧结分为单元系固相烧结和多元系固相烧结两类。单元系固相烧结：纯金属（如难熔金属和纯铁软磁材料）或化合物（A1203、B4C、BeO等），在熔点以下温度进行的固相烧结过程。多元系固相烧结：由两种或两种以上的成分组成的烧结体系.在其中低熔点组分熔点温度以下进行的固相烧结过程。烧结过程包括黏结面形成、烧结颈长大、孔隙封闭和球化阶段。
explanation_en: It refers to the sintering of one or more powder, and there is no liquid phase in the sintering process. Solid state sintering can be divided into two types: unit system solid state sintering and multi-element system solid state sintering. Unit system solid state sintering: the solid state sintering process of pure metals (such as refractory metals and pure iron soft magnetic materials) or compounds (A1203, B4C, BeO, etc.) at temperatures below melting point. Multi system solid state sintering: a sintering system consisting of two or more components. The solid state sintering process is carried out below the melting point temperature of the low melting point component. The sintering process includes the formation of bonding surface, the growth of sintering neck, pore sealing and spheroidization stages.

explanation_cn: 在半导体材料衬底表面通过刻蚀工艺制作具冇细微结构的图形，然后再在图形衬底表面进行发光二极管所需材料的外延。图形化的蓝宝石衬底主要用来外延生长氮化镓基蓝绿光发光二极管，蓝宝石衬底经过图形化衬底加工后，会减少外延发光二极管的缺陷和位错。此外，由外延芯片封装出来的发光二极管能有效提高光提取效率。在发光二极管行业中，蓝宝石图形衬底制作技术也常被称为"PSS技术具体制作方法为：采用氧化硅、光刻胶或者金属作为掩膜；用干法或者湿法刻蚀蓝宝石；然后去掉掩膜，得到图形化的蓝宝石衬底。
explanation_en: The pattern with fine structure is made on the semiconductor materials substrate surface by etching process, and then the epitaxy of materials required for luminescence diodes is carried out on the patterned substrate surface. The patterned sapphire substrate is mainly used for epitaxial growth of gallium nitride based blue-green luminescence diodes. After processing the patterned sapphire substrate, the defects and dislocation of epitaxial luminescence diodes will be reduced. In addition, the luminescence diode encapsulated by the epitaxial chip can effectively improve the light extraction efficiency. In the luminescence diode industry, the production technology of sapphire patterned substrate is also often referred to as "PSS technology. The specific production method is: using silicon oxide, photoresist or metal as the mask; etching sapphire with dry or wet methods; and then removing the mask to get a patterned sapphire substrate.

explanation_cn: 又称为土壤保水剂、保湿剂、高分子吸水剂。在土壤中能将雨水或浇灌水吸收并保住不渗失的具有F.维网状结构的一类有机高分子聚合物材料。保水剂的吸水是由于高分子电解质的离子排斥所引起的分子扩张和网状结构引起阻碍分子的扩张相互作用所产生的三维网状结构.在网状结构上有许多羧基、羟基等亲水基团，当与水接触时.其分子表面的亲水性基团电离并与水分子结合成氢键.通过这种方式吸持大量的水分。在这一过程中.网链上电解质使得网络中的电解质溶液与外部水分之间产生渗透势差，吸水直到浓度差为零。按制品形态可分为粉末状、膜状和纤维状等；根据研制原料可分为淀粉系（淀粉接枝、羧甲基化等）、纤维素系（纤维素接枝、羧甲基化）及合成聚合系（聚丙烯酸系、聚乙烯醇系等）三种，常用有聚丙烯酰胺，保水材料特有的吸水、储水、保水性能.在改善生态环境、防风固沙工程中起到决定成败的作用?广泛用于土地荒漠化治理、农林作物种植、园林绿化等领域。
explanation_en: It is also called soil water retaining agent, humectant and polymer water absorbent. It is a kind of organic macromolecule polymer materials material with F. dimensional network structure that can absorb rainwater or irrigation water in soil and keep it impermeable. The water absorption of water retaining agent is a three-dimensional network structure produced by the molecular expansion caused by the ion repulsion of macromolecule electrolyte and the network structure blocking the molecular expansion interaction. There are many hydrophilic groups such as carboxyl and hydroxyl groups on the network structure. When it contacts with water, the hydrophilic groups on the surface of its molecules ionize and combine with water molecules to form hydrogen bond. In this way, a large amount of water is absorbed. In this process, the elonrolyte on the network chain makes the osmotic potential difference between the elonrolyte solution in the network and the external water, and absorbs water until the concentration difference is zero. According to the shape of the product, it can be divided into powder, film, and fiber shapes; According to the research materials, it can be divided into three types: starch system (starch grafting, carboxymethylation, etc.), cellulose system (cellulose grafting, carboxymethylation, etc.) and synthetic polymerization system (polypropylene acid system, polyvinyl alcohol system, etc.). polyacrylamide is commonly used. The unique water absorption, storage, and retention properties of water retaining materials play a decisive role in improving the ecological environment, wind prevention and sand fixation projects? Widely used in land desertification control, agricultural and forestry crop planting, landscaping and other fields.

explanation_cn: 当土壤受污染程度超出土壤自净能力或土壤荒漠化程度导致土壤无法自我修复时，为了恢复土壤的生产力，保证农作物卫生安全而在土壤中人为施加的材料。该材料主要包括固沙材料、土壤改良剂、土壤生物降解材料、土壤生物降解催化材料、土壤重金属固定剂、土壤保水材料、土壤石油污染降解剂、土壤杀菌剂、吸氟植物、土壤氟污染处理剂、土壤农药残留分解催化材料、土壤农药残留降解微生物、土壤农药残留吸附剂、土壤重金属玻璃化处理、土壤重金属固定剂等。
explanation_en: When the degree of soil pollution exceeds the self purification capacity of the soil or the degree of soil desertification makes the soil unable to self repair, materials are artificially applied in the soil to restore the productivity of the soil and ensure the health and safety of crops. The materials mainly includes sand-fixing materials/sand fixation materials, soil conditioners, soil biodegradable materials, soil biodegradation catalytic materials, soil heavy metal pollution fixing agent, soil water retention materials, soil oil pollution degradation agent, soil fungicide, fluoride absorption plant, treating agent of fluorine contaminated soil, decomposition catalyst of pesticide residues in solid, degradation microorganism of pesticide residues in soils, adsorbent of pesticide residues in soils, soil heavy metal pollution vitrification process Soil heavy metal pollution fixing agent, etc.

name_en: adsorbent of pesticide residues in soils
explanation_cn: 用以减少土壤中未能被降解的残留农药的吸附性材料。不同农药在土壤中的残留期长短的大致次序是：含重金属农药>有机氯农药>取代脲类、均三氯笨类和大部分磺酰脲类除草剂>拟除虫菊酯类农药>氨基甲酸酯农药、有机磷农药。农药残留吸附剂主要有：①活性炭类.巨大的比表面积和发达的孔隙结构决定了其有效的吸附性能，尤其在吸附中性分子时，效果最突出。活性炭类吸附剂常用于处理含有除草剂的土壤=②有机质类（土壤腐殖质、厩肥和植物残渣），当农药的分子质子化以后，以阳离子形式存在于土壤中.可与有机质发生阳离子交换吸附。常用于吸附大片地区土壤的残留农药.③黏土矿物类，黏土矿物是由金属氧化物和羟基氧化物组成，其比表面积大，表面有大量的正负电荷位点，对农药等污染物有一定的吸附能力。黏土矿物主要吸附脂溶性农药，使其主要同定在土壤表面或施药层内。
explanation_en: Adsorbent materials used to reduce residual pesticides that are not degradation in soil. The approximate order of the residual period of different pesticides in soil is: heavy metal pesticides>organochlorine pesticides>substituted ureas, mesyltrichlorobenzenes, and most sulfonylurea herbicides>pyrethroid pesticides>carbamate pesticides, and organophosphorus pesticides. Pesticide residue adsorbents mainly include: ① activated carbon. Its effective adsorption performance is determined by its huge specific surface and developed pore structure, especially when it adsorbs neutral molecules. Activated carbon adsorbents are commonly used to treat soil containing herbicides. ② Organic matter (soil humus, manure, and plant residues) exists in the soil as cations after the molecular protonation of pesticides. They can undergo cation exchange adsorption with organic matter. Commonly used to adsorb residual pesticides from large areas of soil. ③ Clay mineral, clay mineral are composed of metal oxides and hydroxyl oxides, with large specific surface, a large number of positive and negative charge sites on the surface, and certain adsorption capacity for pesticides and other pollutants. Clay mineral mainly absorb fat soluble pesticides, so that they are mainly located on the soil surface or in the application layer.

explanation_cn: 是一种用于土壤处理的化学物质，旨在杀灭或抑制土壤中的病原微生物、有害虫害、杂草和其他有害生物，以减少病害、提高作物生长和保护植物健康的产品。这些杀菌消毒剂在农业、园艺和土壤管理中广泛使用。
explanation_en: It is a chemical substance used for soil treatment, aimed at killing or inhibiting pathogenic microorganisms, harmful pests, weeds, and other harmful organisms in the soil, in order to reduce diseases, improve crop growth, and protect plant health. These bactericidal disinfectant are widely used in agriculture, horticulture and soil management.

name_en: treating agent of fluorine contaminated soil
explanation_cn: 通过物理或化学方法降低土壤中离子态氟含量的材料。由于氟离子相对交换能力较强.易与土壤中带正电荷的胶体.如含水氧化铝相结合，故土壤本身拥有一定的吸氣能力，而当离子态氟含量过高时.需要引人土壤氣污染处理剂。处理剂分为无机盐类和有机物类。无机盐类包括活性氧化铝、磷酸盐、生石灰、电厂脱硫灰渣、活性氧化镁等，可以与土壤中离子态氟生成难溶性的氟铝硅酸盐、氟磷酸盐.以及氟化钙、氟化镁等沉淀。
explanation_en: Materials that reduces the content of ionic fluorine in soil by physical or chemical methods. Due to the strong relative exchange ability of fluoride ions and their tendency to combine with positively charged colloids in the soil, such as aqueous alumina, the soil itself has a certain ability to absorb air. However, when the content of ionized fluoride is too high, soil air pollution treatment agents need to be introduced. Treatment agents are divided into inorganic salts and organic compounds. Inorganic salts include active aluminium, phosphate, quicklime, power plant desulfurization ash, activated magnesium oxide, etc., which can form insoluble fluoroaluminosilicate, fluorophosphate, calcium fluoride, magnesium fluoride and other precipitation with ionic fluorine in soil.

name_cn: 土壤污染的生物降解材料
explanation_cn: 利用生物技术将残存于土壤中的有毒有害有机污染物和重金属"就地"降解或去除，使其转化为无害物质的生物材料。土壤污染生物降解材料包括植物修复材料、动物修材料和微生物修复材料。①植物修复分为植物降解修复、根际圈微生物降解修复、植物提取修复、植物挥发修复和植物稳定修复五种。特定植物通过木质化、矿质化、使化合物完全挥发、根分泌物直接降解作用转化污染物；特定植物根际圈菌根真菌、专性或非专性细菌等微生物的降解作用转化有机污染物；特定超积累植物从污染土壤中超量吸附、吸收一种或几种重金属元素，之后将植物整体（包括部分根）收获并集中处理；特定植物将土壤中的一些挥发性污染物吸收到植物体内，将其转化为气态物质释放到大气中；特定植根系分泌物质能积累和沉淀根际圈污染物质，使其失去生物有效性。②动物修复材料是指能吸收或富集土壤中的残留农药，并通过其代谢作用把部分农药分解为低毒或无毒产物的蚯蚓、线虫、跳虫、蜈蚣、蜘蛛、土蜂等低等动物。③微生物修复材料分为土著微生物、外来微生物和基因工程菌。土著微生物在有机污染物污染诱导下经自然驯化和选择，产生分解污染物的酶体系而将污染物降解转化；外来微生物指可接种一些降解污染物，具有生态适应性的高效微生物菌种；基因工程菌是采用细胞融合技术遗传工程手段将多种降解基因转人同一种微生物中，使之获得广谱的降解能力。
explanation_en: Use biotechnology to "in-situ" degradation or remove toxic and harmful organic pollutants and heavy metals remaining in the soil and convert them into harmless biomaterials. Biodegradable materials for soil pollution include materials for phytoremediation, materials for animal remediation and materials for microbial remediation. ① Phytoremediation includes plant degradation remediation, rhizosphere microbial degradation remediation, plant extraction remediation, plant volatilization remediation and plant stabilization remediation. Specific plants transform pollutants through lignification, mineralization, complete volatilization of compounds, and direct degradation of root exudates; Degradation of certain plant rhizosphere mycorrhizal fungi, specific or non-specific bacteria and other microorganisms to transform organic pollutants; Specific hyperaccumulating plants adsorb and absorb one or several heavy metal elements in excess from contaminated soil, and then harvest the entire plant (including some roots) and concentrate them for treatment; Specific plants absorb some volatile pollutants from the soil into their bodies, converting them into gaseous substances and releasing them into the atmosphere; Secretory substances of specific rooting systems can accumulate and precipitation pollutants in the rhizosphere, making them lose their biological effectiveness. ② Animal remediation materials refer to lower animals such as earthworms, nematodes, springworms, centipedes, spiders, and wasps that can absorb or enrich residual pesticides in soil and decompose some pesticides into low toxic or non-toxic products through their metabolism. ③ Microbial remediation materials are divided into indigenous microorganisms, foreign microorganisms and genetically engineered bacteria. Indigenous microorganisms are naturally domesticated and selected under the induction of organic pollutants to produce an enzyme system that decomposes pollutants and degradation and transforms pollutants; Exotic microorganisms refer to the highly effective microorganisms that can be inoculated with some degradation and have ecological adaptability; Genetic engineering bacteria use cell fusion technology and genetic engineering means to transfer multiple degradation genes into the same microorganism, so that it can obtain a broad spectrum of degradation ability.

name_cn: 土壤生物降解催化材料
explanation_cn: 土壤酶是土壤中所有生物化学反应的催化材料，可分为氧化还原类、水解酶类、转移酶类和裂合酶类四种基本类型。①氧化还原酶类对于土壤生态系统中有机物质的矿化（纤维素和木质素降解）和合成（腐殖化）过程有显著影响。如多酚氧化酶将酚类物质氧化成醌类物质，漆酶和酚氧化酶可以催化木质素的氧化作用。②水解酶类主要将分子量较高的化合物水解为简单的小分子物质（如NH3、NO2、H20、Cu2等)。如土壤纤维素分解酶将纤维素水解为葡萄糖和水，土壤蛋白酶能够促水解蛋白生成各种小分子的含氮化合物（如NH3和H2O)，磷酸酶参与难溶解磷酸盐和有机磷水解。③转移酶类指能催化底物之间进行某些基团的转移或交换的酶类。在转氨酶作用下，氨基酸的氨基转移给其他化合物，并合成新的氨基化合物。此外还有主要包括葡萄糖蔗糖酶和硫氰酸酶。④裂合（解）酶的酶促催化是指从底物上移去一个基团（如氨基和糖基）而形成双键的反应或其逆反应，主要包括醛缩酶、水化酶及脱氨酶。其主要参与土壤生态系统中蛋白质和氨基酸的分解作用，与土壤氮代谢密切相关。
explanation_en: Soil enzymes are catalytic materials for all biochemical reactions in soil, which can be divided into four basic types: oxidation-reduction enzymes, hydrolases, transferases and lyases. ① Oxidoreductases have significant effects on the mineralization (degradation of cellulose and lignin) and synthesis (humification) of organic matter in the soil ecosystem. For example, polyphenol oxidase oxidizes phenols into quinones, laccase and phenol oxidase can catalyze the oxidation of lignin. ② Hydrolases mainly hydrolyze compounds with higher molecular weights into simple small molecule substances (such as NH3, NO2, H20, Cu2, etc.). For example, soil cellulose decomposing enzyme hydrolyzes cellulose into glucose and water, soil protease can promote protein hydrolysis to generate various small molecule nitrogenous compounds (such as NH3 and H2O), and phosphatase participates in the hydrolysis of insoluble phosphate and organic phosphorus. ③ Transferases refer to enzymes that catalyze the transfer or exchange of certain functional groups between substrates. Under the action of transaminases, the amino groups of amino acids are transferred to other compounds and new amino compounds are synthesized. In addition, there are mainly glucose sucrase and thiocyanase. ④ The enzymatic catalysis of lyases refers to the formation of double bonds by removing a functional group (such as amino and sugar groups) from the substrate, or its reverse reaction, mainly including aldolase, hydratase, and deaminase. It mainly participates in the decomposition of proteins and amino acids in soil ecosystems and is closely related to soil nitrogen metabolism.

explanation_cn: 主要是由微生物构成的用以石油降解的菌剂，可利用天然存在的微生物或人为投加的菌株。环烷烃在石油馏分中占有较大的比例，能降解石油中环烷烃的细菌有假单胞菌属、弧菌属、不动杆菌属、黄杆菌属、气单胞菌属、无色杆菌属、产碱杆菌属、肠杆菌属、棒杆菌属、节杆菌属、葡萄球菌属、乳杆菌属；酵母菌有假丝酵母属、红酵母菌属、毕赤氏酵母菌属等；霉菌有青霉菌、曲霉菌、镰孢菌属等。石油烃在水中的溶解度很小，部分微生物可通过特异性附着机制通过菌毛或细胞膜的脂类和蛋白质使细胞形成疏水表面而附着于水中的油滴上，或者部分微生物通过释放出乳化剂将油滴乳化成小颗粒，增大油滴表面积，有利于微生物的直接接触和利用。一般的烷烃在微生物作用下首先被氧化成醇，醇在脱氢酶的作用下被氧化为相应的醛，然后通过醛脱氢酶的作用氧化成脂肪酸。芳烃被细菌和真菌氧化的氧化机理并不相同，细菌是通过过氧化物酶将氧分子的两个氧原子结合进芳香烃中，形成顺式构型的二氢二醇，在另一种过氧化物酶的催化作用下，二氢二醇的芳香环破裂成邻苯二酚；而真菌则是通过催化单氧化酶和环氧化物水解酶使芳烃转化为反式构型的二氢二醇。
explanation_en: It is mainly a microbial agent for oil degradation, which can use natural microorganisms or artificially added strains. Naphthenic hydrocarbons account for a large proportion in petroleum fractions. Pseudomonas, Vibrio, Acinetobacter, Flavobacterium, Aeromonas, Acinetobacter, Acinetobacter, Alcaligenes, Enterobacter, Corynebacterium, Arthrobacter, Staphylococcus and Lactobacillus can degradation naphthenic hydrocarbons in petroleum; Yeasts include Candida, Red Yeast, and Pichia yeast; Fungi include Penicillium, Aspergillus, Fusarium, etc. The water solubility of petroleum hydrocarbons in water is very small. Some microorganisms can attach to oil drops in water by forming hydrophobic surfaces through pili or lipid and protein of cell membrane through specific attachment mechanism, or some microorganisms can emulsify oil drops into small particles by releasing emulsifier to increase the surface area of oil drops, which is conducive to direct contact and utilization of microorganisms. General alkanes are first oxidized to alcohols under the action of microorganisms, and alcohols are oxidized to corresponding aldehydes under the action of dehydrogenase, and then oxidized to fatty acids through the action of aldehyde dehydrogenase. The oxidation mechanism of aromatic hydrocarbons by bacteria and fungi is different. Bacteria combine two oxygen atoms of oxygen molecules into aromatic hydrocarbons through peroxidase to form cis dihydrodiol. Under the catalysis of another peroxidase, the aromatic ring of dihydrodiol breaks into catechol; Fungi, on the other hand, catalyze the conversion of aromatic hydrocarbons into trans configuration dihydrodiol by catalyzing monooxygenases and epoxide hydrolases.

explanation_cn: 材料受土壤环境中的水分、溶盐、氧、微生物的侵蚀而发生的腐蚀损伤现象。
explanation_en: Corrosion damage of materials caused by water, dissolved salt, oxygen and microorganisms in the soil environment.

name_en: soil heavy metal pollution fixing agent
explanation_cn: 通过吸附、络合、沉淀等作用改变土壤中水溶态和离子交换态重金属的存在形态.使其固定，降低其在环境中的迁移性和生物nJ?利用性的材料。主要有无机类、有机类和生物类。①无机类：石灰、高炉渣、矿渣、粉煤灰等碱性物质可以提高土壤pH值，引起重金属沉淀。如石灰硫黄合剂等含硫物质，能与土壤中重金属形成硫化物沉淀.特别适用于受重金属污染的酸性土壤.，②有机类：土壤腐殖质、厩肥和植物残渣等的功能基可以络合和富集重金属，同时施加有机物等还原性物质，增加土壤溶液中还原态物质的相对浓度，从而降低土壤氧化还原电位.促进无机物与重金属沉淀。③生物材料：土壤微生物、重金属超M累枳植物通过：a.生物提取，即利用重金属超量累积植物将土壤中的重金属转移到植物体内.从而净化土壤；b.生物挥发，即利用土壤微生物等将土壤中的部分重金属转化并挥发到空气中去；c.生物固定，即利用植物根系、土壤微生物、土壤动物的生命活动将土壤中的重金属转变成有效性较低的形态，从而降低其毒性。土壤重金属固定剂广泛应用于修复土壤金属污染、增加土壤微生物抗重金属胁迫和毒性耐受力。
explanation_en: Through adsorption, complexation, precipitation and other actions, the existing forms of water-soluble and ion exchange heavy metals in the soil are changed, so that they are fixed, and their mobility in the environment and biological nJ? Usable materials. There are mainly inorganic, organic, and biological types Inorganic: alkaline substances such as lime, blast furnace slag, slag and fly ash can increase soil pH and cause precipitation of heavy metals. Sulfur containing substances such as lime sulfur agent can form sulfide precipitation with heavy metals in soil, especially suitable for acid soil polluted by heavy metals Organic: The functional groups of soil humus, manure and plant residues can complexe and enrich heavy metals, and at the same time, reducing substances such as organic substances are applied to increase the relative concentration of reducing substances in soil solution, thus reducing the soil redox potential and promoting the precipitation of inorganic substances and heavy metals. ③ Biomaterials: Soil microorganisms and heavy metals accumulate in plants through: a. Biological extraction, which uses plants to accumulate excessive amounts of heavy metals in the soil and transfer them into the plant body, thereby purifying the soil; b. Biovolatilization refers to the use of soil microorganisms to convert and volatilize some heavy metals in the soil into the air; c. Biofixation refers to the use of plant roots, soil microorganisms, and the life activities of soil animals to transformation the heavy metals in the soil into less effective forms, thereby reducing their toxicity. Soil heavy metal pollution fixing agent are widely used to repair soil metal pollution and increase the resistance of soil microorganisms to heavy metal stress and toxicity tolerance.

name_cn: 土壤重金属玻璃化处理
name_en: soil heavy metal pollution vitrification process
explanation_cn: 土壤与重金属污染物在1600-2000°C的高温下发生玻璃化熔融?冷却后形成化学惰性、耐久性好、抗渗出、强度高、非扩散的玻璃状或玻璃-陶瓷状的物质，重金属很难被浸提出来，从而牢固地束缚于玻璃体内。玻璃化技术成本很高，一般适用于处理成分复杂、污染严重且含有难以处理的同体废物（如放射性废物）土壤。
explanation_en: Does soil and heavy metal pollutants undergo vitrification and melting at high temperatures ranging from 1600 to 2000 ° C? After cooling, glass like or glass ceramics like substances with chemical inertness, good durability, anti exudation, high strength, and non diffusion will be formed. Heavy metals are difficult to be extracted and firmly bound in glass. The cost of vitrification technology is very high, and it is generally applicable to the treatment of soil containing complex components, serious pollution and difficult to treat homogeneous waste (such as radioactive waste).

explanation_cn: 绿松石，又称“松石”，因其“形似松球，色近松绿”而得名。英文名Turquoise，意为土耳其石。土耳其并不产绿松石，传说古代波斯产的绿松石是经土耳其运进欧洲而得名。
explanation_en: Turquoise, also known as "turquoise", is named for its "shape like a pine ball and color close to pine green". The English name Turquoise means Türkiye stone. Türkiye does not produce turquoise. It is said that turquoise produced in ancient Persia was transported to Europe via Türkiye and got its name.

explanation_cn: 是一种含羟基的铝硅酸盐矿物。是高岭石的同质异象变体，具层状结构，单斜晶系。晶体呈完善的六边形鳞片，鱗片大小0.1-0.5mm。呈白色，集合体微带黄绿或者褐色。解理薄片呈珍珠光泽。硬度2.5-3.5,密度2.62g/cm^3。作为纸张和涂料填料，具有良好的涂敷性和遮盖性。可作为生产无碱玻璃纤维、合成分子筛的原料；色泽美观者可作为雕刻工艺品原料。
explanation_en: It is an aluminum silicate mineral mineral containing hydroxyl. It is a homomorphic variant of kadinite, with layered structure and monoclinic system. The crystal presents perfect hexagonal scales with a scale size of 0.1-0.5mm. It is white, with a slight yellowish green or brown aggregate. The cleavage flakes show pearly luster. Hardness 2.5-3.5, density 2.62g/cm ^ 3. As the filler of paper and coatings, it has good coating and covering properties. It can be used as a raw material for producing alkali free glass fibers and synthesizing molecular sieves; Those with beautiful color can be used as raw materials for carving crafts.

explanation_cn: 是一种使用场发射阴极来轰击荧光粉涂层，充当发光媒介的平面显示方法。发光原理为：在发射和接收电极之间的真空区域中施加高电压以产生电场，使电场激发电子撞击接收电极下的荧光粉，从而产生发光效应。这种发光原理与阴极射线管（CRT）类似，都是在真空中通过电子撞击荧光粉来实现发光，不同之处在于CRT使用单一的电子枪来发射电子束，通过偏向轨来控制电子束的发射和扫描方向。而场发射显示器（FED）拥有数十万个主动冷发射子，因此在构造上，FED可以实现比CRT更紧凑的设计，从而节省空间。此外，电压方面，CRT通常需要使用在15至30千伏的工作电压，而FED的阴极电压通常小于1千伏。
explanation_en: It is a planar display method that uses field emission cathode to bombard phosphor coating as luminescence medium. The principle of luminescence is that high voltage is applied in the vacuum area between the emitting and receiving electrodes to generate an electric field, so that the electric field excites electrons to hit the phosphor under the receiving electrode, thus producing the luminescence effect. This luminescence principle is similar to that of a cathode ray tube (CRT), which achieves luminescence by striking phosphor with electrons in vacuum. The difference is that CRT uses a single electron gun to emit electron beam, and uses deflection rails to control the emission and scanning direction of the electron beam. And field emission displays (FEDs) have hundreds of thousands of active cold emitters, so in terms of construction, FEDs can achieve a more compact design than CRTs, thereby saving space. In addition, in terms of voltage, CRTs typically require operating voltages ranging from 15 to 30 kV, while FEDs typically have cathode voltages less than 1 kV.

explanation_cn:
场发射电子显微术是一种用于观察表面结构的研究方法，借助样品上的针尖实现场致电子发射并将其放大成像。样品制成针状，针尖曲率半径约100纳米，经电蚀加工而成。样品被置于超高真空环境中（约10^-7帕斯卡），并作为阴极，在阳极正电压的电场中，针尖发射电子，这些电子飞向荧光屏。发射电流取决于电场强度F和发射表面的功函数Φ。因此，可以生成反映样品表面结构的二维图像，放大倍数可达10^6，分辨能力约为1纳米。

使用场发射电子显微术可以观察洁净表面的几何形貌，如粗糙表面因表面电荷降低而形成亮点，晶体结构，晶界结构（如果晶界位于针尖处）以及它们的运动，还可以研究加热过程中的表面形貌变化和多型转变。通过测量发射电子的能谱，还可以研究针尖的电子结构。吸附表面和纯净表面的图像会有明显不同。通过在样品上方提供吸附气体的气体源，还可以研究表面的吸附位置、吸附原子在表面的振动和化学反应过程，以及研究催化作用。这种技术的分辨能力虽然不如场离子显微术，但在某些情况下仍然非常有用，尤其是在研究表面结构和表面化学反应方面。
explanation_en: Field emission electron microscopy is a research method used to observe the surface structure. With the help of the needle tip on the sample, electron emission is carried out in situ and it is magnified for imaging. The sample is made into a needle shape, with a curvature radius of about 100 nanometers at the tip, and is processed by electro etching. The sample is placed in an ultra-high vacuum environment (about 10 ^ -7 Pascals) and serves as a cathode. In the positive electric field of the anode, the needle emits electrons, which fly towards the fluorescent screen. The emission current depends on the electric field strength F and the work function of the emission surface Φ。 Therefore, a two-dimensional image reflecting the surface structure of the sample can be generated, with a magnification of up to 10 ^ 6 and a resolution of approximately 1 nanometer. Field emission electron microscopy can be used to observe the geometric morphology of the clean surface, such as the bright spot, crystal structure, grain boundary structure (if the grain boundary is located at the tip) and their movement of the rough surface due to the reduction of surface charge, as well as the surface morphology change and multimodal transformation during the heating process. By measuring the energy spectrum of emitted electrons, the electronic structure of the needle tip can also be studied. The images of adsorbed surfaces and pure surfaces will be significantly different. By providing the gas source of adsorbed gas above the sample, we can also study the adsorption position of the surface, the vibration and chemical reaction process of adsorbed atoms on the surface, and study catalysis. Although the resolution of this technique is not as good as field ion microscopy, it is still very useful in some cases, especially in the study of surface structure and surface chemical reactions.

explanation_cn:
半导体生物传感器，也称为生物场效应晶体管传感器（Field-Effect Transistor Biosensor，BioFET），是一种传感器，它基于金属-氧化物-半导体（MOS）场效应晶体管（MOSFET）的结构和工作原理制成。它使用离子敏感膜或经生物修饰的离子敏感膜（如抗体或抗原等）、电解质溶液和参考电极来替代MOSFET结构中的金属栅极。

当带电荷的生物分子在离子敏感膜上发生识别并形成复合物，或者当生物分子在离子敏感膜上发生生化反应并产生离子型产物时，这将引起离子敏感膜表面的电荷密度变化。这相当于通过外部电源调节栅极电压，从而控制源极与漏极之间的通道电流，同时栅极敏感膜上的生物分子吸附量与漏极输出电流在一定范围内呈线性相关性。

因此，通过测量漏极电流的大小，可以对栅极离子敏感膜上发生的生物反应进行定量分析。这些生物反应包括核酸杂交、蛋白质相互作用、抗体-抗原结合以及酶-底物反应等。
explanation_en: Semiconductor biosensors, also known as biofield-effect transistor sensor (BioFET), is a kind of sensor, which is based on the structure and working principle of metal oxide semiconductor (MOS) field effect transistor (MOSFET). It uses ion sensitive membranes or biologically modified ion sensitive membranes (such as antibodies or antigens), electrolyte solutions, and reference electrodes to replace metal gates in MOSFET structures. When charged biomolecules recognize on the ion sensitive membrane and form complexes, or when biomolecules undergo biochemical reactions on the ion sensitive membrane and produce ionic products, this will cause changes in the charge density of the ion sensitive membrane surface. This is equivalent to adjusting the gate voltage through an external power source, thereby controlling the channel current between the source and drain. At the same time, the adsorption amount of biomolecules on the gate sensitive film is linearly correlated with the drain output current within a certain range. Therefore, by measuring the magnitude of the drain current, quantitative analysis can be conducted on the biological reactions occurring on the gate ion sensitive membrane. These biological reactions include nucleic acid hybridization, protein interactions, antibody antigen binding, and enzyme substrate reactions.

explanation_cn:
场离子显微镜（FIM）和原子探针（AP）是用于在原子尺度上研究材料显微组织和成分的分析技术。FIM的主要设备包括超高真空室、用于冷却样品的液氦制冷系统、稳压高压电源、图像增强系统和成像气体供给系统。在FIM中，试样通常是一极细的针尖，其尖端曲率半径约为20至50纳米。当在试样上施加数千伏的正电压时，针尖尖端的局部电场强度可高达20至50伏特/纳米。此时，靠近试样的成像气体原子（通常是惰性气体如氖或氦）由于隧道效应而被离化为正离子，然后沿表面法线方向飞向荧光屏，产生场离子像。试样尖端表面上的原子排列通常呈现出许多台阶，其中场强最大，成像气体电离概率也最大，从而形成亮点。对于退火后的纯金属，场离子像由形成同心圆的亮点构成，每组同心圆对应某晶面族的像。FIM的放大倍数约为100,000倍，足以分辨单个原子并观察表面原子排列。通过场蒸发逐原子层剥离的方法，可以获得材料的五维显微组织图像。然而，FIM的局限性在于其视场较小，且要求被观察对象具有足够高的密度。

原子探针是一种在FIM之后配置的设备。当在试样上施加适当的直流高压时，能够看到FIM像，但不会发生蒸发。通过添加一个宽度为的高压脉冲，可以逐个蒸发表面原子为正离子。通过测量离子的飞行时间并使用同步计时器，可以计算质荷比并确定其元素种类。原子探针能够定量分析周期表中的所有元素，测定直径为2至5纳米的微小成分，如通过连续场蒸发可得到沿试样深度方向的成分分布。然而，原子探针的局限性在于其破坏性较强，且探测区域通常只有约10纳米，并且深度不超过0.1微米。
explanation_en: Field ion microscope (FIM) and atomic probe (AP) are analytical techniques used to study the microstructure and composition of materials at the atomic scale. The main equipment of FEM includes an ultra-high vacuum chamber, a liquid helium refrigeration system for cooling samples, a regulated high-voltage power supply, an image enhancement system, and an imaging gas supply system. In FIMs, the sample is typically a very thin needle tip with a curvature radius of approximately 20 to 50 nanometers. When a positive voltage of several kilovolts is applied to the sample, the local electric field intensity at the tip of the needle can reach as high as 20 to 50 volts per nanometer. At this point, the imaging gas atoms (usually inert gases such as neon or helium) near the sample are ionized into positive ions due to tunneling effects, and then fly towards the fluorescent screen along the surface normal direction, generating field ion images. The atomic arrangement on the surface of the sample tip usually presents many steps, with the highest field strength and the highest ionization probability of the imaging gas, thus forming bright spots. For pure metal after annealing, the field ion image is composed of bright spots forming concentric circles, and each group of concentric circles corresponds to the image of a crystal face family. The magnification of the FID is approximately 100000 times, which is sufficient to distinguish individual atoms and observe the arrangement of surface atoms. Five dimensional microstructure images of materials can be obtained by field evaporation atomic layer by layer stripping method. However, the limitation of FIM is that its field of view is small and the observed object is required to have a sufficiently high density. An atomic probe is a device configured after the FID. When an appropriate DC high voltage is applied to the sample, the FID image can be seen, but evaporation does not occur. By adding a high-pressure pulse with a width of, surface atoms can be evaporated one by one into positive ions. By measuring the flight time of ions and using a synchronous timer, the mass to charge ratio can be calculated and the types of elements can be determined. Atomic probes can quantitatively analyze all elements in the periodic table and determine small components with a diameter of 2 to 5 nanometers. For example, the distribution of components along the depth direction of the sample can be obtained through continuous field evaporation. However, the limitation of atomic probes lies in their strong destructiveness, and the detection area is usually only about 10 nanometers, with a depth not exceeding 0.1 micrometers.

explanation_cn:
在直流或交流电场的作用下，通过电流和电场的激发，使无机材料发光的现象被称为电致发光，又称为电致发光。场致发光是一种将电能直接转换成光的过程。目前常见的电致发光材料有三种形态：结型、薄膜型和粉末型。许多固体材料都具有电致发光的能力，但实际应用较广的主要是半导体材料，其中包括Ⅲ-Ⅴ族、Ⅱ-Ⅵ族、Ⅳ-Ⅳ族的二元或三元化合物。Ⅲ-Ⅴ族和Ⅱ-Ⅵ族的发光材料是典型的半导体发光材料。Ⅳ-Ⅳ族化合物以硫化锌基质材料为代表，不仅可用于光致发光应用，如长余辉发光材料、阴极射线发光材料、X射线发光材料，还可用作电致发光材料。

电致发光材料分为直流和交流电致发光两大类，进一步分为粉末状直流或交流电致发光材料以及薄膜直流或交流电致发光材料。电致发光材料的主要应用是制造电致发光显示。
explanation_en: Under the action of DC or AC electric field, the phenomenon that inorganic materials luminescence light through the excitation of current and electric field is called electroluminescence, also called electroluminescence. Electroluminescent is a process that converts electric energy directly into light. At present, the common electroluminescence materials have three forms: junction type, film type and powder type. Many solid materials have the ability of electroluminescence, but semiconductor materials are widely used in practice, including binary or ternary compounds of Ⅲ - Ⅴ, Ⅱ - Ⅵ, and Ⅳ - Ⅳ groups. Luminescence materials of ⅲ - ⅴ and ⅱ - ⅵ groups are typical semiconductor luminescence materials. Group IV - IV compounds, represented by zinc sulfide matrix materials, can not only be used for photoluminescence applications, such as long afterglow luminescent material, cathode ray luminescence materials, X-ray luminescence materials, but also can be used as electroluminescence materials. Electroluminescence materials can be divided into DC and AC electroluminescent materials, and further divided into powder DC or AC electroluminescent materials and thin film DC or AC electroluminescent materials. The main application of electroluminescence materials is to manufacture electroluminescence displays.

explanation_cn: 由电场作为激发能源的发光搪瓷。以金属坯胎为一极，涂搪掺有发光体的瓷釉，表面上热喷透明氧化锡导电薄膜为另一极。发光体内固有的电子因受到两电极间强交变电场的激发和跃迁而引起发光。
explanation_en: Luminous enamel with electric field as excitation energy. The metal body is used as one pole, the enamel mixed with luminescent body is coated, and the surface is thermally sprayed with transparent tin oxide conductive film as the other pole. The intrinsic electrons in the luminescence body are excited and transited by the strong alternating electric field between the two electrodes, which causes luminescence.

explanation_en: The most common form of corrosion is that corrosion is distributed on the entire surface of materials, making it thinner as a whole. The conditions for general corrosion are: the composition and structure of materials are relatively uniform, and the corrosion medium is evenly distributed on the surface of materials.

explanation_cn: 是能使染料较缓慢地被纤维吸附，避免上染速率太快造成染色不均的现象，其次是当染色不均匀时，使深色部分染料向浅色部分移动，最后达到均染。根据均染剂的作用机理可以分为纤维亲和性均染剂和染料亲和性均染剂两类。纤维亲和性均染剂对纤维的亲和力大于染料对纤维的亲和力，其与染料对纤维发生竞染作用，均染剂优先与纤维结合，延缓了染料上染，随后，随温度升高，染料才逐渐将均染剂从纤维上置换下来，达到缓染、均染的目的。腈纶阳离子染料染色时使用的季铵盐类阳离子表面活性剂、羊毛用强酸性染料染色和锦纶用弱酸性染料染色时使用的含磺酸基的阴离子表面活性剂都属于纤维亲和性均染剂。染料亲和性均染剂对染料的亲和力大于染料对纤维的亲和力。在染料被纤维吸附之前.先与均染剂结合成某种稳定的聚合体，在高温时.这种聚合体与纤维接触产生分解作用释放出染料，再使染料与纤维结合，从而达到缓染均染作用。这种均染剂对已经上染于纤维的染料还具有拉力，可将深色部分的染料拉回到染浴再转移到浅色部分，通过转移作用而达到均染。髙级醇聚氮乙烯醚、烷基苯酚聚氧乙烯醚等非离子表面活性剂都属于染料亲和性均染剂，常用于还原染料、分散染料的染色。
explanation_en: It enables dye or dyestuffc to be slowly absorbed by fibers to avoid uneven dyeing caused by too fast dyeing rate. Secondly, when the dyeing is uneven, it makes the dark dye or dyestuffc move to the light ones, and finally achieves even dyeing. According to the action mechanism of dye leveller, it can be divided into two categories: fiber affinity dye leveller and dye or dyestuffc affinity dye leveller. Fiber affinity The affinity of dye leveller for fiber is greater than that of dye or dyestuffc for fiber, and it competes with dye or dyestuffc for fiber. dye leveller preferentially combines with fiber, delaying dye or dyestuffc uptake. Then, with the increase of temperature, dye or dyestuffc gradually displaces dye leveller from fiber to achieve the purpose of slow and uniform dyeing. Quaternary ammonium cationic surfactants used in acrylic cationic dye or dyestuffc, anionic surfactants containing sulfonic acid groups used in wool dyeing with strong acid dye or dyestuffc and nylon dyeing with weak acid dye or dyestuffc are all fiber affinity dye leveller. Affinity of dye or dyestuffc The affinity of dye leveller to dye or dyestuffc is greater than that of dye or dyestuffc to fibers. Before dye or dyestuffc are absorbed by fibers, they are first combined with dye leveller to form a stable polymer. At high temperatures, this polymer contacts with fibers to produce decomposition and release dye or dyestuffc, and then dye or dyestuffc are combined with fibers to achieve the effect of retarding and homogenizing. This dye leveller also has tension on the dye or dyestuffc that have been dyed on the fibers. It can pull the dye or dyestuffc in the dark part back to the dyeing bath and then transfer them to the light part, so as to achieve even dyeing through transfer. Non ionic surfactants such as high alcohol polyoxyethylene ether and alkyl phenol polyoxyethylene ether belong to dye or dyestuffc affinity dye leveller, which are commonly used for dyeing of vat dye or dyestuffc and disperse dye or dyestuffc.

explanation_en: In any polymerization system, after monomer is polymerization in the reaction process, the product can be dissolved in its own monomer or solvent, and the reaction system is always a phase polymerization process. In the homogeneous polymerization system, with the increase of monomer conversion, the viscosity of the material increased significantly.

explanation_cn: 仅由一种单体聚合而成的聚合物，例如聚乙烯、聚氯乙烯。此命名只表明原料单体的化学组成，而不说明聚合物的结构。例如不同的单体可合成相同结构的均聚物。而同一单体也得到不同结构的均聚物：头-尾结构和头-头结构或尾-尾结构。此外，还有异构化聚合。
explanation_en: Polymer that is polymerization by only one monomer, such as polyethylene and polyvinyl chloride. This designation only indicates the chemical composition of the monomer of the raw material, not the structure of the polymer. For example, different monomer can synthesize homopolymer with the same structure. The same monomer also has different homopolymer with different structures: head tail structure, head head structure or tail tail structure. In addition, there is isomerization polymerization.

explanation_cn: 一种分子链中仅含-CH2O-重复结构单元的线型、高密度、高结晶性聚合物。以高纯度甲醛或三聚甲醛为单体，以三氟化硼乙醚络合物为催化剂，通过本体或溶液聚合制得。
explanation_en: A linear, high density, high crystalline polymer with only - CH2O - repeating structural units in the molecular chain. It is prepared by bulk or solution polymerization with high-purity formaldehyde or trioxane as monomer and boron trifluoride ether complex as catalyst.

explanation_cn: 由均苯四酸二酐与二胺为原料制备的一类线型聚酰亚胺，其通常只能用粉末冶金方法由模塑粉压制塑料制品，或采用浸渍法或流延法制成薄膜。均苯型聚酰亚胺在空气中的长期使州温度为260°C，在无氧环境中长期使用温度高达300°C。在高温及低温下均有较高的强度和模量，特別是高温下的强度保持率高。均苯型聚酰亚胺的耐辐照性能在高分子合成材料中属于最好的一类。此外均笨型聚酰亚胺还具有优异的介电性、阻燃性和耐磨性等。均苯型聚酰业胺在电力行业主要用于电框线圈的对地绝缘、铝线和电缆绝缘；在航空和宇航方面，用于制作航空导线的绝缘材料、飞机发动机衬套等；在机械与汽车方面，被广泛用于制作垫圈、轴承、防护罩、速度传感轴、离合器衬套等；在电子行业方面，可用于挠性印制电路板。
explanation_en: A class of linear polyimide prepared from pyromellitic dianhydride and diamine can only be pressing from molding powder by powder metallurgy method, or film can be formed by impregnation or tape casting method. The long-term temperature of polypyromellitimide in the air is 260 ° C, and the long-term use temperature in the oxygen free environment is up to 300 ° C. It has high strength and modulus at both high and low temperatures, especially with a high strength retention rate at high temperatures. The radiation resistance of polypyromellitimide belongs to the best class of macromolecule synthetic materials. In addition, homophilic polyimide also has excellent dielectric properties, flame retardancy and wear resistance. Benzene polyimide is mainly used in the power industry for ground insulation of frame coils, aluminum wire and cable insulation; In aviation and aerospace, it is used to make insulating materials for aviation wires, aircraft engine liners, etc; In the fields of machinery and automobiles, it is widely used to make washers, bearings, protective covers, speed sensing shafts, clutch bushings, etc; In the electronic industry, it can be used for flexible printed circuit board.

explanation_cn: 指矿坑里用于接近工作面的地方，通常作为底板与顶棚之间的支柱（直接只用原木）。短的坑木称斜撑。坑木要求强韧、抗压和耐久，以保证坑道的安全。严禁使用脆心木。脆心木即原木中心的木材，其冲击强度很低，只有正常材的二分之一或更小，受外力时，易突然折断，断面整齐无毛刺，折断时又无一般木材折断时的警告声，所以很不安全。
explanation_en: It refers to the place used to approach the working face in the mine pit, which is usually used as the pillar between the bottom plate and the ceiling (only log is used directly). Short pit timbers are called slant support. Pit wood is required to be strong, compressive and durable to ensure the safety of the tunnel. It is strictly prohibited to use brittle wood. Crisp core wood is the wood in the center of log. Its impact strength is very low, only half or less of the normal wood. When subjected to external force, it is easy to break suddenly, the section is neat without burrs, and there is no warning sound when ordinary wood breaks, so it is very unsafe.

explanation_cn: 又称均一构造。是指岩石或矿石中各组成部分成分和结构均匀，矿物排布无一定次序、无明显方向性、不具有任何特种形象的均匀块体。是火成岩中常见的一种构造。
explanation_en: It is also called homogeneous structure. It refers to a uniform block in which the composition and structure of each component in rock or ore are uniform, and the mineral arrangement is not in a certain order, has no obvious directionality, and does not have any special image. It is a common structure in igneous rocks.

explanation_cn: 又称凹凸棒石，层状结构硅酸盐矿物。常有铁、镍等元素混入。单斜晶系。纤维状或土块状集合体。在电子显微镜下呈细柱状、针状。白色、浅绿、浅褐色。土状光泽。质松多孔。易浮于水面。裂片平坦，能弯曲，有韧性。干燥时具有吸水性，亦是岸边浅水沉积的产物。常与蒙脱石组成混合物形成黏土层。由于晶体结构中有大的通道，所以阳离子交换能力强。交换量大于沸石，吸水力强。可用作漂白剂、吸附剂、填充剂、助滤剂等。
explanation_en: Also known as attapulgite, layered silicate mineral. Iron, nickel and other elements are often mixed in. Monoclinic system. A fibrous or block like aggregate. It appears as a thin column or needle under an electron microscope. White, light green, light brown. Earthy luster. The material is loose and porous. Easy to float on the water surface. The lobes are flat, capable of bending, and have toughness. When dry, it has water absorption and is also a product of shallow water deposition on the shore. It is often mixed with montmorillonite to form clay layer. Because there are large channels in the crystal structure, the cation exchange ability is strong. The exchange capacity is greater than zeolite, and the water absorption is strong. It can be used as bleaching agent, adsorbent, filler, filter aid, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称凹凸棒石黏土。是以坡缕石为主的一种黏土，其成分一般较复杂，含海泡石、蒙脱石、高岭石、云母、石英、蛋白石、方解石等。成分单一、质地纯净者较少见。坡缕石黏土有两种成因类型，一是热液型，另一种是沉积型。矿物颗粒较细，黏土常呈白色、灰白色、灰色、灰绿色，土状。有滑腻感，易碎。坡缕石黏土湿润时有良好的可塑性和黏结性，干燥时有很好的吸附性，吸附后体积不膨胀，有较强的脱色能力和除溴性能，能除去毒素。有良好的触变性和保温性，在高温下和盐水中稳定性好，所以是一种用途广泛的重要非金属矿产原料，广泛应用于石油、化工、建筑、造纸、医药、农业等诸多方面。有工业价值的是沉积型坡缕石黏土。中国已发现的坡缕石黏土矿以江苏六合、盱眙和安徽嘉山等地的矿床规模较大，质量较好。
explanation_en: It is also called attapulgite clay. It is a kind of clay mainly composed of palygorskite. Its composition is generally complex, including sepiolite, montmorillonite, kaolinite, mica, quartze, opal, caldte, etc. Single ingredients and pure texture are relatively rare. Palygorskite clay has two genetic types, one is hydrothermal type, the other is sedimentary type. The mineral particles are fine, and clay is often white, gray, gray green, earthy. It has a slippery feeling and is fragile. Palygorskite clay has good plasticity and cohesiveness when wet, and good adsorption when dry. Its volume does not expand after adsorption. It has strong decolorization ability and bromine removal performance, and can remove toxins. It has good thixotropy and insulation properties, and good stability in high temperatures and saline water, making it an important non-metallic mineral raw material with a wide range of applications. It is widely used in various fields such as petroleum, chemical industry, construction, papermaking, medicine, agriculture, etc. Sedimentary palygorskite clay is of industrial value. Among the palygorskite clay minerals discovered in China, the deposits in Liuhe, Xuyi, Jiangsu and Jiashan, Anhui are large in scale and of good quality.

explanation_cn: 又称布里奇曼-斯托克巴杰方法。是借助在一个温度梯度内，在固-液界面上成核结晶。晶体生长时，把要结晶的材料放在一个圆柱形坩埚内，坩埚缓慢下降通过一个温度场，温度场是由炉子和发热体构成，在炉子的某一位置，其温度正好为材料的熔点，当坩埚通过此位置时，就发生结晶，随着坩埚的下降，熔点等温线缓慢地移过坩埚，固-液界面也随之从坩埚下部移到上部，使材料逐渐结晶成晶体并位于低温区，直到材料耗尽，然后晶体在炉内退火取出。
explanation_en: Also known as the Bridgman Stokebacher method. It is achieved by nucleation and crystallization at the solid-liquid interface within a temperature gradient. During crystal growth, the materials to be crystallized is placed in a cylindrical crucible, and the crucible slowly drops through a temperature field, which is composed of a furnace and a heating body. At a certain position of the furnace, the temperature is exactly the melting point of the materials. When the crucible passes through this position, crystallization occurs. With the decline of the crucible, the melting point isotherm slowly moves through the crucible, and the solid-liquid interface also moves from the lower part of the crucible to the upper part, The materials is gradually crystallized into crystal and located in the low temperature zone until the materials is exhausted, and then the crystal are taken out after annealing in the furnace.

explanation_cn: 垂直地夹持材料试样的一端?自由端暴露在点火源上.通过测定有焰燃烧和无焰燃烧的时间及燃烧状态来评定材料燃烧件能的试验方法。将受试材料按规定尺寸加工成矩形柱休试样.以一定深度央住试样的一端.使长轴处于垂直状态，距试样自由端一定距离水平放置规定尺、t的干燥脱脂棉，点燃源为规定燃烧热的可燃气体.火焰高度一定。在保证对试样施加火焰深度一定的情况下，对试样施加火焰10s，移开点火源，i己录测试的有焰燃烧时间h。火焰熄灭后.在仍保持对试样残留部分施加火焰且火焰深度一定的情况下，再次对试样施加火焰10s.移开点火源?记录试样的有焰燃烧时间O和无焰燃烧时间根据二次施加火焰后有焰燃烧时间和无焰燃烧时间以及燃烧滴落后能否引燃下面脱脂棉的情况等，评价材料的阻燃级别。本法适用于评定固体材料及表观密度不小于250kg的泡沫塑料在规定实验条件下的燃烧性能。其结果可用于评定材料的燃烧性能1也为选材提供依据.是阻燃材料要通过UL认证的必测项目。但本法对那些未点燃即收缩的材料不适用。因此不能用于评定收缩材料在实际使用条件下着火的危险性。
explanation_en: Clamp one end of the materials sample vertically? The free end is exposed to the ignition source. It is a test method to evaluate the combustion energy of materials by measuring the time and combustion state of after flame and after glow. Process the tested materials into a rectangular cylindrical sample according to the specified size. Center one end of the sample at a certain depth to make the long axis vertical. Place a specified ruler, t of dry absorbent cotton horizontally at a certain distance from the free end of the sample. The ignition source is the combustible gas with the specified combustion heat. The flame height is certain. Under the condition of ensuring a certain depth of flame applied to the sample, apply the flame to the sample for 10s, remove the ignition source, and record the after flame time h of the test. After the flame is extinguished, while still applying flame to the remaining part of the sample with a certain flame depth, apply flame to the sample again for 10 seconds. Remove the ignition source? Record the after flame time O and after glow time of the sample. Evaluate the flame retardant level of materials according to the after flame time and after glow time after the second flame application, and whether the degreasing cotton can be ignited after combustion dripping. This method is applicable to evaluating the combustion performance of solid materials and foamed plastics with apparent density not less than 250kg under specified experimental conditions. The results can be used to evaluate the combustion performance of materials and provide basis for material selection. It is a required test item for flame retardant materials to pass UL certification. However, this method is not applicable to materials that shrink without ignition. Therefore, it cannot be used to assess the fire hazard of shrinkage materials under actual service conditions.

explanation_cn: 根据时温等效原理.把不同温度下测得的黏弹性材料的松弛谱平移成参考温度下的松弛谱时.为修正材料平衡模量或柔量和密度随温度的变化，需在垂直方向即性能对数纵坐标上移动一定的量.该移动量称为垂直移动因子。
explanation_en: According to the principle of time temperature equivalence, when the relaxation spectrum of viscoelasticity materials measured at different temperatures is translated into the relaxation spectrum at reference temperature, in order to correct the change of materials equilibrium modulus or compliance and density with temperature, it is necessary to move a certain amount in the vertical direction, that is, the longitudinal coordinate of performance logarithm. This shift is called the vertical shift factor.

explanation_cn: 一种超基性侵人岩。fl乎全由橄榄石组成（90%~100%),MJ有10%以内的辉石及少量铬铁矿、磁铁矿、钛铁矿和磁黄铁矿、自然铂等。颜色呈深绿、褐绿色。全自形或他形粒状结构.致密块状构造蚀变后变为具油脂光泽的致密蛇纹岩。常与橄榄岩、辉石岩、辉长岩等形成杂岩体。可作为制备硅镁质耐火材料的原料；完全蚀变后可用于制备硅镁复合肥。
explanation_en: A type of ultrabasic intrusive rock. The fl is almost all composed of olivine (90%~100%), and MJ has less than 10% pyroxene and a small amount of chromite, magnetite, ilmenite, pyrrhothe, natural platinum, etc. The color is dark green and brownish green. Fully idiomorphic or xenomorphic granular structure, dense massive structure, after alteration, becomes dense serpentinite with oil luster. It often forms complex with peridmite, pyroxenite, gabbro, etc. It can be used as raw material for preparing silica magnesia refractory; After complete alteration, it can be used to prepare silicon magnesium composite fertilizers.

explanation_cn: 垃圾渗滤液是指垃圾自身水和外来水通过淋溶作用形成的一种高浓度有毒有害废水。垃圾渗滤液的处理包括预处理、主处理和深度处理。①预处理采用吹脱、混凝沉淀、化学沉淀等方法来去除垃圾渗滤液中的重金属离子、氨氮、色度或改善其可屯化性。吹脱法是利用空气将挥发性溶解物质脱出；混凝沉淀法利用硫酸亚铁、氯化铁等混凝剂可使COD去除率达50%;化学沉淀法中鸟粪石沉淀法应用最为广泛，即磷酸铵镁沉淀法。②主处理采用生物法、化学氧化等联合工艺去除大部分有机物。化学氧化法利用Fenton法和臭氧氧化等来处理生化件较差的中老龄垃圾渗滤液；生物法有好氧生物处理和厌氧生物处理，厌氧生物处理用厌氧生物滤池、厌氧接触池、上流式厌氧污泥及分段厌氧消化等处埋高浓度有机废水；好氧生物处理用曝气氧化池、好氧稳定塘、生物转盘和滴滤池等有效降解BOD、COD和氨氮。③深度处理有光催化氧化、吸附、膜分离等方法，光催化氧化采用的催化材料是二氧化钛、氧化锌、氧化铁等，其中二氧化钛使用最广泛；吸附法常用的吸附剂有活性炭、高岭土、焦炭、焚烧炉底灰、沸石、硅藻土、粉煤灰、蒙脱石等多孔性物质；膜分离法对垃圾渗滤液中的COD、BOD、TN均有很好的去除效果，同时也能够去除色度和盐度，出水能够达到杂用水标准。
explanation_en: Garbage leachate refers to a high concentration of toxic and harmful wastewater formed by the leaching of garbage's own water and external water. The treatment of landfill leachate includes pre-treatment, main treatment, and advanced treatment Pretreatment uses methods such as blowing off, coagulation precipitation, chemical precipitation, etc. to remove heavy metal ions, ammonia nitrogen, color or improve the tunability of landfill leachate. The blowing off method uses air to remove volatile dissolved substances; The coagulation precipitation method uses coagulant such as ferrous sulfate and ferric chloride to remove COD by 50%; Among chemical precipitation method, struvite precipitation method is the most widely used, namely magnesium ammonium phosphate precipitation method. ② The main treatment uses a combination of biological and chemical oxidation processes to remove most of the organic matter. The chemical oxidation method utilizes Fenton method and ozone oxidation to treat the leachate of middle-aged and elderly garbage with poor biochemical components; Biological methods include aerobic biological treatment and anaerobic biological treatment. Anaerobic biological treatment uses anaerobic biological filters, anaerobic contact tanks, upflow anaerobic sludge, and segmented anaerobic digestion to bury high concentration organic wastewater; Aerobic biological treatment uses aeration oxidation tank, aerobic stabilization pond, biological rotating disk and trickling filter to effectively degradation BOD, COD and ammonia nitrogen. ③ Advanced treatment includes photocatalytic oxidation, adsorption, membrane separation and other methods. The catalytic materials used for photocatalytic oxidation are titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, iron oxide, etc., of which titanium dioxide is the most widely used; The commonly used adsorbents for adsorption are activated carbon, kaolin, coke, incinerator bottom ash, zeolite, diatomite, fly ash, montmorillonite and other porous materials; The membrane separation method has good removal effects on COD, BOD, and TN in landfill leachate, while also removing color and salinity. The effluent can meet the standards for miscellaneous water use.

explanation_cn: 用有孔型的轧棍的轧机把锭坯热轧成各种断面形状的型材的工艺过程。型材断面形状多种多样.轧制过程中各部位的变形程度相差非常大。简单断面型钢如棒材多用于建筑钢筋及制造机械零件，复杂断面型钢多用于建筑结构、桥梁和各种工程用构件。轧制型钢用的原料主要有初轧坯、连铸坯和锻压坯，个別用小钢锭轧制，生产宽翼展H型钢吋则可采用异型坯。一般初轧坯的断面尺寸为50mmX150mm)（300mmX300mm)，连铸述为（50mmX50mm)（350mmX350mm)。型材轧机的布置有横列式、越野式、布棋式、串列式、半连续式和连续式等.拫据生产品种和屯产规模而选取不同的形式。复杂断面型材的孔型设计非常重要，既要保证获得合适的形状和尺寸，又要保证工件不同部位的组织与性能的均匀性。n型超导体见空穴型掺杂超导体。P型超导体见电子型掺杂超导体（。
explanation_en: The process of hot rolling ingots into sections of various cross section shapes by using a rolling mill with pass shaped rollers. The sectional shapes of profiles are various, and the deformation degree of each part during rolling varies greatly. Simple section section steel, such as bar, is mostly used for building reinforcement and manufacturing mechanical parts, while complex section section steel is mostly used for building structures, bridges and various engineering components. The raw materials used for rolling section steel mainly include blooms, continuous casting billets and forging and pressing billets. Small steel ingots are used for rolling in some cases. Profile billets can be used when producing H section steel with wide wingspan. The cross-sectional size of the general bloom is 50mmX150mm (300mmX300mm), while the continuous casting is described as (50mmX50mm) (350mmX350mm). The layout of profile rolling mill includes horizontal type, cross-country type, checkerboard type, tandem type, semi continuous type and continuous type. Different forms are selected according to production varieties and production scale. The roll pass design of complex section profile is very important, which not only ensures to obtain the appropriate shape and size, but also ensures the uniformity of the structure and performance of different parts of the workpiece. explanation_cn: 长度相对于横截面尺寸显著较大的直条钢材。简单断面有圆钢、方钢、扁钢、角钢（断面形状为直角形，包括等边和不等边）、六角钢等，复杂断面有I（也称工字钢）、H、槽钢、U、T塑钢、L、钢轨钢等。按生产方式可分为热轧、冷弯、挤压型钢、拔制和焊接等。
explanation_en: A straight steel product whose length is significantly larger than the cross-sectional dimension. Simple sections include round steel, square steel, flat steel, angle steel (the section shape is rectangular, including equal and unequal sides), six angle steel, etc. Complex sections include I (also known as I-beam), H, channel steel, U, T plastic steel, L, rail steel, etc. According to the production mode, it can be divided into hot rolling, cold bending, extrusion section steel, drawing and weld.

explanation_cn: 牙体缺损修复治疗中，用充填材料充填中等深度或深度牙齿窝洞之前，为了保护牙髓，在洞壁（轴壁和髓壁）或洞底牙本质暴露的部位衬垫的一层有一定厚度（>0.5mm)，能够隔绝温度、化学电流及机械刺激的材料，同时也具有垫平洞底，形成充填洞型，承受充填压力和咀嚼力的作用。
explanation_en: In the treatment of tooth defect repair, before filling a moderately deep or deep tooth cavity with filling materials, in order to protect the dental pulp, a certain thickness (>0.5mm) of materials is placed on the cavity wall (shaft wall and pulp wall) or the exposed part of dentin at the cavity bottom, which can insulate temperature, chemical current and mechanical irritation. At the same time, it can also level the cavity bottom, form a filling cavity, and bear the filling pressure and masticatory force.

explanation_en: It is a method to determine the force required for cutting a specified crack to expand a specified length on a thin and soft plastics sheet or film sample under specified loading conditions.

explanation_cn: 利用在焊剂层下燃烧的电弧作热源进行焊接的一种电弧焊方法。焊接电极和工件之间产生的电弧除了使电极和工件熔化形成熔池外，还使其周闱的焊剂熔化成液态熔渣。覆盖着电弧和熔化金属。除了对熔池有保护、净化作用外，还能稳定电弧，渗入合金元素，从而提高焊缝性能。由于允许采用大的电流密度?热量又集中在很小的焊接区。所以焊速快、熔深大，可用较小坡口和较少的填充材料。节省材料和电能，适合中、厚板焊接。其焊缝光洁、无电弧闪光、无飞溅、少烟尘、劳动条件明显改善。其对接头加工和装配要求高，适于平焊缝和长焊缝。有自动埋弧焊和半自动埋弧焊两类。焊接设备由电源、控制箱、焊丝送进机构、焊机；行走机构及焊剂输送器等组成。一般采用陡降外特性电源，细丝(直径2.4mm以下)焊薄板时则采用直流平特性电源。送纹方式有等速送进和变速送进两种。焊剂有熔炼焊剂和烧结焊剂之分。电极有单丝、多丝药芯焊丝和带极等多种形式。埋弧焊是适合大量生产的焊接方法，广泛用于非合金钢、低合金钢、不锈钢、耐热钢和某些有色金属(如镍基合金、钛基合，金和铜基合金)的焊接，也广泛用于表面堆焊。
explanation_en: A arc welding method using combustion arc under welding flux layer as heat source for weld. The arc generated between the weld electrode and the workpiece not only makes the electrode and the workpiece melt to form a molten pool, but also makes the welding flux around it melt to liquid slag. Covered with arc and molten metal. In addition to protecting and purifying the molten pool, it can also stabilize the arc and infiltrate alloy elements, thus improving the weld performance. Because it is allowed to use large current density? The heat is concentrated in a very small welding area. Therefore, the welding speed is fast, the penetration is large, and smaller groove and less filler materials can be used. Save materials and electric energy, suitable for weld of medium and thick plates. The welding seam is smooth, without arc flash, splashing, and less smoke and dust, and the working conditions are significantly improved. It has high requirements for joint processing and assembly, and is suitable for flat and long welds. There are automatic submerged arc welding and semi-automatic submerged arc welding. Weld equipment is supplied by power supply, control box, welding wire feeding mechanism and welding machine; Traveling mechanism and welding flux conveyor. Generally, a steep drop external characteristic power supply is used, while a DC flat characteristic power supply is used for thin wire (with a diameter of less than 2.4mm) welding of thin plates. There are two types of feeding methods: constant speed feeding and variable speed feeding. Welding flux can be divided into melting welding flux and sintering welding flux. Electrodes include single wire, multi wire flux cored welding rot and strip electrode. Submerged arc welding is a weld method suitable for mass production. It is widely used for weld of non-alloy steel, low alloy steel, stainless steel, heat resistant steel and some non-ferrous metals (such as nickel base alloy, titanium base alloy, gold and copper base alloy), as well as surface overlaying.

explanation_cn: 将一些长度较大的薄壁、中空或窄截面的橡胶压出制品(如纯胶管、密封胶条、压出嵌条等)埋在撒有滑石粉的圆盘中进行加热硫化的工艺方法。埋粉的目的是防止制品在硫化初期由于自身质量的影响而发生变形，还可利用滑石粉吸收硫化过程中生成的水，使之不与橡胶接触，以保证制品外观。
explanation_en: The process method of burying some thin wall, hollow or narrow section rubber extrusion products (such as pure rubber tubes, sealing strips, extrusion fillets, etc.) with large length in a disc sprinkled with talcum powder for heating vulcanization. The purpose of powder embedding is to prevent the products from deformation due to their own quality at the initial stage of vulcanization, and talc powder can also be used to absorb the water generated during vulcanization to prevent it from contacting with rubber, so as to ensure the appearance of products.

explanation_cn: 将增强体或功能体连接在一起形成复合材料整体，并起到传递载荷与保护增强体和功能体的作用，是复合材料的主要组分之一。基体基本上按原材料的类别区分.即聚合物基（树脂基）、金属基、陶瓷基、碳基等几大类。
explanation_en: The reinforcement or functional body is connected together to form a composite materials as a whole, and plays the role of transferring load and protecting reinforcement and functional body. It is one of the main components of composite materials. Matrix are basically classified according to the categories of raw materials, namely polymer based (resin based), metal based, ceramic based, carbon based, etc.

explanation_cn: 化学成分与高速钢高温淬火组织的基体化学成分相同的钢。凡在高速钢基体成分基础上添加少量其他元素，并适当增减碳含量以适应某些特殊用途的钢种，称为基体钢。基体钢具有与高速钢相当的高硬度和强度，又因不存在大量碳化物而具有优于高速钢的韧性和疲劳强度。
explanation_en: Steel with the same chemical composition as the matrix of high speed steel quenching at high temperature. The steel grades that add a small amount of other elements on the basis of high speed steel matrix composition and appropriately increase or decrease the carbon content to adapt to some special purposes are called matrix steel. Matrix steel has the same high hardness and strength as high speed steel, but also has better toughness and fatigue strength than high speed steel because there is no large amount of carbide.

explanation_cn: 将目的基因 (外源基因）负载于特定载体中，输送并导入到靶细 胞进行表达的系统。基因传递系统对基因治疗具有重要作用，用于基因治疗的核酸（如pDNA、siRNA 等）带负电荷，进入细胞的能力差.在生理环境中极不稳定.难以在病灶部位富集，因此临床应用的关键在于其传递体系。
explanation_en: A system that loads target genes (foreign genes) into specific vectors, transports them, and introduces them into target cells for expression. The gene delivery system plays an important role in gene therapy. Nucleic acids (such as pDNA, siRNA, etc.) used for gene therapy are negatively charged and have poor ability to enter cells. It is extremely unstable in the physiological environment and difficult to concentrate in the focus. Therefore, the key to clinical application is its delivery system.

explanation_cn: 又称DNA芯片（DNA chip)，是指固着在同相载体上的高密度的DNA微点阵。
explanation_en: Also known as DNA chip, it refers to the high density DNA microarray fixed on the in-phase carrier.

explanation_cn: 是基因导入细胞的工具。基因载体可以把目的基因送入靶细胞内，然后将目的基因释放出来，有的目的基因还可以整合到细胞核中，从而发挥目的基因的特定功能。基因载体分为病毒载体和 非病毒载体两大类。病毒载体具有较高的转染效率，但安全性问题限制了其广泛应用。非病毒基因载体具有安全性高的优点，但转染效率通常难与病毒载体相比，提高非病毒载体的转染效率是这一领域的研究热点。
explanation_en: It is a tool for gene introduction into cells. The gene vector can send the target gene into the target cell, and then release the target gene. Some target genes can also be integrated into the nucleus, so as to play the specific function of the target gene. Gene vector can be divided into two categories: viral vectors and non viral vectors. Virus vectors have high transfection efficiency, but safety issues limit their widespread application. Non viral gene vector has the advantage of high security, but its transfection efficiency is usually difficult to compare with that of viral vector. Improving the transfection efficiency of non viral vector is a research hotspot in this field.

explanation_en: The addition growth reaction of monomer is accompanied by the group closed transfer polymerization reaction.

explanation_cn: 二氧化硅含量在45%-53%的一类火成岩。主要矿物为辉石、基性斜长石，其次为橄榄石、角闪石、黑云母等。金属矿物有钛铁矿、磁铁矿。不含石英或石英含量极低。多呈深灰色，密度较大。
explanation_en: A type of igneous rock with a silicon dioxide content of 45% -53%. The main minerals are pyroxene and basic plagioclase, followed by olivine, amphibole, biotite, etc. Metal minerals include ilmenite and magnetite. No quartze or very low quartze content. Most of them are dark gray with high density.

explanation_cn: 用高分子材料负载基因或基因/载体复合物，将基因传递到特定组织的技术，又称"固相转染"（solid-phase transfection)。基质介导转染可以克服基因传递的细胞外屏障，实现基因的可控持续释放，减小毒性，从而提高基因转染效率。通常用于基因及其复合物控制释放的高分子材料为可生物降解高分子。
explanation_en: The technology of using macromolecule materials to load genes or gene/carrier complexes to transfer genes to specific tissues is also called "solid-phase transfection". Subslrate mediated delivery can overcome the extracellular barrier of gene transmission, realize the controlled and continuous release of genes, reduce toxicity, and improve the efficiency of gene transfection. The macromolecule materials commonly used to control the release of genes and their compounds is biodegradation macromolecule.

explanation_cn: 又称堆垛次序。某一晶面交替排列构成密排（或相对密排）晶体结构的次序。即可将晶体视为由某一晶面按一定序列堆垛而成的。
explanation_en: Also called stacking order. The order in which a certain crystal plane is alternately arranged to form a close packed (or relatively close packed) crystal structure. Crystal can be regarded as a crystal plane stacked in a certain sequence.

explanation_cn: 在材料或工件表面熔敷金属以得到要求的表层性能或尺寸而进行的焊接。是机械制造行业中重要的制造手段，也是一种主要的维修手段。堆焊常常起到表面强化作用，提高耐磨性、耐冲击性、耐腐蚀性、抗氧化性及抗冷热疲劳性能等，可显著提高工件的使用寿命、节省制造维修费用，提高生产率和经济效益，同时还可合理地利用材料，以获得优异的综合性能。
explanation_en: Weld performed by depositing metal on the surface of materials or workpiece to obtain the required surface properties or dimensions. It is an important manufacturing method and a major maintenance method in the mechanical manufacturing industry. Overlaying often plays a role in surface strengthening, improving wear resistance, impact resistance, corrosion resistance, oxidation resistance, cold and hot fatigue resistance, etc. It can significantly improve the service life of the workpiece, save manufacturing and maintenance costs, improve productivity and economic benefits, and can also reasonably use materials to obtain excellent comprehensive performance.

explanation_cn: 岛状结构硅酸盐矿物。单体少见，有时呈假六方形短柱状，在岩石中呈似圆形的横断面。微带蓝色或紫 蓝色.有时亦带浅黄、浅褐色。玻璃光泽.断口油脂光泽，贝壳状。性脆，莫氏硬度7-7.5，密度2. 53?2.78 g/cm3。主要产于片麻岩、结晶片岩，与 黑云母、角闪石、基性斜长石、矽线石共生。色泽鲜 艳者可作宝石。
explanation_en: Island structure silicate mineral. Monomer is rare, sometimes in the shape of pseudo hexagonal short column, and in the shape of round cross section in rock. Slightly blue or purplish blue, sometimes also with light yellow or light brown. Glass luster, fracture grease luster, shell like. Brittle, Mohs hardness 7-7.5, density 2 53? 2.78 g/cm3. It is mainly produced in gneiss and crystalline schist, coexisting with biotite, amphibole, basic plagioclase and sillimanite. Those with bright colors can be used as gems.
