explanation_cn: 常用的堵口胶材料有室温固化的环氧树脂和紫外光固化的树脂，对于大规模工业化生产来说，室温同化周期较长，而紫外固化树脂只需几秒钟的光照时间。实际使用的紫外固化胶是由多种成分组成的，其主要成分是在紫外光照下反应的不饱和聚合物（由它提供了材料的大多数所要求的特性，如硬度、化学稳定性以及柔韧性等）、反应性稀释剂和光引发剂等。紫外固态聚合物一般为环氧树脂、聚氨酯、聚乙酸内酯、聚醚等的衍生物。
explanation_en: The commonly used plugging gum materials include epoxy resin curing at room temperature and resin curing by ultraviolet light. For large-scale industrial production, the assimilation period at room temperature is long, while the ultraviolet curing resin only needs a few seconds of light. The UV curing adhesive actually used is composed of many components, and its main components are unsaturated polymer (which provides most of the required properties of materials, such as hardness, chemical stability and flexibility), reactive diluents, photo initiator, etc. UV solid polymer are generally derivatives of epoxy resin, polyurethime, polyacrylate lactone, polyether, etc.

explanation_cn: 指通过热能或机械能使热塑性塑胶软化并赋予可塑性的过程。该过程是物料在初混合基础上的再混合，是在高于树脂流动温度和较强剪切作用下进行的。塑化的目的是使物料在温度和剪切力的作用下熔融，获得剪切混合的效果，驱除其中的水分和挥发物.使各组分的分散更趋均匀，得到具有一定可塑性的均匀物料。塑化常用的设备主要是开炼机、密炼机和挤出机。对于不同的塑料品种和组成，塑化工艺的要求和作用也就不同。热塑性塑料的塑化，基本上是一个物理过程，但要严格控制塑化的条件.如控制不当，则会发生树脂降解、交联等化学变化，给成型和制品性能带来不良影响。热固性塑料的塑化主要也是一个物理过程，但塑化时树脂有一定程度的化学反应。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of bating and plasticity of thermoplastic plastics through thermal or mechanical energy. This process is the remixing of materials on the basis of initial mixing, which is carried out under the condition of higher flowing temperature of resin and stronger shearing force. The purpose of plasticization is to melt the material under the action of temperature and shear force, achieving the effect of shear mixing, removing moisture and volatile substances, and making the dispersion of each component more uniform, resulting in a uniform material with a certain degree of plasticity. The commonly used equipment for plasticization is mainly the open mixer, internal mixer, and extruder. For different types and compositions of plastics, the requirements and functions of plasticizing process are different. The plasticization of thermoplastic plastics is basically a physical process, but the plasticization conditions should be strictly controlled. If not properly controlled, chemical changes such as resin degradation and crosslinking will occur, which will have adverse effects on molding and product performance. Plasticization of thermosetting plastics is mainly a physical process, but resin has a certain degree of chemical reaction during plasticization.

explanation_cn: 又称压力加工。通过塑性变形使材料达到所需的形状和性能的过程。塑性加工与机械切削加工相比具有如下特点：无切削，材料利用率很高；在得到所需形状时，还可改善材料的组织和性能；适宜进行大规模生产，生产效率高；需要专门的设备和工具、模具。塑性加工的实际采用，必须考虑三方面的因素：材料的塑性加r性能，即材料能容许的塑性变形程度，它取决于材料本身的性质(晶体类型、晶粒尺寸、第二相尺寸与分布等）和形变条件（如温度、形变速率、应力状态等）；形变设备和必要的工模具；技术经济性。技术的塑性加工方法主要有轧制、锻压、挤压、冲压、钣金加工等。
explanation_en: Also known as pressure processing. The process of making materials reach the required shape and properties through plastic deformation. Compared with mechanical cutting, plastic forming has the following characteristics: no cutting, high utilization rate of materials; When the desired shape is obtained, the structure and properties of the materials can also be improved; Suitable for large-scale production with high production efficiency; Need specialized equipment, tools, and molds. The actual use of plastic forming must consider three factors: the plastic plus property of materials, that is, the allowable plastic deformation degree of materials, which depends on the nature of materials itself (crystal type, grain size, second phase size and distribution, etc.) and deformation conditions (such as temperature, deformation rate, stress state, etc.); Deformation equipment and necessary tools; Technical economy. The plastic forming methods of technology mainly include rolling, forging and pressing, extrusion, stamping, sheet metal processing, etc.

explanation_cn: 除去外力后不能恢复的变形，也称范性变形。它是由晶体滑移和孪生引起的。位错在滑移面内运动就导致晶体滑移，因为位错扫过的区域上下两半晶体将沿滑移方向产生相对位移，从而产生一个塑性切应变.总之，只要外力超过屈服应力而能使位错运动，就能产生塑性变形。对单晶体，分切应力大于临界分切应力r。就能产生塑性变形。对工程材料，当应力大于屈服强度时就能产生宏观塑性变形。有时，当应力略低于屈服强度时也能使局部区域的位错发生运动，从而产生微塑性变形。机械孪生时两部分晶体要转动而成镜面对称，并产生剪切塑性变形。孪生引起的变形只占总塑性变形中的一小部分，但孪生可改变部分晶体相对于拉伸轴的取向，使新的滑移系开始滑移，从而塑性变形能继续发生。高温蠕变时，通过晶界滑动以及空位扩散也能产生塑性变形。马氏体相变或第二相析出时，如内应力足够大，就能在周围诱发位错的增殖和运动，从而产生微观塑性变形。
explanation_en: Deformation that cannot be restored after removing external forces, also known as plastic deformation. It is caused by crystal slip and twinning. The movement of dislocation in the slip plane will cause the crystal to slip, because the upper and lower crystal halves of the area swept by dislocation will produce relative displacement along the slip direction, thus generating a plastic shear strain. In short, as long as the external force exceeds the yield stress and can make the dislocation move, plastic deformation can be generated. For single crystals, the shear stress is greater than the critical resolved shear stress r. Can produce plastic deformation. For engineering materials, when the stress is greater than yield strength, macro plastic deformation can occur. Sometimes, when the stress is slightly lower than the yield strength, the dislocation in the local area can also move, resulting in micro plastic deformation. During mechanical twinning, the two parts of crystal will rotate to form mirror symmetry, and shear plastic deformation will occur. The deformation caused by twinning only accounts for a small part of the total plastic deformation, but twinning can change the orientation of some crystal relative to the tensile axis, making the new slip system start to slip, so that plastic deformation can continue to occur. During high temperature creep, plastic deformation can also be generated through grain boundary slip and vacancy diffusion. When the martensitic transformation or the second phase precipitation occurs, if the internal stress is large enough, the proliferation and movement of dislocation can be induced around, resulting in microscopic plastic deformation.

explanation_cn: 在陶瓷坯体中液相含量很少时，高温下流动传质不能看成是纯牛顿型流动，而是属于塑性流动型。此时的传质规律被称为塑性流动传质机理。只有作用力超过屈服值时，流动速率才与作用的剪切应力成正比。在固态烧结中也存在塑性流动，在烧结早期表面张力较大，塑性流动可以靠位错的运动来实现。烧结后期，在低应力作用下靠空位自扩散而形成扩散蠕变，在高温下发生的蠕变是以位错的滑移或攀移来完成的。塑性流动传质机理目前已成功用于解释热压烧结的动力学过程。
explanation_en: When the liquid content in ceramics body is small, the flow and mass transfer at high temperature can not be regarded as pure Newtonian flow, but belongs to plastic flow. The mass transfer law at this time is called mass transfer by plastic flow. Only when the applied force exceeds the yield value, the flow rate is proportional to the applied shear stress. Plastic flow also exists in solid sintering, and the surface tension is large in the early stage of sintering, so plastic flow can be realized by the movement of dislocation. At the later stage of sintering, diffusion creep is formed by vacancy self-diffusion under the action of low stress, and creep at high temperature is completed by the sliding or climbing of dislocation. The mass transfer by plastic flow has been successfully used to explain the dynamic process of hot pressing sintering.

explanation_cn: 塑性炸药一般是指主体炸药、黏结剂、增塑剂等组成的，呈面团状，在-50-70°C下依旧具有塑性和柔软性，易捏成所需形状，也能装填复杂弹形的弹体，且机械感度较低.使用较安全。爆炸性能好，爆速可达8km/s以上，性质稳定，便于伪装与携带，适用范围广。主体炸药用于提供能量；黏结剂是用来保证炸药塑性及适当感度的添加剂；增塑剂用以增加高分子黏结剂的可溶性及流动性。塑性炸药制造主要有原料准备、黏结剂溶解、混合造粒、抽滤、洗涤及烘干等步骤，常用的方法有溶液水悬浮制造法、捏合法、聚合法和挥发法等。应用广泛，主要用于反坦克破甲弹及工程爆破。
explanation_en: Plastic explosive generally refers to the main explosive, adhesive, plasticizer, etc., which is in the form of dough. It still has plasticity and flexibility at -50-70 ° C, and is easy to pinch into the desired shape. It can also be used to fill complex shaped projectiles, with low mechanical sensitivity and safe use. Explosion performance is good, the explosion speed can reach more than 8km/s, the property is stable, easy to camouflage and carry, and the scope of application is wide. The main explosive is used to provide energy; Adhesive is a additive used to ensure the plasticity and proper sensitivity of explosive; Plasticizer is used to increase the solubility and flow ability of macromolecule adhesive. The manufacturing of plastic explosive mainly includes the steps of raw material preparation, adhesive dissolution, mixed granulation, suction filtration, washing and drying, and the common methods include solution water suspension manufacturing, kneading, polymerization and volatilization. Widely used, mainly for anti tank armor piercing shells and engineering blasting.

explanation_cn: 塑料是以树脂为主要成分并添加填料、增塑剂、稳定剂、润滑剂、色料等添加剂混合塑化而成的一种可塑性原材料。它在加T.完成时呈现固态形状，在制造以及加工过程中，可以借流动性和可塑性来造型。可通过压塑（模压成型）、挤塑（挤出成型）、注塑（注射成型）、吹塑（中空成型）、压延等方法加工成型。按不同的使用特性.塑料可分为通用塑料、工程塑料。根据不同的理化特性.可以把塑料分为热固性塑料和热塑性塑料两种类型。大部分塑料的抗腐蚀能力强.不与酸、碱反应。塑料制造成本低。耐用、防水、质轻。容易被_制成不同形状。是良好的绝缘体,，但是也有其缺点，比如多数塑料制品的强度较差、耐热性较差、容易燃烧.有的塑料燃烧时会产生有毒气体.多数塑料的废弃物不易腐烂分解而造成环境污染.使用过程中容易老化使性能降低等。目前.塑料已被广泛用于工业、农业、建筑、包装、国防尖端工业以及人们日常生活等各个领域。
explanation_en: Plastics is a kind of plastic raw material made of resin and additive such as filler, plasticizer, stabilizer, lubricant and pigment. It presents a solid shape when it is finished with T. In the process of manufacturing and processing, it can be molding with flow ability and plasticity. It can be processed and molded by compression molding (press molding), extrusion molding (extrusion molding), injection molding (injection molding), blow molding (hollow molding), calendering and other methods. According to different use characteristics, plastics can be divided into general purpose plastics and engineering plastics. According to different physical and chemical properties, plastics can be divided into thermosetting plastics and thermoplastic plastics. Most plastics have strong corrosion resistance and do not react with acids and alkalis. Plastics has low manufacturing cost. Durable, waterproof, and lightweight. Easily affected by_ Make different shapes. It is a good insulator, but it also has its disadvantages. For example, most plastics products have poor strength, poor heat resistance, and are easy to combustion. Some plastics will produce toxic gases when combustion. Most plastics waste is not easy to decay and decompose, resulting in environmental pollution. It is easy to aging during use, resulting in reduced performance, etc. At present, plastics has been widely used in industry, agriculture, construction, packaging, national defense cutting-edge industry and people's daily life and other fields.

explanation_cn: 由导光性良好的透明塑料芯材和折射率比芯材小0.1左右并具备某种性能要求的透明塑料鞘材组成的纤维。可见光或红外光可沿内界面折射传导.故称全反射塑。根据选材的不同.光的传导距离和耐温等级等也不同。比如以聚苯乙烯（折射率<=1.5924)为芯材、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯（n=1.495)为鞘材的光纤.开口数为〇.56,人射角68°,强度为6076?9310MPa.伸长率2.5%~5.0%.使用温度范围为-30-80°C,纤维直径0.1-3.0mm,传导距离约10m左右，只能用于光显示、玩具和装饰品等。以聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯为芯材、聚偏乙烯类（《=1.402)为鞘材的光纤，开口数为0.50,入射角60°,强度为6860?12740MPa.伸长率50%-80%,光损耗1.02-1.93dB/m,纤维直径0.1?2.5mm,传导距离数十米。其制备方法是采用芯-鞘型同心圆复合喷丝板.将两种树脂熔融纺丝，也可先熔纺出芯材纤维，再浸过鞘材树脂溶液，使其表面均匀涂覆一层鞘体。对于高纯光纤要从单体精制、本体聚合至连续熔纺和卷取，都在密封的装置中进行。还有另一种渐变指数型塑料光纤，具有聚焦性能，其制备方法有两段共聚法，即将能形成高折射率聚合物的二乙烯基单体如苯二甲酸二丙烯酯等先部分聚合成预聚体，再浸于能获得低折射率聚合物的乙烯类单体如甲基丙烯酸甲酯中进行共聚，再熔纺成纤，也可选用光共聚法、热拉伸法、7射线照射法和稀释剂膨润法制取。
explanation_en: The fiber consists of a transparent plastics core with good light conductivity and a transparent plastics sheath with a refractive index about 0.1 less than the core and certain performance requirements. Visible or infrared light can refract and conduct along the inner interface, hence it is called total reflection plastic. According to the different materials selected, the light transmission distance and temperature resistance level also vary. For example, the optical fiber with polystyrene (refractive index<=1.5924) as the core material and polymethyl methacrylate (n=1.495) as the sheath material has an opening number of 0.56, an angle of 68 ° and an intensity of 6076? 9310MPa. Elongation 2.5%~5.0%. The temperature range for use is -30-80 ° C, the fiber diameter is 0.1-3.0mm, and the transmission distance is about 10m. It can only be used for light displays, toys, and decorations. Using polymethyl methacrylate as the core material Polyvinylidene (=1.402) The optical fiber is sheathed, with opening number of 0.50, incidence angle of 60 °, and strength of 6860? 12740MPa. Elongation 50% -80%, optical loss 1.02-1.93dB/m, fiber diameter 0.1? 2.5mm, with a transmission distance of tens of meters. The preparation method is to use a core sheath type concentric circular composition spinneret to melt and spin the two resin, or melt and spin the core fiber first, and then soak it in the sheath resin solution, so that its surface is evenly coated with a sheath. The high-purity optical fiber should be refined from monomer, bulk polymerization to continuous melt spinning and coiling in sealed devices. There is another kind of gradual index plastic fiber with focusing performance. Its preparation method is two-stage copolymerization, that is, divinyl monomer that can form high refractive index polymer, such as diphenyl phthalate, is partially polymerized into prepolymer, and then dipped into vinyl monomer that can obtain low refractive index polymer, such as methyl methacrylate, for copolymerization, and then melt spun into fiber. Optical copolymerization, thermal stretching 7. It is prepared by radiation method and diluents swelling method.

explanation_cn: 是用一种透光聚合物制成的光纤。由高透明聚合物如聚苯乙烯（PS)、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯（PMMA)、聚碳酸酯（PC)作为芯层材料，PMMA、氟塑料等作为包层材料的一类光纤(光导纤维）D可以利用聚合物成熟简单的拉制工艺制成。质地柔软，坚固.直径较大（约达1mm)，接续损耗较低。制作塑料光纤主要的材料有两类：一类是聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯聚合物PMMA;另一类是含氟聚合物。塑料光纤质轻、柔软，更耐破坏（振动和弯曲），有着优异的拉伸强度、耐用性和占用空间小的特点。由于塑料光纤的大直径和数值孔径.光传导能力大。塑料光纤比铜类传输介质（双绞线和同轴电缆）有着高得多的带宽能力。塑料光纤的切割、布i线、黏结、抛光和其他加工容易，不产生辐射，完全不受电磁干扰和无线电频率干扰以及噪声的影响。塑料光纤不但可用于接人网的最后100?1000m,也可以用于各种汽车、飞机、等运载工具上，是优异的短距离数据传输介质。其缺点是不耐高温、长时间使用易老化。
explanation_en: It is a optical fiber made of a light transmitting polymer. A class of optical fiber (optical waveguide fiber) D, which uses highly transparent polymer such as polystyrene (PS), polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA), polycarbonate (PC) as core materials, and PMMA, fluoronenenebe plastics, etc. as cladding materials, can be made by mature and simple drawing processes of polymer. Soft and sturdy in texture, with a larger diameter (approximately 1mm) and low splicing loss. There are two main materials for making plastic fiber: one is polymethyl methacrylate polymer PMMA; The other is fluorinated polymer. Plastic fiber is light, soft, and more resistant to damage (vibration and bending). It has excellent tensile strength, durability and small space occupation. Due to the large diameter and numerical aperture of plastic fiber, the light transmission capacity is large. Plastic fiber has much higher bandwidth capacity than copper transmission media (twisted pair and coaxial cable). The plastic fiber is easy to cut, lay i-wires, bond, polish and other processes, does not produce radiation, and is completely free from electromagnetic interference, radio frequency interference and noise. Plastic fiber can not only be used in the last 100? 1000m can also be used on various vehicles such as cars, airplanes, etc. It is an excellent medium for short distance data transmission. Its disadvantage is that it is not resistant to high temperature and easy to aging after long time use.

name_en: die steel for plastic materials forming
explanation_cn: 适合于制作塑料制品成型生产所用模具的模具钢。根据塑料模具的工作条件和特点，塑料模具钢要求具有较高的纯净度以获得高度光泽的加工表面，具有表面耐磨耐蚀性能和一定深度的表面硬化层，具有足够高的强度和軔性以保证较长的使用寿命，同时还需要具有良好的工艺性能如较小的热处理变形以保证尺寸精度。塑料模具钢（YB/T094-1997、YB/T107-1997、YB/T129-1997)多采用结构钢与工具钢，但对其表面质量有特殊要求，故在钢号前加SM表示。塑料模具钢可分为：热塑性挤压成型的塑料模具，多采用中碳非合金钢SM45、SM50等；中小型且形状不太复杂的塑料模具，可采用T7A、T10A、9Mn2V、CrWMn等工具钢；大型塑料模具可采用高淬透性的SM4Cr5M〇SiV]钢或空淬微变形模具钢；要求高耐磨性的大型塑料模具可采用SMCrl2MolVl钢；复杂精密的塑料模具多采用渗碳型塑料模具钢如20、20Cr、SMlCrNi3等或预硬化型塑料模具钢如SM3Cr2Mo、SM3Cr2NiMo等；对于塑料成型时会析出有害气体对模具产生侵蚀作用的情况，则应采用马氏体不锈钢如SM20O13、SM30Crl7Mo等。
explanation_en: Die steel suitable for making molds for plastics products. According to the working conditions and characteristics of plastics molds, die steel for plastic materials forming is required to have a high degree of purity to obtain a high gloss machined surface, wear and corrosion resistance of the surface and a certain depth of surface hardening layer, high enough strength and toughness to ensure a long service life, and good process performance such as small heat treatment deformation to ensure dimensional accuracy. Die steel for plastic materials forming (YB/T094-1997, YB/T107-1997, YB/T129-1997) mostly uses structural steel and tool steel, but there are special requirements for its surface quality, so SM is added before steel designation. Die steel for plastic materials forming can be divided into: Thermoplastic extrusion moulding plastics molds, mostly medium carbon non-alloy steel SM45, SM50, etc; Small and medium-sized plastics molds with less complex shapes can be made of tool steel such as T7A, T10A, 9Mn2V, CrWMn, etc; Large plastics dies can be made of SM4Cr5M 〇 SiV] steel with high hardenability or air quenched micro deformation die steel; Large plastics molds requiring high wear resistance can be made of SMCrl2MolVl steel; The complex and precise plastics mould mostly adopts carburizing die steel for plastic materials forming such as 20, 20Cr, SMlCrNi3, etc. or pre hardened die steel for plastic materials forming such as SM3Cr2Mo, SM3Cr2NiMo, etc; For the situation that harmful gases will be released during plastics forming and cause erosion to the mold, martensitic stainless steel such as SM20O13, SM30Crl7Mo, etc. shall be used.

explanation_cn: 指凭借热的作用，使两个塑料部件的表面同时发生熔融，从而使它们联结在一起的过程。按所采用的加热软化方式的不同，塑料焊接方法可分为通过外加热源软化、通过机械运动方式软化和通过电磁光和声波作用软化几种。①热板焊接.一般是平面电热板将需焊接的两平面熔融软化后迅速移去电热板合并两平面并施压直至冷却；②脉冲热焊接，主要用在连接厚度较小的塑料薄膜的焊接，将两片薄膜紧压在一起，利用镍铬丝产生的瞬间热量完成焊接；③红外线焊接，这项技术类似于电热板焊接.将需要焊接的两部分固定在贴近电热板的地方但不与电热板接触；④激光焊接，将激光聚焦区中的塑料软化熔融，在随后的凝固过程中，已融化的材料形成接头，待焊接的部件即被连接起来.通常用于PMMA'PC、PVC、PA66、PS等透光性好的材料；⑤超声波焊接，指利用高频振动波传递到两个需焊接的物体表面，在加压的情况下，使两个物体表面相互摩擦发热而形成分子层之间的熔合；⑥高频焊接：在电极的髙频电场作用下，塑料分子发生振动、摩擦生热、熔融，同时在压力下熔接在一起。大量用于塑料薄膜焊接。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of melting the surface of two plastics parts at the same time by means of heat, so that they can be connected together. According to the different heating bating methods used, plastics welding methods can be divided into bating by external heat source, bating by mechanical movement and bating by electromagnetic light and sound wave. ① Hot plate weld. Generally, the plane hot plate will melt and bating the two planes to be weld, and then quickly remove the hot plate to merge the two planes and apply pressure until cooling; ② Pulse thermal weld is mainly used for weld of connecting plastics films with small thickness, pressing the two films together and completing weld by using the instantaneous heat generated by nickel chromium wire; ③ Infrared weld, which is similar to the weld of electric hot plate. Fix the two parts to be weld close to the electric hot plate but not in contact with it; ④ Laser weld: bating and melt the plastics in the laser focus area. During the subsequent solidification process, the melted materials forms a joint, and the parts to be weld are connected. It is usually used for materials with good light transmittance such as PMMA'PC, PVC, PA66, PS, etc.; ⑤ Ultrasonic weld refers to the use of high-frequency vibration waves to transmit to the surfaces of two objects to be weld. Under pressure, the surfaces of two objects rub and heat each other to form a fusion between molecular layers; ⑥ High frequency weld: under the high frequency electric field of the electrode, plastics molecules vibrate, generate heat by friction, melt, and weld together under pressure. It is widely used for plastics film weld.

explanation_cn: 当带电粒子通过时，吸收辐射后能发出光子产生闪烁光的塑料。塑料牙参见合成树脂牙

explanation_cn: 是微细的树脂粒子分散悬浮于增塑剂介质中的一种分散体系，经高温可以塑化为固态，因此可用作胶黏剂和密封胶。
explanation_en: It is a kind of dispersion system in which fine resin particles are dispersed and suspended in plasticizer medium. It can be plasticized into solid state at high temperature, so it can be used as adhesive and sealant.

explanation_cn: 通过热、氧、机械力或化学试剂的作用使生胶由强韧性的弹性状态转变为柔软的可塑性状态，这种使弹性材料增加流动性的工艺过程称为塑炼。其实质是降低橡胶的分子量，降低黏流温度》塑炼过的生胶称为塑炼胶。塑炼胶具有易与各种配合剂混合和分散的性能；其弹性降低，便于流延和压出.使胶坯（半成品）的形状和尺寸稳定：其表面光滑，可使制品花纹清晰.胶料与纤维骨架材料的黏着性提高。通过塑炼可起到"调匀"作用，使生胶的nf塑性均匀一致。塑炼时加人塑解剂来加速塑炼过程，谓之"化学塑炼"或"加塑解剂塑炼"。塑炼是在较低的温度（45?55X：)下进行的，除辊温之外，影响塑炼的因素还有辊距、转速、速比、塑炼时间、塑炼容量、滚筒工作长度、切割次数和方式、停放时间等。塑炼程度以可塑度来表示。可塑度（流动性）的测定方法分为压缩式（如威氏可速度计、德弗塑性剂和华莱士快速塑性计）、旋转式（如门尼黏度计）、花出式（如毛细管流变仪）和Brabender塑性计（双转子转矩流变仪）等。目前橡胶加工厂主要采用威氏可塑计（可塑计是从0到1的无量纲量，其值越大，表明可塑性越高，流动性越好），合成橡胶则用门尼黏度计》
explanation_en: Through the action of heat, oxygen, mechanical force or chemical reagent, crude rubber changes from a strong and tough elasticity state to a soft and plastic state. This process that increases flow ability of elasticity materials is called mastication. Its essence is to reduce the molecular weight of rubber and reduce the viscous flow temperature. The mastication crude rubber is called plasticized rubber. Plastic compound has the ability to easily mix and disperse with various additives; Its elasticity is reduced, which is convenient for tape casting and pressing. It makes the shape and size of the rubber blank (semi-finished product) stable. Its surface is smooth, which can make the pattern of the product clear. The adhesion between the rubber material and the fiber skeleton materials is improved. Mastication can play the role of "blending", so that the nf plasticity of crude rubber is uniform. Mastication is added to speed up the mastication process during plasticizing, which is called "chemical mastication" or "plasticizing mastication". Mastication is carried out at a lower temperature (45? 55X:). In addition to the roll temperature, the factors affecting mastication include roll spacing, rotational speed, speed ratio, mastication time, mastication capacity, drum working length, cutting times and methods, and parking time. Mastication is expressed as plasticity. The measurement methods of plasticity (flow ability) can be divided into compression type (such as Wechsler Velocimeter, Deval Plastimeter and Wallace Rapid Plastimeter), rotary type (such as Mooney Viscometer), flower type (such as capillary tube rheometer) and Brabender Plastimeter (dual rotor torque rheometer). At present, rubber processing plants mainly use the Wechsler plastometer (the plastometer is a dimensionless quantity from 0 to 1, and the larger the value, the higher the plasticity and the better the flow ability), while synthetic rubber uses the Mooney viscometer

explanation_cn: 又称温差电动势，塞贝克电动势。它是两种不同电导体（或半导体）的两端处于不同温度时，其两端间出现电动势的热电现象。它是德同人塞贝克在1821年发现的。塞贝克效应的实质是两种金属接触时会产生接触电势差.该电势差取决于两种金属中的电子逸出功不同及两种金属中电子浓度不同。
explanation_en: nan

explanation_cn: 是由于异质金属之间因塞贝克效应产生的电位差。当两种金属的两个接头分别处于不同温度条件下时在两个接头之间会形成电位差，即塞贝克电动势。
explanation_en: It is due to the potential difference between heterogeneous metals caused by the Seebeck effect. When two joints of two metals are at different temperatures, a potential difference will be formed between the two joints, that is, Seebeck electropotential.

explanation_cn: 以黏土和石英砂为主要原料，经球磨、喷雾造粒，压制成型、施釉、烧成等工序制成的陶质或瓷质制品。品种主要有釉面砖、抛光砖、玻化砖等。主要用作装饰建材。
explanation_en: Ceramic or porcelain products made of clay and quartz sand as main raw materials through ball milling, spray granulation, pressing molding, glaze application, firing and other processes. The main varieties are glaze tiles, polished tiles, vitrified tiles, etc. Mainly used as decorative building materials.

explanation_cn: 又称塑化剂。指加入到聚合物体系中能改善其加工性、柔韧性或膨胀性等的液体有机化合物或低熔点的固体.其主要作用是削弱聚合物分子间的次价键（即范德华力），从而增加聚合物分子链的移动性，降低聚合物分子链的结晶性.即增加了聚合物的塑性，主要表现为聚合物的硬度、模量、转化温度和脆化温度的下降，以及伸长率、挠曲性和柔韧性的提高。理想的应能在聚合物材料中均匀分散，能长期稳定地存在，并对聚合物的物理机械性能无不良影响。根据与树脂相容性的大小可分为主和辅助，主与树脂有良好的相容性，一般用量较大，能够单独使用;辅助与树脂的相容性相对较差，一般用量较少，不能单独使用，需与适当的主配合，以增加其相容性。按照的化学结构可分为苯二甲酸酯类增塑剂、脂肪族羧酸酯类、磷酸酯类、聚合物型、苯多酸酯类、含卤、磺酸衍生物类、多元醇等。主要用于聚氯乙烯（PVC),尤其软质PVC,此外在纤维素、ABS(丙浠腈-丁二烯-苯乙烯）塑料、橡胶、涂料及黏合剂中也有应用。
explanation_en: Also called plasticizer. It refers to the liquid organic compound or low melting point solid added to the polymer system to improve its processability, flexibility or expansibility. Its main role is to weaken the secondary bond (i.e. Van der Waals force) between polymer molecules, thus increasing the mobility of polymer molecular chain and reducing the crystallinity of polymer molecular chain. That is, it increases the plasticity of polymer, which is mainly manifested in the decrease of hardness, modulus, conversion temperature and embrittlement temperature of polymer, And the improvement of elongation, flexibility, and flexibility. Ideally, it should be evenly dispersed in polymer materials, can exist stably for a long time, and has no adverse effect on the physical and mechanical properties of polymer. According to the compatibility with resin, it can be divided into primary and secondary. The primary and resin have good compatibility. Generally, the dosage is large, and can be used alone; The compatibility between auxiliary and resin is relatively poor. Generally, the amount of auxiliary is small, and it cannot be used alone. It needs to cooperate with the appropriate main to increase its compatibility. According to the chemical structure, it can be divided into phthalic acid ester plasticizer, aliphatic carboxylic acid ester, phosphoric acid ester, polymer type, benzene poly acid ester, halogen containing, sulfonic acid derivatives, polyols, etc. It is mainly used in polyvinyl chloride (PVC), especially soft PVC, and also in cellulose, ABS (acrylonitrile butadiene styrene) plastics, rubber, coatings and adhesive.

explanation_cn: 是把金属粉末与一定量的有机黏结剂混合置于挤制机内，只需更换挤制机模具的机嘴与机芯，便可由挤出口在较低的温度下（40-200°C)挤压出各种形状、尺寸的坯块，适合棒状和管状等截面相同的细长制品成形。
explanation_en: It is to mix the metal powder and a certain amount of organic adhesive in the extruder. Just replace the nozzle and core of the extruder die, and then extrusion various shapes and sizes of billets from the extrusion outlet at a lower temperature (40-200 ° C). It is suitable for forming slender products with the same cross section of rod and tube.

explanation_cn: 提高两相或多相高分子共混物中界面黏结力并使相结构稳定化的作用。
explanation_en: The role of improving interfacial adhesion and stabilizing phase structure in two-phase or multiphase phase blends.

explanation_cn: 在复合材料中主要承受外力载荷作用的组分。按几何形状主要可分为零维的颗粒、一维的纤维、二维的片状和三维的编纺。而最主要的仍为纤维增强体，如碳纤维、玻璃纤维、芳纶纤维、碳化硅纤维等，其中碳纤维的密度只有1.7g/cm3.其强度却可达到35GPa、拉伸模量为200700GPa、拉伸模量为120150GPa,是典型的高性能纤维增强体。
explanation_en: The component in composite materials that mainly bears external load. According to geometric shape, it can be mainly divided into zero dimensional particles, one-dimensional fibers, two-dimensional flakes, and three-dimensional weaving. The most important is still fiber reinforcement, such as carbon fiber, glass fiber, aramid fiber, silicon carbide fiber, etc. The density of carbon fiber is only 1.7g/cm3. Its strength can reach 35GPa, tensile modulus is 200700GPa, and tensile modulus is 120150GPa. It is a typical high performance fiher reinforcement.

name_cn: 增强的透过及滞留效应
explanation_cn: 正常组织中的微血管内皮间隙致密、结构完整，纳米粒子不易透过血管壁，而肿瘤组织中血管丰富、血管壁间隙较宽、结构完整性差，淋巴回流缺失，对一定尺寸的纳米粒子具有选择性、高通透性和滞留性，这种现象称作增强的透过及滞留效应。
explanation_en: The microvascular endothelial gap in normal tissue is dense and intact, and nanoparticles are not easy to penetrate the vascular wall. However, tumor tissue is rich in blood vessels, wide in vascular wall gap, poor in structural integrity, and lack of lymphatic return. It has selectivity, high permeability and retention for nanoparticles of a certain size, which is called the enhanced permeability and retention (EPR) effect.

explanation_cn: 与树脂（聚合物）复合后能提高聚合物机械强度与制品尺寸稳定性、降低收缩率或减少热变形的纤维物质。材料包括无机纤维（如玻璃纤维、石棉纤维、碳纤维、石英纤维、陶瓷纤维等）、有机纤维（如聚乙烯纤维、聚酯纤维、聚酰胺纤维、聚丙烯腈纤维等）及金属纤维(如硼纤维、钛纤维、铝纤维等）。应用最广的为玻璃纤维及其制品。
explanation_en: Fiber material that can improve the mechanical strength of polymer and dimensional stability of products, reduce shrinkage or reduce thermal deformation after composition with resin (polymer). Materials include inorganic fiber (such as glass fiber, asbestos fiber, carbon fiber, quartze fiber, ceramics fiber, etc.), organic fiber (such as polyethylene fiber, polyester fiber, polyamide fiber, polyacrylonitrile fiber, etc.) and metal fiber (such as boron fiber, titanium fiber, aluminum fiber, etc.). The most widely used is glass fiber and its products.

explanation_cn: 涂覆在纤维表面形成很薄涂层、用以提高纤维加工性能并改善与基体黏结强度的材料。能保护纤维表面在生产及加工过程中减少毛丝及单丝断裂现象，使纤维集束，改善深加工性能。根据上浆剂使用的溶剂类型划分，可分为溶剂型上浆剂和乳液型上浆剂两类。溶液型上浆剂是将有机树脂如聚乙烯醇、醋酸乙烯酯聚合物、丙烯酸的聚合物、聚氨酯、环氧树脂等溶解在丙酮等有机溶剂中配制而成的。乳液型上浆剂是以树脂为主体，配以一定量的乳化剂、少量（或没有）交联剂以及提高界面黏合性的助剂制成的乳液。
explanation_en: Materials coated on the fiber surface to form a very thin coating, which is used to improve the processing performance of the fiber and improve the bonding strength with the matrix. It can protect the fiber surface and reduce the fracture of filaments and monofilaments in the production and processing process, make the fibers bunched and improve the deep processing performance. According to the type of solvent used for sizing agent, it can be divided into solvent sizing agent and lotion sizing agent. The solution sizing agent is prepared by dissolving organic resin such as polyvinyl alcohol, vinyl acetate polymer, acrylic acid polymer, polyurethime, epoxy resin, etc. in acetone and other organic solvents. Lotion sizing agent is a lotion made of resin as the main body, a certain amount of emulsifier, a small amount (or no) of crosslinking agent and additive to improve the interfacial adhesion.

explanation_cn: 又称光谱。是使感光乳剂的感色范围得以扩展的一类有机染料。卤化银感光乳剂本身只感蓝光和紫外线，而不能感受波长较长的绿光和红光。感光乳剂中加入后，染料可以把吸收绿光、红光，甚至产生红外线后生成的能量给予闶化银.使闶化银感色范围从蓝光区扩展至可见光和近红外区，各种增感染料由于结构上的差异，有不同的增感范围。最常用的增感染料是菁染料。根据不同的杂环种类，菁染料可分为硫菁、氧菁、砸菁等。按次甲基链长度的不同，又可分为一次甲基菁、三次甲基菁（也称碳菁）、五次甲基菁（也称二碳菁）、七次甲基菁（也称三碳菁）。另一类增感染料是份菁染料.由二次甲基份菁可合成多核菁。增感染料使用时都是将染料配成甲醇或乙醇溶液，然后加到感光乳剂中，使染料吸附在肉化银晶体的表面.即起光谱增感作用。同时应跟据乳剂感色范围要求，选择合适的增感染料。
explanation_en: Also known as spectrum. It is a kind of organic dye or dyestuffc that can expand the color sensing range of photosensitive emulsion. Silver halide photosensitive emulsions themselves only sense blue and ultraviolet light, but cannot sense longer wavelengths of green and red light. When the photosensitive emulsion is added, dye or dyestuffc can give the energy generated after absorbing green light, red light and even producing infrared light to silver halide, so that the color sensing range of silver halide is expanded from blue light to visible light and near infrared light. Due to the structural differences, various sensitizing dye have different sensitizing ranges. The most commonly used sensitizing dye are cyanine dye or dyestuffc. According to different types of heterocycles, cyanine dye or dyestuffc can be divided into thiocyanine, oxycyanine, cyclocyanine, etc. According to the length of the methylene chain, it can be further divided into primary methylcyanine, tertiary methylcyanine (also known as carbocyanine), pentamethylcyanine (also known as dicarbocyanine), and heptamethylcyanine (also known as tricarbocyanine). Another kind of sensitizing dye is merocyanine dye or dyestuffc. Polynuclear cyanines can be synthesized from methylene merocyanines. When sensitizing dye are used, dye or dyestuffc are mixed into methanol or ethanol solutions, and then added to photosensitive emulsions, so that dye or dyestuffc are adsorbed on the surface of silver flesh crystals, which plays a role in spectral sensitization. At the same time, appropriate sensitizing dye should be selected according to the requirements of emulsion color sensing range.

explanation_cn: 提高分散染料在聚酯纤维织物上染色深度所用的助剂。其作用机理可归为两个方面：①染料与形成低分子共溶物，加快染料向纤维内部扩散;②促使染料膨化，便于染料向纤维内部扩散。根据使用方法不同，增深剂大致可分两类：染色过程中使用的增深剂和染色后使用的增深剂。前者增深的原理实际上是对纤维表面进行改性处理，从而改变或改善纤维表面性质，提高纤维对涂料、染料的亲和力，使着色材料被更好地吸收、固着;另外也可通过改变染料在溶液中的溶解性能，或者轻微改变染料结构等方法，以改善染色性能。后者的增深原理是通过改变纤维表面的光学性质，从而获得表观深色效果。这类增深剂对于染色后成品的染色深度没有达到要求，或者染料用量较大的深色产品，具有很好的实用价值。常用的增深剂有尿素、硫酸羟胺、聚丙烯酰胺、多元醇磺化物，还包括某些表面活性剂如烷基酚聚氧乙烯醚（增深剂Z、HDF)等。
explanation_en: Additive used to increase the dyeing depth of disperse dye or dyestuffc on polyester fiber fabrics. Its action mechanism can be classified into two aspects: ① dye or dyestuffc form low molecular co soluble substances with dye or dyestuffc to accelerate the diffusion of dyes into the fiber; ② Promote the expansion of dye or dyestuffc and facilitate the diffusion of dye or dyestuffc into the fiber. According to the different use methods, deep dyeing promoter can be roughly divided into two categories: deep dyeing promoter used in the dyeing process and deep dyeing promoter used after dyeing. The principle of the former is actually to modify the fiber surface, so as to change or improve the fiber surface properties, improve the affinity of the fiber to coatings and dye or dyestuffc, and make the colored materials better absorbed and fixed; In addition, the dyeing performance can be improved by changing the solubility of dye or dyestuffc in solution or slightly changing the structure of dye or dyestuffc. The deepening principle of the latter is to obtain an apparent dark color effect by changing the optical properties of the fiber surface. This kind of deep dyeing promoter has a good practical value for dark products that do not meet the requirements for the dyeing depth of the finished products after dyeing, or have a large amount of dye or dyestuffc. Common deep dyeing promoter include urea, hydroxylamine sulfate, polyacrylamide, polyol sulfonate, and some surfactants such as alkylphenol polyoxyethylene ether (deep dyeing promoter Z, HDF).

explanation_cn: 又称水溶胶，是一种能使分散液或溶液黏度增加、流动性减小的物质。均为亲水性高分子化合物，它可以使物系保持均匀稳定的悬浮状态或乳浊状态，或形成凝胶。种类繁多，根据其来源可分为三类：天然高分子化合物，半合成高分子化合物，合成高分子化合物。广泛用于食品、涂料、胶黏剂、化妆品、洗涤剂、印染、橡胶、医药等领域。
explanation_en: Also known as hydrosol, it is a substance that can increase the viscosity of dispersion or solution and reduce flow ability. They are hydrophilic macromolecule compounds, which can keep the system in a uniform and stable suspension state or opaque state, or form gel. There are many kinds, and they can be divided into three categories according to their sources: natural polymer compounds, semi synthetic macromolecule compounds, and synthetic macromolecule compounds. It is widely used in food, coatings, adhesive, cosmetics, detergent, printing and dyeing, rubber, medicine and other fields.

explanation_cn: 能增加胶膜黏性和扩展胶黏剂黏性范围的物质。
explanation_en: A substance that can increase the viscosity of adhesive film and expand the viscosity range of adhesive.

explanation_cn: 聚合物溶液、胶乳及聚合物熔体沿模具壁面滑移，在壁附近形成大的速度梯度的现象。
explanation_en: The polymer solution, latex and polymer melt slip along the die wall and form a large velocity gradient near the wall.

explanation_cn: 以纸基材，经特殊加工处理，用于墙而或天花板的装饰材料。
explanation_en: Paper based materials, after special processing, are used as decorative materials for walls or ceilings.

explanation_cn: 声光效应是一种通过声波在介质中引起周期性密度变化而实现光学效应的现象。在声波通过介质时，声波的振幅会导致介质密度的周期性变化，就像一种光栅一样。当光束以适当的角度照射到这个声波引起的周期性结构上时，会产生衍射现象，这就是声光效应。声光效应主要分为两种情况：拉曼-奈斯（Raman-Nath）衍射：在声波频率较低且入射光平行于声波波阵面时，声光衍射表现为多级的拉曼-奈斯衍射。衍射光的分布会在入射光方向两侧，但光强较弱。布拉格（Bragg）衍射：在声波频率较高或入射光以适当角度（布拉格角）斜入射时，会发生布拉格衍射。此时第一级衍射光强可达到最大值，占入射光强的90%以上。衍射角度取决于声波频率，频率越高，衍射角度越大；而衍射光强则取决于声波的功率。这些声光效应可以应用于激光光学中，用于实现高效率的激光束的调制、开关、偏转、调Q和锁模等功能。声光效应在光通信、激光干涉仪、声光光纤光栅和其他光学器件中具有广泛的应用。通过控制声波的频率和强度，可以实现不同的声光效应，从而实现特定的光学任务。
explanation_en: Acousto-optic effect is a phenomenon that realizes optical effect through periodic density change caused by sound waves in the medium. When the sound wave passes through the medium, the amplitude of the sound wave will cause the periodic change of the density of the medium, just like a grating. When the beam shines on the periodic structure caused by the sound wave at an appropriate angle, the diffraction phenomenon will occur, which is the acousto-optic effect. The acousto-optic effect can be divided into two cases: Raman Nath diffraction: when the acoustic frequency is low and the incident light is parallel to the acoustic wave front, the acousto-optic diffraction shows multi-level Raman Nath diffraction. The distribution of diffracted light will be on both sides of the incident light direction, but the light intensity is weak. Bragg diffraction: When the frequency of sound waves is high or the incident light is oblique at an appropriate angle (Bragg angle), Bragg diffraction occurs. At this point, the first level diffraction light intensity can reach its maximum value, accounting for over 90% of the incident light intensity. The diffraction angle depends on the frequency of the sound wave, and the higher the frequency, the larger the diffraction angle; The diffraction intensity depends on the power of the sound wave. These acousto-optic effect can be used in laser optics to realize the modulation, switching, deflection, Q-switching, mode locking and other functions of high efficiency laser beams. Acousto-optic effect is widely used in optical communication, laser interferometer, acoustooptic optical fiber grating and other optical devices. By controlling the frequency and intensity of sound waves, different acousto-optic effect can be achieved, thus achieving specific optical tasks.

explanation_cn: 是指具有声光效应的晶体。声光效应指由超声波引起介质中形成折射率的疏密波，对人射光产生衍射，光受到折射、反射和散射的现象.特别是折射率的疏密起着衍射晶格的作用，大多指示光进行方向的变化。分为由超声波频率较低式产生的"喇曼-奈斯衍射"和超声频率较高时产生的"布喇格衍射'声光晶体除满足光学晶体的一般要求外，还需具备：优值大；声吸收系数低；声速及其对温度的变化小等特点。
explanation_en: It refers to crystal with acousto-optic effect. Acousto-optic effect refers to the phenomenon that the dense wave of refractive index is formed in the medium caused by ultrasonic waves, which diffracts the light emitted by people, and the light is refracted, reflected and scattered. In particular, the density of refractive index plays the role of diffraction lattice, mostly indicating the change of light direction. There are two types of acousto-optical crystal: Raman Ness diffraction produced at a lower ultrasonic frequency and Bragg diffraction produced at a higher ultrasonic frequency. In addition to meeting the general requirements of optical crystal, they also need to have the following characteristics: large merit value, low acoustic absorption coefficient, and small change in sound speed and temperature.

explanation_cn: 能产生强的声光互作用的玻璃。其性能要求是具有大的声光互作用品质因子，并有高的光学均匀性和低的光和声损耗。它在结构上常具有类似晶体的硅氧四面体敞形结构，以获得低的声损耗。其组分中常含有重金属离子，以获得高的声光品质因子。通常分为四类：①熔石英；②重金属离子玻璃.；③硫属化合物玻璃：④单质半导体玻璃。与声光晶体相比，声光玻璃易于制成大块均匀的材料，易通过改变组分而对器件性能进行调控，成本较低。它是最早应用的声光材料，也是很常用的声光材料。用于低于300MC调制频率的声光器件中，使器件有低的插人损耗。
explanation_en: Glass capable of producing strong acousto-optic interaction. Its performance requirement is to have a large quality factor of acousto-optic interaction, high optical uniformity, and low optical and acoustic losses. It often has an open silicon oxygen tetrahedron structure similar to crystal in structure to obtain low sound loss. Its components often contain heavy metal ions to achieve high acousto-optic quality factors. It is generally divided into four categories: ① fused quartze; ② Heavy metal ion glass; ③ Chalcogenide glass: ④ simple semiconductor glass. Compared with acousto-optical crystal, acousto-optic glass is easy to be made into large and uniform materials, and it is easy to adjust the device performance by changing the composition, so the cost is low. It is the earliest acousto-optic materials and also a very common acousto-optic materials. Used in acoustooptic devices with modulation frequencies below 300MC, resulting in low insertion loss.

explanation_cn: 燃烧时产生声效应的烟火药剂.用于制作声诱饵.对声呐进行干扰。应具有模拟舰（潜）艇辐射噪声特征和声反射特征的能力，能与舰（潜）艇的环境条件和使用条件相适应。.
explanation_en: Pyrotechnic composition that produces acoustic effect during combustion. It is used to make acoustic bait and interfere with sonar. It should have the ability to simulate the radiated noise characteristics and acoustic reflection characteristics of ships (submarines), and be able to adapt to the environmental and usage conditions of ships (submarines)

explanation_cn: 一种动态无损检测方法。材料受力作用时产生弹性变形、断裂或相变，而以弹性波形式释放出应变能的现象称为声发射。它的信号来自缺陷本身，而当裂纹等处于静止状态、没有变化或不扩展时则不能实现声发射检测。声发射技术可以用来长期连续地或间歇地监视缺陷对材料的安全性影响，所采用的表示参数主要有声发射事件和振铃计数.声发射源的定位是声发射技术中一个最主要的检测内容，它将几个压电换能器按一定的几何关系组成阵列.测定从声源发射的声波传播到各换能器的相对时差.求解后对缺陷定位。声发射仪大多采用多通道，它由换能器、前置放大器、衰减器、主放大器、门槛电路、计数器和数模转换器等组成，并配有计算机。其优点是可以动态监测缺陷的发生与发展，适用于各种材料并对其实施在线监控；缺点是需与工件耦合，需采用多探头和配备计算机进行信号处理。
explanation_en: A dynamic non-destructive testing method. Acoustic emission refers to the phenomenon that materials produce elastic deformation, fracture or phase transformation when subjected to force, and release strain energy in the form of elastic wave. Its signal comes from the defect itself, and acoustic emission detection cannot be achieved when cracks are in a stationary state, without change or expansion. Acoustic emission can be used to monitor the impact of defects on the safety of materials continuously or intermittently for a long time. The main parameters used are acoustic emission events and ringing counts. The location of acoustic emission source is one of the most important detection contents in acoustic emission. It forms an array of several piezoelectric transducers according to a certain geometric relationship. It measures the relative time difference between the acoustic waves emitted by the sound source and each transducer. After solving the problem, it locates the defects. Most acoustic emission instruments use multi-channel technology, which consists of transducers, preamplifiers, attenuators, main amplifiers, threshold circuits, counters, and analog-to-digital converters, and is equipped with a computer. Its advantage is that it can dynamically monitor the occurrence and development of defects, which is applicable to all kinds of materials and can be monitored online; The disadvantage is that it needs to be coupled with the workpiece, requiring the use of multiple probes and equipped with a computer for signal processing.

explanation_cn: 声子是晶格振动的简正模的量子。晶格具有周期性，因此晶格的振动模式具有波的形式，被称为格波。一个格波表示晶体所有原子都参与的一种振动模式。原子总是围绕着其平衡位置不断振动。这些原子通过它们之间的相互作用力相互联系。一般来说，原子之间的相互作用力可以很好地近似为弹性力，这使得振动以弹性波的形式在晶体中传播。这种振动可以理论上被认为是一系列基本的振动，即简正振动的叠加。当原子振动的振幅相对于原子间距很小时，这意味着简正振动模式之间可以近似看作是独立的。换句话说，每一种简正振动模式实际上就是一种具有特定频率、波长和一定传播方向的弹性波，整个系统就相当于一系列相互独立的谐振子构成。这些谐振子的能量将是连续的，根据量子力学，它们的能量必须是量子化的，只能取整数倍的离散值，即E_n = (n + 1/2)?ω，其中 n 为非负整数，? 为约化普朗克常数，ω 为格波的振动频率。这些能态 E_n 可以被认为是由多个能量为 ?ω 的“激发子”相加而成，而这种量子化了的弹性波的最小单位就叫声子。声子是全体原子集体的，而不是单独一个原子的运动模式的量子。声子是一种准粒子，具有空间坐标参数和动量。由于化学势为零，声子服从玻色-爱因斯坦统计，是一种玻色子。由于是准粒子，所以它不具有真正的质量，也不能从晶体中取出声子，因此不能简单地将声子等同于晶格振动中的简谐振子。声子本身并不具有物理动量，但携带有准动量，格波波矢代表声子波矢，并具有能量 ?ω（其中 ? 为约化普朗克常数，ω 为格波的振动频率）。这个能量并不归属于某一个特定的原子，而代表一种集体激发，只是这种激发具有粒子的属性。谐振子的激发态可以包含任意数量的声子，因此声子数可以相互产生和消失。声子动量的守恒定律也不同于一般的粒子，而且声子不能脱离晶体存在。声子只是格波激发的量子，被称为集体振荡的元激发或准粒子。
explanation_en: Phonon is the quantum of normal mode of lattice vibration. The lattice has periodicity, so the vibration mode of the lattice takes the form of waves, known as lattice waves. A lattice wave represents a vibrational mode in which all atoms in a crystal participate. Atoms always vibrate around their equilibrium position. These atoms are interconnected through their mutual forces. In general, the interaction force between atoms can be well approximated as an elastic force, which makes the vibration propagate in crystal in the form of elastic wave. This vibration can theoretically be considered as a series of fundamental vibrations, namely the superposition of normal vibrations. When the amplitude of atomic vibration is small relative to the atomic spacing, it means that the modes of normal vibration can be approximated as independent. In other words, each normal vibration mode is actually a elastic wave with a specific frequency, wavelength and certain propagation direction, and the whole system is equivalent to a series of mutually independent harmonic oscillators. The energy of these harmonic oscillators will be continuous. According to quantum mechanics, their energy must be quantized, and only discrete values of integer times can be taken, that is, E_ N=(n+1/2) ?ω， Where n is a non negative integer, ? Is the reduced Planck constant, ω Is the vibration frequency of the lattice wave. These energy states E_ N can be considered to be composed of multiple energies ?ω And the smallest unit of this quantized elastic wave is called phonon. Phonon is the collective of all atoms, not the quantum of the motion mode of an individual atom. Phonon is a kind of quasi particle with space coordinate parameters and momentum. Since the chemical potential is zero, the phonon obeys Bose Einstein statistics and is a boson. Because it is a quasi particle, it does not have real mass, nor can phonon be taken from the crystal, so phonon cannot be simply equated with a simple harmonic oscillator in the lattice vibration. Phonon itself does not have physical momentum, but it carries quasi momentum, lattice wave vector represents phonon wave vector, and has energy ?ω (Among them ? Is the reduced Planck constant, ω Is the vibration frequency of the lattice wave. This energy does not belong to a specific atom, but represents a collective excitation that has particle properties. The excited state of the harmonic oscillator can contain any number of phonon, so the number of phonon can generate and disappear from each other. The conservation law of phonon momentum is also different from that of ordinary particles, and phonon cannot exist without crystal. Phonon is just a lattice wave excited quantum, which is called collective oscillation elementary excitation or quasiparticle.

explanation_cn: 声子碰撺而引起的声子态的改变。声子不是真实的粒子.称为准粒子，它反映的是晶格原子集体运动状态的激发单元。它所代表的是晶体点阵的简正振动。在简谐近似下，声子间即简正模之间是没有相互作用的.晶格原子振动的各谐振子之间是线性独立的，不能交换能量。因此没有声子碰掩.声子态是定态.将不随时间变化只有在非简谐相互作用下才发生声子的碰掩。由于原子间的相互作用力并非严格的与原子的位移成正比，当晶体的势能展开式中需要考虑三次方及以上的高次项时，晶格原子的振动就不能用严格线性独立的谐振子来描述，通常把三次方及以上的高次项称为非简谐项，非简谐项的微扰作用可导致声子态之间的跃迁，这种声子态之间的跃迁称为声子-声子相互作用，或声子之间的碰撞或散射。声子间的相互作用遵循准动量守恒与能量守恒。只有当非简谐相互作用存在时，声子系统才能通过碰撞，内部交换能量而达到热平衡，此时满足爱因斯坦-玻色（Einstein-Bose)统计律。
explanation_en: The change of phonon state caused by phonon bouncing. The phonon is not a real particle. It is called a quasiparticle. It reflects the excitation unit of the collective motion state of lattice atoms. It represents the normal vibration of crystal lattice. Under the simple harmonic approximation, there is no interaction between phonon, that is, between normal modes. The harmonic oscillators of lattice atomic vibration are linearly independent and cannot exchange energy. Therefore, there is no phonon masking. The phonon state is a stationary state, and phonon masking will occur only under the anharmonic interaction. Since the interaction force between atoms is not strictly proportional to the displacement of atoms, when the cubic and higher terms need to be considered in the potential energy expansion of crystal, the vibration of lattice atoms cannot be described by strictly linear independent harmonic oscillators. Generally, the cubic and higher terms are called anharmonic terms, and the perturbation of anharmonic terms can lead to transitions between phonon states, This transition between phonon states is called phonon phonon interaction, or collision or scattering between phonon. The interaction between phonon follows the conservation of quasi momentum and energy. Only when the anharmonic interaction exists, the phonon system can reach thermal equilibrium through collision and internal exchange of energy, which satisfies Einstein Bose statistical law.

explanation_cn: 又称晶格振动谱。晶格振动谱或声子谱一般通过光子、X射线与中子的非弹性散射实验来测定，其中最常用的方法是中子的非弹性散射。这些方法都是采用外来粒子与晶格发生非弹性碰撞，即粒子与声子碰撞。
explanation_en: It is also called lattice vibration spectrum. The lattice vibration spectrum or phonon spectrum is generally measured by the non elasticity scattering experiment of photons, X-rays and neutrons, and the most commonly used method is the non elasticity scattering of neutrons. These methods all adopt the non elasticity collision between foreign particles and lattice, that is, the collision between particles and phonon.

explanation_cn: 一种检测材料声学参数的相关技术。它利用聚焦超声束对样品（包括薄膜）表面、内部进行检测.得到声学参数。所用设备是超声显微镜.它由超声探头、检测电路、机械装贾及计算机软硬件等组成。检测时.超声波传人样品.样品内结构不同的材料其声速、声阻抗、声衰减不同.声波通过样品后产生不同的反射、相移和衰减,，通过检测散射声波幅度、相位、分布.可得到样品内部结构参数阁像其分辨率接近样品内声波波长。
explanation_en: A related technique for detecting acoustic parameters of materials. It uses a focused ultrasound beam to detect the surface and interior of samples (including thin films) and obtain acoustic parameters. The equipment used is an ultrasound microscope. It consists of an ultrasound probe, detection circuit, mechanical equipment, and computer software and hardware. During detection, ultrasonic waves are transmitted to samples. materials with different structures in the samples have different sound velocities, acoustic impedances, and acoustic attenuation. The sound waves pass through the samples and generate different reflections, phase shifts, and attenuation. By detecting the amplitude, phase, and distribution of the scattered sound waves, it can be obtained that the resolution of the internal structure parameters of the samples is close to the wavelength of the acoustic waves in the samples.

explanation_cn: 声表面波（Surface Acoustic Wave，SAW）是一种机械波，是一种通过固体表面传播的超声波。SAW是一种弹性波，其振动是通过固体表面传播的，而不是通过物质内部传播，因此具有独特的特性和应用。SAW的产生和传播通常依赖于利用压电效应。具体而言，当电压施加到压电晶体上时，会产生机械应力，导致晶体表面的微小位移。这些微小位移在晶体表面传播，形成声表面波
explanation_en: Surface acoustic wave (SAW) is a mechanical wave, which is an ultrasonic wave propagating through the solid surface. SAW is a kind of elastic wave, whose vibration is transmitted through the surface of a solid rather than through the interior of a material, so it has unique characteristics and applications. The generation and propagation of SAW typically rely on the use of piezoelectric effects. Specifically, when the voltage is applied to the piezoelectric crystal, mechanical stress will be generated, resulting in small displacement of the crystal surface. These small displacements propagate on the surface of crystal and form surface acoustic wave

name_en: elastic modulus by sonic velocity method
explanation_cn: 根据声波在材料内的传播速度和材料密度计算的弹性模量。测试方法包括声脉冲传播法和超声脉冲法。利用脉冲发生器发出的电脉冲，使紧贴试样的一个超声探头发出超声脉冲，同时触发示波器扫描信号。
explanation_en: The elastic modulus calculated according to the propagation speed of sound wave in materials and the density of materials. The testing methods include acoustic pulse propagation method and ultrasonic pulse method. Utilize the electrical pulse emitted by the pulse generator to produce an ultrasonic pulse from an ultrasonic probe closely attached to the sample, while triggering the oscilloscope to scan the signal.

explanation_cn: 媒质中一点的声压和质点速度的比值。这个比值一般为复数，其实部称为声阻率（specificacousticresistance)，其虚部称为声抗率（specificacousticreactance)。在平面行波的波场中，声阻抗率为实数，它等于传播媒质的密度和声传播速度的乘积，也称为媒质的特性声阻(characteristicacousticresistance)。
explanation_en: The ratio of sound pressure to particle velocity at a point in the medium. This ratio is usually a complex number, and its actual part is called specific acoustic resistance, while its imaginary part is called specific acoustic resistance. In the wave field of plane traveling waves, the specific acoustic impedance is a real number, which is equal to the product of the density of the propagation medium and the acoustic propagation velocity, also known as the characteristic acoustic resistance of the medium.

explanation_cn: 声隐身材料（Acoustic Stealth Materials）是一类设计用于减少声波反射和散射，从而使物体在声波检测中更难被探测到的材料。声隐身技术的目标是减少声波的反射或散射，以使物体在声纳、声波探测或声音传播中减小其声学特征。这类材料和技术通常用于军事、海洋、水下、航空和工业领域。
explanation_en: Acoustic stealth material are a kind of materials designed to reduce the reflection and scattering of sound waves, so that objects are more difficult to detect in acoustic detection. The goal of acoustic stealth technology is to reduce the reflection or scattering of sound waves, in order to reduce the acoustic characteristics of objects in sonar, sound detection, or sound propagation. Such materials and technologies are usually used in military, marine, underwater, aviation and industrial fields.

explanation_cn: 反映电介质在交变电场作用下，电位移或极化强度P比电场强度E滞后δ相角时的介电常数。
explanation_en: It reflects that under the action of alternating electric field, the electric displacement or polarization P of dielectric lags behind the electric field E δ Dielectric constant at phase angle.

explanation_cn: 指用印模材料翻制阳模时的仿真性能。取阴模后用与其匹配的模型材料翻制阳模，以阳模上所显示出的实物上最细线的宽度评价其复制再现性。
explanation_en: It refers to the simulation performance when the impression materials is used to reproduce the male mold. After the female mold is taken, the male mold is reproduced with the matching model materials, and its dental duplicating characteristics is evaluated by the width of the thinnest line on the physical object displayed on the male mold.

explanation_cn: 一种未经涂布，用于静电复印机、喷墨打印机，以及其他类型复印和打印设备的纸。
explanation_en: A type of uncoated paper used in electrostatic copiers, inkjet printers, and other types of copying and printing equipment.

explanation_cn: 复印机中将色调剂转移到复印纸上的磁性颗粒。载体磁粉通过带电摩擦吸附色调剂（有机色粉）输送到感光鼓表面，使潜像显影，从而完成复印过程。复印载体最初用玻璃粉，后改用球形金属铁粉，现多用球形铁氧体粉末。
explanation_en: Magnetic particles that transfer toner to the copy paper in a copier. The carrier magnetic powder is transported to the surface of the photosensitive drum through charged friction adsorption color toner (organic color powder) to develop latent images, thus completing the copying process. The copy carrier was originally made of glass powder, then spherical metal iron powder, and now spherical ferrite powder is mostly used.

explanation_cn: 粉末压制和烧结后再进行一次压制的过程，用以提高制品的密度和力学性能。在实际生产中，复压进行第二次烧结，即两次压制-烧结工艺。
explanation_en: The process of powder pressing and sintering followed by another pressing is used to improve the density and mechanical properties of products. In actual production, the second sintering is carried out by repressing, that is, the two pressing sintering process.

explanation_cn: 将两种或两种以上不同性质的材料，通过物理或化学的方法,在宏观上组成具有新性能的材料即是复合材料。各种材料在性能上互相取长补短，产生协同效应，使复合材料的综合性能优于原组成材料而满足各种不同的使用要求。
explanation_en: Two or more materials with different properties can be used to form a new materials with new properties through physical or chemical methods, which is called composite materials. Various materials learn from each other in terms of performance and produce synergistic effect, which makes the comprehensive performance of composite materials better than that of the original materials to meet various use requirements.

explanation_cn: 是根据各种催化材料活性组分的特性，有选择地把两种或两种以上的活性组分组合起来而形成的催化材料。复合型催化材料可使催化材料活性组分有更高的分散度和更合适的粒度，具有元素种类可调、分散程度可调的结构性质，可出现一些不常见或混合价态的活性离子，并且复合材料存在着相互作用，进而表现出更高的催化活性和更好的稳定性。
explanation_en: It is a catalytic materials formed by selectively combining two or more active components according to the characteristics of active components of various catalytic materials. Compound catalytic materials can make the active components of the catalytic materials have higher dispersivity and more appropriate particle size, and have structural properties of adjustable element types and dispersions. Some unusual or mixed valence active ions can appear, and composite materials have interactions, thus showing higher catalytic activity and better stability.

explanation_cn: 又称复合火药，是固体推进剂中一个重要的类别。由高分子黏合剂、固体氧化剂（一般为高氯酸铵）、轻金属燃料(一般为铝粉）和其他功能助剂组成。
explanation_en: Also known as composite gunpowder, it is an important category of solid propellant. It is composed of macromolecule adhesive, solid oxidizer (generally ammonium perchlorate), light metal fuel (generally aluminium powder) and other functional additive.

explanation_cn: 又称改性双基推进剂，是在双基推进剂的基础上发展起来的一类高能同体推进剂，主要成分有硝化纤维素、硝化甘油、铝粉、高氯酸氨和高能硝铵炸药（如HMX或RDX)及安定剂和燃烧催化剂等，其标准实测比冲可达2472N·s/kg,密度1.75-1.80g/cm3,燃烧速度10-20mm/s，燃速压力指数0.45-0.48,由于黏合剂由消化纤维素和硝酸酯组成，其低温伸长率较小，-40℃时仅为6%左右。可以采用螺压工艺或淤浆浇铸工艺成型。主要用于各种火箭、导弹武器的固体发动机装药。
explanation_en: Also called modified double base propellant, it is a kind of high-energy homogeneous propellant developed on the basis of double base propellant. Its main components include nitrocellulose, nitroglycerin, aluminium powder, ammonia perchlorate, high-energy ammonium nitrate explosive (such as HMX or RDX), stabilizer and combustion catalysts. Its standard measured specific impulse can reach 2472N · s/kg, density 1.75-1.80g/cm3, combustion speed 10-20mm/s, burning rate pressure index 0.45-0.48, As adhesive is composed of digestible cellulose and nitrate, its elongation at low temperature is small, only about 6% at -40 ℃. It can be formed by screw pressing process or slurry casting process. Mainly used for solid motor charging of various rocket and missile weapons.

explanation_cn: 由两种或两种以上不同化学性质的组分,通过物理或化学的方法,在宏观上组成多相且各相之间具有明显界面和新性能的一种固体材料。复合材料应具有以下特点：①复合材料组元之间存在着明显的界面；②复合材料有单一材料组元所不具备的优良特殊性能；③复合材料具有可设计性。它既能保留原组成材料的特色，还可以通过复合和材料设计使各组分的性能互补并彼此关联，获得原组分所不具备的性能，且与一般材料的简单混合备本质的区别。
explanation_en: A kind of solid materials consisting of two or more components with different chemical properties, through physical or chemical methods, to form a multi phase macroscopically, and each phase has an obvious interface and new properties. Composite materials should have the following characteristics: ① there is an obvious interface between composite material components; ② Composite materials has excellent special properties that are not possessed by a single materials component; ③ Composite materials are designable. It can not only retain the characteristics of the original materials, but also make the performance of each component complementary and related to each other through composition and materials design to obtain the performance that the original component does not have, and it is essentially different from the simple mixed preparation of ordinary materials.

explanation_cn: 层合结构复合材料内部存在的一种缺陷，即层与层之间出现较大面积的脱胶或开裂，形成一种空洞状态，是由于层间应力或制造缺陷引起的基体本身或界面破坏，并最终导致层与层之间分离的现象。
explanation_en: A defect existing in the interior of the laminated structure composite materials, that is, a large area of debonding or cracking occurs between layers, forming a void state. It is a phenomenon that the matrix itself or interface is damaged due to interlaminar stress or manufacturing defects, and eventually leads to the separation between layers.

explanation_cn: 指基体与增强相之间物理结构或化学成分有显著变化且能够在增强体与基体之间传递载荷的微小区域，一般是具有一定尺度的多层结构过渡域，是复合材料区分于其他单相材料的重要特征之一。
explanation_en: It refers to the tiny area where the physical structure or chemical composition between the matrix and the reinforcement phase has significant changes and can transfer load between the reinforcement and the matrix. Generally, it is a multi-layer structure transition area with a certain scale, which is one of the important characteristics of composite materials that distinguish it from other single-phase materials.

explanation_cn: 见复合材料组分。
explanation_en: See componoit of composite.

explanation_cn: 又称复合材料组元。指组成复合材料的原材料。对于结构复合材料，主要是增强体和基体。针对各种不同基体的复合材料还有一些辅助组分，可根据需要选用。
explanation_en: It is also called composite material components. It refers to the raw materials that make up composite materials. For structural composite materials, mainly reinforcement and matrix. There are also some auxiliary components for composite materials with different matrix, which can be selected according to needs.

explanation_cn: 是一种在治疗牙齿龋坏时，充填于牙齿窝洞以恢复牙齿解剖形态的高分子材料。复合树脂充填材料的主要成分为基础单体、无机填料、活性稀释剂、聚合反应引发剂和促进剂及稳定剂等。
explanation_en: It is a macromolecule materials that is filled in the tooth cavity to restore the tooth anatomy when treating tooth caries. The main components of dental resin filling materials are basic monomer, inorganic filler, active diluents, initiator and promoter of polymerization reaction, stabilizer, etc.

explanation_cn: 是将具有永磁特性的粉体与有机材料混合，通过模压或注射成型具有可塑性的黏结永磁材料。由于填充了体积分数为10%-15%的非磁性物质，复合永磁材料的磁性能要比烧结体低一些。复合永磁材料主要有两大类：复合钡和緦铁氧体；复合稀土永磁材料。
explanation_en: It is a plastic bonded permanent magnet material by mixing the powder with permanent magnetic properties with organic materials and molding or injection molding. The magnetic properties of composite permanent-magnetic material are lower than that of sintered body due to the filling of non-magnetic material with volume fraction of 10% -15%. There are two main types of composite permanent-magnetic material: composition barium and electric ferrite; Composition the rare earth permanent magnetic material.

explanation_cn: 联合应用多种表面加工技术由两种或两种以上不同材料所组成的涂层，以提高涂层的附着力以及涂层对基体的防护能力，最终得到的涂层为复合涂层。如多层氧化物和氮化物复合涂层。复合涂层具有多种涂层的不同性质，提高硬度，提高耐磨性，提高加工精度，提高使用寿命。
explanation_en: A coating composed of two or more different materials is jointly applied with a variety of surface processing technologies to improve the adhesion of the coating and the protective ability of the coating to the matrix. The final coating is a composite coating. Such as multilayer oxide and nitride composite coating. The composite coating has different properties of various coatings to improve hardness, wear resistance, machining accuracy and service life.

explanation_cn: 简称复合水泥，由硅酸盐水泥熟料、两种或两种以上规定的混合材料、适量石膏磨细制成的水硬胶凝性材料。水泥中混合材料总掺加量（按质量分数计）应大于20%,且不超过50%。
explanation_en: Referred to as composition cement, it is a hydraulic cementing materials made of Portland cement clinker, two or more specified mixed materials, and an appropriate amount of gypsum. The total amount of mixed materials in cement (calculated by mass fraction) shall be more than 20% and not more than 50%.

explanation_cn: 有机钙锌与亚磷酸酯的复合物。本品可作为聚氯乙烯的无毒热稳定剂，热和光稳定效能高，耐候性、透明性好。主要用于制作软质聚氯乙烯食品包装材料，与食物或饮料接触的容器、管材、运输带等。
explanation_en: Organic calcium zinc and phosphite ester complexes. This product can be used as a non-toxic heat stabilizer for polyvinyl chloride, with high heat and light stability, good weather resistance and transparency. It is mainly used to make soft polyvinyl chloride food packaging materials, containers, tube, transport belts, etc. in contact with food or drinks.

explanation_cn: 由两种或多种不同材料制成的两层或多层的管材。复合管的截面多为不同材料的同心圆环。从复合的材料来看，有不同钢种复合、钢与有色金属复合、钢与塑料复合等，如非合金钢-不锈钢、钢-铜、钢-钛、钢-塑料复合管等，广泛应用于化学工业、核工业、海洋工程等。
explanation_en: Two or more layers of tube made of two or more different materials. The cross section of clad pipe is mostly concentric rings made of different materials. From the perspective of composition materials, there are different steel composition, steel and non-ferrous metal composition, steel and plastics composition, such as non-alloy steel stainless steel, steel copper, steel titanium, steel plastics clad pipe, etc., which are widely used in chemical industry, nuclear industry, marine engineering, etc.

explanation_cn: 纤维截面含有两种或两种以上不相混合的聚合物纤维。复合纤维要用特殊结构的复合纺丝机，用湿法或熔体法进行复合纺丝。使两种不同的聚合物或不同分子量的同种聚合物（也可以是不同组成和配比的聚合物溶液或熔体）形成两股细流，在贴近喷丝孔入口处汇合，从同一喷丝孔中挤出凝固成复合纤维。
explanation_en: The cross section of the fiber contains two or more polymer fibers that are not phase mixed. The composite fiber shall be spun with a special composition spinning machine by wet process or melt method. Two different polymer or the same polymer with different molecular weights (or polymer solutions or melts with different compositions and ratios) are formed into two streams, which converge close to the inlet of the spinneret hole and extrude and solidify from the same spinneret hole to form composite fibers.

explanation_cn: 应用物理气相淀积（PVD)和化学气相淀积(CVD)技术制备的延期药。它以延期药的一种组分作为基板，采用溅射、沉积等物理或化学的方法，在其表面覆盖一层厚度很小（微米、亚微米级）的另一组分材质的致密均匀的薄膜，同样可以再覆盖一层另一种组分的薄膜。
explanation_en: The delay composition was prepared by physical vapor deposition (PVD) and chemical vapor deposition (CVD). It takes one component of delay composition as the substrate, and uses physical or chemical methods such as sputtering and deposition to cover its surface with a layer of dense and uniform film of another component material with very small thickness (micron, submicron), which can also cover another layer of thin film of another component.

explanation_cn: 又称复层钢板，在普通非合金钢板的一面或两面覆以不同的金属板（如不锈钢板、高速钢板、铜板、镍板、钛板等）、陶瓷材料或有机材料（如泡沫塑料、黏弹性树脂等），通过一定的生产工艺方法使其结合成一体的钢板。
explanation_en: Also known as clad sheet steel, ordinary non alloy steel plate is covered on one or both sides with different metal plates (such as stainless steel plate, high-speed steel plate, copper plate, nickel plate, titanium plate, etc.), ceramics materials or organic materials (such as foamed plastics, viscoelastic resin, etc.), which are combined into one steel plate through a certain production process.

explanation_cn: 两种或多种材料通过铸造使之生产冶金结合的方法。可以在同一铸件采用几种不同的材料，使铸件具有良好的实际使用性能，并可节约贵重合金材料。
explanation_en: A method of metallurgical combination of two or more materials through foundry. Several different materials can be used in the same casting, so that the casting has good practical performance and can save valuable alloy materials.

explanation_cn: 复盐(合）起爆药是一类很有发展前途的起爆药。可以分为两类：一类是共同结晶工艺，是将两种以上单质药的阴离子或阳离子与共同的金属离子或阴离子在一定的条件下反应，共同生成结晶化合物；另一种是混合结晶工艺，是将一种单质药作为"晶核"预先加入另一单质药的反应体系中，生成包结化合物。
explanation_en: Double salt primary explosive is a kind of promising primary explosive. It can be divided into two categories: one is the co crystallization process, which involves the reaction of two or more anions or cations of single substance drugs with common metal ions or anions under certain conditions to jointly generate crystalline compounds; Another type is the mixed crystallization process, which involves pre adding a single substance as a "crystal nucleus" to the reaction system of another substance to generate an inclusion compound.

explanation_cn: 利用复鞣剂对主鞣后在制品进行的处理。以弥补主鞣剂在某些性能方面的不足，如提高丰满性能，改善粒面紧实性能和减少部位差别等。
explanation_en: Treatment of products in process after main tanning with retanning agent. In order to make up for the shortcomings of the main tanning agent in some aspects of performance, such as improving fullness, improving grain surface compactness and reducing position differences.

explanation_cn: 用于涂刷建筑物外立墙面的涂料。最重要的一项指标就是抗紫外线照射，要求达到长时间照射不变色，且具有抗水性，自涤性。的种类很多，可以分为强力抗酸碱外墙涂料、有机硅自洁抗水、钢化防水腻子粉、i纯丙烯酸弹性、有机硅自洁弹性、i高级丙烯酸、氟碳涂料、瓷砖专用底漆、瓷砖面漆、高耐候憎水面漆、环保外墙乳胶漆、丙烯酸油性面漆、外墙油霸、金属漆、内外墙多功能涂料等。外墙面用溶剂型涂料主要是聚氨酯涂料和丙烯酸涂料》复层浮雕花纹外墙涂料以溶剂型环氧树脂涂料为基材打底漆，乳胶型丙烯酸涂料为中间涂层，双组分脂肪族聚氨酯丙烯酸磁漆为面漆，用脂肪族聚氨酯丙烯酸清漆罩光，有立体感，耐候性可达20年以上。
explanation_en: It is used to paint coatings on the external wall of buildings. The most important indicator is resistance to ultraviolet radiation, which requires long-term exposure without discoloration, as well as water resistance and self washing ability. There are many kinds of paint, which can be divided into strong acid and alkali resistant exterior coating, organic silicon self-cleaning and water resistant, tempered waterproof patty powder, i pure acrylic acid elasticity, organic silicon self-cleaning elasticity, i advanced acrylic acid, fluorocarbon coatings, special primer for ceramic tiles, ceramic tile top coating, high weather resistant and hydrophobic water surface paint, environmental friendly exterior wall latex paint, acrylic oily top coating, exterior wall oil, metal paint, interior and exterior wall multi-functional coatings, etc. The solvent based coatings for exterior walls are mainly polyurethane resin coatings and acrylic coatings. The multi-layer relief pattern exterior coating use solvent based epoxy resin coatings as the base material to prime, latex based acrylic coatings as the intermediate coating, two-component aliphatic polyurethime acrylic enamel as the top coating, and aliphatic polyurethime acrylic varnish as the finish. It has a three-dimensional sense and weather resistance of more than 20 years.

explanation_cn: 通过物理混合方法向高分子中外加高沸点、低挥发液体或低熔点同体物质的增塑剂，使高分子链距离增大、链间相互作用力降低、树脂具有可塑性的作用。与树脂有一定相容性的增塑剂为主增塑剂，如聚氯乙烯中使用的邻苯二甲酸二辛酯等。一些虽与树脂不相容或相容性很差但与主增塑剂并用时方可发挥作用的增塑剂称为副增塑剂.如氯化石蜡等。为降低产品价格而使用的稀释剂或增量剂也可称为副增塑剂。外增塑使用方便、应用范围广，但增塑剂因易迁移和挥发而损失。
explanation_en: Add plasticizer with high boiling point, low volatile liquid or low melting point homologous substance to the macromolecule through physical mixing method, so that the chain distance of macromolecule increases, the interaction force between chains decreases, and resin has the effect of plasticity. Plasticizer with certain compatibility with resin is the main plasticizer, such as dioctyl phthalate used in polyvinyl chloride. Some plasticizer that are incompatible with resin or have poor compatibility but can only function when used together with primary plasticizer are called secondary plasticizer, such as chlorinated paraffin. The diluents or increment agent used to reduce the product price can also be called a side plasticizer. External plasticizing is easy to use and has a wide range of applications, but plasticizer is lost due to easy migration and volatilization.

explanation_cn: 在单晶衬底上沿其晶向连续生长具有特定参数的单晶薄层的方法。根据衬底材料与外延材料的化学组成可分为：真同质外延、赝同质外延、真异质外延与赝异质外延。真同质外延是指衬底与外延层的化学组成，包括掺杂剂与浓度都完全相同的，所得材料几乎没有应用价值。赝同质外延是指衬底与外延层的主化学成分相同，但其掺杂剂或掺杂浓度不同，它简称为同质外延。真异质外延是指衬底与外延层的化学组成完全不同，而赝异质外延是指衬底与外延层的化学组成中有一个或部分组元相同，这两种都称异质外延。的方法有：化学气相外延、液相外延、固相外延、分子束外延、离子束（团）外延、化学分子束外延等。工业生产中主要使用化学气相外延、液相外延;在高精密超薄外延方面则使用分子束外延或金属有机物化学气相外延。可改善单晶的质量，形成各种化合物，制备难以用体单晶生长法制备的单晶和固溶体、多层、超薄层材料等。
explanation_en: A method for continuously growing a thin layer of single crystal with specific parameters along its crystal direction on a single crystal substrate. According to the chemical composition of backing materials and epitaxial materials, it can be divided into: true homoepitaxy, pseudo homoepitaxy, true heteroepitaxy and pseudo heteroepitaxy. True homoepitaxy refers to the chemical composition of the substrate and the epitaxial layer, including the dopant and concentration are identical, and the obtained materials have little application value. Pseudohomoepitaxy refers to the phenomenon where the main chemical components of the substrate and epitaxial layer are the same, but their dopants or doping concentrations are different. It is abbreviated as homoepitaxy. True heteroepitaxy refers to the chemical composition of the substrate and epitaxial layer being completely different, while pseudo heteroepitaxy refers to the chemical composition of the substrate and epitaxial layer having one or some of the same components, both of which are called heteroepitaxy. The methods include chemical vapor phase epitaxy, liquid phase epitaxy, solid phase epitaxy, molecular beam epitaxy, ion beam (cluster) epitaxy, chemical molecular beam epitaxy, etc. Chemical vapor epitaxy and liquid phase epitaxy are mainly used in industrial production; For high-precision ultra-thin epitaxy, molecular beam epitaxy or metal organic chemical vapor phase epitaxy is used. It can improve the quality of single crystal, form various compounds, and prepare single crystal and solid solution, multi-layer and ultra-thin materials that are difficult to be prepared by bulk single crystal growth method.

explanation_cn: 在制备好的单晶衬底上，一定的条件下，沿其原来晶体的结晶轴方向，生长一层导电类型、电阻率、厚度都符合要求的单晶层薄膜。
explanation_en: On the prepared single crystal substrate, under certain conditions, along the direction of the original crystal axis, a layer of single crystal thin films with conductive type, resistivity and thickness meeting the requirements are grown.

explanation_cn: 专用于外科手术术后缝合伤口用的纤维材料。按纤维的来源分，有天然纤维与合成纤维两类;按纤维的性能分，有可被受体组织吸收的纤维和不可吸收的纤维两类。作为外科手术缝合线，其基本性能要求为：能经受必要的消毒、灭菌处理，具有适当的强度和弹性，对受体组织无副作用。
explanation_en: Fiber materials specially used to suture wounds after surgery. According to the source of fiber, there are two types: natural fiber and synthetic fiber; According to the properties of fibers, there are two types: fibers that can be absorbed by the recipient tissue and fibers that cannot be absorbed. As a surgical suture, its basic performance requirements are: it can withstand necessary disinfection and sterilization treatment, has appropriate strength and elasticity, and has no side effects on receptor tissue.

explanation_cn: 发生在电堆外部的重整。重整反应产生的富氢气体混合物可以被储存起来，或者直接通过管道输送人电堆的阳极进行反应。
explanation_en: Reforming that occurs outside the stack. The hydrogen rich gas mixture generated by reforming reaction can be stored or directly transported to the anode of the stack through pipeline for reaction.

explanation_cn: 在模拟固体和复杂的分子结构时，要考虑原子间的多体效应，即势函数方程中的高阶项。
explanation_en: When simulating solid and complex molecular structures, it is necessary to consider the multi body effect between atoms, which is the higher-order term in the potential function equation.

name_cn: 多元氧化物激光透明陶瓷
explanation_cn: 多元组分氧化物制备的能够用做激光介质材料的透明陶瓷材料。通过对粉体形貌和纯度的控制，以及烧结过程中工艺参数的控制，实现陶瓷晶界洁净、气孔率极低，从而实现了高的光学透过率。
explanation_en: Transparent ceramics materials prepared by multi-component oxides that can be used as a laser medium materials. Through the control of powder morphology and purity, as well as the control of process parameters in the sintering process, the grain boundary of ceramics is clean and the porosity is extremely low, thus achieving high optical transmittance.

explanation_cn: 指具有两个或两个以上功能的复合材料。复合材料可以选用两个以上的原材料构成，完全可以通过设计来实现所组成的复合材料具有多功能性。
explanation_en: Refers to a composite materials with two or more functions. Composite materials can be composed of more than two raw materials, and the composite materials composed by it can be realized through design with multi-function.

explanation_cn: 在产生激光后，利用自身的功能赋予激光以某种特性的激光晶体。已研制成的多功能晶体有以下几种：①自倍频激光晶体。在一些没有对称中心的晶体中掺入激活离子，让激活离子产生激光后，由基质的非线性效应直接将激光转换成谐波，实现自倍频。②自调Q、自锁模晶体。激光的调Q和锁模可利用可饱和吸收体的漂白效应和电光晶体的电光调制技术来实现。
explanation_en: After the laser is generated, it is a laser crystal that uses its own functions to endow the laser with certain characteristics. The multifunctional crystal that have been developed are as follows: ① Self frequency doubling laser crystal. Some crystal without symmetry center are doped with active ions, so that the active ions can generate laser, and the laser can be directly converted into harmonics by the nonlinear effect of the matrix to realize self frequency doubling. ② Self tuning Q, self locking crystal. Q-switching and mode locking of laser can be realized by using bleaching effect of saturable absorber and electro-optic modulation technology of electro-optic crystal.

explanation_cn: 液体金属经由增殖区反应堆腔体的多孔性内壁渗出，在壁表面形成液态金属保护层的第一壁结构。它是惯性约束聚变堆的一种设计概念。惯性约束聚变中，燃料小球接连爆炸，第一壁结构将受到脉冲式的能量沉积和辐射损伤。
explanation_en: Liquid metal seeps out through the porous inner wall of the breeder zone reactor cavity, forming the first wall structure of a liquid metal protective layer on the wall surface. It is a design concept of inertial-confinement fusion reactor. In inertial-confinement fusion, when fuel pellets explode in succession, the first wall structure will suffer pulsed energy deposition and irmdiatiem damage.

explanation_cn: 同相与大量孔隙共同构成的多相材料。
explanation_en: Multi phase materials composed of in-phase and a large number of pores.

explanation_cn: 具有多孔结构的生物活性涂层材料。多孔结构可以促进新骨生成和血管长入，发挥骨传导作用，起到加速修复骨缺损作用。常见的多孔生物陶瓷涂层有羟基磷灰石、生物活性玻璃陶瓷和β-TCP等无机生物活性材料。
explanation_en: Bioactive coating materials with porous structure. The porous structure can promote the generation of new bone and the growth of blood vessels, play the role of osteoconduction, and accelerate the repair of bone defects. Common porous bioceramic coating include hydroxyapatite, bioactive glass-ceramics and β- TCP and other inorganic bioactive materials.

explanation_cn: 以桂片为阳极在含氢氟酸的电解液中以合适的电流密度阳极氧化，或者硅片在含氢氟酸和强氧化剂的溶液中择优腐蚀，即可形成多孔硅，1956年被首次制备出来。多孔硅的孔隙度一般在60%-90%,表面积很大，可达100-1000m2，利用其表面积大且易于氧化的特点，曾用于制备集成电路的隔离层和硅片。
explanation_en: Porous silicon can be formed by anodic oxidation of cinnamon chips in hydrofluoric acid containing electrolyte with appropriate current density, or preferential corrosion of silicon wafer in hydrofluoric acid containing solution and strong oxidant, which was first prepared in 1956. The porosity of porous silicon is generally 60% -90%, and its surface area is large, up to 100-1000m2. With its large surface area and easy oxidation, it has been used to prepare isolation layers and silicon wafer for integrated circuits.

explanation_cn: 利用光助电化学刻蚀技术制备出具有=维有序结构的多孔硅微通道，再将氧化剂嵌入微通道而形成的含能点火基材，在外界热能作用下会发生猛烈的化学反应而释放更大的能量。
explanation_en: Photoassisted electrochemical etching technology is used to prepare porous silicon microchannels with=dimensional ordered structure, and then oxidizer is embedded into the microchannels to form an energetic ignition substrate. Under the action of external heat energy, violent chemical reactions will occur and more energy will be released.

explanation_cn: 以金属粉末为主要原料，用粉末冶金方法制取的多孔减摩制品。经浸油后，使用时具有自润滑性能。用粉末冶金法制作的烧结体，其本来就是多孔质的，而且具有在制造过程中可较自由调节孔隙的数量、大小、形状及分布等。
explanation_en: Porous antifriction products are made from metal powder by powder metallurgy. After immersion in oil, it has self-lubricating performance when used. The sintered body made by powder metallurgy is originally porous, and can freely adjust the number, size, shape and distribution of pores in the manufacturing process.

explanation_cn: 粉末冶金烧结体的孔隙度高于45%，并含有多量连通孔的材料。它是粉末冶金一大类别，是其他冶金工艺制造不出来的金属体。
explanation_en: The porosity of powder metallurgy sintered body is higher than 45%, and the materials contains a large number of connected pores. It is a major category of powder metallurgy, and is a metal body that cannot be produced by other metallurgical processes.

explanation_cn: 是一种用于人体组织修复的具有独特多孔结构的金属材料。多孔钽的微观结构为空间上互联的排列规则的十二面体微孔，与松质骨类似。其结构体现了高的容积孔隙率，低的弹性模量，高的摩擦系数。
explanation_en: It is a kind of metallic materials with unique porous structure used for human tissue repair. The microstructure of porous tantalum is regularly arranged dodecahedral micropores connected in space, similar to cancellous bone. Its structure reflects high volume porosity, low elastic modulus and high friction coefficient.

explanation_cn: 对材料进行的包含原子（分子）水平、纳观尺度、微观尺度、介观尺度、宏观尺度等不同尺度耦合关联的计算机仿真模型的建立。
explanation_en: The computer simulation model of materials, which includes the coupling and correlation of atomic (molecular) level, nano scale, micro scale, mesoscale, macro scale and other different scales, is established.

explanation_cn: 多层吹塑是制备多层复合制品的一种成型方法。它是釆用两种以上塑料品种，同时使用两台以上的挤出机或多料筒注塑机，共挤出或注塑出多层结构的型坯，经调节温度以后通过压缩空气使型坯在模具型腔内吹胀，成型多层复合结构的吹塑制品。可以分为共注射吹塑、共注射拉伸吹塑、多层共挤出吹塑等方法成型。利用多层吹塑成型制成的薄壁多层中空制品可以提高容器的阻隔性.改进耐热性、外观和可印刷性及其着色装饰性，还可生产夹芯层发泡的制品。
explanation_en: Multilayer blow molding is a molding method to prepare multilayer composition products. It uses more than two kinds of plastics, and uses more than two extruders or multi barrel injection molding machines at the same time to coextrusion or inject the parison with multi-layer structure. After the temperature is adjusted, the parison is inflated in the mold cavity through compressed air to form the blow molding product with multi-layer composition structure. It can be divided into co injection blow molding, co injection stretch blow molding, multi-layer coextrusion blow molding and other methods. Thin wall and multi-layer hollow products made by multilayer blow molding can improve the barrier property of containers, improve the heat resistance, appearance, printability, coloring and decoration, and can also produce sandwich layer foam products.

explanation_cn: 利用复合技术使两种以上物理、化学、力学性质不同的金属在界面i上实现牢固地结合。使其既能保持各层金属原有的特性，又使物理、化学、力学性能比单一金属更加优越，在材料性能方面实现了装饰性、导电性、导热i性、耐磨耐蚀性和力学性能等的有效组合，可实现材料综合性能的提高。同时也包括纳米多层金属，通过控制多层膜间的调制波长，可以实现隹变化。例如，为了满足电阻系列变化、耐蚀及强度等方面特殊要求，热双金属除了主动层和被动层以外，加入第三组元或更多的组元，成为多层复合金属，制备电阻系列热双金属。
explanation_en: By using composition technology, two or more metals with different physical, chemical and mechanical properties can be firmly combined on interface i. It can not only maintain the original characteristics of each layer of metal, but also make its physical, chemical and mechanical properties more superior than that of a single metal. In terms of materials performance, it has achieved an effective combination of decoration, conductivity, thermal conductivity, wear resistance and corrosion resistance, and mechanical properties, which can improve the comprehensive performance of materials. At the same time, it also includes nano multilayer metals, which can achieve excellent changes by controlling the modulation wavelength between multilayer films. For example, in order to meet the special requirements of resistance series change, corrosion resistance and strength, in addition to the active layer and passive layer, the thermal bimetals add a third component or more components to become multilateral metal and prepare electro-resistance thermobimetal series.
