explanation_cn: 多层共挤成型技术是通过两台或两台以上的挤出机将两种或两种以上的树脂挤出，在压力与温度作用下，这些熔体经口模区熔合成为型坯，再经冷却和定型得到所需复合型材的一类成型加工方法。或者说，多层共挤就是由一个挤出机群和共挤复合机头所构成的体系。该成型方法能充分发挥各种塑料的固有特性，使其在复合型材中起到应有的作用；故效率高、成本低；可将硬质材料与软质材料复合，集强度与弹性于一体，将阻隔性强的材料与普通价廉材料复合，将黏结材料复合在无黏结能力的材料之间，也可将多孔材料与致密材料复合，构成质轻、比强度高的材料；本方法可构成品种多、花样新、性能优的各种型材，以满足特殊场合使用的材料；多层共挤的产品主要有片材、薄膜、异型材、中空容器、托盘、汽车油箱、管材以及其他的工业用制品等。
explanation_en: Multi layer co extrusion technology is a kind of forming processing method that extrudes two or more resin through two or more extruders. Under the effect of pressure and temperature, these melts are fused into parison through the die area, and then cooled and shaped to obtain the required composite profiles. In other words, multi-layer coextrusion is a system composed of an extruder group and coextrusion composition dies. The molding method can give full play to the inherent characteristics of various plastics and make them play a due role in composite profiles; High efficiency and low cost; It can composition hard materials with soft materials, integrate strength and elasticity, composition strong barrier materials with ordinary cheap materials, composition bonded materials between materials without bonding ability, or composition porous materials with dense materials to form materials with light weight and high specific strength; The method can form various profiles with many varieties, new patterns and excellent performance to meet the requirements of materials used in special occasions; The products of multi-layer coextrusion mainly include sheet, film, profile, hollow container, tray, automobile fuel tank, tube and other industrial products.

explanation_cn: 多层注射成型是一种兼有共挤出成型和注射成型特点的成型工艺，该工艺能在复杂制件中任意的产生很薄的分层状态。多层注射成型同时实施两种或两种以上的不同的树脂注射，使其通过一个多级共挤模头将各股熔体在共挤模头中逐级分层，各层的厚度变薄而层数增加，最终进入注塑模腔叠加，保留通过上述过程获得的层状形态，即各种树脂不是沿制品厚度方向呈无序共混状态存在的，而是复合叠加在一起的。因为这种层状的结构，保留了各组分材料的特性，比传统共混材料更能充分地发挥材料的性能，使制品在阻隔气体渗透、耐溶剂、透明性等方面具有突出的优点。
explanation_en: Multilayer injection molding is a molding process that combines the characteristics of coextrusion molding and injection molding. This process can arbitrarily produce very thin layered state in complex parts. Multilayer injection molding simultaneously implements injection of two or more different resin, so that each strand of melt is gradually layered in the coextrusion die head through a multi-stage coextrusion die head, the thickness of each layer becomes thinner and the number of layers increases, and finally enters the injection mold cavity for superposition, retaining the layered morphology obtained through the above process, that is, various resin do not exist in a disordered polymer blending state along the thickness direction of the product, but are composition superimposed together. Because this layered structure retains the characteristics of each component materials, it can give full play to the performance of materials more than the traditional polymer blending materials, making the products have outstanding advantages in gas barrier, solvent resistance, transparency, etc.

name_cn: 多层结构碳化硅/硼化铪涂层
name_en: muhi-layered silicon carbide hafnium boride coating
explanation_cn: 高性能陶瓷涂层的一种，可由等离子体喷涂方法或化学气相沉积方法交替制备碳化硅和硼化铪涂层而成。硼化铪HfB2在400-500℃之间发生氧化，形成HfO2和B2O3，B2O3为黏流态，可覆盖表面而阻止氧扩散。该多层结构涂层硬度高，耐高温，阻止氧扩散能力强，可作硬质耐磨涂层和超高温抗氧化涂层用。
explanation_en: A kind of high performance ceramics coating, which can be made by alternately preparing silicon carbide and hafnium boride coating by plasma spraying or chemical vapor deposition. Hafnium boride HfB2 oxidizes at 400-500 ℃ to form HfO2 and B2O3. B2O3 is viscous flow state, which can cover the surface and prevent diffusion of oxygen. The multilayer structure coating has high hardness, high temperature resistance, strong ability to prevent diffusion of oxygen, and can be used as hard wear resistant coating and ultra high temperature oxidationresistant coating.

name_cn: 多层结构碳化硅/硼化锆涂层
name_en: multi-layered silicon carbide zirconium boride coating
explanation_cn: 高性能陶瓷涂层的一种，可通过交替喷涂、沉积等工艺获得具有多层结构、致密紧凑、与基体结合强度高且抗氧化性能优异的（SiC/ZrB2)n涂层。硼化锆涂层具有优异的抗氧化性能，但其与使用温度有很大关系，添加SiC可在不破坏ZrB2高温稳定性的同时大大改善其高温抗氧化性能，可以大大提高其耐高温及高温抗氧化性能.使其满足高温及超髙温强氧化应用领域的要求。
explanation_en: As one of the high performance ceramics coatings, (SiC/ZrB2) n coatings with multi-layer structure, compact structure, high bonding strength with matrix and excellent oxidation resistance can be obtained by alternate spraying, deposition and other processes. Zirconium boride coating has excellent oxidation resistance, but it has a great relationship with the use temperature. Adding SiC can greatly improve the high-temperature oxidation resistance of ZrB2 without damaging its high-temperature stability, and can greatly improve its high-temperature resistance and high-temperature oxidation resistance, so as to meet the requirements of high-temperature and ultra-high temperature strong oxidation applications.

name_cn: 多层结构碳化硅/碳化铪涂层
name_en: multi-layered silicon carbide hafnium carbide coating
explanation_cn: 超高温复合碳化物涂层的一种。多层结构碳化硅/碳化铪涂层可由不同制备工艺通过交替喷涂、沉积获得。
explanation_en: Ultra high temperature composition carbide coating. The multi-layered silicon carbide hafnium carbide coating can be obtained by alternate spraying and deposition with different preparation processes.

explanation_cn: 具有两个或两个以上超导能隙（或能带）的超导体称为多带超导体；典型的多带超导体，如MgB2。
explanation_en: Superconductors with two or more superconducting gap (or energy bands) are called multi-band superconductor; Typical multi-band superconductor, such as MgB2.

explanation_cn: 同质多晶型之间的转变（例如固溶体的多晶哦转变)，与纯组元的同素异构转变（allotropieiransformation〉密切相关。当体系中组元具有同素异构转变时，形成的固溶体常常有多形性转变。
explanation_en: The transformation between homogeneous polycrystal forms (such as the polycrystal transformation of solid solution) is closely related to the allotropism transformation of pure components. When the components in the system have allotropism transformation, the formed solid solution often has polymorphic transformation transformation.

name_cn: 多态波茨蒙特卡罗模型
explanation_cn: 采用广义自旋变量，表示多个可能状态中的一个态，同时只计及不同近邻情况下相互作用的一种蒙特卡罗方法。
explanation_en: A Monte Carlo method that uses generalized spin variables to represent one state among multiple possible states, while only considering interactions in different neighboring situations.

explanation_cn: 由两个以上的同种或异种单晶组成的晶体物质。其中各单晶是通过晶界结合在一起的。各单晶的晶体学取向大多具有任意性，在特殊条件下，也可具有择优取向。前者已无晶体所特有的各向异性特征，而后者则可不同程度地显示出固有的方向性。
explanation_en: A crystal substance consisting of more than two single crystal of the same or different species. Each single crystal is combined through grain boundary. The crystallographic orientation of each single crystal is mostly arbitrary, and under special conditions, it can also have a preferred orientation. The former no longer has the unique anisotropic characteristics of crystals, while the latter can exhibit inherent directionality to varying degrees.

explanation_cn: 指生长单晶硅用的原料，呈多晶结构，杂质均在十亿分之几（ppb)。根据形态可分为棒状、块状及颗粒状多晶硅；根据用途及纯度可分为电子级直拉硅单晶用、区熔硅单晶用、探测器级、太阳电池级多晶硅。通常采用含硅的高纯气体为源，经高温化学反应或热分解沉积形成多晶硅，主流的制备工艺有：三氯氢硅氢还原法（西门子法）和硅烷法。
explanation_en: Refers to the raw material used for growing monocrystalline silicon, which is in a polycrystalline structure with impurities ranging from a few parts per billion (ppb). According to the shape, it can be divided into rod, block and granular polycrystalline silicon; According to the use and purity, it can be divided into electronic grade Czochralski siliconcrystalline, zone melting siliconcrystalline, detector grade and solar cell grade polycrystalline silicon. Usually, high-purity gas containing silicon is used as the source to form polycrystalline silicon through high-temperature chemical reaction or thermal decomposition deposition. The mainstream preparation processes are: trichlorosilane hydrogen reduction method (Siemens method) and silane method.

explanation_cn: 在光纤中可以传输许多电磁模式的光纤不同的电磁模式以不同的速度来传输，到达接收端的时间各不相同，这个时间差称为群时延。它远大于单模光纤的色散.群时延引起光信息脉冲展宽，因而限制了多模光纤传输信息速率的提高。为了提高多模光纤的传输速率，采用抛物线折射射率剖面的波导结构。
explanation_en: In optical fiber, many electromagnetic modes can be transmitted. Different electromagnetic modes of optical fiber are transmitted at different speeds, and the time to reach the receiving end is different. This time difference is called group delay. It is much larger than the dispersion of single mode optical filler. Group delay causes optical information pulse broadening, thus limiting the improvement of transmission information rate of multimode optical fiber. In order to improve the transmission rate of multimode optical fiber, the waveguide structure with parabolic refractive index profile is adopted.

explanation_cn: 参见松质火药。
explanation_en: See loose propellant.

explanation_cn: 能量高于带隙数倍的光子入射到半导体上，产生多个电子空穴对，即称为多激子产生。
explanation_en: Photons with energy several times higher than the band gap incident on the semiconductor to generate multiple electron hole pairs, which is called multiple excitongeneration.

explanation_cn: 又称复相或复合陶瓷，指在陶瓷基体中引入一种或一种以上异质、异形、异性的材料，通过适当的艺复合制成的一种新材料，使单相陶瓷的某些特性得到改善，如补强，增韧，属于多相材料。广义地讲.陶瓷是无机非金属材料的同义词，故多相复合陶瓷应包含所有无机非金属材料作为基体所制备的多相材料，即无机非金属材料基多相材料，如陶瓷基复合材料、玻璃基复合材料、水泥基复合材料、碳基复合材料以及两种以上的基体相构成的层状结构、梯度结构或机械混合的多相材料等，这类材料统称为多相复合陶瓷。
explanation_en: Also known as composite or composite ceramics, it refers to a new materials that is introduced one or more heterogeneous, heteromorphic, and heterotropic materials into the ceramics matrix, and is made by appropriate composition technology, which improves some characteristics of single-phase ceramics, such as reinforcement and toughening. It is a multi phase materials. Broadly speaking, ceramics is a synonym of inorganic nonmetallic materials, so multiphase composite ceramics should include all inorganic nonmetallic materials as matrix prepared multiphase materials, that is, inorganic nonmetallic materials based multiphase materials, such as ceramic matrix composite, glass matrix composite, cement matrix composite, carbon matrix composite, as well as layered structures, gradient structures or mechanically mixed multiphase materials composed of more than two matrix phase, Such materials are collectively called multiphase composite ceramics.

name_cn: 多级增强陶瓷基复合材料
explanation_cn: 又称multiscale、hierarchical或hybridcomposite。是指用不同尺度的增强体共同强化的陶瓷基复合材料，如微米级的纤维和纳米级的纳米线（纳米管）共同作为增强体强化的陶瓷材料。多级增强在植物细胞、动物贝壳和骨骼中广泛存在.具有优异的力学性能。多级增强陶瓷基复合材料是在传统纤维增强复合材料基础上进一步开发出来的新一代复合材料,利用微纳协调作用来进一步强化复合材料。多级增强体的构建方式主要分为：①多级增强体的构建，即直接在微米纤维表面加载纳米尺度增强体；②微米纤维强化纳米增强体改性的基体，该方式是预先将纳米增强体引入到基体组分中，最后再利用纤维进一步强化。纳米增强体填充到微米纤维之间的孔隙之中，能有效强化微区基体.提高陶瓷基体的断裂靭性和损伤容忍度。调控纳米增强相的性质还可以实现材料的结构功能一体化。
explanation_en: Also known as multiscale, hierarchical, or hybrid composite. It refers to ceramic matrix composite strengthened with reinforcement of different scales, such as micron sized fibers and nanometer sized nanowires (nanotube) as reinforcement to strengthen ceramics materials. Multi level enhancement is widely present in plant cells, animal shells, and bones, and has excellent mechanical properties. Multiscale reinforced ceramic matrix composite is a new generation of composite materials developed on the basis of traditional fiber reinforced composite materials, which uses micro nano coordination to further strengthen composite materials. The construction methods of multi-level reinforcement mainly include: ① construction of multi-level reinforcement, that is, directly loading nano scale reinforcement on the surface of micro fibers; ② Micron fibers strengthen the matrix modified by nano reinforcements. This method is to introduce nano reinforcement into the matrix components in advance, and then further strengthen with fibers. The nano reinforcement filled into the pores between the micro fibers can effectively strengthen the micro matrix and improve the fracture toughness and damage tolerance of ceramics matrix. The structural and functional integration of materials can also be achieved by regulating the properties of nano reinforcements.

explanation_cn: 多组分聚合反应是指三种或以上的不同反应单体同时进行反应，一步生成高分子产物的新型聚合方法。多组分聚合是从小分子多组分反应衍生而来。通过这种方法可以从结构简单的前体得到含有复杂化学结构和生物活性的化合物。
explanation_en: Multi-component polymerization refers to a new polymerization method in which three or more different monomer react simultaneously to produce macromolecule products in one step. Multi-component polymerization is derived from small molecule multi-component reaction. By this method, compounds with complex chemical structure and bioactivity can be obtained from precursors with simple structure.

explanation_cn: 由多根超导芯丝和金属或合金基体组成的超导线材；芯丝的数量根据导体设计的不同而变化。
explanation_en: Superconducting wire rod composed of multiple superconducting core wires and metal or alloy matrix; The number of core wires varies depending on the design of the conductor.

explanation_cn: 具有一种以上的敏感性能的传递系统。多重敏感的种类很多，如磁场/温度、pH/温度、磁场/pH、PH/氧化还原、光/温度、光/pH、pH/温度/磁场、光/pH/温度等。在药物与基因传递领域，多重敏感传递系统可利用多种刺激下的协同作用最大限度地优化传递系统在病灶部位的疗效，并可根据需要对药物或基因的传递过程进行程序化控制。
explanation_en: A transmission system with more than one sensitive performance. There are many types of multiple sensitivities, such as magnetic field/temperature, pH/temperature, magnetic field/pH, pH/redox, light/temperature, light/pH, pH/temperature/magnetic field, light/pH/temperature, etc. In the field of drug and gene delivery, the multi-sensitive delivery system can maximize the efficacy of the delivery system at the focus by using the synergy of multiple irritation, and can program the drug or gene delivery process as required.

explanation_cn: 是指生长的薄膜材料中所需的各种元素成分来自不同的前驱体。这种方式可以比较容易调节各种前驱体的比例，从而精准地控制所需薄膜材料中各种元素的组分比例，因此在工业界广泛地应用。
explanation_en: It means that the various elements required in the grown film materials come from different precursors. This method can easily adjust the proportion of various precursors, so as to accurately control the composition proportion of various elements in the required film materials. Therefore, it is widely used in the industry.

explanation_cn: 多铁性材料是指材料中包含两种及两种以上铁的基本性能，这些铁的基本性能包括铁电性（反铁电性）、铁磁性（反铁磁性、亚铁磁性）和铁弹性。这类材料在一定的温度下同时存在自发极化和自发磁化，正是它们的同时存在引起的磁电耦合效应，使多铁性体具有某些特殊的物理性质，引发了若干新的、有意义的物理现象，如：在磁场的作用下极化重新定向或者诱导铁电相变；在电场作用下磁化重新定向或者诱导铁磁相变；在居里（Curie)温度铁磁相变点附近产生介电常数的突变，多铁性材料已成为当前国际上研究的一个热点。
explanation_en: Multi iron materials refer to the basic properties of materials containing two or more iron. These basic properties of iron include ferroelectricity (amiferroelectricity), ferromagnetism (anti ferromagnetism, ferrimagnetism) and ferroelasicity. This kind of materials has both spontaneous polarization and spontaneous magnetize at a certain temperature. It is their simultaneous existence that causes the magnetoelectric coupling effect, which makes the multi iron have some special physical properties and causes some new and meaningful physical phenomena, such as polarization reorientation or ferroelectric transformation under the action of magnetic field; Magnetize reorients or induces ferromagnetic phase transition under electric field; The sudden change of dielectric constant occurs near the ferromagnetic phase transition point at Curie temperature, and multiferroic materials have become a hot research topic in the world.

explanation_cn: 薄膜材料的同一个相中包含两种或两种以上铁的基本性能（或反铁电性）、铁磁性或铁弹性的材料，可以通过铁性的耦合协同作用而产生一些新的功能的薄膜材料。
explanation_en: Thin film materials contain two or more basic properties of iron (or amiferroelectricity), ferromagnetism or ferroelasicity in the same phase, which can generate some new functional thin film materials through the coupling and synergistic action of iron.

explanation_cn: 在阳光和紫外线照射停止后仍能发光的材料，又称长余辉发光材料。夜光粉典型的代表是铜激活的硫化锌（ZnS:Cu)和碱土金属硫化物。主要用于隐蔽照明和紧急照明，将它们掺入陶瓷、玻璃、塑料中，可制成发光陶瓷、发光玻璃和发光塑料。由于这些材料在黑夜里发光，起到方便生活的作用。涂在飞机仪表盘上，飞机起飞前用紫外线照射，发光材料能在几十分钟内保持最低限度的亮度。
explanation_en: The materials that can still emit luminescence after the stop of sunlight and ultraviolet radiation is also called long afterglow luminescent material. Typical representatives of luminous powder are copper activated zinc sulfide (ZnS: Cu) and alkaline earth metal sulfide. It is mainly used for concealed lighting and emergency lighting. They can be mixed into ceramics, glass and plastics to make luminescence ceramics, luminescence glass and luminescence plastics. Because these materials luminescence in the dark, they play a role in facilitating life. The luminescence materials can maintain the minimum brightness within tens of minutes after being coated on the aircraft dashboard and irradiated by ultraviolet light before takeoff.

explanation_cn: 混凝土结构物实体最小几何尺寸不小于1m的大体量混凝土，或预计会因混凝土中胶凝材料水化引起的温度变化和收缩而导致有害裂缝产生的混凝土，称之为大体积混凝土。它的表面系数比较小，水泥水化热释放比较集中，内部升温比较快，当混凝土内外温差较大时，会使混凝土产生温度裂缝，影响结构安全和正常使用。因此，在制作大体积混凝土或整体尺寸较大时，必须对混凝土进行温度控制，妥善处理好混凝土拌合物在凝结、硬化过程中发出的热量及随之出现的体积变化，并防止硬化后散热降温产生体积收缩，以减少或防止由温度应力而出现裂纹。主要用于大坝及电站、桥梁、大型工厂、高层楼房、大型设备等。
explanation_en: The mass concrete with the minimum geometric dimension of the concrete structure not less than 1m, or the concrete that is expected to cause harmful cracks due to the temperature change and shrinkage caused by the hydration of cementitious materials in concrete, is called mass concrete. Its surface coefficient is relatively small, cement heat of hydration release is relatively concentrated, and internal temperature rise is relatively fast. When the temperature difference between the inside and outside of concrete is large, concrete will have temperature cracks, affecting the safety and normal use of the structure. Therefore, when making mass concrete or when the overall size is large, it is necessary to control the temperature of concrete, properly handle the heat generated by the concrete mixture in the process of setting and hardening and the subsequent volume change, and prevent the volume shrinkage caused by cooling after hardening, so as to reduce or prevent cracks caused by temperature stress. Mainly used for dams and power plants, bridges, large factories, high-rise buildings, large equipment, etc.

explanation_cn: 简称大单体。带有可聚合端基的线型聚合物，一般分子量在1000～2000左右，分子量分布窄。可由负离子聚合、正离子聚合、基团转移聚合、自由基聚合及缩聚等制备。可聚合端基有苯乙烯基、烯丙基、甲基丙烯酰基、环氧基、噁唑啉基等。大分子单体与一般单体共聚，可得到支链长短很规整的接枝共聚物。大分子单体的共聚物或均聚物常被称为梳状聚合物。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as a large monomer. The linear polymer with polymerization end groups has a general molecular weight of about 1000~2000 and a narrow molecular weight distribution. It can be prepared by anionic polymerization, cationic polymerization, group transfer polymerization, free radical polymerization and polycondensation. The end groups that can be polymerization include styrene, allyl, methacryloyl, epoxy, oxazolinyl, etc. Macromer can be copolymerized with general monomer to obtain graft copolymer with regular branch chain length. The copolymer or homopolymer of macromer is often called comb polymer.

explanation_cn: 具有引发剂功能的大分子物质。这类物质一般分子链上有引发单体聚合的活性中心，可制备结构明确的嵌段共聚物。目前应用广泛的有大分子偶氮化物和大分子过氧化物。
explanation_en: Macromolecule with initiator function. Such substances generally have an active center on the molecular chain to initiate monomer polymerization, which can prepare block copolymer with clear structure. At present, macromolecule azo compounds and macromolecule peroxides are widely used.

explanation_cn: 又称大孔树脂、全孔树脂。由聚合单体，交联剂，甲苯、二甲苯等致孔剂、分散剂经聚合反应制成的具有多孔骨架结构的不溶于水的交联聚合物。根据聚合材料不同，可分为非极性、中等极性和极性大类型。非极性树脂由偶极矩小的单体聚合制备，树脂骨架没有任何官能团，其中聚苯乙烯型吸附树脂，是目前应用最广泛的商品化大孔吸附树脂.以疏水作用力吸附极性溶剂(如水）中非极性或弱极性小分子物质。中等极性吸附树脂是丙烯酸酯（或甲基丙烯酸酯）与双甲基丙烯酸乙二醇酯的共聚物，以聚丙烯酸酯为骨架结构，在树脂骨架结构中引人弱极性酯基，通过疏水和偶极共同作用，既可以从极性溶剂中吸附非极性或弱极性组分，也可以从弱极性溶剂中吸附极性组分。极性树脂主要有亚砜类、聚丙烯酰胺类、氧化氮类、脲醛树脂类等，骨架中含有氨基、酰胺基、氰基、磺酸基、羧基、酚羟基，通过氢键作用、静电作用产生特异性作用力，适用管从非极性溶剂中选择性吸附极性物质。大孔吸附树脂最早用于废水处理、医药工业、化学工业、分析化学、临床检定和治疗等领域，近年来在我国已广泛用于中草药有效成分的提取、分离、纯化工作中。
explanation_en: It is also called macroporous resin and full pore resin. It is a water insoluble crosslinked polymer with porous framework structure, which is made of polymerization monomer, cross linking agent, toluene, xylene and other pore forming agents, dispersing agent through polymerization reaction. According to different polymeric materials, they can be divided into non polar, medium polar, and polar large types. Non polar resin is prepared by polymerization of monomer with small dipole moment. The resin skeleton has no functional group. Among them, polystyrene type adsorption resin is the most widely used commercial macroporous adsorption resin. It adsorbs non-polar or weakly polar small molecules in polar solvents (such as water) by hydrophobic force. The moderately polar adsorption resin is a copolymer of acrylate (or methacrylate) and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate. With polyacrylate as the skeleton structure, weakly polar ester groups are introduced into the skeleton structure of resin. Through the combined action of hydrophobic and dipole, non-polar or weakly polar components can be adsorbed from polar solvents, and polar components can also be adsorbed from weakly polar solvents. Polar resin mainly include sulfoxides, polyacrylamide, nitrogen oxides, urea formaldehyde resin, etc. The skeleton contains amino, amide, cyano, sulfonic acid, carboxyl, and phenolic hydroxyl groups, which generate specific force through hydrogen bond action and electrostatic action, and are suitable for selectively adsorbing polar substances from non-polar solvents. Macroporous adsorption resin was first used in wastewater treatment, pharmaceutical industry, chemical industry, analytical chemistry, clinical verification and treatment and other fields. In recent years, it has been widely used in the extraction, separation and purification of effective ingredients of Chinese herbal medicine in China.

explanation_cn: 珠体内部具有类似活性炭、沸石样物理孔结构的树脂，是在凝胶型树脂的基础上发展起来的一类新型离子交换树脂。在干态或湿态下，珠体内都有毛细孔，可用一般物理方法测定，区别于凝胶孔，称之为大孔。在溶剂存在下进行聚合反应，溶剂不参与聚合，在聚合过程中聚合物与溶剂形成相分离.抽提出溶剂，即得到大孔型共聚物。交联剂用量、溶剂种类、溶剂用量均影响其结构。大孔离子交换树脂有较大孔存在，有利于离子的粒扩散.适用于较大分子的分离提取。有较好的抗渗透压能力及优良的力学性能，在水处理时，适用于高流速。由于其物理孔存在，还适用于非水体系。高比表面及较大的孔径使其在有机合成及催化反应中广泛应用，在多种酯化反应及开环聚合中已用于工业化生产。大孔离子交换树脂的出现，进一步扩大了离子交换树脂的é用领域.目前强酸、强碱、弱酸、弱碱及螯合型树脂等都有大孔型产品。
explanation_en: Resin with activated carbon and zeolite like physical pore structure inside the bead is a new type of ion exchange resin developed on the basis of gel resin. In the dry state or wet state, there are capillary pores in the beads, which can be measured by general physical methods. Different from gel pores, they are called macropores. Polymerization is carried out in the presence of solvent, and the solvent does not participate in polymerization. During polymerization, polymer and solvent form phase to separate, and solvent is extracted to obtain macroporous copolymer. The amount of crosslinking agent, the type of solvent and the amount of solvent all affect its structure. Macroporous ion exchange resin has larger pores, which is conducive to the diffusion of ions. It is suitable for the separation and extraction of larger molecules. It has good resistance to osmotic pressure and excellent mechanical properties, suitable for high flow rates in water treatment. Due to its physical pores, it is also suitable for non aqueous systems. Its high specific surface area and large pore size make it widely used in organic synthesis and catalytic reaction. It has been used in industrial production in a variety of esterification reactions and ring opening polymerization. The appearance of macroporous ion exchange resin has further expanded the application field of ion exchange resin. At present, there are macroporous products in strong acid, strong base, weak acid, weak base and chelating resin.

explanation_cn: 模场直径是单模光纤基模(LPm)模场强度空间分布的一种度量，它反映了单模光纤中传输的基模（LPw)模场强度的空间分布。一般将模场直径定义为光强降低到轴心线处最大光强的1/e2的各点中两点最大距离。模场直径小会引起非线性效应。所以对于传输光纤而言，模场直径越大越好。大模场光纤大幅度增加了光纤的模场直径，从而减少了光纤中各种非线性相互作用引起的寄生效应，如拉曼散射和布里渊散射。突破传统的单模光纤激光器不能产生更高输出功率的限制。
explanation_en: The mode field diameter is a measure of the spatial distribution of the fundamental mode (LPm) field strength in single mode optical filler, which reflects the spatial distribution of the fundamental mode (LPw) field strength transmitted in single mode optical filler. The diameter of the mode field is generally defined as the maximum distance between two points at each point where the light intensity decreases to 1/e2 of the maximum light intensity at the axis. A small diameter of the mode field can cause nonlinear effects. Therefore, for transmission optical fiber, the larger the mode field diameter, the better. The large-mode-area fibers significantly increases the mode field diameter of the optical fiber, thus reducing the parasitic effects caused by various nonlinear interactions in the optical fiber, such as Raman scattering and Brillouin scattering. The traditional single mode optical filler laser can not produce higher output power.

name_en: materials for the control of atmospheric pollutants
explanation_cn: 大气污染物主要有二氧化硫、氮氧化物、一氧化碳、碳氢化物和卤素气体等有害气体以及粉尘、酸雾和气溶胶等颗粒物。大气污染治理材料主要包括各类吸附剂、吸收剂和催化材料》常用的吸附剂有活性炭、分子筛、硅胶、硅藻土、活性氧化铝及合成沸石、天然沸石等。吸收剂常用的是石灰石，氨水溶液，钠碱化合物，还有一些如Mg、Zn、Fe、Cu等的金属氧化物。催化材料包括以贵金属（Pt、Rh、Pd等）为活性位点的贵金属基催化材料以及非金属催化材料，在实际应用中通常会添加稀土等元素提高催化材料性能。
explanation_en: The main atmospheric pollutants include harmful gases such as sulfur dioxide, nitrogen oxides, carbon monoxide, carbon hydrides, and halogen gases, as well as particulate matter such as dust, acid mist, and aerosols. Materials for air pollution control mainly include various adsorbents, absorbents and catalytic materials. Common adsorbents include activated carbon, molecular sieve, silicone gel, diatomite, active aluminium, synthetic zeolite, natural zeolite, etc. The commonly used absorbers are limestone, ammonia solution, sodium alkali compounds, and some metal oxides such as Mg, Zn, Fe, Cu, etc. Catalytic materials include precious metals based catalytic materials with precious metals (Pt, Rh, Pd, etc.) as active sites and non-metallic catalytic materials. In practical applications, rare earth and other elements are usually added to improve the performance of catalytic materials.

explanation_cn: 指喷枪和基体均处于大气之中的等离子喷涂方式.没有保护气氛。大气等离子喷涂的粒子飞行速率较低，涂层在喷涂过程中容易被污染或氧化，并在大气等离子喷涂制得的陶瓷层致密度较低，一般在10%左右，因此需要再进行封孔处理以提高涂层的性能。
explanation_en: It refers to the plasma spraying mode in which both the spray gun and the matrix are in the atmosphere. There is no protective atmosphere. The particle flight rate of APS is low, and the coating is easy to be polluted or oxidized during the spraying process. The ceramics layer produced by APS has a low efficiency of spare filling, generally about 10%. Therefore, sealing treatment is required to improve the performance of the coating.

explanation_cn: 在环境温度下大气环境中材料发生腐蚀的现象t按照材料表面潮湿程度不同可以分为干大气腐蚀、潮大气腐蚀、湿大气腐蚀5类。按大气腐蚀性可分为乡村大气、城市大气、工业大气、海洋大气、高原风沙大气等。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of corrosion of materials in the atmospheric environment at ambient temperature can be divided into five categories: dry atmospheric corrosion, wet atmospheric corrosion and wet atmospheric corrosion according to the humidity of surface of materials. According to atmospheric corrosiveness, it can be divided into rural atmosphere, urban atmosphere, industrial atmosphere, marine atmosphere, plateau sandstorm atmosphere, etc.

explanation_cn: 又名生漆、天然漆、中国漆、金漆或土漆。为乳白色或谷黄色黏稠液体，是漆树的分泌物。按产地分为毛垠漆、建始漆、城口漆、安康漆、毕节漆等；按产区分为阳山漆、阴山漆等；按割漆期分为头刀漆、中刀漆、尾刀漆等。但习惯上则统分为大木漆和小木漆两大类.大漆的组分非常复杂，主要组分有漆酚、漆酶、树胶质和水分。漆酚是大漆的主要成膜物质，含量一般在40%是烃基取代的邻二苯酚的混合物；漆酶在大漆中的含量极少，是一种含铜离子的多元酶氧化蛋內酶.能使漆酚氧化、聚合，形成涂膜；树胶质是一种多糖类化合物，含量为3.5%-9%。大木漆含树胶质较多.小木漆较少。水分使大木漆成为乳胶体.大漆含水分少的质量较好，但在精制后的大漆中，水分含童必须保持在4%-6%之间。大漆经加工精制，可制得底漆、油基大漆、漆酚树脂漆等；漆酚经化学加工，制成漆酚缩醛树脂.能制造漆酚环氧防腐剂、漆酚多环氧树脂漆、漆酚缩糠醛清漆、漆酚醛油舱漆、漆酚缩甲醛清漆、改性快干漆等；漆酚还可用元素冇机化合物或其他合成树脂改性制成各种改性漆。
explanation_en: Also known as raw lacquer, natural paint, chinese lacquer, golden lacquer or earthen lacquer. It is a milky white or valley yellow viscous liquid, which is the secretion of lacquer trees. According to the origin, it is divided into Maoyin paint, Jianshi paint, Chengkou paint, Ankang paint, Bijie paint, etc; Classified by production as Yangshan lacquer, Yinshan lacquer, etc; According to the cutting period, it is divided into head knife paint, middle knife paint, tail knife paint, etc. However, it is traditionally divided into big wood paint and small wood paint. The composition of Chinese lacquer is very complex, and the main components are urushiol, laccase, resin and water. Urushiol is the main film-forming material of Chinese lacquer, and its content is generally 40% of the mixture of o-diphenol substituted by alkyl group; Laccase, which contains very little in Chinese lacquer, is a kind of enzyme containing copper ions and can oxidize and polymerization urushiol to form a film; Gum is a polysaccharide compound with a content of 3.5% -9%. Large wood lacquer contains more resin, while small wood lacquer has less. Moisture makes big wood paint become emulsion. Chinese lacquer with low moisture content has better quality, but in refined Chinese lacquer, the moisture content must be kept between 4% -6%. After processing and refining, Chinese lacquer can be made into primer, oil-based Chinese lacquer, urushiol resin paint, etc; Urushiol is processed into urushiol acetal resin through chemical machining. It can be used to manufacture urushiol epoxy preservative, urushiol multi epoxy resin paint, urushiol furfural varnish, urushiol formaldehyde oil tank paint, urushiol acetal varnish, modified quick drying paint, etc; Urushiol can also be modified with elemental organic compounds or other synthetic resin to make various modified paints.

explanation_cn: 一种由方解石、白云石组成的变质岩石，是石灰岩、白云岩等碳酸岩盐经区域变质或热接触变质作用而形成的。一般具细?粗粒状变晶结构，块状构造，有时具条带状构造。因原岩所含杂质和变质条件的不同，大理岩可含少量蛇纹石、镁橄榄石、透辉石、透闪石、金云母、钙铝榴石、硅灰石或石英等变质矿物。大理岩根据碳酸盐矿物的种类、特征变质矿物、特殊的结构构造及颜色等进一步详细命名。如大理岩、白云质大理岩、硅灰石大理岩、斑花大理岩、粉红色大理岩等。其中成分纯、粒度细小均匀、致密的白色大理岩被称为"汉白石"，蛇纹石化大理岩称蓝田玉。含多种杂质者呈现不同的颜色和花，磨光后十分美观。大理岩是优良的艺术装饰品、建筑石材的原料。大理耑分布甚广，中国云南省大理县盛产，由此得名。
explanation_en: A metamorphic rock composed of caldte and dolomite, which is formed by carbonatite such as limestone and dolomitite through regional metamorphism or thermal contact metamorphism. Is it generally fine? Coarse grained balastic texture, massive structure, sometimes with banded structure. Due to the different impurities and metamorphic conditions of the original rocks, marble can contain a small amount of metamorphic minerals such as serpentine, forsterite, diopside, tremolite, phlogopite, almandine, wollastonite or quartze. Marble are further named in detail according to the types of carbonate minerals, characteristics of metamorphic minerals, special structures and colors. Such as marble, dolomitic marble, wollastonite marble, spotted marble, pink marble, etc. The white marble with pure composition, fine and uniform grain size and density is called "Hanbaishi", and the serpentinized marble is called lamianyu. People with various impurities present in different colors and flowers, which are very beautiful after polishing. Marble is an excellent raw material for artistic decorations and building stones. Dali College is widely distributed and abundant in Dali County, Yunnan Province, China, hence its name.

explanation_cn: 由天然大理石加工而成的板状装饰材料。按形状分为普型板（PX，正方形或长方形的板材）和圆弧板（HM,装饰面轮廓线的曲率半径处处相同的饰面板材）两大类。产品按如下规则标记，荒料产地地名+花纹色调特征描述+大理石：编号+类别+规格尺寸+等级+标准号。
explanation_en: Plate shaped decorative materials processed from natural marble. According to shape, it is divided into two categories: regular board (PX, square or rectangular board) and circular board (HM, decorative board with the same curvature radius of the contour line of the decorative surface). The products shall be marked according to the following rules: place name of quarry stone origin+description of pattern and tone characteristics+marble: number+category+size+grade+standard number.

explanation_cn: 又称沉淀碳酸钙、白垩粉、轻质碳酸钙、碳酸钙。通过碳化法制得，白色粉末，无味无臭，有无定形和结晶两种形态。结晶型中又可分为斜方晶系和六方晶系，呈柱状或菱形。难溶于水和乙醇，溶于酸同时放出二氧化碳?呈放热反应，也溶于氯化铵溶液，在空气中稳定，有轻微的吸潮能力，有较好的遮盖力。可用作橡胶、塑料、造纸、腻子、底漆、涂料、油墨等行业的填料。广泛用于有机合成、冶金、玻璃和石棉等生产中。
explanation_en: It is also called precipitated calcium carbonate, barus effect, light calcium carbonate and calcium carbonate. It is made by carbonization method, white powder, tasteless and odorless, with amorphous and crystalline forms. In the crystal form, it can also be divided into rhombic and hexagonal crystal systems, which are columnar or rhombic in shape. Difficult to dissolve in water and ethanol, soluble in acids while releasing carbon dioxide? It is exothermic reaction, also soluble in ammonium chloride solution, stable in air, slightly hygroscopic, and has good covering power. It can be used as filler in rubber, plastics, paper making, patty, primer, coatings, ink and other industries. It is widely used in organic synthesis, metallurgy, glass and asbestos production.

name_en: steel for high heat input welding
explanation_cn: 指采用比一般焊接条件高得多的焊接线能量焊接，不至于引起焊接区韧性显著降低、也不会产生焊接裂纹的钢种。焊接线能量为每道次焊接时由外界输入的能量除于焊接线速度。为了提高焊接效率，通常采用减少焊接道次增大焊接线速度的方法.这就使得焊接线能量显著提高。一般将焊接线能量输入大于50kJ/cm的称为大线能量焊接。焊接线能量的提高将使焊接热影响区晶粒过分粗大造成性能明显恶化(晶粒细化效果丧失导致强度和韧性下降、淬透性提高导致容易产生焊接裂纹）。为适应大线能量焊接的需求.必须采用大线能量焊接用钢，通过微合金化技术和氧化物冶金技术在钢中形成高温稳定的第二相颗粒（包括TiN和氧化物）以阻止晶粒长大，同时通过晶内铁素体技术减轻或消除这些第二相颗粒对钢材性能的损害并抑制焊接热裂纹的扩展。船舶、石油平台、桥梁、储罐、海洋工程结构、管线等使用的厚钢板和特厚钢板广泛采用大线能量焊接用钢。
explanation_en: It refers to steel grades that adopt weld line energy weld with much higher weld conditions than normal, which will not significantly reduce the toughness of weld zone and will not produce weld cracks. The linear energy of weld is the energy input from outside during each weld, which is divided by the linear speed of weld. In order to improve weld efficiency, the method of reducing weld passes and increasing weld line speed is usually adopted, which makes weld line energy significantly increased. Generally, weld with input of line energy greater than 50kJ/cm is called high heat input welding. The increase of weld line energy will make the grain in the weld heat affected zone too coarse and cause obvious deterioration of performance (the loss of grain refinement effect will lead to the decrease of strength and toughness, and the increase of hardenabilhy will lead to the easy occurrence of weld cracks). In order to meet the needs of high heat input welding, steel for high heat input welding must be used to form high-temperature stable second phase particles (including TiN and oxide) in steel through micro alloying technology and oxide metallurgy technology to prevent grain growth. At the same time, the damage of these second phase particles to steel product properties and the expansion of weld hot cracks must be reduced or eliminated through intragranular ferrite technology. The thick and extra thick steel plates used in ships, oil platforms, bridges, storage tanks, offshore engineering structures, pipelines, etc. are widely used as steel for high heat input welding.

explanation_cn: 以单粒、表镶形式使用的金刚石。包括单晶和多晶体金刚石两种。常用来制作玻璃刀、车刀、硅片刀、雕刻刀、拉丝膜、砂轮修正笔、刻制笔、表镶砖头、硬度计压头等。
explanation_en: Diamond used in the form of single grain and surface setting. Including single crystal and polycrystalline compact diamond. It is commonly used to make glass knife, turning tool, silicon wafer knife, carving knife, drawing film, grinding wheel correction pen, engraving pen, surface inlay brick, sclerometer indenter, etc.

explanation_cn: 存在于自然界的增强体可分为无机和有机两类。天然无机增强体是地球从灼热熔融状态冷却固化时，经受高温高压而生成的，包括石棉、岩棉（亦称石绒或岩石纤维）等。有机类天然高分子纤维等为主要成分的植物纤维包括亚麻、大麻、花麻、黄麻、马尼拉麻、豆沙尔麻、苎麻及棉花及动物来源的辞.可以通过不同的加工方法制成纱.作为要求不太高的树脂基复合材料的增强剂。
explanation_en: Reinforcement existing in nature can be divided into inorganic and organic. Natural inorganic reinforcement are generated when the earth is cooled and curing from the hot melting state under high temperature and pressure, including asbestos, rock wool (also known as cashmere or rock fiber), etc. Organic natural polymer fibers and other plant fiber, mainly composed of flax, hemp, ramie, jute, manila, douxar, ramie, cotton and animal origin, can be made into yarn through different processing methods and used as reinforcements for resin based composite materials with low requirements.

explanation_en: Unprocessed or processed materials taken from nature. It is divided into natural organic materials and natural inorganic materials.

explanation_cn: 天然树脂主要来源于植物渗（泌）出物的无定形半同体或固体有机物。受热时变软，可熔化，在应力作用下有流动倾向，一般不溶于水，而能溶于醇、醚、酮及其他有机溶剂。按照树脂的基本组分可分为三大类：①纯树脂，即由萜类物质及粗香精油组成的树脂状物质。如松香等。②含树胶脂或称树胶树脂，是由多糖类物质组成的?可溶于水或遇水溶胀.而不溶于醇及有机溶剂。如乳香等。③含油树脂或称香胶，是指含有较多精油、能溶于油中的树脂。按树脂的形成历史可分为化石树脂、半化石树脂和新鲜树脂后者是最重要的天然树脂来源。天然树脂主要用作涂料（见天然树脂涂料）也可用于造纸、绝缘材料、胶黏剂、医药、香料、装饰T艺品的原料（如琥珀）；还有的如加拿大胶（冷杉胶）其折射率与普通玻璃相似，故作为显微镜等光学器材的透明胶黏剂。
explanation_en: Natural resin mainly comes from amorphous hemimorph or solid organic matter of plant exudates. When heated, it becomes soft and can melt. It tends to flow under stress and is generally insoluble in water, but can be soluble in alcohols, ethers, ketones, and other organic solvents. According to the basic components of resin, they can be divided into three categories: ① pure resin, that is, resin like substances composed of terpenoids and crude essential oils. Such as rosin, etc. ② The gum containing resin or gum resin is composed of polysaccharides? It is soluble in water or swelling with water, but insoluble in alcohol and organic solvents. Such as frankincense. ③ Oily resin or gum refers to resin that contains more essential oil and can be dissolved in oil. According to the formation history of resin, it can be divided into fossil resin, semi fossil resin and fresh resin, the latter being the most important source of natural resin. Natural resin is mainly used as coatings (see natural resin coatings), and can also be used as raw material for paper making, insulation materials, adhesive, medicines, spices, and decorative arts (such as amber); Another example is Canada glue (fir glue), whose refractive index is similar to that of ordinary glass, so it can be used as a transparent adhesive for optical devices such as microscopes.

Natural rubber is widely used in the manufacture of tires, medical products, seals, etc.

explanation_cn: 主要由天然橡胶树的胶乳为基料.添加硫化体系、防老剂、补强填充体系和增稠剂组成。所得的新鲜胶乳经离心、浓缩使干胶量达58%-60%之间，加入氨水使PH=11-13,利于保存2-3年。它可以直接用于配制水基橡胶胶黏剂.也可以将天然橡胶胶乳凝聚，干燥制得易于保存和运输的干胶片。干胶片经塑炼及与助剂一起混炼，再以溶剂溶解，以制得各种天然橡胶胶黏剂。天然橡胶胶黏剂的主要特点是钿性好、弹性高，对橡胶、织物等有良好的粘接力。改性后对塑料、陶瓷、水泥、金属等都有一定的黏结强度，广泛应用在制鞋工业、建筑、装饰丁.业、汽车工业的内饰物、轮胎修补，以及在医用上制造橡皮膏及工业压敏胶带、食品I.业的罐头密封、耐水标签粘接等方面。
explanation_en: It is mainly composed of latex of natural rubber tree as the base material, vulcanization system, antiager, reinforcement filling system and thickener added. The obtained fresh latex is centrifuged and concentrated to achieve a dry rubber content of 58% -60%, and ammonia water is added to maintain a pH of 11-13, which is beneficial for storage for 2-3 years. It can be directly used to prepare water-based rubber adhesive. It can also agglomerate natural rubber latex and dry it to make dry film easy to store and transport. After mastication and mixing with additive, the dry film is dissolved in solvent to produce various natural rubber adhesive. The main characteristics of natural rubber adhesive are good mother of pearl, high elasticity, and good adhesion to rubber, fabrics, etc. After modification, it has a certain bonding strength to plastics, ceramics, cement, metal, etc., and is widely used in the shoe industry, architecture, decoration industry, automobile industry's interior decoration, tire repair, as well as in the medical manufacture of rubber paste and industrial pressure sensitive tape, food I industry's can sealing, water resistant label bonding, etc.

name_cn: 天然气燃烧贵金属催化材料
name_en: precious metal catalysts for gas combustion
explanation_cn: 贵金属是活性最高的燃烧催化材料，具有很高的低温催化燃烧活性和抗中毒能力。在贵金属催化材料的作用下，甲烷催化燃烧的过程中，甲烷解离吸附吸附解离为甲基（CH3)或亚甲基（CH2)，或者生成甲醛（HCHO),甲醛再与贵金属所吸附的氧进一步反应生成C02和H2O。一般认为甲醛作为中间物质，一旦产生就快速分解为CO和H2,而不是以甲醛分子形式脱附到气相中。甲烷催化燃烧方面，由于贵金属比较稀有以及在高温下易挥发，只有Pd和Pt作为催化材料得到了广泛的应用。Pd、Pt贵金属催化材料载体的物理化学性质的不同会对其活性有较大的影响。Al2():i是最常用的高比表面积载体，在高温环境下其比表面大量损失。天然气燃烧贵金属催化材料高温稳定性较差，在1000-C以上高温时，会因贵金属粒子增大、烧结、蒸发等而失去活性。因此该燃烧催化材料适合应用于低温或中温燃烧装置，如无焰加热器、催化炉、尾气净化器等。
explanation_en: Precious metals are the most active combustion catalytic materials, with high low-temperature catalytic combustion activity and anti poisoning ability. Under the action of precious metal catalytic materials, during the process of methane catalytic combustion, methane dissociation adsorption dissociation is methyl (CH3) or methylene (CH2), or formaldehyde (HCHO) is generated, and formaldehyde further reacts with oxygen adsorbed by precious metals to generate C02 and H2O. It is generally believed that formaldehyde, as an intermediate, will quickly decompose into CO and H2 once generated, instead of desorption into the gas phase in the form of formaldehyde molecules. In terms of methane catalytic combustion, only Pd and Pt have been widely used as catalytic materials because precious metals are relatively rare and volatile at high temperatures. The physical chemistry properties of Pd and Pt precious metal catalytic materials carriers will have a greater impact on their activities. Al2(): i is the most commonly used carrier with high specific surface area, and its specific surface loss is large under high temperature environment. Precious metal catalysts for gas combustion for natural gas combustion have poor high-temperature stability. When the temperature is above 1000-C, they will lose their activity due to the increase of precious metals particles, sintering, evaporation, etc. Therefore, the combustion catalytic materials is suitable for low or medium temperature combustion devices, such as flameless heaters, catalytic furnaces, tail gas purifiers, etc.

name_cn: 天然气燃烧非贵金属催化材料
name_en: non-precious metal catalysts for gas combustion
explanation_cn: 甲烷在催化材料表面发生化学吸附而活化，形成活泼的表面有机中间体.然后和表面氧种（包括吸附氧和晶格氧）或者气相氧反应。常用的天然气燃烧非贵金属催化材料可分为主要有钙钛矿型、六铝酸盐型和负载型过渡金属复合氧化物催化材料。
explanation_en: Methane is activation or conditioning by chemical adsorption on the catalytic surface of materials to form an active surface organic intermediate, which then reacts with surface oxygen (including adsorbed oxygen and lattice oxygen) or gaseous oxygen. The commonly used non-precious metal catalysts for gas combustion for natural gas combustion can be divided into perovskite type, hexaaluminate type and supported transition metal composite oxide catalytic materials.

explanation_cn: 在自然条件下生成的生物材料。主要包括天然纤维、生物体组织、结构蛋白和生物矿物等材料，如蚕丝、蜘蛛丝、贝壳、蛋壳等。由于生物体的精确调控机制，天然生物材料具有特定的精巧的形貌、结构，因此件能常优于相应的人工合成材料。天然生物材料的研究主要集中在多级结构及其形成过程以及与性能的关系，以期从中抽象出材料模型.指导制备具有优良性能的仿生材料。
explanation_en: Biomaterials generated under natural conditions. It mainly includes natural fiber, biological tissue, structural protein, biological minerals and other materials, such as silk, spider silk, shells, eggshells, etc. Due to the precise regulation mechanism of organisms, natural biomaterials have specific and exquisite morphology and structure, so they can often be better than corresponding synthetic materials. The research of natural biomaterials mainly focuses on the multi-level structure and its formation process, as well as the relationship with performance, in order to abstract the model of materials from it and guide the preparation of biomimetic materials with excellent performance.

explanation_cn: 天然形成、伴随矿石产出的石墨，根据外观和性状可分为高结晶度的鳞片状石墨和较低结晶度的土状石墨。在地球上分布较广，可露天大规模开采，在矿石中一般含量为5%-20%。将矿石粉碎后，经反复浮选提纯，进一步提高纯度则需要化学或高温处理。
explanation_en: Graphite naturally formed and produced with ore can be divided into scaly graphite with high crystallinity and earthy graphite with low crystallinity according to its appearance and properties. It is widely distributed on Earth and can be mined on a large-scale open-pit basis, with a general content of 5% -20% in ores. After crushing the ore and repeated flotation purification, further improvement of purity requires chemical or high-temperature treatment.

explanation_cn: 含水层状结构碳酸盐矿物。单斜晶系。晶体呈板状或板柱状；集合体呈粒状、纤维状、放射状、板状等。白色、浅黄色或染成深灰色。玻璃光泽，透明。断口不平坦状，莫氏硬度2.5-3.5,密度2.11-2.14g/cm3.易溶于水.具碱味，溶于无机酸并剧烈起泡。产于盐湖中，与水碱、泡碱、钙水碱等共生。广泛用于化工、冶金、纺织、造纸、石油、橡胶等工业部门.是制取烧碱、纯碱的矿物原料，提取Al2O3的主要辅助原料。
explanation_en: Carbonate minerals with aquifer like structures. Monoclinic system. The crystal is in the form of plate or column; Aggregates appear in granular, fibrous, radial, plate-like, etc. White, light yellow, or dyed deep gray. Glass is glossy and transparent. The fracture surface is not flat, Mohs hardness is 2.5-3.5, and density is 2.11-2.14g/cm3. It is easily soluble in water, with alkaline smell, soluble in inorganic acid and blistering violently. It is produced in salt lakes and coexists with thermonatrite, natron, calcium thermonatrite, etc. It is widely used in chemical industry, metallurgy, textile, paper making, petroleum, rubber and other industrial sectors. It is the raw mineral material for producing caustic soda and soda ash, and the main auxiliary raw material for extracting Al2O3.

explanation_cn: 自然界存在和生长的具有纺织价值的纤维。包括植物纤维（棉、木棉、大麻、黄麻、亚麻、蕉麻、剑麻和椰壳纤维等）、动物纤维（羊毛、马海毛、山羊绒、兔毛、骆驼毛、牦牛毛和蚕丝等）和矿物纤维（石棉等）。20世纪中叶以来，由于合成纤维产量的增长速度很快，致使纺织原料的构成发生了很大的变化。因此，在纺织纤维的年总产量中天然纤维所占的比例逐年有所下降。天然纤维具有各种优良的服装用性能，主要用于加T.成各种服装、装饰和T.业用纺织品。
explanation_en: Fibers with textile value that exist and grow in nature. It includes plant fiber (cotton, kapok, hemp, jute, flax, banana hemp, sisal and coconut shell fiber, etc.), animal fiber (wool, mohair, cashmere, rabbit hair, camel hair, yak hair and silk, etc.) and mineral fiber (asbestos, etc.). Since the middle of the 20th century, due to the rapid growth of synthetic fiber output, the composition of textile raw materials has undergone great changes. Therefore, the proportion of natural fiber in the total annual output of textile fiber has declined year by year. Natural fiber has a variety of excellent clothing properties, mainly used to add T. to various clothing, decoration and T. industrial textiles.

explanation_cn: 天然纤维和基体材料经一定复合工艺组合而成的材料、天然纤维包括植物纤维、矿物纤维和动物纤维.其中应用最多的是织物纤维?如木材、棉纤维、麻纤维、竹纤维等纤维素纤维；矿物纤维主要是指玄武岩纤维、动物纤维（如毛发纤维、甲壳素纤维）等。天然纤维相比于化学纤维具有价格低廉、可降解可再生、对环境无污染等优异性能*且来源广泛.价格低廉。一般天然动植物纤维都有亲水基W，不容易与树脂结合?而且容易吸收环境中水分，导致最终复合材料力学性能的下降，因此使用前应对其进行改性，比如加入表面活性剂或者对纤维做表面处理。目前，天然纤维复合材料主要应用在汽车内部的装潢材料、隔声材料以及汽车零部件等。
explanation_en: Natural fiber and matrix materials are combined by a certain composition process to form materials, natural fiber includes plant fiber, mineral fiber and animal fiber, of which fabric fiber is the most widely used? Such as wood, cotton fiber, bast fiber and leaf fiber fiber, bamboo fiber and other cellulose fibers; Mineral fiber mainly refers to basalt fiber, animal fiber (such as hair fiber, chitin fiber), etc. Compared with chemical fiber, natural fiber has excellent properties such as low price, degradation and renewable, and no pollution to the environment. Generally, natural animal and plant fibers have hydrophilic base W, which is difficult to combine with resin? Moreover, it is easy to absorb water in the environment, which will lead to the decline of the mechanical properties of the final composite materials. Therefore, it should be modified before use, such as adding surfactants or surface treatment of fibers. At present, natural fiber reinforced composite are mainly used in interior decoration materials, acoustic insulation materials and auto parts.

explanation_cn: 指从自然界中的橡胶植物上割取或浸出的含橡胶乳液。天然胶乳化学组成复杂，主要成分为橡胶烃、非橡胶烃和水。橡胶烃占胶乳质量的33%左右，化学成分是线型的顺式聚异戊二烯；非橡胶烃成分主要是蛋白质、糖类及无机盐等。天然胶乳的成膜性能良好，湿凝胶强度高，制品具有优良的弹性、较高的强度、较大伸长率，但耐老化性和耐油性差。天然胶乳可用于制造浸溃制品，如手套、气球、避孕套等，?海绵制品如床垫、减震垫、密封胶条、纯胶或填料板材等；压出制品如胶丝和医用输血胶管；铸模制品如鞋类、医疗制品、玩具等，还可用于纺织，造纸、地毯的黏合剂等。
explanation_en: It refers to lotion containing rubber cut or leached from rubber plants in nature. The chemical composition of natural latex is complex, and the main components are rubber hydrocarbon, non rubber hydrocarbon and water. The hydrocarbon of rubber accounts for about 33% of the mass of latex, and the chemical composition is linear cis polyisoprene; The non rubber hydrocarbon components are mainly proteins, sugars, and inorganic salts. Natural latex has good film forming performance, high wet gel strength, excellent elasticity, high strength, and large elongation, but poor aging resistance and oil resistance. Natural latex can be used to make soaked products, such as gloves, balloons, condoms, etc,? Sponge products such as mattresses, shock absorbers, sealing strips, pure rubber or filler boards, etc; Pressed products such as rubber wire and medical blood transfusion hose; Molded products, such as shoes, medical products, toys, etc., can also be used for textile, paper making, carpet adhesive, etc.

explanation_cn: 自然界中天然存在的铀.其中的富集度为天然丰度。天然铀主要含三种同位素,其含量分别为：238U99.3%,235U0.7%,234U0.006%。所有自然界存在的铀同位素都放射a粒子。铀的化学性质活泼.自然界无纯金属.而是以氧化物、磷酸盐、硫酸盐、硅酸盐和碳酸盐等矿物形式存在。天然金属铀用于制造石墨水冷生产堆、镁诺克斯生产动力两用堆的燃料元件。CANDU型重水动力堆燃料元件采用天然二氧化铀陶瓷芯块。天然铀经过铀同位素分离可以生产出低、中和高富集铀，分别用于动力堆、快堆、研究试验堆和核武器装料。
explanation_en: Uranium naturally exists in nature. Its enrichment degree is natural abundance. Natural uranium mainly contains three isotopes, and their contents are respectively 238U99.3%, 235U0.7% and 234U0.006%. All natural uranium isotopes emit a particle. Uranium has active chemical properties. There is no pure metal in nature. It exists in the form of oxides, phosphates, sulfates, silicates, carbonates and other minerals. Natural metal uranium is used to manufacture fuel element for graphite water-cooled production reactor and Magnox production power dual-use reactor. The fuel element of CANDU heavy water power reactor uses natural uranium dioxide ceramics pellets. Through uranium isotope separation, natural uranium can produce low, medium and high enriched uranium, which is used for power reactor, fast reactor, research and test reactor and nuclear weapon loading respectively.

explanation_cn: 是没有经过人工合成的.天然存在于自然界（如动物、植物和微生物内）的大分子有机化合物。天然高分子包括多糖类(淀粉、纤维素、果胶等）、蛋白质、天然橡胶、多核苷酸、木质素和其他混杂天然高分子等。
explanation_en: It is a macromolecule organic compound that has not been artificially synthesized and naturally exists in nature (such as animals, plants and microorganisms). Natural polymer include polysaccharides (starch, cellulose, pectin, etc.), proteins, natural rubber, polynucleotides, lignin and other hybrid natural polymer.

explanation_cn: 天然胶乳经甲基丙烯酸甲酯接枝共聚制得的胶乳。用这种胶乳制得的膜具有良好的耐磨性、耐弯曲性、耐动态疲劳性和耐老化性能，主要用来制造要求具有良好冲击性能的坚硬制品.无内胎轮胎中不透气的内贴层，合成纤维与橡胶黏合的强力胶黏剂等。
explanation_en: Natural latex is prepared by graft copolymerization of methyl methacrylate. The film made from this latex has good wear resistance, bending resistance, dynamic fatigue resistance and aging resistance. It is mainly used to manufacture hard products that require good impact performance, airtight inner layer in tubeless tires, strong adhesive for adhesion of synthetic fiber and rubber, etc.

explanation_cn: 日本陶瓷界对中国黑柚的通称。中国宋代流行以福建建窑为代表的黑釉茶盏。相传当时浙江天目山佛教寺庙林立，日本僧人至天目山留学，返国时常带回天目山寺庙所用之建窑黑柚盏，这种"天目茶盏"在日本成为时尚.因此日本人把黑袖称为天目柚。天目釉是以大量铁为着色剂的袖。其釉质润泽，釉色乌黑，多数釉面呈现条纹与斑块.有明显的垂流厚挂和窑变现象^天ü釉外观变化无穷，有素天目（即普通黑釉）、曜变、红油滴、银油滴、金兔毫、银兔毫、灰兔毫、木叶天目、星盏、玳瑁、鹧鸪斑、黄天目、灰被等品种。其中以曜变天[：!最为名贵。普通黑釉和各种天ü釉的含铁量都很高，介于3%?9%之间。油滴釉和兔毫釉都是赤铁矿或磁铁矿晶体在黑釉中析出而成，结晶尺寸很小，成堆成蔟地聚合在一起，一般要在显微镜下才能看清结晶的形状。结晶体颜色常见的有红色和银色两种，其色调变化与烧成时窑中气氛性质有关。吉州窑的剪纸天目、木叶天目、玳瑁、鹧鸪斑都由底袖和面釉构成：这两种釉的成分、着色剂、熔融温度和流动性都不一样，在高温下熔融后它们相互作用.便形成各种不同色调和形状的斑点、流纹或图案。
explanation_en: Japanese ceramics generally refer to Chinese black pomelo. The black glaze tea cup represented by Fujian Jianyao was popular in the Song Dynasty of China. According to legend, there were numerous Buddhist temples in Tianmu Mountain, Zhejiang Province at that time. Japanese monks went to study in Tianmu Mountain and often brought back the black pomelo cup used in the construction of the Tianmu Mountain temple when they returned home. This "Tianmu tea cup" became fashionable in Japan, so the Japanese referred to the black sleeve as Tianmu pomelo. Temmoku glaze is a sleeve with a large amount of iron as colorant. The glaze is moist and black, and most of the glaze presents stripes and patches. There are obvious vertical flow, thick hanging and kiln change phenomena. The appearance of glaze changes endlessly, including Su Tianmu (i.e. ordinary black glaze), Yao Bian, red oil drop, silver oil drop, gold rabbit hair, silver rabbit hair, gray rabbit hair, wood leaf Tianmu, star lamp, hawksbill, partridge spot, yellow Tianmu, gray quilt and other varieties. Among them, the sky changes with Yao [:! It is the most precious. The iron content of ordinary black glaze and all kinds of tian ü glaze is very high, between 3% and 9%. The oil drop glaze and rabbit hair glaze are both hematite or magnetite crystal precipitated in the black glaze. The crystal size is very small, and they are clustered together in piles. The crystal shape can be seen clearly under the microscope. The crystal color is commonly red and silver, and its color change is related to the nature of the kiln atmosphere at the time of firing Paper Cuttings tianmu, wood leaf tianmu, hawksbill and partridge spot are all composed of bottom sleeve and surface glaze: the composition, colorant, melting temperature and flow ability of the two glaze are different, and after melting at high temperature, they interact to form spots, streaks or patterns of different colors and shapes.

explanation_cn: 具附加阴离子的复杂岛状结构磷酸盐矿物。单斜晶系。晶体呈尖锥状或板状，集合体呈粒状或致密块状。天蓝、蓝白、深蓝、蓝绿色。玻璃光泽。产于花岗伟晶岩或石英脉中；亦产于片右中，与蓝晶石、刚玉、矽线石、金红石、石榴子石等共生。因化学性质稳定，也常见于砂矿中。色艳者叶作为宝石矿物和工艺雕刻的材料。
explanation_en: Complex island like phosphate minerals with additional anions. Monoclinic system. The crystal are tapered or tabular, and the aggregates are granular or compact. Sky blue, blue white, deep blue, and blue green. Glass lustre. It occurs in granite pegmatite or quartz vein; It is also produced in the middle of the right side of the sheet and coexists with kyanite, corundum, sillimanite, rutile, garnet, etc. It is also common in placer ores due to its stable chemical properties. Colorful leaves are used as materials for gems mineral and craft carving.

explanation_cn: 简单岛状结构硫酸盐矿物。常有钙、钡代替锶。晶体呈板状或柱状；集合体呈粒状、板状、纤维状，有时呈钟乳状、结核状。浅蓝色.有时无色透明。玻璃光泽.在紫外线下发荧光。主要产于石灰岩、白S岩、泥灰岩和含石膏黏土岩里.系沉积作用的产物；也产于热液矿床和基性喷出岩的洞穴之中。是提取锶的主要矿物原料。
explanation_en: Sulfate minerals with simple island like structures. Calcium and barium often replace strontium. The crystal is in plate or column shape; Aggregates are granular, tabular, fibrous, and sometimes bell shaped or nodular. Light blue. Sometimes colorless and transparent. Glass luster, fluorescence under ultraviolet light. It mainly occurs in limestone, white S rock, marl and gypsum bearing clay rock. It is the product of sedimentation; It also occurs in hydrothermal deposits and caves of basic extrusive rock. It is the main raw mineral material for strontium extraction.

explanation_cn: 学名季戊四醇四硝酸酯.常用代号PETN,太安是俄文T3H的音译，白色结晶，不吸湿.室温下不挥发。不溶于水.微溶于苯、甲苯、甲醇.乙醇、环己醇等，溶于丙酮、乙酸及乙酸乙酯等.密度L77g/cm3(22°C),纯品熔点142.91：.丨：业品熔点（140.5士0.5)°(：.爆发点225°C(Ss)。密度l.?0g/cra3_时的爆热为6.32MJ/kg(气态水）：密度UOg/cnv*时的爆速为8.30km/s;密度i._6_7g/êm3时的爆压为31.|?GP_a;密度1.77g/cm3时的爆温约4200K;密度1.65g/cm3时的全爆容为790L/kf；.撞击感度100%(10kg.25cm)，摩擦感度92%(摆角90°)，做功能力523mL(铅墙扩孔值）或M5%(TNT当量），猛度22mm(铅柱压缩值）或145%(TNT当量）。150°0下半分解期157min。用浓硝酸硝化季戊四醇制得。在太安表面包覆一层钝感剂（如石蜡），制得钝化太安.其机械感度较低。主要用于混合炸药、导爆索、传爆药柱和雷管装药。
explanation_en: The scientific name is pentaerythritol tetranitrate. The common code is PETN. penthrite is a transliteration of Russian T3H, white crystal, non hygroscopic, and non volatile at room temperature. Insoluble in water, slightly soluble in benzene, toluene, methanol, ethanol, cyclohexanol, etc., soluble in acetone, acetic acid, ethyl acetate, etc. density L77g/cm3 (22 ° C), pure melting point 142.91: |: melting point of industrial product (140.5 ± 0.5) ° (:. explosion tcmperature 225 ° C (Ss). A layer of deterrent (such as paraffin) is coated on the surface of penthrite to produce passivation penthrite, which has low mechanical sensitivity. It is mainly used for composite explosive, detonating cord, booster charge and detonator charging.

explanation_cn: 由太安和梯恩梯组成的熔铸混合炸药，又称喷托莱特。其主要品种组成为太安/梯恩梯TO/30、50/50及10/90等。太梯炸药的爆轰感度和机械感度均较高。热安定性逊于黑索今.结晶密度也比黑索今低.且易渗油.故综合性能不如黑梯炸药。爆发点为220°C(5s),50/50太梯炸药（密度为1.71g/cm3)的爆炸能量与特屈儿相近，爆热为5.lOMJ/kg,爆速为7.52km/S(密度为1.64g/cm3);当密度为1.68g/cm3时爆压28.OGPa、爆容为815L/kg,做功能力120%(TNT当量）。87/13的太安/梯恩梯形成低共培物.共熔点为76°C。太梯炸药用淤浆法和共沉淀法生产，曾广泛用于装填破甲弹，但目前已不再用于装填弹药。
explanation_en: The fused cast composite explosive composed of penthrite and 2,4,6-trinitrotoluene is also called Pentolet. The main varieties are penthrite/TNT TO/30, 50/50 and 10/90. Pentolit has high detonation sensitivity and mechanical sensitivity. Its thermal stability is inferior to that of RDX, its crystalline density is also lower than that of RDX, and it is easy to leak oil, so its comprehensive performance is inferior to that of black ladder explosive. The explosion tcmperature is 220 ° C (5s), the explosion energy of 50/50 pentolit (density is 1.71g/cm3) is similar to that of tetryl, the explosion heat is 5.lOMJ/kg, and the detonation velocity is 7.52km/S (density is 1.64g/cm3); When the density is 1.68g/cm3, the explosion pressure is 28.OGPa, the explosion capacity is 815L/kg, and the work capacity is 120% (TNT equivalent). 87/13 of penthrite/2,4,6-trinitrotoluene formed a low co culture with a total melting point of 76 ° C. Pentolit is produced by slurry method and co precipitation method. It was once widely used to load armour piercing bombs, but it is no longer used to load ammunition.

explanation_cn: 又称窟窿石、假山石，是一种石灰岩。为我国古代著名的四大玩石、奇石之一(英石、太湖石、灵璧石、黄蜡石），因盛产于太湖地区而古今闻名.是一种玲珑剔透的观赏石。以甴色为多，少有青黑、黄色，尤其黄色的更为稀少。适宜布置公园、草坪、校园、庭院旅游景色等，有很高的观赏价值。
explanation_en: Also known as hole stone and rockery stone, it is a kind of limestone. It is one of the four famous antique stones and rare stones in ancient China (Yingshi, the Taihu Lake Stone, Lingbi Stone and Xanthophyllite). It is famous for being rich in the Taihu Lake Lake. It is a kind of exquisite ornamental stone. Mostly in orange color, there are few cyan black or yellow, especially those with yellow are even rarer. explanation_cn: 太阳电池对环境非常敏感，而其应用环境又都在户外，为了延长其使用寿命必须将太阳电池密封起来，以隔绝外界环境的影响，延长使用寿命。封装材料必须满足如下要求：具有满足需求的机械强度；透光性能良好；能隔绝环境侵蚀（酸、碱、盐、水汽等）；减弱紫外线的辐照强度；耐高电压击穿。太阳电池封装主要包括以下几种：玻璃、背板材料、密封塑料。玻璃能够很好地满足上述对封装材料提出的主要需求。为了提髙透过率，目前产业上使用的主要是超白玻璃，并在玻璃表面进行织构化处理，典型的透过率大于90%。为了提髙其机械强度，玻璃须经钢化处理。密封塑料使用乙烯-醋酸乙烯酯共聚物（EVA)。在太阳电池组件制备过程中，封装工艺就是使用层压机将EVA融化凝固。封装后的EVA具有隔绝环境气氛影响的作用，同时也具有一定的电绝缘特性。背板为多层的含氟材料，一种典型的背板材料TPT膜包括两层聚氟乙烯（PVF)膜中间夹一层涤纶树脂（PET),具有很强的耐候性，也具有耐受1000V电压的绝缘特性"对于薄膜电池需要不同的封装材料，主要是背板材料的阻水性要求高很多，为了进一步加强背板材料的阻水特性，须在背板中再增加一层铝箔。但是为了降低成本，薄膜电池通常采用双玻璃夹层的组件封装模式。
explanation_en: Solar cell are very sensitive to the environment, and their application environment is outdoors. In order to extend their service life, solar cell must be sealed to isolate the impact of the external environment and extend their service life. The packaging materials must meet the following requirements: have the required mechanical strength; Good transparency; Able to isolate environmental erosion (acid, alkali, salt, water vapor, etc.); Reduce the intensity of ultraviolet radiation; High voltage breakdown resistance. Solar cell packaging mainly includes the following: glass, backplane materials, and sealed plastics. Glass can well meet the above main requirements for packaging materials. In order to improve the transmissivity, ultra white glass is mainly used in the industry at present, and texture treatment is carried out on the surface of glass. The typical transmissivity is more than 90%. In order to improve its mechanical strength, glass must be tempered. Seal plastics with ethylene-vinylacetatecopolymer (EVA). In the preparation process of solar cell modules, the packaging process is to use a laminator to melt and solidify EVA. The encapsulated EVA has the function of isolating the influence of environmental atmosphere, and also has certain electrical insulation characteristics. The backplane is a multi-layer fluorinated materials. A typical materials of the backplane, TPT film, consists of two layers of polyvinyl fluoride (PVF) film sandwiched with a layer of polyester resin (PET), which has strong weather resistance, It also has the insulation characteristic of withstanding 1000V voltage. "For thin film batteries, different packaging materials are required, mainly because the water resistance of the materials of the backplane is much higher. In order to further strengthen the water resistance of the materials of the backplane, an additional layer of aluminum foil must be added to the backplane. However, in order to reduce costs, thin film batteries usually use the module packaging mode of double glass interlayer.

name_cn: 太阳电池用金属电极浆料
explanation_cn: 在太阳电池上制备电极用的浆料。按照材料的种类区分，有三种电极浆料，分别为：制备迎光的前表面电极的银浆料，制备背表面电极的铝浆料，制备背表面主栅线的银浆料。前表面银浆料的成分主要为微米量级的银颗粒，包括各种玻璃料、黏合剂和稀释剂等。玻璃料包括氧化硅、氧化铅、氧化硼、氧化铍等等，这些氧化物颗粒的主要作用是对硅片表面的钝化膜--氮化硅以及硅材料本身进行腐蚀.以使银颗粒到达硅片表面；此外玻璃料还通过氧化还原反应溶解银和铅等金属，使之与硅原子在高温下形成液态的合金，并在烧结的降温阶段析出，形成很好的半导体与金属的欧姆接触。黏合剂主要为一些树脂类的材料，如乙基纤维素等；稀释剂主要是一些具有稀释与分散作用的化学试剂，如乙二醇等。黏合剂的作用主要是使银颗粒具有一定的黏性.稀释剂的作用主要是提供浆料的流动性，以便于进行丝网印刷。背表面的铝浆主要成分为微米量级的铝颗粒，也包括各种玻璃料、黏合剂与稀释剂。在高温烧结过程中，铝与硅发生熔融反应，在降温阶段，在接近背面硅体内有大量的铝原子，形成重掺杂的P-区域，该区域起到背场的作用。在P+铝背场区域的外面有-层较厚的铝硅合金，起到很好的欧姆接触的作用，再靠外层就是烧干的铝电极区域。背表面铝的导电性较差，而且与焊带的焊接特性不好，因此要在背表面与金属焊接的条带位置处制备条状的银栅线电极。金属栅线浆料的特性直接影响着电池的输出特性，在提高晶体硅太阳电池效率方面起到了非常重要的作用。太阳能电池参见太阳电池
explanation_en: The slurry for preparing electrodes on solar cell. According to the types of materials, there are three kinds of electrode pastes: silver paste for preparing the front surface electrode facing the light, aluminum paste for preparing the back surface electrode, and silver paste for preparing the main grid line on the back surface. The silver paste on the front surface is mainly composed of silver particles of micron size, including various glass frits, adhesive and diluents. Glass frits include silicon oxide, lead oxide, boron oxide, beryllia, etc. The main role of these oxide particles is to corrosion the passive film on the surface of silicon wafer -- silicon nitride and the silicon material itself, so that silver particles can reach the surface of silicon wafer; In addition, the glass frit dissolves silver, lead and other metals through redox reaction to form liquid alloy with silicon atoms at high temperature, and precipitates in the cooling stage of sintering to form good ohmic contact between semiconductor and metal. Adhesive are mainly materials of some resin, such as thyl cellulose, etc; Diluents are mainly chemical reagents with dilution and dispersion effects, such as ethylene glycol. The role of adhesive is to make silver particles have a certain viscosity. The role of diluents is to provide flow ability of slurry for screen printing. The aluminum slurry on the back surface is mainly composed of micron sized aluminum particles, as well as various glass frits, adhesive and diluents. In the process of high temperature sintering, aluminum and silicon melt. In the cooling stage, there are a large number of aluminum atoms in the body near the back side of the silicon, forming a heavily doped P-region, which plays the role of the back field. There is a thick layer of aluminum silicon alloy outside the P+aluminum back field area, which plays a good role in ohmic contact, and then the outer layer is the burned out aluminum electrode area. The conductivity of aluminum on the back surface is poor, and the weld characteristics with the welding strip are not good, so it is necessary to prepare a strip shaped silver grid wire electrode at the strip position of the back surface weld with the metal. The characteristics of metal gate wire paste directly affect the output characteristics of the battery, and plays a very important role in improving the efficiency of crystalline silicon solar cell. Solar cell See solar cell

explanation_cn: 在太阳电池的前表面外加上聚光系统可以提高照射到电池上太阳光的能量密度，使得具有同样面积的太阳电池转化出更多的能量，减少太阳电池的用量。对于有些高转化效率、高成本的太阳电池，如砷化镓类的DI-V族太阳电池。这种聚光系统尤其有效。从原理上讲，聚光系统主要是一种凸透镜，形状可以是球面形的，也可以是柱面形的。对于长期运行在室外条件下的太阳电池系统，最好使用耐候性较强的聚烯烃塑料制成。由于这种材料可以注压成型，因此可以设计出各种形状的聚光器，这种使用塑料注压成型的聚光器又称菲涅耳透镜。在聚光器的焦平面上放置太阳电池，为了确保太阳电池均匀地发电，要确保太阳电池平面上各处的能量密度均匀，也不能在电池表面产生色差，这对聚光器形状的设计提出了较高的要求。由于聚焦在太阳电池表面的光能量密度较高，会使表面发热严重，因此对于高倍聚光系统，需要在电池背表面连接散热装置。聚光器的倍数可以从数倍到数千倍。太阳电池聚光系统还需要跟踪器?以确保焦斑始终落在电池表面。
explanation_en: Adding a concentrating system to the front surface of the solar cell can improve the energy density of the sunlight on the battery, so that solar cell with the same area can convert more energy and reduce the consumption of solar cell. For some solar cell with high conversion efficiency and high cost, such as gallium arsenide DI-V family solar cell. This type of spotlight system is particularly effective. In principle, a spotlight system is mainly a convex lens, which can be spherical or cylindrical in shape. For solar cell systems that operate outdoors for a long time, it is best to use polyolefin plastics with strong weather resistance. Since this materials can be molded by injection molding, it is possible to design condensers of various shapes. This kind of condenser using plastics injection molding is also called Fresnel lens. Place solar cell on the focal plane of the concentrator. In order to ensure that the solar cell generate electricity evenly, it is necessary to ensure that the energy density is uniform everywhere on the solar cell plane, and no color difference can be generated on the cell surface, which puts forward higher requirements for the design of the concentrator shape. Since the energy density of the light focused on the surface of the solar cell is high, it will cause serious heating on the surface. Therefore, for the high power concentrating system, it is necessary to connect a heat dissipation device on the back surface of the battery. The multiplier of a condenser can range from several times to thousands of times. Does concentrator system of solar cell still need tracker? To ensure that the focal spot always falls on the surface of the battery.

explanation_cn: 太阳能级硅材料是指具有适当的纯度可用于制备太阳电池的晶体硅材料，一般指纯度在6个9(99.9999%)以上的高纯硅材料。工业中应用的硅是从天然的硅氧化物中提纯出来的，太阳电池用的硅材料的最低杂质浓度的要求如下表：杂质指标Fe，A1，Ca，Ti，天然存在的含硅氧化物通过碳热还原法可将氧化硅还原成纯度大于98.5%以上的硅，称为冶金硅或金属硅。在此基础上可以通过两类方法将冶金硅进一步提纯为太阳能级硅，一种方法称为化学法，它主要是在西门子法的基础上改进而形成的；另一种方法是物理法或冶金法（见相关词条）。西门子法提纯的主要思想是将冶金硅材料与一些含有氯和氢的化学物质反应，合成液态或气态的硅氢化合物，然后使用化学工业中常用的分馏方法将这些硅氢化合物提纯到一定的纯度，最后将具有高纯度的单一硅氢化合物通人一种高温反应器中，使得该种氢化物在高温下分解沉积得到高纯度的硅材料。这种西门子法可以得到高达11个9的纯度（99.999999999%)，但是太阳电池产业的纯度要求低得多.因此可以减少分馏塔的级数以降低最终硅材料的纯度，这样做所带来的好处就是降低了硅材料的成本。
explanation_en: Solar grade silicon refers to crystal silicon material with appropriate purity that can be used to prepare solar cells, and generally refers to high-purity silicon material with purity of more than six nines (99.9999%). Silicon used in industry is purified from natural silicon oxide. The requirements for the minimum impurity concentration of silicon materials for solar cell are shown in the following table: impurity indicators Fe, A1, Ca, Ti. Natural silicon containing oxides can reduce silicon oxide to silicon with purity greater than 98.5% by carbothermal reduction method, which is called metallurgical silicon or metal silicon. On this basis, metallurgical silicon can be further purified into solar grade silicon by two methods. One method is called chemical method, which is mainly formed on the basis of Siemens method; Another method is the physical or metallurgical method (see relevant terms). The main idea of Siemens purification method is to react metallurgical silicon materials with some chemical substances containing chlorine and hydrogen to synthesize liquid or gaseous silicon hydrogen compounds. Then, the commonly used fractionation methods in the chemical industry are used to purify these silicon hydrogen compounds to a certain degree of purity. Finally, a single high-purity silicon hydrogen compound is introduced into a high-temperature reactor, allowing the hydride to decompose and deposit at high temperatures to obtain high-purity silicon materials. This Siemens method can achieve a purity of up to 11 nines (99.9999999999%), but the purity requirements of the solar cell industry are much lower. Therefore, the number of fractionators can be reduced to reduce the purity of the final silicon material. The benefit of doing so is to reduce the cost of silicon materials.

explanation_cn: 研究构件在外部条件(或环境）作用下，发生断裂、磨损、腐蚀、变形等而失去其原有功能的失效行为的特征和规律，从而找出失效的模式和原因。由不同材料制成的各类机电产品或微电子元件和仪器仪表，在外部条件（或坏境）作用下，发生断裂、磨损、腐蚀、变形等而失去其原有功能的现象称为失效。失效有时是突发性的，如构件的断裂、运转失灵等，有时是渐进性的.如材料的腐蚀、磨损或老化等。失效不但发生于机械装置，也发生于仪器仪表、微电子元件。失效分析就是研究失效现象的特征和规律.从而找出失效的模式和原因。
explanation_en: To study the characteristics and laws of the failure behavior of components that lose their original functions due to fracture, wear, corrosion, deformation, etc. under the action of external conditions (or environment), so as to find out the failure mode and cause. All kinds of electromechanical products or microelectronic components and instruments made of different materials lose their original functions due to fracture, wear, corrosion, deformation, etc. under the action of external conditions (or bad environment). Sometimes the failure is sudden, such as fracture and operation failure of components, and sometimes progressive, such as corrosion, wear or aging of materials. Failure not only occurs in mechanical devices, but also in instruments and microelectronic components. Failure analysis is to study the characteristics and laws of failure phenomena so as to find out the failure modes and causes.

explanation_cn: 超导体具有零电阻特性和迈斯纳(Meissner)效应两大基本特性。温度、磁场及电流中的任一参数超过临界值.超导体都会失去超导电性，成为常导体，此过程称为失超。保持超导体的工作温度不变，只有当流过超导体的电流降到临界电流以下时，超导体才能稳定地恢复为超导态。失超通常用于表示超导磁体系统由于励磁电流或者温度过高导致其超导线材失去超导电性而发生的现象。
explanation_en: Superconductors have two basic characteristics: zero resistance and Meissner effect. If any parameter in temperature, magnetic field and current exceeds the critical value, superconductors will lose superconductivity and become normal conductors, which is called quench. Keep the working temperature of the superconductor unchanged. Only when the current flowing through the superconductor drops below the critical current, can the superconductor return to the superconducting state state stably. Quench is usually used to indicate the phenomenon that superconducting magnet system loses superconductivity of its superconducting wire rod due to high excitation current or temperature.

explanation_cn: 超导磁体在没有保护的情况下，一旦发生失超，会对整个磁体系统造成不可逆的破坏性影响。为了避免磁体发生这种破坏性的影响，需要对超导磁体设计一套保护系统.使其在发生失超时，能量能够迅速排除，避免对磁体造成破坏。
explanation_en: Without protection, once quench occurs in the superconducting magnet, it will cause irreversible destructive effects on the whole magnet system. In order to avoid this destructive effect on the magnet, it is necessary to design a set of protection system for the superconducting magnet, so that the energy can be quickly removed in case of timeout, avoiding damage to the magnet.

explanation_en: Also known as sandwich structure skin, it is a part of sandwich structure. It is usually a thin layered materials with high strength placed on the surface of the sandwich structure. The panel materials mainly includes metallic materials such as aluminum alloy and titanium alloy, and composite materials laminates reinforced by carbon fiber, glass fiber, aramid or hybrid fiber. It is the main carrier in the sandwich structure, mainly bearing in-plane tensile stress and compressive stress.

explanation_cn: 两层薄钢板之间夹有一层塑料或树脂材料夹层的钢板，可分为复合减振钢板（阻尼钢板）和复合塑料夹层钢板。
explanation_en: A layer of plastics or resin materials sandwich steel plate sandwiched between two layers of thin steel plate can be divided into composition damping steel plate (damping steel plate) and composition plastics sandwich steel sheet.

explanation_cn: 种复合线材制备方法，常用于制备超导线材前驱体。该方法是将一种金属棒材插进另一种金属管中，然后将其加工成线材；将所获得的线材进行二次组装再拉拔，可以获得多芯线材。通过热处理后，两种金属发生反应生成所需要的物质。通过改变金属棒的直径或者金属管的壁厚可以调整两种物质的量。
explanation_en: The invention relates to a method for preparing composite wire rod, which is commonly used for preparing the precursor of super wire material. The method is to insert one metal bar into another metal tube, and then process it into wire rod; Multi core wire rod can be obtained by secondary assembly and drawing of the obtained wire rod. After heat treatment, the two metals react to produce the required substances. The amount of both substances can be adjusted by changing the diameter of the metal rod or the wall thickness of the metal tube.

explanation_cn: 奥克托今（HMX），也称奥克托金、奥托金，是现今军事上使用的综合性能最好的炸药，具有八元环的硝胺结构，化学名“环四亚甲基四硝胺”。
explanation_en: Octogen (HMX), also known as Octogen and Octogen, is the explosive with the best comprehensive performance used in the military today. It has an eight membered ring nitramine structure and its chemical name is "cyclotetramethylene tetranitramine".

explanation_cn: 室温组织为稳定的奥氏体（面心立方结构）組织的不锈钢，不能通过基体的固态相变来使其强化。奥氏体不锈钢一般无磁性，无冷脆现象。由于奥氏体不锈钢具有优良的耐蚀性和适当的综合力学性能，因而获得广泛应用。
explanation_en: Stainless steel with stable austenite (face-centered cubic structure) at room temperature cannot be strengthened by solid phase transformation of matrix. Austenilic stainless steel generally has no magnetism and cold brittleness. Austenilic stainless steel is widely used because of its excellent corrosion resistance and appropriate comprehensive mechanical properties.

explanation_cn: 奥氏体化是钢铁材料热处理的基本过程，是随后发生奥氏体-铁素体相变的基础。奥氏体化大致分为四个阶段：奥氏体晶核形成、奥氏体晶核长大、残余铁素体转变（亚共析钢）及残余碳化物溶解（过共析钢）、奥氏体均匀化。
explanation_en: Austenitization is the basic process of heat treatment of steel materials and the basis of the subsequent austenite ferrite phase transformation. Austenitization can be roughly divided into four stages: austenite nucleation formation, austenite nucleation growth, residual ferrite transformation (hypo-eutectoid steel) and residual carbide dissolution (hypereutectoid steel), and austenite homogenization.

explanation_cn: 适合采取奥氏体形变热处理工艺获得高强度、高韧性和优良疲劳忡能的合金结构钢。奥氏体形变热处理钢广泛应用于航空、兵器、车辆r程的弹簧、轴类、高强度紧固件等。
explanation_en: Alloy structural steel with high strength, high toughness and excellent fatigue energy can be obtained by austenite deformation heat treatment process. Ausforming steel is widely used in aviation, weapons, vehicle R - way springs, axles, high-strength fasteners, etc.

explanation_cn: 含有较高的镍、锰、氮等奥氏体形成元素，常温下具有奥氏体组织的耐热钢。奥氏体耐热钢主要利用高温稳定元素如Mo、W、V、Ti、Nb等强化基体组织，利用弥散分布的、高温下不易聚集长大的碳化物或金属间化合物沉淀析出使钢进一步强化。
explanation_en: It is a heat resistant steel with high content of nickel, manganese, nitrogen and other austenite forming elements and austenite structure at room temperature. Austenitic heat-resistant steel mainly uses high-temperature stable elements such as Mo, W, V, Ti, Nb, etc. to strengthen the matrix structure, and further strengthens steel by using the precipitation precipitation of carbide or imermetallif compound that is dispersed and not easy to gather and grow at high temperature.

explanation_cn: 使用态组织为奥氏体的钢。在钢中加人足够量的扩大奥氏体区或增加奥氏体稳定性的元素如Ni、Mn、Co、N、Cu、C等使奥氏体在室温甚至低温下成为稳定相，可得到奥氏体钢。奥氏体具有密排的面心立方晶体结构，致密度高，耐蚀性比铁素体好。奥氏体钢广泛用作耐浊性优良的不锈钢；铁原子在奥氏体中的自扩散激活能明显大于在铁素体中的自扩散激活能，相同温度下铁原子不容易扩散使得其热强性较高.故奥氏体钢广泛用作耐热钢；奥氏体基本无磁性，因而奥氏体钢也是无磁钢。
explanation_en: As used steel with austenitic structure. Add enough elements such as Ni, Mn, Co, N, Cu, C, etc. to expand the austenite zone or increase the stability of austenite in steel to make austenite become a stable phase at room temperature or even low temperature, and austenitic steel can be obtained. Austenite has a close packed face centered cubic crystal structure, high efficiency of spare filling and better corrosion resistance than ferrite. Austenitic steel is widely used as stainless steel with excellent turbidity resistance; The self-diffusion activation energy of iron atoms in austenite is significantly greater than that of self-diffusion atoms in iron. At the same temperature, iron atoms are not easy to diffusion, which makes them have high thermal strength. Therefore, austenitic steel is widely used as heat resistant steel; Austenite is basically non-magnetic, so austenitic steel is also a non-magnetic steel.
