explanation_en: See poly (tridecane diacyl tridecane diamine) resin.

explanation_cn: 见聚己二酰丁二胺树脂。
explanation_en: See polytetramethylene adipamide resin.

explanation_cn: 见聚己白酰胺树脂。
explanation_en: See polyhexylamide resin.

explanation_cn: 含有癸二酰与己二胺交替相连结构的聚酰胺热塑性树脂，外观半透明奶白色，能耐强碱及弱酸，不耐浓无机酸，可溶于酚类和甲酸中。由癸二酸与己二胺缩聚制得。可以采用注塑、挤塑、喷涂和柚丝等方法成沏加工。可制作尺寸稳定件要求高的制品。应用于机械、纺织、交通运输等行业。如汽车与拖拉机中的齿轮、衬垫、密封材料、输油管、轴承等。
explanation_en: The polyamide thermoplastic resin containing sebacic acid and hexamethylene diamine alternately connected structure is translucent and milky white in appearance, resistant to strong alkali and weak acid, not resistant to concentrated inorganic acid, and soluble in phenols and formic acid. Prepared by condensation polymerization of sebacic acid and adipic acid. Injection molding, extrusion, spraying, and pomelo silk can be used for brewing processing. Can produce products with high requirements for dimensional stability. Applied in industries such as machinery, textiles, transportation, etc. Such as gears, gaskets, sealing materials, oil pipes, bearings, etc. in automobiles and tractors.

explanation_cn: 含有十二烷二酰与己二胺交替相连结构的聚酰胺热塑性树脂，外观呈半透明奶白色。可采用挤塑、模压、浇铸、喷涂和抽丝等成型方法加工。广泛应用于机电、交通、纺织等行业。制作机械性能和尺寸稳定性要求较高的制品。如枪托、弹药箱、火箭尾翼件、精密机械部件等。
explanation_en: The polyamide thermoplastic resin containing dodecyl and hexamethylene diamine alternately connected structure has a translucent milky white appearance. It can be processed by extrusion, molding, casting, spraying and wire drawing. Widely used in industries such as electromechanical, transportation, and textile. Make products with high requirements for mechanical properties and dimensional stability. Such as gun stock, ammunition box, rocket tail parts, precision mechanical components, etc.

explanation_cn: 见聚己二酰己二胺树脂
explanation_en: See polyhexamethylene adipamide resin

explanation_cn: 又称聚氨基庚酸聚合物。属聚酰胺类热塑性树脂。由氨基庚酸在水溶液中于氮气气氛下聚合制得-吋采用注塑、挤出、模压、抽丝等方法成型加工，用于机械、汽车、交通、化工、电子及纺织等行业，如制作齿轮、吸湿性好的纤维、电器壳体、线圈骨架等。
explanation_en: It is also called polyaminoheptanoic acid polymer. It belongs to polyamide thermoplastic resin. Produced by polymerization of aminoheptanoic acid in aqueous solution under nitrogen atmosphere, it is molded and processed using injection molding, extrusion, molding, and drawing methods. It is used in industries such as machinery, automobiles, transportation, chemical engineering, electronics, and textiles, such as making gears, fibers with good moisture absorption, electrical housing, coil frames, etc.

explanation_cn: 辛白酰胺或8-氨基辛酸聚合物，属聚酰胺类热塑性树脂。又称聚8-氨基辛酸。其熔融温度低，能溶于酒精，对挥发性烃类有良好的阻透性，相对密度1.09，熔融温度200-205°C。伸长率38%。由氨基辛酸加热聚合或辛白酰胺水解开环聚合制得。可采用注塑、挤出、抽丝、喷涂等方法成型加工。用于航空、机电等行业。可制作模制品和纤维。也可作热封材料。如用尼龙8浸渍过的尼龙纤维薄板作飞机的燃油箱。
explanation_en: Octanolamide or 8-aminooctanoic acid polymer, belonging to polyamide thermoplastic resin. Also known as poly8-aminooctanoic acid. Its melting temperature is low, it is soluble in alcohol, and has good permeability resistance to volatile hydrocarbons. Its relative density is 1.09, and its melting temperature is 200-205 ° C. Elongation rate 38%. It is prepared by heating polymerization of amino octanoic acid or hydrolytic ring opening polymerization of octyl leucamide. Injection molding, extrusion, wire drawing, spraying and other methods can be used for molding and processing. Used in industries such as aviation and electromechanical. Can produce molded products and fibers. It can also be used as heat sealing materials. For example, polyoctanoyllactam resin impregnated nylon resin fiber sheet is used as fuel tank of aircraft.

explanation_cn: 见聚-氨基壬酸。
explanation_en: See poly (aminononanoic acid).

explanation_cn: 把从电堆阳极排出的尾气中的氢气去掉的反应器。它一般是通过催化氢气和空气中的氧气的化学反应来实现。阳极尾气排放的频率一般在每分钟一'次左右.所以反应必须在lmin左右彻底成;为此，尾气处理器中需要催化剂如Pt等，并制成多孔结构以加大反应总表面积。
explanation_en: A reactor that removes hydrogen from the tail gas discharged from the anode of a stack. It is generally achieved by catalyzing a chemical reaction between hydrogen and oxygen in the air. The frequency of anode exhaust emissions is generally around once per minute, so the reaction must be completely completed within about 1 minute; For this reason, catalysts such as Pt are needed in the tail gas oxidizer and made into porous structures to increase the total reaction surface area.

explanation_cn: 安装在汽车排气管内的微粒捕集器（dieselparticulatefilter;DPF)中采用的过滤体材料。尾气过滤材料主要分为三大类：陶瓷基、金属基和新型过滤体材料。常用的陶瓷基过滤材料有堇青石蜂窝陶瓷、泡沫陶瓷、编织陶瓷纤维等;金属基过滤材料如金属丝网、金属纤维毡等。金属基材料强度高，能耐高温，抗腐蚀性好，但其过滤效率较低;新型过滤材料常见的有新型碳化硅、紊流金属载体、炭化微米木纤维。新型碳化硅材料及紊流金属载体等相对于传统材料表现出更加优异的性能。炭化微米纤维绿色环保、成本低廉、过滤效率高，是一种比较有前途的过滤体材料。
explanation_en: The filter materials used in the diesel particulate filter (DPF) installed in the automobile exhaust pipe. Tail gas filter materials are mainly divided into three categories: ceramics based, metal based and new filter materials. Common ceramics based filtering materials include cordierite honeycomb ceramics, foam ceramics, woven ceramics fibers, etc; Metal based filter materials, such as metal wire mesh, metal fiber felt, etc. Metal based materials have high strength, high temperature resistance and good corrosion resistance, but their filtration efficiency is low; The common new filter materials are new silicon carbide, turbulent metal carrier and carbonization micron wood fiber. New silicon carbide materials and turbulent metal carriers show more excellent performance than traditional materials. Carbonization micron fiber is a kind of promising filter body materials with green environment protection, low cost and high filtration efficiency.

explanation_cn: 与晶体中杂质或缺陷相联系的电子态。完整晶体中电子波函数为布洛赫（Bloch)波，即电子在整个晶体范围内作共有化运动，称扩展态（extended state)。相反，局域电子态在实空间中局限于一定区域。半导体中低浓度杂质处为局域态，即施主或受主能级。非晶态物质不存在长程序，Anderson提出把无规势场与电子定域化相联系的概念，即一个无规势加到三维周期势场，如前者的幅度大于晶体势场引起的电子能带宽度，将出现局域态。局域态中的电子一般只能通过热激发和隧道效应，从一个态跳到另一个态，即所谓跳跃电导。
explanation_en: An electronic state associated with an impurity or defect in a crystal. The wave function of electrons in a complete crystal is Bloch wave, that is, electrons move in common in the whole crystal, called extended state. On the contrary, the localized electronic state is confined to a certain region in real space. Low concentration impurities in semiconductors are localized states, i.e. donor or acceptor energy levels. There is no long order in amorphous matter. Anderson proposed the concept of linking the random potential field with the electronic localization, that is, adding a random potential to the three-dimensional periodic potential field. If the amplitude of the former is greater than the electronic energy band width caused by the crystal potential field, a localized state will appear. In general, electrons in local states can only jump from one state to another through thermal excitation and tunneling effect, which is called hopping conductivity.

explanation_cn: 与环境接触的金属表面局限于某些区域发生的腐蚀。局部腐蚀按形态可分为：点蚀、缝隙腐蚀、晶间腐蚀、电偶腐蚀、选择性腐蚀等。
explanation_en: The metal surface in contact with the environment is limited to the corrosion that occurs in some areas. Localized corrosion can be divided into pitting corrosion, crevice corrosion, intergranular corrosion, galvanic corrosion, selective corrosion, etc.

explanation_cn: 是由材料主方向不同的若干简单层板，通过基体材料黏合而成的。层合板可以由不同材料的平板组成，也可以是许多纤维增强简单层板层合而成。层合板的优势在于可以根据需要来设计每层的材料主方向，设计铺层的方向、数里及厚度来满足与方向有关的材料强度和刚度，以满足结构元件的载荷要求。
explanation_en: It is made of a number of simple laminates with different main directions of materials and bonded by matrix materials. Laminate can be composed of flat plates of different materials, or many simple fiber reinforced laminates. The advantage of laminate is that the main direction of materials of each layer can be designed as required, and the direction, mileage and thickness of the layer can be designed to meet the strength and stiffness of materials related to the direction, so as to meet the load requirements of structural elements.

explanation_cn: 研究层合板在各种加载条件下，其中损伤随变形而演化发展并最终导致破坏的力学规律一门分支学科。
explanation_en: It is a branch of science to study the mechanical laws of laminate under various loading conditions, in which damage evolves with deformation and eventually leads to failure.

explanation_cn: 层状硅酸盐结构是指硅氧四面体通过三个共同氧在二维平面内延伸成一个硅氧四面体层。在硅氧层中，处于同一平面的三个氧都被硅离子共用而形成一个无限延伸的六角环层。硅氧四面体另一顶角上的氧为自由氧，它将与硅氧层以外的阳离子相连。
explanation_en: The layer silicate structure means that the silicon oxygen tetrahedron extends into a silicon oxygen tetrahedron layer in a two-dimensional plane through three common oxygen. In the silicon oxide layer, three oxygen atoms in the same plane are shared by silicon ions to form an infinitely extended hexagonal ring layer. The oxygen at the other vertex of the silica tetrahedron is free oxygen, which will be connected to cations outside the silica layer.

explanation_cn: 将镁合金与其他板材复合组成的层状复合材料。这类复合材料具有单一板材所难以达到的综合性能，如抗腐蚀、耐磨、抗冲击、高导热性、高导电性、高阻尼等性能特点。其中镁与其他金属层板复合材料、镁与聚合物层板复合材料的研究开发发展迅速。
explanation_en: Layered composite materials composed of magnesium alloy and other plates composition. Such composite materials have comprehensive properties that are difficult to achieve by a single plate, such as corrosion resistance, wear resistance, impact resistance, high thermal conductivity, high conductivity, high damping and other performance characteristics. The research and development of magnesium and other metal laminates composite materials, magnesium and polymer laminates composite materials are developing rapidly.

explanation_cn: 层错常常发生在外延生长的硅单晶体上，当硅单晶片经过900~1200℃热氧化过程后，经常可发现表面出现层错。这些由氧化过程引起的层错，称之为OISF。因为每个层错都结合着部分位错，所以层错对硅单晶片的电性质影响与位错相似。
explanation_en: Stacking fault often occur on epitaxial growth silicon monocrystals. stacking fault are often found on the surface of silicon monocrystals after thermal oxidation at 900~1200 ℃. These stacking faults caused by the oxidation process are called OISF. Because each stacking fault is bound to a part of dislocation, the influence of stacking fault on the electrical properties of silicon wafer is similar to that of dislocation.

explanation_cn: 由析出相的层错能与基体的层错能之间的差异产生的硬化。
explanation_en: Hardening caused by the difference between stacking fault energy of precipitated phase and stacking fault energy of matrix.

explanation_cn: 位错滑移会引起晶体的剪切变形，它是金属塑性变形的主要机制。位错造成晶体内原子的错排，进而引起它附近晶体点阵结构的弹性畸变，因此位错也是内应力源。只有当金属的层错能很低时，完整位错的分解才会明显出现。当满足一定条件时，完整位错可以分解成若干部分位错，但是必须满足分解之前的能量大于分解后各部分的能量总和，只有这样的分解从能量角度分析是有利的，因此这个过程才能在热力学上进行下去。因此可以认为，各部分位错之间是存在某种排斥作用。当完整位错在某一晶面上分解后，该晶面上各部分位错之间的正常点阵结构受到进一步的破坏，促使体系能量升高。这种能量称为层错能。
explanation_en: Dislocation slip can cause shear deformation of crystals, which is the main mechanism of metal plastic deformation. Dislocation causes the dislocation of atoms in the crystal, and then causes the elasticity distortion of the lattice structure of the nearby crystal, so dislocation is also the source of internal stress. Only when the stacking fault energy of the metal is very low, the decomposition of complete dislocation will appear obviously. When certain conditions are met, complete dislocation can be decomposed into several parts of dislocation, but it must be satisfied that the energy before decomposition is greater than the total energy of each part after decomposition. Only such decomposition is advantageous from the perspective of energy, so this process can proceed on thermodynamics. Therefore, it can be considered that there is a certain repulsive effect between the dislocations in various parts. When the complete dislocation decomposes on a crystal plane, the normal lattice structure between the dislocation on the crystal plane is further destroyed, which promotes the energy increase of the system. This energy is called stacking fault energy.

explanation_cn: 层间绝缘材料是指在场效应晶体管（MOS)器件结构中的一层绝缘材料，起到覆盖及绝缘的作用，可以降低电路的漏电电流、导线间的电容效应和电路发热等问题。
explanation_en: Layer insulating materials refers to a layer of insulating materials in the field effect transistor (MOS) device structure, which plays the role of covering and insulation, and can reduce the leakage current of the circuit, capacitance effect between wires, circuit heating and other problems.

explanation_cn: 居里定律描述了顺磁材料的磁化强度M如何随环境温度T和外部磁场强度B变化的物理规律。这个定律的一般形式表示为M=(C/T)B，其中C是与材料特性相关的常数，称为居里常数。这个定律是由法国科学家皮埃尔·居里（Pierre Curie）在他的博士研究期间进行铁磁、顺磁和抗磁材料研究时发现的。他的研究揭示了顺磁材料的磁性在不同温度下的变化规律，这就是居里定律的基础。
explanation_en: Curie's law describes how the magnetization M of paramagnetic materials changes with the ambient temperature T and the external magnetic field strength B. The general form of this law is expressed as M=(C/T) B, where C is a constant related to materials properties, called Curie constant. This law was discovered by French scientist Pierre Curie when he was studying ferromagnetic, paramagnetic and diamagnetic materials during his doctoral research. His research has revealed the variation law of paramagnetic materials' magnetism at different temperatures, which is the basis of Curie's law.

explanation_cn: 又称居里点、磁性转变点。从物理学的角度来看，居里温度是物质由永久磁性到感生磁性转变的临界温度。铁磁和亚铁磁材料的内部在居里温度以下含有大量局部磁矩定向取向的磁畴结构，表现出宏观磁性。这些磁畴结构形成于材料内部磁性原子磁矩的定向排列。原子磁矩来源于其核外电子的轨道磁矩和自旋磁矩。当温度高于居里点时，各个原子磁矩的取向因热运动而变得完全无序，磁畴结构随之消失，致使材料失去永久磁性。从材料科学的角度来说，居里温度是铁磁和亚铁磁材料到顺磁材料转变的临界点。随着温度的升高，在反铁磁材料中也存在一个向顺磁材料转变的临界点，该临界温度被称为奈尔温度。
explanation_en: Also known as curie point, magnetic transition point. From the point of view of physics, the Curie temperature is the critical temperature for the transformation of matter from permanent magnetism to induced magnetism. The interior of ferromagnetic and ferrimagnetic materials contains a large number of magnetic domain structures with local magnetic moment oriented orientation below the Curie temperature, showing macroscopic magnetism. These magnetic domain are formed by the directional arrangement of magnetic magnetic moment of an atom in the materials. The magnetic moment of an atom is derived from the orbital magnetic moment and spin magnetic moment of its extranuclear electrons. When the temperature is higher than the curie point, the orientation of each magnetic moment of an atom becomes completely disordered due to thermal movement, and the magnetic domain structure disappears, resulting in the loss of permanent magnetism of materials. From the perspective of materials science, Curie temperature is the critical point of transformation from ferromagnetic and ferromagnetic materials to paramagnetic materials. With the increase of temperature, there is also a critical point of transformation from anti iron materials to paramagnetic materials, which is called Neel temperature temperature.

explanation_cn: 材料的屈服强度和其拉伸强度外之比。屈强比和材料的塑性变形能力以及加工硬化能力有关。材料的塑性愈好，加工硬化能力愈高，则拉伸强度和屈服强度的差值就愈大。屈强比对超高强度钢有重要的意义，提高屈服强度，即提高屈强比，可提高材料的使用应力，但屈强比过高时，使用的安全性将降低。
explanation_en: Ratio of the yield strength of the materials to its tensile strength. Yield ratio is related to plastic deformation ability and work hardening ability of the materials. The better the plasticity of materials and the higher the work hardening capacity, the greater the difference between the tensile strength and yield strength. The yield ratio is of great significance for ultra-high strength steel. Increasing the yield strength, that is, increasing the yield ratio, can improve the service stress of materials, but when the yield ratio is too high, the safety of use will be reduced.

explanation_cn: 在给定循环载荷条件下。试件或结构巾开始加载至出现可检测裂纹时或疲劳失效时所经受的应力或应变的循环次数。疲劳损伤发生在受交变应力（或应变）作用的零件和构件，零件和构件在低于材料屈服极限的交变应力（或应变）的反复作用下，经过一定的循环次数以后，在应力集中部位萌生裂纹，裂纹在一定条件下扩展。最终突然断裂，这一失效过程称为疲劳破坏。材料在疲劳破坏前所经历的应力循环数称为疲劳寿命。
explanation_en: Under given cyclic load conditions. The number of cycles of stress or strain experienced by the test piece or structural towel from the start of loading to the occurrence of detectable cracks or fatigue failure. Fatigue damage occurs in parts and components under the action of alternating stress (or strain). Under the repeated action of alternating stress (or strain) lower than the yield limit of materials, after a certain number of cycles, cracks are initiated at stress concentration, and the cracks expand under certain conditions. The final sudden fracture is called fatigue failure. The number of stress cycles experienced by materials before fatigue failure is called fatigue life.

explanation_cn: 材料开始产生宏观塑性变形所需之应力，它表示材料抵抗塑性变形的能力。对单晶体，当分切应力等于临界值&时位错就开始增殖和运动，幵始产生塑性变形，从而屈服。对多晶或工程材料。存在明显屈服点时，屈服强度等于屈服点所对应的应力。对于没有明显屈服点的材料，认为塑性变形量为0.2%时材料就屈服。称为条件屈服。则塑性变形0.2%所对应的应力称为条件屈服强度。
explanation_en: Materials begins to produce the stress required for macro plastic deformation, which indicates the ability of materials to resist plastic deformation. For single crystals, when the shear stress is equal to the critical value -, the dislocation begins to multiply and move, and plastic deformation starts to occur, thus yielding. For polycrystal or engineering materials. When there is an obvious yield point, the yield strength is equal to the stress corresponding to the yield point. For the materials without obvious yield point, it is considered that the materials will yield when the plastic deformation is 0.2%. It is called conditional yielding. Then the stress corresponding to 0.2% of plastic deformation is called conditional yield strength.

explanation_cn: 材料开始塑性变形（即位错；开始增殖和运动）时外加应力突然下降或不再增加的现象称屈服点现象。应力下降点称为屈服点，应力开始下降时的最大值称上屈服点（上屈服极限），应力I下降到达的最低值称下屈服点。对于显示屈服点的材I料，应力-应变曲线上的屈服点所对应的应力就是屈服强度。对于有明显上、下屈服点的材料，其下屈服点所对应的应力为屈服强度。屈服点现象可用气团理i论以及位错增殖理论来解释。对含间隙杂质的bcc材I料（如低碳钢），位错被杂质气团所钉扎，使位错脱I钉而运动所需的外应力就很大，对应上屈服点。一旦脱钉，位错继续运动所需的外应力就变小，它对应下屈服点。位错增殖理论则具有更普遍的意义。
explanation_en: When materials starts plastic deformation (dislocation; multiplication and movement), the applied stress suddenly drops or no longer increases, which is called yield point phenomenon. The stress drop point is called the yield point, the maximum value when the stress starts to drop is called the upper yield point (upper yield limit), and the lowest value when the stress I drops is called the lower yield point. For material I showing yield point, the stress corresponding to the yield point on the stress-strain curve is the yield strength. For materials with obvious upper and lower yield point, the stress corresponding to the lower yield point is the yield strength. The yield point phenomenon can be explained by the i theory of air mass and the theory of dislocation multiplication. For bcc material I containing interstitial impurities (such as low-cardon steel), dislocation is pinned by impurity air mass, so the external stress required for dislocation to move off the I pin is large, corresponding to the yield point. Once the nail is removed, the external stress required for the continued movement of the dislocation becomes smaller, which corresponds to the lower yield point. The theory of dislocation proliferation has more general significance.

explanation_cn: 用于屏蔽反应堆核辐射的结构材料。如FePh、水、石墨、含硼材料、混凝土等。反应堆产生的辐射中，危害最大的是穿透力大的中子和y射线。屏蔽材料必须能够衰减7射线。并使快中子减速而被吸收。
explanation_en: Structural materials used for shielding reactor nuclear radiation. Such as FePh, water, graphite, boron containing materials, concrete, etc. Among the radiation generated by reactors, the most harmful ones are the highly penetrating neutrons and y-rays. The shielding materials must be able to attenuate 7 rays. And slow down the fast neutrons to be absorbed.

explanation_cn: 按照桂氧四面体在空间的组合情况而划分的硅酸盐矿物的亚类之一。其络阴离子为单个硅氧四面体或由两个硅氧四面体共用一个顶角而联成的硅氧双四面体，前者由于有足够的其他阳离子以使其电价得到饱和因而硅氧四面体之间不相互连接而各自独立，这些阳离子可以是Mg2+、Ca2+、Fe2+、Be2+、Zn2+、Mn2+、ZP等。镁橄榄石（Mg2Si4)和锆英石（ZrSiO4)等是这种结构的代表;后者中较为典型的矿物有硅钙石（Ca3Si207）。此外，个数有限的硅氧四面体，如共用顶角连接而成的环状结构亦属于岛状硅酸盐结构类型，如绿柱石。本类矿物由于晶格中离子排列紧密，所以一般密度较大，硬度较高。
explanation_en: One of the subclasses of silicate mineral classified according to the spatial assemblage of cinnamic oxygen tetrahedrons. Its complex anions are either a single silicon oxygen tetrahedron or a silicon oxygen dihedron formed by two silicon oxygen tetrahedrons sharing a vertex angle. The former has sufficient other cations to saturate its electricity price, so the silicon oxygen tetrahedra are not interconnected but independent of each other. These cations can be Mg2+, Ca2+, Fe2+, Be2+, Zn2+, Mn2+, ZP, etc. Forsterite (Mg2Si4) and zircon (ZrSiO4) are representatives of this structure; The more typical mineral in the latter is calcium silicate (Ca3Si207). In addition, the limited number of silicon oxygen tetrahedrons, such as the ring structure formed by the common vertex connection, also belong to the type of island silicate structure, such as beryl. This type of mineral has high density and hardness due to the close arrangement of ions in the lattice.

explanation_cn: 是一种多孔吸声材料。是以玄武岩、白云石等为主要原材料，经高温熔化后，采用四辊离心制棉工艺，将高温熔体甩拉成的非连续性纤维.然后在岩棉纤维中加入适量的憎水剂、防尘油、黏结剂等，经过集棉机收集，通过摆锤法工艺，加上三维法铺棉后进行固化、切割等工序而制成。岩棉纤维具有阻隔性（隔热、隔冷、隔声）好、化学稳定性好、不燃性好和工作温度高等突出优点。根据不同用途可制成棉毡、半硬板、保温带、管壳等多种制品，广泛应用于管道、储罐、蒸馏塔、锅炉烟道、热交换器、风机和车船等工业设备和建筑上的保温、隔热和隔声。
explanation_en: It is a porous sound absorbing materials. It is a discontinuous fiber made of basalt, dolomite, etc. as the main raw materials, after melting at high temperature, using the four roll centrifugal cotton making process to spin and pull the high-temperature melt into discontinuous fibers, and then adding an appropriate amount of hydrophobic agent, dust-proof oil, adhesive, etc. into the rock wool fiber, which is collected by the cotton collector, through the pendulum process, combined with three-dimensional cotton paving, and then curing, cutting and other processes. Rock wool fiber has outstanding advantages such as good barrier properties (thermal insulation, cold insulation, sound insulation), good chemical stability, good non flammability, and high working temperature. According to different uses, various products such as cotton felt, semi hard board, insulation tape, and pipe shell can be made, which are widely used for insulation, insulation, and sound insulation in industrial equipment and buildings such as pipelines, storage tanks, distillation towers, boiler flues, heat exchangers, fans, and vehicles.

explanation_cn: 又称火成岩。由岩架在地下或喷出地表后冷却凝固形成的岩石的总称。包括侵入岩、喷出岩、次火山岩等。它是组成地壳的主要岩石，占地壳总体积的95%，也与众多矿产有密切成因联系。
explanation_en: Also known as igneous rock. The general name of rock formed by cooling and solidification of rock shelf after underground or eject. Including intrusive rocks, extrusive rock, sub volcanic rock, etc. It is the main rock making up the crust, accounting for 95% of the total volume of the crust, and has close genetic relationship with many minerals.

explanation_cn: 天然产出的具有一定结构构造的矿物或类矿物物质（如有机质、玻璃质物质）的集合体。按成因可分为火成岩、沉积岩和变质岩三大类。矿石为具有经济价值的可供利用的特殊。
explanation_en: A natural aggregate of minerals or mineral like substances (such as organic matter and glass substances) with a certain structure. According to its origin, it can be divided into three categories: igneous rock, sedimentary rock and metamorphic rock. Ore is a special resource with economic value that can be utilized.

explanation_cn: 岩石中不同矿物集合体之间、岩石的各个组成部分之间或矿物集合体与岩石其他组成部分之间的相互关系的特征。岩石构造与成因关系密切，具有多样性特点。常见的构造有片麻状构造、块状构造、流纹构造、枕状构造、气孔状构造、齊仁状构造、晶洞构造等。
explanation_en: The characteristics of the relationship between different mineral aggregates in rock, between various components of rock, or between mineral aggregates and other components of rock. The rock structure is closely related to the genesis and has diversity characteristics. Common structures include gneissose structure, massive structure, rhyolite structure, pillow structure, vesicular structure, Qiren structure, and crystal cave structure.

explanation_cn: 成岩石的矿物的结晶程度、大小、形态以及晶粒之间或晶粒与玻璃质之间的相互关系的特征，类型繁多，命名方式多样，如等粒、斑状、似斑状等名称。有些结构在某种岩石中较为典型，其名称就以岩石名称命名，如花岗结构、粗面结构等。
explanation_en: The crystallization degree, size, morphology of rock forming minerals and the characteristics of the relationship between grains or between grains and glassy matter are characterized by various types and naming methods, such as equal grain, porphyritic, and porphyritic. Some structures are typical in a certain rock, and their names are named after rock, such as granite structure, rough structure, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称蛇纹石玉、岫岩玉。是在地质作用过程中形成的达到玉石级，主要由微细蛇纹石组成的矿物集合体。次要矿物有方解石、滑石、磁铁矿、白云石、菱镁矿、绿泥石、透闪石、透辉石、铬铁矿等。次要矿物的含量变化很大，对的质量有着明显的影响，个别情况下次要矿物的含量可超过半数而上升为主要组成矿物。因主要产于辽宁岫岩而得名。颜色有黄绿色、深绿色、绿色、灰黄色、白色、棕色、黑色及多种颜色的组合。参见蛇纹石。
explanation_en: Also known as serpentine jade and xiuyan jade. It is a mineral aggregate of jade grade formed in the process of geological process, mainly composed of fine serpentine. Secondary minerals include caldte, talc, magnetite, dolomite, magnesite, chlorite, tremolite, diopside, chromite, etc. The content of secondary minerals varies greatly and has a significant impact on their quality. In some cases, the content of secondary minerals can exceed half and increase to become the main constituent minerals. It is named after its main origin in Xiuyan, Liaoning. Colors include yellow green, dark green, green, grayish yellow, white, brown, black, and various combinations of colors. See serpentine.

explanation_cn: 发光二极管所发之光并非单一波长，光强最大对应的波长（λm)称之为峰值波长。
explanation_en: The light emitted by luminescence is not a single wavelength, and the wavelength corresponding to the maximum light intensity（ λ m) It is called peak-emission wavelength.

explanation_cn: 皮革产品一面受到压力后，另一面出现裂纹或破裂时所承受的压力。以N/mm2表示。
explanation_en: The pressure borne by leather products when one side is under pressure and the other side is cracked or cracked. Expressed in N/mm2.

explanation_cn: 由Daw和Basket于1984年提出。在对势模型的基础上，假设将每个原子镶嵌在由所有其他近邻原子产生的背景电了云中-由电子云密度和将原子"镶嵌"到该电子云中所需的能量来衡量原子所处背景电子的特征和背景电子云对势能的影响。由于在电子云密度的计算中采用球面平均。嵌入原子势法特别适用于电子云基本呈球对称分布的金属原子。这种方法单独求解电子云对原子核的多体效应。而不是在原子间对势吸引项上采取参数修正的拟合方法，结果更为精确。
explanation_en: Proposed by Daw and Basket in 1984. On the basis of the potential model, it is assumed that each atom is embedded in the background electric cloud generated by all other neighboring atoms - the characteristics of the background electron where the atom is located and the influence of the background electronic cloud on the potential energy are measured by the density of the electronic cloud and the energy required to "embed" the atom into the electronic cloud. Because spherical average is used in the calculation of electron cloud density. The embedded atomic potential method is particularly suitable for metal atoms with electron clouds that are basically spherically symmetric. This method solves the multi body effect of electron clouds on atomic nuclei separately. Instead of using parameter correction fitting methods on the potential attraction term between atoms, the results are more accurate.

explanation_cn: 见共聚物
explanation_en: See copolymer

explanation_cn: 除金属矿石、矿物燃料、玉石以外，其化学成分或物理性能可资工业利用且具有经济价值的岩石。如高岭土、膨润土、霞石正长岩、大理岩、白云岩等。
explanation_en: In addition to metal ores, mineral fuels and jade, rock whose chemical composition or physical properties can be used in industry and have economic value. Such as kaolin, bentonite, nepheline syenite, marble, dolomitite, etc.

explanation_cn: 用化学法从高锅矾土矿除去Si、Fe、Ti等杂质得到的氧化铝。主要用于生产烧结莫来石、烧结氧化铝和电熔刚玉质耐火材料等。
explanation_en: Aluminum oxide obtained by removing impurities such as Si, Fe, Ti, etc. from high pot bauxite ore using chemical methods. It is mainly used to produce sintering mullite, sintering alumina and fused corundum refractory.

explanation_cn: 又称产业生态学。是为了解决现存的一些工业过程与可持续发展的目标之间的矛盾而提出的工业代谢理论。工业生态学的目标是通过分析自然界的生物循环系统，将生物圈的循环原理应用干工业过程.用自然界的运行规则来改造工业系统，使之像地球生命的进化一样，与环境相容，生生不息，良性循环，最终实现人类社会的可持续发展。
explanation_en: It is also called industrial ecology. The theory of industrial metabolism was proposed to address the contradiction between existing industrial processes and sustainable development goals. The goal of industrial ecology is to apply the circulation principle of the biosphere to the dry industrial process by analyzing the biological circulation system of the nature, and to transform the industrial system with the operation rules of the nature, so as to make it compatible with the environment, endless and benign cycle, like the evolution of life on the earth, and finally realize the sustainable development of human society.

explanation_cn: 除金属矿物、矿物燃料、宝石以外，其化学成分或物理性能可资工业利用且具有经济价值的非金属矿物。按终端用途又可分为工业矿物原料或矿物原料（如石英、钾长石、透辉石、石膏等）和工业矿物材料（如石墨、白云母、冰洲石等）两类。它与材料领域的"矿物材料"含义相近。
explanation_en: In addition to metal minerals, mineral fuels and gems, no-metallic mineral whose chemical composition or physical properties can be used in industry and have economic value. According to the end use, it can be divided into industrial mineral raw materials or raw mineral material (such as quartze, potassium feldspar, diopside, gypsum, etc.) and industrial mineral materials (such as graphite, muscovilte, iceland spar, etc.). It is similar to the meaning of "mineral materials" in the field of materials.

explanation_cn: 含一定量的氧、氮、碳、桂、铁及其他元素杂质的α相钛。具有优良的冲压工艺性能，好的焊接性能，对热处理及组织类型不敏感，在令人满意的塑性条件下具有一定的强度。
explanation_en: Containing a certain amount of oxygen, nitrogen, carbon, cinnamon, iron and other elemental impurities α Phase titanium. It has excellent stamping process performance, good weld performance, is insensitive to heat treatment and structure type, and has certain strength under satisfactory plastic conditions.

explanation_cn: 碳含量不超过0.04%，纯度在99.5%-99.9%，可工业化大规模生产的纯铁，也称阿姆科铁或锭铁。工业纯铁的纯度低于电解铁，故其强度、硬度、弹性模量均高于电解铁但塑性相对较低。
explanation_en: The carbon content is not more than 0.04%, and the purity is 99.5% -99.9%. pure iron, also known as Armco-iron or ingot iron, can be industrialized and mass produced. The purity of Armco-iron is lower than that of electrolytic iron, so its strength, hardness and elastic modulus are higher than those of electrolytic iron, but its plasticity is relatively low.

explanation_cn: 含镁99.85%-99.95%(质量分数），常含有铁、硅、铜、镍、铝、等杂质的一种轻金属。室温下密度为1.736g/cm3,为密排六方结构晶体。工业纯镁主要用于配制镁合金、球墨铸铁球化剂、铝合金的添加元素、生产难熔金属的还原剂、钢铁脱硫剂、烟火、照明弹、信号弹等。现今工业纯镁的主要生产方法包括氯化熔盐电解法和硅热还原法。
explanation_en: A light metal containing 99.85% -99.95% (mass fraction) of magnesium, and often containing impurities such as iron, silicon, copper, nickel, aluminum, etc. At room temperature, the density is 1.736g/cm3, which is a hexagonal close packed structure crystal. Commercially pure magnesium is mainly used to prepare magnesium alloy, spheroidizing agent for spheroidizing graphite cast iron, additive elements for aluminum alloy, reducing agent for producing refractory metal, desulfurizer for steel, pyrotechnics, flares, signal flares, etc. At present, the main production methods of commercially pure magnesium include chlorinated molten salt electrolysis and silicothermic reduction.

explanation_cn: 适合于制造刃具、模具和量具等各式工具用的钢。由于用途不同，对钢的性能要求也不同。刃具钢要求具有很高的强度、硬度、耐磨性和热硬性；热作模具钢要求具有高温强度、硬度、导热性和抗疲劳性能；冷作模具钢要求具有很高的强度、硬度、耐磨性、抗疲劳性能和韧性，量具钢要求具有高硬度、耐磨性、尺寸稳定性和一定的耐浊性。按照钢的化学成分及用途.工具钢可分为非合金工具钢、合金工具钢和高速工具钢。
explanation_en: Suitable for making steel for cutting tools, moulds, measuring tools and other tools. Due to different applications, the performance requirements for steel are also different. Cutting tool steel requires high strength, hardness, wear resistance and thermal hardness; Hot-working die steel requires high temperature strength, hardness, thermal conductivity and fatigue resistance; Cold working die steel requires high strength, hardness, wear resistance, fatigue resistance and toughness, and gauge steel requires high hardness, wear resistance, dimensional stability and certain turbidity resistance. According to the chemical composition and application of steel, tool steel can be divided into non alloy tool steel, alloy tool steel and high-speed tool steel.

explanation_cn: 又称钢梁，断面形状为工字形(I形）的型钢。工字钢（GB/T706-2008)规格用腰高度（cm)表示（如12号工字钢的腰高为12cm),腰高相同而腿宽和腰厚不同的则采用a、b、c予以区别。工字钢与H型钢的区别是其腿由根部向外缘逐渐变薄。而工字钢与钢轨钢的区别是其上下腿宽度相同。工字钢一般采用热轧方法生产。工字钢广泛应用于桥梁、建筑、车辆、矿山的工程结构。
explanation_en: It is also called steel beam, and the section shape is I-shaped (I-shaped) section steel. The specification of I-beam (GB/T706-2008) is expressed by waist height (cm) (for example, the waist height of No. 12 I-beam is 12cm). If the waist height is the same but the leg width and waist thickness are different, a, b and c shall be used to distinguish them. The difference between I-beam and H section steel is that its legs gradually become thinner from the root to the outer edge. The difference between I-beam and rail steel is that their upper and lower legs are the same width. I-beam is generally produced by hot rolling. I-beam is widely used in engineering structures of bridges, buildings, vehicles and mines.

explanation_cn: 能用作工程结构材料的热塑性塑料。其基材多是分子主链除含碳原子外还含有氧、氯、硫原子的杂链线型结构的合成树脂，有通用工程塑料与特种工程塑料两类。
explanation_en: Thermoplastic plastics that can be used as engineering structural materials. Its base material is mostly synthetic resin with heterochain linear structure containing oxygen, chlorine and sulfur atoms in addition to carbon atoms in the molecular main chain. There are two types of general engineering plastics and special engineering plastics.

explanation_cn: 超导线材所能承受的临界电流与超导线材横截面积的比值。
explanation_en: The ratio of the critical current that the superconducting wire rod can withstand to the cross-sectional area of the superconducting wire rod.

explanation_cn: 见结构陶瓷。
explanation_en: See structural ceramics.

explanation_cn: 工艺辅助材料是复合材料制件成型过程中，除制件主体材料和模具外，为保证制件质量与工艺正常进行所必需的、不进入最终制件的一类材料。工艺辅助材料主要有：脱模剂、真空袋薄膜、透气材料、隔离薄膜、吸胶材料、表面层材料、高温压敏胶带、真空密封胶带、离型纸等。该类材料属于消耗型，多为一次性使用。工艺辅助材料的类型、质量和使用方法对复合材料成型固化质量有非常重要的影响.其耐温和耐压特性要与复合材料成型固化条件相适应。热压罐成型工艺中使用的工艺辅助材料种类较多。
explanation_en: Auxiliary materials is a kind of materials that is necessary to ensure the normal progress of the quality and process of the parts and does not enter the final parts in addition to the main materials and mold of the parts during the forming process of composite materials parts. Auxiliary materials mainly include: releasing agent, vacuum bag film, breathable materials, isolation film, adhesive materials, surface layer materials, high temperature pressure sensitive tape, vacuum sealing tape, release paper, etc. This type of materials is consumable, and most of them are disposable. The type, quality and use method of auxiliary materials have a very important impact on the curing quality of composite materials molding. Its temperature resistance and pressure resistance characteristics should be compatible with the curing conditions of composite materials molding. There are many kinds of auxiliary materials used in the autoclave forming process.

explanation_cn: 巨磁电阻材料在微弱的磁场变化作用下可以导致电阻大小的急剧变化，其变化的幅度比通常高十几倍。在Fe/Cr多层金属膜体系.金属间化合物如Sm-Mn-Ge以及钙钛矿结构的磁性氧化物膜如Nd-Pb-Mn-O、La-Ba-Mn-O、La-Ca-Mn-O之中均观察到了巨磁电阻现象。成分、结构、温度和磁场是影响巨磁电阻材料性能的重要因素。巨磁阻是一种量子力学效应，由铁磁材料和非铁磁材料薄层交替叠合而成，当铁磁层的磁矩相互平行时，载流子与自旋有关的散射最小，材料有最小的电阻；当铁磁层的磁矩为反平行时，与自旋有关的散射最强。材料的电阻最大。磁电阻材料已用于制造磁记录磁头、磁传感器、磁开关、磁泡检测器和磁膜存储器的读出器等，在磁电子学等方面具有巨大的应用前景。
explanation_en: The giant magnetoresistance alloy can lead to a sharp change in the resistance under the action of weak magnetic field changes, and the amplitude of the change is more than ten times higher than usual. Giant magnetoresistance was observed in Fe/Cr multilayer metallic film system, imermetallif compound such as Sm Mn Ge and perovskite magnetic oxide films such as Nd-Pb-Mn-O, La-Ba-Mn-O, La-Ca-Mn-O. Composition, structure, temperature and magnetic field are important factors affecting the performance of giant magnetoresistance alloy. Giant magnetoresistance is a quantum mechanical effect, which is composed of ferromagnetic materials and non ferromagnetic materials thin layers alternately. When the magnetic moment of the ferromagnetic layer is parallel to each other, the carrier spin related scattering is the smallest, and the materials has the smallest resistance; When the magnetic moment of the ferromagnetic layer is antiparallel, the spin related scattering is strongest. The resistance of materials is the largest. Magnetoresistance materials have been used to manufacture magnetic recording heads, magnetic sensors, magnetic switches, bubble detectors, magnetic film memory readers and so on.

explanation_cn: 一类具有巨磁阻效应的薄膜材料。它引发了计算机硬盘的大容量、小型化革命，计算机硬盘的存储密度记录不断被刷新。
explanation_en: A kind of thin film materials with giant magnetoresistance effect. It has triggered the revolution of large capacity and miniaturization of computer hard disk, and the record of storage density of computer hard disk has been constantly refreshed.

explanation_cn: 差别化纤维通常是指在原来纤维组成的基础上进行物理或化学改性处理，使纤维的形态结构、物理化学性能与常规化纤有显著的不同。纤维的差别化加工处理，起因于普通合成纤维的一些不足，大多采用简单仿天然纤维特征的方式进行以改进纤维形态或性能。
explanation_en: Differential fiber usually refers to the physical or chemical modification on the basis of the original fiber composition, so that the morphological structure and physical chemistry properties of the fiber are significantly different from those of conventional chemical fibers. The differential processing of fibers is due to some shortcomings of ordinary synthetic fiber, which are mostly carried out by simply imitating the characteristics of natural fiber to improve fiber morphology or performance.

explanation_cn: 由主产于亚马逊河流域、巴拿马等地的山榄科、人心果属植物巴拉塔树晈乳制得的一种天然高分子材料。其物理化学性质与杜仲胶基本相同，巴拉塔胶被作为古塔波胶的补充原料。
explanation_en: It is a kind of natural polymer materials made from Balata tree kyoto milk, which is mainly produced in the Amazon River basin, Panama and other places, and belongs to the family Calamaceae and the genus Cardiocarpus. Its physical chemistry properties are basically the same as those of eucommia ulmoides gum, and balata rubber is used as a supplementary raw material of gutta percha gum.

explanation_cn: 锡基轴承合金和铅基轴承合金的总称现在巴氏合金有多种成分，主要为锡基和铅基两大类。铅基巴氏合金的强度和硬度比锡基合金低。巴氏合金具有优良的减摩性能，巴氏合金应用于柴油机、汽轮机、齿轮箱等设备上使用的轴承材料。
explanation_en: The general name of tin-base bearing alloy and lead-base bearing alloy Now Babbitt metal has many components, mainly including tin base and lead base. The strength and hardness of lead based babbitt alloy alloy are lower than those of tin base alloy. Babbitt metal alloy has excellent antifriction performance. Babbitt metal alloy is used as bearing materials for diesel engine, steam turbine, gearbox and other equipment.

explanation_cn: 又称空间点阵。在任一方向均为周期排布的无限个全同点的空间阵列，总共有14种?用以表达所有晶体的内部结构。是由法国晶体学家布喇菲（A.Bravais)首先用数学方法所创立的，而后才由实验得到证实。其基本特征每个几何点（阵点）的空间环境都是一样的，1『1丨且具有平移的特性。因此，这种点阵也称为平移点阵。在空间点阵上填人具体物质的原子或分子，即可构成物质的具体晶体点阵。每一种空间点阵可表达许多种具体的晶体结构.而所有的晶体结构都可毫无例外地包括在这14种空间点阵中。
explanation_en: Also known as space lattice. There are a total of 14 types of spatial arrays with infinite identical points arranged periodically in any direction? It is used to express the internal structure of all crystal. It was first established by French crystallographer A. Bravais using mathematical methods and later confirmed through experiments. Its basic characteristics: the space environment of each geometric point (array) is the same, 1 [1] and has the characteristic of translation. Therefore, this kind of lattice is also called translation lattice. The space lattice can be filled with atoms or molecules of specific substances to form a specific crystal lattice of substances. Each space lattice can express many specific crystal structure. All crystal structure can be included in these 14 space lattice without exception.

explanation_cn: 又称布拉本德塑化仪。用于测量材料性能随温度、黏度和剪切速率变化的关系来预测材料性能的仪器，也被称为塑度计。
explanation_en: It is also called Brabender plasticizer Plasticizer. The instrument used to measure the relationship between materials properties and temperature, viscosity and shear rate to predict materials properties is also called plastimeter.

explanation_cn: 布氏硬度是表示材料硬度的一种标准。由布氏硬度计测定。由瑞典人J.A.布瑞纳（J.A.Brinell）首先提出，故称布氏硬度。用一定大小的载荷P把直径为D的淬火钢球压入被测金属材料表面，保持一段时间后卸除载荷。载荷P与压痕表面积F的比值即为布氏硬度值，记作HB。
explanation_en: Brinell hardness hardness is a standard to indicate the hardness of materials. Determined by Brinell hardness tester. It was first proposed by Swede J.A. Brinell, so it is called Brinell hardness hardness. Press the quenching steel ball with diameter D into the surface of the tested metallic materials with a certain load P, and remove the load after holding it for a period of time. The ratio of load P to indentation surface area F is the Brinell hardness hardness value, which is recorded as HB.

name_cn: 布里奇曼-斯托克巴杰法
explanation_cn: 见坩埚下降法。
explanation_en: See descending crucible method.

explanation_cn: 织造帘布的经线材料。帘布是以帘子线作经线，用中(或细)支棉纱作纬线机织成的布。经线排列紧密，起承受负荷的作用；纬线仅起固定经线位置的作用，排列稀疏，状似帘子，故称帘布。帘子线用于制作轮胎、运输带、传动带等橡胶制品的增强材料，即骨架材料，以用于轮胎为主。
explanation_en: Warp materials for weaving cord fabric. Cord fabric is a fabric woven using cord thread as warp thread and medium (or fine) count cotton yarn as weft thread. The meridians are arranged tightly, playing a role in bearing loads; The weft only serves to fix the position of the warp, arranged sparsely and resembling a curtain, hence the name curtain fabric. The cord is used to make reinforcement materials of rubber products such as tires, transportation belts, transmission belts, etc., that is, skeleton materials, which is mainly used for tires.

explanation_cn: 用冷挤压方法（不加热，反之称热轧）。冷轧带钢和薄板一般厚度为0.1～3mm，宽度为100～2000mm；均以热轧带钢或钢板为原料，在常温下经冷轧机轧制成材。冷轧带钢和薄板具有表面光洁、平整、尺寸精度高和机械性能好等优点，产品大多成卷，并且有很大一部分经加工成涂层钢板出厂。成卷冷轧薄板生产效率高，使用方便，有利于后续加工。因此应用广泛，已逐渐取代同样厚度的热叠轧薄板。只有少量的特殊用途的冷轧合金钢板采取单片轧制。冷轧带钢和薄板的产量在工业发达国家已占钢材总产量的30%左右。钢种除普通碳钢外，还有硅钢、不锈钢和合金结构钢等。
explanation_en: Use cold extrusion method (without heating, otherwise called hot rolling). The thickness of cold rolled strip steel and thin plate is generally 0.1~3mm, and the width is 100~2000mm; Hot rolled strip steel or steel plate are used as raw materials and are rolling by cold rolling mill at normal temperature. Cold rolled strip steel and sheet steel have the advantages of smooth and smooth surface, high dimensional accuracy and good mechanical properties. Most of the products are rolled, and a large part of them are processed into coated sheet before leaving the factory. The production efficiency of rolled cold rolled sheet is high, and it is convenient to use, which is beneficial for subsequent processing. Therefore, it has been widely used and has gradually replaced hot rolled sheets of the same thickness. Only a small number of cold-rolled alloy steel plate for special purposes adopt single piece rolling. The output of cold rolled strip steel and sheet steel has accounted for about 30% of the total output of steel product in industrial developed countries. In addition to ordinary carbon steel, there are also silicon steel, stainless steel and alloy structural steel.

explanation_cn: 在带钢热轧机上生产厚度为1.2～8mm成卷热轧带钢的工艺。带钢宽度600mm以下称为窄带钢；超过600mm的称为宽带钢。第一台带钢热连轧机于1905年在美国投产，生产宽 200mm的带钢。带钢热轧机的技术经济指标优越，发展很快。在工业发达国家，1950年以前热轧宽带钢的产量约占钢材总产量的25%,70年代已达50%左右。热轧带钢的原料是连铸板坯或初轧板坯，厚度为130～300mm。板坯在加热炉中加热后,送到轧机上轧成厚1.00～25.4mm的带钢，并卷成钢卷。轧制的钢种有普通碳钢、低合金钢、不锈钢和硅钢等。其主要用途是作冷轧带钢、焊管、冷弯和焊接型钢的原料；或用于制作各种结构件、容器等。
explanation_en: The process of producing 1.2~8mm thick hot rolled strip steel in coils on the hot strip mill. The width of strip steel below 600mm is called narrow strip steel; Wideband steel is called if it exceeds 600mm. The first strip steel hot tandem mill was put into production in the United States in 1905, producing 200 mm wide strip steel. The technical and economic indicators of strip steel hot rolling mill are superior and developing rapidly. In industrial developed countries, the output of hot-rolled wide strip steel accounted for about 25% of the total output of steel product before 1950, and reached about 50% in the 1970s. The raw material of hot rolled strip steel is continuous casting slab or blooming slab, with a thickness of 130~300mm. After being heated in the soaking pit, slabs are sent to the rolling mill to be rolled into 1.00~25.4mm thick strip steel and rolled into steel coils. Rolling steels include ordinary carbon steel, low alloy steel, stainless steel and silicon steel. It is mainly used as raw material for cold rolled strip steel, welded pipe, cold bending and weld section steel; Or used to make various structural components, containers, etc.

explanation_cn: 幕墙或帷幕墙上使用的玻璃。一般反射比不大于0.30，其采光折减系数不宜低于O.20。目前具有保温隔热等节能性能的玻璃如中空Low-e低辐射玻璃已得到广泛的应用，幕墙玻璃需是安全玻璃。
explanation_en: Glass for curtain wall or curtain wall. Generally, the reflectance should not exceed 0.30, and its daylight reduction coefficient should not be lower than O.20. At present, glass with energy-saving performance such as thermal insulation, such as hollow Low-e low emissivity glass, has been widely used. curtain wall glass needs to be safety glass.

explanation_cn: 将粉料装入钢模内，通过模冲对粉末施加压力，压制成一定尺寸和形状的压坯。卸压后，坯体从阴模中脱出。压制过程中，粉末颗粒之间、粉末与模冲、模壁之间存在摩擦使甩力损失而造成压坯密度和强度不均匀分布，故常用双向压制或可动压模并在粉料中加入少量(或涂在模壁）含极性官能团的有机润滑剂（如油酸有些粉料中加入有机黏结剂（如聚乙烯醇）以增强粉料的黏结力。
explanation_en: The powder is loaded into the steel mold, and the powder is pressed through the die punch to pressing into a compact of certain size and shape. After pressure relief, the billet comes out of the female mold. During pressing, friction exists between powder particle, between powder and die punch, and between die wall, resulting in loss of throwing force, which results in uneven distribution of density and strength of compact. Therefore, double-action pressing or movable die pressing is commonly used, and a small amount of organic lubricant containing polar functional groups (such as oleic acid, and some powders are added with organic adhesive (such as polyvinyl alcohol) to enhance the bonding force of powder.

explanation_cn: 动植物油脂在涂成薄膜后,暴露于空气中，能在较短时间内形成固态薄膜的油脂被称为干性油，不能形成固态薄膜的油脂称为不干性油；虽能形成固态薄膜但需要时间较长，薄膜强度较差的油脂称为半干性油。
explanation_en: Animal and vegetable fats and oils that can form a solid film in a relatively short time after being coated as a film and exposed to the air are called drying oil, while those that cannot form a solid film are called non drying oil; Although it can form a solid film, it takes a long time and has poor film strength, which is called semi dry oil.

explanation_cn: 从屠宰后的动物身上剥离下来的经过干燥处理后用作制革或毛皮生产原料的动物皮。
explanation_en: Animal skins stripped from slaughtered animals and used as raw materials for leather making or fur production after drying.

explanation_cn: 一种光敏热显影、具有干式快速显示、无污染、并有良好层次和高分辨率的新颖记录材料。
explanation_en: A novel recording materials with photosensitive thermal development, dry fast display, no pollution, good level and high resolution.

explanation_cn: 具有平台燃烧现象的固体推进剂。在某一压强范围内推进剂燃速不随压强增加而发生明显变化的燃烧现象称平台燃烧，其燃速压强指数在此压强区间近于零。
explanation_en: Solid propellant with plateau combustion. The combustion phenomenon that the burning rate of propellant does not change significantly with the increase of pressure within a certain pressure range is called plateau combustion, and its burning rate pressure index is close to zero in this pressure range.

explanation_cn: 表征介质折射率随波长变化的一种定量关系，光与物质的这种相互作用称为光的色散。表征色散现象中介质折射率与波长间关系的物理量有多个，常用的有：①介质的色散率。数值上等于介质对波长差为1单位的两光的折射率之差；②平均色散；③部分色散，定义为介质对任意两波长的折射率之差;④色散本领；⑤相对（部分）色散。这些物理量在不同情况下使用。对玻璃而言，通常需给出介质的平均色散或阿贝数。
explanation_en: A quantitative relationship that characterizes the variation of the refractive index of a medium with wavelength, and the interaction between light and matter is called the dispersion of light. There are multiple physical quantities that characterize the relationship between the refractive index and wavelength of a medium in dispersion phenomena, commonly used being: ① the dispersion index of the medium. The numerical value is equal to the difference in refractive index of two light waves with a wavelength difference of 1 unit in the medium; ② Mean dispersion; ③ Partial dispersion is defined as the difference in refractive index of a medium to any two wavelengths; ④ Dispersion ability; ⑤ Relative (partial) dispersion. These physical quantities are used in different situations. For glass, it is usually necessary to give the mean dispersion or Abbe number of the medium.

explanation_cn: 大规模集成电路制作过程中，随着各层电路的叠加，表面粗糙度随之增大，为了更好地进行集成电路的制作，实现更优的器件性能。在工艺过程当中，用于填补祖糙度的材料叫作平坦化材料。常规使用材料为旋转涂布式玻璃材料SOG(spinonglass)、BCBOenzocylobutene)、憐硼桂玻璃（BPSG;borophospho'silicateglass)、亚克力（acrylic)。沉积方式分为两种：一种是采用旋转式涂布方式；第二种采用PECVD方式。
explanation_en: In the process of large-scale integrated circuit manufacturing, as the layers of circuits are stacked, the surface roughness increases. In order to better manufacture integrated circuits and achieve better device performance. In the process, the materials used to fill the roughness is called planarization materials. The commonly used materials are spin coated glass, BCBOenzocylobutene, BPSG, boropho's silicateglass, and acrylic. There are two types of deposition methods: one is to use a rotary coating method; The second method uses PECVD.

explanation_cn: 板状无机玻璃制品的统称。多系钠钙硅酸盐玻璃。具有透光、透视、隔音、隔:热、耐磨、耐气候变化等性能。
explanation_en: A general term for tabular inorganic glass products. Multi series sodium calcium silicate glass. It has properties such as transparency, perspective, sound insulation, heat insulation, wear resistance, and resistance to climate change.

explanation_cn: 通过测定在一块固定和另一块在力矩作用下可旋转的两个同心平行板间隙白的聚合物熔体的剪切速率与力矩之间的关系来计算聚合物熔体切黏度的方法。平行板测黏法具有以下优点：①制样体积小,易于加工。②测试时间短。平行板法测试时间仅为2h左右。③测量精度高。经过标准物质检测，测量误差为±2°C。
explanation_en: The method of calculating the shear viscosity of polymer melt by measuring the relationship between the shear rate and the torque of two concentric parallel plates with white gaps, one fixed and the other rotatable under the action of torque. The parallel plate viscosity measurement method has the following advantages: ① small sample volume and easy processing. ② Short testing time. The parallel plate method testing time is only about 2 hours High measurement accuracy. After standard substance testing, the measurement error is ± 2 ° C.

explanation_cn: 在一定温度下交联高分子的溶胀达到平衡后的体积与溶胀前的体积之比。
explanation_en: The ratio of the volume of crosslinking macromolecule after swelling reaches equilibrium and the volume before swelling at a certain temperature.

explanation_cn: 交联聚合物在溶剂中不能溶解，但是能发生一定程度的溶胀。溶胀度取决于聚合物的交联度。当交联聚合物浸入溶剂中时，由于交联点之间的分子链段仍然较长，具有相当的柔性，溶剂分子容易渗入聚合物白，引起三维分子网的伸展，体积膨胀；但是交联点之间分子链的伸展引起它的构象熵降低-分子网络产生弹性收缩力，阻止溶剂进入分子网。当这两种相反的作用相当时，体系就达到了溶胀平衡状态，体积不再变化。可采用体积法和质量法测定交联聚合i物的溶胀度，进而得到其交联度。
explanation_en: The crosslinked polymer cannot be dissolved in solvent, but it can undergo swelling to a certain extent. The swelling degree depends on the degree of crosslinking of polymer. When the crosslinked polymer is immersed in the solvent, because the molecular chain segment between the crosslinking points is still long and quite flexible, the solvent molecules are easy to penetrate into the polymer white, causing the extension of the three-dimensional molecular network and volume expansion; However, the extension of the molecular chain between the cross-linking points causes the reduction of its conformation entropy - the molecular network generates elasticity contraction force, preventing the solvent from entering the molecular network. When these two opposite actions are equal, the system reaches the swelling equilibrium state, and the volume does not change. The volume method and mass method can be used to determine the swelling degree of crosslinking polymerization i, and then its degree of crosslinking can be obtained.

explanation_cn: 高分子在一定压力下完善晶体与非晶相达到热力学平衡的温度。
explanation_en: The temperature at which macromolecule perfects crystal and amorphous phase to reach thermodynamics equilibrium under certain pressure.

explanation_cn: 又称可逆电位。处于热力学平衡状态的电极体系（可逆电极），由于氧化反应和还原反应速率相等。电荷交换和物质交换都处于动态平衡之中，因而净反应速率为零，电极上没有电流流过。即外电流等于零。这时的电极电位就是平衡电极电位。
explanation_en: Also known as reversible potential. The electrode system in thermodynamics equilibrium (reversible electrode) has the same rate of oxidation reaction and reduction reaction. Both charge exchange and material exchange are in dynamic equilibrium, resulting in a net reaction rate of zero and no current flowing through the electrode. The external current is equal to zero. At this time, the electrode potential is the equilibrium electrode potential.

explanation_cn: 高分子链段运动的松弛时间远小于观察时间时的高弹性。
explanation_en: The relaxation time of macromolecule chain segment motion is far less than the high elasticity of observation time.

explanation_cn: 并列复合纤维是一种新型的具有耐氯漂，耐化学药品等优良性能的卷面弹性纤维。
explanation_en: The juxtaposed composite fiber is a new type of roll surface elastic fiber with excellent properties such as chlorine bleach resistance and chemical resistance.

explanation_cn: 共聚物主链中单体单元排列长度的统计分布。
explanation_en: Statistical distribution of monomer unit arrangement length in the main chain of copolymer.

explanation_cn: 又称库珀对。金属中两个电子在微弱吸引相互作用下形成的束缚电子对。库珀在1956年证明：对于金属中的两个电子，如果它们之间存在吸引相互作用，则无论该作用多么微弱都必然使它们形成一个束缚态。人们可以简单通过下述的经典解释以理解库珀电子对的形成原因：由于电子带负电荷，金属中的电子之间是相互排斥的。但是，电子会与晶格点阵上带正电的原子核产生吸引相互作用。该吸引作用导致局部晶格点阵畸变，使格点上的离子稍微靠向该电子并导致附近局域正电荷密度的增加。这时，局部增强的正电荷区域会对其他电子产生吸引作用从而形成电子对耦合。形成库珀对的两个电子之间的距离可达上百纳米。
explanation_en: Also known as Cooper pair. A bound electron pair formed by the weak attractive interaction between two electrons in a metal. Cooper proved in 1956 that for two electrons in a metal, if there is an attractive interaction between them, no matter how weak the interaction is, it will inevitably cause them to form a bound state. One can simply understand the formation of Cooper electron pair through the following classical explanation: because electrons are negatively charged, electrons in metals are mutually exclusive. However, electrons will engage in attractive interactions with positively charged atomic nuclei on the lattice lattice. This attraction leads to the distortion of the local lattice lattice, making the ions on the lattice slightly close to the electron and leading to the increase of the nearby local positive charge density. At this point, the locally enhanced positive charge region will attract other electrons, forming electron pair coupling. The distance between the two electrons forming a Cooper pair can reach hundreds of nanometers.

explanation_cn: 以应力为纵坐标，应变为横坐标的曲线称为应力-应变曲线。实验测出的应力-应变曲线也称为工程（或条件）应力-应变曲线。
explanation_en: The curve with stress as ordinate and strain as abscissa is called stress-strain curve. The stress-strain curve measured experimentally is also called the engineering (or conditional) stress-strain curve.

explanation_cn: 又称胁强光学恒量，是胁强光学范畴内的一个特征物理量。由于介质在外界影响下发生形变，导致其折射率发生变化而引起的一系列的光学效应，均属胁强光学范畴。它是光测弹性等技术应用方面的重要物理参量。
explanation_en: Also called coercive optical constant, it is a characteristic physical quantity in the field of stress optics. A series of optical effects caused by the deformation of the medium under the influence of the outside, resulting in the change of its refractive index, belong to the category of stress optics. It is an important physical parameter in the application of optical elasticity and other technologies.

explanation_cn: 通常指高分子材料在应力作用下内部产生大量微裂纹、光线在应力区的局部折射率发生变化而在材料中出现发白区域的现象。可以是材料中微空洞形成的结果，而对于非均相材料来说，也可以是材料中形成微裂纹的。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to the phenomenon that a large number of microcracks are generated in the polymer materials under stress, and the local refractive index of light in the stress area changes, resulting in a white area in the materials. It can be the result of the formation of microvoids in materials, and for heterogeneous phase materials, it can also be the result of the formation of microcracks in materials.

explanation_cn: 材料在低于其静拉伸强度的张应力作用下表面或内部出现银纹或裂纹的现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of craze or crack on the surface or inside of materials under the action of tensile stress lower than its static tensile strength.

explanation_cn: 在弹性范兩内，应力和应变多值关系时，从而导致应力超前应变并随时间增长而减小的现象称为。它是滞弹性现象的一种表现形式。对滞弹性体，应力和应变服从胡克定律，但并不在加载瞬时成立，而是要经过一段时间后才能到达胡克定律所对应的值（平衡值）。这时应变随时间而不断增大，最后达平衡值，这个过程也称为滞弹性蠕变（微蠕变）。
explanation_en: In the elasticity range, when the stress and strain are multivalued, the phenomenon that the stress leads to the strain and decreases with time is called. It is a form of anelasticity. For anelastic bodies, stress and strain obey Hooke's law, but it does not hold true at the moment of loading, but it takes some time to reach the value corresponding to Hooke's law (equilibrium value). At this time, the strain increases with time and finally reaches the equilibrium value, which is also called anelasticity creep (micro creep).

explanation_cn: 控制裂纹前端各点弹性应力场大小的参量（即裂尖应力场大小的度量）称为应力强度因子。应力-溶剂银纹高分子材料在低于其静拉伸强度的张应力和溶剂的共同作用下表面或内部出现的银纹。
explanation_en: The parameter that controls the size of the elasticity stress field at each point at the front of the crack (that is, the measurement of the size of the stress field at the crack tip) is called stress intensity factor. Stress solvent craze The craze on the surface or inside of a macromolecule materials under the combined action of a tensile stress lower than its static tensile strength and a solvent.

explanation_cn: 构件或试样在总形变(或位移）恒定的条件下，由于弹性变形不断转变为塑性变形，从而使应力随时间不断减小的过程称为应力松弛。这种现象多出现于弹簧、螺栓以及其他压力配合件。尽管在室温下也能产生，但随温度升高，也变明显，它本质上是一种蠕变。应力松弛试验是在恒温（一般在高温）恒位移条件下测量应力随时间的变化，并以规定时间后的剩余应力作为材料抗力的判据。它除了和材料的本质及组织结构有关外，也和试验温度及初始变形量有关。试验可用来确定栓接件在高温下长期使用时保持足够紧同力所需的初始应力，预测密封垫密封度的减小，弹簧弹力的降低，预应力混凝土中钢筋的稳定性。
explanation_en: When the total deformation (or displacement) of a component or sample is constant, the process of stress decreasing with time due to the continuous transformation of elastic deformation to plastic deformation is called stress release. This phenomenon often occurs in springs, bolts, and other pressure fitting components. Although it can also occur at room temperature, it becomes obvious with the increase of temperature. It is essentially a creep. Test of stress relaxation is to measure the change of stress with time under the condition of constant temperature (generally at high temperature) and constant displacement, and take the residual stress after the specified time as the criterion of materials resistance. It is not only related to the nature and structure of materials, but also to the test temperature and initial deformation. The test can be used to determine the initial stress required for the bolted parts to maintain sufficient tightness when they are used for a long time under high temperature, predict the reduction of the sealing degree of the gasket, the reduction of the spring elasticity, and the stability of the reinforcement in the prestressed concrete.

explanation_cn: 测定材料应力松弛性能的一种高温力学性能试验方法。松弛稳定性表征材料抵抗高温应力松弛的力学性能，根据应力松弛试验所测定的松弛曲线来评定。材料的松弛曲线是在给定温度和总变形量不变条件下应力随时间而降低的曲线，其第一阶段的晶间稳定系数，以及第二阶段的晶内稳定系数均可用来表征材料的松弛稳定性。影响试验精度的主要因素是试样中试验长度内温度的均匀性以及载荷与伸长量同步测量的精度等。
explanation_en: A high temperature mechanical property test method to determine the stress release property of materials. The relaxation stability characterizes the mechanical properties of materials against high temperature stress release, and is evaluated according to the relaxation curve measured by the stress release test. The relaxation curve of materials is the curve that the stress decreases with time under the condition that the given temperature and total deformation are constant. The intergranular stability coefficient in the first stage and the intracrystalline stability coefficient in the second stage can be used to characterize the relaxation stability of materials. The main factors affecting the accuracy of the experiment are the uniformity of temperature within the test length of the sample and the accuracy of synchronous measurement of load and elongation.

explanation_cn: 见疲劳试验。
explanation_en: See fatigue test.

explanation_cn: 由残余应力或外加应力与腐蚀联合作用产生的材料破坏过程。
explanation_en: The failure process of materials caused by the combined action of residual stress or external stress and corrosion.

explanation_cn: 应力腐蚀导致材料开裂，其主要特征有：①必须有应力，包括外加载荷产生的应力、残余应力、腐蚀产物的楔形应力等;②腐蚀介质是特定的.只有某些金属-介质的组合.才会发生应力腐蚀断裂;③需要一定时间。
explanation_en: Stress corrosion causes cracking of materials, and its main characteristics are: ① there must be stress, including stress generated by external load, residual stress, wedge stress of corrosion products, etc.; ② Corrosion medium is specific. stress corrosion fracture only occurs in some metal medium combinations; ③ It takes some time.

explanation_cn: 用惰性介质和腐蚀介质中伸长率、断面收缩率的相对差值作为应力腐蚀敏感性的度量。
explanation_en: The relative difference of elongation and reduction of area in inert medium and corrosion medium is used as the measurement of stress corrosion cracking susceptibility.

explanation_cn: 一种用来降低贴壁黏结的同体火箭发动机燃烧室装药局部应力的结构设计。通过在贴壁浇铸的固体火箭发动机燃烧室装药两端部绝热层与推进剂装药之间预制一圈低模量的包覆层材料。当温度发生变化时，在燃烧室两端部产生的热应力因的模量低、形变大.可通过变形降低其热应力水平，从而降低应力对推进剂装药结构的影响程度。与自由脱黏层结构相比，应力释放罩结构简单，施工方便，但只能降低该部位热应力水平而不能消除热应力，一般用于结构简单的小型固体火箭发动机装药设计。
explanation_en: A structural design for reducing local stress in the combustion chamber charge of a homogeneous rocket engine with wall adhesion. A ring of low modulus cladding layer materials is prefabricated between the heat insulation liner at both ends of the solid rocket motor combustion chamber charge and the propellant charge, which is cast against the wall. When the temperature changes, the thermal stress generated at both ends of the combustion chamber has low modulus and large deformation. The level of its thermal stress can be reduced by deformation, thus reducing the impact of stress on the propellant charge structure. Compared with the liner for stress self release structure, the casing for stress release has a simple structure and is easy to construct, but it can only reduce the thermal stress level of this part and cannot eliminate thermal stress. It is generally used for the design of small solid rocket motor charges with simple structure.

explanation_cn: 物体内几何不连续（如缺口或裂纹）或缺陷（对金属如位错寒积群）附近的应力比平均（或名义）应力要高，称为应力集中。对于孔或缺口，可用系数,来描述应力集中，它等于集中应力和名义应力之比。
explanation_en: The stress near the geometric discontinuity (such as notch or crack) or defect (such as dislocation cold accumulation group for metal) in the object is higher than the average (or nominal) stress, which is called stress concentration. For holes or notches, a coefficient can be used to describe the stress concentration, which is equal to the ratio of the concentrated stress to the nominal stress.

explanation_cn: 由晶格失配的两种材料组成超晶格时，界面失配引起大量位错将严重损害超晶格的质量。但若使超晶格各层的厚度不超过所谓的临界厚度，则层向产生形变可使各层的纵向晶格常数增大或减小而横向晶格常数保持一致，从而补偿晶格失配并得到无界面失配位错的应变层超晶格。大大扩展了超晶格材料的种类而不再局限于晶格匹配材料。应变的存在还导致一些新的电学和光学性质，但它使超晶格成为一种亚稳结构。
explanation_en: When a superlattice is composed of two materials with lattice mismatch, a large number of dislocation caused by interface mismatch will seriously damage the quality of superlattice. However, if the thickness of each layer of the superlattice is not more than the so-called critical thickness, deformation in the layer direction can increase or decrease the longitudinal lattice constant of each layer and keep the transverse lattice constant consistent, thus compensating for lattice mismatch and obtaining a stained layer superlattice without boundary mismatch dislocation. It has greatly expanded the category of superlattice materials and is no longer limited to lattice matching materials. The existence of strain also leads to some new electrical and optical properties, but it makes superlattice a metastable structure.

explanation_cn: 在塑性变形时或变形后钢中间隙固溶原子C、N与位错发生弹性交互作用而引起钢的性能变化的过程。性能的变化发生在变形之后的称为静态;性能变化与塑性应变同时发生的称为动态。钢中可区分为三个过程：间隙原子在位错核心或畸变场的短程有序分布、Cottrell气团（及Snoek气团）的形成、间隙原子过饱和沉淀相的析出。通常所说的系指低碳钢的静态，在常温长时间放置过程中发生间隙固溶原子与位错的交互作用，形成气团，使位错运动变得困难，导致强度和硬度增高、塑性和韧性下降，且重新出现屈服点现象。
explanation_en: The process of elasticity interaction between steel interstitial solution atoms C, N and dislocation during or after plastic deformation, which causes the property change of steel. The change in performance that occurs after deformation is called static; The simultaneous occurrence of performance changes and plastic strain is called dynamic. Three processes can be distinguished in steel: short range ordered distribution of interstitial atoms in dislocation core or distortion field, formation of Cottrell air mass (and Snoek air mass), and precipitation of supersaturated precipitation phase of interstitial atoms. Generally speaking, it refers to the static state of low-cardon steel. During the long-term storage at room temperature, the interaction between interstitial solid solution atoms and dislocation occurs, forming air masses, making the movement of dislocation difficult, leading to increased strength and hardness, decreased plasticity and toughness, and the yield point phenomenon reappears.

explanation_cn: 电阻与应变关系曲线在较大应变量范围内线性好，斜率大而且电阻温度系数绝对值很小的合金，种类繁多。康铜或镍铬合金是应用很广的，成本低廉，使用最广，但不能在较高温度下工作。卡玛合金稳定性好，电阻率、灵敏系数和疲劳寿命较高，热输出曲线比康铜平直，温度自补偿效果好，能做成温度自补偿型或弹性模量自补偿型，在-269-290°C范围内进行静态测量，短期高温可至400°C。铂钨合金是优良的贵金属应变片材料。典型的合金是PtW8和PtW9.5,它们具有高的抗张强度、电阻率和电阻应变灵敏系数，电阻温度系数低，抗氧化性优良。将PtW9.5应变线制成电阻应变片，可用在航空发动机的转动部件上。
explanation_en: There are many kinds of alloy with good linearity, large slope and small absolute value of resistance temperature coefficient in a large strain range. Constantan or nickel chromium alloy is widely used, with low cost and the widest use, but it cannot work at higher temperatures. Kama alloy has good stability, high resistivity, sensitivity coefficient and fatigue life, flat and straight thermal output curve compared with Common, and good temperature self compensation effect. It can be made into temperature self compensation type or elastic modulus self compensation type. Static measurement can be carried out within the range of -269-290 ° C, and short-term high temperature can reach 400 ° C. Platinum tungsten alloys is an excellent precious metals strain gauge materials. Typical alloy are PtW8 and PtW9.5, which have high tensile strength, resistivity and resistance strain sensitivity coefficient, low resistance temperature coefficient and excellent oxidation resistance. The PtW9.5 strain line is made into a resistance strain gauge, which can be used on rotating parts of aircraft engines.
