explanation_en: See fatigue test.

explanation_cn: 指原子之间的距离不同于通常硅晶格常数的薄层硅，因而存在应变。引入应变可降低载流子的有效质量和减少声子对载流子的散射，从而提高载流子的迁移率，使器件的电流特性和频率特性都得到改善。有两大类：一是全局应变硅，即在整个硅片表面形成一层均匀的层，当衬底的晶格常数大于外延层时，引入双轴张应力，反之则引入双轴压应力;另一类是局部，即仅在晶体管的沟道区存在应变而在其他区域没有应变，这种应变一般是单轴应变。全局的实现方式主要有：应变弛豫缓冲层结构、绝缘层上错硅、绝缘层上应变硅等。局部的实现方式主要有：嵌入式、浅槽隔离、氮化硅帽层、等。
explanation_en: A thin layer of silicon with a distance between atoms that is different from the usual lattice constant of silicon, resulting in strain. The introduction of strain can reduce the effective mass of carriers and the scattering of phonon on carriers, thus improving the mobility of carriers and improving the current and frequency characteristics of devices. There are two major categories: one is global strained silicon, that is, a uniform layer is formed on the surface of the entire silicon wafer. When the lattice constant of the substrate is greater than the epitaxial layer, biaxial tensile stress is introduced, and vice versa; The other type is local, which means that there is only strain in the channel region of the transistor and no strain in other regions, and this strain is generally uniaxial. The global realization methods mainly include: strain relaxation buffer layer structure, dislocation silicon on insulation layer, strained silicon on insulation layer, etc. The main local implementation methods include embedded, shallow groove isolation, silicon nitride cap layer, and so on.

explanation_cn: 又称加工硬化。塑性变形阻力（继续塑性变形所需外应力）随塑性变形量的增大而增加的现象。本质是在塑性变形过程中位错运动的阻力愈来愈大。塑性变形过程中位错将增殖，从而位错密度随变形量增大而升高，当晶体中位错密度愈大时，运动位错遇到的阻力也愈大，需要不断增大外应力才能使塑性变形继续进行。应变硬化程度用率来表示。
explanation_en: Also called work hardening. The phenomenon that the resistance to plastic deformation (the external stress required to continue plastic deformation) increases with the increase of plastic deformation. The essence is that the resistance of dislocation movement is increasing during plastic deformation. During plastic deformation, dislocation will multiply, so the dislocation density will increase with the increase of deformation. When the dislocation density in crystal is larger, the resistance encountered by moving dislocation will be larger, and the external stress needs to be continuously increased to continue the plastic deformation. The degree of strain hardening is expressed by rate.

explanation_cn: 材料形变过程中，单位体积中外力所做的形变功为这个功一个部分变成热，大部分储存在试样内部，成为。一般情况下，可以忽略热能损耗时，认为变形功全部成为，它可用应力应变曲线下的面积度量。卸载后弹性应变回复到零，这时储存的弹性就全部释放。因塑性变形后试样中要产生大量缺陷（对金属主要是位错），它们能引起点阵畸变，生成畸变能，它就是卸载试样中储存的应变能。因为经过塑性变形后的晶体储存有应变能，它使内能升高，处于热力学不稳定状态，有向稳定状态转化的自发倾向，这是形变晶体发生回复和再结晶的驱动力。
explanation_en: In the process of deformation of materials, part of the deformation work done by the external force in the unit volume becomes heat, and most of it is stored in the sample. In general, when thermal energy loss can be ignored, it is considered that the deformation work is all, which can be measured by the area under the stress-strain curve. After unloading, the elasticity strain recovery to zero, and then all the stored elasticity is released. Since a large number of defects (mainly dislocation for metals) will be produced in the sample after plastic deformation, they can cause lattice distortion and generate distortion energy, which is the strain energy stored in the unloading sample. Because the crystal after plastic deformation stores strain energy, it makes the internal energy rise, and it is in a thermodynamics unstable state, with a spontaneous tendency to transform to a stable state, which is the driving force for recovery and recrystallization of deformation crystal.

explanation_cn: 指材料试件经1次或多次加载和卸载后，进一步变形所需的应力（载荷极限）比原来的要小，即应变后材料变软的现象。对高分子而言，通常指材料被拉伸至屈服点以后，当进一步增加应变时，材料的负载力会下降的现象。
explanation_en: It refers to the phenomenon that the stress (load limit) required for further deformation of materials specimen is smaller than the original after one or more times of loading and unloading, that is, the materials becomes soft after strain. For macromolecule, it usually refers to the phenomenon that after materials is stretched to yield point, when the strain is further increased, the load force of materials will decrease.

explanation_cn: 单位时间内的应变改变量称为或应变率。高速加载相当绝热过程，有很大一部分塑性变形功将转化为热能，从而使试样温度明显升高，有时可高达几百摄氏度。
explanation_en: The amount of strain change per unit time is called the strain rate. High speed loading is an adiabatic process, where a significant portion of plastic deformation work is converted into thermal energy, resulting in a significant increase in the temperature of the sample, sometimes up to several hundred degrees Celsius.

explanation_cn: 装在大口径大炮弹丸底部，在弹丸飞行中稳定燃烧排出燃气的一种装药。在弹丸飞行中通过燃烧排出的高温燃气填充因弹丸运动所形成的弹底低压区，以提高弹丸的飞行速度和增加其射程。现用的底排药有丁羟复合推进剂和烟火药两类。使用底排发射药后可使弹丸的射程由原来的28km增加到40km左右。
explanation_en: A charge that is installed at the bottom of a large caliber projectile to stably combustion and exhaust gas during the flight of the projectile. During the flight of the projectile, the high temperature gas discharged through combustion fills the low pressure zone at the bottom of the projectile formed by the movement of the projectile, so as to improve the flight speed of the projectile and increase its range. There are two types of base bleed propellant currently used, namely, HTPB composition propellant and pyrotechnic propellant. With the use of bottom bleed gun propellant, the range of the projectile can be increased from 28 km to about 40 km.

explanation_cn: 直接涂到物体表面作为面漆坚实基础的涂料。常用金属表面底漆有醇酸底漆、环氧酯底漆、过氯乙烯底漆、硝基底漆等，木材表面底漆有虫胶清漆。
explanation_en: Coatings that is directly applied to the surface of an object as a solid foundation for top coating. Common primer for metal surface include alkyd primer, epoxy ester primer, perchloroethylene primer, nitro primer, etc., and primer for wood surface includes shellac varnish.

explanation_cn: 以稳定的速度燃烧，实现一定燃烧传递延迟时间的药剂。主要由氧化剂、还原剂（可燃剂）、黏合剂及燃速调节剂组成，通常装压入壳体中，或制成柱、延期索装入壳体中。按可燃剂组分不同可分为硅系延期药、硼系、钨系，以及有机药剂组分延期药等;按燃烧时有无气体可分为有气体、微气体和无气体三类，有气体的燃速受外界压力影响较大;按延期时间可分为微秒级（瞬间延期药）、毫秒级（短）、秒级（长）。延期时间主要取决于柱的燃速和长度。主要技术要求是燃速稳定，燃烧传递时间精确。作用可靠，物理化学安定性好，机械感度低，工艺简便。影响燃速和精度的主要因素有药剂组分与配比、引燃火焰猛度、环境温度、原料的纯度和粒度、压药密度以及约束条件等。评定的参数主要有的延期精度（发火点）、燃速和输出能量等。主要用于时间引信、自毁装置、解脱机构、延期雷管、延期点火具等。
explanation_en: Combustion at a stable speed to achieve a certain delay time of combustion. It is mainly composed of oxidizer, reducing agent (combustible agent), adhesive and burning rate regulator, and is usually pressed into the housing, or made into columns and delay cables. It can be divided into silicon type delay composition, boron delay composition, tungsten delay composition, and organic delay composition delay composition according to different combustible composition; According to the presence or absence of gas during combustion, it can be divided into three categories: presence of gas, micro gas and absence of gas. The burning rate with gas is greatly affected by external pressure; According to the delay time, it can be divided into microsecond level (instantaneous delay composition), millisecond level (short) and second level (long). The delay time mainly depends on the burning rate and length of the column. The main technical requirements are stable burning rate and accurate combustion transfer time. It has reliable function, good physical chemistry stability, low mechanical sensitivity and simple process. The main factors affecting the burning rate and accuracy are the composition and proportion of the propellant, the intensity of the pilot flame, the ambient temperature, the purity and particle size of the raw materials, the density of the pressurized propellant, and the constraint conditions. The evaluation parameters mainly include delay precision (ignition point), burning rate and output energy. Mainly used for time fuses, self destruct devices, release mechanisms, delay detonators, delay igniters, etc.

explanation_cn: 由局部应力引起氢化物在裂纹尖端形成而使材料脆化，发生不可逆损伤、塑性下降以及低屯力下的滞后断裂的现象。
explanation_en: The local stress causes the formation of hydride at the crack tip to embrittle the materials, causing irreversible damage, plastic decline and delayed fracture under low tunneling force.

name_cn: 延迟荧光有机/聚合物材料
explanation_cn: 延迟荧光有机/聚合物材料是一种具有延迟荧光性质的有机或聚合物材料。它们在光激发后能够延迟发光，通常用于生物成像、荧光探针、传感器和其他光学应用。
explanation_en: Delay-fluorescent organic polymer materials is an organic or polymer materials with delayed fluorescence property. They can delay luminescence after light excitation, and are usually used in biological imaging, fluorescence probes, sensors and other optical applications.

explanation_cn: 建筑物按受爆炸破坏的程度划分的等级，可用冲击波超压值表征，共分七级，一级是建筑物基本上无破坏，偶尔有门窗玻璃破坏现象；二级是建筑物受到次轻度破坏，冲击波超压值不大于2kPa;三级是建筑物受到轻度破坏，冲击波超压值为9-24kPa;四级 是建筑物受到中等破坏，冲击波超压值为24-44kPa;五级是建筑物受到次严重破坏，冲击波超压 值为44-68. 6kPa;六级是建筑物遭受严重破坏，冲击波超压值大于68. 6kPa;七级是建筑物遭到完全破坏，冲击波超压值大于98kPa。通常设计工厂总平面图时，需按破坏等级确定安全距离和建筑结构方式。
explanation_en: The buildings are classified according to the degree of explosion damage, which can be characterized by the value of shock wave overpressure. There are seven levels in total. The first level is that the buildings are basically free of damage, and occasionally the glass of doors and windows is damaged; The second level refers to the minor damage to the building, with a shock wave overpressure value not exceeding 2kPa; Level 3 refers to mild damage to the building, with a shock wave overpressure value of 9-24kPa; Level 4 refers to moderate damage to the building, with a shock wave overpressure value of 24-44kPa; Level 5 refers to the second severe damage to the building, with a shock wave overpressure value of 44-68 6kPa; Level 6 refers to severe damage to buildings, with a shock wave overpressure value greater than 68 6kPa; Level 7 indicates complete damage to the building, with a shock wave overpressure value greater than 98kPa. In general, when designing the general layout of the factory, safe distance and building structure mode shall be determined according to the damage level.

explanation_cn: 用于建筑装饰或作为建筑构件的陶瓷制品。包括陶瓷内墙砖、外墙砖、地砖、陶管、砖瓦、琉璃以及道路砖等。一般采用黏土和其他无机非金属材料为原料通过混合、成型、干燥、烧成等工序制成。按制品材质分为粗陶、精陶、 半瓷和瓷质四类；按坯体烧结程度分为多孔性、致密 性以及有釉、无釉制品。其共同特点是强度高、防潮、防火、耐酸、耐碱、抗冻、不老化、不变质、不 褪色、易清洁等，并具有丰富的艺术装饰效果。
explanation_en: Ceramics products used for architectural decoration or as building components. Including ceramics interior wall tiles, exterior wall tiles, floor tiles, ceramic pipes, bricks, tiles, colored glaze and road tiles. Generally, clay and other inorganic nonmetallic materials are used as raw materials through mixing, molding, drying, firing and other processes. According to the product material, it can be divided into four categories: coarse pottery, fine pottery, semi porcelain and porcelain; According to the degree of sintering of green body, it can be divided into porous, dense and glaze and glaze free products. Its common characteristics are high strength, moisture resistance, fire resistance, acid resistance, alkali resistance, frost resistance, non aging, non deterioration, non fading, easy cleaning, etc., and it has rich artistic decoration effects.

explanation_cn: 开尔文关系式是由英国科学家威廉.汤姆逊(William Thomson).即开尔文男爵，于1854年提出的关于热力学效应的关系式，也称为汤姆逊关系式(Thomson relations)。开尔文关系式包括第一关系式和第二关系式。在开尔文第一关系式中.汤姆逊系数是唯一一个可以针对单种材料直接测量的热电系数。珀耳帖系数和塞贝克系数只能由两种材料放在一起测量其相对值。这两个物理系数对于每种材料的绝对数值可借助于开尔文第一关系式通过积分的方法计算出来。
explanation_en: The Kelvin relation was put forward by British scientist William Thomson, namely Baron Kelvin, in 1854 about the thermodynamics effect, also known as Thomson relations. The Kelvin relationship includes the first and second relationships. In the first Kelvins relationship, Thomson coefficient is the only thermoelectric coefficient that can be directly measured for a single materials. Peltier coefficient and Seebeck coefficient can only be measured by two materials together. The absolute values of these two physical coefficients for each materials can be calculated by means of the first Kelvins relationship through integration.

explanation_cn: 参见汤姆逊效应。
explanation_en: See Thomson effect.

explanation_cn: 简称开系。与外界环境之间既有能量交换又有物质交换的系统。与开放系统相对立的有封闭系统。在客观世界中封闭系统的存在是相对的，而开放系统的存在是绝对的。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as Kaishi. A system that involves both energy exchange and material exchange with the external environment. Opposite to the opened system is the closed system. In the objective world, the existence of closed system is relative, while the existence of opened system is absolute.

explanation_cn: 环状化合物单体经过开环加成转变为线型聚合物的反应。生成的聚合物和单体组成相同，聚合过程中只发生环的破裂，由单体分子环内连接，变成开环分子间连接，不增加新键。可合成主链上含有杂原子的聚合物（如含醚键、酯键、酰胺键等杂链聚合物）开环聚合反应主要是离子型引发体系进行引发反应。开环聚合的链增长反应能既有连锁聚合也有逐步聚合或两者皆有的特性。已有许多品种实现工业化，如环氧乙烷、尼龙-6、氯化聚醚（聚3,3’-双氯甲基丁氧环）、聚甲醛等。
explanation_en: The reaction of ring compound monomer through ring opening addition to transformation into linear polymer. The composition of the generated polymer and monomer is the same. During polymerization, only the ring breaks occur, and the monomer becomes an open ring intermolecular connection, without adding new bonds. The ring opening polymerization of synthetic polymer containing heteroatoms on the main chain (such as heterochain polymer containing ether bonds, ester bonds, amide bonds, etc.) is mainly initiated by ionic initiator systems. The chain growth reaction energy of ring opening polymerization has the characteristics of chain polymerization, stepwise (reaction) polymerization or both. Many varieties have been industrialized, such as ethylene oxide, nylon resin -6, chlorinated polyether (poly (3,3 '- dichloromethyl butyloxane)), polyformaldehyde, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称经济断面钢管。它包括横断面轮廓非圆形的、等壁厚的、变壁厚的、沿长度方向变直径和变壁厚的、断面对称的和不对称的等。如方形、矩形、锥形、梯形、螺旋形管等。异型钢管更能适应使用条件的特殊性，节约金属和提高零部件制造的劳动生产率。广泛应用在航空、汽车、造船、矿山机械、农业机械、建筑、轻纺以及锅炉制造等方面。与普通圆形管相比.种类多，数量少。随着国民经济的发展和钢管工业的进步，会不断出现更多种类的。生产的方法有冷拔、冷轧、电焊、挤压、热轧等。其中冷拔法得到了比较广泛的应用。特别在小批量生产的情况下更为合适。和其他方法比较，冷拔法适应性广，可以生产断面对称和断面不对称的异型钢管，也可生产变直径和螺旋形管等。所用成型工具、设备、工艺的准备，相对比较简单。
explanation_en: Also known as economic section steel pipe. It includes cross-sectional contours that are non circular, of equal wall thickness, of varying wall thickness, of varying diameter and wall thickness along the length direction, of symmetrical and asymmetric cross-sections. Such as square, rectangular, conical, trapezoidal, spiral tubes, etc. Specially shaped steel pipes are more suitable for the unique usage conditions, saving metal and improving labor productivity in component manufacturing. Widely used in aviation, automobiles, shipbuilding, mining machinery, agricultural machinery, construction, light textile, and boiler manufacturing. Compared with ordinary circular tubes, there are many types and fewer quantities. With the development of the national economy and the progress of the steel pipe industry, more types will continue to emerge. The production methods include cold drawing, cold rolling, electric welding, extrusion, hot rolling, etc. The cold drawing method has been widely used among them. Especially suitable for small-scale production. Compared with other methods, the cold drawing method has a wide adaptability and can produce special-shaped steel pipes with symmetrical and asymmetric sections, as well as variable diameter and spiral pipes. The preparation of the molding tools, equipment, and processes used is relatively simple.

explanation_cn: 环状结构硅酸盐矿物。三方晶系。晶体常呈板状或柱状。黄褐色及不同色调的砖红色。玻璃至半油脂光泽。一组中等解理。断口不平坦。性脆，莫氏硬度55.5,密度2.74-2.98g/cm3,具弱磁性。主要产于碱性岩及有关的气成热液矿床中，与长石、霞石、闪叶石共生。
explanation_en: Silicate mineral with ring structure. Tripartite crystal system. Crystal are usually in the form of plates or columns. Yellow brown and different shades of brick red. Glass to semi greasy gloss. A set of moderate cleavage. The fracture is not flat. Brittle, Mohs hardness 55.5, density 2.74-2.98g/cm3, weak magnetism. It mainly occurs in alkaline rock and related gas generated hydrothermal deposits, coexisting with feldspar, nepheline and amphibole.

explanation_cn: 又称不对称乳制。轧制时上下轧辊的圆周线速度不同，故属于差速轧制。上下轧辊的圆周线速度不同将改变轧件变形区中的变形条件，使板材在压缩变形的同时产生较大的剪切变形。上下轧辊的圆周线速度不同可通过改变上下辊直径或转速来实现。该工艺具有降低轧制力等优点，可用于生产极薄带材或精密带材。但该工艺容易使轧机颤振。
explanation_en: Also known as asymmetric milking. When rolling, the circumferential linear speed of upper and lower roll is different, so it belongs to differential rolling. The different circumferential linear velocities of the upper and lower roll will change the deformation conditions in the deformation zone of the rolled piece, so that the plate will produce large shear deformation while compressing. The difference of the circumferential linear speed of the upper and lower roll can be realized by changing the diameter or speed of the upper and lower rolls. This process has the advantages of reducing rolling force and can be used to produce extremely thin or precision strips. But this process is easy to make rolling mill chatter.

explanation_cn: 系指医学设备、假肢或生物材料等植入人体后，由巨噬细胞和异物巨细胞参与所产生的终期炎症反应或伤口愈合反应。在医学材料植入人体的最初24周生物材料的表面物理、化学和形貌在调节巨噬细胞和异物巨细胞相互作用方面发挥着重要作用。异物反应的过程包括蛋白吸附单核/巨噬细胞的黏附，巨噬细胞融合形成异物巨细胞。最终巨噬细胞/异物巨细胞和炎症/伤口愈合细胞间交互影响在生物材料表面形成异物反应。
explanation_en: It refers to the final inflammatory reaction or wound healing reaction caused by macrophages and foreign body giant cells after medical equipment, artificial limbs or biological materials are implanted into the human body. In the first 24 weeks of implantation of medical materials into human body, the surface physics, chemistry and morphology of biological materials play an important role in regulating the interaction between macrophages and foreign body giant cells. The process of foreign body reaction includes protein adsorption, adhesion of monocytes/macrophages, and macrophage fusion to form foreign body giant cells. Finally, the interaction between macrophages/foreign body giant cells and inflammatory/wound healing cells forms foreign body reaction on the surface of biomaterials.

explanation_cn: 参见火药。
explanation_en: See propellant.

explanation_cn: 由两种不同元素或不同成分材料所构成的结型材料。结两边的导电类型由掺杂控制，掺杂类型相同的称为同型异质结，掺杂类型不同的称为异型异质结。由于结两边材料的禁带宽度和其他特性不同，异质结具有一系列同质结所没有的特性。采用异质结制作器件可获得高放大倍数和响应速度。异质结材料可采用液相外延、气相外延、金属有机化学气相沉积和分子束外延方法来制备，在半导体器件、光电子器件、集成光学和集成电路等领域有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: A junction type materials consisting of two different elements or different materials. The conductivity type on both sides of the junction is controlled by doping. Those with the same doping type are called homojunction, while those with different doping types are called heterojunction. Because the band gap and other characteristics of the materials on both sides of the junction are different, the heterojunction has a series of characteristics that are not available in the homogeneous junction. Using heterojunctions to fabricate devices can achieve high magnification and response speed. Heterojunction materials can be prepared by liquid phase epitaxy, vapor phase epitaxy, metal organic chemical vapor deposition method and molecular beam epitaxy, and are widely used in semiconductor devices, optoelectronic devices, integrated optics and integrated circuits.

explanation_cn: 见接触腐蚀。
explanation_en: See contact corrosion.

explanation_cn: 又称引线。电子元件的引出线与印制电路板连接，形成整机的功能部件。整机的可靠性在很大程度上取决于引线的可靠性。电子元件所用的导电材料.因基材成分、键（涂）层种类、含杂量、厚度和产生工艺不同，各种在力学性能、电性能、热性能、磁性能、耐腐蚀性和可焊性上各有不同.在选用电子元件时应具体考虑以下情况：①对电子元件本身的影响.如的导电性、接触电阻、离子和分子的迁移、化学变化和电化学影响。②对电子元件密封性影响，如与电子元件包封料的亲和性，的热膨胀系数及其熔封性。③是否适应电子元件生产工艺，如是否适于清洗、烘干、对焊、轧扁、铆接、涂漆、烘漆、电气老练、机械设备的牵引打弯，是否适应高速连续生产，能经受气体污染否等。④是否适应整机的工作环境.能否确保整机不因而发生故障。⑤是否适于整机高密度群焊技术。
explanation_en: Also called leads. The outgoing Une of the electronic components is connected with the printed circuit board to form the functional parts of the whole machine. The reliability of the whole machine depends to a great extent on the reliability of the leads. The conductive material used for electronic components are different in mechanical properties, electrical properties, thermal properties, magnetic properties, corrosion resistance and solderability due to different base material composition, bond (coating) layer type, impurity content, thickness and production process. When selecting electronic components, the following conditions should be taken into consideration: ① the impact on electronic components itself, such as conductivity, contact resistance, migration of ions and molecules Chemical changes and electrochemical effects. ② The impact on the sealing performance of electronic components, such as the affinity with electronic component packaging materials, the coefficient of thermal expansion, and its sealing ability Whether it is suitable for the production process of electronic components, such as cleaning, drying, butt welding, flattening, riveting, painting, baking, electrical aging, traction and bending of mechanical equipment, whether it is suitable for high-speed continuous production, and whether it can withstand gas pollution. ④ Is it suitable for the working environment of the entire machine? Can it ensure that the entire machine does not malfunction as a result? ⑤ Whether it is suitable for high density group welding technology of the whole machine.

explanation_cn: 在自由基聚合中，同时起到引发、链转移和链终止作用的一类特殊化合物。一般可分为热分解和光分解两种类型。热分解型引发-转移-终止剂主要是1,2-二取代的四苯基乙烷衍生物，可以引发极性单体甲基丙烯酸甲酯活性聚合，引发非极性单体如苯乙烯聚合则没有活性聚合的特征。光分解型引发-转移-终止剂主要是含二乙基二硫代氨基甲酰氧基基团的化合物，可以引发多种烯类单体活性聚合，从而制备端基功能化聚合物及嵌段、接枝共聚物。
explanation_en: In free radical polymerization, a special class of compounds that simultaneously play the role of initiation, chain transfer and chain termination. It can generally be divided into two types: thermal decomposition and photodecomposition. The thermal decomposition initiator transfer terminator is mainly a 1,2-disubstituted tetraphenylethane derivative, which can initiate the active polymerization of polar monomer methyl methacrylate, while the initiation of non-polar monomer such as styrene polymerization does not have the characteristics of active polymerization. Photolytic initiation transfer terminators are mainly compounds containing diethyldithiocarbamoyloxy groups, which can initiate active polymerization of a variety of olefin monomer to prepare end group functionalized polymer and block and graft copolymer.

explanation_cn: 在自由基聚合中，同时具有引发作用和链转移作用的化合物。
explanation_en: In free radical polymerization, compounds with both initiation and chain transfer functions.

explanation_cn: 在一定条件下可产生自由基或离子等活性种，以引发链式聚合反应的物质。
explanation_en: A substance that can produce reactive species such as free radicals or ions under certain conditions to initiate chain polymerization.

explanation_cn: 参加引发反应的引发剂量占引发剂分解量的百分数。另一部分引发剂因诱导分解和/或笼蔽效应而损耗。影响引发效率的因素主要包括引发剂种类、单体种类、溶剂、温度、体系黏度。自由基向引发剂转移的反应称为诱导分解，诱导分解反应不仅使引发剂的效率降低，同时也使聚合度降低。在溶液聚合反应中，浓度较低的引发剂分子及其分解出的初级自由基始终处于含大量溶剂分子的高黏度聚合物溶液的包围之中。一部分初级自由基无法与单体分子接触而更容易发生向引发剂或溶剂的转移反应，从而使降低，这种现象称为笼蔽效应。
explanation_en: The percentage of the initiation dose participating in the initiation reaction to the decomposition amount of initiator. Another part of the initiator is lost due to induced decomposition and/or cage effect. The factors affecting the initiation efficiency mainly include the type of initiator, the type of monomer, solvent, temperature, and the viscosity of the system. The reaction of radical transfer to initiator is called induced decomposition. The induced decomposition reaction not only reduces the efficiency of initiator, but also reduces the degree of polymerization. In solution polymerization, initiator molecules with low concentration and the primary free radicals decomposed from them are always surrounded by a high viscosity polymer solution containing a large number of solvent molecules. Some of the primary free radicals cannot contact with monomer molecules and are more likely to transfer to initiator or solvent, so as to reduce. This phenomenon is called cage effect.

explanation_cn: 指受损组织借助生物材料载体定向生长，促进组织修复的过程。例如，受损神经的两个断端能借助硅橡胶、胶原等管状导管的、促进和导向，使神经细胞生长和修复。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of directional growth of damaged tissue with the help of biological materials carrier to promote tissue repair. For example, the two broken ends of the injured nerve can promote and guide the growth and repair of nerve cells with the help of tubular catheter such as silicone rubber and collagen.

explanation_cn: 一种利用机械性阻隔作用人为地控制结缔组织和上皮组织生长人某些区域，从而保证某些组织细胞（如骨细胞）在该去域的生长的膜状材料。在牙周手术或牙种植手术中利用其作为屏障，阻挡上皮在愈合过程中沿牙根方向爬行，并提供一定的空间，引导具有形成新附着能力的牙周膜细胞或骨细胞优先生长，从而促进需要部位形成足够新骨和新附着性愈合。引导组织再生膜可分为可吸收性和不可吸收性两类，不吸收性膜在人体内不能被吸收，需在手术后46周取出。主要成分为聚四氟乙烯（PTFE),是临床最常用的膜材料。可吸收性膜在愈合过程中可降解而被吸收.种类有胶原膜、聚乳酸膜、聚乙醇酸与聚乳酸和碳酸三甲烯共聚膜等。近期也有人用人造皮肤或自体骨膜进行移植，代替可吸收引导组织再生膜。
explanation_en: A membrane like material that artificially controls the growth of connective tissue and epithelial tissue in certain areas by utilizing mechanical barrier effects, thereby ensuring the growth of certain tissue cells (such as bone cells) in that area. It can be used as a barrier in periodontal surgery or dental implant surgery to prevent the epithelium from crawling along the root direction during the healing process, and provide a certain space to induction the periodontal ligament cells or bone cells with the ability to form new attachments to preferentially grow, so as to promote the formation of enough new bone and new attachment healing at the required sites. The guided tissue regeneration membrane can be divided into two types: absorbable and non absorbable. The non absorbable membrane cannot be absorbed in the human body and needs to be taken out 46 weeks after the operation. The main component is polylctrafluorocthylone (PTFE), which is the most commonly used membrane materials in clinic. The absorbable membrane can be degradation and absorbed during the healing process. The types include collagen membrane, polylactic acid membrane, polyglycolic acid and polylactic acid and trimethylene carbonate copolymer membrane. Recently, some people have also used artificial skin or autologous periosteum for transplantation to replace the absorbable guided tissue regeneration membrane.

explanation_cn: 用于制造集成电路引线框架或半导体分立器件引线框架的材料。引线框架是为半导体芯片提供支撑并把芯片的电路与外部线路板提供连接作用的。理想的引线框架材料，必须满足以下特性：①材料的导热导电性能要好，能通过较大的电流将半导体芯片在工作时所产生的热量及时地散发出去。②材料要有足够的强度、刚度和成型性。一般拉伸强度要大于450MPa,延伸率大于4%。③材料要具有较低的热膨胀系数，良好的匹配性、钎焊性、耐蚀性、热耐性和耐氧化性。④平整度好，残余应力小。⑤易冲裁加工，且不起毛刺。⑥材料的成本要尽可能低，以满足大规模商业化应用的要求。引线框架材料常用的主要有两类：铜基引线框架材料和铁基引线框架材料，目前铜基引线框架材料已占80%以上，因价格较高在军工和特殊电路、器件应用。
explanation_en: Materials used for manufacturing integrated circuit leads frames or semiconductor discrete device leads frames. The leads frame provides support for the semiconductor chip and connects the circuit of the chip with the external circuit board. The ideal lead frame materials must meet the following characteristics: ① The materials has good thermal conductivity, and can timely emit the heat generated by the semiconductor chip during operation through a large current. ② Materials shall have sufficient strength, rigidity and formability. Generally, the tensile strength should be greater than 450MPa and the elongation should be greater than 4% Materials shall have low coefficient of thermcal expansion, good matching, soldering, corrosion resistance, thermal resistance and oxidation resistance. ④ Good flatness and low residual stress. ⑤ Easy to punch and process without burrs. ⑥ The cost of materials should be as low as possible to meet the requirements of large-scale commercial applications. There are two main types of lead frame materials commonly used: copper base lead frame materials and iron base lead frame materials. At present, copper base lead frame materials account for more than 80%, and they are used in military industry, special circuits and devices due to their high prices.

explanation_cn: 当晶体热振动时，一些能量足够大的原子离开平衡位置而挤到晶格点的间隙中，形成间隙原子，而原来位置上同时产生空穴，两者成对出现，数量相等，晶体不会因为出现空位而产生密度变化，晶体体积不发生变化，这种缺陷称为弗伦克尔对。
explanation_en: When the crystal is thermally vibrated, some atoms with enough energy leave the equilibrium position and squeeze into the gap of the lattice points to form interstitial atoms, while holes are generated at the original position at the same time. The two appear in pairs with the same number. The crystal will not have density changes due to the presence of vacancy, and the crystal volume will not change. This defect is called a Frenkl pair.

explanation_cn: 在面心立方晶体中，伯格斯矢量为1/3<111>的纯刃型不全位错。如果层错不贯穿整个晶体，而是中止在晶体内部，这个层错边界线为具有1/3<111>型伯格斯矢量的位错。
explanation_en: In face centered cubic crystal, pure edge type incomplete dislocation with Burgers vector of 1/3<111>. If the stacking fault does not run through the whole crystal, but stops inside the crystal, the boundary line of the stacking fault is a dislocation with 1/3<111>type Burgess vector.

name_cn: 弗洛利-哈金斯溶液理论
explanation_cn: 由PaulFlory和MauriceHuggins提出的经典高分子溶液理论，该理论借助于似晶格模型、用统计力学方法研究高分子溶液的热力学性质。
explanation_en: The classical macromolecule solution theory proposed by Paul Flory and Maurice Huggins is used to study the thermodynamics properties of macromolecule solutions with the help of lattice like model and statistical mechanics method.

explanation_cn: 以细颗粒状燃料弥散在基体材料中的混合燃料。常用的有UAl4-Al、U3O8-Al、(U，Th)O2-石墨和U3Si2-Al等。
explanation_en: Mixed fuel dispersed in matrix materials with fine granular fuel. UAl4-Al, U3O8-Al, (U, Th) O2- graphite and U3Si2-Al are commonly used.

explanation_cn: 用粉未冶金方法制备的，氧化物质点弥散分布在金厲基体中的材料。弥散强化相可以通过球磨混合加入，或者共沉淀方式加人。弥散强化材料包括烧结铝、无氧铜以及镍和铁基材料，如ThO2弥散强化钨丝、弥散强化镍，Y2O3弥散强化高温合金等。弥散强化材料有优良的高温性能，甚至在接近基体金属熔点时，仍有足够的强度；组织稳定，再结晶温度高:有良好的导热和导电性能。
explanation_en: A materials prepared by powder metallurgy method, in which the oxidized material points are dispersed in the matrix. The dispersion strengthening phase can be added by ball milling or by co precipitation. Dispersion strengthened materials include sintered aluminum powder, oxygen-free copper, nickel and iron based materials, such as ThO2 dispersion strengthening tungsten wire, dispersion strengthening nickel, Y2O3 dispersion strengthening high temperature alloy, etc. The dispersion strengthened materials has excellent high temperature performance, even when it is close to the melting point of the matrix metal, it still has sufficient strength; Stable structure, high recrystallization temperature: good thermal conductivity and conductivity.

explanation_cn: 以细小颗粒的形式弥散分布在材料组织基体中的第二相。大多是化合物或中间相，是强化合金的手段之一。
explanation_en: The second phase dispersed in the matrix of materials in the form of fine particles. Most of them are compounds or intermediate phase, which is one of the means to strengthen alloy.

explanation_cn: 又称抗弯强度。指材料抵抗弯矩作用而不失效的能力，是承受弯矩作用材料的一个重要性能参数。可用弯曲试验时，试样至破断过程中最大弯矩与弯曲截面系数W之比来表征,它表示弯断时试样拉伸侧表面的最大正应力。由于弯曲试验中试样拉伸侧应力状态与拉伸试样相似，因此对于加工不方便的脆性材料常用弯曲试验测定抗弯强度（即断裂强度）。对于塑性材料，由于发生大量变形，使试样不发生弯曲断裂，这时弯曲试验不是为了测定抗弯强度，而是用来比较各种材料在一定弯曲条件下的塑性变形性能，或是鉴别零件表面i质量，是一种式工性能试验。
explanation_en: It is also called bending strength. It refers to the ability of materials to resist bending moment without failure, and is an important performance parameter of materials under bending moment. The ratio of the maximum bending moment of the specimen to the bending section coefficient W during the bending test can be used to represent the maximum normal stress on the tensile side surface of the specimen during bending. Because the stress state of the tensile side of the specimen in the bending test is similar to that of the tensile specimen, the bending strength (i.e. fracture strength) of brittle materials that are not easy to process is usually measured by the bending test. For plastic materials, due to a large amount of deformation, the sample will not bend fracture. At this time, the bending test is not to measure bending strength, but to compare the plastic deformation performance of various materials under certain bending conditions, or to identify the surface quality of parts. It is a type of performance test.

explanation_cn: 一个材料常数，是弯曲试验中，在弹性变形范围内，拉伸（或压缩）侧表面拉伸（压缩）应力与应变的比值。它表征材料抵抗弯曲变形的能力。弯曲模量是材料力学性能的一个指标，它反映了材料内部原子间结合力的大小。由于试验方法，试样形状，表面加工精度等因素.此值测量波动较大，规定由六个试样测定结果得出其平均值，其中三个试样弯曲时凸面朝上，三个试样弯曲时凹面朝上
explanation_en: A materials constant is the ratio of tensile (compression) stress to strain on the surface of the tensile (or compression) side in the range of elastic deformation in the bending test. It represents the ability of materials to resist bending deformation. Bending modulus is an index of mechanical properties of materials, which reflects the binding force between atoms in materials. Due to factors such as test method, sample shape, surface machining accuracy, etc., the measurement of this value fluctuates greatly. It is specified that the average value should be obtained from the results of six samples, with three samples bending with the convex surface facing upwards and three samples bending with the concave surface facing upwards

explanation_cn: 见硝化纤维素。
explanation_en: See nitrocellulose.

explanation_cn: 在实用超导材料中，晶粒之间的连接性对超导材料的性能影响很大。通常我们把晶界阻挡电流传输的现象，称为弱连接。
explanation_en: In practical superconducting materials, the connectivity between grains has a great impact on the performance of superconducting materials. Usually we call the phenomenon of grain boundary blocking current transmission week connectivity.

explanation_cn: 卸除外力后材料能恢复原状的性能。外力除去后就能消失的变形称为弹性变形。反映材料弹性性质的参数有比例极限、弹性极限以及泊松比。应力和应变成正比关系的最大应力称为比例极限。卸载后能恢复原状的最大应力称为弹性极限。弹性范围内.正应力和正应变的比值称弹性（杨氏）模量E;切应力和切应变的比值为切变模量"。侧向收缩和纵向伸长之比称为泊松比。弹性可分为线弹性.非线弹性和滞弹性三类。应力和应变成线性中值关系称线弹性。应力和应变不满足线性关系，但仍保持单值关系称非线弹性。加载后经过一定时间后应力和应变才满足线性关系称滞弹性。
explanation_en: The materials can recover its original state after removing the external force. The deformation that can disappear after the external force is removed is called elastic deformation. The parameters reflecting elasticity properties of materials include proportional limit, elasticity limit and Poisson's ratio. The maximum stress in a proportional relationship between stress and strain is called the proportional limit. The maximum stress that can recover after unloading is called the elasticity limit. In the elasticity range, the ratio of normal stress to normal strain is called elasticity (Young's) modulus E; The ratio of shear stress to shear strain is called shear modulus. The ratio of lateral shrinkage to longitudinal elongation is called Poisson's ratio. elasticity can be divided into three categories: linear elasticity, non-linear elasticity, and anelasticity. The linear elasticity refers to the relationship between stress and strain as a linear median. The non-linear elasticity refers to the relationship between stress and strain that does not meet the linear relationship, but still maintains a single value relationship. It is called anelasticity when the stress and strain meet the linear relationship after a certain period of time after loading.

explanation_cn: 以弹性体为主要原料、具有高度弹性的丝或纱。为高延伸性、高回弹性的合成纤维.其弹性由聚合物本身的性质所致。这种纤维如拉伸为原长的倍，再松弛时.可以迅速地恢复到基本原长。弹性纤维主要有三类：①最具有代表性且大量生产的为聚氨基甲酸酯纤维.又称聚氨酯弹性纤维.中国商品名为氨纶。聚氨基甲酸酯纤维是包含硬链段和软链段的多嵌段的共聚纤维，其分子链中有两种链段，一种叫软链段，由不具结晶性的低分子量聚酯或聚醚链组成，其玻璃化转变温度低.在常温下处于高弹态，在应力作用下.很容易发生形变.从而使纤维具有易拉长变形特征。另一种链段叫硬链段.由结晶性并能产生横向交联的二异氰酸酯链段组成.在应力作用下，基本上不产生形变，从而防止分子间发生滑移，为软链段的大幅度伸长和回弹提供了必要的结点条件.并赋予纤维一定的强度。②聚丙烯酸酯型弹性纤维，是由丙烯酸乙酯与一些具交联性单体（如丙烯酸酰胺>共聚后，与偏二氯乙烯进行接枝共聚.该接枝共聚物再用乳液纺丝法纺丝制得的纤维。主要优点是抗老化性能和耐漂白性能等比聚氨酯弹性纤维好.另外不易燃烧并具有自熄性。③聚酯型弹性纤维是另一种弹性纤维。化学组成是均一的.弹性由其物理结构的不均一性所致。采用熔体纺丝法成形。弹性伸长不及聚氨酯弹性纤维，但强度比较高，所以其又可称为硬质弹性纤维。
explanation_en: Silk or yarn with elasticity as main raw material and high elasticity. It is a synthetic fiber with high extensibility and high resilience. Its elasticity is caused by the nature of polymer itself. This type of fiber can quickly recover to its basic original length when stretched to times its original length and then relaxed. There are three main types of elastic fiber: ① The most representative and mass-produced one is polyurethane fiber, also known as polyurethime elastic fiber. The Chinese trade name is spandex. Polyurethane fiber is a multi block copolymer fiber containing hard chain segment and soft chain segment. There are two kinds of chain segment in its molecular chain, one is called soft chain segment, which is composed of non crystalline low molecular weight polyester or polyether chains. Its glass transition temperature is low. It is in high elastic slate at room temperature, and deformation is easy to occur under stress, so that the fiber is easy to stretch and deform. Another kind of chain segment is called hard chain segment. It is composed of crystalline diisocyanate chain segment that can produce transverse crosslinking. Under stress, it basically does not produce deformation, thus preventing intermolecular slippage, providing necessary node conditions for large extension and rebound of soft chain segment, and endowing fiber with certain strength. ② Polyacrylate elastic fiber, It is composed of ethyl acrylate and some crosslinking monomer (For example, after acrylamide>copolymerization, graft copolymerization is carried out with vinylidene chloride. The graft copolymer is spun by lotion spinning method. The main advantages are that the aging resistance and bleaching resistance are better than polyurethime elastic fiber. In addition, it is not easy to combustion and has self extinguishing property. ③ Polyester elastic fiber is another kind of elastic fiber. Its chemical composition is uniform. elasticity is caused by the inhomogeneity of its physical structure. Melt spinning method is adopted Forming. Elasticity elongation is less than polyurethime elastic fiber, but the strength is relatively high, so it can also be called hard elastic fiber.

explanation_cn: 研究弹性体在外部因素（如载荷、温度等）作用下所产生应力和应变的一门学科。它的基本假定：物体连续、均质、弹性变形且变形量很小。弹性力学的基本方法是从静力平衡，几何关系和物理方程三方面建立一组以应力（或位移）为基本未知函数的微分方程；解满足边界条件的高阶微分方程。数学上，弹性力学问题可归结于边值问题，即弹性体必须既满足基本方程组（静力平衡.几何关系和物理方程），又满足边界条件（应力或位移边界条件.或混合边界条件）。由于数学上求解闲难.弹性力学一般问题很难有解析解，所以传统上主要应用于一些简单的板壳结构，以及堤坝和地基等T程问题。利用弹性力学求解的一些典型问题包括：非圆截面杆的扭转；圆孔附近的应力集中；两个弹件体之间的接触应力；集中力作用下无限大弹性体中的应力场分析；一些简单板壳中应力分析：以及位错线周围的应力分析等，它们在工程上得到了广泛应用。随着电子计算机的广泛应用，对于实际工程的复杂问题，往往采用差分法、变分法、有限元等数值方法求解。此外，弹性力学也是塑性力学、断裂力学的基础。
explanation_en: A discipline that studies the stress and strain generated by an elastic body under external factors such as load, temperature, etc. Its basic assumption is that the object is continuous, homogeneous, elasticity deformed and the amount of deformation is very small. The basic method of elastic mechanics is to establish a set of differential equations with stress (or displacement) as the basic unknown function from three aspects of static balance, geometric relations and physical equations; Solve high-order differential equations that satisfy boundary conditions. Mathematically, the problem of elastic mechanics can be attributed to the boundary value problem, that is, the elastic body must meet both the basic equations (static balance, geometric relations and physical equations) and the boundary conditions (stress or displacement boundary conditions, or mixed boundary conditions). Because it is difficult to solve mathematically and it is difficult to have analytical solutions for general problems of elastic mechanics, it is traditionally applied to some simple plate and shell structures, as well as T-path problems such as dams and foundations. Some typical problems solved by elastic mechanics include: torsion of rods with non-circular cross section; Stress concentration near the circular hole; Contact stress between two projectile bodies; Stress field analysis in an infinite elastic body under concentrated force; Stress analysis in some simple plates and shells, as well as stress analysis around dislocation lines, have been widely used in engineering. With the widespread application of electronic computers, numerical methods such as difference method, variational method, and finite element method are often used to solve complex problems in practical engineering. In addition, elastic mechanics is also the basis of plastic mechanics and fracture mechanics.

explanation_cn: 表征材料弹性。联系各向异性介质中应力和应变关系的广义弹性张ft有21个独立的常数。在两个正交方向测M时，性质相同的横向各向同性介质中减为5个独立常数。各向同性介质（在任何方向测量时性质都相同）只有2个独立的弹性常数。单对称材料有13个独立常数，正交各向异性材料有9个独立常数。对于小形变而言，胡克定律成立。应变与应力成正比，遵守胡克定律的各向同性材料的弹性性质由弹性模量来说明。
explanation_en: Characterize the elasticity of materials. There are 21 independent constants in the generalized elasticity tension ft, which relates the stress and strain relationship in anisotropic media. When measuring M in two orthogonal directions, it is reduced to 5 independent constants in a transversely isotropic medium with the same properties. There are only two independent elastic constants for isotropic media (the properties are the same when measured in any direction). Monosymmetric materials have 13 independent constants, and orthotropic materials have 9 independent constants. Hooke's law holds for small deformation. The strain is proportional to the stress, and the elasticity property of isotropic materials that obey Hooke's law is explained by elastic modulus.

explanation_cn: 固体在外力作用下发生形状及尺寸的变化，若取消外力，形状与尺寸复原，即形变是可逆的.称为弹性形。在弹性阶段内，简单拉伸的情况下，应力与应变的关系服从胡克定律。弹性形变是晶体中原子结合键长度（正应变）或键的夹角的变化（切应变），与这些变化对应的弹性模量反映晶体中原子结合键的强度》
explanation_en: The shape and size of a solid change under the action of an external force. If the external force is removed, the shape and size will be restored, that is, the deformation is reversible. It is called elasticity shape. In the elasticity stage, in the case of simple tension, the relationship between stress and strain obeys Hooke's law. Elastic deformation is the change of atomic bond length (normal strain) or bond angle (shear strain) in crystal, and the elastic modulus corresponding to these changes reflects the strength of atomic bond in crystal

explanation_cn: "弹性模量"通常由"E"表示，它是一种材料的力学性质，度量了材料在弹性变形阶段内应力与应变的比值。弹性模量表征了材料抵抗弹性变形的能力，具体是指它反映了材料的刚度。它的数值越大，材料越难发生弹性变形。弹性模量是最常见的弹性材料性质之一，它通常不受成分和微观结构的影响。它可以在材料的各种变化下保持稳定，包括温度变化。不过，对于各向异性材料，弹性模量可以成为晶体方向的函数。弹性模量通常分为不同类型，包括：拉压模量（Young's Modulus）： 用符号 "E" 表示，它描述了材料在拉伸或压缩时的弹性性能。剪切模量（Shear Modulus）： 用符号 "G" 表示，它衡量了材料在受剪切应力时的弹性性能。泊松比（Poisson's Ratio）： 用符号 "ν" 表示，描述了材料在沿一个方向拉伸时，垂直方向的收缩程度。对于一些不符合Hooke's Law（胡克定律）的材料，如木材、大理石、混凝土等，人们有时会使用原点切线弹性模量、切线弹性模量、割线弹性模量和弦弹性模量这些不同定义方法，这些方法用于描述材料应力-应变曲线的不同部分。这些方法通常是为了更好地适应材料的非线性行为。这些修正方法的使用是合理的，因为某些材料的弹性性能可能不符合Hooke's Law。
explanation_en: "Elastic modulus" is usually expressed by "E", which is a mechanical property of materials and measures the ratio of stress to strain of materials in elastic deformation stage. Elastic modulus characterizes the ability of materials to resist elastic deformation, specifically, it reflects the stiffness of materials. The greater its value, the more difficult it is for materials to undergo elastic deformation. Elastic modulus is one of the most common properties of elasticity materials, which is usually not affected by composition and microstructure. It can keep stable under various changes of materials, including temperature change. However, for anisotropic materials, elastic modulus can be a function of crystal direction. Elastic modulus is usually divided into different types, including: Young's Modulus: it is represented by the symbol "E", which describes the elasticity properties of materials in tension or compression. Shear modulus: it is represented by the symbol "G", which measures the elasticity property of materials under shear stress. Poisson's ratio: using symbols“ ν "It indicates the shrinkage degree of materials in the vertical direction when it is stretched in one direction. For some materials that do not conform to Hook's Law Materials, such as wood, marble, concrete, etc., people sometimes use different definition methods such as origin tangent elastic modulus, tangent elastic modulus, secant elastic modulus, and chord elastic modulus. These methods are used to describe different parts of the stress-strain curve of materials. These methods are usually used to better adapt to the nonlinear behavior of materials. The use of these correction methods is reasonable because the elasticity properties of some materials may not conform to Hook's Law.

explanation_cn: 在国外称为无大孔水泥（MDF)、新型无机材料或水泥塑料等。1980-1984年期间.由英国牛津大学和英国帝闰化学工业公司联合研制成功。其显著特性是具有极高的抗折强度，一般可达70MPa以上，最高为150MPa。由于这种材料在加工过程中呈现奇异的橡胶状弹性，故在我国称之为弹性水泥。
explanation_en: It is called non macroporous cement (MDF), new inorganic materials or cement plastics in foreign countries. Between 1980 and 1984, it was jointly developed by the University of Oxford in the United Kingdom and the British Chemical Industry Corporation. Its remarkable characteristic is that it has extremely high bending strength, which can generally reach more than 70MPa, and the maximum is 150MPa. This materials is called elastic cement in China because of its strange rubber like elasticity during processing.

explanation_cn: 弹性变形在物体中的传播.当物体某部分突然受力时.该处将产生弹性变形，然后它以弹性波的形式向周围传播.经过一段时间后，整个物体都将产生弹性变形。
explanation_en: The propagation of elastic deformation in an object. When a part of the object is suddenly stressed, elastic deformation will occur there, and then it will spread to the surrounding in the form of elastic wave. After a period of time, the entire object will produce elastic deformation.

explanation_cn: 黏弹性材料在外力作用下弹性形变滞后于外力变化的现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that the elastic deformation of viscoelasticity materials under external force lags behind the change of external force.

explanation_cn: 由弹性蛋白构成的纤维状蛋白。具有很大的弹性.主要分布在各种腺体的周围。
explanation_en: A fibrous protein composed of elasticity. It has great elasticity and is mainly distributed around various glands.

explanation_cn: 指有弹性记忆行为的复合材料。弹性记忆是指当温度在某一很窄的范围内可逆变化时.在塑料成型加工工艺中，离模膨胀与制品尺寸的精确性和稳定性有很大关系，对制品强度也有一定影响，在T艺操作中应予以考虑。
explanation_en: It refers to composite materials with elasticity memory behavior. Elasticity memory refers to when the temperature changes reversibly in a narrow range. In the plastics molding process, the mold release expansion has a great relationship with the accuracy and stability of the size of the product, and also has a certain impact on the strength of the product, which should be considered in the T-process operation.

explanation_cn: 适合于制造各种弹寶或具有类似性能要求的零件用的结构钢。弹簧钢需要具有高弹性极限、高屈服强度、高疲劳极限及一定的冲击韧性和塑性，同时由于弹簧类零件丨:作过程中承受弯曲、扭转、拉压等疲劳载荷时表面的丨:作应力最大.还要求具有良好的表面质量。弹簧钢最终热处理通常采用淬火加中温回火以获得回火屈氏体组织.得到相对较高的弹性极限。为了得到很高的屈服强度并保持适当韧性，弹簧钢多采用中高碳含量并需要严格控制表面脱碳。为了提高弹簧零件的表面承载能力和疲劳强度，弹簧产品通常需要在最终热处理后进行抛丸造成表面压应力状态以抑制表面微裂纹萌生根据化学成分可分为非合金弹簧钢、合金弹簧钢（GB/T1222-2007)和特殊弹簧钢。根据弹簧产品形状要求.弹簧钢的供货形式多为热轧扁钢（用于板簧）、棒材或丝材（用于螺旋簧、扭杆簧等）和冷轧带材(用于片簧）。
explanation_en: It is suitable for structural steel used to manufacture various sabot shells or parts with similar performance requirements. Spring steel needs to have high elastic limit, high yield strength, high fatigue limit, and a certain impact toughness and plasticity. At the same time, because spring parts bear the maximum surface working stress under fatigue loads such as bending, torsion, tension and compression in the process of working, they also need to have good surface quality. The final heat treatment of spring steel usually adopts quenching and medium temperature tempering to obtain tempering troostite structure and obtain relatively high elasticity limit. In order to obtain very high yield strength and maintain proper toughness, spring steel mostly uses medium and high carbon content and needs to strictly control surface decarburization. In order to improve the surface bearing capacity and fatigue strength of spring parts, the spring products usually need to be shot blasting after the final heat treatment to cause the surface compressive stress state to inhibit the surface microcrack initiation. According to the chemical composition, the spring products can be divided into non alloy spring steel, alloy spring steel (GB/T1222-2007) and special spring steel. According to the shape requirements of spring products, spring steel is mostly supplied in the form of hot rolled flat steel (for leaf spring), bar or wire (for spiral spring, torsion bar spring, etc.) and cold rolled strip (for leaf spring).

explanation_cn: 适合于制作弹黃或弹性元件的专用钢丝"主要有非合金弹簧钢丝、合金弹簧钢丝、不锈弹簧钢丝等。采用热轧、冷轧、热拉拔或冷拉拔工艺生产。非机械弹簧用非合金弹簧钢丝(YB/T5220-2014)可直接使用，按抗拉强度分组。油淬火回火弹簧钢丝（GB/T18983-2003)分为静态级、中疲劳级（TD表示.用于离合器弹簧、悬架弹簧等）。不锈弹簧钢丝（GB/T24588-2009)按抗拉强度分组，用于对耐蚀性要求较高的弹簧。
explanation_en: Special wire suitable for making elastic yellow or elasticity components mainly includes non alloy spring steel wire, alloy spring steel wire, stainless spring steel wire, etc. It is produced by hot rolling, cold rolling, hot drawing or cold drawing processes. Non alloy spring steel wire (YB/T5220-2014) for non mechanical springs can be used directly and grouped by tensile strength. Oil quenching tempering spring steel wire (GB/T18983-2003) is divided into static grade and medium fatigue grade (TD represents. Used for clutch springs, suspension springs, etc.). Stainless spring steel wire (GB/T24588-2009) is grouped by tensile strength, and is used for springs with high requirements for corrosion resistance.

explanation_cn: 见硝化纤维素。
explanation_en: See nitrocellulose.

explanation_cn: 以硝酸按和氯化钠的混合物为主要成分，再加敏化剂硝酸酯（主要为硝化甘油）而成的煤矿许用炸药，含有大量的消焰剂（NaCl）,其安全性与被筒炸药相当，故名当量炸药。组成为硝酸铵50%-60%、氯化钠30%-50%、木粉3%-5%、混合酯6%-10%,以及少量胶棉、柴油等添加剂。由于消焰剂含量大，大大影响爆炸性能.所以爆炸能力较弱，具有较好的安全性，猛度7.2-8.3cm(铅柱Hi缩值），做工能力150-180mL(铅墙扩孔值）.爆速1.8?2km/s。适用于有煤与瓦斯突出危险的工作面.由于爆炸能力较弱，现已停产，被新型的硝铵炸药、乳化炸药等取代。
explanation_en: The permissible explosive for coal mine, which is mainly composed of the mixture of nitric acid and sodium chloride, and added with sensitizer nitrate (mainly nitroglycerin), contains a large amount of flash reducer (NaCl). Its safety is equivalent to that of the explosive in the cylinder, so it is called equivalent explosive. The composition is ammonium nitrate 50% -60%, sodium chloride 30% -50%, wood flour 3% -5%, mixed ester 6% -10%, and a small amount of collodion, diesel and other additive. Due to the large content of flash reducer, it greatly affects the explosion performance. Therefore, the explosion ability is weak, with good safety. The intensity is 7.2-8.3cm (Hi shrinkage value of lead column), the processing capacity is 150-180mL (lead wall expanding value), and the explosion speed is 1.8? 2km/s. It is applicable to the working face with coal and gas outburst danger. Due to the weak explosion ability, it has stopped production and has been replaced by new ammonium nitrate explosive, emulsion explosive, etc.

explanation_cn: 一般都称为硼当量，一般杂质元素对热中子的吸收，以相当于硼的量来表示。
explanation_en: Generally referred to as boron equivalent, the absorption of thermal neutrons by impurity elements is represented by an amount equivalent to boron.

explanation_cn: 同体在外力作用下发生形状及尺寸的变化，若取消外力，形状与尺寸复原，即形变是可逆的，称为弹性;外力超过一定限度，取消外力作用，变形物质的形状与尺寸不复原发生了永久性的变化，称为塑性形变。
explanation_en: The shape and size of the same body change under the action of external force. If the external force is canceled, the shape and size will recover, that is, deformation is reversible, which is called elasticity; When the external force exceeds a certain limit, the effect of external force will be canceled, and the shape and size of the deformed material will not be restored, resulting in permanent changes, which is called plastic deformation.

explanation_en: See twin.

explanation_cn: 有效地综合利用形变强化与相变强化将热加工（锻、轧等）与热处理操作相结合使成形工艺与获得最终性能的热处理工艺统一起来的工艺方法，这种方法不但能够得到一般处理所达不到的高强度与高塑性（韧性）的良好组合，还可大大简化金属材料或工件的生产流程，提高材料或工件的质量。工艺可应用的范围为广泛，包括各种碳钢、合金结构钢、工具钢、不锈耐热钢、镍或钼基合金、铝合金和钛合金等几乎所有的金属材料。工艺方法繁多，根据工艺中形变与相变的安排顺序，可分为形变在相变之前、相变之中和相变之后进行三大类，此外还有一类是由上述基本方法引伸出来的所谓派生的形变热处理工艺方法。形变在相变之前的包括：高温形变淬火（包含锻热淬火、轧热淬火）、高温形变正火、高温形变等温淬火、亚温形变淬火、低温形变淬火、低温形变等温淬火等。形变在相变之中的包括：形变诱导铁素体相变、形变诱导珠光体相变、形变诱导沉淀、等温形变淬火、连续冷却形变处理等。形变在相变之后的包括：珠光体温形变、珠光体冷形变、马氏体（回火马氏体、贝氏体）形变时效等。派生的包括：预先形变热处理、表面形变时效、表面高温形变淬火、复合形变热处理、形变化学热处理（锻热渗碳淬火、锻热淬火渗氮、低温形变淬火渗硫)、化学形变热处理（渗碳表面形变时效、渗碳表面形变淬火）等。
explanation_en: Effectively and comprehensively utilize deformation strengthening and phase transformation strengthening to combine hot working (forging, rolling, etc.) and heat treatment operations to unify the forming process and heat treatment process to obtain final properties. This method can not only obtain a good combination of high strength and high plasticity (toughness) that can not be achieved by general treatment, but also greatly simplify the production process of metallic materials or workpieces and improve the quality of materials or workpieces. The process can be applied in a wide range, including almost all kinds of metallic materials such as carbon steel, alloy structural steel, tool steel, stainless heat resistant steel, nickel or molybdenum based alloy, aluminum alloy and titanium alloy. There are many process methods. According to the arrangement order of deformation and phase transformation in the process, it can be divided into three categories: deformation before phase transformation, phase transformation, and phase transformation. In addition, there is a so-called derived thermomechanical treatment process method derived from the above basic methods. Before phase transformation, deformation includes: high temperature deformation quenching (including forging heat quenching and rolling heat quenching), high temperature deformation normalizing, high temperature deformation isothermal quenching, sub temperature deformation quenching, low temperature deformation quenching, low temperature deformation isothermal quenching, etc. Deformation in phase transformation includes: deformation induced ferrite phase transformation, deformation induced pearlite phase transformation, deformation induced precipitation, isothermal deformation quenching, continuous cooling deformation treatment, etc. After phase transformation, deformation includes pearlite body temperature deformation, pearlite cold deformation, martensite (tempering martensite, bainite) deformation aging, etc. Derived from: pre thermomechanical treatment, surface deformation aging, surface high temperature deformation quenching, composition thermomechanical treatment, deformation chemical heat treatment (forging heat carburizing quenching, forging heat quenching nitriding, low temperature deformation quenching sulphurizing), chemical thermomechanical treatment (carburizing surface deformation aging, carburizing surface deformation quenching), etc.

explanation_cn: 多晶体经塑性形变之后，晶体取向萚优的现象。常出现在连续应变量大的加工制品中，如冷轧、拔丝、拔管和挤压的制品。
explanation_en: After plastic deformation of multi crystal, the orientation of crystal becomes better. It often occurs in processed products with large continuous strain, such as cold rolled, wire drawn, tube drawn and extrusion products.

explanation_cn: 加工变形的形变储存能使基体固态相变的驱动能增大由此促进相变进行，使相变可能发生的温度范围变化并使相变时间缩短。
explanation_en: The deformation storage of processing deformation can increase the driving energy of matrix solid phase transformation to promote the phase transformation, change the possible temperature range of phase transformation and shorten the phase transformation time.

explanation_cn: 满足玻璃形成理论的玻璃材料制备方法。
explanation_en: The preparation method of glass materials satisfying the glass formation theory.

explanation_en: The number of crystal nuclei per unit volume of time that form a new phase.

explanation_en: The phase transformation is carried out by the formation of a crystal nucleus with a critical size and the further growth of the crystal nucleus.

explanation_cn: 又称为形状记忆高分子.指具有初始形状的制品，在一定的条件下，改变其初始条件并同定后.通过外界刺激(如热、电、光、化学感应等），又可恢复其初始形状的高分子材料。
explanation_en: Also known as shape memory polymer, it refers to a macromolecule materials that has an initial shape and can recover its initial shape through external irritation (such as heat, electricity, light, chemical induction, etc.) under certain conditions after changing its initial conditions.

explanation_cn: 彩钢是指彩涂钢板，彩涂钢板是一种带有有机涂层的钢板，具有耐蚀性好，色彩鲜艳，外观美观，加工成型方便及具有钢板原有的强度等优点而且成本较低等特点。
explanation_en: Color steel refers to prepainted steel sheet. prepainted steel sheet is a kind of steel plate with organic coating, which has the advantages of good corrosion resistance, bright colors, beautiful appearance, convenient processing and molding, original strength of steel plate, and low cost.

explanation_cn: 溶解在玻璃中的过渡金属离子或稀土金属离子的电子跃迁而引起的光吸收，或者分散在玻璃中呈胶体状的元素或化合物微粒子的色散与吸收，或者放射线等的照射所产生的着色中心所引起的光吸收等产生的玻璃着色。
explanation_en: The light absorption caused by the electronic transition of transition metal ions or rare earth metal metal ions dissolved in glass, or the dispersion and absorption of colloidal elements or compound particles dispersed in glass, or the glass coloring caused by the light absorption caused by the coloring center generated by radiation, etc.

explanation_en: See wulfenite.

explanation_cn: 亦称陶瓷绘画，早在距今七千年左右的半坡文化时期，陶上便出现了最早的彩绘。而瓷上作品相对纸本更具张力，彩陶艺术中融合了艺术家的各种创作思想、风格、语言，创作出风格各异而又多姿多彩的艺术珍品，是我国不可多得的文化瑰宝。
explanation_en: Also known as ceramics painting, the earliest color painting appeared on pottery as early as the Banpo Culture period, which is about 7000 years ago. While porcelain works have more tension than paper works, painted pottery art integrates various creative ideas, styles and languages of artists, creating artistic treasures with different styles and colorful styles, which is a rare cultural treasure in China.

explanation_cn: 物质中原子或离子（统称为粒子）随距离的分布函数。
explanation_en: The distribution function of atoms or ions (collectively referred to as particles) in matter with distance.

explanation_cn: 目的是去除"难变形区"，缩短金属质点流动距离并提高变形均匀性。常规实心坯料变形时金属由中心向外流动，与模具端面接触的底部为难变形区，角部为大变形区，造成变形极不均匀，成为裂纹源。综合考虑空心坯料挤压应变分布规律和成形力变化、变形均匀性、成形力及失稳折叠缺陷等因素，用带芯轴凸模反挤压空心坯料，去除了常规实心坯料挤压时存在的"难变形区"，改变了分流面，金属可向多个方向流动，同时降低了接触表面正应力.改善构件重要承力部位的变形均匀性，同时控制金属流线的分布，减小合金的各向异性，提高构件的疲劳寿命。
explanation_en: The purpose is to remove the "difficult deformation zone", shorten the flow distance of metal particles, and improve deformation uniformity. When conventional solid billets deform, the metal flows outward from the center, and the bottom that contacts the end face of the mold is a difficult deformation area, while the corners are large deformation areas, resulting in extremely uneven deformation and becoming the source of cracks. Considering comprehensively the strain distribution law of extrusion of hollow billet and the factors such as the change of forming force, deformation uniformity, forming force and instability folding defects, the hollow billet is reverse extrusion with a punch with a mandrel, which removes the "hard deformation zone" existing in the extrusion of conventional solid billet, changes the flow diversion surface, and the metal can flow in multiple directions, while reducing the normal stress on the contact surface. It improves the deformation uniformity of the important load-bearing parts of the component, At the same time, the distribution of metal streamline is controlled to reduce the anisotropy of alloy and improve the fatigue life of components.

explanation_cn: 一种常用的电化学研究方法：控制电极电势以不同速率，以角波形一次或多次反复扫描，电势范围是使电极上能交替发生氧化和还原反应，并记录电流-电势曲线。
explanation_en: A commonly used electrochemical research method is to control the electrode potential at different rates and repeatedly scan the angular waveform once or multiple times. The potential range is to enable alternating oxidation and reduction reactions to occur on the electrode, and record the current potential curve.

explanation_cn: 指的是极化电流与极化电位的关系。它通过循环伏安法测得。首先使恒电位仪处在控制电位状态下选择某一初始电位，然后使电极电位按指定的方向和速度随时间线性变化，达到某一指定电位后又自动地以同样的速度逆回到初始电位，同时记录极化电流与极化电位的关系，将该过程重复多次，直至相对稳定后才记录伏安曲线。是电化学性能的组成部分，可用于电极反应的性质、机理和电极过程动力学参数的研究。
explanation_en: It refers to the relationship between polarization current and polarization potential. It is measured by cyclic voltammetry. First, make the potentiostat in the control potential state to select an initial potential, and then make the electrode potential change linearly with time in the specified direction and speed. After reaching a specified potential, it will automatically reverse back to the initial potential at the same speed. At the same time, record the relationship between polarization current and polarization potential, repeat the process for many times, and record the volt ampere curve until it is relatively stable. It is a component of electrochemical performance and can be used for studying the properties, mechanisms, and kinetic parameters of electrode reactions.

explanation_cn: 在一定的充放电制度下，电池容量降至某一规定值之前，电池所能承受的循环充放电次数，称为二次电池的。影响的因素有电极材料、电解液、隔膜、制造工艺、放电深度等。在电池寿命的测试中，电池的容量不是唯一衡量电池的指标，还应综合考虑其电压特性、内阻的变化等。
explanation_en: Under a certain charging and discharging system, the cycle charging and discharging times that the battery can withstand before the cell capacity drops to a specified value are called secondary cell. The influencing factors include electrode materials, electrolyte, separator, manufacturing process, depth of discharge, etc. In the testing of battery life, the capacity of the battery is not the only indicator to measure the battery, but should also comprehensively consider its voltage characteristics, changes in internal resistance, etc.

explanation_cn: 单体几乎全溶于大量乳化剂形成的胶束中进行的乳液

explanation_cn: 接触炎面间因小幅度相对切向振动造成磨损和诱发疲劳断裂的总称。它包括微动磨损和由其萌生裂纹并在交变应力下扩张，导致断裂的微动疲劳。微动磨损是一种轻微的难以预料和消除的磨损?在多数机械结构，例如螺钉联接、键连接及一些过盈配合件上都可能发生。由于磨肩往往不容易排出而残留在接触区内，因氧化而成为磨粒参与磨损。微动磨损往往是由黏着、磨料和腐蚀（氧化）等种磨损形式结合在一起的复杂磨损过程。微动疲劳以其危害性大于微动磨损而备受关注?因它造成的恶性事件有飞机机翼与机身联接螺栓断裂导致飞机坠毁，以及原子反应堆燃料套管破裂而核泄漏等。可以在接触表面间加入衬垫、采取润滑措施或用表面涂层办法提高材料抗微动磨损能力。但只有提高材料的抗疲劳性能和合理设计以消除因微动而萌生裂纹的I结构后才能防止微动疲劳的发生。
explanation_en: The general term of wear and fatigue induced fracture caused by small relative tangential vibration between contact inflamed surfaces. It includes fretting and fretting fatigue caused by crack initiation and expansion under alternating stress, leading to fracture. Fretting is a slight wear that is difficult to predict and eliminate? It can occur on most mechanical structures, such as screw connections, key connections, and some interference fit components. As the wear shoulder is not easy to discharge and remains in the contact area, it becomes abrasive particles due to oxidation and participates in wear. Fretting is a complex wear process which is often combined by adhesion, abrasive and corrosion (oxidation) and other wear forms. Fretting fatigue is more harmful than fretting? The malignant events caused by it include the aircraft crash caused by the fracture of the connecting bolt between the aircraft wing and the fuselage, and the nuclear leakage caused by the rupture of the fuel sleeve of the atomic reactor. The resistance to fretting of materials can be improved by adding gaskets between contact surfaces, taking lubrication measures or using surface coatings. However, fretting fatigue can be prevented only by improving the fatigue resistance of materials and reasonably designing the I structure to eliminate the cracks caused by fretting.

explanation_cn: 是指构件在循环载荷的作用下，由于表面某一部位与其它接触表面产生小振幅相对滑动而导致构件疲劳强度降低或早期断裂的现象。
explanation_en: It refers to the phenomenon that the fatigue strength of a component decreases or early fracture occurs due to the small amplitude relative sliding between a part of the surface and other contact surfaces under the action of cyclic load.

explanation_cn: 两表面间由于振幅很小的相对振动所产生的磨损。一般发生在紧密配合的轴颈;汽轮机和压气机叶片配合处：受振动影响的螺栓、铆钉等联接件的接合面;绳和绳轮;液压装置中的活塞等处。摩擦副间有润滑油，则会流出红褐色的胶状物质。两摩擦表面配合紧密磨屑不易排出，这些磨屑1往往起着磨料的作用，加速微动磨损过程，如此循环不止，最终导致零件表面破坏。微动磨损引起的破坏形式主要是擦伤、金属黏着、凹坑（或麻点）、局部磨损条纹（或沟槽）以及表面微裂纹等。影响微动磨损的主要因素是材料的成分、微观组织与性能、外加载荷大小及循环次数、振动频率与振幅、温度、气氛、润滑及环境条件等。
explanation_en: Wear caused by relative vibration with small amplitude between two surfaces. Usually occurs on closely fitting journals; The joint between the turbine and compressor blades: the joint surface of bolts, rivets, and other connecting parts affected by vibration; Rope and rope pulley; Pistons and other parts in hydraulic devices. If there is lubricating oil between the friction pairs, a reddish brown colloidal substance will flow out. The two friction surfaces are closely matched and the wear debris is not easy to be discharged. These wear debris 1 often plays the role of abrasive, accelerating the fretting process, and this cycle continues, eventually leading to the damage of the part surface. The failure modes caused by fretting are mainly scratches, metal adhesion, pits (or pits), local wear stripes (or grooves) and surface microcracks. The main factors affecting fretting are the composition of materials, microstructure and properties, applied load size and cycle times, vibration frequency and amplitude, temperature, atmosphere, lubrication and environmental conditions.

explanation_cn: 凡是在基本化学成分中添加微量（一般不大于0.2%)合金元素，使钢的一种或几种性能得到明显改善的钢都可称作微合金钢。微合金钢可分为微合金化不锈钢、微合金化耐热钢、微合金化非调质钢、微合金化渗碳钢、微合金化低合金高强度钢等。微合金元素主要包括Nb、V、Ti、B等。微合金钢中加入的微合金元素量很少，生产工艺无明显变化，但对性能具有明显的改善?因而获得非常广泛的生产和应用。②特指微合金化低合金高强度钢，是在普通低碳钢或低合金高强度钢基本化学成分中加入能形成碳化物或氮化物的微量合金元素（Nb、V、Ti等），采用控制轧制和控制冷却工艺，充分发挥微合金元素的作用，使其力学性能明显改善的钢。微合金元素的主要作用为：高温未溶或沉淀析出的微合金碳氮化物在均热时阻止晶粒长大;热轧过程中应变诱导析出的微合金碳氮化物阻止形变奥氏体再结晶或阻止再结晶晶粒长大;卷取或连续冷却过程中在铁素体中沉淀析出的微合金碳氮化物产生强烈沉淀强化效果;固定C、N原子降低它们对韧性、焊接性及冷成型性能的危害。微合金钢中加入的微合金元素量很少，生产工艺无明显变化，生产成本增加不多?但明显改善了钢的力学性能.常广泛的生产和应用.目前微合金钢的产量已占总钢产量的20%左右，大部分高强度低合金钢均是微合金钢。
explanation_en: All steels that add trace (generally no more than 0.2%) alloy elements to the basic chemical composition to significantly improve one or several properties of steel can be called microalloyed steel. Microalloyed steel can be divided into microalloying stainless steel, microalloying heat resistant steel, microalloying hot rolled high strength steel, microalloying carburized steel, microalloying low alloy high strength steel, etc. Micro alloying elements mainly include Nb, V, Ti, B, etc. The amount of micro alloy elements added to microalloyed steel is very small, and the production process has no obvious change, but the performance has been significantly improved? Therefore, it has been widely produced and applied It refers to micro alloy low alloy high strength steel, which is a steel in which micro alloy elements (Nb, V, Ti, etc.) that can form carbide or nitride are added to the basic chemical composition of ordinary low carbon steel or low alloy high strength steel, controlled rolling and cooling process are adopted to give full play to the role of micro alloy elements, so as to significantly improve its mechanical properties. The main functions of microalloy elements are: the insoluble or precipitation microalloy carbonitrides at high temperature prevent grain growth during soaking; The strain induced precipitation of microalloyed carbonitride during hot rolling prevents recrystallization of deformation austenite or grain growth of recrystallization; The microalloyed carbonitride precipitated in ferrite during coiling or continuous cooling has a strong precipitation strengthening effect; Fixing C and N atoms reduces their harm to toughness, weld and cold formability. The amount of micro alloy elements added to microalloyed steel is small, the production process has no obvious change, and the production cost has not increased much? However, the mechanical properties of steel have been significantly improved. It is often widely produced and applied. At present, the output of microalloyed steel accounts for about 20% of the total output of steel, and most high-strength low alloy steel are microalloyed steel.

explanation_cn: 将物质或细胞包裹于囊内的技术。囊的直径范围从纳米到上百个微米，由半透膜制成"也是固定化技术中的一种.是用一层半透膜将酶、辅酶、蛋白质等生物大分子或动植物细胞包围在珠状的微囊里，从而使得酶等生物大分子和细胞不能从微囊里逸出，而小分子的物质、培养基的营养物质可以自由出入半透膜，达到催化或培养的目的。常用的方法有藻酸盐法、藻酸盐-聚赖氨酸法、糖胺聚糖和脱乙酰壳聚糖法、聚丙烯酸酯、聚乙烯醇、尼龙界面聚合等方法。已广泛用于细胞治疗以及药物控制释放等生物医药领域。
explanation_en: The technique of encapsulating substances or cells within a capsule. The diameter range of the capsule ranges from nanometers to hundreds of micrometers, Made of semi permeable membrane "It is also one of the immobilization technologies. It uses a layer of semi permeable membrane to enclose biomacromolecule such as enzymes, coenzymes, proteins, or animal and plant cells in beaded microcapsules, so that biomacromolecule such as enzymes and cells cannot escape from the microcapsules, while small molecules and nutrients of culture media can freely enter and exit the semi permeable membrane to achieve the purpose of catalysis or culture. Common methods include alginate method, alginate polylysine method, and glycosaminoglycan polymerization Sugar and deacetylated chitosan method, polyacrylate, polyvinyl alcohol, nylon resin interfacial polymerization and other methods. It has been widely used in biopharmaceutical fields such as cell therapy and drug controlled release.

explanation_cn: 额定孔径为0.11pm的筛孔分离膜材料。操作压力6-?207kPa,能截留大于额定孔径的微粒。有机高分子微滤膜的制备方法有溶出法（干-湿法）、拉伸成孔法、相转化法、热致相法，浸涂法、辐照法、表面化学改性法、核径迹法和动力形成法等，主要有硝酸纤维素(CN)、醋酸纤维素（CA)、硝酸纤维素与醋酸纤维素混合物、聚氯乙烯（PVC)、聚酰胺（Nylon)、聚丙烯（PP)、聚四氟乙烯（PTEE)和聚碳酸酯(PC);无机微滤膜的制备方法主要有溶胶-凝胶法、烧结法、化学沉淀法等，主要有陶瓷、氧化铝、氧化锆、氧化硅等。应用在制药行业中的过滤除菌、电子工业用的高纯水制备、食品工业、饮用水生产和城市污水处理等领域^
explanation_en: Materials of mesh separation membrane with rated pore size of 0.11pm. Operating pressure 6-? 207kPa, capable of intercepting particles larger than the rated aperture. The preparation methods of organic polymeric microfiltration membrane include dissolution method (dry wet method), stretching pore forming method, phase conversion method, thermally induced phase method, dip coating method, irradiation method, surface chemical modification method, nuclear track method and dynamic formation method, mainly including cellulose nitrate (CN), cellulose acetate (CA), cellulose nitrate and cellulose acetate mixture, polyvinyl chloride (PVC), polyamide (Nylon), polypropylene (PP) Polylctrafluorocthylone (PTEE) and polycarbonate (PC); The preparation methods of inorganic microfiltration membrane mainly include sol-gel method, sintering method, chemical precipitation method method, etc., mainly including ceramics, alumina, zirconia, silica, etc. Applied in fields such as filtration and sterilization in the pharmaceutical industry, high-purity water preparation for electronic industry, food industry, drinking water production, and urban sewage treatment^

explanation_cn: 平均孔径小于lmm和孔径小于的孔容积百分率大于70%的炭砖。耐碱侵蚀、抗铁水渗透、导热好。主要用于高炉炉缸和炉底部位。
explanation_en: Carbon brick with average pore diameter less than 1mm and pore volume percentage less than 70%. Alkali corrosion resistance, hot metal penetration resistance, good heat conduction. Mainly used in the hearth and bottom of blast furnaces.

explanation_cn: 通常是指高分子材料制成的直径小于1.01mm的导管，其被设计用于放射介入诊断和治疗手术.插人血管系统，注射或输人对照介质.进行血管系统造影，或导人其他治疗器件（如PVA、弹簧圈等）.进行介人治疗手术。的特点是管壁柔软.可进入比较细的血管内进行介人治疗。由导管和导管座组成。所用材料主要为聚乙烯、尼龙和聚酰胺等;导管座所用材料主要为塑料、硅胶等;导管头端的标记一般采用钼金。
explanation_en: It usually refers to the catheter made of macromolecule materials with a diameter of less than 1.01mm, which is designed for interventional radiology diagnosis and treatment. It is inserted into the vascular system, injected or transfused into the control medium, performed angiography of the vascular system, or guided into other therapeutic devices (such as PVA, spring coil, etc.), and performed interventional treatment surgery. Its characteristic is that the tube wall is soft and can enter relatively small blood vessels for interventional treatment. It consists of catheter and catheter seat. The materials used are mainly polyethylene, nylon resin, polyamide, etc; The materials used for the conduit seat are mainly plastics, silicone gel, etc; The marking of the catheter head end is generally made of molybdenum gold.

explanation_cn: 在微弧氧化过程中，在阳极表面生成阳极化膜的同时，弧光放电产生的瞬时高温高压作用引起各种化学反应，把极化膜转为陶瓷相，进而在阳极表面生长一层结合强度较高的陶瓷膜层。陶瓷相硬度高、耐磨性好、韧性好、与基体紧密结合，耐腐蚀、耐高温氧化、绝缘性能好等特点。
explanation_en: In the process of micro arc oxidation, while an anodized film is generated on the anode surface, the instantaneous high-temperature and high-pressure effects generated by arc discharge cause various chemical reactions, converting the polarized film into a ceramic phase, and then growing a layer of ceramic film with high bonding strength on the anode surface. Ceramics phase has high hardness, good wear resistance, good toughness, close combination with matrix, corrosion resistance, high temperalure oxidation resistance, good insulation and other characteristics.

explanation_cn: 一种通过原子核超精细相互作用研究材料的结构和性能的微观分析方法。以放射性原子核发射7光子的发射概率与核自旋轴的方向关联现象为基础。在发射7光子的过程中，由原子核与周围环境的磁和电四极超精细作用使相应的角关联发生扰动及其弛豫现象，可提供材料的结构、磁结构和磁性信息，对固体辐照损伤可提供详细的缺陷情况和退火行为。主要方法有：时间微分、积分、核磁共振微扰角关联、频闪观测、离子注人。与穆斯堡尔谱等研究超精细作用和方法相比.优点在于：样品可以是固态、液态或气态;可用于任何温度;有较高的灵敏度。其局限性在于要求把放射性同位素标记在被研究的特定分子部位上，或掺杂在被研究的固体里。
explanation_en: A microscopic analysis method for studying the structure and properties of materials through hyperfine nuclear interaction. Based on the correlation between the emission probability of 7 photons emitted by a radioactive atomic nucleus and the direction of the nuclear spin axis. In the process of emitting 7 photons, the magnetic and electrical quadrupole hyperfine interaction between the atomic nucleus and the surrounding environment causes the corresponding angular correlation to be disturbed and relaxed, which can provide the structure, magnetic structure and magnetic information of materials, and provide detailed defect conditions and annealing behavior for solid radiation damage. The main methods are: time differentiation, integration, nuclear magnetic resonance perturbed angular correlation, stroboscopic observation, ion implantation. Compared with Mossbauer spectroscopy spectroscopy and other methods for studying hyperfine interaction, the advantages are: the sample can be solid, liquid or gas; Can be used at any temperature; Has high sensitivity. Its limitation is that it requires that radioisotope be labeled on specific molecular sites to be studied, or doped in solids to be studied.

explanation_cn: 指包含微晶相和无定形相结构的薄膜半导体材料，即由平均尺度在数纳米至数I纳米的晶粒分布在无定形基体中的半导体薄膜。
explanation_en: It refers to the thin film semiconductor materials containing microcrystalline phase and amorphous phase structure, that is, the semiconductor thin film whose average size is from several nanometers to several nanometers is distributed in the amorphous matrix.

explanation_cn: 是一种特殊设计的光纤，具有微米级的复杂结构，以实现各种光学和光通信应用。与传统的单模或多模光纤不同，微结构光纤的核心和包层结构可能会呈现多种不同的几何形状和排列方式。这些复杂的结构使微结构光纤具有一些独特的性能和应用。
explanation_en: It is a specially designed optical fiber with a complex structure of micron level to realize various optical and optical communication applications. Different from the traditional single-mode or multimode optical fiber, the core and cladding structure of microstructure fiber may present a variety of different geometric shapes and arrangements. These complex structures make microstructure fiber have some unique properties and applications.

explanation_cn: 通过附加的热处理使玻璃基体中长出大量均匀分布的微小晶体而形成的一类性能介于玻璃和陶瓷之间的无机材料。晶体含量可达到50%-90%，通常不透明但脆度比玻璃小。
explanation_en: A kind of inorganic materials with properties between glass and ceramics is formed by growing a large number of tiny crystal evenly distributed in the glass matrix through additional heat treatment. Crystal content can reach 50% -90%, usually opaque but less brittle than glass.

explanation_cn: 由平均尺度在数纳米至数十纳米的晶粒分布在晶态基体中的半导体硅薄膜。它的带隙可达2.4cV，电子与空穴迁移率都分别高于非晶硅两个数量级以上。
explanation_en: Semiconductor silicon thin film with average size of several nanometers to tens of nanometers distributed in crystalline matrix. Its band gap can reach 2.4cV, and the electron and hole mobility are two orders of magnitude higher than that of amorphous silicon respectively.

explanation_cn: 晶粒尺寸为微米数量级的金属间化合物。j利用气体雾化法、旋转电极法、机械合金化法或快冷制带法可以制备出。微晶金属间化合物在室温的强度和韧性都有明显改善。见快凝金属I间化合物。
explanation_en: Imermetallif compound whose grain size is in the order of microns. J can be prepared by gas atomization method, rotating electrode method, mechanical alloy method or rapid cooling belt making method. The strength and toughness of microcrystalline intermetallic compound at room temperature have been significantly improved. See rapid solidification metal intermetallic compounds.
