explanation_cn: 在热塑性高分子介质中，因光敏物质经光照产生微泡所引起对光的散射而获得影像的一种非银盐光敏材料。微泡体系中最常用的光敏物质是重氮化合物：①经适当波长的光源（约385nm)曝光，重氮化合物可分解生成氮气和其他挥发性化合物;②通过在适当温度下加i热.使挥发性物质从感光层中扩散逸出;③未分解的I重氮化合物再曝光;④热显影，使挥发性核中心膨i胀.以形成微泡。在热显影过程中，热塑性树脂软I化，生成的气相核心膨胀形成0.5-5.Opm微泡，引起树脂变形并在气泡周围产生较密实的硬壳，结果在介质的交界处因折射率变化引起光的强烈散射.使影像可见。最常用的热塑树脂是丙烯腈类、苯乙烯类及其共聚物。的优点是工艺简单、成本低、可快速得到影像、生片的影像均具有高稳定性。其缺点是感光度较低。故近年来开发了光敏性叠氮化合物用于微泡体系.以提高感光度。主要用于缩微和复印材料.也可用于电影和航空照相术中.近年来在全息照相中也有应用。
explanation_en: In the thermoplastic macromolecule medium, a non silver salt photosensitive materials can obtain images due to the scattering of light caused by the microbubbles generated by photosensitive substances under illumination. The most commonly used photosensitive substance in microbubble systems is diazo compounds: ① Upon exposure to an appropriate wavelength light source (approximately 385nm), diazo compounds can decompose into nitrogen and other volatile compounds; ② The volatile matter diffusion and escapes from the photosensitive layer by adding i heat at an appropriate temperature; ③ Unexposed I diazo compound without decomposition; ④ Thermal development causes the center of the volatile nucleus to expand and form microbubbles. In the process of thermal development, thermoplastic resin is softened, and the generated gas phase core expands to form 0.5-5.Opm microbubbles, which causes resin deformation and produces a dense hard shell around the bubbles. As a result, light is strongly scattered at the interface of the medium due to the change of refractive index, making the image visible. The most commonly used thermoplastic resin are acrylonitrile, styrene and their copolymer. The advantages of this method are simple process, low cost, and the ability to quickly obtain images, as well as the high stability of raw images. Its disadvantage is low sensitivity. In recent years, photosensitive azide compounds have been developed for microbubble systems to improve sensitivity. It is mainly used for microfilming and copying materials. It can also be used in film and aerial photography. In recent years, it has also been used in holography.

explanation_cn: 用于微波技术领域的陶瓷材料是指应用于微波频段，主要是特高频（UHF，300MHz - 3GHz）、超高频（SHF，3GHz - 30GHz）电路中作为介质材料并完成一种或多种功能的陶瓷。如微波管中的管壳、谐振腔、功率输出窗、收集极、高频滤波器和电容器等都使用微波介质陶瓷。这种材料的特点是具有适宜的介电常数、高的品质因数，低介质损耗、合适的线胀系数和足够高的机械强度。主要的陶瓷材料包括高氧化铝陶瓷、多钛酸钡陶瓷，如四钛酸钡和九钛酸钡陶瓷等，适用于1GHz以下的频段。而(SnZn)Ti4O13、Ba(ZnTa)2O6等材料可用于10GHz和100GHz的频段。此外，还有衰减陶瓷、微波铁氧体等材料也属于这一类别。以BaTi4O9为例，其主要性能包括相对介电常数（109Hz）约为38，介电损耗角正切（103Hz）约为4x10^-4，电容温度系数为-150x10^-6，频率温度系数约为15x10^-6/°C，线胀系数为9.1x10^-6/°C，弯曲强度大于95MPa。而Ba2Tiu4O11的主要性能包括相对介电常数（4x10^9Hz）约为40，介电常数温度系数约为-24x10^-6，频率温度系数约为2x10^-6/°C，电学品质因数（4x10^9Hz）大于5000。
explanation_en: The ceramics materials used in the field of microwave technology refers to the ceramics used in the microwave frequency band, mainly as a dielectric materials in ultrahigh frequency (UHF, 300MHz -3GHz) and ultrahigh frequency (SHF, 3GHz -30GHz) circuits, and to complete one or more functions. For example, the shell, resonator, power output window, collector, high-frequency filter and capacitor in the microwave tube all use microwave dielectric ceramics. This materials is characterized by suitable dielectric constant, high quality factor, low dielectric loss, suitable linear expansion coefficient and high enough mechanical strength. The main ceramics materials include high alumina ceramics, multi barium titanate ceramics, such as barium tetratitanate and nine barium titanate ceramics, which are suitable for frequencies below 1GHz. Materials such as (SnZn) Ti4O13, Ba (ZnTa) 2O6 can be used in the 10GHz and 100GHz frequency bands. In addition, there are attenuation ceramics, microwave ferrite and other materials also belong to this category. Taking BaTi4O9 as an example, its main properties include the relative dielectric constant (109Hz) of about 38, the dielectric loss tangent (103Hz) of about 4x10 ^ -4, the capacitance temperature coefficient of -150x10 ^ -6, the frequency temperature coefficient of about 15x10 ^ -6/° C, the linear expansion coefficient of 9.1x10 ^ -6/° C, and the bending strength of more than 95MPa. The main properties of Ba2Tiu4O11 include the relative dielectric constant (4x10 ^ 9Hz) of about 40, the temperature coefficient of dielectric constant of about -24x10 ^ -6, the frequency temperature coefficient of about 2x10 ^ -6/° C, and the electrical quality factor (4x10 ^ 9Hz) of more than 5000.

explanation_cn: 指微波催化氧化技术中使用的强氧化剂。废水微波催化氧化技术是将废水和氧化剂混合后在微波场中进行废水处理的技术,微波频率与分子转动频率相近，微波电磁作用会影响分子中未成对电子的旋转方式和氢键缔合度，并通过在分子中储存微波能量以改变分子间微观排列及相互作用等方式来影响化学反应的宏观焓或熵效应.从而降低活化反应能，改变反应动力学。废水微波催化氧化过程中水中的极性分子和水分子吸收微波后运动速度加剧，碰撞接触概率增加，从而使氧化过程迅速完成;微波对水中的物质进行选择性分子加热，对吸波污染物质的氧化反应具有强烈的催化作用，对有些不能直接吸收微波的污染物，可通过催化介质如镍、钴、铁等把微波能传给这些物质，使污染物分子结构产生变形和振动，改变污染物的焓或熵，降低化学反应的活化自由能，使氧化反应更加彻底。微波催化氧化对污染物的降解去除率明显提高。微波具有直线性、反射性、吸收性和穿透性等特征，915MHz多用于工业化生产，2450MHz-般用于民用。
explanation_en: Refers to strong oxidants used in microwave catalytic oxidation technology. Microwave catalytic oxidation technology for wastewater is a technology for wastewater treatment in microwave field after mixing wastewater and oxidizer. Microwave frequency is close to molecular rotation frequency, and microwave electromagnetic effect will affect the rotation mode of unpaired electrons in molecules and hydrogen bond association degree, The macro enthalpy or entropy effect of chemical reaction is affected by changing the microscopic arrangement and interaction of molecules by storing microwave energy in molecules, so as to reduce the activation or conditioning reaction energy and change the reaction kinetics. In the process of microwave catalytic oxidation of wastewater, polar molecules and water molecules in the water absorb microwaves and their movement speed increases, resulting in an increase in the probability of collision and contact, thus completing the oxidation process quickly; Microwave selectively heats the substances in water and has a strong catalysis effect on the oxidation reaction of microwave absorbing pollutants. For some pollutants that cannot directly absorb microwave, microwave energy can be transmitted to these substances through catalytic media such as nickel, cobalt, iron, etc., so that the molecular structure of pollutants will deform and vibrate, change the enthalpy or entropy of pollutants, reduce the activation or conditioning free energy of chemical reaction, and make the oxidation reaction more thorough. The removal rate of pollutants by microwave catalytic oxidation was significantly improved. Microwave has the characteristics of linearity, reflectivity, absorption, and penetration. 915MHz is mostly used for industrial production, and 2450MHz is generally used for civilian use.

explanation_cn: 通过微波作用产生热能而引发树脂体系产生化学交联形成间化聚合物的过程，是辐射固化的一种。微波同化反应的机理存"致热效应"和"非致热效应"两种解释。"致热效应"指反应体系温度升高而加速反应;"非致热效应"认为来自于微波辐射场对离子和极性分子的洛仑兹力作用。传统观点认为加速反应主要是由于"致热效应其机理是极性物质在外加电磁场作用下.内部介质极化产生的极化强度矢量落后于电场一个角度，产生与电场同相的电流，构成功率耗散形成体积加热。该方法具有传热均匀、加热效率高、固化速度快和易于控制等优点。
explanation_en: The process of chemical crosslinking of resin system and the formation of interstitial polymer by generating heat energy through microwave action is a kind of radiation curing. The mechanism of microwave assimilation reaction can be explained by two factors: "heating effect" and "non heating effect". The "heating effect" refers to the acceleration of the reaction by increasing the temperature of the reaction system; "Non thermal effect" is believed to come from the Lorentz force effect of microwave radiation field on ions and polar molecules. According to the traditional view, the accelerated reaction is mainly due to the "heating effect". Its mechanism is that the polarization vector generated by the polarization of the internal medium lags behind the electric field by an angle, generating a current in the same phase with the electric field, forming a power dissipation to form volume heating. This method has the advantages of uniform heat transfer, high heating efficiency, fast curing speed and easy control.

explanation_cn: 能有效衰减频率在300MHz-300GHz，波长在1mm范围内的电磁波材料。主要由导电填料、树脂黏结剂、溶剂和添加剂组成。导电填料一般选用导电性能优良的大尺寸纤维或片状材料.如金属纤维、金属片、镀金属片，此外还有碳纤维、超导炭黑和金属合金等。根据填料种类的不同，可分为银系、碳系、镍系和铜系电磁屏蔽涂料等。按应用形式分为涂敷型涂料和结构型复合材料。结构型复合材料以屏蔽塑料为主，其中主要是表层导电型屏蔽塑料和填充型屏蔽塑料。表层导电型屏蔽塑料是利用贴金属箔、金属熔融喷射和非电解电镀等方法在塑料表面获得很薄的金属层，从而达到屏蔽的目的。表层导电型材料导电性好，屏蔽效果佳，但其金属箔复合层或镀层在使用和加T.过程中容易剥离，性能较差，因此使用较少。填充型复合屏蔽塑料是由导电填料和合成树脂通过混炼造粒，并采用注射成型、挤灰成型或压塑成型等方法制得"主要有导电纤维混纺织物、金属化织物、金属涂层织物、不锈钢非纺织布等。微波屏蔽材料主要用于电子设备、元件、微波反射室以及提高雷达与微波设备性能等方面。
explanation_en: It can effectively attenuate the electromagnetic wave materials with a frequency of 300MHz-300GHz and a wavelength of 1mm. It is mainly composed of conductive filler, resin adhesive, solvent and additive. Conductive filler generally selects large size fiber or sheet materials with excellent conductivity, such as metal fiber, metal sheet, metal plated sheet, carbon fiber, superconducting carbon black and metal alloy. According to the type of filler, it can be divided into silver series, carbon series, nickel series and copper series electromagnetic shielding coatings. According to the application form, it can be divided into coated coatings and structural composite materials. Structural composite materials are mainly shielding plastics, including surface conductive shielding plastics and filled shielding plastics. Surface conductive shielding plastics is used to obtain a very thin metal layer on the surface of plastics by pasting metal foil, metal melt spraying and non electrolytic electroplating, so as to achieve the purpose of shielding. The surface conductive materials has good conductivity and good shielding effect, but its metal foil composition layer or coating is easy to peel off during use and application of T. Its performance is poor, so it is seldom used. Filled composition shielding plastics is made from conductive filler and synthetic resin through mixing and granulation, and by injection molding, ash extrusion molding or compression molding, "mainly including electroconcluctive fiber blended fabric, metallized fabric, metal coated fabric, stainless steel non-woven fabric, etc. microwave shielding materials is mainly used for electronic equipment, components, microwave reflector, and improving the performance of radar and microwave equipment.

explanation_cn: 一种根据微波反射、透射、衍射干涉、腔体微扰等物理特性的改变.以及被检材料介电常数和介电损耗角正切的相对变化.通过测M微波基本参数（如幅度衰减、相移量或频率等〉变化，实现对缺陷进行检测的方法。微波是一种波长短、频带宽、方向性好和贯穿介电材料能力i强的电磁波，具有能穿透声衰减很大的非金属材料的特性.因此可用来检测大多数非金属和复合材料内部的缺陷，例如各种胶接结构与蜂窝结构件中的分层、脱粘.金属件表面粗糙度和裂纹，非金属材料的湿度、密度，混合物间化度.板材厚度.线径和微小位移等。微波检测可分为穿透法、反射法和散射法。它的优点是设备不太复杂，非接触式，便于自动化。尤其适用于生产线的连续、快速测量和自动控制;缺点是不能穿透金属或导电性能较好的复合材料。由于集肤效应，它不适于检测材料内部较深的缺陷，对操作人员要求较高。
explanation_en: A method based on microwave reflection, transmission, diffraction interference Changes in physical properties such as cavity perturbation, and the relative changes in the dielectric constant and tangent of dielectric loss angle of the tested materials (such as amplitude attenuation, phase shift or frequency, etc.) change to realize the detection of defects. Microwave is an electromagnetic wave with long wave length, wide frequency band, good directivity and strong ability to penetrate dielectric materials. It has the characteristics of penetrating non-metallic materials with great sound attenuation. Therefore, it can be used to detect the internal defects of most non-metallic and composite materials, such as delamination, debonding and metal part surface in various adhesive structures and honeycomb structural parts Roughness and crack, humidity and density of non-metallic materials, mixture degree, plate thickness, wire diameter and small displacement, etc. Microwave testing can be divided into penetration method, reflection method and scattering method. Its advantage is that the equipment is not too complex, non-contact, and easy to automate. Especially suitable for continuous, rapid measurement and automatic control of production lines; The disadvantage is that it cannot penetrate metal or composite materials with good conductivity. Due to the skin effect, it is not suitable for detecting deeper defects in materials, and requires higher requirements for operators.

explanation_cn: 利用微波与材料之间相互作用产生的介电损耗使陶瓷表面和内部同时自发热从而实现快速致密化的烧结技术。传统加热方式是由材料表面到内部的传热，因此存在较大的温度梯度，并需要长时间保温。而微波加热是由材料组分的介电损耗所引发的，其加热特点是三维整体式的、同时原发于试件内部.所以升温速率快、温度场均匀、无热惯性、能量转换效率高、环境友好.可实现快速、高效烧结，并细化晶粒、优化微观组织结构。该方法的另一特点是，通过成分设计，利用微波对材料的选择性加热特性，可对材料的特定部位进行热修复或缺陷愈合。
explanation_en: It is a sintering technology that uses the diekctric loss generated by the interaction between microwave and materials to make the surface and interior of ceramics self heating at the same time to achieve rapid densification. The traditional heating method is the heat transfer from the surface of materials to the interior, so there is a large temperature gradient, and it needs a long time of insulation. However, microwave heating is caused by diekctric loss of materials components, and its heating characteristics are three-dimensional integral and originated from the inside of the specimen. Therefore, the heating rate is fast, the temperature field is uniform, there is no thermal inertia, the energy conversion efficiency is high, and the environment is friendly. It can achieve rapid and efficient sintering, refine the grain, and optimize the microstructure. Another feature of this method is that through composition design and the selective heating characteristics of microwave on materials, specific parts of materials can be thermally repaired or defects can be healed.

name_cn: 微波等离子体化学气相沉积
explanation_cn: 用微波等离子体激活化学反应，进行气相沉积的技术。微波等离子体增强了气体反应活性，加速气相分解反应和表面原子的迁移，使沉积过程可以在较低生长温度下进行。常用设备在一低压CVD反应管上交叉安置一共振腔和与之匹配的微波发射器。在CVD反应管中被共振腔包围的气体可通过微波作用形成等离子体.微波频率通常为2.45GHz，发射功率通常在几百瓦至一千瓦以上，这可根据托盘温度和生长过程满足质量输运限速步骤等条件决定。如为了得到通常条件难以合成的氮化物（TiN,ZnN)，可在N2气氛下引人Ti或Zn的生长源.通过微波等离子体作用.促使N2分子wei765分解，产生大量单原子N,即在较低生长温度下也可得到高质量的氮化物。该方法减少了因高温生长造成的位错缺陷.组分或杂质的互扩散：避免了电极污染;薄膜受等离子体的破坏小;对于低熔点和高温下：不稳定的化合物的薄膜生长更为适合。
explanation_en: The technique of using microwave plasma to activate chemical reactions for vapor deposition. Microwave plasma enhances gas reaction activity, accelerates gas phase decomposition reaction and surface atom migration, allowing the deposition process to occur at lower growth temperatures. The commonly used equipment is cross arranged with a common resonator and a matching microwave transmitter on a low-pressure CVD reaction tube. The gas surrounded by the resonant cavity in the CVD reaction tube can form a plasma through microwave action. The microwave frequency is usually 2.45GHz, and the emission power is usually several hundred to one thousand watts or more. This can be determined by conditions such as tray temperature and meeting the mass transport rate limiting step during the growth process. In order to obtain nitrides (TiN, ZnN) that are difficult to synthesize under normal conditions, a growth source of Ti or Zn can be introduced under N2 atmosphere. Through the action of microwave plasma, the N2 molecule wei765 can be decomposed to produce a large amount of single atom N, which can also yield high-quality nitrides at lower growth temperatures. The method reduces dislocation defects caused by high temperature growth, mutual diffusion of components or impurities, and avoids electrode pollution; The film is less damaged by plasma; For low melting point and high temperature: the film growth of unstable compounds is more suitable.

explanation_cn: 又称旋磁铁氧体。一种可在微波波段（包括从米波至毫米波）使用的铁氧体材料。主要有尖晶石型、石榴石型和磁铅石型等三种?尖晶石型包括镁系（Mg-Mn、Mg-Mn-A1)、镍系（Ni-Zn、Ni-Al)和锂系（Li-Al、Li-Ti)铁氧体。石榴石型包括钇铁石榴石YIG、钇铝石榴石YA11G、钇钆石榴石YGdIG和钙钒系石榴石型铁氧体。磁铅石型也包括Sr-F^Al系和Ba-Ni-Co系铁766wei氧体。磁铅石型材料具有高的各向异件.-?般适用于毫米波器件。对微波铁氧体的性能要求是：低共振线宽;在低频段，要求饱和磁化强度和磁晶各向异性常数K低，在高频段，要求饱和磁化强度和内场高;低损耗和髙稳定性等。
explanation_en: Also called gyromagnetic ferrite. The invention relates to a ferrite materials which can be used in the microwave wave band (including from meter wave to millimeter wave). There are mainly three types: spinel type, garnet type and magnetite lead type? The spinel type includes magnesium (Mg Mn, Mg Mn A1), nickel (Ni Zn, Ni Al) and lithium (Li Al, Li Ti) ferrite. The garnet type includes yttrium iron garnet YIG, yttrium aluminum garnet YA11G, yttrium gadolinium garnet YGdIG and calcium vanadium garnet ferrite. Magnetite type also includes Sr-F ^ Al and Ba Ni Co iron 766wei ferrite. Magnetic lead stone materials has high anisotropy? It is generally suitable for millimeter wave devices. The performance requirements of microwave ferrite are: low resonance linewidth; In low frequency band, saturation magnetization and magnetocrystalline anisotropy constant K are required to be low, and in high frequency band, saturation magnetization and internal field are required to be high; Low loss and high stability.

explanation_cn: 是指橡胶制品的半成品在频率为900-2450MHz的高频交变电场及微波（高频波）的作用下.使橡胶自感应发热，达到硫化温度后，再进入热空气管道保温完成硫化的工艺过程。这种高频波可以使偶极材料的原子或分子极化.并随电场的迅速变化而运动，产生热量。橡胶分子的振动强度除受电磁场的影响外，还取决于分子的极性和配方组成。电磁场的强度越大，频率越高，加热效率就越高;胶料极性越大.加热效率越高。过程分成两个阶段：第一阶段在微波道部分将胶料加热到硫化温度;第二阶段在热空气道部分保温并完成硫化。微波硫化最大的特点是热从被加热物体内部产生，从而克服了通常所采用的加热方式存在表里温差的缺点，有利于提高制品的硫化质M.并可大大缩短硫化时间，特别是对厚壁制品的硫化（如载重车胎和大型越野轮胎、护舷等）。经微波加热，可以减少1/3以上的硫化时间;热能消耗仅为其他连续硫化方法的20%左右，且没有污染，是一种迅速发展的新工艺。适于各种尺寸和复杂断面形状的制品;
explanation_en: It refers to the process in which the semi-finished products of rubber products, under the action of high-frequency alternating electric field and microwave (high-frequency wave) with the frequency of 900-2450MHz, make rubber self induction heating, reach the vulcanization temperature, and then enter the hot air pipeline for insulation to complete vulcanization. This high-frequency wave can polarization atoms or molecules of dipole materials and move with the rapid change of electric field, generating heat. The vibration intensity of rubber molecules is not only affected by electromagnetic field, but also depends on the polarity of molecules and formula composition. The higher the intensity and frequency of the electromagnetic field, the higher the heating efficiency; The greater the polarity of the rubber material, the higher the heating efficiency. The process is divided into two stages: the first stage is to heat the rubber to the vulcanization temperature in the microwave channel; In the second stage, heat preservation and vulcanization are completed in the hot air duct. The biggest feature of microwave vulcanization is that heat is generated from the inside of the object to be heated, which overcomes the shortcoming of the temperature difference between the surface and the inside of the commonly used heating method. It is conducive to improving the vulcanization quality of the products and can greatly shorten the vulcanization time, especially for the vulcanization of thick walled products (such as truck tires, large off-road tires, fenders, etc.). After microwave heating, the vulcanization time can be reduced by more than 1/3; The heat energy consumption is only about 20% of that of other continuous vulcanization methods, and there is no pollution. It is a rapidly developing new process. Suitable for products of various sizes and complex cross-sectional shapes;

explanation_cn: 又称芯片实验室.是把生物和化学领域中所涉及的样品制备、反应、分离、检测等基本操作单元集成或基本集成到一块几平方厘米，甚至更小的芯片上，由微通道形成网络，以可控流体贯穿整个系统的一种检测技术。的基本特征和最大优势是多种单元技术在微小平台的灵活组合和大规模集成，高通量是大规模集成的一种形式。的基本特点是多种单元技术在微小平台上的灵活组合和规模集成，B前一个重要的趋势是：集成的单元部件越来越多，且集成的规模越来越大。所涉及的部件包括：和进样及样品处理有关的透析、膜、固相萃取、净化;用于流体控制的微阀、微泵;还包括微混合器、微反应器、微分离器和微检测器等。这样一种高度集成的平台具备物料耗量低、运行时间短、价格低廉、使用安全、通量高、污染小等特点，形成了微技术领域的一种固有优势。一个完整的芯片实验室大体包括H个部分：一是芯片：二是包括驱动源和信号检测装置在内的芯片工作站;三是包含有实现芯片功能化方法和材料的试剂盒。
explanation_en: It is also called chip lab. It is a detection technology that integrates or basically integrates the basic operation units involved in the biological and chemical fields, such as sample preparation, reaction, separation and detection, into a chip of several square centimeters or even smaller, forms a network by microchannels, and penetrates the whole system with controllable fluid. The basic feature and biggest advantage of high throughput is the flexible combination and large-scale integration of multiple unit technologies on micro platforms, which is a form of large-scale integration. The basic feature of B is the flexible combination and scale integration of multiple unit technologies on micro platforms. explanation_cn: 指在土壤或江、河、湖、海水中受微生物的作用而完全分解的合成纤维。分解产物为水和二氧化碳，分解时间为一到两年。主要包括两类，一类是聚己内酯纤维，具有较高的断裂强度，但熔点较低;另一类为全脂肪族聚酯纤维，性能和聚己内酯纤维相近。其主要用于制作吋降解的钓鱼丝、卫生医疗用品、土木工程和农业用材等，其特点为使用后可在土壤或水中完全分解。
explanation_en: It refers to synthetic fiber that is completely decomposed by microorganisms in soil or rivers, lakes and seawater. The decomposition products are water and carbon dioxide, with a decomposition time of one to two years. It mainly includes two types: one is polycaprolactone fiber, which has higher fracture strength but lower melting point; The other is full aliphatic polyester fiber, whose properties are similar to those of polycaprolactone fiber. It is mainly used for making degradation fishing lines, medical supplies, civil engineering and agricultural materials, etc. It is characterized by complete decomposition in soil or water after use.

explanation_cn: 将微生物在生存状态下固定在高分子膜上，并与电化学传感元件相结合而构成的一种生物功能电极，又称微生物传感器。它利用细胞中酶对待测物的水解、氨解或氧化反应的选择性催化作用.以及电化学传感元件对反应物的选择性探测.依据反应的化学计量关系.定量地检测底物存在量的信息。按其原理可分为微生物的呼吸活性型和代谢活性型两类。前者由好气型微生物固定化膜与氧电极组合而成，于含有有机化合物的样品液中，有机物被微生物所摄取，使微生物的呼吸活性增加，呼吸活性的变化可由氧电极检测出来;后者是将厌气型微生物固定化膜与燃料电池型电极、离子选择电极或各种气敏电极组合而成，当微生物摄取有机物时产生各种代谢产物.如二氧化碳、氢、甲酸、还原型辅酶等电极活性物质，应用上述各种电极可检测这些代谢产物。与酶电极相比，直接利用了细胞内的复合酶系、辅酶系和产生能量的系统，减少了酶的分离和提纯过程，因而具有价格低廉、使用寿命长的优点。可以用于测定抗生素、维生素、氨基酸及生物需氧量（BOD)，已在医疗检测中得到应用。
explanation_en: A biological functional electrode, also called microbe sensor, is composed of microorganisms fixed on tnacromolecular film in the living state and combined with electrochemical sensor elements. It uses the selective catalysis of the hydrolysis, ammonolysis or oxidation of the enzyme in the cell to be measured, and the selective detection of the reactant by the electrochemical sensor element. According to the stoichiometric relationship of the reaction, it can quantitatively detect the information about the presence of the substrate. According to its principles, it can be divided into two categories: respiratory active type and metabolic active type of microorganisms. The former is composed of a fixed membrane of aerobic microorganisms and an oxygen electrode. In the sample solution containing organic compounds, organic matter is absorbed by the microorganisms, which increases their respiratory activity. Changes in respiratory activity can be detected by the oxygen electrode; The latter is a combination of anaerobic microbial immobilized membranes with fuel cell electrodes, ion selective electrodes, or various gas sensitive electrodes. When microorganisms ingest organic matter, they produce various metabolic products, such as carbon dioxide, hydrogen, formic acid, reducing coenzyme, and other electrode active substances. These metabolic products can be detected using these various electrodes. Compared with enzyme electrode, it directly utilizes the composition enzyme system, coenzyme system and energy generating system in the cell, reducing the separation and purification process of enzyme, so it has the advantages of low price and long service life. It can be used to measure antibiotics, vitamins, amino acids, and biological oxygen demand (BOD), and has been applied in medical testing.

explanation_cn: 指微米至纳米量级精度或特征尺寸并具有特定功能器件或系统的制造、设计，研究中涉及微纳器件与系统的设计与器件原理、微纳及其跨尺度加工、操作、测试与表征、封装与装备等。利用.可以批量化地制造微纳结构、微纳传感器、微纳执行器以及微机电系统（MEMS)、纳机电系统（NEMS)等。习惯上.将分为集成电路（1C)兼容的制造和非1C兼容制造。由于硅材料不仅有优异的电学特性，也有良好的机械特性，同时有强大的1C工业基础设施支撑，因此成为的主流材料。非1C兼容的微纳制造则可以满足不同材料和结构的制造需要以及特定应用环境的需求。将机械制造、电子、物理、化学、光学等多学科有机地交织在一起，不仅向基础科学提供了许多挑战性问题，它的快速发展也推动着相关学科的快速发展。具有极强的应用渗透力，已成为衡量一个国家制造水平的重要标志。已经在信息、汽车、消费电子、工业控制、医疗、电信、航空、国防、新能源等领域大量应用，具有良好发展前景。
explanation_en: It refers to the manufacturing and design of devices or systems with precision or feature sizes ranging from micrometers to nanometers and specific functions. The research involves the design and device principles of micro/nano devices and systems, micro/nano and their cross scale processing, operation, testing and characterization, packaging and equipment, etc. By utilizing, micro/nano structures, micro/nano sensors, micro/nano actuators, as well as micro electromechanical systems (MEMS), nano electromechanical systems (NEMS), etc. can be mass-produced. Traditionally, it will be divided into integrated circuit (1C) compatible manufacturing and non 1C compatible manufacturing. As silicon materials not only have excellent electrical properties, but also have good mechanical properties, and are supported by strong 1C industrial infrastructure, they have become mainstream materials. Non 1C compatible micro/nano manufacturing can meet the manufacturing needs of different materials and structures as well as the needs of specific application environments. The organic interweaving of multiple disciplines such as mechanical manufacturing, electronics, physics, chemistry, and optics not only provides many challenging problems for basic science, but also promotes the rapid development of related disciplines. It has strong application penetration and has become an important indicator of a country's manufacturing level. It has been widely applied in fields such as information, automobiles, consumer electronics, industrial control, healthcare, telecommunications, aviation, national defense, new energy, and has good development prospects.

explanation_cn: 半导体中由杂质或点缺陷聚集形成的缺陷以及位错和层错等的总称，尺寸最大约几十微米，一般为微米级和亚微米量级，故名微缺陷。由杂质聚集形成的沉淀物本身就属于，当沉淀物足够大时还会诱生出层错和位错等二次微缺陷。点缺陷聚集形成的有自间隙性缺陷（如位错环）和空位型缺陷（如空洞）。对半导体器件的影响是利害并存的。以最重要的半导体单晶硅为例，若微缺陷存在于硅单晶片表面，则降低器件的成品率;而当微缺陷存在于硅单晶片的体内，则它们可以吸除表面的有害沾污，从而有利于提高器件成
explanation_en: The general name of defects, dislocations and stacking faults formed by the aggregation of impurities or point defects in semiconductors. The maximum size is about tens of microns, generally in the micron and submicron scales, so it is called microdefect. The precipitate formed by impurity aggregation itself belongs to. When the precipitate is large enough, secondary microdefect such as stacking faults and dislocation will be induced. The self gap defects (such as dislocation loop) and vacancy type defects (such as voids) are formed by the aggregation of point defects. The impact on semiconductor devices is a win-win situation. Taking the most important semiconductor monocrystalline silicon as an example, if microdefect exist on the surface of silicon monocrystalline chips, the yield of devices will be reduced; When micro defects exist within the body of a silicon single crystal chip, they can absorb harmful surface contamination, which is beneficial for improving device performance

explanation_cn: 指微观粒子运动的逆过程是其正过程沿相反方向的重复，即正：逆反应一定沿着同一条反应途径相向进行。这就是的数学表示，又叫做牛顿运动方程，是时间反演对称的。运动没有方向性，过去和未来没有差别，逆过程和正过程的轨道相同，速率大小相等，方向相反，两者都是现实中可能存在的。I描述微观粒子运动规律的薛定谔方程同样是时间反演对称的，由此推之，在量子力学中，同样成立。宏观多粒子系统运动状态取决于系统中所包含的各个粒子的运动状态。根据，既然每个粒子的运动过程是可逆的，系统的运动过程亦必然是可逆的。可是热力学第二定律指明，所有宏观过程都是不可逆的。因此，与宏观不可逆性的矛盾是物理学中迄今还没有很好解决的问题。
explanation_en: The reverse process of micro particle motion refers to the repetition of its positive process in the opposite direction, that is, the positive and negative reactions must proceed along the same reaction pathway in the opposite direction. This is the mathematical representation, also known as the Newton's equation of motion, which is time reversal symmetric. Motion has no directionality, there is no difference between the past and the future. The orbits of the reverse process and the positive process are the same, with equal rates and opposite directions, both of which may exist in reality. I The Schrodinger equation, which describes the motion law of microscopic particles, is also time reversal symmetric, and thus, it is also true in quantum mechanics. The motion state of a macroscopic multi particle system depends on the motion state of each particle contained in the system. According to, since the motion process of each particle is reversible, the motion process of the system must also be reversible. However, the the second law of thermodynamics indicates that all macro processes are irreversible. Therefore, the contradiction with macroscopic irreversibility is a problem that has not yet been well solved in physics.

explanation_cn: 低温下强磁场中金属的磁化率随磁场的倒数而振荡的现象称为德哈斯-凡阿尔芬效应。这种现象与金属费米能级附近电子在强磁场下的行为有关，因而与费米面结构有密切关系，成为研究费米面的重要工具。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that the magnetic susceptibility of metals in a strong magnetic field oscillates with the reciprocal of the magnetic field at low temperatures is called the de Haas-van Alphen effect. This phenomenon is related to the behavior of the electrons near the Fermi level of the metal in a strong magnetic field, so it is closely related to the structure of the Fermi surface and becomes an important tool for studying the Fermi surface.

explanation_cn: 固态的定容比热常用此温度表示θ=ω (h/2π)/k，式中，θ为狄拜温度，h 为普朗克常数(Planck constant)被 2π 除；k 为波兹曼常数(Boltzmann constant)；ω为与固体本身特性有关之角频率。具体地，ω^3 = 6π^2v^3N/V其中，v为恒定声速，N为固体原胞数，V为固体体积。该名称因美籍荷兰物理学家德拜而得名。不同固体的德拜温度不同。金属的德拜温度越高，原子间作用力越大，膨胀系数越小，杨氏模量越大。德拜温度和频率上限成正比。和一般振动系统类似，原子间相互作用力较强、原子较轻时振动频率高，因此德拜温度也高。例如，金刚石的德拜温度约2050K，铅原子间相互作用力较弱，而且原子也较重，因此德拜温度值很低，不到100K，一般元素的德拜温度值大约在200K到400K。德拜理论的偏差，反映在由各个温度下的比热数值求出的德拜温度值不是常数,而是德拜温度随温度稍有变化。大多数情况下和平均值的偏差小于10%，个别情况，变化可大于20%(如锌)
explanation_en: The specific heat of solid state at constant volume is commonly represented by this temperature θ=ω (h/2 π)/k, where, θ Is the Debye temperature, and h is the Planck constant divided by 2 π; K is the Boltzmann constant; ω The angular frequency related to the characteristics of the solid itself. Specifically, ω^ 3=6 π ^ 2v ^ 3N/V, where v is a constant sound velocity, N is the number of solid cells, and V is the volume of the solid. This name is named after Dutch American physicist Debye. Different solids have different Debey temperature. The higher the Debey temperature of the metal, the greater the interatomic force, the smaller the expansion coefficient and the larger the Young's modulus. The Debey temperature is proportional to the upper frequency limit. Similar to the general vibration system, the vibration frequency is high when the interaction between atoms is strong and the atoms are light, so the Debey temperature is also high. For example, the Debey temperature of diamond is about 2050 K, the interaction between lead atoms is weak, and the atoms are also heavy, so the Debey temperature value is very low, less than 100 K, and the Debey temperature value of general elements is about 200 K to 400 K. The deviation of Debye theory is reflected in that the Debey temperature value calculated from the specific heat value at each temperature is not a constant, but the Debey temperature slightly changes with temperature. In most cases, the deviation from the average value is less than 10%, and in some cases, the variation can be greater than 20% (such as zinc)

explanation_cn: 用新月形裁刀裁取硫化橡胶试样，在试样圆弧凹边的中心处割口，沿主轴方向拉伸试样，直至开裂时的最大拉力与试片厚度的比值。这种类型的试样内，切有一个狭长的切口，是一种比较容易从成品上裁取的小尺寸试样，在国际标准ISO816中，采用了这种类型的试样。

This type of specimen has a narrow cut inside, which is a relatively easy to cut small-sized specimen from the finished product. This type of specimen is used in the international standard ISO816.

explanation_cn: 由超弹性镍钛合金丝编织而成，放置于心脏缺损部位的膨胀性双伞结构的器械。用于治疗先天性心脏病室间隔缺损和房间隔缺损，实现完全封闭心脏缺损部位。封堵器材料为组织工程材料，具备以下特点：无毒性，即无论材料本身，还是其降解产物都不能产生炎症和毒性反应;存良好的生物相容性：生物吋降解性及降解调节性；不引起机体免疫排斥反应;具有可塑性和一定的机械强度;良好的表面活性.有利于细胞黏附、生长、增殖。其主要的原理是将左右心室间的"漏洞"、左右心房间的"漏洞"、主动脉与肺动脉之间的通道堵住。临床治疗使用的封堵器即刻及近期效果较好。经导管房间隔缺损、室间隔缺损封堵已成为目前治疗房间隔缺损、室间隔缺损最安全、有效的方法。用于制作封堵器的传统材料是金属或其合金，它们滞留在人体内，存在容易引起炎症、取出困难、与现代成像技术形成阴影、过一段时间尺寸与病灶处脱节等问题。因此，如果能够利用可降解材料制成封堵器，待身体组织受到引导使装置表面内皮化之后材料顺利降解。而且对人体无毒，将大大改善封堵器的性能。部分运用的可降解的封堵器大概有左旋聚乳酸、聚乙醇酸、聚己内酯等材料。
explanation_en: The instrument is made of super elasticity nickel titanium alloy wire and placed in the heart defect area with an expansive double umbrella structure. Used to treat congenital heart disease with ventricular septal defect and atrial septal defect, achieving complete closure of the heart defect site. The materials of the occluder is tissue engineering materials, which has the following characteristics: non-toxic, that is, neither the materials itself nor its degradation products can produce inflammatory and toxic reactions; Good biocompatibility: biological time degradation and degradation regulation; Does not cause immune rejection in the body; Having plasticity and certain mechanical strength; Good surface activity, beneficial for cell adhesion, growth, and proliferation. The main principle is to block the "loopholes" between the left and right ventricles, the "loopholes" between the left and right cardiac chambers, and the channels between the aorta and pulmonary arteries. The occluder used in clinical treatment has good immediate and short-term effects. Transcatheter closure of atrial septal defect (asd) and ventricular septal defect (vsd) has become the most safe and effective method to treat asd and vsd. The traditional materials used to make the occluder is metal or its alloy. They stay in the human body, and there are problems such as easy to cause inflammation, difficult to remove, shadow with modern imaging technology, and the size is disconnected from the focus after a period of time. Therefore, if degradation materials can be used to make occluders, materials can be degradation smoothly after the body tissues are induction to endothelialize the device surface. Moreover, it is non-toxic to the human body and will greatly improve the performance of the occluder. Some degradation occluders are made of materials such as L-polylactic acid, polyglycolic acid, poly (e-caprolactone), etc.

explanation_cn: 指具有优异的抗疲劳性能和抗老化性能以及血液相容性，对病变或损伤的心血管系统（如心脏或血管）进行修复或替换的材料。心血管系统是一个封闭的管道系统，由心脏和血管组成,心脏是动力器官，血管是运输血液的管道。通过心脏有节律性收缩与舒张推动血液在血管中按照一定的方向不停地循环流动，称为血液循环。由于血液循环，血液的全部机能才得以实现，并随时调整分配血量。以适应活动着的器官、组织的需要。从而保证机体内环境的恒定和新陈代谢的正常进行。但是由于先天或者后天的某些因素，如先天性心脏病、高血脂、高血压等疾病原因，引起心血管系统功能障碍，不能正常维持体内环境的新陈代谢时，必须从外界对其进行介入治疗。所用的材料称为。针对不同的病变部位选用不同的心血管材料，对于先天性心脏病患者，特别室间隔不全者，常用金属制的栓塞剂进行人工填补。心血管材料主要用在外周冠状动脉和二尖瓣等部位，用于冠状动脉支架的主要材料有316L不锈钢、钴铬钼合金、高分子、镍钛合金等材料;用于人工心脏瓣膜的主要有钛合金、低温热解碳、有机高分子等材料。
explanation_en: It refers to materials with excellent fatigue resistance, aging resistance and Wood compatibility to repair or replace diseased or damaged cardiovascular systems (such as heart or blood vessels). The cardiovascular system is a closed pipeline system composed of the heart and blood vessels. The heart is the power organ, and blood vessels are the pipes that transport blood. The rhythmic contraction and relaxation of the heart promote the continuous circulation of blood in blood vessels in a certain direction, which is called blood circulation. Due to blood circulation, all functions of the blood can be achieved and the distribution of blood volume can be adjusted at any time. To adapt to the needs of active organs and tissues. To ensure the constant internal environment and normal metabolism of the machine. However, due to certain congenital or acquired factors, such as congenital heart disease, hyperlipidemia, hypertension, etc., which cause cardiovascular system dysfunction and cannot maintain normal metabolism of the internal environment, intervention treatment must be carried out from the outside. The materials used is called. Different cardiovascular materials are selected for different lesion sites. For patients with congenital heart disease, especially those with ventricular septal insufficiency, metal embolic agents are commonly used for artificial filling. Cardiovascular materials are mainly used in peripheral coronary arteries and mitral valves. The main materials used for coronary stem are 316L stainless steel, cobalt chromium molybdenum alloy, macromolecule, nickel titanium alloy and other materials; The main materials used for artificial heart valve are titanium alloy, low-temperature pyrolytic carbon, organic macromolecule and other materials.

explanation_cn: 用快速凝固方法（冷却速度通常大于100°C/s)制成的金属间化合物。如果将冷却速度控制到超过lO°C/s,可以获得非常优异的非平衡组织，金属间化合物单相区和固溶范围扩大m，大幅度降低偏析，晶粒更加细小，从而大幅度改善力学性能。
explanation_en: Imermetallif compound made by rapid solidification method (cooling rate is usually greater than 100 ° C/s). If the cooling rate is controlled to exceed lO ° C/s, excellent non-equilibrium structure can be obtained. The single-phase area and solid solution range of imermetallif compound are expanded by m, segregation is greatly reduced, and the grains are finer, thus greatly improving the mechanical properties.

explanation_cn: 又称超离子导体、固体电解质。材料主体是快离子导体，是一类特殊的具有离子导电性的物质。它以其高电导率和低活化能区别于一般的离子导体。在这类物质中都存在可供离子迁移的一维、二维或三维通道；此外，在快离子导体的迁移离子亚晶格内存在非常高的缺陷浓度。这种亚晶格无序可产生离子的协同运动，从而降低离子的迁移活化能，使其具有高电导率。快离子导体可按其迁移率的种类分类，如阳离子导体、阴离子导体、锂离子导体、钠离子导体等；也可按其物质存在的形态分类，如晶态离子导体、非晶态离子导体、聚合物离子导体等。快离子导体由于它的高离子电导率可以起电解质的作用，也被称为固体电解质。固体电解质的出现，使高比能、大容量的蓄电池成为可能。氢、氧等离子导体也可用作高温燃料电池的固体电解质。快离子导体还可用于制造各种离子选择电极，如氧传感器，以及各种电化学器件，如电色显示器、双电层电容器、库仑计等。
explanation_en: It is also called superionic conductor and solid electrolyte. The main body of materials is fast ionic conductor, which is a special kind of material with ionic conductivity. It is distinguished from the general ion conductor by its high electric conductivity and low activation energy. There are one-dimensional, two-dimensional, or three-dimensional channels available for ion migration in these substances; In addition, there is a very high defect concentration in the migration ion sublattice of fast ion conductors. This sublattice disorder can produce coordinated movement of ions, thus reducing the migration activation or conditioning energy of ions and making them have high electric conductivity. Fast ion conductors can be classified according to their mobility, such as cation conductors, anion conductors, lithium ion conductors, sodium ion conductor, etc; It can also be classified according to the existing form of its substance, such as crystalline ion conductor, amorphous (glassy) ion conductor, polymer ion conductor, etc. Fast ionic conductor is also called solid electrolyte because of its high ionic electric conductivity, which can play the role of elonrolyte. The appearance of solid electrolyte makes it possible for accumulator with high specific energy and large capacity. Hydrogen and oxygen plasma conductors can also be used as solid electrolyte for high-temperature fuel cell. Fast ion conductors can also be used to manufacture various ion selective electrodes, such as oxygen sensors, and various electrochemical devices, such as electrochromic displays, double layer capacitors, coulometers, etc.

explanation_cn: 利用流体模将压力传递到粉末上，压力和等静压一样是全向施加的，但较之速度快。它是一种近年发展起来的粉末材料致密化新技术，特别是将高性能预合金粉末固结成全密实零件的廉价工艺。这种方法能重复制造形状复杂或简单的异形零件，这使之适于制造接近最终形状的零件或预成行坯。快速全向压制时，加热粉末的温度较低，制品具有很细的显微组织和极好的力学性能。
explanation_en: The pressure is transmitted to powder by fluid model. The pressure is applied in all directions like isostatic pressing, but faster than the speed. It is a new densification technology of powder materials developed in recent years, especially the cheap process of consolidating high-performance pre alloy powder into fully compacted parts. This method can repeatedly manufacture irregularly shaped parts with complex or simple shapes, making it suitable for manufacturing parts or preforms that are close to the final shape. During rapid omnidirectional pressing, the temperature of heating powder is low, and the product has very fine microstructure and excellent mechanical properties.

explanation_cn: 通过对液态金属或合金直接或间接的以高冷凝速率冷却制备得到的粉末。快速冷凝粉的制备工艺有雾化法和单辊双辊法。快速冷凝粉末颗粒具有亚稳结构，几乎无成分偏析，晶粒细化，且合金的固溶能力增大，甚至得到非晶态粉末。快速冷凝粉常见的有钛合金、铁合金等。
explanation_en: Powder prepared by cooling liquid metal or alloy directly or indirectly at a high condensation rate. The preparation technology of rapid soldified powder includes atomization method and single roll and double roll method. Rapid condensation powder particle have metastable structure, almost no segregation of components, refined grains, and the solid solution capacity of alloy increases, even amorphous powder is obtained. The common rapid soldified powder is titanium alloy, ferroalloy, etc.

explanation_cn: 通过强制传热，使合金熔液以很高的降温速率（比常规铸造凝固速率大得多，一般>lOmm/S)冷却的凝固过程。主要包括急冷凝同和大过冷凝固，前者通过设法减少同一时刻凝固的熔体量，增加与冷却介质之间的传热速率来提高凝固的冷速，雾化法制取粉末、熔体旋转法制取薄带均属急冷凝固。后者则设法在尽可能接近均匀形核的凝固条件下使熔体在远低于平衡熔点的温度下凝固，熔滴弥散法、电磁悬浮熔炼法等均为大过冷凝同方法。快速凝同可细化晶粒、相、有序畴等微观组织尺寸、减少成分偏析、形成新的亚稳相，通常可以改善材料的性能，还能制取在常规铸造条件下难以得到的高技术新材料。
explanation_en: The solidification process in which the alloy melt is cooled at a very high cooling rate (much higher than the solidification rate of conventional foundry, generally>lOmm/S) through forced heat transfer. It mainly includes rapid solidification and large undercooling solidification. The former increases the cooling rate of solidification by reducing the amount of melt solidified at the same time and increasing the heat transfer rate with the cooling medium. The atomization method for producing powder and the melt rotation method for producing thin strip are both rapid solidification. The latter tries to make the melt solidify at a temperature far lower than the equilibrium melting point under the solidification conditions as close to uniform nucleation as possible. The droplet dispersion method and electromagnetic levitation melting method are the same methods for large supercooling. Rapid solidification can refine the size of grains, phase, ordered domains and other microstructures, reduce segregation of components, and form new metastable phase, which can generally improve the performance of materials, and can also produce high-tech new materials that are difficult to obtain under conventional foundry conditions.

explanation_cn: 采用快速凝固技术制备的镁合金。相比常规铸锭冶金技术，快速凝固可以使镁合金的组织、结构和性能发生很大的改变，主要包括以下几个方面：①细化显微组织；②扩展α-Mg基固溶体的固溶度；③形成新的晶态相、准晶或是非晶相；④提高合金的力学强度和延展性；⑤改善合金的耐热和耐蚀性能。镁合金快速凝固的方法根据熔体分离和冷却方式的不同分为雾化技术、模冷技术和表面熔化与沉积技术3大类。根据不同的制备工艺，快速凝固镁合金产品可以是粉末、纤维、薄带和块体等，其中，粉末、纤维和薄带状等产品不能直接进行工程应用，必须通过破碎加工、粉末固结成型和塑性加工技术才能致密化为块体结构材料。为确保材料保留快速凝同组织的特性，要防止后续热加工过程中过饱和间溶体分解、沉淀相析出并迅速长大、细晶组织粗化、非晶或准晶相晶化等不利影响。
explanation_en: Magnesium alloy prepared by rapid solidification technology. Compared with conventional ingot casting metallurgy technology, rapid solidification can greatly change the structure, structure and properties of magnesium alloys, mainly including the following aspects: ① refine the microstructure; ② extend α- Solid solubility of Mg based solid solution; ③ Forming new crystalline phase, quasicrystalline or amorphous phase; ④ Improve the mechanical strength and ductility of alloy; ⑤ Improve the heat resistance and corrosion resistance of alloy. The methods of rapid solidification of magnesium alloys can be divided into three categories: atomization technology, mold cooling technology and surface melting and deposition technology according to different melt separation and cooling modes. According to different preparation processes, rapidly solidified magnesium alloy products can be powder, fibers, ribbons and blocks. Among them, powder, fibers, ribbons and other products cannot be directly used in engineering applications, and must be densified into block structural materials through crushing, powder consolidation molding and plastic forming technologies. In order to ensure that materials retain the characteristics of rapid solidification structure, it is necessary to prevent the disadvantageous effects of supersaturated solution decomposition, precipitation phase precipitation and rapid growth, fine grain structure coarsening, amorphous or quasicrystalline phase crystallization, etc. during the subsequent hot processing.

explanation_cn: 简称RTP。用极快的升温速率和在目标温度保温短暂的时间并快速冷却的热处理，其目的是降低热预算。商用的RTP系统一般是等温型的，通常采用非相干光源加热。这样，在半导体晶片的横向和纵向上引起的温度梯度最小。RTP能够显著减少杂质扩散，降低金属沾污概率，防止器件结构的变形和不必要的边缘效应，因此适合于制造特征线宽小的集成电路。RTP已经成为半导体器件工艺中重要的热处理技术，在离子注入后退火、接触合金化、化学气相沉积薄膜的致密化等方面有广泛的运用。在硅片制造领域，RTP可用于降低内吸杂工艺的热预算。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as RTP. The purpose of heat treatment is to reduce the heat budget by using extremely fast heating rate, holding at the target temperature for a short time and fast cooling. Commercial RTP systems are generally isothermal and typically heated using incoherent light sources. In this way, the temperature gradient caused in the transverse and longitudinal directions of the semiconductor chip is minimized. RTP can significantly reduce the diffusion of impurities, reduce the probability of metal contamination, prevent the deformation of device structure and unnecessary edge effects, so it is suitable for manufacturing integrated circuits with small characteristic linewidth. RTP has become an important heat treatment technology in semiconductor device technology, and has been widely used in annealing after ion implantation, contact alloy, densification of chemical vapor deposition films, etc. In the field of silicon wafer manufacturing, RTP can be used to reduce the thermal budget of the internal gettering process.

explanation_cn: 指在给予单剂量或多剂量受试物后24h内所引起的中毒效应，甚至死亡。
explanation_en: Refers to the toxic effect or even death caused within 24 hours after administering a single or multiple doses of the test substance.

explanation_cn: 在一定温度范围内，弹性模量几乎不随温度而变化的弹性合金，又称艾林瓦型合金。
explanation_en: In a certain temperature range, the elastic modulus of elasticity alloy almost does not change with temperature, also known as constant elastic alloy.

explanation_cn: 指以恒定的电流对电池进行充电。此法的优点是可以根据蓄电池的容量确定充电电流值，直接计算充电量并确定充电完成的时间。
explanation_en: Refers to charging a battery with a constant current. The advantage of this method is that the charging current value can be determined according to the capacity of the accumulator, the charging amount can be calculated directly and the charging completion time can be determined.

explanation_cn: 在一定磁场强度范围内，具有基本恒定磁导率的软磁合金。主要特点是，材料的磁滞回线呈扁平状，剩余磁 感应强度极低。某些铁镍系软磁合金，通过特殊处理 便可获得这种恒磁导率性质。
explanation_en: A soft magnetic alloy with a basically constant magnetic permeability within a certain range of magnetic field intensity. The main characteristics are that the magnetic hysteresis of materials is flat, and the residual magnetic induction intensity is extremely low. This constant permeability property can be obtained by special treatment for some iron nickel soft magnetic alloys.

explanation_cn: 以水为介质，将溶有引发剂的单体在水中分散成小液滴内进行的聚合反应。特点：①体系比较单纯，产物单纯千净尤其适用于制备透明产品;②由于液滴比表面积较大，水的比热容也比较大，故移热及控制温度均比本体聚合好，所得产物性能也因而有提高。聚合后产物成珠状，故亦称珠状或珍珠聚合。聚合一般在带搅拌的聚合釜中进行。此法只宜用于产物的玻璃化温度高于聚合温度的场合。此外，单体或共聚单体均应难溶于水，才能使产物维持规整的外形及一定的组成，使产品性能稳定。
explanation_en: Polymerization in which monomer dissolved with initiator is dispersed into small droplets in water as a medium. Features: ① The system is relatively simple, and the product is particularly suitable for preparing transparent products with pure purity; ② Due to the large specific surface of the droplets and the large specific heat [capacity of water, the heat transfer and temperature control are better than those of bulk polymerization, and the properties of the products obtained are also improved. After polymerization, the product becomes bead like, so it is also called bead like or pearl aggregation. Polymerization is generally carried out in polymerization kettle with stirring. This method can only be used where the glass transition temperature of the product is higher than the polymerization temperature. In addition, monomer or copolymerized monomer should be insoluble in water, so that the product can maintain a regular shape and certain composition, and make the product performance stable.

name_cn: 悬滴法表面张力和界面张力
name_en: surface tension by pendant drop method
explanation_cn: 当液滴在管口形成时，其形状与表面张力和界面张力存在一定的关系。悬滴法就是利用液滴外形测定表面张力和界面张力的一种方法。悬滴法是一种绝对的测量方法，它所作的假设有二：①液滴处于表面张力和重力的静力平衡;②悬滴呈中心轴对称。基于数字阁像的悬滴法唯一需要校正的，或者更准确地说，需要测量的是图像的放大倍数，这可通过对已知尺寸的、用来形成悬滴的毛线管/针管的图像的同时测量来获得，由此引入的系统误差可控制在0.1%左右。
explanation_en: When the droplet forms at the nozzle, its shape has a certain relationship with surface tension and interfacial tension. Suspended drop method is a method to measure surface tension and interfacial tension by using the shape of liquid drop. The hanging drop method is an absolute measurement method, which has two assumptions: ① the liquid drop is in the static balance of surface tension and gravity; ② The suspended droplets are symmetrical about the central axis. The only thing that needs to be corrected, or more accurately, measured is the magnification of the image, which can be obtained by simultaneously measuring the image of the known size of the yarn tube/needle tube used to form the hanging drop based on the digital cabinet image. The system error introduced by this can be controlled at around 0.1%.

explanation_cn: 以惯性约束高温等离子体实现的受控核聚变。由于惯性，高温等离子体飞散需要一定的时间，可利用这段时间来实现足够的聚变反应。
explanation_en: Controlled nuclear fusion achieved by inertial confinement of high-temperature plasma. Due to inertia, the dispersion of high-temperature plasma requires a certain amount of time, which can be utilized to achieve sufficient fusion reactions.

explanation_cn: 感光复合材料是指在光的作用下能迅速发生光化学反应，引起物理和化学变化的复合材料。其功能体通常有感光树脂和感光化合物两类。
explanation_en: Photosensitive composite refers to the composite materials that can rapidly undergo photochemical reaction under the action of light and cause physical and chemical changes. Its functional body usually includes photosensitive resin and photosensitive compound.

explanation_cn: 指感光材料对光线的化学反应速度[国际标准化组织（internationalstandardsorganization)规定]。感光度是制造胶片行业中感光速度的标准。感光度用特定的曝光、显影加工和光密度测量条件，并使其光密度达到一定数值时所需曝光量的倒数值来度量。
explanation_en: It refers to the chemical reaction rate of photographic materials to light [specified by the International Standards Organization]. Sensitivity is the speed standard in the film industry. Sensitivity is measured by the reciprocal value of the required exposure when the specific exposure, development processing and optical density measurement conditions are used to make the optical density reach a certain value.

explanation_cn: 用感光性树脂，经光照使其发生光交联、光聚合、光改性或光分解反应，经显影加工制成传递油墨至承印物上的印刷图文载体主要有感光性树脂平版、感光性树脂凸版、感光性树脂凹版和感光性丝网印刷版。
explanation_en: Photosensitive resin is used to produce photocrosslinking, photo polymerization, photo modification or photo decomposition reaction after illumination, and is developed to produce printing image and text carriers that transfer ink to the substrate, mainly including photosensitive resin lithography, photosensitive resin relief, photosensitive resin intaglio and photosensitive screen printing.

explanation_cn: 指某种含有光敏化合物及其他助剂的涂层材料。它对光敏感，并能在机器的帮助下完成以光传输的图像信息记录任务。
explanation_en: It refers to a coating materials containing photosensitive compounds and other additive. It is sensitive to light and can complete the task of recording image information transmitted through light with the help of machines.

explanation_cn: 通过感应电热效应作为加热方式的熔炼或加热保温设备，通常将用于熔炼的称为感应炉，而将由于加热保温的称为感应加热设备。感应炉由电源、感应圈和盛装物料的坩埚（无芯感应炉）或熔沟（有芯感应炉）组成。
explanation_en: Melting or heating insulation equipment that uses induction electrothermal effect as the heating method is usually called induction furnace for melting, and induction heating equipment for heating insulation. The induction furnace is composed of power supply, induction ring and crucible (coreless induction furnace) or melting ditch (cored induction furnace) for holding materials.

explanation_cn: 胶片对不同颜色光波的敏感程度，感色性的测定是指在一定的仪器条件和特定的光源条件下，测定感光胶片光谱响应的一种定性测量方法。通常利用摄谱仪使胶片同时接受整个感兴趣的波长范围的曝光，胶片前附有一个透过型的分级光楔或是连续光楔。曝光后的样片经显影加工后，即可直接看出胶片的感色性或光谱的响应情况。通常用来作比较，它是相对的和定性的。
explanation_en: The sensitivity of film to light waves of different colors. The determination of spectra response refers to a qualitative measurement method to determine the spectral response of photographic film under certain instrument conditions and specific light source conditions. Usually, a spectrograph is used to expose the film to the entire wavelength range of interest simultaneously, with a transparent graded or continuous wedge attached to the front of the film. After the exposed sample is developed, the spectra response or spectral response of the film can be seen directly. Usually used for comparison, it is relative and qualitative.

explanation_cn: 热中子堆内用作降低裂变快(中子)能量的材料。通常采用轻水、重水、石墨、铍和氦等氢元素材料。轻水慢化能力大，价格低廉.但吸收截面较大，对金属有腐蚀作用?易发生辐射分解。重水的吸收截面小，并可发生(γ.n)反应而为链式反应提供中子；缺点坫价格昂贵，还要细心防止泄漏损失、污染和与氢化物发生同位素交换。石墨的吸收截面低于重水，且价格便宜，又是耐高温材料，可用于非氧化气氛的高温堆中。铍等作慢化剂材料，铍的慢化能力比石墨好，用它作慢化剂可缩小堆芯尺寸，但铍有剧毒、价格昂贵、易产生辐照肿胀，故使用受到限制。
explanation_en: The materials used in thermal neutron reactor to reduce fission fast (neutron) energy. Hydrogen materials such as light water, heavy water, graphite, beryllium and helium are usually used. Light water has great moderating capacity and low price, but its absorption cross section is large, which can corrosion metals? It is prone to mdidysis. The absorption cross section of heavy water is small and can occur（ γ. n) Reactions provide neutrons for chain reactions; The disadvantage is that goblets are expensive and need to be careful to prevent leakage losses, pollution, and isotope exchange with hydrides. Graphite has a lower absorption cross section than heavy water, is cheap, and is a high-temperature resistant materials, which can be used in high-temperature reactor in non oxidizing atmosphere. As a moderator materials, beryllium has a better moderating ability than graphite, which can reduce the core size. However, beryllium is highly toxic, expensive, and prone to irradiation swelling, so its use is limited.

explanation_cn: 指长期接触低剂物或染毒对机体所致功能或结构形态的损害慢性性是衡量蓄积毒性的重要指标，也是制定卫生标准的重要资料。慢性毒性测定致畸性、致突变、致癌性。常涉及毒作用剂量、作用件质、靶器官、病损程度(可逆性或不逆性病变)及无害作用剂等。是预测人类在生活环境和生产环境中过量接触有害物质可能引起慢性危害的主要依据是指在受试动物至少10%的寿命期间内(如大鼠一般不少于90d)，一次或多次接触或给予受试物所引起的不良反应。
explanation_en: Chronic damage to the function or structural form of the body caused by long-term exposure to low dose substances or toxins is an important indicator for measuring cumulative toxicity and an important data for formulating health standards. Chronic toxicity: teratogenicity, mutagenicity and carcinogenicity. It often involves toxic dosage, substance of action, target organs, degree of damage (reversible or irreversible lesions), and harmless agents. The main basis for predicting the potential chronic harm caused by excessive exposure of humans to harmful substances in their living and production environments refers to the adverse reactions caused by one or more exposure or administration of the test substance during at least 10% of the lifespan of the test animal (generally not less than 90 days for rats).

explanation_cn: 相的成分保持不变而晶体结构发生改变的相变。
explanation_en: Phase transformation in which the composition of phase remains unchanged while the crystal structure changes.

explanation_cn: 材料中出现的成分的周期性波动，是结构相变理论中的一种表述。两金属元素组成合金时，不同原子在整个晶体内绝对随机排列只是一种理想情况，实际常出现局部原子簇聚（同类相邻）或短程序（异类相邻）。可用成分波描述此种局部的非随机性。
explanation_en: The periodic fluctuation of composition in materials is an expression in the theory of structural transformation. When two metal elements form a alloy, the absolute random arrangement of different atoms in the whole crystal is only an ideal situation. In fact, local atomic clustering (similar adjacent) or short order (dissimilar adjacent) often occurs. This local non randomness can be described by compositional wave.

explanation_cn: 又称模后收缩，是指聚合物成型脱模后冷却至室温.成型制品的尺寸小于模具型腔尺寸的现象。成型收缩程度与聚合物的特性、模具的结构、成型的工艺等条件有关。在聚合物模具设计时需要额外增加一部分尺寸余量用来补偿制品的成型收缩。成型收缩程度通常用成型收缩率来
explanation_en: Also called post mold shrinkage, it refers to the phenomenon that polymer is cooled to room temperature after demoulding, and the size of the molded product is smaller than the size of the mold cavity. The degree of molding shrinkage is related to the characteristics of polymer, mold structure, molding process and other conditions. When designing the polymer mold, it is necessary to add an additional part of the size allowance to compensate for the molding shrinkage of the product. The degree of molding shrinkage is usually determined by molding shrinkage

explanation_cn: 粉末压制后，压坯保持既定形状的能力。成形性用粉末能够成形的最小单位制压力表示，或者用压坯的强度表示。成形性的测定方法有矩形压坯法，圆柱形压坯法等。成形性受颗粒形状的影响最为明破，颗粒松软、形状不规则的粉末，压紧后颗粒的联接增强，成形性就好。
explanation_en: The ability of compact to maintain a given shape after pressing of powder. Formability is expressed by the minimum unit pressure that powder can form, or by the strength of compact. The measurement methods of formability include rectangular compact method, cylindrical compact method, etc. The formability is most obviously affected by the shape of the particles. The powder with soft particles and irregular shape will have better formability if the connection of the particles is strengthened after compaction.

explanation_cn: 成核剂是适用于聚乙烯、聚丙烯等不完全结晶塑料，通过改变树脂的结晶行为，加快结晶速率、增加结晶密度和促使晶粒尺寸微细化，达到缩短成型周期、提高制品透明性、表面光泽、抗拉强度、刚性、热变形温度、抗冲击性、抗蠕变性等物理机械性能的新功能助剂。成核剂作为聚合物的改性助剂，其作用机理主要是：在熔融状态下,由于成核剂提供所需的晶核，聚合物由原来的均相成核转变成异相成核，从而加速了结晶速度，使晶粒结构细化，并有利于提高产品的刚性，缩短成型周期，保持最终产品的尺寸稳定性，抑制光散射，改善透明性和表面光泽及聚合物的物理机械性能(如刚度、模量)，缩短加工周期等。而作为成核剂中重要的一类，透明剂的主要作用则是改善聚合物光学效果。我国对成核剂的研究、开发始于20世纪80年代，种类很多，现在实用且价格便宜和商品化的成核剂主要可分为无机成核剂、有机成核剂和高分子成核剂。此外，将PP中的α-晶型转变为β-晶型的转晶剂，通常也被归纳在成核剂中。
explanation_en: Nucleating agent is a new functional additive that is suitable for incomplete crystalline plastics such as polyethylene and polypropylene. It can shorten the molding cycle, improve the transparency, surface gloss, tensile strength, rigidity, heat deflection temperature, impact resistance, creep resistance and other physical and mechanical properties of products by changing the crystallization behavior of resin, accelerating the crystallization rate, increasing the crystallization density and promoting the grain size refinement. As a modifier of polymer, nucleator has the main mechanism of action: in the molten state, because nucleator provides the required nucleation, polymer is transformation from homogeneous nucleation to heterogeneous nucleation, which accelerates the crystallization rate, refines the grain structure, and is conducive to improving the rigidity of the product, shortening the molding cycle, maintaining the dimensional stability of the final product, inhibiting light scattering, Improve transparency, surface gloss and physical and mechanical properties (such as stiffness and modulus) of polymer, shorten processing cycle, etc. As an important kind of nucleating agent, transparent agent is mainly used to improve the optical effect of polymer. The research and development of nucleating agents in China began in the 1980s. There are many kinds of nucleating agents. Now, the practical, inexpensive and commercialized nucleating agents can be mainly divided into inorganic nucleating agents, organic nucleating agents and macromolecule nucleating agents. In addition, the α- The crystal form transformation into β- Crystalline crystal transfer agents are also generally included in nucleator.

explanation_cn: 能使聚合物制成满足适当要求、质量良好的纤维的性能。聚合物纺丝时必须在熔融时不分解，或能在普通溶剂中溶解制成溶液，具有一定的成纤能力并能得到有良好的综合性能、有实用价值的纤维。
explanation_en: It can enable polymer to be made into fiber with proper requirements and good quality. When spinning, polymer must not decompose during melting, or can be dissolved into solution in common solvent, which has certain fiber forming ability and can obtain fibers with good comprehensive performance and practical value.

explanation_cn: 由垂体和下丘脑分泌的多肽。有酸性(pI 5.6)和碱性(pI 9.6)两种。能促进成纤维细胞 有丝分裂、中胚层细胞的生长，还可刺激血管形成，在创伤愈合及肢体再生中发挥作用。有几种异构体，在动脉硬化灶中起作用的主要是bFGF（basic fibroblast growth factor），bFGF可以由内皮细胞、平滑肌细胞、巨噬细胞分泌。它的作用是促进内皮细胞的游走和平滑肌细胞的增殖，不能使平滑肌细胞游走。能够促进新血管形成，修复损害的内皮细胞。FGF被认为是病灶形成促进因子，但从修复角度看它也有有利的一面。
explanation_en: Peptides secreted by the pituitary gland and hypothalamus. There are two types: acidic (pI 5.6) and alkaline (pI 9.6). It can promote the mitosis of fibroblasts, the growth of mesodermal cells, irritation the formation of blood vessels, and play a role in wound healing and limb regeneration. There are several isomers, mainly bFGF (basic fibroblast growth factor), which plays a role in atherosclerotic lesions. bFGF can be secreted by endothelial cells, smooth muscle cells, and macrophages. Its function is to promote the migration of endothelial cells and the proliferation of smooth muscle cells, but not smooth muscle cells. It can promote the formation of new blood vessels and repair damaged endothelial cells. FGF is considered a promoting factor for lesion formation, but it also has advantages from a repair perspective.

explanation_cn: 彩色显影成色剂的简称。银盐彩色感光材料中，显影时能与彩色显影剂氧化产物反应而生成染料的有机物。主要用作感光乳剂添加剂，仅少数具有扩散性的成色剂，因不能在乳剂中固定，故加在彩色显影液中用以显色。
explanation_en: Short for color developing color coupler. In silver salt color photographic materials, the organic matter that can react with the oxidation product of color developer to generate dye or dyestuffc during development. It is mainly used as additive of photosensitive emulsion. Only a few color coupler with diffusion can be added to color developer for color development because they cannot be fixed in emulsion.

explanation_en: The stone separated from the stone mine can be added with T to become the proportion of quarry stone. Commonly expressed as a percentage of volume.

explanation_en: Glass with a large slope of absorption curve. The spectral curve does not show a transmission peak or absorption peak, but a continuous absorption K and transmission zone, with a large slope boundary between them, collectively referred to as the absorption limit or truncated wave line.

explanation_en: See ball propellant.

explanation_en: Also called photoactive polymer, a polymer whose macromolecule chain contains multiple chiral centers. If the configuration of each chiral center in the molecular chain is the same, this stereoregular polymer is called isotactic polymer: if the configuration of adjacent chiral carbon atoms is opposite and arranged alternately, it is a syndiotacticbolymer; If the configuration of each chiral center in the molecular chain is randomly arranged

explanation_cn: 手糊成型是一类以手工作业为主的复合材料制件成型方法.又称接触成型"在涂好脱模剂的模具t均匀地刷（或喷涂）一层树脂?然后手工铺放增强材料并涂刷树脂胶液.重复铺放涂胶步骤.直到所需厚度为止，然后进行固化成型。手糊成型用增强材料应易被树脂浸润，有一定几何变形性.主要有无捻粗纱布、加捻布、玻璃布带、短切毡及表面毡等。所用树脂要对增强材料冇良好的浸润性，黏度适宜（0.2?0.8Pa，s).常用的树脂是不饱和聚酯树脂和环氣树脂.其他树脂较少使用。其T艺特点是不需要专用设备，模具简单，投资少.牛.产技术简单易学，适于现场制备不宜运输的大型制品。其缺点是生产效率低，废料较多，不适合大批ft生产.产品质量高度依赖丨:人的操作水平.性能稳定性差，承载能力不高.气味大，粉尘大，生产环境差。主要用于不加压、单面光洁、室温固化的复合材料制件的成型，适于成嗤大尺寸、小批量、使用要求不高的产品，如渔船、游艇、大型建筑部件等。
explanation_en: Hand lay-up is a kind of molding method for composite materials parts mainly based on manual operation. Also known as contact molding, "evenly brush (or spray) the mold with releasing agent A layer of resin? Then manually lay reinforcement materials and apply resin glue solution. Repeat the steps of laying and applying glue until the required thickness is reached, and then conduct curing molding. Reinforcement materials for hand lay-up shall be easy to be soaked by resin and have certain geometric deformation, mainly including non twisted coarse gauze, twisted cloth, glass cloth tape, chopped felt and surface felt. The resin used should have good wettability to reinforcement materials, and the viscosity should be appropriate (0.2 ± 0.8 Pa, s). The commonly used resin is unsaturated polyester resin and annular resin. Other resin are seldom used. The characteristics of its technology are that it does not require specialized equipment, the mold is simple, the investment is low, and the production technology is simple and easy to learn, making it suitable for on-site preparation of large products that are not suitable for transportation. Its disadvantages are low production efficiency, a large amount of waste, which is not suitable for mass production. Product quality is highly dependent on human operation level, poor performance stability, low load-bearing capacity, strong odor, large dust, and poor production environment. It is mainly used for the molding of composite materials parts that are not pressurized, single-sided and smooth, and curing at room temperature. It is suitable for products with large size, small batch and low use requirements, such as fishing boats, yachts, large building parts, etc.

explanation_cn: C矿又称才里特。为硅酸盐水泥中化学组成在6CaO·2Al2O3·2Fe2O3(简称C6AF2)和6CaO·2Al2O3·Fe2O3(简称C6A2F)之间的铁铝酸盐晶体，平均组成为4CaO·Al2O3·Fe2O3(简称C4AF) 。矿物中的主要成分是铁铝酸盐矿物固溶体系列之一，又称钙铁石(C4AF)。
explanation_en: C mine is also called Cailite. It is a iron aluminate crystal with chemical composition between 6CaO · 2Al2O3 · 2Fe2O3 (C6AF2 for short) and 6CaO · 2Al2O3 · Fe2O3 (C6A2F for short) in Portland cement, and the average composition is 4CaO · Al2O3 · Fe2O3 (C4AF for short). The main component of the mineral is one of the solid solution series of iron aluminate minerals, also known as anorthite (C4AF).

explanation_cn: 利用打光机中的玻璃或玛瑙辑打磨皮革表面，使皮革表面紧实、平整光亮的操作。
explanation_en: The operation of polishing leather surface with glass or agate in polishing machine to make leather surface compact, smooth and bright.

explanation_cn: 在皮革的涂饰中采用了打光处理而得到的一种表面光泽好、表面粒纹清晰的皮革。
explanation_en: In the finishing of leather, glazing treatment is used to obtain a kind of leather with good surface gloss and clear surface grain.

explanation_cn: 是一种利用磁约束来实现受控核聚变的环形容器。它的名字Tokamak 来源于环形、真空室、磁、线圈。最初是由位于苏联莫斯科的库尔恰托夫研究所的阿齐莫维齐等人在20世纪50年代发明的。托卡马克的中央是一个环形的真空室，外面缠绕着线圈。在通电的时候托卡马克的内部会产生巨大的螺旋型磁场，将其中的等离子体加热到很高的温度，以达到核聚变的目的。
explanation_en: It is a circular container that utilizes magnetic constraints to achieve controlled nuclear fusion. Its name Tokamak comes from rings, vacuum chambers, magnets, and coils. Originally invented by Azimovich and others at the Kurchatov Institute in Moscow, Soviet Union, in the 1950s. In the center of the Tokamak is a circular vacuum chamber with coils wrapped around it. When the Tokamak is powered on, a huge spiral magnetic field will be generated inside the Tokamak to heat the plasma to a very high temperature for the purpose of nuclear fusion.

name_cn: 扩展X射线吸收精细结构
explanation_cn: 指物质X射线吸收谱中吸收限能量以上30-lOOOeV范围内吸收系数的振荡。由于X射线光子激发的光电子波与周围原子的散射波相互干涉，使电子向终态跃迁的概率随能量而变化，引起吸收系数的变化形成了EXAFS谱。不同元素的吸收限能量不同，通过改变入射X射线能量，可以测量指定种类原子的EXAFS谱。
explanation_en: It refers to the oscillation of the absorption coefficient within the range of 30-lOOOeV above the absorption limit energy in the X-ray absorption spectroscopy of the substance. Due to the interference between the photoelectron waves excited by X-ray photons and the scattered waves of surrounding atoms, the probability of electrons transitioning to the final state varies with energy, resulting in a change in absorption coefficient and forming the EXAFS spectrum. The absorption limit energy of different elements is different. By changing the incident X-ray energy, the EXAFS spectrum of specified types of atoms can be measured.

explanation_cn: 面心立方晶体中，能量最低的全位错1/2<110>在{111}面上分解为两个肖克莱不全位错。
explanation_en: In the face centered cubic crystal, the lowest energy total dislocation 1/2<110>decomposes into two Shockley partial dislocation on the {111} plane.

explanation_cn: 测量半导体材料微区电阻率的方法。该方法的空间分辨率通常可达到亚微米量级，若结合扫描探针显微技术，甚至可达纳米量级。一般地，将两根探针加压接触在经磨角和化学机械抛光的试样表面，形成欧姆接触。在探针间施加电压V,测得的电流为I。由于a和f的真实数值不易获得，为了获得电阻率，首先需要获得在某一探针状态下的校正曲线，即先测量一系列已知电阻率标样的扩展电阻，从而获得正曲线。依据这一校正曲线，测得待测样的扩展电阻后，即可得到相应的电阻率。因此，扩展电阻法是一种相对测量方法。扩展电阻法可用于测量硅外延片中外延层的电阻率和厚度、外延层和衬底之间过渡区的宽度以及半导体材料掺杂的微区均匀性，更是测量半导体器件中电活性杂质纵向分布的最重要手段。
explanation_en: A method for measuring the resistivity of semiconductor materials in micro areas. The spatial resolution of this method can usually reach submicron level, or even nanometer level if combined with scanning probe microscopy. Generally, the two probes are pressed to contact the surface of the sample after grinding and chemical mechanical polishing to form ohmic contact. Apply voltage V between the probes, and the measured current is I. Since the true values of a and f are not easy to obtain, in order to obtain resistivity, it is first necessary to obtain the correction curve under a certain probe state, that is, first measure the spreading resistance of a series of known resistivity standard samples to obtain the positive curve. According to this correction curve, the corresponding resistivity can be obtained after measuring the spreading resistance of the sample to be measured. Therefore, the spreading resistance is a relative measurement method. The spreading resistance can be used to measure the resistivity and thickness of the epitaxial layer of silicon epitaxial wafers, the width of the transition zone between the epitaxial layer and the substrate, and the uniformity of the micro area doped with semiconductor materials. It is also the most important means to measure the longitudinal distribution of electrically active impurities in semiconductor devices.

explanation_cn: 又称洛胀因子。髙分子在特定温度下溶剂中的尺寸与相同温度下θ状态时的尺寸的比值。常用的扩张因子包括均方根末端距之比，或均方根回转半径之比。根据不同尺寸定义的扩张因子一般不相等。扩张因子是无量纲量，它的值与温度、溶剂性质、溶液浓度、高分子链长有关，可表征高分子链的扩张程度，反应溶剂的优劣，良溶剂中扩张因子大于1。
explanation_en: Also known as the inflation factor. The size of high molecules in a solvent at a specific temperature is similar to that at the same temperature θ The ratio of dimensions in the state. Common expafision factor include the ratio of root-mean-square end-to-end distance, or the ratio of root mean square radius of gyratio. The expafision factor defined according to different sizes are generally unequal. The expafision factor is a dimensionless quantity. Its value is related to temperature, solvent property, solution concentration and macromolecule chain length. It can characterize the expansion degree of macromolecule chain and the advantages and disadvantages of reaction solvent. The expafision factor in good solvent is greater than 1.

explanation_cn: 由热振动引起的原子迁移现象。体系中由于化学浓度梯度而产生的物质宏观流称为化学扩散。通过物质输送达到系统化学成分上均匀；在没有化学浓度梯度下，仅仅由于热振动而产生的迁移过程称为自扩。此外，在温度梯度，应力场和电场作用下都可引起扩散。在自然界扩散是一相当普遍的现象。扩散系数（D)作为代表物质扩散快慢最基本的物理量，可由菲克定律给出。扩散现象的研究涉及材料科学中许多与原子运动有关的物理与化学过程，例如相变过程、化学过程动力学，同时也提供了晶体缺陷形成和运动所需能量的最基本的信息。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of atomic migration caused by thermal vibration. The macroscopic flow of substances due to chemical concentration gradient in the system is called chemical diffusion. Achieve uniform chemical composition of the system through material transportation; The migration process that occurs solely due to thermal vibration without a chemical concentration gradient is called self expansion. In addition, diffusion can be caused by temperature gradient, stress field and electric field. Diffusion is a very common phenomenon in nature. Diffusion coefficient (D), as the most basic physical quantity representing the speed of diffusion of matter, can be given by Fick's law. The study of diffusion phenomenon involves many physical and chemical processes related to atomic movement in materials science, such as phase transition process, chemical process dynamics, and also provides the most basic information about the energy required for the formation and movement of crystal defect.

explanation_cn: 在高温下蒸气压低的体系内，材料进行烧结时的传质规律。大多数固体材料由于高温下蒸气压低，传质更易通过固态内质点扩散过程来进行。在扩散传质中要达到颗粒中心距缩短必须有物质向气孔迁移，气孔作为空位源，进行反向迁移。颗粒点接触处的应力促使扩散传质中物质的定向迁移。扩散首先从空位浓度最大部位（颈表面）向空位浓度最低的部位（颗粒接触点）进行，其次是颈部向颗粒内部扩散?空位扩散即原子或离子的反向扩散。因此，扩散传质时，原子或离子由颗粒接触点向颈部迁移达到气孔充填的作用。从扩散传质的途径来看：扩散可以沿颗粒表面进行，也可以沿着两颗粒之间的界面进行或在晶粒内部进行，分别称为表面扩散、界面扩散和体积扩散。
explanation_en: In the system of low vapor pressure at high temperature, the mass transfer law of materials during sintering. For most solid materials, due to the low vapor pressure at high temperature, mass transfer is easier to be carried out through the diffusion process of solid internal particle. In diffusion mass transfer, in order to shorten the particle center distance, there must be material migration to the pores, and the pores, as the source of vacancy, conduct reverse migration. The stress at the contact of particles promotes the directional migration of matter in diffusion mass transfer. Diffusion starts from the position with the highest vacancy concentration (the neck surface) to the position with the lowest vacancy concentration (the particle contact point), followed by diffusion from the neck to the particle interior? Vacancy diffusion is the reverse diffusion of atoms or ions. Therefore, during diffusion mass transfer, atoms or ions migrate from the particle contact point to the neck to fill the pores. From the way of diffusion mass transfer: diffusion can be carried out along the particle surface, along the interface between two particles or in the grain, which are called surface diffusion, interface diffusion and volume diffusion respectively.

explanation_cn: 相变的进程（新相生长）需依靠扩散输运物质来维持的相变，新相生长的速度受扩散控制。扩散性相变分两类：一类是母相中的长程扩散，一类是界面近旁的短程扩散。前者称为扩散控制的生长，后者称为界面控制的生长。
explanation_en: The process of phase transformation (new phase growth) needs to rely on diffusion to transport substances to maintain the phase transformation, and the growth rate of new phase is controlled by diffusion. There are two types of diffusional transformation: one is the long-range diffusion in the parent phase, and the other is the short-range diffusion near the interface. The former is called diffusion controlled growth, and the latter is called interface controlled growth.

explanation_cn: 扩散系数与温度关系D=D0exp[―Q/(RT)]，式中指数上的能量Q，其量纲一般为kJ/mol。上式中的D0称为扩散常数，一般通过实验给出lgD对1/T为一线性关系，按照上式从一条截距为IgD0。斜率为一Q/R的直线很容易求出扩散激活能。一些金属的自扩散激活能与金属的熔点有着简单的关系Q=34Tm。通过扩散机制可以证明对bcc、fcc纯金属自扩散，Q=Hf+Hm，其中Hf，Hm分别表示空位形成和空位运动所引起的焓变。
explanation_en: The relationship between diffusion coefficient and temperature is D=D0exp [― Q/(RT)], where the energy Q on the index is generally kJ/mol. D0 in the above formula is called the diffusion constant. Generally, lgD is a linear relationship with 1/T through experiments. According to the above formula, an intercept is IgD0. It is easy to calculate the diffusion activation energy for a straight line with a slope of one Q/R. The activation energy of self-diffusion of some metals has a simple relationship with the melting point of metals Q=34Tm. Through the diffusion mechanism, it can be proved that for the self-diffusion of bcc and fcc pure metals, Q=Hf+Hm, where Hf and Hm respectively represent the enthalpy change caused by the formation of vacancy and the movement of vacancy.

explanation_cn: 在真空或保护气氛的保护下，使平整光洁的两焊接表面紧密贴合，在一定温度和压力下保持一定时间，使接触面发生微观塑性流变和原子相互扩散（或利用中间扩散层及过渡液相加速扩散过程）从而达到冶金连接的一种压焊方法。可分为不加中间层的固态扩散焊和填加中间层的液相扩散焊。焊接接头的形成取决于三个主要参数：温度、压力和给定温度及压力下的焊接时间。扩散焊接时，由于母材不过热或熔化，可以在不损坏被焊母材性能情况下，焊接几乎所有的金属和非金属材料，特別适合于焊接不同类型材料如异种金属、金属与陶瓷等冶金上完全互不相溶的材料，也应用于高温合金、钛及钛合金的焊接。
explanation_en: Under the protection of vacuum or protective atmosphere, the smooth and clean two weld surfaces can be closely fitted, and kept for a certain time under a certain temperature and pressure, so that micro plastic rheology and atomic mutual diffusion can occur on the contact surface (or the intermediate diffusion layer and transition liquid phase can accelerate the diffusion process) to achieve metallurgical connection. It can be divided into solid diffusion welding without intermediate layer and liquid diffusion welding with intermediate layer. The formation of weld joint depends on three main parameters: temperature, pressure and weld time under given temperature and pressure. During diffusion weld, since the base metal does not overheating or melt, almost all metal and non-metallic materials can be weld without damaging the properties of the base metal to be welded. It is especially suitable for weld different types of materials, such as dissimilar metals, metals and ceramics, and other materials that are completely incompatible with each other in metallurgy. It is also used for weld of high temperature alloy, titanium and titanium alloy.

explanation_cn: 扩散是由于热振动所引起原子的迁移。扩散理论涉及：①宏观理论，用扩散来描述宏观物质流动，而不是个別原子的移动；在Fick定律基础上，把物质扩散通量快慢与扩散系数大小联系起来，并通过不可逆过程热力学进一步描述扩散现象；②微观理论，给定原子跳跃方式-扩散机制，通过原子跃迁概率说明物质的扩散系数的实质，因此，对于不同组元扩散系数大小的测定，也有助于了解晶体中缺陷的存在状态、运动的规律。扩散现象也是一个相当普遍的现象。许多冶金过程中反应的快慢常常受到扩散的限制，例如金属与合金中的相变过程、氧化过程、烧结现象以及蠕变过程都受到原子在晶体中扩散所制约。扩散理论的发展，有助于对这些问题的理解。
explanation_en: Diffusion is the migration of atoms caused by thermal vibration. Diffusion theory involves: ① macro theory, which describes the flow of macro matter with diffusion rather than the movement of individual atoms; On the basis of Fick's law, the speed of diffusion flux of matter is related to the size of diffusion coefficient, and the diffusion phenomenon is further described through irreversible process thermodynamics; ② In microscopic theory, given the atomic jump mode - diffusion mechanism, the essence of the diffusion coefficient of matter is explained by the atomic transition probability. Therefore, the measurement of the diffusion coefficient of different components is also helpful to understand the existence state and movement law of defects in crystal. Diffusion is also a very common phenomenon. The speed of reaction in many metallurgical processes is often limited by diffusion, for example, the phase transformation process, oxidation process, sintering phenomenon and creep process in metals and alloy are all restricted by the diffusion of atoms in crystal. The development of diffusion theory is helpful to understand these problems.

explanation_cn: 见极谱法
explanation_en: See polarography

explanation_cn: 在纯金属中自扩散或代位式固溶体有置换原子参与的扩散中，原子离开它自己的点阵位置去填充邻近的空位，随着扩散的继续，就形成了原子和空位的逆向运动。在高温平衡状态下，晶体中包含有大量的空位点缺陷，这些空位在整个晶体内不断地移动，沿着运动的途径，每一个空位位移移置一个原子，因而在较长时间内使组元浓度发生了显著的变化。
explanation_en: In the self-diffusion of pure metals or the diffusion of substitutional solid solution with substitution atoms, the atom leaves its own lattice position to fill the adjacent vacancy. As the diffusion continues, the reverse movement of the atom and the vacancy is formed. In the high temperature equilibrium state, the crystal contains a large number of vacancy point defects. These vacancy move continuously throughout the crystal. Along the path of movement, each vacancy displaces an atom, thus causing significant changes in the component concentration in a long time.

explanation_cn: 两个相对运动表面间由于扩散引起的磨损。它主要出现在工具，特别是切削刀具上，是造成工具磨损的五种形式之一。被切削材料与刀具表面因摩擦热而局部处于很高温度，其接触面之间会因此而发生原子扩散，即刀具材料的原子向切屑或工件表面迁移，使它的成分和性能发生变化而引起刀面的逐渐磨损，扩散严重时甚至在刀尖上可以观察到黏着物。由于切屑与刀具正面接触部位发生摩擦，故在正刀面上会出现磨损凹坑，它也包括了扩散磨损所起的作用。WC-Co硬质合金刀具切削钢材时，因易与钢件产生扩散而比TiC及TaC刀具的磨损严重。在切削不锈钢、钛合金一类热导率低的材料时，扩散磨损是造成刀具损坏的重要原因之一。
explanation_en: Wear caused by diffusion between two relatively moving surfaces. It mainly appears on tools, especially cutting tools, and is one of the five forms of tool wear. The materials to be cut and the tool surface are locally at a very high temperature due to the friction heat, and atomic diffusion will occur between their contact surfaces, that is, the atoms of the tool materials will migrate to the chip or workpiece surface, making its composition and performance change, resulting in gradual wear of the tool surface. When the diffusion is serious, even the adhesive can be observed on the tool tip. Due to friction between the chip and the front contact part of the tool, wear pits will appear on the positive tool surface, which also includes the role of diffusion wear. WC Co hardmetal tools are more wear than TiC and TaC tools when cutting steel product because they are prone to diffusion with steel. Diffusion wear is one of the important reasons for tool damage when cutting materials with low thermal conductivity, such as stainless steel and titanium alloy.

explanation_cn: 部分扩散合金粉末是采用高压缩性铁粉与微细的纯合金元素或母合金粉末一起进行适当处理，使铁粉与微细合金元素粉末产生未进行充分扩散的极薄扩散层，因而不影响铁粉的压缩性。巾于合金元索在烧结前就黏结在铁粉颗粒表面上，因而在烧结时，合金元素可迅速扩散，提高均匀化程度。
explanation_en: Some diffusion alloy powder are properly treated with high compressibility iron powder and fine pure alloy elements or master alloy powder, so that iron powder and fine alloy element powder produce an extremely thin diffusion layer that is not fully diffusion, thus not affecting the compressibility of iron powder. The alloy elements are bonded to the surface of iron powder particles before sintering, so alloy elements can be rapidly diffusion during sintering to improve the degree of homogenization.

explanation_cn: 菲克第一定律中比例因子，通常以D表示。在固体中扩散系数也是一个结构敏感的物理量，晶体缺陷的存在对它的大小有着重要的影响。
