explanation_en: See pulling method.

explanation_cn: 又称为捻数，是表示复丝或纱线加捻程度的指标。不同品种和度量制所取的长度不同。棉及棉型化学短纤维采用特数(tex)制，捻度Tc，表示10cm纱线的捻回数；毛纺纱线及化纤长丝采用公制，捻度Tm，表示1m纱线的捻回数。加捻是将两根或两根以上长丝或纤维束沿轴向扭转，使它们相互缠绕成纱或线的过程。加捻后，原先平行于纤维轴线的纤维变成螺旋状，纱条的截面间产生相对的转动或角位移。每转动一周，即角位移360°，称为一个捻回。捻回的方向以螺旋线方向分别称为左捻或右捻（或称Z捻或S捻）。加捻使纱线获得一定的物理性质，如增加抱合力、耐磨性和抗疲劳性能等。
explanation_en: Also known as twist number, it is an indicator of twisting degree of multifilament or yarn. Different varieties and measurement systems take different lengths. Cotton and cotton type chemical staple fiber are made of tex, and twist Tc is the number of turns of 10cm yarn; Wool yarn and chemical fiber filamem adopt metric system, and twist Tm represents the twist number of 1m yarn. Twisting is the process of twisting two or more filamem or fiber bundles along the axial direction so that they can wind each other into yarn or thread. After twisting, the fibers that were originally parallel to the fiber axis become helical, causing relative rotation or angular displacement between the cross sections of the yarn. Every rotation, which means an angular displacement of 360 °, is called a twist. The direction of twisting back is called left twisting or right twisting (also known as Z twisting or S twisting) in the spiral direction. Twisting enables the yarn to obtain certain physical properties, such as increased cohesion, wear resistance and fatigue resistance.

explanation_cn: 高分子或链段在溶液中能有效排除其他髙分子或链段进入的体积。排除体积的大小取决于高分子链段间作用力以及高分子链段同溶剂之间的作用力-取决于溶剂的性质，因此排除体积可以表征溶剂的优劣。
explanation_en: Macromolecule or chain segment can effectively exclude the volume of other high molecules or chain segment in the solution. The size of excluded volume depends on the force between macromolecule chain segment and the force between macromolecule chain segment and solvent - depending on the nature of the solvent, so the excluded volume can characterize the advantages and disadvantages of the solvent.

explanation_cn: 临床上置于龈沟白使游离牙龈缘远离牙齿表面以便修复操作的线状材料。排龈材料有多种类型，如编织排龈线、双股搓捻排龈线及添加药剂的排龈线等。编织排龈线因具备更好的止血、扩张及干燥龈沟作用，且易从出血块上取出等特点而被广泛应用。临床使用目的是：①牙体预备前排龈可以减少在预备龈下肩台时对临近软组织的损伤及出血，为龈下牙体预备提供良好空间和视野；②取模前排龈可帮助获得更清晰的印模及模i型；③黏结时排龈有利于提高黏结效果，去除剩余黏结剂，预防边缘微漏的发生及牙龈炎症。使用方法是：萏先干燥隔湿基牙，选用与龈沟宽度一致的排龈线，用牙周探针或专用排龈器将其按顺时针或逆时针顺序压入基牙与游离牙龈间，使牙龈向侧方及根尖向移动。若遇牙龈出血，可在排龈线安置就位后蘸上少量止血剂。
explanation_en: Clinically, a linear material placed in the gingival sulcus to keep the free gingival margin away from the surface of the teeth for repair operations. There are many types of gingival retraction materials, such as braided gingival retraction thread, double twisted gingival retraction thread and medicated gingival retraction thread. Knitted gingival suture is widely used due to its better hemostasis, dilation, and drying effect on the gingival sulcus, as well as its easy removal from the bleeding block. The purpose of clinical use is: ① The front gingiva of dental preparation can reduce damage and bleeding to adjacent soft tissues during preparation of the subgingival shoulder, providing a good space and field of view for subgingival dental preparation; ② Removing the front gingiva of the mold can help obtain a clearer impression and mold shape; ③ Gingival retraction during bonding is conducive to improving the bonding effect, removing the remaining adhesive, and preventing the occurrence of marginal microleakage and gingivitis. The method of use is to dry and isolate the wet abutment first, select a gingival line that is consistent with the width of the gingival sulcus, and use a periodontal probe or specialized gingival remover to press it clockwise or counterclockwise between the abutment and the free gingiva, so that the gingiva moves laterally and apically. If there is gum bleeding, a small amount of hemostatic agent can be dipped in after the gingival line is placed in place.

explanation_cn: 见共聚物。
explanation_en: See copolymer.

explanation_cn: 天然橡胶通过与烯烃类单体接枝聚合得到的接枝共聚物。通过接枝共聚反应可对天然橡胶进行化学修饰得到具有指定性能的接枝共聚物，从而改善天然橡胶制品的综合性能、拓宽其应用领域。用于天然橡胶接枝的单体主要有丙烯酸酯类、马来酸酐、苯乙烯、丙烯腈、醋 酸乙烯酯、丙烯酸、丙烯酰胺等。
explanation_en: Natural rubber is a graft copolymer obtained by grafting polymerization with olefin monomer. Through graft copolymerization, natural rubber can be chemically modified to obtain graft copolymer with specified properties, thereby improving the comprehensive properties of natural rubber products and broadening their application fields. The monomer used for grafting natural rubber mainly include acrylate, maleic anhydride, styrene, acrylonitrile, vinyl acetate, acrylic acid, acrylamide, etc.

explanation_cn: 聚合物主链上已被接枝的接枝点数与所有可被接枝的接枝点总数之比。
explanation_en: The ratio of the number of grafted points on the main chain of polymer to the total number of grafting site that can be grafted.

explanation_cn: 通过在基体材料及高分子链上接枝引入特定结构.以改变其性质的方法。例如，在聚乳酸、羟基磷灰石等生物材料表面接枝引入胶原，可提高材料的生物相容性。
explanation_en: It is a method to change the properties of matrix materials and macromolecule by introducing a specific structure onto the chain. For example, the introduction of collagen onto the surface of biological materials such as polylactic acid and hydroxyapatite can improve the biocompatibility of materials.

explanation_cn: 接枝在高分子主链上的单体占聚合单体的质量分数。
explanation_en: The monomer grafted on the main chain of macromolecule accounts for the mass fraction of polymerization monomer.

explanation_cn: 接枝共聚物中主链与侧链分支的连接点。
explanation_en: The connection point of main chain and side chain branch in graft copolymer.

explanation_cn: 在聚丙烯主链上通过化学反应引入极性组分或其他功能性组分的 热塑性聚烯烃。常用的方法有溶液接枝法、熔融接 枝法、辐射和光引发接枝法、高温热接枝法、气相 接枝法、同相接枝法，其中溶液接枝法和熔融接枝法是目前最常用的方法。
explanation_en: Thermoplastic polyolefin that introduces polar components or other functional components into the main chain of polypropylene through chemical reaction. The commonly used methods are solution grafting, melt grafting, radiation and photoinduced grafting, high-temperature thermal grafting, gas phase grafting, and in-phase grafting. Among them, solution grafting and melt grafting are the most commonly used methods.

explanation_cn: 一种具有较大初粘力的胶黏剂。通常由溶于有机溶剂的橡胶制成，涂胶后待溶剂挥发，合在一起压紧随即黏牢.无需保持压力。如黏内胎用的胶水和通用的氯丁胶浆，
explanation_en: A adhesive with large initial adhesion. It is usually made of rubber dissolved in organic solvent. After gluing, the solvent volatilizes, and then it is pressed together and then stuck firmly without maintaining pressure. For example, the adhesive used for sticking the inner tube and the general chloroprene adhesive,

explanation_cn: 摩擦副两对偶表面做滚动或滚滑复合运动时，由于交变接触应力 的作用，使表面材料疲劳断裂而形成点蚀或剥落的现象。
explanation_en: When the two pairs of surfaces of the friction pair are rolling or rolling sliding, the surface materials fatigue fracture will form pitting corrosion or peeling due to the effect of alternating contact stress.

explanation_cn: 又称电偶腐蚀、异金属腐浊。当两种不同的金属或合金在介质中相偶 接触电位较负的金属腐蚀速率加大，而电位较正的金属受到保护。
explanation_en: It is also called galvanic corrosion and heterogeneous metal corrosion. When two different metals or alloy are coupled in the medium, the corrosion rate of the metal with negative contact potential increases, while the metal with positive potential is protected.

explanation_cn: 胶黏剂在轻微压力下经短暂接触后对表面发生黏附的能力。
explanation_en: The ability of adhesive to adhere to the surface after a short contact under slight pressure.

explanation_cn: 用于固定骨折和连结碎骨的医用金属丝。通常为奥氏体不锈钢。用于髌骨、尺骨鹰嘴骨折的固定，短骨的斜行骨折的固定或其他内固定术。
explanation_en: Medical metal wire used to fix fractures and connect broken bones. Usually austenilic stainless steel. Used for fixation of patellar and ulnar olecranon fractures, fixation of oblique fractures of short bones, or other internal fixation techniques.

explanation_cn: 反应堆内影响反应性的可移动部件，用于反应堆控制。由于结构、强度或相容性等问题，控制材料除铪外，几乎都需要包覆以结构材料。控制元件与燃料元件一样，常制成组件的形式。控制元件设计时，应考虑：①材料的核性能，控制材料的中子吸收截面要大，散射截面要小，以保证到达控制元件的中子被吸收掉而不被反射回去；控制材料应有足够的装量，以保证其寿期内对于热中子都是黑体，控制材料吸收中子后的子体的吸收截面越大越好；结构材料的散射載面应尽可能小。②控制元件的及何形状取决于控制元件的值和中子在堆芯中的扩散长度；一般说小，扩散长度短时，控制元件的表面积应该发达一些；控制元件的几何形状有棒状、板状及十字形等。③材料的力学性能和辐照稳定性。④抗腐蚀能力和相容性。⑤加工性能。⑥价格低，易于获得。
explanation_en: A movable component within a reactor that affects reactivity and is used for reactor control. Due to the problems of structure, strength or compatibility, almost all control materials except hafnium need to be coated with structural materials. Like fuel element, control element is often made into an assembly. When designing the control element, the following should be considered: ① the nuclear performance of materials. The neutron absorption cross section of control materials should be large and the scattering cross section should be small to ensure that the neutrons arriving at the control element are absorbed and not reflected back; The control materials shall have sufficient inventory to ensure that it is black body for thermal neutrons during its service life. The larger the absorption cross section of the daughter of control materials after absorbing neutrons, the better; The scattering load surface of structural materials shall be as small as possible. ② The shape of control element depends on the value of control element and the diffusion length of neutron in the core; Generally speaking, if the diffusion length is short, the surface area of control element should be developed; The geometric shapes of control element are bar, plate and cross. ③ Mechanical properties and irradiation stability of materials. ④ Corrosion resistance and compatibility. ⑤ Processing performance. ⑥ Low price, easy to obtain.

explanation_cn: 又称中子吸收材料，能显著吸收中子、有效控制核反应堆反应性的材料。分为控制棒材料、化学补偿剂和可燃毒物三类。控制棒是中子强吸收体，移动速度快、操作可靠、使用灵活、控制反应性准确度高。控制棒是堆芯紧急控制和功率调节所不可缺少的部件。主要控制反应性快速变化。对控制棒材料的要求主要有：大的中子吸收截面，如铪、银-铟-镉合金；抗辐照、抗腐蚀和良好的力学性能等。对化学补偿剂的要求有：能溶解于冷却剂，化学及物理性质稳定，有较大的吸收截面。对堆芯结构部件无腐蚀性且不吸附在部件上。硼酸可满足上述要求。作为可燃毒物主要元素有硼和钆。在压水堆中应用最广泛的是硼玻璃，在堆芯寿期末，硼基本上被烧尽。留下的玻璃吸收截面比较小，对堆芯寿期的影响不大。
explanation_en: Also known as neutron absorbing material, it is a materials that can significantly absorb neutrons and effectively control the reactivity of nuclear reactor. It is divided into three categories: control rod materials, chemical compensating agent and combustible poison. The control rod is a strong neutron absorber with fast movement speed, reliable operation, flexible use, and high control reactivity accuracy. The control rod is an indispensable component for emergency control and power regulation in the reactor core. Mainly controlling rapid changes in reactivity. The main requirements for control rod materials are: large neutron absorption cross section, such as hafnium, silver-indium-cadmium alloy; Anti radiation, anti corrosion and good mechanical properties. The requirements for chemical compensation agents include solubility in the coolant, stable chemical and physical properties, and a large absorption cross-section. It is non corrosive to the core structural components and does not adhere to the components. Boric acid can meet the above requirements. The main elements used as combustible toxins include boron and gadolinium. Boron glass is the most widely used in PWR. At the end of core life, boron is basically burned out. The left glass absorption section is relatively small, which has little impact on the core life.

explanation_cn: 燃料组件骨架中供控制棒、可燃毒物或中子源棒、阻流塞棒插入的管件。具有为控制棒运动提供导向和为控制棒下落提供缓冲的功能。采用锆-铌合金材料，这种合金在反应堆内的低腐蚀和低吸氢性能，使组件在高燃耗下仍能保持良好的机械强度和尺寸稳定性。
explanation_en: The pipe fittings in the fuel assembly framework for the insertion of control rods, burnable poisons or neutron source rods, and choke rods. It has the function of providing guidance for control rod movement and buffering for control rod drop. Zirconium niobium alloy alloy materials is used. This alloy has low corrosion and low hydrogen absorption performance in the reactor, so that the module can still maintain good mechanical strength and dimensional stability under high fuel consumption.

explanation_cn: 反应堆内用于控制核裂变反应速率的可移动的集合构件。通常由不同几何形状（如棒、片、球状）的控制元件组成。更多参见控制材料。
explanation_en: A movable assembly component within a reactor used to control the rate of nuclear fission reaction. It usually consists of control element with different geometric shapes (such as rod, sheet, ball). See control materials for more information.

explanation_cn: 构成控制释放体系的聚合物薄膜。控制释放体系可区分为：在扩散控制体系中使用无孔的均质膜，物质的释放速度决定其与膜的溶解扩散速度，并可根据物质的亲水性和疏水性调整膜材料的亲水性和疏水性以控制物质的释放速度，所以使用纤维素衍生物，甲基丙烯酸酯及其羟基酯的均聚物或共聚物、聚乙烯醇与N-乙烯基吡咯烷酮共聚物、聚硅氧烷、乙烯醋酸乙烯酯共聚物等，但膜厚度的影响也很重要。在化学反应控制体系中，使用的是可降解的聚合物，物质分散或接枝于聚合物中，物质的释放速度决定于pH值、水解、酶解速度。聚合物有多肽类、聚酶类、聚原酸酶类、聚缩醛类、多糖类、聚氰基丙烯酸甲酯等。在溶剂化控制体系中，使用的是多孔聚合物膜或可被溶胀的聚合物膜。物质的释放速度决定于孔径大小、孔密度。传递介质经膜孔进人药物核心，以同样方式渗透释放等体积含有药物的溶液，以纤维素为基础的多层膜制成微渗透录。在溶胀控制释放体系中，聚合物薄膜只能被介质溶胀，物质经溶胀的聚合物膜向外扩散，物质的控制释放速度决定于聚合物膜的溶胀程度和物质的渗透扩散速度。可使用半结晶或轻度交联的聚合物为基材，如甲基丙烯酸乙酯和甲基丙烯酸甲酯的共聚物、EVA共聚物、交联聚乙烯醇等。在磁控制释放体系中，一般在乙烯醋酸乙烯酯共聚物基材中分散高分子量药物和磁性粒子，在外部磁场的振荡或永久磁场的影响下，由磁场控制物质的释放。随控制体系的不同对聚合物膜有不同的要求，但稳定的物理和化学性质，良好的加工性能和生物相容性是控制释放膜的基本要求。控制释放速度受膜材料性质、膜结构、膜孔径和孔密度的影响。控制释放膜可用于医药、农药、化肥、除草剂、香料等方面的控制释放体系，特別是药物的控制释放体系可经不同途径，如口服、透过皮肤、埋置于皮下或某些器官内等，使用范围广，有很好的疗效和经济价值。
explanation_en: Polymer film forming controlled release system. The controlled release system can be divided into: the porous homogeneous membrane is used in the diffusion control system. The release rate of the substance determines its dissolution and diffusion rate with the membrane, and the hydrophilicity and hydrophobicity of the membrane materials can be adjusted according to the hydrophilicity and hydrophobicity of the substance to control the release rate of the substance. Therefore, cellulose derivatives, homopolymer or copolymer of methacrylate and its hydroxyl ester, polyvinyl alcohol and N-vinylpyrrolidone copolymer Polysiloxane, vinyl acetate copolymer, etc., but the influence of film thickness is also very important. In the chemical reaction control system, degradation polymer is used. The substance is dispersed or grafted into the polymer. The release rate of the substance depends on the pH value, hydrolysis, and enzymolysis rate. Polymer include polypeptides, polyenzymes, polygenases, polyacetals, polysaccharides, and polymethyl cyanoacrylate. In the solvation control system, porous polymer membranes or swelling polymer membranes are used. The release rate of substances depends on the pore size and density. The transfer medium enters the drug core through the membrane pore, and penetrates and releases the solution containing drugs in the same volume in the same way. The cellulose based multilayer membrane is made into micro osmotic recording. In the swelling controlled release system, the polymer film can only be swelling by the medium, and the substance is diffusion outward through the swelling polymer film. The controlled release speed of the substance is determined by the swelling degree of the polymer film and the permeation diffusion speed of the substance. Semi crystalline or slightly crosslinking polymer can be used as substrates, such as copolymer of ethyl methacrylate and methyl methacrylate, EVA copolymer, crosslinking polyvinyl alcohol, etc. In the magnetic controlled release system, macromolecule weight drugs and magnetic particles are generally dispersed in the vinyl acetate copolymer substrate. Under the influence of the external magnetic field oscillation or permanent magnetic field, the magnetic field controls the release of substances. Different control systems have different requirements for polymer membranes, but stable physical and chemical properties, good processing performance and biocompatibility are the basic requirements for controlled released membrane. The controlled release rate is affected by the properties of membrane materials, membrane structure, membrane pore size and pore density. The controlled released membrane can be used in the controlled release system of medicine, pesticides, fertilizers, herbicides, spices and other aspects. In particular, the controlled release system of drugs can be used in different ways, such as oral administration, through the skin, buried under the skin or in some organs. It has a wide range of use and good curative effect and economic value.

name_en: pressure sensitivity coefficient of propellant to temperature
explanation_cn: 火箭发动机内装药喉面比(KN)确定的条件下，推进剂初温变化1K时，燃烧室内压力的相对变化量，通常以7TK表示。是火箭发动机设L1JKN计的重要参数之一。
explanation_en: Under the condition that the throat area ratio (KN) of the charge in the rocket engine is determined, when the initial temperature of the propellant changes 1K, the relative change of pressure in the combustion chamber is usually expressed as 7TK. It is one of the important parameters for designing L1JKN meters in rocket engines.

explanation_cn: 黏弹性材料端变过程的松弛时间t，有时称为推迟时间.表示形变推迟发生的意思，是蠕变柔量发展到平衡蠕变柔量的(约63.2%)所需的时间。
explanation_en: The relaxation time t of the end deformation process of viscoelasticity materials is sometimes called the retardation time. It means that deformation is delayed, and it is the time required for creep compliance to develop to equilibrium creep compliance (about 63.2%).

explanation_cn: 在一种基质材料中，掺人少量其他元素或化合物，以使基质材料产生特定的电学、磁学和光学性能等物理性能，从而具有实际应用价值或特定用途的材料叫作掺杂材料。
explanation_en: In a matrix materials, a small amount of other elements or compounds are doped to make the matrix materials produce specific electrical, magnetic and optical properties and other physical properties, so that the materials with practical application value or specific use is called doped materials.

explanation_cn: 由材料相同但掺杂类型不同的薄层交替t复组成的超品格，实际上在n型层与p型层之间还有一个本征层i,因此又称为nipi晶格其特点是电子只能聚集在n型区而空穴聚集在P型区.是一种典型的真实空间间接带隙半导体。电子和空穴的分离很彻底，从而使非平衡载流子的复合寿命特别长，电子和空穴的浓度在大范围内nf调。掺杂超晶格不存在晶格卩C.配问题，对原材料几乎没有限制。
explanation_en: The superlattice consists of alternating thin layers of t complex with the same materials but different doping types. In fact, there is an intrinsic layer i between the n-type layer and the p-type layer, so it is also called nipi lattice. Its characteristic is that electrons can only gather in the n-type region and holes gather in the P-type region. It is a typical real space indirect band gap semiconductor. The separation of electrons and holes is very thorough, so that the composition life of non-equilibrium carriers is particularly long, and the concentration of electrons and holes is nf adjusted in a large range. Doping superlattice have no lattice matching problem and almost no restrictions on raw materials.

explanation_en: See non-sag tungsten wire.

explanation_cn: 高温钼，是指在钼中掺杂Si、Al、K氧化物制成的钼合金。掺杂钼在高温材料领域里愈来愈多地取代金属钼，如高温炉的发热体、隔热屏、钼舟、电子管中的支架、引线等。
explanation_en: High-temperature molybdenum refers to molybdenum alloy made by doping Si, Al and K oxides into molybdenum. Doped molybdenum is increasingly replacing metal molybdenum in the field of high-temperature materials, such as heater, heat shield, molybdenum boat, stem and leads in electronic tubes of high-temperature furnaces.

explanation_cn: 掺有Al，Ga，P，Pb，Cr，Nd，Zn，Fe，Eu等的锗酸铋晶体。其中Al，Ga，P的掺杂可以使锗酸铋晶体退色，并可以增强其暗场传导性能。
explanation_en: Bismuth germanate crystals doped with Al, Ga, P, Pb, Cr, Nd, Zn, Fe, Eu, etc. The doping of Al, Ga and P can discolor bismuth germinate crystal and enhance its dark field conductivity.

explanation_cn: 属四方晶系，白钨矿结构。空间群，光学上属单轴晶，物理性能和激光性能呈现各向异性。
explanation_en: It belongs to tetragonal system with scheelite structure. The space group is optically uniaxial, and its physical properties and laser properties are anisotropic.

explanation_cn: 萤石结构，属立方晶系，因易于生长成大尺寸单晶吗，以及突光寿命长达毫秒级而储能高等特性使氟化钙晶体成为强激光材料的预选对象之一。
explanation_en: The fluorite structure belongs to the cubic crystal system. Because it is easy to grow into large single crystal, and its light burst life is up to millisecond, and its high energy storage characteristics make the calcium fluoride crystal one of the preselected objects of strong laser materials.

explanation_cn: 具有磷灰石结构，属六方晶系，空间群。一般用提拉法生长。此种晶体导热率低，质脆而裂，须小心加工。特点是单线荧光分支比大，激光阈值低，效率高。
explanation_en: It has apatite structure, belongs to hexagonal system and space group. Generally, it grows by pulling method method. This kind of crystal has low thermal conductivity and is brittle and cracked, so it must be carefully processed. It is characterized by large single line fluorescence branching ratio, low laser threshold value and high efficiency.

explanation_cn: 在氧化镥基质中掺入少量的钕激活离子形成的激光晶体。稀土氧化物系列晶体具有优良的热学性能、力学性能和光谱性能，是一种优质的激光基质材料。掺钕氧化镥晶体属于立方晶系，方铁锰矿结构。
explanation_en: A laser crystal is formed by doping a small amount of neodymium activated ions into lutetium oxide matrix. Rare earth oxide series crystal have excellent thermal, mechanical and spectral properties, and are a high-quality laser matrix materials. The Nd-doped lutetium oxide crystal belongs to the cubic crystal system, with square iron manganese structure.

explanation_cn: 以钕为激活离子的激光器玻璃。激光玻璃发展初期，以高能输出为主，以发展用于激光等离子体研究和惯性约束核聚变的高功率激光系统为主要方向。掺钕激光玻璃同时用于中小输出激光器，在材料加工、医学、农业等方面获得应用。
explanation_en: Laser glass with neodymium as the active ion. At the early stage of the development of laser glass, the main direction was to develop high-power laser systems for laser plasma research and inertial confinement fusion. Neodymium doped laser glass is also used for small and medium-sized output lasers, and has been applied in materials processing, medicine, agriculture, etc.

name_en: neodymium doped yttrium aluminate garnet crystal
explanation_cn: 这类晶体物理、化学性能稳定，力学性能、激光性能优良，是迄今最优良、使用最普遍的一种激光晶体。利用模选和单频技术已得到衍射极限的基横模激光和光谱宽度极窄的单频激光，而且这种激光器可靠性好、寿命长、器件结构紧凑。
explanation_en: This kind of crystal has stable physical and chemical properties, excellent mechanical properties and laser properties. It is the most excellent and widely used laser crystal so far. The use of mode selection and single frequency technology has resulted in diffraction limited fundamental transverse mode lasers and extremely narrow spectral width single frequency lasers, with good reliability, long lifespan, and compact device structure.

name_en: neodymium doped gadolinium gallium garnet crystal
explanation_cn: 立方晶系，石榴石结构，与NdYAG晶体相比，能够得到掺钦浓度更高、均匀性优良的大晶体。
explanation_en: Cubic crystal system, gamet structure, compared with NdYAG crystal, large crystal with higher doping concentration and excellent uniformity can be obtained.

explanation_cn: 掺钕钒酸钇激光晶体t系错英石结构单品体。
explanation_en: Nd-doped yttrium vanadate laser crystalk t is a single crystal with cristobalite structure.

explanation_cn: 具有白钨矿型结构，属四方晶系。
explanation_en: It has scheelite type structure and belongs to tetragonal crystal system.

explanation_cn: 属正交晶系，钙钛矿结构。用提拉法生长单晶，物理性能和激光性能的各向异性性。这种晶体是1300nm波段高功率连续和大能量脉冲激光器以及双波长连续和脉冲激光器的最佳晶体之一。
explanation_en: It belongs to the orthorhombic crystal system and has a perovskite structure. The anisotropy of physical properties and laser properties of single crystal grown by pulling method method. This crystal is one of the best crystal for 1300 nm high power CW and high energy pulsed lasers and dual wavelength CW and pulsed lasers.

explanation_cn: 在刚玉（A1203)晶体中掺人一定量的Ti3+而获得的一种激光晶体。该激光器的能量参数及光谱参数适用于很多光谱应用.特别是腔内光谱学。在工业、科研中占有重要地位。
explanation_en: A laser crystal obtained by doping a certain amount of Ti3+into corundum (A1203) crystal. The energy and spectral parameters of this laser are suitable for many spectral applications, especially intracavity spectroscopy. It holds an important position in industry and scientific research.

explanation_cn: 掺钛蓝宝石激光器中产生自锁模的主要因素是由增益介质非线性克尔效应引起的自振幅调制、自相位调制和时域的色散。
explanation_en: Self amplitude modulation, self phase modulation and time-domain dispersion caused by nonlinear Kerr effect of gain medium are the main factors that cause self mode locking in Ti: sapphire lasers.

explanation_cn: 在氟化镁基质晶体中掺入少量钴而形成的可调谐激光晶体。
explanation_en: A tunable laser crystal is formed by doping a small amount of cobalt into the magnesium fluoride matrix crystal.

explanation_cn: 闪烁晶体以其高光输出、快发光衰减、密度大等特性引起国际闪烁晶体界极大关注，并且物化性质稳定、不潮解、对Y射线探测效率高，被认为是综合性能最好的无机闪烁晶体材料，在高能物理、核物理、油井钻探、安全检査、环境检查等领域也具有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: Scintillation crystal has attracted great attention from the international scintillation crystal community because of its high light output, fast luminescence attenuation, high density and other characteristics. It is also considered as the best inorganic scintillation crystal materials with the best comprehensive performance, and has extensive applications in high-energy physics, nuclear physics, oil well drilling, safety inspection, environmental inspection and other fields.

explanation_cn: 属立方晶系，石榴石型结构，晶体的生长方法主要有提拉法和温梯法。
explanation_en: It belongs to cubic crystal system and garnet type structure. The growth methods of crystal mainly include pulling method method and temperature gradient method.

name_en: sodiurn iodide activated by thallium NaI:Tl
explanation_cn: 单晶，立方晶系。除用作放射线闪烁体之外，大量应用于X射线增强管，近来发展用于X射线计算断层扫描检出器用荧光粉。
explanation_en: Single crystal, cubic system. In addition to being used as a radioactive scintillator, it is widely used in X-ray enhancement tubes, and recently developed as phosphor for X-ray computed tomography detector.

name_cn: 掺铬氟化铝锂钙激光晶体
name_en: Cr-dopcd lithium calcium aluminum fluoride laser crystal
explanation_cn: 掺铬氟化铝锂钙激光晶体，一种可调谐激光晶体，晶体断面坚硬，发射谱吸收带为红光和漾光区，优点是其激发态吸收很小，晶体中铬离子的分凝系数接近I?掺铬浓度高且容易掺杂均匀而具有高激光效率。晶体因具有宽增益带宽，长荧光寿命和大的发射截面积而使〇CAF间体激光器可应用于激光测距、照明、激光雷达、海下通信（可倍频到蓝光）、光谱学研究以及泵浦：其他激光器。
explanation_en: Cr-dopcd lithium calcium aluminum fluoride laser crystal is a tunable laser crystal. The crystal section is hard, and the emission spectrum absorption band is red and rippling. The advantage is that its excited state absorption is very small, and the segregation coefficient of chromium ions in the crystal is close to I? High chromium doping concentration and easy uniformity of doping result in high laser efficiency. Due to the wide gain bandwidth, long fluorescence lifetime and large emission cross section of crystal, 〇 CAF interbody laser can be used in laser ranging, lighting, lidar, underwater communication (frequency doubling to blue light), spectroscopy research and pumping: other lasers.

name_cn: 掺铬氟化铝锶锂激光晶体
name_en: Cr-doped lithium strontium aluminum fluoride laser crystal
explanation_cn: 可用于激光测距、照明器、激光雷达、海底通信、光谱学、医学。
explanation_en: It can be used for laser ranging, illuminators, LiDAR, submarine communication, spectroscopy, and medicine.

explanation_cn: 掺铬石榴石晶体是指在YAN基质晶体中掺入Cr，石榴石，地质学专业术语，上地幔主要造岩矿物之一。石榴石晶体与石榴籽的形状、颜色十分相似，故名“石榴石”。颜色好净度高的石榴子石可以成为宝石。
explanation_en: Cr doped garnet crystal refers to the addition of Cr and garnet into the YAN matrix crystal, which is a geological term and one of the main rock forming minerals in the upper mantle. The shape and color of garnet crystal and garnet seed are very similar, so it is called "garnet". The garnet with good color and high clarity can become a gems.

explanation_en: Crystal has good physical and chemical properties.

explanation_cn: 紫翠宝石激光晶体。此晶体为重要的高功率可调谐激光晶体，可应用于遥感、气象、大气测污、半导体硅退火处理、同位素分离、医疗、光刻及光谱学等领域。
explanation_en: Alexandrite laser crystal. This crystal is an important high-power tunable laser crystal, which can be used in remote sensing, meteorology, atmospheric pollution measurement, semiconductor silicon annealing treatment, isotope separation, medical treatment, photolithography, spectroscopy and other fields.

explanation_cn: 在氟化镁基质晶体中掺入少量镍而形成的可调谐激光晶体。
explanation_en: A tunable laser crystal is formed by doping a small amount of nickel into a magnesium fluoride matrix crystal.

explanation_en: Lutetium aluminum garnet. The single crystal method is mainly prepared by micro Czochralski method and Czochralski method.

explanation_en: In recent years, one of the most widely studied laser mediums is the laser crystal formed by doping ytterbium ion into crystal.

explanation_cn: 其结构和镥镓石榴石晶体相同，是能实现可调谐和超快激光的良好晶体。
explanation_en: Its structure is the same as lutetium gallium garnet crystal, and it is a good crystal that can realize tunable and ultrafast laser.

explanation_cn: 石榴石结构，可作为高功率、超快激光器的增益介质应用。
explanation_en: The gamet structure can be used as a gain medium for high-power and ultrafast lasers.

explanation_cn: 用于描绘原稿的图像和文字的纸。具有适当的吸墨性和透明度。
explanation_en: Paper used to depict images and text of the original manuscript. Has appropriate ink absorption and transparency.

explanation_cn: 又称捷克拉斯基方法。是在熔体生长晶体的方法中应用最广泛的，能在较短时间里生长出大而无位错的晶体。要实现成功的提拉，必须要求晶体要同成分地熔化而不分解，具有低蒸气压、黏度，材料不与坩埚或生长气氛发生反应。材料的熔点要低于坩埚的熔点。在晶体生长过程中.必须选择好适当的温度梯度、旋转速度、提拉速率和生长气氛.所用的籽晶定向精确，提拉时要保证籽晶的旋转中心位于温度梯度的中心，避免引人生长层，同时要选择适当的固-液界面。较平坦的界面有利提高晶体的质量。生长晶体时，首先将原料熔化，籽晶预热，再将旋转着的籽晶引入熔体，微熔后缓慢拉.使籽品变大（放肩阶段）.当坩埚温度达到恒定时?晶体开始等径生长。晶体长到需要长度后.使晶体脱离熔体，退火取出,，改进的提拉法.引进了等径生长的自动控制、导模、液封技术，改善了提拉法生长的晶体的质量.提高了利用率。用提拉法生长的晶体很多。
explanation_en: Also known as the Czech Laski method. It is the most widely used method in melt growth of crystal, and can grow large and dislocation free crystal in a relatively short time. To achieve successful lifting, crystal must be melted without decomposition in the same composition, with low vapor pressure and viscosity, and materials will not react with crucible or growth atmosphere. The melting point of materials is lower than the melting point of the crucible. In the process of crystal growth, proper temperature gradient, rotation speed, pulling speed and growth atmosphere must be selected. The seed crystal used is oriented accurately. When pulling, ensure that the rotation center of the seed crystal is at the center of the temperature gradient, avoid introducing growth layers, and select appropriate solid-liquid interface. The flat interface is beneficial to improve the quality of crystal. When growing crystal, first melt the raw material, preheat the seed crystal, then introduce the rotating seed crystal into the melt, slowly pull it after micro melting, so that the seed becomes larger (shoulder stage). When the crucible temperature reaches constant? Crystal began to grow in equal diameter. After the crystal grows to the required length, the crystal is separated from the melt and taken out after annealing. The improved pulling method method introduces automatic control of equal diameter growth, mold guide and liquid seal technology, which improves the quality of crystal grown by pulling method method and improves the utilization rate. There are many crystal grown by pulling method method.

explanation_cn: 在梯制过程中使用弱碱性物质提高浴液和在制品的pH值以促进鞣剂和胶原纤维之间结合的操作。
explanation_en: In the process of ladder making, weak alkaline substances are used to increase the pH value of bath solution and work in progress to promote the combination between tanning agent and collagen fiber.

explanation_cn: 由于石墨和具有石墨结构的炭材料具有层状结构，化学物质可插入到石墨层间，称之为插层反应。
explanation_en: Because graphite and carbon materials with graphite structure have layered structure, chemicals can be inserted into the graphite layer, which is called intercalation reaction.

explanation_cn: 又称插层复合法，是指在制备纳米复合材料的过程中，首先将层状材料（如层状硅酸盐、石墨等）经插层剂处理增大层间距，然后将单体或聚合物插入层间，进而破坏片层材料紧密有序的堆积结构.使微米尺度的层状材料颗粒被剥离成纳米厚度的片层单元，并均匀分散于聚合物基体中，实现聚合物与材料片层单元在纳米尺度上的层状复合。插层法可分为插层聚合法和聚合物插层法。
explanation_en: Also known as intercalation hybird method, it means that in the process of preparing nanocomposites, layered materials (such as layered silicates, graphite, etc.) are first treated with intercalating agents to increase the layer spacing, and then monomer or polymer is inserted into the layers, thus destroying the compact and orderly stacking structure of the lamellar materials. Micron sized layered materials particles are stripped into lamellar units with nanometer thickness and uniformly dispersed in the polymer matrix, Realize the layered composition of polymer and materials lamellar units on a nanoscale. Intercalation method can be divided into intercalation polymerization method and polymer intercalation method.

explanation_cn: 单体插入层状硅酸盐或其他层状物质的片层间进行的原位聚合反应。
explanation_en: In situ polymerization in which monomer is inserted into layered silicate or other layered substances.

explanation_cn: 又称搅拌铸造法、熔体搅拌法等。是将颗粒增强体加入熔融金属并使颗粒均匀分布在基体中的一种颗粒增强金属基复合材料常用制备方法，通常分为液相法和半同态法两类。
explanation_en: Also known as stirring casting method, melt stirring method, etc. It is a common preparation method of particle reinforced metal matrix composite by adding particle reinforcement to molten metal and making the particles evenly distributed in the matrix, which is generally divided into two types: liquid phase method and semi homomorphic method.

explanation_cn: 利用搓纹板或搓纹机对皮革的重复搓揉弯折作用，从而在皮革表面搓出各种特殊纹路的操作
explanation_en: The operation of repeatedly rubbing and bending leather with a rubbing board or a rubbing machine, so as to rub various special lines on the surface of leather

explanation_cn: 利用搓纹板或搓纹机在皮革表面搓出各种特殊纹路的皮革。
explanation_en: The leather with various special lines can be rubbed on the surface of leather by using a grain rubbing board or a grain rubbing machine.

explanation_cn: 在金属表面涂M-层或数层瓷釉，在一定温度下进行烧成，金属和瓷釉间发生物理化学反应而牢固结合的一种复合材料。搪瓷具有金属的机械强度，瓷釉面具有玻璃的耐蚀、耐热、耐磨、易洁和能用于装饰等特点。搪瓷用的金属材料为各种钢板、有色金属、贵金属等。在涂搪前金属材料需进行预处理.如除油、酸洗、喷砂。瓷袖就是将一定组成的玻璃熔块与磨加物一起进行粉碎混合.然后涂烧在金属表面上一层涂层。用于T.业上常有底釉和面釉。丨底袖主要目的是与金属底坯密着，同时防止出现过烧、气泡等缺陷。面釉主要作用是达到与使用目的相适应的性能。有些特殊情况不采用底袖。瓷袖加涂方法有湿法涂搪、干法涂搪、静电涂搪、电泳涂搪等。搪瓷制品一般分为：①按底坯材料分.有钢板、铸铁等黑色金属搪瓷。铜、金、银等有色金属搪瓷，另外还有不锈钢、铝镁等合金搪瓷，其中以钢板搪瓷和铸铁搪瓷较为常用；②按用途分，有日用搪瓷、化工搪瓷、建筑搪瓷、艺术搪瓷等；③以瓷釉特点分，如耐酸搪瓷、低熔搪瓷、自洁搪瓷、微晶搪瓷等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of composite materials that is coated with M-layer or several layers of enamel on the metal surface, fired at a certain temperature, and firmly bonded by physical and chemical reaction between metal and enamel. Enamel has the mechanical strength of metal, and the enamel mask has the characteristics of corrosion resistance, heat resistance, wear resistance, easy cleaning and decoration of glass. Metallic materials used for enamel are various steel plate, non-ferrous metals, precious metals, etc. Metallic materials shall be pretreated before coating, such as degreasing, pickling and grit blasting. Porcelain sleeves are made by crushing and mixing certain glass frits and grinding additives, and then coating and burning them on the metal surface. For T. industry, there are usually bottom glaze and surface glaze. The main purpose of the bottom sleeve is to be close to the metal substrate, and to prevent oversintering/over- burning, bubbles and other defects. The main function of surface glaze is to achieve performance that is suitable for the purpose of use. In some special cases, bottom sleeves are not used. The coating methods for porcelain sleeves include wet coating, dry coating, electrostatic coating, electrophoretic coating, etc. Enamel products are generally divided into: ① according to the materials of the bottom blank, there are steel plate, cast iron and other black metal enamel. Non ferrous metal enamel such as copper, gold and silver, and alloy enamel such as stainless steel and aluminum magnesium, among which steel plate enamel and cast iron enamel are more commonly used; ② According to the use, there are domestic enamdware, chemical enamel, architectural enamel, art enamel, etc.; ③ According to the characteristics of enamel, such as acid resistant enamel, low melting enamel, self-cleaning enamel, microcrystalline enamel, etc.

explanation_cn: 利用皮革在转鼓中干摔时所产生的对皮革的重复弯折作用，从而在皮革表面产生比较自然的皱纹的操作。
explanation_en: Use the repeated bending effect of leather on leather when it is tumbled in the drum, so as to produce more natural wrinkles on the surface of leather.

explanation_cn: 将皮革在转鼓内干摔，利用转鼓的机械作用而得到表面具有自然皱纹的皮革。
explanation_en: Dry throw leather in the drum, and use the mechanical action of the drum to obtain leather with natural wrinkles on the surface.

explanation_cn: 具有高摩擦系数、低磨损速率的复合材料。摩擦功能复合材料的主体是高聚物基复合材料，以酚醛树脂等高聚物为堪体，石棉纤维、玻璃纤维、碳纤维、有机纤维、钢纤维为增强组分，天然矿石粉、合成氧化物粉、石墨粉、橡胶粉、金属粉为摩擦性能调节剂。新型碳复合材料具有高度稳定的摩擦系数，耐磨、耐热，怛价格较贵，常用來制作制动器、离合器或转向机构中的摩擦部件，以其高摩擦特性及时停止机械运动或改变机械运动的方向和速度。
explanation_en: Composite materials with high friction coefficient and low wear rate. The main body of friction functional composite is polymer based composite materials, which takes phenolic resin and other polymers as the matrix, asbestos fiber, glass fiber, carbon fiber, organic fiber and steel fiber as the reinforcement component, and natural ore powder, synthetic oxide powder, graphite powder, rubber powder and metal powder as the friction performance modifier. New carbon composite materials have highly stable friction coefficient, wear resistance, heat resistance, and are relatively expensive. They are commonly used to make friction components in brakes, clutches, or steering mechanisms, and with their high friction characteristics, timely stop mechanical movement or change the direction and speed of mechanical movement.

explanation_cn: 在压力作用下，利用焊件接触端面相对运动时相互摩擦产生的热量，使端部达到热塑性状态形成连接的固态压焊方法。依据工件相对运动形式，当工件绕轴线高速旋转时，可分为驱动摩擦焊、惯性摩擦焊和相位控制摩擦焊等；当工件不运动时，则有径向摩擦焊、揽拌摩擦焊等；当工件做直线运动时，有线性摩擦焊；当工件做其他运动时.则有轨道摩擦焊合摩擦堆焊等。摩擦焊可用来焊接异种金属和尺寸差別大的部件，焊接生产率高，能耗低，焊件尺寸精度高，摩擦焊主要应用于汽车、液压设备和工具行业。
explanation_en: A solid state pressure welding method that utilizes the heat generated by mutual friction between the contact surfaces of the welded parts under pressure to achieve a thermoplastic state at the ends and form a connection. According to the relative motion form of the workpiece, when the workpiece rotates at high speed around the axis, it can be divided into drive friction welding, inertia friction welding and phase control friction welding; When the workpiece does not move, there are radial friction welding, cable mixing friction welding, etc; When the workpiece moves in a straight line, there is linear friction welding; When the workpiece moves in other ways, there are rail friction welding, friction overlaying, etc. Friction welding can be used to weld dissimilar metals and parts with large size differences. weld has high productivity, low energy consumption and high dimensional accuracy of weldments. friction welding is mainly used in automobile, hydraulic equipment and tool industries.

explanation_cn: 一种通过摩擦引发聚合反应而在摩擦表面上形成的聚合物膜。摩擦聚合膜一般是固体膜，它的形成是一种复杂过程，取决于摩擦条件、成膜物质和底材的性质，一般都能起有效的抗磨、抗压和抗擦伤的作用。它是一种"原位形成"特殊的间体润滑膜，其性能既取决于成膜物质和底材的性质，又与摩擦过程中表面上的物理和化学过程密切相关。如摩擦过程中新裸露金属表面的催化作用，金属表面的晶格缺陷；金属表面发射外逸电子的Kramer效应:在气相或液相中打机物质在金属表面上的吸附；由于机械、化学、表面催化和聚合物的高温热解等导致的游离基反应；有机基闭与金属相互作用等。已有一些摩擦聚合成膜物质作为润滑油脂的添加剂应用于实际的润滑工作中.并取得了较大的经济效益。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a polymer film formed on a friction surface through a friction initiated polymerization reaction. The friction polymer film is generally a solid film, and its formation is a complex process, depending on the friction conditions, the properties of the film forming material and the substrate, which can generally play an effective role in wear resistance, compression resistance and scratch resistance. It is a special intermetallic lubricating film formed in situ, and its performance depends not only on the properties of the film-forming material and substrate, but also closely related to the physical and chemical processes on the surface during friction. For example, catalysis of new bare metal surface and lattice defects of metal surface during friction; Kramer effect of emitting exoelectrons on metal surfaces: adsorption of organic matter on metal surfaces in gas or liquid phases; Free radical reaction caused by mechanical, chemical, surface catalysis and high-temperature pyrolysis of polymer; Interaction between organic compounds and metals, etc. Some friction polymerization film-forming substances have been used as additive of lubricating grease in actual lubrication work, and great economic benefits have been achieved.

explanation_cn: 用规定方法撕裂薄型试样所需的力.单位为N，是测定薄膜或薄片耐撕裂性的一个试验方法中定义的一个术语。该方法是将切有规定裂口的试样在专门的试验机上进行的一种撕裂试验。对于一般薄膜材料而言，往往纵向和横向的性能不同，所以要分别制样测定撕裂强度受试样形状、厚度、压延方向（纹理方向）、割口深度、测定温度以及撕裂速度的影响。目前撕裂试验方法很多，有无割口和有割口两种.所用试样形状也各不相同，有裤形、直角形和新月形等几种，相应则有裤形撕裂强度、无割口直角撕裂强度、割口直角撕裂强度和割口新月形撕裂强度等。
explanation_en: The force required to tear a thin specimen using a specified method, in N, is a term defined in a test method for determining the tear resistance of a thin film or sheet. This method is a tearing test conducted on specimens with specified cracks on a specialized testing machine. For general film materials, the longitudinal and transverse properties are often different, so it is necessary to prepare samples separately to measure the tear strength, which is affected by the shape, thickness, rolling direction (texture direction), cut depth, measurement temperature and tear speed of the sample. At present, there are many tear test methods, with or without a cut and with a cut. The shapes of the samples used are also different, including pants shape, right angle shape and crescent shape. Accordingly, there are trousers tearing strength, non cut initial tearing strength, cut initial tearing strength and cut crescent tear strength.

explanation_cn: 最常用的测试表面膜与基体材料之间结合强度的标准方法之一。将表面膜与基材分别用黏结剂固定在两个卡头上，垂直界面施加拉伸应力，用膜与基材拉脱时单位面积截面所受拉力评定结合强度。
explanation_en: One of the most commonly used standard methods to test the bonding strength between surface facial mask and matrix materials. Fix the surface facial mask and base material on two clamps with adhesive respectively, apply tensile stress on the vertical interface, and assess the bonding strength with the tensile force on the unit area section when the film and base material are pulled off.

explanation_cn: 参见磨料磨损。
explanation_en: See abrasive wear.

explanation_cn: 主要用于擦拭眼镜和玻璃仪器等的一类皮革产品。
explanation_en: It is a kind of leather product mainly used for wiping glasses and glass instruments.

explanation_cn: 布基和胶料同时通过压延机中以不同线速度回转的两棍筒之间，把胶料擦入织物间隙的工艺过程。
explanation_en: The process of wiping the fabric gap between two rollers rotating at different linear speeds in a rolling machine, using both the cloth base and the adhesive material.

explanation_cn: 将表面涂饰着色后的部分涂层擦去而得到的具有双色效应或仿古效应的一种皮革。
explanation_en: A kind of leather with two-color effect or antique effect obtained by wiping off part of the colored coating after surface finishing.

explanation_cn: 在主链中含有支链的线型聚合物，其支链具有与主链相同的基本结构。当聚合反应中存在链转移反应时，会生成此种聚合物。根据支化程度，可有多种拓扑结构，如梳形、蜈松形和哑铃形等。最简单的是高分子链上有两个支链。
explanation_en: A linear polymer containing branched chains in the main chain has the same basic structure as the main chain. When chain transfer reaction exists in polymerization, such polymer will be generated. According to the degree of branching, there can be various topological structures, such as comb shaped, centipine shaped, and dumbbell shaped. The simplest is that there are two branches on the macromolecule chain.

explanation_cn: 由医用材料制成的、用于支撑由于病变造成的血管或其他管腔狭窄的管状材料。
explanation_en: Tubular materials made of medical materials and used to support the narrowing of blood vessels or other lumens caused by pathological changes.

explanation_cn: 在医学影像设备引导下，将由金属或高分子材料制成的能够氏期或临时留置于人体管腔内的管体支架，通过输送系统放置到目标病变处，用于支撑体内狭窄管腔而使其成开放状态的微创技术。血管、腔道狭窄、闭塞是介人支架植人技术的治疗强项。具有创伤小、疗效高、风险低、并发症少、住院时间短等优点，为血管、腔道狭窄、闭塞开创了一条新路，以尽可能小的创伤换取。21世纪是微创医学的世纪.介人放射技术是微创医学的主要组成部分，以微小创伤、更高疗效、更低风险顺应了医学的发展方向。
explanation_en: Under the induction of medical imaging equipment, the stem made of metal or macromolecule materials that can be temporarily placed in the human lumen or temporarily placed in the human lumen is placed at the target lesion through the delivery system, which is a minimally invasive technology used to support the narrow lumen in the body and make it open. Stenosis and occlusion of blood vessels and lumens are the treatment strengths of human stem implantation technology. It has the advantages of minimal trauma, high efficacy, low risk, fewer complications, and short hospital stay, opening up a new path for vascular and luminal stenosis and occlusion, in exchange for minimizing trauma as much as possible. The 21st century is the century of minimally invasive medicine. Interventional radiation technology is a major component of minimally invasive medicine, which conforms to the development direction of medicine with minimal trauma, higher efficacy, and lower risk.

explanation_cn: 介入治疗中将支架输送到人体病变部位的辅助器械.包括穿刺针、导管鞘、导丝、导管和球旗等。
explanation_en: It is an auxiliary instrument for delivering stem to the diseased part of human body in interventional therapy, including puncture needle, catheter sheath, guide wire, catheter, ball flag, etc.

explanation_cn: 用来表征皮革的耐湿热稳定性能.是将湿透的试样浸泡在逐渐加热的水中.试样开始收缩时的温度。
explanation_en: It is used to characterize the moisture and heat resistance stability of leather. It refers to the temperature at which the saturated sample is immersed in gradually heated water and the sample begins to shrink.

explanation_cn: 是注射塑料制品的一种缺陷，具体是指由于浇口冻结封闭模腔后.熔体在模腔冷却时热收缩所导致的注塑成型制品表面上产生凹陷浅痕或陷窝的现象.通常出现在制品厚度较大和厚度发生变化的位置。可以通过降低熔体温度和模具温度、增加注射速度和注射压力、增加保压压力和保压时间、增加补料量等方式减轻或消除收缩痕。
explanation_en: It is a defect of injection molded plastics products, specifically refers to the phenomenon that the melt shrinks when the mold cavity cools after the gate freezes to close the mold cavity, which results in shallow dents or pits on the surface of injection molded products. It usually occurs in the position where the product thickness is large and the thickness changes. The sink mark can be reduced or eliminated by reducing the melt temperature and mold temperature, increasing the injection speed and injection pressure, increasing the pressure holding pressure and time, and increasing the amount of feed.

explanation_cn: 是利用壳聚糖分子中-OH和-NH2等功能基团发生接枝共聚反应、交联反应、羧甲基化反应、酰化反应、酯化反应或氧化还原反应壳聚糖衍生物。
explanation_en: It is a chitosan derivative that uses functional groups such as - OH and - NH2 in chitosan molecules to produce graft copolymerization, crosslinking reaction, carboxymethyl reaction, acylation reaction, esterification reaction or redox reaction.

explanation_cn: 是利用木质素分子中的芳香基、酚羟基、羰基、甲氧基、羧基、共轭双键等活性基团发生氧化、还原、水解、醇解、光解、酰化、磺化、烷基化、卤化、缩聚或接枝共聚反应制备的木质素衍生物。
explanation_en: It is a derivative of lignin prepared by oxidation, reduction, hydrolysis, alcoholysis, photolysis, acylation, sulfonation, alkylation, halogenation, polycondensation or graft copolymerization of active groups such as aromatic group, phenolic hydroxyl group, carbonyl group, methoxy group, carboxyl group and conjugated double bond in lignin molecule.

explanation_cn: 是指在淀粉原有特性基础上，通过物理、化学或酶法处理淀粉，以改变其某些天然性质，增加其性能或引进新特性而制备的具有吸附性能的淀粉。
explanation_en: It refers to starch with adsorption properties prepared by physically, chemically, or enzymatically treating starch based on its original characteristics to change some of its natural properties, increase its performance, or introduce new characteristics.

explanation_cn: 是利用物理、化学方法对富含纤维素的物质进行处理，使其成为具有良好吸附性的高分子材料。纤维素中每个葡萄糖基上有三个可供反应的羟基，通过对羟基的衍生化反应实现对纤维素的改性。改性纤维素的吸附作用主要包括离子交换、共价螯合、静电中和、范德华力、偶极-偶极相互作用和氢键键合等"可用于吸附去除水体中重金属离子和染色及污水的脱色。
explanation_en: It is to use physical and chemical methods to treat the material rich in cellulose to make it become a macromolecule materials with good adsorption. There are three reactive hydroxyl groups on each glucose group in cellulose, and the modification of cellulose is achieved through the derivatization of hydroxyl groups. The adsorption of modified cellulose mainly includes ion exchange, covalent chelation, electrostatic neutralization, van der Waals force, dipole dipole interaction and hydrogen bond. "It can be used for adsorption and removal of heavy metal ions in water bodies, dyeing and wastewater decolorization.

explanation_cn: 指借助化学或物理的方法使常规化学纤维品种的某些性能加以改进而派生的一系列新纤维的总称，常用的方法包括：①化学方法，如共聚或接枝：②物理方法，如共混或物理添加。
explanation_en: A general term for a series of new fibers derived from the improvement of some properties of conventional chemical fiber varieties by chemical or physical methods. Common methods include: ① chemical methods, such as copolymerization or grafting; ② physical methods, such as polymer blending or physical addition.

explanation_cn: 合成纤维中丙烯腈系纤维的一种。由含丙烯腈组分35%-85%的成纤共聚物制得的纤维主要品种有丙烯腈-氯乙烯共聚纤维，偏二氯乙烯-丙烯腈共聚纤维等。
explanation_en: A kind of acrylonitrile fiber in synthetic fiber. The main types of fibers made from fiber forming copolymers containing 35% -85% acrylonitrile components include acrylonitrile-vinyl chloride copolymer fiber, vinylidene chloride acrylonitrile copolymer fiber, etc.

explanation_cn: 通常指聚苯醚与（高抗冲）聚苯乙烯（HIPS;PS)、聚酰胺（PA)、及聚酸酰亚胺（PEI)等聚合物掺混形成的聚合物合金材料.为五大通用工程塑料之一。改性聚苯醚在保留聚苯醚优良的综合性能基础上，具有更好的熔融流：动性和加工性能。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to the polymer alloy materials formed by mixing polyphenylene oxide with (high impact) polystyrene (HIPS; PS), polyamide (PA), polyimide (PEI) and other polymer. It is one of the five general engineering plastics. Modified polyphenylene oxide has better melt flow, mobility and processing properties on the basis of retaining the excellent comprehensive properties of polyphenylene oxide.

name_cn: 改性锆钛酸铅（PZT）热释电陶瓷
explanation_cn: 锆钛酸铅属于钙钛矿型结构，常用的PZT陶瓷的介电常数比较大，因此，热释电优值较低。
explanation_en: Lead zirconate titanate is a perovskite type structure, and the commonly used PZT ceramics have a relatively large dielectric constant, so the pyroelectric merit value is low.

explanation_cn: 某种元素的具有放射性的同位素，它的原子核处于不稳定状态，会自发地释放出α、β、γ射线，直至转变为稳定的同位素。每一种放射性同位素都有自己特定的射线种类、能量和半衰期。放射性同位素分天然的和人工的两类。
explanation_en: A radioactive isotope of an element whose atomic nucleus is in an unstable state and spontaneously releases α、β、γ Until transformation to stable isotope. Each radioisotope has its own specific ray type, energy and half life. Radioisotope are classified into natural and artificial.

explanation_cn: 含有放射性核素或被放射性核素污染，其浓度或活度大于国家审管部门规定的清洁解控水平，并且预计不再利用的物质，又称核废物（nuclearwaste)。分为放射性废气、废液和同体废物，简称放射性"三废"。
explanation_en: Substances containing radionuclides or contaminated by radionuclides, whose concentration or activity is greater than the cleaning and control level specified by the national audit and management department, and which are expected to no longer be used, are also called nuclear waste. It is divided into radioactive waste gas, liquid waste, and homogeneous waste, abbreviated as radioactive "three wastes".

explanation_cn: 单位时间内放射源发生衰变、自发核跃迁的次数。即以每秒一次的速率进行衰变的放射性核素样品定义为具有1贝可（Bq)的活度。
explanation_en: The number of times a radioactive source undergoes decay and spontaneous nuclear transitions per unit time. That is, a radionuclide sample that decays at a rate of once per second is defined as having a activity of 1 Becquerel (Bq).

explanation_cn: 具有放射性为其鉴别特性的示踪剂。示踪剂与被失踪的物质具有相同或相似的物理化学性质，研究某物质在物理化学过程、生物过程中的行为时，可在其中加入该物质的放射性同位素，在过程中或过程后测定放射性随时间的变化，就可以得到它的运动和变化的信息，揭示其规律。选择放射性示踪剂时，应考虑其半衰期、射线种类和比活度。
explanation_en: Tracers with radioactive properties as their identification properties. Tracers have the same or similar physical chemistry properties as missing substances. When studying the behavior of a substance in physical chemistry processes and biological processes, radioisotope of the substance can be added to it. By measuring the change of radioactivity with time during or after the process, we can get information about its movement and change and reveal its laws. When selecting radioactive tracer, its half life, radiation type and specific activity should be considered.

explanation_cn: 放电平台是指电池恒压充电到电压为4.2V并且充电电流小于0.01C时停止充电，然后搁置10min,在任何值的放电电流下放电至3.6V时的放电时间。放电平台的长短是衡量电池好坏的重要标准。
explanation_en: Discharge plateau refers to the discharge time when the battery is charged to 4.2V at constant voltage and the charging current is less than 0.01C, and then it is left for 10min and discharged to 3.6V at any value of the discharge current. The length of the discharge plateau is an important standard to measure the quality of the battery.

explanation_cn: 又称等离子活化烧结或脉冲电流烧结。其通过在模具或样品上直接施加大脉冲电流，通过热效应或其他场效应并施加压力，以实现材料烧结的一种技术。
explanation_en: Also known as plasma activated sintering or pulse current sintering. It is a technology to realize sintering of materials by directly applying large pulse current on the mold or sample, and applying pressure through thermal effect or other field effects.

explanation_cn: 电参量随环境的物理、化学参量变化而变化的陶瓷材料。按感应环境的物理、化学等参量可分为物理敏、化学敏、生物敏。物理敏感陶瓷主要有:光敏，如CdS、CdSe等；热敏，如PTCR陶瓷，NTC、CTR热敏陶瓷；磁敏，如InSb、InAs、GaAs等；声敏，如罗息盐、水晶、BaTi03、PZT等；压敏.如ZnO、SiC等；力敏,如PbTiO3、PZT等。化学敏感陶瓷主要有:气敏，如SnO2、ZnO、ZrO2等；湿敏，如TiO2-MgCr2O4等。生物敏感陶瓷尚待开发之中。
explanation_en: Ceramics materials whose electrical parameters change with the physical and chemical parameters of the environment. According to the physical and chemical parameters of the induction environment, it can be divided into physical sensitivity, chemical sensitivity, and biological sensitivity. Physical sensitive ceramics mainly include: photosensitive, such as CdS, CdSe, etc; Thermal sensitive, such as PTCR ceramics, NTC, CTR thermosensitive ceramics; Magnetic sensitivity, such as InSb, InAs, GaAs, etc; Sound sensitivity, such as rosite, crystal, BaTi03, PZT, etc; Pressure sensitive, such as ZnO, SiC, etc; Li Min, such as PbTiO3, PZT, etc. Chemical sensitive ceramics mainly include: gas sensing, such as SnO2, ZnO, ZrO2, etc; Humidity sensitive, such as TiO2 MgCr2O4, etc. Biological sensitive ceramics are still under development.

explanation_cn: 又称整皮模塑泡沫，是依靠外发泡剂作气泡源，在发泡时一次性形成表皮材与泡芯材的泡沫塑料。内部生成正常的泡沫体，外部自身形成一层致密的表皮，具有明显密度变化的梯度结构。表皮具有较高的拉伸、撕裂强度，耐磨、耐化学腐蚀性以及良好的低温柔韧性，因而其性能大大超过相同密度的聚氨酯泡沫。整皮模塑泡沫可分为低密度、中密度和高密度三种。低密度泡沫整体密度为0.1-0.3mg/m3，具有良好的回弹性.舒适性能相当于高回弹泡沫，主要用作床垫材、枕头。中密度微孔泡沫整体密度为0.5-0.8mg/m3,泡沫芯体透气率较低，主要用于汽车仪表嵌板、方向盘、遮阳板以及聚氨酯鞋底。高密度制品通过在闭模中反应注塑成型。为了增加其机械强度.常采用玻璃纤维增强，一般用于高模量的汽车保险杠、车门等大型模塑件和各种耐高冲击的缓冲器。
explanation_en: Also known as whole skin molded foam, it is a foamed plastics that relies on external blowing agent as the bubble source to form skin material and foam core material at one time during foaming. Normal foam body is generated inside, and a layer of dense epidermis is formed outside, with obvious gradient structure of density change. The skin has high tensile strength, tear strength, wear resistance, chemical corrosion resistance and good low-temperature flexibility, so its performance greatly exceeds that of polyurethime foam with the same density. Whole skin molded foam can be divided into low density, medium density and high density. The overall density of low density foam is 0.1-0.3mg/m3, with good resilience. The comfort performance is equivalent to high resilience foam, which is mainly used as mattress material and pillow. The overall density of medium density microporous foam is 0.5-0.8mg/m3, and the permeability of foam core is low. It is mainly used for automobile instrument panel, steering wheel, sun visor and polyurethime sole. High density products are molded by reaction injection molding in closed mold. In order to increase its mechanical strength, it is often reinforced with glass fiber, which is generally used for large molded parts such as high modulus automobile bumpers, doors, and various high impact resistant buffers.

explanation_cn: 简单岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。化学式为Ca[CO3]，常有锶、铅、锌、稀土等代替钙，形成锶文石、铅文石、稀土文石等变种。产于现代温泉、间歇喷泉、超基性岩风化壳、硫化矿床氧化带及石灰岩的洞穴、玄武岩裂隙及近代海洋沉积物中。亦是动物贝壳及珍珠的主要成分。
explanation_en: A carbonate mineral with a simple island like structure. The chemical formula is Ca [CO3], and strontium, lead, zinc, and rare earth often replace calcium, forming varieties of strontium aragonite, lead aragonite, and rare earth aragonite. Produced in modern hot springs, geysers, weathering crusts of ultrabasic rocks, oxidation zones of sulfide deposits, caves in limestone, basalt fractures, and modern marine sediments. It is also the main ingredient of animal shells and pearl.

explanation_cn: 岩石中石英和钾长石(通常为微斜长石或条纹长石）相互穿插、有规则共生的一种结构。这两种矿物互结成楔形连晶，似楔形文字，故得名。它是石英和碱性长石在共结条件下形成的，但也可能与交代作用或固溶体出溶作用有关。常见于花岗岩及伟晶岩的边缘带。大者肉眼可见。只能在偏光显微镜下观察到的，称为"显微"。纹片釉见裂纹釉。
explanation_en: In rock, quartz and potassium feldspar (usually microcline or perthite) alternate with each other and coexist regularly. These two minerals are interconnected into wedge-shaped crystals, resembling wedge-shaped characters, hence their name. It is formed by quartze and alkaline feldspar under the condition of coalescence, but it may also be related to metasomatism or solid solution exsolution. It is common in the marginal zone of granite and pegmatite. The larger ones are visible to the naked eye. What can only be observed under polarized light microscopy is called "microscope". See crackle glaze for lamellar glaze.

explanation_cn: 一种具有文象结构的花岗岩。主要由石英和碱性长石组成，暗色矿物很少。具有典型的文象结构，块状构造。多出现在伟晶岩相中。
explanation_en: A granite with graphic texture. It is mainly composed of quartze and alkaline feldspar, with few dark minerals. It has typical graphic texture and massive structure. It mostly occurs in pegmatite facies.

explanation_cn: 斑岩是一种具有斑状结构的中性、酸性或碱性的火成岩（可以是侵入岩，也可以是喷出岩）。它们通常呈散点状分布在称为“基质”的结晶细小的矿物之间。是以斑状结构为特征的火成岩的总称，是以结构特征对岩石的命名。比较坚固，可用于做建筑材料。斑晶一般由碱性长石或石英组成，基质为细粒或隐晶（玻璃体）。
explanation_en: Porphyry is a kind of neutral, acidic or alkaline igneous rock with porphyritic texture (it can be intrusive rocks or extrusive rock). They are usually scattered and distributed between fine crystalline minerals called "matrices". It is the general name of igneous rock characterized by porphyritic texture and the name of rock based on its structural characteristics. It is relatively solid and can be used as building materials. The phenocryst is generally composed of alkaline feldspar or quartze, and the matrix is fine-grained or cryptocrystalline (vitreous).

explanation_cn: 具有斑状结构和似斑状结构的岩石中.矿物颗粒大小相差悬殊。其中，颗粒较大的称为斑晶颗粒较小或为隐晶质或玻璃质的则称为基质。
explanation_en: In rock with porphyritic texture and porphyritic texture, the size of mineral particles varies greatly. Among them, those with larger particles are called phenocryst particles or those with aphanitic or glassy particles are called matrix.

explanation_cn: 岩石中由两种截然不同的矿物颗粒组成的结构，一般把基质为隐晶质或玻璃质的结构称为斑状结构。若斑晶含量超过基质，称为多斑结构。斑晶明显少于基质则称少斑结构。
explanation_en: The structure of rock is composed of two different mineral particles. Generally, the structure whose matrix is aphanitic or glassy is called porphyritic texture. If the content of speckle crystals exceeds that of the matrix, it is called a multi speckle structure. The phenocryst is obviously less than the matrix, so it is called less phenocryst structure.

explanation_cn: 配位型硫化物矿物，有三种同质多象变体。高温变体属等轴晶系晶体极为少见，集合体呈致密块状、粒状。新鲜面呈喑铜红色，不新鲜表面常被蓝、紫斑状锖色覆盖条痕灰黑色，金属光泽，不透明。产于基性岩冇关的铜镍等矿床中，与黄铜矿、钛磁铁矿等共生；也见于接触交代的矽卡岩矿床及热液矿床中m与铜的硫化物、黄铁矿、辉铜矿、方铅矿等共生。
explanation_en: Coordination type sulfide minerals have three homogeneous polymorphs. The high-temperature variant belongs to the equiaxed crystal system, which is extremely rare, and the aggregate is dense, massive and granular. The fresh surface is a dull copper red color, while the non fresh surface is often covered with blue or purple spots and streaks of gray black, metallic luster, and opaque. It occurs in copper nickel deposits related to basic rocks and coexists with chalcopyrite, titanium magnetite, etc; It is also found in contact metasomatic skarn deposits and hydrothermal deposits where m is associated with copper sulfide, pyrite, chalcocite, galena, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称逗彩，创烧于明成化时期，是釉下彩（青花）与釉上彩相结合的一种装饰方法。斗彩是预先在高温（1300℃)下烧成的釉下青花瓷器上，用矿物颜料进行二次施彩，填补青花图案留下的空白和涂染青花轮廓线内的空间.然后再次人窑经过低温（800℃)烘烤而成。斗彩瓷器是瓷器中最为名贵的种类之一。斗彩以其绚丽多彩的色调，沉稳老辣的色彩，形成了一种符合明代时期人们审美情趣的装饰风格。
explanation_en: Also known as to amuse oneself with color, it was created in the Chenghua period of the Ming Dynasty. It is a decorative method combining glaze color (blue and white) with glaze color phase. Doucai contrasting colors is a kind of underglaze blue and white porcelain that is fired at high temperature (1300 ℃) in advance. It is painted twice with mineral pigment to fill the blank left by the blue and white pattern and the space inside the painted blue and white outline. Then it is baked again at low temperature (800 ℃). Doucai contrasting colors porcelain is one of the most valuable types of porcelain. Doucai contrasting colors, with its gorgeous and colorful colors and calm and spicy colors, has formed a decorative style that conforms to the aesthetic tastes of people in the Ming Dynasty.

explanation_cn: 由石材矿山开采的形状不规则的，经加工具有一定规格，能用来砌筑建筑物的石料。按加工后的外形的规则程度，可分为毛料石、粗料石、半细料石和细料石。按形状可分为条石、方石及拱石。粗料石主要应用子建筑物的基础、勒脚、墙体部位:半细料石和细料石主要用作镶面的材料。
explanation_en: Irregular shaped stones mined by stone mines, processed to certain specifications, can be used for building masonry. According to the regularity of the processed appearance, it can be divided into rough stone, coarse stone, semi fine stone, and fine stone. It can be divided into strip stones, square stones, and arch stones according to their shape. Coarse aggregate is mainly used for the foundation, plinth and wall parts of the sub buildings: semi fine aggregate and fine aggregate are mainly used as facing materials.

explanation_cn: 一种几乎全由基性斜长石组成的基性侵入岩。斜长石含量一般大于90%,含少量橄榄石、辉石、角闪石、黑云母等。多呈白色、灰、浅灰黄色等。中粗粒半自形或他形粒状结构。按斜长石成分，可进一步分为拉长岩和倍长岩。斜长石常发生钠黝帘石化，暗色矿物发生绿泥石化、绿帘石化.形成鲜艳的浅绿色、黄绿色。斜长石常具有双晶，由于双晶单体对光线的不同反射和干涉作用。在岩石的表面形成闪烁变彩的现象，具有这些特点的斜长岩可以用作优质的建筑装饰石材。常与辉长岩共生，并与钛铁矿床的形成有密切关系。中国河北省大庙有较典型的产出。
explanation_en: A basic intrusive rock composed almost entirely of basic plagioclase. The content of plagioclase is generally more than 90%, with a small amount of olivine, pyroxene, amphibole, biotite, etc. It is mostly white, gray, light grayish yellow, etc. Medium to coarse grained semi self shaped or heteromorphic granular structure. According to the composition of plagioclase, it can be further divided into plagioclase and plagioclase. Plagioclase often undergoes sodium zoidization, while dark minerals undergo chloritization and epidotization, forming bright light green and yellow green colors. Plagioclase often has twin, because of the different reflection and interference of twin monomer to light. The phenomenon of twinkling and color changing is formed on the surface of rock, and plagioclase with these characteristics can be used as high-quality building decoration stone. It is often associated with gabbro and closely related to the formation of ilmenite deposit. The temples in Hebei Province, China have typical outputs.

explanation_cn: 一种具片麻状构造的富含斜长石的变质岩，是片麻岩中最常见的岩石类型。主要由中酸性斜长石、石英、黑云母、普通角闪石、辉石等组成。它是中酸性侵入岩、火山岩或硬砂岩等经中高级变质作用的产物。
explanation_en: A metamorphic rock with gneissose structure and rich plagioclase, it is the most common rock type in gneiss. It is mainly composed of intermediate acid plagioclase, quartze, biotite, ordinary amphibole, pyroxene, etc. It is the product of intermediate and high grade metamorphism of intermediate acid intrusive rocks, volcanic rock or hard sandstone.

explanation_cn: 一种由斜长石和普通角闪石组成的区域变质岩。斜长石和角闪石含量相近，几乎不含石英。有时含少量绿帘石、透辉石、石榴石或黑云母。柱粒状花岗变晶结构，片麻状、块状或条带状构造。片理清楚者称为斜长角闪片岩;斜长石少而角闪石为主的称为角闪岩或角闪片岩。石英、斜长石和角闪石含量相近者称为角闪斜长片麻岩。由基性火山岩、杂砂岩、凝灰岩或铁镁质泥灰岩变质而成。
explanation_en: A regional metamorphic rock consisting of plagioclase and common amphibole. The content of plagioclase and amphibole is similar, and there is almost no quartze. Sometimes it contains a small amount of epidote, diopside, garnet or biotite. Columnar granite balastic texture, gneissic, massive or banded structure. Those with clear schistosity are called plagioclase hornblende schist; Amphibolite or hornblende schist refers to those with less plagioclase and mainly amphibole. Those with similar contents of quartze, plagioclase and amphibole are called hornblende plagioclase gneiss. It is metamorphosed from basic volcanic rock, greywacke, tuff or mafic marl.

explanation_cn: 一种环状硅酸盐矿物，化学成分为(Ca，Fe,Mn，Mg)3Al2BSi4O15(OH)。呈板状晶体或集合体，常见宽薄的楔形。褐色、紫色、紫褐色、褐黄色及蓝色。
explanation_en: A cyclic silicate mineral with chemical composition of (Ca, Fe, Mn, Mg) 3Al2BSi4O15 (OH). It is a plate shaped crystal or aggregate, usually in a wide and thin wedge shape. Brown, purple, purple brown, brown yellow, and blue.

explanation_cn: 分析断口宏观与微观特征形貌的技术与方法。材料受力断裂形成的断面称为断口，材料断裂时裂纹总是在受应力最大或材料最薄弱处萌生，沿消耗能最最小的路径扩展。因此，断口详细记录了断裂过程中内外因素的变化，分析断口有可能发现断裂原因、分析断裂机理、提出防止断裂的措施。
explanation_en: Techniques and methods for analyzing the macroscopic and microscopic characteristics of fracture morphology. The fracture surface formed by materials fracture under stress is called fracture surface. When materials fracture occurs, the crack always starts at the place where the stress is the largest or the materials is the weakest, and propagates along the path where the energy consumption is the smallest. Therefore, the fracture surface recorded the changes of internal and external factors in the process of fracture in detail, analyzed the fracture surface to find the cause of fracture, analyzed the fracture mechanism, and proposed measures to prevent fracture.

explanation_cn: 裂纹失稳扩展导致试样或构件破坏称为断裂。根据断裂原因可分为超载断裂，疲劳断裂，蠕变断裂和环境断裂（应力腐蚀.氢致开裂以及液体金属脆断)。环境断裂是在恒载下通过裂纹的形核和扩展造成的，需要一个时间过程，故也称为滞后断裂。
explanation_en: Fracture refers to the failure of specimen or component caused by unstable crack propagation. According to the causes of fracture, it can be divided into overload fracture, fatigue fracture, creep fracture and environmental fracture (stress corrosion, hydrogen induced cracking and liquid metal brittle fracture). Environmental fracture is caused by crack nucleation and propagation under constant load, which requires a time process, so it is also called delayed fracture.

explanation_cn: 应用宏观力学定量研究含裂纹物体裂纹扩展规律的一门学科。断裂力学以材料内部不可避免存在原始裂纹为前提，根据线弹性理论和弹塑性理论分析裂纹体受力后裂纹尖端的应力场和应变场，提出描述裂纹尖端附近应力场的力学参量和裂纹失稳扩展的力学判据，确定材料强度、裂纹尺寸和零件几何形状、工作应力之间的定量关系，建立断裂判据。
explanation_en: The application of macro mechanics to the quantitative study of crack propagation of cracked objects. Fracture mechanics is based on the premise that there is inevitably an original crack in the materials. According to the linear elasticity theory and the elastic-plastic theory, the stress field and strain field at the crack tip after the crack body is stressed are analyzed. The mechanical parameters describing the stress field near the crack tip and the mechanical criteria for the unstable propagation of the crack are proposed. The quantitative relationship between materials strength, crack size, part geometry and working stress is determined, and the fracture criterion is established.

explanation_cn: 指承受载荷时材料抵抗断裂的能力，用断裂瞬间的应力值表征。静拉伸时，实际断裂负荷FK与实际断裂面积SK之比称为实际断裂强度。必须根据实际断裂情况才能确定的意义。
explanation_en: It refers to the ability of materials to resist fracture under load, which is characterized by the stress value at the moment of fracture. In static tension, the ratio of the actual fracture load FK to the actual fracture area SK is called the actual fracture strength. The meaning can only be determined according to the actual fracture situation.

explanation_cn: 从细观（晶粒尺度）和微观（原子尺度）分析材料变形、强化与断裂的一门科学。主要包括：①基于位错理论的塑性变形和强化机理；②提出各种服役条件下裂纹萌生与扩展机制，指出影响断裂模式和断裂性质的内外因素。断裂物理与断裂力学分别从微观和宏观两个角度分析断裂问题，并相互渗透、相互补充，共同构成一个完整的断裂学科。但两者仍有较大区别：断裂力学提供工程应用的断裂判据和描述裂纹尖端应力和应变场，但不能描述裂纹失稳扩展前后的物理问题；断裂物理对裂纹萌生和亚临界扩展给以清晰的物理解释，但不能提供工程的断裂判据。
explanation_en: It is a science to analyze the deformation, strengthening and fracture of materials from the micro (grain scale) and micro (atomic scale). It mainly includes: ① plastic deformation and strengthening mechanism based on dislocation theory; ② The mechanism of crack initiation and propagation under various service conditions is proposed, and the internal and external factors affecting the fracture mode and fracture properties are pointed out. Fracture physics and fracture mechanics analyze fracture problems from both microscopic and macroscopic perspectives, and penetrate and complement each other to form a complete fracture discipline. But there are still big differences between the two: fracture mechanics provides engineering applied fracture criteria and describes the stress and strain fields at the crack tip, but it cannot describe the physical problems before and after the unstable crack growth; Fracture physics gives a clear physical explanation of crack initiation and subcritical growth, but it can not provide engineering fracture criteria.

explanation_cn: 又称断裂韧度，指含裂纹构件抵抗裂纹失稳扩展的能力，用裂纹尖端应力强度因子的临界值表示。有平面应变断裂韧性(KIC)和平面应力断裂韧性（Kr)之分，通常所述断裂韧性一般为平面应变断裂韧性。
explanation_en: Also known as fracture toughness, it refers to the ability of a cracked component to resist the unstable propagation of cracks, which is expressed by the critical value of the stress intensity factor at the crack tip. There are plane strain fracture toughness (KIC) and plane stress fracture toughness (Kr). Generally, the fracture toughness is plane strain fracture toughness.

explanation_cn: 测定带裂纹构件抵抗裂纹失稳扩展能力即断裂韧性的力学性能试验方法。测定的断裂韧性指标不同，试样的形状、尺寸也不相同。
explanation_en: A test method for determining the mechanical properties of cracked components to resist crack instability propagation, that is, fracture toughness. The shape and size of samples are different with different fracture toughness indexes measured.

explanation_cn: 试样原始截面积A0和拉断后最小截面积A的差值与原始截面积的百分比称为断面收缩率，用φ表示。φ和试样长度l无关，但随原始截面Au的不同而略有差异。
explanation_en: The difference between the original cross-sectional area A0 of the sample and the minimum cross-sectional area A after fracture, and the percentage of the original cross-sectional area, is called the reduction of area φ Represent. φ It is not related to the length l of the sample, but varies slightly with the original cross-sectional Au.

explanation_cn: 发光材料的发射光波长一般总是大于激发光波长的规律。激发光波长(或能量）与发射光波长（或能量）之差称为斯托克斯位移。或者说发光的光子能量通常要小于激发光子的能量。
explanation_en: The emission wavelength of luminescence materials is always greater than the excitation wavelength. The difference between the wavelength (or energy) of the excitation light and the wavelength (or energy) of the emission light is called the Stokes shift. In other words, the energy of luminescence photons is usually less than that of exciting photons.

explanation_cn: 部分互溶高分子共混物的混合自由能组成关系曲线上的拐点。
explanation_en: The inflection point on the composition relationship curve of the mixing free energy of partially miscible polyblend.

explanation_cn: 部分互溶二元混合物在相图上斯皮诺达线包围的不稳定区内.以浓度涨落引发和上坡扩散控制机理进行的相分离。
explanation_en: The phase separation of partially miscible binary mixtures in the unstable region surrounded by the spinodal curve on the phase diagram is initiated by concentration fluctuations and controlled by uphill diffusion.

explanation_cn: 部分互溶高分子共混物二元相图上不同温度下斯皮诺达点的连线。
explanation_en: The lines of Spinoda points at different temperatures on the binary phase diagram of partially miscible polyblend.

explanation_cn: 以斯蒂芬酸铅为主要组分的点火药。斯蒂芬酸铅的学名为2,4,6-三硝基间苯二酚铅，是一种起爆力较弱的单质起爆药，不适于单独作为雷管装药；其静电感度高，但火焰感度好，多用于火焰雷管和电火工品中.用桥丝或电火花点燃。做电点火头药剂时通常用硝棉胶（由硝化纤维素与一定量的丙酮配制而成）作黏合剂制成药糊，电桥丝在药糊中经多次蘸制、干燥而成。斯蒂芬酸铅的碱式盐和中式盐均可作i点火药.但碱式斯蒂芬酸铅的静电积累值明显低于中式盐；碱式盐的晶体较小、均匀.故采用碱式盐作为点火药比较好。
explanation_en: Ignition composition with lead styphnate as the main component. The scientific name of lead styphnate is 2,4,6-2,4,6-trinitroresorcinate, which is a kind of single compound primary explosive with weak initiating power and is not suitable to be used as detonator charge alone; Its static inductance is high, but its flame sensitivity is good. It is mostly used in flame detonators and electric explosive devices. It is ignited with bridge wire or electric spark. The nitrocellulose glue (made of nitrocellulose and a certain amount of acetone) is usually used as the adhesive to make the medicine paste when making the electric igniter agent, and the electric bridge wire is dipped and dried in the medicine paste for many times. The basic salt and Chinese salt of lead styphnate can be used as i ignition propellant, but the electrostatic accumulation value of basic lead styphnate is significantly lower than that of Chinese salt; The crystal of basic salt is small and even, so it is better to use basic salt as ignition composition.

explanation_cn: 见先进材料。
explanation_en: See advanced materials.

explanation_cn: 旧称洋彩，是因为新中国成立以前所用的色料和表现技法都由外国引进，描绘的纹样也模仿西方，作品粗糙，技术不高。新中国成立后，经过一系列的革新和研究。我国不仅能自己生产各种颜料而且在表现技法上，吸收我国绘画的没骨法、工笔画法及写意画法，所谓"洋彩"已经失去了它的含义。颜料色彩纯正鲜艳，由铜、铁、锡、锰、钴等多种不同金属氧化物制成的一种低温釉上彩绘颜料，烧成温度600-900°C。颜色极为丰富，其中部分红色系列的颜色中含有黄金。其特点是，绘画程序比较简单。可直接用笔取色料在瓷上作画。表现力较强，可以任意画出浓淡条理，并可随意调配颜色，在画完烧过之后，还可以反复罩色，屡次回炉烧制。新彩颜料呈色多，性能好。既能手绘又可以印制贴花纸，喷花、戳花等，对于描绘人物、山水、花鸟图案都无局限性，因此在日用瓷装饰方面大量使用。景德镇现时流行的新彩中除颇有中闰写意画风格的扁笔新彩外，还有鲜艳明快的刷花、喷彩，规整秀丽的平印、丝印贴花等。
explanation_en: The old name "Yangcai" was because the colors and techniques used before the establishment of the People's Republic of China were imported from foreign countries, and the patterns depicted were also imitated from the West, resulting in rough works and low technology. After the establishment of New China, it underwent a series of reforms and research. Our country can not only produce all kinds of pigment by itself, but also absorb the boneless, meticulous and freehand brushwork of our painting in terms of performance techniques. The so-called "foreign color" has lost its meaning. Pigment is pure and bright. It is a low-temperature glaze color pigment made of copper, iron, tin, manganese, cobalt and other different metal oxides. The firing temperature is 600-900 ° C. The colors are extremely rich, with some of the red series colors containing gold. Its characteristic is that the painting program is relatively simple. You can directly use a pen to draw colors on porcelain. Strong expressive power, able to draw rich and weak patterns at will, and can freely mix colors. After painting and burning, it can also be repeatedly masked and fired. New colors pigment has many colors and good performance. It can be both hand-painted and printed with floral paper, spray painting, poking flowers, etc. It has no limitations in depicting characters, landscapes, and flower and bird patterns, so it is widely used in daily porcelain decoration. Among the current popular new colors in Jingdezhen, in addition to the flat pen new colors with the style of Zhongrun freehand brushwork, there are also bright and bright brushstrokes, spray colors, and neat and beautiful flat prints, silk screen decals, etc.

explanation_cn: 见混凝土拌和物
explanation_en: See concrete mixuire

explanation_cn: 用于印刷报纸的纸。以机械浆、废纸为主要原料在长网纸机抄造。具有高抗张强度和高不透明度。
explanation_en: Paper used for printing newspapers. Manufactured using mechanical pulp and waste paper as the main raw materials on a long web paper machine. It has high tensile strength and high opacity.

explanation_cn: 架状结构硅酸盐矿物。化学式为（Na,Ca)4[Al2Si2〇8]3(Cl,F,OH,CO3,SO4)。钠与钙形成完全类质同象，按端元组分钠柱石（Ma)与钙柱石（Me)含量分为四个亚种。
explanation_en: Silicate mineral with shelf structure. The chemical formula is (Na, Ca) 4 [Al2Si208] 3 (Cl, F, OH, CO3, SO4). Sodium and calcium form a complete isomorphism, and are divided into four subspecies based on the content of the end member components of sodium (Ma) and calcium (Me).

explanation_cn: 又称方英石或白硅石。化学组成为SiO2,与石英、鳞石英等为同质异象变体。
explanation_en: It is also called quartzite or cristobalite. The chemical composition is SiO2, which is a homomorphic variant with quartze, squama quartze, etc.

explanation_cn: 属架状桂酸盐一类结构，为立方晶系。方石英是石英的一种，为硅氧矿物，其结构主要由硅氧四面体共角顶连接而成。
explanation_en: It belongs to a type of framework like cinnamate structure and is a cubic crystal system. Cristobalite is a kind of quartze, which is a silicon oxide mineral.

explanation_cn: 岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。化学式为Ca[CO3]，常含镁、锰、铁等混入物，形成镁方解石、锰方解石、铁方解石等。
explanation_en: Island structured carbonate minerals. The chemical formula is Ca [CO3], which often contains magnesium, manganese, iron and other mixed substances, forming magnesium caldte, manganese caldte, iron caldte, etc.

explanation_cn: 以方解石CaCO3,为代表的一类型化合物的晶体结构。方解石型固溶体很普遍.如MgCO3和FeCO3能形成连续同溶体。如果两个正离子的大小有明显差别，则会产生有序结构，如矿物白云石。
explanation_en: The crystal structure of a type of compound represented by caldte CaCO3. Caldte type solid solution is very common. For example, MgCO3 and FeCO3 can form a continuous isosolution. If the size of two positive ions is obviously different, an ordered structure will be produced, such as mineral dolomite.

explanation_cn: 架状结构硅酸盐矿物。等轴晶系，粒状。带各种色调的灰色，紫外线下发橘红色荧光。新鲜断口显示浅红色者称紫方钠石（以成分中含S2-为特征）。
explanation_en: Silicate mineral with shelf structure. Equiaxed crystal system, granular. With various shades of gray, orange red fluorescence under ultraviolet light. The fresh fracture showing a light red color is called purple sodalite (characterized by the presence of S2- in its composition).

explanation_cn: 配位型硫化物矿物。化学式为PbS。常见有Ag、Cu、Zn、Fe、As、Sb、Bi、Cd、T1、In、Se等混入。等轴晶系，氯化钠型结构。
explanation_en: Coordination type sulfide minerals. The chemical formula is PbS. Commonly mixed with Ag, Cu, Zn, Fe, As, Sb, Bi, Cd, T1, In, Se, etc. Equiaxed crystal system, rock salt structure.

explanation_cn: 镁的氧化物矿物。化学成分MgO,等轴晶系，晶体呈立方体、八面体，集合体为不规则粒状。呈白色、浅灰色、浅黄色或黑色。
explanation_en: Magnesium oxide minerals. Chemical composition: MgO, equiaxed crystal system, crystal is cube, octahedron, and the aggregate is irregular granular. It appears white, light gray, light yellow, or black.

explanation_cn: 在磁场作用下产生偏振面旋转的光纤。玻璃在纵向强磁场的作用下变为旋光性。即平面偏振光沿外磁场方向透过玻璃，则可观察到光的偏振面发生旋转。阶跃单模光纤传输的是线偏振模，因此法拉第旋光现象也将在单模光纤中出现。
explanation_en: A optical fiber that rotates its polarization plane under the action of a magnetic field. Glass becomes optically active under the action of a strong longitudinal magnetic field. That is, the plane polarized light passes through the glass along the direction of the external magnetic field, and the rotation of the polarization plane of the light can be observed. Step single mode optical filler transmits linear polarization mode, so Faraday rotation will also occur in single mode optical filler.

explanation_cn: 将平板毛述或预先成型的毛还固定在旋转的芯模的一端，用具有一定边缘形状的旋轮，对毛坯加压，旋轮可作轴向和径向运动，经过一次或多次加工，得到各种形状和壁厚的空心回转体制品的工艺方法。旋轮和毛坯的接触区很小材料只发生局部塑性变形，力小，可用小吨位的设备加工大型制品。是制造空心锥体、筒形件、杯形件、半球体和薄壁管材等精密制品的有效方法。旋压产品的精度高，力学性能好，尺寸范围广。旋压的模具简单，更换容易，生产成本较低。缺点是生产工时长，产量低。适宜小批量多品种生产。旋压可用于有色金属、稀有金属和钢铁的加工。可制造生活用具、化工容器、机器零件、火箭导弹和航天器的各种壳体等。按金属的变形特征可分为普通旋压和强力旋压两种。普通旋压，毛坯的壁厚和表面积基本不变，只改变毛坯的形状。多用于旋压各种薄壁的铝、铜、不锈钢等的日用品。强力旋压.毛坯的形状和壁厚都发生变化。锥形件强力旋压时，金属的移动符合正弦定律是纯剪切变形。用于生产等壁厚和变壁厚的锥形件和半球形体件等。筒形件强力旋压时，筒形毛坯的壁厚减小，长度增加。用于生产薄壁无缝管、杯状体等。按旋压.温度可分为冷旋压、温旋压和热旋压三种。最大的旋压机床可旋压直径达6m的零件。
explanation_en: The process of fixing flat or pre formed wool onto one end of a rotating core mold, and using a spinning wheel with a certain edge shape to pressurize the blank. The spinning wheel can perform axial and radial movements, and after one or multiple processing, various shapes and wall thicknesses of hollow rotary products can be obtained. The contact area between the roller and the blank is very small. materials only has local plastic deformation, and the force is small. Large products can be processed with small tonnage equipment. It is an effective method for manufacturing precision products such as hollow cones, cylindrical parts, cup shaped parts, hemispherical bodies, and thin-walled pipes. Spinning products have high precision, good mechanical properties and wide size range. The mould of spinning is simple, easy to replace and low in production cost. The disadvantage is long production hours and low output. Suitable for small batch and multi variety production. Spinning can be used for processing nonferrous metals, rare metals and steel. It can manufacture various shells for daily necessities, chemical containers, machine parts, rockets, missiles, and spacecraft. According to the deformation characteristics of metal, it can be divided into ordinary spinning and powerful spinning. In ordinary spinning, the wall thickness and surface area of the blank are basically unchanged, only the shape of the blank is changed. It is mainly used for spinning various thin-walled aluminum, copper, stainless steel and other daily necessities. Powerful spinning. The shape and wall thickness of the blank change. When the conical part is forced spinning, the movement of the metal conforms to the sine law, which is a pure shear deformation. Used for producing conical and hemispherical parts with equal and variable wall thicknesses. The wall thickness of the tubular blank decreases and the length increases when the tubular part is strongly spun. Used for producing thin-walled seamless pipes, cup-shaped bodies, etc. According to spinning, temperature can be divided into cold spinning, warm spinning and hot spinning. The largest spinning machine can spinning parts with a diameter of 6m.

explanation_cn: 针对带环筋镁合金壳体件的成形，是一种可在坯料径向、轴向与周向同时进行控制加载的高效的全新的体积成形方法，将传统挤压成形单一轴向运动，增加可控制的定轴旋转运动及径向运动实现内筋壳体构件的整体塑性成形。
explanation_en: For the forming of magnesium alloy shell with ring ribs, it is an efficient new volume forming method that can control the loading in the radial, axial and circumferential directions of the blank at the same time. The traditional extrusion is formed with a single axial movement, and the controllable fixed axis rotation movement and radial movement are added to realize the overall plastic forming of the shell with internal ribs.

explanation_cn: 是指适用于微波频段的旋磁介质。其中，主要是旋磁铁氧体材料，也称微波铁氧体材料。实际应用中有尖晶石型，以及应用于毫米波段的磁铅石型。
