explanation_cn: 液晶，特别是应用最多的向列相液晶，其分子的质心在整个体系里是无序的，如同普通液体，然而向列相液晶又不同于一般液体，向列相液晶处于各向异性的状态。分子排列越整齐，越没缺陷，该物体的整体各向异性就越明显。但是，不论用什么方法，在什么条件下，液晶分子的排列都不可能百分之百的一致。称这种分子排布的有序程度为"有序参量"，用"S"表示。
explanation_en: Liquid crystals, especially the most widely used nematic liquid crystal, have disordered molecular centroids in the whole system, just like ordinary liquids. However, nematic liquid crystal are different from ordinary liquids, and nematic liquid crystal are in an anisotropic state. The more orderly the arrangement of molecules and the absence of defects, the more pronounced the overall anisotropy of the object. However, regardless of the method used and under any conditions, the arrangement of liquid crystal molecules cannot be 100% consistent. The degree of order of this molecular arrangement is referred to as the "order parameter", denoted by "S".

explanation_cn: 溶质原子占据溶剂晶体点阵中的某些确定位置的固溶体。无序固溶体由于其组元原子在其点阵中的分布是任意的，从点阵特性来看，它仍然保持着溶剂组元的点阵，只是点阵常数有一定的变化。而则具有如下特点：①中各组元原子占据特定位置，由此而形成了两种或多种亚点阵，整个的结构就是由各组元的亚点阵相互穿插而成的叠结构（或称超结构），在其X射线衍射谱或中子衍射谱中便出现了新的点阵谱线（或称超点阵谱）;②异类原子力图靠近，同类原子力图远离，这表明异类原子的结合力比同类原子强;③有序结构可以存在于一定的成分范围，但只有在特定的成分比才能达到完全有序的结构;④一般来说，有序同溶体加热到一定温度会发生有序-无序转变。
explanation_en: A solid solution in which solute atoms occupy certain positions in the lattice of a solvent crystal. The disordered solid solution still keeps the lattice of solvent components, but the lattice constant has some changes, because the distribution of its constituent atoms in its lattice is arbitrary. However, it has the following characteristics: ① the atoms of each component occupy a specific position, thus forming two or more kinds of sublattice. The whole structure is a stack structure (or superstructure) formed by the interpenetration of the sublattice of each component, and new lattice lines (or superlattice spectrum) appear in its X-ray diffraction spectrum or neutron diffraction spectrum; ② Heterologous atoms strive to approach, while similar atoms strive to stay away, indicating that heterologous atoms have stronger binding forces than similar atoms; ③ Ordered structures can exist within a certain range of components, but only at a specific component ratio can a completely ordered structure be achieved; ④ Generally speaking, the order disorder transformation occurs when the ordered synsolution is heated to a certain temperature.

explanation_cn: 又称退火硬化。固溶体内异种原子间相对分布的有序化所引起的合金强度和硬度增大效应。与无序合金的滑移过程相比，有序合金的位错滑移过程会引起更多的异类原子键断裂，产生反相畴界或其他缺陷。在这类合金中异类原子的结合能比同类原子强，故有序合金位错滑移更困难，强度和硬度增加。由于一般过程大多是先获得无序固溶体，再将它在其临界温度以下进行恒温退火而实现的。有烟火药见黑火药。
explanation_en: Also called annealing hardening. The strength and hardness of alloy increase due to the ordering of the relative distribution of heterogeneous atoms in the solid solution. Compared with the slip process of disordered alloy, the dislocation slip process of ordered alloy will cause more fracture of heterogeneous atomic bonds, resulting in antiphase domain boundary or other defects. In this kind of alloy, the cohesive energy of dissimilar atoms is stronger than that of similar atoms, so the dislocation slip of ordered alloy is more difficult, and the strength and hardness increase. The general process is to obtain disordered solid solution first, and then conduct constant temperature annealing below its critical temperature. See black powder for pyrotechnic powder.

explanation_cn: 固溶体有序化时所引起的自由能变化。主要由两项组成：其一，由于同种原子间和异种原子间的结合能互不相同，有序化后增加了异种原子对的数量，由此而引起内能的变化;其二，有序化后，异种原子相互间由混乱的任意分布，转变为规律的有序分布，由此必然会引起熵值的变化。这都将引起系统自由能的变化。
explanation_en: The change of free energy caused by the ordering of solid solution. It is mainly composed of two items: first, because the cohesive energy between the same kind of atoms and the different kinds of atoms are different from each other, the ordering increases the number of different atomic pairs, which causes the change of internal energy; Secondly, after ordering, heterogeneous atoms will change from chaotic arbitrary distribution to regular orderly distribution, which will inevitably lead to changes in entropy. This will cause the change of free energy of the system.

explanation_cn: 从火药或炸药成品验收到组成该成品的各组分含量以及与成品有关的物理化学和爆炸或燃烧性能等指标降至出厂规格下限的时间。试验在40-100℃区间选三个温度或更多温度点进行，定量测试各组分和成品的恒温功能性诸参量随时间的变化，以确定火药或炸药的失效判据，或称寿命"临界点"。如用聚异丁烯黏结的塑性或弹性炸药，以黏结剂分子量降至6万左右，混合炸药失去塑性或弹性为寿命临界点;XTX-8003橡皮炸药和PBX-94321塑料黏结炸药，则分别以不能继续维持稳定爆轰和不符合产品出厂标准为失效判据。将各试验温度下到达临界点所对应的时间的对数值，分別与热力学温度（T)和它的倒数作图，由所得的两条直线，分别外推至规定温度，求其有效使用期。所求出的值系预估值，与库存实际情况尚有一定差别，但火药或炸药的对预估武器系统的寿命仍有一定的参考价值。
explanation_en: The time from the acceptance of propellant or explosive finished products to the reduction of the content of each component of the finished products and the physical chemistry, explosion or combustion performance and other indicators related to the finished products to the lower limit of factory specifications. The test is carried out at three or more temperature points in the range of 40-100 ℃, and the constant temperature functional parameters of each component and finished product are tested quantitatively over time to determine the failure criterion of propellant or explosive, or called the "critical point" of life. For example, plastic or elasticity explosive bonded with polyisobutylene, when the molecular weight of adhesive drops to about 60000, and composite explosive lose their plasticity or elasticity, it is the critical point of life; For XTX-8003 rubber explosive and PBX-94321 plastic bonded explosives, the failure criteria are that they cannot continue to maintain stable detonation and do not meet the product delivery standards. Plot the logarithm of the time corresponding to the critical point at each test temperature with the thermodynamics temperature (T) and its reciprocal, extrapolate the two lines to the specified temperature, and calculate its available life. The calculated value is the estimated value, which is different from the actual inventory situation, but the propellant or explosive still have some reference value for estimating the life of the weapon system.

explanation_cn: 又称张量，是描述电子在晶体中的准经典运动时引入的一个张量，代表电子受外力作用时外力与加速度的一个比例系数。若用电子的真空质量描述晶体中电子的准经典运动时，需同时计入外力和晶体周期势场的共同作用，情况十分复杂。而引入后，可直接用牛顿第二运动定律的简单形式描述电子的运动。显然，涵盖了晶体周期势场的作用。不是一个常数，是波矢的函数。一般情况下，是一个张量，某些特殊条件下可简化为标量。的取值可正可负，在能带底附近，总是正的;在能带顶附近有效质量总是负的。
explanation_en: Also called tensor, it is a tensor introduced to describe the quasi classical motion of electrons in crystal, representing a proportional coefficient of external force and acceleration when electrons are subjected to external force. If we use the vacuum mass of electrons to describe the quasi classical motion of electrons in crystal, it is very complicated to take into account the combined effect of external forces and periodic potential fields in crystal. After introduction, the motion of electrons can be directly described in the simple form of Newton's second law of motion. Obviously, the effect of periodic potential field of crystal is covered. It's not a constant, it's a function of the wave vector. In general, it is a tensor, which can be simplified as a scalar under certain special conditions. The value of can be positive or negative, always positive near the bottom of the energy band; The effective mass is always negative near the band top.

explanation_cn: 主要指可以进行光电转换的有机材料，分为有机小分子光电材料和光电高分子材料。有机小分子光电材料通常具有较大的共轭平面是良好的有机小分子半导体。光电高分子材料多具有共轭主链骨架，有良好的半导体性质，能够实现高效的光电转换功能，作为光电信息和能源相关的功能材料研究发展十分迅速。目前研究比较成熟的光电高分子包括聚乙炔、聚噻吩、聚咔唑、聚芴等高分子材料，另外，基于给/受体（D/A)共聚物的高分子材料研究也比较深入和广泛。具有良好导电性和光学性质，在有机发光二极管、有机高迁移率场效应晶体管、高效有机太阳能电池以及高分子荧光探针等领域有广泛研究和应用并体现出极大优势。具有驱动电压低、宽发光、响应速度快、超薄、质轻及全固化主动发光等优点，制作于柔性衬底上可实现柔性显示屏的目标，被认为是下一代大屏幕平板显示的首选。另外，具有质轻、价格低廉、可溶液加工、柔性等诸多优点，为解决能源危机提供了可能，成为目前有机光电子材料研究的热点。
explanation_en: It mainly refers to organic materials that can perform photoelectric conversion, including organic small molecule photoelectric materials and optoelectronic polymer materials. Organic small molecule photoelectric materials usually have large conjugate planes and are good organic small molecule semiconductors. Most optoelectronic polymer materials have conjugated backbone, good semiconductor properties, and can achieve efficient photoelectric conversion function. As functional materials related to photoelectric information and energy, their research and development are very rapid. At present, optoelectronic polymer with relatively mature research includes macromolecule materials such as polyacetylene, polythiophene, polycarbazole, polyfluorene, etc. In addition, macromolecule materials based on donor/acceptor (D/A) copolymer have also been studied deeply and extensively. It has good electrical conductivity and optical properties, and has extensive research and application in organic light emitting diode, organic high mobility field effect transistors, efficient organic solar cell, macromolecule fluorescence probes and other fields, showing great advantages. It has the advantages of low driving voltage, wide luminescence, fast response speed, ultra-thin, light weight and full curing active luminescence. It can achieve the goal of flexible display on flexible substrate, and is considered to be the first choice for the next generation of large screen flat panel display. In addition, it has many advantages, such as light weight, low price, solvable processing, flexibility, etc., which makes it possible to solve the energy crisis, and has become a research hotspot of organic optoelectronic materials.

explanation_cn: 又称有机光致变色材料，在适当波长的光辐射下，材料颜色发生可逆变化，实现信息的记录和擦除。某些单一化合物或络合物（A)在受到一定波长的光照后，形成结构不同的另一化合物或络合物(B),当用另一波长的光照射或加热时，又能恢复原来的结构。A和B具有完全不同的吸收光谱。物质发生光致色变有物理和化学两种过程。原子和分子由基态在光诱导下转变为激活态为物理过程。分子吸收光能后引起化学结构变化为化学过程。有机化合物的光致变色过程发生的光化学反应：①闭环开环反应(螺吡喃类）;②反式顺式反应（偶氮苯类）;③光异构化反应（水杨醛缩苯胺）;④光诱质子转移反应（钉配合物）等。有机光致变色材料有以下优点：存储密度高，信噪比大，感度好，速度快，抗酸性好.易加工、毒性小，价格便宜。是一种引人注目的光存储材料。
explanation_en: Also known as organic photochromic materials, under the light radiation of appropriate wavelength, the color of materials changes reversibly to realize the recording and erasure of information. Some single compounds or complexes (A) form another compound or complex (B) with a different structure after being illuminated by a certain wavelength of light. When illuminated or heated by another wavelength of light, the original structure can be restored. A and B have completely different absorption spectrum. There are two processes involved in the occurrence of photochromic change in substances: physical and chemical. The transformation of atoms and molecules from the ground state to the activated state is a physical process. The absorption of light energy by molecules causes a change in chemical structure, which is a chemical process. The photochemical reactions that occur during the photochromic process of organic compounds include: ① closed-loop ring opening reactions (spiropyrans); ② Trans cis reaction (azobenzenes); ③ Photoisomerization reaction (salicylaldehyde aniline acetal); ④ Photoinduced proton transfer reactions (nail complexes), etc. Organic photochromic materials have the following advantages: high storage density, large signal-to-noise ratio, good sensitivity, fast speed, good acid resistance, easy processing, low toxicity and low price. It is an attractive optical storage materials.

explanation_cn: 用作反应堆冷却剂的有机物。某些有机物，例如芳香族有机化合物，可用作反应堆的冷却剂，它具有如下特点：中子吸收截面小，有较好的中子慢化能力，可兼作慢化剂;感生放射性小;蒸气压力低，沸点高，因而冷却系统的压力较低：与铝及铝合金、不锈钢的相容性较好，锆及锆合金在中会产生氢脆现象：有一定的耐辐射分解能力。与水和钠相比，耐辐射分解和传热性能都较差，可能对环境造成有害影响.这些因素限制了的实际应用。
explanation_en: Organic substances used as reactor coolant. Some organic compounds, such as aromatic organic compounds, can be used as reactor coolant, which has the following characteristics: small neutron absorption cross section, good neutron moderation ability, and can also be used as moderator; Low induced radioactivity; The steam pressure is low and the boiling point is high, so the pressure of the cooling system is low: it has good compatibility with aluminum, aluminum alloy, and stainless steel. Zirconium and zirconium alloy will produce hydrogen embrittlement in the: it has certain resistance to mdidysis. Compared with water and sodium, the resistance to mdidysis and heat transfer performance are poor, which may cause harmful effects on the environment. These factors limit the practical application of.

explanation_cn: 具有半导体性质，即导电能力介于金属和绝缘体之间，具有热激活电导率的有机材料称为。可分为小分子、聚合物和电荷转移络合物三类。小分子主要包括多环芳香族化合物、染料、金属有机化合物等;聚合物包括主链为饱和态的聚合物以及各种共轭聚合物，如聚乙烯咔唑、聚苯、聚乙炔等：电荷转移络合物由电子给体和受体两部分组成，给体包括碱金属、四甲基对苯二胺（TMPD)、四硫并四苯（TTT)和三乙基胺（TEA)等，受体包括四氰基乙烯等。有机半导体可以通过掺杂方法调制其导电类型和电阻率。
explanation_en: Organic materials with semiconductor properties, that is, conductivity between metals and insulators, and thermal activated electric conductivity are called. It can be divided into small molecules, polymer and charge transfer complexes. Small molecules mainly include polycyclic aromatic compounds, dye or dyestuffc, organometallic compounds, etc; Polymer include polymer with saturated main chains and various conjugated polymer, such as polyvinylcarbazole, polyphenylene, polyacetylene, etc. Charge transfer complexes are composed of two parts: electron donor and acceptor. The donor includes alkali metal, tetramethyl-p-phenylenediamine (TMPD), tetrathiotetrabenzene (TTT), triethylamine (TEA), etc. The acceptor includes tetracyanoethylene, etc. Organic semiconductor can modulate its conduction type and resistivity by doping method.

explanation_cn: 活性介质在电场的作用下产生光辐射，称为电致发光。当夹在正极和负极（金属电极）之间的活性物质是有机物时的电致发光，即为有机电致发光。有机发光二极管属于载流子注入型发光。其工作原理是：有机发光材料夹在一对电极之间，在外加电场的作用下，空穴由阳极注入，电子由阴极注入。经过相反的方向运动，进入到有机材料层的电子和空穴可以在某个位置相遇.一部分通过复合形成激子，激子经由辐射衰减而产生光。为有利于空穴注入，阳极材料一般要求是高功函材料;阴极材料注人电子，需要功函较低，通常为碱金属、碱土金属或其合金。有机发光二极管前在信息显示和间态照明等方面有着广泛的研究和应用。
explanation_en: Active medium generates light radiation under the action of electric field, which is called electroluminescence. When the active substance sandwiched between the positive electrode and the negative electrode (metal electrode) is an organic substance, electroluminescence is called organic electroluminescence. Organic light emitting diode belongs to carrier injection luminescence. Its working principle is that the organic luminescence materials is sandwiched between a counter electrode. Under the effect of an external electric field, holes are injected by the anode and electrons are injected by the cathode. After moving in the opposite direction, the electrons and holes entering the organic materials layer can meet at some place. Some of them form exciton through composition, and exciton generate light through radiation attenuation. In order to facilitate hole injection, the anode materials is generally required to be a high power materials; Cathode materials, usually alkali metals, alkaline earth metals or their alloy, need low work function to inject electrons. Organic light emitting diode have been widely studied and applied in information display and inter state illumination.

name_cn: 有机发光显示用阴极材料
explanation_cn: 有机电发光显示器（简称LED）中使用的阴极材料一般指电极材料和电子注入材料。电极材料一般使用高功函金属，如像铝（A1，功函4.28eV)、银（Ag,功函4.26eV)或镁/银（Mg/Ag，Mg的功函3.66eV)合金等，电子注入材料一般用碱金属的氟化物或氧化物，例如氟化锂（LiF)、氣化铯（CsF)、氧化锂（Li2O)、偏硼酸锂(LiBO2)等。
explanation_en: Cathode materials used in organic luminescence displays (LED) generally refer to electrode materials and electron injection materials. The electrode materials generally use high-energy metals, such as aluminum (A1, 4.28eV), silver (Ag, 4.26eV) or magnesium/silver (Mg/Ag, 3.66eV of Mg) alloy, etc., and electron injection into materials generally uses fluoride or oxide of alkali metals, such as lithium fluoride (LiF), cesium gasification (CsF), lithium oxide (Li2O), and meta lithium borate (LiBO2).

name_en: organic semiconductors for field- effect transistors
explanation_cn: 通常是含有芳香基团或其他共轭体系的有机半导体材料，分子轨道波函数具有较大的离域范围，在有机场效应晶体管中作为活性层，起载流子的传输作用。需要有高的载流子迁移率和大的电流开关比。按化合物分子量可分为两大类：一是高分子聚合物，如聚噻吩、吡咯并吡咯二酮（DPP)共聚物等;二是有机小分子化合物，如并五苯、红荧烯、茈四羧酸二酰亚胺等。按载流子传输类型可分为以传导空穴为主的P型半导体、以传导电子为主的n型半导体以及双极性材料。在使用中的形态可以是多晶薄膜，也可以是单根或多根微晶体。与多晶硅或其他无机场效应材料相比，的应用有利于实现器件的柔性化和低成本。
explanation_en: It is usually organic semiconductor materials containing aromatic groups or other conjugated systems. The molecular orbital wave function has a large range of delocalization. It acts as the active layer in organic field effect transistors and plays the role of carrier transport. High mobility of current carrier and large current switching ratio are required. According to the molecular weight of compounds, they can be divided into two categories: one is macromolecule polymer, such as polythiophene, pyrrolopyrrolidone (DPP) copolymer, etc; The second is organic small molecule compounds, such as pentacene, red fluorene, tetracarboxylic acid diimide, etc. According to the type of carrier transport, it can be divided into P-type semiconductors dominated by conduction holes, n-type semiconductors dominated by conduction electrons, and bipolar materials. The form in use can be polycrystal film, or single or multiple microcrystals. Compared with polycrystalline silicon or other non field effect materials, its application is conducive to achieving flexibility and low cost of devices.

name_cn: 有机复合型正温度系数热敏电阻
name_en: organic composite positive temperature coefficient thermistor
explanation_cn: 以聚烯烃树脂、尼坨及聚乙烯等高分子材料为基，掺入一定体枳比的炭黑等导电颗粒制成的具有PTC效应的热敏电阻。导电颗粒随机地分布在高聚物构成的母体中，常温下这些导电颗粒彼此相连构成导电链呈现低电阻率。当温度升高到接近有机物熔点时，突然变为非晶态，有机物体积膨胀，部分导电链被切断，致使复合材料电附升高而产生PTC效应。缺点是响应时间长，不适宜用在要求时间快的场合;另一个问题是恢复特性差，即第一次动作后，两次动作之间需要经过较长的冷却时间才能重新恢复原始状态。
explanation_en: The thermistor with PTC effect is made of macromolecule materials such as polyolefin resin, Nito and polyethylene, and conductive particles such as carbon black with a certain volume ratio. Conductive particles are randomly distributed in the parent polymer, and these conductive particles are connected to each other to form a conductive chain at room temperature, showing low resistivity. When the temperature rises to close to the organic melting point, it suddenly becomes amorphous, the organic volume expands, and part of the conductive chain is cut off, resulting in the increase of electrical adhesion of composite materials and PTC effect. The disadvantage is that it has a long response time and is not suitable for use in situations that require fast time; Another issue is poor recovery characteristics, which means that after the first action, a longer cooling time is required between the two actions to restore the original state.

explanation_cn: 指具有类似金属电导性的由电子给体和电子受体组成的有机电荷转移络合物。根据电荷转移程度，复合物晶体可分为分子晶体和电荷转移晶体。在电荷转移晶体中，视离子化程度差异有离子晶体和混合价晶体之分，前者为离子电导，后者为电子电导。金属电导的产生必须满足一定的结构条件和能量条件，即结构上要求D/A分列成柱、分子紧密而有序堆砌、分子以最合理的形式交叠;能量上的条件是有机固体中库仑排斥能量大大减小。有机电荷转移络合物晶体的电导具有不同于金属电导的一些特点：①具有强烈的各向异性，这是由强烈方向性的K电子云所造成的，沿着电子云相互交叠的分子堆砌方向电导最高.而垂直于该方向的电导较差;②具有金属态的失稳性，由于电荷密度波及自旋密度波的产生和有序-无序的转变，晶体生长方向的电导率随温度降低而升高.在一定低温时出现电导峰，然后向半导态和绝缘态转化，所以这种金属态的不稳定性是普遍存在的。
explanation_en: It refers to an organic charge transfer complex composed of electron donor and electron acceptor with similar metal conductivity. According to the degree of charge transfer, the complex crystal can be divided into molecular crystal and charge transfer crystal. In charge transfer crystal, the difference in apparent ionization degree can be divided into ionic crystal and mixed valence crystal. The former is ionic conductivity, and the latter is electronic conductivity. The generation of metal conductivity must meet certain structural and energy conditions, that is, the structure requires D/A to be arranged in columns, molecules to be tightly and orderly stacked, and molecules to overlap in the most reasonable form; The energy condition is that the Coulombic repulsion energy in organic solids is greatly reduced. The conductivity of organic charge transfer complex crystal has some characteristics different from that of metal: ① it has strong anisotropy, which is caused by the strong directional K electron cloud. The conductivity is highest along the molecular stacking direction where the electron clouds overlap each other, while the conductivity perpendicular to this direction is poor; ② It has the instability of metal state. Because of the generation of charge density wave and spin density wave and the transformation from order to disorder, the electric conductivity in the crystal growth direction increases with the decrease of temperature. At a certain low temperature, the conductivity peak appears, and then it transforms to semiconductive state and insulating state, so this instability of metal state is universal.

explanation_cn: 主要以导电聚合物为主，也包括小分子导电材料。其中小分子导电材料主要是指并五笨、红荧烯等有机半导体，导电聚合物乂称导电塑料，当高分子结构拥有较长的共轭链.离域7T键电子不受原子束缚能在聚合链上自由移动，经过掺杂后，使电子或空穴在分子链上自由移动.从而形成导电分子。目前具有导电功能的有机高分子材料主要有：聚乙炔（PA)、聚吡咯（PPY)、聚噻吩(FTH).、聚对亚苯棊乙烯（PPV)、聚苯咹（PANI)及其衍生物等。
explanation_en: Mainly conductive polymer, including small molecule conductive material. Among them, small molecule conductive material mainly refer to organic semiconductor such as pentacene and red fluorescene, and conductive polymer are also called conductive plastics. When the macromolecule structure has a long conjugated chain, the delocalized 7T bond electrons are free to move on the polymer chain without atomic binding energy. After doping, electrons or holes are free to move on the molecular chain, thus forming conductive molecules. At present, the organic macromolecule materials with conductive function mainly include: polyacetylene (PA), polypyrrole (PPY), polythiophene (FTH) Polyphenylene vinylidene (PPV), polyaniline (PANI), and their derivatives.

explanation_cn: 具有良好的屏蔽射线作用的有机物。石蜡、聚乙烯和木材等有机物含有大量的氢原子，常用作中子慢化剂和屏蔽材料。为了提高屏蔽效率，把铅等原子序数大的物质和有机物结合起来使用，例如，含铅量为80%(质量分数）左右的加铅聚乙烯可用于射线的屏蔽;也可把对慢中子和热中子吸收截面大的硼和锂粉末与有机材料混合起来使用，或者做成互相重叠的多层板来使用。例如，含锂为10%(质量分数）以下的加锂聚乙烯感生辐射低，尤其适用于做探测器的屏蔽体。
explanation_en: Organic compounds with good radiation shielding properties. Organic substances such as paraffin, polyethylene and wood contain a large number of hydrogen atoms, which are commonly used as neutron moderators and shielding materials. In order to improve shielding efficiency, substances with high atomic numbers such as lead can be combined with organic compounds. For example, lead-containing polyethylene with a lead content of about 80% (mass fraction) can be used for radiation shielding; The boron and lithium powder with large absorption cross sections for slow neutrons and thermal neutrons can also be mixed with organic materials for use, or made into overlapping multilayer plates for use. For example, lithium containing polyethylene with a mass fraction of 10% or less has low induced radiation, making it particularly suitable for use as a shielding material for detectors.

explanation_cn: 一种主要（或全部）由碳和氢构成的有机化合物慢化剂。碳和氢都具有良好的慢化性能.有机化合物和水一样是良好的慢化剂。如果选用的有机化合物沸点很高，则反应堆一回路的压力比用水时低。此外，一般有机化合物在高温下对材料的腐蚀性比水小。一种叫导热姆的有机混合物在，工业上已被用作冷却剂，它是联（二）苯与二苯醚的低熔点混合物,在此温度范围内热稳定。有机化合物作慢化剂（冷却剂）的困难是它们在辐照下不稳定。
explanation_en: An organic compound moderator mainly (or entirely) composed of carbon and hydrogen. Both carbon and hydrogen have good moderating properties. Organic compounds, like water, are good moderators. If the selected organic compound has a high boiling point, the pressure in the primary circuit of the reactor is lower than when using water. In addition, general organic compounds are less corrosive to materials at high temperatures than water. An organic mixture called Diatom has been used as a coolant in industry. It is a low melting point mixture of biphenyl and diphenyl ether, which is thermally stable within this temperature range. The difficulty of using organic compounds as moderators (coolants) is that they are unstable under irradiation.

explanation_cn: 由有机分子为基本单元构成的具有周期性结构的物质形态称为。其常用的生长方法有溶液析出法和物理气相传输法。溶液法是将晶体原料溶解在一定的溶剂中，采取一定措施使溶剂中的晶体分子达到过饱和状态，如：溶液降温或蒸发.从而析出结晶;在物理气相传输法中，晶体原料在温度较高的加热区域升华。在载气带动下传输到温度较低的生长区域，此时，晶体分子在气相中处于过饱和状态，从而析出结晶。有机晶体与无机晶体相比具有如下的特点：①有机晶体的分子结构更为复杂;②较无机晶体要柔软的多;③在光、电、磁等交互功能效应中具有效率髙、响应快的特点;④热稳定性较差，熔点和沸点较低。目前的主要用途有：有机非线性光学晶体（频率转换晶体、电光晶体等）;有机电学功能晶体（导电晶体、光导晶体、光折变晶体等）。
explanation_en: The form of a substance with a periodic structure composed of organic molecules as the basic units is called. The commonly used growth methods include solution precipitation method and physical gas phase transfer method. The solution method is to dissolve crystal raw materials in a certain solvent and take certain measures to make the crystal molecules in the solvent reach supersaturated state, such as solution cooling or evaporation, so as to precipitate crystals; In the physical vapor transport method, crystal raw materials sublimate in the heating area with higher temperature. Driven by the carrier gas, crystal molecules are transported to the growth region with lower temperature. At this time, the crystal molecules are in the supersaturated state in the gas phase, and then crystallize. Compared with inorganic crystal, organic crystal have the following characteristics: ① the molecular structure of organic crystal is more complex; ② It is much softer than inorganic crystal; ③ It has the characteristics of high efficiency and fast response in interactive functional effects such as light, electricity, and magnetism; ④ Poor thermal stability, low melting point and boiling point. At present, the main applications are: organic nonlinear optical crystal (frequency conversion crystal, electro-optic crystal, etc.); Organic electrical functional crystal (conductive crystal, photoconductive crystal, phot, etc.).

explanation_cn: 是一种通俗的名称，化学名称为聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯，是由甲基丙烯酸甲酯聚合而成的高分子化合物。具有高透明度、低价格、易于机械加工等优点，是平常经常使用的玻璃替代材料，有极好的透光性能，可透过92%以上的可见光，紫外线达73.5%，机械强度较高，有一定的耐热耐寒性，耐腐蚀、绝缘性能良好，尺寸稳定，易于成型，质地较脆.易溶于有机溶剂，表面硬度不够、容易擦毛，可作要求有一定强度的透明结构件，如油杯、车灯、仪表零件、光学镜片、装饰礼品等。在里面加人一些添加剂可以提高其性能，如耐热、耐摩擦等。有机玻璃不仅能用车床进行切削、钻床进行钻孔，而且能用丙酮、氯仿等黏结成各种形状的器具，也能用吹塑、注射、挤出等塑料成型的方法加工成大到飞机座舱盖、小到义齿和牙托等形形色色的制品。另一方面，该材料广泛地应用于广告灯箱、铭牌等方面的制作;由于其稳定性，在医学领域也有一定的应用。
explanation_en: It is a popular name, and its chemical name is polymethyl methacrylate. It is a macromolecule compound formed by polymerization of methyl methacrylate. It has the advantages of high transparency, low price, easy machining, etc. It is a commonly used glass substitute for materials. It has excellent light transmittance, can penetrate more than 92% of visible light, and can reach 73.5% of ultraviolet light. It has high mechanical strength, certain heat and cold resistance, corrosion resistance, good insulation performance, stable size, easy molding, brittle texture, easy to dissolve in organic solvents, insufficient surface hardness, and easy to scratch, Can be used as transparent structural components with certain strength requirements, such as oil cups, car lights, instrument parts, optical lenses, decorative gifts, etc. Adding some additive in it can improve its performance, such as heat resistance, friction resistance, etc. Organic glass can not only be cut by lathe and drilled by drilling machine, but also be bonded into various shapes with acetone, chloroform and other tools. It can also be processed into various products, ranging from airplane canopy to demure and denture base, by plastics molding methods such as blow molding, injection and extrusion. On the other hand, the materials is widely used in the production of advertising light boxes, nameplates, etc; Due to its stability, it also has certain applications in the medical field.

explanation_cn: 构成有机发光二极管，即有机电激发光的关键有机材料，主要包括有机小分子和聚合物两种类型。典型的有机发光二极管由阴极、电子传输层、发光层、空穴传输层和阳极组成，且至少有一侧为透明电极.比较常用的透明电极是铟锡氧化物。电子从阴极注人到电子传输层，空穴由阳极注人进空穴传输层，它们在发光层重新结合而产生光子，根据发光层的发光半导体材料的不同特性，产生红、绿和蓝三原色光甚至白光。有机/聚合物发光材料主要包括荧光材料、磷光材料和热活化延迟荧光材料等三类。有机发光二极管具有自发光性、广视角、高对比度、高响应速率、低功耗、质量轻、厚度薄、柔性好、构造简单、成本低、全固态、抗震性好等优点，被应用于新一代的平板显示和白光照明，被视为21世纪最具前途的技术之一。
explanation_en: The key organic materials that constitute organic light emitting diode, namely electromechanical luminescence, mainly include organic small molecules and polymer. A typical organic light emitting diode consists of a cathode, an electron transport layer, a luminescence layer, a hole transport layer, and an anode, and at least one side is a transparent electrode. A more common transparent electrode is indium tin oxide. Electrons are injected into the electron transport layer from the cathode, and holes are injected into the hole transport layer from the anode. They are recombined in the luminescence layer to generate photons. According to the different characteristics of the luminescence semiconductor materials of the luminescence layer, red, green, blue and even white light are generated. Organic/polymer luminescence materials mainly include fluorescence materials, phosphorescence materials and thermally activated delayed fluorescence materials. Organic light emitting diode have the advantages of self luminescence, wide viewing angle, high contrast, high response rate, low power consumption, light weight, thin thickness, good flexibility, simple structure, low cost, all solid state, good seismic resistance, etc. They are used in the new generation of flat panel display and white light lighting, and are regarded as one of the most promising technologies in the 21st century.

explanation_cn: 以有机盐为先驱体，通过各种化学反应制备陶瓷粉末的方法。有机盐是由金属元素和有机极性基团组成的一类有机金属化合物。包括气相法和液相法。气相法又称金属有机化学气相沉积、金属有机气相外延是一种新的化学气相沉积（CVD)技术。利用低温下易分解、挥发的金属有机化合物作为源物质进行化学气相沉积的方法。在MOCVD过程中，金属有机源可以通过热解或光解作用.在较低温度下沉积出相应的各种无机材料，如金属、氧化物、氮化物、氟化物、碳化物和半导体等粉末或薄膜。液相法即通过液相体系合成粉末的方法。目前醇盐水解法是比较常用的方法。金属醇盐一般可溶于乙醇，遇水后很容易分解成醇和氧化物或其水合物。金属醇盐具有挥发性，而易于精制。因为金属醇盐水解时不需添加其他阳离子和阴离子，所以能获得高纯度的生成物。根据不同的水解条件，可以得到颗粒直径几纳米到几十纳米的化学组成均匀的粉末，是制备单一或复合氧化物高纯超细粉末的重要方法。
explanation_en: The method of preparing ceramics powder with organic salt as precursor through various chemical reactions. Organic salts are a class of organometallic compounds composed of metal elements and organic polar groups. Including gas phase method and liquid phase method. Vapor deposition, also known as metal organic chemical vapor deposition method and metal organic vapor phase epitaxy, is a new chemical vapor deposition (CVD) technology. The method of chemical vapor deposition using metal organic compounds that are easy to decompose and volatilize at low temperature as source materials. In the MOCVD process, the metal organic source can deposit various corresponding inorganic materials, such as metal, oxide, nitride, fluoride, carbide, semiconductor and other powder or films at lower temperatures through pyrolysis or photolysis. Liquid phase method is a method of synthesizing powder through liquid phase system. At present, the hydrolysis of alcohol and salt water is a commonly used method. Metal alkoxides are generally soluble in ethanol and can easily decompose into alcohols, oxides, or their hydrates when exposed to water. Metal alkoxides are volatile and easy to refine. Because metal alcohols do not require the addition of other cations and anions during hydrolysis, high-purity products can be obtained. According to different hydrolysis conditions, powder with uniform chemical composition and particle diameter of several nanometers to tens of nanometers can be obtained, which is an important method to prepare high-purity and ultra-fine powder of single or composite oxides.

explanation_cn: 油含量一般在20%-30%,pH值6-8。离心稳定性（3000r/min)1530min。表面张力小，对水的接触角大，耐热，抗氧化。由八甲基环四硅氧烷在阴离子表面活性剂，如十二烷基磺酸钠或阳离子表面活性剂如十六烷基三甲基溴化铵和催化剂存在下，进行乳液聚合而制取。是一种性能优良的纺织化学整理剂.常用作织物的柔弹滑爽整理、仿丝绸整理、仿毛整理、拒水防水整理等，可单独使用或与其他整理剂拼混使用。用它整理的织物，可获得舒适化、风格化、高档化、功能化的质量效果。
explanation_en: The oil content is generally between 20% -30%, with a pH value of 6-8. Centrifuge stability (3000r/min) 1530min. Low surface tension, large contact angle to water, heat resistance, oxidation resistance. It is prepared by emulsion polymerization of octamethylcyclotetrasiloxane in the presence of anionic surfactant such as sodium dodecyl sulfonate or cationic surfactant such as hexadecyl trimethylammonium bromide and catalyst. It is a high-performance textile chemical finishing agent commonly used for soft and smooth finishing of fabrics, silk like finishing, wool like finishing, water repellent and waterproof finishing, etc. It can be used alone or mixed with other finishing agents. The fabric treated with it can achieve comfortable, stylized, high-end, and functional quality effects.

explanation_cn: 简称有机硅。含有硅元素的有机化合物的统称。
explanation_en: It is abbreviated as organic silicon. A general term for organic compounds containing silicon.

name_cn: 有机硅树脂基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以有机硅树脂为基体的复合材料。有机硅树脂是一类由硅原子和氧原子交替连接组成骨架，不同的有机基团再与硅原子连接的聚合物的统称通常由有机氯硅烷经水解缩合而成，分子上有活性基团，可进一步固化，属热固性树脂。其结构中既含有"有机基团"，又含有"无机结构"，这种特殊的组成和分子结构使它集有机物持性与无机物功能于一身。有机硅树脂兼具优良的耐热性、电绝缘性与耐电弧性、且受湿度的影响极小，但存在力学性能较差、固化时间长、耐有机溶剂性能差等缺点，因此常用其他有机树脂改性以弥补其缺点。其常用的增强体有碳纤维、玻璃纤维及其织物等。有机硅树脂复合材料适用的成型工艺有模压成型、真空袋成型、液体成型等。该类复合材料广泛应用于火箭、宇航、飞机制造工业、无线电、电工及其他工业，如玻璃布增强有机硅树脂基复合材料可用作电机的槽楔绝缘、高温继电器外壳、飞机的雷达罩、飞机的耐火墙等。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on silicone resin. Organosilicon resin is a kind of polymer composed of silicon atoms and oxygen atoms alternately connected to form a skeleton, and different organic groups are connected with silicon atoms. It is usually formed by hydrolysis and condensation of organochlorosilane. There are active groups on the molecule, which can be further curing. It is a thermosetting resin. Its structure contains both "organic groups" and "inorganic structures", and this special composition and molecular structure make it a combination of organic and inorganic functions. Organic silicon resin has excellent heat resistance, electrical insulation and arc resistance, and is little affected by humidity. However, it has poor mechanical properties, long curing time, poor resistance to organic solvents and other shortcomings. Therefore, other organic resin are often modified to make up for its shortcomings. The commonly used reinforcements are carbon fiber, glass fiber and its fabrics. The suitable molding processes of organic silicone resin composite materials include press molding, vacuum bag molding, liquid molding, etc. This kind of composite materials is widely used in rocket, aerospace, aircraft manufacturing industry, radio, electrician and other industries, such as glass cloth reinforced silicone resin matrix composite can be used as slot wedge insulation of motor, high-temperature relay housing, aircraft radome, aircraft fire wall, etc.

explanation_cn: 使成型后的模制品易与模具分离而事先在模具上涂覆的一层有机隔离材料。分硅油型、溶液型、乳液型和硅脂咽四类。主要组成为硅油、填料、添加剂、乳化剂和溶剂等。具有优异的不黏性、耐热和抗氧化性.化学性能稳定，不易挥发.对模具不腐蚀、不污染，无毒无味。用于塑料成型、橡胶加工、金属铸造、造纸、纤维、食品加工等。模塑出的产品表面光洁.可提高劳动生产率和产品质量。
explanation_en: A layer of organic isolation materials coated on the mold in advance to make the molded product easy to separate from the mold. It can be divided into four types: silicone oil type, solution type, lotion type and silicone grease grease type. The main components are silicone oil, filler, additive, emulsifier, solvent, etc. It has excellent stickiness, heat resistance and oxidation resistance. It has stable chemical properties and is not easy to volatilize. It does not corrosion or pollute the mold, and is non-toxic and tasteless. Used for plastics molding, rubber processing, metal foundry, paper making, fiber, food processing, etc. The surface of the molded product is smooth and can improve labor productivity and product quality.

explanation_cn: 见离子交换树脂。
explanation_en: See ion exchange resin.

explanation_cn: 由有机聚合物制成的纤维状质，简称有机纤维。按原料来源可分为合成纤维和天然高分子纤维。合成纤维来源于煤、天然气、石油、石灰石和农副产品加工提炼出来的有机物质，经化学合成为高分子化合物，将高分子化合物的溶液或熔体从喷丝头细孔中压出，再经凝固而成。如聚酯、聚酰胺、聚烯烃、聚氟烯烃等纤维增强材料。天然高分子纤维是指自然界生长和存在的可用于纺织或用于增强材料的一类纤维.包括植物纤维、动物纤维等。
explanation_en: The fibrous substance made of organic polymer is called organic fiber for short. According to the source of raw materials, it can be divided into synthetic fibers and natural polymer fibers. Synthetic fibers are derived from organic substances extracted from coal, natural gas, petroleum, limestone and agricultural by-products. They are chemically synthesized into macromolecule compounds, which are pressed out of the pores of the spinneret and then solidified. Such as polyester, polyamide, polyolefin, polyfluoroolefin and other fiber reinforcement materials. Natural polymer fiber refers to a kind of fiber that grows and exists in nature and can be used for textile or reinforcement materials, including plant fiber, animal fiber, etc.

explanation_cn: 主要组分为有机化合物的一类延期药。目前主要有苦味酸金属盐类、硝基酚盐类、有机高分子材料、弱起爆药类、梯恩梯-金属盐类等。按组分类型通常又可分为单质延期药、混合延期药、共晶延期药等。单质延期药有苦味酸钾、三硝基间苯二酚钡（羧甲基纤维素钠为控制剂）、二硝基间苯二酚的铅盐、钡盐等，可选择不同的晶形控制剂和黏合剂，控制其含量以达到调节燃速之目的。混合型有：三硝基间苯二酚钡、硝基萘与碳的混合物;与梯恩梯混合的常用药剂有二代亚磷酸铅、氯酸钾、高锰酸钾、氧化钡等，其静电感度低，并有良好的储存稳定性;苦味酸钾与黑索金、奥克托今混合，是一种延期精度高、燃烧性能稳定的有机延期药。
explanation_en: A kind of delay composition whose main components are organic compounds. At present, there are mainly picric acid metal salts, nitrophenol salts, organic macromolecule materials, weak primary explosives, 2,4,6-trinitrotoluene metal salts, etc. According to the type of components, it can be divided into simple delay composition, mixed delay composition, eutectic delay composition, etc. The simple delay composition include potassium picrate, barium trinitroresorcinol (sodium carboxymethyl cellulose as the control agent), lead salt and barium salt of dinitroresorcinol, etc. Different crystal shape control agents and adhesive can be selected to control their content to achieve the purpose of regulating burning rate. Mixed types include: a mixture of barium dinitroresorcinol, nitronaphthalene, and carbon; Commonly used reagents mixed with 2,4,6-trinitrotoluene include second-generation lead phosphite, potassium chlorate, potassium permanganate, barium oxide, etc., which have low static inductance and good storage stability; Potassium picrate mixed with hexogen and octogen is an organic delay composition with high delay precision and stable combustion performance.

explanation_cn: 有机分子晶体在一定压力和低温条件下，电阻表现为零时称为有机超导体。超导有两个基本现象：一是从有限电阻状态向零电阻状态的过渡;二是外磁场不能穿透超导体内，被称为迈斯纳效应。此外超导体在临界温度时还会出现其他性质如比热容、热电动势、霍尔效应和红外吸收等的突变。因此，可以通过在静压下临界温度、临界磁场、临界电流等来表征和确认超导体。关于有机超导理论仍有争论，它的应用已开始探索，可以压成块材或制成薄膜来制造有机超导器件。
explanation_en: Organic molecular crystal is called organic superconductor when its resistance is zero under certain pressure and low temperature. There are two basic phenomena in superconductivity: firstly, the transition from a finite resistance state to a zero resistance state; The other is that the external magnetic field cannot penetrate the superconductor, which is called the Meissner effect. In addition, other properties of superconductors such as specific heat [capacity, thermoelectric electromotive force, Hall effect and infrared absorption will change abruptly at the critical temperature. Therefore, superconductors can be characterized and confirmed by critical temperature, critical magnetic field, critical current, etc. under static pressure. There is still debate about the theory of organic superconductivity, and its applications have begun to be explored, which can be pressed into blocks or made into thin films to manufacture organic superconducting devices.

explanation_cn: 是二说基二硫代磷酸氧钼、二烷基二硫代氨基甲酸钥、钼胺络合物、环烷酸钼、烷基水杨酸钼等油溶性化合物的总称。添加剂能够改善润滑油的抗磨、抗氧和抗腐性能。满足低黏度、低磷化、长寿命的需求，可用于内燃机油、齿轮油、润滑脂和工业用油中，显著改善润滑剂的抗磨减磨性能。
explanation_en: It is a general term for oil soluble compounds such as molybdenum dithiophosphate, dialkyl dithiocarbamate, molybdenum amine complexes, molybdenum naphthenate, and molybdenum alkylsalicylate. Additive can improve the anti-wear, anti-oxidation and anti-corrosion properties of lubricating oil. It can meet the requirements of low viscosity, low phosphorizing and long life. It can be used in internal combustion engine oil, gear oil, grease and industrial oil, and significantly improve the anti-wear and antifriction performance of lubricant.

explanation_cn: 具有铁磁性质的有机材料，又称磁性有机化合物。分为三大类：①分子晶体，包括自由基晶体及电荷转移盐晶体;②有机金属化合物，包括电子转移络合物及有机金属聚合物;③有机聚合物，包括有机聚卡宾体系、稳定自由基取代二炔体系及一些其他体系。这类不含有金属的常被称为纯有机铁磁材料。
explanation_en: Organic materials with ferromagnetic properties are also called magnetic organic compounds. It can be divided into three categories: ① molecular crystal, including free radical crystal and charge transfer salt crystal; ② Organometallic compounds, including electron transfer complexes and organometallic polymer; ③ Organic polymer include organic polycarbene system, stable radical substituted diyne system and some other systems. This kind of metal free material is often called pure organic ferromagnetic materials.

explanation_cn: 用于静电复印的具有光导性的有机化合物和高分子化合物，简称OPC。自1969年美国IBM公司开发出聚乙烯咔唑和三硝基芴酮的电荷转移复合物作为静电复印材料后，使有机光导体进入了实用阶段。目前，使用有机光导复印材料的静电复印机占总数的50%以上，并呈继续上升趋势。用于静电复印材料的有机光导体主要有：酞菁类颜料、斯夸尔系颜料、双偶氮颜料、菲系颜料、噻喃镐盐、聚乙烯咔唑-三硝基芴酮的电荷转移复合物等。它们具有以下优点：双重导电性（既可空穴导电，也可电子导电）;根据所需性能，可自行设计分子结构，进行材料合成;易加工成型.工艺简便，成本较低;毒性低、环境污染少。不足之处在于耐印率和光敏性不及非晶硅和硫化镉，尚待进一步研究提高。
explanation_en: Organic compounds and macromolecule compounds with photoconductivity used for xerography are called OPC for short. Since 1969, IBM developed the charge transfer complex of polyethylene carbazole and trinitrofluorenone as electrophotographic materials, the organic photoconductor has entered the practical stage. At present, more than 50% of the electrostatic photocopiers use organic photoconductive materials, and the trend continues to rise. The organic photoconductors used for electrophotographic materials mainly include: phthalocyanine pigment, Squar pigment, bisazo pigment, phenanthrene pigment, thiopyranous salts, polyethylene carbazole trinitrofluorenone charge transfer complexes, etc. They have the following advantages: dual conductivity (both hole conduction and electronic conduction); According to the required properties, we can design the molecular structure and synthesize materials by ourselves; Easy to process and shape, simple process, and low cost; Low toxicity and minimal environmental pollution. The disadvantage is that the print resistance and photosensitivity are lower than those of amorphous silicon and vulcanization, which needs further research and improvement.

explanation_cn: 具有大的二阶非线性极化率，或在强激光作用下产生三阶非线性极化响应等非线性光学性质的有机小分子或高分子材料。
explanation_en: Organic small molecules or macromolecule materials with large second-order nonlinear polarizability, or third-order nonlinear polarization response under intense laser action.

explanation_cn: 一类能产生絮凝作用的天然或人工合成的水溶性有机高分子物质。大多属于线型高分子聚合物，分子量大、官能团多，具有很强的吸附能力。絮凝机理主要有吸附交联和电中和作用。吸附交联作用：高聚物线型长度较大，可以在相距较远的两胶粒之间进行吸附、交联;当它的一端吸附某一胶粒后，另一端伸入水中又吸附另一胶粒，形成微粒-高分子-微粒的结构;各个高分子再互相搭接，形成大的絮凝体在重力作用下沉降。电中和作用，分子链上的带电官能团可以中和异性电荷物质，使可溶物生成不溶物，还可以中和胶体颗粒表面的负电荷，压缩双电层，降低电位，使胶体颗粒相互吸引絮凝，在重力作用下失稳沉降。根据官能团带电性可分为阴离子型、阳离子型、两性型及非离子型的天然或人工合成高分子絮凝剂。与无机絮凝剂相比，有机高分子絮凝剂用量小、沉降速度快、絮凝效果明显、受共存盐类、介质及环境温度影响小、产生的絮体粗大、处理过程时间短、产生的污泥容易处理等特点，但成本高，广泛应用于高浓度、高浊度、高色度及特殊臭味废水的处理。
explanation_en: A kind of natural or synthetic water-soluble organic macromolecule that can produce flocculation. Most of them are linear macromolecule polymer with large molecular weight, many functional groups and strong adsorption capacity. The flocculation mechanism mainly includes adsorption crosslinking and electric neutralization. Adsorption crosslinking effect: the linear length of the polymer is large, and it can be adsorbed and crosslinking between two colloidal particles far away; When one end of it adsorbs a certain colloidal particle, the other end extends into the water and adsorbs another colloidal particle, forming the structure of particle macromolecule particle; Each macromolecule is then overlapped to form a large floc that settles under gravity. Electroneutralization: The charged functional groups on the molecular chain can neutralize heterotopic charged substances, causing soluble substances to form insoluble substances. It can also neutralize the negative charges on the surface of colloidal particles, compress the double layer, reduce the potential, and cause colloidal particles to attract and flocculate with each other, causing instability and sedimentation under the action of gravity. According to the electrification of functional groups, they can be divided into anionic, cationic, amphoteric and non-ionic natural or synthetic macromolecule coagulant. Compared with inorganic coagulant, organic polymeric flocculant has the characteristics of small dosage, fast settling speed, obvious flocculation effect, little influence by coexisting salts, media and environmental temperature, large flocs generated, short treatment process time, easy treatment of sludge generated, but high cost, and is widely used in the treatment of wastewater with high concentration, high turbidity, high chroma and special odor.

explanation_cn: 若以晶体的交于一点的三个晶棱作为坐标轴，并以单位晶面在此S轴上的截距作为度量单位，则晶体的任何晶面在此三轴上截距的倒数比可按比例化为简单的互质整数比。晶面的指数表示法正是根据此定律而建立起来的。
explanation_en: If the three edges of the crystal at the intersection of a point are taken as the coordinate axis, and the intercept of the unit crystal plane on the S-axis is taken as the measurement unit, then the reciprocal ratio of the intercept of any crystal plane of the crystal on the three-axis can be proportionally reduced to a simple coprime integer ratio. The exponential representation of crystal planes is based on this law.

explanation_cn: 对特定波长的可见光、紫外线或红外线具有选择性吸收和透过性能的光学玻璃，又称为滤光玻璃。它的一般理论、工艺原理、生产方式和质量要求等类似于无色光学玻璃。其主要技术要求是必须具有严格的光谱特性。为了达到一定的光谱特性，一般在原料中加入适量的着色剂，按一定的工艺制度熔制而成。按玻璃的透光曲线可分截止型、选择吸收型和中性灰色滤光玻璃三类。品种有紫色、蓝色、蓝绿色、黄色、橙色、红色等及透紫外、透红外、吸热、色温变换玻璃等。是照相机、电影、电视、光学仪器等T业的重要光学材料。在彩色电影摄影中，作为滤光器来改变景物的色调，明暗反差和制造某种气氛。若采用红色滤光玻璃，可创造出晨曦、黄昏的气氛。采用蓝色滤光玻璃，可创造出夜景或暴风雨气氛。采用黄色滤光玻璃可增加反差和表现云彩。资源卫星、气象卫星用的高级彩色摄影机，遗传学研究细胞内部结构中的荧光显微镜，激光全息摄影装置，各类光谱仪器等，都需要特殊性能的滤光玻璃。
explanation_en: Optical glass with selective absorption and transmission of visible light, ultraviolet or infrared light of a specific wavelength is also called filter glass. Its general theory, process principle, production mode and quality requirements are similar to colorless optical glass. Its main technical requirement is to have strict spectral characteristics. In order to achieve certain spectral characteristics, an appropriate amount of colorant is usually added to the raw material and melted according to a certain process system. According to the light transmission curve of glass, it can be divided into cut-off type, selective absorption type and neutral gray filter glass. Varieties include purple, blue, blue-green, yellow, orange, red, ultraviolet, infrared, heat absorption, color-temperature changing glass, etc. It is an important optical materials for camera, film, television, optical instrument and other industries. In color film photography, it serves as a filter to change the color tone, contrast between light and dark, and create a certain atmosphere. If red filter glass is used, the atmosphere of dawn and dusk can be created. Blue filter glass is used to create the night scene or storm atmosphere. The use of yellow filter glass can increase contrast and show clouds. Advanced color cameras for resource satellites and meteorological satellites, fluorescence microscopes for genetic research on the internal structure of cells, laser holography devices, and various spectral instruments all need filter glass with special performance.

explanation_cn: 又称为定向聚合物或立构规整聚合物。是链结构具有高度立构规整性的聚合物。立构规整聚合物占聚合物总量的百分数称为立构规整度。
explanation_en: It is also called directional polymer or stereo regular polymer. It is a polymer with highly stereoregularity in chain structure. The percentage of stereo regular polymer in the total amount of polymer is called degree of tacticity.

explanation_cn: 又称转子硫化仪。将未硫化橡胶放入有转子的恒温模腔内，在转子的水平摆动剪切作用下，测定胶料硫化过程中对转子反作用力矩（表征硫化程度）连续变化的仪器。仪器工作原理是测定胶料在硫化过程中剪切模量的变化，而剪叻模量与交联密度成正比，因此测定结果反映了胶料在硫化过程中交联程度的变化，可以测出胶料初始黏度、焦烧时间、硫化速度、正硫化时间和过硫返原性等重要参数。按测定原理可分两大类型：第一类是对胶料施加一定振幅的力，测定相应的变形量，如华莱土硫化仪和阿克发硫化仪;另一类对胶料施加一定振幅的剪切变形，测出相应的剪切力，包括有转子和无转子圆盘振荡硫化仪。
explanation_en: Also known as rotor vulcanizer. The unvulcanized rubber is put into the constant temperature mold cavity with a rotor, and under the horizontal swing shear of the rotor, the instrument is used to measure the continuous change of the reaction torque (representing the curing degree) of the rubber compound to the rotor during vulcanization. The working principle of the instrument is to measure the change of shear modulus of rubber compound during vulcanization, and the shear modulus is proportional to the crosslinking density. Therefore, the measurement results reflect the change of crosslinking degree of rubber compound during vulcanization, and can measure the initial viscosity, scorching time, vulcanization speed, positive vulcanization time, over sulfur reversibility and other important parameters of rubber compound. According to the principle of measurement, it can be divided into two types: the first type is to apply a certain amplitude of force to the rubber material and measure the corresponding deformation, such as the Hualai soil vulcanization instrument and the Akfa vulcanization instrument; Another type applies a certain amplitude of shear deformation to the rubber material, and measures the corresponding shear force, including a rotary and non rotary disc oscillating vulcanizer.

explanation_cn: 见六方金刚石。
explanation_en: See hexagonal diamond.

explanation_cn: 由木纤维或植物纤维填充改性的热塑性树脂基复合材料，经过挤出、压制或注射成型成板材或者其他制品，可以代替木材和塑料。木质材料可以选用单板，木纤维等整体材料，亦可选用木刨花、纸浆、锯末、木粉等工业废料或秸秆、谷壳、甘蔗渣等农业废弃物；热塑性基体树脂主要采用聚丙烯、聚乙烯、聚苯乙烯、聚氯乙烯等，可采用螺杆挤出机挤出成型、热压成塑和挤爪成型等。木塑复合材料可以应用于家具、建筑、化工、车辆船舶、包装运输等各个领域。木塑新材料既保留了木材在加工性能方面的优势，又克服了木材不耐用的缺陷，同时其生产原料取自于工业废料，是一种极具有发展前途的绿色环保材料。
explanation_en: The thermoplastic resin based composite materials filled and modified by wood fiber or plant fiber can be extruded, pressing or injection molding into plates or other products, which can replace wood and plastics. Wood materials can be monolithic materials such as veneer and wood fiber, or industrial wastes such as wood shavings, pulp, sawdust, wood flour, or agricultural wastes such as straw, chaff, and sugarcane slag; Thermoplastic matrix resin mainly adopts polypropylene, polyethylene, polystyrene, polyvinyl chloride, etc. It can be extrusion molding by screw extruder, hot pressing, extrusion claw, etc. Wood plaslic composite can be used in furniture, construction, chemicals, vehicles, ships, packaging and transportation and other fields. The new wood plastic materials not only retains the advantages of wood in processing performance, but also overcomes the defects of wood's durability. At the same time, its production raw materials are from industrial waste, which is a green and environmental materials with great development prospects.

explanation_cn: 指木本植物维管组织的次生木质部，是形成层向内部分形成的，即由髓心到韧皮部之间的细胞组织作为原材料使用。由裸子植物获得的木材称针叶树材；由一部分被子植物中的双子叶植物获得的木材称阔叶树材。英、美等国通称针叶树材为软阔叶材为硬木材由纤维素、半纤维素和木质素等构成。木材是一种多孔性、各向异性材料，在径向、横向、弦向上表现不同的性质。具有质量轻、强重比、易于制成各种形状的木制品、木构件和美术工艺品等特点，而且有较好的绝缘性。在传统的建筑材料中，以木材的绝缘性能最佳。热损失仅为普通砖的1/6，一般混凝土的1/5,钢的1/390,铝的1/1700，电传导性差。常用来做绝缘材料有美丽的花纹和天然雅致的颜色，是装饰的好材料。木材是森林的主产品，是可以永续利用的再生资源，除了做建筑、家具、乐器、电杆、枕木、坑木、桥梁外，还可制造各种多功能的人造板。木材的易胀缩、易腐朽、易蛀浊、易燃等缺陷，可通过改性、防腐、防虫、阻燃等处理，以提高其利用价值。
explanation_en: Refers to the secondary xylem of woody plant vascular tissue, which is formed from the inward part of the cambium, that is, the cellular tissue between the pith and the phloem is used as the raw material. Wood obtained from gymnosperms is called coniferous wood; Wood obtained from dicotyledons in some angiosperms is called broad-leaved wood. In Britain, the United States and other countries, softwood and hardwood are commonly called softwood and hardwood. wood is composed of cellulose, semi cellulose and lignin. Wood is a porous and anisotropic materials, which has different properties in radial, transverse and chord directions. It has the characteristics of light weight, strength to weight ratio, easy to make various shapes of wooden products, wooden components, and art crafts, and has good insulation. Among the traditional building materials, wood has the best insulation performance. The heat loss is only 1/6 of ordinary brick, 1/5 of ordinary concrete, 1/390 of steel, 1/1700 of aluminum, and the electrical conductivity is poor. It is often used as an insulating materials with beautiful patterns and natural and elegant colors, and is a good materials for decoration. Wood is the main product of the forest and a renewable resource that can be used forever. In addition to building, furniture, musical instruments, poles, crosstie, pitlogs and bridges, it can also be used to manufacture various multi-functional wood based-panel. The defects of wood, such as easy expansion and contraction, easy decay, easy moth, and flammability, can be improved through modification, anti-corrosion, insect prevention, flame retardant and other treatments to improve its utilization value.

explanation_cn: 木材与其承受外力荷载或抵抗变形能力有关的性质，包括木材抗弯强度、抗压强度、抗拉强度等。荷载包括静荷载和动荷载，木材受外力或荷载作用时，其内部产生的抵抗力称应力。在应力方向，木材单位长度发生的变化称为应变。由于木材构造具有非均一性和各向异性，而且不可避免存在不同程度的缺陷.因此木材力学性质具有较大的变异性。
explanation_en: The properties of wood related to its ability to bear external loads or resist deformation, including bending strength, compressive strength, tensile strength, etc. of wood. Load includes static load and dynamic load. When wood is subjected to external force or load, its internal resistance is called stress. In the direction of stress, the change of unit length of wood is called strain. Because of the heterogeneity and anisotropy of wood structure, and the inevitable existence of different degrees of defects, mechanical properties of wood have greater variability.

explanation_cn: 指木材中水分的含量。又称木材含水量。用木材中水分的质量与木材的质量之比的百分数(％)表示。含水率以全干木材质量作为计算基础，得出的数值称为绝对含水率，简称含水率。在生产实践中一般以此作为计算木材水分含量的标准。含水率以湿材质量作为计算基础，得出的数值称相对含水率。测定含水率有重量法(干燥法)、蒸馏法和导电法等，其中最常用的是重量法。生材含水率一般指刚采伐木材的含水率。通常边材含水率高于心材，针叶材中早材含水率高于晚材。
explanation_en: It refers to the water content in wood. It is also called wood moisture content. It is expressed as the percentage (%) of the ratio of the mass of water in wood to the mass of wood. The water content is calculated on the basis of the quality of fully dried wood, and the value obtained is called absolute water content, or water content for short. In production practice, it is generally used as the standard for calculating wood moisture content. The moisture content is calculated based on the mass of the wet material, and the resulting value is called the relative moisture content. There are methods for measuring moisture content, such as gravimetric method (drying method), distillation method, and conductivity method, among which the most commonly used is gravimetric method. The moisture content of green wood generally refers to the moisture content of newly harvested wood. Usually, the moisture content of sapwood is higher than that of heartwood, and the moisture content of early wood is higher than that of late wood in coniferous wood.

explanation_cn: 指侵入水中的木材吸取水分的能力。吸水速度指吸水至饱和状态所需用的时间，或单位时间(一昼夜)内木材的吸水量。吸水性以木材吸水至饱和状态时的含水率，即吸水率表示。当木材的细胞腔和细胞壁中各充满了自由水和吸着水时，木材的含水率就是吸水率。木材的细胞腔内有自由水，细胞壁中有吸着水和以化学共价键结合的化学水。木材是多孔性毛细管胶体的固体，其吸附能力比一般同体更强。木材的吸水有毛细管和吸附两种现象。干木材侵人水中后.水首先进人横切的细胞腔内。因为水的亲和力比较大，并能润湿细胞壁，借氢键力将吸着水束缚在木材细胞壁的纤维素、半纤维素和木素等的羟基上。细胞壁吸附足够的吸着水，并在细胞腔表面形成一层连续的吸附膜后以毛细管作用继续吸水。顺纹理方向吸水最快，弦向次之，径向最慢。密度小和体积小的木材吸水快而多。边材比心材吸水性强。水(或液体)温度愈高，吸水愈快。木材侵入水中开始时吸水很快，然后速度减慢，至饱和状态(即细胞内充满了自由水和吸着水)吸水就停止了。木材的吸水性对防腐性等药剂的侵入、油漆、涂料等都有实用意义。
explanation_en: It refers to the ability of wood invading water to absorb water. Water absorption rate refers to the time required for water absorption to reach saturation, or the water absorption capacity of wood in unit time (one day and night). Water absorption is expressed as the water content of wood when it absorbs water to saturation, that is, water absorption. When the cell cavity and cell wall of wood are filled with free water and absorbed water respectively, the moisture content of wood is the water absorption rate. There is free water in the cell cavity of wood, and there are adsorbed water and chemical water bound by chemical covalent bond in the cell wall. Wood is a solid of porous capillary tube colloid, and its adsorption capacity is stronger than that of common congeners. Water absorption of wood has two phenomena: capillary tube and adsorption. After the dry wood invades into the water, the water head is advanced into the cell lumen crosscut by human beings. Because the affinity of water is relatively large, it can wet the cell wall, and bind the adsorbed water to the hydroxyl groups of cellulose, semi cellulose and ligin in the cell wall of wood by hydrogen bonding force. The cell wall absorbs enough adsorbed water, and forms a continuous adsorption membrane on the surface of the cell cavity, and then continues to absorb water by capillary tube action. The water absorption is fastest along the texture direction, followed by the chord direction, and slowest in the radial direction. Wood with small density and volume absorbs water quickly and more. Sapwood has stronger water absorption than heartwood. The higher the temperature of water (or liquid), the faster it absorbs water. Wood absorbs water quickly at the beginning when it invades water, and then slows down to the saturation state (that is, the cells are full of free water and absorbed water). The water absorption of wood is of practical significance to the invasion of antiseptic agents, paints, coatings, etc.

explanation_cn: 当木材含水率低于平衡含水率时，从空气中吸取水蒸气及其他液态蒸气，称为吸湿。反之，当木材含水率高于平衡含水率时.即比大气湿润时，木材中的水分就会蒸发到空气中去，称为解湿。木材具有较高的孔隙率和巨大的表面积、具有吸附作用和毛细管凝结现象。当木材和水蒸气接触时，这种极性水蒸气的分子扩散到细胞壁中的微纤丝之间长而很细的孔隙中。液体分子进人细胞壁时，微线丝长轴侧向膨胀，膨胀程度与被吸收液体分子的大小和数量成比例。当胞壁内部有效羟基位置全被液体占据时，胞壁中的水分达到达到饱和.吸湿中止。长期置于大气中的木材到一定程度时就会达到平衡状态。无论木材从大气中吸取水分，还是散失水分都取决于周围大气的温度和湿度。空气的温度和湿度随地区、季节、天气、早晚不同而变化。在温度一定而相对湿度不同时，木材的平衡含水率随大气的相对湿度的增加而上升。相反，在相对湿度一定而温度不同时，木材的平衡含水率随温度的上升而减小。木材的吸湿性系一种不良的性质，导致木材尺寸不稳定，甚至发生翘曲和开裂。同时木材的物理力学性质亦随木材的含水率的变化而变化。用涂料和油漆涂刷木材表面，引用石蜡、沥青等极性液体借氢键与木材的干细胞结合，可以减低木材的吸湿性，保持尺寸的稳定性。
explanation_en: When the moisture content in wood is lower than the equilibrium moisture content, the absorption of water vapor and other liquid vapor from the air is called moisture absorption. Conversely, when the moisture content in wood is higher than the equilibrium moisture content, that is, when it is wetter than the atmosphere, the moisture in wood will evaporate into the air, which is called dehumidification. Wood has high porosity, huge surface area, adsorption and capillary tube condensation. When wood contacts with the water vapor, molecules of the this polar water vapor diffusion into long and thin pores between microfilaments in cell wall. When liquid molecules enter the cell wall, the long axis of the microfilament expands laterally, and the degree of expansion is proportional to the size and quantity of absorbed liquid molecules. When the effective hydroxyl positions inside the cell wall are fully occupied by the liquid, the water in the cell wall reaches saturation and moisture absorption stops. Wood placed in the atmosphere for a long time will reach a balance state when it reaches a certain degree. Whether wood absorbs or loses water from the atmosphere depends on the temperature and humidity of the surrounding atmosphere. The temperature and humidity of the air vary with region, season, weather, and morning and evening. When the temperature is constant but the relative humidity is different, the equilibrium moisture content of wood increases with the increase of the relative humidity of the atmosphere. On the contrary, when the relative humidity is constant but the temperature is different, the equilibrium moisture content of wood decreases with the increase of temperature. The hygroscopicity of wood is a bad property, which leads to the dimensional instability of wood, even warpage and cracking. At the same time, the physical and mechanical properties of wood also change with the moisture content of wood. Brush wood surface with coatings and paint, introduce polar liquids such as paraffin and pitch to combine with wood stem cells by hydrogen bond, which can reduce the hygroscopicity of wood and maintain dimensional stability.

explanation_cn: 主要有声辐射品质常数、声衰及声阻抗等声学特性.即木材对声的吸收、传导、反射性质。声速与木材的弹性模量平方根成正比，与木材密度的平方根成反比。其传声速度对长的木材来说，当试样厚度与波长相比可以忽略不计，声的传递速度沿试材顺文理方向大于沿横纹理方向。木材的自振运动亦与木材长度、密度和弹性模有关。木材声辐射能力与其密度成反比。声辐射品质的优劣常用声速与密度的比值表示。声阻抗在空气和其他同体材料之间。由于木材的声阻抗较空气高.所以木材表面的声波，除少量被吸收和透过外，大部分被反射回来。如冷杉等板方才，其平均吸声系数仅为0.1，因此木材具有很好的声反射能力，所以常用作隔声材料。木材的隔声能力，除与频率有关外，与其白身重量或木板厚度成正比，有人说木材厚度>20mm就无影响，但门窗等又不能做得太厚，所以也常与其它隔声材料(如玻璃、泡沫塑料等)组合成隔声罩，以防止噪声外传。
explanation_en: It mainly has acoustic characteristics such as acoustic radiation quality constant, acoustic attenuation and acoustic impedance, that is, the absorption, transmission and reflection properties of wood to sound. The sound velocity is proportional to the square root of wood's elastic modulus and inversely proportional to the square root of wood's density. For long wood, when the thickness of the specimen is negligible compared with the wavelength, the sound transmission speed along the textural direction of the specimen is greater than along the transverse texture direction. The natural vibration of wood is also related to the length, density and elasticity mode of wood. The sound radiation capacity of wood is inversely proportional to its density. The quality of sound radiation is usually expressed by the ratio of sound velocity to density. The acoustic impedance is between air and other homogeneous materials. Since the acoustic impedance of wood is higher than that of air, most of the acoustic waves on the surface of wood are reflected back except for a small amount of absorption and transmission. For example, the average sound absorption coefficient of fir and other boards is only 0.1, so wood has good sound reflection ability, so it is often used as acoustic insulation materials. In addition to being related to frequency, the sound insulation capacity of wood is proportional to its white body weight or board thickness. Some people say that if the thickness of wood is greater than 20mm, there will be no impact, but doors and windows cannot be made too thick, so it is often combined with other acoustic insulation materials (such as glass, foamed plastics, etc.) to form a sound insulation cover to prevent noise transmission.

explanation_cn: 在温度或湿度变化的环境中，木材保持其原有尺寸和形状的能力。
explanation_en: The ability of wood to maintain its original size and shape in the environment of temperature or humidity changes.

explanation_cn: 木材由于含水率降低导致其尺寸缩小的性能。木材发生干缩的原因是木材十燥时.水分向外蒸发而散失，当含水率低于纤维饱和点后，细胞壁纤丝之间、微纤丝之间的吸附水减少，彼此之间的距离靠拢，以致细胞壁或整个木材的寸变小。木材纵向和横向干缩率有差别，横向干缩率大于纵向干缩率，主要是因为纤丝和微纤丝在初生壁、次生壁的内、外层上的排列方向与纵向夹角小。在次生壁的中间层几乎与树轴平行，次中间层占细胞壁的绝大部分，对木材干缩起主要牵制作用。
explanation_en: The capability of wood to reduce its size due to the reduction of its moisture content. The reason for drying shrinkage of wood is that when the wood is dry, the water evaporates outward and loses. When the moisture content is lower than the fiber saturation point, the adsorbed water between cell wall filaments and microfibrils decreases, and the distance between each other is close, so that the cell wall or the entire wood becomes smaller. The longitudinal and transverse shrinkage rates of wood are different, and the transverse shrinkage rate is greater than the longitudinal shrinkage rate, mainly because the arrangement direction of filaments and microfilaments on the inner and outer layers of the primary wall and secondary wall is smaller than the longitudinal angle. The middle layer of the secondary wall is almost parallel to the tree axis, and the secondary middle layer accounts for the majority of the cell wall, which plays a major role in inhibiting the drying of wood.

explanation_cn: 粉末状木材碎料，尺寸大小一般在40目以下。木粉用途广泛，作为木塑复合材料制造的原料，还可以作为可再生能源燃烧原料。也可用作蚊香、皮革、服装、造纸、电器、生活用品、涂料、化工、绝缘材料、建筑材料等多种产品的原料。
explanation_en: Powdered wood chips, with the size generally below 40 meshes. Wood flour is widely used as raw material for wood plaslic composite manufacturing and as raw material for renewable energy combustion. It can also be used as raw materials for mosquito repellent incense, leather, clothing, paper making, electrical appliances, household goods, coatings, chemicals, insulation materials, building materials and other products.

explanation_cn: 又称木质素，是天然高分子有机化合物，与纤维素伴，.存在于木材细胞壁中，细胞间的胞间层主要由它形成，和半纤维素构成结壳物质，以增强细胞壁的强度，是裸子和被子植物所特有的化学成分。木质素在木材中的分布不均，随树种、树龄、树的部位不同而有明显变化，木材中木质素含量为20%-40%。木质素组成复，化学稳定性低，易受酸、碱、氧化剂、卤化物等影响。工业产量主要从制浆废液中获得。工业上利用它的活性从木材中去除木质素以获得纤维素，制浆工艺即利用此原理木质素是热塑性高聚物，无明显熔点，纤维受热木质塑化，即可促进纤维的分离，纤维板生产利用这一原理，采用热磨法分离纤维，利用高温高压下木质素的塑化性质，生产纤维板和刨花板。木质素的用途广泛，可作燃料、染料、颜料、炭黑、水泥与钻件泥浆的分散剂、石墨、铁矿砂的黏结剂、橡胶的增强剂和抗氧剂。木质素还町作制造塑料、树脂等的辅料。
explanation_en: Also known as lignin, it is a natural polymer organic compound, accompanied with cellulose. It exists in the cell wall of wood. The intercellular layer between cells is mainly formed by it, and it forms crusts with semi cellulose to enhance the strength of the cell wall. It is a unique chemical component of gymnosperms and angiosperms. The distribution of lignin in wood is uneven, and it changes significantly with different tree species, tree ages, and tree parts. The lignin content in wood is 20% -40%. Lignin is complex in composition, low in chemical stability, and susceptible to acid, alkali, oxidizer, halide, etc. Industrial output is mainly obtained from pulping waste liquid. In industry, it uses its activity to remove lignin from wood to obtain cellulose. The pulping process uses this principle that lignin is a thermoplastic polymer with no obvious melting point. The fiber is plasticized by heated wood, which can promote the separation of fibers. fiberboard production uses this principle to separate fibers by hot grinding and produce fiberboard and particleboard by using the plasticizing properties of lignin under high temperature and pressure. Lignin is widely used as fuel, dye or dyestuffc, pigment, carbon black, dispersing agent for cement and drilling mud, graphite, adhesive for iron ore, reinforcing agent and antioxidant for rubber. Lignin is also used as an auxiliary material for manufacturing plastics, resin, etc.

explanation_cn: 木质部中除去导管及木薄嘴组织以外长而狭的木材细胞，包括针叶树材中的管胞及阔叶材中的韧型木纤维和纤维状管胞。
explanation_en: The long and narrow wood cells in the xylem except for catheter and thin mouthed tissues, including tracheids in coniferous trees and tough wood fiber and fibrous tracheids in hardwoods.

explanation_cn: 在常规熔体纺丝工艺中纺丝速度1000~1500m/min制得的卷绕丝，简称UDY丝。不能满足服用性能的要求，必须进行适当的后拉伸处理等。
explanation_en: In the conventional melt spinning process, the winding yarn is made at the spinning speed of 1000~1500m/min, which is called UDY yarn for short. Unable to meet the requirements for wearing performance, appropriate post stretching treatment must be carried out.

explanation_cn: 线性高分子链的一端至另一端的直线距离，为向量用h表示。在通常条件下，聚合物分子链的构象在不断变化，所以其末端距也在不断改变，因此衡量一个聚合物分子的末端距的大小需采用统计平均的方法。一个聚合物分子所有可能未端距的平方的统计平均值称为均方末端距，其平方根称为根均方末端距。单个的聚合物分子只有在溶剂中才能观察到，但溶剂分子和聚合物链的相互作用往往会改变聚合物分子链的伸展程度如果在一定的溶剂和温度下，能使溶剂对聚合物分子构象产生的影响忽略不计，在这种条件下，测得的才是高分子链在无千扰条件下的完全由高分子自身的链结构决定的均方未端距。可以通过一些模型来计算聚合物分子，但都和实际值之间存在不同程度的差别。
explanation_en: The linear distance from one end of a linear macromolecule chain to the other end is a vector expressed in h. Under normal conditions, the conformation of polymer molecular chain is constantly changing, so its end toend clistanct is also constantly changing, so the end toend clistanct of a polymer molecule needs to be measured by statistical average method. The statistical average of the squares of all possible non end distances of a polymer molecule is called mean-square end-to-end distance, and its square root is called root mean-square end-to-end distance. A single polymer molecule can only be observed in the solvent, but the interaction between the solvent molecule and the polymer chain will often change the extension degree of the polymer molecular chain. If under certain solvent and temperature, the influence of the solvent on the polymer molecular conformation can be ignored. Under this condition, the measured mean square end distance of the macromolecule chain is completely determined by the chain structure of the macromolecule itself without interference. Some model can be used to calculate polymer molecules, but there are different degrees between them and the actual values.

explanation_cn: 本体异质结，是指n型半导体和p型半导体在整个区域范围内充分混合且界面分布于整个区域范围的pn结。本体异质结可通过将含有n型半导体材料和p型半导体材料的混合溶液以旋涂、丝网印刷和喷墨打印等方式制备，也可通过共同蒸镀的方式获得，还可以通过热处理的方式将真空蒸镀的平面型双层异质结转换为本体异质结结构。
explanation_en: Bulk heterojunction refers to the pn junction where n-type semiconductor and p-type semiconductor are fully mixed in the whole region and the interface is distributed in the whole region. The bulk heterojunction can be prepared by spin coating, screen printing and ink-jet printing of the mixed solution containing n-type semiconductor materials and p-type semiconductor materials, or by common vapor exposition, or by heat treatment to convert the vacuum vapor exposition planar double-layer heterojunction into the bulk heterojunction structure.

explanation_cn: 单体在无其他介质的条件下，在引发剂、光、热等作用下进行的聚合反应。工艺流程简单，产品纯度高。根据聚合物能否溶于原单体相或是否生成新相，本体聚合还可分为均相与非均相两类。均相本体法的工艺用于聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯及聚苯乙烯的生产中，非均相本体聚合的例子聚乙烯。
explanation_en: Polymerization of monomer under the action of initiator, light and heat without other media. The process flow is simple and the product purity is high. Bulk polymerization can also be divided into homogeneous and heterogeneous phase according to whether polymer can dissolve in the original monomer phase or generate a new phase. Homogeneous phase bulk polymerization process is used in the production of polymethyl methacrylate and polystyrene. Heterogeneous phase bulk polymerization is an example of polyethylene.

explanation_cn: 材料表面和内部同时发生分解、溶解或分子量降低，导致材料强度下降，最终出现崩解的现象。
explanation_en: Decomposition, dissolution or molecular weight reduction occur on the surface of materials and inside at the same time, leading to the decrease of materials strength, and finally the phenomenon of disintegration.

explanation_cn: 不包含溶剂或分散介质的高分子在汗缩形变下的黏度。
explanation_en: Viscosity of macromolecule without solvent or dispersion medium under sweat shrinkage deformation.

explanation_cn: 没有杂质和缺陷的半导体称为本征半导体。
explanation_en: The semiconductor without impurities and defects is called intrinsic semiconductor.
