explanation_cn: 能感知环境变化，并通过改变自身一个或多个性能参数对环境变化作出响应，使之与变化后的环境相适应的复合材料或材料器件的复合结构。一般亦称之为机敏材料和机敏结构。机敏复合材料具有自诊断、自适应或自愈合等功能，因此必然是感知材料和执行材料的复合，有时还需要外接的电源、信息处理系统和反馈系统。
explanation_en: The composition structure of composite materials or materials device that can sense environmental changes and respond to environmental changes by changing one or more of its own performance parameters to adapt to the changed environment. Also known as smart materials and smart structures. Smart composite have the functions of self diagnosis, self adaptation or self-healing, so they must sense materials and perform composition of materials, and sometimes they also need external power, information processing systems and feedback systems.

explanation_cn: 可以感知环境刺激因素（包括压力、应力、温度、电磁场、pH等）并以可控方式显著变化的材料。属于智能材料的低级形式。
explanation_en: Materials that can sense environmental irritation factors (including pressure, stress, temperature, electromagnetic field, pH, etc.) and change significantly in a controllable way. It belongs to the low-level form of intelligent materials.

explanation_cn: 通过高能球磨将不同粉末实现固态合金化状态形成的粉未。粉末在此过程经受反复的变形、冷焊、破碎，从而达到元素间原子水平合金化的复杂物理化学过程。机械合金化粉是具有平衡或非平衡相组成的合金粉末或复合粉末。机械合金化粉的晶粒尺寸细小，晶界密度极大，但往往会因为在制备时与罐体、球体摩擦造成粉 末污染。机械合金化粉包括氧化钍弥散强化镍基高温合金、镍铬铝钛合金、钨铜合金等。
explanation_en: The powder formed by realizing solid alloy of different powder through high-energy ball milling. In this process, powder undergoes repeated deformation, cold welding and crushing, thus achieving the complex physical chemistry process of alloy at the atomic level between elements. Mechanical alloy powder is alloy powder or composition powder with equilibrium or non-equilibrium phase composition. The grain size of mechanical alloying powder is small, and the density of grain boundary is very high, but the powder pollution is often caused by friction with tank body and ball during preparation. Mechanical alloying powder includes thorium oxide dispersion strengthened nickel-base superalloy, nickel chromium aluminum titanium alloy, tungsten copper alloy, etc.

explanation_cn: 将不同的金属元素和中间+合金粉末与氧化物粉未按照所需配比置于高能球磨机中，在真空或惰性气体保护下，利用高能球磨机高速转动的搅拃棒带动磨球高速运动，使球与球和球乌滚筒壁间反复碰撞加工粉末，粉末反复发生变形、冷焊、硬化和破碎，并形成复合质点。经过一定时间研磨，这种复合物在反复破碎和冷焊的两个过程中达到平衡达到真正的合金化，各合金元素已形成固溶体，氧化物已均匀弥散地分布在同溶体基体中，这就是机械合金化。
explanation_en: Different metal elements and intermediate+alloy powder and oxide powder are not placed in the high-energy ball mill according to the required ratio. Under the protection of vacuum or inert gas, the grinding ball is driven to move at a high speed by the high-speed stirring rod of the high-energy ball mill, so that the ball and the ball and the wall of the ball and graphite cylinder are repeatedly collided to process powder. powder is repeatedly deformed, cold welded, hardened and broken, and composition particles are formed. After a certain period of grinding, this composite achieves balance in the two processes of repeated crushing and cold welding to achieve true alloy. Each alloy element has formed solid solution, and oxides have been evenly distributed in the matrix of the same solution, which is called mechanical alloy.

explanation_cn: 由活体细胞与一种或多种生物材料共同构建的人工器官。由于它具有活体组织的全面功能，材料又能促进细胞生长、增殖、分化从而对受损器官进行修复，因此具有很大的潜在应用价值，是组织工程和再生医学研究的重要内容，目前尚无临床应用产品。
explanation_en: A artificial organ constructed by living cells and one or more biological materials. Because it has the comprehensive function of living tissue, and materials can promote cell growth, proliferation and differentiation to repair damaged organs, it has great potential application value and is an important content of tissue engineering and regenerative medicine research. At present, there is no clinical application product.

explanation_cn: 在有机小分子（如：膦腈碱）催化下，环状单体和乙烯基黾体的共聚合反应。该聚合反应因包含了开环聚合和双键加聚反应，称为"杂化聚合"。一般情况下，乙烯基单体或环状单体只能与同类型的单体进行共聚，由于单体和活性种活性的差异，乙烯基单体和环状单体之间的共聚则几乎无法进行。实现常规乙烯基单体与环状单体之间的共聚合，在这个反应体系中，每种单体都能被引发剂引发产生两种活性中心，产生的活性中心又都能引发两种单体进行共聚反应，并最终形成无规共聚物。适用的单体包括各种内酯或环碳酸酯等环状单体以及（甲基）丙烯酸酯类等乙烯基单体。通过，可以在常见的聚己内酯、聚丙交酯或聚环碳酸酯等生物降解高分子中引入双键类单体，以改善其结晶性、亲/疏水性，并对其降解性能和力学性能进行有效调控。
explanation_en: Copolymerization of cyclic monomer and vinyl strider catalyzed by small organic molecules (such as phosphonitrile base). The polymerization reaction is called "hybrid polymerization" because it includes ring opening polymerization and double bond addition polymerization. Generally, vinyl monomer or cyclic monomer can only be copolymerized with the same type of monomer. Due to the difference in activity between monomer and reactive species, copolymerization between vinyl monomer and cyclic monomer is almost impossible. Realize copolymerization between conventional vinyl monomer and cyclic monomer. In this reaction system, each monomer can be initiated by initiator to generate two active centers, and the generated active centers can also initiate copolymerization of two monomer, and finally form random copolymer. Applicable monomer include various cyclic monomer such as lactones or cyclic carbonates, and vinyl monomer such as (meth) acrylate. Through, double bond monomer can be introduced into the common biodegradation macromolecule such as poly (e-caprolactone), polylactide or polycyclic carbonate to improve their crystallinity, hydrophilicity/hydrophobicity, and effectively regulate their degradation and mechanical properties.

explanation_cn: 由无机半导体材料与有机半导体材料杂化形成的太阳电池。一般情况下，p型有机聚合物半导体作为电子给体及空穴传输材料，n型半导体纳米晶或者量子点作为电子受体及电子传输材料。其工作原理是：太阳光入射后在有机半导体或者无机半导体中产生激子，激子扩散到相界面发生电荷分离，形成分别可以在两相中自由移动的电子和空穴电荷载流子，电荷载流子传输到电极并被外电路收集。杂化的方式可以是将无机相、有机相在溶液中共混，然后通过旋涂、丝网印刷及喷墨打印等方式在衬底上形成电池活性层，也可以首先在衬底上制备无机相或者有机相结构，然后再沉积有机相或者无机相。根据有机相和无机相的几何结构分布，可以分类为：电子给体/受体双层异质结、本体异质结和有序异质结。一般地，双层异质结由于受到激子扩散长度仅为几十纳米的限制，其活性层厚度不能太厚，不利于最大程度地吸收太阳光，因此电池电流受到限制。本体异质结和有序异质结则有利于充分增加吸光材料，提高电池电流及性能。杂化太阳电池吋将有机聚合物分子结构易"裁剪"、低成本以及无机半导体的电荷迁移率高的优点互相结合，且具备易制备柔性器件等优点。
explanation_en: Solar cell is a hybrid of inorganic semiconductor materials and organic semiconductor materials. Generally, p-type organic polymer semiconductors are used as electron donor and hole transport materials, and n-type semiconductor nanocrystal or quantum dots are used as electron acceptor and electron transport materials. Its working principle is: after sunlight incident, exciton is generated in organic semiconductor or inorganic semiconductor, and exciton diffusion to the phase interface to generate charge separation, forming electron and hole charge carriers that can move freely in the two phases respectively, and the charge carriers are transmitted to the electrode and collected by the external circuit. The hybrid method can be to mix inorganic phase and organic phase in solution, and then form a battery active layer on the substrate through spin coating, screen printing and inkjet printing, or first prepare inorganic phase or organic phase structure on the substrate, and then deposit organic phase or inorganic phase. According to the geometric structure distribution of organic and inorganic phases, they can be classified into: electron donor/acceptor double-layer heterojunction, bulk heterojunction and ordered heterojunction. Generally, due to the limitation that the diffusion length of the exciton is only tens of nanometers, the active layer thickness of the double-layer heterostructure cannot be too thick, which is not conducive to the maximum absorption of sunlight, so the battery current is limited. The bulk heterojunction and ordered heterojunction are beneficial to fully increase the light absorbing materials and improve the battery current and performance. Hybrid solar cells combine the advantages of organic polymer molecular structure easy to "cut", low cost and high charge mobility of inorganic semiconductors, and have the advantages of easy preparation of flexible devices.

explanation_cn: 含水的复杂岛状结构硫酸盐矿物。三斜晶系。晶体细小，呈柱状或板状;依集合体呈块状、叶片状或纤维状。无色或白色，含氧化铁染成红色，含泥质染成灰色。条痕白色，透明至半透明。玻璃光泽。产于海盆地盐类化学沉积物中，由富含钾、镁、钙的天然盐水经蒸发作用而成，与石盐、硬石膏等共生。是制取化肥的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Sulfate minerals with complex island like structures containing water. Triclinal crystal system. The crystal is small, columnar or plate-like; The aggregate is in the form of blocks, leaves, or fibers. Colorless or white, dyed red with iron oxide and gray with mud. Stripes are white, transparent to semi transparent. Glass lustre. It is produced in salt chemical sediments of sea basins, and is formed by evaporation of natural brine rich in potassium, magnesium, and calcium. It is symbiotic with halite, anhydrite, etc. It is the raw mineral material for making fertilizer.

explanation_cn: 高分子主链中含有杂环或芳杂环结构的聚合物，成环原子除碳原子外还有氧、氮、硫、磷等其他原子，通常为五元杂环或六元杂环结构。杂环聚合物通常以含有杂环结构的单体聚合或者在逐步聚合过程中经闭环反应得到。杂环聚合物如聚酰亚胺、聚苯并咪唑、聚苯并嗯嗪等，具有非常优异的耐热性能，通常作为耐高温高分子材料。
explanation_en: The main chain of macromolecule contains heterocycles or aromatic heterocycles. The ring forming atoms of polymer include oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur, phosphorus and other atoms in addition to carbon atoms, which are usually five membered heterocycles or six membered heterocycles. Heterocyclic polymer is usually obtained by polymerization of monomer containing heterocyclic structure or by closed-loop reaction during stepwise (reaction) polymerization. Heterocyclic polymers, such as polyimide, polybenzimidazole, polyphenylene triazine, etc., have excellent heat resistance and are usually used as high temperature resistant macromolecule materials.

explanation_cn: 已电离或未电离杂质对晶格周期件势场有一定的微扰作用而引起的对载流子的散射。施主杂质电离后是带正电的离子，受主杂质电离后是带负电的离子，在电离施主或受主周围形成库仑场。当载流子运动到电离杂质附近时，由于库仑场的作用，使载流子运动的方向和速度发生改变。杂质浓度越大，载流子被散射的概率则越大。温度越高，电离杂质对载流子的散射概率越小。电离杂质散射在低温下逛起支配作用的载流子散射机制，在低温下没有电离的杂质是中件的，这些中性杂质也能起载流子的散射作用。
explanation_en: The scattering of charge carriers caused by the perturbation effect of ionized or non ionized impurities on the potential field of lattice periodic devices. The ionized donor is a positive ion, and the ionized acceptor is a negative ion, forming a coulomb field around the ionized donor or acceptor. When the carrier moves near the ionized impurity, the direction and velocity of the carrier movement change due to the Coulomb field. The higher the impurity concentration, the greater the probability of carrier scattering. The higher the temperature, the smaller the scattering probability of ionized impurities on carriers. The ionized impurity scattering plays a dominant role in the carrier scattering mechanism at low temperatures. At low temperatures, the impurities that are not ionized are medium, and these neutral impurities can also play a role in carrier scattering.

explanation_cn: 由培体或溶液法生长晶体时所形成的微区杂质不均匀分布，因其腐蚀花样呈条纹状而得名。条纹的成因是单晶生长过程中所发生的瞬时生长速率变化或边界层厚度变化，从而造成杂质的有效分凝系数的变化条纹可分为旋转形条纹与非旋转形条纹。前者是由于热场分布对晶体旋转轴不对称造成的，晶体每旋转一周就经历一次热场变化，故这种条纹呈周期性。非旋转条纹是不规则的，其形成的原因主要是熔体的各种对流和机械振动等。采用磁控拉晶或在微重力下拉晶，可抑制甚至消除由热对流所形成的条纹。
explanation_en: The impurities in the micro area formed during the growth of crystal by culture or solution method method are unevenly distributed, so it is named because its corrosion pattern is striped. The cause of fringes is the change of instantaneous growth rate or boundary layer thickness during the growth of single crystal, which results in the change of effective segregation coefficient of impurities. The fringes can be divided into rotating fringes and non rotating fringes. The former is caused by the asymmetry of the thermal field distribution on the rotation axis of the crystal. Every time the crystal rotates, it undergoes a thermal field change, so this fringe is periodic. Non rotating stripes are irregular, mainly caused by various convection and mechanical vibrations of the melt. The use of magnetic controlled crystallization or crystallization under microgravity can suppress or even eliminate the stripes formed by thermal convection.

explanation_cn: 大分子主链除含碳原子外，还含有氧、氮或硫等其他原子的杂链聚合物制成的合成纤维。杂链聚合物通常由具有双官能团的单体缩聚或从杂环化合物开环聚合而成。杂链纤维品种繁多。
explanation_en: The main chain of macromolecule is a synthetic fiber made of heterochain polymer containing not only carbon atoms, but also oxygen, nitrogen or sulfur and other atoms. Heterochain polymer are usually formed by condensation polymerization of bifunctional monomer or ring opening polymerization from heterocyclic compounds. There are many kinds of heterochain fiber.

explanation_cn: 高分子主链中除碳原子外，还有氧、氮、硫、硅等杂原子存在的聚合物，如聚醚、聚酯、聚酰胺、聚苯硫醚等，这类聚合物都含有特征官能团，如醚键、酯键、酰胺键、硫醚键等。
explanation_en: In addition to carbon atoms, there are also oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur, silicon and other heteroatoms in the main chain of macromolecule, such as polyether, polyester, polyamide, polyphenylene sulfide, etc. These polymer all contain characteristic functional groups, such as ether bond, ester bond, amide bond, sulfide bond, etc.

explanation_cn: 次生矿物充填火山岩中气孔而形成的形如杏仁的实体。大多呈椭圆形，灰白色白色。中基性火山岩常见，充填矿物以方解石、沸石类、玉髓等为主。
explanation_en: An almond shaped entity formed by filling pores in volcanic rock with secondary minerals. Most of them are oval shaped and gray white in color. Medium basic volcanic rock are common, and the filling minerals are mainly caldte, zeolite, chalcedony, etc.

explanation_cn: 次生矿物充填火山岩中气孔而形成的一种构造。多见于中基性火山岩中，充填矿物以方解石、沸石类、玉髓等为主。
explanation_en: A structure formed by filling pores in volcanic rock with secondary minerals. It is mostly found in intermediate basic volcanic rock, and the filling minerals are mainly caldte, zeolite, chalcedony, etc.

explanation_cn: 研究通过材料二维截面或投影阁像获取材料中5维结构信息定量分析方法的一门学科，其原理是淀量金相的重要基础。
explanation_en: It is a discipline to study the quantitative analysis method of obtaining the 5-dimensional structural information in materials through the two-dimensional cross section or projection pavilion image of materials. Its principle is an important basis for precipitation metallography.

explanation_cn: 是利用信息科学与技术对材料信息进行收集、存储、加工、检索、提取、交换、传输、分析、研究和应用的学科。
explanation_en: It is a discipline that uses information science and technology to collect, store, process, retrieve, extract, exchange, transmit, analyze, research and apply materials information.

explanation_cn: 研究控制材料的外部形状和内部组织结构，以及将材料加工成人类社会所需求的各类零部件及成品的应用技术学科。
explanation_en: Study the external shape and internal organizational structure of control materials, and the applied technology discipline of processing materials into various parts and finished products required by human society.

explanation_cn: 生物机体内环境作用于植人材料所引起的材料结构或功能的变化。材料反应主要体现在三个方面，即植人材料的降解、腐蚀和磨损。植人材料在体内的降解一般分为物理降解和化学降解。物理降解过程主要包括吸收、溶胀、软化、结晶、去结晶、应力断裂、疲劳断裂和冲击破坏等过程；化学降解主要包括水解、分解、氧化等过程。这些过程有些是对机体有利的，如某些组织工程支架材料，在植人体内后，在相关生化因子的刺激下逐步降解，为组织的再生浸人提供空间等D有些过程则是对机体有害的，如由于植人材料的降解造成的植入体和周围组织顺应性的不匹配.以及降解产物对机体造成的毒性作用等。腐蚀更多是指沐液的电解质环境对植入金厲材料的电化学腐蚀以及细胞和生物分子对植入材料的生物腐蚀。根据腐蚀机理的不同，一般吋分为侵蚀腐蚀、接触腐蚀、裂缝腐蚀、粒间腐蚀、应力腐蚀开裂、电化腐蚀等。腐蚀ê多的是造成植入材料整体结构的破坏以及对机体的不良反应。磨损更多地发生于人工骨关节面，高分子或金属磨损颗粒造成界面骨的溶解?从而导致假体松动?一直是骨关节最终失败的主要原因之一。
explanation_en: Changes in the structure or function of implanted materials caused by the internal environment of the organism. Materials response is mainly reflected in three aspects, namely degradation, corrosion and wear of implanted materials. The degradation of implanted materials in vivo is generally divided into physical degradation and chemical degradation. The physical degradation process mainly includes absorption, swelling, bating, crystallization, recrystallization, stress fracture, fatigue fracture and impact failure; Chemical degradation mainly includes hydrolysis, decomposition, oxidation and other processes. Some of these processes are beneficial to the body. For example, some materials of tissue engineering scaffolds are gradually degradation under the irritation of relevant biochemical factors after being implanted in the body, providing space for tissue regeneration and immersion. D Some processes are harmful to the body, such as the mismatch of implant and surrounding tissue compliance caused by degradation of implanted materials, and the toxic effect of degradation products on the body. Corrosion refers more to the electrochemical corrosion of the electrolyte environment of the bath solution to implantation Jinli materials and the bioerosion of cells and biomolecules to implantation materials. According to the different mechanisms of corrosion, it is generally divided into erosion corrosion, contact corrosion, crack corrosion, intergranular corrosion, stress corrosion cracking, electrochemical corrosion, etc. Corrosion is more likely to cause damage to the overall structure of implantation materials and adverse reactions to the body. Wear more often occurs on the articular surface of artificial bone, and macromolecule or metal wear particles cause the dissolution of interface bone? So that the prosthesis becomes loose? It has always been one of the main reasons for the ultimate failure of bone joints.

explanation_cn: 材料吸附是指一个或多个组分（气体、液体、固体）在材料与其介质界面上的富集；由材料组分、结构导致的对特定物质优先吸附的能力称为材料的选择性吸附功能。材料吸附特性主要是由材料的微孔结构、比表面积、表面拓扑结构及与吸附质分子形成化学键的基团所决定的，可分为物理吸附和化学吸附。
explanation_en: Materials adsorption refers to the enrichment of one or more components (gas, liquid, solid) at the interface between materials and its medium; The ability of materials to preferentially adsorb specific substances due to its composition and structure is called the selective adsorption function of materials. The adsorption characteristics of materials are mainly determined by the micropore structure, specific surface, surface topological structure of materials and the groups forming chemical bonds with adsorbate molecules, which can be divided into physical adsorption and chemical adsorption.

explanation_cn: 研究各类材料的组成、结构、工艺、性能与使用效能之间相互关系的学科。
explanation_en: A discipline that studies the relationship between the composition, structure, process, performance and use efficiency of various materials.

explanation_cn: 材料表面抑制蛋白质、多肽、多糖等生物质黏附的能力。在某些生物材料应用领域，如人工晶状体、心脏瓣膜等，蛋白质、多肽、多搪等生物质在生物材料表面黏附可能导致负面效应?因此应采取措施赋予材料表面抑制这些生物质黏附的能力。
explanation_en: The ability of surface of materials to inhibit the adhesion of proteins, peptides, polysaccharides and other biomass. In some application fields of biological materials, such as intraocular lenses, heart valves, etc., the adhesion of proteins, polypeptides, polymers and other biomass on the surface of biological materials may lead to negative effects? Therefore, measures should be taken to endow the surface of materials with the ability to inhibit the adhesion of these biomass.

explanation_cn: 依靠计算机，利用计算材料学领域的计算方法，通过数值计算和图像显示的途径，进行材料成分的设计、显微组织结构的模拟和性能的预测等.达到解决材料科学或工程问题的目的。
explanation_en: Rely on computers, use the calculation methods in the field of computational materials science, through the way of numerical calculation and image display, carry out the design of materials composition, simulation of microstructure and prediction of properties, etc., so as to achieve the purpose of solving materials science or engineering problems.

explanation_cn: 材料科学与工程领域的数据可在不同地方使用不同计算机、不同软件的用户能够读取，并进行各种操作、运算和分析。
explanation_en: Data in the field of materials science and engineering can be read by users of different computers and software in different places, and can perform various operations, calculations and analyses.

explanation_cn: 材料型号繁多、品种各异，每一种材料都有其不同的化学成分和性能，而且材料的结构、性能还随制备方式与处理工艺不同而不同。在选材过程中，为了得到最佳的选择，一方面要采用比较科学的材料选择方法，另一方面要借助于计算机的强大功能使选材过程程序化、定量化。同时，再结合工程技术人员的判断和经验，才能达到比较正确而快捷的选择和权衡。由此产生了便于进行数据查询、数据处理的材料数据库。
explanation_en: Materials have various models and varieties, each materials has its own chemical composition and performance, and the structure and performance of materials also vary with different preparation methods and treatment processes. In the process of material selection, in order to get the best choice, on the one hand, it is necessary to adopt more scientific materials selection methods, on the other hand, it is necessary to make the process of material selection programmed and quantified with the help of the powerful functions of computers. At the same time, combined with the judgment and experience of engineering and technical personnel, a more accurate and efficient selection and balance can be achieved. Thus, a materials database convenient for data query and data processing is generated.

explanation_en: The technology of simplifying the real situation of materials, establishing a model that reflects the essential characteristics of the real situation, and formulaic description is an important tool and way for materials simulation and design.

explanation_cn: 又称材料仿真。根据实际材料问题建立模型，对真实材料及其体系和过程进行求解汁算或模拟?以获知所模拟系统的某些关键性特征的一类研究方法。
explanation_en: It is also called materials simulation. Establish a model based on the actual materials problem to solve or simulate the real materials and its system and process? A type of research method used to obtain certain key features of the simulated system.

explanation_en: Based on physical, chemical, mathematical and other natural sciences, it is a discipline that studies the physical and chemical behaviors and laws of materials from the molecular, atomic, electronic and other levels.

explanation_cn: 要求材料在完成其使用功能后能够以初始的形式被反复使用。
explanation_en: It is required that materials can be used repeatedly in their original form after completing their use functions.

explanation_cn: 界面失稳引起材料几何分形与界面形态的演变。在自然界许多形态各异的构体.例如雩花、云彩、山脉、海岸线等，其特点是分形的形态的自我相似性和维数之间成分数关系。在几何性质上这种重要的特征可以用一个有效的空间维数来表示，它称为Hausdorff维数。液态金属的枝晶生长过程也是晶体分形的重要表现的一个方面。
explanation_en: The interface instability causes the evolution of geometric fractal and interface morphology of materials. In nature, many structures with different forms, such as raindrops, clouds, mountains, coastlines, etc., are characterized by a fractional relationship between fractal self similarity and dimensionality. This important feature in geometric properties can be represented by an effective spatial dimension, which is called the Hausdorff dimension. Dendrite growth process of liquid metal is also an important aspect of crystal fractal.

explanation_cn: 要实现社会与经济的可持续发展.必然涉及一系列产品的升级改造和丄业结构的调整，离不开材料产业的环境协调性技术进步。无论何种形式和功能的物质产品，其所用材料的环境属性和特征.即从原料提取和生产、使用、废弃、回收到再生循环过程的资源效率、对环境的影响，决定了所有物质产品以及社会物质经济的整体可持续发展水平。材料是构成所有产品的物质基础，材料与产品的环境协调性技术进步是社会和经济可持续发展最重要的组成部分。因此，材料n丨持续发展是指材料在其制备、生产、使用和废弃的整个过程中，始终贯彻资源（能源）节约型、环境友好型和资源循环再生的设计原则、工艺路线、技术与政策措施，是整个材料领域永恒的战略部署和发展方向。
explanation_en: To realize the sustainable development of society and economy, it must involve the upgrading and transformation of a series of products and the adjustment of the industrial structure, which cannot be separated from the environmental coordinated technological progress of the materials industry. No matter what form and function of material products, the environmental properties and characteristics of the materials used, namely, the resource efficiency and environmental impact of the process from raw material extraction and production, use, waste, recycling to recycling, determine the overall sustainable development level of all material products and social material economy. Materials are the material basis of all products, and the environmental coordinated technological progress of materials and products is the most important part of social and economic sustainable development. Therefore, the sustainable development of materials means that materials always implement the design principles, process routes, technologies and policy measures of resource (energy) conservation, environment-friendly and resource recycling in the whole process of its preparation, production, use and waste, which is the eternal strategic deployment and development direction of the entire materials field.

explanation_cn: 要求材料在完成其使用功能后能重新变成可以利用的资源.而不是无利用价值的垃圾
explanation_en: It is required that materials can be turned back into usable resources after completing their use functions, rather than useless garbage

explanation_cn: 在生态环境材料的性能指标中，除传统的力学、物理与化学性能之外，又增加了环境协调性和舒适性。在这里的环境协调性是指材料在制造、使用、废弃的整个寿命周期过程中，无害（安全）、资源与能源消耗少，环境污染小以及再生循环利用率高。
explanation_en: In the performance indicators of ecomaterials, in addition to the traditional mechanical, physical and chemical properties, environmental coordination and comfort are also increased. The environmental coordination here refers to the harmless (safe), low resource and energy consumption, low environmental pollution and high recycling rate of materials during the whole life cycle of manufacturing, use and waste.

explanation_cn: 就是材料宏观塑性变形受抑制程度的度量。材料宏观塑性变形能力受到抑制就显示脆性。材料的韧性和脆性是两个相反的概念，韧性低显示脆性，但两者没有明确的分界线，除了本质上是脆性的材料（如玻璃、陶瓷、金属间化合物）显示明显的脆性外，本质上是钿性的材料在各种内外因素的影响下也能由韧变脆。使材料变脆的判据如下：①材料的塑性和韧性指标（如拉伸塑性，冲击韧性，断裂韧性）明显下降；②断裂应力低于拉伸强度乃至屈服强度，或断裂应力强度因子低于断裂韧性；③脆性断口（如沿晶，解理或准解理）比例明显增加。使材料变脆的内在原因是各种强化处理.冋火脆处理。使材料变脆的外部原因是各种力学及环境因素?例如：①降低温度能使bcc和hep材料显示低温脆性；②增大应变速率和降低温度效果相同；③三向应力（如有缺口）下材料变脆：④疲劳(应力交变）能导致低应力脆断；⑤蠕变能使材料变脆；⑥氢能引起氢脆：⑦在液体金属中材料变脆；⑧应力腐蚀导致裂纹形成乃至低应力脆断；⑨中子辐照也能使材料变脆。
explanation_en: It is a measure of the degree of inhibition of macro plastic deformation of materials. When the macro plastic deformation ability of materials is restrained, it shows brittleness. Toughness and brittleness of materials are two opposite concepts. Low toughness indicates brittleness, but there is no clear boundary between the two. In addition to materials that are essentially brittle (such as glass, ceramics, imermetallif compound) show obvious brittleness, materials that are essentially ceramic can also change from toughness to brittleness under the influence of various internal and external factors. The criteria for making materials brittle are as follows: ① the plasticity and toughness indexes (such as tensile plasticity, impact toughness, fracture toughness) of materials decrease significantly; ② Fracture stress is lower than tensile strength and even yield strength, or fracture stress intensity factor is lower than fracture toughness; ③ The proportion of brittle fractures (such as intergranular, cleavage, or quasi cleavage) increases significantly. The internal cause of materials embrittlement is various strengthening treatment and flame embrittlement treatment. Are various mechanical and environmental factors the external reasons that make materials brittle? For example: ① lowering temperature can make bcc and hep materials show low temperature brittleness; ② Increasing strain rate has the same effect as decreasing temperature; ③ Materials becomes brittle under triaxial stress (if there is a notch): ④ fatigue (stress alternation) can lead to low stress brittle fracture; ⑤ Creep can make materials brittle; ⑥ Hydrogen can cause hydrogen embrittlement: ⑦ materials becomes brittle in liquid metal; ⑧ Stress corrosion leads to crack formation and even low stress brittle fracture; ⑨ Neutron irradiation can also make materials brittle.

explanation_cn: 研究材料成分、结构、工艺、性能与用途之间有关知识和应用的学科?属于工学学科门类。材料科学是有关材料成分、组织与工艺流程对于材料性质与用途的影响规律的知识与运用，是研究从电子到巨型物体各个尺寸层次上材料行为的科学。材料工程是以材料科学原理为基础?研究、开发、生产和应用各种材料的工程领域。
explanation_en: The discipline that studies the knowledge and application related to materials' composition, structure, process, performance and use? Belongs to the engineering discipline category. Materials science is the knowledge and application of the laws governing the influence of materials composition, organization and technological process on the properties and uses of materials. It is also a science that studies the behavior of materials at all dimensions, from electrons to giant objects. Is materials engineering based on the principles of materials science? Research, development, production and application of various engineering fields of materials.

explanation_cn: 材料表面是指结构、物性与体相不相同的整个表面层。表面上原子配位与晶体内部的各个原子的配位相比是不完全的，表面上的原子只有一边有近邻原子，因为它的能量较高，它们之间的结合也比内部要弱，当外来原子沉积到表面原子上时就会释放能量，产生表面吸附现象。
explanation_en: Surface of materials refers to the whole surface layer whose structure and physical properties are different from those of the bulk phase. The atomic coordination on the surface is incomplete compared with the coordination of each atom inside the crystal. The atoms on the surface have only one side of the adjacent atoms. Because of its high energy, the combination between them is also weaker than that inside. When foreign atoms are deposited on the surface atoms, energy will be released, resulting in surface adsorption.

explanation_cn: 在计算材料学领域，对应不同显微组织层次荷不同的表征材料特性的计算途径。例如，具有代表性的四种计算方法包括：用于电子和原子尺度材料计算的量子力学第一性原理方法和分子动力学方法。
explanation_en: In the field of computational materials science, there are different computational approaches to characterize the properties of materials corresponding to different microstructural levels. For example, four representative calculation methods include the first principle method of quantum mechanics and molecular dynamics method for electronic and atomic scale materials calculation.

explanation_cn: 通过理论与计算预报新材料的组分、结构与性能，或者说，通过理论设计来定做具有特定性能的新材料的方法，可分为经验设计和科学设计。
explanation_en: The method to predict the composition, structure and performance of new materials through theory and calculation, or to customize new materials with specific properties through theoretical design, can be divided into empirical design and scientific design.

explanation_cn: 材料设计专家系统是指具有相当数量的与材料有关的各种背景知识，并能运用这些知识解决材料设计中有关问题的计算机程序系统。传统的专家系统主要有优化模块、集成化模块、知识获取模块。最理想的专家系统是从基本理论出发，通过计算和逻辑推理预测未知材料的性能和制备方法。但由于影响材料的组织结构和性能的因素极其复杂，这种完全演绎式的专家系统还难以实现。目前的专家系统是以经验知识和理论知识相结合为基础的。
explanation_en: Expert system for materials design refers to a computer program system that has a considerable amount of background knowledge related to materials and can use this knowledge to solve relevant problems in materials design. Traditional expert systems mainly include optimization modules, integration modules, and knowledge acquisition modules. The most ideal expert system is to predict the properties and preparation methods of unknown materials based on the basic theory through calculation and logical reasoning. However, due to the complexity of the factors that affect the structure and performance of materials, this fully deductive expert system is still difficult to achieve. The current expert system is based on a combination of empirical and theoretical knowledge.

explanation_cn: 从杜胶树的叶、皮、籽等含胶组织中提取出来的一种天然高分子材料，分子结构为反式-1,4-聚异戊二烯，为一种反式天然橡胶。杜仲胶的外观颜色可视杜仲胶的制备方法以及树脂含量从纯白色到棕褐色变化。工业化制备方法有碱煮法和溶剂法两种。
explanation_en: It is a kind of natural polymer materials extracted from rubber containing tissues such as leaves, bark and seeds of Hevea rubra. Its molecular structure is trans-1,4-polyisoprene, which is a kind of trans natural rubber. The appearance color of eucommia ulmoides gum can be seen from the preparation method of eucommia ulmoides gum and the content of resin from pure white to brown. There are two industrial preparation methods: alkali boiling method and solvent method.
