Einstein first developed Planck's quantum hypothesis and put forward the quantum theory of the specific heat [capacity of solids. Later, Debye further developed the theory of specific heat [capacity.

explanation_cn: 岩石或矿石中的不同成分、结构或不同粒径的组成部分沿一定方向呈条带状相间排列的构造。条带彼此平行或近似平行，宽窄不一，颜色不同。多见于变质岩或热液成因、岩浆成因的岩石和矿石中。
explanation_en: The components with different compositions, textures or different particle sizes in rock or ores are arranged in strips in a certain direction. The stripes are parallel or approximately parallel to each other, with varying widths and colors. It is mainly found in metamorphic rocks or rock and ores of hydrothermal and magmatic origin.

explanation_cn: 分子链沿着应力方向排列并形成周期性的弯曲呈锯齿状的织态结构，在正交偏光显微镜下呈草席状的、明暗相间的条纹形貌。
explanation_en: The molecular chains are arranged along the stress direction and form a periodically curved zigzag texture structure. Under the orthogonal polarized light microscopy, the molecular chains are straw mat shaped, light and dark stripes.

explanation_cn: 是长石中的一种，它是由两种成分不一样的长石（钠长石和正长石或微斜长石）紧密生长在一起而形成的。
explanation_en: It is one of feldspar, which is formed by two feldspar (sodium feldspar and orthoclase or microcline) with different composition growing together closely.

explanation_cn: 电子在非轨道中的不对称占据会导致分子的几何构型发生畸变，从而降低分子的对称性和轨道的简并度，使体系的能量进一步下降的这种效应。轨道简并电子态与晶格振动模的相互作用将导致晶格的不稳定性，晶格将发生畸变而使简并能级分裂，电子将占据能量较低的态。当此分裂与弹簧恢复力达到平衡时，能量减少达极值。杨-泰勒效应通常发生在具有一定对称性的分子与晶体中。这一效应的发生将导致系统从一个对称性高的状态畸变为一个对称性低的状态。通常还伴随系统基态能级分裂、频率分裂和各向异性等现象的发生。杨-泰勒效应是系统的电子态与原子核的振动态之间的耦合作用引起的。杨-泰勒效应的系统的能量对应着系统的电子运动能量与原子核振动能量均为最小值，这样的系统就是没有声子激发的状态，即系统的基态。当系统的电子态与声子态发生耦合作用时，系统就一定会发生杨-泰勒效应畸变。在温度较高时，热扰动使各个过渡元素的畸变取向不一致，且随时间无规则地变动。这种现象称为动力学杨-泰勒效应。
explanation_en: The asymmetric occupation of electrons in non orbitals can cause distortion in the geometric configuration of molecules, thereby reducing the symmetry of molecules and the degeneracy of orbitals, resulting in a further decrease in the energy of the system. The interaction between the orbital degenerate electronic state and the lattice vibration mode will lead to the instability of the lattice, the lattice will be distorted and the degenerate energy level will be split, and the electrons will occupy the state with lower energy. When this splitting and spring restoring force reach equilibrium, the energy decreases to its maximum. Jahn-Teller effect usually occurs in molecules and crystal with certain symmetry. The occurrence of this effect will cause the system to distort from a state with high symmetry to a state with low symmetry. It is usually accompanied by the occurrence of ground state energy level splitting, frequency splitting and anisotropy. The Jahn-Teller effect is caused by the coupling between the electronic state of the system and the vibrational state of the nucleus. The energy of the system of the Jahn-Teller effect corresponds to the minimum of the electronic motion energy and the nuclear vibration energy of the system. Such a system is a state without phonon excitation, that is, the ground state of the system. When the electronic state and phonon state of the system are coupled, the Jahn-Teller effect distortion will occur in the system. At high temperature, the thermal disturbance makes the distortion orientation of each transition element inconsistent and changes irregularly with time. This phenomenon is called dynamic Jahn-Teller effect.

explanation_cn: 是个材料常数，是材料在单向拉伸或单向压缩应力作用下，在弹性变形比例极限范围内，应力与应变的比值，用字母E表示。它表征材料抵抗正应变的能力。
explanation_en: It is a materials constant, which is the ratio of stress to strain of materials under the action of uniaxial tension or uniaxial compression stress within the limit range of elastic deformation ratio, expressed by the letter E. It represents the ability of materials to resist normal strain.

explanation_cn: 又称弛豫时间。是衡量高分子松弛过程的一个物理量。它指材料在外场作用力下.从一种平衡状态通过分子运动达到另一个与外场相适应的、新的平衡状态所需要的时间。在其他条件相同时，分子运动的单元越小.则分子间的相互作刖越小.热运动所需克服的位垒即所需的活化能越低.因而松弛时间越短。高分子结构单元的多样性，决定了每种高分子的松弛时间不是一个单一的数值，而是一个连续的分布且分布很宽。
explanation_en: Also called relaxation time. It is a physical quantity to measure the relaxation process of macromolecule. It refers to the time required for materials to reach a new equilibrium state adapted to the external field through molecular motion under the external field force. Under the same other conditions, the smaller the unit of molecular motion is, the smaller the interaction distance between molecules is. The lower the activation or conditioning energy required to overcome the barrier of thermal motion is, the shorter the relaxation time is. The diversity of macromolecule structural units determines that the relaxation time of each macromolecule is not a single value, but a continuous and wide distribution.

explanation_cn: 又称弛豫时间谱。指体系内尺寸不同的运动单元的松弛时间分布函数.
explanation_en: Also known as relaxation time spectrum. It refers to the relaxation time distribution function of motion units with different sizes in the system

explanation_cn: 又称弛豫谱。是描述松弛过程的曲线，如材料力学性能（如模量）和形变随时间、温度或频率的变化曲线，或力学损耗与温度、频率关系曲线的动力学谱。
explanation_en: Also called relaxation spectrum. It refers to the curve describing the relaxation process, such as the change curve of materials mechanical properties (such as modulus) and deformation with time, temperature or frequency, or the dynamic spectrum of the relationship curve of mechanical loss with temperature and frequency.

explanation_cn: 具有松脂光泽的酸性玻璃质喷出岩。化学成分与珍珠岩、黑曜岩相近.但其含水量（>6%)较高。是一种几乎全由玻璃质组成的岩石。常呈黑色、灰色、浅绿、褐色、黄白等。松脂光泽和贝壳状断口。它是制造膨胀珍珠岩的原料，制品广泛用于建筑、化工、石油、冶金、电力及保温、隔声和土壤改良等领域。中国松脂岩资源较丰富，且多与珍珠岩、黑曜岩共生。
explanation_en: Acid glass extrusive rock with turpentine luster. Its chemical composition is similar to that of perlite and obsidian, but its water content (>6%) is high. It is a kind of rock almost entirely composed of glass. It is often black, gray, light green, brown, yellow white, etc. Rosin luster and shell like fractures. It is the raw material for manufacturing expanded perlite, and its products are widely used in construction, chemical industry, petroleum, metallurgy, electric power, thermal insulation, sound insulation, soil improvement and other fields. China is rich in pitchstone resources, which are mostly associated with perlite and obsidian.

explanation_cn: 粉末在规定条件下A然充满规定的容器时.单位体积内的粉末质量，即在没有受到重力之外的其他任何作用力情况下的松散粉末的密度，它等于粉末的质量除以粉末的总体枳.单位为g/cm3。松装密度是粉末自然堆积的密度，是粉末的工艺性能之一。它取决于颗粒间的黏附力、杆丨对滑动的阻力以及粉末体空隙被小颗粒填充的程度。松装密度的测定方法有漏斗法、斯科特容量计算法和振动漏斗法。粉末压制过程中，常采用容量装粉法.即用充满一定容积的型腔的粉末量来控制压件的密度和单个质量，这就要求每次装满型腔的粉末有严格不变的质量。但是，不同粉末容积一定是质量不同，因此规定可用松装密度来描述粉末的这种容积性质。
explanation_en: When the powder is filled with the specified container under the specified conditions, the mass of powder per unit volume, that is, the density of loose powder without any force other than gravity, is equal to the mass of powder divided by the total amount of powder. The unit is g/cm3. The apparent density is the density of powder naturally stacked, which is one of the technological properties of powder. It depends on the adhesion between particles, the resistance of the rod to sliding, and the degree to which the voids of powder body are filled by small particles. The measurement methods of apparent density include funnel method, Scott capacity calculation method and vibrating funnel method. In the pressing process of powder, the capacity loading method is often used, that is, the density and single mass of the pressed parts are controlled by the amount of powder filled with a certain volume of the cavity, which requires that the powder filled with the cavity each time has a strictly constant quality. However, the volume of different powder must be different in quality, so it is stipulated that apparent density can be used to describe this volume property of powder.

explanation_cn: 又称多气孔火药。通过特殊生产工艺使药粒呈疏松结构的火药。某种枪用松质火药的配方为：硝化纤维素96%-96.5%、总挥发分1.8%、二苯胺1%?2%、石墨0.9%、硝酸钾小于0.2%。松质火药的特点是药粒中含有大ffi的细小而均匀的微孔，密度较小.燃烧速度较快。制造时，用一定量的水溶性无机化合物如硝酸钾均匀地分散于单基药组分中，成型后用水浸泡，硝酸钾被溶解浸出，药粒中形成很多细小而均匀的微孔，孔的多少和大小通过改变硝酸钾的加人量和粒径调节。用作手枪和猎枪的发射药及点火药。
explanation_en: It is also called porous gunpowder. Propellant with porosity structure made by special production process. The formula of certain gun bulk propellant is: 96% -96.5% nitrocellulose, 1.8% total volatile, 1% diphenylamine? 2%, graphite 0.9%, potassium nitrate less than 0.2%. The characteristics of bulk propellant are that the grain contains small and uniform micropores with large ffi, the density is small, and the combustion speed is fast. During manufacturing, a certain amount of water-soluble inorganic compounds such as potassium nitrate are uniformly dispersed in the single base drug component. After forming, the potassium nitrate is soaked in water, and dissolved and leached. Many small and uniform micropores are formed in the drug particles, and the number and size of the pores are adjusted by changing the dosage and particle size of potassium nitrate. Gun propellant and ignition composition for pistols and shotguns.

explanation_cn: 一种具板状构造的浅变质岩石。原岩是黏土岩、粉砂畀或中酸性凝灰岩。原岩经脱水硬度有所提高.但矿物只冇极微弱1结晶。
explanation_en: A shallow metamorphic rock with plate-like structure. The original rock is clay rock, silty sand or intermediate acid tuff. The hardness of the original rock has been improved after dehydration, but the mineral only has very weak crystallization.

explanation_cn: 用氧化招粉制球后在竖炉中加温得到的烧结刚玉。体积稳定性I好。常用于制作滑板、透气砖以及刚玉质浇注料等。
explanation_en: Sintering corundum is obtained by heating in a shaft furnace after pelletizing with oxidized powder. Good volume stability. It is commonly used for making slide plates, breathable bricks and corundum castable.

explanation_cn: 又称板劈理。是一种由泥质岩低级区域变质作用形成的构造，是板岩的特征构造。它与原岩层理平行或斜交，常整齐而光滑，有时有少量絹云母、绿泥石等，显微弱的丝绢光泽。热接触变质作用也可形成板岩?但其板状构造可能是原岩的板状层理，而不是由应力作用形成的板状劈理。
explanation_en: It is also called slaty cleavage. It is a structure formed by low-grade regional metamorphism of argillaceous rock, and is the characteristic structure of slate. It is parallel or oblique to the original rock bedding, usually neat and smooth, sometimes with a small amount of sericite, chlorite, etc., showing weak silky luster. Thermal contact metamorphism can also form slate? But its plate like structure may be the plate like bedding of the original rock, rather than the plate like cleavage formed by stress.

explanation_cn: 由多块燃料板与少数构件组成的独立燃料单元。有平板型、弧板型和渐开线型三种。
explanation_en: An independent fuel unit composed of multiple fuel panels and a few components. There are three types: flat plate type, arc plate type, and involute type.

explanation_cn: 层状结构氧化物矿物。与金红石、锐钛矿成同质三象。主要在阿尔卑斯山脉中.与石英、钠长石、绿泥石、榍石、金红石、锐钛矿等共生，形成晚于金红石，早于锐钛矿。在自然条件下稳定.在砂矿中出现。是提炼钛的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Layered oxide minerals. It forms three homogenous images with rutile and anatase. Mainly in the Alps, it coexists with quartze, albite feldspar, chlorite, sphene, rutile, anatase, etc., forming later than rutile and earlier than anatase. Stable under natural conditions. Appears in placers. It is a raw mineral material for refining titanium.

explanation_cn: 离子晶体等材料中由极化子通过点阵运动形成电流的现象。在晶体中，一个缓慢运动的电子，由于库仑相互作用，能使附近点阵极化，即正离子被吸引，负离子被排斥，从而点阵也发生相应的弹性应变。
explanation_en: In materials such as ionic crystal, current is formed by polaron moving through lattice. In a crystal, a slow moving electron can polarization the nearby lattice due to the Coulomb interaction, that is, the positive ions are attracted and the negative ions are repelled, so the lattice also has corresponding elasticity strain.

explanation_cn: 电介质单位体积内的电偶极矩的总和。
explanation_en: The sum of the electric dipole moments per unit volume of dielectric.

explanation_cn: 衡量原子、离子或分子在电场作用下极化强度的微观参数，为其在电场作用下形成的偶极矩与作用于其上的有效内电场之比。
explanation_en: The microscopic parameter that measures the polarization intensity of atoms, ions, or molecules under an electric field is the ratio of the dipole moment formed by the electric field to the effective internal electric field acting on it.

explanation_cn: 表示多晶体晶粒取向择优分布位置及强度的极射赤面投影图。将试样的三个正交方向分别与参考球的三个主轴平行，将试样（乳板）置于参考球中心，在每一晶粒中选取同一适当晶面，将各晶面的法线与参考球面的各焦点极射投影到赤道面上便得到这些交点在赤面上的投影点。
explanation_en: Stereographic projection diagram showing the preferred distribution position and strength of orientation of polycrystalline grains. The three orthogonal directions of the sample are parallel to the three main axes of the reference sphere, the sample (breast plate) is placed at the center of the reference sphere, the same appropriate crystal plane is selected from each grain, and the projection points of these intersection points on the red plane are obtained by projecting the normal of each crystal plane and the focus of the reference sphere onto the equatorial plane.

explanation_cn: 用于描述晶体中各晶面的方位、晶面夹角、晶带关系以及对称状况的投影方法。
explanation_en: The projection method used to describe the orientation of each crystal plane, the included angle of crystal plane, the relationship between crystal bands and the symmetry condition in crystal.

explanation_cn: 根据物质在滴汞电极上电解过程中的电流-电压曲线进行分析的方法。
explanation_en: A method of analyzing the current voltage curve of a substance during the electrolysis process on a drop mercury electrode.

explanation_cn: 燃料电池中反应物在催化剂表面的浓度为零时的电流。也就是说，反应物到达催化剂表面时就被立刻反应掉了。
explanation_en: The current in a fuel cell when the concentration of reactants on the catalyst surface is zero. That is to say, when the reactant reaches the surface of the catalyst, it is immediately reacted off.

explanation_cn: 剪切速率趋于无穷大或者很大的切应力作用下髙分子流体的表观剪切黏度，是一个不随剪切速率变化的常数，此时大分子的取向达到极限状态，不再改变，分子的流动阻力也不再改变。
explanation_en: The apparent shear viscosity of the high molecular fluid under the action of shear rate tends to infinity or great shear stress is a constant that does not change with the shear rate. At this time, the orientation of the macromolecule reaches the limit state and does not change, and the flow resistance of the molecule does not change.

explanation_cn: 当NiMH电池储存的电量达到饱和后，继续对电池允电，电解液会在阳极产生氧气。
explanation_en: After the NiMH battery reaches saturation, continue to charge the battery, and the electrolyte will generate oxygen at the anode.

explanation_cn: 要求木材耐久性强、抗横压（局部）强度大、握钉力大。是在露天使用，受气候影响很大。在适宜的条件下，有利于发生腐朽以及白蚁活动。所以，要求木材天然耐腐性能强.且易于进行防腐处理。是处在重载火车的冲击之下，受到的局部横压力很大，所以要求木材的横纹抗压（局部）的强度要大，但不要使用具有扭转纹原木制成的。同时还要求木材具有钿性，以木材的弹性来减少铁轨的冲击。要求木材握道钉力大，以保持铁轨牢牢地固定在上。另外岔枕和桥枕的凿孔要求不固定，这对来说是没有问题的。适宜制作普通及道岔的树种有落叶松、马尾松、云南松、云杉、冷杉、铁杉、偷木、桦木、白青冈类、红青冈类、麻栎类、槲栎类、红锥、硬叶锥、枫香等。适宜制作桥梁的树种有落叶松、华山松、思茅松、高山松、云南松、云杉、冷杉、铁杉、红松等，还可试用杨木。对云南松和桉树要重视有无扭转纹（即斜纹理），枫香要注意有无腐朽。
explanation_en: Wood is required to have strong durability, strong transverse pressure resistance (local) strength and strong nail holding force. It is used outdoors and is greatly affected by the climate. Under suitable conditions, it is conducive to decay and termite activity. Therefore, wood is required to have strong natural corrosion resistance and be easy to carry out anti-corrosion treatment. Under the impact of heavy load trains, the local transverse pressure is very large, so the transverse compressive (local) strength of wood is required to be large, but do not use log with twist grain. At the same time, wood is also required to have a mother of pearl property, and the elasticity of wood is used to reduce the impact of the rail. It is required that the wood should have a strong grip on the spike to keep the rail firmly fixed. In addition, the drilling requirements for turnout sleepers and bridge sleepers are not fixed, which is not a problem for them. Suitable tree species for making ordinary and turnouts include larch, masson pine, Yunnan pine, spruce, fir, hemlock, steal wood, birch, white green oak, red green oak, oak, red cone, hard leaf cone, maple, etc. Suitable tree species for making bridges include larch, Huashan pine, Simao pine, Gaoshan pine, Yunnan pine, spruce, fir, hemlock, red pine, etc. Poplar can also be used as a trial. For Yunnan pine and eucalyptus trees, attention should be paid to the presence of twisting patterns (i.e. oblique textures), and for maple incense, attention should be paid to the presence of decay.

explanation_cn: 对于正在滑移面上运动的位错来说，穿过此滑移面的其他位错称为林位错。林位错的存在会阻碍位错的运动，但是若应力足够大，滑动的位错将切过林位错而继续前进。运动中位错互相切割的过程称为位错交割。例如两个刃型位错交割后，对不动的刃型位错将产生一小段位错(称为位错割阶)，它的伯格斯矢量等于正在滑动的刃型位错的伯格斯矢量。
explanation_en: For a dislocation moving on the slip plane, other dislocation passing through the slip plane are called dislocation forest. The existence of the dislocation forest will hinder the movement of the dislocation, but if the stress is large enough, the sliding dislocation will cut through the dislocation forest and continue to move forward. The process of dislocation cutting each other in motion is called dislocation delivery. For example, after the delivery of two edge dislocation, a small segment of dislocations (called dislocation cut order) will be generated for the fixed edge dislocation. Its Burgers vector is equal to the Burgers vector of the sliding edge dislocation.

explanation_cn: 按照硅氧四面体在空间的组合情况而划分的一类硅酸盐矿物结构。结构中.每个硅氧四面体的四个角顶分别与相邻的四个硅氧四面体共用，形成三维无限延伸的络阴离子。
explanation_en: A type of silicate mineral structure classified according to the spatial combination of silicon oxygen tetrahedron. In the structure, the four corners of each silicon oxide tetrahedron are shared with the adjacent four silicon oxide tetrahedrons, forming a three-dimensional infinitely extended complex anion.

explanation_cn: 在一定温度下能溶于水、油或树脂的着色剂称为染料。染料按来源分为天然染料和合成染料，其中天然染料主要包括一些植物染料和动物染料。按应用方法可将将染料分为溶剂染料和分散染料。分别对应于非纺织品领域和纺织品领域。在染料的加工工艺中。由于其溶于聚合物熔体中，因此不存在分散问题。当染料完全溶解时即达到它的最大着色强度，熔融染料在聚合物熔体中的完全溶解以及均匀分布对于避免最后成品中的瑕疵十分重要。染料不但数a多，且每类染料的性质和使用方法又各不相同。衡量一种染料染色质量髙低的指标是染色牢度。染色牢度包括日晌牢度、皂洗牢度、摩擦牢度、汗渍牢度、氯洗牢度等。染料的应用不局限于纺织物的染色和印花，也应用于油漆、塑料、皮革、光电通信、食品等许多领域。我国对染料的命名统一使用三段命名法。其名称包括三个部分，即冠称、色称和尾注。
explanation_en: Colorant that can dissolve in water, oil or resin at a certain temperature is called dye or dyestuffc. Dye or dyestuffc can be divided into natural dye or dyestuffc and synthetic dye or dyestuffc according to their sources. Natural dye or dyestuffc mainly include some plant dye or dyestuffc and animal dye or dyestuffc. According to the application method, dye or dyestuffc can be divided into solvent dye or dyestuffc and disperse dye or dyestuffc. Corresponds to the non textile field and the textile field respectively. In the processing of dye or dyestuffc. Since it is soluble in polymer melt, there is no dispersion problem. When the dye or dyestuffc is completely dissolved, its maximum coloring strength is reached. The complete dissolution and uniform distribution of molten dye or dyestuffc in polymer melt are very important to avoid defects in the final product. Dye or dyestuffc not only have a large number, but also each type of dye or dyestuffc has different properties and use methods. The index to measure the dyeing quality of a dye or dyestuffc is the color fastness. Color fastness includes fastness to sunlight, soaping, rubbing, sweating, and chlorine washing. The application of dye or dyestuffc is not limited to textile dyeing and printing, but also applied to paint, plastics, leather, photoelectric communication, food and many other fields. In our country, the naming of dye or dyestuffc is unified using the three paragraph naming method. Its name includes three parts, namely the crown name, color name, and endnote.

explanation_cn: 一种利用些对可见光强吸收的染料光敏化剂将半导体的光谱响应拓宽从而实现光能转化成电能的装置。染料敏化剂吸附在半导体表面与半导体的能级形成匹配。当染料敏化剂受到光照时产生电子空穴对，随后将一种电荷注入到半导体之中实现电荷分离。对外输出光电流和光电压。染料敏化太阳电池中所使用的半导体材料大都是光谱响应窄的宽禁带半导体材料，而染料敏化剂则采用的是光谱响应宽的有机染料分子、无机染料分子。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a device which uses dye or dyestuffc photosensitizers that absorb visible light intensity to broaden the spectral response of semiconductors so as to convert light energy into electric energy. The dye or dyestuffc sensitizer adsorbed on the semiconductor surface matches the energy level of the semiconductor. When the dye or dyestuffc sensitizer is illuminated, an electron hole pair is generated, and then a charge is injected into the semiconductor to realize charge separation. Output photocurrent and photovoltage externally. Most semiconductor materials used in dye sensitized solar cell are wide bandgap semiconductor materials with narrow spectral response, while dye or dyestuffc sensitizer uses organic dye or dyestuffc molecules and inorganic dye or dyestuffc molecules with wide spectral response.

explanation_cn: 在光的照射下，体系通过光化学反应形成有色染料，使曝光区与未曝光区产生颜色差异构成图像的光敏成像材料。
explanation_en: Under the irradiation of light, the system forms colored dye through photochemical reaction, which makes the exposed area and unexposed area produce color difference to form a photosensitive imaging materials of the image.

explanation_cn: 在第二类超导体进入混合态后，超导体内部会形成一定数量的磁通涡旋线：这种磁通涡旋线在洛伦兹力的作用下会运动.同时这种磁通涡旋线也受到磁通钉扎中心（如：点钉扎）的作用，当这种涡旋线可以弯曲，并使能量保持最低时，称这种涡旋线为柔性涡旋线。
explanation_en: After the type II superconductor enters the mixed state, a certain number of flux vortex line will be formed inside the superconductor: this flux vortex line will move under the Lorentz force. At the same time, this flux vortex line is also affected by the flux pinning center (such as point pinning). When this vortex line can be bent and keep the energy to the minimum, it is called flexible vortex line.

explanation_cn: 石墨生成石墨层间化合物后，将其在800-1000°C热处理得到的膨胀石墨粉报制成厚0.2-1mm的片状炭材料，主要用于密封填料和垫片等。
explanation_en: After graphite generates graphite interlayer compound, the expanded graphite powder obtained by heat treatment at 800-1000 ° C is reported to be flake carbon materials with thickness of 0.2-1 mm, which is mainly used for sealing packing and gasket.

explanation_cn: 指能够在空间自由卷曲形成无规线团的柔顺分子链高分子长链能以不同程度卷曲的特性称为柔性，是高分子特有的属性，是橡胶高弹性的根本原因，也是决定高分子形态的主要因素。高分子链柔性的根源是基于它的长链结构和链上各键的自由旋转性。
explanation_en: It refers to the flexible molecular chain macromolecule long chain that can curl freely in space to form random coil, which is called flexibility with the characteristics of varying degrees of curling. It is a unique attribute of macromolecule, the fundamental reason for rubber's high elasticity, and the main factor determining the shape of macromolecule. The root of macromolecule chain flexibility is its long chain structure and the free rotation of the bonds on the chain.

explanation_cn: 位错与溶质原子碳、氮结合，把位错钉扎住，使之不易运动。溶质原子在同溶体中由于原子直径的差异将会引起应变能，这便是柯垂尔气团形成的原因。柯垂尔气团常用于解释低碳钢中明显屈服点现象，当外加应力加大到上屈服点时位错从气团中挣脱出来而变成自由的位错，因此使它继续运动的力可以较小。
explanation_en: Dislocation combines with carbon and nitrogen atoms of solute to pin dislocation so that it is not easy to move. The strain energy will be caused by the difference in the atomic diameter of solute atoms in the same solution, which is the reason for the formation of Cottrell atmosphere. The Cotrell air mass is often used to explain the obvious yield point phenomenon in low carbon steel. When the applied stress increases to the upper yield point, the dislocation breaks away from the air mass and becomes a free dislocation, so the force that makes it continue to move can be small.

explanation_cn: 对于未满能带的一维晶格，等距离排列的原子体系总能量比较高，因此是不稳定的，被称为柯恩-派尔斯失稳。原子一定要发生位移，原子发生位移后可使体系的总 能量降低。
explanation_en: For one-dimensional lattice with incomplete energy band, the atomic system with equidistant arrangement has higher total energy, so it is unstable, and is called Kohn-Peierls instability. The atoms must undergo displacement, which can reduce the total energy of the system.

explanation_cn: 柱塞式挤出成型过程是将物料加入加料室，经机筒的加热段熔融塑化后，在柱塞压力作用下使熔融物料通过挤出机口模挤出、冷却，从而获得所要求的形状制品的过程。该方法存在着在成型过程中剪切力较小、流动平稳等优点。世界上第一台柱塞挤出机为手动，用于连续制造铅管，它是Bramall于1795年发明的，于1870年开始用于塑料加工。随着螺杆挤出机的出现，并表现出对塑料加工的良好适应性和优越性，使得柱塞挤出机的发展应用几乎停滞。近年来，由于超高分子量聚乙烯（UHMWPE)和聚四氟乙烯（PTFE)等原料在成型时，螺杆挤出机表现出不适应性，柱塞挤出成型方法又得到了很好的应用。
explanation_en: The plunger extrusion molding process is a process in which the material is added to the feeding room, melted and plasticized in the heating section of the barrel, and the molten material is extruded and cooled through the die of the extruder under the action of the plunger pressure, so as to obtain the products with the required shape. This method has the advantages of low shear force and smooth flow during the forming process. The first plunger extruder in the world is manual, which is used for continuous manufacturing of lead pipes. It was invented by Bramall in 1795 and began to be used for plastics processing in 1870. With the appearance of screw extruder and its good adaptability and superiority to plastics processing, the development and application of plunger extruder almost stagnate. In recent years, the screw extruder is not suitable for the molding of ultra high molecular weight polyethylene, polylctrafluorocthylone and other raw materials, and the ram-extrusion method has been well applied.

name_cn: 柴油车尾气净化四效催化材料
name_en: four way catalyst of diesel exhaust purification
explanation_cn: 能同时消除柴油车四种主要污染物，利用碳烟燃烧催化材料在同一催化床层除去四种污染物。
explanation_en: Four main pollutants of diesel vehicle can be eliminated at the same time, and four pollutants can be removed in the same catalytic bed using soot combustion catalytic materials.

explanation_cn: 栅极导电材料一般是指场效应晶体管（FET)或有机发光显示器（OLED)中用于制备栅电极（gate)的具有导电性能材料，其主要用于控制有源层的电流的强度。栅极导电材料一般采用金属或合金材料，如铬（Cr)或铬合金、钼钽（MoTa)合金、钼（Mo)、钼钨合金（MoW)、钼铌合金（MoNd)铝（A1)或铝铌合金（AINd)等。
explanation_en: Gate electrode materials generally refers to the conductive materials used to prepare gate electrode in field effect transistor (FET) or organic luminescence display (OLED), which is mainly used to control the current intensity of the active layer. The gate electrode materials is generally metal or alloy materials, such as chromium (Cr) or chromium alloy, molybdenum tantalum (MoTa) alloy, molybdenum (Mo), molybdenum tungsten alloys (MoW), molybdenum niobium alloy (MoNd) aluminum (A1) or aluminum niobium alloy (AINd).

explanation_cn: 栅极绝缘材料是金属栅极与有源层（或金属）之间的一层绝缘层材料，起到绝缘的作用，常用的栅极绝缘层材料是SiO2，对其要求是绝缘性好、击穿电压高、薄膜覆盖性好。
explanation_en: The grid insulating materials is an insulating layer materials between the metal grid and the active layer (or metal), which plays an insulating role. The commonly used grid insulating layer materials is SiO2, which is required to have good insulation, high breakdown voltage and good film coverage.

explanation_cn: 镍-镉和镍-氢电池的标准耐过充测试。
explanation_en: Overcharge test of standard resistance for nickel cadmium and nickel hydrogen batteries.

explanation_cn: 镍-镉和擦-氢电池的标准荷电保持测试。
explanation_en: Standard charge retention test for Nickel Cadmium and Wipe Hydrogen Batteries.

explanation_cn: 标度理论是在总结、分析和归纳实验结果的基础上，提出的一种研究临界现象的唯象理论。它不能确定临界指数的值，但可以建立临界指数之间的关系——标度律。
explanation_en: The scaling theory is a phenomenological theory for studying critical phenomena based on the summary, analysis and induction of experimental results. It cannot determine the value of the critical index, but it can establish the relationship between the critical indices - scaling law.

explanation_cn: 一种能将其分枝成长过程中的某一阶段保留下来的树枝状晶体。其中，有的是由于在其分枝成长过程中母液枯竭而直接残留下来的；有的是虽已无树枝状形貌?但经过适当的溶液侵蚀而间接显现的。树枝晶成长过程大多是先形成主枝(一次枝晶），而后在其上分出二次枝晶.二次枝晶上再分出三次枝晶.如此不断，直至母液枯竭或各级枝晶相互衔接合缝而终结。
explanation_en: A dendritic crystal that can retain a certain stage of its branching growth process. Some of them are directly retained due to the depletion of the mother liquor during its branching and growth process; Some have no dendritic morphology? But indirectly manifested through appropriate solution erosion. Most of the growth process of dendritic crystal is to form the main branch (primary dendrite) first, and then separate the secondary dendrite on it, and then separate the secondary dendrite from the secondary dendrite, and so on, until the mother liquor is exhausted or all levels of dendrites are connected with each other.

explanation_cn: 外形呈树枝状的粉末。电解法生产的铜粉的形状是树枝状。树枝状粉末具有高的成形性。
explanation_en: Powder with dendritic shape. The shape of copper powder produced by electrolysis is dendritic. Dendritic powder has high formability.

explanation_cn: 具有三维枝状结构、直径在一至数十纳米范围的球状大分子。具有规整的化学结构，球形中心有一核，从其延伸出若干分支，每个分支可再延伸出分支，由此持续伸展下去，最后达到球形分子表面。树状高分子的球形结构限制了聚合物分子链间的相互缠结，因此其聚合物溶液和本体黏度均比相同结构单元的线型聚合物的低。
explanation_en: Spherical macromolecule with three-dimensional dendritic structure and diameters ranging from one to tens of nanometers. It has a regular chemical structure, with a nucleus at the center of the sphere, from which several branches extend. Each branch can then extend further, continuing to reach the surface of the spherical molecule. The spherical structure of dendrimer restricts the mutual entanglement between polymer molecular chains, so its polymer solution and bulk viscosity are lower than those of linear polymer with the same structural unit.

explanation_cn: 可分为天然树脂与合成树脂两大类。天然树脂是植物组织的正常代谢产物或分泌物，常和挥发油并存于植物的分泌细胞、树脂道或导管中，尤其是多年生木本植物芯材部位的导管中。天然树脂是由多种有机成分组成的混合物，通常为无定形固体，少数为半固体?有时也可以是液态的有机物质。相对分子质量不确定但通常较高，具有软化或熔融温度范围，一般不溶于水，能溶于有机溶剂。，合成树脂是人工合成的一类高分子化合物。在一定温度范围内可流动、塑形并固化成制品。按其加工行为不同的特点又有热塑性树脂和热固性树脂之分。按使用范围合成树脂用来制造塑料、橡胶、合成纤维，也用来制造涂料、黏合剂、绝缘材料等。AS树脂见苯乙烯-丙烯腈共聚物（21页）。
explanation_en: It can be divided into natural resin and synthetic resin. Natural resin is the normal metabolite or secretion of plant tissue, and often coexists with volatile oil in the secretory cells, resin ducts or catheter of plants, especially in the catheter of the core wood of perennial woody plants. Natural resin is a mixture composed of various organic components, usually amorphous solid, and a few semi solid? Sometimes it can also be a liquid organic substance. The relative molecular weight is uncertain but usually high, with a range of bating or melting temperature, which is generally insoluble in water and soluble in organic solvents., Synthetic resin is a kind of artificial macromolecule compound. It can flow, shape and curing into products within a certain temperature range. According to its different processing behavior, it can be divided into thermoplastic resin and thermosetting resin. According to the scope of use, synthetic resin is used to manufacture plastics, rubber, synthetic fiber, coatings, adhesive, insulation materials, etc. See styrene acrylonitrile copolymer (page 21) for as resin.

explanation_cn: 树脂基复合材料是一种由两个或更多种不同类型的材料组成的复合材料，其中至少一个组分是树脂。这些材料通常包括一种坚固的增强材料，通常是纤维、颗粒或颗粒，以及一种树脂基体，用于将增强材料绑定在一起并传递力量。
explanation_en: Resin based composite materials is a composite materials composed of two or more different types of materials, at least one component of which is resin. These materials usually include a solid reinforcement materials, usually fibers, particles or particles, and a resin matrix, which is used to bind reinforcement materials together and transfer force.

explanation_cn: 指一类具有黏固或黏结性能的树脂基复合材料，主要种类按固化方式可分为自凝型、光固化型和双重固化型。按使用方式可分为酸蚀-冲洗型、自酸蚀型和自黏结型。树脂水门汀的组成与化学固化复合树脂很相似，主要由树脂基质、增强填料和引发剂组成，剂型有粉液型和双糊剂型。树脂水门汀的压缩强度可达到150-240MPa,其强度、韧性和黏结效果均优于传统的无机水门汀。结合特定的底涂剂和处理方法，树脂水门汀能对牙釉质、牙本质、陶瓷和合金进行黏结。临床上主要用于黏固或黏结固定修复体。
explanation_en: It refers to a class of resin based composite materials with adhesive or bonding properties. The main types can be divided into self curing, light curing and dual curing according to the curing mode. According to usage, it can be divided into acid etching flushing type, self acid etching type, and self bonding type. The composition of resin cement is very similar to the chemical curing composition resin, which is mainly composed of resin matrix, reinforcing filler and initiator. The dosage forms include powder liquid and double paste dosage forms. The compressive strength of resin cement can reach 150-240MPa, and its strength, toughness and bonding effect are superior to those of traditional inorganic cement. Combined with specific primer (dental) and treatment method, resin cement can bond enamel, dentin, ceramics and alloy. Clinically, it is mainly used to cement or fix prosthesis.

explanation_cn: 指粒子（包括原子核）碰撞导致原子核的质量、电荷或能量状态发生改变的现象的总称。这一术语也适用于弹性散射。核反应的发现和研究对核物理和核工程领域有着重要的意义。核反应的基本特征包括：核反应的方程式描述了起始粒子（反应物）与末态粒子（产物）之间的相互作用。这些方程式反映了反应物质的变化以及释放或吸收的能量。Q值（也称为反应能量）是核反应的一个关键参数。当Q值为正时，表示反应时释放能量，反之，则吸收能量。释放的能量可以表现为反应产物的动能或产物原子核的激发能。核反应遵守能量、动量、质量、电荷等守恒定律，这些守恒律是核反应的基本原理。核反应的研究在核物理、核工程、核能利用（包括核裂变和核聚变）以及基本粒子物理等领域具有重要意义。通过使用各种类型的加速器和核反应堆，已经产生了数以千计的不同核反应，获得了大量放射性同位素以及一系列基本粒子，如介子、超子、反质子、反中子等。这些研究有助于深入了解原子核的结构、核反应的机制，以及核能的应用和基本粒子间的相互作用。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of particles (including atomic nuclei) colliding and causing changes in the mass, charge, or energy state of atomic nuclei. This term also applies to elasticity scattering. The discovery and research of nuclear reaction is of great significance in the field of nuclear physics and nuclear engineering. The basic characteristics of nuclear reaction include: the equation of nuclear reaction describes the interaction between the initial particle (reactant) and the final particle (product). These equations reflect the changes in reactants and the energy released or absorbed. Q value (also called reaction energy) is a key parameter of nuclear reaction. When the Q value is positive, it indicates that energy is released during the reaction, and vice versa, energy is absorbed. The released energy can be expressed as the kinetic energy of the reaction product or the excitation energy of the product nucleus. Nuclear reaction obeys the conservation laws of energy, momentum, mass and charge, which are the basic principles of nuclear reaction. The research of nuclear reaction is of great significance in the fields of nuclear physics, nuclear engineering, nuclear energy utilization (including nuclear fission and nuclear fusion) and elementary particle physics. Through the use of various types of accelerators and nuclear reactor, thousands of different nuclear reaction have been produced, and a large number of radioisotope and a series of basic particles have been obtained, such as mesons, hyperons, antiprotons, antineutrons, etc. These studies are helpful to understand the structure of atomic nucleus, the mechanism of nuclear reaction, the application of nuclear energy and the interaction between elementary particles.

explanation_cn: 又称瞬发辐射分析。用离子束分析薄膜及材料近表面层化学成分的一种方法。
explanation_en: It is also called prompt radiation analysis. A method of analyzing the chemical composition of thin films and near surface layers of materials by ion beam.

explanation_cn: 产生、维持并控制核裂变链式反应，能够以一定功率释放能量的装置。简称反应堆。由中子引发的裂变反应能生产中子，当产生的平均中子数和等于吸收及泄漏的总数，裂变链就是定态的、自持的。
explanation_en: A device that generates, maintains and controls nuclear fission chain reaction and can release energy at a certain power. Abbreviated as a reactor. The fission reaction initiated by neutrons can produce neutrons. When the average number of neutrons produced equals the total number of absorbed and leaked neutrons, the fission chain is stationary and self-sustaining.

explanation_cn: 具有特殊耐蚀性能的堆用合金。轻水动力及钠冷却块中用作热交换器的传热管材料，含 Ni、Cr、Mo等合金元素较多的镍基或铁基耐蚀合金。沸水堆及压水堆热交换器传热管的实用材料是因科镍600合金或其改进型。
explanation_en: Heap alloy with special corrosion resistance. Heat transfer tube material used as heat exchanger in light water power and sodium cooling block, nickel base or iron base corrosion resistant alloy containing more alloy elements such as Ni, Cr, Mo, etc. The practical materials of heat exchanger tubes for BWR and PWR is Inconel 600 alloy or its improved type.

explanation_cn: 用来记录基本粒子行踪的照相乳剂。
explanation_en: A photographic emulsion used to record the movement of elementary particles.

explanation_cn: 蛋白质的一个结构域，通常为一短的氨基酸序列，它能与人核载体相互作用，使蛋内能被运进细胞核。NLS存在于亲核蛋内和病毒蛋白中。根据结构，可以将核定位信号分为含一个序列的单分型核定位信号、含分隔的两个序列的双分型核定位信号,非经典核定位信号。在基因传递领域，核定位信号吋用来帮助蛋白质入核，提高传递效率。
explanation_en: A structural domain of a protein, usually a short amino acid sequence, that can interact with a human nuclear carrier, allowing the egg to be transported into the nucleus. NLS exists in nucleophilic eggs and viral proteins. According to the structure, the nuclear localization signal can be divided into a single nuclear localization signal containing one sequence, a double nuclear localization signal containing two separated sequences, and a non classical nuclear localization signal. In the field of gene transmission, nuclear localization signal is used to help protein enter the nucleus and improve transmission efficiency.

explanation_cn: 因有很大的中子吸收截面而降低核反应堆反应性的物质。
explanation_en: A substance that reduces the reactivity of a nuclear reactor because of its large neutron absorption cross section.

explanation_cn: 可在核反应堆中通过核裂变或核聚变产生实用核能的材料。至今还未有建成使用聚变核燃料的反应堆。因此通常说到核燃料时指的 是裂变核燃料。含有易裂变核素，在反应堆内可以实现自持核裂变链式反应的材料。
explanation_en: Materials that can produce practical nuclear energy through nuclear fission or nuclear fusion in nuclear reactor. So far, no reactor using fusion fuel has been built. Therefore, nuclear fuel usually refers to fission fuel. A materials containing fissile nuclides that can realize self-sustaining nuclear fission chain reaction in the reactor.

explanation_cn: 防止发生临界事故的专门技术。一个能产生链式反应的介质或系统，当其链式裂变反应能稳定自持地进行时 (有效倍增因子等于1)，称该系统处于临界状态。
explanation_en: Specialized techniques to prevent critical accidents from occurring. A medium or system capable of producing chain reactions is said to be in a critical state when the chain fission reaction can proceed stably and self-sustaining (with an effective multiplication factor equal to 1).

name_cn: 核燃料元件的无损检验
name_en: non-deslructive test of nuclear fuel element
explanation_cn: 利用材料的物理性质，不破坏被检材料、试样本身或不影响其使用效果而鉴定其质 量的检验方法。又称非破坏性检验。
explanation_en: It is an inspection method that uses the physical properties of materials to identify the quality without damaging the materials and samples to be tested or affecting their use effect. Also known as non-destructive testing.

explanation_cn: 堆芯内单位体积核燃料所产生的热功率。
explanation_en: Thermal power generated by unit volume of nuclear fuel in the core.

explanation_cn: 对反应堆中用过的乏燃料进行处理，以除去其中的裂变产物 并回收易裂变材料和可转换材料的过程。
explanation_en: The process of treating the used spent fuel (nuclear) in the reactor to remove fission product and recover fissile materials and fertile materials.

explanation_cn: 核燃料所经历的一系列步骤，包括利用、后处理和再加工等。
explanation_en: A series of steps experienced by nuclear fuel, including utilization, reprocessing and reprocessing.

explanation_cn: 反应堆运行期间燃料原子吸收中子引起的核转变。在物理和科学 研究中，常用发生转变的原子数与核燃料原始原子数的百分比来表。
explanation_en: Nuclear transformation caused by the absorption of neutrons by fuel atoms during reactor operation. In physical and scientific research, the percentage between the number of atoms that have undergone transformation and the original number of atoms of nuclear fuel is often expressed.

explanation_cn: 从安全和经济两个方面制定和实施的对燃料供应、堆内最佳利 用、储存、后处理和重复使用过程的最合理措施。燃料管理分为堆内燃料管理、堆外燃料管理和核燃料安全管理。堆内核燃料管理的目的是最有效地利用核燃料，以降低核燃料的研究费用。
explanation_en: Develop and implement the most reasonable measures for fuel supply, optimal utilization in the reactor, storage, reprocessing, and reuse processes from both safety and economic perspectives. Fuel management includes in core fuel management, out of core fuel management and nuclear fuel safety management. The purpose of nuclear fuel management is to make the most effective use of nuclear fuel to reduce the research cost of nuclear fuel.

explanation_cn: 从乏燃料或增殖元件中回收易裂变材料和吋转换材料-重新制成核反应堆燃料的过程。用高浓铀作燃料的核反应堆运行过程中，由于裂变产物的枳累，不可能把易裂变核素全部裂变，低浓铀作燃料的反应堆中初装的铀235可以被烧"尽'但可转换材料吸收中子转换出来的易裂变核素不可能全部烧尽。因此在乏燃料中一般都存在有宝贵的易裂变核素。从增殖堆中卸出的增殖元件尤其如此。燃料元件再制造包括燃料后处理和燃料元件再制造两部分。从反应堆中卸出的元件经一定时间冷却后-进行解体-除去结构材料，然后用酸溶解-用萃取法等从铀中分离出转换生成的钚。从钚中分离出转换出来的铀。从铀中去除裂变产物-特別是中子寄生吸收大的裂变产物，也可以用火法冶金的办法（使裂变产物挥发或掉渣）从燃料中除去。经净化后的燃料或增殖得到的燃料-用常规的燃料制造工艺重新制造成燃料元件，由于裂变产物不可能完全除净。特別是铀或钚的不可裂变放射性同位素的存在（如回收的燃料具有较强的易放射性，再制造过程需要屏蔽-远距离操作。增殖元件中的可转换材料只有一小部分被转换成易裂变材料，经后处理后，一般也都需要再制成增殖元件，重新加以利用。
explanation_en: Recovery of fissile materials from spent fuel (nuclear) or breeder elements and time conversion of materials - the process of reprocessing nuclear reactor fuel. During the operation of nuclear reactor using highly enriched uranium as fuel, due to the accumulation of fission product, it is impossible to fission all fissile nuclides, The uranium 235 initially installed in the reactor with low enriched uranium as fuel can be burned "As far as possible, it is impossible to burn out all the fissile nuclides converted from fertile materials by absorbing neutrons. Therefore, there are usually valuable fissile nuclides in spent fuel (nuclear). This is especially true for the breeder elements unloaded from the breeder reactor. The remanufacturing of fuel element includes fuel reprocessing and fuel element remanufacturing. The elements unloaded from the reactor are cooled for a certain time - disassembled - structural materials are removed, and then dissolved with acid - extracted The plutonium produced by conversion is separated from uranium. The converted uranium is separated from plutonium. Fission product, especially fission product with large neutron parasitic absorption, can be removed from uranium by pyrometallurgy (volatilizing or deslagging fission product). The purified fuel or the fuel obtained by multiplication is remanufactured into a fuel element by a conventional fuel manufacturing process, because fission product cannot be completely removed. In particular, the presence of non fissionable radioisotope of uranium or plutonium (for example, the recovered fuel is highly radioactive, and the remanufacturing process needs shielding remote operation. Only a small part of fertile materials in the proliferation elements are converted into fissile materials, and after post-processing, they generally need to be made into proliferation elements and reused.

explanation_cn: 核磁共振是一种用于分析物质结构的重要方法，它利用具有核磁矩的原子核在恒定磁场下对高频电磁场的吸收现象。具体来说，核磁矩的旋进运动在恒定磁场作用下，而在与恒定磁场垂直的方向施加高频磁场。当核磁矩的旋进频率与高频磁场的频率相等时，核磁矩系统将从高频电磁场中吸收能量。这个过程可以用来分析物质的性质和结构。核磁共振谱是一种原子核在恒定磁场下对高频电磁场能量吸收随频率变化的记录。它提供了关于物质结构的重要信息，包括谱线移位、弛豫时间和谱结构（多重共振峰）等参数。
explanation_en: Nuclear magnetic resonance is an important method for analyzing the structure of matter. Specifically, the precession motion of the nuclear magnetic moment is subjected to a constant magnetic field and a high-frequency magnetic field is applied in a direction perpendicular to the constant magnetic field. When the precession frequency of the nuclear magnetic moment is equal to the frequency of the high-frequency magnetic field, the nuclear magnetic moment system will absorb energy from the high-frequency electromagnetic field. This process can be used to analyze the properties and structure of substances. Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy is a record of the energy absorption of high-frequency electromagnetic fields by atomic nuclei under a constant magnetic field as a function of frequency. It provides important information about material structure, including spectral line shift, relaxation time and spectral structure (multiple resonance peaks) and other parameters.

explanation_cn: 核燃料，元件包壳等堆芯材料的纯度标准。它是以中子俘获截面的大小为依据 而规定的杂质含量的上限。从核物理角度考虑，为了 有效地利用中子，必须避免或减少吸收中子的杂质浸入堆芯。
explanation_en: Purity standards for core materials such as nuclear fuel and element cladding. It is the upper limit of impurity content specified based on the size of the neutron capture cross-section. From the perspective of nuclear physics, in order to effectively utilize neutrons, it is necessary to avoid or reduce the immersion of impurities that absorb neutrons into the core.

explanation_cn: 一个原子核分裂成两个 (在少数情况下，可分为三个或更多个）质量相差不多的碎片的现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of a nucleus splitting into two (in rare cases, three or more) fragments of similar mass.

explanation_cn: 一种核素转变为另一种核素的过程，又称核嬗变。核转变有天然的和人工的两类。前者为天然放射性元素（如铀、钍）的衰变过程，后者包括所有人工核反应过程。利用各种加速器和核反应堆，已经实现了上万种核反应，因此获得了80余种核素和各种基本粒子。
explanation_en: The process of transformation one nuclide into another nuclide is also called nuclear transmutation. There are two types of nuclear transformation: natural and artificial. The former is the decay process of natural radioactive elements (such as uranium and thorium), and the latter includes all artificial nuclear reaction processes. With various accelerators and nuclear reactor, tens of thousands of nuclear reaction have been realized, so more than 80 kinds of nuclides and various basic particles have been obtained.

explanation_cn: 又称DNA传感器，是基于DNA分子链上的四个碱基（A，T. G，C)具有唯一的配对（A-T, G-C)特性，通过换能器将碱基识别配对引起的变化转换成可测量的电信号的一种生物传感器。
explanation_en: Also known as dna sensor, it is a kind of biosensor based on the unique pairing (A-T, G-C) characteristics of four bases (A, T. G, C) on the DNA molecular chain, which converts the changes caused by base recognition pairing into measurable electrical signals through transducers.

explanation_cn: 在牙髓病及根尖周病治疗时，用于充填入牙齿根管内的材料。目的是严密封闭主根管和侧支根管，消除死腔，防止再感染。主要有固体根管充填材料、糊状根管充填材料及液体根管充填材料三大类。
explanation_en: Materials used to fill the root canal of teeth during the treatment of pulp diseases and periapical diseases. The purpose is to tightly seal the main and lateral root canals, eliminate dead spaces, and prevent reinfection. There are mainly three categories of solid root canal filling materials, paste root canal filling materials and liquid root canal filling materials.

explanation_cn: 又称糊状根管充填剂，是在根管治疗时充填入牙根管内的一种糊状材料，用于充填和封闭固体充填材料使用后残留的根管内间隙。其可塑性强，能将根管严密封闭，可单独充填根管，也可与固体根充材料联合使用。
explanation_en: Also known as paste root canal filling agent, it is a paste materials filled into the root canal of teeth during root canal treatment, which is used to fill and seal the residual gap in the root canal after the use of materials. It has strong plasticity, can seal the root canal tightly, can fill the root canal alone, or can be used together with solid root canal filling materials.

explanation_cn: 用于制造桥梁结构的工程结构钢，性能钢号后加q表示桥梁钢，主要使用板材和部分型材如H型钢、槽钢等。铁道和公路桥梁承受车辆的冲击载荷，故桥梁用钢要求具有足够的刚性、强度、韧性和良好的抗疲劳强度以及较低的缺口敏感性，同时对钢材的表面质量和耐候性也有较高的要求。桥梁结构件广泛采用铆接和焊接方法连接，对焊接件用钢还需要具有良好的焊接性能。桥梁用结构钢（GB/T714-2008)主要采用非合金结构钢和低合金高强度钢。
explanation_en: For engineering structural steel used for manufacturing bridge structures, the performance steel designation followed by q represents steel for bridge construction, which mainly uses plates and some profiles, such as H section steel, channel steel, etc. Railway and highway bridges bear the impact load of vehicles, so steel used for bridges is required to have sufficient rigidity, strength, toughness, good fatigue strength and low notch sensitivity. At the same time, steel product has high requirements for surface quality and weather resistance. Bridge structural members are widely connected by riveting and weld, and steel used for weld members also needs to have good weld performance. Structural steel for bridges (GB/T714-2008) mainly adopts non alloy structural steel and low alloy high-strength steel.

explanation_cn: 由A和B两种单体单独构成.其单体单元随着相对分子质量的增加沿主链从A单体单元主导地位逐渐变化到B单体单元占主体地位的聚合物。
explanation_en: It is composed of two monomer, A and B. Its monomer unit gradually changes along the main chain from the dominant position of A monomer unit to the dominant polymer of B monomer unit with the increase of relative molecular weight.

explanation_cn: 采用先进的材料复合技术.通过控制构成材料的要素（组成、结构等一侧向另一侧呈连续梯度变化的非均质材料。其内部达到界面消失，性质和功能相应于组成和结构的变化而里现梯度变化.可减小和克服结合部位的性能不PC.配因素。具有优异的隔热、防热和缓和热应力的功能。是一种组成、结构、性能可连续变化的功能性复合材料.
explanation_en: Advanced materials composition technology is adopted. By controlling the elements of materials (Heterogeneous materials whose composition and structure change from one side to the other in a continuous gradient. Its internal interface disappears, and its properties and functions show gradient changes corresponding to the changes of composition and structure. It can reduce and overcome the performance non PC and matching factors of the joint. It has excellent functions of heat insulation, heat protection and thermal stress mitigation. It is a functional composite materials whose composition, structure and performance can change continuously

explanation_cn: 指其组成、结构在断面的不同部位呈现有规律差别的一种合金。宏观梯度结构硬质合金由于其非均匀结构，表现出与常规均质硬质合金不同的力学性能。特别是其三明治结构.能够同时提高材料表面硬度和内部韧性，因而在力学性能和使用寿命方面更具有优势.尤其是其硬度性能。主要应用于冲击性较大的凿岩工具。梯度折射率光纤
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of alloy whose composition and structure are regularly different at different parts of the section. Macroscopic gradient structure carbide shows different mechanical properties from conventional homogeneous hardmetal due to its heterogeneous structure. Especially its sandwich structure can simultaneously improve the hardness of surface of materials and the internal toughness, so it has more advantages in mechanical properties and service life, especially its hardness performance. Mainly used for rock drilling tools with high impact. Gradient index fiber

explanation_cn: 组成大分子链的原子或基团不是一个单链，而是以两个及以上的单链相连而生成的梯状高分子链。由于其分子链中没有单链.梯形聚合物分子链比一般线型聚合物的刚性更强、溶解性较差，但常表现出良好的热稳定性。梯形聚合物的结构示意图，典型梯形聚合物。
explanation_en: The atoms or groups constituting the macromolecular chain are not a single chain, but a ladder shaped macromolecule chain formed by connecting two or more single chains. Because there is no single chain in its molecular chain, ladder polymer molecular chain is more rigid and less soluble than general linear polymer, but it often shows good thermal stability. Structure diagram of ladder polymer, typical ladder polymer.

explanation_cn: 学名2,4,6-三硝基甲苯，常用代号TNT,是目前最重要和用量最大的军用和民用单质炸药。纯品为无色针状结晶，工业品为淡黄色鱗片状物，吸湿性很小，室温下不挥发，难溶于水，微溶于乙醇、四氯化碳及二硫化碳等，易溶于吡啶、丙酮、甲苯、苯及氯仿等。晶体密度L654g/cm3,凝同点80.9°C(军品为80.2X：或80.1T,爆发点475X：(5s)或295C(5min)。密度L60g/cm3时的爆速为4.54MJ/kg(液态水）：密度1.64g/cm3时的爆速为6.92km/s,爆压16.9GPa(密度1.60g/cm3,药柱直径20mm):密度1.61g/cm3时的爆温约2600K;密度1.50g/cm3时的全爆容为750L/kg,做功能力285mL(铅墙扩孔值）猛度16_(铅柱压缩值），撞击感度4%-8%(10kg,25cm)?摩擦感度（摆角90°)4%-6%,150X：下不分解，200t下分解0.8%需要385miiu由甲苯经硝硫混酸多段连续硝化，往甲苯分子中逐步引人三个硝基，再以亚硫酸钠精制而得，制造工艺成熟，原料来源充足，爆炸性能及化学安定性良好，机械感度较低，具有令人满意的装药工艺性.既可压装，也可铸装，也可单独使用，尤其能与多种猛炸药及其他物质组成为数极多的混合炸药。广泛用于装填各种炮弹、航空炸弹、火箭弹、导弹、地雷、水雷、鱼雷、手榴弹及爆破器材。
explanation_en: The scientific name is 2,4,6-trinitrotoluene, and the common code is TNT. It is the most important military and civilian single explosive with the largest amount of use. The pure product is a colorless needle like crystal, while the industrial product is a light yellow flake like substance with low moisture absorption. It is not volatile at room temperature and is difficult to dissolve in water. It is slightly soluble in ethanol, carbon tetrachloride, and carbon disulfide, and is easily soluble in pyridine, acetone, toluene, benzene, and chloroform. The density of crystal is L654g/cm3, the condensation point is 80.9 ° C (80.2X for military products: or 80.1T, and the explosion point is 475X: (5s) or 295C (5min). The detonation velocity at density L60g/cm3 is 4.54MJ/kg (liquid water); the detonation velocity at density 1.64g/cm3 is 6.92km/s, and the detonation pressure is 16.9GPa (density 1.60g/cm3, grain diameter 20mm); the detonation temperature at density 1.61g/cm3 is about 2600K; The full explosion capacity is 750L/kg when the density is 1.50g/cm3, and the work capacity is 285mL (lead wall reaming value). The brisance is 16_ (Lead column compression value), impact sensitivity 4% -8% (10kg, 25cm)? Friction sensitivity (swing angle 90 °) 4% -6%, 150X: no decomposition at lower temperature, 0.8% decomposition at 200t requires 385miiu, which is obtained by multi-stage continuous nitration of toluene through nitrate sulfur mixed acid, gradually introducing three nitros into toluene molecule, and refining with sodium sulfite. The manufacturing process is mature, the source of raw materials is sufficient, the explosion performance and chemical stability are good, the mechanical sensitivity is low, and the charging process is satisfactory. It can be pressed, cast, or used alone, In particular, it can form a large number of composite explosive with a variety of heavy explosives and other substances. Widely used for loading various shells, aviation bombs, rockets, missiles, landmines, mines, torpedoes, grenades, and explosive equipment.

explanation_cn: 梯黑炸药又称黑梯炸药
explanation_en: Hexolite is also called black ladder explosive

explanation_cn: —种接枝聚合物，其特点在于支链整齐.接上的枝的分子量基本一致.一般不再带支链，这样得到的接枝共聚物的分子形状像梳子。合成时主链的聚合物应具可供反应的基团或原子.先将它溶解，再加人拟接枝的单体和催化剂或者预先做好的活性链.即可发生接枝共聚反应。例如用PVC接枝活性PS的反应就能得到具有PS支链的梳形结构聚合物：CH—CH,—CH—CH,—CH—(PVC)+2I2I2IClClCl在上述反应中被接上去的PS链是由活性阴离子聚合得到的，离子催化剂Li+与PVC中C1原子反应而使PS接上去。由于活性聚合分子量可以预先设计好，所以接上去的支链的分子量也是确定的。
explanation_en: A kind of grafted polymer, characterized by neat branched chains, basically the same molecular weight of the connected branches, and generally without branched chains, so that the molecular shape of the graft copolymer obtained is like a comb. During synthesis, the polymer of the main chain should have reactive groups or atoms. First dissolve it, and then add the monomer and catalyst to be grafted or the pre prepared active chain. Graft copolymerization can take place. For example, a comb shaped polymer with PS branch chain can be obtained by the reaction of PVC grafting active PS: CH-CH, - CH-CH, - CH - (PVC)+2I2I2IClClCl The PS chain connected in the above reaction is obtained by active anion polymerization, and the ionic catalyst Li+reacts with the C1 atom in PVC to connect PS. Since the molecular weight of the living polymerization can be designed in advance, the molecular weight of the connected branch chain is also determined.

explanation_cn: 一种在密封容器外部，环绕其外表面检测是否有气体或液体从密封容器中漏出或从外部漏入，同时确定漏点位置，并估算出漏出率的检测方法。检漏是根据密封容器内外压力不同而有流体从漏道流出的原理进行的。具体可以采用多种方法，如声学法、气泡法、流量法、化学反应法.卤素气体法、压差法等。
explanation_en: A detection method for detecting the leakage of gas or liquid from or into a sealed container by surrounding its outer surface, determining the location of the leakage point, and estimating the leakage rate. Leak testing is carried out according to the principle that fluid flows out of the leakage channel due to the different pressure inside and outside the sealed container. Multiple methods can be used, such as acoustic method, bubble method, flow rate method, chemical reaction method, halogen gas method, pressure difference method, etc.

explanation_cn: 指由化纤长丝束加工成长度为30-40mm、线密度为1.67dtex左右的短纤维。棉型短纤维一般采用切断机将化纤长丝束切成等长的纤维。对于工业用纱，也用牵切机加工成不等长的牵切纱。现在棉型纤维已不限于化学短纤维，用长丝短纤化处理，也时以制成各种棉纱。棉型纤维主要用于与棉纤维混纺，也可以纯纺。用于加工制备各种棉织品、非织造布、带子、缝纫线和绳索等。
explanation_en: It refers to the staple fiber with a length of 30-40mm and a linear density of about 1.67dtex processed from the chemical fiber tow. Cotton staple fiber is generally cut into equal length fibers by a cutter. For industrial yarn, drawing and cutting machines are also used to process unequal lengths of drawing and cutting yarn. Now cotton fiber is not limited to chemical staple fiber. It is treated with filamem staple fiber, and is sometimes used to make various cotton yarns. Cotton type fiber is mainly used for blending with cotton fiber, or pure spinning. Used for processing and preparing various cotton fabrics, non-woven fabrics, belts, sewing threads, ropes, etc.

explanation_cn: 见植物纤维。
explanation_en: See plant fiber.

explanation_cn: 棕榈树干的外围为叶鞘形成的网状棕衣所包覆，棕衣的纤维称棕丝或棕裥纤维，简称棕。呈棕色或黑褐色，表面较光滑，无纹节，横截面近似圆形.单纤维粗而短，较刚硬，耐磨性能差，强度和细度不匀率大，一般不适于纺丝加工，但耐腐蚀性好、断裂伸长率高。一般用于制造船用缆绳和毛刷、地毡、棕棚、蓑笠、床热和衬料等日常生活用品。
explanation_en: The outer periphery of the palm trunk is covered by a network of palm coats formed by leaf sheaths, and the fibers of the palm coat are called palm silk or palm pleated fibers, abbreviated as palm. It is brown or dark brown, with smooth surface, no knuckles, and approximate circular cross section. The single fiber is thick and short, relatively rigid, with poor wear resistance and large unevenness of strength and fineness. It is generally not suitable for spinning, but it has good corrosion resistance and high percentage elongation after fracture. It is generally used for manufacturing daily necessities such as ship ropes and brushes, floor felt, brown sheds, coir hats, bed heat, and lining materials.

explanation_cn: 晶体中一个特殊位错环，在外力作用下它能够在以平行于伯格斯矢量的线为轴的棱柱面上滑移。
explanation_en: A special dislocation loop in a crystal can slip on a prismatic surface with a line parallel to the Burgers vector as the axis under the action of an external force.

explanation_cn: 是指将全部或部分假体长期(30d以上）埋人体内.用以在形体上或者同时在形体及功能上替代或部分替代人体肢体、器官或组织的治疗过程。
explanation_en: It refers to the treatment process in which all or part of the prosthesis is embedded in the body for a long time (more than 30 days) to replace or partially replace human limbs, organs or tissues in shape or at the same time in shape and function.

explanation_cn: 由一种或多种生物医学材料制成，部分或全部埋入上皮表面以下的医疗器械。植入体与植入性假体比较具有更为广泛的含义。不论硅有形地还是无形地替代了人体中某部分组织或器官的医疗器械，只要是全部或部分地埋入上皮表面之下，都称为植入体，它既包含了人工心瓣膜、人工关节、人工种植牙、人工韧带和人造血管等植入性假体，又包括心脏起搏器、接骨板和医用缝线等临时性植人的辅助装置。
explanation_en: A medical device made of one or more biomedical materials and partially or completely embedded below the epithelial surface. Implant has a broader meaning than implantable prosthesis. Medical device that either physically or invisibly replace some tissues or organs in the human body, as long as they are completely or partially buried under the epithelial surface, are called implant. They include implantable prosthesis such as artificial heart valves, artificial joint, artificial dental implants, artificial ligaments and artificial blood vessels, as well as temporary implantable auxiliary devices such as cardiac pacemakers, internal fixation plate and medical sutures.

explanation_cn: 指那些用于特定的任务的被植入人体的皮下或病灶的传感器。其主要是为了更有效地实时监测人体内某些重要的生理或病理指标，或有目的地控制神经功能或定时释放药物等。如无线植入式血糖传感器、神经刺激传感器和避孕芯片等。
explanation_en: It refers to those sensors that are implanted under the skin or focus of the human body for specific tasks. Its main purpose is to more effectively monitor certain important physiological or pathological indicators in the human body in real-time, or to purposefully control neural function or release drugs on a scheduled basis. Such as wireless implantable blood glucose sensor, nerve irritation sensor and contraceptive chip.

explanation_cn: 由植物的籽、皮、叶、茎等获得的一类天然纤维。由籽获得的有棉纤维；由皮获得的有苎麻、亚麻、黄麻、大麻等纤维;由叶获得的有蕉麻、剑麻等纤维。由茎秆获得的有木材、竹、芦苇、稻麦秆、高粱秆等茎秆纤维。榨搪后的蔗渣也属茎秆纤维。的化学组成主要是纤维素.伴以半纤维素和木质素.是纺织、人造纤维、制浆造纸、木材加工等工业原料。
explanation_en: A kind of natural fiber obtained from seeds, skins, leaves and stems of plants. Cotton fibers obtained from seeds; Fibers obtained from the skin include ramie, linen, jute, hemp, and other fibers; Fibers obtained from leaves include banana hemp, sisal hemp, and other fibers. Stem fibers such as wood, bamboo, reed, rice and wheat straw and sorghum straw are obtained from stems. The sugarcane bagasse after squeezing is also a type of stem fiber. Its chemical composition is mainly cellulose, accompanied by semi cellulose and lignin. It is an industrial raw material for textile, man-made fiber, pulp and paper making, wood processing, etc.

explanation_cn: 是依靠分子间的氢键结合成为复合体。包括普通淀粉胶黏剂、氧化淀粉胶黏剂、淀粉接枝共聚物胶黏剂、糊精胶黏剂、木质素胶黏剂、豆蛋白胶黏剂、纤维素胶黏剂、单宁胶黏。
explanation_en: It depends on the hydrogen bond between molecules to form a complex. It includes ordinary starch adhesive, oxidized starch adhesive, starch graft copolymer adhesive, dextrin adhesive, lignin adhesive, soy protein adhesive, cellulose adhesive and tannin adhesive.

explanation_cn: 主要使用植物鞣剂进行主鞣制得到的一类皮革产品。
explanation_en: It is a kind of leather product obtained by main tanning with vegetable tanning agent.

explanation_cn: 是具有恒定张开位移的胶接双悬臂梁开裂扩展试验，用于评定胶接耐久性。最先由美国波音公司所采用。沿胶接试样的胶缝打入一个楔子，即楔子试样。
explanation_en: It is a crack propagation test of a bonded double cantilever beam with constant opening displacement, used to evaluate the durability of the bonding. It was first adopted by Boeing in the United States. Drive a wedge along the adhesive seam of the bonded specimen, which is the wedge specimen.

explanation_cn: 适合于制作各种模具用的工具钢。模具成形加工具有产品质量好、性能稳定、尺寸统一、生产效率高的特点，是机械加工业重要的少、无切削加工工艺。模具钢产量占工具钢产量的80%以上，模具工业已成为现代工业的重要子行业，模具生产数量与质量已成为衡量工业化发达程度的重要指标。模具钢可用于制造冷冲压模、热锻压模、压铸模等，品种繁多。模具钢应具有较高的硬度、强度、耐磨性和适当的韧性，根据不同模具工作环境的不同还要求具有优良的高温强度、红硬性、热疲劳性、导热性和耐蚀性等。根据模具钢的使用性质可分为三大类，一类是使金属在冷状态下变形的冷作模具钢，第二类是使金属在热状态下变形的热作模具钢，第二类是塑料模具钢。
explanation_en: It is suitable for making tool steel for various moulds. Mold forming processing has the characteristics of good product quality, stable performance, uniform size, and high production efficiency, and is an important minimally cutting and non cutting processing process in the mechanical processing industry. The output of die steel accounts for more than 80% of the output of tool steel. The mold industry has become an important sub industry of modern industry. The quantity and quality of mold production has become an important indicator to measure the degree of industrialization. Die steel can be used to manufacture cold stamping die, hot forging die, die-casting die, etc. Die steel shall have high hardness, strength, wear resistance and appropriate toughness. According to different die working environments, it also requires excellent high temperature strength, red hardness, thermal fatigue, thermal conductivity and corrosion resistance. According to the use properties of die steel, it can be divided into three categories: one is cold work die steel that deforms metal in cold state, the second is hot-working die steel that deforms metal in hot state, and the second is die steel for plastic materials forming.

explanation_cn: 做低熔点快速铸造成型模具用的锌合金，适用于做组合模具或塑料制品模具。合金具有良好的流动性，可以铸造出形状复杂的立体曲面和花纹。熔化时对热源尤特殊要求，浇铸简单，不需专门的设备，可用于制造冲裁、弯曲、成型、拉伸模具的工作零件。
explanation_en: Zinc alloy used for low melting point rapid foundry mould is suitable for making combination mould or plastics product mould. Alloy has good flow ability, and can foundry three-dimensional surfaces and patterns with complex shapes. It has special requirements for heat source during melting. casting is simple and does not need special equipment. It can be used to manufacture working parts of blanking, bending, forming and drawing dies.

explanation_cn: 模压成型（又称压制成型或压缩成型）是先将粉状，粒状或纤维状的塑料放入成型温度下的模具型腔中，然后闭模加压而使其成型并固化的作业。模压成型可兼用于热固性塑料，热塑性塑料和橡胶材料。
explanation_en: Press molding (also known as pressing or compression molding) is the operation of putting powdery, granular or fibrous plastics into the mold cavity at the molding temperature, and then pressing the closed mold to form and curing them. Press molding can also be used for thermosetting plastics, thermoplastic plastics and rubber materials.

explanation_cn: 又称模块容器，具有一定的外形尺寸和强度，用于取代药包式装药用的药包布和迫击炮装药用药包布，其配方和制造工艺与浆液模压法可燃药筒相同，其他主要性能要求是具有可燃药筒相同的可燃容器。
explanation_en: Also known as module container, it has a certain overall dimension and strength, and is used to replace the cartridge cloth for cartridge charging and mortar charging. Its formula and manufacturing process are the same as those of slurry molded combustible case. Other main performance requirements are combustible containers with the same combustible case.

explanation_cn: 泛指通过模压或传递模塑、注射模塑成型的塑料原料。过去模塑料大多指热间性塑料采用压制成型或传递成塑者，如酚醛树脂模塑料，但有的热塑性塑料由于流动性差，不能注塑成型，而采用模乐成型者，亦称为模塑料，如聚中基丙烯酸甲酯模塑料。见聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯模塑料。
explanation_en: It generally refers to plastics raw materials formed by molding or transfer molding and injection molding. In the past, molding plastics mostly refer to those thermotropic plastics that are molded or transferred into plastics by pressing, such as phenolic resin molding plastics. However, some thermoplastics plastics cannot be injected due to poor flow ability, and those that are molded by molding are also called molding plastics, such as polymethyl methacrylate molding plastics. See polymethyl methacrylate molding plastics.

explanation_cn: 是以成型材料所需的模板为主体构型去控制、影响和修饰材料的形貌，控制材料尺寸，进而调控材料性质的一种合成方法。该方法基于模板的空间限域作用实现对合成纳米材料的大小、形貌、结构等的控制，具有操作简单、重复率高、预见性好及合成材料的大小、形貌和结构可控等优点。传统模板法分为硬模板法和软模板法两类。硬模板主要以多孔阳极氧化铝、多孔硅为代表，可以根据目标材料的大小和形貌来设计，并基于模板良好的空间限域和调控作用实现对目标纳米材料的微观尺寸和空间有序排列的控制.以合成所需要的纳米材料。硬模板法制备纳米材料可结合电化学沉积法、溶胶-凝胶法、浸溃沉积法、化学沉积法等手段，通过前驱体的填充、包裹等将模板的结构、形貌复制到产物中去，然后通过酸碱溶解、高温分解等去除模板，合成目标纳米材料。软模板是一类由大量分子形成的结构相对稳定的分子体系，通过分子间作用力及空间限域能力，引导和凋控游离前驱体的规律性组装，从而控制纳米材料的组成、结构、形貌、尺寸、取向和排布。与硬模板相比，软模板的后期模板去除工作较为方便，但是软模板结构稳定性较差。
explanation_en: It is a synthesis method that uses the template required for forming materials as the main configuration to control, affect and modify the morphology of materials, control materials, and then regulate the properties of materials. This method realizes the control of the size, morphology and structure of the synthesized nanomaterials based on the spatial confinement of the template. It has the advantages of simple operation, high repetition rate, good predictability and controllable size, morphology and structure of the synthesized materials. The traditional template method is divided into hard template method and soft template method. The hard template is mainly represented by porous anodic aluminum oxide and porous silicon, which can be designed according to the size and morphology of the target materials. Based on the good spatial confinement and regulation of the template, the micro size and spatial orderly arrangement of the target nanomaterials can be controlled to synthesize the required nanomaterials. The preparation of nanomaterials by hard template method can be combined with electrochemical deposition, sol-gel method, immersion deposition, chemical deposition and other means to copy the structure and morphology of the template into the product through the filling and wrapping of precursors, and then remove the template through acid alkali dissolution, high-temperature decomposition and other means to synthesize the target nanomaterials. Soft template is a relatively stable molecular system formed by a large number of molecules. Through intermolecular force and spatial confinement ability, it can induction and control the regular assembly of free precursors, thus controlling the composition, structure, morphology, size, orientation and layout of nanomaterials. Compared with hard templates, the removal of templates in the later stage of soft templates is more convenient, but the structural stability of soft templates is poor.

explanation_cn: 一类新的聚合方法，它是在模板材料存在的条件下，单体在模板材料分子提供的特殊的反应场所中进行的聚合。模板聚合种类较多，如利用共价键结合的模板聚合、利用酸碱基团相互作用的模板聚合、利用氢键作用的模板聚合、利用电荷转移作用的模板聚合以及利用偶极作用和立体选择作用的模板聚合等。模板聚合的特点:单体在模板材料分子提供的特殊反应场所中进行聚合，聚合反应的速率、制得的子体聚合物的聚合度、立构规整性、序列结构、性能均受模板材料特殊的影响.因此它是高分子设计及仿生高分子制备方面的重要手段。生物体内蛋白质的合成，脱氧核搪(DNA)的遗传信息的储存和复制都与模板聚合有密切关系。
explanation_en: A new kind of polymerization method, which is the polymerization of monomer in the special reaction site provided by template materials molecule in the presence of template materials. There are many kinds of template polymerization, such as template polymerization using covalent bond, template polymerization using acid-base group interaction, template polymerization using hydrogen bond, template polymerization using charge transfer, and template polymerization using dipole action and stereo selection. Characteristics of template polymerization: monomer conducts polymerization in the special reaction site provided by template materials molecule. The rate of polymerization reaction, the degree of polymerization, stereoregularity, sequence structure and properties of the resultant polymer are all affected by the special characteristics of template materials. Therefore, it is an important means for macromolecule design and biomimetic macromolecule preparation. The synthesis of protein in organism, the storage and replication of genetic information of deoxidation nucleus (DNA) are closely related to template polymerization.

explanation_cn: 由基体的切变模量与析出相颗粒的切变模量不同产生的硬化效果。
explanation_en: The hardening effect is caused by the difference between the shear modulus of matrix and that of precipitated phase particles.

explanation_cn: 采用锻压设备并利用模具使坯料在模具内产生塑性变形并充满模膛(型腔)而获得所需形状和尺寸的锻件的工艺方法。模锻工艺生产率高，工人劳动强度低，锻件尺寸精度高，并可锻制复杂形状的锻件，适合于批量生产。但需要专用的模锻设备且模具成本高，故不适合单件或小批量生产。模锻一般分为开式模锻和闭式模锻。模锻的工序为制坯、预锻和终锻。
explanation_en: The process method of obtaining the required shape and size of forgings by adopting forging and pressing equipment and using the die to make the billet plastic deformation in the die and fill the die chamber (cavity). Die forging process has high productivity, low labor intensity of workers, high dimensional accuracy of forgings, and can forge forgings of complex shapes, which is suitable for batch production. However, special die forging equipment is required and the die cost is high, so it is not suitable for single piece or small batch production. Die forging is generally divided into open die forging and closed die forging. The processes of die forging include blank making, pre forging and final forging.

explanation_cn: 将硬质橡胶的长方形条状试样放在水平的两支点上，然后在 两支点中间施加载荷，试样折断时达到的最大弯曲力矩与试样横向截面模量的比值为横向折断强度。
explanation_en: The rectangular strip sample of hard rubber is placed on two horizontal fulcrums, and then a load is applied between the two fulcrums. The ratio of the maximum bending moment reached when the sample breaks to the transverse section modulus of the sample is the cross-breaking strength.

explanation_cn: 由两条膨胀系数不同的合金带材沿侧边焊接而成。横拼双金属针对两种膨胀系数差别较大的异种奥氏体金属材料的焊接，是生产横拼双金属弹簧片的重要工艺环节，可采用真空电子束焊或激光焊。
explanation_en: It is formed by weld two alloy strips with different expansion coefficient along the side. The weld of laterally welded bimetals is an important process for the production of laterally welded bimetallic spring sheets, which is aimed at two dissimilar austenitic metallic materials with significantly different expansion coefficients. Vacuum electron beam welding or laser welding can be used.

explanation_cn: 是聚合物挤出过程中熔体在沿螺杆径向的螺槽横截面上往复流动的一种流动状态，是由螺杆旋转时螺棱的推挤和阻挡作用造成的。
explanation_en: It is a kind of flow state in which the melt reciprocates on the cross section of the screw groove along the radial direction of the screw during polymer extrusion, which is caused by the extrusion and blocking effect of the screw edge when the screw rotates.

explanation_cn: 一种超基性侵入岩。化学成分特点是SiO2<45%,主要氧化物的平均含量为：SiO2 42.3%,Al2O3 4.23%,Fe2O3+FeO10.19%,CaO5.06%,MgO 31.24%,K2O+Na2O 0.83%,氧化铁含量高于其它类型岩浆岩。主要矿物成分是橄榄石和辉石。
explanation_en: A type of ultrabasic intrusive rock. The chemical composition is characterized by SiO2<45%, the average content of main oxides is: SiO2 42.3%, Al2O3 4.23%, Fe2O3+FeO 10.19%, CaO 5.06%, MgO 31.24%, K2O+Na2O 0.83%, and the content of iron oxide is higher than other types of magmatic rocks. The main mineral components are olivine and pyroxene.

explanation_cn: 岛状结构硅酸盐矿物。化学式为(Mg，Fe)2[SiO4]。Mg与Fe形成完全类质同象。
explanation_en: Island structure silicate mineral. The chemical formula is (Mg, Fe) 2 [SiO4]. Mg and Fe form complete isomorphism.

explanation_cn: 在使用温度下显示高弹性（或称橡胶弹性）的高分子材料。通常情况下这类物质的玻璃化转变温度低于室温，可在应力作用下发生大幅可逆形变。按来源可分为天然和合成两大类。天然是从树、草等植物中提取胶质后经后续硫化加工制备;合成则由各种单体经聚合反应得到的聚合物经后续硫化加工制备。经交联后形成的分子链网络结构使得其在受外力作用发生变形时具有迅速复原的能力。广泛用于制造轮胎、胶管、密封垫、电缆及其他各种制品，是重要的工业基础原料。
explanation_en: Macromolecule materials that shows high elasticity (or rubber elasticity) at service temperature. Generally, the glass transition temperature of such substances is lower than room temperature, which can cause a large reversible deformation under stress. It can be divided into two categories based on its source: natural and synthetic. It is naturally prepared by extracting gum from trees, grass and other plants and subsequent vulcanization processing; The synthesis is made from polymer obtained by polymerization of various monomer through subsequent vulcanization processing. The molecular chain network structure formed after crosslinking makes it have the ability to recover quickly when deformed by external force. Widely used in the manufacturing of tires, rubber hoses, gaskets, cables, and other various products, it is an important industrial basic raw material.

explanation_cn: 国际橡胶硬度，又称 IRH 硬度，是一种度量橡胶硬度的方法，按照 ISO 标准规定进行测量。在这个方法中，使用橡胶国际硬度计，按照规定的条件将一个球形压头压在试样表面上，从较小的初负荷逐渐增加到较大的最大负荷。然后，测量两个负荷下的压痕深度之差，通过将这个差值与压入深度差值与国际橡胶硬度值的关系表相对照，或者根据此表绘制的曲线图，来确定硬度值。硬度值通常以 IRH 单位表示。当 IRH 读数为 0 时，表示材料的弹性模量为零；当 IRH 读数为 100 时，表示材料的弹性模量为无穷大。对于高弹性橡胶，国际橡胶硬度值与邵氏 A 硬度值大致相同。这个方法主要适用于测定硫化橡胶的硬度值，测量范围通常在 30 到 85 IRH 之间。其优点是测量迅速、简单，不会破坏试样，而且与邵氏 A 硬度值具有可比性。
explanation_en: International rubber hardness, also known as IRH hardness, is a method to measure rubber hardness according to ISO standards. In this method, use the rubber international hardness tester to press a spherical indenter on the surface of the sample according to the specified conditions, and gradually increase the initial load from a small to a large maximum load. Then, measure the difference of indentation depth under two loads, and determine the hardness value by comparing this difference with the relationship table of indentation depth difference and international rubber hardness value, or according to the curve chart drawn in this table. Hardness values are usually expressed in IRH units. When the IRH reading is 0, it means that the elastic modulus of materials is zero; When the IRH reading is 100, it means that the elastic modulus of materials is infinite. For high elastic rubber, the international hardness value of rubber is roughly the same as Shore A hardness value. This method is mainly applicable to the determination of the hardness value of vulcanized rubber, and the measurement range is usually between 30 and 85 IRH. It has the advantages of rapid and simple measurement, no damage to the sample, and is comparable with Shore A hardness value.

explanation_cn: 一类添加剂，用于提高橡胶的可加工性和使用性能。这种添加剂可溶于或浸润于橡胶中，在加工后的橡胶制品中起到降低硬度、提高伸展性、减小弹性模量等效果。橡胶软化剂通常分为两大类：油性软化剂和低挥发性软化剂。前者在橡胶中的扩散速率快，使用范围广，常见的油性软化剂有石蜡油、液体橡胶、萘系等；后者则具有挥发性小、热稳定性高等优点，常见的低挥发性软化剂有蜡状物质、烷基苯、酯类等。橡胶软化剂使用量的多少、种类的选择和配合方式对橡胶制品的性能有着很大的影响。
explanation_en: The first kind of additive is used to improve the processability and service performance of rubber. This additive can be dissolved or soaked in rubber, and can reduce hardness, improve extensibility, and reduce elastic modulus in processed rubber products. Rubber softener are generally divided into two categories: oily softening agent and low volatility softening agent. The former has a fast diffusion rate in rubber and a wide range of applications. The common oily softening agent include paraffin oil, liquid rubber, naphthalene series, etc; The latter has the advantages of low volatility and high thermal stability. Common low volatility softening agent include waxy substances, alkyl benzene, esters, etc. The amount of rubber softener used, the selection of types and the matching method have a great impact on the performance of rubber products.

explanation_cn: 烧结温度过低或烧结时间过短致使产品未达到所耑性能的烧结过程。
explanation_en: The sintering process in which the sintering temperature is too low or the sintering time is too short, so that the product does not reach the specified performance.

explanation_cn: 一种由酸性火山岩或次火山岩经火山热液交代而高度硅化的变质岩石。矿物组成主要为石英，可有红柱石、刚玉、叶蜡石、高岭石、绢云母及明矾石、重晶石，其次为刚玉、黄电气石、蓝线石、绿黄晶等。一般为灰白色或深灰色，有时呈褐红色。细粒至显微鳞片粒状变晶结构及变余斑状结构、变余火山碎屑结构。块状、斑块状、斑杂状、孔洞状等构造。常见种属有明矾石次生石英岩、刚玉红柱石次生石英岩、叶蜡石次生石英岩、高岭石次生石英岩等。它与明矾石、高岭石、叶蜡石、水铝石、红柱石等非金属矿床关系密切，也有铜、铁、金、银及多金属矿床伴生。质地细腻的叶蜡石次生石英岩在中国俗称印章石，也可被加工为各种工艺玉雕。福州寿山石中的田黄、艾绿，浙江昌化鸡血石、青田石、阳平石、宁波石、内蒙古的巴林鸡血石以及广东的广绿石等都是名贵品种。
explanation_en: A metamorphic rock that is highly silicified by volcanic hydrothermal metasomatism of acidic volcanic rock or sub volcanic rock. The mineral composition is mainly quartze, including andalusite, corundum, pyrophyllite, kaolinite, seridte, alunite and barite, followed by corundum, yellow tourmaline, kyanite, green topaz, etc. Generally gray white or dark gray, sometimes brownish red. Fine grained to microscale granular balastic texture and meta porphyritic texture, meta pyroclastic texture. Block like, patchy, patchy, and porous structures. Common species include alunite secondary quartzite, corundum andalusite secondary quartzite, pyrophyllite secondary quartzite, kaolinite secondary quartzite, etc. It is closely related to alumite, kaolinite, pyrophyllite, boehmite, andalusite and other non-metallic deposits, and is also associated with copper, iron, gold, silver and polymetallic deposits. The delicate pyrophyllite secondary quartzite, commonly known as pyrophyllite in China, can also be processed into jade carvings of various crafts. Tian Huang and Ai Lu from Shoushan Stone in Fuzhou, chicken-bloodstone from Changhua, Qingtian Stone, Yangping Stone, Ningbo Stone, chicken-bloodstone from Bahrain, Inner Mongolia, and Guangdong Cantonese are all valuable varieties.

explanation_cn: 一般指金属与半导体接触后不具有整流特性，对两个方向上的电流产生的电阻都很小。降落在欧姆接触的电压很小，而且电流与电压成正比。因此，欧姆接触几乎不影响器件的电流-电压特性。半导体器件一般都要利用金属电极输入或输出电流。这就要求在金属和半导体之间形成良好的欧姆接触。金属和n型（p型）半导体接触时，若金属功函数小于（大于）半导体功函数，两者接触可形成反阻挡层，即载流子在半导体和金属之间运动没有势垒阻挡。因此。选用适当的金属材料，就有可能得到欧姆接触。然而，Ge、Si、GaAs这些最常用的重要半导体材料，一般都有很高的表面态密度，无论是n型材料还是p型材料与金属接触都有可能形成势垒，用选择金属材料的办法往往不能获得欧姆接触。在这种情况下，可以利用隧穿效应来获得欧姆接触。如果半导体掺杂浓度很高，则势垒区宽度变得很薄。电子可以直接隧穿势垒，这时金属-半导体接触的电阻很小，形成了欧姆接触。实际上。通常利用重掺半导体与金属形成欧姆接触。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to the fact that metal and semiconductor do not have rectification characteristics after contact, and the resistance generated by current in both directions is very small. The voltage falling on ohmic contact is very small, and the current is proportional to the voltage. Therefore, ohmic contact hardly affects the current voltage characteristics of devices. Semiconductor devices generally use metal electrodes to input or output current. This requires a good ohmic contact between metal and semiconductor. When a metal contacts with an n-type (p-type) semiconductor, if the metal work function is less than (greater than) the semiconductor work function, the contact between the two can form a reverse barrier layer, that is, the carrier moves between the semiconductor and the metal without barrier barrier. Therefore. Ohmic contact may be obtained by selecting appropriate metallic materials. However, the most commonly used important semiconductor materials, such as Ge, Si, and GaAs, generally have high surface state density, and both n-type materials and p-type materials may form potential barriers when contacting with metals, so ohmic contact cannot be obtained by selecting metallic materials. In this case, the tunneling effect can be used to obtain ohmic contact. If the semiconductor doping concentration is high, the width of the barrier region becomes very thin. Electrons can directly tunnel through the barrier, when the resistance of metal semiconductor contact is very small, ohmic contact is formed. Actually. Heavily doped semiconductors are usually used to form ohmic contact with metals.

explanation_cn: 矿物名称为蛋白石，另含有少量石英、黄铁矿等次要矿物。含水量不定，一般为4%-9%，最高可达20%。非晶质体。欧泊的体色可有白、黑、深灰、蓝、绿、棕、橙、橙红、红等多种颜色；具最典型的变彩效应，在光源下转动可以看到五颜六色的色斑。玻璃光泽至树脂光泽。莫氏硬度5-6。欧泊有许多品种，归总起来有四大类，即黑欧泊、白欧泊、火欧泊和晶质欧泊。
explanation_en: The mineral name is opal, and it also contains a small amount of secondary minerals such as quartze and pyrite. The water content varies, generally ranging from 4% to 9%, with a maximum of 20%. Amorphous material. The body color of opal can be white, black, dark grey, blue, green, brown, orange, orange red, red and other colors; It has the most typical color changing effect, and when rotated under the light source, colorful spots can be seen. Glass luster to resin luster. Mohs hardness 5-6. There are many varieties of opal, which can be summarized into four categories, namely black opal, white opal, fire opal and crystalline opal.

explanation_cn: 又称止血棉，是多孔、柔软和吸水后具有优良黏附性和凝血作用的纤维。凝血纤维的主要品种有：羧甲基纤维素纤维与羧甲基纤维素钠、非离子型表面活性剂（如山梨醇硬脂酸酯）与有机溶剂（如乙醇、乙醚、甲醇及四氯化碳等）在酸性条件下（pH值3-7)混合，再涂敷于消毒纸上，干燥后即成纸;另有一种是海藻纤维，由海藻中提取的藻酸采用湿法纺丝制成的纤维，再做成止血敷料，止血纤维的止血机理为：这种纤维具有优良的黏附性与柔软性，能紧密地与出血面黏结，使出血创面的毛细管末端黏结而封闭;又因血液容易进人多孔的纤维细结构的空隙中促使血液里的血小板凝结，达到止血的。对这类纤维的要求是：无毒性;可经受严格消毒;纤维本身可降解最后可由人体组织吸收。
explanation_en: Also known as hemostatic cotton, it is porous, soft and has excellent adhesion and coagulation after absorbing water. The main varieties of coagulation fibers are: carboxymethyl cellulose fiber and carboxymethyl cellulose sodium, non-ionic surfactants (such as sorbitol stearate) and organic solvents (such as ethanol, ether, methanol, carbon tetrachloride, etc.) are mixed under acidic conditions (pH 3-7), then coated on the disinfection paper, and dried into paper; The other is alginmefiber. The algic acid extracted from seaweed is made by wet spinning and then made into a hemostatic dressing. The hemostatic mechanism of stanch fiber is that this fiber has excellent adhesion and softness, and can closely bond with the bleeding surface, so that the end of the capillary tube of the bleeding wound can be bonded and sealed; And because blood easily enters the pores of porous fibrous structures, it promotes the coagulation of platelets in the blood, achieving hemostasis. The requirements for this type of fiber are: non-toxic; Can withstand strict disinfection; The fiber itself can be degradation and finally absorbed by human tissues.
