explanation_cn: 以氟磷酸盐为基质的激光玻璃。在激光玻璃发展早期，对Nd3+在氟磷玻璃中的性质进行了研究并探索激光。作为实用玻璃的研究是随着高功率激光而提出的。
explanation_en: Fluorophosphate based laser glass. In the early development of laser glass, the properties of Nd3+in fluorophosphate glass were studied and laser was explored. As a practical glass, the research is proposed with the high power laser.

explanation_cn: 以氟离子为传导离子的快离子导体。多以萤石型结构的氟化物为基，与稀土金属氟化物形成异价取代的固溶体。
explanation_en: A fast ion conductor that uses fluoride ions as conduction ions. Most of them are based on fluorides with fluorite structure and form solid solution with heterovalent substitution with rare earth metal metal fluorides.

explanation_cn: 以翻土、石灰石、萤石（或再加石膏）经配料煅烧得以氟铝酸钙为主要矿物的熟料，再与石膏一起磨细而成的水泥。主要用于机场跑道、道路的紧急抢修工程等。
explanation_en: Cement is made of clinker with calcium fluoaluminate as the main mineral by mixing and calcining earth, limestone, fluorite (or adding gypsum), and then grinding together with gypsum. Mainly used for emergency repair projects of airport runways and roads.

explanation_cn: 化学式3.5MgO·0.5MgF2·GeO2。淡黄色粉末，相对密度3.83。在253.7mn紫外线激发下发出深红色荧光，发射光谱的峰值波长为658nm;色坐标:x=0.712，：y=0.287;量子效率为73%;激发光的反射率为0.015;单色荧光灯的流明效率达18.61m/W;它还是365rmi激发下很有效的荧光粉，粉的最高工作温度达320°C。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is 3.5MgO · 0.5MgF2 · GeO2. Pale yellow powder, relative density 3.83. Under the excitation of 253.7 mn ultraviolet light, it emits dark red fluorescence, and the peak-emission wavelength of the emission spectrum is 658 nm; Colour coordinate: x=0.712,: y=0.287; Quantum efficiency is 73%; The reflectivity of excitation luminescence is 0.015; The lumen efficiency of monochromatic fluorescent lamp reaches 18.61m/W; It is also a very effective phosphor excited by 365rmi. The maximum working temperature of the phosphor is 320 ° C.

explanation_cn: 将金属与氢气在一定温度下反应得到氢化物，氢化物脆性大、容易破碎成粉末，再将氢化物粉在一定温度真空下脱氢而制备的金属粉末。氢化-脱氢法常用于制备钛粉，此工艺生产的钛粉粒度范围宽、成本低、对原料要求低，是目前生产钛粉的主要方法。钕铁硼磁粉也属于这种粉末。
explanation_en: The metal powder is prepared by reacting metal and hydrogen at a certain temperature to obtain hydride, which is brittle and easy to break into powder, and then dehydrogenating the hydride powder under a certain temperature and vacuum. The hydrogenation dehydrogenation method is often used to prepare titanium powder. The titanium powder produced by this process has a wide particle size range, low cost, and low requirements for raw materials, making it the main method for producing titanium powder at present. Nd-Fe-B magnetic powder also belongs to this kind of powder.

explanation_cn: 是由丁腈橡胶中不饱和键经催化加氢而制得的弹性体。主要采用丁腈橡胶溶液加氢法生产。氢化丁腈橡胶是一种综合性能优异的橡胶。主要具有好的耐热性、耐油性、耐化学稳定性、耐臭氧性和低温屈挠性，尤其是耐H2S性能优异，可用于制造苛刻环境中使用的石油机械设备部件、汽车燃油系统发热零部件、各种耐油密封件和胶管。
explanation_en: It is an elastomer prepared by catalytic hydrogenation of unsaturated bonds in acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber. It is mainly produced by hydrogenation of acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber solution. Hydrogenated acrylonitrile-butadienerubber is a kind of rubber with excellent comprehensive properties. It mainly has good heat resistance, oil resistance, chemical stability, ozone resistance, and low-temperature flexibility, especially excellent H2S resistance. It can be used for manufacturing petroleum machinery equipment components, automotive fuel system heating components, various oil resistant seals, and rubber pipes used in harsh environments.

explanation_cn: 让燃料中的含硫化合物先与H2在300T左右进行反应生成H2S。随后再让H2S和金属如Zn反应生成ZnS，进而把硫从燃料中去除的过程。
explanation_en: Let the sulfur compounds in the fuel first react with H2 at around 300T to generate H2S. The process of subsequently reacting H2S with metals such as Zn to generate ZnS, thereby removing sulfur from the fuel.

explanation_cn: 又称氢氧化钙糊剂，主要由氢氧化钙和螯合剂组成，常配成双糊剂使用。氢氧化钙水门汀生物性能良好-在口腔中具有较大的溶解性，可杀灭细菌和抑制细菌生长。促进基底钙化和形成继发性牙本质。特別适用于深龋保髓和盖髓。还可用于根管充填和牙本质脱敏。
explanation_en: Also known as calcium hydroxide paste, it is mainly composed of calcium hydroxide and chelating agents, and is often used as a double paste. Calcium hydroxide cement has good biological properties - it has greater solubility in the mouth, and can kill bacteria and inhibit bacterial growth. Promote basal calcification and formation of secondary dentin. Especially suitable for deep caries preservation and pulp capping. It can also be used for root canal filling and dentin desensitization.

explanation_cn: 是将氯化氢与天然橡胶中的不饱和双键进行加成反应得到的饱和弹性体，提高了天然橡胶的黏合性能，，工业生产的氢氯化天然橡胶一般将含氯量控制在29%-30.5%的范围，以保证制品具有良好的屈挠性。氢氯化橡胶为白色粉末。常温下呈结晶状态，在80-110°C时具有可塑性。110°C以上为无定形，180-I85t时脱出氯化氢。具有耐燃性，氢氯化橡胶可溶于氯代烃和热的芳香族化合物溶液中，不溶于水、酒精、乙醚和丙酮。氢氯化橡胶配制的胶黏剂可用来使橡胶与钢、紫铜、黄铜、铝以及其他材料黏合，具有良好的黏合性能。
explanation_en: It is a saturated elastomer obtained by the addition reaction of hydrogen chloride and unsaturated double bonds in natural rubber, which improves the adhesion performance of natural rubber. The chlorine content of industrial natural rubber hydrochloride is generally controlled within the range of 29% -30.5% to ensure that the product has good flexibility. The hydrochlorinated rubber is white powder. It is in a crystalline state at room temperature and exhibits plasticity at 80-110 ° C. Above 110 ° C is amorphous, and hydrogen chloride is removed at 180-I85t. It has flame resistance and is soluble in chlorinated hydrocarbons and hot aromatic compound solutions, but insoluble in water, alcohol, ether, and acetone. The adhesive prepared by hydrochlorinated rubber can be used to bond rubber with steel, purple copper, brass, aluminum and other materials, with good bonding performance.

explanation_cn: 通过外加电力把氢气从正极移动到负极的电化学反应过程。氢气在正极被氧化生成质子和电子;质子通过传导质子的电解质、电子通过外电路移动到负极，两者结合生成氢气。在催化剂如Pt存在下，上述两个半反应的活化过电压都很低；为此，在正极外加0.05V电压反应即可快速进行。
explanation_en: The electrochemical reaction process in which hydrogen is moved from the positive electrode to the negative electrode by applying an external electric force. Hydrogen is oxidized at the positive electrode to generate protons and electrons; Protons move to the negative electrode through the elonrolyte and electrons that conduct protons, and the two combine to generate hydrogen. In the presence of catalysts such as Pt, the activation or conditioning overvoltage of the above two semi reactions is very low; To achieve this, a rapid reaction can be achieved by applying a voltage of 0.05V to the positive electrode.

explanation_cn: 氢燃料电池是使用氢这种化学元素。把化学能直接转化为电能的电化学发电装置。氢燃料电池本质是水电解的"逆"装置，主要由3部分组成，即阳极、阴极、电解质。其阳极为氢电极。阴极为氧电极。通常。阳极和阴极上都含有一定量的催化剂，用来加速电极上发生的电化学反应，两极之间是电解质。工作过程中把氢和氧分别供给阴极和阳极，氢通过阴极向外扩散与电解质发生反应后，放出的电子通过外部的负载到达阳极。氢燃料电池的特点是环保节能、高效。氢燃料电池与普通电池的区别主要在于：干电池、蓄电池是一种储能装置，是把电能贮存起来，需要时再释放出来；而氢燃料电池严格地说是一种发电装置，像发电厂一样，是把化学能直接转化为电能的电化学发电装置。由于燃料电池的发电是直接将化学能转换为电能，不需要经过热能和机械能（发电机）的中间变换，因此效率可以达到50%以上。典型的燃料电池种类：①熔融碳酸盐燃料电池（MCFC):②固体氧化物燃料电池(SOFO;③磷酸燃料电池（PAFC);④固体高分子燃料电池（PEFC);⑤质子交换膜燃料电池（PEM-FO:⑥碱性燃料电池（AFC);⑦甲醇燃料电池(DMFC)
explanation_en: The hydrogen fuel cell uses hydrogen, a chemical element. An electrochemical power generation device that directly converts chemical energy into electrical energy. The essence of hydrogen fuel cell is the "reverse" device of water electrolysis, which is mainly composed of three parts, namely anode, cathode and elonrolyte. Its anode is a hydrogen electrode. The cathode is an oxygen electrode. Usually. Both the anode and cathode contain a certain amount of catalyst to accelerate the electrochemical reaction on the electrode, and elonrolyte is between the two poles. In the process of work, hydrogen and oxygen are supplied to the cathode and anode respectively. After hydrogen diffusion outward through the cathode and reacts with the elonrolyte, the released electrons reach the anode through the external load. Hydrogen fuel cell is characterized by environmental protection, energy saving and high efficiency. The main difference between hydrogen fuel cell and ordinary battery is that dry cell and accumulator are energy storage devices, which store electric energy and release it when needed; Strictly speaking, hydrogen fuel cell is a power generation device. Like a power plant, it is an electrochemical power generation device that directly converts chemical energy into electrical energy. Since fuel cell power generation directly converts chemical energy into electrical energy without intermediate conversion of thermal energy and mechanical energy (generator), the efficiency can reach more than 50%. Typical fuel cell types: ① molten carbonate fuel cell (MCFC); ② solid oxide fuel cell (SOFO); ③ bhosphoric acid fuel cell (PAFC); ④ Solid macromolecule fuel cell (PEFC); ⑤ Proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEM-FO: ⑥ alkaline fuel cell (AFC); ⑦ Methanol fuel cell (DMFC)

explanation_cn: 由于氢的存在使材料发生不可逆损伤、塑性下降以及低应力下的滞后断裂。总称为氢脆。
explanation_en: Due to the existence of hydrogen, materials suffer from irreversible damage, plastic decline and delayed fracture under low stress. It is generally called hydrogen embrittlement.

explanation_cn: 氢的存在导致材料的塑性指标（伸长率、面缩率、断裂应变）明显下降的现象。
explanation_en: The existence of hydrogen causes the plastic indexes (elongation, area shrinkage, fracture strain) of materials to decrease significantly.

explanation_cn: 氢的存在而导致材料经历一段时间后发生开裂。
explanation_en: The existence of hydrogen causes the cracking of materials after a period of time.

explanation_cn: 高温高所环境下，氢进入材料白部与一种组分或元素发生化学反应。在材料白部产生小裂纹或孔洞等损伤，称为氢蚀。
explanation_en: Under high temperature and high temperature environment, hydrogen enters the white part of materials and reacts with a component or element. Damage such as small cracks or holes in the white part of materials is called hydrogen attack.

explanation_cn: 一种由氢转移产生的离子加成聚合反应。例如以丙烯酰胺为单体，以叔丁氧钠为引发剂，在少量N-苯基-/--苯胺存在下于溶剂中聚合-得到尼龙的聚合反应。
explanation_en: An ionic addition polymerization produced by hydrogen transfer. For example, with acrylamide as the monomer, sodium tert butoxide as the initiator, polymerization is carried out in the presence of a small amount of N-phenyl -/- aniline in the solvent to obtain the polymerization reaction of nylon resin.

explanation_cn: 采用氦气作保护气体的气体保护电弧焊，是惰性气体保护电弧焊的一种，包括钨极氦弧焊和熔化极氦弧焊。氦气和氩气同属惰性气体，焊接过程中不会与液态和固态金属发生化学反应，但氦气的电离电位高、热传导系数大、原子质量小；与氩弧相比，氦弧的电弧电压高、电弧温 度高、热量集中；因此，氦弧焊的熔深较大而热影响区较小，为获得同样保护效果需要耗用的气体流量较 大.更适合于焊接厚板、高热导率金属和高熔点金属。单独采用氦气保护的成本太高，故在焊接铝、铜 等有色金属及合金时通常以氩气为主要气体，适当混入氦气可实现兼具两者优点的惰性气体保护焊。
explanation_en: Gas shielded arc welding using helium as shielding gas is a kind of inert gas shielded arc welding, including tungsten helium arc welding and consumable helium arc welding. Helium and argon are both inert gases and will not react with liquid and solid metals during weld. However, helium has high ionization potential, large thermal conductivity coefficient and low atomic mass; Compared with argon arc, helium arc has higher arc voltage, arc temperature, and heat concentration; Therefore, helium arc welding has a large penetration and a small heat affected zone. In order to obtain the same protection effect, it needs a large gas flow. It is more suitable for weld thick plates, high thermal conductivity metals and high melting point metals. The cost of helium protection alone is too high, so argon is usually used as the main gas when weld aluminum, copper and other non-ferrous metals and alloy. Proper mixing of helium can achieve inert gas shielded welding with both advantages.

explanation_cn: 材料中因惰性气体 (He)的积累而引起的催化现象。裂变堆、聚变堆结构材料在辐射场中工作时，由于（n，α)反应生成He，聚变堆一壁材料还由于等离子体中泄漏出来的α粒子（He核）的轰击产生He的淀积。
explanation_en: Catalytic phenomenon caused by the accumulation of inert gas (He) in materials. When structural materials of fission reactor and fusion reactor work in the radiation field, due to (n, α) The reaction generates He, and the materials on the wall of the fusion reactor is also due to the α The bombardment of particles (He nuclei) produces the deposition of He.

explanation_cn: 氧-乙炔焊是一种使用乙炔和氧气混合燃烧产生的火焰作为热源的手工焊接方法。其火焰温度最高可达3150°C，是各种气体火焰中最高的。氧-乙炔焊的主要设备包括氧气瓶、乙炔发生器（或乙炔瓶）和焊炬。与电弧焊相比，氧-乙炔焊的火焰温度较低，热量较为分散，易于控制焊接熔池的温度。这种方法适用于焊接薄板和低熔点金属，也便于预热和后热，因此常用于补焊和野外施工。然而，氧-乙炔焊也有其缺点，包括生产率较低、热影响区较大，容易引起严重的变形。此外，焊缝和热影响区的组织通常较粗大，导致接头的力学性能较差。主要的工艺参数包括火焰的强度和使用的填充焊丝直径，这些参数通常根据焊件的厚度来确定。
explanation_en: Oxy-acetylene welding is a manual weld method that uses the flame generated by the combustion of acetylene and oxygen as the heat source. Its flame temperature can reach up to 3150 ° C, which is the highest among various gas flames. The main equipment of oxy-acetylene welding includes oxygen cylinder, acetylene generator (or acetylene cylinder) and welding torch. Compared with arc welding, oxy-acetylene welding has lower flame temperature, more dispersed heat, and it is easy to control the temperature of weld molten pool. This method is suitable for weld thin plates and low melting point metals, and is also convenient for preheating and post heating, so it is often used for repair welding and field construction. However, oxy-acetylene welding also has its disadvantages, including low productivity, large heat affected zone and easy to cause serious deformation. In addition, the microstructure of weld and heat affected zone is usually coarse, resulting in poor mechanical properties of joints. The main process parameters include the strength of the flame and the diameter of the filler welding wire used. These parameters are usually determined according to the thickness of the weldment.

explanation_cn: 泛指在氧化还原反应中能够获得电子的物质。间体推进剂中的通常是指能为其他组分反应提供氧的物质，如高氯酸铵、硝酸铵、硝化计油等，一般用余氧系数或氧平衡来表示其供氧能力。但复合同体推进剂中的泛指能提供维持推进剂燃烧所需氧化元素的固体物质.如髙氯酸铵、硝酸铵、硝仿肼、奥克托今、黑索今等统称为氧化剂。
explanation_en: A substance that can obtain electrons in an oxidation-reduction reaction. Substances in interstitial propellants usually refer to substances that can provide oxygen for other component reactions, such as ammonium perchlorate, ammonium nitrate, nitration oil, etc. Their oxygen supply capacity is generally expressed by residual oxygen coefficient or oxygen balance. However, in composite homogeneous propellant, it generally refers to the solid substances that can provide the oxidizing elements needed to maintain the combustion of propellant. For example, ammonium perchlorate, ammonium nitrate, nitroform hydrazine, octogen, RDX, etc. are collectively referred to as oxidizer.

explanation_cn: 具有半导体性质的氧化物。其电学性质与环境气氛有关。Cu20、NiO的电导率随氧化气氛而增加.称为氧化型半导体，是P型半导体;ZnO、SnO2等的电导率随还原气氛而增加，称为还原型半导体，是n型半导体;BaO、Fe203等随气氛中氧分压的大小而形成P型或n型，称为两性半导体。制备方法有焰熔法、熔体生长法、气相反应、金属热氧化、蒸镀、溅射、溶胶-凝胶法等。ZnO、CdO、Sn02等常用于制造气敏元件;Fe203、Cr2O，ZnO常用于湿敏元件;ZnO、氧化镓铟锌等可用于薄膜晶体管。
explanation_en: Oxides with semiconductor properties. Its electrical properties are related to the environmental atmosphere. The electric conductivity of Cu20 and NiO increases with the oxidation atmosphere. They are called oxidation type semiconductors, which are P-type semiconductors; The electric conductivity of ZnO, SnO2, etc. increases with the reduction atmosphere, which is called the reduction semiconductor, which is n-type semiconductor; BaO, Fe203, and other materials form P-type or n-type semiconductors with varying oxygen partial pressures in the atmosphere, known as amphoteric semiconductors. The preparation methods include flame melting method, melt growth method, gas phase reaction, metal thermal oxidation, evaporation plating, sputtering, sol gel method, etc. ZnO, CdO, Sn02, etc. are commonly used in the manufacturing of gas sensing components; Fe203, Cr2O, and ZnO are commonly used in humidity sensitive components; ZnO, gallium indium zinc oxide, and other materials can be used for thin film transistors.

name_cn: 氧化物弥散强化高温合金
explanation_cn: 是利用惰性的氧化物弥散质点在/沉淀强化相失去作用的高温阻止位错运动起高温强化作用的高温合金。最早的弥散强化高温合金是1962年美国杜邦公司利用共同沉淀法研制成功的TDNi，它是在纯镍中加人2%(体积分数）Th02进行弥散强化的合金。从1970年后，弥散强化高温合金通常都采用机械合金化方法制备，弥散相一般为Y2O3。
explanation_en: It is a high temperature strengthening high temperature alloy that uses inert oxide dispersed particles to stop dislocation movement at high temperature when they lose their function in/precipitation strengthening phase. The earliest dispersion strengthened high temperature alloy is TDNi, which was developed by DuPont in 1962 by using the common precipitation method. It is a alloy that is dispersion strengthened by adding 2% (volume fraction) Th02 to pure nickel. Since 1970, dispersion strengthened high temperature alloy have generally been prepared by mechanical alloy, and the dispersed phase is generally Y2O3.

explanation_cn: 即具有电致变色效应的过渡金属氧化物薄膜材料。在电场的作用下可发生离子与电子的共注入和共抽出，从而导致材料的价态和化学组分或结构发生可逆变化，引起透过与反射特性的变化。根据着色机理的不同，可以分为两大类：①阴极着色材料，可在负的电压作用下着色;②阳极着色材料，可在正的恒电压作用下着色。电变色材料的主要参数是其太阳光谱透过与反射特性的变化幅度，取决于材料的制备工艺和结构特征。一般较多采用的方法有蒸镀、化学气相沉积、电化学沉积、溶胶、凝胶、热氧化等。与其他变色材料相比电致变色材钊具有主动动态控制的特点。仅在变色过程中需要能量的供给，所需的电压很低（<5V)，同时具有变色后的记忆效应。其主要作为机敏窗口材料应用于建筑物采光自动控制，可对投入建筑物的太阳辐射强度和窗口的红外辐射特性进行主动动态调节，使室内既能保持最佳照明环境，又能节省室内温控的能量。此外，电变色材料还可在汽车玻璃、大屏幕显示等方面获得重要应用。
explanation_en: That is, transition metal oxide film materials with electrochromic effect. Under the action of electric field, the co injection and co extraction of ions and electrons can occur, resulting in reversible changes in the valence state and chemical composition or structure of materials, resulting in changes in transmission and reflection characteristics. According to different coloring mechanisms, it can be divided into two categories: ① cathode coloring materials, which can be colored under negative voltage; ② Anodic coloring materials can be colored under positive constant voltage. The main parameter of electrochromic materials is the change amplitude of its solar spectral transmission and reflection characteristics, which depends on the preparation process and structural characteristics of materials. Generally, the most commonly used methods are vapor exposition, chemical vapor deposition, electrochemical deposition, sol, gel, thermal oxidation, etc. Compared with other color changing materials, electrochromic materials have the characteristics of active dynamic control. Only in the process of color change, energy supply is required, the required voltage is very low (<5V), and there is a memory effect after color change. It is mainly used as a smart window materials for building daylighting automatic control, which can actively and dynamically adjust the solar radiation intensity of the building and the infrared radiation characteristics of the window, so that the indoor can not only maintain the best lighting environment, but also save the energy of indoor temperature control. In addition, electrochromic materials can also be used in automobile glass, large screen display, etc.

explanation_cn: 指涂覆在医用金属基体表面上的一种生物惰性的氧化物陶瓷保护层或表面膜，研究较多的有氧化铝、氧化锆、氧化钛等单组分或多组分共混的陶瓷涂层，由于其具有很好的耐磨损和耐腐蚀性能，且其生物相容性好，可有效阻隔金属离子向周围组织溶出.利于肌肉等软组织在植人体表面攀附生长。其制备方法多样，主要有等离子喷涂法、化学气相沉积、物理气相沉积、高温自蔓延法、溶胶-凝胶法等。主要用于人工牙根、人工关节柄、关节臼、外科和牙科用器械等。该纤维主要用为结构复合材料的增强纤维。同时由于具有透电磁波性和耐热性亦可用于功能复合材料。
explanation_en: It refers to a bioinert oxide ceramics protective layer or surface facial mask coated on the surface of medical metal matrix. The ceramics coating with single or multi-component polymer blending such as aluminum oxide, zirconia, titanium oxide, etc., which has been studied extensively, can effectively prevent metal ions from dissolving out to surrounding tissues due to its excellent wear resistance and corrosion resistance, and its good biocompatibility, which is conducive to the attachment and growth of soft tissues such as muscles on the surface of the implanted human body. Its preparation methods are various, including plasma spraying, chemical vapor deposition, physical vapor deposition, high temperature self propagating, sol gel, etc. It is mainly used for dental implant, artificial joint handle, joint socket, surgical and dental instruments, etc. The fiber is mainly used as reinforcing fiber of structural composite materials. At the same time, it can also be used in functional composite materials due to its electromagnetic wave transmission and heat resistance.

explanation_cn: 通过强氧化剂处理石墨而得到，石墨层状结构未被破坏，氧进入石墨层面间并与之结合，形成膨胀的层状化合物。主要成分是碳、氢、氧等，但比例不定，随制备条件等而不同。迅速加热至l000°C左右时，层间膨胀，得到凝胶化膨胀石墨。
explanation_en: By treating graphite with strong oxidant, the layered structure of graphite is not destroyed, and oxygen enters and combines with graphite layers to form expanded layered compounds. The main components are carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, etc., but the proportion varies depending on the preparation conditions. When heated rapidly to about 1000 ° C, the interlayer expands to obtain gel expanded graphite.

explanation_cn: 材料表面因受空气或润滑剂中氧的作用形成氧化膜，然后氧化膜又不断地被磨去而使材料损耗称为。
explanation_en: The surface of materials forms an oxide film due to the action of air or oxygen in lubricant, and then the oxide film is constantly rubbed off to cause the loss of materials.

explanation_cn: 在常压、氧气或空气气氛及规定温度下通过量热法测定材料出现氧化放热的时间。是评价被测材料稳定水平或程度的一种手段，也可以用来评价试样中抗氧剂的效果。测量方法,在差示扫描量热仪（DSC)中进行。试样和参比物在惰性气氛（氮气）中以恒定速率升温。达到规定温度时，切换成相同流速的氧气或空气，然后将试样保持在该恒定温度下，直到在热分析曲线上显示出氧化反应。等温OIT就是开始通氧气或空气到氧化反应开始的时间间隔。氧化的起始点是由试样放热的突然增加来表明。通常试验温度越高，越短，在纯氧中测试会比普通大气环境下测得的氧化诱导时间短。
explanation_en: The time of oxidation and exothermic of materials is measured by calorimetry under normal pressure, oxygen or air atmosphere and specified temperature. It is a means to evaluate the stability level or degree of the tested materials, and can also be used to evaluate the effect of antioxidant in the sample. The measurement method is carried out in a differential scanning calorimeter (DSC). The sample and reference material are heated at a constant rate in an inert atmosphere (nitrogen). When the specified temperature is reached, switch to the same flow rate of oxygen or air, and then keep the sample at this constant temperature until the oxidation reaction is shown on the thermal analysis curve. Isothermal OIT is the time interval between the beginning of oxygen or air supply and the beginning of the oxidation reaction. The starting point of oxidation is indicated by a sudden increase in heat release from the sample. Generally, the higher the test temperature is, the shorter it is. The oxidation induced time measured in pure oxygen is shorter than that measured in ordinary atmospheric environment.

explanation_cn: 指硅片经过氧化后在表面形成的层错，英文简称OISF或者OSF。若硅片表面存在机械损伤、金属及其他沾污，或者硅片中含有某些特定结构的氧沉淀，则硅片热氧化过程中释放的自间隙硅原子可在上述缺陷处聚集形成层错。是插入型层错，周围由Frank不全位错包围。其长大通过攀移进行，生长方向为<110>。形成与诸多因素有关，除了上述形核因素以外，主要还有硅片的晶向、掺杂浓度和导电类型以及氧化温度和时间等。会增加器件的漏电流、劣化MOS晶体管的栅极氧化物完整性。密度是衡量硅片质量的重要指标之一。
explanation_en: It refers to the stacking fault formed on the surface of silicon wafer after oxidation, which is referred to as OISF or OSF in English. If there are mechanical damage, metal and other contamination on the surface of silicon wafer, or silicon wafer contains some oxygen precipitation of specific structure, self interstitial silicon atoms released during thermal oxidation of silicon wafer can accumulate at the above defects to form stacking faults. It is an inserted stacking fault surrounded by Frank incomplete dislocation. Its growth is carried out through climbing, with a growth direction of<110>. The formation is related to many factors. In addition to the above nucleation factors, there are mainly the crystal orientation, doping concentration, conductive type, oxidation temperature and time of silicon wafer. It will increase the leakage current of the device and degrade the gate oxide integrity of the MOS transistor. Density is one of the important indexes to measure the quality of silicon wafer.

explanation_cn: 通过氧化剂和还原剂之间的单电子转移引起氧化还原反应而产生自由基用于引发自由基聚合的引发体系。氧化还原引发剂引发活化能低.可常温或低温引发。常用的有过氧化氢类与金属盐组成的引发体系、有机过氧化氢物与亚铁盐组成的氧化还原引发体系、酮过氧化物与盐组成的氧化还原引发体系、过氧化物和胺组成的氧化还原引发体系和铈离子氧化还原引发体系。
explanation_en: It is an initiator system for initiating free radical polymerization through the redox reaction caused by the single electron transfer between oxidizer and reducing agent to generate free radicals. The redox initiator has low initiation activation or conditioning energy and can be initiated at room temperature or low temperature. Commonly used are initiation systems composed of hydrogen peroxide and metal salts, oxidation-reduction initiation systems composed of organic hydrogen peroxide and ferrous salts, oxidation-reduction initiation systems composed of ketone peroxides and salts, oxidation-reduction initiation systems composed of peroxides and amines, and cerium ion oxidation-reduction initiation systems.

explanation_cn: 利用氧化还原反应产生自由基所引发的聚合反应。这种聚合体系的优点是活化能较低（4060kJ/mol),可在较低温度下引发聚合，有较快的聚合速率。氧化-还原引发体系的组分可以是无机和葙机化合物，性质可以是水溶性和油溶性氧化-还原反应的实质是电子转移反应。
explanation_en: Polymerization initiated by the generation of free radicals from oxidation-reduction reactions. The advantage of this polymerization system is that it has low activation or conditioning energy (4060kJ/mol), can initiate polymerization at a lower temperature, and has a faster polymerization rate. The components of the oxidation-reduction initiation system can be inorganic and organic compounds, and their properties can be water-soluble and oil-soluble. The essence of the oxidation-reduction reaction is electron transfer reaction.

explanation_cn: 由激活离子掺杂的氧化钇纳米粉体在1750-1900°C真空烧结制得。Y203激光透明陶瓷的主要物理化学性质与其单晶材料相同，化学和光化学稳定性高，光学透明性范围0.238m，热导率约27W/(mK)，20°C达到YAG材料的2倍，声子能量低，抑制无辐射跃迁的概率，能实现更高的发光量子效应。
explanation_en: Yttrium oxide nanosized powder doped with active ions was prepared by vacuum sintering at 1750-1900 ° C. The main physical chemistry properties of Y203 laser transparent ceramics are the same as those of its single crystal materials. It has high chemical and photochemical stability. Its optical transparency range is 0.238m, thermal conductivity is about 27W/(mK), 20 ° C is twice as high as that of YAG materials, phonon energy is low, and the probability of inhibiting nonradiative transition can be achieved, which can achieve higher luminescence quantum effects.

name_cn: 氧化钇稳定氧化锆陶瓷
explanation_cn: 切削成型牙科陶瓷的一种，主要成分是氧化锆，含量达94%;其次为氧化钇，含量为4%,主要对氧化锆四方晶相起稳定作用，提高陶瓷强度。其他还含有微量的氧化铝，起增强陶瓷的耐久性作用。使用方法是通过热等静技术将陶瓷粉未压制成颗粒间具有微小孔隙的坯块，并进行预烧结，但预烧结温度须低于氧化锆的常规烧结温度。此时氧化锆颗粒轻度烧结在一起，强度较低，使得瓷坯块容易进行切削加工。切削成型后进行进一步的致密化烧结，再次烧结后形成致密的四方氧化锆晶相结构，基本上没有玻璃相。最后在修复体表面涂布饰面瓷并进行烧结，完成修复体制作。由于致密化烧结过程中伴随较大的体积收缩，通常切削时：对瓷坯块尺寸进行适当放大，以补偿烧结过程中的体积收缩。
explanation_en: One of the cutting molding dental ceramics, the main component is zirconia, the content is 94%; The second is yttrium oxide, with a content of 4%, which mainly stabilizes the tetragonal phase of zirconia and improves the strength of ceramics. Others also contain trace aluminum oxide, which plays a role in enhancing the durability of ceramics. The use method is to press ceramic powder into billets with tiny pores between particles by thermal isostatic technology, and conduct pre sintering, but the pre sintering temperature must be lower than the conventional sintering temperature of zirconia. At this time, zirconia particles are slightly sintering together, and the strength is low, making it easy to cut ceramic blanks. After cutting and forming, further densification and sintering are carried out, and after sintering again, dense tetragonal zirconia crystal phase structure is formed, basically without glass phase. Finally, the surface of the prosthesis was coated with decorative porcelain and sintering to complete the production of the prosthesis. Because the densification sintering process is accompanied by large volume shrinkage, the size of the ceramic block is usually enlarged properly during cutting to compensate for the volume shrinkage in the sintering process.

explanation_cn: 立方晶系，晶胞参数a=10.6041。激发带位于980nm,发射主峰波长约为561nm。
explanation_en: Cubic crystal system, unit cell of crystal parameter a=10.6041. The excitation band is located at 980nm, and the main emission peak wavelength is approximately 561nm.

explanation_cn: 立方晶系，激发带与254nm的采线重叠的相当好，位于613nm的锐线是它的主发射峰，合成方法：将Y3+和Eu+与草酸混合形成草酸盐，然后焙烧得到最终产物，主要用于三基色中的红粉。
explanation_en: In the cubic crystal system, the excitation band overlaps well with the 254nm sampling line, and the sharp line located at 613nm is its main emission peak. The synthesis method is to mix Y3+and Eu+with oxalic acid to form oxalate, and then calcine to obtain the final product, mainly used for red powder in the three primary colors.

explanation_cn: 以氧化自弓为主要成分的陶瓷。CaO为立方晶系，具有岩盐型晶体结构，密度为3.08-3.40g/cm3,熔点为2570°C,具有热力学稳定性，能在高温下使用，与高活性金属熔体的反应小，受氧或杂质元素的污染少。氧化钙由于与水很容易发生水化，所以制造过程中，不能与水接触。具有良好的抗熔融金属侵蚀性，是冶炼有色金属，如高纯度铂、铀的重要容器，其也能抗熔融磷酸钙的侵蚀，可作为熔融磷酸盐矿回转窑内衬材料。
explanation_en: Ceramics with oxidation bow as the main component. CaO is a cubic crystal system with rock salt type crystal structure, density of 3.08-3.40g/cm3, melting point of 2570 ° C, thermodynamics stability, can be used at high temperatures, has little reaction with highly active metal melts, and is less polluted by oxygen or impurity elements. Calcium oxide cannot come into contact with water during the manufacturing process due to its easy hydration with water. With good resistance to molten metal corrosion, it is an important container for smelting non-ferrous metals, such as high-purity platinum and uranium. It can also resist the corrosion of molten calcium phosphate, and can be used as the lining materials of molten phosphate rotary kiln.

name_cn: 氧化钨电致变色陶瓷薄膜
explanation_cn: 在电流或外加电场的作用下，物质的颜色发生稳定的、可逆的变化的氧化钨陶瓷薄膜材料。具有着色效率高、可逆性好、响应时间短、寿命长、成本低等特点。
explanation_en: Ceramics tungsten oxide film materials whose color changes stably and reversibly under the action of current or applied electric field. It has the characteristics of high coloring efficiency, good reversibility, short response time, long lifespan, and low cost.

explanation_cn: 反应堆用核纯。具有优良的核性能：它的热中子俘获截面为9.5mb，慢化比180,导热性好，是一种优良的慢化剂和反射层材料，铍和中子发生（n，2n)反应，是中子倍增材料。它的熔点为（2820±100)K，生成热在298K时为608kJ/mol,化学稳定性好，因此有可能比铍用在更高的温度。价格贵、有毒性以及辐照肿胀等因素限制了它在反应堆中的应用。
explanation_en: The reactor uses nuclear purity. It has excellent nuclear properties: its thermal neutron capture cross section is 9.5mb, the moderation ratio is 180, and the thermal conductivity is good. It is an excellent moderator and reflector materials. Beryllium reacts with neutrons (n, 2n), and it is a neutron-multiplier materials. Its melting point is (2820 ± 100) K, and its heat of formation is 608kJ/mol at 298K. It has good chemical stability, so it may be used at a higher temperature than beryllium. Its high price, toxicity and irradiation swelling limit its application in reactors.

explanation_cn: 以氧化铍为主要成分的陶瓷。纯氧化铍属立方晶系。密度3.03g/cm3，熔点2570°C。具有很高的导热性，几乎与紫铜纯铝相等，还有很好的抗热震性。其介电常数67(0.1MHz)。最大缺点是粉末有剧毒性，且使接触伤口难于愈合。以氧化铍粉未为原料加入氧化铝等配料经高温烧结而成。制造这种陶瓷需要良好的防护措施。氧化铍在含有水气的高温介质中，挥发性会提高，l000°C开始挥发，并随温度升高挥发量增大这就给生产带来困难，有些国家已不生产.但制品性能优异，虽价格较高，仍有相当大的需求量。用作大规模集成电路基板，大功率气体激光管，晶体管的散热片外壳，微波输出窗和中子减速剂等材料。
explanation_en: Ceramics with beryllia as the main component. Pure beryllium oxide belongs to the cubic crystal system. Density 3.03g/cm3, melting point 2570 ° C. It has high thermal conductivity, almost equal to purple copper pure aluminum, and has good thermal shock resistance. Its dielectric constant is 67 (0.1MHz). The biggest disadvantage is that powder is highly toxic and difficult to heal the contact wound. It is made by sintering beryllium oxide powder without adding alumina and other ingredients at high temperature. Making this kind of ceramics requires good protective measures. Beryllia will become more volatile in high temperature medium containing water and gas. It will start to volatilize at 1000 ° C, and the volatilization will increase with the temperature rising, which will bring difficulties to production. Some countries have stopped producing it. However, the product has excellent performance. Although the price is high, there is still a considerable demand for it. It is used as materials for large-scale integrated circuit substrate, high-power gas laser tube, heat sink shell of transistor, microwave output window, neutron retarder, etc.

explanation_cn: 氧化铝已知的晶型结构有八种，常用的晶体生长方法有：提拉法、导模法、泡生法、热交换法和导向温梯法等。a-Al203单晶莫氏硬度9(仅次于金刚石），另外，还具有高强度、高热导、高抗热冲击品质因子以及耐腐蚀等性能，使其广泛应用于红外窗口、整流罩、基片和衬底、光学镜片、探测窗口等领域
explanation_en: There are eight known crystal structures of alumina, and the commonly used crystal growth methods are: pulling method, guided mode method, bubbling method, heat exchange method and guided temperature gradient method. A-Al203 single crystal has a Mohs hardness of 9 (second only to diamond). In addition, it also has high strength, high thermal conductivity, high thermal shock resistance quality factor, corrosion resistance and other properties, making it widely used in infrared window, fairing, substrate and substrate, optical lens, detection window and other fields

explanation_cn: 由高纯度氧化铝构成的一种近于惰性的生物陶瓷，又称纯刚玉生物陶瓷。多晶强度大.，硬度高，摩擦系数小，磨损率低，其摩擦系数和磨损率还随水蒸气压升高而降低.特别适合制造人工关节头和臼等对耐磨性有高要求的修复体。氧化铝生物陶瓷在生理环境中不被腐蚀或溶解，致密型陶瓷和组织间的结合是形态结合，多孔型陶瓷与组织间的结合是生物结合。还可用作牙种植体、耳听骨修复体、骨螺钉和药物释放载体等。
explanation_en: A kind of biological cemmics that is nearly inert and is composed of high-purity alumina, also known as pure corundum biological cemmics. Polycrystal has high strength, High hardness, small friction coefficient, low wear rate, and its friction coefficient and wear rate also decrease with the increase of water vapor pressure. It is especially suitable for manufacturing prosthesis with high requirements for wear resistance such as artificial joint heads and mortars. Alumina bioceramics are not corrosion or dissolved in physiological environment. The combination between dense ceramics and tissues is morphological, while the combination between porous ceramics and tissues is biological. It can also be used as dental implant, ear and hearing bone prosthesis, bone screw and drug delivery carrier.

explanation_cn: 以氧化铝为主要成分的陶瓷。属六方晶系，熔点达2050°C。氧化铝有多种变体。
explanation_en: Ceramics with alumina as the main component. It belongs to hexagonal system with melting point up to 2050 ° C. There are various variants of alumina.

name_cn: 氧化铬磁记录陶瓷薄膜
name_en: chromium oxide ceramic thin films for magnetic recording
explanation_cn: 利用氧化铭磁特性和磁效应来输入（写人）、记录、存储和输出（读出）声音、图像、数字等信息的磁性薄膜材料。
explanation_en: A magnetic thin film materials that uses oxide magnetic properties and magnetic effects to input (write people), record, store and output (read out) sound, image, digital and other information.

explanation_cn: 锂的氧化物。在所有候选氚增殖材料中锂原子密度最高，不需要中子倍增剂便可增殖氚。作为氚增殖材料的可行性与热力学平衡、氚的存留量、在氚处理流体中的稳定性及候选结构材料的相容性有关。锂的燃耗引起组分变化、LiOH的形成。与含低水分氦（氚处理流体）接触的的质量损失数据和高温下气相平衡数据表明，在氚处理流体中锂存在相当大的质量迁移，在1000°C下每小时的损失速率超过1%。由于上述问题的存在，尚未被列为氚增殖材料的主要候选材料。
explanation_en: Lithium oxide. The density of lithium atom is the highest among all candidate tritium breeder materials, and tritium can be breeded without neutron multiplier. The feasibility of tritium-breeding materials is related to thermodynamics balance, tritium retention, stability in tritium treatment fluid and compatibility of candidate structural materials. The depletion of lithium causes changes in composition and the formation of LiOH. The mass loss data in contact with low moisture helium (tritium treatment fluid) and the gas phase equilibrium data at high temperature show that there is a considerable mass transport (nuclear) of lithium in tritium treatment fluid, and the loss rate exceeds 1% per hour at 1000 ° C. Due to the above problems, it has not been listed as the main candidate materials for tritium-breeding materials.

name_cn: 氧化锆增韧生物活性玻璃陶瓷复合材料
name_en: bioactive glass-ceramic composite toughened by zirconia
explanation_cn: 由四方相的氧化锆颗粒弥散分布于磷灰石-硅灰石微晶玻璃陶瓷中构成的一种复合生物陶瓷材料。作为增强体的ZrO2是由共沉淀法制得的含有3%(摩尔分数）Y2O3的四方相氧化锆。在应力作用下，弥散分布的四方相氧化锆颗粒使裂纹扩展转向、分支和（或）增殖，从而消耗大量能量，起到抑制裂纹扩展的作用使复合陶瓷的强度和韧性大大提高。在ZrO2体积含量为20%-60%的范围内，其抗弯强度和断裂韧性较不含ZrO2的玻璃陶瓷可提高23倍当Zr02含量达到60%时，其抗弯强度可达818MPa,是迄今为止强度最高，韧性最好的生物陶瓷。同时其结构中的生物活性玻璃陶瓷能够同骨形成骨键合，保持了生物活性，是一种有可能用于承力的生物活性复合陶瓷材料。
explanation_en: A composition biological cemmics materials consisting of tetragonal phase zirconia particles dispersed in apatite wollastonite glass-ceramics ceramics. As a reinforcement, ZrO2 is a tetragonal phase zirconia containing 3% (mole fraction) Y2O3 prepared by the co precipitation method. Under the action of stress, the dispersed tetragonal phase zirconia particles make the crack propagation turn, branch and/or multiply, thus consuming a lot of energy and playing the role of inhibiting crack propagation, which greatly improves the strength and toughness of composition ceramics. When the volume content of ZrO2 is 20% -60%, its bending strength and fracture toughness can be 23 times higher than that of glass-ceramics without ZrO2. When the volume content of ZrO2 reaches 60%, its bending strength can reach 818MPa, which is the highest strength and best toughness biological cemmics so far. At the same time, bioactive glass-ceramics in its structure can form bone bonding with bone, maintaining bioactivity, and it is a bioactivity composition ceramics materials that may be used for force bearing.

explanation_cn: 由高纯二氧化锆（Zr02)制备的一种近于惰性的生物陶瓷。是将含有少量稳定剂碱土氧化物（氧化钙，氧化镁）或稀土氧化物（氧化钇）的高纯Zr02经过高温烧结而制得的。稳定剂的作用使氣化锆的正方和立方等高温相得以成为亚稳相于室温下部分地保留下来。与氧化铝陶瓷相比，由于氧化锆陶瓷通过其结构中的高温相向室温斜方相转变而实现相变增韧，因此氧化锆生物陶瓷不仅具有良好的耐磨性、抗生理腐蚀性和生物相容性，而且其断裂韧性和强度均优于氧化铝陶瓷。用其制作的髋关节头也相应地比氧化铝关节头小达20%左右，从而具有更好的耐磨性和寿命。氧化锆生物陶瓷主要用于人工关竹、牙种植体等硬组织修复和替换材料。
explanation_en: A kind of nearly inert biological cemmics prepared from high-purity zirconia (Zr02). The high-purity Zr02 containing a small amount of alkaline earth oxides (calcium oxide, magnesium oxide) or rare earth oxides (yttrium oxide) as stabilizer is prepared by high-temperature sintering. The stabilizer makes the high-temperature phase such as square and cubic of the vaporized zirconium become metastable phase and partially retain at room temperature. Compared with alumina ceramics, zirconia ceramics realize phase transformation toughening by transformation the high-temperature phase in its structure into the room temperature rhombic phase, so zirconia bioceramics not only have good wear resistance, physiological corrosion resistance and biocompatibility, but also have better fracture toughness and strength than alumina ceramics. The hip joint head made of it is also correspondingly 20% smaller than the alumina joint head, so it has better wear resistance and service life. Zirconia bioceramics are mainly used to repair and replace materials such as artificial Guanzhu, dental implant and other hard tissues.

explanation_cn: 一种利用氧化错马氏体相变效应来改善脆性的陶瓷。氧化锆发生马氏体相变时伴随着体积和形状的变化，能吸收能量，减缓裂纹尖端的应力集中，阻出裂纹扩展提高陶瓷韧性。增韧机制有应力诱导相变增韧、裂纹弯曲增韧及微裂纹增韧。氧化锆的含量、颗粒大小及其在基体中的分布与其所处的应力状态、氧化锆中添加的相稳定剂的多少和性质都显著影响氧化锆的增韧效果。有三种类型：部分稳定氧化锆陶瓷（PSZ)、四方氧化锆多晶体陶瓷（TZP)及氧化锆增韧陶瓷（ZTC)。
explanation_en: A kind of ceramics that improves brittleness by utilizing the effect of oxidation fault martensitic transformation. The martensitic transformation of zirconia is accompanied by changes in volume and shape, which can absorb energy, slow down the stress concentration at the crack tip, prevent crack propagation and improve the toughness of ceramics. The toughening mechanisms include stress induced phase transformation toughening, crack bending toughening, and microcrack toughening. The toughening effect of zirconia is significantly affected by the content of zirconia, particle size and its distribution in the matrix, its stress state, the number and nature of phase stabilizer added in zirconia. There are three types: partially stabilized zirconia ceramics ceramics (PSZ), tetragonal zirconia polycrystalline ceramics (TZP) and zirconia toughened ceramics (ZTC).

explanation_cn: 又称氧化锌丁香油水门汀。通常由粉、液两组分组成，也有的商品为两组分糊剂。粉剂的主要成分为经热处理的氧化锌和松香.并含少量促进剂，如硬脂酸锌和醋酸锌等，也可加人一些氧化镁。液剂主要是丁香酚，有时加入橄榄油以增强丁香酚的安抚作用，亦可在粉剂和液剂中加入其他改性剂。当粉、液两剂调和后，氧化锌和丁香酚形成螯合物使水门汀固化变硬。但固化产物易水解，机械强度差，其机械强度与调和时粉液比例、粉末粒度及添加剂类型有关。氧化锌丁香酚水门汀的pH值为78,对牙髓有安抚作用。常用于牙齿窝洞暂时封闭及暂时充填、修复体黏固、窝洞基衬、盖髓.以及根管充填、根管封闭和牙周塞治。
explanation_en: Also known as zinc oxide clove oil water cement. Usually composed of two components: powder and liquid, and some products are two component pastes. The main components of the powder are heat treatment zinc oxide and rosin, and a small amount of accelerants, such as zinc stearate and zinc acetate, can also be added with some magnesium oxide. The liquid agent mainly consists of eugenol, and sometimes olive oil is added to enhance the soothing effect of eugenol. Other modifiers can also be added to powder and liquid agents. When the powder and liquid are mixed, zinc oxide and eugenol form a chelate to make the cement curing and harden. However, curing products are easy to hydrolyze, and their mechanical strength is poor. Their mechanical strength is related to the proportion of powder to liquid, partidesize and the type of additive when blending. The pH value of zinc oxide eugenol cement is 78, which has a soothing effect on dental pulp. It is commonly used for temporary sealing and filling of tooth cavities, bonding of prosthesis, cavity lining, pulp capping, root canal filling, root canal sealing and periodontal treatment.

explanation_cn: 氧化锌晶须外观呈白色疏松状粉体，微观为二维针状立体结构。氧化锌晶须的针尖部位为具备特殊的表面效用和高氧化活性的纳米级，其活性成分能在水分和空气存在的体系中，自行产生出自由电子(e-)，同时留下带正电的空穴（h-),产生的带正电的空隙（P)具有很强的氧化作用，羟基自由基和过氧化物阴离子自由基有极强的化学活性，可直接将细菌、细菌残骸和毒素灭杀、消除。氧化锌晶须内部载流子可调，其晶格中有极强的氧化活性的原子氧。可破坏绝大多数细菌的生物活性和代谢繁殖功能。氧化锌晶须的网络效应为抗菌离子提供了高效的传输路径。由于细菌通常带负电荷.带正电的锌离子到达细胞膜时，通过库仑引力，二者牢固结合，锌离子穿透细胞膜，进入细胞，与细胞中的硫基反应，使蛋白质变性，从而细胞丧失分裂增殖能力而死亡。氧化锌晶须的制备和生产主要有锌原料预处理法、惰性气体法、液态法、碳还原法和平衡气量控制法。由于抗菌效果好、安全无毒、使用方便、耐温性和耐光性好，并且表现出良好的可见光催化特性.氧化锌晶须抗菌材料广泛应用于多种抗菌、防藻、分解有害有机物和环境净化等领域。
explanation_en: The appearance of zinc oxide crystal whisker is white loose powder, and its microstructure is two-dimensional acicular three-dimensional structure. The needle tip of zinc oxide crystal whisker is a nanometer level with special surface effect and high oxidation activity. Its active ingredients can generate free electrons (e -) in the system of water and air, leaving positive holes (h -). The generated positive space (P) has a strong oxidation effect. Hydroxyl radical and peroxide anion radical have strong chemical activity, which can directly convert bacteria Kill and eliminate bacterial debris and toxins. The internal carrier of zinc oxide crystal whisker is adjustable, and there is atomic oxygen with strong oxidation activity in its lattice. It can destroy the bioactivity and metabolic reproduction function of most bacteria. The network effect of zinc oxide crystal whisker provides an efficient transport path for antibacterial ions. Due to the fact that bacteria usually carry negative charges and positively charged zinc ions when they reach the cell membrane, they firmly bind through Coulombic attraction. Zinc ions penetrate the cell membrane and enter the cell, reacting with the sulfur group in the cell, causing protein denaturation, resulting in the loss of cell division and proliferation ability and death. The preparation and production of zinc oxide crystal whisker mainly include zinc raw material pretreatment, inert gas method, liquid method, carbon reduction method and balance gas volume control method. Zinc oxide whiskers antibacterial materials is widely used in many fields such as antibacterial, algae prevention, decomposition of harmful organic substances and environmental purification due to its good antibacterial effect, safety, non-toxic, convenient use, good temperature resistance and light resistance, and good visible light catalytic properties.

explanation_cn: 组成为氧化锌（ZnO)的薄膜。它具有六角棱柱形纤锌矿晶格结构，室温下能隙宽度为3.3eV;-般可用反应气相沉积方法制备，包括反应电子束蒸发或反应磁控派射。大面积均匀用化学气相沉积（CVD)、等离子体增强化学气相沉积（PCVD)或平面直流磁控溅射法制成。不同工艺条件下制出的具有不同的性能，主要有：①ZnO透明导电薄膜，在400-800nm的可见光范围内，透光率大于90%。在制备ZnO薄膜的过程中掺入2%左右的Al2O3,薄膜的每方块电阻可控制在1000以下而且透光率不变，这类薄膜可广泛用于液晶显示器件和太阳能电池中，亦可制成光电探测器的窗口以及反射红外线的热镜等;②ZnO高阻压电膜，用平面直流磁控溅射制出的ZnO厚膜，结晶性能良好，呈轴取向，有显著的压电效应，可以制成氧化锌膜压敏传感器。
explanation_en: A thin film composed of zinc oxide (ZnO). It has hexagonal prismatic wurtzite lattice structure, and its energy gap is 3.3eV at room temperature- Generally, reactive vapor deposition methods can be used for preparation, including reactive electron beam evaporation or reactive magnetron emission. A large area is uniformly prepared by chemical vapor deposition (CVD), plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PCVD) or planar DC magnetron sputtering. The ZnO transparent conductive thin films prepared under different process conditions has different properties, mainly including: ① The transmittance of ZnO transparent conductive thin films is more than 90% in the visible light range of 400-800nm. When about 2% Al2O3 is doped in the process of preparing ZnO thin films, each block resistance of the films can be controlled below 1000 and the transmittance remains unchanged. This kind of thin films can be widely used in liquid crystal display devices and solar cell, and can also be made into windows of photodetectors and thermal mirrors that reflect infrared light; ② ZnO high resistance piezoelectric film, ZnO thick film prepared by planar DC magnetron sputtering, with good crystallization performance, axial orientation, significant piezoelectric effect, can be made into zine oxide film varistor sensor.

name_en: zinc oxide activated by zinc ZnO
explanation_cn: 白色粉末。难溶于水，可溶于酸和强碱。六方晶系，相对密度5.66.自激活荧光粉，它只是在阴极射线激发下为有效的发光材料。发光颜色是绿白色，发光峰值波长505nm，色坐标r=0.240、y=0.418。合成方法：取荧光纯ZnS，磨细，装在石英舟里.推入石英管管式炉内，通人经净化的空气，灼烧1.52h.出炉后在空气中速冷。经紫外灯下选粉后成产品。ZnO:Zn是一种极短余辉的阴极射线荧光粉，用于飞点扫描管中。由于它在低加速电压下的电子束激发下就能发光，又称为低压或低能电子荧光粉。即在能量低于几百伏的电子束激发下，产生满足一定亮度和光谱分布要求的荧光粉，用在低压荧光数码管中。相类似的荧光粉有ZnO:Zn,Pb,在阴极射线激发下，峰值波长468.5mn,半宽度78nm。
explanation_en: White powder. Difficult to dissolve in water, soluble in acids and strong bases. Hexagonal system, relative density 5.66. self-activation phosphor, which is only an effective luminescence materials under the excitation of cathode ray. The luminescence color is green and white, the peak-emission wavelength of luminescence is 505nm, and the colour coordinate r=0.240, y=0.418. Synthesis method: take fluorescent pure ZnS, grind it, put it in a quartze boat, push it into a quartze tube furnace, pass through purified air, burn it for 1.52h, and then cool it quickly in air after it is out of the furnace. The product is made by selecting powder under ultraviolet light. ZnO: Zn is an extremely short afterglow cathode ray phosphor, which is used in flying spot scanning tubes. It is also called low-voltage or low-energy electron phosphor because it can emit luminescence under the excitation of electron beam under low acceleration voltage. That is to say, under the excitation of electron beam with energy lower than several hundred volts, phosphor meeting certain brightness and spectral distribution requirements will be produced and used in low-voltage fluorescence nixie tubes. The phase phosphor includes ZnO: Zn, Pb. Under the excitation of cathode ray, the peak-emission wavelength is 468.5mn, and the half width is 78nm.

explanation_cn: 组成为氧化锡的膜它具有四方晶系金红石结构。特点为高导电性，在可见光波段良好的透光性，较高的红外线反射率和紫外线吸收性。通常用热解化学气相沉积(TCVD)制备.沉积温度在400-800°C。还可以用反应磁控射在较低的沉积温度下制备。作为导电膜，其载流子主要来自晶体缺陷，即空位和掺杂杂质提供的电子。为提高其透明导电性，常在氧化锡中加入锑离子。的应用包括：①透明电极，它用于光电元件、太阳能电池、场致发光元件和显示器件;②电阻器;③既透光又能反射红外的窗玻璃节能膜;④汽车防霜玻璃。与氧化锡类似的透明导电膜还有氧化铟膜，它可用磁控濺射制备。
explanation_en: The film composed of tin oxide has a tetragonal rutile structure. It is characterized by high conductivity, good light transmittance in visible light band, high infrared reflectance and ultraviolet absorption. It is usually prepared by pyrolytic chemical vapor deposition (TCVD) at 400-800 ° C. Reactive magnetron sputtering can also be used to prepare at lower deposition temperatures. As a conductive film, its carriers mainly come from crystal defect, namely the electrons provided by vacancy and doped impurities. To improve its transparent conductivity, antimony ions are often added to tin oxide. Its applications include: ① transparent electrode, which is used for photoelectric elements, solar cell, electroluminescent luminescence elements and display devices; ② Resistor; ③ Window glass energy-saving film that can both transmit light and reflect infrared; ④ Anti frost glass for cars. The transparent conductive film similar to tin oxide also has indium oxide film, which can be prepared by magnetron sputtering.

name_cn: 氧化锰基负温度系数热敏陶瓷
name_en: manganese oxide based negative temperature coefficient thermosensitive ceramics
explanation_cn: 见负温度系数热敏陶瓷。
explanation_en: See negative temperature coefficient thermosenshive ceramics.

explanation_cn: 以氧化镁为主成分的陶瓷。属立方晶系，岩盐型结构。它的高温强度也较低，MgO是良好的绝缘体，随温度升高.电阻率急剧降低。掺杂的MgO基陶瓷高温下的电阻率比纯的多晶Mgü低。是典塑的碱性耐火材料，在氧化气氛或氮气保护下可稳定到2400°C;在还原气氛中MgO会分解，以金属镁的形式挥发，在真空中于1600°C开始大量挥发;Fe、Zn、Pb、Cu、Ni等金属对它不起还原作用。氧化镁陶瓷的原料来自含镁矿物或从海水中提取.一般应先预烧到1100-1300°C,研磨时应用陶瓷材料作磨衬及磨球，不能用钢球，多采用干法研磨以防水化。通常采用振动磨细碎成型方法有半干压法、注浆法、热压铸法和热压法，烧结为降低烧结温度需加入适量添加剂。烧结过程中坯体强度增长缓慢，必须支承坯体，以免开裂和变形，MgO陶瓷可用作冶炼金属的坩埚，在原子能工业中也适于冶炼高纯度的铀和钍;还可用作热电偶保护套管。利用它能使电磁波通过的性质，作雷达罩及红外辐射的透射窗口材料等。
explanation_en: Ceramics mainly composed of magnesium oxide. It belongs to cubic system and rock salt structure. Its high temperature strength is also low, and MgO is a good insulator. With the increase of temperature, the resistivity decreases sharply. The resistivity of doped MgO based ceramics at high temperature is lower than that of pure polycrystal Mg ü. It is a typical basic refractory, which can be stabilized to 2400 ° C under the protection of oxidizing atmosphere or nitrogen; MgO will decompose in a reducing atmosphere and evaporate in the form of metallic magnesium, starting to evaporate in large quantities at 1600 ° C in vacuum; Metals such as Fe, Zn, Pb, Cu, Ni do not have a reducing effect on it. The raw materials of magnesium oxide ceramics are from magnesium containing minerals or extracted from sea water. Generally, they should be pre fired to 1100-1300 ° C. When grinding, ceramics materials should be used as the grinding lining and grinding balls, instead of steel balls, dry grinding is often used to prevent water. Generally, the vibration grinding fine crushing molding methods include semi dry pressing method, grouting method, hot pressing casting method and hot pressing method. In order to reduce the sintering temperature, sintering needs to add appropriate additive. During sintering, the strength of the green body grows slowly, and the green body must be supported to avoid cracking and deformation. MgO ceramics can be used as crucibles for smelting metals, and also suitable for smelting high-purity uranium and thorium in the atomic energy industry; It can also be used as a thermocouple protective sleeve. It can be used as radar cover and transmission window materials of infrared radiation by making electromagnetic wave pass through.

explanation_cn: 评价材料燃烧性能的一种试验方法。在规定的试验条件下，在氧、氮混合气流中，测定刚好能维持试样稳定燃烧时所需的最低氧浓度。根据材料的不同类型如板材、型材、泡沫、软片或薄膜等按规定的尺寸加工成试样，用夹具将试样固定在燃烧筒中心位置上;如为液体材料，则应按规定取一定量的试样放在特别的试样盘匕，再固定在燃烧筒中。使氧、氮混合气流以规定的流速，由下向上流经燃烧筒中，根据需要调节氧、氮气体的流量使氧：浓度满足试验要求。根据试样形式确定点燃方式，用点火器点燃试样记录试样的燃烧时间和燃烧长度，按规定的判据，采用"少量样品升降法"这一统计方法.确定是增加还是降低氧浓度。在不同的氧浓度下，试验一组试样计算出。
explanation_en: A test method for evaluating the combustion performance of materials. Under the specified test conditions, in the mixed flow of oxygen and nitrogen, measure the minimum oxygen concentration just enough to maintain the stable combustion of the sample. According to the different types of materials, such as plates, profiles, foam, films or films, the samples shall be processed according to the specified dimensions, and the samples shall be fixed at the center of the combustion cylinder with a fixture; If it is a liquid materials, a certain amount of samples shall be taken according to the regulations and placed in a special sample tray, and then fixed in the combustion cylinder. Make the mixed flow of oxygen and nitrogen flow through the combustion cylinder from bottom to top at the specified flow rate, and adjust the flow of oxygen and nitrogen as required to make the oxygen concentration meet the test requirements. Determine the ignition mode according to the sample form, ignite the sample with an igniter to record the combustion time and combustion length of the sample, and use the statistical method of "small sample lifting method" according to the specified criteria to determine whether to increase or decrease the oxygen concentration. Calculate by testing a set of samples at different oxygen concentrations.

explanation_cn: 通过转炉的喷嘴把氧气或吹入炉内熔池从而强化炼钢过程同时改善熔池搅拌的炼钢工艺。转炉炼钢金属炉料主要是高温铁水（占70%-85%)和废钢，炼钢的主要任务是四脱（脱碳、脱硫、脱磷、脱氧）二去(去除气体和夹杂物）二调整（调整化学成分和钢水温度）。将高压纯氧或空气吹人炉内熔池，可通过氧化反应降低钢中的硅、锰、碳、磷等元素的含量，并通过造渣进行脱硫和脱磷.而氧化反应释放的化学热可使钢水温度提高。炼钢过程中吹人氧气或空气可加速氧化反应，提高转炉生产效率。最早的转炉多采用底吹空气工艺;而采用纯氧吹炼可进一步提高生产吹炼和提高冶炼质量，从转炉底部的氧气喷嘴把氧气吹人炉内熔池的底吹工艺的优点是吹炼平稳、喷少、炉渣内氧化铁含量低，也获得广泛采用;而既有顶吹又有底吹的复合吹炼工艺兼具底吹和顶吹的优点，已成为世界上最广泛采用的转炉炼钢氧-硝基化合物参见硝酸酯。氧-乙炔焊，以乙快和氧气混合燃烧形成的火焰作为热源的一种手工焊接方法。氧-乙炔火焰的温度最高可达3150°C，是各种气体火焰中最高的。氧-乙炔焊的主要设备为氧气瓶、乙炔发生器（或乙炔瓶）和焊炬。氧-乙炔焊的火焰温度远低于电弧，热量较分散，易于控制熔池温度;便于焊接薄板及低熔点金属;便于预热、后热_可用于补焊;便于野外施工。其缺点是生产率低热影响区大，变形严重.焊缝和热影响区组织粗大，接头力学性能较差。氧-乙炔焊的主要工艺参数是火焰能力和填充焊丝直径，可根据焊件厚度而确定。
explanation_en: The steelmaking process is strengthened by blowing oxygen or oxygen into the molten pool in the converter through the nozzle, and the steelmaking process of stirring the molten pool is improved. The metal charge for converter sleelmaking is mainly high temperature molten iron (70% -85%) and scrap steel. The main task of steelmaking is four decarbonization (decarburization, desulfurization, dephosphorization, deoxidation), two removal (removal of gases and inclusions) and two adjustment (adjustment of chemical composition and molten steel temperature). Blowing high-pressure pure oxygen or air into the furnace molten pool can reduce the content of silicon, manganese, carbon, phosphorus and other elements in steel through oxidation reaction, and carry out desulfurization and dephosphorization through slagging. The chemical heat released by oxidation reaction can increase the temperature of molten steel. Blowing oxygen or air during steelmaking can accelerate oxidation reaction and improve converter production efficiency. The earliest converter mostly adopts bottom blowing air process; The use of pure oxygen blowing can further improve production blowing and smelting quality. The bottom blowing process of blowing oxygen into the molten bath in the converter from the oxygen nozzle at the bottom of the converter has the advantages of smooth blowing, less injection, low iron oxide content in slag, and is also widely used; The composition blowing process with both top blowing and bottom blowing has the advantages of both bottom blowing and top blowing, and has become the most widely used oxygen nitro compounds in converter sleelmaking steelmaking in the world. See nitrate ester. Oxy-acetylene welding is a manual weld method that uses the flame formed by the combustion of acetylene and oxygen as the heat source. The temperature of the oxygen acetylene flame can reach up to 3150 ° C, which is the highest among various gas flames. The main equipment of oxy-acetylene welding is oxygen cylinder, acetylene generator (or acetylene cylinder) and welding torch. The flame temperature of oxy-acetylene welding is far lower than that of the arc, and the heat is relatively dispersed, so it is easy to control the temperature of the molten pool; It is convenient for weld thin plates and low melting point metals; Easy for preheating and post heating_ Can be used for repair welding; Convenient for field construction. Its disadvantages are low productivity, large heat affected zone, serious deformation, coarse structure of weld and heat affected zone, and poor mechanical properties of joints. The main process parameters of oxy-acetylene welding are the flame capacity and the diameter of the filler welding wire, which can be determined according to the thickness of the weldment.

explanation_cn: 指直拉硅中的过饱和的间隙氧原子聚集与硅原子反应形成的氧化硅颗粒。直拉硅中的氧杂质是由于晶体生长使用石英坩埚而不可避免地引入的，绝大部分氧原子处于硅晶格的间隙位，且处于过饱和状态。因此.在器件制造的热处理工艺中，一部分过饱和氧原子会聚集形成。直拉硅的行为非常复杂，它与硅晶体中氧的初始浓度、其他杂质的种类和浓度、点缺陷、热历史和热处理的条件（如热处埋气氛、温度、时间）等有关。包括形核和长大两个阶段，形核在较低温度（不高于800-900V)下发生，而长大则在1000°C及以h的温度进行。氧沉淀形核有两种机制：均质形核和异质形核。均质形核是氧原子本身的聚集，其速率主要由间隙氧的过饱和度和扩散速度决定;异质形核是氧原子在其他杂质和缺陷处聚集.如氮、硼、碳、锗等杂质及其与点缺陷的复合体、空位与氧的复合体等都可以作为异质形核中心。长大时，发射出的自间隙硅原子还会聚集崩塌形成位错、层错等二次缺陷。硅片体内的氧沉淀及其诱生缺陷在器件制造过程中具有吸除有害金属沾污的作用，从而提高器件的成品率。过度的及其诱生缺陷会导致硅片翘曲;若出现在器件工作区域还会增加漏电流。
explanation_en: Refers to silicon oxide particles formed by the aggregation of supersaturated interstitial oxygen atoms in Czochralski silicon and the reaction of silicon atoms. The oxygen impurity in Czochralski silicon is inevitably introduced due to the use of quartze crucible for crystal growth. Most of the oxygen atoms are in the gap position of the silicon lattice and are in an oversaturated state. Therefore, in the heat treatment process of device manufacturing, a part of supersaturated oxygen atoms will gather and form. The behavior of Czochralski silicon is very complex, which is related to the initial concentration of oxygen in silicon crystal, the type and concentration of other impurities, point defects, thermal history and heat treatment conditions (such as the buried atmosphere, temperature, time). Including two stages of nucleation and growth, nucleation occurs at lower temperatures (not higher than 800-900V), while growth occurs at temperatures of 1000 ° C and h. There are two mechanisms of oxygen precipitation nucleation: homogeneous nucleation and heterogeneous nucleation. Homogeneous nucleation is the aggregation of oxygen atoms themselves, and its rate is mainly determined by the supersaUiration degree and diffusion rate of interstitial oxygen; Heterogeneous nucleation is the aggregation of oxygen atoms at other impurities and defects. For example, nitrogen, boron, carbon, germanium and other impurities and their complexes with point defects, vacancy and oxygen can be used as heterogeneous nucleation centers. When growing up, the emitted self interstitial silicon atoms will also gather and collapse to form secondary defects such as dislocations and stacking fault. The oxygen precipitation and its induced defects in silicon wafer can absorb harmful metal contamination during device manufacturing, thus improving the yield of devices. Excessive and induced defects will lead to warpage of silicon wafer; If it appears in the working area of the device, it will also increase leakage current.

explanation_cn: 以氧离子为传导离子的快离子导体,，大多以立方萤石型结构的氧化物为基，经过异价离子置换形成的具有氧空位的固溶体,,其中又以ZrO2基固溶体研究得最多。ZrO2基固溶体一般分为两类：一类是以二价离子置换Zr，另一类是以三价离子置换Zr。这类有着广泛的用途，如高温燃料电池的同体电解质，还可用以制造各类氧传感器。Bi2O3基固溶体也是一类，通过在Bi2O3中添加二价、三价、五价或六价的金属氧化物形成，其中有些材料的电导率可比ZrO2基固溶体高一个数量级，但它们在低氧分压下会被部分还原为金属Bi，因此只能在一定的氧分压范围内应用。
explanation_en: Most of the fast ion conductors with oxygen ions as conducting ions are based on cubic fluorite structure oxides, which are replaced by heterovalent ions to form solid solution with oxygen vacancy, among which ZrO2 based solid solution are the most studied. ZrO2 based solid solution are generally divided into two categories: one is to replace Zr with divalent ions, and the other is to replace Zr with trivalent ions. This kind of elonrolyte has a wide range of applications, such as the homologous elonrolyte of high-temperature fuel cell, and can also be used to manufacture various oxygen sensors. Bi2O3 based solid solution are also a class. They are formed by adding divalent, trivalent, pentavalent or hexavalent metal oxides to Bi2O3. Some materials have electric conductivity one order of magnitude higher than ZrO2 based solid solution, but they will be partially reduced to metal Bi under low oxygen partial pressure, so they can only be used within a certain oxygen partial pressure range.

explanation_en: The ratio of oxygen atoms to metal atoms in oxide or mixed oxide fuel.

explanation_cn: 由含有氨基或酰胺基的单体与醛类（主要是甲醛）经缩聚反应而制得的热固性树脂。包括脲醛、三聚氰胺甲醛、脲三聚氰胺甲醛和苯胺甲醛等树脂。最常用的是尿醛树脂和三聚氰胺甲醛树脂。氨基树脂可制得氨基塑料粉、纤维增强材料及层压材料。
explanation_en: Thermosetting resin is prepared by polycondensation reaction of monomer containing amino or amide group and aldehydes (mainly formaldehyde). Including urea formaldehyde, melamine formaldehyde, urea melamine formaldehyde, aniline formaldehyde and other resin. The most commonly used are urea formaldehyde resin and melamine formaldehyde resin. Amino resin can be used to produce amino plastic powder, fiber reinforcement materials and laminated materials.
