explanation_cn: 采用氧气作保护气体的气体保护电弧焊，是惰性气体保护电弧焊的一种，包括钨极和熔化极。钨极是利用钨极（或铈钨、钍钨）和工件之间形成的电弧热使金属熔化而形成焊缝，焊接过程中钨极不熔化。由焊枪喷嘴送进氩气作保护，根据需要可在钨极前方添加填充金属，操作方式分为手工焊和自动焊，由于钨极的载流能力有限，电弧功率受限制，故焊缝熔深小，焊接速度低，只适于焊接厚度小于3mm的共件。熔化极是利用连续送进的焊丝与被焊工件之间形成的电弧作为热源，熔化焊丝与母材金属，由焊枪喷嘴喷出的氩气保护电弧、熔池、熔滴及附近的母材金属，连续送进的焊丝不断熔化并过渡到熔池，与熔化的母材金属熔合形成焊缝，熔化极可采用高密度电流。母材熔深大，填充金属熔敷速率高，适用于焊接厚板。没有脱氧或去氢作用，对焊前的除油、去锈、去水及焊接坡口等准备工作要求严格，抗风能力差。适用于各种金属和合金的焊接，但由于成本较高。通常多用于焊接有色金属及其合金、不锈钢、高温合金、钛及钛合金以及难熔活性金属(如钼、铌、锆、钽等），广泛应用于航天航空、原子能、化工、纺织等工业部门。氩-氧脱碳法利用吹人氩-氧混合气体精炼低碳不锈钢的炉外精炼工艺技术。炉体和传动装置近似于转炉，向炉内吹入的气体为氩气-氧气混合气。氧气与钢液中的碳反应生成CO,而用氩气稀释炉气，使CO的分压降低。钢液中的CO可迅速上浮，从而达到脱碳保铬、生成低碳超低碳不诱钢的目的。氩氧脱碳精炼法设备简单，操作方便.经济效果显著。
explanation_en: The gas shielded arc welding using oxygen as the shielding gas is a kind of inert gas shielded arc welding, including tungsten electrode and melting electrode. Tungsten electrode is to use the arc heat formed between the tungsten electrode (or cerium tungsten, thorium tungsten) and the workpiece to melt the metal to form a weld, and the tungsten electrode will not melt during weld. Argon is fed into the nozzle of the welding gun for protection. Filler metal can be added in front of the tungsten electrode as required. The operation modes are divided into manual welding and automatic welding. Because the current carrying capacity of the tungsten electrode is limited and the arc power is limited, the weld penetration is small and the weld speed is low. It is only suitable for weld of components with a thickness of less than 3mm. The melting electrode uses the arc formed between the continuously fed welding wire and the weldee as the heat source to melt the welding wire and the base metal. The argon gas sprayed from the welding gun nozzle protects the arc, molten pool, molten droplets and nearby base metal. The continuously fed welding wire continuously melts and transits to the molten pool, and fuses with the molten base metal to form a weld. The melting electrode can use high density current. Large penetration of base metal and high deposition rate of filler metal are suitable for weld thick plates. There is no deoxidation or dehydrogenation, and the requirements for oil removal, rust removal, water removal and weld groove preparation before welding are strict, with poor wind resistance. It is suitable for weld of various metals and alloy, but the cost is high. It is usually used for weld nonferrous metals and their alloy, stainless steel, high temperature alloy, titanium and titanium alloy as well as refractory active metals (such as molybdenum, niobium, zirconium, tantalum, etc.), and is widely used in aerospace, atomic energy, chemical, textile and other industrial sectors. Argon oxygen decarburization process uses argon oxygen mixed gas to refining low-carbon stainless steel, which is a off furnace refining process. The furnace body and transmission device are similar to converter, and the gas blown into the furnace is argon oxygen mixture. Oxygen reacts with carbon in steel liquid to generate CO, and argon dilutes furnace gas to reduce CO partial pressure. The CO in the steel liquid can float up rapidly, so as to achieve the goal of decarburization and chromium retention, and to generate low carbon and ultra-low carbon steel without inducing. Argon oxygen decarburization refining method has simple equipment, convenient operation and remarkable economic effect.

explanation_cn: 一类重要的键合剂品种.是一种含有氮丙啶环的多官能团化合物。氮丙啶键合剂可以在高氯酸铵表面开环自聚并形成高模量的抗撕裂层。不仅能提高固体推进剂的力学性能。而且能改善推进剂药浆的工艺性能。大部分的氮丙啶类键合剂在室温下不稳定.需要在低温下储存。常见氮丙啶键合剂品种有MAPO、HX-868、iHX-752、MT-4。主要用于以高氯酸铵氧化剂为主要组分的HTPB推进剂中，其中以MAPO应用最广。
explanation_en: An important type of bonding agent. It is a multifunctional compound containing aziridine ring. The aziridine bonding agent can open the ring and self polymerize on the surface of ammonium perchlorate to form a high modulus tear resistant layer. It can not only improve the mechanical properties of solid propellant. And it can improve the process performance of propellant slurry. Most aziridine bonding agent are unstable at room temperature and need to be stored at low temperature. Common aziridine bonding agent include MAPO, HX-868, iHX-752 and MT-4. Mainly used in HTPB propellants with ammonium perchlorate oxidant as the main component, with MAPO being the most widely used.

explanation_cn: 又称渗氮。将钢件放人具有一定氮活度的介质中加热保温，使钢件表层氮含量升高形成富氮硬化层的化学热处理工艺。常采用气体氮化方法.氮化温度略低于Ft-N系共析温度，多在480-590°C,氮化时间为数十小时，氮化层深度零点几毫米。由于氮在铁素体中的同溶度很小.因而氮化层主要是氮化物层，硬度可达HV950-1200。氮化前钢件一般需经调质处理，氮化后则不再进行热处理。离子氮化和软氮化均是加速渗氮的工艺。为加强渗氮硬化效果，氮化钢种一般应含有强氮化物形成元素如钼、铝、钒、铬等。
explanation_en: Also called nitriding. A thermo-chemical treatment process in which steel parts are put into a medium with a certain nitrogen activity for heating and insulation, so as to increase the nitrogen content in the surface layer of steel parts and form a nitrogen rich hardening layer. Gas nitriding method is often used. nitriding temperature is slightly lower than Ft-N eutectoid temperature, mostly at 480-590 ° C, nitriding time is tens of hours, and nitriding layer depth is a few millimeters. Since the same solubility of nitrogen in ferrite is very small, the nitriding layer is mainly nitride layer, and the hardness can reach HV950-1200. Before nitriding, steel parts generally need to undergo quenching and tempering treatment, and after nitriding, heat treatment is no longer required. Both ionitricling and soft nitriding are accelerated nitriding processes. In order to strengthen the nitriding hardening effect, nitriding steel should generally contain strong nitride forming elements such as molybdenum, aluminum, vanadium, chromium, etc.

name_cn: 氮化物基透波复合材料
explanation_cn: 又称氮化物基天线罩复合材料或氮化物基低介电复合材料，复合材料的一种，泛指以氮化物陶瓷为基体，并引入纤维、晶须、颗粒等增强相进行增强增韧的具有良好透波性能的复合材料。其基体材料主要包括氮化硅、氮化硼、氮化铝、硅硼氮、硅铝氧氮等具有较低介电常数的氮化物陶瓷材料，其增强相主要包括石英纤维、氮化物纤维、氮化硅颗粒及晶须、氮化硼纳米管等。其制备方法根据材料体系的不同，可采用先驱体浸溃裂解法、热压烧结法、反应烧结法、无机盐溶液浸渍固化烧结法等；其中，先驱体浸溃裂解法适用于制备连续纤维织物增强的氮化物基透波复合材料，有利于实现材料和构件的一体化成形。与目前广泛使用的氧化物基透波复合材料相比，氮化物基透波复合材料具有更好的耐温性能、更高的力学性能以及更好的耐烧蚀性能，且同时具有良好的透波性能，可应用于未来新型I高马赫地地导弹、地空导弹、空空导弹、高超音速巡航导弹、跨大气层空间作战飞行器等精确制导武器的天线罩或天线窗等防热/承载/透波一体化部件。
explanation_en: Also known as nitride based radome composite material or nitride based low dielectric composite materials, it is a kind of composite materials, which generally refers to a composite materials with good wave transmission performance that uses nitride ceramics as the matrix and introduces fiber, crystal whisker, particle and other reinforced phase for strengthening and toughening. Its matrix materials mainly include silicon nitride, nitriding, aluminum nitride, silicon boron nitride, silicon aluminum oxynitride and other nitride ceramics materials with low dielectric constant, and its reinforced phase mainly include quartze fiber, nitride fiber, silicon nitride particles, crystal whisker, nitriding nanotube, etc. According to the different materials systems, the preparation methods can be precursor immersion pyrolysis method, hot pressing sintering method, reaction sintering method, inorganic salt solution immersion curing sintering method, etc; Among them, the precursor immersion pyrolysis method is suitable for the preparation of continuous fiber fabric reinforced nitride matrix wave-transparent composite, which is conducive to the integration of materials and components. Compared with the oxide based wave transmitting composite materials widely used at present, the nitride matrix wave-transparent composite has better temperature resistance, higher mechanical properties, better ablation resistance, and also has good wave transmitting properties, which can be used in the future new I high Mach ground to ground missiles, ground to air missiles, air to air missiles, hypersonic cruise missiles Thermal/load-bearing/wave transmitting integrated components such as radomes or antenna windows for precision guided weapons such as transatmospheric space combat aircraft.

explanation_cn: 以有机硅氮烷为先驱体，经熔纺或溶液干纺?成先驱体纤维，再经热定型和高温氮气下烧成。即以|HSiClu与六甲基二硅氮烷合成得到固体的高分子量i的含氢聚氮硅烷，经纺丝，用CH3SiCl3,不熔化处理，再在1200°C惰性环境中烧成。得到纯度很高的氮化硅纤维。纤维的各元素含量分别为硅60%、氮6%、碳2.3%、氧2.2%，拉伸强度为3.lGPa,模量260GPa。该纤维热膨胀系数及热导率小.抗冲击性强，又具有优越的力学性能.主要用于金属、陶瓷基复合材料作增强纤维和防热功能复合材料。
explanation_en: Melt spinning or solution dry spinning with organosilazane as precursor? Formed into precursor fibers, then heat set and fired under high temperature nitrogen gas. That is, | HSiClu and hexamethyldi silazane are used to synthesize solid macromolecule weight i hydrogen containing silane, which is spun, treated with CH3SiCl3, and then fired in an inert environment at 1200 ° C. The silicon nitride fiber with high purity is obtained. The content of each element in the fiber is 60% silicon, 6% nitrogen, 2.3% carbon, and 2.2% oxygen, with a tensile strength of 3.4GPa and a modulus of 260GPa. The fiber has low thermal expansion coefficient and thermal conductivity, strong impact resistance, and superior mechanical properties. It is mainly used in metal and ceramic matrix composite as reinforcing fiber and heat resistant composite.

explanation_cn: 以Si3Ni为主要成分的特种耐火材料。常用硅粉氮化后烧结或热压制备。其热稳定性好，耐氧化温度1400°C左右，在还原气氛中可达1800°C以上。
explanation_en: Special refractory with Si3Ni as main component. Silicon powder is usually prepared by sintering or hot pressing after nitriding. Its thermal stability is good, its oxidation resistance temperature is about 1400 ° C, and it can reach more than 1800 ° C in reducing atmosphere.

explanation_cn: 在SiC骨料中加入工业S粉，Si粉与N2在高温下反应生成，使得SiC颗粒相互结合制成的碳化硅砖。具有抗蠕变性、导热好和耐磨性强的特点。主要用作高炉及有色冶炼炉内衬、窑具。
explanation_en: Industrial S powder is added into SiC aggregate, and the reaction between Si powder and N2 is generated at high temperature, which makes SiC particles combine with each other to make silicon carbide brick. It has the characteristics of creep resistance, good heat conduction and strong wear resistance. It is mainly used as lining and kiln furniture of blast furnace and non-ferrous smelting furnace.

explanation_cn: 是指硅氮化合物的薄膜，常用作微电子技术电绝缘层。化学计量比的氮化硅由正方氮化硅晶胞组成，多余的硅原子在其中排列成六方结构。化学计量比的氮化硅由正方氮化硅晶胞组成，多余的硅原子在其中排列成六方结构。氮化硅低温相的点阵常数为a=0.758nm，c=0.5623nm。它的介电常数高达6-7，击穿场强1x107V·cm。可用化学气相沉积和溅射法制备。
explanation_en: It refers to a thin film of silicon nitride compounds, commonly used as an electrical insulation layer for microelectronics technology. The stoichiometric silicon nitride consists of square silicon nitride unit cell of crystal, in which the redundant silicon atoms are arranged into a hexagonal structure. The stoichiometric silicon nitride consists of square silicon nitride unit cell of crystal, in which the redundant silicon atoms are arranged into a hexagonal structure. The lattice constant of silicon nitride low temperature phase is a=0.758nm, c=0.5623nm. Its dielectric constant is as high as 6-7, and the breakdown field strength is 1x107V · cm. It can be prepared by chemical vapor deposition and sputtering.

explanation_cn: 氮化硅陶瓷，是一种烧结时不收缩的无机材料陶瓷。氮化硅的强度很高，尤其是热压氮化硅，是世界上最坚硬的物质之一。具有高强度、低密度、耐高温等性质。Si3N4 陶瓷是一种共价键化合物，基本结构单元为[ SiN4 ]四面体，硅原子位于四面体的中心，在其周围有四个氮原子，分别位于四面体的四个顶点，然后以每三个四面体共用一个原子的形式，在三维空间形成连续而又坚固的网络结构。
explanation_en: Silicon nitride ceramics is an inorganic materials ceramics that does not shrink during sintering. Silicon nitride has high strength, especially hot pressing silicon nitride, which is one of the hardest materials in the world. It has properties such as high strength, low density, and high temperature resistance. Si3N4 ceramics is a covalent bond compound. The basic structural unit is the [SiN4] tetrahedron. The silicon atom is located in the center of the tetrahedron, and there are four nitrogen atoms around it, respectively located at the four vertices of the tetrahedron. Then, in the form that every three tetrahedrons share one atom, a continuous and solid network structure is formed in the three-dimensional space.

explanation_cn: 以BN为主要成分的耐火制品。BN通常为六方晶型（与石墨性质相似），在高温和超高压下可转化为立方晶型（与金刚石超硬材料相似）。具有优良的热震稳定性、良好的抗酸、碱侵蚀性，可机械加工。
explanation_en: Refractory products with BN as the main component. BN is usually hexagonal (similar to graphite), and can be transformed into cubic (similar to diamond superhard materials) under high temperature and ultra-high pressure. It has excellent thermal shock resistance, good acid and alkali resistance, and can be machined.

explanation_cn: 为改进BN强度低、抗氧化性差、易潮解性能，可在氮化硼材料中加人某些氧化物、硼化物或氮化物制成复合耐火制品。
explanation_en: In order to improve the properties of BN with low strength, poor oxidation resistance and easy deliquescence, some oxides, borides or nitrides can be added into boron nitride materials to make composition refractories.

explanation_cn: 氮化硼晶体属六方晶系，结构与石墨相似，性能也有很多相似之处，所以又叫“白石墨”。它有良好的耐热性、热稳定性、导热性、高温介电强度，是理想的散热材料和高温绝缘材料。氮化硼的化学稳定性好，能抵抗大部分熔融金属的浸蚀。它也有很好的自润滑性。氮化硼制品的硬度低，可进行机械加工，精度为1/100mm。
explanation_en: Boron nitride crystal belongs to hexagonal crystal system, which is similar to graphite in structure and performance, so it is also called "white graphite". It has good heat resistance, thermal stability, thermal conductivity, high temperature dielectric strength, and is an ideal heat dissipation materials and high temperature insulation materials. Boron nitride has good chemical stability and can resist erosion by most molten metals. It also has good self-lubrication. Boron nitride product have low hardness and can be machined with an accuracy of 1/100mm.

explanation_cn: 氮化钛膜是指由钛氮化合物组成的薄膜。氮化钛属于间隙化合物，具有美丽的金黄色光泽，化学稳定性好，熔点高达3000℃，维氏显微硬度为20GPa左右。氮化钛属于间隙化合物，具有美丽的金黄色光泽，化学稳定性好，熔点高达3000℃，维氏显微硬度为20GPa左右。氮化钛以面心立方的-TiN和体心四方的Ti2N两种相存在Ti2N的Ti/N比变化范围很窄，而的N/Ti比的变化范围则很宽。当N/Ti偏离1时，TiN中存在原子空位。这两种相的颜色和硬度相近。使用的氮化钛镀层，其中常常TiN和Ti2N两相共存，其组成比可以通过工艺调节
explanation_en: Titanium nitride film refers to the film composed of titanium nitride compounds. Titanium nitride is a interstitial compound with beautiful golden yellow luster and good chemical stability. Its melting point is up to 3000 ℃ and Vickers micro hardness is about 20 GPa. Titanium nitride is a interstitial compound with beautiful golden yellow luster and good chemical stability. Its melting point is up to 3000 ℃ and Vickers micro hardness is about 20 GPa. The Ti/N ratio of Ti2N, which exists in face centered cubic TiN and body centered tetragonal Ti2N phase, varies in a narrow range, while the N/Ti ratio varies in a wide range. When N/Ti deviates from 1, there is an atomic vacancy in TiN. The color and hardness of the two phase are similar. The titanium nitride coating used often coexists with TiN and Ti2N phases, and its composition ratio can be adjusted by the process

explanation_cn: 铀与氮组成的二元化合物。浅灰色粉末，体心立方结构，是热和电的良导体。是UO2的替代核燃料，用于空间反应堆。
explanation_en: A binary compound of uranium and nitrogen. Light gray powder, body-centered cubic structure, is a good conductor of heat and electricity. It is an alternative nuclear fuel to UO2, used for space reactors.

explanation_cn: 无色六方晶系晶体。有良好导热性、绝缘性、介电性能和冲击强度且热膨胀系数小，热导率高，抗熔融金属的侵蚀能力强。由铝粉在氨或氮气中于800-1000°c合成；或由氯化铝与氨经气相反应制得。是良好的耐热冲击材料和电子器件的表面涂覆材料。还用于制造赛隆陶瓷、氮化铝增强陶瓷材料、氮I化铝弥散钢及由六方氮化硼转变为立方氮化硼的催化剂等，是制作电极的主要材料。
explanation_en: Colorless hexagonal crystal. It has good thermal conductivity, insulation, dielectric property and impact strength, small coefficient of thermcal expansion, high thermal conductivity, and strong corrosion resistance to molten metal. Synthesized from aluminum powder in ammonia or nitrogen at 800-1000 ° C; Alternatively, it can be prepared by reacting aluminum chloride with ammonia in a gas phase. It is a good heat-resistant impact materials and a surface coating materials for electronic devices. It is also used to manufacture sialon ceramics, aluminum nitride reinforced ceramics materials, aluminum nitride dispersion steel, and catalysts for transforming hexagonal boron nitride into cubic boron nitride, etc. It is the main materials for making electrodes.

explanation_cn: 是指用气相沉积、液相沉积、表面转化或其它表面技术制备的氮化铝覆盖层。氮化铝(AIN)是AI-N二元系中唯一稳定的相，它具有共价键、六方纤锌矿结构，在常压下不能熔化，而是在2500K分解它的直接能带间隙高达6.2eV，也可以通过掺杂成为宽带隙半导体材料。
explanation_en: It refers to the aluminum nitride coating prepared by vapor deposition, liquid deposition, surface conversion or other surface technology. Aluminum nitride (AIN) is the only stable phase in the AI-N binary system. It has a covalent bond, hexagonal wurtzite structure, and cannot be melted under normal pressure. Instead, it can be decomposed at 2500K with a direct band gap of up to 6.2eV, and can also be doped into a wide band gap semiconductor materials.

explanation_cn: AIN晶体以〔AIN4〕四面体为结构单元共价键化合物，具有纤锌矿型结构，属六方晶系。化学组成 AI 65.81%，N 34.19%，比重3.261g/cm3，白色或灰白色，单晶无色透明，常压下的升华分解温度为2450℃。为一种高温耐热材料。热膨胀系数（4.0-6.0）X10-6/℃。多晶AIN热导率达260W/(m.k)，比氧化铝高5-8倍，所以耐热冲击好，能耐2200℃的极热。此外，氮化铝具有不受铝液和其它熔融金属及砷化镓侵蚀的特性，特别是对熔融铝液具有极好的耐侵蚀性。
explanation_en: AIN crystal takes [AIN4] tetrahedron as structural unit and covalent bond compound, with wurtzite type structure, belonging to hexagonal crystal system. Chemical composition AI 65.81%, N 34.19%, specific gravity 3.261g/cm3, white or grayish white, colorless and transparent single crystal, sublimation decomposition temperature under normal pressure 2450 ℃. It is a high-temperature and heat-resistant materials. Thermal expansion coefficient (4.0-6.0) X10-6/℃. The thermal conductivity of polycrystal AIN is up to 260W/(m.k), 5-8 times higher than that of alumina, so it has good thermal shock resistance and can withstand extreme heat of 2200 ℃. In addition, aluminum nitride is not corroded by molten aluminum, other molten metals and gallium arsenide, and has excellent corrosion resistance to molten aluminum.

explanation_cn: 氮化铟是氮化物半导体材料的一种。常温常压下的稳定相是六方纤锌矿结构，是一种直接带隙半导体材料。这种材料的引人之处在于它的优良的电子输运性能和窄的能带。有望应用于制造新型高频太拉赫兹通信的光电子器件。
explanation_en: Indium nitride is a kind of nitride semiconductor materials. The stable phase at normal temperature and pressure is hexagonal wurtzite structure, which is a direct band gap semiconductor materials. The attraction of this materials lies in its excellent electronic transport properties and narrow energy band. It is expected to be applied to the manufacturing of optoelectronic devices for new high-frequency terahertz communication.

explanation_cn: 铬氮化合物的薄膜，在CrN系中存在六方结构的Cr2N和m-NaCl结构的CrN两相。氮化铬膜具有高硬度和良好的耐磨性，是一种很受重视的耐磨涂层。用空心阴极离子镀制备的氮化铬膜具有Cr+Cr2N两相组织，晶粒度为20-70mn,硬度为HV22GPa。经真空退火后，能提高到HV35.4GPa。反应溅射法制备的氮化铬膜能得到Cr+Cr2N或单相CrN两种组织。其硬度均在HV20-25GPa(块体ON硬度为HVllGPa)。
explanation_en: The thin film of chromium nitride compounds has hexagonal Cr2N and m-NaCl CrN phases in the CrN system. Chromium nitride film has high hardness and good wear resistance, which is a very important wear resistant coating. The chromium nitride film prepared by hollow cathode ion plating has a Cr+Cr2N two-phase structure, with a grain size of 20-70mn and a hardness of HV22GPa. After vacuum annealing, it can be increased to HV35.4 GPa. The chromium nitride film prepared by reactive sputtering method can obtain two types of structures: Cr+Cr2N or single-phase CrN. Their hardness is HV20-25GPa (block ON hardness is HVllGPa).

explanation_cn: 重要的HI-V族宽禁带化合物半导体材料。室温时能隙3.39eV,为直接跃迁型，晶格常数ci=0.3189nm，t'=0.5185nm,六方晶系。目前直接制备体单晶比较困难，主要采用MOCVD或MBE技术在Al2O3、SiC、ZnO
explanation_en: Important HI-V family wide band gap compounds semiconductor materials. At room temperature, the energy gap is 3.39eV, which is a direct transition type. The lattice constant ci=0.3189nm, t '=0.5185nm, hexagonal crystal system. At present, it is difficult to directly prepare bulk single crystals, mainly using MOCVD or MBE technology in Al2O3, SiC, ZnO

name_cn: 氮氧化物储存还原催化材料
explanation_cn: 机动车在贫燃条件下，空燃比大于理论空燃比下运行可有效降低排放和提高燃料燃烧效率，但氧浓度升高条件下还原效果差。氮氧化物储存还原催化材料就是用来解决贫燃条件下NO引发的污染问题。将贵金属以及稀土氧化物（主要是U2O3）浸溃负载在氧化铝上，经过高温焙烧制成。大部分NSR催化材料是以贵金属作为催化活性成分，以碱或碱土金属作为储存材料。
explanation_en: Under lean burn condition, the vehicle can effectively reduce emissions and improve fuel combustion efficiency when the air-fuel ratio is greater than the theoretical air-fuel ratio, but the reduction effect is poor when the oxygen concentration is increased. Nitrogen oxides storage-reduction catalysts are used to solve the pollution problem caused by NO under lean burn conditions. Precious metals and rare earth oxides (mainly U2O3) are leached and loaded on alumina, and then calcined at high temperature. Most NSR catalytic materials use precious metals as catalytic active components and alkali or alkaline earth metals as storage materials.

name_cn: 氮氧化物分解催化材料
name_en: catalytic decomposition materials of nitrogen oxides
explanation_cn: 能提高氮氧化物的分解速度，降低反应活化能，促使NO2和NO分解生成无毒无害的N2和O2的催化材料。主要有贵金属、金属氧化物、金属离子交换分子筛催化材料、三效催化材料、NO的选择催化还原剂等五类。①贵金属催化材料常用的有Pt、Pt-Rh、Pd-Au等单金属及其合金，载体常用Al2O3、SiO2、ZnO等，一般用浸溃法负载贵金属。通过NO分子吸附在活性中心原位离解为氧和氮原子，再以分子氧和分子氮脱附，释放活性中心来达到催化作用。其催化活性高、抗硫中毒能力和抗水蒸气失活能力强，但操作温度范围窄，有氧阻抑现象。②金属氧化物催化材料有Co、Ni、Cu、Fe、Zr、Ti等氧化物.可直接分解NO，分解NO的活性与氧化物中晶格氧的M-()键强有关，键强度越低,金属氧化物活性越高。③金属离子交换分子筛催化材料，是将C'u、CO、Fe、Ni等过渡元素通过离子交换法负载于ZSM或Y型沸石上，将NO2直接分解成化N2和O2,反应温度较高。④三效催化材料（见三效催化材料词条）。⑤NO的选择催化还原剂，氨选择还原（NH3-SCR）,还原为氮气，在潮湿、富氧和含硫条件下具有较长的使用寿命，应用广泛，但易造成氨污染。烃类选择还原(HC-SCR)可与N()反生催化反应生成N2、CO2和H2O,此法较NIVSCR更加环保。
explanation_en: It can improve the decomposition rate of nitrogen oxides, reduce the activation or conditioning energy of reaction, and promote the decomposition of NO2 and NO to generate non-toxic and harmless N2 and O2 catalytic materials. There are mainly five categories: precious metals, metal oxides, metal ion exchange molecular sieve catalysts, three-way catalysts, and selective catalytic reducing agents for NO. ① Precious metal catalytic materials commonly include Pt, Pt Rh, Pd Au and other single metals and their alloy, and carriers commonly include Al2O3, SiO2, ZnO, etc. precious metals is generally loaded by immersion method. The catalysis is achieved by the adsorption of NO molecules on the active center and the in-situ dissociation of NO molecules into oxygen and nitrogen atoms, and then the desorption of molecular oxygen and molecular nitrogen to release the active center. It has high catalytic activity, strong resistance to sulfur poisoning and water vapor deactivation, but has a narrow operating temperature range and oxygen inhibition phenomenon Metal oxide catalytic materials include Co, Ni, Cu, Fe, Zr, Ti and other oxides, which can directly decompose NO. The activity of decomposition of NO is related to the M-() bond strength of lattice oxygen in the oxide. The lower the bond strength, the higher the activity of metal oxide. ③ Metal ion exchange molecular sieve catalysts is used to load transition elements such as C'u, CO, Fe, Ni, etc. on ZSM or Y type zeolite by ion exchange method, and directly decompose NO2 into N2 and O2, with high reaction temperature. ④ Three-way catalysts (see three-way catalysts entry). ⑤ The selective catalytic reductant of NO, ammonia selective reduction (NH3-SCR), is reduced to nitrogen, which has a long service life under humid, oxygen rich and sulfur containing conditions, and is widely used, but it is easy to cause ammonia pollution. Hydrocarbon selective reduction (HC-SCR) can react with N () to generate N2, CO2, and H2O through reverse catalysis, which is more environmentally friendly than NIVSCR.

name_cn: 氮氧化物选择性催化材料
explanation_cn: 在含氧气氛中，使还原剂或氧化剂优先与废气中NO发生反应的催化材料。
explanation_en: It is a catalytic materials that makes reductant or oxidizer preferentially react with NO in exhaust gas in oxygen atmosphere.

name_en: silicon aluminium oxynitride activated by ytterbium
explanation_cn: 化学式SiAlON:Yb2+，白色粉末。
explanation_en: Chemical formula SiAlON: Yb2+, white powder.

explanation_cn: 在自由基聚合体系中，引人稳定的氮氧自山基，通过在氮氧自由基与链增长自由基之间建立一种动态热力学可逆平衡来控制聚合反应动力学和聚合物分子量及其分布的可控自由莪聚合。在聚合初期.引发剂引发并通过链增长反应形成活性链自由基，活性链自由基与稳定的氮氧自由基发生可逆反应形成休眠种.休眠种也可再次断裂重新产生增长链自由基，但反应速率常数较小。氮氧自由基调控聚合是制备结构可控聚合物的最主要技术之一。相对于其他可控自由基聚合方法优点包括：调控基W的化学稳定性高.不易受各种官能团的影响.苻利于合成带有功能团的聚合物，聚合产物也不需要复杂的纯化步骤.产品没有异味。
explanation_en: In the free radical polymerization system, stable nitrogen and oxygen are introduced from the mountain base. By establishing a dynamic thermodynamics reversible balance between nitrogen and oxygen free radicals and chain growth free radicals, polymerization reaction kinetics and polymer molecular weight and its distribution can be controlled. At the initial stage of polymerization, initiator initiates and forms active chain free radicals through chain growth reaction, and the active chain free radicals and stable nitrogen oxygen free radicals react reversibly to form dormant species. The dormant species can also fracture again to regenerate growth chain free radicals, but the reaction rate constant is small. Nitroxide mediated polymerization is one of the most important technologies for the preparation of structure controllable polymer. Compared with other controlled/living radical polymerization methods, the advantages include: the chemical stability of the regulatory group W is high, and it is not susceptible to the influence of various functional groups. It is convenient to synthesize polymer with functional groups, and the polymerization products do not need complex purification steps. The products have no odor.

explanation_cn: 将2-氯-1，3-丁二烯单体聚合得到的高分子材料。工业上采用过硫酸盐为引发剂，硫、秋兰姆或者硫醇作为分子量调节剂，烷基磺酸钠和松香皂作为乳化剂，按照乳液聚合流程生产。其中反式1,4-结构含量约为85%，较天然橡胶、丁苯橡胶的结晶倾向更大。氯丁橡胶物理机械性能较好，拉伸性能与天然橡胶相似，生胶具有很高的拉伸度以及断裂伸长率，具有自补强件能。同时氯丁橡胶具有优良的耐老化性、耐燃性、耐油性、耐溶剂件、耐水性以及气密性，但是耐低温性以及储存稳定性较差。主要用于电线电缆、各种软管和胶带、防水装置保护层、海底电缆、汽车部件以及胶黏剂等方面。
explanation_en: Macromolecule materials obtained by polymerization of 2-chloro-1,3-butadiene monomer. In industry, persulfate is used as initiator, sulfur, thiuram or mercaptan as molecular weight regulator, and sodium alkyl sulfonate and rosin soap as emulsifier, which are produced according to emulsion polymerization process. The content of trans 1,4-structure is about 85%, which is more crystalline than natural rubber and styrene butadiene rubber. Chloroprene rubber has good physical and mechanical properties, and its tensile properties are similar to those of natural rubber. crude rubber has high tensile strength and percentage elongation after fracture, and has the ability of self reinforcing parts. At the same time, chloroprene rubber has excellent aging resistance, flame resistance, oil resistance, solvent resistance, water resistance and air tightness, but poor low temperature resistance and storage stability. Mainly used for wires and cables, various hoses and tapes, waterproof device protective layers, submarine cables, automotive components, and adhesives.

explanation_cn: 是指2-氯-1.3-丁二烯的乳液聚合产物，是最早成功开发的合成胶乳MT橡胶胶乳总固含量为34.5%?60%,粒径为50?190nm.pH值在12左右。氯丁胶乳分为通用型和特种型两类.通用型氯丁橡胶为2-氯-1,3-丁二烯均聚物.具有高凝胶含量；而特种型氯丁橡胶为2-氯-1,3-丁二烯与第二单体共聚得到，有凝胶型和溶胶型两种胶乳。氯丁胶乳的黏合性以及成膜性较好，湿凝胶膜强度高，硫化胶综合性能较好，具有耐油，耐溶剂、耐燃烧、耐老化、气密性好等优良性能，但耐寒性、电绝缘性能较差，由于聚合物容易水解，故储存稳定性也较差，容易变色，通常会加入3%-5%的碱吸收橡胶分解出的HCl,延长储藏时间。氯丁胶乳主要用于制备浸渍制品、乳液型胶黏剂、胶乳水泥和胶乳沥青、涂料、造纸等方面。
explanation_en: It refers to the emulsion polymerization product of 2-chloro-1.3-butadiene. It is the first successfully developed synthetic latex MT rubber latex with a total solid content of 34.5%? 60%, particle size 50? The 190nm.pH value is around 12. The neoprene latex can be divided into general type and special type. The general type chloroprene rubber is a homopolymer of 2-chloro-1,3-butadiene with high gel content; The special type chloroprene rubber is obtained by copolymerization of 2-chloro-1,3-butadiene and the second monomer, and there are two types of latex: gel type and sol type. Neoprene latex has good adhesion and film-forming properties, high wet gel film strength, good comprehensive performance of vulcanized rubher, good oil resistance, solvent resistance, combustion resistance, aging resistance, good air tightness and other excellent properties, but poor cold resistance and electrical insulation performance. Because polymer is easy to hydrolyze, its storage stability is also poor, and it is easy to change color. Usually 3% -5% alkali will be added to absorb HCl decomposed from rubber, so as to extend the storage time. Neoprene latex is mainly used to prepare impregnation products, lotion type adhesive, latex cement and latex pitch, coatings, paper making, etc.

name_cn: 氯乙烯-醋酸乙烯酯共聚物
explanation_cn: 为氯乙烯和赌酸乙烯进行无规共聚得到的热塑性树脂。在聚氯乙烯分子链中引入醋酸乙烯，侧链所带酯基，起着白增塑作用，适用于生产硬质制品和高填料含量制品。还改进了在溶剂中的可溶解性，适于配制涂料，可提高对金属的黏结性。
explanation_en: Thermoplastic resin obtained by random copolymerization of vinyl chloride and vinyl gamble. Vinyl acetate is introduced into the molecular chain of polyvinyl chloride, and the ester group in the side chain plays a role of white plasticizing. It is suitable for the production of hard products and products with high filler content. The solubility in solvent is also improved, which is suitable for preparing coatings and can improve the adhesion to metal.

name_cn: 氯乙烯接枝乙烯-醋酸乙烯酯
explanation_cn: 以乙烯-醋酸乙烯酯(EVA)为主链。与氯乙烯(VC)单体经接枝共聚合反应制得的接枝共聚物。工业上常用此种接枝共聚物与聚氯乙烯之共混物。硬质抗冲型PVC可进行挤塑、注塑、压延等加工用作PVC硬制品抗冲击改性剂。可得到比PVC/EVA共混物冲击强度高的优良制品。主要用于生产管材、异型材、板材等。
explanation_en: Using ethylene vinyl acetate (EVA) as the main chain. Graft copolymer is prepared by graft copolymerization with vinyl chloride (VC) monomer. The blends of this graft copolymer and polyvinyl chloride are commonly used in industry. Hard impact resistant PVC can be used as an impact modifier for PVC hard products during processing such as extrusion, injection molding, and rolling. Good products with higher impact strength than PVC/EVA blends can be obtained. It is mainly used to produce tube, profiled materials, plates, etc.

name_cn: 氯乙烯接枝氯化聚乙烯树脂
explanation_cn: 以氯化聚乙烯为主链与氯乙烯单体经接枝聚合反应制得的接枝共聚物树脂。根据CPE含量不同，一般可分为低氯含量，中氯含量，高氯含量等几类。CPK含量不同，性能与用途也不同。其机械强度和冲击强度较高，耐低温性、绝缘性、耐候性、抗燃烧性、高填充性和耐溶剂萃取性优良。
explanation_en: The graft copolymer resin was prepared by grafting polymerization of chlorinated polyethylene as the main chain and vinyl chloride monomer. According to the different CPE content, it can generally be divided into several categories: low chlorine content, medium chlorine content, high chlorine content, etc. The CPK content varies in terms of performance and usage. It has high mechanical strength and impact strength, excellent low temperature resistance, insulation, weather resistance, combustion resistance, high filling and solvent extraction resistance.

name_cn: 氯乙烯接枝聚丙烯酸酯树脂
explanation_cn: 由氯乙稀单体与聚丙稀酸酯经接枝共聚合制成的共聚物。需用的聚丙烯酸酯(ACR)有聚丙烯酸丁酯、聚丙烯酸乙酯、聚丙烯酸辛酯等常用这类接枝共聚物和聚氯乙烯的共混物，ACR含量一般为6%-8%，其中PVC、连续相，ACR橡胶弹性体为分散相均匀地分散(接枝)在PVC中。两相间有牢固的化学键结合。该共聚物有良好的耐候性，加工温度宽，产品表面光泽度好。比PVC/ACR共混物价格低廉。例如用作PVC门窗异型材的共聚物性能:拉伸屈服强度>45MPa,屈服伸长率<5%,简支梁缺口冲击强度20°C时〉30mJ/mm2、0°C时>8mJ/mm2，不破裂拉伸冲击强度(缺口)20°C>170mJ/mm2,球压痕硬度>90N/mm2,部氏硬度77-79,弯曲模量>2500MPa,维卡软化点>76℃。共聚物可用悬浮共聚合及乳液共聚合制造。常用悬浮共聚，主要用挤塑成型法制造PVC硬制品，如PVC的异型材、板材等。氯乙烯-丙烯酸酯树脂的生产原料和树脂粉尘，对人体的皮肤黏膜和肺部有不同程度的刺激损害，应加以注意。
explanation_en: The copolymer is prepared by graft copolymerization of vinyl chloride monomer and polypropylene ester. The polyacrylate (ACR) required includes butyl polyacrylate, ethyl polyacrylate, octyl polyacrylate and other commonly used graft copolymer and polymer blending of polyvinyl chloride. The ACR content is generally 6% -8%, among which PVC, continuous phase and ACR rubber elastomer are dispersed phase and uniformly dispersed (grafted) in PVC. There is a strong chemical bond between the two phases. The copolymer has good weather resistance, wide processing temperature and good surface gloss. It is cheaper than PVC/ACR polymer blending. For example, the properties of copolymer used as PVC door and window profile: tensile yield strength>45MPa, yield elongation<5%, simply supported beam notch impact strength>30mJ/mm2 at 20 ° C,>8mJ/mm2 at 0 ° C, unbreakable tensile impact strength (notch) 20 ° C>170mJ/mm2, ball indentation hardness>90N/mm2, Brinell hardness 77-79, bending modulus>2500MPa, Vicat bating point>76 ℃. Copolymer can be produced by suspension copolymerization and lotion copolymerization. Commonly used for suspension copolymerization, PVC hard products are mainly manufactured by extrusion molding method, such as PVC profiles, plates, etc. The raw materials for the production of vinyl chloride acrylate resin and resin dust have different degrees of irritation and damage to human skin, mucosa and lungs, which should be noted.

explanation_cn: 处理废水或土壤中含氯代脂昉烃废弃物的材料。一种是仅将土壤中的氯代脂肪烃转移的材料，如萃取剂、活性炭，这种方法容易造成二次污染、成本高；另一种是利用微生物材料是将土壤中的氯代脂肪烃分解或转化为其他无毒或低毒性物质。自然界中的微生物通常最初不具备转化人工合成的有毒物质的酶体系，因而氯代有机物一般不易生物降解，只有在一定条件下，通过富集培养.诱导出降解酶系的合成，通过驯化假单胞菌属、根瘤菌属、生丝微菌属、不动杆菌属、分枝杆菌属、亚硝化单胞菌属及甲基单胞菌属中的某些菌种能够在特定条件下降解氯代脂肪族物质。此外还可利用零价铁处理氯代脂昉烃，零价铁对氯代脂肪烃的还原脱氯有三种反应路径:①氢解。金属直接反应，将零价铁表面的电子转移到氯代烃使之脱氯。②还原消除。铁腐蚀的直接产物Fe2+具有还原能力，它可使得一部分氯代烃拖氯。③铁反应产生的氢气可使有机氯化污染物还原。在厌氧条件下，H2O可作为电子接受体。
explanation_en: Materials for treating waste water or soil containing chlorinated aliphatic hydrocarbon wastes. One is materials that only transfer chlorinated aliphatic hydrocarbons in soil, such as extractants and activated carbon. This method is easy to cause secondary pollution and high cost; The other is to use microbial materials to decompose or transform chlorinated aliphatic hydrocarbons in soil into other non-toxic or low toxic substances. The microorganisms in nature usually do not initially have the enzyme system to transform artificially synthesized toxic substances, so chlorinated organics are generally not easy to biodegradation, and only under certain conditions, through enrichment culture, can the synthesis of degradation enzyme system be induced, and through domestication of Pseudomonas, Rhizobia, Micromyces, Acinetobacter, Mycobacterium Some strains of Nitrosomonas and Methylmonas can degrade chlorinated aliphatic substances under specific conditions. In addition, zero valent iron can also be used to treat chlorinated aliphatic hydrocarbons. There are three reaction paths for reductive dechlorination of chlorinated aliphatic hydrocarbons by zero valent iron: ① hydrogenolysis. Metal reacts directly, transferring electrons on the surface of zero valent iron to chlorinated hydrocarbon for dechlorination. ② Restore elimination. The direct product of iron corrosion, Fe2+, has the reduction ability, which can make some chlorinated hydrocarbons drag chlorine. ③ The hydrogen generated by the iron reaction can reduce organic chlorinated pollutants. Under anaerobic conditions, H2O can serve as an electron acceptor.

explanation_cn: 化学式为CuCl,属立方晶系，闪矿型结构。是一种声光晶体。可用坩埚下降法生长。CuCl是一种在大气中易潮解的晶体，故在加工、使用时造成困难。用于电光调制。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is CuCl, belonging to the cubic crystal system and a diorite type structure. It is a acousto-optical crystal. It can be grown by descending crucible method. CuCl is a kind of crystal that is easily deliquescent in the atmosphere, so it is difficult to process and use. Used for electro-optic modulation.

explanation_cn: 聚丙烯分子链上引入氯原子的白色粉末或颗粒状的极性聚烯烃树脂。分为低氯化度(氯含量20%-40%)和高氯化度(氯含量高达63%-67%)的产品。对无机酸、有机酸、强氧化性酸、强碱有良好的耐腐蚀性，耐油、耐热、耐光，不溶于醇、脂肪烃，溶于芳烃、酯类、酮类，熔点<150°C，氯含量为30%的产品熔点最低-分解温度180-190°C。具有黏结性和涂饰性。成膜后无色。与大多数树脂相容性好，尤其是与古马隆树脂、石油树脂、松脂、酚醛树脂、醇酸树脂、煤焦油树脂等。工业生产采用溶液法、悬浮法或固相氣化聚丙烯制得。产品可用作黏胶剂。与PE、PP、PVC等塑料、铝箔、钢、金、银等具有很好的黏合性。亦可作涂料载色剂、印刷油墨、纸张涂层、防水剂、阻燃剂等。
explanation_en: White powder or granular polar polyolefin resin with chlorine atoms introduced into the molecular chain of polypropylene. It is divided into products with low chlorine content (20% -40% chlorine content) and products with high chlorine content (up to 63% -67% chlorine content). It has good corrosion resistance to inorganic acid, organic acid, strong oxidizing acid and strong base, oil resistance, heat resistance, light resistance, insoluble in alcohol and aliphatic hydrocarbon, soluble in aromatic hydrocarbon, ester and ketone, melting point<150 ° C, and the lowest melting point decomposition temperature of products with 30% chlorine content is 180-190 ° C. Has adhesive and finishing properties. Colorless after film formation. Compatibility with most resin is good, especially with Gumarone resin, petroleum resin, rosin, phenolic resin, alkyd resin, coal tar resin, etc. In industrial production, polypropylene is produced by solution method, suspension method or solid phase gasification. The product can be used as an adhesive. It has good adhesion with PE, PP, PVC and other plastics, aluminum foil, steel, gold, silver, etc. It can also be used as coatings carrier, printing ink, paper coating, waterproof agent, flame retardant or fire retardant, etc.

explanation_cn: 由聚乙烯经氯化而制得的一种热塑性材料，根据含量不同有塑料和弹性体两种。含氯一般为25%-45%，具有优良的耐寒性、耐冲击性、耐化学腐蚀性、耐臭氧性、耐油性和电气特性，与其他塑料相容性好。含氯>25%时，有阻燃性。含氯量30%的产品软化点为33°C，断裂伸长率600%。拉伸强度llMPa。产品用于制备各种制品、地板、建筑材料密封剂、电线被概和聚諷乙烯的抗冲改性剂、高分子增塑剂、阳-燃添加剂、橡塑共混产品、重包装袋、输送化学药品的软管、设备涂层、发泡材料等。
explanation_en: A thermoplastic materials made from polyethylene by chlorination. There are two kinds of plastics and elastomer according to the content. Chlorine content is generally 25% -45%, with excellent cold resistance, impact resistance, chemical corrosion resistance, ozone resistance, oil resistance and electrical characteristics, and good compatibility with other plastics. When the chlorine content exceeds 25%, it has flame retardancy. The bating point of the product with 30% chlorine content is 33 ° C, and the percentage elongation after fracture is 600%. Tensile strength llMPa. The products are used to prepare various products, floor, building materials sealant, wire quilt and impact modifier of polyethylene polystyrene, macromolecule plasticizer, cation burning additive, rubber plastic polymer blending products, heavy packaging bags, hoses for transporting chemicals, equipment coatings, foaming materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 聚乙烯中部分氢被氯取代制得的弹性体。聚乙烯的氯化采用溶液法、悬浮法、流化床法和固相法。通常其含氣质量分数为25%-48%,具有优良的耐候性、耐寒性和电气特性。与其他塑料和填料的相容性好，有阻燃性。含氯量30%的产品软化点-33℃,断裂伸长率600%，拉伸强度11MPa;含氯量45%的产品，软化点44°C,断裂伸长率60%，拉伸强度22MPa。主要用于制作耐候、阻燃、耐腐蚀和耐油制品等。
explanation_en: Elastomer made of polyethylene in which part of hydrogen is replaced by chlorine. The chlorination of polyethylene adopts solution method, suspension method, fluidized bed method and solid phase method. It usually has a gas content of 25% -48% and excellent weather resistance, cold resistance, and electrical characteristics. Good compatibility with other plastics and fillers, flame retardant. The bating point of the product with 30% chlorine content is -33 ℃, the percentage elongation after fracture is 600%, and the tensile strength is 11MPa; The product with 45% chlorine content has a softening point of 44 ° C, a percentage elongation after fracture of 60%, and a tensile strength of 22MPa. It is mainly used for making weather resistant, flame retardant, corrosion resistant and oil resistant products.

explanation_cn: 聚氯乙烯经氯化制得的高分子化合物。根据聚合度大小，制成高黏度、中黏度和低黏度树脂。白色粉状物。含氯量一般为61%-68%，易溶于酯类、酮类、芳烃等多种有机溶剂，具有良好的黏结性、耐燃性、耐老化性、电绝缘性。制品在沸水中不变形，最高使用温度100-105-C。熔融温度110工拉伸断裂强度52-62MPa，断裂伸张率4^-65%，压缩强度62-152MPa，弯曲强度100-117MPa，拉伸模S2182-3280MPa。产品具有卓越的耐高温、抗腐蚀和阻燃性能，可视作一种新的工程塑料，可在挤塑、注塑、压延等成型方法加工，CPVC管长期使用温度高达105工可作耐热管材输送热水。此外还可用作耐腐蚀涂料、黏合剂，也可作过滤材料和纤维。
explanation_en: Macromolecule compound prepared by chlorination of polyvinyl chloride. According to the degree of polymerization, resin with high viscosity, medium viscosity and low viscosity is made. White powder. The chlorine content is generally 61% -68%, and is easily soluble in various organic solvents such as esters, ketones, aromatics, etc. It has good adhesion, flame resistance, aging resistance, and electrical insulation. The product does not deform in boiling water and can be used at a maximum temperature of 100-105-C. Melting temperature 110 tensile fracture strength 52-62MPa, fracture elongation 4 ^ -65%, compressive strength 62-152MPa, bending strength 100-117MPa, drawing die S2182-3280MPa. The product has excellent high temperature resistance, corrosion resistance and flame retardancy. It can be regarded as a new engineering plastics, which can be processed by extrusion, injection molding, calendering and other molding methods. CPVC pipes can be used as heat-resistant tube to transport hot water when the long-term use temperature is up to 105. In addition, it can also be used as corrosion resistant coatings, adhesive, filter materials and fiber.

explanation_cn: 又称岩盐型结构。以NaCl为代表的一类AB型化合物结构类型。属立方晶系，面心立方点阵，空间群为Fm3m。阳离子(Na+)及阴离子(Cl-)各位于面心立方点阵的结点位置上，两个点阵相距1/2的晶胞氏度。其中阴离子B排列成立方密堆枳，阳离子A填充在阴离子构成的八面体空隙中，A和B的配位数均为6。碱土金属的硫化物和氧化物(氧化镁至氧化钡，而氧化铍除外)；碱金属的氢化物和卤化物(氯化铯、溴化铯和碘化铯除外)，以及某些二价过渡元素的氧化物(如一氧化锰、氧化亚铁、一氧化钛、一氧化镍)等都具有氯化钠型结构，其中A-B间的联系为离子键。A、B离子半径比大多在0.732-0.414之间。此外，某些氮化物和碳化物[如氮化钪(ScN)和碳化钛(TiC)]也属M化钠型结构。其中，LiF、NaF等是主要的玻璃及陶瓷烧结助剂的原料。MgO、TiC、TiN等是很重要的高温材料。
explanation_en: It is also called rock salt structure. A type of AB type compound structure represented by NaCl. It belongs to cubic crystal system, face centered cubic lattice, and the space group is Fm3m. Cation (Na+) and anion (Cl -) are respectively located at the node of the face centered cubic lattice, and the two lattices are 1/2 unit cell of crystal degrees apart. Among them, anion B is arranged in a square close packed trifoliate orange, and cation A is filled in the octahedral space formed by anion. The coordination number number of A and B is 6. Sulfides and oxides of alkaline earth metals (magnesium oxide to barium oxide, except beryllia); The hydrides and halides of alkali metals (except cesium chloride, cesium bromide and cesium iodide), as well as the oxides of some bivalent transition elements (such as manganese oxide, ferrous oxide, titanium oxide and nickel oxide), all have a rock salt structure, in which the connection between A-B is a ionic bond. A. B The ratio of ionic radius is mostly between 0.732-0.414. In addition, some nitrides and carbide [such as nitriding (ScN) and titanium carbide (TiC)] also belong to sodium carbide type structure. Among them, LiF, NaF, etc. are the main raw materials for glass and ceramics sintering additive. MgO, TiC, TiN, etc. are very important high-temperature materials.

explanation_cn: 以氯化铯(CsCl)为代表的一类AB型离子晶体。属立方晶系，简单立方点阵，空间群为Pm3m。结构中阴离子B排列成原始立方格子，而阳离子A位于体心位置。A，B两种离子的配位数都是8。每个晶胞中含一个阴离子，一个阳离子，负离子多面体为正六面体。虽然属于这种结构类型的化合物有很多，如溴化铯碘化铯、氯化铊、溴化铊、碘化铊等，何是在常用的陶瓷材料中很少有这种姑型存在。
explanation_en: A class of AB type ionic crystal represented by cesium chloride (CsCl). It belongs to cubic crystal system, simple cubic lattice, and the space group is Pm3m. In the structure, anion B is arranged in the original cubic lattice, while cation A is located at the center of the body. A. B The coordination number of both ions is 8. Each unit cell of crystal contains an anion and a cation, and the anion polyhedron is a positive hexahedron. Although there are many compounds belonging to this structural type, such as cesium bromide, cesium iodide, thallium chloride, thallium bromide, thallium iodide, etc., it is rare that this type of compound exists in commonly used ceramics materials.

name_en: calcium magnesium chlorosilicate activated by europium
explanation_cn: 化学式Ca8Mg(SiO4)4Cl2:Eu2+。白色粉末。立方晶系。激发带位于270-470nm，最大激发峰位于375nm左右。相应的发射谱带位于475-575mn。为一个对称宽带发射峰。谱峰位于510nm。
explanation_en: The chemical formula Ca8Mg (SiO4) 4Cl2: Eu2+. White powder. Cubic crystal system. The excitation band is located at 270-470nm, and the maximum excitation peak is around 375nm. The corresponding emission bands are located between 475-575mn. It is a symmetric broadband emission peak. The spectral peak is located at 510nm.

name_en: barium calcium magnesium chlorophosphate activated by europium
explanation_cn: 化学式(Ba，Ca，Mg)5(PO4)3Cl:Eu2+白色粉末。该荧光粉在253.7nm紫外线激发下所发出的荧光随Ca2+的增加从蓝色变成蓝绿色(470-500nm)，当同定某一Ca24量时。n了以得到峰值波长为48finm的蓝绿色荧光。量子效率达83%，激发光的反射率是0.066。主要用作高显色荧光灯中蓝绿色荧光粉。
explanation_en: Chemical formula (Ba, Ca, Mg) 5 (PO4) 3Cl: Eu2+white powder. The fluorescence emitted by the phosphor under the excitation of 253.7 nm ultraviolet light changes from blue to blue-green (470-500 nm) with the increase of Ca2+, when a certain amount of Ca24 is determined. N to obtain a blue-green fluorescence with a peak-emission wavelength of 48 finm. The quantum efficiency is 83%, and the reflectivity of the stimulated light is 0.066. It is mainly used as blue-green phosphor in high color rendering fluorescent lamps.

explanation_cn: 化学式Sr5(PO4)3Cl:Eu2+，六方晶系。获得荧光粉的激发波长位于304nm和344nm处，发射波长在445nm左右。是高效的蓝色发光材料，被广泛应用在基色节能灯、CCTL背光源荧光灯等照明器件和场发射显示器件。
explanation_en: Chemical formula Sr5 (PO4) 3Cl: Eu2+, hexagonal crystal system. The excitation wavelength of phosphor obtained is at 304nm and 344nm, and the emission wavelength is about 445nm. It is an efficient blue luminescence materials, widely used in lighting devices and field emission display devices such as primary color energy-saving lamps, CCTL backlight fluorescent lamps, etc.

explanation_cn: 是由聚乙烯经氯磺化后得到的白色固态弹性体。氯磺化聚乙烯的工业生产多采用溶液法。相对密度为1.07-1.27,溶于芳香烃及卤代烃，不溶于醇及烷烃，由于其结构具有高饱和度，并有极性基团。故有优异的耐臭氧、耐候性；耐化学试剂如酸、碱和油类，可在120-140℃下连续使用，耐磨耗性、耐燃、抗屈挠性好，与通用胶的相容性好。氯磺化聚乙烯橡胶主要用于耐热、耐介质密封、耐酸碱、耐氧制品及胶辊、胶管、电缆电线护套、耐热运输带、黏结剂、涂料、保护涂层、防雨布、雨衣、橡皮船、胶布等的制造。
explanation_en: It is a white solid elastomer obtained by chlorosulfonation of polyethylene. The industrial production of chlorosulfonated polyethylene mostly adopts the solution method. The relative density is 1.07-1.27, soluble in aromatic hydrocarbons and halogenated hydrocarbons, insoluble in alcohols and alkanes, because of its high saturation structure and polar groups. Therefore, it has excellent ozone resistance and weather resistance; It is resistant to chemical agents such as acid, alkali and oil, and can be used continuously at 120-140 ℃. It has good abrasion resistance, flame resistance, flexion resistance and compatibility with general adhesives. Chlorosulfonated polyethylene is mainly used for the manufacture of heat resistant, medium resistant sealing, acid and alkali resistant, oxygen resistant products, rubber rollers, rubber hoses, cable and wire sheaths, heat resistant transport belts, adhesive, coatings, protective coatings, raincoats, rubber boats, adhesive tapes, etc.

explanation_cn: 由氯丁二烯与丙烯腈经乳液聚合法制得。结构式:一般为浅黄色的间体，相对密度0.95-1.0,溶解度参数约为9.0,溶于氯笨、二甲苯等溶剂中，在植物油中溶胀不溶解。丙烯腈含量高于35%为高含量氯睛橡胶，丙烯腈含量为25%-35%是中含量氯腈橡胶。丙烯腈含量低于25%为低含量氯腈橡胶。氯腈橡胶具有良好的耐油性、耐臭氧老化性，随着丙烯腈含量增加，耐油性能增加，随着氯丁二烯含量增加，耐臭氧老化性能增加，同时氯腈橡胶的阻燃性能也随之增加。氯腈橡胶的缺点是耐寒性以及电绝缘性不佳，不易长期储存。氯腈橡胶可以应用于耐油、耐臭氧、阻燃型制品中，如耐油管、密封件、电线电缆、阻燃垫片以及化工设备的里衬材料等。
explanation_en: It is prepared by emulsion polymerization of chloroprene and acrylonitrile. Structural formula: it is generally a light yellow intermediate, with a relative density of 0.95-1.0 and a water solubility parameter of about 9.0. It is soluble in chlorobenzene, xylene and other solvents, and it is swelling and insoluble in vegetable oil. High content chloronitrile rubber refers to acrylonitrile content higher than 35%, and medium content chlorobutadiene acrylonhrile rubber refers to acrylonitrile content 25% -35%. Low content chlorobutadiene acrylonhrile rubber refers to acrylonitrile content lower than 25%. Chlorobutadiene acrylonhrile rubber has good oil resistance and ozone aging resistance. With the increase of acrylonitrile content, the oil resistance increases. With the increase of chloroprene content, the ozone aging resistance increases. At the same time, the flame retardancy of chlorobutadiene acrylonhrile rubber also increases. The disadvantages of chlorobutadiene acrylonhrile rubber are poor cold resistance and electrical insulation, and it is not easy to store for a long time. Chlorobutadiene acrylonhrile rubber can be used in oil resistant, ozone resistant and flame retardant products, such as oil resistant pipes, seals, wires and cables, flame retardant gaskets, and lining materials of chemical equipment.

explanation_cn: 部分硅原子上带有氯代苯基的二甲基硅油或甲基苯基硅油。
explanation_en: Some silicon atoms contain chlorophenyl dimethyl silicone oil or methylphenylsiliconeoil.

explanation_cn: 又称索瑞尔水泥。是一种特殊品种水泥，以氧化镁为主要成分，是用煅烧菱镁矿石所得的轻烧粉或低温煅烧白云石所得的灰粉为胶结剂，以六水氯化镁等水溶性镁盐为调和剂，再加人水所形成的水泥硬化体。可制成人造大理石、苦土瓦、装饰板等。
explanation_en: It is also called sorel cement. It is a special kind of cement, with magnesium oxide as the main component. It is a hardened cement formed by using the light calcined powder obtained by calcining magnesite ore or the ash powder obtained by low-temperature calcining dolomite as the cementitious agent, using water-soluble magnesium salts such as magnesium chloride hexahydrate as the blending agent, and adding water. It can be made into artificial marble, bitter clay tiles, decorative boards, etc.

explanation_cn: 以a-氰基丙烯酸酯为主要成分的黏剂。由于它一接触大气或黏结面0R上附着的极微量的水分即发生剧烈的聚合反应而固化。故又称为"瞬干胶"。具有如下的特点：单组分，无溶剂，胶液无色透明。黏度低；铺展性好，单位体积用胶量少；不需加热和固化剂就能在室温下快速固化（5-10s）；被粘物表面不需要作特殊处理，使用及其方便；几乎对各种材料（金属、橡胶、塑料、玻璃、陶瓷）都有良好的黏结强度，特别适用于小零件的快速黏结、修补和固定；对皮肤等微生物体也有较强的粘合作用。而且基本无毒。缺点是不宜大面积黏合、胶层较脆、耐冲击和剥离强度低、耐水及耐碱性较差、有刺激性气味。
explanation_en: Adhesive mainly composed of a-cyanoacrylate. As soon as it contacts the atmosphere or the extremely small amount of water attached to the bonding surface 0R, it will undergo intense polymerization and curing. Therefore, it is also called "instant drying adhesive". It has the following characteristics: single component, solvent-free, colorless and transparent adhesive solution. Low viscosity; Good spreading ability, with less glue per unit volume; Rapid curing at room temperature (5-10s) without heating and curing agent; The surface of the adhesive does not require special treatment and is extremely convenient to use; It has good bonding strength for almost all kinds of materials (metal, rubber, plastics, glass, ceramics), especially for fast bonding, repairing and fixing of small parts; It also has a strong adhesive effect on micro organisms such as skin. And it is basically non-toxic. The disadvantages are not suitable for large area bonding, brittle adhesive layer, low impact resistance and peel strength, poor water and alkali resistance, and pungent smell.

name_cn: 氰酸酯树脂基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以氰酸酯树脂为基体的复合材料。氰酸酯树脂是分子结构中含有两个或两个以上的氰酸酯官能闭(-O一C=N)的树脂-在热或催化剂作用下进行三环化反应。生成含有5嗪环的_型结构大分子。称为氰酸酯树脂或歹嗪树脂（trifiziiK'resin)。三嗓环结构的交联度极高，同化后的氰酸酯树脂具有优异的耐烧蚀性能、耐高温性能、耐湿热性能、介电性能、电绝缘性能和力学性能等。但缺点是固化温度高、韧性较差。可通过热固性树脂共聚、热塑性树脂共混等方式对其进行改性。常用的增强体有玻璃纤维、石英纤维、碳纤维及其织物等。m酸酯树脂基复合材料适用于模压成型、真空袋成型、热压罐成型、缠绕成型等方法。氰酸酯树脂基复合材料在电子电路、航空航天、电气绝缘、光学仪器、医疗器材等领域中得到广泛应用，如高频印制电路板、髙性能透波雷达罩，以及高模型碳纤维增强氰酸酯基复合材料用作卫星太阳能帆板结构材料、空间光学镜面反射材料等"
explanation_en: Composite materials based on cyanate ester resin. Cyanate ester resin is a kind of resin with two or more cyanate ester functional blocks (- O-C=N) in its molecular structure, which carries out the tricyclization reaction under the action of heat or catalyst. Generation of 5-zine ring containing_ Type macromolecule. It is called cyanate ester resin or oxazine resin (trifiziiK'resin). The degree of crosslinking of the three ring structure is extremely high. The assimilated cyanate ester resin has excellent ablation resistance, high temperature resistance, moisture and heat resistance, dielectric properties, electrical insulation properties and mechanical properties. However, the disadvantages are high curing temperature and poor toughness. It can be modified by copolymerization of thermosetting resin and polymer blending of thermoplastic resin. Common reinforcement include glass fiber, quartze fiber, carbon fiber and its fabric. M-ester resin based composite materials is suitable for press molding, vacuum bag molding, autoclave molding, filament winding molding and other methods. Cyanate resin matrix composite are widely used in electronic circuits, aerospace, electrical insulation, optical instruments, medical equipment and other fields, such as high-frequency printed circuit board, high-performance wave transmitting radomes, and high model carbon fiber reinforced cyanate ester matrix composite materials as structural materials of satellite solar panels, space optical mirror reflective materials, etc“

explanation_cn: 金属材料在水介质中发生的腐蚀。
explanation_en: Corrosion of metallic materials in water.

explanation_cn: 一类具有亲水性、能被水溶胀但不溶解于水的物质。水凝胶具有三维网络结构?在水中可溶胀至平衡体积仍保持其形状。常见的有高分子水凝胶、自组装多肽凝胶等。高分子水凝胶可分为天然高分子水凝胶和合成高分子水凝胶两类.前者如钙离子交联的海藻酸，后者如通过化学键交联的聚甲基丙烯酸-2-羟基乙酯、聚异丙基丙烯酰胺。水凝胶的亲水性来源于结构中的亲水性基W;不溶性和溶胀形状稳定性是出交联分子中的化学键以及自组装凝胶中的氢键作用等分子间力的作用引起的。水凝胶含大量水分。可使溶于其中的低分子量物质在其间渗透扩散。有些水凝胶还具有刺激响应性，随着温度、pH值、光、电等环境参数的变化而收缩或溶胀。水凝胶在生物医用领域具有广泛的应用?可用作诊断、治疗和植入材料等。诊断用水凝胶主要柯各种导管、酶免疫试验载体等；在治疗方面主要用作血液灌流术中的吸附剂涂层、透析膜、隐形眼镜、烧伤敷料、药物释放载体等；水凝胶植入物有人工晶体、人工角膜、软组织替代物等。
explanation_en: A type of substance that is hydrophilic and can be swelled by water but does not dissolve in water. Hydrogel has three-dimensional network structure? It can swelling in water until the equilibrium volume still keeps its shape. The common ones are macromolecule hydrogel, self-assembly polypeptide gel, etc. Macromolecule hydrogel can be divided into natural polymer hydrogel and synthetic macromolecule hydrogel. The former is like calcium ion crosslinking alginate, and the latter is like crosslinking polymethacrylic acid 2-hydroxyethyl ester and polyisopropylacrylamide. The hydrophilicity of hydrogel comes from the hydrophilic group W in the structure; Insolubility and swelling shape stability are caused by intermolecular forces such as chemical bonds in crosslinking molecules and hydrogen bond in self-assembly gel. Hydrogel contains a lot of water. It can make the low molecular weight substances dissolved in it permeate and diffusion. Some hydrogel also have stimuli-responsive, shrinking or swelling with the change of temperature, pH value, light, electricity and other environmental parameters. Is hydrogel widely used in biomedical field? It can be used as materials for diagnosis, treatment and implantation. Diagnostic water gel mainly includes various catheter, enzyme immunoassay carriers, etc; In terms of treatment, it is mainly used as adsorbent coating, dialysis membrane, contact lenses, burn dressing, drug release carrier, etc. in hemoperfusion; Hydrogel implantation include intraocular lens, artificial cornea, soft tissue substitutes, etc.

It is prepared by hydrothermal synthesis of lime water and burnt clay, C3A and silica sd and lime water, glass state C2As lime water, volcanic ash and burnt clay and lime water. But pure is difficult to obtain. Is the birefringence weak? The average refractive index is 1.512, the crystal structure is pseudo hexagonal sheet, a=0.573nm. explanation_cn: 水冷反应堆用燃料元件或燃料组件。水堆分轻水堆和重水堆两类。压水堆（PWR)燃料组件和沸水堆（BWR)燃料组件是两种应用最广的轻水堆长棒束燃料元件。以低浓uo2烧结芯块为燃料芯体，在芯体两端各有一块A1203隔热块，以锆合金作为燃料棒包壳材料，包壳为自立型。棒内设有裂变气体储存腔和压紧弹簧.并预充一定压力的氦气；燃料棒按正方形或六角形排列，通过定位格架或栅格板定位；留冇燃料搾轴向膨胀空间。PWK燃料组件以分布在方阵栅格位置上的导向管为控制棒组件的导向构件.并以导向管连接上下管嘴及格架作为组件支撑燃料棒的刚性骨架.没有元件盒。BWR燃料组件以元件盒作为燃料棒的机械支撑，元件盒壁作为十字形控制棒的导向面.兼有控制组件冷却剂流量和防止蒸汽进入控制棒空间的功能》CANDU型燃料棒束是典型的压力管式重水堆燃料元件，以高密度天然U()2烧结芯块为燃料芯体.锆-4合金为包壳材料，管壁薄，属非自立型包壳，短棒束组件。燃料棒呈同心圆排列，棒的两端点焊同定在端部支撑板上，构成刚性部件：燃料棒之间的间隙由包壳管表面的钎焊垫块来保证，外圈燃料棒的外侧焊有垫块.用以保持棒束组件与工艺管壁之间的水流通道。
explanation_en: Fuel element or fuel assembly for water-cooled reactor. The water reactor is divided into light water reactor and heavy water reactor. Pressurized water reactor (PWR) fuel assembly and boiling water reactor (BWR) fuel assembly are the two most widely used light water reactor long rod bundle fuel element. The low concentration UO2 sintering pellet is used as the fuel core, and there is an A1203 heat insulation block at both ends of the core. The zirconium alloy is used as the fuel rod cladding materials, and the cladding is self-supporting. The rod is equipped with a fission gas storage chamber and a compression spring, and pre filled with helium gas at a certain pressure; The fuel rods are arranged in a square or hexagonal shape and positioned through a positioning grid or grid plate; Leave no space for axial expansion of the fuel press. PWK fuel assembly takes the guide tube distributed on the square grid as the guide member of control rod assembly, and uses the guide tube to connect the upper and lower nozzles and the grid as the rigid framework of the assembly to support the fuel rod. There is no element box. The BWR fuel assembly uses the element box as the mechanical support of the fuel rod, and the element box wall as the guide surface of the cross shaped control rod. It also has the function of controlling the coolant flow of the assembly and preventing steam from entering the control rod space. CANDU type fuel rod bundle is a typical fuel element of the pressure tube heavy water reactor, with high density natural U () 2 sintering pellets as the fuel core. zircaloy-4 as the materials of the cladding. The tube wall is thin, and it is a non self-supporting cladding, short rod bundle assembly. The fuel rods are arranged in concentric circles, and the sport welding at both ends of the rods are fixed on the end support plate to form a rigid part: the gap between the fuel rods is ensured by the soldering spacer on the surface of the cladding tube, and the outer side of the outer ring fuel rods is welded with a spacer to maintain the water flow channel between the rod bundle assembly and the process tube wall.

explanation_cn: 又称幕状层流冷却，是控制冷却应用的一种冷却方式。将数个上水幕集管布置在精轧机后输出辊道的上方1?=-2m高处，下水幕集管则布置在辊道辊间的下方。将上下水幕分为几组单独控制，通过改变水幕集管的流量、开启组数和辊道速度来实现对冷却速度和终止冷却温度的控制。水幕集管具有特殊的结构.管口为垂直于辊道的狹缝状且同排集管的狭缝相互基本连接.从上水幕流下的水流是幕状的，而下水幕集管出来的水流则是向上喷出的幕状.上集管水压一般为1-2kPa.下集管水压一般为10-20kPa。水幕集管按结构可分为开放式和封闭式两类，开放式集管上面与大气相通，封闭式集管是封闭的，与大气不通。水幕冷却与其他水冷却方式相比，冷却较均匀，冷却能力强，集管数及冷却带可根据需要安排，集管不容易阻塞，维修管理费用低。但集管加工要求高.控制技术比较复杂.耗水量较大。
explanation_en: Also known as episodic laminar cooling, it is a cooling method for controlled cooling applications. Arrange several water curtain headers above the output roller table after the finishing mill 1=- At a height of 2m, the water curtain header is arranged below the roller table roll room. Divide the upper and lower water curtains into several groups for separate control, and control the cooling speed and end cooling temperature by changing the flow rate, number of opening groups, and roller speed of the water curtain header. The water curtain header has a special structure. The nozzle is a slit perpendicular to the roller table and the slit in the same row of headers are basically connected with each other. The water flow from the upper water curtain is curtain shaped, while the water flow from the lower water curtain header is curtain shaped. The water pressure of the upper header is generally 1-2kPa. The water pressure of the lower header is generally 10-20kPa. The water curtain header can be divided into two types according to its structure: open and closed. The open header is connected to the atmosphere, while the closed header is closed and not connected to the atmosphere. Compared with other water cooling methods, curtain wall cooling has uniform cooling and strong cooling capacity. The number of headers and cooling belts can be arranged as required. The headers are not easy to block, and the maintenance and management costs are low. But the requirements for header processing are high, the control technology is relatively complex, and the water consumption is high.

explanation_cn: 水平央持材料试样一端，自由端暴露在规定气体的火焰上，通过测定线性燃烧速度来评价燃烧性能的试验方法。将受试材料制备成规定尺寸的矩形柱体试样，夹住试样一端，使长轴呈水平状态，横轴与水平方向呈45°角.如果材料为非自撑的.应采用专用的支撑夹具放置试样。在距试样自由端25mm和100mm处各划一条标线，使A由端暴露在规定火焰高度的点燃源上，并保证承受火焰深度为规定值。在不改变点火源位置的情况下，对试样施加火焰3S后移开点火源?根据燃烧施加时间和烧掉长度计算燃烧速度。适用于评定固体材料和表观密度大于250kg/m3的泡沫材料的燃烧性能。其结果可用于评价不同材料的燃烧特性，认证中本项也是必测项目。本试验方法是在规定的试验条件下进行的，不能用于评定在实际使用条件下着火的危险性.本性能只是众多燃烧性能之一，且对于那些没有点燃就收缩的材料不适用。
explanation_en: Test method for evaluating the combustion performance by measuring the linear combustion speed when one end of the materials sample is held horizontally and the free end is exposed to the flame of the specified gas. Prepare the tested materials into a rectangular cylinder sample of specified size, clamp one end of the sample so that the long axis is horizontal and the horizontal axis is 45 ° from the horizontal. If the materials is not self-supporting, use a special support fixture to place the sample. Draw a line at a distance of 25mm and 100mm from the free end of the sample, exposing A to the ignition source at the specified flame height, and ensuring that the flame depth is within the specified value. Without changing the position of the ignition source, apply flame to the sample for 3 seconds and then remove the ignition source? Calculate the combustion speed according to the combustion application time and burning length. It is applicable to evaluating the combustion performance of solid materials and foam materials with apparent density greater than 250kg/m3. The results can be used to evaluate the combustion characteristics of different materials, and this item is also a must test item in the certification. This test method is carried out under specified test conditions and cannot be used to assess the risk of ignition under actual service conditions. This property is only one of many combustion properties and is not applicable to materials that shrink without ignition.

explanation_cn: 以水作主要溶剂，其中有机溶剂低于15%的涂料品种。由于树脂水性化途径的不同，通常分为三类：①水溶性；②胶束分散型；③乳液。其特点：在湿表面和潮湿环境中可以直接涂覆施工，对材质表面适应性好，涂层附着力强；涂装工具可用水清洗，大大减少清洗溶剂的消耗。
explanation_en: Coatings with water as the main solvent and organic solvents less than 15%. Due to the different ways of waterborne resin, they are generally divided into three categories: ① water-soluble; ② Micelle dispersion; ③ Lotion. Its characteristics: It can be directly applied on wet surfaces and environments, with good adaptability to material surfaces and strong coating adhesion; Painting tools can be cleaned with water, greatly reducing the consumption of cleaning solvents.

explanation_cn: 水晶是一种透明的宝石和矿物，其化学名为二氧化硅（SiO2）。它在自然界中以各种不同形式存在，包括晶状石英、紫水晶、玫瑰石英等，这些变种在晶体结构和颜色上有所不同。

explanation_cn: 在水晶坐标轴某种方位上的切割方式。水晶的切型符号有两种：一种是按IRK标准规定的符号.包括晶体的直角坐标轴X、Y、Z,并用厚、长、宽来表示旋转轴的位置，即晶体片绕X轴旋转35°后的切割.它的法线方向为Y方向.另一种切型符号为水晶特有的习惯符号。
explanation_en: The cutting method in a certain direction of the crystal coordinate axis. There are two types of cutting symbols for crystal: one is the symbol specified in IRK standard, which includes the rectangular coordinate axes X, Y and Z of crystal, and uses thickness, length and width to indicate the position of the rotation axis, that is, the cutting of crystal sheet after rotating 35 ° around the X axis. Its normal direction is Y direction. The other type of cutting symbol is a custom symbol unique to crystal.
