explanation_cn: 水平布里渣曼法（Horizontal Bridgman）生长GaAs单晶的简称。它是GaAs单晶的主要品种，占据了GaAs单晶总量的60%到70%。其生长设备相对简单，包括一个带有三个或多个温区的水平炉、机械传动装置以及温度控制系统。在水平布里渣曼法中，高纯度As和盛有Ga的舟密封在石英反应管的两端。通过控制As端的温度（约610°C，此时As的蒸气压为0.1MPa），确保反应管内维持一定的As压力，而在高温区（1245°C至1260°C）中生长GaAs单晶，利用一定的温度梯度。在高温区与低温区之间通常还有一个或多个中间温区，有助于减小系统内的温度梯度并抑制硅（Si）的污染。相对于其他生长方法，水平布里渣曼法的单晶通常具有较低的位错密度，降低了0.5到1个数量级。通过这种方法生长的掺杂Si的水平GaAs的位错密度可以低于10^2 cm?2。在生长过程中，As压易于控制，单晶的化学成分控制性较好。此外，此法容易掺杂Fe、Si、Zn等杂质，适用于生长各种掺杂的GaAs和半绝缘单晶。
explanation_en: GaAs single crystal is grown by horizontal Bridgman method. It is the main variety of GaAs single crystal, accounting for 60% to 70% of the total amount of GaAs single crystal. The growth equipment is relatively simple, including a horizontal furnace with three or more temperature zones, mechanical transmission devices, and temperature control systems. In the horizontal Bridgman method, high-purity As and the boat containing Ga are sealed at both ends of the quartze reaction tube. By controlling the temperature at the As end (about 610 ° C, when the vapor pressure of As is 0.1MPa), a certain As pressure is maintained in the reaction tube. GaAs single crystal are grown in the high temperature region (1245 ° C to 1260 ° C), using a certain temperature gradient. There is usually one or more intermediate temperature zones between the high-temperature and low-temperature zones, which helps to reduce the temperature gradient within the system and suppress silicon (Si) pollution. Compared with other growth methods, the single crystal produced by horizontal Bridgman method usually has a lower dislocation density, which is 0.5 to 1 order of magnitude lower. The dislocation density of Si doped horizontal GaAs grown by this method can be lower than 10 ^ 2 cm ? 2。 In the growth process, As pressure is easy to control, and the chemical composition of single crystal is well controlled. In addition, this method is easily doped with Fe, Si, Zn and other impurities, and is suitable for growing various doped GaAs and semi insulating single crystal.

explanation_cn: 为防止有机电致发光器件被外界水氧侵蚀而使用的阻隔材料。LED器件对水氧阻隔材料要求较高。水氧阻隔材料一般是单层或多层致密的无机介电薄膜或者有机薄膜，无机材料如氧化铝、氮化硅(Si:iN.i)、二氧化硅（Si02)等，采用溅射、等离子体增强化学气相沉积或原子层沉积等方法制备；有机材料如聚丙烯酸酯、聚对二甲苯、聚脲、聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯等，采用闪蒸发-紫外固化、旋涂-固化等方法制备。水氧阻隔材料在柔性屏应用方面尤其重要，直接影响封装储存寿命。
explanation_en: Barrier materials used to prevent organic electroluminescent devices from being eroded by external water and oxygen. LED devices have high requirements for water oxygen barrier materials. Water oxygen barrier materials are generally single-layer or multi-layer dense inorganic dielectric films or organic films. Inorganic materials such as aluminum oxide, silicon nitride (Si: iN. i), silicon dioxide (SiO2), etc. are prepared by sputtering, plasma enhanced chemical vapor deposition or atomic layer deposition; Organic materials, such as polyacrylate, polyethylene terephthalate, polyurea, polyethylene terephthalate, etc., are prepared by flash evaporation UV curing, spin coating curing and other methods. Water oxygen barrier materials is particularly important in the application of flexible screen, which directly affects the storage life of packaging.

explanation_cn: 含水的简单配位型氯化物矿物。晶体呈短柱状；集合体呈粒状、P|?片状、纤维状。无色或白色.，玻璃光泽。断口不平坦状或贝壳状。莫氏硬度1-2，密度1.59-1.60g/cm3。具可塑性，极易变形，味辣而苦》产于现代和古代盐湖中，与光卤石、石盐、硬石膏、硫镁矾等共生。是提取镁和制取镁化合物的矿物原料。
explanation_en: A simple coordination type chloride mineral containing water. Crystal is short columnar; Aggregates are granular, P |? Flaky or fibrous. Colorless or white, Glass lustre. The fracture is uneven or shell like. Mohs hardness 1-2, density 1.59-1.60g/cm3. It is plastic, easy to deform, and tastes hot and bitter. It is produced in modern and ancient salt lakes, coexisting with camallite, halite, anhydrite, bisulfite, etc. It is a raw mineral material for extracting magnesium and preparing magnesium compounds.

explanation_cn: 粉状水硬性无机胶凝材料。加水搅拌后成浆体.能在空气中硬化或者在水中更好地硬化，并能把砂、石等材料牢固地胶结在一起。长期以来，它作为一种重要的胶凝材料，广泛应用于土木建筑、水利、国防等工程。
explanation_en: Powder hydraulic inorganic cementitious materials. It can harden in air or better in water, and can firmly cement sand, stone and other materials together. For a long time, as an important cementitious materials, it has been widely used in civil construction, water conservancy, national defense and other projects.

explanation_cn: 以桂酸盐水泥为基体，以耐碱玻璃纤维、通用合成纤维、各种陶瓷纤维、碳和芳纶等高性能纤维、金属丝以及天然植物和矿物纤维为增强体.加人填料、化学助剂和水经复合工艺构成的复合材料。水泥基复合材料比一般混凝土性能有所提高，性能随所用原材料、配比、工艺和养护条件而异。成型工艺主要有搅拌、喷射、挤出、缠绕和铺设等方法。成型后还需一定的养护过程使之不发生畸变和性能降低。水泥基复合材料基本上用于制造建筑构件，人们正试图将高性能纤维与树脂构成的复合材料替代传统的钢筋水泥并用于高层建筑的承重框架。
explanation_en: The composite materials is made of cinnamate cement as the matrix, alkali resistant glass fiber, general synthetic fiber, various ceramics fibers, carbon and aramid high performance fiher, metal wires, natural plant and mineral fibers as reinforcement, fillers, chemical additive and water through composition process. The performance of cement matrix composite is better than that of general concrete, and the performance varies with the raw materials used, ratio, process and curing conditions. The forming process mainly includes mixing, spraying, extrusion, winding, and laying methods. After forming, a certain curing process is required to prevent distortion and performance degradation. Cement matrix composite are basically used to manufacture building components. people are trying to replace the traditional steel cement and use composite materials composed of high performance fiher and resin for load-bearing frames of high-rise buildings.

explanation_cn: 即转帆石。在水泥石中以局部反应形成时，它的结晶压力可使水泥石（或混凝土）全部崩解，故称水泥杆菌。如海港码头混凝土柱被破坏，往往是海水中硫酸盐与硬化水泥石中的高碱性水化铝酸四钙反应生成钙矾石之故。它含有较多的结晶水.相应的体积比原来的水化铝酸钙增加2.5倍.因此对水泥石起极大的破坏作用。钙矾石的形成如控制得当，也可对水泥石强度增长有利。如由铝酸盐和氧化钙或氢氧化钙化合而成的含水盐类。
explanation_en: That is, turning the sail stone. When formed by local reaction in cement stone, its crystallization pressure can make cement stone (or concrete) completely disintegrate, so it is called cement bacillus. For example, the destruction of concrete columns at seaports is often due to the reaction of sulfate in seawater with highly alkaline tetracalcium aluminate hydrate in hardened cement stone to generate ettringite. It contains a large amount of crystalline water, which increases its volume by 2.5 times compared to the original hydrated calcium aluminate. Therefore, it has a great destructive effect on the cement paste. If the formation of ettringite is properly controlled, it can also be beneficial to the strength growth of cement stone. Aqueous salts formed by the combination of aluminates and calcium oxide or calcium hydroxide.

explanation_cn: 水淬矿渣主要指炼铁高炉排出的粒化炉渣，从炉中高温熔融状态流出后经水淬急冷而成的一种工业废渣，简称"高炉水渣"或"水渣"。它是一种具有很高潜在活性的玻璃体结构材料.其主要成分为Siü2及Ca?，可作为优质的水泥原料.可制成矿渣硅酸盐水泥、石膏矿渣水泥、石灰矿淹水泥、矿渣砖、矿渣混凝土等，
explanation_en: Water-granulated slag mainly refers to the granulated slag discharged from the ironmaking blast furnace, which flows out of the high-temperature melting state of the furnace and is quenched and quenched by water. It is called "blast furnace water slag" or "water slag" for short. It is a kind of vitreous structural materials with high potential activity. Its main components are Si ü 2 and Ca?, It can be used as high-quality cement raw materials and can be made into slag portland cement, gypsum slag cement, lime mine flooded cement, slag brick, slag concrete, etc,

explanation_cn: 易溶于水且易与树脂相容的丙烯酸树脂.水溶性是因聚合物中含有水溶性基团。其制法有两种：①使单体在有机溶剂中聚合，反应结束后蒸出溶剂，加碱类物质.使聚合物成水溶性；②单体在能与水相溶的溶剂如醇类、二氧六环等溶剂中进行聚合.反应结束后加碱类物质。水溶性丙烯酸树脂主要包括丙烯酸树脂乳液、丙烯酸树脂水分散体（亦称水可稀释丙烯酸）及丙烯酸树脂水溶液。树脂分子量介于乳液型树脂的高分子量和溶液型树脂的低分子量之间，广泛用于汽车、家具、铝制品、钢门窗框、建筑板材等方面的底漆，其漆面有耐久、耐化学品性及高光泽、优良的保色性。水溶性丙烯酸树脂的渗透力强，分子结构中的羧基可与皮革胶原蛋白分子链上的阳离子基团结合，也可以与铬鞣革中的铬盐结合产生很好的复鞣效果，是新型的合成树脂鞣剂。
explanation_en: Acrylic resin that is easily soluble in water and compatible with resin. Water solubility is due to the water soluble group contained in polymer. There are two preparation methods: ① polymerization the monomer in organic solvent, evaporate the solvent after the reaction, and add alkali substances to make the polymer water-soluble; ② The monomer is polymerization in water soluble solvents such as alcohols, dioxane, etc. After the reaction, alkali substances are added. Water-soluble acrylic resin mainly includes acrylic resin emulsion, acrylic resin aqueous dispersion (also called water dilutable acrylic acid) and acrylic resin aqueous solution. The molecular weight of resin is between the macromolecule of lotion resin and the low molecular weight of solution resin. It is widely used as primer for automobiles, furniture, aluminum products, steel door and window frames, building panels, etc. Its paint surface has durability, chemical resistance, high gloss and excellent color retention. Water-soluble acrylic resin has strong penetration. The carboxyl group in the molecular structure can combine with the cationic group on the molecular chain of leather collagen, and can also combine with the chromium salt in chrome tanned leather to produce good retanning effect. It is a new type of synthetic resin tanning agent.

explanation_cn: 指能溶于水的纤维。如聚乙烯醇纤维、海藻纤维和羧甲基纤维素纤维等。通过调整聚乙烯醇的脱乙酰率，可以得到水溶温度不同的水溶性纤维，当脱乙酰率为86%时，采用有机溶剂法?可以得到在冰水中溶解的纤维；海藻酸钠纺丝原液在氯化钙溶液中挤出和凝间?再经过拉伸和洗涤、烘干，得到海藻纤维，能在80°C以上热水中溶解。水溶性纤维与羊毛等交织?经溶解处理后，可得薄型的凹凸形毛织物?与麻纤维等混纺以后再经溶解处理，可制成高支麻纱，此外水溶性纤维在医疗卫生、军事、植物栽培杯、食品工业等领域也有广泛应用。
explanation_en: Refers to fibers that are soluble in water. Such as polyvinyl alcohol fiber, alginmefiber and carboxymethyl cellulose fiber. By adjusting the deacetylation rate of polyvinyl alcohol, water soluble fiber with different water soluble temperatures can be obtained. When the deacetylation rate is 86%, the organic solvent method is used to prepare the fiber with different water soluble temperatures? Fibers that dissolve in ice water can be obtained; Extrusion and coagulation of sodium alginate spinning solution in calcium chloride solution? After stretching, washing and drying, alginmefiber is obtained, which can be dissolved in hot water above 80 ° C. Is water soluble fiber interwoven with wool, etc? After dissolution treatment, a thin concave convex shaped wool fabric can be obtained? It can be blended with hemp fiber and then dissolved to make high count hemp yarn. In addition, water soluble fiber is also widely used in medical and health, military, plant cultivation cup, food industry and other fields.

explanation_cn: 指在水中可溶解的一类高分子物质。如天然高分子有明胶、阿拉伯树胶、淀粉和多糖等；半合成高分子有纤维素醚类.如竣甲基纤维素、甲基或乙基纤维素、羟乙基纤维素及淀粉和明胶等天然物的变性衍生物等。合成的水溶性高分子有：聚乙烯醇、聚环氧乙烷、聚丙烯酰胺类、聚丙烯酸类、聚丙烯酸等。含有离子性基团的水溶性高分子叫聚电解质。如聚乙烯磺酸、聚丙烯酸等，可制成代用血浆。聚环氧乙烷可以制成水溶性嵌段或接枝共聚物。在中性洗涤剂和非离子型表面活性剂等的合成上应用。水溶性高分子在医药、选矿、纺织、化妆品、造纸和污水处理中广泛应用，可作增稠剂、乳化剂、土壤调节剂、水溶性黏合剂、水溶性涂料的增黏剂、化妆品的添加剂和纤维改良剂等。水溶性高分子经交联可成为药物缓释用的水凝胶和离子变换树脂等。
explanation_en: It refers to a class of macromolecule substances that can be dissolved in water. For example, natural polymer include gelatin, gum arabic, starch and polysaccharide, etc; Semi synthetic macromolecule include cellulose ethers, such as modified derivatives of natural substances such as ethyl cellulose, methyl or thyl cellulose, hydroxyethyl cellulose, starch and gelatin. The synthetic water soluble polymer include polyvinyl alcohol, polyethylene oxide, polyacrylamide, polypropylene acid, polypropylene acid, etc. The water soluble polymer containing ionic groups is called polyelectrolyte. For example, polyethylene sulfonic acid and polyacrylic acid can be made into substitute plasma. Polyethylene oxide can be made into water-soluble block or graft copolymer. Applied in the synthesis of neutral detergents and non ionic surfactants. Water soluble polymer is widely used in medicine, mineral processing, textile, cosmetics, paper making and sewage treatment, and can be used as thickener, emulsifier, soil conditioner, water soluble adhesive, tackifier of water soluble coatings, additive of cosmetics, fiber modifier, etc. After crosslinking, water-soluble polymers can become hydrogel and ion exchange resin for drug sustained release.

explanation_cn: 基本原理是将作为溶剂的水不断地蒸发移出，以保持溶液处于过饱和状态，使晶体生长具有足够的驱动力，并用控制蒸发量的多少来控制饱和度的大小、主要装置有自控加热器、转晶电动机、冷凝回收溶剂装置等。优点是生长时可以保持恒温，得到的晶体成分均匀，特别有利于掺杂晶体的生长。缺点是将大量腐蚀溶剂排人于大气，溶剂的蒸发速率较准控制，通常会在熔体表面发生成核，因为由于溶剂损失产生了局部的高过饱和度，并常出现晶体的交互生长。只有当结晶发生在坩埚底部时，才可能生长出质量非常好的晶体。蒸发法在工业生产中运用广泛。
explanation_en: The basic principle is to continuously evaporate the water as solvent to keep the solution in supersaturated state, so that crystal growth has sufficient driving force, and control the saturation by controlling the amount of evaporation. The main devices are automatic heater, crystal converter motor, cold condensation solvent recovery device, etc. The advantage is that the constant temperature can be maintained during the growth, and the crystal composition obtained is uniform, which is particularly conducive to the growth of doped crystal. The disadvantage is that a large number of corrosion solvents are discharged into the atmosphere, and the evaporation rate of the solvent is controlled accurately. Nucleation usually occurs on the surface of the melt, because local high supersaUiration degree occurs due to the loss of solvent, and crystal interactive growth often occurs. Only when crystallization takes place at the bottom of the crucible can very good crystal be grown. The evaporation method is widely used in industrial production.

explanation_cn: 又称桂酸钠。俗称泡花碱。无色、青绿色或棕色黏稠液体。常用作耐酸、耐热砂浆和混凝土的胶凝材料.也可用作防水剂等
explanation_en: Also known as sodium cinnamate. Commonly known as Paohua Alkali. Colorless, turquoise or brown viscous liquid. It is commonly used as cementitious materials for acid resistant, heat resistant mortar and concrete. It can also be used as waterproof agent, etc

explanation_cn: 以瓷石或瓷石加高岭土配制烧成的瓷器。这种瓷是利用瓷石中所含云母类矿物的特性及其熔融后形成高黏度玻璃的性质.并利用其本身已经含有石英的特点，在一定温度范围内烧后成瓷。中国浙江、江西、福建、江苏、安徽都蕴藏大量瓷石矿。瓷石是由流纹岩、石英粗面岩、长英岩等长石类矿物受火山的长期热液作用而生成的。其中的长石转化成水白云母和绢云母。这两种云母类矿物的K2()含量都很高，在高温下和长石相似，起熔剂作用。如果风化程度较浅，瓷石中除石英、云母类矿物外.还含有残余长石矿物.这类瓷石中加入釉灰（石灰石和草木的锻烧物）即可制釉。如果风化程度较深，部分云母类矿物会进一步转化成高岭族矿物，这类瓷石可用于制坯。瓷石经粉碎和淘洗后，不但含有瓷坯所需要的各种成分，而且还有良好的可塑性。瓷石还含有铁、钛、钙、钠等成分。其中钠含量较高的瓷石在景德镇称为釉果，是用于配釉的主要原料。中国在元代以前，有些窑场单用瓷石就能配胎。元代以后.为了提高瓷质.采用瓷石加高岭土配胎。水白云质瓷的显微结构由晶相、玻璃相和气孔组成，瓷胎吸水率接近干零，强度高。
explanation_en: Porcelain made from china stone or china stone and kaolin. This kind of porcelain takes advantage of the characteristics of mica minerals contained in china stone and the nature of forming high viscosity glass after melting, and uses its own characteristics of containing quartze to form porcelain after burning within a certain temperature range. China's Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian, Jiangsu and Anhui all contain a large number of china stone deposits. China stone is formed by feldspar minerals such as rhyolite, quartze trachyte and felsic rock under long-term volcanic hydrothermal action. The feldspar is transformed into water muscovilte and seridte. These two mica minerals have high K2() content, which are similar to feldspar at high temperature and act as fluxes. If the weathering degree is relatively shallow, china stone contains residual feldspar minerals in addition to quartze and mica minerals. This kind of china stone can be made into glaze by adding glaze ash (calcined products of limestone and plants). If the weathering degree is deep, some mica minerals will be further transformed into kaolin minerals, which can be used for making body. After being crushed and elutriated, the porcelain stone not only contains various components required by the porcelain body, but also has good plasticity. China stone also contains iron, titanium, calcium, sodium and other ingredients. Among them, china stone with high sodium content is called glaze fruit in Jingdezhen, and is the main raw material for preparing glaze. Before the Yuan Dynasty in China, some kilns could be matched with china stone alone. After the Yuan Dynasty, in order to improve the quality of porcelain, china stone and kaolin were used to match the body. The microstructure of hydromicaceous porcelain is composed of crystal phase, glass phase and pores. The water absorption of porcelain body is close to dry zero, and the strength is high.

explanation_cn: 水分子随着质子从阳极迁移到阴极的过程。对于使用甲醇为燃料的质子交换膜燃料电池.甲醇分子也会随着质子一同迁移
explanation_en: The process of water molecules migrating from the anode to the cathode with protons. For the proton exchange membrane fuel cell using methanol as fuel, methanol molecules will also migrate with the proton

explanation_cn: 含水的简单岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。晶体呈板状；集合体呈皮壳状或粉末状。白色.常染成黄色、灰色.玻璃光泽。莫氏硬度1-1.5,密度2.55g/cm3.易溶于水。产于干枯碱湖表面或一些干燥土壤和火山喷气升华物里。是制碱工业的矿物原料。
explanation_en: A carbonate mineral with a simple island like structure that contains water. The crystal is tabular; The aggregate is in the form of a shell or powder. White, often dyed yellow, gray, glass luster. Mohs hardness 1-1.5, density 2.55g/cm3. Easily soluble in water. Produced on the surface of dry alkali lakes or in some dry soil and volcanic eruptions. It is the raw mineral material of the soda industry.

explanation_cn: 这是一种由氧化剂水溶液、可燃剂（非敏化型可燃剂）、敏化剂）、胶凝剂和其他添加剂组成的混合炸药。其本质仍然于浆状炸药，主要特点是使用有机胺硝酸盐（硝酸甲胺）为敏化剂。硝酸甲胺与硝酸铵、硝酸钠混合.发生作用.使得析晶点显著降低.形成微细液珠，提高了凝胶的分散性，胶体稳定性大大增加并且提高了药卷的起爆感度和降低了爆轰的临界直径，从而可制成小直径的雷管敏感的药卷。其制造工艺勻浆状炸药基本相似。具体性质可见浆状炸药。
explanation_en: This is a composite explosive composed of oxidizer aqueous solution, combustible (non sensitized combustible), sensitizer, gelling agent and other additive. Its essence is still slurry explosive, and its main feature is to use organic amine nitrate (methylamine nitrate) as sensitizer. When methylamine nitrate is mixed with ammonium nitrate and sodium nitrate, the crystallization point is significantly reduced and micro droplets are formed, which improves the dispersibility of gel, colloid stability, sensitivity to initiation and critical diameter of detonation are greatly increased and reduced, thus making detonator sensitive coils with small diameter. The manufacturing process of homogenous explosive is basically similar. The specific properties can be seen in slurry explosive.

explanation_cn: 水锆石（Hydrozircon）是一种矿物，属于锆石矿物的一种变种。它的名称暗示了与水有关的特性，因为它通常含有水分子。水锆石的化学式通常表示为ZrSiO4·nH2O，其中n代表不同数量的水分子。
explanation_en: Malacon hydrozircon is a mineral, which belongs to a variety of zircon mineral. Its name implies properties related to water, as it typically contains water molecules. The chemical formula of malacon hydrozircon is usually expressed as ZrSiO4 · nH2O, where n represents different numbers of water molecules.

explanation_cn: 简单层状结构氢氧化物矿物。化学式为Mg(OH)2。Fe、Mn、Zn能以类质同象置换Mg。三方晶系，空间群DirP3m。晶体呈板状或叶片状，常呈板状、细鱗片状或浑圆状，集合体呈不规则粒状、纤维状。白色、灰白色.有时呈绿色、黄色或褐红色。条痕白色。新鲜晶面和断口上呈玻璃光泽，解理面呈珍珠光泽，纤维状者呈丝绢光泽。透明。莫氏硬度2.5,密度2.3-2.6g/cm3。细片具挠性及柔性。具热电性。纤维粗而脆.无弹性及挠性.易折断.劈分性好。为碱性溶液对镁质硅酸盐作用后的次生变化产物。常见于蛇纹岩的裂隙中或蛇纹石化纯橄榄岩的裂隙中。也产于接触变质菱镁矿石灰岩中.与方解石、透闪石、蛇纹石、金云母等共生。大量聚集时.用作提取镁的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Simple layered structure of hydroxide minerals. The chemical formula is Mg (OH) 2. Fe, Mn, and Zn can replace Mg with isomorphism. Trilateral system, space group DirP3m. Crystal are tabular or leaf shaped, often tabular, scaly or round, and aggregates are irregular granular or fibrous. White, grayish white. Sometimes appearing in green, yellow, or brownish red. Stripe white. The fresh crystal plane and fracture surface are glass luster, the cleavage surface is pearly luster, and the fibrous surface is silk luster. Transparent. Mohs hardness 2.5, density 2.3-2.6g/cm3. Fine pieces have flexibility and flexibility. It has thermoelectric properties. The fiber is coarse and brittle, without elasticity and flexibility, easy to break and good splitting performance. The product of secondary transformation after the action of alkaline solution on magnesium silicate. It is commonly found in the fissures of serpentinite or serpentinized pure peridmite. It also occurs in contact metamorphic magnesite limestone and coexists with caldte, tremolite, serpentine, phlogopite, etc. It is used as raw mineral material for extracting magnesium in large amount.

explanation_cn: 用高压水分散金属液流并冷却凝固获得粉末的方法。这种方法生产的粉末表面粗糙?形状不规则，粒径在75-200pm之间。如雾化铁粉、不锈钢粉等。
explanation_en: A method for obtaining powder by dispersing metal liquid flow with high-pressure water and cooling and solidification. Is the surface of powder produced by this method rough? Irregular shape, particle size between 75-200pm. Such as atomized iron powder, stainless steel powder, etc.

explanation_cn: 如果在发光材料中加入一定量的放射性物质，在放射性物质蜕变过程中不断放出带电或不带电的粒子激发下长时间地均匀地发光。这种发光不需要再外加能源，就可持续不断地发光。发光时间的长短取决于所加放射性同位素的半衰期。这种发光材料被称为永久性发光材料。在发现人工放射性同位素之前，作为永久性发光材料的激活源是天然放射性镭和新钍盐的制剂。它们有严重的缺点：放射性射线辐射对生物体有强烈的破坏作用和严重的环境污染;X粒子的电离作用强，造成发光材料基质的破坏，使发光亮度很快下降;而且天然放射性同位素价格昂贵，不便大量推广使用。永久性发光材料主要用来涂覆航空、航海仪器、仪表、武器的瞄准器具、标尺、望远镜等。
explanation_en: If a certain amount of radioactive material is added to the luminescence materials, it will continuously emit charged or uncharged particles in the process of radioactive material transformation to excite luminescence uniformly for a long time. This kind of luminescence does not need additional energy, and can continuously luminescence. The length of luminescence time depends on the half life of the radioisotope added. This luminescence materials is called permanence luminescent materials. Before the discovery of artificial radioisotope, natural radioactive radium and new thorium salt were the activation sources of permanence luminescent materials. They have serious drawbacks: radioactive radiation has a strong destructive effect on organisms and serious environmental pollution; The strong ionization of X particles causes the destruction of the luminescence materials matrix and the rapid decline of luminescence brightness; Moreover, natural radioisotope are too expensive to be widely used. Permanence luminescent materials are mainly used to coat aviation and navigation instruments, instruments, aiming devices, rulers, telescopes, etc. of weapons.

explanation_cn: 典型的永磁材料包括永磁铁氧体、铝镍钻以及稀土永磁材料。一般情况下，永磁材料的密度较高，脆而硬，不易加工成复杂的形状。但是，制成高聚物基或软金属基复合材料后，上述难加工的缺点可得到克服。永磁复合材料的功能组元是磁性粉末，高聚物和软金属起到黏结剂的作用。其中，高聚物使用较为普遍，常用的有环氧树脂、尼龙和橡胶等材料。
explanation_en: Typical permanent magnet material include permanent magnetic ferrite, aluminum nickel drill and the rare earth permanent magnetic material. Generally, permanent magnet material have high density, are brittle and hard, and are not easy to process into complex shapes. However, after being made into high polymer based or soft metal based composite materials, the above difficult machining shortcomings can be overcome. The functional component of permanent magnetic composite materials is magnetic powder, and polymers and soft metals act as binders. Among them, polymers are commonly used, such as epoxy resin, nylon resin, rubber and other materials.

explanation_cn: 是指材料被外磁场磁化后，去掉外磁场仍然保持着较强的剩磁的磁性材料。这类材料的剩余磁感应强度在周围空间产生磁场。具有高的剩余磁感应强度和矫顽力。常用的有铝镍钴系永磁合金、铁铬钴系永磁合金、永磁铁氧体、稀土和复合永磁材料等。
explanation_en: It refers to the magnetic materials that is magnetize by the external magnetic field and still maintains strong remanence after removing the external magnetic field. The residual magnetic induction intensity of this kind of materials generates a magnetic field in the surrounding space. It has high residual magnetic induction and coercive force. The commonly used permanent magnet alloy are Al Ni Co, Fe Cr Co permanent magnet alloy, permanent magnetic ferrite, rare earth and composite permanent-magnetic material.

explanation_cn: 见硬磁铁氧体。
explanation_en: See hard magnetic ferrite.

explanation_cn: 一种天然白色细粒大理石。质地均匀且坚硬，白度高，是上等的石雕和建筑装饰材料。主要产于我国北京房山、河北曲阳、安徽 凤阳等地。常用大理石来装饰墙壁、制作桌面及文具 和工艺品。北京故宫主要大殿台基周围的栏杆、颐和园中大型建筑和天门广场的华表以及人民英雄纪念碑 的浮雕都使用了汉白玉石。
explanation_en: A natural white fine-grained marble. It is uniform and hard, with high whiteness, and is a superior materials for stone carving and architectural decoration. Mainly produced in Fangshan, Beijing, Quyang, Hebei, Fengyang, Anhui and other places in China. Marble is commonly used to decorate walls, make tabletops, stationery, and handicrafts. White marble is used in the railings around the foundation of the main hall of the Forbidden City in Beijing, the large and medium-sized buildings in the Summer Palace, the ornamental column in Tianmen Square, and the reliefs of the Monument to the People's Heroes.

explanation_cn: 汝窑是宋代"五大名窑"之一，窑址在今河南省宝丰县清凉寺，宋时属汝州，故名。以青瓷闻名，釉色有天青、天蓝、淡粉、粉青、月白等，釉层薄而莹润，釉泡大而稀疏，有"寥若晨星"之称。其工艺精湛，造型秀美，釉面蕴润，高雅素净的丰韵而独具风采，在我国青瓷发展史上，是一个划时代的重要标志。汝窑瓷胎质细腻，胎土中含有微量铜，迎光照看，微见红色，胎色灰中略带着黄色，俗称"香灰胎"。汝窑兴盛前后只有二十年，由于烧造时间短暂?传世品亦不多见，流传到至今的真品，已知的仅67件，弥足珍贵^
explanation_en: Ru Kiln was one of the "Five Famous Kilns" of the Song Dynasty, located at Qingliang Temple in present-day Baofeng County, Henan Province. During the Song Dynasty, it belonged to Ruzhou, hence its name. It is famous for celadon. The glaze colors include azure, azure, light powder, pink green, and moon white. The glaze layer is thin and shiny, and the glaze bubble is large and sparse, so it is known as "rare as morning stars". Its exquisite craftsmanship, beautiful molding, moist glaze, elegant and pure charm and unique style are an important landmark in the development history of celadon in China. The Ru kiln porcelain body is delicate in texture, and the body soil contains trace amounts of copper. When exposed to light, it shows a slight red color with a slight yellow tinge in the gray, commonly known as the "fragrant gray body". Before and after the prosperity of Ru Kiln, it only lasted for twenty years, due to its short firing time? It is also rare to see heirlooms, and only 67 of the authentic items that have been passed down to this day are known, which are extremely precious^

explanation_cn: 汞系高温超导体家族的简称，也是目前所发现的超导转变温度最高的超导体，在常压下HgBaCaCuO超导转变温度T,可以达到135K.高压下可以达到165K。但是由于汞具有毒性.这种超导体没有实用价值。
explanation_en: The abbreviation of mercury high-temperature superconductor family is also the superconductor with the highest superconducting transition temperature found at present. The superconducting transition temperature of HgBaCaCuO can reach 135K under normal pressure and 165K under high pressure. However, due to the toxicity of mercury, this type of superconductor has no practical value.

explanation_cn: 摩擦系统受到大气及润滑剂中存在的磨粒污染引起的不正常磨损。在密封不严、环境不洁净和润滑系统过滤不严格以至不能及时排除磨损产物时，一些硬质粒子如尘埃、化学气氛、金属及其氧化物甚至水蒸气将参与摩擦过程。硬质颗粒会导致磨粒磨损或在接触表面留下压痕使之成为表面疲劳的裂纹源.某些污染物会改变摩擦表面的状态.促进或减小黏着的发生.这些都会给磨损带来影响。为减少污染对磨损的影响，必须对润滑剂进行过滤国际标准化组织对粒子污染润滑油的程度有严格的规定.以便于机械设计人员在确定过滤系统时作为依据。
explanation_en: The friction system is subject to abnormal wear caused by air and abrasive particles in lubricant. When the sealing is not tight, the environment is not clean, and the lubrication system filtration is not strict enough to eliminate wear products in time, some hard particles such as dust, chemical atmosphere, metals and their oxides, and even water vapor will participate in the friction process. Hard particles can cause abrasive wear or leave indentation on the contact surface, making it a source of surface fatigue cracks. Some pollutants can change the state of the friction surface, promote or reduce the occurrence of adhesion, which will affect wear. In order to reduce the impact of pollution on wear, the lubricant must be filtered. The International Organization for Standardization has strict regulations on the degree of particle pollution of lubricating oil, so that mechanical designers can use them as a basis when determining the filtering system.

explanation_cn: 见污泥调理剂。
explanation_en: See sludge conditioning agent.

explanation_cn: 当直流电流通过一段有温差的均匀金属或半导体时，除焦耳热外还会释放或吸收热量；反之，当一根金属棒的两端温度不同时，其两端会形成电势差的热电现象。汤姆逊热量Q=r/AT，式中，r为汤姆逊系数，V/K;J为电流，A。对于金属或N型半导体?当电流由高温流向低温端时.材料释放热量.r为正；反之为负。对于P型半导体，情况相反。r可由材料的塞贝克系数《导出r=了g.称开尔文第二关系式（thesecondkelvin'srelationship)。与拍耳帖效应相比，汤姆逊效应一般很小.常忽略不计。汤姆逊效应、塞贝克效应、珀耳帖效应是材料的=个不同而又相互关联的热电效应，它们都是可逆的。
explanation_en: When direct current passes through a uniform metal or semiconductor with a temperature difference, in addition to Joule heat, it also releases or absorbs heat; On the contrary, when the temperature at both ends of a metal rod is different, a thermoelectric phenomenon of potential difference will form at both ends. Thomson heat Q=r/AT, where r is the Thomson coefficient, V/K; J is the current, A. For metal or N-type semiconductors? When the current flows from high temperature to low temperature, the heat released by materials. r is positive; On the contrary, it is negative. For P-type semiconductors, the situation is the opposite. R can be derived from the Seebeck coefficient of materials, which is called the the second Kelvins relationship. Compared with the Peltier effect, the Thomson effect is generally small and often ignored. The Thomson effect, Seebeck effect, and Peltier effect are different but related thermoelectric effect of materials, and they are reversible.

name_cn: 汽油车尾气催化净化材料
name_en: gasoline vehicle exhaust catalytic purification materials
explanation_cn: 汽油尾气主要有CO、HC和NOx三种有害成分。汽油车尾气催化净化材料主要由载体、扩表涂层和活性组分三部分组成，可使将汽车尾气中CO和HC氧化成二氧化碳和水，NOr还原成氮气的材料。活性组分主要有贵金属催化材料、稀土复合氧化物催化材料、普通金属氧化物催化材料、助催化材料和稳定剂。铂、钯、铑等贵金属催化材料-具有很高的催化剂转化率，但其价格昂贵，对发动机空燃比要求严，易发生铅、硫、磷中毒-导致催化剂失效等问题；纳米级稀土材料铈及镧的氧化物等稀土复合氧化物催化材料可大幅提高金属催化剂的抗毒性能、高温稳定性；C'uO、Ti(>2、ZrO2、NiO2等普通金属氧化物催化材料-主要作为复合氧化物催化材料使用；CeO2、La2O2等稀土氧化物作为助催化材料"f显著提高贵金属催化材料的活德;另外ZrO2、C:aO、ThQ2、Si羅:、BaO等都可充当稳定剂，尤KSiO2和BaO对7-Al2O3有双重稳定作用，组织相变并抑制烧结。
explanation_en: Gasoline exhaust mainly consists of three harmful components: CO, HC, and NOx. Gasoline vehicle exhaust catalytic purification materials is mainly composed of carrier, surface expansion coating and active components, which can oxidize CO and HC in vehicle exhaust into carbon dioxide and water, and reduce NOR into nitrogen materials. The active components mainly include noble metal catalytic materials, rare earth composition oxide catalytic materials, common metal oxide catalytic materials, co catalytic materials and stabilizer. Precious metal catalytic materials such as platinum, palladium and rhodium have high catalyst conversion rate, but they are expensive, have strict requirements on the air-fuel ratio of the engine, and are prone to lead, sulfur and phosphorus poisoning, leading to catalyst failure and other problems; Nanometer sized rare earth materials, such as cerium and lanthanum oxides, and other rare earth composition oxide catalytic materials can significantly improve the toxicity resistance and high-temperature stability of metal catalysts; Common metal oxide catalytic materials such as C'uO, Ti (>2, ZrO2, NiO2) - mainly used as composite oxide catalytic materials; rare earth oxides such as CeO2, La2O2, etc. used as co catalytic materials "f significantly improve the activity of precious metal catalytic materials; in addition, ZrO2, C: aO, ThQ2, Siro:, BaO, etc. can act as stabilizer, especially KSiO2 and BaO have dual stabilizing effects on 7-Al2O3, organize phase transformation and inhibit sintering.

explanation_cn: 过饱和同溶体在热激活足够的条件下析出过饱和的组元（溶质），往往不以纯组元的形式析出，而多数是以富含溶质的化合物（中间相）或另一固溶体的形式析出，称为沉淀。沉淀分为连续沉淀与不连续沉淀两类。
explanation_en: The supersaturated components (solutes) precipitated from the supersaturated same solution under the condition of sufficient thermal activation are often not precipitated in the form of pure components, but mostly precipitated in the form of solute rich compounds (intermediate phase) or another solid solution, which is called precipitation. Precipitation is divided into continuous precipitation and non continuous precipitation.

explanation_cn: 见高分子分级。
explanation_en: See fractionation.

explanation_cn: 通过加入沉淀硬化元素如铝、铜、钛、铌并经沉淀硬化处理，从钢的基体固溶体中析出沉淀硬化相产生沉淀硬化作用，而获得高强度、高韧性、高耐蚀性的不锈钢（600系）。根据基体组织可分为：马氏体沉淀硬化不锈钢、半奥氏体沉淀硬化不锈钢、奥氏体沉淀硬化不锈钢。由于具有高I强度、高韧性、高耐蚀性、髙抗氧化性和良好的成型性、焊接性，广泛应用于航空航天、国防军工、核电、能源、石油化工等工业部门。
explanation_en: By adding precipitation hardening elements such as aluminum, copper, titanium, niobium and undergoing precipitation hardening treatment, precipitation hardening phase is precipitated from the matrix solid solution of steel to produce precipitation hardening effect, and stainless steel (600 series) with high strength, high toughness and high corrosion resistance is obtained. According to the matrix structure, it can be divided into martensitic precipitation hardening stainless steel, semi-austenitic precipitation hardening stainless steel and austenitic precipitation hardening stainless steel. Due to its high strength, high toughness, high corrosion resistance, high oxidation resistance, good formability and weldability, it is widely used in aerospace, defense and military industry, nuclear power, energy, petrochemical and other industrial sectors.

explanation_cn: 由溶液通过化学液相沉淀而制成的粉末。化学液相沉淀法是物理化学法的一种，沉淀粉根据具体生产方法的不同，还可分为I置换沉淀粉、氢还原沉淀粉、熔盐沉淀粉等。沉淀粉的原材料通常为金属盐溶液或金属熔盐，常见的有Cu、Ag盐溶液和Zr、Be熔盐等。
explanation_en: Powder made from solution through chemical liquid phase precipitation. Chemical liquid phase precipitation method is a kind of physical chemistry method. According to the different production methods, precipitated powder can also be divided into I replacement precipitated powder, hydrogen reduction precipitated powder, molten salt precipitated powder, etc. The raw materials of precipitated powder are usually metal salt solutions or molten metal salts, such as Cu, Ag salt solutions and Zr, Be molten salts.

explanation_cn: 聚合物不溶于反应介质中，聚合物生成后从反应介质中沉淀出i来的聚合反应。对于本体聚合体系，生成的聚合物由于不溶于其单体中，从而析出。如氯乙烯本体聚合法、丙烯腈本体聚合法都会因生成的聚氯乙烯和聚丙I烯腈不溶于其单体中而沉析出来。用该法聚合产物后处理简单，同时由于体系黏度不大，可以有效地控制反应温度。
explanation_en: The polymer is insoluble in the reaction medium, and the polymer is precipitation from the reaction medium after being formed, which is a polymerization reaction. For the bulk polymerization system, the generated polymer is precipitated because it is insoluble in its monomer. For example, both vinyl chloride bulk polymerization and acrylonitrile bulk polymerization will precipitate out because the generated polyvinyl chloride and polyacrylonitrile are insoluble in their monomer. The post-treatment of polymerization products by this method is simple, and because the viscosity of the system is not large, the reaction temperature can be effectively controlled.

explanation_cn: 又称直接脱氧，往钢液中加入块状锰铁、硅铁、硅锰合金或铝等脱氧剂或复合脱氧剂，使之与钢中的氧结合，生成脱氧产物，与钢液分离，上浮进入炉渣，从而达到降低钢中氧含量的目的。
explanation_en: Also known as direct deoxygenation, deoxidizer or composition deoxidizer such as block ferromanganese, ferrosilicon, silicon manganese alloy or aluminum is added into the steel liquid to combine it with the oxygen in steel to generate deoxidation products, which are separated from the steel liquid and floated up into slag, so as to reduce the oxygen content in steel.

explanation_cn: 又称水成岩。是由成层沉积的松散沉积物同结而成的岩石。沉积岩种类繁多，形成方式多样。其中的碎屑岩（砾岩、砂岩、粉砂岩）是由古老岩石经机械破碎作用形成的碎屑，经搬运并沉积下来形成的。化学岩（岩盐和石膏）是从溶液中沉积形成的。生物化学岩（某些石灰岩）是由动物及植物的遗体或分泌物经生物化学作用形成的。地球上许多重要矿产如能源、非金属、金属和稀有元素矿产，包括化石群等都赋存在沉积岩中。
explanation_en: It is also called aqueous rock. It is a rock formed by layering of loose sediments. Sedimentary rock have various types and forms. Among them, clastic rocks (conglomerate, sandstone, siltstone) are fragments formed by mechanical crushing of ancient rock, transported and deposited. Chemical rock (halite and gypsum) are formed by deposition from solution. Biochemigenic rock (some limestone) is formed by biochemical action of animal and plant remains or secretions. Many important minerals on the earth, such as energy, non-metal, metal and rare element minerals, including fossil groups, are hosted in sedimentary rock.

explanation_cn: 一种以硅质作为胶结物的砂岩。硅质胶结物全部发生了重结晶，有时在原来石英颗粒的周边形成次生加大边。石英含量一般在98%以上，不含或含有很少的黏土和其他矿物杂质。化学成分较稳定。碎屑颗粒与胶结物界线模糊，颗粒间隙很少，岩石坚硬?抗风化能力很强。人工加工破碎成不同粒级的石英砂，使用价值与天然石英砂相同。
explanation_en: A type of sandstone with siliceous material as cement. All siliceous cements recrystallized, sometimes forming secondary enlarged edges around the original quartze particles. The content of quartze is generally more than 98%, without or with little clay and other mineral impurities. The chemical composition is relatively stable. The boundary between detrital particles and cement is fuzzy, the particle gap is few, and rock is hard? Strong resistance to weathering. The quartz sand with different particle sizes is broken by manual processing, and its use value is the same as that of natural quartz sand.

explanation_cn: 沉降法是指粒度分析(settlinganalysis)通过检测物料颗粒在介质中的沉降速度进行物料粒度分析，确定其粒度组成的技术。此法用于检测粒度小于74拜m的微细粒物料的粒度组成。原理微细粒固体颗粒在流体介质中的自由沉降末速二。与其粒度直径d，的平方成正比，因此可以通过测定颗粒的沉降末速来确定其粒度。但是，沉降末速v。同时还与颗粒的有效密度(乃一川成正比，其中Ps和p分别为颗粒的密度和流体的密度，且受颗粒形状的影响。粒度不同、密度各异的颗粒可具有相同的沉降末速。因此，当按沉降速度分析物料的粒度时，测得的是具有等沉降末速的颗粒粒度，称为水力粒度或等沉降速度粒度，而非其真实粒度，为此在粒度分析结果中应标明物料的密度。
explanation_en: Sedimentation method refers to the technology of determining the particle size composition by detecting the settling speed of material particles in the medium. This method is used to detect the particle size composition of fine-grained materials with a particle size less than 74 μ m. The principle is the free settling velocity of fine solid particles in a fluid medium. It is directly proportional to the square of its particle size diameter d, so its particle size can be determined by measuring the settling velocity of the particles. However, the final settling velocity v. It is also related to the effective density of particles (It is proportional to each other, where Ps and p are the density of particles and the density of fluids, respectively, and are affected by the shape of particles. Particles with different particle sizes and density can have the same final settling velocity. Therefore, when analyzing the particle size of materials according to the settling velocity, the particle size with the same final settling velocity is measured, which is called hydraulic particle size or the same final settling velocity particle size, rather than its true particle size. Therefore, the material should be indicated in the particle size analysis results Density of.

explanation_cn: 是由不同分子量的碳氢化合物及其非金属衍生物组成的黑褐色复杂混合物，是高黏度有机液体的一种，多半以液体或半固体的石油形态存在，表面呈黑色，可溶于二硫化碳、四氯化碳。
explanation_en: It is a dark brown complex mixture composed of hydrocarbons with different molecular weights and their non-metallic derivatives. It is a kind of high viscosity organic liquid, mostly in the form of liquid or semi-solid petroleum, with black surface and soluble in carbon disulfide and carbon tetrachloride.

explanation_cn: 单独用沥青或用沥青、植物油和其他树脂作为主要成膜物质的涂料。
explanation_en: Coatings that use pitch alone or pitch, vegetable oil and other resin as the main film-forming substances.

explanation_cn: 一种常用的铺路材料，俗称沥青砼。是经人工选配具有一定级配组成的矿料(碎石或轧碎砾石、石屑或砂、矿粉等)与一定比例的路用沥青，在严格控制条件下拌制而成的混合料。
explanation_en: A commonly used paving materials, commonly known as pitch concrete. It is a mixture of mineral aggregate (crushed stone or crushed gravel, stone chips or sand, mineral powder, etc.) with a certain gradation manually selected and mixed with a certain proportion of road pitch under strict control.

explanation_cn: 又称液体浙青、轻质沥青或稀释沥青。是指用汽油、煤油、柴油等溶剂将石油沥青稀释而成的沥青产品。
explanation_en: It is also called liquid Zheqing, light asphalt or cutback asphalt. It refers to the pitch product made by diluting petroleum pitch with gasoline, kerosene, diesel and other solvents.

explanation_cn: 是一种为提高沥青的耐热性、降低沥青层的低温脆性而在沥青材料中加入填料进行改性而成的，以石油沥青为基体的矿物胶黏剂，分为热熔型、溶剂型和乳液型三种。
explanation_en: It is a kind of mineral adhesive based on petroleum pitch, which is modified by adding filler in pitch materials to improve the heat resistance of pitch and reduce the low-temperature brittleness of pitch layer. It can be divided into three types: hot melt type, solvent type and lotion type.

explanation_cn: 参见晶质铀矿。
explanation_en: See uraninite.

explanation_cn: 纤维遇沸水时产生的不可逆收缩。纤维经沸水处理前后的长度之差对处理前长度的百分数称为沸水收缩率。在一定的预加张力下，量取一定长度（L0)的纤维，经湿热(沸水100℃)处理一定的时间后；量取收缩后纤维的长度L1。
explanation_en: The irreversible shrinkage of fibers when they come into contact with boiling water. The difference in length between fibers before and after boiling water treatment and the percentage of length before treatment is called boiling water shrinkage. Under a certain pre tension, measure a certain length of fiber (L0) and treat it with damp heat (boiling water at 100 ℃) for a certain period of time; Measure the length L1 of the contracted fibers.

explanation_cn: 是利用溶液的依数性测定聚合物数均分子量的一种方法。在溶剂中加入某种溶质时，溶液的沸点较纯溶剂有所升高，这种变化与溶质的分子数目密切相关。
explanation_en: It is a method to measure the number average molecular weight of polymer by using the colligative property of solution. When a certain solute is added to a solvent, the boiling point of the solution increases compared to a pure solvent, and this change is closely related to the number of molecules in the solute.

explanation_cn: 架状结构硅酸盐矿物。化学通式为AmXpO2p·nH2O。A=Na、Ca、K、Ba、Sr,少量Mg、Mn,X=Si、Al。为含水的碱或碱土金属的铝硅酸盐矿物。
explanation_en: Silicate mineral with shelf structure. The general chemical formula is AmXpO2p · nH2O. A=Na, Ca, K, Ba, Sr, with a small amount of Mg, Mn, and X=Si, Al. Aluminum silicate mineral mineral containing water alkali or alkaline earth metal.

explanation_cn: 指含碱土金属或碱金属的具有三维空间结构的硅铝酸盐晶体，化学通式为Mx/n[(AlO2)x(SiO2)y]·mH2O，其中M通常为Na+、K+、Ca2+等金属离子。
explanation_en: It refers to the aluminosilicate crystal with three-dimensional spatial structure containing alkaline earth metal or alkali metal. The general chemical formula is Mx/n [(AlO2) x (SiO2) y] · mH2O, where M is usually Na+, K+, Ca2+and other metal ions.

explanation_cn: 一种以沸石为主要矿物的硅铝质岩石。按矿物组合，可划分为单一型沸石岩和混合型沸石岩。
explanation_en: A silicoaluminal rock with zeolite as the main mineral. According to mineral assemblage, it can be divided into single zeolite rock and mixed zeolite rock.

explanation_cn: 属架状硅酸盐一类结构。[(Si,Al)O4]四面体以角顶相互连接形成架状铝硅氧骨架，但与其他具有架状骨干的铝硅酸盐不同的是，它的构造开放性较大，有许多大小均一的空洞和孔道，这些空洞和孔道为离子和水分子所占据，在烘烧使其部分或全部脱水后并不破坏其结晶格架。
explanation_en: It belongs to a type of framework like silicate structure. The tetrahedron of [(Si, Al) O4] is connected to form a framework like aluminum silicon oxide skeleton with an angular top. However, unlike other aluminum silicates with a framework like backbone, its structure is relatively open, with many uniformly sized voids and channels occupied by ions and water molecules. After baking, it partially or completely dehydrates without damaging its crystalline lattice.

explanation_cn: 不用硅或铝脱氧，未经过镇静处理而直接浇注成钢锭的非合金钢。沸腾钢凝固时钢水中残留的氧与熔解于钢水中的碳生成CO气体逸出，另外氧在固体钢中的溶解度比在液体钢中低得多，因而使钢水在钢锭模内产生沸腾现象。
explanation_en: Non-alloy steel cast directly into steel ingots without silicon or aluminum deoxidation and without sedation treatment. When rimmed steel solidifies, the residual oxygen in steel water and the carbon melted in the steel water form CO gas, which escapes. In addition, the water solubility of oxygen in solid steel is much lower than that in liquid steel, so that the liquid steel will boil in the ingot mold.

explanation_cn: 使用油脂对皮革表面进行处理和打光处理而得到的一种表面具有油脂光泽和手感的皮革。
explanation_en: The leather is treated with grease and glazing to get a kind of leather with grease luster and feel.

explanation_cn: 皮革产品或在制品中可以被有机溶剂（二氯甲烷等）萃取出来的油脂的量占试样总质量的百分比。
explanation_en: The percentage of grease in leather products or products in process that can be extracted by organic solvent (dichloromethane, etc.) in the total mass of the sample.

explanation_cn: 主要使用不饱和油脂等油鞣剂进行主鞣制得到的一类皮革产品。的原料皮主要是轻、薄、软的羊皮或麂皮等，与鱼油等不饱和油脂一同捣匀，悬挂在一定温度和湿度的室内.使鱼油等不饱和油脂氧化，氧化过程中所产生的醛类化合物可使胶原蛋白发生交联而变件，油脂的氧化聚合物则将胶原纤维包裹，使它们之间具有滑动性和疏水性，从而起到鞣制的作用。油鞣革柔软而有延伸性，透气性好，能耐水洗，干后不变形。除用作服装、手套革外，还可用于过滤汽油和擦拭光学玻璃。
explanation_en: It is a kind of leather product obtained by main tanning with unsaturated oil and other tanning agents. The raw skin is mainly light, thin and soft sheepskin or chamois, which is tamped together with unsaturated oils such as fish oil and hung in the room at a certain temperature and humidity to oxidize unsaturated oils such as fish oil. Aldehydes produced in the oxidation process can make collagen crosslinking and transform, and the oxidized polymer of oil can wrap collagen fiber, making them sliding and hydrophobic, thus playing the role of tanning. Oil-tanned leather is soft and has extensibility, good air permeability, water washing resistance, and no deformation after drying. In addition to being used as clothing and glove leather, it can also be used to filter gasoline and wipe optical glass.

explanation_cn: 又称油母页岩。一种含炭质很高的有机质页岩。棕褐色.有清晰的纹层构造。密度1.3-1.7g/cm3,无光泽或具有蜡状油脂光泽。有良好的韧性，用小刀削之可以卷起刨花状薄片.用指甲刻划时，划痕是暗褐色。用火柴烧时可冒烟并有沥青质油气体。可提炼石油，也可提取硫酸铵、润滑油和石蜡等数百种副产品。主要由低等生物遗体及黏土物质在闭塞的海湾或湖泊中埋藏后.在缺氧的还原条件下经细菌作用形成腐泥。又在一定静水压力下使腐泥失去水分而成。中国分布比较广泛，但集中在辽宁抚顺、吉林桦甸、广东茂名、河西走廊和陕北等地。
explanation_en: It is also called oil shale. A type of organic shale with high carbon content. Brownish brown with clear layered structure. Density 1.3-1.7g/cm3, dull or waxy grease luster. It has good toughness and can be rolled up into thin flakes with a small knife. When scratching with a nail, the scratches are dark brown. When burning with a match, it can smoke and contain pitch oil gas. It can extract petroleum, as well as hundreds of by-products such as ammonium sulfate, lubricating oil, and paraffin. Mainly composed of low-level biological remains and clay materials buried in closed bays or lakes, and formed into sapropel through bacterial action under anaerobic reduction conditions. It is formed by causing the sapropel to lose its moisture under a certain hydrostatic pressure. China is widely distributed, but concentrated in Fushun, Liaoning, Huadian, Jilin, Maoming, Hexi Corridor, and northern Shaanxi.

explanation_cn: 又称泄压。为了保障主体建筑物、设备和人员的安全危险品发生燃烧或爆炸时采取的将所产生的气体、冲击波压力迅速释放出作业场所的技术措施。通常的泄爆措施是：建筑物某个方面一定面积的建筑物构件，如屋盖、非承重墙，用轻型建筑材料构筑;装设易脱落的门窗;设备上采用薄弱释放环节及安全阀等。这些建筑结构面积称泄压面积。泄压面积应靠近易爆部件，不应面对人员集中的场所和主要交通要道。
explanation_en: Also called pressure relief. In order to ensure the safety of main buildings, equipment and personnel, technical measures are taken to rapidly release the generated gas and shock wave pressure from the workplace in case of combustion or explosion of dangerous goods. The usual explosion relief measures are: building components of a certain area in one aspect of the building, such as roof and non load bearing wall, are constructed with light building materials; Install easily detached doors and windows; Use weak release links and safety valves on the equipment. These building structure areas are called pressure relief areas. The pressure relief area shall be close to explosive parts, and shall not face places where people are concentrated and main traffic arteries.

explanation_cn: 一个材料常数，是材料在均匀分布的轴向应力作用下。对于各向同性材料，抗拉模量E，剪切模量G，泊松比和体积模量B之间有关系。在材料弹性变形比例极限范围白此值是一常数，当超出此范围，此值随平均应力及使用的应力范围而变，不再称为泊松比，对于各向异性材料，存在有多个泊松比值。永久性发光材料除用于工业、仪表、军事外，在民用上如电灯开关、插头、电话号码盘、锁孔、门把手、楼梯阶线、门牌、影剧院座位号等等均可涂用。也可作非常标志：如入防工程、太平门、消防警报器、船舶救生圈、矿并通道、矿并尾部标志等。
explanation_en: A materials constant is the materials under the action of uniformly distributed axial stress. For isotropic materials, there is a relationship between tensile modulus E, shear modulus G, Poisson's ratio and bulk modulus B. This value is a constant in the limit range of elastic deformation ratio of materials. When it exceeds this range, this value changes with the average stress and the stress range used, and is no longer called Poisson's ratio. For anisotropic materials, there are multiple Poisson's ratios. In addition to industrial, instrument and military applications, permanence luminescent materials can be applied in civilian applications, such as light switches, plugs, telephone number plates, keyholes, door handles, stair steps, door plates, theater seat numbers, etc. It can also be used as a special sign, such as entrance protection engineering, emergency exit, fire alarm, ship lifebuoy, mining passage, mining tail sign, etc.

explanation_cn: 由高分子的弹性效应所造成，指高分子流体在高剪切速率环境中表现出的平面方向应力与垂直应力（即互为法向的应力间）的差值表现出各向异性，而在低剪切速率下它们则是各向同性。这种差异可以导致流体沿搅拌轴即垂直方向上爬的爬杆效应等现象。
explanation_en: It is caused by the elasticity effect of macromolecule, which means that the difference between the plane stress and the vertical stress (that is, between normal stresses) of macromolecule fluid in the environment of high shear rate shows anisotropy, while at low shear rate they are isotropic. This difference can lead to the climbing rod effect of the fluid climbing along the stirring axis, that is, the vertical direction.

explanation_cn: 在外电场作用下，电光材料折射率的改变与外加电场强度成正比关系，这种效应称泡克耳斯效应或一次电光效应和线性电光效应。呈现这种效应的材料称泡克耳斯材料。此类材料品种很多，包括无机材料和有机材料-但具有实用意义的主要为无机晶体。它们可按晶体结构分为四种类型：磷酸二氢钾型、钛铁矿型、钨青铜型和闪锌矿型。晶体结构上的共同特征是不具有对称中心。要求具有大的电光系数、高的折射率、小的介电常数和光吸收系数。实际材料在耐光损伤能力、热膨胀系数、透光范围、温度稳定性、化学稳定性和可获得性上往往有重要的差别，须根据特定的使用条件加以选择。泡克耳斯材料是最常用因而也是最重要的电光材料，使用时可通过不同的器件构型、晶体取向和外加电场相对于入射光偏振的方向在晶体中感生折射率改变，从而实现激光的强度、相位或偏振的调制。
explanation_en: Under the action of external electric field, the change of refractive index of electro-optical materials is proportional to the intensity of external electric field. This effect is called paul kerrs or primary electrophoto effect and linear electrophoto effect. The materials presenting this effect is called Pockels materials. There are many kinds of such materials, including inorganic materials and organic materials - but inorganic crystal are mainly of practical significance. They can be divided into four types according to crystal structure: potassium dihydrogen phosphate type, ilmenite type, tungsten bronze type and sphalerite type. The common feature of crystal structure is that there is no symmetry center. It is required to have large electro-optic coefficient, high refractive index, small dielectric constant and optical absorption coefficient. Actual materials often have important differences in light damage resistance, coefficient of thermcal expansion, light transmission range, temperature stability, chemical stability and availability, which must be selected according to specific use conditions. Pockels materials is the most commonly used and therefore the most important electro-optical materials. When used, it can induce refractive index changes in crystal through different device configurations, crystal orientation and the direction of applied electric field relative to the polarization of incident light, thus realizing the modulation of laser intensity, phase or polarization.

explanation_cn: （Al2O3）大于90%，以刚玉相为主要成分的轻质耐火制品。通常用以Al203为原料、加入气体发泡剂的方法制备。制品有较好的高温性能，能用于高温工业窑炉。
explanation_en: (Al2O3) is more than 90%, and light refractory products with corundum phase as the main component. It is usually prepared by taking Al203 as raw material and adding gas blowing agent. The product has good high-temperature performance and can be used in high-temperature industrial kilns.

explanation_cn: 以树脂为基材制成的白部含有无数微孔的塑料。是以树脂构成连续相、气体为分散相的两相体系。按其结构可分为气孔间相互相连通的开孔型泡沫塑料；气孔互相隔开的闭孔型泡沫塑料：气孔壁几乎全部被除掉的网状泡沫塑料。按其硬度分为软质、半硬质和硬质泡沫塑料。也可按塑料的种类分为热固性泡沫塑料和热塑性泡沫塑料。泡沫塑料发泡方法有机械发泡法、物理发泡法和化学发泡法。成型方法可分为挤塑法、模压法、注塑法、浇铸成型法等。泡沫塑料按其构成的基材。常见有聚氨酯泡沫塑料、聚苯乙烯泡沫塑料、聚乙烯泡沫塑料、聚氯乙烯泡沫塑料、酚醛泡沫塑料、脲甲醛泡沫塑料、环氧泡沫塑料等。泡沫塑料含有气孔。使其具有密度低、隔热保温。吸声、防震等优点。可用作绝热隔声材料以及轻质高强度的夹层材料。化学工业中用作管道和容器等的保温材料。建筑；工业中用作屋顶、墙壁的建材。也可用作飞机附件、船只外壳、救屯圈、浮漂、保暖衣等。
explanation_en: Plastics with numerous micropores in the white part made of resin. It is a two-phase system with resin as continuous phase and gas as dispersed phase. According to its structure, it can be divided into open cell foamed plastics with interconnected pores; Closed cell foamed plastics with separated pores: reticulated foamed plastics with almost all pore walls removed. According to its hardness, it can be divided into soft, semi hard and hard foamed plastics. It can also be divided into thermosetting foamed plastics and thermoplastic foamed plastics according to the type of plastics. The foaming methods of foamed plastics include mechanical foaming, physical foaming and chemical foaming. Molding methods can be divided into extrusion, molding, injection molding, casting, etc. The base material of foamed plastics. Common products include polyurethane foam, polystyrene foamed plastics, polyethylene foamed plastics, polyvinyl chloride foamed plastics, phenolic foamed plastics, urea-formaldehyde foam, epoxy foamed plastics, etc. Foamed plastics contains pores. It has low density and heat insulation. Advantages such as sound absorption and shock resistance. It can be used as thermal insulation acoustic insulation materials and lightweight high-strength sandwich materials. In the chemical industry, it is used as a thermal insulation materials for pipes and containers. Architecture; Building materials used for roofs and walls in industry. It can also be used as aircraft accessories, ship casings, rescue circles, floats, warm clothing, etc.

explanation_cn: 由面板（蒙皮）与轻质泡沫芯材组成的层状复合结构。面板多为铝板和碳纤维、玻璃纤维、芳纶纤维复合材料板。泡沫芯材主要是泡沫塑料。泡沫夹层结构突出i特点是弯曲刚度大，质量轻，材料强度可充分利用。泡沫夹层结构的性能取决于面板材料和泡沫芯材料。一般硬质泡沫夹层结构的力学性能较优异。泡沫夹层结构的制造方法主要有两种：一是先制得泡沫芯而后在其上成型面板（蒙皮）；另一种是先制成夹层结构骨架-面板（蒙皮）组合件，而后在其所闱的空腔中填充泡沫塑料半成品（液态或颗粒料），再经发泡而成"热固性泡沫塑料是原材料配好后直接搅拌发泡。而热塑性泡沫塑料则是先发泡成坯，而后将坯再次升温发泡。泡沫夹层结构可用作飞机的舵面、舱门、直升机的旋翼等；还可以用在其他民用产品。如用作隔声、隔热、减震构件；体育器具中有不少也采用泡沫夹层结构。硬质泡沫夹层结构多用于承载作用；软质泡沫夹层结构受力变形大，适用于减震。
explanation_en: Layered composition structure composed of panel (skin) and lightweight foam core. The panel is mostly aluminum plate and carbon fiber, glass fiber, aramid fiber composite material plate. The foam core material is mainly foamed plastics. Foam core sandwich structure is characterized by large bending stiffness, light weight and full utilization of materials strength. The performance of foam core sandwich structure depends on the panel materials and foam core materials. The mechanical properties of general rigid foam core sandwich structure are excellent. There are two main manufacturing methods for foam core sandwich structure: one is to make foam core first and then form panel (skin) on it; The other is to first make sandwich structure skeleton panel (skin) assembly, and then fill the cavity on which it faces with foamed plastics semi-finished products (liquid or granular materials), Formed by foaming again "Thermosetting foamed plastics is made by mixing and foaming directly after raw materials are prepared. Thermoplastic foamed plastics is first foamed into billets, and then heated and foamed again. foam core sandwich structure can be used as aircraft control surface, cabin door, helicopter rotor, etc. It can also be used in other civil products. For example, it can be used as sound insulation, heat insulation and shock absorption components. Many sports equipment also use foam core sandwich structure. Hard foam core sandwich structure is mostly used to carry Use; The soft foam core sandwich structure has large stress deformation and is suitable for shock absorption.

explanation_cn: 又称发泡水泥或轻质混凝土。采用机械方法将泡沫剂水溶液制备成泡沫，冉将泡沫加入含硅质材料、钙质材料、水及各种外加剂等组成的浆料中。经混合搅拌、浇注成型、养护而成的一种多孔材料。通常使用的泡沫剂有松香胶泡沫剂、废动物毛泡沫剂、树脂皂素脂泡沫剂、石油。具有密度小、质量轻、保温、隔声、抗震等性能，是一种新塑环保建筑材料。广泛应用于节能墙体材料。
explanation_en: Also known as foam cement or lightweight concrete. Foam agent aqueous solution is mechanically prepared into foam, and foam is added to the slurry consisting of siliceous materials, calcareous materials, water and various additives. It is a porous materials formed by mixing, pouring molding and curing. The commonly used foam agent include rosin gum foam agent, waste animal hair foam agent, resin sapogenin fat foam agent and petroleum. With low density, light weight, thermal insulation, sound insulation, seismic performance, it is a new plastic environmental protection building materials. Widely used in energy-saving wall materials.

explanation_cn: 孔隙率达到90%以上。I具有一定强度和刚度的多孔金属。这类金属孔隙含量高。孔隙直径可达至毫米级。它的透气性很高，几乎都是联通孔_孔隙表面积大，材料容重很小。粉未冶金法制造泡沫金属，是在粉末中加入发泡剂（如NH，C1)，烧结时发泡剂挥发。留下孔隙。电化学沉积法可以制得规则形状孔隙，孔隙率高达95%的泡沫金属，包括以CXNi、NiCrFe、ZnCu、NiCu、NiCrW、NiFe等金属和合金骨架为泡沫材料。将电化学沉积在多孔体上的金属，经烧结使沉积组分连接成整体。强度达到要求的高孔隙度泡沫金属，孔隙利用率高，使用中可以填充更多的物质（如催化剂。电解质等）。泡沫金属在石油化工、航空航天、环保中用于制造净化、过滤、催化支架、电极等装置。
explanation_en: The porosity reaches over 90%. Porous metal with certain strength and stiffness. This type of metal has a high porosity content. The pore diameter can reach up to millimeter level. Its air permeability is very high, almost all of them are through holes_ The pore surface area is large, and the unit weight of materials is small. Formed metal is produced by powder metallurgy method by adding blowing agent (such as NH, C1) into powder, and blowing agent volatilizes during sintering. Leave pores behind. The electrochemical deposition method can produce formed metal with regular shape pores and porosity up to 95%, including foam materials made of CXNi, NiCrFe, ZnCu, NiCu, NiCrW, NiFe and other metals and alloy skeletons. The metal electrochemically deposited on the porous body is connected into a whole through sintering. Formed metal with high porosity and required strength can be used to fill more materials (such as catalyst, elonrolyte, etc.). Formed metal is used to manufacture purification, filtration, catalytic stem, electrode and other devices in petrochemical industry, aerospace and environmental protection.

explanation_cn: 又称苏打。一种含水的简单岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。单斜晶系，晶体呈菱形板状、粒状集合体。白色、黄色或灰色。在空气中易失水呈白色。易溶于水和盐酸。稍加热即熔，析出水碱。主要产于碱湖、炎热干旱的松散岩石和土壤表面。是制作肥皂、染料、玻璃等的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Also called soda. A simple island like carbonate mineral with water content. Monocline system, crystal are rhombic plate shaped and granular aggregates. White, yellow, or gray. It is prone to water loss in the air and turns white. Easily soluble in water and hydrochloric acid. Melt when heated slightly, and precipitate thermonatrite. It mainly occurs in alkali lakes, hot and dry loose rock and soil surfaces. It is a raw mineral material for making soap, dye or dyestuffc, glass, etc.

explanation_cn: 在电子探针仪或扫描电镜上用X射线光谱仪进行微区化学成分分析的方法。
explanation_en: The method of analyzing micro chemical components using an X-ray spectrometer on an electron probe or scanning electron microscope.

explanation_cn: 是一种水热蚀变岩石，通常呈内色、瓷白色、蓝灰色或褐红色。这类岩石的矿物成分复杂，主要由高岭石、蒙脱石以及埃洛石等黏土矿物组成。次要的矿物包括绢云母、绿泥石、绿脱石、叶蜡石、钠云母、方解石、白云石、铁白云石、蛋白石、五髓、石英、蛭石等。有时主要的矿物可以是石英，晚期可能出现重晶石等。这些岩石通常具有显微鳞片状晶结构，变晶结构、斑状结构、凝灰结构、碎裂结构、交代假象结构等。它们也可以表现出块状构造、糜棱片状构造、角砾状构造、细网脉状构造等。这种岩石主要由中性到中酸性的火成岩，如浅成岩或中酸性凝灰岩等，在地表或地下浅处受到地热水热蚀变而形成。这类岩石通常分布于原岩构造断裂带和层间滑动裂隙带附近，常用作陶瓷、化工等原料。
explanation_en: It is a kind of hydrothermal altered rock, usually in internal color, porcelain white, blue gray or maroon. The mineral composition of such rock is complex, mainly composed of clay mineral such as kadinite, montmorillonite and halloysite. Secondary minerals include seridte, chlorite, chlorite, pyrophyllite, sodium mica, caldte, dolomite, iron dolomite, opal, pentapite, quartze, vermiculite, etc. Sometimes the main mineral can be quartze, and barite may appear in the late stage. These rock usually have micro scale crystal structure, balastic texture, porphyritic texture, tuff structure, cataclastic structure, metasomatic pseudomorphic structure, etc. They can also show massive structure, mylonitic schistose structure, breccia structure, fine mesh vein structure, etc. This kind of rock is mainly composed of neutral to intermediate acid igneous rocks, such as hypabyssal rocks or intermediate acid tuff, which are formed by thermal alteration of geothermal water on the surface or shallow underground. This kind of rock is usually distributed near the original rock structural fracture zone and interlayer sliding fracture zone, and is often used as raw materials for ceramics, chemicals, etc.

explanation_cn: 一种成分较复杂，层节理不明显的块状黏土岩。它是弱固结黏土经过挤压作用、脱水作用、重结晶作用及胶结作用形成的。呈块状，局部失去可塑件，遇水不立即膨胀。黑色泥岩常含有机质，是良好的生油岩系。产于煤系地层或第四纪沉积层中的浅色泥岩，可作陶瓷或耐火材料原料。
explanation_en: A kind of massive clay rock with complex composition and no obvious bedding joints. It is formed by weakly consolidated clay through extrusion, dehydration, recrystallization and cementation. It is blocky and partially loses its plasticity, and does not immediately expand when exposed to water. Black mud rock often contains organic matter and is a good source rock series. The light colored mud rock produced in the coal measure strata or the Quaternary sedimentary layer can be used as raw materials for ceramics or refractory.

explanation_cn: 泥煤，也称为草炭。它是一种形成于沼泽中的松散堆积物，由植物遗体经过生物变化和物理化学变化形成。泥煤是煤中煤化程度最低的类型，也是最原始的状态。在自然状态下，泥煤呈块体状，含水率通常在80%到90%之间。自然干燥后，含水分一般在35%到45%之间，有机质含量在30%到90%之间，灰分含量在10%到70%之间。无机物主要是黏土、石英等。泥煤具有纤维状或颗粒状结构，颜色可以是黑色、褐色、棕色等。它是疏松多孔的，密度在1.20g/cm3到1.60g/cm3之间。泥煤可用作低热值燃料。由于其高有机质和腐殖酸成分，质轻，通气性能好，因此可用作良好的栽培基质和土壤调解剂。此外，泥煤也可以用作制造建筑材料和轻型保温材料的原料。提纯后的腐殖酸及其盐类可用于生产染料、涂料、离子交换剂、泡沫稳定剂、蓄电池负极板膨胀剂、酿酒酵母刺激剂、锅炉防垢剂、钻井泥浆、混凝土调整剂等。泥煤分布于中国东北地区、河北、河南、山东、四川、云南、广东、海南等地。
explanation_en: Peat coal is also called peat. It is a loose deposit formed in marshes, formed by plant remains through biological changes and physical chemistry changes. Peat coal is the lowest degree of coalification in coal, and also the most primitive state. In natural state, peat coal is in block shape, and its water content is usually between 80% and 90%. After natural drying, the moisture content is generally between 35% and 45%, the organic matter content is between 30% and 90%, and the ash content is between 10% and 70%. Inorganics are mainly clay, quartze, etc. Peat coal has fibrous or granular structure, and its color can be black, brown, brown, etc. It is porosity and porous, with a density of 1.20g/cm 3 To 1.60g/cm 3 Between. Peat coal can be used as low calorific value fuel. Due to its high organic matter and humic acid composition, light weight, and good ventilation performance, it can be used as a good cultivation substrate and soil conditioner. In addition, peat coal can also be used as raw material for manufacturing building materials and light thermal insulation materials. The purified humic acid and its salts can be used to produce dye or dyestuffc, coatings, ion exchanger, foam stabilizer, accumulator negative plate expander, yeast stimulant, boiler scale inhibitor, drilling mud, concrete conditioner, etc. Peat coal is distributed in Northeast China, Hebei, Henan, Shandong, Sichuan, Yunnan, Guangdong, Hainan and other places.

explanation_cn: 一种泥质成分(黏土矿物)为25%-50%的石灰岩。除泥质外，碳酸盐矿物含量在50%-75%之间。常呈土黄色，微晶、细晶结构，有时含少量黄褐色硅质结核。遇稀盐酸起泡。
explanation_en: A limestone with argillaceous composition (clay mineral) of 25% -50%. Except for mud, the content of carbonate minerals ranges from 50% to 75%. It is often earthy yellow in color, with microcrystalline and fine-grained structures, and sometimes contains a small amount of yellowish brown siliceous nodules. Foaming when exposed to dilute hydrochloric acid.

explanation_cn: 载流子向有机层和有机层之间界面或有机层和电极之间界面注入时的势垒能隙。
explanation_en: The potential barrier energy gap when carriers are injected into the interface between the organic layer and the organic layer or the interface between the organic layer and the electrode.

explanation_cn: 是生产中空塑料容器的两步成型方法。由注射机在高压下将熔融塑料注入型坯模具内形成管状型坯，开模后型坯留在芯模（又称芯棒）上，通过机械装置将热型坯移至吹塑模具内，合模后由芯模通道引人0.2-0.7MPa的压缩空气，使型坯吹胀达到吹塑模腔的形状，并在空气压力下进行冷却定型，脱模后得到制品。与挤出吹塑法相比，注射吹塑法的优点是：制品精度高，壁厚均匀一致，不需要进行后修饰加工制品无合缝线，废边废料少。缺点是：模具和专用的注吹成型机投资费用大，生产容器的形状和尺寸受限及不宜生产带把手的容器等。的中空容器，主要用于化妆品、日用品、医药和食品的包装，常用的树脂有PP、PE、PS、SAN、PVC、PC等。
explanation_en: It is a two-step molding method for producing hollow plastics containers. The injection machine injects molten plastics into the parison mold under high pressure to form a tubular parison. After the mold is opened, the parison remains on the core mold (also known as the mandrel). The hot parison is moved into the blow mold through a mechanical device. After the mold is closed, 0.2-0.7MPa compressed air is introduced from the core mold channel to make the parison expand to the shape of the blow mold cavity. The parison is cooled and shaped under air pressure, and the product is obtained after demoulding. Compared with the extrusion blow molding method, the advantages of the injection blow molding method are: high product accuracy, uniform wall thickness, no need for post modification processing, no seam lines in the product, and less waste edge. The disadvantages are: high investment costs for molds and specialized injection molding machines, limited shape and size of production containers, and unsuitable for producing containers with handles. It is mainly used for packaging cosmetics, daily necessities, medicine and food. The commonly used resin are PP, PE, PS, SAN, PVC, PC, etc.

explanation_cn: 塑料在注塑机加热料筒中塑化后，由柱塞或往复螺杆注射到闭合模具的模腔中形成制品的塑料加工方法。机简称注塑机，由注射装置、合模装置两部分组成。其中注射装置的作用是将塑料加热塑化成流动状态，并施加高压将塑料熔体注射入模具。注射装置有柱塞式、预塑化式和往复螺杆式。合模装置用来锁紧模具的定模和动模，并实现模具开闭动作及顶出成品。注塑模具由浇注系统、成型零件和结构零件所组成。注塑成型是一门工程技术，它能将塑料原料转变为有用并能保持其性能的制品的重要工艺条件包括影响塑料原料塑化和冷却温度，注塑压力和相应的各个作用时间。温度控制包括：料筒温度、喷嘴温度、模具温度。注塑过程中压力包括塑化压力和注射压力工艺条件直接影响塑料的塑化和制品质量。完成一次注射模塑过程所需的时间称成型周期，也称模塑周期。
explanation_en: After plastics is plasticized in the heating barrel of the injection molding machine, the plunger or reciprocating screw is injected into the mold cavity of the closed mold to form a plastics processing method of the product. The machine is abbreviated as an injection molding machine and consists of two parts: an injection device and a clamping device. The function of the injection device is to heat plastics into a flowing state, and apply high pressure to inject plastics melt into the mold. Injection devices include plunger type, pre plasticizing type, and reciprocating screw type. The clamping device is used to lock the fixed and moving molds of the mold, and to achieve mold opening and closing actions and eject the finished product. An injection mold consists of a pouring system, formed parts, and structural parts. Injection molding is an engineering technology, which can transformation plastics raw materials into useful products that can maintain their properties. The important process conditions include the influence of plastics raw material plasticization and cooling temperature, injection pressure and corresponding action time. Temperature control includes: barrel temperature, nozzle temperature, and mold temperature. In the injection molding process, the pressure including plasticizing pressure and injection pressure process conditions directly affect the plasticization of plastics and product quality. The time required to complete an injection molding process is called the molding cycle, also known as the molding cycle.

explanation_cn: 又称浇注成型，将具有较高固含量好良好流动性的浆料注入多孔质模具内，待模具的气孔将料浆中的液体吸走，在模具内留下具有一定形状和强度的坯体，这种成型方法称为注浆成型。最常用的模具为石膏模，近年来也有用多孔塑料模。其工艺包括料浆制备、石膏模制备和料浆浇注三部分。制备料浆时需要加入分散悬浮剂、黏结剂、除气剂和滴定剂。分散悬浮剂是为了防止颗粒聚集、控制沉降速度。黏结剂可增强坯体强度。滴定剂调节浆料的酸碱度。该成型过程是将粉料与水(或有机液体）制成一定浓度的悬浮料浆，注入具有所需形状的石膏模中，多孔石膏模吸收料浆中液体使粉料变成致密，形成与模具形面相应的注件。浆料中液体被吸干后，拆开模具取出注件，去掉多余料，在室温下自然干燥或在可调节干燥速率的装置中进行干燥。此法可制造大型、形状复杂的薄壁制品。成型过程中需注意浆料的稳定性、黏度、气泡排除、浇注速度、排浆性、收缩性、脱模性和坯体强度。
explanation_en: Also known as pouring molding, the slurry with high solid content and good flow ability is injected into the porous mold, and the liquid in the slurry is sucked away by the pores of the mold, leaving a green body with a certain shape and strength in the mold. This forming method is called slip casting. The most commonly used mold is gypsum mold. In recent years, porous plastics mold has also been used. The process includes slurry preparation, gypsum mold preparation and slurry pouring. Disperse suspending agent, adhesive, degassing agent and titrant need to be added when preparing slurry. Dispersive suspension agents are used to prevent particle aggregation and control settling speed. Adhesive can enhance green body strength. Titration agents regulate the acidity and alkalinity of the slurry. The molding process is to make a certain concentration of suspended slurry from powder and water (or organic liquid) and inject it into the gypsum mold with the desired shape. The porous gypsum mold absorbs the liquid in the slurry to make the powder become dense, forming the injection parts corresponding to the mold surface. After the liquid in the slurry is sucked dry, the mold is opened and the injection part is taken out. The excess material is removed and dried naturally at room temperature or in an adjustable drying rate device. This method can manufacture large and complex thin-walled products. During the molding process, attention should be paid to the stability, viscosity, bubble elimination, pouring speed, slurry discharge, shrinkage, mold release and green body strength of the slurry.

explanation_cn: 泵送混凝土是用混凝土泵或泵车沿输送管运输和浇筑混凝土拌合物。是一种有效的混凝土拌合物运输方式，速度快、劳动力少，尤其适合于大体积混凝土和高层建筑混凝土的运输和浇筑。输送管可为钢管、橡胶管和塑料软管。钢管每段长3m，常用者为φ100、125和150mm，还配有45°、90°等弯管和变截面的锥形管。布管时应尽量减小混凝土拌合物在管中的流动阻力。
explanation_en: Pump concrete is to use concrete pump or pump truck to transport and pour concrete mixture along the delivery pipe. It is an effective transportation mode of concrete mixture, with fast speed and less labor, especially suitable for the transportation and pouring of mass concrete and high-rise building concrete. The delivery pipe can be steel pipe, rubber pipe and plastics hose. Each section of steel pipe is 3m long, commonly used ones are φ 100, 125, and 150mm, also equipped with 45 °, 90 ° bends, and tapered pipes with variable cross-section. The flow resistance of concrete mixture in the pipe shall be minimized during pipe laying.

explanation_cn: 含水的简单岛状结构硫酸盐矿物。莫氏硬度22.5,性脆。味苦稍咸.易溶于水。在干燥空气中易失去一部分水转变成六水泻利盐产于富含镁的盐湖沉积物或沙漠里，也出现于干燥地区的硫化矿床氧化带或土壤里。是提取镁的矿物原料。广泛用于纺织、化工、造纸、制药等部门。
explanation_en: Sulfate minerals with a simple island like structure containing water. Mohs hardness 22.5, brittle. Bitter and slightly salty in taste, easily soluble in water. It is easy to lose a part of water in dry air and transformation it into six water laxatives, which are produced in magnesium rich salt lake sediments or deserts, and also in vulcanization deposit oxidation zones or soils in dry areas. It is a raw mineral material for extracting magnesium. Widely used in sectors such as textiles, chemicals, papermaking, pharmaceuticals, etc.

explanation_cn: 钢中杂质元素及非金属夹杂物的含量具有非常严格的控制要求的钢.其硫、磷含量一般要求不大于0.01%，且对氢、氧以及低熔点金属的含S也有相当严格的控制要求。采用合适的梢炼技术可以降低杂质元素含量并使非金属夹杂 物上浮分离而生产洁净钢。非金属夹杂物的含量降低、尺寸减小、分布合理，可明显提髙钢的韧塑性、冷加工性、性能均匀性以及疲劳性能（特别是疲劳寿命和可靠性）。
explanation_en: The content of impurity elements and non-metallic inclusions in steel has very strict control requirements. The sulfur and phosphorus content of steel is generally required to be no more than 0.01%, and there are also quite strict control requirements for hydrogen, oxygen and S content of low melting point metals. Using proper tip smelting technology can reduce the content of impurity elements and make non-metallic inclusions float and separate to produce clean steel. The decrease of non-metallic inclusion content, size and distribution can significantly improve the toughness, plasticity, cold workability, performance uniformity and fatigue performance of steel (especially fatigue life and reliability).

explanation_cn: 参见高分子分级。
explanation_en: See fractionation.

explanation_cn: 一种表示测量物体硬度值的方法，属于压入法，将金刚石圆锥压头(顶角为120°)或钢球压头(直径为1.588mm)，分别两次加载，先加初始载荷p0,再加主载荷pm，总载荷p=p0+pm，当压头被压入物体表面时，将留下深度为h的压痕，以h值作为衡量物体硬度的值。并规定将金刚石压头的常数K=0.2mm(或钢球压头的常数K=0.26mm)与h值之差作为洛氏硬度的指标。为了使同硬度计可以测量不同软硬程度的物体，可采用不同的压头和总载荷，组成几种不同的洛氏硬度标度。
explanation_en: A method to indicate the hardness value of an object, which belongs to the indentation method. The diamond cone indenter (with a top angle of 120 °) or the steel ball indenter (with a diameter of 1.588mm) are loaded twice respectively. The initial load p0 is applied first, and then the main load pm. The total load p=p0+pm. When the indenter is pressed into the surface of the object, an indentation with a depth of h will be left. The value of h is used as the value to measure the hardness of the object. It is specified that the difference between the constant K=0.2mm of diamond indenter (or the constant K=0.26mm of steel ball indenter) and h value is taken as the index of Rock well hardness. In order to enable the same hardness tester to measure objects with different degrees of hardness and softness, different indenters and total loads can be used to form several different Rock well hardness hardness scales.

explanation_cn: 在使用充填材料充填中等深度或深度牙齿窝洞之前，为了保护牙髓，在洞壁或洞底牙本质暴露的部位涂布的一层能够隔绝冷热或化学刺激的材料。其主要作用是防止热传导或化学药物以及金属修复体的流电现象对牙髓的刺激，同时还有安抚牙髓、中和水门汀的酸性、降低边缘微漏等作用。洞衬剂通常有洞漆和衬层两类。
explanation_en: In order to protect the dental pulp, a layer of materials that can insulate from cold and heat or chemical irritation shall be coated on the exposed part of dentin on the cavity wall or bottom before filling a moderately deep or deep cavity with filling materials. Its main function is to prevent the irritation of the dental pulp caused by the heat conduction or the galvanic phenomenon of chemical drugs and metal prosthesis, as well as to soothe the dental pulp, neutralize the acidity of the cement, and reduce the marginal microleakage. Cavity liner usually includes hole paint and liner.

explanation_cn: 洪德法则，有时也称为洪德定则，是有关原子核外电子排布规律的一项物理定律。该法则主要规定了核外电子在轨道上排布的次序，它包括以下几个要点：对于一个给定的电子系统，具有最大总自旋角动量S的电子组态将具有最低的能量。这里的多重度等于2S+1，即多重度与总自旋角动量S有关。当多个组态的总自旋量子数S相同时，拥有最大总轨道角动量L的组态将具有最低的能量。这表示总轨道角动量L与组态的能量有关。对于电子总数小于或等于满壳层电子数一半的系统，总角动量量子数J（J = |L - S| 到 L + S）最小的组态将具有最低的能量。这适用于开壳层系统。对于电子总数大于满壳层电子数一半的系统，具有最大总角动量量子数J的组态将具有最低的能量。总之，洪德法则帮助确定了核外电子在轨道上的排布次序，考虑了多重度、自旋、轨道角动量以及总角动量等因素，以便更好地理解和预测原子核外电子的行为和能级结构。
explanation_en: Hund's mie, sometimes called Hongde rule, is a physical law related to the arrangement of electrons outside the nucleus. This law mainly specifies the order in which electrons outside the nucleus are arranged in the orbit, including the following points: for a given electronic system, the electronic configuration with the maximum total spin angular momentum S will have the lowest energy. The multiplicity here is equal to 2S+1, which means that the multiplicity is related to the total spin angular momentum S. When the total spin quantum number S of multiple configurations is the same, the configuration with the maximum total orbital angular momentum L will have the lowest energy. This indicates that the total orbital angular momentum L is related to the energy of the configuration. For systems with a total number of electrons less than or equal to half the number of full shell electrons, the configuration with the smallest total angular momentum quantum number J (J=| L - S | to L+S) will have the lowest energy. This applies to open shell systems. For systems with a total number of electrons greater than half the number of full shell electrons, the configuration with the maximum total angular momentum quantum number J will have the lowest energy. In conclusion, Hund's mie helps to determine the arrangement order of extranuclear electrons on the orbit, taking into account such factors as multiplicity, spin, orbital angular momentum and total angular momentum, so as to better understand and predict the behavior and energy level structure of extranuclear electrons.

explanation_cn: 使燃料电池的性能达到最大值的过程。活化一般是在特定条件下运行燃料电池而使典发挥出最大潜能。
explanation_en: The process of maximizing the performance of fuel cell. Activation or conditioning generally refers to the operation of fuel cell under specific conditions to maximize its potential.

explanation_cn: 鉴别和测量由辐照感生的放射性核素的特征辐射来进行元素和核素分析的方法，又称放射化分析。用中子、光子或其他带电粒子照射试样，使待测元素转变为放射性同位素，测量所成的同位素的特征辐射（射线种类、能量和半衰期）及其强度，就可以知道该元素是否存在，并计算其含量。
explanation_en: The method of element and nuclide analysis by identifying and measuring the characteristic radiation of radiation induced radionuclides is also called radiochemical analysis. Irradiate the sample with neutrons, photons or other charged particles to transformation the element to be measured into a radioisotope. Measure the characteristic radiation (ray type, energy and half life) of the formed isotope and its intensity to know whether the element exists and calculate its content.

explanation_cn: 用来促进烧结过程的物质。通过在粉未中添加活化剂，能较低温度下获得高的致密化。如钨烧结时添加极少量的镍。
explanation_en: A substance used to promote the sintering process. By adding activamr to the powder, high densification can be obtained at low temperature. For example, a small amount of nickel is added during tungsten sintering.

explanation_cn: 见活化反应蒸镀。
explanation_en: See activation or conditioning reaction vapor exposition.

explanation_cn: 用物理的或化学的方法促进烧结的过程或为提高制品性能所采取的有利于烧结的措施。不断解决难烧结材料的活化问题，应是烧结技术进步的重要标志。
explanation_en: Physical or chemical methods are used to promote the sintering process or measures taken to improve the performance of products in favor of sintering. Continuously solving the activation or conditioning problem of materials difficult to sintering should be an important sign of sintering technology progress.

explanation_cn: 硫化胶粉经表面活化处理而得到的具有反应活性的弹性体粉末。已经实现工业化生产的活化胶粉制造方法主要有饱和量硫化促进剂处理法和液体高分子/硫化剂处理法。
explanation_en: Cured rubber powder is a reactive elastomer powder obtained by surface activation or conditioning treatment. The manufacturing methods of active waste rubber powder that have realized industrial production mainly include saturated vulcanization accelerator treatment method and liquid macromolecule/vulcanizing agent treatment method.

explanation_cn: 又称有效浓度。为使理想溶液(或极稀溶液）的热力学公式适用于真实溶液，用来代替浓度的一种物理量。活度是浓度与活度系数的乘积，是有效浓度，表示系统中组元的活泼程度。活度愈大，其化学位愈高，愈易发生化学变化。
explanation_en: Also called effective concentration. In order to make the thermodynamics formula of ideal solution (or extremely dilute solution) applicable to real solution, it is used to replace a physical quantity of concentration. Activity is the product of concentration and activity coefficient, is the effective concentration, and represents the activity degree of components in the system. The greater the activity, the higher the degree of chemistry, and the more prone to chemical changes.

explanation_cn: 孔隙结构丰富、比表面积很大（一般1000m2/g以上）、吸附能力很强的多孔炭材料。以木材和果壳等植物或煤、石油、合成树脂等为原料，经炭化、活化和后处理而制得。孔隙结构随原料及活化条件的不同而变化。按外观形状可分为粉状、粒状、纤维状。
explanation_en: Porous carbon materials with rich pore structure, large specific surface (generally more than 1000m2/g) and strong adsorption capacity. It is made from wood, fruit shell and other plants or coal, petroleum, synthetic resin and other raw materials through carbonization, activation or conditioning and post-treatment. The pore structure varies with raw materials and activation or conditioning conditions. It can be divided into powder, granular, and fibrous shapes according to its appearance.

explanation_cn: 具有引发单体进行增长反应的物质，活性种可以是自由基、阳离子、阴离子或者带有活性端基的各种链长的活性链。
explanation_en: The reactive species can be free radicals, cations, anions or various chain length active chains with active end groups.

explanation_cn: 高分子溶液中流体力学等效球的体积。
explanation_en: The volume of hydrodynamic equivalent sphere in macromolecule solution.

explanation_cn: 在胶体颗粒呈棒状或板状的条件下，这种胶体溶液的流动其颗粒的长轴向液流方向统计性地平行排列，因此即使颗粒本身也不具有光学的异向性，有时也出现双折射。
explanation_en: Under the condition that the colloidal particles are in the shape of rods or plates, the flow of this colloidal solution exhibits a statistically parallel arrangement of the long axis of the particles in the direction of the liquid flow. Therefore, even the particles themselves do not exhibit optical anisotropy and sometimes exhibit birefringence.

explanation_cn: 即50g粉末从规定孔径的标准流速漏斗流出所需要的时间，单位为s/50g，简称流速。流动性釆用测定松装密度的漏斗来测定。粉末的流动性与粉末体和颗粒的性质、颗粒密度和粉米松装密度以及颗粒间黏附作用的影响。具体地说，粉末颗粒大，颗粒形状规范，粒度组成中极细粉末所占比例小，流动性将变好。粉末氧化能提高流动性。颗粒密度不变时相对密度增加，则流动性增加。颗粒表面吸附水分、气体或加入成形剂会降低粉末流动性。
explanation_en: That is, the time required for 50g powder to flow out of the standard flow rate funnel with the specified aperture, in s/50g, referred to as flow rate. Flow ability is measured by funnel for measuring loose density. The flow ability of powder is affected by the properties of powder body and particles, the density of particles, the loose density of powders, and the adhesion between particles. Specifically, the powder particle are large, the particle shape is standard, and the proportion of extremely fine powder in the particle size composition is small, so the flow ability will become better. Powder oxidation can improve flow ability. When the particle density is constant, the relative density increases, and the flow ability increases. The adsorption of water, gas on the particle surface or the addition of forming agent will reduce the powder flowability.

explanation_cn: 常用流动性控制剂为糠酸、对苯二酸、硫酸铵等。浆料在烧结膜层凝结状态，烧结初期膜层中载体受热软化、熔融产生二次流动，造成烧结后膜层出现裂缝。为此，在浆料中加入流动性控制剂以控制二次流动，即加入一些添加剂使载体在熔融前不断升华而增加黏稠性。在厚膜浆料中流动性控制剂的应用并不广泛，只有在要求比较高的细线工艺中才应用。
