explanation_en: Common mobility control agent are furoic acid, terephthalic acid, ammonium sulfate, etc. When the slurry is in the condensed state of the sintered film layer, the carrier in the film layer is bating and melted during the initial stage of sintering, resulting in secondary flow, resulting in cracks in the film layer after sintering. Therefore, mobility control agent is added to the slurry to control the secondary flow, that is, some additive are added to make the carrier sublimate continuously before melting to increase the viscosity. The application of mobility control agent in thick film slurry is not extensive, and it is only used in fine wire process with high requirements.

explanation_cn: 高聚物高弹态与粘流态之间的转变区，称为粘流转变区，对应的转变温度称为流动温度Tf。流动温度Tf是确定高聚物熔体成型工艺参数的主要依据之一。
explanation_en: The transformation zone between the high elastic slate state and the viscous flow state of the polymer is called the viscous flow transformation zone, and the corresponding transformation temperature is called the flowing temperature Tf. Flowing temperature Tf is one of the main bases for determining the processing parameters of polymer melt molding.

explanation_cn: 又称沸腾床硫化。是指先在盛满玻璃微珠的容器下面通入蒸汽或热空气，使玻璃微珠上下翻腾而呈流态化，成为流化床(沸腾床)，然后让压出橡胶制品通过，从而实现连续硫化的工艺方法。流化床是在热空气流中悬浮直径为0.15-0.25mm的玻璃珠或粒径为0.2-0.3mm的石英砂为硫化介质的装置。操作过程中，热气体自上而下流经无数粒子构成的粒层，固体粒子悬浮于气体中翻动形成沸腾状态的加热床。分散在气体中的悬浮体具有液体的各种特征，并具有良好的传热性能，从而使得传热均匀。通过的半成品被沸腾床介质覆盖，达到加热硫化的目的。常用的沸腾床由若干个单元槽组成，可以硫化压出橡胶制品。与热空气硫化中的连续硫化罐相比，由于其加热气体与固体物料之间的接触面积大?所以硫化速度快，硫化装置小；与盐浴连续硫化法相比，沸腾床使硫化介质呈悬浮状态的空气压力很低(层高体15mm时的压力为1.7-1.5kPa)，不会使制品截面受压变形；可以用来硫化复杂断面的空心制品和海绵型材，且不会像盐浴硫化那样在制品表面黏上融盐等污物。为防止悬浮热载体黏在硫化制品上，一般需将压出后的半成品用隔离剂(滑石粉)处理。
explanation_en: Also called fluidized bed sulfurization. It refers to the process method of first introducing steam or hot air under the container full of glass microsphere to make glass microsphere tumble up and down to become fluidized bed (boiling bed), and then allowing the pressed rubber products to pass through, so as to achieve continuous vulcanization. Fluidized bed is a device that suspends glass beads with a diameter of 0.15-0.25mm or quartz sand with a particle size of 0.2-0.3mm as vulcanization medium in hot air flow. During the operation, hot gas flows through a layer of countless particles from top to bottom, and solid particles are suspended in the gas and flip to form a boiling heated bed. Suspended solids dispersed in gases exhibit various characteristics of liquids and exhibit excellent heat transfer performance, resulting in uniform heat transfer. The semi-finished products passed through are covered by the boiling bed medium to achieve the purpose of heating vulcanization. The commonly used fluidized bed is composed of several unit tanks, which can vulcanization and press out rubber products. Compared with the continuous vulcanization tank in hot air vulcanization, the contact area between the heated gas and the solid material is large? Therefore, vulcanization speed is fast and vulcanization device is small; Compared with the salt bath continuous vulcanization method, the air pressure of the fluidized bed to suspend the vulcanization medium is very low (the pressure is 1.7-1.5kPa when the height of the layer is 15mm), and the product section will not be compressed and deformed; It can be used to vulcanization hollow products and sponge profiles with complex cross sections, and will not stick molten salt and other dirt on the surface of products like salt bath cure. In order to prevent the suspended heat carrier from sticking to the vulcanized products, it is generally necessary to treat the semi-finished products after pressing with isolation agent (talcum powder).

explanation_cn: 衡量涂料在施工后经流动而形成平整、光滑，均匀涂膜的能力。减少或消除橘皮、刷痕、浮色等涂膜缺陷的主要方法是在涂料中加人流平剂，使涂料的表面张力适当降低，湿膜的流平时间延长等达到涂膜要求。
explanation_en: Measure the ability of coatings to form a flat, smooth and even film after flowing. The main method to reduce or eliminate film defects such as orange peel, brush mark and floating color is to add artificial leveling agent in coatings to properly reduce the surface tension of coatings and extend the leveling time of wet film to meet the film requirements.

explanation_cn: 一种陶瓷制品的成型方法，首先把粉碎好的粉料与有机塑化剂溶液按适当配比混合制成具有一定黏度的料浆，料浆从容器流下，被刮刀以一定厚度刮压涂敷在专用基带上，经干燥、固化后从上剥下成为生坯带的薄膜，然后根据成品的尺寸和形状需要对生坯带作冲切、层合等加工处理，制成待烧结的毛坯成品。
explanation_en: A molding method of ceramics products, firstly, the crushed powder and organic plasticizer solution are mixed in proper proportion to make a slurry with a certain viscosity, the slurry flows down from the container, is scraped and coated on the special base belt with a certain thickness by a scraper, and is peeled off from the top to become a film of green compact belt after drying and curing. Then, according to the size and shape of the finished product, the green compact belt is processed by punching, laminating, etc, Make the finished product to be sintering.

explanation_cn: 拌合料树落度大于20cm的混凝土。通常采用适量的流化剂(如高效减水剂或普通减水剂）作为外加剂加到坍落度为5-1Ocm的混凝土混合物中，使其流动性大幅度提高，从而达到便于浇灌、减较甚至免去振捣成型工序的目的，为减少泌水和离析现象，可适当增加砂率和细粉料含量。除能减少用水量外，流化剂还有一定的早强性能。流态混凝土不需提高水灰比与单位用水量。故其强度比普通混凝土的强度有所提高，其他物理力学件能与普通混凝土的相近。流态混凝土适用于泵送、管道输送、漏斗浇灌、钢筋密布或断面狭小不易浇捣及快速施工等场合。
explanation_en: Concrete with mixture tree fall greater than 20cm. A proper amount of fluidizing agent (such as high-efficiency water reducing agent or ordinary water reducing agent) is usually used as an additive to add to the concrete mixture with a slump of 5-10 cm to greatly improve its flow ability, so as to achieve the purpose of facilitating pouring, reducing or even eliminating the vibration molding process. In order to reduce bleeding and segregation, the sand rate and fine powder content can be appropriately increased. In addition to reducing water consumption, fluidizing agents also have certain early strength properties. Liquiti concrete does not need to increase the water cement ratio and unit water consumption. Therefore, its strength is higher than that of ordinary concrete, and other physical and mechanical parts can be similar to that of ordinary concrete. Liquiti concrete is suitable for pumping, pipeline transportation, funnel pouring, dense reinforcement or narrow section, difficult to pour and tamp, rapid construction and other occasions.

explanation_cn: 符号为lm。是光通量的国际单位制单位，是人眼感知的光能的量度。
explanation_en: The symbol is lm. It is the International System of Units (SI) unit of luminous flux and a measure of the perceived energy of light by the human eye.

explanation_cn: 焚光灯的发光效率通常以流明效率来表示。流明效率即是发射的光通量(以流明为单位)与激发时输入的电功率或被吸收的其他形式能最总功率P之比。
explanation_en: The luminescence efficiency of an incandescent lamp is usually expressed in terms of lumen efficiency. The lumen efficiency is the ratio of the luminous flux emitted (in lumen) to the maximum total power P of the input electrical power or other forms of energy absorbed at the time of excitation.

explanation_cn: 是聚合物加工成型过程中由于熔体流动不良或流动速度差异而导致的一种表面缺陷，是指制品表面显示熔体流动方向的流线，常见于挤出片材和注塑制品。在聚合物片材挤出成型过程中，熔体挤出口模时在垂直于挤出方向上存在速度梯度，由于熔体黏度过高或冷却速率过快，导致熔体的流动曲线在制品表面留下痕迹而产生流痕。在聚合物注塑成型过程中，当流动性较差的低温高黏度熔体在注料口及流道中以半固体状态注入型腔后，熔体沿模腔表面流动，并被不断注入的后续熔体挤压形成回流和滞流，从而在制品表面产生以浇口为中心的年轮状或螺旋状、云雾状的流痕。
explanation_en: It is a surface defect caused by poor melt flow or different flow speed during the polymer processing molding process. It refers to the flow line on the product surface showing the direction of melt flow, which is commonly used in extruded sheets and injection molded products. In the extrusion molding process of polymer sheet, there is a velocity gradient in the direction perpendicular to the extrusion direction when the melt extrudes from the die. Because the viscosity of the melt is too high or the cooling rate is too fast, the flow curve of the melt leaves traces on the surface of the product, resulting in flow mark. In the process of polymer injection molding, when the low temperature and high viscosity melt with poor flow ability is injected into the mold cavity in a semi-solid state in the injection port and flow fields or flow channels, the melt flows along the surface of the mold cavity, and is extrusion by the continuously injected subsequent melt to form reflux and stagnation, so that a ring shaped or spiral shaped and cloud shaped flow mark with the gate as the center is generated on the surface of the product.

explanation_cn: 一种成分与花岗岩相当的酸性喷出岩。呈浅灰白、浅灰、白、灰红和浅紫色等。常为隐晶质结构和斑状结构，部分有玻璃质和球粒结构具明显的流纹构造，有时呈条带状或气孔状构造。主要矿物成分是长石和石英，两者含量可达90%以上。长石多为透长石和酸性斜长石，有时为歪长石，另外可有10%以内的黑云母或角闪石。长石和石英常成斑晶，斑晶含量可达30%以上，称为斑流岩。如果斑晶主要是歪长石和碱性辉石、碱性角闪石，则称为碱流岩。与流纹岩有关的矿产主要是非金属矿产，如沸石、明矾石、叶蜡石、髙岭石、蒙脱石和萤石。部分黄铁矿的形成也与流纹岩有关。新鲜的流纹岩抗压强度为150-300MPa,是理想的建筑石材。具有流纹或特殊球粒结构的新鲜流纹岩，也是优质的装饰石材。1982年中国四川省发现一种富钡流纹岩，与多金属矿产关系密切。
explanation_en: An acid extrusive rock with composition equivalent to granite. It appears as light gray white, light gray, white, greyish red, and light purple. They are usually aphanitic texture and porphyritic texture, and some are glassy and spheroidal texture with obvious flow structure, sometimes with banded or vesicular structure. The main mineral components are feldspar and quartze, the content of which can reach more than 90%. Feldspar mainly consists of transparent feldspar and acid plagioclase, sometimes askew feldspar, and biotite or hornblende within 10%. Feldspar and quartze often form phenocryst, and the content of phenocryst can reach more than 30%, which is called porphyry. If phenocryst are mainly crooked feldspar, alkaline pyroxene and alkaline amphibole, they are called alkali flow rocks. The minerals related to rhyolite are mainly non-metallic minerals, such as zeolite, alunite, pyrophyllite, kaolinite, montmorillonite and fluorite. The formation of some pyrite is also related to rhyolite. The compressive strength of fresh rhyolite is 150-300MPa, which is an ideal building stone. Fresh rhyolite with rhyolite or special spherical structure is also a high-quality decorative stone. In 1982, a barium rich rhyolite was discovered in Sichuan Province, China, which is closely related to polymetallic minerals.

explanation_cn: 一种由不同颜色的条纹、拉长的气孔或定向排列的矿物或浆肩构成的流动状构造。是由岩浆流动造成的，可用于指示熔岩的流动方向。为流纹岩所具有的典型构造，也见于其他中酸性喷出岩或岩颈、岩管等火山机构中。
explanation_en: A flowing structure composed of stripes of different colors, elongated pores, or directionally arranged minerals or slurry shoulders. It is caused by magma flow and can be used to indicate the direction of lava flow. The typical structure of rhyolite can also be found in other intermediate acid extrusive rock or volcanic institutions such as rock necks and pipes.

explanation_cn: 一种压实固结的酸性火山碎肩岩。火山碎肩物含量在50%以上，粒度<2mm,被更细的火山碎屑物(火山尘)及火山灰水化学分解产物所胶结，构成典型的凝灰结构。分选较差，层状构造不明显。火山碎屑有岩屑、晶屑和玻屑，但以玻屑和晶屑为主，岩屑一般不超过20%。晶屑主要为石英和碱性长石。呈浅绿、紫红色，致密状。与沸石、蒙脱石等非金属矿成矿关系密切。致密坚硬者可作建筑装饰材料。
explanation_en: A compacted and consolidated acidic volcanic shoulder rock. The content of volcanic debris is over 50%, with a particle size of<2mm. It is cemented by finer volcanic debris (volcanic dust) and the chemical decomposition products of volcanic ash water, forming a typical tuff structure. Poor sorting and unclear layered structure. Volcanic debris includes rock debris, crystal debris, and glass debris, but mainly consists of glass debris and crystal debris, with rock debris generally not exceeding 20%. The crystal chips are mainly quartze and alkaline feldspar. It is light green, purple red, and dense. It is closely related to the metallogenesis of zeolite, montmorillonite and other non-metallic minerals. Dense and hard materials can be used as building decoration materials.

explanation_cn: 能量很靠近导带底的电子束缚态，或能量很接近价带顶的空穴束缚态。浅能级中的电子或空穴，在稍高的温度（如室温）就基本上电离而成为在导带中的自由电子和价带中的自由空穴，起导电作用。
explanation_en: The electron bound state whose energy is very close to the bottom of the conduction band, or the hole bound state whose energy is very close to the top of the valence band. The electrons or holes in the shallow level are basically ionized at a slightly higher temperature (such as room temperature) to become free electrons in the conduction band and free holes in the valence band, which conduct electricity.

explanation_cn: 见注浆成型。
explanation_en: See slip casting.

explanation_cn: 用浇注法施工的不定形耐火材料。由耐火骨料、粉料、结合剂、外加剂等组成。施工时加一定量的水（或含结合剂的溶液），搅拌后浇注成型。使用前需经养护烘烤，用途广泛。
explanation_en: Unshaped refractory constructed by casting method. Composed of refractory aggregates, powders, binders, admixtures, etc. During construction, add a certain amount of water (or solution containing binder), mix and pouring molding. Before use, it needs to be cured and baked, and has a wide range of uses.

explanation_cn: 将液态材料注入铸型内并使之凝同为固态材料的操作过程。根据铸型形式和分为模铸和连铸两大类，铸件生产广泛采用模铸，而铸锭生产多采用连铸。
explanation_en: The operation process of injecting liquid materials into mold and making it congealed as solid materials. According to the form of mold, it can be divided into mold casting and continuous casting. mold casting is widely used in casting production, while continuous casting is widely used in ingot production.

explanation_cn: 试样在升降温过程中开始出现浑浊时的温度，是多组分混合物的熔体或液体随着温度变化的性能指标之一。产生的原因是多组分体系的微相分离。
explanation_en: The temperature at which the sample begins to appear turbid during the temperature rise and fall process is one of the performance indicators of a multi-component mixture's melt or liquid as it changes with temperature. The reason for this is the microphase separation of multi-component systems.

explanation_cn: 是利用浊点的测定来研究溶液或溶质性质的分析方法，也是判断共混聚合物组分相容件的方法之一。
explanation_en: It is an analytical method to study the properties of solution or solute by measuring cloud point, and it is also one of the methods to judge the phase content of polymer blending polymer components.

explanation_cn: 俗称浮石，一种多孔的酸性喷出岩。其特点是气孔多（孔隙率达40%-70%),密度低（密度0.3-0.4g/cm3)，能浮于水面之上。状似炉渣，呈白色、灰白色。全玻璃质结构，气孔构造。化学成分与流纹岩相当。
explanation_en: Commonly known as pumice, it is a porous acidic extrusive rock. It is characterized by many pores (porosity up to 40% -70%), low density (density 0.3-0.4g/cm3), and can float above the water surface. It looks like slag, white and gray. All vitreous texture, pore structure. The chemical composition is equivalent to that of rhyolite.

explanation_cn: 高分子共混物中一相为基本球状分散相、另一相为连续相的结构。
explanation_en: In polyblend, one phase is basically spherical dispersed phase and the other phase is continuous phase.

explanation_cn: 由分散相聚合物均匀嵌在连续相聚合物中形成的复合纤维，简称海岛纤维。分散相聚合物沿纤维纵向不连续分布，呈微纤状的称基体-微纤型；呈棒条状分布的称分散型、藕芯型。当分散相和连续相由化学或物理性质不同、但化学组成属于同一种属聚合物组成时，称双组分海岛纤维；由完全不同种属两种聚合物组成时，称双成分海岛纤维。
explanation_en: The composite fiber is formed by uniformly embedding dispersed phase polymer in continuous phase polymer, which is called island fiber for short. The dispersed phase polymer is discontinuously distributed along the longitudinal direction of the fiber, which is called the matrix microfiber type; Distributed in a rod like manner, it is called dispersed type or lotus root core type. When the dispersed phase and continuous phase are composed of polymer with different chemical or physical properties, but the chemical composition belongs to the same kind, they are called two-component island fibers; It is called bicomponent island fiber when it is composed of two polymer of completely different species and genera.

explanation_cn: 用化学法从海水中提取的沉淀物再经高温烧结制成的烧结镁砂。MgO含量较高，用于生产镁质和镁碳质耐火材料。
explanation_en: Sintered magnesite is made from the precipitate extracted from seawater by chemical method and then sintered at high temperature sintering. The content of MgO is high, which is used to produce magnesia and magnesia carbon refractory.

explanation_cn: 层状结构硅酸盐矿物。块状、土状集合体。白色、浅灰色、黄褐色或玫瑰红色。成分中含铜呈浅蓝绿色，含铁为黑色。新鲜面为珍珠光泽，风化后为土状光泽。
explanation_en: Layered silicate mineral. Block like and soil like aggregates. White, light gray, yellow brown, or rose red. The composition contains copper in a light blue-green color, while iron in a black color. The fresh surface is pearly luster, and the weathered surface is earthy luster.

explanation_cn: 以海泡石为主的一种黏土或岩石。其成因有两种类型，一种为热液型，另一种为沉积型。前者的海泡石含量可达80%-90%以上，其次可含有少量的石英、白云石、方解石、蛋白石、云母、滑石等。这种类型的海泡石矿因规模小，大多数达不到开采价值。
explanation_en: A clay or rock dominated by sepiolite. There are two types of genesis, one is hydrothermal type and the other is sedimentary type. The former contains more than 80% -90% sepiolite, followed by a small amount of quartze, dolomite, caldte, opal, mica, talc, etc. Most of this type of sepiolite ore can not reach the mining value because of its small scale.

explanation_cn: 应用于船舶、舰艇、海港码头等近海设施的专用涂料。船舶、舰艇 涂料对船舰具有保护、装饰和伪装作用，也关系到船舰的使用效率和寿命，是提高船舰的航速和战斗力的重要材料。海洋及船舶涂料按使用的部位和作用的不同通常有以下分类：车间底漆（如富锌漆、锌粉漆），船底涂料（船底防锈防污）、水线涂料、水线以上部位涂料（如甲板、船壳等）、船舶内部涂料（船舱、机舱涂料等)。
explanation_en: It is a special coatings applied to offshore facilities such as ships, warships, seaports and docks. Ship and warship coatings have the functions of protection, decoration and camouflage for ships, and are also related to the service efficiency and life of ships. They are important materials to improve the speed and combat effectiveness of ships. Marine coalings are generally classified as follows according to the different parts and functions used: workshop primer (such as zinc rich paint and zinc powder paint), ship bottom coatings (ship bottom rust prevention and antifouling), waterline coatings, coatings above waterline (such as deck, hull, etc.), and ship interior coatings (cabin, engine room coatings, etc.).

explanation_cn: 材料在海洋性环境下的腐蚀现象.包括在海洋大气环境、飞溅区、潮差区、海水中以及海泥等环境中的腐蚀。
explanation_en: Corrosion of materials in marine environment, including corrosion in marine atmospheric environment, splash area, tidal range area, seawater, sea mud and other environments.

explanation_cn: 将还原法制得的高度多孔金属海绵体粉碎而制成的多孔性还原粉末。如将碳还原氧化铁得到的海绵铁块，通过机械粉碎法粉碎之 后，便得到海绵铁粉。海绵粉因为多孔，有很大的比表面积，吸附能力强.化学活性高，易氧化，但导电导热性能较差。
explanation_en: Porous reduction powder is made by crushing highly porous metal sponge obtained by reduction method. If the sponge iron block obtained by reducing carbon to iron oxide is crushed by mechanical crushing method, sponge iron powder is obtained. Sponge powder has a large specific surface due to its porosity, strong adsorption capacity, high chemical activity, easy oxidation, but poor conductivity and thermal conductivity.

explanation_cn: 金红石（TiO2 )等经氯化牛成四氯化钛，随后用活泼金属（例如镁等）还原法制得的海绵状金属钛。它是工业钛合金最主要的原料.其生产率较高，成本较低。其储存和运输一般采用充氢密封罐装，以防止海绵钛颗粒表面的氧吸附和氧化。
explanation_en: Rutile (TiO2) and the like are chlorinated into titanium tetrachloride, and then reduced with active metals (such as magnesium, etc.) to obtain spongy metal titanium. It is the main raw material for industrial titanium alloys, with high productivity and low cost. The storage and transportation of titanium sponge particles are generally conducted in sealed hydrogen filled cans to prevent oxygen adsorption and oxidation on the surface of titanium sponge particles.

explanation_cn: 以铁矿石或球团为原料，在低于原料熔点的温度以下，采用固体或气体还原剂还原去除原料中的氧而得到的内部含有海绵状孔隙的铁，也称直接还原铁（DRI)。还原过程中不产生液态铁水和熔渣，因内部含有海绵状孔隙及发育的表面而得名。其密度较低，金属化率大于85%，硫、磷 等杂质含量较低。工业化生产主要为固相还原法，或称直接还原法，根据生产设备可分为竖炉法（以氢气和一氧化碳为还原剂）、管状炉法（以焦粉、褐煤、 无烟煤等固体炭为还原剂）、回转窑炉法等。金属化率大于92%且以硅石为主的脉石碱度不大于0.3的 海绵铁代替废钢广泛用于电炉或转炉炼钢，可明显缩短冶炼时间而提高生产效率，可降低钢中非金属夹杂物及氮的含量并改善钢的均匀性。由于海绵铁具有较 强的吸水能力，使用前需保持干燥或预热后入炉。
explanation_en: With iron ore or pellets as raw materials, iron containing spongy pores inside is obtained by reducing and removing oxygen in raw materials with solid or gas reducing agents at a temperature below the melting point of raw materials, which is also called direct reduced iron (DRI). During the reduction process, there is no liquid iron or slag produced, and it is named after the sponge like pores and developed surface inside. Its density is low, the metallization rate is more than 85%, and the content of sulfur, phosphorus and other impurities is low. Industrial production is mainly solid phase reduction method, or direct reduction method. According to production equipment, it can be divided into shaft furnace method (hydrogen and carbon monoxide are used as reducing agents), tubular furnace method (coke powder, lignite, anthracite and other solid carbon are used as reducing agents), rotary kiln method, etc. Sponge iron with metallization rate greater than 92% and gangue alkalinity not greater than 0.3 dominated by silica is widely used in electric furnace or converter sleelmaking steelmaking instead of scrap, which can significantly shorten the smelting time and improve production efficiency, reduce the content of non-metallic inclusions and nitrogen in steel and improve the uniformity of steel. Since sponge iron has a strong water absorption capacity, it should be kept dry or preheated before use.

explanation_cn: 层状结构硅酸盐矿物。呈圆粒状分布于疏松的硅质或黏土质碳酸岩盐中。暗绿至绿黑色，亦呈黄绿、灰绿色。不透明，土状光泽。
explanation_en: Layered silicate mineral. It is distributed in porosity siliceous or clayey carbonate rock salt in a round shape. Dark green to greenish black, also showing yellow green and grayish green. Opaque, earthy luster.

explanation_cn: 矿物名称为绿柱石。绿蓝色至蓝绿色、浅蓝色，一般色调较浅。其蓝绿色由 Fe2+致色而成。可具有猫眼效应。主要产于巴西、 马达加斯加。参见绿柱石。
explanation_en: The mineral name is beryl. Green blue to blue-green, light blue, generally with a lighter color tone. Its blue-green color is caused by Fe2+. It can have a cat's eye effect. Mainly produced in Brazil and Madagascar. See beryl.

explanation_cn: 海蓝色的宝石级方柱石品种。参见方柱石。
explanation_en: Sea blue gems scapolite variety. See scapolite.

explanation_cn: 天然改性人造纤维的一种。由某些海藻中分离出来的海藻酸为原料制成的纤维，纤维组分一般是海藻酸的金属盐.如钠盐、钙 盐、铍盐、铬盐等。有的具有水溶性（钠盐），有些具有耐碱性（如铍盐和铬盐），有些不具有耐碱性 (如钙盐和镁盐）。
explanation_en: A type of natural modified artificial fiber. Fibers made from alginate separated from certain seaweed, typically consisting of metal salts of alginate, such as sodium salts, calcium salts, beryllium salts, chromium salts, etc. Some have water solubility (sodium salts), some have alkali resistance (such as beryllium and chromium salts), and some do not have alkali resistance (such as calcium and magnesium salts).

explanation_cn: 有用组分或矿物呈细小的粒状、细脉状或不规则状均匀或不均 匀散布于脉石中形成的一种构造。在岩浆或热液成因的矿石中较为常见。
explanation_en: A structure formed by useful components or minerals dispersed uniformly or unevenly in small grains, veins, or irregular shapes in gangue. It is common in ores of magmatic or hydrothermal origin.

explanation_cn: 把被涂物置入涂料液中，经一定时间后取出，并滴尽余漆的漆涂装方法。按其，设备和操作的不同，可分手工浸涂、传动浸涂、回转 浸涂、真空浸涂及浸涂-流涂法等多种，浸涂的主要影响因素有涂料黏度、进涂时间、工件入槽出槽速度、滴漆时间等。
explanation_en: The coating method involves placing the coated object into the coating liquid, taking it out after a certain period of time, and dripping all remaining paint. According to the difference of equipment and operation, it can be divided into manual dipping coating, transmission dipping coating, rotary dipping coating, vacuum dipping coating and dipping coating flow coating method. The main influencing factors of dipping coating include coatings viscosity, in coating time, workpiece in and out slot speed, paint dripping time, etc.

explanation_cn: 用以石灰为主的碱性材料处理原料皮的操作。目的是松散胶原纤维结构和除去纤维间质，一般和脱毛同浴进行。
explanation_en: The operation of treating raw skin with alkaline materials mainly composed of lime. The purpose is to loosen the structure of collagen fiber and remove interfibrillary substance, which is usually carried out in the same bath with unhairing.

explanation_cn: 第二代高温超导带材的简称.由金属基带、阻挡层、缓冲层、超导层和保护层组成.超导层主要为RE-BCü超导薄膜。涂层导体在未来超导强电应用中起着至关重要的作用。涂层导体带材的制备方法分为物理法是化学法两类；其主要区别是：物理法是采用脉冲激光沉积（PLD)方法，利用脉冲激光束轰击氧化物耙材，从而制备出YBCO超导层薄膜，而化学法是采用金属有机盐，结合气相沉积或者溶胶-凝胶等方法制备出YBCO超导薄膜。
explanation_en: The abbreviation of the second generation high temperature superconducting tape. It is composed of metal baseband, barrier layer, buffer layer, superconducting layer and protective layer. The superconducting layer is mainly RE-BC ü superconducting film. Coated conductor plays an important role in the future superconducting applications. The preparation methods of coated conductor strips can be divided into physical methods and chemical methods; The main difference is that the physical method uses pulsed laser deposition (PLD) to bombard the oxide rake material with a pulsed laser beam to prepare YBCO superconducting layer films, while the chemical method uses metal organic salts, combined with vapor deposition or sol-gel methods to prepare YBCO superconducting films.

explanation_cn: 用化学气相沉积（CVD)或物理气相沉积法（PVD).在硬质合金刀片的表面气相沉积等高硬度陶瓷材料得到的刀具。由于硬质合金刀片能经受高温，因而多数选用涂层结合力较高的CVD法。但由于其硬度高.因而可以大大延长刀片使用寿命。涂层刀片具有导热、阻止工件与刀具黏结、抗氧化和牛.成氧化物1'丨润滑膜等作用。涂层刀具适用于重粗加工、间断切削、铣削以及高速切削铸铁。不宜切削含磷工件、奥氏体钢、司太立合金、玻璃钢等。
explanation_en: The tool is made of high hardness ceramics materials such as chemical vapor deposition (CVD) or physical vapor deposition (PVD) on the surface of hardmetal inserts. Since hardmetal inserts can withstand high temperatures, CVD method with high coating adhesion is mostly used. But because of its high hardness, it can greatly extend the service life of the blade. Coated blades have functions such as thermal conductivity, preventing adhesion between the workpiece and the tool, oxidation resistance, and forming an oxide 1 '- lubricating film. Coated tools are suitable for heavy rough machining, intermittent cutting, milling and high-speed cutting of cast iron. It is not suitable to cut phosphorus containing workpieces, austenitic steel, stellite alloy, glass steel, etc.

explanation_cn: 将某种物质涂覆于纤维表面，以改进其特性的复合纤维。例如塑料光导纤维是在聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯纤维的外层涂上聚冈氟乙烯后，纤维的耐磨损性、挠曲性、难熔性以及光损耗等性能都得到改善，属于典型的涂层纤维。
explanation_en: A composite fiber coated with a substance to improve its properties. For example, plastic optical fiber is a typical coated fiber, whose abrasion resistance, flexibility, refractory and optical loss properties have been improved after the outer layer of polymethyl methacrylate fiber is coated with polyvinylfluoride.

explanation_cn: 又称镀层钢板。在具有良好深冲性能的低碳薄钢板表面涂覆Sn、Zn、Al、Pb-Sn合金、有机涂料和塑料等，使其耐腐蚀性能显著提高或具备特殊表面功能如装饰功能的薄钢板制品。常用的涂（镀）层钢板包括：镀锡薄板、无锡钢板、镀锌钢板、镀铝钢板、镀铅-锡合金钢板和有机涂层钢板（彩涂钢板）等。
explanation_en: Also known as coated steel plate. Low carbon steel sheet with good deep drawing performance is coated with Sn, Zn, Al, Pb Sn alloy, organic coatings and plastics to significantly improve its corrosion resistance or steel sheet products with special surface functions such as decoration. Commonly used coated (plated) steel plate include: tinplate, tin-free steel sheet, galvanized steel plate, aluminium coated sheet, lead plated tin alloy steel plate and organic coated steel sheet (prepainted steel sheet).

explanation_cn: 涂料使用单位。指以正常方式在某一适当表面上用一定量涂料或清漆涂装而遮盖住该表面的面积，通常用平方米/公斤或平方米/公升表示。主要用于计算涂料的使用量和核算施工成本。它受许多因素影响，如被涂表面的孔隙度、结构形状、施工方法、操作人员的熟练程度、膜厚控制等。理论涂布率通常基于理想条件下的施H(指在完全平整没有粗糙度的表面施工完全均匀的涂膜，且没有任何浪费），实际上这种理想条件是不存在的。因此.实际操作中存在一定的"涂料损耗"。这些损耗包括表观损失（因表面粗糙度及涂料分布不均匀所造成的损失）与实际损失（因损耗和浪费引起的损失）。I其中涂料分布损失是指经验丰富的涂料工人为达到所规定的最低膜厚.而涂装过多的涂料所产生的损失。通常，涂料损耗量与施工方法（刷涂、滚涂、常规喷涂或无空气喷涂等）、被涂底材的结构类型（平坦表面、凹凸不平表面等）及膜厚控制水平等相关。而损耗系数主要取决于实施：而与涂料关系不大。
explanation_en: Coatings user. It refers to the area covered by a certain amount of coatings or varnish on a proper surface in a normal way, usually expressed in square meters/kg or square meters/liter. It is mainly used to calculate the usage of coatings and calculate the construction cost. It is affected by many factors, such as porosity of the coated surface, structural shape, construction method, operator's proficiency, film thickness control, etc. The theoretical spreading rate is usually based on the application of H under ideal conditions (that is, to apply a completely uniform coating on a completely flat surface without roughness, without any waste). In fact, this ideal condition does not exist. Therefore, there is a certain "coatings loss" in actual operation. These losses include apparent loss (loss caused by uneven distribution of surface roughness and coatings) and actual loss (loss caused by loss and waste). I The loss of coatings distribution refers to the loss caused by excessive coatings coating by experienced coatings workers in order to reach the specified minimum film thickness. Generally, the loss of coatings is related to the construction method (brush coating, roller coating, conventional spraying or airless spraying, etc.), the structure type of the substrate to be coated (flat surface, uneven surface, etc.) and the film thickness control level. The loss coefficient mainly depends on the implementation: it has little to do with coatings.

explanation_cn: 原纸的面层、底层以漂白木浆为主，中间层加有机械木浆，经单面或双面涂布后，以经压光整饰制成的纸板。主要用于印制拳术印刷品或印刷后制作高档商品的包装纸盒。
explanation_en: The surface layer and bottom layer of the original paper are mainly made of bleached wood pulp, and the middle layer is added with mechanical wood pulp. After being coated on one or both sides, the cardboard is made by pressing and finishing. Mainly used for printing boxing prints or packaging boxes for high-end goods after printing.

explanation_cn: 原纸的面层为漂白木浆，经单面涂布后压光整饰制成的纸板。在单面彩色印刷后，用于制作包装纸盒。
explanation_en: The surface layer of the original paper is bleached wood pulp, which is coated on one side and then pressed and polished to make cardboard. After single-sided color printing, it is used to make packaging paper boxes.

explanation_cn: 俗称铜版纸。在原纸一面或两面涂布，经汛光整饰制成的印刷纸。光泽度高，吸墨性好，呈现的图像逼真。用于单色或多色印刷生产画册、日历等。
explanation_en: Commonly known as coated paper. A printing paper made by coating one or both sides of the original paper and finishing it with flood light. High glossiness, good ink absorption, and realistic images. Used for monochrome or multi-color printing production of picture albums, calendars, etc.

explanation_cn: 俗称漆。凡涂敷于物体表面能十结成坚韧而连续膜的物料统称为涂料。
explanation_en: Commonly known as lacquer. Materials that can form a tough and continuous film on the surface energy of an object are collectively referred to as coatings.

explanation_cn: 能降低聚合物制品表面反射程度且消除其部分光泽的添加剂，涂料行业中常用的有如下两类：①无机二氧化硅、高岭土、硅藻土等无机填料②有机主要是蜡，其中用处最多的是合成蜡及硬脂酸的金属皂等。
explanation_en: Additive that can reduce the surface reflection of polymer products and eliminate part of their gloss are commonly used in the coatings industry as follows: ① inorganic fillers such as inorganic silica, kaolin, diatomite, etc. ② organic fillers are mainly waxes, among which synthetic waxes and metal soaps of stearic acid are the most useful.

explanation_cn: 外观表面无光泽的化学纤维，亦称无光纤维。一般条件下化学纤维表面具有较强的光泽，有时致使外观不佳。其改善方法一般在纺丝前将消光剂加入纺丝溶液或熔体中，经纺丝成型。使纤维散射光线而消除光泽，降低透明度，使之悦目。如在生产过程中未经物理或化学方法作消光处理的化学纤维称冇光纤维。有光、无光或消光都是相对语。消光剂一般用二氧化钛，要求粒度很细。粒度范围大部分在1微米以下。消光纤维中所含消光剂浓度，大多在0.03%-2.0%范围。弹性纤维所含消光剂浓度可高达4%。根据消光度的不同可分为有光纤维、半消光纤维和消光纤维等。
explanation_en: The man-made fiber with dull surface is also called matte fiber. Under general conditions, the surface of man-made fiber has a strong gloss, sometimes resulting in poor appearance. The improvement method is generally that flatting agent is added into the spinning solution or melt before spinning, and is spun into shape. Make fibers scatter light and eliminate luster, reduce transparency, and make them pleasing to the eye. For example, man-made fiber that has not been subject to physical or chemical matting treatment during production is called no optical fiber. Light, no light, or extinction are all relative terms. The flatting agent is usually titanium dioxide, which requires very fine particle size. The particle size range is mostly below 1 micron. The concentration of flatting agent in dull fiber is mostly in the range of 0.03% -2.0%. The concentration of flatting agent in elastic fiber can reach 4%. According to the different degree of extinction, it can be divided into bright fiber, semi dull fiber and dull fiber.

explanation_cn: 指用于杀灭传播媒介上病原微生物，将病原微生物消灭于人体之外。切断传染病的传播途径，达到控制传染病的目的药剂。消毒机理主要是通过与微生物的蛋白质发生氧化或其他化学反应，破坏微生物细胞壁、改变细胞膜的渗透性和原生质的胶体性质、改变有机体的DNA或KNA、抑制酶的活性。按照其作用的水平可分为火菌剂、高效、中效和低效消毒剂。灭菌剂可杀灭一切微生物使其达到灭菌要求，包括甲醛、戊二醛、环氧乙烷、过氧乙酸、过氧化氢、二氧化氯、氯气、硫酸铜、生石灰、乙醇等。高效消毒剂可杀灭一切细菌繁殖体（包括分枝杆菌）、病毒、真菌及其孢子等，对细菌芽孢也有一定杀灭作用，达到高水平消毒要求。包括含氯消毒剂、臭氧、甲基乙内酰类化合物、双链季铵盐等。中效消毒剂仅可杀灭分枝杆菌、真菌、病毒及细菌繁殖体等微生物，达到消毒要求.包括含碘消毒剂、醇类消毒剂、酚类消毒剂等。低效消毒剂仅可杀灭细菌繁殖体和亲酯病毒，达到消毒剂要求.包括苯扎溴铵等季铵盐类消毒剂、氯己定（洗必泰）等双胍类消毒剂，汞、银、铜,等金属离子类消毒剂及中草药消毒剂。
explanation_en: It refers to the use of killing pathogenic microorganisms on the transmission medium and eliminating pathogenic microorganisms outside the human body. Cut off the transmission route of infectious diseases and achieve the goal of controlling infectious diseases. The disinfection mechanism mainly involves oxidizing or other chemical reactions with microbial proteins, disrupting microbial cell walls, altering the permeability of cell membranes and the colloidal properties of protoplasm, altering the DNA or KNA of organisms, and inhibiting enzyme activity. According to its action level, it can be divided into pyrogen, high efficiency, medium efficiency and low efficiency disinfectant. The sterilizing agent can kill all microorganisms to meet the sterilization requirements, including formaldehyde, glutaraldehyde, ethylene oxide, peracetic acid, hydrogen peroxide, chlorine dioxide, chlorine, copper sulfate, quicklime, ethanol, etc. The highly effective disinfectant can kill all bacterial propagules (including mycobacteria), viruses, fungi and their spores, and can also kill bacterial spores to a certain extent, meeting the requirements of high-level disinfection. Including chlorine containing disinfectant, ozone, methyl hydantoin compounds, double chain quaternary ammonium salts, etc. Medium effect disinfectant can only kill microorganisms such as mycobacteria, fungi, viruses and bacterial propagules to meet the disinfection requirements, including iodine containing disinfectant, alcohol disinfectant, phenol disinfectant, etc. Low effective disinfectant can only kill bacterial propagules and lipophilic viruses, meeting the requirements of disinfectant, including quaternary ammonium disinfectant such as benzalkonium bromide, biguanide disinfectant such as chlorhexidine (chlorhexidine), metal ion disinfectant such as mercury, silver, copper, and Chinese herbal disinfectant.

explanation_cn: 是能消除或减少射击时炮口或炮尾二次燃烧火焰的装药组成部分或发射药的组成物质。火炮发射时由于火药燃气中的一氧化碳、氢与空气中的氧作用，常生成炮口焰和炮尾焰，常用的大都是钾盐。在发射时变成粉末状，与火药燃气一同逸出炮口，使火药气体难于和空气中的氧接触提高氧化碳和氢的发火点促使气相连锁反应的断裂。用量根据火炮口径、初速、炮口压力和燃气温度而变。一般为装药量的2%-15%。
explanation_en: It is a charge component or gun propellant component that can eliminate or reduce the secondary combustion flame at the muzzle or tail during firing. When the gun is launched, because of the interaction of carbon monoxide and hydrogen in propellant gas with oxygen in the air, muzzle flame and gun tail flame are often generated, mostly potassium salt. It becomes powder when fired and escapes from the muzzle together with propellant gas, making it difficult for propellant gas to contact with oxygen in the air, improving the ignition point of carbon oxide and hydrogen, and promoting fracture of gas phase chain reaction. The dosage varies based on the caliber, initial velocity, muzzle pressure, and gas temperature of the artillery. Usually 2% -15% of the charge.

explanation_cn: 掺有大量消焰剂的单基火药。发射时无焰或少焰。常用的消焰剂有硫酸钾、硝酸钾、碳酸钾、草酸钾、聚过氯乙烯等。用作火炮的发射装药。
explanation_en: Single base gunpowder mixed with a large amount of flash reducer. There is no flame or less flame during launch. The commonly used flash reducer are potassium sulfate, potassium nitrate, potassium carbonate, potassium oxalate, poly (perchloroethylene), etc. Used as a firing charge for artillery.

explanation_cn: 指具有消除恶臭功能的化学纤维，与活性碳纤维相比，其对硫醇、硫化氢等的持续吸附能力高100倍左右;对氨气和异祜草酸的吸附效果，比椰壳活性炭髙2050倍;并可除去人尿与牛、猪、鸡等家畜的屎尿、鱼腥和臭污泥等几乎所有天然恶臭。这类纤维是由消臭剂或催化剂和纤维载体构成的，消臭剂或催化剂具有活性中心。能对恶臭物质起催化反应而达到消臭的。代表性的消臭剂有酞箐铁等用量约3%(质量分数）即可满足要求。纤维载体要求具备以下性能：多孔，表面积大;在空气中使用时需要具有疏水和亲水两种基团.使恶臭物质能接近消臭活性中心，在水介质中使用时.需要具有多的亲水基团;有时，恶臭反应副产物也具有臭味因此需具有容易吸附它们的能力;容易加工成型。可用作床上用品、尿布、鞋袜运动衣、空气净化器滤材、窗帘、壁纸、天花板等。
explanation_en: It refers to man-made fiber with odor elimination function. Compared with activated carbon fiber, its continuous adsorption capacity for mercaptan, hydrogen sulfide, etc. is about 100 times higher; The adsorption effect on ammonia and isohumic acid is 2050 times higher than that of coconut shell activated carbon; And it can remove almost all natural odors such as feces and urine, fishy odor, and foul sludge from human urine, cattle, pigs, chickens, and other livestock. This type of fiber is composed of deodorants or catalysts and fiber carriers, which have active centers. Capable of catalyzing the reaction of odorous substances to achieve deodorization. Typical deodorants include phthalocyanine, iron, etc. The dosage is about 3% (mass fraction), which can meet the requirements. Fiber carriers require the following properties: porous, large surface area; When used in the air, it is necessary to have two types of functional groups: hydrophobic and hydrophilic, so that the odorous substance can approach the deodorizing active center. When used in an aqueous medium, it needs to have multiple hydrophilic groups; Sometimes, byproducts of foul odor reactions also have a foul odor, so they need to have the ability to easily adsorb them; Easy to process and shape. It can be used as bedding, diaper, shoes, socks, sportswear, air purifier filter material, curtain, wall paper, ceiling, etc.

explanation_cn: 单体在聚合过程中，其结构中的部分组分脱除掉，从而生成重复单元与单体结构不同的聚合物。
explanation_en: In the process of polymerization of monomer, some components in its structure are removed, thus generating polymer with different repeating unit and monomer structure.

explanation_cn: 又称喷泉流动、喷泉效应，是由Rose在20世纪70年代末最早提出的，通常发生在注塑成型过程中，当聚合物熔体从浇口注入模腔时，熔体并不是通过简单的向前推进到达模壁，而是先从模腔中心流动到前端区域，然后再从前端区域转向两侧并逐步充满模壁附近的区域，熔体前端的流动就会出现类似喷泉状的曲线流动形式。现象在冷模充模过程中会更加明显。会对流动诱导高分子分子链取向的方向产生很大的影响.进而会影响制品的微观形态结构。远离流动前端处的流动前端
explanation_en: Also known as fountain flow and fountain effect, it was first proposed by Rose in the late 1970s. It usually occurs in the injection molding process. When polymer melt is injected into the mold cavity from the gate, the melt does not simply move forward to the mold wall, but first flows from the center of the mold cavity to the front area, then turns from the front area to both sides and gradually fills the area near the mold wall, The flow at the front end of the melt will exhibit a fountain like curved flow pattern. The phenomenon becomes more pronounced during the cold mold filling process. It will have a great impact on the direction of flow induced orientation of macromolecule molecular chain, and then affect the micromorphology of the product. Move away from the flow front end

explanation_cn: 又称维护充电。涓流充电是一种用来弥补电池在充满电后由于自放电而造成的容量损失，使蓄电池保持在近似完全充电状态下连续小电流的充电。一般采用脉冲电流充电来实现上述目的。
explanation_en: It is also called maintenance charging. Trickle charging is a kind of charging that is used to make up for the capacity loss caused by self-discharge after the battery is fully charged, so that the accumulator can be kept in a state of nearly full charge with continuous low current. Pulse current charging is generally used to achieve the above objectives.

explanation_cn: 一种以电磁感应为基础，通过测定检测线圈阻抗变化来确定被检材料有无缺陷的方法。当载有交变电流的检测线圈靠近导电材料时，由于线圈磁场的作用，材料中会感生出涡流，涡流的大小、相位及流动形式受到材料导电性能的影响，而涡流产生的反作用磁场又使线圈的阻抗发生变化，因此通过测量检测线圈阻抗的变化，可以得到被检材料有无缺陷的结论。
explanation_en: A method based on electromagnetic induction to determine whether the materials to be inspected has defects by measuring the impedance change of the detection coil. When the test coil with alternating current is close to conductive material, eddy current will be induced in materials due to the effect of coil magnetic field. The size, phase and flow form of eddy current are affected by the conductivity of materials, and the reaction magnetic field generated by eddy current will change the impedance of the coil. Therefore, through measuring the change of the impedance of the test coil, it can be concluded whether the materials is defective.

explanation_cn: 原指液体对其他物体的浸湿能力，但也吋推广到任何两种物相之间相互浸润和附着的能力。
explanation_en: Originally, it refers to the wetting ability of liquid to other objects, but it also extends to the ability of any two phase to infiltrate and adhere to each other.

explanation_cn: 液体润湿单位表面的固体时释放出热量，适用于粉末状间体。根据热力学，在恒温恒压下，润湿发生的条件是表面自由能变化小于0。表面自由能变化越负.固体被润湿的趋势越大。润湿热实质上相当于比表面积自由能的降低值。
explanation_en: When a liquid wets a solid on a unit surface, it releases heat and is suitable for powder like intermetallic materials. According to thermodynamics, at constant temperature and pressure, the condition of wetting is that the change of surface free energy is less than 0. The more negative the change of surface free energy, the greater the tendency of solid wetting. Heat of wetting is essentially equivalent to the reduction of free energy of specific surface.

explanation_cn: 又称浸润角。在固、液、气三相交界处，自固-液界面经过液体内部到气-液界面之间的夹角称为接触角。通常以0表示。将一滴液体放在一均匀平滑的固体表面上，有时是液体完全展开，覆盖在固体表面；有时是液滴停留在液体表面，且与同体表面形成一定的角度.即接触角。
explanation_en: It is also called contact angle. At the junction of solid, liquid and gas phases, the included angle from the solid-liquid interface through the liquid interior to the gas-liquid interface is called the contact angle. Usually represented by 0. Place a drop of liquid on a uniform and smooth solid surface, sometimes with the liquid fully unfolded and covering the solid surface; Sometimes, the droplets stay on the liquid surface and form a certain angle with the same surface, that is, the contact angle.

explanation_cn: 见润滑材料。
explanation_en: See lubrication materials.

explanation_cn: 又称润滑剂。具有减少两摩擦表面之间的摩擦力和磨损或其他形式表面破坏的性能的任何物质。可分为气体、液体、半固体和固体四种基本类型。最常用的气体润滑材料是空气，如气体轴承。应用最广的液体润滑材料是润滑油，包括矿物油、动植物油、合成油和各神乳剂。
explanation_en: Also called lubricant. Any substance that has the property of reducing friction between two friction surfaces and wear or other forms of surface damage. It can be divided into four basic types: gas, liquid, semi solid, and solid. The most commonly used gas lubrication materials is air, such as gas bearings. The most widely used liquid lubrication materials is lubricating oil, including mineral oil, animal and vegetable oil, synthetic oil and various emulsions.

explanation_cn: 为提高润滑材料原有性能或获得新的特性而加入很少量（从百分之几到百万分之几），但对润滑材料性能带来巨大改善的物质。
explanation_en: In order to improve the original performance of lubrication materials or obtain new characteristics, a small amount of materials (from a few percent to a few million percent) are added, but the properties of lubrication materials are greatly improved.

explanation_cn: 某些有色的同体润滑剂可作为润滑颜料，如二硫化钼、二硒化钼、石墨、氧化锑、二硫化钨、二硒化钨等。
explanation_en: Some colored homologous lubricant can be used as lubricant pigment, such as molybdenum disulfide, molybdenum selenide, graphite, antimony oxide, tungsten disulfide, tungsten selenide, etc.

explanation_cn: 是指以丁二烯和丙烯腈为主链结构、常温下呈黏稠液体状存在、分子量小于10000的橡胶，主要通过自由基乳液聚合获得"按照所含基闭分类，液体丁腈橡胶可以分为无官能团类、无规官能团类以及端官能团类三种橡胶。官能团以为羟基、羧基、氨基、巯基、卤基以及异氰酸酯基等。由于分子链中含有氰基基团，能很好地溶于酮类、苯类等极性溶剂，而在非极性溶剂中溶解性能较差，分子量较低，流动性能、黏合性较好.液体丁腈橡胶主要缺点为弹性不足、不活泼的游离链段比较多，直接硫化得到的硫化胶的力学性能比丁腈橡胶差，主要用作丁腈橡胶的增塑剂，以及制备胶黏剂、密封剂、涂料、电绝缘材料和火箭推进剂等。
explanation_en: It refers to the rubber with butadiene and acrylonitrile as the main chain structure, which exists in the form of viscous liquid at room temperature, and its molecular weight is less than 10000, Mainly obtained through free radical emulsion polymerization "According to the classification of the contained groups, liquid nitrile-butadiene rubber can be divided into three types of rubber: non functional groups, random functional groups and end functional groups. The functional groups are hydroxyl, carboxyl, amino, mercapto, halo and isocyanate groups. Because the molecular chain contains cyano groups, it can be well dissolved in ketones, benzene and other polar solvents, while in non-polar solvents it has poor solubility, low molecular weight, good flow performance and adhesion The main disadvantages of liquid nitrile-butadiene rubber are insufficient elasticity and more inactive free chain segment. The mechanical properties of vulcanized rubher obtained by direct vulcanization are worse than those of acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber. It is mainly used as plasticizer of acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber, as well as the preparation of adhesive, sealants, coatings, electrical insulation materials and rocket propellant.

explanation_cn: 平均分子量一般为500-10000的液体丁二烯和苯乙烯的共聚物，其合成方法与液体聚丁二烯橡胶类似，一般采用由基聚合方法制备。可用作丁苯橡胶、丁腈橡胶和氯丁橡胶的增塑剂，或作为胶黏剂、密封材
explanation_en: The copolymer of liquid butadiene and styrene with a average molecular weight of 500-10000 is generally prepared by radical polymerization, similar to that of liquid polybutadiene rubber. It can be used as plasticizer of styrene butadiene rubber, acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber and chloroprene rubber, or as adhesive and sealing material

explanation_cn: 使用形态为液体的冷却剂。常用的有轻水、重水和液态金属钠。冷却剂的特点是：具有良好的传热性和流动性，高沸点、低熔点、泵送功率低，对热和辐射有良好的稳定性，在反应堆系统下不产生腐蚀.感生放射性低.中子俘获截面小。液体沥青见沥青溶液。
explanation_en: Use a coolant in the form of a liquid. Light water, heavy water and liquid metal sodium are commonly used. The coolant is characterized by good heat transfer and flow ability, high boiling point, low melting point, low pumping power, good stability to heat and radiation, no corrosion under the reactor system, low induced radioactivity and small neutron capture section. See hitumastic solution for liquid pitch.

explanation_cn: 用于发射枪炮弹丸的液体能源。嵙单组元和双组元液体发射药两类。用于单组元的物质有硝基甲烷、肼、过氧化氢、硝酸乙酯等;可用于双组元液体发射药的物系有硝酸-肼、过氧化氢-肼等。主要优点是能量高、爆温低、烧蚀性小，存在的主要问题是还不能有效控制燃烧过程。目前尚处在研究阶段
explanation_en: A liquid energy source used to launch firearms and bullets. There are two types of monopropellant and bipropellant liquid gun propellant. Substances used for single component include nitromethane, hydrazine, hydrogen peroxide, ethyl nitrate, etc; The materials that can be used for bipropellant liquid gun propellant include nitric acid hydrazine, hydrogen peroxide hydrazine, etc. The main advantages are high energy, low explosion temperature and low ablation. The main problem is that the combustion process cannot be effectively controlled. Currently in the research stage

explanation_cn: 又称解聚橡胶.指将天然橡胶的分子量降解至1万2万范围而得到的一种黏稠而有流动性黏流体橡胶。液体天然橡胶具有天然橡胶的一些基本的物化性能.由于分子量较低，通常用于橡胶加工助剂。将降解天然橡胶分子末端接上活性官能基团，既能实现链的扩展和链的交联，也为功能单体的接枝改性提供了可能.拓展了液体天然橡胶的应用范围，是的主要产品。主要应用于黏合剂、复杂橡胶制品、防护涂层、多功能加工助剂、橡胶增黏剂以及填料改性剂。
explanation_en: Also known as depolymerized rubber, it refers to a viscous and flow ability viscous fluid rubber obtained by degradation the molecular weight of natural rubber to 120000. Liquid natural rubber has some basic physical and chemical properties of natural rubber. Due to its low molecular weight, it is usually used as rubber processing aids. The end of degradation natural rubber molecule is connected with active functional groups, which can not only realize chain expansion and crosslinking of the chain, but also provide the possibility of graft modification of functional monomer. It expands the application range of liquid natural rubber, which is the main product of. Mainly used in adhesive, complex rubber products, protective coatings, multi-functional processing additive, rubber tackifier and filler modifier.

explanation_cn: 两种不同电解质的溶液.或电解质相同但浓度不同的两种溶液相接触时.在液体接界处存在浓度梯度，离子从高浓度的一侧向低浓度的一侧扩散。阴、阳离子由于浓度不同，即运动速率不同.导致界面两侧电荷分布不均衡，产生电位差，称为液体接界电位。液体接界电位不是电极反应所产生的，因此会影响电池电动势的测定。在多数电化学实验中.需尽可能降低液体接界电位以减少附加影响.使用合适的盐桥是一个有效的办法。液体介质连续硫化法见盐浴硫化。
explanation_en: When two solutions with different elonrolyte or two solutions with the same elonrolyte but different concentrations phase, there is a concentration gradient at the liquid junction, and ions diffusion from the high concentration side to the low concentration side. Due to different concentrations of anions and cations, that is, different movement rates, the charge distribution on both sides of the interface is uneven, resulting in potential difference, which is called liquid junction potential. The liquid junction potential is not generated by the electrode reaction, so it will affect the measurement of the battery electromotive force. In most electrochemical experiments, it is necessary to reduce the liquid junction potential as much as possible to reduce additional effects. The use of appropriate salt bridges is an effective method. See salt bath cure vulcanization for continuous vulcanization of liquid medium.

explanation_cn: 分子量一般在1000-4000的2-氯-1,3-丁二烯的均聚物，常温下为液体。又称液体氯丁二烯橡胶。液体氯丁橡胶分子结构规整，易结晶.可以很好地溶解在固体氯丁橡胶所用的有机溶剂中，制备高浓度、低黏度溶液。
explanation_en: The homopolymer of 2-chloro-1,3-butadiene with molecular weight of 1000-4000 is liquid at normal temperature. Also known as liquid chloroprene rubber. Liquid polychloroprene rubber has regular molecular structure and is easy to crystallize. It can be well dissolved in organic solvents used for solid chloroprene rubber to prepare solutions with high concentration and low viscosity.

explanation_cn: 以液体状态进入发动机推力室.为推进系统提供能量和工质的物质.简称液体推进剂。按来源分为石油基和化学基;按使用方式分为双组元液体推进剂、单组元液体推进剂和三组元液体推进剂;按点火方式分为自燃推进剂和非自燃推进剂。单组元推进剂分为H类：一类是单一化合物单组元推进剂，分子中同时含有可燃性元素与燃烧所必需的氧的物质，如硝酸丙酯;一类是混合物单组元推进剂，如肼-硝酸肼-水体系;一类是分解时放出大量热和气体的吸热化合物，如无水肼。液体推进剂比冲较高、推力吋调、能多次启动和短脉冲工作。与固体推进剂相比.密度较低，大都易燃易爆或有毒.存在泄漏危险性，加注耗时。已广泛用于卫星、运载火箭、导弹、飞船、空间站、深空探测器、航天飞机、歼击机和鱼雷。
explanation_en: A substance that enters the engine thrust chamber in a liquid state to provide energy and working fluid for the propulsion system, abbreviated as liquid propellant. Classified by source into petroleum based and chemical based; It can be divided into two component liquid propellants, one component liquid propellants, and three component liquid propellants according to their usage; According to the ignition mode, it can be divided into hypergolic propellant and non hypergolic propellant. Monocomponent propellants are divided into H types: one is single compound monopropellant, which contains both flammability elements and oxygen necessary for combustion, such as propyl nitrate; One type is a mixture of single component propellants, such as the hydrazine nitrate hydrazine water system; One type is endothermic compounds that release a large amount of heat and gas during decomposition, such as anhydrous hydrazine. Liquid propellant has high specific impulse, timely thrust adjustment, multiple starting and short pulse operation. Compared with solid propellant, the density is low, most of which are flammable, explosive or toxic. There is a risk of leakage, and filling time is time-consuming. It has been widely used in satellites, launch vehicles, missiles, spacecraft, space stations, deep space probes, space shuttles, fighter jets, and torpedoes.

explanation_cn: 燃料溶解或弥散在液态金属中的核燃料。溶剂金属要求熔点低，热中子吸收截面小。液体金属燃料中需加缓蚀剂（如锆）和除氧剂（如镁）。液体金属燃料有以下优点：可在高温低压下运行;热导率高;裂变气体可随时排出，中子经济性好。缺点是：腐蚀性强;需预热且泵送复杂;需采用高浓铀。液体金属核燃料用于液体金属快中子堆或石墨慢化的热中子堆。
explanation_en: Nuclear fuel dissolved or dispersed in liquid metal. Solvent metal requires low melting point and small thermal neutron absorption cross section. Corrosion inhibitor (such as zirconium) and deoxidizer (such as magnesium) shall be added to liquid metal fuel. Liquid metal fuel has the following advantages: it can operate under high temperature and low pressure; High thermal conductivity; Fission gas can be discharged at any time, and neutron economy is good. The disadvantage is: strong corrosiveness; Preheating is required and pumping is complex; Highly enriched uranium is required. Liquid metal nuclear fuel is used in liquid metal fast reactor or graphite moderated thermal reactor.

explanation_cn: 是指以液态形式存在的聚碳硅烷.包括具有液态超支化聚碳硅烧和液态低分子量聚碳硅烷，通常指前者。超支化聚碳硅烷可以简单描述为具有高度支化结构的聚合物其支化度大于支化聚合物而小于树形分子。LHBPCS合成方法有很多，包括开环聚合、Grignard偶联和桂氢化反应等。LHBPCS具有流动性好、可自交联及陶瓷产率高等优点，是制备SiC陶瓷的理想先驱体，最具代表性的LHBPCS是美国Starfire公司合成的烯丙基取代的氣化聚碳桂烧（AHPCS)。AHPCS分子组成Si/C接近1:1(摩尔比），室温为液态，具有良好的流动性、可自交联、高陶瓷产率以及裂解产物近SiC化学计量比等特点，是制备SiC基复合材料较理想的先驱体。由于LHBPCS中含大量的活性基团，如Si-H键、乙烯或乙炔基等不饱和基闭，通过功能化改性后还可应用于材料改性剂、催化剂、生物材料、高聚物薄膜等。
explanation_en: It refers to polycarbosilane in liquid form, including liquid hyperbranched polycarbosilane and liquid low molecular weight polycarbosilane, usually referring to the former. Hyperbranched polycarbosilane can be simply described as a polymer with highly branched structure, whose degree of branching is greater than that of branched polymer and smaller than that of dendrimer. There are many synthetic methods for LHBPCS, including ring opening polymerization, Grignard coupling and hydrogenation of cinnamon. LHBPCS has the advantages of good flow ability, self-crosslinking and high ceramics yield. It is an ideal precursor for preparing SiC ceramics. The most representative LHBPCS is the allyl substituted gasification polycarbonate calcine (AHPCS) synthesized by Starfire Company in the United States. AHPCS molecular composition Si/C is close to 1:1 (molar ratio), and it is liquid at room temperature. It has good flow ability, self-crosslinking, high ceramics yield, and pyrolysis product near SiC stoichiometry. It is an ideal precursor for preparing SiC based composite materials. Because LHBPCS contains a large number of active groups, such as Si-H bond, ethylene or ethynyl and other unsaturated groups, it can also be applied to materials modifiers, catalysts, biological materials, polymer films, etc. after functional modification.

explanation_cn: 液态金属中的无长程有序而只存在短程有序的结构，可描述成是中瞬时存在瞬时消失的具有短程有序的原子才所组成的。如用X射线衍射法测量原子分布函数，在短程内，液态金属与其固态相近.是不连续的，而且原子密度也相近;但在长程内，液态金属不再与其固态相近，固态的函数仍保持其不连续的特征.而液态的函数则变为连续的。
explanation_en: The structure in liquid metals that does not have long-range order but only has short-range order can be described as consisting of atoms with short-range order that disappear instantaneously. For example, if the atomic distribution function is measured by X-ray diffraction method, in a short distance, the liquid metal is similar to its solid state, which is discontinuous, and the atomic density is also similar; But over a long range, liquid metals are no longer close to their solid state, and the function of the solid state remains discontinuous. However, the function of the liquid state becomes continuous.

explanation_cn: 在一定温度与拉应力作用下，一种液态金属在另一种固体材料表面优先吸附在应力集中区域，或沿其晶界渗入材料内部.引起该固体材料脆化而导致失效。
explanation_en: Under the action of a certain temperature and tensile stress, a liquid metal preferentially adsorbs in the stress concentration area on the surface of another solid surface of materials, or penetrates into the materials along its grain boundary, which causes the embrittlement of the solid materials and leads to failure.

name_cn: 液晶显示器用玻璃基板
name_en: glass substrate for liquid crystal display panels
explanation_cn: 一种表面极其平整的薄玻璃片，是构成液晶显示器件的一个基本部件，采用浮法、流孔下引法或溢流熔融法生产的薄玻璃片。其厚度为050.7mm,甚至更薄（如小于等于0.4mm)。主要应用在(TN,扭曲向列型）面板，超级扭曲向列液晶显示器,薄膜晶体管液晶显示器（TFT-LCD)等电子产品中。
explanation_en: A type of thin glass sheet with an extremely flat surface, which is a basic component of liquid crystal display devices. It is produced by float method, flow hole downdraft method, or overflow melting method. Its thickness is 050.7mm or even thinner (such as less than or equal to 0.4mm). Mainly used in electronic products such as TN (twisted nematic) panels, super twisted nematic liquid crystal displays, thin film transistor liquid crystal displays (TFT-LCD), etc.

explanation_cn: 液态下其分子位置无序但分子取向仍长程有序，其物相性质介于传统液体和固体晶体之间的材料。
explanation_en: In liquid state, the molecular position is disordered, but the molecular orientation is still long range ordered, and its phase properties are between traditional liquid and solid crystal materials.

explanation_cn: 结晶结构能在受热熔融或被溶剂溶解后，由各向异性的晶体.转变为各向同性的液体的一类高分子。根据液晶的形成条件，可分为溶致液晶、热致液晶、感应液晶、流致液晶;根据分子排列的形式和有序性的不同，可分为向列型液晶、近晶相液晶、手征性向列相液晶;按液晶基元所在位置分类.可分为主链型液晶、侧链型液晶。与小分子液晶相比高分子液晶具有下列特性：热稳定性大幅提高，热致液晶高分子有较大的相区温度，黏度大，流动行为与一般溶液显著不同;主要应用于制造高拉伸强度和高模量的纤维、复合材料、信息存储介质、精密温度指示材料、液晶显示材料、生物功能材料等。I主要品种：溶致液晶包括芳香族聚酰胺、聚酰胺酰肼、聚苯并噻唑、纤维素类等;热致液晶包括液晶芳香族聚酯等。
explanation_en: A class of macromolecule whose crystalline structure can be transformed from an anisotropic crystal to an isotropic liquid after being melted by heat or dissolved by solvent. According to the formation conditions of liquid crystal, it can be divided into lyotmpic liquid crystals, thermotropic liquid crystals, inductive liquid crystal and fluidic liquid crystal; According to the different molecular arrangement and order, it can be divided into nematic liquid crystal, smectic liquid crystal, chiral nematic liquid crystal; According to the location of liquid crystal units, they can be classified into main chain liquid crystals and side chain liquid crystals. Compared with small molecule liquid crystal, macromolecule liquid crystal has the following characteristics: thermal stability is greatly improved, thermotropic liquid crystals macromolecule has a larger phase zone temperature, viscosity is large, and flow behavior is significantly different from general solution; It is mainly used to manufacture fibers with high tensile strength and modulus, composite materials, information storage media, precision temperature indicating materials, liquid crystal display materials, biological functional materials, etc. I Main varieties: lyotmpic liquid crystals include aromatic polyamide, polyamide hydrazide, polybenzothiazole, cellulose, etc; Thermotropic liquid crystals include liquid crystal aromatic polyester, etc.

explanation_cn: 分子式H2，分子量2.016,由氢液化而成的无色无味透明液体。沸点-252.7t，冰点-259.1°C,沸点时密度为0.07077g/cm3,无腐蚀性，无毒。挥发成的氢气在空气中浓度足够高时，相对降低了空气中的氧浓度。会使人产生缺氧症状。氢气液化可制取。氢的液化采用压缩、膨胀、冷却、压缩循环过程，有高压液化和低压液化两法。能量高，与液氧组成双组元低温推进剂。
explanation_en: Molecular formula H2, molecular weight 2.016, a colorless and odorless transparent liquid formed by liquefaction of hydrogen. Boiling point: -252.7t, freezing point: -259.1 ° C, density at boiling point: 0.07077g/cm3, non corrosive, non-toxic. When the concentration of hydrogen gas evaporated in the air is high enough, it relatively reduces the oxygen concentration in the air. It can cause symptoms of hypoxia. Hydrogen liquefaction can be produced. The liquefaction of hydrogen involves compression, expansion, cooling, and compression cycles, with two methods available: high-pressure liquefaction and low-pressure liquefaction. It has high energy and forms bipropellant cryogenic propellant with liquid oxygen.

explanation_cn: 分子量32.00,淡蓝色透明液体。沸点一183°C,冰点一218.9°C,液化空气精馏得到。用作火箭发动机氧化剂。
explanation_en: Molecular weight 32.00, light blue transparent liquid. Boiling point -183 ° C, freezing point -218.9 ° C, obtained by distillation with liquefied air. Used as oxidizer for rocket engine.

explanation_cn: 一般称为氧化还原液流电池，是一种新型的大型电化学储能装置。液流电池正负电解液分开，分別通过外置循环泵进行循环，将正负电解液泵人电池反应体系之中，正负电解液分别在电极正负表面发生氧化还原化学反应，从而提供能量。通过将能量储存于电解液中，明显区别于电池的电极。目前已经发展出多种体系，如钒、Zn-Br电池等，已在部分储能项目中得到应用。
explanation_en: Commonly known as redox flow battery, it is a new type of large-scale electrochemical energy storage device. The positive and negative electrolytes of the flow redox cell are separated and circulated through an external circulating pump respectively. The positive and negative electrolytes are pumped into the battery reaction system. The positive and negative electrolytes respectively undergo redox chemical reactions on the positive and negative surfaces of the electrode to provide energy. By storing energy in an electrolyte, it is significantly different from the electrodes of a battery. At present, various systems have been developed, such as vanadium and Zn-Br batteries, which have been applied in some energy storage projects.

explanation_cn: 一种制备纳米粒子的方法，制备粉体材料的开始状态为液态，通过溶液反应获得均相溶液，除去溶剂后得到所需粉末的前驱体，经热解得到细小粉末。该方法具有设备简单、原料容易获得、纯度高、均匀性好、化学组成控制准确等优点，但适用范围较窄，主要用于氧化物纳米材料的制备。常见的液相反应法主要包括沉淀法、水热法、溶胶-凝胶法、微乳液法、喷雾法。
explanation_en: A method for preparing nano particles. The initial state of preparing powder materials is liquid. Homogeneous solution is obtained through solution reaction. The precursor of the required powder is obtained after solvent removal, and fine powder is obtained through pyrolysis. This method has the advantages of simple equipment, easy access to raw materials, high purity, good uniformity, accurate chemical composition control, etc., but its application scope is narrow, and it is mainly used for the preparation of oxide nanomaterials. Common liquid-phase reaction mainly include precipitation method, hydrothermal method, sol-gel method, microemulsion method and spray method.

explanation_cn: 在一定取向单晶讨底上从过饱和溶液中生长薄层单晶材料的技术。例如，以As为溶质的Ga的过饱和溶液在GaAs单晶衬底上生长GaAs薄层。其生长驱动力是溶液中溶质的过饱和度，其动力学过程为溶质扩散、对流输运到生长界面.并在衬底表面上吸附、反应、迁移、成核。其主要优点是生长设备简单、生长速率较高，与VPE相比，操作较安全、可广泛选择掺杂剂、易于控制外延层的组分和厚度。主要缺点是外延层表面形貌较差、对外延层与衬底晶格匹配的要求较高等。生长工艺按衬底与舟接触的方式来划分有：舟倾斜法、坩埚浸渍法、反应管旋转法和滑动舟法，后一方法的应用最广。控制溶液过饱和度有降温法和温差法;前者又分平衡冷却法、过冷法、步冷法和两相溶液冷却法等。液相外延是工业上生产多种化合物半导体外延材料主要工艺之一。
explanation_en: The technology of growing thin layer of single crystal materials from supersaturated solution on the basis of a certain orientation single crystal. For example, GaAs thin layers are grown on GaAs single crystal substrates by supersaturated solutions of Ga with As as solute. Its growth driving force is the supersaUiration degree of solute in solution, and its dynamic process is solute diffusion, convection transport to the growth interface, and adsorption, reaction, migration and nucleation on the substrate surface. Its main advantages are simple growth equipment, high growth rate, safer operation compared to VPE, wide selection of dopants, and easy control of the composition and thickness of the epitaxial layer. The main drawbacks are poor surface morphology of the epitaxial layer and high requirements for matching the epitaxial layer with the substrate lattice. The growth process is divided according to the way the substrate contacts the boat: boat tilting method, crucible immersion method, reaction tube rotation method, and sliding boat method, with the latter method being the most widely used. There are temperature drop method and temperature difference method to control supersaUiration degree of solution; The former is further divided into equilibrium cooling method, subcooling method, step cooling method, and two-phase solution cooling method. Liquid phase epitaxy (LPE) is one of the main processes for the industrial production of a variety of compound semiconductor epitaxial materials.

explanation_cn: 在足够高的烧结温度下，烧结坯内出现一定量的液相，则该烧结过程就是过程。由于液相的形成和铺展，粉末烧结系统的表面能迅速降低，组兀的扩散活性明显增力口，使烧结的压坯充分致密化甚至达到全致密。由于不施加外压力，在较低的烧结温度下可以得到致密的烧结件。因此，生产成本比其他高密度加工烧结的成本低。据估计，70%粉末冶金产品烧结过程是或与相关。其主要应用领域航天、航空材料（粉末钛合金、粉末高温合金）、硬质合金（钢结硬质合金)、电触头原件、金刚石工具（金刚石-金属）等。液相烧结分为两大类。一类是仅在很短的烧结时间内出现很少量液相的烧结，叫做瞬时，如烧结Fe粉与Cu粉的混合粉压坯时，有少量铜的熔化并进行扩散。另一类是在较长时间内有较大量液相存在的烧结，如硬质合金和高比重合金的烧结过程。
explanation_en: At a sufficiently high sintering temperature, a certain amount of liquid phase appears in the sintering billet, and the sintering process is a process. Due to the formation and spreading of the liquid phase, the surface energy of the powder sintering system decreases rapidly, and the diffusion activity of the composition increases significantly, making the sintering compact fully densification or even fully densified. Because no external pressure is applied, dense sintering parts can be obtained at lower sintering temperature. Therefore, the production cost is lower than that of other high density processing sintering. It is estimated that 70% of the sintering process of powder metallurgy products is or is related to. Its main application fields are aerospace, aerospace materials (P/M titanium alloy, powder metalluygy superalloy), hardmetal (steel bond hard alloy), electrical contact components, diamond tools (diamond metal), etc. Liquid phase sintering can be divided into two categories. One is sintering in which only a small amount of liquid phase occurs in a very short sintering time, which is called instantaneous. For example, when the mixed powder of sintering Fe powder and Cu powder is pressed into compact, a small amount of copper is melted and diffusion. The other is sintering in which a large amount of liquid phase exists for a long time, such as the sintering process of hardmetal and high specific gravity alloy.

explanation_cn: 是指单晶从液-同平衡系统中生长，分为单组分体系和多组分体系生K。单组分生长就是只有被生长的单晶成分;多组分生长，除了被沉积物外，还有第二组分的加入。是晶体生长中运用最广泛的方法，包括布里奇曼斯托克巴杰方法、提拉法、水热法、溶剂法等。每种方法都有各自的优缺点，运用的范围也各不相同。总之，比较容易控制.生长过程简单，生长晶体的纯度高和速率较快。是生长晶体时应优先选用的生长方法。
explanation_en: It refers to the growth of single crystal from the liquid-liquid equilibrium system, which is divided into single component system and multi-component system to generate K. One component growth means that only the single crystal component is grown; Multi component growth involves the addition of a second component in addition to being deposited. It is the most widely used method in crystal growth, including Bridgman Stoke Bajie method, pulling method method, hydrothermal method, flux growth method, etc. Each method has its own advantages and disadvantages, and the scope of application also varies. In a word, it is relatively easy to control. The growth process is simple, and the purity of crystal growth is high and the rate is fast. It is the preferred growth method for crystal growth.

explanation_cn: 淀粉不溶于水，在搅拌下可以悬浮于水中.随着加热温度提高而浑浊、膨胀、糊化成黏稠半透明液体，可根据具体要求加入各种不同的添加剂，改善性能。淀粉胶黏剂的制备方法有热凝法、碱化法、糊精法、氧化法等多种，其中常用的为氧化法。淀粉胶黏剂具有强度高、质量轻、无腐蚀、不污染、防潮、挺力大、韧性好、制造易、成本低等优点。
explanation_en: Starch is insoluble in water and can be suspended in water when stirred. With the increase of heating temperature, it will become turbid, swollen and gelatinized into a viscous translucent liquid. Various additive can be added according to specific requirements to improve performance. The preparation methods of starch adhesive include thermal coagulation, alkalization, dextrin and oxidation, among which the oxidation method is commonly used. Starch adhesive has the advantages of high strength, light weight, no corrosion, no pollution, moisture-proof, large stiffness, good toughness, easy manufacturing, low cost, etc.

explanation_cn: 聚合时采用溶剂或用单体本身作为分散介质，引发剂和生成的聚合物不溶于分散介质中，聚合物和溶剂混在一起，呈淤浆状，故名。这种聚合特点使体系黏度小，便于溶液的搅拌、散热，可用较高的单体浓度，提高单位设备生产率。目前此法用于高密度聚乙烯、聚丙烯和丁基橡胶、乙丙橡胶的生产。在丙烯聚合时可以直接用丙烯作介质，丙烯到达一定转化率后从聚合物中分出再回收，这样形成不用溶剂的，利于工业化生产。
explanation_en: In polymerization, solvent or monomer itself is used as dispersion medium. initiator and generated polymer are insoluble in the dispersion medium. polymer and solvent are mixed together in slurry form, hence the name. This polymerization feature makes the system viscosity small, which is convenient for solution agitation and heat dissipation. Higher monomer concentration can be used to improve unit equipment productivity. At present, this method is used in the production of high density polyethylene, polypropylene, butyl rubber and ethylene propylene rubber. In the polymerization of propylene, propylene can be directly used as the medium. Propylene can be separated from polymer and recycled after reaching a certain conversion rate, so as to form solvent free, which is conducive to industrial production.

explanation_cn: 合金经固溶处理后淬冷得到过饱和固溶体后进行时效保温，发生过饱和固溶体的脱溶析出使合金的强度和硬度升高的现象。
explanation_en: After solution treatment and quenching to obtain supersaturated solid solution of alloy, aging heat preservation is carried out, and the supersaturated solid solution desolvates to increase the strength and hardness of alloy.

explanation_cn: 其最高冷却速度达(106~108)K/s，使许多金属或离子化合物都能形成玻璃的方法。
explanation_en: Its maximum cooling rate is (106~108) K/s, which enables many metal or ionic compounds to glass forming method.

explanation_cn: 将合金加热得到相应的髙温相，然后快速冷却，获得低温亚稳组织的热处理工艺。大部分钢淬火处理后得到强度和硬度很高的马氏体组织，故淬火是使大部分钢铁材料强化的最重要的热处理工艺。而室温稳定组织为奥氏体的高合金含量的钢，淬火处理后得到单相均匀的奥氏体组织，其强度和硬度相对较低，故反而是一种软化工艺。钢的淬火工艺种类很多，按加热温度不同可分为：完全淬火、不完全淬火、亚温淬火、低温淬火等；按加热介质和加热方式的不同可分为：空气介质加热淬火、盐浴加热淬火、可控气氛加热淬火、真空加热淬火、感应加热淬火、余热淬火、二次加热淬火等；按所用的淬火介质的不同可分为：单液淬火、双液淬火、热浴淬火和气冷淬火等：按淬火冷却方式不同可分为：预冷淬火、连续冷却淬火、局部淬火、喷液淬火、等温淬火、分级淬火等。
explanation_en: The alloy is heated to obtain the corresponding high temperature phase, and then rapidly cooled to obtain the heat treatment process of low temperature metastable structure. Most steel get martensite with high strength and hardness after quenching, so quenching is the most important heat treatment process to strengthen most steel materials. However, for steel with high alloy content whose room temperature stable structure is austenite, single-phase uniform austenite structure is obtained after quenching treatment, and its strength and hardness are relatively low, so it is a bating process instead. There are many kinds of quenching processes for steel, which can be divided into complete quenching, unfull quenching, subthermal quenching, low temperature quenching, etc. according to different heating temperatures; According to different heating medium and heating method, it can be divided into: air medium heating quenching, salt bath heating quenching, controlled atmosphere heating quenching, vacuum heating quenching, induction heating quenching, residual heat quenching, secondary heating quenching, etc; According to the different quenchant used, it can be divided into: single liquid quenching, two-liquid quenching quenching, hot bath quenching and air cooling quenching; according to the different cooling methods of quenching, it can be divided into: precooling quenching, continuous cooling quenching, local hardening, liquid injection quenching, isothermal quenching, marquwiching, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称冷却介质。工件萍火冷却时将工件热量带走所用的载体。主要有水、水溶液（氯化钠、苛性碱、硝酸盐、亚硝酸盐等的水溶液）、熔融盐浴、矿物油、有机聚合物溶液、铅浴以及固体金属等。对淬透性很高的钢。空气也可作为淬火介质。
explanation_en: Also called cooling medium. The carrier used to remove the heat from the workpiece during cooling. It mainly includes water, aqueous solution (aqueous solution of sodium chloride, caustic soda, nitrate, nitrite, etc.), molten salt bath, mineral oil, organic polymer solution, lead bath, solid metal, etc. Steel with high hardenabilhy. Air can also be used as a quenchant.

explanation_cn: 钢在淬火过程中所产生的缺陷，包括淬火裂纹、淬火变形、氧化脱碳、过热过烧、表面腐蚀、硬度偏低及软点等。产生淬火缺陷的原因主要有：钢材本身存在偏析、带状组织、夹杂物等冶金缺陷，工件截面尺寸变化大（如尖棱、锐角、薄刃、刀痕等），淬火介质选择不当或浸人淬火液方式合理，装炉时工件放置不妥以及加热温度过低或过高等。在各种淬火缺陷中，较为普遍的是淬火变形与裂纹，它们是由于加热冷却过程中所产生的热应力与组织应力所引起的。要避免淬火缺陷的形成，需从选材、工件设计、加工锻造工艺、预先热处理工艺以及淬火操作方法上综合考虑。
explanation_en: Defects of steel during quenching include quenching cracks, quenching deformation, oxidation decarburization, overheating oversintering/over- burning, surface corrosion, low hardness and soft spots. The main reasons for quenching defect are: steel product itself has segregation, banded structure, inclusions and other metallurgical defects, the size of workpiece section changes greatly (such as sharp edges, acute angles, thin edges, knife marks, etc.), quenchant is improperly selected or immersed in quenching liquid in a reasonable way, the workpiece is improperly placed during charging, and the heating temperature is too low or too high. Among various quenching defect, quenching deformation and cracks are more common, which are caused by thermal stress and structural stress generated during heating and cooling. To avoid the formation of quenching defect, comprehensive consideration should be given to material selection, workpiece design, processing and forging process, pre heat treatment process and quenching operation method.

explanation_cn: 钢在理想条件下萍火所能获得的最高硬度的大小。所谓理想条件是指可得到完全马氏体且未发生自回火的最佳条件。淬硬性主要与马氏体中的碳含量有关，碳含量越高，淬火硬度越高即淬硬性越大，但当碳含量大于0.6%以后，淬硬性随碳含量的变化趋于平缓。
explanation_en: The maximum hardness of steel under ideal conditions. The ideal condition refers to the optimal condition under which complete martensite can be obtained without self tempering occurring. The hardening capacity is mainly related to the carbon content in martensite. The higher the carbon content, the higher the quenching hardness, that is, the greater the hardenability. But when the carbon content is greater than 0.6%, the change of hardening capacity tends to be gentle with the carbon content.

explanation_cn: 钢经奥氏体化后粹火时所能获得的淬硬层深度的大小。通常规定为从试样表面到50%马氏体（半马氏体）处为淬硬层深度。钢的淬透性可用理想临界直径来表示，也可用一定冷却条件下淬冷得到的临界直径来表示，还可用端淬试验时试样硬度随距水冷端距离的变化曲线（淬透性曲线）来表征。钢的淬透性取决于过冷奥氏体的冷却速度、奥氏体的化学成分（固溶的合金元素种类及含量）、晶粒大小、均匀化程度、第二相（包括未溶碳化物和夹杂物）存在状态等。淬透性的测定方法主要有末端萍火法、断口检验法等。
explanation_en: The depth of hardened layer of steel obtained during quenching after austenitizing. It is usually specified that the depth of the hardened layer is from the surface of the specimen to 50% martensite (semi martensite). The hardenabilhy of steel can be expressed by the ideal critical diameter, or by the critical diameter obtained by quenching under certain cooling conditions, or by the curve of hardness of the sample changing with the distance from the water cooling end (hardenabilhy curve) during the end quenching test. The hardenabilhy of steel depends on the cooling rate of undercooled austenite, the chemical composition of austenite (type and content of solution alloy elements), grain size, homogenization degree, and the existence state of the second phase (including undissolved carbide and inclusion). The determination methods of hardenabilhy mainly include end burning method, fracture inspection method, etc.

explanation_cn: 具有优良的冲压成型性能，用于制造各种冲压零件（如容器、车体、仪表盘等）的冷轧低碳钢板或钢带。深冲钢的屈服强度较低以保证容易发生塑性变形.屈强比很低以保证足够大的均匀塑性变形能力，而最能1丨:确反映钢板冲压性能的指标是塑性应变比/?值和加丨:硬化指数n值，r、《值越大，深冲性能越好。为了获得良好的深冲性能，必须采用低碳含tt、细晶组织并保证优良的表面质量和冶金质量。冷轧低碳钢板及钢带(GB/T5213-2008)首先用字母DC表示?后跟顺序号，数字越大表示深冲性能越高.DC〇3(DQ级）可用于一般冲压件.DC04以上才属于深冲钢（DDQ级，r大于1.6、n大于0.18),DC05、DC06和DC07则称为超深冲钢（EDDQ级.；?大于1.9、《大于0.20),超深冲钢均为无间隙原子钢"高强度冷轧钢板及钢带（GB/T20564.i-2007)用字母CR表示，后跟数值表示上屈服强度.再用英文字母表示类型UF无间隙原子钢、丨)P双相钢、BH烘烤硬化钢>。
explanation_en: Cold rolled low-carbon steel plate or steel strip with excellent stamping forming performance, used to manufacture various stamping parts (such as containers, car bodies, instrument panels, etc.). The yield strength of deep drawing steel is low to ensure plastic deformation easily. The yield ratio is very low to ensure a large enough uniform plastic deformation capacity, and the most effective index to reflect the stamping performance of steel plate is the plastic strain ratio/? Value and addition: hardening index n-value, r The higher the value, the better the deep drawing performance. In order to obtain good deep drawing performance, it is necessary to use low-carbon tt containing, fine grain structure and ensure excellent surface quality and metallurgical quality. Cold rolled low-carbon steel plate and steel strip (GB/T5213-2008) are first represented by the letter DC? Followed by a sequence number, and the larger the number, the higher the deep drawing performance. DC 〇 3 (DQ level) can be used for general stamping parts. Only those above DC04 belong to deep drawing steel (DDQ level, r is greater than 1.6, n is greater than 0.18) DC05, DC06 and DC07 are called ultra deep drawing steel (EDDQ grade;?>1.9,>0.20). Ultra deep drawing steel is interstitial-free steel. "High strength cold-rolled steel plate and steel strip (GB/T20564.i-2007) are represented by the letter CR, followed by a numerical value representing the upper yield strength. Then English letters are used to represent the types UF interstitial-free steel, |) P dual-phase steel, BH bake hardening steel>.

explanation_cn: 在半导体禁带中部附近，离开导带或价带边缘较远的杂质能级或缺陷能级.深能级杂质或缺陷对半导体的载流子浓度和导电类型的影响较小，主要起载流子的陷阱或复合中心的作用。
explanation_en: The impurity energy level or defect energy level near the middle of the semiconductor band gap, which is far away from the edge of the conduction band or valence band. The deep energy level impurity or defect has little influence on the carrier concentration and conduction type of the semiconductor, and mainly acts as the carrier trap or composition center.

explanation_cn: 简称DLTS,是指通过表征p-n结、肖特基结或MOS电容的空间电荷区电容的瞬态变化行为来研究半导体中深能级杂质和缺陷的电学行为的测试方法。
explanation_en: It is called DLTS for short, which is a test method to study the electrical behavior of deep level impurities and defects in semiconductors by characterizing the transient change behavior of the space charge area capacitance of p-n junction, Schottky junction or MOS capacitor.

explanation_cn: 用胶凝材料 (水泥或胶结料）将集料胶结成整体的复合同体材料 的总称，是一种原材料易得、可塑造成各种形态、 应用成本低，且具有较好耐久性的建筑材料，应用极为广泛。
explanation_en: The general name of composition homo materials that use cementitious materials (cement or cementitious material) to cement aggregate into a whole is a kind of building materials with good durability, which is easy to obtain, plastic to form various forms, low application cost and widely used.

explanation_cn: 两种或多种材料构成的囊泡。在药物控制释放领域，混合囊泡可达到结合多种功能的目的。
explanation_en: A vesicle made of two or more materials. In the field of controlled drug release, mixed vesicle can achieve the purpose of combining multiple functions.

explanation_cn: 离子导电和电子导电同时存在的一类导体。这类导体具有较高的电子电导率，而且能发生拓扑化学反应，即当外来金属离子进入晶格内所形成的产物（成为插入化合物）仍保留原来的结构特征。
explanation_en: A type of conductor in which ionic conduction and electronic conduction coexist. Such conductors have high electronic electric conductivity and can undergo topological chemical reaction, that is, when foreign metal ions enter the lattice, the products formed (become insertion compounds) still retain the original structural characteristics.

explanation_cn: 又称润旋态。超导态与正常态同时并存的一种状态。第II类超导体存在这种现象。
explanation_en: Also known as moist spin state. A state in which the superconducting state coexists with the normal state. This phenomenon exists in type II superconductors.

explanation_cn: 第II类超导体在环境温度低于Tc且外场在上下两个临界磁场之间的条件下所处的迈斯纳效应状态。
explanation_en: The Meissner effect state of type II superconductors when the ambient temperature is lower than Tc and the external field is between the upper and lower critical magnetic field.

explanation_cn: 由铀和钚或钍的二氧化物混合物组成的燃料。混合氧化物燃料技术已经在英国和法国被广泛应用。
explanation_en: Fuel consisting of a mixture of uranium and plutonium or thorium dioxide. Mixed oxide fuel technology has been widely used in Britain and France.

explanation_cn: 是由两种或两种以上的物质组成的能发生爆炸变化的混合物，又称爆炸混合物。由单质炸药及添加剂或氧化剂、可燃剂及添加剂按适当比例混制而成。
explanation_en: It is a mixture composed of two or more substances that can produce explosion changes, also known as explosive mixture. It is made of single explosive and additive or oxidizer, combustible agent and additive in proper proportion.

explanation_cn: 由两种或多种材料构成的胶束。在药物控制释放领域，混合胶束可达到结合多种功能的目的。
explanation_en: A micelle consisting of two or more materials. In the field of controlled drug release, mixed micelle can combine multiple functions.

explanation_cn: 由两种及以上不同性能单质起爆药或起爆药与氧化剂、可燃剂组成的混合火工药剂。通过配方的设计与调节，使其各组分相互取长补短，以便获得更好的综合起爆性能。
explanation_en: A mixed initiating explosives and relative compositions consisting of two or more single compound primary explosive with different properties or primary explosive, oxidizer and combustible agent. By designing and adjusting the formula, each component can complement each other's strengths and weaknesses, in order to achieve better comprehensive detonation performance.

explanation_cn: 不同类型的增强组分以叠层结构形式组成的复合材料，其增强组分可为纤维、片材或蜂窝芯材，其基体可为树脂或金属。
explanation_en: The composite materials composed of different types of reinforcement components in the form of laminated structure can be made of fiber, sheet or honeycomb core, and its matrix can be resin or metal.

explanation_cn: 广义上指由两种（或以上）的基体或增强体进行混杂所构成的复合材料，也包括两种（或以上）的复合材料或复合材料与其他材料进行混杂所构成的复合材料。
explanation_en: Broadly speaking, it refers to composite materials composed of two (or more) matrix or reinforcement, and also includes composite materials composed of two (or more) composite materials or composite materials and other materials.

explanation_cn: 以一定方式将两种或两种以上纤维组合成的纤维集合体。用于混杂的纤维类型和品种很多，如碳纤维、玻璃纤维、芳纶纤维、硼纤维、氧化铝纤维、碳化硅纤维等；纤维形态吋以是连续也可是短切的。
explanation_en: A fiber assembly that combines two or more fibers in a certain way. There are many types and varieties of hybrid fibers, such as carbon fiber, glass fiber, aramid fiber, boron fiber, alumina fiber, silicon carbide fiber, etc; The fiber form can be continuous or short cut.

explanation_cn: 参见硝化纤维素。
explanation_en: See nitrocellulose.

explanation_cn: 生胶和各种配合剂经过机械混合翻炼达到均化和分散的加工工艺过程。混炼后得混炼胶（或称胶料）。混炼的目的是使橡胶与配合剂混合、分散均匀并具有需要的可塑度.对进一步加工和制品 质量有重要影响。目前主要的混炼方法有幵炼机混炼 和密炼机混炼，连续混炼尚未大量应用。
explanation_en: The process of homogenization and dispersion of crude rubber and various additives through mechanical mixing and refining. The rubber mixture (or compound) is obtained after mixing. The purpose of mixing is to mix and disperse rubber and compounding agent evenly with the required plasticity, which has an important impact on further processing and product quality. At present, the main mixing methods are open mill mixing and internal mixer mixing, and continuous mixing has not been widely used.

explanation_cn: 由不同质量分数的脂肪胺或芳香胺组成的液体火箭燃料的通称。黄棕色均匀液体，有氨味，吸湿性强.易挥发。部分溶于水，可溶于酒精、丙酮、汽油等有机溶剂。呈弱碱性，与酸作用生成盐。常温下可被空气缓慢氧化，变成深棕色。属中闪点易燃液体。热稳定性好。
