explanation_en: A general term for liquid rocket fuels composed of fatty or aromatic amines with different mass fractions. Yellowish brown uniform liquid, with an ammonia odor, strong moisture absorption, and easy volatility. Partially soluble in water, soluble in organic solvents such as alcohol, acetone, gasoline, etc. It is weakly alkaline and reacts with acids to form salts. At room temperature, it can be slowly oxidized by air and turn dark brown. It is a flammable liquid with medium flash point. Good thermal stability.

explanation_cn: 布拉格的植物学家斐德烈-莱尼泽（FriedrichReinitzer)在加热安息香酸胆固醇脂（cholesterylbenzoate)时，于1883年3月14日观察到苯甲酸胆固醇酯在热熔时的异常表现：它在145.5°C时熔化，产生了带有光彩的混浊物，温度上升后，光彩消失，液体透明。该化合物冷却时同样的现象重复，只是次序反转，最后形成固态的结晶体。熔化时的温度叫作熔点。变为透明时的温度叫作液晶的清亮点。
explanation_en: On March 14, 1883, when Prague botanist Friedrich Reinitzer heated cholesterylbenzoate, he observed the abnormal behavior of benzoic acid cholesterol ester during hot melting: it melted at 145.5 ° C, producing a cloudy substance with a bright color. As the temperature increased, the luster disappeared and the liquid became transparent. When the compound cools down, the same phenomenon repeats, but the order is reversed, ultimately forming a solid crystal. The temperature at which it melts is called the melting point. The temperature at which the liquid crystal becomes transparent is called the clearing point of the liquid crystal.

explanation_cn: 将综合预防的环境保护策略持续应用于生产过程和产品中，以期降低其危害人类健康和环境安全的风险。清洁生产从本质上来说，就是对生产过程与产品采取整体预防的环境策略，减少或者消除它们对人类及环境的可能危害，同时充分满足人类需要，使社会经济效益最大化的一种生产模式。
explanation_en: Continuously apply comprehensive prevention environmental protection strategies to production processes and products, in order to reduce their risks to human health and environmental safety. In essence, clean production is a production mode that adopts an overall prevention strategy for production processes and products to reduce or eliminate their possible harm to human beings and the environment, while fully meeting human needs and maximizing social and economic benefits.

explanation_cn: 一种光刻制程助剂。用于光刻制程前去除油脂、颗粒等杂物。清洗剂除了要求能快速有效去除杂质之外，还要求避免损伤其下的玻璃基板，清洗剂一般为含表面活性剂的碱性水溶液。表面活性剂通常为平平加等非离子表面活性剂，碱通常为氢氧化钾等无机碱或乙醇胺、四甲基氢氧化铵等有机碱。生产过程主要包括各成分按比例复配、过滤、包装等过程。
explanation_en: A lithography process additive. Used to remove impurities such as grease and particles before the photolithography process. In addition to rapidly and effectively removing impurities, cleaner is also required to avoid damaging the glass substrate under it. cleaner is generally alkaline aqueous solution containing surfactant. Surfactants are usually non ionic surfactants such as Pingpingjia, while bases are usually inorganic bases such as potassium hydroxide or organic bases such as ethanolamine and tetramethylammonium hydroxide. The production process mainly includes the proportional compounding, filtration, packaging, and other processes of various components.

explanation_cn: 又称假漆，俗称凡立水。由树脂、溶剂等配制而成的透明漆；有时加入油脂，但不含颜料。
explanation_en: Also known as false lacquer, commonly known as Fanlishui. Transparent paint prepared by resin, solvent, etc; Sometimes grease is added, but pigment is not included.

explanation_cn: 高温超导体的超导性能受氧含量的影响非常大；正常情况下通过原位法烧结而成的YBCO超导体氧含量不足.为了获得超导性能更好的YBCO超导体?在YBCO成相以后，还会将其在氧气气氛下再一次进行退火处理，从而使YBCO超导体获得足够的氧含量，这一过程被称为"渗氧"。
explanation_en: The superconductivity of high-temperature superconductor is greatly affected by oxygen content; Under normal circumstances, YBCO superconductors made by in-situ sintering are insufficient in oxygen content. In order to obtain YBCO superconductors with better superconductivity? After YBCO is formed into phase, it will be annealing again in oxygen atmosphere, so that YBCO superconductor can obtain enough oxygen content. This process is called "oxygen-infiltration".

explanation_cn: 又称氮化钢。适合采用渗氮处理使零件表面具有很高硬度和耐磨性的合金结构钢。
explanation_en: Also known as nitrided steel. Alloy structural steel suitable for nitriding treatment to make the surface of parts have high hardness and wear resistance.

explanation_cn: 将硫渗入钢或铸铁工件表面的化学热处理工艺。渗硫后在工件表面形成几十微米以下厚度的硫化膜.可降低摩擦系数.提高抗咬合性能。广泛采用气体渗硫方法（也称离子渗硫），包括离子渗硫、离子硫氮共渗、离子硫碳氮共渗等工艺。渗硫是在已淬硬或已表面硬化零件上进行的最终处理.用于使用过程中需承受严重摩擦磨损的零件如高速钢刀具、凸轮、滚轮等。
explanation_en: The process of thermo-chemical treatment in which sulfur is infiltrated into the surface of steel or cast iron workpiece. After sulphurizing, a vulcanization film with a thickness of less than tens of microns is formed on the surface of the workpiece, which can reduce the friction coefficient and improve the anti seizing performance. Gas sulphurizing (also known as ion sulphurizing) is widely used, including ion sulphurizing, ion sulfurizing, ion carbonitriding and other processes. Sulphurizing is the final treatment on hardened or surface hardened parts. It is used for parts that need to bear severe friction and wear during use, such as high speed steel cutters, cams, rollers, etc.

explanation_cn: 将硼渗入钢铁或键、钴、钛基合金工件表层形成硼化物硬化层的化学热处理丁.艺。渗硼方法有固态渗硼、气体渗硼、液态渗硼等.以液体渗硼应用最广，渗硼温度在950°C左右，渗硼时间数小时.渗层深度0.05~0.4mm,硼化物硬化层硬度可达HV1200~2000,硬度和耐磨性优于其他化学热处理，并具有良好的热硬性、耐氧化性和耐腐蚀性。
explanation_en: The thermo-chemical treatment process of infiltrating boron into the surface layer of steel or bond, cobalt, titanium base alloy workpiece to form a boride hardening layer. Boronizing methods include solid boronizing, gas boronizing, liquid boronizing, etc. Liquid boronizing is the most widely used, boronizing temperature is about 950 ° C, and boronizing time is several hours. The depth of the layer is 0.05~0.4mm, and the hardness of the hardened boride layer can reach HV1200~2000. The hardness and wear resistance are superior to other thermo-chemical treatment, and have good thermal hardness, oxidation resistance, and corrosion resistance.

explanation_cn: 适合进行渗硼处理的结构钢。渗硼主要是在工件表面形成硼化物硬化层.提高钢的表面硬度、耐磨性和耐蚀性。渗硼处理工艺有固态渗硼、气体渗硼、液体渗硼、电解渗硼等。渗硼钢多为中碳钢，广泛应用于机械零件、工具和模具等。
explanation_en: Structural steel suitable for boronizing treatment. Boronizing is mainly to form a boride hardening layer on the surface of the workpiece to improve the surface hardness, wear resistance and corrosion resistance of steel. Boronizing treatment processes include solid boronizing, gas boronizing, liquid boronizing, electrolytic boronizing, etc. Boronized steel is mostly medium carbon steel, which is widely used in machine parts, tools and dies.

explanation_cn: 将钢件放入具有一定碳活度的介质中加热保温，使钢件表层碳含量升高的化学热处理工艺。根据含碳介质的不同可分为液态渗碳、同态渗碳、气体渗碳等。
explanation_en: A thermo-chemical treatment process in which steel parts are put into a medium with a certain carbon activity for heating and insulation to increase the carbon content in the surface layer of steel parts. According to different carbon containing media, it can be divided into liquid carburizing, homogeneous carburizing, gas carburizing, etc.

explanation_cn: 可进行渗碳处理并经淬火和低温回火处理后使零件表面硬度和耐磨性显著提高而心部保持适当强度和良好韧性的结构钢。
explanation_en: Structural steel that can be carburizing, quenching and low temperature tempering to significantly improve the surface hardness and wear resistance of parts while maintaining proper strength and good toughness in the center.

explanation_cn: 在被检材料表面浸涂某些渗透力比较强的液体.利用液体对微细孔隙的渗透作用将液体渗入缺陷中，然后用水或清洗液清除材料表面的剩余渗透液，最后再用显示材料喷涂在被检表面，经毛细管作用.将缺陷中的渗透液吸附出来并加以显示。
explanation_en: Dipping coating some liquid with strong penetrability on the surface of the tested surface of materials. Use the penetration of the liquid into the micro pores to infiltrate the liquid into the defects, and then use water or cleaning solution to remove the residual penetrant on the surface of materials. Finally, spray the display materials on the tested surface, and absorb the penetrant in the defects and display it through capillary tube action.

explanation_cn: 将钢铁制件放入含有氯化铵的铝粉中加热.或将钢铁制件浸入熔融钔中，或在钢铁制件表面喷铝然后加热到高温，使铝渗入工件表层的化学热处理工艺.可在工件表面形成耐高温的氧化铝薄膜.显著提高工件抗高温氧化能力
explanation_en: A thermo-chemical treatment process in which steel parts are heated in aluminium powder containing ammonium chloride, or steel parts are immersed in molten metal, or aluminum is sprayed on the surface of steel parts and then heated to high temperature, so that aluminum can penetrate into the surface of the workpiece. High temperature resistant aluminum oxide film can be formed on the surface of the workpiece, significantly improving the resistance to high temperalure oxidation of the workpiece

explanation_cn: 采用特制的粉末加温、粉末输送和模具加热系统.将加有特殊润滑剂的预合金粉末和模具等加热至130~150°C，并将温度波动控制在±2.5°C以内。
explanation_en: The special powder heating, powder conveying and mold heating system is used to heat the pre alloy powder and mold with special lubricant to 130~150 ° C, and control the temperature fluctuation within ± 2.5 ° C.

explanation_cn: 见热室。
explanation_en: See hot cell.

explanation_cn: 见塞贝克效应。
explanation_en: See Seebeck effect.

explanation_cn: 电阻与温度关系曲线斜率大致为定值的电阻合金，经多次加热冷却后性能重现性好。一般具有较高的电阻率.电阻值随温度变化较为敏感，不同的温度下表现出不同的电阻值。
explanation_en: The resistance alloy whose slope of the resistance temperature relationship curve is approximately constant has good reproducibility after repeated heating and cooling. Generally, it has high resistivity. The resistance value is sensitive to temperature changes, and different resistance values appear at different temperatures.

explanation_cn: 温度使其导电率、热导率、折射率、体积等性质发生巨大变化的高分子材料。
explanation_en: Macromolecule materials whose conductivity, thermal conductivity, refractive index, volume and other properties are greatly changed by temperature.

explanation_cn: 又称热控涂层，空间飞行器（包括卫星、空间站和航天飞机）热控系统的重要组成部分，利用涂层改变航天器的表面热物理性质，以便在辐射热交换中有效地控制航天器的温度.使之在内外热交换过程中，内部仪器、设备的工作时温度不超过或低于允许范围，以保证人造天1=体内部的工常工作环境。=
explanation_en: Also known as thermal control coating, it is an important part of the thermal control system of space vehicles (including satellites, space stations and space shuttles). The coating is used to change the surface thermophysical properties of the spacecraft, so as to effectively control the temperature of the spacecraft in the process of radiant heat exchange. In the process of internal and external heat exchange, the temperature of internal instruments and equipment during operation does not exceed or fall below the allowable range, so as to ensure the normal working environment inside the artificial spacecrafts=

explanation_cn: 又称游离石灰。指熟料中没有以化合状态存在而是以游离状态存在的氧化钙。由于高温煅烧使结构致密、水化很慢。且生成氢氧化钙时，体积膨胀约1倍，使硬化水泥体受到膨胀应力。通常硅酸盐水泥熟料中，游离氧化钙含量控制在1.0%以下。
explanation_en: It is also called free lime. It refers to the calcium oxide in the clinker that does not exist in the combined state but in the free state. Due to high-temperature calcination, the structure is dense and hydration is slow. When calcium hydroxide is generated, the volume expansion is about one time, which makes the hardened cement subject to expansion stress. Generally, the content of free lime in Portland cement clinker is controlled below 1.0%.

explanation_cn: 物理参量（常用电阻或电阻率）随相对湿度变化而发生显著变化的半导体陶瓷。利用表面吸附所引起的电导率变化来获得有用信号。通常是由两种以上的金属氧化物半导体材料混合而成，结构上可能是微粒状粉末堆积体.也可能是多孔多晶烧结体。
explanation_en: Semiconductive ceramics whose physical parameters (common resistance or resistivity) change significantly with relative humidity. The electric conductivity change caused by surface adsorption is used to obtain useful signals. It is usually mixed by more than two kinds of metal oxide semiconductor materials, which may be in the form of granular powder accumulations or porous polycrystalline sinters in structure.

explanation_cn: 通过水溶液反应过程从矿石中或矿石浓缩物中分离出金属的方法。
explanation_en: The method of separating metals from ores or ore concentrates through an aqueous solution reaction process.

explanation_cn: 湿法氧化膜指使氧气通过加热的高纯去离子水，携带一定量的水汽进入氧化炉中进行反应生成的薄膜。
explanation_en: The wet oxidation film refers to the film formed by the oxygen passing through the heated high-purity deionized water and carrying a certain amount of water vapor into the oxidation furnace for reaction.

explanation_cn: 湿法蚀刻是通过使用特定的溶液与薄膜进行化学反应来去除未被光阻覆盖的部分，以实现蚀刻的目的。湿法蚀刻利用化学反应来除去薄膜，而这些化学反应通常不具有方向性，因此湿法蚀刻是一种各向同性的蚀刻方法。一般来说，这种方法不适用于定义3微米以下的线宽，但对于大于3微米的线宽，湿法蚀刻仍然是一个可选的技术。湿法蚀刻的过程可以分为三个步骤：化学蚀刻液扩散到待蚀刻材料的表面。蚀刻液与待蚀刻材料发生化学反应。反应后的产物从蚀刻材料表面扩散到溶液中，并随溶液排出。大多数蚀刻过程包含一个或多个化学反应步骤，各种不同形式的反应都有可能发生。但通常遇到的反应是将待蚀刻层的表面氧化，然后将这个氧化层溶解并随溶液排出，反复进行以实现蚀刻效果。例如，湿法蚀刻硅和蚀刻金属通常采用这种化学反应方式。
explanation_en: Wet etching is to remove the part not covered by photoresistance by chemical reaction between specific solution and film to achieve the purpose of etching. Wet etching uses chemical reactions to remove films, and these chemical reactions usually have no directionality, so wet etching is an isotropic etching method. Generally, this method is not suitable for defining linewidths below 3 μ m, but for linewidths greater than 3 μ m, wet etching is still an optional technology. The process of wet etching can be divided into three steps: diffusion of chemical etchant to the surface of materials to be etched. The etchant reacts with the materials to be etched. The product after reaction diffusion from the etched surface of materials to the solution and is discharged with the solution. Most etching processes involve one or more chemical reaction steps, and various forms of reactions may occur. But the usual reaction encountered is to oxidize the surface of the layer to be etched, then dissolve this oxide layer and discharge it with the solution, repeating the process to achieve the etching effect. For example, wet etching silicon and etching metal usually adopt this chemical reaction mode.

explanation_cn: 亦称溶液法预浸料。预先用合适的溶剂将树脂体系配成一定浓度的溶液，纤维（或织物）从溶液中通过.浸上树脂.经晾置或加热烘干后收卷于筒。湿法预浸料适用于热固性树脂基体和热塑性树脂基休.常用于热固性树脂基体.制备关键在于选抒能溶解树脂的合适溶剂.如环氧树脂常用丙酮等作溶剂、酚醛树脂常用乙醇等作溶剂。对于热塑性树脂堪体的溶剂选择.则因热塑性树脂有无定形与结晶型之分而有所区别：无定形热塑性树脂基体的溶剂比较好选择.而结晶型热塑性树脂基体的溶剂却较难找到.并往往需在高温下溶解，工艺复杂，所以结晶型热塑性树脂不常用此法制备预浸料。溶液法制：备预浸料.设备相对简单.操作简便，对纤维的浸润程度高。
explanation_en: Also called solution method prepreg. Prepare the resin system into a solution of a certain concentration with a suitable solvent in advance, and the fiber (or fabric) passes through the solution, is dipped into resin, and is wound up in the cylinder after being dried in the air or heated. Wet method prepreg is suitable for thermosetting resin matrix and thermoplastic resin matrix. It is commonly used for thermosetting resin matrix. The key to preparation is to select suitable solvent that can dissolve resin, such as acetone commonly used for epoxy resin and ethanol commonly used for phenolic resin. For the solvent selection of thermoplastic resin, there are differences between amorphous and crystalline thermoplastic resin: amorphous thermoplastic resin matrix solvent is better selected, while crystalline thermoplastic resin matrix solvent is more difficult to find. It often needs to be dissolved at high temperature, and the process is complex, so crystalline thermoplastic resin is not commonly used to prepare prepreg by this method. Solution method: prepare prepreg. The equipment is relatively simple, the operation is simple, and the degree of fiber infiltration is high.

explanation_cn: 用于考核各种黏合剂相对耐湿热的性能，或考核在一定温度和湿度条件下.某种黏合剂耐湿热老化的变化趋势。试验条件，要求在调温调湿箱中进行。严格要求试验空间的任意一点温度应控制在控制值±2t、相对湿度控制在控制值±3%内；试验箱内任意-处的卞应流动，但风速不大于1mA。如采用喷水雾法或加泡法加湿时，所用的水应洁净，一般采用蒸馏水。试样在试验前应除去灰尘、油污，并保持完整无损；在试验中样品应尽能按工作状态放置，并以不影响箱内温湿度为宜；样品放置时不能相互重叠、接触，并应避免上层试样的冷却水滴落在下层样品上。
explanation_en: It is used to assess the relative damp heat resistance of various adhesive, or to assess the change trend of damp heat aging resistance of a certain adhesive under certain temperature and humidity conditions. The test conditions are required to be carried out in a temperature and humidity control box. Strictly require that the temperature at any point in the experimental space should be controlled within the control value of ± 2t, and the relative humidity should be controlled within the control value of ± 3%; The flow should occur at any point in the test chamber, but the wind speed should not exceed 1mA. When using water spray or bubble method for humidification, the water used should be clean, usually distilled water. The sample should be cleaned of dust and oil stains before testing and kept intact and undamaged; During the experiment, the samples should be placed as close as possible to their working state and should not affect the temperature and humidity inside the box; When placing samples, they should not overlap or come into contact with each other, and the cooling water from the upper sample should be avoided from dripping onto the lower sample.

explanation_cn: 用动能在几十电子伏特以上的荷能粒子轰击试样表面，使试样表面原子获得能量而进入气相的复杂的粒子散射过程。
explanation_en: The complex particle scattering process involves bombarding the surface of a sample with charged particles with kinetic energy above tens of electron volts, causing the surface atoms of the sample to gain energy and enter the gas phase.

explanation_cn: 指利用荷能离子轰击具有生物活性元素的靶材表面，使被轰击出的粒子。
explanation_en: It refers to the particles bombarded out by bombarding the target surface of bioactivity elements with charged ions.

explanation_cn: 溅渣护炉技术是在转炉炼钢过程对熔渣进行调节或出钢后对终点渣进行改性使K- MgO含量达到饱和或过饱和.然后采用氮气将炉渣吹溅到炉壁上形成高熔点的熔渣层，由此修补炉墙受损部位的工艺技术
explanation_en: Slag splashing technology is a process technology that adjusts the slag during converter sleelmaking or modifies the end slag after tapping to make the K-MgO content reach saturation or supersaturation, and then uses nitrogen to blow slag onto the furnace wall to form a slag layer with high melting point, thus repairing the damaged part of the furnace wall

explanation_cn: 一般是指场效应晶体管（FET)或有机发光显示器（OLED)中用于制备源漏电极（gate)的具有导电性能材料，源漏导电材料可以采用金属或金属合金材料以及氧化物半导体材料，例如铝（A1)和铝钦合金、钼铝钼多层结构（Mo-Al-Mo)、钛铝钛（Ti-AI-Ti)、氧化铟锡（ITO)等。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to the conductive materials used to prepare the source drain electrode (gate) in the field effect transistor (FET) or organic luminescence display (OLED). The source and drain electrode materials can be metal or metal alloy materials and oxide semiconductor materials, such as aluminum (A1) and aluminum alloy, molybdenum aluminum molybdenum multilayer structure (Mo Al Mo), titanium aluminum titanium (Ti AI Ti), indium tin oxide (ITO), etc.

explanation_cn: 一种锌和溴的化合物。无色斜方晶系晶体或粉末，易溶于水，溶液呈酸性，在浓溶液中能产生Zn(ZnBr4)复盐、能溶于醇、醚和丙酮。储存时要求密封、避光和干燥。质量分数为79%的溴化锌水溶液的密度大（约2J4gArm3，和普通混凝土相当）、透明度高、价格低、无毒、辐照稳定性好，是屏蔽用液体窥视窗中首选的填充液体。
explanation_en: A compound of zinc and bromine. Colorless rhombic crystal or powder, easily soluble in water, acidic solution, can produce Zn (ZnBr4) double salt in concentrated solution, soluble in alcohol, ether and acetone. Storage requires sealing, avoiding light, and drying. With a mass fraction of 79%, zinc bromide aqueous solution has high density (about 2J4gArm3, equivalent to ordinary concrete), high transparency, low price, non-toxic, and good irradiation stability. It is the preferred filling liquid in liquid windows for shielding.

explanation_cn: 又称溶液胶黏剂。由聚合物溶解于有机溶剂中.通过溶剂的挥发而固化发生黏结作用的胶黏剂（但不含以水为溶剂的水溶性胶黏剂）。一般可溶于溶剂的聚合物都可做成这种胶黏剂。
explanation_en: Also called solution adhesive. The adhesive is dissolved by polymer in organic solvent and curing through solvent volatilization (excluding water-soluble adhesive with water as solvent). Generally, solvent soluble polymer can be made into this adhesive.

explanation_cn: 又称培盐法。指在高温下从熔融盐溶剂中生长晶体的方法.其过程与从水溶液中生长晶体类似。采用熔盐法生长晶体，首先要选择适当的高温助熔剂.使溶质相在远低于其熔点的温度下进行生长。温度低是熔盐法的主要优点。好的助熔剂必须对溶质有高的溶解度.不与溶质生成稳定的化合物.对坩埚的溶解度要小。
explanation_en: Also known as salt cultivation method. It refers to the method of growing crystal from molten salt solvent at high temperature. Its process is similar to that of growing crystal from aqueous solution. In order to grow crystal by molten salt method method, it is necessary to select appropriate high temperature flux to make the solute phase grow at a temperature far below its melting point. Low temperature is the main advantage of molten salt method. A good flux must have a high water solubility for the solute. It does not form stable compounds with the solute. It has a low water solubility for the crucible.

explanation_cn: 1，3-丁二烯和笨乙烯通过阴离子溶液聚合所得的无规共聚物.其中苯乙烯含量在5%-45%。与乳液丁苯橡胶相比，主要差别在于分子量分布窄、支化度少、单体序列分布和丁二烯荜元微观结构可控四个方面。
explanation_en: Random copolymer obtained by anionic solution polymerization of 1,3-butadiene and styrene, in which styrene content is 5% -45%. Compared with emulsion styrene-butadiene rubber, the main differences lie in four aspects: narrow molecular weight distribution, less branching degree, monomer sequence distribution and controllable cuboidal microstructure of butadiene.

explanation_cn: 溶液是由两种或两种以上物质组成的均匀混合物。它是由溶质和溶剂组成的，常用的溶剂有水、有机溶剂等。溶液生长法是把被沉淀物从它的溶液里分离出来形成晶体的生长方法。
explanation_en: A solution is a uniform mixture composed of two or more substances. It is composed of solutes and solvents, commonly used solvents include water, organic solvents, etc. The solution growth method is to separate the precipitate from its solution to form crystal.

explanation_cn: 将单体和引发剂溶于适当溶剂中进行的聚合。溶液聚合中主要的参数是溶剂的种类、温度、单体浓度和最终聚合物浓度。
explanation_en: Polymerization in which monomer and initiator are dissolved in appropriate solvent. The main parameters in solution polymerization are solvent type, temperature, monomer concentration and final polymer concentration.

explanation_cn: 溶剂分子渗入高分子内部使高分子体积膨胀的过程。溶胀过程是线型高分子溶解过程的第一阶段。随后，高分子均匀分散在溶剂中，形成完全溶解的均相体系，这是溶解过程的第二阶段。对于交联高分子，与溶剂接触时也会发生溶胀，但因有交联点的化学键束缚，不能再进一步使交联的分子分散，只能停留在最高的溶胀阶段，达到溶胀平衡不发生溶解。
explanation_en: The process of solvent molecules penetrating into macromolecule to expand the volume of macromolecule. The swelling process is the first stage of linear macromolecule dissolution process. Subsequently, the macromolecule is uniformly dispersed in the solvent to form a completely dissolved homogeneous phase system, which is the second stage of the dissolution process. For crosslinking macromolecule, swelling will also occur when they contact with solvents, but due to the chemical bond binding of crosslinking point, crosslinking molecules can no longer be further dispersed, and can only stay at the highest swelling stage, so that swelling equilibrium will not occur.

explanation_cn: 高分子溶胀后的体积与溶胀前的体积之比。
explanation_en: The ratio of the volume of macromolecule after swelling to the volume before swelling.

explanation_cn: 采用胶体化学原理制备粉体或先驱体的方法。原理是以金属盐为原料，与溶剂等原料混合、调制成均匀的混合溶液.然后完成水解、缩合化学反应，形成稳定的透明溶胶体系；经陈化形成=.维空M网络结构的凝胶，该凝胶再经过干燥、煅烧制备粉来。主要用于制备多组分氧化物玻璃.高纯陶瓷粉体和硅酸盐材料等。
explanation_en: The method of preparing powders or precursors using the principles of colloidal chemistry. The principle is to use metal salts as raw materials, mix and modulate them with solvents and other raw materials to form a uniform mixed solution, and then complete hydrolysis and condensation chemical reactions to form a stable transparent sol system; After aging, a gel with a dimension space M network structure is formed, and the gel is dried and calcined to prepare powder. It is mainly used to prepare multi-component oxide glass, high-purity ceramic powder and silicate materials.

name_cn: 溶胶-凝胶生物活性玻璃
explanation_cn: 是一类具有较高生物活性和良好生物矿化特性的新型生物活性材料.可用作骨缺损填充和制作骨组织工程支架的基本原料。
explanation_en: It is a new type of bioactive materials with high bioactivity and good biomineralization characteristics. It can be used as the basic raw material for filling bone defects and making bone tissue engineering stem.

explanation_cn: 一种以尤机物或金属醇盐作为前驱体，在液相将这些原料均匀混合.并进行水解、缩合化学反应.在溶液中形成稳定的透明溶胶体系，溶胶经陈化，胶粒间缓慢聚合，形成5维空间网络结构的凝胶，凝胶网络间充满了失去流动性的溶剂.形成凝胶.凝胶经过干燥、烧结同化制备出分子乃至纳米亚结构材料的方法。该方法在制备玻璃、陶瓷、薄膜、纤维、复合材料等方面获得重要应用，更广泛用于制备纳米粒子
explanation_en: A kind of gel with five dimensional spatial network structure is formed by aging the sol and slowly polymerization between the colloidal particles. The gel network is filled with solvents that lose flow ability. gel is formed. The gel is dried The method of sintering and assimilation to prepare molecular and even nano sub structural materials. This method has important applications in the preparation of glass, ceramics, films, fibers, composite materials, etc., and is more widely used to prepare nanoparticles

explanation_cn: 材料（如钛金属）浸没于溶胶凝胶体系（如钛溶胶凝胶）后取出，再在适当温度下进行热处理得到具有生物活性表面的改性技术。
explanation_en: The materials (such as titanium metal) is immersed in the sol gel system (such as titanium sol gel) and taken out, and then heat treatment is carried out at an appropriate temperature to obtain a bioactivity surface modification technology.

explanation_cn: 溶致液晶是指一种包含溶剂在内的两种或多种化合物由于溶剂破坏溶质分子的结晶晶格，在一定浓度范围内出现液晶相的组合物。溶致液晶广泛存在于自然界、生物体中，如简单的肥皂水、离子型和非离子型表面活性剂、生物膜等都呈现溶致液晶的特性
explanation_en: Lyotmpic liquid crystals refers to a composition containing two or more compounds, including solvent, that appears liquid crystal phase within a certain concentration range because the solvent destroys the crystal lattice of solute molecules. Lyotmpic liquid crystals widely exists in nature and organisms, such as simple soapy water, ionic and non-ionic surfactants, biomembrane, etc., all present the characteristics of lyotmpic liquid crystals

name_en: mass transfer by dissolution precipitation mechanism
explanation_cn: 烧结陶瓷材料过程中存在同液两相.当同相可溶解在液相中时烧结传质机理为：部分固相溶解于液相中然后析出沉淀在另一部分固相上，直至晶粒长大并获得致密的烧结体。
explanation_en: In the process of sintering ceramics materials, there are two phases of the same liquid. When the same phase can be dissolved in the liquid phase, the mass transfer mechanism of sintering is that part of the solid phase is dissolved in the liquid phase and then precipitates precipitation on the other part of the solid phase until the grain growth and dense sintering body is obtained.

explanation_cn: 专门用来生产黏胶纤维用的纸浆。多以木材为原料.经特殊制浆工艺生产。浆的纤维纯度高，一般纤维素含量在90%以上。
explanation_en: It is specially used to produce pulp for viscose fiber. It is mainly made of wood through special pulping process. The fiber purity of the pulp is high. Generally, the content of cellulose is more than 90%.

explanation_cn: 两个相对滑动物体，其公共接触面积上表面速度的大小和 (或）方向相同时产生的切向阻力和材料流失，也是以运动方式的特征描述的一类摩擦磨损。
explanation_en: The tangential resistance and materials loss generated when the surface velocity on the common contact area of two relative sliding objects is the same and/or in the same direction are also a kind of friction and wear described by the characteristics of motion mode.

explanation_cn: 用于控制钢水流量和流速的带孔耐火砖。材质有高铝质、铝碳质、铝锆碳质等。安装在钢包、中间包等底部。为了实现开闭钢流的功能，对滑板砖的滑动面平整度、平行度以及外形尺寸要求高。
explanation_en: Perforated firebrick used to control the flow and velocity of molten steel. The materials include high aluminum, aluminum carbon, aluminum zirconium carbon, etc. Installed at the bottom of ladle, tundish, etc. In order to realize the function of opening and closing the steel flow, there are high requirements for the flatness, parallelism and overall dimensions of the sliding surface of sliding brick.

explanation_cn: 层状结构硅酸盐矿物。 致密块状、鱗片状集合体。白色，含杂质而带浅黄、 粉红、浅绿等色调。玻璃光泽。
explanation_en: Layered silicate mineral. Dense blocky and scaly aggregates. White, with impurities and shades of light yellow, pink, and green. Glass lustre.

explanation_cn: 主要由滑石组成的具片状构造的变质岩。矿物组成除滑石外，还有石英、绿泥 石、蛇纹石和碳酸盐矿物。岩石呈浅灰色、浅绿色、 浅红色或灰紫色，以硬度低、有滑腻感为特征，是主要的滑石矿石。常与绿泥片岩及蛇纹岩伴生。
explanation_en: Metamorphic rock with schistose structure mainly composed of talc. In addition to talc, there are also quartze, chlorite, serpentine and carbonate minerals. Rock is light gray, light green, light red or gray purple, characterized by low hardness and a sense of smoothness, and is the main talc ore. It is often associated with green mud schist and serpentinite.

explanation_cn: 又称原顽辉石瓷，镁质瓷的一种，采用滑石为主要原料制造而成，主晶相为原顽辉石，电气性能优良，机械强度中等，便于加工,价格低廉，但热膨胀系数较大，热稳定性较差，耐热性低。
explanation_en: It is also called original enstatite porcelain, a kind of magnesia porcelain. It is made of talc as the main raw material. The main crystal phase is original enstatite, with excellent electrical performance, medium mechanical strength, easy processing, and low price. However, it has large thermal expansion coefficient, poor thermal stability, and low heat resistance.

explanation_cn: 一种主要由滑石和菱镁矿组成的变质岩石。主要矿物为滑石、菱镁矿、方解石、白云石等及石英等，有时含少量蛇纹石、透闪 石、磁铁矿、尖晶石、铬云母、黄铁矿等。一般呈灰白色、浅绿色、粉红色等。具中细粒鳞片粒状变晶结构和块状构造。
explanation_en: A metamorphic rock consisting mainly of talc and magnesite. The main minerals are talc, magnesite, caldte, dolomite, quartze, etc., sometimes containing a small amount of serpentine, tremolite, magnetite, spinel, chrome mica, pyrite, etc. It is generally grayish white, light green, pink, etc. It has medium fine scale granular balastic texture and massive structure.

explanation_cn: 又称原顽辉石瓷。以MgSiO3主成分的陶瓷。主晶相为原顽辉石.所以滑石装置瓷，通常称滑石瓷。其电气性能优良，机械强度中等，便于加工,且价格低廉，但 它的热膨胀系数较大.热稳定性较差，耐热性低。
explanation_en: Also known as protoenstatite ceramics. Ceramics with MgSiO3 as the main component. The main crystal phase is protoenstatite, so steatite mounting ceramics is usually called steatite porcelain. Its electrical performance is excellent, its mechanical strength is medium, it is easy to process, and its price is low, but its thermal expansion coefficient is large, its thermal stability is poor, and its heat resistance is low.

explanation_cn: 由一组平行的细的滑移线所构成的带。它出现在经过塑性变形后的抛光表面上，而且只有高倍观察（如用电子显微镜）才能分辨滑移带中各个平行的细滑移线。
explanation_en: A band composed of a set of parallel thin slip lines. It appears on the polished surface after plastic deformation, and only high power observation (such as electron microscope) can distinguish the parallel fine slip lines in the slip band.

explanation_cn: 单晶体通过滑移产生塑性变形时，由滑移面和其上的滑移方向所组成的系统滑移面一般是原子的密排面或较密排的面，滑移方向是原子的密排方向。
explanation_en: When a single crystal produces plastic deformation through slip, the system consisting of slip plane and the slip direction on it is generally a close packed plane or a relatively close packed plane of atoms, and the slip direction is the close packed direction of atoms.

explanation_cn: 可发生滑移的晶面。通常是晶体中面间距最大、滑移阻力最小的原子密排或较密排的晶面。
explanation_en: A crystal surface that can undergo slip. Usually, it is the close arrangement of atoms or relatively close arrangement of crystal plane with the largest spacing between planes and the smallest slip resistance in the crystal.

explanation_cn: 两个相对滚动物体.其接触面上表而速度的大小和（或）方向相同时产生的切向阻力和材料流失.是以运动方式的特征描述的一类摩擦磨损。
explanation_en: Tangential resistance and materials loss caused by two relative rolling objects with the same surface speed and/or direction on their contact surfaces are a kind of friction wear described by the characteristics of motion.

explanation_cn: 将银末和蓝湿革在转鼓内一起转动.以调节蓝湿革的水分含量并使黏附了锯末的蓝湿革在削匀时增加摩擦力。
explanation_en: Rotate the silver powder and wet blue together in the drum to adjust the moisture content of wet blue and increase the friction of wet blue with sawdust when shaving.

explanation_cn: 在弹性范围内加载，只有经过一定时间后弹性应变（或弹性应力）才能到达和胡克定律所对应的平衡值（即应力应变存在非单值的线性关系）。它有两种表现形式，一种称为应变弛豫或弹性后效.另一种称应力弛豫。加弹性应力产生一个瞬时应变,在保持恒定过程中，弹性应变随时间而不断升高，直到平衡值。恒应力下弹性应变随时间而升高的现象称为滞弹性蠕变（或微蠕变）。如卸载，则一部分弹性应变将瞬时消失，剩余的弹性应变，将逐渐恢复到零，这个过程称为弹性后效。滞弹性蠕变和弹性后效总称应变弛豫.它是滞弹性的一种表现形式。
explanation_en: When loading in the elasticity range, only after a certain period of time can the elasticity strain (or elasticity stress) reach the equilibrium value corresponding to Hooke's Law (that is, there is a non single linear relationship between stress and strain). It has two forms, one is called strain relaxation or elasticity aftereffect, and the other is called stress-relaxation. Adding elasticity stress produces an instantaneous strain, and in the process of keeping constant, the elasticity strain increases with time until the equilibrium value. The phenomenon that elasticity strain increases with time under constant stress is called anelasticity creep (or micro creep). If unloading, part of elasticity strain will disappear instantaneously, and the remaining elasticity strain will gradually recover to zero, which is called elasticity aftereffect. Anelasticity creep and elasticity aftereffect are called strain relaxation, which is a form of anelasticity.

explanation_cn: 用于从液体或气体中滤出固体颗粒的多孔性的、未施胶的纸。其匀度好，湿强度高，化学纯度高。可用于化学分析试验，也可用于工业生产或制造工业产品，如压滤机、过滤机、汽车等。
explanation_en: A porous, unglued paper used to filter solid particles from liquids or gases. It has good uniformity, high wet strength, and high chemical purity. It can be used for chemical analysis experiments, as well as for industrial production or manufacturing of industrial products, such as filter presses, filters, automobiles, etc.

explanation_cn: 以漂珠为主要原料制成的轻质耐火材料。
explanation_en: Light-weight refractory made from floating beads.

explanation_cn: 种成分与膨润土相似的黏土。含钙较膨润土多，含钠较少。吸水性和膨胀性能较差；吸附能力强，能吸附大量色素、黏液、胶状物和其他杂质。在精炼石油产品及精制各种矿物油和植物油时作为脱色剂和漂白剂。工业用的漂白土有活性白土和天然漂白土。天然漂白土又称酸性白土，具有漂白和脱色作用，但其漂白性能明显比活性白土差。活性白土是一种用酸处理活化后具有较强漂白性能的黏土。
explanation_en: Three kinds of clay with similar composition to bentonite. It contains more calcium than bentonite and less sodium. Poor water absorption and expansion performance; With strong adsorption capacity, it can absorb a large number of pigment, mucus, colloidal substances and other impurities. It is used as decolorant and bleaching agent when refining petroleum products and refining various mineral oils and vegetable oils. Industrial bleached soil includes activated white soil and natural bleached soil. Natural bleached soil, also known as acidic white soil, has bleaching and decolorization effects, but its bleaching performance is significantly worse than that of activated white soil. Activated clay is a kind of clay with strong bleaching property after acid treatment and activation or conditioning.

explanation_cn: 在色漆制造中用于分散颜料的液料（液相组分、清漆）称漆料。因用它分散颜料、填料，故又称展色剂和调漆料。或者双组分涂料中把铝粉浆、固化剂以外的另一组分。在涂装中常称为漆料。
explanation_en: Liquid materials (liquid components, varnish) used to disperse pigment in paint manufacturing are called paint vehicle. Because it is used to disperse pigment and fillers, it is also called chromogenic agent and paint mixing material. Or another component in the two-component coatings other than aluminum slurry and curing agent. It is often called paint vehicle in painting.

explanation_cn: 以漆为涂料得到的表面涂饰层很厚，具有高光亮和高光洁度的皮。
explanation_en: The surface coating layer obtained by using paint as coatings is very thick, with high brightness and high smoothness.

explanation_cn: 半导体材料中呈漩祸状分布的微缺陷这种分布与晶体生长的热场不完全对称、熔体对流以及晶体旋转相关。漩涡缺陷主要发生在无位错硅单晶中，用X射线透射形貌法或化学腐蚀法显示其呈同心圆状、偏心圆状或螺纹状的横断面分布在单晶纵断面上则呈条纹状分布。无位错区熔硅单晶中通常有A类和B类漩涡缺陷。A类漩涡缺陷由位错环和其聚集体构成，B类漩涡缺陷的本质未彻底弄清，一般认为是由硅自间隙集团和一些碳原子构成。无位错直拉硅单晶中的漩涡缺陷的分布和区熔单晶近似，但其产生的主要原因是过饱和的氧杂质和点缺陷共同作用的结果，即形成了氧沉淀及其诱生层错和位错环。
explanation_en: The distribution of micro defects in semiconductor materials with swirling distribution is related to the thermal field asymmetry of crystal growth, melt convection and crystal rotation. Swirl defect mainly occurs in dislocation free siliconcrystalline, and its cross section distribution in concentric circle, eccentric circle or thread shape is shown by X-ray transmission topography or chemical corrosion method, while it is in stripe shape on the vertical section of single crystal. Class A and B swirl defect are usually found in dislocation free zone fused silicon single crystal. Type A swirl defect is composed of dislocation loop and its aggregate, while the nature of type B swirl defect is not fully understood, and it is generally considered to be composed of silicon self gap group and some carbon atoms. The distribution of swirl defect in dislocation free Czochralski siliconcrystalline is similar to that of zone melting single crystal, but the main reason is the joint effect of supersaturated oxygen impurities and point defects, that is, oxygen precipitation and its induced stacking fault and dislocation loop are formed.

explanation_cn: 光线投射到粗糙表面时，它向各方向反射，称为漫反射，通常用漫反射效率表示物质的漫反射能力。漫反射率随入射光波长(或频率)而变化的谱图，称为漫反射光谱。漫反射率是指反射光的总量和入射光总量之比。大部分发光材料是粉未状的，难以精确地测定其吸收光谱。通常只能通过粉末材料的漫反射光谱来估计其对光的吸收。但不能认为漫反射光谱就是吸收光谱，这两种光谱的概念是不同的，它们之间既有联系又有区别。
explanation_en: When light is projected onto a rough surface, it reflects in all directions, known as diffuse reflection. The diffuse reflection efficiency is usually used to represent the diffuse reflection ability of a substance. The spectrum of diffuse reflectance changing with the wavelength (or frequency) of incident light is called diffuse reflection spectrum. Diffuse reflectance refers to the ratio of the total amount of reflected light to the total amount of incident light. Most luminescence materials are in powder form, so it is difficult to accurately measure their absorption spectrum. Generally, the absorption of powder materials can only be estimated by its diffuse reflection spectrum. But diffuse reflection spectrum cannot be regarded as absorption spectrum. The concepts of these two kinds of spectra are different, and there are both connections and differences between them.

explanation_cn: α相与β相的界面是一个有限区间，在该区间内由α相到β相成分变化是连续的。过去在估算界面能时都基于这样的假设，即界面处的一个原子间距离内成分产生突变。后来Cahn.L.W和Hillird.J.E提出漫散界面模型。
explanation_en: α Phase and β The interface of phase is a finite interval in which α Phase to β The composition change of phase is continuous. In the past, the estimation of interface energy was based on the assumption that there was a sudden change in the composition within the distance between an atom at the interface. Later, Cahn. L. W and Hillard. J. E proposed the diffused interface model.

explanation_cn: 加入到环氧树脂中与其组成的单组分体系在室温下具有一定的贮存稳定性，而在加热、光照、湿气、加压等条件下能迅速进行固化反应的固化剂。虽然环氧树脂潜伏性固化剂的种类很多，但是每种类型的固化剂都有一定的优点和缺点，仍然没有发现一种性能特别优良，十分理想的潜伏性固化剂。
explanation_en: The single component system added to epoxy resin and composed of it has certain storage stability at room temperature, and can quickly carry out curing reaction under the conditions of heating, light, moisture, pressure, etc. Although there are many kinds of latent curing agent for epoxy resin, each type of curing agent has certain advantages and disadvantages, and no latent curing agent with excellent performance and ideal properties has been found.

explanation_cn: 通过激光与固相物质的相互作用的热效应，使材料表面快速熔化、凝固和形成新的合金结构以改变其物理、化学性能的工艺方 法。其突出优点是在瞬态过程及区域可扫描选择性。
explanation_en: Through the thermal effect of the interaction between laser and solid material, the surface of materials can be rapidly melted, solidified and a new alloy structure can be formed to change its physical and chemical properties. Its outstanding advantage is its scanning selectivity in transient processes and regions.

explanation_cn: 用聚焦激光束照射样品使样品表面产生离子的质谱分析法。聚焦激光束的高能量密度使样品表面受 照射区在瞬间汽化电离，经质M分析器快速取谱，就能记录下样品表面的微区成分信息。
explanation_en: Mass spectrometry analysis method for producing ions on the surface of a sample by irradiating it with a focused laser beam. The high energy density of the focused laser beam makes the irradiated area on the surface of the sample vaporize and ionize instantaneously, and the composition information of the micro area on the surface of the sample can be recorded by the mass M analyzer through rapid spectrum acquisition.

explanation_cn: 测定火工药剂在激光作用下发生爆炸的难易程度，测试方法为激 光头输出的激光经过分光镜分光和反射，反射光经过衰减片衰减和聚焦透镜聚焦作用于被测试样，将其引爆，激光能量通过调节激光器电压和衰减片厚度来完成，通过升降法测得50%发火对应的激光能量作为激光感度值。
explanation_en: Determine the difficulty of explosion of initiating explosives and relative compositions under the action of laser. The test method is that the laser output by the laser head is divided and reflected by a spectroscope, the reflected light is attenuated by an attenuator and focused by a focusing lens on the tested sample, which is detonated. The laser energy is completed by adjusting the voltage of the exciter and the thickness of the attenuator. The laser energy corresponding to 50% ignition is measured by the lifting method as the laser sensitivity value.

explanation_cn: 表征被激光辐照的介质抗激光损伤能力的重要参量。激光能量的高度集中会引起介质内部或表面的局部变形甚至完全被损坏。介质在单位面积上所能承受的最大激光功率，称为该介质的激光损伤阈值。
explanation_en: An important parameter characterizing the ability of a medium irradiated by laser to resist laser damage. The high concentration of laser energy can cause local deformation or even complete damage to the interior or surface of the medium. The maximum laser power that a medium can withstand per unit area is called the laser damage threshold of the medium.

explanation_cn: 用于固体激光器产生激光的晶体，由基质晶体和激活离子构成。
explanation_en: The crystal used for solid laser generation is composed of a matrix crystal and active ions.

explanation_cn: 能把各种激励（电、光、射线）能量转换成激光的材料，以固体物质为主。固体激光材料主要有以电激励为主的半导体激光材料和以光激励为主的金属离子掺杂的激光品体和激光玻璃。
explanation_en: Materials that can convert various excitation (electricity, light, ray) energy into laser, mainly solid material. Solid laser materials mainly include semiconductor laser materials mainly driven by electricity, metal ion doped laser materials and laser glass mainly driven by light.

explanation_cn: 激光器的输出波长，是激光器输出激光光束的重要参数。
explanation_en: The output wavelength of a laser is an important parameter for outputting laser beams.

explanation_cn: 以激光为热源对粉末压坯进行烧结的技术。对常规烧结炉不易完成的烧结材料，此技术有独特的优点。由于激光光束集中和穿透能力小，适于对小面积、薄片制品的烧结。易于将不同于基体成分的粉末或薄片压坯烧结在一起。利用光可实现高熔点金属和陶瓷的烧结。与其他快速成型技术相比，激光烧结制备的部件，具有性能好、制作速度快、材料多样化，成本低等特点。激光烧结不仅是一项用于快速成形的有效工具，而且日益成为那些大量不同复杂产品的制造工艺的选择。
explanation_en: The technology of sintering powder compact with laser as heat source. This technology has unique advantages for sintering materials that are not easy to complete in conventional sintering furnaces. Because the laser beam has small concentration and penetration, it is suitable for sintering of small area and thin products. It is easy to sintering powder or thin compact that are different from the matrix composition together. Sintering of high melting point metals and ceramics can be realized by using light. Compared with other rapid prototyping technologies, the components made by laser sintering have the characteristics of good performance, fast manufacturing speed, diversified materials and low cost. Laser sintering is not only an effective tool for rapid prototyping, but also increasingly becomes the choice of manufacturing processes for a large number of different complex products.

explanation_cn: 利用高能量激光束加热金属工件表层（必要时还同时熔化表面涂覆的物质）实现表面化学成分改变或表面组织结构变化的热处理工艺方法。
explanation_en: It is a heat treatment process that uses high-energy laser beam to heat the surface layer of metal workpiece (and also melts the material coated on the surface when necessary) to realize the change of surface chemical composition or surface structure.

explanation_cn: 采用聚焦的激光束作为热源的焊接方法，功率密度可达10^5W/cm2以上。按能量输出方式可分为连续激光焊和脉冲激光焊，按作用在工件上的功率密度不同而形成的工艺特征可分为深熔焊接（功率密度大于10^6W/cm2）和热传导焊接（功率密度小于10^6W/cm2）。用于焊接的激光主要有CO2激光（波长10.6μm）以及YAG（掺钕钇铝石榴石）激光（波长1.06μm）。激光焊具有功率密度高、焊缝深而窄、热影响区小、速度快、质量高的特点，适用于难熔金属以及热物理性能悬殊工件间的焊接。也广泛用于汽车薄板的拼焊、微电子电路封装焊接等。YAG激光可用光纤传输机器人结合，可组成柔性激光焊接系统。激光与电弧复合作为热源的焊接称为激光电弧复合焊（laser-arc hybrid welding），用以提高母材对激光的吸收率、增加熔深及稳定电弧。
explanation_en: Weld method using focused laser beam as heat source, power density can reach 10 ^ 5W/cm 2 Above. According to the energy output mode, it can be divided into continuous laser welding and pulse laser welding. According to the process characteristics formed by different power density acting on the workpiece, it can be divided into deep penetration weld (power density is greater than 10 ^ 6W/cm 2） And heat conduction weld (power density is less than 10 ^ 6W/cm 2）。 The laser used for weld mainly includes CO2 laser (wavelength 10.6 μ m) And YAG (neodymium doped yttrium aluminum garnet) laser (wavelength 1.06 μ m) . Laser welding has the characteristics of high power density, deep and narrow weld, small heat affected zone, fast speed and high quality. It is suitable for weld between refractory metals and workpieces with different thermophysical properties. It is also widely used in auto sheet welding, microelectronic circuit packaging weld, etc. YAG laser can be combined with optical fiber transmission robot to form a flexible laser weld system. Laser arc hybrid welding is the weld with laser and arc as the heat source, which is used to improve the laser absorption of the base metal, increase the penetration and stabilize the arc.

explanation_cn: 激光玻璃是一种以玻璃为基质的固体激光材料。其广泛应用于各类塑间体激光光器中，并成为高功率和高能量激光器的主要激光材料。激光玻璃由两部分组成，基质玻璃和激活离子。
explanation_en: Laser glass is a kind of solid laser materials based on glass. It is widely used in various kinds of plastisol lasers and has become the main laser materials for high-power and high-energy lasers. The laser glass consists of two parts, the matrix glass and the activated ions.

explanation_cn: 原稿经计算机照排后，根据电信号的强弱调制激光，直接扫描到PS版上制成印刷版，也可以通过卫星、电传实现远距离直接制版，省去了银盐胶片以及烦琐的显、定影、拷贝工艺.大大加快了制版速度。
explanation_en: After being typeset by computer, the original manuscript is directly scanned onto the PS plate using a laser modulated by the intensity of the electrical signal to create a printing plate. It can also be directly made from a long distance through satellite or telex, eliminating the need for silver salt film and cumbersome display, fixing, and copying processes, greatly accelerating the plate making speed.

name_cn: 激光诱导化学气相反应制粉
name_en: powder preparation by laser-induced chemical vapor reaction
explanation_cn: 又被称为激光热分解和激光化学分解，是一种使用激光作为能源来促使化学气相反应的方法。激光热分解指的是激光聚焦在衬底材料上，通过在局部区域升高温度，使该区域内的反应物气体发生类似于一般热分解化学气相沉积（CVD）过程的过程。不同之处在于此时的热源是激光光能。为了实现激光热分解，需要选择适合激光吸收的波长，以使衬底具有较高的吸收系数，同时，主要反应气体应该是透明的。激光化学分解是指当反应物气体吸收单光子或多光子时，它们分解成更简单的分子或原子的过程。激光具有单色性好和高功率密度的特点。通过选择吸收光子的波长与反应气体的激发波长相匹配，能够在极短时间内将气体加热到自发反应温度，并促使化学反应发生。与其他气相合成方法相比，激光化学气相沉积有以下优点：1. 反应物直接通过吸收光子而被加热，无需高温壁的存在，因此产物更高纯。2. 反应区域被限定在小的加热空间内，温度梯度陡峭，有助于粒子的核生成、生长速率和曝光时间的严格控制，从而可以合成粒径分布范围较窄的超细粉末。3. 反应条件可以得到严格控制，确保经过反应区域的气体分子几乎具有相同的时间温度历程。
explanation_en: Also known as laser thermal decomposition and laser chemical decomposition, it is a method of using laser as energy to promote chemical vapor phase reactions. Laser thermal decomposition refers to the process that the laser focuses on the backing materials and makes the reactant gas in the region occur similar to the general thermal decomposition chemical vapor deposition (CVD) process by raising the temperature in the local region. The difference is that the heat source at this time is laser light energy. In order to achieve laser thermal decomposition, it is necessary to choose a wavelength suitable for laser absorption, so that the substrate has a high absorption coefficient, and the main reaction gas should be transparent. Laser chemical decomposition refers to the process of decomposing reactant gases into simpler molecules or atoms when they absorb single or multiple photons. Laser has the characteristics of good monochromaticity and high power density. By selecting the wavelength of the absorption photon to match the excitation wavelength of the reaction gas, the gas can be heated to the spontaneous reaction temperature in a very short time, and the chemical reaction can be promoted. Compared with other vapor synthesis methods, laser chemical vapor deposition has the following advantages: 1 The reactants are directly heated by absorbing photons, without the need for high-temperature walls, resulting in higher purity products. 2. The reaction area is limited in a small heating space, and the temperature gradient is steep, which helps to strictly control the nucleation, growth rate and exposure time of particles, so that ultrafine powder with narrow particle size distribution can be synthesized. 3. The reaction conditions can be strictly controlled to ensure that gas molecules passing through the reaction area have almost the same time and temperature history.

explanation_cn: 激光系统工作效率的重要标志，通常以输入激光器的能量作为横坐标，以激光器输出的能量作为纵坐标，作出激光器的输出特性曲线（如图所示）。激光器的效率通常有两种定义，一种叫总体效率（又称绝对效率），一种叫斜率效率。总体效率是指输出能量或功率与输入能量或功率之比。由于特性曲线通常不是通过原点的直线，所以随着输出能量的变化而变化。斜率效率是指当输入功率超过阈值时，激光器的输出特性曲线接近一条直线的直线斜率，它反映输出功率随输入功率的增长速率。
explanation_en: An important indicator of the efficiency of a laser system is usually based on the input laser energy as the horizontal axis and the output laser energy as the vertical axis, and the output characteristic curve of the laser is drawn (as shown in the figure). There are usually two definitions for the efficiency of lasers, one is called overall efficiency (also known as absolute efficiency), and the other is called slope efficiency. Overall efficiency refers to the ratio of output energy or power to input energy or power. Due to the fact that the characteristic curve is usually not a straight line passing through the origin, it changes with the output energy. Slope efficiency means that when the input power exceeds the threshold, the output characteristic curve of the laser is close to the linear slope of a straight line, which reflects the growth rate of output power with the input power.

explanation_cn: 激光器实现光振荡的临界条件。激光器产生临界振荡时的有关参量之间的数量关系，称为激光（振荡）阈值。激光阚值在不同情况下可以有不同的表示方式。如产生激光振荡的最小反转粒子数密度称为阈值粒子数反转密度。在实际激光器中，加于激光器的激励功率必须超过一个临界值，此最小值称为阈值功率，它是激光振荡的重要特征。
explanation_en: The critical conditions for laser to achieve optical oscillation. The quantitative relationship between the relevant parameters when a laser generates critical oscillation is called the laser (oscillation) threshold. Laser threshold values can be represented differently in different situations. For example, the minimum inversion particle number density that generates laser oscillation is called threshold particle number inversion density. In practical lasers, the excitation power applied to the laser must exceed a critical value, which is called threshold power and is an important characteristic of laser oscillation.

explanation_cn: 能对10MJ以上高脉冲能量激光进行有效频率转换的非线性光学材料。要求材料完整性高，缺陷、杂质少和无结构应力，以保证材料有高光学均匀性和高光损伤阈值。
explanation_en: Nonlinear optical materials capable of effective frequency conversion of high pulse energy laser above 10MJ. It is required that materials have high integrity, few defects, impurities and no structural stress to ensure that materials have high optical uniformity and high light damage threshold.

explanation_cn: 指发光材料在不同波长光的激发下，材料的某一发光谱线和谱带的强度或发光效率与激发光波长的关系。根据激发光谱可以确定该发光材料发光所需的激发光波长范围，并可以确定某发光谱线强度最大时，最佳的激发光波长。
explanation_en: It refers to the relationship between the intensity of a certain luminescence spectral line and spectral band of a luminescence materials or the luminescence efficiency and the wavelength of the excitation light when the materials is excited by light of different wavelengths. According to the excitation spectrum, the range of excitation light wavelength required for luminescence of the luminescence materials can be determined, and the optimal excitation light wavelength can be determined when the intensity of a luminescence spectral line is the largest.

explanation_cn: 当材料中的电子受到激发而跃迁到较高能级时，材料由基态变为激发态。其中激发态中具有较高能量的电子与材料中的某空穴有一定的束缚关系。这种较高能量的电子和与之有束缚作用的空穴六一起构成了所谓的激子。
explanation_en: When the electrons in the materials are excited and jump to a higher level, the materials changes from the ground state to the excited state. The electron with higher energy in the excited state has a certain binding relationship with a hole in the materials. This higher energy electron and the hole six with which it is bound constitute the so-called exciton.

explanation_cn: 在发光材料的基质晶体中加人某种杂质，造成结构上的缺陷，使原来不发光或发光很弱的材料产生发光，这种作用叫作激活，所加入的杂质称为激活剂。
explanation_en: Adding some impurity to the matrix crystal of luminescence materials will cause structural defects and make materials that does not luminescence light or has weak luminescence light luminescence. This effect is called activation, and the added impurity is called activator.

explanation_cn: 一种以粒径小于2mm 的火山碎屑（晶屑、岩屑及玻肩）组成的压实固结的火山碎屑岩。碎屑物质小于50%，分选很差，填隙 物是更细的火山微尘。分布在火山口周围，但距火山口距离较远。按碎屑物组成可以进一步划分为玻屑凝 灰岩、晶屑凝灰岩、岩屑凝灰岩等。与膨润土、沸石等非金属矿成矿关系密切。可作建筑材料与水泥原料。
explanation_en: A compacted and consolidated pyroclastic rock composed of pyroclasts (crystal chips, rock chips and glass shoulder) with particle size less than 2mm. The detrital material is less than 50%, poorly sorted, and the interstitial material is finer volcanic dust. Distributed around volcanic craters, but far away from them. According to the composition of detritus, it can be further divided into glassy tuff, crystalline tuff, lithic tuff, etc. It is closely related to the metallogenesis of bentonite, zeolite and other non-metallic minerals. It can be used as building materials and cement raw materials.

explanation_cn: 是岩衆喷出地表或近地表冷凝而成的岩石的总称。包括喷出岩、火山碎屑岩和次火山岩（与火山活动有关的超浅成岩）。按喷发 环境，可划分为海相火山岩和陆相火山岩两类。成分变化大，从基性至酸性都有，如玄武岩、安山岩、流纹岩等分布十分广泛，与其有关的矿产相当丰富，如沸石、水晶、浮石、铜矿、铁矿等。
explanation_en: It is the general name of rock eject from the surface or condensed near the surface. It includes extrusive rock, pyroclastic rock and sub volcanic rock (ultra hypabyssal rock related to volcanic activity). According to the eruption environment, it can be divided into marine volcanic rock and continental volcanic rock. The composition varies greatly, from basic to acidic, such as basalt, andesite, rhyolite, etc., which are widely distributed, and its related minerals are quite abundant, such as zeolite, crystal, pumice, copper ore, iron ore, etc.

explanation_cn: 火山爆发过程中形成的粒径<2mm的火山碎屑物。化学成分变化大.从基性至酸性都有；物相组成以玻屑为主，也有岩屑和晶屑。第三纪和第四纪的火山灰大多呈松散状态，具有容重小、密度小、孔隙率大、活性大等特点。其它时代的火山灰大多已凝固成为凝灰岩。可用作水泥的活性混合料及混凝土的掺合料，也可制备保温、隔声轻型建筑材料，还可作为磨料和填料。主要分布在我国 黑龙江北部、吉林东部等地。
explanation_en: Volcanic debris with a particle size of<2mm formed during volcanic eruptions. The chemical composition varies greatly, ranging from basic to acidic; The phase is mainly composed of glass chips, rock chips and crystal chips. The Tertiary and Quaternary volcanic ash is mostly loose, characterized by small bulk density, small density, large porosity and high activity. Most of the volcanic ash of other ages has solidified into tuff. It can be used as an active mixture of cement and an admixture of concrete, as well as a light materials for thermal insulation and sound insulation, and as an abrasive and filler. Mainly distributed in northern Heilongjiang and eastern Jilin in China.

explanation_cn: 在水泥粉磨过程加人的火山灰质材料。以氧化硅、氧化铝为主要成分，单独磨细加水拌和并不能硬化，但与水泥 熟料混合后.可以与其加水拌合时释放的氢氧化钙反 应生成水化硅酸钙，具有水硬性。
explanation_en: Volcanic ash materials added during cement grinding. With silica and alumina as the main components, grinding and mixing alone with water can not harden, but after mixing with cement clinker, it can react with the calcium hydroxide released when mixing with water to generate calcium silicate hydrate, which has hydraulic properties.

explanation_cn: 由火山喷发活动形成的火山碎屑物在火山口附近堆积，或经过空中搬运、沉积而固结、胶结形成的岩石。
explanation_en: Volcanic debris formed by volcanic eruption accumulates near the crater, or is consolidated and cemented by air transportation and sedimentation.

explanation_cn: 一种以粒径大于64mm火山岩块为主要组成的压实固结的火山岩。火山岩块含量一般在50%以上，棱角明显，形态不规则，也有少量其他岩石的碎块。填隙物为火山灰等细碎屑物。通常分布在火山口附近，有时呈渐变过渡关系。
explanation_en: A kind of compacted and consolidated volcanic rock mainly composed of volcanic rock blocks with grain size greater than 64mm. The content of volcanic rock is generally more than 50%, with obvious edges and corners, irregular shape, and a small amount of other rock fragments. The filler is fine debris such as volcanic ash. Usually distributed near volcanic craters, sometimes in a gradual transition relationship.

explanation_cn: 通常火工品由壳体与火工药剂两个基本部分组成。火工品装药工艺就是以火工药剂为装填物料， 通过多种装药机、压药机等机械设备，将火工药剂经装、压药工艺装填到火工品的壳体内，制造出合格火工品的过程。
explanation_en: Generally, initiating explosive device consists of shell and initiating explosives and relative compositions. Cheirging technology of initiating device is the process of taking initiating explosives and relative compositions as the filling material, and filling initiating explosives and relative compositions into the shell of initiating explosive device through a variety of charging machines, pressing machines and other mechanical equipment through charging and pressing process, so as to produce qualified initiating explosive device.

explanation_cn: 火工药剂是一种具有独特性能和功能的化学能源。它是火工品专用的特种含能材料。它的作 用是接受火工品换能元件给出的可精确控制的低能激发能量，发生快速化学反应.输出燃烧、爆燃或 爆轰能量，使火工品实现点火、传火、引爆、传爆、 延期、燃气做功以及烟火效应。
explanation_en: Initiating explosives and relative compositions is a kind of chemical energy with unique performance and function. It is a special energetic materials for initiating explosive devices. Its function is to receive the accurately controlled low-energy excitation energy given by the energy converter of initiating explosive device, generate rapid chemical reaction, output combustion, deflagration or detonation energy, and enable initiating explosive device to realize ignition, flame transmission, detonation, detonation transmission, delay, gas work and pyrotechnic effect.

explanation_cn: 测定火工药剂安全性或感度的试验，主要用于评定火工药剂受外界刺激，如机械作用、 热、光、电、电磁波、静电、冲击波、震动等而发生燃烧、爆燃、爆轰的难易程度。对不同的外界刺激作 用采用相应的测试装置和方法进行测定。
explanation_en: The test to determine the safety or sensitivity of initiating explosives and relative compositions is mainly used to assess the difficulty of combustion, deflagration and detonation of initiating explosives and relative compositions caused by external irritation, such as mechanical action, heat, light, electricity, electromagnetic wave, static electricity, shock wave and vibration. The effects of different external irritation were measured with corresponding test devices and methods.

name_en: small scale gap test (SSGT) of pyrotechnic composition
explanation_cn: 测定火工药剂受冲击波作用发生爆炸的难易程度，其测试方法是：标准施主炸药被雷管起爆后，产生的冲击波经过隔板衰减作用于被测样品，被测样品50%发生爆炸对应的隔板厚度用于表征其冲击波感度，该值越大则冲击波感度越高。隔板材料可为有机玻璃或铝、铜等，施主炸药和测试样品均压制为直径为5mm的药柱并装入钢套筒内，试验采用升降法进行。
explanation_en: To determine the degree of difficulty of initiating explosives and relative compositions explosion under the action of shock wave, the test method is: after the standard donor explosive is detonated by detonator, the shock wave generated will attenuate on the tested sample through the diaphragm. The thickness of the diaphragm corresponding to 50% of the tested sample explosion is used to characterize its sensitivity to shock wave. The greater the value, the higher the sensitivity to shock wave. The diaphragm materials can be organic glass or aluminum, copper, etc. The donor explosive and test sample are pressing into a grain with a diameter of 5mm and put into a steel sleeve. The test is conducted by the lifting method.

explanation_cn: 相容性是指两种或两种以上的物质相互混合或相互接触组成混合体系后.体系的反应能力与单一物质相比其变化的程度。相容性有内相容性和外相容性，内相容性指火工药剂各组分间的相容性，外相容性指药剂作为整体与相接触物质的相容性。
explanation_en: Compatibility refers to the degree to which the reaction ability of the system changes compared with that of a single substance after two or more substances mix or contact each other to form a mixed system. Compatibility includes internal compatibility and external compatibility. Internal compatibility refers to the compatibility among the components of initiating explosives and relative compositions, and external compatibility refers to the compatibility between the agent as a whole and the phase contacting substances.

name_cn: 火工药剂真空安定性试验
name_en: vacuum stability test of pyrotechnic composition
explanation_cn: 测试火工药剂在恒温、定时热作用下的化学安定性。
explanation_en: Test the chemical stability of initiating explosives and relative compositions under constant temperature and timed thermal action.

explanation_cn: 又称干法冶金，利用高温从矿石中提取金属或其化合物的冶金过程。火法冶金是提取冶金的最重要的工艺方法，过程中所发生的反应主要是氧化还原反应。
explanation_en: Also known as dry metallurgy, it is a metallurgical process that uses high temperature to extract metals or their compounds from ores. Pyrometallurgy is the most important process method of extraction metallurgy, and the reaction in the process is mainly redox reaction.

explanation_cn: 火药或炸药吸收水汽的能力。是增重伴随吸热的物理过程。通常将一定颗粒度的火药、炸药或它们的组分置于一定温度和湿度下的专用仪器中，记录在一定时间内的连续吸热过程和一定时间后 的质量增加，来衡量其吸湿性。
explanation_en: The ability of propellant or explosive to absorb water vapor. It is a physical process of weight gain accompanied by heat absorption. Generally, propellant, explosive or their components with a certain particle size are placed in a special instrument under a certain temperature and humidity, and the continuous heat absorption process within a certain time and the mass increase after a certain time are recorded to measure their moisture absorption.

explanation_cn: 又称火焰法。在火焰射流中进行化学反应以制取表面覆盖层的工艺方法。它在分类上应归入热化学气相沉积（TCVD)。
explanation_en: It is also called flame method. The process of conducting chemical reactions in a flame jet to produce a surface covering layer. It should be classified as thermo-chemical vapor deposition (TCVD).

explanation_cn: 火焰感度是火工药剂在火焰（火花或火星）作用下发生燃烧、爆 炸的难易程度，是热感度的一种。火焰感度试验以导火索或标准熏火药药柱燃烧产生的火星或火焰作用于不同距离的药剂试样上，观察是否被引燃，用升降法测得50%发火率对应的距离或上下限（100%发火的最大距离为上限，100%不发火的最小距离为下限）表示火焰感度。
explanation_en: Flame sensitivity is a kind of thermal sensitivity, which refers to the difficulty of combustion and explosion of initiating explosives and relative compositions under the action of flame (spark or spark). The flame sensitivity test uses the spark or flame generated by the combustion of the fuse or standard fuming powder column to act on the reagent samples at different distances to observe whether they are ignited. The distance or upper and lower limits corresponding to 50% of the firing rate are measured by the lifting method (the maximum distance of 100% firing is the upper limit, and the minimum distance of 100% non firing is the lower limit) to indicate the flame sensitivity.

explanation_cn: 见火焰射流反应沉积。
explanation_en: See flame jet reaction deposition.

explanation_cn: 参见燧石岩。
explanation_en: See flint rock.

explanation_cn: 简称F玻璃。无色光学玻璃两大类之一，较另一类冕玻璃（K玻璃）色散为大。习惯上按密度或组分特征分为轻火石、火石、 重火石、钡火石、重钡火石、镧火石、重镧火石、 钛火石及特种火石等品种。大都含PbO。主要用作光学仪器中光学零件的材料。
explanation_en: It is called F glass for short. One of the two major types of colorless optical glass, which has a larger dispersion than the other type of coronal glass (K glass). According to density or composition characteristics, it is customarily divided into light flim, flim, heavy flim, barium flim, heavy barium flim, lanthanum flim, heavy lanthanum flim, titanium flim and special flim. Most contain PbO. It is mainly used as materials of optical parts in optical instruments.

explanation_cn: 火箭飞行器自身在携带的能源和工质的总称。在不依赖外界空气条件下在火箭发动机内能源转化为工质的动能，经喷管形成高速气流排出而产生反作用力。也可简称为产生火箭发动机推力的物质，化学火箭推进剂由氧化剂与燃烧剂及一些功能添加剂组成，可以是单质也可以是混合物。
explanation_en: The general term for the energy and working fluids carried by rocket aircraft themselves. The kinetic energy converted from energy into working fluid in a rocket engine without relying on external air conditions is discharged through a high-speed airflow formed by the nozzle, resulting in a reaction force. It can also be referred to as the material that generates rocket engine thrust. Chemical rocket propellant is composed of oxidizer, incendiary composition and some functional additive. It can be a single substance or a mixture.

explanation_cn: 一种采用高频火花放电离子源的质谱分析法。是利用两个相距很近的电极在强电场（lO^5V/cm)作用下产生场致发射电子，电子流使电极汽化电离，引起激烈的真空放电（即所谓火花），其温度可达5000K，因而电离效率极高。
explanation_en: A mass spectrometry analysis method using a high-frequency spark discharge ion source. It utilizes two closely spaced electrodes to generate field emission electrons under a strong electric field (lO ^ 5V/cm). The electron flow vaporizes and ionizes the electrode, causing intense vacuum discharge (also known as spark), with a temperature of up to 5000K, resulting in extremely high ionization efficiency.

explanation_cn: 火药是一种能迅速、有规律地燃烧，产生大量高温气体，可用作推进或抛射的能源材料。火药包括发射药、火箭推进剂和点火药等不同类型，其组分通常包括黏合剂、氧化剂、燃料和添加剂。根据物理结构，火药可分为均质火药和异质火药，分别用于不同的应用。火药的制造工艺包括挤压成型、溶解悬浮成型和浇铸成型，以满足各种用途的性能需求。火药主要用于武器发射、火箭推进、航天、气象探测、应急装置、灭火等领域，将化学潜能转化为热能和气态产物，提供强大的动力。
explanation_en: Propellant is a kind of energy materials that can quickly and regularly combustion and produce a large amount of high-temperature gas, which can be used for propulsion or ejection. Propellant includes gun propellant, rocket propellant, ignition propellant and other different types, and its components usually include adhesive, oxidizer, fuel and additive. According to the physical structure, propellant can be divided into homogeneous propellant and inhomogeneous propellant for different applications. The manufacturing process of propellant includes extrusion moulding, solution suspension molding and casting molding to meet the performance requirements of various applications. Propellant is mainly used in weapon launching, rocket propulsion, aerospace, meteorological detection, emergency devices, fire fighting and other fields, transforming chemical potential into thermal and gaseous products, providing powerful power.

explanation_cn: 包括制造火药的方法、原理、流程、设备和工艺条件。火药种类不同，其制造工业也不同。常用的有压伸工艺、 压延工艺、浇铸工艺和悬浮工艺。
explanation_en: It includes the method, principle, process, equipment and process conditions for manufacturing propellant. Different propellant has different manufacturing industries. The commonly used processes are press drawing process, calendering process, casting process and suspension process.

explanation_en: Components added to improve a certain performance of propellant. Generally, it refers to other additional components besides the main components such as adhesive, oxidizer and combustible agent, whose content is generally below 5%, but can significantly improve a certain performance.

explanation_en: Ordinary cast iron in which carbon mainly exists in the form of lamellar graphite, which makes its fracture dark gray.

explanation_en: The animal skin is a work in progress product in the state of lower expansion after unhairing and liming treatment. It can perform mechanical operations such as meat removal and splitting.

explanation_cn: 灰色陶器陶器述体采用还原焰焙烧，将陶胎的铁氧化物还原为Fe2+，使陶胎呈现出灰色。烧成温度一般在840 ~ 900°C，最高可： 达1100°C。
explanation_en: The body of grey pottery pottery is baked in a reducing flame to reduce the iron oxide of the pottery body to Fe2+, making the pottery body appear grey. The firing temperature is generally between 840~900 ° C, with a maximum of 1100 ° C.

explanation_cn: 材料在灼热条件下发生燃烧的性质，有时又称无焰燃烧或阴燃，是材料的一种燃烧现象。灼热燃烧也会蔓延、发光和放出有毒烟气。根据不同的燃烧环境和材料，可以是稳定的灼热燃烧，也可能发展成有焰燃烧或趋向熄灭，例如香烟的燃烧行为就是一种灼热燃烧现象。在电气行业内设备内部容易使火焰蔓延的绝缘材料或其他同体可燃材料的零件吋能会由于灼热丝或灼热元件而起燃。在一定条件下，例如流过导线的故障电流、元件过载以及不良接触的情况下，某些元件会达到某一温度而使其附近的零件起燃。灼热丝试验机是利用模拟技术评定由于灼热元件或过载电阻之类热源，在短时间内所造成热应力的着火危险性。适用于电工电子设备及其元件、部件，也适用于同体电气绝缘物料或其他同体可燃材料。
explanation_en: The combustion of materials under scorching conditions, sometimes called after glow or smoldering, is a combustion phenomenon of materials. Hot combustion will also spread, luminescence and emit toxic smoke. According to different combustion environments and materials, it can be stable burning combustion, or it can develop into after flame or tend to extinguish. For example, the combustion behavior of cigarettes is a burning combustion phenomenon. In the electrical industry, insulating materials or other parts of the same combustible materials that are easy to spread the flame inside the equipment can ignite due to the glow wire or glow element. Under certain conditions, such as fault current flowing through wires, component overload, and poor contact, certain components may reach a certain temperature and cause nearby parts to ignite. Glow wire tester uses simulation technology to assess the ignition risk of thermal stress caused by heat sources such as Glow elements or overload resistance in a short time. It is applicable to electrical and electronic equipment and its components and parts, as well as electrical insulation materials or other combustible materials of the same body.

explanation_cn: 将带钢在炉内加热，经成型和焊接而成的钢管。制造方法有两种:①非连续炉焊法，在成型和焊接时采用钟罩式模具的方法，将宽度比管子周长稍宽和一定长度的低碳带钢，放入带蓄热室的特殊加热炉中加热，当带钢边缘达到焊接温度时，用夹具夹住带钢前端，通过钟罩式模具进行拉拔而成。在带钢即将通过模具前，在两侧吹风，将带钢上的氧化铁皮吹走，同时利用氧化产生高温以得到良好焊接效果。然后用高压水去除外表面铁鳞，再在除鳞机上去除内壁的铁鳞。此法是焊管生产中最古老的方法。劳动条件差，生产效率低、焊缝质量差，已逐渐被淘汰；②连续炉焊法，又称Fretz-Moon炉焊法，采用的带钢是长带卷，用闪光焊机将多个带卷头尾焊在一起，成为无头带钢，将其放在活套装置内，从活套装置出来的带钢通过狭长的加热炉快速加热，加热时间20-80s,将带钢两边加热到焊接温度(1350°C左右)，出炉后用压缩空气吹去铁鳞，再进入焊接成型机。焊接成型机机由立辊和平辊交替配置，共十几对轧辊，带钢经过成型、焊接、减径等工序加工成钢管。Fretz-Moon法特点是:生产效率高，焊接速度达300-500m/min;配有张力减径机可用相同尺寸的带钢生产出不同尺寸的焊管；不适宜小批量生产；只用于生产煤气管、自来水管和电线管等比较低级的钢管；受加热工序限制，只宜生产较小直径的管子，最大直径约为115mm。
explanation_en: The steel pipe is formed by heating strip steel in furnace, forming and weld. There are two manufacturing methods: ① discontinuous furnace welding method. During forming and weld, bell jar mold method is used. Low carbon strip steel with a width slightly wider than the circumference of the pipe and a certain length is put into a special soaking pit with a heat storage chamber for heating. When the edge of strip steel reaches the weld temperature, clamp the front end of strip steel with a clamp and conduct drawing through the bell jar mold. Before the strip steel passes through the mold, blow air on both sides to blow away the scale on the strip steel, and at the same time use oxidation to generate high temperature to obtain good weld effect. Then use high-pressure water to remove the iron scale on the excluded surface, and then remove the iron scale on the inner wall of the descaling machine. This method is the oldest method in welded pipe production. Poor labor conditions, low production efficiency, and poor weld quality have gradually been eliminated; ② The continuous furnace welding method, also known as the Fretz Moon furnace welding method, uses a long strip steel coil. A flash welder is used to weld a number of coil heads and tails together to form a headless strip steel, which is placed in a looper device. The strip steel coming out of the looper device is quickly heated by a narrow and long soaking pit. The heating time is 20-80s, and the two sides of the strip steel are heated to the weld temperature (about 1350 ° C). After being taken out of the furnace, the iron scales are blown off with compressed air, and then enter the weld molding machine. The weld forming machine is alternately equipped with vertical rolls and flat rolls, with a total of more than ten pairs of roll. strip steel is processed into steel pipes through forming, weld, reducing and other processes. The Fretz Moon method is characterized by high production efficiency and weld speed of 300-500m/min; Equipped with tension reducing mill, welded pipes of different sizes can be produced from strip steel of the same size; Not suitable for small-scale production; Only used for producing relatively low-grade steel pipes such as gas pipes, water pipes, and wire pipes; Due to the limitations of the heating process, only smaller diameter pipes should be produced, with a maximum diameter of approximately 115mm.

explanation_cn: 是指通过炔烃单体的聚合反应得到的、具有新型功能的特殊聚合物材料。通常具有共轭的聚合物主链。成为有机半导体材料。自从20世纪70年代末期，Shirakawa等入发现了掺杂后的聚乙烯薄膜具有金属导电性之后。这一领域发展迅速。炔烃聚合物吋以通过不同的聚合方法来制备，例如过渡金属催化的偶联聚合反应、环三聚反应、炔烃的易位聚合反应、点击聚合反应等。通过对新型炔炫单体和催化剂的开发，以及对聚合反应条件的优化，可以得到结构功能各异的线型和超支化炔烃聚合物。在单体结构中引入功能基元，可以赋予炔烃聚合物材料新的性质，例如聚集诱导发光性质、光学非线性、高折射率及低的色散度、光交联性质、氧化还原性和磁性等。
explanation_en: It refers to the special polymer materials with new functions obtained by polymerization of alkyne monomer. It usually has a conjugated polymer backbone. Become organic semiconductor materials. Since the late 1970s, Shirakawa et al. discovered that the doped polyethylene film has metallic conductivity. This field is developing rapidly. Alkyne polymer are prepared by different polymerization methods, such as transition metal catalyzed coupling polymerization, cyclotrimerization, translocation polymerization of alkynes, click polymerization, etc. Linear and hyperbranched alkyne polymer with different structures and functions can be obtained by developing new alkyne monomer and catalysts and optimizing the reaction conditions of polymerization. The introduction of functional units into the monomer structure can endow alkyne polymer materials with new properties, such as aggregation induced luminescence property, optical nonlinearity, high refractive index and low dispersion, photocrosslinking property, redox property and magnetism.

explanation_cn: 指成为最终的炭制品前，处于某一阶段的连续炭化的中间产物，可通过凋整炭前驱体来进行各种结构设计，再通过热处理保持基本结构的同相炭化来得到所需炭材料。
explanation_en: It refers to the intermediate product of continuous carbonization at a certain stage before becoming the final carbon product. Various structural designs can be carried out by trimming the carbon precursor, and then the required carbon materials can be obtained by in-phase carbonization that maintains the basic structure through heat treatment.

explanation_cn: 以沥青为原料.用熔吹法纺成的布（毡）状短纤维，经不熔化、炭化制成，其耐热性、隔热性良好。
explanation_en: The cloth (felt) staple fiber, which is made from pitch by melt blowing, is made of non melting and carbonization, and has good heat resistance and heat insulation.

explanation_cn: 以锻烧无烟煤、焦炭或石墨等为原料，以焦油沥青或酚醛树脂为结合剂，制成的耐火制品。耐火度高，高温体积稳定，热导率很高，热震稳定性好，耐酸、碱、盐、有机物及熔融金属的侵蚀性能优良?但抗氧化性差。
explanation_en: Refractory products are made of calcined anthracite, coke or graphite as raw materials and tar pitch or phenolic resin as binder. High refractoriness, stable volume at high temperature, high thermal conductivity, good thermal shock resistance, excellent corrosion resistance to acid, alkali, salt, organic matter and molten metal? But its antioxidant properties are poor.

explanation_cn: 由约95%以上非晶质炭构成的纳米级微粒，相对密度为1.8-1.9，粉末状炭黑的堆相对密度为0.04-0.08。由比表面积、二次结构、聚集体分布等作为其质量标准，是工业生产的基础原材料。
explanation_en: Nanoparticles composed of more than 95% amorphous carbon have a relative density of 1.8-1.9, and the relative density of powdered carbon black is 0.04-0.08. With specific surface, secondary structure, aggregate distribution, etc. as its quality standards, it is the basic raw material for industrial production.

explanation_cn: 在适当外部激发能量作用下，可发生爆炸变化（速度极快且放出大量热和大量气体的化学反应）并对周围介质做功的化合物或混合物。可以是固态、液态或气态，气-液态或气-固态，多为固态。广义的分起爆药、猛、火药和烟火药剂四类。起爆药用于起爆猛，猛用于产生爆轰，此二类又称高爆速;火药和烟火药剂用于产生燃烧和爆燃，故又称低爆速。通常所说的指猛。按照化学组成，可分为单质和混合。不仅是武器的能源，也是国民经济许多部门不吋缺少的含能材料，它能发生极快的爆炸变化，可在瞬间产生压力达几十吉帕（GPa)、温度达儿千摄氏度的气体，这种气体向炸点周围急剧膨胀而做功。的爆炸特性可用爆热、爆速、爆温、爆压和爆容（比容积）五个参数综合评价，它们是做功能力（威力）和对周围介质粉碎能力（猛度）的决定性因素。表征特性的参量还有感度、安定性、相容性等。在军事上，用作杀伤爆破装药以装填各种炮弹、航空炸弹、导弹战斗部、鱼雷、水雷、地雷、手榴弹、爆破药包以及原子弹和热核武器的起爆元件。在民用上，广泛应用于各种工程爆破作业(如采矿、建筑、水利）和金属爆炸加工（焊接、成型、复合），也用于制造超硬材料（如金刚石、氮化硼）、人工降雨、灭火、地震勘探和油井射孔等。
explanation_en: Under the action of appropriate external excitation energy, the compound or mixture can undergo explosion change (chemical reaction with extremely fast speed and releasing a lot of heat and gas) and work on the surrounding medium. It can be solid, liquid or gaseous, gas liquid or gas solid, mostly solid. Broadly divided into four categories: primary explosive, explosive, propellant and pyrotechnic composition. Primary explosive is used to initiate and produce detonation, which is also called high detonation velocity; Propellant and pyrotechnic composition are used to produce combustion and deflagration, so they are also called low detonation velocity. Usually referred to as' fierce '. According to chemical composition, it can be divided into elemental and mixed substances. It is not only the energy source of weapons, but also the energetic materials that many sectors of the national economy are always short of. It can produce extremely rapid explosion changes, and can instantly generate gas with pressure of tens of gigapapas (GPa) and temperature of thousands of degrees Celsius. This gas expands rapidly around the explosion point to do work. The explosion characteristics of can be comprehensively evaluated by five parameters: explosion heat, detonation velocity, detonation temperature, detonation pressure and detonation volume (specific volume), which are the decisive factors for the work ability (power) and the ability to crush surrounding media (ferocity). The characteristic parameters include sensitivity, stability, compatibility, etc. In military terms, it is used as a lethal explosive charge to fill various shells, aviation bombs, missile warheads, torpedoes, mines, hand grenades, explosive charges, as well as the initiating components of atomic bombs and thermonuclear weapons. In civil use, it is widely used in various engineering blasting operations (such as mining, construction, water conservancy) and metal explosion processing (weld, molding, composition), as well as in manufacturing superhard materials (such as diamond, boron nitride), artificial rainfall, fire extinguishing, seismic exploration, oil well perforation, etc.

explanation_cn: 是指一类具有单体易得、反应高效、条件温和、立体区域选择性好、官能团容忍性好和经济性的聚合反应。主要包括一价铜催化的叠氮和未端炔单体的点击聚合、无金属催化的活性炔与叠氮或者活性叠氮与炔单体的点击聚合，以及后续发展起来的硫醇与烯烃及炔烃的点击聚合反应。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of polymerization reaction with easy availability of monomer, high reaction efficiency, mild conditions, good stereoselectivity, good functional group tolerance and economy. It mainly includes copper catalyzed click polymerization of azide and non terminal alkyne monomer, metal free catalyzed click polymerization of active alkyne and azide or active azide and alkyne monomer, and the subsequent developed click polymerization reaction of mercaptan with alkenes and alkynes.

explanation_cn: 易于被特定形式冲能刺激而激发产生燃烧反应，引燃烟火药剂、推进剂、起爆药等装药的火工药剂。通常作为点火器的发火装药和输出火焰冲能装药，多压装成药柱或药环，也有药头、松装药形式。分为单质点火药和混合点火药两类。
explanation_en: Initiating explosives and relative compositions that is easy to be irritation by specific forms of impulse energy to generate combustion reaction and ignite pyrotechnic composition, propellant, primary explosive and other charges. Usually used as ignition charge and output flame energy charge for igniters, they are often compressed into charge columns or rings, and also in the form of charge heads or loose charges. It is divided into single ignition composition and mixed ignition composition.

explanation_cn: 焊件装配成搭接接头，并压紧在两电极之间，利用电阻热熔化母材金属，形成焊点的方法。
explanation_en: The method of assembling welded parts into overlapping joints and pressing them between two electrodes, using resistance heat to melt the base metal and form solder joints.

explanation_cn: 在规定的试验条件下，从材料中释放出的可燃气体，能够被外火焰点燃并持续燃烧一定时间时周围空气的最低温度，它是评价塑料着火性能的参数之一。
explanation_en: Under the specified test conditions, the lowest temperature of ambient air when the combustible gas released from materials can be ignited by an external flame and continue to combustion for a certain time, which is one of the parameters to evaluate the ignition performance of plastics.

explanation_cn: 决定理想晶体宏观几何外形的对称组合，即晶体的对称类型。是根据晶体的宏观对称元素进行对称操作而组合成的。进行对称操作时，至少要使晶体的某一点保持不动。总共可以推导出32种点群。
explanation_en: It determines the symmetry combination of the ideal crystal's macro geometric shape, that is, the symmetry type of crystal. It is combined by symmetry operation according to the macro symmetry elements of crystal. During symmetrical operation, at least one point of the crystal must be kept still. A total of 32 point group can be deduced.

explanation_cn: 又称孔蚀、小孔腐蚀。在金属表面部分区域出现纵深发展的腐蚀小孔，其他区域不腐蚀或腐蚀轻微，这种腐蚀形态叫点蚀。
explanation_en: It is also called pitting corrosion and pinhole corrosion. In some areas of the metal surface, there are corrosion pores that develop in depth. In other areas, there is no corrosion or slight corrosion. This corrosion form is called pitting corrosion.

explanation_cn: 在非理想第二类超导体中，磁通量子线与超导体内部点缺陷（如：空位和第二相纳米粒子等）之间的相互作用，导致磁通量子线的运动受到阻碍，称为点钉扎。
explanation_en: In the non ideal type II superconductor, the interaction between the magnetic flux quantum wire and the internal point defects of the superconductor (such as vacancy and second phase nanoparticles, etc.) causes the movement of the magnetic flux quantum wire to be blocked, which is called point pinning.

explanation_cn: 又称格子气模型。一种构想的粒子（原子）系统模型。在此模型中，用抽象化的格子代替实际晶体，就会得到一种类似于气体的晶格气体模型。研究在随机时间内，位于点阵上的粒子向其邻近位置的随机跳动。
explanation_en: Also called lattice gas model. A conceived model of a particle (atom) system. In this model, the abstract lattice is used to replace the actual crystal, and a lattice gas model similar to the gas will be obtained. Study the random jumping of particles located on a lattice towards their neighboring positions during random time.

explanation_cn: 晶体中原子之间有相互作用力，故各原子的热振动是相互联系的，这些相互联系的振动构成了晶体中的波动，称为点阵波。
explanation_en: The atoms in the crystal interact with each other, so the thermal vibrations of each atom are interrelated. These interrelated vibrations constitute waves in the crystal, called lattice wave.

explanation_cn: 固体通过点阵波的传播而导热的特性。固体中的导热主要是靠晶格振动的格波（也就是声子或称点阵波）和自由电子的运动来实现的。
explanation_en: The characteristic of a solid conducting heat through the propagation of lattice wave. The heat conduction in solids is mainly realized by the lattice wave of lattice vibration (that is, phonon or lattice wave) and the movement of free electrons.

explanation_cn: 又称缸器.是介于陶器和瓷器间的一类制品。其特点是结构致密，接近瓷化，强度较大，热稳定性好，能耐无机酸的侵蚀（氢氟酸除外），但不具有瓷器的半透明性。烧结温度一般在1200°C以上，气孔率一般在3%?6%之间，坯体颜色有白、灰、黄等，随原料中杂质不同而异。中国传统陶瓷业中没有炻器这一名称，它源于欧洲。其制品主要用于日用、建筑、装饰和化工等。
explanation_en: Also called jar ware, it is a kind of product between pottery and porcelain.
