It is characterized by compact structure, close to porcelain, high strength, good thermal stability, and resistance to erosion of inorganic acids (except hydrofluoric acid), but it does not have the translucency of porcelain. The sintering temperature is generally above 1200 ° C, and the porosity is generally 3%? Between 6%, the color of the green body can be white, gray, yellow, etc., which varies depending on the impurities in the raw material. There is no name of stoneware in Chinese traditional ceramics industry, which originated from Europe. Its products are mainly used for daily use, construction, decoration, and chemical industry.

explanation_cn: 火箭发动机、喷气发动机使用的液态烃的总称。主要包括航空煤油、火箭煤油、卨密度烃类燃料、吸热型烃类燃料和冲压发动机燃料。煤油主要由烷烃、环烷烃及芳香烃所组成。不同牌号和不同产地的煤油，其组成和性质是不同的。烃类燃料可以来自石油炼制或煤液化.也可以人工合成。与肼类燃料相比.烃类燃料安全性好、易存储、毒性低.可以减少燃料存储、运输、加注等过程的安全隐患，避免泄漏对人员及环境的致命危害。
explanation_en: The general term for liquid hydrocarbons used in rocket engines and jet engines. It mainly includes aviation kerosene, rocket kerosene, high density hydrocarbon fuels, endothermic hydrocarbon fuels and stamping engine fuel. Kerosene is mainly composed of alkanes, cycloalkanes, and aromatic hydrocarbons. The composition and properties of kerosene from different grades and origins are different. Hydrocarbon fuels can come from petroleum refining or coal liquefaction. It can also be artificially synthesized. Compared with hydrazine fuels, hydrocarbon fuels is safe, easy to store, and low toxic. It can reduce the potential safety hazards in the process of fuel storage, transportation, and filling, and avoid the fatal harm of leakage to personnel and the environment.

explanation_cn: 材料受辐射或燃烧时所产生的最大比光密度。将受试材料按规定尺寸制备成试样，在试样燃烧而产生烟雾的过程中测定穿过烟雾的一组平行光束透过率的变化，计算出在规定的试样面积和光程长度条件下相应的比光密度，选出最大的比光密度。
explanation_en: The maximum specific optical density of materials generated by radiation or combustion. Prepare the tested materials into a sample according to the specified size, measure the change of transmittance of a group of parallel beams passing through the smoke during the process of combustion of the sample to produce smoke, calculate the corresponding specific density under the conditions of the specified sample area and optical path length, and select the maximum specific density.

explanation_cn: 利用材料燃烧时产生烟雾的密集程度，表征材料燃烧性能的实验方法。适用于测定各种固体合成材料的烟密度。测定材料燃烧时发烟的方法很多，如通过测定累积烟的光吸收率方法、测定烟通过管道时烟密度的方法。通过吸烟筒时测定发烟系数的方法及通过过滤烟气微粒进行称重测定烟密度的方法等》众多的试验方法由于测试条件不同、原理不同，结果不能直接比较，选材时应注意所用烟密度的测定方法，以便对不同材料的燃烧性能进行比较。本法适用于各种合成材料烟密度的测定.其结果可用于评定在规定试验条件下材料的发烟量。
explanation_en: An experimental method for characterizing the combustion performance of materials based on the density of smoke generated during combustion of materials. It is suitable for measuring smoke density of various solid synthetic materials. There are many methods to measure the smoke emission of materials during combustion, such as the method of measuring the light absorption rate of accumulated smoke and the method of measuring the smoke density of smoke when passing through pipes. The method of measuring the smoke generation coefficient when passing through the smoking tube and the method of measuring the smoke density by weighing the filtered smoke particles, etc. Many test methods cannot be directly compared due to different test conditions and principles. When selecting materials, attention should be paid to the measurement method of smoke density, so as to compare the combustion performance of different materials. This method is applicable to the determination of smoke density of various synthetic materials. The results can be used to evaluate the smoke emission of materials under specified test conditions.

explanation_cn: 以碱金属和碱土金属的化合物作为吸收剂，与烟气中的硫氧化物生成硫酸盐或亚硫酸盐。常用的有钙基脱硫剂、氨基脱硫剂、钠基脱硫剂和镁甚脱硫剂等。①钙基脱硫剂主要是石灰石、石灰和消石灰.其资源丰富、开采容易、价格相对低廉。将石灰粉经消化处理后加水搅拌制成吸收浆液烟气中的二氧化硫与浆液中的氢氧化钙以及鼓入的氧化空气进行化学反应从而被吸收脱除，最终产物为石膏。②氨基脱硫剂，一般以氨水或液氨的形式作为脱硫的吸收剂主要用于氨洗涤脱硫丁艺和电子束辐照脱硫脱氨工艺。相同条件下，氨法脱硫剂用量比其他脱硫剂少，其副产品为硫酸铵，可用袋滤器或电除尘器捕集后用作化肥。③钠基脱硫剂，分別应用于湿式洗涤烟气脱硫工艺和用于炉内喷时、管道喷射等工艺的脱硫吸收剂，脱硫效果好，且可再生。其主要问题是来源困难，且易溶于水，造成灰场水体的污染。④镁基脱硫剂具有较强的缓冲性能（pH值最高不超过9)，较高的活性和吸附能力，使用过程中安全可靠、不具腐蚀性、装置易于维护和检修、不产生石膏结垢、副产物硫酸镁或M收利用或无污染排放等诸多优点使其应用越来越广泛。
explanation_en: Using compounds of alkali metals and alkali earth metals as absorbents, they react with sulfur oxides in the flue gas to form sulfates or sulfites. Commonly used include calcium based desulfurizers, amino desulfurizers, sodium based desulfurizers, and magnesium based desulfurizers Calcium based desulfurizers are mainly limestone, lime and slaked lime, which are rich in resources, easy to exploit and relatively cheap. After digestion, lime powder is added with water and stirred to absorb sulfur dioxide in slurry flue gas, which reacts with calcium hydroxide in slurry and blown oxidation air to be absorbed and removed, and the final product is gypsum. ② Amino desulfurization, generally in the form of ammonia or liquid ammonia, is used as the absorbent for desulfurization, mainly for ammonia washing desulfurization process and electron beam irradiation desulfurization and deamination process. Under the same conditions, the amount of ammonia desulfurization agent used is less than other desulfurization agents, and its by-product is ammonium sulfate, which can be collected by bag filters or electrostatic precipitators and used as fertilizer Sodium based desulfurization is respectively used in wet scrubbing flue gas desulfurization process and desulfurization absorbent used in furnace injection, pipeline injection and other processes. desulfurization effect is good and renewable. The main problem is that the source is difficult and easily soluble in water, causing pollution to the water body of the ash field Magnesium based desulfurizer has strong buffering performance (pH value is no more than 9), high activity and adsorption capacity, safe and reliable in use, non corrosive, easy to maintain and repair the device, no gypsum scaling, by-product magnesium sulfate or M recovery and utilization or pollution-free discharge, and many other advantages, making it more and more widely used.

explanation_cn: 足多数情况下能在隔绝外界空气的条件下燃烧（自供氧），并产生光、热、烟、声或气体等不同烟火物现效应的机械混合物。通常由氧化剂、可燃剂和黏合剂等组成，有的还有附加物，军事上用来装填纵火弹、诱饵弹、照明弹、发烟弹和信号弹等实现特种物效应，民间用于制造焰火、爆竹等。性质主要决定于它的组分。其线燃烧速度与制密度有关，而且品种不同，线燃烧速度也相差很大，如发烟剂每秒十分之几毫米;照明剂每秒210mm。其燃烧温度、燃烧热和燃烧产物的组成等对烟火效应有很大影响。大多数烟火药容易吸湿.并且对静电和机械作用（特别是摩擦）敏感。常用的氧化剂有氯酸盐、高氯酸盐、硝酸盐、铬酸盐、过氧化物、氧化物、氣化物等。氧化剂在高温下分解出氧.使可燃物发生氧化还原反应形成快速燃烧。
explanation_en: In most cases, it can combustion (self supplying oxygen) in isolation from the outside air, and produce a mechanical mixture of light, heat, smoke, sound or gas and other different pyrotechnic effects. It is usually composed of oxidizer, combustible agent and adhesive, and some have additives. It is used in military to load incendiary bombs, decoy bombs, flares, smoke bombs and signal bombs to achieve special object effects, and it is used in folk to manufacture fireworks, firecrackers, etc. The properties mainly depend on its composition. The linear combustion speed is related to the density, and the linear combustion speed varies greatly with different varieties, such as several tenths of a millimeter per second for smoke composition/smoke agent; The illuminating composition is 210mm per second. Its combustion temperature, combustion heat and composition of combustion products have great influence on the pyrotechnic effect. Most pyrotechnic powders are easily hygroscopic and sensitive to static electricity and mechanical effects, especially friction. Commonly used oxidizer include chlorate, perchlorate, nitrate, chromate, peroxide, oxide, gasification substance, etc. The oxidizer decomposes into oxygen at high temperature, which causes the oxidation reduction reaction of combustibles to form rapid combustion.

explanation_cn: 指烟火药原材料加工成烟火药制品的全部工序过程。虽然各种烟火药制备工艺有很大区别，但大体包含下列主要顺序：①原材料的准备;②药剂的混合、造粒及干燥;③药剂制品的成型加工。
explanation_en: Refers to the entire process of processing tobacco powder raw materials into tobacco powder products. Although there are significant differences in the preparation processes of various pyrotechnic compositions, they generally include the following main sequence: ① preparation of raw materials; ② Reagent mixing, granulation and drying; ③ Forming and processing of pharmaceutical products.

explanation_cn: 用于制作金属烤瓷修复体金属部分的合金材料。烤瓷熔附合金有贵金属和非贵金属合金两大类，贵金属合金中有含金量80%左右的金合金，如Au-Pt-Pd合金、Au-Pt合金、Au-Pt-Ag合金等，添加成分为Ag、In、Sn、Cu、Ir、Ru等；含金量50%左右的金合金，以Au-Pd-Ag系合金为多。此外，Pd-Ag系合金添加成分为Pt、In、Sn、Cu、Ir、Ru等。这些合金的熔点为1070-1400°C，拉伸强度为320-600MPa，伸长率为3.7%-17.5%。对烤瓷熔附合金的要求是：①熔点明显高于烤瓷；②力学性能优良；③合金与瓷的热膨胀系数匹配；④合金与烤瓷能牢同结合；⑤不能生成有色氧化物。烤瓷熔附合金在与瓷结合前必须进行表面处理，以加强与瓷的结合。处理方法有磨削、氢氟酸处理及除气预氧化等。
explanation_en: Alloy materials used to make metal part of metal ceramic prosthesis. Ceramic fused alloy include precious metals and non precious metals alloy. precious metals alloy include gold alloy with about 80% gold content, such as Au Pt Pd alloy, Au Pt alloy, Au Pt Ag alloy, etc. The added ingredients are Ag, In, Sn, Cu, Ir, Ru, etc; Gold alloy containing about 50% gold are mostly Au Pd Ag alloy. In addition, the added components of Pd Ag series alloy are Pt, In, Sn, Cu, Ir, Ru, etc. The melting point of these alloy is 1070-1400 ° C, the tensile strength is 320-600MPa, and the elongation is 3.7% -17.5%. The requirements for ceramic fused alloy are: ① the melting point is significantly higher than that of porcelain fused to metal; ② Excellent mechanical properties; ③ Thermal expansion coefficient of alloy and porcelain match; ④ Alloy and porcelain can be firmly combined; ⑤ Unable to generate colored oxides. Ceramic fused alloy must be surface treated before bonding with porcelain to strengthen bonding with porcelain. The treatment methods include grinding, hydrofluoric acid treatment, and degassing pre oxidation.

explanation_cn: 在牙科烤瓷工艺中，进行烧结加工制作烤瓷修复体所采用的粉状瓷料。按其组成和性质可分为长石质烤瓷粉和氧化铝质烤瓷粉：按熔点分为高熔烤瓷粉、中熔烤瓷粉和低熔烤瓷粉。长石质烤瓷粉包括体瓷和釉瓷。体瓷主要由长石、石英、白陶土、硼砂、硅石、氧化铝、着色剂，结合剂等组成，釉瓷主要由石英和硼砂等组成。用烤瓷粉制作的烤瓷修复体的理化性能优良，光学性能好，色泽稳定，生物学性能佳，缺点是机械强度不足。烤瓷粉的制造主要经配料、研磨、烧结、骤冷、制粉、包装等工艺步骤。烤瓷粉适用于牙科制作烤瓷全冠、嵌体等。
explanation_en: In the process of dental porcelain fused to metal (PFM), the powder porcelain used to make the PFM prosthesis is processed by sintering. According to its composition and properties, it can be divided into feldspathic ceramic powder and alumina ceramic powder; according to melting point, it can be divided into high melting ceramic powder, medium melting ceramic powder and low melting ceramic powder. Feldspar porcelain powder includes body porcelain and enamel. Body porcelain is mainly composed of feldspar, quartze, white clay, borax, silica, alumina, colorant, binder, etc. Glazed porcelain is mainly composed of quartze and borax. The porcelain fused to metal prosthesis made of porcelain powder has excellent physical and chemical properties, good optical properties, stable color, good biological properties, and the disadvantage is insufficient mechanical strength. The manufacturing of porcelain fused to metal powder mainly goes through the process steps of batching, grinding, sintering, quenching, milling, packaging, etc. Porcelain powder is suitable for dental production of porcelain crowns, inlays, etc.

explanation_cn: 指一类涂敷于烧伤创面上，用以帮助维持体液平衡.防止电解质、蛋白质、体液等丢失以及创面感染的高分子材料。一般为合成水凝胶或多糖类物质，如氧化乙烯-氧化丙烯共聚物和壳聚糖等，除敷料自身可具有抗菌性能外.还可以加入硫酸新霉素和维生素A等药物.以预防感染和促进新皮再生。乂如由亲水性有机玻璃和聚乙二醇组成的水凝胶，也是一种贴附性能较好的烧伤敷料.这种敷料是透明的.有一定弹性，既能观察创面愈合情况.又利于病人自由活动.在未切痂前即可使用。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of macromolecule materials applied to burn wounds to help maintain the balance of body fluid, prevent the loss of elonrolyte, protein, body fluid, etc., and prevent wound infection. Generally, it is synthetic hydrogel or polysaccharide, such as ethylene oxide propylene oxide copolymer and chitosan. In addition to the antibacterial properties of the dressing itself, neomycin sulfate and vitamin A can also be added to prevent infection and promote the regeneration of new skin. For example, hydrogel composed of hydrophilic organic glass and polyethylene glycol is also a kind of burn dressing with good adhesion performance. This kind of dressing is transparent and has certain elasticity, which can not only observe the wound healing, but also help the patient move freely. It can be used before escharectomy.

explanation_cn: 高温下烧成制得的具有一定形状和尺寸的耐火制品。分致密砖和轻质砖。对不同砖种，制定出相应的烧成曲线和气氛，以使耐火坯体烧结后具有一定强度。
explanation_en: Refractory products with a certain shape and size that are fired at high temperatures. Divided into dense bricks and lightweight bricks. For different kinds of bricks, the corresponding firing curve and atmosphere are worked out to make the refractory body have certain strength after sintering.

explanation_cn: 通过加热使粉体产生颗粒黏结，经过物质的迁移使粉体产生强度并伴随着致密化和再结晶的过程。烧结是粉末冶金、陶瓷、耐火材料等的一种重要工艺过程。目的是把粉状物料转变为致密的产品，其显微结构由晶体、玻璃体和气孔组成。烧结过程直接影响显微结构的晶粒尺寸和分布以及气孔形状、尺寸和分布及其晶界体积分数等参数。
explanation_en: Through heating, the powder will produce particle bonding, and through material migration, the powder will produce strength, accompanied by the process of densification and recrystallization. Sintering is an important process of powder metallurgy, ceramics, refractory, etc. The purpose is to transformation powdery materials into dense products. Its microstructure consists of crystal, vitreous body and pores. The sintering process directly affects the grain size and distribution of microstructure, the shape, size and distribution of pores, and the volume fraction of grain boundary.

explanation_cn: 是一种将瓷粉成型后再经过烧结工艺来制备口腔全瓷修复体的全瓷材料，根据不同熔点范围，烧结全瓷材料可分为三类。
explanation_en: It is an all ceramic materials that forms ceramic powder and then undergoes sintering process to prepare oral all ceramic prosthesis. According to different melting point ranges, sintered all-ceramic materials can be divided into three categories.

explanation_cn: 使用固体润滑剂与金属基体制成的、摩擦系数小于0.05的部件。以铁、铜、椎熔化合物为基，或以钢、铜等致密金属为衬背体.选择合适的固体润滑剂.
explanation_en: Parts made of solid lubricant and metal matrix with friction coefficient less than 0.05. Take iron, copper, fusible compound as the base, or take steel, copper and other dense metals as the backing, and select appropriate solid lubricant

explanation_cn: 主要研究烧结过程中各种量之间的动力学关系。由于烧结机理的复杂性，迄今没有一个普遍适用的动力学关系。现仅从各种烧结机理出发提出模型，分别建立动力学方程。将粉体颗粒简化为等径球体，这些球体在成型体中趋于紧密排列。随着烧结的进行.等径球体的接触点处开始形成颈部并逐渐扩大。我们通常采用两个等径球或球与平面作为模型.从一个接触点的颈部生长速率来近似地描述整个成型体的烧结动力学关系，可用收缩率或密度值来度量烧结的程度。对于双球模型而言烧结收缩是随着颈部长大、双球间距离缩短引起的，这时的物质迁移等于颈部的体积增长，据此可以分别推导出各种传质机理的动力学方程。但以上模型对于烧结初期一般是适用的，随着烧结的继续，球形颗粒将会变形，因此在烧结中后期应采用其他形式的模型。
explanation_en: This paper mainly studies the dynamic relationship between various quantities in the sintering process. Due to the complexity of sintering mechanism, there is no universally applicable kinetic relationship so far. The model is proposed based on various sintering mechanisms, and the kinetic equations are established respectively. Simplify the powder particles into equal diameter spheres, which tend to be tightly arranged in the formed body. With the progress of sintering, the neck of the contact point of the spheroid began to form and gradually expanded. We usually use two equal diameter balls or balls and a plane as a model. The growth rate of the neck at a contact point is used to approximately describe the sintering kinetics relationship of the whole molding body. The shrinkage or density value can be used to measure the degree of sintering. For the two ball model, the sintering shrinkage is caused by the neck growing and the distance between the two balls shortening. At this time, the mass transfer is equal to the volume growth of the neck. According to this, the dynamic equations of various mass transfer mechanisms can be derived respectively. However, the above model is generally applicable to the initial stage of sintering. As sintering continues, spherical particles will deform, so other forms of model should be used in the middle and later stages of sintering.

explanation_cn: 以预合金粉末或混合粉未为原料烧结所得的有色、黑色合金材料与制品称为烧结合金所谓烧结就是将粉末压坯加热到一定温度(烧结温度）并保持一定的时间（保温时间），然后冷却下来，从而得到所需性能的材料。
explanation_en: The colored and black alloy materials and products obtained by sintering with pre alloy powder or mixed powder as raw material are called sintered alloy. The so-called sintering is to heat the powder compact to a certain temperature (sintering temperature) and maintain it for a certain time (holding time), and then cool it down to obtain the materials with the required performance.

explanation_cn: 以金属铁粉或铜粉为基，加入石墨等自润滑剂和二氧化硅等高摩擦系数物料混合均匀、成形烧结的部件。要求材料有良好的耐磨性、耐热性和高摩擦系数。
explanation_en: Sintering parts are made of iron or copper powder, graphite and other materials with high friction coefficient such as lubricant and silicon dioxide. The materials shall have good wear resistance, heat resistance and high friction coefficient.

explanation_cn: 用来控制压坯于环境之间的化学反应和清除润滑剂的分解产物，基本要求是保证制品加热时不受氧化。烧结气氛按照其功用分为五种类型：氧化气氛、还原气氛、惰性或中性气氛、渗碳气氛以及氮化气氛。
explanation_en: It is used to control the chemical reaction between the compact and the environment and remove the decomposition products of lubricant. The basic requirement is to ensure that the products are not oxidized when heated. According to its function, sintering atmosphere can be divided into five types: oxidizing atmosphere, reducing atmosphere, inert or neutral atmosphere, carburizing atmosphere and nitriding atmosphere.

explanation_cn: 以高导电性金属和抗电弧烧蚀物质为原料，用粉未冶金方法制成的复合材料。导电金属包括铜、银.抗电弧烧蚀物质包括难熔金属及其化合物、金属氧化物.非金属等。采用普通的压制烧结法制造，或进行复压、复烧提高致密度。烧结触头材料具有良好的导电性和导热性，抗电弧烧损、抗电腐蚀，抗熔焊性强，主要用作各类电气开关、启动器和控制器的电触头。例如银-石墨、铜-石墨、钨-铜、钨-银、银-氧化铺等。
explanation_en: The composite materials is made of high conductivity metals and arc ablation resistant materials by powder metallurgy. Conductive metals include copper and silver, while arc resistant substances include refractory metals and their compounds, metal oxides, non-metals, etc. The ordinary pressing sintering method is adopted for manufacturing, or repressing and re burning are carried out to improve efficiency of spare filling. Sintering contact materials has good conductivity and thermal conductivity, resistance to arc burning, resistance to electric corrosion, and strong resistance to fusion welding. It is mainly used as electrical contact of various electrical switches, starters, and controllers. For example, silver graphite, copper graphite, tungsten copper, tungsten silver, silver oxide paving, etc.

explanation_cn: 烧结过程中烧结体由于收缩不均匀而发生的变形。其原因大多是成形过程中IK坏的密度分布不均.在烧结过程中造成收缩不均匀。耑采用豇好的方法成形如等静压制.也可在烧结时降低升温速率.有利于应力的缓慢释放。
explanation_en: Deformation of sintering body due to uneven shrinkage during sintering. Most of the reasons are the uneven distribution of IK bad density during the forming process and the uneven shrinkage during the sintering process. Specially adopt good forming methods such as isostatic pressing. It can also reduce the heating rate during sintering, which is conducive to the slow release of stress.

explanation_cn: 以铜、铁为基添加锡、锌、锰、镍、钴等元素与金刚石的混合物、经压制、烧结或热压而成的金刚石工具。
explanation_en: The diamond tool is made by adding tin, zinc, manganese, nickel, cobalt and other elements with diamond based on copper and iron and by pressing, sintering or hot pressing.

explanation_cn: 以碳石墨为烧结的基体.将金属粉与石墨粉烧结制备的烧结复合材料。原料则是使用互不溶解的石墨粉与金属粉。通过这种方法制备的材料中的石墨起着润滑、耐高温、导电的作用先在处理过的石墨多孔材料上沉积形成金属骨架.金属骨架形成之后.可以在金属骨架之间填充一些金属或者是合金元素，也可以用热固性的树脂，最后烧结形成金属石墨材料。
explanation_en: With carbon graphite as sintering matrix, sintering composite materials were prepared by sintering metal powder and graphite powder. The raw materials are insoluble graphite powder and metal powder. The graphite in the materials prepared by this method plays the role of lubrication, high temperature resistance and conductivity. First, it is deposited on the treated graphite porous materials to form a metal skeleton. After the metal skeleton is formed, some metal or alloy elements can be filled between the metal skeleton, or thermosetting resin can be used, and finally sintering can be used to form a metal graphite materials.

explanation_cn: 烧结金属铝中弥散有Al2O3硬质点的零件。
explanation_en: Parts with Al2O3 hard spots dispersed in sintering metal aluminum.

explanation_cn: 是菱镁矿、水镁石等原料经高温烧结后的产物。其主成分为MgO,还含少量SiO2、CaO等，结构致密、强度高.是镁质耐火材料的重要原，.经破碎后也可作为冶金炉捣打料和修补料。
explanation_en: It is the product of magnesite, brucite and other raw materials after high temperature sintering. Its main component is MgO, and it also contains a small amount of SiO2, CaO, etc. It is compact in structure and high in strength. It is an important raw material for magnesia refractory. After crushing, it can also be used as ramming material and repair material for metallurgical furnace.

explanation_cn: 烧结时在颗粒间形成颈状的联结。烧结颈在烧结中普遍存在.与烧结过程密切相关。烧结初朗先是颗粒接触处形成黏结面，继而黏结面长大形成烧结颈。
explanation_en: During sintering, a neck like connection is formed between particles. Sintering neck is ubiquitous in sintering and closely related to sintering process. At the beginning of sintering, a bonding surface is formed at the particle contact, and then the bonding surface grows to form a sintering neck.

explanation_cn: 烧结过程中推动物质传递和迁移从而实现致密化过程的动力。
explanation_en: It is the power to promote the mass transfer and migration in the sintering process so as to realize the densification process.

explanation_cn: 用灼热钨丝加热分解碳源物质，激活化学气相反应，制备金刚石膜的工艺方法。这种方法的特点是设备简单，工艺条件较易控制，金刚石膜生长速率比化学输运法快，因而很快在全世界的金刚石膜研究中得到广泛应用，成为制备金刚石膜的主要方法之一。这种方法的缺点是钨丝在工作过程碳化变脆以致断裂，并给金刚石膜带来污染。这个问题尚难解决。另一个问题是活性粒子浓度较低。金刚石膜生长速率难以提高，并且对基材表面要求也很严。为了提高活性粒子浓度，在钨丝和基体间施加正的偏压，使钨丝在高温下发射出的电子在电场中加速。通过电子与气体原子的碰撞。增加活性粒子浓度。利用外加磁场造成电子回旋加速，进一步提高了活性粒子浓度。也能a著提高金刚石生长速率。
explanation_en: A process for preparing diamond film by heating and decomposing carbon source material with hot tungsten wire to activate chemical vapor reaction. This method is characterized by simple equipment, easy control of process conditions, and faster growth rate of diamond film than chemical transport method. Therefore, it was soon widely used in the research of diamond film all over the world and became one of the main methods to prepare diamond film. The disadvantage of this method is that the tungsten wire becomes carbonized and brittle in the working process, resulting in fracture, and brings pollution to the diamond film. This problem is still difficult to solve. Another issue is the low concentration of active particles. The growth rate of diamond film is difficult to improve, and the requirements for the surface of the substrate are also very strict. In order to increase the concentration of active particles, a positive bias voltage is applied between the tungsten wire and the matrix to accelerate the electrons emitted from the tungsten wire at high temperature in the electric field. By the collision of electrons with gas atoms. Increase the concentration of active particles. The use of an external magnetic field causes electron cyclotron acceleration, further increasing the concentration of active particles. It can also improve the growth rate of diamond.

explanation_cn: 测定传爆药和火工药剂在电热丝作用下发生燃烧爆炸的危险程度，电桥丝为直径为0.05mm的钨丝。电源为12V汽车用蓄电池。被测试样压入壳体中，与桥丝紧密接触，密度分别为85%和95%理论密度。连续测试20发，如无一发发火。则判定传爆药或火药剂热丝点火试验合格，否则为不合格。
explanation_en: Determine the risk of combustion and explosion of booster explosive and initiating explosives and relative compositions under the action of electric heating wire. The electric bridge wire is a tungsten wire with a diameter of 0.05mm. The power supply is 12V automotive accumulator. The tested sample is pressed into the shell and is in close contact with the bridge wire. The density is 85% and 95% of the theoretical density respectively. Continuously test 20 rounds, if none of them ignite. It is judged that the booster explosive or propellant hot wire ignition test is qualified, otherwise it is unqualified.

explanation_cn: 简称"热堆'主要由能量小于的热中子引起核裂变的反应堆。目前，已经实用化的核反应堆有轻水堆和重水堆。
explanation_en: It is called "thermal reactor" for short. It is a reactor that mainly causes nuclear fission by thermal neutrons with energy less than. At present, the practical nuclear reactors include light water reactor and heavy water reactor.

explanation_cn: 适合于制造对钢及其他金属合金进行热变形加工的模具（如热压模、锻模、压铸模等）用的合金工具钢。热作模具钢应该具有一定的高温强度、抗热疲劳性、抗氧化性、耐磨性和韧性，还应具有高淬透性和较小的热处理变形。热作模具钢的碳含量一般在0.3%-0.5%的范围白（碳含量过高将使塑性、韧性和导热性变差。碳含量过低则使硬度、耐磨性达不到要求），含有强化铁素体及提高淬透性的合金元素。
explanation_en: Alloy tool steel suitable for manufacturing dies (such as hot pressing dies, forging dies, die-casting dies, etc.) for hot deformation processing of steel and other metal alloy. Hot-working die steel should have certain high temperature strength, thermal fatigue resistance, oxidation resistance, wear resistance and toughness, as well as high hardenability and small heat treatment deformation. The carbon content of hot work die steel is generally 0.3% -0.5% white (too high carbon content will make the plasticity, toughness and thermal conductivity worse. Too low carbon content will make the hardness and wear resistance fail to meet the requirements), and contains alloy elements that strengthen ferrite and improve hardenabilhy.

explanation_cn: 当温度变化时-晶体的折射率发生变化的现象。由于晶体的各向异性。热光效应表现是多种多样的。可能是光率体的半轴长度发生变化、或光轴角的变化、光轴面的转换、光率体的旋转等。热光效应可用于红外辐射的检测及生物中关于分子层状结构的研究。
explanation_en: When the temperature changes - the refractive index of a crystal changes. Because of the anisotropy of crystal of the crystal. The performance of thermo-optical effect is varied. It may be due to changes in the half axis length of the index body, changes in the optical axis angle, conversion of the optical axis plane, rotation of the index body, etc. The thermo-optical effect can be used for the detection of infrared radiation and the study of molecular layered structure in biology.

explanation_cn: 当温度变化或存在着温度梯度时，玻璃本身或由它制成的光学元件的某些光学性质保持不变的光学玻璃。
explanation_en: When the temperature changes or there is a temperature gradient, some optical properties of glass itself or optical elements made of it remain unchanged.

explanation_cn: 在同一树脂中同时具有弱碱、弱酸基的两性树脂-在室温下能交换吸附氯化钠等盐类，用80-90°C的热水可使其进行水解，使盐解析。不需用酸碱即可达到再生目的。树脂的骨架结构。功能基种类、数量、不同功能基的数域以及分布情况等对热再生树脂性能均有很大影响。热再生树脂主要用于苦咸水淡化及废水处理。
explanation_en: Amphoteric resin with weak base and weak acid group in the same resin can exchange and absorb salts such as sodium chloride at room temperature. It can be hydrolyzed with hot water at 80-90 ° C to resolve the salt. Regeneration can be achieved without the use of acid or alkali. Framework structure of resin. The type and quantity of functional groups, the number domain and distribution of different functional groups have great influence on the properties of thermally regenerated resin. Thermal regeneration resin is mainly used for brackish water desalination and wastewater treatment.

explanation_cn: 见示差热分析。
explanation_en: See differential thermal analysis.

explanation_cn: 制备陶瓷粉末的一类方法。凡是将粉来的前驱体化合物在一定条件下加热使其发生热化学分解反应而制备粉宋的方法都属于热分解法。根据加热方式的不同大致可以分为：①喷雾热解法。该法是将金属盐溶液喷雾至高温气氛中。使溶剂蒸发和金属盐热解同在瞬间发生、用同一道工序制得氧化物粉末的方法，将有机硅聚合物的溶液喷雾热解来制备非氧化物陶瓷粉末；②间相先驱体直接热解的方法，将聚碳硅烷、聚硅氮烷在一定气氛下直接热解。制备Sit'、Si^Nt粉末即属此法，又如将化学共沉淀制备的、或溶胶-凝胶先驱体化合物加热分解制备陶瓷粉末，比如BaTiO(C204)2-4H20热解制备BaTi〇3超微细粉；③将单一气相化合物用各种手段。如电阻炉、等离子体、激光等进行加热使其分解而制备陶瓷粉末。比如在等离子体中CH3SiCl3的热分解可以制备SiC超细粉末。
explanation_en: A kind of method for preparing ceramics powder. The method of preparing powder by heating the precursor compound under certain conditions to undergo thermochemical decomposition reaction belongs to the thermal decomposition method. According to different heating methods, it can be roughly divided into: ① spray pyrolysis. This method is to spray the metal salt solution into the high temperature atmosphere. The method of making solvent evaporation and metal salt pyrolysis happen at the same time, and using the same process to prepare oxide powder, the solution of silicone polymer is spray pyrolyzed to prepare non oxide ceramics powder; ② Polycarbosilane and polysilazane are directly pyrolyzed under certain atmosphere by direct pyrolysis of mesophase precursor. This method is used to prepare Sit 'and Si ^ Nt powder, and also for preparing ceramics powder by heating and decomposing chemical co precipitation or sol gel precursor compounds, such as BaTiO (C204) 2-4H2O pyrolysis to prepare BaTi03 ultrafine powders; ③ Using various means to synthesize a single gas phase compound. For example, electric resistance furnace, plasma, laser, etc. are heated to decompose them to prepare ceramics powder. For example, the thermal decomposition of CH3SiCl3 in plasma can produce SiC ultrafine powder.

explanation_cn: 将保持适当间距的焊件两端放入特制铸型并预热至一定温度后，利用金属氧化物匀钔或镁粉之间发生氧化放热反应生成的过热液态金属注入型腔-使焊件端面熔化实现焊接的方法。采用铝粉时称为铝热（剂）焊-采用镁粉时称为镁热(剂）焊铝热焊应用最多，故常把热剂焊叫铝热焊。热剂含不需外加能源-设备简单、投资少、操作方便、焊接速度快（小于30s)、不受环境和场地的限制-足野外和施工现场实用的焊接方法之一。热剂焊常用于铁路钢轨、建筑钢筋、避雷线、铜铝电缆等的对接焊接。
explanation_en: Put both ends of the weldment with proper spacing into a special mold and preheat it to a certain temperature, then inject the overheating liquid metal generated by the oxidation exothermic reaction between the metal oxides or magnesium powder into the mold cavity to melt the end face of the weldment to achieve weld. When aluminium powder is used, it is called thermit (flux) welding - when magnesium powder is used, it is called thermit (flux) welding. thermit welding is usually called thermit welding. The thermit does not need additional energy - the equipment is simple, the investment is small, the operation is convenient, the weld speed is fast (less than 30s), and is not limited by the environment and site - it is one of the practical weld methods in the field and construction site. Thermit welding is often used for butt weld of railway rails, building steel bars, lightning wires, copper aluminum cables, etc.

explanation_cn: 研究物质热运动的规律及热运动对物质宏观性质的影响的科学。它是关于热现象的宏观理论。研究方法是通过对热现象的观测、实验和分析，归纳出热运动的基本规律，即热力学第零定律、第一定律、第二定律和第三定律，并以它们为基础，用严格的逻辑推理方法，研究宏观物体的性质。其基本规律适用于一切宏观物质系统，所得到的结论具有可靠性和普遍性。热力学的研究白容有平衡态热力学、近平衡态的线性非平衡态热力学和远离平衡态的非线性热力学及耗散结构理论。
explanation_en: The science of studying the laws of material thermal motion and the impact of thermal motion on the macroscopic properties of matter. It is a macroscopic theory about thermal phenomena. The research method is to summarize the basic laws of thermal movement, namely, the the zeroth law of thermodynamics, the first law, the second law and the third law of thermodynamics, through observation, experiment and analysis of thermal phenomena, and to study the properties of macro objects based on them with strict logical reasoning methods. Its basic laws apply to all macroscopic material systems, and the conclusions obtained are reliable and universal. The research of thermodynamics includes thermodynamics of equilibrium state, linear non-equilibrium thermodynamics of near equilibrium state, nonlinear thermodynamics far from equilibrium state and dissipative structure theory.

name_cn: 热力学基本微分方程式
name_en: the basic differential equation of thermodynamics
explanation_cn: 综合热力学第一定律和第二定律，可得到热力学基本微分方程式。该方程适用于封闭系统，由方程可导出一系列其他热力学关系式。
explanation_en: By synthesizing the the first law of thermodynamics and the second law of thermodynamics, the the basic differential equation of thermodynamics of thermodynamics can be obtained. This equation is applicable to closed system, from which a series of other thermodynamics relations can be derived.

explanation_cn: 热力学基本定律之一。可表述为：在任何一个热力学过程中，外界对系统所做的功VV与系统从外界吸收的热量Q之和等于系统白能的增加AC。这个定律说明了内能和功、热之间可以相互转化及其数量关系，因此它也是能量守恒与转化定律在热现象中的具体表述。作为实践经验的总结，它还可以表述为：第一类永动机（指不需要任何动力和燃料却能不断对外做功的机器）是不可能造成的。
explanation_en: One of the fundamental laws of thermodynamics. It can be expressed as: in any thermodynamic process, the sum of the work done by the outside to the system VV and the heat absorbed by the system from the outside Q is equal to the increase of the white energy of the system AC. This law shows that internal energy, work and heat can be transformed into each other and their quantitative relationship. Therefore, it is also the specific expression of the law of conservation and transformation of energy in thermal phenomena. As a summary of practical experience, it can also be expressed as: the first type of perpetual motion machine (referring to a machine that can continuously perform external work without any power or fuel) is impossible to cause.

explanation_cn: 又称能斯特定理热力学基本定律之一。表述热力学系统的熵在温度趋近于绝对零度时趋于定值，特别地，对于完整晶体，这个定值为零。1912年能斯特由此做出推论：不可能使一个系统经有限次操作冷却到绝对零度。能斯特定律的各种表述，统称为热力学第三定律。常用的表述有：绝对零度不可能达到；不可能用有限的操作次数使系统冷却到绝对零度。由热力学第三定律可推出：物质在温度趋于绝对零度时，膨胀系数、压力系数和任意过程的比热都趋于零。实验证明第三定律是A然界中的普遍规律。
explanation_en: Also known as Nernst's theorem, one of the basic laws of thermodynamics. The entropy of the thermodynamics system tends to a fixed value when the temperature approaches absolute zero, especially for a complete crystal, the fixed value is zero. In 1912, Nernst deduced that it was impossible to cool a system to absolute zero through finite operations. Various expressions of Nernst's law are collectively referred to as the the third law of thermodynamics of thermodynamics. The commonly used expressions are: absolute zero is impossible to achieve; It is impossible to cool the system to absolute zero with a limited number of operations. It can be inferred from the the third law of thermodynamics that when the temperature of a substance tends to absolute zero, the expansion coefficient, pressure coefficient and specific heat of any process tend to zero. The experiment proves that the third law is a universal law in the natural world.

explanation_cn: 热力学基本定律之一。凡是与热现象有关的实际过程都具有方向性。它有许多种表述，实质上都是相互等效的。常用的有①克劳修斯（Clausius)表述：不可能把热量从低温物体传递到高温物体而不引起其他变化。即热传导过程是不可逆的。②开尔文（Kelvin)表述：不可能从单一热源吸取热量使之完全转变为有用功而不引起其他变化；后也表述为：第二类永动机是不可能造成的。③孤立系统的熵不可能减少第二定律指出自然界能量转换过程进行的方向，说明满足能量转换与守恒关系的过程不一定都能实现。
explanation_en: One of the fundamental laws of thermodynamics. All practical processes related to thermal phenomena have directionality. It has many expressions that are essentially equivalent to each other. Commonly used are ① Clausius' statements: it is impossible to transfer heat from a low-temperature object to a high-temperature object without causing other changes. The heat conduction process is irreversible Kelvin said that it is impossible to absorb heat from a single heat source to make it completely transformation into useful work without causing other changes; The second type of perpetual motion machine is impossible to cause The entropy of an isolated system cannot be reduced. The second law points out the direction of the energy conversion process in nature, indicating that the process that meets the relationship between energy conversion and conservation may not be realized.

explanation_cn: 又称热平衡定律。若两个热力学系统各自与第三个系统处于热平衡状态，则这两个系统也必互相处于热平衡状态。这是热力学中的一个经验规律。由此可推出，处于同一热平衡状态的系统必有一个共同的物理性质，即温度。此定律是用温度计测量系统温度的理论依据。
explanation_en: Also known as the thermal equilibrium law. If two thermodynamics systems are in thermal equilibrium with the third system respectively, the two systems must also be in thermal equilibrium with each other. This is an empirical rule in thermodynamics. From this, it can be inferred that systems in the same thermal equilibrium state must have a common physical property, namely temperature. This law is the theoretical basis for measuring system temperature with a thermometer.

explanation_cn: 在一定条件下，系统从一个热力学状态转变为另一个热力学状态的过程。常见的过程有可逆过程、不可逆过程、循环过程、绝热过程、膨胀过程、相变过程等。
explanation_en: Under certain conditions, a system changes from one thermodynamics state transformation another thermodynamics state. Common processes include reversible process, irreversible process, cyclic process, adiabatic process, expansion process, phase transformation process, etc.

explanation_cn: 利用高温激活化学反应进行气相生长的方法。热化学气相沉积按其化学反应形式吋分成两大类：①化学输运法（chemicaltransport)，构成薄膜物质在源区与另一种间体或液体物质反应生成气体-然后输运到一定温度下的生长区，通过相反的热反应生成所需材料；②热解化学气相沉积（pyrolysis)-将含有构成薄膜元素的某种易挥发物质，输运到生长K。通过热分解反应生成所需物质化学输运法一般用于块状晶体生长，分解反应法通常用于薄膜材料生长，合成反应法则两种情况都用。热化学气相沉积应用于半导体材料-如Si、Ge、GaAs、InP等各种氧化物和其他材料。广泛应用的CVD技术如金属有机化学气相沉积、氯化物化学气相沉积、氢化物化学气相沉积等均属于热化学气相沉积的范围，气相沉积。
explanation_en: The method of growth from vapour phase using high temperature activated chemical reaction. Thermo-chemical vapor deposition can be divided into two categories according to its chemical reaction form: ① chemical transport method, in which the thin film material reacts with another intermediate or liquid material in the source area to generate gas - and then is transported to the growth area at a certain temperature to generate the required materials through the opposite thermal reaction; ② Pyrolytic chemical vapor deposition - transporting certain volatile substances containing film elements to growth K. The chemical transport method is generally used for the growth of blocky crystal growth, the decomposition reaction method is usually used for the growth of thin film materials, and the synthesis reaction method is used in both cases. Thermo-chemical vapor deposition is applied to semiconductor materials such as various oxides such as Si, Ge, GaAs, InP and other materials. Widely used CVD technologies, such as metal organic chemical vapor deposition method, chloride chemical vapor deposition, hydride chemical vapor deposition, etc., belong to the scope of thermo-chemical vapor deposition, vapor deposition.

explanation_cn: 又称加压烧结。是把粉末装在模腔白。在加压的同时使粉末加热到正常烧结温度或更低一些。经过较短时间烧结成质密而均勻的制品，是一种强化烧结。原则上，凡是用一般方法能制得的粉末零件，都适于用热压方法制造。尤其适于制造全致密难熔金属及其化合物等M料。热压工艺具有以下几个优点：大大降低成型压力和缩短烧结时间；可以压制大型零件；热压时，粉末塑性好，可以压成薄壁管、薄片及带螺纹等异型制品；粉末粒度硬度对热压过程不明显，因此可压制一些硬而脆的粉末。然而，热压法也有明显的缺点：对压模材料要求高，而且-模寿命短；单件生产-效率低；制品表面粗糙。精度低；成本高。
explanation_en: It is also called pressure sintering. It is to put powder in the mold cavity. At the same time, the powder is heated to the normal sintering temperature or lower. After a short time of sintering, the products become dense and uniform, which is a kind of strengthened sintering. In principle, all powder parts that can be made by general methods are suitable for hot pressing. Especially suitable for manufacturing M materials such as fully dense refractory metals and their compounds. The hot pressing process has the following advantages: greatly reducing the forming pressure and shortening the sintering time; Can pressing large parts; When hot pressing, powder has good plasticity and can be pressed into thin-walled tubes, thin sheets, threaded and other special-shaped products; The partidesize and hardness are not obvious to the hot pressing process, so some hard and brittle powder can be pressing. However, the hot pressing method also has obvious disadvantages: high requirements for the die materials, and short die life; Single piece production - low efficiency; The surface of the product is rough. Low accuracy; High cost.

explanation_cn: 用热压烧结工艺以高纯度、高细度粉末为原料（或掺入少量添加剂）制备成的、具有一定晶粒尺寸显微结构的多晶陶瓷。热压工艺主要是消除由杂质和微气泡所引起的光的吸收和散射。热压过程中。高温、高压作用合适微晶粒子挤紧、压碎和再分布。此外，由于微晶粒子在高温、高温下产生的塑性变形。能够有效的排挤掉晶体中的微气泡，实现材料的致密化。一般来说。热压光学多晶陶瓷除具有优良的透光性能外，还具有耐高温、高强度、耐腐蚀和耐冲击等优良机械、物理性能，可作各种特殊需要的光学元件及窗口材料。热压光学多晶是由于火箭、导弹、人造卫星；宇宙飞船、高功率红外激光器等新技术发展的需要而发展起来的。
explanation_en: Polycrystal ceramics with a certain grain size microstructure are prepared by hot pressing sintering process with high-purity and high fineness powder as raw materials (or with a small amount of additive). The hot pressing process is mainly to eliminate the absorption and scattering of light caused by impurities and microbubbles. During hot pressing. High temperature and high pressure are suitable for squeezing, crushing, and redistribution of microcrystalline particles. In addition, because microcrystalline particles in high temperature, high temperature plastic deformation. The micro bubbles in the crystal can be effectively squeezed out to achieve densification of materials. Generally speaking. Hot pressing optical polycrystal ceramics not only have excellent light transmittance, but also have excellent mechanical and physical properties such as high temperature resistance, high strength, corrosion resistance and impact resistance. They can be used as optical elements and window materials for various special needs. Hot pressing optical polycrystal is due to rockets, missiles and artificial satellites; Developed in response to the development of new technologies such as spacecraft and high-power infrared lasers.

name_en: hot pressing diffusion bonding fabrication method
explanation_cn: 在低于基体合金熔点的一定温度和高压下，通过基体发牛。塑性变形、蠕变及扩散过程使基体与基体以及基体与增强体紧密结合。得到完全压实金属基复合材料的工艺方法，是连续纤维增强金属基复合材料最具代表性的固相复合工艺。能有效抑制界面反应，解决润湿性问题。在复合之前。常常需先把增强纤维用等离子喷涂、液态金属浸溃、化学涂覆（如用树脂溶胶黏结）等方法制成预制品（条带或复合丝），然后剪裁、层封装。在模具中加汛制成复合材料。温度、压力、时间和气氛。是热压扩散复合工艺的重要物理参数气氛一般为真空或惰忭气体保护，减少纤维与基体金属在高温下的氧化。有利取得较好的复合效果，为降低成本有时也在大气环境中进行。但复合效果较气氛保护差。乐制方法主要有热压法、热等静压法、热轧法等。增大压力、延长加压时间、提高温度。有利于纤维与基体的焊合-但要顾及脆性纤维以及因此而加剧的物理与化学作用的损伤。与其他复合工艺比。热压扩散结合r艺参数易于精确控制。增强纤维在复合材料制件中的空间位置，可按构件受力情况-进行精细铺排。制件质量好。缺点是由于型模加m的单向性及加压容量限制-使该c艺限于制作平板状或低曲率板等形状较为简单的构件；设备费用昂贵。制备成本高。
explanation_en: At a certain temperature and high pressure lower than the melting point of the matrix alloy, it is allowed to grow through the matrix. Plastic deformation, creep and diffusion processes make matrix and matrix as well as matrix and reinforcement closely combined. The process of obtaining fully compacted metal matrix composite is the most representative solid phase composition process of continuous fiber reinforced metal matrix composite. It can effectively inhibit the interface reaction and solve the wettability problem. Before composition. It is often necessary to use plasma spraying, liquid metal immersion, chemical coating (such as bonding with resin sol) and other methods to make reinforcing fiber into pre products (strips or composite wires), and then cut and layer package them. The composite materials is made by adding flood water into the mold. Temperature, pressure, time, and atmosphere. It is an important physical parameter of hot pressing diffusion bonding fabrication method. The atmosphere is generally protected by vacuum or inert gas to reduce the oxidation of fiber and matrix metal at high temperature. It is beneficial to achieve better composition effect, and it is sometimes carried out in the atmospheric environment to reduce costs. But the effect of composition is worse than that of atmosphere protection. The music making methods mainly include hot pressing, hot isostatic pressing, hot rolling, etc. Increase pressure, extend pressurization time, and increase temperature. It is beneficial to the welding of fiber and matrix - but the brittle fiber and the damage caused by physical and chemical action should be taken into account. Compared with other composition processes. Hot pressing diffusion combined with r-process parameters is easy to control accurately. The spatial position of reinforcing fiber in composite materials parts can be finely laid according to the stress condition of the component. The quality of the parts is good. The disadvantage is that due to the unidirectionality of the mold and the limitation of the pressure capacity, this technology is limited to making components with relatively simple shapes such as flat or low curvature plates; The equipment cost is expensive. High preparation cost.

explanation_cn: 将干燥粉料充填入模型内，再从单轴方向边加压边加热，使成型和烧结同时完成的一种烧结方法。
explanation_en: It is a kind of sintering method that the dry powder is filled into the model, and then pressured and heated from the uniaxial direction to complete the molding and sintering at the same time.

explanation_cn: 热压罐是一种为同化树脂基复合材料构件，能按要求进行加热、加压的容器类设备，通常为筒形，属于高压容器。主要由罐体系统、加热系统、冷却系统、储气加压系统、鼓风系统、真空系统、控制系统、架车平台与导轨系统等组成。复合材料制件成型过程一般需要加热加加压系统加压，加热由加热系统实现，压力由储气加压系统实现。加压气体多为空气，只有在较高的温度下才使用氮气、二氧化碳等惰性气体，鼓风系统有助于提高罐体白温度分布均匀性。真空系统提供制件毛坯封装后系统白的真空环境。热压罐可适用于多种复合材料结构的成型，如层压结构、夹芯结构、胶接结构及缝纫结构等。热压罐使用时。先将复合材料制件毛坯用真空袋密封在模具上，在真空状态下，经过升温--加压>保温--降温和卸压等工艺步骤完成制件制备。热压罐成塑工艺其温度、压力的可控性强。制备的复合材料制件尺寸公差小、孔隙率低、质最和性能稳定。多应用于航空航天飞行器复合材料结构件的制造。特別是主承力结构的制造。如B787复合材料中央翼盒、A350复合材料机身、F18复合材料垂尾及航天用大塑加筋筒形结构等。
explanation_en: Autoclave is a kind of vessel equipment that assimilates resin based composite materials components and can be heated and pressurized as required. It is usually cylindrical and belongs to high-pressure vessel. It mainly consists of tank system, heating system, cooling system, air storage and pressurization system, blowing system, vacuum system, control system, lifting platform and guide rail system, etc. The forming process of composite materials parts generally requires heating and pressurization system pressurization. Heating is realized by the heating system, and the pressure is realized by the gas storage pressurization system. The pressurized gas is mostly air, and inert gases such as nitrogen and carbon dioxide are only used at higher temperatures. The blowing system helps to improve the uniformity of the white temperature distribution of the tank body. The vacuum system provides a white vacuum environment for the system after packaging the workpiece blank. The autoclave can be used for forming a variety of composite materials structures, such as laminated structures, sandwich structures, adhesive structures and sewing structures. When the autoclave is used. First, the composite materials workpiece blank is sealed on the mold with a vacuum bag. Under the vacuum state, the workpiece preparation is completed through the process steps of temperature rise - pressure increase - heat preservation - temperature drop and pressure relief. The autoclave molding process has strong controllability of temperature and pressure. The prepared composite materials parts have small dimensional tolerance, low porosity, high quality and stable performance. It is widely used in the manufacturing of composite materials structural parts of aerospace vehicles. Especially in the manufacturing of the main load-bearing structure. Such as B787 composite materials central wing box, A350 composite materials fuselage, F18 composite materials vertical tail and large plastic stiffened cylindrical structure for aerospace, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称注射成塑玻璃陶瓷或铸瓷。系采用注射成堕方法将玻璃陶瓷在高温、高温下注入型腔并烧结、制作成全瓷修复体的一类陶瓷，热铸方法有助于避免瓷体中形成大的孔隙。提高陶瓷的致密度和强度。并促进玻璃某质中的品相很好地分散排列，而且瓷的密度高，品体粒子小。强度较高，由于瓷修复体的收缩口以通过包坪材料的热膨胀加以补偿，故其边缘密合性好。
explanation_en: Also known as injection molded glass-ceramics or cast porcelain. It is a kind of ceramics that uses the injection molding method to inject glass-ceramics into the cavity at high temperature and high temperature and sintering to make an all ceramic prosthesis. The hot casting method helps to avoid the formation of large pores in the porcelain body. Improve the efficiency of spare filling and strength of ceramics. It also promotes the dispersion and arrangement of the product phases in a certain substance of glass, and the density of porcelain is high, and the product particles are small. The strength is high. Because the shrinkage of the porcelain prosthesis is compensated by the thermal expansion of the coating materials, its edge tightness is good.

explanation_cn: 将陶瓷粉料与熔化的蜡及农而活性剂搅拌混炼得到蜡板，破碎后放入热戊铸机内。
explanation_en: The ceramics powder, melted wax and agricultural activator are stirred and mixing to obtain wax plate, which is crushed and put into the hot pentane casting machine.

explanation_cn: 涂覆在基体材料表面，能对400-2500nm范围白的红外线和紫外线进行高反射的涂层。具有好的防污件能和耐候性能，对太阳热反射率达到90%以上，广泛应用于建筑屋顶和外墙、石化和医药储罐、机械设备等需要反射太阳光并隔热的建筑或设备表面。
explanation_en: It is coated on the surface of materials of the matrix and can provide a highly reflective coating for white infrared and ultraviolet rays in the range of 400-2500nm. It has good anti fouling performance and weather resistance, with a solar heat reflection rate of over 90%. It is widely used in buildings or equipment surfaces that need to reflect sunlight and be insulated, such as roofs and exterior walls, petrochemical and pharmaceutical storage tanks, and mechanical equipment.

explanation_cn: 又称为热畸变温度。它是聚合物作为结构材料使用的上限温度，是衡量聚合物或高分子材料耐热性能的一种表征参数。
explanation_en: Also known as thermal distortion temperature. It is the upper limit temperature of polymer used as structural materials and a characterization parameter to measure the heat resistance of polymer or macromolecule materials.

explanation_cn: 当燃料电池系统中的主要模块如电堆和重整器处于它们正常工作的温度范围内时启动燃料电池系统。
explanation_en: Start the fuel cell system when the main modules in the fuel cell system, such as the stack and the reformer, are within their normal operating temperature range.

explanation_cn: 满足热喷涂技术要求的粉末。热喷涂是将熔融状态的喷涂材料，通过高速气流使其雾化喷射在零件表面上，形成喷涂层的一种金属表面加工方法。热喷涂粉末具有一定的球化程度以保证喷涂过程能顺利均匀送粉，其粒度及粒度分布对热喷涂层的质量有直接影响。其流动性对喷涂效率有一定影响。热喷涂粉末常见的制备方法有雾化法、球磨法、包覆法等。热喷涂粉末包括金属粉和陶瓷粉，如镍基自熔合金粉、硬质合金喷涂粉、氧化锆喷涂粉等。
explanation_en: Powder meeting the technical requirements of thermal spraying. Thermal spraying is a metal surface processing method that sprays materials in molten state on the surface of parts through high-speed air flow to form a spraying layer. The thermal spray powder has a certain degree of spheroidization to ensure smooth and uniform powder feeding during the spraying process. Its particle size and particle size distribution have a direct impact on the quality of the thermal spraying coating. Its flow ability has certain influence on spraying efficiency. The common preparation methods of thermal spray powder include atomization, ball milling, coating, etc. Thermal spray powder includes metal powder and ceramic powder, such as nickel base self melting alloy powder, hardmetal spraying powder, zirconia spraying powder, etc.

name_cn: 热固化型义齿基托树脂
explanation_cn: 又称热凝树脂。是一种需加热凝同的制作义齿基托的树脂材料。需要加热至65°C以上才能发生固化反应，热固化型义齿基托树脂一般由粉剂和液剂组成。粉剂商品名为牙托粉，主要成分为聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯珠状聚合体：液剂商品名为牙托水。由与粉剂相适应的单体材料构成。使用时将热凝牙托粉和热凝牙托水按一定的比例调和。经加压加热处理工艺完成聚合而间化。其聚合原理为热引发自由基聚合反应。热凝义齿基托树脂在口腔白有稳定的机械强度和适当的挠曲强度。易抛光。色泽稳定。热膨胀系数较大。聚合后有一定的收缩程度。可溶于有机溶剂。是广泛应用于临床的一种义齿基托材料。
explanation_en: Also known as thermosetting resin. It is a resin materials that needs to be heated and coagulated to make denture base. The curing reaction can only occur when the temperature is above 65 ° C. The heat-curing denture base polymer is generally composed of powder and liquid. The trade name of the powder is denture base polymer powder, the main component is polymethyl methacrylate bead polymer, and the trade name of the liquid is denture base water. It is composed of monomer materials suitable for powder. When using, the thermosetting denture base polymer powder and thermosetting denture support water shall be mixed in a certain proportion. Polymerization and intermediation are completed by pressure heating treatment process. The principle of polymerization is heat initiated free radical polymerization. Thermosetting denture base resin has stable mechanical strength and appropriate flexural strength in oral cavity. Easy to polish. Stable color. The coefficient of thermal expansion is relatively high. There is a certain degree of shrinkage after polymerization. Soluble in organic solvents. It is a kind of denture base materials widely used in clinic.

explanation_cn: 是以丙烯酸系单体（丙烯酸甲酯、丙烯酸乙酯、丙烯酸正丁酯和甲基丙烯酸甲酯、甲基丙烯酸正丁酯等）为基本成分。经交联成网络结构的不溶不熔树脂。有本体浇铸材料、溶液型、乳液型、水基型多种形态。除具有丙烯酸树脂的一般性能以外，具有更优良的耐热性、耐水性、耐溶剂性及耐磨、耐刻划性。主要用作织物、皮革、纸张处理剂、工业用漆及建筑涂料。
explanation_en: It is based on acrylic monomer (methyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate, n-butyl acrylate, methyl methacrylate, n-butyl methacrylate, etc.). Insoluble and fusible resin with network structure after crosslinking. There are many forms of body casting materials, solution type, lotion type and water-based type. In addition to the general properties of acrylic resin, it has better heat resistance, water resistance, solvent resistance, wear resistance and scratch resistance. Mainly used as fabric, leather, paper treatment agent, industrial paint and architectural coatings.

name_cn: 热固性树脂基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以热固性树脂为基体的复合材料。这种复合材料占连续纤维增强树脂基复合材料的绝大多数。热间性树脂间化交联前可流动、黏度低。间化后形成不溶不熔的体型结构，固化时通常需要加入固化剂-根据固化剂的不同，可以在常温下间化，也可以加热同化。热固性树脂主要品种有：酚醛树脂、氨基树脂、环氧树脂、不饱和聚酯树脂、有机硅树脂与双马来酰亚胺树脂、氰酸酯树脂以及热固性聚酰亚胺树脂等。该类复合材料成型工艺性好，适于各种成型方法，如热压（真空袋、模压、热压罐）成型、自动铺放成型、缠绕成型、拉挤成型、液体成型、手糊成型、喷射成型等，树脂基体对增强体具有良好的浸润性和黏附性。这类复合材料一般具有很高的强度、模量及优良的耐热、耐疲劳、抗蠕变、耐腐蚀、耐湿热等性能。"用作结构材料，也可用作功能材料，广泛应用于航空航天、机械制造、交通运输、化工、电子/电气、建筑、能源及其他T业领域中。以碳纤维增强的热同性树脂基复合材料为例。由于其质轻高强特性突出，用作飞行器结构在减轻结构重量、提高结构效率、改善结构可靠性、延长结构寿命等方面凸显出无吋比拟的优势，目前在先进民用飞机结构上其用量已达到50%。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on thermosetting resin. This composite materials accounts for the vast majority of continuous fiber reinforced resin based composite materials. The thermotropic resin can flow before crosslinking and has low viscosity. After intermediation, insoluble and unmelted body structure is formed, and curing agent is usually required to be added during curing - according to the difference of curing agent, it can be intermediated at room temperature or heated for assimilation. The main varieties of thermosetting resin include: phenolic resin, amino resin, epoxy resin, unsaturated polyester resin, silicone resin and bismaleimide resin, cyanate ester resin and thermosetting polyimide resin. This kind of composite materials has good molding technology and is suitable for various molding methods, such as hot pressing (vacuum bag, molding, autoclave) molding, automatic placement molding, filament winding, pultrusion process, liquid molding, hand lay-up molding, spray molding, etc. resin matrix has good wettability and adhesion to reinforcement. Such composite materials generally have high strength, modulus and excellent heat resistance, fatigue resistance, creep resistance, corrosion resistance, damp heat resistance and other properties. "As a structural materials, it can also be used as a functional materials, and is widely used in aerospace, machinery manufacturing, transportation, chemical industry, electronics/electrical, architecture, energy and other T industry fields. Take carbon fiber reinforced thermal resin based composite materials as an example. Because of its light weight and high strength, its use as an aircraft structure highlights the advantages of reducing structural weight, improving structural efficiency, improving structural reliability, and extending structural life The advantage of inch comparison is that its usage in advanced civil aircraft structures has reached 50%.

name_cn: 热固性聚酰亚胺树脂基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以热同性聚酰亚胺树脂为基体的复合材料。聚酰亚胺是一类分子链上含有酰亚胺重复单元的聚合物。若聚合物分子端基为反应性基团。经过化学交联则形成热固性聚酰亚胺，是目前耐温性最好的结构复合材料用树脂基体。热间性聚酰亚胺根据活性端基可分为PMR聚酰亚胺、乙炔封端聚酰亚胺以及双马来酰亚胺。热固性聚酰亚胺克服了热塑性材料不易成型加工的缺点。兼具良好的工艺性和优良的力学性能。常用的增强材料有玻璃纤维、碳纤维，硼纤维及其织物等。适用的成型工艺有热压罐成型、模压成型、树脂传递模塑成型等。热固性聚酰亚胺树脂基复合材料具有优异的耐热氧化性能、力学性能、介电性能和耐低温性能。以及优良的耐辐照、耐燃、耐磨和耐溶剂性能等。在航空航天等领域的耐高温结构中得到广泛应用，如碳纤维增强热固性聚酰亚胺树脂基复合材料用作航空发动机的压气机机匣、外涵道。巡航导弹的进气道、整流罩，以及航天飞机的轨道器等。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on thermally isotropic polyimide resin. Polyimide is a kind of polymer with imide repeating unit on the molecular chain. If the end group of polymer molecule is reactive group. After chemical crosslinking, thermosetting polyimide is formed, which is the resin matrix for structural composite materials with the best temperature resistance at present. Thermotropic polyimide can be divided into PMR polyimide, acetylene terminated polyimide and bismaleimide according to the active end group. Thermosetting polyimide overcomes the disadvantage that thermoplastic materials are not easy to form and process. It has both good processability and excellent mechanical properties. Common reinforcement materials include glass fiber, carbon fiber, boron fiber and its fabric. Applicable molding processes include autoclave molding, press molding, resin transfer molding, etc. Thermosetting polyimide resin matrix composite have excellent thermal oxidation resistance, mechanical properties, dielectric properties and low temperature resistance. And excellent radiation resistance, flame resistance, wear resistance, and solvent resistance. It has been widely used in high-temperature structures in aerospace and other fields, for example, carbon fiber reinforced thermosetting polyimide resin matrix composite are used as compressor casings and external conduits of aeroengines. The inlet and fairing of cruise missiles, as well as the orbiter of space shuttles.

explanation_cn: 以热塑性树脂为基体、以填料填充或以纤维(或其织物）增强的复合材料。常用的有聚丙烯（等规）、聚酰胺、饱和聚酯、聚醚酮、热塑性聚酰亚胺、聚苯乙烯和液晶高聚物等。常用的增强纤维有玻璃纤维、碳纤维、芳纶；常用的填料有碳酸钙、云母、石墨、滑石粉、二硫化铝；也可用金属粉。过去热塑性树脂基体一般局限于用短纤维增强，以模压与注射工艺成型制品。复合方法是将树脂溶液或熔体浸渍增强纤维制成预浸料，然后用模压法、真空袋或热压罐法、冲汛法、拉挤法和缠绕成型法成型制品，与热固性树脂基复合材料相比，热塑性树脂基复合材料具有韧性高，成型工艺简单、容易修补、二次成型等优点。目前'热塑性树脂基复合材料存在的主要问题是成型中需用高温高压、高黏度熔体浸润纤维比较困难、有可能出现环境应力开裂、树脂回收成本较高。
explanation_en: A composite materials based on thermoplastic resin, filled with fillers or reinforced with fibers (or fabrics thereof). Commonly used are polypropylene (isotactic), polyamide, saturated polyester, polyether ketone, thermoplastic polyimide, polystyrene and liquid crystal polymers. Common reinforcing fiber include glass fiber, carbon fiber and aramid fiber; Commonly used fillers are calcium carbonate, mica, graphite, talcum powder, aluminum disulfide; Metal powder can also be used. In the past, the matrix of thermoplastic resin was generally limited to staple fiber reinforcement for molding and injection molding products. The composition method is to impregnate resin solution or melt with reinforcing fiber to make prepreg, and then use molding, vacuum bag or autoclave, flushing, pultrusion and filament winding to form products. Compared with thermosetting resin matrix composite, thermoplastic resin matrix composite materials has the advantages of high toughness, simple molding process, easy repair, post forming, etc. At present, the main problems of thermoplastic resin based composite materials are that it is difficult to soak fibers with high temperature and pressure, high viscosity melt, environmental stress cracking may occur, and resin recovery costs are high.

explanation_cn: 它的分子中含有具橡胶弹性的柔软部分（软质链节）和相当于硫化橡胶的交联点以及为了防止塑性变形的分子约束成分（硬质链节）。指既吋采用与热塑性塑料相同的加工机械进行快速、有效、经济的加工，又可在使用温度（近室温）下显示橡胶弹性的一类高分子材料。热塑性弹忭体种类众多，包括苯乙烯类、聚烯烃类、聚氨酯类。聚酯类TPE(TPEE)、氯乙烯类、聚酰胺类TPK(TPAE)、热塑性氣橡胶（TPF)、熔融加工哦TPE(MPR)等。主要用在汽车零部件和橡胶工业制品的代替品等方面。
explanation_en: Its molecule contains a soft part (soft link) with rubber elasticity, a cross-linking point equivalent to vulcanized rubber, and a molecular constraint component (hard link) to prevent plastic deformation. It refers to a class of macromolecule materials that can not only use the same processing machinery as thermoplastic plastics for rapid, effective and economical processing, but also display rubber elasticity at the service temperature (near room temperature). There are many kinds of thermoplastic elastomers, including styrene, polyolefin and polyurethime. Polyester TPE (TPEE), vinyl chloride, polyamide TPK (TPAE), thermoplastic rubber (TPF), melt processed TPE (MPR), etc. It is mainly used as a substitute for auto parts and rubber industrial products.

explanation_cn: 指加工时受热变软具可塑件、冷却后又能变硬具有不同的力学性能。改变温度能够重复可熔可溶的一类合成树脂。这类聚合物多具有线性链结构，可用自由基型、离子型、配位型等聚合反应及溶液、乳液、悬浮聚合等方法制得。工业上最常见的有聚乙烯、聚丙烯、聚氯乙烯、聚苯乙烯等树脂制成的塑料，在橡胶中的热塑性弹性体。如聚笨乙烯-聚丁二烯-聚苯乙烯5嵌段共聚物。热塑性树脂大分子间无化学交联，只有物理交联存在。因此一般热塑性树脂有易于加_工的优点。也有耐热性不甚理想的缺点。
explanation_en: It refers to the plastic parts that become soft when heated during processing and have different mechanical properties that can harden after cooling. A kind of synthetic resin that can be melted and dissolved repeatedly by changing the temperature. Most of these polymer have linear chain structure and can be prepared by free radical, ionic, coordination and other polymerization reactions, as well as solution, lotion, suspension polymerization and other methods. The most common plastics in industry are resin such as polyethylene, polypropylene, polyvinyl chloride, polystyrene, and thermoplastic elastomers in rubber. Such as polystyrene polybutadiene polystyrene 5 block copolymer. There is no chemical crosslinking between macromolecule of thermoplastic resin, only physical crosslinking exists. Therefore, thermoplastic resin is easy to add_ The advantages of work. There are also drawbacks to poor heat resistance.

name_cn: 热塑性聚合物基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以热塑性树脂为基体的复合材料。原则上所有的热塑件塑料都可用作复合材料的基体，常用的有聚丙烯、聚酰胺、饱和聚酯、聚碳酸酯、聚苯硫醚、聚醚酮、热塑性聚酰亚胺、聚苯醚、聚砜、聚四氟乙烯、聚氯乙烯、聚苯乙烯和液晶高聚物等。常用的增强体有短切纤维、连续纤维或荇粉状《料等。热塑性树脂具有很多独特优点-如韧性高、耐冲击性能好、预浸料稳定且无储存时间限制、制造周期短、耐化学性能好、吸湿率低、可重复加工等。似热塑性树脂的熔体黏度很高，与增强体的浸渍较热固忡树脂要差。所适用的成型H艺有：注射成型、热m成型、真空模压成型T_艺、纤维缠绕成型、辊压成型及拉挤成型等。热塑性树脂基复合材料以其优异的K性、抗损伤、抗疲劳性能和雷达波传输性能、介电透射性能等。在航空、航天领域的应用日益广泛。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on thermoplastic resin. In principle, all thermoplastic plastics can be used as the matrix of composite materials materials, such as polypropylene, polyamide, saturated polyester, polycarbonate, polyphenylene sulfide, polyether ketone, thermoplastic polyimide, polyphenylene oxide, polysulfone, polylctrafluorocthylone, polyvinyl chloride, polystyrene and liquid crystal polymers. Commonly used reinforcements include short cut fibers Continuous fiber or powder free Materials, etc. thermoplastic resin has many unique advantages - such as high toughness, good impact resistance, stable prepreg without storage time limit, short manufacturing cycle, good chemical resistance, low moisture absorption, reprocessing, etc. The melt viscosity of thermoplastic resin like melt is very high, and the impregnation with reinforcement is worse than that with hot solid resin. The suitable molding processes include injection molding, hot m molding, vacuum press molding T_ process, fiber filament winding Roll forming and pultrusion forming, etc. Thermoplastic resin based composite materials have excellent K properties, damage resistance, fatigue resistance, radar wave transmission properties, dielectric transmission properties, etc. The application in the aviation and aerospace fields is becoming increasingly widespread.

explanation_cn: 又称聚氨酯弹性体，是一类具有刚性和弹性链段的聚氨酯。能够可重复性地加热变软冷却硬化。主要由低聚物多元醇（软段）、二异氰酸酯（硬段）以及扩链剂构成。常用软段有聚己白酯二醇和聚四氢呋喃二醇等。常用的硬段包括甲苯二异氰酸酯（TD）、二苯基甲烷-二异氰酸酯（MD1)、多次平基多笨基多异氰酸酯（PAPI)等，常用的扩链剂包括1，4-丁二醇、乙二醇等。TPU具有机械强度高、耐寒性突出、加工性能好、耐油、耐水、耐霉菌、再生利用性好等优点，广泛应用于鞋材、成衣、充气玩具、水上及水下之运动器材等。热塑性聚氨酯（TPU)具有良好的生物相容性、抗凝血性和优良的物理性能-在医学和生物领域中用量虽少，却占有重要的地位，正向生物工程、细胞工程和免疫工程等方面迅速发展。
explanation_en: nan

explanation_cn: 由分子量为1.5万以上的低熔点聚醚或聚酯柔性链段和酊形成结晶结构的高熔点的聚氨基甲酸酯刚性段组成的聚氨酯橡胶。热塑性聚氨酯是一类可加热塑化、可被溶剂溶解的聚氨酯，其化学结构上几乎没有化学交联，其分子链基本上是线型的。但存在一定量的物理交联。热塑性聚氨酯橡胶具有较高的机械强度，较好的低温性能和耐臭氧性。但耐热和耐溶剂型较差。适用于制汽车零件、各种轴承、机器壳体、齿轮、密封件等。热塑性聚氨酯橡胶可以制成透明、浅色和纯度很高的制品。可用于制作要求无毒副作用和美观的食品和医疗行业，不足之处在于它只适用于生产小件制品，而大制品成型困难、模具价格高。
explanation_en: Polyurethane rubber is composed of low melting point polyether or polyester flexible chain segment with molecular weight of more than 15000 and high melting point polyurethane rigid segment with tincture forming crystal structure. Thermoplastic polyurethane is a kind of polyurethime that can be heated, plasticized and dissolved by solvent. Its chemical structure is almost free of chemical crosslinking, and its molecular chain is basically linear. However, there is a certain amount of physical crosslinking. Thermoplastic polyurethane elastomers has high mechanical strength, good low-temperature performance and ozone resistance. But the heat and solvent resistant types are poor. Suitable for manufacturing automotive parts, various bearings, machine shells, gears, seals, etc. Thermoplastic polyurethane elastomers can be made into transparent, light colored and high-purity products. It can be used in the food and medical industries that require non-toxic side effects and aesthetics, but its disadvantage is that it is only suitable for producing small products, while large products are difficult to shape and mold prices are high.

explanation_cn: 利用金属固态相变原理及强韧化原理，采用不同的加热和冷却制度，改变材料白部的组织结构-从而达到改善并控制其性能的H的，这样的技术学科称为热处理。为达到预期目的。必须选择控制材料组织和性能变化的加热和冷却制度，包括加热速度、保温温度、保温时间、冷却速度等，这种工艺制度称为热处理工艺。金属材料的热处理工艺可分为：常规热处理，如退火、正火、淬火、回火、固溶、时效、深冷处理等；化学热处理，既改变材料白部的组织4性能同时还改变表层化学成分和组织，如渗碳、渗氮、渗金属等；形变热处理。将形变与相变相结合从而强化处理效果。如形变淬火、形变诱导析出等；表面热处理，主要改变表层的组织与性能，如高频热处理、表面淬火、表面激光热处理等。为保证热处理过程中钢材表面成分不发生有害的变化（如氧化、脱碳等），还广泛采用可控气氛、保护气氛或真空热处理。而为了强化热处理工艺，节约能源，利用非平衡相变的特殊作W-还研究幵发和应用了髙密度能量的热处理工艺如感应加热、离子轰击、激光加热、电子束加热热处理。
explanation_en: Using the principle of phase transformation of metal solid state and the principle of strengthening and toughening, different heating and cooling systems are used to change the structure of the white part of materials so as to improve and control its performance. Such a technical discipline is called heat treatment. To achieve the expected purpose. Heating and cooling systems must be selected to control the changes in the structure and properties of control materials, including heating rate, holding temperature, holding time, cooling rate, etc. This process system is called heat treatment process. The heat treatment process of metallic materials can be divided into: conventional heat treatment, such as annealing, normalizing, quenching, tempering, solution, aging, cryogenic treatment, etc; Thermo-chemical treatment not only changes the structure and properties of the white part of materials, but also changes the chemical composition and structure of the surface layer, such as carburizing, nitriding, diffusion metallizing, etc; Thermomechanical treatment. Deformation and phase are combined to enhance the treatment effect. Such as deformation quenching, deformation induced precipitation, etc; Surface heat treatment mainly changes the structure and properties of the surface layer, such as high-frequency heat treatment, case hardening, surface laser heat treatment, etc. In order to ensure that no harmful changes (such as oxidation, decarburization, etc.) occur to the surface composition of steel product during heat treatment, controllable atmosphere, protective atmosphere or vacuum heat treatment are also widely used. In order to strengthen the heat treatment process and save energy, we also developed and applied heat treatment processes with high density energy, such as induction heating, ion bombardment, laser heating, and electron beam heating heat treatment, using the special work of non-equilibrium phase transformation.

explanation_cn: 涂覆在金属工件表面，在不同气氛热处理时-能保持金属表面原有组成或结构的暂时性保护涂层。按不同气氛和保护要求，有抗氧化、防渗碳、防渗氮、防渗硼等功能。热处理后，涂层应能较方便地从金属工件表面除去。
explanation_en: It is a temporary protective coating that can maintain the original composition or structure of the metal surface when it is coated on the surface of the metal workpiece and subjected to heat treatment in different atmospheres. According to different atmospheres and protection requirements, it has functions such as oxidation resistance, anti carburization, anti nitriding, and anti boronizing. After heat treatment, the coating shall be easily removed from the metal workpiece surface.

explanation_cn: 用于加热阴极的材料。是旁热式阴极的一个组成部分。由于长期在较高温度下工作，要求热子材料具有高熔点、高温强度高、蒸发率低和电阻小等特性。热子一般有不带绝缘层的裸丝、带绝缘层的和组合式三种形式。绝缘层是将绝缘物质加上黏结剂和有机溶剂混在一起配制成悬浮浆状涂料，涂覆在芯丝上，最后高温烧结而成。芯丝常用钨合金丝，如不下垂钨丝、钨铼丝、钨钍丝和钨钼合金丝。也有用纯钨制成热子。绝缘物质要求具有良好的绝缘强度、在高温工作条件下不脱落不开裂、高的化学稳定性、良好的热导性和不产生有害污染。一般用耐火氧化物作绝缘物质。
explanation_en: The materials used to heat the cathode. It is a component of a side heating cathode. Due to long-term operation at higher temperatures, thermoemitting materials are required to have high melting point, high high temperature strength, low evaporation rate and low resistance. Thermists generally come in three forms: bare wire without insulation layer, wire with insulation layer, and combination type. The insulating layer is made by mixing insulating material, adhesive and organic solvent to prepare suspension slurry coatings, coating it on the core wire, and finally sintering at high temperature. The core wire is usually made of tungsten alloy wire, such as non-sag tungsten wire, tungsten rhenium wire, tungsten thorium wire and tungsten molybdenum alloy wire. Pure tungsten can also be used to make thermionic particles. Insulation materials require good insulation strength, non detachment and cracking under high temperature working conditions, high chemical stability, good thermal conductivity, and no harmful pollution. Generally, refractory oxides are used as insulation materials.

explanation_cn: 一种以远距离安全操作和观察强放射性物质的屏蔽密封宰：热室可分成两类。热室由屏蔽壁、衬层、屏蔽门、密封门、水电供给设备、通风系统、照明设备、排水系统、观察装置、遥控操作装置和物料运输出入口等部分构成。热室的侧壁要具有足够的屏蔽能力。所使用的材料有混凝土、钢、铅和水。热室壁的衬层吋以选用不锈钢、碳钢、塑料板和油漆等材料。观察装置可用反射镜、窥视窗、潜望镜和电视。为了防止放射性物质的扩散和污染-热室应该是密封的并保持负压状态。进出热室放射性物质的传送可用带屏蔽的运输罐经设在热室顶板、墙面或地板上的转送口实现。热室主要用于被辐照过的燃料以及包壳材料试验、乏燃料元件以及照射过的靶子的化学再处理、冶金学研究、放射性同位素生产以及其他高水平放射性物质的研究等。
explanation_en: A kind of shield sealing device for safe operation and observation of strong radioactive substances at a long distance: hot cell can be divided into two categories. The hot cell is composed of shield wall, liner, shield door, seal door, water and electricity supply equipment, ventilation system, lighting equipment, drainage system, observation device, remote control operating device, material transportation entrance and exit, etc. The side walls of the hot cell shall have sufficient shielding capacity. The materials used are concrete, steel, lead and water. The liner of the hot chamber wall shall be made of stainless steel, carbon steel, plastic plate, paint and other materials. The observation device can be a reflector, a viewing window, a periscope, and a television. In order to prevent diffusion and pollution of radioactive materials, the hot cell should be sealed and kept in a negative pressure state. The transfer of radioactive materials into and out of the hot cell can be realized by the transfer port set on the roof, wall or floor of the hot cell through the transport tank with shield. The hot cell is mainly used for the test of irradiated fuel and cladding materials, chemical reprocessing of spent fuel (nuclear) elements and irradiated targets, metallurgy research, radioisotope production and research of other high-level radioactive substances.

explanation_cn: 简称热容。物质的温度升高（或降低）1K时所吸收（或放出）的热量。
explanation_en: It is abbreviated as heat capacity. The amount of heat absorbed (or released) when the temperature of a substance increases (or decreases) by 1K.

explanation_cn: 表征物体热传导速度的物理量。当存在温度梯度时。就发生热传导，在一维稳定状态下，单位时间通过垂直于热传导方向的单位面积的热量与温度梯度成正比。固体中传导热量的载体是电子、声子、磁激发以及在某些!情况下的电磁辐射。同体的总的热导率由各种导热载体的贡献叠加而成。
explanation_en: A physical quantity that characterizes the heat conduction velocity of an object. When there is a temperature gradient. Heat conduction occurs, and in a one-dimensional stable state, the amount of heat per unit area passing through a unit time perpendicular to the direction of heat conduction is directly proportional to the temperature gradient. The carriers of heat conduction in solids are electrons, phonon, magnetic excitations and in some cases! Electromagnetic radiation under certain conditions. The total thermal conductivity of the same body is composed of the contributions of various heat conduction carriers.

explanation_cn: 既不吸热又不放热的重整反应。它包括部分氧化反应和蒸气重整反应；部分氧化反应先发生。蒸气重整反应后发生。
explanation_en: A reforming reaction that neither absorbs nor releases heat. It includes partial oxidation reaction and steam reforming reaction; Partial oxidation reaction occurs first. Occurs after steam reforming reaction.

explanation_cn: 物体受热不均勾或各组元的膨胀系数不冋。在加热或冷却时所产生的应力称热应力。物体受热就会膨胀。当各部分受热不均匀或膨胀系数不同，则各部分的膨胀就不相同，从而引起畸变，导致热应力的产生。产生热应力的原因是多种多样的。例如：①构件白存在温度梯度，如蒸汽锅炉管，涡轮叶片等；②组元之间存在温差，如管道中的热膨胀接头：③组元的热膨胀系数不同，如不同材料的焊接件；④构件或试样急冷（如淬火）或急热(如表面高频加热）。
explanation_en: Uneven heating of objects or uneven expansion coefficients of each component. The stress generated during heating or cooling is called thermal stress. Objects expand when heated. When the heating of each part is uneven or the coefficient of expansion is different, the expansion of each part is different, leading to distortion and the generation of thermal stress. There are many reasons for thermal stress. For example: ① There are temperature gradients in components, such as steam boiler tubes, turbine blades, etc.; ② There is a temperature difference between the components, such as the thermal expansion joints in the pipeline: ③ the thermal expansion coefficients of the components are different, such as weld pieces of different materials; ④ The component or sample is quenched (such as quenching) or heated (such as high-frequency surface heating).

explanation_cn: 马氏体相变的一类。若马氏体相与母相之间的相界面能很小。与马氏体相变相伴生的塑性形变也非常小，当相变的化学驱动力与弹性应变能达到热力学平衡时，马氏体生长停止。由于这种平衡是由温度决定的化学自由能与被应变决定的弹性应变能之间的平衡。故称为热弹性。一旦达到这种热弹性平衡状态，若温度降低(或施加应力）马氏体随之生长，若加热升温（或减小应力）马氏体则随之缩小。这种马氏体相变称为热弹性相变。出现热弹性相变的合金具有形状记忆效应，如NiTi。CuAlNi，CuZnAl合金等。
explanation_en: Martensitic transformation. If the phase interface energy between martensite phase and parent phase is very small. The plastic deformation associated with the transformation of martensite phase is also very small. When the chemical driving force of phase transformation and elasticity strain energy reach thermodynamics equilibrium, the growth of martensite stops. Because this balance is the balance between the chemical free energy determined by temperature and the elasticity strain energy determined by strain. Therefore, it is called thermal elasticity. Once this thermal elasticity equilibrium state is reached, if the temperature decreases (or the stress is applied), the martensite will grow, and if the temperature rises (or the stress is reduced), the martensite will shrink. This martensitic transformation is called thermoelastic transformation. Alloy with thermoelastic transformation has shape memory effect, such as NiTi. CuAlNi, CuZnAl alloy, etc.

explanation_cn: 在高温环境中保持较高强度并兼具有一定抗氧化性的合金钢。热强钢要求具有较高的持久强度和蠕变强度、足够的韧性、良好的加工性及焊接tfe以及一定的组织稳定性。在钢中加入Ni、Co、Cu、Al、Ti、Cr、Mo、w、Nb等合金元素提高钢的热强性。热强钢主要用于制作在高温下承受较高应力的重要零件。
explanation_en: Alloy steel with high strength and oxidation resistance at high temperature. High-temperature strength steel requires high endurance strength and creep strength, sufficient toughness, good workability, weld tfe and certain structural stability. Adding alloy elements such as Ni, Co, Cu, Al, Ti, Cr, Mo, w and Nb into steel can improve the thermal strength of steel. High-temperature strength steel is mainly used to make important parts that bear high stress under high temperature.

explanation_cn: 热成型是一种以热塑性塑料板材或片材为原料的二次成型技术-其法一般是先将板材裁切成一定形状和尺寸的坯件，再将坯件在一定温度下加热到弹塑性状态，然后施加压力使坯件弯曲与延伸。在达到预定的型样后使其冷却定型，经过适当的修整，即成为制品。热成型过程中对坯件施加的压力，在大多数情况下是靠一侧抽真空或在一侧导入压缩空气在坯件两面形成气压差，有时也借助于机械压力与液压力。主要用来生产薄壳制品，一般都是形状为较简单的杯、盘、盖、冰箱白胆、浴缸等。板、片材厚度为1-10mm，所用的塑料品种有纤维素塑料、ABS、PS、PMMA等。按照制品类型和操作方法的不同，热成型方法有十几种，主要有：差压成型、覆盖成型、柱塞助压成型、回缩成型、对模成型以及双片热成型。热成型的优点是设备投资低、成型温度低、模具费用低、易成型大制件、成型周期短、易于产品更新，缺点是原材料损耗大、残余应力大、成型形状受限、制品精度及表面质量低等。
explanation_en: Thermo-forming is a post forming technology using thermoplastic plastics plates or sheets as raw materials. Generally, the method is to cut the plates into blanks of a certain shape and size, then heat the blanks to an elastic-plastic state at a certain temperature, and then apply pressure to bend and extend the blanks. After reaching the predetermined shape, it is cooled and shaped, and after appropriate trimming, it becomes a product. In most cases, the pressure exerted on the blank in the thermo-forming process is to form a pressure difference between two sides of the blank by vacuumizing on one side or introducing compressed air on the other side, sometimes with the help of mechanical pressure and hydraulic pressure. Mainly used to produce thin shell products, usually in simple shapes such as cups, plates, lids, refrigerators, bathtubs, etc. The thickness of plates and sheets is 1-10mm, and the plastics used include cellulose plastics, ABS, PS, PMMA, etc. According to the different product types and operation methods, there are more than ten thermo-forming methods, mainly including differential pressure forming, covering forming, plunger assisted pressure forming, retraction forming, die forming and double piece thermo-forming. The advantages of thermo-forming are low equipment investment, low molding temperature, low mold cost, easy to form large parts, short molding cycle, and easy to update products. The disadvantages are high consumption of raw materials, large residual stress, limited molding shape, low product precision and surface quality, etc.

explanation_cn: 反映温度不平均的物体中，温度均匀化速度的一个物理量。它正比于物体的热导率。
explanation_en: A physical quantity that reflects the rate of temperature homogenization in objects with uneven temperature. It is proportional to the thermal conductivity of the object.

explanation_cn: 是一种在不同温度下。显示不同颜色的纤维-属特种功能纤维。可以采用染色的方法使热敏变色染料与纤维表面结合，或釆用共混纺丝的方法使热敏变色颜料与纤维本体结合。得到热敏变色纤维；也可以在纤维表面形成含热敏变色剂或热敏变色微胶囊涂层的方法来制备热敏变色纤维。
explanation_en: It is a type of device that operates at different temperatures. Fibers showing different colors belong to special functional fiber. The thermochromic dye can be combined with the fiber surface by dyeing, or the thermochromic pigment can be combined with the fiber body by blending. Obtaining thermochromie fiber; The thermochromie fiber can also be prepared by forming a thermochromic agent or thermochromic microcapsule coating on the fiber surface.

explanation_cn: 面涂有热敏材料的纸。在接收电脉冲后能产生高分辨率的文字和图像。通常用在电热打印机上。
explanation_en: Paper coated with heat sensitive materials. After receiving electrical pulses, it can generate high-resolution text and images. Usually used on electric thermal printers.

explanation_cn: 在工作温度范围内，零功率电阻值随温度变化而变化的陶瓷材料。热敏陶瓷分为：①负温度系数热敏电阻陶瓷，简称NTC热敏陶瓷；②正温度系数热敏电阻陶瓷。简称PTC热敏陶瓷；③临界温度热敏电阻陶瓷，简称CTK热敏陶瓷。不同类塑的热敏陶瓷性能参数不同。主要用于制作热敏电阻器、温度传感器、加热器以及限电流元件等。
explanation_en: A ceramics materials whose zero power resistance varies with temperature within the operating temperature range. Thermosensitive ceramics are divided into: ① negative temperature coefficient thermistor ceramics, referred to as NTC thermosensitive ceramics; ② Positive temperature coefficient thermistor ceramics. PTC thermosensitive ceramics for short; ③ Critical temperature thermistor ceramics, referred to as CTK thermosensitive ceramics. The performance parameters of different plastic thermosensitive ceramics are different. Mainly used for making thermistors, temperature sensors, heaters, and current limiting components.

explanation_cn: 聚合物热和氧的作用下发生的降解。氧化降解往往与其他物理因累如热、光、机械作用引起的降解交错进行。(r)链聚合物容易发生热氧化反应。尤其是含有不饱和双键的聚烯烃。
explanation_en: Degradation of polymer under the action of heat and oxygen. Oxidative degradation is often interleaved with degradation caused by other physical factors such as heat, light and mechanical effects. (r) Chain polymer are prone to thermal oxidation. In particular, polyolefin containing unsaturated double bonds.

explanation_cn: 材料（尤其是烷基为主的橡胶材料）在热和氧的共同作用下。外观和理化性能随着时间改变。外观方面包括材料表面硬化、龟裂或变软、发黏、材料几何尺寸变化；理化性能方面包括化学组成、密度、硬度、拉伸强度、黏弹性、电性能等也会发生变化。高分子材料的碳氢键在高温和氧气作用下会形成过氧化物由基，而自由基又可以引发相邻分子链的烷基、双键、羰基等发生支化、交联、环化、羰基化等一系列链式反应，使分子链结构改变。材料在使用中往往需要加入苯酚、芳香族仲胺等作为抗氧剂。捕获在热氧条件下生成的自由基。通常可以通过在烘箱中的模拟实验来研究材料的热氧老化现象。
explanation_en: Materials (especially alkyl based rubber materials) are under the combined action of heat and oxygen. The appearance and physicochemical properties change over time. Appearance includes surface of materials hardening, cracking or softening, sticky, materials geometric dimension changes; Physical and chemical properties, including chemical composition, density, hardness, tensile strength, viscoelasticity and electrical properties, will also change. The hydrocarbon bond of macromolecule materials will form peroxide radical under the action of high temperature and oxygen, and free radicals can trigger a series of chain reactions such as branching, crosslinking, cyclization, carbonylation, etc. of alkyl, double bond, carbonyl, etc. of adjacent molecular chains, which will change the structure of molecular chains. In the use of materials, it is often necessary to add phenol, aromatic secondary amine, etc. as antioxidant. Capture free radicals generated under hot oxygen conditions. The phenomenon of thermal oxidative aging of materials can usually be studied through simulation experiments in the oven.

explanation_cn: 以热能来激活的反应或过程。
explanation_en: A reaction or process activated by thermal energy.

explanation_cn: 在结晶相中，大分子链聚集排列得紧密有序，直至温度升高至熔融温度（Tm)才出现晶相的熔化和分子链的运动。结晶度越高，材料的熔点越高，熔融所需吸收的热量越多。
explanation_en: In the crystalline phase, the macromolecule chains are clustered and arranged in a tight order, until the temperature rises to melting temperature (Tm), the melting of crystalline phase and the movement of molecular chains occur. The higher the crystallinity, the higher the melting point of materials, and the more heat it needs to absorb for melting.
