explanation_cn: 亦称熔融法预浸料。将固态树脂体系加热熔融后，浸溃纤维而制得的预浸料。通过三种方法来完成纤维浸溃:①用"-"字头挤出机将熔化的树脂挤到纤维所经过的模具中-从而得到纤维型预浸料；②将树脂放入带有加热功能的树脂槽。树脂槽加热后，纤维（或织物）通过流动状态的树脂，再绕到排布机上（或收卷装置上）冷却，得到预浸料；③先将树脂制成树脂膜，然后在加热板温度和压辊（轧轮）压力的作用下，使树脂膜熔化并浸渍纤维（或织物）-冷却后得到预浸料。热熔法预浸料适用于热固性树脂、无定形及结晶型热塑性树脂。适用范围广，！其制造过程无溶剂、无污染，利于生产低孔隙含量的复合材料。但这种方法需要特定的设备和高温条件，对树脂、纤维间的浸润性要求高。
explanation_en: Also called melting method prepreg. The prepreg is prepared by heating and melting the solid resin system and soaking the fiber. Fiber impregnation can be completed by three methods: ① extrude the melted resin into the mold through which the fiber passes with the "-" extruder to obtain fiber type prepreg; ② Put resin into resin tank with heating function. After the resin tank is heated, the fiber (or fabric) passes through the flowing resin, and then is wound onto the laying machine (or winding device) for cooling to obtain prepreg; ③ First, resin is made into resin film, and then under the action of heating plate temperature and pressure of pressing roller (roller), resin film is melted and impregnated with fiber (or fabric) - cooled to obtain prepreg. Mtting prepared prepreg is suitable for thermosetting resin, amorphous and crystalline thermoplastic resin. Wide application range,! Its manufacturing process is solvent-free and pollution-free, which is conducive to the production of low porosity composite materials. However, this method requires specific equipment and high temperature conditions, and requires high wettability between resin and fibers.

explanation_cn: 能够产生热释电效应的物质。常见的热电体材料有铁电钛酸钡、电气石和硫酸三甘肽等。铁电体是应用最广泛的热电体材料。见释电效应。
explanation_en: A substance capable of producing pyroelectric effect. Common pyroelectrics materials include ferroelectric barium titanate, tourmaline and triglycol sulfate. Ferroelectric body is the most widely used pyroelectrics materials. See the pyroelectric effect.

explanation_cn: 又称温差电材料，是指具有较大热电效应的半导体材料，能把热能转换成电能，或由电能产生致冷作用。热电I半导体具有比金属大得多的温差电动势，在热能与电i能之间的转换工有较高的效率，因此在温差发电、温差致冷方面得到了较好的应用。热电材料目前已有一百余多种。
explanation_en: Also known as thermoelectric materials, it refers to semiconductor materials with greater thermoelectric effect, which can convert heat energy into electric energy or generate cooling effect from electric energy. Thermoelectric I semiconductor has a much larger thermoelectromotive force than metal, and has a higher efficiency in the conversion between thermal energy and electric energy, so it has been better applied in thermoelectric power generation and thermoelectric cooling. At present, there are more than 100 kinds of thermoelectric materials.

explanation_cn: 在真空或填充惰性气体的条件下加热金属或其他固体时。电子从材料表面逸出的现象。热电子发射电流密度大小强烈依赖于材料本身的性能和加热温度。使用中温度不能太高，以防止材料过分蒸发。
explanation_en: When heating metals or other solids under vacuum or inert gas filled conditions. The escape of electrons from surface of materials. The density of thermal electron emission current strongly depends on the properties of materials and heating temperature. The temperature during use shall not be too high to prevent excessive evaporation of materials.

explanation_cn: 材料中fh温度差直接转化为电位差或由电位差直接转化为温度差的物理效应。热电效应现象一般包含个分立的物理效应，分别是塞贝克效应（Seebeckeffect)、拍耳帖效应（Peltiereffect)和汤姆逊效应（Thomsoneffect)，热电效应的原子尺度机理是由于外加的温度梯度会使材料中的带电载流子由热的一端朝向冷的一端扩散。从而使材料两端的电荷分布不均并产生电压。其实几乎所有的材料都存在某种程度的热电效应，只是大多数材料该效应的效果微乎其微以致可以忽略不计。
explanation_en: The physical effect that fh temperature difference in materials directly converts into potential difference or from potential difference to temperature difference. The thermoelectric effect phenomenon generally includes separate physical effects, namely, the Seebeck effect, Peltier effect and Thomson effect. The atomic scale mechanism of the thermoelectric effect is that the applied temperature gradient will diffusion the charged carriers in materials from the hot end to the cold end. Thus, the charge distribution at both ends of materials is uneven and voltage is generated. In fact, almost all materials have some degree of thermoelectric effect, but the effect of most materials is so small that it can be ignored.

explanation_cn: 燃料电池系统所产生的有效电能和有效热能之和占进入电堆燃料量低热焓值的百分比。它是燃料电池系统电效率和热效率之和。燃料电池系统的热电效率可以超过80%。
explanation_en: The sum of effective electric energy and effective thermal energy generated by the fuel cell system accounts for the percentage of the low enthalpy value of the fuel entering the stack. It is the sum of electrical efficiency and thermal efficiency of fuel cell system. The combined heat and electrical efficiency of the fuel cell system can exceed 80%.

explanation_cn: 具有随温度改变其电极化性能产生变化（产生电信号），反之改变外加电场会发生温度变化的聚合物材料称为子。热电现象的产生主要是因为温度的变化会使材料的极化强度发生变化，引起表面电荷变化，或者释放原先被屏蔽的电荷。热电高分子材料是制作红外线传感器的核心材料之一，应用于红外线传感器、火灾报警器的热敏元件、防范传感器、照相复印、夜视仪热成像器、热电检测器、信号传递、光反射计、放射线计、红外摄像管靶材及自记温度计等方面。
explanation_en: The polymer materials with its electric polarization property changing with temperature (generating electrical signal), on the contrary, changing the applied electric field will cause temperature change is called the polymer material. The thermoelectric phenomenon is mainly caused by the change of temperature, which will change the polarization of materials, cause the change of surface charges, or release the previously shielded charges. Pyroelectric polymer materials is one of the core materials for making infrared sensors. It is used in infrared sensors, thermal elements of fire alarms, prevention sensors, photo copying, night vision thermal imagers, thermoelectric detectors, signal transmission, light reflectometers, radiometers, infrared camera tube targets and self recording thermometers.

explanation_cn: 见高温磨损。
explanation_en: See high temperature wear.

explanation_cn: 是塑料加工助剂中重要类别之一，热稳定剂与聚氯乙烯的诞生和发展同步，主要用于聚氯乙烯加工中，因此热稳定剂与聚氯乙烯中软硬制品的比例有密切关系。聚氯乙烯由于能和许多其他物质如增塑剂、填料、其他聚合物等相容。因而被认为是最通用的聚合物之一，其主要缺点是热稳定性差。热稳定剂主要是无机物或有机金属化合物。一般无机物和金属有机化合物是基本的(或主要的）稳定剂，而有机物则是次要的或辅助的稳定剂。
explanation_en: It is one of the important categories of additive in plastics processing. The birth and development of thermal stabilizer and polyvinyl chloride are synchronized, and it is mainly used in polyvinyl chloride processing. Therefore, thermal stabilizer is closely related to the proportion of soft and hard products in polyvinyl chloride. Polyvinyl chloride is compatible with many other substances, such as plasticizer, filler and other polymer. Therefore, it is considered as one of the most common polymer, and its main disadvantage is poor thermal stability. Heat stabilizer is mainly inorganic or organometallic compound. Generally, inorganic and organometallic compounds are basic (or primary) stabilizer, while organic compounds are secondary or auxiliary stabilizer.

explanation_cn: 材料在受控的热空气中，经受热和氧作用下产生的不可逆变化。聚合物的热氧化过程是一系列的自由基链式反应。在热和氧作用下，大分子首先在最薄弱的化学键上发生断裂。生成活泼的自由基R-和氢过氧化物ROOH。氢过氧化物发生分解反应，生成烃氧自由基RO-和羟基向由基HO*。这些由基引发一系列的自由基链式反应，最后导致聚合物结构和性能发生根本变化。氧化性能还与聚合物的化学结构和物理形态有关。含双键结构的聚合物比饱和结构的容易氧化；无定形比结晶的更易氧化热空气老化与环境条件温度和空气流速密切相关。评定材料的热空气老化。
explanation_en: Irreversible change of materials under the action of heat and oxygen in controlled hot air. The thermal oxidation process of polymer is a series of free radical chain reactions. Under the action of heat and oxygen, macromolecule first fracture on the weakest chemical bond. Generate active free radicals R - and hydroperoxide ROOH. Hydrogen peroxide undergoes a decomposition reaction, generating hydrocarbon oxygen free radicals RO - and hydroxyl groups towards the free radical HO *. These radical initiated a series of free radical chain reactions, which ultimately led to fundamental changes in the structure and properties of polymer. The oxidation performance is also related to the chemical structure and physical morphology of polymer. The polymer with double bond structure is easier to be oxidized than that with saturated structure; Amorphous is easier to oxidize than crystalline hot air aging is closely related to ambient temperature and air flow rate. Evaluate the hot air aging of materials.

explanation_cn: 把粉末坯或粉水装入特制容器（粉末包套）白置入高压容器中，施以高温和高气压，使这些粉末体被均匀压制和烧结成致密的零件或材料的过程称为粉末热等静压制粉末在等静压高压容器白同一时间经受高温和高压的联合作用，可以强化压制与烧结过程，降低制品的烧结温度，改善制品的组织结构，消除材料白部颗粒间的缺陷和孔隙，提高材料的致密度和强度。
explanation_en: The process of putting powder blanks or powder water into a special container (powder can) into a high-pressure container, applying high temperature and high pressure to make these powder bodies evenly pressing and sintering into dense parts or materials is called powder hot isostatic pressing. powder can undergo the combined effect of high temperature and high pressure at the same time in a isostatic pressing high-pressure container, which can strengthen the pressing and sintering processes, reduce the sintering temperature of products, and improve the structure of products, Eliminate the defects and pores between particles in the white part of materials, and improve the efficiency of spare filling and strength of materials.

explanation_cn: 管理燃料电池系统中热量分配的系统。由于电堆会产生热量。其中一部分热量需要排出以避免电堆温度过高。散热主要由散热器承担，通过冷却液在电堆和散热器之间循环有控制地把一部分热量散到外界环境中。同时，在环境温度低于0°C时，为了避免电堆中的水结冰，通过外界加热的方式保持冷冻液的温度在0°C以上。并使其在电堆和散热器之间循环。另外，燃料电池系统中的一些部件如DC-DC变换器、控制板、二极管等在运行过程中也会产生热量，这些热量也必须有效地排到外界环境中以避免它们过热而出现问题。如果燃料电池系统中包含燃料重整系统-燃料重整系统中的各个模块的热量需求也需要进行管理。
explanation_en: A system that manages heat distribution in a fuel cell system. Because the stack generates heat. Some of the heat needs to be discharged to avoid excessive temperature of the stack. The heat dissipation is mainly undertaken by the radiator, which circulates coolant between the stack and the radiator to dissipate part of the heat to the external environment in a controlled manner. At the same time, when the ambient temperature is lower than 0 ° C, in order to prevent the water in the stack from freezing, the temperature of the freezing liquid is kept above 0 ° C by external heating. It circulates between the stack and the radiator. In addition, some components in the fuel cell system, such as DC-DC converters, control boards, diodes, etc., will also generate heat during operation. These heat must also be effectively discharged to the external environment to avoid problems caused by their overheating. If the fuel cell system includes the fuel reforming system - the heat demand of each module in the fuel reforming system also needs to be managed.

explanation_cn: 不添加引发剂-单体直接在热的作用下形成单体自由基而聚合的过程。多数单体热聚合反应速率很慢。并旦受单体中少量氧气、过氧化物等影响，不易得到重复的聚合数据。苯乙烯的热聚合速率较快，并可以得到重复的热聚合数据，是工业生产中用热聚合工艺聚合的典型单休。笨乙烯的热聚合速率随着温度升高而增加，转化率达到50%，29°C聚合需400d，100°C聚合需25h，而167°C聚合只需16min，当转化率增大到85%-95%时-聚合速率明显下降-因而聚合后期要提高聚合温度。
explanation_en: The process of polymerization in which monomer forms monomer free radicals directly under the action of heat without adding initiator. The reaction rate of thermal polymerization of most monomer is very slow. It is not easy to get repeated polymerization data due to the influence of a small amount of oxygen and peroxide in monomer. The thermal polymerization rate of styrene is fast, and repeated thermal polymerization data can be obtained. It is a typical process of polymerization using thermal polymerization process in industrial production. The thermal polymerization rate of styrene increases with the increase of temperature, the conversion rate reaches 50%, the polymerization takes 400 days at 29 ° C, the polymerization takes 25 hours at 100 ° C, and the polymerization takes only 16 minutes at 167 ° C. When the conversion rate increases to 85% -95% - the polymerization rate decreases significantly - so the polymerization temperature should be increased in the later stage of polymerization.

explanation_cn: 高温下，材料与沉积在其表面的熔盐（主要为Na2SO)及周围气体发生综合作用而产生的腐蚀现象。材料发生热腐蚀的特征是，腐浊产物的外层为疏松的氧化物和熔盐。次白层为氧化膜-氧化膜下为硫化物。
explanation_en: At high temperature, the materials, molten salt (mainly Na2SO) deposited on its surface and surrounding gas have a comprehensive effect to produce corrosion phenomenon. The hot corrosion of materials is characterized by porosity oxide and molten salt as the outer layer of the corrosion products. The secondary white layer is the oxide film - sulfides are present below the oxide film.

explanation_cn: 间体在温度每升高一度时线度的相对变化量。有线膨胀系数和体膨胀系数（cubicalexpansioncoefficient)之分。热膨胀系数是在复合材料结构设计中必须考虑的因素。它影响到构件的尺寸稳定性和应力分布情况。直接关系到复合材料的使用性能。在工程上，常采用石英管热膨胀计测量热膨胀系数。
explanation_en: The relative change in linearity of the interlayer at each degree of temperature increase. The difference between linear expansion coefficient and volumetric expansion coefficient. The coefficient of thermcal expansion must be considered in the design of composite materials structures. It affects the dimensional stability and stress distribution of members. It is directly related to the use performance of composite materials. In engineering, quartz tube thermal expansion meters are often used to measure the thermal expansion coefficient.

explanation_cn: 固体被加热时出现的发光现象。很多固体中存在着能束缚电子或空穴的缺陷，即色心。固体中由于光照或X射线等产生的自由载流子会有相当一部分被束缚在这些色心。温度较低时，这些载流子比较稳定；升温时。它们将获得足够的能量逸出色心而造成一个空的色心。而其他载流子又会和这个色心复合而放出能量（即发光发光强度随温度的升高而逐渐增强，达到某一温度T时最强，之后由于自由载流子的能量越来越大而不易再被色心所束缚。光强又渐渐变弱。通过热致发光的测量可以确定固体中色心的势阱深度。用以研究固体中的缺陷及杂质性质。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of luminescence that occurs when a solid is heated. Many solids have defects that can bind electrons or holes, that is, color centers. A considerable part of the free carriers generated by light or X-ray in solids will be bound to these color centers. When the temperature is low, these carriers are relatively stable; When heating up. They will get enough energy to escape from the color centers and create an empty color centers. Other carriers will composition with this color centers and emit energy (that is, the luminescence luminous intensity will gradually increase with the increase of temperature, reaching the maximum at a certain temperature T. After that, due to the increasing energy of free carriers, it is not easy to be bound by the color centers. The light intensity will gradually become weaker. The potential well depth of the color centers in the solid can be determined through the measurement of thermoluminescence to study the properties of defects and impurities in the solid.

explanation_cn: 热致液晶是指基于温度变化而显现液晶相的物质，可以是单一化合物或是由多个化合物的均匀混合物。液晶单分子都有各自的溶点（mp:meltingpoint)和清亮点(cp:clearingpoint}。低于培点。温度时它是晶体结构。高于清亮点温度时则变为普通的液体。在中间温度则以液晶形态存在。在热致液晶中，基于液晶分子的排列结构不同可分为三大类：近晶相（smectic)、向列相（nematic)和胆甾相（cholesteric)。目前用于显示的液晶材料基本上都是热致液晶。
explanation_en: Thermotropic liquid crystals refers to the substance that displays liquid crystal phase based on temperature change, which can be a single compound or a uniform mixture of multiple compounds. Each liquid crystal molecule has its own melting point (mp: melting point) and clearing point (cp: clearing point}). Below the training point, it is a crystal structure at the temperature. Above the clearing point temperature, it becomes a common liquid. At the intermediate temperature, it exists in the form of liquid crystal. In thermotropic liquid crystals, based on the different arrangement structures of liquid crystal molecules, it can be divided into three categories: smectic, nematic and cholesteric. At present, liquid crystal materials used for display are basically thermotropic liquid crystals.

explanation_cn: 热致变色液通常指胆甾相液晶。此类液晶分子呈扁平状。排列成层，层白分子相互平行，分子长轴平行于层平面，不同层的分子长轴方向稍有变化，沿层的法线方向排列成螺旋状结构胆尚相液晶的螺纹距约为300mn，与可见光波长同一M级-当螺距与光的波长一致时，就产生强烈性有选择的反射。在日光下，随温度的升高，色彩按红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、靛、紫的顺序变化，温度下降又按相反顺序变色。高灵敏度的在不到rc的温差白就可显出整个色谱。利用这一效应可作金属探测仪、微电子学中热点（短路处）、检查制冷机的漏热，以及诊断疾病等。
explanation_en: Thermochromic liquid usually refers to cholesteric phase liquid crystal. This type of liquid crystal molecule is flattened. Arranged into layers, the white molecules in the layers are parallel to each other, and the long axis of the molecules is parallel to the layer plane. The direction of the long axis of the molecules in different layers is slightly changed. The thread pitch of the cholesteric phase liquid crystals arranged along the normal direction of the layers is about 300mn, which is the same as the wavelength of visible light. - When the thread pitch is the same as the wavelength of light, strong selective reflection will occur. Under sunlight, as the temperature increases, the colors change in the order of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, and purple, while as the temperature decreases, the colors change in the opposite order. High sensitivity can display the entire chromatography at a temperature difference of less than RC. This effect can be used for metal detectors, hot spots (short circuits) in microelectronics, checking heat leakage in refrigerators, and diagnosing diseases.

explanation_cn: 铸件在凝固末期由于外力或白应力或两者同时作用而产生裂纹。热裂是铸钢件、韧性铸铁件和一些轻合金铸件中常见的一种严重的铸造缺陷。其特征是裂纹表面呈现氧化现象，因而不可能通过随后的热加工焊合。热裂可分为外裂和内裂，外裂从铸件表面向白部延伸，表面裂口宽而白部窄，氧化现象严重，常从铸件弯曲处、截面厚度突变处或局部应力集中处产生，产生原因主要为收缩受阻引起较大拉应力，而连铸坯的边裂和角裂还与结晶器设计有关。内裂常出现在厚大铸件最后凝同处-氧化现象不明显-常伴有枝晶组织。
explanation_en: Cracks occur in castings at the end of solidification due to external force, white stress, or both. Hot tear is a serious casting defect in cast steel castings, malleable cast iron castings and some light alloy castings. It is characterized by oxidation on the crack surface, so it is impossible to weld through subsequent hot working. Hot tear can be divided into external cracks and internal cracks. The external cracks extend from the surface of the casting to the white part. The surface cracks are wide and the white part is narrow. The oxidation phenomenon is serious. They often occur from the bending of the casting, the abrupt change of the section thickness, or the local stress concentration. The causes are mainly due to the large tensile stress caused by the blocked shrinkage. The edge cracks and corner cracks of the continuous casting billet are also related to the mold design. Internal cracking often occurs at the final solidification point of thick and large castings - oxidation phenomenon is not obvious - often accompanied by dendritic structure.

explanation_cn: 见热化学气相沉积。
explanation_en: See thermo-chemical vapor deposition.

explanation_cn: 又称高温分解法。就是利用某种化合物在高温条件下分解，提供所需要的沉淀物蒸气进行晶体生氏的方法。它属于气相生长中的化学蒸气沉淀方法。常用于生长硅、锗的单质晶体。很少用于化合物晶体的生长-因为今反应包含单质输入物质时（除运输气体外）-要按理想配比来控1制所获得的产品就受到了很大的限制。利用热解法生长晶体先应选择适当的热解化合物。这种化合物不能过于稳定，并易于挥发，在生长区附近的条件下能够发生分解反应并生成该沉淀物，一般情况下，反应温度应低于沉积物晶体的熔点。
explanation_en: Also known as high-temperature decomposition method. It is a method of using a certain compound to decompose under high temperature conditions and provide the required precipitate vapor for crystal growth. It belongs to the chemical vapor precipitation method in growth from vapour phase. It is commonly used to grow crystal of silicon and germanium. It is seldom used for the growth of compound crystal - because when the reaction contains a single input substance (except for transport gas) - the products obtained by controlling 1 according to the ideal ratio are greatly limited. In order to grow crystal by pyrolysis method, appropriate pyrolysis compounds should be selected first. This compound cannot be too stable and easy to volatilize. It can decompose and generate this sediment under conditions near the growth zone. Generally, the reaction temperature should be lower than the melting point of the crystal of the sediment.

explanation_cn: 指具有热释电效应的复合材料热释电效应是指由于温度的变化而引起晶体表面荷电的现象。它由于晶体受热膨胀而引起正负离子相对位移，从而导致晶体的总电矩发生改变，与压电效应相类似，具有对称中心的晶体不会具有热释电效应。
explanation_en: Composite materials with pyroelectric effect pyroelectric effect refers to the phenomenon that crystal surface is charged due to the change of temperature. It causes the relative displacement of positive and negative ions due to the thermal expansion of the crystal, which leads to the change of the total electric moment of the crystal. Similar to the piezoelectric effect phase, the crystal with a symmetric center will not have the pyroelectric effect.

explanation_cn: 一些物质在温度变化时可产生暂时电压的物理现象。具有热释电效应的材料称为热电体。热释电现象早在公元前314年就被古希腊哲学家西奧弗拉斯塔（Theophrastus)所发现。苏格璧科学家大卫-布鲁斯特（DavidBrewster)于1824年为这类现象起了现在这个名称。热释电效应的物理机理如下：温度变化引起这些材料中正、负离子相对位置的少许改变。由此导致电极化状态的改变。极化状态的变化使得材料的两个极化面上产生了电压。热释电材料必须是极性晶体材料。有一个自发的电极化方向。
explanation_en: A physical phenomenon in which some substances can generate temporary voltage when temperature changes. Materials with pyroelectric effect are called thermoelectric. The phenomenon of pyroelectricity was discovered by the ancient Greek philosopher Theophrastus as early as 314 BC. Sugebi scientist David Brewster gave this phenomenon its current name in 1824. The physical mechanism of the pyroelectric effect is as follows: the temperature change causes a slight change in the relative position of positive and negative ions in these materials. This leads to a change in the polarization state. The change of polarization state causes voltage on two polarization surfaces of materials. Pyroelectric material must be polar crystalline materials. There is a spontaneous polarization direction.

explanation_cn: 具街热释电效应的材料称为热释电材料。热释电效应是具有发极化的电介质极化特随温度变化而产生自由电荷的现象。自发极化导致的电介质表面呈带电性，在热平衡状态下，将在其表面吸附等量反号的自由电荷。成为束缚电荷，显示电中性。当温度变化时，材料的极化产生变化，由于极化产生的材料表面电性不足以平衡原先的束缚电荷。表面出现自由电荷。这些自由电荷在附近空间形成电场-如果与外电路连接，则可在电路形成电流。升温和降温两种情况下，产也的电流方向相反。具有热释电特性的材料主要有上千种，但广泛应用的有十几种。主要有硫酸三甘肽，钙钛矿结构铁电氧化物如锆钛酸铅镧、铌酸锶钡、钛酸锶钡、锆钛酸铅等，以及高分子有机聚合物及复合材料聚氣乙烯、聚偏二氟乙烯、偏二氟乙烯-三氟乙烯共聚物等。热释电材料可用作红外探测器件、热摄像管等的制备。
explanation_en: Materials with street pyroelectric effect are called pyroelectric materials. Pyroelectric effect is a phenomenon that the polarization dielectric polarization produces free charge with the change of temperature. The surface of dielectric caused by spontaneous polarization is charged, and under the state of thermal equilibrium, an equal amount of anti sign free charge will be adsorbed on its surface. Becoming a bound charge, indicating electrical neutrality. When the temperature changes, the polarization of materials changes, and the electrical property of surface of materials generated by polarization is not enough to balance the original bound charge. Free charge appears on the surface. These free charges form an electric field in the nearby space - if connected to an external circuit, they can form a current in the circuit. Under both heating and cooling conditions, the direction of the current produced is opposite. There are mainly thousands of materials with pyroelectric properties, but there are more than a dozen widely used. It mainly includes triethylene sulfate, perovskite structured ferroelectric oxides such as lead lanthanum zirconate titanate, strontium barium niobate, strontium barium titanate, lead zirconate titanate, etc., as well as macromolecule organic polymer and composite materials such as polyethylene, polyvinylidene fluoride, and vinylidene fluoride trifluoroethylene copolymer. Pyroelectric material can be used for the preparation of infrared detection devices, thermography tubes, etc.

explanation_cn: 驻极体在无外电场作用下受热时。因驻极体内原先被冻结的取向偶极矩的解取向、被俘获在陷阱内的真实电尙解俘获以及电极极板:感应电荷的释放而产牛的电流。可用于表征和研究：原子极化、偶极取向极化。离子位移极化、宏观离子极化、注入电荷极化等过程和材料结构的关系。
explanation_en: When an electret is heated without an external electric field. The current generated by the disorientation of the orientation dipole moment that was originally frozen in the electret, the true electric dissociation trapped in the trap, and the release of the induced charge from the electrode plate. It can be used for characterization and research: atomic polarization, dipole orientation polarization. Relationship between materials structure and ion displacement polarization, macro ionic polarization, injected charge polarization and other processes.

explanation_cn: 通过测定驻极体升温过程中释放的电流强度随温度的变化来研究物质分子运动的方法。实质是在程序升温的条件下。测ft被极化材料释放的电流与温度的闲数艾系。操作时将材料加热至高温，并在直流高玉电场中使之极化。而后将高聚物迅速冷却至低温。移出电场。形成驻极体。升温时。驻极体中冻结的分子再次运动。释放出极化的电荷，主要设备有：程序温度控制器、直流高R电源、测量电极和微电流放大器。"
explanation_en: A method for studying the motion of material molecules by measuring the variation of the current intensity released during the heating process of an electret with temperature. Essentially, it is under the conditions of programmed heating. The idle number of current and temperature released by the polarization materials is measured. During the operation, the materials is heated to high temperature and polarization in the DC Gaoyu electric field. Then quickly cool the polymer to a low temperature. Remove the electric field. Form an electret. When heating up. The frozen molecules in the electret move again. The main equipment for releasing polarization charges are: programmable temperature controller, DC high R power supply, measuring electrode and micro current amplifier. “

explanation_cn: 反映由于温度变化而引起热释电体极化强度变化的响应关系的比例系数。实际上，几乎所有的热释电材料的热释电效应都是非线性的。Pa是温度T的函数。
explanation_en: The proportional coefficient reflecting the response relationship of polarization change of pyroelectric body caused by temperature change. In fact, the pyroelectric effect of almost all pyroelectric materials is nonlinear. Pa is a function of temperature T.

explanation_cn: 一类具有热释电性的薄膜材料。在红外探测技术上发挥着重要的作用。
explanation_en: A class of pyroelectric thin film materials. It plays an important role in infrared detection technology.

explanation_cn: 经直流场处理(极化处理）后具有宏观剩余极化的多品体：由于其剩余极化随温度而变化，从而产生表面电荷。故为热释电陶瓷。在32种晶体点群对称中，有10种对称的敁体具有自发极化。并随温度变化而产生表面电荷，称为热释电品体。热释电晶体分为：①自发极化不能随外电场而转向。如电气石和氧化锌等：②自发极化随外电场而转向。称为铁电晶体这类晶体中的大多数-以制备成多晶陶瓷体-经极化处理后具有剩余极化。并且将随温度变化而变化，像单晶体一样显现热释电效应。W此。称为热释电陶瓷。热释电陶瓷主要有钛酸钡、钛酸铅、锆钛酸铅和铌酸锶钡等。通常采用常规陶瓷:艺制备，对于要求高的用途，可采用热阳烧结丄艺-以改善材枓性能。提高机械强度。衡量材料性能的主要参数是热释电系数、介电损耗、介电常数和电附率等。热释电陶瓷主要用于制造热电探测器，这类探测器具有响应频谱宽。响应速度快、室温下工作和价格便宜等优点。目前已广泛用于防火、防盗报警器、非接触开关、气体分析、环境污染监测和激光功率检测等许多方面。近来，陶瓷红外列阵器件发展迅速。它将作为一种新的红外成像器件而在军事、医疗和工业系统中得到应用。
explanation_en: The polyhedron with macro residual polarization after DC field treatment (polarization treatment): because its residual polarization changes with temperature, surface charges are generated. Therefore, it is pyroelectric ceramics. Among 32 kinds of point group symmetries of crystal, 10 kinds of symmetrical "bodies" have spontaneous polarization. And with temperature changes, surface charges are generated, known as pyroelectric materials. Pyroelectric crystals can be divided into: ① spontaneous polarization can not be turned with the external electric field. For example, tourmaline and zinc oxide: ② spontaneous polarization turns with the external electric field. Most of these crystal, called ferroelectric crystal - to prepare polycrystal ceramics - have residual polarization after polarization treatment. And it will change with the temperature, like a single crystal, showing the pyroelectric effect. W This. It is called pyroelectric ceramics. Pyroelectric ceramics mainly include barium titanate, lead titanate, lead zirconate titanate and strontium barium niobate. Generally, conventional ceramics are prepared by technology. For the purpose with high requirements, hot positive sintering technology can be used to improve the material performance. Improve mechanical strength. The main parameters to measure the performance of materials are pyroelectric coefficient, diekctric loss, dielectric constant and electrical adhesion. Pyroelectric ceramics are mainly used to manufacture thermoelectric detectors, which have a wide response spectrum. The advantages include fast response speed, working at room temperature, and low cost. At present, it has been widely used in many aspects such as fire prevention, anti-theft alarms, non-contact switches, gas analysis, environmental pollution monitoring, and laser power detection. Recently, ceramics infrared array devices have developed rapidly. It will be applied as a new infrared imaging device in military, medical, and industrial systems.

explanation_cn: 热导率的倒数，它反映了物体阻碍热量传递的能力。
explanation_en: The reciprocal of thermal conductivity, which reflects the ability of objects to hinder heat transfer.

explanation_cn: 聚合物在单纯热的作用下发生的降解。聚合物热降解主要包括主链的断裂和侧基的消除反应。主链降解又分为链式降解（解聚）和无规降解两种（lAl降解）。
explanation_en: Degradation of polymer under the action of pure heat. Thermal degradation of polymer mainly includes fracture of main chain and elimination of side groups. Main chain degradation can be divided into chain degradation (depolymerization) and random degradation (lAl degradation).

explanation_cn: 耐火材料受激烈的温度变化或在一定温度范围白冷热交替而不致破坏的能力。检验方法有水浴法和气浴法。
explanation_en: The ability of refractory not to be damaged by intense temperature change or alternating cold and hot in a certain temperature range. The inspection methods include water bath method and air bath method.

explanation_cn: CR-39，俗称哥伦比亚 39，是由PPG公司研制的一种热固型塑料。它可以通过浇铸成型，也可以使用玻璃的研磨和抛光工艺进行加工。CR-39具有出色的可见光区域透过率，对于低于 390 nm 的紫外线有较强的截止能力。其折射率 (n) 约为 1.498，略低于一般的光学玻璃，而阿贝数 (VD = 57.8) 较高，色差较小。此外，CR-39 具有卓越的抗冲击、抗磨损和抗刮伤能力，在未经镀膜的光学塑料中属于最高水平。其密度 (ρ) 为 1.32 g/cm3。CR-39 还具有抗溶剂和抗化学品侵蚀的能力，能够承受较高的温度冲击，甚至能够抵御焊接火花引起的剧烈温度变化。目前，CR-39 是制造低折射率眼镜镜片的首选材料，也用于各种护具和防护头盔的制造。
explanation_en: CR-39, commonly known as Columbia 39, is a thermosetting plastics developed by PPG. It can be formed by casting, or processed by the grinding and polishing process of glass. CR-39 has excellent transmittance in the visible light region and strong cut-off ability for ultraviolet rays below 390 nm. Its refractive index (n) is about 1.498, slightly lower than that of ordinary optical glass, while the Abbe number (VD=57.8) is high and the color difference is small. In addition, CR-39 has excellent impact resistance, wear resistance and scratch resistance, which is the highest level among uncoated optical plastics. Its density（ ρ) 1.32 g/cm 3。 CR-39 also has the ability to resist solvent and chemical corrosion, can withstand higher temperature shocks, and even can resist the violent temperature changes caused by weld sparks. At present, CR-39 is the preferred materials for manufacturing glasses lenses with low refractive index, and is also used for manufacturing various protective devices and helmets.

explanation_cn: 烯烃化合物经过连锁聚合得到的聚合物，例如由乙烯、丙烯、1-丁烯、1-戊烯等α-烯烃以及某些环烯烃均聚反应或共聚反应得到的聚合物。
explanation_en: Polymer obtained by chain polymerization of olefin compounds, such as ethylene, propylene, 1-butene, 1-pentene, etc α- Polymer obtained by homopolymerization or copolymerization of olefins and some cycloolefins.

explanation_cn: 焊接时采用的线状或带状金属，在电弧焊过程中熔化成为焊缝填充金属，在各种熔化极电弧焊方法中焊丝还起到电极的作用。焊丝一般缠绕成盘供焊接用。
explanation_en: The linear or strip metal used in weld is melted into weld filler metal during arc welding, and welding wire also acts as an electrode in various consumable electrode arc welding methods. Generally, welding wire is wound into a reel for weld.

explanation_cn: 焊件过程中能熔化形成焰渣并对焊缝熔池起保护和冶金作用的固态颗粒状物质，主要应用于埋弧焊和电渣焊。
explanation_en: Solid granular materials that can melt and form flame slag during the welding process and play a protective and metallurgical role in the weld pool. They are mainly used in submerged arc welding and electroslag welding.

explanation_cn: 材料对焊接加工的适应性，即材料在一定焊接工艺条件下获得优质焊接接头的难易程度和焊接接头在使用条件下运行的可靠性。焊接性包括工艺焊接性和使用焊接性。工艺焊接性（fabrication weldability) 是指材料在一定焊接工艺条件下 获得优质焊接接头的能力。
explanation_en: The adaptability of materials to weld processing, that is, the difficulty of materials to obtain high-quality weld joints under certain weld process conditions and the reliability of weld joints under service conditions. Weldability includes process weldability and use weldability. Process weldability refers to the ability of materials to obtain high-quality weld joints under certain weld process conditions.

explanation_cn: 焊接时所消耗的各种材料的总称，根据功能可分为填充材料（焊料）， 如各类焊条、焊丝、焊剂；保护材料，如保护气体、 焊剂等：其他功能材料，如各类电极、强迫成型用的各类衬垫、钎焊用钎料和钎剂等。
explanation_en: The general term of various materials consumed during weld can be divided into filling materials (solder) according to their functions, such as various electrode, welding wire, and welding flux; Protective materials, such as shielding gas, welding flux, etc.: other functional materials, such as various electrodes, various gaskets for forced forming, brazing filler metal and brazing flux for soldering, etc.

explanation_cn: 由钢板或带钢卷成筒状经焊接而成的钢管。生产工艺通常包括成型、焊接和精整三个工序。根据焊接方法可分为电弧焊管、 高频或低频电阻焊管、气焊管、炉焊管等；从焊缝形式可分为直缝焊管和螺旋焊管。
explanation_en: A steel pipe made of steel plate or strip steel rolled into a cylinder and weld. The production process usually includes three processes: forming, weld and finishing. According to the weld method, it can be divided into arc welded pipe, high-frequency or low-frequency resistance welded pipe, gas welded pipe, lap welded tube, etc; It can be divided into straight seam welded pipes and spiral welded pipes in terms of weld seam form.

explanation_cn: 热力学系统中的一个状态函数。焓 (H)的定义式为：H=U+pV,即一个体系的内能 (U）与体系的体积（V)和外界拖加于体系的压强 (p)的乘积之和。焓的物理意义可以理解为，在等压可逆过程且只做体积功的特殊条件下，系统吸收的热量就等于其焓的增量。
explanation_en: A state function in a thermodynamics system. The definition formula of enthalpy (H) is: H=U+pV, that is, the sum of the product of the internal energy (U) of a system, the volume (V) of the system and the pressure (p) of the system dragged by the outside. The physical meaning of enthalpy can be understood as the heat absorbed by the system is equal to its enthalpy increment under the special condition of isobaric reversible process and only volume work.

explanation_cn: 由有机物热解生成的茶褐色、褐色或黑色的黏稠液状物质，由复杂芳香族化合物组成。
explanation_en: A dark brown, brown, or black viscous liquid substance generated by the pyrolysis of organic matter, composed of complex aromatic compounds.

explanation_cn: 炼焦物料在隔绝空气的高温炭化室内经过热解、缩聚、同化、收缩等复杂的物理化学过程而获得的固体炭质材料。按原料和用途不同可分为冶金焦、铸造焦、石油焦、沥青焦等。
explanation_en: It is a solid carbonaceous materials obtained from coking materials in a high-temperature carbonization chamber isolated from air through complex physical chemistry processes such as pyrolysis, polycondensation, assimilation and shrinkage. According to different raw materials and uses, it can be divided into metallurgical coke, cast coke, petroleum coke, pitch coke, etc.

explanation_cn: 橡胶胶料在混炼、压延或压出操作中，以及在硫化前的储存过程中出现的早期硫 化即由线型分子开始出现交联的现象。在胶浆、胶乳中表现为凝胶.也称作早期硫化。
explanation_en: The early vulcanization of rubber compounds in mixing, calendering or extrusion operations, as well as in the storage process before vulcanization, is the phenomenon of crosslinking starting from linear molecules. It is also called early vulcanization, which is manifested as gel in rubber slurry and latex.

explanation_cn: 又称硫化诱导期，胶料在加工过程中发生早期硫化所需要的时间.是衡量加工安全性的重要评价参数。由于橡胶具有热累积效应，故实际焦烧时间包括操作焦烧时间和剩余焦烧时间两部分。操作焦烧时间是指橡胶加工过程中由于热累积效应所消耗掉的焦烧时间.它取决于加工条件(如橡胶混炼、热炼、压延、压出等）和加工程度 (如混炼时间、返炼次数等）；剩余焦烧时间是指胶料 在模型中受热时保持流动性的那部分时间。焦烧时间的长短主要取决于配方中的硫化体系，尤其是促进剂的品种和用量。
explanation_en: Also called sulfurization induction period, the time required for early vulcanization of rubber during processing is an important evaluation parameter to measure processing safety. Since rubber has heat accumulation effect, the actual scorching time includes two parts: operation scorching time and remaining scorching time. Operation scorching time refers to the scorching time consumed due to the heat accumulation effect during the processing of rubber. It depends on the processing conditions (such as mixing, hot mixing, calendering, pressing out, etc. of rubber) and the processing degree (such as mixing time, number of returnings, etc.); The remaining scorching time refers to the part of time that the rubber material maintains flow ability when heated in the model. The length of scorching time mainly depends on the vulcanization system in the formula, especially the type and amount of accelerator.

name_en: barium aluminium pyrosilicate activated by europium
explanation_cn: 白色粉末，六角晶系,相对密度3.29。是一种新型碱土硅酸盐蓝色荧光粉，具有良好的发光强度、耐热温度、抗氧化性能、化学稳定性和显色性。合成方法：①化学共沉淀法。②高温固相法。
explanation_en: White powder, hexagonal system, relative density 3.29. It is a new alkaline earth silicate blue phosphor with good luminous intensity, heat resistant temperature, oxidation resistance, chemical stability and color rendering. Synthesis method: ① chemical coprecipitation method method. ② High temperature solid-phase method.

name_en: barium strontium magnesium zinc pyrosilicate activated by lead
explanation_cn: 白色粉末，三斜晶系，相对密度4.16。主要用于治疗用紫外荧光灯和诱杀昆虫的黑光灯。
explanation_en: White powder, triclinic system, relative density 4.16. Mainly used for treatment with ultraviolet fluorescent lamps and black light lamps for trapping and killing insects.

explanation_cn: 白色粉末，有毒。253.7nm紫外线激发下发出桃红色荧光。峰值波长621nm。主要用作彩色荧光灯用荧光粉。
explanation_en: White powder, toxic. It emits pink fluorescence under the excitation of 253.7 nm ultraviolet light. The peak-emission wavelength is 621nm. It is mainly used as phosphor for color fluorescent lamps.

explanation_cn: 白色粉末。在253.7nm紫外线激发下发出紫外线，其峰波长为350nm。主要用于黑光灯中。
explanation_en: White powder. Under excitation of 253.7nm ultraviolet light, ultraviolet light is emitted with a peak wavelength of 350nm. Mainly used in black light lamps.

explanation_cn: 白色粉末。要用作光化学反应的荧光灯和复印机用荧光灯的荧光粉，在临床上这种荧光灯可用来治疗小儿黄疸病。
explanation_en: White powder. The fluorescent lamp to be used for photochemical reaction and phosphor for fluorescent lamp of copier can be used to treat jaundice in children clinically.

explanation_cn: 暗色矿物较高的深色脉岩的总称。新鲜且色泽美观者可作建筑装饰材料。
explanation_en: Dark vein rock with high dark minerals. Fresh and beautiful color can be used as building decoration materials.

explanation_cn: 由远古植物遗骸埋在地层下经过炭化而形成，主要成分为超过95%碳、氢、氧及少量的氮、硫或其他元素。根据炭化程度不同分类，可依次分为泥炭、褐煤(棕褐煤、黑褐煤）、烟煤(生煤)、无烟煤。尤烟煤的炭化程度最高。煤是非常重要的能源，也是冶金、化学工业的重要原料。
explanation_en: It is formed by carbonization of ancient plant remains buried under the stratum, mainly composed of more than 95% carbon, hydrogen, oxygen and a small amount of nitrogen, sulfur or other elements. According to the degree of carbonization, it can be divided into peat, lignite (brown brown coal, black lignite), bituminous coal (raw coal), and anthracite. The carbonization degree of bituminous coal is the highest. Coal is a very important energy source and an important raw material for metallurgical and chemical industries.

explanation_cn: 见煤精。
explanation_en: See jet.

explanation_cn: 煤精，又称煤玉。具有明亮的沥青和金属光泽。黑色、致密，韧性大。有两种，一种是一种高级煤，主要成分是炭c，比一般煤轻。另一种是石化得很彻底的，主要成分不是炭，密度比较大，比煤重，雕刻加工后光泽更漂亮。存在于煤层之间。煤精可用于制作工艺美术品、雕刻工艺品和装饰品，故有的人称它为雕刻漆煤。中国主要产地是抚顺。
explanation_en: Jet, also known as coal jade. It has bright pitch and metallic luster. Black, dense, with high toughness. There are two kinds, one is a kind of high-grade coal, the main component is carbon c, which is lighter than ordinary coal. The other is completely petrified. The main component is not carbon. The density is relatively large, heavier than coal, and the luster is more beautiful after carving. It exists between coal seams. Jet can be used to make arts and crafts, carving handicrafts and decorations, so some people call it coal carving paint. The main origin of China is Fushun.

explanation_cn: 是每单位面积所接收到的光通量。
explanation_en: It is the amount of light flux received per unit area.

explanation_cn: 燃烧时产生强烈发光（可见光或红外线）效应的烟火药剂。通常压装于照明弹壳内，用于照明物体，以观察目标。
explanation_en: Pyrotechnic composition that produces strong luminescence (visible light or infrared light) effect during combustion. Usually pressed inside the illuminated cartridge case, used to illuminate objects and observe the target.

explanation_cn: 又称熔体弹性（meltelasticity).是工程上对高分子材料熔融伸长黏性(elongationalviscosity)的大约量度，表征高分子材料在熔融状态下支持自身质量的能力。其与熔融状态下的缠结度（degreeofpolymerchainentanglementatmelt),缠结度高，熔体强度就高.可以通过支链化或交联（cross-linking)来提高高分子擦体强度。一般来说，熔体强度高的产品比较适合挤出，熔体强度低的产品比较适合注塑；熔体强度和熔融指数在数值上呈相反关系，即熔体强度越高，熔融指数越低。但是否适合挤出或注塑则没有明显区分，而和工艺条件有关。熔体强度不仅和分子量（MW)和分子量分布(MWD)有关，还和分子中支链的数量和长度很大。有时候可以用熔体黏度来表征熔体强度。
explanation_en: Also known as melt elasticity, it is an approximate measurement of the melting elongation viscosity of macromolecule materials in engineering, and represents the ability of macromolecule materials to support their own quality in the melting state. Its degree of entanglement with molten state (degree of entanglement) is high, and melt strength is high. The strength of macromolecule friction body can be improved by branching or crosslinking. Generally speaking, products with high melt strength are more suitable for extrusion, and products with low melt strength are more suitable for injection molding; The melt strength and melt index are inversely related in numerical value, that is, the higher the melt strength, the lower the melt index. However, there is no clear distinction between whether it is suitable for extrusion or injection molding, and it depends on the process conditions. Melt strength is not only related to molecular weight (MW) and molecular weight distribution (MWD), but also to the number and length of branch chains in the molecule. Sometimes melt strength can be characterized by melt viscosity.

explanation_cn: 以熔块为主要助熔剂而配制烧成的瓷器。制造过程是先将石英、长石、硝石、硼砂等在高温下熔制成熔块.然后将熔块、黏土、石英等配制成泥料.再经成型、烧结等工序而制成。
explanation_en: Porcelain fired with frit as the main flux. The manufacturing process is to melt quartze, feldspar, saltpeter, borax, etc. into frits at high temperature, then prepare frits, clay, quartze, etc. into mud, and then make them through molding, sintering and other processes.

explanation_cn: 精密铸造工艺方法之一，使用蜡型时也称为失错铸造（l〇stwaxinvestmentcasting）。首先将易熔模料注入压型（模具）中制成熔模，然后熔焊成组，涂挂耐火材料和耐高温黏结剂配制的涂料.向涂料上撒耐火材料颗粒并使之硬化成壳，重复多次后可得到由多层耐火材料组成的型壳。将型壳快速加热.使模料熔化流出。而型壳经高温焙烧后，即可浇人熔融的铸造合金，凝固后即得到尺寸精确、表面质量良好的铸件。常用来生产中小型薄壁复杂铸件
explanation_en: One of the precision casting process methods, when using wax mold, is also called dislocation foundry. First, the fusible mold material is injected into the molding (mold) to make the investment mold, and then fusion welding is performed to form a group. The coatings prepared by refractory and high temperature resistant adhesive is coated. The coatings is sprayed with refractory particles and hardened into a shell. After repeated times, the mold shell consisting of multiple layers of refractory can be obtained. Quickly heat the mold shell to melt and flow out the mold material. After the shell is baked at high temperature, molten foundry alloy can be poured into the shell. After solidification, the casting with accurate size and good surface quality can be obtained. Commonly used to produce small and medium-sized thin-walled complex castings

explanation_cn: 将粉末压胚与液体金属接触或浸在液体金属内，让压坯内的空隙为金属液体所填充.冷却下来就得到致密材料或零件，这种工艺称为熔浸。熔浸过程依靠外部金属液浸湿粉末多孔体，在毛细管力作用下，液体金属沿着颗粒间空隙或颗粒内空隙流动，直到完全填充空隙位置。因此，从本质上来说.熔浸是液相烧结的一种特殊情况。所不同的只是致密化主要靠易熔成分从外面去填满空隙，而不是靠压坯本身的收缩，因此熔浸的零件基本上不产生收缩，烧结所需时间短。主要用于生产电接触材料，机械零件以及金属陶瓷材料和复合材料。
explanation_en: Contact the powder preform with the liquid metal or immerse it in the liquid metal, so that the gaps in the compact are filled by the metal liquid. After cooling down, dense materials or parts are obtained. This process is called infiltration. The infiltration process depends on the external metal liquid to wet the powder porous body. Under the action of capillary tube force, the liquid metal flows along the interspace between particles or the interspace within particles until the interspace is completely filled. Therefore, in essence, infiltration is a special case of liquid phase sintering. The difference is that densification mainly depends on the fusible components to fill the gap from the outside, rather than the shrinkage of the compact itself, so the infiltration parts basically do not shrink, and sintering takes a short time. It is mainly used to produce electrical contact materials, machine parts, cermet materials and composite materials.

explanation_cn: 用熔融浸没法制取的、包含金属元素和金属元素、金属元素和非金属元素的复合材料。熔浸法是指将液相金属和粉末坯块接触或浸在液体金属内，让坯块内空隙为金属液填充.冷却下来得到致密材料或零件的工艺。在烧结初期发生的是固相的烧结反应.中后期则发生液相的烧结反应.最终形成复合材料。例如碳化硅/铝电子熔浸复合材料.用做轻质高导热电子封装材料；同时对于铝轻质装甲材枓被应用在制备穿甲弹。
explanation_en: A composite materials made by molten immersion method, which contains metal elements and metal elements, metal elements and non-metallic elements. Infiltration refers to the process of contacting liquid metal with powder billet or immersing it in liquid metal, filling the void in the billet with liquid metal, and cooling down to obtain dense materials or parts. In the early stage of sintering, the solid phase sintering reaction occurs, and in the middle and late stage, the liquid phase sintering reaction occurs, finally forming composite materials. For example, silicon carbide/aluminum electronic infiltrated composite materials is used as light and high thermal conductivity electronic packaging materials; At the same time, aluminum lightweight armor materials are applied in the preparation of armor piercing shells.

explanation_cn: 一种材料制备方法。该方法是利用两种物质的熔点差异，使其中一种物质熔化后向另一种未熔化的物质渗透，从而发生反成生成所需要的物质。
explanation_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of materials. This method is to use the difference of melting point of two substances to make one substance melt and then penetrate into the other unmelted substance, so as to generate the required substance through reverse formation.

explanation_cn: 又称抗渣性，指无机非金属材料（如耐火材料、金属陶瓷和某些先进陶瓷材料等）抵抗熔淹侵蚀而保持原始尺寸、形状和原有性质稳定不变的能力。测定方法分为静态法和动态法，一般通过试验前后试样的体枳或质量损失等判断抗渣性能。
explanation_en: Also known as slag resistance, it refers to the ability of inorganic nonmetallic materials (such as refractory, cermet and some advanced ceramics materials) to resist molten erosion while maintaining the original size, shape and original properties. The determination methods are divided into static method and dynamic method. Generally, the slag resistance is judged by the body weight or mass loss of samples before and after the test.

explanation_cn: 见熔融温度
explanation_en: See melting temperature

explanation_cn: 用作反应堆冷却剂的熔盐。由热中子吸收截面较小的15N、O、D、C、F、ü、Be、Bi、Li、Mg以及Na组成的熔盐可用作反应堆冷却剂。与其他冷却剂相比，碱金属或碱土金属的岗化物熔盐有如下特性：可配成熔点较低，高温常压下为稳定的透明液体，用于常压冷却系统；化学惰性.通常与水、空气不反应；辐照稳定性好；传热性好：流动性好，便于泵送；能溶解多种化合物，因而可兼作慢化剂或燃料熔剂。
explanation_en: Molten salt used as reactor coolant. Molten salts composed of 15N, O, D, C, F, U, Be, Bi, Li, Mg and Na with small thermal neutron absorption cross sections can be used as reactor coolant. Compared with other coolants, the molten salts of alkali metals or alkaline earth metals have the following characteristics: they can be prepared into transparent liquid with low melting point, stable at high temperature and normal pressure, and used in atmospheric cooling systems; Chemical inertness. Usually does not react with water or air; Good irradiation stability; Good heat transfer: good flow ability, easy to pump; It can dissolve many compounds, so it can also be used as moderator or fuel flux.

explanation_cn: 见解剂法。
explanation_en: Insightful agent method.

explanation_cn: 金属材料在熔盐中发生的金属腐浊。可分为两类：一类是金属被氧化成金属离子，具有与水溶液腐蚀相同的电化学腐蚀过程，这是熔盐腐蚀的主要形式，阴、阳极间的电位差是腐蚀反应的推动力.而氧化剂的迁移速率控制着整个腐蚀的反应速度；另一类是以金属态溶解于熔盐中，不伴随氧化作用，如铅浸入氯化铅熔盐中产生的腐蚀。
explanation_en: Metal corrosion of metallic materials in molten salt. It can be divided into two types: one is that metal is oxidized into metal ions, which has the same electrochemical corrosion process as aqueous solution corrosion, which is the main form of melten salt corrosion. The potential difference between cathode and anode is the driving force of corrosion reaction. The migration rate of oxidizer controls the reaction rate of the whole corrosion; The other is dissolved in molten salt in metallic state without oxidation, such as corrosion caused by lead immersion in lead chloride molten salt.

explanation_cn: 是液相外延法的一种。是从材料的熔融状态中进行外延生长的方法。
explanation_en: It is a type of liquid phase epitaxy method. It is a method of epitaxial growth from the molten state of materials.

explanation_cn: 又称熔点。物质的晶态和液态平衡共存的温度。晶体的熔点与所受压强有关。
explanation_en: Also called melting point. The temperature at which the crystalline state and liquid equilibrium of a substance coexist. The melting point of crystal is related to the pressure.

explanation_cn: 使用能够传导碳酸根（CO3 2-)的物质作为电解质的燃料电池。工作温度在650°C左右，输出功率一般在几十千瓦到上兆瓦。根据工作温度.这类燃料电池是高温燃料电池.最适用于作为大型固定式发电站。
explanation_en: A fuel cell uses a substance capable of conducting carbonate (CO32-) as an electrolyte. The operating temperature is about 650 ° C, and the output power is generally tens of kilowatts to megawatts. According to the operating temperature, this type of fuel cell is a high-temperature fuel cell, which is most suitable for large fixed power stations.

explanation_cn: 以熔融石英(即石英玻璃)为原料制得的再结合制品.其热膨胀系数小、强度高、耐化学侵蚀（特别是酸和氯气）。但在lOOO°C以上长期使用时，晶型朝方石英转变，易使制品产生裂纹和剥落。
explanation_en: The recombined product made from molten quartze (i.e. quartze glass) has low coefficient of thermcal expansion, high strength and chemical resistance (especially acid and chlorine). However, when it is used for a long time above lOOO ° C, the crystal form will change to square quartze transformation, which is easy to crack and peel off the products.

explanation_cn: 简称MTG,一种大块单晶YBCO超导块体的制备方法。它是以氧化物粉末为原料，将其加热到一定的温度后使其熔化.并通过定向凝固诱导其沿织构方向生长，从而制备出大块的YBCO单晶。
explanation_en: It is called MTG for short. It is a method for preparing large single crystal YBCO superconducting blocks. It takes oxide powder as raw material, heats it to a certain temperature to melt it, and induces it to grow along the texture direction through directional solidification, thus preparing bulk YBCO single crystal.

explanation_cn: 在熔融状态下进行的缩聚反应。
explanation_en: Polycondensation reaction in molten state.

name_en: smelting reduction process for iron making
explanation_cn: 用煤粉、碎焦将高温熔融的铁氧化物（铁矿石、精矿粉）还原熔炼成液态生铁的非高炉炼铁法。不使用焦炭，铁矿粉也无需造块（烧结为球团）.故具有工艺流程短、建设资金少、生产成本低、效率高、对原料燃料适应性强、环境污染小、工艺过程可控制性好等优点，生产的铁水可直接用于转炉炼钢，适应于中小型工厂生产。熔融还原炼铁按工艺过程可分为一步法和二步法。目前已开发了多种熔融还原炼铁工艺，如Corex法、Hismelt法等。
explanation_en: Non blast furnace ironmaking ironmaking process in which high-temperature molten iron oxide (iron ore, concentrate powder) is reduced to liquid pig iron by pulverized coal and crushed coke for melting. Coke is not used, and iron ore powder does not need to be agglomerated (sintering is pelletizing). Therefore, it has the advantages of short process flow, low construction capital, low production cost, high efficiency, strong adaptability to raw materials and fuels, small environmental pollution, and good process controllability. The produced molten iron can be directly used for converter sleelmaking, and is suitable for production in small and medium-sized factories. According to the technological process, smelting reduction process for iron making can be divided into one-step process and two-step process. At present, many smelting reduction process for iron making ironmaking processes have been developed, such as Corex process, Hismelt process, etc.

explanation_cn: 能以熔融态进行铸装的混合炸药。能适应各种形状药室的装药，综合性能较好。熔铸混合炸药的组分至少应有一个是易熔炸药。
explanation_en: Composite explosive that can be cast in molten state. It can adapt to the charging of various shapes of drug chambers and has good overall performance. At least one component of cast composite explosive shall be fusible explosive.

explanation_cn: 用熔融法将混合原料高温熔化后浇铸得到的耐火制品。又称电熔砖。熔铸砖的抗渣、抗玻璃液的侵蚀性强。主要使用在玻璃熔窑中的熔化池等冲刷、侵蚀最严重的部位。
explanation_en: Refractory products obtained by casting after melting the mixed raw materials at high temperature by melting method. Also known as electric fused bricks. The fused cast brick has strong resistance to slag and corrosion of liquid glass. It is mainly used in the melting pool in the glass furnace and other parts with the most serious erosion.

explanation_cn: 经高温熔化后直接浇铸，冷却后制成的耐火材料。一般在电弧炉内熔化，然后浇铸到高温模具中，经冷却结晶。
explanation_en: The refractory is made by directly casting after high temperature melting and cooling. Generally, it is melted in the electric arc furnace, and then casting into the high-temperature mold for cooling and crystallization.

explanation_cn: 结品高分子自熔融开始至熔融结束的温度范围。
explanation_en: The temperature range of the resultant macromolecule from the beginning of melting to the end of melting.

explanation_cn: 以石灰石和黏土为主要原料.按适当比例配制成生料，烧至部分或全部熔融.并经冷却而获得的半成品，称为水泥熟料。
explanation_en: The semi-finished products obtained by taking limestone and clay as the main raw materials, preparing raw meal in proper proportion, burning to partial or full melting, and cooling are called cement clinker.

explanation_cn: 晶体呈显微针状.也呈块状.无色或白色.条痕呈白色。似玻璃光泽，但不透明。其凝结速度快、有微膨胀性、孔隙率大，且可塑性和抗火性好，可用作磨光粉、纸张填充物、气体干燥剂以及医疗上的石膏绷带，也用于冶金和农业等方面。
explanation_en: The crystal is in the form of microscopic needle, block, colorless or white, and streak is white. It looks like glass, but it is opaque. It has fast setting speed, slight expansion, large porosity, good plasticity and fire resistance, and can be used as polishing powder, paper filler, gas desiccant, medical gypsum bandage, metallurgy and agriculture.

explanation_cn: 又称软铁、锻铁。碳含量低于0.0218%,并含有少量弥散硅酸盐渣的铁。熟铁由铁矿石用碳直接还原，或由生铁经过熔化并将杂质氧化而生产。前者冶炼温度较低.后者温度虽然较高，但生铁去碳后由于熔点增高而使铁液变稠；两者都不易使渣和铁完全分离.所以熟铁中常含有少量的渣.经乳制后渣沿轧制方向成纤维状或层状.故轧向的力学性能远远高于横向.相差可达20%以上。熟铁塑性、钿性高，易加r变形，强度较低熟铁通常制成薄板、棒材和线材等.可以锻接或熔接。用于制造铆钉、支撑螺拴、水管、油箱、链条及锻件等。含锰熟铁含有约1%锰.具有较高的抗冲击强度。普通含渣熟铁常有炉渣裂纹.为此需对硅酸盐含量加以控制.并按其含量划分质量等级1
explanation_en: It is also called soft iron and wrought iron. Iron with carbon content less than 0.0218% and a small amount of dispersed silicate slag. Wrought iron is produced by direct reduction of iron ore with carbon, or by melting pig iron and oxidizing impurities. The former has a lower smelting temperature, while the latter has a higher temperature, but after decarburization of pig iron, the liquid iron thickens due to the increase of melting point; Both of them are not easy to separate slag and iron completely. Therefore, wrought iron often contains a small amount of slag. After being milked, slag becomes fibrous or layered along the rolling direction. Therefore, the mechanical properties in the rolling direction are far higher than those in the transverse direction, with a difference of more than 20%. Wrought iron has high plasticity and tin oxide, easy to deform with r, and low strength. wrought iron is usually made into thin plates, bar, wire rod, etc. It can be forged or welded. Used for manufacturing rivets, support bolts, water pipes, oil tanks, chains, and forgings. Manganese wrought iron contains about 1% manganese and has high impact strength. Ordinary slag containing wrought iron often has slag cracks. Therefore, it is necessary to control the silicate content and divide the quality grade according to its content 1

explanation_cn: 热力学系统的一个状态函数，表示体系状态的混乱和无序程度。通常用符号S表示。
explanation_en: A state function of a thermodynamics system, which indicates the degree of chaos and disorder of the system state. Usually represented by the symbol S.

explanation_cn: 由于高分子链的热运动，链段在小范围内可绕某链轴作旋转运动，使构象发生变化。分子链愈卷曲，则可能的构象数目愈多，体系的熵愈大；反之.链愈伸直，则可能的构象数目愈少，体系的熵也愈小。理想高弹体拉伸时只引起熵变，形变时回缩力也主要由物化中的熵增原理引起，这种弹性为熵弹性。其特征是当温度升高时，热运动增加.因而弹性增大。因此，高弹性的本质是一种熵弹性。
explanation_en: Due to the thermal movement of the macromolecule chain, the chain segment can rotate around a chain axis in a small range, which changes the conformation. The more curly the molecular chain, the more possible conformations, and the greater the entropy of the system; On the contrary, the more straight the chain is, the fewer possible conformations and the smaller the entropy of the system. The ideal elastomer only causes entropy change when it is stretched, and the retraction force when it is deformed is also mainly caused by the principle of entropy increase in physico-chemical process. This elasticity is entropy elasticity. Its characteristic is that when the temperature rises, the thermal movement increases, so the elasticity increases. Therefore, the essence of high elasticity is a entropy elasticity.

explanation_cn: 泛指反应堆白具有独立结构的燃料使用单元。包括从单一的圆柱状短棒到结构复杂的大组件。通常指由燃料芯体和包壳组成的燃料单元，如燃料棒、燃料板和燃料球。
explanation_en: Refers to the fuel usage unit of a reactor that has an independent structure. Including from a single cylindrical short rod to large components with complex structures. Usually refers to a fuel unit composed of a fuel core and cladding, such as a fuel rod, fuel plate, and fuel ball.

explanation_cn: 电堆的燃料利用率是在电堆中参与反应的燃料量占进入电堆的燃料量的百分比。没有被利用的燃料主要是随电堆阳极尾气排出且没有被有效利用的燃料，一般占燃料总量的5%左右。燃料电池系统的燃料利用率是产生有效电能和热能的燃料量占进入燃料电池系统燃料总量的百分比。没有被利用的燃料主要是在燃料重整过程中没被有效利用的燃料、在选择性氧化器中被氧气消耗掉的燃料和随电堆阳极尾气排出且没有被有效利用的燃料，一般超过燃料总量的10%。
explanation_en: The fuel utilization of the stack is the percentage of the amount of fuel participating in the reaction in the stack to the amount of fuel entering the stack. The unutilized fuel is mainly the fuel discharged with the anode tail gas of the stack and not effectively used, which generally accounts for about 5% of the total fuel. The fuel utilization of the fuel cell system is the percentage of the amount of fuel generating effective electric energy and heat energy in the total amount of fuel entering the fuel cell system. The unutilized fuel is mainly the fuel that is not effectively used in the fuel reforming process, the fuel that is consumed by oxygen in the selective oxidizer, and the fuel that is discharged with the anode tail gas of the stack and is not effectively used, generally more than 10% of the total fuel.

explanation_cn: 包覆和封闭核燃料的外壳。用以保护核燃料（芯体或芯块）不受化学性质活泼的环境影响，包容核燃料和裂变产生的放射性产物，提供结构支撑。燃料包壳是燃料元件的主要组成部分之一。燃料包壳材料应具有如下性能：①热中子吸收截面小（限于热堆）。感生放射性小：②在冷却剂中有良好的耐蚀性；③与核燃料相容性好；④热导率高；⑤有足够的强度和塑性；⑥辐射损伤小；⑦易加工；⑧易于后处理；⑨价格便宜等。燃料元件通常选用铝及铝合金、镁及镁合金、锆及锆合金和不锈钢等作燃料包壳材料，，燃料包壳表面工作温度低于200°C的研究试验堆，一般采用铝及铝合金作包壳，包壳与核燃料采用中间层（如镍层）达到冶金结合；镁诺斯（Magnox)型堆采用镁合金作燃料包壳，表面工作温度450-500°C，包壳与核燃料一般采用机械结合的形式。为强化放热。采用肋化的燃料包壳表面；水冷动力堆一般采用锆-2或锆-4合金作燃料包壳。包壳与核燃料之间充一定压力的氦气；快中子增殖堆采用不锈钢作包壳；高温气冷堆采用热解碳和热解碳化硅复合包覆层。
explanation_en: Encapsulates and seals the outer shell of nuclear fuel. It is used to protect nuclear fuel (core or pellet) from the impact of environment with active chemical properties, contain nuclear fuel and radioactive products generated by fission, and provide structural support. Fuel cladding is one of the main components of fuel element. The fuel cladding materials shall have the following properties: ① Small thermal neutron absorption cross section (limited to thermal reactor). Low induced radioactivity: ② Good corrosion resistance in the coolant; ③ Good compatibility with nuclear fuel; ④ High thermal conductivity; ⑤ Having sufficient strength and plasticity; ⑥ Irmdiatiem damage is small; ⑦ Easy to process; ⑧ Easy for post-processing; ⑨ Cheap prices, etc. The fuel element usually uses aluminum and aluminum alloy, magnesium and magnesium alloy, zirconium and zirconium alloy, stainless steel, etc. as the materials of fuel cladding, and the research and test reactor with fuel cladding surface working temperature lower than 200 ° C generally uses aluminum and aluminum alloy as the cladding, and the cladding and nuclear fuel use an intermediate layer (such as nickel layer) to achieve metallurgical bonding; Magnox type reactor uses magnesium alloy as fuel cladding, and the surface working temperature is 450-500 ° C. The cladding and nuclear fuel are generally mechanically combined. To enhance heat release. Ribbed fuel cladding surface; Water cooled power reactors generally use Zirconium-2 or zircaloy-4 as fuel cladding. Fill helium with certain pressure between cladding and nuclear fuel; The fast breeder reactor uses stainless steel as the cladding; High temperature gas cooled reactor (HTGR) uses pyrolytic carbon and pyrolytic silicon carbide composition cladding layer.

explanation_cn: 燃料的供应量小于与产生的电流所对应的燃料量叫作燃料匮乏。燃料匮乏可能发生在整个阳极表面上，也可能发生在阳极的局部。当燃料匮乏发生时，阳极中的其他物质（如催化剂载体、催化剂本身、微孔扩散层）。甚至阳极侧的气体扩散层和极板都不得不参与反应，这样，阳极在几秒钟就会被损坏。
explanation_en: The fuel supply less than the fuel quantity corresponding to the generated current is called fuel starvation. Fuel starvation may occur on the whole anode surface or on the local anode. When fuel starvation occurs, other substances in the anode (such as catalyst support, catalyst itself, microporous diffusion layer). Even the gas diffusion medium and plate on the anode side have to participate in the reaction, so the anode will be damaged in a few seconds.

explanation_cn: 燃料芯体和包壳材料在工作条件下不发生物理、化学作用的特性。在元件设计中，一般要求燃料芯体和包壳材料之间不能发生剧烈的物理化学反应；相互之间原子扩散渗透系数越低越好；在结合型元件的燃料与包壳的界面处要求不产生脆性疏松的化合物；在给定的温度场中，燃料和包壳的膨胀量基本保持一致，两种材料的膨胀系数差异要适当限制。相容性直接关系到燃料元件的使用寿命和使用过程中的安全可靠性，在燃料设计、材料选择时要给予足够的重视，是反应堆运行温度的限制因素之一。
explanation_en: The fuel core and cladding materials do not have the characteristics of physical and chemical actions under working conditions. In the element design, it is generally required that no violent physical chemistry reaction should occur between the fuel core and the cladding materials; The lower the atomic diffusion permeability coefficient, the better; Brittle porosity compounds shall not be produced at the interface between fuel and cladding of bonded elements; In a given temperature field, the expansion amount of fuel and cladding basically keep the same, and the difference of expansion coefficient between the two materials should be appropriately limited. Compatibility is directly related to the service life of fuel element and the safety and reliability in the use process. Adequate attention should be paid to fuel design and materials selection, which is one of the limiting factors of reactor operating temperature.

explanation_cn: 一种把化学能直接转换为电能的电化学能董转换装置。其所用燃料由储罐储存于电化学反应器的外部。燃料电池有如下几个特点：①化学能到电能的转换一次完成：②能量转换是通过电化学过程而非燃烧过程完成的；③反应物储存在反应器的外部；④它是能量转换装置而非能量储存装置。
explanation_en: An electrochemical energy conversion device that directly converts chemical energy into electrical energy. The fuel used is stored in a storage tank outside the electrochemical reactor. The fuel cell has the following characteristics: ① the conversion from chemical energy to electric energy is completed at one time; ② the energy conversion is completed through the electrochemical process rather than the combustion process; ③ The reactants are stored outside the reactor; ④ It is an energy conversion device rather than an energy storage device.

explanation_cn: 与透过电解质隔膜的燃料量相对应的电流。
explanation_en: The current corresponding to the amount of fuel passing through the elonrolyte separator.

explanation_cn: 由一组燃料棒或燃料板按一定排列方式组装起来的几何构件。装卸、使用和运输时均无需拆开。在压水堆中，燃料组件通常由14X14到17X17的捆绑在一起的燃料棒组成，燃料组件长约4m。在沸水堆燃料组件中，每个组件中有91、92或96根燃料棒。
explanation_en: A geometric component assembled in a certain arrangement by a group of fuel rods or fuel plates. There is no need to disassemble during loading, unloading, use, and transportation. In PWR, fuel assembly is usually composed of 14X14 to 17X17 fuel rods bundled together, and fuel assembly is about 4m long. In BWR fuel assembly, there are 91, 92 or 96 fuel rods in each assembly.

explanation_cn: 叠装成燃料棒芯体的圆柱状小块》直径5-10mm，高度与直径比一般为1-1.5，有实心和空心两种。燃料芯块的表面必须机械磨光，以保证与包壳材料的配合。为适应燃料芯块的辐照肿胀，芯块的上下面压制成凹碟形。
explanation_en: A cylindrical small piece stacked into the core of a fuel rod, with a diameter of 5-10mm and a height to diameter ratio of 1-1.5, can be either solid or hollow. The surface of the fuel pellet must be mechanically polished to ensure the fit with the cladding materials. In order to adapt to the irradiation swelling of fuel pellet, the upper and lower parts of the pellet are pressing into a concave dish shape.

explanation_cn: 通过化学反应把碳氢化合物变成富氢气体混合物的过程。常用的方法包括部分氧化、水蒸气重整、热平衡重整和高温裂解重整。
explanation_en: The process of converting hydrocarbons into hydrogen rich gas mixtures through chemical reactions. Common methods include partial oxidation, steam reforming, autothermal reforming and thermal reforming.

explanation_cn: 物质进行剧烈的氧化还原反应，伴随发热和发光现象。通常所称的燃烧是指某些物质（如柴，炭、煤、油等）与空气中的氧气化合引起的剧烈氧化还原反应现象。火药含有足够的氧化剂。燃烧时不需要空气或外加的氧化剂。它的燃烧过程是一个复杂的物理化学过程。火药表面受到点火作用的加热，开始分解、气化。气化后的产物在气相中继续进行化学反应。直到生成最后的燃烧产物。并将火药中储存的化学能释放出来》整个燃烧过程依靠其本身的作用得以稳定进行。同时还有高温气相向固相表面的传热、分解物质和燃烧产物离开火药表面向外流动和相互扩散形成的质量传递的"传质过程"。这一系列过程在高温高压下进行，反应速度很快。且在：比较窄的燃烧反应区白完成。已有的各种燃烧理论是极其复杂的燃烧过程假设简化。加以理想化。尽管所得结果不精确-只能定性地解释一些现象和趋势，但仍借以理解火药燃烧的本质，指导对火药燃速进行。调节和火药配方的设计。火药的燃烧按照反应程度分为完全燃烧和不完全燃烧：根据燃烧的稳定性分为稳态燃烧和非稳态燃烧-非稳态燃烧包括振荡燃烧，燃烧转爆轰等。
explanation_en: The substance undergoes intense redox reaction, accompanied by heating and luminescence. Generally, the so-called combustion refers to the violent oxidation-reduction reaction caused by the combination of certain substances (such as firewood, carbon, coal, oil, etc.) and oxygen in the air. Propellant contains enough oxidizer. No air or additional oxidizer is required for combustion. Its combustion process is a complex physical chemistry process. The surface of propellant is heated by ignition and begins to decompose and gasify. The products after gasification continue to undergo chemical reactions in the gas phase. Until the final combustion product is generated. And release the chemical energy stored in propellant: The whole combustion process can be carried out stably by its own role. At the same time, there is also the "mass transfer process" of heat transfer from high-temperature gas phase to solid phase surface, decomposition substances and combustion products flowing outward from propellant surface and forming mutual diffusion. This series of processes is carried out under high temperature and pressure, and the reaction speed is very fast. And it is completed in the relatively narrow combustion reaction zone. The existing combustion theories are very complicated assumptions and simplifications of combustion process. Idealize it. Although the results obtained are not accurate - they can only qualitatively explain some phenomena and trends, they can still be used to understand the essence of propellant combustion and guide the burning rate of propellant. Adjustment and design of propellant formula. Combustion of propellant can be divided into complete combustion and incomplete combustion according to the degree of reaction: according to the stability of combustion, it can be divided into steady combustion and unsteady combustion - unsteady combustion, including oscillating combustion, combustion to detonation, etc.

explanation_cn: 推进剂的线性燃速定义为单位时间白沿燃烧表面的法线方向上推进剂消失的距离。其质量燃速定义为单位时间、单位面积上推进剂间相消失的质ft，推进剂的能量释放速度由其形状(燃烧面积）和燃烧速度所控制，故燃速是推进剂的重要性能指标之一。
explanation_en: The linear burning rate of propellant is defined as the distance that the propellant disappears along the normal direction of combustion surface per unit time. Its mass burning rate is defined as the mass ft with phase disappearing between propellants per unit time and per unit area. The energy release rate of propellant is controlled by its shape (combustion area) and combustion speed, so burning rate is one of the important performance indicators of propellant.

explanation_cn: 用于固体推进剂中可加速或减慢推进剂的燃烧过程的物质。加速燃烧过程的称为增速催化剂。减慢燃烧过程的称为降速催化剂。燃速催化剂的种类很多，在一定的压力范围白有其最佳的燃烧催化剂。每一种催化剂都有其合适加入量的范围。常用的燃烧催化剂有以下四种：无机金属化合物，如PbO、QiO、Mgü、Ti02、Co203、PbCO、亚铅酸铜（氧化铜和氧化铅的混合物）等；有机金属化合物。如苯二甲酸铅、水杨酸铅、鞣酸铅、己二酸铜等；二茂铁及其衍生物。如正丁基二茂铁（NBF)和叔丁基二茂铁(TBF);碳硼烷及其衍生物，如正己基碳硼烷(MHC)、正丁基碳硼烷（NBC)等。
explanation_en: A substance used in solid propellant to accelerate or slow down the combustion process of propellant. Accelerating the combustion process is called speed increasing catalyst. The catalyst that slows down the combustion process is called speed reduction catalyst. There are many kinds of burning rate catalyst, and the best combustion catalyst is available within a certain pressure range. Each catalyst has its appropriate dosage range. There are four kinds of commonly used combustion catalysts: inorganic metal compounds, such as PbO, QiO, Mg ü, Ti02, Co203, PbCO, copper lead oxide (a mixture of copper oxide and lead oxide), etc; Organic metal compounds. Such as lead benzoate, lead salicylate, lead tannate, copper adipate, etc; Ferrocene and its derivatives. Such as n-butyl ferrocene (NBF) and tert butyl ferrocene (TBF); Carboboranes and their derivatives, such as n-hexylcarboboranes (MHC), n-butyl carboboranes (NBC), etc.

explanation_cn: 描述固体火箭发动机内推进剂燃速与压力关 系的参数。
explanation_en: Parameters describing the relationship between propellant burning rate and pressure in solid rocket motors.

name_en: temperature sensitivity coefficient of burning rate
explanation_cn: 温度越高，推进剂的燃速越大，所以，可用燃速温度敏感系数表征推进剂初温的变化对燃速的影响。燃速温度敏感系数的定义为：在一定压力条件下，某一初温范围白推进剂温度变化1K所引起的燃速相对变化量。燃速压力(压强)指数描述固体火箭发动机白推进剂燃速与压力关系的参数。
explanation_en: The higher the temperature is, the greater the burning rate of the propellant is. Therefore, the temperature sensitivity coefficient of burning rate can be used to characterize the effect of the change of the initial temperature of the propellant on the burning rate. The temperature sensitivity coefficient of burning rate is defined as the relative change of burning rate caused by the temperature change of 1K of white propellant in an initial temperature range under certain pressure conditions. Burning rate pressure (pressure) index is a parameter describing the relationship between burning rate and pressure of white propellant in solid rocket motor.

explanation_cn: 俗称火石，是比较常见的硅质岩石，燧石质密、坚硬，多为灰、黑色，敲碎后具有贝壳状断口。
explanation_en: Commonly known as flim, it is a common siliceous rock. flint is dense, hard, mostly gray and black, and has a shell shaped fracture after being broken.

explanation_cn: 又称魅石，俗称火石,一种具贝壳状断口、致密坚硬的隐晶质或显微晶质的硅质岩石。主要由玉髓和自生的微粒石英或蛋白石组成，还常见黏土矿物、碳酸盐类、有机质等混人物，也可有少量的硅质生物碎屑。具贝壳状或瓷状断口，颜色以灰色、灰黑色、黑色为常见，也有黄白色、黄色、褐红等。按产状可分为层状燧石岩和结核状燧石岩。可用作研磨材料，如油石和细工磨石等。色彩美观者可作为宝玉石。也可作为工业用硅质原料。
explanation_en: It is also called charm stone, commonly known as flim, a dense and hard cryptocrystalline or microcrystalline siliceous rock with shell like fracture. It is mainly composed of chalcedony and authigenic granular quartze or opal, and is also commonly mixed with clay mineral, carbonates, organic matter and a small amount of siliceous bioclasts. There are shell like or porcelain like fractures, with common colors such as gray, grayish black, and black, as well as yellow white, yellow, and maroon. According to occurrence, it can be divided into layered chert rock and nodular chert rock. It can be used as grinding materials, such as oilstone and fine grinding stone. Those with beautiful colors can be used as gemstones. It can also be used as a siliceous raw material for industrial use.

explanation_cn: 火药或炸药在一定试验条件下爆发时的最低温度。是检验火药或炸药化学安定性和热感度的指标之一。测量爆发点的方法有等速升温法和恒温法。爆发点的数值随测试方法不同而异。等速升温法是：以一定量的火药放入具有一定升温程序的加热浴中升温到爆炸（爆燃发光或发声）时，测定热浴介质温度，取两个平行试样试验结果的最低值为爆发点。恒温法是在几个不同的恒温点下测定爆发延滞期。
explanation_en: The lowest temperature at which propellant or explosive bursts under certain test conditions. It is one of the indicators for testing the chemical stability and thermal sensitivity of propellant or explosive. The methods for measuring the explosion tcmperature are constant rate heating method and constant temperature method. The value of explosion tcmperature varies with different test methods. Constant rate temperature rise method: when a certain amount of propellant is put into a heating bath with a certain temperature rise program to raise the temperature to explosion (deflagration luminescence or sound), measure the temperature of the heat bath medium, and take the lowest value of the test results of two parallel samples as the explosion tcmperature. The constant temperature method is used to measure the explosive delay period at several different constant temperature points.

explanation_cn: 爆发点是指在一定测试条件下，火药剂被加热并发生爆炸时所需加热介质的最低温度，是评定火工药剂热感度的参数之一。爆发点采用爆发点测定装置进行测定。
explanation_en: Explosion tcmperature refers to the lowest temperature of the heating medium required for the propellant to be heated and explosion under certain test conditions. It is one of the parameters for evaluating the thermal sensitivity of initiating explosives and relative compositions. The explosion tcmperature is measured by the explosion tcmperature measuring device.

explanation_cn: 物质的一种非常急剧的物理化学变化，一种在限制状态下系统潜能突然释放并转化为动能而对周围介质发生作用的过程。分为物理爆炸和化学爆炸。炸药的爆炸属于化学爆炸是在外界激发能作用下引起的、放出大量热能并形成大量气体的高速化学反应。反应的放热性、快速性和反应生成大量气体产物是决定化学爆炸变化的个重要因素。
explanation_en: A very rapid physical chemistry change of matter, a process in which the system potential is suddenly released and converted into kinetic energy under a limited state to act on the surrounding medium. It is divided into physical explosion and chemical explosion. The explosion of explosive belongs to chemical explosion, which is a high-speed chemical reaction caused by the action of external excitation energy, releasing a lot of heat energy and forming a lot of gas. The exothermic and rapid reaction and the formation of a large number of gas products are important factors that determine the change of chemical explosion.

explanation_cn: 爆炸喷涂是在特殊设计的燃烧室里，将氧气和乙炔气按一定的比例混合后引爆，使料粉加热熔融并使颗粒高速撞击在零件表面形成涂层的方法。
explanation_en: Detonmion spraying is a method of mixing oxygen and acetylene in a certain proportion in a specially designed combustion chamber and detonating them to heat and melt the powder and make particles hit the surface of parts at a high speed to form coatings.

explanation_cn: 用炸药产生的能量固结粉末的一种粉末致密化方法。冲击波能量通过粉末间的摩擦、绝热剪切、塑性变形、绝热压缩等转变为热能，使材料产生大的温升。根据爆炸固结加载方式的不同可以分为平面加载和柱面加载两种方式。
explanation_en: A method of densification of powder by consolidating powder with energy generated by explosive. Shock wave energy is transformed into heat energy through friction between powder, adiabatic shearing, plastic deformation, adiabatic compression and other transformation, resulting in a large temperature rise of materials. According to the different loading modes of explosive consolidation, it can be divided into plane loading and cylinder loading.

explanation_cn: 可燃物质（可燃气体、蒸气和粉尘）与空气（或氧气）必须在一定的浓度范围内均匀混合，形成预混气，遇着火源才会发生爆炸，这个浓度范围称为爆炸极限，或爆炸浓度极限。可燃性混合物的爆炸极限有爆炸（着火）下限和爆炸（着火）上限之分：分别称为爆炸下限和爆炸上限。上限指的是可燃性混合物能够发生爆炸的高浓度。在高于爆炸上限时，空气不足，导致火焰不能蔓延，既不爆炸，也不着火。下限指的是可燃性混合物能够发生爆炸的低浓度。由于可燃物浓度不够，过量空气的冷却作用，阻止了火焰的蔓延，因此在低于爆炸下限时不爆炸也不着火。在日常生活和化工生产中，为了降低爆炸浓度极限，可以加入惰性气体或其他不易燃的气体来降低浓度或者在排放气体前，或者以涤气器、吸附法来清除可爆的气体。。
explanation_en: Combustible substances (combustible gas, vapor and dust) and air (or oxygen) must be evenly mixed within a certain concentration range to form a premixed gas. explosion will occur only when they meet the fire source. This concentration range is called explosion limit, or explosion concentration limit. The explosion limit of flammability mixture can be divided into explosion (fire) lower limit and explosion (fire) upper limit: explosion lower limit and explosion upper limit respectively. The upper limit refers to the high concentration of flammability mixture that can cause explosion. When it is higher than the upper limit of explosion, the air is insufficient, so the flame cannot spread, neither explosion nor fire. The lower limit refers to the low concentration of flammability mixture that can cause explosion. Due to the insufficient concentration of combustibles and the cooling effect of excess air, the spread of flame is prevented. Therefore, when it is lower than the lower limit of explosion, neither explosion nor fire occurs. In daily life and chemical production, in order to reduce the explosion concentration limit, inert gas or other nonflammable gas can be added to reduce the concentration, or the explosive gas can be removed by scrubber and adsorption before the gas is discharged..

explanation_cn: 又称激波固结或激波压实，陶瓷粉末在由炸药爆炸产生的高温高压冲击波作用下瞬态发生烧结或合成的一种技术。利用可控爆炸作为加热、加压手段的烧结技术。
explanation_en: Also known as shock wave consolidation or shock wave compaction, ceramics powder is a technology of transient sintering or synthesis under the action of high-temperature and high-pressure shock wave generated by explosive explosion. Sintering technology using controllable explosion as heating and pressurizing means.

explanation_cn: 爆炸焊是指利用炸药爆炸产生的冲击力造成工件迅速碰撞而实现焊接的方法。爆炸焊是以炸药为能源，进行金属间的焊接方法。这种焊接是利用炸药爆炸时的冲击波，使金属受到高速撞击，在十分短暂的冶金过程中相结合。
explanation_en: Explosive welding is a method to realize weld by using the impact force generated by explosive explosion to cause rapid collision of workpiece. Explosive welding is a weld method between metals using explosive as energy. This kind of weld uses the shock wave of explosive explosion to make the metal be impacted at high speed and combine in a very short metallurgical process.

explanation_cn: 爆热亦称爆炸热。1mol爆炸物爆炸时放出的热量。爆热是爆炸物产生巨大破坏、抛掷和粉碎功的能源，它与爆炸物的爆速、爆压等数据密切相关。因为爆炸变化极为迅速，可以看作是在定容下进行的，因此一般用Qv来表示。如果发生爆轰，爆轰过程的爆热是指爆轰波中C-J面上所放出的能量，它完全传递给爆轰波的稳定传播；爆破热则是在爆轰波中进行的一次化学反应的热效应的总和，它与爆炸物的作功能力有着密切关系。
explanation_en: Explosion heat is also called explosion heat. The heat released when 1mol explosion explosion. Explosion heat is the energy source for explosion to produce huge damage, throwing and crushing work, which is closely related to the data of explosion such as detonation velocity and detonation pressure. Because explosion changes very quickly, it can be regarded as being carried out under constant volume, so it is generally expressed in Qv. If detonation occurs, the explosion heat in the detonation process refers to the energy released on the C-J plane in the detonation wave, which is completely transferred to the stable propagation of the detonation wave; Explosion heat is the sum of the thermal effects of a chemical reaction carried out in a detonation wave, which is closely related to the work capacity of the explosive.

explanation_cn: 爆破强度，是对一定规格的片状或管状聚合物材料进行爆破试验时，连续通过液体或空气施加压力，测得试样突然破裂时的最大压力。
explanation_en: Burst strength refers to the maximum pressure measured when a specimen suddenly breaks by continuously applying pressure through liquid or air during the burst test of a certain specification of sheet or tubular polymer materials.

explanation_cn: 带有化学反应的间断面（或冲击波）以大于物料中的声速沿爆炸物传播的流体动力学过程。冲击波传人爆炸物内，受压缩的薄层爆炸物内产生高速化学反应，释放大量热能支持冲击波继续传播。这种带有高速化学反应的冲击波称为爆轰波。爆轰波通过后，原来的爆炸产物变成高温、高压、高能量密度的气体爆轰产物，急剧膨胀，对周围物体产生压缩、抛掷或其他破坏作用。
explanation_en: The hydrodynamic process in which a discontinuity (or shock wave) with chemical reactions propagates along an explosive at a speed greater than that of sound in the material. The shock wave is transmitted into the explosion, and a high-speed chemical reaction is generated in the compressed thin layer of explosion, releasing a large amount of heat energy to support the continuous propagation of the shock wave. This type of shock wave with high-speed chemical reactions is called a detonation wave. After the detonation wave passes through, the original explosion product becomes a gas detonation product with high temperature, high pressure and high energy density, which expands rapidly and compresses, throws or destroys the surrounding objects.

explanation_cn: 在较短时间内药物快速释放的现象。通常不希望药物释放系统在起始释药期有爆释行为。但为达到特定的目的，某些药物释放体系在特定阶段的爆释是需要的，例如：膜包衣定时爆释系统利用膜内崩解物质崩解而胀破膜的吋间来控制药物的释放时间；某些智能肿瘤靶向药物传递系统在到达肿瘤组织后，利用肿瘤组织的酸性较正常组织高的特点发生化学反应，导致体系崩解而快速释放出药物。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of rapid drug release in a relatively short period of time. Generally, the drug release system is not expected to have burst release behavior during the initial release period. However, in order to achieve a specific purpose, burst release of some drug release systems at a specific stage is required, for example, the membrane coating timing burst release system controls the drug release time by using the time when the disintegrating substances in the membrane collapse and burst the membrane; Some intelligent tumor targeting drug delivery system take advantage of the fact that the tumor tissue is more acidic than the normal tissue to produce chemical reactions after reaching the tumor tissue, leading to the disintegration of the system and rapid release of drugs.

explanation_cn: 为了解释固体比热容计算而引人的一个物理量。
explanation_en: A physical quantity introduced to explain the calculation of specific heat [capacity of solids.

explanation_cn: -种具有明显片状构造的变质岩石。常具有鱗片（纤维）状、粒状变晶结构。片状-柱状矿物多为云母类、绿泥石、滑石、角闪石等，粒状矿物为长石、石英；另有少量铁铝榴石、十字石、蓝晶石等特征变质矿物的变斑晶。按矿物组成。可划分为云母片岩、角闪片岩、绿泥片岩、滑石片岩或石英片岩等。按其原岩性质和化学成分，可划分为泥质片岩、富镁片岩、基性片岩和长英质片岩等。
explanation_en: -Three kinds of metamorphic rock with obvious schistose structure. It often has scaly (fibrous) and granular balastic texture. The schistose columnar minerals are mostly mica, chlorite, talc, hornblende, etc. The granular minerals are feldspar and quartze; There is also a small amount of metamorphic phenocryst of iron almandine, staurolite, kyanite and other characteristic metamorphic minerals. According to mineral composition. It can be divided into mica schist, hornblende schist, chlorite schist, talc schist or quartz schist, etc. According to the original rock nature and chemical composition, it can be divided into argillaceous schist, magnesium rich schist, basic schist and felsic schist.

explanation_cn: 结晶高分子中晶片的厚度，以X射线衍射测试时等于长周期与结晶度的乘积。
explanation_en: The thickness of the wafer in crystallinebolymer is equal to the product of long period and crystallinity when measured by X-ray diffraction.
