explanation_cn: 通常为长与宽尺度相近的薄片。可通过天然、入造和在复合材料工艺过程中自身生长三种途径获得。天然的片状增强体的典型代表是矿产云母；入造的片状增强体有玻璃(又称玻璃鱗片）、铝、。铍、银等。复合材料工艺过程中自身生长的为二元共晶合金CUA12-A1中的CUA12片状晶。天然和入造片状增强体的含量可以在较大的范围白变动，从很少直至几乎构成整个复合材料。片状增强体可以在片的方向上提供各向均衡的性能。当它紧密堆叠时。其重叠形成的曲折途径能有效阻碍流体的渗漏，同时也减小了机械损伤沿垂直于片的方向贯穿的危险。由于片增强体的性质及其基体的组合不同，可以赋予复合材料不同的性能。例如，云母和玻璃片复合材料可用于防腐蚀、防渗漏、隔热和电绝缘，金属片也可提供防腐蚀和防渗漏性能。当金属片紧密堆叠时，还可在片平面提高导电和导热性能。同时在垂直于片平面的方向具有电磁波屏蔽性能。
explanation_en: Usually a thin sheet with similar length and width scales. It can be obtained by three ways: natural, in process and self growth in composite materials process. The typical representative of natural flake reinforcement is mineral mica; The incoming flake reinforcement includes glass (also called glass scale), aluminum. Beryllium, silver, etc. The self growth of composite materials in the process is CUA12 lamellar crystal in binary eutectic alloy CUA12-A1. The content of natural and imported lamellar reinforcement can vary in a large range, from little to almost the whole composite materials. The flake reinforcement can provide an isotropic performance in the direction of the sheet. When it is tightly stacked. The zigzag path formed by its overlap can effectively hinder fluid leakage, while also reducing the risk of mechanical damage penetrating perpendicular to the sheet. Due to the different properties of sheet reinforcement and the combination of its matrix, composite materials can be endowed with different properties. For example, mica and glass sheet composite materials can be used for corrosion prevention, leakage prevention, thermal insulation and electrical insulation, and metal sheets can also provide corrosion prevention and leakage resistance. When metal sheets are tightly stacked, they can also improve conductivity and thermal conductivity on the sheet surface. At the same time, it has electromagnetic wave shielding performance in the direction perpendicular to the plane of the sheet.

explanation_cn: 又称片理。变质岩中由云母、绿泥石、滑石、角闪石等片状或柱状矿物呈连续平行排列形成的一种构造。它是变质岩中最常见的一种构造。它的组成矿物一般粒度较粗，肉眼能分辨矿物颗粒，以此区别于千枚状构造（颗粒细小）。由矿物平行排列所组成的平面称为片理面。片理面可以是较平直的面，也可以是呈波状的曲面。它常与原岩的层理面一致，但有时也可斜交。
explanation_en: Also called schistosity. A structure in metamorphic rock formed by continuous parallel arrangement of lamellar or columnar minerals such as mica, chlorite, talc, hornblende, etc. It is the most common structure in metamorphic rock. Its constituent minerals are generally coarse in grain size, and can be distinguished from phyllitic structure (fine in grain) by the naked eye. The plane formed by parallel arrangement of minerals is called a schistosity plane. The foliated surface can be a relatively straight surface or a wavy surface. It is often consistent with the bedding plane of the original rock, but sometimes it can also intersect diagonally.

explanation_cn: 外形呈片状的粉末。通常是由塑性较好金属粉末球磨得到，如片状铝粉，其表面积大，遮盖力强，可制作涂料。
explanation_en: Powder with flaky appearance. It is usually obtained by ball milling metal powder with good plasticity, such as flaky aluminium powder, which has large surface area and strong hiding power and can be used to make coatings.

explanation_cn: 利用片皮机中快速运动的带状刀片将皮革在制品一层剖成多层的操作。根据在制品的区别可以分为片灰皮、片硝皮和片蓝皮。
explanation_en: The operation of using the fast moving band blade in the splitting machine to split one layer of leather work in progress into multiple layers. According to the difference of in-process products, it can be divided into pieces of limed skin, pieces of nitric oxide skin and pieces of blue skin.

explanation_cn: 一类具有明显片麻状构造的变质岩石。组成矿物主要有长石、石英和暗色矿物三类，且长石含量往往高于石英。暗色矿物为黑云母、角闪石、辉石等，总含量大于15%。有时含硅线石、石榴石、蓝晶石、堇青石等变质矿物。矿物粒度一般较粗（粒径大于lmrn)，片麻状构造典型，有时呈眼球状构造或条带状构造。按矿物组合及特征，可划分为角闪斜长片麻岩、角闪二辉斜长片麻岩、黑云二长片麻岩、绿帘钠长片麻岩、白云钾长片麻岩、刚玉夕线石片麻岩、石榴石黑云母正长片麻岩、石墨片麻岩、硬玉片麻岩等。片麻岩的原岩类型复杂，通常将由中酸性侵入岩或火山岩变来的称为正片麻岩。由长石砂岩、杂砂岩、钙质泥岩、黏土岩、半泥半砂质岩或相应成分的凝灰质岩石变来的称为副片麻岩。片麻岩中常含有云母、石墨、长石、石榴石、刚玉、蓝晶石等有用矿物。有些片麻岩色彩鲜艳，花纹美观，是良好的建筑或装饰石材。
explanation_en: A class of metamorphic rock with obvious gneissose structure. The composition minerals mainly include feldspar, quartze and dark minerals, and the content of feldspar is often higher than that of quartze. Dark minerals are biotite, amphibole, pyroxene, etc., with a total content of more than 15%. Sometimes it contains metamorphic minerals such as sillimanite, garnet, kyanite and cordierite. The mineral grain size is generally coarse (larger than lmrn), and the gneissose structure is typical, sometimes in the form of eye ball or banded structure. According to mineral assemblage and characteristics, it can be divided into hornblende plagioclase gneiss, hornblende lherzolite plagioclase gneiss, biotite monzonite gneiss, epidote albite gneiss, dolomite potash feldspar gneiss, corundum sillimanite gneiss, garnet biotite syenite gneiss, graphite gneiss, jadeite gneiss, etc. The original rock type of gneiss is complex, and it is usually called orthogneiss from intermediate acid intrusive rocks or volcanic rock. It is called paragneiss, which is changed from arkose, greywacke, calcareous mud rock, clay rock, semi muddy and semi sandy rock or tuffaceous rock of corresponding composition. Gneiss often contains mica, graphite, feldspar, garnet, corundum, kyanite and other useful minerals. Some gneiss have bright colors and beautiful patterns, which are good building or decorative stones.

explanation_cn: 又称片麻理。变质岩中由片状暗色矿物（黑云母）和柱状矿物（角闪石、辉石）平行排列、断续出现或被粒状浅色矿物(石英、长石）隔开所形成的黑白相间、片点结合的层带状构造。它是片麻岩的典型构造。
explanation_en: Also known as flake texture. In metamorphic rock, the lamellar dark minerals (biotite) and columnar minerals (amphibole, pyroxene) are arranged in parallel, intermittently, or separated by granular light minerals (quartze, feldspar), forming a black white alternating, lamellar and point combination layered structure. It is a typical structure of gneiss.

explanation_cn: 牙周手术后为保护组织创面正常愈合而使用的材料。使用时调配成软条状敷盖于牙龈表面、伤口创面或塞于牙间隙、龈袋内。具有止血、止痛、压迫、保护伤口、消除肿胀、促进组织早期愈合等作用。主要有含丁香酸及不含丁香酿两大类。两类均由粉剂和液剂组成，使用时按适当比例调和。含丁香酚牙周寒治剂粉剂主要由40%-60%氧化锌、13%-50%粉状松香、4%-10%鞣酸、少量硬脂酸锌组成;液剂主要由70%丁香酚，适量杏仁油或一些矿物油组成。不含丁香酚牙周塞治剂粉剂主要由氧化锌、杏仁粉或加上重矿物油、橄榄树脂胶组成;液剂可由氧化锌软膏、氢化脂肪组成，或由揶子油脂肪酸、松香树脂组成，牙周塞治剂中加人一些抗菌药物可起到抗菌或抑菌作用。
explanation_en: A materials used to protect the normal healing of tissue wounds after periodontal surgery. When used, prepare a soft strip to cover the surface of the gums, wound surface, or plug it into the interdental space or gingival pocket. It has functions such as hemostasis, pain relief, compression, wound protection, swelling elimination, and promoting early tissue healing. There are two main types of brewing, including those containing clove acid and those without clove. Both types are composed of powder and liquid, and are mixed in appropriate proportions when used. The powder containing eugenol periodontal cold treatment agent mainly consists of 40% -60% zinc oxide, 13% -50% powdered rosin, 4% -10% tannic acid, and a small amount of zinc stearate; The liquid agent mainly consists of 70% eugenol, an appropriate amount of almond oil, or some mineral oil. The eugenol free periodontal pack powder is mainly composed of zinc oxide, almond powder or heavy mineral oil and olive resin glue; The liquid agent can be composed of zinc oxide ointment, hydrogenated fat, or the fatty acid of tea tree seed oil, rosin resin. The periodontal pack can play an antibacterial or bacteriostatic role by adding some antibacterial drugs.

explanation_cn: 制作义齿基托的聚合物液剂材料，牙托水为其商品名。分热凝和自凝两大类，热凝牙托水主要成分为甲基丙烯酸甲酯(纯度大于97.5%，相对密度约0.94)及少量稳定剂，如对苯二酚或2,6-二叔丁基对甲苯酚。还可加入适量的交联剂，如二甲基丙烯酸乙二醇酯和甲基丙烯酸丙烯酯等，以改善性能。也可加入少量交联剂。应用时牙托水与相应的牙托粉以一定的比例调和使用。
explanation_en: The trade name of the polymer liquid materials used to make denture base is denture base water. There are two major categories: thermosetting and self setting. The main components of thermosetting denture base polymer liquid are methyl methacrylate (purity more than 97.5%, relative density about 0.94) and a small amount of stabilizer, such as hydroquinone or 2,6-di-tert-butyl-p-cresol. An appropriate amount of cross linking agent, such as ethylene glycol dimethacrylate and propylene methacrylate, can also be added to improve the performance. A small amount of crosslinking agent can also be added. When applied, denture base polymer liquid and corresponding denture base polymer powder shall be used in a certain proportion.

explanation_cn: 制作义齿基托的聚合物粉剂材料，为其商品名。有热凝和自凝两大类，热凝主要成分为聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯珠状聚合体及少量金属氧化物着色剂，如镉红。其色泽以模拟口腔黏膜颜色为主，有时加入少量染色合成纤维，如醋酸纤维，以模拟微血管。自凝牙托粉主要成分为甲基丙烯酸甲酯聚合体或甲基丙烯酸甲酯与丙烯酸甲酯、丙烯酸乙酯或丙烯酸丁酯二元或三元共聚体，分子量20万40万，另外还有引发剂，如过氧化苯甲酰以及着色剂，如镉红。应用时牙托粉与相应的牙托水按一定的比例调和使用。
explanation_en: The polymer powder materials used to make denture base is its trade name. There are two categories of thermal coagulation and self coagulation. The main components of thermal coagulation are polymethyl methacrylate bead polymer and a small amount of metal oxide colorant, such as cadmium red. Its color mainly simulates the color of oral mucosa, and sometimes a small amount of dyed synthetic fiber, such as acetate fiber, is added to simulate microvessels. Self curing denture base polymer powder is mainly composed of methyl methacrylate polymer or binary or ternary copolymer of methyl methacrylate and methyl acrylate, ethyl acrylate or butyl acrylate, with a molecular weight of 200000. 400000, in addition, there are initiator, such as benzoyl peroxide and colorant, such as cadmium red. When applied, denture base polymer powder and corresponding denture support water shall be used in a certain proportion.

explanation_cn: 一类能够与牙本质产生黏结力的材料，主要用于复合树脂充填龋齿窝洞之前洞壁牙本质层的预处理，以提高充填体的固位力。同时也可以封闭牙本质小管，以防止继发龋齿发生。口腔临床使用的主要有以下两类：①含有亲水及疏水基团的丙烯酸酯类功能单体，它们可以渗入经预处理剂处理过的牙本质小管、小管周围，甚至小管之间的区域随即固化，形成树脂增强的牙本质层可以获得1018MPa的黏合强度：②主要成分为戊二醛及甲基丙烯酸羟乙酯（HEMA)等，它可以与经EDTA溶液预处理后的牙本质表面存在的胶原等有机质产生共聚合反应，从而获得甚至高于l.lMPa的黏合强度。
explanation_en: A kind of materials that can produce adhesive force with dentin. It is mainly used for pretreatment of dentine layer of cavity wall before filling cavities with composition resin to improve the retention of filling body. At the same time, it can also seal the dentin tubules to prevent secondary caries from occurring. There are two main types of clinical use in oral cavity: ① acrylate functional monomer containing hydrophilic and hydrophobic groups, which can penetrate into the pretreated dentinal tubules, around the tubules, and even the area between the tubules is curing immediately, forming a resin enhanced dentinal layer that can obtain a adhesion strength of 1018 MPa; ② the main components are glutaraldehyde and hydroxyethyl methacrylate (HEMA), etc, It can produce copolymerization reaction with collagen and other organic matters on the dentin surface pretreated by EDTA solution, thus obtaining adhesion strength even higher than l.lMPa.

explanation_cn: 又称人工牙根。是经外科手术植人颌骨内、颌骨骨膜下或软组织内，代替天然牙根支撑人工牙冠以恢复咀嚼功能的医用装置。其主要类型有黏膜下、骨膜下、骨内、经根管和牙-骨联合植人体等。①黏膜下种植体.采用金属及合金制成，有纽扣形、蘑菇形、网状形等形状，植入到口腔颌面部黏膜组织下作为支撑列修复体的基桩。②骨膜下种植体，主要由金属或金属-陶瓷复合材料制成，植入到颌骨骨膜下以支持义齿修复体。③骨内种植体，为前临床上应用最多的一类牙种植体。主要由钛金属、钛合金或钛金属-陶瓷复合材料制成。骨内种植体外形多样.使用较多的是螺旋状种植体、圆柱状种植体和叶状植人体，螺旋状种植体和柱状种植体的形态与牙根类似，手术创伤小，支持力好，既可作为个别牙齿缺失修复用的人工牙根，也可作为多个牙缺失或全口牙缺失修复的口内甚桩，特别是改进的分段式螺旋状种植体还可减少棺人后的感染和应力造成的吸收问题。叶状棺人体的特点是形态变化多样，植入体与骨接触面积大，能够抵抗较大的垂直力和侧向力，而获得足够的机械同位。缺点是植人过程中对骨组织的损伤较大。此外骨内种植体还有针形、钉形、树枝状、锚状等.以及将骨内与骨膜下连接成一体的骨内骨膜下联合植入体，后者是将基桩植人颂骨内，桩所带的翼嵌于牙梢嵴两侧的骨膜下，能加强固位和稳定性④牙-骨联合植人沐。将牙和骨连接为一体的植人体。采用钴铬合金、钛合金、钽等金属材料制成针状植人体，置人短根牙、松动牙和残根冠牙.起到同位的作用。其特点是植人体经过牙齿进入颌骨.可避免种植龈袋的形成和感染的发生。
explanation_en: Also called dental implant. It is a medical device that is surgically implanted into the jawbone, under the periosteum of the jawbone, or in soft tissue to replace natural tooth roots to support artificial crowns and restore chewing function. The main types include submucosal, subperiosteal, intraosseous, root canal, and dental bone joint grafting The submucosal implant is made of metal and alloy and has button, mushroom and mesh shapes. It is implantation under the oral and maxillofacial mucosa tissue as the foundation pile of the supporting prosthesis. ② The subperiosteal implant, mainly made of metal or metal ceramics composite materials, is implantation under the jaw periosteum to support the demure prosthesis. ③ Intraosseous implant is the most widely used dental implant in preclinical practice. It is mainly made of titanium metal, titanium alloy or titanium metal ceramics composite materials. Intraosseous implants have various shapes. Spiral implants, cylindrical implants and leaf shaped implants are widely used. Spiral implants and cylindrical implants are similar to dental roots in shape, with less surgical trauma and good support. They can be used as dental implant for the repair of individual tooth loss, or as intraoral implants for the repair of multiple tooth loss or complete tooth loss, Especially the improved segmented spiral implant can reduce the absorption problems caused by infection and stress after the coffin is placed. The human body of the leafy coffin is characterized by various morphological changes. The implantation body has a large contact area with the bone, and can resist large vertical and lateral forces to obtain sufficient mechanical alignment. The disadvantage is that there is significant damage to bone tissue during the implantation process. In addition, there are needle shaped, nail shaped, dendritic, anchor shaped, etc., as well as the intra osseous subperiosteal combined implant that connects the intra osseous with the subperiosteal. The latter is to implant the base post into the chanting bone, and the wings of the post are embedded under the periosteum on both sides of the apical ridge, which can strengthen retention and stabilize ④ the tooth bone combined implant. A implant that connects teeth and bones together. The needle shaped implant is made of metallic materials such as cobalt chromium alloy, titanium alloy, tantalum, etc. It can be used to place short root teeth, loose teeth and residual root crowns. Its characteristic is that the implanted human body enters the jawbone through the teeth, which can avoid the formation of gingival pocket and the occurrence of infection.

explanation_cn: 采用未漂的硫酸盐针叶木浆为原料生产的具有高物理强度的纸呵作为纸袋制作原料，也可直接用于包装物体。
explanation_en: High physical strength paper produced from unbleached kraft softwood pulp can be used as the raw material for paper bag production, and can also be directly used for packaging objects.

explanation_cn: 表达热力学系统中若干个态函数参量之间关系的数学方程式。由热力学第零定律可以推证出，处于同一热平衡状态的各系统必定具有一个共同的宏观性质，即温度。而处于平衡状态的热力学系统可以用四类状态参量（几何参量、力学参量、化学参量和电化学参量）来描述。
explanation_en: A mathematical equation that expresses the relationship between several state function parameters in a thermodynamics system. It can be inferred from the the zeroth law of thermodynamics of thermodynamics that all systems in the same thermal equilibrium state must have a common macro property, that is, temperature. The thermodynamics system in equilibrium can be described by four kinds of state parameters (geometric parameters, mechanical parameters, chemical parameters and electrochemical parameters).

explanation_cn: 利用范德华力或氢键等点形成交联网状结构的交联过程。
explanation_en: Crosslinking process in which crosslinking network structure is formed by van der Waals force or hydrogen bond.

explanation_cn: 见金属学。
explanation_en: See physical metallurgy.

explanation_cn: 以物理学的原理和实验技术为基础，研究化学体系的性质及行为，总结化学变化规律的科学。它是介于物理和化学之间的中间学科，包括与物理现象及原理有关的化学内容.属于化学的一个分支。的研究内容一般可分为三方面：①化学体系宏观平衡性质和规律.其理论基础是热力学四个定律;②化学体系的微观结构和性质，其理论基础是量子力学;③化学体系的动态性质与规律，其理论基础是气体动力学原理。
explanation_en: The science of studying the properties and behaviors of chemical systems based on the principles and experimental techniques of physics, and summarizing the laws of chemical changes. It is an intermediate discipline between physics and chemistry, including chemical content related to physical phenomena and principles. It belongs to a branch of chemistry. The research contents of the research can generally be divided into three aspects: ① the macroscopic equilibrium properties and laws of chemical systems. Its theoretical basis is the four laws of thermodynamics; ② The theoretical basis of the microstructure and properties of chemical systems is quantum mechanics; ③ The dynamic properties and laws of chemical systems are based on the principles of gas dynamics.

explanation_cn: 又称为挥发性发泡剂。指在使用过程中不发生化学变化，而在一定温度范围内通过发生物理状态的变化产生气体从而使塑料和橡胶发泡的物质。其包括压缩气体（如CO2、N2等）、挥发性液体（如低沸点脂肪烃、卤代脂肪烃等）、可溶性固体等。
explanation_en: It is also called volatile foaming agent. It refers to a substance that does not change chemically during use, but generates gas through the change of physical state within a certain temperature range to make plastics and rubber foam. It includes compressed gases (such as CO2, N2, etc.), volatile liquids (such as low boiling point fatty hydrocarbons, halogenated fatty hydrocarbons, etc.), soluble solids, etc.

explanation_cn: 是利用物理原理制备聚合物发泡材料的方法。包括以下几种：①在加压下把超临界流体加入熔融聚合物或其复合物中，然后减压升温使溶解气体释放并形成稳定气孔，最后通过降温（降低到聚合物熔点或玻璃化转变温度以下），形成稳定的泡孔结构，常见有超临界状态的C02和N2;②通过溶入聚合物熔体的低沸点液体气化形成泡孔，常见有卤代烃、烷基醚、低级烷烃、低级醇和酯;③通过溶解聚合物中的可溶组分例如食盐粉末而形成微孔聚合物材料;④在熔融聚合物中添加空心球后经固化而制成聚合物泡沫材料。
explanation_en: It is a method of preparing polymer foaming materials by using physical principles. It includes the following types: ① add supercritical fluid into molten polymer or its composite under pressure, then reduce pressure and temperature to release dissolved gas and form stable pores, and finally form stable bubble structure by cooling (down to below the melting point of polymer or glass transition temperature), commonly including C02 and N2 in supercritical state; ② Bubbles are formed by vaporization of low boiling liquid dissolved in polymer melt, commonly including halohydrocarbons, alkyl ethers, low-grade alkanes, low-grade alcohols and esters; ③ Porous polymer materials is formed by dissolving soluble components in polymer, such as salt powder; ④ The polymer foam materials is made by adding hollow spheres into the molten polymer and curing.

explanation_cn: 又称由范德瓦耳斯力引起的吸附。吸附质的分子或原子借助于范德瓦耳斯力被吸附在吸附剂表面的现象。
explanation_en: Also known as adsorption caused by van der Waals force. The phenomenon of molecules or atoms of adsorbates being adsorbed on the surface of an adsorbent using van der Waals forces.

explanation_cn: 用物理方法将源物质转移到气相中，在基材上形成覆盖层的方法。通常在真空中进行.其工作模式有四种：①真空沉积，如真空蒸发、分子束外延、离子束沉枳、离子团簇沉积、激光蒸发（laserablalion);②溅射沉积，如射频溅射、磁控派射、离子束溅射;③等离子体增强沉积.如加偏压的活化反应蒸发、空心阴极放电离子镀、阴极电弧沉积、磁控溅射离子镀：④离子束增强沉积.如离子束增强磁控溅射、离子束增强离子束沉积。
explanation_en: The method of physically transferring the source material into the gas phase and forming a covering layer on the substrate. It is usually carried out in vacuum. There are four working modes: ① vacuum deposition, such as vacuum evaporation, molecular beam epitaxy, ion beam deposition, ion cluster deposition, laser evaporation; ② Sputtering deposition, such as radio frequency sputtering, magnetron sputtering, ion beam sputtering; ③ Plasma enhanced deposition, such as biased activation or conditioning reactive evaporation, hollow cathode discharge ion plating, cathodic arc deposition, magnetron sputtering ion plating: ④ ion beam enhanced deposition, such as ion beam enhanced magnetron sputtering, ion beam enhanced ion team deposition.

explanation_cn: 高分子因物理结构变化而发生性能随时间逐渐变化的现象。是玻璃态高聚物通过链段的微布朗运动使其凝聚态结构从非平衡态向平衡态过渡的松弛过程。由于，玻璃态高聚物（塑料）在长期的存放过程中，冲击强度和断裂伸长率大幅度降低.材料变脆。事实上，从熔体快速淬火成玻璃态时，体系处在热力学非平衡态.其凝聚态结构不稳定，在存放过程中会逐渐向稳定的平衡态转变。
explanation_en: The performance of macromolecule changes gradually with time due to the change of physical structure. It is the relaxation process of glass state polymer's condensed state structure from non-equilibrium state to equilibrium state through the micro Brownian motion of chain segment. Because the impact strength and percentage elongation after fracture of glass state polymers (plastics) are greatly reduced during long-term storage, materials become brittle. In fact, when the melt is rapidly quenching into a glass state, the system is in a thermodynamics non-equilibrium state. Its condensed state structure is unstable and will gradually change to a stable transformation state during storage.

explanation_cn: 一般指亚稳奥氏体在应力诱发马氏体相变温度以下加工时诱发马氏体转变，造成的材料流变应力降低的现象。在这种情况下.形变诱发马氏体可看成是一种由相变构成的形变机制.由于它本身的容积变化协助塑性延伸.与此同时将应力松弛而使流变应力下降.在应力应变曲线中造成一向上弯曲的凹谷.称为物理软化。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to the phenomenon that metastable austenite induces martensitic transformation when processing below the stress induced transformation transformation temperature, resulting in the reduction of flow stress of materials. In this case, deformation induced martensite can be regarded as a deformation mechanism consisting of phase transformation. Its volume change assists plastic extension. At the same time, stress release reduces the flow stress. In the stress strain curve, a concave valley with upward bending is created, which is called physical softening.

explanation_cn: 牺牲阳极的阴极保护技术是使用一种电位比所要保护的金属的电位更负的金属或合金与被保护的金属电连接在一起，依靠电位更负的金属不断腐蚀溶解以产生电流，从而保护其他金属。当锌合金被用作阳极时，就是一种牺牲阳极，通常用于土壤电阻率小于200欧姆米的土壤环境或海水环境。在高于49°C的温度下，会发生晶间腐蚀。当温度高于54°C时，锌阳极的电位会变得正，这将导致其与钢铁的极性发生逆转，锌阳极将变成阴极并受到保护，而钢铁将变成阳极并受到腐蚀。因此，锌阳极通常用于环境温度低于49°C的情况下。它可以作为牺牲阳极用于海水、淡水、土壤等电解质中的金属构件的阴极保护，包括船舶、港口设施、海洋工程、埋地金属管道、储罐、海水冷却系统以及其他钢结构的阴极保护。
explanation_en: The cathodic protection technology of sacrificial anode is to use a metal or alloy with more negative potential than the metal to be protected to electrically connect with the protected metal, and rely on the metal with more negative potential to continuously corrosion and dissolve to generate current, so as to protect other metals. When zinc alloy is used as anode, it is a sacrificial anode, usually used in soil environment or seawater environment with soil resistivity less than 200 ohm meters. At temperatures higher than 49 ° C, intergranular corrosion will occur. When the temperature is higher than 54 ° C, the potential of the zinc anode will become positive, which will lead to the reversal of its polarity with the steel. The zinc anode will become the cathode and be protected, while the steel will become the anode and be corrosion. Therefore, zinc anodes are typically used when the ambient temperature is below 49 ° C. It can be used as a sacrificial anode for cathodic protection of metal components in elonrolyte such as seawater, fresh water and soil, including cathodic protection of ships, port facilities, marine engineering, buried metal pipelines, storage tanks, seawater cooling systems and other steel structures.

explanation_en: A basic extrusive rock. The composition is equivalent to gabbro, and it is one of the most widely distributed rock in extrusive rock. To protect children's health, the film should be non-toxic. The so-called toxicity refers to the content of heavy metals, with the following standards: lead<5000mg/kg, chromium<250mg/kg, barium<100mg/kg, arsenic<100mg/kg, ladder<250mg/kg, cadmium<100mg/kg. explanation_en: When local damage and decline occur to the environmental structure and function, leading to the degradation of the overall environmental system function, and the recovery of the degraded environmental system is hindered, in order to curb further deterioration of the environmental system, based on the self-organization and self recovery ability of the environmental system itself, ecological principles are applied to repair specific damaged objects in the environment through physical, chemical, or biological methods Reconstruction or improvement. explanation_cn: 又称为"绿色纳米材料"或"生态纳米材料"，是指在加工、制造、使用和再生过程中具有最低环境负荷、最大使用功能、至少有一维尺寸在纳米尺度的材料。

explanation_en: Polycyclopentadiene resin is a kind of polymer widely used. Because it is a petrochemical product, it has abundant raw materials, low synthesis cost and acid and alkali resistance.

explanation_cn: 以丁腈橡胶增韧改件环氧树脂胶黏剂以丁晴橡胶的状态分为以下三种：①以同体丁腈橡胶增韧环氧树脂，首先将丁腈橡胶混炼压成胶片。然后溶解于溶剂（醋酸乙酯）配成一定固含量溶液。再与环氧树脂和固化剂混合配成胶液或制成胶膜。这种环氧-丁腈胶黏剂耐温100°C左右。如果用酚醛环氧树脂或氨基多官能环氧树脂，使用温度则达15_0-180°C"由于使用溶剂需加温加压同化。②液体丁腈橡胶增韧环氧树脂。液体丁腈橡胶相对分子质量3000-10000，易与环氧树脂混合，Hi配成尤溶剂型环氧-丁腈胶黏剂。液体丁腈橡胶用M通常为10%-20%(质量分数），固化剂为芳香胺或酸酐。并加入少量DMP-30或咪唑作促进剂-固化后环氣树脂为连续相-丁腈橡胶为分散相。③液体羧瑤丁睛橡胶增韧环氧树脂。端羧基与环氧基发生化学反应。在两相界面h存在着化学键结合的强相互作用。-固化过程中形成环氧树脂为连续相，丁腈橡胶为粒子状分散相的两相体系。即所谓的''海岛"式两相结构。获得了显著的增韧效果。
explanation_en: The epoxy resin adhesive toughened with acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber can be divided into the following three types in the state of nitrile rubber: ① toughen epoxy resin with the same acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber, and first mixing and press acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber into film.
