explanation_cn: 一般指生物相容性良好、与人体硬组织相似的新型磷酸钙骨水泥。这种骨水泥包含了固液两相，其中固相是两种或两种以上的磷酸钙盐的混合粉末，液相是低浓度的磷酸或磷酸盐溶液或其他液体，如血浆、柠檬酸溶液等。将固液两相按比例混合后，可调成任意塑形的糊状混合物，并注入修复部位。这种骨水泥可以在人体内的环境和温度下硬化，最终的成分会转化为羟基磷灰石。这种骨水泥的成分类似于自然骨，植入人体后可以参与新陈代谢，促使骨组织生长，最终逐步重建成具备承重能力的坚固骨骼。这种新工艺和新材料的集成具有临床使用的一体化，它能够根据缺损部位的需要进行任意塑形，操作简便。这克服了使用粉末和颗粒材料制备骨修复材料时的困难、力学性能差和易流失等问题。目前，研究中包括p-TCP体系、crTCP体系和TECP体系等不同类型的磷酸钙骨水泥。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to a new type of calcium phosphate bone cement with good biocompatibility and similar to human hard tissue. This kind of bone cemem contains solid and liquid phases, in which the solid phase is a mixed powder of two or more calcium phosphate salts, and the liquid phase is low concentration phosphoric acid or phosphate solution or other liquids, such as plasma, citric acid solution, etc. After mixing the solid-liquid phases in proportion, they can be adjusted into any shaped paste mixture and injected into the repair site. This kind of bone cement can harden under the environment and temperature of human body, and the final composition will be converted into hydroxyapatite. The composition of this kind of bone cement is similar to that of natural bone. After being implanted into the human body, it can participate in metabolism, promote the growth of bone tissue, and eventually gradually rebuild a solid bone with load-bearing capacity. The integration of this new process and new materials has the integration of clinical use. It can be shaped arbitrarily according to the needs of the defect site, and the operation is simple. This overcomes the difficulties in preparing bone repair materials with powder and granular materials, poor mechanical properties and easy loss. At present, the research includes different types of calcium phosphate bone cemem such as p-TCP system, crTCP system and TECP system.

explanation_cn: 又称生物活性玻璃(bioactiveglasses)，是一类非常重要的无机非金属类生物材料，具有良好的生物相容性和生物活性，能够同时与骨组织及软组织形成化学键合而无纤维包裹层形成。
explanation_en: Also known as bioactive glass, they are a very important class of inorganic non-metallic biomaterials with good biocompatibility and bioactivity. They can form chemical bonds with bone tissue and soft tissue at the same time without fiber coating.

explanation_en: It refers to the coating formed by coating bioglass (BG) or its composite materials on matrix materials.

explanation_cn: 生物医学材料在特定应用中引起适当的宿主反应和产生有效作用的能力。生物相容性表征生物医学材料的生物学性能，决定于材料和活体系统间的相互作用。这种相互作用包括两个方面：一是宿主反应，即材料对活体系统的作用或活体系统对材料的反应.包括局部和全身反应，如炎症、细胞毒性、溶血、刺激性、致敏、致癌、致诱变、致畸和免疫等反应，其结果可能导致对机体的毒副作用和机体对材料的排斥作用；二是材料反应，即活体系统对材料的作用或材料对活体系统的反应，主要来自生物环境对材料的腐蚀和降解，可能使材料i性质发生退化甚至破坏。生物相容性是生物医学材料区别于其他功能材料所必须具备的特性，受多种因素的综合影响。来自材料方面的影响有：材料类型和形态、表面和组成，物理、化学及力学性质等。生物系统方面有：动物种系、植人部位、受体状况、存留时间和使用环境等。生物医学材料的生物相容性和其使用目的和条件密切相关，又吋分为血液相容性和组织相容性，近年生物相容性评价已从整体、组织水平发展到了细胞、分子水平。生物相容性的研究涉及多学科交叉的综合性因素，是十分复杂的，也是生物医学材料一直在研究的课题。
explanation_en: The ability of biomedical materials to cause appropriate host response and produce effective effects in specific applications. Biocompatibility characterizes the biological properties of biomedical materials and is determined by the interaction between materials and living systems. This interaction includes two aspects: one is host response, that is, the effect of materials on living systems or the reaction of living systems to materials, including local and systemic reactions, such as inflammation, cytotoxicity, hemolysis, irritation, sensitization, carcinogenesis, mutagenesis, teratogenicity and immunity, which may lead to toxic and side effects on the body and rejection of the body to materials; The second is materials response, that is, the action of living systems on materials or the reaction of materials on living systems, mainly from the corrosion and degradation of materials by the biological environment, which may degrade or even destroy the properties of materials i. Biocompatibility is a characteristic that biomedical materials must have, which is different from other functional materials. It is affected by many factors. The influences from materials include: materials type and shape, surface and composition, physical, chemical and mechanical properties, etc. In terms of biological systems, there are: animal species, plant site, receptor status, survival time, and usage environment. The biocompatibility of biomedical materials is closely related to their use purposes and conditions, and can be divided into Wood compatibility and histocompatibility. In recent years, biocompatibility evaluation has developed from the overall and organizational levels to the cellular and molecular levels. The research of biocompatibility involves comprehensive factors of multidisciplinary intersection, which is very complex. It is also the subject of biomedical materials.

explanation_cn: 是指具有良好生物相容性的材料。材料在生物体内静态与动态变化的过程中能耐受宿主各系统作用而保持相对稳定，且对生物体无毒性、无致敏性、无不良刺激、无遗传毒性和无致癌性，对生物体组织、血液、免疫等系统不产生不良反应，同时还要有助于其生物活性及功能的实现3按材料种类可分为天然、合成、陶瓷和金属材料等，可用于人体嚣官等受损部位的功能替代或修复。
explanation_en: It refers to materials with good biocompatibility. In the process of static and dynamic changes in the organism, materials can tolerate the effects of various host systems and remain relatively stable, and are non-toxic to the organism, free of sensitization, no adverse irritation, no genotoxicity and no carcinogenicity. They do not produce adverse reactions to biological tissues, blood, immune and other systems, and also help to achieve their bioactivity and functions. 3 According to the types of materials, they can be divided into natural, synthetic, ceramics and metallic materials, It can be used for functional replacement or repair of damaged parts such as the human body.

explanation_cn: 指在生物体内通过生物大分子调控和介导无机矿物的形成过程。生物矿化与一般矿化的最大不同在于有生物大分子、有机基质和细胞的参与。通过有机大分子与生物体液中无机离子在界面处的相互作用，从分子水平控制无机矿物相的析出，使其具有一定的形状、尺寸及取向，从而使生物矿物具有特殊的多级结构和组装方式，呈现高力学强度的同时具有特殊的生物学及物理、化学等性质。通过有机或高分子模板控制的生物矿化模拟研究受到化学、物理、生物以及材料学等多学科领域研究者的广泛关注。对生物矿化的研究是生命科学的重要研究领域，已成为指导仿生型生物医学材料制备的重要理论依据。生物矿化材料是指这种由生命系统参与合成的天然的生物陶瓷和生物高分子复合材料，如骨骼、牙齿、珍珠、贝壳、蛋壳和鹿角等。
explanation_en: Refers to the process of regulating and mediating the formation of inorganic minerals within an organism through biological macromolecules. The biggest difference between biomineralization and general mineralization lies in the involvement of biomacromolecules, organic matrix and cells. Through the interaction between organic macromolecule and inorganic ions in biological fluid at the interface, the precipitation of inorganic mineral phase is controlled at the molecular level to make it have a certain shape, size and orientation, so that biological minerals have a special multi-level structure and assembly mode, showing high mechanical strength and special biological, physical, chemical and other properties. The simulation of biomineralization controlled by organic or macromolecule templates has attracted extensive attention from researchers in many disciplines such as chemistry, physics, biology and materials. The research on biomineralization is an important research field of life science, and has become an important theoretical basis for guiding the preparation of biomimetic biomedical materials. Biomineralization materials refers to this kind of natural biological cemmics and biopolymer composite materials synthesized by the life system, such as bones, teeth, pearl, shells, eggshells and antlers.

explanation_cn: 材料在微生物作用下性能随时间的变化。可降解高分子材料在一定时间和一定条件下，可以被微生物（细菌、真菌、藻类等）通过生化过程产生的分泌物、有机酸或酶降解为低分子化合物.最终分解为二氧化碳和水等无机物难以降解的高分子材料长期在微生物存在的环境中也有被腐蚀的风险.例如某些真菌如杂色曲霉等可以在石墨纤维表面生长和腐蚀纤维；杂色曲霉也可以在聚酰亚胺表面生长从而改变聚酰亚胺的介电性质。聚合物在生产过程中添加的增塑剂、表面活性剂等也会作为营养物质吸引微生物侵蚀材料。大量微生物还可以附着在材料表面形成一层菌膜.并进一步形成微生物黏膜.这种黏膜不仅影响材料的腐蚀过程.也影响使用性能。目前，主要通过对材料表面进行物理和化学的方法处理、增加防护涂层、添加杀菌剂等方法抑制材料表面的细菌繁殖和细菌群落形成。
explanation_en: The change of materials performance with time under the action of microorganism. Degradation macromolecule materials can be secreted by microorganisms (bacteria, fungi, algae, etc.) through biochemical processes for a certain time and under certain conditions Organic acids or enzymes degradation into low molecular compounds. macromolecule materials that are ultimately decomposed into carbon dioxide, water and other inorganic substances that are difficult to degradation also have the risk of corrosion in the environment where microorganisms exist for a long time. For example, some fungi such as Aspergillus versicolor can grow on the surface of graphite fibers and corrosion fibers; Aspergillus versicolor can also grow on the surface of polyimide to change the dielectric properties of polyimide. The plasticizer and surfactant added in the production process of polymer will also act as nutrients to attract microorganisms to attack materials. A large number of microorganisms can also attach to the surface of materials to form a biofilm and further form a microbial mucosa, which not only affects the corrosion process of materials, but also affects the use performance. At present, mainly through physical and chemical treatment of surface of materials, adding protective coating, adding fungicide and other methods to inhibit bacterial proliferation and bacterial community formation on surface of materials.

explanation_cn: 由于生物的生物活动性导致非生命物质的性质发生不利于人类需求的变化，即非生命物质的内在价值受到削弱。这种变化可以是机械的、物理的、化学的、美学的，不一定是物质的化学分解。生物腐蚀过程可分为两类：①机械的，包括非营养物质被昆虫和啮齿动物啮蚀和穿孔.如电缆上的绝缘物、铅管等遭到损害；建筑物或其他构造也可由于植物的根系生长而遭受损害；②化学的.包括同化效应和异化效应，同化效应是指生物将物质中的基质作为营养源使用；而异化效应则指生物产生代谢产物，如酸或毒素.可以引起腐蚀、霉变、变色、变质或使之不能使用。
explanation_en: Due to the biological activity of organisms, the properties of non living substances undergo changes that are not conducive to human needs, that is, the intrinsic value of non living substances is weakened. This change can be mechanical, physical, chemical, or aesthetic, not necessarily the chemical decomposition of matter. The bioerosion process can be divided into two categories: ① mechanical, including non nutritive substances eroded and perforated by insects and rodents, such as insulation and lead pipes on cables damaged; Buildings or other structures can also suffer damage due to the growth of plant roots; ② Chemical, including assimilation and alienation effects, assimilation effect refers to the use of substrates in substances by organisms as nutrient sources; Alienation effect refers to the biological production of metabolites, such as acids or toxins, which can cause corrosion, mildew, discoloration, deterioration or render them unusable.

explanation_cn: 在生物环境里，材料表面黏附一层由细菌本身或由其分泌的黏多糖以及胞外基质复合体构成的三维黏膜，即指生物材料表面附着生长并经常镶嵌在有机多聚物结构中的微牛物细胞层.通常具冇孔状结构.并具有很强的吸附性能。生物膜技术也是微生物同定化技术，生物膜反应器已有广泛应用。另一方面，生物膜又指由细菌在其分泌的黏液(黏多糖）内形成的细菌团块与细胞外基质的复合体结构.
explanation_en: In the biological environment, the surface of materials is attached with a layer of three-dimensional mucosa composed of bacteria themselves or mucopolysaccharides secreted by them and extracellular matrix complexes, that is, the micro bovine cell layer attached to the biological surface of materials and often embedded in the structure of organic polymers. It usually has a porous structure and has strong adsorption performance. Biomembrane technology is also a microbial co immobilization technology, and biomembrane reactors have been widely used. On the other hand, biomembrane refers to the complex structure of bacterial mass and extracellular matrix formed by bacteria in the mucus (mucopolysaccharide) secreted by them

explanation_cn: 是指将大量生物探针高密度固定于硅片、凝胶、膜等载体上后与生物样品分子(如蛋白、核酸、因子或小分子）进行杂交，通过检I测每个探针分子的'杂交信号强度进而获取样品分子的数量和序列信息的芯片。生物芯片通过生物分子间特异相互作用的原理，将生化分析过程集成于芯片表面.从而实现对核酸、多肽、蛋白质以及其他生物成分的高通量快速检测。
explanation_en: It refers to a chip that fixes a large number of biological probes on silicon wafer, gel, membrane and other carriers with high density, hybridizes with biological sample molecules (such as protein, nucleic acid, factor or small molecule), and obtains the number and sequence information of sample molecules by measuring the hybridization signal strength of each probe molecule. The biochip integrates the biochemical analysis process on the chip surface through the principle of specific interaction between biomolecules, so as to realize the high-throughput and rapid detection of nucleic acids, polypeptides, proteins and other biological components.

explanation_cn: 由经过生物或化学处理的天然生物组织所形成的生物医学材料。生物组织可取自同种或异种物体的组织；生物或化学处理包括维持组织原有构型而进行的固定、灭菌和消除抗原性的较轻微的处理.以及拆散原有构型、重建新的物理形态的强烈处理。前者如用戊二醛处理固定的猪心瓣膜、牛心包、牛颈动脉、人胳动脉以及冻干的骨片、猪皮、牛皮、羊膜、胚胎皮等；后者如用再生的胶原、弹性蛋白、透明质酸、硫酸软骨素和壳聚糖等构成的粉体、纤维、膜、海绵体等。由于经过处理的生物组织已失去生命力?生物衍生材料是无生命活力的材料。但是，由于生物衍生材料或是具有类似于自然组织的构型和功能，或是其组成类似于自然组织，在维持人体动态过程的修复和替换中具有重要的作用。
explanation_en: Biomedical materials formed from natural biological tissues after biological or chemical treatment. Biological tissues can be taken from tissues of the same or different species of objects; Biological or chemical treatment includes minor treatments such as fixation, sterilization, and antigenicity elimination to maintain the original configuration of the tissue, as well as strong treatments such as dismantling the original configuration and reconstructing a new physical form. The former involves treating fixed pig heart valves, bovine pericardium, bovine carotid artery, human skeletal artery, as well as freeze-dried bone fragments, pig skin, bovine skin, amniotic membrane, embryonic skin, etc. with glutaraldehyde; The latter includes powder, fiber, membrane, cavernous body, etc. composed of regenerated collagen, elasticity, hyaluronic acid, chondroitin sulfate and chitosan. Due to the loss of vitality of processed biological tissues? Biologically derived materials are non vital materials. However, because biologically derived materials either have a configuration and function similar to natural tissues, or their composition is similar to natural tissues, they play an important role in maintaining the repair and replacement of human dynamic processes.

explanation_cn: 细胞或组织在材料表面上的内在附着。这种附着吋以是机械的、物理的、化学的和生物的相互作用。一般认为，生物附着常发生在生物粘连的早期阶段。
explanation_en: The internal attachment of cells or tissues on the surface of materials. This adhesion is a mechanical, physical, chemical, and biological interaction. It is generally believed that bioattachment often occurs in the early stage of bioadhesion.

explanation_cn: 在生理环境和生物体内，以及在微生物作用下，由于物理、化学、生物、机械等复杂因素的作用，一些材料或物质的结构和性质会发生变化，例如腐蚀、分解、溶解或分子量降低等现象。生物降解是一个复杂的过程，受到生物环境的影响，包括体内环境（如pH值、离子、酶等）、微生物以及其他生物学因素。除了生物学因素外，材料本身的结构和性质也会影响生物降解的过程。例如，脂肪族化合物通常比芳香族化合物更容易被生物降解，不同种类的材料具有不同的降解机制。高分子材料的生物降解通常涉及到分子链中的化学键断裂以及其他分子间作用力的破坏；金属材料的生物降解主要是由于物体内存在的电解质导致金属和合金电极电位的变化，从而引发电化学腐蚀；生物陶瓷的生物降解与其结构中的微孔有关，涉及体内的溶解和细胞内的降解。生物降解的降解产物如果能够通过机体的正常新陈代谢机制排出或吸收，就不会对机体造成不良影响；否则可能对机体产生毒副作用。
explanation_en: In the physiological environment and organism, as well as under the action of microorganisms, the structure and properties of some materials or substances will change due to the effects of complex factors such as physics, chemistry, biology and machinery, such as corrosion, decomposition, dissolution or molecular weight reduction. Biodegradation is a complex process, which is affected by the biological environment, including the internal environment (such as pH, ions, enzymes, etc.), microorganisms, and other biological factors. In addition to biological factors, the structure and properties of materials themselves will also affect the process of biodegradation. For example, aliphatic compounds are usually more easily biodegradation than aromatic compounds, and different types of materials have different degradation mechanisms. The biodegradation of macromolecule materials usually involves the fracture of chemical bonds in molecular chains and the destruction of other intermolecular forces; Biodegradation of metallic materials is mainly due to the change of electrode potential of metals and alloy caused by the existence of elonrolyte in the object, which leads to chemical corrosion of electricity generation; The biodegradation of biological cemmics is related to the micropores in its structure, involving dissolution in vivo and degradation in cells. If the biodegradation degradation products can be discharged or absorbed through the normal metabolic mechanism of the body, they will not cause adverse effects on the body; Otherwise, it may have toxic side effects on the body.

explanation_cn: 是一种在植入人体后能够在生理环境中发生分子量降低、分解或表面腐蚀的管状支架。这些支架既可以在一段时间内支持管壁，保持血管通畅，又能抑制早期血栓形成和晚期新生内膜增生。此外，它们还可以作为药物的局部释放载体，以有效防止支架植入后的血管急性闭塞和降低再狭窄的发生率。研究表明，可生物降解聚合物支架的制备材料有多种选择，如聚乳酸、聚己内酯、聚羟基乙酸、聚羟基丁酸戊酯、聚氧化乙烯等。生物可降解性血管支架可以分为四种类型：生物降解膜覆盖金属支架、药物涂层支架、完全生物可降解性冠状动脉支架和载药生物可降解性冠状动脉支架。尽管这方面的研究取得了显著进展，但仍然存在一些问题。此外，还有基于镁合金制备的可降解支架。镁合金的优点是可以被人体吸收，但缺点是密度小，支架在X射线下不能显示，因此需要采用血管内超声引导来定位，这增加了手术的难度和费用。虽然镁合金的冠状动脉支架已经进行了人体临床试验，但其治疗效果和对人体的副作用仍需要更长时间的临床观察和更多的临床数据验证。随着科学技术的进步和各学科间的合作加强，载药生物可降解官腔支架有望取得更大的成功
explanation_en: It is a kind of tubular stem that can reduce the molecular weight, decompose or corrosion the surface in the physiological environment after implantation in the human body. These stem can not only support the tube wall for a period of time, keep the blood vessels unobstructed, but also inhibit early thrombosis and late neointimal hyperplasia. In addition, they can also be used as local drug release carriers to effectively prevent acute occlusion of blood vessels after implantation of stem and reduce the incidence of restenosis. The research shows that there are many choices of materials for the preparation of biodegradation polymer stem, such as polylactic acid, poly (e-caprolactone), polyglycolic acid, polyglycol butyrate, polyoxyethylene, etc. Biodegradable vascular stent can be divided into four types: biodegradable membrane covered metal stem, drug coated stem, fully biodegradable coronary stem and drug loaded biodegradable coronary stem. Although significant progress has been made in this area of research, there are still some problems. In addition, there are degradation stem based on magnesium alloys. The advantage of magnesium alloy is that it can be absorbed by the human body, but the disadvantage is that the density is small, and the stem cannot be displayed under X-ray, so it needs to use intravascular ultrasound induction to locate, which increases the difficulty and cost of surgery. Although magnesium alloy coronary artery stem has been tested in human clinical trials, its therapeutic effect and side effects on human still need longer clinical observation and more clinical data validation. With the progress of science and technology and the strengthening of cooperation among disciplines, drug loaded biodegradable official stem is expected to achieve greater success

explanation_cn: 可在生理环境及生物体中或微生物作用下结构与性质发生变化（如腐蚀、分解、分子量降低等）的材料。生物降解材料主要包括生物降解高分子、生物降解陶瓷、生物降解金属.它们在生物医用领域具有广泛的应用.如生物降解高分子可用于组织工程、药物控制释放及基因传递等领域；生物降解陶瓷可作为骨修复材料;生物降解金属（如镁合金）可用作血管支架。
explanation_en: Materials that can change their structure and properties (such as corrosion, decomposition, molecular weight reduction, etc.) in the physiological environment and organisms or under the action of microorganisms. Biodegradable materials mainly include biodegradation macromolecule, biodegradation ceramics, and biodegradation metals. They are widely used in the biomedical field. For example, biodegradation macromolecule can be used in tissue engineering, drug controlled release, gene transfer, and other fields; Biodegradation ceramics can be used as bone repair materials; Biodegradation metals (such as magnesium alloys) can be used as vascular stent.

explanation_cn: 可在生理环境及生物体中或微生物作用下发生降解的一类高分子材料。理想的生物降解材料能完全分解为C02和H2()。依据降解机理，生物降解高分子材料丨可分为生物破坏性高分子材料和完全生物降解高分子i材料.，生物破坏性高分子材料属于不完全降解材料，主要指天然高分子与通用型高分子材料共混或共聚制得的掺混型降解材料，目前广泛用于包装、卫生、医疗器材等领域.、完全生物降解高分子材料指本身可以被全部分解的生物降解高分子材料，主要有化学合成丨型，如聚乳酸（PLA)、聚己内酯（PCL)、聚丁烯琥珀酸酯（PBS)等；天然高分子型：微生物合成型，如聚羟基脂肪酸酯（PHA)、聚羟基丁酯（PHB)等。影响材料降解性的因素主要包括内部因素（材料的组成、结构、结晶状态等）和外部因素（环境的温度、湿度、pH值以及土壤成分等）。生物降解高分子材料以其无毒、可生物降解及良好的生物相容性等优点，广泛应用于医药、农业、园林、包装、卫生及化妆品等领域，在医学领域的应用主要包括医用楦人材料、药物释放载体、组织工程支架等方面。
explanation_en: It is a kind of macromolecule materials that can be degradation in physiological environment and organism or under the action of microorganism. The ideal biodegradable materials can be completely decomposed into C02 and H2 (). According to the degradation mechanism, biodegradable polymer can be divided into biodegradable macromolecule materials and completely biodegradation macromolecule i materials, Biodestructive macromolecule materials is an incomplete degradation materials, which mainly refers to the blended degradation materials made by polymer blending or copolymerization of natural polymer and general macromolecule materials. It is currently widely used in packaging, health, medical equipment and other fields Fully biodegradable polymer refers to biodegradable polymer that can be completely decomposed, mainly including chemical synthesis, such as polylactic acid (PLA), poly (e-caprolactone) (PCL), polybutylene succinate (PBS), etc; Natural polymer type: microbial synthetic type, such as polyhydroxy fatty acid ester (PHA), polyhydroxybutyl ester (PHB), etc. The factors affecting the degradability of materials mainly include internal factors (materials composition, structure, crystalline state, etc.) and external factors (environmental temperature, humidity, pH value, soil composition, etc.). Biodegradable polymer are widely used in the fields of medicine, agriculture, landscape, packaging, health and cosmetics due to their non-toxic, biodegradation, good biocompatibility and other advantages. Their applications in the medical field mainly include medical last materials, drug release carriers, tissue engineering scaffolds and other aspects.

explanation_cn: 用于生物科学领域的陶瓷材料。包括替代生物（人或动物、植物）硬组织的陶瓷材料、酶或者生物催化剂载体陶瓷材料、生化过滤陶瓷膜以及医药用陶瓷材料。
explanation_en: Ceramics materials used in biological science. It includes ceramics materials, ceramics materials as enzyme or biological catalyst support, ceramics membranes for biochemical filtration, and ceramics materials for medicine, which can replace biological (human or animal, plant) hard tissues.

explanation_cn:
又称生物载体，用于微生物处理污水的系统中，提供微生物附着场所的材料。可以分为定着式、悬挂式、分散型和新型生物填料四种类型。
定着式填料：包括蜂窝状和波纹板状等硬性填料。蜂窝状填料的优点是具有大的孔隙率、充填材料轻便、韧性强、长期使用不会变质，具有长久的稳定性，但缺点是容易堵塞。波纹板状填料具有大孔径、不易堵塞、流程较长、处理效率较高、安装和运输方便，但存在水在波纹通道内流动不均匀，不利于生物膜更新等缺陷。悬挂式填料：分为软性填料、半软性填料、组合填料和弹性填料四类。软性填料应用广泛，易于挂膜，不易堵塞，但容易缠结、结块、断丝，中心绳易断，影响使用寿命。半软性填料弥补了硬性填料易堵塞和软性填料易缠结和断丝两方面的不足，但比表面积相对较小，微生物附着性能相对较差。组合填料兼具软性纤维填料和半软性填料的优点。
分散型填料：包括堆积式和悬浮式填料，如拉西环、鲍尔环、空心球和悬浮粒子等。这种填料不需要固定安装，具有大的比表面积，容易脱膜，不断运动中能够得到连续不断的冲洗，不容易堵塞，水中的溶氧值提高快，氧气传输效率高，微生物代谢旺盛。新型生物填料：包括固定化微生物填料和酶促填料。具有高生物量、优势菌种明显、处理效率高、设备占地面积小、产生废污泥量低等优点。
explanation_en: Also known as biological vector, it is used in the system of microbial sewage treatment to provide materials for microbial attachment sites. It can be divided into four types: fixed, suspended, dispersed and new biological filter media. Fixed fillers: including hard fillers such as honeycomb and corrugated plates. Honeycomb filler has the advantages of large porosity, lightweight filling materials, strong toughness, long-term use will not deteriorate, and long-term stability, but the disadvantage is easy to plug. Corrugated plate-like packing has large pore size, is not easy to block, has a long process, high treatment efficiency, and is easy to install and transport. However, there are some defects such as uneven flow of water in the corrugated channel, which is not conducive to the renewal of biomembrane. Suspended packing: it is divided into soft packing, semi soft packing, combined packing and elasticity packing. Soft filler is widely used, easy to hang film, not easy to block, but easy to tangle, block, break wire, and the center rope is easy to break, affecting the service life. Semi soft fillers make up for the shortcomings of hard fillers that are easy to block and soft fillers that are easy to tangle and break, but the specific surface is relatively small, and the microbial adhesion is relatively poor. Composite fillers have the advantages of both soft fiber fillers and semi soft fillers. Disperse fillers: including stacked and suspended fillers, such as Rasch rings, Bauer rings, hollow spheres, and suspended particles. This kind of filler does not need fixed installation. It has a large specific surface and is easy to remove the membrane. It can be continuously washed during continuous movement and is not easy to block. The dissolved oxygen value in water increases rapidly, the oxygen transmission efficiency is high, and microbial metabolism is vigorous. New biological filter media: including immobilized microbial filler and enzymatic filler. It has the advantages of high biomass, obvious advantageous bacterial species, high treatment efficiency, small equipment footprint, and low waste sludge production.

explanation_cn: 用可调节的化学（无机）组成和温度部分模拟生物学、生理学或细胞周围的环境。指和生物材料接触的体液的物理化学特征，常用pH值和所含阴离子、阳离子等来表征，不反映环境中的有机质和细胞等情况。
explanation_en: Simulate the biological, physiological, or cellular environment using adjustable chemical (inorganic) composition and temperature components. It refers to the physical chemistry characteristics of body fluids in contact with biological materials, which are usually characterized by pH value, anions, cations, etc., and do not reflect the organic matter and cells in the environment.

explanation_cn: 又称石灰。将主要成分为碳酸钙的天然岩石，在适当温度下煅烧，排除分解出的二氧化碳后，所得的以氧化钙（CaO)为主要成分的产品。
explanation_en: It is also called lime. The natural rock with the main component of calcium carbonate is calcined at an appropriate temperature to remove the carbon dioxide decomposed, and the product with calcium oxide (CaO) as the main component is obtained.

explanation_cn: 又称生橡胶，指从天然橡胶植物或人工合成生产出来的未经配合加工硫化的橡原料。
explanation_en: Also known as raw rubber, it refers to the raw rubber materials produced from natural rubber plants or artificial synthesis that are not processed and vulcanization together.

explanation_cn: 碳含量大于2.11%的铁碳合金，通常铁的碳含量多在2.5至4.5%之间。
explanation_en: Iron carbon alloys with a carbon content greater than 2.11% typically have a carbon content of between 2.5 and 4.5%.

explanation_cn: 具有刺激细胞生长活性功能的多肽类物质，其由细胞产生，通过与特异的、高亲和的细胞膜受体结合，对其细胞自身或周边细胞的生存、增殖以及迁移等生物学行为具有调控作用.且对不同种类细胞其生物活性具有一定的专一性。
explanation_en: Polypeptides with the function of irritation cell growth activity are produced by cells. They can regulate the survival, proliferation, migration and other biological behaviors of their own cells or surrounding cells by binding to specific, high affinity cell membrane receptors, and have certain specificity for the bioactivity of different types of cells.

explanation_cn: 见孪晶
explanation_en: See twin

explanation_cn: 见生长条纹。
explanation_en: See growth striation.

explanation_cn: 又称生长层，晶体中常见的一种宏观缺陷.它的存在严重地破坏了晶体的均匀性，使晶体的物理、化学、光学、力学等性能出现周期性和间歇性的变化.严重影响了晶体的质量。生长条纹的形成主要是由于温度起伏或生长速率起伏引起溶质浓度的起伏.从而使晶体中成分产生起伏。
explanation_en: Also called growth layer, a common macroscopic defect in crystal. Its existence seriously destroys the uniformity of crystal, making periodic and intermittent changes in physical, chemical, optical, mechanical and other properties of crystal, and seriously affecting the quality of crystal. The formation of growth striation is mainly due to the fluctuation of solute concentration caused by the fluctuation of temperature or growth rate, which makes the composition of crystal fluctuate.

explanation_cn: 化学式CH3SiCl3,无色液体。相对密度1.273 (25°C),熔 点一77.8°C,沸点 66.4°C：,折射率 1.415 (25°C)。
explanation_en: Chemical formula CH3SiCl3, colorless liquid. Relative density 1.273 (25 ° C), melting point -77.8 ° C, boiling point 66.4 ° C, refractive index 1.415 (25 ° C).

explanation_cn: 甲基丙储酸及其酯或衍生物的均聚物和共聚物。其热稳定性、硬 度和刚性较丙烯酸系聚合物为好，且随其酯基碳原子增加，树脂的柔软性增加。
explanation_en: Homopolymer and copolymer of methyl propionic acid and its esters or derivatives. Its thermal stability, hardness and rigidity are better than those of acrylic polymer, and the flexibility of resin increases with the increase of its ester based carbon atoms.

name_cn: 甲基丙烯酸甲酯-丁二烯-苯乙烯共聚物
explanation_cn: 是一种非晶性热塑性高分子材料，由丁苯弹性体、甲基丙烯酸甲酯和苯乙烯等组分经过接枝共聚制备而成。典型的MBS中，苯乙烯含量在15%到20%之间。通过共聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯，使树脂组分的折射率与橡胶组分接近，这使得MBS材料具有透明性。与普通的MBS相比，它在保留了MS（丙烯腈-苯乙烯-丙烯酸甲酯）材料的优点的同时，也提高了低温冲击性能。但它的耐化学品性能和耐老化性能相对较差。MBS的密度约为1.07g/cm3，透光率（3.2mm厚度）可达85%，浊度（3.2mm厚度）约为12%。其拉伸断裂强度为38MPa，断裂伸长率在12%到18%之间。简支梁缺口冲击强度达到281J/m2，洛氏硬度为R100。热变形温度（1.82MPa）为84°C，介电强度达到20kV/mm。工业生产中，通常采用乳液接枝共聚法，使用丁苯胶乳、甲基丙烯酸甲酯和丁苯等原料制备MBS。MBS材料在用途上类似于ABS，但更具透明性。它通常与PVC（聚氯乙烯）进行共混，其中MBS的添加量在5%到12%之间。这种材料可通过注射成型、模压、挤出和吹塑等方法制成透明的板材、片材和管材，广泛用于包装材料、工业和民用制品，以及电气和机械产品的透明外壳和零部件制造等领域。
explanation_en: It is a kind of amorphous thermoplastic macromolecule materials, which is prepared by graft copolymerization of styrene butadiene elastomer, methyl methacrylate, styrene and other components. In a typical MBS, the styrene content ranges from 15% to 20%. By copolymerizing methyl methacrylate, the refractive index of resin component is close to that of rubber component, which makes MBS materials transparent. Compared with ordinary MBS, it not only retains the advantages of MS (acrylonitrile styrene methyl acrylate) materials, but also improves the low-temperature impact properties. But its chemical resistance and aging resistance are relatively poor. The density of MBS is about 1.07g/cm 3， The transmittance (3.2mm thickness) can reach 85%, and the turbidity (3.2mm thickness) is about 12%. The tensile fracture strength is 38MPa, and the percentage elongation after fracture is between 12% and 18%. The notch impact strength of simply supported beam reaches 281J/m 2， The Rock well hardness hardness is R100. The heat deflection temperature (1.82MPa) is 84 ° C, and the dielectric strength reaches 20kV/mm. In industrial production, MBS is usually prepared by lotion graft copolymerization using styrenebutadiene latex, methyl methacrylate, styrene butadiene and other raw materials. MBS materials is similar to ABS in use, but more transparent. It is usually polymer blending with PVC (polyvinyl chloride), and the addition amount of MBS is between 5% and 12%. This materials can be made into transparent plates, sheets and tube through injection molding, molding, extrusion and blow molding, and is widely used in packaging materials, industrial and civil products, as well as transparent shells and parts manufacturing of electrical and mechanical products.

explanation_cn: 二甲基硅氧烷和甲基乙烯基硅氧烷的共聚物，为无色透明塑性体。与填料、硫化剂和加工助剂所组成的混配物，经硫化加工后可成为弹性体。
explanation_en: The copolymer of dimethyl siloxane and methyl vinyl siloxane is a colorless transparent plastic body. The mixture composed of filler, vulcanizing agent and processing additive can become elastomer after vulcanization processing.

explanation_cn: 分子中含有Si-H键的聚二甲基硅氧烷无色透明油状液体，分全含氢和部分含氢两种。全含氢硅油是由甲基氢二氯硅烷和三甲基氯硅烷共水解，经酸催化平衡、脱除低分子物后而制得。若在上述反应中加入二甲基二氯硅烷共水解，则可制得部分含氢硅油。主要应用于纺织、纸张、皮革、金属、玻璃、木材等建筑材料上，作为防水剂、防黏剂、防锈剂的主要成分，若与羟基硅油乳液共同处理织物，可提高织物的抗撕裂、耐磨和防污性能，还可改善手感和缝合性。此外，含氢硅油还可在柏催化下与含碳官能的不饱和键加成，作为制备改性硅油和加成硫化硅橡胶的交联剂。
explanation_en: A colorless transparent oily liquid of polydimethylsiloxane containing Si-H bonds in its molecules, divided into two types: fully hydrogenated and partially hydrogenated. Fully hydrogenated silicone oil is prepared by co hydrolysis of methylhydrochlorosilane and trimethylchlorosilane, acid catalytic equilibrium, and removal of low molecular substances. If dimethyl dichlorosilane is added to the above reaction for co hydrolysis, a part of hydrogen containing silicone oil can be prepared. It is mainly used in textile, paper, leather, metal, glass, wood and other building materials as the main component of waterproof agent, anti sticking agent and rust inhibitor. If the fabric is treated together with hydroxyl silicone oil lotion, it can improve the tear resistance, wear resistance and antifouling properties of the fabric, and also improve the hand feel and stitching. In addition, hydrogen containing silicone oil can also be added to the unsaturated bond of carbon containing function under the catalysis of cypress, as a cross linking agent for the preparation of modified silicone oil and addition vulcanized silicone rubber.

explanation_cn: 无色透明液体，具有刺激气味，易潮解。溶于苯、乙醚、乙烷等。主要用于生产含氢硅油、甲基乙烯基单体及改性硅油等。
explanation_en: Colorless transparent liquid, with irritation smell, easy to deliquescence. Soluble in benzene, ether, ethane, etc. It is mainly used to produce hydrogen containing silicone oil, methyl vinyl monomer and modified silicone oil.

explanation_cn: 无色透明高黏滞塑性直链高分子化合物，主链由硅和氧原子组 成，与硅相连的侧基为甲基。
explanation_en: Colorless transparent high viscosity plastic straight chain macromolecule compound, the main chain is composed of silicon and oxygen atoms, and the side group connected with silicon is methyl.

explanation_cn: 又称纤维素甲醚。灰内色纤维状粉末，无臭，无味。在水中溶胀成澄清或微浑浊的胶体溶液，在无水乙醇、氯仿或乙醚中不溶。分子式：[C6H7O2(OH)3]n。纤维素甲醚是通过将纤维素与碱液反应生成的碱性纤维素。在一定压力下与氯甲烷反应可制备粗甲基纤维素，经过分离、洗涤、干燥、粉碎等步骤制备成粉状物。甲基纤维素水溶液经长时间储存仍然稳定，且具有抗霉菌生长的性质。在浓的过氧化物存在下，甲基纤维素可以分解。水溶液中的甲基纤维素不带电荷。其水溶液表面张力低于水，同时具有良好的黏附性、分散性。甲基纤维素在各种工业领域有广泛应用。由于它能形成高黏度的溶液，表面张力小于水，并且具有优良的润湿性和分散性，因此可用作增稠剂、悬浮剂、分散剂等。此外，它还可用作成膜剂和胶黏剂，以及用于防止动物、植物和矿物油脂的渗透，因此可作为耐油脂的表面处理剂。
explanation_en: Also known as cellulose methyl ether. Grey inner color fibrous powder, odorless and tasteless. Swelling in water to form a clear or slightly turbid colloidal solution, which is insoluble in absolute ethanol, chloroform or ether. Molecular formula: [C6H7O2 (OH) 3] n. Cellulose methyl ether is an alkaline cellulose produced by reacting cellulose with alkaline solution. The crude methyl cellulose can be prepared by reacting with methyl chloride under a certain pressure, and the powder can be prepared through the steps of separation, washing, drying, crushing, etc. Ethyl cellulose aqueous solution is still stable after long-term storage, and has the property of anti mold growth. In the presence of concentrated peroxide, ethyl cellulose can be decomposed. Ethyl cellulose in aqueous solution is not charged. The surface tension of its aqueous solution is lower than that of water, and it has good adhesion and dispersion. Ethyl cellulose is widely used in various industrial fields. Because it can form a solution with high viscosity, surface tension is less than water, and has excellent wettability and dispersibility, it can be used as thickener, suspending agent, dispersing agent, etc. In addition, it can also be used as a film-forming agent and adhesive, as well as to prevent the penetration of animal, plant, and mineral oils, making it a oil-resistant surface treatment agent.

explanation_cn: 又称一甲基肼、一甲肼。易溶于水、低级醇及某些碳氢化合物。吸湿性强，中闪点易燃液体，系强还原剂，与许多氧化性物质发生反应，与强氧化剂接触能自燃。铁、钼、铜等金属及其氧化物对其有催化分解作用。采用氯胺法生产，制得甲基肼水溶液，经分离、去盐、浓缩、蒸馏等步骤制得纯品。广泛用作可储存液体推进剂燃料，可单独使用，也可与无水肼、偏二甲肼组成混合燃料。常与四氧化二氮等氧化剂组成双组元液体推进剂，用于航天器轨道姿态控制系统。
explanation_en: Also known as monomethylhydrazine, monomethylhydrazine. Easily soluble in water, lower alcohols, and certain hydrocarbons. Strong hygroscopicity, medium flash point flammable liquid, a strong reducing agent, reacts with many oxidizing substances, and can spontaneously ignite when in contact with strong oxidizing agents. Iron, molybdenum, copper and other metals and their oxides have catalytic decomposition effect on them. The monomethylhudrazine aqueous solution is produced by chloramine method, and the pure product is obtained through separation, desalting, concentration, distillation and other steps. It is widely used as a liquid propellant fuel that can be stored. It can be used alone or mixed with hydrazine and unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine. A bicomponent liquid propellant often composed of oxidizing agents such as nitrogen tetroxide is used in spacecraft orbit and attitude control systems.

explanation_cn: 甲基苯基硅油是一种透明油状液体，是线型聚硅氧烷，其中包含平基苯基或二苯基硅氧烷链节的成分。相较于同黏度的甲基硅油，它表现出一些不同的特性。它具有较高的黏温系数，较低的凝固点和闪点。抗压缩性较甲基硅油低，而在压力下，其黏度变化更为敏感。此外，甲基苯基硅油还具有较高的氧化稳定性和耐辐照性能。该油的性质会随着苯基含量的增加而发生变化，包括相对密度和折射率的增加。在升高温度下，该油的性能在经过一段时间后依然不会发生变化。特别是高苯基含量的硅油展现出出色的耐辐照性能，即使在受到剂量为5.16X10^12C/kg的辐射后，仍能继续使用。此外，其润滑性能也优于甲基硅油。典型的甲基苯基硅油具有黏度在25°C时为100至200mm^2/s，相对密度（25°C）为1.02至1.08，折射率（25°C）为1.480至1.495，凝固点低于-40°C，闪点（开杯）高于300°C。制备甲基苯基硅油通常通过水解二苯基二氯硅烷或甲基苯基二氯硅烷，然后添加适量的止链剂，并经过催化平衡和去除低分子物质制得。此外，也可以通过二苯基硅二醇与八甲基环四硅氧烷、止链剂在碱的催化平衡下制备。甲基苯基硅油广泛应用于金属制品的热处理浴、高温加热油、气液色谱间定液、电子电气设备的高低温润滑油以及大型电力电容器的浸渍剂等领域。
explanation_en: Methylphenylsiliconeoil is a transparent oily liquid, which is linear polysiloxane, and contains the components of flat phenyl or diphenylsiloxane chain links. Compared with methyl silicone oil with the same viscosity, it shows some different characteristics. It has a higher viscosity temperature coefficient, lower solidification point and flash point. The compression resistance is lower than that of methyl silicone oil, and its viscosity is more sensitive to change under pressure. In addition, methyl phenyl silicone oil also has high oxidation stability and radiation resistance. The properties of the oil will change with the increase of phenyl content, including the increase of relative density and refractive index. At elevated temperatures, the performance of the oil remains unchanged after a period of time. In particular, silicone oil with high phenyl content shows excellent radiation resistance, and can continue to be used even after being irradiated with 5.16X10 ^ 12C/kg. In addition, its lubricating performance is also better than that of methyl silicone oil. Typical methylphenylsiliconeoil has a viscosity of 100 to 200mm ^ 2/s at 25 ° C, a relative density (25 ° C) of 1.02 to 1.08, a refractive index (25 ° C) of 1.480 to 1.495, a freezing point of less than -40 ° C, and a flash point (open cup) of more than 300 ° C. The preparation of methyl phenyl silicone oil is usually made by hydrolyzing diphenyldichlorosilane or methyl phenyl dichlorosilane, adding an appropriate amount of chain stopper, and then through catalytic equilibrium and removal of low molecular substances. In addition, diphenylsilanediol can also be prepared with octamethylcyclotetrasiloxane and chain stoppers under the catalytic equilibrium of alkali. Methylphenylsiliconeoil is widely used in heat treatment bath of metal products, high-temperature heating oil, gas-liquid chromatography, high and low temperature lubricating oil of electronic and electrical equipment, impregnant of large power capacitor and other fields.

explanation_cn: 由三甲基铝与水反应得到的线型及环型产物。茂金属催化剂中常用的助催化剂，由三甲基铝部分水解得到的一种低分子量聚合物，聚合度为5-30。甲基铝氧烷结构组成复杂，化学简式为(C5H12O3)n，CAS号：120144-90-3。常温、常压下为白色无定形粉末，对水分及空气有很强的敏感性，应密封储存，可溶于苯、甲苯、二甲苯等芳香烃中，在脂肪烃如己烷、庚烷中溶解度小。
explanation_en: Linear and cyclic products obtained from the reaction of trimethylaluminum with water. The co catalyst commonly used in metallocene catalyst is a low molecular weight polymer obtained by partial hydrolysis of trimethyl aluminum, with degree of polymerization of 5-30. The structure and composition of methylaluminoxane are complex, and its chemical formula is (C5H12O3) n, CAS No.: 120144-90-3. It is a white amorphous powder under normal temperature and pressure, which is highly sensitive to water and air. It should be sealed and stored. It is soluble in benzene, toluene, xylene and other aromatic hydrocarbons, and has low water solubility in aliphatic hydrocarbons such as hexane and heptane.

explanation_cn: 把甲烷变成富氢气体混合物的过程。不论是通过部分氧化重整、水蒸气重整、热平衡重整还是高温裂解重整，工业化规模的甲烷重整技术是很成熟的。
explanation_en: The process of converting methane into a mixture of hydrogen rich gases. Whether through partial oxidation reforming, steam reforming, autothermal reforming or thermal reforming, the industrialized methane reforming technology is very mature.

explanation_cn: 在直接甲醇燃料电池中甲醇可以穿过质子交换膜从阳极移动到阴极，和甲醇透过率相对应的电流叫作甲醇穿透电流。
explanation_en: In a direct methanol fuel cell, methanol can move from anode to cathode through the proton exchange membrane. The current corresponding to the methanol transmittance is called methanol crossover current.

explanation_cn: 用脲醛树脂等甲醛系列胶黏剂压制成的人造板，在制造、堆放、使用过程中向外界不断散发游离甲醛气体的现象。测定人造板甲醛释放量的方法有干燥器法、穿孔萃取法以及气候箱法等。
explanation_en: The wood based-panel pressing with formaldehyde series adhesive such as urea formaldehyde resin continuously emits free formaldehyde gas to the outside world during manufacturing, stacking and use. The methods for measuring formaldehyde release emission from wood based-panel include desiccator method, perforated extraction method and climate chamber method.

explanation_cn: 见介电相位角。
explanation_en: See dielectric phase angle.

explanation_cn: 主要是绝缘材料形成的薄膜。用于电子、光电子器件中，起绝缘或保护作用。在器件中作为隔离电极的绝缘层，还要考虑它的介电特性。利用热电效应可进行热电转换，制成红外传感器等，参见电绝缘膜。
explanation_en: It is mainly the film formed by insulating materials. Used in electronic and optoelectronic devices for insulation or protection. As the insulation layer of the isolation electrode in the device, its dielectric properties should also be considered. The thermoelectric effect can be used for thermoelectric conversion to make infrared sensors, etc. See electrical insulation film.

explanation_cn: 不导电或具有很大的电阻率的陶瓷薄膜材料，被广泛应用于微电子技术和光电子技术中。
explanation_en: Ceramics thin film materials, which is non-conductive or has a large resistivity, is widely used in microelectronics and optoelectronics.

explanation_cn: 能够加快电化学反应速度而自身不被消耗的物质。为增加其单位质量的表面积，电催化剂一般被制成纳米颗粒、原子层或多孔状。
explanation_en: A substance that can accelerate electrochemical reactions without being consumed. In order to increase the surface area per unit mass, electrocatalyst are generally made into nanoparticle, atomic layers or porous structures.

explanation_cn: 当一块固体在直流电场或低频（相对于光频）交流电场的作用下内部发生电极化，使固体内部的介电常数ε折射率n等发生改变，从而影响频率为ω的光波在固体中的传输特性。
explanation_en: When a solid is internally polarized under the action of a DC electric field or a low-frequency (relative to light frequency) AC electric field, the dielectric constant inside the solid is ε The refractive index n and other factors change, thereby affecting the frequency ω The transmission characteristics of light waves in solids.

explanation_cn: 具有电光效应的晶体的统称。指在外加电场作用下，折射率发生变化的晶体。与光折变晶体（光照引起晶体内载流子重新分布而引起折射率变化的晶体）相对应。依其电光效应的不同而分为泡克耳斯晶体和克尔晶体两大类。
explanation_en: Crystal with electrophoto effect. It refers to the crystal whose refractive index changes under the action of an external electric field. It corresponds to phot (a crystal whose refractive index changes due to the redistribution of carriers in the crystal caused by light). According to its electrophoto effect, it can be divided into two categories: Pockels crystal and Kerr crystal.

explanation_cn: 具有电光效应的材料。依其电光效应的特征分泡克耳斯材料与克尔材料两种。通常制成器件应用于激光束的调制、偏转和开关。材料电光效应的大小以电光系数和半波电压衡量。
explanation_en: Materials with electrophoto effect. According to the characteristics of its electrophoto effect, it can be divided into Pockels materials and Kerr material. Usually made devices are used for modulation, deflection, and switching of laser beams. The electrophoto effect of materials is measured by electro-optic coefficient and half wave voltage.

explanation_cn: 基于电化学原理发展起来的各类工艺技术，如电解、电镀、电抛光、电泳、电渗析、电凝聚气浮、电化学氧化等。可应用于无机化工原料制备、有机化合物合成、金属提取、金属表面精整、化工原料分离、水污染物处理、土壤修复、电子元件制造、腐蚀控制、电池制备等领域。
explanation_en: Various process technologies developed based on electrochemical principles, such as electrolysis, electroplating, electropolishing, electrophoresis, electrodialysis, electrocoagulation air flotation, electrochemical oxidation, etc. It can be used in the fields of inorganic chemical raw material preparation, organic compound synthesis, metal extraction, metal surface finishing, chemical raw material separation, water pollutant treatment, soil remediation, electronic component manufacturing, corrosion control, battery preparation, etc.

explanation_cn: 电化学沉积活化改性是指通过电化学的方法在生物医用金属表面沉积一层具有生物活性的磷酸钙盐涂层，赋予金属表面生物活性。其基本原理是使用含Ca2+等离子的溶液作为电解液，通过控制电化学反应条件，调节阴极界面化学环境.使得作为阴极的金属表面附近电解液的局部pH值增大，电解液中的Ca2+在阴极表面达到磷酸钙盐临界过饱和度，从而在阴极上沉积出磷酸钙盐涂层。电化学沉积法具有反应条件温和、可获得高生物活性的纯羟基磷灰石晶体、工艺简单、易于操作、成本低廉等优点。
explanation_en: Bioactivation by electrochemical deposition is to deposit a layer of bioactivity calcium phosphate coating on the surface of biomedical metal by electrochemical method, giving the metal surface bioactivity. The basic principle is to use the solution containing Ca2+plasma as the electrolyte, adjust the chemical environment of the cathode interface by controlling the electrochemical reaction conditions, so that the local pH value of the electrolyte near the metal surface as the cathode increases, and the Ca2+in the electrolyte reaches the critical supersaUiration degree of calcium phosphate on the cathode surface, thus depositing a calcium phosphate coating on the cathode. The electrochemical deposition method has the advantages of mild reaction conditions, obtaining pure hydroxyapatite crystal with high bioactivity, simple process, easy operation and low cost.

explanation_cn: 单位几何面积催化剂层内能够催化电化学反应的催化剂总表面积。由于处在三相界面处的催化剂表面才能催化电化学反应，电化学活性面积一般小于按照催化剂颗粒的大小所计算出来的总面积，或按照一些物理方法（如BET方法）所测出来的总面积。
explanation_en: The total surface area of the catalyst layer per unit geometric area that can catalyze electrochemical reactions. Since the catalyst surface at the three-phase boundary or three-phase region can catalyze electrochemical reaction, the electrochemically active surface area is generally smaller than the total area calculated according to the size of catalyst particles, or the total area measured according to some physical methods (such as BET method).

explanation_cn: 是基于在电极表面发生的生物反应（生物分子的识别、生化反应和形成产物）而引起的电化学信号（电位、电流或电阻），由此确定生物分子种类和浓度的一种传感器。电化学生物传感器可分为电位型、电流型、电导型、电容型和阻抗型传感器。根据检测的生物对象的不同，电化学生物传感器也可以分为微生物、酶、免疫、细胞、组织、蛋白质和DNA传感器。
explanation_en: It is a sensor that determines the type and concentration of biomolecules based on electrochemical signals (potential, current, or resistance) caused by biological reactions (recognition of biomolecules, biochemical reactions, and formation products) occurring on the electrode surface. Electrochemical biosensor can be divided into potential type, current type, conductivity type, capacitance type and impedance type sensors. According to the different biological objects detected, electrochemical biosensors can also be divided into microbial, enzyme, immune, cell, tissue, protein and dna sensor.

explanation_cn: 金属和电解质接触时，由于腐蚀电池作用而引起的金属腐蚀现象称为电化学腐蚀，其特点在于，腐蚀历程可分为两个相对独立的并同时进行的阳极（发生氧化反应）和阴极（发生还原反应）过程。
explanation_en: When metal contacts with elonrolyte, metal corrosion caused by corrosion battery is called electrochemical corrosion, which is characterized by that corrosion process can be divided into two relatively independent and simultaneous anode (oxidation reaction) and cathode (reduction reaction) processes.

explanation_cn: 金属摩擦件在酸、碱、盐等电解质中，由于形成微电池发生电化学反应而产生材料损耗的现象。
explanation_en: In elonrolyte such as acid, alkali, salt, etc., metal friction parts produce materials loss due to the formation of micro batteries and electrochemical reaction.

explanation_cn: 电化学体系通过电流发生电极反应时，在电极上单位电量引起反应物的理论变化量。常用的单位为g/U或g/(A·h)等。电化当量在电解、电镀、化学电源等电化学工业和科学研究中有广泛的应用，是进行一系列设计和计算的基础数据。
explanation_en: When an electrochemical system undergoes electrode reactions through current, the theoretical change in reactants caused by a unit charge on the electrode. The commonly used units are g/U or g/(A · h), etc. Electrochemical equivalent is widely used in electrochemical industry and scientific research such as electrolysis, electroplating, chemical power supply, etc. It is the basic data for a series of design and calculation.

explanation_cn: 一种具有电变色效应的材料。在电场的作用下，发生离子与电子的共注入与共抽出，导致材料的价态与化学组分发生可逆变化，从而使材料的穿透与发射特性发生变化。这类材料能够根据要求进行主动动态调节，一般调节时所加电压较低（小于3V),并仅在变色过程中需要能量供给，变色后具有长期的记忆效应。电变色材料一般分为有机与无机两大类。
explanation_en: A materials with electrochromic effect. Under the action of the electric field, the co injection and co extraction of ions and electrons occur, leading to the reversible change of the valence state and chemical composition of materials, thus changing the penetration and emission characteristics of materials. This kind of materials can be actively and dynamically adjusted according to requirements. Generally, the applied voltage is low (less than 3V), and only needs energy supply in the process of color change. After color change, it has long-term memory effect. Electrochromic materials are generally divided into organic and inorganic categories.

explanation_cn: 含有两个或以上膜电极的燃料电池。电堆中一个单电池的正极与另一个单电池的负极相连，各单电池之间通过极板串联在一起。除膜电极外，单电池或电堆还含有其他部件，如极板、密封塾、电流收集体、端板等。下图是由两个单电池组成的一个电堆的示意。
explanation_en: A fuel cell containing two or more membrane electrode. The positive pole of one single cell in the stack is connected to the negative pole of another single cell, and each single cell is connected in series through a plate. In addition to the membrane electrode, the single cell or stack also contains other components, such as plate, sealed cell, current collector, end plate, etc. The following figure shows a stack composed of two single batteries.

explanation_cn: 电堆所发出的电能占进入电堆燃料量低热焓值的百分比。
explanation_en: The percentage of the electric energy emitted by the stack to the low enthalpy value of the fuel entering the stack.

explanation_cn: 描述的是固体中晶格热运动与电子运动行为的关联。在有限温度下，晶体中的原子总是在其平衡格点位置附近进行着往复的热振动运动。晶格振动对晶体中的周期性势场产生微扰，该微扰进而影响了附近电子的运动行为。固体的许多物理性质与电子-声子相互作用密切相关，例如电导、热导和超导性质等等。电子-声子散射是固体电阻存在的主要原因。电子-声子耦合系数决定着电子与晶格之间的热弛豫速率，与材料热导率关系密切。第I类超导体的超导机理就是由于材料在极低温度下电子-声子的耦合效应形成库珀电子对，超导现象归因于库珀电子对凝聚态的形成。
explanation_en: It describes the correlation between lattice thermal motion and electronic motion behavior in solids. At a finite temperature, atoms in a crystal always carry out reciprocating thermal vibration near their equilibrium lattice points. The lattice vibration perturbs the periodic potential field in the crystal, which in turn affects the motion of nearby electrons. Many physical properties of solids are closely related to electrorr phonon interaction, such as conductivity, thermal conductivity and superconductivity. Electron phonon scattering is the main reason for the existence of solid resistance. The electron phonon coupling coefficient determines the thermal relaxation rate between the electron and the lattice, and is closely related to the thermal conductivity of materials. The superconducting mechanism of type I superconductors is that the Cooper electron pair is formed by the electron phonon coupling effect of materials at extremely low temperatures, and the superconducting phenomenon is attributed to the formation of Cooper electron pair condensate.

explanation_cn: 真空能级和导带底之间的能量差[单位为电子伏（eV)]。
explanation_en: The energy difference between the vacuum energy level and the bottom of the conduction band [unit: eV].

explanation_cn: 在外电场作用下，电介质内部束缚在原子、离子或分子上的电子相对于原子核发生弹性位移，即电子云变形而形成的极化。
explanation_en: Under the action of the external electric field, the electrons bound to atoms, ions or molecules in the dielectric have elasticity displacement relative to the atomic nucleus, that is, the polarization formed by the deformation of the electron cloud.

explanation_cn: 电子在光的作用下可被陷餅俘获和释放的一种可擦除光存储材料。主要为双掺杂的碱土硫化物。基质提供较宽的带隙，掺入的两种杂质分别作为电子和孔穴俘获中心，它们能在光照下相互作用。
explanation_en: An erasable optical storage materials in which electrons can be captured and released by traps under the action of light. Mainly double doped alkaline earth sulfides. The matrix provides a wide bandgap, and the two impurities doped serve as electron and hole capture centers, which can interact under light.

explanation_cn: 电子元器件是电子元件和电子器件的总称，如电阻器、电容器、电感器、二极管、晶体极管、场效应晶体管、连接器等。电子元器件材料是指制备电子元器件所用到的相关材料，如金属箔材料、金属丝、电介质、铁电材料、压电材料、磁性材料、磁光材料、有机电介质材料、陶瓷材料、金属封装材料、复合封装材料等。
explanation_en: Electronic components are the general term of electronic components and electronic devices, such as resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, crystal transistors, field effect transistors, connectors, etc. Electronic components materials refer to the relevant materials used to prepare electronic components, such as metal foil materials, metal wires, dielectric, ferroelectric materials, piezoelectric materials, magnetic materials, magneto-optical material, organic dielectric material, ceramics materials, metal packaging material, composition packaging materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 对超导状态下电子行为的一种描述，主要是指库珀电子对的凝聚态。参见库珀电子对和BCS理论。
explanation_en: A description of the electronic behavior in the superconducting state, mainly referring to the condensed state of the Cooper electron pair. See Cooper electron pair and BCS theory.

explanation_cn: 专指一些其结构的形成及其稳定性主要取决于电子浓度因素的金属间化合物。参见Hume~Rothery定律。
explanation_en: It refers to some imermetallif compound whose structure formation and stability mainly depend on the electron concentration factor. See Hume Rothery's law.

explanation_cn: 接受电子的一方叫作电子受体，具有良好的电子传输性能，是很好的n型材料。
explanation_en: The party receiving electrons is called electron acceptor, which has good electron transmission performance and is a good n-type materials.

explanation_cn: 又称P型超导体。铜氧化物或Fe基高温超导体中的一类，通过霍尔效应可以测量，其载流子类型由晶体结构中的自由电子所提供。
explanation_en: Also known as P-type superconductor. Copper oxide or Fe based high-temperature superconductor, which can be measured by Hall effect, and its carrier type is provided by free electrons in crystal structure.

explanation_cn: 由自由电子（或空穴）在电场作用下做定向运动而产生高电导率的陶瓷。传统的陶瓷材料，虽然是不导电的绝缘体，但通过掺杂、加热或其他激发方法，外层价电子获得足够能量，摆脱原子核对它的束缚和控制，成为自由电子（或空穴）即可参与导电。导电性能不仅与自由电子激发的难易有关，而且也与晶粒表面及界面特性、晶粒大小、形状和取向有关。
explanation_en: Ceramics with high electric conductivity are produced by the directional movement of free electrons (or holes) under the action of electric field. Although traditional ceramics materials are non-conductive insulators, through doping, heating or other excitation methods, the outer valence electrons obtain enough energy to get rid of the bondage and control of the atomic nucleus, and become free electrons (or holes) to participate in conduction. The conductivity is not only related to the difficulty of free electron excitation, but also related to the surface and interface characteristics of grains, grain size, shape and orientation.

explanation_cn: 是指用于电子工业中溅射镀膜等的目标材料。主要有金属钯材和陶瓷靶材，可以制备电学薄膜、光学薄膜、光电薄膜、磁性薄膜、超导薄膜等，在微电子平面显示器、磁记录、信息等各个领域中已得到十分广泛的应用。
explanation_en: It refers to the target materials used for sputtering coating in the electronic industry. It mainly includes metal palladium materials and ceramics targets, which can be used to prepare electrical films, optical coating, optoelectronic films, magnetic films, superconducting films, etc. It has been widely used in various fields such as microelectronic planar displays, magnetic recording, information, etc.

explanation_cn: 固体中的电子（或空穴）会与杂质、缺陷或其他载流子发生碰撞，在相继两次碰撞之间通过的自由距离之平均值称平均自由程，表示为l,相应经历的时间称平均自由时间，或弛豫时间t，v0是载流子的真实速度，与漂移速度不同。杂质和缺陷越多，晶体电子的平均自由程就越小。
explanation_en: The electrons (or holes) in solids will collide with impurities, defects or other carriers. The average value of the free distance passed between two successive collisions is called the average free path, expressed as l, and the corresponding time experienced is called the average free time, or the relaxation time t, v0 is the real speed of the carrier, which is different from the drift speed. The more impurities and defects, the smaller the average free path of crystal electrons.

explanation_cn: 电介质中由弱束缚电子在一个或几个离子范围内做定向运动，造成电荷不对称分布而产生的极化。
explanation_en: The polarization in dielectric is caused by the directional movement of weak bound electrons within one or several ion ranges, resulting in the asymmetric distribution of charges.

explanation_cn: 利用入射电子轰击试样表面产生的特征X射线，非破坏性地分析固体表面区域（约lμm)内化学组成的方法。特征X射线的波长出电子跃迁前后所在能级差决定，通过探测特征X射线的波长（波谱法）或能量（能谱法)，可确定所含元素，对试样的成分作定性分析，并可根据特征X射线强度定量分析所含元素的浓度。
explanation_en: Non destructive analysis of the solid surface area (approximately l) using characteristic X-rays generated by incident electrons bombarding the surface of the sample μ m) The method of internal chemical composition. The wavelength of the characteristic X-ray is determined by the energy level difference before and after the electron transition. By detecting the wavelength (spectral method) or energy (spectral method) of the characteristic X-ray, the elements contained can be determined, and the composition of the sample can be qualitatively analyzed. The concentration of the elements contained can be quantitatively analyzed based on the intensity of the characteristic X-ray.

explanation_cn: 用于电子信息产业中半导体器件、集成电路、光电子器件和新型元器件生产制造，具有特定要求的材料为电子信息材料，是发展电子信息产业的基础和先导。主要包括半导体材料、光电子材料、印制电路用基材（覆铜板等材料）、电子陶瓷材料、磁性材料、压电晶体材料、电子焊接材料、真空电子与专用金属材料、电子精细化工等材料。特点是技术要求严格、资金投入大、制造难度大、品种多、用ft相对少、发展更新换代快、材料的增值高等。
explanation_en: It is used for the production and manufacturing of semiconductor devices, integrated circuits, optoelectronic devices and new types of components in the electronic information industry. The materials with specific requirements is electronic information materials, which is the basis and guide for the development of electronic information industry. It mainly includes semiconductor materials, optoelectronic materials, printed circuit substrates (materials such as copper clad plate), electronic ceramics materials, magnetic materials, piezoelectric crystal materials, electronic welding materials, vacuum electronics and special metallic materials, electronic fine chemicals and other materials. It is characterized by strict technical requirements, large capital investment, great manufacturing difficulty, many varieties, relatively few ft, rapid development and upgrading, and high value added of materials.

explanation_cn: 指利用高能电子束引发树脂体系发生交联反应来制造高交联密度热固性树脂基复合材料的方法，是辐射固化的一种。
explanation_en: It refers to the method of producing high crosslinking density thermosetting resin matrix composite by crosslinking reaction of resin system initiated by high-energy electron beam, which is a kind of radiation curing.

explanation_cn: 又称EBC涂料。在高能量电子束照射下，可激发漆膜内某些分子中有些基团的活性而发生聚合反应，在极短时间内形成固体漆膜的涂料。其主要组成为带活性基团的不饱和聚合物、活性稀释剂、颜料、体质颜料。电子束固化涂料不需要光引发剂，也不受颜料和体质颜料的影响。
explanation_en: Also known as ebc coating. Under the irradiation of high-energy electron beam, it can stimulate the activity of some groups in some molecules in the paint film to produce polymerization reaction, and form a solid coatings film in a very short time. It is mainly composed of unsaturated polymer with active group, active diluents, pigment and constitutional pigment. EB curing coating does not need photoinitiator, nor is it affected by pigment and constitutional pigment.

explanation_cn: 以高能量密度的电子束冲击金属表面，在极短的时间内加热到高温，然后进行自冷淬火的热处理工艺。电子束热处理包括电子束表面淬火和电子束表面合金化，电子束加热表面淬火可实现快速加热与冷却。
explanation_en: The metal surface is impacted by electron beam with high energy density, heated to high temperature in a very short time, and then subjected to heat treatment process of self cooling quenching. Electron beam heat treatment includes electron beam case hardening and electron beam surface alloy. Electron beam heating case hardening can realize rapid heating and cooling.

explanation_cn: 电子束与物理气相沉积技术相互渗透而发展起来的先进表面处理技术。以电子束作为热源的一种蒸镀方法，其蒸发速率较高，乎可以蒸发所有物质，而且涂层与工件的结合力非常好。
explanation_en: Advanced surface treatment technology developed by the mutual penetration of electron beam and physical vapor deposition technology. A vapor exposition method using electron beam as heat source has a high evaporation rate, almost all substances can be evaporated, and the adhesion between the coating and the workpiece is very good.

explanation_cn: 因与该方法相关的装置通常作为扫描电子显微镜的附件，又称为电荷收集扫描电子显微术。将扫描电子束施加在结型（包括：pn结、肖特基结、MOS晶体管和MOS电容等）半导体器件上，电子束诱生的少数载流子被器件中的自建电场收集，形成电流。该电流的大小与电子束诱生载流子的浓度成正比，而载流子浓度又与少子寿命成正比；并且少子寿命又与半导体中的缺陷紧密相关。因此，电子束诱生电流与缺陷紧密相关。
explanation_en: Because the device related to this method is usually used as an accessory of the scanning electron microscope, it is also called charge collection scanning electron microscopy. Applying a scanning electron beam to junction type semiconductor devices (including pn junctions, Schottky junctions, MOS transistors, and MOS capacitors), the minority carriers induced by the electron beam are collected by the self built electric field in the device, forming a current. The magnitude of this current is proportional to the concentration of charge carriers induced by the electron beam, and the concentration of charge carriers is also proportional to the minority carrier lifetime; And the minority carrier lifetime is closely related to defects in semiconductors. Therefore, the electron beam induced current is closely related to defects.

explanation_cn: 是指采用电子束辐照橡胶，与橡胶中的电子相互作用，将能量传递给橡胶分子，使之活化、离子化，继而发生交联反应的工艺过程。电子束辐照是一个基本能量转移的过程，其穿透力依赖于辐照的波长及加速电压。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of using electron beam to irradiate rubber, interact with electrons in rubber, transfer energy to rubber molecules, make them activation or conditioning, ionize, and then crosslinking reaction occurs. Electron beam irradiation is a fundamental energy transfer process, and its penetration depends on the wavelength of irradiation and the accelerating voltage.

explanation_cn: 在电子工业中用于制备导体、电阻、介质体等所用浆料的总称。按照功能电子浆料可分为：①导体浆料，主要有贵金属导体浆料如银浆料、银钯浆料、金浆料、铝浆料以及铜基等贱金属浆料；②电阻浆料.主要有钌系玻璃浆料等；③电介质浆料，如钛酸钡介质浆料等；④焊接浆料，如InBi焊接浆料等。电子浆料的制法一般是用有机载体把功能粉末和作黏结剂用的玻璃粉及其他固体粉末混合分散而形成膏状物质。电子浆料应用很广，导体浆料可用于薄膜开关与计算机键盘、钽电解电容器阴极引出、太阳电池、厚膜混合电路、多层陶瓷电容器、半导体芯片黏结等。电阻浆料可用于制造厚膜混合电路、电阻网络以及片状电阻器等。介质浆料可用于制造电容器、多层电路的绝缘层以及厚膜电路包封等。焊接浆料可用于再流焊技术中。
explanation_en: The general term for slurries used in the electronic industry to prepare conductors, resistors, dielectric materials, etc. According to the function, electronic paste can be divided into: ① conductor paste, mainly including precious metal conductor paste such as silver paste, silver palladium paste, gold paste, aluminum paste and copper based base metal paste; ② Resistance paste, mainly ruthenium based glass paste; ③ Dielectric slurry, such as barium titanate dielectric slurry; ④ Weld paste, such as InBi weld paste, etc. The preparation method of electronic paste is generally to mix and disperse functional powder, glass powder and other solid powder used as binder with organic carrier to form paste. Electronic paste is widely used. Conductor paste can be used for film switches and computer keyboards, cathode lead of tantalum electrolytic capacitors, solar cell, thick film hybrid circuits, multilayer ceramics capacitors, semiconductor chip bonding, etc. Resistance slurry can be used to manufacture thick film hybrid circuits, resistance networks, and chip resistors. Dielectric slurry can be used for manufacturing capacitors, insulation layers for multi-layer circuits, and thick film circuit encapsulation. Weld paste can be used in reflow welding technology.

explanation_cn: 高纯特种气在集成电路和平板显示面板制造中起着成膜、掺杂、离子注入、刻蚀、清洗等作用。品种多达20多种，如硅烷、磷烷、砷烷、硼烷及其混合气、高纯氨气、四氟化碳、三氟化氮、六氟乙烷、八氣丙烷、八氟环丁烷、三氟甲烷、高纯氯气、六氟化钨、氧化亚氮、高纯二氧化碳、高纯六氟化硫、笑气等，纯度要求在99.9999%或99.9999%以上。
explanation_en: High purity special gas plays the role of film forming, doping, ion implantation, etching and cleaning in the manufacturing of integrated circuits and flat panel display panels. There are more than 20 varieties, such as silane, phosphine, arsenic, borane and its mixture, high-purity ammonia, carbon tetrafluoride, nitrogen trifluoride, hexafluoroethane, octafluoropropane, octafluorocyclobutane, trifluoromethane, high-purity chlorine, tungsten hexafluoride, nitrous oxide, high-purity carbon dioxide, high-purity sulfur hexafluoride, nitrous oxide, etc. The purity requirements are 99.9999% or more.

explanation_cn: 半导体中能够产生非平衡载流子（电子和空穴）的外界因素撤除以后，导带中的电子将逐渐落回价带的空穴中去的过程。这是一个趋向热平衡的统计性弛豫过程。实际上在热平衡的半导体中所维持的一般也是载流子不断由热激发产生并复合的动平衡。复合过程分直接与间接两种。直接复合为电子直接跃迁到价带的某一空穴。间接复合则先在某一中间态暂时停留，例如一些具有较深束缚能级（多半处于禁带中央附近〉的杂质或缺陷中心，特称为复合中心，借助于复合中心的复合就称为间接复合。
explanation_en: After the removal of external factors that can generate non equilibrium charge carriers (electrons and holes) in semiconductors, the electrons in the conduction band will gradually fall back into the holes in the valence band. This is a statistical relaxation process that tends towards thermal equilibrium. In fact, the dynamic equilibrium maintained in a semiconductor with thermal equilibrium is generally the constant generation and recombination of charge carriers through thermal excitation. There are two kinds of composition processes: direct and indirect. Direct recombination is the direct transition of electrons to a hole in the valence band. Indirect recombination first stays in an intermediate state temporarily, for example, some impurity or defect centers with deeper bound energy level (mostly near the center of the band gap) are specifically called composition centers, and composition by virtue of composition centers is called indirect recombination.

explanation_cn: 提供电子的一方叫作电子给体，具有良好的空穴传输性能，是很好的p型材料。
explanation_en: The provider of electrons is called electron donor, which has good hole transmission performance and is a good p-type materials.

explanation_cn: 高能入射电子束中部分电子与试样发生非弹性交互作用损失部分能量，在入射电子束前进方向上的弹性与非弹性散射电子按能量大小展开而形成的谱图，简称EELS。EELS是一次过程，是直接的内壳层电子激发、原子电离的过程。
explanation_en: Part of the electrons in the high-energy incident electron beam interact with the sample non elasticity to lose part of the energy, and the elasticity and non elasticity scattered electrons in the direction of the incident electron beam travel are expanded according to the energy size, which is called EELS for short. EELS is a process that involves direct excitation of inner shell electrons and atomic ionization.

explanation_cn: 见电子顺磁共振。
explanation_en: See electron paramagnetic resonance.

explanation_cn: 是用于分辨液体中味道及成分分析的仪器。它是一种可以在短时间内分辨和定量溶液中不同的味觉（taste)或化学成分的仪器。因此电子舌是仿生感测科技的一种，它模仿人的舌头及味觉判定。电子舌具有分析快速、多用途及可以定性及定量溶液中化学成分的功能。
explanation_en: It is an instrument used to distinguish the taste and composition of liquids. It is an instrument that can distinguish and quantify different taste or chemical components in a solution in a short period of time. Therefore, electronic tongue is a kind of bionic sensing technology, which imitates human tongue and taste judgment. The electronic tongue has the functions of rapid analysis, multi-purpose and qualitative and quantitative analysis of chemical components in solution.

explanation_cn: 电子束与物质原子相互作用产生的一种衍射现象。由于它携带着物质内部结构的信息，分析衍射谱是研究材料微观结构的有力手段。
explanation_en: A diffraction phenomenon caused by the interaction between an electron beam and a substance atom. Because it carries the information of the internal structure of the material, the analysis of diffraction spectrum is a powerful means to study the microstructure of materials.

explanation_cn: 简言之，就是对电子有阻挡作用的一层材料。在GaN基蓝绿光LED中，通常会在量子阱生长结束以后，在最后一个量子垒之上和P型材料之间生长一个厚度在10-30nm的p型AlGaN层，A1组分在10%-30%不等；或者采用P-GaN/P-AlGaN超晶格结构作为电子阻挡层。主要是利用更宽禁带的AlGaN材料，在p型区I之前形成一个对电子的高势垒结构，将浓度高且迁移率大的电子阻止在有源区内从而增加与空穴相遇的概率以发生高效率的辐射复合，而不是在P型区和空穴发生低效率的辐射复合。
explanation_en: In short, it is a layer of materials that blocks electrons. In GaN based blue-green LEDs, a p-type AlGaN layer with a thickness of 10-30nm is usually grown on the last quantum barrier and between the P-type materials after the growth of the quantum well, and the composition of A1 varies from 10% to 30%; Or P-GaN/P-AlGaN superlattice structure can be used as electron blocking layer. It is mainly to use the AlGaN materials with wider band gap to form a high barrier structure for electrons in front of the p-type area I, to stop electrons with high concentration and mobility in the active area, thus increasing the probability of encountering holes to generate efficient radiative recombination, rather than inefficient radiative recombination between the P-type area and holes.

explanation_cn: 见功能陶瓷。
explanation_en: See functional ceramics.

explanation_cn: 俘获导带中电子的速率远远大于俘获空穴的速率的陷阱，或发射电子的速率远远大于发射空穴的速率的陷阱。
explanation_en: Traps that capture electrons in the conduction band at a rate far greater than the rate of trapping holes, or trap that emits electrons at a rate far greater than the rate of emitting holes.

explanation_cn: 能量低于所面对势垒的电子贯穿通过该势垒的量子效应。这种效应是物质波动性的直接结果。电子隧道效应在固体中的表现除局域态间的跳跃电导外，还有半导体和超导体的若干特性。
explanation_en: The quantum effect of electrons with energy lower than the barrier they face penetrating through the barrier. This effect is a direct result of material volatility. In addition to the hopping conductivity between local states, the tunneling effect of electron also has some characteristics of semiconductors and superconductors in solids.

explanation_cn: 又称电子自旋共振。含有未成对电子的顺磁性物质在恒定（直流）磁场和与其垂直的高频（微波）磁场同时作用下，当恒定磁场强度H与高频磁场角频率ω满足一定条件时，该物质对高频电磁场产生的强烈吸收现象。原理可以用经典唯象理论或量子力学理论来说明。
explanation_en: Also known as electron spin resonance. Under the simultaneous action of a constant (DC) magnetic field and a high frequency (microwave) magnetic field perpendicular to the paramagnetism material containing unpaired electrons, when the constant magnetic field intensity H and the angular frequency of the high frequency magnetic field ω The strong absorption of high-frequency electromagnetic fields by this substance when certain conditions are met. The principle can be explained by classical phenomenological theory or quantum mechanics theory.

explanation_cn: 是模拟动物嗅觉器官，利用气体传感器阵列的响应图案来识别气味的电子装置。主要由气敏传感器阵列、信号预处理和模式识别三部分组成。某种气味呈现在一种活性材料的传感器面前，传感器将化学输入转换成电信号，由多个传感器对一种气味的响应构成了传感器阵列对该气味的响应谱。
explanation_en: It is an electronic device that simulates the olfactory organ of animals and uses the response pattern of a gas sensor array to recognize odors. It mainly consists of three parts: gas sensor array, signal preprocessing, and pattern recognition. An odor is presented in front of the sensor of an active materials, which converts the chemical input into an electrical signal. The response spectrum of the sensor array to the odor is composed of the response of multiple sensors to the odor.

explanation_cn: 即C-V测试法，它是利用半导体器件（p-n结、肖特基结和MOS电容〉的空间电荷区电猝随反向电压变化的特点而建立的测试方法。空间电荷区的宽度随反向电压变化而变化.因而空间电荷区的电容也随之变化。电容随电压的变化关系与半导体中的载流子浓度紧密相关。因此,C-V法可用于测定半导体材料中的杂质浓度及其深度分布。在工业生产中，汞探针C-V法是最常用的测量硅外延层电阻率的方法。利用MOS电容OV法，可以获得半导体的导电类型、掺杂浓度和SiO2/Si界面态密度等信息。用于检测半导体材料中深能级杂质和缺陷的深能级瞬态谱（DLTS),其实是C-V测试法的一个特例.
explanation_en: The C-V test method, It utilizes semiconductor devices (p-n junction, Schottky junction and MOS capacitor). The width of the space charge area changes with the reverse voltage. Therefore, the capacitance of the space charge area also changes. The relationship between the capacitance and the voltage is closely related to the carrier concentration in the semiconductor. Therefore, the C-V method can be used to determine the concentration and depth distribution of impurities in semiconductor materials. In industrial production The mercury probe C-V method is the most commonly used method to measure the resistivity of silicon epitaxial layer. Using MOS capacitance OV method, we can obtain the information of semiconductor conduction type, doping concentration and SiO2/Si interface state density. The deep level transient spectroscopy (DLTS) used to detect deep level impurities and defects in semiconductor materials is actually a special case of the C-V test method

explanation_cn: 用作玻璃电容器的玻璃材料.具有介电系数大、损耗低等特点，耐温性和抗湿性也较好。
explanation_en: The glass materials used as glass capacitor has the characteristics of large dielectric coefficient, low loss, good temperature resistance and moisture resistance.

explanation_cn: 用于制造电容器的电绝缘体的纸。通常用100%本色硫酸盐针叶木浆为原料，生产用水要经过离子交换树脂处理，以除去水中的重金属离子。纸浆在长网薄页纸机上抄造，成纸再经超级甩光机整平，最后卷成一定规格的卷筒纸。纸质均匀紧密，厚度为0.004-0.010mm。
explanation_en: Paper used to manufacture electrical insulators for capacitors. Generally, 100% natural color kraft softwood pulp is used as raw material, and production water is treated with ion exchange resin to remove heavy metal ions in the water. The pulp is made on the fourdrinier, and the finished paper is leveled by the super polishing machine, and finally rolled into a certain size of web paper. The paper is uniform and compact, with a thickness of 0.004-0.010mm.

explanation_cn: 反映导体中电场和电流密度关系的物理量。导体内无电流存在时，则电荷在微观上是无规则运动.宏观平均速度为零，无电流存在；如导体内加一电场，电荷在无规则运动的基础上又叠加了一个有规则的运动，正电荷沿着电场方向运动，负电荷则逆着电场方向运动，形成电流。电导率的倒为电阻率，是决定导体电阻的参量。
explanation_en: A physical quantity reflecting the relationship between electric field and current density in a conductor. When there is no current present in a conductor, the charge moves irregularly at the microscopic level. The macroscopic average velocity is zero, and there is no current present; If an electric field is added to a conductor, the charge superimposes a regular motion on top of the irregular motion. Positive charges move along the direction of the electric field, while negative charges move against the direction of the electric field, forming a current. The converse of electric conductivity to resistivity is a parameter that determines conductor resistance.

explanation_cn: 以两根形成涂层材料的消耗性电极丝之间产生的电弧为热源加热熔化消耗性电极丝，用压缩气体将其雾化后喷射到经预处理的基体表面上形成涂层的热喷涂方法。
explanation_en: The thermal spraying method uses the arc generated between two consumable electrode wires forming the coating materials as the heat source to heat and melt the consumable electrode wires, atomize them with compressed gas and spray them onto the pretreated matrix surface to form the coating.

explanation_cn: 利用电弧热效应熔炼金属和其他物料的电冶炼炉。电弧炉主要由炉身、倾动机构、电极及其升降装置、供电系统和控制调节系统组成。根据电流特性可分为交流电弧炉和直流电弧炉，炼钢用三相交流电弧炉是最常用的直接加热电弧炉，电弧在电极与废钢料之间产生，直接加热废钢；而直流电弧炉具有电耗和电极消耗小、噪声小、电压波动小和冶炼周期短的特点，近十年来也得到迅速发展。
explanation_en: An electric smelting furnace that utilizes the thermal effect of electric arc to melting metals and other materials. The electric arc furnace is mainly composed of furnace stack, tilting mechanism, electrode and its lifting device, power supply system and control and regulation system. According to the current characteristics, it can be divided into AC electric arc furnace and DC electric arc furnace. The three-phase AC electric arc furnace for steelmaking is the most commonly used direct heating electric arc furnace. The electric arc is generated between the electrode and the scrap to directly heat the scrap; DC arc furnace has the characteristics of low power consumption and electrode consumption, low noise, small voltage fluctuation and short smelting cycle, and has also been developed rapidly in the past decade.

explanation_cn: 用于电弧放电过程的炭材料，是由焦炭、石墨加适当黏合剂，通过挤压成型，经高温处理后，得到的耐高温、导电性良好、不易断裂的棒状炭材料。
explanation_en: The carbon materials used in the arc discharge process is a rod shaped carbon materials with high temperature resistance, good conductivity and fracture resistance, which is made of coke, graphite and appropriate adhesive through extrusion moulding and high temperature treatment.

explanation_cn: 利用电弧作为热源的熔焊方法，简称弧焊，是应用最为广泛的一类焊接方法。采用金属电极的电弧焊有手工电弧焊、熔化极气体保护电弧焊、焊条电弧焊、药芯焊丝电弧焊、钨极气体保护电弧焊、埋弧焊、等离子弧焊和原子氢焊等。采用碳棒电极的电弧焊有碳弧焊、双极碳弧焊、保护碳弧焊和气体碳弧焊等。电弧焊有的加填充金属，有的不加填充金属。与气体火焰焊相比.电弧焊温度高、能量集中、易于机械化自动化，因而生产效率非常高。
explanation_en: Fusion welding method using arc as heat source, referred to as arc welding, is the most widely used type of weld method. Metal electrode arc welding includes manual arc welding, consumable gas shielded arc welding, electrode arc welding, flux cored welding rot arc welding, tungsten gas shielded arc welding, submerged arc welding, plasma arc welding and atomic hydrogen welding. Arc welding with carbon rod electrode includes carbon are welding welding, bipolar carbon are welding welding, shielded carbon are welding welding and gas carbon are welding. Some of the arc welding is carried out with filler metal, while others are carried out without filler metal. Compared with gas flame welding, arc welding has the advantages of high temperature, concentrated energy, easy mechanization and automation, so its production efficiency is very high.

name_cn: 电弧等离子射流反应沉积
explanation_cn: 利用电弧等离子体射流的高能环境进行化学反应制备涂层或新材料的工艺方法。主要设备是电弧等离子喷枪，其阴极为钨棒，阳极为与阴极同轴的水冷铜喷嘴喷枪通常装在真空室内。
explanation_en: The process of preparing coatings or new materials by chemical reaction in the high-energy environment of arc plasma jet. The main equipment is an arc plasma spray gun, with a tungsten rod as the cathode and a water-cooled copper nozzle coaxial with the cathode as the anode. The spray gun is usually installed in a vacuum chamber.

explanation_cn: 材料多数是电中性的，含有的正电荷和负电荷几乎相等，但电荷的分布有时是不均匀的和不对称的，当正、负电荷的重心不重合时，则出现电偶极矩，其数值由电荷乘以正、负电荷中心的向量矩给出，单位体积的电偶极矩称为电极化率。
explanation_en: Most materials are electrically neutral, containing nearly the same positive and negative charges, but the distribution of charges is sometimes uneven and asymmetric. When the gravity centers of positive and negative charges do not coincide, an electric dipole moment will appear. Its value is given by multiplying the charge by the vector moment of the positive and negative charge centers. The electric dipole moment per unit volume is called electric susceptibility.

explanation_cn: 环状结构硅酸盐矿物。按阳离子不同，有镁电气石、黑电气石、锂电气石等矿物种。三方晶系，空间群CSV-R3m。柱状或针状晶体，柱面上常有纵纹，晶体横断面呈弧线三角形。富含镁的电气石呈褐色或黄色，含铁的电气石呈黑色.含锂、锰和铯的电气石呈浅绿色。经常在横断面上呈现不同颜色的色环，或柱体上下端出现不同的色带。玻璃光泽。莫氏硬度7,参差状断口，密度3.03-3.25g/cm^3。主要产于花岗伟晶岩、气成高温热液矿脉和云英岩中，与绿柱石、铌钽铁矿共生。亦产于变质岩中与黑云母、石榴石共生。透明、色泽鲜艳者可作宝石。具有明显的压电性和热释电性，热释电性良好的晶体可用于无线电工业。有释放远红外线和产生负离子的性能，可用于制备环境材料。
explanation_en: Silicate mineral with ring structure. According to different cations, there are clravite, black tourmaline, elbaite and other minerals. Trilateral system, space group CSV-R3m. Cylindrical or acicular crystal, often with longitudinal lines on the cylindrical surface, and the cross section of crystal is arc triangle. Tourmaline rich in magnesium is brown or yellow, tourmaline containing iron is black, and tourmaline containing lithium, manganese and cesium is light green. Often, different colored rings appear on the cross-section, or different color bands appear at the upper and lower ends of the column. Glass lustre. Morse hardness 7, staggered fracture, density 3.03-3.25g/cm ^ 3. It mainly occurs in granitic pegmatite, gas generated high-temperature hydrothermal veins and greisen, and coexists with beryl and columbite-tantalite. It also occurs in metamorphic rock and coexists with biotite and garnet. Transparent and bright color can be used as gems. Crystal with obvious piezoelectricity and pyroelectric properties and good pyroelectric properties can be used in the radio industry. It can release far infrared ray and produce negative ions, and can be used to prepare environmental materials.

explanation_cn: 在一定放电条件下电池能放出的电量，即电池放电到额定终止电压时，放电电流对时间的积分值，通常以安/时（A/h)或毫安/时（mA/h)为单位。电池容量按条件可以分为理论容量、实际容量和额定容量，电池的理论容量可根据电极活性物质的电化当量及其在电池内的含量计算出来。电池实际容量是指在测试或应用过程中按一定条件实际释放出的容量，实际容量总是小于理论容量，额定容量又称标称容量，是指电池设计和生产时规定的在某一特定条件下放电至终止电压所提供的最低容量，额定容量是电池产品规格中重要的性能指标。
explanation_en: The amount of electricity that a battery can release under certain discharge conditions, that is, the integral value of the discharge current over time when the battery is discharged to the rated termination voltage, usually measured in amperes per hour (A/h) or milliamperes per hour (mA/h). According to conditions, cell capacity can be divided into theoretical capacity, actual capacity and rated capacity. The theoretical capacity of the battery can be calculated according to the electrochemical equivalent of the electrode active substance and its content in the battery. The actual capacity of the battery refers to the capacity actually released under certain conditions during the test or application process. The actual capacity is always less than the theoretical capacity. The rated capacity, also known as the nominal capacity, refers to the minimum capacity provided by the battery when it is discharged to the termination voltage under a specific condition specified during the design and production of the battery. The rated capacity is an important performance index in the battery product specifications.

explanation_cn: 指电池在工作时，电流流过电池内部所受到的阻力。它是衡量电池性能的一个重要参数，由欧姆电阻和极化电阻组成。
explanation_en: The resistance experienced by the current flowing through the interior of a battery during operation. It is an important parameter to measure the performance of the battery and consists of ohmic resistance and polarization resistance.

explanation_cn: 电池的可逆性指的是二次电池（即可充电电池）的充放电可逆性。
explanation_en: Reversibility of the battery refers to the charge discharge reversibility of secondary cell (i.e. rechargeable battery).

explanation_cn: 电池的可靠性测试主要包括：循环寿命、不同倍率放电特性、不同温度放电特性、充电特性、自放电特性、不同温度自放电特性、存储特性、过放电特性、不同温度内阻特性、高温测试、温度循环测试、跌落测试、振动测试、容量分布测试、内阻分布测试和静态放电测试。
