explanation_en: The function between the relative molecular weight of macromolecule and the sum of the number or mass fraction of all molecules with a relative molecular weight less than or equal to the relative molecular weight is also a function.

explanation_cn: 含孔隙材料的密度与同种材料无孔隙状态下的理论密度之比，以百分数表示。多数粉末冶金材料与制品均含有不同程度的孔隙?孔隙的存在降低了材料的强度。表示材料达到理论密度的程度。相对密度百分数越大，孔隙越少，材料强度越接近无孔隙材料的最大值。
explanation_en: The ratio of the density of porous materials to the theoretical density of the same materials in the void free state, expressed as a percentage. Most powder metallurgy materials and products contain different degrees of porosity? The existence of pores reduces the strength of materials. It indicates the degree to which materials reaches theoretical density. The larger the percentage of relative density is, the less the pores are, and the strength of materials is closer to the maximum value of non porous materials.

explanation_cn: 参见绝对电位。
explanation_en: See absolute potential.

explanation_cn: 超导体的重要参量。表示超导体内电子间相互关联的空间范围。朗道相干长度则表示为超导态与正常态界面处或超导体表面处超导能隙的变化范围。
explanation_en: Important parameters of superconductors. Represents the spatial range of electron correlations within a superconducting body. The Landau coherence length is expressed as the variation range of the superconducting gap at the interface between the superconducting state and the normal state or at the superconductor surface.

explanation_cn: 吉布斯定理，又称吉布斯规则，用于确定多元复相平衡体系中相数与独立组元数以及其他影响平衡状态的独立变数之间的关系。在一般情况下，它可以表示为：F = C - P + 2其中 F 代表自由度，表示在平衡体系中，当各相保持不变的情况下，可以自由、独立变化的强度因素（如温度、压力和各相的浓度等）。C 是系统中独立组元数，等于系统中物种数减去其独立限制条件（如化学反应式、浓度关系式等）的个数。数字 "2" 是一般只考虑温度和压力两个外界条件的特例。当存在表面、电磁场、重力等效应时，关系式变为：F = C - P + 2 + S + G其中 S 和 G 分别代表相应的外界条件数。MAX 相陶瓷是一种二元层状碳（氮）化合物，通用表达式为 M(n+1)AX(n) ，其中 M 代表过渡金属元素， A 代表第 II A 或第 VA 族元素，而 X 是碳或氮元素，其 n 值一般在 1 到 3 范围内，但最高可达 6。这类材料融合了陶瓷和金属的特性，具有良好的导电性、导热性，在常温下表现出硬度较低、较高的弹性模量和剪切模量，容易进行机械加工。此外，它们具有较高的屈服强度、良好的热稳定性和抗氧化性，因此广泛应用于高温结构材料、高温发热材料、电极电刷材料以及化学防腐材料等领域。这类材料在制备时可以通过同相反应合成或采用化学气相沉积法制备。
explanation_en: Gibbs theorem, also known as Gibbs rule, is used to determine the relationship between the number of phases and the number of independent components, as well as other independent variables that affect the equilibrium state in a multicomponent multiphase equilibrium system. In general, it can be expressed as: F=C - P+2, where F represents the degree of freedom, indicating the strength factors (such as temperature, pressure and concentration of each phase) that can change freely and independently in the equilibrium system when each phase remains unchanged. C is the number of independent components in the system, which is equal to the number of species in the system minus the number of independent limiting conditions (such as chemical reaction equations, concentration relationships, etc.). The number "2" is a special case that generally only considers two external conditions: temperature and pressure. When there are surface, electromagnetic field, gravity and other effects, the relationship becomes: F=C-P+2+S+G, where S and G represent the corresponding number of external conditions. MAX phase ceramics is a binary layered carbon (nitrogen) compound, the general expression is M (n+1) AX (n), where M represents the transition metal element, A represents the second A or VA group element, and X is the carbon or nitrogen element, whose n value is generally in the range of 1 to 3, but up to 6. This kind of materials combines the characteristics of ceramics and metals, and has good conductivity and thermal conductivity. It has low hardness, high elastic modulus and shear modulus at room temperature, and is easy to machine. In addition, they have high yield strength, good thermal stability and oxidation resistance, so they are widely used in high-temperature structural materials, high-temperature heating materials, electrode brush materials, chemical anti-corrosion materials and other fields. Such materials can be prepared by in phase reaction synthesis or chemical vapor deposition.

explanation_cn: 不同结构之间存在不同的界面能，这些结构和能量对金属和合金的性能具有极为重要的影响。根据原子在界面上的排列方式，可以将这些界面分为三种类型：一是共格面，它类似于共格孪晶界，其中界面上的原子同时占据两个不同晶体点阵的位置。为了维持共格界面，需要两个不同相之间特殊的晶体学取向关系，这种情况在铝铜合金中的GP区形成时就有所体现；二是没有任何共格关系的界面，被称为非共格界面；三是利用刃型位错来保持共格性的相界，称为半共格相界，在钢中，马氏体的形成和外延生长过程中，这种半共格相界是比较常见的。这些界面类型对于材料的性能和性质都具有显著的影响。
explanation_en: There are different interface energies between different structures, and these structures and energies have a very important impact on the properties of metals and alloy. According to the arrangement of atoms on the interface, these interfaces can be divided into three types: one is the coherent plane, which is similar to the coherent twin boundary, where the atoms on the interface occupy the positions of two different crystal lattice at the same time. In order to maintain the coherent interface, special crystallographic orientation relationship between two different phase is required, which is reflected in the formation of GP zone in aluminum copper alloy; The second is an interface without any coherent relationship, which is called a non coherent interface; The third is the phase boundary that uses edge dislocation to maintain cohesiveness, which is called semi coherent phase boundary. In steel, this semi coherent phase boundary is relatively common during the formation of martensite and epitaxial growth. These interface types have significant effects on the properties and properties of materials.

explanation_cn: 颗粒质量用除去开孔和闭孔的颗粒体积除得的商值。实际上就是粉末的固体密度。粉末材料的理论密度，通常不能代表粉末颗粒的实际密度，因为颗粒总是有孔的。
explanation_en: The quotient obtained by removing the volume of particles with open and closed pores for particle mass. In fact, it is the solid density of powder. The theoretical density of powder materials usually cannot represent the actual density of powder particle, because particles always have pores.

explanation_cn: 真应力-应变曲线是在材料力学和材料性能研究中的重要曲线之一，用于描述材料在受载时的行为。这种曲线以真应力（载荷除瞬时截面积）为纵坐标，以真应变（瞬时长度和原始长度比值的自然对数）为横坐标。通常，真应力-应变曲线在材料的强度、塑性行为和变形过程中提供了重要信息。在材料的弹性部分，真应力-应变曲线呈线性关系，根据胡克定律，应力和应变成正比。弹性部分两曲线基本重合，这表示在这个阶段材料恢复到原始状态，没有永久的塑性变形。然而，在材料的塑性变形阶段，真应力-应变曲线的行为变得复杂。通常，这个阶段可以用方程a = A * e^n 来描述，其中 a 是真应力，e 是真应变，A 和 n 是材料的常数。这种曲线的斜率反映了材料的硬度和塑性性能。加工硬化指数n的数值通常在0.05到0.55之间，对不同类型的材料会有所不同。它等于曲线的斜率，表示材料的硬度和塑性行为。对于一般的钢材，n的值通常在这个范围内。在实验中，测得的是工程（或条件）应力和应变曲线，工程应力是根据原始截面积计算的，工程应变则是根据瞬时长度和原始长度比值计算的。真应力和真应变可以通过这些工程值来计算。在塑性变形过程中，材料的体积保持不变，即 nA(t) = nA(0)。通过在工程应力-应变曲线上获取某一瞬时点的工程应力和工程应变，然后通过一定的关系，可以获得相应的真应力和真应变。真应力-应变曲线的形状对材料的性能和行为有重要影响，可以用于材料性能的评估和材料的设计。这些曲线也可以用真切应力和真切应变来描述，这有助于研究材料的变形和强度行为。
explanation_en: The true stress-strain curve is one of the important curves in the study of materials mechanics and materials properties, which is used to describe the behavior of materials under load. This curve takes true stress (load divided by instantaneous cross-sectional area) as the ordinate, and true strain (natural logarithm of the ratio of instantaneous length to original length) as the abscissa. In general, the true stress-strain curve provides important information in the strength, plastic behavior and deformation process of materials. In the elasticity part of materials, the true stress-strain curve is linear. According to Hooke's law, stress and strain become proportional. The two curves of the elasticity part basically coincide, which means that the materials returns to the original state at this stage without permanent plastic deformation. However, in the plastic deformation stage of materials, the behavior of the true stress-strain curve becomes complicated. Generally, this stage can be described by the equation a=A * e ^ n, where a is the true stress, e is the true strain, and A and n are constants of materials. The slope of this curve reflects the hardness and plasticity of materials. The value of work hardening index n is usually between 0.05 and 0.55, which will be different for different types of materials. It is equal to the slope of the curve, representing the hardness and plastic behavior of materials. For ordinary steel product, the value of n is usually within this range. In the experiment, the measured stress and strain curves are engineering (or conditional), engineering stress is calculated based on the original cross-sectional area, and engineering strain is calculated based on the ratio of instantaneous length to original length. The true stress and true strain can be calculated from these engineering values. During plastic deformation, the volume of materials remains unchanged, that is, nA (t)=nA (0). The engineering stress and engineering strain at a certain instantaneous point can be obtained from the engineering stress-strain curve, and then the corresponding true stress and true strain can be obtained through a certain relationship. The shape of true stress-strain curve has an important influence on the performance and behavior of materials, which can be used to evaluate the performance of materials and design materials. These curves can also be described by true shear stress and true shear strain, which is helpful to study the deformation and strength behavior of materials.

explanation_cn: 位于表皮以下和皮下组织以上、主要由胶原纤维编织而成的结构。是皮或革的主要成分，包括乳头层和网状层。
explanation_en: A structure located below the epidermis and above the subcutaneous tissue, mainly woven by collagen fiber. It is the main component of skin or leather, including the papillary layer and reticular layer.

explanation_cn: 在低于0.1MPa至超真空条件下进行的冶金过程，包括金属与合金的提炼、冶炼、重熔、精炼、成形及热处理等。真空冶金可减小金属受气相的污染;易于脱气或去除易挥发杂质元素（如铅、锌等）;促进有气态产物生成的化学反应;某些情况下还可避免由耐火材料带来的污染。主要包括真空电阻熔炼、真空感应熔炼、真空精炼、真空电弧重熔、电子束熔炼及电渣重熔等。
explanation_en: Metallurgical process under the condition of less than 0.1MPa to ultravacuum, including refining, smelting, remelting, refining, forming and heat treatment of metals and alloy. Vacuum metallurgy can reduce the pollution of metal by gas phase; Easily degassing or removing volatile impurity elements (such as lead, zinc, etc.); Promote chemical reactions that generate gaseous products; In some cases, pollution caused by refractory can also be avoided. It mainly includes vacuum resistance melting, vacuum induction melting, vacuum refining, vacuum arc remelting, electron beam melting and electric slag remelting.

explanation_cn: 利用真空将液态金属吸入铸型（结晶器）的方法。铸件凝固后，解除真空，多余的金属液将自动流回坩埚。所得铸件组织致密，力学性能较好。可以制造一定壁厚的空心铸件，适用于铝合金或铜合金小件的生产。金属利用率高，铸件壁厚可小到0.75mm。
explanation_en: The method of drawing liquid metal into mold (mold) by vacuum. After the casting solidifies, the vacuum is released, and the excess metal liquid will automatically flow back to the crucible. The obtained castings have dense microstructure and good mechanical properties. It can manufacture hollow castings with a certain wall thickness, suitable for the production of small aluminum or copper alloy parts. The metal utilization rate is high, and the wall thickness of the casting can be as small as 0.75mm.

explanation_cn: 在真空条件下向钢液吹氧脱碳的炉外精炼工艺技术。主要用于生产高铬不锈钢，也可用于生产超低碳钢和对特殊钢进行真空精炼及真空脱气处理。由于真空条件下碳脱氧的能力很强，故可使钢中碳含量降至很低，由此保证铬的收得率很高。通过测定真空度和分析废气成分确定吹炼终点。
explanation_en: Off furnace refining technology of blowing oxygen decarburization into liquid steel under vacuum condition. It is mainly used to produce high chromium stainless steel, ultra-low-carhon steel and special steel for vacuum refining and vacuum degassing treatment. Due to the strong carbon deoxidation capacity under vacuum conditions, the carbon content in steel can be reduced to a very low level, thus ensuring a high yield of chromium. Determine the blowing endpoint by measuring the vacuum degree and analyzing the composition of the exhaust gas.

explanation_cn: 对硝环流动状态的钢液进行真空脱气的炉外处理工艺技术，简称RH。钢液脱气在真空室内进行，真空下设抽吸和排放钢液的上升与下降管。RH主要用于钢液脱气，脱气效率取决于处理容量、脱气时间、真空度和钢液循环量，脱气率可达80%以上。此外，RH处理还具有脱氮、脱氢、脱硫能力及升温和成分微调功能。
explanation_en: The vacuum degassing process outside the furnace for molten steel in flowing state of nitrate ring is called RH for short. The degassing of steel liquid is carried out in the vacuum chamber, under which the ascending and descending pipes for suction and discharge of steel liquid are set. RH is mainly used for degassing of steel liquid. degassing efficiency depends on processing capacity, degassing time, vacuum degree and steel liquid circulation amount. degassing rate can reach more than 80%. In addition, RH treatment also has denitrification, dehydrogenation, desulfurization capabilities, temperature rise and composition tuning functions.

explanation_cn: 是热成型方法的一种，依靠大气与真空压力差使片材拉伸变形，广泛用于塑料包装、灯饰、广告、装饰等行业。常用的方法主要有自由、空腔成型和覆盖成型三种。①自由是将片材加热到所需温度后，置于夹持环上，周边用压环压紧，开启真空阀，直到片材达到所需的成型深度位置。所形成的制件光学畸变小、透明性优异，故可用于制造飞机部件如仪器罩和天窗等。②空腔成型，该方法属于阴模成型。预热后的片材在夹持环上固定后，通过阴模上的气孔抽真空使片材下移.片材底部最先接触模具，然后侧外壁逐渐贴合模具。模腔底部中心壁厚最大模腔侧面与底面交界转角处最薄。③覆盖成型用阳模成型产品的方法，覆盖成型法生产的制品与空腔成型法一样，与模腔壁贴合的一面质量较高，结构花纹较鲜明细致。壁厚的最大部位在阳模的顶部，而最薄部位在阳模侧面与底面的交界区，该部位也是最后成型的部位。
explanation_en: It is a kind of thermo-forming method, which relies on the difference between atmospheric and vacuum pressure to stretch and deform the sheet, and is widely used in plastics packaging, lighting, advertising, decoration and other industries. The commonly used methods mainly include free, cavity forming, and cover forming Freedom is the process of heating the sheet to the desired temperature, placing it on a clamping ring, compressing the surrounding area with a pressure ring, and opening the vacuum valve until the sheet reaches the desired forming depth position. The resulting parts have low optical distortion and excellent transparency, making them suitable for manufacturing aircraft components such as instrument covers and skylights Cavity forming, which belongs to female mold forming. After the preheated sheet is fixed on the clamping ring, vacuum is pumped through the pores on the female mold to move the sheet downwards. The bottom of the sheet first contacts the mold, and then the outer wall gradually fits the mold. The center wall thickness at the bottom of the mold cavity is the thickest, and the corner between the side of the mold cavity and the bottom surface is the thinnest The method of forming products using male molds for cover molding is the same as that of cavity molding, where the quality of the side that adheres to the mold wall is higher and the structural pattern is more distinct and detailed. The largest part of the wall thickness is at the top of the male mold, while the thinnest part is at the junction of the side and bottom of the male mold, which is also the final formed part.

explanation_cn: 火箭推进剂的比冲与其喷管出口处的环境压力有关。热力学计算表明，选择火箭发动机喷管的膨胀比使喷管出口处的压力与环境压力相等时.燃气在喷管流动中动能转化为推力处于最佳状态。当喷管出口处压力为零（真空）时，推进剂的比冲为最佳值，此时的比冲称为真空比冲。
explanation_en: The specific impulse of rocket propellant is related to the ambient pressure at the nozzle exit. Thermodynamics calculation shows that when the expansion ratio of the rocket engine nozzle is selected to make the pressure at the nozzle outlet equal to the ambient pressure, the kinetic energy of the gas in the nozzle flow is converted into thrust in the optimal state. When the pressure at the nozzle outlet is zero (vacuum), the specific impulse of the propellant is the optimal value, and the specific impulse at this time is called the vacuum specific impulse.

explanation_cn: 一种制造金属基复合材料零构件的有效方法。在真空（或惰性气体保护）的密闭容器中加热由增强体组成的预制件，同时熔化基体合金并升温至预计温度，通入高压惰性气体（常用氩气或氮气）将熔融金属液强行渗入增强体预制件的孔隙之中，从而制备金属基复合材料坯料或零件的工艺方法。真空或惰性气体保护可有效防止加热过程中增强体与基体的氧化.改善浸润性;具有较强的灵活性，适用范围较宽，对增强体类型无限制;工艺参数易于控制，可制备出形状复杂、尺寸精确、性能优异的复合材料零件但难以制备大型构件，生产效率低。
explanation_en: The invention provides an effective method for manufacturing metal matrix composite components. The process method of heating the preform composed of reinforcement in a vacuum (or inert gas protection) closed container, melting the matrix alloy and heating it to the expected temperature, introducing high-pressure inert gas (usually argon or nitrogen) to force molten metal into the pores of the reinforcement preform, so as to prepare metal matrix composite blanks or parts. Vacuum or inert gas protection can effectively prevent oxidation of reinforcement and matrix during heating and improve wettability; It has strong flexibility, wide scope of application and unlimited type of reinforcement; The process parameters are easy to control, and composite materials parts with complex shape, accurate size and excellent performance can be prepared, but it is difficult to prepare large components, and the production efficiency is low.

explanation_cn: 在真空或者在真空下通人低于大气压的特殊气体进行的热处理工艺。主要分真空淬火、真空退火和真空化学热处理三大类。真空淬火是在真空下加热，然后在不同的冷却介质中冷却。真空淬火较广泛应用的是气冷和油冷，气冷多采用惰性气体氩气或者用高纯氮气。真空退火主要用于高温合金、难熔金属及合金的退火。真空化学热处理常用的有真空渗碳、真空碳氮共渗、真空离子渗碳、真空渗铬、真空戤射等。真空热处理的优点是：①可以实现无氧化、无脱碳的光亮热处理，由于真空热处理是在负压下加热，可以达到去除氧化皮和真空除气的目的，热处理后工件表面无需清理;②真空加热主要靠辐射，升温速率缓慢，工件表面和心部温差小，热处理变形小;③在真空条件下加热，溶解在金属中的氧、氢、氮气等可逸出，可使表面层气体元素含量显著降低，从而提高材料性能;④磁性材料真空热处理，可提高磁性的稳定性;⑤真空渗碳速度快、质量良好。真空热处理的主要缺点是设备复杂，价格昂贵，热处理周期对含有易蒸发的合金元素的材料不太适宜。
explanation_en: Heat treatment process in vacuum or under vacuum with special gas below atmospheric pressure. It is mainly divided into three categories: vacuum quenching, vacuum annealing and vacuum thermo-chemical treatment. Vacuum quenching is heated under vacuum and then cooled in different cooling medium. Air cooling and oil cooling are widely used in vacuum quenching. Inert gas argon or high-purity nitrogen is mostly used for gas cooling. Vacuum annealing is mainly used for annealing of high temperature alloy, refractory metal and alloy. Vacuum thermo-chemical treatment is commonly used for vacuum carburizing, vacuum carbonitriding, vacuum ion carburizing, vacuum chromizing, vacuum jet, etc. The advantages of vacuum heat treatment are: ① bright heat treatment without oxidation and decarburization can be achieved. Since vacuum heat treatment is heated under negative pressure, the purpose of oxide scale removal and vacuum degassing can be achieved, and the workpiece surface does not need to be cleaned after heat treatment; ② Vacuum heating mainly depends on radiation, the heating rate is slow, the temperature difference between the surface and the center of the workpiece is small, and heat treatment deformation is small; ③ When heated in vacuum, oxygen, hydrogen, nitrogen, etc. dissolved in the metal can escape, which can significantly reduce the content of gas elements in the surface layer, thus improving the performance of materials; ④ Vacuum heat treatment of magnetic materials can improve the stability of magnetism; ⑤ Vacuum carburizing has high speed and good quality. The main disadvantage of vacuum heat treatment is that the equipment is complex and expensive, and the heat treatment cycle is not suitable for materials containing alloy elements that are easy to evaporate.

explanation_cn: 在真空条件下进行的熔浸，是熔浸方法的一种类型。
explanation_en: Infiltration in vacuum is a type of infiltration method.

explanation_cn: 将两片平板玻璃四周密闭起来，将其间隙抽成真空并密封排气孔而成的一种玻璃制品。两片玻璃之间的间隙为0.1-0.2mm,真空玻璃的两片一般至少有一片是低辐射玻璃，这样就将通过的传导、对流和辐射方式散失的热降到最低，其工作原理与玻璃保温瓶的保温隔热原理相同。具有变形小，强度高.不传热、不传冷、不传声，节能降噪等优点。可广泛应用于建筑门窗、幕墙、汽车、火车、轮船，飞机窗等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of glass product made by sealing around two pieces of flat glass, vacuuming the gap and sealing the exhaust hole. The gap between two pieces of glass is 0.1-0.2mm. Generally, at least one piece of vacuum glass is low emissivity glass, which minimizes the heat loss through conduction, convection and radiation. Its working principle is the same as that of glass thermos bottle. It has the advantages of small deformation, high strength, no heat transfer, no cooling, no sound transmission, energy conservation and noise reduction. It can be widely used in building doors and windows, curtain walls, cars, trains, ships, aircraft windows, etc.

explanation_cn: 在较高真空条件下用电子枪发射电子束，轰击被熔炼物料使之熔化，然后滴入水冷铜结晶器凝固成锭的熔炼金属和合金的冶炼方法。其熔炼金属的纯净度比其他真空熔炼法更高。主要适用于熔炼钨、钼等高熔点金属及合金、高级合金钢、高温合金和超纯金属。
explanation_en: The smelting method of emitting electron beam with electron gun under high vacuum conditions, bombarding melting materials to melt them, and then dropping them into water-cooled copper mold to solidify into ingots of melting metals and alloy. The purity of its melting metal is higher than that of other vacuum melting methods. It is mainly used for melting tungsten, molybdenum and other high melting point metals and alloy, advanced alloy steel, high temperature alloy and ultrapure metals.

explanation_cn: 又称真空自耗重熔，在真空条件下通过电弧热效应加热熔炼金属和合金的冶炼方法。由于采用一定的真空度且被熔金属作为自耗电极，故相应的设备称为真空自耗电极电弧炉或简称真空自耗炉。炉体由炉壳、电极、电极杆、电极升降装置及水冷铜结晶器组成，炉壳一般选用不锈钢材料。被重熔金属制成的自耗电极(负极）装在电极杆上，待抽到一定真空度后通以低电压大电流，金属熔化后滴入水冷铜结晶器（正极）内，凝结成锭。真空电弧重熔法可熔炼难熔金属如钨、钥、铌、钽等及其合金及活性很高的金属如钛、锆等及其合金以及高温合金、髙合金钢等。
explanation_en: Also known as vacuum consumable remelting, it is a smelting method of melting metals and alloy under vacuum conditions by heating the arc thermal effect. Since a certain vacuum degree is adopted and the molten metal is used as consumable electrode, the corresponding equipment is called vacuum consumable electrode electric arc furnace or vacuum consumable furnace for short. The furnace body is composed of furnace shell, electrode, electrode rod, electrode lifting device and water-cooled copper mold. The furnace shell is generally made of stainless steel materials. The consumable electrode (negative electrode) made of remelted metal is installed on the electrode rod. After being pumped to a certain vacuum, it is connected with low voltage and high current. After the metal is melted, it drops into the water-cooled copper mold (positive electrode) and condenses into ingots. The vacuum arc remelting process can melting refractory metals such as tungsten, key, niobium, tantalum, and their alloy, and highly reactive metals such as titanium, zirconium, and their alloy, as well as high temperature alloy, high alloy steel, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称低压等离子喷涂。在真空下进行等离子喷涂的表面工艺技术。等离子喷涂具有涂层与基体结合强度高、涂层致密、材料种类广的优点。在大气中喷涂时，存在涂层氧化的问题，对于性能要求高的涂层这个问题更为突出。采用真空喷涂可以解决这个问题。工作时，喷涂室预抽至真空，然后通入氩气使气压升至数千帕，在此气压下起动等离子喷枪。由于枪内与喷涂室压差大，通常都能使等离子体射流速度达到马赫数高的射流速度，使喷涂颗粒的速度大大提高，有利于提高涂层与基体的附着力，减少涂层的气孔率。已在航空发动机涡轮叶片抗热腐蚀涂层、硬质合金涂层，难熔金属件上得到应用。配备喷涂机器人和计算机程序控制，可以保证叶片涂层厚度的均匀和精度。还可用这种设备制备纳米超微粉、超细纤维、金刚石薄膜和C60。
explanation_en: Also known as low pressure plasma spraying. Surface technology of plasma spraying in vacuum. Plasma spraying has the advantages of high bonding strength between coating and matrix, dense coating and wide variety of materials. When spraying in the atmosphere, there is a problem of coating oxidation, especially for coatings with high performance requirements. Vacuum spraying can solve this problem. During operation, the spraying chamber is pre evacuated to a vacuum, and then argon gas is introduced to increase the pressure to thousands of pascals. At this pressure, the plasma spray gun is started. Due to the large pressure difference between the gun and the spray chamber, the plasma jet velocity can usually reach the jet velocity with high Mach number, which greatly increases the velocity of the spray particles, improves the adhesion between the coating and the matrix, and reduces the porosity of the coating. It has been applied to thermal corrosion resistant coating, hardmetal coating and refractory metal parts of aeroengine turbine blades. Equipped with spraying robots and computer program control, it can ensure the uniformity and accuracy of blade coating thickness. It can also be used to prepare nano ultrafine powder, superfine fiber, diamond film and C60.

explanation_cn: 在真空条件下进行钢液或液态合金的脱氧、脱氢、脱氮的工艺技术。是改善钢的质量、提高其力学性能和其他物理性能的主要手段。真空条件可降低相关气体的分压从而也降低了气体在钢液中的溶解度;而真空条件下碳-氧反应剧烈搅动钢液可促使气体排出。液态金属表面积大小、搅拌强度、气泡成核速率、扩散等因素均将影响脱气效果。RH、DH、钢包吹氩、滴流脱气、真空浇铸等工艺均为专门脱气的方法，而真空熔炼、真空二次冶金等也具有功能。
explanation_en: Deoxidation, dehydrogenation and denitrification of liquid steel or liquid alloy under vacuum conditions. It is the main means to improve the quality of steel and its mechanical and other physical properties. The vacuum condition can reduce the partial pressure of the relevant gas and thus the water solubility of the gas in the steel liquid; Under vacuum condition, the carbon oxygen reaction agitates the liquid steel violently, which can promote the gas discharge. The surface area of liquid metal, stirring intensity, bubble nucleation rate, diffusion and other factors will affect the degassing effect. RH, DH, ladle argon blowing, trickle degassing, vacuum casting and other processes are special degassing methods, while vacuum melting, vacuum secondary metallurdy and other processes also have functions.

explanation_cn: 又称真空碳脱氧。常压下碳的脱氧能力较弱，而在真空条件下碳的脱氧能力很强。利用真空条件下碳的高脱氧能力和某些金属氧化物的蒸气压比金属的蒸气压高的特点来进行脱氧称为。
explanation_en: It is also called vacuum carbon deoxygenation. The deoxidation capacity of carbon under normal pressure is weak, while the deoxidation capacity of carbon under vacuum condition is strong. Deoxidation is carried out by taking advantage of the high deoxidation capacity of carbon under vacuum conditions and the higher vapor pressure of some metal oxides than that of metals.

explanation_cn: 采用真空自耗炉，利用低电压下电弧热来加热和熔炼金属。这种工艺起始于1839年，20世纪50年代开始用于重熔高温合金。真空自耗炉重熔是将一次熔炼的高温合金电极棒.在真空无渣的条件下，利用低压直流电弧作热源，将自耗电极逐渐溶化，熔化的高温合金液滴滴入水冷铜结晶器内，再凝固成锭。熔滴通过高达5000K的电弧区进入结晶器中，在高真空下得到精炼在金属熔滴形成和下落过程中以致在熔池内，均要发生一系列的冶金反应，如不稳定的氧化物或氮化物的解离或还原气体（特别是氢和氧）的排除和有害杂质的挥发等，同时受水冷铜制结晶器强制冷却作用，因而易得到定向结晶、组织致密、成分均匀及夹杂物分散均匀的锭材，从而可消除各种宏观和微观组织缺陷，克服了一次熔炼高温合金锭的缺点。所以真空自耗重熔是将提纯净化和改善铸锭结晶组织集中在一起的工序过程，使高温合金工艺塑性和持久、疲劳性能等显著改善。
explanation_en: Vacuum consumable furnace is used to heat and melting metal by using arc heat under low voltage. This process started in 1839 and began to be used for remelting high temperature alloy in the 1950s. The vacuum consumable furnace remelting is to melt the consumable electrode of high temperature alloy electrode rod that is melting in a vacuum without slag by using low-voltage DC arc as the heat source. The molten high temperature alloy drops into the water-cooled copper mold and then solidifies into ingots. Molten droplets enter the mold through the arc zone up to 5000K, and are refined under high vacuum. During the formation and falling of metal droplets, a series of metallurgical reactions will occur in the molten pool, such as the dissociation of unstable oxides or nitrides or the removal of reducing gases (especially hydrogen and oxygen) and the volatilization of harmful impurities. At the same time, they are forced by the water-cooled copper mold, so they are easy to obtain directional crystallization, compact structure Ingot materials with uniform composition and dispersed inclusions can eliminate various macro and micro structural defects and overcome the shortcomings of single melting superalloy ingots. Therefore, vacuum consumable remelting is a process that integrates purification and improvement of ingot crystal structure, and significantly improves the technological plasticity, durability and fatigue properties of high temperature alloy.

explanation_cn: 材料或其浸提液滴入宿主眼中，角膜、红膜与结膜所产生的反应。通常以角膜浑浊程度与受损范围，虹膜的损伤程度，以及结膜的充血、水肿和分泌物作为标准评价的强度。
explanation_en: The reaction of the cornea, red membrane and conjunctiva when materials or its extract is dropped into the eyes of the host. The intensity of evaluation is usually based on the degree and extent of corneal opacity and damage, the degree of iris damage, and conjunctival congestion, edema, and secretions.

explanation_cn: 又称色素，是一种具有强烈色泽的物质，当与其他物质接触时，能够赋予其颜色。根据其溶解性和来源，颜料可以分为颜料和染料两种：颜料（Pigments）：颜料通常不溶于水或油，因此它们被用于制备各种颜色的涂料、油墨、绘画颜料等。颜料可以分为无机颜料和有机颜料两类，具有良好的耐热稳定性和分散性。它们广泛应用于绘画、油墨、塑料制品、建筑材料等领域。染料（Dyes）：染料是一种可溶于水或油的着色剂，用于给织物、食品、化妆品等物体染色。它们可以分为天然染料和合成染料两种。染料在染色过程中能够渗透到材料内部，使其着色。在染料应用中，染料的色牢度和耐光性等特性也是关键因素。在化妆品中，使用的着色剂需要满足一系列要求，包括对皮肤无刺激、无毒、无副作用，不含有害物质，具有耐光稳定性和耐热性，无异味、无臭等。此外，着色剂应该有良好的配伍性，使用量低，颜色鲜艳，价格适中等特点。毒性和安全性是着色剂应用的重要考虑因素，因此许多国家和地区都出台了法规来限制使用具有潜在危害的着色剂，特别是重金属着色剂和某些芳香胺类着色剂。
explanation_en: Also known as pigment, it is a substance with strong color. When it contacts with other substances, it can give its color. According to its solubility and source, pigment can be divided into pigment and dye or dyestuffc: pigment: pigment are usually insoluble in water or oil, so they are used to prepare various colors of coatings, inks, painting pigment, etc. Pigment can be divided into inorganic pigment and organic pigment, which have good thermal stability and dispersion. They are widely used in painting, ink, plastics products, building materials and other fields. Dye or dyestuffc: dye or dyestuffc are colorant that are soluble in water or oil and are used to dye fabrics, food, cosmetics and other objects. They can be divided into natural dye or dyestuffc and synthetic dye or dyestuffc. Dye or dyestuffc can penetrate into the interior of materials during dyeing to make them colored. In the application of dye or dyestuffc, the color fastness and light fastness of dye or dyestuffc are also key factors. In cosmetics, colorant used need to meet a series of requirements, including no irritation to skin, no toxicity, no side effects, no harmful substances, light stability and heat resistance, no odor, etc. In addition, colorant should have good compatibility, low usage, bright color, moderate price and other characteristics. Toxicity and safety are important considerations for the application of colorant, so many countries and regions have issued regulations to restrict the use of potentially harmful colorant, especially heavy metal colorant and some aromatic amine colorant.

explanation_cn: 指有色颜料加入白色漆后可使其着色或使其具有颜色深浅的能力。
explanation_en: It refers to the ability of colored pigment to make it colored or have color depth after adding white paint.

explanation_cn: 瞬发辐射分析通常涉及使用辐射测量设备、核仪器、颗粒探测器和数学建模来收集和解释数据。这些分析对于确保辐射相关活动的安全性、有效性和可控性至关重要。
explanation_en: Prompt radiation analysis usually involves the use of radiation measurement equipment, nuclear instruments, particle detectors, and mathematical modeling to collect and interpret data. These analyses are crucial for ensuring the safety, effectiveness, and controllability of radiation related activities.

explanation_cn: 当压坯被加热到烧结温度时.开始出现液相.在烧结保温阶段.由于相互扩散作用.液相逐渐消失的烧结过程。烧结体系通常由高熔点和低熔点粉未混合而成.烧结温度在两者熔点之间，加热时，低熔点粉末首先熔化，润湿溶人高熔点粉末.形成具有合适流动性和对固相粉末润湿良好的液相。液相的出现，促进了烧结.而当烧结完成时，低熔点的液相全部融人固相晶格中.形成高熔点间擀体相，使烧成的工件不再具有低熔点界面相.从而保证其良好的力学性能。瞬时液相烧结广泛应用于制备功能陶瓷、压电陶瓷等。
explanation_en: When the compact is heated to the sintering temperature, the liquid phase begins to appear. At the sintering holding stage, due to the mutual diffusion, the liquid phase gradually disappears in the sintering process. The sintering system is usually composed of high melting point and low melting point powders that are not mixed. The sintering temperature is between the melting point of the two. When heated, the low melting point powder first melts, wetting and dissolving into the high melting point powder, forming a liquid phase with proper flow ability and good wetting of solid powder. The appearance of liquid phase promotes sintering. When sintering is completed, all the liquid phase with low melting point is melted into the solid lattice, forming a "body phase" between high melting point, so that the sintered workpiece no longer has a low melting point interface phase, thus ensuring its good mechanical properties. Transient liquid phase sintering is widely used to prepare functional ceramics, piezoelectric ceramics, etc.

explanation_cn: 磁滞回线呈矩形的软磁合金。主要特性是磁滞回线呈矩形且有很高的矩形比，同时具有低的矫顿力和高的最大磁导率。合金的矩磁特性主要来源于合金的晶粒取向和磁畴取向。矩磁合金主要用于磁放大器、磁调制器、中小功率脉冲变压器、方波变压器和磁芯存储器等。
explanation_en: A soft magnetic alloy with a rectangular magnetic hysteresis. The main characteristics are that the magnetic hysteresis is rectangular and has a high rectangular ratio, while it has low correction force and high maximum permeability. The moment magnetic properties of alloy mainly come from the orientation of grain and orientation of magnetic domain of alloy. Moment magnetic alloys are mainly used in magnetic amplifiers, magnetic modulators, small and medium-sized pulse transformers, square wave transformers, and magnetic core memories.

explanation_cn: 具有矩形磁滞回线且矫顽力较小的铁氧体。主要包括两大类：一类是常温矩磁铁氧体材料，如Mn-Mg系、Mn-Zn系、Cii-Mn系、Cd-Mn系等；另一类是宽温矩磁铁氧体材料，如Li系（Li-Mn、Li-Ni、Li-Cu、Li-Zn等）、Ni系（Ni-Mn、Ni-.Zn、Ni-Cd等）。常温型材料适宜在环境温度不高的条件下工作，它具有矩形性较好，开关时间较短等优点。可作为在室内工作的大容量、高速电子计算机的记忆磁芯，但缺点是居里温度低，温度系数高，使用时需要温度补偿装置；宽温型材料适宜在很高的温度范围内工作，具有居里温度高、温度稳定性好、开关系数较大等特点。矩磁铁氧体在电子计算机、自动控制等科学技术中用作记忆元件、开关元件和逻辑元件等。
explanation_en: Ferrite with rectangular magnetic hysteresis and low coercivity. It mainly includes two categories: one is normal temperature rectangular loop ferrite materials, such as Mn Mg system, Mn Zn system, Cii Mn system, Cd Mn system, etc; The other is wide temperature moment ferrite materials, such as Li system (Li Mn, Li Ni, Li Cu, Li Zn, etc.), Ni system (Ni Mn, Ni -. Zn, Ni Cd, etc.). The normal temperature materials is suitable for working at low ambient temperature. It has the advantages of good rectangularity and short switching time. It can be used as the memory magnetic core of large capacity and high-speed electronic computers working indoors, but its disadvantage is that the Curie temperature temperature is low, the temperature coefficient is high, and the temperature compensation device is required when using it; The wide temperature type materials is suitable for working in a very high temperature range, and has the characteristics of high Curie temperature, good temperature stability, and large switching coefficient. Rectangular loop ferrite is used as memory element, switch element and logic element in computer, automatic control and other science and technology.

explanation_cn: 铁磁性和亚铁磁性物质的饱和磁滞回线（B-H回线）与横坐标交点的磁场值。在M-H回线上的交点记为称为本征矫顽力，单位是A/m，它的物理意义是当 物质饱和磁化以后，由于磁滞的原因，除去外磁场，其磁感应强度并不为零，为使物质完全退磁（B = 0 或M=0)所需加的反向磁场。
explanation_en: The magnetic field value at the intersection of the saturation magnetic hysteresis (B-H loop) of ferromagnetism and ferrimagnetism materials and the abscissa. The intersection point on the M-H loop is called the intrinsic coercive force, and its unit is A/m. Its physical meaning is that when the material is saturation magnetization, its magnetic induction intensity is not zero after the external magnetic field is removed due to hysteresis, and the reverse magnetic field required to completely demagnetize the material (B=0 or M=0).

explanation_cn: 具有电堆的所有特性但其发电功率小于负载所需功率的电堆。短堆中所用各部件和电堆中所用各部件完全相同（如极板、膜电极和流体分配腔室的形状和截面积），但短堆中单电池数量小于电堆中单电池数量。使用短堆的主要目的是在尽量节约材料的情况下研究电堆的特性。
explanation_en: A stack that has all the characteristics of a stack, but its generating power is less than the power required by the load. The components used in the short stack are identical to those used in the stack (such as the shape and cross-sectional area of plate, membrane electrode and manifold), but the number of single cells in the short stack is less than that in the stack. The main purpose of using short stack is to study the characteristics of stack while saving materials as much as possible.

explanation_cn: 塑料管在规定时间内破坏前管壁所能承受的最大张应力，用来评价管材的短期耐压强度。一般各种规格管材出厂检验都要进行该试验，是实际生产中对产品的一种检验手段。
explanation_en: The maximum tensile stress that the pipe wall can withstand before the plastic pipe is damaged within the specified time is used to evaluate the short-term compressive strength of tube. Generally, the test is required for the delivery inspection of various specifications of tube, which is an inspection method for products in actual production.

explanation_cn: 是指油度在50%以下的醇酸树脂。
explanation_en: It refers to alkyd resin with oil degree below 50%.

explanation_cn: 是指以尽可能少的制备工序实现材料（产品）的生产或加工。
explanation_en: It refers to the production or processing of materials (products) with as few preparation processes as possible.

explanation_cn: 决定固溶体内原子近邻范围内组元原子间有序分布程度的参量。
explanation_en: A parameter that determines the degree of ordered distribution between component atoms within the vicinity of atoms in a solid solution.

explanation_cn: 又称切断纤维。将适当线密度的化学纤维长丝束切断或拉断成为类似于各种天然纤维长度的纤维。短纤维的生产由化纤长丝束经拉伸、上油、卷曲、切断、定型等工序组成。短纤维可以纯纺，也可与天然纤维或其他化学纤维混纺。
explanation_en: It is also called cut off fibers. Cut or pull the man-made fiber tow with proper linear density to form a fiber similar to the length of various natural fiber. The production of staple fiber consists of chemical fiber filamem bundle stretching, oiling, crimping, cutting, shaping and other processes. Staple fiber can be pure spun, or blended with natural fiber or other man-made fiber.

explanation_cn: 亦称切断纤维增强体。化学纤维长纤维束被切断或拉断成相当于各种天然纤维长度的纤维。也可用天然纤维如石棉及晶须。
explanation_en: Also called cut off fiber reinforcement. The long bundle of man-made fiber is cut or pulled to break into fibers equivalent to the length of various natural fiber. Natural fiber such as asbestos and crystal whisker can also be used.

name_cn: 短纤维增强金属基复合材料
name_en: short fiber reinforced metal matrix composite
explanation_cn: 以短纤维增强的以金属或合金为基体的复合材料。金属基体主要有铝、镁、锌、铅、铜等金属及合金。短纤维的材质主要有碳、氧化铝（Saffile)、硅酸铝、碳化硅、氮化硼等。短纤维可以是天然纤维制品（长度一般为35-150mm)或是由连续纤维切割而成的长度为1-50mm的短切纤维。
explanation_en: Staple fiber reinforced composite materials based on metal or alloy. Metal matrix mainly includes aluminum, magnesium, zinc, lead, copper and other metals and alloy. Staple fiber is mainly made of carbon, aluminum oxide (Saffile), aluminum silicate, silicon carbide, boron nitride, etc. Staple fiber can be natural fiber products (generally 35-150mm in length) or short cut fibers with a length of 1-50mm cut from continuous fibers.

explanation_cn: 由相互平行堆叠的多环碳六角平面构成具有三维晶体规则性的碳同素异形体。
explanation_en: The carbon allotrope with 3D crystal regularity is composed of multi ring carbon hexagonal planes stacked in parallel with each other.

explanation_cn: 指非石墨化炭经至少1500°C以上的热处理，主要物理变化是使其乱层堆叠结构转变成H维规则的石墨结构。
explanation_en: It refers to the non graphitization carbon after heat treatment at least above 1500 ° C. The main physical change is to make its disorderly stacking structure transformation into H-dimensional regular graphite structure.

explanation_cn: 表示炭材料中石墨化进行到何种程度的经验参数指标，一般采用层间距心()2作为石墨化的指标.也可用微晶大小、拉曼特征谱峰强度比、真密度、磁阻、残留电阻比等来表征。
explanation_en: The empirical parameter index that indicates the degree of graphitization in carbon materials generally uses interlayer spacing center () 2 as the index of graphitization. It can also be characterized by microcrystal size, Raman characteristic spectrum peak intensity ratio, true density, magnetoresistance, residual resistance ratio, etc.

explanation_cn: 利用石墨的耐热性高、热膨胀系数小、易于加工的特点，而用作各种用途的夹具，如制造半导体材料用的夹具，附着银焊料、焊锡等的焊料夹具，输送高温物质（如熔融玻璃等）的夹具等。
explanation_en: Graphite is characterized by high heat resistance, low coefficient of thermcal expansion and easy processing, and is used as fixtures for various purposes, such as those for manufacturing semiconductor materials, those for attaching silver solder, solder, etc., and those for transporting high-temperature materials (such as molten glass, etc.).

explanation_cn: 将苯环共辄连接形成的具有二维平面网络结构的单原子层结构，也被看成是二维碳的同素异形体，同时具有sp、sp2和sp3三种杂化态。
explanation_en: The single atom layer structure with a two-dimensional planar network structure formed by co connecting benzene rings is also considered as an allotrope of two-dimensional carbon, and has three hybrid states: sp, sp2, and sp3.

explanation_cn: 即单层石墨片，是由一层碳原子通过Sp2杂化方式构成六角形呈蜂巢晶格的二维晶i体。石墨烯是世界上最薄的二维材料，单层石墨烯的厚度仅为0.34nm,约为头发丝直径的二十万分之一。石墨烯具有许多优异的特性，比如力学、光学、电学、热学等物理化学性质，同时还拥有巨大的比表面积。:石墨烯是迄今为止强度和硬度最高的材料，其拉伸强度和弹性模量分别为125GPa和1.1TPa。石墨烯具有优异的电学性质，具有很高的迁移率，约为桂中电子迁移率的140倍。石墨稀具有很高的导热性能，其室温热导率约为5000W/(m?K).是室温下铜的热导率的10倍多。目前，制备石墨烯的方法主要包括机械剥离法、外延生长法、氧化还原法、液相剥离法、有机合成法、溶剂热法、化学气相沉积法等。根据其超薄.强度超大的特性，石墨烯可被广泛应用于各领域，比如超轻防弹衣、超薄超轻型飞机材料等。根据其优异的电学性质，使它在微电子领域也具有巨大的应用潜力，有可能取代硅制造超微型晶体管。由于其高电导性、高比表面积，石墨烯材料在新能源领域如超级电容器、锂离子电池等方面也有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: The single-layer graphite sheet is a two-dimensional crystal i with hexagonal honeycomb lattice formed by a layer of carbon atoms through Sp2 hybridization. Graphene is the thinnest two-dimensional materials in the world. The thickness of a single layer of graphene is only 0.34nm, about 200000 times the diameter of a hair. Graphene has many excellent properties, such as mechanical, optical, electrical, thermal and other physical chemistry properties, and also has a huge specific surface Graphene is the materials with the highest strength and hardness so far, and its tensile strength and elastic modulus are 125 GPa and 1.1 TPa respectively. Graphene has excellent electrical properties and high mobility, about 140 times the mobility of Guizhong electron. Graphite thin has very high thermal conductivity. Its room temperature thermal conductivity is about 5000W/(m? K), more than 10 times the thermal conductivity of copper at room temperature. At present, the preparation methods of graphene mainly include mechanical stripping method, epitaxial growth method, redox method, liquid phase stripping method, organic synthesis method, solvothermal method, chemical vapor deposition method, etc. According to its super thin and super strong characteristics, graphene can be widely used in various fields, such as ultralight bulletproof clothing, ultrathin ultralight aircraft materials, etc. Due to its excellent electrical properties, it also has great potential for application in the field of microelectronics, potentially replacing silicon in the manufacturing of ultra micro transistors. Due to its high conductivity and high specific surface area, graphene materials also have broad application prospects in new energy fields such as supercapacitors, Li ion battery, etc.

explanation_cn: 石墨烯层数是石墨烯各种性质的决定性因素之一。石墨烯的层数不同，其电子结构会发生显著的变化，石墨烯层数的鉴定十分重要。原子力显微镜是表征石墨烯片层结构的有效工具之一，直接观察其表面形貌.测定其厚度.但效率低.且由于表面吸附物的存在.使其测得的厚度比实际值偏大。透射电镜对石墨烯层片边缘进行高分辨成像，也可以获得石墨烯的层数信息。拉曼光谱是表征石墨烯层数的一种无破坏性且相对有效的手段，其峰谱形状、宽度和位置与其层数相关。光学显微镜是快速简便表征石墨烯层数的一种冇效辅助方法。
explanation_en: The number of graphene layers is one of the decisive factors for various properties of graphene. The number of layers of graphene is different, and its electronic structure will change significantly. The identification of the number of layers of graphene is very important. Atomic force microscope (AFM) is one of the effective tools for characterizing the lamellar structure of graphene, which can directly observe its surface morphology and measure its thickness. However, the efficiency is low, and the measured thickness is larger than the actual value due to the presence of surface adsorbents. Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) can also obtain the layer number information of graphene by high-resolution imaging of graphene layer edges. Raman spectroscopy is a non-destructive and relatively effective means to characterize the number of layers of graphene. The shape, width and position of the peak spectrum are related to the number of layers. Optical microscope is a fast and simple method to characterize the number of graphene layers.

explanation_cn: 利用石墨烯稀磁的高电子迁移率（室温下为10,000 cm^2/V·s）和高光学透过率（单层可见光透过率为97.7%）特性，作为半导体器件的透明电极，可以替代传统的氧化物透明电极，在半导体领域具有广阔的应用前景。目前，制备石墨烯电极主要有两种方法：一种是将石墨烯氧化物旋涂在基底上，然后在高温下还原；另一种方法是利用化学气相沉积法（CVD）的方法在金属镍或铜表面催化生长石墨烯，然后再转移到不同的基底上。
explanation_en: With the high electron mobility (10000 cm ^ 2/V · s at room temperature) and high optical transmittance (97.7% of the single-layer visible light transmittance) of graphene diluted magnetic field, as the transparent electrode of semiconductor devices, it can replace the traditional oxide transparent electrode, and has broad application prospects in the semiconductor field. At present, there are two main methods to prepare graphene electrode: one is spin coating graphene oxide on the substrate, and then reducing it at high temperature; Another method is to use chemical vapor deposition (CVD) to catalyze the growth of graphene on the surface of nickel or copper, and then transfer it to different substrates.

explanation_cn: 是指利用尺寸为微纳米级别的石墨烯或氧化石墨烯片.通过湿法纺丝方法或其他方法制成的长度可以达到数米的宏观纤维.现有的石墨烯纤维由于不同的石墨烯片之问的结合力弱，其强度比常规碳纤维略低.如何增大石墨烯片结合力、提高石墨烯纤维的强度是该种纤维今后应用的重要研究方向。同时.石墨烯纤维具有质量轻、韧性好、电导率高、抗腐蚀等优点，可替代金属作为导线，可用作复合材料的增强材料.也可用于柔性器件与系统中。
explanation_en: It refers to the use of micro nano graphene or graphene oxide sheets. The length of macro fibers can reach several meters through wet spinning or other methods. The existing graphene fiber are slightly lower in strength than conventional carbon fibers due to the weak adhesion between different graphene sheets. How to increase the adhesion of graphene sheets and improve the strength of graphene fiber is an important research direction for the future application of such fibers. At the same time, graphene fiber has the advantages of light weight, good toughness, high electric conductivity, corrosion resistance, etc. It can replace metal as a conductor, and can be used as reinforcement materials of composite materials materials. It can also be used in flexible devices and systems.

explanation_cn: 石墨烯的表面修饰是指通过物理的或化学的方法在石墨烯的表面进行功能化修饰.以改善其分散性和可加工性》结构完整的石墨烯化学稳定性高，容易产生聚集，利用石墨烯表面修饰可以改善其分散性和可加工性。石墨烯的表面修饰分为共价键修饰和非共价键修饰两种。
explanation_en: Surface modification of graphene refers to functional modification on the surface of graphene by physical or chemical methods to improve its dispersibility and processability. graphene with complete structure has high chemical stability and is prone to aggregation. graphene surface modification can improve its dispersibility and processability. The surface modification of graphene can be divided into covalent bond modification and non covalent bond modification.

explanation_cn: 由富含有机质的沉积岩和火成岩经中级区域变质作用形成的含石墨的变质岩。是鳞片状石墨的主要岩石。主要矿物以斜长石、石英、石墨为主（含量50%-60%),其次为黑云母、辉石、角闪石等。细粒鱗片变晶结构，部分为纤维状花岗变晶结构，片麻状构造。岩石呈灰色、青灰色、黑灰色。
explanation_en: Graphite bearing metamorphic rock is formed by intermediate regional metamorphism of organic rich sedimentary rock and igneous rock. It is the main rock of scaly graphite. The main minerals are plagioclase, quartze and graphite (50% -60%), followed by biotite, pyroxene and hornblende. Fine scale balastic texture, part of which is fibrous granite balastic texture and gneissose structure. Rock is gray, greenish gray and blackish gray.

explanation_cn: 一般指使用量大的炼钢用人造石墨电极，也包括电化学用电极、人造石I墨电极、石墨电极板、光谱分析用电极、铝电解精炼电解槽用的炭材料。以石油焦、针状焦等为原料，沥青等作黏结剂，经锻烧、配料、混捏、压型、焙烧、石墨化、机加工等而制成。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to the artificial graphite electrode for steelmaking making, which is widely used, and also includes the electrode for electrochemistry, artificial graphite I electrode, graphite electrode plate, electrode for spectral analysis, and carbon material for aluminum electrolysis refining electrolyzer. With petroleum coke, needle coke, etc. as raw materials, pitch, etc. as binder, it is made by calcination, batching, kneading, molding, roasting, graphitization, machining, etc.

explanation_cn: 石墨在辐照时会产生缺陷，这些缺陷引起的热能增加通常被称为Wigner能量。辐照温度越低，缺陷积累越快，总的缺陷能量也越大。例如，石墨在30°C和5×10^20 n/cm^2辐照条件下，总缺陷能量达到2.633×10^6 J/kg，这个值相当于未辐照的石墨在100°C至150°C之间的总热容量。当辐照过的石墨被加热到高于辐照温度50°C至100°C时，缺陷能量以热的形式被释放。当辐照温度较低，注量不高时，辐照后加热和退火在170°C至200°C之间存在缺陷能量释放的峰值。随着注量的增加，这个峰值逐渐减小；当辐照温度高于150°C时，峰值消失，辐照温度超过300°C至350°C时，缺陷能量的积累将不再是一个重要问题。当缺陷能量的释放速率（dS/dT）大于石墨的比热容（Cp）时，可能引发缺陷能量的自发释放，导致石墨温度迅速上升，从而存在引发石墨自燃的危险。在石墨生产堆中，石墨温度较低（低于250°C），存在着石墨缺陷能量失控的问题。可以通过选择适当的运行条件、限制总的缺陷能量，以及限制缺陷能量的释放速度来预防缺陷能量的自发释放。
explanation_en: Graphite will produce defects when irradiated, and the increase of heat energy caused by these defects is usually called Wigner energy. The lower the irradiation temperature, the faster the accumulation of defects, and the greater the total defect energy. For example, graphite at 30 ° C and 5 × Under irradiation conditions of 10 ^ 20 n/cm ^ 2, the total defect energy reaches 2.633 × 10 ^ 6 J/kg, which is equivalent to the total heat capacity of non irradiated graphite between 100 ° C and 150 ° C. When the irradiated graphite is heated to 50 ° C to 100 ° C higher than the irradiation temperature, the defect energy is released in the form of heat. When the irradiation temperature is low and the fluence is not high, there is a peak value of defect energy release between 170 ° C and 200 ° C for post irradiation heating and annealing. As the fluence increases, this peak gradually decreases; When the irradiation temperature exceeds 150 ° C, the peak disappears, and when the irradiation temperature exceeds 300 ° C to 350 ° C, the accumulation of defect energy will no longer be an important issue. When the release rate of defect energy (dS/dT) is greater than the specific heat [capacity (Cp) of graphite, it may lead to the spontaneous release of defect energy, resulting in the rapid rise of graphite temperature, which may lead to the risk of spontaneous combustion of graphite. In the graphite production reactor, the temperature of graphite is low (below 250 ° C), and the energy of graphite defect is out of control. The spontaneous release of defect energy can be prevented by selecting appropriate operating conditions, limiting the total defect energy, and limiting the release rate of defect energy.

explanation_cn: 核辐射引起的石墨的性能变化。辐射对石墨性能的影响主要取决于中子能量、通量密度和注量、辐照温度、温度梯度和石墨的结构与类型。
explanation_en: The performance change of graphite caused by nuclear radiation. The effects of radiation on the properties of graphite mainly depend on the neutron energy, flux density and fluence, irradiation temperature, temperature gradient, and the structure and type of graphite.

explanation_cn: 石墨纤维亦称高模量碳纤维.将含碳量在90%以上的碳纤维在高温炉内以一定的升温速度（约200t7h)惰性气体保护下.加张力于2500-3000°C热处理,形成纤维含碳量在99%以上具有层状六方晶格的石墨结构纤维。石墨化过程中，碳纤维中残留的非碳原子不断被驱除，形成的碳芳环平面逐渐增大，排列趋于规整，择优取向明显提高.逐渐由二维无规层状石墨结构向三维有序结构转化。晶体的增长及其尺寸取决于石墨化温度和含碳量。影响石墨化程度的主要因素有加张程度、介质、温度、时间及碳纤维的取向度等。石墨纤维质轻，耐热性高.热膨胀系数小.耐热冲击性好，抗燃性，导电性，耐化学性.耐水性，耐挠性及尺寸稳定性良好。在无氧情况下最高可耐350CTC，365CTC左右升华。是两种典型石墨纤维，其力学性能分别是拉伸强度为2.15GPa.2.24GPa;密度为2.16g/cm3和2.18g/cm3。石墨纤维可用于高温绝缘辐射屏罩。石墨纤维增强体主要用于结构复合材料.特别是先进复合材料的增强体。另外.石墨纤维的织物用聚四氟乙烯浸渍后，可作为密封功能复合材料用。
explanation_en: Graphite fiber, also known as high modulus carbon fiber, is tensioned at 2500-3000 ° C under inert gas protection at a certain heating rate (about 200t7h) in a high-temperature furnace under heat treatment at a temperature of 2500-3000 ° C to form a graphite structured fiber with a carbon content of more than 99% and a layered hexagonal lattice. In the process of graphitization, the remaining non carbon atoms in the carbon fibers are continuously removed, the plane of the formed carbon aromatic rings is gradually increased, the arrangement tends to be regular, and the preferred orientation is significantly improved. The structure is gradually transformed from two-dimensional random layered graphite to three-dimensional ordered structure. The growth and size of crystal depend on graphitization temperature and carbon content. The main factors affecting the degree of graphitization are the degree of tension, medium, temperature, time and the degree of orientation of carbon fibers. Graphite fiber is light, high in heat resistance, low in coefficient of thermcal expansion, good in heat shock resistance, fire resistance, conductivity, chemical resistance, water resistance, flexibility resistance and dimensional stability. Under anaerobic conditions, it can withstand up to 350CTC and sublimation at around 365CTC. They are two typical graphite fibers, and their mechanical properties are tensile strength 2.15GPa. 2.24GPa; The density is 2.16g/cm3 and 2.18g/cm3. Graphite fiber can be used for high temperature insulation radiation shield. Graphite fiber reinforcement is mainly used in structural composite materials, especially the reinforcement of advanced composite materials. In addition, graphite fiber fabric can be used as sealed functional composite after being impregnated with polylctrafluorocthylone.

explanation_cn: 有意加人石墨化元素桂，经石墨化退火后在其组织中存在一定量石墨的钢。石墨具有固体润滑的作用且可吸收冲击能量，控制钢中石墨的量及其分布形态，可限制石墨对钢的强度的不利影响而发挥其固体润滑和吸收冲击能量的有利作用，可广泛用作减振降噪耐磨材料。
explanation_en: Steel that is intentionally added with graphitization element and has a certain amount of graphite in its structure after graphitization and annealing. Graphite has the function of solid lubrication and can absorb impact energy. It can control the amount and distribution of graphite in steel, limit the adverse effect of graphite on the strength of steel and play its beneficial role in solid lubrication and absorption of impact energy. It can be widely used as a wear resisting materials for vibration and noise reduction.

explanation_cn: 用黏土熟料、结合黏土与石墨粉制成耐火砖生产工艺与黏土砖类似，只是在烧成时需要气氛保护。
explanation_en: The production process of refractory bricks made of clay clinker, clay and graphite powder is similar to that of chamotte brick, except that atmosphere protection is required during firing.

explanation_cn: 纤维状硅酸盐矿物及纤维状氢氧化物矿物的总称.商业用词。常呈集合体出现。用机械方法可分离成极细的纤维，在火中不燃烧.故称石棉。包括链状结构硅酸盐的角闪石石棉、层状结构硅酸盐的蛇纹石石棉、层状结构氢氧化物的水镁石石棉。具有工业价值的有：①钠闪石石棉（又名青石棉或蓝石棉），浅蓝或浅蓝灰色；纤维耐酸能力强，但杭张强度差；主要产于蓝片岩中或经钠质交代的片岩中：②纤蛇纹石石棉（又名温石棉或低铁石棉）.化学式为浅黄绿或蓝绿色。纤维抗张强度较高.作1耐酸能力较差。产于蛇纹岩裂隙中这两种石棉均制成石棉制品.用于隔热、绝缘、防火等领域。蓝石棉还吋以过滤有毒气体.是战略物资。
explanation_en: General term for fibrous silicate mineral and fibrous hydroxide minerals. Commercial terms. It often appears as an aggregate. It can be separated into very fine fibers by mechanical method and will not combustion in fire, so it is called asbestos. It includes amphibole asbestos of chain silicate, serpentine asbestos of layered silicate and brucite asbestos of layered hydroxide. The industrial value includes: ① riebeckite (also known as blue asbestos or crocidolite), light blue or light blue gray; Fiber has strong acid resistance, but poor tensile strength; It is mainly produced in blue schist or sodium metasomatized schist: ② chrysotile asbestos (also known as chrysotile asbestos or low-ferroasbestos). The chemical formula is light yellow green or blue green. The fiber has high tensile strength and poor acid resistance. Both asbestos and asbestos produced in serpentinite fissures are made into asbestos products, which are used in heat insulation, insulation, fire prevention and other fields. Crocidolite is also used to filter toxic gases. It is a strategic material.

explanation_cn: 由沉积岩和中性火成岩经中高级区域变质作用形成的富含斜长石和石榴子石的片麻岩。主要矿物为斜长石、石榴子石、石英、黑云母等，
explanation_en: Gneiss rich in plagioclase and garnet, which is formed from sedimentary rock and intermediate igneous rock through middle and high grade regional metamorphism. The main minerals are plagioclase, garnet, quartze, biotite, etc,

explanation_cn: 石棉石矿是金属的硅酸盐。钇铝石榴石（YAG）晶体是一种硅酸盐晶体，其化学式为Y3Al5O12。这种晶体的空间群属于立方晶系，其晶格常数为约12.002埃，每个晶胞中包含八个Y3Al5O12分子。YAG晶体由三种不同的格位组成，每个Y3+离子位于八个Al3+离子构成的十二面体格位中，而四十个Al3+离子分别位于八个Si4+离子构成的八面体格位和四个O2-离子构成的四面体格位中。这种晶体的结构使得它适合用作激光材料。由于YAG晶体结构的特点，它可以容纳激活离子，如稀土离子和过渡金属离子，以实现激光发射。例如，用稀土元素（如Gd、Ho、Er、Tm、Yb、Lu等）替代Y和用过渡金属元素（如Ga、Sc、Fe等）替代Al，然后通过适当的激活离子掺杂，可以获得不同波长和性能的石榴石型激光晶体。这些石榴石型激光晶体广泛用于激光技术，包括波长可调谐激光、高转换效率激光和具有高储能能力的激光等应用。石榴石型激光晶体已被用于产生波长范围从0.3146微米到2.9365微米的激光，因此在激光技术中具有广泛的应用
explanation_en: Asbestos ore is the silicate of metals. Yttrium aluminum garnet (YAG) crystal is a silicate crystal with the chemical formula Y3Al5O12. The space group of this crystal belongs to the cubic crystal system, whose lattice constant is about 12.002 angstroms, and each unit cell of crystal contains eight Y3Al5O12 molecules. YAG crystal consists of three different lattice sites. Each Y3+ion is located in the dodecahedral lattice site composed of eight Al3+ions, while forty Al3+ions are located in the octahedral lattice site composed of eight Si4+ions and the tetrahedral lattice site composed of four O2 ions. The structure of this crystal makes it suitable for use as a laser materials. Due to the characteristics of YAG crystal structure, it can accommodate activated ions, such as rare earth ions and transition metal ions, to achieve laser emission. For example, by replacing Y with rare earth elements (such as Gd, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu, etc.) and replacing Al with transition metal elements (such as Ga, Sc, Fe, etc.), and then through appropriate activation ion doping, garnet laser crystal with different wavelengths and properties can be obtained. These garnet laser crystal are widely used in laser technology, including wavelength tunable lasers, high conversion efficiency lasers and lasers with high energy storage capacity. Garnet laser crystal have been used to generate lasers with wavelengths ranging from 0.3146 μ m to 2.9365 μ m, so they are widely used in laser technology

explanation_cn: 是石油裂解所副产的Cn(芳香族类）馏分，经前处理、聚合、蒸馏等工艺生产的一种热塑性树脂，它不是高分子量聚合物，而是分子量介于300-3000的低聚物。石油树脂因来源为石油衍生物而得名，它具冇酸值低、混溶性好、耐水、耐乙醇和耐化学品等特性.对酸碱具有化学稳定性，并有调节黏性和热稳定性好的特点。石油树脂一般不单独使用，而是作为促进剂、调节剂、改性剂和其他树脂一起使用。石油树脂是近年来新开发的一种化工产品，由于其有价格低廉、混溶性好等优点.可广泛用于橡胶、胶黏剂、涂料、造纸、油墨等多种行业和领域。
explanation_en: It is a thermoplastic resin produced by pretreatment, polymerization, distillation and other processes from Cn (aromatic) fraction, a by-product of petroleum cracking institute. It is not a macromolecule polymer, but a oligomer with a molecular weight of 300-3000. Petroleum resin is named because it is derived from petroleum derivatives. It has low acid value, good miscibility, water resistance, ethanol resistance and chemical resistance. It is chemically stable to acids and bases, and has good viscosity regulation and thermal stability. Generally, petroleum resin is not used alone, but used together with other resin as accelerator, regulator, modifier. Petroleum resin is a newly developed chemical product in recent years. Because of its low price and good miscibility, it can be widely used in rubber, adhesive, coatings, paper making, printing ink and other industries and fields.

explanation_cn: 以石油系重质油为原料，经焦化装置热解裂化制造的焦炭，碳含量大于90%且杂质较少。
explanation_en: With petroleum heavy oil as raw material, coke produced by pyrolysis cracking of coking unit has carbon content more than 90% and less impurities.

explanation_cn: 在石灰釉的基础上发展起来的中国传统高温釉品种.该釉料中以长石代替部分石灰石，使釉中K2O，Na2O含量提高而CaO含量相应降低，釉的组成便演变成石灰碱釉.其特点是高温黏度大，不易流动，釉层较厚，釉面光泽柔和，无刺眼感觉，降低了烟熏和裂釉的倾向.主要用来配制釉色或胎色较深的制品，如梅子青，豆青釉等。如中国南宋、元、明时的龙泉青釉，南宋以后各地窑场生产的各种高温颜色釉，元明以来的景德镇白瓷釉都属此类
explanation_en: Chinese traditional high-temperature glaze developed on the basis of lime glaze. This glaze uses feldspar instead of part of limestone to increase the K2O and Na2O content in glaze and correspondingly reduce the CaO content. The composition of glaze will evolve into lime alkali glaze. It is characterized by high temperature viscosity, difficulty in flowing, thick glaze layer, soft glaze luster, no dazzling feeling, and reduced the tendency of smoke and cracking of glaze. It is mainly used to prepare products with deep glaze color or body color, Such as plum green, bean green glaze, etc. For example, the Longquan celadon glaze in the Southern Song Dynasty, Yuan Dynasty and Ming Dynasty in China, various high-temperature colored glaze produced in various kilns after the Southern Song Dynasty, and Jingdezhen white porcelain glaze since the Yuan and Ming Dynasties all belong to this category

explanation_cn: 以方解石为主要矿物的沉积岩。矿物成分主要是方解石，但含一些陆源碎屑物和黏土矿物，如各种砂粒、粉砂质、燧石、白云石等。较纯的石灰岩一般呈灰色、浅灰，含泥质或白云质时呈灰白、黄白色.含有机质较多时呈灰黑、深灰色。硬度3,加稀盐酸强烈起泡。按成分可分为石灰岩、含泥质灰岩、内云质灰岩；按结构可分为粒屑亮晶灰岩（如竹叶状灰岩、鲕粒灰岩、生物碎屑灰岩等）、粒肩微晶灰岩、泥晶灰岩、生物礁灰岩、藻灰岩等。是生产硅酸盐水泥的主要原料：可用作冶炼用熔剂；还吋作为生产苏打、电石、染料、漂白剂、造纸、肥料；可用作食品业中的澄清剂；在陶瓷业中可作为瓷釉的配料，在环保方面可用作吸附剂.在农牧业中用来改良土壤和作家畜词料的配料：可用来烧制石灰或直接用作建筑石材、铁路枕木垫石。结晶均匀、纹理特别的石灰岩可作高级装饰石材。石灰岩的大裂隙或空洞中有时可形成纯净透明的冰洲石.是宝贵的光学材料，有些晶莹透亮的方解石晶族还是高级的工艺品。一些微晶硅质石灰岩，因石质致密细腻，孔隙小而少，微晶石英颗粒分布均匀，是名贵的砚石原料。
explanation_en: Sedimentary rock with caldte as the main mineral. The mineral composition is mainly caldte, but contains some terrigenous detritus and clay mineral, such as various sands, silty sands, flint, dolomite, etc. The relatively pure limestone is generally gray and light gray, grayish white and yellowish white with argillaceous or dolomite, and grayish black and dark gray with more organic matter. Hardness 3, add dilute hydrochloric acid to strongly foam. According to composition, it can be divided into limestone, argillaceous limestone and inner dolomite limestone; According to its structure, it can be divided into fine-grained bright crystal limestone (such as bamboo leaf shaped limestone, oolitic limestone, bioclastic limestone, etc.), shoulder microcrystalline limestone, mud crystal limestone, reef limestone, algal limestone, etc. It is the main raw material for producing Portland cement: it can be used as flux for smelting; It is also used in the production of soda, calcium carbide, dye or dyestuffc, bleach, paper making and fertilizer; Can be used as a clarifying agent in the food industry; It can be used as the ingredient of porcelain glaze in the ceramic industry, and as an adsorbent in environmental protection. It can be used to improve soil and livestock materials in agriculture and animal husbandry: it can be used to burn lime or directly used as building stone, railway crosstie pad stone. Limestone with uniform crystal and special texture can be used as high-grade decorative stone. Pure and transparent iceland spar can sometimes be formed in the large cracks or cavities of limestone. It is a precious optical materials, and some crystal families of crystal caldte are also advanced handicrafts. Some microcrystalline siliceous limestone is a precious raw material for inkstone because of its compactness and fineness, small pores and even distribution of microcrystalline quartze particles.

explanation_cn: 一种以氧化镁为主要成分的耐火材料。它具有良好的抗碱性和渣能力，可以吸附钢液中的氧化铝等杂质，起到洁净钢液的作用。然而，氧化镁具有极易水化的特性，难以长时间保存，这限制了其使用。它通常用于制造熔炼高纯铂、铜等金属的坩埚以及中间包过滤器等应用中，以确保金属在熔炼过程中保持高纯度。
explanation_en: A refractory mainly composed of magnesium oxide. It has good alkali resistance and slag resistance, can absorb impurities such as aluminum oxide in steel liquid, and plays the role of cleaning clean steel liquid. However, magnesium oxide has the characteristic of being easily hydrated and difficult to store for a long time, which limits its use. It is usually used to manufacture crucibles for melting high-purity platinum, copper and other metals, as well as tundish filters and other applications, to ensure that metals remain high-purity in the melting process.

explanation_cn: 又称灰釉，是中国传统高温釉品种之一。它主要以CaO（氧化钙）作为主要助熔剂。CaO通常来自于草木灰、石灰石以及釉果等材料。草木灰中的CaO含量高达15%到20%，此外，草木灰还含有其他元素，如SiO2（二氧化硅）、Al2O3（氧化铝）、Fe2O3（氧化铁）、K2O（氧化钾）、MnO、P2O5等，这些成分对于釉的形成都是必需的。其中，磷元素能够在高温下促使釉产生液-液分相，从而形成乳浊感和一系列独特的艺术效果。例如，唐代的郏县窑釉中的花袖、宋代的钧窑釉中的天青和月白，宋代的建窑釉中的兔毫、油滴，以及吉州窑釉中的玳瑁等名贵色釉中的液-液分相都与磷的存在相关。商代以后，逐渐开始使用釉灰来代替草木灰。釉灰是石灰石与草木一同烧制后留下的产物。在制备釉料时，采用某些助熔剂含量较高的瓷石（如景德镇的釉果），并与适量的釉灰混合即可制备成釉。石灰釉的特点包括高温下的黏度较低，易于流动，釉层不能太厚，透明性强，釉面光泽好，釉面硬度大等特点。它的成熟温度通常在摄氏1200到1250度之间。石灰釉不仅具有较好的透明性，还有助于多种颜色的发色。特别是在制备青花、铜红、铁青、铬绿等多种色釉时，只有使用石灰釉才能得到较理想的颜色效果。石灰釉在中国传统陶瓷制作中具有重要地位，并且为陶瓷作品提供了多种色彩选择。
explanation_en: Also known as lime glaze, it is one of the traditional high-temperature glaze varieties in China. It mainly uses CaO (calcium oxide) as the main flux. CaO usually comes from materials such as plant ash, limestone and glaze fruit. CaO content in plant ash is as high as 15% to 20%. In addition, plant ash also contains other elements, such as SiO2 (silicon dioxide), Al2O3 (aluminum oxide), Fe2O3 (iron oxide), K2O (potassium oxide), MnO, P2O5, etc., which are necessary for the formation of glaze. Among them, phosphorus can promote glaze to produce liquid-liquid phase separation under high temperature, thus forming opacification and a series of unique artistic effects. For example, the floral sleeves in the glaze of Jiaxian Kiln in the Tang Dynasty, the azure and moonlight in the glaze of Jun Kiln in the Song Dynasty, the rabbit hair and oil drops in the glaze of Jian Kiln in the Song Dynasty, and the liquid-liquid phase separation in rare colored glazes such as tortoise shell in the glaze of Jizhou Kiln are all related to the existence of phosphorus. After the Shang Dynasty, glaze ash gradually began to be used instead of plant ash. Glaze ash is the product of burning limestone together with plants. When preparing glaze, china stone with high flux content (such as glaze fruit in Jingdezhen) is used and mixed with appropriate glaze ash to prepare glaze. The characteristics of lime glaze include low viscosity under high temperature, easy flow, glaze layer can not be too thick, strong transparency, good glaze luster, and large hardness of glaze. Its maturity temperature is usually between 1200 and 1250 degrees Celsius. Lime glaze not only has good transparency, but also contributes to the coloration of many colors. Especially in the preparation of blue and white, copper red, iron blue, chrome green and other color glazes, only the use of lime glaze can get a better color effect. Lime glaze plays an important role in the production of Chinese traditional ceramics, and provides a variety of color choices for ceramics.

explanation_cn: 又称石炭。由菌藻类等生物遗体在浅海、泻湖、海湾环境中，经腐泥化作用和煤化作用转变成的高灰分（灰分一般>60%)、深变质(变质程度大体相当无烟煤）的可燃有机苦石。外观似岩石，易与石灰岩或碳质页岩相混淆。含碳量较高的优质石煤一般为黑色，具半亮光泽，杂质少，裂隙较发育。质量较差者则颜色偏灰，暗淡无光，夹杂有较多的黄铁矿、石英和磷、钙质结核。是一种低热值燃料。热值高者在沸腾炉中燃烧可供发电；还可用以烧制水泥、提取五氧化二钒、制造化肥以及利用灰渣制碳化砖等，综合利用价值高。
explanation_en: It is also called charcoal. Combustible organic bitter stone with high ash content (ash content generally>60%) and deep metamorphism (metamorphic degree is roughly equivalent to anthracite), which is formed from biological remains such as bacteria and algae in shallow sea, lagoon and bay environment through saproperization and coalification transformation. It looks like rock and is easily confused with limestone or carbonaceous shale. High quality stone coal with high carbon content is generally black, with semi bright luster, less impurities and developed fractures. Those with poor quality are grayish and dull, with more pyrite, quartze, phosphorus and calcareous concretions. It is a low calorific value fuel. Those with high calorific value can be combustion in fluidized bed furnace for power generation; It can also be used for burning cement, extracting vanadium pentoxide, manufacturing fertilizer, and making carbonized bricks from ash, with high comprehensive utilization value.

explanation_cn: 配位型氯化物矿物。化学式为NaCl。常含溴、铷、铯、锶及泥质、有机质等杂质。等轴晶系。空间群Fm3m。晶体多呈立方体，集合体通常呈粒状或块状，有时呈柱状、纤维状、毛发状、盐华状等。中国柴达木盆地达布逊盐湖盛产白色、半透明的球粒状石盐，称珍珠盐。纯者为无色透明，含不同杂质可染成各种颜色。玻璃光泽，风化表面或潮解后呈油脂光泽。解理平行{100}完全。贝壳状断口，性脆。莫氏硬度2，密度2.1~2.2g/cm3。具弱导电性和极高导热性。易溶于水，有咸味，易潮解。主要产于干旱的内陆盆地盐湖，被隔绝砂。是制造玻璃、硅质耐火材料和陶瓷的重要原料。
explanation_en: Coordination type chloride minerals. The chemical formula is NaCl. It often contains impurities such as bromine, rubidium, cesium, strontium, mud and organic matter. Equiaxed crystal system. Space group Fm3m. Crystal are mostly cubic, and aggregates are usually granular or massive, sometimes columnar, fibrous, hairlike, salt bloom, etc. The Dabuxun Salt Lake in the Qaidam Basin of China is rich in white, translucent spherical halite, called pearl salt. Pure ones are colorless and transparent, containing different impurities and can be dyed into various colors. Glass luster, weathered surface or deliquescence shows grease luster. The cleavage is parallel {100} completely. Shell like fracture, brittle in nature. Mohs hardness 2, density 2.1~2.2g/cm 3。 Has weak conductivity and extremely high thermal conductivity. Easy to dissolve in water, has a salty taste, and is prone to deliquescence. It is mainly produced in arid inland basin salt lakes, isolated from sand. It is an important raw material for manufacturing glass, siliceous refractory and ceramics.

explanation_cn: 石膏是一种含水的硫酸盐矿物，其化学式为CaSO4·2H2O。它属于单斜晶系，通常呈板状、柱状，具有特殊的解理特征。根据解理面的不同，石膏晶体可以呈现加里双晶、巴黎双晶等形态。石膏可以呈现不同的形态，包括块状、纤维状、片状或土状。细粒块体的石膏称为石膏花，而纤维状集合体被称为纤维石膏。石膏可以是无色或白色，透明的石膏被称为透石膏。然而，通常石膏可能被氧化铁、黏土、有机物质染成浅褐色、黄色、灰色等颜色。石膏的硬度在莫氏硬度为1.5到2之间，它是一种相对脆弱的矿物，其密度约为2.3 g/cm3。石膏主要产于盐湖中，是一种典型的化学沉积作用产物。它也可以在石灰石、红色页岩、泥灰岩、砂岩或黏土岩中形成巨大的矿床，与硬石膏和石盐等矿物一起出现。此外，石膏也可以由硬石膏水化而成，或在硫化矿床的氧化带和低温热液硫化矿床中形成。石膏在多个领域中有广泛的应用，包括农业、建筑、水泥制造、陶瓷制品、医疗、造纸和化工等。它在建筑业中用于制备石膏板、石膏石膏石膏粉、水泥掺合材料等。在医疗领域，石膏用于制备石膏绷带，而在造纸业中，它用于处理废水和造纸过程中的沉淀物。
explanation_en: Gypsum is a kind of sulfate mineral containing water, and its chemical formula is CaSO4 · 2H2O. It belongs to the monoclinic system, usually in the form of plates or columns, with special cleavage characteristics. According to the different cleavage planes, gypsum crystal can present Gary twin, Paris twin and other forms. Gypsum can take on different forms, including block, fiber, sheet or soil. The gypsum of fine block is called gypsum flower, and the fibrous aggregate is called fibrous gypsum. Gypsum can be colorless or white, and transparent gypsum is called transparent gypsum. However, usually gypsum may be dyed light brown, yellow, gray and other colors by iron oxide, clay and organic matter. The hardness of gypsum is between 1.5 and 2 Mohs hardness. It is a relatively fragile mineral with a density of about 2.3 g/cm 3。 Gypsum is mainly produced in salt lakes and is a typical product of chemical deposition. It can also form huge deposits in limestone, red shale, marl, sandstone or clay rock, together with anhydrite, halite and other minerals. In addition, gypsum can also be hydrated from anhydrite, or formed in the oxidation zone of vulcanization deposits and low-temperature hydrothermal vulcanization deposits. Gypsum is widely used in many fields, including agriculture, construction, cement manufacturing, ceramics products, medical treatment, papermaking and chemical industry. It is used in the construction industry to prepare gypsum board, gypsum, gypsum, gypsum powder, cement admixtures, etc. In the medical field, gypsum is used to prepare gypsum bandages, while in the paper industry, it is used to treat wastewater and sediment in the paper making process.

explanation_cn: 采用石膏制作铸型进行浇铸的方法。用半水硫酸钙（熟石膏）作造型材料.将其浆料浇到模样周围，硬化后起模=将铸型加热烘干后浇铸金属即得铸件。常用来浇铸熔点较低的有色金属（如Au、Ag、Al、Cu)及其合金3其优点是铸件尺寸精度高、表面光洁、轮廓线条清晰.纯石膏铸型的缺点是强度低、透气性差、热膨胀系数大，故通常把石棉、滑石、陶土、石英砂和熟石膏混在一起制成浆料。为增大铸型的透气性，有时也加入一些活性剂，使之形成泡沫。石膏型铸造的缺点是费用较高、工序多而长、造型材料不能重复使用。
explanation_en: Gypsum is used to make mold for casting. Use hemihydrate calcium sulfate (basanite) as molding materials. Pour its slurry around the pattern, and lift the mold after hardening=heat and dry the mold, and then casting the metal. Non ferrous metals (such as Au, Ag, Al, Cu) and their alloy with low melting point are commonly used for casting. 3 The advantages of the castings are high dimensional accuracy, smooth surface, and clear contour lines. The disadvantages of pure gypsum mold are low strength, poor air permeability, and large thermal expansion coefficient. Therefore, asbestos, talc, clay, quartz sand, and basanite are usually mixed together to make slurry. In order to increase the air permeability of mold, some active agents are sometimes added to form foam. The disadvantages of plaster mold casting are high cost, many and long processes, and molding materials can not be reused.

explanation_cn: 简单架状结构氧化物矿物.常见的有由两个左形或两个右形组成的道芬双晶；由一个左形和一个右形组成的巴西双晶；还有日本双晶.集合体呈粒状或晶簇状.肾状、钟乳状的隐晶质石英称为石髓(灰蓝至蓝绿色玉髓称蓝玉髓，绿色的玉髓称绿玉髓)；呈结核状的石髓称为燧石；由多色石髓组成并具同心带状结构者称为玛瑙.砖红、黄褐、绿色的隐晶质石英致密块体称为碧玉.Ar石英常呈无色、乳白色，常由于含有不同的混人物或机械混入物而呈多种颜色.无色透明者称为水晶；乳白色者称为乳石英(含多量的气液包体)；紫色者称为紫水晶(含锰和Fe3+)；浅玫瑰色者称蔷薇石英(含锰和钛)；黄色和柠檬色者称黄水晶或黄晶(含Fe2+和水)；烟色者称烟水晶；褐色者称茶晶:黑色透明者为墨晶；含鳞片状赤铁矿或云母而呈褐红或微黄色者称砂金石；由于交代石棉而呈各种不同色调，具丝绢光泽，似猫眼者称猫眼石[虎眼石(黄色)、鹰眼石(蓝灰色)]。玻璃光泽，断口油脂光泽，无解理，贝壳状断口.莫氏硬度7，密度2.65g/cm3。具压电性，不溶于氢氟酸以外的任何酸.R-SiO2是分布最广的矿物之一--.是岩浆岩、沉积岩和变质岩的主要造岩矿物.在深成岩浆岩中一般最晚形成；在酸性火山岩中常呈斑晶出现；在伟晶岩中和钾长石规则连生成文象结构；热液脉中呈块状或长柱状，为主要脉石矿物.由于性质稳定常集中成砂矿.无色透明、无双晶、无杂质及裂隙的晶体可作压电石英，用于无线电工业作振荡元件.还可用于光学仪器.一般石英可作玻璃和陶瓷原料.玛瑙可作研磨器材、轴承及宝石材料等.
explanation_en: The oxide minerals with simple shelf structure are commonly Doffen twin crystals composed of two left or two right forms; Brazilian twin consisting of a left shape and a right shape; There are also Japanese twin. The aggregates are granular or cluster shaped. Kidney shaped, bell shaped cryptocrystalline quartze is called chalcedony (gray blue to blue-green chalcedony is called blue chalcedony, and green chalcedony is called green chalcedony); The nodular chalcedony is called flint; Agate is composed of polychrome chalcedony and has concentric banded structure. The dense block of cryptocrystalline quartze with brick red, yellow brown and green is called jasper. Ar quartze is often colorless and milky white, and it often has multiple colors due to different mixed figures or mechanical blends. Colorless and transparent ones are called crystal; Milky white is called milky quartz (containing a large amount of gas-liquid inclusions); Purple is called amethyste (containing manganese and Fe3+); Light rose color is called rose quartz (containing manganese and titanium); Yellow and lemon are called yellow crystal or dtrhle (containing Fe2+and water); Smoke color is called smoke crystal; Brown ones are called tea crystals: black transparent ones are called ink crystals; Those with scaly hematite or mica in maroon or yellowish color are called aventurine; Due to the replacement of asbestos, it has a variety of colors, with silk luster, and is called cats eye [tiger's eye (yellow), eagle's eye (blue gray)]. Glass luster, fracture grease luster, no cleavage, shell fracture, Mohs hardness 7, density 2.65g/cm3. With piezoelectricity, it is insoluble in any acid other than hydrofluoric acid. R-SiO2 is one of the most widely distributed minerals -- it is the main rock forming mineral of magmatic rocks, sedimentary rock and metamorphic rock. It is generally the latest formed in plutonic rock magma; Phenocryst often appear in acidic volcanic rock; In pegmatite and potassium feldspar regularly connect to form graphic texture; The hydrothermal veins are massive or long columnar, which are the main gangue minerals. Because of their stable properties, they are often concentrated into placers. Colorless, transparent, twinned, impurity free, and fissure free crystal can be used as piezoelectric quartze, and can also be used in radio industry as oscillating elements. They can also be used in optical instruments. quartze can be used as raw materials for glass and ceramics. agate can be used as grinding equipment, bearings, and gems materials

explanation_cn: 用石英玻璃(SiO2)制成的导光纤维.为了解决低损耗，石英光纤由超纯的化学原料经过高温合成，普遍采用的是化学气相沉积法.光纤制造工艺包括提纯工艺、熔炼工艺和拉丝工艺.提纯指利用多次精馏等方法使原料纯度达到99.999%。熔炼工艺就是将超纯的化学原料经过高温化学反应合成具有一定折射率分布的预制棒.制造光纤预制棒的方法常见的有改进的化学气相沉(Mcvd)法、等离子体化学气相沉积(Pcvd)法、气相轴向沉积(Vad)法、管外气相(CVD)法等。MCVD、和、PCVD、这两种方法都属于管内法。管内化学气相沉积法的特点是:在石英衬底管内壁先后沉积包层和芯层玻璃，整个化学反应都是在封闭石英管中进行的.由于有限的反应空间封闭，维持其超纯状态比较方便，对外部环境条件要求不是很高.OVD和Vad法都属于管外法，工艺过程对环境要求很高但反应空间开放不受限制，可以沉积较大直径的预制棒，适于大规模生产.拉丝工艺是将已制好的预制棒拉成高质量的光纤.由于这种石英光纤吸收损耗、散射损耗低、不存在相分离、化学稳定性好等优点，现在成为光纤通信的最重要的传输介质材料.石英光纤也应用于光纤传感和光信息处理。
explanation_en: Optical fiber made of quartze glass (SiO2). In order to solve the problem of low loss, silica fiber is synthesized from ultrapure chemical raw materials at high temperature, and chemical vapor deposition is commonly used. optical fiber manufacturing process includes purification process, melting process and wire drawing process. Purification refers to the use of multiple rectification and other methods to make the purity of raw materials reach 99.999%. The melting process is to synthesize preforms with a certain refractive index distribution from ultra pure chemical raw materials through high-temperature chemical reaction. The common methods for manufacturing optical fiber preforms are the improved chemical vapor deposition (Mcvd) method, plasma chemical vapor deposition (Pcvd) method, gas axial deposition (Vad) method, and external vapor deposition (CVD) method. MCVD, PCVD, and both methods belong to the in tube method. The characteristics of in tube chemical vapor deposition method are as follows: cladding and core layer glass are deposited successively on the inner wall of quartze substrate tube, and the whole chemical reaction is carried out in a closed quartze tube, It can deposit larger diameter preforms, which is suitable for large-scale production. The drawing process is to draw the preforms into high-quality optical fiber. Because of the advantages of silica fiber, such as low absorption loss, low scattering loss, no phase separation, good chemical stability, etc., it is now the most important transmission medium materials for optical fiber communication. silica fiber is also used in optical fiber sensing and optical information processing.

name_cn: 石英微重力天平生物传感器
explanation_cn: 又称石英晶体微天平生物传感器，是基于AT切型石英晶体在交变电场激励下，产生垂直于晶体表面传播的剪切共振波的共振频率与晶体表面附着物质量的变化存在线性关系的原理.通过检测共振频率的变化，定量分析发生在石英晶体表面的生物事件的仪器。
explanation_en: Also known as quartz crystal microbalance biosensor, it is an instrument based on the principle that the resonance frequency of AT cut quartze crystal, which generates shear resonance waves propagating perpendicular to the crystal surface under the excitation of alternating electric field, has a linear relationship with the change of crystal surface attachment quality. By detecting the change of resonance frequency, it can quantitatively analyze biological events occurring on the surface of quartze crystal.

explanation_cn: 石英斑岩石英斑岩一种含石英斑晶的酸性浅成岩或喷出岩.斑状结构，斑晶以石英为主，还有少量透长石或正长石及黑云母.基质为隐晶质.块状构造，有时显流动构造.多呈脉状产出，有时为浅成岩体的边缘相.岩石抗风化能力强，质地坚硬，是优良的建筑材料，也可用作陶瓷原料.
explanation_en: Quartz porphyry quartz porphyry is an acid hypabyssal rock or eject rock containing quartze phenocryst. porphyritic texture, phenocryst is mainly quartze, with a small amount of transparent feldspar or ortho feldspar and biotite. The matrix is aphanitic, massive structure, and sometimes flow structure. It mostly occurs in vein shape, and sometimes is the edge phase of hypabyssal rock. rock has strong weathering resistance, hard texture, and is an excellent building materials, and can also be used as raw material for ceramics

explanation_cn: 一种具片状构造的富含石英的区域变质岩石.矿物组成以石英、酸性斜长石为主，其他为绢云母、绿泥石、白云母、黑云母等.其中石英和长石的含量之和>50%，长石含量<25%它与一般片岩的区别是石英含量较多，与片麻岩的区别是其中的长石含量少于石英.按片状矿物类型可进-一步分为绢云母石英片岩、白云母石英片岩等.它们是粉砂岩或中酸性火山岩经中低级变质作用形成的.
explanation_en: A regional metamorphic rock rich in quartze with schistose structure. The mineral composition is mainly quartze and acid plagioclase, and other minerals are seridte, chlorite, muscovilte, black mica, etc. The total content of quartze and feldspar is more than 50%, and the content of feldspar is less than 25%. It is different from general schist in that quartze content is more, and the difference from gneiss is that feldspar content is less than quartze. According to the type of schistose minerals, it can be further divided into seridte quartz schist Muscovite quartz schist, etc. They are siltstone or intermediate acid volcanic rock formed by middle and low grade metamorphism

explanation_cn: 是二氧化硅单一成分的玻璃，通常分为透明石英玻璃和不透明石英玻璃(熔融石英)两大类.
explanation_en: It is a single component glass of silicon dioxide, usually divided into transparent quartze glass and opaque quartze glass (fused quartze)

explanation_cn: 一种耐高温玻璃纤维，是以高纯度天然石英(二氧化硅)为原料纺制的纤维.制法是先将石英棒或石英管用氢氧焰熔融并拉成细丝，再用氢氧焰吹管喷吹，可得到直径为0.7~lμm的石英棉.或用火焰将石英加热熔融，用高速高压气流纤维化，制得短纤维.石英玻璃纤维的二氧化硅含量为99.9%，密度2.20g/厘米，纤维拉伸强度1.50GPa，模量73GPa，高温下强度损失小.尺寸稳定及抗热震性好，化学稳定性好，在100~200°C内耐浓酸侵蚀，但耐碱性差.透光性和电绝缘性好.石英纤维增强的复合材料可用作火箭的耐烧蚀部件.
explanation_en: A high temperature resistant glass fiber, which is spun from high-purity natural quartze (silica). The preparation method is to melt the quartze rod or quartze tube with a hydrogen oxygen flame and draw it into filaments, and then blow it with a hydrogen oxygen flame to obtain a diameter of 0.7~l μ M of quartze wool, or quartze is heated and melted by flame, and then fibrosed by high-speed high-pressure air flow to produce staple fiber. quartze glass fiber has 99.9% silicon dioxide content, 2.20g/cm density, 1.50GPa fiber tensile strength, 73GPa modulus, small loss of strength under high temperature, good dimensional stability, thermal shock resistance, good chemical stability, and resistance to concentrated acid attack at 100-200 ° C, However, it has poor alkali resistance, good light transmittance and electrical insulation. quartze fiber reinforced composite materials can be used as ablation resistant parts of rockets

explanation_cn: 又称硅砂。石英含量超过95%的砂。由基岩经机械物理风化破碎后形成的石英颗粒，经水或风力搬运堆积而成.它呈松散态(未胶结)，没有可塑性和黏结性.石英颗粒大小均匀，磨圆好，分选度高.杂质少者呈白色，含铁杂质时呈浅黄、浅褐色.在工业领域，也将由石英砂岩、石英岩、脉石经人工破碎加工而成的石英碎屑称为石英砂。是制造玻璃、硅制耐火材料和陶瓷的重要原料。
explanation_en: It is also called silica sand. Sand containing more than 95% quartze. Quartze particles, which are formed after the bedrock is mechanically weathered and broken, are transported and piled up by water or wind. They are loose (unconsolidated) and have no plasticity and cohesiveness. quartze particles are uniform in size, well rounded, and highly sorted. Those with less impurities are white, and those with iron impurities are light yellow and light brown.
