explanation_en: Chain structured borate mineral monoclinic system. The crystal is short columnar or granular; Aggregates are granular or blocky in shape. Colorless, interior or light yellow, streaked white, transparent to translucent, glass luster. Mohs hardness 4.55, brittle. It occurs in the Qianyan Lake and salt lake deposits in dry areas, and coexists with borax, gypsum and other minerals. It is a raw mineral material for extracting boron and making boride.

explanation_cn: 又称永磁铁氧体。一种去掉磁场后仍能对外长久显示较强磁性的铁氧体。晶体结构为磁铅石型，按一般电子陶瓷工艺制成，它不需要用钴、镍等贵金属元素，具有料源充足，工艺简单、成本低廉.便于大规模工业化生产的特点、性能方面具有顽矫力大、电阻率高和质量轻等优点。缺点是温度系数较高。硬磁铁氧体用于扬声器、磁选机、直流电动机、行波管、微波器件等。
explanation_en: Also known as permanent magnetic ferrite. A kind of ferrite that can show strong magnetism for a long time after removing the magnetic field. The crystal structure is magnetite lead stone type, which is made according to the general electronic ceramics process. It does not need precious metals elements such as cobalt and nickel. It has the characteristics of sufficient material source, simple process, low cost, and convenient for large-scale industrial production. In terms of performance, it has the advantages of high coercivity, high resistivity and light weight. The disadvantage is that the temperature coefficient is relatively high. Hard magnetic ferrite is used in loudspeakers, magnetic separators, DC motors, traveling wave tubes, microwave devices, etc.

explanation_cn: 用以修复和替代机体中发生病变或损伤的硬组织(骨、齿等），恢复或部分恢复原有组织形态和功能的材料。也指当局部组织、细胞因某种致病因素的作用遭受损伤和死亡后，用来恢复该病损组织完整性的一类具有多种优良理化特性（如自固化、高强度、使用方便等）和生物学特性（无毒副作用、可吸收和降解、生物相容性好、能诱导骨细胞和血管生长等）的生物医用材料。第一代产生于20世I纪6070年代，以医用金属与合金、硅橡胶和惰性生物陶瓷为代表。主要特点是注重材料力学性能及物理性能与人体的匹配，在体内生物惰性，即在引发宿主最小毒性反应的条件下，重建受损组织的物理连接。第二代产生于20世纪80年代，以羟基磷灰石、生物活性玻璃、生物活性玻璃陶瓷和聚乳酸等为代表。主要特点在于注重材料的生物相容性，材料本身具有生物活性或生物降解性。第三代硬组织修复材料，这一概念于2002年Hetich教授在Science杂志上首次提出，其基本特征在于材料兼具：生物活性和生物降解性的主要应用包括：①代替患病、缺损或衰老的硬组织;②矫治先天畸形;③恢复硬组织的形态和功能;④整形和美容。
explanation_en: It is a materials used to repair and replace the diseased or damaged hard tissues (bone, teeth, etc.) in the body, and restore or partially restore the original tissue morphology and function. It also refers to a kind of biomedical materials with a variety of excellent physical and chemical properties (such as self curing, high strength, easy to use, etc.) and biological characteristics (non-toxic side effects, absorbability and degradation, good biocompatibility, and ability to induce bone cells and vascular growth, etc. The first generation came into being in the 1960s and 1970s of the 20th I period, represented by medical metals and alloy, silicone rubber and inert biological ceramics. The main feature is to pay attention to the matching of the mechanical and physical properties of materials with the human body, and to reconstruct the physical connection of damaged tissues under the condition of bioinert in vivo, that is, under the condition of triggering the least toxic reaction of the host. The second generation came into being in the 1980s, represented by hydroxyapatite, bioactive glass, bioactive glass-ceramics and polylactic acid. The main feature is to pay attention to the biocompatibility of materials. materials themselves have bioactivity or biodegradability. The concept of the third generation hard tissue repairing materials was first proposed by Professor Hetich in Science magazine in 2002. Its basic characteristics are that materials have both bioactivity and biodegradability. The main applications include: ① replacing diseased, defective or aging hard tissue; ② Correction of congenital malformations; ③ Restore the form and function of hard tissue; ④ Plastic surgery and beauty.

explanation_cn: 植入生物体内，占据硬组织损伤或病变造成的空腔或缺损部位，替代或部分替代其原冇功能的一类生物医用材料。常见的有牙齿填充材料和骨填充材料等。牙齿填充材料可分为：①汞剂类，由汞与合金粉组成;②树脂类，有合成树脂的复合树脂和天然树脂的牙胶;③金属盐黏同粉类，如磷酸锌黏固：粉等。骨填充材料可分为自体骨、异体骨和人工骨材料等，其中自体骨来源有限不能大量获取，而异体骨：存在免疫原性问题限制了其使用，人工骨材料是目前国内外研究最广泛、最有前途的一类填充材料包括：①高分子合成材料，如聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯和高密度聚乙烯等;②无机材料，如生物活性玻璃、羟基磷灰石、磷酸钙和氧化铝生物陶瓷等。
explanation_en: Implantation in the organism, occupy the cavity or defect caused by hard tissue injury or disease, and replace or partially replace a class of biomedical materials that have no original function. The common ones are tooth filling materials and bone filling materials. Dental filling materials can be divided into: ① mercury agents, which are composed of mercury and alloy powder; ② Resin, including synthetic resin composition resin and natural resin gums; ③ Metal salt bonding is similar to powder, such as zinc phosphate bonding: powder, etc. Bone filling materials can be divided into autologous bone, allogeneic bone and artificial bone materials, among which the source of autologous bone is limited and cannot be obtained in large quantities, while the use of allogeneic bone is limited due to the existence of immunogenicity problems. artificial bone materials are the most widely studied and promising materials at home and abroad, including: ① macromolecule synthetic materials, such as polymethyl methacrylate and high density polyethylene; ② Inorganic materials, such as bioactive glass, hydroxyapatite, calcium phosphate and alumina bioceramics.

name_cn: 硬质反应性注塑成型聚氨酯塑料
name_en: rigid reaction injection molding polyurethane plastics
explanation_cn: 是利用反应性注塑成型技术得到的硬质聚氨酯塑料。通常外表层结实平滑，可同时形成低密度多层结构的泡沫芯，属于整皮硬质聚氨酯泡沫塑料。具有较好的靭性。为了增加其机械强度，常采用玻璃纤维增强，一般用于高模量的汽车保险杠、车门等大型模塑件和各种耐高冲击的缓冲器。已推向市场的有汽车行李箱盖、拖拉机拖车外侧和顶部、计算机外壳、电视机外壳、硬质鞋底、椅子外框、窗框、门框、百叶窗等。
explanation_en: It is a rigid polyurethime plastics obtained by reactive injection molding technology. Generally, the outer surface layer is solid and smooth, which can form a foam core with low density multi-layer structure at the same time. It belongs to the whole skin rigid polyurethane foam. Has good toughness. In order to increase its mechanical strength, it is often reinforced with glass fiber, which is generally used for large molded parts such as high modulus automobile bumpers, doors, and various high impact resistant buffers. The ones that have been pushed to the market include car trunk lids, tractor trailers on the outside and top, computer casings, TV casings, hard soles, chair frames, window frames, door frames, blinds, etc.

explanation_cn: 以碳化钨为主成分，钴为黏结相制成的烧结碳化物。是金属与陶瓷（碳化钨）的典型结合体。高熔点碳化钨借助均匀包覆的液相钴相对碳化钨的润湿性，将碳化钨烧结成一个整体。在1400°C液相烧结成合金。其弯曲强度可以达到1500-2800MPa,而且保留了碳化钨的耐高温性能和高温硬度，常温硬度也很高。制取的碳化钨粒度、碳含量、加钴粉混合均匀度和烧结质量，均影响着的性能。烧结需依照钴含量多少而调整温度，真空烧结比氢气烧结质量好，是烧结材料中密度最高的材料之一。烧结后的不需要外加包套，即可在热等精压机中进行处理，其密度可达到99.999%,精密仪表、轧辊、大型柱塞、金刚石生产用顶锤，均能用热等静压处理得到高质量产品。主要用于制造各种刀具、模具、矿山工具和耐磨件。国内牌号以钻含量命名，如YG6为含钻6%,含WC94%的。提高钴含量则硬度降低，韧性增高。除碳化钨基外，还有碳化铬基、钢结等。碳化钛基常称作金属陶瓷。严格地说，是一种典型的金属陶瓷。
explanation_en: Sintering carbide is made of carbonization as the main component and cobalt as the bonding phase. It is a typical combination of metal and ceramics (tungsten carbide). High melting point carbonization sintering carbonization into a whole by virtue of the wettability of uniformly coated liquid cobalt to carbonization. The alloy is sintered in liquid phase at 1400 ° C. Its bending strength can reach 1500-2800MPa, and it retains the high temperature resistance and high temperature hardness of carbonization. Its hardness is also very high at room temperature. The particle size of carbonization, carbon content, mixing uniformity of cobalt powder and sintering quality all affect the properties of tungsten carbide. The temperature of sintering should be adjusted according to the cobalt content. The vacuum sintering is better than the hydrogen sintering, and it is one of the sintering materials with the highest density. After sintering, it can be processed in the hot isostatic press without additional can. Its density can reach 99.999%. Precision instruments, roll, large plungers, and diamond production anvil can all be treated with hot isostatic pressing to obtain high-quality products. Mainly used for manufacturing various cutting tools, molds, mining tools, and wear-resistant parts. Domestic brands are named after their diamond content, such as YG6, which contains 6% diamond and 94% WC. Hardness decreases and toughness increases with increasing cobalt content. In addition to tungsten carbide base, there are carbonization base, steel bond, etc. Carbonization base is often called cermet. Strictly speaking, it is a typical cermet.

explanation_cn: 又称高火瓷，因配方组成中高岭土含量较多，长石及其他熔剂物质含量较少，其成瓷温度较高，一般在1300°C以上。因其显微结构中含莫来石晶体较多，玻璃相相对少，瓷及釉面硬度也较其他瓷高一些，因而称为。高火瓷具有较高的机械强度、良好的化学稳定性、热稳定性和电绝缘性能，吸水率接近于零。用于化学瓷、电瓷及高级日用细瓷。
explanation_en: Also known as high fire porcelain, because the formula contains more kaolin and less feldspar and other flux, its porcelain forming temperature is higher, generally above 1300 ° C. Because its microstructure contains more mullite crystal, less glass phase, and the hardness of porcelain and glaze is higher than that of other ceramics, it is called. High fire porcelain has high mechanical strength, good chemical stability, thermal stability and electrical insulation performance, and its water absorption is close to zero. It is used for chemical porcelain, electric porcelain and high-grade daily fine porcelain.

explanation_cn: 由不饱和橡胶用高剂量硫黄硫化制成的硬而坚韧的硫化胶。天然橡胶、丁苯橡胶和丁腈橡胶等二烯类橡胶都能用硫黄硫化制成硬质胶。含有乙烯基的橡胶在不配用硫黄的情况下，在高温（200-300°C)、高压和无氧条件下，经长时间加热可制成无硫硬质橡胶。与软质橡胶相比，硬质橡胶坚硬，具有良好的电绝缘性、耐老化性、化学稳定性、耐溶剂性及热稳定性，具有很高的拉伸强度和抗折断强度，具有良好的机械加工性能，可进行切削、钻孔等机械加工。其最大缺点是脆性大，受冲击时容易碎裂，特别在0℃以下时更为显著。主要用作蓄电池槽及蓄电池隔板等电绝缘制品，化工耐腐蚀槽、罐、管、泵等的衬里材料等。
explanation_en: Hard and tough vulcanized rubher made of unsaturated rubber by vulcanizing with high dosage of sulfur. Diene rubber such as natural rubber, styrene-butadiene rubber and acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber can be made into hard rubber by sulfur vulcanization. Under the condition of high temperature (200-300 ° C), high pressure and oxygen free, the rubber containing vinyl can be made into sulfur free hard rubber after long-term heating without sulfur. Compared with soft rubber, hard rubber is hard, with good electrical insulation, aging resistance, chemical stability, solvent resistance and thermal stability, high tensile strength and breaking strength, good machining performance, and can be used for machining such as cutting and drilling. Its biggest drawback is its high brittleness, which makes it easy to break under impact, especially when it is below 0 ℃. It is mainly used as electrical insulation products such as accumulator tank and accumulator separator, and lining materials of chemical corrosion resistant tank, tank, pipe, pump, etc.

explanation_cn: 覆于工具模具或机械零件表面提高其硬度和耐磨性的覆盖膜层。的显微硬度比工模具基材高，一般在10-30GPa之间。在超硬膜材料中，具有金属键的TiN,TiCN等间隙化合物具有高的硬度和较好的韧性，因而其综合性能较好。离子键的Al2O3除硬度高外，能够抗氧化。耐腐蚀，化学稳定性佳，适用于切削铁基材料。金刚石和立方氮化硼具有共价键，其硬度最高。以上这些单质超硬膜或它们的复合涂层沉积在工模具上可以提高它们的寿命。由于这些硬质膜是化合物膜或碳氮化硼的特殊结构，需利用热能和等离子体能量提高沉积粒子的能量。能制备硬质膜的技术有化学气相沉积(CVD)法、等离子体化学气相沉积（PCVD)法、磁控溅射法、辉光放电离子镀法、弧光放电离子镀法、离子束辅助沉积法等。
explanation_en: The coating layer is applied on the surface of tool mould or mechanical part to improve its hardness and wear resistance. The micro hardness of is higher than that of the tool and die base material, generally between 10-30GPa. In superhard film materials, interstitial compound such as TiN and TiCN with metal bonds have high hardness and good toughness, so their comprehensive properties are better. In addition to high hardness, Al2O3 of ionic bond can resist oxidation. Corrosion resistance, good chemical stability, suitable for cutting iron based materials. Diamond and cubic boron nitride have covalent bond, and their hardness is the highest. These simple super hard films or their composite coating can be deposited on tools and dies to improve their service life. Because these hard film are compound films or special structures of boron carbonitride, thermal energy and plasma energy need to be used to increase the energy of deposited particles. The technologies that can prepare hard film include chemical vapor deposition (CVD), plasma chemical vapor deposition (PCVD), magnetron sputtering, glow discharge ion plating, arc discharge ion plating, and ion beam assisted deposition.

explanation_cn: 在水中不易分散、可塑性较低的耐火黏土。主要矿物多为髙岭石单矿物型的沉积黏土，或有少量迪开石或水云母类等伴生矿物。用于制造黏土质耐火材料。
explanation_en: Refractory clay that is not easy to disperse in water and has low plasticity. The main minerals are mostly kaolinite single mineral sedimentary clay, or a small amount of dickite or hydromica and other associated minerals. It is used to manufacture clay refractory.

explanation_cn: 以铅铺为基加有其他合金化元素的合金，该类合金与其他铅合金相比.具有较高的强度和硬度。锑是重要的强化元素.它仅部分固溶于铅.既可固溶强化，又可时效强化。加人少量Cu、Sn、Ag、As、Te、Ca等可进一步增加强度、细化组织。这些合金中的微量元素Ag为0.02%.As为0.015%，Ca为0.05%。有板、带、棒、管等产品，高锑则以铸件形式供应。硬铅合金用于化学工业和人造纤维工业中的耐蚀材料。
explanation_en: Alloy based on lead pavement with other alloy elements, this kind of alloy has higher strength and hardness than other lead alloy. Antimony is an important strengthening element. It is only partially solid soluble in lead. It can be both solid solution strengthening and aging strengthening. Adding a small amount of Cu, Sn, Ag, As, Te, Ca, etc. can further increase strength and refine the structure. The trace elements Ag, As and Ca in these alloy are 0.02%, 0.015% and 0.05% respectively. There are products such as plates, strips, rods, and tubes, while high antimony is supplied in the form of castings. Hard lead alloy is used as corrosion resistant materials in chemical industry and man-made fiber industry.

explanation_cn: 又称杜拉铝。在Al-Cu系合金基础上发展起来的具有较高力学性能的变形铝合金。属于可热处理强化类。包括Al-Cu-Mg系和Al-Cu-Mn系的合金。这类合金的特点是：主要组元Cu、Mg、Mn都处于铝内的饱和溶解度状态.具有较高的强度。通常把Al-Cu-Mg系硬铝称为普通硬铝.其中铜和镁的总含量越高。镁铜含量的比值越大，热处理强化效果增加，合金的强度和硬度随之提高。提高合金纯度可改善其抗应力腐蚀性能和断裂韧度。可以在淬火自然时效状态下使用。也可以在淬火人工时效状态下使用。主要用来生产板材、型材等各种半成品;用于制造铆钉和承力结构零件、蒙皮等。而常把Al-Cu-Mn系硬铝合金称为耐热硬铝，在淬火人工时效状态下使用。可用来制造在250350°C下长期工作的锻件和焊件，如压气机叶片、压气机盘、燃料容器等，在航空工业中应用广泛。但耐腐蚀性能低，其制品需要进行防腐处理，如包铝，阳极氧化和涂漆等。
explanation_en: Also known as Duralumin. Wrought aluminium alloy with high mechanical properties developed on the basis of Al Cu series alloy. Belongs to the category of heat treatable reinforcement. It includes alloy of Al Cu Mg system and Al Cu Mn system. This kind of alloy is characterized by that the main components Cu, Mg and Mn are in the saturated water solubility state in aluminum and have high strength. Generally, Al Cu Mg series duralumin is called common hard aluminium alloy, in which the higher the total content of copper and magnesium is. The greater the ratio of Mg to Cu content, the more strengthening effect of heat treatment will be, and the strength and hardness of alloy will be improved accordingly. Increasing the purity of alloy can improve its stress corrosion resistance and fracture toughness. It can be used in the state of quenching and natural aging. It can also be used in the state of quenching and artificial aging. Mainly used for producing various semi-finished products such as plates and profiles; Used for manufacturing rivets, load-bearing structural parts, skins, etc. Al Cu Mn series hard aluminium alloy is often called heat resistance hard aluminium alloy, which is used in the state of quenching and artificial aging. It can be used to manufacture forgings and weldments that work for a long time at 250350 ° C, such as compressor blades, compressor discs, fuel containers, etc., and is widely used in the aviation industry. But its corrosion resistance is low, and its products need to undergo anti-corrosion treatment, such as aluminum coating, anodizing, and painting.

explanation_cn: 广义为细分散多矿物集合体;狭义属一个矿物种。常见的是广义，为含多种元素锰的氧化物和氢氧化物的集合体。成钟乳状、葡萄状、肾状。黑色.条痕褐至褐黑色。莫氏硬度46,密度4.4-4.7g/cm3。是一种典型的表生矿物，由锰的碳酸盐或硅酸盐经风化作用而成。与软锰矿共生。也可在海相湖相沉积层中呈团块或结核状，是提炼锰的重要矿物原料。
explanation_en: Broadly defined as finely dispersed multi mineral aggregates; Narrowly defined as a mineral species. Commonly defined as a collection of oxides and hydroxides containing multiple elements of manganese. Becoming bell shaped, grape shaped, or kidney shaped. Black. Stripes brown to brownish black. Mohs hardness 46, density 4.4-4.7g/cm3. It is a typical epigenetic mineral formed by weathering of manganese carbonate or silicate. Symbiosis with pyroIusite. It can also be lumpy or nodular in marine lake phase sediments, and is an important raw mineral material for manganese extraction.

explanation_cn: 主要指钴、镍、铁基自熔性合金通过热喷涂、喷焊、电弧及火焰堆焊和低温熔敷等工艺提高金属表面耐磨性的一类材料。为使硬面层能与基体有良好的冶金结合而又不在熔焊或涂敷过程中损失其性能.这类材料中除含有基体金属、碳和能与碳形成硬质相的Cr、W、Mo、V钒等元素外，一般还含有为降低合金熔点。保证熔敷时能清洁被涂金属表面并改善其润湿性的硼及硅。随被保护的零件承受冲击和磨损的情况而调整碳的含量。最著名的钴基硬面材料是司太立合金。由于含碳量高影响合金的耐腐蚀性能，又发展出以金属间化合物相强化的合金。硬面材料的耐磨性能主要依靠强韧基体中的硬质相,因硬面工艺给表层带来的缺陷如气孔、氧化夹杂，也可能出硼硅与金属氧化物形成的玻璃相等予以清除或堵塞，从而保证硬面下艺可以在大气中进行。利用这类硬面材料制备表层时.被涂基材大多因经受高温而发生组织变化这种缺点可以用事后的热处理消除。激光表面熔敷工艺的推广，扩大硬面材料的应用范围。
explanation_en: It mainly refers to a class of materials in which cobalt, nickel and iron base self fluxing alloy improve the wear resistance of metal surface through thermal spraying, spray welding, arc and flame overlaying, low-temperature deposition and other processes. In order to make the hard surface layer have a good metallurgical bond with the matrix without losing its performance in the process of fusion welding or coating, this kind of materials generally contains alloy melting point to reduce in addition to matrix metal, carbon, Cr, W, Mo, V vanadium and other elements that can form hard phase with carbon. Boron and silicon that can clean the surface of the coated metal and improve its wettability during deposition. Adjust the carbon content according to the impact and wear of the protected parts. The most famous cobalt based hard facing materials is Stellite alloy. Because the high carbon content affects the corrosion resistance of alloy, alloy strengthened by imermetallif compound phase has been developed. The wear resistance of hard-facing materials mainly depends on the hard phase in the strong and tough matrix. Because of the defects brought to the surface by the hard facing process, such as pores and oxidation inclusions, it is also possible to remove or block the glass formed by boron silicon and metal oxides, so as to ensure that the hard facing process can be carried out in the atmosphere. When using this kind of hard-facing materials to prepare the surface layer, the defect that most of the coated substrate undergoes structural changes due to high temperature can be eliminated by post heat treatment. The popularization of laser surface cladding technology expands the application range of hard-facing materials.

explanation_cn: 袪于把一些代数方程或微分方程作为静态方程和演化方程。以明确严格的模拟方式描述材料微观组织演化的模拟方法。
explanation_en: Instead of treating some algebraic or differential equations as static and evolutionary equations. A simulation method that describes the evolution of materials' microstructure in a clear and rigorous way.

explanation_cn: 无机高强度、高模纤维增强体的一种。是以钨丝为芯的尤机复合纤维增强体。用EVD法的氢气为还原剂，使三氯化硼还原成硼沉枳仵炽热移动的直径为12。上述性能指标均受沉积条件及纤维直径的影响。由于硼在常温下为较惰性的物质。高温下易与金属反应，因此需在纤维表面涂SiC层，称Bosic纤维。主要作高聚物基和金属基等复合材料的增强纤维。
explanation_en: Inorganic high strength, high modulus fiber reinforcement. It is a special machine composite fiber reinforcement with tungsten wire as the core. Using hydrogen gas from the EVD method as a reducing agent, boron trichloride is reduced to boron precipitate with a diameter of 12. The above performance indicators are all affected by deposition conditions and fiber diameter. Boron is a relatively inert substance at room temperature. At high temperatures, it is easy to react with metals, so a SiC layer needs to be coated on the surface of the fiber, known as Bosic fiber. It is mainly used as reinforcing fiber of composite materials such as polymer matrix and metal matrix.

explanation_cn: 以硼与过渡金属或非金属所形成的化合物为主要成分的陶瓷材料。该类陶瓷通常具有熔点高、硬度高，耐高温、电导性和抗氧化性、抗热震性优良，可用于航空、汽车、动力、能源、核工业等高温环境中的耐热构件如汽车发动机零件、燃气轮机叶片，以及高温润滑与耐磨材料，应用较广泛的有硼化锆（ZrBj)、硼化钽（TaBj)、硼化铬（CrB)、硼化钨（W2B5)等。
explanation_en: Ceramics materials mainly composed of compounds formed by boron and transition metals or nonmetals. Such ceramics usually have high melting point, high hardness, high temperature resistance, conductivity, oxidation resistance and thermal shock resistance. They can be used for heat-resistant components in high temperature environments such as aviation, automobile, power, energy, nuclear industry, etc., such as automotive engine parts, gas turbine blades, and high-temperature lubrication and wear resisting materials. The widely used ones are zirconium boride (ZrBj), tantalum boride (TaBj), chromium boride (CrB), tungsten boride (W2B5), etc.

explanation_cn: 金刚石类超导体.金刚石在掺杂进B以后会变为常规超导体.超导临界温度根据AL掺杂量的变化而变化小于8K。
explanation_en: Diamond like superconductor. diamond will become a conventional superconductor after doping B. The superconductor critical temperature changes less than 8K according to the change of AL doping amount.

explanation_cn: 又称二硼化铪涂层。高性能陶瓷涂层的一种，硼化铪可由氧化铪、碳化硼发生碳热还原制备而成。可由等离子体喷涂制成涂层。硼化铪密度10。7g/cm3，熔点338CTC，弹性模量500GPa，硬度29GPa，为六方晶相。耐髙温，耐腐蚀。硬度高，高温下表面形成黏流态氏，可有效阻挡气体扩散，主州用作硬质耐磨涂层、耐高温涂层、扩散阻挡层和喷墨打印机薄膜电阻器等。
explanation_en: Also known as hafnium diboride coating. It is a kind of high performance ceramics coating. Hafnium boride can be prepared by carbothermal reduction of hafnium oxide and boron carbide. Coatings can be made by plasma spraying. Hafnium boride density 10. 7g/cm3, melting point 338CTC, elastic modulus 500GPa, hardness 29GPa, hexagonal phase. High temperature resistance and corrosion resistance. High hardness, viscous flow state mode formed on the surface under high temperature, which can effectively block the diffusion of gas. It is mainly used as hard wear resistant coating, high temperature resistant coating, diffusion barrier layer and inkjet printer film resistor.

explanation_cn: 以硼化铪为主要成分的陶瓷材料。密度为11.19g/cm3，熔点高达3380t，弹性模量530GPa，维氏硬度21.2~28.4GPa，室温弯曲强度480MPa。其优异的耐热性、高模量、高硬度、高导热性、耐烧蚀、抗氧化和较好的抗热震性，使其成为近空间飞行器核心热防护部件的主要候选材料之一；但烧结困难，制备时常引入部分SC提高烧结性，改善综合性能。
explanation_en: Ceramics materials with hafnium boride as the main component. The density is 11.19g/cm3, the melting point is up to 3380t, the elastic modulus is 530GPa, the Vikers hardness is 21.2~28.4GPa, and the room temperature bending strength is 480MPa. Its excellent heat resistance, high modulus, high hardness, high thermal conductivity, ablation resistance, oxidation resistance and better thermal shock resistance make it one of the main candidate materials for the core thermal protection components of near space vehicles; However, sintering is difficult, and some SC is often introduced to improve the sintering property and comprehensive properties.

explanation_cn: 一般是指热解产物为硼化锆陶瓷。的聚合物或混合物。ZrBj具有AlBz型六方晶体结构。其中的B-B、B-Zr强共价键使其具有高的熔点（3040°C)。密度为5.80g/cm3，具有较高的硬度、良好的导电、导热性能和化学稳定性，对熔融金属表现出良好的化学惰性。ZrBz陶瓷的制备方法主要包括：Zr和B直接化合法、固相还原法、化学气相沉积法、熔盐电解法、前驱体法等。前驱体法一般是指以Zr源化合物（如氯氧化锆、异丙醇锆、乙酰丙酮锆、硝酸氧化锆等）、B源化合物（如硼酸、硼氮烷、氨硼烷等）、C源化合物（如酚醛树脂等）的混合物为原料。在高温下反应制备得到ZrBj陶瓷的方法，产率为30%-50%，通常在1400t:以上才能反应完全。或采用双环戊二烯基二氢化锆与硼烷反应合成基于Zr-H-B多中心桥键的聚合物，在高温下热解也吋制备得到ZrB-陶瓷，产率为40%-50%，在700°C即可基本实现无机化。用于制备ZrB2陶瓷粉体、Zrfi纤维、Zrfi复合材料等。
explanation_en: Generally, the pyrolysis product is zirconium boride ceramics. Polymer or mixture of. ZrBj has AlBz type hexagonal crystal structure. The strong covalent bond of B-B and B-Zr makes it have a high melting point (3040 ° C). The density is 5.80g/cm3, with high hardness, good electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity and chemical stability, and good chemical inertness to molten metal. The preparation methods of ZrBz ceramics mainly include: Zr and B direct method, solid phase reduction method, chemical vapor deposition method, molten salt electrolysis method, precursor method, etc. The precursor method generally refers to the mixture of Zr source compounds (such as zirconium oxychloride, zirconium isopropoxide, zirconium acetylacetonate, zirconium oxynitrate, etc.), B source compounds (such as boric acid, borazone, ammonia borane, etc.), and C source compounds (such as phenolic resin, etc.) as raw materials. The method of preparing ZrBj ceramics by reaction at high temperature has a yield of 30% -50%, and the reaction can be completed only when the yield is more than 1400t. Or the polymer based on Zr-H-B multi center bridge bond can be synthesized by the reaction of dicyclopentadienyl zirconium dihydrogen with borane, and ZrB ceramics can be prepared by pyrolysis at high temperature, with a yield of 40% -50%, and can be basically inorganic at 700 ° C. It is used to prepare ZrB2 ceramic powder, Zrfi fiber, Zrfi composite materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 硼化错具有高熔点、高硬度、低挥发率、高热导率和高电导率等突出优点，其导率高、弹性模量高。因此其抗热震性能比其他陶瓷好，是制备抗氧化涂层的典型候选材料，硼化锆涂层优异的抗氧化性能来源于氧化可生成黏流态氏保护层。抗氧化性能与使用温度有很大关系，1800C以上使用的硼化锆涂层必须进行填料改性以提高抗氧化性。
explanation_en: Boronized dislocation has many outstanding advantages, such as high melting point, high hardness, low volatility, high thermal conductivity and high conductivity. It has high conductivity and high elastic modulus. Therefore, its thermal shock resistance is better than other ceramics, and it is a typical candidate materials for preparing oxidation resistant coatings. The excellent oxidation resistance of zirconium boride coating comes from the viscous flow state protective layer generated by oxidation. The oxidation resistance has a great relationship with the service temperature. The zirconium boride coating used above 1800C must be modified with filler to improve the oxidation resistance.

explanation_cn: 以硼和锆的化合物为主要成分的陶瓷材料。包括一硼化锆、二硼化锆（ZrB2)等气种，其中二硼化锆最为常见，熔点高达304CTC。它具有耐高温、抗氧化、高强度、高硬度和良好的导电导热性等特点。硼化锆陶瓷熔点虽高，似在较低温度下能烧结。由金属锆与碳化硼、氮化硼混合后在氩气流中加热至2000°C制得。可用作宇航耐高温材料、耐磨光滑的固体材料、切削工具、温差热电偶保护管以及电解熔融化合物的电极材料。其是超高温结构的最佳候选材料。但其韧性较差，一般需引入增强相进行韧化。如引入10%-20%(体积分数）的SiC，不仅可以有效改善其室温与高温力学性能（如Zrli-30%SiC：的室温弯曲强度达到1089MPa)。还能进一步改善其高温抗氧化性。
explanation_en: Ceramics materials mainly composed of boron and zirconium compounds. Including zirconium diboride, zirconium diboride (ZrB2) and other gas seeds, zirconium diboride is the most common, with a melting point as high as 304CTC. It has the characteristics of high temperature resistance, oxidation resistance, high strength, high hardness and good conductivity. Although the melting point of zirconium boride ceramics is high, it seems that they can be sintering at a lower temperature. It is prepared by mixing zirconium with boron carbide and nitriding boron and heating it to 2000 ° C in argon flow. It can be used as aerospace high temperature resistant materials, wear-resistant and smooth solid materials, cutting tools, temperature difference thermocouple protection tube and electrode materials of electrolytic melting compound. It is the best candidate materials for ultrahigh temperature structure. However, its toughness is poor and generally needs to be toughened by introducing reinforced phase. For example, the introduction of 10% -20% (volume fraction) SiC can not only effectively improve its room temperature and high temperature mechanical properties (such as Zrli-30% SiC: the room temperature bending strength reaches 1089MPa). It can further improve its high-temperature oxidation resistance.

explanation_cn: 含水复杂硼酸盐矿物。斜品系，集合体呈粒状、块状、土状和皮壳状等。有时呈浅黄、浅绿或浅蓝色。玻璃光泽。微带甜涩味。在空气中易失水，使晶体表面呈白色粉末状皮壳。加热膨胀，易熔成透明玻璃状小球。是自然界分布最广的矿物之一。主要产于盐湖和十盐湖的蒸发沉积物及淤泥中-与石盐、天然碱、无水芒硝、钾芒硝、石膏等共生；在干旱地硼砂还呈删霜产于土壤表而。是提取硼和制取硼化物的矿物原料
explanation_en: Water-containing complex borate minerals. The oblique strain has aggregates in the form of granules, blocks, soil, and shells. Sometimes it appears light yellow, light green, or light blue. Glass lustre. Slightly sweet and astringent. It is easy to lose water in the air, making the surface of crystal white powder like crust. Heating expands and easily melts into transparent glass like balls. It is one of the most widely distributed minerals in nature. It is mainly produced in the evaporation sediments and sludge of salt lakes and ten salt lakes - symbiosis with halite, trona, thenardite, aphthitalke, gypsum, etc; In arid land, borax also appears as frost on the soil surface. It is a raw mineral material for extracting boron and making boride

name_cn: 硼硅酸盐玻璃性氧化膜
explanation_cn: 通常在Mo~Si-B涂层表面能够形成一层成分为Sio2-Bso3的硼硅酸盐玻璃性氧化膜。这种保护性氧化膜的形成依赖于Mo-Si-U涂层在高温氧化气氛中形成低熔点的共晶氧化膜，该氧化膜与涂层有着优异的结合性。B2o:自身黏度较低。同时也可以降低SiO2的黏度，从而提高玻璃型氧化膜的流动性，加速涂层表面连续、致密氧化膜的形成与铺展，填补涂层的孔洞及微裂纹，增强氧化膜的保护性，缩短氧气与涂层的接触时间。阻止氧气的进一步扩散。
explanation_en: Generally, a layer of borosilicate glass composed of SiO2-Bso3 can be formed on the surface of Mo-Si-B coating. The formation of this protective oxide film depends on the formation of low melting point eutectic oxide film of Mo-Si-U coating in high temperalure oxidation atmosphere, which has excellent adhesion with the coating. B2o: low viscosity. At the same time, it can also reduce the viscosity of SiO2, thus improving the flow ability of glass type oxide film, accelerating the formation and spread of continuous and dense oxide film on the coating surface, filling the holes and microcracks of the coating, enhancing the protection of the oxide film, and shortening the contact time between oxygen and the coating. Prevent further diffusion of oxygen.

explanation_cn: 以硼粉为主要可燃剂的一类延期药，属高燃速延期药。通常用于毫秒级延期雷管中，反应产生的气体很少，是典型的微气体延期药。它具有延期时间精度高、延期时间短、燃烧温度高、点火能量足等优点。常用的氧化剂有四氧化三铅、铬酸钡、氧化铬、铬酸铅等，有硼/四氧化=铅、硼/铬酸钡两种基本配比，硼的纯度和粒度会严重影响延期精度。通常硼的纯度>97%精度较高。此外。由于不同生产厂家的铬酸钡的结晶状态不同，故它对延期药的燃烧稳定性也有重要影响。
explanation_en: A kind of delay composition with boron powder as the main combustible agent belongs to high burning rate delay composition. Usually used in millisecond delay detonators, the reaction produces little gas, which is a typical micro gas delay composition. It has the advantages of high precision of delay time, short delay time, high combustion temperature and sufficient ignition energy. Common oxidizer include lead trioxide, barium chromate, chromium oxide, lead chromate, etc. There are two basic ratios of boron/tetraoxide=lead and boron/barium chromate. The purity and particle size of boron will seriously affect the delay precision. Usually, boron has a purity of>97% and higher accuracy. In addition. As the crystal state of barium chromate from different manufacturers is different, it also has an important impact on the combustion stability of delay composition.

explanation_cn: 以硼（一般为无定形硼粉）为可燃剂，与氧化剂按一定配比混合而成的点火药，属于微烟点火药中的一种，其点火能力较强，可用于点燃发火点较高的药剂。常见的硼系点火药主要有硼/硝酸钾/酚醛树脂、硼/二氧化碲/黏合剂和硼/铬酸钡/二氧化铅等。硼/硝酸钾/酚醛树脂点火药是一种性能良好的替代黑火药的点火药，其成分比例为23.6%/70.7%/5.7%。
explanation_en: The ignition composition, which uses boron (usually amorphous boron powder) as the combustible agent and is mixed with oxidizer in a certain ratio, is one of the micro smoke ignition composition. Its ignition ability is strong and can be used to ignite the agent with higher ignition point. The common boron type ignition composition mainly include boron/potassium nitrate/phenolic resin, boron/tellurium dioxide/adhesive and boron/barium chromate/lead dioxide. Boron/potassium nitrate/phenolic resin ignition composition is a kind of ignition composition with good performance to replace black powder, and its composition ratio is 23.6%/70.7%/5.7%.

explanation_cn: 复合固体推进剂常用的键合剂品种。适用于含硝胺炸药的HTH3推进剂。由硼酸与含羟基化合物发生酯交换反应后得到的硼酸酯类化合物（如乙醇胺与晒酸反应制得硼酸三乙醇胺酯）的统称。
explanation_en: Bonding agent commonly used in composition solid propellant. HTH3 propellant suitable for explosive containing nitramine. A general term for borate ester compounds obtained by the ester exchange reaction between boric acid and hydroxyl containing compounds (such as triethanolamine borate ester obtained by the reaction of ethanolamine and tannic acid).

name_en: yttrium gadolinium borate activated by europium
explanation_cn: 白色粉末。它是真空紫外线（185nm)和阴极射线激发下很有效的发光材料.荧光色为红色，主峰波长在611nm处.
explanation_en: White powder. It is a very effective luminescence materials excited by vacuum ultraviolet (185 nm) and cathode ray. The fluorescence color is red, and the main peak wavelength is 611 nm

explanation_cn: 化学式为LiB3。厲于正交晶系。空间群为P21Cn，莫氏硬度为6。这是一种较新型的非线性光学晶体。大尺寸的晶体主要用下降法生长。用提拉法生长时，由于黏度大、易挥发、应力大等原因。已发生开裂及出现缺陷。如；包裹物和气泡。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is LiB3. Stronger than orthorhombic crystal systems. The space group is P21Cn, and the Mohs hardness is 6. This is a relatively new nonlinear optical crystal. Large size crystal are mainly grown by descent method. When growing by pulling method, it is due to high viscosity, volatility, high stress and other reasons. Cracking and defects have occurred. For example; Wraps and bubbles.

explanation_cn: 主要用作合金添加剂的铁和硼的合金，硼含量通常为12%-23%。采用铝热法、电铝热法或电碳热法生产，根据碳含量可分为低碳硼铁（碳含量不大于0.1%)和中碳硼铁（碳含量大于0.1%但不大于1.0%)。GB/T5682-1995对硼铁牌号和化学成分具有明确规定。硼铁是炼钢生产中的强脱氧剂和合金添加剂。极微量的硼加入钢中就可显著提高钢的淬透性。因而可替代其他提高淬透性的元素明显降低合金原料成本，合金结构钢、弹簧钢、低合金高强度钢、耐热钢中广泛采用硼合金化。硼是非石墨化元素。加入铸铁中可增加白口的深度提高耐磨性。在可锻铸铁中加入0.001%-0.005%的硼。有利形成球墨并改善其分布状况。此外，铸造、热喷涂、非晶态合金、钕铁硼永磁材料生产中也使用硼铁。
explanation_en: Iron and boron alloy, mainly used as additive for alloy, usually contain 12% -23% boron. It is produced by thermit method, electro thermit method or electro carbothermic method. According to the carbon content, it can be divided into low carbon ferroboron (carbon content is not more than 0.1%) and medium carbon ferroboron (carbon content is more than 0.1% but not more than 1.0%). GB/T5682-1995 has clear regulations on the grade and chemical composition of ferroboron. Ferroboron is a strong deoxidizer and alloy additive in steelmaking production. The hardenabilhy of steel can be significantly improved by adding very little boron to steel. Therefore, it can replace other elements that improve hardenabilhy to significantly reduce the cost of alloy raw materials. Boron alloy is widely used in alloy structural steel, spring steel, low alloy high-strength steel and heat resistant steel. Boron is a non graphitization element. Adding cast iron can increase the depth of white cast iron and improve wear resistance. Add 0.001% -0.005% boron into malleable cast iron. Beneficial for the formation of nodular graphite and improving its distribution. In addition, foundry, thermal spraying, amorphous alloy, neodymium iron boron permanent magnet material also use ferroboron.

explanation_cn: 复杂岛状结构硼酸盐矿物。常有铁和锰替代镁。单斜晶系。晶体呈纤维状、板状和柱状。根据晶体形态划分为纤维状硼镁石、板状硼镁石和柱状硼镁石。三者化学成分基本相同。其中纤维状硼镁石的含水ü偏高。白色或淡黄白色，玻璃光泽，集合体呈丝絹光泽至土状光泽。产于侵入体与镁质石灰岩或白云岩的接触带中，与硼镁铁矿等无水硼酸盐矿物、金云母、硅镁石等共生；在沉积硼矿床中。由含水硼酸盐矿物经脱水而成。板状和柱状硼镁在热液作用条件下常转变成纤维状硼镁石。楚提取硼和制取硼化物的主要原料。
explanation_en: Complex island structured borate minerals. Iron and manganese often replace magnesium. Monoclinic system. The crystal are fibrous, tabular and columnar. According to the crystal morphology, it can be divided into fibrous boromagnesite, tabular boromagnesite and columnar boromagnesite. The chemical composition of the three is basically the same. The water content of fibrous boromagnesite is relatively high. White or yellowish white, glass luster, the aggregate is silky luster to earthy luster. It occurs in the contact zone between the intrusion and magnesian limestone or dolomitite, and coexists with anhydrous borate minerals such as ludwigite, phlogopite, and bischofite; In sedimentary boron deposits. It is formed by dehydration of hydrated borate minerals. Platy and columnar boron magnesium are often transformation into fibrous boromagnesite under hydrothermal conditions. Chu is the main raw material for extracting boron and producing borides.

explanation_cn: 含附加阴离子的简单岛状结构硼酸盐矿物。斜方晶系，晶体呈长柱状、i针状或纤维状。颜色随含铁量增多。由暗绿色转变为I黑色条痕浅黑绿色至黑色，暗淡光泽不透明。产I于蛇纹石化白云石大理岩或镁矽卡岩中，常与磁铁矿、硅镁石、透辉石、金云母等共生。是提取硼及制取硼化物的原料。
explanation_en: Borate minerals with simple island like structures containing additional anions. Orthorhombic crystal system, the crystal is in the form of long column, i needle or fiber. The color increases with iron content. From dark green transformation I black streaks, light dark green to black, dull luster and opaque. I occurs in serpentinized dolomite marble or magnesium skarn, and is often associated with magnetite, bischofite, diopside, phlogopite, etc. It is a raw material for extracting boron and producing borides.

explanation_cn: 碘与粗钛在低温下直接作用生成挥发性的碘化钛，继而加热到高于碘化钛能分解的温度，沉积而制得的高纯度的金属钛。纯度可达99.9%(质量分数），杂质元素的总含量显著低于工业上用的四氯化钦镁还原法制得的金属钛。
explanation_en: Iodine reacts directly with crude titanium at low temperatures to generate volatile titanium iodide, which is then heated to a temperature higher than the decomposition temperature of titanium iodide and deposited to obtain high-purity metallic titanium. The purity can reach 99.9% (mass fraction), and the total content of impurity elements is significantly lower than the metal titanium obtained by the industrial reduction method of magnesium tetrachloride.

explanation_cn: 化学式CsI:Na单晶薄膜，正立方体，相对密度4.51。在X射线激发下发出蓝色荧光。
explanation_en: Chemical formula CsI: Na single crystal film, cube, relative density 4.51. It emits blue fluorescence under X-ray excitation.

explanation_cn: 化学式为KIO3,属于三斜晶系。空间群C-P1，晶格常数a=8.9235埃,b=8.9427埃,c=7.7096埃,α=54.47°，β=123.33°，γ=90.42°,密度3。934g/cm^3,熔点为560℃,溶解度0℃时为4.47g、,100℃时为32.3g。常压下用水溶液温差法和水溶液蒸发法生长的晶体易产生宏观缺陷。水热法能够生长出优质无缺陷单晶。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is KIO3, belonging to the triclinic system. Space group C-P1, lattice constant a=8.9235 A, b=8.9427 A, c=7.7096 A, α= 54.47 °, β= 123.33 °, γ= 90.42 °, density 3. 934g/cm ^ 3, melting point is 560 ℃, water solubility is 4.47g at 0 ℃, and 32.3g at 100 ℃. Crystal grown by aqueous solution temperature difference method and aqueous solution evaporation method under normal pressure are prone to produce macroscopic defects. High quality defect free single crystal can be grown by hydrothermal method.

explanation_cn: 碧玉为一种含矿物质较多的和田玉，其中氧化铁和粘土矿物等含量可达20%以上，不透、微透或半透，颜色多呈绿色。按产地可分为新疆碧玉、沱江碧玉、俄罗斯碧玉、加拿大碧玉、新西兰碧玉、美国加州碧玉。
explanation_en: Jasper is a kind of hotan jade with more minerals, in which the content of iron oxide and clay minerals can reach more than 20%, which is impermeable, slightly permeable or semi permeable, and the color is mostly green. According to origin, it can be divided into jasper from Xinjiang, jasper from Tuojiang, jasper from Russia, jasper from Canada, jasper from New Zealand, and jasper from California, USA.

explanation_cn: 碧玉岩主要是由玉髓和自生石英组成，常含氧化铁、有机质等混入物，故有各种色彩。碧玉岩多为隐晶结构，岩石致密坚硬，具贝壳状断口。多分布于地槽区，常与火山岩伴生，呈巨厚层(数百米以上)，称碧玉岩建造。致密坚硬的硅质岩石。主要由玉髓和自生石英组成，带有氧化铁及有机质混入，故常呈红色、棕色、绿色、玫瑰色等，色美者可作宝石。
explanation_en: Jasper rock is mainly composed of chalcedony and authigenic quartze, often containing iron oxide, organic matter and other mixed substances, so it has various colors. The jasper rock is mostly of cryptocrystalline structure, and the rock is dense and hard, with shell shaped fracture. It is mostly distributed in geosyncline area, often associated with volcanic rock, and is in a very thick layer (hundreds of meters above), called jasper rock formation. Dense and hard siliceous rock. It is mainly composed of chalcedony and authigenic quartze, mixed with iron oxide and organic matter, so it is often red, brown, green, rose, etc. Those with beautiful colors can be used as gems.

explanation_cn: 是以碱激发磨细水淬高炉矿渣制成的一种新型混凝土，具有优良的物理力学性能与耐久性。
explanation_en: It is a new type of concrete made of alkali activated ground and water quenched blast furnace slag. It has excellent physical and mechanical properties and durability.

name_cn: 碱土金属-碱金属卤化物：铕（Ⅱ）
name_en: alkaline earth-alkaline metal halide activated by europium
explanation_cn: 该荧光粉通过X射线、电子束和紫外线辐照后，用450-900mn电磁波激励发出近紫外和蓝区的荧光。用作X射线图像存储屏用发光材料。
explanation_en: After being irradiated by X-ray, electron beam and ultraviolet ray, the phosphor emits near ultraviolet and blue fluorescence with 450-900 mn electromagnetic wave excitation. Used as luminescence materials for X-ray image storage screen.

explanation_cn: 一类SiO2含量较低而Na2O和K20含量较高的火成岩。
explanation_en: A type of igneous rock with low SiO2 content and high Na2O and K20 content.

explanation_cn: 药皮以碱性氧化物和氟化钙为主的焊条称碱性焊条。药皮主要组成物是碳酸钙岩（大理石或石灰石）和萤石。
explanation_en: The electrode whose coating is mainly alkaline oxide and calcium fluoride is called basic welding rod. The main components of the coating are calcium carbonate rock (marble or limestone) and fluorite.

explanation_cn: 燃料电池是一种利用OH-离子（氢氧根离子）作为电解质传导物质的电池。通常在60°C到250°C的温度范围内运行，可以提供几十千瓦的输出功率。在这些反应中，氧气在阴极还原生成水。OH-离子通过电解质传导，迁移到阳极，与氢气发生反应生成水。最常用的电解质是氢氧根（OH-）的水溶液，如氢氧化钾（KOH）。然而，KOH在地球上使用时会与大气中的二氧化碳（CO2）反应生成碳酸钾（K2CO3），降低了OH-离子的浓度，从而降低了电解质的传导性能。此外，K2CO3的低溶解度也会导致固体颗粒的形成，这些颗粒会堵塞气体扩散电极中的通道，降低气体的扩散速度。因此，在地球上使用KOH作为电解质不太合适。然而，在没有CO2的外层空间中，使用KOH是可行的。为了解决这个问题，研究人员目前正在研究能够传导OH-离子的固体聚合物电解质。这些电解质具有不同的化学结构，但它们都具有较高的抗CO2性能。这类电解质的支链端基通常包含-NR3或-PR2基团，其中OH-离子通常用于传导，R是有机基团。尽管这些电解质的抗CO2性能显著提高，但它们仍在研究和探索中，目前尚没有商业化产品。虽然铂系贵重金属的催化性能最好，但这类燃料电池也可以使用非铂金属如镍（Ni）作为催化剂，以降低成本。
explanation_en: Fuel cell is a kind of battery that uses OH - ion (hydroxyl ion) as electrolyte conduction material. Generally, it operates in the temperature range of 60 ° C to 250 ° C, and can provide dozens of kilowatts of output power. In these reactions, oxygen is reduced at the cathode to generate water. OH - ions are conducted through electrolytes, migrate to the anode, and react with hydrogen gas to generate water. The most commonly used elonrolyte is an aqueous solution of hydroxyl (OH -), such as potassium hydroxide (KOH). However, when used on Earth, KOH reacts with carbon dioxide (CO2) in the atmosphere to generate potassium carbonate (K2CO3), reducing the concentration of OH ions and thus reducing the conductivity of electrolytes. In addition, the low water solubility of K2CO3 will also lead to the formation of solid particles, which will block the channels in the gas diffusion electrode and reduce the diffusion speed of gas. Therefore, using KOH as an electrolyte on Earth is not suitable. However, in outer space without CO2, the use of KOH is feasible. In order to solve this problem, researchers are currently studying solid polymer elonrolyte that can conduct OH ions. These elonrolyte have different chemical structures, but they all have high CO2 resistance. The side chain end groups of such elonrolyte usually contain - NR3 or - PR2 groups, where OH ions are usually used for conduction, and R is an organic group. Although the CO2 resistance of these electrolytes has significantly improved, they are still under research and exploration, and there are currently no commercial products available. Although platinum based precious metals have the best catalytic performance, such fuel cell can also use non platinum metals such as nickel (Ni) as catalysts to reduce costs.

explanation_cn: 一般指以MgO、CaO或MgO和CaO为主要成分的耐火材料。按化学 矿物组成可分为镁质、镁铬质、镁铝质、镁白云石质、白云石质和石灰质等。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to refractory with MgO, CaO or MgO and CaO as main components. According to chemical mineral composition, it can be divided into magnesium, magnesium chromium, magnesium aluminum, magnesium dolomite, dolomite, and limestone.

explanation_cn: 是由磨细矿渣（或磷渣、钢渣等）和碱性激发剂混合而制成的一种胶凝材料。
explanation_en: It is a cementitious material made by mixing ground slag (or phosphorus slag, steel slag, etc.) and alkaline activator.

explanation_cn: 钛、钽等金属置于强碱溶液中一段时间后取出，再经高温后处理，形成具有生物活性表面的改性技术。
explanation_en: Titanium, tantalum and other metals are taken out after being put in strong alkaline solution for a period of time, and then treated at high temperature to form a bioactivity surface modification technology.

explanation_cn: 材料在碱性溶液中，在拉应力和腐浊介质协同作用下而产生的开裂，属于应力腐蚀开裂的一种。
explanation_en: The cracking of materials in alkaline solution under the synergistic action of tensile stress and corrosive medium is a kind of stress corrosion cracking.

explanation_cn: 重要的II-XI族化合物半导体材料，为闪锌矿结构。晶格常数6.48埃(300K)。密度5.86g/cm^3。禁带宽度1.5eV,与太阳光谱带匹配较好。具有直接跃迁型能带结构，光电转换效率高。
explanation_en: The important II-XI compound semiconductor materials is sphalerite structure. The lattice constant is 6.48 angstroms (300K). Density 5.86g/cm ^ 3. The bandgap width is 1.5eV, which matches well with the solar spectral band. It has a direct transition band structure and high photo-electric conversion efficiency.

explanation_cn: 重要的三元固溶半导体材料，为PbTe与SnTe的连续间溶体，属NaCl型晶体结构。具有直接带隙，变换其x值，可使其77K的带隙由0变到0.22eV。
explanation_en: The important ternary solid solution semiconductor materials is the continuous intersolution of PbTe and SnTe, which belongs to NaCl type crystal structure. It has a direct bandgap, and by changing its x value, its 77K bandgap can be changed from 0 to 0.22eV.

explanation_cn: 重要的三元固溶体材料，为HgTe与CdTe的连续同溶体，变换x值可使其带隙从0变到1.6eV,属闪锌矿结构。
explanation_en: The important ternary solid solution materials is the continuous synsolution of HgTe and CdTe. Changing x value can change its band gap from 0 to 1.6eV, which belongs to sphalerite structure.

explanation_cn: 以碳或石墨纤维为增强体，碳或石墨为基体复合而成的材料，又称为碳纤维增强碳基复合材料。研制始于1958年，按制造工艺可分为有机聚合热解法和化学气相浸渍法。将碳纤维按单向、双向或多向编制成所需的预成型体。有机聚合物热解法是将有机聚合物，如酚醛树脂.反复浸溃纤维预成型体，将其热解成炭，并在高温下将基体碳转化为石墨。化学气相浸渍法是将气相碳渗人到纤维与成型体形成热解石墨.得到复合材料。制造工艺复杂、周期长、成本高，但具有较好的力学性能、强度高、刚性好、密度小、耐磨损，有良好的导热性。在惰性气氛下使用，有很好的热和化学稳定性，可使用到2000t以上。抗氧化性能较差，在氧化气氛中600°C左右性能严重下降。在氧化气氛下使用，应采用涂层防护，在复合材料或碳纤维表面涂上一层或多层保护膜，来提高耐高温性能。保护层一般采用难熔化合物，如碳化物、石英等。广泛用于洲际导弹、火箭和航天飞机等的鼻锥帽、表面层、喷嘴、机翼等.高超音速飞机和赛车的刹车片、高温发动机热部件和生物医学材料等。
explanation_en: The materials made of composition with carbon or graphite fiber as reinforcement and carbon or graphite as matrix is also called carbon fiber reinforced carbon matrix composites. It was developed in 1958 and can be divided into organic polymerization pyrolysis method method and chemical vapor impregnation method according to the manufacturing process. Weave carbon fibers into the required preforms in a unidirectional, bidirectional, or multi-directional manner. The pyrolysis method of organic polymer is to repeatedly soak the fiber preform of organic polymer, such as phenolic resin, pyrolyze it into carbon, and convert matrix carbon into graphite at high temperature. The chemical vapor impregnation method is to infiltrate the vapor phase carbon into the fiber and the molding body to form pyrolytic graphite and obtain composite materials. The manufacturing process is complex, the cycle is long, and the cost is high, but it has good mechanical properties, high strength, good rigidity, low density, wear resistance, and good thermal conductivity. Used in an inert atmosphere, it has good thermal and chemical stability and can be used for over 2000t. The antioxidant performance is poor, and its performance severely decreases at around 600 ° C in an oxidizing atmosphere. When used in oxidizing atmosphere, coating protection shall be adopted, and one or more layers of protective films shall be coated on the surface of composite materials or carbon fiber to improve the high temperature resistance. The protective layer generally adopts refractory compounds, such as carbide, quartze, etc. It is widely used for nose cone caps, surface layers, nozzles, wings, etc. of intercontinental missiles, rockets and space shuttles, brake pads of hypersonic aircraft and racing cars, thermal components of high-temperature engines, biomedical materials, etc.

name_cn: 碳/碳复合材料表面抗氧化处理
name_en: treatment of oxidation resistance on surface of carbon/carbon composite
explanation_cn: 在碳/碳复合材料表面涂一层保护层防止材料在高温条件下与空气中等发生化学反应而气化.提高材料的抗氧化能力。但单一涂层尚难以根本上解决材料的抗氧化问题，因为单一的涂层很难满足熔点高并与碳材料浸润性好、膨胀系数小、达到匹配性好、致密性优良等诸多条件。一种由硅化物、硼化物、Zr、Ni等复合组分组成的涂层，可在1200°C空气中烧蚀而不被氧化，能有效地改善材料表面的抗氧化能力。通过在碳/碳基体中添加碳化物、硼化物、氮化物等组分.而制成的C/C-SiC、C/C-BN、C/C-TiC、C/C-ZrBz等，在1000-C以内其抗氧化效果较好。另外通过浸溃有机硅高分子、硼酸盐和磷酸盐等无机盐，也可不同程度地提高材料的抗氧化性能。
explanation_en: Apply a protective layer on the surface of carbon/carbon composhes to prevent materials from gasification due to chemical reaction with air at high temperature, and improve the oxidation resistance of materials. However, a single coating is still difficult to fundamentally solve the oxidation resistance problem of materials, because a single coating is difficult to meet many conditions such as high melting point, good wettability with carbon materials, small expansion coefficient, good matching, good compactness, etc. A coating composed of composition components such as silicide, boride, Zr, Ni, etc., can be ablated in air at 1200 ° C without being oxidized, which can effectively improve the oxidation resistance of surface of materials. The C/C-SiC, C/C-BN, C/C-TiC, C/C-ZrBz, etc. made by adding carbide, boride, nitride and other components to the carbon/carbon matrix have better oxidation resistance within 1000-C. In addition, the oxidation resistance of materials can be improved to varying degrees by soaking inorganic salts such as organosilicon polymer, borate and phosphate.

explanation_cn: 具有0.4nm左右及均勾微孔的炭材料,可作为变压吸附法的气体分离、精制用吸附剂而用于各种工业领域。
explanation_en: Carbon materials with around 0.4nm and uniform micropores can be used as adsorbents for gas separation and refining in various industrial fields using pressure swing adsorption.

explanation_cn: 非碳原子与碳化合生成碳化物的反应。碳化生成的物质主要是由碳组成的碳化物而不是碳的化合物。
explanation_en: The reaction of non carbon atoms and carbonization to form carbide. The substances generated by carbonization are mainly carbide composed of carbon rather than carbon compounds.

explanation_cn: 碳与其他元素（主要是与过渡元素）所形成的一类化合物，是合金（特别是一般钢铁）中的重要组成相之一。与碳形成化合物的元素大部分都在其原子结构中具有一个未填满的d电子层，而且d电子层越不满的元素与碳的亲和力便越大，形成的碳化物也越稳定。碳化物按其晶体结构特点应归属于间隙相"
explanation_en: A kind of compound formed by carbon and other elements (mainly transition elements) is one of the important constituent phases in alloy (especially general steel). Most of the elements that form compounds with carbon have an unfilled d d electron layer in their atomic structure, and the more dissatisfied the d electron layer is, the greater the affinity between the elements and carbon will be, and the carbide formed will be more stable. Carbide should be classified as interstitial phase according to its crystal structure“

explanation_cn: 易裂变材料铀、钚或可转换材料钍的碳化物及它们的混合物，主要有U-C系、Pu-C系和Th-C系。1>C系有H种化合物：UC、UC2和U2C3。UC燃料的U含量高，热导率高，为各向同性立方结构.高温及高燃耗时的辐照稳定性好，理论密度13.63g/cm3,熔点2643K,含铀量95.2%(质量分数），较活泼，但高温时在熔融钠与钾中是惰性的。UC2理论密度11.68g/m3，含铀密度90.8%(质量分数），熔点27431T.其他性能与UC相近。Pu-C系有四种化合物：PuC、Pu2C3、PuC2和Pu3C2。PuC为立方结构，理论密度13.6g/cm3,熔点2123K,热导率明显低于UC。Th-C系有两种化合物：ThC和ThC2。分别为立方和单斜结构，密度分别为10.64g/cm3和9.Sg/cm3，熔点分别为2898K和2928K,它们直到熔点都是稳定的。(U,Pu)C固溶体热导率高，与钠、钾不易作用，辐照稳定性好。碳化物的制备采用三种方法：电弧熔化法、化学粉碎及碳化法（金属氢化，热分解得到金属粉，与石墨混合、压制、加热）和碳热法。可用粉末冶金法或溶胶-凝胶法制造球形碳化物颗粒，然后弥散在石墨基体中，可用作高温气冷堆和其他类型反应堆的燃料。
explanation_en: The carbide of fissile materials uranium, plutonium or fertile materials thorium and their mixtures mainly include U-C system, Pu-C system and Th-C system. 1> There are H compounds in the C series: UC, UC2, and U2C3. UC fuel has high U content, high thermal conductivity and isotropic cubic structure. It has good irradiation stability at high temperature and high burning time. Its theoretical density is 13.63g/cm3, melting point is 2643K, and uranium content is 95.2% (mass fraction). It is relatively active, but it is inert in molten sodium and potassium at high temperature. UC2 theoretical density 11.68g/m3, uranium containing density 90.8% (mass fraction), melting point 27431T. Other properties are similar to UC. There are four types of compounds in the Pu-C system: PuC, Pu2C3, PuC2, and Pu3C2. PuC has a cubic structure, with a theoretical density of 13.6g/cm3, a melting point of 2123K, and a thermal conductivity significantly lower than that of UC. There are two types of compounds in the Th-C system: ThC and ThC2. They are cubic and monoclinic structures, with density of 10.64g/cm3 and 9.Sg/cm3, respectively, and melting point of 2898K and 2928K, respectively. They are stable until melting point. (U, Pu) C solid solution has high thermal conductivity, is not easy to interact with sodium and potassium, and has good irradiation stability. Carbide is prepared by three methods: arc melting, chemical crushing and carbonization (metal hydrogenation, thermal decomposition to obtain metal powder, mixing with graphite, pressing, heating) and carbothermal method. Spherical carbide particles can be produced by powder metallurgy or sol-gel method, and then dispersed in graphite matrix, which can be used as fuel for high-temperature gas cooled reactor and other types of reactors.

explanation_cn: 陶瓷纤维品种之一，是碳化硅、碳化硼和碳化钛等含有碳素的难熔纤维的总称。按结构分类有：①填隙相碳化物纤维，碳与过渡金属元素之间形成填隙结构的固熔体（如碳化钛等），无严格的化学组成，有明显的固体性质及金属特性.如有金属光泽、优良的导热和导电性能、正电阻系数等。②碳原子与金属原子形成共价键的碳化物，如碳化硅等。制法有原丝转化法、气相沉积法、气-液-固（VLS法）生长法及载体纺丝法等。前三种已达到工业化水平。按纤维的形态分为连续纤维及短纤维。前者属多晶纤维，后者属单晶纤维。这类纤维具有高强度、高模量、低伸长、耐热、高温下抗氧化性能好以及耐化学腐蚀等性能。主要作高聚物、金属、陶瓷等结构复合材料的增强体.亦可用于烧蚀与防热功能复合材料，如窑炉内衬、耐热帘布等以及过滤、耐磨等功能复合材料等。
explanation_en: One of the varieties of ceramics fibers is the general name of carbon containing refractory fibers such as silicon carbide, boron carbide and titanium carbide. According to the structure, there are: ① interstitial phase carbide fiber, solid melt (such as titanium carbide) forming interstitial structure between carbon and transition metal elements, without strict chemical composition, with obvious solid properties and metal characteristics, such as metallic luster, excellent thermal conductivity and conductivity, positive resistance coefficient, etc. ② Carbide, such as silicon carbide, that forms covalent bond between carbon atoms and metal atoms. The production methods include precursor conversion method, vapor deposition method, gas liquid solid (VLS) growth method, and carrier spinning method. The first three have reached the level of industrialization. It can be divided into continuous fiber and staple fiber according to fiber morphology. The former belongs to polycrystal fiber, while the latter belongs to single crystal fiber. This kind of fiber has high strength, high modulus, low elongation, heat resistance, good oxidation resistance at high temperature and chemical corrosion resistance. It is mainly used as reinforcement of structural composite materials such as polymers, metals, ceramics, etc. It can also be used as ablative and heat resistant composite, such as furnace lining, heat resistant cord fabric, functional composite materials such as filtration and wear resistance.

explanation_cn: 碳化硅晶体有两种基本的晶型，即立方型和六方型。立方型称p-SiC,它在1800?2000°C形成.六方型称crSiC,在六方型中又有120多种晶体形态，它在2000T:以上形成。常压下SiC没有液相，在2000°C热分解。SiC的能隙与晶体形态有关，在2.20-2.80eV范围，是高温半导体材料，Sic器件可以在50CTC下工作，且具有很强的抗辐射能力。制备SiC单晶的方法主要有：①SiC'粉直接升华法，控制温度1800-2200°C;②气相生长，控制温度1600-1800°C;③液相外延，控制温度1600-1700-C。SiC单晶可用于制备绿色和蓝色发光二极管，但主要用于制备场效应晶体管和双极型晶体管等功率器件。
explanation_en: There are two basic crystal forms of silicon carbide crystal, namely cubic and hexagonal. The cubic type is called p-SiC, which is at 1800? Formed at 2000 ° C. The hexagonal type is called crSiC, and there are more than 120 crystal forms in the hexagonal type. It forms at more than 2000T:. Under normal pressure, SiC has no liquid phase and undergoes thermal decomposition at 2000 ° C. The energy gap of SiC is related to the crystal morphology. It is a high-temperature semiconductor materials in the range of 2.20-2.80eV. SiC devices can work at 50CTC and have strong radiation resistance. The main methods for preparing SiC single crystal are: ① direct sublimation of SiC 'powder, control temperature 1800-2200 ° C; ② Growth from vapour phase, control temperature 1600-1800 ° C; ③ Liquid phase epitaxy, control temperature 1600-1700-C. SiC single crystal can be used to prepare green and blue luminescence diodes, but it is mainly used to prepare power devices such as field effect transistors and bipolar transistors.

explanation_cn: SiC晶体结构具有多型性，原子不同的堆垛形式对应不同的结构。目前已发现并已确定其晶格结构的SiC晶体多达200余种，其中较为常见的有3C、15R、6H、4H和2H共5种。SiC单晶是一种宽带隙的半导体材料，常温下6H-SiC单晶的带隙为3.023eV，而Si和GaAs分别为1.leV和L4eV。同时SiC又具有优良的热导率，如6闩^(：的热导率为3.6界(/(111-10，抗电压击穿能力是Si的10倍。SiC单晶的生长的传统方法有Acheson法和Lely法，这两种方法均是自发成核，生成的SiC单晶尺寸小。目前物理气相传输法(physicalvapourtransition，PVT)是生长大尺寸、高质量SiC单晶的最好方法。半导体晶体具有禁带宽度大、击穿电乐高、热导率高、电子饱和漂移速率高、电子迁移率高、介电常数小、抗辐射性能强、化学稳定性好等优良的物理化学性质，是发展高亮度LED、电力电子器件、微波功率器件的关键材料。
explanation_en: SiC crystal structure is polytype, and different stacking forms of atoms correspond to different structures. Up to now, more than 200 kinds of SiC crystal have been found and their lattice structures have been determined, among which there are 5 kinds of common SiC crystal, namely 3C, 15R, 6H, 4H and 2H. SiC single crystal is a wide band gap semiconductor materials. The band gap of 6H SiC single crystal at room temperature is 3.023 eV, while that of Si and GaAs is 1. leV and L4eV respectively. At the same time, SiC also has excellent thermal conductivity. For example, the thermal conductivity of 6 × 10 is 3.6 (/(111-10), and the resistance to voltage breakdown is 10 times that of SiC. The traditional growth methods of SiC single crystal are Acheson method and Lely method, both of which are spontaneous nucleation, and the size of the generated SiC single crystal is small. The physical vapor transport (PVT) method is the best method to grow large and high-quality SiC single crystal. Semiconductor crystal have excellent physical chemistry properties such as wide band gap, breakdown Lego, high thermal conductivity, high electron saturation drift rate, high electron mobility, small dielectric constant, strong radiation resistance, good chemical stability, etc. They are key materials for the development of high brightness LEDs, power electronic devices, and microwave power devices.

name_cn: 碳化硅晶须增强生物活性玻璃陶瓷复合材料
explanation_cn: 是由碳化硅晶须与生物活性玻璃陶瓷复合而成的一种生物陶瓷复合材料。生物活性玻璃陶瓷赋予其高生物活性、高强度、高弹性模量、无毒的碳化硅晶须在陶瓷基材中弥散分布，使材料中的裂纹尺寸相对均匀，裂纹扩展发生转向和分支，加上外力作用下碳化硅晶须拔出时产生的拔出效应，特别是其维伯尔系数高达24.7,标志着这种复合陶瓷是最可靠的可承力的生物陶瓷复合材料。动态疲劳试验研究表明.在生理环境中，这种复合陶瓷在与人体密质骨抗弯强度相当的应力作用下，寿命可超过50年，是预测寿命最长的生物陶瓷材料。
explanation_en: It is a biological cemmics composite materials made of composition of silicon carbide crystal whisker and bioactive glass-ceramics. Bioactive glass-ceramics endow its highly bioactivity, high-strength, high elastic modulus, non-toxic silicon carbide crystal whisker with dispersion and distribution in the ceramics substrate, so that the crack size in materials is relatively uniform, crack propagation turns and branches, plus the pull out effect of silicon carbide crystal whisker when pulled out under external force, especially its Weibull coefficient is as high as 24.7, This indicates that this composition ceramics is the most reliable load-bearing biological cemmics composite materials. The research of dynamic fatigue test shows that under the stress equivalent to the bending strength of human compact bone in the physiological environment, the life of this composition ceramics can exceed 50 years, which is the longest predicted biological cemmics materials.

explanation_cn: 以碳化娃为主要成分的耐火制品，包括砖、管、棒及各种异形制品。具有高温强度大、耐磨性优、热导率高、热震稳定性以及耐蚀性好等优点。碳化硅砖由于结合方式不同而性能差别较大，应用领域广泛。
explanation_en: Refractory products mainly composed of carbonized bricks, including bricks, pipes, rods, and various shaped products. It has the advantages of high temperature strength, excellent wear resistance, high thermal conductivity, thermal shock resistance and good corrosion resistance. Silicon carbide brick has a wide range of applications due to its different bonding modes and different properties.

name_cn: 碳化硅纤维增强碳化锆基复合材料
name_en: silicon carbide fiber reinforced zirconium carbide matrix composite
explanation_cn: 纤维增强超高温陶瓷基复合材料中的一种，增强相为碳化硅纤维，基体为碳化锆。基体可通过化学气相沉积和碳化锆前驱体浸渍-热解工艺制备。碳化硅纤维的热稳定性直接影响复合材料的性能及使用温度。
explanation_en: One of fiber reinforced ultra high temperature ceramic matrix composite, the reinforcing phase is silicon carbide fiber, and the matrix is zirconium carbide. The matrix can be prepared by chemical vapor deposition and impregnation pyrolysis process of zirconium carbide precursor. The thermal stability of silicon carbide fibers directly affects the properties and service temperature of composite materials.

explanation_cn: 碳桂化合物的薄膜。化学计量比的碳硅化合物化学势为SiC，后者根据密排面堆垛次序不同，有三种多型体。SiC机械强度高，耐高温和耐腐蚀性优良。为了得到高质量的单晶膜，基体反应温度应保持在1000-1500°C。SiC膜除用作耐磨镀层外，还可用作薄膜热敏电阻器，光电子学和高温半导体器件，以及聚变堆的第一壁材料。
explanation_en: A thin film of carbon cinnamon compounds. The chemical potential of stoichiometric carbon silicon compound is SiC, and the latter has three polytypes according to the stacking order of closely packed surfaces. SiC has high mechanical strength, excellent high temperature resistance and corrosion resistance. In order to obtain high-quality single crystal films, the reaction temperature of matrix should be kept at 1000-1500 ° C. In addition to being used as wear-resistant coatings, SiC films can also be used as thin film thermistors, optoelectronics and high-temperature semiconductor devices, and first-wall materials of fusion reactor.

explanation_cn: 以碳化硅为主要原料的陶瓷。SiC是典型的共价键结合化合物，单位晶胞是由相同四面体构成，_硅原子处于中心位置，周围是碳原子。它有a、P两种晶型，六方结构；P为低温型，立方结构。SiC陶瓷的制备方法主要有反应烧结法、热压烧结法、无压烧结法、热等静压烧结法等SiC陶瓷的物性随不同制备工艺和不同烧结添加物而不同。Sic陶瓷不仅具有优良的常温力学性能，如高的弯曲强度、优良的抗氧化性、耐腐蚀性好、高的抗磨损以及低的摩擦系数，而且高温力学性能（强度、抗蠕变性等）是已知陶瓷材料中最佳的。热压烧结、无压烧结、热等静压烧结的材料，其高温强度可一直维持到1600°c，是陶瓷材料中高温强度最好的材料。抗氧化性也是所有非氧化物中最好的，表面生成氧化硅层可阻止氧分子进一步进人基体。SiC陶瓷的缺点是断裂靭性较低，即脆性较大的SiC陶瓷在石油、化工、微电子、汽车、航空航天、造纸、激光、矿业以及原子能等工业领域获得了广泛的应用，如喷嘴、轴承、密封件、涡轮增压器转子、燃气轮机叶片、反射屏、封装材料、基片等。
explanation_en: Ceramics with silicon carbide as the main raw material. SiC is a typical covalent bond binding compound, and the unit unit cell of crystal is composed of the same tetrahedron_ Silicon atoms are located in the center, surrounded by carbon atoms. It has two crystal forms, a and P, with a hexagonal structure; P is a low-temperature type with a cubic structure. The preparation methods of SiC ceramics mainly include reaction sintering, hot pressing sintering, pressureless sintering, hot isostatic pressing sintering, etc. The physical properties of SiC ceramics vary with different preparation processes and different sintering additives. Sic ceramics not only have excellent mechanical properties at room temperature, such as high bending strength, excellent oxidation resistance, good corrosion resistance, high wear resistance and low friction coefficient, but also have the best high-temperature mechanical properties (strength, creep resistance, etc.) among known ceramics materials. The high temperature strength of materials sintered by hot pressing sintering, pressureless sintering and hot isostatic pressing sintering can be maintained up to 1600 ° C, which is the best materials of high temperature strength among ceramics materials. The oxidation resistance is also the best of all non oxides. The formation of silicon oxide layer on the surface can prevent oxygen molecules from further entering the matrix. The disadvantage of SiC ceramics is low fracture toughness, that is, SiC ceramics with high brittleness have been widely used in petroleum, chemical industry, microelectronics, automobile, aerospace, paper making, laser, mining, atomic energy and other industrial fields, such as nozzles, bearings, seals, turbocharger rotors, gas turbine blades, reflective screens, packaging materials, substrates, etc.

explanation_cn: 硼的一种碳化物，分子式Rf。吸收中子后发生反应产生氦气和锂，产物的体积比硼的体积约大20倍，含硼材料的辐照肿胀问题是其主要缺点。碳化硼为六角菱形晶系?在晶胞各个角上有十二个硼原子，因而可以把锂原子，甚至氦原子保留在晶体内，可以预计在硼的燃耗低于8%时，B4C在辐照下是稳定的。用气相沉积法或电热法合成。可以粉末、压块或弥散在其他基体里，制成多种结构.用于各种反应堆中。碳化硼硬度高、强度大.也用作磨料和耐腐材料。
explanation_en: A carbide of boron, molecular formula Rf. After absorbing neutrons, the reaction produces helium and lithium, and the volume of the product is about 20 times larger than that of boron. The irradiation swelling problem of boron containing materials is its main disadvantage. Is boron carbide hexagonal rhombic crystal system? There are twelve boron atoms at each corner of the unit cell of crystal, so lithium and even helium atoms can be retained in the crystal. It can be predicted that B4C will be stable under irradiation when the boron burn up is less than 8%. Synthesized by vapor deposition or electrothermal method. It can be made of powder, briquette or dispersed in other matrix and used in various reactors. Boron carbide has high hardness and high strength. It is also used as abrasive and anti-corrosion materials.

explanation_cn: 将碳化硼和三氧化二铝的混合，采用烧结方法制取的弥散强化的复合材料材料，并且将这种复合材料制作成为控制棒。因为碳化硼复合材料具有较大的中子吸收截面，可用做核反应堆的控制棒。碳化硼是一种极硬的陶瓷材料，用于坦克车的装甲、避弹衣和很多丁.业用品中。
explanation_en: The dispersion strengthened composite materials materials is made by mixing boron carbide and aluminum oxide with sintering method, and this composite materials is made into a control rod. Because boron carbide composite materials has a large neutron absorption cross section, it can be used as control rod of nuclear reactor. Boron carbide is an extremely hard ceramics materials, which is used in tank armor, bullet proof clothing and many household products.

explanation_cn: 以碳化硼(B4C)为主要成分的陶瓷材料，弹性模量450?470GPa?摩氏硬度为9.3,硬度仅次于金刚石和立方氮化硼.俗称"人造金刚石"，电阻率0.1?10fi?cm，中子吸收截面600b.化学稳定性良好。ftC陶瓷密度低、硬度高、中子俘获截面大，被广泛用作硬质材料的磨削、研磨、抛光、钻孔、切割和喷砂嘴等耐磨部件的制备.和耐酸、碱腐蚀零部件、防弹装甲（尤其是武装直升机和轻型装甲战车的理想装甲材料）、中子吸收剂（如核反应炉场里控制链式反应的控制棒、终止失控核堆链式反应进行应急投埋处理的陶瓷粉料）等。
explanation_en: Ceramics materials mainly composed of boron carbide (B4C), with elastic modulus of 450? 470GPa? The Mohs hardness is 9.3, and the hardness is second only to diamond and cubic boron nitride, commonly known as "synthetic diamond", and the resistivity is 0.1? 10fi? Cm, neutron absorption cross section 600b. Good chemical stability. With low density, high hardness and large neutron capture section, ftC ceramics are widely used for grinding, grinding, polishing, drilling, cutting and grit blasting of hard materials, as well as the preparation of acid and alkali resistant corrosion parts, bulletproof armor (especially the ideal armor materials for armed helicopters and light armored combat vehicles) Neutron absorber (such as control rod for chain reaction control in nuclear reaction furnace field, ceramics powder for emergency burial treatment after chain reaction of out of control nuclear reactor is terminated), etc.

explanation_cn: 钛碳化合物的薄膜.一种重要的耐磨涂层。吋以用化学气相沉积(CVI))、离子镀和溅射法制备.常有明ffi的（111)或（110)择优取向和较高的缺陷密度。20世纪60年代末碳化钛曾作为硬质合金刀具耐磨镀层进入市场，但不久即为综合性能较好的CVI>TiN取代。但作为氮化钛多层复合耐磨涂层的组元，碳化钛层一直在应用。碳化钛也用作黑色和灰色装饰层。
explanation_en: Titanium carbon compound film. An important wear resistant coating. It is prepared by chemical vapor deposition (CVI), ion plating and sputtering. There is usually a (111) or (110) preferred orientation of obvious ffi and a higher defect density. In the late 1960s, titanium carbide entered the market as a wear-resistant coating for hardmetal tools, but soon it was replaced by CVI>TiN with better comprehensive performance. However, as a component of titanium nitride multi-layer composition wear resistant coating, titanium carbide layer has been applied. Titanium carbide is also used as a black and gray decorative layer.

explanation_cn: 以碳化钛(TO为主要成分的陶瓷材料，密度为4.93g/ori1,熔点为3160t.热膨胀系数为Y./XlO-ef-1(20?1S00T),弹性模量451GPa,磾度为30GPa。TiC陶瓷硬度高、化学稳定性好.可用于制造耐磨材料、切削陶瓷刀具材料等，还是硬质合金生产的重要原料"
explanation_en: The ceramics materials with titanium carbide (TO) as the main component has a density of 4.93g/ori1, a melting point of 3160 t. The thermal expansion coefficient is Y./XlO-ef-1 (20 × 1S00T), elastic modulus of 451GPa, and the thermal expansion coefficient of 30GPa. TiC ceramics has high hardness and good chemical stability. It can be used to manufacture wear resisting materials, cut ceramics tool materials, etc. It is also an important raw material for hardmetal production“

explanation_cn: 以碳化拷(WC)为主要成分的陶瓷材料，密度15.55g/m3<.熔点为2870T。抗氧化能力弱，空气中5()0°C以上即开始活性氧化。硬度与金刚石接近.为电、热优良导体.化学性能稳定，常用作高速切削工具，耐磨材料，金属陶瓷材料，电阻发热元件以及铜、钴、铋等金属的熔炼坩埚，耐磨半导体薄膜。它能与许多碳化物形成固溶体。WCTiC-Co硬质合金刀具已获得广泛应用。它还能作为NbC-C及TaC-C三元体系碳化物的改性添加物，既可降低烧结温度，又能保持优良性能，可用于喷气发动机部件。
explanation_en: The ceramics materials with carbonization copy (WC) as the main component has a density of 15.55g/m3<. The melting point is 2870T. The antioxidant capacity is weak, and active oxidation begins at temperatures above 5 () 0 ° C in the air. The hardness is close to that of diamond. It is an excellent electrical and thermal conductor with stable chemical properties. It is commonly used as high-speed cutting tools, wear resisting materials, cermet materials, resistance heating elements, melting crucibles for copper, cobalt, bismuth and other metals, and wear-resistant semiconductor films. It can form solid solution with many carbide. WCTiC Co hardmetal tools have been widely used. It can also be used as a modification additive for carbide of NbC-C and TaC-C ternary systems, which can not only reduce the sintering temperature, but also maintain excellent performance, and can be used for jet engine parts.

explanation_cn: 一种耐超高温抗烧蚀涂层材料。常采用化学气相沉积法，以五氯化钽和甲烷气为反应混合气，用氩作载气，把该混合气通入氧化铝制反应管，用碳化硅电阻从外部进行辐射加热和炭化反应。该陶瓷涂层熔点3880°C，密度13.9g/cm3,莫氏硬度9?10,热膨胀系数6.29X1(KSK-1,化学稳定性好，难洛于无机酸.耐蚀和耐热冲击，抗氧化能力强，是一种具有很大应用前景的抗烧蚀涂层材料。
explanation_en: The invention relates to an ultra-high temperature and ablation resistant coating materials. The chemical vapor deposition method is often used. Tantalum pentachloride and methane gas are used as the reaction mixture, argon is used as the carrier gas, the mixture is passed into the aluminum oxide reaction tube, and the silicon carbide resistor is used for radiation heating and carbonization reaction from the outside. The ceramics coating has a melting point of 3880 ° C, a density of 13.9g/cm3, and a Mohs hardness of 9? 10. The coefficient of thermal expansion is 6.29X1 (KSK-1). It has good chemical stability and is difficult to resist inorganic acid. It has strong corrosion resistance, heat shock resistance and oxidation resistance. It is a kind of anti ablation coating materials with great application prospects.

explanation_cn: 一种担和给的混合碳化物.以铪原子固溶于碳化钽中而形成钽-铪-碳的连续单相固溶体，是目前已知熔点最高的物质。常以高纯度的碳化钽粉末和碳化铪粉末为原料.经高速机械球磨1?36h后，制备要求较高。该陶瓷密度M.CMg/cm3,熔点4215°C.硬度20GPa。因其超高熔点和硬度，材料主要可应用于航空航天的热端部件，例如头锥、推力室以及发动机喉衬等。
explanation_en: A kind of mixed carbide of support and supply. It is a continuous single-phase solid solution of tantalum hafnium carbon formed by dissolving hafnium atoms in tantalum carbide. It is the substance with the highest melting point known at present. It is usually made of high-purity tantalum carbide powder and carbonization powder. It is milled by high-speed mechanical milling? After 36 hours, the preparation requirements are high. The ceramics has a density of M.CMg/cm3, a melting point of 4215 ° C. and a hardness of 20GPa. Because of its super high melting point and hardness, materials can be mainly used in aerospace hot end components, such as nose cone, thrust chamber and engine throat liner.

explanation_cn: 一般是指热解产物为HfC陶瓷的聚合物或混合物。HfC的密度是12.67g/cmS熔点为3890°C,热膨胀系数为(659±0.04)X10-6°C-、热导率为20.1W/(m.K),弹性模量352GPa。HfC在冷的盐酸、硫酸、磷酸，甚至于硫酸、磷酸与草酸的混合酸中都具有很高的稳定性，在沸腾的浓硫酸、草酸、稀硫酸与稀磷酸中稳定性也很好。HfC陶瓷的制备方法主要包括：Hf和C直接化合法、固相还原法、化学气相法、前驱体法等。前驱体法一般是指以Hf源化合物（如氯氧化铪、乙酰丙酮铪等）、C源化合物（如酚醛树脂等）的混合物为原料，在高温下反应制备得到HfC陶瓷的方法。或采用含氯的铪化合物（如环戊二烯氯化铪、四氯化铪等），经反应引人C=C键，通过交联得到碳铪聚合物，在高温下热解得到陶瓷。SJ用于制备HfC陶瓷粉体、HfC陶瓷纤维、H[C复合材料等。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to polymer or mixture whose pyrolysis product is HfC ceramics. The density of HfC is 12.67g/cmS, the melting point is 3890 ° C, the coefficient of thermal expansion is (659 ± 0.04) X10-6 ° C -, the thermal conductivity is 20.1W/(m.K), and the elastic modulus is 352GPa. HfC exhibits high stability in cold hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid, phosphoric acid, and even mixed acids of sulfuric acid, phosphoric acid, and oxalic acid. It also exhibits good stability in boiling concentrated sulfuric acid, oxalic acid, dilute sulfuric acid, and dilute phosphoric acid. The preparation methods of HfC ceramics mainly include: direct Hf and C method, solid phase reduction method, chemical vapor phase method, precursor method, etc. Precursor method generally refers to the method of preparing HfC ceramics from mixtures of Hf source compounds (such as hafnium oxychloride, acetylacetone hafnium, etc.) and C source compounds (such as phenolic resin, etc.) under high temperature. Or use chlorine containing hafnium compounds (such as cyclopentadiene hafnium chloride, hafnium tetrachloride, etc.), introduce C=C bond through reaction, obtain carbon hafnium polymer through crosslinking, and obtain ceramics by pyrolysis at high temperature. SJ is used to prepare HfC ceramics powder, HfC ceramics fiber, H [C composite materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 一种耐超高温抗烧蚀涂层材料。常采用化学气相沉积法，以四氯化铪为反应源气，以甲烷或者丙烷气体为碳源.用氩作载气，在1100-160CTC环境下发生炭化反应而制得。该陶瓷涂层熔点3890°C,是已知单一化合物熔点最高者，密度12.7g/cm3,热膨胀系数6.73X10-化学稳定性好，耐烧蚀和高温热冲击，抗氧化能力强.适用于火箭喷嘴和鼻锥等航空航天领域的高温部件，以改善其抗氧化烧蚀性能。
explanation_en: The invention relates to an ultra-high temperature and ablation resistant coating materials. It is usually prepared by chemical vapor deposition with hafnium tetrachloride as the reaction source gas, methane or propane as the carbon source, argon as the carrier gas, and carbonization reaction under 1100-160CTC environment. This ceramics coating has a melting point of 3890 ° C, which is the highest melting point of a single compound known. Its density is 12.7g/cm3, and its thermal expansion coefficient is 6.73X10. It has good chemical stability, resistance to ablation and high temperature thermal shock, and strong antioxidant capacity. It is suitable for high-temperature components in the aerospace field such as rocket nozzles and nose cones, to improve their antioxidant ablation performance.

explanation_cn: 是一种具有抗高温氧化的硬质合金，耐汽蚀性能良好。主成分为可以加入WC抑制晶粒长大，避免大晶粒造成的强度降低。其热膨胀系数较大，接近不锈钢。常用真空气氛烧结，使碳化铬与不锈钢基体黏结成一个整体，制得硬质合金、不锈钢复合零件。它的主要用途是石油化I:高温抗腐件，如密封环与反应塔部件、高温喷嘴、热挤压模、双曲固玻璃成形膜、抗汽蚀部件等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of hardmetal with high temperalure oxidation resistance and good cavitation resistance. The main component is that WC can be added to inhibit grain growth and avoid strength reduction caused by large grains. Its coefficient of thermal expansion is large, close to that of stainless steel. The hardmetal and stainless steel composition parts are made by sintering in vacuum atmosphere to bond chromium carbide and stainless steel matrix as a whole. It is mainly used for petrochemical I: high-temperature corrosion resistant parts, such as sealing ring and reactor parts, high-temperature nozzle, hot extrusion die, hyperbolic solid glass forming film, cavitation resistant parts, etc.

explanation_cn: 一般是指热解产物为ZrC陶瓷的聚合物或混合物。ZrC的溶点为3540°C，密6.66g/cm3，不溶于盐酸，但溶于硝酸。ZrC陶瓷的制备方法主要包括：Zr和C直接化合法、碳热还原法、化学气相法、前驱体法等。前驱体法一般是指以C源化合物（如酚醛树脂等）的混合物为原料.在高温下反应制备得到ZrC陶瓷的方法。或采用含氯的锆化合物（如环戊二烯氯化锆、四氯化锆等），经反应引入C=C键，通过交联得到碳锆聚合物，在高温下热解得到ZrC陶瓷。可用于制备ZrC陶瓷粉体、ZrC复合材料等。现已有报道采用聚锆氧烷PNZ为锆源，该前驱体经1600°C热解能够转化为高度结晶的ZrC陶瓷。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to polymer or mixture whose pyrolysis product is ZrC ceramics. The melting point of ZrC is 3540 ° C, with a density of 6.66g/cm3. It is insoluble in hydrochloric acid but soluble in nitric acid. The preparation methods of ZrC ceramics mainly include: Zr and C direct method, carbothermal reduction method, chemical vapor phase method, precursor method, etc. The precursor method generally refers to the method of preparing ZrC ceramics from the mixture of C source compounds (such as phenolic resin, etc.) under high temperature. Or use chlorine containing zirconium compounds (such as cyclopentadiene zirconium chloride, zirconium tetrachloride, etc.), introduce C=C bond through reaction, obtain carbon zirconium polymer through crosslinking, and obtain ZrC ceramics by pyrolysis at high temperature. It can be used to prepare ZrC ceramic powders, ZrC composite materials, etc. It has been reported that PNZ is used as zirconium source, and the precursor can be transformed into highly crystalline ZrC ceramics after pyrolysis at 1600 ° C.

explanation_cn: 超高温碳化物涂层的一种。ZrC涂层的制备方法主要有热蒸镀、脉冲激光沉积、磁场濉射和化学气相沉积等。碳化锆密度为6.7g/cm3,熔点3380°C，在700°C氧化环境中生成氧化锆，该涂层具有优异的高温力学稳定性、抗高速气流冲刷性、抗烧蚀性、抗热震性和化学稳定性。碳化锆涂层能够适应超高音速飞行、大气层冉人、跨大气层飞行和火箭推进系统等极端环境，吋用于飞行器鼻锥、机翼前缘、发动机热端等各种关键部位或部件。
explanation_en: A kind of ultra-high temperature carbide coating. The preparation methods of ZrC coating mainly include thermal evaporation, pulsed laser deposition, magnetic field injection and chemical vapor deposition. The density of zirconium carbide is 6.7g/cm3, and its melting point is 3380 ° C. Zirconia is generated in an oxidizing environment at 700 ° C. This coating has excellent high temperature mechanical stability, high-speed airflow erosion resistance, ablation resistance resistance, thermal shock resistance resistance, and chemical stability. Zirconium carbide coating can adapt to extreme environments such as hypersonic flight, atmospheric flight, trans atmospheric flight and rocket propulsion system, and is used in various key parts or components such as aircraft nose cone, wing leading edge, engine hot end, etc.

explanation_cn: 用作通电发热体或高频感应加热用的炭材料.主要包括人造石墨、碳纤维增强碳基复合材料和大塑石墨化炉2500°C以上用作发热材料的焦炭。
explanation_en: Carbon materials used for electrified heating or high-frequency induction heating mainly include artificial graphite, carbon fiber reinforced carbon matrix composites and coke used as heating materials in large plastic graphitization furnaces above 2500 ° C.

explanation_cn: 碳同位素除碳12(98.90%)和碳13(1.10%)外，还有放射性同位素碳10、碳11、碳14和碳15。碳12被选作原子量的基准.一个碳12原子质量的1/12为一个原子质量单位。因为只有碳12有核自旋.故可通过核磁共振吸收来确定有机化合物的结构。碳14(半衰期5730年）被广泛用作示踪剂。
explanation_en: In addition to carbon 12 (98.90%) and carbon 13 (1.10%), there are also radioactive isotopes carbon 10, carbon 11, carbon 14 and carbon 15 in carbon isotope. Carbon 12 is selected as the benchmark for atomic weight. 1/12 of the atomic mass of a carbon 12 is a unit of atomic mass. Because only carbon 12 has nuclear spin, the structure of organic compounds can be determined by nuclear magnetic resonance absorption. Carbon 14 (half life 5730 years) is widely used as a tracer.

explanation_cn: 仅由碳原子组成但具有不同结构的同相物质的总称.以前主要包括金刚石、石墨、卡宾。随着科学的进步，近年来发现的能够稳定存在的富勒烯、碳纳米管和石墨晞也被认为是碳同素异形体。
explanation_en: A general term for in-phase materials consisting only of carbon atoms but with different structures. Previously, they mainly included diamond, graphite and carbene. With the progress of science, fullerene, carbon nanotube and graphite discovered in recent years that can exist stably are also considered as carbon allotrope.

explanation_cn: 以碳纤维（织物）或碳化硅等陶瓷纤维（织物）为增强体，以碳为基体的复合材料的总称。碳基复合材料有两种制备方法：一种是浸渍法，即用增强体浸溃熔融的石油或煤沥青，再经炭化和石墨处理，它的基体是碳石墨，呈层状条带结构，性能是各向异性的。还有用增强体浸溃糠醇或酚醛等热固性树脂，只经炭化处理.它的基体是玻璃碳，即无定形碳结构，性能是各向同性的。另一种是CVD法，即把烃类化合物的热解碳沉积在增强体上来进行复合，这种方法的碳基体是类似玻璃碳的热解碳。碳/碳复合材料不耐氧化，所以有时需要加抗氧化涂层。碳基复合材料在航天航空技术中广泛应用的是碳/碳复合材料，碳/碳复合材料目前在国外已经被公认是高级再人飞行器鼻锥和固体火箭发动机喷管等关键部位最理想的耐烧蚀、防热材料，也用作飞机的刹车片。
explanation_en: The general term of composite materials with carbon fiber (fabric) or ceramics fiber (fabric) such as silicon carbide as reinforcement and carbon as matrix. There are two preparation methods for carbon matrix composite: one is the impregnation method, that is, the molten petroleum or coal pitch is soaked with reinforcements, and then treated with carbonization and graphite. Its matrix is carbon graphite, which is in a layered strip structure, and its performance is anisotropic. There are also reinforcements impregnated with thermosetting resin such as furfuryl alcohol or phenolic aldehyde, which are only carbonization. Its matrix is glass-like carbon, that is, amorphous carbon structure, and its properties are isotropic. The other is the CVD method, that is, the pyrolytic carbon of hydrocarbon compounds is deposited on the reinforcement for composition. The carbon matrix of this method is pyrolytic carbon similar to glass-like carbon. Carbon/carbon composhes are not resistant to oxidation, so sometimes anti-oxidation coating is required. Carbon matrix composite is widely used in aerospace technology as carbon/carbon composhes. At present, carbon/carbon composhes has been recognized abroad as the most ideal ablation resistant and heat resistant materials for key parts such as nose cone of advanced reentry vehicle and nozzle of solid rocket motor, and also used as brake pad of aircraft.

explanation_cn: 用于电气铁路机车上部与架设在轨道上的导线接触的部件,起到把外部电流导给电动机车上的电动机的作用。
explanation_en: The component used for the contact between the upper part of an electric railway locomotive and the wires installed on the track, which serves to guide external current to the electric motor on the electric locomotive.

explanation_cn: 电弧焊的一种。利用碳棒或石墨棒与工件之间形成的电弧作为热源进行焊接的方法。电源为直流弧焊发电机或弧焊整流器，采用直流正接，焊接时视需要可加或不加填充金属。可用于焊接钢、铸铁、有色金属等。也可用于表面堆焊。由于保护效果差，只适用于要求不严格的场合.如一般低碳钢容器的焊接。双极碳弧焊是一种变化形式.双极电弧焊枪中电弧在两个碳棒之间形成，工件不是电路的一部分。碳弧焊可用于堆焊、钎焊，但主要用于堆焊和维修工作。通常采用小电流，只要能保证填充金属在工件上的自由流动即可
explanation_en: A type of arc welding. The method of weld with the arc formed between the carbon rod or graphite rod and the workpiece as the heat source.
