The power source is DC arc welding generator or arc welding rectifier, which adopts DC positive connection. When weld, filler metal can be added or not added as required. It can be used for weld steel, cast iron, nonferrous metals, etc. It can also be used for surface overlaying. Due to poor protection effect, it is only applicable to occasions with less strict requirements, such as weld of general low-carbon steel vessels. Bipolar carbon arc welding is a form of variation. In a bipolar arc welding gun, the arc is formed between two carbon rods, and the workpiece is not part of the circuit. Carbon are welding can be used for overlaying and soldering, but it is mainly used for overlaying and repair work. Usually, a small current is used, as long as it can ensure the free flow of the filler metal on the workpiece

explanation_cn: 焊接碳当量：焊接碳当量是将相关合金元素对钢材焊接性能的影响等效为碳含量的影响，通常用于评估钢材的焊接性能。低碳钢和低合金钢中，常用的焊接碳当量计算公式为：C_eq(%) = C + Mn/6 + (Cr+Mo+V)/5 + (Cu+Ni)/15。碳当量的数值越高，钢材的淬硬倾向越大，从而焊接时产生焊接裂纹的风险也增大。碳当量的计算可用于预测焊接性能，并决定是否需要采取预热或其他适当的工艺措施，以确保焊接过程顺利进行。铸铁碳当量：铸铁碳当量是将相关合金元素对铁碳共晶成分的影响等效为碳含量的影响，以评估铸铁的流动性和铸造工艺性能。对于合金元素含量较低的铸铁，计算碳当量的常用公式为：CE(%) = C + (Si+P)/3。当碳当量接近共晶碳含量时，铁水具有最佳的流动性。
explanation_en: Weld carbon equivalent: weld carbon equivalent refers to the effect of relevant alloy elements on weld performance of steel product equivalent to the effect of carbon content, which is usually used to evaluate weld performance of steel product. In low-cardon steel and low alloy steel, the commonly used calculation formula of weld carbon equivalent is: C_ Eq (%)=C+Mn/6+(Cr+Mo+V)/5+(Cu+Ni)/15. The higher the value of carbon equivalent, the greater the hardening tendency of steel product, and thus the risk of weld cracks during weld is also increased. The calculation of carbon equivalent can be used to predict weld performance and decide whether preheating or other appropriate process measures are required to ensure the smooth progress of weld process. Cast iron carbon equivalent: cast iron carbon equivalent is equivalent to the influence of relevant alloy elements on iron carbon eutectic composition as the influence of carbon content to evaluate the flow ability and foundry process performance of cast iron. For cast iron with low alloy element content, the common formula for calculating carbon equivalent is: CE (%)=C+(Si+P)/3. When carbon equivalent is close to eutectic carbon content, molten iron has the best flow ability.

explanation_cn: 粒径1到1000微米球形炭材料的总称，也包括中空结构微球。多数是以树脂、焦沥青等为原料，经过成球过程后炭化而得到。
explanation_en: The general term of spherical carbon materials with a particle size of 1 to 1000 microns, including hollow microsphere. Most of them are made from resin, tar pitch and other raw materials through carbonization after pelletizing process.

explanation_cn: 由碳原子组成的具有不同结构与性质的同素异形体，例如三维金刚石晶体、二维石墨层片、一维碳纳米管、零维富勒烯分子等，它们在硬度、光学特性、耐热性、耐辐射特性、耐化学药品特性、电绝缘性、导电性、表面与界面特性等方面具有比其他材料更为优异的性能。
explanation_en: Allotropes composed of carbon atoms with different structures and properties, such as three-dimensional diamond crystal, two-dimensional graphite laminates, one-dimensional carbon nanotube, zero dimensional fullerenes, etc., have better performance than other materials in hardness, optical properties, heat resistance, radiation resistance, chemical resistance, electrical insulation, conductivity, surface and interface properties, etc.

explanation_cn: 由碳纳米颗粒相互连接而成的多孔炭材料，其〒维网络结构内部富含中孔。通常利用溶胶凝胶反应合成有机凝胶.经干燥(一般是二氧化碳超临界干燥）去除凝胶内部的溶剂而成为有机气凝胶，再经炭化后得到。
explanation_en: The porous carbon materials, which is made of carbon nanoparticle, is rich in mesopores in its "dimensional network structure". Usually, the sol gel reaction is used to synthesize organic gel. After drying (usually carbon dioxide supercritical drying), the solvent inside the gel is removed to become an organic aero gel, which is obtained after carbonization.

explanation_cn: 用于对碳氢化合物氧化催化的材料。主要应用于汽车尾气处理和石油化工方面。汽车尾气处理方面的氧化催化材料主要有销、铑和钯等贵金属，HC氧化反应遵循Lamgmuir-Hinshelwood机理即两个反应物先吸附在固体催化材料L.在表面上反应?产物再脱附，对于HC氧化，含Pt催化材料表现出较好的起燃特性，少量的Pt的存在对苺催化材料起到明显促进作用，随着催化材料活性组分含量增加起燃温度降丨低；随着HC浓度增大，起燃温度升高。
explanation_en: Materials used to catalyze the oxidation of hydrocarbons. Mainly used in automotive exhaust treatment and petrochemical industry. The oxidation catalytic materials for automobile exhaust treatment mainly include precious metals such as pins, rhodium and palladium. The HC oxidation reaction follows the Lamgmuir Hinshelwood mechanism, that is, the two reactants are adsorbed on the solid catalytic materials first, and react on the surface? When the product is re desorption, for the oxidation of HC, the Pt containing catalytic materials shows good light off characteristics. The presence of a small amount of Pt significantly promotes the strawberry catalytic materials, and the light off temperature decreases with the increase of the active component content of the catalytic materials; As the HC concentration increases, the ignition temperature increases.

explanation_cn: 向低碳钢表层同时渗入碳和氮元素，并以渗碳为主而强化表层的化学热处理工艺。常采用气体碳氮共渗方法，共渗温度在800?870°C,共渗时间为数小时，表层碳含量大于0.6%,氮含量为0.1%-0.5%，渗层深度一般为0.2-1mm。碳氮共渗零件兼具氮化表面硬度高和渗碳的渗层较深的优点，具有优良的耐磨性、耐蚀性和较高的强度与抗疲劳性能。同时，由于共渗温度低于渗碳温度，基体晶粒较细，共渗后可直接淬火。
explanation_en: It is a thermo-chemical treatment process in which carbon and nitrogen elements are simultaneously infiltrated into the surface layer of low carbon steel, and the surface layer is strengthened mainly by carburizing. Gas carbon nitrogen co infiltration method is often used, with a co infiltration temperature of 800? At 870 ° C, the co infiltration time is several hours, the surface carbon content is greater than 0.6%, the nitrogen content is 0.1% -0.5%, and the depth of the infiltration layer is generally 0.2-1mm. Carbonitriding parts have the advantages of high hardness of nitriding surface and deep carburizing layer of carburizing, and have excellent wear resistance, corrosion resistance, high strength and fatigue resistance. At the same time, the matrix grain is fine because the co cementation temperature is lower than the carburizing temperature, and can be directly quenching after co cementation.

explanation_cn: 用碳氮化物做主要硬质相，与黏结金属组成的硬质合金。
explanation_en: A hardmetal consisting of carbonitride as the main hard phase and bonding metal.

name_cn: 碳氮化硅纤维增强碳化硅基复合材料
name_en: SiCN fiber reinforced silicon carbide matrix composite
explanation_cn: 纤维增强陶瓷基复合材料中的一种，指以碳氮化硅纤维为增强体、碳化硅为基体制备的复合材料。目前SiCN纤维仍处于研究中，碳氮化硅纤维强化的碳化硅基复合材料也在研究中。
explanation_en: One of fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite refers to composite materials prepared with carbon silicon nitride fiber as reinforcement and silicon carbide as matrix. At present, SiCN fiber is still under research, and silicon nitride fiber reinforced silicon carbide matrix composite materials is also under research.

explanation_cn: 作为生物医用材料的碳涂层.常用的有利用碳氢化合物热解沉积于金属表面的低温各向同性（LT1)碳涂层，以及气相沉积于聚氯乙烯、聚酯、尼龙等高分子薄膜上的超低温各向同性（ULTI)碳涂层。LTI和ULTI具有乱层结构，其相对密度为1.4?2.1。高密度的LTI和ULTI碳保持小于20GPa的弹性模量，从而具有良好的韧性，断裂能可达5.5Mj/m3.约为氧化铝陶瓷的25倍，即使应变达到2%左右.仍不会发生破裂.ULTI碳涂层甚至在应变大于5%吋仍能保持完好。碳涂层还具有其他优点：如耐磨性十分好.可承受局部甚至点负荷的作用；抗疲劳性能优越，在周期负荷下的强度同于单次负荷下的强度。碳涂层的生物相容性良好，特别是血液相容性十分优良，其表面具有良好的抗凝血性，对血浆蛋甴和血浆酶的活性无影响.与良好的力学性能配合，使其成为重要的心血管系统修复材料.几乎所有常用的人工心脏瓣膜的W寒体和瓣架都使用了LT1碳涂层，此外.碳涂层还可用于肌肉-骨骼系统和其他软组织修复材料。
explanation_en: As a carbon coating for biomedical materials, the commonly used carbon coatings are low temperature isotropic (LT1) carbon coatings deposited on metal surfaces by pyrolysis of hydrocarbons, and ultra low temperature isotropic (ULTI) carbon coatings deposited on macromolecule films such as polyvinyl chloride, polyester, nylon resin, etc. by vapor deposition. LTI and ULTI have turbostratic structure, and their relative density is 1.4? 2.1. High density LTI and ULTI carbon maintain a elastic modulus of less than 20GPa, so they have good toughness. The fracture energy can reach 5.5 Mj/m3, which is about 25 times that of alumina ceramics. Even if the strain reaches about 2%, there will be no fracture. ULTI carbon coating can remain intact even when the strain is greater than 5%. The carbon coating also has other advantages: for example, its wear resistance is very good, and it can bear local or even point loads; Excellent fatigue resistance, with the same strength under cyclic loads as under single loads. The biocompatibility of the carbon coating is good, especially the Wood compatibility is very good. Its surface has good anticoagulation, and has no effect on the plasma egg and the activity of plasma enzymes. In combination with good mechanical properties, it has become an important materials for repairing the cardiovascular system. Almost all commonly used W cold bodies and valve racks of artificial heart valve use LT1 carbon coating, In addition, carbon coating can also be used for musculoskeletal system and other repairing materials of soft tissue.

explanation_cn: 适合于制作各种工具、模具的非合金钢，在钢号前加T表示碳素工具钢（GB/T1298-2008)。根据冶金质量可分为优丨质碳素X具钢和特殊质量碳素工具钢。碳素T.具钢的碳含量较高，属于共析或过共析钢，可加入0.5%左右的锰以提高淬透性（但仍归类于非合金钢）。淬火加低温冋火处理后工件表面具有很高的强度、硬度和耐磨性.具有良好的冷热加工性能.价格低廉.因而应用较为广泛。但由于淬透性较差，一般只用于制作尺寸较小、工作温度不高（一般低于200°C)的小型工具和模具。
explanation_en: Non-alloy steel suitable for making various tools and moulds. T is added before steel designation to indicate carbon tool steel (GB/T1298-2008). According to metallurgical quality, it can be divided into high-quality carbon X steel and special quality carbon tool steel. Carbon T. steel has a high carbon content and belongs to eutectoid or hypereutectoid steel steel. About 0.5% manganese can be added to improve hardenabilhy (but it is still classified as non-alloy steel). After quenching and low-temperature annealing treatment, the workpiece surface has high strength, hardness and wear resistance. It has good cold and hot workability and low price, so it is widely used. However, due to poor hardenabilhy, it is generally only used to make small tools and molds with small size and low working temperature (generally below 200 ° C).

explanation_cn: 用于制作工程结构件及机械零件的非合金钢，一般为低碳钢.机械制造用也包括部分中碳钢甚至高碳钢。普通碳素结构钢（GB/TKI0-2006)为低碳钢，广泛用于直接制作各种1:程结构件，采用性能钢号，主要按强度和质量等级供货，字母Q后加屈服强度数值（包括195、215、235和275MPa级别），必要时再加质量等级符号（按英文字母顺序，A为普通.B为保证20°C冲击钿性，C为保证0°C冲击钿性，I)为保证-20°C冲击韧性）；优质碳素结构钢（GB/T699-1999)采用成分钢号，可用于制作各种T.程结构件，也可用于制造各种需经热处理的机械结构件。
explanation_en: The non-alloy steel used to make engineering structural parts and mechanical parts is generally low-cardon steel. Mechanical manufacturing also includes some medium carbon steel and even high carbon steel. Ordinary carbon structural steel (GB/TKI0-2006) is low carbon steel, which is widely used to directly produce various 1: way structural parts. Performance steel designation is used, which is mainly supplied according to strength and quality grade. The letter Q is followed by yield strength values (including 195, 215, 235 and 275MPa grades), If necessary, add quality grade symbols (in English alphabetical order, A is ordinary. B is to ensure 20 ° C impact resistance, C is to ensure 0 ° C impact resistance, and I) is to ensure -20 ° C impact toughness); High quality carbon structural steel (GB/T699-1999) is made of steel designation, which can be used to manufacture various T structural parts, as well as various mechanical structural parts requiring heat treatment.

name_cn: 碳纤维增强医用高分子复合材料
explanation_cn: 作为增强体的碳纤维与医用高分子复合形成的一类生物医学复合材料，是最早发展的一类模拟自然组织结构的医用复合材料，主要用于聚甲基；丙烯酸甲酯（PMMA)骨水泥、人工关节臼和接骨：板等。例如?通过热解碳纤维无规则地分布于超高分子量聚乙烯基体中所形成的复合材料.强度和刚性随纤维含量增加而提高，当碳纤维体积含量达10%-15%时.其强度、刚性、抗疲劳和抗摩擦性能均显著地高于基材聚乙烯.主要用于制作承受复杂应力和摩擦力作用的髋关节臼和膝关节；用石墨和碳纤维增强PMMA骨水泥，可分别提高其抗拉强度和弹性模量50%和10%,并使其抗疲劳和抗蠕变性能也大大提髙，同时，聚合温度可降低近已试用于临床；HI石墨增强树脂接骨板，通过调整纤维含tt.可使其弹性模i：接近于自然骨.避免因弹性失配造成的应力屏蔽效应.同时抗蠕变性能亦得到改善：丨丨丨碳纤维增强聚乳酸的内接骨板植人体内后.随着聚乳酸被逐步降解吸收，其刚度和刚性也随之降低.同时新骨同步生长，逐步康复，不仅避免了应力屏蔽效应，而且也不需做第二次手术取出。此外.将碳纤维在聚乳酸中定向排列而制成的人r肌腱和韧带.植人体内后.胶原将随聚乳酸逐步降解吸收而沿碳纤维定向沉积.形成新的类肌腱和类韧带组织。
explanation_en: A kind of biomedical composite materials formed by composition of carbon fiber and medical macromolecule as reinforcement is the earliest medical composite materials simulating natural tissue structure, mainly used for polymethyl; Methyl acrylate (PMMA) bone cemem, artificial joint mortar and bone plate. For example? The strength and rigidity of the composite materials formed by pyrolytic carbon fibers randomly distributed in the ultra high molecular weight polyethylene matrix increase with the increase of fiber content. When the volume content of carbon fibers reaches 10% -15%, its strength, rigidity, fatigue resistance and friction resistance are significantly higher than that of the base material polyethylene. It is mainly used to make hip joint acetabulum and knee joint under complex stress and friction; With graphite and carbon fiber reinforced PMMA bone cemem, its tensile strength and elastic modulus can be increased by 50% and 10% respectively, and its fatigue resistance and creep resistance can also be greatly improved. At the same time, the polymerization temperature can be reduced, which has been used in clinical trials recently; HI graphite reinforced resin internal fixation plate can make its elasticity modulus close to natural bone by adjusting the fiber content of tt. It can avoid the stress shielding effect caused by elasticity mismatch. At the same time, the creep resistance can also be improved: After the carbon fiber reinforced PLA internal bone plate is implanted into the body, its stiffness and rigidity will also be reduced as the PLA is gradually degradation and absorbed. At the same time, new bone will grow synchronously and gradually recover, not only avoiding the stress shielding effect, And there is no need for a second surgery to remove it. In addition, human r tendons and ligaments made of carbon fibers arranged directionally in polylactic acid. After being implanted into the body, collagen will gradually degradation and absorb with polylactic acid and deposit directionally along the carbon fibers, forming new tendon like and ligament like tissues.

name_cn: 碳纤维增强硼化铪基复合材料
name_en: carbon fiber reinforced hafnium boride matrix composite
explanation_cn: 纤维增强超高温陶瓷基复合材料中的一种.增强相为碳纤维.基体为硼化铪。复合材料制备包括纤维预制体制备、界面相沉积、基体致密化以及涂层制备。Hfli基体可通过HfCU、BC13、气体经化学气相沉积工艺制备，也可通过浸溃含Hfli的浆料引人。硼化物基体氧化产物B2()3高温时会大量挥发.抗氧化性较差，常通过引人碳化硅等来提高其高温抗氧化性能。主要应用于2000°C以上的超高温环境中。
explanation_en: One of fiber reinforced ultra high temperature ceramic matrix composite. The reinforcing phase is carbon fiber, and the matrix is hafnium boride. The preparation of composite materials includes fiber prefabrication, interfacial phase deposition, matrix densification and coating preparation. Hfli matrix can be prepared by HfCU, BC13, gas through chemical vapor deposition process, or it can be introduced by soaking slurry containing Hfli. The oxidation product B2 () 3 of boride matrix will evaporate in large quantities at high temperatures, and its oxidation resistance is poor. It is often improved by introducing silicon carbide and other additives to improve its high-temperature oxidation resistance. Mainly used in ultra-high temperature environments above 2000 ° C.

name_cn: 碳纤维增强硼化锆基复合材料
name_en: carbon fiber reinforced zirconium boride matrix composite
explanation_cn: 粒径1到1000微米球形炭材料的总称，也包括中空结构微球。多数是以树脂、焦沥青等为原料，经过成球过程后炭化而得到。
explanation_en: The general term of spherical carbon materials with a particle size of 1 to 1000 microns, including hollow microsphere. Most of them are made from resin, tar pitch and other raw materials through carbonization after pelletizing process.

name_cn: 碳纤维增强碳化铪基复合材料
name_en: carbon fiber reinforced hafnium carbide matrix composite
explanation_cn: 又称Cf/HFC,纤维增强超高温陶瓷基复合材料中的一种，增强相为碳纤维.基体为碳化铪。复合材料制备包括纤维预制体制备、界面相沉积、基体致密化以及涂层制备。HfC基体可通过HfCl4、CH4、H2和Ar气体经化学气相沉积工艺，也可通过铪系合金反应熔渗制备。HfC的有机前驱体较少且价格较贵，利用有机前驱体浸渍-热解T.艺制备碳纤维增强碳化铪基复合j材料的研究相对较少。Cf/HfC复合材料主要应用于2000°C以上的超高温环境中。
explanation_en: Also known as Cf/HFC, it is one of fiber reinforced ultra high temperature ceramic matrix composite. The reinforcing phase is carbon fiber. The matrix is carbonization hafnium. The preparation of composite materials includes fiber prefabrication, interfacial phase deposition, matrix densification and coating preparation. HfC matrix can be prepared by chemical vapor deposition of HfCl4, CH4, H2 and Ar gas, or by reactive infiltration of hafnium alloy. The organic precursors of HfC are few and expensive, and the research on the preparation of carbon fiber reinforced carbonization hafnium based composition j materials using the organic precursor impregnation pyrolysis T. process is relatively few. Cf/HfC composite materials are mainly used in ultra-high temperature environments above 2000 ° C.

name_cn: 碳纤维增强碳化锆基复合材料
name_en: carbon fiber reinforced zirconium carbide matrix composite
explanation_cn: 又称Cf/ZrC,纤维增强超高温陶瓷基复合材料中的一种，增强相为碳纤维，基体为碳化锆。复合材料制备包括纤维预制体制备、界面相沉积、基体致密化以及涂层制备。ZrC基体可利用化学气相沉积、锆系合金反应熔渗和碳化锆有机前驱体浸渍热解制备。主要应用于2000°C以上的超高温环境中。
explanation_en: Also called Cf/ZrC, it is one of the fiber reinforced ultra high temperature ceramic matrix composite. The reinforcing phase is carbon fiber, and the matrix is zirconium carbide. The preparation of composite materials includes fiber prefabrication, interfacial phase deposition, matrix densification and coating preparation. ZrC matrix can be prepared by chemical vapor deposition, reactive infiltration of zirconium alloy and impregnation pyrolysis of zirconium carbide organic precursor. Mainly used in ultra-high temperature environments above 2000 ° C.

explanation_cn: 是通过在一个碳纳米管中形成不同导电性的两个或多个部分而产生具有二极管特性的碳纳米管。通常通过引人缺陷或产生具有不同电性能的五元环（金属性）-七元环（半导体性）对而形成结节面，致使整根碳管呈现出二极管特性。
explanation_en: It is through forming two or more parts with different conductivity in a carbon nanotube to produce carbon nanotube with diode characteristics. Usually, a nodular surface is formed by introducing defects or producing a five membered ring (metallic) to seven membered ring (semiconductor) pair with different electrical properties, resulting in the entire carbon tube exhibiting diode characteristics.

explanation_cn: 为了获得特定性能而对碳纳米管进行的各种化学方法、机械方法（粉碎、研磨）或包覆、填充等处理。在碳纳米管复合物的研究中，表面修饰可以改善碳纳米管的分散性能、改进其与基体的相容性和湿润性、增加与基体的接合面、提高材料的界面结合能和整体力学强度。
explanation_en: Various chemical methods, mechanical methods (crushing, grinding) or coating, filling and other treatments for carbon nanotube to obtain specific properties. In the study of carbon nanotube composites, surface modification can improve the dispersion of carbon nanotube, improve its compatibility and wettability with matrix, increase the interface with matrix, and improve the interface cohesive energy and overall mechanical strength of materials.

explanation_cn: 采用碳纳米管作为复合材料的纤维增强体。碳纳米管是由单层或多层石墨片层卷曲而成的典型一维纳米材料，力学性能优异，如单壁碳纳米管的轴向力学性质接近完美石墨片层的理论值。用其作为复合材料的纤维增强体表现出极好的强度、弹性、抗疲劳性以及各向同性。
explanation_en: Carbon nanotube were used as the fiber reinforcement of composite materials. Carbon nanotube are typical one-dimensional nanomaterials made of single-layer or multi-layer graphite sheets, with excellent mechanical properties. For example, the axial mechanical properties of single-walled carbon nanotube are close to the theoretical values of perfect graphite sheets. As the fiber reinforcement of composite materials, it shows excellent strength, elasticity, fatigue resistance and isotropy.

explanation_cn: 指碳纳米管与其它纳米线、纳米管组成的异质结构，也指单壁碳纳米管中由于缺陷产生的界面结构。这些异质结构使碳纳米管产生独特的电性能和光学性能。如由五元环-七元环对的存在使碳管产生不同的晶体走向和晶体界面，而使不同晶体走向分别呈现出金属性与半导体性，致使整根碳管呈现出单向导电特性。
explanation_en: It refers to the heterostructure of carbon nanotube with other nanowires and nanotube, and also refers to the interface structure of single-walled carbon nanotube due to defects. These heterostructures enable carbon nanotube to produce unique electrical and optical properties. For example, the existence of the five membered ring seven membered ring pair makes the carbon tube produce different crystal orientations and crystal interfaces, and makes the different crystal orientations present metallicity and semiconductivity respectively, resulting in the unidirectional conductivity of the entire carbon tube.

explanation_cn: 由多壁碳纳米管或单壁碳纳米管组成，通过纺丝或手动抽拉等方法制备的纤维。一般直径可控在5-10(Vm或更长。虽然单根管的力学性能超过常规碳纤维，但碳纳米管纤维由于管间结合较弱，其性能尚需进一步优化。
explanation_en: The fiber is composed of multi walled carbon nanotube or single walled carbon nanotube and is prepared by spinning or manual drawing. Generally, the diameter can be controlled between 5-10 (Vm or longer. Although the mechanical properties of a single tube are better than those of conventional carbon fibers, the properties of carbon nanotube fiber need to be further optimized due to the weak combination between tubes.

explanation_cn: 是指有多壁碳纳米管或单壁碳纳米管组成薄膜状材料。多壁管膜可以用作显示器、热传导材料、热电材料、电极材料等。半导体性单壁管膜可以构建场效应晶体管及相关器件。
explanation_en: It refers to the thin film material composed of multi walled carbon nanotube or single walled carbon nanotube. Multi wall tube film can be used as display, heat conduction materials, thermoelectric materials, electrode materials, etc. Semiconductor single-walled tube films can be used to construct field-effect transistors and related devices.

explanation_cn: 一类碳酸盐类矿物（方解石、白云石及铁白云石、菱铁矿、菱镁矿）含量超过50%的火成岩。按化学成分.可划分为钙质碳酸岩、镁质碳酸岩和铁质碳酸岩；按主要矿物成分，可划分为方解石碳酸岩、内云石碳酸岩和铁质碳酸岩。岩石多呈浅灰至灰白色；细粒-粗粒粒状结构，有时呈巨晶结构；常为块状构造.有时见原生条带、球粒和球体构造。与一般硅酸盐岩浆岩相比?这类岩石富Ca()及C()2,而贫Si()2及AWL;与沉积碳酸盐岩相比，富Si()2及Fe、Mg、Al、Ti、P等的氧化物.主要组成矿物为方解石、白云石及铁白云石，偶尔见菱铁矿。此外.还富含多种(180种左右）次要矿物和副矿物，如辉石类、金云母、磷灰石、天青石、铈族稀土氟碳酸盐矿物、磁铁矿、铌钽矿物、铀钍矿物、萤石、碳硅石等。多呈中心型侵人杂岩体产出，产状有岩株，环状、锥状及放射状岩墙，岩床、岩流及岩被等。形成及分布与深大断裂有关，与碱性岩-超基性杂岩体或金伯利岩共生。与之有关的矿产有铌、钽、稀土元素、磷.铁等。最为重要的矿床类型为稀土碳酸岩及烧绿石碳酸岩。世界著名的白云鄂博超大型稀土铁-磷矿床即与碳酸盐具有密切成因联系。
explanation_en: Igneous rocks containing more than 50% of the first class of carbonate minerals (caldte, dolomite, iron dolomite, siderite, magnesite). According to chemical composition, it can be divided into calcareous carbonate rock, magnesium carbonate rock and iron carbonate rock; According to the main mineral composition, it can be divided into caldte carbonate rock, dolomite carbonate rock and ferruginous carbonate rock. Rock is mostly light gray to gray white; Fine coarse grained structure, sometimes in the form of giant crystal structure; It is usually massive structure, and sometimes primary strip, spherulite and spherulite structures can be seen. Compared with ordinary silicate magmatic rocks? Such rock are rich in Ca () and C () 2, but poor in Si () 2 and AWL; Compared with sedimentary carbonatite, it is rich in Si () 2, Fe, Mg, Al, Ti, P and other oxides. The main minerals are caldte, dolomite and iron dolomite, and occasionally siderite. In addition, it is rich in a variety of (about 180 kinds) secondary minerals and accessory minerals, such as pyroxene, phlogopite, apatite, celestite, cerium rare earth fluorocarbonate minerals, magnetite, niobium tantalum minerals, uranium thorium minerals, fluorite, carborundum, etc. Most of them occur as central intrusive complexes, with occurrences such as rock stocks, circular, conical, and radial rock walls, rock beds, rock flows, and rock covers. The formation and distribution are related to the deep fracture and associated with alkaline rock ultrabasic complex or kimberite. Related minerals include niobium, tantalum, rare earth elements, phosphorus, iron, etc. The most important deposit types are rare earth carbonate rock and pyrochlore carbonate rock. The world-famous Bayan Obo super large rare earth iron phosphate deposit is closely related to carbonate genesis.

explanation_cn: 沉积形成的碳酸盐矿物含量超过50%的岩石的总称。主要矿物为方解石、白云石和铁白云石，其他非碳酸盐混人组分有石英、长石、云母和黏土矿物及重矿物。自生矿物有石英、海绿石、磷酸盐矿物、石膏等》常见结构有结晶粒状结构、鲕状结构、豆状结构、碎屑结构、生物结构等。按化学成分可划分为超高钙石灰岩)、高钙石灰岩、高纯碳酸盐岩和高镁白云岩碳酸盐岩中储集有丰富的石油、天然气和地下水，世界上碳酸盐岩型油气田储量占总储量的50%,占总产量的60%。与碳酸盐岩共生的固体矿产有石膏、岩盐、钾盐及汞、锑、铜、铅、i锌、银、镍、钴、铀、钒等
explanation_en: The general name of rock formed by sedimentation with more than 50% carbonate minerals. The main minerals are caldte, dolomite and iron dolomite. Other non carbonate mixed components include quartze, feldspar, mica, clay mineral and heavy minerals. Authigenic minerals include quartze, glauconite, phosphate mineral, gypsum, etc. Common structures include crystalline granular structure, oolitic structure, pisolitic structure, clastic structure, biological structure, etc. According to chemical composition, it can be divided into ultra-high calcium limestone, high calcium limestone, high-purity carbonatite rock and high magnesium dolomitite carbonatite. The reserves of carbonatite type oil and gas fields in the world account for 50% of the total reserves and 60% of the total production. Solid minerals associated with carbonatite include gypsum, rock salt, potassium salt, mercury, antimony, copper, lead, zinc, silver, nickel, cobalt, uranium, vanadium, etc

explanation_cn: 简单岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。化学式为Sr[C03],常有钙、钡代替锶，形成钙碳酸锶矿、钡碳酸锶矿变种。斜方晶系，空间群Dif,-Pmm。晶体呈柱状或针状。纯者白色，常染成灰、绿或褐色等。玻璃光泽。解理U10丨中等。莫氏硬度3,5?4,性脆，密度3.6?3.8g/cm3。在阴极射线下发弱浅蓝色荧光.有的加热发磷光。易溶于盐酸。主要产于低温热液阶段.呈脉状于石灰岩和泥灰岩中.与重晶石、碳酸钡矿、天青石、方解石等共生。是提取锶的矿物原料。
explanation_en: A carbonate mineral with a simple island like structure. The chemical formula is Sr [C03], and calcium and barium often replace strontium to form varieties of calcium strontium carbonate and barium strontium carbonate. Orthorhombic system, space group Dif, - Pmm. The crystal are columnar or needle shaped. Pure white, often dyed gray, green, or brown. Glass lustre. Cleavage U10 | Moderate. Mohs hardness 3,5? 4. Brittle, density 3.6? 3.8g/cm3. It emits weak light blue fluorescence under cathode ray, and some emits phosphorescence when heated. Easily soluble in hydrochloric acid. It is mainly produced in the low-temperature hydrothermal stage, in vein shape in limestone and marlstone, and coexists with barite, barium carbonate, celestite, caldte, etc. It is a raw mineral material for extracting strontium.

explanation_cn: 大分子主链完全由碳原子组成的合成纤维。碳链纤维主要有聚乙烯纤维(乙纶）、等规聚丙烯纤维（丙纶）、含氯纤维（聚氯乙烯及其共聚纤维）、聚丙烯腈纤维（腈纶）及改性聚丙烯腈纤维、聚乙烯醇缩甲醛纤维（维纶）和含氟纤维（聚四氟乙烯及其共聚物纤维）等。碳链高分子一般由不饱和碳氢化合物或其衍生物，经自由基链式反应聚合或离子型聚合，生成主链纯碳-碳键的高聚物。碳链纤维主要用于化学工业、建筑建材工业、农业、渔业等领域。
explanation_en: A synthetic fiber whose main chain of macromolecule is completely composed of carbon atoms. Carbon chain fiber mainly includes polyethylene fiber (ethylene fiber), isotactic polypropylene fiber (polypropylene fiber), chlorofiber (polyvinyl chloride and its copolymer fiber), polyacrylonitrile fiber (acrylic fiber) and modacrylic fiber, formalized polyvinyl alcohol fiber (vinylon fiber) and fluorofibrc (polylctrafluorocthylone and its copolymer fiber). Carbon chain macromolecule generally consist of unsaturated hydrocarbons or their derivatives, which are polymerization by free radical chain reaction or ionic polymerization to generate polymers with pure carbon carbon bond in the main chain. Carbon chain fiber is mainly used in chemical industry, building materials industry, agriculture, fishery and other fields.

Its microstructure is similar to artificial graphite, with a disorderly layer of graphite structure, and its carbon content is more than 90%, including similar structures obtained by chemical vapor deposition.

explanation_cn: 是一种干硬性贫水泥的混凝土。将硅酸盐水泥、火山灰质掺和料、水、外加剂、砂和分级控制的粗骨料拌制成无坍落度的干硬性混凝土.再经振动碾分层压实而成。

explanation_cn:
磁光光盘是一种可擦重写光盘，它使用热磁记录（擦除）和磁光效应来读取存储的数据。理想的磁光光盘存储材料需要具备多种性能特点：

1.磁化矢量垂直于膜面，具有大的各向异性常数Ku。
2.高矫顽力r，使磁滞回线矩形比接近1。
3.低的居里温度Tc（通常在250°C到300°C之间）。
4.大的磁光克尔效应或法拉第效应OF。
5.稳定的亚微米圆柱体磁畴。
6.能够保持数据稳定性并拥有长达10年以上的使用寿命。
7.MnBi是最早用于室温磁光存储的材料之一，它是一种金属间化合物，具有两个相：低温相（LPT）和高温冻结相（q-HTP），其中Tc为180°C，但它的结构不太稳定并容易向低温相转变。MnBi系多晶薄膜在读出时会产生较大的噪声。

稀土-过渡金属非晶态薄膜被广泛应用，这些薄膜通常是亚铁磁的，同时具有反铁磁耦合。通常会选择重稀土元素（如Tb、Gd、Dy）和过渡金属（如Co、Fe）。常见的材料包括ThFeCo、TbDyFeCo、TbGdFeCo等。这些非晶态薄膜没有晶界噪声，但它们的抗腐蚀性能稍差，尽管如此，它们已经在实际应用中得到了使用。

第二代高密度磁光光盘存储材料需要在较短波长的激光波长下（500纳米至400纳米）具有大的磁光效应。理想的材料之一是PtCo成分调制结构薄膜，还包括掺Bi和Ga的钆石榴石氧化物薄膜。轻稀土元素如Nd或Pr和过渡金属的非晶态薄膜在短波长下的饱和磁感应强度大，但各向异性常数Ku较小。因此，使用双层磁光膜的结构（如NdGdFeTbCo）也有望用于高密度磁光光盘。
explanation_en: The magneto-optical disc is a kind of erasable rewritable disc, which uses thermal magnetic recording (erasure) and magneto-optical effect to read the stored data. The ideal magneto-optical optical disk storage materials needs to have a variety of performance characteristics: 1. The magnetize vector is perpendicular to the film surface and has a large anisotropy constant Ku. 2. High coercive force r makes the rectangular ratio of magnetic hysteresis close to 1. 3. Low Curie temperature temperature Tc (usually between 250 ° C and 300 ° C). 4. Large magneto optical Kerr effect or Faraday effect OF. 5. Stable submicron cylinder magnetic domain. 6. It can maintain data stability and has a service life of more than 10 years. 7. MnBi is one of the earliest materials used for room temperature magneto-optical storage. It is a imermetallif compound, which has two phase: low temperature phase (LPT) and high temperature frozen phase (q-HTP), where Tc is 180 ° C, but its structure is not very stable and it is easy to transform into low temperature phase transformation. The MnBi system polycrystal thin films will produce a large noise during readout. Rare earth transition metal amorphous films are widely used. These films are usually ferromagnetic and have anti iron coupling. Usually, heavy rare earth elements (such as Tb, Gd, Dy) and transition metals (such as Co, Fe) are chosen. Common materials include ThFeCo, TbDyFeCo, TbGdFeCo, etc. These amorphous films have no grain boundary noise, but their corrosion resistance is slightly poor. However, they have been used in practical applications. The second generation high density slorage malerials for magneto-optical disk needs to have a large magneto-optical effect at a shorter laser wavelength (500 nm to 400 nm). One of the ideal materials is the PtCo component modulation structure film, and also includes the gadolinium garnet oxide film doped with Bi and Ga. Amorphous thin films of light rare earth elements such as Nd or Pr and transition metals exhibit high saturation magnetic induction at short wavelengths, but low anisotropy constant Ku. Therefore, the structure using double-layer magneto-optical film (such as NdGdFeTbCo) is also expected to be used for high density magneto-optical discs.

explanation_cn:
光与磁场中的物质.或光与具有自发磁化特性的物质相互作用所产生的各种现象，包括：

1.法拉第效应（Faraday Effect）：这是一种代表性的磁光效应。当偏振光透过置于外磁场中的物质时，若磁场方向与光束方向平行，光的偏振面会产生旋转。这个旋转角度与样品的长度（L）、磁感应强度（B）之间存在线性关系，通常表示为θ = VLB，其中V为常数。值得注意的是，这个旋转角度在光束传播方向与磁场方向相反时不会倒转，这种非互易特性在光通信等领域有实际应用。

2.科顿-木顿效应（Cotton-Mouton Effect）：当光束与磁场垂直时，平行于磁场方向和垂直于磁场方向的线偏振光会有不同的相速度，从而引发双折射现象。这种现象会导致两种偏振方向的光的相位差与样品的厚度和磁场强度的平方成正比。此外，不同偏振方向的光的吸收系数也会不同，这就称为磁线二向色性效应。

3.克尔效应（Kerr Effect）：这是一种使线偏振光在照射到磁化介质表面时，反射光的偏振面发生偏转的效应。克尔效应可以分为不同类型，包括极向克尔效应、横向克尔效应和纵向克尔效应。极向和纵向克尔磁光偏转都正比于磁化强度，而偏振面的旋转方向与磁化强度的方向有关。克尔效应通常用于磁畴观察和磁光记录等领域。

4.光磁效应（Photomagnetic Effect）：这是物质在受到光照后，其磁性能（如磁化率、磁晶各向异性、磁滞回线等）发生变化的效应。这个现象的原因在于光能使电子在二价和三价铁离子之间发生转移，从而导致磁性的变化。

这些磁光效应在科学研究和技术应用中具有重要意义，可用于测量磁场、实现光学器件的调制以及磁光储存等领域。
explanation_en: Various phenomena generated by the interaction of light and matter in magnetic field or light and matter with spontaneous magnetize characteristics, including: 1. Faraday Effect: this is a representative magneto-optical effect. When polarized light passes through a substance placed in an external magnetic field, if the direction of the magnetic field is parallel to the direction of the beam, the polarization plane of the light will rotate. There is a linear relationship between this rotation angle and the length (L) and magnetic induction intensity (B) of the sample, usually expressed as θ = VLB, where V is a constant. It is worth noting that this rotation angle does not reverse when the direction of beam propagation is opposite to the direction of the magnetic field, and this non reciprocal characteristic has practical applications in fields such as optical communication. 2. Cotton Mouton Effect: When the beam is perpendicular to the magnetic field, the linearly polarized light parallel to the magnetic field direction and perpendicular to the magnetic field direction will have different phase velocities, causing birefringence. This phenomenon causes the phase difference between the two polarization directions of light to be proportional to the thickness of the sample and the square of the magnetic field strength. In addition, the absorption coefficient of light in different polarization directions also varies, which is called the magnetic line dichroism effect. 3. Kerr Effect: This is an effect that deflects the polarization plane of reflected light when linearly polarized light shines on the surface of magnetize medium. The Kerr effect can be divided into different types, including polar Kerr effect, transverse Kerr effect, and longitudinal Kerr effect. The polar and longitudinal Kerr magneto-optical deflections are proportional to the magnetization, and the rotation direction of the polarization plane is related to the direction of magnetization. Kerr effect is usually used in the field of magnetic domain observation and magneto-optical recording. 4. Photomagnetic effect: it refers to the effect that the magnetic properties (such as magnetic susceptibility, magnetocrystalline anisotropy, magnetic hysteresis, etc.) of a substance change after being exposed to light. The reason for this phenomenon is that light energy causes electrons to transfer between divalent and trivalent iron ions, leading to changes in magnetism. These magneto-optical effects are of great significance in scientific research and technological applications, and can be used for measuring magnetic fields, achieving modulation of optical devices, and magneto-optical storage.

explanation_cn:
磁光晶体是一种在强磁场作用下，其光学性质发生变化的晶体。这种效应分为两类：

磁致旋光效应（法拉第效应）：在这种效应下，强磁场引起晶体内部的原子或分子中的电子发生旋进式运动，导致本来不具备旋光性质的晶体表现出明显的旋光现象。这种效应通常称为法拉第效应。

磁致双折射效应（科顿-木顿效应）：在强磁场的作用下，晶体中的极化偶极子会排列成定向结构，导致一些本来光学各向同性的晶体表现出双折射现象。这种效应通常称为科顿-木顿效应。

典型的磁光晶体代表是含铁石榴石晶体，如Yttrium Iron Garnet (YIG)。YIG单晶体通常通过助熔剂法或提拉法生长，而掺入少量外部离子，如Ca2+、Si4+、Bi3+等，可以增强磁光效应。

磁光晶体主要用于激光调制。其优点包括所需的调制功率较低，且受温度影响较小，因此在激光技术和通信领域中具有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: Magneto-optic crystal is a kind of crystal whose optical properties change under the action of strong magnetic field. This effect can be divided into two categories: magnetic rotatory effect (Faraday effect): under this effect, the strong magnetic field causes the electrons in atoms or molecules inside the crystal to spin forward, resulting in the crystal that does not have optical rotatory property to show obvious optical rotatory phenomenon. This effect is commonly referred to as the Faraday effect. Magnetically induced birefringence effect (Cotton Multon effect): under the action of a strong magnetic field, the polarization dipoles in the crystal will be arranged into a directional structure, resulting in birefringence in some originally optically isotropic crystal. This effect is commonly referred to as the Cotton-Muton effect. Typical magneto-optical crystal are iron bearing garnet crystal, such as Yttrium Iron Garnet (YIG). YIG monocrystals are usually grown by flux method or pulling method method, and a small amount of external ions, such as Ca2+, Si4+, Bi3+, can enhance the magneto-optical effect. Magneto-optic crystal is mainly used for laser modulation. Its advantages include lower modulation power required and less temperature influence, making it widely used in laser technology and communication fields.

explanation_cn: 具有磁光现象的材料。当光透过透明的磁性物质或被磁性物质反射时，由于存在自发磁化强度将产生光的各向异性，故可以观察到各种特殊的化学现象.这些现象总称为磁光现象，例如法拉第效应、克尔效应等。应用在此领域的材料主要是薄膜形态的磁光材料。
explanation_en: A materials with magneto-optical phenomena. When light passes through transparent magnetic materials or is reflected by magnetic materials, various special chemical phenomena can be observed due to the anisotropy of light due to the existence of spontaneous magnetization. These phenomena are collectively called magneto-optical phenomena, such as Faraday effect, Kerr effect, etc. The materials used in this field are mainly magneto-optical material in the form of thin films.

explanation_cn: 和磁场平行的人射偏振光，通过置于磁场中的透明物质，按照θ=VlH产生偏转现象称为法拉第效应。式中，θ为偏转角，l为物质的长度，H为磁场强度，V为物质的固有常数，称弗尔德常数，逆磁性取正，顺磁性取负。V值大的材料被用于激光光学系统中的光学隔离器元件、人造卫星的远距离操纵，大电流测定等，称磁光元件。与单晶体比较，玻璃的V值虽较小，但易制得均匀的各向同性、大尺寸制品，增大l，实际上就使θ增大。所以愿用玻璃制造磁光元件
explanation_en: Polarized light emitted by a person parallel to a magnetic field is transmitted through a transparent substance placed in the magnetic field θ= The deflection phenomenon caused by VlH is called the Faraday effect. In the equation, θ Is the deflection angle, l is the length of the material, H is the intensity of the magnetic field, V is the intrinsic constant of the material, called the Verde constant. The diamagnetism is positive, and the paramagnetism is negative. Materials with large V values are used as optical isolator elements in laser optical systems, remote control of artificial satellites, large current measurement, etc., called magneto-optical elements. Compared with single crystal, although the V value of glass is small, it is easy to produce uniform isotropic and large-sized products. Increasing l actually makes θ Increase. So we are willing to use glass to make magneto-optical components

explanation_cn: 置于磁场中时，光学性质就发生变化的薄膜材料。主要包括石榴石等。
explanation_en: A thin film materials whose optical properties change when placed in a magnetic field. Mainly including garnet, etc.

explanation_cn: 基于磁热效应的磁制冷是传统的蒸汽循环制冷技术的一种有希望的替代方法。在有这种效应的材料中，施加和除去一个外加磁场时磁动量的排列和随机化引起材料中温度的变化.这种变化吋传递给环境空气中。磁制冷就是利用磁热效应的制冷。磁热效应是指融制冷质在等温磁化时向外界放出热量，而绝热去磁时温度降低，从外界吸收热的现象。磁制冷技术中的制冷质是固态的磁性材料。
explanation_en: Magnetic refrigeration based on magnetocaloric effect is a promising alternative to traditional steam cycle refrigeration technology. In materials with this effect, the arrangement and randomization of magnetic momentum when an external magnetic field is applied or removed will cause the temperature change in materials, which will be transmitted to the ambient air. Magnetic refrigeration is refrigeration that utilizes the magnetothermal effect. The magnetocaloric effect refers to the phenomenon that the molten refrigerant emits heat to the outside when it is isothermal magnetize, and the temperature decreases when it is adiabatic demagnetized, thus absorbing heat from the outside. The refrigerant in magnetic refrigeration technology is solid magnetic materials.

explanation_cn: 参见磁极化。
explanation_en: See magnetic polarization.

explanation_cn: 描述磁性材料磁化状态的物理量。磁化强度是矢量，通常中符号M表示。在物理上定义磁性材料单位体积内原子磁矩的矢量和为其磁化强度。
explanation_en: A physical quantity that describes the magnetize state of a magnetic materials. The magnetization is a vector, usually represented by the symbol M. Physically, the vector sum of magnetic moment of an atom in unit volume of magnetic materials is defined as its magnetization.

explanation_cn: 在外磁场H中，物质的磁化强度M与磁场强度H的比值，用Z表示，在国际单位制中是一个无量纲的量。其数值的大小表示物质磁化的难易程度。不同物质的Z差别很大，影响因素也不同。除铁磁和亚铁磁性物质外，其他物质的磁化率主要决定于化学成分。铁磁和亚铁磁性物质的磁化率与化学成分、晶体结构、晶粒组织、内应力等都有密切的关系，是组织敏感特性。
explanation_en: In the external magnetic field H, the ratio of the magnetization M to the magnetic field H, expressed in Z, is a dimensionless quantity in the International System of Units. The value indicates the difficulty of magnetize. The Z of different substances varies greatly, and the influencing factors also vary. Except for ferromagnetic and ferrimagnetism materials, the magnetic susceptibility of other materials is mainly determined by chemical composition. The magnetic susceptibility of ferromagnetic and ferrimagnetism materials is closely related to chemical composition, crystal structure, crystal structure, internal stress, etc., and is a tissue sensitive property.

explanation_cn: 对磁场具有响应性的传递系统在药物传递领域，磁场敏感传递系统的载体通常为磁性纳米粒子，最常见的是基于氧化铁的超顺磁性纳米粒子，为提高其稳定性.一般需对其进行修饰，如用高分子进行表面修饰。超顺磁性纳米粒子除了可以通过自身热效应在肿瘤部位杀灭肿瘤细胞，还可以负载药物，在外加磁场引导下进行肿瘤部位药物靶向治疗。
explanation_en: Delivery system responsive to magnetic field In the field of drug delivery, the carrier of magnetic sensitive delivery system is usually magnetic nanoparticles, and the most common is super paramagnetism nanoparticles based on iron oxide. In order to improve its stability, it is generally necessary to modify it, such as surface modification with macromolecule. Super paramagnetism nanoparticles can not only kill tumor cells through their own thermal effects, but also load drugs to target drug therapy at tumor sites under the external magnetic field induction.

explanation_cn: 磁场热处理是指在磁场中居于居里温度附近将材料保温若干时间后冷却，或以一定的速度在磁场中冷却的热处理过程。通过磁场热处理，常常可以使合金中的磁性离子或离子对出现方向有序，从而引起所谓感生各向异性，使材料中原来易磁化方向各不相同的磁畴结构，变成易磁化的，方向大致平行于磁场取向的磁畴结构。
explanation_en: Thermo-magnetic treatment refers to the heat treatment process in which materials are kept at Curie temperature in the magnetic field for a certain period of time and then cooled, or cooled at a certain speed in the magnetic field. Through thermo-magnetic treatment, the magnetic ions or ion pairs in alloy can often appear orderly in direction, which causes the so-called induced anisotropy, making the magnetic domain structure of materials with original easy magnetize directions different from each other become easy magnetize magnetic domain structure with directions roughly parallel to the orientation of the magnetic field.

explanation_cn: 磁头铁芯用的软磁材料，包括金属材料和铁氧体两大类。
explanation_en: Soft magnetic materials used for magnetic head cores include metallic materials and ferrite.

explanation_cn: 通常指时间常数为微秒级的磁化的时间效应。即由于原子或亚原子的动力学作用，致使平衡的磁系统受到扰动以后，需要经过一个短暂的时间才能重新达到平衡状态的一种物理过程。
explanation_en: It usually refers to the time effect of magnetize with a time constant of microseconds. A physical process in which the equilibrium magnetic system is disturbed due to the dynamic effects of atoms or subatoms, requiring a brief period of time to regain equilibrium.

explanation_cn: 它们是具有强磁性的液体材料，通常是将强磁性微粉跟少量分散剂均匀混合成不沉淀的胶体液。这样制成的磁性液体.具有磁场控制的黏滞性和磁浮力及典型的超顺磁性，已在动圈式、扬声器、磁密封、磁印刷以及磁流体发电机方面获得应用。
explanation_en: They are strong magnetic liquid materials, which are usually mixed with a small amount of dispersing agent to form a colloidal solution without precipitation. The magnetic fluid thus made has magnetic field controlled viscosity, magnetic buoyancy and typical super paramagnetism, and has been applied in moving coil, loudspeaker, magnetic seal, magnetic printing and magnetic fluid generator.

explanation_cn: 指添加有磁性物质并有磁性的合成纤维，是一种特种纤维。为了保持纤维的良好力学性能，一般制成各种复合纤维的形式，包括皮芯型、海岛型、共扼型等。磁性物质的平均粒径一般要求小于0.5mm，最好小于0.3mm。磁性纤维的性能随所选用的聚合物、磁性物质的种类、含量及复合形式而异。磁性纤维通常采用熔融纺丝的方法制备，通过纺丝成型得到初生纤维，再经过拉伸和热处理提高纤维的力学性能。磁性纤维可以作为电磁波屏蔽材料使用，由于其中磁性物质的直径很小，具有广谱吸收电磁波的能力；此外，磁性纤维还具有很好的远红外发射和X射线屏蔽性能。
explanation_en: It refers to the synthetic fiber added with magnetic substances, which is a special fiber. In order to maintain the good mechanical properties of the fiber, it is generally made into various forms of composite fiber, including skin core type, island type, conjugate type, etc. The average particle size of magnetic substances is generally required to be less than 0.5mm, preferably less than 0.3mm. The performance of magnetic fiber varies with the type, content and composition form of the selected polymer and magnetic material. The magnetic fiber is usually prepared by melt spinning. The as-spum fiber is obtained by spinning, and then the mechanical properties of the fiber are improved by stretching and heat treatment. Magnetic fiber can be used as electromagnetic wave shielding materials, because the diameter of the magnetic material is very small, it has the ability to absorb electromagnetic waves in a broad spectrum; In addition, magnetic fiber also has good far infrared emission and X-ray shielding performance.

explanation_cn: 磁性纳米粒子是指纳米尺度的磁性颗粒，该类颗粒通常由磁性元素构成，如铁、钴、镍及其合金或化合物等。因为磁性纳米颗粒具有独特的磁学性质而广泛应用于不同的领域，包括数据存储、核磁共振成像、磁成像、环境净化、纳米流体、纳米催化、生物医药等。
explanation_en: Magnetic nanoparticles refer to nanoscale magnetic particles, which are usually composed of magnetic elements, such as iron, cobalt, nickel and their alloy or compounds. Because magnetic nanoparticle have unique magnetic properties, they are widely used in different fields, including data storage, nuclear magnetic resonance imaging, magnetic imaging, environmental purification, nanofluid, nano catalysis, biomedicine, etc.

explanation_cn: 具有亚铁磁性的非金属磁性材料。以氧化铁和其他铁族或稀土族氧化物为主要成分，按一般的电子陶瓷工艺过程制备而成。它与金属磁性材料之间的主要区别在于导电性。按铁氧体的晶体结构类型分尖晶石型、磁铅石型、石榴石型等三类；按其物性和应用分为永磁、软磁、矩磁、旋磁和压磁等五类。由于铁氧体的电阻率较高，在高频应用上可以减小涡流损失。在雷达、通信、记录、航天、电子对抗、电视广播、自动控制、计算机、仪器仪表等方面得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: Non metallic magnetic materials with ferrimagnetism. With iron oxide and other iron or rare earth oxides as the main components, it is prepared according to the general process of electronic ceramics. The main difference between it and metal magnetic materials is conductivity. According to the type of crystal structure of ferrite, it can be divided into three types: spinel type, magnetic lead type and garnet type; According to their physical properties and applications, they are divided into five categories: permanent magnet, soft magnet, moment magnet, rotational magnet, and piezoelectric magnet. Due to the high resistivity of ferrite, eddy current loss can be reduced in high-frequency applications. It has been widely used in radar, communication, recording, aerospace, electronic countermeasures, television broadcasting, automatic control, computers, instruments, and other fields.

explanation_cn: 包括结构型磁性高分子和复合型磁性高分子。前者是指表现出的磁性质来源于分子内部结构的高分子,例如掺杂聚乙炔、经热处理的聚丙烯腈、聚氨基苯醌、某些氮氧自由基和电荷转移络合物等；后者是指以非磁性质的高分子材料为基体与磁性材料复合构成的，磁性来源于材料内部的磁性体。
explanation_en: It includes structural magnetic polymer and composite magnetic polymer. The former refers to the macromolecule whose magnetic substance is derived from the internal structure of the molecule, such as doped polyacetylene, polyacrylonitrile after heat treatment, polyaminobenzoquinone, some nitroxide radicals and charge transfer complexes; The latter refers to the non-magnetic macromolecule materials as the matrix and magnetic materials composition, and the magnetism comes from the magnetic body inside the materials.

explanation_cn: 可以通过磁场变动诱发大的可逆应变的合金(如钴-镍系合金)，形状记忆响应快是其重要特点。以Ni-Mn-Ga为代表的磁性形状记忆合金单晶中可得到约10%的可恢复磁感牛应变，响应时间为几毫秒。合金兼具铁磁性和热弹性马氏体相变，并且结合了形状记忆合金应变大和磁致伸缩材料响应快的优点。利用磁场对合金中不利取向马氏体变体的Zeeman静磁力，促使有利取向的马氏体变体长大并吞并不利取向的变体（表现为孪晶界的移动），从而产生宏观变形?当磁场强度减小或撤去时孪晶界又回到初始位置。磁性形状记忆合金具有双向高应变效应，高响应频率，可应用于传感器、表层智能结构、自动控制、飞机机翼调控系统和超大功率超声换能器技术等方面。
explanation_en: For alloy (such as cobalt nickel alloy) that can induce large reversible strain through magnetic field changes, the fast shape memory response is an important feature. About 10% recoverable magnetic induced strain can be obtained in the magnetic shape memory alloy single crystal represented by Ni Mn Ga, and the response time is several milliseconds. Alloy has both ferromagnetism and thermal elasticity martensitic transformation, and combines the advantages of large strain of shape memory alloy and fast response of magnetostriction materials. The Zeeman static magnetic force of magnetic field on disadvantageous orientation martensite variants in alloy is used to promote the growth and annexation of favorable orientation martensite variants and disadvantageous orientation variants (manifested as the movement of twin boundaries), thus resulting in macro deformation? When the magnetic field intensity decreases or withdraws, the twin boundaries return to their initial position. Magnetic shape memory alloy have high bidirectional strain effect and high response frequency, and can be used in sensors, surface intelligent structures, automatic control, aircraft wing control system and ultra high power ultrasonic transducer technology.

explanation_cn: 磁控溅射是物理气相沉积（Physical Vapor Deposition，PVD）的一种。一般的溅射法可被用于制备金属、半导体、绝缘体等多材料，且具有设备简单、易于控制、镀膜面积大和附着力强等优点。上世纪 70 年代发展起来的磁控溅射法更是实现了高速、低温、低损伤。因为是在低气压下进行高速溅射，必须有效地提高气体的离化率。磁控溅射通过在靶阴极表面引入磁场，利用磁场对带电粒子的约束来提高等离子体密度以增加溅射率。
explanation_en: Magnetron sputtering is a kind of physical vapor deposition (PVD). The general sputtering method can be used to prepare metal, semiconductor, insulator and other multi materials, and has the advantages of simple equipment, easy control, large coating area and strong adhesion. The magnetron sputtering method developed in the 1970s has realized high speed, low temperature and low damage. Because high-speed sputtering is carried out at low pressure, the ionization rate of gas must be effectively improved. Magnetron sputtering increases the sputtering rate by introducing a magnetic field on the surface of the target cathode and using the magnetic field to restrict the charged particles to increase the plasma density.

explanation_cn: 又称磁化。物质中原子磁矩沿外磁场方向定向排列或对齐的物理现象。磁极化的结果使物质表现出整体的宏观磁性，在材料中形成磁南极和磁北极,，物质在磁场中的磁极化现象可以与介电材料在电场中的电极化现象进行类比：介电材料的电极化结果总是试阁削弱外电场的影响，但磁极化的结果有可能强化（铁磁、亚铁磁、顺磁材料）或削弱（抗磁材料）外磁场的影响。被磁极化的铁磁和亚铁磁材料在消除外磁场后仍旧保持部分磁性，其他材料在没有外场的条件下磁极化诱导的磁性就消失了。
explanation_en: Also called magnetize. A physical phenomenon in which the magnetic moment of atoms in a substance is aligned in the direction of the external magnetic field. The result of magnetic polarization makes the material show the overall macro magnetism, forming the magnetic south pole and magnetic north pole in the materials. The magnetic polarization phenomenon of the material in the magnetic field can be compared with the electrode phenomenon of the dielectric materials in the electric field: the electrode result of the dielectric materials always tries to weaken the influence of the external electric field, but the result of magnetic polarization may strengthen (ferromagnetic, ferromagnetic, paramagnetic materials) or weaken (diamagnetic materials) the influence of the external magnetic field. The magnetic polarization ferromagnetic and ferromagnetic materials still retain some magnetism after eliminating the external magnetic field, and the magnetism induced by magnetic polarization of other materials disappears without the external field.

explanation_cn: 居里温度在室温附近、磁感应强度随温度上升以近似线性规律急剧下降的一类软磁合金。
explanation_en: A class of soft magnetic alloys in which the Curie temperature is near room temperature and the magnetic induction intensity decreases sharply with the increase of temperature in an approximately linear manner.

explanation_cn: 磁化强度随磁场变化出现明显的滞后的合金。磁滞合金属于铁磁性物质，种类很多按照磁性能可分为软磁合金、永磁合金和半硬磁合金。还有磁滞伸缩合金和磁记录材料。通过热处理工艺，改变合金的组织结构，获得较好的磁性能磁滞合金是制造磁滞电机转子的重要材料，广泛应用于电力、电信、仪表和计算技术等领域。
explanation_en: Alloy with obvious hysteresis of magnetization as a function of magnetic field. Magnetic hysteresis alloy belong to ferromagnetism materials. According to their magnetic properties, they can be divided into soft magnetic alloy, permanent magnetic alloy and semi hard magnetic alloy. There are also magnetostrictive alloy and magnetic recording materials. Through heat treatment process, change the structure of alloy to obtain better magnetic properties. magnetic hysteresis alloy is an important materials for manufacturing the rotor of hysteresis motor, and is widely used in power, telecommunications, instrumentation, computing technology and other fields.

explanation_cn: 在有外界磁场环境下，铁磁和亚铁磁材料的磁感应强度与磁场强度的关系可以用曲线图形表示。当外磁场作周期性变化时，这些磁件材料中的磁感应强度与外磁场强度的关系形成一条闭合曲线，这条闭合曲线即称为磁滞回线。磁滞回线所包ffl的面积等于材料被外磁场循环磁化一次所消耗的能量。这部分能量称为磁滞损耗，它使材料温度升高。磁滞回线的形状会随着材料的种类、结构、环境温度和最大外磁场强度变化。在外部磁场强度大到可使磁性材料达到饱和磁化程度时形成的磁滞回线，称作饱和磁滞回线。饱和磁滞回线是闭合回路曲线面积最大的一条磁滞回线。磁滞回线产生的微观机理起因于磁性材料内部的大量磁畴结构。这些磁畴在外场作用下其自身磁矩会随着外场强度和方向的变化进行调整，同时也会导致磁畴形状和大小的变化。在外加磁场消失后，材料内部的磁畴分布状况不能完全复原致使其保持某种程度的剩余磁性。
explanation_en: In the presence of an external magnetic field, the relationship between the magnetic induction intensity and the magnetic field intensity of ferromagnetic and ferromagnetic materials can be represented by a curve. When the external magnetic field changes periodically, the relationship between the magnetic induction strength in these magnetic parts materials and the external magnetic field strength forms a closed curve, which is called the hysteresis loop. The area of the ffl wrapped by the magnetic hysteresis is equal to the energy consumed by the materials for one magnetize cycle of the external magnetic field. This energy is called magnetic hysteresis loss, which makes the temperature of materials rise. The shape of magnetic hysteresis will change with the type of materials, structure, ambient temperature and maximum external magnetic field strength. The magnetic hysteresis formed when the external magnetic field is strong enough to make the magnetic materials reach the saturation magnetization degree is called the saturation magnetic hysteresis. Saturated magnetic hysteresis is a magnetic hysteresis with the largest area of closed loop curve. The microscopic mechanism of the hysteresis loop is due to the large number of magnetic domain in the magnetic materials. These magnetic domain will adjust their own magnetic moment with the change of the strength and direction of the external field under the action of the external field, and will also lead to the change of the shape and size of the magnetic domain. After the external magnetic field disappears, the distribution of magnetic domain in the materials can not be completely restored, resulting in its remaining magnetism to some extent.

explanation_cn: 是铁磁体等在反复磁化过程中因磁滞现象而消耗的能量。 磁滞指铁磁材料的磁性状态变化时，磁化强度滞后于磁场强度，它的磁通密度B与磁场强度 H之间呈现磁滞回线关系。经一次循环，每单位体积铁芯中的磁滞损耗正比于磁滞回线的面积。这部分能量转化为热能，使设备升温，效率降低，它是电气设备中铁损的组成部分，这在交流电机一类设备中是不希望的。软磁材料的磁滞回线狭窄，其磁滞损耗相对较小。硅钢片因此而广泛应用于电机、变压器、继电器等设备中。
explanation_en: It is the energy consumed by ferromagnets due to hysteresis phenomenon in the process of repeated magnetize. Hysteresis means that when the magnetic state of a ferromagnetic materials changes, the magnetization lags behind the magnetic field strength, and there is a magnetic hysteresis relationship between its magnetic flux density B and magnetic field strength H. After one cycle, the magnetic hysteresis loss per unit volume of iron core is proportional to the area of magnetic hysteresis. This energy is converted into thermal energy, which heats up the equipment and reduces efficiency. It is a component of iron loss in electrical equipment, which is not expected in equipment such as AC motors. The magnetic hysteresis of soft magnetic materials is narrow, and its magnetic hysteresis loss is relatively small. Therefore, silicon steel sheets are widely used in motors, transformers, relays and other equipment.

explanation_cn: 顺磁与铁磁性物质在外磁场的作用下，磁矩由杂乱变为有序。原子磁矩之间及与外磁场之间的相互作用能降低。它的磁熵减小，排出熵的过程也就是放热的过程反之，在取消磁场的过程中，.磁性物质的磁矩从有序而变为杂乱。从外界吸收能，磁熵增加，在系统绝热的情况下则磁性物质本身降温。这种由外磁场变化而引起磁性物质放热或吸热的现象称为磁热效，利用该效应在尺寸变化时产生电流的复合材料是磁热压电复合材料。
explanation_en: Under the action of external magnetic field, the magnetic moment of paramagnetic and ferromagnetism materials changes from chaos to order. The interaction energy between magnetic moment of an atom and external magnetic field is reduced. Its magnetic entropy decreases, and the process of entropy elimination is also a process of heat release. On the contrary, in the process of eliminating the magnetic field, the magnetic moment of the magnetic material changes from order to chaos. By absorbing energy from the outside, magnetic entropy increases, and in the case of adiabatic system, the magnetic material itself cools down. This kind of exothermic or endothermic phenomenon of magnetic material caused by the change of external magnetic field is called magnetocaloric effect. The composite materials that uses this effect to generate current when the size changes is magnetocaloric piezoelectric composite.

explanation_cn: 磁电复合材料是将铁电相与铁磁相经过界面应力耦合的方式复合形成的一种新的功能材料。其磁电耦合效应是通过压电相的压电效应与磁性相的磁致伸缩效应在界面的应力传递来实现。从磁电效应定义可知：磁电材料能够直接将磁场转换成电场，也可以把电场直接转换为磁场。这种不同能量场之间的转换一步而成，不需要额外的设备，因此转换效率高、易操作。利用磁电材料以及磁电效应可以灵活方便地应用电场或磁场来实现其磁化或极化状态的控制，通过调节电场(磁场）就可以调控磁场（电场）。
explanation_en: Magnetoeiectric composite is a new functional materials formed by composition of ferroelectric phase and iron phase through interface stress coupling. The magnetoelectric coupling effect is realized by the stress transfer between the piezoelectric effect of the piezoelectric phase and the magnetostriction effect of the magnetic phase at the interface. From the definition of magnetoelectric effect, we can know that magnetoelectric materials can directly convert magnetic field into electric field, and also can directly convert electric field into magnetic field. This conversion between different energy fields is achieved in one step, without the need for additional equipment, resulting in high conversion efficiency and easy operation. The use of magnetoelectric materials and magnetoelectric effects can flexibly and conveniently apply electric field or magnetic field to control its magnetize or polarization state. The magnetic field (electric field) can be adjusted by adjusting the electric field (magnetic field).

explanation_cn: 具有磁电转换功能即磁电效应的新型陶瓷材料。是压电相和磁致伸缩铁氧体相的机械混合物。
explanation_en: New ceramics materials with magnetoelectric conversion function, namely magnetoelectric effect. It is a mechanical mixture of piezoelectric phase and magnetostriction ferrite phase.

explanation_cn: 理论是用量子理论从微观上说明铁磁质的磁化机理。所谓磁畴，是指铁磁体材料在自发磁化的过程中为降低静磁能而产生分化的方向各异的小型磁化区域，每个区域内部包含大量原子，这些原子的磁矩都像一个个小磁铁那样整齐排列，但相邻的不同区域之间原子磁矩排列的方向不同，如概述图所示。各个磁畴之间的交界面称为磁畴壁。宏观物体一般总是具有很多磁畴，这样，磁畴的磁矩方向各不相同，结果相互抵消，矢量和为零，整个物体的磁矩为零，它也就不能吸引其它磁性材料。也就是说磁性材料在正常情况下并不对外显示磁性。只有当磁性材料被磁化以后，它才能对外显示出磁性。
explanation_en: The theory uses quantum theory to explain the magnetize mechanism of ferromagnetic materials from a microscopic perspective. The so-called magnetic domain refer to small magnetize regions with different directions generated by iron materials in the process of spontaneous magnetize in order to reduce the magnetostatic energy. Each region contains a large number of atoms. The magnetic moment of these atoms are orderly arranged like small magnets, but the magnetic moment of an atom between adjacent different regions are arranged in different directions, as shown in the overview diagram. The interface between each magnetic domain is called the magnetic domain wall. Macroscopic objects generally have many magnetic domain. In this way, the magnetic moment directions of magnetic domain are different, and the results cancel each other. The vector sum is zero, and the magnetic moment of the whole object is zero, so it cannot attract other magnetic materials. That is to say, magnetic materials do not show external magnetism under normal conditions. Only when the magnetic materials is magnetize can it show its magnetism externally.

explanation_cn: 描述载流线圈或微观粒子磁性的物理量。平面载流线圈的磁矩定义为m=iSe。式中，i为电流强度；S为线圈面积；e为与电流方向成右手螺旋关系的单位矢量。在均匀外磁场中，平面载流线圈所受合力为零而所受力矩不为零，该力矩使线圈的磁矩m转向与外磁场B的方向相同的方向；在均匀径向分布外磁场中，平面载流线圈受力矩偏转。许多电机和电学仪表的工作原理即基于此。
explanation_en: Describe the physical quantity of magnetic properties of current carrying coils or microscopic particles. The magnetic moment of the plane current carrying coil is defined as m=iSe. In the formula, i is the current intensity; S is the coil area; E is the unit vector in a right-hand spiral relationship with the direction of the current. In a uniform external magnetic field, the resultant force on the plane current carrying coil is zero but the torque is not zero. This torque makes the magnetic moment m of the coil turn to the same direction as the direction of the external magnetic field B; In a uniformly radially distributed external magnetic field, the planar current carrying coil is deflected by torque. The working principle of many motors and electrical instruments is based on this.

explanation_cn:
这是一种检测工件表面和近表面缺陷的方法，其中首先对被检材料进行磁化，然后使用磁粉作为传感器来检测工件表面的漏磁场。如果被检材料没有缺陷，磁粉会均匀分布在工件表面。但当材料上存在缺陷（如裂纹、气孔、夹杂物）时，由于缺陷的磁导率远小于材料本身，工件表面或接近表面的缺陷区域会产生漏磁场。这个漏磁场会吸引磁粉，使缺陷区域因积聚了更多的磁粉而显现出来。为了提高磁粉检测的灵敏度，必须增强漏磁场的强度。通常，当材料内的磁感应强度达到大约0.8特斯拉时，可以确保缺陷区域的漏磁场能够吸引磁粉。此外，还可以使用其他磁传感器，如霍尔元件、磁敏二极管和电磁线圈等，来检测漏磁场。

在使用磁传感器扫描材料表面时，可以通过检测漏磁通来发现缺陷，这在管材和棒材的自动检测中特别适用。用于执行磁粉检测的设备通常被称为磁粉探伤机。磁粉检测法的优点包括设备简单、操作方便、结果可靠、价格便宜，因此可以广泛用于对磁性材料的表面和近表面缺陷进行检测。但需要注意的是，该方法不适用于非磁性材料。
explanation_en: This is a method to detect the surface and near surface defects of the workpiece. First, magnetize the inspected materials, and then use the magnetic particle as the sensor to detect the magnetic leakage field on the workpiece surface. If the inspected materials has no defects, the magnetic particles will be evenly distributed on the surface of the workpiece. However, when there are defects (such as cracks, pores, inclusions) on the materials, because the permeability of the defect is far less than the materials itself, the workpiece surface or the defect area near the surface will produce magnetic leakage field. This leakage magnetic field will attract magnetic particles, causing the defect area to appear due to the accumulation of more magnetic particles. In order to improve the sensitivity of magnetic particle testing, the strength of magnetic leakage field must be strengthened. Generally, when the magnetic induction strength in the materials reaches about 0.8 Tesla, it can ensure that the magnetic leakage field in the defect area can attract magnetic particles. In addition, other magnetic sensors such as Hall elements, magnetic diodes, and electromagnetic coils can also be used to detect leakage magnetic fields. When magnetic sensors are used to scan surface of materials, defects can be found by detecting magnetic flux leakage, which is particularly applicable to automatic detection of tube and bar. The equipment used to perform magnetic particle testing is usually called magnetic particle flaw detector. The advantages of magnetic particle testing include simple equipment, convenient operation, reliable results and low price, so it can be widely used to detect surface and near surface defects of magnetic materials. However, it should be noted that this method is not applicable to non-magnetic materials.

explanation_cn:
磁粉芯是一种复合软磁材料，由铁磁性粉末和绝缘介质混合并压制而成。铁磁性粉末通常包括Fe（铁）、Fe-Ni-Mo（铁-镍-钼）、Fe-Si-Al（铁-硅-铝）金属粉末，还可以包含非晶态和纳米晶态合金粉末。绝缘包覆剂可分为有机包覆剂（如环氧树脂、聚酰胺树脂、硅树脂、聚乙烯醇、酚醛树脂和聚苯乙烯等）以及无机包覆剂（如水玻璃和氧化物层等）。制备这种复合材料的方法包括冷压、温压、真空热压、两步压制和模壁润滑压制等。

这些磁粉芯具有许多优点，包括较高的饱和磁感应强度、高电阻、出色的频率特性、低高频损耗、高宽恒导磁和恒导磁等。纯铁粉芯表现出良好的初始磁导率随频率变化的稳定性以及良好的直流叠加特性，但在高频时会有较大的损耗。铁硅铝粉芯的磁损比纯铁粉芯低80%，而且其磁致伸缩系数接近零，在不同频率下工作时不会产生噪声，因此广泛用于EML电感器。非晶态软磁合金具有高强度、耐腐蚀性和无磁晶各向异性等特点。纳米晶软磁合金则具有高饱和磁感应强度、高磁导率和低损耗等特点。

非晶态软磁材料的常见系列包括Fe-(Al，Ga)-(P，C，B，Si，Ge)系、FeTM-B系和CoTM-B系（其中TM表示过渡金属）。纳米晶软磁合金多为铁基材料，分为FeCdVISiB型（其中M为Nb、Mo、W、Ta）和FeMB型（其中M为Zr、Hf、Ta）。

磁粉芯广泛应用于高频电感、变压器、电感滤波器、调频扼流线圈、开关电源主振铁芯、逆变器等领域，其工作频率范围可从数十赫兹到数兆赫兹。
explanation_en: The magnetic powder core is a composition soft magnetic materials, which is made by mixing ferromagnetism powder and insulating medium and pressing. Ferromagnetism powder usually includes Fe (iron), Fe Ni Mo (iron nickel molybdenum), Fe Si Al (iron silicon aluminum) metal powder, and can also include amorphous and nanocrystalline alloy powder. Insulation restricter can be divided into organic restricter (such as epoxy resin, polyamide resin, silicone resin, polyvinyl alcohol, phenolic resin and polystyrene) and inorganic restricter (such as water glass and oxide layer). The methods for preparing the composite materials include cold pressing, warm pressing, vacuum hot pressing, two-step pressing and die wall lubrication pressing. These magnetic powder cores have many advantages, including high saturation magnetic induction strength, high resistance, excellent frequency characteristics, low high-frequency losses, high bandwidth constant magnetic conductivity, and constant magnetic conductivity. Pure iron powder core shows good stability of initial permeability changing with frequency and good DC superposition characteristics, but it will have greater loss at high frequency. The magnetic loss of iron silicon aluminium powder core is 80% lower than that of pure iron core, and its magnetostriction coefficient is close to zero, so it will not produce noise when working at different frequencies, so it is widely used in EML inductors. Amorphous soft magnetic alloys are characterized by high strength, corrosion resistance and nonmagnetic crystalline anisotropy. Nanocrystalline soft magnetic alloys have the characteristics of high saturation magnetic induction intensity, high magnetic permeability, and low loss. Common series of amorphous soft magnetic materials include Fe - (Al, Ga) - (P, C, B, Si, Ge) system, FeTM-B system and CoTM-B system (where TM represents transition metal). The nanocrystalline soft magnetic alloys are mostly iron based materials, which are divided into FeCdVISiB type (where M is Nb, Mo, W, Ta) and FeMB type (where M is Zr, Hf, Ta). Magnetic powder cores are widely used in fields such as high-frequency inductors, transformers, inductance filters, frequency modulation choke coils, switching power supply main oscillator cores, inverters, etc. Their operating frequency range can range from tens of Hertz to several megahertz.

explanation_cn: 磁约束聚变是指用特殊形态的磁场把氘、氚等轻原子核和自由电子组成的、处于热核反应状态的超高温等离子体约束在有限的体积内，使它受控制地发生大量的原子核聚变反应，释放出能量。我国磁约束聚变研究开始于上世纪五六十年代。中科院物理所最先建造了一个直线放电装置和两个角向箍缩装置。原子能科学研究院建造了磁镜“小龙”装置。北京大学、复旦大学和清华大学等开展了相关基础研究。
explanation_en: Magnetic-confinement fusion refers to the use of a special form of magnetic field to confine the ultrahigh temperature plasma composed of light atomic nuclei and free electrons such as deuterium and tritium, which is in the state of thermonuclear reaction, within a limited volume, so that it can generate a large number of nuclear fusion reactions under control and release energy. The research on magnetic confinement fusion in China began in the 1950s and 1960s. The Institute of Physics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences was the first to construct a linear discharge device and two angular pinch devices. The Institute of Atomic Energy Science has built the magnetic mirror "Little Dragon" device. Peking University, Fudan University, and Tsinghua University have conducted relevant basic research.

explanation_cn: 退磁曲线上任何一点的B和H的乘积即BH我们称为磁能积，而B×H的最大值称之为最大磁能积，为退磁曲线上的D点。磁能积是衡量磁体所储存能量大小的重要参数之一。在磁体使用时对应于一定能量的磁体，要求磁体的体积尽可能小。
explanation_en: The product of B and H at any point on the demagnetization curve, known as BH, is called the magnetic energy product, while B × The maximum value of H is called the maximum magnetic energy product, which is the D point on the demagnetization curve. The magnetic energy product is one of the important parameters to measure the energy stored in a magnet. When using magnets, corresponding to a certain amount of energy, the volume of the magnet should be as small as possible.

explanation_cn: 磁致伸缩是指物体在磁场中磁化时，在磁化方向会发生伸长或缩短，当通过线圈的电流变化或者是改变与磁体的距离时其尺寸即发生显著变化的铁磁性材料，通常称为铁磁致伸缩材料。其尺寸变化比铁氧体等磁致伸缩材料大得多，而且所产生的能量也大，则称为超磁致伸缩材料。
explanation_en: Magnetostriction refers to ferromagnetism materials that will stretch or shorten in the magnetize direction when the object is magnetize in the magnetic field, and its size will change significantly when the current through the coil changes or the distance from the magnet is changed. It is usually called iron magnetostriction materials. Its size change is much larger than that of magnetostriction materials such as ferrite, and the energy generated is also large, so it is called super magnetostriction materials.

explanation_cn: 主要有铁镍合金、铁铝合金和稀土铁合金等。磁致伸缩合金可制成超声波发生器和接收器，以及力、速度、加速度的传感器，滤波器、稳频器和磁声存储器。磁性合金随磁化过程将发生不同程度的线性变化，亦即具有不同的磁致伸缩系数λ值，磁化到饱和时的磁致 伸缩系数称为饱和磁致伸缩系数λs，通常将λs≥20 ×10-6的合金称为磁致伸缩合金，亦称高磁致伸缩合金。包括纯镍、镍合金（如4Co-1.7Si-Ni、2Co- 24Cr-Ni、5Co-Ni合金等）、8%～14%Al-Fe合金（如 含13%Al，余为Fe的1J13合金）、35%～70%Co-Fe 合金（如含2%V、49%Co、余为Fe的1J22、65Co-Fe 等合金）和50%Ni-Fe合金（1J50）等。这类合金除 了需有高的磁致伸缩系数外，还需具有高的电机械 耦合系数km和高的电阻率ρ，由于以片材状态使 用，合金应有良好的加工性能。这类合金主要用于 音频或超音频声波发生器、流体声学装置、电机械滤 波器和阻挡器线路中的磁致伸缩变流器等。
explanation_en: It mainly includes iron nickel alloy, iron aluminum alloy and rare earth iron alloy. Magnetostriction alloy can be made into ultrasonic generators and receivers, as well as force, velocity, acceleration sensors, filters, frequency stabilizers and magnetoacoustic memory. Magnetic alloy will change linearly in varying degrees with the magnetization process, that is, they have different magnetostriction coefficient λ Value, the magnetostriction coefficient when magnetize reaches saturation is called saturation magnetostriction coefficient λ s. Usually λ S ≥ 20 × The 10-6 alloy is called magnetostriction alloy, also called high magnetostriction alloy. It includes pure nickel, nickel alloy (such as 4Co-1.7Si Ni, 2Co -24Cr Ni, 5Co Ni alloy, etc.), 8% -14% Al Fe alloy (such as 1J13 alloy containing 13% Al, the rest being Fe), 35% -70% Co Fe alloy (such as alloy containing 2% V, 49% Co, the rest being 1J22, 65Co Fe), 50% Ni Fe alloy (1J50), etc. In addition to high magnetostriction coefficient, this kind of alloy also needs high electromechanical coupling coefficient km and high resistivity ρ， Alloy shall have good processability because it is used in sheet state. This kind of alloy is mainly used in audio or super audio sound generators, fluid acoustic devices, electromechanical filters and magnetostriction converters in blocker circuits.

explanation_cn: 磁性材料在磁化时发生的尺寸变化称为磁致伸缩，在饱和磁化情况下所产生的磁致伸缩称为饱和磁致伸缩（As)，产生磁致伸缩的复合材料为磁致伸缩复合材料。其原理为磁体受到外磁场磁化时，由于磁畴结构的变化和磁化向量的转动，出现整个物体的线磁致伸缩，磁致伸缩复合材料把磁能转换成机械能。可用来做超声发生器、传动器和传感器等。
explanation_en: The size change of magnetic materials during magnetize is called magnetostriction, the magnetostriction generated under saturation magnetization is called saturated magnetostriction (As), and the composite materials that generates magnetostriction is called magnetostrictive composite. The principle is that when the magnet is magnetize by an external magnetic field, due to the change of magnetic domain structure and the rotation of magnetize vector, the linear magnetostriction of the whole object appears, and magnetostrictive composite converts magnetic energy into mechanical energy. It can be used as an ultrasound generator, driver, and sensor.

explanation_cn: 铁磁性物质在磁化时，沿着磁化方向会发生长度的伸长或缩短的现象，这种效应可以用磁致伸缩系数λ来表示。而且λ的大小等于沿着磁化方向的伸长量与总长度的比值，单位一般取ppm。λ＞0表示沿着磁化方向上的尺寸伸长，称为正磁致伸缩，例如铁；反之称为负磁致伸缩，例如镍。
explanation_en: When ferromagnetism material is magnetize, its length will stretch or shorten along the magnetize direction. This effect can be used as magnetostriction coefficient λ To represent. furthermore λ The value of is equal to the ratio of the elongation along the magnetize direction to the total length, and the unit is generally ppm. λ＞ 0 represents the dimensional elongation along the magnetize direction, which is called positive magnetostriction, such as iron; On the contrary, it is called negative magnetostriction, such as nickel.

explanation_cn: 在磁场中磁化时，发生长度或体积变化并具有较高磁致伸缩系数的陶瓷材料。在外加交变电场中产生机械变形，可用来产生超声波。在磁场中磁化时.会发生长度或体积变化的现象。在外加交变电场中产生机械变形.可用来产生超声波。压磁铁氧体由于电阻率高，适用于较高频段，它通常是镍-锌系、镍-铜系或含钴的铁氧体。作为磁致伸缩陶瓷，必须有高磁致伸缩系数髙电阻率和高密度，同时要求压磁耦合系数大，对温度、振动的稳定性和机械强度好等。主要用于制造超声器件。包括超声发生器、超声接收器、超声探伤器、超声钻头、超声焊接器等；水声器件，包括声呐和回声探测仪器等。还可以用于机械滤波器、混频器和超声延迟线。
explanation_en: Ceramics materials with high magnetostriction coefficient and change in length or volume when magnetize in a magnetic field. Mechanical deformation is generated in an external alternating electric field, which can be used to generate ultrasonic waves. When magnetized in a magnetic field, there may be a change in length or volume. Mechanical deformation is generated in an external alternating electric field, which can be used to generate ultrasonic waves. Because of its high resistivity, piezomagnetic ceramics is suitable for higher frequency band. It is usually nickel zinc, nickel copper or cobalt containing ferrite. As a magnetostrictive ceramics, it must have high magnetostriction coefficient, high resistivity and high density. At the same time, it requires large piezomagnetic coupling coefficient, good stability to temperature, vibration and mechanical strength. Mainly used for manufacturing ultrasonic devices. Including ultrasonic generator, ultrasonic receiver, ultrasonic flaw detector, ultrasonic drill bit, ultrasonic welding device, etc; Underwater acoustic devices, including sonar and echo detection instruments. It can also be used for mechanical filters, mixers, and ultrasonic delay lines.

explanation_cn: 简称涡旋线。对于第二类超导体，当外加磁场处于时，磁通进人超导体，在第二类超导体内部的这些磁通线是被超导态包围的，形成一个复连通体系，这类似于环的情况；为了维持这个磁通线，磁通线外的超导区中必定存在一个分布的环形电流围绕着它，这个环形的涡旋电流产生的磁场就是正常态芯子中的量子化磁通量的磁场。通常把正常芯子和包围它的涡旋电流整个结构称为磁通涡旋线。
explanation_en: It is abbreviated as a vortex line. For the type II superconductor, when the external magnetic field is in, the magnetic flux enters the superconductor. These magnetic flux lines inside the type II superconductor are surrounded by the superconducting state state, forming a complex connected system, which is similar to the situation of a ring; In order to maintain this flux line, there must be a distributed annular current surrounding it in the superconducting region outside the flux line. The magnetic field generated by this annular vortex current is the quantized magnetic flux magnetic field in the normal state core. Generally, the whole structure of the normal core and the vortex current surrounding it is called the flux vortex line.

explanation_cn: 由临界态概念给出，只要一个涡旋线受到的洛伦兹力小于钉扎力，涡旋线就不能运动，使得涡旋线即使在洛伦兹力小于钉扎力情况下也可以发生缓慢运动，通常称它为磁通蠕动。
explanation_en: According to the concept of critical state, as long as the Lorentz force on a vortex line is less than the pinning force, the vortex line cannot move, so that the vortex line can move slowly even if the Lorentz force is less than the pinning force, which is commonly called vortex creep.

explanation_cn: 磁通运动导致能量损耗。由于磁热效应，能量损耗又导致局部升温，局部升溫导致该处钉扎效应降低，钉扎效应降低又导致磁通进一步运动。如是一次又一次的继续循环.可使原来少量缓慢的磁通运动引起大量的、迅速的磁通运动，即称磁通跳跃。这种现象若温度不采取措施加以控制，则体温升至极限时，第二类超导体即整体转入正常态。这就是第二类超导体的不稳定问题。
explanation_en: Magnetic flux movement leads to energy loss. Due to the magnetocaloric effect, energy loss leads to local heating, which leads to a decrease in the pinning effect at this location. The reduction in pinning effect leads to further movement of the magnetic flux. If the cycle continues again and again, a small amount of slow magnetic flux movement can cause a large number of rapid magnetic flux movement, which is called vortex jump. If no measures are taken to control the temperature of this phenomenon, when the temperature rises to the limit, the type II superconductor will turn into the normal state as a whole. This is the instability of type II superconductor.

explanation_cn: 磁通量的最小单位。
explanation_en: The smallest unit of magnetic flux.

explanation_cn: 是一种超导体中的磁通量量子化现象，磁通量量子化出现在有外加磁场的第二类超导体中。当施加在第二型超导体的磁场小于临界磁场时，由于迈斯纳效应，超导体内没有磁通，超导体会有超抗磁性；但若外加磁场时，则会有离散的磁通量，而大部分材料仍然维持超导的特性。
explanation_en: It is a phenomenon of magnetic flux quantization in superconductors, which occurs in type II superconductor with an external magnetic field. When the magnetic field applied to the second type superconductor is less than the critical magnetic field, because of the Meissner effect, there is no magnetic flux in the superconductor, and the superconductor will have super diamagnetism; However, if a magnetic field is applied, there will be discrete magnetic flux, and most materials still maintain superconducting properties.

explanation_cn: 是指超导体量子磁通线被缺陷或其他各种势阱所束缚的状态。磁通线是Ⅱ类超导体中有磁场时出现的一根一根磁力线束，每束的总磁通量为h/2e。由于涨落效应，磁通线总是在其平衡位置周围作无规则运动。当超导体中通以电流时，磁通线受到洛伦兹力作用会定向运动，并在其正常芯及其周围放出热量，超导体就会有电阻出现，不再是真正意义上的超导体。但超导材料中总有一些缺陷，或人为制造一些缺陷，使得磁通线刚好处于这些缺陷位置时，系统的总能量最低，因此磁通线会被束缚住，这个现象叫磁通钉扎。根据磁通线的结构特点，磁通钉扎可通过降低凝聚能（非超导芯钉扎）、超导电子动能（平均自由程钉扎）、磁相互作用能、表面能等来实现。如利用高能重离子束对超导体进行辐照会产生半径与相干长度相当的柱状钉扎中心，对于横向涨落强的磁通线（如高温超导体的涡旋饼）可起到非常有效的钉扎，可大大提高超导体的临界电流。通过纳米尺度非超导颗粒的夹杂，亦可对磁通形成非常有效的钉扎。利用现代微加工技术对超导体进行刻蚀形成特殊形状的缺陷阵列，可对磁通的集体运动加以限制，出现磁通的单向流动的二极管行为。磁通钉扎的研究对超导体的强电方面的应用非常重要。
explanation_en: It refers to the state in which the quantum flux line of a superconductor is bound by defects or various other potential wells. Magnetic flux lines are magnetic harnesses that appear in Class II superconductors when there is a magnetic field, each with a total magnetic flux of h/2e. Due to the fluctuation effect, the magnetic flux line always moves irregularly around its equilibrium position. When a current is applied to a superconductor, the magnetic flux line will move in a directional direction under the Lorentz force and release heat around its normal core. The superconductor will have resistance and is no longer a true superconductor. However, there are always some defects in superconducting materials, or man-made defects, so that when the magnetic flux line is just in the position of these defects, the total energy of the system is the lowest, so the magnetic flux line will be bound. This phenomenon is called flux pinning. According to the structural characteristics of the flux line, flux pinning can be achieved by reducing the condensation energy (non superconducting core pinning), superconducting electron kinetic energy (average free path pinning), magnetic interaction energy, surface energy, etc. If the superconductor is irradiated by high-energy heavy ion beam, a cylindrical pinning center with a radius equal to the coherence length will be generated, which can effectively pin the magnetic flux line with transverse fluctuation strength (such as the vortex cake of high-temperature superconductor), and greatly increase the critical current of the superconductor. The inclusion of nanoscale non superconducting particles can also form very effective pinning of magnetic flux. The use of modern microfabrication technology to etch superconductors to form special shaped defect arrays can limit the collective movement of magnetic flux, resulting in the diode behavior of unidirectional flow of magnetic flux. The study of flux pinning is very important for the application of superconductors in strong electricity.

explanation_cn: 在非理想第II类超导体中，超导体存在磁通捕获和磁滞现象以及其磁通线呈不均匀分布均表明，磁通线除了受到洛伦兹力作用外，还受到来自存在于超导体中的缺陷的作用力，称之为钉扎力，缺陷称之为钉扎中心。
explanation_en: In non ideal type II superconductors, the phenomena of magnetic flux capture and hysteresis, as well as the uneven distribution of their magnetic flux lines, indicate that the magnetic flux lines are not only subjected to Lorentz forces, but also to forces from defects present in the superconductor, called pinning forces, and defects are called pinning centers.

explanation_cn: 石英石的一种。主要由石英和磁铁矿（部分赤铁矿）组成的区域变质岩石。常含少量铁闪石、镁铁闪石、透辉石、斜方辉石等。一般为粒状变晶结构，条带状构造或块状构造。可能由含铁硅质岩经变质作用而成。当铁含最大于20%时可作为铁矿石开采。
explanation_en: A type of quartz. A regional metamorphic rock mainly composed of quartze and magnetite (part of hematite). It often contains a small amount of iron amphibole, magnesium iron amphibole, diopside, orthorhombic pyroxene, etc. Generally, it is granular balastic texture, banded structure or massive structure. It may be formed by metamorphism of iron bearing silicolite. When the iron content is more than 20%, it can be mined as iron ore.

explanation_cn: 磁铁矿晶体属等轴晶系的氧化物矿物，晶体常呈八面体和菱形十二面体、集合体呈粒状或块状。完好单晶形呈八面体或菱形十二面体，呈菱形十二面体时，菱形面上常有平行该晶面长对角线方向的条纹。集合体为致密块状或粒状。
explanation_en: The magnetite crystal belongs to the oxide mineral of equiaxed crystal system, and the crystal is usually octahedral and rhombic dodecahedral, and the aggregate is granular or massive. The intact single crystal is octahedral or rhombic dodecahedron in shape, and when it is rhombic dodecahedron, the rhombic plane often has stripes parallel to the long diagonal direction of the crystal plane. Aggregates are dense block or granular.

explanation_cn: 摩擦副表面材料在相对运动中由于机械作用，间或伴有化学作用而导致不断损耗的现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that the materials on the surface of the friction pair is constantly lost due to mechanical action, sometimes accompanied by chemical action, in the relative movement.

explanation_cn: 又称比磨损率滑动轴承的径向磨损除以名义接触压力与行程的乘积。
explanation_en: Also known as specific wear rate, the radial wear of sliding bearing is divided by the product of nominal contact pressure and stroke.

explanation_cn: 磨损量与磨损时间之比。由于磨损量是时间的函数，磨损率可表示与时间有关的磨损特性。
explanation_en: The ratio of wear amount to wear time. Since the amount of wear is a function of time, wear rate can represent the time related wear characteristics.

explanation_cn: 磨损过程中，相对运动表面材料的损失。国内外在摩擦磨损的试验研究中，采用多种不同的摩擦磨损试验机。磨损量的评定方法并不统一。
explanation_en: The loss of materials on the relative moving surface during wear. A variety of different friction and wear testing machines are used in the friction and wear test research at home and abroad. The evaluation method for wear is not uniform.

explanation_cn: 通过轻磨粒面得到的表面具有非常细小绒头的一类皮革。
explanation_en: A kind of leather with very fine pile on the surface obtained by light abrasive grain.

explanation_cn: 在同一条件下标准胶料的磨耗量与试验胶料的磨耗量之比。
