Its thermal conductivity is small, and it can be directly laid on the lining of the high-temperature kiln in contact with the flame.

explanation_cn: 又称空化腐蚀。由腐蚀和空泡联合作用产生的材料破坏过程。常发生在高速流体流经形状复杂的金属表面、液体压强变化的场合，容易在汽轮机叶片、船用螺旋桨、泵叶轮等表面上产生蚀坑。气泡是在流体内局部区域的绝对压强降低到液体汽化压强时在液体内形成的，气泡随液体达到压强高的区域时破灭，同时产生很大冲击压强，使气泡破灭处的金属表面膜破坏、发生塑性变形或使脆性金属开裂。促进了腐浊。由于力学与化学元素协同作用，在金属表面形成蚀坑，最终造成疲劳剥落。预防措施有：改变设计使流程中流体动压差减小，可减轻空泡腐蚀；合理选材并降低表面粗糙度，使空泡形核概率减少；采用弹性高的橡胶或塑料涂层吸收冲击波；采用阴极保护。
explanation_en: It is also called cavitation corrosion. The failure process of materials caused by the combined action of corrosion and cavitation. It often occurs in situations where high-speed fluid flows through complex metal surfaces and changes in liquid pressure, which can easily cause corrosion pits on the surfaces of steam turbine blades, marine propellers, pump impellers, and other surfaces. Bubbles are formed in the liquid when the absolute pressure in the local area of the fluid decreases to the vaporization pressure of the liquid. Bubbles burst when the liquid reaches the area with high pressure. At the same time, a large impact pressure is generated, which will damage the metal surface facial mask, cause plastic deformation or crack the brittle metal where the bubbles burst. Promotes decay and turbidity. Due to the synergistic effect of mechanical and chemical elements, corrosion pits are formed on the metal surface, which eventually leads to fatigue peeling. The preventive measures include: changing the design to reduce the hydrodynamic pressure difference in the process can reduce cavitation corrosion; Reasonable selection of materials and reduction of surface roughness reduce the probability of cavitation nucleation; Adopt rubber or plastics coating with high elasticity to absorb shock wave; Adopt cathodic protection.

explanation_cn: 又称D-defect，是硅单晶中一种由空位聚集产生的微缺陷。硅单晶刚形成后，其中的点缺陷类型由晶体生长速度V与固液界面附近温度梯度G的比值（即V/G)决定。当V/G的值大于某一临界值时，硅单晶中点缺陷的类型为空位。这样，在后续的晶体冷却过程中，空位将进入过饱和状态而聚集，最终形成空洞型微缺陷。硅片中的空洞型缺陷会劣化MOS晶体管的栅极氧化层完整性，导致漏电流。直拉硅单晶中的空洞型缺陷通常呈八面体状，构成八面体的主要晶面为{111}。观察到的八面体空洞可能是单独存在的，也有可能出现孪生情况。直拉硅单晶中的空洞型缺陷的内壁还覆盖一层不超过5nm厚的氧化桂层。空洞型缺陷可以通过氩气或者氢气气氛下的高温（不低于1200°C)热处理消除。
explanation_en: Also called D-defect, it is a kind of micro defect in siliconcrystalline caused by vacancy aggregation. The type of point defects in silicon single crystal is determined by the ratio of crystal growth speed V to the temperature gradient G near the solid-liquid interface (i.e. V/G) just after the crystal is formed. When V/G is greater than a certain critical value, the type of point defect in siliconcrystalline is vacancy. In this way, in the subsequent cooling process of crystal, the vacancy will enter the supersaturation state and gather, and finally form a cavity type micro defect. The void defect in silicon wafer will degrade the integrity of the gate oxide layer of MOS transistors, resulting in leakage current. The void defect in Czochralski siliconcrystalline is usually octahedral, and the main crystal plane forming the octahedron is {111}. The observed octahedral voids may exist alone, or twinning may occur. The inner wall of void defect in Czochralski siliconcrystalline is also covered with a layer of cinnamon oxide no more than 5 nm thick. Void defect can be eliminated by high temperature (not less than 1200 ° C) heat treatment in argon or hydrogen atmosphere.

explanation_cn: 晶体中大量空位凝聚的复合体。在淬火铝合金中已观察到空洞的形成。这些空洞具有由{111}面围成的八面体形状。这种淬火缺陷形态的相对稳定性与它的能量有关，计算表明球形或多面体形的空洞在能量上最稳定。许多纯金属(例如Nb、Ta、Ni)在核反应堆中，形成的空洞是球形或多面形体的空隙，它们随辐射最增大而增大，并且往往排列成一种立方的"空间点阵"。当空洞半径约为30nm时.空洞的总体积超过试样总体积的10%。在高温下，空洞将失去空位而消失，空洞的形成对金属与合金的物理、化学和力学性能都有着重要的影响。
explanation_en: A complex in which a large number of vacancy condense in a crystal. Voids have been observed in quenching aluminum alloys. These voids have an octahedral shape surrounded by {111} faces. The relative stability of this quenching defect shape is related to its energy. Calculations show that spherical or polyhedral cavities are the most stable in energy. Many pure metals (such as Nb, Ta, Ni) in nuclear reactor form voids of spherical or polyhedral bodies, which increase with the maximum radiation and are often arranged into a cubic "space lattice". When the radius of the cavity is about 30nm, the total volume of the cavity exceeds 10% of the total volume of the sample. At high temperature, voids will lose vacancy and disappear. The formation of voids has an important impact on the physical, chemical and mechanical properties of metals and alloy.

explanation_cn: 又称n型超导体。铜氧化物或Fe基高温超导体中的一类，通过霍尔效应可以测量，其载流子类型由晶体结构中的空穴所提供。根据强关联电子理论，高温超导电性是由于载流子通过载流层向受流层转移自由电子或者空穴，从而产生超导电性。
explanation_en: Also known as n-type superconductor. A type of copper oxide or Fe based high-temperature superconductor, which can be measured by the Hall effect, and its carrier type is provided by the holes in the crystal structure. According to the strongly correlated electron theory, high temperature superconductivity is due to the carrier transferring free electrons or holes through the current carrying layer to the current receiving layer, resulting in superconductivity.

explanation_cn: 俘获空穴的速率远远大于俘获导带中电子的速率或发射空穴的速率远远大于发射电子的速率的陷阱称为空穴陷阱。
explanation_en: Traps that capture holes at a rate far greater than the rate of capturing electrons in the conduction band or emitting holes at a rate far greater than the rate of emitting electrons are called hole trap.

explanation_cn: 用于制备空间光调制器的材料。即在电、光的控制下能改变输出空间光场（包括相位、振幅、偏振甚至波长的空间分布）的材料总称。包括光或电传感材料和电光调制材料。表征性能的主要参数有：光探测灵敏度、电光系数、调制速度（即响应时间）、工作电压等，除此之外还需考虑材料的稳定性、可靠性及加工的难易程度.根据典型电光调制材料的响应时间，可见它们之间性能差异是很大的。在材料生长和加工方面皆采用常用的体单晶生长方法、薄膜淀积方法和超大规模集成电路的微细圆形和结构的加工技术。
explanation_en: Materials for preparing spatial light modulator. It is the general term of materials that can change the output spatial light field (including the spatial distribution of phase, amplitude, polarization and even wavelength) under the control of electricity and light. It includes optical or electrical sensing materials and electro-optical modulation materials. The main parameters characterizing the performance are: optical detection sensitivity, electro-optic coefficient, modulation speed (i.e. response time), operating voltage, etc. In addition, the stability, reliability and processing difficulty of materials should also be considered. According to the response time of typical electro-optic modulation materials, it can be seen that their performance is very different. In terms of materials growth and processing, the commonly used bulk single crystal growth method, thin film deposition method and the processing technology of ultra large scale integrated circuit (VLSI) micro circle and structure are adopted.

explanation_cn: 在半导体的表面，不同半导体的界面，或半导体与金属的接触面，电中性往往遭到破坏，形成一个带电的区域称为空间电荷区，或称空间电荷层。在PN结中.由于自由电子的扩散运动和内电场导致的漂移运动，使PN结中间的部位（P区和N区交界面）产生一个很薄的电荷区，它就是空间电荷区。当P型半导体和N型半导体结合在一起时，由于交界面处存在载流子浓度的差异，这样电子和空穴都要从浓度高的地方向浓度低的地方扩散。但是，电子和空穴都是带电的，它们扩散的结果就使P区和N区中原来的电中性条件破坏了。P区一侧因失去空穴而留下不能移动的负离子，N区一侧因失去电子而留下不能移动的正离子。这些不能移动的带电粒子通常称为空间电荷，它们集中在P区和N区交界面附近，形成了一个很薄的空间电荷区，这就是我们所说的PN结。在这个区域内，多数载流子已扩散到对方并复合掉了，或者说消耗殆尽了，因此，空间电荷区又称为耗尽层。P区一侧呈现负电荷，N区一侧呈现正电荷，因此空间电荷区出现了方向由N区指向P区的电场，由于这个电场是载流子扩散运动形成的，而不是外加电压形成的，故称为内电场。
explanation_en: On the surface of semiconductor, the interface of different semiconductors, or the contact surface between semiconductor and metal, the electrical neutrality is often destroyed, forming a charged area called the space charge area, or the space charge layer. In the PN junction, because of the diffusion movement of free electrons and the drift movement caused by the internal electric field, the middle part of the PN junction (the interface between P area and N area) produces a very thin charge area, which is the space charge area. When P-type semiconductor and N-type semiconductor are combined, due to the difference of carrier concentration at the interface, electrons and holes will diffusion from the place with high concentration to the place with low concentration. However, both electrons and holes are charged, and their diffusion results in the destruction of the original neutral conditions in the P and N regions. On one side of the P region, negative ions that cannot move are left due to the loss of holes, while on the other side of the N region, positive ions that cannot move are left due to the loss of electrons. These immovable charged particles are commonly referred to as space charges, which concentrate near the interface between the P and N regions, forming a very thin space charge region, which is what we call a PN junction. In this region, most of the carriers have diffusion to each other and composition, or have been exhausted. Therefore, the space charge region is also called the depletion layer. The negative charge appears on one side of P area, and the positive charge appears on the other side of N area. Therefore, the space charge area has an electric field in the direction from N area to P area. Since this electric field is formed by the carrier diffusion movement, rather than the external voltage, it is called the internal electric field.

explanation_cn: 标定晶体内部结构的对称群，是根据晶体的微观对称元素进行对称操作而组合成的。从七大晶系出发，总共可推导出230种空间群。每一空间群都包含着一个作为其子群的平移群。因此，构成空间群的所有对称元素都是按周期重复的规律无限地配置在整个空间点阵图像中。用衍射法可测得晶体的空间群。空间群多用国际符号来表示，由两部分所组成：第一部分用大写字母P、A、B、C、I和F等表示空间群的平移群，用以描述晶体点阵的周期性；第二部分大多由三个规定的位序组成（简单的只用一个位序），用以表示空间群中主导方向上的对称元素系。
explanation_en: The symmetry group for calibrating the internal structure of a crystal is composed of symmetry operations based on the microscopic symmetry elements of a crystal. Starting from the seven major crystal systems, a total of 230 spatial groups can be derived. Each space group contains a translation group as its subgroup. Therefore, all symmetrical elements constituting the space group are infinitely arranged in the entire space lattice image according to the periodic repetition rule. The space group of crystal can be measured by diffraction method. The space group is usually represented by international symbols and consists of two parts: the first part uses capital letters P, A, B, C, I and F to represent the translation group of the space group to describe the periodicity of crystal lattice; The second part is mostly composed of three prescribed bit orders (simply using only one bit order), used to represent the symmetric element system in the dominant direction of a spatial group.

explanation_cn: 由一系列引爆火工品元件，按激发感度递减和输出能量递增的次序.分级有序地完成爆轰型能量转换、能量控制和能量放大功能的组合体。在弹药和爆炸装置中，传爆序列第一级首发火工品为敏感元件，在接受电的或非电的激发能量后，火工药剂被激发，由机械能或电能转换成化学能.能量迅速增强.形成爆燃或爆轰反应冲能,引燃或引爆下一级火工品装药，以更强的输出能ft再激发下一级火工品并逐级向下传递，直至输出爆轰能量能坷靠地起爆炸药主装药。传爆序列的能量转换、i能量放大和时间控制的分级设计.应满足安全、可靠以及适应主装药在最佳时间内起爆的要求。传爆系列分隔爆式和直列式两类。隔爆式传爆序列的第一级敏i感元件与下一级爆炸元件之间被隔爆件隔开，以保证：弹药、爆炸装置勤务处理和使用的安全性。直列式爆炸序列的第一级激发电雷管与主装爆炸元件直接连丨接，其电雷管用高输人激发能量的钝感型冲击片雷i管、触发电路和保护开关组成的全电子保险装置取代i机械隔爆机构，在高压电容器未被充电和发火电路未被接通时，不可能激发。同时，对各级爆炸元件的装药只准使用许用炸药，即必须通过军用标准规定的八项安全性试验要求。
explanation_en: A combination of detonation type energy conversion, energy control and energy amplification functions is completed in a hierarchical and orderly manner by a series of initiating explosive device elements in the order of decreasing excitation sensitivity and increasing output energy. In ammunition and explosion devices, the first initiating explosive device in the first stage of the high explosives train is a sensitive element. After receiving the electric or non electric excitation energy, the initiating explosives and relative compositions is excited, and the mechanical energy or electrical energy is converted into chemical energy. The energy is rapidly increased. The detonation or detonation reaction impulse energy is formed, and the next level of initiating explosive device charge is ignited or detonated. The next level of initiating explosive device is excited with a stronger output energy ft and transmitted downward step by step, Until the output of detonation energy can bump the main explosive charge against the ground. The graded design of energy conversion, i energy amplification and time control of the high explosives train shall meet the requirements of safety, reliability and adaptability to the detonation of the main charge in the best time. There are two types of explosion transmission series: separated explosion type and inline type. The first level sensitive I sensor of the flameproof high explosives train is separated from the next level explosion element by flameproof pieces to ensure the safety of service handling and use of ammunition and explosion devices. The first level excitation electric detonator of the in-line explosion sequence is directly connected to the main explosion element. Its electric detonator uses a fully electronic safety device composed of insensitive shock plate detonator with high input excitation energy, trigger circuit and protection switch to replace the mechanical explosion-proof mechanism. When the high-voltage capacitor is not charged and the ignition circuit is not connected, it cannot be activated. At the same time, only permitted explosive are allowed to be used for charging explosion elements at all levels, that is, they must pass the eight safety test requirements specified in military standards.

explanation_en: Semiconductors with a bandgap width less than 0.26eV.

explanation_cn: 窗干材又称室干材和炉干材。指在特别的建筑物或金属容器内的人工干燥木材。人工干燥是人为地控制干燥介质的温度、湿度及气流速度，主要利用气体介质的对流传热对木材进行干燥处理。窑干按干燥介质温度，可以分为低温干燥（包括低温窑干、常规窑干）和高温窑干。常规干燥和高温千燥介质的温度分别达到95°C以下和100°C以上在中国常用于纺织和乐器行业。常规窑干应用最广，温度对材性的影响较小，高温窑干可分为以湿空气为介质和以过热蒸汽为介质的两种。前者用于车辆、家具、纺织、军工、机械制造等行业，但高温对某些树种（如红松）的某些材性有影响.往往使木材表面变硬，不易刨切、铣削加工，严重时甚至变脆发焦。后者用于干燥针叶树材及材质较软的阔叶树材.千燥速度快效果显著。但对材质较硬、厚度较大的阔叶树材等效果较差。窑干的效果主要是选定适当的千燥基准。中窑干的设备投资大、工艺复杂、成本较高，但干燥快、需时短，可以干燥至任何最终含水率，便于工业生产，干燥效果比天然干燥好。目前主要使用的是窑干材。
explanation_en: Window dry material is also called room dry material and furnace dry material. It refers to manually dried wood in special buildings or metal containers. Artificial drying is to artificially control the temperature, humidity and airflow speed of the drying medium, and mainly use the convection heat transfer of the gas medium to dry wood. Kiln drying can be divided into low-temperature drying (including low-temperature kiln drying and conventional kiln drying) and high-temperature kiln drying according to the temperature of the drying medium. Conventional drying and high-temperature drying media with temperatures below 95 ° C and above 100 ° C are commonly used in the textile and musical instrument industries in China. The conventional kiln drying is the most widely used, and the temperature has little influence on the material properties. The high-temperature kiln drying can be divided into two types: wet air as the medium and overheating steam as the medium. The former is used in vehicle, furniture, textile, military industry, machinery manufacturing and other industries, but high temperature has an impact on some wood properties of some tree species (such as Korean pine), which often makes the surface of wood hard, difficult to plane, milling, and even brittle and charred in serious cases. The latter is used for drying coniferous wood and soft hardwood wood. The drying speed is fast and the effect is significant. However, the effect is poor on hardwood trees with harder materials and thicker thickness. The main effect of kiln drying is to select an appropriate drying standard. The equipment investment of medium kiln drying is large, the process is complex, and the cost is high. However, the drying is fast, the time required is short, and it can be dried to any final moisture content, which is convenient for industrial production. The drying effect is better than natural drying. At present, kiln-dried timber are mainly used.

explanation_cn: 义称窝沟点隙封闭剂。指用以封闭牙齿上的天然窝沟和裂隙（龋齿的好发部位）以达到预防龋齿的目的所用的材料、按固化方式可将分为化学固化和光固化两类。
explanation_en: It means pit and fissure sealant. It refers to the materials used to seal the natural pits and fissures (the prone part of caries) on the teeth to prevent caries. According to the curing method, it can be divided into chemical curing and light curing.

explanation_cn: 又名闪锌矿型结构。是一类以立方ZnS为代表的AB型化合物晶体结构。属立方晶系，面心立方点阵，空间群F-43m，其中B原子(如硫)位于面心立方点阵的结点位置上，A原子(如锌)位于另一套这样的点阵位置上，两者体对角线相对位移量是一比一。
explanation_en: Also known as zinc blende structure. It is a kind of AB type compound crystal structure represented by cubic ZnS. It belongs to cubic crystal system, face centered cubic lattice, and space group F-43m, where atom B (such as sulfur) is located at the node of face centered cubic lattice, and atom A (such as zinc) is located at another set of such lattice positions, and the relative displacement of their body diagonals is one-to-one.

explanation_cn: 化学式为BN,属等轴晶系。晶体为六面体-八面体聚形、八面体等。呈黑棕色细粒结晶状，有时也呈灰色和浅黄色晶体。是一种人造的超硬材料。在自然界中尚未发现。通常以六方氮化硼为原料,以碱金属，碱土金属及其氮化物为催化剂制得(于5GPa和lOO0℃以上的静态超高压高温条件下)，或用爆炸法不加催化剂制得。立方氮化硼的硬度略低于金刚石。而其热稳定性及对铁元素及其合金的化学惰性均优于金刚石。特别适用于加工高硬淬火钢、不锈钢等难加工材料。用于制成磨具和多晶体立方氮化硼车刀，铣刀和钻头等。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is BN, belonging to the equiaxed crystal system. The crystal is a hexahedron octahedron polymer, octahedron, etc. It is dark brown fine-grained crystal, sometimes gray and light yellow crystal. It is an artificial super hard materials. Not yet discovered in nature. It is usually made from hexagonal boron nitride as raw material, with alkali metal, alkaline earth metal and its nitride as catalyst (under static ultra-high pressure and high temperature conditions above 5GPa and lOO0 ℃), or by explosion without catalyst. The hardness of cubic boron nitride is slightly lower than that of diamond. Its thermal stability and chemical inertness to iron and its alloy are better than diamond. It is especially suitable for processing hard to machine materials such as high hardness quenching steel and stainless steel. It is used to make abrasive tools, multi crystal cubic boron nitride turning tools, milling tools and drills.

explanation_cn: 具立方晶体结构的氮化硼薄膜。立方氮化硼(c-BN)是仅次于金刚石的超硬材料，化学稳定性极好，具有高电阻率，髙热导率，掺入某些杂质可以成为半导体。立方氮化硼薄膜可以用低压气相形成金刚石薄膜相似的方法合成。氮比硼(BN)有三种异构体:h-BN,c-BN和w-BN(纤锌矿结构)，它们之间的性能差别很大，b-BN具有与石墨极相似的层状结构，称为"白色石墨"，质地很软。w-BN和c-BN中B、N原子都是彼此形成四配位结构，在硬度方面两者差别不大，都是:硬质膜，可以用于切削刀具。在大气中，c-BN直到lOOO℃也不发生氧化；在真空加热c-BN,直到l1550°C才发生向h-BN的相变。C-BN掺人铍(Be)可成为P型半导体，加入S或Si可得到N型半导体.
explanation_en: Nitriding thin films with cubic crystal structure. Cubic boron nitride (c-BN) is an ultra hard materials second only to diamond. It has excellent chemical stability, high resistivity, and high thermal conductivity. It can become a semiconductor when doped with some impurities. Cubic boron nitride (CBN) films can be synthesized by a method similar to that of forming diamond films in vapor phase at low pressure. There are three isomers of nitrogen to boron (BN): h-BN, c-BN and w-BN (wurtzite structure). Their properties are very different. b-BN has a layered structure very similar to graphite, called "white graphite", and its texture is very soft. In w-BN and c-BN, B and N atoms form a four coordinated structure with each other. There is little difference in hardness between the two. Both are hard film, which can be used for cutting tools. In the atmosphere, c-BN does not undergo oxidation until lOOO ℃; When c-BN is heated in vacuum, the phase transformation to h-BN does not occur until l1550 ° C. C-BN doped with beryllium (Be) can become P-type semiconductors, while adding S or Si can obtain N-type semiconductors

explanation_cn: 稳定的立方浩石晶体具有硬度高,折射率高，色散性强和化学稳定性好等特性。由于其熔点高达2750V，故不能用焰熔法、电弧熔法、等离子喷管技术来生长。Zr02在不同的温度下有三种变体:2300-2750时为立方晶体;1100-2300°C时为四方晶体(P42/nmc)I在<1000℃时为单斜(P21/c）。为了防止生长过程中由于相变而引起的开裂，需在原料中加入稳定剂，以使Zr02保持高温立方相。其物理性质和加人的稳定剂的种类及量有关。立方的氧化锆是一种很有前途的人造宝石，具有广阔的市场，从而具有极高的开发、生产价值。
explanation_en: Stable cubic halloysite crystal has the characteristics of high hardness, high refractive index, strong dispersion and good chemical stability. Because its melting point is up to 2750V, it cannot be grown by flame melting, arc melting or plasma nozzle technology. Zr02 has three variants at different temperatures: 2300-2750 is a cubic crystal; Tetragonal crystal (P42/nmc) at 1100-2300 ° C, monoclinic (P21/c) at<1000 ° C. In order to prevent the cracking caused by phase transformation in the growth process, stabilizer should be added to the raw material to keep Zr02 in a high temperature cubic phase. Its physical properties are related to the type and amount of added stabilizer. Cubic zirconia is a kind of promising artificial gems, which has a broad market and thus has high development and production value.

explanation_cn: 是立构规整聚合物占总聚合物的分数，是评价聚合物性能、引发剂定向聚合能力的一个重要指标。
explanation_en: It is the percentage of stereo regular polymer in the total polymer and an important index to evaluate the performance of polymer and the directional polymerization ability of initiator.

explanation_cn: 链式共聚合时，以某一单体的结构单元为末端的活性链分别与该单体1及参与共聚的另一种单体2的加成反应的速率常数之比。换而言之，竞聚率是自增长速率常数(均聚）与交叉增长速率常数（共聚）的比值。因此根据进料组成和r1、r2的值可用共聚物组成方程求出共聚物组成及分布情况。
explanation_en: In chain copolymerization, the ratio of the rate constants of the addition reaction of the active chain with the structural unit of a monomer as the end, the monomer 1 and the other monomer 2 participating in the copolymerization. In other words, reactivity ratio is the ratio of self growth rate constant (homopolymerization) and cross growth rate constant (copolymerization). Therefore, according to the feed composition and the values of r1 and r2, the composition and distribution of copolymer can be calculated from the composition equation of copolymer.

name_cn: 端叠氮基缩水甘油醚增塑剂
explanation_cn: 简称GAPA增塑剂，一种叠氮基封端的GAP低聚物。通过将GAP中的端羟基用叠氮基取代即可合成出GAPA。GAPA增塑剂为浅黄色液体，氮含量约为49%,密度1.24-1.27g/cm3,数均分子量700-900。GAPA具有感度低、力学性能好、含氮量高、不易渗出等优点，用作增塑剂可明显改善叠氮类推进剂的加工性能和力学性能。使用支链结构GAPA增塑剂的推进剂具有耐迁移、稳定性好等优点。
explanation_en: It is called GAPA plasticizer for short, a GAP oligomer with azide end capping. GAPA can be synthesized by replacing the terminal hydroxyl groups in GAP with azide groups. GAPA plasticizer is a light yellow liquid, with nitrogen content of about 49%, density of 1.24-1.27g/cm3, and average molecular weight of 700-900. GAPA has the advantages of low sensitivity, good mechanical properties, high nitrogen content, and difficult to exude. As a plasticizer, it can significantly improve the processability and mechanical properties of azide propellant. The propellant with branched GAPA plasticizer has the advantages of migration resistance and good stability.

explanation_cn: 是利用基团分析测定聚合物数均分子量的一种方法。高分子链的末端含有特殊的基团（如羧基、羟基、氨基等），且这些基团与分子链其余部分化学结构不同时，可用滴定或其他分析方法定量分析末端基团的数目。由于每一高分子链末端基团数是确定的，因此在一定质量的试样中，就可以借助分析末端基团的数目来计算聚合物的分子量》此法适用的分子量在3×10^4以下。
explanation_en: It is a method to determine the number average molecular weight of polymer by group analysis. When the end of the macromolecule chain contains special groups (such as carboxyl, hydroxyl, amino, etc.), and these groups are different from the chemical structure of the rest of the molecular chain, the number of end groups can be quantitatively analyzed by titration or other analytical methods. Since the number of end groups of each polymer chain is determined, the molecular weight of polymer can be calculated by analyzing the number of end groups in a certain mass of sample × Below 10 ^ 4.

name_cn: 端羟基液体聚丁二烯橡胶
explanation_cn: 指链端含有轻基的低分子量聚丁二烯液体橡胶。端羟基聚丁二烯可采用由基聚合、阴离子活性聚合和阴离子配位聚合的方法合成，用于胶黏剂、涂料、密封材料，填缝材料等。
explanation_en: Low molecular weight polybutadiene liquid rubber with light group at the end of the finger chain. Hydroxyl terminated polybutadiene can be synthesized by radical polymerization, anionic active polymerization and anionic coordination polymerization, and is used as adhesive, coatings, sealing materials, sealing materials, etc.

name_cn: 端羟基聚丁二烯推进剂
explanation_cn: 简称丁轻推进剂，缩写HTPB。以端羟基聚丁二烯（HTPB)为黏合剂的一类复合固体推进剂。HTPB预聚物黏度低，药浆工艺性能好，有利于固体填料的加入，所以制得的推进剂比冲和密度都较高。
explanation_en: Short for HTPB, also known as HTPB. A kind of composition solid propellant with hydroxyl terminated polybutadiene (HTPB) as adhesive. The HTPB prepolymer has low viscosity and good slurry processing performance, which is conducive to the addition of solid filler, so the prepared propellant has high specific impulse and density.

explanation_cn: 以端羟基嵌段共聚醚为黏合剂的一类复合推进剂。缩写为HTPE。该黏合剂由四氢呋喃及乙二醇的低聚物嵌段共聚而成。与高氯酸铵、硝酸铵、硝胺炸药（HMX、RDX)及铝粉制成推进剂的能量水平与HTPB推进剂相当，但氧化剂的用量明显减少并具有突出的低易损性质，是目前唯一可通过各项低易损性考核的固体推进剂，在各类火箭和战术导弹中有十分重要应用价值。
explanation_en: A kind of composite propellant with hydroxyl terminated block copolyether as adhesive. The abbreviation is HTPE. The adhesive is formed by block copolymerization of tetrahydrofuran and ethylene glycol oligomer. The energy level of propellants made of ammonium perchlorate, ammonium nitrate, nitramine explosive (HMX, RDX) and aluminum powder is equivalent to that of HTPB propellants, but the amount of oxidizer is significantly reduced and has outstanding low vulnerability properties. At present, it is the only solid propellant that can pass various low vulnerability assessments, and has very important application value in various rockets and tactical missiles.

name_cn: 端羧基液体聚丁二烯橡胶
explanation_cn: 指链端含有羧基的液体聚丁二烯。采用自由基和阴离子聚合的方法制备，自由基聚合得到的产品羧基官能度可大于2，阴离子聚合产品的聚合物分子量分布窄，官能度等于或小于2。
explanation_en: Refers to liquid polybutadiene with carboxyl groups at the end of the chain. The product is prepared by free radical and anion polymerization. The carboxyl functionality of the product obtained by free radical polymerization can be greater than 2. The molecular weight distribution of the polymer of the anion polymerization product is narrow, and the functionality is equal to or less than 2.

name_cn: 端羧基聚丁二烯推进剂
explanation_cn: 缩写CTPB,又称遥爪丁羧推进剂。以端羧基聚丁二烯为黏合剂的一类复合固体推进剂。
explanation_en: Abbreviation CTPB, also known as teleclawed polycarboxylate propellant. A kind of composition solid propellant with carboxyl terminated polybutadiene as adhesive.

explanation_cn: 一种典型的碎屑陈屑灰岩。其特点是砾石呈圆形、橢圆形扁平状，平行层理排列，砾石在截面上呈竹叶状形态。砾石大小不一(一般长几厘米至十几厘米），成分相对单一（多为泥晶方解石），边缘有一层黄或紫红色的氧化铁质色圈。胶结物为微晶或细晶方解石，局部有白云化现象。我国华北地区寒武系、奥陶系地层中广泛分布。
explanation_en: A typical type of clastic limestone. It is characterized by that gravel is round, oval and flat, arranged parallel to bedding, and gravel is in bamboo leaf shape on the section. Gravel vary in size (generally several centimeters to more than ten centimeters long), have relatively single composition (mostly argillaceous caldte), and have a yellow or purplish red iron oxide color circle on the edge. The cement is microcrystalline or fine-grained caldte with local dolomitization. The Cambrian and Ordovician strata are widely distributed in North China.

explanation_cn: 将竹材、木材加工成的各种片状材料，组坯胶压制成的胶合板。
explanation_en: Plywood is made of various sheet materials processed from bamboo and wood and laminated with glue.

explanation_cn: 岛状结构硅酸盐矿物。化学式为Ca10(Mg，Fe)2Al4[SiO4]5[Si207]2(OH，F)4。四方晶系，短柱状晶体。黄褐色，含铬时呈绿色，含钛和锰时呈红褐或粉红色，含铜时呈绿蓝色。玻璃光泽，莫氏硬度6.5-7，性脆，密度3.33-3.43g/cm3。
explanation_en: Island structure silicate mineral. The chemical formula is Ca10 (Mg, Fe) 2Al4 [SiO4] 5 [Si207] 2 (OH, F) 4. Tetragonal crystal system, short columnar crystal. Yellow brown, green when containing chromium, reddish brown or pink when containing titanium and manganese, and green blue when containing copper. Glass luster, Mohs hardness 6.5-7, brittle, density 3.33-3.43g/cm3.

explanation_cn: 聚变堆第一壁部件用材料。又称面向等离子体材料（plasma-facingmaterials)。以目前比较成熟的托卡马克（Tokamak)反应堆概念为例，第一壁部件包括：①第一壁，形成等离子体真空室的容器壁；②孔栏，限定等离子体边界的部件，也可以兼作杂质控制系统；③偏滤器，杂质控制系统；④其他部件，如中性束流注入区（beamdump)、诊断窗口及内衬板（armor)等。
explanation_en: Materials for the first wall of fusion reactor. Also known as facing plasma materials. Taking the relatively mature Tokamak reactor concept as an example, the first wall components include: ① the first wall, the vessel wall that forms the plasma vacuum chamber; ② Hole bars, components that define plasma boundaries, can also serve as impurity control systems; ③ Deflector, impurity control system; ④ Other components, such as the neutral beam injection zone (beamdump), diagnostic window, and inner lining plate (armor).

name_cn: 第一壁表面覆盖层材料
explanation_cn: 聚变堆第一壁材料表面上的低原子序数覆盖层材料。其中高原子序数成分的第一壁材料在等离子体离子和中性粒子的作用下发生溅射，溅射射产物进入等离子体引起的热辐射损失随着材料原子序数Z的增加急剧上升，并容易引发等离子体的破裂，在第一壁基体材料上覆盖一层低原子序数材料，可减轻等离子体的污染，结构功能则由基体材料承担，使第一壁材料的选择更为灵活
explanation_en: Low atomic number coating materials on the surface of first-wall materials of fusion reactor. The first-wall materials with high atomic number components is sputtering under the action of plasma ions and neutral particles. The thermal radiation loss caused by sputtering products entering the plasma rises sharply with the increase of materials atomic number Z, and is easy to cause plasma rupture. The first wall matrix materials is covered with a layer of low atomic number materials, which can reduce plasma pollution. The structure and function are assumed by the matrix materials, Make the selection of first-wall materials more flexible

explanation_cn: 黏弹性流体流动时，流动方向的法向应力与垂直方向的法向应力之差，该值通常为正值，且较大，也被称为主法向应力差。常用来描述材料的弹性行为，该值越大表明弹性越大。
explanation_en: When viscoelasticity fluid flows, the difference between the normal stress in the flow direction and the normal stress in the vertical direction is usually positive and large, which is also called the main normal stress difference. It is often used to describe the elasticity behavior of materials. The higher the value, the greater the elasticity.

explanation_cn: 组分超晶格按带边结构可分为三大类。能隙差ΔEg=导带偏移ΔEc+价带偏移ΔEv者称为第一类超晶格。其特点是电子势阱和空穴势阱都位于窄带材料中。
explanation_en: Constituent superlattices can be divided into three major categories based on band edge structures. Energy gap difference Δ Eg=conduction band offset Δ Ec+valence band offset Δ Ev is called the type I superlattice. Its characteristic is that both the electron potential well and the hole potential well are located in the narrow band materials.

explanation_cn: 由宽带隙半导体CdTe和零带隙半导体HgTe可构成第三类超晶格，其能隙差ΔEg由最低的导带子能带和价带子能带的距离决定。只有当超晶格的周期小于某一定值时，CdTe-HgTe超晶格才具有半导体特性，否则将具有半金属性。
explanation_en: The type III superlattice can be formed by the wide band gap semiconductor CdTe and the zero band gap semiconductor HgTe, and its energy gap difference Δ Eg is determined by the distance between the lowest conduction band and the valence band band. Only when the period of the superlattice is less than a certain value, can CdTe HgTe superlattice possess semiconductor properties, otherwise it will have semi metallic properties.

explanation_cn: 黏弹性流体流动时，与流动方向垂直的两个方向上的法向应力之差，该值通常为负值，且一般小于第一法向应力差。常用来描述材料的弹性行为。
explanation_en: When viscoelasticity fluid flows, the difference between the normal stress in two directions perpendicular to the flow direction is usually negative and generally less than the first normal stress difference. It is often used to describe the elasticity behavior of materials.

explanation_cn: 组分超晶格按带边结构可分为三大类。能隙差么ΔE=导带偏移ΔEc-价带偏移ΔEv的绝对值称为第二类超晶格，其特点是电子和空穴势阱不在同一种材料中，电子和空穴将在空间上分离从而形成真实空间间接带隙材料。
explanation_en: Constituent superlattices can be divided into three major categories based on band edge structures. Is there a difference in energy gap Δ E=conduction band offset Δ Ec valence band offset Δ The absolute value of Ev is called type II superlattice, which is characterized by the fact that the electron and hole potential wells are not in the same materials, and the electron and hole will be spatially separated to form a real space indirect band gap materials.

explanation_cn: 一种包含有机-无机杂化结构的纳米材料。由Si-O-Si组成的八元环无机白核，在其八个顶角上的Si原子连接的基团R可带多种反应性或非反应性的有机取代基团，如羟基、酚基、烷氧基、氯硅烷、环氧基、醋基、卤、异氰酸酯、甲基丙烯酸、烷基、环烷基、氰基、降冰片基、烯烃基、磷化氢、硅烷、硅醇和苯乙烯等。具有很强的结构对称性，使得POSS与聚合物及生物体系相容很好，且有利于分子结构的设计。
explanation_en: The invention relates to a nanomaterials containing an organic-inorganic hybrid structure. The eight membered ring inorganic white nucleus composed of Si-O-Si can have a variety of reactive or non reactive organic substituents, such as hydroxyl, phenolic, alkoxy, chloro silane, epoxy, acetic, halogen, isocyanate, methacrylic acid, alkyl, cycloalkyl, cyano, norbornyl, alkenyl, phosphine, silane, silanol, styrene, etc. With strong structural symmetry, POSS is well compatible with polymer and biological systems, and is conducive to the design of molecular structures.

explanation_cn: 分子结构为笼形且含有多个硝基的化合物。系高能量密度材料(HEDM)，如多硝基多面体烷、多环笼形硝铵等。结构对称，密度高，爆炸性能优异。已经合成的多硝基多面体烷有1,4-二硝基立方烷、1,3,5-硝基立方烷、1，3,5.7-四硝基立方烷、六硝基立方烷、四硝基二高立方烷、四硝基二高五棱晶烷、六硝基-Cs-三高立方院、六硝基-Ds-三高立方院、四硝基金刚烷等。美国曾设计出三个多环笼形硝胺，即六硝基六氮杂金刚烷、六硝基六氮杂伍尔兹烷及六硝基六氮杂异伍尔兹烷，三者的密度均可达2.0g/cm3以上(比奥克托今高10%)，爆压为9.4-9.5km/s(比奥克托今高4%),爆压为42.0-43.OGPa(比奥克托今高8%)。笼形多硝基化合物可用于高能量密度推进剂、水下装药、高穿透能力的锥形装药及核武器装药等，并将对武器系统性能产生重大的影响。
explanation_en: A compound with a cage shaped molecular structure and containing multiple nitro groups. It is a high energy density materials (HEDM), such as polynitropolyhedral alkanes, polycyclic cage ammonium nitrate, etc. Symmetric structure, high density, excellent explosion performance. The synthesized polynitropolyhedral alkanes include 1,4-dinitrocubane, 1,3,5-nitrcubane, 1,3,5.7 tetranitrocubane, hexanitrocubane, tetranitrodihomocubane, tetranitrodihomopentagonane, hexanitro-Cs-trihomocubane, hexanitro-Ds-trihomocubane, tetranitroadamantane, etc. The United States has designed three polycyclic caged nitramine, namely, hexanitrohexaazaadamantane, hexanitrohexaazawurzane and HNIW. The density of the three nitramine can reach more than 2.0g/cm3 (10% higher than that of Octogen), the detonation pressure is 9.4-9.5km/s (4% higher than that of Octogen), and the detonation pressure is 42.0-43.OGPa (8% higher than that of Octogen). Caged polynitrocompound can be used in high energy density propellants, underwater charges, high penetration cone charges and nuclear weapon charges, and will have a significant impact on the performance of weapon systems.

explanation_cn: 同高分子稀溶液内一个包含束缚溶剂的无规线团状高分子链体积相等的球。
explanation_en: A ball with the same volume as a random coil like macromolecule chain containing binding solvent in dilute macromolecule solution.

explanation_cn: 又称贝氏体等温淬火。将钢加热奥氏体化后淬人温度稍高于ACA的冷却介质中.等温保持使钢发生下贝氏体相变，然后冷却至室温的淬火硬化处理工艺，与马氏体组织相比.在强度和硬度相同的情况下.下贝氏体组织具有更高的韧性，但通常化学成分的钢中连续冷却不能得到下贝氏体，故需采用等温淬火。等温淬火的等温温度在下贝氏体转变温度范围，一般为250-400℃，等温时间则根据钢的等温曲线或S曲线确定。等温泮火适用于要求较高硬度和较高轫性的合金钢及高碳钢制作的机械零件。
explanation_en: It is also called austempering. The quenching hardening process of heating and austenitizing steel and quenching it into a cooling medium whose temperature is slightly higher than ACA. Isothermal holding makes steel undergo lower bainitic transformation, and then cooling it to room temperature. Compared with martensite structure, lower bainite structure has higher toughness under the condition of the same strength and hardness, but lower bainite cannot be obtained by continuous cooling in steel with normal chemical composition, so isothermal quenching is required. The isothermal temperature of isothermal quenching is in the lower bainitic transformation temperature range, generally 250-400 ℃, and the isothermal time is determined according to the isothermal curve or S curve of steel. Isothermal pan fire is applicable to mechanical parts made of alloy steel and high-carbon steel requiring higher hardness and higher toughness.

explanation_cn: 根据等温纺丝中来自喷丝口的纤维状熔体所受的单轴拉伸应力和产生的拉伸应变速率所计算的拉伸黏度称为等温纺丝拉伸黏度。
explanation_en: The tensile viscosity calculated according to the uniaxial tensile stress and the tensile strain rate of the fibrous melt from the spinneret in isothermal spinning is called tensile viscosity by isothermal spinning.

explanation_cn: 将钢件加热到临界温度以上（亚共析钢加热到以上，共析钢和过共析钢加热到Ad以上）保温一定时间，使其奥氏体化，然后冷却到稍低于Ad的温度进行等温，等温保持足够时间使奥氏体转变成珠光体后出炉冷却（为防止钢件产生热应力，通常采用空冷）的热处理工艺。等温退火与完全退火的目的相同，但转变易于控制，能够获得预期的均匀组织，对合金钢来说还易于得到比较低的硬度，节省钢件在炉内的时间，增加退火炉的周转率。钢的等温转变温度应根据所要求的组织和性能依据该钢种的等温转变曲线来确定，等温温度越高，所获得的珠光体越粗大，硬度越低。
explanation_en: Heat steel parts to above the critical temperature (hypo-eutectoid steel to above, eutectoid steel and hyper eutectoid steel to above Ad) for a certain period of time to make them austenitization, and then cool them to a temperature slightly lower than Ad for isothermal. Hold the isothermal temperature for enough time to transform austenite into pearlite and then cool them out of the furnace (air cooling is usually used to prevent steel parts from generating thermal stress). The purpose of isothermal annealing is the same as that of full annealing, but the transformation is easy to control, and the expected uniform structure can be obtained. For alloy steel, it is also easy to obtain relatively low hardness, save the time of steel parts in the furnace, and increase the turnover rate of annealing furnace. The isothermal transformation temperature of steel shall be determined according to the required microstructure and properties and the isothermal transformation curve of the steel. The higher the isothermal temperature, the thicker the pearlite obtained and the lower the hardness.

explanation_cn: 具有等量正电荷和负电荷的离子气体称为等离子体。在刻蚀工艺中，用于产生等离子体的气体称为等离子体刻蚀材料。如在二氧化硅刻蚀中，通常使用含氟的等离子体刻蚀气体，如四氟化碳（CF4)、三氟甲烷(CHF3)等来进行等离子体刻蚀。
explanation_en: Ionic gases with equal amounts of positive and negative charges are called plasmas. In the etching process, the gas used to generate plasma is called plasma dry etch materials. In silicon dioxide etching, fluorinated plasma etching gases such as carbon tetrafluoride (CF4) and trifluoromethane (CHF3) are usually used for plasma etching.

explanation_cn: 又称电浆显示器。是继CRT(阴极射线管）、LCD(液晶显示器）后的新一代显示器，其特点是厚度极薄，分辨率I佳。其工作原理类似普通U光灯和电视彩色图像，由各个独立的荧光粉像素发光组合而成.因此图像鲜艳、明亮、干净而清晰。另外，等离子体显示设备最突出的特点是可做到超薄，可轻易做到40m?以上的完全平面大屏幕，而厚度不到100mm,,
explanation_en: Also known as plasma display. It is a new generation of display after CRT (cathode ray tube) and LCD (liquid crystal display), characterized by extremely thin thickness and excellent resolution. Its working principle is similar to that of ordinary U-light and TV color images, and it is composed of individual phosphor pixels luminescence, so the image is bright, bright, clean and clear. In addition, the most prominent feature of plasma display devices is their ability to achieve ultra-thin, easily reaching 40m? The above fully flat large screen, with a thickness of less than 100mm,,

explanation_cn: 又称等离子培炼，是利用电能产生的等离子弧作为热源的电热冶金方法.具有熔炼温度高、物料反应速率快的特点，用于熔炼、精炼、重熔高熔点金属和合金。
explanation_en: Also known as plasma smelting, it is an electrothermal metallurgical method that uses the plasma arc generated by electric energy as the heat source. It has the characteristics of high melting temperature and fast material reaction rate, and is used for melting, refining, and remelting high melting point metals and alloy.

name_en: powder preparation by plasma synthetic method
explanation_cn: 以等离子体为加热手段的一种气相反应制备粉体的方法。目前常用的有直流电弧等离子体和高频感应等离子体。高频感应等离子体反应器主要由绕有感应线圈的石英管（等离子管）、反应腔和冷却腔组成。通过感应线圈向等离子管中提供能量，通人等离子管的稳定氩气流就形成等离子焰，并向反应腔中提供稳定的尾焰。将反应气体导人该尾焰中，等离子焰就可以把气体加热到的高温，使之解离为原子或离子状态，再从这种状态经冷却过程后反应合成超细粉末.该方法的特点：①感应等离子合成法给气相反应提供一个非常干净的反应环境，因此产物是高纯的；但直流电弧等离子体存在来自电极的污染；②等离子焰的温度极高，可以形成很陡的温度梯度，从而产生极快的冷却速度，因此可以制备粒径分布范围窄的超细粉末。该法主要用于制备液相法和固相法不易直接得到的非氧化物陶瓷粉末。
explanation_en: A gas phase reaction method for preparing powders using plasma as a heating method. Currently, commonly used are DC arc plasma and high-frequency induction plasma. The high-frequency induction plasma reactor mainly consists of a quartz tube (plasma tube) surrounded by an induction coil, a reaction chamber, and a cooling chamber. By providing energy to the plasma tube through an induction coil, a stable argon flow through the plasma tube forms a plasma flame and provides a stable tail flame to the reaction chamber. When the reaction gas is introduced into the tail flame, the plasma flame can heat the gas to a high temperature, dissociate it into an atomic or ionic state, and then react from this state to synthesize ultrafine powder after the cooling process. The characteristics of this method: ① The induction plasma synthesis method provides a very clean reaction environment for the gas phase reaction, so the product is highly pure; However, there is contamination from the electrode in the DC arc plasma; ② The temperature of the plasma flame is extremely high, which can form a very steep temperature gradient, resulting in an extremely fast cooling rate, so it can prepare ultra-fine powder with narrow particle size distribution. This method is mainly used to prepare non oxide ceramics powder which is not easy to be obtained directly by liquid phase method and solid phase method.

explanation_cn: 采用由直流电驱动的等离子电弧作为热源，将陶瓷、合金、金属等材料加热到熔融或半熔融状态，并以高速喷向经过预处理的工件表面而形成附着牢固的表面层的一种技术。它是一种材料表面强化和表面改性的技术，可以使基体表面具有耐磨、耐蚀、耐高温氧化、电绝缘、隔热、防辐射、减磨和密封等性能.并且具有生产率高，气孔率低（1%-1.5%),涂层致密，黏结强度高(16?80MPa),超高温特性（等离子弧焰温度高达15000-20000K),喷射粒子的速度高（焰流速度最高达1000-2000m/S,粉末，粒子飞行速度一般在200m/s左右，高能等离子喷涂则可达610m/s),喷涂材料不易氧化，喷涂材料来源广、成本低等优点.可制备高耐磨、耐蚀、抗高温氧化、绝缘、热障、超导、密封、润滑等功能性涂层，应用于航天航空、钢铁冶金、机械制造、机车车辆及医疗等领域。
explanation_en: The plasma arc driven by DC is used as the heat source to heat materials such as ceramics, alloy and metals to the molten or semi molten state, and spray them at high speed to the surface of the pretreated workpiece to form a firmly attached surface layer. It is a technology of surface of materials strengthening and surface modification, which can make the surface of matrix have the properties of wear resistance, corrosion resistance, high temperalure oxidation resistance, electrical insulation, heat insulation, radiation protection, wear reduction and sealing. It also has high productivity, low porosity (1% -1.5%), dense coating, high bonding strength (16? 80MPa), and ultra-high temperature (plasma arc temperature up to 15000-2000K), The velocity of sprayed particles is high (the flame flow velocity is up to 1000-2000m/S, the powder, the particle flight velocity is generally about 200m/s, and the high-energy plasma spraying can reach 610m/s). The sprayed materials is not easy to oxidize, and the spraying materials has a wide source and low cost. It can prepare functional coatings with high wear resistance, corrosion resistance, high temperalure oxidation resistance, insulation, thermal barrier, superconductivity, sealing, lubrication, etc., which are used in aerospace, iron and steel metallurgy, machinery manufacturing Rolling stock and medical fields.

explanation_cn: 利用等离子喷涂材料表面强化和表面改性的技术，使基体材料表面活化并使其具有生物活性。如在金属植人体（关节、齿根等）表面喷涂一层数十微米的具有生物活性的羟基磷灰石（HA)涂层，作为改善金属植入体表面生物活性、提高植入体与宿主骨的结合强度和骨传导特性的方法。常用的生物活性涂层材料有生物活性陶瓷，如羟基磷灰石(HA)、磷酸二钙（TCP)及生物活性玻璃陶瓷(BGC)等。
explanation_en: The surface of materials strengthening and surface modification technology of plasma spraying is used to activation or conditioning the surface of materials of matrix and make it bioactivity. For example, a layer of tens of microns of bioactivity hydroxyapatite (HA) coating is sprayed on the surface of the metal implant body (joint, tooth root, etc.) as a method to improve the bioactivity of the surface of the metal implant, the bonding strength between the implant and the host bone, and the osteoconduction characteristics. The commonly used bioactive coating materials are bioactiw ceramics, such as hydroxyapatite (HA), dicalcium phosphate (TCP) and bioactive glass-ceramics (BGC).

name_cn: 等离子喷涂钛多孔表面
explanation_cn: 在惰性气体保护或真空环境下，采用等离子喷涂技术在医用金属基体表面沉积钛形成的多孔表面。植入体内后，这种钛多孔表面更有利于血管和组织的长入，使得植入体与组织结合得更为紧密，可促进骨修复效果。
explanation_en: Porous surface formed by titanium deposition on medical metal matrix by plasma spraying under inert gas protection or vacuum environment. After being implanted into the body, this porous titanium surface is more conducive to the growth of blood vessels and tissues, making the implant more closely integrated with the tissue, which can promote the bone repair effect.

name_cn: 等离子增强沉积活化改性
name_en: bioactivation modification by plasma enhanced deposition
explanation_cn: 将等离子体中的离子引出可以形成离子束.从而进行离子束溅射、离子束沉积或离子束辅助沉积以及离子注人等；利用等离子体中高速电子与其他粒子之间具有的碰撞与电离作用，可以离化气体分子，形成离子.直接用于沉积；等离子体中的电离使化学反应的活化能降低，从而可以使原本需要在高温下进行的反应在较低温度下即可进行，实现低温化学气相沉积。等离子体技术与其他技术的结合在材料表面改性领域获得越来越多的应用。
explanation_en: The ions in the plasma can be extracted to form an ion beam for ion beam sputtering, ion team deposition or ion beam assisted deposition and ion implantation; By utilizing the collision and ionization effects between high-speed electrons and other particles in plasma, gas molecules can be ionized to form ions, which can be directly used for deposition; The ionization in the plasma reduces the activation or conditioning energy of the chemical reaction, so that the reaction that originally needed to be carried out at high temperature can be carried out at a lower temperature to achieve low temperature chemical vapor deposition. The combination of plasma technology and other technologies has gained more and more applications in the field of surface of materials modification.

explanation_cn: 利用建立在辑极与工件（转移型电弧）之间、钨极与喷嘴（非转移型电弧）之间或上述两者同时存在（联合型电弧）的自由电弧经机械压缩、热收缩或磁收缩而成为高功率密度的等离子弧作为热源的一种焊接方法。实质上它是钨极气体保护电弧焊方法的发展，两者相比，所用设备类似，但等离子弧焊具有能量集中、熔深大、焊缝窄、焊速高、变形小、允许弧长有较大变化、无钨夹杂等优点。
explanation_en: It is a weld method that uses the free arc established between the electrode collector and the workpiece (transfer arc), between the tungsten electrode and the nozzle (non transfer arc) or both of the above (combined arc) to become a high power density plasma arc as the heat source through mechanical compression, thermal contraction or magnetic contraction. In essence, it is the development of tungsten gas shielded arc welding method. Compared with the two, the equipment used is similar, but plasma arc welding has the advantages of energy concentration, large penetration, narrow weld, high welding speed, small deformation, large change in allowable arc length, and no tungsten inclusion.

explanation_cn: 见等离子冶金。
explanation_en: See plasma metallurgy.

explanation_cn: 利用低温等离子体中的电子、离子、自由基以及其他激发态分子等活性粒子引发单体聚合而得到的聚合膜、涂层等。等离子体聚合是一种用等离子体使气体分子聚合的方法，通常是在真空条件下将气态单体通人等离子体反应器中，在室温下进行聚合。等离子体聚合不需要单体带有双键等特定官能团，常规情况下不能聚合的烷烃和芳烃等也可以进行等离子体聚合，其聚合机理非常复杂，目前尚有较大的争论，但有证据证明，等离子体聚合过程中有自由基产生，因此它是自由基聚合反应。生成的聚合物沉积在反应板上，得到的往往是高度支化的聚合物薄膜或涂层等，具有高密度网络结构，其机械强度、化学稳定性和热稳定性均很好，可用作反渗透膜、光学仪器的涂层、半导体的绝缘层、涂料等。
explanation_en: Monomer polymerization is initiated by active particles such as electrons, ions, free radicals and other excited molecules in low-temperature plasma to obtain polymerization films, coatings, etc. Plasma polymerization is a method of polymerization of gas molecules with plasma. Usually, gaseous monomer is introduced into the plasma reactor under vacuum conditions, and polymerization is carried out at room temperature. Plasma polymerization does not need specific functional groups such as monomer with double bonds. Under normal circumstances, alkanes and aromatics that cannot be polymerization can also be plasma polymerization. Its polymerization mechanism is very complex, and there is still much debate at present. However, there is evidence that free radicals are generated in the process of plasma polymerization, so it is a free radical polymerization reaction. The generated polymer is deposited on the reaction plate to obtain highly branched polymer film or coating, which has a high density network structure and good mechanical strength, chemical stability and thermal stability. It can be used as reverse osmosis membrane, optical instrument coating, semiconductor insulation layer, coatings, etc.

explanation_cn: 由卜丁烯经均聚或与少量cr烯烃共聚而成热塑性树脂。其乙基侧链沿聚合物主链在空间呈有序排列成立体规整的线型聚合物。
explanation_en: Thermoplastic resin is prepared by homopolymerization of butylene or copolymerization with a small amount of cr olefin. Its ethyl side chain is spatially orderly arranged along the main chain of the polymer to form a stereo regular linear polymer.

explanation_cn: 见聚丙烯。
explanation_en: See polypropylene.

explanation_cn: 把被加工物体放置于盛满液体的密闭容器中，通过增压系统进行逐步加压对各个表面施加以相等的压力使粉末致密化的方法。等静压制是伴随现代粉末冶金技术兴起而发展起来的一种新的成形方法。通常，等静压成形按其特性分成冷等静压和热等静压。前者常用水或油作压力介质，故称为液静压、水静压或油水静压之称；后者常用气体（如氩气）作为压力介质，固有气体热等静压之称。一般工业生产用热等静压机压力为150-200MPa,温度为1500°C。热等静压主要应用于：高性能粉末制品的成型，如粉末冶金高温合金、粉末冶金高速钢和陶瓷材料等；消除硬质合金、铸件或使用过的构件的内部缺陷；固态材料的黏结，如金属与金属、陶瓷或纤维复合材料的黏结等。
explanation_en: It is a method of densification of powder by placing the processed object in a closed container full of liquid and gradually pressurizing each surface with equal pressure through the pressurization system. Isostatic pressing is a new forming method developed with the rise of modern powder metallurgy technology. Generally, isostatic pressing is divided into cold isostatic pressing and hot isostatic pressing according to its characteristics. The former is commonly used as a pressure medium with water or oil, hence it is referred to as hydrostatic pressure, hydrostatic pressure, or oil-water hydrostatic pressure; The latter often uses gas (such as argon) as the pressure medium, and is known as inherent gas hot isostatic pressing. The pressure of the hot isostatic press used in general industrial production is 150-200MPa, and the temperature is 1500 ° C. Hot isostatic pressing (HIP) is mainly applied to the molding of high-performance powder products, such as powder metallurgy high temperature alloy, powder metallurgy high speed steel and ceramics materials; Eliminate the internal defects of hardmetal, castings or used components; Bonding of solid materials, such as metal to metal, ceramics or fiber composite materials.

explanation_cn: 当 n 型 (P型〉半导体的掺杂浓度很高时，费米能级接近甚至处在导带底之上（价带顶之下），必须用费米狄拉克统计分布来描述导带中的电子或价带中的空穴的统计分布。
explanation_en: When the doping concentration of n-type (P-type) semiconductors is very high, the Fermi level is close to or even above the bottom of the conduction band (below the top of the valence band), and the Fermi Dirac statistical distribution must be used to describe the statistical distribution of electrons in the conduction band or holes in the valence band.

explanation_cn: 水平地放置在两支撑上的高分子材料试样，由具有一定位能的摆锤一次摆动使试样破坏。用断裂时单位面枳上所消耗的功。单位用kJ/m2表示。
explanation_en: The macromolecule materials sample horizontally placed on two supports is destroyed by a swing of a pendulum with a certain potential energy. Use the work consumed per unit area when fracture. The unit is expressed in kJ/m2.

explanation_cn: 铝箔轧制是一种特殊的冷轧，双零箔是在无辊缝条件下轧制。当前可生产的轧制箔的最大宽度为2150 mm，最薄厚度为0.0045 mm负偏差。轧制箔材所用的坯料有两类，一类是采用铁模、水冷模或半连续铸造法所生产的铸锭，经轧制而获得的一定厚度带材。另一类是采用连铸连轧方法所生产的带材。
explanation_en: Aluminum foil rolling is a special kind of cold rolling. Double zero foil is rolling without roll gap. At present, the maximum width of rolling foil that can be produced is 2150 mm, and the minimum thickness is 0.0045 mm minus deviation. There are two types of billets used for rolling foil. One is the ingot produced by iron mold, water-cooled mold or semi continuous casting, and the strip of certain thickness is obtained by rolling. The other is the strip produced by continuous casting and rolling.

explanation_cn: 又称虹吸管层流冷却，是控制冷却应用的一种冷却方式。将数个装有U形管的集管安置在输出辊道的上方，组成一个数十米到上百米的冷却带，整个冷却带又分为几个冷却段。通过控制水流量、冷却段开启数目、辊道速度可控制冷却速度和终止冷却温度。从U形管流下的柱状水流必须具有一定的冲击力，以冲破钢板上的水层和蒸汽膜，提高冷却效率。
explanation_en: Also known as siphon laminar cooling, it is a cooling method for controlled cooling applications. Place several U-shaped pipes above the output roller table to form a cooling strip ranging from tens of meters to hundreds of meters, and the entire cooling strip is divided into several cooling sections. By controlling the water flow rate, the number of cooling sections opened, and the roller speed, the cooling speed and termination cooling temperature can be controlled. The columnar water flow under the U-shaped pipe must have a certain impact force to break through the water layer and steam film on the steel plate and improve the cooling efficiency.

explanation_cn: 用于制作石油天然气田的集输和油气输送管道的工程结构钢板材。我国国家标准GB21237-2007和GB/T14164-2013分别对管线钢宽厚钢板和宽钢带的技术要求具有明确规定，采用首字母L表示管线钢宽厚钢板。
explanation_en: It is used to make engineering structural steel plates for gathering and transmission of oil and gas fields and oil and gas transmission pipelines. Our national standards GB21237-2007 and GB/T14164-2013 clearly stipulate the technical requirements of pipe line steel wide and thick steel plate and wide steel strip respectively, and the initial L is used to indicate pipe line steel wide and thick steel plate.

explanation_cn: 高分子主链在高分子浓溶液、熔体、凝胶及交联高分子的缠结或交联网络中运动时，由于运动模式受到较大限制，只能沿着自身链的方向进行运动，类似于一条蛇在长洞中蠕动，可形象的将该限制分子运动的缠结或者交联点看作一根管道，而这根管道的轴大致沿着高分子链的围线，称之为管道模型。
explanation_en: When the main chain of macromolecule moves in the entanglement or crosslinking network of macromolecule concentrated solution, melt, gel and crosslinking macromolecule, because the movement mode is greatly limited, it can only move in the direction of its own chain, similar to a snake wriggling in a long hole, which can visually regard the entanglement or crosslinking point that restricts the movement of the molecule as a pipe, and the axis of this pipe roughly follows the contour of the macromolecule chain, which is called the tube model.

explanation_cn: 在生产瓦愣纸板、纸盒等制品时，作为面层材料的纸板。目前生产的主要原料为废纸。具有较好的抗压强度和耐破性能。
explanation_en: Board used as surface materials in the production of corrugated board, carton and other products. The main raw material currently produced is waste paper. It has good compressive strength and burst resistance.

explanation_cn: 又称i-c膜。碳的一种亚稳态，组成主要是碳，也含有氢，其含量随工艺条件而异，最多时可达20%。类金刚石大部分为非晶结构，但在局部区域中，也能观察到多晶和单晶衍射谱与立方相对应，其点阵常数对应0.34-0.67nm。
explanation_en: Also called i-c film. A metastable state of carbon, mainly composed of carbon and also containing hydrogen. Its content varies with process conditions, up to 20% at most. Most of the diamond are amorphous, but in local areas, polycrystal and single crystal diffraction spectra correspond to cubic, and their lattice constants correspond to 0.34-0.67nm.

explanation_cn: 一种利用黏附力，将改性剂覆盖于粉体表面进行包膜，可达到不同颗粒间混合的方法。最理想的包覆工艺是控制沉淀时非均匀成核生长，即控制包覆层物质以被覆颗粒为成核基体进行生长，从而实现包覆颗粒的目的。
explanation_en: A method of using adhesive force to cover the surface of powder with a modifier for coating, which can achieve mixing between different particles. The most ideal coating process is to control the uneven nucleation and growth during precipitation, that is, to control the growth of cladding layer material with the coated particles as the nucleation matrix, so as to achieve the purpose of coating particles.

explanation_cn: 解决超细粉体团聚的一种最重要的途径，其主要目的是改善粉体的表面化学与物理特性，在提高粉体在介质中的分散性、降低粉体的团聚程度的同时，赋予材料新的特性。
explanation_en: One of the most important ways to solve the agglomeration of ultra-fine powder, its main purpose is to improve the surface chemical and physical properties of the powder, improve the dispersion of the powder in the medium, reduce the degree of agglomeration of the powder, and endow materials with new properties.

explanation_cn: 根据应用需要对粉体粒子进行新的加工，在一定程度上改善或提高粒子的表面特性，如表面能、表面电性等，从而赋予粒子新的机能。粉体改性后的表面性质即为粒子的特性，也是人们所期望的特性。
explanation_en: New processing shall be carried out for the powder particles according to the application needs to improve or enhance the surface characteristics of particles to a certain extent, such as surface energy, surface electricity, etc., so as to endow the particles with new functions. The surface properties after powder modification are the properties of particles, which are also expected by people.

explanation_cn: 一种线条纤秀、画面工整、色彩柔和、绚丽粉润、形象逼真的传统陶瓷釉上彩装饰方法。
explanation_en: A glaze decoration method for traditional ceramics with delicate lines, neat pictures, soft colors, gorgeous powder and vivid images.

explanation_cn: 粉末体简称粉末，是由大量颗粒及颗粒之间的空隙所构成的集合体。自然界的物质按物态可以分为固态、液态和气态，而同态物质按分散程度不同分为致密体、粉末体和胶体三类，即大小在1mm以上的称为致密体或常说的固体，0.1μm以下的称为胶体，而介于两者之间的称为粉末体。
explanation_en: Powder body is called powder for short, which is an aggregate composed of a large number of particles and spaces between particles. The substances in nature can be divided into solid, liquid and gas states according to their physical states, while homomorphic substances can be divided into three categories according to the degree of dispersion: dense body, powder body and colloid, that is, those with a size of more than 1mm are called dense body or commonly referred to as solid, 0.1 μ Those below m are called colloids, while those between the two are called powders.

explanation_cn: 指制取金属粉末或用金属粉末（或非金属粉末）作原材料，经成形和烧结，得到具有所需形状和性能的材料与制品的工艺技术。它既是一种能生产具有特殊性能材料的技术，如多孔材料、硬质合金及超硬材料、摩擦材料、电工材料；又是一种制造廉价优质机械零件的少切削、无切削加工工艺，如机械结构零件。
explanation_en: It refers to the process technology of making metal powder or using metal powder (or non-metallic powder) as raw materials, forming and sintering to obtain materials and products with required shape and performance. It is a technology that can produce materials with special properties, such as porous materials, hardmetal and superhard materials, friction materials, and electrical materials; It is also a low cutting and no cutting machining process for manufacturing cheap and high-quality mechanical parts, such as mechanical structural parts.

explanation_cn: 表征金属粉末在规定的压制条件下被压紧的能力，粉末在压制过程中塑性变形的能力。压缩性的测定是在封闭模具中采用单轴双向压制，在规定的润滑条件下压成压坯，用压坯密度衡量粉末压缩性。
explanation_en: Characterize the ability of metal powder to be compacted under specified pressing conditions, and the ability of powder to plastic deformation during pressing. The measurement of compressibility is to use uniaxial double-action pressing in a closed mold, press compact under specified lubrication conditions, and measure powder compressibility with density of compact.

explanation_cn: 粉末受压后，其压坯保持既定形状的能力。成形性是以粉末能够成形的最小单位压制压力表示，或者用压坯的强度来衡量。
explanation_en: The ability of powder compact to maintain a given shape after being pressed. Formability is expressed by the smallest unit pressing pressure that powder can form, or measured by the strength of compact.

explanation_cn: 为了抑制或阻碍烧结体在烧结过程中或使用过程中再结晶或晶粒长大而在金属粉末中加入的少量物质。如稀土掺杂钨灯丝。
explanation_en: A small amount of material added to metal powder to inhibit or hinder recrystallization or grain growth of sintering body during sintering or use. Such as rare earth doped tungsten filament.

explanation_cn: 单位质量(或体积）的粉末所具有的总表面积。通常以每克粉末所具有表面积之和（m2/g)表示。从大颗粒粉碎成小颗粒时，表面积增大（即比表面增加）；破碎用的能量储存在表面上，因而粒度愈小，表面积愈大，表面能也愈大，表面活性急速增加。
explanation_en: The total surface area of powder per unit mass (or volume). It is usually expressed as the sum of surface areas per gram of powder (m2/g). When crushing large particles into small particles, the surface area increases (i.e., the specific surface area increases); The energy used for crushing is stored on the surface, so the smaller the particle size is, the larger the surface area is, the larger the surface energy is, and the surface activity increases rapidly.

explanation_cn: 将很细小的树脂粉末均匀地分散在纤维（或织物）上，而后加热使树脂粉末熔化并浸渍在纤维（或织物）上，冷却后得到粉末预浸料。该法主要用于制备热塑性树脂预浸料也适用于制备热间性树脂预浸料。
explanation_en: The very small resin powder is evenly dispersed on the fiber (or fabric), and then heated to melt the resin powder and dip it on the fiber (or fabric), and after cooling, powder prepreg is obtained. This method is mainly used to prepare thermoplastic resin prepreg, and also suitable for preparing thermal resin prepreg.

explanation_cn: 粉末注射成形是将塑料注射成形工艺和粉末冶金工艺相结合的新工艺。它是制备三维复杂形状的金属近净成形技术，具有高效、节能、节材、环保、低成本、能大批量生产的特点。
explanation_en: Powder injection molding (pim) is a new process which combines plastics injection molding process with powder metallurgy process. It is a near net metal forming technology for preparing three-dimensional complex shapes, which has the characteristics of high efficiency, energy conservation, material conservation, environmental protection, low cost, and mass production.

explanation_cn: 粉末从国际标准流速漏斗中流出所需的时间，时间愈短，流动性愈好。粉末流动性与颗粒形状、粒度等因素有关。球形颗粒流动性最好，树枝状粉末流动性较差。
explanation_en: The shorter the time required for powder to flow out of the international standard flow funnel, the better the flow ability. Powder flowability is related to particle shape, particle size and other factors. Spherical particles have the best flow ability, while dendritic powder flowability have poor fluidity.

explanation_cn: 一种不含溶剂的固态涂料。可分为热固性和热塑性两大类。热固性粉末涂料的主要组成是各种热间性的合成树脂，如环氧、聚酯、丙烯酸、聚氨酯树脂等，其中环氧和环氧改性的粉末涂料应用最广。
explanation_en: A solvent free solid coatings. It can be divided into two categories: thermosetting and thermoplastic. Thermosetting powder coating are mainly composed of various thermosetting synthetic resin, such as epoxy, polyester, acrylic acid, polyurethime resin, etc., of which epoxy and epoxy modified powder coating are most widely used.

explanation_cn: 粉末材料是由大量微小的发光粉晶粒所构成。这些小晶粒的粒度通常为几微米到几十微米，把发光粉混在电介质里，并夹在两个平板电极之间，加上电流发光粉就会发光。
explanation_en: The powder materials is composed of a large number of tiny luminescence powder crystals. The particle size of these small grains is usually several to tens of microns. The luminescence powder is mixed in the dielectric and sandwiched between two flat electrodes. The current luminescence powder will luminescence light.

explanation_cn: 粉末颗粒的尺寸。粉末粒度是粉末冶金中描述粉末性能的主要参数，通常，粉末粒度范围为1-150pm。特殊用途的粉末可将粒度范围扩大到纳米级的超细粉末与0.5mm的粗颗粒。
explanation_en: Size of powder particle. Partidesize is the main parameter describing the performance of powder in powder metallurgy. Generally, partidesize ranges from 1-150pm. The powder for special purpose can expand the particle size range to nanometer powder and 0.5mm coarse particle.

explanation_cn: 一种复合线材制备方法，常用于制备超导线材。该方法是把前驱体粉末混合均匀后，装入金属或合金管中，然后将其加工成长线。在热处理时.前驱体粉末变成所需要的超导体，从而获得超导线材。
explanation_en: The invention relates to a preparation method of composite wire rod, which is commonly used for preparing superconducting wire rod. The method is to mix the precursor powder evenly, put it into a metal or alloy tube, and then process it into a long line. During heat treatment, the precursor powder becomes the superconductor needed to obtain superconducting wire rod.

explanation_cn: 一种利用轧机将金属粉末连续成形的工艺，是生产薄的、长的和横截面不变的制品的一项重要粉末冶金工艺。在此工艺中，金属粉末从料斗中喂入一套成形轧辊，生产出连续的生带坯或薄板。然后经过烧结，如果需要，经过二次轧制，得到具有所需材料性能的最终产品。最终产品可以是全致密的，或者具有所需的孔隙度。
explanation_en: A continuous forming process of metal powder by rolling mill is an important powder metallurgy process to produce thin, long and constant cross section products. In this process, metal powder is fed into a set of forming roll from the hopper to produce continuous green belt blanks or thin sheets. Then, after sintering and secondary rolling if necessary, the final product with the required materials properties can be obtained. The final product may be fully dense or have the required porosity.

explanation_cn: 钛合金粉末经成形烧结制成的合金。钛和钛合金具有密度小、抗氧化、耐腐蚀等特性。由于钛合金的热加工性差，需多次真空熔炼或精密铸造等高水平复杂生产工艺.因而常用粉末冶金法生产钛合金部件。将海绵钛氢化、粉碎、脱氢、压形、真空烧结，即可制得制件。也采用雾化、旋转电极或真空减压雾化成粉。钛合金的牌号主要有Ti6A14V、TiAl、Ti6A14V5Sn、Ti6A14Sn、Ti6A14Sn2、Zr6M9等。粉末钛合金是将冶炼合格的钛合金液态金属，经热挤压成棒、热等静压成钛合金涡轮盘、飞机龙骨接头、海水淡化装置。
explanation_en: Powder of titanium alloy is formed into alloy by sintering. Titanium and titanium alloys have the characteristics of low density, oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance. Due to the poor hot workability of titanium alloys, high-level complex production processes such as multiple vacuum melting or precision casting are required. Therefore, titanium alloy parts are usually produced by powder metallurgy. The sponge titanium can be hydrogenated, crushed, dehydrogenated, shaped, and vacuum sintering to obtain the workpiece. Powders are also formed by atomization, rotating electrodes, or vacuum vacuum vacuum atomization. The main grades of titanium alloys include Ti6A14V, TiAl, Ti6A14V5Sn, Ti6A14Sn, Ti6A14Sn2, Zr6M9, etc. P/M titanium alloy is a smelting qualified titanium alloy liquid metal, which is hot extrusion into rods, hot isostatic pressing into titanium alloy turbine disks, aircraft keel joints, and seawater desalination devices.

explanation_cn: 采用粉末冶金技术将铜粉和其他金属粉末直接成型的铜合金。用金属粉末可采用制粉、混料、压型、烧结的传统工艺直接制成各种形状的制品或零件。
explanation_en: Copper alloy directly formed by copper powder and other metal powder using powder metallurgy technology. With metal powder, products or parts of various shapes can be directly made by the traditional process of powder making, mixing, molding and sintering.

explanation_cn: 用粉末冶金方法制造的铝合金，传统的工艺流程为制造粉末-压制-烧结-精整-热处理。可以获得精度高、强度高、重量轻的耐腐蚀的零件。由于快速冷凝技术和机械合金技术的应用，粉末铝合金迅速发展。
explanation_en: For aluminum alloy manufactured by powder metallurgy, the traditional process flow is manufacturing powder - pressing - sintering - finishing - heat treatment. Corrosion resistant parts with high precision, high strength, and light weight can be obtained. Due to the application of rapid condensation technology and mechanical alloy technology, powder metallurgy aluminium alloy has developed rapidly.

explanation_cn: 粉末预成形坯或烧结体加热到易压性变形的高温（锻造温度）后，在闭式模内锻成复杂形状的工艺。它可将烧结体内残留孔隙消除，得到100%相对密度的粉末冶金零件。粉末预成形坯内部孔隙的存在，对减少锻造阻力有良好的作用，因而锻造变形性好.锻造中粉末成形坯内孔隙几乎全部由金属充填。将粉末压坯在H2炉中烧结后调整炉温到锻造温度，取出红热烧结体放入密闭模具内，施以冲击压力的方法成为粉末锻造；将烧结体加热（感应加热最好）到锻造温度入模锻造，称为烧结锻造；在雾化制粉时，以锻模作为受粉器，将入模的红热粉末施以冲击力，称为Osprey法锻造。Osprey法最节能，其次为粉末锻造，不过烧结锻造也比金属锻造节省能源。粉末锻造技术能一次成型得到产品，费用取决于模具寿命，成本比机加工工艺大大降低。粉末锻造虽然较金属锻造省力，但仍需大型锻造机，如高速锤和摩擦压机，因此.零件尺寸受到限制。粉末锻造零件多用于高负荷部位，如汽车后轿齿轮即是工作条件苛刻的产品。如果将预成形粉末烧结体加热到1200°C左右，经摩擦压机锻造成形，即可得到齿轮形状的金属零件。粉末锻造已发展为制取高强度零件的粉末冶金方法，是获得全密度材料的重要新技术。
explanation_en: The process of forging powder perform or sintered bodies into complex shapes in a closed die after being heated to a high temperature (forging temperature) that is easy to deform. It can eliminate the residual pores in sintering body and obtain powder metallurgy parts with 100% relative density. The existence of pores in the powder perform has a good effect on reducing the forging resistance, so the forging deformation is good. The pores in the powder preform are almost all filled with metal during forging. After sintering the powder compact in H2 furnace, adjust the furnace temperature to the forging temperature, take out the red hot sintering body and put it into the closed mold, and apply impact pressure to become power forging; The sintering body is heated (induction heating is the best) to the forging temperature for forging, which is called sintering forging; When atomizing the powder, the forging die is used as the powder collector to apply the impact force to the red hot powder into the mold, which is called Osprey forging. Osprey method is the most energy-saving, followed by power forging, but sintering forging also saves energy than metal forging. The power forging technology can form products at one time, and the cost depends on the service life of the mold. The cost is much lower than that of the machining process. Although power forging is more labor-saving than metal forging, it still needs large forging machines, such as high-speed hammer and friction press, so the size of parts is limited. Power forging parts are mostly used in high load parts, such as rear car gears, which are products with harsh working conditions. If the preformed powder sintered body is heated to about 1200 ° C and forged by the friction press, the metal parts with gear shape can be obtained. Power forging has been developed as a powder metallurgy method to produce high-strength parts, and is an important new technology to obtain full density materials.

explanation_cn: 粉末中能分开并独立存在的最小实体称为颗粒，又称单颗粒。单颗粒如果以某种形式聚集就构成所谓二次颗粒，其中的原始颗粒就成为一次颗粒。
explanation_en: The smallest entity that can be separated and exist independently in powder is called particle, also called single particle. If a single particle gathers in some form, it will form a so-called secondary particle, and the original particle will become a primary particle.

explanation_cn: 利用粉末冶金方法生产的高温合金。由于高合金化高温合金的铸锭偏析太严重，热加工性能差，所以采用传统的铸-锻工艺很难成型。而利用粉末冶金工艺，将高合金化难变形高温合金，在真空或惰性气体保护下制成细小粉末，压实成型材或零件毛坯。因其晶粒细小偏析轻，成分均匀，热加工性能好，在力学性能上表现为屈服强度和疲劳性能大幅度提高。
explanation_en: High temperature alloy produced by powder metallurgy. Due to the serious segregation of the high alloying high temperature alloy ingot and the poor hot working performance, it is difficult to form it with the traditional casting forging process. The powder metallurgy process is used to make high alloy hard to wrought superalloy into fine powder under vacuum or inert gas protection, and then compact the molding materials or parts blanks. Because of its fine grains, light segregation, uniform composition, and good hot working performance, its mechanical properties show that the yield strength and fatigue properties are greatly improved.

name_cn: 粉浆堆涂玻璃浸渗全瓷材料
explanation_cn: 又称玻璃渗透全瓷。是通过粉浆堆涂成型方法将耐高温微晶体颗粒在耐火模型上成型，耐火模型吸收堆涂的水分，干燥后进行高温半烧结，烧制成由微粒骨架组成的、具有多孔结构的瓷修复体，随后将镧系玻璃粉熔融后通过毛细管作用渗透入瓷的孔隙内，最后用线胀系数匹配饰面瓷对修复体进行饰面。
explanation_en: Also known as glass infiltrated all ceramic. The high-temperature resistant microcrystalline particles are formed on the refractory model by the slurry heap forming method, and the refractory model absorbs the moisture of the heap coating. After drying, the high-temperature semi sintering is carried out, and the ceramic prosthesis with porous structure composed of particle skeleton is fired. Then the lanthanide glass powder is fused and infiltrated into the pores of the porcelain through the action of capillary tube. Finally, the prosthesis is decorated with the linear expansion coefficient matching the decorative porcelain.

explanation_cn: 又称飞灰或烟灰。煤燃烧所产生烟气中的细灰，一般是指燃煤电厂从烟道气体中收集的细灰，它是煤粉进入1300-1500℃的炉膛后，在悬浮燃烧条件下经受热面吸热冷却形成的。
explanation_en: Also called fly ash or soot. The fine ash in the flue gas generated by coal combustion generally refers to the fine ash collected from the flue gas in the coal fired power plant. It is formed after the pulverized coal enters the furnace at 1300-1500 ℃ and undergoes the endothermic cooling of the hot surface under the condition of suspended combustion.

explanation_cn: 又称飞灰。一种工业废渣，是煤炭燃烧排放的高度分散的黏土类火山灰性质的微细颗粒混合材料，主要由硅铝酸盐组成。其颗粒粒径一般在1-50μm之间，具有多孔结构.孔隙率一般为60%-75%,比表面积为0.25-0.5m2/g,具有较强的吸附能力。
explanation_en: Also called fly ash. An industrial waste residue, which is a highly dispersed clay pozzolanic fine particle mixture material emitted from coal combustion, mainly composed of aluminosilicate. The particle size is generally between 1-50 μ M, with a porous structure. The porosity is generally 60% -75%, and the specific surface is 0.25-0.5m2/g, with a strong adsorption capacity.

explanation_cn: 由硅酸盐水泥熟料和粉煤灰、适量石膏磨细制成的水硬性胶凝材料称为粉煤灰硅酸盐水泥，简称粉煤灰水泥，代号P·F。
explanation_en: The hydraulic cementing material made of Portland cement clinker, fly ash and appropriate amount of gypsum is called fly-ash Portland cernent, referred to as fly ash cement, code P · F.

explanation_cn: 天然形成的平均粒径在20pm左右的石英粉末。一般呈白色、灰色或黄白色，粉末状，干粉白度高。原矿石饱和吸水量可达20%-35%。
explanation_en: Natural quartze powder with an average particle size of about 20pm. It is generally white, gray or yellowish white, powder, and the whiteness of dry powder is high. The saturated water absorption of raw ore can reach 20% -35%.

explanation_cn: 一种已固结的碎屑沉积岩，其中粒径0.025-0.039mm的粉砂含量在50%以上，其余为砂、黏土或化学沉积物。粉砂的组成以石英为主，其次为长石和白云母，岩屑少见。碎屑的磨圆度不好，常呈棱角状。胶结物以钙质、铁质为主。常具有薄的水平层理。
explanation_en: A consolidated clastic sedimentary rock, in which the content of silt sand with particle size of 0.025-0.039mm is more than 50%, and the rest is sand, clay or chemical deposit. The silt is mainly composed of quartze, followed by feldspar and muscovilte, and rock debris is rare. The roundness of the debris is poor and often appears in an angular shape. The cement is mainly composed of calcium and iron. Often with thin horizontal bedding.

explanation_cn: 通过机械粉碎固态金属而制成的粉末。机械粉碎是靠压碎、击碎、和磨削等作用，将块状金属或合金粉碎成粉末的。
explanation_en: Powder made by mechanically crushing solid metal. Mechanical crushing is to crush block metal or alloy into powder by crushing, smashing and grinding.

explanation_cn: 又称水淬矿渣。高炉冶炼生铁所得以硅酸钙和铝酸钙为主要成分的融熔物经淬冷后的粒状活性混合材料。因常用水淬冷，故又称水淬矿渣，俗称水渣。主要化学成分为氧化钙和SiO2、CaO和A12O3。矿渣的活性主要取决于矿物成分和结构形态，磨细矿渣的活性主要取决于磨细程度。粒化高炉矿渣是水泥生产重要的混合材和混凝土生产重要的矿物掺和料。
explanation_en: It is also called water-granulated slag. Granular active mixed materials obtained from blast furnace smelting of pig iron with calcium silicate and calcium aluminate as main components after quenching. It is commonly used for water quenching, so it is also called water-granulated slag, commonly known as water slag. The main chemical components are calcium oxide and SiO2, CaO, and A12O3. The activity of slag mainly depends on the mineral composition and structure, and the activity of ground slag mainly depends on the degree of grinding. Granulated blast furnace slag is an important admixture in cement production and an important mineral admixture in concrete production.

explanation_cn: 在过饱和固溶体中，扩散效应可导致新相晶粒的形成。这个过程可分为两个阶段:首先是浓度起伏产生新相核心并生长，直到基体中的溶质原子含量达到平衡为止；随后是粗化过程，在此阶段中各种尺寸的析出相粒子在基体中竞争生长。由于浓度梯度溶质原子既从较小粒子表面向基体流动，也从基体向较大粒子的表面流动，在此过程中.粒子的平均尺寸增加，这种现象称为粒子粗化。
explanation_en: In supersaturated solid solution, the diffusion effect can lead to the formation of new phase grains. This process can be divided into two stages: first, the concentration fluctuation produces a new phase core and grows until the content of solute atoms in the matrix reaches equilibrium; Then there is the coarsening process, in which the precipitates of various sizes grow competitively in the matrix. Because the concentration gradient solute atoms flow not only from the surface of smaller particles to the matrix, but also from the matrix to the surface of larger particles, in this process, the average size of particles increases, which is called particle coarsening.

explanation_cn: 粒状铵梯炸药在20世纪中业到21世纪初是我国主要的炸药品种之一，20世纪中业占我国工业炸药产量的70%以上。但由于产品含有TNT成分，有毒、有害且严重污染环境，极大地影响了其使用。20世纪末采用硝酸铵表面改性并以燃料油代替部分TNT的方法使炸药中的TNT含量由12%降低到4%,但由于TNT本质上具有毒性而无法改变，至2008年，该炸药基本停产，目前也仅仅有少量铵梯震源药柱仍生产。具体制造过程主要包括硝酸铵和木粉的粉碎与干燥、TNT的球磨机粉碎、均匀混合、装药、包装等。
explanation_en: Granular ammonium ladder explosives is one of the main explosive in China from the middle of the 20th century to the beginning of the 21st century. The middle of the 20th century accounted for more than 70% of the output of industrial explosives in China. However, due to the presence of TNT in the product, it is toxic, harmful, and seriously pollutes the environment, greatly affecting its use. At the end of the 20th century, the method of surface modification of ammonium nitrate and replacing part of TNT with fuel oil reduced the TNT content of explosive from 12% to 4%, but because TNT is toxic in nature, it cannot be changed. By 2008, the explosive had basically stopped production, and only a small number of TNT focal grains were still produced. The specific manufacturing process mainly includes crushing and drying of ammonium nitrate and wood flour, crushing by TNT ball mill, uniform mixing, charging, packaging, etc.

explanation_cn: 表皮经脱毛去除后暴露出来的粒纹表面。不同的动物皮具有不同的表面纹路。
explanation_en: The surface of grains exposed after unhairing of the epidermis. Different animal skins have different surface patterns.

explanation_cn: 又称粗面安山岩，是成分介于粗面岩与安山岩之间的一种火山岩。含近等量碱性长石和斜长石。呈内、灰、浅黄或红色。斑状结构或祖面结构，气孔块状构造。斑晶主要由斜长石(中长石、更长石和暗色矿物组成，基质主要为斜长石及碱性长石中国江苏、安徽的中生代火山岩中常见粗安岩，并与I铁、铜、黄铁矿矿床等有成因联系。
explanation_en: Also known as trachyandesite, it is a volcanic rock with composition between trachyte and andesite. It contains nearly equal amount of alkaline feldspar and plagioclase. Appearing in an inner, gray, light yellow, or red color. Porphyritic texture or ancestral plane structure, pore massive structure. Phenocryst is mainly composed of plagioclase (meso feldspar, geng feldspar and dark minerals, and its matrix is mainly plagioclase and alkaline feldspar. trachyandensite is common in Mesozoic volcanic rock in Jiangsu and Anhui, China, and has genetic relationship with I iron, copper, pyrite deposits, etc.

explanation_cn: 按照Sandvik的晶粒度分级标准，粗晶硬质合金的晶粒度3.5~4.9μm，超粗晶粒硬质合金的晶粒度为5.0~7.9μm。石油钻齿、截煤机齿、路面冷铣刨机齿、冲压模具、轧辊等广泛应用粗晶及超粗晶粒硬质合金。低钴粗晶和高钴细晶硬质合金均已成为硬质合金的发展方向。低钴粗晶合金的设计结构原理是：WC晶粒粗，比表面积小，使合金中钴层增厚，从而提高合金的冲击韧性。合金中钴含量的减少，合金中WC含量的增加，提高合金的耐磨性。低钴粗晶合金的综合作用使得合金的韧性好，耐磨性高。
explanation_en: According to Sandvik's grain size grading standard, the grain size of coarse grain carhicle is 3.5~4.9 μ m. The grain size of ultra coarse grained hardmetal is 5.0~7.9 μ M. Coarse grained and ultra coarse grained hardmetal is widely used in petroleum drill teeth, coal cutter teeth, road cold milling machine teeth, stamping dies, roll, etc. Low Co coarse grained and high Co fine grain cemented carbide have become the development direction of hardmetal. The design structure principle of low cobalt coarse grained alloy is that WC grains are coarse and specific surface is small, which thickens the cobalt layer in alloy, thus improving the impact toughness of alloy. The decrease of cobalt content in alloy and the increase of WC content in alloy improve the wear resistance of alloy. The comprehensive effect of low Co coarse grained alloy makes alloy have good toughness and high wear resistance.

explanation_cn: 粉末粒度能够用标准筛进行筛分。粗粉常用球磨破碎法制得。粗粉的松装密度高，流动性好，压制性好，多用于模具压制成形。
explanation_en: The partidesize can be screened with standard sieve. Coarse powder is usually produced by ball milling and crushing. Coarse powder has high apparent density, good flow ability and pressing, and is mostly used for die pressing forming.

explanation_cn: 参见自然柏。
explanation_en: See natural cypress.

explanation_cn: 矿石经鼓风炉冶炼出来的含有1%-4%(质量分数）杂质和贵金属金、银及铜，锡的铅。可用作楮炼铅的原料以及提取金银等贵金属。
explanation_en: Lead containing 1% -4% (mass fraction) impurities and precious metals such as gold, silver, copper and tin from ore smelting in blast furnace. It can be used as raw material for lead smelting in Broussonetia papyrifera and for extracting precious metals such as gold and silver.

explanation_cn: 成分相当于正长岩的喷出岩。岩石常呈浅灰、浅灰黄、灰红等，多具斑状结构，基质为隐晶质或微晶，具粗面结构。斑晶常为透长石、歪长石、钠长石，有时有正长石和斜长石。暗色矿物主要是黑云母.其次是角闪石和辉石。与粗面岩有关的矿产不多。某些铜矿和锌矿与角斑岩有关。
explanation_en: The composition is equivalent to extrusive rock of syenite. Rock is usually light gray, light grayish yellow, grayish red, etc., with porphyritic texture, and its matrix is aphanitic or microcrystalline, with rough texture. The phenocrysts are usually transparent feldspar, crooked feldspar, sodium feldspar, and sometimes orthoclase feldspar and plagioclase. Dark minerals are mainly biotite, followed by amphibole and pyroxene. There are few minerals related to trachyte. Some copper and zinc deposits are related to hornblende porphyry.

explanation_cn: 用精密铸型获得形状与尺寸准确、表面质量良好的铸件的铸造方法的总称。精密铸造的铸件不仅尺寸精度高，而且表面光洁，轮廓和线条清晰，可不加工或少加工。精密铸造方法主要包括：①用细颗粒耐火材料和特种黏结剂制作型腔表面光洁、尺寸精确、强度高的铸型，如壳型铸造、熔模铸造、陶瓷型铸造、石膏型铸造等；②采用实体造型方法，获得尺寸精确的整体铸型，如熔模铸造、实型铸造等；③采用型腔表面光洁、尺寸精确的铸型，如金属型铸造、压力铸造等；④利用压力和离心力提高铸件致密度，如压力铸造、离心铸造、低压铸造、液态模锻等。
explanation_en: The general term of foundry methods for obtaining castings with accurate shape and size and good surface quality by precision mold. The castings of precision casting not only have high dimensional accuracy, but also have smooth surface, clear contour and line, and can be processed without or less. Precision casting methods mainly include: ① using fine refractory and special adhesive to make mold with smooth cavity surface, accurate size and high strength, such as shell mold casting, expenable pattern casting, ceramic mold casting, plaster mold casting, etc.; ② Adopt solid molding method to obtain integral mold with accurate size, such as expenable pattern casting, full mold casting, etc.; ③ Adopt mold with smooth cavity surface and accurate size, such as metallic mold casting, die-casting, etc.; ④ Use pressure and centrifugal force to improve efficiency of spare filling of castings, such as die-casting, centrifugal casting, low pressure casting, liquid metal forging, etc.

explanation_cn: 白色胎或浅色胎上施釉的陶器。用可塑法、注浆法或半干压法成型。一般在1250°C左右先进行素烧，施釉后再在1100°C左右进行釉烧，也可采用一次烧成。按坯体组成有长石质精陶（硬质精陶）和石灰质精陶（软质精陶）之分；按用途有日用精陶和建筑卫生精陶之分。主要生产日用器皿、釉面砖等。
explanation_en: White or light colored pottery with glaze. Forming using plastic method, grouting method, or semi dry pressing method. Generally, the plain firing is carried out at about 1250 ° C, and then the glaze firing is carried out at about 1100 ° C after the application of glaze, or one-time firing can be used. According to the green body composition, there are feldspathic fine pottery (hard fine pottery) and calcareous fine pottery (soft fine pottery); According to the use, there are daily fine pottery and fine pottery for building and sanitation. It mainly produces household utensils, glaze tiles, etc.

explanation_cn: 一类将合成树脂或橡胶配制成易挥发的高黏度溶液的胶黏剂，主要用于密封和嵌缝等方面。
explanation_en: A kind of adhesive that is prepared from synthetic resin or rubber into volatile high viscosity solution, mainly used for sealing and caulking.

explanation_cn: 糠醒、丙酮先生成糠酮单体然后进一步缩聚的产物。未固化的树脂通常是暗褐色至黑色高黏稠液体或固体，相对密度1.16,水分含量小于2%，pH值为7左右。固化剂为无机酸或有机酸，如苯磺酸、对氯苯磺酸等。
