explanation_en: The product of furfural ketone monomer formed by furfural ketone and acetone and further polycondensation. The non curing resin is usually dark brown to black high viscous liquid or solid, with a relative density of 1.16, a moisture content of less than 2%, and a pH value of about 7. The curing agent is inorganic acid or organic acid, such as benzene sulfonic acid, p-chlorobenzene sulfonic acid, etc.

explanation_cn: 糠醇在酸性催化剂作用下缩聚而成的树脂。未同化的树脂是红色黏稠不易流动的液体，能溶于丙酮、醇、醚类等，不溶于苯。以无机酸或有机酸作固化剂。强酸（如硫酸或对甲苯磺酸）可使树脂室温固化。弱酸（如笨二甲酸酐、顺丁烯二酸酐、磷酸）在室温时基本上不增加树脂黏度，需在95-200°C数小时后方能固化，适于低压成型。固化后耐酸（不耐氧化性酸如硝酸、铬酸等)，耐碱，耐有机溶剂，耐水，耐热性较好（玻纤增强后可在120°C使用），硬度较高，与炭、石墨、石棉、玻璃纤维等有良好的黏结性，纯树脂固化后拉伸强度lO.9MPa。对木材黏结强度为6.7MPa，对钢黏结强度1.1MPa。缺点是脆性大、对非多孔性物质表面的附着力差、固化收缩率较大。可用来制造耐腐蚀玻璃钢管道，阀门、泵体及模压制品，还用于防腐衬里、耐酸胶泥、耐腐蚀涂料和各种黏结剂。树脂价格便宜，尤其作为铸造砂芯黏结剂，能提高铸件质量和劳动生产率，特别适用于大批量的机械制造，如汽车、军工、内燃机、柴油机、缝纫机等的生产。
explanation_en: Resin made by condensation of furfuryl alcohol with acid catalyst. The unassimilated resin is a red viscous liquid that is not easy to flow, and can be soluble in acetone, alcohol, ether, etc., but insoluble in benzene. Inorganic acid or organic acid is used as curing agent. Strong acids (such as sulfuric acid or p-toluenesulfonic acid) can make resin curing at room temperature. Weak acids (such as phthalic anhydride, maleic anhydride, phosphoric acid) basically do not increase the viscosity of resin at room temperature, and can be curing after several hours at 95-200 ° C, which is suitable for low-pressure molding. After curing, it is acid resistant (not resistant to oxidizing acids such as nitric acid, chromic acid, etc.), alkali resistant, organic solvent resistant, water resistant, heat resistant (glass fiber can be used at 120 ° C after reinforcement), high hardness, good adhesion with carbon, graphite, asbestos, glass fiber, etc. The tensile strength of pure resin after curing is lO.9MPa. The bonding strength to wood is 6.7MPa, and to steel is 1.1MPa. The disadvantages are high brittleness, poor adhesion to the surface of non porous materials, and large curing shrinkage. It can be used to manufacture corrosion resistant FRP pipes, valves, pump bodies and molded products, as well as anti-corrosion linings, acid resistant mastic, corrosion resistant coatings and various adhesive. Resin is cheap, especially as foundry sand core binder, which can improve casting quality and labor productivity. It is especially suitable for mass machinery manufacturing, such as automobile, military industry, internal combustion engine, diesel engine, sewing machine, etc.

explanation_cn: 糠醛与六次甲基四胺（乌洛托品）反应生成的树脂，未固化前的树脂为黑色黏稠液体,可用对甲苯磺酸处理加热固化,固化后形成不溶不熔体型树脂。耐高温、耐化学腐蚀、耐辐射，电绝缘性优良,黏结性较差。改变六次甲基四胺用量，能够制得不同牌号的树脂。可用于制造耐腐浊的塑料、涂料、胶黏剂和胶泥等，可作砂型、石墨和耐火材料的黏结剂,还可作为浸溃液,浸溃各种多孔性材料，如石墨、陶瓷、石棉、玻璃布、碳纤维等，并能通过热固化得到性能优良的玻璃纤维增强塑料和耐高温玻璃钢。
explanation_en: The resin generated by the reaction of furfural and hexamethylenetetramine (urotropine), the resin before curing is a black viscous liquid, which can be treated with p-toluene sulfonic acid and heated for curing. After curing, insoluble and fusible resin is formed. High temperature resistance, chemical corrosion resistance, radiation resistance, good electrical insulation, poor adhesion. Different grades of resin can be prepared by changing the amount of hexamethylenetetramine. It can be used to manufacture corrosion-resistant plastics, coatings, adhesive and mortars, etc. It can also be used as a binder for sand molds, graphite and refractory materials, and can also be used as a soaking liquid to soak various porous materials, such as graphite, ceramics, asbestos, glass cloth, carbon fiber, etc., and can obtain glass fiber reinforced plastics and high-temperature resistant glass steel with excellent performance through thermal curing.

explanation_cn: 涉及整个生物体的毒性反应。包括全身各个系统的组织、器官或细胞等毒性。分为急性毒性、亚急性毒性、亚慢性毒性和慢性毒性。在材料学领域主要是指机体一次或多次接触医疗器械、生物材料或其浸提液后，对远离接触点的组织和器官造成的潜在危害作用。生物材料引起全身毒性反应的原因通常是材料中低分子量物质的渗出或材料降解伴有毒性物质的释放。通过动物全身毒性试验（如经口途径、经静脉途径）可检测材料的全身毒性作用，经呼吸系统途径可检测材料内的挥发性成分的全身毒性作用。
explanation_en: Toxic reactions involving the entire organism. Including toxicity to tissues, organs, or cells of various systems throughout the body. It is divided into acute toxicity, sub acute toxicity, sub chronic toxicity and chronic toxicity. In the field of materials, it mainly refers to the potential harmful effect on tissues and organs far away from the contact point after the body contacts with medical device, biological materials or their extracts for one or more times. The systemic toxic reaction caused by biological materials is usually caused by the exudation of low molecular weight substances in materials or the release of toxic substances accompanied by degradation of materials. The systemic toxicity of materials can be detected through animal systemic toxicity tests (such as oral and intravenous routes), and the systemic toxicity of volatile components in materials can be detected through the respiratory system.

explanation_cn: 燃料电池系统所发出的电能占进人电堆燃料量低热焓值的百分比。由于燃料电池系统中自身寄生负载的能耗及其DC-DC变换器或DC-AC逆变器的能耗，从系统输出的电能会比从电堆输出的电能少10%-30%。
explanation_en: The percentage of electric energy generated by the fuel cell system in the low enthalpy value of the fuel entering the man power stack. Due to the energy consumption of its own parasitic load or power in the fuel cell system and the energy consumption of its DC-DC converter or DC-AC inverter, the power output from the system will be 10% -30% less than the power output from the stack.

explanation_cn: 采用紫外线照射漆膜使其产生聚合反应，从而能在极短时间形成固体漆膜的涂料。涂料中的光敏剂在光引发下产生自由基并引发涂料中的不饱和单体、预聚物，聚合成大分子，形成固体漆膜。聚合类型主要为自由基聚合及阳离子聚合。所用单体有苯乙烯、各种丙烯酸酯;所用的预聚物有不饱和聚酯树脂、聚丙烯酸酯、丙烯酸聚氨酯、聚醚丙烯酸酯等，目前国内的紫外光同化涂料以不饱和聚酯树脂涂料为主。光固化涂料特别适用于不宜高温烘烤的木材、纸张、塑料等的涂装。
explanation_en: It is a coatings that uses ultraviolet ray to irradiate the paint film to produce polymerization reaction, so as to form a solid paint film in a very short time. The photosensitizer in coatings generates free radicals under photoinitiation and initiates the unsaturated monomer and prepolymer in coatings, which polymerization into macromolecules and form a solid paint film. The main types of polymerization are free radical polymerization and cationic polymerization. The monomer used include styrene and various acrylates; The prepolymer used include unsaturated polyester resin, polyacrylate, acrylic polyurethime, polyether acrylate, etc. At present, the domestic UV assimilation coatings are mainly unsaturated polyester resin coatings. Light curing coatings is especially suitable for the coating of wood, paper, plastics, etc. that are not suitable for high-temperature baking.

explanation_cn: 利用紫外线引发树脂休系中的相应基团发生交联反应的过程，是辐射间化的一种。紫外线间化只适用于透明增强材料与透明树脂的复合材料，如玻璃纤维复合材料。将紫外线同化与手糊、喷射、纤维缠绕、拉挤等玻璃纤维复合材料成型工艺结合起来，既能提高制品的件能，又能有效地降低成本和保护环境。
explanation_en: The process of crosslinking reaction of corresponding groups in resin system initiated by ultraviolet radiation is a kind of radiation intermediation. UV intercalation is only applicable to transparent reinforcement materials and transparent resin composite materials, such as glass fiber composite materials. The combination of UV assimilation with glass fiber composite materials molding processes such as hand pasting, spraying, filament winding, pultrusion, etc. can not only improve product performance, but also effectively reduce costs and protect the environment.

explanation_cn: 在紫外波长范围具有良好透过率的石英玻璃。分远紫外和一般紫外两种。前者采用高纯四氯化硅为原料，化学气相沉积法熔制。
explanation_en: Quartz glass with good transmittance in the ultraviolet wavelength range. Divided into two types: far ultraviolet and general ultraviolet. The former is made of high-purity silicon tetrachloride by chemical vapor deposition.

explanation_cn: 具有和某些无色光学玻璃相同的光学常数和物理、化学性质，但紫外和可见光的透过率较-般要高得多得光学玻璃。
explanation_en: It has the same optical constant, physical and chemical properties as some colorless optical glass, but the transmittance of ultraviolet and visible light is much higher than normal optical glass.

explanation_cn: 参见方钠石。
explanation_en: See sodalite.

explanation_cn: 参见石英。
explanation_en: See quartze.

explanation_cn: 江苏宜兴丁山镇等地利用当地特有的泥、红泥和绿泥等制成的质地坚硬的无釉细陶制品。紫砂泥是由黏土、石英、云母、赤铁矿等多种矿物组成，呈团粒状结构，烧成后的器，其显微结构形成双重气孔结构，即团粒间的断续链状气孔结构和团粒内各物相间的显气孔结构，这种双重气孔结构在一般陶瓷中极为少见，是器气孔率高，透气性能好的主要原因。主要用作茶壶，优点是用以泡茶不失原味，茶水不易霉馊变质，耐热性能良好，能经受温度突变，且能保温。
explanation_en: Dingshan Town, Yixing, Jiangsu Province and other places use the local unique mud, red mud and green mud to make hard glaze free fine ceramics. The zisha mud is composed of clay, quartze, mica, hematite and other minerals, which is in a granular structure. The microstructure of the fired utensil forms a dual pore structure, that is, the intermittent chain pore structure between the particles and the apparent pore structure between the various phases in the particles. This dual pore structure is extremely rare in general ceramics, and is the main reason for the high porosity and good permeability of the utensil. Mainly used as a teapot, the advantage is that it is used to brew tea without losing its original flavor, the tea is not easily moldy or spoiled, has good heat resistance, can withstand temperature changes, and can keep warm.

explanation_cn: 一种含有紫苏辉石的花岗岩。成分与花岗岩或云英闪长岩相当，矿物组成以石英、斜长石、碱性长石和紫苏辉石为主，有时含石榴子石、普通角闪石和黑云母。钾长石一般为微斜长石，其特征之一是条纹成分不是钠长石，而是更长石或者中长石。颜色较深。宏观特征与粗粒片麻岩相似。具有花岗结构和片麻状构造。常与片麻岩相的变质岩伴生，也有的与斜长岩共生。成因有岩浆成因和深成变质成因两种说法。
explanation_en: A granite containing perilla pyroxene. The composition is equivalent to granite or mica diorite, and the mineral composition is mainly quartze, plagioclase, alkaline feldspar and perilla pyroxene, sometimes containing garnet, ordinary amphibole and biotite. Potassium feldspar is generally microcline feldspar, one of its characteristics is that the striped component is not sodium feldspar, but more feldspar or medium feldspar. The color is darker. The macroscopic characteristics are similar to coarse grained gneiss. It has granite structure and gneissic structure. It is often associated with metamorphic rock of gneiss phase, and also with anorthosite. There are two theories of origin: magmatic origin and plutonic metamorphic origin.

explanation_cn: 参见辉石。
explanation_en: See pyroxene.

explanation_cn: 即石榴石，又称紫牙乌、紫鸦乌。参见石榴石。
explanation_en: Garnet, also known as Purple Yawu or Purple Crow Wu. See garnet.

explanation_cn: 一种以累托石为主要矿物的黏土岩。矿物组成除累托石外，还有高岭石、水云母、硬水铝石、蒙脱石等。微量杂质矿物有石英、长石、叶蜡石、绿泥石、方解石、黄铁矿、内铁矿、针铁矿、玉髓、石膏和炭质等。纯净者呈白色。因含杂质而呈灰色、深灰、灰绿和灰黑色等。干燥的累托石黏土为块状或土状，颗粒细小，泥质结构，具滑感，遇水膨胀，有可塑性，髙温下化学性质稳定。在石油工业中作为裂变催化剂能大大提高催化效果，作为石油钻井泥浆原料，可制成造浆率高、失水量小、不需预水化、耐高温的优质泥浆。作为陶瓷，染料、冶金、铸造、橡胶、化工、轻工与建筑材料，也具有良好的工艺性能。
explanation_en: A clay rock with rectorite as the main mineral. In addition to rectorite, there are also kaolinite, hydromica, diaspore, montmorillonite, etc. Trace impurity minerals include quartze, feldspar, pyrophyllite, chlorite, caldte, pyrite, nei iron ore, goethite, chalcedony, gypsum and carbonaceous. Pure ones appear white. Due to impurities, it appears gray, dark gray, grayish green, and grayish black. Dry rectorite clay is in the form of blocks or soil, with small particles and a muddy structure. It has a slippery texture, expands when exposed to water, has plasticity, and is chemically stable at high temperatures. As a fission catalyst in the petroleum industry, it can greatly improve the catalytic effect. As a raw material for petroleum drilling mud, it can be made into high-quality mud with high mud making rate, low water loss, no need for pre hydration, and high temperature resistance. As ceramics, dye or dyestuffc, metallurgy, foundry, rubber, chemical industry, light industry and building materials also have good technological performance.

explanation_cn: 又称混凝剂。指用来将水溶液中的溶质、胶体或悬浮物粒子凝聚成絮状物沉淀的物质。在工业用水处理中，则将混凝沉降过程的水处理剂统称为混凝剂。胶凝剂分为无机物和有机物两类。其胶凝机理复杂，基本原理是增加水中悬浮离子的直径，加快其沉降速度，具体胶凝作用是通过物理作用和化学作用两种因素实现的。化学因素是使粒子的电荷中和，降低其电位，使之成为不稳定的粒子，然后聚集沉降这类胶凝剂多为低分子无机盐。物理因素则是胶凝剂通过交联、吸附，使小粒子聚集体变为絮团，这类胶凝剂多为高分子物。
explanation_en: It is also called coagulant. It refers to the substance used to condense solutes, colloids or suspended solids in aqueous solution into flocs and precipitation. In industrial water treatment, water treatment agent in the process of coagulation and sedimentation is collectively referred to as coagulant. Gellants are divided into two categories: inorganic and organic. The gelation mechanism is complex, and the basic principle is to increase the diameter of suspended ions in water and accelerate their settling speed. The specific gelation effect is achieved through two factors: physical and chemical effects. Chemical factors neutralize the charge of particles, reduce their potential, make them unstable particles, and then aggregate and settle. These types of gelling agents are mostly low molecular inorganic salts. The physical factor is that the gelling agent changes small particle aggregates into flocs through crosslinking and adsorption, and most of these gelling agents are macromolecule substances.

explanation_cn: 是玄武岩等富铝铁质岩石在湿热气候条件下经强烈化学风化分解而残留于原地的 物。化学成分富含铁和铝，矿物成分主要为三水铝石、高岭石。
explanation_en: It is the remains of basalt and other aluminum rich iron rock in situ after intense chemical weathering and decomposition under humid and hot climate conditions. The chemical composition is rich in iron and aluminum, and the mineral composition is mainly gibbsite and kaolinite.

explanation_cn: 波长介于可见光与微波之间的电磁波谱。自然界中，太阳光线、热 辐射、无线电等，都是物体内部带电粒子不断运动辐射出的电磁辐射，但由于能量不同，所辐射的波长也不同。按波长或频率的排列形成电磁辐射谱。
explanation_en: An electromagnetic spectrum with a wavelength between visible light and microwave. In nature, solar radiation, thermal radiation, radio, and so on are all electromagnetic radiation emitted by the continuous movement of charged particles inside an object. However, due to different energies, the wavelengths of radiation also vary. Forming an electromagnetic radiation spectrum in an arrangement of wavelengths or frequencies.

explanation_cn: 辐射波长位于红外波段的半导体激光材料。
explanation_en: A semiconductor laser materials whose radiation wavelength is in the infrared band.

explanation_cn: 一类对红外辐射敏感的感光材料。通常卤化银微晶体仅对蓝紫光敏感，要对红外辐射敏感则必须在照相乳剂 中加入红外增感染料。
explanation_en: A class of photographic materials sensitive to infrared radiation. Generally, silver halide microcrystals are only sensitive to blue violet light. To be sensitive to infrared radiation, infrared sensitizing dye must be added to the photographic emulsion.

explanation_cn: 一种利用红外辐射原理对材料表面进行检测的方法，其实质是扫描记录被检材料表面上由于缺陷或材料不同的热性质所引起的温度变化。
explanation_en: A method of detecting the surface of materials by using the infrared radiation principle. Its essence is to scan and record the temperature changes on the surface of materials due to defects or different thermal properties of materials.

explanation_cn: 指能激发出红外线（0.76-20微米)的激光玻璃。
explanation_en: It refers to the laser glass that can excite infrared ray (0.76-20 μ m).

explanation_cn: 在近红外波长范围具有良好透过率的石英玻 璃。应用于光谱波长范圈为26-350微米。
explanation_en: Quartze glass with good transmittance in the near-infrared wavelength range. Applied to the spectral wavelength range of 26-350 microns.

explanation_cn: 对波长为0.76-1000微米红外波段的电磁波，具有透过、吸收或辐射功能的陶瓷材料。
explanation_en: It is a ceramics materials with the function of transmitting, absorbing or radiating electromagnetic waves with the wavelength of 0.76-1000 μ m infrared band.

explanation_cn: 指在红外频谱下可以隐身的复合材料。具有符合要求 的热红外发射率或较强的控温能力；具有合理的表面结构；具有较低的太阳能吸收率；能与其他频段的隐身要求兼容。主要有单一型和复合型两种。复合型红外隐身材料主要有涂料型隐身材料、多层隐身材料和夹芯材料。
explanation_en: Refers to composite materials that can be invisible in the infrared spectrum. Having a satisfactory thermal infrared emissivity or strong temperature control ability; Having a reasonable surface structure; Having a low solar energy absorption rate; Compatible with stealth requirements in other frequency bands. There are mainly two types: single type and composite type. Composite infrared stealth materials mainly include coatings stealth materials, multi-layer stealth materials and sandwich materials.

explanation_cn: 红色调的宝石级刚玉品种，包括 红色、橙红色、紫红色、褐红色的刚玉宝石。
explanation_en: Gems grade corundum varieties in red tone include corundum gems in red, orange red, purple red and maroon.

explanation_cn: 以刚玉（又称蓝宝石）单晶为基质，掺入CP为激活剂所组成的激光晶体材料。
explanation_en: Corundum (also known as sapphire) single crystal as the matrix, doped with CP as the activator of the laser crystal materials.

explanation_cn: 岛状结构硅酸盐矿物。化学| 式为Al2 [Si()4=()"常含Mn、Fe和炭质。斜方晶 系，空间群D〗2h-Pnnm。柱状晶体，横断面近正方形。 常呈放射状集合体（称为菊花石）。红柱石在生长过 程中常俘获部分炭质和黏土物质成定向排列?纵向上i 的分布与柱体延长方向一致，在横断面上呈黑十字， 称为空晶石。灰色，含Mn、Fe者呈浅玫瑰红，亦黾i 黄、绿色，风化后呈灰色。玻璃光泽《平行{110} i 有两组中等解理。莫氏硬度6.5?7.5,密度3.15?I 3.16 g/cm3。典型的接触热变质矿物，产于泥质岩石 与侵人体接触带。是铝质耐火材料原料。色泽鲜艳的 粉红色者可作宝石。
explanation_en: Island structure silicate mineral. Chemical formula: Al2 [Si() 4=() "often contains Mn, Fe and carbonaceous. Orthorhombic system, space group D] 2h Pnnm. Cylindrical crystal, nearly square in cross section, often presents a radial aggregate (called chrysanthemum stone) . During the growth process, andalusite often captures some carbon and clay substances in a directional arrangement? The distribution of i in the longitudinal direction is consistent with the elongation direction of the column, and it appears as a black cross in the cross-section, known as hollow crystal. Grey, with Mn and Fe present in a light rose red color, and also in yellow and green colors. After weathering, it appears gray. The glass luster "parallel {110} i" has two groups of medium cleavage. The Mohs hardness is 6.5 × 7.5, and the density is 3.15 × I 3.16 g/cm3. The typical contact thermal metamorphic mineral is produced in the contact zone between argillaceous rocks and intruders. It is the raw material of aluminum refractory. The bright pink can be used as gems.

explanation_cn: 见赤铁矿。
explanation_en: See hematite.

explanation_cn: 简单配位型氧化物矿物。成分ZnO。经常有Mn、Pb、Fe的类质同象混入物代替锌六方晶系。
explanation_en: Simple coordination type oxide minerals. Composition ZnO. There are often isomorphic mixtures of Mn, Pb, and Fe replacing the zinc hexagonal system.

explanation_cn: 以水泥浆、砂浆或混凝土为基材，以金属纤维、无机纤维或有机纤维为增强材料组成的一种复合材料。具有较高抗拉强度和抗压强度以及较高抗冲击韧性和断裂能。所采用纤维材料有钢纤维、玻璃纤维、碳纤维和高分子合成纤维。通常使用三维乱向分布短纤维，石子最大粒径≤10mm。最常用的是钢纤维增强混凝土，聚丙烯纤维效果也较好。用玻璃纤维时，应使用低碱水泥（pH≤ll)或耐碱玻璃纤维。用于飞机跑道、断面较薄的轻型结构和压力管道等处。
explanation_en: A composite materials consisting of cement slurry, mortar or concrete as the base material and metal fiber, inorganic fiber or organic fiber as the reinforcement materials. It has high tensile strength, compressive strength, impact toughness and fracture energy. The fiber materials used include steel fibre, glass fiber, carbon fiber and macromolecule synthetic fiber. Generally, three-dimensional random distribution staple fiber is used, and the maximum particle size of stones is ≤ 10mm. The most commonly used is steel fibre reinforced concrete, and the effect of polypropylene fiber is also good. When glass fiber is used, low alkali cement (pH ≤ ll) or alkali resistant glass fiber shall be used. Used for aircraft runways, lightweight structures with thin sections, and pressure pipelines.

name_cn: 纤维增强超高温陶瓷基复合材料
name_en: fiber reinforced ultra high temperature ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 纤维增强陶瓷基复合材料是一种重要的材料类别，旨在解决极端高温环境下材料性能不足的问题。这些复合材料以碳纤维和碳化硅纤维为增强相，采用超高温陶瓷作为基体，通常包括熔点在3000°C以上的碳化物、硼化物和氮化物。它们的研发旨在提高超高温陶瓷在高温、高压、高速等极端条件下的可靠性和性能。超高温陶瓷基复合材料制备方法多种多样，主要包括以下几种：1. 化学气相渗透（CVI）：这一方法使用超高温陶瓷的金属卤化物前驱体与其他气体（如碳氢气体和含硼气体）反应，将超高温陶瓷基体沉积在纤维表面。2. 聚合物浸渍-热解工艺（PIP）：这一过程涉及将超高温陶瓷有机前驱体浸渍到纤维预制体中，经过多次浸渍和热解，最终形成超高温陶瓷基体。3. 反应熔渗工艺：这个方法使用金属，如金属锆或其合金，以熔体的形式渗入多孔含碳的纤维预制体中，与碳反应，形成碳化物超高温相。这些纤维增强的超高温陶瓷基复合材料在高超音速飞行器、超燃冲压发动机、空间飞行器热防护材料等领域中得到广泛应用。它们能够承受高温氧化、烧蚀和冲刷等严酷的极端环境，为航空航天领域提供了重要的材料解决方案。
explanation_en: Fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite is an important materials category, which aims to solve the problem of insufficient materials performance under extreme high temperature environment. These composite materials use carbon fiber and silicon carbide fiber as the reinforced phase, and uhra high temperature ceramics as the matrix, usually including carbide, boride and nitride with melting point above 3000 ° C. Their research and development aims to improve the reliability and performance of uhra high temperature ceramics under extreme conditions such as high temperature, high pressure and high speed. The preparation methods of ultra high temperature ceramic matrix composite are diverse, mainly including the following: 1 Chemical vapor infiltration (CVI): This method uses the metal halide precursor of uhra high temperature ceramics to react with other gases (such as hydrocarbon gas and boron containing gas), and deposits the matrix of uhra high temperature ceramics on the fiber surface. 2. polymer impregnation pyrolysis process (PIP): This process involves impregnating uhra high temperature ceramics organic precursors into fiber preforms, and finally forming uhra high temperature ceramics matrix after repeated impregnation and pyrolysis. 3. Reaction infiltration process: This method uses metal, such as metal zirconium or its alloy, to penetrate into porous carbon containing fiber preforms in the form of melt, react with carbon, and form carbide ultra-high temperature phase. These fiber reinforced ultra high temperature ceramic matrix composite have been widely used in hypersonic aircraft, supersonic stamping engines, thermal protection materials for spacecraft and other fields. They can withstand severe extreme environments such as high temperalure oxidation, ablation and erosion, and provide important materials solutions for the aerospace field.

name_cn: 纤维增强金属基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以金属及其合金为基体、以硼纤维、氧化铝纤维、碳化硅纤维、碳纤维与石墨纤维等为增强材料的复合材料。常用的金属基体有铝、钛、镁、铜及其合金以及金属间化合物等。该类复合材料的耐温性能随基体不同而异：铝基复合材料工作温度350-400℃，钛基复合材料工作温度600-750°C，高温合金基复合材料工作温度可在lOO0℃以上。传统的的制备方法可以分为三大类，分别为固态法、液态法和涂层热压法。纤维增强金属基复合材料具有比强度、比模量高，耐磨性强，耐高温性能好，导电、导热性好，抗疲劳，抗老化等优良的综合性能，特别适用于航空航天工业中，如航天飞机主舵骨支柱、飞机发动机风扇叶片、尾翼、空间站结构材料等。此外.在汽车结构、保险杠、活塞连杆、自行车车架以及体育运动和其他器械上也得到了应用。
explanation_en: Composite materials with metal and its alloy as matrix and boron fiber, alumina fiber, silicon carbide fiber, carbon fiber and graphite fiber as reinforcement materials. The commonly used metal matrix includes aluminum, titanium, magnesium, copper and its alloy, as well as imermetallif compound. The temperature resistance of such composite materials varies with the matrix: the working temperature of aluminum matrix composite materials is 350-400 ℃, the working temperature of titanium matrix composite materials is 600-750 ℃, and the working temperature of high temperature alloy matrix composite materials can be above 100 ℃. The traditional preparation methods can be divided into three categories: solid state method, liquid state method, and coating hot pressing method. Fiber reinforces metal-matrix composites have excellent comprehensive properties, such as high specific strength, specific modulus, strong wear resistance, high temperature resistance, good electrical and thermal conductivity, fatigue resistance, aging resistance, etc. They are especially suitable for aerospace industry, such as the main rudder pillar of the space shuttle, fan blades of the aircraft engine, tail wings, structural materials of the space station, etc. In addition, it has also been applied in automotive structures, bumpers, piston connecting rods, bicycle frames, as well as sports and other equipment.

explanation_cn: 纤维在各种不同的条件下所具有的适应能力。可以分为物理性能、力学性能、稳定性能、加工性能和使用性能等。
explanation_en: The adaptability of fibers under various conditions. It can be divided into physical performance, mechanical performance, stability performance, processing performance, and usage performance.

explanation_cn: 一维方向上的尺度远大于另外二维尺度的晶体。是由伸展高分子链交错连接构成的，因此的长度大大超过高分子链的长度。
explanation_en: The scale in one dimension is much larger than that in other two dimensions of crystal. It is composed of stretched macromolecule chains interlaced, so its length is much longer than that of macromolecule chains.

explanation_cn: 以植物纤维为原料，有的加人少量化学剂，多数不经化学处理直接以机械方法分离成单体纤维和纤维束，并在其中加入一定量的添加剂（如增强剂、防水剂、防火剂等）制成浆液，再用成型机制成板坯，通过热压作用，使互相交织的纤维之间自身产生结合力，或者利用加人胶合剂的胶合作用，重新组合成板材。按原料可分为木质、非木质。湿法硬质纤维板制造工艺为：切片、筛选、热磨、精磨、添加防水剂、成型、预压、热压、裁边、分等。用途广泛，软质主要用于天花板、隔声材料;硬质可用作包装材料、家具背面板。中密度可用于家具、车、船、音乐器材等。
explanation_en: With plant fiber as raw material, some are added with a small amount of chemicals, most of which are directly separated into monomer fibers and fiber bundles without chemical treatment, and a certain amount of additive (such as reinforcing agent, waterproof agent, fireproof agent, etc.) are added into them to make slurry, and then the molding machine is used to make slabs. Through hot pressing, the interlaced fibers can produce their own bonding force, or the bonding effect of added adhesives is used, Reassemble into sheets. According to raw materials, it can be divided into wood and non wood. The manufacturing process of wet hard fiberboard includes: slicing, screening, hot grinding, fine grinding, adding waterproof agent, forming, pre pressing, hot pressing, trimming, grading, etc. Widely used, soft material is mainly used for ceiling and acoustic insulation materials; Hard can be used as packaging materials and furniture back panel. Medium density can be used for furniture, cars, boats, music equipment, etc.

explanation_cn: 通过β-1,4-糖苷键结合而成的线型天然高聚物，是植物细胞壁的主要组成物质，也是地球上储量最多、分布最广的有机化合物之一。纤维素存在于许多植物和废物中，其中棉花中的含量最高，可达95%到99%；木材中含有40%到50%的纤维素；而稻谷、麦草、竹、芦苇等的茎部含有10%到50%的纤维素；苎麻等的韧皮部分含有80%到90%的纤维素。纤维素也可以在海藻、细菌和动物皮膜中找到。天然纤维素的密度约为1.60 g/cm3，聚合度通常在1000到15000之间，分子量分布较为分散，其化学性质非常稳定，不溶于水和一般有机溶剂。在酸性条件下，纤维素会分解成单糖，而在强碱性条件下，纤维素会发生液化。纤维素的溶解通常需要特殊溶剂，如金属胺溶剂、铁酒石酸钠溶剂和一些非水溶剂。天然纤维素的结晶度通常在80%到90%之间，这对其物理化学性质起着决定性作用。天然纤维素（如棉花和亚麻）主要用于织物原料。此外，纤维素经过化学处理后，可以制得硝化纤维素、醋酸纤维素、黄原酸纤维素等，这些产品广泛用于制造人造纤维、涂料、薄膜、印刷电路板、电气绝缘材料、塑料、炸药等。纤维素还可以通过水解生成葡萄糖，用于发酵等过程，制备酵母、乙醇以及合成树脂、氨基酸等的原料。木材中也富含纤维素，因此被广泛用于造纸和化学加工。
explanation_en: adopt β- A linear natural polymer formed by the binding of 1,4-glycosidic bonds is the main component of plant cell walls and one of the most abundant and widely distributed organic compounds on Earth. Cellulose exists in many plants and wastes, among which cotton has the highest content, up to 95% to 99%; Wood contains 40% to 50% cellulose; The stems of rice, wheat straw, bamboo, reed, etc. contain 10% to 50% cellulose; The phloem of ramie, etc. contains 80% to 90% cellulose. Cellulose can also be found in algae, bacteria and animal skins. The density of natural cellulose is about 1.60 g/cm 3， The degree of polymerization is usually between 1000 and 15000, the molecular weight distribution is relatively dispersed, its chemical properties are very stable, and it is insoluble in water and general organic solvents. Under acidic conditions, cellulose will be decomposed into monosaccharides, while under strong alkaline conditions, cellulose will be liquefied. The dissolution of cellulose usually requires special solvents, such as metal amine solvent, iron sodium tartrate solvent and some non-aqueous solvents. The crystallinity of natural cellulose is usually between 80% and 90%, which plays a decisive role in its physical chemistry properties. Natural cellulose (such as cotton and flax) is mainly used as fabric raw material. In addition, after chemical treatment, cellulose can be made into nitrocellulose, cellulose acetate, xanthate cellulose, etc. These products are widely used to manufacture man-made fibers, coatings, films, printed circuit boards, electrical insulation materials, plastics, explosive, etc. Cellulose can also be hydrolyzed to produce glucose, which can be used in fermentation and other processes to prepare yeast, ethanol, synthetic resin, amino acids and other raw materials. Wood is also rich in cellulose, so it is widely used in paper making and chemical machining.

explanation_cn: 用纤维在三维空间内编织成型的复合材料增强体，编织预成型体的纤维向有向、四向、七向和十一向等。预成型体可编成立方体、圆柱体、圆筒壳、圆锥壳、方管、I和T字形等截面的异型构件。按编织工艺不同有辫织、机织、穿刺和针织。由于一维和二维铺层的复合材料，其层间剪切强度较弱，受剪容易分层破坏，限制了应用;用三维编织的增强体制成的复合材料，不仅保持了一维二维增强复合的特性，而且大幅度地增加了层间承载能力，是复合材料比较理想的增强相。
explanation_en: The composite materials reinforcement is woven with fibers in three-dimensional space, and the fiber direction of the braided preform is directional, four-way, seven way and eleven way. Preformed bodies can be woven into irregular components with cross sections such as cubes, cylinders, cylindrical shells, conical shells, square tubes, I and T shapes. According to different weaving techniques, there are braiding, weaving, piercing, and knitting. Due to the weak interlaminar shear strength of one-dimensional and two-dimensional laminated composite materials, it is easy to delaminate under shear, which limits its application; The composite materials made of three-dimensional braided reinforcement system not only maintains the characteristics of one-dimensional and two-dimensional reinforced composition, but also greatly increases the interlaminar bearing capacity. It is an ideal reinforcement phase of composite materials.

name_cn: 纤维补强陶瓷基复合材料
explanation_cn: 在陶瓷基体中添加纤维以提高强度和韧性的材料。此外，将玻璃基和玻璃陶瓷基复合材料归入陶瓷基复合材料的范畴。常用的陶瓷基体包括碳化物（如碳化硅、碳化锆、碳化铪、碳化硼以及碳化物复相基体等）、氮化物（如氮化硅、氮化硼、氮化铝、氮化铪等）、硼化物（如硼化锆、硼化铪以及硼化物复相基体等）、氧化物（如氧化铝、莫来石、钙长石、Sialon、熔石英等）。目前可用的纤维主要包括碳（石墨）纤维、碳化硅纤维、氮化硼纤维、石英玻璃纤维、氧化铝纤维、莫来石纤维等。选择纤维必须满足工作环境的需求，并在热力学上与基体相匹配。制备陶瓷基复合材料的方法主要包括化学气相渗透法、聚合物浸渍热解法、料浆浸渍热压法、热等静压法和反应熔渗法等。纤维补强陶瓷基复合材料利用高强度纤维骨架，通过纤维对陶瓷基体的补强和增韧，有效提高了在实际应用条件下的可靠性。增韧机理主要包括载荷转移、微裂纹增韧、裂纹偏转、纤维脱粘和纤维拔出等。因此，需要在纤维表面施加涂层，以防止纤维与基体发生反应并受损，并确保纤维与基体之间形成弱界面结合。纤维增强陶瓷基复合材料克服了传统陶瓷的低韧性和易脆性断裂的问题，具有密度低、比强度高、高断裂韧性、非脆性断裂和高可靠性等优点。目前应用研究较多的有CF/SiC、Si3N4/SiC、Al2O3/SiC等复合材料，主要用于高温发动机的耐热部件，如航空发动机密封片、尾喷管调W片等热结构部件，航天器的热防护部件以及透波天线罩等领域。
explanation_en: A materials in which fibers are added to a ceramic matrix to improve strength and toughness. In addition, glass matrix and glass-ceramics matrix composite materials are classified as ceramic matrix composite. Commonly used ceramics matrix includes carbide (such as silicon carbide, carbonization zirconium, carbonization hafnium, boron carbide and carbide multiphase matrix), nitride (such as silicon nitride, nitriding boron, aluminum nitride, nitriding hafnium, etc.), boride (such as zirconium borate, hafnium borate and borate multiphase matrix, etc.), oxides (such as aluminum oxide, mullite, calcium feldspar, sialon, fused quartz, etc.). Currently available fibers mainly include carbon (graphite) fiber, silicon carbide fiber, boron nitride fiber, quzrtz glass fiber, alumina fiber, mullite fiber, etc. The fiber selection must meet the requirements of the working environment and match with the matrix in thermodynamics. The preparation methods of ceramic matrix composite mainly include chemical vapor infiltration, polymer impregnation pyrolysis method, slurry impregnation hot pressing, hot isostatic pressing and reactive infiltration. Fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite use high-strength fiber skeleton, through fiber reinforcement and toughening of ceramics matrix, effectively improve the reliability under practical application conditions. The toughening mechanism mainly includes load transfer, microcrack toughening, crack deflection, fiber debonding, and fiber pull-out. Therefore, it is necessary to apply a coating on the fiber surface to prevent the fiber from reacting with and damaging the matrix, and to ensure that a weak interface is formed between the fiber and the matrix. Fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite overcome the problems of low toughness and brittle fracture of traditional ceramics, and have the advantages of low density, high specific strength, high fracture toughness, non brittle fracture and high reliability. At present, composite materials such as CF/SiC, Si3N4/SiC, Al2O3/SiC, etc., which are mainly used for heat-resistant parts of high-temperature engines, such as thermal structural parts such as aeroengine seals, tail nozzle W-switches, thermal protection parts of spacecraft, and wave transmitting radome, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称约瑟夫森隨穿效应。该效应是指成对电子穿过两个超导体弱连接区域的现象。是一种超流现象，即在无外加电压情况下的长时间电流循环流动。该效应可分三种类型：①直流，在无任何外界电磁场的情况下，因库柏对的隧穿现象产生的直流电流。该约瑟夫森直流电流强度与绝缘体两侧电子波函数相位差的正弦成正比。②交流约瑟夫森效应，在约瑟夫森结两端加一个直流电场产生交变电流的现象。③逆交流，在约瑟夫森结两端加一个交流电场产生直流电流的现象;这时，约瑟夫森结的作用相当于一个完美的频率-电压转换器。约瑟夫森于1962年指出不仅正常电子能够穿透两块超导体之间的绝缘势垒，同样库柏电子对也有类似行为。究其原因是由于两块超导体的电子波函数之间存在一种耦合，这种耦合致使形成隧穿超导电流，该电流的强度取决于两边超导体波函数的位相差。电子对的隧道贯穿过程还引起所谓超导量子干涉效应，这是一种利用磁场对约瑟夫森结中超电流位相的调制作用而得到的干涉/衍射现象。
explanation_en: Also known as the Josephson effect. This effect refers to the phenomenon of paired electrons passing through the weakly connected regions of two superconductors. It is a phenomenon of overcurrent, which refers to the long-term cyclic flow of current without external voltage. This effect can be divided into three types: ① DC, the direct current generated by the tunneling phenomenon of Cooper pairs in the absence of any external electromagnetic field. The Josephson DC current intensity is proportional to the sine of the phase difference between the electron wave functions on both sides of the insulator AC Josephson effect, the phenomenon of alternating current generated by adding a DC electric field at both ends of the Josephson joint. ③ Reverse AC, the phenomenon that an AC electric field is applied at both ends of the Josephson joint to generate DC current; At this point, the Josephson junction acts as a perfect frequency voltage converter. Josephson pointed out in 1962 that not only can normal electrons penetrate the insulating barrier between two superconductors, but Cooper electron pairs also exhibit similar behavior. The reason for this is due to a coupling between the electronic wave functions of two superconductors, which leads to the formation of a tunneling superconducting current. The strength of this current depends on the phase difference of the wave functions of the two superconductors. The tunneling process of the electron pair also causes the so-called superconducting quantum interference effect, which is an interference/diffraction phenomenon obtained by using the modulation of the magnetic field on the super current phase in the Josephson junction.

explanation_cn: 它是由两个超导体通过弱连接构成的。其中弱连接可以用薄绝缘壁（称为超导-绝缘-超导接点，或S-I-S)、短的非超导金属节（S-N-S)或一种物理上能收缩以减弱连接点超导性的物质（S-s-S)构成。每一个都具有一个临界电流。如果流过的电流小于这个临界电流，则上无电压降。电流稍大于临界值，就会发生多重安德烈夫反射。电流大到使结两边电压差超过超导体的带隙时，电流-电压关系就变得线性，多重安德烈夫反射消失。
explanation_en: It is composed of two superconductors through week connectivity. The week connectivity can be made of a thin insulating wall (called superconductor insulation superconductor contact, or S-I-S), a short non superconducting metal joint (S-N-S), or a substance (S-s-S) that can shrink physically to weaken the superconductivity of the connection point. Each has a critical current. If the current flowing is less than the critical current, there is no voltage drop on the power supply. If the current is slightly greater than the critical value, multiple Andrev reflections will occur. When the current is large enough to cause the voltage difference between the two sides of the junction to exceed the bandgap of the superconductor, the current voltage relationship becomes linear, and multiple Andrev reflections disappear.

explanation_cn: 从理论上讲纯铁是不含碳及其他任何杂质的铁，但实际上不可能完全不含杂质，故纯铁通常指碳及杂质含量很低的铁。根据纯度吋大致分为工业纯铁（纯度99.5%~99.9%)、纯铁（纯度99.90%~99.99%)和高纯铁（纯度99.990%-99.997%)三类。根据生产工艺可分为区域熔炼铁、电解铁、氢处理铁、阿姆科铁等纯铁纯度越高.强度越低，延展性越好，电磁性能越优良。不含任何杂质的铁的室温屈服强度仅为53~57MPa，极微量的碳可产生明显的固溶强化作用，而微量硫、磷则在含量很低也容易引起热脆和冷脆。纯铁的力学性能随纯度（特别是碳含量）和晶粒尺寸的不同而在一定范围内变化，98~116MPa,176?274MPa,A30%~60%,70%~85%,硬度HB50~80。高纯铁主要用于研究和制作标样.具有优良磁性的纯铁可用作电磁材料，而具有良好塑性变形能力的纯铁可用作深冲材料
explanation_en: In theory, pure iron is iron without carbon and any other impurities, but in fact it cannot be completely free of impurities, so pure iron usually refers to iron with low carbon and impurities. According to the purity, it can be roughly divided into three categories: Armco-iron (purity of 99.5%~99.9%), pure iron (purity of 99.90%~99.99%) and high purity iron (purity of 99.990%~99.997%). According to the production process, it can be divided into regional melting iron, electrolytic iron, hydrogen treated iron, Armco-iron and other pure iron with higher purity, lower strength, better ductility and better electromagnetic performance. The room temperature yield strength of iron without any impurities is only 53~57MPa. A very small amount of carbon can produce an obvious solution strengthening effect, while a small amount of sulfur and phosphorus can easily cause hot and cold embrittlement at a very low content. The mechanical properties of pure iron vary with the purity (especially carbon content) and grain size in a certain range, 98~116MPa, 176? 274MPa, A30%~60%, 70%~85%, hardness HB50~80. High purity iron is mainly used for research and making standard samples. pure iron with excellent magnetism can be used as electromagnetic materials, while pure iron with good plastic deformation can be used as deep drawing materials

explanation_cn: 又称紫铜，工业用金属铜.纯度高于99.5%。通常爭紫红色。纯铜具有优良的导电、导热、耐蚀和焊接性能。又有一定的强度，广泛用于导电、导热、耐蚀器件。纯铜在室温下的导电性能仅次于银。高纯铜（99.99%)在20°C时的电阻率cm。纯铜分三类：①加丁.紫铜。其中又细分四种牌号，即一号、二号、三号和四号紫铜.纯度分别为：99.95%、99.90%、99.70%、99.5%;②无氧铜和脱氧铜。无氧铜有一号和二号两种，含氧量均小于0.003%,脱氧铜分磷脱氧铜和锰脱氧铜两种，含氧量小于0.001%,锰的残留量0.1%~0.3%。
explanation_en: Also known as purple copper, it is an industrial metal copper with a purity higher than 99.5%. Usually competes for purple red. explanation_cn: 这是一种反渗透膜，通常也称为纳滤膜或疏松型反渗透膜。这种膜的孔径通常在1到2纳米左右，允许溶剂分子或某些低分子量的溶质或低价离子通过，因此它是一种功能性的半透膜。纳滤膜具有离子选择性，其中膜表面或膜内部带有带负电的功能基团，通过静电相互作用来阻碍多价离子的渗透。纳滤膜通常需要在3.5到30巴的运行压力下操作，可以截留分子量约在150到500左右的有机物和高价无机盐。纳滤膜可以制成不同的材料，包括醋酸纤维素、磺化聚醚砜、聚酰亚胺和聚乙烯等。最早的应用领域之一是海水淡化。在水处理中，它经常用于去除色素、低分子量有机物、悬浮物、消毒副产物（如三氯甲烷和卤代乙酸）及其前体，以及重金属的分离。纳滤膜对去除色度、硬度、异味等方面有出色的能力。此外，它还在食品和医药生产中用于有用物质的提取和浓缩。
explanation_en: This is a kind of reverse osmosis membrane, also known as nanofiltration membrane or loose reverse osmosis membrane. The pore size of this membrane is usually around 1 to 2 nanometers, allowing solvent molecules or certain low molecular weight solutes or low valent ions to pass through, making it a functional semi permeable membrane. Nanofiltration membrane has ion selectivity, in which there are functional groups with negative electricity on the surface or inside of the membrane, which can block the penetration of multivalent ions through electrostatic interaction. The nanofiltration membrane usually needs to be operated under the operating pressure of 3.5 to 30 bar, which can intercept organics and high valence inorganic salts with molecular weight of about 150 to 500. Nanofiltration membrane can be made into different materials, including cellulose acetate, sulfonated polyether sulphone, polyimide, polyethylene, etc. One of the earliest application areas was seawater desalination. In water treatment, it is often used to remove pigment, low molecular weight organics, suspended solids, disinfection by-products (such as chloroform and haloacetic acid) and their precursors, and to separate heavy metals. Nanofiltration membrane has excellent ability to remove chromaticity, hardness, odor, etc. In addition, it is also used for the extraction and concentration of useful substances in food and pharmaceutical production.

explanation_cn: 纳米仿生是一门跨学科领域，它受到生物学中各种生物特性的启发或模拟，以开发纳米尺度的材料。这个新兴学科在仿生学的基础上结合了纳米科学，旨在通过研究生物材料的有序结构和功能，人工设计和合成具有生物结构和功能类似的纳米材料。这构成了现代纳米仿生的基础。在自然界中，很多生物体的特殊功能都与其微观尺度的纳米结构有关。纳米仿生的核心思想是从自然中获取灵感，然后合成微观尺度上的材料结构，从而显著改善材料的特定性质。纳米仿生研究包括从分子水平到整体多层次结构的生命过程，探究了生物组织形成不同材料的机理、材料结构、性能以及形成过程之间的相互关系，最终以此为基础设计和合成新型材料。为制备纳米仿生材料，目前已经有多种物理和化学方法可供选择，包括异相成核法、等离子体处理法、刻蚀法、阳极氧化法、气相沉积法、模板法、静电纺丝法、溶胶-凝胶法、电化学法、交替沉积法、自组装法、溶剂-非溶剂法以及直接成膜法等。纳米仿生材料已经广泛应用于多个领域，包括纺织、电子、环境、能源、生物学、农业、航空和军事等。这些材料的开发有望在各种领域中推动技术和科学的发展。
explanation_en: Nanobionics is an interdisciplinary field, which is inspired or simulated by various biological characteristics in biology to develop nanoscale materials. This new discipline combines nano science on the basis of bionics, aiming to artificially design and synthesize nanomaterials with similar biological structure and function by studying the ordered structure and function of biological materials. This forms the foundation of modern nano biomimetics. In nature, the special functions of many organisms are related to their microscale nanostructures. The core idea of nano bionics is to obtain inspiration from nature, and then synthesize micro scale materials structures to significantly improve the specific properties of materials. Nanobionic research includes the life process from the molecular level to the overall multi-level structure. It explores the mechanism of biological tissue forming different materials, the structure and performance of materials, and the relationship between the formation process, and ultimately designs and synthesizes advanced materials based on this. In order to prepare nano bionic materials, there are many physical and chemical methods to choose from, including heterogeneous nucleation method, plasma treatment method, etching method, anodic oxidation method, vapor deposition method, template method, electrostatic spinning method, sol-gel method, electrochemical method, alternative deposition method, self-assembly method, solvent non solvent method and direct film forming method. Nano bionic materials have been widely used in many fields, including textile, electronics, environment, energy, biology, agriculture, aviation and military. The development of these materials is expected to promote the development of technology and science in various fields.

explanation_cn: 纳米储能材料是指利用纳米材料、纳米结构或纳米复合材料的物理或化学变化来储存能量的功能材料。其储存的能量可以是电能、机械能、化学能或热能，也可以是其他形式的能量。纳米电极材料具有较大的表面积，有利于离子的吸附，增大电极的有效反应面积。纳米材料的特征尺寸很小，大大缩短了离子扩散时间。纳米有序结构有利于离子传输，可以提高电极材料的比电容和倍率特性，从而提高电化学储能器件的能量密度和功率密度。纳米储能材料广泛用于锂离子电池、超级电容器、燃料敏化太阳能电池、燃料电池、储氢材料等领域。
explanation_en: Energy storage nanomaterials refer to functional materials that use physical or chemical changes of nanomaterials, nanostructures or nanocomposites to store energy. The energy stored can be electrical energy, mechanical energy, chemical energy, thermal energy, or other forms of energy. The nanoelectrode materials has a large surface area, which is conducive to the adsorption of ions and increases the effective reaction area of the electrode. The characteristic size of nanomaterials is very small, which greatly shortens the diffusion time of ions. Ordered nanostructures are conducive to ion transport and can improve the specific capacitance and magnification characteristics of electrode materials, thus improving the energy density and power density of electrochemical energy storage devices. Energy storage nanomaterials are widely used in Li ion battery, supercapacitors, fuel sensitized solar cell, fuel cell, hydrogen storage materials and other fields.

explanation_cn: 纳米催化是指发生在具备纳米尺度结构的催化材料表面上的催化反应过程，以及由于催化剂所具有的纳米尺度而表现出的独特催化效应。典型的纳米催化剂包括零维纳米粒子或纳米簇，一维纳米线、纳米棒和纳米管，以及二维纳米薄膜。在这些纳米结构上发生的反应通常表现出与体相材料迥异的催化性能。这种催化特性的变化一般是由于纳米尺寸效应、纳米形貌效应、纳米界面效应以及纳米限域效应等因素引起的。例如，体相金一直被认为是催化惰性的，但是纳米金在诸多反应中表现出优异的催化性能。分子筛内纳米孔道中的催化反应通常表现出很好的选择性催化效应。近年来，由于纳米合成方法的发展，可以实现纳米材料的可控设计和组装。同时，纳米表征技术的进步使得能够在原子和分子尺度上对纳米结构表面上的催化反应过程进行研究。这些进展大大促进了新的纳米催化剂体系的设计和开发，有望解决在能源、环境、健康等领域发展中所面临的许多重大问题。
explanation_en: Nano catalysis refers to the catalytic reaction process that takes place on the surface of catalytic surface of materials with nanoscale structure, as well as the unique catalytic effect due to the nanoscale of the catalyst. Typical nano catalysts include zero dimensional nanoparticles or nanoclusters, one-dimensional nanowires, nanorods and nanotube, and two-dimensional nano films. The reactions on these nanostructures usually show different catalytic properties from those of bulk phase materials. The changes in catalytic properties are generally caused by factors such as nano size effects, nano morphology effects, nano interface effects, and nano confinement effects. For example, bulk phase gold has always been considered as catalytic inert, but nano gold has shown excellent catalytic performance in many reactions. The catalytic reactions in the nanopores within molecular sieves typically exhibit excellent selective catalytic effects. In recent years, due to the development of nano synthesis methods, controllable design and assembly of nanomaterials can be realized. At the same time, the advancement of nano characterization technology enables the study of catalytic reaction processes on the surface of nanostructures at the atomic and molecular scales. These developments have greatly promoted the design and development of new nanocatalyst systems, which are expected to solve many major problems faced in the development of energy, environment, health, and other fields.

explanation_cn: 指以纳米尺度的材料为光催化剂，进行光催化反应的过程。采用纳米尺度的光催化剂的优点主要有:①量子尺寸效应使半导体能隙变宽，导带电位变得更负，而价带电位变得更正，从而使光催化剂具有更强的氧化还原能力;②相比于块体材料，纳米颗粒的比表面积较大，高比表面积使得光催化材料具有强大的吸附污染物的能力，有利于提高催化反应的速率。催化剂的尺寸越小，电子与空穴复合概率越小，电荷分离效果越好，催化活性越好。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of photocatalytic reaction with nanometer materials as photocatalyst. The advantages of using nanoscale photocatalyst mainly include: ① quantum size effect widens the semiconductor energy gap, makes the conduction band potential more negative, and corrects the valence band potential, so that the photocatalyst has stronger redox ability; ② Compared with the block materials, the specific surface of nanoparticle is larger. The high specific surface area makes the photocatalytic materials have a strong ability to absorb pollutants, which is conducive to improving the rate of catalytic reaction. The smaller the size of the catalyst, the smaller the probability of electron hole composition, the better the charge separation effect and the better the catalytic activity.

explanation_cn: 纳米光催化材料是一类通过在光照下促发光化学反应，将光能转化为化学能的材料，其至少有一维尺度在1到100纳米范围内。这类催化材料主要包括纳米半导体材料，如二氧化钛、氧化锌、氧化锡、二氧化锆、硫化镉等。其中，纳米二氧化钛因其强氧化性、稳定性和无毒性成为最重要的纳米光催化材料。纳米光催化材料比相应的体相材料具有更高的催化活性，这可以归因于以下几个原因：尺寸效应：纳米半导体颗粒具有尺寸效应，使其能级呈现分立态，电子的导带电势更低，价带电势更高，从而提高还原和氧化能力。比表面积增大：纳米光催化剂的比表面积相对较大，增强了对底物的吸附能力。快速电子传输：较小的颗粒尺寸导致光生电子更快地从晶体内扩散到表面，减小了电子和空穴的复合概率，从而提高了光催化效率。纳米光催化材料通常分为紫外线光催化材料和可见光光催化材料。它们应用广泛，包括抗菌和除臭、有机物分解、重金属离子处理、废气净化、光解水制氢、光催化有机和无机反应化学以及太阳能电池等领域。这些材料的制备方法包括溶胶-凝胶法、水热法、微乳液法、化学气相沉积法等。
explanation_en: Photocatalytic nanomaterials are a kind of materials that can convert light energy into chemical energy by promoting luminescence chemical reaction under light, with at least one dimension in the range of 1 to 100 nm. Such catalytic materials mainly include nano semiconductor materials, such as titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, tin oxide, zirconia, cadmium sulfide, etc. Among them, nanometer titanium dioxide has become the most important photocatalytic nanomaterials due to its strong oxidation, stability and non-toxic. Photocatalytic nanomaterials have higher catalytic activity than corresponding bulk phase materials, which can be attributed to the following reasons: size effect: nano semiconductor particles have size effect, making their energy level appear discrete, the conduction band potential of electrons is lower, and the valence band potential is higher, thus improving the reduction and oxidation capabilities. Specific surface increases: The specific surface of the nano photocatalyst is relatively large, which enhances the adsorption capacity of the substrate. Fast electron transport: smaller particle size leads to faster diffusion of photogenerated electrons from the crystal to the surface, reducing the composition probability of electrons and holes, thus improving the photocatalytic efficiency. Photocatalytic nanomaterials are generally divided into UV photocatalysis materials and visible light photocatalysis materials. They are widely used, including antibacterial and deodorization, organic decomposition, heavy metal ion treatment, waste gas purification, hydrogen generation production from water photolysis, photocatalytic organic and inorganic reaction chemistry, and solar cell. The preparation methods of these materials include sol-gel method, hydrothermal method, microemulsion method, chemical vapor deposition method, etc.

explanation_cn: 是一门结合纳米技术与光子学的新型交叉技术，可以定义为"利用近场光学对纳米器件进行设计、制造和运用的技术"。纳米光子技术是研究在纳米尺度上光与物质相互作用的科学与技术，在纳米尺度上实现对光子的操纵和光学器件的构筑是纳米光子技术的研究目标，目前相关的研究热点集中在纳米光子学材料、光波导、生物光子表面等离子体、磁等离子体晶体等多个方向。
explanation_en: It is a new cross technology combining nanotechnology and photonics, which can be defined as "the technology of using near-field optics to design, manufacture and apply nano devices". Nanophotonics is a science and technology that studies the interaction of light and matter at the nanometer scale. The research goal of nanophotonics is to achieve the manipulation of photons and the construction of optical devices at the nanometer scale. At present, the relevant research focuses on nano photonics materials, optical waveguides, biophoton surface plasmons, magnetic plasma crystal and other directions.

explanation_cn: 纳米光存储材料是在光存储技术中使用的一种特殊材料，它通过光束的作用实现光学参数的改变，从而实现信息的记录和读取。这些材料通常拥有纳米尺度的结构，以实现高密度的信息存储。纳米光存储材料可以根据其成分和功能划分为不同的类别：成分：纳米光存储材料可以是金属、硫族元素、类硅元素、多元合金、有机物等不同的物质。这些材料的选择取决于其在特定应用中的性能和适用性。功能：根据功能，纳米光存储材料可以分为可擦除和不可擦除的两类。可擦除的材料可以多次记录和擦除信息，而不可擦除的材料记录后信息不可轻易删除。与光作用方式：根据与入射光的相互作用方式，纳米光存储材料可以分为烧蚀型、绒面-镜面型、鼓泡型、共晶型、散粒型和相变型材料。每种类型都有不同的工作原理和应用场景。存储原理：根据存储原理的不同，纳米光存储材料可以分为热致模式和光致模式。热致模式通常涉及通过光束产生热效应来改变材料性质，而光致模式则侧重于通过光激发来改变材料的状态。相较于传统磁存储材料，纳米光存储材料具有许多优势，包括更高的存储密度、更长的存储寿命以及更高的信息载噪比，使其在高密度信息存储等领域具有广泛的应用前景。
explanation_en: Photonic storage nanomaterials is a special materials used in optical storage technology. It changes optical parameters through the role of light beam, thus realizing the recording and reading of information. These materials usually have nanoscale structures to achieve high density information storage. Photonic storage nanomaterials can be divided into different categories according to their composition and function: composition: photonic storage nanomaterials can be different substances such as metals, sulfur group elements, silicon like elements, multi-component alloy, organics, etc. The choice of these materials depends on their performance and suitability for the particular application. Functions: According to functions, photonic storage nanomaterials can be divided into two categories: erasable and non erasable. Erasable materials can record and erase information for many times, while non erasable materials cannot be deleted easily after recording. Interaction mode with light: According to the interaction mode with incident light, photonic storage nanomaterials can be divided into ablation type, textured mirror type, bubbling type, eutectic type, granular type and phase change type materials. Each type has different working principles and application scenarios. Storage principle: According to different storage principles, photonic storage nanomaterials can be divided into thermal mode and photomode. The thermally induced mode usually involves changing the properties of materials by generating thermal effects through light beams, while the photoinduced mode focuses on changing the state of materials by light excitation. Compared with traditional magnetic storage materials, photonic storage nanomaterials have many advantages, including higher storage density, longer storage life and higher information carrier noise ratio, which make them have a broad application prospect in high density information storage and other fields.

explanation_cn: 利用纳米材料的光电效应制成的光探测器件。这种探测器的分类主要基于所使用的材料和工作原理，主要包括半导体纳米光电探测器、金属纳米光电探测器和有机纳米光电探测器。半导体纳米光电探测器：这类探测器的工作原理是利用半导体材料在受到光照射后，光能激发了电子，从而改变了半导体纳米材料的电学性能。根据器件对不同入射光波长的响应，可以分为紫外、可见光、近红外、近-中红外和中远红外光电探测器。这些探测器在科研、军事和国民经济的各个领域具有广泛的应用前景。金属纳米光电探测器：金属纳米材料对光敏感，它们可以捕获光并引发电子的激发。这类探测器通常用于特定波长范围的应用，如红外光电探测器和太赫兹光电探测器。金属纳米光电探测器在红外热成像、红外遥感等领域有广泛应用。有机纳米光电探测器：这类探测器使用有机材料，通常是有机分子或聚合物，具有光电性能。它们可以用于光敏感应用，例如光电二极管或光电晶体管。不同类型的纳米光电探测器在各种光谱范围内具有广泛的应用，包括射线测量、红外热成像、导弹制导、工业自动控制、光度计量、光电子学、太赫兹技术等领域。这些探测器的发展有望推动光电子学和传感技术的进步。
explanation_en: A light detection device made of photoelectric effect of nanomaterials. The classification of such detectors is mainly based on the materials used and the working principle, including semiconductor nano photoelectric detector, metal nano photoelectric detector and organic nano photoelectric detector. Semiconductor nano photoelectric detector: the working principle of this type of detector is that the light energy excites electrons after semiconductor materials is irradiated by light, thus changing the electrical properties of semiconductor nanomaterials. According to the response of devices to different incident light wavelengths, they can be divided into ultraviolet, visible, near-infrared, near-mid infrared, and mid far infrared photodetectors. These detectors have broad application prospects in various fields such as scientific research, military, and national economy. Metal nano photoelectric detector: metal nanomaterials are sensitive to light, they can capture light and trigger the excitation of electrons. This type of detector is typically used for specific wavelength range applications, such as infrared photodetectors and terahertz photodetectors. Metal nano photoelectric detector are widely used in infrared thermal imaging, infrared remote sensing and other fields. Organic nano photoelectric detector: This type of detector uses organic materials, usually organic molecules or polymer, with photoelectric properties. They can be used for photosensitive applications, such as photodiodes or phototransistors. Different types of nano photoelectric detector have wide applications in various spectral ranges, including ray measurement, infrared thermal imaging, missile guidance, industrial automatic control, photometry, optoelectronics, terahertz technology and other fields. The development of these detectors is expected to promote the progress of optoelectronics and sensing technology.

explanation_cn: 其颗粒尺度介于1到100纳米之间，并具有光生伏特效应，可以将光能直接转化为电能或化学能等其他形式的能量。这些材料在光电转换过程中涉及分子、离子或固体物质吸收光能，导致电子处于激发态，然后发生电荷传递过程。纳米光电转换材料可以根据其组成分为以下几类：由有机化合物构成的半导体光电材料，如酞菁及其衍生物、卟啉及其衍生物、聚苯胺、噬菌调理素等。由无机化合物构成的光电材料，例如硅（Si）、二氧化钛（TiO2）、硫化锌（ZnS）、砷化镓（GaAs）、铜铟硒（CuInSe2）等。由中心金属离子和有机配体组成的光电功能配合物，如2-2联吡啶合铑类配合物。制备纳米光电转换材料的方法多种多样，包括化学沉淀法、溶胶凝胶法、微乳液法、水热法、激光诱导气相法、物理粉碎法、固相反应法、喷雾热分解法、醇盐水解法、溅射法、电解法、等离子气相合成法等。在实际应用中，为了控制材料的光响应范围、减少电荷的复合以提高太阳能利用效率，可以采用一些修饰和改性方法，包括：使用染料进行表面敏化，以扩展吸收光谱范围。在材料表面沉积贵金属，如金或银，以增强光吸收和电子传输。进行半导体复合，结合不同半导体材料的优势。通过过渡金属离子的掺杂来调控材料的电子结构和性能。纳米光电转换材料在太阳能电池、纳米激光器、光探测器等光电转换领域具有广泛的研究和应用，有望在未来的可再生能源和光电子学中发挥关键作用。
explanation_en: Its particle size ranges from 1 to 100 nanometers and has a photovoltaic effect, which can directly convert light energy into other forms of energy such as electrical or chemical energy. These materials involve molecules, ions or solid substances to absorb light energy in the photoelectric conversion process, resulting in the excited state of electrons, and then the charge transfer process occurs. Photo electric conversion nanomaterials can be divided into the following categories according to their composition: semiconductor photoelectric materials composed of organic compounds, such as phthalocyanine and its derivatives, porphyrin and its derivatives, polyanilene, bacteriophage opsonin, etc. Photoelectric materials composed of inorganic compounds, such as silicon (Si), titanium dioxide (TiO2), zinc sulfide (ZnS), gallium arsenide (GaAs), copper indium selenium (CuInSe2), etc. Optoelectronic functional complexes composed of central metal ions and organic ligands, such as 2-2 bipyridine rhodium complexes. There are many methods to prepare photo electric conversion nanomaterials, including chemical precipitation method, sol-gel method, microemulsion method, hydrothermal method, laser induced gas phase method, physical pulverization method, solid phase reaction method, spray pyrolysis method, alkoxide hydrolysis method, sputtering method, electrolysis method, plasma gas phase synthesis method, etc. In practical applications, in order to control materials and reduce the composition of charges to improve the utilization efficiency of solar energy, some modification and modification methods can be used, including surface sensitization with dye or dyestuffc to expand the range of absorption spectrum. Precious metals, such as gold or silver, are deposited on the surface of materials to enhance light absorption and electron transmission. Conduct semiconductor composition and combine the advantages of different semiconductor materials. The electronic structure and properties of materials are regulated by the doping of transition metal ions. Photo electric conversion nanomaterials have extensive research and application in photoelectric conversion fields such as solar cell, nano laser, photodetectors, and are expected to play a key role in renewable energy and optoelectronics in the future.

explanation_cn: 是以被固定在纳米光纤顶端的生物分子(酶、抗体、抗原等)为敏感元件，利用光敏(光电)换能器，将生物敏感元件选择性识别结合过程中引起(产生)的光学(光子)信号(荧光或不同颜色)转换成可测量的电信号，并以此来确定试样中待测底物的种类和浓度的传感器。纳米光纤生物传感器具有体积小、灵敏度高、电磁场干扰小、可用于细胞内部结构的实时观察和测试等特点。
explanation_en: It is a sensor that uses the biomolecules (enzymes, antibodies, antigens, etc.) fixed on the top of the nano optical fiber as the sensitive elements, and uses the photosensitive (photoelectric) transducer to convert the optical (photon) signals (fluorescence or different colors) caused (generated) in the selective recognition and binding process of the biosensitive elements into measurable electrical signals, and then determine the type and concentration of the substrate to be measured in the sample. Nano optical fibre biosensor has the characteristics of small size, high sensitivity, low electromagnetic interference, and can be used for real-time observation and testing of the internal structure of cells.

explanation_cn: 一般来说，纳米凝胶是指直径在200nm以下的水凝胶。纳米凝胶的基本结构是水凝胶，这是一种三维网状的聚合物，具有不可融化和不可溶性的特性，只能发生溶胀反应。相对于其他凝胶，纳米凝胶具有几个优势：首先，其尺寸较小，容易被细胞吞噬；其次，能够穿透人体内的各种保护膜，如脑膜，从而可以实现脑部给药；最后，它在药物载荷方面具有高效率。
explanation_en: Generally speaking, nanogel refers to hydrogel with a diameter below 200nm. The basic structure of nanogel is hydrogel, which is a three-dimensional network of polymer, with the characteristics of non melting and insoluble, and can only occur swelling reaction. Compared with other gel, nanogel have several advantages: first, they are small in size and easy to be swallowed by cells; Secondly, it can penetrate various protective membranes in the human body, such as the meninges, thus enabling brain drug delivery; Finally, it has high efficiency in drug loading.

explanation_cn: 又称基于纳米材料的绿色制版技术，是一种新型印刷制版技术，特指通过利用纳米材料和打印技术实现印刷制版的过程。这一技术具有非感光、无污染和低成本的特点。其基本原理是通过调控纳米材料的浸润性，将特制的转印材料精确打印到具有纳微米复合结构的超亲水版材上。通过调控转印材料与版材之间纳微米尺度界面性质，可以在印版上形成具有相反浸润性（亲油/亲水）的微区（图文区和非图文区），从而实现直接制版印刷。这一技术摒弃了传统感光成像的技术思路，从根本上解决了感光冲洗带来的污染问题，无需进行避光操作，简化了制版工艺，并大幅降低了成本。
explanation_en: Also known as green plate making technology based on nanomaterials based on nano materials, it is a new type of printing plate making technology, especially the process of realizing printing plate making by using nanomaterials and printing technology. This technology has the characteristics of non photosensitivity, non pollution, and low cost. Its basic principle is to precisely print the special transfer materials onto the super hydrophilic plate with nano micron composition structure by regulating the wettability of nanomaterials. By regulating the nano micron scale interface properties between transfer materials and plates, micro areas (graphic and non graphic areas) with opposite wettability (lipophilic/hydrophilic) can be formed on the plates, thus realizing direct plate making printing. This technology abandons the traditional approach of photosensitive imaging and fundamentally solves the pollution problem caused by photosensitive processing, eliminating the need for light avoidance operations, simplifying the plate making process, and significantly reducing costs.

explanation_cn: 是指在三维空间中至少有一维处于纳米尺度范围(1-lOOrnn)或由它们作为基本单元构成的，具有特殊物理、化学性能与功能的纳米材料。纳米材料平均粒径微小、表面原子多、比表面积大、表面能高，其性质显示出独特的小尺寸效应、量子尺寸效应、表面效应和宏观量子隧道效应等特性。通过控制纳米材料的尺度形貌、内部表面组成和结构的差异、结晶方式、缺陷和掺杂等使材料有随机生长到可控生长，无序到有序，实现材料性能调控，制备出具有特殊性质和相应功能的纳米材料。大批量材料可控制备是实现材料应用的一个关键环节。纳米功能材料的制备方法很多.主要分为物理法和化学法。物理法主要包括粉碎法和构筑法，化学法主要包括气相反应法和液相反应法。该类材料由于具有独特的电子转移性能.已在纳米电子器件和分子电子器件上得到重要应用;其高效的光电转化和催化性能也在新能源领域得到应用(如太阳能、燃料电池等);磁性和光学功能纳米材料在超灵敏生物分子标定、检测、敏感器件以及核磁共振成像中得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: It refers to nanomaterials with special physical and chemical properties and functions that have at least one dimension in the nanoscale range (1-lOOrnn) or are composed of them as basic units in three-dimensional space. Nanomaterials have small average particle size, many surface atoms, large specific surface and high surface energy. Their properties show unique small size effect, quantum size effect, surface effect and macroscopic quantum tunneling effet. By controlling the size morphology, internal surface composition and structure difference, crystallization mode, defects and doping of nanomaterials, materials can grow randomly to controllable growth, disorder to order, realize the control of materials' performance, and prepare nanomaterials with special properties and corresponding functions. The controllable preparation of large quantities of materials is a key link to realize the application of materials. There are many methods to prepare functional nanomaterials, mainly including physical method and chemical method. Physical method mainly includes crushing method and construction method, while chemical method mainly includes gas phase reaction method and liquid-phase reaction. This kind of materials has been widely used in nano electronic devices and molecular electronic devices due to its unique electron transfer performance; Its efficient photoelectric conversion and catalytic performance have also been applied in the field of new energy (such as solar energy, fuel cell, etc.); Magnetic and optical functional nanomaterials have been widely used in the calibration, detection, sensitive devices and nuclear magnetic resonance imaging of ultra sensitive biomolecules.

explanation_cn: 是指研究尺度在原子以上、lOOnm以下的纳米科学与技术中各种化学问题的科学，是研究纳米体系的化学制备、化学性质及应用的科学，主要涉及胶体与界面化学、材料化学、催化化学、环境科学等领域。纳米体系的化学制备包括水热/溶剂热合成法、沉淀法、水解法(无机盐水解法、喷雾水解法、溶胶凝胶法)、高温有机液相法、氧化还原法、乳状液和微乳法、模板法、光学合成法等方法制备的纳米粒子，用化学反应原理人为地"自下而上"制备/组装零维(量子点、纳米晶)、一维(纳米线、纳米带、纳米管)、二维(纳米片、超薄类石墨烯材料)、三维(纳米薄膜、纳米阵列、微孔或介孔材料、凝胶和气凝胶、超晶格、超晶体等)，以及在一定化学工艺条件下制备纳米薄膜和各种固体纳米材料。利用纳米技术研究化学反应的机理也是纳米化学的内容。纳米化学的几个核心科学问题分别是大小、形状、表面、缺陷、自组装，以及在能源、信息以及生物医学等领域的应用。
explanation_en: It refers to the science that studies various chemical problems in nano science and technology with a scale above atom and below lOOnm. It is the science that studies chemical preparation, chemical properties and applications of nano systems, mainly involving colloid and interface chemistry, materials chemistry, catalytic chemistry, environmental science and other fields. Chemical preparation of nano system includes hydrothermal/solvothermal synthesis, precipitation, hydrolysis (inorganic saltwater hydrolysis, spray hydrolysis, sol gel method), high-temperature organic liquid phase method, redox method, emulsion and microemulsion method, template method method, optical synthesis and other methods to prepare/assemble nano particles artificially "bottom-up" with the principle of chemical reaction, zero dimension (quantum dots, nanocrystal), one dimension (nanowires, nanobelt, nanotube) 2D (nano sheet, ultra-thin graphene like materials), 3D (nanofilm, nano array, microporous or mesoporous materials, gel and aerogel, superlattice, super crystal, etc.), as well as preparation of nanofilm and various solid nanomaterials under certain chemical process conditions. Using nanotechnology to study the mechanism of chemical reaction is also the content of nanochemistry. Several core scientific issues of nanochemistry are size, shape, surface, defect, self-assembly, and applications in energy, information, biomedicine and other fields.

explanation_cn: 又称为基于纳米材料的绿色印刷技术，指的是利用纳米材料的特性在印刷关键环节或过程中实现图案化或图像传输的技术。纳米印刷技术主要包括以下三个方面：使用纳米涂层版材：这些版材通过在表面应用具有特殊纳米结构或纳米粒子涂层来实现表面保水性和粗糙度控制。这一方法彻底摒弃了传统印刷版材采用电解氧化等高耗能、高污染工艺来实现砂砾化和控制保水性的方式。使用纳米油墨：这些油墨中含有纳米粒子，使得印刷品的质量更为出色。同时，溶剂排放大大减少，使印刷过程更为环保。使用纳米制版技术：这种技术将纳米转印材料精确地打印到纳米版材上，形成了墨文区和空白区之间亲油性和亲水性的差异。这使得可以直接进行印刷，避免了复杂的曝光、冲洗工序和环境污染。近年来，纳米材料与印刷技术的结合扩展了传统印刷技术的内涵和外延，并在印刷电子、3D打印等新兴领域取得了显著进展。例如，金属纳米粒子在印制电路中的应用解决了传统蚀刻工艺严重污染的问题，同时降低了成本，提高了生产效率。此外，纳米材料的使用使得3D打印产品具有更好的性能和更精确的结构。总之，纳米印刷技术通过融合纳米科技、材料科学、信息科学以及物理、化学等多个学科领域，使传统的印刷技术呈现出向“绿色化、功能化、立体化、器件化”发展的广阔前景。
explanation_en: Also known as green printing technology based on nanomaterials, it refers to the technology that uses the characteristics of nanomaterials to achieve patterning or image transmission in key printing links or processes. Nano printing technology mainly includes the following three aspects: using nano coated plates: these plates achieve surface water retention and roughness control by applying special nano structure or nano particle coating on the surface. This method completely abandons the traditional printing plate materials that use high energy consumption and high pollution processes such as electrolytic oxidation to achieve sanding and control water retention. Use nano ink: These inks contain nano particles, making the quality of printed matter more excellent. At the same time, solvent emissions are greatly reduced, making the printing process more environmentally friendly. Use of nano plate making technology: This technology accurately prints nano transfer materials onto nano plates, forming the difference in lipophilicity and hydrophilicity between ink area and blank area. This allows for direct printing, avoiding complex exposure, processing, and environmental pollution. In recent years, the combination of nanomaterials and printing technology has expanded the connotation and extension of traditional printing technology, and made significant progress in emerging fields such as printing electronics and 3D printing. For example, the application of metal nanoparticles in printed circuits has solved the problem of severe pollution in traditional etching processes, while reducing costs and improving production efficiency. In addition, the use of nanomaterials makes 3D printing products have better performance and more accurate structure. In a word, nano printing technology, by integrating nanotechnology, material science, information science, physics, chemistry and other disciplines, makes the traditional printing technology present a broad prospect of "green, functional, three-dimensional, and device oriented" development.

explanation_cn: 是一项新兴的电子制造科学与技术，广泛指的是基于具有导电、介电或半导体电学性能的纳米材料制备的各种纳米油墨。该技术采用包括丝网印刷、数字喷墨印刷、柔版印刷、凹版印刷以及胶版印刷等印刷技术，通过逐层印刷的方式将纳米油墨图案化地转移到各种印刷基材表面，从而实现电子元器件与系统的印刷制造科学与技术。传统电子制造业基于传统的减法制造工艺技术，存在环境污染、工艺复杂和高昂投资等问题，如硅材料的半导体制造和基于覆铜板材料的传统印制电路板制造工艺等造成了严重污染，制程复杂。因此，基于印刷原理与技术制造各种电子元器件的研发应运而生。例如，在柔性薄膜表面印刷导电纳米油墨可制造导电线路，印刷半导体纳米油墨可制造晶体管或存储器元件等。纳米印刷电子制造的典型元器件包括连接线路、电阻器、存储器、射频电子标签、触控传感器、薄膜开关、晶体管、LED照明和显示器件等，其中包括了电子连接线路和元件的组合。这种技术有望取代传统印制电路板制造中的元器件再安装工艺。纳米印刷电子制造具有环保、高效、低成本、大面积和柔性等特点，可用于制造柔性、可弯曲、可折叠和可穿戴的电子产品，体现了电子产品向“轻、柔、薄、透”方向发展的趋势。
explanation_en: It is a new electronic manufacturing science and technology, widely referring to various nano ink prepared based on nanomaterials with conductive, dielectric or semiconductor electrical properties. This technology adopts printing technologies including screen printing, digital inkjet printing, flexographic printing, intaglio printing and offset printing, and transfers nano ink graphically to the surface of various printing substrates through layer by layer printing, so as to realize the printing manufacturing science and technology of electronic components and systems. The traditional electronic manufacturing industry is based on the traditional subtractive manufacturing process technology, which has problems such as environmental pollution, complex process and high investment. For example, the semiconductor manufacturing of silicon materials and the traditional printed circuit board manufacturing process based on copper clad plate materials have caused serious pollution and complicated process. Therefore, the research and development of manufacturing various electronic components based on printing principles and technologies has emerged. For example, printing conductive nano ink on the surface of flexible film can produce conductive lines, and printing semiconductor nano ink can produce transistors or memory elements. The typical components manufactured by nano printed electronics include connecting lines, resistors, memories, radio frequency electronic tags, touch sensors, film switches, transistors, LED lighting and display devices, including the combination of electronic connecting lines and components. This technology is expected to replace the reinstallation process of components in traditional printed circuit board manufacturing. Nano printed electronics manufacturing has the characteristics of environmental protection, high efficiency, low cost, large area and flexibility. It can be used to manufacture flexible, bendable, foldable and wearable electronic products, reflecting the trend of electronic products towards "light, soft, thin and transparent".

explanation_cn: 又称纳米压印微影技术，是一种纳米级图案的制作方法。其基本原理是通过模板将图案转移到相应的基底上，而转移的媒介通常是一层非常薄的聚合物薄膜。这一薄膜会在经过热压或紫外曝光等方法后硬化，从而实现图形的转移。根据压印方法的不同，这一技术可分为三种主要类型：热塑（hotembossing）、紫外固化（UV）、和微接触（microcontactprint）。这项技术具有高分辨率、低成本和高产率等特点，因此在半导体制造、微机电系统（MEMS）、生物芯片、生物医学等领域得到了广泛的应用。
explanation_en: Also known as nanoimprinting microlithography technology, it is a method of making nano scale patterns. The basic principle is to transfer the pattern to the corresponding substrate through the template, and the transfer medium is usually a very thin polymer film. This film will harden after hot pressing or ultraviolet exposure, so as to realize the transfer of patterns. According to different embossing methods, this technology can be divided into three main types: thermoplasticization, ultraviolet curing, and micro contact print. This technology has the characteristics of high resolution, low cost and high yield, so it has been widely used in semiconductor manufacturing, MEMS, biochip, biomedicine and other fields.

explanation_cn: 当对晶体结构具有非中心对称性的纳米材料（如六方晶体结构的氧化锌、氮化镓和氮化铟）施加应力时，在晶体中会产生一个压电电势。由于同时具有半导体特性和压电特性，所产生的压电电势会对载流子的输运性质产生影响。以纳米线为例，当纳米线被拉伸或压缩，这种独特的非中心对称性结构导致了弯曲纳米线的内外表面产生反极性的极化电荷。压电电势将会沿着纳米线的轴向分布，进而改变与其电极接触区域的电场或者肖特基势垒的高度。因此，电子传输特性将会被改变。纳米压电材料基压电器件具有尺寸微小（纳米量级）、功耗小、灵敏度高等宏观器件所不完全具备的独特优势。
explanation_en: When stress is applied to nanomaterials with non central symmetry in crystal structure (such as zinc oxide, gallium nitride and indium nitride with hexagonal crystal structure), a piezoelectric potential will be generated in the crystal. Due to both semiconductor and piezoelectric properties, the generated piezoelectric potential can have an impact on the transport properties of charge carriers. Taking nanowires as an example, when the nanowires are stretched or compressed, this unique non central symmetry structure causes the inner and outer surfaces of bent nanowires to generate reverse polar polarization charges. Piezoelectric potential will be distributed along the axial direction of the nanowire, thus changing the electric field in the contact area with its electrode or the height of the Schottky barrier. Therefore, the electronic transmission characteristics will be changed. The nano piezoelectric materials based piezoelectric devices have unique advantages that are not completely possessed by macro devices, such as small size (nanometer scale), low power consumption, high sensitivity, etc.

explanation_cn: 纳米发电机是一种装置，利用特殊纳米材料的压电效应，能够将受到外界的拉伸和压缩作用转换为电能。其中，最常见的纳米发电机基于规则氧化锌纳米线构建。这类纳米发电机的工作原理如下：使用竖直生长的纤锌矿结构氧化锌纳米线。这些纳米线在外力的作用下会发生弯曲，导致内部和外部产生压缩和拉伸形变。由于压电效应的存在，弯曲的纳米线内外表面会产生不同的极化电荷分布。利用氧化锌纳米线的半导体特性以及与接触金属尖部之间的肖特基势垒，可以实现电能的储存和输运。在纳米尺度上，机械能会被转化为电能，从而实现电荷的分离和电流的生成。这种纳米发电机的应用领域包括自供电纳米器件、生物医学传感、纳米机器人以及能量收集等。通过将纳米材料的压电效应与半导体特性相结合，可以有效地将机械能转化为电能，从而实现微型和纳米尺度装置的电力供应。
explanation_en: Nanogenerator is a device that can convert the external tension and compression into electrical energy by using the piezoelectric effect of special nanomaterials. Among them, the most common nanogenerator is based on regular zinc oxide nanowires. The working principle of this kind of nanogenerator is as follows: use vertically grown wurtzite structure zinc oxide nanowires. These nanowires will bend under the action of external forces, resulting in compression and tensile deformation inside and outside. Due to the existence of piezoelectric effect, the inside and outside surfaces of bent nanowires will produce different polarization charge distribution. Using the semiconductor properties of ZnO nanowires and the Schottky barrier between ZnO nanowires and the tip of the contact metal, the storage and transport of electric energy can be realized. At the nanoscale, mechanical energy is converted into electrical energy, thereby achieving charge separation and current generation. The application fields of this nanogenerator include self powered nano devices, biomedical sensors, nano mbot and energy collection. By combining the piezoelectric effect of nanomaterials with the semiconductor characteristics, we can effectively convert mechanical energy into electrical energy, thus realizing the power supply of micro and nano scale devices.

explanation_cn: 吸波材料是指材料能够吸收电磁波能量，将其转化为热能或其他形式的能量，并且具有特定的组分特征尺寸在0.1到100纳米之间。这种材料通常由颗粒组元和界面组元组成。在微波辐射下，原子和电子在纳米材料中发生加速振动，从而增加了电磁波的吸收性能，将电磁能量转化为热能。吸波材料通常包括基体材料（或黏结剂）和吸收介质（吸收剂），并可以根据吸波机理分为电损耗型和磁损耗型。这些材料具有宽频率范围、兼容性好、轻质、薄厚度等特点，因此在各种领域都有广泛的应用，如隐身飞机、军舰、太空膜、织物等。
explanation_en: Absorbing material refers to materials that can absorb electromagnetic wave energy, convert it into heat energy or other forms of energy, and have specific component characteristic sizes between 0.1 and 100 nanometers. This kind of materials usually consists of particle component and interface component. Under microwave radiation, atoms and electrons in nanomaterials undergo accelerated vibration, which increases the absorption of electromagnetic waves and converts electromagnetic energy into heat energy. Absorbing material usually include matrix materials (or adhesive) and absorbing media (absorbents), and can be divided into electrical loss type and magnetic loss type according to the wave absorbing mechanism. These materials have wide frequency range, good compatibility, light weight, thin thickness and other characteristics, so they are widely used in various fields, such as stealth aircraft, warships, space films, fabrics and so on.

explanation_cn: 吸附是当不同相之间接触时出现的界面结合现象。吸附通常分为两种类型：物理吸附：在物理吸附中，吸附剂与吸附相之间的结合是由较弱的物理力，如范德华力等所导致的。这种吸附的特点包括吸附速度快、吸附非选择性、吸附是可逆的、吸附热较小，可以形成多层吸附。化学吸附：化学吸附时，吸附剂与吸附相之间以化学键的形式发生强烈结合。这种吸附通常较难脱附。纳米颗粒由于具有较大的比表面积和表面原子的配位数较少，因此它们通常表现出较强的吸附性。吸附的强度取决于被吸附物质的性质、溶剂的性质以及溶液的性质。吸附作用可以发生在不同类型的界面上：气-液界面吸附：在气体与液体界面上发生的吸附作用，也称为液体表面吸附。固-气界面吸附：指气体在固体表面上吸附的作用，也称为气体在固体表面的吸附。固-液界面吸附：发生在固体表面与液体中的吸附作用，也称为液相吸附或溶液吸附。液-液界面吸附：在液体-液体界面上发生的吸附作用。吸附是一种重要的表面现象，对许多领域，如催化、分离、环境科学和材料科学具有重要意义。
explanation_en: Adsorption is an interface binding phenomenon that occurs when different phase contact. Adsorption is generally divided into two types: physical adsorption: in physical adsorption, the combination between adsorbent and adsorption phase is caused by weak physical force, such as van der Waals force. The characteristics of this kind of adsorption include fast adsorption speed, non selective adsorption, reversible adsorption, low heat of adsorption, and the formation of multi-layer adsorption. Chemical adsorption: during chemical adsorption, the adsorbent and the adsorbed phase are strongly combined in the form of chemical bonds. This type of adsorption is usually difficult to desorb. Nanoparticle usually exhibit strong adsorption due to their large specific surface and less coordination number number of surface atoms. The strength of adsorption depends on the properties of the adsorbed substance, solvent, and solution. Adsorption can occur at different types of interfaces: gas-liquid interface adsorption: adsorption that occurs at the gas-liquid interface, also known as liquid surface adsorption. Solid gas interface adsorption: refers to the adsorption of gas on a solid surface, also known as the adsorption of gas on a solid surface. Solid liquid interface adsorption: The adsorption process that occurs between a solid surface and a liquid, also known as liquid phase adsorption or solution adsorption. Liquid liquid interface adsorption: The adsorption process that occurs at the liquid liquid interface. Adsorption is an important surface phenomenon that has significant implications for many fields, such as catalysis, separation, environmental science, and materials science.

explanation_cn: 是指棒状结构的两端具有类似球形颗粒的纳米材料，类似于体育用品的哑铃结构。该结构包括球、棒、球三部分。在纳米研究中，也将生长在一起具有点接触的两个球形颗粒的纳米材料，称作纳米哑铃结构。制备方法通常有过择优腐蚀和选择性生长法。
explanation_en: It refers to the nanomaterials with spherical particles at both ends of the rod structure, similar to the dumbbell structure of sporting goods. This structure includes three parts: ball, rod, and ball. In nano research, the nanomaterials growing together with two spherical particles in point contact is also called dumbbell nanostructures. The preparation methods usually include preferential etching and selective growth.

explanation_cn: 是由颗粒或晶粒尺寸为1-100nm的粒子凝聚而成的三维块体，其结构可以是晶体、非晶或准晶，其晶粒尺寸、晶界宽度、析出相分布、气孔尺寸和缺陷尺寸都在纳米量级。其主要特征是具有巨大的颗粒间界面、界面部分占总体积的百分比很大、缺陷多。由于纳米粒子尺寸小，界面所占体积分数几乎可以与纳米微粒所占体积分数相比拟。因此纳米固体材料的界面不能简单地看成是一种缺陷-它已成为纳米固体材料基本构成之一，其微观结构是影响纳米材料性能的最重要因素，纳米固体材料的结构与常规材料相比发生了很大的变化，颗粒组元细小到纳米数a级。界面组元大幅度增加，使得材料的强度、轫性等力学性能大幅度提高，同时对材料的热学、光学、电学、磁学等性能产生重大影响，目前相对成熟的纳米金属材料的制备方法包括惰性气体蒸发原位加压法、高能球磨法以及非晶晶化法。纳米陶瓷材料常用无压。烧结、热压烧结和微波烧结等方法制备。
explanation_en: It is a three-dimensional block agglomerated by particles or particles with a grain size of 1-100nm. Its structure can be crystal, amorphous or quasicrystal. Its grain size, grain boundary width, precipitation phase distribution, pore size and defect size are all in the nanometer scale. Its main characteristics are having a huge interparticle interface, a large percentage of the total volume of the interface, and numerous defects. Due to the small size of nanoparticles, the volume fraction of the interface can almost be compared to the volume fraction of nanoparticles. Therefore, the interface of nano-solid materials cannot be simply regarded as a defect - it has become one of the basic components of nano-solid materials, and its microstructure is the most important factor affecting the performance of nanomaterials. Compared with conventional materials, the structure of nano-solid materials has changed greatly, and the particle composition is small to a nanometer number. The increase of interface components has greatly improved the strength, brevity and other mechanical properties of materials, and has a significant impact on the thermal, optical, electrical, magnetic and other properties of materials. At present, the relatively mature preparation methods of nano metallic materials include inert gas evaporation in-situ pressure method, high-energy ball milling method and amorphous crystallization method. Nano ceramics materials are commonly used without pressure. Sintering, hot pressing sintering and microwave sintering.

explanation_cn: 纳米图案印刷术是软刻印技术的发展，它是一种自上而下的纳米制备技术。该技术使用带有纳米图案的刚性压模，将聚合物薄膜压印成纳米级别的花纹。然后，对压印的材料进行常规的刻蚀、剥离等加工步骤，最终制成纳米结构和器件。纳米图案印刷术适用于大规模、重复性的纳米图案制备。这项技术具有操作简便、高分辨率、出色的重复性、高效率以及较低的成本等优点。
explanation_en: Nano patterning typography is the development of soft printing technology, which is a top-down nano preparation technology. This technology uses a rigid die with a nano pattern to stamp the polymer film into a nano level pattern. Then, the imprinted materials is processed by conventional etching, stripping and other processing steps, and finally made into nanostructures and devices. Nano patterning typography is suitable for large-scale, repetitive preparation of nano patterns. This technology has the advantages of simple operation, high resolution, excellent repeatability, high efficiency and low cost.
