explanation_cn: 是指可以用来构成块体、薄膜、多层膜等高级纳米结构的基本单元，其形态并不限于球形，还有片状、棒状、针状、星状、线状等，包括原子团簇、纳米微粒、量子点、纳米管、纳米棒、纳米线等。原子团簇是指几个至几百个原子的聚集体-通常粒径小于或等于lnm，不同于具有特定大小和形状的分子:纳米微粒是指颗粒R寸为纳米量级的超细微粒，它的尺度大于原子簇(cluster)，小于通常的微粉；量子点又称为入造原子，是由一定数量的实际原子组成的聚集体。它们的尺寸小于100nm;纳米棒是指纵横比(长度与直径的比)小的准一维实心的纳米材料；而相对应地。纵横比大的则称为纳米线。DNA纳米技术DNAnanotechnology利用脱氧核搪核酸或其他核酸的分子来构建可操控的新型纳米结构或纳米机构。[)NA纳米技术是通过合理设计、自下而上的核酸分子f彳组装过程-单链DNA按照碱基配对原则形成特定的目标结构。一条长链通过预设计的碱基序列折叠成11标结构，又称DNA折纸；任意的纳米结构、不规则的形状通常可用DNA折纸法制成。DNA分子还-用作模板-吸收其他分子如蛋白质、金属纳米离子、量子点、富勒烯等进行自组装。UNA纳米技术提供了设计构建复杂结构并精确，控制纳米特性的一种方法，在分子电子学以及纳米器l件等领域方而具有潜在的应用价值。
explanation_en: It refers to the basic units that can be used to form advanced nanostructures such as blocks, films, multilayers, etc. Its shape is not limited to spherical, but also sheet, rod, needle, star, wire, etc., including atomic clusters, nanoparticles, quantum dots, nanotube, nanorods, nanowires, etc. Atomic clusters refer to aggregates of several to hundreds of atoms - usually with a particle size less than or equal to lnm, unlike molecules with specific sizes and shapes: nanoparticles refer to ultrafine particles with a particle size of nanometers, which are larger in size than atomic clusters and smaller in size than ordinary micropowders; Quantum dots, also known as building atoms, are aggregates of a certain number of actual atoms. Their size is less than 100nm; Nanorods are quasi one dimensional solid nanomaterials with small aspect ratio (ratio of length to diameter); Correspondingly. Those with a large aspect ratio are called nanowires. DNA nanotechnology uses deoxidation nucleic acid or other nucleic acid molecules to build controllable new nanostructures or nanostructures. [) NA nanotechnology is a process of bottom-up assembly of nucleic acid molecules through reasonable design - single strand DNA forms a specific target structure according to the principle of base pairing. A long strand is folded into an 11 label structure through the pre designed base sequence, also known as DNA origami; arbitrary nanostructures and irregular shapes can usually be made by DNA origami. DNA molecules are also used as templates to absorb other molecules such as proteins, metal nano ions, quantum dots Fullerene, etc. for self-assembly. UNA nanotechnology provides a method to design and construct complex structures and accurately control nano characteristics, which has potential application value in molecular electronics, nano devices and other fields.

explanation_cn: 是以纳米粒子为载体将基因导入细胞的工具。基因载体可以把目的基因送入靶细胞内，然后将目的基因释放出来从而发挥目的基因的特定功能。它的作用是运载目的基因进人宿主细胞，使之能得到复制和进行表达。如何找到一个高效、靶向、在体内长循环的基因载体一直是各国科学家努力探索的重点和热点。而纳米颗粒具有表面效应、小尺寸效应等特性，同时具有很大的比表面积，易与其他原子相结合而稳定。由于纳米颗粒的这些特点，将纳米颗粒作为基因载体用于恶性肿瘤的基因治疗正在全面开展。
explanation_en: It is a tool for introducing genes into cells using nanoparticles as carriers. The gene vector can deliver the target gene into the target cell, and then release the target gene to play the specific function of the target gene. Its function is to transport the target gene into human host cells, enabling it to be replicated and expressed. How to find an efficient, targeted and long circulating gene vector in the body has always been the focus and hotspot of scientists all over the world. Nanoparticle have surface effect, small size effect and other characteristics, and also have a large specific surface, which is easy to combine with other atoms and stable. Because of these characteristics of nanoparticle, nanoparticle are being used as gene vector in gene therapy of malignant tumors.

explanation_cn: 指由均匀分散在聚合物基体树脂中的无机纳米粒子构成的复合材料，通常具有纳米级尺寸范围（1到100纳米）。这些无机纳米粒子包括硅酸盐、碳酸钙、二氧化硅、二氧化钛、碳化硅、氧化铝、云母等。纳米塑料的种类取决于所使用的基体树脂，可以分为纳米尼龙、纳米聚烯烃、纳米聚酯、纳米聚甲醛等。与传统基体树脂相比，纳米塑料提高了材料的力学性能、热性能和尺寸稳定性。通常，无机纳米粒子的加入量约为2%到5%，仅为传统无机填料改性时所需添加量的约1/10左右。因此，纳米塑料的密度几乎不发生变化，或者仅略微增加。此外，由于纳米粒子的小尺寸，成型加工和回收时几乎不会出现断裂和损坏，因此具有出色的可回收性。不过，需要注意的是，加入无机纳米粒子会使塑料的焊接强度和韧性略有降低。生产纳米塑料的方法主要包括插层复合法、原位复合法、分子复合法和超微粒子直接分散法。目前，市场上产量最大的纳米塑料是纳米尼龙，其次是纳米聚烯烃。纳米聚酯、纳米紫外固化聚丙烯酸酯树脂、纳米聚酰亚胺、纳米聚中醛等也是常见的类型。纳米塑料在包装、汽车制造和机电工业等领域得到广泛应用。由于其出色的阻隔性能，纳米塑料可用于食品保鲜包装，延长食品保质期。其耐热性和优越的力学性能使其适用于多种汽车零部件制造。由于其刚性特点，纳米塑料还可以用于制造薄壁复杂结构产品，以降低重量和成本。此外，由于纳米塑料具有阻燃性，它们也成为替代含卤素阻燃剂的理想选择。
explanation_en: It refers to a composite materials composed of inorganic nanoparticles uniformly dispersed in the polymer matrix resin, which usually has a nanometer size range (1 to 100 nm). These inorganic nanoparticles include silicate, calcium carbonate, silicon dioxide, titanium dioxide, silicon carbide, aluminum oxide, mica, etc. The type of nano plastic depends on the matrix resin used, which can be divided into nano nylon, nano polyolefin, nano polyester, nano polyformaldehyde, etc. Compared with traditional matrix resin, nano plastic improves the mechanical properties, thermal properties and dimensional stability of materials. Usually, the amount of inorganic nanoparticles added is about 2% to 5%, which is only about 1/10 of the amount required for traditional inorganic filler modification. As a result, the density of nano plastic has hardly changed, or only slightly increased. In addition, due to the small size of nanoparticles, there is almost no fracture and damage during molding and recycling, so it has excellent recyclability. However, it should be noted that the addition of inorganic nanoparticles will slightly reduce the weld strength and toughness of plastics. The production methods of nano plastic mainly include intercalation hybird method, in-situ composite method, molecular composite method and uhrafine particle direct dispersion method. At present, the largest output of nano plastic on the market is nano nylon, followed by nano polyolefin. Nano polyester, nano UV curing polyacrylate resin, nano polyimide, nano polyaldehyde, etc. are also common types. Nano plastic are widely used in packaging, automobile manufacturing, electromechanical industry and other fields. Due to its excellent barrier performance, nano plastic can be used for food preservation packaging to extend the shelf life of food. Its heat resistance and superior mechanical properties make it suitable for the manufacturing of various automotive components. Due to its rigidity, nano plastic can also be used to manufacture thin-walled products with complex structures to reduce weight and cost. In addition, due to the flame retardancy of nano plastic, they are also an ideal alternative to halogen containing flame retardant or fire retardant.

explanation_cn: 由两相或以上在纳米尺度上形成的复合物所构筑的，在宏观三维尺度上呈现出贯通开孔的网络结构，称为纳米复合支架。
explanation_en: The nanocomposite scaffold is a network structure formed by two or more composition formed on a nanometer scale, which shows a through opening on a macroscopic three-dimensional scale.

explanation_cn: 纳米复合材料是由两种或两种以上的纳米级（1到100纳米）物质组合而成的材料。这些物质可以包括非晶体、半晶体、晶体或它们的组合，也可以是无机物、有机物，或者它们的混合物。纳米复合材料也可以指分散相的尺寸小于100纳米的复合材料。根据制备方法的不同，纳米复合材料可以分为以下几类：填充型纳米复合材料：这是指将无机纳米颗粒以粉体的形式分散在聚合物基体中形成的复合材料。插层型纳米复合材料：这种类型的复合材料使用层状黏土矿物等物质，将其分散在聚合物基体中，形成层状的结构。杂化型纳米复合材料：在这种类型的复合材料中，无机纳米颗粒和聚合物基体可以原位形成，或者纳米颗粒与聚合物同时在基体中原位生成。与传统的复合材料相比，纳米复合材料具有许多新的特性，包括同步增强效应、新的功能、高强度、高模量、出色的阻隔性能等。这使得纳米复合材料在电子学、光学、机械学、生物学等领域具有广泛的应用前景。
explanation_en: Nanocomposites are materials composed of two or more nano materials (1-100 nm). These substances can include non crystal, semi crystal, crystal or their combination, and can also be inorganic, organic or their mixture. Nanocomposites can also refer to composite materials with dispersed phase size less than 100 nm. According to different preparation methods, nanocomposites can be divided into the following categories: filled nanocomposites: composite materials formed by dispersing inorganic nanoparticle in the form of powder in the polymer matrix. Intercalated nanocomposites: this type of composite materials uses layered clay mineral and other substances to disperse them in the polymer matrix to form a layered structure. Hybrid nanocomposites: in this type of composite materials, inorganic nanoparticle and polymer matrix can be formed in situ, or nanoparticle and polymer can be formed in situ in matrix at the same time. Compared with traditional composite materials, nanocomposites have many new characteristics, including synchronous reinforcement effect, new functions, high strength, high modulus, excellent barrier performance, etc. This makes nanocomposites have broad application prospects in electronics, optics, mechanics, biology and other fields.

explanation_cn: 研究一维或多维尺寸在纳米级别的复合材料催化剂。由于纳米颗粒具有独特的性能，因此它们的催化活性和选择性远远超过传统催化剂。纳米催化剂的主要类型包括纳米线、纳米棒、核壳结构以及大面积的二维载体负载型等。这些纳米催化剂在催化反应中能够提供更高的效率和更好的催化性能，因此在催化领域具有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: Composite materials catalysts with one-dimensional or multi-dimensional dimensions at the nanometer level were studied. Due to the unique performance of nanoparticle, their catalytic activity and selectivity far exceed those of traditional catalysts. The main types of nanocatalysts include nanowires, nanorods, core-shell structures, and large-area two-dimensional support supported types. These nanocatalysts can provide higher efficiency and better catalytic performance in catalytic reactions, thus having wide applications in the field of catalysis.

explanation_cn: 指火工药剂的分散或结合尺度至少有一维处于纳米级(1-100nm)，其功能优于传统工艺条件下得到的火药，主要表现在安全钝感、能量转化率和释放率高、反应热值大或者温度高。按照纳米尺度可以分为零维纳米材料，如纳米晶粒、原子团簇、纳米微球等，一维单元包括纳米线、纳米管、纳米棒、纳米纤维等。二维单元包括超薄膜、多层膜、超晶格等。根据功能不同可划分为纳米炸药、纳米点火药、纳米延期药、纳米烟火药等。根据化学成分可分为纳米单质含能物和纳米复合含能物，纳米复合火工药剂的制备方法很多。主要是借鉴纳米材料制备技术的"软化学"手段，包括溶胶-凝胶、微乳液、微胶囊、分子组装、壳核修饰、模板法等等。代表产物有纳米铝热剂、纳米炸药晶粒、纳米点火药、纳米延期药等。
explanation_en: It means that the dispersion or combination scale of initiating explosives and relative compositions has at least one dimension at the nanometer level (1-100nm), and its function is better than that of propellant obtained under traditional process conditions, mainly manifested in safety insensitivity, high energy conversion rate and release rate, large reaction heat value or high temperature. According to the nanometer scale, it can be divided into zero dimensional nano materials, such as nanocrystals, atomic clusters, nano microsphere, etc., and one-dimensional units include nanowires, nanotube, nanorods, nanofibre, etc. Two dimensional elements include ultra-thin films, multilayers, superlattice, etc. According to different functions, it can be divided into nano explosive, nano ignition powder, nano delay composition, nano pyrotechnic powder, etc. According to the chemical composition, it can be divided into nano elemental energetic substance and nano composition energetic substance. There are many methods to prepare nano-composite energetic materials. It mainly refers to the "soft chemistry" means of nanomaterials preparation technology, including sol gel, micro lotion, microcapsule, molecular assembly, shell core modification, template method method, etc. Representative products include nano thermite, nano explosive grain, nano ignition powder, nano delay composition, etc.

explanation_cn: 纳米晶复合永磁材料具有一些显著的特性，如剩磁增强效应和较高的理论磁能积，使其成为具有潜在应用前景的磁性材料。这些特性主要是由该材料的微观结构和磁性相互作用所决定的。具体来说，纳米晶复合永磁材料通常包含软磁相（如CrFe等软磁材料）和硬磁相（如RE2Fe14B等硬磁材料）。这两种不同磁性相之间的交换耦合作用是关键因素，它使得剩磁大大增强，从而提高了这些材料的磁能积。这意味着这些材料能够在较小的体积内存储更多的磁能量。此外，通过精心设计和处理这些材料，可以进一步增强软磁相和硬磁相之间的交换耦合作用，从而提高其剩磁和内禀矫顽力。这通常涉及对材料进行磁场处理，这一过程可以调整材料的磁性性质，使其表现出更高的磁性性能。理论计算表明，由硬磁相（如Nd2Fe14B）和软磁相（如CrFe）组成的纳米晶复合材料的磁能积可以达到很高的值，甚至高达100 kJ/m3。这种高磁能积使得这些材料在永磁应用领域具有很大的潜力，如电机、发电机、磁盘驱动器等。总之，纳米晶复合永磁材料的特性主要得益于软、硬磁相之间的交换耦合作用，这使得它们成为高性能永磁材料的有前景的候选。通过合适的制备和处理方法，这些材料的性能可以进一步改进，满足各种应用的需求。
explanation_en: Nanocrystal composite permanent-magnetic material has some remarkable characteristics, such as remanence enhancement effect and high theoretical magnetic energy product, which makes it become a magnetic materials with potential application prospects. These properties are mainly determined by the microstructure and magnetic interaction of the materials. Specifically, nanocrystal composite permanent-magnetic material usually include soft magnetic phase (such as CrFe and other soft magnetic materials) and hard magnetic phase (such as RE2Fe14B and other hard magnetic materials). The exchange coupling between these two different magnetic phases is the key factor, which makes the remanence greatly enhanced, thus improving the magnetic energy product of these materials. This means that these materials can store more magnetic energy in a smaller volume. In addition, through careful design and treatment of these materials, the exchange coupling between the soft magnetic phase and the hard magnetic phase can be further enhanced, thus improving their remanence and intrinsic coercive force. This usually involves magnetic treatment of materials, which can adjust the magnetic properties of materials to show higher magnetic properties. Theoretical calculation shows that the magnetic energy product of nanocrystal composite materials composed of hard magnetic phase (such as Nd2Fe14B) and soft magnetic phase (such as CrFe) can reach a very high value, even up to 100 kJ/m3. This high magnetic energy product makes these materials have great potential in permanent magnet applications, such as motors, generators, disk drives, etc. In a word, the characteristics of nanocrystal composite permanent-magnetic material mainly benefit from the exchange coupling between soft and hard magnetic phases, which makes them a promising candidate for high-performance permanent magnet material. The properties of these materials can be further improved by appropriate preparation and treatment methods to meet the needs of various applications.

explanation_cn: 纳米多孔膜是一种多孔薄膜，其孔径小于100纳米。根据IUPAC的分类，纳米多孔膜可以分为三类：微孔膜（0.2-2纳米）、介孔膜（2-50纳米）和大孔膜（大于50纳米）。这些多孔膜的孔道可以具有不同的形状，包括圆柱形、圆锥形、狭缝形或不规则形状。这些孔道可以整齐排列或随机网状排列。根据材料种类，纳米多孔膜可以分为有机纳米多孔膜、无机纳米多孔膜和复合材料纳米多孔膜。无机纳米多孔膜包括氧化铝、氧化锆、氧化钛、氧化硅等材料。有机纳米多孔膜则包括用于过滤和液相分离技术的聚合物超滤、微滤膜和纳滤膜，如Nafion、聚碳酸酯、聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯、聚砜、聚酰胺-聚砜超薄复合膜等。复合材料多孔膜由两种或更多不同的材料组成，以提高选择性和稳定性。纳米多孔膜的制备技术包括界面聚合法、溶胶凝胶法、阳极氧化法、核径迹辐照刻蚀法、电化学物质过滤制备、微细加工制备技术、静电纺丝法、电化学刻蚀、半导体光刻技术等。这些多孔膜在超纯水制备、物质的分离和提纯、生物传感器、分子分析、燃料电池质子交换膜、敏化太阳能电池等领域都有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: Nanoporous membrane is a kind of porous membrane with a pore diameter of less than 100 nm. According to the classification of IUPAC, nanoporous membrane can be divided into three categories: microporous membrane (0.2-2 nm), mesoporous membrane (2-50 nm) and macroporous membrane (more than 50 nm). The pores of these porous membranes can have different shapes, including cylindrical, conical, slit or irregular shapes. These pores can be arranged neatly or randomly in a network. According to the type of materials, nanoporous membrane can be divided into organic nanoporous membrane, inorganic nanoporous membrane and composite materials nanoporous membrane. Inorganic nanoporous membrane includes alumina, zirconia, titanium oxide, silicon oxide and other materials. Organic nanoporous membrane includes polymer ultrafiltration, microfiltration membrane and nanofiltration membrane used for filtration and liquid phase separation technology, such as Nafion, polycarbonate, polyethylene terephthalate, polysulfone, polyamide polysulfone ultra-thin composite membrane, etc. The composite materials porous membrane is composed of two or more different materials to improve selectivity and stability. The preparation technology of nanoporous membrane includes interfacial polymerization, sol-gel method, anodic oxidation, nuclear track irradiation etching, electrochemical material filtration preparation, micro processing preparation technology, electrostatic spinning, electrochemical etching, semiconductor lithography technology, etc. These porous membranes are widely used in ultra pure water preparation, material separation and purification, biosensor, molecular analysis, fuel cell proton exchange membrane, sensitized solar cell and other fields.

explanation_cn: 导热材料是指在三维空间中至少有一维处于纳米尺度范围（1到100纳米之间），或者由这些纳米结构作为基元构成的材料，具有较好的导热性能。导热材料包括纳米流体、纳米导热聚合物、纳米导热界面材料等，通过改变材料体系的热导率或者将纳米粉体填充到材料体系中来增加其导热性能。
explanation_en: Thermal conductive materials refer to materials that have at least one dimension in the nanoscale range (1 to 100 nm) in the three-dimensional space, or are composed of these nanostructures as primitives, and have good thermal conductivity. Thermal conductive materials include nanofluid, nano thermal conductive polymer, nano thermal conductive interface materials, etc. Their thermal conductivity can be increased by changing the thermal conductivity of materials system or filling nano powder into materials system.

explanation_cn: 特指电阻率小，尺寸在1-1OOnm，主要用于添加在有机或无机基体使其电阻率小于1*lO^10Ω.cm而具有导电或抗静电特性的一类金属、合金或复合结构的纳米材料。
explanation_en: Specifically, it refers to a kind of metal, alloy or composition nanomaterials with conductive or antistatic characteristics added to organic or inorganic matrix to make its resistivity less than 1 * lO ^ 10 Ω. cm, with a small resistivity and a size of 1-1OOnm.

explanation_cn: 填充物以纳米尺寸分散在聚合物基体中形成的纳米复合材料，具有一般工程塑料所不具备的优异性能，参见工程塑料。
explanation_en: The filler is dispersed in the polymer matrix in nanometer size to form a nanocomposites, which has excellent properties that are not available in general engineering plastics. See engineering plastics.

explanation_cn: 纳米带是一种介于一维和二维之间的纳米结构，指的是具有长方形截面、厚度在纳米量级、宽度可达几百纳米、宽厚比较大、非常薄的长方形纳米结构。其显著特点是具有特定完整的晶面，其任意垂直截面呈矩形。制备纳米带的方法主要包括真空-冷凝法、微乳合成法、模板合成法、分子自组装法等。纳米带与纳米管、纳米线等材料不同，具有独特的结构和光电性能，因此备受关注。它是研究功能性氧化物中输运现象以及单根纳米带元器件尺度效应的理想系统。纳米带具有较大的比表面积，其电学性质对表面吸附非常敏感，因此适合用作传感器。纳米带传感器具有响应速度快、灵敏度高、选择性好等特点。
explanation_en: Nanobelts are nanostructures that range between one and two dimensions, referring to rectangular nanostructures with rectangular cross-sections, thicknesses on the nanometer scale, widths up to several hundred nanometers, large width to thickness ratios, and very thin structures. Its remarkable feature is that it has a specific and complete crystal plane, and its arbitrary vertical section is rectangular. The main methods for preparing nanoribbons include vacuum condensation method, microemulsion synthesis method, template synthesis method, molecular self-assembly method, etc. Different from materials such as nanotube and nanowires, nanobelt have unique structure and photoelectric properties, so they have attracted much attention. It is an ideal system to study the transport phenomena in functional oxides and the scale effect of single nanobelt components. Nanobelt have large specific surface, and their electrical properties are very sensitive to surface adsorption, so they are suitable for use as sensors. The nanobelt sensor has the characteristics of fast response, high sensitivity and good selectivity.

explanation_cn: 外形类似于弹簧的纳米结构，由一维纳米线、纳米带或者纳米管等螺旋生长而形成弹簧一样的形状。纳米弹簧的功能主要是通过表面原子的重构来实现能量的存储与释放。在研究钨金属单晶纳米线的变形行为时，人们发现钨金属纳米线在拉伸时会发生大范围的等应力孪晶变形，并表现出与已知面心立方金属（如Cu、Ni）纳米线相似的超弹性行为。其加/卸载应力-应变曲线在很大的应变范围内几乎是重合的，也就是说在相当大的应变区间（>30%）内，系统的能量在加载和卸载循环过程中几乎没有损耗。这种低损耗源自钨金属孪晶界具有的极低移动阻力。基于上述发现，人们设计出了以表面能为媒介，高效存储和释放机械能的新装置，即纳米弹簧。纳米弹簧有望在高效率能量存储与释放方面实现新的突破，对微/纳电子元器件与微纳机电系统的设计具有重要指导意义。而碳纳米管弹簧有望应用于可伸缩异体/电极、微型应变传感器、超级电容器、光伏、场发射、能量耗散纤维等领域，并可发展成具有多功能的碳纳米管纤维增强复合材料。
explanation_en: A nanostructure with a shape similar to a spring is formed by the spiral growth of a one-dimensional nanowire, nanobelt or nanotube to form a spring like shape. The function of nanospring is to store and release energy through the reconstruction of surface atoms. When studying the deformation behavior of tungsten metal single crystal nanowires, it was found that tungsten metal nanowires will undergo a wide range of equal stress twin deformation when stretched, and show a super elasticity behavior similar to that of known face centered cubic metal (such as Cu, Ni) nanowires. The loading/unloading stress-strain curve is almost coincident in a large strain range, that is to say, in a large strain range (>30%), the energy of the system is almost lost during the loading and unloading cycle. This low loss originates from the extremely low movement resistance of tungsten twin boundaries. Based on the above findings, people have designed a new device that can efficiently store and release mechanical energy with surface energy as the medium, namely nanospring. Nanospring is expected to achieve new breakthroughs in efficient energy storage and release, which has important guiding significance for the design of micro/nano electronic components and micro/nano electromechanical systems. The carbon nanotube spring is expected to be used in the fields of flexible heterogeneous body/electrode, micro strain sensor, supercapacitor, photovoltaic, field emission, energy dissipation fiber, etc., and can be developed into a multi-functional carbon nanotube fiber reinforced composite materials.

explanation_cn: 是指在1-lOOnm尺度内对原子、分子等进行操纵和加工的技术。从本质上来讲，纳米技术是在纳米尺度上进行研究产生新的分子结构。纳米尺寸的物体被直接应用是直接性的纳米技术;包含纳米材料的装置称为间接性的纳米技术;从纳米的观点在原子尺度上来理解一个过程的机理称为概念性的纳米技术。一般来讲，纳米技术通常满足三个条件:①至少有一维的尺寸是在纳米尺度进行技术的研究和开发;②所制造的结构由于处于纳米尺度具有了新的性质;③在原子尺度上能够进行操纵和控制，可以将分子结构合成更大尺度的结构。
explanation_en: It refers to the technology of manipulating and processing atoms, molecules, etc. on a scale of 1-lOOnm. In essence, nanotechnology is to research and produce new molecular structures on a nanoscale. It is a direct nanotechnology that nanometer sized objects are directly applied; Devices containing nanomaterials are called indirect nanotechnology; Understanding the mechanism of a process at the atomic scale from the perspective of nano is called conceptual nanotechnology. Generally speaking, nanotechnology usually meets three conditions: ① at least one dimension is used for technology research and development at the nanoscale; ② The structure manufactured has new properties due to its nanoscale nature; ③ The ability to manipulate and control molecular structures at the atomic scale allows for the synthesis of larger scale structures.

explanation_cn: 纳米颗粒可以用于对细菌或病毒的蛋白质或组织结构进行改性或破坏，以实现杀灭这些微生物的效果。这种利用纳米抗菌原理制备的药物被称为纳米抗菌剂，例如纳米银和纳米氧化钛。贵金属类纳米材料由于其小尺寸、高比表面积以及表面活性原子的特性，能够与细胞、组织中的蛋白质、DNA、RNA等分子发生相互作用，例如结合氨基、羧基或核糖基，导致它们发生变性，从而失去生物活性，达到杀菌的效果。对于具有光电效应的纳米材料，如二氧化钛及其复合材料，它们能够利用光生电子和产生空穴，导致蛋白质和组织的电离和改性，也能够达到杀菌的效果。这种光敏感性纳米材料在特定光照条件下可以更有效地杀灭微生物。
explanation_en: Nanoparticle can be used to modify or destroy the protein or tissue structure of bacteria or viruses to achieve the effect of killing these microorganisms. This kind of drug prepared by the nano antibacterial principle is called nano antibiotics, such as nano silver and nano titanium oxide. Due to its small size, high specific surface area and characteristics of surface active atoms, precious metals like nanomaterials can interact with proteins, DNA, RNA and other molecules in cells and tissues, such as binding amino, carboxyl or ribose groups, causing them to denature, thus losing bioactivity and achieving sterilization effect. For nanomaterials with photoelectric effect, such as titanium dioxide and its composite materials, they can use light to generate electrons and generate holes, leading to ionization and modification of proteins and tissues, and also achieving sterilization effect. This photosensitive nanomaterials can kill microorganisms more effectively under specific lighting conditions.

explanation_cn: 是指纳米材料作为药物、基因传递和控释的载体。主要包括纳米粒子和纳米胶囊。制备纳米控释系统较常用的是高分子材料，如聚乳酸、聚乙醇酸、聚乙烯醇、甲壳素、聚丙烯酸酯类以及它们的共聚物等。纳米粒子的制备方法根据形成机理可分为聚合反应法和聚合材料分散法。聚合反应法制备的纳米粒子由聚合反应生成，主要采用界面缩聚法和乳化聚合法。聚合材料分散法制备的纳米粒子由大分子或聚合物分散而制得。在对纳米粒子进行表面修饰而制备体内长循环纳米粒子时多采用聚合材料分散法。影响纳米粒子体内输送的因素主要包括亲水性、表面电荷、粒径等。纳米控释系统因其超微小的体积，在药物和基因载体方面有着重要的应用前景。
explanation_en: It refers to nano materials as carriers for drug, gene delivery and controlled release. Mainly including nanoparticles and nanocapsules. Macromolecule materials are commonly used to prepare nano controlled release system, such as polylactic acid, polyglycolic acid, polyvinyl alcohol, chitin, polyacrylate and their copolymer. The preparation methods of nanoparticles can be divided into polymerization reaction method and polymerization material dispersion method according to the formation mechanism. The nanoparticles prepared by the polymerization reaction method are generated by the polymerization reaction, which mainly adopts the interfacial polycondensation method and the emulsion polymerization method. Nanoparticles prepared by polymeric material dispersion method are prepared by dispersing macromolecules or polymer. Polymeric material dispersion method is commonly used to prepare in vivo long-cycling nanoparticles by surface modification of nanoparticles. The main factors affecting the transport of nanoparticles in vivo include hydrophilicity, surface charge, particle size, etc. Nano controlled release system has an important application prospect in medicine and gene vector because of its ultra small size.

explanation_cn: 在光刻过程中使用纳米材料或者纳米级别的结构作为光刻过程中的掩膜，以提供更高的光刻分辨率，该纳米材料或纳米结构称为纳米掩膜。采用纳米掩膜，可以制备尺寸更小、性能优异的半导体电子和光电子器件。
explanation_en: In the photolithography process, nanomaterials or nanoscale structure is used as the mask in the photolithography process to provide higher photolithography resolution. The nanomaterials or nanostructure is called nano mask. Using nano mask, semiconductor electronic and optoelectronic devices with smaller size and excellent performance can be prepared.

explanation_cn: 无机生物材料包括无机非金属生物材料、金属生物材料、碳基生物材料、复合生物材料等。纳米无机生物材料是将纳米材料与无机生物材料相结合，利用纳米材料的特异性来提高无机生物材料的性能，例如生物相容性和耐久性。纳米生物无机材料可以分为纳米无机陶瓷材料、纳米生物玻璃陶瓷、纳米生物复合无机材料、纳米生物碳材料等几类，其中应用最广泛的是纳米生物陶瓷材料和纳米生物碳材料。
explanation_en: Inorganic biological materials include inorganic non-metallic biological materials, metal biological materials, carbon based biological materials, composition biological materials, etc. Inorganic biological nanomaterials combine nanomaterials with inorganic biological materials, and use the specificity of nanomaterials to improve the performance of inorganic biological materials, such as biocompatibility and durability. Nano bio inorganic materials can be divided into nano inorganic ceramics materials, nano bioglass ceramics, nano biological composition inorganic materials, nano bio carbon materials, among which biological ceramic nanomaterials and nano bio carbon materials are the most widely used.

explanation_cn: 又称胶体纳米晶(colloidal nanocrystal)，是指相对于块体材料来说，在溶液中生长的、粒径在纳米尺寸、由一层附着在表面的表面活性剂稳定的无机颗粒，吋可以是单晶、多晶或准晶。有时也被称为"人造原子。它们的电子态密度(许多物理性能调控的根本点)易于通过调节纳米晶的组成、尺寸和形状来进行调控。纳米晶具有典型的纳米材料所具备的尺寸效应、表面效应以及量子限域效应等。其尺寸小于100nm的半导体纳米晶体，也称为量子点。化学家可以控制纳米晶体的组成、大小、形状、晶体结构和表面特性，以实现这些材料的物化特性更精细的调控。胶体纳米晶的合成要素包括前驱体、有机表面活性剂和溶剂。在生长过程中，被广泛认可的生长机制包括Ostwald生长、LaMer生长以及取向附生(oriented attachment)等。可以利用LaMer生长机制中的"快速成核"和"缓慢生长"两个关键步骤来实现单分散纳米晶的制备。可以使用不同的表面活性剂实现各向同性、各向异性的限制生长，从而实现其尺寸和形状的精确调控。尤其是可以利用表面活性剂活性基团与不同晶面的键合作用力，选择性地限制某些晶面的生长，从而实现不同形貌、不同晶面的晶体颗粒。因此，通过调控可以获得高活性晶面的暴露，已经在催化领域展现了广泛的应用前景。目前，被广泛研究的纳米晶包括金属、金属氧化物、半导体纳米晶以及异质纳米晶等。这些纳米晶在发光、光电信息、新能源、生物学、催化等领域展现了广泛的应用前景。
explanation_en: Also known as colloidal nanocrystals, it refers to the inorganic particles that grow in solution, have a particle size of nanometer, and are stabilized by a layer of surfactant attached to the surface, which can be single crystal, polycrystal or quasicrystal, as opposed to bulk materials. Sometimes called "artificial atoms. Their electronic state density (the fundamental point of many physical property regulation) It is easy to adjust the composition, size and shape of nanocrystal. Nanocrystal has typical size effect, surface effect and quantum confinemem effect of nanomaterials. Semiconductor nano crystal whose size is less than 100nm are also called quantum dots. Chemists can control the composition, size, shape, crystal structure and surface properties of nano crystal to achieve more precise control of physical and chemical properties of these materials. The synthetic elements of colloidal nanocrystals include precursors, organic surfactants and solvents. In the growth process, the widely recognized growth mechanisms include Ostwald growth, LaMer growth, and orientation epiphyte. The two key steps of "rapid nucleation" and "slow growth" in the LaMer growth mechanism can be used to realize the preparation of monodisperse nanocrystal. Different surfactants can be used to achieve isotropic and anisotropic growth restriction, thereby achieving precise regulation of their size and shape. In particular, it is possible to selectively restrict the growth of some crystal faces by using the bonding force between the active groups of surfactants and different crystal faces, so as to achieve crystal particles with different shapes and different crystal faces. Therefore, by regulating the exposure of highly active crystal surfaces, it has shown broad application prospects in the field of catalysis. At present, the widely studied nanocrystal include metals, metal oxides, semiconductor nanocrystal and heterogeneous nanocrystal. These nanocrystal show broad application prospects in luminescence, photoelectric information, new energy, biology, catalysis and other fields.

explanation_cn: 将WC晶粒尺寸小于100nm的硬质合金称为纳米晶硬质合金。纳米晶硬质合金具有特殊的耐磨性、高硬度以及优异的断裂韧性和压缩强度等优点。广泛应用在木工工具、精密模具、点阵打印机打印针头、难加工材料刀具等领域。研制纳米晶或纳米结构的WC-Co硬质合金的关键是开发稳定生产纳米级WC颗粒的制粉技术，特别是在抑制晶粒长大方面的研究。通过优化工艺，降低烧结温度，可以进一步降低成本，从而实现纳米WC-Co硬质合金的产业化。
explanation_en: The hardmetal with WC grain size less than 100nm is called nanocrystal cemented carbide. Nanocrystal cemented carbide has the advantages of special wear resistance, high hardness, excellent fracture toughness and compressive strength. It is widely used in woodworking tools, precision molds, dot matrix printer printing needles, difficult to machine materials tools and other fields. The key to the development of nanocrystal or nanostructured WC Co hardmetal is to develop a powder preparation technology for the stable production of nanoscale WC particles, especially the research on the inhibition of grain growth. By optimizing the process and reducing the sintering temperature, the cost can be further reduced, thus realizing the industrialization of nano WC Co hardmetal.

explanation_cn: 纳米有机生物材料是可以替代生物体组织和器官的组织工程与再生医学材料(例如人造皮肤和血管、人工移植动物器官等生物相容性纳米材料)，以及在医疗诊断中使用的天然或合成的有机纳米材料(例如新铟纳米药物基因传递材料、基团控释载体及高效的医用诊断材料等)。
explanation_en: Organic biomedical nanomaterials are tissue engineering and regenerative medicine materials that can replace biological tissues and organs (such as biocompatibility nanomaterials such as artificial skin and blood vessels, artificial transplanted animal organs, etc.), and natural or synthetic organic nanomaterials used in medical diagnosis (such as new indium nanomedicine gene delivery materials, group controlled release carriers, and efficient medical diagnosis materials, etc.).

explanation_cn: 属于分子仿生学的范畴，是指根据分子水平的生物学原理设计制造可对纳米空间进行操作的"智能分子器件"(smart molecular device)。基于生物学原理，运用"智能分子器件"发现新现象，研制可编程的分子机器人，也称纳米机器人。纳米机器人潜在用途十分广泛，主要应用于医疗和军事领域。
explanation_en: It belongs to the category of molecular bionics, which refers to the design and manufacture of "smart molecular device" that can operate in nano space according to the biological principles at the molecular level. Based on biological principles, we use "intelligent molecular device" to discover new phenomena and develop programmable molecular robots, also known as nano mbot. Nano mbot has a wide range of potential applications, mainly in medical and military fields.

explanation_cn: 纳米材料是指在三维空间中至少有一维尺度处于纳米尺度范围（1到100纳米），或由这些纳米尺度的基本单元构成的材料。这些基本单元根据维度可以分为以下三类：零维：在三维空间中的所有尺度均在纳米尺度范围内，例如纳米颗粒、原子簇等。一维：在三维空间中有两个维度处于纳米尺度，如纳米线、纳米带、纳米棒、纳米管等。二维：在三维空间中有一个维度处于纳米尺度，如纳米片、纳米薄膜等。制备纳米材料的方法可以分为两种途径："自上而下"（top-down）：这是一个由大到小的过程，大块物体通过破碎、粉碎、磨碎等方式，被转变成纳米级颗粒。"自下而上"（bottom-up）：通过适当的化学反应，使原子有序排列，从分子或原子出发制备纳米颗粒。制备纳米材料的方法也可以分为不同的类型，包括气相法、液相法和固相法：气相法包括惰性气体下的蒸发凝聚法、物理气相法和化学沉积法等。液相法包括水热法、溶剂热法、溶胶凝胶法、水解法、微乳液法、溶剂挥发分解法等。固相法包括高能球磨法、固相反应法等。纳米材料由于其特殊的尺寸效应、小尺寸效应、表面效应、以及量子隧道效应，表现出许多常规材料不具备的独特性质，包括在熔点、蒸气压、光学性质、化学反应活性和选择性、磁性、超导性、以及塑性形变等方面的特性。因此，纳米材料在磁性材料、电子材料、光学材料、催化、传感、环保、能源、医药等众多领域具有广泛的应用前景。
explanation_en: Nanomaterials refer to materials that have at least one dimension in the range of nanoscale (1 to 100 nm) or are composed of basic units of these nanoscale in three-dimensional space. These basic units can be divided into the following three categories according to dimensions: zero dimension: all scales in three-dimensional space are within the scope of nanoscale, such as nanoparticle, atomic clusters, etc. One dimension: there are two dimensions at the nanometer scale in the three-dimensional space, such as nanowires, nanobelt, nanorods, nanotube, etc. Two dimensional: there is a dimension at the nanometer scale in the three-dimensional space, such as nano sheet, nanofilm, etc. The methods of preparing nanomaterials can be divided into two ways: "top-down": this is a process from large to small, and large objects are transformation into nanoscale particles through crushing, smashing, grinding and other methods. "Bottom up": through appropriate chemical reactions, atoms are arranged in order to prepare nanoparticle from molecules or atoms. The methods for preparing nanomaterials can also be divided into different types, including gas phase method, liquid phase method and solid phase method: gas phase method includes evaporation condensation method under inert gas, physical gas phase method and chemical deposition method. Liquid phase method includes hydrothermal method, solvothermal method, sol-gel method, hydrolysis method, microemulsion method, solvent volatile decomposition method, etc. The solid-state method includes high-energy ball milling method, solid-state reaction method, etc. Because of its special size effect, small size effect, surface effect, and quantum tunneling effect, nanomaterials exhibit unique properties that many conventional materials do not possess, including melting point, vapor pressure, optical properties, chemical reaction activity and selectivity, magnetism, superconductivity, and plastic deformation. Therefore, nanomaterials have broad application prospects in magnetic materials, electronic materials, optical materials, catalysis, sensing, environmental protection, energy, medicine and many other fields.

explanation_cn: nanoplate/nanosheet是指厚度在1-100nm的二维纳米结构。由于在厚度维度上的尺寸远远小于另外两个维度，造成了该类材料的电子能级和态密度与体相材料相比会发生显著变化，从而表现出独特的物理和化学性质，仅由一层石墨片层构成的石墨烯就是典型的纳米板/片材料。纳米板/片的制备方法有化学法和物理法，化学法是从下而上的合成方法。包括液相合成和化学气相沉积法；物理法是从上而下的剥离方法，可以制备石墨烯及各种半导体类纳米板/片，如MOS2、GaN、BN等。纳米板/片吋以制成各种薄膜、用于晶体管等电子器件、传感器等。
explanation_en: Nanoplate/nanosheet refers to a two-dimensional nanostructure with a thickness of 1-100nm. Because the size in the thickness dimension is far smaller than the other two dimensions, the electronic energy level and density of this kind of materials will change significantly compared with the bulk phase materials, thus showing unique physical and chemical properties. graphene, which consists of only one layer of graphite, is a typical nano plate/sheet materials. The preparation methods of nanoplate/nanosheet include chemical method and physical method, and the chemical method is a bottom-up synthesis method. Including liquid phase synthesis and chemical vapor deposition methods; Physical method is a top-down stripping method, which can prepare graphene and various semiconductor nanoplate/nanosheet, such as MOS2, GaN, BN, etc. Nanoplate/nanosheet can be made into various films for electronic devices such as transistors and sensors.

explanation_cn: 又称枝晶纳米材料，指的是由尺寸在1到100纳米范围内的基元结构构建的、具有树枝或树丛状结构的超结构纳米材料。这些材料以其特殊的分级结构特点和在电、磁、催化等领域表现出的卓越性能而受到科学界广泛关注。纳米枝晶具有大量的边缘和台阶，因此可以提供非常出色的表面等离子共振信号。目前，已经成功制备了银、铜、金、铂和钯等金属的枝晶纳米结构，这些结构在表面等离子材料、纳米催化、各向异性电子传输和光学效应等领域得到了广泛应用。
explanation_en: Also known as dendritic nanomaterials, it refers to the superstructured nanomaterials with branches or clumps of structures that are constructed from elementary structures with sizes ranging from 1 to 100 nanometers. These materials have been widely concerned by the scientific community because of their special hierarchical structure characteristics and outstanding performance in the fields of electricity, magnetism, catalysis, etc. Dendritic nanocrystal have a large number of edges and steps, so they can provide excellent surface plasmon resonance signals. At present, dendrite nanostructures of silver, copper, gold, platinum and palladium have been successfully prepared. These structures have been widely used in surface plasma materials, nano catalysis, anisotropic electron transport and optical effects.

explanation_cn: 是以一个纳米级尺寸的颗粒为核，在其表面包覆数层均匀的纳米薄膜而形成的一种复合多相结构，包括无机-无机、无机-有机、有机-有机等核壳纳米结构，核与壳之间通过物理或化学作用相互连接，是纳米异质结构的一种典型结构。这些粒子可被人为设计和制备以满足特定性能的要求，如不同的表面化学组成、稳定性的增加、较高的比表面积等。可以控制核大小、壳的厚度等实现复合性能，如磁学、光学、电学、力学、催化等不同性质的偶合调控。核与壳层的晶格失配度会影响壳层材料在核表面的外延、非外延生长的结晶性能，在界面形成缺陷等，壳层的单晶性以及减少界面应力引起的缺陷等是实现不同的磁学、光学、电学等性能偶合的关键问题。在材料学、信息、能源、药物输送、生物化学诊断等领域具有极大的潜在应用价值。设计、可控合成单分散金属/聚合物、半导体/聚合物、金属/金属、金属/半导体、半导体/金属、金属/介电材料、介电材料/金属、半导体/半导体等核壳纳米结构及性能研究成为复合材料、纳米材料等领域的研究热点。
explanation_en: It is a composition multiphase structure formed by taking a nanometer sized particle as the core and covering several layers of uniform nanofilm on its surface, including inorganic inorganic, inorganic organic, organic organic and other core-shell nanostructures. The core and shell are connected by physical or chemical interaction, which is a typical structure of nano heterostructure. These particles can be artificially designed and prepared to meet the requirements of specific properties, such as different surface chemical composition, increased stability, higher specific surface, etc. It can control the size of the core and the thickness of the shell to achieve composition properties, such as magnetic, optical, electrical, mechanical, catalytic and other coupling regulation of different properties. The lattice mismatch between the core and the shell will affect the crystalline properties of the shell materials for epitaxial and non epitaxial growth on the surface of the core, and the formation of defects at the interface. The single crystal of the shell and the reduction of defects caused by interface stress are the key issues to achieve the coupling of different magnetic, optical, electrical and other properties. It has great potential application value in materials, information, energy, drug delivery, biochemical diagnosis and other fields. The design and controllable synthesis of monodisperse metal/polymer, semiconductor/polymer, metal/metal, metal/semiconductor, semiconductor/metal, metal/dielectric materials, dielectric materials/metal, semiconductor/semiconductor and other core-shell nanostructures and performance research have become research hotspots in composite materials, nanomaterials and other fields.

explanation_cn: 纳米橡胶是将橡胶材料用纳米材料进行改性，通常是指把有机或者无机的纳米粉体材料加入橡胶基体中所得到的复合体。一般来说，纳米橡胶的制备是将橡胶溶液或乳液与纳米粒子的混合，或将纳米粒子预处理后分散在橡胶聚合单体中，然后进行本体或溶液聚合。
explanation_en: Nano-rubber refers to the modification of rubber materials with nanomaterials, which usually refers to the composite obtained by adding organic or inorganic nanosized powder materials into rubber matrix. Generally speaking, the preparation of nano-rubber is to mix rubber solution or lotion with nanoparticles, or disperse nanoparticles into rubber polymerization monomer after pretreatment, and then conduct bulk or solution polymerization.

explanation_cn: 纳米气敏传感器是一种传感器，其敏感材料由纳米材料构成。这些传感器主要通过纳米材料与特定气体接触后，发生特定的化学反应或物理吸附作用，导致其电、磁或光学性能发生变化。这种变化的程度和性质可以用来测定特定气体的存在和浓度。相对于传统气敏传感器，纳米气敏传感器具有以下优点：纳米固体材料拥有庞大的界面，提供了更多的气体通道，从而提高了灵敏度。工作温度降低，甚至可以在室温下工作。缩小了传感器的尺寸，有利于微型传感器的制造。目前，研究较多的纳米材料包括金属氧化物半导体纳米结构、石墨烯、碳纳米管等。纳米气体传感器在生物、化学、机械、航空、军事等领域都具有广泛的发展前景。
explanation_en: Nano gas sensor is a kind of sensor, and its sensitive materials is composed of nanomaterials. These sensors mainly contact with specific gases through nanomaterials, and then undergo specific chemical reactions or physical adsorption, resulting in changes in their electrical, magnetic or optical properties. The degree and nature of this change can be used to determine the presence and concentration of specific gases. Compared with traditional gas sensors, nano gas sensors have the following advantages: nano-solid materials have a huge interface, providing more gas channels, thus improving the sensitivity. The working temperature decreases and can even work at room temperature. Reducing the size of the sensor is beneficial for the manufacturing of micro sensors. At present, nanomaterials that have been studied more include metal oxide semiconductor nanostructures, graphene, carbon nanotube, etc. Nano gas sensor have broad prospects in biology, chemistry, machinery, aviation, military and other fields.

explanation_cn: 是指那些能够感应接触气体并将这种感应转化为电信号输出，以便对气体进行定量或半定量检测的材料。这些材料至少具有一维尺寸在纳米级别。纳米材料因其极小的颗粒尺寸、巨大的比表面积以及高化学活性的表面而被广泛用于气敏应用，因为它们能够显著提高材料的气敏响应并减小检测限。一维和准一维的纳米结构具有高比表面积和富含表面原子的特点，这些特点使它们的电性能高度依赖于与其接触的气体种类。因此，它们通常表现出高度的气敏响应。金属氧化物半导体纳米材料是其中最成熟的研究领域之一。这些材料的表面氧缺陷和悬键对环境中某些气体具有高度敏感性。当这些气体吸附在材料表面时，会引起电学性能的变化，从而实现对气体的检测。纳米气敏材料在工业生产、日常生活、科学技术和国防等领域都具有重要应用前景。
explanation_en: It refers to those materials that can sense the gas and convert this induction into electrical signal output for quantitative or semi quantitative detection of gas. These materials have at least one dimension at the nanometer level. Nanomaterials are widely used in gas sensing applications because of their extremely small particle size, huge specific surface and highly chemically active surfaces, because they can significantly improve the gas sensing response of materials and reduce the detection limit. One dimension and quasi one dimension nanostructures have the characteristics of high specific surface area and rich surface atoms, which make their electrical properties highly dependent on the type of gas they contact. Therefore, they typically exhibit a high degree of gas sensitivity response. Metal oxide semiconductor nanomaterials is one of the most mature research fields. The surface oxygen defects and dangling bonds of these materials are highly sensitive to some gases in the environment. When these gases are adsorbed on the surface of materials, it will cause changes in electrical properties, thus realizing the detection of gases. Gas sensitive nanomaterials have important application prospects in industrial production, daily life, science and technology, national defense and other fields.

explanation_cn: 是指将纳米粒子添加到油墨中，或者将制造油墨的原材料(如连接料、颜料、填料等)制成纳米尺度的粒子，再经混合分散而成的油墨。由于纳米粒子具有独特的尺寸效应和表面效应，以纳米粒子为原料制成的油墨具有着色力高、遮盖力强的特点，颜料分散性和抗老化性能得到提高，油墨再现色域增大和印刷适性增强。基于不同纳米粒子的制备和表面性能的调控，可发展出不同特性的环保油墨和功能油墨，适应不同的印刷工艺、承印介质及应用领域，乃至实现光、电器件制造。
explanation_en: It refers to the ink made by adding nano particles to the ink, or making the raw materials (such as binder, pigment, filler, etc.) to nano particles, and then mixing and dispersing them. Due to the unique size effect and surface effect of nano particles, the ink made from nano particles has the characteristics of high coloring power and strong hiding power. The dispersivity and aging resistance of pigment are improved, and the colour gamut of ink reproduction is increased and the printability is enhanced. Based on the preparation of different nanoparticles and the regulation of surface properties, environmentally friendly and functional inks with different characteristics can be developed to adapt to different printing processes, printing media, and application fields, and even achieve the manufacturing of optical and electrical components.

explanation_cn: 是指把金属或非金属纳米粉体分散到水、醇、油等换热介质中，制备成均匀、稳定、高导热的新型换热介质，这是纳米技术应用于热能工程领域的创新性研究。与纯液体相比，纳米流体具有较高的热导率，且比微米或毫米级的固体颗粒更易悬浮在基液中。纳米流体的制备方法有一步法和两步法。一步法是将纳米颗粒的制备过程和纳米颗粒在基液中的分散过程同时完成。两步法是将制备好的纳米颗粒通过某种手段分散到基液中，制备和分散过程分两步进行。由于一步法制备工艺复杂，所需设备昂贵，不具备大批量生产的能力，所以现阶段主要采用两步法制备纳米流体。纳米流体中纳米颗粒容易自聚，纳米颗粒会从基液中析出，两步法制备中需要解决的问题是粒子在基液中的分散稳定性。长纳米流体在能源、化工、汽车、建筑、微电子、信息等领域具有巨大的潜在应用前景，成为材料、物理、化学、传热学等领域的研究热点。
explanation_en: It refers to dispersing metal or non-metallic nanosized powder into heat exchange media such as water, alcohol and oil to prepare new heat exchange media with uniform, stable and high thermal conductivity. This is an innovative research on the application of nanotechnology in the field of thermal engineering. Compared with pure liquids, nanofluid have higher thermal conductivity and are easier to suspend in the base liquid than micron or millimeter sized solid particles. The preparation methods of nanofluid include one-step method and two-step method. One step method is to complete the preparation of nanoparticle and the dispersion of nanoparticle in the base solution at the same time. The two-step method is to disperse the prepared nanoparticle into the base solution by some means, and the preparation and dispersion process is divided into two steps. Due to the complex one-step preparation process, expensive equipment, and lack of mass production capacity, the two-step method is mainly used to prepare nanofluid at this stage. Nanoparticle in nanofluid are easy to self assemble, and nanoparticle will precipitate from the base solution. The problem to be solved in the two-step preparation is the dispersion stability of particles in the base solution. Long nanofluid have great potential applications in energy, chemical industry, automobile, architecture, microelectronics, information and other fields, and become a research hotspot in materials, physics, chemistry, heat transfer and other fields.

explanation_cn: 又称纳米复合涂料，是一种将纳米粒子用于涂料中的涂料，具有某些特殊性能。根据其特性和功能，纳米涂料可以分为吸波纳米涂料、力学增强型纳米涂料、纳米抗菌涂料等。根据其用途，它还可以分为纳米抗菌涂料、纳米界面涂料、纳米耐老化涂料等。纳米涂料的特殊性能源自纳米材料的特性，例如表面效应、小尺寸效应、光学效应和量子尺寸效应，使其具备一些独特的功能，例如自清洁、抗辐射、耐高温等，适用于不同领域的专用涂料。
explanation_en: Also known as nano composite coating, it is a kind of coatings that uses nano particles in coatings and has some special properties. According to its characteristics and functions, nano coating can be divided into wave absorbing nano coating, mechanics enhanced nano coating, nano antibacterial coatings, etc. According to its use, it can also be divided into nano antibacterial coatings, nano interface coatings, nano aging resistant coatings, etc. The particularity of nano coating derives from the characteristics of nanomaterials, such as surface effect, small size effect, optical effect and quantum size effect, which enable them to have some unique functions, such as self-cleaning, radiation resistance, high temperature resistance, etc., and are suitable for special coatings in different fields.

explanation_cn: 纳米润滑涉及在原子和分子尺度上研究相对运动界面上的摩擦、磨损和润滑行为，以揭示微观摩擦磨损机制。纳米润滑材料指的是用作润滑油添加剂的纳米颗粒，包括各种种类的纳米粒子，如单质、氧化物、氢氧化物、硫化物、稀土化合物和聚合物等。其中，低熔点金属，如锡、铟、铋和它们的合金等，常被用作薄膜润滑材料和护层材料。纳米颗粒具有自身组成和结构上的特点，使其具备与传统有机润滑添加剂不同的润滑特性，包括：球形纳米微粒：这些纳米颗粒通常呈球状，它们在摩擦对偶面之间可能起到一种类似于“球轴承”的作用，有效提高润滑油的摩擦性能。受压时的变形：在受到重载荷和高温条件下，摩擦对偶面之间的纳米颗粒可能会被压平，形成一种滑动层，从而降低摩擦和磨损。原位修复：纳米颗粒可以填充工件表面的微小凹陷和受损部位，有望实现摩擦表面的现场修复。这些特性使纳米润滑成为一种具有潜力的润滑技术，可以改善摩擦和磨损性能，减少机械部件的磨损，并提高设备的寿命。
explanation_en: Nanolubrication involves studying the friction, wear and lubrication behavior at the relative moving interface at the atomic and molecular scales to reveal the microscopic friction and wear mechanism. Lubricating nanomaterials refer to nanoparticle used as additive of lubricating oil, including various kinds of nano particles, such as simple substances, oxides, hydroxides, sulfides, rare earth compounds and polymer. Among them, low melting point metals, such as tin, indium, bismuth and their alloy, are often used as thin film lubrication materials and protective layer materials. Nanoparticle have their own composition and structural characteristics, which make them have different lubrication characteristics from traditional organic lubricant additive, including spherical nanoparticles: these nanoparticle are usually spherical, and they may play a role similar to "ball bearing" between friction pairs, effectively improving the friction performance of lubricating oil. Deformation under pressure: under heavy load and high temperature conditions, nanoparticle between the friction dual surfaces may be flattened to form a sliding layer, thus reducing friction and wear. In situ repair: nanoparticle can fill the tiny depressions and damaged parts on the workpiece surface, which is expected to achieve on-site repair of friction surfaces. These characteristics make nano lubrication a potential lubrication technology, which can improve the friction and wear performance, reduce the wear of mechanical parts, and increase the service life of equipment.

explanation_cn: 是指尺寸在纳米级的可以产生激光的材料，简称纳米激光器。纳米半导体、纳米等离子体激元、纳米局域化的表面等离子体及其复合体均可受激而发射出不同波段的激光。可应用于超级计算机芯片、高敏感度生物传感器、疾病的治疗以及下一代通信技术等多个领域。纳米激光器的微小尺寸可以使光子被限制在少数几个光学状态上，而"低音廊效应"(椭球形房间声音在焦点的聚焦效应)则使光子受到约束，直到所产生的光波累积到足够的能量后透过此腔体，使激光器在能量阈很低状态下达到极高的工作效率。氧化锌(ZnO)纳米激光器是第一个纳米级激光器，最近通过表面等离子体共振效应可以将半导体(如CdSe)产生的受激发射大幅度提高，成为纳米激光器的研究热点。
explanation_en: It refers to the materials with the size of nanometer that can produce laser, referred to as nano laser for short. Nano semiconductors, nano plasmons, nano localized surface plasmons, and their complexes can all be stimulated to emit lasers of different wavelengths. It can be used in many fields, such as supercomputer chips, highly sensitive biosensor, disease treatment and next-generation communication technology. The tiny size of the nano laser can restrict photons to a few optical states, while the "bass gallery effect" (the focusing effect of the sound in the focus of the ellipsoid room) restricts photons until the generated light waves accumulate enough energy and pass through the cavity, so that the laser can achieve high efficiency in the state of very low energy threshold. Zinc oxide (ZnO) nano laser is the first nano laser. Recently, stimulated emission generated by semiconductor (such as CdSe) can be greatly improved through surface plasmon resonance effect, which has become a research hotspot of nano laser.

explanation_cn: 热电转换技术利用半导体材料的塞贝克效应（Seebeckeffect）和帕尔特效应（Peltiereffect）来实现热能到电能的直接转换。这项技术具有诸多优点，如尺寸小、高可靠性、无传动部件、无噪音和无污染。热电材料在余热回收和温差发电领域具有广泛的应用前景，尤其在需要释放大量废热的领域，如钢铁和化学工业。一些研究已经在超晶格纳米线和超晶格薄膜材料中部分实现了Seebeck系数和电导率的独立调控。研究表明，通过控制纳米结构的尺寸和分布，可以实现对电子和声子的选择性散射。结合界面结构的设计，可以利用界面能量势垒来过滤高能电子，从而进一步提高Seebeck系数和功率因子。这些方法有望改进热电材料的性能，推动热电技术的发展。
explanation_en: The thermoelectric conversion technology uses the Seebeck effect and Peltier effect of semiconductor materials to realize the direct conversion of thermal energy to electrical energy. This technology has many advantages, such as small size, high reliability, no transmission components, no noise, and no pollution. Thermoelectric materials have broad application prospects in the fields of waste heat recovery and thermoelectric power generation, especially in the fields that need to release a large amount of waste heat, such as steel and chemical industries. Some studies have partially realized the independent control of Seebeck coefficient and electric conductivity in superlattice nanowires and superlattice film materials. It is shown that selective scattering of electrons and phonon can be achieved by controlling the size and distribution of nanostructures. By combining the design of the interface structure, the interface energy barrier can be utilized to filter high-energy electrons, thereby further improving the Seebeck coefficient and power factor. These methods are expected to improve the performance of thermoelectric materials and promote the development of thermoelectric technology.

explanation_cn: 这是一种印刷版材，通常也称为纳米绿色版材或纳米转印版材（nanogreenplate），它基于纳米材料对版材表面浸润性的调控，实现了直接制版的印刷。纳米版材的表面具有特定的纳米和微米级结构，具备良好的保水性和特定的表面粗糙度，这使得它能够有效地调控纳米转印材料在不同区域的浸润性能。因此，在印版表面的图文区域和非图文区域之间呈现出明显的浸润性差异，从而可以通过印刷方式将图文信息转印到纸张等基材上。这种纳米版材有望为印刷工业提供一种更具环保和高效性质的印刷材料，同时也可以实现更精确和高质量的图文印刷。这对于图文印刷、包装、标志制作等领域可能具有重要的应用潜力。
explanation_en: This is a kind of printing plate, usually called nano green plate or nano green plate, which realizes direct plate making printing based on the control of nanomaterials on the surface wettability of the plate. The surface of nano plate has specific nano and micro structure, good water retention and specific surface roughness, which enables it to effectively control the wettability of nano transfer materials in different areas. Therefore, there is a significant difference in wettability between the graphic and non graphic areas on the surface of the printing plate, allowing for the transfer of graphic information to substrates such as paper through printing. This nano plate is expected to provide a more environmentally friendly and efficient printing materials for the printing industry, and can also achieve more accurate and high-quality graphic printing. This may have important application potential in fields such as graphic printing, packaging, and logo production.

explanation_cn: 又称圆环状纳米结构，其外形类似于圆环，纵切面是一个完整的圆。基于无机纳米材料和有机纳米材料的纳米环都曾被成功合成，如单晶氧化锌(ZnO)纳米带自组装成为氧化锌纳米环，PEI-PSS(poly ethylenimine-poly sodium 4-styrene-sulfanate)自组装纳米环。纳米环的直径可以从几十纳米到上百微米。具有良好生物相容性的无机氧化物纳米环可以作为血液实时监测微纳器件的载体，金属纳米环可用于高密度信息存储。
explanation_en: Also known as circular nanostructures, its shape is similar to a circular ring, and its longitudinal section is a complete circle. Nanorings based on inorganic nanomaterials and organic nanomaterials have been successfully synthesized, such as single crystal zinc oxide (ZnO) nanobelt self-assembly into zinc oxide nanorings, and PEI-PSS (poly ethylene poly sodium 4-styrene-sulfanate) self-assembly nanorings. The diameter of nanoring can range from tens of nanometers to hundreds of microns. The inorganic oxide nanoring with good biocompatibility can be used as the carrier of micro nano devices for real-time blood monitoring, and the metal nanoring can be used for high density information storage.

explanation_cn: 以多元合金为原料的纳米级尺度的球状原子团簇主要应用于润滑剂领域。这些团簇制备时采用高速气流粉碎技术，通过精确控制添加剂的颗粒粒度，能够吸附在受损的摩擦表面，形成新的超高硬度、极低摩擦系数、抗磨损和耐腐蚀的保护膜。这些纳米级别的润滑剂实现了在润滑、修复和保护作用方面的协同效应，从而大大降低摩擦阻力，仅为普通润滑剂的1/3。此外，这种纳米级别的润滑剂还提高了机械密封性，通过严格控制燃料和空气的比例，促进燃料更加充分的燃烧。这有助于减少不完全燃烧过程中产生的多种有害气体污染，实现了节能和减少排放的目标。这种纳米润滑剂在多个方面都有广泛的应用前景，包括在减少能源消耗和改善环境质量方面的潜在益处。
explanation_en: Nanometer scale spherical atomic clusters based on multi-component alloy are mainly used in the field of lubricant. During the preparation of these clusters, high-speed airflow pulverization technology is used. By precisely controlling the particle size of additive, they can be adsorbed on the damaged friction surface to form a new protective film with ultra-high hardness, extremely low friction coefficient, wear resistance and corrosion resistance. These nano level lubricant have achieved synergistic effects in lubrication, repair and protection, thus greatly reducing friction resistance, which is only 1/3 of that of ordinary lubricant. In addition, this nano level lubricant also improves the mechanical sealing performance, and promotes more sufficient combustion of fuel by strictly controlling the proportion of fuel and air. This helps to reduce the multiple harmful gas pollution generated in the incomplete combustion process, and achieves the goal of energy saving and emission reduction. This nano lubricant has broad application prospects in many aspects, including potential benefits in reducing energy consumption and improving environmental quality.

explanation_cn: 又称生物分子探针，纳米传感器的一种，泛指由纳米尺度材料构建的用于检测生物分子信息的传感器。这些传感器通过对纳米材料（包括颗粒或薄膜）进行表面化学修饰，然后将具有活性或反应性的生物分子（如各种抗体或糖类）耦合到上面。当待检测的生物分子（如抗原或其他能与糖发生反应的生物分子）与这些颗粒或薄膜上的活性生物分子相互作用时，会引发一种反应，从而影响到颗粒或薄膜的光学、电学、磁学等性能，并将这种变化的信号传递给信号收集和处理器，最终转化成与待测的生物分子种类和浓度一一对应的光学、电学信号输出。这类纳米生物传感器具有出色的空间分辨率和检测灵敏度。如果将其耦合到具有特异性的生物分子对（如抗体-抗原对，比如IgG-ProteinA），则这些传感器可以实现有针对性的定量检测。对于特定待测物质，它们可以实现单分子或单细胞的检测灵敏度。
explanation_en: Also known as biomolecular probes, a kind of nanosensor, generally refers to the sensor constructed of nanoscale materials for detecting biomolecular information. These sensors chemically modify the surface of nanomaterials (including particles or films), and then couple active or reactive biomolecules (such as various antibodies or sugars) onto them. When the biomolecules to be tested (such as antigens or other biomolecules that can react with sugars) interact with the active biomolecules on these particles or films, a reaction is triggered, which affects the optical, electrical, magnetic, and other properties of the particles or films. The signal of this change is transmitted to the signal collection and processor, and ultimately converted into optical Electrical signal output. This kind of nano biological sensor has excellent spatial resolution and detection sensitivity. If coupled to specific biomolecular pairs (such as antibody antigen pairs, such as IgG ProteinA), these sensors can achieve targeted quantitative detection. For specific substances to be tested, they can achieve single molecule or single cell detection sensitivity.

explanation_cn: 具有生物医药功能和疗效的材料。这一领域代表了生物材料和纳米材料的融合，旨在将纳米材料和纳米技术应用于传统医用材料中，赋予其纳米特性和增强的功能特性。这些纳米材料包括磁性纳米颗粒、银纳米颗粒、二氧化硅颗粒，以及具有止血等功能的高分子材料等。生物医用纳米材料的研究涉及多个学科，包括物理学、化学、材料学、生物学和医学。研究方向包括纳米材料的制备技术，表面修饰和功能化技术，生物相容性和安全性检测与评价，以及与生物医学应用相关的技术。需要强调的是，对这类材料的尺寸要求并不严格在1到100纳米范围内，更重要的是其具备纳米特性和在生物医学领域的应用效果。因此，其尺寸上限可以扩展到几百纳米甚至几微米。随着纳米技术、材料科学和生命科学的不断交叉和发展，生物医用纳米材料已经在新型医用植入材料、组织工程和再生医学材料、新型药物和基因控释载体，以及高效生物诊断材料领域取得了显著进展。
explanation_en: Materials with biomedical functions and therapeutic effects. This field represents the integration of biological materials and nanomaterials, aiming to apply nanomaterials and nanotechnology to traditional medical materials, giving them nano properties and enhanced functional properties. These nanomaterials include magnetic nanoparticle, silver nanoparticle, silicon dioxide particles, and macromolecule materials with hemostasis and other functions. The research of biomedical nanomaterials involves many disciplines, including physics, chemistry, materials, biology and medicine. His research interests include the preparation technology of nanomaterials, surface modification and functionalization technology, biocompatibility and safety testing and evaluation, and technologies related to biomedical applications. It should be emphasized that the size requirements for such materials are not strictly within the range of 1 to 100 nm, but more importantly, they have nano characteristics and application effects in the biomedical field. Therefore, its size limit can be extended to hundreds of nanometers or even a few micrometers. With the continuous intersection and development of nanotechnology, materials science and life science, biomedical nanomaterials have made significant progress in the fields of new medical implantation materials, tissue engineering and regenerative medicine materials, new drugs and gene controlled release carriers, and efficient biological diagnostic materials.

explanation_cn: 纳米生物科学是一门利用纳米技术研究生物学和活体物质的自然科学领域。它包括对生物和活体物质的结构、功能、生长、演化、分布和分类等方面的研究。这一领域的目标是深入理解生命的微观层面，探索生物系统的各种属性和相互作用，并应用纳米技术来研究和利用生物体系。纳米生物科学在生物医学、药物研发、生物材料和其他生命科学领域具有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: Nanobioscience is a natural science field that uses nanotechnology to study biology and living matter. It includes research on the structure, function, growth, evolution, distribution, and classification of organisms and living substances. The goal of this field is to deeply understand the micro level of life, explore various properties and interactions of biological systems, and apply nanotechnology to research and use biological systems. Nanobioscience has extensive applications in biomedical, drug research and development, biomaterials, and other life sciences.

explanation_cn: 是指在三维空间内至少有一维尺度处于纳米范围，或者由纳米粒子作为基本单元构成的生物材料。纳米粒子，特别是那些尺寸小于100纳米的纳米粒子，具有与它们的原材料不同的多种特性。其中包括高表面活性，这一特性显著提高了检测的灵敏度和特异性。尺寸适当的纳米粒子由于EPR效应（增强透过和滞留效应）可以穿过癌细胞周围的血管隙缝，从而在肿瘤区域聚集。纳米生物材料在医疗领域具有广泛应用，包括：药物控制释放：纳米药物传递系统可以更好地实现靶向给药和智能释药，从而提高治疗效果。基因传递：在基因治疗中，基因载体材料通常需要具有纳米级尺寸，以有效地输送基因到目标细胞。组织工程：一些纳米生物材料，如通过电纺丝制备的纳米纤维和高分子/无机复合纳米材料，在组织工程中发挥着重要作用。疾病诊断：基于纳米粒子的疾病诊断技术包括早期肿瘤标志物检测和影像诊断技术等，有望提高疾病的诊断精度。这些应用使纳米生物材料成为医疗领域中备受关注的领域，为医疗诊断和治疗提供了新的机会。
explanation_en: It refers to biological materials that have at least one dimensional scale in the nanometer range in three-dimensional space, or are composed of nanoparticles as basic units. Nanoparticles, especially those smaller than 100 nanometers in size, have various characteristics that differ from their raw materials. This includes high surface activity, which significantly improves the sensitivity and specificity of the detection. Properly sized nanoparticles can penetrate the vascular gaps around cancer cells due to the EPR effect (enhanced permeability and retention effect), thereby aggregating in the tumor area. Nano biomaterials are widely used in the medical field, including: drug controlled release: nano drug delivery system can better achieve targeted drug delivery and intelligent drug release, thus improving the therapeutic effect. Gene delivery: In gene therapy, gene vector materials usually need to have nanometer size to effectively deliver genes to target cells. Tissue engineering: Some nano biomaterials, such as nanofibre prepared by electrospinning and macromolecule/inorganic composition nanomaterials, play an important role in tissue engineering. Disease diagnosis: Nanoparticle based disease diagnosis technologies, including early tumor marker detection and imaging diagnosis, are expected to improve the accuracy of disease diagnosis. These applications have made nano biomaterials a field of concern in the medical field, providing new opportunities for medical diagnosis and treatment.

explanation_cn: 基本结构单元至少有一维处于纳米尺度范围（通常在1到100纳米）的生物活性玻璃，包括纳米生物活性玻璃微球、微囊、纳米丝、纳米管以及薄膜等。这些纳米材料具有独特的结构和巨大的比表面积，因此表现出小尺寸效应、量子尺寸效应、表面效应和宏观量子隧道效应等特殊的力学和生物学特性。纳米生物活性玻璃粉末是一类重要的新型生物活性材料，它不仅可以用于制备骨修复体和组织工程支架，而且近年的研究表明，具有特定结构和形貌的纳米生物活性玻璃还可以用作药物和基因的载体等。目前，制备纳米生物活性玻璃的方法包括溶胶-凝胶法和模板合成法等。
explanation_en: The basic structural unit includes at least one dimensional bioactive glass in the nanoscale range (usually 1 to 100 nm), including nano bioactive glass microsphere, microcapsules, nanowires, nanotube and films. These nanomaterials have unique structures and huge specific surface, so they show special mechanical and biological characteristics such as small size effect, quantum size effect, surface effect and macroscopic quantum tunneling effet. Nano bioactive glass powder is an important new type of bioactive materials. It can not only be used to prepare bone prosthesis and tissue engineering scaffolds, but also recent research shows that nano bioactive glass with specific structure and morphology can also be used as drug and gene carriers. At present, the methods of preparing nano bioactive glass include sol-gel method and template synthesis method.

explanation_cn: 应用微纳米技术的生命科学工具，用于研究生物体内微观活动的规律。其主要原理是使用微纳米技术来操控基因发射电磁信号，这些信号使其他分子带上基因的特征。与传统生物芯片相比，纳米生物芯片在非常小的几何尺度表面上集成了多种生物活性，仅需微小的生理或生物采样即可同时检测和研究不同的生物细胞、生物分子和DNA的特性，以及它们之间的相互作用，从而有助于揭示生命微观活动的规律。这意味着基因可以将其特征从一个细胞传递给另一个细胞，实现基因的传递和复制。通过电磁信号，我们可以改变基因的序列，进而实现对细胞的修复和复制。这些技术对生命科学研究和医学领域有重要的应用前景。
explanation_en: The life science tools of micro nanotechnology are used to study the laws of micro activities in organisms. Its main principle is to use micro nanotechnology to manipulate genes to emit electromagnetic signals, which make other molecules carry the characteristics of genes. Compared with the traditional biochip, the nano biochip integrates a variety of bioactivity on a very small geometric scale surface, and it can simultaneously detect and study the characteristics of different biological cells, biomolecules and DNA, as well as their interactions, so as to help reveal the laws of microscopic life activities. This means that genes can transmit their characteristics from one cell to another, achieving gene transmission and replication. Through electromagnetic signals, we can alter the sequence of genes, thereby achieving cell repair and replication. These technologies have important application prospects in life science research and medical fields.

explanation_cn: 是指晶粒处于纳米尺度(1-lOOnm)、与生物体或生物化学有关的新型陶瓷，包括精细陶瓷、多孔陶瓷、某些玻璃和单晶。根据使用分为植入陶瓷和生物工艺学陶瓷。
explanation_en: It refers to new ceramics with nano scale (1-lOOnm) grains and related to biology or biochemistry, including fine ceramics, porous ceramics, some glass and single crystal. According to the use, it can be divided into implantation ceramics and biotechnology ceramics.

explanation_cn: 纳米电极是指临界尺寸在纳米尺度内的电极，一般认为其一维有效直径在1到100纳米之间。如果小于10纳米，通常称为"nanode"。这类电极可以由纳米材料制成，如单个纳米丝、纳米粒子，或者由纳米粒子聚集体构成。这些粒度均匀的块状纳米电极与单个纳米电极具有相同的性质。此外，纳米电极也可以通过掺杂或表面修饰纳米材料来制备。纳米电极材料的种类有很多，包括碳纳米管电极、纳米氧化铅电极、纳米阵列钼电极、纳米二氧化钛电极、复合半导体纳米电极等。当宏观物质被加工到纳米尺度时，由于表面效应、小尺寸效应、量子尺寸效应和宏观量子隧道效应等因素，其电学、光学、磁学等性质会发生显著的变化。纳米电极在电化学领域的应用十分广泛。它们可以用于电池制造，提高电化学活性、循环性能和放电容量，从而进行电极过程动力学研究。纳米电极还可用于扫描探针显微技术，制成各种探头，用于研究多种形式的局部腐蚀和表面或界面过程。此外，它们用于生理生化测量，借助其极高的传质速率和分辨率，能够检测单个细胞中的液体，适合微区和痕量分析。纳米电极还在传感器、光谱电化学和电催化等领域得到了广泛应用。尽管纳米电极已经广泛应用，但这个领域仍然有很多值得探索的前景。
explanation_en: Nanoelectrode refers to the electrode whose critical size is within the nanometer scale, and its one-dimensional effective diameter is generally considered to be between 1 and 100 nanometers. If it is less than 10 nanometers, it is usually referred to as a 'nano'. Such electrodes can be made of nanomaterials, such as single nanowires, nanoparticles, or aggregates of nanoparticles. These block nanoelectrode with uniform particle size have the same properties as a single nanoelectrode. In addition, nanoelectrode can also be prepared by doping or surface modifying nanomaterials. There are many kinds of nanoelectrode materials, including carbon nanotube electrode, nano lead oxide electrode, nano array molybdenum electrode, nano titanium dioxide electrode, composition semiconductor nanoelectrode, etc. When macro materials are processed to nanometer scale, their electrical, optical and magnetic properties will change significantly due to surface effect, small size effect, quantum size effect, macroscopic quantum tunneling effet and other factors. Nanoelectrode are widely used in the field of electrochemistry. They can be used for battery manufacturing to improve electrochemical activity, cycling performance, and discharge capacity, thus conducting electrode process dynamics research. Nanoelectrode can also be used in scanning probe microscopy to make various probes for studying various forms of localized corrosion and surface or interface processes. In addition, they are used for physiological and biochemical measurement. With their extremely high mass transfer rate and resolution, they can detect the liquid in a single cell, and are suitable for micro area and trace analysis. Nanoelectrode are also widely used in sensors, spectroelectrochemistry and electrocatalysis. Although nanoelectrode has been widely used, there are still many prospects worth exploring in this field.

explanation_cn: 电致发光，又称为场致发光，是一种物理现象，通过在两个电极之间加电压产生电场，电场激发电子，使其碰撞到发光中心，从而导致电子能级的跃迁、变化和复合，最终产生光的过程。这是一种能量直接从电能转化为光能的现象。纳米电致发光材料是将纳米结构引入电致发光材料中，从而实现更出色的光学器件性能。由于纳米材料的小尺寸效应，其电性能和光学特性与块体材料有明显差异，因此将纳米材料应用于电致发光材料可以引发新的电致发光机制，提高性能，或创造出新的应用。这种材料可以在照明、显示、激光器和其他光电器件中得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: Electroluminescence, also known as electroluminescent, is a physical phenomenon that generates an electric field by applying a voltage between two electrodes. The electric field excites electrons and makes them collide with the luminescence center, which leads to the transition, change and composition of the energy level of electrons, and finally produces light. This is a phenomenon where energy is directly converted from electrical energy to light energy. Electroluminescent nanomalerials introduce nanostructures into electroluminescence materials to achieve better optical device performance. Because of the small size effect of nanomaterials, their electrical and optical properties are significantly different from those of block materials. Therefore, the application of nanomaterials to electroluminescence materials can lead to new electroluminescence mechanisms, improve performance, or create new applications. This materials can be widely used in lighting, display, laser and other photoelectric devices.

explanation_cn: 是指具有纳米结构的区，其边界也称畴壁。在不同领域有不同的定义，如在化学领域，纳米畴是指具有边界、尺寸在1-lOOnm的小原子团簇;而在生物化学领域，纳米畴是指在几个纳米尺度的开放钙通道中，钙与蛋白结合的位点。
explanation_en: Refers to areas with nanostructures, whose boundaries are also known as domain walls. There are different definitions in different fields. For example, in the chemical field, nanodomain refers to small atomic clusters with boundary and size of 1-lOOnm; In biochemistry, nanodomain refers to the site where calcium binds to protein in several nanoscale open calcium channels.

explanation_cn: 至少有一维尺寸小于100纳米的炭材料，主要由碳原子组成，包括富勒烯、碳纳米管、碳纳米纤维、碳纳米球、石墨烯等。
explanation_en: There are at least carbon materials with one-dimensional size less than 100 nm, mainly composed of carbon atoms, including fullerene, carbon nanotube, carbon nanofibre, carbon nanasphere, graphene, etc.

explanation_cn: 是指直径为50到100纳米，长度直径比较大（通常超过100）的新型碳材料。从尺寸上看，其直径一般大于单壁碳纳米管（直径0.4到2.5纳米）及多壁碳纳米管（MWNTs）（外径5到100纳米），但比常规碳纤维（直径为7到70微米）直径要小。从结构上来看，纳米碳纤维与常规碳纤维相似，为实心结构，而碳管则为高度石墨化的空心管状结构。纳米碳纤维的石墨化程度与常规碳纤维相似，石墨化程度远低于碳纳米管。纳米碳纤维具有较高的强度、模量、长径比、热稳定性、化学活性、导电性等特点。在复合材料中，如增强、导电以及电磁屏蔽添加剂等领域都有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: It refers to a new type of carbon materials with a diameter of 50 to 100 nm and a relatively large length and diameter (usually more than 100). In terms of size, its diameter is generally larger than that of single wall carbon nanotube (0.4 to 2.5 nm in diameter) and multi wall carbon nanotube (MWNTs) (5 to 100 nm in outer diameter), but smaller than that of conventional carbon fibers (7 to 70 microns in diameter). From the structural point of view, carbon nanofibre are similar to conventional carbon fibers, which are solid structures, while carbon tubes are highly graphitization hollow tubular structures. The degree of graphitization of carbon nanofibre is similar to that of conventional carbon fibers, and the degree of graphitization is much lower than that of carbon nanotube. Carbon nanofibre have high strength, modulus, aspect ratio, thermal stability, chemical activity, conductivity and other characteristics. It has broad application prospects in composite materials, such as reinforcement, conductivity and electromagnetic shielding additive.

explanation_cn: 又称磁性吸附材料、磁性微纳米吸附材料。甶尺寸介于1-100nm的过渡元素铁、钴、镍及其合金的超细颗粒组成的具有磁性的一类多孔固体材料。一方面纳米材料表面电位高、比表面积大、表而原子有很高的活性。很容易与其他原子结合，其结构单元中存在孔洞或通道，有助于吸附质进入材料白部-从而极大地提高了其对重金属离子和毒害柯机物的吸附性能；一方面，其拥有良好的磁导向性，在吸附污染物后，以借助超导磁分离技术快速从污水中分离，从而重复使用。
explanation_en: It is also called magnetic adsorption materials and magnetic micro nano adsorption materials. It is a kind of magnetic porous solid materials composed of ultrafine particles of transition elements iron, cobalt, nickel and their alloy with a size of 1-100nm. On the one hand, nanomaterials have high surface potential, large specific surface and high surface and atom activity. It is easy to combine with other atoms, and there are holes or channels in its structural unit, which helps the adsorbate enter the white part of materials - thus greatly improving its adsorption performance for heavy metal ions and toxic organic compounds; On the one hand, it has good magnetic guidance, and after adsorbing pollutants, it can be quickly separated from sewage using superconducting magnetic separation technology, thus being reused.

explanation_cn: 碳纳米管、硅纳米管、无机纳米管和氮化硼纳米管等都是一维管状纳米结构。碳纳米管由碳原子构成，有单壁碳纳米管和多壁碳纳米管两种类型。它们具有出色的力学、电学和化学性能，可应用于电子材料、氢气存储材料、聚合物力学增强材料等领域。碳纳米管制备方法包括电弧放电法、激光烧蚀法、化学气相沉积法、固相热解法、辉光放电法、气体燃烧法和聚合反应合成法。硅纳米管由硅原子构成，具有广泛的电子产业和锂离子电池应用前景。无机纳米管通常由金属氧化物或硫化物构成，如WS2、MoS2、SnS2、TiO2、ZnO等。它们可以作为碳纳米管的替代材料，具有易合成、高结晶性、均匀性、导电性可调、良好的黏附性和耐冲击性等优点。这些特性使得无机纳米管适用于用于聚合物复合材料，以增强聚合物的热、力学和电性能。氮化硼纳米管由氮化硼单层卷曲而成，类似于碳纳米管，但是它们是绝缘体。在航空航天领域，氮化硼纳米管具有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: Carbon nanotube, silicon nanotube, inorganic nanotube and nitriding nanotube are one-dimensional tubular nanostructures. Carbon nanotube are composed of carbon atoms, and there are two types of single-walled carbon nanotube and multi walled carbon nanotube. They have excellent mechanical, electrical and chemical properties, and can be used in electronic materials, hydrogen storage materials, polymer mechanical reinforcement materials and other fields. The preparation methods of carbon nanotubes include arc discharge, laser ablation, chemical vapor deposition, solid phase pyrolysis, glow discharge, gas combustion and polymerization reaction synthesis. Silicon nanotube are composed of silicon atoms, which have a wide range of electronic industry and Li ion battery application prospects. Inorganic nanotube are usually composed of metal oxides or sulfides, such as WS2, MoS2, SnS2, TiO2, ZnO, etc. They can be used as substitute materials for carbon nanotube, and have the advantages of easy synthesis, high crystallinity, uniformity, adjustable conductivity, good adhesion and impact resistance. These characteristics make inorganic nanotubes suitable for polymer composite materials to enhance the thermal, mechanical and electrical properties of polymer. Nitriding nanotube are made of nitriding single-layer curls, similar to carbon nanotube, but they are insulators. In the aerospace field, nitriding nanotube have broad application prospects.

explanation_cn: 纳米粉是指颗粒的粒度小于100纳米，通常使用高分辨率电子显微镜来观察其粒度大小。制备纳米粉主要涉及气相法和液相法两种方法。在气相法中，包括化学气相沉积（CVD，化学气相沉积）、激光气相沉积（LCVD，激光化学气相沉积）、真空蒸发、电子束溅射以及射线束溅射等技术。液相法方面，涵盖了溶胶-凝胶法（sol-gel法）、水热法（hydrothermal synthesis）以及沉淀法（co-precipitation法）等多种方法。其中，溶胶-凝胶法在制备纳米粉末中得到广泛应用。纳米粉具有独特的功能，这主要是由表面效应和体积效应共同作用的结果。因为大部分原子都位于纳米颗粒的表面，因此每个颗粒都具有极高的表面能。另一方面，体积效应指的是当颗粒的尺寸减小到一定程度时，物质的性质会发生变化。例如，几纳米尺寸的金属颗粒，在极低温度条件下可能会失去典型的金属性质，如超导性和磁性。超细纳米粉末在多个领域有广泛的应用，例如将其用作浆料来印刷大型电子计算机集成电路、制备高效净化微孔过滤器、制造高密度录音带、录像带、磁性液体以及高效催化剂等。这些应用充分利用了纳米颗粒的特殊性质，从而实现了各种功能性要求。
explanation_en: Nanosized powder refers to the particle size less than 100 nm, which is usually observed with a high-resolution electron microscope. The preparation of nanosized powder mainly involves two methods: gas phase method and liquid phase method. The vapor method includes chemical vapor deposition (CVD, chemical vapor deposition), laser vapor deposition (LCVD, laser chemical vapor deposition), vacuum evaporation, electron beam sputtering and ray beam sputtering. In terms of liquid phase method, it covers sol-gel method, hydrothermal synthesis method and precipitation method. Among them, the sol-gel method is widely used in the preparation of nano powder. Nanosized powder has unique functions, which is mainly due to the combined effect of surface effect and volume effect. Because most atoms are located on the surface of nanoparticle, each particle has a very high surface energy. On the other hand, volume effect refers to the change in the properties of a substance when the particle size decreases to a certain extent. For example, metal particles with several nanometers in size may lose their typical metal properties, such as superconductivity and magnetism, at extremely low temperatures. Ultrafine nano powder has been widely used in many fields, such as printing large electronic computer integrated circuits with slurry, preparing high-efficiency purification microporous filters, manufacturing high density audio tapes, video tapes, magnetic liquids and high-efficiency catalysts. These applications make full use of the special properties of nanoparticle, thus realizing various functional requirements.

explanation_cn: 是指纤维的直径在纳米级别的超细纤维，通常将纳米颗粒填充到普通纤维中，或者对普通纤维进行改性以获得纳米尺度的特性。这些纤维也有时被称为纳米纤维。制备纳米纤维的方法包括拉伸法、模板合成、自组装、微相分离、静电纺丝等。纳米纤维具有许多显著的特点，包括：极大的比表面积：纳米纤维的高比表面积使其在吸附和反应等方面表现出优异的性能。长度直径比高：纳米纤维的长度相对于其直径来说很高，这增加了其纤维间互相渗透的能力。极细的纤维直径：这使得纳米纤维的结构非常细致，具有特征光泽和颜色。高孔隙度：纳米纤维具有极高的孔隙度，适用于过滤和分离等应用。出色的柔韧性、吸附性、黏合性和保温性。纳米纤维在各个领域具有广泛的应用前景，包括国防领域（如防护服）、增强剂、高效过滤介质、药物传输、生物材料、精密电子和光学器件等。这些特性使纳米纤维成为一种非常有前途的材料。
explanation_en: It refers to the superfine fiber with a diameter of nanometer. Usually, nanoparticle are filled into ordinary fibers, or ordinary fibers are modified to obtain nanometer scale characteristics. These fibers are sometimes called nanofibre. The methods for preparing nanofibre include stretching, template synthesis, self-assembly, microphase separation, electrostatic spinning, etc. Nanofibre have many remarkable characteristics, including: great specific surface: nanofibre have high specific surface area, which makes them show excellent performance in adsorption and reaction. High length diameter ratio: the length of nanofibre is very high relative to its diameter, which increases its ability to penetrate each other. Extremely fine fiber diameter: this makes the structure of nanofibre very fine, with characteristic luster and color. High porosity: nanofibre has very high porosity, suitable for filtration and separation applications. Excellent flexibility, adsorption, adhesion, and insulation. Nanofibre have broad application prospects in various fields, including national defense (such as protective clothing), reinforcing agent, efficient filter media, drug delivery, biological materials, precision electronics and optical devices. These characteristics make nanofibre a very promising materials.

explanation_cn: 纳米纺丝是一种制备纳米纤维的方法，它包括电纺丝法、相分离法、自组装法、拉伸法和模板法等。通常，纳米纺丝采用湿纺的方法，这意味着通过将带电荷的高分子溶液或熔体在静电场中流动和变形，然后通过溶剂蒸发或熔体冷却来使其凝固，从而形成纳米纤维。静电纺丝方法具有几个显著的优点。首先，这种方法可以使纳米纤维直接成膜并制备成纺织物，因此它是一种方便且成本较低的技术。其次，静电纺丝可以在室温下进行，而不需要高温处理。最后，它提供了良好的工艺可控性，可以控制纤维的尺寸和形态，同时也具有可重复性和可操作性。这种新型制备纳米纤维的技术有广泛的应用前景，涉及生物医学材料、过滤和防护、催化、能源、光电、食品工程、化妆品等多个领域。它有望在这些领域中发挥重要作用。
explanation_en: Nano spinning is a method for preparing nanofibre, including electrospinning, phase separation, self-assembly, stretching and template method methods. Generally, nano spinning adopts the wet spinning method, which means that the charged macromolecule solution or melt flows and deforms in the electrostatic field, and then solidifies it through solvent evaporation or melt cooling to form nanofibre. The electrostatic spinning method has several significant advantages. First, this method can make nanofibre film directly and prepare textile fabric, so it is a convenient and low-cost technology. Secondly, electrostatic spinning can be carried out at room temperature without high temperature treatment. Finally, it provides good process controllability, which can control the size and morphology of fibers, while also possessing repeatability and operability. This new technology for preparing nanofibre has broad application prospects, involving biomedical materials, filtration and protection, catalysis, energy, photoelectricity, food engineering, cosmetics and other fields. It is expected to play an important role in these fields.

explanation_cn: 具有特殊尺寸和结构的材料，它们通常表现出纳米尺度下独特的物理和化学性质。这些材料可以根据维度和构筑方式进行分类。通常，纳米结构材料可以分为零维、一维、二维和三维结构，具体如下：零维纳米结构材料：包括原子团簇和纳米颗粒等。它们通常是零维的，尺寸在1到100纳米之间。一维纳米结构材料：包括纳米棒、纳米线、纳米纤维、纳米管、纳米带、纳米针等。它们在至少一个维度上的尺寸介于1到100纳米之间。二维纳米结构材料：主要是纳米薄膜，这些薄膜在两个维度上具有纳米级的尺寸。三维纳米结构材料：通常是由多个纳米粒子或纳米结构组成的块体材料。这些纳米结构材料通常具有纳米尺寸效应、量子效应、界面效应、光子耦合效应以及协同效应等特性，这些特性使它们在各种应用领域中具有潜力。纳米结构材料的制备方法包括自上而下法和自下而上法。自上而下法通常涉及从大尺寸材料中削减或加工出纳米结构，例如通过化学气相沉积、物理气相沉积、光刻等方法。自下而上法则涉及通过组装原子、分子或纳米粒子来构建所需的结构，包括模板法、光刻法和化学自组装等。这些纳米结构材料在材料科学和纳米技术领域具有广泛的应用前景，可以应用于超塑性、高温材料、光电器件、传感器等多个领域，具有重要的科学和工程价值。中科院金属研究所的研究团队在这方面的研究取得了重要的进展，特别是在间体熔点极限动力学理论方面，这对于开发高温材料具有实际意义。
explanation_en: Materials with special size and structure usually exhibit unique physical and chemical properties at nanometer scale. These materials can be classified according to dimensions and construction methods. Generally, structural nanomaterials can be divided into zero dimensional, one-dimensional, two-dimensional and three-dimensional structures, as follows: zero dimensional structural nanomaterials: including atomic clusters and nanoparticle. They are usually zero dimensional, with sizes ranging from 1 to 100 nanometers. One dimensional structural nanomaterials: including nanorods, nanowires, nanofibre, nanotube, nanobelt, nanoneedles, etc. Their size ranges from 1 to 100 nanometers in at least one dimension. Two dimensional nano structural materials: mainly nanofilm, which have nanometer size in two dimensions. Three dimensional structural nanomaterials: usually a bulk materials composed of multiple nanoparticles or nanostructures. These structural nanomaterials usually have nano size effect, quantum effect, interface effect, photon coupling effect and synergistic effect, which make them have potential in various application fields. The preparation methods of structural nanomaterials include top-down method and bottom-up method. The top-down method usually involves cutting or processing nanostructures from large-sized materials, such as chemical vapor deposition, physical vapor deposition, photolithography and other methods.
