The bottom-up rule involves the construction of required structures by assembling atoms, molecules or nanoparticles, including template method, photolithography and chemical self-assembly. These structural nanomaterials have broad application prospects in materials science and nanotechnology, and can be used in superplasticity, high-temperature materials, photoelectric devices, sensors and other fields, with important scientific and engineering values. The research team of the Institute of Metals, Chinese Academy of Sciences has made important progress in this field, especially in the theory of inter body melting point limit dynamics, which is of practical significance for the development of high-temperature materials.

explanation_cn: 是指具有药物缓释的纳米材料，可调节药物释放速度，影响功效，需要具有生物相容性和生物可降解性。药物缓释是将小分子药物与高分子载体以物理或化学方法结合，在体内通过扩散、渗透等控制方式，将小分子药物以适当的浓度持续地释放出来，从而达到充分发挥药物功效的目的。
explanation_en: It refers to the nanomaterials with drug sustained release, which can adjust the drug release rate and affect the efficacy. It needs to be biocompatibility and biodegradable. Drug slow release refers to the combination of small molecule drugs and macromolecule carriers by physical or chemical methods, and the continuous release of small molecule drugs with appropriate concentration through diffusion, penetration and other control methods in the body, so as to achieve the purpose of giving full play to drug efficacy.

explanation_cn: 其基本结构单元至少有一维处于纳米尺度范围，通常在1到100纳米之间。这些纳米尺度的结构单元对于羟基磷灰石的药物载体、肿瘤领域和硬组织修复材料等应用具有重要意义。
explanation_en: Its basic structural units have at least one dimension in the nanoscale range, usually between 1 and 100 nanometers. These nanoscale structural units are of great significance for the application of hydroxyapatite as drug carrier, tumor field and hard tissue repairing materials.

explanation_cn: 是指在纳米尺度的材料和体系中实现操控电子自旋本征属性的一种纳米结构单元。微电子器件是利用外加电场来操控材料中电子电荷属性的结构单元，在小尺寸情况下常遇到局部高温现象;而纳米自旋器件则利用外加磁场或其等效场(如自旋极化电流、温度场、光场、电场等)来操控体系中的电子自旋，可以大幅度提高磁信息存储密度并避免局部髙温现象(如纯自旋流不产生焦耳热)。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of nanostructure unit that controls the intrinsic properties of electron spin in nanoscale materials and systems. Microelectronic devices are structural units that use an external electric field to manipulate the electronic charge properties in materials, and often encounter local high temperature phenomenon in small size cases; The nano spin device uses an external magnetic field or its equivalent field (such as spin polarization current, temperature field, optical field, electric field, etc.) to control the electronic spin in the system, which can greatly improve the density of magnetic information storage and avoid local high temperature phenomenon (such as pure spin current does not produce Joule heat).

explanation_cn: 芯片，也称为集成电路芯片，是电子设备的关键组成部分，它包含了许多微型电子元件，如晶体管、电容器和电阻器，用于处理和存储信息。芯片的电路特征尺寸越小，其集成度越高，性能越强大。在电子工业中，制程工艺（芯片的生产工艺）的不断发展和尺寸的不断缩小推动了芯片技术的进步。"纳米芯片"通常指的是电路中的一些尺寸在纳米级范围内的关键部分。如您所提到的，随着技术的不断进步，制程工艺逐渐缩小，目前主流的芯片技术已经达到了14纳米（nm）的制程水平。此制程指的是芯片上的关键电子元件尺寸的缩小。在未来，碳纳米管等纳米材料可能会成为新一代芯片制程的一部分，因为它们具有出色的电学性能，并可以进一步减小芯片元件的尺寸，提高集成度，减少功耗，提高运行速度。IBM等公司的研究部门一直在探索碳纳米管等新材料的应用，以推动芯片技术的进一步发展。
explanation_en: Chips, also known as integrated circuit chips, are key components of electronic devices that contain many micro electronic components, such as transistors, capacitors, and resistors, for processing and storing information. The smaller the circuit feature size of a chip, the higher its integration and stronger its performance. In the electronics industry, the continuous development of process technology (the production process of chips) and the continuous reduction of size have driven the progress of chip technology. "Nanochip" usually refers to some key parts of the circuit whose size is in the nanometer range. As you mentioned, with the continuous progress of technology, the process technology is gradually shrinking, and the current mainstream chip technology has reached a process level of 14 nanometers (nm). This process refers to the reduction in the size of key electronic components on a chip. In the future, nanomaterials such as carbon nanotube may become a part of the new generation chip manufacturing process because they have excellent electrical properties and can further reduce the size of chip components, improve integration, reduce power consumption and improve operating speed. Research departments of IBM and other companies have been exploring the application of new materials such as carbon nanotube to promote the further development of chip technology.

explanation_cn: 又称为纳米花束，是指通过化学反应生成的、在微观上为花状的纳米结构。纳米花不仅在外观上形成了一种漂亮的花状结构，而且具有许多独特的性质，如大的比表面积等，在催化、能源存储和催化等方面显示了优异的性能。研究者提出了一种合成含酶杂化纳米花的新方法，并证实纳米花结构能够有效提高酶分子的体外催化活性和催化稳定性。通过金属粉尘倒入熔炉，烧至气化，然后将其吹到熔炉内温度相对低的区域，粉尘在此固化形成由金属硫化锗的粉尘制成的纳米花，它呈花瓣状，比表面积很大，有望提高锂电池的容量。
explanation_en: Also known as nano bouquet, it refers to the flower like nanostructures generated by chemical reaction. Nanoflowers not only form a beautiful flower like structure in appearance, but also have many unique properties, such as large specific surface, showing excellent performance in catalysis, energy storage and catalysis. The researchers proposed a new method to synthesize enzyme containing hybrid nanoflower, and confirmed that the structure of nanoflower can effectively improve the catalytic activity and catalytic stability of enzyme molecules in vitro. The metal dust is poured into the furnace, burned to gasification, and then blown to the relatively low temperature area in the furnace, where the dust is curing to form nanoflower made of metal germanium sulfide dust. It is petal shaped and has a large specific surface, which is expected to improve the capacity of lithium batteries.

explanation_cn: 纳米薄膜是指具有纳米数量级（1到100纳米）厚度的薄膜材料。这些纳米薄膜可以由尺寸在纳米尺度的颗粒（晶粒）构成，也可以由层厚在纳米尺度的单层或多层薄膜组成，分别被称为纳米颗粒薄膜和纳米多层薄膜。纳米薄膜可以根据不同的特性和用途进行分类，包括以下几种：按层数：单层薄膜和多层薄膜。按用途：纳米功能薄膜和纳米结构薄膜。按致密度：颗粒薄膜和致密薄膜。按组分：有机纳米薄膜和无机纳米薄膜。制备纳米薄膜的方法多种多样，包括凝胶-溶胶法、化学沉积法、自组装、Langmuir-Blodgett（L-B）膜法、物理气相沉积、真空蒸镀和溅射等。不同的制备方法会导致具有不同结构、特性和功能的纳米薄膜。这些纳米薄膜在材料科学、纳米技术和其他领域中具有广泛的应用，可以用于开发新型材料、传感器、涂层、电子器件等。
explanation_en: Nanofilm refers to a thin film materials with a thickness of nanometer order of magnitude (1 to 100 nm). These nanofilm can be composed of particles (grains) with the size of nanometer, and can also be composed of single-layer or multi-layer films with the thickness of nanometer, which are called nanoparticle films and nano multilayer films respectively. Nanofilm can be classified according to different characteristics and uses, including the following: by layers: single-layer films and multilayer films. By purpose: Nanofunctional thin films and nanostructured thin films. According to efficiency of spare filling: granular film and dense film. By component: organic nanofilm and inorganic nanofilm. There are many methods to prepare nanofilm, including gel sol method, chemical deposition method, self-assembly, Langmuir Blodgett (L-B) film method, physical vapor deposition, vacuum vapor exposition and sputtering. Different preparation methods will lead to nanofilm with different structures, characteristics and functions. These nanofilm are widely used in materials science, nanotechnology and other fields, and can be used to develop advanced materials, sensors, coatings, electronic devices, etc.

explanation_cn: 指纳米级精度的尺寸和位移的测量以及纳米级表面形貌的测最方法。前者主要利用的是光学的方法如光干涉测量技术，即利用双频激光干涉测量法、光外差干涉测量法、X射线干涉测量法、F-P标准工具测量法等来提高测量的分辨率，可用于纳米级精度的长度和位移的精确测量，也可用于表面显微形貌的测量。后者是利用扫描探针显微测量技术，即利用极尖的探针(或类似的方法)对被测表面进行扫描，或者依据电子束与物质的相互作用获取被测量样品表面的微观形貌、尺寸、晶体结构、电子结构和内部电场或磁场等信息而获得纳米尺度的测量。利用这种原理的测量方法主要有:扫描隧道显微术(STM)、扫描电子显微术(SEM)、透射电子显微术(TEM)、原子显微术(AFM)等。
explanation_en: Refers to the measurement of size and displacement with nanoscale accuracy, as well as the measurement method of nanoscale surface morphology. The former mainly uses optical methods such as optical interferometry technology, that is, using dual frequency laser interferometry, optical heterodyne interferometry, X-ray interferometry, F-P standard tool measurement, etc. to improve the resolution of measurement, which can be used for precise measurement of length and displacement with nanometer precision, and also for measurement of surface micromorphology. The latter is the use of scanning probe micro measurement technology, that is, using a tip probe (or similar method) to scan the measured surface, or according to the interaction between the electron beam and the material to obtain the micro morphology, size, crystal structure, electronic structure, internal electric field or magnetic field and other information of the measured sample surface to obtain nanoscale measurement. The measurement methods using this principle mainly include: scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), atomic microscopy (AFM), etc.

explanation_cn: 是指材料的组分特征尺寸在0.1到100纳米之间，能透过电磁波且几乎不改变电磁波的外部性质（包括能量）的材料。低介电常数和低介质损耗是纳米透波材料满足使用要求的必要条件。在实际应用中，介电常数和耗散损耗是衡量透波材料透波能力的两个重要指标。根据透波材料的使用环境，还需要考虑除透波率外的其他性能，如温度耐受性、高刚性、尺寸稳定性、阻燃性、韧性、化学腐蚀性、耐磨性、自润滑性、耐老化等。纳米透波材料属于光电磁和结构功能复合材料领域，是多学科交叉并涉及设计、材料、性能检测等多个领域的综合工程。它是经典的多功能材料，在航天器中具有重要地位，是航天器的重要组成部分，用于保护航天飞行器的通信、遥测、制导、引爆等系统在恶劣环境条件下正常工作。纳米透波材料在运载火箭、飞船、导弹和返回式卫星等航天飞行器的无线电系统中得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: It refers to a materials whose component characteristic size is between 0.1 and 100 nm, which can penetrate electromagnetic waves and hardly change the external properties (including energy) of electromagnetic waves. Low dielectric constant and low dielectric loss are the necessary conditions for wave transparent nanoruaterials to meet the application requirements. In practical applications, dielectric constant and dissipation loss are two important indicators to measure the wave transmitting ability of wave transmitting materials. According to the use environment of wave transmitting materials, other properties other than wave transmitting rate should also be considered, such as temperature tolerance, high rigidity, dimensional stability, flame retardancy, toughness, chemical corrosion, wear resistance, self lubrication, aging resistance, etc. Wave transparent nanoruaterials belong to the field of photoelectric magnetism and structural functional composite materials. They are multidisciplinary and comprehensive projects involving design, materials, performance testing and other fields. It is a classic multi-functional materials, plays an important role in spacecraft, and is an important part of spacecraft. It is used to protect the communication, telemetry, guidance, detonation and other systems of spacecraft under adverse environmental conditions. Wave transparent nanoruaterials have been widely used in the radio systems of space vehicles, such as launch vehicles, spacecraft, missiles and recoverable satellites.

explanation_cn: 是指由单个开放式的纳米管，或是被垂直定向的纳米管阵列构成的表面蜂窝状的不渗透薄膜。与传统的多孔薄膜相比，"防渗"是纳米通道膜的特性。流体和气体分子可以逐个或集体通过纳米通道薄膜。例如，通过碳纳米管的水分子能够通过，这是由于其具有链状的有序氢键。这源自纳米管和水之间几乎无摩擦、原子级平滑的界面，即疏水性界面相关的"滑移长度"。自2000年起，有关60nm和100nm直径的聚苯乙烯颗粒通过150nm单管薄膜的研究不断涌现，涉及多壁和双壁碳纳米管构成的组装纳米通道薄膜。
explanation_en: It refers to the honeycomb like impermeable film formed by a single open nanotube or vertically oriented nanotube array. Compared with traditional porous membrane, "seepage prevention" is the characteristic of nanotube membrane. Fluid and gas molecules can pass through nanochannel films individually or collectively. For example, water molecules passing through carbon nanotube can pass through because they have chain like ordered hydrogen bond. This is due to the almost frictionless, atomic level smooth interface between nanotube and water, that is, the "slip length" related to the hydrophobic interface. Since 2000, research on 60nm and 100nm diameter polystyrene particles through 150nm single tube films has been emerging, involving multi wall and double wall carbon nanotube composed of assembled nanochannel films.

explanation_cn: 是指金刚石晶粒尺寸在纳米尺度的金刚石薄膜，它不仅具备普通金刚石薄膜的一切优异性能，同时作为纳米材料，它具有许多优异的特性，如表面粗糙度和摩擦系数更低、场发射性能更好等。纳米金刚石膜的制备方法包括微波等离子化学气相沉积法、热丝法、化学气相沉积法、直流电弧法、溅射法、燃烧火焰法等。其关键是要有非常高的成核密度和二次成核率来抑制金刚石颗粒的长大，以获得纳米级的金刚石。纳米金刚石膜可用作耐磨和减摩材料，具有更好的生物相容性，因此可应用于生物医学装置，如心脏瓣膜、矫形装置等。其晶粒较小，表面光洁度高，硬度高，耐磨性好，摩擦系数低，还可用于微机电领域。
explanation_en: It refers to the diamond film with the grain size of diamond in nanometer scale. It not only has all the excellent properties of ordinary diamond film, but also as a nanomaterials, it has many excellent characteristics, such as lower surface roughness and friction coefficient, better field emission performance, etc. The preparation methods of nano diamond film include microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition, hot wire method, chemical vapor deposition, DC arc method, sputtering method, combustion flame method method, etc. The key is to have very high nucleation density and secondary nucleation rate to inhibit the growth of diamond particles, so as to obtain nano diamond. Nano diamond film can be used as wear-resistant and antifriction materials, and has better biocompatibility, so it can be used in biomedical devices, such as heart valves, orthopedic devices, etc. It has small grains, high surface finish, high hardness, good wear resistance and low friction coefficient. It can also be used in the field of MEMS.

explanation_cn: 是指晶粒的特征尺寸在1-lOOnm的金属单相或多相材料，其特点是晶粒小、晶界所占比例很大。纳米金属材料按其结构单元分为层状、柱状、晶粒等三种形态。按化学成分不同又可分为四种类型:晶粒、晶界成分相同(单相金属纳米材料);晶粒成分不同(多相金属纳米材料);晶粒、晶界成分不同;晶粒弥散分布于不同化学成分的基体中。由于纳米金属材料结构上的特异性，使其具有许多传统材料无可比拟的优异性能，如高强度、高电阻率以及良好的塑性变形能力等。纳米金属材料的制备方法包括物理、化学和机械的方法。这些方法可大致划分为"两步法"和"一步法"两类。两步法是将预先制备的孤立金属纳米颗粒通过后续的间结或烧结致密化而成，包括物理气相沉积、化学气相沉积、微波等离子体、低压火焰燃烧、溶液的热分解和沉积等方法，其中物理气相沉积法以"惰性气体冷凝法"最具代表性。"一步法"是以前驱体作为母体材料，通过外部能量的引人和作用，直接制备出纳米金属材料?包括非晶合金晶化法、可控快速凝固法等。
explanation_en: It refers to metal single-phase or multi-phase materials with the characteristic size of grain at 1-lOOnm, characterized by small grain size and large proportion of grain boundary. According to its structural unit, nano metallic materials can be divided into three forms: layered, columnar and crystalline. According to different chemical composition, it can be divided into four types: grain and grain boundary have the same composition (single-phase metal nanomaterials); Different grain composition (multi phase metal nanomaterials); The composition of grain and grain boundary is different; The grains are dispersed in matrix with different chemical composition. Due to the structural specificity of nano metallic materials, they have many outstanding properties that traditional materials can not match, such as high strength, high resistivity and good plastic deformation ability. The preparation methods of nano metallic materials include physical, chemical and mechanical methods. These methods can be roughly divided into two categories: "two-step method" and "one-step method". The two-step method is the densification of isolated metal nanoparticle prepared in advance through subsequent interphase or sintering, including physical vapor deposition, chemical vapor deposition, microwave plasma, low-pressure flame combustion, thermal decomposition and deposition of solutions, etc. The physical vapor deposition method is most representative of the "inert gas condensation method". The "one-step method" is to directly prepare nano metallic materials from the precursor as the parent materials through the introduction and effect of external energy? Including amorphous alloy crystallization method, controlled rapid solidification method, etc.

explanation_cn: 是指在基底上有序排列的纳米结构，如碳纳米管阵列。该阵列具有独特的物理特性，如场发射低开启电压、各向异性等。
explanation_en: Refers to nanostructures arranged in an orderly manner on a substrate, such as carbon nanotube arrays. This array has unique physical characteristics, such as low field emission on voltage, anisotropy, etc.

explanation_cn: 能够抑制或者延缓燃烧过程而自身并不容易燃烧的纳米材料。这些材料可以根据其维度被分类为三种类型：一维纳米材料，如碳纳米管和各种纳米晶须，例如镁盐和硫酸钙晶须。二维纳米材料，如层状黏土，包括蒙脱土（montmorillonite;MMT）、高岭土（kaolinite）、氧化石墨、层状双金属氢氧化物（layereddoublehydroxides;LDH）等。零维纳米材料，包括纳米氢氧化铝、氢氧化镁、二氧化钛、二氧化硅、聚合倍半硅氧烷（POSS）、富勒烯（C60）等。与传统的阻燃材料相比，纳米阻燃材料的显著特点在于只需添加极少量（<5%）的纳米阻燃材料即可显著提高材料的力学性能。而通常情况下，常规阻燃材料的添加会显著降低材料的力学性能。
explanation_en: Nanomaterials that can inhibit or delay the combustion process but are not easy to combustion themselves. These materials can be classified into three types according to their dimensions: one-dimensional nanomaterials, such as carbon nanotube and various nano crystal whisker, such as magnesium salt and calcium sulfate crystal whisker. Two dimensional nano materials, such as layered clay, including montmorillonite (MMT), kaolinite (Kaolinite), graphite oxide, layered double hydroxides (LDH), etc. Zero dimensional nano materials, including nano aluminum hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide, titanium dioxide, silicon dioxide, polymerization silsesquioxane (POSS), fullerene (C60), etc. Compared with the traditional flame retardant materials, the remarkable feature of flame resistant nanomaterials is that only a small amount (<5%) of flame resistant nanomaterials can significantly improve the mechanical properties of materials. In general, the addition of conventional flame retardant materials will significantly reduce the mechanical properties of materials.

explanation_cn: 基于纳米科技，通过将纳米粉体加入或制备纳米级颗粒，对现有陶瓷材料进行改性，使晶粒、晶界以及它们之间的结合都达到纳米尺度（1到100纳米）的陶瓷。通过控制纳米陶瓷相粒子的各种尺寸效应、表（界）面效应、微观结构以及工艺条件，改善其压电性能、介电性能和力学性能，并开发出其特殊的纳米性能，使陶瓷材料的强度、韧性和超塑性显著提高。这一技术填补了传统陶瓷的许多不足之处，对材料的力学、电学、热学、磁学、光学等性能产生重要影响，并可广泛应用于家电、测试仪器、医疗卫生（新型多功能医用传感器）、交通、能源、预警监测等领域。
explanation_en: Based on nanotechnology, the existing ceramics materials are modified by adding nanosized powder or preparing nano particles, so that the grains, grain boundary and the combination between them all reach nano scale (1 to 100 nm) ceramics. By controlling various size effects, surface (interface) effects, microstructure and process conditions of nano ceramics phase particles, their piezoelectric properties, dielectric properties and mechanical properties are improved, and their special nano properties are developed, so that the strength, toughness and superplasticity of ceramics materials are significantly improved. This technology fills in many shortcomings of traditional ceramics, has an important impact on the mechanical, electrical, thermal, magnetic, optical and other properties of materials, and can be widely used in home appliances, testing instruments, medical health (new multi-function medical sensors), transportation, energy, early warning and monitoring and other fields.

explanation_cn: 由包含至少一种组元为纳米尺度颗粒组成的陶瓷复合材料。纳米陶瓷复合材料可分为晶内型（纳米颗粒分布在基体晶粒之内）、晶界型（纳米颗粒分布在基体晶粒的界面）、混合型（纳米颗粒分布于基体晶粒之内、分布于基体晶粒界面，或者有两种或多种纳米颗粒组元混合分布）。由于纳米尺寸的晶粒具有很大的表面能，使一般不易固溶、混溶的组分能够在纳米尺寸下合适分布，从而形成新型的纳米陶瓷复合材料。由于存在纳米尺寸效应，这些材料有望明显改善复合材料的强度、韧性等性能，形成性能优异的新一代功能复合材料。目前，制备纳米陶瓷复合材料的难点主要在于如何防止烧结过程中纳米颗粒尺寸的增长，这是当前研究的重点。
explanation_en: The ceramics composite materials is composed of at least one component of nanometer sized particles. Nanometer ceramic composite can be divided into intragranular type (nanoparticle are distributed in the matrix grains), grain boundary type (nanoparticle are distributed in the matrix grain interface), mixed type (nanoparticle are distributed in the matrix grains, distributed in the matrix grain interface, or two or more nanoparticle components are mixed). Due to the large surface energy of nanocrystalline grains, the components that are not easy to be dissolved and miscible can be properly distributed under the nanometer size, thus forming a new type of nanometer ceramic composite. Due to the nano size effect, these materials are expected to significantly improve the strength, toughness and other properties of composite materials, forming a new generation of functional composite materials with excellent performance. At present, the difficulty of preparing nanometer ceramic composite mainly lies in how to prevent the growth of nanoparticle in the sintering process, which is the focus of current research.

explanation_cn: 非晶态纳米材料，又称非晶纳米材料，是一种指尺寸在1到100纳米范围内，具有短程（亚纳米尺度）有序和长程无序微观结构的材料。通常，这个术语特指金属或金属合金基的非晶态纳米材料。对于聚合物和非金属材料，通常指的是在纳米尺度上呈无定形态的材料。非晶态纳米材料的制备原理主要是控制生成这些纳米材料的热力学条件，以使其迅速凝固在非平衡位置，从而减小材料的结晶活化能。这可以通过不同方法来实现，包括使用球磨等方法来增加晶体缺陷，使用物理气相沉积方法将材料沉积在高热导率的基板上，或者使用化学方法在成核和生长过程中引入抑制晶体有序生长的元素。与大于5纳米的晶态纳米材料相比，非晶态纳米材料通常在X射线衍射谱中表现出宽而模糊的峰，其原子排列在高分辨电子显微镜下通常表现出短程有序和长程无序。非晶态纳米材料具有独特的性质和应用潜力。它们不仅表现出纳米尺度下的尺寸效应，还具有非晶态材料的特性。由于其成分和主要元素之间的协同作用，它们的性能独特，如更高的热稳定性、更优异的软磁性能、更高的催化活性和生物活性等。此外，非晶态纳米材料通常具有更多的缺陷和活性点，使它们在催化和生物应用等领域表现出更高的性能。对于需要通过缺陷来调节性能的半导体材料，非晶态纳米材料可以充分利用其缺陷，以获得独特的光电性能。
explanation_en: Amorphous nanomaterials, also known as amorphous nanomaterials, are materials with short range (sub nanometer scale) ordered and long range disordered microstructures in the size range of 1 to 100 nanometers. Generally, the term refers specifically to amorphous nanomaterials based on metals or metal alloy. For polymer and non-metallic materials, it usually refers to materials that are amorphous in nanoscale. The preparation principle of amorphous nanomaterials is mainly to control the thermodynamics conditions for the formation of these nanomaterials, so that they can rapidly solidify in the non-equilibrium position, thus reducing the crystallization activation or conditioning energy of materials. This can be achieved by different methods, including using ball milling and other methods to increase crystal defect, using physical vapor deposition to deposit materials on a substrate with high thermal conductivity, or using chemical methods to introduce elements that inhibit the orderly growth of crystal during nucleation and growth. Compared with crystalline nanomaterials larger than 5 nm, amorphous nanomaterials usually show wide and fuzzy peaks in the X-ray diffraction spectrum, and their atoms usually show short range order and long range disorder under the high-resolution electron microscope. Amorphous nanomaterials have unique properties and potential applications. They not only show the size effect in nanometer scale, but also have the characteristics of amorphous materials. Due to the synergistic effect between its components and main elements, they have unique properties, such as higher thermal stability, better soft magnetic properties, higher catalytic activity and bioactivity. In addition, amorphous nanomaterials usually have more defects and active points, which enable them to show higher performance in catalytic and biological applications. For semiconductor materials whose performance needs to be adjusted by defects, amorphous nanomaterials can make full use of their defects to obtain unique photoelectric properties.

explanation_cn: 是指三维尺寸均在纳米尺度的物质颗粒.可以是单晶、多晶、非晶态或准晶结构，形状并不局限在球形。随着纳米科技发展，纳米颗粒的生物安全性及在大气污染问题上的作用受到广泛关注。
explanation_en: It refers to the material particles whose three-dimensional dimensions are all in nanometer scale. It can be single crystal, polycrystal, amorphous or quasicrystal structure, and its shape is not limited to spherical. With the development of nanotechnology, the biosafety of nanoparticle and their role in air pollution have attracted extensive attention.

explanation_cn: 是指热塑性塑料产品在热影响下的长度变化百分数，反映了沿纵向塑性变化的稳定性能。依据《(JBT6671-2001热塑性塑料管材纵向回缩率的测定》做塑料管材纵向回缩率测定。测试方式有液浴试验和烘箱试验两种,液浴试验是指将规定长度的试样在（150±2)°C的惰性液体中浸泡30min,在（23士2)℃条件下测定浸泡前后标线间距离：烘箱试验是将规定长度的试样，置于（150±2)℃的烘箱中，保持120min,在（23±2)℃下测定试样置入烘箱前后的标线间距离。最终回缩率是按对原始长度的长度变化百分数汁算的。它的测定对提高产品在使用过程中对气温的变化、日照和其他热源影响的承受能力，以及提高产品的使用年限都有着重要的意义。
explanation_en: It refers to the percentage of length change of thermoplastic plastics products under the influence of heat, reflecting the stability of plastic changes along the longitudinal direction. According to (JBT6671-2001 Determination of Longitudinal Shrinkage of Thermoplastic plastics tube), the longitudinal shrinkage of plastics tube is measured. The test methods include liquid bath test and oven test. The liquid bath test refers to immersing a sample of specified length in an inert liquid at (150 ± 2) ° C for 30min, and measuring the distance between the marks before and after immersion at (23 ± 2) ° C: the oven test is to place the sample of specified length in an oven at (150 ± 2) ° C for 120min, Measure the distance between the markings before and after placing the sample in the oven at (23 ± 2) ℃. The final retraction rate is calculated as a percentage change in length from the original length. Its measurement is of great significance in improving the product's ability to withstand changes in temperature, sunlight, and other heat sources during use, as well as in extending the product's lifespan.

explanation_cn: 由植物纤维原料通过化学或机械方法制得的用于造纸的纤维状物质。由木材制得的祢为木浆，由竹材制成的称为竹浆。
explanation_en: A fibrous substance made from plant fiber raw materials by chemical or mechanical methods and used for papermaking. Wood pulp is made from wood, and bamboo pulp is made from bamboo.

explanation_cn: 纸电容器是电容器的主要类别之一，使用较早，用量很大。电容器纸以硫酸故木质纤维素为主要原料经抄纸、烘干、压光等工艺制成。要求质地密实厚薄均匀。目前国内可生产纸同国际水平相当。电容器纸的电阻率与其中所含导体、半导休及杂质有关，当外加电压低于纸的电离电压时，电阻率与电压无关。当超过电离电压以后，纸的电导率则突然陡增，电离电压大致在1.5-20kV范围，电容器纸的抗电强度则与其密度相关;当密度增大后，抗电强度增加。由于电容器纸的结构十分不均匀，且受含杂影响较大，故实际抗电强度较理论值为低，其分散性常用击穿概率值描述。在实用中，为了避免这种偶发因素，常在电介质总厚度不变的条件下采用多层叠合达到更佳效果。
explanation_en: Paper capacitors are one of the main categories of capacitors, used earlier and in large quantities. Capacitor tissue paper is made from sulfuric acid and wood cellulose through papermaking, drying, calendering and other processes. Require a dense and uniform texture. At present, the domestic production of paper is comparable to the international level. The resistivity of capacitor tissue paper is related to the conductor, semi conductivity and impurities contained in it. When the applied voltage is lower than the ionization voltage of the paper, the resistivity is independent of the voltage. When the ionization voltage is exceeded, the electric conductivity of paper suddenly increases, the ionization voltage is about 1.5-20kV, and the dielectric strength of capacitor tissue paper is related to its density; When the density increases, the dielectric strength increases. Because the structure of capacitor tissue paper is very uneven and is greatly affected by impurities, the actual dielectric strength is lower than the theoretical value, and its dispersion is usually described by the breakdown probability value. In practice, in order to avoid this accidental factor, multilayer superposition is often used to achieve better results under the condition that the total thickness of dielectric is constant.

explanation_cn: 指通过纺织，可加工为织物的纤维，且具有一定的长度、细度、弹性、断裂强度和伸长等良好物理性能和化学性能，满足织物对纤维的要求，且能够承受纺织加工过程中施加在纤维上的力的纤维。纺织纤维种类繁多，可以分为天然纤维（如棉、麻）、化学纤维（如聚酯纤维、聚酰胺纤维、聚丙烯腈纤维、再牛纤维素纤维等）、金属纤维(如不锈钢纤维、铜纤维、金纤维等）、无机纤维（如石棉、玻璃纤维、玄武岩纤维）等
explanation_en: It refers to the fiber that can be processed into fabric through weaving, and has good physical and chemical properties such as certain length, fineness, elasticity, fracture strength and elongation, meets the requirements of fabric for fiber, and can withstand the force exerted on fiber during textile processing. There are many kinds of textile fiber, which can be divided into natural fiber (such as cotton and hemp), man-made fiber (such as polyester fiber fiber, polyamide fiber, polyacrylonitrile fiber, Zeniu cellulose fiber, etc.), metal fibers (such as stainless steel fiber, copper fiber, gold fiber, etc.), inorganic fibers (such as asbestos, glass fiber, basalt fiber, etc

explanation_cn: 高分子链的重复单元在一个连续的长度上键接而成的聚合物。但这种只从外形分类是不很严格的，例如，具短支链结构的单体如a-烯烃、异丁烯、苯乙烯等的聚合物虽有短支链但仍应属线型聚合物，因为它们都具有线型聚合物的某些特征，如能溶解、熔融等;都有很大的内旋转自由度;具有不同的柔性（从柔性到刚性），并且由于热运动的结果而有无数构象（conformation)。线型聚合物的分子链间没有化学键结合，在受热或受力下分子间可以相对移动（流动），因此易于加工成型。支化聚合物的化学性质与线型分子相似，但物理、力学性能却有区別。以聚乙烯为例，有支化的聚乙烯（低密度）与无支化、线型的聚乙烯（高密度）在密度、熔点、硬度、流动性等方面均不一样。一般说，线型聚合物与部分支链聚合物均具有较好的流变性，易于加工。
explanation_en: A polymer in which the repeating units of a macromolecule chain are bonded in a continuous length. However, it is not very strict to classify this kind of monomer only from its appearance. For example, polymer with short branched chains, such as a-olefin, isobutene, styrene, etc., should still belong to linear polymer although they have short branched chains, because they all have some characteristics of linear polymer, such as being able to dissolve, melt, etc; Both have large internal rotation degree of freedom; It has different flexibility (from flexibility to rigidity) and countless conformations due to the result of thermal motion. There is no chemical bond between the molecular chains of linear polymer, and the molecules can move (flow) relatively under heat or force, so it is easy to process and shape. The chemical properties of branched polymer are similar to linear molecules, but their physical and mechanical properties are different. Taking polyethylene as an example, branched polyethylene (low density) is different from unbranched, linear polyethylene (high density) in density, melting point, hardness, flow ability, etc. Generally speaking, linear polymer and some branched chain polymer have good rheological properties and are easy to process.

explanation_cn: 由服从胡克定律的理想固体弹性和服从牛顿流动定律的理想流体黏性组合而成的一类黏弹性。其应力-应变-速率本构方程为线性微分方程。
explanation_en: It is a kind of viscoelasticity composed of ideal solid elasticity obeying Hooke's law and ideal fluid viscosity obeying Newton's law of flow. The stress-strain rate constitutive equation is a linear differential equation.

explanation_cn: 热轧成最小直径为5mm的圆形或其他简单断面形状的成卷钢材及铜、铝等有色金属材的加工工艺过程。线材断面形状主要为圆形，少量为方形、六角形等，一般直径为5.5-13mm。的特点是总伸长率大，轧制速度高(高线生产可达80-160m/s)，轧件断面小导致温降较快。用于轧制线材的坯料有轧制坯和连铸坯两种，坯料断面尺寸一般为（80mmX80mm)-（130mmX130mm)，长度为3-22m。坯料尺寸主要根据乳机的形式、最高轧制速度、每条轧线机架总数和采用的平均延伸系数来确定。线材轧机多为二辊式，布置形式很多，主要有四种：①横列式，机架数一般不超过15架，布置成两列或多列式，以穿梭和活套方式轧制;横列式劳动强度大，轧件头尾温差大，产品质量低。但投资少，适合多品种小批量生产;②复二辊式，粗轧为横列式或连续式，而中轧和精轧多为复二辊式，采用多线（2-5线）轧制;生产能力比横列式大;③连续式，一般以串列式布置，粗轧和中轧机组采用平辊同时轧四根钢，而精轧机组采用平立辊单线、平辊多线或多列控制活套单线轧制;④高速无扭整体式，摩根式45°无扭整体机座的高速线材轧机为二辊式，辊轴中心线与水平成45°角.相邻轧辊轴线成90°角交替配置，轧制中轧件无扭转，轧机集体传动：精轧机组后，布置有控制冷却线;整体机座由8-10个辊组组成，采用悬臂式小直径碳化钨轧辊：由于高速变形，精轧时不降温，反可升温，头尾温差小，既可加大坯料断面尺寸和单重，又可提高线材尺寸精度、表面质量和轧机生产能力，是目前线材轧制的主要方式。
explanation_en: The processing process of hot-rolled rolled steel product into round or other simple sectional shapes with a minimum diameter of 5mm and non-ferrous metal materials such as copper and aluminum. The section shape of wire rod is mainly circular, and a few are square, hexagonal, etc., with a general diameter of 5.5-13mm. It is characterized by large total elongation, high rolling speed (high-speed wire production can reach 80-160m/s), small section of rolled piece and rapid temperature drop. The billets used for rolling wire rod include rolling billets and continuous casting billets. The section size of billets is generally (80mmX80mm) - (130mmX130mm), and the length is 3-22m. The billet size is mainly determined according to the type of dairy machine, the maximum rolling speed, the total number of stands for each rolling line and the average elongation coefficient adopted. Most of the wire rod rolling mill are two high, and there are many layout forms, mainly including four types: ① horizontal type, the number of stands is generally not more than 15, arranged in two or more rows, and rolling by shuttle and looper; The horizontal type has high labor intensity, large temperature difference between the head and tail of the rolled piece, and low product quality. But with low investment, it is suitable for multi variety and small batch production; ② Double two roll type, rough rolling is horizontal or continuous, while medium rolling and finish rolling are mostly double two roll type, using multi line (2-5 lines) rolling; The production capacity is greater than that of the horizontal type; ③ Continuous, generally in tandem arrangement, rough rolling and intermediate rolling units use flat rolls to roll four steel at the same time, while finishing rolling units use flat vertical roll single line, flat roll multi line or multi row control looper single line rolling; ④ High speed torsion free integral type, Morgan type 45 ° torsion free integral stand high-speed wire rod rolling mill is a two roll type, the roll axis center line forms a 45 ° angle with the horizontal. The adjacent roll axis forms a 90 ° angle alternately, the rolled piece is not twisted in rolling, and the rolling mill is collectively driven: a control cooling line is arranged behind the finish rolling unit; The overall stand is composed of 8-10 roll groups, and cantilever type small diameter carbonization roll is used: due to high-speed deformation, the temperature can be raised instead of being lowered during finish rolling, and the temperature difference between head and tail is small, which can not only increase the sectional size and unit weight of billet, but also improve the dimensional accuracy, surface quality and rolling mill production capacity of wire rod. It is the main way of wire rolling at present.

explanation_cn: 在非理想第二类超导体中，磁通量子线与超导体内部线缺陷（如：线位错和第二相纳米线等）之间的相互作用，导致磁通量子线的运动受到阻碍，称为线钉扎。
explanation_en: In the non ideal type II superconductor, the interaction between the magnetic flux quantum wire and the internal wire defects of the superconductor (such as: line dislocation and second phase nanowires, etc.) causes the movement of the magnetic flux quantum wire to be blocked, which is called wire pinning.

explanation_cn: 有序合金中，合金成分偏离化学比时所引起的空位浓度增加在有序合金如AlCo、AlFe、AlNi、AlPd、CoGa、GaNi、InPd合金中，若过渡金属（A)占据α亚点阵，B组元占据β亚点阵。由于B原子占据α亚点阵引起的能量较高，所以B原子占据α亚点阵Bα是不可能的，但A原子占据β亚点阵Aβ是可能的。对提高化学比富A合金，点缺陷主要是Aβ，对富B合金，带来的点缺陷为在α亚点阵形成过多的空位，这种超越热平衡的空位点缺陷为组元空位。它对合金的扩散、相变过程有着重要影响。
explanation_en: In ordered alloy, the increase of vacancy concentration caused by the deviation of alloy composition from chemical ratio In ordered alloy such as AlCo, AlFe, AlNi, AlPd, CoGa, GaNi, InPd alloy, if transition metal (A) occupies α Sub lattice, occupied by B-group elements β Sublattice. Due to the occupation of B atoms α The energy caused by the sub lattice is relatively high, so B atoms occupy α Sublattice B α It's impossible, but the A atom occupies β Sublattice A β It's possible. For the A rich alloy with higher chemical ratio, the point defect is mainly A β， For B rich alloy, the point defects are α The sublattice forms too many vacancy, and this vacancy point defect that exceeds the thermal balance is constitutional vacancy. It has an important influence on the diffusion and phase transformation of alloy.

explanation_cn: 采用并行合成和高通量表征的研究策略，能以有限的步骤在短时间内合成出成百上万的材料样品，形成材料样品库，并快速表征样品库内每个材料的性质，从中筛选出性能突出的线索材料（又称先导化合物）。围绕着线索材料，改变合成条件，进行细致的优化，最终可筛选出功能突出的新材料。
explanation_en: The research strategy of parallel synthesis and high-throughput characterization can synthesize millions of materials samples in a short time with limited steps, form a materials sample library, quickly characterize the properties of each materials in the sample library, and screen out clue materials (also called lead compounds) with outstanding performance. Focusing on the clue materials, change the synthesis conditions and carry out careful optimization, so as to finally screen out new materials with outstanding functions.

explanation_cn: 利用烧结的收缩使两个接触在一起的坯件紧密的配合，并通过烧结扩散烧结在一起。这样所得到的不是简单的配合件，而是有着较高结合强度的整体件。不但可以生产形状复杂的零件，而且可以赋予粉来冶金零件新的特性，将不同部位功能的复合件烧结在
explanation_en: The shrinkage of sintering is used to make the two blanks in contact closely fit, and sintering diffusion is used to sintering together. The result is not a simple mating component, but a whole component with high bonding strength. It can not only produce parts with complex shapes, but also endow powder metallurgy parts with new characteristics, and sintering composite parts with different functions in different parts

explanation_cn: 又称组分过冷。晶体生长过程中同液界面前沿液相因组成变化而产生过冷的现象。对于合金凝固的情况，即使在液/固界面前沿的液体中具有正的温度梯度的情况下仍然可能出现过冷状态，其实质是由于在选择性结晶的过程中，凝固前沿的液体中产生了具有一定浓度梯度的溶质富集层，相应地出现了熔点的梯度。实际的熔点与实际的温度相比，如果出现过冷，则称为组成过冷。
explanation_en: Also called component subcooling. In the process of crystal growth, the liquid phase at the front of the same liquid interface is supercooled due to the composition change. In the case of alloy solidification, supercooling may still occur even if there is a positive temperature gradient in the liquid at the front of the liquid/solid interface. The essence is that in the process of selective crystallization, a solution enrichment layer with a certain concentration gradient is generated in the liquid at the front of solidification, and a melting point gradient correspondingly appears. If the actual melting point is compared with the actual temperature, it is called constitution undercooling.

explanation_cn: 是以具有特殊生物功能或含有某种生物功能的生物活性物的动植物组织（器官）为敏感元件，通过光、电磁，电化学和力等检测技术，将生物组织对外界刺激产生的影响转换成电信号，从而获取外部刺激信息(种类和浓度）的装置。由于许多动植物组织中含有某些特定的酶类，利用这些组织制备的生物传感器，其工作原理类似于酶传感器。比如，犬具有很高的嗅觉，某些昆虫具有很高的气味敏感力，可以利用这种组织制出生物电子舌和电子鼻。
explanation_en: It is a device that uses animal and plant tissues (organs) with special biological functions or containing bioactive substances with certain biological functions as sensitive elements, and converts the influence of biological tissues on external irritation into electrical signals through optical, electromagnetic, electrochemical and force detection technologies, so as to obtain external irritation information (type and concentration). Because many animal and plant tissues contain some specific enzymes, the biosensor prepared from these tissues works similarly to the enzyme sensor. For example, dogs have a very high sense of smell, and some insects have a very high smell sensitivity. This tissue can be used to make biological electronic tongue and electronic nose.

explanation_cn: 是以细胞生物学和材料工程学相结合进行体外或体内构建组织或器官的一门新型学科。其基本原理是应用工程和生命科学的原理和方法认识哺乳动物的正常和病态组织的结构功能关系，研制用于修复、保持和增进组织功能的生物修复体。基本途径是从机体获得少量活组织，将功能细胞从组织中分离出来并在体外进行培养扩增，然后与三维支架材料复合，植入体内病变或缺损部位，支架在体内逐渐被降解和吸收，植入的细胞在体内增殖和分泌细胞外基质，最后形成所需的组织或器官，以达到创伤修复和功能重建的目的。有三个基本要素：支架、细胞和信号系统。被认为是继细胞生物学与分子生物学之后，生命科学发展史上又一新的里程碑，也是一场深远的医学革命。组织工程的出现，意味着外科学的发展从组织的切除、修补和替代进入"再生医学"的新阶段，可望实现病变和缺损组织的再生修复。
explanation_en: It is a new discipline combining cell biology and materials engineering to construct tissues or organs in vitro or in vivo. Its basic principle is to apply the principles and methods of engineering and life science to understand the structure function relationship between normal and diseased tissues of mammals, and to develop biological prosthesis for repairing, maintaining and improving tissue functions. The basic approach is to obtain a small amount of living tissue from the body, isolate functional cells from the tissue, and culture and expand them in vitro, and then combine them with three-dimensional stem materials composition to implantation into the lesion or defect in the body. The stem is gradually degradation and absorbed in the body, and the implantation cells proliferate and secrete extracellular matrix in the body, finally forming the required tissues or organs to achieve the purpose of wound repair and functional reconstruction. There are three basic elements: stem, cell and signal system. It is considered a new milestone in the history of life science development, following cell biology and molecular biology, and also a profound medical revolution. The emergence of tissue engineering means that the development of surgery has entered a new stage of "regenerative medicine" from tissue resection, repair and replacement, which is expected to realize the regeneration and repair of diseased and defective tissues.

explanation_cn: 在组织工程构建中为细胞植入或接种提供支持从而形成三维组织的结构。无论是体内还是体外，支架的结构对重塑体内环境进而影响细胞自身的微环境都是至关重要的。为了达到组织重建的目的，支架必须满足一些特定的要求。首先，支架必须具有高孔隙率以及足够的孔隙大小以促进细胞的接种，同时利于细胞及营养物质在整个支架结构中的扩散。其次，支架的可生物降解性也是一个至关重要的因素，理想的支架不应通过额外的手术取出，而是能在体内逐渐降解并被周围组织吸收，同时支架降解的速度还应该与组织形成的速度相一致，这就意味着种子细胞在形成组织结构的过程中，支架能够保持其结构完整性，而当新的组织结构形成后，支架将降解，新形成的组织将代替原支架提供力学支撑。随着材料组织诱导作用的提出，还希望具有与生物体相互作用实现诱导组织再生的生物功能。
explanation_en: Provide support for cell implantation or inoculation in tissue engineering construction to form three-dimensional tissue structure. Whether in vivo or in vitro, the structure of stem is crucial to reshape the internal environment and thus affect the microenvironment of cells themselves. In order to achieve the purpose of tissue reconstruction, stem must meet some specific requirements. First of all, the stem must have high porosity and sufficient pore size to promote cell inoculation, while facilitating the diffusion of cells and nutrients in the entire stem structure. Secondly, the biological degradation of stem is also a crucial factor. The ideal stem should not be taken out by additional surgery, but can gradually degradation in the body and be absorbed by surrounding tissues. At the same time, the speed of degradation of stem should also be consistent with the speed of tissue formation, which means that the stem can maintain its structural integrity during the formation of tissue structure of seed cells. When a new tissue structure is formed, The stem will be degradation, and the newly formed tissue will replace the original stem to provide mechanical support. With the introduction of tissue induction of materials, it is hoped that they can interact with organisms to achieve the biological function of inducing tissue regeneration.

explanation_cn: 生物相容性的一部分，主要包括：①植入材料与机体组织之间相互作用共存的能力;②器官、组织移植中不同组织共存的能力。
explanation_en: Part of biocompatibility, mainly including: ① the ability of interaction and coexistence between implantation materials and body tissues; ② The ability of different tissues to coexist in organ and tissue transplantation.

explanation_cn: 某种物质或材料具有调控并促进多分化潜能（干）细胞定向分化并形成相应组织的能力。
explanation_en: A certain substance or materials has the ability to regulate and promote the directional differentiation of pluripotent (stem) cells and form corresponding tissues.

explanation_cn: 组织重建是对现有组织的重组或修复。这个过程可能会改变组织的特征（如血管重建）或者会影响组织的动态平衡（如骨重建）。组织修复是用新的健康细胞代替身体组织中的死细胞或受到损伤的细胞。为了维持生命和机体所必需的功能，身体具备一定的自我修复的能力，如通常皮肤损伤不需要借助医疗便可以自愈。再生是指新生组织完全修复受损组织使组织恢复到正常状态，而替代是指修复过程中结缔组织的形成.通常称之为疤痕。
explanation_en: Tissue reconstruction is the reorganization or repair of existing tissues. This process may alter the characteristics of the tissue (such as vascular reconstruction) or affect the dynamic balance of the tissue (such as bone reconstruction). Tissue repair involves replacing dead or damaged cells in body tissue with new healthy cells. In order to maintain life and the necessary functions of the body, the body has a certain ability to self repair, such as skin damage that usually can self heal without the need for medical treatment. Regeneration refers to the complete repair of damaged tissue by new tissue to restore it to its normal state, while substitution refers to the formation of connective tissue during the repair process, commonly referred to as scarring.

explanation_cn: 能够将组织黏合在一起，具有帮助伤口愈合、止血等作用的材料。理想的应具备以下性质：安全，具有良好的生物相容性，不妨碍人体组织的自身愈合，达到使用效果后能被降解、吸收、代谢，在有血液和组织液的条件下可以使用，在常温、常压下可以实现快速黏合，具有良好的黏合强度及一定的弹性和韧性。组织黏合剂按材料性质可分为化学黏合剂和生物黏合剂。化学黏合剂如氰基丙烯酸酯类黏合剂、琥珀酰亚胺酯类黏合剂等;生物黏合剂如纤维蛋白黏合剂、贻贝黏蛋白黏合剂等，通常生物相容性更好，因此日益受到人们的重视。
explanation_en: It is a materials that can bind tissues together and has the functions of helping wound healing, hemostasis, etc. Ideally, it should have the following properties: safe, with good biocompatibility, without hindering the self healing of human tissues, and can be degradation, absorbed, and metabolized after reaching the use effect. It can be used under the conditions of blood and tissue fluid, and can achieve rapid adhesion at normal temperature and pressure. It has good adhesion strength and certain elasticity and toughness. Tissue adhesive can be divided into chemical adhesive and biological adhesive according to materials properties. Chemical adhesive, such as cyanoacrylate adhesive, succinimide ester adhesive, etc; Biological adhesive, such as fibrin adhesive, mussel adhesive, etc., usually have better biocompatibility, so they are increasingly valued.

explanation_cn: 一种浅色具全晶质细粒结构的酸性火成岩。主要矿物为长石和石英。黑云母、角闪石、辉石的含量很少。多呈脉状产出，最常见类型有花岗、辉长、闪长、正长细晶岩、斜长细晶岩和歪长细晶岩等。细晶岩最主要的结构特点是全晶质细粒结构、矿物颗粒大小均匀，块状构造。与有关的矿产是硫化矿脉和铌钽矿床。新鲜的也可作为建筑装饰材料。
explanation_en: A light colored acidic igneous rock with a fully crystalline fine-grained structure. The main minerals are feldspar and quartze. The content of biotite, amphibole and pyroxene is small. Most occur in vein shape, and the most common types are granite, gabbro, diorite, syenite aplite, plagioclase aplite and plagioclase aplite. The main structural characteristics of aplite are full crystalline fine grain structure, uniform mineral particle size, and massive structure. Related minerals are vulcanization veins and niobium tantalum deposits. Fresh can also be used as building decoration materials.

explanation_cn: 碳化物平均晶粒度在0.6-1.00μm范围内的硬质合金。具有硬度高，耐磨性好的特点。用于磨损高的零件以及刀具制作。
explanation_en: The average grain size of carbide is 0.6-1.00 μ Hardmetal within the range of m. It has the characteristics of high hardness and good wear resistance. It is used for making parts with high wear and tools.

explanation_cn: 采用细晶铸造工艺，使铸造高温合金的晶粒尺寸大幅度减小，晶界面积增大，枝晶尺寸和γ’相尺寸也更加细化,因而在中、低温条件下拉伸性能和持久性能明显改善，疲劳性能大幅度提高。细晶铸造工艺主要有三种，即热控法、化学法和机械法。采用细晶铸造工艺使零件整体晶粒细化，特别适于制作工作温度较低的低压涡轮叶片和导向叶片以及小型发动机的整铸祸轮。
explanation_en: The use of fine grain foundry technology has greatly reduced the grain size of raw superalloy, increased the area of grain boundary γ’ The phase size is also more refined, so the tensile properties and endurance properties are significantly improved at medium and low temperatures, and the fatigue properties are significantly improved. There are three main fine grain foundry processes, namely, thermal control method, chemical method and mechanical method. The fine grain foundry process is used to refine the overall grain of the parts, which is especially suitable for making low-pressure turbine blades and guide vanes with low operating temperature and integral casting turbine wheels of small engines.

explanation_cn: 通过快速凝固或大塑性变形，可以获得镁合金材料，其显微组织的晶粒尺寸达到微米级甚至纳米级。细化晶粒的效果在两方面表现出来：首先，它显著增加了晶界的总面积，其次，强化相更加均匀地分布在镁基体上。这增强了细晶强化和弥散沉淀强化效应，显著提高了镁合金的屈服强度。根据Hall-Petch关系，细化晶粒后，镁合金的屈服强度提高的幅度远远大于铝合金。最近开发的含硅和含稀土的快速凝固镁铝锌硅和镁铝锌稀土合金的屈服强度数据比根据Hall-Petch公式计算的数据还要高。这是因为这些合金中硅和稀土元素形成了温度稳定的细小Mg2Si和Mg2RE相，这些相钉扎位错并限制晶界运动。细晶粒还可以引发新的变形机制，改善塑性，包括晶界滑移和新的室温下流变过程。此外，这些合金具有更高的成分均匀性，从而避免了有害的微电池效应，提高了镁合金的耐蚀性能。
explanation_en: Through rapid solidification or large plastic deformation, magnesium alloy materials can be obtained, and the grain size of its microstructure can reach micron or even nanometer level. The effect of grain refinement is shown in two aspects: first, it significantly increases the total area of grain boundary, and second, the strengthened phase is more evenly distributed on the magnesium matrix. This enhances the fine grain strengthening and dispersion precipitation strengthening effects, and significantly improves the yield strength of magnesium alloys. According to the Hall-Petch relationship, the yield strength of magnesium alloys is much higher than that of aluminum alloys after grain refinement. The yield strength data of recently developed rapid solidification magnesium aluminum zinc silicon and magnesium aluminum zinc rare earth alloy containing silicon and rare earth are higher than those calculated according to the Hall Petr formula. This is because silicon and rare earth elements in these alloy form fine Mg2Si and Mg2RE phase with stable temperature, and these phase pin dislocations and restrict grain boundary movement. Fine grains can also initiate new deformation mechanisms and improve plasticity, including grain boundary slip and new rheological processes at room temperature. In addition, these alloy have higher composition uniformity, thus avoiding harmful micro battery effects and improving the corrosion resistance of magnesium alloy.

explanation_cn: 皮张较小、产量较低并以毛面作为主要用途的毛皮产品。包括水貂皮、狐狸皮、水獭皮和黄狼皮等。
explanation_en: Fur products with small fur sheet, low output and wool surface as the main use. Including mink skin, fox skin, otter skin, and yellow wolf skin.

explanation_cn: 一种海底喷发的富含钠长石的基件熔岩。矿物组成复杂且变化大。斑晶矿物主要为钠长石和辉石;基质由绿泥石、阳起石、方解石、绿帘石、葡萄石、石髓以及变化了的玻璃质组成。呈灰绿色、浅绿色，常具细碧结构和枕状构造。常与角斑岩、石英角斑岩一起组成海底火山喷出岩系（习惯称为细碧-角斑岩系）。常伴有黄铁矿、黄铜矿的富集层。
explanation_en: A basic lava rich in sodium feldspar erupted from the sea floor. The mineral composition is complex and varies greatly. Phenocryst minerals are mainly sodium feldspar and pyroxene; The matrix is composed of chlorite, actinolite, caldte, epidote, grape stone, chalcedony and changed glassy substance. It is grayish green and light green, often with a fine blue structure and pillow shaped structure. It often forms submarine volcanic extrusive rock series (commonly called spilite hornblende porphyry series) with hornblende porphyry and quartz hornblende porphyry. It is often accompanied by rich layers of pyrite and chalcopyrite.

explanation_cn: 只能用光学显微镜观察粒度大小。常用雾化法、电解法生产。容易烧结致密化，但成形时流动性差、松装密度低.常采用添加有机黏结剂制成较大的。
explanation_en: Particle size can only be observed using an optical microscope. Commonly used atomization and electrolysis methods for production. It is easy to be densification by sintering, but the flow ability is poor and the apparent density is low during forming. It is often made by adding organic adhesive.

explanation_cn: 是指某种因素（化学因素、物理因素及生物因素）引起细胞溶解（细胞死亡）、抑制细胞牛长或对细胞产生其他不良反应的能力。检测主要是根据细胞膜通透性发生改变来进行的检测，常用以下三种方法：噻唑兰（MTT)法、XTT和乳酸脱氢酶（LDH)法等。定性评价研究生物材料的主要有三种方法。①直接接触法，适用于低密度的材料，如隐形眼镜。测试材料直接放在细胞株上，然后在适当的温度下加热，促使材料中可溶出化学物质扩散到培养基中和细胞接触。②琼脂扩散法，适用于高密度的材料，如人造胶塞。将一块补加营养的琼脂覆盖在培养好的细胞株上，然后把测试材料放在琼脂层上。材料中的溶出化学物质就会扩散到琼脂中并与细胞接触。③最低基础培养基(MEM)洗脱法，此方法用于判断测试材料萃取物，一般会模拟实际使用状态或最坏的情况，用不同的萃取剂和不同条件萃取。然后将萃取物转移至细胞层中并加热，用显微镜观察细胞是否畸形、退化和分解。以上三种方法可以对医用材料的做定性分析。
explanation_en: It refers to the ability of certain factors (chemical, physical, and biological) to cause cell lysis (cell death), inhibit cell growth, or produce other adverse reactions to cells. The detection is mainly based on changes in cell membrane permeability, and the following three methods are commonly used: thiazolium (MTT) method, XTT, and lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) method. There are three main methods for qualitative evaluation of biological materials. ① The direct contact method is applicable to materials with low density, such as contact lenses. The test materials is directly placed on the cell line, and then heated at an appropriate temperature to promote the diffusion of soluble chemicals in the materials to the culture medium and contact the cells. ② Agar diffusion method is applicable to materials with high density, such as artificial rubber plugs. Cover a piece of nutrient supplemented agar on the cultured cell line, and then put the test materials on the agar layer. Dissolved chemicals in materials will diffusion to agar and contact with cells. ③ The minimum basic medium (MEM) elution method, which is used to judge the materials extract, usually simulates the actual use state or the worst case, and extracts with different extractants and different conditions. Then transfer the extract to the cell layer and heat it, and observe under a microscope whether the cells are deformed, degraded, and decomposed. The above three methods can be used for qualitative analysis of medical materials.

explanation_cn: 是以活细胞作为敏感元件，通过换能器将细胞对来自环境的刺激因素（生化因子、光、电磁、热和力学等）所作出的响应转换成可测量的电信号，从而确定刺激细胞的因素的类别和浓度的装置。
explanation_en: It is a device that uses living cells as sensitive elements to convert the responses of cells to environmental irritation factors (biochemical factors, light, electromagnetic, thermal and mechanical factors, etc.) into measurable electrical signals through transducers, so as to determine the category and concentration of factors that stimulate irritation.

explanation_cn: 聚合物在细菌作用下发生的降解。
explanation_en: Degradation of polymer by bacteria.

explanation_cn: 多晶体材料由于受到外界的力、热、电、磁等各种不同条件的影响，或在形成后受到不同的加工工艺的影响，多晶集合体中的各晶粒会沿着某些方向排列，呈现出或多或少的统计不均匀分布，即出现在某些方向上取向概率增大的现象，叫做择优取向，具有这种择优取向的组织结构及规则聚集排列的状态。
explanation_en: Because polycrystalline materials are affected by various external conditions such as force, heat, electricity and magnetism, or by different processing technologies after formation, the grains in the polycrystal aggregate will be arranged in some directions, showing more or less statistical uneven distribution, that is, the probability of orientation increases in some directions, which is called preferred orientation, The organization structure with this preferential orientation and the state of regular aggregation arrangement.

explanation_cn: 含有织构的多晶薄膜。在膜中多晶体中的各晶粒在某些方向聚集排列，出现择优取向。
explanation_en: Polycrystal film with texture. In the film, the grains in the multi crystal gather and arrange in some directions, showing a preferred orientation.

explanation_cn: 又称经验势函数。指计算原子间相互作用势的经验的势函数。
explanation_en: Also called empirical potential function. Refers to the empirical potential function used to calculate the interaction potential between atoms.

explanation_cn: 简称 EET理论。以确定晶体内各类原子的杂化状态为基础描述晶体价电子结构的理论，是1978年由余瑞璜在能带理论、共价键理论、电子浓度理论的基础上，针对现代固体物理，尤其是金属电子理论中的一些矛盾，经过大量的实践归纳提出来的。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as EET theory. The theory of describing the valence electron structure of crystals on the basis of determining the hybrid states of various atoms in crystals was put forward by Yu Ruihuang in 1978 on the basis of energy band theory, covalent bond theory, and electron concentration theory, aiming at some contradictions in modern solid physics, especially in metal electron theory, through a lot of practice.

explanation_cn: 专门用来加工成绒毛状纤维的纸浆。多采用针叶木原料生产，具有较高的松厚度，易起绒.吸收性好。是一种良好的液体吸收材料，用于生产纸尿裤、卫生巾等产品。
explanation_en: Pulp specially used for processing into fluffy fibers. It is mostly produced using coniferous wood raw materials, which have a high loose thickness, easy to pile up, and good absorption. It is a good liquid absorption materials, which is used to produce diapers, sanitary napkins and other products.

explanation_cn: 表面具有均匀绒头的一类皮革产品。包括正绒而革、反绒面革和二层绒面革。合格的绒面革绒毛细致.均匀紧密，不露底，无毛眼和油腻感.柔软、丰满而有弹性.厚薄均匀.软硬基本一致。原料可以是牛皮、猪皮或羊皮。一般用铬鞣法鞣制。可作为服装革、手套革或鞋面革。
explanation_en: A class of leather products with uniform pile on the surface. It includes suede leather, reverse suede leather leather and double suede leather leather. The qualified suede leather is fine, even and compact, without exposing the bottom, hairless eyes and greasy feeling, soft, plump and elasticity, even in thickness, and basically consistent in softness and hardness. The raw materials can be cowhide, pigskin, or sheepskin. Generally, chrome tanning is used for tanning. Can be used as clothing leather, glove leather, or shoe upper leather.

explanation_cn: 橡胶与炭黑共混过程中，部分橡胶分子与炭黑表面的活性基团反应，形成不溶于溶剂的化学键接大分子，这部分橡胶就称为结合胶。
explanation_en: During the polymer blending of rubber and carbon black, some rubber molecules react with the active groups on the surface of carbon black to form solvent insoluble chemically bonded macromolecule. This part of rubber is called boimcl rubber.

explanation_cn: 将粒子（原子、分子或 离子）从自由状态结合为晶体所放出的能量，或将晶体拆散成自由粒子所需能量，又称为晶体的内能，结 合能越大，晶体越稳定。
explanation_en: The energy released by combining particles (atoms, molecules or ions) into crystal from a free state, or the energy required to disassemble crystal into free particles, also known as the internal energy of crystal. The greater the binding energy, the more stable the crystal will be.

explanation_cn: 结晶高分子中晶相部分含量的量度。
explanation_en: Measurement of the content of crystalline phase in crystallinebolymer.

explanation_cn: 物质从液相转变为固相的过程中熔融物或溶液结晶时所放出的热量。 结晶的温度称为凝固点或凝同温度.在一个大气压下物质的结晶热以符号结,表示，单位为J/mol或 W/mol。
explanation_en: The heat released when the molten substance or solution crystallizes in the process of transforming a substance from a liquid phase to a solid phase. The temperature of crystallization is called the freezing point or condensation temperature. The heat of crystallization of a substance at one atmospheric pressure is represented by a symbol, expressed in J/mol or W/mol.

explanation_cn: 釉内含有大量结晶性物质（熔质），在产品烧制过程中，经熔融后处于过饱和状态，在缓冷过程中产生析晶而形成。结晶釉的烧 成温度有高温和低温两种。
explanation_en: The glaze contains a large amount of crystalline substances (molten substances). During the firing process of the product, it is in an oversaturated state after melting, and it is formed by crystallization during the slow cooling process. There are two firing temperatures for crystalline glaze: high temperature and low temperature.

explanation_cn: 可形成长程三维有序晶体的高分子。
explanation_en: Macromolecule that can form long-range three-dimensional ordered crystal.

explanation_cn: 使用目的来区分的其中一大类复合材料（另一类为功 能复合材料），即以承受载荷为主要目的而使用的复合材料。它由能承受载荷的增强体组分与能连接增强体成为整体承载并同时起分配与传递载荷作用的基体组分构成。
explanation_en: One of the major categories of composite materials (the other is functional composite materials) distinguished by the purpose of use is composite materials used for the main purpose of bearing loads. It is composed of the reinforcement component that can bear the load and the matrix component that can connect the reinforcement to become the overall load bearing component that can simultaneously distribute and transmit the load.

explanation_cn: 以强度、硬度、塑性、軔性等力学性质为主要性能指标的工程材料的统称。主要用于制造工程建筑中的构件、机械装备中的支撑件、连接件、运动件、传动件、紧固件、弹性件以及工具、模具等。
explanation_en: Engineering materials with strength, hardness, plasticity, toughness and other mechanical properties as the main performance indicators. It is mainly used to manufacture components in engineering buildings, supports, connectors, moving parts, transmission parts, fasteners, elasticity parts, tools, molds, etc. in mechanical equipment.

explanation_cn: 凡是由于温度、压力、各种物理场等的改变而引起的结构状态的 变化称为结构性相变。
explanation_en: Structural phase transformation refers to the change of structural state caused by the change of temperature, pressure, various physical fields, etc.

explanation_cn: 用于受力结构件的粘接.能承受一定的载荷，在规定的温度下具有 较好的机械强度。通常在使用期内要求粘接接头的承载能力与被粘物本身的强度相当，具有优良的环境耐受能力。
explanation_en: Used for the bonding of load-bearing structural components. It can withstand certain loads and has good mechanical strength at specified temperatures. Usually, the load-bearing capacity of the adhesive joint is required to be equivalent to the strength of the adhesive itself during its service life, and it has excellent environmental resistance.

explanation_cn: 又称高温结构陶瓷或工程陶瓷.指在苛刻场合中作为结构构件发挥优异机械、热、化学等性能的先进陶瓷材料。具有耐高 温、耐冲刷、耐腐蚀、高耐磨、高硬度、高强度、低蠕变速率、生物相容性好等优异性能，可承受极端使役环境。
explanation_en: Also known as high-temperature structural ceramics or engineering ceramics, it refers to advanced ceramics materials that play an excellent role in mechanical, thermal, chemical and other properties as structural components in harsh occasions. It has excellent performance such as high temperature resistance, erosion resistance, corrosion resistance, high wear resistance, high hardness, high strength, low creep rate, good biocompatibility, and can withstand extreme service environment.

explanation_cn: 又称绘图法琅。在金属坯胎上用各色彩釉按绘画艺术加工而成的搪瓷工艺品。
explanation_en: Also known as drawing method. It is a enamel handicraft that is processed on the metal body with colored glazes according to the painting art.

explanation_cn: 指能在硫化温度下游离出活性硫的有机硫化物，常作为不饱和橡胶的交联剂使用。
explanation_en: It refers to the organic sulfide that can separate the active sulfur downstream of the vulcanization temperature, and is often used as the cross linking agent of unsaturated rubber.

explanation_cn: 络合氢化物按照是否包含过渡族元素分为两大类，第一类主要由第一主族或第二主族元素和一种低化合价的过渡族兀素组成。由于其吸放氢所需温度太高、热动力学性能差而难以应用。第二类主要由BH4-、AlH4-等阴离子和轻金属Li+、Na+和Mg2+等阳离子形成稳定的无机盐化合物，氢位于氢化物四面体的角上，而金属位于氢化物中央。该类络合氢化物的储氢性能比较出色，但其最大的弱点是不能从气态吸氢而只能通过溶液进行。络合氢化物储氢一般是不可逆的，但是可以使用催化剂使反应逆转，储氢量可髙达5.5%-18.5%。
explanation_en: Complex hydrides can be divided into two categories according to whether it contains transition group elements. The first category is mainly composed of the first or second main group elements and a transition group element with low valence. Due to the high temperature required for hydrogen absorption and desorption and poor thermodynamic performance, it is difficult to apply. The second type mainly consists of anions such as BH4- and AlH4-, as well as cations such as light metals Li+, Na+, and Mg2+, forming stable inorganic salt compounds. Hydrogen is located at the corners of the tetrahedron of the hydride, while metals are located at the center of the hydride. This kind of complex hydrides has excellent hydrogen storage performance, but its biggest weakness is that it can not absorb hydrogen from the gas state but only through the solution. The hydrogen storage of complex hydrides is generally irreversible, but the reaction can be reversed by using a catalyst, and the amount of hydrogen storage can be as high as 5.5% -18.5%.

explanation_cn: 半导休中杂质原子之间或者杂质与点缺陷之间相互作用形成的缺陷。如直拉硅中氧和空位相互作用形成的VO复合体。
explanation_en: A defect formed by the interaction between impurity atoms or between impurities and point defects in a semi conductor. Such as the VO complex formed by the interaction of oxygen and vacancy in Czochralski silicon.

explanation_cn: 固体推进剂壳体内壁涂覆或黏结的一种保护壳体不被高温火焰烧蚀和防止热散失的材料。固体推进剂的燃烧温度高达2400-3800K,火箭发动机内的工作压力一般在2-30MPa之间，为防止高温高压下燃气对火箭发动机壳体产生的化学烧蚀、气流剥蚀、粒子冲刷等多种有害作用，需要选择具有良好绝热效能的材料敷设于发动机壳体内壁。常用的绝热层由成碳性好的丁腈橡胶、三元乙丙橡胶或硅橡胶与阻燃剂、耐热剂等填料和其他功能组分组成。通常要求绝热层具有较低的烧蚀率、较低的密度、良好的力学性能。
explanation_en: A kind of materials coated or bonded on the inner wall of solid propellant shell to protect the shell from high temperature flame ablation and prevent heat loss. The combustion temperature of solid propellant is as high as 2400-3800K, and the working pressure in the rocket engine is generally between 2-30MPa. In order to prevent the chemical ablation, airflow erosion, particle erosion and other harmful effects of fuel gas on the rocket engine housing under high temperature and pressure, it is necessary to select materials with good thermal insulation efficiency and lay them on the inner wall of the engine housing. The commonly used thermal insulation layer is composed of acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber, ethylene-propylene-diene-terpolymer rubber or silicone rubber with good carbonization, flame retardant or fire retardant, heat-resistant agent and other fillers and other functional components. Generally, the insulation layer is required to have low ablation rate, low density and good mechanical properties.

explanation_cn: 导电功能复合材料，典型材料为塑料和玻璃成分。属于导电功能复合材料的一种。
explanation_en: Electrical conducting functional composite, typical materials are plastics and glass. It belongs to electrical conducting functional composite.

explanation_cn: 研究物质热运动及其热学性质的科学。与热力学不同，它从物质的微观结构出发.用统计方法研究宏观物体的热学性质，是热现象的微观理论。统计物理把物质的宏观性质看成是相应微观量的统计平均值。它的优点是可求出宏观量的微观决定因素，深人理解各种热现象的本质；缺点是近似模型给出的结论只是实际结构的近似代表.这是统计物理的局限性。在实际工作中，往往先由热力学导出普遍特性，再用统计物理作进一步研究，并用热力学结论验证统计物理分析的正确性。统计物理学包括统计热力学（系统平衡态）和非平衡态统计理论以及涨落理论。
explanation_en: The science of studying the thermal motion of matter and its thermal properties. Different from thermodynamics, it starts from the microscopic structure of matter and uses statistical methods to study the thermal properties of macroscopic objects, which is a microscopic theory of thermal phenomena. Statistical physics regards the macroscopic properties of matter as the statistical average of the corresponding microscopic quantities. Its advantage is that it can calculate the micro determining factors of macro quantities, which deepens people's understanding of the essence of various thermal phenomena; The disadvantage is that the conclusions given by the approximate model are only approximate representatives of the actual structure, which is the limitation of statistical physics. In practical work, the general characteristics are usually derived from thermodynamics first, and then statistical physics is used for further research, and thermodynamics conclusions are used to verify the correctness of statistical physics analysis. Statistical physics includes statistical thermodynamics (system equilibrium state), non-equilibrium state statistical theory and fluctuation theory.

explanation_cn: 一种具有丝绢光泽的微晶白云母。呈鳞片状，丝绢光泽，灰色、紫玫瑰色、白色。主要是中低温热液饰变的产物。可用作橡胶、塑料、涂料、油漆、化妆品、颜料、纸张的填料以及陶瓷、保温材料的原料。
explanation_en: A microcrystalline muscovilte with silk luster. It is in the form of scales, with a silky luster, and is gray, purple rose, and white. Mainly products of low-temperature hydrothermal modification. It can be used as the filler of rubber, plastics, coatings, paint, cosmetics, pigment, paper, as well as the raw material of ceramics and thermal insulation materials.

explanation_cn: 又称绢云母片岩。一种以绢云母为主要矿物的变质岩。矿物组成除绢云母外.还有绿泥石、石英、长石等。呈灰色，鳞片变晶结构，片状构造，片理面上呈现丝绢光泽。由泥岩、粉砂岩以及中酸性凝灰质岩石经区域变质作用形成。
explanation_en: It is also called pinal schist. A metamorphic rock with sericite mica as its main mineral. In addition to seridte, chlorite, quartze, feldspar, etc. It is gray, with scale balastic texture, schistose structure, and silk luster on schistosity surface. It is formed by regional metamorphism of mud rock, siltstone and intermediate acid tuffaceous rock.

explanation_cn: 以绢云母作助培剂的"绢云母-石英-高岭土"三组分系统瓷，是我国景德镇、福建等瓷区生产的传统瓷质。烧成范围宽，瓷质洁白、半透明、断面致密、吸水率低，透光度及热稳定好，采用还原焰烧成，瓷胎呈"白中泛青"色调，适合于制造餐具、茶具及各类工艺美术品。
explanation_en: The three component system porcelain of "seridte quartze kaolin" with seridte as a training aid is a traditional porcelain produced in Jingdezhen, Fujian and other porcelain areas in China. The firing range is wide, and the porcelain is pure white, semi transparent, with a dense cross-section, low water absorption, good transparency and thermal stability. It is fired using a reducing flame, and the porcelain body has a "white to blue" color tone, suitable for manufacturing tableware, tea sets, and various arts and crafts.

explanation_cn: 是将热塑性塑料放于液体传热介质中，在一定的负荷和一定的等速升温条件下，试样被1mm2的针头压入1mm时的温度。升温速度通常有50t7h和120°C7h,负荷通常有9.8N和49N。测试仪器主要由等速升温装置、试样支架、油浴、负荷等组成.液体介质要求对试样无影响、冇较好的热传导、合适的黏度，通常使用硅油、液体石蜡、甘油等。试样厚度一般为3?6mm,长和宽至少为10mm。主要用于控制产品质量，也吋作为评价材料耐热性能的一个参数。
explanation_en: It refers to the temperature at which the sample is pressed into 1mm by a 1mm 2 needle under a certain load and constant heating rate when the thermoplastic plastics is placed in the liquid heat transfer medium. The heating rate is usually 50t7h and 120 ° C7h, and the load is usually 9.8N and 49N. The test instrument is mainly composed of constant rate heating device, sample stem, oil bath, load, etc. The liquid medium is required to have no impact on the sample, good heat conduction, and appropriate viscosity. silicone oil, liquid paraffin, glycerin, etc. are usually used. The thickness of the sample is generally 3? 6mm, with a minimum length and width of 10mm. It is mainly used to control product quality, and also as a parameter to evaluate the heat resistance of materials.

explanation_cn: 将一个顶角为136°的正四棱锥体的金刚石压头，用一定的负荷P压人到被测物体的表面.保持一定的时间后，卸去载荷.
explanation_en: Press a diamond indenter with a regular quadrangular cone with a top angle of 136 ° onto the surface of the object to be measured with a certain load P. After holding it for a certain time, remove the load

explanation_cn: 即绿色蓝宝石，参见蓝宝石。
explanation_en: Green sapphire, see sapphire.

explanation_cn: 岛状结构硅酸盐矿物。柱状晶体，柱面上有平行柱体的条纹。依(100)形成聚片双晶。黄绿、绿褐色。Fe3+含量增加，颜色变深呈黑绿色。成分中含锰时颜色呈粉红色。玻璃光泽。平行{O1l}一组完全解理。莫氏硬度6，产于矽卡岩中。在绿片岩中与钠长石、阳起石共生。常为各种火成岩，尤其是基性岩的围岩蚀变产物。色泽美丽者可作宝玉石。
explanation_en: Island structure silicate mineral. Cylindrical crystal with parallel cylinder stripes on the cylinder surface. The polycrystalline twin is formed according to (100). Yellow green, green brown. The Fe3+content increases and the color darkens to a dark green color. When the ingredient contains manganese, the color appears pink. Glass lustre. Parallel {O1l} sets of complete cleavage. Mohs hardness 6, produced in skarn. It coexists with albite and actinolite in green schist. It is often the product of wall rock alteration of various igneous rocks, especially basic rock. Those with beautiful color can be used as precious jade.

explanation_cn: 又称土耳其玉。具有附加阴离子的含水架状结构磷酸盐矿物。三斜晶系。偶见短柱状晶形，常呈隐晶质块状或皮壳状集合体。鲜绿、浅绿或蓝绿色。条痕淡绿色至白色。蜡状光泽。解理{010}完全，{001}中等。莫氏硬度5-6，密度2.60-2.8g/cm3。在干热气候条件下，由含铜溶液作用于黏土和含磷岩石而成，常与褐铁矿、高岭石、石髓等共生。色艳块体可用作宝石及工艺雕刻材料；松散碎屑经加工可作颜料。
explanation_en: Also known as türkiye jade. A phosphate mineral with an aqueous framework structure with additional anions. Triclinal crystal system. Occasionally, short columnar crystals are observed, often appearing as cryptocrystalline blocks or crusty aggregates. Fresh green, light green, or blue-green. Stripes light green to white. Wax like luster. The cleavage {010} is complete, {001} is moderate. Mohs hardness 5-6, density 2.60-2.8g/cm3. Under dry and hot climate conditions, it is formed by the action of copper bearing solution on clay and phosphorus bearing rock, and is often associated with limonite, kaolinite, chalcedony, etc. Seyan block can be used as gems and craft carving materials; Loose debris can be processed as pigment.

explanation_cn: 环状结构硅酸盐矿物。六方晶系。柱状晶体横断面呈六边形，柱面上有细纵纹。绿柱石晶形随形成温度由高向低，从长柱状到短柱状。显不同色调的绿色。成分中含铬呈翠绿色者称祖母绿，含微量铁的透明而显蔚蓝色者称海蓝宝石，含铯呈玫瑰色者称铯绿柱石，含铀呈透明黄色者称黄透绿柱石。玻璃光泽，透明至半透明。莫氏硬度7.5-8,密度2.66-2.83g/cm3。产于花岗伟晶岩中，或云英岩及高温热液矿脉中，与钠长石、铌钽铁矿、锂辉石、黑钨矿等共生。是提炼铍的原料。色泽美丽者可作宝石。祖母绿是特等优质宝石，其价值可与金刚石媲美。含Cr3+的绿柱石可以用于制作受激发射微波量子放大器。
explanation_en: Silicate mineral with ring structure. Hexagonal crystal system. The cross section of columnar crystal is hexagonal, and there are fine longitudinal lines on the cylinder. The crystal form of beryl changes from high to low with the formation temperature, from long columnar to short columnar. Display different shades of green. Emerald refers to those with chrome in emerald green, aquamarine refers to those with trace iron in transparent blue, vorobyevife refers to those with cesium in rose color, and heliodor refers to those with uranium in transparent yellow. Glass is glossy, transparent to translucent. Mohs hardness 7.5-8, density 2.66-2.83g/cm3. It occurs in granite pegmatite, or greisen and high-temperature hydrothermal veins, and coexists with albite, columbite-tantalite, spodumene, wolframite, etc. It is the raw material for extracting beryllium. Those with beautiful color can be used as gems. Emerald is a superior quality gems, whose value is comparable to that of diamond. Beryl containing Cr3+can be used to make stimulated emission microwave quantum amplifiers.

explanation_cn: 层状结构硅酸盐矿物。阳离子中类质同象代替普遍。根据Fe2+与全部阳离子数的比例以及硅原子的含量，将绿泥石分成若干矿物种。各矿物种的晶体结构也有些差异。只有精确鉴定时才能分开，故肉眼鉴定时一般将这类矿物统称为绿泥石。稳定的多型为单斜晶系。假六方片状，短柱状晶体。常呈鳞片状集合体。带有黑、棕、黄、蓝等不同色调的绿色。铁含量高时，颜色加深。玻璃光泽，解理面上呈珍珠光泽。莫氏硬度2-3。平行{001}一组极完全解理。薄片有挠性以区别于海绿石。主要产于片岩和低温热液矿床的围岩蚀变带中，近海岸的沉积物中亦有产出。
explanation_en: Layered silicate mineral. The substitution of isomorphism in cations is common. According to the ratio of Fe2+to all cations and the content of silicon atoms, chlorite is divided into several minerals. The crystal structure of each mineral species is also somewhat different. They can be separated only when they are accurately identified, so these minerals are generally called chlorite when they are identified by naked eyes. The stable polytype is a monoclinic system. Pseudohexagonal lamellar, short columnar crystal. Often present as a scale like aggregate. Green with different shades of black, brown, yellow, blue, etc. When the iron content is high, the color will deepen. Glass luster, pearly luster on cleavage surface. Mohs hardness 2-3. Parallel {001} sets of extremely complete cleavage. The sheet is flexible to distinguish it from glauconite. Mainly occurring in rock alteration zones of schist and low-temperature hydrothermal deposits, as well as in sediments near the coast.

explanation_cn: 又称绿泥片岩。一种主要由绿泥石组成的具有片状构造的区域变质岩。除细鳞片状绿泥石外，还有绿帘石、阳起石、钠长石、石英、绢云母等。有时含少量方解石。绿色至暗绿色，片理明显，略有滑腻感，质地软。它是绿片岩中最常见的岩石类型。通常由中基性火山岩或黏土质岩石等经低级变质作用而形成。绿泥石片岩碎块为中药，即青礞石。
explanation_en: It is also called green mud schist. A regional metamorphic rock with schistose structure mainly composed of chlorite. In addition to fine scale chlorite, there are also epidote, actinolite, sodium feldspar, quartze, seridte, etc. Sometimes it contains a small amount of caldte. Green to dark green, with obvious schistosity, slightly greasy and soft texture. It is the most common rock type in green schist. It is usually formed by low-grade metamorphism of intermediate basic volcanic rock or clayey rock. The fragments of chlorite schist are Chinese medicine, namely lapis lazuli.

explanation_cn: 呈不同色调绿色的玉髓，为隐晶质石英质玉石。由Fe、Cr、Ni等杂质元素致色，也可由细小的绿泥石、阳起石等绿色矿物的均匀分布引起颜色，可显示带状构造。市场上产于澳大利亚的绿玉髓称澳玉。参见石英。
explanation_en: The chalcedony with different shades of green is cryptocrystalline quartz jade. It is colored by impurity elements such as Fe, Cr and Ni, and can also be colored by the uniform distribution of fine green minerals such as chlorite and actinolite, showing banded structure. Green chalcedony produced in Australia on the market is called Australian jade. See quartze.

explanation_cn: 是指环境负担最小而再循环利用率最高的新型包装材料，体现为资源的再生利用和生态环境保护。是在生产、制造、使用和回收过程中对人体健康无害，对生态环境有良好保护作用的包装材料。目前人们常见的绿色包装材料大致有可降解塑料和天然生物分子材料类等。其实，绿色包装材料属于生态环境材料的一个门类，因此，它理所当让地应该具备生态环境材料资源和能源消耗少，环境污染小和循环再生利用率高的属性和基本要素。
explanation_en: It refers to the new packaging materials with the lowest environmental burden and the highest recycling rate, which is reflected in the recycling of resources and ecological environment protection. It is a packaging materials that is harmless to human health and has good protection effect on ecological environment in the process of production, manufacturing, use and recycling. At present, the common green packaging materials include degradation plastics and natural biomolecular materials. In fact, green packaging materials belong to a category of ecomaterials, so it should have the attributes and basic elements of low consumption of resources and energy of ecomaterials, low environmental pollution and high recycling rate.

explanation_cn: 20世纪90年代初，国外提出无毒推进剂、与环境友好的推进剂概念。21世纪初，欧洲航天局提出"绿色推进剂"概念(降低推进剂毒性和污染)，相继在2001年、2004年、2006年召开了绿色推进会议。研制新一代绿色单组元液体推进剂大都以替代肼为目标。研制双组元绿色推进剂主要以高浓度过氧化氢替代四氧化二氮为目标。绿色推进剂应低毒或无毒。液氢/液氧、液氧/煤油、硝酸羟胺基单组元推进剂、二硝酰胺铵基单组元推进剂等属于绿色推进剂。国外仍存在无毒推进剂和与环境友好的推进剂术语。
explanation_en: In the early 1990s, foreign countries proposed the concept of non-toxic and environmentally friendly propellants. At the beginning of the 21st century, the European Space Agency proposed the concept of "green propellant" (reducing propellant toxicity and pollution), and held green propulsion conferences in 2001, 2004, and 2006. The goal of developing a new generation of green single component liquid propellant is mostly to replace hydrazine. The goal of developing bipropellant grepn propellants 20 is to replace nitrogen tetroxide with high concentration hydrogen peroxide. The grepn propellants 20 shall be low toxic or non-toxic. Liquid hydrogen/liquid oxygen, liquid oxygen/kerosene, HAN-based monopropellant, ammonium dinitrate based monopropellant, etc. are grepn propellants 20. There are still non-toxic propellants and environmentally friendly propellant terms in foreign countries.

explanation_cn: 又称环境友好型水处理剂。制造、使用过程中对环境无污染，对人体健康无害，且被降解为无害物质的水处理剂。分为绿色缓释阻垢剂、绿色杀菌灭藻剂和绿色絮凝剂。绿色缓释阻垢剂有无机、天然、人工合成三类。无机绿色缓蚀阻垢剂有钼酸盐、钨酸盐等，能在金属表面发生吸附、沉积，或通过自身的氧化性促进金属钝化。天然高分子缓蚀阻垢剂有淀粉、纤维素、单宁等，其中淀粉和纤维素都属于碳水化合物中的多聚糖类，；单宁中含有酚羟基，能与Ca2+、Mg2+等形成螯合物。人工合成类有聚天冬氨酸、聚环氧琥珀酸、S-羧乙基硫代琥珀酸、聚谷氨酸等，聚天冬氨酸PASP带有羧酸侧链的聚氨基酸.能被生物降解且具有螯合和分散性能；聚环氧琥珀酸PESA易生物降解.并适用于高碱高硬度水系，缓蚀阻垢效果好；S-羧乙基硫代琥珀酸生物降解性能强，可降低污水处理负荷；聚谷氨酸可溶于水，能够完全生物降解，由其开发的相对低分子质量聚谷氨酸具有较好的阻垢缓蚀性能，符合绿色水处理剂的要求。绿色杀菌灭藻剂(见绿色杀菌灭藻剂)，绿色絮凝剂(见天然高分子絮凝剂)。
explanation_en: Also known as environmentally friendly water treatment agents. Water treatment agent that has no pollution to the environment, is harmless to human health, and is degradation into harmless substances during manufacturing and use. It is divided into green slow release scale inhibitor, green germicide and algicide and green coagulant. There are three types of green slow-release scale inhibitors: inorganic, natural, and synthetic. Inorganic green corrosion and scale inhibitors include molybdate, tungstate, etc., which can adsorb and deposit on the metal surface, or promote metal passivation through its own oxidation. Natural polymer corrosion and scale inhibitors include starch, cellulose, tannin, etc. Among them, starch and cellulose belong to polysaccharides in carbohydrates,; Tannin contains phenolic hydroxyl groups and can form chelates with Ca2+, Mg2+, etc. Synthetic products include polyaspartic acid, polyepoxysuccinic acid, S-carboxyethylthiosuccinic acid, polyglutamic acid, etc. Polyaspartic acid PASP has polyamino acid with carboxylic acid side chain, which can be biodegradation and has chelating and dispersion properties; The polyepoxysuccinic acid PESA is easy to biodegradation and suitable for high alkali and high hardness water systems, with good corrosion and scale inhibition effect; S-carboxyethylthiosuccinic acid has strong biodegradation performance, which can reduce the sewage treatment load; Polyglutamic acid is soluble in water and can be completely biodegradation. The relatively low molecular weight polyglutamic acid developed by it has good scale and corrosion inhibition performance, which meets the requirements of green water treatment agwit. Green germicide and algicide (see green germicide and algicide), green coagulant (see natural polymer flocculant).

explanation_cn: 又称延迟作用。自由基活性链与其他分子发生链转移反应，生成稳定的非自由基或低活性自由基，使聚合反应速率降低的现象。
explanation_en: Also called delayed effect. The chain transfer reaction between the free radical active chain and other molecules generates stable non free radicals or low active free radicals, which reduces the reaction rate of polymerization.

explanation_cn: 又称高分子间复合物。高分子间有氢键、电荷转移或离子相互作用，从而形成氢键型高分子间复合物、电荷转移型高分子间复合物、离子型高分子间复合物。此外还有一种立体构型高分子间复合物。缔合聚合物的性能与未复合聚合物有很大不同。缔合是一种可逆现象。生物高分子常以缔合状态存在。
explanation_en: Also known as interpolymer complex. There are hydrogen bond, charge transfer or ion interactions between macromolecule to form hydrogen bond interpolymer complex, charge transfer interpolymer complex and ionic interpolymer complex. In addition, there is a three-dimensional interpolymer complex. The performance of association polymer is very different from that of non composition polymer. Association is a reversible phenomenon. Biopolymers often exist in association state.
