explanation_cn: 液体硅橡胶根据交联硫化机理可分为缩合型和加成型两个体系。缩合型硅橡胶是借助空气中的湿气由表及里的硫化，对空气的温度和湿度会有很大的要求。缩合型硅橡胶固化后手指触摸表面黏性消失时间称为表干时间，。交联剂不同，表干时间也不一样：脱醇型5-30min;脱酮肟型10-60min;脱醋酸型5-15min;脱丙酮型1-10m
explanation_en: Liquid silicone rubber can be divided into condensation type and addition type according to the crosslinking curing mechanism. Condensation type silicone rubber is vulcanization from the outside to the inside with the help of moisture in the air, which will have great requirements on the temperature and humidity of the air. After curing of condensation type silicone rubber, the time when the adhesion of the finger touch surface disappears is called surface drying time,. The surface drying time varies with different crosslinking agents: 5-30min for dealcoholization type; Deketoxime type for 10-60 minutes; Deacetic acid type for 5-15 minutes; Deacetone type 1-10m

explanation_cn: 又称缩聚反应。含有两个或两个以上官能团的单体.发生缩合反应脱去小分子副产物（水、醇、氨、卤化氢等）而生成高分子化合物的聚合反应。缩聚反应的主要特点：大分子链的增长是一个逐步的过程。缩聚反应分为线型缩聚和体型缩聚，线型缩聚反应是指单体仅有两个官能团，大分子向两个方向增长.得到的聚合物是线型分子；体型缩聚反应是指至少有一种单体含有两个以上官能团.大分子向多个方向增长，得到体型结构的聚合物。按反应性质吋分为平衡（可逆）缩聚反应和不平衡（不可逆）缩聚反应。按制备方法不同分为熔融缩聚反应、界面缩聚反应、溶液缩聚反应、乳液缩聚反应、气相缩聚反应、固相缩聚反应等。
explanation_en: Also called polycondensation reaction reaction. Monomer containing two or more functional groups undergoes a condensation reaction to remove small molecular by-products (water, alcohol, ammonia, hydrogen halide, etc.) and generate a polymerization reaction of macromolecule compounds. The main feature of polycondensation reaction reaction: the growth of macromolecule chain is a gradual process. Polycondensation reaction can be divided into linear polycondensation and three-dimensional polycondensation. Linear polycondensation reaction refers to that monomer has only two functional groups and macromolecule grows in two directions. The resulting polymer is linear molecule; Three-dimensional polycondensation reaction means that at least one monomer contains more than two functional groups, and macromolecule grows in multiple directions to obtain polymer with body type structure. According to the reaction properties, it can be divided into balanced (reversible) polycondensation reaction and unbalanced (irreversible) polycondensation reaction. According to different preparation methods, it can be divided into meltphase polycondensation reaction, interfacial polycondensation reaction, solution polycondensation reaction reaction, lotion polycondensation reaction reaction, gas phase polycondensation reaction reaction, solid phase polycondensation reaction reaction, etc.

explanation_cn: 合金材料最后凝固区域于补缩不到而产生的敞开或封闭的孔穴，形状不规则，孔壁粗糙且一般存在氧化膜，故后续热加工时不能焊合。缩孔的出现与合金的液态收缩率、凝固收缩率、固态收缩率、结晶温度区间、热导率等有关，还与工艺参量如浇铸温度、浇铸速度、铸型冷却能力、型腔形状等有关。缩孔是严重的铸造缺陷，铸件内部存在的缩孔具有很大的危害性，应尽量避免产生缩孔或通过切削加I:去除缩孔。
explanation_en: The final solidification area of alloy materials is an open or closed cavity due to insufficient feeding. The appearance of shrinkage hole is related to the liquid shrinkage, solidification shrinkage, solid shrinkage, crystallization temperature range, thermal conductivity, etc. of alloy, as well as process parameters such as casting temperature, casting speed, mold cooling capacity, cavity shape, etc. Shrinkage hole is a serious casting defect, and the shrinkage hole inside the casting is very harmful. shrinkage hole should be avoided or shrinkage hole should be removed by cutting.

name_cn: 缩水甘油叠氮聚醚推进剂
explanation_cn: GAP推进剂，也称为叠氮推进剂，是一类以缩水H2油叠氮聚合物（GAP）作为黏合剂的固体推进剂。GAP黏合剂通常为常温下的棕红色黏稠液体，具有密度约为1.298 g/cm3（25摄氏度）、玻璃化温度为约143摄氏度，生成热为正的特性。然而，GAP黏合剂的理化性能会因其聚合度、结构和合成方法的不同而有所差异。GAP推进剂具有以下特点：高密度、高氮含量、低机械感度、正生成热，并且具有良好的热稳定性。此外，GAP推进剂与常用的氧化剂（如高氯酸铵、硝酸铵）、硝胺炸药（如HMX、RDX）以及含能增塑剂（如硝酸酯类、硝基硝胺类）之间具有良好的化学相容性。这些特性使GAP推进剂在固体火箭发动机中表现出高能量输出、高燃速和高成气量的性能，因此适用于那些对高能量、低特征信号和低易损性要求较高的应用场合。
explanation_en: GAP propellant, also known as azide propellant, is a kind of solid propellant with condensed H2 oil azide polymer (GAP) as adhesive. GAP adhesive is generally a brownish red viscous liquid at room temperature, with a density of about 1.298 g/cm3 (25 ℃), a glass transition temperature of about 143 ℃, and a positive heat of formation. However, the physical and chemical properties of GAP adhesive will vary with its degree of polymerization, structure and synthesis method. GAP propellant has the following characteristics: high density, high nitrogen content, low mechanical sensitivity, positive heat of formation, and good thermal stability. In addition, GAP propellant has good chemical compatibility with common oxidizer (such as ammonium perchlorate, ammonium nitrate), nitramine explosive (such as HMX, RDX) and energetic plasticizer (such as nitrates, nitronitramine). These characteristics enable GAP propellant to exhibit high energy output, high burning rate, and high gas generation performance in solid rocket engines, making it suitable for applications that require high energy, low characteristic signals, and low vulnerability.

explanation_cn: 羟乙基纤维素是一种白色或淡黄色的无味、无毒的纤维状或粉状固体。是一种非离子型的水可溶性纤维素醚。不是热塑性塑料。不同取代度的品种具有不同的黏度和性能，也因而有不同的用途。由碱纤维素与环氧乙烷反应制得。它具有增稠、悬浮、黏合、乳化、成膜稳定、分散、保水及提供保护胶体作用等性质，因此可用作表面活性剂、胶体保护剂、分散剂、分散稳定剂等，广泛用于涂料、纤维、染色、造纸、化妆品、医药、农药等。此外，还可用于石油工业及选矿中。
explanation_en: Hydroxyethyl cellulose is a white or light yellow, tasteless, non-toxic fibrous or powdery solid. It is a non ionic water-soluble cellulose ether. Not thermoplastic plastics. Varieties with different degrees of substitution have different viscosity and properties, and therefore have different uses. It is prepared by reacting alkali cellulose with ethylene oxide. It has the properties of thickening, suspension, adhesion, emulsification, film forming stability, dispersion, water retention and providing protective colloid. Therefore, it can be used as surfactant, colloid protector, dispersing agent, dispersion stabilizer, etc., and is widely used in coatings, fibers, dyeing, papermaking, cosmetics, medicine, pesticides, etc. In addition, it can also be used in the petroleum industry and mineral processing.

explanation_cn: 端基为轻基的线型聚二甲基硅氧烷油状液体。羟基硅油具有甲基硅油的特点，其黏度可以从很小一直到上万帕-秒，其羟基含量可以从万分之几到百分之-几的范围白变动。羟基硅油的最大特点是端基带有可反应的活性羟基，在有机锡催化下羟基和羟基以及羟基与烷氧基之间可以缩合，形成交联的弹性体。典型羟基硅油黏度（25°C)矣40mPa。s，折射率（25°C)L4000-1。4100，羟基含量4%-5K。羟基硅油可由八甲基环四硅氧烷在酸或碱催化下开环聚合后加水降解而成。也可由高分子量聚二甲基硅氧烷在高压中以KüH催化加水降解而成。还可以由二甲基二烷氧基硅烷在弱酸条件下水解或由八甲基环四硅氧烷开环后端基酰化再水解而成。分子量为5万-6万的羟基硅油是室温硫化硅橡胶的基胶，低黏度的羟基硅油是硅橡胶加工中的优良结构控制剂，可代替二苯基硅二醇，简化加工工艺，提高工艺性能。羟基硅油还用作织物、皮革、纸张的防水、柔软和防黏处理剂》
explanation_en: Linear polydimethylsiloxane oil-like liquid with light end groups. Hydroxyl silicone oil has the characteristics of methyl silicone oil. Its viscosity can range from very small to tens of thousands of pascals per second, and its hydroxyl content can vary from a few ten thousandths to a few percent. The biggest feature of hydroxyl silicone oil is that the end group has reactive active hydroxyl groups. Under the catalysis of organotin, hydroxyl and hydroxyl groups as well as hydroxyl and alkoxy groups can be condensed to form crosslinking elastomers. The viscosity of typical hydroxyl silicone oil (25 ° C) is 40mPa. s. Refractive index (25 ° C) L4000-1. 4100, hydroxyl content 4% -5K. Hydroxyl silicone oil can be produced by ring opening polymerization of octamethylcyclotetrasiloxane catalyzed by acid or alkali, and then degradation by adding water. It can also be made from macromolecule weight polydimethylsiloxanes by K ü H catalysis and degradation with water under high pressure. It can also be formed by hydrolysis of dimethyl dialkyloxy silane under weak acid conditions or by end acylation and re hydrolysis of octamethylcyclotetrasiloxane after ring opening. Hydroxyl silicone oil with molecular weight of 50000 to 60000 is the base rubber of room temperature vulcanized silicone rubber, and hydroxyl silicone oil with low viscosity is an excellent structure control agent in the processing of silicone rubber, which can replace diphenyl silicone glycol, simplify processing technology and improve process performance. Hydroxyl silicone oil is also used as a waterproof, soft and anti sticking agent for fabrics, leather and paper

name_cn: 羟基磷灰石-氧化物陶瓷复合材料
explanation_cn: 经基鱗灰石（HA)颗粒捧入氧化物陶瓷而形成的一类生物复合陶瓷。旨在通过生物活性的羟基憐灰石的掺入，赋予高强度惰性氧化铝、氧化锆和氧化钛等生物惰性陶瓷以生物活性，以获得高强度的生物活性陶瓷。通常使用超细的羟基磷灰石和氧化物微粉，经球磨混匀后。经热等静压烧结而制备，烧结温度低于1250°C，压力为200MPa左右。使用热等静压烧结是为了降低烧结温度，避免羟基磷灰石高温相变。
explanation_en: It is a kind of biological composition ceramics formed by carrying oxide ceramics into the base apatite (HA) particles. The purpose is to endow bioinert ceramics such as high-strength inert alumina, zirconia and titanium oxide with bioactivity through the incorporation of bioactivity hydroxyapatite, so as to obtain high-strength bioactiw ceramics. Generally, ultrafine hydroxyapatite and oxide micropowder are used, which are milled and mixed evenly. It is prepared by hot isostatic pressing sintering. The sintering temperature is lower than 1250 ° C and the pressure is about 200MPa. The purpose of hot isostatic pressing (HIP) sintering is to reduce the sintering temperature and avoid high temperature phase transformation of hydroxyapatite.

name_cn: 羟基磷灰石/高分子复合材料
explanation_cn: 是将轻基鱗灰石与一种或多种高分子材料复合所得的生物活性陶瓷复合材料。羟基磷灰石具有良好的生物活性和骨传导性。但材料力学性能差。与高分子复合可改善其靭性。常选用的高分子相有入工合成的聚乳酸、聚乙醇酸及其共聚物聚乙丙交酯等以及天然的胶原、壳聚糖、明胶等和入体中存在的有机质。目前主要用于非承重骨、牙科、眼科等领域以及承重骨植入体的表面处理方面。
explanation_en: It is a bioactiw ceramics composite materials obtained by composition light base limestone with one or more macromolecule materials. Hydroxyapatite has good bioactivity and bone conductivity. But the mechanical properties of materials are poor. Composition with macromolecule can improve its toughness. The commonly selected macromolecule phase includes synthetic polylactic acid, polyglycolic acid and its copolymer polyglycolide, as well as natural collagen, chitosan, gelatin, etc. and organic matter in the body. Currently, it is mainly used in the fields of non load-bearing bone, dentistry, ophthalmology, and the surface treatment of load-bearing bone implants.

explanation_cn: 经基磷灰石属六方晶系，羟基磷灰石中的Ca2f可被Na+、Mg2+、Ba2+、Sr2'Pb2+、Zn2+、Cu2'、、Cd2+、Ge3离子取代。羟基磷灰石抗菌材料中实际使用的金属离子主要是对人体安全的银、铜、锌等，其中银离子的抗菌能力最强。羟基磷灰石抗菌剂的制备方法为：①将磷灰石或磷酸钙类材料与银或铜、锌化合物混合，通常在1000°C以上烧结，使银或铜、锌化合物转变为金属态；②在合成羟基磷灰石反应I中，将银或铜、锌等可溶性盐的水溶液加入反应物中。使抗菌金属离子进入磷灰石结晶产物中；③将结晶化的羟基磷灰石粉与可溶性的银或铜、锌盐等水溶液进行离子交换反应。即可制得羟基磷灰石抗菌材料。羟基磷灰石抗菌剂的抗菌离子是以离子交换方式进去其结构中的。故其抗菌离子的溶出量很小，抗菌力较强。羟基磷灰石抗菌剂能有效地灭杀大肠杆菌、绿脓杆菌、金黄色葡萄球菌等多种致病细菌。是一种广谱、高效的缓释型抗菌剂。并且具有优良的耐高温性能与抗变色性能。
explanation_en: The base apatite belongs to hexagonal system, and Ca2f in hydroxyapatite can be replaced by Na+, Mg2+, Ba2+, Sr2'Pb2+, Zn2+, Cu2 ', Cd2+, Ge3 ions. The metal ions actually used in hydroxyapatite antibacterial materials are mainly silver, copper, zinc, etc., which are safe for human body, of which silver ion has the strongest antibacterial ability. The preparation method of hydroxyapatite antibacterial agent is as follows: ① mix apatite or calcium phosphate materials with silver or copper and zinc compounds, usually sintering at above 1000 ° C, to make silver or copper and zinc compounds transformation into metallic state; ② In the synthesis of hydroxyapatite reaction I, the aqueous solution of silver or copper, zinc and other soluble salts is added to the reactant. Make antibacterial metal ions enter apatite crystal products; ③ Conduct ion exchange reaction between crystallized hydroxyapatite powder and soluble silver or copper, zinc salt and other aqueous solutions. The hydroxyapatite antibacterial materials can be prepared. Antibacterial ions of hydroxyapatite antibacterial agent enter its structure by ion exchange. Therefore, the dissolution amount of antibacterial ions is very small and the antibacterial effect is strong. Hydroxyapatite antibacterial agent can effectively kill Escherichia coli, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Staphylococcus aureus and other pathogenic bacteria. It is a kind of broad-spectrum, highly effective sustained-release antibacterial agent. And it has excellent high-temperature resistance and anti discoloration performance.

explanation_cn: 指涂在基体材料表面的羟基磷灰石材料，羟基磷灰石涂层能赋予基体良好的生物相容性和生物活性，有利于骨组织长入。羟基磷灰石涂层的制备方法包括：等离子喷涂、物理气相沉积、化学气相沉积、磁控溅射、电泳沉积、脉冲激光沉积、溶胶-凝胶法、仿生沉积法等。为加强涂层与基体的结合，可对基体进行表面处理、设计成梯度结构或制备复合涂层等。其主要用于入工膝关节和髋关节的股骨柄表面、髋臼杯外层、骨干表面等。
explanation_en: It refers to hydroxyapatite materials coated on the surface of materials of matrix. hydroxyapatite coating can endow matrix with good biocompatibility and bioactivity, which is conducive to bone tissue growth. The preparation methods of hydroxyapatite coalings include plasma spraying, physical vapor deposition, chemical vapor deposition, magnetron sputtering, electrophoretic deposition, pulsed laser deposition, sol-gel method, biomimetic deposition, etc. In order to strengthen the combination of the coating and the matrix, the matrix can be surface treated, designed into a gradient structure or prepared with composite coating. It is mainly used for the surface of the femoral stem, outer layer of the acetabular cup, and surface of the shaft of the knee and hip joints.

name_cn: 羟基磷灰石生物活性陶瓷
explanation_cn: 是一种由羟基磷灰石构成的致密生物活性陶瓷。羟基磷灰石生物活性陶瓷的抗压强度可达400-917MPa，但抗弯强度仅80-195MPa，是典型的脆性材料。该陶瓷具有骨传导性，并能和骨产生化学键合。合成方法主要有沉淀法、水解法和水热合成法等。用于入体硬组织的修复和替代，如制作入工骨、牙种植体、骨填充材料和入工关节等；也用于心血管系统和软组织修复。如入造血管、气管、喉管支架等；还用于经皮器件、药物缓释载体及负载生长因子等。该材料的缺点是脆性高，在生理环境中抗疲劳破坏性能差，目前还只限于用作受力较小部位的骨修复和填充。
explanation_en: It is a compact bioactiw ceramics composed of hydroxyapatite. The compressive strength of hydroxyapatite bioactive ceramics can reach 400-917MPa, but the bending strength is only 80-195MPa, which is a typical brittle materials. The ceramics has bone conductivity and can produce chemical bonding with the bone. The main synthesis methods are precipitation, hydrolysis and hydrothermal synthesis. It is used to repair and replace the hard tissue in the body, such as making the bone, dental implant, bone filling materials and joint; It is also used for cardiovascular system and soft tissue repair. Such as angioplasty, trachea, laryngeal stem, etc; It is also used for transdermal devices, drug sustained release carriers and growth factors loading. The disadvantage of this materials is its high brittleness and poor fatigue resistance in physiological environment. At present, it is only used for bone repair and filling in the parts with less stress.

explanation_cn: [-CH,-CH-CN-CH,-CH=CH-CH,-CH,-CH4+CH,-CH-CH=CH羧基丁腈橡胶是在丁二烯和丙烯腈乳液中加人第三单体（丙烯酸或甲基丙烯酸）共聚得到的产物。羧基丁腈橡胶的丙烯腈含量一般在30%-40%,甲基丙烯酸含量为2%-3%，生胶门尼黏度（100°C)为35-115,相对密度0.98-0.99。与普通丁腈橡胶相比，羧基的引入增加了橡胶的极性，提高了与PVC、酚醛树脂等的相容性。XNBR的硬度、耐磨性、耐臭氧老化性、拉伸强度和撕裂强度，特别是高温拉伸强度显著提高。羧基丁腈橡胶的缺点为低温柔性较差、压缩永久变形大，特别是焦烧安全性差。羧基丁腈橡胶主要用于密封圈、形圈、胶鞋及各种膜制品、环氧树脂增韧及高性能黏合产品。
explanation_en: [- CH, - CH-CN-CH, - CH=CH-CH, - CH, - CH4+CH, - CH-CH=CH carboxy nitrile rubber XNBR is the product of copolymerization of butadiene and acrylonitrile lotion with the addition of a third monomer (acrylic acid or methacrylic acid). The acrylonitrile content of carboxy nitrile rubber XNBR is generally 30% -40%, the methacrylic acid content is 2% -3%, and the Mooney viscosity of crude rubber (100 ° C) Is 35-115, and the relative density is 0.98-0.99. Compared with ordinary acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber, the introduction of carboxyl group increases the polarity of rubber and compatibility with PVC, phenolic resin, etc. The hardness, wear resistance, ozone aging resistance, tensile strength and tear strength of XNBR, especially the tensile strength at high temperature, are significantly improved. The disadvantages of carboxy nitrile rubber XNBR are poor low-temperature flexibility, large compression set, and poor scorching safety. Carboxy nitrile rubber XNBR is mainly used for sealing rings, shaped rings, rubber shoes and various film products, epoxy resin toughening and high-performance bonding products.

explanation_cn: 是由丁二烯、苯乙烯及少量含羧基的第三单体（1%-3%)如不饱和羧酸、甲基丙烯酸或衣康酸等乳液聚合而得，生产工艺基本与普通丁苯橡胶相同。由于羧基的引人，增加了乳液的极性，提高了黏结性能.用作地毯、纸加工、无纺布、服装衬里等的胶黏剂。由于羧基的反应能力强，可用多价金属硫化，还可用二胺、二醇、二异氰酸酯、多环氧化物等作硫化剂。由于羧基丁苯橡胶中不但存在不饱和键而且还有羧基，硫化时可产生多种形式的键，结果使硫化胶具有较高的力学性能和弹性。产品主要是胶乳，用于地毯工业、预涂层、二次被衬、上浆、针刺毡、泡沫制品及纸张加工等方面，还可以用作高温黏合剂、人造革行业等。
explanation_en: It is produced by emulsion polymerization of butadiene, styrene and a small amount of third monomer (1% -3%) containing carboxyl group, such as unsaturated carboxylic acid, methacrylic acid or itaconic acid. The production process is basically the same as that of ordinary styrene-butadiene rubber. Due to the introduction of carboxyl group, the polarity of lotion is increased and the bonding performance is improved. It is used as a adhesive for carpet, paper processing, non-woven fabric, clothing lining, etc. Due to the strong reaction ability of carboxyl group, it can be vulcanization by multivalent metals, and can also be used as vulcanizing agent by diamine, glycol, diisocyanate, polyepoxide, etc. Because carboxylated styrene butadiene rubber has not only unsaturated bonds but also carboxyl groups, various forms of bonds can be generated during vulcanization, resulting in high mechanical properties and elasticity of vulcanized rubher. The products are mainly latex, which are used in carpet industry, pre coating, secondary lining, sizing, needle punched felt, foam products, paper processing, etc., and can also be used as high-temperature adhesive, artificial leather industry, etc.

explanation_cn: 羧基氯丁二烯橡胶，又称羧基氯丁橡胶，是由2-氯-1,3-丁二烯与丙烯酸或甲基丙烯酸共聚所制得的橡胶。羧基氯丁橡胶具有良好的黏结性、弹性、成膜性、储存稳定性及耐化学药品性，而且不易燃。因此，它广泛用于制造水基接触型胶黏剂和感光胶黏剂等应用领域。
explanation_en: Carboxyl chloroprene rubber, also known as carboxylated chloroprene rubber latex, is a rubber made by copolymerization of 2-chloro-1,3-butadiene with acrylic acid or methacrylic acid. Carboxylated chloroprene rubber latex has good adhesion, elasticity, film formation, storage stability, chemical resistance, and is not flammable. Therefore, it is widely used in the manufacture of water-based contact adhesive, photosensitive adhesive and other application fields.

explanation_cn: 羧甲基纤维素是最具代表性的离子型纤维素醚，通常所使用的是它的钠盐。。纯净的CMC系白色或乳白色纤维状粉未或颗粒，无臭无味.不溶于酸和甲醇、乙醇、乙醚、丙酮、氯仿及苯等有机溶剂，而溶于水。吸湿性强。与其他水溶性胶、软化剂及树脂均有相容性。制造方法可分为水媒法和溶媒法，制造过程中的主要的化学反应为：①纤维素与碱水溶液反应生成碱纤维素；②碱纤维素与一氯醋酸钠的醚化反应。用途广、适应性强，是许多工业部门不可缺少的原料和辅助材料。羧甲基纤维素可形成高黏度的胶体、溶液，有黏着、增稠、乳化分散、赋形、保水、保护胶体、成膜、耐酸、耐盐、悬浊等特性，且生理无害，因此在食品、医药、丨3化、石油、造纸、纺织、建筑等领域生产中得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: Carboxymethyl cellulose is the most representative ionic cellulose ether, and its sodium salt is usually used.. Pure CMC is a white or milky white fibrous powder or particle, odorless and odorless. It is insoluble in acids and organic solvents such as methanol, ethanol, ether, acetone, chloroform, and benzene, but soluble in water. Strong hygroscopicity. It has compatibility with other water-soluble adhesives, softening agent and resin. The manufacturing methods can be divided into water medium method and solvent method. The main chemical reactions in the manufacturing process are: ① cellulose reacts with alkaline aqueous solution to produce alkali cellulose; ② Etherification reaction of alkali cellulose with sodium monochloroacetate. It is widely used and adaptable, and is an indispensable raw material and auxiliary materials for many industrial sectors. Carboxymethyl cellulose can form colloid and solution with high viscosity. It has the characteristics of adhesion, thickening, emulsification and dispersion, shaping, water retention, protective colloid, film forming, acid resistance, salt resistance, suspension, and is physiologically harmless. Therefore, it is widely used in food, medicine, chemicals, petroleum, paper making, textile, construction and other fields.

explanation_cn: 又称作低胺硼酸胶乳，商品名LA-BA胶乳。采用0.2%氨、0.24%硼酸和0.24%月桂酸作为保存体系的低胺型离心浓缩天然胶乳，属一种专用胶乳.标称干胶含量为60%-64%。低氨型羧胺胶乳的优点是可省去除氨工序、降低胶乳制品的成产成本、并改善周围环境卫生条件，硼酸的加入可起到杀菌、防腐的作用，羧胺胶乳可用于外科医疗手套、安全套等卫生安全产品的制造。
explanation_en: Also known as low amine boric acid latex, trade name LA-BA latex. The low amine centrifugal concentrated natural latex with 0.2% ammonia, 0.24% boric acid and 0.24% lauric acid as the preservation system is a special latex with a nominal dry rubber content of 60% -64%. The advantage of low ammonia type carboxamide latex is that it can save the ammonia removal process, reduce the production cost of latex products, and improve the surrounding environmental hygiene conditions. The addition of boric acid can play a bactericidal and anti-corrosion role, and carboxamide latex can be used for the manufacturing of health and safety products such as surgical gloves and condoms.

explanation_cn: 某些金属与一氧化碳合成羰基化合物，经高温裂解制得的细金属粉未。铁系金属较易与C()起反应.合成羰基铁、钻、镍，在约4001惰性气体保护气氛中，裂解得到羰基铁粉、羰基钴粉与羰基镍粉。羰基金属的合成随压力升高而加速.现多在20MPa压力的t'O中进行合成。羰基粉末的粒度一般为50-100nm.在空气中容易自燃.羰基铁粉有良好的磁性和吸收电磁波持性。羰基镍粉有良好的抗腐浊性，主要用下?防腐蚀材料的涂层、催化剂和制作微孔分离材料。羰基钻粉极少用到。就价格而言，羰基铁、镍、钴粉末依次增高，不过羰基铁粉的售价也为还原铁粉售价的10倍以上。
explanation_en: Some metals synthesize carbonyl compounds with carbon monoxide, and fine metal powders are obtained through high-temperature cracking. Iron series metals are easy to react with C () to synthesize carbonyl iron, cobalt and nickel, which are cracked to obtain carbonyl iron powder, carbonyl cobalt powder and carbonyl nickel powder in about 4001 inert gas protection atmosphere. The synthesis of carbonyl metals accelerates with increasing pressure. Currently, synthesis is mostly carried out in t'O at a pressure of 20MPa. The particle size of carbonyl powder is generally 50-100nm. It is prone to spontaneous combustion in air. The carbonyl iron powder has good magnetism and electromagnetic wave absorption. Carbonyl nickel powder has good corrosion and turbidity resistance, mainly used for? Coating and catalyst of anti-corrosion materials and preparation of microporous separation materials. Carbonyl diamond powder is rarely used. In terms of price, carbonyl iron, nickel and cobalt powder increase in turn, but the price of carbonyl iron powder is more than 10 times that of reduced iron powder.

explanation_cn: 是塑料制品常见缺陷之一，具体是指制品形状偏离了模具型腔的形状。处在同一平面的各质点因为外力或白应力的作用而发生大小不等的位移，以至最终不再处于同一平面上，即产生了翘曲，是成型过程中由于各个方向成型时收缩率不同。应力-应变分布不均匀引起的制品不均匀弯曲变形。
explanation_en: It is one of the common defects of plastics products, specifically, the shape of the product deviates from the shape of the mold cavity. Each particle on the same plane has different displacement due to the action of external force or white stress, so that it will no longer be on the same plane, that is, warpage is generated. It is because the shrinkage rate is different in each direction during the molding process. Uneven bending deformation of the product caused by uneven stress-strain distribution.

explanation_cn: 耀州窑位于陕西省铜川市黄堡镇。窑址以黄堡为中心，其范围包括二店、立地坡、玉华、陈炉，及耀县塔坡一带。此地在宋代辖于耀州，故名耀州窑，其产品称为耀州瓷，或名耀瓷。装饰手法上以刻花和印花为主.刻花尤为精美，刀法犀利流畅.刚劲有力，立体感较强。产品特征：唐和五代时胎质稍松.呈灰色.釉质失透.有乳浊感;宋代时胎体较坚簿.胎色灰褐或灰紫釉质莹润透明.袖色青绿如橄榄，釉薄处呈姜黄色;金、元时胎质稍粗，胎色呈浅灰或灰色，袖面多数姜黄，青色者少.釉质稀薄而不润。
explanation_en: Yaozhou Kiln is located in Huangbao Town, Tongchuan City, Shaanxi Province. The kiln site is centered around Huangbao, covering the areas of Erdian, Lidipo, Yuhua, Chenlu, and Yaoxian Tapo. This place was under the jurisdiction of Yaozhou in the Song Dynasty, hence the name Yaozhou Kiln. Its products are called Yaozhou Porcelain, or Yaozhou Porcelain. In terms of decoration techniques, carving and printing are the main methods. The carving is particularly exquisite, with sharp and smooth cutting techniques, strong and powerful strength, and strong three-dimensional sense. Product features: During the Tang and Five Dynasties, the fetal material was slightly loose, appearing gray, with opaque enamel and a feeling of opacification; In the Song Dynasty, the body was hard and thin. The body color was grayish brown or grayish purple, and the enamel was transparent. The sleeve color was as green as olive, and the thin glaze was ginger; During the Jin and Yuan dynasties, the fetal material was slightly thicker, with a light gray or gray color. The sleeve surface was mostly turmeric, with few cases of cyan. The enamel was thin and not smooth.

explanation_cn: 材料老化前后物理或化学性能变化的比率，以老化后的性能与老化前的性能之差相对于老化前的性能的百分数表示。老化性能变化率是评价老化程度的指标。主要评价的性能包括镜面光泽度、拉伸强度、断裂伸长率、冲击强度、介电系数等。
explanation_en: The ratio of changes in physical or chemical properties of materials before and after aging is expressed as the percentage of the difference between the properties after aging and those before aging relative to those before aging. Property variation percent during aging is an index to evaluate the degree of aging. The main properties evaluated include degree of specular gloss, tensile strength, percentage elongation after fracture, impact strength, dielectric coefficient, etc.

explanation_cn: 将橡胶试样放在恃定的环境条件下一定时间，测定橡胶试样性能的变化率的试验，常用拉伸强度、扯断伸长率的变化量（或变化率）表示。橡胶或橡胶制品在使用、储存和运输过程中，由于受到各种因素的作用，逐渐失去原有的优良性能。以致最终丧失使用价值，这种现象称为橡胶的老化。其实质是在外界因素.如氧、热、臭氧、光、金属离子、电离辐射及机械力等作用下，橡胶本身的分子量、化学组成、分子结构发生了改变。此外，橡胶本身（如橡胶化学、分子结构状态、配方成分等）以及成型加工条件也是造成橡胶老化的原因。目前，研究和评价生胶和硫化橡胶的老化性能和老化规律的老化试验方法有自然老化试验和人工老化试验两大类。
explanation_en: The test of measuring the change rate of the performance of rubber samples by putting rubber samples under certain environmental conditions for a certain time is usually expressed by the change amount (or change rate) of tensile strength and maximum percentage elongation. During the use, storage and transportation of rubber or rubber products, due to various factors, they gradually lose their original excellent performance. This phenomenon is called aging of rubber. Its essence is that the molecular weight, chemical composition and molecular structure of rubber itself have changed under the action of external factors, such as oxygen, heat, ozone, light, metal ions, ionizing radiation and mechanical force. In addition, rubber itself (such as rubber chemistry, molecular structure state, formula composition, etc.) and molding processing conditions are also the causes of aging of rubber. At present, natural aging test and artificial aging test are two major types of aging test methods for studying and evaluating aging properties and aging laws of crude rubber and vulcanized rubber.

explanation_cn: 又称Z向钢或耐层状撕裂钢。这是一种用于制造海洋石油平台、船舶或压力容器的厚板或特厚钢板，其特点是硫含量极低，夹杂物的形态能够得到良好的控制，从而不容易在厚度方向产生层状台阶状裂纹。通常，这种类型的钢板在承受厚度方向的应力时容易发生层状撕裂。厚度方向性能钢板（或称Z向钢）的力学性能在钢板的厚度方向往往较其他方向差。这意味着当钢板承受来自厚度方向的应力时，容易发生层状撕裂。这种各向异性主要是由钢中的硫化物和氧化物夹杂物导致的，这些夹杂物在轧制过程中会沿着轧制方向拉长，从而提供了裂纹扩展的路径。改善钢的耐层状撕裂性能需要降低钢中硫的含量、控制和改善硫化物的形态。为了表示耐层状撕裂性能级别，通常在钢的标号后面会添加Z15、Z23、Z35等数值，这些数值分别表示在沿着厚度方向测试时必须达到的断面收缩率指标（以百分比表示）。耐层状撕裂钢（GB/T5313-2010）广泛应用于制造船舶、海洋石油平台或压力容器等领域，以确保这些结构在服务中不容易发生层状撕裂。
explanation_en: Also known as Z-direction steel or steel resistant to lamellar tear. This is a thick or extra thick steel plate used for manufacturing offshore oil platforms, ships, or pressure vessels. Its characteristic is that the sulfur content is extremely low, and the morphology of inclusions can be well controlled, so it is not easy to generate layered stepped cracks in the thickness direction. Generally, this type of steel plate is prone to lamellar tearing when bearing the stress in the thickness direction. The mechanical properties of steel plate (or Z-direction steel) in thickness direction are often worse than those in other directions in steel plate. This means that when the steel plate bears the stress from the thickness direction, lamellar tearing is easy to occur. This anisotropy is mainly caused by sulfide and oxide inclusions in steel, which will elongate along the rolling direction during rolling, thus providing a path for crack propagation. To improve the lamellar tear resistance of steel, it is necessary to reduce the sulfur content in steel, control and improve the morphology of sulfide. In order to indicate the level of lamellar tear resistance, Z15, Z23, Z35 and other values are usually added after the mark of steel. These values represent the reduction of area index (expressed in percentage) that must be reached when testing along the thickness direction. Steel resistant to lamellar tear (GB/T5313-2010) is widely used in the manufacturing of ships, offshore oil platforms or pressure vessels to ensure that these structures are not prone to lamellar tear in service.

explanation_en: The change degree of color, softness and other properties of leather products after repeated washing under certain conditions.

explanation_cn: 在海洋环境中耐腐蚀的钢，可以根据腐蚀机理不同，大致分为海洋大气区、飞溅区、潮差区、浅海全浸区、深海全浸区、海底泥土区。钢在海洋环境中的耐腐蚀性，不仅取决于钢的化学成分，还受海域、水深、流速、温度、气候条件以及海洋生物附着情况等许多因素的影响。潮差区由于间歇浸泡和冲刷，一般的钢铁材料难以满足需求，因此需要采用涂层防护或者使用钛合金。海水飞溅区可以使用耐海水腐蚀的不锈钢。其他区域则可以采用耐海水腐蚀的高强度结构钢。耐海水腐蚀结构钢是在耐候钢的基础上发展而来的。根据海洋腐蚀的特点，适当增加或调整耐腐蚀合金元素及其含量，主要包括铬系、铜-镍系、铜-镍-铝系、铜-镍-钴系、铜-镍-硅系、铜-镍-铝-硅系、铜-铬-钼系、铬-铝系等。这种耐海水腐蚀钢广泛应用于船舶、海洋石油平台、海洋石油管线、跨海桥梁、海港基础设施等工程结构。随着海洋工程建设的迅速发展，研制和生产专门用途的耐海水腐蚀钢已经成为钢铁行业的重要发展方向。
explanation_en: Steel resistant to corrosion in the marine environment can be roughly divided into marine atmospheric zone, splash zone, tidal range zone, shallow sea full immersion zone, deep sea full immersion zone and seabed mud zone according to different corrosion mechanisms. The corrosion resistance of steel in the marine environment is not only determined by the chemical composition of steel, but also affected by many factors such as sea area, water depth, flow rate, temperature, climatic conditions and marine bioattachment. Due to intermittent immersion and scouring in tidal range area, general steel materials are difficult to meet the demand, so coating protection or titanium alloy shall be used. Seawater corrosion resistant stainless steel can be used in the seawater splash zone. In other areas, high-strength structural steel resistant to seawater corrosion can be used. Seawater corrosion resistant structural steel is developed on the basis of atmospheric corrosion resisting steel. According to the characteristics of marine corrosion, properly increase or adjust the elements and content of corrosion resistant alloy, mainly including chromium system, copper nickel system, copper nickel aluminum system, copper nickel cobalt system, copper nickel silicon system, copper nickel aluminum silicon system, copper chromium molybdenum system, chromium aluminum system, etc. This sea water corrosion resistant steel is widely used in engineering structures such as ships, offshore oil platforms, offshore oil pipelines, cross sea bridges, and port infrastructure. With the rapid development of offshore engineering construction, the development and production of special purpose sea water corrosion resistant steel has become an important development direction of the steel industry.

explanation_cn: 高分子材料的溶剂抵抗性是指它们抵抗在溶剂中引起的溶胀和溶解的能力。在溶剂中，溶剂中的小分子会渗透到高分子材料的内部，导致材料发生溶胀作用，从而使其体积和质量增加，但材料的耐溶性能下降。如果高分子没有交联结构，溶胀会一直进行下去，最终导致材料完全溶解。材料的溶胀和溶解行为与材料的分子极性、电负性以及其与溶剂之间的相互作用能力有关。通常情况下，极性高分子材料在强极性溶剂中溶解，而在非极性溶剂中不容易溶解。非极性高分子材料则易于在非极性溶剂中溶解。如果溶剂和高分子材料的电负性相反，它们之间会有较强的亲和力，这可能会导致高分子材料的溶胀和溶解。另外，溶剂和高分子材料的溶解度参数之间的差异也会影响它们相互之间的溶解和溶胀行为。如果这些差异较大，它们之间的互溶能力较弱，材料则不容易受到浸润，因此其耐溶剂性能较好。因此，在选择高分子材料时，需要考虑溶剂的极性、电负性以及溶解度参数，以选择适合的高分子材料，以提高其对溶剂的抵抗性。
explanation_en: Solvent resistance of macromolecule materials refers to their ability to resist swelling and dissolution caused by solvent. In the solvent, small molecules in the solvent will penetrate into the interior of macromolecule materials, causing swelling of materials, which will increase its volume and mass, but the solubility of materials will decline. If the macromolecule does not have a crosslinking structure, swelling will continue and eventually lead to complete dissolution of materials. The swelling and dissolution behavior of materials is related to the molecular polarity, electron-negativity of materials and their interaction ability with solvents. Generally, polar macromolecule materials are dissolved in strong polar solvents, but not easily dissolved in non-polar solvents. Non polar macromolecule materials are easy to dissolve in non-polar solvents. If the electron-negativity of solvent and macromolecule materials is opposite, they will have strong affinity, which may lead to swelling and dissolution of macromolecule materials. In addition, the difference between the water solubility parameters of solvents and macromolecule materials will also affect their dissolution and swelling behavior. If these differences are large, their mutual solubility is weak, and materials are not easy to be soaked, so their solvent resistance is good. Therefore, when selecting macromolecule materials, solvent polarity, electron-negativity and water solubility parameters need to be considered to select suitable macromolecule materials to improve their resistance to solvents.

explanation_cn: 借助于外力，进行挤压施工的塑性不定形耐火材料。分冷同性压入料和热固性压入料。用于高炉的炮泥和炉身修补、转炉工作衬与永久衬间的填缝等。
explanation_en: Plastic unshaped refractory used for extrusion construction with the help of external force. Divide into cold isotropic pressing material and thermosetting pressing material. It is used for the repair of blast furnace gunpowder and furnace stack, and the caulking between converter working lining and permanent lining.

explanation_cn: 具有一定可塑性的泥坯状或泥闭状的不定形耐火材料。由一定颗粒级配的耐火骨料和粉料、结合剂和外加剂组成的，加水或含结合剂的液体经混炼制成。采用捣同法或挤压法施工时一般需加锚固件及支撑件。
explanation_en: Unshaped refractory with certain plasticity in the form of mud body or mud closed. It is composed of refractory aggregates and powders with a certain particle size distribution, binders, and additives, and is made by mixing with water or a liquid containing binders. When using the ramming or squeezing method for construction, it is generally necessary to add anchors and supporting components.

explanation_cn: 用喷射机进行喷补施工的不定形耐火材料。它由具有一定粒度组成的耐火骨料和粉料、结合剂和外加剂组成。按材质分有碱性、硅酸铝质、含锆质和含碳化硅质等。主要用于冶金窑炉以及加热炉等的修补。
explanation_en: Unshaped refractory for gunning construction with a jet machine. It consists of refractory aggregates and powders with a certain particle size composition, binders, and admixtures. According to the material, there are alkaline, aluminum silicate, zirconium containing, and silicon carbide containing materials. It is mainly used for repairing metallurgical kilns and soaking pit.

explanation_cn: 耐火材料在无荷重时抵抗高温不熔化的性能。耐火材料一般由多相同体混合物组成，无统-的溶点。
explanation_en: Refractory is resistant to high temperature melting without load. Refractory is generally composed of multiphase and homogeneous mixture, with no uniform melting point.

explanation_cn: 采用投射机投射施工的不定形耐火材料。由耐火骨料和粉料、结合剂和促凝剂组成。主要用于修筑耐火内衬。
explanation_en: Unshaped refractory constructed by projector is used. Composed of refractory aggregate and powder, binder and accelerator. Mainly used for building refractory lining.

explanation_cn: 由具有合理级配的耐火骨料、粉料和结合剂、外加剂等组成的，采用人工或机械捣打方法施工的不定形耐火材料。如可用作感应炉、加热炉、均热炉的内衬以及转炉炉衬的填料、铝电解槽等。
explanation_en: Unshaped refractory consisting of reasonably graded refractory aggregate, powder, binder, additive, etc., which is constructed by manual or mechanical tamping. For example, it can be used as the lining of induction furnace, soaking pit, soaking pit, as well as the filler of converter lining, aluminum reduction cell, etc.

explanation_cn: 能在高温环境中使用，耐火度一般不低于1580℃的无机非金属材料。可分为酸性、中性、碱性三大类;烧成或不烧制品;定形或不定形产品。常使用的材质有:硅质、黏土质、高铝质、刚玉质、镁铝尖晶石质、镁质、镁钙质、碳复合材料、碳化物、氮化物以及氧化物与非氧化物复合材料。
explanation_en: Inorganic nonmetallic materials that can be used in high temperature environment and has a refractoriness of no less than 1580 ℃. It can be divided into three categories: acidic, neutral, and alkaline; Burned or unburned products; Fixed or amorphous products. Commonly used materials include siliceous, clay, high alumina, corundum, magnesium aluminum spinel, magnesium, magnesium calcium, carbon composite materials, carbide, nitride, and oxide and non oxide composite materials.

explanation_cn: 又称火泥。用于填充耐火砌体接缝的不定形耐火材料。由一定颗粒配比的耐火粉料和结合剂、外加剂组成，加水或液态结合剂调成的泥料。选用时，应与耐火砌体的种类一致或物性相似。
explanation_en: It is also called fireclay. Unshaped refractory used to fill the joints of refractory masonry. A clay material composed of a certain particle ratio of refractory powder, binder, and additives, mixed with water or liquid binder. When selecting, it should be consistent with the type of refractory masonry or have similar physical properties.

explanation_cn: 耐火混凝土（又称耐火浇注料）是由适当的胶凝材料、耐火粗细骨料和水按一定比例混合而成的特种混凝土，能够在温度范围900°C至1600°C下工作，并保持其物理力学性能，包括耐火度、热稳定性、荷载软化点和高温下的收缩等。其成分和配料比例与耐火浇注料类似。施工性能、理化性能和使用效果也与耐火浇注料相似。耐火混凝土的耐火粗细骨料可以根据使用温度选择碎耐火砖、安山岩、玄武岩、铝矾土熟料、烧结镁砂以及铬铁矿等。根据所用的胶凝材料，可以分为硅酸盐耐火混凝土、铝酸盐耐火混凝土、硫酸盐耐火混凝土、磷酸盐耐火混凝土、矾土耐火混凝土、氯化物耐火混凝土等。一般情况下，在900°C以下使用硅酸盐水泥，在1200°C至1630°C之间使用矾土水泥，而在300°C以上至1400°C时可以选择使用铝酸盐水泥。如果温度要求更高，可以采用磷酸铝胶结材料。这种混凝土广泛用于工业窑炉的构筑、炉衬等，以及用于热工设备、烟囱、冶金、石油、核电等领域。需要注意的是，用于900°C以下的情况通常称为耐热混凝土。
explanation_en: Refractory concrete (also known as refractory castable) is a special concrete composed of appropriate cementitious materials, refractory coarse and fine aggregates and water in a certain proportion, which can work in the temperature range of 900 ° C to 1600 ° C, and maintain its physical and mechanical properties, including refractoriness, thermal stability, load softening point and shrinkage under high temperature. Its composition and ingredient ratio are similar to those of refractory castables. The construction performance, physical and chemical properties, and usage effect are also similar to those of refractory castables. The coarse and fine refractory aggregates of refractory concrete can be selected from crushed refractory bricks, andesite, basalt, bauxite clinker, sintered magnesite and chromite according to the service temperature. According to the cementitious materials used, it can be divided into silicate refractory concrete, aluminate refractory concrete, sulfate refractory concrete, phosphate refractory concrete, bauxite refractory concrete, chloride refractory concrete, etc. Generally, Portland cement is used below 900 ° C, bauxite cement is used between 1200 ° C and 1630 ° C, and aluminate cement can be used above 300 ° C and 1400 ° C. If the temperature requirement is higher, aluminum phosphate cementitious materials can be used. This kind of concrete is widely used in the construction and lining of industrial kilns, as well as in thermal equipment, chimneys, metallurgy, petroleum, nuclear power and other fields. It should be noted that the conditions used below 900 ° C are usually referred to as heat-resistant concrete.

explanation_cn: 以耐火纤维棉为主要原料制成的毯、毡、板、绳、纸等高温隔热制品。其密度小、热导率低，热稳定性和抗机械震动性能好，可广泛应用于各种工业窑炉。
explanation_en: High temperature insulation products such as blankets, felt, boards, ropes, paper, etc. made mainly of fire-resistant fiber cotton. Its low density, low thermal conductivity, good thermal stability and mechanical vibration resistance can be widely used in various industrial kilns.

explanation_cn: 用喷射机进行喷射施工的、由耐火纤维和耐火粉料、结合剂及外加剂组成的混合泥料。用作工业炉窑的隔热衬或工作衬。
explanation_en: A mixed mud material composed of refractory fibers and refractory powder, binders, and additives used for spraying construction using a spraying machine. Used as an insulation lining or working lining for industrial furnaces.

explanation_cn: 一般规定在600°C时保温一定时间(1-3h)的屈服强度大于室温屈服强度的2/3，用于钢结构建筑或高层大型建筑的在一定条件下具有防火抗坍塌功能的工程结构钢。添加适当的合金元素如铌、钼等并采用控制轧制工艺，利用碳氮化物的沉淀强化以及合金元素的固溶强化，可明显提高钢材的高温屈服强度从而得到耐火钢。
explanation_en: It is generally specified that the yield strength of insulation at 600 ° C for a certain period of time (1-3h) is greater than 2/3 of the room temperature yield strength. It is used for engineering structural steel of steel structure buildings or high-rise large buildings with fire and collapse resistance under certain conditions. Adding appropriate alloy elements such as niobium, molybdenum, etc. and adopting controlled rolling process, precipitation strengthening of carbonitride and solution strengthening of alloy elements can significantly improve the high-temperature yield strength of steel product and thus obtain fire-resistant steel.

explanation_cn: 由直径小于1-2μm的多种含水铝硅酸盐矿物组成的混合体。主要成分为Al2O3和SiO2。分为硬质、软质和半软质黏土。其耐火性能随Al2O3的增加而提高。
explanation_en: By diameter less than 1-2 μ M, a mixture of various hydrated aluminum silicate mineral. The main components are Al2O3 and SiO2. It is divided into hard, soft and semi soft clay. Its fire resistance increases with the increase of Al2O3.

explanation_cn: 在高温热流作用下能够发生分解、熔化、蒸发、升华和侵蚀等化学和物理变化的材料，借助材料表面的质量迁移来吸收热量，从而实现热防护的作用。这些复合材料通常用于高温环境下，以保护结构或设备免受热流的侵害。烧蚀复合材料的机理可以分为不同类型，包括：升华型烧蚀：例如碳/碳复合材料，材料在高温下升华为气体，以吸收热量来保护下方的结构。熔化型烧蚀：例如石英和玻璃基复合材料，材料在高温下熔化并流动，以消耗热量。碳化型烧蚀：例如碳纤维增强酚醛树脂复合材料，材料中的碳化物在高温下发生化学反应，以抵抗高温侵蚀。烧蚀复合材料还可以根据密度的不同分为高密度和低密度两种。高密度复合材料包括各种纤维增强塑料和碳/碳复合材料等，而低密度烧蚀复合材料通常以轻质填料为基质，结合酚醛树脂和硅橡胶等基体材料，其密度可以根据具体应用需求进行调整，可在一定范围内变化。这些复合材料在航空航天和高温环境中的应用中具有重要价值，用于保护材料和设备免受高温侵蚀。
explanation_en: Materials that can undergo chemical and physical changes such as decomposition, melting, evaporation, sublimation and erosion under the action of high temperature heat flow absorb heat with the help of mass transport (nuclear) on the surface of materials, thus realizing the role of thermal protection. These composite materials are usually used in high temperature environments to protect structures or equipment from heat flow. The mechanism of ablating composite materials can be divided into different types, including sublimation ablation: for example, carbon/carbon composhes, materials sublimate into gases at high temperatures to absorb heat to protect the structure below. Melting ablation: for example, quartze and glass matrix composite, materials melt and flow at high temperatures to consume heat. Carbonization ablation: for example, carbon fiber reinforced phenolic resin composite materials, carbide in materials reacts at high temperature to resist high-temperature erosion. Ablative composite materials can also be divided into high density and low density according to the different density. High density composite materials include various fiber reinforced plastics and carbon/carbon composhes, while low density ablative composite materials usually use light fillers as the matrix, combined with matrix materials such as phenolic resin and silicon rubber, their density can be adjusted according to specific application needs, and can change within a certain range. These composite materials have important value in aerospace and high-temperature environment applications, and are used to protect materials and equipment from high-temperature corrosion.

explanation_cn: 耐热低感炸药是指对外界烤燃(可以经受220°C)、冲击波、破片撞击等具有较低易损特性的炸药。
explanation_en: Thermally stable and insensitive explosives refer to explosive with low vulnerability characteristics to external baking (can withstand 220 ° C), shock wave, fragment impact, etc.

explanation_cn: 见抗热震性。
explanation_en: See thermal shock resistance.

explanation_cn: 泛指一切在高温应用的结构用合金，包括耐热钢、高温合金、难熔金属合金、钛合金和高温铝合金等。在中国高温合金发展的早期阶段，人们往往把高温合金翻译成耐热合金，如把《Nimonic alloy》一书译成尼莫尼克镍铬耐热合金等。由于科技的不断发展，人们用更精准的名称对高温应用的合金进行归类，如耐热钛合金，耐热铝合金等，一般不用耐热合金这个名称了。
explanation_en: It generally refers to all structural alloy used in high-temperature applications, including heat resistant steel, high temperature alloy, refractory metal alloy, titanium alloy and high-temperature aluminum alloy. In the early stage of the development of high temperature alloy in China, people tend to translate high temperature alloy into heat resistant alloy, such as Nimonic alloy into Nimonic heat resistant alloy. Due to the continuous development of science and technology, people use more accurate names to classify alloy for high temperature applications, such as heat resistant titanium alloy, heat-resistant aluminum alloy, etc., and generally do not use the name heat resistant alloy.

explanation_cn: 无机材料机械强度开始显著降低以前的温度。对耐火材料的原料和制品耐熔(指无显著变形、在大气中无显著化学变化、强度无显著降低)性能的一种量度。一般将待测材料做成与标准测温赛克锥形状大小相同的试样锥，将其与标准赛克锥一起以一定加热速率同吋加热，比较其变形程度而得。对水泥混凝土是指耐热作用的能力。水泥耐热性与水泥品种有关，矿渣水泥优于普通水泥。对玻璃则指夹层玻璃在特定试验条件下，承受一定的温度作用而不引起破坏，起泡和脱胶的能力。
explanation_en: The mechanical strength of inorganic materials began to significantly reduce the previous temperature. A measure of the melting resistance (no significant deformation, no significant chemical change in the atmosphere, and no significant reduction in strength) of raw materials and products of refractory. Generally, the material to be tested is made into a sample cone with the same shape and size as the standard temperature measurement cone. It is heated together with the standard temperature measurement cone at a certain heating rate at the same time, and the degree of deformation is compared. For cement concrete, it refers to the ability of heat resistance. The heat resistance of cement is related to the type of cement, and slag cement is superior to ordinary cement. For glass, it refers to the ability of laminated glass to withstand certain temperature without causing damage, foaming and degumming under specific test conditions.

explanation_cn: 通常把Al-Cu-Mn系硬铝合金称为耐热硬铝，在淬火人工时效状态下使用。可用来制造250-350℃下长期工作的锻件和焊件，如压气机叶片、压气机盘、燃料容器等。
explanation_en: Al Cu Mn series hard aluminium alloy is usually called heat resistance hard aluminium alloy, which is used in the state of quenching and artificial aging. It can be used to manufacture forgings and weldments that work for a long time at 250-350 ℃, such as compressor blades, compressor discs, fuel containers, etc.

explanation_cn: 涂层的发展可以分为四代，主要用于耐受高温腐蚀的涂层，特别是在熔融碱性金属盐介质中。这些涂层在性能要求方面逐渐提高：第一代涂层是单元系，例如AKCr；第二代涂层是二元系，例如Al-Cr和Al-Si；第三代涂层是多元系，例如MCrAlY（其中M可以是Fe、Ni、Co）、NiCoCrAlY、NiCoCrAlTaY等；第四代涂层是Pt-Al系。这些涂层的厚度范围很广，从几十微米到200微米。使用寿命方面，第一代和第二代涂层可以达到几千小时，而第三代比前两代提高了一倍以上。第四代涂层相对于多元系寿命提高了两倍以上。这些涂层的制备方法和工艺多种多样。例如，单元系涂层可以使用粉末包装法或气相渗Al法；二元系涂层可以采用粉末包装共渗，Cr-Al涂层则需要使用两步法；多元系涂层（如Co-CrAlY）可以使用等离子喷涂工艺；而Pt-Al系涂层则是通过先电镀Pt，然后再进行Al渗透的方法制备的。
explanation_en: The development of coatings can be divided into four generations, which are mainly used for coatings resistant to high temperature corrosion, especially in molten alkaline metal salt medium. These coatings gradually improve in terms of performance requirements: the first generation coatings are unit systems, such as AKCr; The second generation coatings are binary systems, such as Al Cr and Al Si; The third generation coating is a multicomponent system, such as MCrAlY (where M can be Fe, Ni, Co), NiCoCrAlY, NiCoCrAlTaY, etc; The fourth generation coating is the Pt Al system. These coatings have a wide range of thicknesses, ranging from tens of micrometers to 200 micrometers. In terms of service life, the first generation and the second generation of coatings can reach several thousand hours, while the third generation has more than doubled the previous two generations. The fourth generation coating has increased its lifespan by more than twice compared to the multi-component system. There are various preparation methods and processes for these coatings. For example, the unit system coating can use the powder packaging method or the vapor infiltration Al method; Binary system coating can adopt powder packaging penetration, while Cr Al coating requires two-step method; Multi system coating (such as Co CrAlY) can use plasma spraying process; The Pt Al coating is prepared by electroplating Pt first, followed by Al infiltration.

explanation_cn: 在高温环境中保持较高强度和良好化学稳定性的合金钢。高温环境下工作的工件，将与高温空气、蒸汽、燃气等接触，这一方面会使其强度降低，另一方面会影响钢的化学稳定性。钢在高温下能保持具有较高的强度而不致发生明显变形或破断的特性称为热强性，而在高温下能持久使用而不形成氧化铁皮或不产生明显腐蚀的特性称为抗氧化性。由此，耐热钢一般可分为热强钢和抗氧化钢(或称耐热不起皮钢)两大类。为满足耐热钢的性能要求，可加人12%以上的CT及少量Al、Si等合金元素以提高钢的抗氧化性，加入Ni、Co、Cu、Mo、W、Cr、Al、Nb、Ti等合金元素以提高钢的热强性。因此，大部分高合金耐热钢的化学成分与不锈钢非常接近，很多钢号既属于耐热钢也属于不锈钢(我国耐热钢国家标准GB/T4238-2007中的钢号均包含在不锈钢与耐热钢标准GB/T20878-2007中)。然而，耐热钢对髙温强度和抗氧化性的需求与不锈钢对室温耐蚀性的需求毕竟是不同的，在钢种化学成分设计及生产工艺技术方面需要慎重考虑和区别对待。耐热钢根据其组织和特性可分为珠光体耐热钢、马氏体耐热钢、奥氏体耐热钢和铁素体耐热钢。耐热钢广泛用于蒸汽锅炉、汽轮机、涡轮机、内燃机、喷气发动机、工业炉构件等方面。
explanation_en: Alloy steel with high strength and good chemical stability at high temperature. Workpieces working in high temperature environment will contact with high temperature air, steam, gas, etc., which will reduce their strength on the one hand, and affect the chemical stability of steel on the other hand. The characteristic that steel can maintain high strength without obvious deformation or fracture at high temperature is called thermal strength, while the characteristic that it can be used for a long time without scale formation or obvious corrosion at high temperature is called oxidation resistance. Therefore, heat resistant steel can generally be divided into two categories: heat strengthened steel and oxidation resistant steel (or heat resistant and non peeling steel). In order to meet the performance requirements of heat resistant steel, more than 12% CT and a small amount of alloy elements such as Al, Si can be added to improve the oxidation resistance of steel, and alloy elements such as Ni, Co, Cu, Mo, W, Cr, Al, Nb, Ti can be added to improve the thermal strength of steel. Therefore, the chemical composition of most high alloy heat resistant steel is very close to that of stainless steel, and many steel designation belong to both heat resistant steel and stainless steel (steel designation in the national standard of heat resistant steel GB/T4238-2007 are included in the standard of stainless steel and heat resistant steel GB/T20878-2007). However, the demand for high temperature strength and oxidation resistance of heat resistant steel is different from the demand for room temperature corrosion resistance of stainless steel, which requires careful consideration and different treatment in terms of steel chemical composition design and production process technology. Heat resistant steel can be divided into pearlitic heat-resistant steel, martensitic heat resistant steel, austenitic heat-resistant steel and ferritic heat-resistant steel according to its structure and characteristics. Heat resistant steel is widely used in steam boilers, steam turbines, turbines, internal combustion engines, jet engines, industrial furnace components, etc.

explanation_cn: 是一类用于高温（超过400°C）工作条件的钛合金。它们具有良好的高温强度、抗蠕变性和长时间高温暴露后的热稳定性。这些合金的铸造工艺性能也很好，并且不容易发生严重的热裂倾向。工业中的耐热铸造钛合金可以分为三种类型：第一类是近α钛合金，例如Ti-6Al-5Zr-0.5Mo-0.25Si和Ti-5.5Al-3.5Sn-3Zr-1Nb-0.3Mo-0.3Si合金。第二类是含钼的α+β钛合金，其组织包括α相、α2相、β相和硅化物。例如Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Mo-2Zr、Ti-4Al-4Mo-2Sn-0.5Si和Ti-6.5Al-3.5Mo-2Zr-0.3Si合金。第三类是在凝固时形成高熔点固相的铸造钛合金，其组织包括α相、β相、高熔点固相和难熔化合物。例如Ti-5Al-5Mo-5Sn-0.5Si-0.3WC-0.3Ce合金。耐热铸造钛合金在航空航天工业中扮演着重要的角色，主要用于航空发动机的压气机机匣、叶轮、火箭结构件等部件。
explanation_en: It is a type of titanium alloy used for high-temperature (over 400 ° C) working conditions. They have good high temperature strength, creep resistance and thermal stability after long-term high temperature exposure. These alloy have good foundry properties and are not prone to serious hot tear. Heat resistant titanium alloy in industry can be divided into three types: α Titanium alloy, such as Ti-6Al-5Zr-0.5Mo-0.25Si and Ti-5.5Al-3.5Sn-3Zr-1Nb-0.3Mo-0.3Si alloy. The second type is molybdenum containing α+β Titanium alloy, its structure includes α Phase α 2 phase β Phase and silicide. For example, Ti-6Al-2Sn-4Mo-2Zr, Ti-4Al-4Mo-2Sn-0.5Si and Ti-6.5Al-3.5Mo-2Zr-0.3Si alloy. The third type is cast titanium alloy that forms high melting point solid phase during solidification, and its structure includes α Phase β Phase, high melting point solid phase and refractory compound. For example, Ti-5Al-5Mo-5Sn-0.5Si-0.3WC-0.3Ce alloy. Heat resistant titanium alloy plays an important role in aerospace industry, mainly used for compressor casing, impeller, rocket structure parts and other components of aeroengine.

explanation_cn: 是指在高温(200°C至300°C)时，具有足够的抗氧化性，在长时间的温度和载荷（包括动态和静态载荷）作用下，具备抵抗塑性变形（蠕变）和破坏的能力的合金。耐热铸造铝合金主要包括Al-Si系耐热铝合金（如ZL105、ZL109、ZIJ11合金）、Al-Cu系耐热铝合金（如ZL206、ZL208）、Al-RE系耐热铝合金（如ZL207合金）等。其中，Al-Si系耐热铝合金在300°C时抗拉强度一般都小于90MPa，实际使用温度一般不超过150°C；Al-Cu系耐热铝合金在300°C时抗拉强度可达160至170MPa，实际使用温度范围为200°C至300°C；AIRE系耐热铝合金在300°C时抗拉强度可达115MPa，但室温下的强度相对较低（小于200MPa），因此在室温下的性能利用率不高。

explanation_cn: 用于200°C至300°C工作温度下的铸造镁合金，具有在高温下保持组织稳定性、高屈服强度和抗蠕变性能的特点。工业中的耐热铸造镁合金主要包括两个系列：Mg-RE系合金：包括Mg-RE-Zn-Zr、WE43、Mg-10Gd-3Y-0.5Zr等合金。经过热处理后，这些合金可以在200°C至250°C的高温下长期使用。它们具有良好的铸造性能，组织致密性好，适合生产各种复杂的铸件。 Mg-Th系合金：包括Mg-Th-Zr、Mg-Th-Zn-Zr等合金。这些合金的使用温度可达300°C，但需要注意的是，钍（Th）具有放射性，因此在生产过程中需要采取一定的安全措施。耐热铸造镁合金主要用于高温下长期工作的零件，如发动机机匣、整流舱、电动机机匣、液压系统壳体等。
explanation_en: It is used for cast magnesium alloy at operating temperature from 200 ° C to 300 ° C, and has the characteristics of maintaining structural stability, high yield strength and creep resistance at high temperature. Heat resistant cast magnesium alloy in industry mainly include two series: Mg RE series alloy, including Mg RE Zn Zr, WE43, Mg-10Gd-3Y-0.5Zr and other alloy. After heat treatment, these alloy can be used for a long time at a high temperature of 200 ° C to 250 ° C. They have good castability and good structure density, and are suitable for producing various complex castings. Mg Th alloy: including Mg Th Zr, Mg Th Zn Zr and other alloy. The service temperature of these alloy can reach 300 ° C, but it should be noted that thorium (Th) is radioactive, so certain safety measures need to be taken in the production process. Heat resistant cast magnesium alloy is mainly used for parts that work for a long time under high temperature, such as engine casing, rectifier cabin, motor casing, hydraulic system shell, etc.

explanation_cn: 材料在一定环境因素（如温度、湿度、气氛、液体介质）和应力作用下保持不开裂的能力，可以通过应力开裂实验进行测量。应力开裂是指在低于材料机械强度的应力作用下，在材料内部和外部形成可肉眼观察到的裂纹。例如，根据GB/T1842-2008的要求，可以在聚乙烯样片表面进行人为刻痕并进行弯曲试验，然后将这些样片浸入不同温度的不同液体介质中。在此过程中，可以平行测试不少于十个试样，并记录试样裂纹率达到50%所需的时间。这个时间越长，说明材料的耐环境应力开裂能力越强，即具有更好的耐应力开裂性能。
explanation_en: The ability of materials to remain uncracked under certain environmental factors (such as temperature, humidity, atmosphere, liquid medium) and stress can be measured through stress cracking experiments. Stress cracking refers to the formation of visible cracks inside and outside the materials under the action of a stress lower than the mechanical strength of the materials. For example, according to the requirements of GB/T1842-2008, artificial nicking and bending test can be conducted on the surface of polyethylene samples, and then these samples can be immersed in different liquid media at different temperatures. During this process, no less than ten specimens can be tested in parallel and the time required for the crack rate of the specimens to reach 50% can be recorded. The longer this time is, the stronger the environmental stress cracking resistance resistance of materials is, that is, it has better stress cracking resistance.

explanation_cn: 绝缘材料表面经受电弧作用而不破坏的能力。电弧有高压，小电流电弧及低压大电流电弧，在试验时是记取材料在电弧作用下产生破坏所需的时间。具体试验方法参见高压电弧起迹试验。该性能对于用于高压开关或低压大电流开关的绝缘材料有着重要意义，因为在开关启闭时，常会受到电弧的作用，只有耐电弧性好的材料才能被选用。
explanation_en: The ability of insulating surface of materials to withstand the action of arc without damage. There are high-voltage, low current and low-voltage high current arcs. During the test, the time required for materials to be damaged under the action of the arc is recorded. Please refer to the high-voltage arc tracing test for specific test methods. This property is of great significance for insulating materials used for high-voltage switches or low-voltage high current switches, because they are often subject to the action of arc when the switch is opened and closed, and only materials with good arc resistance can be selected.

explanation_cn: 耐碱混凝土通常采用耐碱性能出色的硅酸盐类水泥作为凝胶材料，将石灰岩和火成岩类用作耐碱骨料。它还包含一些细粉料，以较低的水灰比比例制成，具有密实性、抗渗性和抗碱腐蚀能力较强的特性。耐碱混凝土具有较高的抗压强度和较好的耐久性（主要表现在抗渗性方面）。在摄氏50°C以下的条件下，它能够抵抗浓度为25%的氢氧化钠（NaOH）和氢氧化铝（铝酸钠）溶液的腐蚀，同时也可以抵御任何浓度的氨水、碳酸钠溶液、碱性气体和粉尘等的腐蚀。根据所使用的凝胶材料的不同，耐碱混凝土可以分为四种类型：使用普通硅酸盐类水泥制成的混凝土，抗压强度大于20MPa，抗渗标号大于1.2MPa，能够抵抗浓度低于15%的NaOH等碱液的腐蚀。使用硫黄制成的混凝土，可以抵抗浓度为1%的NaOH溶液的腐蚀。使用石油沥青制成的混凝土，可以抵抗浓度小于20%的NaOH溶液的腐蚀。使用聚合物制成的混凝土，可以抵抗浓度不超过50%的NaOH溶液的腐蚀。在混凝土的制备过程中，需要严格控制骨料的级配，降低空隙率，提高密实度，降低水灰比。此外，还需要选择合适的密实性外加剂。耐碱混凝土主要用于冶金和化学工业中，例如地面、池槽等需要抵抗碱液腐蚀的场合，以及室内存在较高浓度碱蒸气的环境。
explanation_en: Alkali resistant concrete usually uses Portland cement with excellent alkali resistance as gel materials, and limestone and igneous rock as alkali resistant aggregate. It also contains some fine powder, which is made with low water cement ratio, and has strong compactness, impermeability and alkali corrosion resistance. Alkali resistant concrete has higher compressive strength and better durability (mainly in impermeability). At the temperature below 50 ° C, it can resist the corrosion of 25% sodium hydroxide (NaOH) and aluminum hydroxide (sodium aluminate) solutions, as well as the corrosion of ammonia, sodium carbonate solution, alkaline gas and dust at any concentration. According to the different gel materials used, alkali resistant concrete can be divided into four types: concrete made of ordinary Portland cement, with compressive strength greater than 20MPa and impermeability grade greater than 1.2MPa, can resist the corrosion of NaOH and other alkaline liquids with concentration less than 15%. The concrete made of sulfur can resist the corrosion of 1% NaOH solution. Concrete made of petroleum pitch can resist corrosion of NaOH solution with concentration less than 20%. Concrete made of polymer can resist corrosion of NaOH solution with concentration no more than 50%. During the preparation of concrete, it is necessary to strictly control the aggregate gradation, reduce the void ratio, improve the compactness and reduce the water cement ratio. In addition, it is also necessary to choose appropriate compactness additives. Alkali resistant concrete is mainly used in metallurgical and chemical industries, such as the ground, tanks and other places that need to resist the corrosion of alkali liquor, and the indoor environment where there is high concentration of alkali vapor.

explanation_cn: 在碱液介质中耐腐蚀作用的钢。在一定的应力下或在一定的低浓度碱液中，可采用奥氏体不锈钢，而在高浓度喊液或高应力条件下，则应采用高纯铁素体不锈钢。
explanation_en: Steel resistant to corrosion in alkaline medium. Under certain stress or certain low concentration alkaline solution, austenilic stainless steel can be used, while under high concentration solution or high stress conditions, high-purity ferritic stainless steel should be used.

explanation_cn: 能用于同时经受磨料磨损和腐浊的场合，主要合金元素是铬和镍的一类合金钢。有三种类型:奥氏体不锈钢；马氏体不锈钢；铁素体不锈钢，退火态的硬度为HV180。一般在磨料磨损占优势的腐蚀磨损过程中，宜选用马氏体型不锈钢，在腐蚀占优势的腐蚀磨损过程中，宜选用奥氏体型的。铁素体不锈钢的抗腐蚀能力优于马氏体型而逊于奥氏体型，但其价格则低于奥氏体型。
explanation_en: It can be used for occasions that can withstand abrasive wear and corrosion at the same time. The main alloy elements are chromium and nickel, a kind of alloy steel. There are three types: austenilic stainless steel; Martensitic stainless steel; Ferritic stainless steel, hardness of annealing state is HV180. In general, martensite stainless steel should be selected in the corrosive wear process dominated by abrasive wear, and austenite type should be selected in the corrosive wear process dominated by corrosion. The corrosion resistance of ferritic stainless steel is better than that of martensite and worse than that of austenite, but its price is lower than that of austenite.

explanation_cn: 在耐磨合金钢中，合金元素总量不得高于5%即称为低合金钢，低合金钢的力学性能特别是硬度和初性可以在很大的范围内调整，可根据不同的使用条件，将强度、冲击韧度和耐磨性能综合考虑和匹配。通常低合金耐磨钢以高强韧性、高硬韧性著称。其强度和硬度高于耐磨锰钢而在非大冲击磨损工况可替代锰钢;其塑、韧性高于耐磨铸铁，而在一定冲击载荷的磨损工况，使用寿命高于耐磨铸铁。耐磨钢加入合金元素的主要目的在于提高淬透性、强度、韧度和耐磨性。最常用的添加元素是Mo、Cr、Mn、Ni、和Si等。耐磨低合金钢的铸造、焊接性能与其他低合金钢相似，碳量高时焊接性能较差。低合金耐磨钢，可按热处理和含碳量分类。
explanation_en: In wear resistant alloy steel, the total amount of alloy elements shall not be more than 5%, which is called low alloy steel. The mechanical properties of low alloy steel, especially hardness and initial properties, can be adjusted in a large range. Strength, impact toughness and wear resistance can be comprehensively considered and matched according to different service conditions. Generally, wear-resisting low alloy steel is famous for its high strength and toughness. Its strength and hardness are higher than that of wear-resistant manganese steel, and it can replace manganese steel under non large impact wear conditions; Its plasticity and toughness are higher than that of wear resistance cast iron, and its service life is higher than that of wear resistance cast iron under a certain impact load under wear conditions. The main purpose of adding alloy elements to wear-resistant steel is to improve hardenabilhy, strength, toughness and wear resistance. The most commonly used added elements are Mo, Cr, Mn, Ni, and Si. The foundry and weld properties of wear resistant low alloy steel are similar to those of other low alloy steel, and the weld properties are poor when the carbon content is high. Wear-resisting low alloy steel can be classified according to heat treatment and carbon content.

explanation_cn: 为提高机械装备的耐磨性，开发出了各种合金。其中，铁基耐磨合金应用最广泛，包括各类工具钢、轴承钢以及凿岩、破碎机械等领域的高锰钢和各类耐磨铸铁。高硬度和强韧的基体与硬质的第二相是构成耐磨铁基合金的基本原则。这些合金的碳含量通常较高（大约0.8%或更高），同时还应含有一定量的Cr（铬）、V（钒）、Ti（钛）、Mo（钼）等元素，这些元素可以形成坚硬的碳化物。根据所受载荷的高低以及冲击负荷的大小，可以将合金的基体相选定为马氏体（用于低冲击情况）或能发生相变的奥氏体相（用于高冲击情况）。高钴合金也是耐磨减摩轴瓦的典型材料，由强韧或软质基体中嵌入硬质的颗粒或岛状强化物组成。耐磨合金通常采用传统的冶炼、铸造、锻造工艺或粉末冶金工艺进行制造。
explanation_en: In order to improve the wear resistance of mechanical equipment, various alloy have been developed. Among them, iron based wear resistant alloy is the most widely used, including all kinds of tool steel, bearing steel, high manganese steel and all kinds of wear resistance cast iron in rock drilling, crushing machinery and other fields. High hardness, strong and tough matrix and hard second phase are the basic principles of forming wear-resistant iron base alloy. These alloy usually have a high carbon content (about 0.8% or more), and also contain a certain amount of Cr, V, Ti, Mo and other elements, which can form hard carbide. According to the load and impact load, the matrix phase of alloy can be selected as martensite (for low impact cases) or austenite phase that can undergo transformation (for high impact cases). High cobalt alloy is also a typical materials of wear-resistant antifriction bearing bush, which is composed of hard particles or island reinforcements embedded in a strong or soft matrix. Wear resistant alloy is usually manufactured by traditional smelting, foundry, forging process or powder metallurgy process.

explanation_cn: 某种材料在一定的摩擦条件下抵抗磨损的能力，通常以磨损量或磨损率的倒数表示。耐磨性不完全是材料的固有特性，是与磨损条件(如载荷、速度、温度等)和材料特性等因素有关的摩擦学系统特性。
explanation_en: The ability of a certain materials to resist wear under certain friction conditions is usually expressed as the reciprocal of wear amount or wear rate. Wear resistance is not completely an inherent characteristic of materials, but a tribological system characteristic related to wear conditions (such as load, speed, temperature, etc.) and materials characteristics.

explanation_cn: 以化学方法改变普通有机玻璃大分子结构或经表面处理制得耐擦伤、耐刻划的有机玻璃。前者是采用交联共聚法，在聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯线型大分子链段间引入交联剂形成网状交联结构;后者有真空涂膜法、夹层聚合法和表面涂层法。耐磨有机玻璃具有较好的表面耐擦伤性、耐刻划性，同时具有耐化学腐蚀、耐磨涂层附着力强等优点。适用于飞机舷窗、侧风挡、建筑物和车辆、售货亭、自动电话间的窗玻璃及电器仪表盘、安全防护罩等。
explanation_en: The scratch resistant and scratch resistant organic glass is prepared by chemically changing the macromolecular structure of ordinary organic glass or by surface treatment. The former adopts crosslinking copolymerization method, introducing cross linking agent between linear macromolecular segments of polymethyl methacrylate to form a network crosslinking structure; The latter includes vacuum coating method, interlayer polymerization method, and surface coating method. The wear-resistant organic glass has good surface scratch resistance, scratch resistance, chemical corrosion resistance and strong adhesion of wear resistant coating. Suitable for window glass, electrical instrument panel, safety protective cover, etc. in aircraft portholes, side windshields, buildings and vehicles, kiosks, automatic telephone rooms.

explanation_cn: 具有高硬度、韧性、润滑性以及与摩擦材料相容等特性。制备耐磨涂层的工艺技术方法主要包括：热喷涂技术：包括氧乙炔火焰喷涂、等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂以及高速火焰喷涂。电火花强化涂层技术。真空镀膜和化学气相沉积。离子束溅射与离子镀工艺。电镀与表面阳极氧化技术。不同种类的耐磨涂层包括：氧化物，如Cr2O3、Al2O3、Al2(VTiC)2、TiO2，用于石化工业的泵柱、磨环和轴套，以提供防腐和抗磨损的表面。碳化物，如CrC、WC、TiC，以及它们与金属的复合物，主要用于抵抗气蚀磨损和冲击磨损，例如用于航空发动机的风扇叶汽凸台、压气机衬套和齿轮箱转动装置。氮化物，如TiN，用于机械工业中，如刀具、模具和工具的表面涂层，以提高使用寿命、功率和产品质量。这些涂层技术和材料的选择取决于具体应用的要求，以提供所需的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。
explanation_en: It has the characteristics of high hardness, toughness, lubricity and compatibility with friction materials. The technological methods for preparing wear resistant coating mainly include: thermal spraying technology, including oxyacetylene flame spraying, plasma spraying, detonmion spraying and high-speed flame spraying. Electric spark strengthening coating technology. Vacuum coating and chemical vapor deposition. Ion beam sputtering and ion plating processes. Electroplating and surface anodizing technology. Different kinds of wear resistant coating include oxides, such as Cr2O3, Al2O3, Al2 (VTiC) 2, TiO2, and pump columns, wear rings, and shaft sleeves used in the petrochemical industry to provide corrosion and wear resistant surfaces. Carbide, such as CrC, WC, TiC, and their composites with metals, are mainly used to resist cavitation wear and impact wear, such as fan blade bosses, compressor bushings, and gear box rotating devices for aeroengines. Nitrides, such as TiN, are used in the machinery industry, such as the surface coating of tools, molds and tools, to improve service life, power and product quality. The selection of these coating technologies and materials depends on the requirements of the specific application to provide the required wear resistance resistance and corrosion resistance.

explanation_cn: 具有较高耐磨性的钢-根据合金元素总含量可分为低合金耐磨钢(合金元素总含量小于中合金耐磨钢(合金元素总含量-5%-10%之间)和高合金耐磨钢(合金元素总含ft大于1O%):根据用途分为矿用耐磨钢、农机具用耐磨钢、工程机械用耐磨钢、钢轨钢、履带钢、耐气蚀钢、耐磨蚀钢等；根据主要合金元素可分为高锰钢、耐磨不锈钢、中碳铬钼锰硅合金钢、高碳珠光体耐磨钢、低合金高强度耐磨钢。
explanation_en: Steel with high wear resistance can be divided into wear-resisting low alloy steel according to the total content of alloy elements (the total content of alloy elements is less than medium alloy wear-resistant steel (the total content of alloy elements is between -5% and 10%) and high alloy wear-resistant steel (the total content of alloy elements is more than 10%): according to the use, it can be divided into wear-resistant steel for mining, wear-resistant steel for agricultural machinery, wear-resistant steel for engineering machinery, rail steel, crawler steel, cavitation resistant steel, wear resistant steel, etc; According to the main alloy elements, it can be divided into high manganese steel, wear resistant stainless steel, medium carbon chromium molybdenum manganese silicon alloy steel, high carbon pearlite wear-resistant steel, low alloy high strength wear-resistant steel.

explanation_cn: 铜基耐磨合金主要分为两大类：青铜和黄铜。铜合金因其出色的导热、导电和耐腐蚀性能而在摩擦系统，特别是导电器件中得到广泛应用。在青铜类中，含有高比例铜的铍青铜（含约2%的铍）是最佳的耐磨铜合金之一。由于其硬度、疲劳强度和耐腐蚀性都很出色，因此在高速、较高温度（约300°C）下作为轴承和精密齿轮材料非常合适。锡青铜和铝青铜是在二元合金中加入少量其他元素，如铁、镍、锌、锰、磷等，以改善其性能。除了固溶强化相以外，它们还包含一些硬质金属间化合物，具有很高的耐磨性，通常用于制造巴氏合金的轴承衬套。在黄铜中，添加锡、铝、锰、铅或硅等元素可以在保持其力学性能或加工性能基本不变的条件下，形成锡（铝、锰或硅）黄铜。这些添加元素在提高合金的抗腐蚀性和耐磨减摩性能方面发挥显著作用。开发耐磨黄铜合金的主要目标是寻找青铜的替代品，黄铜与青铜的用途相似，主要用于制造耐磨零件，如齿轮、轴瓦和轴套。
explanation_en: Copper based wear resistant alloy are mainly divided into two categories: bronze and brass. Copper alloys are widely used in friction systems, especially in conductive devices, due to their excellent thermal conductivity, conductivity, and corrosion resistance. In the bronze category, beryllium bronze (containing about 2% beryllium) with a high proportion of copper is one of the best wear resistant copper alloy. Because of its excellent hardness, fatigue strength and corrosion resistance, it is very suitable for bearing and precision gear materials at high speed and high temperature (about 300 ° C). Tin bronze and aluminium bronze are binary alloy with a small amount of other elements, such as iron, nickel, zinc, manganese, phosphorus, etc., to improve their performance. In addition to solution strengthened phase, they also contain some hard intermetallic compounds with high wear resistance, which are usually used to manufacture Babbitt metal bearing bushings. Adding elements such as tin, aluminum, manganese, lead or silicon into brass can form tin (aluminum, manganese or silicon) brass while maintaining its mechanical properties or processing properties basically unchanged. These additives play a significant role in improving the corrosion resistance, wear resistance and friction reduction of alloy. The main goal of developing wear-resistant brass alloy is to find substitutes for bronze. brass is similar to bronze in use and is mainly used to manufacture wear-resistant parts, such as gears, bearing shells and bearing sleeves.

explanation_cn: 在含硅量超过铝硅合金共晶点（硅约为11.7%）的合金中，硅颗粒的存在能明显提高合金的耐磨性，这构成了一类广泛应用的耐磨合金。铝合金具有低密度、优良的导热性和导电性，在机械制造，特别是动力和航空机械中被广泛使用。铝及其合金表面形成致密的氧化膜，这膜可以在低载荷下提供轻微磨损的保护。但在高载荷下，氧化膜会破裂，引发严重磨损。在铝中加入适量的硅可以将从轻微磨损到严重磨损的转变载荷从40牛顿提高到120牛顿甚至240牛顿。当硅的含量达到11%或更高时，加入一定量的镍（Ni）、铜（Cu）、镁（Mg）等元素可以改善合金的综合力学性能。这些合金可以替代铸铁汽缸，以减轻重量。实践证明，影响铝硅合金的耐磨性的主要原因是硅颗粒在基体中的分布，而不仅仅是硅的含量。细小且分散的硅颗粒可以显著提高合金的耐磨性。用作汽缸的铝硅合金可以通过电化学处理，以溶解表层铝，并保留在缸内壁上嵌入基体中的初生硅颗粒。这会明显改善抗擦伤和抗磨损性能。含有约11%硅的合金因其轻质、低膨胀系数和高耐腐蚀性能等特点，成为最佳的活塞材料之一。
explanation_en: In the alloy containing more silicon than the eutectic point of Al Si alloy (about 11.7% silicon), the presence of silicon particles can significantly improve the wear resistance of alloy, which constitutes a kind of widely used wear resistant alloy. Aluminum alloys have low density, excellent thermal conductivity and conductivity, and are widely used in mechanical manufacturing, especially in power and aviation machinery. Dense oxide film is formed on the surface of aluminum and its alloy, which can provide slight wear protection under low load. However, under high load, the oxide film will break, causing serious wear. Adding an appropriate amount of silicon to aluminum can increase the transformation load from mild wear to severe wear from 40 N to 120 N or even 240 N. When the content of silicon reaches 11% or more, the comprehensive mechanical properties of alloy can be improved by adding a certain amount of nickel (Ni), copper (Cu), magnesium (Mg) and other elements. These alloy can replace cast iron cylinders to reduce weight. Practice has proved that the main reason affecting the wear resistance of Al Si alloy is the distribution of silicon particles in the matrix, not just the silicon content. Fine and dispersed silicon particles can significantly improve the wear resistance of alloy. The aluminum silicon alloy used as the cylinder can be treated by electrochemistry to dissolve the surface aluminum and retain the primary silicon particles embedded in the matrix on the inner wall of the cylinder. This will significantly improve the resistance to scratches and wear. Alloy containing about 11% silicon has become one of the best piston materials because of its light weight, low expansion coefficient and high corrosion resistance.

explanation_cn: 具有高硬度且在一定的磨损条件下具有高耐磨性的特殊性能铸铁。包括冷硬铸铁、合金灰口铸铁、中锰球墨铸铁、高磷铸铁、合金白口铸铁等。铸铁的耐磨性主要取决于基体组织和硬化相的种类、数量、尺寸及分布，不同类型的耐磨铸铁适用于不同的工况条件。如低合金灰口(或球墨)耐磨铸铁中的石墨具有良好的固体润滑作用而加入Cr、Ni、W、Mo、Ti、V、Cu、P等合金元素形成各种硬质相(如磷共晶、合金碳化物或氮化物等)具有很高的硬度和耐磨性，有的还具有良好耐蚀性，故适用于制作机床导轨、缸套、活塞环等耐磨机械零件;合金白口铸铁(GB/T 8263-2010)抗磨料磨损能力较强，大量用作农机具、磨球、磨煤机零件、抛丸机叶片、泥浆栗等;而高铬铸铁中存在大量高硬度的含铬碳化物，对外来硬颗粒或磨料有非常良好的抵抗能力.适用于制作磨球、衬板、杂质栗过流部件等。
explanation_en: Cast iron with high hardness and high wear resistance under certain wear conditions. Including chilled cast iron, alloy grey cast iron, medium manganese ductile cast iron, high phosphorus cast iron, alloyed white cast iron, etc. The wear resistance of cast iron mainly depends on the type, quantity, size and distribution of matrix structure and hardening phase. Different types of wear resistance cast iron are suitable for different working conditions. For example, graphite in low alloy gray cast iron (or nodular graphite) wear resistance cast iron has good solid lubrication, and alloy elements such as Cr, Ni, W, Mo, Ti, V, Cu, P are added to form various hard phase (such as phosphorus eutectic, alloy carbide or nitride), which have high hardness and wear resistance, and some also have good corrosion resistance, so it is suitable for manufacturing wear-resistant mechanical parts such as machine tool guide, cylinder liner, piston ring, etc; Alloyed white cast iron (GB/T 8263-2010) has strong abrasive wear resistance and is widely used as agricultural machinery, grinding balls, coal grinding machine parts, shot blasting machine blades, mud chestnut, etc; High chromium cast iron contains a large amount of chromium containing carbide with high hardness, which has a very good resistance to foreign hard particles or abrasives. It is suitable for making grinding balls, lining plates, impurity flow passage parts, etc.

explanation_cn: 锌基合金是一种用于滑动轴承的耐磨减摩材料，通常含有一定量的铝、铜或其他元素来代替锡青铜和铅锡巴氏合金。锌合金具有较低的成本，低熔点，易于熔化和浇铸，但硬度较高，无法完全取代软质的锡基巴氏合金。在锌铝铜三元合金中，当含铝约为10%、铜约为5.0%时，合金表现出最佳的综合性能，还可以适量添加少量镁以提高合金的抗腐蚀性能。这种合金由三元共晶、二元共晶和富铝的固溶体组成，能够承受高压力，因此可用于轧钢机轴承，以替代锡青铜制品等。当向锌中添加约3%的锑时，将形成锌锑共晶合金，而当锑的含量增加到约7%时，将生成硬质相Sb2Zn3。锌锑锡合金（约94%锌，3%锑，3%锡）是Sb2Zn3三元共晶体，改善了Sb2Zn3针状硬质相在Zn-Sb二元共晶中的分布，从而提高了合金的耐磨性，同时保持了合金的整体性能。这种类型的合金主要用于轻载车辆的轴承。
explanation_en: Zinc base alloy is a kind of wear-resistant and antifriction materials used for sliding bearings, which usually contains a certain amount of aluminum, copper or other elements to replace tin bronze and lead tin babbitt alloy. Zinc alloy has low cost, low melting point, and is easy to melt and casting, but its high hardness cannot completely replace the soft tin based Babbitt metal alloy. In the zinc aluminum copper ternary alloy, when the aluminum content is about 10% and the copper content is about 5.0%, the alloy shows the best comprehensive performance, and a small amount of magnesium can be added to improve the corrosion resistance of alloy. This alloy is composed of ternary eutectic, binary eutectic and aluminum rich solid solution, which can withstand high pressure, so it can be used for rolling mill bearings to replace tin bronze products. When about 3% antimony is added to zinc, zinc antimony eutectic alloy will be formed, and when the antimony content increases to about 7%, hard phase Sb2Zn3 will be formed. Zinc antimony tin alloy (about 94% zinc, 3% antimony, 3% tin) is a ternary eutectic of Sb2Zn3, which improves the distribution of Sb2Zn3 needle like hard phase in Zn Sb binary eutectic, thus improving the wear resistance of alloy, while maintaining the overall performance of alloy. This type of alloy is mainly used for bearings of lightly loaded vehicles.

explanation_cn: 除了需要承受磨料磨损、粘着磨损和其他类型的磨损之外，还必须耐受介质腐蚀和高温氧化的影响。因此，它的工作条件比一般的耐磨钢和耐磨铸铁要复杂得多。这种材料通常具有良好的伸长率，因此常被用于在空气或低润滑液体中工作的耐磨零件，如石油化工设备、原子能设备，喷气飞机和内燃机中的阀门、泵件、活塞、活塞环、密封件、制动器、凸轮、梃杆、平板推套、轮叶和叶片等。
explanation_en: In addition to abrasive wear, adhesive wear and other types of wear, it must also withstand the impact of medium corrosion and high temperalure oxidation. Therefore, its working conditions are much more complicated than those of ordinary wear-resistant steel and wear resistance cast iron. This materials usually has good elongation, so it is often used for wear-resistant parts working in air or low lubricating liquid, such as petrochemical equipment, atomic energy equipment, valves, pump parts, pistons, piston rings, seals, brakes, cams, stiles, flat push sleeves, blades and blades in jet aircraft and internal combustion engines.

explanation_cn: 特定腐蚀环境中材料所具有的抗腐蚀能力。各种材料的腐蚀行为特征是相对的，不同环境下其耐蚀性不同。
explanation_en: The ability of materials to resist corrosion in a specific corrosion environment. The corrosion behavior characteristics of various materials are relative, and their corrosion resistance is different under different environments.

explanation_cn: 金属在介质中发生化学或电化学作用，在其表面上生成一层薄的氧化物或盐类。一般有钝化膜、阳极氧化膜、化学转化膜和高温氧化膜。这些膜能够相当程度地阻止同一介质或另一介质的腐蚀。例如，铁或不锈钢在硝酸或稀硫酸溶液中形成的钝化膜非常薄，通常只有几纳米厚，但它可以将腐蚀速率降低3到5个数量级。铁的钝化膜主要由Fe2O3组成，而不锈钢的钝化膜则主要包含Cr2O3、Fe2O3和其他氧化物。阳极氧化膜是指金属在较高阳极电位下生成的一种薄膜，例如，铝和铝合金在硫酸、草酸或铬酸溶液中进行阳极氧化，形成表面膜。这种膜的厚度通常在几十微米左右，并且可以通过封闭处理来提高其抗腐蚀性，还可以根据需要染色以用作装饰膜。化学转化膜是指金属在一种或多种化学介质中经过适当的化学处理后，在其表面上生成本金属或其他金属的化合物薄膜。例如，将黄铜在含铬的介质中处理，就会在表面生成几微米到几百微米的Cr2O3或含少量Cr2O3的薄膜，这种薄膜具有良好的抗室内大气腐蚀能力。高温氧化膜是指金属材料或涂层在含氧介质中，在高温下形成的表面氧化膜。通常，金属材料或涂层中活性较强的元素，如铝、铬和硅，会首先发生氧化并形成相应的Al2O3、Cr2O3、SiO2等薄膜。这些氧化薄膜阻碍了氧原子向内扩散和基体合金元素向外扩散，从而有效地减缓了氧化速度。
explanation_en: Metals undergo chemical or electrochemical reactions in the medium, generating a thin layer of oxides or salts on their surface. Generally, there are passive film, anodic oxide film, chemical conversion film and high-temperature oxide film. These films can prevent corrosion of the same medium or another medium to a considerable extent. For example, the passive film formed by iron or stainless steel in nitric acid or dilute sulfuric acid solution is very thin, usually only a few nanometers thick, but it can reduce the corrosion rate by 3 to 5 orders of magnitude. The passive film of iron mainly consists of Fe2O3, while the passive film of stainless steel mainly consists of Cr2O3, Fe2O3 and other oxides. Anodic oxide film refers to a kind of film formed by metal at high anodic potential. For example, aluminum and aluminum alloy are anodized in sulfuric acid, oxalic acid or chromic acid solution to form a surface facial mask. The thickness of this film is usually about tens of microns, and its corrosion resistance can be improved by sealing treatment, and it can also be dyed as decorate film as required. Chemical conversion film refers to a compound film of metal or other metals formed on the surface of a metal after appropriate chemical treatment in one or more chemical media. For example, when brass is treated in a medium containing chromium, Cr2O3 of several microns to several hundred microns or a film containing a small amount of Cr2O3 will be generated on the surface. This film has good resistance to indoor atmospheric corrosion. High temperature oxide film refers to the surface oxide film of metallic materials or coating formed at high temperature in oxygen containing medium. Generally, elements with strong activity in metallic materials or coatings, such as aluminum, chromium and silicon, will first oxidize and form corresponding Al2O3, Cr2O3, SiO2 and other films. These oxide films prevent oxygen atoms from diffusion inwards and matrix alloy elements from diffusion outwards, thus effectively slowing down the oxidation rate.

explanation_cn: 可在各种腐蚀介质中应用的钛合金。纯钛表面由于形成一层致密的、能自愈合的氧化薄膜而钝化，电极电位可达到+0.46V，使之具有比不锈钢高100倍的耐腐蚀能力。钛及其合金在非航空航天领域中的应用，主要是利用耐腐蚀性能好这一优点。工业纯钛和Ti-6Al-4V合金广泛用于制造生产对苯二甲酸、尿素、乙醛、丙酮、氯气和乙酸等化工产品的设备；在石油精炼、纤维着色、纸浆制造和金属电镀设备中也是不可少的。为改善在高氯离子浓度介质中的抗缝隙腐蚀能力，发展了Ti-0.2Pd和Ti-0.8Ni-0.3Mo合金。在浓度为20%的盐酸中，工业纯钛在60°C下的年腐蚀速率为25.6mm，而Ti-0.2Pd合金只有0.255mm，相差约100倍。Ti-0.8Ni-0.3Mo合金还具有更好的高温强度，适合在高氯离子浓度和高温下使用。这类合金在近海油田、海水淡化和海生物人工养殖等领域中也获得了广泛应用。
explanation_en: Titanium alloy that can be used in various corrosion media. The surface of pure titanium is passivation due to the formation of a dense, self-healing oxide film. The electrode potential can reach+0.46V, making it 100 times more resistant to corrosion than stainless steel. The application of titanium and its alloy in non aerospace fields mainly takes advantage of the good corrosion resistance. Commercial pure titanium and Ti-6Al-4V alloy are widely used to manufacture equipment for production of terephthalic acid, urea, acetaldehyde, acetone, chlorine, acetic acid and other chemical products; It is also indispensable in oil refining, fiber coloring, pulp manufacturing and metal electroplating equipment. Ti-0.2Pd and Ti-0.8Ni-0.3Mo alloy were developed to improve the resistance to crevice corrosion in high chloride concentration media. In 20% hydrochloric acid, the annual corrosion rate of commercial pure titanium at 60 ° C is 25.6mm, while that of Ti-0.2Pd alloy is only 0.255mm, about 100 times the difference. Ti-0.8Ni-0.3Mo alloy also has better high-temperature strength, which is suitable for use at high chloride ion concentration and high temperature. This kind of alloy has also been widely used in offshore oil fields, seawater desalination and marine biological artificial aquaculture.

explanation_cn: 主要指耐腐蚀较强的Al-Mg系铸造铝合金（如ZI303合金）。在众多铸造铝合金中，具有最好的耐腐蚀性能和切削性能，同时表面光亮美观，焊接性能也优良。在大气、海水和碱性溶液中的耐腐蚀性能均优于其他系列的铸造铝合金。这类合金的熔炼工艺比较复杂，而且铸造性能不如A-Si系合金。因此，通常只在对耐腐蚀性能有特殊要求的条件下（例如海水或其他腐蚀介质）使用，比如用于水上飞机的一些承载不大的零件或装饰件。
explanation_en: It mainly refers to Al-Mg cast aluminium alloy with strong corrosion resistance (such as ZI303 alloy). Among many cast aluminium alloy, it has the best corrosion resistance and cutting performance, bright and beautiful surface, and excellent weld performance. The corrosion resistance in atmosphere, seawater and alkaline solution is superior to other series of cast aluminium alloy.
