The melting process of this kind of alloy is relatively complex, and the castability is not as good as A-Si series alloy. Therefore, it is usually only used under the conditions with special requirements for corrosion resistance (such as seawater or other corrosion media), such as some parts or decorative parts with small load for seaplanes.

explanation_cn: 在各种腐蚀环境或同时受到腐蚀和机械应力因素作用下表现出卓越抵抗能力的合金材料。各种金属在不同环境下表现出不同的耐蚀行为，这些行为受到几个关键因素的影响，包括金属本身的热力学稳定性（通常根据标准电位分为四类）、金属的活化到钝化的转变、金属表面生成的腐蚀产物膜的保护性能以及金属中能够形成有效阴极的杂质或第二相等因素。因此，发展耐蚀合金的原则包括以下几点：提高金属或合金的热力学稳定性。降低合金中的阴极活性和阳极活性。促使合金表面生成致密的腐蚀产物保护膜。这些目标可以通过合金化、热处理等方法来实现。以铁基合金为例，添加Cr、Ni、Mo、Cu、Si等元素不仅可以提高合金的腐蚀电位，还可以促进合金的钝化并形成良好的保护膜。耐蚀合金的种类多种多样，可以根据其成分分为铁基合金、镍基合金、铜基合金、铝基合金、镁基合金、其他有色金属及其合金、稀有金属（如W、Mo、Ta、Nb、Ti、Zr等）及其合金，以及贵金属及其合金。根据耐蚀合金的组织，可以分为同质合金、具有阳极基的二元合金（例如Mg-Al合金）、具有阴极基的二元合金（例如Cu-Zn合金）以及复杂的多相合金。
explanation_en: Alloy materials that exhibits excellent resistance in various corrosion environments or under the action of corrosion and mechanical stress factors at the same time. Various metals show different corrosion resistance behaviors in different environments. These behaviors are affected by several key factors, including the thermodynamics stability of the metal itself (usually divided into four categories according to the standard potential), the transformation from activation or conditioning to passivation of the metal, the protective performance of the corrosion product film generated on the metal surface, and the impurities or second equivalent factors that can form an effective cathode in the metal. Therefore, the principles for developing corrosion resistant alloy include the following: improving the thermodynamics stability of metals or alloy. The cathode activity and anode activity in alloy are reduced. The dense corrosion product protective film is formed on the surface of alloy. These goals can be achieved by alloy, heat treatment and other methods. Taking iron base alloy as an example, the addition of Cr, Ni, Mo, Cu, Si and other elements can not only improve the corrosion potential of alloy, but also promote the passivation of alloy and form a good protective film. There are many kinds of corrosion resistant alloy, which can be divided into iron based alloy, nickel based alloy, copper based alloy, aluminum based alloy, magnesium based alloy, other non-ferrous metals and their alloy, rare metals (such as W, Mo, Ta, Nb, Ti, Zr, etc.) and their alloy, as well as precious metals and their alloy according to their compositions. According to the structure of corrosion resistant alloy, it can be divided into homogeneous alloy, binary alloy with anode base (such as Mg Al alloy), binary alloy with cathode base (such as Cu Zn alloy) and complex multiphase alloy.

explanation_cn: 由Ni16Cr11Fe(或FeNi19Cr7)主动层和FeNi20Co26Cr8(或FeNi38Cr7)被动层组成，具有良好耐蚀性，主要用作腐蚀介质或蒸汽疏水阀等潮湿气氛中工作的热敏感元件。牌号有5J1075等。有时也用普通型热双金厲片的外表面包覆一薄层耐蚀合金达到耐蚀的目的。
explanation_en: It is composed of Ni16Cr11Fe (or FeNi19Cr7) active layer and FeNi20Co26Cr8 (or FeNi38Cr7) passive layer. It has good corrosion resistance and is mainly used as a thermal sensitive element working in humid atmosphere such as corrosion medium or steam trap. The grades include 5J1075, etc. Sometimes, a thin layer of corrosion resistant alloy is coated on the surface of ordinary hot double gold flakes to achieve the purpose of corrosion resistance.

explanation_cn: 既具有软磁性能又具有耐蚀性能，常用于在氧化性介质和肼类介质等腐蚀环境中中工作的电磁器件，具有优良的耐蚀性能，磁性能在温度、应力、辐射等等因素影响下能保持好的稳定性。随着耐蚀性增加，通常Bs有所下降。适于制作耐蚀航空微电机、全自动燃气热水器水控电磁阀、汽车发动机电磁阀喷油器等耐浊电磁元器件。
explanation_en: It has both soft magnetic properties and corrosion resistance. It is commonly used in electromagnetic devices operating in corrosion environments such as oxidizing media and hydrazine media. It has excellent corrosion resistance. Magnetic properties can maintain good stability under the influence of temperature, stress, radiation and other factors. As corrosion resistance increases, Bs usually decrease. Suitable for producing corrosion-resistant aviation micro motors, fully automatic gas water heater water control solenoid valves, automotive engine solenoid valves, fuel injectors, and other turbidity resistant electromagnetic components.

explanation_cn: 指抗溶液腐蚀的金厲间化合物:如Fe3Si在腐浊液中可形成SiO2纯化膜，因而在不同浓度的硫酸溶液中具良好的耐蚀性。Fe3Al在3.5%NaCl水溶液中耐蚀性与OCrl3相当，优于1Cr13。FeAl在浓硝酸中由于生成Al2O3纯化膜而具有良好的耐蚀性能。
explanation_en: It refers to the intermetallic compounds resistant to solution corrosion: for example, Fe3Si can form SiO2 purification membrane in the corrosion liquid, so it has good corrosion resistance in sulfuric acid solutions of different concentrations. The corrosion resistance of Fe3Al in 3.5% NaCl aqueous solution is equivalent to OCrl3 and superior to 1Cr13. FeAl exhibits excellent corrosion resistance in concentrated nitric acid due to the formation of an Al2O3 purification membrane.

explanation_cn: 钽是一种非常耐蚀的金属。由于生产成本高，因此加入Mo、W、Hf等元素仍可在保持其耐蚀性的情况下形成一类合金。钽在氢氟酸及热碱液中发生腐蚀，但在硝酸等介质中很耐蚀，其行为与玻璃相似。能在270°C的70%硝酸、150°C以下的浓硝酸、190°C以下各种浓度的盐酸、浓硫酸下使用。钽在300°C以上开始与H2、N2、O2反应，350°C时吸氢，400°C以上与氮反应而变脆，600°C以氧化加速。生成的TaN易开裂而不具保护性能。钽还能耐液态金属的腐蚀。钽的加工性好，室温力学性能与中碳钢相近。以钽为基的合金品种不多，如Ta-10W、Ta-8W-2Hf、Ta-10W-2.5Hf-0.05C等。合金化的目的在于改善钽的力学性能，但对其耐腐蚀性稍有影响。作为耐蚀合金，钽主要用于硫酸系统、含氯及其衍生物系统、高纯硝酸、硝酸铵及对苯二甲酸等容器衬里、搅拌桨叶等。
explanation_en: Tantalum is a very corrosion-resistant metal. Due to the high production cost, the addition of Mo, W, Hf and other elements can still form a type of alloy while maintaining its corrosion resistance. Tantalum is corrosion in hydrofluoric acid and hot alkaline solution, but it is resistant to corrosion in nitric acid and other media, and its behavior is similar to that of glass. Can be used at 70% nitric acid at 270 ° C, concentrated nitric acid below 150 ° C, hydrochloric acid at various concentrations below 190 ° C, and concentrated sulfuric acid. Tantalum begins to react with H2, N2, and O2 above 300 ° C, absorbs hydrogen at 350 ° C, reacts with nitrogen above 400 ° C and becomes brittle, and accelerates oxidation at 600 ° C. The generated TaN is prone to cracking and lacks protective properties. Tantalum is also resistant to corrosion of liquid metals. Tantalum has good workability, and its mechanical properties at room temperature are similar to those of medium carbon steel. There are few alloy based on tantalum, such as Ta-10W, Ta-8W-2Hf, Ta-10W-2.5Hf-0.05C, etc. The purpose of alloy is to improve the mechanical properties of tantalum, but it has a slight impact on its corrosion resistance. As a corrosion resistant alloy, tantalum is mainly used in sulfuric acid system, chlorine and its derivatives system, high-purity nitric acid, ammonium nitrate, terephthalic acid and other container linings, mixing blades, etc.

explanation_cn: 纯铅或含一定量Sb(6.0%)、Sn(0.25%-1%)及少量Ca、Ag等能耐硫酸.，酸和磷酸等腐蚀的铅合金。铅的耐蚀性来源于它在介质中形成不溶性铅盐，此外铅在许多介质中具有相当高的化学稳定性。在含有碳酸盐的淡水或硬水中，铅表面上形成碱性碳酸盐保护膜而使其具有很高的耐蚀性，铅对硫酸具有很好的耐蚀性，因为硫酸铅在水中的溶解度很低而对铅有保护二氧化硫、三氧化硫、硫化氢、二氧化碳等气体对铅耐蚀性影响不大。在盐酸中生成的氣化铅膜虽能保持完整，但却不甚稳定，故其耐蚀性能变化较大。硬铅、铅锑合金主要用干地下电缆、耐硫酸管子及阀门器件。
explanation_en: Pure lead or containing a certain amount of Sb (6.0%), Sn (0.25% -1%), and a small amount of Ca, Ag, etc., can withstand sulfuric acid, Lead alloy corrosion by acids and phosphoric acid. The corrosion resistance of lead comes from the formation of insoluble lead salts in the medium, and in addition, lead has considerable chemical stability in many media. In fresh water or hard water containing carbonate, an alkaline carbonate protective film is formed on the surface of lead to make it have high corrosion resistance. Lead has good corrosion resistance to sulfuric acid. Because the water solubility of lead sulfate in water is very low, it has little effect on lead corrosion resistance due to sulfur dioxide, sulfur trioxide, hydrogen sulfide, carbon dioxide and other gases. Although the vaporized lead film generated in hydrochloric acid can remain intact, it is not very stable, so its corrosion resistance changes greatly. Hard lead and lead-antimony alloy are mainly used for dry underground cables, sulfuric acid resistant pipes and valve devices.

explanation_cn: 在多种环境下具有较好的耐蚀性的铜合金。铜本身就具有耐大气、淡水、海水以及很多有机化合物腐蚀的性能。镍、铝和锡等添加元素可进一步改善其抗腐蚀性能。铜镍合金对水分、非氧化性酸、碱和盐溶液、有机酸以及干燥的气体，例如氧、氯、二氧化硫和碳都是稳定的，不存在应力开裂腐蚀危险，而且产生选择性腐蚀和点状腐蚀的趋势较小。Cu-10Ni，Cu-30Ni合金是典型的耐蚀铜合金，具有好的耐蚀性和中等强度，高塑性，可进行热、冷压力加工，广泛用于造船、电力、化工及石油等工业部门，用来制作冷凝器、热交换器、蒸发器和各种高强耐蚀件。铜铝合金也具有优良的耐蚀性，在大气、海水和多数有机酸溶液中均有很高的耐蚀性。在某些硫酸盐、苛性碱、酒石酸等溶液中也有较好的耐蚀性，对应力开裂腐蚀不敏感。由于铜铝合金表面形成了致密的氧化膜，还可防止高温氧化，主要用于制作要求耐蚀的弹性元件。铜锡合金在大气和海水中具有很高的化学稳定性，在海水中的耐蚀性优于紫铜和黄铜，主要用在航空、汽车、拖拉机及其他工业中制造承受摩擦、耐蚀的零件。
explanation_en: Copper alloy with good corrosion resistance in various environments. Copper itself is resistant to corrosion of atmosphere, fresh water, seawater and many organic compounds. Adding elements such as nickel, aluminum and tin can further improve its corrosion resistance. Copper nickel alloy is stable to water, non oxidizing acid, alkali and salt solution, organic acid and dry gas, such as oxygen, chlorine, sulfur dioxide and carbon. There is no risk of stress cracking corrosion, and there is little tendency to produce selective corrosion and pitting corrosion. Cu-10Ni and Cu-30Ni alloy are typical corrosion resistant copper alloy with good corrosion resistance, medium strength and high plasticity. They can be used for hot and cold pressure processing, and are widely used in shipbuilding, power, chemical and petroleum industries to make condensers, heat exchangers, evaporators and various high-strength corrosion resistant parts. Copper aluminum alloy also has excellent corrosion resistance, which is very high in atmosphere, seawater and most organic acid solutions. It also has good corrosion resistance in some sulfate, caustic soda, tartaric acid and other solutions, and is insensitive to stress cracking corrosion. Due to the dense oxide film formed on the surface of copper aluminum alloy, it can also prevent high temperalure oxidation, and is mainly used to make elasticity components that require corrosion resistance. Copper tin alloy has high chemical stability in the atmosphere and sea water, and its corrosion resistance in sea water is better than purple copper and brass. It is mainly used in aviation, automobile, tractor and other industries to manufacture friction resistant and corrosion resistant parts.

explanation_cn: 能够抵抗环境（如酸、碱、盐以及大气、海水等）腐蚀的合金铸铁。根据加入合金元素的种类可分为:高硅耐蚀铸铁（GB/T8491-2009,硅含量10%~15%，碳含量0.65%~1.2%，铸件表面形成致密SiO2薄膜，显著提高铸铁在氧化性酸中的耐蚀性）、铝耐蚀铸铁和铝硅耐蚀铸铁（铝含量4%~6%，铸件表面形成致密Al2O3薄膜，显著提高铸铁在氨碱类溶液中的耐蚀性）、高硅钼耐蚀铸铁（硅含量14.5%~16%，钼含量3%~4%，铸件表面易形成MoO2Cl2薄膜，有效耐含氯离子溶液的腐蚀）、高铬铸铁（铬含量大于15%）等。提高铸铁耐蚀性的主要机制有:在铸件表面形成致密保护膜;降低铸铁中基体相的电位;减少基体相的数目;提高组织致密度。耐蚀铸铁广泛应用于化工、石油等行业的高耐蚀零部件。
explanation_en: Alloy cast iron that can resist corrosion of environment (such as acid, alkali, salt, atmosphere, seawater, etc.). According to the types of alloy elements added, it can be divided into: high silicon corrosion resistant cast iron (GB/T8491-2009, silicon content is 10%~15%, carbon content is 0.65%~1.2%, dense SiO2 film is formed on the surface of the casting, which significantly improves the corrosion resistance of cast iron in oxidizing acid), aluminum corrosion resistant cast iron and aluminum silicon corrosion resistant cast iron (aluminum content is 4%~6%, dense Al2O3 film is formed on the surface of the casting, which significantly improves the corrosion resistance of cast iron in ammonia alkali solutions) High silicon molybdenum corrosion resistant cast iron (silicon content 14.5%~16%, molybdenum content 3%~4%, the casting surface is easy to form MoO2Cl2 film, effective resistance to chloride containing solution corrosion), high chromium cast iron (chromium content greater than 15%), etc. The main mechanisms to improve the corrosion resistance of cast iron are: forming a dense protective film on the surface of the casting; Reduce the potential of the matrix phase in cast iron; Reduce the number of matrix phase; Improve the efficiency of spare filling of tissue. Corrosion resistant cast iron is widely used in high corrosion resistant parts in chemical, petroleum and other industries.

explanation_cn: 主要应用于核反应堆、化工设备、农药和染料工业等领域。尽管锆是一种非常活泼的金属，但由于其表面形成致密和牢固的氧化层，具有出色的耐腐蚀性能。这使得锆成为核反应堆的重要结构材料，因为它具有较低的热中子吸收截面。锆在硫酸浓度低于70%和盐酸浓度低于25%的条件下腐蚀速率很低。此外，它还能够耐受强碱溶液和熔融碱的腐蚀。在硝酸浓度低于95%且温度低于210°C的条件下，锆也表现出很好的耐腐蚀性。然而，锆不耐受湿氯气、王水和金属氯化物溶液的腐蚀，特别是氢氟酸。常见的耐蚀锆合金包括Zr-2（包括1.5%锡、0.1%铬、0.12%铁和0.05%镍）、Zr-0.5Cu-0.8Mo和Zr-2.5Nb。实际上，商业纯锆也是一种出色的耐蚀材料，因为不需要进行锆铪分离，从而降低了成本，能够满足民用工业的需求。通常情况下，只有在需要更高强度的情况下才会选择使用Zr-2.5Nb等合金材料。
explanation_en: It is mainly used in nuclear reactor, chemical equipment, pesticide and dye or dyestuffc industries. Although zirconium is a very active metal, it has excellent corrosion resistance due to the formation of a dense and solid oxide layer on its surface. This makes zirconium an important structural materials for nuclear reactor because of its low thermal neutron absorption cross section. The corrosion rate of zirconium is very low when the concentration of sulfuric acid is less than 70% and the concentration of hydrochloric acid is less than 25%. In addition, it can also withstand the corrosion of strong alkali solution and molten alkali. Zirconium also shows good corrosion resistance when the nitric acid concentration is lower than 95% and the temperature is lower than 210 ° C. However, zirconium is not resistant to the corrosion of wet chlorine, aqua regia and metal chloride solutions, especially hydrofluoric acid. Common corrosion resistant zirconium alloy include Zr-2 (including 1.5% tin, 0.1% chromium, 0.12% iron and 0.05% nickel), Zr-0.5Cu-0.8Mo and Zr-2.5Nb. In fact, commercial pure zirconium is also an excellent corrosion resistant materials, because no separation of zirconium and hafnium is required, which reduces the cost and can meet the needs of civil industry. Generally, alloy materials such as Zr-2.5Nb will be used only when higher strength is required.

explanation_cn: 铁、铜、镍等杂质含量很低的高纯镁合金，也泛指Mg-Mn系等耐浊性较好的镁基合金。
explanation_en: High purity magnesium alloy with low impurity content such as iron, copper and nickel also generally refer to magnesium based alloy with good turbidity resistance such as Mg Mn series.

explanation_cn: 镍的标准电极电位较铁正，使其腐蚀产物较铁致密，具有较好的保护作用，因此拥有比铁更高的耐蚀性。耐蚀镍合金主要包括以下类型：Ni-Cu系合金：如蒙乃尔合金，特别耐氢氟酸腐蚀，常用于船舶、印染和食品工业。Ni-Si合金：在硅含量高于11%时，合金的韧性下降，但添加适量的Cu和Mo可改善韧性而不降低耐蚀性。该合金在耐热硫酸腐蚀方面表现良好。Ni-Mo和Ni-Mo-W合金：这些合金通常为单相奥氏体组织。在中等浓度的盐酸和硫酸中具有较好的耐蚀性。Ni-Cr-Fe合金：代表性合金有Inconel 600和690，但在不同碳含量下，这些合金在600°C至1100°C加热时可能会析出碳化物，导致晶间腐蚀倾向。它们通常用于水冷却型原子反应堆的蒸气发生器管路，承受高温水的腐蚀。Ni-Mo和Ni-Mo-W合金：这些是耐蚀镍合金中广泛应用的一类，性能卓越。与纯镍不同，它们表现出耐受盐酸、硫酸和磷酸腐蚀的性能，特别是在高温和高浓度碱性环境中表现出色。
explanation_en: The standard electrode potential of nickel is more positive than that of iron, which makes its corrosion products denser than that of iron and has better protection, so it has higher corrosion resistance than iron. Corrosion resistant nickel alloy mainly includes the following types: Ni Cu alloy: such as Monel alloy, which is especially resistant to hydrofluoric acid corrosion and is commonly used in shipping, printing and dyeing and food industries. Ni Si alloy: when the silicon content is higher than 11%, the toughness of the alloy decreases, but the addition of appropriate amount of Cu and Mo can improve the toughness without reducing the corrosion resistance. The alloy performs well in resisting corrosion of sulfuric acid. Ni Mo and Ni-Mo-W alloy: These alloy are usually single-phase austenitic structures. It has good corrosion resistance in medium concentrations of hydrochloric acid and sulfuric acid. Ni Cr Fe alloy: representative alloy include Inconel 600 and 690, but under different carbon content, these alloy may precipitate carbide when heated at 600 ° C to 1100 ° C, leading to intergranular corrosion tendency. They are usually used in the steam generator pipes of water cooled atomic reactors to withstand the corrosion of high temperature water. Ni Mo and Ni-Mo-W alloy: these are widely used in corrosion resistant nickel alloy, with excellent performance. Different from pure nickel, they show resistance to hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid and phosphoric acid corrosion, especially in high temperature and high concentration alkaline environment.

explanation_cn: 主要包括各类不锈钢和耐强腐蚀介质的耐蚀合金。各类不锈钢包括相变强化的马氏休不锈钢;形变强化的奥氏体不锈钢；沉淀硬化塯奥氏体-马氏体不锈钢；马氏体时效不锈钢。通过元素替代或添加微量元素，以及合理的制备和热处理工艺，可得到综合力学件能优异的耐蚀高弹性合金。
explanation_en: It mainly includes all kinds of stainless steel and corrosion resistant alloy resistant to strong corrosion medium. All kinds of stainless steel include phase transformation strengthened martensite stainless steel; Deformation strengthened austenilic stainless steel; Precipitation hardening peak austenite martensite stainless steel; Martensitic aging stainless steel. The corrosion resistant high elastic alloy with excellent comprehensive mechanical properties can be obtained by replacing or adding trace elements, as well as reasonable preparation and heat treatment processes.

name_cn: 耐超高温抗氧化陶瓷基复合材料
name_en: ultra-high temperature-resistant and oxidation-resistant ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 一种近年发展较快的高比强度、高比模、耐超高温、抗氧化的新兴材料体系，材料具有密度低、力学性能优异、耐磨损、耐高温、抗氧化、抗烧蚀等良好的综合性能。为了获得能够在未来航空航天领域极端热环境中使用的耐超高温抗氧化材料，针对目前的不足，立足于提高材料的耐超高温抗氧化性能，同时兼顾到材料的力学性能。
explanation_en: A newly emerging materials system with high specific strength, high specific modulus, ultra-high temperature resistance and oxidation resistance that has developed rapidly in recent years, materials has good comprehensive properties such as low density, excellent mechanical properties, wear resistance, high temperature resistance, oxidation resistance, ablation resistance, etc. In order to obtain ultra-high temperature and anti-oxidation materials that can be used in the extreme thermal environment of the future aerospace field, in view of the current shortcomings, the aim is to improve the ultra-high temperature and anti-oxidation performance of materials, while taking into account the mechanical properties of materials.

explanation_cn: 一般是指热解产物为超高温陶瓷的聚合物或混合物超高温陶瓷。具有良好的抗氧化、抗热震和抗烧蚀性能的过渡族金属的硼化物、碳化物和氮化物，具有低密度、高强度、高模量的耐高温性能等特性。超尚温陶瓷的制备方法主要包括:单质元素直接化合法、固相还原法、化学气相沉积法、熔盐电解法、前驱I本法等前驱体法一般是指以金属化合物、B源化合物、C源化合物的混合物为原料，通过高温下的碳热还原反应或硼热还原反应制备超高温陶瓷的方法。用于制备超高温陶瓷粉体、纤维、复合材料等。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to polymer or mixture of uhra high temperature ceramics whose pyrolysis product is uhra high temperature ceramics. Borides, carbide and nitrides of transition metals with good oxidation resistance, thermal shock resistance and ablation resistance have the characteristics of low density, high strength, high modulus and high temperature resistance. The preparation methods of ultrahigh temperature ceramics mainly include: the direct method of elemental elements, the solid phase reduction method, the chemical vapor deposition method, the molten salt electrolysis method, the precursor I This method and other precursor methods generally refer to the method of preparing uhra high temperature ceramics by carbothermal reduction reaction or borothermal reduction reaction at high temperature using the mixture of metal compounds, B source compounds, and C source compounds as raw materials. It is used to prepare uhra high temperature ceramics powder, fiber, composite materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 在酸性介质作用下具有抗腐蚀能力的混凝土。一般通过控制耐酸混凝土的水胶比、提高耐酸性，即水/(水泥+矿物掺和料)，宜小于0.35。矿物掺和料占胶凝材料比例，粉煤灰应不低于25%,矿粉不低于40%,硅灰5%-10%,或者复合掺加。此时水泥水化产生的氢氧化钙，会比较完全地与矿物掺和料的活性二氧化硅反应(二次水化反应或火山灰反应)生成硅酸钙凝胶。广泛应用于化学工业的防酸槽、电镀槽等。
explanation_en: Concrete with corrosion resistance under the action of acid medium. Generally, the water binder ratio of acid resistant concrete is controlled to improve the acid resistance, that is, water/(cement+mineral admixture) should be less than 0.35. The proportion of mineral admixtures in cementitious materials shall not be less than 25% for fly ash, 40% for mineral powder, 5% -10% for silica fume, or composition admixtures. At this time, the calcium hydroxide produced by cement hydration will completely react with the active silica of mineral admixture (secondary hydration reaction or pozzolanic reaction) to generate calcium silicate gel. Widely used in acid proof tanks, electroplating tanks, etc. in the chemical industry.

explanation_cn: 在腐蚀性较强的酸、碱和盐介质中耐腐蚀的钢。通常把不锈钢与耐酸钢统称为不锈耐酸钢，而简称为不锈钢，所以通常讲的不锈钢都包括了耐酸钢。按使用介质环境划分可将耐酸钢分为耐氧化性酸不锈钢、耐还原性酸不锈钢、耐硝酸不锈钢、耐硫酸不锈钢、耐亚硫酸不锈钢、耐磷酸不锈钢、耐有机酸不锈钢、耐液体金属腐蚀不诱钢和耐海水不锈钢等。
explanation_en: Corrosion resistant steel in highly corrosive acid, alkali and salt media. Generally, stainless steel and acid resistant steel are collectively called stainless acid resistant steel, and stainless steel for short. Therefore, stainless steel generally includes acid resistant steel. According to the service medium environment, acid resistant steel can be divided into oxidation resistant acid stainless steel, reductive acid resistant steel, nitric acid resistant stainless steel, sulfuric acid resistant stainless steel, sulfite resistant stainless steel, phosphoric acid resistant stainless steel, organic acid resistant stainless steel, liquid metal corrosion resistant non inductive steel and seawater resistant stainless steel.

name_cn: 耐高温不饱和聚酯树脂
explanation_cn: 在高温下仍能保持良好物理机械性能和耐蚀性的不饱和聚酯树脂。酸酐类不饱和聚酯结构式可参见通用不饱和聚酯。酚醛环氧型乙烯不饱和聚酯结构式：前者由二元醇、饱和二元酸酐（如邻、间、对苯二甲酸酐，3.6-内亚甲基四氢邻苯二甲酸酐）和不饱和二元酸酐（如顺丁烯二酸酐）缩聚而成，采用三聚氰酸三烯丙酯或苯乙烯交联剂。后者主要为酚醛环氧型乙烯基酯类不饱和聚酯，由酚醛环氧树脂（F型环氧树脂）与甲基丙烯酸进行反应，以苯乙烯作为稀释剂，按通用不饱和聚酯进行固化。酸酐型耐高温不饱和聚酯树脂适用于热固化低压成型，其玻璃钢在260°C下有良好的强度保持率与稳定的高频介电性能，且200小时后，性能无明显下降。弯曲强度为447MPa（室温）、323MPa（260°C，30分钟）、274MPa（260°C，500小时），相对介电常数（10GHz）为4.05-4.07，介质损耗因子为0.008-0.010。由酚醛环氧型乙烯基不饱和聚酯制成的浇铸料的热变形温度为129℃，较通用型不饱和聚酯浇铸料高出50-80℃。手糊玻璃钢的弯曲强度为320MPa，弯曲模量为15GPa，拉伸强度为300MPa，拉伸模量为17.5GPa，冲击强度为5kJ/m^2，吸水率为0.07%-0.08%。相对介电常数（1MHz）为4.3，介质损耗因子（1MHz）为1.72x10^-2，表面电阻率为1.43x10^1Ω，体积电阻率为5.41x10^11Ω·m，介电强度为25.9MV/m。主要用于制作耐热玻璃钢和耐高温与高频绝缘浇铸料、泡沫塑料、耐蚀玻璃钢、涂料和胶黏剂。
explanation_en: Unsaturated polyester resin that can still maintain good physical and mechanical properties and corrosion resistance at high temperatures. The structural formula of acid anhydride unsaturated polyester can be found in general unsaturated polyester. Structural formula of phenolic epoxy ethylene unsaturated polyester: the former is polycondensation of binary alcohol, saturated binary anhydride (such as o-phthalic anhydride, m-phthalic anhydride, 3.6-n-methylenetetrahydrophthalic anhydride) and unsaturated binary anhydride (such as maleic anhydride), and adopts triallyl cyanate or styrene cross linking agent. The latter is mainly phenolic epoxy vinyl ester unsaturated polyester, which is reacted by phenolic epoxy resin (F-type epoxy resin) and methacrylic acid, and curing as general unsaturated polyester with styrene as diluents. The acid anhydride type high temperature resistant unsaturated polyester resin is suitable for heat curing and low-pressure molding. Its glass fiber reinforced plastic has good strength retention and stable high-frequency dielectric properties at 260 ° C, and after 200 hours, its performance does not decline significantly. The bending strength is 447MPa (room temperature), 323MPa (260 ° C, 30 minutes), 274MPa (260 ° C, 500 hours), the relative dielectric constant (10GHz) is 4.05-4.07, and the dielectric loss factor is 0.008-0.010. The heat deflection temperature of casting material made of phenolic epoxy vinyl unsaturated polyester is 129 ℃, which is 50-80 ℃ higher than that of general unsaturated polyester casting material. The bending strength, bending modulus, tensile strength, tensile modulus, impact strength and water absorption of hand laid FRP are 320MPa, 15GPa, 300MPa, 17.5GPa, 5kJ/m ^ 2 and 0.07% -0.08% respectively. The relative dielectric constant (1MHz) is 4.3, the dielectric loss factor (1MHz) is 1.72x10 ^ -2, the coefficient of surface resistance is 1.43x10 ^ 1 Ω, the coefficient of volume resistance is 5.41x10 ^ 11 Ω· m, and the dielectric strength is 25.9MV/m. It is mainly used for making heat-resistant glass fiber reinforced plastics, high-temperature and high-frequency insulation casting materials, foamed plastics, corrosion resistant glass fiber reinforced plastics, coatings and adhesive.

explanation_cn: 指长期使用温度在200℃以上、熔点和软化点高、高温下不易降解和尺寸稳定性好、并具有一定耐水解和化学药品的纤维。多为芳杂环类纤维如间位芳酰胺、聚芳砜酰胺、聚嗯唑、噻唑和咪唑类、聚芳砜、聚芳酰亚胺纤维等。这些纤维兼有良好的阻燃性和自熄性，聚芳酰亚胺和咪唑类还具有抗辐射性，而聚苯醚类可耐超高电压等。其制备方法以低温溶液缩聚和湿法纺丝为主，也有采用干纺的，有些还需经高温环化后处理。耐高温纤维主要用于制备各种防护服，包括消防服、赛车服、焊工服及防护罩与手套；耐18O℃以上的电绝缘材料;特种降落伞;高温粉尘和耐酸、碱滤材;蜂窝结构材料和混纺衣料等。
explanation_en: It refers to fibers with long-term use temperature above 200 ℃, high melting point and softening point, difficult degradation at high temperature, good dimensional stability, and certain resistance to hydrolysis and chemicals. Most of them are aromatic heterocyclic fibers, such as meta aromatic amide, polyarysulfone amide, polyazole, thiazole and imidazole, polyarysulfone, polyarylimide fiber, etc. These fibers have both good flame retardancy and self-extinguishing properties. Polyarylimides and imidazoles also have radiation resistance, while polyphenylene ethers can withstand ultra-high voltages. Its preparation methods are mainly low temperature solution polycondensation and wet spinning, some are dry spinning, and some are subject to high-temperature cyclization after treatment. High temperature resistant fiber is mainly used to prepare various protective clothing, including fire-fighting clothing, racing clothing, welding clothing, protective covers and gloves; Electrical insulation materials resistant to above 18O ℃; Special parachutes; High temperature dust and acid and alkali resistant filter materials; Honeycomb structural materials and blended clothing, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称非平衡有序 结构。远离平衡态的开放系统，在不断与外界交换物质和能量的过程中，通过内部非线性动力学机制，自动从无序状态形成并维持的在时间、空间或功能上的有序结构状态。耗散结构实质上就是非平衡系统中的 自组织状态。
explanation_en: Also known as non equilibrium ordered structure. The opened system far away from the equilibrium state, in the process of constantly exchanging matter and energy with the outside world, automatically forms and maintains an ordered structural state in time, space or function from the disordered state through the internal nonlinear dynamic mechanism. Dissipative structure is essentially a self-organizing state in an unbalanced system.

explanation_cn: 又称P30T，是3-辛基噻吩的聚合物，溶解性好，电导率高，热稳定性好，因其具有良好的光电转换性质，被广泛应用于非线性光学材料、有机薄膜晶体管和有机太阳能电池等有机光电领域。
explanation_en: Also known as P30T, it is a polymer of 3-octylthiophene. It has good solubility, high electric conductivity, and good thermal stability. Because of its good photoelectric conversion properties, it is widely used in organic photoelectric fields such as nonlinear optical materials, organic thin film transistors, and organic solar cell.

explanation_cn: 又称尼龙9。乳白色半透明或不透明颗粒，属热塑性聚酰胺树脂。有较好的耐老化性、柔韧性及热稳定性，玻璃化转变温度46°C，熔融温度194-209°C。可用注射、挤出、吹塑、喷涂浇注成型等方法加工。制品可用于汽车及其他机械零部件，如齿轮、轴承等。
explanation_en: Also known as nylon 9. Milky white translucent or opaque particles belong to thermoplastic polyamide resin. It has good aging resistance, flexibility and thermal stability, with glass transition temperature of 46 ° C and melting temperature of 194-209 ° C. It can be processed by injection, extrusion, blow molding, spray pouring molding and other methods. Products can be used for automobiles and other mechanical components, such as gears, bearings, etc.

explanation_cn: 由α氰基丙烯酸酯单体聚合得到的聚合物。其单体为α-碳上含有氰基的丙烯酸酯具有很强的极性，在微量水分存在时，由水电离产生的OH-可引发快速聚合，生成无色透明聚合物，溶于二甲基甲酰胺、硝基甲烷、乙腈等溶剂；加热至180°C左右可分解，在-80°C至软化点范围内均可有较高的抗拉强度。
explanation_en: from α Polymer obtained by polymerization of cyanoacrylate monomer. Its monomer is α- Acrylates containing cyano groups on the carbon have strong polarity. In the presence of trace water, OH - generated by water ionization can initiate rapid polymerization to generate colorless transparent polymer that are soluble in solvents such as dimethylformamide, nitromethane, acetonitrile, etc; It can be decomposed when heated to about 180 ° C and has high tensile strength from -80 ° C to bating point.

explanation_cn: 是聚经基脂肪酸酯 (PHA)家族中的一种， 属于热塑性聚酯类聚合物，可用于生产注塑制品，如文具、玩具、食品盒、薄板和纤维板、泡沫塑料等。因其是利用微生物发酵而得到的而受到特别关注。
explanation_en: It is a kind of polyacrylic fatty acid ester (PHA) family, belonging to thermoplastic polyester polymer, and can be used to produce injection molding products, such as stationery, toys, food boxes, thin sheets, fiberboard, foamed plastics, etc. It has received special attention because it is obtained through microbial fermentation.

name_cn: 聚丁二烯丙烯酸丙烯腈推进剂
explanation_cn: 简称丁睛羧推进剂，缩写PBAN。以丁二烯，丙烯酸、丙烯腈共聚物（PBAN)为黏合剂的一类复合固体推进剂。PBAN是一种无官能团、单官能团及多官能团的分子混合物，丙烯腈基团的引人使预聚物分子链的竣基间距加大，官能团分布比聚丁二烯丙烯酸共聚物均匀。因此PBAN推进剂能克服PBAA推进剂力学性能差的缺点，储存性能、力学性能及其重现性得以改善，是价格最低的一种黏合剂。曾广泛地应用于各种火箭发动机中。其缺点是黏度大，黏合剂分子中三组分分布无规律，官能度不易控制。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as nitrile carboxylic propellant, abbreviated as PBAN. A kind of composition solid propellant with butadiene, acrylic acid and acrylonitrile copolymer (PBAN) as adhesive. PBAN is a kind of molecular mixture without functional group, single functional group and multi functional group. The introduction of acrylonitrile group makes the end group spacing of prepolymer molecular chain increase, and the functional group distribution is more uniform than that of polybutadiene acrylic acid copolymer. Therefore, PBAN propellant can overcome the shortcomings of poor mechanical properties of PBAA propellant, improve its storage performance, mechanical properties and reproducibility, and is the lowest price adhesive. It has been widely used in various rocket engines. The disadvantage is that the viscosity is large, the three components in the adhesive molecule are distributed irregularly, and the functionality is difficult to control.

explanation_cn: 是1,3-丁二烯单体聚合得到的聚合物。聚丁二烯合成可采用包括自由基聚合、配位聚合和离子聚合的多种聚合方法。顺、反聚丁二烯主要采用配位聚合，如有机镍、有机钴、有机钛、有机稀土催化剂，低顺-聚丁二烯和中乙烯基聚丁二烯主要采用有机锂为引发剂的阴离子聚合方法，高乙烯基聚丁二烯可以采用阴离子聚合方法。也可采用配位聚合方法。聚丁二烯橡胶具有成本低、品种多、性能优异等优点，在轮胎以及其他橡胶制品中得到广泛的应用。
explanation_en: It is a polymer obtained by polymerization of 1,3-butadiene monomer. Polybutadiene can be synthesized by a variety of polymerization methods, including free radical polymerization, coordination polymerization and ionic polymerization. Cis and trans polybutadiene mainly adopt coordination polymerization, such as organic nickel, organic cobalt, organic titanium, organic rare earth catalyst, low cis polybutadiene and medium vinyl polybutadiene mainly adopt anion polymerization method with organic lithium as initiator, and high vinyl polybutadiene can adopt anion polymerization method. The coordination polymerization method can also be used. Polybutadiene rubber is widely used in tires and other rubber products because of its low cost, variety and excellent performance.

name_cn: 聚丁内酰胺纤维（耐纶4纤维）
explanation_cn: 聚合物分子结构中含有+NH(CHACON链节的一种聚酰胺纤维）。20世纪50年代初，美国阿尔拉克公司（AlmcCrop）首先研制成功，随后日本、联邦德国和意大利等都进行过大量研究工作，但由于原料价格较贵，故迄今均未工业化生产。制备方法是将cr吡咯烷酮以本体聚合或悬浮聚合制成聚合物，然后进行熔体纺丝，也可采用干法纺丝和湿法纺丝。熔点260°C，特性与尼龙6相似，宜用于制作袜子、白衣、家庭装饰品等。
explanation_en: The molecular structure of polymer contains+NH (a polyamide fiber of CHACON chain link). In the early 1950s, the American company AlmcCrop was the first to successfully develop, followed by extensive research work in Japan, Federal Germany, and Italy. However, due to the high cost of raw materials, none of them have been industrialized to date. The preparation method is to prepare cr pyrrolidone into polymer by bulk polymerization or suspension polymerization, and then conduct melt spinning, or dry spinning and wet spinning. Melting point 260 ° C, similar to nylon 6 in characteristics, suitable for making socks, white clothes, home decorations, etc.

explanation_cn: 简称PP，是丙烯通过加聚反应而成的聚合物。系白色蜡状材料，外观透明而轻。化学式为(C3H6)n，密度为0。89～0。91g/cm3，易燃，熔点为164~170℃，?在155℃左右软化，使用温度范围为-30～140℃?。在80℃以下能耐酸、碱、盐液及多种有机溶剂的腐蚀，能在高温和氧化作用下分解。聚丙烯是一种性能优良的热塑性合成树脂，为无色半透明的热塑性轻质通用塑料，具有耐化学性、耐热性、电绝缘性、高强度机械性能和良好的高耐磨加工性能等?，广泛应用于服装、毛毯等纤维制品、医疗器械、汽车、自行车、零件、输送管道、化工容器等生产，也用于食品、药品包装。
explanation_en: It is called PP for short, which is a polymer made of propylene through addition polymerization. It is white waxy materials with transparent and light appearance. The chemical formula is (C3H6) n, and the density is 0. 89-0. 91g/cm3, flammable, with melting point of 164~170 ℃, bating at about 155 ℃, and operating temperature range of -30~140 ℃. Under 80 ℃, it can resist corrosion of acid, alkali, salt solution and various organic solvents, and can decompose under high temperature and oxidation. Polypropylene is a kind of thermoplastic synthetic resin with excellent performance. It is a colorless and translucent thermoplastic light general purpose plastics. It has chemical resistance, heat resistance, electrical insulation, high strength mechanical properties and good high abrasion resistance processing performance. It is widely used in the production of clothing, blankets and other fiber products, medical device, cars, bicycles, parts, transmission pipelines, chemical containers, and also used in food and drug packaging.

explanation_cn: 是一种由丙烯酰胺单体聚合而成的高分子聚合物。它具有线型结构，也可以发生交联形成网状结构。PAM存在多种形式，包括内色粉末、半透明珠粒和片状等。这种聚合物能够以任何比例溶于水，微溶于一些特定溶剂如冰醋酸、乙二醇、甘油和乳酸，但几乎不溶于有机溶剂。PAM的制备方法包括使用过硫酸盐等引发剂进行溶液聚合或反相悬浮聚合等方法。在制备过程中，PAM可以出现多种形态，如粉状、水溶液、乳液和珠状等。PAM在生物应用中通常无毒，具有良好的生物相容性，但其单体具有毒性，可能对神经肌肉功能产生影响，并对皮肤具有一定刺激性。因此，在医用PAM中，游离单体的含量通常受到限制，不得超过0.05%。PAM具有黏合性和絮凝性，因此常被用作医用黏结剂和合成生理黏液。此外，PAM的水凝胶表现出抗凝血性和耐水解稳定性良好，吸水性强，因此可用于血液灌流的活性炭包覆微粒等应用。PAM的最大用途之一是作为液体的絮凝剂，广泛应用于水处理和造纸等领域，以帮助悬浮在液体中的微粒聚集并形成絮凝体，从而便于固液分离等处理。
explanation_en: It is a macromolecule polymer formed by polymerization of acrylamide monomer. It has a linear structure and can also be crosslinking to form a network structure. PAM exists in many forms, including internal color powder, translucent beads and flakes. This polymer can be soluble in water in any proportion, slightly soluble in some specific solvents such as glacial acetic acid, ethylene glycol, glycerol and lactic acid, but almost insoluble in organic solvents. The preparation methods of PAM include solution polymerization or inverse suspension polymerization with persulfate and other initiator. In the preparation process, PAM can appear in various forms, such as powder, aqueous solution, lotion and bead. PAM is usually non-toxic in biological applications and has good biocompatibility, but its monomer is toxic, which may affect the neuromuscular function and have certain irritation to the skin. Therefore, in medical PAM, the content of free monomer is usually limited to 0.05%. PAM has cohesive and flocculating properties, so it is often used as medical adhesive and synthetic physiological mucus. In addition, the hydrogel of PAM shows good anticoagulation and hydrolysis resistance stability, and strong water absorption, so it can be used for applications such as activated carbon coated particles for blood perfusion. One of the biggest uses of PAM is as a liquid coagulant, which is widely used in water treatment, papermaking and other fields to help the particles suspended in the liquid gather and form flocs, so as to facilitate solid-liquid separation and other treatment.

explanation_cn: 又称丙烯酸酯橡胶，是指由丙烯酸酯均聚物或内含有少量具有交联活性基团单体的弹性共聚物构成的橡胶。聚丙烯酸酯橡胶因其饱和型主键结构而具有优异的耐氧化和耐臭氧侵蚀性。同时，它含有极性侧基，因此在耐烃类油的溶胀性能方面表现出色。这种橡胶通常使用温度范围为-17°C到204°C，在高温下表现较好，相对于丁腈橡胶、天然橡胶以及通用型丁二烯橡胶，它的性能略有不同。然而，聚丙烯酸酯橡胶在一些方面不如其他橡胶种类，如其拉伸性能、加工性能、耐寒性和耐水性相对较差，且硫化比较困难。因此，它更适合用于制造那些要求耐高温、耐油的橡胶零件，长期接触油液的管道、容器衬里，以及暴露于臭氧和恶劣气候环境下的橡胶部件。
explanation_en: Also known as acrylic rubber, it refers to rubber composed of acrylate homopolymer or elasticity copolymer containing a small amount of monomer with crosslinking active group. Polyacrylate rubber has excellent oxidation resistance and ozone resistance due to its saturated main key structure. At the same time, it contains polar side groups, so it has excellent resistance to swelling of hydrocarbon oil. This kind of rubber is usually used at temperatures ranging from -17 ° C to 204 ° C, and performs well at high temperatures. Compared with acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber, natural rubber, and general-purpose butadiene rubber, its performance is slightly different. However, polyacrylate rubber is inferior to other types of rubber in some aspects, such as its tensile properties, processing properties, cold resistance and water resistance are relatively poor, and vulcanization is relatively difficult. Therefore, it is more suitable for manufacturing rubber parts that require high temperature and oil resistance, pipes and container linings that are exposed to oil for a long time, and rubber parts exposed to ozone and harsh weather.

explanation_cn: 包括主链上有侧酯基的聚丙烯酸酯和主链同一碳原子上有甲基的聚合物等纺制的纤维，例如聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯纤维，采用熔融纺法制成纤维，或用喷射纺丝法制成超细纤维，用于空气溶胶过滤器。可与聚笨乙烯成含氟聚合物等热塑性材料制得皮芯型全反射光导纤维.折射率约为1.5,具有可挠性，易于集束加工，其强度、耐挠曲性等物理性能优于玻璃纤维。适用于家用电器、控制台等领域。
explanation_en: It includes polyacrylate with side ester group on the main chain and polymer with methyl group on the same carbon atom of the main chain, and other spun fibers, such as polymethyl methacrylate fiber, which is made by melt spinning or superfine fiber by jet spinning for aerosol filter. The sheath core type total reflection optical fiber can be made of thermoplastic materials such as fluorine-containing polymer with polystyrene. The refractive index is about 1.5, it is flexible, easy to cluster processing, and its physical properties such as strength and flexural resistance are superior to glass fiber. Suitable for household appliances, control consoles, and other fields.

explanation_cn: 是一种水溶性直链高分子聚合物。可以由以下三种方法制备：①由丙烯酸钠单体在水溶液中用过硫酸盐（或加还原剂）进行引发聚合；②由聚丙烯酸用NaOH中和后再聚合；③由聚丙烯腈在80*C以上的浓碱中水解制得。分子量小的聚丙烯酸钠为液体，分子量高的可为固体。同体的聚丙烯酸钠是硬而脆的白色固体，吸湿性强，能溶于水及极性溶剂如甲醇、乙醇、二氧六环、乙二醇、二甲基甲酰胺中。其水溶液可以成为水凝胶。玻璃化温度为lO6°C。聚丙烯酸钠的水溶液广泛用于絮凝剂，以净化水或在制糖工业中用来澄清糖液：作为颜料分散剂，处理合成纤维的糊剂；另外还可作为土壤改良剂、胶乳增稠剂、纸张的增强剂、食品添加剂等。
explanation_en: It is a water-soluble straight chain macromolecule polymer. It can be prepared by the following three methods: ① initiating polymerization with persulfate (or adding reducing agent) from sodium acrylate monomer in aqueous solution; ② Neutralized by polypropylene acid with NaOH and then repolymerization; ③ It is obtained by hydrolysis of polyacrylonitrile in a concentrated alkaline solution above 80 * C. Low molecular weight sodium polyacrylate is liquid, and high molecular weight can be solid. The same sodium polyacrylate is a hard and brittle white solid with strong hygroscopicity and can be dissolved in water and polar solvents such as methanol, ethanol, dioxane, ethylene glycol and dimethylformamide. Its aqueous solution can become hydrogel. The glass transition temperature is lO6 ° C. The aqueous solution of sodium polyacrylate is widely used as a coagulant to purify water or clarify sugar liquor in the sugar industry: as a pigment dispersing agent, it is used to treat the paste of synthetic fiber; In addition, it can also be used as soil conditioners, latex thickener, paper intensifier, food additive, etc.

explanation_cn: 乙炔的聚合物，聚乙炔是最简单的聚炔烃，包括顺式聚乙炔和反式聚乙炔两种立体异构体。线型高分子量聚乙炔是不溶不熔的，对氧敏感的结晶性高分子半导体，深色、有金属光泽。
explanation_en: Polymer of acetylene, polyacetylene is the simplest polyacetylene, including cis polyacetylene and trans polyacetylene stereoisomers. Linear macromolecule weight polyacetylene is insoluble, oxygen sensitive crystalline macromolecule semiconductor, dark, metallic luster.

explanation_cn: 由乙烯聚合制得的乳白色、半透明、热塑性塑料，其共聚物有乙烯与少量α-烯烃（指1-丁烯、1-己烯、1-辛烯、4-甲基-卜戊烯）或其他单体共聚的产品，按其密度区分有低密度聚乙烯（也包括线型低密度聚乙烯）、超低密度聚乙烯、中密度聚乙烯、高密度聚乙烯、超高分子量聚乙烯等。
explanation_en: Milky white, translucent, thermoplastic plastics produced by ethylene polymerization, and its copolymer consists of ethylene and a small amount of α- The products copolymerized with olefins (1-butene, 1-hexene, 1-octene, 4-methyl - pentene) or other monomer can be divided into low density polyethylene (also including linear low density polyethylene), ultra low density polyethylene, medium density polyethylene, high density polyethylene, ultra high molecular weight polyethylene, etc. according to their density.

explanation_cn: 又称低分子量聚乙烯。指分子量为1000-4000的乙烯低聚物。白色或微黄色粉末或颗粒，外观呈蜡状。密度为0.920-0,94g/cm3，熔点为95-105°C,软化点105-120°C,在140°C时的黏度为0.1-1.5Pa·s (100-1500cP)。
explanation_en: Also known as low molecular weight polyethylene. It refers to ethylene oligomer with molecular weight of 1000-4000. White or yellowish powder or particles with waxy appearance. The density is 0.920-0,94g/cm3, the melting point is 95-105 ° C, the softening point is 105-120 ° C, and the viscosity at 140 ° C is 0.1-1.5Pa · s (100-1500cP).

explanation_cn: 是一种白色粉末状、片状或絮状固体的水溶性高分子聚合物，其性能介于塑料和橡胶之间，玻璃转化温度60-85°C。 由于乙烯醇单体不稳定，聚乙烯醇不能从单体乙烯醇制备。只能通过聚醋酸乙烯酯部分或全部水解制取。
explanation_en: It is a white powder, flake or flocculent solid water soluble polymer polymer, whose performance is between plastics and rubber, and the glass transition temperature is 60-85 ° C. Because the monomer of vinyl alcohol is unstable, polyvinyl alcohol cannot be prepared from monomer vinyl alcohol. It can only be obtained by partial or complete hydrolysis of polyvinyl acetate.

explanation_cn: 以聚乙稀醇为原料制得的合成纤维的统称。主要指聚乙烯醇缩甲醛纤维，也包括水溶性聚乙烯醇纤维和用硫酸钛溶液替代甲醛作整理剂的非缩醛型聚乙烯醇纤维等。制造过程由醋酸乙烯为原料，经聚合、醇解获得的聚乙烯醇，经洗涤后溶解于热水中制得纺丝液，从喷丝头细孔中压出后，引人由硫酸钠水溶液组成的凝同浴中固化成丝，随后再经拉伸、干燥、热定型、缩醛处理、水洗、上油、干燥等后加工而得成品纤维。纤维耐酸、耐碱、耐霉变、耐日晒。
explanation_en: A general term for synthetic fibers made from polyethylene glycol. It mainly refers to formalized polyvinyl alcohol fiber, including water-soluble polyvinyl alcohol fiber and non acetal polyvinyl alcohol fiber using titanium sulfate solution as finishing agent instead of formaldehyde. In the manufacturing process, polyvinyl alcohol, which is obtained from vinyl acetate as raw material through polymerization and alcoholysis, is washed and dissolved in hot water to produce spinning solution. After being pressed out of the spinneret pores, it is introduced into the coagulation bath consisting of sodium sulfate aqueous solution to curing into silk. Then, the finished fiber is processed after stretching, drying, heat setting, acetalization, washing, oiling, drying, etc. Fibers are resistant to acid, alkali, mold, and sunlight.

explanation_cn: 是将聚乙烯醇溶于水中，在搅拌下加入丁醛及催化剂如盐酸或硫酸，在15-50°C的温度下进行缩醛反应，之后经水洗、离心干燥制得的。具有较高的透明性、耐寒性、耐冲击、耐紫外辐照。与金属、玻璃、木材、陶瓷、纤维制品等有良好的黏结力。应用于制造无机或有机玻璃的中间夹层，涂料及黏合剂等。
explanation_en: It is made by dissolving polyvinyl alcohol in water, adding butyraldehyde and catalyst such as hydrochloric acid or sulfuric acid under stirring, conducting acetal reaction at 15-50 ° C, and then washing and centrifugal drying. It has high transparency, cold resistance, impact resistance, and resistance to ultraviolet radiation. Good adhesion with metal, glass, wood, ceramics, fiber products, etc. It is used for making intermediate interlayer of inorganic or organic glass, coatings and adhesive, etc.

explanation_cn: 又叫PVB胶片、PVB薄膜、PVB中间膜等。是一种热塑性树脂膜，由PVB树脂加增塑剂生产而成。由于是热塑性树脂生产而成，它具有可回收利用加工、重复使用的特点。
explanation_en: Also called pvb film, PVB Film, pvb intermediate membrane, etc. It is a thermoplastic resin film, produced from PVB resin and plasticizer. As it is produced from thermoplastic resin, it has the characteristics of recycling, processing and reuse.

explanation_cn: 由醋酸乙稀以甲醇或乙醇为介质，在过氧化苯甲酰存在下先反应生成聚醋酸乙烯酯，之后在甲醇和硫酸存在下水解，加乙醛进行缩醛化、中和、沉淀、过滤、干燥而制得。溶于乙醇、丙酮、甲乙酮、环己酮、醋酸乙酯、二氯乙烷、苯、甲苯等。能与酚醛树脂、硝酸纤维素、天然树脂等混溶，对金属、木材、皮革等有很强的黏结能力，在木材、纤维、纸制品和建材等领域被用作胶黏剂，因其不含甲醛，是一种绿色环保的功能性高分子材料。
explanation_en: The polyvinyl acetate is prepared by the reaction of vinyl acetate with methanol or ethanol as the medium in the presence of benzoyl peroxide, followed by hydrolysis in the presence of methanol and sulfuric acid, acetalization, neutralization, precipitation, filtration and drying with acetaldehyde. Soluble in ethanol, acetone, methyl ethyl ketone, cyclohexanone, ethyl acetate, dichloroethane, benzene, toluene, etc. It can be miscible with phenolic resin, cellulose nitrate, natural resin, etc., and has strong bonding ability to metals, wood, leather, etc. It is used as adhesive in wood, fiber, paper products, building materials and other fields. Because it does not contain formaldehyde, it is a green and environmentally friendly functional macromolecule materials.

explanation_cn: 聚乙烯醇缩甲醛是由聚乙烯醇与甲醛在酸性催化剂存在下缩醛化而得的，或者是将聚醋酸乙烯酯溶于醋酸或醇中，在酸性催化剂作用下与甲醛进行水解和缩醛化反应制得的。
explanation_en: Polyvinyl formal is prepared by acetalization of polyvinyl alcohol and formaldehyde in the presence of acid catalyst, or polyvinyl acetate is dissolved in acetic acid or alcohol and hydrolyzed and acetalized with formaldehyde in the presence of acid catalyst.

explanation_cn: 是一种高分子有机硅化合物，通常被称为有机硅。惰性，无毒，不易燃，透光性良好，生物相容性佳，易与多种材质室温接合。聚二甲基硅氧烷（PDMS)是最广泛使用的硅，为基础的有机聚合物材料，应用在生物微机电中的微流道系统、填缝剂、润滑剂、隐形眼镜等。液态的聚二甲基硅氧烷为黏稠状不易挥发的液体，称作硅油，是一种具有不同聚合度链状结构的有机硅氧烷混合物，其端基和侧基全为烃基（如甲基、乙基、苯基等）。固态的聚二甲基硅氧烷为一种硅胶，透明弹性体。
explanation_en: It is a macromolecule organosilicon compound, usually called organosilicon. Inert, non-toxic, nonflammable, good light transmittance, good biocompatibility, easy to connect with a variety of materials at room temperature. Polydimethylsiloxanes is the most widely used silicon based organic polymer materials, which is used in microfluidic systems, caulking agents, lubricant, contact lenses, etc. Liquid polydimethylsiloxanes is a viscous, nonvolatile liquid, called silicone oil, which is a mixture of organosiloxanes with chain structures of different polymerization degrees. Its end groups and side groups are all hydrocarbon groups (such as methyl, ethyl, phenyl, etc.). The solid polydimethylsiloxanes is a silicone gel gel, transparent elastomer.

explanation_cn: 一类快速同化的医用组织黏合剂。其中亚烷基丙二酸二烷基酯和亚烷基丙二酸二烯丙酯等与α-氰基丙烯酸的低级烷基酯一样，生物相容性差，组织吸收慢，在使用上受到很大的限制。为克服上述缺点，发展了一种新的亚烷基丙二酸甲基、烯丙基酯黏结剂。已用于血管、组织、肌肉、骨和牙的黏结，其综合性能较好.应用范围也较广。
explanation_en: A fast assimilating medical tissue adhesive. Among them, dialkyl malonate and diallyl malonate are related to α- Like the lower alkyl ester of cyanoacrylate, it has poor biocompatibility and slow tissue absorption, so its use is greatly limited. In order to overcome the above shortcomings, a new alkylene malonate methyl and allyl ester adhesive was developed. It has been used for the bonding of blood vessels, tissues, muscles, bones, and teeth, with good comprehensive performance and a wide range of applications.

explanation_cn: 聚硅氧烷中较为特殊的品种。可呈梯形、树枝形或笼型等结构。与一般的聚硅氧烷相比，聚倍半硅氧烷具有更好的耐热性、更低的表面能；常用作耐高温涂料的基料，也是一类新的有应用开发前景的液晶高分子材料。
explanation_en: The more special variety of polysiloxane. It can have a trapezoidal, dendritic, or cage shaped structure. Compared with general polysiloxane, polysilsequioxane has better heat resistance and lower surface energy; Commonly used as the base material of high temperature resistant coatings, it is also a new kind of liquid crystal polymer materials with application and development prospects.

name_cn: 聚偏二氟乙烯-三氟乙烯共聚物
explanation_cn: 由偏二乙烯和三氟乙烯在水中悬浮聚合制得或直接在聚偏二氟乙烯（PVDF)碳链上引入TrFE单体。
explanation_en: TrFE monomer is prepared by suspension polymerization of vinylidene and trifluoroethylene in water or directly introduced into the carbon chain of polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF).

explanation_cn: 商品名为赛纶。为偏二氯乙烯均聚物或无规共聚物，均聚物榕融温度高达195-210°C。熔融时快速分解，难于用挤塑等方法加工，因而常与其他单体共聚使熔融温度降到140-175°C。
explanation_en: The product name is Cylon. It is vinylidene chloride homopolymer or random copolymer, and the melting temperature of homopolymer is up to 195-210 ° C. It decomposes rapidly during melting and is difficult to process by extrusion and other methods, so it is often copolymerized with other monomer to reduce the melting temperature to 140-175 ° C.

explanation_cn: 十一酰胺聚合物，白色，半透明结晶性颗粒，又称尼龙11。具有吸水性低、良好耐应力开裂性和动态疲劳性、耐碱、酮、醇、芳烃、脂及油类等溶剂，不耐浓无机酸，易受50%盐酸和苯酚混合液腐蚀。
explanation_en: Undecanamide polymer, white, translucent crystalline particles, also known as nylon 11. It has low water absorption, good stress cracking resistance and dynamic fatigue resistance, and is resistant to alkali, ketone, alcohol, aromatic hydrocarbon, grease, oil and other solvents. It is not resistant to concentrated inorganic acid and is vulnerable to corrosion of 50% hydrochloric acid and phenol mixture.

explanation_cn: 十三内酰胺开环聚合物。具有相对密度小、吸水性低、熔融温度低、柔韧性好、易于加工成型等特点。
explanation_en: Tridecalactam ring opening polymer. It has the characteristics of small relative density, low water absorption, low melting temperature, good flexibility and easy processing.

explanation_cn: 又称尼龙12。十二内酰胺于3O0°C高温下在1%对苯磺酸催化下开环聚合，结晶热塑性树脂。属低熔点、吸水性低树脂，结晶性高、易于加工成型，耐低温性能好，使用温度范围较宽 (55-90°C)。
explanation_en: Also known as nylon 12. Dodecalactam was ring opening polymerization catalyzed by 1% p-benzenesulfonic acid at 3O0 ° C to crystallize thermoplastic resin. It is a resin with low melting point, low water absorption, high crystallinity, easy processing and molding, good low temperature resistance, and wide use temperature range (55-90 ° C).

explanation_cn: 由多元醇和双烯酮合成的聚合物，如1,6-己二醇与2,4,8,10-四环螺[5.5]十一烷经加成反应合成的聚原酸酯,这类原酸酯可以通过加酸或碱控制药物释放速度。聚原酸酯亦可由多元醇和原酸酯或原碳酸酯经酯交换反应聚合合成。这类聚原酸酯降解产生的酸能催化酯键水解，而具有自催化降解功能。也可以由烷基原酸酯与三元醇在无水溶剂中反应，得到半固态的胶状物。聚原酸酯为疏水性聚合物，它在碱性条件下稳定，可酸性水解，具有良好的生物相容性，不引起有害的组织反应或全身反应。将它和碳酸钠与炔诺酮混合后熔融压制成片材，可制成基材型药物释放体系，由线型大分子主链的酸性水解使药释放，由于药物由疏水性聚合物非均相浸蚀而释放，可防止水进人聚合物载体内部。
explanation_en: Polymer synthesized from polyols and diketenes, such as polyorthoester POE synthesized by the addition reaction of 1,6-hexanediol and 2,4,8,10-tetracyclospiro [5.5] undecane, can control the drug release rate by adding acid or base. Polyorthoester POE can also be synthesized by polymerization of polyols and orthoesters or orthocarbonates through transesterification. The acid generated from the degradation of these polyesters can catalyze the hydrolysis of ester bonds, and has the function of autocatalytic degradation. It can also be obtained by reacting alkyl orthoesters with ternary alcohols in an anhydrous solvent to obtain a semi solid colloidal substance. Polyorthoester is a hydrophobic polymer, which is stable under alkaline conditions, can be hydrolyzed in acid, has good biocompatibility, and does not cause harmful tissue reactions or systemic reactions. After mixing it with sodium carbonate and norethisterone, it is melted and pressing to form a sheet, which can be made into a base material type drug release system. The acid hydrolysis of linear macromolecular main chain releases the drug. As the drug is released by the etching of hydrophobic polymer heterogeneous phase, it can prevent water from entering the inside of polymer carrier.

explanation_cn: 在受控的条件下实现核聚变反应，持续地释放出核能的装置。氢原子核发生反应形成较重的原子核而释放出核力相互作用能的聚变反应是恒星的能源，也是氢弹的主要能源。核聚变必须在很高的温度下才能进行，为了使聚变反应放出的能量大于补偿加热时所投入的能量，反应核的温度、密度和约束时间必须满足一定的条件（即所谓Lawson判据），才能建成有用的聚变堆，例如氘氚反应。在上述三种反应中，氘氚反应的截面最大，是第一代聚变堆的基础。实现Lawson判据主要有磁约束和惯性约束两种途径，无论哪种途径，都还有一系列科学技术问题需要解决，材料问题是关键之一。
explanation_en: A device that achieves nuclear fusion reactions under controlled conditions and continuously releases nuclear energy. The fusion reaction in which hydrogen nuclei react to form heavier nuclei and release nuclear force interaction energy is the energy source for stars and the main energy source for hydrogen bombs. Nuclear fusion can only be carried out at a very high temperature. In order to make the energy released by fusion reaction greater than the energy input during compensation heating, the temperature, density and constraint time of the reaction nucleus must meet certain conditions (the so-called Lawson criterion), so as to build a useful fusion reactor, such as deuterium tritium reaction. Among the three reactions mentioned above, the deuterium tritium reaction has the largest cross section, which is the basis of the first generation fusion reactor. There are two ways to realize Lawson criterion: magnetic constraint and inertial constraint. No matter which way, there are still a series of scientific and technological problems to be solved, and the materials problem is one of the keys.

explanation_cn: 冷却聚变堆第一壁/增殖区结构并通过热交换器载出聚变能的介质。液态Li、Li-Pb合金、水和氦气是候选材料。液态Li和Li-Pb合金作为冷却剂，同时也是增殖材料，简化了增殖区的设计。缺点是：①与很多第一壁结构材料的相容性差；②磁流体力学泵送损失大。水的热交换性能好，价格便宜，它的能量转换系统发展成熟，与结构材料如奥氏体、铁素体等不锈钢的相容性好，但与某些增殖材料如液体金属Li和Li-Pb合金的反应性高。另外，水中氚的回收十分困难，费用高，冷却管道应有氚阻挡层以减少增殖层内产生的氚通过扩散渗透人水中。氦是惰性气体，已在高温气冷堆中得到应用，安全性好.与不锈钢和Ni基合金相容性好，放射性低，尤磁性，不导电，很适合于磁约束聚变堆。缺点是：体积热容量低，热交换能力差，不适合于高热流部件，如孔栏和偏滤器；为了获得较高的冷却效率。应采用高乐、高温（>773K)和大直径的管道，因而耗能高；为了获得适当的能量传递效率，需要高温，而材料在高温下力学性能差，辐照效应严重；V和Nb基合金可以工作在更高的温度，但必须采用较高纯度的氦气；对于第一壁/增殖区结构，形状复杂，焊缝多，氦泄漏进入等离子体的速率会较高；此外，庞大的冷却系统增加了增殖区之外屏蔽系统设计的闲难。
explanation_en: The medium that cools the first wall/breeder zone structure of the fusion reactor and carries the fusion energy through the heat exchanger. Liquid Li, Li Pb alloy, water and helium are candidate materials. Liquid Li and Li Pb alloy are used as coolants and as breeder materials, which simplifies the design of breeder zone. Disadvantages: ① poor compatibility with many first wall structural materials; ② Magnetic fluid dynamics has a high pumping loss. Water has good heat exchange performance and low price. Its energy conversion system is mature and has good compatibility with structural materials such as austenite, ferrite and other stainless steel, but it has high reactivity with some proliferation materials such as liquid metal Li and Li Pb alloy. In addition, the recovery of tritium in water is very difficult and costly. The cooling pipe should have a tritium barrier to reduce the tritium generated in the breeder layer to penetrate into water through diffusion. As an inert gas, helium has been used in high-temperature gas cooled reactor with good safety. It has good compatibility with stainless steel and Ni based alloy, low radioactivity, particularly magnetic, non-conductive, and is very suitable for magnetic confinement fusion reactor. Disadvantages are: low volume heat capacity, poor heat exchange capacity, not suitable for high heat flow components, such as pore bars and diverters; In order to achieve higher cooling efficiency. High pressure, high temperature (>773K), and large diameter pipes should be used, resulting in high energy consumption; In order to obtain proper energy transfer efficiency, high temperature is required, but the mechanical properties of materials at high temperature are poor, and the radiation effect is serious; V and Nb based alloy can work at higher temperatures, but high purity helium must be used; For the first wall/proliferation zone structure, with complex shapes and multiple welds, the rate of helium leakage into the plasma will be higher; In addition, the massive cooling system increases the difficulty of designing shielding systems outside the proliferation zone.

explanation_cn: 用于聚变堆的绝缘材料。它除了应满足对一般绝缘材料的要求外，还必须满足聚变堆的特殊要求，如耐中子辐照。由于聚变堆结构复杂，有些部件在其寿期内无法更换，这些部件的绝缘材料的耐辐照性能往往决定了聚变堆的寿命。用于磁体的绝缘材料还应有足够高的耐疲劳能力。
explanation_en: Insulating materials for fusion reactor. In addition to meeting the requirements for general insulation materials, it must also meet the special requirements of fusion reactor, such as neutron irradiation resistance. Due to the complex structure of fusion reactor, some components cannot be replaced during their life. The irradiation resistance of the insulation materials of these components often determines the life of fusion reactor. The insulating materials used for magnets shall also have sufficient fatigue resistance.

explanation_cn: 又称"热核燃料"。在反应堆内可维持受控聚变反应的核素。有氘2、氚3、氦4锂（锂6、锂7)和硼11。
explanation_en: Also known as "thermonuclear fuel". A nuclide that can maintain a controlled fusion reaction inside a reactor. There are deuterium 2, tritium 3, helium 4 lithium (lithium 6, lithium 7) and boron 11.

explanation_cn: 由单体合成聚合物的反应总称。
explanation_en: Synthesis of polymer from monomer.

explanation_cn: 若聚合物是由整齐的重复单元所组成的，则其聚合度可定义为聚合物分子所含的平均结构单元的数。这里强调 "平均"是因为聚合物为多分散性体系，由不同分子量的聚合物分子组成，故聚合度只能取平均值。
explanation_en: If a polymer is composed of regular repeating units, its degree of polymerization can be defined as the number of average structural units contained in polymer molecules. The "average" is emphasized here because polymer is a polydispersity system composed of polymer molecules with different molecular weights, so the degree of polymerization can only be taken as the average.

explanation_cn: 又称聚合上限温度。当聚合体系处于聚合和解聚的平衡状态时,此时的温度是单体聚合的上限温度。
explanation_en: It is also called upper limit temperature of polymerization. When the polymerization system is in the equilibrium state of polymerization and depolymerization, the temperature at this time is the upper limit temperature of monomer polymerization.

explanation_cn: 指在极高的压强和温度下，氮分子内部的三个键断裂形成的类似金刚石的亚稳态、高密度、非分子结构的氮，其具有很高的能量密度。理论上聚合氮的结构很多。全氮化合物具有显著优于现有高能物质的能量特性，是未来炸药、推进剂等新型含能化合物的发展方向，但由于技术水平限制，仅限于实验室制备，距离实际运用尚有较大差距。
explanation_en: It refers to the metastable, high density, non molecular nitrogen similar to diamond formed by the fracture of three bonds inside the nitrogen molecule under extremely high pressure and temperature, which has a very high energy density. Theoretically, polynitrogen has many structures. Total nitrogen compounds have significantly better energy characteristics than the existing high-energy materials, and are the development direction of new energetic compounds such as explosive and propellants in the future. However, due to technical level constraints, they are only prepared in the laboratory, and there is still a big gap from the actual application.

explanation_cn: 又称高分子。一种或几种小分子单体通过化学键连接而成的、具有多个重复单元的长链分子同系物组成的聚集体。聚合物分子量具有多分散性，可由平均分子量和分子量分布来表征。与金属材料相比，聚合物的主要特点是密度小、电绝缘性好、耐腐蚀性好、加工容易。根据用途，可分为塑料、纤维、橡胶、涂料、胶黏剂等。按照分子量大小，聚合物分为低聚物和高聚物。
explanation_en: Also known as macromolecule. An aggregate composed of long chain molecular homologues with multiple repeating units, one or more small monomer are connected by chemical bonds. The molecular weight of polymer is polydisperse and can be characterized by average molecular weight and molecular weight distribution. Compared with metallic materials, polymer is characterized by small density, good electrical insulation, good corrosion resistance and easy processing. According to the use, it can be divided into plastics, fiber, rubber, coatings, adhesive, etc. According to the molecular weight, polymer are divided into oligomer and polymers.

explanation_cn: 通过Langmuir-Blodgett成膜技术制备的、聚合物分子有序排列的薄膜，膜可以是单分子层或多分子层。
explanation_en: The films prepared by Langmuir Blodgett film forming technology and orderly arranged polymer molecules can be single molecular layer or multi molecular layer.

explanation_cn: 聚合物加工通常是使固体状态（粉状或粒状）、糊状或溶液状态的聚合物通过熔融、共混或者变形，经过混合设备或模具形成所需要的形状及性能的制品的工艺过程。根据聚合物的类型不同其成型加工包括塑料、橡胶加工、聚合物纤维加工、复合材料加工等。塑料、橡胶加工方法包括挤出成型、注射成型、压制成型、压延成型、热成型、吹塑成型等。聚合物纤维成型加工方法包括熔融纺丝、溶液纺丝、冻胶纺丝、静电纺丝等。复合材料成型方法包括手糊成型、压制成型、树脂传递模塑等。目前聚合物加工领域又发展了一些新型成型加工方法，包括微尺度加工、微刻蚀、微沉积、肉组装、仿生加工和3D打印技术等。
explanation_en: Polymer processing is usually a process to make polymer in solid state (powder or particle), paste or solution state form the required shape and performance products through melting, polymer blending or deformation and through mixing equipment or molds. According to the type of polymer, its molding processing includes plastics, rubber processing, polymer fiber processing, composite materials processing, etc. Processing methods of plastics and rubber include extrusion molding, injection molding, pressing molding, calendaring molding FR molding, thermo-forming, blow-molding, etc. The forming and processing methods of polymer fiber include melt spinning, solvent spinning, jelly spinning, electrostatic spinning, etc. The composite materials molding methods include hand lay-up, pressing molding, resin transfer molding, etc. At present, some new molding and processing methods have been developed in the field of polymer processing, including micro scale processing, micro etching, micro deposition, meat assembly, bionic processing and 3D printing technology.

explanation_cn: 由聚合物构成的囊泡。在药物控制释放领域，聚合物囊泡可作为药物载体。
explanation_en: A vesicle made of polymer. In the field of controlled drug release, polymer vesicles can be used as drug carrier.

explanation_cn: 又称树脂基复合材料。以有机高分子聚合物或俗称树脂为基体而构成的复合材料。包括热固性聚合物基复合材料和热塑性聚合物基复合材料。
explanation_en: Also known as resin based composite materials. The composite materials is made of organic macromolecule polymer or resin. It includes thermosetting polymer matrix composite and thermoplastic polymer matrix composite.

name_cn: 聚合物基复合材料层合板
explanation_cn: 又称聚合物基复合材料层压板。由聚合物基体浸渍的增强材料经热压层合在一起而成的整体板材。在该组合形式下，增强材料和基体仍然保持各自的物理和化学性质，然而它们组合所形成的材料性质是各组分材料性质所达不到的。常用的树脂有热固性不饱和聚酯、酚醛、环氧和氨基树脂以及某些热塑性树脂；增强材料多为纤维及织物，纸张、木板等片状材料也可使用。与许多传统的金属材料相比，聚合物基复合材料层合板比刚度、比强度高，化学稳定性和介电隔热性能优良，抗疲劳、抗破坏，具有良好的性能可设计性。层合板由一定数量单层（该单层出增强材料和基体构成）材料按照需要的厚度堆积固化而成，通常的设计中改变各单层的厚度、纤维铺设方向角度以及不同单层的堆积次序能够很大程度上改变其物理性能，层合板有单向层合板、双向层合板和斜交层合板等。其制造通常有浸胶、裁剪、叠合及压制等工序。聚合物基复合材料层压板广泛应用于机械、电气、建筑、化工、交通运输和航空航天工业中，还可作为透波、耐腐蚀和耐烧蚀性等功能忭材料。
explanation_en: Also known as polymer matrix composite laminate. The whole plate is formed by hot pressing and laminating reinforcement materials impregnated with polymer matrix. In this combination form, reinforcement materials and matrix still maintain their own physical and chemical properties, however, the materials properties formed by their combination are beyond the properties of each component materials. Common resin include thermosetting unsaturated polyester, phenolic, epoxy, amino resin and some thermoplastic resin; Reinforcement materials are mostly fibers and fabrics, and sheet materials such as paper and wood can also be used. Compared with many traditional metallic materials, polymer matrix composite lamimtes have high specific stiffness and strength, excellent chemical stability and dielectric insulation properties, fatigue resistance, damage resistance, and good performance designability. Laminate is made of a certain number of single layers (consisting of reinforcement materials and matrix) of materials stacked and curing according to the required thickness. In general, changing the thickness of each single layer, fiber laying direction angle and stacking sequence of different single layers can greatly change its physical properties. laminate includes unidirectional laminate, bidirectional laminate and diagonal laminate. Its manufacturing process usually includes dipping, cutting, folding and pressing. Polymer matrix composite laminates are widely used in machinery, electrical, construction, chemical, transportation and aerospace industries, and can also be used as functional materials such as wave transmission, corrosion resistance and ablation resistance resistance.

explanation_cn: 一类由一种或几种分子或分子团（结构单元或单体）以共价键结合成具有多个重复单体单元的大分子，它们可以是天然产物，如纤维、蛋白质和天然橡胶等，也可以是用合成方法制得的，如合成橡胶、合成树脂、合成纤维等非生物高聚物以及合成生物有规高分子等。聚合物由有机物组成，但也有由无机物组成的聚合物。聚合物的特点是种类多、密度小，比强度大，电绝缘性、耐腐蚀性好，加工容易，可符合多种、特种用途的要求，包括塑料、纤维、橡胶、涂料、黏合剂等领域，可部分取代金属和非金属材料。
explanation_en: One kind is macromolecule with multiple repeated monomer units that are combined by one or more molecules or molecular groups (structural units or monomer) with covalent bond. They can be natural products, such as fiber, protein, natural rubber, etc., or can be made by synthetic methods, such as synthetic rubber, synthetic resin, synthetic fiber and other non biological polymers, as well as synthetic biological macromolecule. Polymer is composed of organic substances, but there are also polymer composed of inorganic substances. Polymer is characterized by a wide variety, low density, high specific strength, good electrical insulation and corrosion resistance, and easy processing. It can meet the requirements of a variety of special uses, including plastics, fibers, rubber, coatings, adhesive and other fields, and can partially replace metal and non-metallic materials.

explanation_cn: 在规定的试验条件下，聚合物燃烧时产生的有物理和(或）化学的变化。聚合物燃烧时，发生的是一个复杂的热氧化过程，主要包括三个相互联系、相互依存的阶段。聚合物多属可燃性物质，其特点是燃烧时热释放率高、热值大、火焰传播速度快等，而且产生大量的浓烟和毒气，对人的生命财产安全造成威胁，故评价聚合物燃烧性能十分重要。测试聚合物燃烧性能的试验办法很多，主要是根据聚合物燃烧特点、影响燃烧特性的因素及使用条件等。测试方法有水平燃烧法、垂直燃烧法、氧指数法、炽热棒法、点着温度法、烟密度法、闪点和自燃点测定法等。影响聚合物燃烧性能与试样尺寸或试样量、试样表面积大小等有关。因此不同尺寸、不同量的试样，其结果是不可比的。聚合物对加工条件的敏感性比其他材料大得多，不同的制备方法和加工条件对试验结果有影响，所以，测试时应注意。由于火灾发生的因素很复杂，阻燃材料也是一个复杂的体系，简单地用一两个指标的测试结果来评价实际使用条件下着火的危险性是比较困难的，有时也是不合实际的，而且，各种燃烧性试验方法，均是在规定的试验条件下进行的，与实际使用条件相差很大，因此.每种测试方法，都是在试验条件下的结果，不能用于实际使用条件下着火的危险性。
explanation_en: Under the specified test conditions, there are physical and/or chemical changes during combustion of polymer. During combustion of polymer, a complex thermal oxidation process occurs, which mainly includes three interrelated and interdependent stages. Most polymer belong to flammability substances, which are characterized by high heat release rate, high calorific value, fast flame propagation speed, etc. during combustion, and produce a large amount of smoke and toxic gas, threatening the safety of human life and property. Therefore, it is very important to evaluate the combustion performance of polymer. There are many test methods to test the combustion performance of polymer, mainly based on the combustion characteristics of polymer, the factors affecting combustion characteristics and service conditions. Test methods include horizontal burning method, vertical burning method, oxygen index method, incandescent rod method, ignition temperature method, smoke density method, flash point and spontaneous ignition point measurement method, etc. The influence on combustion performance of polymer is related to sample size or sample volume, sample surface area, etc. Therefore, the results of samples of different sizes and quantities are incomparable. Polymer is much more sensitive to processing conditions than other materials. Different preparation methods and processing conditions have an impact on the test results. Therefore, attention should be paid to testing. Because the factors of fire occurrence are very complex, and the flame-retardant materials are also a complex system, it is difficult and sometimes impractical to simply use the test results of one or two indicators to evaluate the risk of fire under the actual use conditions. Moreover, all kinds of flammability test methods are carried out under the specified test conditions, which is very different from the actual use conditions. Therefore, each test method, All results are obtained under experimental conditions and cannot be used to assess the risk of ignition under actual usage conditions.

explanation_cn: 在电场作用下能发出光的有机高分子材料。这类材料通常具有准一维的共轭结构。与小分子材料相比，聚合物发光材料具有热稳定性高、成膜工艺简单（旋涂或者印刷）且成膜性好、机械强度和粘贴性好等优点。应用聚合物发光材料的有机电致发光显示器（简称PLED)被认为是制备质轻、低成本、可折叠卷曲的柔性显示的有力竞争者。
explanation_en: Organic macromolecule materials that can emit light under the action of electric field. Such materials usually have quasi one dimensional conjugate structure. Compared with small molecule materials, polymer luminescence materials have the advantages of high thermal stability, simple film forming process (spin coating or printing), good film forming property, good mechanical strength and adhesion. Organic light-emitting luminescence displays (PLED) using polymer luminescence materials are considered as a strong competitor to produce flexible displays with light weight, low cost and foldable curl.

explanation_cn: 一种常见的导电聚合物。通常为无定形黑色同体，不溶不熔。能导电，由小的阴离子掺杂的聚吡咯在空气中会缓慢老化，导致其电导率降低。大的疏水阴离子掺杂的聚吡咯能在空气中保存数年而无显著的变化。通过吡咯单体氧化聚合得到。氧化剂通常为三氯化铁、过硫酸铵等。电化学阳极氧化吡咯也是制备聚吡咯的有效手段。聚吡咯可用于气体传感、生物、离子检测、超电容及防静电材料..
explanation_en: A common conductive polymer. Usually amorphous black homomorphic, insoluble and non fusible. It can conduct electricity. The polypyrrole doped with small anions will slowly aging in the air, causing its electric conductivity to decrease. The large hydrophobic anion doped polypyrrole can be stored in air for several years without significant change. It is obtained by oxidizing polymerization of pyrrole monomer. The oxidizer is usually ferric chloride, ammonium persulfate, etc. Electrochemical anodic oxidation of pyrrole is also an effective method to prepare polypyrrole. Polypyrrole can be used in gas sensing, biology, ion detection, ultracapacitor and anti-static materials

explanation_cn: 一种常见的导电聚合物。聚噻吩本为红色无定形固体，掺杂后显绿色。聚噻吩不溶，有较高的强度，在三氟化硼乙醚络合物中电化学聚合得到的聚噻吩强度甚至大于金属铝。聚噻吩可用于有机太阳能电池、化学传感、电致发光器件等。
explanation_en: A common conductive polymer. Polythiophene is a red amorphous solid, and it turns green after doping. Polythiophene is insoluble and has high strength. The strength of polythiophene obtained by electrochemical polymerization in boron trifluoride ether complex is even greater than that of aluminum. Polythiophene can be used in organic solar cell, chemical sensors, electroluminescence devices and so on.

explanation_cn: 简称F4，别名teflon、特氟龙、塑料王。是一种氟取代聚乙烯中所有氢原子的人工合成高分子均聚物。大分子无极性直链型结构，在常温下为无臭、无味、无毒的白色结晶性聚合物，工业上多以四氟乙烯为单体，用过硫酸盐作引发剂进行水相自由基聚合而得。
explanation_en: It is called F4 for short, and is also called Teflon, Teflon, plastics King. It is a synthetic macromolecule homopolymer that fluorine replaces all hydrogen atoms in polyethylene. The macromolecule has a nonpolar linear chain structure. It is a white crystalline polymer that is odorless, tasteless and non-toxic at room temperature. In industry, it is usually produced by aqueous free radical polymerization using tetrafluoroethylene as monomer and persulfate as initiator.

explanation_cn: 又称特氟纶，是以聚四氟乙烯为原料纺制而成。制备方法主要有三种：第一种是合成或天然高分子为载体与聚四氟乙烯乳液混合，经湿纺然后在聚四氟乙烯的熔点以上烧结而成；第二种是借助易挥发液态介质(如白油等）与聚四氟乙烯粉未混合调成糊状，然后纺丝、拉伸、烧结而成；第三种是薄膜切割法.以聚四氟乙烯烧结圆柱体为起始原料，切削成纤条物后热拉伸形成纤维。纤维具有化学惰性和疏水性，表面有蜡感，并具有非黏着性，摩擦系数在合成纤维中最小(动摩擦系数0.2.静摩擦系数0.16)。主要用于制作高温粉尘滤袋、密封填料和制碱工业用离子交换膜的补强材料，还可用作缝合线等。
explanation_en: Also known as teflon, it is spun from polytetrafluoroethylene. There are three main preparation methods: the first is to mix polylctrafluorocthylone lotion with synthetic or natural polymer as carrier, wet spinning and sintering above melting point of polylctrafluorocthylone; The second is made by mixing volatile liquid medium (such as white oil) and polylctrafluorocthylone powder into paste, then spinning, stretching and sintering; The third is the film cutting method, which takes the polytetrafluoroethylene sintering cylinder as the starting material, cuts into fiber strips, and then forms fibers by hot stretching. The fiber has chemical inertia and hydrophobicity, waxy surface and non adhesion, and the friction coefficient is the smallest among synthetic fiber (dynamic friction coefficient 0.2 and static friction coefficient 0.16). It is mainly used to make high-temperature dust filter bags, sealing fillers, reinforcing materials of ion exchange membranes for alkali manufacturing industry, and can also be used as sutures.

explanation_cn: 聚苯酯，又称为Ekonol，是一种高性能塑料，其化学结构主链含有对氧甲酰重复单元，为结晶直链状线型分子。这种材料呈浅黄色到褐色的粉末或粒料，相对密度为1.45 g/cm3，在320°C以下不发生分解失重，直到425°C才开始明显失重。与一般塑料不同的是，它在538°C加热时不熔融，仅在427°C开始非黏性流动。聚苯酯表现出卓越的热稳定性，热导率为一般塑料的3到5倍，具有较低的线胀系数。此外，聚苯酯具有出色的机械性能，包括弯曲强度、弯曲弹性模量、压缩强度、摩擦系数等。其化学耐久性也令人印象深刻，对脂肪族、芳香族和油类有优异的抵抗能力，尽管会受到浓硫酸和氢氧化钠的侵蚀。此外，聚苯酯还表现出卓越的耐辐射性，即使经过10 kGy的钻射线辐射，机械强度仍能保持100%。聚苯酯的制备可采用多种方法，包括酯交换反应后的缩聚，乙酰化反应后的缩聚，以及酯化反应后的缩聚。这种高性能材料在飞机制造、电子电气、电绝缘材料等领域得到广泛应用。同时，其涂层也可用于高速运转机械，如发动机，作为可磨耗密封涂层。
explanation_en: Polyphenylene ester, also known as Ekonol, is a high-performance plastics. Its main chain of chemical structure contains paraoxonyl repeating units, which is a crystalline linear chain molecule. This materials is a light yellow to brown powder or granule with a relative density of 1.45 g/cm 3， No decomposition weight loss occurs below 320 ° C, and it is not until 425 ° C that significant weight loss begins. Different from ordinary plastics, they do not melt when heated at 538 ° C, and only start non viscous flow at 427 ° C. Polyphenylene ester shows excellent thermal stability, thermal conductivity is 3 to 5 times that of ordinary plastics, and has low linear expansion coefficient. In addition, polyphenylene ester has excellent mechanical properties, including bending strength, bending elastic modulus, compressive strength, friction coefficient, etc. Its chemical durability is also impressive, with excellent resistance to aliphatic, aromatic, and oil compounds, despite being attacked by concentrated sulfuric acid and sodium hydroxide. In addition, polyphenylene ester also shows excellent radiation resistance, even after 10 kGy drill ray radiation, the mechanical strength can still maintain 100%. Polyphenylene ester can be prepared by many methods, including polycondensation after transesterification, acetylation, and esterification. This high-performance materials has been widely used in aircraft manufacturing, electronic and electrical, electrical insulation materials and other fields. At the same time, its coating can also be used for high-speed running machinery, such as engines, as a wearable sealing coating.

name_cn: 聚对苯二甲酰三甲基己二胺
explanation_cn: 一种无定形的透明的聚酰胺热塑性树脂，称为透明尼龙。由对苯二甲酸和三甲基己二胺脱水制得，也可先将对苯二甲酸用氯化亚砜进行酰氯化反应制得对苯二甲酰氯，再与三甲基己二胺进行界面缩聚制得。无毒，无臭，耐稀酸、稀碱、脂肪烃、芳香烃、酯类、醚类和油类溶剂；不耐醇类，能溶于80%氯仿与20%甲醇混合液；果汁、咖啡、茶、墨水不能使其着色。吸湿性小、尺寸稳定性优良。可采用注塑、挤塑、吹塑模塑等成型加工，制成工业监视窗、计算机和光学仪器零件、食具和食品接触的容器、包装用薄膜、电绝缘器件以及与燃油相关的机器零部件等。
explanation_en: An amorphous transparent polyamide thermoplastic resin is called transparent nylon. It is obtained by dehydration of terephthalic acid and trimethylhexanediamine, or by acyl chlorination of terephthalic acid with sulfoxide chloride to obtain terephthaloyl chloride, and then by interfacial condensation with trimethylhexanediamine. Non toxic, odorless, resistant to dilute acids, alkalis, aliphatic hydrocarbons, aromatic hydrocarbons, esters, ethers, and oil solvents; Not resistant to alcohols, soluble in a mixture of 80% chloroform and 20% methanol; Juice, coffee, tea, and ink cannot color them. Small hygroscopicity, excellent dimensional stability. Injection molding, extrusion molding, blow molding, and other molding processes can be used to produce industrial monitoring windows, computer and optical instrument parts, containers for tableware and food contact, packaging films, electrical insulation devices, and machine parts related to fuel.

name_cn: 聚对苯二甲酸丁二酯纤维
explanation_cn: 简称PBT纤维。是聚酯纤维的一种。由对苯二甲酸或对苯二甲酸二甲醋与1，4-丁二醇缩聚生成的聚对苯二甲酸丁二酯，然后进行熔融纺丝制得。PBT具有比PET更低的熔点，因而加工窗口更大、加工性更好。其回弹性和上染率也优于PET纤维，在<10%定伸长下，纤维的弹性恢复可达到1OO%。主要用于制作具有弹性的衣着，如健美服、游泳衣以及医疗上应用的绷带等；也可用以制作仿毛织物和地毯等。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as PBT fiber. It is a kind of polyester fiber. The poly (butylene terephthalate) produced by the condensation of terephthalic acid or dimethyl terephthalate vinegar with 1,4-butanediol is melt spun. PBT has a lower melting point than PET, so the processing window is larger and the processability is better. Its resilience and dye uptake are also better than that of PET fiber. Under the constant elongation of<10%, the elasticity recovery of the fiber can reach 100%. It is mainly used to make clothes with elasticity, such as body-building clothes, swimming suits and bandages for medical applications; It can also be used to make imitation wool fabrics and carpets.

name_cn: 聚对苯二甲酸乙二酯-3,5-二甲酸二甲酯苯磺酸钠共聚纤维
name_en: ethylene terephthalate-3,5-dimethyl sodium sulfoisophthalate copolymer fiber
explanation_cn: 是改性PET纤维中阳离子染料可染的一种聚酯纤维。其是在聚对苯二甲酸乙二酯缩聚过程中添加入3,5-二甲酸二甲酯苯磺酸钠的共缩聚酯所制得的纤维。它在提高纤维对阳离子染料亲和力的同时，不影响PET纤维原有的优良物理性能。
explanation_en: It is a kind of polyester fiber that can be dyed by cationic dye or dyestuffc in modified PET fiber. The fiber is made by adding sodium dimethyl benzene sulfonate 3,5-dicarboxylate into the copolyester during the polycondensation of poly (ethylene terephthalate). It not only improves the affinity of PET fiber to cationic dye or dyestuffc, but also does not affect the original excellent physical properties of PET fiber.

explanation_cn: 又名聚酰胺46,俗称尼龙46，简称PA46。PA46是由丁二胺和己二酸缩聚而成，含有己二酰与丁二胺交替重复相连结构的聚酰胺热塑性树脂。
explanation_en: It is also called polyamide 46, commonly known as nylon 46, or PA46 for short. PA46 is a polyamide thermoplastic resin with adipic acid and adipic acid by condensation polymerization.

explanation_cn: 又称尼龙66。用己二胺和己二酸所生成的尼龙66盐在280℃缩聚而得的一种脂肪族聚酰胺，含有己二酰与己二胺交替相连结构的酰胺聚合物。
explanation_en: Also known as nylon 66. An aliphatic polyamide obtained by polycondensation of nylon 66 salt formed by adipic acid and adipic amine at 280 ℃, which contains an amide polymer with adipic acid and adipic acid alternately linked.

explanation_cn: 聚酰胺树脂的一种，又称尼龙6。可用ε-氨基己酸缩聚而得，商业产品用己内酰胺开环聚合生产，亦可在较低温度下（约100℃)用负离子本体聚合得到。外观色或淡黄色，半透明或不透明，属热塑性结晶性树脂。
explanation_en: A kind of polyamide resin, also known as nylon 6. available ε- The commercial product is produced by ring opening polymerization of caprolactam, or by negative ion bulk polymerization at a lower temperature (about 100 ℃). The appearance color is light yellow, translucent or opaque, belonging to thermoplastic crystalline resin.

explanation_cn: 是异丁烯单体在低温下采用淤浆法聚合得到的一类合成橡胶，是典型的线型饱和聚合物。
explanation_en: It is a kind of synthetic rubber obtained by slurry polymerization of isobutene monomer at low temperature, and is a typical linear saturated polymer.

explanation_cn: 由异戊二烯单体经溶液聚合而得，在不同条件下聚合，会产生结构不同的聚合物异构体，作为橡胶主要有三种结构：顺式-1,4-聚异戊二烯、反式-1，4-聚异戊二烯、3,4-聚异戊二烯。玻璃化温度因结构不同而异。聚异戊二烯橡胶的结构与天然橡胶类似，但二者在微观结构、分子结构及极性基团等方面存在差异，致使在物理机械性能和化学性质上呈现差别。聚异戊二烯橡胶的生胶强度显著低于天然橡胶，聚异戊二烯的黏结性、弹性模量、撕裂强度、高温强度、耐磨性、疲劳寿命都不如天然橡胶，但具有较高的弹性、较好的耐寒性。
explanation_en: The monomer of isoprene is obtained by solution polymerization. polymerization under different conditions will produce polymer isomers with different structures. As rubber, there are three main structures: cis-1,4-polyisoprene, trans-1,4-polyisoprene, and 3,4-polyisoprene. The glass transition temperature varies depending on the structure. The structure of polyisoprene rubber is similar to natural rubber, but there are differences in microstructure, molecular structure and polar groups between the two, resulting in differences in physical and mechanical properties and chemical properties. The strength of crude rubber of polyisoprene rubber is significantly lower than that of natural rubber. The adhesion, elastic modulus, tear strength, high temperature strength, wear resistance and fatigue life of polyisoprene rubber are not as good as those of natural rubber, but it has higher elasticity and better cold resistance.

explanation_cn: 见多晶体金刚石。
explanation_en: See polycrystalline compact diamond.

explanation_cn: 商品名称：Tedlar。氟乙稀的均聚物，部分结晶性的白色粉末。PVF是氟塑料中氟含量最低、相对密度最小、价格最便宜的品种。
explanation_en: Product name: Tedlar. Homopolymer of vinyl fluoride, partially crystalline white powder. PVF is the lowest fluorine content, the lowest relative density and the cheapest variety in fluorine plastics.

name_cn: 聚氨酯树脂基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以热固性聚氨酯树脂为基体的复合材料。热固性聚氨酯是多壬二酚异氰酸酯与高分子量多元醇的缩聚产物。热固性聚氨酯的特点是成本低、固化放热少、固化后收缩率低。常用的增强体有粉状填料、短切或连续玻璃纤维或碳纤维等。未同化聚氨酯热同性树脂在室温下是流动性很好的液体，可迅速固化为不溶不熔的状态。聚氨酯树脂基复合材料适用的成型工艺有结构反应注射成型、喷射成型、拉挤成型、缠绕成型等。聚氨酯树脂基复合材料具有密度低、强度与冲击韧性好、耐磨性好、降解性好、生产效率高、成本低等优势，在交通运输、机械制造等领域有广泛应用，如碳纤维增强聚氨酯树脂基复合材料制造车盖、发动机罩栅板、阻流板、仪表板、保险杠等。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on thermosetting polyurethime resin. Thermosetting polyurethime is the polycondensation product of polynonyldiphenol isocyanate and macromolecule weight polyol. Thermosetting polyurethime is characterized by low cost, less curing heat release and low post-shrinkage of curing. Commonly used reinforcements include powder filler, chopped or continuous glass fiber or carbon fiber. Unassimilated polyurethime thermotropic resin is a liquid with good flow ability at room temperature, and can be quickly curing into an insoluble and unmelted state. The suitable molding processes of polyurethane resin matrix composite include structural reaction injection molding, spray molding, pultrusion process molding, filament winding, etc. Polyurethane resin matrix composite have the advantages of low density, good strength and impact toughness, good wear resistance, good degradation, high production efficiency, low cost, etc. They are widely used in transportation, machinery manufacturing and other fields, such as carbon fiber reinforced polyurethane resin matrix composite manufacturing car covers, engine hood grids, choke plates, dashboard, bumper, etc.

explanation_cn: 主链含氨基甲酸酯基链结构的弹性体，由聚醚或聚酯与二异氰酸酯的反应制得。聚氨酯的合成方法有一步法和两步法之分。聚氨酯大分子链是由玻璃化温度低于室温的柔性链段（亦称软链段或软段）和玻璃化温度高于室温的刚性链段(亦称硬链段或硬段）嵌段而成的。微相分离是聚氨酯橡胶的物理结构特征，聚氨酯橡胶的物性不仅与化学结构有关，而且与微相分离的程度有关。聚氨酯橡胶硬度范围宽、强度高、耐磨、耐油、耐臭氧性能优良，并且吸振、抗辐射和耐透气性能好；其不足为内生热大、耐热尤其是耐湿热性能较差。按照加工方法聚氨酯弹性体可分为浇注型、热塑型和混炼型三类，三种类型的聚氨酯橡胶性能略异，用途也不尽相同。此外，聚氨酯弹性体与人体相容性较好，在医疗上也有不少用途。
explanation_en: Elastomer with carbamate chain structure in the main chain is prepared by the reaction of polyether or polyester with diisocyanate. The synthesis of polyurethime can be divided into one-step method and two-step method.
