Polyurethime macromolecule chain is composed of flexible chain segment (also called soft chain segment or soft segment) with glass transition temperature lower than room temperature and rigid chain segment (also called hard chain segment or hard segment) with glass transition temperature higher than room temperature. Micro phase separation is the physical structure characteristic of polyurethane rubber. The physical properties of polyurethane rubber are not only related to the chemical structure, but also related to the degree of micro phase separation. Polyurethane rubber has wide hardness range, high strength, excellent wear resistance, oil resistance, ozone resistance, and good vibration absorption, radiation resistance and air permeability resistance; Its shortcomings include high endogenous heat and poor heat resistance, especially in terms of moisture and heat resistance. According to the processing method, polyurethime elastomers can be divided into three types: pouring type, thermoplastic type and mixing type. The three types of polyurethane rubber have slightly different properties and different uses. In addition, polyurethime elastomer has good compatibility with human body and has many uses in medical treatment.

explanation_cn: 以有机异氰酸酯、多元醇化合物（包括聚酯多元醇和聚醚多元醇两大类）和助剂为主要原料，将含有羟基的聚醚树脂或聚酯树脂与异氰酸酯反应构成聚氨酯主体，并由异氰酸酯与水反应生成的二氧化碳或用低沸点氟碳化合物为发泡剂制成的泡沫塑料。具有多孔性、相对密度小、比强度高的特点。可分为硬质、半硬质和软质聚氨酯泡沫塑料等几种。聚氨酿泡沫塑料具有优良的物理力学性能、声学性能、电学性能和耐化学性能，尤其是硬质聚氨酯泡沫塑料的热导率特別低，是一种优质的绝热保温保冷材料。软质聚氨酯泡沫塑料主要用作家具、床垫、包装材料、过滤材料、隔声材料等。
explanation_en: With organic isocyanate, polyol compounds (including polyester polyols and polyether polyols) and additive as the main raw materials, polyether resin or polyester resin containing hydroxyl groups is reacted with isocyanate to form a polyurethime main body, which is made of carbon dioxide generated by the reaction of isocyanate with water or low boiling point fluorocarbon compounds as blowing agent. It has the characteristics of porosity, low relative density and high specific strength. It can be divided into hard, semi hard and soft polyurethane foam. Polyurethane foamed plastics has excellent physical and mechanical properties, acoustic properties, electrical properties and chemical resistance, especially the thermal conductivity of rigid polyurethane foam is particularly low, which is a high-quality thermal insulation and cold insulation materials. Soft polyurethane foam is mainly used as furniture, mattress, packaging materials, filtering materials, acoustic insulation materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 聚氨基甲酸酯涂料。以聚氨基甲酸酯（简称聚氨酯）树脂为主要成膜物质的涂料。又称异氰酸酯涂料。生产聚氨酯涂料所用的二异氰酸酯有甲苯二异氰酸酯（TDI)、二甲苯二异氰酸酯（MDI)、己二异氰酸酯（HDI)、苯二亚基二异氰酸酯（XDI)等，还有异佛尔酮二异氰酸酯、三甲基己二异氰酸酯、二环己基甲烷二异氰酸酯、六氢甲苯二异氰酸酯等。聚氨酯涂料的主要品种有胺酯油涂料、双组分聚氨酯涂料、封闭型聚氨酯涂料、顶聚物潮气固化型聚氨酯涂料、预聚物催化固化型聚氨酯涂料、聚氨酯沥青和弹性聚氨酯涂料等。聚氨酯涂料的涂膜坚硬耐磨，附着力好，有良好的物理力学性能，柔韧、光亮、丰满；防腐性能特好，耐油、耐化学品腐蚀，被称为"涂料之王"；可以室温固化或烘干；电性能良好.可作漆包线漆；可与多种树脂拼混，配制成适用于多种用途的涂料品种。其不足之处是生产操作与施工要求高，价格较贵。广泛应用于化工、石油、航空、造船、汽车、机车车辆、桥梁、机电制造、木器家具、精密仪器仪表、建筑、轻工家电、湿热地区防腐蚀、乃至军工尖端等国民经济部门，兼作防护与装饰之用。
explanation_en: Polyurethane coatings. Coatings with polyurethane (polyurethime) resin as the main film-forming material. Also known as isocyanate coating. The diisocyanates used in the production of polyurethane resin coatings include toluene diisocyanate (TDI), xylene diisocyanate (MDI), hexamethylene diisocyanate (HDI), phenylene diisocyanate (XDI), isophorone diisocyanate, trimethyl hexamethylene diisocyanate, dicyclohexyl methane diisocyanate, hexahydrotoluene diisocyanate, etc. The main varieties of polyurethane resin coatings include amine ester oil coatings, two-component polyurethane resin coatings, closed polyurethane resin coatings, top polymer moisture curing polyurethane resin coatings, prepolymer catalyzed curing polyurethane resin coatings, polyurethime pitch and elasticity polyurethane resin coatings. The film of polyurethane resin coatings is hard and wear-resistant, with good adhesion, good physical and mechanical properties, flexible, bright and plump; With excellent corrosion resistance, oil resistance and chemical resistance, it is known as the "King of coatings"; It can be curing or dried at room temperature; Good electrical performance. Can be used as enameled wire paint; It can be mixed with a variety of resin to prepare a variety of coatings suitable for various purposes. Its shortcomings are high production operation and construction requirements, and high prices. Widely used in chemical, petroleum, aviation, shipbuilding, automobiles, locomotives and vehicles, bridges, electromechanical manufacturing, wooden furniture, precision instruments and meters, architecture, light industrial appliances, anti-corrosion in humid and hot areas, and even cutting-edge military industries, it is also used for protection and decoration.

explanation_cn: 由氯乙烯经自由基加成聚合得到的一种非晶性线型热塑性树脂。按照制造方法分为悬浮法树脂、本体法树脂和乳液法树脂。
explanation_en: A kind of amorphous linear thermoplastic resin obtained by free radical addition polymerization of vinyl chloride. According to the manufacturing method, it can be divided into suspension resin, bulk resin and lotion resin.

explanation_cn: 以聚氯乙烯（PVC)和增塑剂形成的塑溶胶为黏合剂的复合固体推进剂。常用配方中的氧化剂为高氯酸铵，燃烧剂为铝粉,并含少量稳定剂和工艺助剂。先将细粒度PVC与增塑剂混合形成浆状塑溶胶,再加人高氯酸铵等固体成分，均匀混合成药浆，浇铸于模具中加温固化成型或挤压成型。曾用作火箭及大型导弹的发射能源。由于同化温度较髙，固化后热应力较大，与壳体黏结不好，力学性能较差，已逐渐被其他推进剂取代。因价格低，推力稳定，耐热性能较好，故仍用作民用火箭及导弹和航天飞行器小型控制器的动力源。
explanation_en: Composition solid propellant with plastisol formed by polyvinyl chloride (PVC) and plasticizer as adhesive. The oxidizer in the common formula is ammonium perchlorate, the incendiary composition is aluminium powder, and a small amount of stabilizer and process additive are included. First, fine PVC and plasticizer are mixed to form a paste like plastisol, and then solid components such as ammonium perchlorate are added to uniformly mix into a slurry. casting is heated in the mold and curing or extrusion moulding. Formerly used as a launch energy source for rockets and large missiles. Due to high assimilation temperature, high thermal stress after curing, poor adhesion with the shell and poor mechanical properties, it has been gradually replaced by other propellants. Due to its low price, stable thrust, and good heat resistance, it is still used as a power source for small controllers of civilian rockets, missiles, and aerospace vehicles.

explanation_cn: 由聚氯乙烯糊用树脂和增塑剂、稳定剂、填料、着色剂等混合配成的糊状悬浮分散液。其中增塑剂占30%-50%,当增塑剂用量较少时，可加入一些挥发性有机液体（如直链烷烃、醇等）以降低其黏度便于施工，留待其后的加热熔融时这些液体逸去，得到硬度和强度较高的产品。这种糊叫作有机增塑或稀释增塑糊（organosol)。
explanation_en: A paste suspension dispersion prepared by mixing polyvinylchloride paste with resin, plasticizer, stabilizer, filler, colorant, etc. Among them, plasticizer accounts for 30% -50%. When the amount of plasticizer is small, some volatile organic liquids (such as straight chain alkanes, alcohols, etc.) can be added to reduce their viscosity to facilitate construction. These liquids will escape during subsequent heating and melting to obtain products with higher hardness and strength. This type of paste is called organic plasticizer or diluted plasticizer paste (organosol).

explanation_cn: 常指乙烯、丙烯或高级烯烃的聚合物。医用聚烯烃主要有聚乙烯、聚丙烯、聚氯乙烯、聚苯乙烯、聚丙烯腈、聚四氟乙烯、聚异戊二烯等，是医用高分子材料中用量最大、品种繁多的一类，属非降解型高分子材料。常用于制作软、硬组织修复体、人工器官、膜和管腔制品，以及生物医学复合材料等。
explanation_en: Often referred to as polymer of ethylene, propylene or higher olefins. Medical polyolefin mainly includes polyethylene, polypropylene, polyvinyl chloride, polystyrene, polyacrylonitrile, polylctrafluorocthylone, polyisoprene, etc. It is a kind of non degradation macromolecule materials with the largest amount and a wide variety of biomedical polymer. It is commonly used to make soft and hard tissue prosthesis, artificial organ, membrane and lumen products, and biomedical composite materials.

name_cn: 聚烯烃型热塑性弹性体
explanation_cn: 由橡胶和聚烯烃树脂组成的呈两相分离的聚合物混合物，为热塑性弹性体的一种，分为机械共混型和化学接枝型。随所混人的热塑性树脂比例不同，硬度在55-95(邵氏A)范围内变化，拉伸强度4-13MPa,断裂伸长率150%-230%，拉伸永久变形10%-50%,低温下耐冲击性好，高温下力学性能保持性好，耐磨，耐撕裂，耐油，化学稳定性好，耐酸碱性，介电性能优良。产品主要应用于汽车行业的汽车内外部配件、电线、电缆的绝缘护套及文体用品、家用电器和生活用品。
explanation_en: A two-phase polymer mixture composed of rubber and polyolefin resin, which is a kind of thermoplastic elastomers and can be divided into mechanical blending type and chemical grafting type. With the different proportion of thermoplastic resin mixed, the hardness varies from 55-95 (Shore A). The tensile strength is 4-13MPa, the percentage elongation after fracture is 150% -230%, and the tensile permanent deformation is 10% -50%. It has good impact resistance at low temperature, good mechanical property retention at high temperature, wear resistance, tear resistance, oil resistance, good chemical stability, acid and alkali resistance, and excellent dielectric properties. The product is mainly used in the automotive industry for internal and external accessories, insulation sheaths for wires and cables, as well as cultural and sports goods, household appliances, and daily necessities.

explanation_cn: 由脂肪族聚烯烃纺制成的合成纤维。主要有聚乙烯和聚丙烯纤维。聚烯烃是非极性饱和脂肪烃聚合物，大分子链柔顺性好，有很好的结晶性。但由于大分子间相互作用比较弱，所以玻璃化转变温度和熔融温度都比较低。纤维的力学性能与聚合物分子量有很大关系。聚烯烃纤维原料丰富、价格便宜，广泛用于生产各种非织造布。纤维有较好的亲油性和疏水性，是制造吸油和油水分离材料的原料；纤维强度高、密度小，是生产绳索、缆绳、渔网、包带等的好材料。聚烯烃还可加工成薄膜，然后将薄膜拉伸、分裂成纤维状，称膜裂纤维；也有将薄膜切割成扁带状，称为扁丝，供加工绳索、包装袋等用。
explanation_en: Synthetic fiber spun from aliphatic polyolefin. Mainly polyethylene and polypropylene fiber. Polyolefin is a nonpolar saturated aliphatic polymer with good flexibility of macromolecular chain and good crystallinity. However, due to the weak interaction between macromolecule, the glass transition temperature and melting temperature are relatively low. The mechanical properties of fiber are closely related to the molecular weight of polymer. Polyolefin fiber is widely used in the production of various nonwovens due to its abundant raw materials and low price. The fiber has good lipophilicity and hydrophobicity, and is the raw material for manufacturing oil absorption and oil-water separation materials; With high fiber strength and low density, it is a good materials for producing ropes, cables, fishing nets, wrapping belts, etc. Polyolefin can also be processed into a film, and then the film is stretched and split into fibers, called membrane split fibers; The film is also cut into flat strips, called flat filament, for processing ropes, packaging bags, etc.

explanation_cn: 一种高密度、高结晶度的线型高分子材料，五大通用工程塑料之一。根据分子链中化学结构的不同可以分为均聚甲醛和共聚甲醛两种。
explanation_en: A linear macromolecule materials with high density and high crystallinity, and one of the five general engineering plastics. According to the different chemical structures in the molecular chain, it can be divided into acetal homopolymer and acetal copolymer resin.

explanation_cn: 简称POM纤维，聚甲醛又称聚缩醛，分子重复单元结构式为-CH2-O-,是一种无支链、高密度、高结晶性的线型聚合物，可由高纯甲醛或三聚甲醛催化聚合而成。
explanation_en: It is called POM fiber for short. Polyoxymethylene, also known as polyacetal, has a molecular repeating unit structure formula of - CH2-O -. It is a linear polymer without branched chain, with high density and high crystallinity. It can be made by polymerization catalyzed by high-purity formaldehyde or trioxane.

explanation_cn: 聚电解质即高分子电解质，包括线型或支化的合成和天然水溶性高分子，其结构单元上含有可电离的基闭。按聚电解质所含有的电离基团可分为三类：阴离子型聚电解质（即聚酸类）、阳离子型聚电解质（即聚碱类）和同时含有阴离子基团和阳离子基团的两性聚电解质。阴离子型聚电解质主要包括聚合物侧链含有羧酸基、磺酸基和磷酸基等的合成聚合物和天然聚合物：阳离子型聚电解质主要包括聚合物侧面含有季铵盐基闭、吡啶盐基闭等的高分子。聚电解质通常可以溶解在水中，并电离成为一个高分子聚离子和许多反离子.可形成强高分子静电场。聚电解质同时具备电解质和高分子的性质.其溶液类似电解质溶液，可以导电；也类似高分子溶液，具有很大黏度。作为软物质体系，聚电解质对很多分子组装结构的稳定性和相互作用具有重要影响。聚电解质可以用作食品、化妆品、药物和涂料的增稠剂、分散剂、絮凝剂、乳化剂、悬浮稳定剂、胶黏剂，皮革和纺织品的整理剂，土壤改良剂、纸张增强剂、织物抗静电剂等。新型的共轭聚电解质结合了共轭聚合物的光电性质和聚电解质的水溶性，在一系列水相荧光检测和生物应用中表现出极大的应用前景，包括他们在针对金属离子、蛋白质、DNA等生物大分子的荧光检测等。此外，由于它们的离子基团能够与其他带电物质发生静电作用，可用于层层自组装或喷墨打印方法制作有机光电器件，可实现大面积显示器件的制作，在新一代光电器件制作中展现了它们独特的优势。
explanation_en: Polyelectrolyte are macromolecule elonrolyte, including linear or branched synthesis and natural water soluble polymer, whose structural units contain ionizable groups. According to the ionized groups contained in polyelectrolyte, they can be divided into three categories: anionic polyelectrolyte (i.e. polyacids), cationic polyelectrolyte (i.e. polybases) and amphoteric polyelectrolyte containing both anionic and cationic groups. Anionic polyelectrolyte mainly include synthetic polymer and natural polymer with carboxylic acid group, sulfonic acid group and phosphoric acid group in the side chain of polymer; cationic polyelectrolyte mainly include macromolecule with quaternary ammonium salt group and pyridine salt group in the side chain of polymer. Polyelectrolyte can usually be dissolved in water and ionized into a macromolecule polyion and many counter ions, which can form a strong macromolecule electrostatic field. Polyelectrolyte has the properties of both elonrolyte and macromolecule. Its solution is similar to elonrolyte solution and can conduct electricity; It is also similar to macromolecule solution, which has great viscosity. As a soft matter system, polyelectrolytes play an important role in the stability and interaction of many molecular assembly structures. Polyelectrolyte can be used as thickener, dispersing agent, coagulant, emulsifier, suspension stabilizer, adhesive for food, cosmetics, medicine and coatings, finishing agent for leather and textiles, soil conditioners, paper reinforcing agent, fabric antistatic agent, etc. New conjugated polyelectrolyte combine the photoelectric properties of conjugated polymer and the water solubility of polyelectrolyte, showing great application prospects in a series of aqueous fluorescence detection and biological applications, including their fluorescence detection of biomacromolecule such as metal ions, proteins, DNA, etc. In addition, because their ionic groups can have electrostatic interactions with other charged substances, they can be used to make organic optoelectronic devices by layer by layer self-assembly or inkjet printing methods, which can realize the production of large area display devices, showing their unique advantages in the production of new generation optoelectronic devices.

explanation_cn: 一种由硅原子和氮原子交替排列所形成链状或环状的聚合物，因硅原子和氮原子所连接基团的不同，分为全氢聚硅氮烷、氢化聚硅氮烷和聚有机硅氮烷。聚硅氮烷的合成方法主要有5种：氨解或胺解反应；开环聚合，脱胺缩合；Si-Cl/Si-N键的交换反应；催化脱氢偶合。通过选择不同的含硅分子和含氮分子可以方便制备不同组成结构的聚硅氮烷。聚硅氮烷因其聚合度的大小，可以为液态或固态，遇水及空气会发生水解和氧化，加热时Si-H和N-H键进一步交联使聚硅氮烷成为不溶解、不熔融、不易水解的固体，在lOOO°C以上热分解为氮化硅或氮碳化硅陶瓷。聚硅氮烷町用于制备有机透明涂层、防腐涂层、陶瓷涂层、黏结剂、陶瓷纤维外，还可用于制备陶瓷基复合材料、纳米材料、多孔材料、锂电池阳极、3D打印材料等。
explanation_en: A chain like or ring like polymer formed by alternating arrangement of silicon atoms and nitrogen atoms. Due to different groups connected by silicon atoms and nitrogen atoms, it can be divided into fully hydrogenated silazane, hydrogenated silazane and polyorganosilazane. There are five main synthetic methods of polysilazane: ammonolysis or ammonolysis reaction; Ring opening polymerization, deamination condensation; Exchange reaction of Si Cl/Si N bonds; Catalytic dehydrogenation coupling. Polysilazane with different composition and structure can be easily prepared by selecting different silicon containing molecules and nitrogen containing molecules. Due to its degree of polymerization, polysilazane can be liquid or solid. It will be hydrolyzed and oxidized when it meets water and air. When heated, Si-H and N-H bonds will further crosslinking to make polysilazane become a solid that is insoluble, unmelted and difficult to hydrolyze. It will be thermally decomposed into silicon nitride or nitrogen silicon carbide ceramics ceramics above lOOO ° C. Polysilazane can be used to prepare organic transparent coatings, anti-corrosion coatings, ceramics coatings, adhesive, ceramics fibers, as well as ceramic matrix composite, nanomaterials, porous materials, lithium battery anodes, 3D printing materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 一种主链为全硅结构的有机硅高聚物。线型聚二甲基硅烷，当其聚合度小于6时，室温下为无色液体；聚合度为6-7时为过渡态；聚合度在8以上的为白色晶体。烷基环状聚硅烷为无色、熔点较高的物质。环状聚二甲基硅烷为高度结晶化合物，不易溶于溶剂中。但随着侧链烷基碳链延长而溶解度增加。侧基为芳香基团时，可溶于甲苯、己烷等溶剂，易于加工成膜；含极性侧基的聚硅烷可溶于酮、醚中；含酚基侧基的聚硅烷可溶于稀碱液中。聚硅烷的玻璃化转变温度明显高于聚硅氧烷。在氮气中分解温度在350°C以上，而在空气中则在2O0°C左右就会分解。聚硅烷易吸收紫外线，吸收紫外线后又可以发射荧光。
explanation_en: A silicone polymer with a main chain of all silicon structure. Linear polydimethyl silane is a colorless liquid at room temperature when its degree of polymerization is less than 6; When degree of polymerization is 6-7, it is transition state; White crystal with degree of polymerization above 8. Alkyl cyclic polysilane is colorless and has high melting point. Cyclic polydimethylsilane is a highly crystalline compound and is not easily soluble in solvents. However, the water solubility increases with the extension of the side chain alkyl carbon chain. When the side group is an aromatic group, it is soluble in solvents such as toluene and hexane, making it easy to process into a film; Polysilane containing polar side groups is soluble in ketones and ethers; Polysilane containing phenolic side groups can be dissolved in dilute alkali solution. The glass transition temperature of polysilane is significantly higher than that of polysiloxane. The decomposition temperature in nitrogen is above 350 ° C, while in air it will decompose at around 2O0 ° C. Polysilane is easy to absorb ultraviolet light, and can emit fluorescence after absorbing ultraviolet light.

explanation_cn: 见聚硫橡胶密封剂。
explanation_en: See polysulfide sealant.

explanation_cn: 主链含有硫原子的特种合成橡胶的总称。通常由有机二卤化物和碱金属的多硫化物缩合而成，有固态、液态聚硫橡胶两类，其中液体橡胶产量约占总量的80%以上。大部分是二缩甲醛与四硫化钠的缩聚物。氧原子的引入改进了橡胶的低温弹性。聚硫橡胶最突出的特点是耐溶剂尤其是非极性溶剂，聚合物中含硫量越多.则耐溶剂性能越好。聚硫橡胶耐紫外线、潮气性能优异，对各种溶剂的蒸汽渗透率低。水密性、气密性、耐臭氧性均较突出。聚硫橡胶可通过有机氯单体（C1RC1)和多硫化钠的缩合反应合成。液体聚硫橡胶的分子量多在数千。液体聚硫橡胶主要用于耐油密封材料，对铝合金有较好的粘接力，用于飞机、造船、火车、建材、公路建设上。固体聚硫橡胶还用于大型油罐衬里及耐油胶管、飞机油箱衬里等场所。
explanation_en: A general term for special synthetic rubber with sulfur atoms in the main chain. It is usually condensed from organic dihalides and alkali metal polysulfides. There are two types of solid and liquid polysulfide rubber, of which the output of liquid rubber accounts for more than 80% of the total. Most of them are condensation polymers of formaldehyde and sodium tetrasulfide. The introduction of oxygen atoms improved the low-temperature elasticity of rubber. The most prominent feature of polysulfide rubber is solvent resistance, especially non-polar solvent. The more sulfur content in polymer, the better solvent resistance. Polysulfide rubber has excellent UV resistance, moisture resistance and low vapor permeability to various solvents. Water tightness, air tightness, and ozone resistance are all outstanding. Polysulfide rubber can be synthesized by condensation reaction of organochlorine monomer (C1RC1) and sodium polysulfide. The molecular weight of liquid polysulfide rubber is more than thousands. Liquid polysulfide rubber is mainly used as oil resistant sealing material. It has good adhesion to aluminum alloy and is used in aircraft, shipbuilding, trains, building materials and highway construction. Solid polysulfide rubber is also used in large oil tank lining, oil resistant hose, aircraft oil tank lining and other places.

explanation_cn: 是指一种在主链上硅原子和碳原子相间成键的有机高分子聚合物，结构复杂，具有线型、环状及笼状结构。PCS常见的合成方法有：热解重排转化法；硅氢化法；聚合物金属化法；开环聚合法；共混法。
explanation_en: It refers to an organic macromolecule polymer with complex structure, linear, ring and cage structures, in which silicon atoms and carbon atoms are bonded on the main chain. The common synthesis methods of PCS include: pyrolysis rearrangement conversion method; Silicon hydrogenation method; Polymer metallization; Ring opening polymerization method; Polymer blending method.

explanation_cn: 一类大分子链含重复碳酸酯结构的线型聚合物。可分为脂肪族、 脂肪-芳香族及芳香族聚碳酸酯。脂肪族聚碳酸酯主要通过二氧化碳与环氧烷烃在金属配合物催化剂的作用下共聚制得。
explanation_en: A kind of linear polymer with repeated carbonate structure in macromolecule chain. It can be divided into aliphatic, fat aromatic and aromatic polycarbonate. Aliphatic polycarbonate is mainly prepared by the copolymerization of carbon dioxide and epoxy alkanes in the presence of metal complex catalysts.

explanation_cn: 通过聚合物上带正负电荷的基团的静电作用形成的复合物。在药物控制释放领域，聚离子复合物可作为药物载体。
explanation_en: A complex formed by the electrostatic action of groups with positive and negative charges on polymer. In the field of controlled drug release, polyion complex can be used as drug carrier.

explanation_cn: 通过聚合物上带正负电荷的基团的静电作用形成的囊泡。在药物控制释放领域，聚离子复合物囊泡可作为药物载体。
explanation_en: Vesicle formed by the electrostatic action of positive and negative charged groups on polymer. In the field of controlled drug release, polyion complex vesicles can be used as drug carrier.

explanation_cn: 通过聚合物上带正负电荷的基团的静电作用形成的胶束。在药物控制释放领域，聚离子复合物胶束可作为药物载体。
explanation_en: Micelle formed by the electrostatic action of positively and negatively charged groups on polymer. In the field of controlled drug release, PIC micelle can be used as drug carrier.

explanation_cn: 见聚甲醛纤维。
explanation_en: See polyoxymethylene fiber.

explanation_cn: 又称聚丙烯酸锌水门汀，属聚电解质水门汀。粉剂由经过处理的氧化锌、10%氧化镁或氧化锡、少量氟化亚锡、氧化钡等组成。液剂的主要成分为30%-50%的聚丙烯酸水溶液，其平均分子量为3万-5万。有的商品为粉状丙烯酸聚合物与氧化锌粉的混合物，使用时用水调和即可固化变硬。聚羧酸锌水门汀的凝固机理是锌离子与竣基的交联作用，生成交链内盐。此种水门汀与牙齿之间可能存在化学性结合，羧基有可能与牙齿中的钙及其他反应性金属发生反应，并可能以氢键与牙本质胶原相结合。聚羧酸锌水门汀的性能与聚丙烯酸的分子量和浓度有关。调和后pH值为1.7,凝结时pH值为7。对牙髓刺激性小，对金属与牙齿、陶瓷与牙齿之间均有黏结力。凝固时间为6-9min。固化后抗压强度为60-90MPa,拉伸强度为5-lOMPa。常用于修复体及正畸附件的黏固、充填体下方基衬、窝洞暂时充填及根管封闭。
explanation_en: Also known as zinc polyacrylate cement, it belongs to polyelectrolyte cement. The powder is composed of treated zinc oxide, 10% magnesium oxide or tin oxide, a small amount of stannous fluoride, barium oxide, etc. The main component of the liquid agent is 30% -50% polyacrylic acid aqueous solution, and its average molecular weight is 30000-50000. Some products are the mixture of powdered acrylic acid polymer and zinc oxide powder, which can be curing and hardened when mixed with water. The coagulation mechanism of zinc polycarboxylate cement is the crosslinking effect of zinc ion and terminal group to generate inter chain salts. There may be chemical binding between such cement and teeth. Carboxyl may react with calcium and other reactive metals in teeth, and may combine with dentin collagen by hydrogen bond. The properties of zinc polycarboxylate cement are related to the molecular weight and concentration of polyacrylic acid. The pH value after blending is 1.7, and the pH value at coagulation is 7. It is less irritating to dental pulp, and has adhesive force between metal and teeth, and between ceramics and teeth. The solidification time is 6-9 minutes. After curing, the compressive strength is 60-90MPa, and the tensile strength is 5-lOMPa. It is commonly used for bonding of prosthesis and orthodontic attachments, underlay under fillings, temporary filling of cavities and root canal sealing.

explanation_cn: 在分子主链上不含脂肪族C-C键的全芳香族聚苯醚砜。由醚二磺酰氯、联苯、联苯单磺酰氯在硝基苯或环丁砜溶液中，以FeCl3为催化剂，氮气下于130℃反应23h制得，为琥珀色透明颗粒。
explanation_en: All aromatic polyphenylene ether sulfone without aliphatic C-C bond on the main chain of the molecule. The amber transparent particles were prepared by reacting ether disulfonyl chloride, biphenyl, and biphenyl monosulfonyl chloride in nitrobenzene or sulfolane solutions with FeCl3 as catalyst at 130 ℃ for 23 hours under nitrogen gas.

explanation_cn: 一种化学结构的线型、全芳香热塑性聚酯树脂。由对苯二甲酸和间苯二甲酸与双酚缩聚而得，对苯二甲酸和间苯二甲酸的摩尔比通常介于（7 : 3)-（5 : 5)。
explanation_en: A linear, all aromatic thermoplastic polyester resin resin with chemical structure. It is obtained by condensation of terephthalic acid and isophthalic acid with bisphenol, and the molar ratio of terephthalic acid to isophthalic acid is usually between (7:3) - (5:5).

explanation_cn: 聚芳醚酮是一类分子主链由醚基、酮基和苯基构成的芳香族聚合物。由于分子主链上含有大量的芳环及极性酮基，其分子链呈现出较大的刚性且分子间作用力较强，使其具有优良的耐热性、刚性及机械强度，另外，主链上所含有的相当多的醚键，故又表现出一定的靭性，且醚键含量越高韧性也越好。
explanation_en: Polyaryl elher ketone is a kind of aromatic polymer whose main chain is composed of ether group, ketone group and phenyl group. Due to the presence of a large number of aromatic rings and polar ketone groups in the main chain of the molecule, the chain exhibits high rigidity and strong intermolecular forces, resulting in excellent heat resistance, rigidity, and mechanical strength. In addition, the main chain contains a considerable number of ether bonds, indicating a certain degree of toughness. The higher the ether bond content, the better the toughness.

explanation_cn: 以苯环为链节的高聚物。依据结构特点，聚苯主要分为直链型和树枝形。线型聚苯在空气中低于400°C时不发生显著的分解，可长期使用；另外，聚苯耐辐射能力也很强，还具有光致发光和电致发光特性。树枝形聚苯具有较高的强度。引人生色团的聚苯有较高的量子产率、较好的光致发光、电致发光和光致变色性，是一种很好的电极材料。树枝形聚苯还具有自组装性和易成膜性。线型聚苯的合成可采用化学聚合法，也可用电化学聚合法。可以通过化学掺杂或离子注人获得导电聚苯。化学聚合聚苯是一种深褐色、不溶于有机溶剂（或水）的粉末状聚合物。它具有很好的热及热氧化稳定性、高温水解稳定性。它可通过化学掺杂或离子注人得导电聚笨，真空蒸发成膜。电化学聚合法的优点是，易于在电极上制备聚苯膜。树枝形聚合物的合成有由外向内逐步收敛的合成方法和由内向外逐步扩散增长的合成方法。目前已有核壳结构、单晶结构和纳米纤维状结构等树枝形聚苯的报道。未经掺杂的线型聚苯可用作电子设备中半导体的绝缘层；掺杂的聚苯作为导电相，主要用作充电电池的电极材料；聚苯可用作固体的润滑剂助剂；作为橡胶的增强、耐热填料。树枝形聚笨应用于各种电子设备、传感器、光泵激光、场致发光晶体管、计算机芯片和药物传输等。
explanation_en: A polymer with a benzene ring as a chain link. According to the structural characteristics, polyphenylene is mainly divided into straight chain type and dendritic type. Linear polystyrene does not undergo significant decomposition in air below 400 ° C and can be used for a long time; In addition, the radiation resistance of polyphenylene is also very strong, and it also has the characteristics of photoluminescence and electroluminescence. Dendritic polyphenylene has high strength. Polyphenylene with attractive chromophores has high quantum yield, good photoluminescence, electroluminescence and photochromism, and is a good electrode materials. Dendritic polyphenylene also has the properties of self-assembly and easy film formation. The synthesis of linear polystyrene can be achieved through chemical polymerization or electrochemical polymerization. Conductive polyphenylene can be obtained by chemical doping or ion implantation. Chemical polymerization polyphenylene is a dark brown, insoluble in organic solvents (or water) powder polymer. It has good thermal and thermal oxidation stability, as well as high-temperature hydrolysis stability. It can be obtained through chemical doping or ion implantation to obtain conductive polymer, which can be evaporated into a film under vacuum. The advantage of electrochemical polymerization method is that it is easy to prepare polystyrene film on the electrode. The synthesis of dendritic polymer includes the synthesis method of gradual convergence from outside to inside and the synthesis method of gradual diffusion growth from inside to outside. At present, there have been reports of dendritic polyphenylene with core-shell structure, single crystal structure and nanofibre structure. Undoped linear polystyrene can be used as an insulating layer for semiconductors in electronic devices; The doped polyphenylene, as a conductive phase, is mainly used as the electrode materials of rechargeable batteries; Polyphenylene can be used as solid lubricant additive; As reinforcement and heat-resistant filler of rubber. The dendrimers are used in various electronic devices, sensors, optically pumped lasers, electroluminescent transistors, computer chips and drug delivery.

explanation_cn: 由苯乙烯单体通过自由基聚合反应合成。根据大分子链上苯乙烯基的排列方式，可以分为无规聚苯乙烯（aPS）、等规聚苯乙烯（i-PS）和间规聚苯乙烯（s-PS）等不同类型，其中无规聚苯乙烯应用最广泛。由于聚苯乙烯分子链上的苯乙烯基侧链呈尤规结构，因此聚苯乙烯是一种无定形聚合物，具有很高的透明性。苯乙烯侧链的排列方式导致聚苯乙烯分子链刚性较高，使其成为透明、无色、无味的刚性固体，透光率可高达88%到90%。这使得制成的产品坚硬，敲击时会发出清脆的声音。聚苯乙烯是一种无定形聚合物，因此没有明显的熔点。它在宽广的温度范围内具有流动性，从开始熔融到分解的温度范围宽广，通常在120°C到180°C之间，因此成型加工可以在这个范围内进行。聚苯乙烯可以通过多种方法进行成型加工，包括注射成型、挤出、发泡、吹塑、热成型等。此外，聚苯乙烯还经常被用于制造泡沫塑料制品，如泡沫杯、泡沫盘等。它也可以与其他单体一起共聚，以生成各种不同性能的产品。在日常生活中，聚苯乙烯广泛应用于制造一次性塑料杯、透明CD盒等。此外，它还用于制造各种医疗用品、瓶子、包装材料等。
explanation_en: It is synthesized by free radical polymerization of styrene monomer. According to the arrangement of styrene groups on the macromolecular chain, it can be divided into different types, such as random polystyrene (aPS), isotactic polystyrene (i-PS) and syndiotactic polystyrene (s-PS), of which random polystyrene is the most widely used. Polystyrene is an amorphous polymer with high transparency because the side chain of the styryl group on the molecular chain of polystyrene is a special structure. The arrangement of the side chains of polystyrene results in high rigidity of the molecular chain of polystyrene, making it a transparent, colorless and tasteless rigid solid, and the transmittance can be as high as 88% to 90%. This makes the product hard and produces a crisp sound when struck. Polystyrene is an amorphous polymer, so there is no obvious melting point. It has flow ability in a wide temperature range. The temperature range from melting to decomposition is wide, usually between 120 ° C and 180 ° C. Therefore, molding processing can be carried out in this range. Polystyrene can be processed by many methods, including injection molding, extrusion, foaming, blow molding, thermo-forming, etc. In addition, polystyrene is often used to make foamed plastics products, such as foam cups, foam trays, etc. It can also be copolymerized with other monomer to produce products with different properties. In daily life, polystyrene is widely used to manufacture disposable plastic cups, transparent CD boxes, etc. In addition, it is also used to manufacture various medical supplies, bottles, packaging materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 是聚烯烃纤维的一种。由全同立构聚苯乙烯经熔体纺丝、拉伸等工序制成。熔点约为235°C，软化点约为228°C,密度1.08g/cm3，有优良的耐水性、耐化学腐蚀性和绝缘性，染色性较好。主要用于制作电气材料、低温热绝缘材料、制毛刷等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of polyolefin fiber. It is made of isotactic polystyrene through melt spinning, stretching and other processes. The melting point is about 235 ° C, the softening point is about 228 ° C, and the density is 1.08g/cm3. It has excellent water resistance, chemical corrosion resistance, insulation, and dyeing property. It is mainly used for making electrical materials, low-temperature thermal insulation material, brushes, etc.

explanation_cn: 高分子主链中含有苯并咪唑重复单元的耐高温、芳杂环聚合物合成聚苯并咪唑树脂的聚合工艺主要有两种，一是溶液法缩聚工艺；二是熔融法缩聚工艺。芳香族PBI是一种耐高温的工程塑料。可用作燃料电池的隔膜及自润滑轴承的垫片，或作为纤维增强复合材料的树脂基低，也可纺丝制成防火及防辐射服。低分子聚合物可用作耐高温黏合剂及绝缘涂料。
explanation_en: There are two main polymerization processes for the synthesis of polybenzimidazole resin from high temperature resistant, aromatic heterocyclic polymer with benzimidazole repeating unit in the main chain of macromolecule: one is solution polycondensation process; The second is the melt polycondensation process. Aromatic PBI is a high temperature resistant engineering plastics. It can be used as the separator of fuel cell and the gasket of self-lubricating bearing, or as the resin base of fiber reinforced composite materials. It can also be spun into fireproof and radiation proof clothing. Low molecular polymer can be used as high temperature resistant adhesive and insulation coatings.

explanation_cn: 简称PBI纤维，具有耐高温和阻燃性能的特种合成纤维。
explanation_en: PBI fiber for short is a special synthetic fiber with high temperature resistance and flame retardancy.

explanation_cn: 全称为聚亚甲基硫醚，又称聚亚苯基醚或聚次苯基硫醚，是一种线性的聚苯硫醚树脂，属于结晶性聚合物。聚笨硫醚是聚芳硫醚类树脂的一种，通常呈棕色或米黄色，具有高结晶度，是一种热塑性树脂。它具有较高的强度和模量，良好的尺寸稳定性，抗蠕变性强，具备耐疲劳的性能。此外，它还表现出出色的耐腐蚀性、阻燃性、耐高温性、耐辐射性和绝缘性。聚笨硫醚的相对密度为1.36g/cm3，熔点约在280°C到290°C之间，玻璃化温度约在90°C左右。它在空气中需要超过430°C到460°C才开始分解，而在氮气氛围中，加热至500°C以下时没有明显的重量损失。此树脂的阻燃等级为UL-94V0级，且在200°C以下不溶于绝大多数有机溶剂。聚苯硫醚的工业生产通常采用硫化钠法或硫氢化钠法。作为中国具有自主知识产权的工程塑料和特种工程塑料树脂，它已成功实现工业化生产。由于其卓越的综合性能，聚笨硫醚已被广泛应用于飞机制造业、汽车工业、电子工业、化学工业以及国防工业等具有特殊要求的领域，如需要耐高温、阻燃、耐腐蚀、绝缘、耐磨等性能的领域。
explanation_en: The full name is polymethylene sulfide, also known as polyphenylene ether or polyphenylene sulfide. It is a linear polyphenylene sulfide resin, which belongs to crystalline polymer. Polyphenylene sulfide is a kind of polyarylene sulfide resin, usually brown or beige, with high crystallinity, which is a thermoplastic resin. It has high strength and modulus, good dimensional stability, strong creep resistance and fatigue resistance. In addition, it also shows excellent corrosion resistance, flame retardancy, high temperature resistance, radiation resistance and insulation. The relative density of polyphenylene sulfide is 1.36g/cm 3， The melting point is about 280 ° C to 290 ° C, and the glass transition temperature is about 90 ° C. It needs to exceed 430 ° C to 460 ° C in the air to begin decomposition, while in a nitrogen atmosphere, there is no significant weight loss when heated below 500 ° C. The flame retardant grade of this resin is UL-94V0, and it is insoluble in most organic solvents below 200 ° C. The industrial production of polyphenylene sulfide usually adopts sodium sulfide method or sodium hydrosulfide method. As China's engineering plastics and special engineering plastics resin with independent intellectual property rights, it has successfully achieved industrial production. Due to its excellent comprehensive performance, polyphenylene sulfide has been widely used in fields with special requirements such as aircraft manufacturing, automotive industry, electronics industry, chemical industry, and national defense industry, such as those that require high temperature resistance, flame retardancy, corrosion resistance, insulation, and wear resistance.

explanation_cn: 以聚苯硫醚（PPS)树脂为基体的复合材料聚苯硫醚树脂是以二氯苯和硫化钠为原料，在极性溶剂中进行溶液聚合或以卤代苯硫酚金属盐在吡啶溶液或在无溶剂条件下自缩聚制得。其分子链由苯环与硫原子交替排列，苯环与硫醚分別提供树脂刚性与柔韧性，致使聚苯硫醚具有很强结晶能力，在特定条件下的结晶度可达70%,改变工艺条件可制得无定形或部分结晶树脂。聚苯硫醚树脂耐热性能优异，其短期耐热性和热稳定性强于其他工程塑料。聚苯硫醚树脂尺寸稳定性好，成型收缩率低，具有优良的电性能、耐燃性、耐化学性，但该树脂冲击轫性较低，用纤维增强后，冲击强度大幅度提高，耐热性与其他力学性能也得到改善。常用的增强体有玻璃纤维、碳纤维、芳纶及其织物等。具有很好的流动性和工艺性，所适用的成型方法如模压成型、注塑成型、挤出成型等。该类复合材料因其耐高温、耐腐蚀性能被广泛用于汽车工业、电气电子工业与航空航天工业，例如其碳纤维增强聚苯硫醚树脂基复合材料可作战机机翼、导弹垂直尾翼、检修舵门等结构件。
explanation_en: The composite materials polyphenylene sulfide (PPS) resin based polyphenylene sulfide resin is made from dichlorobenzene and sodium sulfide as raw materials by solution polymerization in polar solvent or self polycondensation of halogenated phenyl thiophenol metal salt in pyridine solution or solvent-free condition. Its molecular chain is alternately arranged by benzene ring and sulfur atom. The benzene ring and sulfur ether provide the rigidity and flexibility of resin respectively, so that polyphenylene sulfide has a strong crystallization ability, and its crystallinity can reach 70% under specific conditions. Amorphous or partially crystalline resin can be obtained by changing the process conditions. Polyphenylene sulfide resin has excellent heat resistance, and its short-term heat resistance and thermal stability are better than other engineering plastics. Polyphenylene sulfide resin has good dimensional stability, low molding shrinkage, excellent electrical properties, flame resistance, and chemical resistance, but the impact toughness of this resin is low. After being reinforced with fiber, the impact strength is greatly improved, and the heat resistance and other mechanical properties are also improved. Common reinforcement include glass fiber, carbon fiber, aramid fiber and its fabrics. It has good flow ability and processability, and is suitable for molding methods such as press molding, injection molding, extrusion molding, etc. This kind of composite materials is widely used in the automotive industry, electrical and electronic industry and aerospace industry because of its high temperature resistance and corrosion resistance, such as its carbon fiber reinforced polyphenylene sulfide resin based composite materials, which can be used for the wing of combat aircraft, missile vertical tail, maintenance rudder door and other structural parts.

explanation_cn: 一种具有特殊的电学、光学性质，经掺杂后可具有导电性的高分子材料。在电子工业、信息工程、国防工程等的开发和发展方面都具有多种用途。
explanation_en: A macromolecule materials with special electrical and optical properties and conductivity after doping. It has multiple uses in the development and development of electronic industry, information engineering, national defense engineering, and other fields.

explanation_cn: 是一类含有PBT(聚对苯二甲酸丁二醇酯）聚酯硬段和脂肪族聚酯或聚醚软段的线型嵌段热塑性弹性体。通常是由二元羧酸及其衍生物、两端为-OH的聚醚及低分子二醇的混合物通过熔融酯交换反应制备的。通过对软硬段比例的调节，产品硬度可在32-82(邵氏D)的范闱内进行变化；拉伸强度25-40MPa。产品在常温下及低温下的冲击强度高，化学稳定性优良，耐候性优良，且具备优异的电件能和电荷承受能力，与金属以及ABS、PC等高分子材料均具有极好的黏结性。在汽车制件、液瓜软管、电缆电线、电子电气、工业制品、文体用品、生物材料等领域得到了广泛的应用，其中在汽车工业中的应用最广，占70%以上。
explanation_en: It is a linear block thermoplastic elastomers containing PBT (polybutylene terephthalate) polyester hard segment and aliphatic polyester or polyether soft segment. It is usually prepared by the mixture of dicarboxylic acid and its derivatives, polyether with - OH at both ends and low molecular glycol through melt transesterification. By adjusting the proportion of soft and hard sections, the hardness of the product can be changed within the range of 32-82 (Shore D); The tensile strength is 25-40MPa. The product has high impact strength at room temperature and low temperature, excellent chemical stability, excellent weather resistance, excellent electrical component capability and charge bearing capacity, and excellent adhesion with metals, macromolecule materials such as ABS and PC. It has been widely used in automobile parts, liquid melon hoses, cables and wires, electronic and electrical products, industrial products, sporting goods, biological materials and other fields, among which, it is the most widely used in the automobile industry, accounting for more than 70%.

explanation_cn: 高分子主链具有重负羧酸酯结构的树脂状高聚物。可分成饱和的（热塑性）和不饱和的（热固性）两大类。饱和的聚酯树脂常见的多是芳香族二元酸的线型聚酯。其中二元醇的聚酯，包括聚对苯二甲酸乙二酯、丁二酯和1,4-环己二甲酯，以及聚2,6-萘二甲酸乙二酯等，统称为热塑性聚酯。至于芳香族二元羧酸与双酚（或二元酚）的聚酯则属全芳香族聚酯，而聚芳酯通常指的是共聚对，间笨二甲酸双酚A酯。醇酸树脂是多元酸或/和多元醇的聚酯，其分子链具有枝化结构，主要用作涂料。它也分饱和的与不饱和的两类。不饱和的聚酯树脂，实际包括醇酸不饱和聚酯树脂和通常意义的不饱和聚酯树脂。
explanation_en: A resin like polymer with a heavy carboxylate structure in the main chain of macromolecule. It can be divided into two categories: saturated (thermoplastic) and unsaturated (thermosetting). Saturated polyester resins are commonly linear polyesters with aromatic dicarboxylic acids. Among them, polyester of diols, including poly (ethylene terephthalate), butyl ester, 1,4-cyclohexanedimethyl ester, and polyethylene 2,6-naphthalate, are collectively referred to as thermoplastic polyester. As for the polyester of aromatic dicarboxylic acids and bisphenols (or bisphenols), it belongs to the category of fully aromatic polyester, while polyaromatic esters usually refer to copolymers of bisphenol A, m-benzoic acid. Alkyd resin is a polyester of polybasic acids or/and polyhydric alcohols. Its molecular chains have branched structure and are mainly used as coatings. It is also divided into two categories: saturated and unsaturated. Unsaturated polyester resin actually includes alkyd unsaturated polyester resin and generally unsaturated polyester resin.

explanation_cn: 以聚酯为主要成膜物质的涂料。聚酯树脂涂料分为不饱和的和饱和的两大类。不饱和聚酯涂料是用不饱和二元酸（如顺丁烯二酸酐）和二元醇（如乙二醇、丙二醇）反应制得线型高聚物，用笨乙烯作为活性溶剂，配成涂料。使用时再加人引发剂、促进剂等。使高聚物再与苯乙烯共聚同化成膜，为了克服对树脂的阻聚作用，加人石蜡作为封闭剂。由于活件溶剂苯乙烯也是成膜组分，故不饱和聚酯涂料也叫无溶剂涂料。以双组分(双包装）或多组分的形式供应用户掺和后使用。以石蜡作为封闭剂时，硬固后.表面上的石蜡膜必须经机械抛光，才能光亮。不饱和聚酯树脂涂料，一次涂装，减少涂装道数，所得涂膜丰满度高、透明色浅、装饰效果极好；涂膜的硬度高、耐磨、耐热、耐寒、耐化学性优良，绝缘性也好。缺点是多组分包装，使用不便；涂膜硬而脆.不耐碰撞；固化过程中收缩率较大，对附着力有影响。不饱和聚酯涂料用于涂装木器家具、钢琴、仪表木壳、缝纫机台板等，有时也用于金属表面罩光，浸渍电机线圈和制作漆包线等。饱和聚酯树脂涂料称为无油醇酸漆，三聚氰胺树脂交联同化。由于树脂的主链上有脂肪族的二元醇和芳香族的二元醇，交联点的多少可通过配方来决定，故饱和聚酯涂料的涂膜在较高的硬度下，仍保持着较好的柔韧性，并且保色保光，广泛应用于后加工性要求较高的预涂卷材上。聚酯树脂中加人光敏剂或引人光敏基团，可制成光敏涂料，适合用紫外线或电子束进行固化.提高生产力。
explanation_en: Coatings with polyester as the main film forming material. Polyester resin coatings are divided into two categories: unsaturated and saturated. Unsaturated polyester resin coatings is a linear polymer prepared by reaction of unsaturated dicarboxylic acid (such as maleic anhydride) and diol (such as ethylene glycol and propylene glycol), and a coatings is prepared by using styrene as active solvent. Add initiator and accelerator when using. The polymer is copolymerized and assimilated with styrene to form a film. In order to overcome the inhibition on resin, paraffin is added as a sealing agent. As live solvent styrene is also a film forming component, unsaturated polyester resin coatings is also called solventless coating. Supplied to users in the form of dual component (dual packaging) or multi-component blending for use. When using paraffin as a sealing agent, the paraffin film on the surface must be mechanically polished to be bright after hardening. Unsaturated polyester resin coatings can be applied in one time to reduce the number of coating layers. The resulting film has high fullness, light transparent color and excellent decorative effect; The film has high hardness, wear resistance, heat resistance, cold resistance, chemical resistance and good insulation. The disadvantage is multi-component packaging, which is inconvenient to use; The coating is hard and brittle, resistant to collision; The shrinkage rate during curing is large, which affects the adhesion. Unsaturated polyester resin coatings is used for painting wooden furniture, piano, instrument wooden shell, sewing machine bedplate, etc., sometimes it is also used for metal surface polishing, dipping motor coil and making enameled wire, etc. Saturated polyester resin coatings is called oleanol free acid paint, and melamine resin crosslinking assimilation. As there are aliphatic diols and aromatic diols on the main chain of resin, the number of crosslinking points can be determined by the formula, so the film of saturated polyester resin coatings still maintains good flexibility under high hardness, and maintains color and light, which is widely used in pre coated coiled materials with high post-processing requirements. Polyester resin can be made into photosensitive coatings by adding photosensitizer or photosensitive group, which is suitable for curing with ultraviolet ray or electron beam to improve productivity.

explanation_cn: 由多种二元醇和芳香族二羧酸经缩聚合成的聚酯为原料制得的合成纤维的统称。纤维的制造一般采用熔融纺丝法。是服用、家纺、产业用丝的重要材料。
explanation_en: A general term for synthetic fibers made from polyester synthesized by condensation polymerization of various diols and aromatic dicarboxylic acids. The manufacturing of fibers generally adopts the melt spinning method. It is an important materials for clothing, home textile and industrial silk.

explanation_cn: 在聚合物大分子链中具有交替的酯-酰压胺重复链节的一种改性聚酰亚胺。用偏苯三酸酐对苯二酚酯与二元胺在强极性溶剂中室温下反应缩聚制成。制得的酰胺酸溶液，可制膜或干燥成粉末。用聚酯酰亚胺制得的淡黄色透明坚韧薄膜，强度高于普通聚酰亚胺膜。软化温度为300°C，长期使用温度230-240°C。薄膜表面硬度为3H。高温氧化稳定性不如主链无聚酯的聚酰亚胺好。耐化学药品件能良好，介质损耗因子低。聚酯酰亚胺主要用作F级和H级电机浸溃绝缘漆、耐热绝缘薄膜、电缆包覆、半导体封装等。
explanation_en: A modified polyimide having alternating ester imide repeat chains in the polymer macromolecule chain. It is prepared by reacting and polycondensation of terephthalic anhydride hydroquinone ester and diamine in a strong polar solvent at room temperature. The prepared amide acid solution can be used to prepare film or dried into powder. The light yellow transparent and tough film made of polyesterimide has higher strength than ordinary polyimide film. The bating temperature is 300 ° C, and the long-term use temperature is 230-240 ° C. The hardness of the film surface is 3H. High temperalure oxidation stability is not as good as that of polyester free polyimide in the main chain. Chemical resistant parts are good, and the medium loss factor is low. Polyesterimide is mainly used as Class F and Class H motor immersion insulation paint, heat-resistant insulation film, cable coating, semiconductor packaging, etc.

explanation_cn: 分子结构含有酰亚胺基链节的一类芳杂环聚合物。其包括线型聚酰亚胺和交联聚酰亚胺两大类。
explanation_en: A class of aromatic heterocyclic polymer whose molecular structure contains imide groups. It includes linear polyimide and crosslinking polyimide.

explanation_cn: 指聚合物分子链中含有芳酰亚胺的特种合成纤维。商品名阿里米特(Arimid)和P84。阿里米特是耐高温阻燃纤维，P84的针刺毡主要用于130-260°C高温烟道气的滤材，其绝热非织造布可取代玻纤用于飞机上，可减重50%。其纸产品可用作电绝缘材料、蜂窝结构材料及热封材料等。
explanation_en: It refers to special synthetic fiber containing aromatic imide in polymer molecular chain. Trade names Arimid and P84. Arimet is a high temperature resistant flame retardant fiber. P84 needled felt is mainly used as filter material for 130-260 ° C high temperature flue gas. Its thermal insulation nonwoven fabric can replace glass fiber for aircraft, which can reduce weight by 50%. Its paper products can be used as electrical insulation materials, honeycomb structural materials and heat sealing materials.

explanation_cn: 以聚酰胺酸或可溶性聚酰亚胺树脂为基料，溶解于某种有机溶剂中制成的耐高温特种胶黏剂，根据选择聚酰亚胺的种类不同，具有不同的使用温度，但一般在28O°C以上长期使用，短期使用温度可达420°C; 耐高剂量辐照性好；耐低温性能和电绝缘性优良；对金属粘接力强。
explanation_en: The special high temperature resistant adhesive, which is made of polyamide acid or soluble polyimide resin as the base material and dissolved in some organic solvent, has different use temperatures according to the type of polyimide selected, but generally it is used for a long time above 28O ° C, and the short-term use temperature can reach 420 ° C; Good resistance to high dose irradiation; Excellent low-temperature resistance and electrical insulation; Strong adhesion to metal.

explanation_cn: 指含芳酰胺-酰亚胺链节的特种合成纤维，属耐高温纤维。商品名克美尔（Kermel )。
explanation_en: It refers to the special synthetic fiber containing aromatic amide imide chain link, which is a high temperature resistant fiber. Trade name Kermel.

explanation_cn: 又称尼龙树脂，是在主链结构中含有多个重复酰胺基团（-NH-CO-）的高分子化合物的总称。聚酰胺可以分为天然来源及人工合成两种天然高分子中的蛋白质都可以看作是氨基酸的缩聚物，在生物界叫做多缩氨基酸，这类高分子物质在生命过程中起到重要的作用，并构成细胞及整个基体的基础。
explanation_en: Also known as nylon resin, it is the general name of macromolecule compounds containing multiple repeated amide groups (- NH-CO -) in the main chain structure. Polyamide can be divided into two kinds of natural polymer: natural source and artificial synthesis. Protein in natural polymer can be regarded as the condensation polymer of amino acid, which is called poly amino acid in the biological world. This kind of macromolecule plays an important role in the life process and forms the basis of cells and the whole matrix.

explanation_cn: 由酰胺基（-CONH-)与烃基连接为结构单元的线型聚酰胺制成的合成纤维。根据官能团在芳香环上取代位置不同，有聚对苯二甲酰对苯二胺纤维、聚间苯二甲酰间苯二胺纤维
explanation_en: The synthetic fiber is made of linear polyamide with amide group (- CONH -) and hydrocarbon group as the structural unit. According to the different substitutions of functional groups on the aromatic ring, there are poly (p-phenyleneterephthamide) fiber and poly (m-phenylene isophthalamide) fiber

explanation_cn: 酰亚胺环和酰胺键有规则交替排列的一类耐高温聚合物。PAI的合成是用偏苯三酸酐酰氯与芳族二胺在极性溶剂中低温（-15°C左右）反应生成含酰胺基的二酐，再加入等当量的芳香二胺制成酰胺酸，其溶液可直接用作涂料。
explanation_en: A class of high temperature resistant polymer with regularly alternating imide rings and amide bonds. The synthesis of PAI is to use trimellitic anhydride acyl chloride and aromatic diamine to react in polar solvent at low temperature (about -15 ° C) to produce dianhydride containing amide group, and then add equivalent aromatic diamine to produce amide acid. Its solution can be directly used as coatings.

explanation_cn: 由芳香二元酸脱水缩聚而成的聚合物。如以反式-4-羟基肉桂酸和1,8-二溴辛烷为原料合成二元酸，然后脱水而成聚酐。聚酸酐的生物降解为表面溶蚀降解，其在药物释放体系中的应用很有价值，可实现生物活性物质的短期恒速释放。它的表面浸蚀降解性能可由改变聚合物主链结构而控制。由双（对羧苯氧基）甲烷缩聚所得聚酐，水解速度很快，可制成纤维，用作药物释放载体，其在体内的浸蚀速率稍大于体外缓冲液中浸蚀的速率，释放行为接近零级。
explanation_en: A polymer formed by dehydration and condensation of aromatic dicarboxylic acids. For example, binary acids are synthesized from trans 4-hydroxycinnamic acid and 1,8-dibromooctane, and then dehydrated to form polyanhydrides. The biodegradation of polyanhydride is surface corrosion degradation, which is very valuable in the application of drug release system, and can realize the short-term constant rate release of bioactivity substances. Its surface etching degradation performance can be controlled by changing the main chain structure of polymer. The polyanhydride obtained from the condensation of bis (p-carboxyphenyloxy) methane has a fast hydrolysis rate and can be made into fibers for drug release carriers. Its corrosion rate in vivo is slightly higher than that in vitro buffer, and its release behavior is close to zero order.

explanation_cn: 即聚醚多元醇，又称多元醇撑羟基聚氧乙烯聚氧丙烯醚。一种无色或浅蓝色不挥发黏稠液态聚合物。即由环氧烷烃（如环氧乙烷、环氧丙烷、环氧丁烷）在碱性催化剂作用下与含活泼氢的起始剂（如丙三醇、乙二醇、丙二醇等）按阴离子开环聚合而得。其中以丙三醇为起始剂与环氧乙烷(EO)、环氧丙烷（PO)进行聚合制备聚醚最为通用，通过调节EO与PO配比、改变聚合条件可生产各种通用聚醚。聚醚是合成聚氨酯泡沫塑料的主要原料，可用于制备胶黏剂和弹性体，亦可直接用作非离子型表面活性剂和消泡剂。在生物医学领域，聚醚一般指分子主链中含醚氧键的热塑性聚合物。根据反应物的性质和反应条件，可制得许多性质不同的聚醚。医用聚醚有：①环氧树脂，由芳香二环氧化合物聚合而成，具有优良的化学耐浊性和黏结力，用作齿科修复料；②聚环氧乙烷，可用作药物缓释载体等；③聚氧化亚甲基，即聚甲醛，用于制作人工心瓣膜瓣架及人工关节等；④聚环氧丙烷，用于制作抗凝血的聚氨酯弹性体等。此外，氧化乙烯和氧化丙烯的ABA型嵌段共聚物，可用于制作含硝酸根的水凝胶敷料等，聚苯醚可用于制造医用器械等。
explanation_en: It is polyether polyol, also known as polyol supported hydroxy polyoxyethylene polyoxypropylene ether. A colorless or light blue nonvolatile viscous liquid polymer. It is obtained by anionic ring opening polymerization of epoxy alkanes (such as ethylene oxide, propylene oxide, and butane oxide) with initiators containing active hydrogen (such as glycerol, ethylene glycol, propylene glycol, etc.) under the action of alkaline catalyst. Among them, glycerol is the most common initiator for polymerization with ethylene oxide (EO) and propylene oxide (PO) to prepare polyether. Various general polyether can be produced by adjusting the ratio of EO and PO and changing the polymerization conditions. Polyether is the main raw material for the synthesis of polyurethane foam, which can be used to prepare adhesive and elastomer, and can also be directly used as non-ionic surfactant and defoamer. In the field of biomedicine, polyether generally refers to the thermoplastic polymer containing ether oxygen bond in the main chain of the molecule. According to the properties of reactants and reaction conditions, many polyether with different properties can be prepared. Medical polyether includes: ① epoxy resin, polymerization from aromatic diepoxy compounds, which has excellent chemical turbidity resistance and adhesion and is used as dental restorative materials; ② Polyethylene oxide can be used as a drug sustained-release carrier, etc.; ③ Polymethylene oxide, or paraformaldehyde, is used to make artificial heart valve frames and artificial joint; ④ Polyepoxypropane is used to make anticoagulant polyurethime elastomer, etc. In addition, ABA type block copolymer of ethylene oxide and propylene oxide can be used to make hydrogel dressings containing nitrate, and polyphenylene oxide can be used to make medical devices, etc.

explanation_cn: 主链硅原子上连有聚醚基团的聚二甲基硅氧烷油状液 体。分水解型和非水解型两大类，水解型是以Si-O-C键相连，非水解型以Si-C链相连。聚醚改性硅油是一种表面活性剂。最大特点是溶于水。
explanation_en: Polydimethylsiloxane oily liquid with polyether groups attached to the main chain silicon atoms. There are two main types of hydrolysis type and non hydrolysis type. The hydrolysis type is connected by Si-O-C bonds, while the non hydrolysis type is connected by Si-C chains. Polyether-modified silicone oil is a kind of surfactant. The biggest characteristic is its solubility in water.

explanation_cn: 又称聚苯醚砜和聚芳醚砜。主链含醚键的聚芳砜透明的高性能热塑性工程塑料。
explanation_en: Also known as polyphenylene ether sulfone and polyarylethersulfone. Polyarysulfone with ether bond in the main chain is a transparent high-performance thermoplastic engineering plastics.

explanation_cn: 重复单元以醚基、砜基和酮基为结构特征基团并依次与亚苯基环相连接而成的芳香族聚合物。PESK一般由聚醚砜 (PES)和聚醚酮（PEK)通过亲核取代缩聚反应制得。
explanation_en: The repeating unit is an aromatic polymer with ether group, sulfone group and ketone group as the structural characteristic group and successively linked with the phenylene ring phase. PESK is generally prepared from polyether sulphone (PES) and polyether ketone (PEK) through nucleophilic substitution polycondensation reaction.

explanation_cn: 醚键和酮基交替与亚苯基联结的半结晶性聚芳醚酮类聚合物。由于PEK分子结构中的醚键与酮键的比例低于PEEK，因而其熔点和玻璃化转变温度均高于PEEK。耐热性是芳族聚醚酮中最高的，耐长期使用温度为250°C。
explanation_en: Semi crystalline poly (aryl ether ketone) polymer with ether bond and ketone group alternately linked with phenylene. Because the ratio of ether bond to ketone bond in the molecular structure of PEK is lower than that of PEEK, its melting point and glass transition temperature are higher than that of PEEK. The heat resistance is the highest among aromatic polyether ketone, and the long-term use temperature is 250 ° C.

explanation_cn: 酮酮顺序交替与亚苯基环联结的半晶型聚芳醚酮类聚合物。由于提高了主链上羰基的含量，使得其耐热性能比PEKK有较大的提高，具有耐高温、耐化学药品腐蚀、优良的耐燃性和较低的烟密度等物理化学性能。
explanation_en: Semi crystalline poly (aryl ether ketone) polymer with ketones and ketones alternately linked with phenylene ring. Due to the increase of carbonyl content in the main chain, its heat resistance is greatly improved compared with PEKK, and it has physical chemistry properties such as high temperature resistance, chemical corrosion resistance, excellent flame resistance and low smoke density.

name_en: polyether ether ketone ether ketone ketone
explanation_cn: 醚键和羰基以醚酮醚酮酮顺序依次与亚苯基环相连接而成的半晶型聚芳醚酮类聚合物。具有优异的耐热性、机械强度和模量。
explanation_en: The semi crystalline poly (aryl ether ketone) polymer is formed by connecting the ether bond and carbonyl group with the phase of the phenylene ring in the order of ether ketone ether ketone ketone ketone. It has excellent heat resistance, mechanical strength, and modulus.

explanation_cn: 指大分子链由聚醚二醇类软链段和聚酯类硬链段所构成的聚合物纤维。该纤维的断面呈梅花形，伸长率为600%以上，其他性能与聚氨酯弹性纤维相仿，耐湿热和耐碱性优良。其制备方法主要有：①将2,6-萘二酸与1,4-丁二醇缩聚而得的聚2,6-萘二酸丁二酯硬链段与聚（氧化亚烷）二醇软链段进行嵌段共聚，熔纺后即得弹性纤维;②将聚对苯二甲酸丁二酯与数均分子量约2000的聚丁二醇,以质量比为45/55的比例进行共聚,制得弹性体后，加人1%-5%的直链状低密度聚乙烯,以提高可纺性,铸带切粒后熔纺、拉伸，松弛40%,即得弹性纤维，强度1.06cN/dtex,伸长率413%,回弹率95.92%;③以聚酯或聚对笨二甲酸丁二酯为硬链段，并以三官能团的醇类与氧烷环的缩合物如三羟甲基丙烷与环氧乙烷的缩合物（数均分子量为1000-3000)与歧化剂进行共聚，熔纺后进行拉伸，并在热板上热收缩50%左右，即得强度O.91cN/dtex,伸长率400%，回弹率87%的弹性纤维，耐热性、耐候性和耐药品性优良。其与涤纶或锦纶混纺后主要用于制备连裤袜、紧身衣、游泳衣、滑雪服和运动服等。
explanation_en: It refers to the polymer fiber whose macromolecular chain is composed of polyether glycol soft chain segment and polyester hard chain segment. The cross section of the fiber is quincunx shaped, and the elongation is more than 600%. Other properties are similar to those of polyurethime elastic fiber, and the fiber has excellent moisture and heat resistance and alkali resistance. The preparation methods mainly include: ① block copolymerization of the hard chain segment of polybutylene 2,6-naphthalate obtained by condensation of 2,6-naphthalene diacid and 1,4-butanediol with the soft chain segment of poly (alkylene oxide) glycol, and melt spinning to obtain elastic fiber; ② Poly (butylene terephthalate) and polybutylene glycol with a number average molecular weight of about 2000 were copolymerized at a mass ratio of 45/55 to obtain elasticity. 1% -5% straight chain low density polyethylene was added to improve spinnability. After the casting belt was pelletized, it was melt spun, stretched, and relaxed by 40% to obtain elastic fiber with strength of 1.06cN/dtex, elongation of 413%, and rebound rate of 95.92%; ③ Polyester or polybutylene terephthalate is used as hard chain segment, and trifunctional alcohol and oxane ring condensate, such as trimethylolpropane and ethylene oxide condensate (number average molecular weight is 1000-3000), is copolymerized with disproportionator. After melt spinning, it is stretched, and heat shrinks by about 50% on the hot plate to obtain a elastic fiber with strength of 0.91cN/dtex, elongation of 400%, and resilience of 87%. It has excellent heat resistance, weather resistance, and drug resistance. After blending with polyester or nylon, it is mainly used to prepare pantyhose, tight fitting clothes, swimsuits, ski suits, and sportswear.

explanation_cn: 醚键序交替与亚苯基环联结的半晶型聚芳醚酮类聚合物。最大特点是耐热性极好，在所有工程塑料中具有最好的耐热水性和耐蒸汽性，可在200-240°C蒸汽中长期使用，或在300°C高压蒸汽中短期使用。氧指数高，燃烧时发烟量少，耐蠕变和耐疲劳性能优良，耐化学药品性优良，并有良好的绝缘性和耐辐射性。
explanation_en: Semi crystalline poly (aryl ether ketone) polymer with alternating ether bond order and phenylene ring. The biggest feature is excellent heat resistance. It has the best heat water resistance and steam resistance among all engineering plastics. It can be used for a long time in 200-240 ° C steam, or for a short time in 300 ° C high-pressure steam. High oxygen index, less smoke during combustion, good creep resistance and fatigue resistance, good chemical resistance, good insulation and radiation resistance.

explanation_cn: 醚键和羰基以醚醚酮酮顺序依次与亚苯基环相连接而成的半晶型聚芳醚酮类聚合物。由于分子结构中的酮基/醚键的比例与PEK相同，其熔点和玻璃化转变温度与PEK相近，也具有优异的耐热性、机械强度和模量。
explanation_en: The semi crystalline poly (aryl ether ketone) polymer is formed by connecting the ether bond and carbonyl group with the phase of the phenylene ring in the order of ether ether ketone ketone ketone. Because the ratio of ketone/ether bond in the molecular structure is the same as that of PEK, its melting point and glass transition temperature are similar to that of PEK, and it also has excellent heat resistance, mechanical strength and modulus.

name_cn: 聚间苯二甲酰间苯二胺树脂
explanation_cn: 主要由间苯二甲酰氯和苯二胺经溶液缩聚或界面缩聚制得。结晶结构属于三斜晶系，密度1.33-1.36g/cm3，熔融温度340-360℃,分解温度450℃,脆化温度约-70℃，维卡耐热270℃。
explanation_en: It is mainly prepared by solution polycondensation or interfacial polycondensation of m-phthaloyl chloride and phenylenediamine. The crystal structure belongs to triclinic system, with density of 1.33-1.36g/cm3, melting temperature of 340-360 ℃, decomposition temperature of 450 ℃, embrittlement temperature of about -70 ℃, and Vicat heat resistance of 270 ℃.

name_cn: 聚间苯二甲酸二烯丙酯
explanation_cn: 间苯二甲酸二烯丙酯的聚合物。单体先制成预聚物.使用时加入催化剂，或在光、热作用下交联固化成不溶不熔固体树脂，DAIP塑料的基本性能与DAP塑料十分接近，而且更易成塑，具有更高的热稳定性和机械强度。
explanation_en: Polymer of diallyl isophthalate. The monomer is first made into a prepolymer. When used, a catalyst is added, or crosslinking curing under the action of light and heat to form an insoluble and unmelted solid resin. The basic properties of DAIP plastics are very close to those of DAP plastics, and it is easier to form plastic, with higher thermal stability and mechanical strength.

explanation_cn: 聚集诱导发光（AIE)是由我国科学家定义的一类光物理现象并引领的一个研究领域，AIE是指一类荧光分子在溶液中不发光或者发光微弱，而在聚集态或者固态发光增强的现象。AIE聚合物是一类具有AIE或聚集发光增强（aggregation-en-hanced emission; AEE)特性的功能高分子材料。
explanation_en: Aggregation induced luminescence (AIE) is a kind of photophysical phenomenon defined and led by Chinese scientists. AIE refers to the phenomenon that a kind of fluorescence molecule does not luminescence or luminescence weakly in solution, but luminescence increases in the aggregated state or solid state. AIE polymer is a kind of functional macromolecule materials with AIE or aggregation enhanced emission (AEE) characteristics.

explanation_cn: 又称聚（卡硼烷硅氧烷）。聚硼硅氧烷PB的结构与聚硅氧烷类似，是聚硅氧烷主链中的部分Si原子被B原子取代而形成的一类聚合物。功能高分子材料(functionalpolymersmaterial)具有化学反应活性、光敏性、导电性、催化性、生物相容性、药理性、选择分离性、能量转换性、磁性等功能的高分子及其复合材料。
explanation_en: Also known as poly (carborane siloxane). The structure of polyborosiloxane PB is similar to polysiloxane. It is a kind of polymer formed by replacing some Si atoms in the main chain of polysiloxane with B atoms. Functional macromolecule materials is a macromolecule and its composite materials with chemical reactivity, photosensitivity, conductivity, catalysis, biocompatibility, pharmacology, selective separation, energy conversion, magnetism and other functions.

explanation_cn: 动物皮上与动物体相连的一面。
explanation_en: The side of an animal's skin that is connected to its body.

explanation_cn: 肖克莱不全位错是指在构造地质学中，地层（通常是页岩）在构造活动中被压缩、弯曲或错位的过程。这种错位通常是由地壳构造运动引起的，例如山脉的抬升或地震活动。肖克莱不全位错是指地层被挤压并弯曲，然后在某一位置上部分重叠在下部，形成一种错位的地质结构。
explanation_en: Shockley partial dislocation refers to the process in which strata (usually shale) are compressed, bent or dislocated in tectonic activity in structural geology. This misalignment is usually caused by crustal tectonic movements, such as mountain uplift or seismic activity. Shockley partial dislocation refers to that the stratum is extrusion and bent, and then partially overlaps the lower part at a certain position, forming a dislocation geological structure.

explanation_cn: 在金属与半导体界面区域形成的势垒，具有整流作用。N喷半导体的费米能级高于金属费米能级，P型半导体的费米能级低于金属费米能级。
explanation_en: The potential barrier formed at the interface between metal and semiconductor has a rectifying effect. The Fermi level of N-jet semiconductor is higher than that of metal Fermi level, and the Fermi level of P-type semiconductor is lower than that of metal Fermi level.

explanation_cn: 指的是一种半导体器件的结构形式，由基底、n型半导体和p型半导体三部分构成。在n型半导体和p型半导体的接触面上，形成一个正向偏压的势垒，使得电子由n型半导体向p型半导体方向运动时，容易通过势垒而到达p型半导体，而从p型半导体向n型半导体运动时则比较困难。这种特性使得肖特基接触适用于快速开关、光电探测器等应用场景。
explanation_en: Refers to the structural form of a semiconductor device, consisting of three parts: substrate, n-type semiconductor, and p-type semiconductor. On the contact surface between n-type and p-type semiconductors, a forward bias potential barrier is formed, which makes it easier for electrons to pass through the barrier and reach p-type semiconductors when moving from n-type semiconductors to p-type semiconductors, while it is more difficult to move from p-type semiconductors to n-type semiconductors. This characteristic makes Schottky contact suitable for fast switching, photodetector and other application scenarios.

explanation_cn: 是晶体结构中的一种原子或离子离开原来所在的格点位置形成的空位式的点缺陷。每一个空位都是一个独立的肖特基缺陷。在金属中空位运动是重要的扩散机制之一，空位扩散机制的理论计算与实验结果最相近。晶体中位错的攀移也有赖于空位的运动。在离子晶体中单个的阳离子空位或阴离子空位吋与电子或空穴结合而形成色心。半导体中空位对电性质有显著影响。一般来说，随着温度的升高，缺陷的浓度会增大。对于典型的离子晶体碱金属卤化物，肖特基缺陷形成能较低，对于氧化物而言，其离子性显然小于碱金属卤化物，所以它的形成能较高，只有在较高的温度下，它才变得重要。
explanation_en: It is a kind of vacancy type point defect formed by atoms or ions leaving the original lattice position in crystal structure. Each vacancy is an independent Schottky defect. The movement of vacancy in metals is one of the important diffusion mechanisms, and the theoretical calculation of vacancy diffusion mechanism is the closest to the experimental results. The climb of dislocation in crystal also depends on the movement of vacancy. A single cation vacancy or anion vacancy in an ionic crystal combines with electrons or holes to form a color centers. Vacancy in semiconductor has a significant effect on electrical properties. Generally speaking, as the temperature increases, the concentration of defects will increase. For typical ionic crystal alkali halide, the formation energy of Schottky defect is low. For oxide, its ionicity is obviously smaller than that of alkali halide, so its formation energy is high. It becomes important only at a higher temperature.

explanation_cn: 专门用于加工农作物筒的纸。具有一定的干强度、湿强度和透气性。
explanation_en: Paper specifically used for processing crop barrels. It has certain dry strength, wet strength and air permeability.

explanation_cn: 可用作火箭燃料的肼及其衍生物的通称。泛指无水胼、甲基胼、偏二甲肼、混胼50、单推-3、肼-70、UH25等。有鱼腥味，均匀透明的液体。溶于水、乙醇等溶剂中，吸湿性强，在空气中冒白烟。系还原剂，与许多氧化性物质发生反应，与强氧化剂接触能自燃。热稳定性随肼中碳原子数增加而改善。对冲击、压缩、摩擦、枪击、振动均不敏感。只有在高温、明火、氧化剂或催化剂存在下，才可能发生着火或爆炸。生产工艺成熟，已广泛应用在航天领域。不仅可单独用作可储存液体推进剂的燃料，也可组成混肼燃料。偏二甲肼与煤油混合组成油肼燃料，与胺类燃料混合组成胺胼燃料。常与氧化剂如红烟硝酸、四氧化二氮等组成双组元液体推进剂，广泛应用于各种运载火箭、战略导弹和战术导弹。还用于运载火箭姿态控制和航天器轨姿控。
explanation_en: A general term for hydrazine and its derivatives that can be used as rocket fuel. It generally refers to anhydrous, methyl, unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine, mixed 50, monopropellant-3, hydrazin-70, UH25, etc. A uniformly transparent liquid with a fishy odor. Soluble in solvents such as water and ethanol, with strong hygroscopicity and emitting white smoke in the air. It is a reducing agent that reacts with many oxidizing substances and can spontaneously ignite when in contact with strong oxidizing agents. The thermal stability improved with the increase of the number of carbon atoms in hydrazine. Not sensitive to impact, compression, friction, gunfire, and vibration. Fire or explosion may occur only in the presence of high temperature, open flame, oxidizer or catalyst. The production process is mature and has been widely applied in the aerospace field. Not only can it be used separately as a fuel for storing liquid propellants, but it can also be composed of mixed hydrazine fuel. Unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine is mixed with kerosene to form oil hydrazine fuel, and mixed with amine fuels to form amine fuel. It often forms bipropellant liquid propellant with oxidizer such as red fuming nitric acid, nitrogen tetroxide, etc., and is widely used in various launch vehicles, strategic missiles and tactical missiles. It is also used for attitude control of launch vehicles and spacecraft orbits.

explanation_cn: 见赤铁矿。
explanation_en: See hematite.

explanation_cn: 见应力光学系数。
explanation_en: See stress-optical coefficient.

explanation_cn: 五水硫酸铜是一种无机化合物，化学式为CuSO4·5H2O，俗称蓝矾、胆矾或铜矾。具有催吐，祛腐，解毒，治风痰壅塞、喉痹、癫痫、牙疳、口疮、烂弦风眼、痔疮功效但有一定的副作用。
explanation_en: Copper sulfate pentahydrate is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula of CuSO4 · 5H2O, commonly known as blue alum, chalcanthite or copper alum. It has the effects of inducing vomiting, dispelling rot, detoxifying, treating wind and phlegm obstruction, throat obstruction, epilepsy, chancre, aphthous ulcer, erosive wind and eye, and hemorrhoids, but has certain side effects.

explanation_cn: 晶体或晶粒内部的一种细胞状组织。典型的胞状晶在空间呈蜂巢状，其纵断面为条状或板状，横断面为网状。胞状晶是由于晶体在其生长过程中界面不稳定而发生规律性的突起所造成的。胞状晶各晶粒之间的晶体学取向是一致的，胞晶界面多富集着能降低熔点的合金组元或杂质元素。
explanation_en: A cellular structure in or within a crystal. The typical cellular crystal are honeycombed in space, their longitudinal sections are strip or plate, and their transverse sections are network. The cellular crystal is caused by the regular protrusion of the unstable interface of the crystal during its growth. The crystallographic orientation of cellular crystal grains is consistent, and the cellular interface is rich in alloy components or impurities that can reduce the melting point.

explanation_cn: 在储存状态下呈凝胶状，在高于屈服应力的条件下呈液态的推进剂，由液体推进剂、添加剂、胶凝剂等组成。与液体推进剂相比：降低泄漏速率；避免意外点火燃烧；添加含能微粒后比冲和密度比冲提高。存在的问题：流阻大，输送压力高，增加结构质量；流量控制系统复杂；流变性能取决于温度等多种因素；雾化较困难。燃烧速度低，降低了燃烧效率；胶凝剂增加了燃烧残渣，性能降低2%-5%;传热性能差，不适合作为再生冷却剂；若是非均相体系，会发生颗粒沉降、相分离和物理不稳定。
explanation_en: The propellant, which is in the form of gel in the storage state and liquid in the condition higher than the yield stress, is composed of liquid propellant, additive, gelling agent, etc. Compared with liquid propellants: reducing leakage rate; Avoid accidental ignition and combustion; The specific impulse and density specific impulse increased after adding energetic particles. Existing problems: high flow resistance, high conveying pressure, and increased structural quality; The flow control system is complex; The rheological properties depend on various factors such as temperature; Atomization is difficult. Low combustion speed reduces combustion efficiency; The gelling agent increases the combustion residue and reduces the performance by 2% -5%; Poor heat transfer performance, unsuitable as a regenerative coolant; If it is a heterogeneous phase system, particle sedimentation, phase separation and physical instability will occur.

explanation_cn: 通过物理、化学作用，能从浆体变成坚固的固体，并能胶结其他物料，形成有一定机械强度的固体物质。可分为水硬性 胶凝材料和气硬性胶凝材料。
explanation_en: Through physical and chemical reactions, it can transform from a slurry into a solid and bond with other materials, forming a solid substance with a certain mechanical strength. It can be divided into hydraulic cementitious materials and pneumatic cementitious materials.

explanation_cn: 纤维状蛋白，是真皮的最主要成分，皮或革主要由胶原纤维经过复杂的三维编织而成。
explanation_en: Fibrous protein is the main component of dermis. Skin or leather is mainly made of collagen fiber through complex three-dimensional weaving.

explanation_cn: 胶原纤维经过部分降解后得到的具有较好水溶性的蛋白质。
explanation_en: After partial degradation of collagen fiber, the protein with good water solubility can be obtained.

explanation_cn: 由木段旋切成单板或木方刨切成薄木，通常按相邻层木纹方向垂直组坯胶合而成的板状材料。由于胶合板中心平 面两侧的单板互相对称，以及相邻层单板的纤维方向互相垂直，各方向上单板的收缩、膨胀和强度等都可以互相约束和补充.因此胶合板在使用中不易产生开裂、翘曲等缺陷，又可把木材的缺陷（节疤等）除 去、分散或加以覆盖，使材质较均匀，还可不受原木 直径限制，制成幅面很大的平面或曲面状。胶合板用途十分广泛，主要用于家具、室内装饰、车船、飞机、建筑等领域。
explanation_en: A board like material made by rotating and cutting wood segments into single boards or planing wood into thin pieces, usually glued vertically along the grain direction of adjacent layers of wood. Since the veneers on both sides of the central plane of plywood are symmetrical, and the fiber directions of adjacent layers of veneers are perpendicular to each other, the shrinkage, expansion and strength of veneers in all directions can be mutually constrained and supplemented. Therefore, plywood is not prone to crack, warpage and other defects in use, and wood defects (knots, etc.) can be removed, dispersed or covered, so that the material is more uniform, and log diameter is not limited, Make a large flat or curved surface. Plywood is widely used, mainly in furniture, interior decoration, vehicles, ships, aircraft, architecture and other fields.

explanation_cn: 见蒙脱石。
explanation_en: See montmorillonite.

explanation_cn: 制造耐久胶接结构所需的一系列技术综合形成的体系。包括表面 处理、底胶、胶黏剂的胶膜、胶接工艺和同化体系等。
explanation_en: A comprehensive system formed by a series of technologies required to manufacture durable adhesive structures. Including surface treatment, primer, adhesive film of adhesive, bonding process and assimilation system.

explanation_cn: 具有两亲性的分子在溶液中的浓度到达某一临界值及超过该值后，其分子或离子自动缔合成的胶体大小的聚集体粒子。
explanation_en: The concentration of amphiphilic molecules in solution reaches a critical value and exceeds it, resulting in the automatic synthesis of colloidal sized aggregate particles by their molecules or ions.

explanation_cn: 简称胶版纸。用于胶版印刷的未涂布的纸。胶版纸质地紧密，伸缩 性较小，抗水能力强，有较好的表面强度，可以有效地防止出现多色套印时的纸张变形、错位、拉毛、脱粉等毛病。主要用于印制书籍、宣传画单、画册、图片等。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as offset paper. Uncoated paper used for offset printing. Offset paper has a tight surface, low elasticity, strong water resistance, and good surface strength, which can effectively prevent paper deformation, misalignment, fuzzing, and peeling during multi-color overprinting. Mainly used for printing books, promotional flyers, picture albums, pictures, etc.

explanation_cn: 俗称毛边。胶接过程中，在两被粘物交角处固化后的产物（即填充在两被粘物交角处的那部分胶黏剂）。
explanation_en: Commonly known as rough edges. During bonding, the product after curing at the intersection of two adherends (that is, the part of adhesive filled at the intersection of two adherends).

explanation_cn: 参见磷灰石。
explanation_en: See apatite.

explanation_cn: 用作火箭燃料的脂肪胺和芳香胺的通称。
explanation_en: A general term for fatty amines and aromatic amines used as rocket fuels.

explanation_cn: 见热力学第三定律。
explanation_en: See the third law of thermodynamics.

explanation_cn: 微观粒子系统(如原子、离子、分子等)所具有的确定的内部能量值或状态。
explanation_en: The determined internal energy value or state of a microscopic particle system (such as atoms, ions, molecules, etc.).

explanation_cn: 利用光子作为能量的载体，以光的形式传递能量的光纤。光纤输出激光的方式具有传输功率损耗小、操作简单方便、可以任意伸展待加工部位等优点，大大地简化并缩小了现代激光设备，已经广泛地应用于材料表面热处理、激光焊接、激光切割、激光医疗、激光美容、激光制导等领域。
explanation_en: A optical fiber that uses photons as the carrier of energy and transmits energy in the form of light. The optical fiber laser output mode has the advantages of small transmission power loss, simple and convenient operation, and can extend the parts to be processed at will, greatly simplifying and reducing the modern laser equipment, and has been widely used in surface of materials heat treatment, laser weld, laser cutting, laser medical treatment, laser beauty, laser guidance and other fields.

explanation_cn: 电池的能量密度指的是电池的平均单位体积或平均单位质量所释放出的电能
explanation_en: The energy density of the battery refers to the electric energy released by the average unit volume or average unit mass of the battery

explanation_cn: 在透射和扫描电镜中使用X射线能谱仪分析试样化学成分的方法及可得到的谱图。X射线能谱仪用铍窗口-漂移锂硅探测器，可探测从钠至铀的元素。改用薄窗口或无窗口，可探测元素扩展至轻元素。
explanation_en: The method of analyzing the chemical composition of the sample using X-ray energy spectrometer in transmission and scanning electron microscopy, and the available spectra. The beryllium window drift lithium silicon detector used in X-ray energy spectrometer can detect elements from sodium to uranium. Switch to thin or windowless windows to expand the detection of elements to light elements.

name_en: the law of energy transformation and conservation
explanation_cn: 又称能量守恒定律。自然界中一切物质都具有能量，能量有各种不同形式，以从一种形式转化为另一种形式，从一个物体传递到另一物体，而且在传递与转化中总能M既不能创生也不能消灭，这是A然界屮关于物质运动最普遍的基本定律之一。能量是物质运动的一种度量，对应不同形式的运动，有不同形式的能量。
explanation_en: Also known as the the law of conservation of energy. All substances in nature possess energy, which takes various forms to transform from one form to another, from one object to another, and in the process of transmission and transformation, there is always M that cannot be created or eliminated. This is one of the most universal fundamental laws of material motion in the natural world. Energy is a measure of material motion, corresponding to different forms of motion and having different forms of energy.

explanation_cn: 又称能带隙(energybandgap)。在间态物理学中泛指半导体或是绝缘体的价带顶端至导带底端的能量差距。
explanation_en: It is also called band gap. In inter state physics, it generally refers to the energy gap from the top of the valence band of a semiconductor or insulator to the bottom of the conduction band.

name_cn: 脂肪族硝基化合物炸药
explanation_cn: 分子中含脂肪烃基及硝基的炸药。可分为烷烃类、环烷烃类、杂环烷烃类、卤代烃类、醇类、醚类、酮类等多种，或分为一硝基、二硝基及三硝基化合物三类。一个碳原子上带有两个硝基的称为携二硝基化合物炸药，带有三个硝基的称为硝仿系炸药。多硝基化合物能量和机械感度均较高.且两者均随分子中硝基数增多而增高。硝仿系炸药氧平衡好，密度大，爆速高，有的已获应用。硝基烷烃还是制造其他硝基化合物的原料，并广泛用作溶剂。重要的硝基烷烃有硝基甲烷、硝基乙烷、1-硝基丙烷、2-硝基丙烷等。脂肪族硝仿系炸药大多通过Mannich反应制备，硝基烷烃则以气相硝化，或液相硝化制得。
explanation_en: Explosive with aliphatic hydrocarbon group and nitro group in its molecule. It can be divided into various types, such as alkanes, cycloalkanes, heterocyclic alkanes, halogenated hydrocarbons, alcohols, ethers, ketones, etc., or can be divided into three categories: mononitro, dinitro, and trinitro compounds. One carbon atom with two nitros is called dinitro compound explosive, and one with three nitros is called nitroform explosive. Polynitro compounds have high energy and mechanical sensitivity, and both increase with the increase of the nitrate number in the molecule. Nitroform explosive have good oxygen balance, large density and high detonation velocity, and some have been applied. Nitroalkanes are also raw materials for manufacturing other nitro compounds and are widely used as solvents. Important nitroalkanes include nitromethane, nitroethane, 1-nitropropane, 2-nitropropane, etc. Aliphatic nitroform explosive are mostly prepared by Mannich reaction, while nitroalkanes are prepared by gas phase nitration or liquid phase nitration.

explanation_cn: 脂质体按照所包含脂质双分子层的层数不同，分为含有单一双分子层的单宰及含有多层双分子层的多室。的基本材料是磷脂。磷脂分子含有一个极性基和两条非极件脂肪链在水中时自组装生成闭合的磷脂双分子层，即为了增强其稳定性、调节膜的流动性，通常加入胆同醇。在药物控制释放领域，可作为药物载体，广泛用于抗肿瘤药物（阿霉素、顺铂等）、抗寄牛虫药物、抗菌药物、激素类药物的传递。脂质体的给药途径多种多样，包括静脉注射、肌内和皮下注射、口服、滴眼、肺部给药、经皮给药、鼻腔给药等。
explanation_en: According to the different layers of lipid bilayer, liposome can be divided into monolayer containing a single bilayer and multi compartment containing multiple bilayers. The basic materials is phospholipid. Phospholipids contain a polar group and two nonpolar fat chains. When self-assembly in water, they form a closed phospholipid bilayer. That is, in order to enhance its stability and regulate the flow ability of the membrane, cholesterol is usually added. In the field of drug controlled release, it can be used as a drug carrier, widely used in the delivery of anti-tumor drugs (doxorubicin, cisplatin, etc.), anti parasitic cattle worm drugs, antibacterial drugs, hormone drugs. Liposome can be administered in various ways, including intravenous injection, intramuscular and subcutaneous injection, oral administration, eye drops, pulmonary administration, percutaneous administration, nasal administration, etc.

explanation_cn: 脉冲充电一般分为负脉冲充电和正脉冲充电。负脉冲充电即在充电时，间断地对电池脉冲放电，消除极化作用。正脉冲充电即使用瞬间高压大电流对蓄电池进行充电，其主要作用为去硫化。
explanation_en: Pulse charging is generally divided into negative pulse charging and positive pulse charging. Negative pulse charging means that during charging, the battery is discharged intermittently to eliminate polarization. Positive pulse charging refers to charging the accumulator with instantaneous high voltage and large current, whose main function is to remove vulcanization.

explanation_cn: 又称脉冲激光烧蚀(pulsedlaserablation，PLA)，是一种利用激光对物体进行轰击，然后将轰击出来的物质沉淀在不同的衬底上，得到沉淀或者薄膜的一种手段。PLD的系统设备简单，相反，它的原理却是非常复杂的物理现象。它涉及高能董脉冲辐射冲击固体靶时-激光与物质之间的所有物理相互作用，亦包括等离子羽状物的形成，其后已熔化的物质通过等离子羽状物到达已加热的基片表面的转移及最后的膜生成过程。所以，PLD一般可以分为以下四个阶段:①激光辐射与靶的相互作用；②熔化物质的动态；I③熔化物质在基片的沉积；④薄膜在基片表面的成核(nucléation)与生成。PLD主要优点:易获得期望化学计量比的多组分薄膜，即具有良好的保成分性:沉积速率高-试验周期短，衬底温度要求低，制备的薄膜均匀；工艺参数任意调节，对靶材的种类没有限制；发展潜力巨大，具有极大的兼容性；便于清洁处理，可以制备多种薄膜材料。
explanation_en: Also known as pulsed laser ablation (PLA), it is a means of bombarding objects with lasers, and then precipitation the bombarded materials on different substrates to obtain precipitation or films. The system equipment of PLD is simple, on the contrary, its principle is a very complex physical phenomenon. It involves all physical interactions between laser and matter during high-energy Dong pulse radiation impact on solid targets, as well as the formation of plasma plumes, followed by the transfer of melted material through plasma plumes to the heated substrate surface and the final film formation process. Therefore, PLD can generally be divided into the following four stages: ① the interaction between laser radiation and the target; ② The dynamics of molten matter; I ③ Deposition of molten material on the substrate; ④ The nucleation and generation of thin films on the substrate surface. The main advantages of PLD are that it is easy to obtain multi-component films with the expected stoichiometric ratio, which has good compositional retention. The deposition rate is high, the test cycle is short, the substrate temperature requirement is low, and the prepared films are uniform; Process parameters can be adjusted arbitrarily without any restrictions on the type of target material; Huge development potential and great compatibility; It is easy to clean, and can prepare a variety of film materials.

explanation_cn: 呈脉状产出的火成岩的总称。它们的侵入深度一般较浅，规模较小，成分与空间分布常常与深成岩密切相关，结构变化大。按矿物组合，可划分为浅色脉岩(细晶岩和伟晶岩等)和深色脉岩(煌斑岩)。依据其与对应侵入岩的关系，可分为花岗斑岩、正长斑岩、闪长玢岩等。
explanation_en: A general term for igneous rocks produced in the form of veins. Their intrusion depth is generally shallow, their scale is small, and their composition and spatial distribution are often closely related to plutonic rocks, with significant structural changes. According to mineral assemblage, it can be divided into light colored vein rock (aplite, pegmatite, etc.) and dark colored vein rock (lamprophyre). According to its relationship with corresponding intrusive rocks, it can be divided into granite porphyry, syenite porphyry, diorite porphyry, etc.

explanation_cn: 矿床中与矿石相伴生的非矿石部分。它们通常在采矿或选矿过程中被废弃。脉石与矿石是相对的对象。如在金矿中，石英是脉石；而在石英矿中，石英是矿石。
explanation_en: The non ore part of a mineral deposit that is associated with the ore. They are usually discarded during mining or beneficiation processes. Gangue and ore are the opposite objects. For example, in gold deposits, quartze is gangue; In quartze ore, quartze is an ore.

explanation_cn: 用于制作人工椎体和内固定脊柱矫形器的材料。主要有医用不锈钢、钛合金、钻基合金、镍钛记忆合金、碳素材料、高分子材料和生物陶瓷等。
explanation_en: Materials used for manufacturing artificial vertebral body and internal fixation spinal orthosis. It mainly includes medical stainless steel, titanium alloy, drill base alloy, nickel titanium memory alloy, carbon materials, macromolecule materials and biological cemmics.

explanation_cn: 为了保证压坯能从模具中顺利脱出，在压坯沿脱出方向上的所有内表面都要有一定的斜度，该斜度称为脱模斜度。脱模斜度的大小取决于材料本身的性质、收缩率的大小、制品的壁厚和形状.设计时一般考虑以下几种情况：制品形状复杂，深度较深，不易脱模的应选用较大的脱模斜度；制品尺寸精度要求高的应选用较小的脱模斜度。
explanation_en: In order to ensure that the compact can be smoothly detached from the mold, all the internal surfaces of the compact along the direction of ejection must have a certain slope, which is called the draw taper. The size of the draw taper depends on the nature of the materials itself, the size of the shrinkage rate, the wall thickness and shape of the product. The following situations are generally considered in the design: the product is complex in shape, deep in depth, and it is difficult to demould, a larger draw taper should be selected; Small draw taper shall be selected for products with high dimensional accuracy requirements.

explanation_cn: 利用化学及物理方法除去原料皮上毛和表皮的操作。包括硫化物脱毛法、酶脱毛法、氧化脱毛法和有机胺脱毛法等。
explanation_en: The operation of removing hair and epidermis from raw skin by chemical and physical methods. It includes sulfide unhairing, enzyme unhairing, oxidative unhairing and organic amine unhairing.

explanation_cn: 去除钢液中所溶解的氧的过程。未充分脱氧的钢液凝固时，多余的氧将与碳继续i反应生成CO气体，使钢锭内部产生气泡。而氧在固态钢中的溶解度很低，钢液凝固过程中氧将与磷、硫、铁、铝、钛等元素生成非金属夹杂物.分布在枝；晶间及晶界上，显著降低钢的塑性；而晶界处的FeO和FeS还会形成低熔点共晶.使钢在热加工时产生热脆。因此，炼钢过程后期必须进行充分的脱氧。脱氧操作主要在炼钢炉和钢包内进行，有些炉外精炼方法具有深脱氧功能。往钢液中加人与氧的亲和力比铁大的脱氧元素或脱氧剂可实现脱氧。脱氧方法主要有沉淀脱氧、扩散脱氧和真空脱氧。
explanation_en: The process of removing dissolved oxygen from molten steel.
