When the steel liquid that is not fully deoxidation solidifies, the excess oxygen will continue to react with carbon to generate CO gas, which will generate bubbles in the ingot. However, the water solubility of oxygen in solid steel is very low. During the solidification of liquid steel, oxygen will form non-metallic inclusions with phosphorus, sulfur, iron, aluminum, titanium and other elements, which are distributed in branches; The plasticity of steel is significantly reduced in intergranular and grain boundary; FeO and FeS at the grain boundary also form eutectic with low melting point, which makes steel hot brittle during hot working. Therefore, sufficient deoxidation must be carried out in the later stage of the steelmaking process. The deoxidation operation is mainly carried out in the steelmaking furnace and ladle, and some off furnace refining methods have deep deoxidation function. Deoxidation can be achieved by adding deoxidation elements or deoxidizer with greater affinity to oxygen than iron into steel liquid. Deoxidation methods mainly include precipitation deoxidation, diffusion deoxidation and vacuum deoxidation.

explanation_cn: 在多元合金系统中，往往有许多脱溶相按一定的温度高低与时间先后的顺序依次形核长大。根据驱动力、应变能、表面能、小面化和形核地址的潜在优势等因素综合在一起，存在着（自发优化出）一个具有最小的形核位垒的过程，它相应于最大的形核率。适应这种条件的析出相便优先形核，出现脱溶序列。
explanation_en: In a multi-component alloy system, there are often many desolved phase that nucleate and grow in order of a certain temperature and time. According to the driving force, strain energy, surface energy, faceting and potential advantages of nucleation address, there is a process with the smallest nucleation barrier, which corresponds to the largest nucleation rate. The precipitates that adapt to this condition will preferentially nucleate and appear precipitation sequence.

explanation_cn: 使用洗漆和中和的方法去除浸灰后存在于灰皮中的碱性物质的操作。降低在制品的pH值并基本消除碱膨胀。
explanation_en: The operation of removing alkaline substances in the ash skin after liming by means of paint washing and neutralization. Reduce the pH value of the in-process product and basically eliminate alkali expansion.

explanation_cn: 催化材料：在这一过程中，通常使用的催化材料包括贵金属及金属氧化物、离子交换分子筛、钙钛矿复合氧化物、碳基催化材料、类金属氧化物催化材料等。贵金属类催化材料：描述中提到的贵金属类催化材料如Pt（铂）、Rh（铑）、Pd（钯）通常用于NOx的催化还原。然而，它们的主要问题是在较窄的温度范围内有效，容易受到氧抑制和硫中毒的响。氧化物催化材料：氧化物催化材料如V2O5、WO3、Fe2O3、CuO、MoO3、NiO等通常可以替代贵金属类催化剂，其中NiO和V2O5在NiO/CeO2/TiO2复合催化剂中可实现NOx的高效转化率。离子交换分子筛：描述中提到的Y-沸石、发光沸石等离子交换分子筛通常与金属元素如Mn、Cu、Co、Pd、V、Fe、Ce等进行离子交换，以提高其催化性能。Cu-ZSM-5和Fe-ZSM-5是常用的离子交换分子筛，但低温下活性较低且容易受硫中毒影响。碳基催化材料：碳基催化材料包括活性焦炭、活性炭、纳米碳管和活性炭纤维。纳米碳管负载V2O5催化剂具有卓越的热导性和化学稳定性，且在脱硝方面表现出卓越的效果。类金属氧化物催化材料：类金属氧化物催化材料包括V2O5、WO3、Fe2O3等，它们的混合物通常在280°C至400°C的温度下具有一定的催化活性。这些催化材料常用于燃煤电厂、燃重油电厂、燃气电厂锅炉中的SCR脱硝系统，有助于将NOx转化为无害的氮气和水蒸气，以减少空气污染
explanation_en: Catalytic materials: in this process, the commonly used catalytic materials include precious metals and metal oxides, ion exchange molecular sieves, perovskite composite oxides, carbon based catalytic materials, metal oxide catalytic materials, etc. Precious metals catalytic materials: precious metals catalytic materials mentioned in the description, such as Pt (platinum), Rh (rhodium) and Pd (palladium), are usually used for catalytic reduction of NOx. However, their main problem is that they are effective within a narrow temperature range and are susceptible to oxygen suppression and sulfur poisoning. Oxide catalytic materials: oxide catalytic materials such as V2O5, WO3, Fe2O3, CuO, MoO3, NiO, etc. can usually replace precious metals catalysts, in which NiO and V2O5 can achieve efficient conversion of NOx in NiO/CeO2/TiO2 composition catalysts. Ion exchange molecular sieves: Y - zeolite and light-emitting zeolite mentioned in the description usually conduct ion exchange with metal elements such as Mn, Cu, Co, Pd, V, Fe, Ce, etc. to improve their catalytic performance. Cu ZSM-5 and Fe ZSM-5 are commonly used ion exchange molecular sieves, but their activity is low at low temperatures and they are easily affected by sulfur poisoning. Carbon based catalytic materials: carbon based catalytic materials include activated coke, activated carbon, carbon nanotubes and activated carbon fiber. The V2O5 catalyst loaded on carbon nanotubes has excellent thermal conductivity and chemical stability, and exhibits excellent performance in denitrification. Metal oxide catalytic materials: metal oxide catalytic materials include V2O5, WO3, Fe2O3, etc. Their mixtures usually have certain catalytic activity at 280 ° C to 400 ° C. These catalytic materials are commonly used in SCR denitration systems in coal-fired power plants, heavy oil fired power plants, and gas-fired power plant boilers, helping to convert NOx into harmless nitrogen and water vapor to reduce air pollution

explanation_cn: 钢铁熔炼过程中降低铁水或钢液中硫含量的过程,对绝大多数钢种.硫属于有害元素，将降低钢的加工性能和力学性能.因而应严格控制钢中硫含量。钢铁生产过程中硫主要来自于矿石、熔剂和燃料，因而在冶炼的每一个阶段都应采取必要的脱硫措施，包括高炉脱硫、铁水预处理脱硫、炼钢脱硫和炉外精炼脱硫。高温、高碱度和低氧化铁炉渣及还原气氛有利于脱硫。常用脱硫剂是石灰(主要成分为CaO)，某些情况下也可采用电石(CaC2)、苏打（Na2CO3)、金属镁基脱硫剂等。采用氧化焙烧也可去除金属硫化物中的硫，使之转变为金属氧化物。
explanation_en: The process of reducing the sulfur content in molten iron or molten steel during the melting of steel is harmful to most steel grades. Sulfur is a harmful element, which will reduce the processability and mechanical properties of steel. Therefore, the sulfur content in steel should be strictly controlled. During steel production, sulfur mainly comes from ores, flux and fuels, so necessary desulfurization measures should be taken at every stage of smelting, including blast furnace desulfurization, hot metal pretreatment desulfurization, steelmaking desulfurization and off furnace refining desulfurization. High temperature, high alkalinity, low iron oxide slag and reducing atmosphere are conducive to desulfurization. The common desulfurizer is lime (mainly composed of CaO). In some cases, calcium carbide (CaC2), soda (Na2CO3), metal magnesium based desulfurizer, etc. can also be used. The sulfur in the metal sulfide can also be removed by oxidizing roasting to transformation it into metal oxide.

explanation_cn: ①炼钢时铁水或钢液中的碳被氧化脱除的过程。脱碳反应是贯穿炼钢过程始终，使高碳的生铁变成钢的最重要的反应。向铁水或钢液熔池中吹人高压氧气可显著加快脱碳速度，而所产生的C0气泡将引起熔池强烈沸腾，加快熔池传热、传质和钢渣反应，促进气体和非金属夹杂物的排除，改善钢水质量，提高炼钢生产率。②钢材或钢铁产品在高温加热和保温过程中，由于周围氧化气氛的作用，使表层中的碳全部或部分发生氧化生成气体，造成表层中的碳含量降低的过程和现象，也称表面脱碳。发生脱碳后，会使钢材表层硬度及耐磨性下降。采用控制加热介质的成分和性质、真空加热、涂防氧化涂层等工艺措施可以防止表面脱碳。
explanation_en: ① The process of oxidizing and removing carbon from molten iron or steel during steelmaking. Decarburization reaction is the most important reaction throughout the steelmaking process to turn high carbon pig iron into steel. Blowing high pressure oxygen into molten iron or molten steel bath can significantly speed up decarburization, while the generated C0 bubbles will cause strong boiling in the bath, accelerate heat and mass transfer in the bath and steel slag reaction, promote the elimination of gas and non-metallic inclusions, improve the quality of molten steel and increase the production rate of steelmaking. ② In the process of high temperature heating and thermal insulation of steel product or steel products, due to the role of the surrounding oxidation atmosphere, all or part of the carbon in the surface layer will be oxidized to generate gas, resulting in the process and phenomenon of reducing the carbon content in the surface layer, also known as surface decarburization. After decarburization, the hardness and wear resistance of steel product surface will decrease. Decarburization can be prevented by controlling the composition and nature of heating medium, vacuum heating, coating anti oxidation coating and other technological measures.

explanation_cn: 钢铁培炼过程中.降低铁水或钢液中磷含量的过程。对绝大多数钢种.磷属于有害元素，将降低钢的力学性能.因而应严格控制钢中磷含量。脱磷反应是炼钢和铁水预处理过程中的基本反应之一。操作中普遍使用的脱磷剂是石灰（主要成分为CaO),而铁水预处理脱磷除选用石灰基脱磷剂外，还可使用碱性更强的苏打（Na2CO3)基脱磷剂。
explanation_en: The process of reducing the phosphorus content in molten iron or steel during steel smelting. For most steel grades, phosphorus is a harmful element, which will reduce the mechanical properties of steel. Therefore, the phosphorus content in steel should be strictly controlled. Dephosphorization reaction is one of the basic reactions in steelmaking and hot metal pretreatment. The widely used dephosphorization agent in operation is lime (main component is CaO). In addition to lime based dephosphorization agent, soda (Na2CO3) based dephosphorization agent with stronger alkalinity can also be used for hot metal pretreatment.

explanation_cn: 指采用生物学和化学脱细胞技术，以去除能够引起免疫排异反应的抗原组分或物质，但完整地保留细胞外基质的形态、三维结构以及其中包含的可产生促进细胞分化作用的生长因子，而得到的主要由蛋白多糖、糖蛋白和胶原蛋白构成的贾通网络结构。脱细胞支架包括对同种或异种动物来源组织的经脱细胞处理所获得的生物衍生支架，也包括对由细胞培养技术所获得的单纯脱细胞片层或保留在支架材料孔壁表面上的脱细胞外基质层。
explanation_en: It refers to the use of biological and chemical acellular technology to remove antigen components or substances that can cause immune rejection, but completely retain the shape and three-dimensional structure of extracellular matrix and the growth factors contained therein that can promote cell differentiation, and the resulting Jatong network structure mainly consists of proteoglycans, glycoproteins and collagen. The acellular scaffold includes the bio derived stem obtained from the acellular treatment of the tissue of the same or different animal origin, and also includes the pure acellular sheet layer obtained by the cell culture technology or the acellular matrix layer retained on the surface of the hole wall of the materials of the stem.

explanation_cn: 凡是能够将影响产品外观的颜色脱除的物质统称为脱色剂。常用于废水处理、柴油加工、食品加工行业等，如纺织、印染、油墨、皮革、橡胶、焦化、造纸、制药等废水脱色的处理。脱色剂根据脱色原理大致可分为以下H类：①絮凝脱色剂。集脱色、絮凝、降解等多种功能于一身的季胺型阳离子高分子化合物。②吸附脱色剂。一般为活性炭、白土或吸附树脂可直接用过滤的方式滤除油品中的杂质和氧化物，集除杂、去味、脱色、分离于一体，使变黑的油品变成浅色透明的液体.加工后柴油的酸值、色度符合国家燃料标准。③氧化脱色剂。采用氧化性物质如氯酸钠、高锰酸钾、臭氧等?将有色基团破坏达到去除色度的目的。
explanation_en: All substances that can remove the color that affects the appearance of the product are collectively referred to as decolorant. Commonly used in wastewater treatment, diesel processing, food processing industries, such as textile, printing and dyeing, ink, leather, rubber, coking, paper making, pharmaceutical and other wastewater decolorization treatment. Decolorant can be roughly divided into the following H categories according to the decolorization principle: ① flocculating decolorant. Quaternary amine cationic macromolecule compound integrating decolorization, flocculation, degradation and other functions. ② Adsorption of decolorant. Generally, activated carbon, clay or adsorption resin can directly filter impurities and oxides in the oil by means of filtration, which integrates impurity removal, odor removal, decolorization and separation, so that the blackened oil can become a light and transparent liquid. The acid value and chroma of processed diesel meet the national fuel standards. ③ Oxidizing decolorant. Using oxidizing substances such as sodium chlorate, potassium permanganate, ozone, etc? Destroy the colored groups to achieve the purpose of removing chromaticity.

explanation_cn: 是一种由同种异体骨或异种骨经脱钙处理，能降低免疫原性的骨移植材料。由骨衍生的这一支架材料，无论是形态学还是力学特征，都具有合成材料无可比拟的优势，脱钙骨基质具有和自体骨最接近的三维结构，同时以I型胶原为主，胶原则是细胞黏附和生长的良好支架。脱钙骨基质一般经脱水、脱脂、脱钙、深低温冷冻等处理制备，具有良好的生物相容性，是临床常用的骨缺损修复材料。
explanation_en: It is a kind of bone transplantation materials that can reduce immunogenicity after decalcification treatment of allogeneic bone or xenogeneic bone. This stem materials derived from bone has incomparable advantages over synthetic materials in terms of morphological and mechanical characteristics. decalcified bone matrix has the closest three-dimensional structure to autologous bone. At the same time, it is dominated by type I collagen, which is a good stem for cell adhesion and growth. Decalcified bone matrix is generally prepared by dehydration, degreasing, decalcification, deep freezing and other treatments, and has good biocompatibility. It is a commonly used materials for bone defect repair in clinic.

explanation_en: The reverse process of adsorption, which causes the adsorbate to escape from the surface of the adsorbent. See physical adsorption and chemical adsorption.

explanation_cn: 为了皮革废物重复利用或其他的目的.使用化学方法将与皮革结合的鞣剂脱离出来的操作。
explanation_en: For the purpose of recycling leather waste or other purposes, the operation of separating the tanning agent combined with leather by chemical methods.

explanation_cn: 它是尿素、二聚氰胺、甲醛缩合制成的材料。其性能与三聚氰胺甲醛树脂及塑料基本相同，但成本较低。在树脂中添加填料和润滑剂，经浸渍、干燥后，再加入颜料进行球磨和过筛处理，制得模塑粉。该模塑粉的水分及挥发物含量通常小于4%，流动性为110-190mm（拉两格），模塑件吸水率为0.2%-0.3%，收缩率小于0.4%-0.8%，马丁耐热温度为110-120°C，冲击强度为6-7kJ/m2，弯曲强度大于90MPa，介电强度大于10MV/m，表面电阻率大于1X1011 Ω·cm，体积电阻率大于1X1011 Ω·cm。这种材料适用于各种民用电器、低压电器、食品容器、仪表、电话机外壳等应用领域。
explanation_en: It is a materials made by condensation of urea, dimeric cyanamide and formaldehyde. Its performance is basically the same as that of melamine formaldehyde resin and plastics, but its cost is low. Adding filler and lubricant to resin, dipping and drying, then adding pigment for ball milling and sieving, molding powder is prepared. The moisture and volatile content of the molding powder is generally less than 4%, the flow ability is 110-190mm (pull two grids), the water absorption of the molded part is 0.2% -0.3%, the shrinkage rate is less than 0.4% -0.8%, the Martin heat resistant temperature is 110-120 ° C, the impact strength is 6-7kJ/m2, the bending strength is more than 90MPa, the dielectric strength is more than 10MV/m, the coefficient of surface resistance is more than 1X1011 Ω· cm, and the coefficient of volume resistance is more than 1X1011 Ω· cm. This materials is suitable for various civil appliances, low-voltage appliances, food containers, instruments, telephone casings and other applications.

explanation_cn: 尿素和甲醛的缩合物。浅棕色黏稠水溶液，其间体含量为55%-65%。出脲(尿素)与甲醛<37%水溶液>按一定摩尔比在酸性或碱性介质中加热缩聚得到脲甲醛树脂水溶液，用于制造模塑粉，层压塑料、胶黏剂和涂料。脲甲醛模塑粉(又称电玉粉)以纸浆或木粉为填料。模塑粉主要用于对耐水性和介电性能要求不高的制品，如电插头、开关、机器手柄、仪表外壳、旋钮、日用品、纽扣、瓶盖和装饰品。以树脂作基体。纸、棉织物或玻璃织物作增强材料町制成层压制品，用来制造贴面板等
explanation_en: Condensate of urea and formaldehyde. A light brown viscous aqueous solution with a body content of 55% -65%. Urea (urea) and formaldehyde<37% aqueous solution>heat polycondensation in acid or alkaline medium according to a certain molar ratio to obtain urea-formaldehyde resin aqueous solution, which is used to manufacture molding powder, laminated plastics, adhesive and coatings. Urea formaldehyde molding powder (also called electric jade powder) is filled with pulp or wood powder. Moulding powder is mainly used for products with low requirements for water resistance and dielectric properties, such as electrical plugs, switches, machine handles, instrument shells, knobs, daily necessities, buttons, bottle caps, and decorations. Use resin as matrix. Paper, cotton fabric or glass fabric is used as reinforcement materials to make laminated products, which are used to make veneers, etc

explanation_cn: 以脲甲醛树脂为基材，内部充满了无数微孔的塑料。这种材料机械强度较低，当密度为231 kg/m3 时，其压缩强度垂直于泡沫上升方向为0.057 MPa，平行于泡沫上升方向为0.081 MPa。通过添加一定量的增强剂，例如聚乙二醇醚，以及填料，如木粉、石棉、玻璃粉、石墨和玻璃纤维等，可以提高其强度。这种材料在130°C下处理12小时，然后在-30°C下处理12小时，交替处理一年后，其强度和泡孔结构均未发生变化。此材料具有良好的阻燃性、隔热性和隔声性。它的吸水性很高，试样在水中浸泡后取出，经过室温烘干后，泡孔结构没有发生任何变化。在38°C和相对湿度为90%的条件下，水蒸气透过率为24至27.5 g/m2·h。然而，这种材料不耐受无机酸、强碱以及某些有机酸，如甲酸等。此外，它还具有一定的杀菌作用。制备这种材料的方法是将发泡液（由水、乳化剂、拉开粉、泡沫稳定剂、间二醚酚和间化剂如草酸或磷酸组成）加入鼓泡器中，搅拌并充入空气。1到2分钟后，加入30%的脲甲醛树脂水溶液。搅拌几十秒后将混合物倒入模具中，在室温下进行4小时以进行初步固化，然后在50°C下干燥21到28小时即可制成。这种材料通常用作保温隔热材料，在农业中用于保持土壤水分和养分，也用于制造吸水能力强的绷带、外科手术用的棉和包扎用品，以及制作人造景观等。
explanation_en: With urea-formaldehyde resin as the base material, the interior is filled with countless micropores of plastics. This materials has low mechanical strength, when the density is 231 kg/m 3 Its compressive strength is 0.057 MPa perpendicular to the rising direction of foam and 0.081 MPa parallel to the rising direction of foam. The strength can be improved by adding a certain amount of reinforcing agent, such as polyethylene glycol ether, and fillers, such as wood powder, asbestos, glass powder, graphite and glass fiber. This materials was treated at 130 ° C for 12 hours, and then at -30 ° C for 12 hours. After one year of alternate treatment, its strength and cell structure did not change. This materials has good flame retardancy, heat insulation and sound insulation. It has high water absorption, and after soaking the sample in water and drying it at room temperature, the bubble structure remains unchanged. At 38 ° C and a relative humidity of 90%, the water vapor transmittance ranges from 24 to 27.5 g/m 2· H. However, this materials is not resistant to inorganic acids, strong bases and some organic acids, such as formic acid. In addition, it also has a certain bactericidal effect. The method for preparing this materials is to add the foaming liquid (composed of water, emulsifier, powder, foam stabilizer, m-diethylphenol and intermediating agent such as oxalic acid or phosphoric acid) into the bubbler, stir and fill it with air. After 1-2 minutes, add 30% aqueous solution of urea-formaldehyde resin. After stirring for tens of seconds, pour the mixture into the mold, conduct preliminary curing at room temperature for 4 hours, and then dry it at 50 ° C for 21 to 28 hours. This materials is usually used as a thermal insulation thermal insulation materials material, used to maintain soil moisture and nutrients in agriculture, and also used to make bandages with strong water absorption capacity, cotton and bandages for surgery, and to make artificial landscapes.

explanation_cn: 以脲醛树脂为基体的复合材料。脲醛树脂迠脲4醛(一般用屮醛)在酸性或碱性介质中加热1;缩聚而成的一种热固性树脂。未固化低分子量脲醛树脂在室温下为半透明或乳白色黏性液体，可以加入罔化剂间化或酸忭条件下自固化。固化产物有良好的力:学性能、电绝缘性能、耐电弧性和自熄性，但是耐水性和耐酸性较差-耐热性不高。增强体主要为粉状填料、玻璃纤维及其织物。所适用的成型工艺主要有模压成型、注塑成型、挤压成型等。脲醛树脂基复合材料表面硬度高、耐电弧性能优良、刚度与强度较好、成本低廉在日用化、电子电气等领域有较多应用，主要用于制造白装饰贴面板、食用器皿、电气制件等。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on urea formaldehyde resin. Urea formaldehyde resin is heated in acidic or alkaline medium1; A thermosetting resin made by polycondensation. The un curing low molecular weight urea formaldehyde resin is a translucent or milky white viscous liquid at room temperature, which can be self curing under the condition of adding detergent or acid. The curing product has good mechanical properties: mechanical properties, electrical insulation properties, arc resistance and self extinguishing properties, but poor water resistance and acid resistance - low heat resistance. The reinforcement mainly consists of powder filler, glass fiber and its fabric. The applicable molding processes mainly include press molding, injection molding, extrusion moulding, etc. Urea-aldehyde resin matrix composite have high surface hardness, excellent arc resistance, good stiffness and strength, and low cost, and are widely used in the fields of daily use, electronics and electrical, mainly for manufacturing white decorative veneers, food utensils, electrical parts, etc.

explanation_cn: 分子侧链结构中含氰烷基的聚有机硅氧烷，无色透明高黏滞塑性线甩高分子化合物，由于分子侧链中氰烷基极性强.增加了分子链间的作用力。提高了耐油、耐溶剂性能，破坏了聚合物结构的规整性，改善了耐低温性能。在有机过氧化物作用下，可硫化成弹性橡胶制品，除具有一般硅橡胶的性能外，还具有耐油、耐非极性溶剂等特性。
explanation_en: The polyorganosiloxane containing cyanoalkyl group in the molecular side chain structure is a colorless, transparent, high viscosity, plastic linear polymer compound. Because of the strong polarity of the cyanoalkyl group in the molecular side chain, the force between the molecular chains is increased. The oil resistance and solvent resistance are improved, the structural regularity of polymer is destroyed, and the low temperature resistance is improved. Under the action of organic peroxide, it can be vulcanization into elasticity rubber products, which not only has the properties of general silicone rubber, but also has the characteristics of oil resistance, non-polar solvent resistance, etc.

explanation_cn: 金属材料以及由它们制成的结构物，在自然环境中或者在工况条件下，由于与其所处环境介质发生化学或者电化学作用而引起的变质和破坏，这种现象称为腐蚀。
explanation_en: The deterioration and destruction of metallic materials and structures made of them due to chemical or electrochemical interaction with the environmental medium in the natural environment or working conditions is called corrosion.

explanation_cn: 当两个电极反应锅合成共轭电化学反应时，彼此相互极化，偏离各自的平衡电位，极化到一个共同的电位，即混合电位。如果此时阳极反应是金属的溶解，反应的结果导致金属的腐蚀，则混合电位又叫做腐蚀电位。
explanation_en: When two electrode reaction pots synthesize conjugate electrochemical reaction, they polarization each other, deviate from their respective equilibrium potential, and polarization to a common potential, that is, mixed potential. If the anodic reaction is the dissolution of metal at this time, and the reaction results in corrosion of metal, the mixed potential is also called corrosion potential.

explanation_cn: 通过表格或图形将金属或合金在特定环境下的腐蚀电位进行排序，是比较该环境下活性金属或合金腐蚀行为的一种方法。
explanation_en: It is a method to compare the corrosion behavior of active metals or alloy in a specific environment by ranking the corrosion potential of metals or alloy in a table or figure.

explanation_cn: 在选定的电解液及测试条件下一个被测物件在其平衡电压下其几何表面上所产生的电流。腐蚀电流主要是对金属极板抗腐蚀能力的一种表述。腐蚀电流越大表示极板在燃料电池环境中腐蚀越快，燃料电池性能和寿命的衰减越快。
explanation_en: The current generated on the geometric surface of a tested object at its equilibrium voltage under the selected electrolyte and test conditions. Corrosion current is mainly an expression of the corrosion resistance of metal plate. The higher the corrosion current is, the faster the plate corrosion in the fuel cell environment, and the faster the fuel cell performance and life decay.

explanation_cn: 中交变应力和腐蚀协同作用产生的材料损伤过程。一般是指空气以外的腐蚀环境中的疲劳行为。
explanation_en: The process of materials damage caused by the synergetic action of alternating stress and corrosion. Generally, it refers to fatigue behavior in corrosion environment other than air.

explanation_cn: 材料与周围介质发生化学或电化学反应而产生的磨损。特点是腐蚀和磨损同时对材料起作用。在某些液体、气体或润滑剂中，工作的摩擦副表面由于化学或电化学反应形成腐蚀产物，它们往往与基体材料黏附不牢同，在摩擦过程中剥落，同时新的表面又继续和介质发生反应，继续形成腐蚀产物，于是腐蚀和磨损交替重复作用，而产生腐蚀磨损。
explanation_en: Wear caused by chemical or electrochemical reaction between materials and surrounding medium. It is characterized by corrosion and wear acting on materials at the same time. In some liquids, gases or lubricant, corrosion products are formed on the working friction pair surface due to chemical or electrochemical reactions. They often do not adhere firmly to the matrix materials, and peel off in the friction process. At the same time, the new surface continues to react with the medium, and continues to form corrosion products. Therefore, corrosion and wear alternately and repeatedly act, resulting in corrosive wear.

explanation_cn: 定量表示单位时间内材料腐蚀快慢的数值。材料在介质中发生的腐蚀有均匀腐蚀和局部腐蚀,通常腐蚀速率是指均匀腐蚀的速率，可以通过测量材料质量或厚度的改变,计算出平均腐蚀速率。
explanation_en: Quantitatively represents the speed of corrosion of materials in unit time. Corrosion of materials in the medium includes general corrosion and localized corrosion. Generally, corrosion rate refers to the rate of general corrosion. The average corrosion rate can be calculated by measuring the change of materials quality or thickness.

explanation_cn: 通过对材料表面进行改性、涂覆防护层、施加电极电位等方式达到保护构件、避免腐蚀的目的。
explanation_en: The purpose of protecting components and avoiding corrosion is achieved by modifying surface of materials, coating protective layer, applying electrode potential, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称填泥。由颜料、体质颜料和漆料(树脂或干性油等)调配研磨后而成的稠厚浆状物质。在不平整的表面上涂装油漆而又要求美观、平整。需要采用局部刮腻子或满刮腻子的办法。
explanation_en: It is also called mud filling. It is a thick paste formed by grinding of pigment, constitutional pigment and paint vehicle (resin or drying oil, etc.). Painting on uneven surfaces requires aesthetics and smoothness. Partial patty or full patty shall be applied.

explanation_cn: 一类特殊的化学推进剂。其表观性状介于液体推进剂和固体推进剂之间，一般由液体基质、氧化剂、金属燃料、凝胶剂和其他性能调节剂组成。其中的液体基质为有机胺高氯酸盐的醇溶液，含高氯酸40%左右。氧化剂、金属燃料与固体推进剂相同（如高氯酸铵、铝粉等）。凝胶剂种类较多，有高分子类（如羟乙基纤维素、聚丙烯酰胺）和超细无机物（如白炭黑）两大类。上述组分通过特殊的设备混合均匀后，可得到特定燃烧性能、流变性能并且可稳定储存数年的膏体推进剂。
explanation_en: A special type of chemical propellant. Its apparent properties are between liquid propellant and solid propellant, and it is generally composed of liquid matrix, oxidizer, metal fuel, gel agent and other performance regulators. The liquid matrix is an alcohol solution of organic amine perchlorate, containing about 40% perchloric acid. Oxidizer and metal fuel are the same as solid propellant (such as ammonium perchlorate, aluminium powder, etc.). There are many kinds of gel agents, including macromolecule (such as hydroxyethyl cellulose and polyacrylamide) and ultra-fine inorganic (such as white carbon black). After the above components are mixed evenly through special equipment, paste propellant with specific combustion and rheological properties and stable storage for several years can be obtained.

explanation_cn: 指将催化剂固定在分离膜内部或表面，使之作为反应场地的分离膜。同时具有反应和分离两种功能，如用这种分离膜制成的生物化学反应器和催化化学反应器。膜反应器有两种类型:一种是循环反应器，由泵和膜组件构成半封闭回路系统，基质和一定浓度的催化剂在反应器中反应后，由泵连续送人膜组件，将反应产品与催化剂分离。催化剂再回到反应器中，继续进行催化反应。另一种是固定反应器，催化剂固定在膜的一侧，当料液在渗透膜时与固定的催化剂接触并被催化。生成反应产物，反应产物继续透过膜而被收集。分离膜的选择由催化剂、反应物和生成物的性质决定，可以是无机膜，也可以是高分子膜，膜的孔径应选择反应物不能透过，而生成物易于透过，膜反应器能使反应物受到催化作用，产生反应，并使生成物连续分离，因而具有很高的转化率和持续生产能力，并能在常温常压下生产各种化工产品，特别是用经典方法难以生产的生物制品，如抗生素、氨基酸、干扰素等.具有很高的工业价值。
explanation_en: It refers to the membrane separation materials used to fix the catalyst inside or on the surface of the membrane separation materials as the reaction site. It has both reaction and separation functions, such as biochemical reactor and catalytic chemical reactor made of the membrane separation materials. There are two types of membrane reactor: one is the circulating reactor, which is a semi closed loop system composed of a pump and membrane module. After the substrate and a certain concentration of catalyst react in the reactor, they are continuously pumped into the membrane module to separate the reaction product from the catalyst. The catalyst returns to the reactor and continues the catalytic reaction. Another type is a fixed reactor, where the catalyst is fixed on one side of the membrane and comes into contact with the fixed catalyst when the feed liquid permeates the membrane and is catalyzed. Generate reaction products, which continue to pass through the membrane and be collected. The selection of membrane separation materials is determined by the nature of catalyst, reactants and products. It can be an inorganic membrane or a tnacromolecular film. The pore diameter of the membrane should be such that the reactants cannot pass through, and the products can easily pass through. The membrane reactor can make the reactants subject to catalysis, generate reactions, and enable the products to be separated continuously, so it has a high conversion rate and continuous production capacity, and can produce various chemical products under normal temperature and pressure, Especially biological products that are difficult to produce using classical methods, such as antibiotics, amino acids, interferon, etc., have high industrial value.

explanation_cn: 是利用溶液的依数性来测定聚合物数均分子量的一种方法。选择合适的半透膜是膜渗透法实验的关键，数据处理时为了减少外推的误差，选用不良溶剂较为理想。膜渗透法测定的是数均分子量，测定分子量的下限取决于半透膜。此法是测定共聚物分子量的较好方法。
explanation_en: It is a method to measure the number average molecular weight of polymer by using the colligative property of solution. The key to the membrane osmometry experiment is to select a suitable semipermeable membrane. In order to reduce the extrapolation error during data processing, it is ideal to select poor solvent. The membrane osmometry measures the number average molecular weight, and the lower limit of determining the molecular weight depends on the semi permeable membrane. This method is a better method to determine the molecular weight of copolymer.

explanation_cn: 是以细胞为敏感元件制成的传感器。它是利用细胞的跨膜蛋白质离子通道对细胞膜电位的变化(电压门控)或细胞表面受体对来自配体的刺激(配体门控)可作出迅速的开通或关闭的响应特性。采用膜片钳制(控制或测量细胞膜电位及离子通道电流)技术。通过动态或静态观察细胞离子通道电流的变化来确定影响其通道的因素、类型和数量的仪器。
explanation_en: It is a sensor made with cells as sensitive elements. It is a response characteristic that the transmembrane protein ion channel of cells can be used to respond to the changes of cell membrane potential (voltage gating) or the cell surface receptor can be quickly opened or closed to the irritation from the ligand (ligand gating). Using membrane clamp technology (to control or measure cell membrane potential and ion channel current). An instrument that determines the factors, types, and quantities that affect the ion channel currents of cells by dynamically or statically observing their changes.

explanation_cn: 亦称胶黏薄膜。一类夹在被粘材料中间，加热加压即能黏合的薄膜状或片状的胶黏剂。
explanation_en: Also called adhesive film. A kind of film or sheet adhesive sandwiched in the middle of the adhered materials, which can be bonded by heating and pressing.

explanation_cn: 利用均相膜、非均相膜、液体膜作隔膜对某种离子有透过性或者膜表面与电解液的离子交换平衡所建立的电势来测量电解液中特定离子活度的装置。膜电极中的膜材料是一种选择性穿透膜:有无机膜.如玻璃膜、无机盐膜、半导体膜；高分子膜，功能性分子固定膜、固定化酶膜、固定化细胞膜，同定化微生物膜和抗原体膜；液体模和载体液膜。在测量时按其变化又分两类:在识别物质的同时膜自身发生物性变化的直接转换性；膜自身无物性变化，而与某种联动装置组合的间接转换性。膜电极是一种简单、迅速、能用于有色和浑浊溶液的分析工具。通过电极的微型化已被用于直接观察体液甚至细胞内某些重要离子的活度变化。它已成功地用于环境监测、水质和土壤分析、临床化验、海洋考察、工业流程控制以及地质、冶金、农业食品和药物分析等领域。
explanation_en: A device that measures the activity of a specific ion in an electrolyte by using a homogeneous phase membrane, a heterogeneous phase membrane, or a liquid membrane as a separator to have permeability to a certain ion or the potential established by the ion exchange equilibrium between the membrane surface and the electrolyte. The membrane materials in membrane electrode is a kind of selective penetrating membrane: there are inorganic membranes, such as glass membrane, inorganic salt membrane, semiconductor film; Tnacromolecular film, functional molecular fixed membrane, immobilized enzyme membrane, immobilized cell membrane, and immobilized microbial membrane and antigen body membrane; Liquid mold and carrier liquid film. When measuring, it can be divided into two categories based on its changes: the direct conversion of biological changes in the membrane itself while identifying substances; The membrane itself has no physical property changes, but is indirectly convertible when combined with a certain linkage device. Membrane electrode is a simple, rapid analytical tool for colored and turbid solutions. The miniaturization of electrodes has been used to directly observe the activity changes of some important ions in body fluids and even cells. It has been successfully used in environmental monitoring, water quality and soil analysis, clinical laboratory testing, marine exploration, industrial process control, as well as geological, metallurgical, agricultural food and drug analysis and other fields.

explanation_cn: 是质子交换膜燃料电池(protonexchangemembranefuelcell，PEMFC')的核心部件，主要是由质子交换膜(protonexchangemembranes。PEM)、催化剂层(catalystlayer，CU和气体扩散层(gasdiffusionlayer，GDL)组成的三合-膜电极。其中质子交换膜起传递质子分隔燃料和氧化剂的双重作用。两侧的催化剂层是燃料和氧化剂进行电化学反应的场所。而GüL则起传输燃料氧化剂、反应产生的水以及支撑和保护催化剂层等作用。
explanation_en: It is the core component of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC '), mainly a triple membrane electrode composed of proton exchange membrane (PEM), catalyst layer (CU) and gas diffusion medium (GDL). The proton exchange membrane plays a dual role of transferring protons to separate fuel and oxidizer. The catalyst layer on both sides is the place where the fuel and oxidizer conduct electrochemical reaction. G ü L plays the role of transporting fuel oxidizer, water generated by the reaction, and supporting and protecting the catalyst layer.

explanation_cn: 各种规格的包含膜及其支撑结构的实用装置。单个组件或多个组件都可以组装成膜分离装置以供在工厂和实验室运用。根据膜的形式或排列方式有五种。管式膜组件:膜呈现软管式，置于耐压多孔管的内侧或外侧，多孔管材料为烧结聚乙烯，直径在12-24mm之间，以单根或多根置于耐压支撑管内，构成管式膜组件，膜的装填密度小于80m2/m3。板框式膜组件:由其支撑材料增强的膜和多孔支撑板和导流板组成，两种致密层向外的膜构成板框式元件。一个或多个元件叠装后，用压紧板和拉杆固定，构成板框式膜组件，膜的装填密度为100-400m2/m3。卷式膜组件:在两种膜中加入导流层，把三边密封成袋形、再在膜袋上放置特殊网格卷绕在滤液收集管上。把这种卷式元件一个或多个串联，装入耐压阔筒形容器中，构成了卷式膜组件，膜的装填密度大于900m2/m3。中空纤维膜组件:把很多根中空纤维捆扎成一束，置于耐压圆筒形容器中，把两端中空纤维丝之间的空隙用黏合剂密封，构成中空纤维膜组件，根据中空纤维丝装填组件的直径和长短得到不间膜面积的组件。
explanation_en: Various specifications of practical devices including membranes and their supporting structures. Single or multiple components can be assembled into membrane separation devices for use in factories and laboratories. There are five types of membranes based on their form or arrangement. Tubular membrane module: the membrane is hose type, which is placed on the inside or outside of the pressure resistant perforated pipe. The porous pipe is made of sintering polyethylene, with a diameter of 12-24mm. One or more pipes are placed in the pressure resistant support pipe to form a tubular membrane module. The filling density of the membrane is less than 80m2/m3. Plate and frame membrane module: it is composed of a membrane reinforced by its support materials, a porous support plate and a deflector. The two kinds of membranes with dense layers outward form a plate and frame element. After one or more elements are stacked, they are fixed by pressing plates and pull rods to form a plate and frame membrane module. The membrane filling density is 100-400m2/m3. Rolled membrane module: add a guide layer to the two kinds of membranes, seal the three sides into a bag, and then place a special grid on the membrane bag and wind it on the filtrate collection pipe. One or more of these roll elements are connected in series and put into a pressure resistant wide cylindrical container to form a roll membrane module. The membrane filling density is more than 900m2/m3. Hollow fiber membrane module: bundle many hollow fiber into a bundle, place them in a pressure cylinder, seal the gap between hollow fiber wires at both ends with adhesive to form a hollow fiber membrane module, and obtain the module with different membrane area according to the diameter and length of hollow fiber wire filling module.

explanation_cn: 利用高分子膜的微孔性、疏水性和低热导性而达到水纯化和溶液浓缩的膜分离技术。这是一种以温度为推动力的运行过程，在膜两侧表面边界的两种含水流体有不同的温度，温度差造成蒸汽压力差，使蒸汽分子经过膜孔进行传输，与蒸馏中的蒸发、传输和冷凝的过程类似。但膜蒸馏可在低于溶液沸点和正常压力下进行，能利用工业废热、太阳能等。膜蒸馏用的膜有聚丙烯、聚四氟乙烯、聚偏二氟乙烯等疏水性微孔膜,可以甩卷式、中空纤维式、管式或板框式组件构成膜蒸馏设备。可以进行废水处理或某些化学物质的分离、回收以及产品浓缩等。
explanation_en: It is a membrane separation technology that uses the microporosity, hydrophobicity and low thermal conductivity of tnacromolecular film to achieve water purification and solution concentration. This is a temperature driven operation process, where two types of aqueous fluids at the surface boundaries on both sides of the membrane have different temperatures. The temperature difference causes a steam pressure difference, causing steam molecules to be transported through the membrane pores, similar to the process of evaporation, transportation, and condensation in distillation. However, membrane distillation can be carried out below the boiling point of solution and under normal pressure, and can utilize industrial waste heat, solar energy, etc. The membranes used for membrane distillation include hydrophobic microporous membranes such as polypropylene, polylctrafluorocthylone, polyvinylidene fluoride, etc., and membrane distillation equipment can be composed of spin off, hollow fiber, tube or plate frame components. It can be used for wastewater treatment, separation, recovery of certain chemical substances, and product concentration.

explanation_cn: 是用于膜蒸馏过程的疏水微孔膜。热料液膜一侧接触时(热侧)，料液中的易挥发的组分在膜面处汽化通过膜，并在膜的另一侧被冷凝成液相(冷侧)。膜蒸馏过程中料液中易挥发组分能够通过膜，其他组分则被疏水膜阻挡在热侧，从而实现混合物分离或提纯的目的。膜蒸馏材料具有保证水不会渗入到微孔内和具有较高的通量的特性，还具有足够的机械强度、好的热稳定性、化学稳定性以及低的热导率。主要有聚四氟乙烯(PTFE)、聚偏氣乙烯(PVDF)和聚丙烯(PP)等膜材料。PTFE膜多采用烧结法及拉伸法制备，PVDF膜多采用溶剂致相转化法制备，PP膜通常采用熔融纺丝-冷却拉伸法(MSCS)和热致相分法(TIPS)制备。水处理领域可用于海水的蒸馏淡化、高纯水制备、废水中挥发性污染物的去除等。
explanation_en: It is a hydrophobic microporous membrane used in membrane distillation process. When one side of the hot material liquid film contacts (hot side), the volatile components in the material liquid vaporize and pass through the film at the film surface, and are condensed into a liquid phase (cold side) on the other side of the film. In the process of membrane distillation, volatile components in the feed liquid can pass through the membrane, and other components are blocked at the hot side by hydrophobic membrane, so as to realize the separation or purification of the mixture. Membrane distillation materials has the characteristics of ensuring that water will not penetrate into micropores and has a high flux. It also has sufficient mechanical strength, good thermal stability, chemical stability and low thermal conductivity. There are mainly polylctrafluorocthylone (PTFE), polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), polypropylene (PP) and other membrane materials. PTFE membranes are mostly prepared by sintering and stretching methods, PVDF membranes are mostly prepared by solvent induced phase transformation method, and PP membranes are usually prepared by melt spinning cooling stretching method (MSCS) and thermally induced phase separation method (TIPS). In the field of water treatment, it can be used for distillation and desalination of seawater, preparation of high-purity water, and removal of volatile pollutants in wastewater.

explanation_cn: 将两种不同收缩性纤维混纺成纱。经加热冋缩处理成膨体纱。膨体纱具有表观密度小、手感柔软、保暖性好（纱线白含有大量空气）、蓬松透等膨体纱的生产原丝以腈纶为主。将高收缩纤维和常规纤维（低收缩纤维）按一定比例混合，加工成毛条。再经并合、梳理、牵伸、加捻等工艺过程纺成纱后，在一定温度下借助聚合物的热可塑性进行松弛热处理（汽蒸或沸水处理），高收缩纤维产生纵向冋缩。位于纱中心而常规纤维，由于收缩性差-受到轴向收缩力作用而弯曲变形。形成卷巾状。被推到纱的表面，使纱的体积膨大，形成有膨松性的膨体纱。高收缩纤维与低收缩纤维的混合比是影响收缩率、膨松性的主要因素。质量混合比为40:60时膨松性最好。另外为扩大膨休纱应用领域。提高服用性。高收缩纤维也有用其他高拉伸未定咽的合成纤维。低收缩纤维可以用各种常规化：学纤维和天然纤维，特别是与天然纤维混合制成的膨体纱更具有特殊风格和性能。膨体纱主要用于制造毛线、针织衣料和毛毯。混合型膨体纱还可以用于制造各种针织衫、针织白衣、运动服、儿童服装、床上用品及装饰用品。
explanation_en: Spin two different types of shrinkage fibers into yarn. Bulk yarn is made by heating and shrinking. Bulk yarn is characterized by low apparent density, soft handle, good warmth retention (yarn white contains a lot of air), puffiness, etc. The production precursor of bulk yarn is mainly acrylic fiber. The high shrinkage fiber and the conventional fiber (low shrinkage fiber) are mixed in a certain proportion and processed into wool tops. After spinning into yarn through the process of combination, carding, drafting, twisting, etc., relaxation heat treatment (steaming or boiling water treatment) is carried out at a certain temperature with the help of the thermal plasticity of polymer, and longitudinal shrinkage of high shrinkage fiber occurs. Located at the center of the yarn, conventional fibers undergo bending deformation due to poor shrinkage and axial contraction force. Form a rolled towel shape. It is pushed to the surface of the yarn to expand the volume of the yarn and form a bulky bulk yarn. The mixing ratio of high shrinkage fiber and low shrinkage fiber is the main factor affecting shrinkage and bulkiness. The best bulkiness is achieved when the mass mixing ratio is 40:60. In addition, to expand the application field of expanded yarn. Improve usability. High shrinkage fiber can also be used as other synthetic fiber with high tensile strength. Low shrinkage fiber can be conventionalized into various types: learning fiber and natural fiber, especially bulk yarn mixed with natural fiber has special style and performance. Bulk yarn is mainly used to make woolen yarn, knitted clothes and blankets. Blended bulky yarn can also be used to manufacture various types of knitwear, knitted white clothes, sportswear, children's clothing, bedding, and decorative items.

explanation_cn: 一种以蒙脱石为主要矿物成分的黏土，又称膨土岩或斑脱岩。后来把具有膨润土物性的黏土和黏土岩统称为膨润土。膨润土的蒙脱石含量可达85%-90%，另外可含少量高岭石、伊利石、石英、长石、方解石、贝得石、石膏等杂质。某些膨润土中也发现有沸石类矿物和坡缕石。膨润土具多种颜色，常有白色、灰色、灰绿、淡黄绿、粉红、肉红、砖红、褐红、灰黑色等。油脂、蜡状、土状光泽。常见贝壳状断口，致密块状或松散土状。具泥质或粉砂质结构。按化学成分分为钠质膨润土和钙质膨润土；按物理性质可分为软质膨润土和硬质膨润土。膨润土具有强的膨胀性和吸湿性，可吸附8-15倍于自身体积的水量。体积膨胀可达数倍至数十倍，有强的可塑性和耐火性，较强的阳离子交换能力。对各种气体和液体有一定的吸附能力，最大吸附量可达5倍于自身质量，经酸化处理的膨润土还有吸附有色离子的能力，在水介质中膨润土能分散成胶凝状和悬浮状。这种介质溶液具有一定的黏滞性、触变性或润滑性。因此膨润土在农业上有十分广泛的用途可作黏结剂、悬浮剂、增塑剂、增稠剂、润滑剂、触变剂、絮凝剂、稳定剂、净化脱色剂、催化剂、填充剂、词料混合剂和化肥农药的载体等。钠质膨润土的性能优于钙质膨润土，所以其用途最广。用量最大。钙质膨润土的用量仅为其六分之一，但钙质膨润土通过改性。可大大提高和改善其使用性能。中国膨润土资源量大，但钠质类型较少。
explanation_en: A kind of clay with montmorillonite as the main mineral component, also known as amargosite or bentonite. Later, clay and clay rock with the physical properties of bentonite were collectively referred to as bentonite. Bentonite contains 85% -90% montmorillonite, and a small amount of kadinite, illite, quartze, feldspar, caldte, bedite, gypsum and other impurities. Zeolite minerals and palygorskite are also found in some bentonite. Bentonite has various colors, often including white, gray, grayish green, light yellow green, pink, flesh red, brick red, brown red, gray black, etc. Greasy, waxy, and earthy luster. Common shell like fractures, dense block like or loose soil like. Having a muddy or silty structure. According to chemical composition, it can be divided into sodium bentonite and calcium bentonite; According to physical properties, it can be divided into soft bentonite and hard bentonite. Bentonite has strong expansibility and hygroscopicity, and can absorb 8-15 times of its own volume of water. The volume expansion can reach several to tens of times, with strong plasticity and fire resistance, as well as strong cation exchange ability. It has a certain adsorption capacity for various gases and liquids, and the maximum adsorption capacity can reach 5 times of its own mass. The acidified bentonite also has the ability to adsorb colored ions, and bentonite can be dispersed into gelled and suspended forms in the water medium. This medium solution has certain viscosity, thixotropy, or lubricity. Therefore, bentonite is widely used in agriculture as adhesive, suspending agent, plasticizer, thickener, lubricant, thixotropic agent, coagulant, stabilizer, purification decolorant, catalyst, filler, word material mixture, fertilizer and pesticide carrier, etc. The performance of sodium bentonite is better than that of calcium bentonite, so it is the most widely used. Maximum usage. The amount of calcareous bentonite is only one sixth of that, but calcareous bentonite is modified. It can greatly improve and improve its performance. China has a large amount of bentonite resources, but there are few sodium types.

explanation_cn: 是一种以蒙脱石为主要矿物的晶体。主要化学成分为SiO2、Al2O3，同时含有少量的Na2O及K2O等。膨润土具有阳离子交换性和吸附性"蒙脱石晶体中的硅离子和铝离子易被镁离子置换而使其表面产生过剩负电荷。层间吸附的用来中和负电荷的钠、钙等水合阳离容易被外来的阳离子置换，使膨润土具有阳离子交换性能。阳离子交换容量是判断膨润土质量的主要依据，CEC值大的膨润土带负电量越大，其膨胀和吸附能力较强。膨润土吸附作用可以分为物理吸附、化学吸附和离子交换吸附三种类型。根据层间阳离子种类不同膨润土分为金属基膨润土（钠基膨润土、钙基膨润土等）、氢基膨润土（俗称活性白土）和有机膨润土。金属基膨润土可以用来吸附去除水中的重金属阳离子；氢基膨润土具有表面活性，能吸附有色物质、有机物质；有机膨润土层间吸附的有机阳离子的非极忭有机链使其对有机污染物具有较强的吸。附能力=膨润土吸附剂应用于处理有机废水、去除重金属离子、处理有机污泥、脱色、除磷。地下水修复等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of crystal with montmorillonite as the main mineral. The main chemical components are SiO2 and Al2O3, while also containing a small amount of Na2O and K2O. Bentonite has cation exchange and adsorption properties "The silicon ion and aluminum ion in montmorillonite crystal are easily replaced by magnesium ion, resulting in excess negative charge on its surface. Hydrated cation such as sodium and calcium adsorbed between layers to neutralize negative charge is easily replaced by foreign cation, making bentonite have cation exchange performance. Cation exchange capacity is the main basis for judging the quality of bentonite. bentonite with higher CEC value has stronger expansion and adsorption capacity with greater negative charge. bentonite adsorption The functions can be divided into three types: physical adsorption, chemical adsorption and ion exchange adsorption. Bentonite is divided into metal based bentonite (sodium based bentonite, calcium based bentonite, etc.), hydrogen based bentonite (commonly known as active clay) and organic bentonite according to the type of interlayer cations. Metal based bentonite can be used to adsorb and remove heavy metal cations from water; Hydrogen based bentonite has surface activity and can adsorb colored substances and organic substances; The non-polar organic chains of organic cations adsorbed between organic bentonite layers enable them to have strong adsorption for organic pollutants. Adsorption capacity=bentonite absorbent is used to treat organic wastewater, remove heavy metal ions, treat organic sludge, decolour and remove phosphorus. Groundwater remediation, etc.

explanation_cn: 用膨胀仪测定材料热膨胀性质的方法。试样在偏离室温（20°C)时，其长度的改变量与室温下长度的比值，称为该试样材料在温差（AT)下的热变形率（ALAL)。热膨胀性质通常用热变形率-温度的函数关系表示。热变形率随温度近似于线性变化时，可用平均线胀系数表征材料的热膨胀性能：各向同性材料的平均体膨胀系数g近似等于3a。热膨胀性能可以用来研究固体材料的结构、相变和临界现象等。它在固体物理、金属学、金相热处理以及丁。程结构设计等方面均有广泛应川测试的关键是用膨胀计精确测定试样的微小形变量。其次是通过测温、控温装置对试样温度进行梢确测定与控制。膨胀仪由上述两部分和加热炉、记录及数据处理装置组成。其核心为膨胀计。膨胀计的种类主要有示差式、光栅杆式、光干涉式、直测式以及电容式等。其中光干涉式膨胀计的准确度最高。但结构复杂。而示差式膨胀计的应用最广。直测式膨胀汁可以用于非接触测定。
explanation_en: A method for determining the thermal expansion properties of materials by dilatometer. When the sample deviates from the room temperature (20 ° C), the ratio of its length change to the length at room temperature is called the thermal deformation rate (ALAL) of the sample materials at the temperature difference (AT). The thermal expansion property is usually expressed as a function of thermal deformation rate temperature. When the thermal deformation rate changes linearly with temperature, the average linear expansion coefficient can be used to characterize the thermal expansion performance of materials: the average volume expansion coefficient g of isotropic materials is approximately equal to 3a. Thermal expansion properties can be used to study the structure, phase transformation and critical phenomena of solid materials. It is used in solid state physics, physical metallurgy, metallographic heat treatment and metallurgy. The key to widely applied testing in structural design and other aspects is to accurately measure the small deformation variables of the sample using a dilatometer. Secondly, the sample temperature is accurately measured and controlled through temperature measurement and control devices. The dilatometer consists of the above two parts and the soaking pit, recording and data processing devices. Its core is a dilatometer. The main types of dilatometers include differential type, grating rod type, optical interference type, direct measurement type, and capacitive type. The optical interferometric dilatometer has the highest accuracy among them. But the structure is complex. The differential dilatometer is the most widely used. Direct measurement expansion juice can be used for non-contact measurement.

explanation_cn: 非牛顿性流体中的一种，即流体流动时当剪切应力〃或剪切速率^增加时，表观黏度随之增加，即所谓剪切增稠。具有膨胀性的流体一般为具有一定浓度的、颗粒形状不规则的悬浮体系，如聚氯乙烯糊等。
explanation_en: One of the non Newtonian fluids, that is, when the shear stress ″ or shear rate ^ increases during fluid flow, the apparent viscosity increases accordingly, which is called shear thickening. The expansive fluid is generally a suspension system with certain concentration and irregular particle shape, such as polyvinylchloride paste.

explanation_cn: 是指用膨胀水泥或膨胀剂配制的水泥混凝土。分补偿收缩混凝土和自应力混凝土两大类。前者指在有约束的条件下，巾于膨胀水泥或膨胀剂的作用。能产生0.2-0.7MPa內应力的混凝土；后荇是指在约束的条件下。由于膨胀水泥或膨胀剂的作用。能产生2.0-8.0MPa自应力的混凝土"膨胀混凝土除具有补偿收缩和产生肖应力功能外，还具有抗渗性强、早期快硬、后期强度高(或超过100MPa)、耐硫酸盐能好等特点；适用于地下、防水储罐、路面、屋面、楼板、墙板、管道、接缝、锚同、大跨与高层建筑、水利工程、海水工；程、冬季施工程、抢修工程等。
explanation_en: It refers to cement concrete prepared with expansive cement or expansive agent. There are two main types of shrinkage compensating concrete and self-stressing concrete. The former refers to the effect of expansion cement or expansion agent under constrained conditions. Concrete capable of producing internal stress of 0.2-0.7MPa; The latter refers to being under constraint conditions. Due to the action of expansive cement or expansive agent. The concrete "expansion concrete" capable of producing 2.0-8.0MPa self stress has not only the functions of compensating shrinkage and generating stress, but also strong impermeability, rapid hardening in early stage, and high strength in later stage (or more than 100MPa) Good sulfate resistance and other characteristics; Suitable for underground, waterproof storage tanks, road surfaces, roofs, floors, wall panels, pipelines, joints, anchors, large-span and high-rise buildings, hydraulic engineering, and marine engineering; Construction, winter construction, emergency repair, etc.

explanation_cn: 在适当条件下，酸、碱金属、盐类等可进入石墨层间形成石墨层间化合物，将其快速加热到适当温度时，可瞬间迅速分解。产生大量气体，使石墨沿轴方向膨胀成蠕虫状材料，即膨胀石墨。可用于制备柔性石墨、重油吸附材料、甚至石墨烯材料等。
explanation_en: Under appropriate conditions, acids, alkali metals, salts, etc. can enter the graphite interlayer to form graphite interlayer compounds, which can be rapidly decomposed when rapidly heated to an appropriate temperature. A large amount of gas is generated to expand graphite along the axis into vermicular material, namely expanded graphite. It can be used to prepare flexible graphite, heavy oil adsorption materials, even graphene materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 在丙烯酸树脂结构单元中含有活性基团、在室温或加热或一定pH值条件下自身发生交联而同化成网状结构的树脂。它与丙烯酸、甲基丙烯酸酯共聚生成的产物是典型的自交联丙烯酸树脂。在升高温度时，结构单元中的活性基闭发生自交联反应，当pH<7时自交联反应速度大幅增加。这类树脂主要有两种：一种是自交联丙烯酸树脂乳液，用作涂料、压敏胶、织物印花胶黏剂、无纺布胶黏剂、静电植绒胶黏剂;另一种是本体树脂（塑料），如含有自交联活性基闭的聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯本体聚合，当后同化达到一定温度后即发生自交联反应，得到耐溶剂、耐开裂和耐热的材料。
explanation_en: The acrylic resin contains active groups in the structural unit of the resin, and is assimilated into a network structure by crosslinking itself at room temperature or under heating or a certain pH value. It is copolymerized with acrylic acid and methacrylate to produce a typical self crosslinking acrylic resin. At elevated temperature, the active groups in the structural units undergo self-crosslinking reaction, and when pH<7, the reaction rate of self-crosslinking increases significantly. There are mainly two kinds of such resin: one is self-curing acrylic resin lotion, which is used as coatings, pressure sensitive adhesive, textile printing adhesive, non-woven adhesive, and electrostatic flocking adhesive; The other is bulk resin (plastics), such as bulk polymerization of polymethyl methacrylate containing self-crosslinking active group, when the post assimilation reaches a certain temperature, self-crosslinking reaction will occur to obtain solvent resistant, crack resistant and heat resistant materials.

explanation_cn: 又称自动加速现象或凝胶效应。自由基聚合中，因体系黏度增大而引起的聚合速率自动加快的现象。这种现象产生的原因是随着单体转化率提高，体系黏度增加，引起活性链末端被包埋，活性链移动性下降，造成终止反应速率下降，而体系黏度不足以严重妨碍单体的扩散，即链增长速率变动不大，结果使活性链寿命延长，链增长速率大于扣应的链终止速率，聚合速率增加，分子量也同时增加。温度、单体转化率、聚合物分子量及聚合物结构等凡能影响体系黏度的因素均会对自动加速效应产生一定影响。自动加速效府常见于本体聚合或高浓度的溶液聚合，特别是在聚合物不溶于或难溶于单体的情况。工业生产中，一些自动加速效应往往是由于聚合速率加快而反应热来不及移除而产生的，最终导致产品质量下降，甚至操作失控、爆炸，必须采取有力措施，避免或减少这一现象发生。本体聚合往往采用分段聚合，在自动加速期间采用低温聚合，或采用不同活性的引发剂，使聚合反应匀速进行。在某些场合为了利用自动加速效应，可以用有目的提高体系黏度（用加入聚合物到单体中）的方法使反应快速完成，如在牙科中制造牙托粉。
explanation_en: Also known as automatic acceleration phenomenon or gel effect. In free radical polymerization, the polymerization rate is automatically accelerated due to the increase of viscosity of the system. The reason for this phenomenon is that as the conversion rate of monomer increases, the viscosity of the system increases, causing the end of the active chain to be embedded, the mobility of the active chain to decline, resulting in a decrease in the termination rate. However, the viscosity of the system is not enough to seriously impede the diffusion of monomer, that is, the chain growth rate does not change much, resulting in an extension of the life of the active chain. The chain growth rate is greater than the corresponding chain termination rate. The polymerization rate increases, and the molecular weight increases at the same time. Temperature, monomer conversion, polymer molecular weight, polymer structure and other factors that can affect the viscosity of the system will have a certain impact on the autoacceleration effect. Automatic acceleration effect is common in bulk polymerization or high concentration solution polymerization, especially when polymer is insoluble or insoluble in monomer. In industrial production, some autoacceleration effect are often caused by the acceleration of polymerization rate and the reaction heat cannot be removed in time, which eventually leads to the decline of product quality, even out of control operation and explosion. Therefore, effective measures must be taken to avoid or reduce this phenomenon. Bulk polymerization often adopts segmented polymerization, and low-temperature polymerization is adopted during automatic acceleration, or initiator with different activities are used to make polymerization reaction proceed at a uniform speed. In some cases, in order to take advantage of the autoacceleration effect, the reaction can be completed quickly by purposefully increasing the viscosity of the system (adding polymer into monomer), such as manufacturing denture base polymer powder in dentistry.

explanation_en: A method for obtaining the radioisotope distribution image in an object by using the radiation from the radioisotope contained in the object and developing after being sensitized. Also known as autoradiography.

explanation_en: Prestressed concrete, also known as chemical prestressed concrete, is made by tensioning reinforcement with the expansion energy of self stressing cement. When this kind of concrete expands, the reinforcement is tensioned through the bonding effect with the reinforcement surface, so that the concrete can obtain the pre compression stress.

explanation_cn: 又称自修复复合材料。是一种在材料出现裂纹等损伤时，在一定条件下能够立刻进行自我修复，这种自愈合能力能显著提高复合材料的使用寿命。在陶瓷基复合材料体系中，材料的自愈合能力主要是通过基体中的含硼相，在较宽的温度范围内氧化气氛下形成氧化物玻璃相（如B2O3、B2O3-SiO2)，玻璃相在毛细管力作用下填充并愈合缺陷和裂纹，阻止氧气的扩散进而保护易氧化的组分，上述保护机制即为自愈合机制。含硼基体可通过化学气相沉积、浆料浸渍以及聚合物浸溃-热解的工艺引入。通过引入自愈合组分，碳纤维增强的碳化硅基复合材料使用寿命可由几小时增加至上百小时。上述自愈合复合材料成功应用于航空发动机热结构部件中，如密封片、尾喷管调节片等。
explanation_en: It is also called self-healing composite materials. It is a kind of self-healing ability that can immediately self repair under certain conditions when materials have cracks and other damages. This self-healing ability can significantly improve the service life of composite materials. In the ceramic matrix composite materials system, the self-healing ability of materials is mainly through the boron containing phase in the matrix to form oxide glass phase (such as B2O3, B2O3-SiO2) under the atmosphere of internal oxidation in a wide temperature range. The glass phase fills and heals defects and cracks under the action of capillary tube force to prevent the diffusion of oxygen and then protect easily oxidized components. The above protection mechanism is the self-healing mechanism. Boron containing matrix can be introduced by chemical vapor deposition, slurry impregnation and polymer impregnation pyrolysis processes. By introducing self-healing components, the service life of carbon fiber reinforced silicon carbide based composite materials can be increased from several hours to hundreds of hours. The self-healing composite materials mentioned above have been successfully applied to the thermal structural components of aeroengines, such as seals, tailpipe regulators, etc.

explanation_cn: 是指一类在受到伤害（如割伤）后可自行愈合的聚合物。一般的愈合方法包括：①在聚合物材料中包覆含有聚合单体或催化剂的"胶囊"，一旦聚合物材料破损，部分跟随破损的晈囊"中的溶液流出而发生反应，实现愈合;②在聚合物材料中通过共价键连接具有氢键、主客体作用等的基团，通过超分子作用力实现材料的修复;③在拓扑聚合物中含有大量的可相互反应的基团，通过控制反应即可在破损部位由光或者热诱导实现愈合。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of polymer that can heal itself after being injured (such as cut). General healing methods include: ① coating polymer materials with "capsule" containing polymerization monomer or catalyst, once polymer materials is damaged, Some of them react with the solution flowing out of the damaged "Kyungsa" to achieve healing; ② in polymer materials, groups with hydrogen bond, host guest effect, etc. are connected by covalent bond, and materials are repaired by supramolecular force; ③ in topological polymer, there are a large number of groups that can react with each other, and healing can be achieved by light or heat induction at the damaged part by controlling the reaction.

explanation_cn: 恒温恒压下，在没有化学浓度梯度情况仅仅由于热振动而产生的原子迁移。一般只有通过放射性同位素作为示踪原子才能观察到。
explanation_en: Under constant temperature and pressure, atomic migration occurs solely due to thermal vibration without a chemical concentration gradient. Generally, it can only be observed by using radioisotope as a tracer atom.

explanation_cn: 指经过特殊处理，将纳米技术应用于玻璃表面，赋予玻璃具有自清洁功能的一种玻璃制品。玻璃表面一般镀有掺杂TiO2薄膜或其他半导体薄膜，能够分解空气中的有机物，且催化空气中的氧气使之变为负氧离子，杀灭细菌.从而净化空气，使空气变得清新。另外，还有一种具有自我清洁而且不结雾的玻璃，这种玻璃的表面具有"双重可湿性”可以同时沾上水和油两种液体，当玻璃上有水气的时候便会在整个玻璃表面上扩散开来，而不会凝成水珠。与此同时，水在这种扩散的基础上可以渗透到油污之中，将其冲洗掉，从而达到强的自洁净能力。可应用于建筑幕墙、采光顶及汽车、火车等侧窗、后视镜等。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of glass product that has been specially treated to apply nanotechnology to glass surface and endow glass with self-cleaning function. The glass surface is generally coated with doped TiO2 films or other semiconductor films, which can decompose organic matters in the air, and catalyze the oxygen in the air to turn it into negative oxygen ions, killing bacteria, thus purifying the air and making the air fresh. In addition, there is also a kind of glass that is self-cleaning and does not form fog, The surface of this kind of glass has "double wettability" and can be stained with water and oil at the same time. When there is moisture on the glass, it will diffusion on the whole glass surface without condensation. At the same time, on the basis of this diffusion, water can permeate into oil stains and wash them off, so as to achieve strong self-cleaning ability. It can be applied to building curtain walls, daylighting roofs, side windows and rear-view mirrors of cars, trains, etc.

explanation_cn: 自流平混凝土是在浇注时仅靠自身重力无需经任何振捣而达到自动流平、密实成型的混凝土。它具有高流动性、高稳定性、高抗离析性、高填充性和良好的钢筋间隙通过等性能，以及良好的力学性能和耐久性能，减少施共噪声，防止因振捣不善出现的结构离析与质量事故。与自密实混凝土相比，在相同坍落度的条件下，自流平混凝土对扩展度有更高的要求，扩展后的混凝土越接近圆形、最大直径与最小直径差越小则表明其越接近匀质，变形能力良好，而观察在不发生离析情况下的形状，直径大则表明间隙通过能力强。
explanation_en: Self-leveling concrete is a kind of concrete that can be automatically leveled, compacted and shaped by its own gravity without any vibration during pouring. It has high flow ability, high stability, high anti segregation, high filling ability, good reinforcement clearance passing and other performances, as well as good mechanical performance and durability, reducing construction noise, and preventing structural segregation and quality accidents due to poor vibration. Compared with self compacting concrete, under the condition of the same slump, self-leveling concrete has higher requirements for expansion. The closer the expanded concrete is to the circle, the smaller the difference between the maximum diameter and the minimum diameter is, the closer it is to homogeneity, and the better its deformation ability. However, the shape observed without segregation, and the larger the diameter, the stronger the gap passing ability.

explanation_cn: 具有低摩擦系数、低磨损速率的复合材料。自润滑功能复合材料以高聚物或金属为基体，其低摩擦特性由具有低摩擦系数的固体润滑剂组分提供，常用的固体润滑剂是石墨、二硫化钼等层状结构物质，如聚四氟乙烯、聚乙烯等高聚物，银、铅等软金属及某些耐高温的氟化物。石英砂、玻璃纤维、碳纤维、青铜粉等耐磨组分赋予低的磨损速率和长的工作寿命。塑料-青铜网-钢背层复合材料是另一种自润滑功能复合材料。
explanation_en: Composite materials with low friction coefficient and low wear rate. The self-lubricating composite is based on polymer or metal, and its low friction characteristics are provided by the solid lubricant component with low friction coefficient. The commonly used solid lubricant is graphite, molybdenum disulfide and other layered structural materials, such as polylctrafluorocthylone, polyethylene and other polymers, silver, lead and other soft metals and some high-temperature fluoride. Wear resistant components such as quartz sand, glass fiber, carbon fiber and bronze powder endow low wear rate and long service life. Plastics bronze mesh steel backing composite materials is another kind of self-lubricating composite.

explanation_cn: 本身具有低摩擦特件的固体材料。可以是单一的材料，如聚四氟乙烯（PTFE)、石墨等;也可以是由固体或液体润滑剂与承载基体组成的复合材料。实际应用的自润滑材料大多数都是复合材料。自润滑复合材料的种类较多，如：金属基、聚合物基、陶瓷基和石墨基自润滑复合材料等。例如，纯PTFE虽具有摩擦系数低、耐温范围宽、化学稳定性高，不吸水，不黏，不燃，电绝缘等优异性能，但其抗蠕变性差，不耐磨。因而其应用范围受到很大限制。加入多种填充剂制成PTFE基自润滑复合材料后，不仅吋保持其原有的优异特性，还可使其抗蠕变性得到改善，使其耐磨性较纯PTFE有上千倍的提高且明显改善了其尺寸稳定性，使其成为许多特殊工况下使用的优异的自润滑材料。
explanation_en: Solid materials with low friction features. It can be a single materials, such as polylctrafluorocthylone (PTFE), graphite, etc; It can also be a composite materials composed of solid or liquid lubricant and load bearing matrix. Most of the self-lubrication materials used in practice are composite materials. There are many kinds of self-lubricating composite materials, such as metal based, polymer based, ceramic based and graphite based self-lubricating composite materials. For example, although pure PTFE has such excellent properties as low friction coefficient, wide temperature resistance range, high chemical stability, non water absorption, non adhesion, non combustion, electrical insulation, etc., its creep resistance is poor, and it is not wear-resistant. Therefore, its application range is greatly limited. After a variety of filler are added to make PTFE based self-lubricating composite materials, not only its original excellent properties are maintained, but also its creep resistance is improved, its wear resistance is thousands of times higher than that of pure PTFE, and its dimensional stability is significantly improved, making it an excellent self-lubrication materials used in many special working conditions.

explanation_cn: 使用固体润滑剂与金属粉末等烧结的轴承。一般轴承需外加润滑油、含油轴承需浸油，它们属于外加润滑轴承。用低摩擦系数的固体润滑剂，和铝铜类软金属与金属粉末烧结成的轴承。同体润滑剂能不断生成润滑膜，使轴承润滑，而无需外加润滑剂。滚动与滑动轴承均可采用这种方法。这类轴承常采用热压工艺制造：烧结多孔铜轴承，真空渗入MoS2,压制致密化而成的MoS2-Cu轴承，可克服MoS2在高温挥发难于保留MoS2的特点。镀银或镀金润滑轴承，也是一种有实用价值的工艺。在多频率发射的高频真空管内，需要转速1500r/min以上的自润滑滚动轴承，在工作中，自润滑（或同体润滑）剂不得挥发，真空下摩擦系数<0.2，真空中滚动磨损量6-7mg/1000h。这是一种自润滑轴承的典型数据，用于大型电子管、X射线管等高级设备中。汽车等用的常以PTFE氟塑料为固体润滑剂制成滚动轴承。
explanation_en: Sintering bearings such as solid lubricant and metal powder are used. General bearings need to be externally lubricated and selfoiling bearing needs to be immersed in oil. They are externally lubricated bearings. Bearings made of solid lubricant with low friction coefficient and sintered aluminum copper soft metal and metal powder. Homogeneous lubricant can continuously generate lubricating film to lubricate bearings without additional lubricant. Both rolling and sliding bearings can use this method. This kind of bearing is often manufactured by hot pressing process: sintering porous copper bearing, vacuum infiltrated MoS2, pressing densification MoS2 Cu bearing, which can overcome the difficulty of MoS2 volatilizing at high temperature and retaining the characteristics of MoS2. Silver or gold plated lubricated bearings are also a practical process. In the high-frequency vacuum tube with multi frequency emission, a self-lubricating rolling bearing with a rotating speed of more than 1500r/min is required. During operation, the self-lubricating (or co lubricating) agent shall not be volatilized, the friction coefficient under vacuum shall be less than 0.2, and the rolling wear amount in vacuum shall be 6-7mg/1000h. This is a typical data of self-lubricating bearing, which is used in advanced equipment such as large electronic tubes and X-ray tubes. Rolling bearings for automobiles are usually made of PTFE fluoroplastic as solid lubricant.

explanation_cn: 自清洁分为超疏水和超亲水。超疏水自清洁效应又称荷叶效应。水滴能够在荷叶表面自由滚动，荷叶上的灰尘可以被水滴带走而不留任何痕迹，因此被称为自清洁效应。自清洁表面具有超疏水性，与水的接触角大于150°。引起这种效应的根本原因是表面的微观几何结构实际上是一种微米-纳米分级复合结构。除超疏水表面外，水滴接触角小于10°的超亲水表面也具有自清洁效应，水在超亲水表面形成水膜而不是水滴，由于超亲水材料跟水的亲和力远大于跟灰尘以及其他脏污的亲和力，所以在下雨或有用水冲的情况下会优先跟水结合，水可以渗透到污物下面，把污物从超亲水自洁涂层分离开，从而达到自清洁的目的。由于同体表面的浸润性是由表面的化学组成和表面粗糙度两个因素共同决定的。因此，超疏（亲）水自清洁表面可以通过两种方法来制备：一种方法是利用疏(亲）水材料来构建微纳米级的表面粗糙结构：另一种方法是在微纳米复合结构粗糙表面上修饰低（高）表面能的物质。纳米自清洁效应可以用于各种防污表面.已经广泛应用于建筑、玻璃、卫生洁具、户外防水、船舶、输油管道、包装等领域。
explanation_en: Self cleaning is divided into superhydrophobic and superhydrophilic. Super hydrophobic self cleaning effect is also called lotus leaf effect. The water drop can roll freely on the surface of the lotus leaf, and the dust on the lotus leaf can be taken away by the water drop without leaving any trace, so it is called self cleaning effect. The self-cleaning surface is super hydrophobic, and the contact angle with water is greater than 150 °. The root cause of this effect is that the micro geometry of the surface is actually a micro nano hierarchical composition structure. In addition to superhydrophobic surfaces, superhydrophilic surfaces with a water drop contact angle of less than 10 ° also have a self cleaning effect. Water forms a water film on the superhydrophilic surface instead of water drops. Since the affinity of superhydrophilic materials with water is far greater than that with dust and other dirt, they will preferentially combine with water when it rains or is washed by water. Water can penetrate under dirt, separating dirt from the superhydrophilic self-cleaning coating, Thus achieving the purpose of self-cleaning. The wettability of the homogeneous surface is determined by the chemical composition of the surface and the surface roughness. Therefore, super hydrophobic (hydrophilic) self-cleaning surfaces can be prepared by two methods: one is to use hydrophobic (hydrophilic) materials to construct micro nano scale surface rough structures; the other is to modify low (high) surface energy materials on the rough surface of micro nano composition structures. Nanometer self cleaning effect can be used for various antifouling surfaces, and has been widely used in buildings, glass, sanitary ware, outdoor waterproofing, ships, oil pipelines, packaging and other fields.
