explanation_cn: 层状结构自然半金属单质矿物。化学式为As。类质同象混入物有Sb,少量Ag、Fe、Ni。三方晶系，空间群属畸变的氯化钠型结构。晶体呈假立方体、菱面体。集合体呈肾状、钟乳状、致密块状、粒状、鱗片状。新鲜面为锡白色，暴露空气中逐渐变暗黑色。条痕锡白色。新鲜面为金属光泽。不透明。平行{0001}一组完全解理。莫氏硬度3.5,是一种较罕见的矿物，主要产于热液金属矿脉内，常和Ag、Co、Ni的矿物伴生，也与重晶石、砷华、辰砂、雄黄、雌黄、辉锑矿、闪锌矿、方铅矿、黄铁矿等伴生。
explanation_en: Natural semi metallic elemental minerals with layered structure. The chemical formula is As. The isomorphic mixture includes Sb and a small amount of Ag, Fe, and Ni. The space group belongs to distorted rock salt structure. The crystal is pseudocube and rhombohedron. The aggregates are in the form of kidneys, bell milk, dense blocks, granules, and scales. The fresh surface is tin white, and gradually darkens when exposed to the air. Striped tin white. The fresh surface has a metallic luster. Opaque. Parallel {0001} sets of complete cleavage. Mohs hardness is 3.5, which is a rare mineral, mainly occurring in hydrothermal metal veins, often associated with Ag, Co, Ni minerals, but also associated with barite, arsenolite, cinnabar, realgar, orpiment, stibnite, sphalerite, galena, pyrite, etc.

explanation_cn: 链状结构自然金属单质矿物。化学式为Se。含有微量硫。三方晶系。晶体沿Z轴延长呈针状、柱状，有时呈薄板状集合体，亦呈水滴状。灰色,条痕红色，金属光泽。解理平行{1010}的三组完全。晶体易弯曲，具挠性。为硒化物的风化产物，由硒铅矿变来，常与褐铁矿共生并被胶结。硒的最主要性质是具有光电效应，用作光电池，用于电视、信号装置、玻璃、橡胶及化工等部门。硒可使玻璃变粉红色，甚至达红宝石色。能提高橡胶的抗热、抗氧化及耐磨性，增加可塑性。
explanation_en: Natural metallic elemental minerals with a chain like structure. The chemical formula is Se. Contains trace amounts of sulfur. Tripartite crystal system. The crystal extend along the Z axis in needle and column shape, sometimes in sheet aggregate, or in water drop shape. Grey, streaked red, metallic luster. The three sets of parallel cleavage {1010} are complete. Crystal is flexible and easy to bend. It is the weathering product of selenide, which is changed from selenite and is often associated with limonite and cemented. The most important property of selenium is that it has photoelectric effect and is used as a photocell in television, signal devices, glass, rubber and chemical industry. Selenium can make glass pink, even ruby. It can improve the heat resistance, oxidation resistance, wear resistance and plasticity of rubber.

explanation_cn: 环状结构自然非金属矿物。化学式为S。一般不纯净，火山成因的含As、Se、Sb和Tl;其它成因的含黏土、沥青、有机质等混入物。自然界有三种同质多象变体，在向然条件下稳定的为α-自然硫。斜方晶系，晶体常呈双锥状或厚板状，集合体呈致密块状、粉末状、土状等。硫黄色、浅黄色、蜜黄或黄椋色，含杂质染成红色、绿色、灰色及黑色（含有机质)。条痕白色至淡黄色。晶面金刚光泽，断口油脂光泽。透明至半透明，贝壳状断口。由于硫的热膨胀性不均匀，易受热而破裂。沉积成因的自然硫与生物化学作用有关，是在封闭条件下经细菌作用于硫酸盐类矿物而成，常与方解石、白云石、硬石膏、沥青等组合。火山成因自然硫与硫蒸气凝华有关。硫是化学工业的重要原料，可制造硫酸，还用于造纸、纺织、橡胶、食品、炸药、农药、医药及陶瓷等方面。
explanation_en: Natural non-metallic minerals with circular structure. The chemical formula is S. Generally impure, volcanic origin containing As, Se, Sb, and Tl; Other origins include clay, pitch, organic matter and other mixtures. There are three types of homogeneous polymorphisms in nature, which are stable under natural conditions α- Native sulfur. Orthorhombic system, crystal are usually in the shape of double cones or thick plates, and aggregates are in the shape of compact blocks, powder, soil, etc. Sulfur yellow, light yellow, honey yellow, or yellow starling color, containing impurities dyed into red, green, gray, and black (containing organic matter). Stripes white to light yellow. The crystal plane has diamond luster, and the fracture surface has grease luster. Transparent to semi transparent, with a shell like fracture. Due to the uneven thermal expansion of sulfur, it is prone to cracking due to heating. The natural sulfur of sedimentary origin is related to biochemical action. It is formed by bacteria acting on sulfate minerals under closed conditions, and is often combined with caldte, dolomite, anhydrite, pitch, etc. The natural sulfur of volcanic origin is related to the condensation of sulfur vapor. Sulfur is an important raw material for the chemical industry. It can be used to produce sulfuric acid, paper making, textile, rubber, food, explosive, pesticides, medicine and ceramics.

explanation_cn: 配位型属单质矿物。化学式为Au。纯金很少，常含有银的类质同象代替，还有Cu、Fe、Pd、Bi、Pt、Ni及Te、Se、Ir等。银含量达15%-50%者称银金矿（Au,Ag)。等轴晶系，铜型结构。完好晶形少见。一般多呈不规则粒状、团块状、薄片状、树枝状、海绵状集合体。也常成细小包体存在于黄铁矿、黄铜矿、方铅矿或石英中。颜色和条痕均为金黄色，随含银量增加变浅黄色。金属光泽，无解理。莫氏硬度2-3,密度15.6-18.3g/cm3。具有延展性，化学性质稳定，只溶于王水。为电和热的良导体。产于热液成因的含金石英脉中。在高温热液金矿床中与黄铁矿、磁铁矿、毒砂、闪锌矿、方铅矿等共生，中温热液金矿床中与黄铁矿、方铅矿、闪锌矿、黄铜矿共生，低温热液金矿床中与黄铁矿、方铅矿、闪锌矿、辉银矿、黄铜矿等共生。中国砂金分布广，以金沙江、黑龙江、湖南沅水流域称著。
explanation_en: The coordination type belongs to elemental minerals. The chemical formula is Au. Pure gold is rare and often contains isomorphic substitutes of silver, as well as Cu, Fe, Pd, Bi, Pt, Ni, and Te, Se, Ir, etc. Those with a silver content of 15% -50% are called silver gold mines (Au, Ag). Equiaxed crystal system, copper type structure. Intact crystal form is rare. Generally, it appears as an irregular granular, clumpy, thin sheeted, branched, or sponge like aggregate. It also often occurs as small inclusions in pyrite, chalcopyrite, galena or quartze. The color and stripes are both golden yellow, becoming lighter yellow as the silver content increases. Metallic luster, without cleavage. Mohs hardness 2-3, density 15.6-18.3g/cm3. It has ductility, stable chemical properties, and is only soluble in aqua regia. A good conductor of electricity and heat. It occurs in gold bearing quartz vein of hydrothermal origin. It is associated with pyrite, magnetite, arsenojpyrite, sphalerite, galena, etc. in high-temperature hydrothermal gold deposits, pyrite, galena, sphalerite, chalcopyrite, etc. in medium temperature hydrothermal gold deposits, and pyrite, galena, sphalerite, argent, chalcopyrite, etc. in low-temperature hydrothermal gold deposits. China has a wide distribution of placer gold, which is famous for Jinsha River, Heilongjiang and Yuanshui River basins in Hunan.

explanation_cn: 配位型自然金属单质矿物。化学式为Pt。常含有Ir、Pd、Fe、Cu、Ru、Ni等。铁含量达9%-11%时称粗铂矿（Pt，Fe)。自然钼大多是粗铂矿。等轴晶系。偶见立方晶体，常呈粒状、葡萄状集合体。银内色至钢灰色，面一般带浅黄色。条痕烟灰色至光亮银白色。金属光泽，无解理。莫氏硬度4-4.5,密度21.5g/cm3具延展性，微具磁性。产于基性、超基性岩有关的铂矿床及砂矿中。与钼的矿物及自然铱、自然金、铜铁镍硫化物及铬尖晶石共生。是提炼金属铂的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Coordination type natural metal elemental minerals. The chemical formula is Pt. It often contains Ir, Pd, Fe, Cu, Ru, Ni, etc. When the iron content reaches 9% -11%, it is called coarse platinum ore (Pt, Fe). Most natural molybdenum is platinum. Equiaxed crystal system. Cubic crystal are occasionally seen, often in granular and grape like aggregates. Silver interior color to steel gray, with light yellow surface. Striped smoke gray to shiny silver white. Metallic luster, without cleavage. Mohs hardness 4-4.5, density 21.5g/cm3, ductile, slightly magnetic. It occurs in platinum deposits and placers related to basic and ultrabasic rock. It is associated with molybdenum minerals, natural iridium, native gold, copper iron nickel sulfide and chromium spinel. It is a raw mineral material for refining platinum.

explanation_cn: 层状结构向然半金属单质矿物。化学式为Bi。三方晶系。畸变的氯化納型结构。晶体少见，常呈粒状，有时呈片状或致密块状、羽毛状集合体。颜色在新鲜断口呈银白色，微带浅黄，在空气中很快变成特有的浅红锖色。条痕灰黑色。强金属光泽，不透明。平行{0001}一组完全解理。莫氏硬度2-2.5,密度9.7-9.83g/cm3。略具延展性，具抗磁性。产于高温热液矿床.与毒砂、辉铋矿、辉钼矿、绿柱石等伴生。是提炼铋的矿物原料。中国江西、湖南、广西等省的钨锡矿床中常有产出。
explanation_en: Layered structure of natural semi metallic elemental minerals. The chemical formula is Bi. Tripartite crystal system. Distorted chloride type structure. Crystal are rare, often in granular form, sometimes in sheet or dense block, feather like aggregates. The color appears silver white on the fresh fracture surface, with a slight yellowish tinge. It quickly turns into a unique light red color in the air. The stripes are gray black. Strong metallic luster, opaque. Parallel {0001} sets of complete cleavage. Mohs hardness 2-2.5, density 9.7-9.83g/cm3. Slightly ductile, diamagnetism. It occurs in high temperature hydrothermal deposits and is associated with arsenojpyrite, bismuthinite, molybdenite, beryl, etc. It is a raw mineral material for extracting bismuth. Tungsten tin deposits are often found in provinces such as Jiangxi, Hunan, and Guangxi in China.

explanation_cn: 配位型自然金属单质矿物。化学式为Cu。常含有少量或微量Ag、Au、Hg、Bi、Sb、V、Ge等混入物。铜型结构。等轴晶系，。完好晶形少见，集合体呈不规则树枝状、纤维状、片状。铜红色，表面常氧化成粽褐色被膜。条痕铜红色。金属光泽，无解理，断口锯齿状。具强延展性，具良好的导电性和导热性。最常见于含铜硫化物矿床氧化带，与赤铜矿、孔雀石，有时与辉铜矿等伴生。大量聚集时可作为铜矿石开采。广泛用于电气工业、机械工业等部门，也常用于制货币。
explanation_en: Coordination type natural metal elemental minerals. The chemical formula is Cu. It often contains small or trace amounts of mixed substances such as Ag, Au, Hg, Bi, Sb, V, Ge, etc. Copper shaped structure. The equiaxed crystal system,. Intact crystal form is rare, and the aggregates are irregularly branched, fibrous, or flaky. Copper red, often oxidized to a brown coating on the surface. Striped copper red. Metallic luster, no cleavage, serrated fracture surface. Has strong ductility, good conductivity and thermal conductivity. It is most commonly found in the oxidation zone of copper bearing sulfide deposits, associated with hematite, malachite, and sometimes chalcocite. When there is a large accumulation, it can be used as copper ore for mining. Widely used in electrical and mechanical industries, and also commonly used in currency making.

explanation_cn: 配位型自然金属单质矿物。化学式为Ag。常含Au、Cu、Hg等。等轴晶系。铜型结构。完好晶形少见，常呈树枝状、毛发状、皮壳状及粒状、块状集合体。颜色和条痕均为银白色（含金者条痕带黄色色调），表面氧化后具灰黑色被膜。金属光泽，不透明，无解理。具延展性，锯齿状断口，为电和热的良导体。主要产于中低温热液矿床中，常和其他含银矿物如辉银矿、浓红银矿、淡红银矿以及含银的方铅矿、闪锌矿、黄铜矿、辉铜矿和黄铁矿等共生。是炼银的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Coordination type natural metal elemental minerals. The chemical formula is Ag. It often contains Au, Cu, Hg, etc. Equiaxed crystal system. Copper shaped structure. Intact crystal forms are rare, often appearing as dendritic, hairlike, crusty, and granular or blocky aggregates. The color and stripes are both silver white (the stripes with gold have a yellow hue), and the surface has a gray black coating after oxidation. Metallic luster, opaque, without cleavage. It has ductility and serrated fracture surface, making it a good conductor of electricity and heat. It is mainly produced in medium low temperature hydrothermal deposits and often coexists with other silver bearing minerals such as argentite, concentrated argentite, light argentite and silver bearing galena, sphalerite, chalcopyrite, chalcocite and pyrite. It is raw mineral material for silver smelting.

explanation_cn: 以镜、钴、铁为基与铬、硼、硅组成的能自动造渣保护合金不被氧化，有高的润湿能力，硬度很高的合金粉末。NiCrBSi的热喷涂（焊）硬度HRC55-60,熔点约1000℃，热膨胀系数接近于不锈钢，热喷涂在工件表面的喷涂层经过火焰重烧熔化，可形成与母材的冶金结合层。通过喷涂（指未用火焰重熔）与母材结合力为50MPa,而喷焊（指火焰重熔）为200-300MPa。喷涂（焊）层厚度约lmm,过厚容易脱落。因此，与热喷涂（焊）技术紧密相连。自熔合金也多数依靠热喷涂（焊）技术与母材(工件）熔焊成一个整体，真正体现出合金的特性。自熔合金中的铬生成碳化铬、硼化铬硬质点溶解在镍基体中，硼和硅可降低合金熔点和起造渣作用。冶炼后用水（或气）雾化制成粉末，称为粉。按成分可以分为镍基、铁基、钴基三大类，其中以镍基粉用途最广，广泛用于热喷涂（焊），作工件的耐磨防护和易磨损件的修复。
explanation_en: Alloy powder based on mirror, cobalt, iron and chromium, boron and silicon, which can automatically form slag to protect alloy from oxidation, has high wetting ability and high hardness. The thermal spraying (welding) hardness of NiCrBSi is HRC55-60, the melting point is about 1000 ℃, and the thermal expansion coefficient is close to that of stainless steel. The spraying layer of thermal spraying on the workpiece surface is melted by flame re burning, which can form a metallurgical bonding layer with the base metal. The bonding force between spraying (referring to non flame remelting) and the base metal is 50MPa, while spraying welding (referring to flame remelting) is 200-300MPa. The thickness of the spray (welding) layer is about 1mm, and it is easy to fall off if it is too thick. Therefore, it is closely connected with thermal spraying (welding) technology. Self-fluxing alloy also relies on thermal spraying (welding) technology and base metal (workpiece) fusion welding to form a whole, which truly reflects the characteristics of alloy. Chromium in self-fluxing alloy generates chromium carbide and chromium boride hard spots are dissolved in nickel matrix. Boron and silicon can reduce the melting point of alloy and play a role in slag forming. After smelting, powder is made by atomizing with water (or gas), which is called powder. According to composition, it can be divided into three major categories: nickel based, iron based and cobalt based. Among them, nickel based powder is the most widely used, widely used in thermal spraying (welding), as wear-resistant protection of workpieces and repair of easily worn parts.

explanation_cn: 液体氧化剂和液体燃料相互接触后能自燃的双组元推进剂。如四氧化二氮和偏二甲肼、四氧化二氮和混肼燃料、发烟硝酸和混胺燃料。着火延迟期短，从氧化剂和燃料混合到开始出现火焰的时间间隔一般小于20-30ms，最长不大于50ms。不需要第二点火源，只要喷入发动机燃烧室，就立即进人额定工作状态.燃烧室内几乎无推进剂聚集。使用的发动机可多次熄火和点火，在工作状态的燃烧比非自燃推进剂稳定。液体氧化剂和液体燃料相互接触后不能自燃的双组元推进剂称作非。如液氧和煤油、液氧和酒精等。发动机中需装备外点火装置。
explanation_en: A bipropellant that can spontaneously ignite when liquid oxidizer and liquid fuel contact each other. Such as nitrogen tetroxide and unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine, nitrogen tetroxide and mixed hydrazine fuel, fuming nitric acid and mixed amine fuel. The ignition delay period is short, and the time interval from the mixing of oxidizer and fuel to the start of flame is generally less than 20-30ms, and the longest is not more than 50ms. No second ignition source is required. As long as it is injected into the engine combustion chamber, it will enter the rated working state immediately. There is almost no propellant accumulation in the combustion chamber. The engine used can be extinguished and ignited for many times, and its combustion is more stable than that of non self igniting propellant under working condition. The bipropellant that cannot spontaneously ignite after the liquid oxidizer and liquid fuel contact each other is called non. Such as liquid oxygen and kerosene, liquid oxygen and alcohol. The engine needs to be equipped with an external ignition device.

name_cn: 自生增强镁基复合材料
name_en: in situ reinforced magnesium matrix composite
explanation_cn: 是在镁合金基体内通过反应、定向凝固、塑性变形等方法生成颗粒、晶须、纤维状增强物。与传统的复合材料相比，自生复合材料主要有如下特点：自生增强相热稳定性好，高温性能好，增强相与基体的界面清洁，界面结合力强，通过：工艺优化可以有效控制自生增强相的尺寸、分布和体枳分数等。镁基复合材料是航空航天领域理想的结构材料，在汽车、船舶、电子、化工、仪表等工业中有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: It is to generate particles, crystal whisker and fibrous reinforcements in the matrix of magnesium alloy by reaction, directional solidification, plastic deformation and other methods. Compared with traditional composite materials, in-situ composite materials mainly have the following characteristics: good thermal stability of in-situ reinforcements, good high-temperature performance, clean interface between reinforcements and matrix, strong interface adhesion, and process optimization can effectively control the size, distribution and volume fraction of in-situ reinforcements. Magnesium matrix composite are ideal structural materials in the aerospace field, and have broad application prospects in automotive, shipbuilding, electronics, chemical industry, instrumentation and other industries.

explanation_cn: 两种或两种以上单体以自由基链式聚合机理进行的共聚合反应。
explanation_en: Copolymerization of two or more monomer by free radical chain polymerization mechanism.

explanation_cn: 指一类受热容易分解成自由基（即初级自由基）的化合物，可用于引发烯类、双烯类单体的自由基聚合和共聚合反应，也可用于不饱和聚酯的交联固化和高分子交联反应。按照分解方式可分为热分解嘈和氧化还原分解型两类，按引发剂的分子结构可以分为偶氮类、过氧类和氧化还原类。
explanation_en: It refers to a class of compounds that are easy to decompose into free radicals (i.e. primary free radicals) when heated, and can be used to initiate free radical polymerization and copolymerization of olefin and diene monomer, as well as crosslinking curing of unsaturated polyester and crosslinking reaction of macromolecule. According to the decomposition mode, it can be divided into thermal decomposition type and redox decomposition type. According to the molecular structure of initiator, it can be divided into azo type, peroxide type and redox type.

explanation_cn: 单体通过光、热、辐射或引发剂的作用会产生活性自由基，这些活性自由基可以引发链式聚合反应。在这种链式聚合中，引发剂是关键的组成部分，它们通过与单体发生加成反应而形成初级自由基。引发剂的分解是一个吸热反应，需要高能量。一旦形成了初级自由基，它们会继续与其他单体发生加成反应，形成新的自由基，这些新的自由基具有更多的结构单元，这个过程被称为链增长反应。链增长反应具有低活化能，因此它们发生得非常迅速。链终止反应是链式聚合反应中的另一个关键步骤，其中自由基失去活性。链终止反应可以通过偶联终止或歧化终止两种方式发生。与链增长反应相比，链终止反应的活化能非常低，有时甚至接近零。传统自由基聚合的机理特征包括慢引发、快增长、速终止以及可能存在链转移。反应的速度受多种因素影响，包括自由基浓度、单体浓度、引发剂体系、杂质、反应介质和温度。通常，有机或无机过氧化物和偶氮化合物是常用的引发剂。聚合的主要单体包括乙烯类单体和共轭单体。自由基聚合反应在高分子化学中占有极其重要的地位，许多聚合物，如聚乙烯、聚丙烯、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯、聚丙烯腈、聚乙烯醋酸、丁苯橡胶、丁腈橡胶和氯丁橡胶等，都是通过自由基聚合合成的。
explanation_en: Monomer can produce active free radicals through the action of light, heat, radiation or initiator, which can initiate chain polymerization reaction. In this chain polymerization, initiator is the key component, which forms primary free radicals through addition reaction with monomer. The decomposition of initiator is an endothermic reaction, which requires high energy. Once primary free radicals are formed, they will continue to react with other monomer to form new free radicals, which have more structural units. This process is called chain growth reaction. Chain growth reactions have low activation energy, so they occur very quickly. Chain termination is another key step in chain polymerization, in which free radicals lose their activity. The chain termination reaction can occur through coupling termination or disproportionation termination termination. Compared with chain growth reaction, the activation or conditioning energy of chain termination reaction is very low, sometimes even close to zero. The mechanism characteristics of traditional free radical polymerization include slow initiation, fast growth, fast termination and possible chain transfer. The reaction rate is affected by many factors, including free radical concentration, monomer concentration, initiator system, impurities, reaction medium and temperature. Generally, organic or inorganic peroxides and azo compounds are commonly used initiator. The main monomer of polymerization include ethylene monomer and conjugated monomer. Free radical polymerization plays an extremely important role in polymer chemistry. Many polymer, such as polyethylene, polypropylene, polymethyl methacrylate, polyacrylonitrile, polyethylene acetic acid, styrene butadiene rubber, acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber and chloroprene rubber, are synthesized through free radical polymerization.

explanation_cn: 表示在平衡体系中.当各相保持不变的情况下，可以自由、独立变化的强度因素（如温度、压力和各相的浓度等）的数目。参见相律中的说明。
explanation_en: It refers to the number of intensity factors (such as temperature, pressure and concentration of each phase) that can change freely and independently when each phase remains unchanged in the equilibrium system. Refer to the explanation in the phase diagram.

explanation_cn: 可指亥姆霍兹自由能或吉布斯自由能/吉布斯函数。历史上，在物理学中，自由能常指亥姆霍兹自由能;在化学中，自由能常指吉布斯自由能。分别表征物质体系在恒温恒容过程中和在恒温恒压过程中做非体积功的能力（最大限度），可作为过程自发进行和达到平衡的判据。亥姆霍兹自由能和吉布斯自由能均为热力学系统的状态函数。
explanation_en: It can refer to Helmholtz free energy or Gibbs free energy/Gibbs function. Historically, in physics, free energy often refers to Helmholtz free energy; In chemistry, the free energy is often referred to as the Gibbs free energy. The ability of a material system to perform non volumetric work during constant temperature and constant volume processes and constant temperature and pressure processes can be characterized separately (to the maximum extent possible), which can serve as a criterion for the spontaneous progress of the process and the achievement of equilibrium. Helmholtz free energy and Gibbs free energy are state functions of thermodynamics system.

explanation_cn: 一种用来消除贴壁浇铸的固体火箭发动机燃烧室装药局部应力的结构设计。这种结构设计类似于人工预制裂纹。在燃烧室制造过程中的固化降温阶段以及在固体火箭发动机宽温度范围使用时，由于壳体材料与推进剂装药的热膨胀系数存在显著差异，采用贴壁浇铸的燃烧室推进剂装药两端部将产生很高的热应力，当该应力水平超过推进剂装药的承载能力时将会导致推进剂装药结构破坏。通过在燃烧室两端部预制向由脱黏层可消除该部位的热应力，也就是在绝热层与推进剂装药之间预制一层类似绝热层的弹性材料。其靠近绝热层一面与绝热层呈分离状态，靠近推进剂一面通过衬层材料与推进剂装药黏结在一起，并在靠近燃烧室筒体一端将该材料与绝热层黏结起来。当温度发生变化时，由于绝热层与之间呈分离状态而不会在推进剂装药内产生热应力。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a structural design for eliminating the local stress of the solid rocket motor combustion chamber charge which is cast against the wall by casting. This structural design is similar to artificially prefabricated cracks. In the curing cooling stage of the combustion chamber manufacturing process and in the wide temperature range of the solid rocket motor, due to the significant difference between the coefficient of thermcal expansion of the shell materials and the propellant charge, the two ends of the casting combustion chamber propellant charge with the wall will produce very high thermal stress. When the stress level exceeds the bearing capacity of the propellant charge, the propellant charge structure will be damaged. The thermal stress at the two ends of the combustion chamber can be eliminated by prefabricating the debonding layer, that is, prefabricating a layer of elasticity materials similar to the thermal insulation layer between the thermal insulation layer and the propellant charge. The side close to the heat insulation liner is separated from the heat insulation liner, and the side close to the propellant is bonded with the propellant charge through the materials of the liner, and the materials is bonded with the heat insulation liner at the end close to the combustion chamber cylinder. When the temperature changes, thermal stress will not be generated in the propellant charge due to the separation between the insulation layer and.

explanation_cn: 是将初始扭转力作用于体系，随即除去外力，体系发生形变或形变速率随时间逐渐衰减的振动，根据振动频率与振幅衰减速率计算体系的刚性和阻尼性能。包括扭摆法和扭辫法。
explanation_en: The initial torsional force is applied to the system, and then the external force is removed. The system undergoes deformation or the deformation rate gradually decays with time. The rigidity and damping properties of the system are calculated according to the vibration frequency and amplitude decay rate. Including torsion-pendulum method method and torsion braid method.

explanation_cn: 只用简单的通用性工具，在锻造设备的锤头和砧块间直接对坯料施加外力，使坯料产生变形而获得所需的几何形状及尺寸的锻件的工艺方法。适合于单件小批量生产，灵活性高，但生产率低，机械化程度低，在特殊钢厂用于高合金钢的开坯锻造，在机械厂则广泛用于生产各种小批量锻件。自由锻的基本工序有镦粗、拔长、延伸、冲孔、切断和锻焊等。
explanation_en: The process method of directly applying external force to the blank between the hammer head and anvil block of the forging equipment using simple universal tools to deform the blank and obtain the required geometric shape and size of the forging. It is suitable for single piece small batch production with high flexibility, low productivity and low mechanization. It is used for blooming forging of high alloy steel in special steel plants and widely used for producing various small batch forgings in machinery plants. The basic processes of hammer forging include upsetting, elongation, extension, punching, cutting, forging and welding, etc.

explanation_cn: 部分结晶高分子中非晶相离晶相较远，因而其分子运动基本不受晶相限制的部分。
explanation_en: In partially crystalline polymer, the amorphous phase is far away from the crystalline phase, so the molecular movement is basically not restricted by the crystalline phase.

explanation_cn: 具有自电光效应的多量子阱（MQW）材料是一种具有特殊光学性质的材料。MQW材料的主要特点是其量子阱的宽度相对较小（大约为10纳米），这使得阱内的激子结合能大大增加。因此，即使在室温条件下，MQW材料也能观察到轻和重两个激子吸收峰。相比之下，传统体材料中的激子通常较大（约30纳米），结合能较小，只能在低温下才能观察到激子峰。MQW材料的一个显著特点是在垂直于量子阱方向上加电场时，激子吸收峰会发生氏波移动，这被称为量子限制Stark效应（QCSE）。QCSE的产生是由于电场的作用，导致激子能级发生偏移，从而改变了对光的吸收特性。这一特性使MQW材料成为了光调制器的理想选择。此外，MQW材料也用于光探测器。尤其是由超晶格-多量子阱超晶格结构构成的光探测器，具有内部量子效率接近100%。这些器件结合了调制和探测功能，因此被称为自电光效应器件（SEED）。SEED的工作原理是通过光引起的电流来影响器件两端的电压，而这一电压反过来又影响对光的吸收。因此，SEED内部存在光电反馈现象，其性能取决于外部电子线路和光电反馈方式。这种具有调制和探测功能的SEED器件可以在室温下高速运转，而且可以与其他光电器件如二极管激光器和光探测器等兼容。它们在光通信、光计算、光信息处理等领域有广泛的应用。已实现的自电光效应材料包括GaAs/AlGaAs MQW、InGaAs/InAlAs MQW、GaInAsP/InP MQW等。这些材料的SEED器件在现代光电子技术中发挥着重要的作用。
explanation_en: Multi quantum well (MQW) materials with self electrophoto effect is a materials with special optical properties. The main feature of MQW materials is that the width of its quantum well is relatively small (about 10 nm), which greatly increases the exciton cohesive energy in the well. Therefore, even at room temperature, MQW materials can also observe light and heavy exciton absorption peaks. In contrast, the exciton in traditional materials is usually large (about 30 nm), and the cohesive energy is small. The exciton peak can only be observed at low temperatures. A remarkable feature of MQW materials is that when an electric field is applied perpendicular to the quantum well direction, the exciton absorption summit will shift, which is called the quantum confinement Stark effect (QCSE). The generation of QCSE is due to the effect of electric field, which leads to the shift of exciton energy level, thus changing the absorption characteristics of light. This characteristic makes MQW materials an ideal choice for light modulator. In addition, MQW materials is also used for photodetectors. In particular, the photodetector composed of superlattice multi quantum well superlattice structure has an internal quantum efficiency of nearly 100%. These devices combine modulation and detection functions, so they are called self electrophoto effect devices (SEED). The working principle of SEED is to affect the voltage at both ends of the device through the current caused by light, which in turn affects the absorption of light. Therefore, there is photoelectric feedback phenomenon inside SEED, and its performance depends on external electronic circuits and photoelectric feedback methods. This SEED device with modulation and detection functions can operate at high speed at room temperature and is compatible with other optoelectronic devices such as diode lasers and photodetectors. They have extensive applications in fields such as optical communication, optical computing, and optical information processing. The realized self-electro-optic effect materials include GaAs/AlGaAs MQW, InGaAs/InAlAs MQW, GaInAsP/InP MQW, etc. The SEED devices of these materials play an important role in modern optoelectronic technology.

explanation_cn: 又称自我组装，用于描述无序系统在没有外部条件的作用下，为使系统能量最小化，由其基本结构单元之间通过较弱的相互作用，自发组织或聚集为一个有序、稳定、具苻一定规则几何外观结构的过程。过程可分为自发和可逆两种。现象有三个特征：①有序性，自组装的结构比单独的组成部分具有更高的有序性;②非共价键的弱相互作用;③丰富的基本结构单元，如原子、分子、蛋白质分子、纳米材料、微米或更大尺度的颗粒等。过程在自然界中普遍存在，如生物体的细胞即是由各种生物分子而成。在纳米材料研究中，利用胶体纳米晶表面的表面活性剂稳定层以及表面的电荷产生的均一的范德华力、静电作用力，技术成为一种重要的"由下而上（bottom-up)"的制备不同维度、不同形貌纳米超结构的方法，如超晶格、超晶体以及超材料等，可用于制备具有特殊光学、电学、磁性和催化等性能的新型功能纳米材料。这些自组装形成的超结构已被广泛应用于电子仪器制造、生物传感器、塑料成型、金属防蚀层、高效催化材料、分子器件、医用生物材料等领域。
explanation_en: Also known as self assembly, it is used to describe the process in which a disordered system spontaneously organizes or gathers into an ordered, stable, and regular geometric appearance structure through weak interaction between its basic structural units in order to minimize the system energy without the effect of external conditions. The process can be divided into two types: spontaneous and reversible. The phenomenon has three characteristics: ① orderliness, the self-assembly structure has higher orderliness than the individual components; ② Non covalent bond weak interaction; ③ Abundant basic structural units, such as atoms, molecules, protein molecules, nanomaterials, micron or larger scale particles, etc. Processes are common in nature, such as the cells of living organisms being composed of various biological molecules. In the research of nanomaterials, using the surfactant stabilizing layer on the surface of colloidal nanocrystals and the uniform van der Waals force and electrostatic force generated by the surface charge, technology has become an important "bottom-up" method to prepare nanostructures with different dimensions and shapes, such as superlattices, super crystal and metamaterials, which can be used to prepare special optics, electricity New functional nanomaterials with magnetic and catalytic properties. These superstructures formed by self-assembly have been widely used in electronic instrument manufacturing, biosensor, plastics molding, metal anti-corrosive layer, efficient catalytic materials, molecular device, medical biological materials and other fields.

explanation_cn: 通过超分子自组装制备的药物传递系统。可具有纳米、微米粒子、薄膜、纳米纤维等多种形态。制备自组装药物传递系统的材料多种多样，常见的包括有机高分子、脂质、无机离子等。组装方法很多，以高分子体系为例，最常见的是两亲性高分子通过疏水作用自组装形成纳米粒子，除了疏水作用外.体系中还可能存在其他分子间作用力，如静电作用、立体异构复合作用、主客体作用、氢键等，通过调控这些作用力，可以组装形成具有特定精细复杂结构的有序聚集体系.用于药物传递。
explanation_en: Drug delivery system prepared by supramolecular self-assembly. It can have nano, micron particles, films, nanofibre and other forms. There are various materials for preparing self-assembled drug delivery system, including organic macromolecule, lipids, inorganic ions, etc. There are many assembly methods. Take macromolecule system as an example, the most common one is that amphiphilic macromolecule forms nanoparticles through hydrophobic self-assembly. In addition to hydrophobic interaction, there may also be other intermolecular forces in the system, such as electrostatic interaction, stereoisomeric recombination, host guest interaction, hydrogen bond, etc. By regulating these forces, it can be assembled to form an ordered aggregation system with specific fine and complex structure for drug delivery.

explanation_cn: 又称抛物线或平方律型光纤或梯度折射率光纤。通信用的多模光纤就采用抛物线型光纤。另一用途是制造自聚焦透镜，是将玻璃用离子交换技术在芯捧上形成梯度折射率分布，然后套上包层玻璃而制成。当光在这种光纤中传输时，纤芯中光的轨迹呈余弦形曲线，所以取出四分之一周期的节段便形成一个自聚焦透镜，自聚焦透镜由此得名。这种自聚焦透镜在光纤技术和光信息处理技术中应用很广泛。
explanation_en: Also called parabolic or square law optical fiber or gradient index fiber. The multimode optical fiber for communication uses parabolic optical fiber. Another use is to manufacture self focusing lens, which is made of glass by forming gradient refractive index distribution on the core holder with ion exchange technology, and then sheathing the cladding glass. When light is transmitted in such a optical fiber, the path of light in the core is a cosine curve, so a quarter period segment is taken out to form a self focusing lens, hence the name self focusing lens. This self focusing lens is widely used in optical fiber technology and optical information processing technology.

explanation_cn: 由镍钛超弹合金薄壁管经过激光精密雕刻制成的超弹性支架。通过压握式输送导管到达病变处，解除固定后自扩张使血液畅通，并对病变部位起支撑作用。支架事先已经加工成要求的撑开后的直径尺寸，通过特殊的工艺把支架压握在较小的输送鞘管内。由于材料具有优异的超弹性，支架在很小的鞘管内不会发生塑性变形。输送鞘管到达患者狹窄血管病变区后，后撤鞘管释放支架，支架自行恢复其形状，同时把狹窄的血管撑开，恢复供血。镍钛合金作为一种优良的生物材料，将会在血管介入器械中得到越来越广泛的运用。
explanation_en: Super elasticity stem is made of nickel titanium super elastic alloy thin-wall tube by laser precision engraving. The pressure grip catheter is used to deliver the catheter to the lesion. After the fixation is removed, the catheter will expand to make the blood smooth and support the lesion. The stem has been processed to the required diameter after being stretched in advance, and the stem is pressed and held in a smaller conveying sheath through a special process. Because the materials has excellent super elasticity, the stem will not have plastic deformation in a very small sheath. After the delivery sheath reaches the stenosis vascular lesion area of the patient, withdraw the sheath to release the stem, and the stem will automatically restore its shape, at the same time, open the stenosis blood vessel to restore blood supply. Nickel titanium alloy, as an excellent biomaterial, will be increasingly widely used in vascular intervention devices.

explanation_cn: 见自蔓延高温合成。
explanation_en: See self-propagating high-temperature synthesis.

explanation_cn: 又被称为肉蔓延燃烧反应法或燃烧合成，是一种合成材料的技术，通过引发物料中的各元素之间的化学反应，利用反应放热使整体材料的化学反应自行完成。这一过程的温度通常在2100°C到3500°C之间。通常，SHS有两种模式：蔓延反应和整体反应。蔓延反应模式是指在反应物料的某个局部区域通过高温引发化学反应，产生一个“燃烧波”前沿，这个波会以一定的速率自发蔓延向未反应区域，直至整个反应完成。当物料的绝热燃烧温度（指在绝热条件下，物料发生化学反应所释放的热完全用来加热反应产物，使其达到的温度）大于1800K时，燃烧波会稳定地向前蔓延，这被称为稳态燃烧。整体反应模式则发生在温度低于1800K时，可能出现非稳态燃烧、中途熄灭甚至无法点燃。在这种情况下，可以采用“化学炉”法或预热法来引发反应。化学炉法通过引燃外部的高温物料来诱发反应，而预热法则是通过升温物料，直至达到一定温度，引发整体反应，也被称为“热爆”技术。SHS工艺具有许多优点，包括节能、合成速度快、产品纯度高、活性大、易合成复杂相、工艺简便等。这一技术已成功合成了数百种化合物，其中包括氮化物、碳化物、硼化物、硅化物、非化学计量化合物和金属间化合物等。此外，SHS工艺还衍生了制粉、烧结块体材料、致密化和焊接等技术，用于制备单相或多相陶瓷、硬质合金、金属间化合物和粉体等材料。
explanation_en: Also known as meat spreading combustion reaction method or combustion synthesis, it is a technology for synthesizing materials, which can make the chemical reaction of the whole materials complete by itself by initiating the chemical reaction between the elements in the material and using the reaction exothermic. The temperature of this process is usually between 2100 ° C and 3500 ° C. Usually, SHS has two modes: spreading response and overall response. The spread reaction mode refers to that a chemical reaction is initiated at a local area of the reaction material through high temperature, producing a "combustion wave" front, which will spontaneously spread to the unreacted area at a certain rate until the whole reaction is completed. When the adiabatic combustion temperature of the material (that is, under adiabatic conditions, the heat released by the chemical reaction of the material is completely used to heat the reaction products to reach the temperature) is greater than 1800K, the combustion wave will steadily spread forward, which is called steady state combustion. The overall reaction mode occurs when the temperature is lower than 1800K, which may lead to unstable combustion, mid way extinction or even failure to ignite. In this case, the "chemical furnace" method or preheating method can be used to initiate the reaction. The chemical furnace method triggers a reaction by igniting high-temperature materials from the outside, while the preheating method is to raise the temperature of the material until it reaches a certain temperature, triggering the overall reaction, also known as the "thermal explosion" technology. SHS process has many advantages, including energy saving, fast synthesis, high product purity, high activity, easy synthesis of complex phase, simple process, etc. This technology has successfully synthesized hundreds of compounds, including nitrides, carbide, borides, silicides, non stoichiometric compounds and imermetallif compound. In addition, SHS process has also derived technologies such as powder making, sintering bulk materials, densification and weld, which are used to prepare materials such as single-phase or multi-phase ceramics, hardmetal, imermetallif compound and powders.

name_cn: 自补强陶瓷基复合材料
explanation_cn: 陶瓷材料制备过程中，向身生成一定数量起补强作用的晶须、晶片或柱状晶。见陶瓷某复合材料原位生长工艺。
explanation_en: During the preparation of ceramics materials, a certain number of crystal whisker, wafers or columnar crystals are generated in the body for reinforcement. See the in-situ growth process of a composite materials of ceramics.

explanation_cn: 指硅晶体中自间隙硅原子浓度过高时导致的位错和层错等缺陷。硅晶体中主要的是漩涡缺陷(swirl-defect),是最早被发现的硅单晶微缺陷，经择优腐蚀显现后在硅片表面呈现类似漩涡状的图案。因而称为漩涡缺陷。其中较大的swirl-defect,称为A-swirl，较小的称为B-swirl。A-swirl是由于过饱和的自间隙原子聚集所产生的位错环，这种位错环虽然不会影响器件栅极氧化层的完整性，但会导致载流子寿命的下降、p-n结反向漏电流的增大和局部微等离子击穿。当自间隙原子浓度较低时，有可能聚集形成较小的缺陷，即B-swirl。
explanation_en: Defects such as dislocations and stacking faults caused by high concentration of self interstitial silicon atoms in silicon crystals. The main part of silicon crystal is swirl defect, which is the first discovered silicon single crystal micro defect. After preferential etching, it appears on the surface of silicon wafer with a vortex like pattern. Therefore, it is called swirl defect. The larger swirl defect is called A-swirl, and the smaller one is called B-swirl. A-swirl is a dislocation loop generated by the aggregation of supersaturated self gap atoms. Although this dislocation loop will not affect the integrity of the device grid oxide layer, it will lead to the decline of carrier life, the increase of p-n junction reverse leakage current and local microplasma breakdown. When the concentration of self interstitial atoms is low, it is possible to aggregate and form smaller defects, namely B-swirl.

explanation_cn: 橡胶在界面处发生互相的渗透作用或分子的自行扩张作用，导致胶融合为一体的性质。胶料的自黏件对成型加工和制品的产品质量起着重要作用。例如轮胎、自行车胎成型、夹布胶管成型及接头、硫化制品的结合面处容易裂开等均与自黏性有关。依伏尤斯基的学说当无定形的橡胶相互接触时，由于橡胶是线型分子，不存在互溶问题，仅在界面处发生互相的渗透作用或分子的自行扩张作用。分子扩散的结果，使两块生胶成为一个整体，视为"分子扩散学"。胶黏与自黏的主要区别是，自黏是由于相同大分子的扩散，而胶黏是由于两种不同大分子的扩散。因此，自黏吋以看作是胶黏的特殊情况，即同种类的大分子的扩散。扩散理论的特点是，它建立在高聚物的最本质的特性上，这些特性包括高聚物的链状结构、分子的微布朗运动。
explanation_en: Rubber has mutual penetration or self expansion of molecules at the interface, which leads to the property of rubber fusion. The self-adhesive components of rubber play an important role in forming, processing, and product quality. For example, self adhesion is related to tire, bicycle tire molding, cloth hose molding and joints, and the easy cracking of the junction surface of vulcanization products. According to Evyusky's theory, when amorphous rubber contacts with each other, because rubber is a linear molecule, there is no mutual solubility problem, and only mutual penetration or self expansion of molecules occur at the interface. As a result of molecular diffusion, the two pieces of crude rubber become a whole, which is regarded as "molecular diffusion". The main difference between stickiness and self-adhesion is that self-adhesion is due to the diffusion of the same macromolecule, while stickiness is due to the diffusion of two different macromolecule. Therefore, the self adhesion time is regarded as a special case of adhesive, that is, the diffusion of macromolecule of the same kind. The characteristic of diffusion theory is that it is based on the most essential characteristics of polymers, including the chain structure of polymers and the micro Brownian motion of molecules.

explanation_cn: 见出模膨胀。
explanation_en: See die swell.

explanation_cn: 材料（主要指橡胶及其制品）在模拟、强化大气臭氧条件作用下产生的各种变化，臭氧是化学活性极高的物质.较分子氧更容易1-j含双键的聚合物发生反应。不饱和聚合物在应力作用下.遇臭氧易被氧化，产生与应力方向相垂直的裂纹.即臭氧龟裂。它是不饱和橡胶及其制品在室外使用产生的一种最常见、摄严重的老化现象。臭氧老化是将试样暴露于密闭尤光照的含有恒定臭氧浓度的空气和恒温的试验箱中.按预定时间对试样进行检测，从试样表面发生的龟裂或其他性能的变化程度.评定试样的耐臭氧老化性能.通常利用臭氧加速橡胶材料的老化和应力开裂，来表征橡胶材料的耐老化性能。橡胶材料测量时，通常给予一定的拉伸形变以加速老化。根据ASTMD114~M999和ASTMD1171-1999,给予橡胶样条20%的拉伸，并置于压力为25~200mPa的臭氧箱中24h后，通过观察橡胶表面出现裂纹的时间和裂纹的数目.来评价橡胶材料的耐老化性能。臭氧老化是快速评定橡胶耐老化性能的重要手段之一.对研究橡胶的防老化体系.提高制品的使用寿命有较大的指导意义。
explanation_en: Materials (mainly referring to rubber and its products) produce various changes under the condition of simulating and strengthening atmospheric ozone. Ozone is a substance with high chemical activity. Compared with molecular oxygen, it is easier for 1-j polymer containing double bonds to react. Under the action of stress, unsaturated polymer is easy to be oxidized when encountering ozone, resulting in cracks perpendicular to the phase of the stress direction, namely ozone cracking. It is the most common and serious aging phenomenon of unsaturated rubber and its products when used outdoors. Ozone aging is to expose the sample to air containing constant ozone concentration and constant temperature test chamber under airtight special light. Test the sample according to the scheduled time. Evaluate the ozone aging resistance of the sample from the cracking or other performance changes on the surface of the sample. Generally, ozone is used to accelerate the aging and stress cracking of rubber materials to characterize the aging resistance of rubber materials. When measuring rubber materials, a certain tensile deformation is usually given to accelerate aging. According to ASTMD114~M999 and ASTMD1171-1999, 20% of the rubber spline was stretched and placed in an ozone box with a pressure of 25~200mPa for 24h. The aging resistance of rubber materials was evaluated by observing the time and number of cracks on the surface of rubber. Ozone aging is one of the important means to quickly evaluate the aging resistance of rubber, which has great guiding significance for the research of aging prevention system of rubber and the improvement of service life of products.

explanation_cn: 单分散性高分子凝胶渗透色谱曲线的宽度大于理论零宽度的现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that the width of monodisperse polymer gel permeation chromatography curve is greater than the theoretical zero width.

explanation_cn: 在烧结过程中，使烧结体获得最大的致密程度。烧结在表观上是指粉来烧结过程的收缩，可以用试样的线收缩、体积收缩和孔隙度的减少作为表征参数。致密化是改善粉末冶金材料和制品性能的关键。压制成形后经过烧结虽然可以改善致密化程度.但对粉未冶金性能的提高是有限的。因此发展了全致密工艺，是将压力和温度同时并用，已达到消除孔隙的目的。许多粉末冶金材料，经过完全致密化处理，其性能比锻材更为优异。常用的致密化工艺有：常规烧结、熔浸、热压、热等静压、热挤、热轧、粉末锻造等。
explanation_en: In the sintering process, the sintering body gets the maximum density. Sintering refers to the shrinkage of sintering process of powder superficially, and the linear shrinkage, volume shrinkage and porosity reduction of samples can be used as characterization parameters. Densification is the key to improve the properties of powder metallurgy materials and products. Although the densification degree can be improved by sintering after pressing, the improvement of unmetallic properties of powders is limited. Therefore, a fully dense process has been developed, which combines pressure and temperature to achieve the goal of eliminating pores. Many powder metallurgy materials, after full densification treatment, have better properties than forgings. Common densification processes include conventional sintering, infiltration, hot pressing, hot isostatic pressing, hot extrusion, hot rolling, power forging, etc.

explanation_cn: 低温推进剂密度较低。提高低温推进剂的密度有三条途径：将低温推进剂进一步冷冻，形成浆氢或浆氧;低温推进剂中加入胶凝剂，成为胶体低温推进剂，如胶氢;结合浆氢技术和胶氢技术，形成凝胶浆氢。
explanation_en: Cryogenic propellant has low density. There are three ways to increase the density of cryogenic propellant: further freezing the cryogenic propellant to form slurry hydrogen or slurry oxygen; The cryogenic propellant is added with gelling agent to become colloidal cryogenic propellant, such as gelled hydrogen; Combining slurry hydrogen technology and gel hydrogen technology, gel slurry hydrogen is formed.

explanation_cn: 又称堆操密度,表示晶体中原子或离子在空间堆垛的紧密程度通常以单位晶胞中原子或离子所占体枳与晶胞体积之比来表示。也即晶体结构中单位体积中原子或离子所占的体积。
explanation_en: It is also called stacking density, which means that the compactness of atoms or ions in crystal in space is usually expressed by the ratio of the volume of atoms or ions in unit unit cell of crystal to the volume of unit cell of crystal. That is, the volume of atoms or ions per unit volume in the crystal structure.

explanation_cn: 以为主要成分的致密耐火制品，耐玻璃熔液特别是无碱玻璃液的侵蚀性强。主要用于无碱玻璃纤维、化学玻璃纤维熔渣，不能用于碱性熔渣部位，因为会产生有毒的物质。
explanation_en: Dense refractory products, which are the main components, have strong corrosion resistance to glass melt, especially alkali free glass melt. It is mainly used for alkali free glass fiber and chemical glass fiber slag. It cannot be used for alkaline slag because it will produce toxic substances.

explanation_cn: 指物质或材料作用于机体后不足以引起机体免疫系统的反应，却能使其对特定的刺激物产生更为强大的生理响应的能力。如小剂量的脂质炎症因子提高炎性细胞对炎症介质的敏感性，从而增强炎性细胞的浸润和吞噬等功能。
explanation_en: It refers to the ability of a substance or materials to produce a stronger physiological response to a specific irritation when it is not enough to cause the response of the immune system after acting on the body. Low doses of lipid inflammatory factors increase the sensitivity of inflammatory cells to inflammatory mediators, thereby enhancing the infiltration and phagocytic function of inflammatory cells.

explanation_cn: 是指某种因素（化学因素、物理因素、生物因素及材料因素）引起发育中的胎体发生永久性的结构或功能异常的不良反应产生畸形胚胎的能力，鉴定环境因素对哺乳动物致畸性的标准试验为哺乳动物试验。鉴定对人类的必须进行人群的流行病学调查。
explanation_en: It refers to the ability of some factors (chemical factors, physical factors, biological factors and materials factors) to cause permanent structural or functional abnormalities of the developing fetus to produce deformed embryos. The standard test for identifying the teratogenicity of environmental factors on mammals is the mammalian test. An epidemiological survey of the population is necessary for human identification.

explanation_cn: 指受试动物在其寿命的大部分时期里，一次或多次接触受试物后，该受试物诱导受试动物形成肿瘤的能力和趋势。具有的受试物又称致癌因子。致癌因子主要有三大类：化学性、物理性、生物性。化学性致癌因子如烷化剂、多环芳香烃类化合物、硝胺类及有关化合物、霉菌毒素等。物理性致癌因子如电离辐射、紫外线及异物刺激等。生物性致癌因子主要是病毒、细菌和寄生虫等。生物材料的尽管在临床极少见，但在动物实验中却屡见不鲜。可能与以下因素相关：植入材料在生物老化过程中释放致癌物质;植入材料被致癌物质污染;纤维包膜增厚，导致局部组织代谢障碍代谢产物长期积蓄，细胞发生突变的可能性增加;植入物的表面形状，粉末状或海绵状的材料几乎不会发牛恶性肿瘤，纤维状的材料也很少发生，只有表面光滑的材料才容易发生。因此在材料的选择和应用上避免使用可能产生刺激性乃至有毒可溶物质的材料，尽可能使用表面粗糙的材料，植入时尽量减少材料与组织的间隙等。
explanation_en: Refers to the ability and trend of a test animal to induce tumor formation during most of its lifespan after one or more exposure to the test substance. The tested substance is also known as a carcinogen. There are three main categories of carcinogenic factors: chemical, physical, and biological. Chemical carcinogens such as alkylating agents, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, nitroamines and related compounds, fungal toxins, etc. Physical carcinogenic factors, such as ionizing radiation, ultraviolet ray and foreign body irritation. Biological carcinogens mainly include viruses, bacteria, and parasites. Although biomaterials are extremely rare in clinical practice, they are not uncommon in animal experiments. It may be related to the following factors: implantation materials release carcinogens during biological aging; Implantation materials is contaminated by carcinogens; Thickening of the fibrous capsule leads to long-term accumulation of metabolic products in local tissues, increasing the possibility of cell mutations; The surface shape of implants: powder or sponge like materials are almost free of bovine malignant tumors, and fibrous materials are also rare. Only smooth materials are easy to occur. Therefore, in the selection and application of materials, materials that may produce irritant or even toxic soluble substances should be avoided, materials with rough surface should be used as far as possible, and the gap between materials and tissues should be minimized during implantation.

explanation_cn: 是以甲基丙烯酸甲酯为主要原料，加入少量助剂，在引发剂作用 下，经本体聚合制得的透明板材。按组成可以分为增塑、未增塑、共聚及交联等航空有机玻璃；按加工方式可分成浇注板、定向板及研磨抛光板；按性能可以分为丙烯酸酯塑料板、耐热丙烯酸酯塑料板、改性丙烯酸酯塑料板等。
explanation_en: It is a transparent plate made by bulk polymerization of methyl methacrylate as the main raw material, adding a small amount of additive, under the action of initiator. According to composition, it can be divided into plasticized, unplasticized, copolymerized and crosslinking aircaft acrylic sheet; According to the processing method, it can be divided into casting plate, directional plate and grinding polishing plate; According to performance, it can be divided into acrylate plastics board, heat-resistant acrylate plastics board, modified acrylate plastics board, etc.

explanation_cn: 伸直链晶片上附生许多折叠链晶片且折叠链晶片方向基本平行于伸直链晶片轴向的晶体结构。
explanation_en: Crystal structure in which many folded-chain lamella are attached to the extended chain chips and the direction of folded-chain lamella is basically parallel to the axial direction of the extended chain chips.

explanation_en: The interaction parameters between the solvent with strong solubility to macromolecule solute and macromolecule solute is less than 0.5.

explanation_cn: 在三色系统中，任何一种颜色的色刺激可用适当数量的三个原色的色刺激相匹配.每一原色的刺激量与原色刺激总量的比.称为该种色的色品坐标。
explanation_en: In the three color system, the color irritation of any color can be matched with an appropriate number of color irritation of three primary colors. The ratio of the irritation amount of each primary color to the total irritation amount of the primary color is called the chromaticity coordinate of the color.

explanation_cn: 透明晶体中产生光学吸收带的类原子或电子缺陷。它是许多材料中的一个普遍现象，包括碱金属卤化物，碱土金属氟化物，金属氧化物等。
explanation_en: Atomic like or electronic defects in transparent crystal that produce optical absorption bands. It is a common phenomenon in many materials, including alkali metal halides, alkaline earth metal fluorides, metal oxides, etc.

explanation_cn: 指能在沉淀剂作用下沉淀并转化为不溶于水的颜料的一类水溶性染料。许多水溶性的有机染料.可借助某些方法形成与该染料颜色基本相同的沉淀，用作颜料，称为色淀。纯的色淀色泽鲜艳，着色力高.使用少量即可调制其他颜料的色彩，不溶于普通溶剂，耐晒性强。色淀用于油墨、文教用品、橡胶、塑料及食品的着色。将色淀染料转变为色淀时.可使色淀附着在氢氧化铝、硫酸钡、硫酸钙等金属盐载体上，以提高产品的遮盖力。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of water-soluble dye or dyestuffc that can be precipitated and converted into water-insoluble pigment under the action of precipitant. Many water-soluble organic dye or dyestuffc can form precipitation with the same color as the dye or dyestuffc by some methods, which can be used as pigment, called color lakes. Pure lake has bright color and high tinting power. It can be used to modulate the color of other pigment with a small amount. It is insoluble in ordinary solvents and has strong light resistance. The lake is used for coloring ink, stationery, rubber, plastics and food. When lake dyes is transformation into a lake, the lake can be attached to metal salt carriers such as aluminum hydroxide, barium sulfate, calcium sulfate, etc. to improve the covering power of the product.

explanation_cn: 一个光源发射光的颜色的色品坐标与某一温度的黑体发射光的颜色的色品坐标相同，这个黑体的温度就称为该光源的颜色温度。
explanation_en: The chromaticity coordinate of the color of the light emitted from a light source is the same as the chromaticity coordinate of the color of the light emitted from a blackbody at a certain temperature. The temperature of the blackbody is called the color temperature of the light source.

explanation_cn: 含有颜料的一类涂料的总称.能在被涂物表面形成具保护装饰或特殊性能的带色漆膜。
explanation_en: A generic term for a class of coatings containing pigment. It can form a colored paint film with protective decoration or special performance on the surface of the coated object.

explanation_cn: 指树脂类牙科材料在寇腔环境中能够保持其颜色的性能，国际上检测色稳定性通常采用的方法是以色温范围5000~7000K的氙灯为光源。
explanation_en: It refers to the ability of resin dental materials to maintain their color in the cavity environment. The international method for testing colour stability is to use a xenon lamp with a color-temperature range of 5000-7000K as the light source.

explanation_cn: 在化学纤维生产过程中加入适当的着色剂，使其均匀分散在纺丝原液或熔体中，经纺丝成型后，着色剂即分尔在纤维中，称纺前着色或原液着色；所得纤维即称为色纺纤维、着色纤维或纺前染色纤维等。
explanation_en: In the production process of man-made fiber, appropriate colorant is added to make it evenly dispersed in the spinning stock solution or melt. After spinning and forming, colorant is divided into fibers, which is called pre spinning coloring or stock solution coloring; The resulting fibers are called colored spun fibers, colored fibers, or pre dyed fibers.

explanation_cn: 用搪瓷制成的各种艺术品的统称，包括景泰蓝、绘图釉、浮雕釉、凹凸釉等。
explanation_en: A general term for various artworks made of enamel, including cloisonne, glaze for drawing, relief glaze, concave convex glaze, etc.

explanation_cn: 含水的简单岛状结构硫酸盐矿物。单斜晶系，晶体呈短柱状、针状或板状；依(001)成穿插双晶或依(100)成接触双晶；集合体呈致密块状或纤维状、皮壳状等。纯者透明无色，有时呈白色或浅黄、浅绿等色。条痕白色，玻璃光泽解理U00}完全。莫氏硬度1.5-2,性脆，密度1.49g/cm3,味凉而微带苦咸，极易溶于水。产于干涸盐湖的化学沉积物中，与石膏、石盐、泻利盐、无水芒硝等共生。是提取苏打、制作玻璃的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Sulfate minerals with a simple island like structure containing water. Monocline system, crystal is in short column, needle or plate shape; According to (001), twin is interpenetrated or according to (100), twin is contacted; Aggregates are dense block like, fibrous, or shell like. Pure ones are transparent and colorless, sometimes appearing in white, light yellow, light green, and other colors. Streaks are white, and glass luster cleavage U00} is complete. Mohs hardness is 1.5-2, brittle, and density is 1.49g/cm3. It tastes cool and slightly bitter and salty, and is very soluble in water. It is produced in the chemical sediments of dry salt lakes and coexists with gypsum, halite, epsomite, thenardite, etc. It is the raw mineral material for extracting soda and making glass.

explanation_cn: 核燃料元件在堆内运行期间芯块和包壳的相互作用。它导致燃料元件破损，这种破损有两种机制：机械的和化学的。包壳破损的机械机制是包壳内存在过高的应力集中和过度应变。燃料元件在堆内运行一定时间后，芯块与包壳之间的间隙闭合，包壳跟随芯块变形，由于芯热膨胀大于包壳，功率循环过程中，包壳内可能会产生轴向轮变形;若中间层将包壳和芯块黏结在一起，芯块中的径向裂纹容易扩展到包壳上去。运行中元件径向可能产生竹节状变形，形成环脊造成包壳局部过应变。包壳破损的化学机制是包壳内游离碘低温下在包壳内引起应力腐蚀裂纹。包壳的碘应力腐蚀裂纹有一线功率密度阈值，此阈值随燃耗增加而下降。这两种机制结合起来构成了包壳脆性应力破损条件。影响PCI破损的因素有：芯块密度和形状，功率密度和功率提升速率，包壳性能和燃耗等。克服PCI破损的方法有：包壳内表面加衬里或涂层减小功率峰值，降低燃料棒平均线功率密度，强化包壳管，燃料棒充氦预加压以及运行中限制功率提升速率等。
explanation_en: Interaction between pellet and cladding during operation of nuclear fuel element in reactor. It causes fuel element damage, which has two mechanisms: mechanical and chemical. The mechanical mechanism of cladding failure is that there are too high stress concentration and excessive strain in the cladding. After the fuel element operates in the reactor for a certain time, the gap between the pellet and the cladding is closed, and the cladding deforms with the pellet. As the core thermal expansion is greater than the cladding, the axial wheel deformation may occur in the cladding during the power cycle; If the intermediate layer binds the cladding and the core block together, radial cracks in the core block are easily extended to the cladding. During operation, the radial deformation of the components may result in bamboo like deformation, forming a ring ridge and causing local overstrain of the cladding. The chemical mechanism of cladding damage is that the free iodine in the cladding causes stress corrosion cracks in the cladding at low temperature. The iodine stress corrosion crack of the cladding has a linear power density threshold, which decreases with the increase of fuel consumption. The combination of these two mechanisms constitutes the brittle stress failure condition of the cladding. The factors affecting PCI failure include pellet density and shape, power density and power increase rate, cladding performance and burnup. The methods to overcome PCI damage include: lining or coating the inner surface of the cladding to reduce the power peak, reducing the average linear power density of the fuel rod, strengthening the cladding tube, pre pressurizing the fuel rod with helium, and limiting the power increase rate during operation.

explanation_cn: 一种结晶粗大的酸性侵入岩。化学成分及矿物组成与花岗岩相当，但暗色矿物含量较少，而富含具有挥发成分或稀有元素的矿物，如白云母、黄玉、电气石、绿柱石等。
explanation_en: A coarse crystalline acidic intrusive rocks. The chemical composition and mineral composition are equivalent to that of granite, but the content of dark minerals is less, and minerals with volatile components or rare elements are rich, such as muscovilte, topaz, tourmaline, beryl, etc.

explanation_cn: 一种酸性侵入岩。是一种分布很广的岩石，主要矿物为石英、碱性长石和酸性斜长石，暗色矿物以黑云母为主，有时出现角闪石和白云母。
explanation_en: An acid intrusive rocks. It is a widely distributed rock. The main minerals are quartze, alkaline feldspar and acid plagioclase. The dark minerals are mainly biotite, sometimes amphibole and muscovilte appear.

explanation_cn: 一种具有斑状结构的酸性浅成侵入岩。化学成分及矿物组成与花岗岩相当，成因、产出及分布与花岗岩关系密切。
explanation_en: An acidic hypabyssal intrusive rocks with porphyritic texture. The chemical composition and mineral composition are equivalent to granite, and the genesis, occurrence and distribution are closely related to granite.

explanation_cn: 一种中酸性侵入岩。它是花岗岩类向闪长岩类过渡的中间类型岩石。多为粗粒状，半自形粒状结构，似斑状结构，块状构造。
explanation_en: A kind of intermediate acid intrusive rocks. It is an intermediate type rock from granite to diorite. Most of them are coarse grained, semi euhedral granular structure, like porphyritic texture and massive structure.

explanation_cn: 又称网纹钢板。表面带有凸起（或凹陷）花纹的钢板。花纹可以是单一的菱形、扁豆形或圆豆形，也可以由两种或两种以上花纹适当地组合成为组合型花纹板。
explanation_en: Also known as checkered steel plate. Steel plate with raised (or concave) pattern on the surface. The pattern can be a single diamond, lentil, or round bean shape, or can be appropriately combined by two or more patterns to form a combined pattern board.

name_cn: 芳基乙炔树脂基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以芳基乙炔（PAA)树脂为基体的复合材料。PAA树脂是指由乙炔基（通常为端乙炔基）芳烃为单体共聚而成的聚合物。固化时无挥发物和低分子量副产物逸出，固化后产物通常呈高度交联结构，耐高温性能十分优异，热解成炭率极高，收缩率较低；但是炔基活性高，交联固化反应迅速并放出大量的热，易控制不当出现爆聚。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on aryl acetylene (PAA) resin. PAA resin refers to a polymer formed by copolymerization of acetylene (usually acetylene terminated) aromatics as monomer. During curing, no volatile matter and low molecular weight by-products escape. After curing, the products are usually highly crosslinking, with excellent high temperature resistance, high pyrolysis carbon yield and low shrinkage; However, due to high alkynyl activity, rapid curing reaction of crosslinking and a large amount of heat release, it is easy to cause detonation polymerization if not properly controlled.
