explanation_en: See poly (m-phenylene isophthalamide) resin.

explanation_cn: 商品名凯芙拉（Kevlar)、特瓦论（Twaron)I和德尔纶（Terlon)，是由对苯二甲酸或二酰氯与对苯二胺缩聚并纺丝所得的芳酰胺纤维。芳纶1414有极高的强度，是优质钢材的5?6倍，模量是钢材或玻璃纤维的2?3倍，韧性i是钢材的2倍，而质量仅为钢材的1/5。其中Kev-lar29、49的密度均为L44g/Cm:i,拉伸强度约为I2810MPa,断裂伸长率分別约为3.6%、2.5%,拉伸模量约为63300MPa、126600MPa。纤维的玻璃化转变温度和分解温度各为240°C和500?570°C,最高使用温度为250°C,冲击强度和冲击吸收能高，其复合材料对高速子弹的防护性好，耐酸、碱、有机溶剂和海水的腐蚀。耐磨性优良，但耐疲劳性稍差。用于轮胎、胶带、胶管的骨架材料，热固性和热塑性树脂及金属铝的复合材料.光缆增强芯，防弹背心.体育用品，摩擦材料与代石棉用品，代钢筋的环氧树脂浸i渍材料和增强混凝土的短切纤维，防切割和防穿刺工作服和手套，与其他抗燃或阻燃纤维如聚丙烯腈预氧化丝或聚间苯二甲酰间苯二胺纤维混纺制成防火服，工业帆布及缆绳类等。制作火箭发动机壳体、高速离心机转筒、高压容器、防弹头盔、坦克复合装甲、导弹发射筒、蜂窝结构材料、火车闸瓦、汽车刹车片、子午胎、高压软管、飞机和船舶的型线形结构材料、网球拍、矿山运输带、汽车离合器等。
explanation_en: The trade names Kevlar, Twaron I, and Terlon are aromatic amide fibers obtained by condensation and spinning of terephthalic acid or diacyl chloride with p-phenylenediamine. Poly (p-phenylene terephthalamide) fiber has extremely high strength, which is 5% of high-quality steel product? 6 times, the modulus is 2? Of steel product or glass fiber? 3 times, the toughness i is twice that of steel product, and the mass is only 1/5 of that of steel product. The density of Kev lar29 and 49 is L44g/Cm: i, the tensile strength is about I2810MPa, the percentage elongation after fracture is about 3.6% and 2.5%, and the tensile modulus is about 63300MPa and 126600MPa. The glass transition temperature and decomposition temperature of the fiber are 240 ° C and 500 ° C respectively? 570 ° C, maximum service temperature 250 ° C, high impact strength and impact absorption energy, its composite materials has good protection against high-speed bullets, and is resistant to acid, alkali, organic solvents and seawater corrosion. Wear resistance is good, but fatigue resistance is slightly poor. It is used as the framework materials of tires, tapes, rubber hoses, thermosetting and thermoplastic resin, and metal aluminum composite materials, optical cable reinforcement cores, bulletproof vests, sporting goods, friction materials and asbestos substitutes, epoxy resin impregnating materials and short cut fibers of reinforced concrete, cutting and puncture resistant overalls and gloves, It is blended with other flame resistant or flame retardant fiber such as polyacrylonitrile pre oxidized fiber or poly (m-phenylene isophthalamide) fiber to make fireproof clothing, industrial canvas and cable. Make rocket engine shells, high-speed centrifuge barrels, high-pressure containers, bulletproof helmets, tank composite armor, missile launchers, honeycomb structural materials, train brake shoes, automobile brake pads, radial tires, high-pressure hoses, linear structural materials for aircraft and ships, tennis rackets, mine transport belts, automobile clutches, etc.

name_cn: 芳香族硝基化合物炸药
explanation_cn: 芳香族化合物分子中含有碳-硝基的炸药，通常将其看作是芳环母体分子中的氢原子被硝基取代后生成的衍生物。安定性好，感度较低，能量适中，原料来源广泛，制造方便，成本低廉，是目前用量最大、用途最广的一类单质炸药。
explanation_en: The explosive containing carbon nitro group in the aromatic compound molecule is usually regarded as a derivative formed after the hydrogen atom in the aromatic ring parent molecule is replaced by nitro group. With good stability, low sensitivity, moderate energy, wide source of raw materials, convenient manufacturing and low cost, it is the single explosive with the largest amount of use and the most widely used at present.

explanation_cn: 又称聚芳酰胺。聚酰胺分子链骨架上含有芳香环结构的均属于芳香族聚酰胺，主要包括两类：半芳香族聚酰胺和全芳香族聚酰胺，在脂肪族聚酰胺主链上部分引入芳香环的为半芳香族聚酰胺，由芳香族二酸和芳香族二胺得到的聚酰胺为全芳香族聚酰胺。
explanation_en: It is also called polyarylamide. Those with aromatic ring structure on the molecular chain skeleton of polyamide belong to aromatic polyamide, mainly including two types: semi aromatic polyamide and all aromatic polyamide. Those with partial introduction of aromatic ring on the main chain of aliphatic polyamide are semi aromatic polyamide, and those obtained from aromatic diacid and aromatic diamine are all aromatic polyamide.

explanation_cn: 碳酸氢钠（sodium bicarbonate），也称为小苏打或小苏打粉。化学上，它的分子式为NaHCO3。碳酸氢钠是一种碱性化合物，呈白色固体粉末状，可溶于水。
explanation_en: Sodium bicarbonate, also known as small soda or small soda powder. Chemically, its molecular formula is NaHCO3. Sodium bicarbonate is an alkaline compound in the form of white solid powder and soluble in water.

explanation_cn: 又称重碳钠盐。一种链状碳酸盐矿物。单斜晶系。晶体呈板状或柱状，白色或灰色，玻璃光泽。解。奠氏硬度2.5-3,密度2.21g/m3,易溶于水.加热放出C()2。产于盐湖、矿泉里与水碱、天然碱、无水芒硝、单斜钠钙石等共生。是制碱工业的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Weigh the sodium carbonate again. A chain like carbonate mineral. Monoclinic system. Crystal is plate or column, white or gray, glass luster. Solution. Dien hardness 2.5-3, density 2.21g/m3, easily soluble in water. Heat to release C () 2. It is produced in salt lakes and mineral springs and coexists with thermonatrite, trona, thenardite, monoclinic sodalite, etc. It is the raw mineral material of the soda industry.

explanation_cn: 矿物名为硅铁锂钠石。]单晶罕见，常为半自形粒状集合体。红紫色、蓝紫色，有时在色带和色斑上呈现几种不同色调,，也常呈黄褐色、浅粉红色和黑色但是这些很少用于珠宝首饰。蜡状光泽至玻璃光泽。无解理，不平坦状断口。莫氏硬度5.5-6.5，密度2.74g/cm3。一般呈半透明到不透明.常含黑色、褐色和蓝色线状的含锰包裹体。宝石级苏纪石呈明亮的半透明状.与优质玉髓相似，可用于切磨弧面宝石、珠子和雕件。
explanation_en: The mineral is called ferrosilicon sodalite.] Single crystal is rare, and it is often a semi idiomorphic granular aggregate. Red purple, blue purple, sometimes appearing in several different tones on the color bands and spots, often appearing in yellow brown, light pink, and black, but these are rarely used in jewelry. Waxy luster to glass luster. No cleavage, uneven fracture surface. Mohs hardness 5.5-6.5, density 2.74g/cm3. Generally appearing semi transparent to opaque, often containing black, brown, and blue linear manganese containing inclusions. Gems grade sugilite is bright and translucent, similar to high-quality chalcedony, and can be used to cut and grind curved gems, beads and carvings.

explanation_cn: 学名2.4,6-三硝基苯酚钾，缩写KP。分子量267。苦味酸钾外观为黄色棒状结晶，加晶形控制剂合成为颗粒状结晶。其制备由苦味酸溶液与氢氧化钾溶液反应生成，如果在反应中加人晶形控制剂，可以生成颗粒状的苦味酸钾。安定性：①具有良好的物理化学安定性；②lOO°C加热试验，第一个48h失重0.13%。相容性：与硝化棉、611药、斯蒂芬酸铅、铁、铝、紫铜、镍铜、镍钢相容。苦味酸钾可作为耐温的单体点火药和延期药。亦可与PETN、RDX或HMX混合成为高精度的延期药以及高能热桥丝雷管装药。
explanation_en: Scientific name 2.4,6-trinitrophenol potassium, abbreviated as KP. Molecular weight 267. The appearance of potassium picrate is yellow rod crystal, which is synthesized into granular crystal by adding crystal shape control agent. It is prepared by reacting picric acid solution with potassium hydroxide solution. If crystal shape control agent is added in the reaction, granular potassium picrate can be generated. Stability: ① Good physical chemistry stability; ② Heating test at OO ° C, with a weight loss of 0.13% in the first 48 hours. Compatibility: compatible with nitrocellulose, 611 medicine, lead styphnate, iron, aluminum, purple copper, nickel copper, nickel steel. Potassium picrate can be used as temperature resistant monomer ignition propellant and delay composition. It can also be mixed with PETN, RDX or HMX to form high-precision delay composition and high-energy thermal bridge wire detonator charge.

explanation_cn: 苯乙烯-丙烯腈共聚物，又称AS树脂，是无色透明的热塑性树脂，具有耐高温性、出色的光泽度和耐化学介质性，还有优良的硬度、刚性、尺寸稳定性和较高的承载能力，是以丙烯腈和苯乙烯为原料用悬浮法聚合而得到的，使用热引发剂引发亦可，也可采用乳液聚合法制得，由于该树脂固有的透明性，故用于制造透明塑料制品。
explanation_en: Styrene acrylonitrile copolymer, also known as as resin, is a colorless and transparent thermoplastic resin, which has high temperature resistance, excellent glossiness and chemical resistance, as well as excellent hardness, rigidity, dimensional stability and high bearing capacity. It is obtained by suspension polymerization with acrylonitrile and styrene as raw materials. It can be initiated by thermal initiator or emulsion polymerization. Because of the inherent transparency of this resin, Therefore, it is used to manufacture transparent plastics products.

name_cn: 苯乙烯改性乙烯酯树脂
explanation_cn: 苯乙烯改性的乙烯酯不饱和聚酯树脂。用于浸溃玻璃布后采用叠铺成型制造玻璃钢层压材料。
explanation_en: Styrene modified vinyl ester unsaturated polyester resin. It is used to make glass fiber reinforced plastic laminated materials after soaking glass cloth and adopting the stacking forming method.

name_cn: 苯乙烯类热塑性弹性体
explanation_cn: 苯乙烯类热塑性弹性体(苯乙烯类TPES)，热塑性弹性体的主要种类中，苯乙烯类热塑性弹性体(或苯乙烯嵌段共聚物)是应用最广泛的一种，因为它们能与许多材料混合，如填料、增量剂、改性剂和其它树脂等。
explanation_en: Styrenic thermoplastic elastomers (Styrene type TPES). Among the main types of thermoplastic elastomers, styrenic thermoplastic elastomers (or styrene block copolymer) is the most widely used one, because they can be mixed with many materials, such as fillers, extenders, modifiers and other resin.

explanation_cn: 苯基三氯硅烷，是一种有机化合物，为无色可燃液体， 溶于苯、乙醚、全氯乙烯。用作制造聚硅氧烷的中间体及制取苯基硅树脂。
explanation_en: Phenyl trichlorosilane is an organic compound, which is a colorless flammable liquid and is soluble in benzene, ether and perchloroethylene. It is used as an intermediate for manufacturing polysiloxane and for preparing phenyl silicone resin.

explanation_cn: 苯胺与甲醛的缩聚物。苯胺甲醛树脂，在强酸介质中(PH小于4),当苯胺与甲醛摩尔比为1:1或甲醛稍过量时,则生成对-氨基苯甲醛,并能转变为对-亚甲基环苯胺,受热后都能形成树脂。其结构是对氨基甲醛构成的大分子,其中一部分以次甲基连接而成体型结构。苯胺甲醛树脂有良好的耐气候性、耐紫外线、耐水性、耐油性和耐碱性等。苯胺缩聚物化合物有很多用途,其中之一就是用来作酸性介质缓蚀剂.由于他具有优良的缓蚀性能,因此被广泛地应用于酸性介质体系中.梁瑞等人对苯胺-甲醛聚合物缓蚀剂进行了研究，结果表明合成的苯胺-甲醛聚合物具有优良缓蚀性能,并得出其适宜的应用条件。
explanation_en: A condensation polymer of aniline and formaldehyde. Aniline-formaldehyde resin, in strong acid medium (PH less than 4), when the molar ratio of aniline to formaldehyde is 1:1 or formaldehyde is slightly excessive, it will generate p-aminobenzaldehyde, which can be transformation into p-methylenecycloaniline, and can form resin after heating. Its structure is a macromolecule composed of p-aminoformaldehyde, part of which is connected with methylene to form a body structure. Aniline-formaldehyde resin has good weather resistance, UV resistance, water resistance, oil resistance and alkali resistance. Aniline condensation polymer compounds have many uses, one of which is used as corrosion inhibitor in acid media. Because of its excellent corrosion inhibition performance, it is widely used in acid media systems. Liang Rui et al. studied the aniline formaldehyde polymer corrosion inhibitor, and the results showed that the synthesized aniline formaldehyde polymer has excellent corrosion inhibition performance, and obtained its suitable application conditions.

explanation_cn: 皮革表面涂饰仅用染料着色而不用遮盖性颜料膏、具有透明涂层的较高裆次皮革。
explanation_en: The leather surface finishing is only colored with dye or dyestuffc instead of covering pigment paste. It is a high grade leather with transparent coating.

explanation_cn: 甲醛和苯酚在酸性催化剂或者碱性催化剂作用下经由缩聚制得的醇溶性酚醛树脂，当苯酚过量时，与甲醛在酸性介质存在下生成线性结构的热塑性树脂，而当甲醛过量时，在碱性条件下，苯酚与甲醛反应生成体型结构的热固性树脂。主要用作层压板、复合材料、泡沫塑料、保温材料、蜂窝结构材料以及涂料和胶黏剂等。
explanation_en: The alcohol soluble phenolic resin prepared by condensation of formaldehyde and phenol under the action of acid catalyst or alkaline catalyst will generate linear thermoplastic resin with formaldehyde in the presence of acidic medium when phenol is excessive, and thermosetting resin will be generated by reaction of phenol and formaldehyde under alkaline condition when formaldehyde is excessive. Mainly used as laminates, composite materials, foamed plastics, thermal insulation materials, honeycomb structural materials, coatings and adhesive.

explanation_cn: 主要由双环戊二烯基配位的金属络合物与助催化剂甲基铝氧烷或硼系化合物组成的一类烯烃聚合催化剂。茂金属催化剂具有催化活性高、吋适用单体多、单活性位、聚合物结构可精确控制等优点。改变茂金属配位体的结构，可以设计特制聚合物的微观结构。如二环戊二烯基二氯合锆与平基铝氧烷组成的催化剂用于乙烯聚合，活性比齐格勒催化剂高数十倍。茂金属催化剂可合成出一系列聚烯烃新产品，如茂金属聚乙烯、茂金属聚丙烯和茂金属聚苯乙烯等、间规立构聚丙烯、间规立构聚苯乙烯、环烯共聚物、旋光性低聚物、聚亚甲基环烯等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of olefin polymerization catalyst mainly composed of dicyclopentadienyl coordinated metal complexes and promoter methylaluminoxane or boron compounds. Metallocene catalyst has the advantages of high catalytic activity, multiple monomer, single active site and precise control of polymer structure. The microstructure of special polymer can be designed by changing the structure of metallocene ligand. For example, the catalyst composed of dicyclopentadienyl zirconium dichloride and flat aluminoxane is ten times more active than Ziegler catalyst for ethylene polymerization. Metallocene catalyst can synthesize a series of new polyolefin products, such as metallocene polyethylene, metallocene polypropylene and metallocene polystyrene, syndiotactic polypropylene, syndiotactic polystyrene, cycloene copolymer, optically active oligomer, polymethylene, etc.

name_cn: 茂金属线型低密度聚乙烯
explanation_cn: 见线型低密度聚乙烯。
explanation_en: See linear low density polyethylene.

explanation_cn: 具有稳定电子结构的原子或分子靠瞬时电偶极矩的感应和吸引而形成的键，由它结合的晶体称为分子晶体。一般具有满壳层结构的惰性气体，或价电子已用于形成共价键的饱和分子，其统计平均正、负电荷中心重合；但在某瞬时正、负电荷中心分离而产生瞬时电偶极矩。
explanation_en: The bond formed by the induction and attraction of the instantaneous electric dipole moment of atoms or molecules with stable electronic structure is called molecular crystal. Generally, inert gases with full shell structure or saturated molecules whose valence electrons have been used to form covalent bond have their statistical average positive and negative charge centers coincident; But at a certain moment, the separation of positive and negative charge centers produces an instantaneous electric dipole moment.

explanation_cn: 从矿山分离下来的块状物料，经外形整理加工而成的具有一定规格，可供加工饰面板材的石料。
explanation_en: A block of material separated from a mine and processed in shape, which has a certain specification and can be used for processing decorative boards.

explanation_cn: 参见焚光和磷光。
explanation_en: See Incineration and phosphorescence.

explanation_cn: 比较由同一能级向不同能级跃迁的荧光相对强度的物理量。从能级均向几个低能级跃迁的荧光分支比。这说明，某个跃迁的积分强度与所有的从同一高能级跃迁的积分强度总和的比值就是这个跃迁的荧光分支比。它是物质荧光光谱分析中的一个重要参量。
explanation_en: Compare the physical quantities of the relative fluorescence intensity of the transition from the same energy level to different energy level. Fluorescence branching ratio of transitions from energy level to several lower energy levels. This shows that the ratio of the integral intensity of a transition to the sum of the integral intensities of all transitions from the same high level is the fluorescence branching ratio of this transition. It is an important parameter in fluorescence spectral analysis of substances.

explanation_cn: 在某种外界作用的激发下，物体偏离原来的平衡态，当该受激物体回复到平衡态时，随之而产生具有极少量热量的光辐射过程称为荧光。荧光是物体热辐射之外的一种辐射，又称为冷光。激发停止后仍然发出的光称作磷光，如长余辉发光材料所发的光是典型的磷光。现在对荧光和磷光不作严格区别。
explanation_en: Under the excitation of some external action, the object deviates from the original equilibrium state. When the stimulated object recovery to the equilibrium state, the resulting light radiation process with a small amount of heat is called fluorescence. Fluorescence is a kind of radiation other than thermal radiation of objects, also known as cold light. The light still emitted after the excitation is stopped is called phosphorescence, for example, the light emitted by long afterglow luminescent material is typical phosphorescence. Now there is no strict distinction between fluorescence and phosphorescence and phosphorescence.

explanation_cn: 一种能吸收波长340-380nm左右的紫外线且能发射波长为400-450nm的蓝光，可有效弥补白色物质因蓝光缺损而造成的泛黄，在视觉上显著提高白色物质的白度以及亮度的助剂。由于是利用光学上的补色作用来增白，因此又可称为光学增白剂。按用途常分为：①洗涤剂用;②纺织品用荧光增白剂;③造纸用荧光增加剂;④塑料和合成材料用荧光增白剂;⑤其他用途的。按的离解性质分类，又可分为阴离子增白剂，阳离子增白剂和两性增白剂。按照化学结构可分为二苯乙烯型、香豆素型、吡唑啉型、苯并嗯唑型、苯二甲酰亚胺型五大类。
explanation_en: It is a kind of additive that can absorb ultraviolet light with a wavelength of about 340-380nm and emit blue light with a wavelength of 400-450nm, effectively compensate for yellowing of white substances due to blue light defects, and visually significantly improve the whiteness and brightness of white substances. Due to the use of optical coloring to enhance whitening, it can also be called an optical whitening agent. It is often divided into: ① detergent use; ② Fluorescent whitening agent for textiles; ③ Fluorescence additive for paper making; ④ Fluorescent whitening agent for plastics and synthetic materials; ⑤ For other purposes. Classified by their dissociation properties, they can also be divided into anionic brighteners, cationic brighteners, and amphoteric brighteners. According to chemical structure, it can be divided into five categories: stilbene type, coumarin type, pyrazoline type, benzodiazole type, and phthalimide type.

explanation_cn: 焚光强度随时间衰减规律中的特征参量<通常用r表征，当切断外界激发源后，荧光的强度随时间呈指数型衰减。这与发光一般机理中定义的受激态寿命是一致的，即发光体通过某种方式接收外来的能量而使原子(分子、离子）处于激态，而受激态原子通过自发辐射跃迁到较低受激发态或基态，故原子在受激态暂存一段时间。
explanation_en: The characteristic parameter of burning intensity decay with time<is usually characterized by r. When the external excitation source is cut off, the fluorescence intensity decays exponentially with time. This is consistent with the life of the excited state defined in the general mechanism of luminescence, that is, the luminescence body receives external energy in some way to make the atom (molecule, ion) in the excited state, while the excited atom transitions to a lower excited state or ground state through spontaneous emission, so the atom is temporarily stored in the excited state for a period of time.

explanation_cn: 在电场作用下能够将电能以荧光的形式转化为光能的有机材料。化学结构上通常具有含有发射荧光的基团（称为荧光团）以及能使吸收波长改变并伴随荧光增强的助色基团<荧光电致发光材料需要具有较高的荧光量子效率。其发光机理是：发光层中由电子、空穴复合产生的激子的能量从荧光电致发光材料的单线态激发态辐射跃迁回到基态,发出称为荧光的光。通过改变材料分子的化学结构可以得到不同发光颜色的荧光发光材料(从紫外到红外区域），其中蓝光、绿光和红光三类荧光电致发光材料被广泛地应用在有机电致发光显示器(简称OLED)中。
explanation_en: Organic materials that can convert electric energy into light energy in the form of fluorescence under the action of electric field. In chemical structure, there are usually groups containing fluorescence emitting groups (called fluorescence groups) and color groups that can change the absorption wavelength and accompany fluorescence enhancement<fluorescence electroluminescentmaterials need to have higher fluorescence quantum efficiency. Its luminescence mechanism is that the energy of the exciton generated by the composition of electrons and holes in the luminescence layer radiates from the singlet state excited state of the fluorescence electroluminescentmaterials back to the ground state, emitting light called fluorescence. By changing the chemical structure of materials molecules, fluorescence luminescence materials with different luminescence colors (from ultraviolet to infrared regions) can be obtained. Among them, blue, green and red fluorescence electroluminescentmaterials are widely used in organic luminescence displays (OLEDs for short).

explanation_cn: 在一定的激发条件下能发光的无机粉末材料，叫发光粉。按照激发方式的不同可分为光致发光材料、阴极射线致发光材料、放射线和X射线致发光材料、电致发光材料等。按基质材料分类，以硫化锌为甚质的是光致发光荧光粉，又是阴极射线、放射线、X射线激发下很有效的发光材料，也是电致发光最重要的材料之一。生产通常采用高温固相反应的工艺技术。由于造成频率展宽的物理原因不同谱线形状也不同。通常理论上简化的谱线形状有洛伦兹线形和高斯线形，相应的线宽称为洛伦兹线宽和多普勒线宽。而实际观察到的线形介于两者之间。
explanation_en: The inorganic powder materials that can luminescence light under certain excitation conditions is called luminescence powder. According to different excitation modes, it can be divided into photoneneneba luminescence materials, cathode ray luminescent powder materials, radioactive and X-ray luminescence materials, electroluminescence materials, etc. According to the classification of matrix materials, zinc sulfide is the most important kind of light luminescence phosphor. It is also an effective luminescence materials excited by cathode ray, radiation and X-ray, and is also one of the most important materials of electroluminescence. The production usually adopts the process technology of high-temperature solid-state reaction. Due to the physical reasons for frequency broadening, the shape of different spectral lines also varies. Usually, theoretically simplified spectral line shapes include Lorentz and Gaussian lines, and the corresponding line widths are called Lorentz and Doppler line widths. The actual observed line shape is between the two.

explanation_cn: 焚光频谱分布曲线上的两个半高强度点之间的频率宽度，称为谱线宽度或半值宽度，简称线宽。由于原子（分子、离子）体系的各能级存在固有宽度，也由于热运动及粒子之间的碰撞等主要因素的存在，导致辐射光谱线有一定的频率展开，使光谱中各个频率分量的强度随频率的变化呈现某种形状的分布（如图所示），称为谱线形状，描述该形状的函数叫作光谱线的线型函数。发光剂有磷光材料、荧光材料和自发光材料三种。荧光粉的加入量一般为10%-40%，施釉厚度为1.5mm左右。荧光釉的烧成温度不超过900°C。其主要特点是釉烧温度低，受光照后能发出带色的光，余晖时间长等。可应用于交通标志、疏散出口、报警及陈设陶瓷制品的装饰。
explanation_en: The frequency width between two half high intensity points on the burning spectrum distribution curve is called line width or half value width, which is called line width for short. Due to the inherent width of each energy level of the atom (molecule, ion) system, as well as the existence of major factors such as thermal movement and collision between particles, the radiation spectral line has a certain frequency expansion, so that the intensity of each frequency component in the spectrum changes with the frequency in a certain shape distribution (as shown in the figure), called the spectral line shape, and the function describing the shape is called the linear function of the spectral line. Luminescence agents include phosphorescence materials, fluorescence materials and self luminescence materials. The amount of phosphor is generally 10% -40%, and the thickness of glaze is about 1.5mm. The firing temperature of fluorescent glaze shall not exceed 900 ° C. Its main characteristics are low glaze firing temperature, the ability to emit colored light after being illuminated, and long afterglow time. It can be applied to the decoration of traffic signs, evacuation exits, alarms and ornamemal porcelain.

explanation_cn: 表征辐射系统功效大小的物理量，是激光器的重要参数。有两种表示形式，即荧光量子效率和荧光能量转换效率。荧光量子效率，定义为发射荧光的光子数与被激活物质从泵浦源吸收的光子之比。荧光转换效率取决于系统的工作物质特性、粒子数抽运方式及有关能级间的无辐射跃迁概率和辐射跃迁概率等因素。通常荧光的量子效率用相应的跃迁概率来表示。
explanation_en: The physical quantity that characterizes the effectiveness of a radiation system is an important parameter of a laser. There are two forms of expression, namely fluorescence quantum efficiency and fluorescence energy conversion efficiency. Fluorescence quantum efficiency is defined as the ratio of the number of photons emitting fluorescence to the photons absorbed by the activated substance from the pump source. The fluorescence conversion efficiency depends on the working material characteristics of the system, the pumping mode of the particle number, the nonradiative transition probability and radiative transition probability between the relevant energy level and other factors. Generally, the quantum efficiency of fluorescence is expressed by the corresponding transition probability.

explanation_cn: 具有发光功能的陶瓷制品，通过将荧光材料加入陶瓷生产过程使其具有发光功能，包括透明、长余辉等。其中长余辉指在普通陶瓷生产过程中加入长余辉光致蓄光材料从而成为具有自发光功能的陶瓷制品。除具有陶瓷的原有共性外，同时还具有在吸收可见光后于暗处自行发光的特点，这一特点使其应用范围更为广阔。
explanation_en: Ceramics products with luminescence function have luminescence function by adding fluorescence materials into ceramics production process, including transparency, long afterglow, etc. Long afterglow refers to the addition of long afterglow light emitting materials in the production process of ordinary ceramics to become ceramics with self luminescence function. In addition to the original commonness of ceramics, it also has the feature of self luminescence in the dark after absorbing visible light, which makes its application range wider.

explanation_cn: 是一类在光激发后可发出荧光的有机颜料。用于激发的光源可为紫外线或日光，具有柔和、明亮、鲜艳的色调。与普通颜料比.其明度约高一倍，但其日晒牢度较差。荧光材料用量一般仅为着色物质量的0.015%左右，由于荧光颜料耐光性较差，着色时.常常将其与色调相同的有机或无机颜料配合使用。因此塑料着色制品在使用过程中荧光着色剂发生褪色时.制品光亮度下降而色调不致发生很大变化。可分为无机和有机，主要用于塑料、油墨、染料、文教用品中以提高装饰效果，近年来也用于制作太阳能聚集材料。
explanation_en: It is a kind of organic pigment that can emit fluorescence after being excited by light. The light source used for excitation can be ultraviolet or sunlight, with soft, bright, and bright hues. Compared with ordinary pigment, its brightness is about twice as high, but its light fastness is poor. Generally, the amount of fluorescence materials is only about 0.015% of the coloring matter. Because of the poor light fastness of fluorescent pigment, it is often used together with organic or inorganic pigment with the same color tone when coloring. Therefore, when the fluorescence colorant fades during the use of plastics colored products, the brightness of the products will decline without great change in hue. It can be divided into inorganic and organic materials. It is mainly used in plastics, inks, dye or dyestuffc, stationery and educational supplies to improve the decorative effect. In recent years, it is also used to make solar energy gathering materials.

explanation_cn: 制作药物释放体系中药物载体的生物医学材料.用于储藏和控制释放药物。通常被制成骨架、膜、管、微胶囊等形态.与药物共同组成DDS,药物释放体系是新一代给药制剂，可持续（零级释放）或响应环境变化脉冲式释药，并可将药物送达病变区集中按预定程序释放。其特点是：可在理想剂量下保持长效，并减少副作用。可分为口服体系、经皮吸收体系、皮下植入体系及外部植人体系。用于药物释放的载体材料有生物降解和非降解材料两类。前者如：多糖类、多肽类及聚酰胺、聚酯、聚原酸酯和可吸收生物陶瓷等;非降解类材料有高分子材料和陶瓷材料，如乙烯-醋酸乙烯酯共聚物、聚硅氧烷弹性体、磷酸钙生物活性陶瓷、生物活性玻璃陶瓷等。对于水溶性药物，i则以聚甲基丙烯酸羟乙酯、聚乙烯基吡咯烷酮、聚乙烯醇、聚环氧乙烷及明胶、纤维素衍生物、藻蛋内酸盐为基础的水凝胶等为载体。
explanation_en: Biomedical materials used to make drug carriers in drug release systems for storing and controlling drug release. It is usually made into skeleton, membrane, tube, microcapsule and other forms. It forms DDS together with drugs. The drug release system is a new generation of drug delivery agents, which can be released continuously (zero level release) or in response to environmental changes in pulse mode, and can deliver drugs to the lesion area in a centralized manner according to the predetermined procedure. Its characteristic is that it can maintain long-term efficacy at ideal doses and reduce side effects. It can be divided into oral system, percutaneous absorption system, subcutaneous implantation system and external implant system. There are two types of carrier materials for drug release: biodegradation and non degradation materials. The former includes polysaccharide, polypeptide, polyamide, polyester, polyorthoester POE and absorbable bioceramics; Non degradation materials include macromolecule materials and ceramics materials, such as ethylene-vinylacetatecopolymer, polysiloxane elastomer, bioactiw ceramics of calcium phosphate, bioactive glass-ceramics, etc. For water-soluble drugs, i uses polyhydroxyethyl methacrylate, polyethylene pyrrolidone, polyvinyl alcohol, polyethylene oxide and gelatin, cellulose derivatives, and alginate based hydrogel as carriers.

explanation_cn: 在药物释放系统中用以负载药物并实现药物控制释放和传递等目的的材料,有机高分子材料、无机材料、金属材料以及它们的复合杂化材料都可以作为药物载体。高分子载体材料一般为具有良好生物相容性的可生物降解高分子，包括合成高分子如聚酯、聚酸酐、聚碳酸酯、聚氨基酸、聚酯醚、聚磷酸酯、聚磷腈、聚原酸酯等及其各种功能化衍生物。从仿生的角度出发，天然高分子多糖、多肽及其衍生物等由于具有良好的生物相容性日益引起关注。根据药物传递的需要，高分子的结构、组成和性质可进行设计调节：如具有亲水、疏水或两亲性质;在一定pH范围为电中性或带正负电荷：从简单的线型均聚物到具有各种结构（嵌段、接枝、星形、树形、超支化等）及具有不同化学组成的功能化产物(如引入羟基、羧基、氨基等基团）以调节优化材料的理化性能;引人各种靶向基团以赋予其器官及细胞靶向功能;引人环境敏感结构赋予其智能响应特性。除高分子材料外，其他作为药物载体的材料有较低分子量的有机物如脂质、多肽等，无机材料如碳酸钙、磷酸钙、介孔纳米硅等，金属材料如纳米金（多经表面修饰）等。此外，很多杂化材料也可作为药物载体.如高分子/无机杂化材料、高分子/金属杂化材料等。
explanation_en: Materials used in drug release system to load drugs and achieve drug controlled release and delivery, organic macromolecule materials, inorganic materials, metallic materials and their composition hybrid materials can all be used as drug carrier. Macromolecule carrier materials are generally biodegradation macromolecule with good biocompatibility, including synthetic macromolecule such as polyester, polyanhydride, polycarbonate, polyamino acid, polyester ether, polyphosphate, polyphosphazene, polyorthoester POE and various functional derivatives. From the perspective of bionics, natural polymer polysaccharides, peptides and their derivatives have attracted increasing attention due to their good biocompatibility. According to the needs of drug delivery, the structure, composition and properties of macromolecule can be designed and adjusted: for example, it has hydrophilic, hydrophobic or amphiphilic properties; Electrically neutral or negatively charged in a certain pH range: from simple linear homopolymer to functional products with various structures (block, graft, star, tree, hyperbranched, etc.) and different chemical compositions (such as the introduction of hydroxyl, carboxyl, amino and other groups) to adjust and optimize the physical and chemical properties of materials; Introduce various targeted groups to endow them with organ and cell targeting functions; Attracting environmentally sensitive structures endow them with intelligent response characteristics. In addition to macromolecule materials, other materials used as drug carrier include organic substances with lower molecular weight such as lipids, peptides, inorganic materials such as calcium carbonate, calcium phosphate, mesoporous nano silicon, and metallic materials such as nano gold (mostly surface modified). In addition, many hybrid materials can also be used as drug carrier, such as macromolecule/inorganic hybrid materials, macromolecule/metal hybrid materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称药物传输系统。指能够对药物（包括化学药物、多肽类药物、核酸类药物等）的释放速率和传递模式加以控制、调节的体系。通常由药物与载体构成目的是使药物按设计剂量和特定方式释放至特定组织、器官、细胞及细胞器.从而达到最优化的疗效。与常规给药相比，其主要优点有：在治疗允许范围内维持稳定的药物水平.延长作用时间，减少给药次数，减少血药浓度的峰谷现象.降低毒副作用.减少耐药性产生，增加药物的稳定性.特别适用于一些毒副作用较大（如抗癌药物）或易失活的药物或生物制剂（如蛋白质和多肽药物）。具有多种多样的形态，常见的有纳米及微米粒子、凝胶、纤维、薄膜等。药物释放系统可经不同途径给药，如注射、口服、透皮、吸人等。
explanation_en: Also known as a drug delivery system. A system that can control and regulate the release rate and delivery mode of drugs (including chemical drugs, peptide drugs, nucleic acid drugs, etc.). Usually composed of drugs and carriers, the purpose is to release drugs into specific tissues, organs, cells, and organelles at designed doses and in specific ways, in order to achieve optimal therapeutic effects. Compared with conventional administration, its main advantages include maintaining a stable drug level within the allowable range of treatment, prolonging the duration of action, reducing the frequency of administration, reducing the peak valley phenomenon of blood drug concentration, reducing toxic side effects, reducing drug resistance, and increasing drug stability. It is particularly suitable for some drugs or biological agents with significant toxic side effects (such as anticancer drugs) or easily inactivated (such as protein and peptide drugs). It has a variety of forms, including nano and micro particles, gel, fiber, film, etc. The drug release system can be administered through different routes, such as injection, oral administration, transdermal, inhalation, etc.

explanation_en: See welding wire.

explanation_cn: 又称高温荷重变形温度。材料在持续升温条件下，承受恒定载荷产生一定变形的温度。它表示耐火制品对高温和荷重共同作用的能力。
explanation_en: It is also called high temperature load deformation temperature. The temperature at which materials undergoes constant load and produces certain deformation under the condition of continuous temperature rise. It represents the ability of refractory products to withstand the combined effects of high temperature and load.

explanation_cn: 链状结构硅酸盐矿物。与硅线石相似，但折射率低于硅线石。自然界少见。产于高温热变质岩、火成岩的富铝捕虏体中。多见于陶瓷砖及各种高炉砖中。是优质耐火材料。
explanation_en: Chain structure silicate mineral. Similar to sillimanite, but with lower refractive index than sillimanite. Rare in nature. It occurs in aluminum rich xenoliths of high-temperature thermal metamorphic rock and igneous rocks. It is commonly found in ceramic bricks and various blast furnace bricks. It is a high-quality refractory.

explanation_cn: 以莫来石为主晶相的高铝质耐火制品。其制造方法分为熔铸法和烧结法。
explanation_en: High alumina refractory products with mullite as the main crystal phase. Its manufacturing methods are divided into melting casting method and sintering method.

explanation_cn: 以莫来石为主要成分的陶瓷。莫来石陶瓷主要有普通莫来石瓷和高纯莫来石瓷。普通莫来石瓷以铝硅酸盐系天然矿物作为主要原料，采用在烧结过程中使之莫来石化的反应烧结法或先合成莫来石后再成型、烧结方法制成。因原料纯度低，杂质贪量高，其组分除Al2O3、SiO2外，还含有Ti02、Fe2O3、CaO、MgO、Na2O、K20等杂质，因而制品中有相当数量的玻璃相，致使其力学、热学性质较差，一般应用在对温度、高温强度要求不高的场合作为一般耐火材料使用。高纯莫来石陶瓷是以高纯Al2O3粉体和高纯SiO2粉体进行反应烧结或由合成的超细高纯莫来石粉末制备的陶瓷。具有膨胀均匀、热震稳定性极好、荷重软化点高、高温蠕变值小、硬度大、抗化学腐蚀性好等特点。这种随温度升高、强度和韧性不仅不衰减反而大幅度提高，是高纯莫来石陶瓷作为髙温材料极佳的特性。髙纯莫来石陶瓷可以用于耐火材料、高温结构材料、电子封装材料和光学窗口材料来使用..
explanation_en: Ceramics with mullite as the main component. Mullite ceramics mainly include ordinary mullite ceramics and high-purity mullite ceramics. Ordinary mullite porcelain is made of aluminosilicate natural minerals as the main raw materials by the reaction sintering method of mullitization in the sintering process, or by synthesizing mullite first, then molding and sintering. Due to the low purity of raw materials and high impurity appetite, its components contain TiO2, Fe2O3, CaO, MgO, Na2O, K20 and other impurities in addition to Al2O3 and SiO2, so there is a considerable amount of glass phase in the product, resulting in poor mechanical and thermal properties. It is generally used as a general refractory in places where temperature and high temperature strength are not required. High purity mullite ceramics are ceramics prepared by reaction sintering of high-purity Al2O3 powder and high-purity SiO2 powder or by synthesizing ultra-fine high-purity mullite powder. It is characterized by uniform expansion, excellent thermal shock resistance, high load softening point, low high temperature creep value, high hardness, good chemical corrosion resistance, etc. This kind of strength and toughness not only do not decay but increase significantly with temperature, which is an excellent characteristic of high-purity mullite ceramics as high temperature materials. High purity mullite ceramics can be used as refractory, high-temperature structural materials, electronic packaging materials and optical window materials

explanation_cn: 铸造状态下其组织中含有共晶组织（莱氏体）的钢。碳含量超过2.11%的非合金钢凝固时会发生共晶相变而得到部分莱氏体组织，但由于塑韧性极差因而通常均不采用这样高碳含量的非合金钢。大量加入合金元素后，可使钢的共晶碳含量降低，故目前使用的莱氏体钢主要为高合金钢。含存莱氏体组织的钢热处理后具有较高的硬度、耐磨性和红硬性，广泛用于制作各种模具和切削刀具。
explanation_en: Steel with eutectic structure (ledeburite) in its structure in the foundry state. The non-alloy steel with more than 2.11% carbon content will undergo eutectic phase transformation and obtain part of ledeburite structure during solidification, but such high carbon content non-alloy steel is usually not used because of poor plasticity and toughness. The eutectic carbon content of steel can be reduced by adding a large amount of alloy elements, so the current ledeburitic steel is mainly high alloy steel. After heat treatment, steel containing troostite structure has high hardness, wear resistance and red hardness, and is widely used to make various molds and cutting tools.

explanation_cn: 又称苟性苦土、苦土粉。主要成分是氧化镁。以天然菱镁矿为原料，在800-850°C度下煅烧而成。细粉状的气硬性胶结材料，颜色有纯白、灰白、近淡黄色，新鲜材料有闪烁玻璃光泽。
explanation_en: Also known as Gouxing Bitter Soil or Bitter Soil Powder. The main component is magnesium oxide. It is calcined at 800-850 ° C with natural magnesite as raw material. Fine powdery pneumatic cementitious materials are pure white, gray white and nearly light yellow in color, and fresh materials have a shiny glass luster.

explanation_cn: 简单岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。常有镁、锰、钙代替铁.，形成镁菱铁矿、锰菱铁矿、钙菱铁矿等变种。三方晶系，方解石型结构。晶体呈菱面体状、短柱状；有时依{0112}成聚片双晶:集合体呈粒状、致密块状或土状；在沉积物中呈结核状、凝胶状。新鲜者浅灰白色，风化后呈褐色、黑色。玻璃光泽，透明至半透明。解理{1011}完全。莫氏硬度4,密度3.7-4.0g/cm3。在冷盐酸中作用缓慢，在热盐酸中加剧，生成黄绿色FeCl2。在阴极射线下呈橘红色。主要在热液和沉积条件下形成，热液成因者呈脉状，与铁白云石、方铅矿、闪锌矿等硫化物共生；沉积成因者呈层状，产于黏土岩、页岩或煤层里。大量聚集时，可作提取铁的矿物原料。
explanation_en: A carbonate mineral with a simple island like structure. Magnesium, manganese and calcium often replace iron, The varieties of magnesium siderite, manganese siderite and calcium siderite are formed. Triangular system, calcspar (calcite) structure. Crystal is rhombohedral and short columnar; Sometimes they form twin according to {0112}: the aggregate is granular, compact and massive or earthy; It is nodular and gel shaped in the sediment. Fresh ones are light gray white, and after weathering, they appear brown or black. Glass is glossy, transparent to translucent. The cleavage {1011} is complete. Mohs hardness 4, density 3.7-4.0g/cm3. It acts slowly in cold hydrochloric acid and intensifies in hot hydrochloric acid, generating yellow green FeCl2. It turns orange red under cathode ray. It is mainly formed under hydrothermal and sedimentary conditions. The hydrothermal genesis is vein like, coexisting with sulfide such as ankerite, galena, sphalerite, etc; Sedimentary genesis is layered, occurring in clay rock, shale or coal seam. It can be used as raw mineral material for extracting iron in large amount.

explanation_cn: 简单岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。化学式为Zn[CO3]，常含有Fe、Mn、Mg、Ca等混入物，形成铁菱锌矿、锰菱锌矿、镁菱锌矿、钙菱锌矿等变种。三方晶系。方解石型结构。完好晶形少见，多呈肾状、葡萄状、钟乳状等。纯者白色，常染成浅灰、浅绿、浅褐红色等。玻璃光泽，透明至半透明。解理{1011}完全。莫氏硬度4..25-5.0,密度4.0-4.5g/cm3。与盐酸作用起泡。常见于铅锌矿床氧化带，系闪锌矿转化的产物，与针铁矿等共生。是提取锌的矿物原料。
explanation_en: A carbonate mineral with a simple island like structure. The chemical formula is Zn [CO3], often containing Fe, Mn, Mg, Ca and other mixed substances, forming iron smithsonite, manganese smithsonite, magnesium smithsonite, calcium smithsonite and other varieties. Tripartite crystal system. Calcspar (calcite) structure. Intact crystal forms are rare, often appearing in the form of kidneys, grapes, or bell milk. Pure white, often dyed as light gray, light green, light brownish red, etc. Glass is glossy, transparent to translucent. The cleavage {1011} is complete. Mohs hardness is 4.25-5.0, and density is 4.0-4.5g/cm3. Foaming occurs when it reacts with hydrochloric acid. It is commonly found in the oxidation zone of lead-zinc deposits and is the product of sphalerite transformation, coexisting with goethite, etc. It is a raw mineral material for extracting zinc.

explanation_cn: 简单岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。常有铁、锌、钙代替锰，形成铁菱锰矿、锌菱锰矿、钙菱锰矿等变种。三方晶系，方解石型结构。完好晶体呈菱面体状；有时依{0112}成聚片双晶；集合体呈粒状、柱状、块状、结核状、土状等。淡玫瑰红色，易风化转变为浅灰白、浅黄或褐黄色等。玻璃光泽。解理{1011}完全。莫氏硬度3.4-4.5,性脆，密度3.5-3.7g/cm3。与冷盐酸作用缓慢，加热后加剧。主要产于海相沉积的铁锰矿床中.与水锰矿、赤铁矿、绿泥石、石英等共生。是提取锰的主要矿物原料。
explanation_en: A carbonate mineral with a simple island like structure. Iron, zinc and calcium often replace manganese, forming iron rhodochrosite, zinc rhodochrosite, calcium rhodochrosite and other varieties. Triangular system, calcspar (calcite) structure. The intact crystal is rhombohedral; Sometimes they form twin crystals according to {0112}; Aggregates are granular, columnar, massive, nodular, and soil like. Light rose red, easily weathered transformation to light gray white, light yellow or brown yellow, etc. Glass lustre. The cleavage {1011} is complete. Mohs hardness 3.4-4.5, brittle, density 3.5-3.7g/cm3. The reaction with cold hydrochloric acid is slow, but intensifies after heating. It mainly occurs in marine sedimentary iron manganese deposits and coexists with manganite, hematite, chlorite, quartze, etc. It is the main raw mineral material for extracting manganese.

explanation_cn: 简单岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。常有铁替代镁，形成铁菱镁矿、菱铁镁矿等异种。三方晶系方解石型结构。完好晶形少见，常呈粒状或致密块状集合体。白色或浅黄白色，含铁者染成褐红色。玻璃光泽。解理{1011}完全。性脆，莫氏硬度3.5-4.5,不溶于冷盐酸，溶于热酸中。主要由含镁热水溶液交代白云岩或白云质灰岩及富镁岩石而成，常与方解石、白云石、绿泥石、滑石等共生。中国辽宁大石桥菱镁矿是世界著名的大型矿床。主要用于制取碱性耐火砖、炼钢炉衬、水泥和保温、隔热等建筑材料；亦是提取镁、制取硫酸镁及其他镁化合物的矿物原料。
explanation_en: A carbonate mineral with a simple island like structure. Iron often replaces magnesium and forms iron magnesite, iron magnesite and other varieties. The calcspar (calcite) structure of the trigonal system. Intact crystal form is rare and often presents as granular or dense block like aggregates. White or light yellow white, dyed brownish red for those containing iron. Glass lustre. The cleavage {1011} is complete. Brittle, Mohs hardness 3.5-4.5, insoluble in cold hydrochloric acid, soluble in hot acid. It is mainly formed by replacement of dolomitite or dolomitic limestone and magnesium rich rock with magnesium bearing hot water solution, and is often associated with caldte, dolomite, chlorite, talc, etc. Dashiqiao magnesite deposit in Liaoning, China is a world famous large deposit. It is mainly used for making basic refractory bricks, steelmaking furnace lining, cement, and building materials such as heat preservation and heat insulation; It is also a raw mineral material for extracting magnesium, preparing magnesium sulfate and other magnesium compounds.

explanation_cn: 描述物质宏观扩散的基本规律。
explanation_en: Describe the basic law of macro diffusion of substances.

explanation_cn: 蔽稀树脂由天然松节油加工而成。分子式平均分子量为650-2600。为淡黄色黏稠液体或透明脆性固体。相对密度为0.95-1.0,软化点80-40°C,玻璃化温度73-94t.易溶于甲苯、二氯甲烷、松节油、脂肪烃.不溶于水、甲醇、乙醇、丙剛、醋酸乙酯.热稳定性好，不结晶.遇光和热不变色。耐酸、耐碱、耐海水，低温性、耐候性亦佳，可燃.无毒。其产品广泛应用于胶黏剂、双面胶带、溶剂型胶水、书本装订、包装、胶布、烯烃胶布、牛皮纸卡胶布、胶带标签、木工胶、压敏胶、热熔胶、密封胶、油漆和油墨及其他聚合物改忭剂等方面。
explanation_en: The diluted resin is processed from natural turpentine. The molecular formula average molecular weight is 650-2600. It is a light yellow viscous liquid or a transparent brittle solid. The relative density is 0.95-1.0, the softening point is 80-40 ° C, and the glass transition temperature is 73-94t. It is easily soluble in toluene, dichloromethane, turpentine, and aliphatic hydrocarbons. It is insoluble in water, methanol, ethanol, propylene glycol, and ethyl acetate. It has good thermal stability, is non crystalline, and does not change color in light and heat. Acid, alkali, and seawater resistant, with excellent low-temperature and weather resistance. It is flammable and non-toxic. Its products are widely used in adhesive, double-sided adhesive tape, solvent based glue, book binding, packaging, adhesive cloth, olefin adhesive cloth, kraft paper card adhesive cloth, adhesive tape label, wood glue, pressure sensitive adhesive, hot melt adhesive, sealant, paint and ink and other polymer modifiers.

explanation_cn: 又名氟石。简单配位型氟化物矿物。常有稀土元素代替钙，形成钇萤石、铈萤石变种。等轴晶系。晶体多呈立方体、八面体或由其组成的聚形，常依形成穿插双晶，集合体呈粒状、致密块状、纤维状、土状等。无色透明者极少，多呈黄、绿、蓝、紫、黑等色。加热或用阴极射线照射，颜色会产生变化。条痕白色，玻璃光泽，透明至半透明。解理平行完全。性脆，有的具有荧光性、磷光性、热光性或摩擦发光的现象。主要是热液作用产物，呈脉状产于花岗岩、火山岩、砂页岩和石灰岩中，大量出现于某些铅锌矿床中，与石英、方解石、重晶石、方铅矿、闪锌矿等矿物共生，有时出现在硫化矿床或稀土矿床氧化带中。是制取氢氟酸和人工冰晶石及各种氟化物的矿物原料。冶金工业用作熔剂，用于排除炼钢时矿石中的硫、磷有害杂质。透明无色萤石可用作光学仪器原件。还是玻璃、搪瓷、水泥工业的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Also known as fluorspar. Simple coordination type fluoride minerals. Rare earth elements often replace calcium to form yttrium fluorite and cerium fluorite varieties. Equiaxed crystal system. Crystal are mostly cubes, octahedrons or aggregates composed of them. They often form interpenetrating twins, and aggregates are granular, compact, fibrous, earthy, etc. There are very few colorless and transparent ones, most of which are yellow, green, blue, purple, black, and other colors. Heating or exposure to cathode rays can cause color changes. Streaks white, glass luster, transparent to translucent. The cleavage is parallel and complete. Brittle, some with fluorescence, phosphorescence, thermoluminescence or friction luminescence phenomenon. It is mainly the product of hydrothermal process and occurs in granite, volcanic rock, sand shale and limestone in vein shape. It occurs in some lead-zinc deposits in large quantities, coexists with quartze, caldte, barite, galena, sphalerite and other minerals, and sometimes occurs in vulcanization deposits or rare earth deposit oxidation zones. It is a raw mineral material for producing hydrofluoric acid, artificial cryolite and various fluorides. The metallurgical industry is used as a flux to remove harmful sulfur and phosphorus impurities from ores during steelmaking. Transparent and colorless fluorite can be used as the original of optical instruments. It is also a raw mineral material for glass, enamel and cement industries.

explanation_cn: 又称氟化钙型结构。以CaF2为代表的一类离子晶体结构。属于立方晶系，面心立方点阵。每个晶胞包含4个阳离子A，8个阴离子B。阴离子（如F-)具有简单的立方排列，阳离子（如Ca2+)充填可利用的阴离子六面体中心位置数的一半。晶胞中心有一个很大的空位，正负离子的配位数分别为8和4。对该结构，也可以把Ca2+看成按"立方密堆"，而F-占据全部四面体空隙。
explanation_en: Also known as calcium fluoride structure. A kind of ion crystal structure represented by CaF2. Belongs to the cubic crystal system, with a face centered cubic lattice. Each unit cell of crystal contains four cations A and eight anions B. Anions (such as F -) have a simple cubic arrangement, while cations (such as Ca2+) fill half of the available anionic hexahedral center positions. There is a large vacancy in the center of unit cell of crystal, and the coordination number of positive and negative ions is 8 and 4 respectively. For this structure, Ca2+can also be considered as a "cubic dense pile", while F - occupies all tetrahedral voids.

explanation_cn: 是常温下测定液体黏度的常用的方法。可测极低切变速率值下的切黏度，适合测定具有较高切黏度的牛顿流体。将侍测液体置于玻璃测黏管中，放入加热恒温槽，使之恒温。然后向管中放入不锈钢小球，令其自由下落，记录小球恒速夏落一段距离S听需时间t，由此计算液体黏度。落球测黏法结构简单.操作方便，可进行变温测量。
explanation_en: It is a common method to measure the viscosity of liquid at room temperature. It can measure the shear viscosity at very low shear rate, and is suitable for measuring Newtonian fluids with high shear viscosity. Place the measuring liquid in the glass viscosity measuring tube and put it into the heating constant temperature bath to keep it constant. Then put a stainless steel ball into the tube and let it fall freely. Record the time t required for the ball to fall at a constant speed for a certain distance S in summer, and then calculate the liquid viscosity. The falling ball viscosity measurement method has a simple structure, convenient operation, and can be used for variable temperature measurement.

explanation_cn: 采用头部呈半球形的镖由已知高度垂直下落到适宜尺寸的高分子材料试样上，使试样破坏测其冲击强度的一种方法。冲击吋调节能量的方法有两种:①阶梯法，实验时使用相同的能量增量，在打击每个试样后根据对前一个试样所观察的结果(破坏或不破坏)，减少或增加相同增值的能量，该法是优先选用的方法；②统计法，是对每组至少10个试样的实验组逐个进行实验。对每一组使用一个能量，从一组到另一组按增值改变能量。实验中能量的改变可以通过固定下落高度改变下落质量或者固定下落质量改变下落高度来实现。实验结果用50%破坏率的冲击能，用J表示，也可以用规定下落高度的落镖质量(kg);或用规定质量的下落高度(m)来表示。该方法适用于塑料薄膜、片材、板材或模制品。试样可直接模塑或从片材上切取规定尺寸的圆片或方片。用不同加工方式加工的试样结果不能比较。薄膜试样其长度和宽度尺寸均应大于153mm,数量不少于30个。该法的缺点是采用不同高度法时与速度有关，可能因材料应变速率不同而测得不同结果，因此优先选取固定高度法。而且对于某些对速度敏感的材料用以上两种方法测试，其结果可能不一样。
explanation_en: It is a method to measure the impact strength of macromolecule materials by vertically dropping a hemispherical dart from a known height onto a sample of suitable size to destroy the sample. There are two methods for adjusting energy during impact: ① step method, which uses the same energy increment during the experiment. After striking each sample, based on the observed results of the previous sample (whether it is damaged or not), the same increment of energy is reduced or increased. This method is the preferred method; ② Statistical method involves conducting experiments on each experimental group of at least 10 samples. Apply one energy to each group and change the energy in increments from one group to another. The change in energy in the experiment can be achieved by changing the falling mass by fixing the falling height or by changing the falling height by fixing the falling mass. The experimental results are expressed in terms of impact energy with a 50% failure rate, denoted by J, or the mass of the falling dart at the specified height (kg); Alternatively, it can be expressed as the drop height of the specified mass (m). This method is applicable to plastics films, sheets, plates or molded products. The sample can be directly molded or cut into circular or square pieces of specified size from the sheet material. The results of samples processed using different processing methods cannot be compared. The length and width of the thin film sample should be greater than 153mm, and the number should not be less than 30. The disadvantage of this method is that the different height method is related to speed, and different results may be obtained due to different strain rate of materials, so the fixed height method is preferred. Moreover, for some materials sensitive to speed, the results may be different if the above two methods are used.

explanation_cn: 又称褐煤蜡。是含有蜡质的褐煤经过有机溶剂(苯、甲苯、汽油等)萃取获得的一种含有蜡、树脂和沥青的矿物蜡。要求原料煤的蜡含量在3%以上，粒度<4mm，水分<20%。褐煤蜡可用作价格昂贵的天然动物蜡和植物蜡的代用品及补充品，用于生产复写纸、皮鞋油、地板蜡、上光蜡、金属擦亮剂、电线电缆、皮革装饰以及脱模剂等，还吋用于精密铸造的蜡模、橡胶和道路沥青的添加剂等。
explanation_en: It is also called lignite wax. It is a kind of mineral wax containing wax, resin and pitch extracted from waxy lignite by organic solvent (benzene, toluene, gasoline, etc.). The wax content of raw material coal shall be more than 3%, the particle size shall be less than 4mm, and the moisture content shall be less than 20%. Lignite wax can be used as a substitute and supplement for expensive natural animal wax and vegetable wax to produce carbon paper, shoe polish, floor wax, polishing wax, metal polish, wire and cable, leather decoration, releasing agent, etc. It is also used as wax mold for precision casting, additive for rubber and road pitch.

explanation_cn: 一类基于重复随机取样以计算其结果的计算机模拟方法。通过采用无相关随机数构成的考察变量完成一系列计算机实验，在合理的计算时间内对相对空间大量的状态进行研究的方法。
explanation_en: A type of computer simulation method based on repeated random sampling to calculate its results. The method of conducting a series of computer experiments using unrelated random variables to study a large number of states in relative space within a reasonable computational time.

explanation_cn: 又称胶岭石、微晶高岭石。层状结构硅酸盐矿物。土块状集合体，在电子显微镜下呈绒毛状。白色，含杂质染成黄、玫瑰红、蓝绿色。土状光泽，略带油脂光泽。具滑感。加水膨胀，体积增加几倍并变成糊状物。受热脱水后体积收缩。主要产于基件火山岩的风化壳中，亦可由海底沉积的火山灰分解形成。蒙脱石阳离子交换能力强，吸附性亦强，可作漂白剂、吸附剂、填充剂等。
explanation_en: It is also called jiaoling stone and microcrystalline kaolinite. Layered silicate mineral. A clump like aggregate that appears fluffy under an electron microscope. White, containing impurities dyed yellow, rose red, and blue-green. Earthy luster, slightly greasy luster. Smooth feeling. Add water to expand, increase the volume several times and turn into a paste. The volume shrinks after being heated and dehydrated. It is mainly produced in the weathering crust of the basic volcanic rock, and can also be formed by the decomposition of volcanic ash deposited on the sea floor. Montmorillonite has strong cation exchange ability and strong adsorption, and can be used as bleaching agent, adsorbent, filler, etc.

explanation_cn: 在髙温下蒸气压较大体系内.材料进行烧结时的传质规律。这种传质机理是烧结中定量计算最简单的一种，它是了解复杂烧结过程的基础。在高温过程中由于表面曲率的不同，必然在体系的不同部位有不同的蒸气压，于是就有一种传质趋势。在颗粒的表面有正曲率半径，该处的蒸气压比平面处要大些，而在两个颗粒连接处有一个小的负曲率半径的颈部，在该处蒸气压比颗粒本身要低一个数量级，颈表面和颗粒表面之间由于曲率不同，使物质从蒸气压高的部位蒸发，通过气相传递而凝聚到蒸气压低的部位，从而使颈部逐渐被填充。蒸发凝聚传质的特点使烧结时颈部区域扩大，球的形状变为椭圆，气孔形状也随之发生改变，但球与球之间的中心距不变，也就是坯体不发生收缩。对于几微米大小的颗粒，要求蒸气压为l0Pa才能看出这种传质的效果，因此一般硅酸盐材料的烧结中这种传质方式并不多见。
explanation_en: Mass transfer law of materials during sintering in the system with large vapor pressure at high temperature. This mass transfer mechanism is the simplest kind of quantitative calculation in sintering, and it is the basis for understanding the complex sintering process. During high temperature processes, due to differences in surface curvature, there will inevitably be different vapor pressures at different parts of the system, resulting in a mass transfer trend. On the surface of particles, there is a positive radius of curvature, where the vapor pressure is greater than that of the plane. At the junction of two particles, there is a small neck with a negative radius of curvature, where the vapor pressure is one order of magnitude lower than the particle itself. Due to the different curvature between the neck surface and the particle surface, the material evaporates from the high vapor pressure area and condenses to the low vapor pressure area through gas phase transfer, gradually filling the neck. The characteristics of evaporation, condensation and mass transfer make the neck area expand during sintering, the shape of the ball becomes elliptical, and the shape of the pores also changes, but the center distance between the balls remains unchanged, that is, the green body does not shrink. For particles of several microns in size, the vapor pressure is required to be 10Pa to see the effect of this mass transfer. Therefore, this mass transfer mode is rare in sintering of ordinary silicate materials.

explanation_cn: 在高真空或低压惰性气体气氛（氢或氮）中，通过蒸发源的加热作用。使金属、合金或化合物汽化、升华成为原子或分子。再使这些原子或分子聚集长大，然后冷凝形成纳米材料。通过在惰性气体中的蒸发和冷凝过程得到干净的纳米粒子。制得的纳米粒子表面清洁，可以原位加压粒径可通过调节加热温度、压力和气氛等在几纳米至500nm范围内调控，但是结晶形状难以控制，生产效率低。适于金属纳米粒子的制备。根据具体的过程又分为金属粒子结晶法、活性氢-熔融金属反应法和气体蒸发法。
explanation_en: In a high vacuum or low pressure inert gas atmosphere (hydrogen or nitrogen), the heating effect is achieved through the evaporation source. To vaporize or sublimate a metal, alloy, or compound into atoms or molecules. These atoms or molecules are then aggregated and grown, and then condensed to form nanomaterials. Clean nanoparticles are obtained through the evaporation and condensation process in an inert gas. The surface of the prepared nanoparticles is clean and can be pressurized in situ. The particle size can be adjusted within the range of a few nanometers to 500nm by adjusting heating temperature, pressure, and atmosphere. However, the crystal shape is difficult to control and production efficiency is low. Suitable for the preparation of metal nanoparticles. According to the specific process, it can be divided into metal particle crystallization method, active hydrogen molten metal reaction method, and gas evaporation method.

explanation_cn: 一种化学沉积岩。主要分布在盐湖及咸化泻湖中。系在干燥气候条件下，湖水(卤水）蒸发、浓缩盐类物质依不同的溶解度结晶而成。按成分可分为石膏、硬石膏、石盐、钾石盐、芒硝等。岩石类型与矿产十分丰富。
explanation_en: A chemical sedimentary rock. Mainly distributed in salt lakes and saline lagoons. It is formed by evaporation of lake water (brine) and crystallization of concentrated salt substances according to different water solubility under dry climate conditions. According to composition, it can be divided into gypsum, anhydrite, halite, sylvinite, mirabilite, etc. Rock types and minerals are very rich.

explanation_cn: 是利用溶液的依数性测定聚合物数均分子量的一种方法。当溶液液滴和纯溶剂的液滴处于同一充满溶剂饱和蒸汽的密闭容器中时，液滴和饱和蒸汽相将发生物质和热量的交换。由于溶液滴的蒸气压低于溶剂滴的蒸气压，周围的饱和蒸汽向溶液滴凝聚，放出凝聚热，使溶液滴的温度升高，这样溶剂滴和溶液滴之间产生了温度差。此法的优点：样品用量少，仅几毫克;测量速度快并且可以连续及在任意温度下测定。但由于不是测定平衡时的蒸气压下降，因此，测量时间及液滴大小等变数需要标准化。
explanation_en: It is a method to measure the number average molecular weight of polymer by using the colligative property of solution. When a solution droplet and a pure solvent droplet are in the same sealed container filled with solvent saturated vapor, material and heat exchange occurs between the droplet and the saturated vapor phase. Due to the vapor pressure of the solution droplet being lower than that of the solvent droplet, the surrounding saturated vapor condenses towards the solution droplet, releasing condensation heat, causing the temperature of the solution droplet to increase, resulting in a temperature difference between the solvent droplet and the solution droplet. The advantage of this method is that the sample dosage is small, only a few milligrams; The measurement speed is fast and can be measured continuously and at any temperature. However, since the decrease in vapor pressure is not measured during equilibrium, variables such as measurement time and droplet size need to be standardized.

explanation_cn: 是一种具有储存和释放热功能的特种纤维。含有一定量的相变材料，可以在环境温度变化时通过相变材料的固-液和液-同相转变吸收或放出热量。制备方法有，将相变物质、增黏剂、热稳定剂作为芯层材料，使用皮芯复合纺丝的方法，制备具有皮芯结构的;将含有相变物质的微胶囊与成纤聚合物混合后纺丝的方法制备具有共混结构的。可用于制作保暖服装、滑雪服及毛衣类等。
explanation_en: It is a special fiber with the function of storing and releasing heat. A certain amount of phase transformation materials can absorb or release heat through the solid liquid and liquid in-phase transformation of phase transformation materials when the ambient temperature changes. The preparation method comprises the following steps: taking the phase change material, tackifier and thermal stabilizer as the core layer materials, using the skin core composite spinning method to prepare the skin core structure; The microcapsule containing phase transformation material and the fiber forming polymer are mixed and spun to prepare the fiber with polymer blending structure. It can be used to make warm clothing, ski clothing, and sweaters.

explanation_en: See secondary cell.

explanation_cn: 用来制造铅蓄电池栅板、极板用的铅合金。铅酸蓄电池板栅用铅合金不仅要考虑到加工制作的要求（生产完好的板栅）、机械强度（便于生产中搬运）、蠕变强度（服务期间抗板栅增长）和耐磨性，还必须注意到合金和合金组分可能引起的电化学问题，如水分解增加或者由于正极板栅表面的钝化效应而出现的早期容量损失。要使所有的性能同时达到最佳值是不可能的，所以有很多种不同的板栅合金在使用。作为蓄电池板栅用的铅合金经历了从高锑合金到低锑合金、无锑合金，进而普遍选用铅钙合金。
explanation_en: Lead alloy used for manufacturing grid plates and plate of lead batteries. Lead alloy used for grid of lead-acid battery shall not only take into account the requirements for processing (grid in good condition), mechanical strength (convenient for transportation in production), creep strength (resistance to grid growth during service) and wear resistance, but also pay attention to the electrochemical problems that may be caused by alloy and alloy components, such as increased water decomposition or early capacity loss due to passivation effect on the surface of positive grid. It is impossible to achieve the best performance at the same time, so there are many different grid alloy in use. Lead alloy used as grid of accumulator has gone through the process from high antimony alloy to low antimony alloy and antimony free alloy, and then lead calcium alloy is widely used.

explanation_cn: 除红宝石以外的其他颜色的刚玉宝石，包括白宝石、绿宝石等。颜色丰富，纯净时无色，当晶格中含有微量元素时可致色：Cr、Ni联合作用致橙色或金黄色，Ti、Fe联合作用致紫色或蓝色，Ni致黄色，Co、V、Ni联合作用致绿色等。蓝宝石的主要产地有：缅甸、泰国、斯里兰卡、柬埔寨、印度、澳大利亚、美国，中国的蓝宝石主要产于山东省潍坊地区的昌乐县和五阁县。参见刚玉。
explanation_en: Corundum gems in other colors except mby, including white sapphire, green sapphire, etc. Rich in color, colorless when pure, it can be colored when there are trace elements in the lattice: Cr and Ni combine to cause orange or golden yellow, Ti and Fe combine to cause purple or blue, Ni causes yellow, Co, V, Ni combine to cause green, etc. Sapphire is mainly produced in Myanmar, Thailand, Sri Lanka, Cambodia, India, Australia and the United States. sapphire in China is mainly produced in Changle County and Wuge County in Weifang, Shandong Province. See corundum.

explanation_cn: 一种架状硅酸盐矿物。通常呈粒状集合体，单晶体呈菱形十二面体。天蓝、蓝或绿蓝色，偶为黄色或红色。玻璃光泽，断口为油脂光泽。硬度5.5-6。解理平行菱形十二面体{110}不完全。密度2.4-2.5g/cm3。产于碱性喷出岩或碱性岩与灰岩接触变质带中。色泽鲜艳者可作玉石。
explanation_en: A shelf shaped silicate mineral. Generally, it is a granular aggregate, and the single crystal is a diamond shaped dodecahedron. Sky blue, blue or greenish blue, occasionally yellow or red. Glass luster, fracture surface is grease luster. Hardness 5.5-6. The cleavage parallel rhombic dodecahedron {110} is incomplete. Density 2.4-2.5g/cm3. It occurs in alkaline extrusive rock or alkaline rock limestone contact metamorphic belt. Those with bright colors can be used as jade.

explanation_cn: 岛状结构硅酸盐矿物。晶体呈长板状或刀刃状。蓝、灰、黄、浅绿色。玻璃光泽，解理面上呈珍珠光泽。平行柱面有一组完全解理。垂直柱面有一组裂开。莫氏硬度5.5-7.柱面上平行Z轴方向的莫氏硬度5.5，垂直柱面方向莫氏硬度为6.5,表现出极其显著的异向性，故又称二硬石。性脆。是典型的区域变质矿物，多由泥质岩变质而成。是高级的耐火材料原料。色泽鲜艳者可作宝石。
explanation_en: Island structure silicate mineral. The crystal is long plate or knife edge. Blue, gray, yellow, and light green. Glass luster, pearly luster on cleavage surface. Parallel cylindrical surfaces have a set of complete cleavage. There is a set of cracks on the vertical cylindrical surface. Mohs hardness 5.5-7. The hardness of the cylinder in the direction parallel to the Z axis is 5.5, and the hardness of the cylinder in the vertical direction is 6.5, showing extremely significant anisotropy, so it is also called hard stone. Embrittlement. It is a typical regional metamorphic mineral, mostly formed by the metamorphism of mudstone. It is a high-grade refractory raw material. Those with bright colors can be used as gems.

explanation_cn: 用碱式铬盐鞣制得到的外观呈蓝色的在制品。可以进行片皮和削匀等机械操作，以及储存和运输。
explanation_en: Blue in process products obtained by tanning with basic chromium salt. It can be used for mechanical operation, storage and transportation such as splitting and shaving.

explanation_cn: 又称蓝闪石片岩。一种低温-高压区域变质岩。蓝绿色，细粒、纤状变晶结构、斑状变晶结构，片状构造。主要矿物为蓝闪石，其他矿物为硬柱石、文石、钠长石、绿泥石、多硅白云母、阳起石、黑硬绿泥石、硬绿泥石、绿纤石或红帘石等。岩石类型及矿物组成与原岩关系密切：由基性火山岩变成者含绿帘石、绿泥石较多；由杂砂岩变成者富含钠长石、石英和多硅白云母；山燧石岩变成者则富含石英。蓝片岩常与绿片岩、榴辉岩等共生。
explanation_en: It is also called blue diorite schist. A low-temperature high-pressure regional metamorphic rock. Blue green, fine-grained, fibrous balastic texture, porphyritic balastic texture, schistose structure. The main minerals are glaucophane, and other minerals are andalusite, aragonite, albite feldspar, chlorite, phengite, actinolite, hard chlorite, hard chlorite, chlorite or epidote. The rock type and mineral composition are closely related to the original rock: epidote and chlorite are abundant in the basic volcanic rock; From greywacke to sodium rich feldspar, quartze and siliceous muscovite; The chert metamorphist is rich in quartze. Glaucophane schist is often associated with green schist and eclogite.

explanation_cn: 灰蓝至蓝绿色玉髓。参见石英。
explanation_en: Grey blue to blue-green chalcedony. See quartze.

explanation_cn: 一种蛇纹石化大理岩，主要矿物成分是方解石和蛇纹石，依据蛇纹石化的程度由低到高，方解石含量逐渐减少，局部可变为蛇纹石玉。不等粒状变晶结构至纤维状变晶结构，块状构造。常见白色、黄色、米黄色、苹果绿色等。蓝田玉以产于蓝田而得名，是中国古代主要名玉之一。参见大理岩。
explanation_en: A serpentinized marble whose main mineral components are caldte and serpentine. According to the degree of serpentinization, the content of caldte gradually decreases and can be changed into serpentine jade locally. Unequal granular balastic texture to fibrous balastic texture, massive structure. Common colors include white, yellow, beige, apple green, etc. Lamianyu is named after Lantian, which is one of the main famous jade in ancient China. See marble.

explanation_cn: 蓝相（blue phase)是液晶中具有特殊性质的一个相态，是各种胆甾相液晶在稍低于清亮点时存在的热力学稳定相，它是介于胆甾相和各向同性之间的一个狭窄温度区间(0.5-2°C)的相态，且相态稳定，由于通常呈现蓝色，称为蓝相。能够出现蓝相的液晶被称为蓝相液晶。蓝相液晶有着自组装的三维晶格特性，却保持流体的本性，晶格参数易于变更，可有不同的光电特性，是很好的可调式光子晶体；而且有晶格对应的Bragg散射大都在可见光范围，有很好的色彩性。
explanation_en: Blue phase is a phase state with special properties in liquid crystals. It is a thermodynamics stable phase in various cholesteric phase liquid crystals when it is slightly below the clear point. It is a phase state in a narrow temperature range (0.5-2 ° C) between cholesteric and isotropic, and the phase state is stable. Because it usually appears blue, it is called blue phase. The liquid crystal that can appear blue phase is called blue phase liquid crystal. Blue phase liquid crystal has the three-dimensional lattice characteristics of self-assembly, but maintains the nature of fluid. The lattice parameters are easy to change, and can have different photoelectric properties. It is a good adjustable photonic crystal; Moreover, the Bragg scattering corresponding to the lattice is mostly in the visible light range, with good chromaticity.

explanation_cn: 含水的层状结构磷酸盐矿物。晶体呈柱状或针状；集合体呈放射状、肾状、球状或土状块体。新鲜者无色透明或浅蓝色，条痕内色。在空气中氧化后呈浅蓝、浅绿或深蓝色，条痕浅蓝色。玻璃光泽，解理面呈珍珠光泽。解理{010}完全。莫氏硬度1.5-2,性脆。密度2.65-2.95g/cm3。形成于外生还原条件下，分布于富磷的沉积型铁矿床或泥炭沼泽中，与菱铁矿及其他低铁矿物共生；还产于伟晶岩矿床和热液矿床氧化带中.与黄铁矿、磁黄铁矿等伴生。可作为磷肥或染料。
explanation_en: A layered phosphate mineral with water content. The crystal is columnar or acicular; Aggregates appear in radial, renal, spherical, or earthy masses. Fresh ones are colorless, transparent or light blue, with streaked interior color. After oxidation in the air, it turns light blue, light green, or dark blue, with light blue stripes. Glass luster, cleavage surface pearly luster. The cleavage {010} is complete. Mohs hardness 1.5-2, brittle. Density 2.65-2.95g/cm3. Formed under exogenous reduction conditions, it is distributed in phosphorus rich sedimentary iron ore deposits or peat swamps, coexisting with siderite and other low iron minerals; It also occurs in the oxidation zone of pegmatite deposits and hydrothermal deposits, and is associated with pyrite, pyrrhothe, etc. It can be used as phosphate fertilizer or dye or dyestuffc.

explanation_cn: 又称石青。含附加阴离子的简单岛状结构碳酸盐矿物。晶体呈柱状、厚板状；集合体呈粒状、晶簇状、土状、薄膜状等。深蓝色.条痕浅蓝色。玻璃光泽或土块光泽.透明至半透明。解理{011}、{100}完全或中等。贝壳状断口。莫氏硬度3.5-4,性脆，密度3.7-3.9g/cm3。溶于盐酸。产于铜矿床氧化带，常与孔雀石共生或伴生。是提取铜和制作颜料的矿物原料，是寻找原生铜矿床的矿物标志。
explanation_en: Also known as shiqing. A carbonate mineral with a simple island like structure containing additional anions. The crystal is columnar and thick plate; Aggregates are in the form of granules, crystal clusters, soil, thin films, etc. Dark blue. Stripes light blue. Glass luster or clay luster, transparent to translucent. The cleavage {011} and {100} are complete or moderate. Shell like fracture. Mohs hardness is 3.5-4, brittle, and density is 3.7-3.9g/cm3. Soluble in hydrochloric acid. It occurs in the oxidation zone of copper deposits and is often associated with malachite. It is a raw mineral material for extracting copper and making pigment, and a mineral marker for searching for primary copper deposits.

explanation_cn: 链状结构硅酸盐矿物。常有Mg、Fe、Zn代替Mn、Ca。三斜晶系，空间群C-PU粒状或致密状块体。蔷薇红色或棕红色。常因氧化而形成黑色氢氧化锰覆盖在矿物表面。玻璃光泽，解理面上显珍珠光泽。产于低温热液矿脉中，亦产于沉积锰矿经区域变质形成的变质矿床中。新鲜而色泽鲜艳者可作雕刻材料。在宝玉石中，是京粉翠的主要矿物相。
explanation_en: Chain structure silicate mineral. Mg, Fe, and Zn often replace Mn and Ca. Tricline system, space group C-PU granular or compact block. Rose red or brownish red. Black manganese hydroxide is often formed by oxidation to cover the surface of minerals. Glass luster, pearly luster on cleavage surface. It occurs in low-temperature hydrothermal veins and also in metamorphic deposits formed by regional metamorphism of sedimentary manganese ore. Fresh and bright color can be used as carving materials. In gems and jades, it is the main mineral phase of Beijing jade.

explanation_cn: 由连续铸造得到的厚度尺寸较小的板坯直接送入连轧机组进行轧制的短流程先进生产工艺。
explanation_en: The short process advanced production technology that the slab with smaller thickness obtained by continuous casting is directly sent to the continuous rolling mill for rolling.

explanation_cn: 具有导电功能的薄膜。导电薄膜的荷电载流子在输运过程中受到表面和界面的散射，当薄膜的厚度可以与电子的自由程相比拟时，在表面和界面的影响将变得显著，这个现象称薄膜的尺寸效应。
explanation_en: A thin film with conductive properties. The charged carriers of conductive thin films are scattered by the surface and interface during transportation. When the thickness of the film can be compared to the free path of electrons, the influence on the surface and interface becomes significant, which is called the size effect of the film.

explanation_cn: 根据悬浮在硅油内且夹在两组上、下圆辊之间的薄膜状熔体，在相对转速不同的两辊组作用下产生的拉伸应变速率和所受到的单轴平面拉伸应力所计算的拉伸黏度。
explanation_en: The tensile viscosity is calculated according to the tensile strain rate and uniaxial plane tensile stress of the film melt suspended in silicone oil and sandwiched between two groups of upper and lower round rollers under the action of two groups of rollers with different relative speeds.

explanation_cn: 薄膜电致发光材料，TFEL当发光体制成薄膜形式时，在电场作用下出现的发光现象称为薄膜电致发光。具有这种性能的薄膜称为薄膜电致发光材料。最主要的基质材料是ZnS,也是将发光体夹在两个平行平板电极之间，其中一个是透明或半透明的如导电玻璃等。当在两电极上加一电压时，电致发光从其中透射出来。薄膜的厚度一般是1μm左右。薄膜电致发光也分直流和交流两类。薄膜电致发光屏因可制成平板等各种形状，因此具有视角大、光线柔和、制备工艺简单、造价便宜等特点，在显示和显像方面是很理想的发光器件。
explanation_en: Thin-film eletroluminescent materials, when TFEL is formed into a thin film, the luminescence phenomenon under the action of electric field is called thin film electroluminescence. The thin films with such properties are called thin-film eletroluminescent materials. The main matrix materials is ZnS, which is also sandwiched between two parallel plate electrodes, one of which is transparent or translucent, such as conductive glass. When a voltage is applied to two electrodes, electroluminescence is transmitted from them. The thickness of the thin film is generally 1 μ About m. Thin film electroluminescence can also be divided into DC and AC. Thin film electroluminescence screen can be made into various shapes such as flat plate, so it has the characteristics of large viewing angle, soft light, simple preparation process, low cost, etc. It is an ideal luminescence device in display and imaging.

name_cn: 薄膜阴极射线发光材料
explanation_cn: 铝酸钇和硅酸钇为基色的阴极射线发光材料可以制成薄膜，成为稀土薄膜阴极射线发光屏用材料。
explanation_en: The cathode ray luminescence materials with yttrium aluminate and yttrium silicate as the primary color can be made into thin films and become the materials for rare earth film cathode ray luminescence screen.

explanation_cn: 棕黄、棕至红棕色、黄褐色、褐色的木变石。是二氧化硅交代的石英质玉石。具波状纤维结构，成品表面可具丝绢光泽。弧面型宝石可出现猫眼效应。见石英质玉。
explanation_en: Brown yellow, brown to reddish brown, yellowish brown, brown woody rocks. It is quartz jade replaced by silica. With a wavy fiber structure, the surface of the finished product can have a silky luster. Curved gems can have cat's eye effect. See quartzite.

explanation_cn: 一种光刻制程助剂。用于显影制程后蚀刻去除未有光阻保护的金属或氧化物层从而使光阻表面的图案转移到金属（或氧化物）层。根据浊刻对象的不同.蚀刻液又可以分为铝蚀刻液、铜蚀刻液、银蚀刻液等。蚀刻液一般为酸性水溶液，通常由磷酸、硫酸、醋酸、硝酸、盐酸等不同的酸根据实际需要按比例复配而成。
explanation_en: A lithography process additive. It is used for etching to remove the metal or oxide layer without photoresistance protection after the development process, so as to transfer the pattern of the photoresistance surface to the metal (or oxide) layer. According to different turbid etching objects, etchant can be divided into aluminum etchant, copper etchant, silver etchant, etc. Etchant is generally acidic aqueous solution, which is usually compounded by phosphoric acid, sulfuric acid, acetic acid, nitric acid, hydrochloric acid and other different acids in proportion according to actual needs.

explanation_cn: 在高分子亚浓溶液中，链间的缠结很多。对其中某一条特定的链，该链与相邻链高度缠结，这些缠结点限制了该链的运动模式；可形象认为这些起限制作用的缠结点相当于一根管道，该链处于一个由相邻链构成的管状区域内。按照此模型，分子链总的有效运动模式，可类比于一条蛇在长洞中的蠕动，这种运动方式是一种各向异性的布朗运动。该模型最早由deGermes提出?称为蛇形运动。基于蛇形运动模型所推导的高分子亚浓溶液和高分子熔体中高分子链的运动称为蛇形理论。
explanation_en: In the sub concentrated solution of macromolecule, there are many entanglements between chains. For a specific chain, it is highly entangled with adjacent chains, and these entangled nodes limit the motion mode of the chain; It can be visualized that these limiting entangled nodes are equivalent to a pipeline, which is located within a tubular region composed of adjacent chains. According to this model, the total effective motion mode of the molecular chain can be compared to the creeping of a snake in a long hole, which is an anisotropic Brownian motion. This model was first proposed by deGermes? It is called a serpentine motion. The motion of macromolecule chains in macromolecule sub concentrated solution and macromolecule melt derived from the snake like motion model is called the reptation theory.

explanation_cn: 一种富含蛇纹石的大理岩。是由白云岩或白云质灰岩等镁质碳酸盐类岩石经富含SiO2的热液变质改造形成的。矿物成分以方解石（含量65%左右）和蛇纹石（20%~30%)为主，另有少量白云母和磁铁矿。呈绿色、灰黑色。粒状或斑状变晶结构，致密块状构造。可作建筑装饰材料和雕刻工艺品的原料。
explanation_en: A marble rich in serpentine. It is formed by magnesia carbonate rock such as dolomitite or dolomitic limestone through hydrothermal metamorphism rich in SiO2. The mineral composition is mainly caldte (about 65%) and serpentine (20%~30%), with a small amount of muscovite and magnetite. It is green and gray black in color. Granular or porphyritic crystalloblastic texture, dense massive structure. It can be used as building decoration materials and raw materials for carving handicrafts.

explanation_cn: 一种几乎全部由叶蛇纹石、利蛇纹石或纤蛇纹石、胶蛇纹石等蛇纹石族矿物组成的变质岩石。是纯橄榄岩、橄榄岩、超镁铁质岩石经中低温热液交代作用使橄榄石和辉石蛇纹石化而成。矿物成分除蛇纹石外.还常含有镁质碳酸盐、滑石、水镁石、磁铁矿、铬铁矿、尖晶石等。
explanation_en: A metamorphic rock that is almost entirely composed of serpentine group minerals such as serpentine, serpentine or chrysotile serpentine and colloidal serpentine. It is dunite, peridmite and ultramafic rock that are formed by serpentinization of olivine and pyroxene through medium and low temperature hydrothermal metasomatism. In addition to serpentine, the mineral composition also often contains magnesian carbonate, talc, brucite, magnetite, chromite, spinel, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称蛇绿岩套。是具有特定成分的镁铁-超镁铁质变质岩的组合。主要岩石组合包括：由蛇纹岩类变质形成的蛇纹岩和蛇纹岩片岩；由辉岩类变质形成的具有变余枕状构造的绿泥石透闪片岩；由玄武岩变质形成的具有变余气孔或杏仁构造的阳起石片岩或斜长角闪岩等。大多分布在构造活动带、大洋中脊和板块碰撞带上。与其有关的矿产是铬、钼、金、镍等。蛇绿岩中普遍伴生的蛇纹石是重要的非金属矿产。
explanation_en: It is also called ophiolite suite. It is the combination of magnesium iron ultramafic metamorphic rock with specific composition. The main rock assemblages include: serpentinite and serpentinite schist formed by serpentinite metamorphism; Chlorite tremolite schist with metamorphic pillow structure formed by pyroxene metamorphism; The actinolite schist or amphibolites with metamorphic pores or almond structure formed by basalt metamorphism. Most of them are distributed in tectonic activity zones, mid ocean ridges, and plate collision zones. The minerals related to it are chromium, molybdenum, gold, nickel, etc. The serpentine commonly associated with ophiolite is an important non-metallic mineral.

explanation_cn: 又称蛋白土或粉蛋白岩。是由细小棱角状或粒状的蛋白石颗粒组成的集合体.一般不含或仅含少量的硅质生物碎屑。此外还可有黏土矿物、碳酸盐类矿物、黄铁矿、海绿石、沸石、玉髓、方石英、石英碎屑和有机质混人物。岩石具微孔多孔构造，层理不明显。有黏舌感，硬度小于5.5，贝壳状断口，常为暗灰、灰黑色。SiO2含量可达85%-95%以上。可作为硅质原料、磨料、过滤材料和耐火材料。此外.蛋白土活性高，起活性矿物添加剂作用。它呈细粒分散状和非晶质形式存在于岩石中，并能与游离的氧化钙结合，形成钙质硅酸盐。具有高密度、高耐压性和对酸、盐的化学稳定性。可用作混凝土的黏合剂。
explanation_en: It is also called albumen soil or powdery protein rock. It is a collection of small angular or granular opal particles that generally do not contain or only contain a small amount of siliceous biochar. In addition, clay mineral, carbonate minerals, pyrite, glauconite, zeolite, chalcedony, cristobalite, quartze fragments and organic matter can also be mixed. The rock has microporous and porous structure, and the bedding is not obvious. It is sticky, with hardness less than 5.5, shell shaped fracture, usually dark gray or grayish black. The SiO2 content can reach over 85% -95%. It can be used as siliceous raw material, abrasive, filter materials and refractory. In addition, albumen soil has high activity and acts as an active mineral additive. It exists in rock in fine-grained dispersion and amorphous form, and can combine with free calcium oxide to form calcareous silicate. It has high density, high pressure resistance and chemical stability to acid and salt. It can be used as adhesive for concrete.

explanation_cn: 见动物纤维。
explanation_en: See animal fiber.

explanation_cn: 是一种高通量的蛋白功能分析技术，可用于蛋白质表达谱分析，研究蛋白质与蛋白质的相互作用，甚至DNA-蛋白质、RNA-蛋内质的相互作用，筛选药物作用的蛋白靶点等。其原理是对固相载体进行特殊的化学处理.再将已知的蛋白分子产物间定其上（如酶、抗原、抗体、受体、配体、细胞因子等），根据这些生物分子的特性，捕获能与之特异性结合的待测蛋白（存在于血清、血浆、淋巴、间质液、尿液、渗出液、细胞溶解液、分泌液等），经洗涤、纯化.再进行确认和生化分析；它为获得重要生命信息提供有力的技术支持。
explanation_en: It is a high-throughput protein functional analysis technique that can be used for protein expression profiling, studying protein-protein interactions, and even DNA-protein, RNA endoplasmic reticulum interactions, and screening protein targets for drug action. The principle is to perform special chemical treatment on the solid phase carrier. Then, known protein molecule products (such as enzymes, antigens, antibodies, receptors, ligands, cytokines, etc.) are intertwined with them, and based on the characteristics of these biological molecules, the tested proteins (present in serum, plasma, lymph, interstitial fluid, urine, exudate, cell lysate, secretion, etc.) that can specifically bind to them are captured, washed Purification, followed by confirmation and biochemical analysis; It provides strong technical support for obtaining important life information.

explanation_cn: 层状结构硅酸盐矿物。常依金云母成假象。黄褐、金黄、青铜黄色，有时带绿色。油脂或珍珠光泽呈金内色，晶体弯曲似蛭虫，密度相应减小有很高的绝热、隔声、绝缘性能及阳离子交换能力。由金云母、黑云母经低温热液作用蚀变而形成。是良好的绝热、隔声材料。多用于建筑行业.也用于造纸和涂料，
explanation_en: Layered silicate mineral. It is often distorted by phlogopite. Yellowish brown, golden yellow, bronze yellow, sometimes with green. The grease or pearly luster is golden inside, and the crystal is bent like a leech worm. The density is correspondingly reduced, and it has high thermal insulation, sound insulation, insulation performance and cation exchange ability. It is formed from phlogopite and biotite by low-temperature hydrothermal alteration. It is a good heat insulation and acoustic insulation materials. It is mainly used in the construction industry. It is also used in paper making and coatings,

explanation_cn: 以蛭石为主要原料制成的轻质耐火材料"其强度较低、高温性能较差、使用范围局限在800-900℃以下。
explanation_en: The light-weight refractory made of vermiculite as the main raw material has low strength, poor high temperature performance and limited use range below 800-900 ℃.

explanation_cn: 由面板（蒙皮）与轻质蜂窝芯材通过胶黏剂胶接成的层状复合结构。夹层结构面板可以是铝板或者碳纤维、玻璃纤维、芳纶复合材料板。常用的蜂窝芯材为铝箔、芳纶纸、玻璃布和牛皮纸等，蜂窝芯材按其平面（投影）形状可分为正方形、菱形、斜方形、正弦曲线形和六角形等，以六角形蜂窝夹芯的稳定性最高，制造较容易、用料省、结构效率高，使用最为广泛。
explanation_en: The laminated composition structure is bonded by the panel (skin) and the lightweight honeycomb core through adhesive. The sandwich skin can be aluminum plate or carbon fiber, glass fiber or aramid composite material plate. The commonly used honeycomb core materials are aluminum foil, aramid paper, glass cloth and kraft paper. According to its plane (projection) shape, the honeycomb core materials can be divided into square, diamond, oblique square, sine curve and hexagon. The hexagonal honeycomb sandwich has the highest stability, is easy to manufacture, saves materials, has high structural efficiency, and is most widely used.

explanation_cn: 由两层面纸与中间蜂窝纸芯胶黏而成的纸板。用于制作纸箱和纸盒。
explanation_en: A cardboard made by bonding two layers of paper with a honeycomb paper core in the middle. Used for making cardboard boxes and boxes.

explanation_cn: 又称叶蜡石砖。是以叶蜡石为原料制成的半硅质耐火制品。蜡石的烧失量和烧成收缩小，可直接用来制砖。
explanation_en: It is also called leaf pyzophillite brick. It is a semi silica refractory product made of pyrophyllite. The loss on ignition and shrinkage of wax stone are small, and can be directly used to make bricks.

explanation_cn: 又称整合树脂，是一类能与金属离子形成多配位络合物的交联功能高分子材料。螯合树脂由高分子骨架和配位基闭（配体）两部分组成。螯合树脂在湿法冶金、分析化学、海洋化学、抗菌素药物、环境保护、地球化学、放射化学和催化等领域有广泛的用途。
explanation_en: Also called integrated resin, it is a kind of crosslinking functional macromolecule materials that can form multi coordination complexes with metal ions. Chelate resin consists of macromolecule framework and ligand closure (ligand). Chelate resin is widely used in hydrometallurgy, analytical chemistry, marine chemistry, antibiotics, environmental protection, geochemistry, radiochemistry and catalysis.

explanation_cn: 能从含有金属离子的溶液中以离子键或配位键的形式有选择地螯合特定的金属离子的聚合物。许多天然的和合成的高分子都有螯合性能，天然高分子螯合剂有腐殖酸、甲壳素等，合成的螯合聚合物通常称螯合树脂。其制法一般是通过高分子化学反应或将含冇配位基的单体经聚合或共聚反应，变为在高分子主链或侧链含有配位基的聚合物。
explanation_en: A polymer that selectively chelates specific metal ions in the form of ionic bonds or coordination bonds from a solution containing metal ions. Many natural and synthetic macromolecule have chelating properties. natural polymer chelating agents include humic acid, chitin, etc. Synthetic chelate polymer are usually called chelate resin. Its preparation method is generally through chemical reaction of macromolecule or polymerization or copolymerization of monomer containing no coordination group to become a polymer containing coordination group in the main chain or side chain of macromolecule.

explanation_cn: 伯格斯矢量与位错线平行的位错。围绕位错的原子平面中运动，实际上是螺旋型的，螺旋位错的区域是出于滑移产生显著应变(切应变)的区域。
explanation_en: Burgers vector is a dislocation parallel to the dislocation line. The motion in the atomic plane around the dislocation is actually spiral, and the area of the spiral dislocation is the area where slip produces significant strain (shear strain).

explanation_cn: 钢材表面有螺旋形横肋的钢筋钢，是带肋钢筋钢中的一种通用形式，通常带有两道纵肋和沿长度方向均匀分布的人字形或螺旋形横肋，可以保证与混凝土良好结合。螺纹钢要求具有较高的强度、较高的冷弯性能、与混凝土有良好的附着力。
explanation_en: The concrete steel with spiral transverse ribs on the surface of steel product is a general form of ribbed concrete steel. It usually has two longitudinal ribs and herringbone or spiral transverse ribs evenly distributed along the length direction, which can ensure good combination with concrete. Screw thread steel is required to have high strength, high cold bending performance and good adhesion with concrete.

explanation_cn: 材料在保持应力和温度不变的情况下，应变随时间缓慢增长的现象。金属、高分子材料和岩石等在一定条件下都具有蠕变性质。不同材料的：蠕变微观机制不同：引起多晶体材料蠕变的原因是原子晶间位错引起的点阵滑移以及晶界扩散等；而聚合物的蠕变机理则是高聚物分子在恒定温度及外力长时间作用下发生的构铟和位移变化
explanation_en: The phenomenon that the strain of materials increases slowly with time while keeping the stress and temperature constant. Metals, macromolecule materials and rock all have creep properties under certain conditions. Different materials have different creep micromechanisms: the reasons for creep of polycrystalline materials are lattice slip caused by atomic intergranular dislocation and grain boundary diffusion; The creep mechanism of polymer is the change of indium structure and displacement of polymer molecule under the action of constant temperature and external force for a long time

explanation_cn: 见蠕变试验
explanation_en: See creep test

explanation_cn: 高温长时间载荷作用下.，材料对变形的抗力指标。在实际测定时，需要建立材料的蠕变速率.应力和温度的关系图，采用的温度，时间及应变量一般应按构件服役条件进行选取。
explanation_en: Under high temperature and long-term load, Resistance index of materials to deformation. In actual measurement, it is necessary to establish the relationship diagram of creep rate, stress and temperature of materials, and the temperature, time and strain used should generally be selected according to the service conditions of components.

explanation_cn: 蠕变（恒应力下，应变随时间不断增大）开始到试样断裂的总时间。
explanation_en: The total time from the beginning of creep (under constant stress, the strain increases with time) to the fracture of the specimen.

explanation_cn: 材料蠕变过程中任意时刻的应变与应力之比值。
explanation_en: The ratio of strain to stress at any time during creep of materials.

explanation_cn: 控制稳态蠕变速率的热激活能。随温度升高，蠕变速率增大。
explanation_en: Thermal activation energy controlling steady state creep rate. The creep rate increases with the increase of temperature.

explanation_cn: 由于蠕变而导致材料塑性降低以及在蠕变过程中发生的低应力蠕变断裂的现象。蠕变是塑性变形（滞弹性蠕变除外）.它导致位错密度急剧升高，从而加工硬化。如温度和应力较高或时间较长，这时在晶界可能出现空洞或微裂纹。强度。
