explanation_en: The plastic property of materials is reduced due to creep and low stress creep fracture occurs during creep. Creep is plastic deformation (except anelasticity creep), which leads to a sharp increase in the density of dislocation, resulting in work hardening. If the temperature and stress are high or the time is long, voids or microcracks may appear at the grain boundary. Strength.

explanation_cn: 一种测定材料蠕变极限及其与温度关系曲线的高温力学性能检验方法。材料在高温下所受应力水平虽然远低于材料屈服极限，但随时间延长也会产生缓慢塑性变形，这种变形称为蠕变变形。
explanation_en: A high temperature mechanical property test method for measuring the creep limit of materials and its relationship with temperature. Although the stress level of materials at high temperature is far lower than the yield limit of materials, it will also produce slow plastic deformation with time, which is called creep deformation.

explanation_cn: 材料蠕变柔量-时间双对数曲线上任意时刻的斜率。
explanation_en: The slope of materials creep compliance time double logarithmic curve at any time.

explanation_cn: 石墨形态介于球状和片状之间的虫状的铸铁。采用碳当量较高的铁水，用稀土合金、稀土钙合金或同时使用球化元素Mg与反球化元素Al、Ti等进行处理.即可得到蠕墨铸铁。
explanation_en: Wormlike cast iron with graphite between globular and lamellar shapes. Compacted graphite cast iron can be obtained by using molten iron with high carbon equivalent, rare earth alloy, rare earth calcium alloy or using both spheroidizing elements Mg and anti spheroidizing elements Al, Ti, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称鲍劳特-克莱基链，是研究分子链构象的一种简单的模型链。该模型链对链构象的处理方法是：将链分成很小的单元，使得链上的任何一点的取向对于相邻的点几乎是成连续变化，即链轮廓线上任一点的曲率方向假定是无规的，好似一条弯曲的蠕虫，故称为蠕虫链模型。蠕虫状链可以很好地描述由完全伸展的棒状刚性链到无规线团的整个柔性变化范围的链构象。它特别适合于处理低聚物和刚性分子链的构象。
explanation_en: Also known as the Baurault Kleckey chain, it is a simple model chain for studying the molecular chain conformation. The model chain processes the chain conformation by dividing the chain into very small units so that the orientation of any point on the chain changes almost continuously with respect to adjacent points, that is, the curvature direction of any point on the chain contour is assumed to be random, like a curved worm, so it is called the worm chain model. The worm like chain can well describe the chain conformation of the whole flexible range from the fully extended rod like rigid chain to the random coil. It is particularly suitable for dealing with the conformation of oligomer and rigid molecular chains.

explanation_cn: 将含有毒素或致病物质的血浆从全血中分离出去的治疗方法。它可以清除患者血液中的致病因子如自身抗体、免疫复合物、免疫球蛋白、胆固醇相关的脂蛋白以及代谢毒物等。技术可分为离心和膜式分离。前者是根据血液成分的密度不同，以一定速度离心，利用它们的沉降速率的不同，将血液主要成分（血浆和血球）分开，弃去含毒素的血浆，回输血球到患者体内。膜式分离是利用不同孔径的中空纤维膜，使物质（主要为毒物）通过膜滤掉，而保留血液中的有用成分，同时将血球和分子量大的蛋白质回输体内。其他膜材料有醋酸纤维素，聚丙烯腈和聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯等。膜式分离法，是当前临床上最为广泛使用的方法它主要应用于免疫和代谢两大类疾病，涉及神经、血液、代谢、皮肤、风湿、肾脏等多个领域，甚至近年IH于脓毒症和多器官衰竭。虽然应用优点较多，但需要补充血浆替代液.致使费用增高、感染概率加大。
explanation_en: The treatment method of separating plasma containing toxins or pathogenic substances from whole blood. It can eliminate pathogenic factors such as autoantibodies, immune complexes, immunoglobulins, cholesterol related lipoproteins, and metabolic toxins from the patient's blood. Technology can be divided into centrifugation and membrane separation. The former is to separate the main blood components (plasma and blood cells) according to the different density of the blood components, centrifugate at a certain speed, use their different sedimentation rates, discard the plasma containing toxins, and transfuse blood cells back into the patient's body. Membrane separation is to use hollow fiber membranes with different pore diameters to filter substances (mainly poisons) through the membrane, retain the useful components in the blood, and return blood cells and proteins with large molecular weights to the body. Other membrane materials include cellulose acetate, polyacrylonitrile and polymethyl methacrylate. Membrane separation method is currently the most widely used method in clinical practice. It is mainly applied to two major categories of diseases: immune and metabolic diseases, involving multiple fields such as nerves, blood, metabolism, skin, rheumatism, kidneys, and even in recent years, IH has been used in sepsis and multiple organ failure. Although there are many advantages in application, it is necessary to supplement plasma replacement solution, which increases the cost and probability of infection.

explanation_cn: 具有载氧、放氧，并在体内具行和二氧化碳进行交换能力的血红蛋白代用品。血液代用品主要用于手术、创伤（战争）大量失血后进行补充，可分为氟碳化合物乳液和多聚血红蛋内类。20世纪90年代末期成功开发的产品是全氟溴辛烷、全氟二氯辛烷和以蛋黄卵磷脂为表面活性剂的全氟溴烷乳剂。该乳剂的安全便用量为1.8g/kg，增加剂量可引起暂时性发热和血小板降低。以全氟二氯辛烷为基本原料的另一个产品为乙氧氟草醚(oxyfluor)。全氟碳乳剂能很好地携带氟，在室温下能稳定保持数年，但在体内半衰期较短，有补体激活等副作用。另一类血液代用品为多聚血红蛋白，它是由45个血红蛋白分子通过交联形成的可溶性大分子复合物，其分子量分布很宽。由于小分子量二聚体有肾毒性，因此需要进行纯化。聚合血红蛋白可以很好地结合氧，而在组织需要时又能放出氧，但体内寿命只有1224h，大量使用会引起脾胃不适和血压升高，这是第一代代用品，只能短期使用。
explanation_en: A hemoglobin substitute with the ability to carry oxygen, release oxygen, and exchange with carbon dioxide in the body. Blood substitute are mainly used to supplement blood loss after surgery and trauma (war). They can be divided into fluorocarbon lotion and polyhemoglobin. The products successfully developed in the late 1990s were perfluorobromooctane, perfluorodichlorooctane, and perfluorobromooctane emulsions using egg yolk lecithin as a surfactant. The safe dosage of this emulsion is 1.8g/kg, and increasing the dosage can cause temporary fever and thrombocytopenia. Another product based on perfluorodichlorooctane is oxyfluoro. Perfluorocarbon emulsion can carry fluorine well and keep it stable for several years at room temperature, but it has a short half life in vivo and has side effects such as complement activation. The other type of blood substitute is polyhemoglobin, which is a soluble macromolecule complex formed by 45 hemoglobin molecules through crosslinking, with a wide molecular weight distribution. Due to the nephrotoxicity of small molecular weight dimers, purification is necessary. Polymerization hemoglobin can combine oxygen well and release oxygen when needed by tissues, but its life span in vivo is only 1224h. Large use will cause spleen stomach discomfort and blood pressure rise. This is the first generation substitute, which can only be used for a short time.

explanation_cn: 是一种体外循环技术。主要包括血液透析、血液滤过、血液灌流（含吸附剂）及血浆置换。它的作用原理是通过扩散、对流和吸附等作用清除外源性和自身病理代谢过程产生的毒素.同时还能清除氧自由基等产物.并能超滤出体内多余的水分。除此之外它能平衡机体酸碱，保护心、肾、肝、肺、神经、胃肠和脑免受毒物的损伤。血液净化的核心技术是采用含有活性基团、孔径不同的树脂颗粒、中空纤维和膜材料。该技术的治疗优点是治疗安全性高、血流动力学稳定，可清除各种大、中、小的毒物分子，效率高，费用合理，能为广大患者接受。
explanation_en: It is an extracorporeal circulation technique. It mainly includes hemodialysis, hemofiltration, hemoperfusion (including adsorbent) and plasma exchange. Its principle of action is to remove toxins generated by exogenous and pathological metabolism processes through diffusion, convection and adsorption. At the same time, it can also remove oxygen free radicals and other products, and can ultrafiltration excess water in the body. In addition, it can balance the body's acid-base balance and protect the heart, kidneys, liver, lungs, nerves, gastrointestinal tract, and brain from toxic damage. The core technology of blood purification is to use resin particles, hollow fiber and membrane materials with active groups and different pore sizes. The treatment advantages of this technology are high treatment safety, stable hemodynamics, and the ability to remove various large, medium, and small toxic molecules. It has high efficiency, reasonable cost, and can be accepted by a large number of patients.

explanation_cn: 用于清除患者血液中致病物质的生物材料。如人工肾或人工肝辅助装置中的膜、中空纤维、吸附树脂。
explanation_en: Biomaterials used to remove pathogenic substances from the patient's blood. Such as membrane, hollow fiber and adsorption resin in artificial kidney or artificial liver auxiliary device.

explanation_cn: 指通过血液灌流能将血液中的致病因子，药物内、外源性毒物吸附.清除的材料。采用的材料冇天然和合成的高分子物质，是血液净化材料的一种。
explanation_en: It refers to the materials that can absorb and remove pathogenic factors, internal and external poisons in the blood through hemoperfusion. The materials used is a kind of blood purification materials with natural and synthetic macromolecule substances.

explanation_cn: 是模仿背单位的滤过重吸收的作用原理，将患者的动脉血输人到具有良好通透性的半透膜滤过器中，在压力作用下，滤出大量水分和清除不同分子量大小的毒物。与此同时，通过输液装置补充与细胞外液成分相似的电解液，达到血液净化的目的。目前越来越多地用于肝昏迷，以及各种内外源性中毒、心力衰竭、难治高血讯、肺水肿和多脏器衰竭等疾病。
explanation_en: It imitates the principle of filtration and reabsorption of the dorsal unit, infusing the patient's arterial blood into a semi permeable membrane filter with good permeability. Under pressure, it filters out a large amount of water and removes toxins of different molecular weights. At the same time, blood purification can be achieved by supplementing electrolyte with components similar to extracellular fluid through infusion device. Currently, it is increasingly used for liver coma, as well as various diseases such as internal and external sources of poisoning, heart failure, refractory hyperglycemia, pulmonary edema, and multiple organ failure.

explanation_cn: 是指采用血液灌流方法净化血液时所用的吸附材料。这种材料一般是由三部分构成：一般以高分子化合物为载体，具有吸附作用的物质为配基，将上述二者交联或偶联起来的物质为手臂。吸附的作用机制是吸附剂与被吸附物质（毒素）通过静电、氢键和范德华力的相识别和作用。常用的载体材料有吸附树脂和离子交换树脂、琼脂糖凝胶、纤维素、葡聚糖、聚乙烯醇及活性炭等多孔材料。活性配基可以是特定蛋白、多肽、抗体和各种氨基酸等。吸附材料用于血液净化是近年发展起来的治疗方法。它对一些疑难疾病的救治显示了巨大的潜力。目前血液吸附疗法已成功应用于救治自身免疫性疾病如红斑狼疮、类风湿关节炎、肝、肾衰竭、药物（农药）急忭中毒等患者.并向脓毒病和多器官衰竭方面发展。
explanation_en: It refers to the adsorption materials used for purifying blood by hemoperfusion. This materials is generally composed of three parts: generally, macromolecule compounds are used as carriers, substances with adsorption are used as ligands, and substances crosslinking or coupled with the above two are used as arms. The mechanism of adsorption is the recognition and interaction between adsorbent and adsorbed substance (toxin) through electrostatic, hydrogen bond and van der Waals force. Common carrier materials include porous materials such as adsorption resin and ion exchange resin, agarose gel, cellulose, dextran, polyvinyl alcohol and activated carbon. Active ligands can be specific proteins, peptides, antibodies, and various amino acids. Adsorbent materials for blood purification is a therapeutic method developed in recent years. It has shown great potential for the treatment of some difficult diseases. At present, blood adsorption therapy has been successfully applied to treat patients with autoimmune diseases such as lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis, liver and kidney failure, drug (pesticide) acute poisoning, and has developed towards sepsis and multiple organ failure.

explanation_cn: 材料与血液直接接触时，与血液相互作用不引起凝血或血栓、不损伤血液组成和功能等的能力和性质。既涉及到材料对血液的作用.又涉及血液对材料的影响。生物学反应判断一种医用材料的血液相容性，通常是从其抗凝血能力和不损伤血液成分和功能两方面来考虑。前者为材料表面抑制血管内血液形成血栓的能力，后者指材料对血液的溶血现象（红细胞破坏），血小板数量减少、机能降低，血细胞暂时性减少，白细胞功能下降以及补体激活等血液生理功能的影响。此外，还要考虑材料不致使血浆蛋白变性，不影响血液中存在的各种酶的活性，不改变血液中电解质浓度，不引起有害免疫反应等问题。生物材料血液相容性的评价，目前以凝血与溶血作为主要内容。包括材料表面理化特性，血浆蛋白的竞争吸附，血小板的黏附与激活，红细胞、白细胞的黏附、变形与激活，内源性凝固系统的接触活化。溶纤系统、酶及补体系统等8个方面。此外，要用多种方法来评价，而不能单凭一种方法的试验结果来评价。
explanation_en: When the materials is in direct contact with blood, its interaction with blood will not cause coagulation or thrombosis, and will not damage the ability and nature of blood composition and function. It involves both the effect of materials on blood and the influence of blood on materials. Biological reaction is usually used to judge the Wood compatibility of a medical materials from its anticoagulant ability and not damaging the blood composition and function. The former refers to the ability of surface of materials to inhibit the formation of blood clots in blood vessels, while the latter refers to the influence of materials on blood physiological functions such as hemolysis (destruction of red blood cells), reduction of platelet number and function, temporary reduction of blood cells, decline of white blood cell function, and activation of complement. In addition, materials shall not denature plasma proteins, affect the activities of various enzymes in the blood, change the concentration of elonrolyte in the blood, or cause harmful immune reactions. At present, coagulation and hemolysis are the main contents of Wood compatibility evaluation of biological materials. It includes the physical and chemical properties of surface of materials, competitive adsorption of plasma protein, adhesion and activation of platelets, adhesion, deformation and activation of red blood cells and white blood cells, and contact activation or conditioning of endogenous coagulation system. Fiber dissolving system, enzyme and complement system. In addition, multiple methods should be used to evaluate, rather than relying solely on the experimental results of one method.

explanation_cn: 指与血液接触时，不引起凝血或溶血，不损伤血液组成和功能的材料。优异的应当没有如下特征：①植入物释放一些成分或它的降解产物进人血液，引起血凝结、炎症、致癌和毒性反应;②植入物激活血小板活性，出现血栓塞;③植入物会引发炎症反应和滞后感染。由此看到，血液相容性是植入器械性质的多参量函数。在这个意义上，理想的血液相容性聚合物几乎从来没有得到过，只有部分满足血液相容性要求的聚合物能够得到。血液相容性评价是生物材料研究中最为活跃的领域之一，也是制约血液循环系统相关生物材料临床应用的首要因素。血液相容性的影响因素繁多，除血液固有成分的影响外，材料的表面界面特征亦起着决定性作用，如表面自由能、化学基团的分布、异质性、多孔性、光滑度等。常用的血液相容性材料有：聚二氧六环硅氧烷、醋酸纤维膜、聚丙烯氯、聚四氟乙烯、尼龙、聚氨酯、各向同性裂解碳、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯等。这些材料可用来制作介入导管、表面改性单叶心脏瓣膜、新的心脏瓣膜、表面改性的心脏瓣膜的瓣环等。近年来，对血液相容性材料的研究已由研制和开发不与血小板和凝血因子发生反应的中性材料转向对生物活性材料的开发，如肝素化材料、释放一氧化氮的材料、水胶体表面改性物、聚氨基甲酸己酯（PU)、聚苯乙烯（PS)的衍生物等。目前主要是通过对材料进行表面改性来提高材料的血液相容性。
explanation_en: It refers to materials that do not cause coagulation or hemolysis and do not damage blood composition and function when contacting with blood. Excellent implants should not have the following characteristics: ① implants release some components or its degradation products into the blood, causing blood coagulation, inflammation, carcinogenesis and toxic reactions; ② Implants activate platelet activity and cause thromboembolism; ③ Implants can trigger inflammatory reactions and delayed infections. It can be seen that Wood compatibility is a multi parameter function of the nature of implantation devices. In this sense, ideal Wood compatibility polymer have almost never been obtained, and only some polymer that meet the requirements of Wood compatibility can be obtained. Wood compatibility evaluation is one of the most active fields in the research of biological materials, and also the primary factor restricting the clinical application of biological materials related to the blood circulation system. There are many factors affecting Wood compatibility. In addition to the influence of blood intrinsic components, the surface and interface characteristics of materials also play a decisive role, such as surface free energy, distribution of chemical groups, heterogeneity, porosity, smoothness, etc. Common hemocompability materials include polydioxane, acetate fiber membrane, polypropylene chloride, polylctrafluorocthylone, nylon resin, polyurethime, isotropic pyrolysis carbon, polymethyl methacrylate, etc. These materials can be used to make interventional catheter, surface modified single leaf heart valves, new heart valves, valve rings of surface modified heart valves, etc. In recent years, the research on hemocompability materials has shifted from the development of neutral materials that do not react with platelets and coagulation factors to the development of bioactive materials, such as heparin materials, materials that release nitric oxide, hydrocolloid surface modifiers, polyhexyl carbamate (PU), polystyrene (PS) derivatives, etc. At present, the Wood compatibility of materials is mainly improved by surface modification of materials.

explanation_cn: 将血中的大分子（蛋白质、多糖等）与小分子（氨基酸、葡萄糖等）通过半透膜分开的方法。它是治疗急性宵衰竭和终末期肾病常用和成熟的方法。利用唐南（Donnan)膜平衡原理，将患者血液与透析液同时引入透析器，在透析膜两侧呈逆向流动。借助膜两侧溶质浓度、渗透压和水压的梯度，通过扩散和对流等作用将毒素清除掉。同时通过超滤和渗透将过多的水分排出体外，然后补充需要的物质，调节电解质和酸碱平衡。血液透析可部分代替正常肾脏的排泄、解毒功能，但无分泌、代谢功能。
explanation_en: The method of separating macromolecule (protein, polysaccharide, etc.) and small molecule (amino acid, glucose, etc.) in blood through a semipermeable membrane. It is a commonly used and mature method for treating acute renal failure and end-stage renal disease. Using Donnan's membrane balance principle, the patient's blood and dialysate were introduced into the dialyzer at the same time, with reverse flow on both sides of the dialysis membrane. With the aid of the gradient of solute concentration, osmotic pressure and water pressure on both sides of the membrane, toxins are removed through diffusion and convection. At the same time, excessive water is discharged from the body through ultrafiltration and osmosis, and then the needed substances are supplemented to adjust the elonrolyte and acid-base balance. Hemodialysis can partially replace the excretion and detoxification functions of normal kidneys, but has no secretion and metabolism functions.

explanation_cn: 指血液透析与血液滤过联机使用的治疗模式。它综合了两种方法的优点，提高了对各种不同分子大小的毒素的清除能力，简化了传统的血液透析和滤过技术，使其变得更经济可行。更重要的是它减少了透析液被细菌及其他微生物污染的可能性，使其更安全，成为当今最佳血液净化技术之一。根据需要选择合适的滤膜，可以高效率清除小、中、大分子量毒物，用于治疗透析与滤过方法的疾病。常使用的膜材料有聚砜、聚酰胺、聚丙烯腈、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯以及二醋酸纤维素膜等。
explanation_en: It refers to the treatment mode of hemodialysis and hemofiltration. It combines the advantages of the two methods, improves the ability to remove toxins of different molecular sizes, simplifies the traditional hemodialysis and filtration technology, and makes it more economical and feasible. More importantly, it reduces the possibility of dialysis fluid being contaminated by bacteria and other microorganisms, making it safer and becoming one of the best blood purification technologies today. Select appropriate filter membrane according to needs, which can efficiently remove small, medium and macromolecule poisons, and can be used to treat dialysis and filtration diseases. The commonly used membrane materials are polysulfone, polyamide, polyacrylonitrile, polymethyl methacrylate and cellulose diacetate membrane.

explanation_cn: 是血液透析器中用来制造中空纤维的材料。常用的材料有纤维素膜、聚丙烯腈膜、聚砜膜、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯膜、聚碳酸酯膜等。膜材料血液相容性是透析器的重要指标。对蛋内质的吸附、对血小板的黏附以及激活补体和凝血系统都应控制在一个较低的水平。半透膜的结构和性质直接影响透析的质量，例如膜的表面积、孔径、孔隙率、截留分子量等，对透析时溶质传质速率和清除毒物分子的大小都具有决定性影响。例如膜的表面积大，传质快，透析时间就短。孔大截留分子量大，可清除小分子和中分子毒物。
explanation_en: It is a materials used to make hollow fiber in blood dialyzer. Common materials include cellulose membrane, polyacrylonitrile membrane, polysulfone membrane, polymethyl methacrylate membrane, polycarbonate membrane, etc. Wood compatibility of membrane materials is an important index of dialyzer. The adsorption of egg endoplasmic reticulum, adhesion to platelets, and activation of complement and coagulation systems should be controlled at a lower level. The structure and properties of semi permeable membranes directly affect the quality of dialysis, such as the surface area, pore size, porosity, and retained molecular weight of the membrane, which have a decisive impact on the solute mass transfer rate and the size of toxic molecules removed during dialysis. For example, the membrane has a large surface area, fast mass transfer, and short dialysis time. The pore size intercepts large molecular weights and can remove small and medium molecule toxins.

explanation_cn: 指在管腔球囊扩张成型的基础上，在病变段置人内支架以达到支撑狭窄闭塞段血管、减少血管弹性回缩及再塑形、保持管腔血流通畅的目的。部分内支架还具有预防再狭窄的作用，主要分为冠脉支架、脑、肾动脉支架、大动脉支架等，采用金属或高分子材料加工制成，可短期或暂时留于人体血管内，目前常用于制作支架的材料有金属钽、医用不诱钢及镍钛合金等。支架的类型按照在血管内展开的方式分可分为自展式和球囊扩张式两种。前者如Z形支架及网眼状的支架等，可在血管内自行扩张。后者自身无弹性，依靠球囊扩张到一定径值而贴附于血管内。支架按表面处理情况分可分为裸露型、涂层型和覆膜型。裸露型表面仅作抛光处理：涂层型在金属表面涂以肝素、氧化钛等物质;覆膜型即在金属支架外表覆以可降解或不可降解的聚合物薄膜。按功能分可分为单纯支撑型支架和治疗型支架治疗型支架包括在支架外表涂带药物或利用支架外的覆膜携带治疗物质的支架或放射性支架。
explanation_en: It refers to the placement of an internal stem in the diseased segment on the basis of balloon dilation to support the vessels in the stenosis and occlusion segment, reduce the elasticity retraction and remodeling of the vessels, and maintain smooth blood flow in the lumen. Some internal stem also have the function of preventing restenosis, which are mainly divided into coronary stem, cerebral and renal artery stem, and major artery stem. They are made of metal or macromolecule materials and can be kept in human blood vessels for a short time or temporarily. At present, materials commonly used to make stem include tantalum, medical steel and nickel titanium alloy. The types of stem can be divided into self expanding and balloon expanding according to the way of unfolding in the blood vessel. The former, such as Z-shaped stem and mesh shaped stem, can expand itself in the blood vessel. The latter has no elasticity of its own and adheres to the blood vessel by means of balloon expansion to a certain diameter. Stem can be divided into bare type, coated type and film covered type according to surface treatment. The exposed surface is only polished: the coating type is coated with substances such as heparin and titanium oxide on the metal surface; Film covered type means that the surface of the metal stem is covered with degradation or non degradation polymer film. According to the function, it can be divided into simple support stem and therapeutic stem therapeutic stem, including stem or radioactive stem coated with drugs on the surface of stem or coated with therapeutic materials outside stem.

explanation_cn: 采用行星式乳机生产板带或陴壁管的轧制方式，多个行星辊相继通过坯料变形区，似轧似锻地周期性压缩坯料，虽然每个行星辊的压下量很小，但每秒内通过变形的行星辊数很多。故主要优点为轧制力小，但道次总压下可高达90%以上。主要缺点为结构复杂，维修工作量大，振动和噪声大，生产质量不稳定，产品表面质量差，故发展缓慢。
explanation_en: The rolling method of producing plate, strip or wall tube with planetary milk machine is adopted. Several planetary rollers pass through the billet deformation area successively, and the billet is compressed periodically as if rolling or forging. Although the reduction of each planetary roller is very small, the number of planetary rollers passing through the deformation per second is very large. Therefore, the main advantage is that the rolling force is small, but the total pressure of the pass can reach over 90%. The main drawbacks are complex structure, heavy maintenance workload, high vibration and noise, unstable production quality, and poor surface quality of products, resulting in slow development.

explanation_cn: 材料接触血液时抑制补体激活的能力。补体系统激活是一个快速放大的级联反应，并产生多种生物学效应，对机体既有保护作用，又有损伤作用。正常情况下，体内补体系统激活与抑制处于一个动态调控过程中，控制补体的过度激活，防止补体成分过度消耗和对自身组织的损伤这种调控可通过补体成分自身衰变，以及血清中和细胞膜上存在的各种调节因子实现。
explanation_en: The ability of materials to inhibit complement activation when contacting blood. The activation of the complement system is a rapid amplification cascade reaction, and produces a variety of biological effects, which have both protective and injurious effects on the body. Under normal circumstances, the activation and inhibition of the complement system in the body are in a dynamic regulation process, which can control the excessive activation of the complement, prevent the excessive consumption of the complement components and damage to their own tissues. This regulation can be achieved through the decay of the complement components themselves, as well as various regulatory factors existing in the serum and cell membrane.

explanation_cn: 材料与血液接触时激活补体系统的能力。
explanation_en: The ability of materials to activate the complement system when contacting with blood.

explanation_cn: 补体系统是指一群广泛存在于血清、组织液和细胞膜表面具有酶活性的蛋白质反应系统，在机体抵御感染中起着重要作用，但补体异常活化也参与许多炎症性疾病的发生和发展。
explanation_en: The complement system refers to a group of protein reaction systems with enzyme activity widely existing in serum, tissue fluid and cell membrane surface, which plays an important role in the body's resistance to infection. However, abnormal activation or conditioning of complement is also involved in the occurrence and development of many inflammatory diseases.

explanation_cn: 不掺杂的半导体是本征半导体；掺有施主的半导体是n型半导体，掺有受主的半导体是p型半导体；而补偿半导体是掺有两种杂质的半导体。由于补偿半导体中掺有两种杂质，则就要产生杂质的补偿作用，从而其中能够参加导电的多数载流子，就只有由那些未被补偿的杂质来提供；因此补偿半导体中有效的载流子浓度很小，故电阻率很高。虽然补偿半导体的电阻率很高，但它不同于未掺杂的本征半导体。对于强补偿半导体，还往往因为掺杂浓度不均匀而造成电子电势的起伏，使得导带底和价带顶出现起伏（禁带宽度不变），从而可形成所谓电子和空穴的“液滴”。
explanation_en: Undoped semiconductor is intrinsic semiconductor; Semiconductors doped with donors are n-type semiconductors, while semiconductors doped with acceptors are p-type semiconductors; The compensated semicondurtor is a semiconductor doped with two kinds of impurities. Since there are two kinds of impurities in the compensated semicondurtor, the compensation effect of impurities will be generated, so most carriers that can participate in the conduction are only provided by those impurities that are not compensated; Therefore, the effective carrier concentration in compensated semicondurtor is very small, so the resistivity is very high. Although the resistivity of compensated semicondurtor is very high, it is different from the undoped intrinsic semiconductor. For strong compensated semicondurtor, the uneven doping concentration often causes fluctuations in the electron potential, which makes the bottom of the conduction band and the top of the valence band fluctuate (the band gap width remains unchanged), thus forming so-called "droplets" of electrons and holes.

explanation_cn: 表皮生长因子（EGF）是一种由53个氨基酸残基组成的耐热单链低分子多肽。EGF与靶细胞上的EGF受体特异性识别结合后，发生一系列生化反应，最终可促进靶细胞的DNA合成及有丝分裂。EGF无糖基部位，非常稳定，耐热耐酸，广泛存在于体液和多种腺体中，主要由颌下腺、十二指肠合成，在人体的绝大多数体液中均已发现，在乳汁、尿液、精液中的含量特异性地增高，但在血清中的浓度较低。EGF作用广泛，对估计肿瘤预后，选择治疗方案以及胃溃疡、肝功能衰竭等治疗上均有重要意义。临床可采用放射免疫法（RIA）或双抗体酶联免疫吸附法（ELISA）测定血清或体液中EGF含量。
explanation_en: Epidermal growth factor (EGF) is a heat resistant single chain low molecular polypeptide composed of 53 amino acid residues. After EGF specifically recognizes and binds to EGF receptors on target cells, a series of biochemical reactions occur, ultimately promoting DNA synthesis and mitosis in target cells. EGF has a sugar free site, is very stable, heat-resistant and acid resistant, and is widely present in body fluids and various glands. It is mainly synthesized by the submandibular gland and duodenum. It has been found in the vast majority of body fluids in the human body, with a specific increase in content in milk, urine, and semen, but a lower concentration in serum. EGF has a wide range of effects and is of great significance in estimating tumor prognosis, selecting treatment plans, and treating gastric ulcers, liver failure, and other diseases. Radioimmunoassay (RIA) or double antibody enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) can be used in clinical practice to determine the content of EGF in serum or body fluids.

explanation_cn: 流体流动中给走应力与应变速率之比。
explanation_en: The ratio of given stress to strain rate in fluid flow.

explanation_cn: 表面和界面的偏析是一种在合金或含杂质的材料中常发生的物理现象。这一现象可以显著地改变材料本身的特性，比如抗氧化、抗腐蚀性。
explanation_en: Surface and interface segregation is a physical phenomenon that often occurs in alloy or materials containing impurities. This phenomenon can significantly change the characteristics of materials, such as oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance.

explanation_cn: 参见表面粗糙度。
explanation_en: See surface roughness.

explanation_cn: 表面光电压法，简称SPV法，是通过测量由于光照在半导体材料表面产生的表面电压来获得少数载流子扩散长度的方法。原理是: 用能量大于半导体材料禁带宽度的单色光照射在半导体材料表面，在其内部产生电子-空穴对，受浓度梯度驱动扩散至半导体材料近表面空间电荷区的电子和空穴将被自建电场分离，形成光生电压，即表面光电压。
explanation_en: The surface photovoltage method, or SPV method for short, is a method to obtain the diffusion length of minority carriers by measuring the surface voltage generated on the surface of semiconductor materials due to illumination. The principle is: irradiate the surface of semiconductor materials with monochromatic light with energy greater than the band gap width of semiconductor materials, generate electron hole pairs inside, and the electrons and holes diffusion to the space charge area near the surface of semiconductor materials driven by the concentration gradient will be separated by the self built electric field to form photovoltage, that is, surface photovoltage.

explanation_cn: 表面声子，是指晶体表面可看作准二维晶格，准二维晶格格波的量子。当固体介质表面受到交替变化的表面张力作用时，质点作相应的纵横向复合振动，此时，质点振动所引起的波动传播只在固体介质表面进行，能量集中于固体表层内，故称声表面波(SAW)。弹性介质理论适用于波矢比布里渊边界小得多的声学表面波。当表面波的局域较强或波长较短时，连续介质理论不再适用，表面因为对称性的降低而显现出表面声子性质的重要性。
explanation_en: Surface phonon refers to the quantum of crystal surface that can be seen as quasi two-dimensional lattice, quasi two-dimensional lattice wave. When the surface of a solid medium is subjected to alternating surface tension, the particles undergo corresponding longitudinal and transverse composite vibrations. At this time, the wave propagation caused by the particle vibration only occurs on the surface of the solid medium, and the energy is concentrated within the surface of the solid, hence it is called surface acoustic wave (SAW). The elasticity medium theory is applicable to acoustic surface waves whose wave vector is much smaller than Brillouin boundary. When the local area of the surface wave is strong or the wavelength is short, the continuum theory is no longer applicable, and the surface shows the importance of surface phonon properties due to the reduction of symmetry.

explanation_cn: 由拉伸或者弯曲引起材料表面面积的变化，同时消耗能量，材料产生此种单位面积变化所消耗的能量称为表面应力。
explanation_en: The change of surface of materials area caused by tension or bending consumes energy at the same time. The energy consumed by materials to produce such unit area change is called surface stress.

explanation_cn: 液体表面荷受最小表面力的趋向，像拉伸膜具有的特性。表面张力可定量地用表面张力系数表示。表面张力与液体性质及液面外相邻物质的性质有关，此外还与温度及液体所含杂质有关。
explanation_en: The tendency of a liquid surface to bear the minimum surface force, similar to the characteristics of a stretched film. Surface tension can be expressed quantitatively by surface tension coefficient. The surface tension is related to the properties of the liquid and the adjacent substances outside the liquid surface, as well as the temperature and impurities contained in the liquid.

explanation_cn: 原子在晶体表面的迁移。对多晶体材料扩散可以沿着=种不同的路径进行，即晶格扩散实验结果表明沿表面扩散所需的扩散激活能最低，其次是晶界扩散，而晶格扩散激活能最大。
explanation_en: The migration of atoms on the surface of a crystal. Diffusion of multi crystalline materials can be carried out along=different paths, that is, lattice diffusion experiment results show that diffusion activation energy required for diffusion along surface diffusion is the lowest, followed by grain boundary diffusion, and lattice diffusion activation energy is the largest.

explanation_cn: 通过施加覆盖层或改变表面形貌、化学组分、相组成、微观结构、缺陷状态.达到提高材料抵御环境作用能力或赋予材料表面某种功能特性的材料工艺技术。
explanation_en: Materials process technology that can improve the ability of materials to resist environmental effects or endow surface of materials with certain functional characteristics by applying a coating or changing the surface morphology, chemical composition, phase composition, microstructure, and defect state.

explanation_cn: 以化学或物理方法对纤维进行表面处理得到的具有某些特殊性能的纤维。
explanation_en: Fibers with certain special properties obtained by surface treatment of fibers using chemical or physical methods.

explanation_cn: 球形颗粒的表面积与直径的平方成正比，其体积与直径的立方成正比，故其比表面积（表面积体积）与直径成反比。随着颗粒直径的变小，比表面积将会显著地增加，颗粒表面原子相对增多，从而使这些表面原子具有很高的活性且极不稳定，致使颗粒表现出不一样的特性，这就是表面效应。
explanation_en: The surface area of a spherical particle is proportional to the square of its diameter, and its volume is proportional to the cube of its diameter, so its specific surface (surface area volume) is inversely proportional to its diameter. With the decrease of particle diameter, the specific surface will increase significantly, and the surface atoms of particles will increase relatively, so that these surface atoms have high activity and are extremely unstable, resulting in particles showing different characteristics, which is called surface effect.

explanation_cn: 通过物理吸附、化学结合、自组装等手段将生物活性物质装载到生物材料表面，从而使材料在生理环境下诱发特定的生物学反应。所装载的生物活性物质包括生长因子、细胞外基质、蛋白质、DNA等。
explanation_en: Bioactivity substances are loaded onto the surface of biological materials through physical adsorption, chemical binding, self-assembly and other means, so that materials can induce specific biological reactions under physiological environment. The loaded bioactivity substances include growth factors, extracellular matrix, protein, DNA, etc.

explanation_cn: 晶体表面由于原子排列三维平移周期性中断，或因表面重构、吸附等变化而产生的不同于体内的电子能态。
explanation_en: The electronic energy states on the surface of crystal are different from those in the body due to the periodic interruption of the three-dimensional translation of the atomic arrangement, or changes in surface reconstruction, adsorption, etc.

explanation_cn: 在物体表面利用等离子发生器所产生的等离子进行的聚合。主要应用于对物体的表面改性。
explanation_en: Polymerization on the surface of an object using the plasma generated by a plasma generator. Mainly used for surface modification of objects.

name_cn: 表面等离子共振生物传感器
explanation_cn: 表面等离子共振生物传感器，是基于生物分子在识别并形成复合物过程中，引起界面折射率变化与一定波长的入射光在界面形成的反射光衰减程度存在直接的相关性的原理而研制的一种光学检测仪器。表面等离子共振生物传感器这种光学检测过程包含了三个最重要的物理学现象: 金属表面存在等离子体电磁波; 这种电磁波吸收平行于界面的平面偏振光(p-极化) 时会发生共振; 等离子体共振的发生不仅会导致反射光的强度减弱，而且也会受金属表面吸附物折射率(介电常数) 的变化所控制SPR生物传感器的特点: 无标记、样品量少(1μg 配体)、实时动态监测、灵敏度高、高通量、对待测液浑浊与否无要求、应用领域广。SPR 生物传感器可实时、原位和动态观测各种生物分子，如DNA、RNA、多肽、蛋白质、寡聚糖、脂质/囊、病毒、细菌、噬菌体和细胞等之间的相互作用，在药物筛选、临床诊断、食物检测及环境监控、膜生物学等领域已经得到了广泛的应用。
explanation_en: The surface plasmon res onance (SPR) biosensor is an optical detection instrument developed based on the principle that there is a direct correlation between the change of the refractive index of the interface caused by biomolecules in the process of recognizing and forming the complex and the attenuation degree of the reflected light formed at the interface by the incident light of a certain wavelength. The optical detection process of surface plasmon res onance (SPR) biosensor includes three most important physical phenomena: there are plasma electromagnetic waves on the metal surface; This kind of electromagnetic wave will resonate when it absorbs plane polarized light (p - polarization) parallel to the interface; The occurrence of plasma resonance will not only weaken the intensity of reflected light, but also be controlled by the change of the refractive index (dielectric constant) of the metal surface adsorbate. The characteristics of the SPR biosensor are: no label, small sample size (1 μ G ligand), real-time dynamic monitoring, high sensitivity, high throughput, no requirements for the turbidity of the test solution, and wide application fields. SPR biosensor can observe the interaction between various biomolecules in real time, in situ and dynamically, such as DNA, RNA, polypeptide, protein, oligosaccharide, lipid/capsule, virus, bacteria, bacteriophage and cell, and has been widely used in drug screening, clinical diagnosis, food detection and environmental monitoring, membrane biology and other fields.

explanation_cn: 表面粗糙度一般是由所采用的加工方法和其他因素所形成的，例如加工过程中刀具与零件表面间的摩擦、切屑分离时表面层金属的塑性变形以及工艺系统中的高频振动等。由于加工方法和工件材料的不同，被加工表面留下痕迹的深浅、疏密、形状和纹理都有差别。
explanation_en: Surface roughness is generally formed by the processing method used and other factors, such as the friction between the tool and the part surface during processing, the plastic deformation of the surface layer metal during chip separation, and the high-frequency vibration in the process system. Due to different processing methods and materials of the workpiece, the depth, density, shape and texture of the traces left on the machined surface are different.

explanation_cn: 在垂直板面的拉伸载荷作用下，规定深度的试件面层破坏时的I最大荷载与试件受载面积之比。
explanation_en: The ratio of the maximum load to the loaded area of the specimen when the surface layer of the specimen fails at a specified depth under the tensile load acting on the vertical plate surface.

explanation_cn: 表面能是恒温、恒压、恒组成情况下，可逆地增加物系表面积须对物质所做的非体积功。表面能的另一种定义是，表面粒子相对于内部粒子所多出的能量。表面能是创造物质表面时对分子间化学键破坏的度量。
explanation_en: The surface energy is the non volume work that must be done on the matter to increase the surface area of the system reversibly under the condition of constant temperature, pressure and composition. Another definition of surface energy is the extra energy of surface particles relative to internal particles. Surface energy is a measure of the destruction of intermolecular chemical bonds when creating material surfaces.

name_en: test of bond strength (adhesion strength) of surface film
explanation_cn: 对表面膜与基体材料表面彼此保持黏附状态固有的结合强度的测试。最常用的两种测试标准方法是划痕测试法和撕裂法。
explanation_en: Test on the inherent bonding strength of the surface facial mask and the matrix surface of materials in the adhesion state. The two most commonly used test standard methods are scratch lest method and pull off method.

explanation_cn: 材料表面发生的腐蚀、分解、溶解或分子量降低的过程，材料内部的性质则不发生变化。某种材料是否发生表面降解与材料的化学结构、分子量和形态等本身因素以及降解介质等外界条件相关。
explanation_en: The process of corrosion, decomposition, dissolution or molecular weight reduction on the surface of materials does not change the internal properties of materials. The surface degradation of a materials is related to the chemical structure, molecular weight and morphology of the materials, as well as external conditions such as degradation medium.

explanation_cn: 在制造液晶显示器时，需要确保液晶层间隙为一定的厚度。这个厚度通常叫作盒厚，一般为几微米。为了制备这样小的盒厚，并且保证其均匀性.必须在封框料中加入一些衬垫材料，同时在显示器内也均匀散布一些衬垫材料。液晶层的厚度就是靠这些衬垫材料将两片玻璃支撑起来所形成的间隙。衬垫材料有多种，可分为树脂制的液晶盒内使用的球状衬热材料、玻璃纤维制的通常用于封框胶里的棒状衬锒材料和二氧化硅制的用于周边封U部等处的球状衬热材料等。
explanation_en: When manufacturing liquid crystal displays, it is necessary to ensure that the gap between the liquid crystal layers is of a certain thickness. This thickness is usually called box thickness, which is usually a few micrometers. In order to prepare such a small box thickness and ensure its uniformity, some spacer must be added to the frame sealing material, and some spacer must also be evenly distributed in the display. The thickness of the liquid crystal layer is the gap formed by the two pieces of glass supported by these spacer. There are many kinds of spacer, which can be divided into spherical liner materials used in the liquid crystal cell made of resin, rod liner materials made of glass fiber, which is usually used in the sealing adhesive, and spherical liner materials made of silicon dioxide, which is used in the peripheral sealing U part, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称包覆层，黏结在固体推进剂表面，起到控制药柱燃烧面积、降低或消除药柱在制造、储存和应用过程中可能产生的各种应力的作用，在某些推进剂中含有迁移性的成分（如硝酸酯增塑剂）时，衬层还应具有防迁移功能。一般的衬层由力学性能良好的高分子材料加人耐热性能良好的填料[如SiO2、TiO2、Al(OH]2),等]及其他功能助剂组成，其选材由绝热层及推进剂的基本组成所决定。对贴壁浇铸的发动机装药，一般采用喷涂或旋转滚涂工艺制造；对自由装填的药粒，则可采用挤注、套包或缠绕包覆工艺。良好的黏结力、优良的力学和防迁移性能以及低的特征信号，是对衬层材料的基本要求。
explanation_en: Also known as cladding layer, it is bonded on the surface of solid propellant to control the combustion area of the grain, reduce or eliminate various stresses that may be generated during the manufacturing, storage and application of the grain. When some propellants contain migratory components (such as nitrate plasticizer), the liner should also have anti migration function. The general liner is composed of macromolecule materials with good mechanical properties, fillers with good heat resistance [such as SiO2, TiO2, Al (OH) 2, etc.] and other functional additive. The selection of materials is determined by the basic composition of the thermal insulation layer and propellant. For the engine charge cast against the wall, spray coating or rotary roller coating process is generally adopted; For freely filled particles, extrusion, wrapping, or wrapping processes can be used. Good adhesion, excellent mechanical and anti migration properties and low characteristic signals are the basic requirements for liner materials.

explanation_cn: 衬底材料是指用作基底的材料。在半导体工艺中，衬底材料常用在外延生长中，多为蓝宝石、单晶硅等。在LTPS(低温多晶硅面板）技术中，衬底材料常指用作载体的基板。狭义地讲，衬底材料特指LTPS中的玻璃基板、石英基板以及柔性基板。衬底材料需要满足以下要求：界面特性好、化学稳定性好、热稳定性好、光学性能高、机械加工性好、价格低廉、容易制造大尺寸。
explanation_en: Backing materials refers to the materials used as the substrate. In semiconductor technology, backing materials is commonly used in epitaxial growth, mostly sapphire, monocrystalline silicon, etc. In LTPS (low temperature polycrystalline silicon panel) technology, backing materials often refers to the substrate used as a carrier. In a narrow sense, backing materials refers to glass substrate, quartze substrate and flexible substrate in LTPS. Backing materials needs to meet the following requirements: good interface characteristics, good chemical stability, good thermal stability, high optical performance, good machinability, low price, easy to manufacture large size.

explanation_cn: 核裂变产生的核素的总称。易裂变原子核与中子发生裂变反应时，通常分裂成两个中等质量的核，同时放出2-3个中子，直接产生的这两个核称为裂变碎片。裂变碎片一般含有过多的中子，需经过一系列的β-衰变后才能达到稳定。裂变碎片和它们的衰变产物都称为裂变产物。裂变过程中某种裂变产物生成的概率称为该产物的产额。
explanation_en: The general term for nuclides produced by nuclear fission. When a fissile atomic nucleus undergoes a fission reaction with a neutron, it usually splits into two medium mass nuclei, releasing 2-3 neutrons at the same time. The two nuclei directly produced are called fission fragments. Fission fragments generally contain too many neutrons and require a series of β- Stability can only be achieved after decay. Fission fragments and their decay products are called fission product. The probability of the formation of a certain fission product in the fission process is called the yield of the product.

explanation_cn: 含有易裂变核素、在反应堆内能实现自持核裂变链式反应的材料。主要有铀235、钚239和铀233。
explanation_en: Materials containing fissile nuclides that can realize self-sustaining nuclear fission chain reaction in the reactor internal energy. It mainly includes uranium 235, plutonium 239 and uranium 233.

explanation_cn: 裂纹前端各个应力分量及其分布。
explanation_en: The stress components and their distribution at the front of the crack.

explanation_cn: 在应力和环境因素(或两者联合)作用下，无裂纹试样(或构件)产生裂纹的过程称裂纹形核。分微观裂纹形核和宏观裂纹形核。裂纹可分以下几类:惰性介质中加载过程产生的裂纹；交变载荷下的疲劳裂纹；应力和温度联合作用下的蠕变裂纹；应力和化学介质联合作用下的应力腐蚀裂纹:氢进入后引起的氢致裂纹。每一类裂纹的形核过程及机理都不尽相同，需要分別加以研究。加载过程中裂纹的形核是不均匀塑性变形的结果。不均匀变形能引起应力集中(如位错塞积)，当集中应力等于原子键合力时就会使材料分离而形成微裂纹。孪晶交割处，夹杂和第二相等应乃集中处往往优先形成微裂纹。有些微裂纹形核后可能不长大(或来不及长大)，微裂纹的扩展和连接就会导致宏观裂纹的形核。有时试样内部原来就存在微裂纹，则通过它们的长大和连接就导致宏观裂纹的形核。
explanation_en: Under the action of stress and environmental factors (or a combination of both), the process of crack initiation of crack free specimens (or components) is called crack nucleation. It can be divided into microscopic crack nucleation and macroscopic crack nucleation. Cracks can be divided into the following categories: cracks generated during loading in inert media; Fatigue crack under alternating load; Creep cracks under the combined action of stress and temperature; Stress corrosion crack under combined action of stress and chemical medium: hydrogen induced crack caused by hydrogen entering. The nucleation process and mechanism of each type of crack are different and need to be studied separately. The nucleation of cracks during loading is the result of uneven plastic deformation. Uneven deformation can cause stress concentration (such as dislocation packing). When the concentrated stress is equal to the atomic bonding force, materials will separate and form microcracks. At the junction of twin, the inclusion and the second phase should be concentrated, and microcracks tend to form preferentially. Some microcracks may not grow (or may not have enough time to grow) after nucleation, and the propagation and connection of microcracks will lead to the nucleation of macroscopic cracks. Sometimes micro cracks already exist inside the sample, and their growth and connection lead to the nucleation of macroscopic cracks.

explanation_cn: 材料中微观或宏观裂纹在外力或环境作用下(也可联合作用)不断长大的过程。微观裂纹的扩展将会导致宏观裂纹的形核。宏观裂纹扩展的前期是裂纹不断长大(称为稳态扩展)，当裂纹长大到临界尺寸后，继续扩展就导致试样或构件断裂(这种扩展称失稳扩展)。裂纹可分为惰性介质中加载时形成的裂纹，疲劳裂纹，蠕变裂纹，应力腐浊和氢致裂纹。这些裂纹的扩展规律及机理是各不相同的，应当分别加以研究。在平面应变条件下，把裂纹扩展2%作为失稳扩展的临界条件。在疲劳、应力腐蚀和氢致开裂中.裂纹扩展速率是个很重要的参量。
explanation_en: The process of micro or macro cracks in materials growing under external force or environmental action (or combined action). The propagation of micro cracks will lead to the nucleation of macro cracks. The early stage of macro crack propagation is the continuous growth of the crack (called steady state growth). When the crack grows to the critical size, the continuous growth will lead to the fracture of the sample or component (called unstable growth). Cracks can be divided into cracks formed during loading in inert medium, fatigue cracks, creep cracks, stress corrosion and hydrogen induced cracks. The propagation laws and mechanisms of these cracks are different and should be studied separately. Under the condition of plane strain, 2% of crack propagation is taken as the critical condition of unstable propagation. Crack propagation rate is an important parameter in fatigue, stress corrosion and hydrogen induced cracking.

name_en: energy release rate of erack propagation
explanation_cn: 裂纹扩展单位面积时，裂纹体系所释放的能量。用G表示。在量纲上是F/L，所以也称为裂纹扩展力。这个力就是所想象的裂纹前端单位长度上的组态力。当裂纹体中的裂纹在扩展中有多余的能量释放时，就存在裂纹扩展力。这里所提到的能量包括裂纹体本身的弹性应变能和与裂纹体构成一个体系的外加载荷的势能，这两部分能量的总和为体系的总势能。总势能降低必伴随有裂纹扩展力。
explanation_en: The energy released by the crack system when the crack grows per unit area. Represented by G. In terms of dimensionality, it is F/L, so it is also known as crack propagation force. This force is the imagined configuration force per unit length of the crack front end. When there is excess energy released during the propagation of cracks in the crack body, there is a crack propagation force. The energy mentioned here includes the elasticity strain energy of the crack body itself and the potential energy of the applied load forming a system with the crack body. The sum of these two parts of energy is the total potential energy of the system. The decrease in total potential energy must be accompanied by crack propagation force.

explanation_cn: 又称填充比，即粉来冶金过程中粉未充填模具的高度与脱模后压坯高度之比。充填粉末颗粒的结构逛粉末成形的关键。填充系数直接影响粉末的充填密度，粉末的充填密度直接关系到粉末的实程度、黏结剂的含量和烧结时的收缩率。粉末的自由充填是大多数粉末冶金采用的工艺。
explanation_en: It is also called fill ratio, that is, the ratio of the height of powder unfilled mold in the process of powder metallurgy to the height of compact after demoulding. The structure of filled powder particle is the key to powder forming. The filling coefficient directly affects the filling density of powder, and the filling density of powder directly affects the compactness of powder, the content of adhesive and the shrinkage rate during sintering. Free filling of powder is the process adopted by most powder metallurgy.

explanation_cn: 又称复合装甲。具有防弹功能，保护人员、装备和工事等在遭受多种武器攻击时免受或少受损宵的复合材料。装甲的结构及材料因武器和防护对象不同而异，可分为重型、轻型和软装甲等。
explanation_en: Also known as composite armor. It is a composite materials with bullet proof function to protect personnel, equipment and fortifications from or less damage when attacked by various weapons. The structure and materials of armor vary with different weapons and protection objects, which can be divided into heavy, light and soft armor.

explanation_cn: 以各种纹样饰面搪瓷板装配而成的搪瓷物件。如以橡皮滚简印刷的木纹、大理石纹等饰面搪瓷板装配而成的各种家具。
explanation_en: Enamel objects assembled with enamel plates with various patterns. For example, various kinds of furniture assembled with wood grain, marble grain and other decorative enamel plates printed by rubber roll sheets.

explanation_cn: 用于改变日用品和工业零部件表面色泽和光亮度的薄膜。装视其基材的不同而异，如果基材是不锈钢、黄铜、锌铝合金、碳钢等金属基材，则为仿金氮化钛膜，黑色或灰色的碳化钛膜和碳氮化钛膜，彩色氧化钛膜等。除不锈钢制件外，其他金属基制件需预先镀亮铬、亮镍防锈层和增量层，以提高精饰水平。如果基材是工程塑料、聚酯、陶瓷等非金属基材时，为黄色铜合金膜（亦称仿金铜）或铝膜镀铝膜本身为银白色，但可以经过染色.获得仿金色或其他彩色膜。在非金属上镀装饰膜，一般需涂底漆，面漆。在金属基材上制备化合物装饰膜多采用磁控溅射和各种离子镀技术。在非金属基上制备装饰膜主要用蒸发镀铝技术。仿金铜膜和铬膜则采用磁控溅射技术，还可用电镀法。氮化钛、碳化钛和碳氮化钛及铬膜可兼有耐磨功能.而铝膜、氮化钛膜、仿金铜膜、铬膜酊兼有耐磨、蚀功能。
explanation_en: A thin film used to change the surface color and brightness of daily necessities and industrial components. The installation varies according to the base material. If the base material is stainless steel, brass, zinc aluminum alloy, carbon steel and other metal base materials, it is imitation gold titanium nitride film, black or gray titanium carbide film film, titanium carbonitride film, and colored titanium oxide film. Except for stainless steel parts, other metal based parts need to be pre plated with bright chrome, bright nickel antirust layer and incremental layer to improve the finishing level. If the substrate is engineering plastics, polyester, ceramics and other non-metallic substrates, it is yellow copper alloy film (also called imitation gold copper) or aluminum film aluminized film itself is silver white, but it can be dyed to obtain imitation gold or other colored films. Generally, primer and top coating are required to coat decorative film on nonmetal. Magnetron sputtering and various ion plating technologies are often used to prepare compound decorate film on metal substrates. The preparation of decorate film on non-metallic substrate mainly uses evaporation aluminum plating technology. The imitation gold copper film and chromium film adopt magnetron sputtering technology, and can also be electroplated. Nitriding, titanium carbide, nitriding and chromium film can both wear resistance, while aluminum film, titanium nitride film film, imitation gold copper film and chromium film tincture can also wear resistance and corrosion resistance.

explanation_cn: 用于首饰、服饰、艺术品等制品的铜合金种类繁多，它们具备美丽的色泽和抗变色能力，包括以下几种主要类型：黄铜和铝青铜：这些合金接近黄金的色泽，如12.5%锌的单相黄铜。它们具有金黄色，优良的加工工艺性能，可制成工艺品和首饰。然而，它们对人体汗液有一定腐蚀性，因此通常作为镀金饰品的基底材料。当用于工艺品时，通常需要在表面涂覆有机透明膜以保护。铝青铜（Cu-6Al-3Ni）：这种单相铝青铜具有淡雅的金黄色，抗变色性能良好，适用于室内装潢和人造首饰。它具有较高的力学性能和良好的加工性能，适合制作各种装饰品。锌白铜：传统的德银合金由铜、镍和锌组成，随着镍含量的增加，它的白色色调增加，抗腐蚀性也增强，但会稍微失去银白色的柔和光泽。随后发展了一种Cu-12Ni-24Zn锌白铜，其色泽类似于银白色，具有较好的耐腐蚀性和力学性能，主要用于餐具和奖杯等艺术制品。这些铜合金在不同用途中发挥重要作用，根据其特性和用途需求，可以选择适当的铜合金类型。
explanation_en: There are many kinds of copper alloy used for jewelry, clothing, artwork and other products, which have beautiful color and anti tarnish ability, including the following main types: brass and aluminium bronze: these alloy are close to the color of gold, such as 12.5% zinc single-phase brass. They have golden color and excellent processing performance, and can be made into handicrafts and jewelry. However, they are corrosive to human sweat, so they are usually used as the base materials of gold plated jewelry. When used in handicrafts, it is usually necessary to coat the surface with an organic transparent film for protection. Aluminium bronze (Cu-6Al-3Ni): This single-phase aluminium bronze has a light golden yellow color and good anti tarnish performance, which is suitable for interior decoration and artificial jewelry. It has high mechanical properties and good processing performance, suitable for making various decorations. Zinc white copper: The traditional deutsche bank alloy is composed of copper, nickel and zinc. With the increase of nickel content, its white tone increases, and its corrosion resistance also increases, but it will slightly lose the soft luster of silver white. Later, a kind of Cu-12Ni-24Zn zinc white copper was developed. Its color is similar to silver white, and it has good corrosion resistance and mechanical properties. It is mainly used for tableware, trophies and other artistic products. These copper alloys play an important role in different applications, and appropriate types of copper alloys can be selected based on their characteristics and usage needs.

explanation_cn: 用平行于切口平面方向的外力作用于规定的裤形试样上（一般是在长、宽、厚度分别为100mm、15mm、2.0mm的长方形试样中心沿长度方向割口40mm)，将试样撕断所需的力除以试样厚度，得到的撕裂强度称为裤形撕裂强度。
explanation_en: Apply an external force parallel to the direction of the notch plane on the specified trouser shaped specimen (generally, 40 mm along the length direction of the center of the rectangular specimen with the length, width and thickness of 100 mm, 15 mm and 2.0 mm respectively), divide the force required for the specimen to tear by the specimen thickness, and the tear strength obtained is called trousers tearing strength.

explanation_cn: 将动物皮的毛和表皮脱去后得到的在制品。一般是指在制革生产中脱灰后或软化后的在制品。
explanation_en: Work in progress obtained by removing the fur and epidermis of animal skins. Generally, it refers to the products in process after deashing or bating in leather production.

explanation_cn: 又称开放式硫化法。是直接蒸汽硫化罐硫化法的一种，是指对成型好的半成品不包覆任何外物，裸露送入硫化罐内用蒸汽直接进行硫化的工艺过程。此法工序简单，劳动强度低，省去缠包外材料的工序，生产效率高；但由于硫化时外压比外包材料的小，工艺上较难控制，容易产生气泡、脱层、变形等质量问题。其操作工艺是将包覆好外胶的管坯两端封头，以免硫化时蒸汽冲入而产生脱层，然后平放在硫化架托板上送入硫化罐硫化。裸硫化法主要适用于已经具有符合要求的成品结构(形状和尺寸)，在硫化过程中(至少在正式硫化反应发生之前)具有足够挺性而不会改变形状的橡胶制品的硫化，诸如内径小的棉线编织、缠绕、针织胶管及无芯夹布胶管、胶布、胶鞋、手套等。
explanation_en: Also known as open vulcanization method. It is a kind of direct steam vulcanization tank vulcanization method, which refers to the process of directly vulcanization with steam when the molded semi-finished products are exposed and sent into the vulcanization tank without any external objects. The process of this method is simple, labor intensity is low, and the process of wrapping materials is omitted, so the production efficiency is high; However, since the external pressure during vulcanization is smaller than that of the wrapped materials, it is difficult to control the process, and it is easy to cause quality problems such as bubbles, delamination, deformation, etc. The operation process is to cover the two ends of the tube blank with outer rubber to avoid delamination caused by steam rushing in during vulcanization, and then put it flat on the supporting plate of the vulcanization frame and send it to the vulcanization tank for vulcanization. The naked vulcanization method is mainly applicable to the vulcanization of rubber products that have met the requirements of the finished product structure (shape and size) and have sufficient stiffness without changing the shape during the vulcanization process (at least before the formal vulcanization reaction occurs), such as cotton thread knitting, winding, knitting rubber hose with small inner diameter, and coreless cloth clip hose, rubber cloth, rubber shoes, gloves, etc.

explanation_cn: 岛状结构硅酸盐矿物。
explanation_en: Island structure silicate mineral.

explanation_cn: 复杂配位型氧化物矿物。 成分YNbO4。Y常为Ce所代替。Y>Ce。四方晶系。
explanation_en: Complex coordination type oxide minerals. Component YNbO4. Y is often replaced by Ce. Y> Ce. Tetragonal crystal system.

explanation_cn: 不是单一矿物.是由针铁矿、 纤铁矿、水针铁矿、水纤铁矿和富水的氢氧化铁胶凝 体及铝的氢氧化物、泥质物组成的混合物"成分 Fe2C)3."H2(), Fe-般在 30% ?40%,成分变化 大，常成致密块状或胶态状（鲕状、钟乳状、结核 状、肾状）、土状及疏松多孔状。呈细小针状结晶苒 大多为针铁矿：呈细小鱗片状荇多为纤铁矿（乂称红 云母）。肾状、钟乳状褐铁矿表面常冇一层光亮沥青 黑色的膜壳者称为玻璃头。颜色M黄色、褐色、褐黑 至红褐色。条痕黄褐色或棕黄色。莫氏硬度1?4, 土状者硬度小，密度3.3?4g/ctn3。是表生作用的产 物，主要成因为风化型.由含铁硫化物、氧化物、碳 酸盐及硅酸盐转变而成；沉枳型山海相、湖相的氢氧 化铁胶体溶液凝聚而成。大M聚集时叶作炼铁的矿物 原料。
explanation_en: It is not a single mineral. It is a mixture of goethite, lepidogenite, hydrogoethite, hydrolepidogenite, water rich ferric hydroxide cement, aluminum hydroxide and argillaceous matter, "component Fe2C) 3." H2 (), Fe - generally 30%? 40%, with significant changes in composition, often forming dense blocks or colloidal shapes (oolitic, bell shaped, nodular, renal), earthy, and porous shapes. Most of the fine acicular crystals are goethite; most of them are small scaly but not fibrous iron ore (called red mica). Renal and stalactitic limonite surface often has a layer of bright pitch black membrane shell, which is called glass head. Colors M are yellow, brown, brownish black to reddish brown. Stripes are yellowish brown or brownish yellow. Mohs hardness 1? 4. The earthy ones have low hardness and a density of 3.3? 4g/ctn3. It is the product of supergene, mainly due to weathering, and is formed by transformation of iron bearing sulfide, oxide, carbonate and silicate; The precipitated trifoliate orange is formed by coagulation of ferric hydroxide colloidal solution of mountain sea facies and lake facies. When large M aggregates, leaves are used as mineral raw materials for ironmaking.

explanation_cn: 金属支架上涂覆特殊膜性材料（聚四氟乙烯、涤纶、聚酯、聚氨基甲酸乙酯等）的支架。该支架既保留了金属支架的功能，又具有膜性材料的特性。覆膜支架一般由金属支架与被覆的薄膜两部分组成。
explanation_en: The metal stem is coated with stem made of special membrane materials (polylctrafluorocthylone, polyester, polyester, polyurethane, etc.). The stem not only retains the function of a metal stem, but also has the characteristics of a membrane materials. Paving stent is generally composed of metal stem and covered membrane.

explanation_cn: 一种由热接触变质作用形成变质岩。其特征是具有典型角岩结构和块状构造。角岩结构即显微粒状变晶结构，矿物颗粒之间呈粒状镶嵌. 有时出现变斑晶。典型的角岩无明显定性特征，即使 云母、角闪石、红柱石等也没有定向排列趋势，但可 见变余的层理。
explanation_en: A metamorphic rock formed by thermal contact metamorphism. It is characterized by typical hornfels structure and massive structure. The hornblende structure exhibits a granular metamorphic structure, with mineral particles embedded in a granular manner Sometimes variable phenocryst appear. Typical hornfels have no obvious qualitative characteristics. Even mica, amphibole, andalusite, etc. have no directional arrangement trend, but redundant bedding can be seen.

explanation_cn: 又称"隐形眼镜".直接贴附于角膜表面.用于矫正不规则屈光面和治疗角膜疾病的镜片。接触镜所用的材料应具备以下特点：优良的光学性质、高透氧性、可湿性、防污染，同时易于清洗和灭菌。接触镜主要分为硬和软镜片。角膜接触镜除了矫正角膜屈光 性外.还可释放药物用于治疗眼科疾病。
explanation_en: Also known as "contact lenses". It is directly attached to the corneal surface. It is used to correct irregular refractive surfaces and treat corneal diseases. The materials used for contact lens shall have the following characteristics: excellent optical properties, high oxygen permeability, wettability, anti pollution, and easy to clean and sterilize. Contact lenses are mainly divided into hard and soft lenses. In addition to correcting corneal refraction, contact lens can also release drugs to treat ophthalmic diseases.

explanation_cn: 一种由普通角闪石和斜K石组成的区域变质岩。岩石中普通角闪石和斜长石含量相近，其他矿物有石英、黑云母、铁铝榴石、绿帘 石、透辉石和紫苏辉石等。
explanation_en: A regional metamorphic rock consisting of common amphibole and clinoptilolite. The content of common amphibole and plagioclase in rock is similar, and other minerals include quartze, biotite, iron almandine, epidote, diopside and perilla pyroxene.

explanation_cn: 双链结构硅酸盐矿物。纤维状集合体称为石棉，可制作各种石棉制品，其中钠闪石石棉 (青石棉、蓝石棉）最具工业价值，抗酸性强，可过滤有毒气体，是战略物资之一。
explanation_en: Double chain silicate mineral. The fibrous aggregate, called asbestos, can be used to produce various asbestos products, of which riebeckite (crocidolite, crocidolite) is one of the strategic materials with the most industrial value, strong acid resistance, and the ability to filter toxic gases.

explanation_cn: 属链状硅酸盐的一类结构。
explanation_en: A type of structure belonging to chain like silicates.

explanation_cn: 一种超美铁质区变质岩。以角闪石类矿物为主，可含少量黑云母、 石英、橄榄石、尖晶石或磁铁矿。纤维状或柱状变晶 结构.片状构造。可按角闪石类型进一步划分为透闪 石片岩、阳起石片岩、普通角闪石片岩、镁铁闪石片岩、直闪石片岩等。
explanation_en: An ultramafic metamorphic rock. It is dominated by hornblende minerals, and can contain a small amount of biotite, quartze, olivine, spinel or magnetite. Fibrous or columnar crystalloblastic structure and schistose structure. According to the type of amphibole, it can be further divided into tremolite schist, actinolite schist, ordinary amphibole schist, magnesium iron amphibole schist, and amphibole schist.

explanation_cn: 外场去除后，高分子中分子链、链段、晶体或相区从有序取向变为无序排列的过程。
explanation_en: After the removal of external field, the molecular chain, chain segment, crystal or phase region in macromolecule changes from ordered orientation to disordered arrangement.

explanation_cn: 解聚是链式聚合的逆过程，又称链式降解或连锁降解。聚合物在降解反应过程中完全转化为单体的过程。在氧或各种物理因素 (热、光、辐照、机械力等）影响下，从大分子链末端断裂产生自由基，引起自由基型连锁反应，聚合物迅速裂解为单体。解聚在聚合上限温度以上尤其容易进行。工业上常将高聚物废料在较高温度下解聚.达到回收利用的目的。如聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯在270°C下 可完全解聚成单体。
explanation_en: Depolymerization is the reverse process of chain polymerization, also known as chain degradation or chain degradation. Polymer is completely transformed into monomer in the process of degradation reaction. Under the influence of oxygen or various physical factors (heat, light, irradiation, mechanical force, etc. Depolymerization is particularly easy to be carried out above the upper limit temperature of polymerization. In industry, high polymer waste is often depolymerization at a higher temperature to achieve the purpose of recycling. For example, polymethyl methacrylate can be completely depolymerization to monomer at 270 ° C.

explanation_cn: 在恒温和恒剪切速率作fH下剪切应力（或黏度）随时间递减、在静止时又随时间变黏稠的流体。触变性流体在微观状态下一般具有物理交联的网状结构：搅动时.这些结构被破坏：静止后，结构又重新形成。典型的例子如油漆。
explanation_en: A fluid whose shear stress (or viscosity) decreases with time under fH at constant temperature and shear rate, and becomes viscous with time at rest. In the micro state, thixotropic fluid generally has a network structure of physical crosslinking: when agitated, these structures are destroyed; when stationary, the structure is formed again. A typical example is paint.

explanation_cn: 氢的一种同位素，质S数3,核素符号3H或T。氚是一种(3放射性核素.半衰期2.35年其(3射线的平均能量为5.7keV，最大能量为18.6keV,lmL(标准状态〉氚气的活度值为9.5XlO^Bq(2.58Ci)。氚除了具有这些核辐射性质外，其一般的物理性质和化学性质与氢基本相同，但由于氚和氢的原子质量不一样.它们及其化合物在物理-化学性质上存在微小的差別例如，氚的沸点为25.7K，而氢的沸点为20.3K，氚的热焓（H11)15.15kJmol,氢的热焓26.I6kJmol。天然氚（T)是高空大气层中由于宇宙射线引起下列核反应产生的：其产量极低。氚主要通过下述核反应来制备：以锂-铝、锂-镁合金或含锂陶瓷作为靶材料（sLi在天然锂中的同位素丰度为7.5%).在核反应堆中进行中子照射.然后把产生的氚气从靶材料中提取出来。提取出来的这种氚气还含有一部分氢，因此还要进一步进行同位素分离.才能得到接近100%丰度的氚。通常所用的同位素分离方法有：液氢（氚）精馏、热扩散和色层分离。氚核和氘核能进行核聚变反应并产生大量的能量，因此氚被用作聚变反应堆的核燃料和氢弹弹头的装料。氚核和氘核进行核反应产生高能中子，因此可作为中子发生器的靶材。氚的射线能量很低，可作为低能辐射源使用氚吸收在金属中可产生轫致辐射，因此作为轫致辐射源使用。氚可被制成含氢化合物（特別是碳氢化合物）的氚标记化合物.用于医学、生物学和化学的研究中。
explanation_en: An isotope of hydrogen with a mass S number of 3 and a nuclide symbol 3H or T. Tritium is a 3 radionuclide with a half life of 2.35 years. The average energy of 3 rays is 5.7 keV, the maximum energy is 18.6 keV, and the activity value of lmL (standard state) tritium gas is 9.5 XlO ^ Bq (2.58 Ci). In addition to these nuclear radiation properties, tritium has basically the same general physical and chemical properties as hydrogen, but because of the different atomic masses of tritium and hydrogen, they and their compounds have slight differences in physical and chemical properties. For example, the boiling point of tritium is 25.7K, while the boiling point of hydrogen is 20.3K, the thermal enthalpy of tritium (H11) is 15.15kJmol, and the thermal enthalpy of hydrogen is 26. I6kJmol. Natural tritium (T) is produced by the following nuclear reaction caused by cosmic rays in the upper atmosphere: its production is extremely low. Tritium is mainly prepared by the following nuclear reaction: taking lithium aluminum, lithium magnesium alloys or lithium containing ceramics as target materials (the isotope abundance of sLi in natural lithium is 7.5%), conducting neutron irradiation in nuclear reactor, and then extracting the generated tritium gas from target materials. The extracted tritium gas also contains some hydrogen, so further isotope separation is needed to obtain tritium with nearly 100% abundance. The commonly used isotope separation methods include liquid hydrogen (tritium) distillation, thermal diffusion and chromatography separation. Tritium and deuteron can carry out nuclear fusion reaction and generate a lot of energy, so tritium is used as nuclear fuel for fusion reactors and as fuel for hydrogen warheads. The nuclear reaction of tritium and deuteron generates high-energy neutrons, so it can be used as the target of neutron generator. The ray energy of tritium is very low, so it can be used as a low-energy radiation source. tritium absorption can generate bremsstrahlung in metals, so it can be used as a bremsstrahlung source. Tritium can be made into tritium labeled compounds containing hydrogen compounds (especially hydrocarbons) for medical, biological and chemical research.

explanation_cn: 又称材料计算学。是材料科学与计算机科学的交叉学科，是连接材料学理论与实验的桥梁.是综合材料科学、计算机科学技术、数学、物理学、化学以及机械 工程等学科而发展起来的，对材料的组织结构和性能进行建模、模拟仿真计算和预测预报的一门学科，是关于材料组成、结构、性能、服役性能的模拟与设计的学科。
explanation_en: Also known as materials computing. It is a cross discipline between materials science and computer science, a bridge connecting the theory and experiment of materials science. It is developed by integrating materials science, computer science and technology, mathematics, physics, chemistry, mechanical engineering and other disciplines. It is a discipline that models, simulates, calculates, predicts and forecasts the organizational structure and performance of materials. It is about the composition, structure, performance The discipline of simulation and design of service performance.

explanation_cn: 又称记忆效应自膨胀支架。是指用具有形状记忆功能的镍钛合金 制成的支架。输入目标血管内，感受血液温度时即发生形状恢复，对狭窄病变区起支撑作用。
explanation_en: It is also called memory effect self-expanding stent. It refers to the stem made of nickel titanium alloy with shape memory function. When entering the target blood vessel and feeling the blood temperature, shape recovery occurs, providing support for the narrow lesion area.

explanation_cn: 又称电池效应、懒电池效应或者电池记忆。在Ni-Cd电池或者NiMH电池长期不彻底的充放电情况下，电池逐渐失去最大的存储容，电池容量保持在低容量状态下，这种现象称为电池记忆效应。
explanation_en: Also called battery effect, lazy battery effect or battery memory. When Ni Cd battery or NiMH battery is not fully charged and discharged for a long time, the battery gradually loses its maximum storage capacity, and cell capacity remains at a low capacity state. This phenomenon is called battery memory effect.

explanation_cn: 进行基础研究或应用研究的反应堆的核燃料元件，一般为高浓铀燃料的片组型元件及其变型。片I组型元件通常由10-20个燃料片组装固定在一个方形元件盒内.片与片之间保持一定的间隙，以保证冷却剂畅通。燃料片采取夹心饼干式结构，用铝或铝合金作包壳材料.以弥散体燃料作芯体.采用热轧或共1挤JR工艺成型，芯体厚度约0.6mm。
explanation_en: The nuclear fuel elements of the reactor for basic research or application research are generally sheet type elements and their variants of highly enriched uranium fuel. Sheet I type components are usually assembled and fixed in a square element box with 10-20 fuel sheets. A certain gap is maintained between the sheets to ensure smooth coolant flow. The fuel sheet adopts sandwich biscuit structure, uses aluminum or aluminum alloy as the cladding materials, uses dispersed fuel as the core, and uses hot rolling or co extrusion JR process to form the core, with the core thickness of about 0.6 mm.

explanation_cn: 凡是能引起生物体遗传物质发生突然或根本的改变，使其基因突变或染色体畸变达到自然水平以上的物质，统称为。物理类包括：电离辐射，如X射线、γ射线等;非电离辐射，如紫外线、热等。化学类包括：可直接与核酸的碱基发生化学反应而引起置换的化合物如烷化剂、亚硝酸和羟胺等;间接引起置换的碱基类似物，如5-溴尿嘧啶、2-氨基嘌呤和8-氮鸟嘌呤等;可引起移码突变的吖啶类染料等。生物类包括：转座子;Mu噬菌体增变基因等。
explanation_en: Any substance that can cause sudden or fundamental changes in the genetic material of an organism, resulting in genetic mutations or chromosomal aberrations above the natural level, is collectively referred to as. Physics includes: ionizing radiation, such as X-rays γ Radiation, etc; Non ionizing radiation, such as ultraviolet, heat, etc. Chemicals include compounds such as alkylating agents, nitrite, and hydroxylamines that can directly react with the base of nucleic acids to cause displacement; Base analogues that indirectly cause displacement, such as 5-bromouracil, 2-aminopurine, and 8-azaguanine; Acridine dye or dyestuffc that can cause code shifting mutation. Biology includes: transposons; Mu phage mutated genes, etc.

explanation_en: It is also called aggregation inhibition period. The period when the initiator starts to decompose, the primary free radical is terminated by the polymerization inhibitor impurity, no polymer is formed, and the polymerization rate is zero. If impurities that hinder polymerization are removed, it can be achieved without any impurities.

explanation_cn: 在半导体异质结中禁带宽度大的材料中掺人n型或p型杂质原子，而禁带宽度小的材料则不掺杂，这样载流子转移到禁带宽度小的材料中。由于载流子在空间上与其母体分离，受电离杂质散射的影响显著降低，因此载流子的迁移率得到提高。尤其是在低温下.载流子的迁移率得到显著提升。最具代表性的调制掺杂结构是GaAs/n-AlGaAs超晶格，由于n-AlGaAs中的导带边比GaAs的高，AlGaAs中的电子向GaAs转移，并积累在界面附近的三角形GaAs势阱中形成高浓度、高迁移率的二维电子气。在n-AlGaAs和GaAs之间通常加人一层很薄的不掺杂的AlGaAs层作隔离，可使AlGaAs中离化施主对GaAs层中电子的库仑散射作用进一步减弱，电子可有更高的迁移率。
explanation_en: In the semiconductor heterostructure, n-type or p-type impurity atoms are doped in the materials with a large band gap, while the materials with a small band gap is not doped, so the carrier is transferred to the materials with a small band gap. Because the carrier is spatially separated from its parent, the influence of ionized impurity scattering is significantly reduced, so the mobility of the carrier is improved. Especially at low temperature, the mobility of carriers has been significantly improved. The most representative modulated doping structure is GaAs/n-AlGaAs superlattice. Because the conduction band edge in n-AlGaAs is higher than that of GaAs, electrons in AlGaAs transfer to GaAs, and accumulate in the triangular GaAs potential well near the interface to form two-dimensional electron gas with high concentration and high mobility. A thin undoped AlGaAs layer is usually added between n-AlGaAs and GaAs for isolation, which can further weaken the Coulomb scattering effect of ionized donors in AlGaAs on electrons in GaAs layer, and the electrons can have higher mobility.

explanation_cn: 适合进行调质处理（淬火成马氏体后在500-650°C之间高温回火）的结构钢。经调质处理后，钢的强度、塑性及韧性有良好的配合。调质钢在化学成分上是含碳0?25%?0.5%的中碳非合金钢或低合金钢和中合金钢，调质热处理后的金相组织是回火索氏体。调质钢是机械结构钢中应用最为广泛的钢类.钢号繁多.典型钢号有45、40Cr、40C'rMo、40CrNiMo、40MnB等。各种机械设备的结构零件如轴类、套筒、中小模数齿轮、连杆、销栓等大量使用调质钢.对零件中需要承受较大应力的部位往往进行局部感应加热淬火。
explanation_en: Structural steel suitable for quenching and tempering treatment (quenching to martensite and then high temperature tempering at 500-650 ° C). After quenching and tempering treatment, the strength, plasticity and toughness of steel are well matched. The chemical composition of quenched and tempered steel is 0? 25%? For 0.5% medium carbon non-alloy steel or low alloy steel and medium alloy steel, the microstructure after quenching and tempering heat treatment is tempering sorbite. Quenched and tempered steel is the most widely used steel in mechanical structural steel. There are many steel designation. Typical steel designation include 45, 40Cr, 40C'rMo, 40CrNiMo, 40MnB, etc. Quenched and tempered steel is widely used for structural parts of various mechanical equipment, such as shafts, sleeves, small and medium modulus gears, connecting rods, pins, etc. Local induction heating quenching is often carried out for parts that need to bear greater stress.

explanation_en: A limestone with yellow and maroon irregular stripes. It looks like leopard skin, so it is called leopard limestone. The matrix is usually composed of cryptocrystalline or microcrystalline caldte. It is formed by albitization of limestone during diagenesis, or by ductile shearing of limestone.

explanation_cn: 又称贝氏体相变。贝氏体转变是一种半扩散型相变，转变温度在250~50℃范围，转变温度了间隙原子碳能作长距离散离外，铁和置换溶质元素都不能显著地扩的降低，扩散过程越来越困难，合金元素的作用是通过对以氏体转变和碳原子扩散的影响起作用。
explanation_en: It is also called bainitic transformation. The bainitic transformation is a semi diffusion phase transformation. The transformation temperature is in the range of 250~50 ℃. The transformation temperature causes the interstitial carbon energy to disperse for a long distance. Neither iron nor displaced solute elements can significantly expand and reduce. The diffusion process is becoming more and more difficult. The role of alloy elements is to play a role through the influence on the transformation of bainite and the diffusion of carbon atoms.

explanation_cn: 正火状态或选续冷却条件下可得到以贝氏体为基础组织的钢。贝氏体组织具布比铁素体珠光体组织更高的强度而同时具有适当的韧塑性，而其生产工艺相对简单。低碳贝氏体钢具有较高的强度、塑韧性和焊接性，生产工艺简单，冷加工性能良好，广泛用于工程机械、高强度管线、桥梁、船舶、压力容器、车辆等工程结构件。
explanation_en: Steel with bainite as the basic structure can be obtained under the condition of normalizing or selective cooling. The bainite structure has higher strength than the ferrite pearlite structure, while it has appropriate toughness and plasticity, and its production process is relatively simple. Low carbon bainhe steel has high strength, plastic toughness and weldability, simple production process and good cold workability, and is widely used in engineering machinery, high-strength pipelines, bridges, ships, pressure vessels, vehicles and other engineering structural parts.

explanation_cn: 硅酸二钙，是硅酸盐水泥中的主要矿物成分。遇水反应速率较慢，水化热很低.水化产物对水泥早期强度贡献较小，但对水泥后期强度起重要作用。
explanation_en: Dicalcium silicate is the main mineral component in Portland cement. The reaction rate with water is slow, and the heat of hydration is very low. Hydration products contribute little to the early strength of cement, but play an important role in the late strength of cement.

explanation_cn: 根据Landau提出的分层模型，当超导体进入混合态后，会分成许多正常和超导的交错层，以使样品内部正常区处于临界场中。该模型中，在正常相和超导相共存的界面处存在一个表面能或叫界面能当这个界面能为负时，我们称为负界面能。
explanation_en: According to the layered model proposed by Landau, when the superconductor enters the mixed state, it will be divided into many normal and superconducting interlayers, so that the normal area inside the sample is in the critical field. In this model, there is a surface energy or interface energy at the interface where the normal phase and the superconducting phase coexist. When the interface energy is negative, we call it negative interface energy.
