explanation_en: In an ionic compound, a polyhedron is formed by connecting the centers of the nearest negative ions arranged around a positive ion as the center. The shape of anion coordination polyhedron depends on the number of anions, such as regular triangle, regular tetrahedron, regular octahedron and cube.

explanation_cn: 质子诱发X射线突光分析（PIXE）是一种用于分析薄膜和近表面层化学成分的方法，依赖于入射高能质子或氦离子束激发待分析元素产生特征X射线。这是一种非侵入性技术，用于确定样品中的元素及其相对含量。PIXE分析的主要设备包括小型加速器、射线探测器和多道分析器。在分析过程中，高能质子轰击目标物质，这会导致目标原子的内层电子被电离并留下空穴。当外层电子跃迁填补这些空穴时，多余的能量被释放为特征X射线。与电子激发的X射线荧光分析相似，PIXE分析也根据探测器记录的X射线能谱（即强度与能量关系）来确定样品中包含的元素及其相对含量。但与电子激发X射线分析不同，PIXE的连续谱背景非常低，因此具有更高的灵敏度，特别适用于痕量元素的分析。此外，元素的特征X射线能量是其内电子壳层结构的反映，可被视为元素的"指纹"。PIXE分析的灵敏度非常高，可以检测绝对数量仅为1×10^(-16)克的痕量元素。此方法还允许分析元素的深度分布，因为质子能量降低时，靶原子的X射线发射截面也会变化。这使得PIXE适用于分析100微米以内的薄层，并可以同时分析多种元素。另一个重要的特点是，PIXE技术不仅适用于真空环境中的样品（例如置于真空靶室内的小样品），还可通过外束技术，即通过薄窗引出质子束至空气中，分析置于空气中的样品。因此，PIXE可以用于分析液体、生物活标本、大型文物或工件等。这使得它在多个领域，包括材料科学、地质学、生物学和文化遗产保护中有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: Proton induced X-ray burst analysis (PIXE) is a method used to analyze the chemical composition of thin films and near surface layers, which relies on the excitation of high-energy protons or helium ion beams to generate characteristic X-rays of the analyzed elements. This is a non-invasive technique used to determine the elements and their relative content in the sample. The main equipment for PIXE analysis includes small accelerators, ray detectors, and multi-channel analyzers. During the analysis process, high-energy protons bombard the target substance, causing the inner electrons of the target atom to ionize and leave holes. When the outer electron transitions fill these holes, the excess energy is released as characteristic X-rays. Similar to the electron excited X-ray fluorescence analysis, PIXE analysis also determines the elements contained in the sample and their relative content according to the X-ray energy spectrum recorded by the detector (i.e. the relationship between intensity and energy). However, unlike electron excited X-ray analysis, PIXE has a very low continuous spectral background and therefore has higher sensitivity, making it particularly suitable for the analysis of trace elements. In addition, the characteristic X-ray energy of an element is a reflection of its internal electron shell structure, which can be regarded as the "fingerprint" of the element. The sensitivity of PIXE analysis is very high, and it can detect an absolute quantity of only 1 × 10 ^ (-16) grams of trace elements. This method also allows for analyzing the depth distribution of elements, as the X-ray emission cross-section of the target atom also changes when the proton energy decreases. This makes PIXE suitable for analyzing thin layers up to 100 microns and can simultaneously analyze multiple elements. Another important feature is that PIXE technology is not only suitable for samples in vacuum environments (such as small samples placed in vacuum target rooms), but also can be analyzed by external beam technology, which involves extracting proton beams into air through thin windows. Therefore, PIXE can be used for analyzing liquids, living biological specimens, large cultural relics or workpieces, etc. This makes it widely applicable in multiple fields, including materials science, geology, biology, and cultural heritage protection.

explanation_cn: 使用传导质子（H1)的间体聚合物作为电解质的燃料电池。有时被称为聚合物电解质燃料电池或同体聚合物燃料电池。最常用的间体聚合物电解质为全氟的磺酸聚合物。相对于其他类型的燃料电池，质子交换膜燃料电池工作温度最低，所以有时也被称为低温燃料电池。质子交换膜燃料电池输出功率在几瓦到几十千瓦，可以在室温瞬间启动，且庐停对其性能衰减的影响远小于其他温度比较高的燃料电池，因此，这类燃料电池是备用电源、便携式电源和车用动力电源的最佳选择。这类燃料电池一般要使用贵金属作为阳极和阴极的催化剂。由于这类燃料电池的工作温度较低，电极中催化剂很容易受含硫化合物和一氧化碳的毒化。在有CO存在的情况下，阳极应该用抗中毒能力较强的催化剂，如Pt、Ru合金。
explanation_en: A fuel cell uses an intermediate polymer that conducts protons (H1) as an electrolyte. Sometimes called polymer electrolyte fuel cell or homopolymer polymer fuel cell. The most commonly used intermediate polymer electrolyte is perfluorinated sulfonic acid polymer. Compared with other types of fuel cell, proton exchange membrane fuel cell have the lowest operating temperature, so they are sometimes called low-temperature fuel cell. The output power of proton exchange membrane fuel cell is from several watts to tens of kilowatts, which can be started instantly at room temperature, and the impact of shutdown on its performance is far less than that of other fuel cell with high temperature. Therefore, this kind of fuel cell is the best choice for backup power, portable power and vehicle power supply. Such fuel cell generally use precious metals as catalysts for anode and cathode. Due to the low operating temperature of this type of fuel cell, the catalyst in the electrode is easily poisoned by sulfur compounds and carbon monoxide. In the presence of CO, the anode should use a catalyst with strong poisoning resistance, such as Pt, Ru alloy.

explanation_cn: 能传导质子（氢离子）的固体电解质，又称氢离子导体。质子在同休中的传导可分为两类：一类是在含有氢键的化合物中的传导，另一类是在不含氢键的化合物中的传导。已知的大部分具有氢键它们的传导机理是通过氢离子的跃迁并伴随着分子的转动氢离子导体可以是无机化合物也可以是有机化合物，前者称为无机氢离子导体，后者成为有机氢离子导体。无机氢离子导体主要有杂多酸、黏土及氢离子三大类。有机氢离子导体品种较少且电导率一般小于无机氢离子导体。在三亚乙基二胺以及六亚甲基四胺与硫酸的系统中存在较好的氢离子导体。无氢键的有三价稀土氧化物掺杂的SrCeO3和BaCO3等，能承受较高的温度。氢离子导体具有良好的室温传导性能可以用于间态电色显示器、氢敏元件及燃料电池等。
explanation_en: The solid electrolyte that can conduct protons (hydrogen ions) is also called hydrogen ion conductor. The conduction of protons in the same breath can be divided into two categories: one is in compounds containing hydrogen bond, and the other is in compounds without hydrogen bond. Most of the known hydrogen bonds have their conduction mechanism through the transition of hydrogen ions and the rotation of molecules. The hydrogen ion conductor can be either an inorganic compound or an organic compound. The former is called an inorganic hydrogen ion conductor, and the latter is an organic hydrogen ion conductor. Inorganic hydrogen ion conductors mainly include heteropoly acid, clay and hydrogen ion. There are few types of organic hydrogen ion conductors and their electric conductivity is generally smaller than that of inorganic hydrogen ion conductors. There are good hydrogen ion conductors in the systems of triethylenediamine and hexamethylenetetramine with sulfuric acid. SrCeO3 and BaCO3 doped with trivalent rare earth oxides without hydrogen bond can withstand higher temperatures. Hydrogen ion conductors have good room temperature conductivity, which can be used in inter state electrochromic displays, hydrogen sensors and fuel cell.

explanation_cn: 一种利用回旋加速器或直线加速器产生的高能质子对工件进行检测的方法。一种比较新的射线照相方法。与大多数射线照相方法一样，质子射线照相也是依靠对射线的吸收产生阴影。此外它还可用小角度多库伦散射和大角度散射成像。大多采用临界区质子射线照相法，此法主要是吸收而非散射，但这种吸收与X射线或热中子的吸收不同。高能质子在材料中有明确的吸收区域。在此区域内质子被快速吸收，这就提高了检测微小缺陷的灵敏度，例如对高温合金的微孔隙缺陷来说其对比度比X射线高。此法已用于飞机发动机叶片的微孔监测。质子射线照相还可用于检测高原子数材料，这些材料由于吸收太大，X射线检测有闲难，质子射线照相最大的缺点足为加速质子需要大而复杂的设备。
explanation_en: A method of detecting workpieces using high-energy protons generated by cyclotrons or linear accelerators. A relatively new radiographic method. Like most radiographic methods, proton radiography also relies on the absorption of radiation to produce shadows. In addition, it can also be used for small angle multi Coulomb scattering and large angle scattering imaging. Most critical region proton radiography methods are used, which mainly involve absorption rather than scattering, but this absorption is different from the absorption of X-rays or thermal neutrons. High energy protons have clear absorption regions in materials. In this area, protons are rapidly absorbed, which improves the sensitivity of detecting small defects. For example, the contrast of microporous defects in high temperature alloy is higher than that of X-ray. This method has been used for micro hole monitoring of aircraft engine blades. Proton radiography can also be used to detect materials with high atomic numbers. These materials have too much absorption, which makes X-ray detection difficult. The biggest disadvantage of proton radiography is that it requires large and complex equipment to accelerate protons.

explanation_cn: 使待测样品电离，按质荷比分离检测离子从而对物质进行分析的一种方法。利用质荷比不同的离子在电场或磁场中运动轨道不同的性质把离子分离、记录而得到质谱,即可分析样品成分或结构。使用的质谱仪通常由进样系统、离子源、分析器、接收器和记录器及相应的真空系统和电子学系统组成。样品由进样系统引入。在离子源中样品分子或原子被电离成离子，经过电场或磁场组成的质量分析器分离，再经检测记录而得到质谱图。在质谱图中，每个质谱峰表示一种质荷比的离子，质谱峰的强度表示该种离子的数量。因而可进行定性分析和定量分析。对于有机化合物根据质谱峰的质荷比和相对强度，还可以进行结构分析。质谱法广泛应用于核工业、地质、冶金、医药成分鉴定、石油化工、环境保护、兴奋剂检测和宇宙空间探测等各个领域。按应用范围可划分为同位素、无机和有机分析三大类。气、液、同三态样品，均可用不同类型的质谱仪分析。其优点是：灵敏度高，样品用量少吋实现多组分同时检测，还可得到同位素信息。缺点是仪器结构复杂、价格昂贵。
explanation_en: A method of ionizing the sample to be tested, separating and detecting ions according to mass to charge ratio, and analyzing the substance. By separating and recording ions with different mass to charge ratios and their different trajectories in electric or magnetic fields, mass spectrometry can be obtained to analyze the composition or structure of the sample. The mass spectrometer used typically consists of an injection system, ion source, analyzer, receiver, and recorder, as well as corresponding vacuum and electronic systems. The sample is introduced by the injection system. In the ion source, sample molecules or atoms are ionized into ions, separated by a mass analyzer composed of an electric or magnetic field, and then detected and recorded to obtain a mass spectrum. In the mass spectrum, each peak represents an ion with a specific charge ratio, and the intensity of the peak represents the number of such ions. Therefore, qualitative and quantitative analysis can be conducted. For organic compounds, structural analysis can also be performed based on the mass charge ratio and relative intensity of the mass spectrum peaks. Mass spectrometry is widely used in nuclear industry, geology, metallurgy, pharmaceutical composition identification, petrochemical industry, environmental protection, doping detection, space exploration and other fields. According to the scope of application, it can be divided into three categories: isotope, inorganic, and organic analysis. Gas, liquid, and the same three state samples can all be analyzed using different types of mass spectrometers. Its advantages are high sensitivity, low sample usage, simultaneous detection of multiple components, and the ability to obtain isotope information. The disadvantage is that the instrument structure is complex and expensive.

explanation_cn: 反应堆冷却系统中某些部位的物质溶入冷却剂，随着冷却剂流动，在另外的部位析出和沉积的现象。例如，在用钠作冷却剂的快中子反应堆二回路系统中，有低合金钢和奥氏体不锈钢两种材料的部件。低合金钢中的碳析出溶入钠中，钠中的碳在不锈钢的部位析出并使不锈钢渗碳。结果低合金钢由于脱碳而强度降低，不锈钢由于渗碳抗腐蚀性、韧性降低。低合金钢中加入增加碳稳定性的元素吋减缓碳溶入钠中的速度。
explanation_en: The phenomenon where substances in certain parts of the reactor cooling system dissolve into the coolant and precipitate and deposit in other parts as the coolant flows. For example, in the secondary circuit system of fast reactor with sodium as coolant, there are components made of materials of low alloy steel and austenilic stainless steel. The carbon in low alloy steel precipitates into sodium, and the carbon in sodium precipitates in stainless steel and carburizing stainless steel. Results The strength of low alloy steel decreased due to decarburization, and the corrosion resistance and toughness of stainless steel decreased due to carburizing. The addition of elements that increase carbon stability in low alloy steel slows down the rate of carbon dissolving into sodium.

explanation_cn: 铀浓缩加工成核燃料过程中的副产品，其定义是铀-235丰度低于0.711%的铀。贫铀是放射性重金属，可发射α、β和γ射线。贫铀的放射性主要由具有高线性能量转移( linear energy transfer，LET)能力的α，3粒子构成，其辐射强度是天然铀的40%，放射半衰期长达4.49×109年，一般不引起外照射损伤。贫铀不仅具有放射毒性，更主要是具有化学（或称重金属）毒性。
explanation_en: The by-product of uranium enrichment and processing into nuclear fuel is defined as uranium with uranium -235 abundance less than 0.711%. Depleted uranium is a radioactive heavy metal that can emit α、β and γ Radiation. The radioactivity of depleted uranium is mainly attributed to its high linear energy transfer (LET) ability α， 3 particles, its radiation intensity is 40% of natural uranium, and its radiation half life is 4.49 × In 109 years, it generally does not cause external radiation damage. Depleted uranium not only has radiation toxicity, but also mainly has chemical (or weighing metal) toxicity.

explanation_cn: 又称富燃料推进剂（fuel-richpropellant)。一类特殊用途的复合固体推进剂，其余氧系数一般只有0.05-0.3，远低于常规复合固体推进剂的0.5-0.6。主要用于大气层中工作的固体火箭冲压发动机。贫氧推进剂一次燃烧后产生大量未完全反应的高温燃气及金属颗粒，在喷入补燃室后与冲压空气掺混进行二次燃烧反应。由于能够利用外界环境中的氧参与燃烧反应，可显著提高冲压发动机比冲-贫氧推进剂的基本组成和制造工艺与常规复合固体推进剂相似，只是氧化剂含量相对较少（一般为25%-35%)，燃料（包括金属、非金属燃料和黏合剂）含量相对较高（一般为35%-45%)。按燃料添加剂可将贫氧推进剂分为少烟的碳氢富燃料推进剂、中能的镁铝富燃料推进剂及高能的含硼富燃料推进剂3类。
explanation_en: It is also called fuel rich propellant. For a class of special purpose composition solid propellant, the remaining oxygen coefficient is generally only 0.05-0.3, much lower than 0.5-0.6 of conventional composition solid propellant. It is mainly used for solid rocket stamping working in the atmosphere. After the primary combustion of oxygen rich propellant, a large number of high temperature gas and metal particles with incomplete reaction are produced, which are mixed with stamping air for secondary combustion reaction after being injected into the afterburning chamber. Because the oxygen in the external environment can be used to participate in combustion reaction, the basic composition and manufacturing process of stamping specific impulse lean oxygen propellant can be significantly improved. It is similar to conventional composition solid propellant, except that the content of oxidizer is relatively small (generally 25% -35%), and the content of fuel (including metal, non-metallic fuel and adhesive) is relatively high (generally 35% -45%). According to fuel additive, lean oxygen propellant can be divided into three categories: low smoke hydrocarbon fuel rich propellant, medium energy magnesium aluminum fuel rich propellant and high-energy boron fuel rich propellant.

name_en: base metal conductive material for thick film
explanation_cn: 贱金属厚膜导电材料是一种新型导体，常见的有厚膜铜导体、镍导体和铝导体等。这些贱金属导体浆料有的可以在空气中烧成，有些则必须在中性（N2、Ar)或还原性（N2-H2)气氛中烧成。贱 金属导体有许多优点，如电阻低、可焊性和抗焊溶性好、无离子迁移等；其缺点是对工艺要求很高，老化性能不如贵金属好。
explanation_en: Base metal conductive material for thick film is a new type of conductor. The common conductors are thick film copper conductor, nickel conductor and aluminum conductor. Some of these common metal paste can be fired in air, while others must be fired in neutral (N2, Ar) or reducing (N2-H2) atmosphere. Base metal conductors have many advantages, such as low resistance, good solderability and resistance to soldering, and no ion migration; The disadvantage is that the process requirements are very high, and the aging performance is not as good as that of precious metals.

explanation_cn: 指Al-B、 Ni-B和等导体浆料。在这些贱金属导体浆料中，都含有B或Si，在空气中烧结时，B、Si先被氧化.它们包封了金属粉，保护金属不被氧化，所以这些导体浆料可在空气中烧成。
explanation_en: Refers to Al-B, Ni-B, and other conductor slurries. These common metal paste contain B or Si. When sintering in air, B and Si are oxidized first. They encapsulate metal powder to protect metal from oxidation, so these conductor pastes can be fired in air.

name_cn: 贱金属氧化物电阻浆料
explanation_cn: 由金属氧化物CuO、CdO、In2O3、 SnO2、MoS2等于玻璃黏结剂等所组成的用于制作厚薄电阻的材料。这些浆料大部分配方要在保护气氛下烧结，多数仍处于研究阶段，尚未实用化。但其可代替贵金属而降低成本，因此是今后研究的一个方向。
explanation_en: It is a materials composed of metal oxides CuO, CdO, In2O3, SnO2, MoS2 equal to glass adhesive and used to make thick and thin resistors. Most of these slurry formulations need to be sintered under protective atmosphere, most of which are still in the research stage and have not yet been applied. But it can replace precious metals and reduce costs, so it is a direction of future research.

explanation_cn: 是指织物和胶片同时通过等速回转的压延机辊筒间隙，在辊筒压力作用下，贴合成覆有一定厚度胶层的挂胶织物的工艺过程。压延机等速贴胶的优点是速度快、效率高和对织物的损伤小；缺点是胶料不能很好地渗入织物缝隙，故胶与布间的附着力较差；而且两胶层之间有空隙，容易产生气泡。贴胶作业通常采用三辊压延机一次单面贴胶或四辊压延机一次双面贴胶。多用于制造轮胎和工业制品用胶布半成品和防雨布等，四辊双面贴胶（两贴）在轮胎工业中广泛采用。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of laminating fabric and film into adhesive coated fabric with a certain thickness of adhesive layer under the pressure of the roller through the gap between the rollers of a rolling machine with constant rotation speed. The advantages of a rolling machine for constant speed adhesive application are fast speed, high efficiency, and minimal damage to the fabric; The disadvantage is that the adhesive material cannot penetrate well into the gaps of the fabric, resulting in poor adhesion between the adhesive and the fabric; Moreover, there is a gap between the two adhesive layers, which is prone to the formation of bubbles. The gluing operation usually uses a three roll rolling machine for single sided gluing or a four roll rolling machine for double sided gluing. It is commonly used in the manufacturing of tires and industrial products, such as semi-finished adhesive tape and rainproof cloth. Four roller double-sided adhesive tape (two stickers) is widely used in the tire industry.

explanation_cn: 金（Au)、银〈Ag)、铂（Pt)、钯（Pd)、铑（Rh)、铱（Ir),钌（Ru)和锇（Os)八种元素统称为贵金属，其中，铂、钯、铑、铱、钌和锇又称为铂族金属。
explanation_en: The eight elements of gold (Au), silver (Ag), platinum (Pt), palladium (Pd), rhodium (Rh), iridium (Ir), ruthenium (Ru) and osmium (Os) are collectively referred to as precious metals, among which platinum, palladium, rhodium, iridium, ruthenium and osmium are also referred to as platinum group metals.

explanation_cn: 主要用于尾气净化，贵金属低温催化材料常用的有Pd、Pt、Rh、Au四种。
explanation_en: It is mainly used for tail gas purification. low temperature noble metal catalysts commonly include Pd, Pt, Rh and Au.

explanation_cn: 未填满的d电子轨道使贵金属表面易将吸附反应物转化为活性中间物质，使得几乎所有的贵金属都可用作催化材料，常用的有银、金、铂、钯、铑等。贵金属催化材料要求负载在比表面积大的载体上，银较多负载在氧化铝上，金较多负载在活性炭、沸石等上；钼、钯、铑的负载范围广泛。
explanation_en: The unfilled d d electron orbital makes the surface of precious metals easy to convert the adsorbed reactants into active intermediates, making almost all precious metals can be used as catalytic materials, such as silver, gold, platinum, palladium, rhodium, etc. Precious metal catalytic materials are required to be loaded on carriers with large specific surface, silver is more loaded on alumina, and gold is more loaded on activated carbon, zeolite, etc; The loading range of molybdenum, palladium, and rhodium is wide.

name_en: precious metal conductive material for thick film
explanation_cn: 贵金属厚膜导电材料包括金、钯-金、铂-钯-金、钯-银等，应用较为广泛的是钯-银、金、铂-金等.贵金属厚膜导电材料的特点是有很好的导电性、工艺简单、可在空气中烧成、工艺敏感性差、重复性好、导电膜性能稳定。
explanation_en: Precious metal conductive material for thick film include gold, palladium gold, platinum palladium gold, palladium silver, etc. The more widely used are palladium silver, gold, platinum gold, etc. precious metal conductive material for thick film are characterized by good conductivity, simple process, can be fired in air, poor process sensitivity, good repeatability, and stable conductive film performance.

explanation_cn: 用于微电子工业中集成电路和分立器件内部连接引线的贵金属材料。
explanation_en: Precious metals materials used for connecting leads inside integrated circuits and discrete devices in microelectronics industry.

explanation_cn: 用于制造弹性元件的贵金属材料。具有高弹性、弹性后效小、高强度、无磁、耐腐浊及高温抗氧化等特性。贵金属弹性材料一般分为高弹性合金和恒弹性合金两类。高弹性合金有Pt系、Au系和Os系合金。
explanation_en: Precious metals materials used for manufacturing elasticity elements. It has the characteristics of high elasticity, low after effect of elasticity, high strength, non-magnetic, corrosion resistance, high temperature oxidation resistance, etc. Precious metal elastic materials are generally divided into high elastic alloy and constant elastic alloy. High elastic alloy include Pt series, Au series and Os series alloy.

explanation_cn: 用于制造电接触元件，且具有良好的导电性、导热性、耐磨性能以及适当硬度和弹性的贵金属导体称为贵金属接触材料。其主要作用是在电极设备和仪器系统中传递电信号和电能以及接通或切断各种电路。按用途分为电触点材料、电刷材料、绕组材料、导电环、换向片或整流片材料、接插件材料。贵金属接触材料主要有银系、金系和铂族金属系。银系接触材料导电性能和导热性能高，接触电阻低，加工性能好，价格相对便宜，应用最为广泛。
explanation_en: Precious metals conductors that are used to manufacture electrical contact components and have good conductivity, thermal conductivity, wear resistance and appropriate hardness and elasticity are called precious metal contact materials. Its main function is to transmit electrical signals and energy in electrode equipment and instrument systems, as well as to connect or disconnect various circuits. It can be divided into electrical contact materials, brush materials, winding materials, conductive ring, reversing piece or rectifying piece materials, connector materials according to the use. Precious metal contact materials mainly include silver series, gold series and platinum group metal series. Silver based contact materials have high conductivity and thermal conductivity, low contact resistance, good processing performance, relatively cheap price, and are most widely used.

explanation_cn: 由贵金属或贵金属化合物的超细粉末、添加物和有机载体组成的一种适用于印刷特性或涂敷的膏状物。可分为导电浆料、电阻浆料和介质浆料。贵金属浆料由三种基本成分组成：功能相、黏结剂和载体。功能相决定浆料的应用功能：导电浆料的功能相通常是贵金属和贵金属或合金的混合物，起导电作用；电阻浆料的功能相主要是二氧化钉、钌酸铅、钌酸铋等。
explanation_en: A paste suitable for printing or coating, which is composed of precious metals or precious metals compound superfine powder, additive and organic carrier. It can be divided into conductive paste, resistance paste and dielectric paste. Precious metal paste consists of three basic components: functional phase, adhesive and carrier. The functional phase determines the application function of the paste: the functional phase of the conductive paste is usually a mixture of precious metals and precious metals or alloy, which plays a conductive role; The functional phase of the resistance paste are mainly nails, lead ruthenate, bismuth ruthenate, etc.

explanation_cn: 用于准确测量宽范围温度的贵金属导体.具有抗氧化能力强、热电势高、可在2-2573K的范围内使用.热电势与温度的单值函数关系好等特点。分热电偶测温材料和电阻测温材料两类。热电偶测温材料主要用来制作高温抗氧化热电偶、核场中测温热电偶、高温温差电动势热电偶、快速反应热电偶等测温元件，在航空、宇航、核工业等领域有突出优势。
explanation_en: Precious metals conductor for accurate measurement of temperature in a wide range. It has strong oxidation resistance, high thermoelectric potential, can be used in the range of 2-2573K, and has a good single value function relationship between thermoelectric potential and temperature. There are two types of thermocouple temperature measuring materials and resistance temperature measuring materials. Thermocouple temperature measurement materials are mainly used to make high-temperature oxidation resistance thermocouples, temperature measurement thermocouples in the nuclear field, high-temperature thermoelectromotive force thermocouples, quick reaction thermocouples and other temperature measurement elements, which have outstanding advantages in aviation, aerospace, nuclear industry and other fields.

explanation_cn: 贵金属在口腔内具有良好的生物相容性.对机体无毒、无刺激、无致畸作用.能长期与机体组织相适应，因此常在牙科使用，称作贵金属牙科材料。、
explanation_en: Precious metals have good biocompatibility in the oral cavity. They are non-toxic, non irritation and non teratogenic to the body. They can adapt to the body tissues for a long time, so they are often used in dentistry, called precious metal dental materials

explanation_cn: 用作化学和电化学反应电极的贵金属材料。主要包括：纯铂、纯钯、铂钯合金以及二氧化钉。贵金属电极材料的抗腐蚀能力强.导电性能高，使用寿命长,可提高电化学过程的效率，降低过电位。
explanation_en: Precious metals materials used as chemical and electrochemical reaction electrode. It mainly includes: pure platinum, pure palladium, platinum palladium alloy alloy and oxide nails. Precious metal electrode materials has strong corrosion resistance, high conductivity and long service life, which can improve the efficiency of electrochemical process and reduce overvoltage.

explanation_cn: 利用贵金属电阻特性（如电阻率、电阻温度系数等），在功能器件中主要起通过电流、限流、控制电流及发热等作用的贵金属材料。这类材料具有适当的电阻率和电阻温度系数、稳定的电学性能、抗氧化性能、抗腐蚀性能，以及良好的加工性能和焊接性能。
explanation_en: Precious metals materials that uses the resistance characteristics of precious metals (such as resistivity, resistance temperature coefficient, etc.) to play a major role in passing current, limiting current, controlling current and heating in functional devices. Such materials have appropriate resistivity and resistance temperature coefficient, stable electrical properties, oxidation resistance, corrosion resistance, and good processing and weld properties.

explanation_cn: 集成电路布线和制备薄膜等方面使用的贵金属及其合金的溅射靶材的统称。Ai、Pu、Pd、Ag等靶材多用于大规模集成电路，CoCrPt、CoPt和CoPd等合金靶材多用于磁性材料的制备。
explanation_en: Sputtering targets of precious metals and their alloy used in integrated circuit wiring and film preparation. Ai, Pu, Pd, Ag and other targets are mostly used for large-scale integrated circuits, and alloy targets such as CoCrPt, CoPt and CoPd are mostly used for the preparation of magnetic materials.

explanation_cn: 因贵金属色泽美丽，化学稳定性高和较高的保值增值作用.常被用于制作首饰和其他装饰品，称为贵金属首饰材料。主要有金、银、铂、钯4种元素及其与其他元素形成的合金。
explanation_en: Precious metals is often used to make jewelry and other decorations, called precious metal jewellery materials, because of its beautiful color, high chemical stability and high value maintenance and appreciation. There are mainly four elements: gold, silver, platinum, palladium and their alloy formed with other elements.

explanation_cn: 属于气体透过法。气体流过粉末床的透过率或受到的阻力与粉末的粗细或比表面积的大小有关。粉末越细，比表面积越大。对气体的阻力也就越大，单位时间内流过给定横截面积和高度的粉末床的气体体积。
explanation_en: Belongs to the gas permeation method. The transmissivity or resistance of gas flowing through powder bed is related to the size of powder or specific surface. The finer the powder, the larger the specific surface. The greater the resistance to gas, the volume of gas flowing through the powder bed with a given cross-sectional area and height in unit time.

explanation_cn: 简称费米分布，无相互作用自旋为半整数的量子粒子在诸能级(E)上平均粒子占有数的平衡分布。
explanation_en: Referred to as the Fermi distribution, it refers to the equilibrium distribution of the average particle occupancy of quantum particles with a semi integer spin at various energy levels (E) without interaction.

explanation_cn: 在一组由全同粒子组成的体系中，具有自旋量子数为半整数的基本粒子。费米子遵从泡利不相容原理。
explanation_en: In a system composed of identical particles, elementary particles with a spin quantum number of half integers. Fermion obeys pauli exclusion principle.

explanation_cn: 是一个反映电子在能带中填充能级水平高低的参数。从统计角度看，热平衡状态下的电子按能量大小呈现一定的统计分布规律。根据量子统计理论，服从泡利不相容原理的电子遵循费米-狄拉克（Fermi-Dirac)分布。
explanation_en: It is a parameter reflecting the level of energy level filled by the electron in the energy band. From a statistical perspective, electrons in a thermal equilibrium state exhibit a certain statistical distribution pattern according to their energy levels. According to quantum statistical theory, electrons that follow the Pauli exclusion principle follow the Fermi Dirac distribution.

explanation_cn: 描述固体电子态的k空间中的一个特殊等能面（能量为费米能EF),费米面是系统处于基态（0K)时电子占据态与非占据态的分界面。
explanation_en: Describe a special isoenergetic surface (energy is Fermi energy EF) in the k space of the solid electronic state. The Fermi surface is the interface between the occupied and unoccupied states of the electron when the system is in the ground state (0K).

explanation_cn: 一种钙硼硅酸盐。化学成分为CaB2（SiO4）2。常呈短柱状，顶端楔形.晶面具纵纹，可形成晶簇，集合体呈块状或粒状。无色、浅黄色、褐色，偶见粉红色。玻璃至油脂光泽。莫氏硬度7,密度3.00g/Cm3。一般磨制成刻面宝石，很少直接作为珠宝首饰，多用于收藏。在白云石岩与微斜长石和正长石共生。产于缅甸、马达加斯加、墨西哥、日本、瑞士。
explanation_en: A type of calcium borosilicate. The chemical composition is CaB2 (SiO4) 2. It often appears as a short column with a wedge-shaped top. The crystal surface has longitudinal lines, which can form crystal clusters, and the aggregates are in block or granular form. Colorless, light yellow, brown, occasionally pink. Glass to grease gloss. Mohs hardness 7, density 3.00g/Cm3. Generally, it is grinded into faceted gems, rarely used directly as jewelry, and mostly used for collection. Dolomite rock is associated with microcline and ortho feldspar. Produced in Myanmar, Madagascar, Mexico, Japan, Switzerland.

explanation_cn: 一种有效的虚拟原子核电子的相互作用势。赝势最初是从能带计算的正交平面波方法所引出的一个概念。其普遍定义是：在原子球内部用一个假设的势代替真正的原子势，求解原子间空间的薛定谔方程时若所得能量本征值不变（即与真实原子势的结果一样），则此虚拟的势即是赝势。在正交平面波方法中出现的（波函数）正交项趋向于抵消真实势，从而给出一个有效势。后者比真实的晶体势弱很多，当时即称为赝势。在薛定谔方程中用这个较弱的势代替真实的势，得到一个有效波函数，称为赝波函数。由于赝势比真实势弱，所以赝波函数比真实波函数平滑，因而展开式收敛较快，但本征值不变，可获得正确的能谱。正交化平面波方法引出的赝势仅是赝势的一种具体形式。理论证明：任何一个假想（或虚拟）的势场，只要它能给出原子球半径r,处径向波函数正确的对数微商它就是一个贋势。由于波函数总是对应于某一确定的能所以赝势也是对应于某一能量而言。具体确定赝势的方法包括：模型势法;经验势法;自洽势法。常见的模型势有中空模型、Abarankov-Heine模型。研究发现，根据一组实验数据所确定的半经验赝势预测其他不同实验，时常可以得到预想的实验结果。
explanation_en: An effective virtual nuclear electron interaction potential. Pseudopotential theory was originally a concept derived from the orthogonal plane wave method for energy band calculation. Its general definition is: replace the real atomic potential with a hypothetical potential inside the atomic sphere. If the energy eigenvalue obtained when solving the Schrodinger equation in the space between atoms remains unchanged (that is, the result is the same as that of the real atomic potential), the virtual potential is a pseudopotential theory. The orthogonal term (wave function) appearing in the orthogonal plane wave method tends to cancel out the true potential, thus giving an effective potential. The latter is much weaker than the real crystal potential, which is called pseudopotential theory at that time. In the Schr ? dinger equation, replacing the real potential with this weaker potential yields an effective wave function called the pseudo wave function. Since the pseudopotential theory is weaker than the real potential, the pseudo wave function is smoother than the real wave function, so the expansion converges faster, but the eigenvalue remains unchanged, and the correct energy spectrum can be obtained. The pseudopotential theory derived from the orthogonalized plane wave method is only a specific form of pseudopotential theory. Theoretical proof: Any hypothetical (or virtual) potential field that can provide the correct logarithmic derivative of the radial wave function at the radius r of the atomic sphere is a pseudo potential. Since the wave function always corresponds to a certain energy, the pseudopotential theory also corresponds to a certain energy. The methods to determine pseudopotential theory include: model potential method; Empirical potential method; Self consistent potential method. Common model potentials include hollow model and Abarankov Heine model. It is found that the semi empirical pseudopotential theory determined from a set of experimental data can often predict other different experiments and obtain the expected experimental results.

explanation_cn: 电池内阻是指电池在工作时，电流流过电池内部所受到的阻力，它是集流体、电极活性物质、隔膜、电解液的电阻之和。充电态内阻指的是电池100%充满电时的内阻.放电态内阻指的是电池充分放电后的内阻。一般地.充电态内阻阻值较小，且比较稳定；放电态内阻不太稳定.且偏大。
explanation_en: The internal resistance of the battery refers to the resistance of the current flowing through the battery when the battery is working. It is the sum of the resistance of the collector fluid, electrode active substance, separator and electrolyte. Charging state internal resistance refers to the internal resistance of a battery when it is 100% fully charged. Discharge state internal resistance refers to the internal resistance of a battery after full discharge. Generally, the internal resistance value in the charging state is relatively small and stable; The internal resistance in the discharge state is unstable and too high.

explanation_cn: 在起爆药、传爆药或其他猛炸药的直接作用下。炸药发生爆轰的难易程度，又称爆轰感度（sensitivitytodetonation)。一般以最小起爆药量（极限药量）表示，它是指在一定试验条件下，使猛炸药完全爆轰所需的最小起爆药量。此量愈小，猛炸药的起爆感度愈高。最小起爆药量还与试验条件（如炸药颗粒度和装药密度等）有关。最小起爆药量也用来衡量起爆药的起爆能力，其值愈小，起爆药的起爆能力愈大。
explanation_en: Under the direct action of primary explosive, booster explosive or other heavy explosives. The degree of difficulty of detonation of explosive, also known as detonation sensitivity. Generally, it is expressed by the minimum initial charge (limit charge), which refers to the minimum initial charge required to fully detonation the heavy explosive under certain test conditions. The smaller this amount is, the higher the detonation sensitivity of the heavy explosive is. The minimum amount of primary explosive is also related to the test conditions (such as explosive particle size and density of charge, etc.). The minimum detonating charge is also used to measure the detonating ability of primary explosive. The smaller the value, the greater the detonating ability of primary explosive.

explanation_cn: 又称初级炸药。易受外界低能刺激能量激发而发生燃烧或爆炸，并能迅速转变成爆轰的一类敏感炸药。受外界热、电、光、机械、冲击波等激发能量激发。具有较高的敏感性和燃烧迅速转变成爆轰等特征，故用于引爆较钝感的猛炸药。广泛用于各种火工品中作始发装药。常用的起爆药有叠氮化铅、斯蒂芬酸铅、硝酸肼镍、雷汞等，起爆药除要有足够的起爆能力、合适的特定感度外，还必须保证在生产、储存和使用过程中高度的安全性、良好的安定性、相容性和装药的工艺性。起爆药按组分分为单质、混合和配合物起爆药三种》单质起爆药是含有特征爆炸基团的单一化合物。如重氮化物类、叠氮化物类、长链或环状多氮化物类、硝基酚的重金属盐类、雷酸盐类等。混合起爆药是两种以上的单质起爆药或起爆药与可燃剂、氧化剂等组分经混合组成，如受针刺或撞击激发的击发药或针刺药、电能激发的点火药等。配合物起爆药是新发展的一类安全钝感型起爆药。
explanation_en: It is also called primary explosive. It is a kind of sensitive explosive that is easily excited by the external low-energy irritation energy to produce combustion or explosion and can quickly transformation into detonation. Excited by external excitation energy such as heat, electricity, light, machinery, shock waves, etc. It has the characteristics of high sensitivity and rapid transformation of combustion into detonation, so it is used to detonate insensitive heavy explosives. Widely used as the starting charge in various initiating explosive devices. Common primary explosive include lead azide, lead styphnate, nickel hydrazine nitrate, thunderbolt mercury, etc. In addition to having sufficient initiating capacity and appropriate specific sensitivity, primary explosive must also ensure a high degree of safety, good stability, compatibility and charge processability during production, storage and use. Primary explosive can be divided into three types according to composition: single substance, mixed and complex primary explosive single compound primary explosive is a single compound containing characteristic explosion groups. Such as diazides, azides, long chain or cyclic polynitrides, heavy metal salts of nitrophenols, and fulminates. Mixing primary explosive is composed of two or more single compound primary explosive or primary explosive mixed with combustible agent, oxidizer and other components, such as percussion composition or acupuncture explosive excited by acupuncture or impact, ignition composition excited by electric energy, etc. Complex primary explosive is a newly developed safety insensitive primary explosive.

explanation_cn:
超临界发泡成型是一种物理发泡成型技术，同时也可视为一种微孔发泡成型技术。在这个过程中，超临界状态的气体，如二氧化碳或氮气，被注入到特殊的塑化装置中，然后与熔融的原材料均匀混合扩散，形成单相混合溶胶。这个混合溶胶随后被引导到模具腔体或挤出口模，产生巨大的压力降，使气体析出形成大量的气泡核。

在随后的冷却成型过程中，溶胶内部的气泡核会不断生长，最终形成微孔发泡的塑料制品。这些微孔塑料制品具有高比强度和高性价比，可以显著提高制品的尺寸精度，缩短产品开发周期，减少产品残余应力，减少翘曲变形，消除表面缩痕，缩短薄壁制品的成型周期，有效节约原材料，减轻产品质量。

超临界发泡成型的优点包括低成本，绿色环保，混合溶胶的流动性增强，低黏度，易于充模，以及超临界气体设备简单且成本低廉。这使得该技术在制造微孔发泡的塑料制品时具有广泛的应用前景。
explanation_en: Supercritical foaming molding is a physical foam molding technology, and can also be regarded as a microporous foam molding technology. In this process, the supercritical gas, such as carbon dioxide or nitrogen, is injected into a special plasticizing device, and then mixed evenly with the molten raw materials for diffusion to form a single-phase mixed sol. The mixed sol is then induction to the mold cavity or the extrusion die, resulting in a huge pressure drop, which causes the gas to separate out and form a large number of bubble cores. In the subsequent cooling and molding process, the bubble core inside the sol will continue to grow, and eventually form a microporous plastics product. These microporous plastics products have high specific strength and high cost performance, which can significantly improve the dimensional accuracy of products, shorten the product development cycle, reduce the residual stress of products, reduce warpage deformation, eliminate surface shrinkage marks, shorten the forming cycle of thin-walled products, effectively save raw materials, and reduce product quality. The advantages of supercritical foaming molding include low cost, environmental protection, enhanced flow ability of mixed sol, low viscosity, easy mold filling, and simple and low-cost supercritical gas equipment. This makes the technology have a broad application prospect in the manufacture of microcellular foamed plastics products.

explanation_cn: 通常指碳含量小于0.03%的不锈钢。超低碳不锈钢具有优异的耐蚀性特别是晶间腐蚀敏感件很低_，为避免发生晶间腐蚀，钢中碳含必须控制在很低的水平，但不发生晶间腐蚀的临界碳含量并不是绝对的，而是相对于具体钢种成分、介质条件、钢材热历史等因素而改变的，故超低碳不锈钢的碳含控制范围必须根据具体情况而确，如铁素体不锈钢的碳含量控制要求就比奥氏体不锈钢更为严格。目前我国超低碳不锈钢的碳含量主要有四个级別，O22(碳含量最大值0.030%)、O19(碳含量最大值0.025%)、O15(碳含量最大值0.020%)、O08(碳含量最大值0.010%)。采用精选的原料和氩氧脱碳和真空氧脱碳精炼法以生产超低碳不锈钢。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to stainless steel with carbon content less than 0.03%. Extra low carbon stainless steel has excellent corrosion resistance, especially the intergranular corrosion sensitive parts are very low, In order to avoid intergranular corrosion, the carbon content in steel must be controlled at a very low level, but the critical carbon content that does not cause intergranular corrosion is not absolute, but changes relative to the specific steel composition, medium conditions, steel product thermal history and other factors. Therefore, the carbon content control range of extra low carbon stainless steel must be determined according to the specific situation. For example, the carbon content control requirements of ferritic stainless steel are more stringent than those of austenilic stainless steel. At present, there are four levels of carbon content of ultra-low carbon stainless steel in China: O22 (the maximum carbon content is 0.030%), O19 (the maximum carbon content is 0.025%), O15 (the maximum carbon content is 0.020%), and O08 (the maximum carbon content is 0.010%). Extra low carbon stainless steel is produced with selected raw materials and argon oxygen decarburization and vacuum oxygen decarburization refining methods.

explanation_cn: 碳含量极低的钢，通常指碳含量低于0.03%的钢。碳是钢中重要的合金元素，可以明显提高钢的强度和淬透性，但对钢的韧性、焊接性、深冲性和耐蚀性具有不利的影响，因此对韧性、深冲性或耐晶间腐蚀性能有特殊要求的钢必须采用具有极低碳含量的超低碳钢。由T氮对相关性能具有同样不利的影响.故超低碳钢同时也需要对钢中氮含量进行严格控制。采用优选原料及特殊精炼工艺以生产超低碳钢。超低碳钢包括超深冲钢、IF钢、超低碳不锈钢等。
explanation_en: Steel with very low carbon content usually refers to steel with carbon content less than 0.03%. Carbon is an important alloy element in steel, which can significantly improve the strength and hardenability of steel, but has adverse effects on the toughness, weldability, deep drawing and corrosion resistance of steel. Therefore, steel with special requirements for toughness, deep drawing or intergranular corrosion resistance must use ultra-low-carhon steel with very low carbon content. T nitrogen has the same adverse effect on relevant properties, so ultra-low-carhon steel also needs to strictly control the nitrogen content in steel. Ultra-low-carhon steel is produced by using optimized raw materials and special refining process. Ultra-low-carhon steel includes ultra deep drawing steel, IF steel, extra low carbon stainless steel, etc.

explanation_cn: 超低膨胀微晶玻璃是指以Li2O、Al2O3、SiO2为主要成分的玻璃经过严格的受控晶化处理后形成的以负膨胀β-石英固溶体纳米晶相和正膨胀玻璃相构成的一种复合材料，具有优异的光学、热学、力学性能，是目前变温环境尺寸稳定性最好的材料，在航空、航天、电子、兵器、船舶、精密机械等诸多领域得到广泛应用。β-石英固溶体是β-石英和β-锂霞石形成的连续固溶体，随着晶化过程的进行，固溶程度增加，更多的Li+、Al3+、P5+等离子从玻璃相进入β-石英固溶体中，改变着β-石英固溶体晶体和残余玻璃相的热膨胀系数，进而影响微晶玻璃整体的热膨胀性能，微晶玻璃的热膨胀系数从玻璃相的10-6数量级逐渐减小到10-7数量级，10-8数量级乃至零膨胀。当晶化过程继续进行，残余玻璃相中还有过剩的Li+时，β-石英固溶体晶相含量进一步增加，微晶玻璃从零膨胀开始向负膨胀变化，而且负膨胀系数逐渐变大。

The coefficient of thermcal expansion of glass-ceramics gradually decreases from 10-6 to 10-7, 10-8 or even zero expansion of glass phase. When the crystallization process continues and there is surplus Li+in the residual glass phase, β- The crystal phase content of quartze solid solution further increases, and the glass-ceramics change from zero expansion to negative expansion, and the negative expansion coefficient gradually increases.
