explanation_cn:
又称为超固相线液相烧结。如果原料粉末全部是预合金化粉末，在合金的液相线和同相线之间的温度下加热其压坯，就会出现液相，其烧结过程叫做超固相线液相烧结。它与一般的液相烧结有所不同，其烧结阶段经历不同的阶段。

在烧结初期，烧结温度超过固相线温度，在预合金化粉末颗粒内部的晶界、颗粒间的颈部区以及晶粒内会形成液相。至于在何处形成液相取决于粉末的合金成分、显微组织、粉末粒度和加热速率。随着液相的增加，在高于固相线温度的某一温度下，晶界会布满液相。超过这一温度，晶粒就会有足够的迁移能量，导致晶粒碎化和在毛细力作用下颗粒重排。

超固相线液相烧结广泛用于生产钢铁及非铁合金。钢铁合金包括不锈钢、工具钢及沉淀硬化钢。非铁合金包括从简单的蒙乃尔、黄铜、青铜到复杂的镍基和钴基高温合金。具体应用包括高温合金发动机零件的修复，自润滑轴承，耐腐蚀不锈钢零件，高导电性钎焊料，钴-铬合金耐磨层，用于金刚石黏结的钼基和钴基合金，以及由马氏体不锈钢制造的汽轮机叶片和高速钢刀具。在这些应用中，工具钢和不锈钢的超固相线液相烧结是其中最主要的。
explanation_en: It is also called supersolidus liquid phase sintering. If the raw material powder is all pre alloy powder and its compact is heated at the temperature between the liquidus and the isomorphus of the alloy, a liquid phase will appear, and its sintering process is called supersolidus liquid phase sintering. It is different from the general liquid phase sintering, and its sintering stage goes through different stages. At the initial stage of sintering, when the sintering temperature exceeds the solidus temperature, liquid phase will be formed in the grain boundary, the neck area between particles and the grain inside the pre alloy powder particle. Where the liquid phase is formed depends on the alloy composition, microstructure, partidesize and heating rate of the powder. As the liquid phase increases, at a temperature higher than the solidus temperature, grain boundaries will be filled with the liquid phase. Beyond this temperature, the grains will have sufficient migration energy, leading to grain fragmentation and particle rearrangement under capillary force. Supersolidus liquid phase sintering is widely used to produce steel and non iron alloy. Steel alloy includes stainless steel, tool steel and precipitation hardening steel. Non iron alloy range from simple Monel, brass, bronze to complex nickel based and cobalt-base superalloy. Specific applications include repair of high temperature alloy engine parts, self-lubricating bearing, corrosion-resistant stainless steel parts, high conductivity brazing filler metal, cobalt chromium alloy wear-resistant layer, molybdenum based and cobalt based alloy for diamond bonding, turbine blades made of martensitic stainless steel and high speed steel cutters. In these applications, supersolidus liquid phase sintering of tool steel and stainless steel is the most important.

explanation_cn: 火成岩的一个大类。指化学成分中Si02含量45%,同时富含MgO和FeO的火成岩。主要矿物为橄榄石和辉石以及它们的蚀变产物（蛇纹石、滑石、绿泥石等），深灰黑色，密度较大。代表性岩石符橄榄岩、辉石岩和金伯利岩、苦橄岩等，常与基性岩组成分异杂岩体。常沿深大断裂带分布，呈透镜状、脉状或不规则状，产状为岩床、岩盆、岩筒等，规模大小不一。与其有关的矿产有铬、镍、钴、铂族金属、金刚石、石棉等。
explanation_en: A large category of igneous rocks. Refers to igneous rocks with a chemical composition of 45% SiO2 and rich in MgO and FeO. The main minerals are olivine, pyroxene and their alteration products (serpentine, talc, chlorite, etc.), which are dark gray black with high density. The representative rock, such as peridotite, pyroxenolite, kimberite and picrite, often form differentiated complexes with basic rock. It is often distributed along the deep and large fracture zone, in lenticular, vein or irregular shape, with the occurrence of rock bed, rock basin, rock tube, etc., in different sizes. Its related minerals include chromium, nickel, cobalt, platinum group metals, diamond, asbestos, etc.

explanation_cn: 某些材料在特定的组织状态（如超细晶粒），一定的温度和形变速率下表现出极高的塑性，这种现象称为超塑性。一般工业材料室温伸长率约为百分之几到百分之几十的范围，但超塑性材料的伸长率可高达百分之几百甚至百分之几千。产生超塑性的条件有三个，一是晶粒要细，二是温度要高（一般要大于熔点的一半），三是值要大。晶粒愈细，温度愈高，能发生超塑性的应变速率范围也升高。利用蠕变理论中扩散控制的晶界滑动机制可解释低应力下的超塑性现象。超塑性首先在Al-Zn合金中发现，后来在铁基，铁镍基合金，钛合金以及陶瓷中也发现存在有超塑性，并已获得了工业应用。因为材料处于超塑性状态，其可成型性将大大改善，并可大大降低成型应力。
explanation_en: Some materials exhibit extremely high plasticity under certain structural states (such as ultra-fine grains), certain temperatures and deformation rates, which is called superplasticity. The room temperature elongation of general industrial materials ranges from a few percent to dozens of percent, but the elongation of superplasticity materials can be as high as hundreds or even thousands of percent. There are three conditions to produce superplasticity: first, the grain size should be fine, second, the temperature should be high (generally greater than half of the melting point), and third, the value should be large. The finer the grain size is, the higher the temperature is, and the strain rate range where superplasticity can occur also increases. The diffusion controlled grain boundary slip mechanism in creep theory can be used to explain the superplasticity phenomenon under low stress. Superplasticity was first found in Al Zn alloy, and later in iron base, iron nickel base alloy, titanium alloy and ceramics, superplasticity was also found and has been applied in industry. Because materials is in superplasticity state, its formability will be greatly improved and molding stress can be greatly reduced.

explanation_cn: 是指在特定的组织结构和变形条件下表现出异常高塑性的金属间化合物。其超塑性的判据为拉伸伸长率大于100%; 应变速率敏感指数m 大于或等于0.30。金属间化合物的晶粒组织小于10μm,应变速率在10 -7~10 -2s-1范围，应变温度高于0.5Tm的条件下，通常都具有超塑性。应变温度高于0.5Tm的条件下，通常都具有超塑性。如Ni3AI合金IC-218,晶粒尺寸为6μm,在950~1100°C和应变速率10-5~10-2S-1条件下具有超塑性，其机理为晶界滑动。然而有些金属间化合物在粗晶粒情况下也具有超塑性，如近年发现等原子比NiAI在晶粒尺寸>200μm条件下，当变形温度为1100°C.应变速率为1.67X10-3s-1最大伸长率达到210%，应变速率敏感指数m为0.34.表现出明显超塑性，其变形机理为动态回复和再结晶。
explanation_en: It refers to the imermetallif compound that shows abnormally high plasticity under specific structural and deformation conditions. The criterion of its superplasticity is that the tensile elongation is greater than 100%; The strain rate sensitivity index m is greater than or equal to 0.30. The grain structure of imermetallif compound is less than 10 μ m. When the strain rate is in the range of 10-7~10-2s-1, and the strain temperature is higher than 0.5Tm, it usually has superplasticity. When the strain temperature is higher than 0.5Tm, it usually has superplasticity. For example, Ni3AI alloy IC-218, the grain size is 6 μ m. It has superplasticity at 950~1100 ° C and strain rate of 10-5~10-2S-1, and its mechanism is grain boundary sliding. However, some imermetallif compound also have superplasticity in the case of coarse grains. For example, it has been found in recent years that the atomic ratio of NiAI is greater than 200 μ When the deformation temperature is 1100 ° C, the strain rate is 1.67X10-3s-1, the maximum elongation reaches 210%, and the strain rate sensitivity index m is 0.34. It shows obvious superplasticity, and its deformation mechanism is dynamic recovery and recrystallization.

explanation_cn: 在特定条件下，具有高伸长率，不产生缩颈及有均匀延伸特性i的铜合金。比较成熟的细晶超塑加工方法，其色泽美观，有一定抗蚀性和较好的力学性能，可用于仪表行业，装饰行业和用来制造复杂的工艺美术制品，对形状复杂的零件，可一次成型，降低了成本，缩短了生产周期。
explanation_en: A copper alloy with high elongation, no necking, and uniform elongation characteristics under specific conditions. A relatively mature fine-grained superplastic processing method with beautiful color, certain corrosion resistance, and good mechanical properties can be used in the instrument industry, decoration industry, and for manufacturing complex arts and crafts products. For parts with complex shapes, they can be formed in one go, reducing costs and shortening production cycles.

explanation_cn: 超塑锌合金是指具有超塑性的锌基合金。其典型代表是Zn-22Al的共析合金，它具有很大的延伸率(>1000%)，很小的流变应力和高的应变速率敏感性指数(m=0.5)，具有良好的组织可处理性，通过强化处理，调节组织形态，可提高室温强度。1945年，前苏联金属学家阿·包切瓦尔,对Zn-Al共析合金进行高温拉伸试验时，得到了异常高的延伸率，首先采用了“超塑性”这一名词。以后，对金属材料的“超塑性”进行了大量的研究工作，开发出一系列超塑合金和获得“超塑性”的生产工艺。锌基超塑性合金的典型代表是Zn-22Al的共析合金。该合金具有很大的延伸率，很小的流变应力和高的应变速率敏感性指数，具有良好的组织可处理性。Zn-22Al共析合金通过强化处理，调节组织形态，可提高室温强度。该合金的超塑变形温度不高，便于生产。但该合金的室温综合性能不理想，如抗蠕变性能和抗蚀性能都较差，使其应用受到限制，为改善和提高合金综合性能，通常向Zn-22Al合金中加入少量Cu.Mg等合金化元素。锌基超塑合金用于工艺美术品(纪念币，浮雕制品)、录音机飞轮，塑料模具，仪器壳罩、手轮，旋钮和橡胶制品模具的生产。
explanation_en: Superplastic zinc alloy refers to a zinc based alloy with superplasticity. Its typical representative is the eutectoid alloy of Zn-22Al, which has a large elongation (>1000%), a small flow stress and a high sensitivity index of strain rate (m=0.5), and has good structure treatability. Through strengthening treatment and adjusting the structure morphology, room temperature strength can be improved. In 1945, the former Soviet metallurgist A. Baucheval obtained an abnormally high elongation rate when he conducted a high-temperature tensile test on Zn Al eutectoid alloy, and first adopted the term "superplasticity". Later, a lot of research work has been carried out on the "superplasticity" of metallic materials, and a series of superplastic alloy have been developed and the production process to obtain "superplasticity" has been achieved. The typical representative of zinc based superplasticity alloy is the eutectoid alloy of Zn-22Al. The alloy has a large elongation, a small flow stress and a high strain rate sensitivity index, and has good microstructure treatability. The room temperature strength of Zn-22Al eutectoid alloy can be improved by strengthening treatment and adjusting the microstructure. The superplastic deformation temperature of the alloy is not high, which is convenient for production. However, the comprehensive performance of the alloy at room temperature is not ideal, such as the poor creep resistance and corrosion resistance, which limits its application. In order to improve and enhance the comprehensive performance of the alloy, a small amount of alloy elements such as Cu. Mg are usually added to the Zn-22Al alloy. Zinc based superplastic alloy is used in the production of arts and crafts (commemorative coins, relief products), recorder flywheel, plastics mold, instrument case cover, handwheel, knob and rubber product mold.

explanation_cn:
超声波检测是一种利用超声波在介质中传播的性质来检测材料缺陷和异常的方法。它的原理是将超声波脉冲从探头射入被检材料，如果材料内部存在缺陷，一部分射入的超声波将在缺陷处被反射。通过接收探头接收到的信号，可以在不损害被检材料的情况下，检测出缺陷的位置和大小，例如裂纹、气孔、分层、夹杂物和未黏合的部分等。

具体的超声波检测方法包括超声脉冲回波法、超声透射法和超声共振法，其中超声脉冲回波法是应用最广泛的方法。此外，超声波检测还可以通过测量超声波在介质中传播时的声速和衰减变化来判断材料中是否存在异常的组织、组织是否发生变化，晶粒大小以及热处理情况等。此外，它还可用于检测各种材料的物理性质，如强度、弹性、硬度、温度、料位和厚度等。

超声波检测的仪器根据超声波传播原理、电信号转换原理和尤线电测量原理进行设计。其中，A型显示脉冲式超声探伤仪是应用最广泛的一种。它具有多种优点，包括能够检测材料表面和内部的缺陷，深度可达数米，设备简单，操作方便，对人体无害，适用于多种材料和组件。然而，它也有一些缺点，如信号不够直观，容易受到人为因素的影响，以及在某些晶体材料上的应用仍然存在困难。
explanation_en: Ultrasonic testing is a method to detect defects and anomalies of materials by using the nature of ultrasonic propagation in the medium. Its principle is to shoot ultrasonic pulse from the probe into the inspected materials. If there are defects in the materials, part of the injected ultrasonic will be reflected at the defects. By receiving the signal received by the probe, the location and size of defects, such as cracks, pores, delaminations, inclusions and unbonded parts, can be detected without damaging the materials to be inspected. Concrete ultrasonic testing methods include ultrasonic pulse echo method, ultrasonic transmission method and ultrasonic resonance method, of which ultrasonic pulse echo method is the most widely used method. In addition, ultrasonic testing can also judge whether there is abnormal structure in materials, whether there is any change in the structure, grain size and heat treatment conditions by measuring the sound speed and attenuation change of the ultrasonic when it travels in the medium. In addition, it can also be used to detect the physical properties of various materials, such as strength, elasticity, hardness, temperature, material level and thickness. The instrument of ultrasonic testing is designed according to the principle of ultrasonic propagation, the principle of electric signal conversion and the principle of electric measurement. Among them, the A-type display pulse ultrasonic flaw detector is the most widely used type. It has many advantages, including being able to detect defects on the surface and inside of surface of materials, with a depth of several meters, simple equipment, convenient operation, harmless to human body, and suitable for a variety of materials and components. However, it also has some shortcomings, such as the signal is not intuitive enough, is vulnerable to human factors, and the application in some crystalline materials is still difficult.

explanation_cn:
利用超声波的高频振荡能量，在压力的作用下，使焊接件的接触面产生强烈的摩擦作用，以清除表面氧化膜并通过局部加热来实现焊接。这个方法通常用于将两个焊接件组装成搭接接头，夹持它们在上下的声极之间，通过声极施加静压力和超声振动。在塑料焊接中，超声振动与静压力的方向一致；而在金属焊接中，超声振动的方向与静压力垂直。

这种压焊方法的振动方式可以是纵向振动、弯曲振动、扭转振动等。如果焊点是孤立的，称为超声波点焊，而如果形成了一个连续的焊缝，称为超声波缝焊。

与其他焊接方法相比，超声波焊接的一个优点是焊接部位没有电流通过，也没有外部加热源，因此对被焊材料的性能影响较小。超声波焊接的接头强度通常高于电阻焊，而且适用范围广泛，特别适合于高导电性、高导热性的金属、异种金属、金属与非金属、以及塑料等材料的焊接。
explanation_en: Using the high-frequency oscillation energy of ultrasonic wave, under the action of pressure, the contact surface of weld parts will produce strong friction to remove the surface oxide film and realize weld by local heating. This method is usually used to assemble two weld parts into a lap joint, clamp them between the upper and lower sound poles, and apply static pressure and ultrasonic vibration through the sound poles. In plastics welding, ultrasonic vibration and static pressure are in the same direction; In metal weld, the direction of ultrasonic vibration is perpendicular to the static pressure. The vibration modes of this pressure welding method can be longitudinal vibration, bending vibration, torsional vibration, etc. If the welding spot is isolated, it is called ultrasonic sport welding, and if a continuous weld is formed, it is called ultrasonic seam welding. Compared with other weld methods, ultrasonic weld has the advantage that there is no current passing through the weld part and no external heating source, so it has little impact on the performance of the materials to be welded. The joint strength of ultrasonic weld is usually higher than that of resistance welding, and it has a wide range of applications, especially suitable for weld of materials such as metals, dissimilar metals, metals and nonmetals, and plastics with high conductivity and high thermal conductivity.

explanation_cn: 利用超导线圈作为储能线圈，由电网经变流器供电励磁在线圈中产生磁场而储存能量。需要时经逆变器将线圈储存的能量送回电网或提供其他负载使用。由干超导体在通过直流电流时电阻吋认为是零，因此在超导储能线圈中储存的能量可长期储存而几乎是无损耗的，与其他储能系统相比，超导储能系统具有很高的转换效率（可达95%）和很快的反应速度（可达毫秒级），可有效地提高电力系统稳定性，改善供电品质。
explanation_en: Using superconducting coils as energy storage coils, a magnetic field is generated in the coil through power supply and excitation from the power grid through a converter to store energy. When needed, the energy stored in the coil is sent back to the power grid or provided for other loads through an inverter. Since the resistance of the dry superconductor is considered zero when passing the DC current, the energy stored in the superconducting energy storage coil can be stored for a long time with almost no loss. Compared with other energy storage systems, the superconducting magnetic energy storage system has high conversion efficiency (up to 95%) and fast reaction speed (up to milliseconds), which can effectively improve the stability of the power system and improve the quality of power supply.

explanation_cn: 超导材料就是没有电阻、或电阻极小的导电材料。超导材料最独特的性质是电能在输送过程几乎不会损失。超导体都是脆性材料，不能直接制成线材。因此一般都把Cu或Ag作为基体制成细丝的超导体复合，以增强超导休线材和片材的力学性能与稳定性。
explanation_en: Superconducting materials are conductive material with no or very small resistance. The most unique property of superconducting materials is that electric energy is almost not lost during transmission. Superconductors are brittle materials and cannot be directly made into wire rod. Therefore, Cu or Ag is generally used as the matrix to make thin wire superconductor composition to enhance the mechanical properties and stability of superconducting wire rod and sheet.

explanation_cn: 在实用超导材料中，起主要承载传输电流作用的超导材料。例如：在内锡法Nb3Sn超导线材中，Sn与Nb反应生成的超导体，即孔洞与Nb之间的反应层，称为超导层。
explanation_en: In practical superconducting materials, superconducting materials play a major role in carrying transmission current. For example, in the inner tin method Nb3Sn superconducting wire rod, the superconductor generated by the reaction of Sn and Nb, that is, the reaction layer between the hole and Nb, is called the superconducting layer.

explanation_cn: 某些金属、合金和化合物在某一特定的温度，其电阻将突然消失。且磁力线被完全排斥到该物体之外（即完全抗磁性）。这种现象叫超导电现象这种以零电阻和完全抗磁性为特征的状态，称为超导态。在超导态时。直流电阻为零，但对交流电仍有很小的能量损耗。
explanation_en: The resistance of some metals, alloy and compounds will suddenly disappear at a certain temperature. And the magnetic line of force is completely excluded from the object (that is, completely diamagnetism). This phenomenon is called superconductivity, a state characterized by zero resistance and complete diamagnetism, and is called superconducting state. In the superconducting state. The DC resistance is zero, but there is still a small energy loss on AC power.

explanation_cn: 某些金属、半导体、多元金属氧化物、合金在低温出现的电阻率为零的特性、具有超导性的物体称为超导体。超导体的两个基本特性是零电阻特性（zeroresistivity)和迈斯纳效应（Meissereffect）。零电阻特性是指超导体的电阻率在温度低一于某一温度（称为临界温度.）时迅速降至零，在该温度以下.超导体不存在观测的直流电阻。迈斯纳效应是指当一个磁体和一个处于超导态的超导体相靠近时，磁体的磁场会使超异体表面中出现超导电流。此超导电流形成的磁场，在超导体内部，恰好和磁体的磁场大小相等。方向相反，使超导体内部的磁感应强度为零。不管是先给超导体外加磁场，降温使之变为超导态，还是先降温变为超导态，再外加磁场，处于超导态的超导体中的磁场强度始终为零。
explanation_en: Some metals, semiconductors, multi-component metal oxides, alloy have the characteristic of zero resistivity at low temperatures, and objects with superconductivity are called superconductors. The two basic characteristics of superconductors are zero resistance and Meissner effect. The zero resistance characteristic means that the resistivity of the superconductor rapidly drops to zero when the temperature is one lower than a certain temperature (called the critical temperature). Below this temperature, the superconductor does not have the observed DC resistance. The Meissner effect refers to that when a magnet is close to a superconductor in a superconducting state state, the magnetic field of the magnet will cause superconducting current to appear on the surface of the superconductor. The magnetic field formed by this superconducting current is exactly the same size as the magnetic field of the magnet inside the superconductor. In the opposite direction, the magnetic induction intensity inside the superconductor is zero. Whether the superconductor is first applied with a magnetic field, and then cooled to become a superconducting state state, or first cooled to become a superconducting state state, and then applied with a magnetic field, the strength of the magnetic field in the superconductor in the superconducting state state is always zero.

explanation_cn:
超导材料是指在适当的低温条件下，其电阻等于零并且具有排斥磁力线的特性的材料。其主要特性包括：

零电阻：当超导材料处于超导态时，其电阻为零，能够无损耗地传输电能。如果在超导环中引入外部磁场，会感生出一个电流，而这个电流可以毫不减弱地持续下去。这种持续电流已在实验中多次观察到。

抗磁性：当超导材料处于超导态时，只要外部磁场不超过一定值，磁力线不能渗透到材料内部，超导材料内的磁场将保持为零。

同位素效应：超导体的临界温度（Tc）与其同位素的质量有关。质量越大，Tc越低，这被称为同位素效应。
explanation_en: Superconducting materials refers to the materials whose resistance is equal to zero and has the characteristics of repelling magnetic lines of force under appropriate low temperature conditions. Its main characteristics include: zero resistance: when the superconducting materials is in the superconducting state, its resistance is zero, and it can transmit electric energy without loss. If an external magnetic field is introduced into the superconducting ring, a current will be induced, and this current can continue unabated. This continuous current has been observed multiple times in experiments. Diamagnetism: when the superconducting materials is in the superconducting state state, as long as the external magnetic field does not exceed a certain value, the magnetic line of force cannot penetrate into the inside of the materials, and the magnetic field in the superconducting materials will remain zero. Isotope effect: the critical temperature (Tc) of superconductors is related to the quality of their isotopes. The higher the mass, the lower the Tc, which is called the isotope effect.

explanation_cn: 滤波器允许某一部分频率的信号顺利通过，而另外一部分频率的信号则受到较大的抑制，因此，它实质上是一个选频电路超导滤波器是以高温超导滤波放大器为核心元件的滤波器。目前主要采用高温超导薄膜材料制作而成。
explanation_en: The filter allows signals of some frequencies to pass smoothly, while signals of other frequencies are greatly suppressed. Therefore, it is essentially a frequency selection circuit superconciucting wave-filter, which is a filter with high-temperature superconducting filter amplifier as its core element. At present, it is mainly made of high-temperature superconducting film materials.

explanation_cn: 利用超导体导线绕制成的磁体。施加励磁电流使磁体达到所需磁场强度时，合上超导开关使磁体线圈形成一无阻闭合回路，这时切断励磁电流，依靠流过线圈的超导电流维持磁场。超导磁体的磁场强度目前可达200,000高斯以上。
explanation_en: A magnet made by winding superconductor wires. When the excitation current is applied to achieve the required magnetic field strength of the magnet, the superconducting switch is closed to form an open loop in the magnet coil. At this time, the excitation current is cut off and the magnetic field is maintained by relying on the superconducting current flowing through the coil. At present, the magnetic field strength of superconducting magnet can reach more than 200000 gauss.

explanation_cn: 是利用超导体的抗磁性吋以实现的磁悬浮。当超导体接近永磁体时，因为磁力线不能进人超导体内，所以在超导体表面形成很大的磁通密度梯度，感应出高临界电流，从而对永磁体产生排斥。排斥力随相对距离的减小而逐渐增大，它可以克服超导体的重力，使其悬浮在永磁体上方的一定高度上。磁悬浮列车就是一种靠磁悬浮力（即磁的吸力和排斥力）来推动的列车。
explanation_en: The magnetic suspension is realized by using the diamagnetism of superconductors. When the superconductor is close to the permanent magnet, because the magnetic line of force cannot enter the superconductor, a large gradient of magnetic flux density is formed on the surface of the superconductor, which induces a high critical current and repels the permanent magnet. The repulsive force gradually increases with the decrease of relative distance, which can overcome the gravity of superconductors and suspend them at a certain height above the permanent magnet. A maglev train is a type of train that is propelled by magnetic levitation forces (i.e. magnetic attraction and repulsion).

explanation_cn: 上世纪80年代初期，在ErRh4单晶体中，在1K附近很窄区域观测到铁磁结构和调制磁结构及电附现象消失现象。磁畴和超导区的限度不小于240纳米，证明了磁有序和超导性的同时共存。
explanation_en: In the early 1980s, in ErRh4 single crystal, the disappearance of ferromagnetic and modulated magnetic structures, as well as electrical attachment phenomena, was observed in a very narrow region near 1K. The limit of magnetic domain and superconducting region is not less than 240 nm, which proves that magnetic order and superconductivity coexist at the same time.

explanation_cn: 超导体最低激发态与基态之间存在一定的能量间隙。按BCS理论，拆散一库珀电子对或激发两个电子到正常态最小能量的一半称为能隙。能隙的存在是超导微观理论的基础之一。BCS理论从量子力学基本原理出发推导出能隙的存在，并预言了它与温度以及d(0)和临界温度的关系为绝对零度下的能隙。能隙的发现为BCS理论的建立奠定了基础。但是，能隙并不是超导性存在的必要条件，某些杂质可以降低超导体的临界温度，但它使能隙减小得更快。高于某一杂质浓度时，能隙已降低为零，但却仍是有限值。这就出现了无能隙超导体磁场也吋以造成无能隙的超导体。
explanation_en: There is a certain energy gap between the lowest excited state and the ground state of superconductors. According to BCS theory, splitting a Cooper electron pair or exciting two electrons to half of the minimum energy of normal state is called energy gap. The existence of energy gap is one of the bases of superconductivity microscopic theory. The BCS theory derives the existence of energy gap from the basic principles of quantum mechanics, and predicts that its relationship with temperature, d (0) and critical temperature is energy gap at absolute zero. The discovery of energy gap laid the foundation for the establishment of BCS theory. However, the energy gap is not a necessary condition for the existence of superconductivity. Some impurities can reduce the critical temperature of superconductors, but it makes the energy gap decrease faster. Above a certain impurity concentration, the energy gap has been reduced to zero, but it is still a limited value. This leads to the emergence of superconductors with magnetic fields that can cause gaps.

explanation_cn: 又称超导临界温度。对于第一类超导体.某些元素和化合物在特定的温度下电阻突然消失，我们把这个电阻突然消失的温度定义为超导转变温度。对于第二类超导体，由正常态到超导态的过渡.也就是电阻下降到零的过程.是在一个有限的温度间隔内完成的.这个温度间隔我们称为转变宽带，其的大小取决于材料的纯度、晶体的完整性和样品内部的应力状态等。对于第二类超导体，超导转变温度又分为起始超导转变温度、中间超导转变温度和零电阻温度。起始超导转变温度是指超导体从正常态开始进人混合态时的起始温度。根据BCS理论，超导转变温度也可称为Cooper电子对拆开解体时的温度。
explanation_en: It is also called superconductor critical temperature. For the type I superconductor, the resistance of some elements and compounds suddenly disappears at a specific temperature. We define the temperature at which the resistance suddenly disappears as the superconducting transition temperature. For type II superconductor, the transition from normal state to superconducting state, that is, the process of resistance dropping to zero, is completed within a limited temperature interval, which we call transformation broadband, and its size depends on the purity of materials, the integrity of crystal, and the stress state inside the sample. For type II superconductor, the superconducting transition temperature can be divided into initial superconducting transition temperature, intermediate superconducting transition temperature and zero resistance temperature. The initial superconducting transition temperature refers to the initial temperature when the superconductor enters the mixed state from the normal state. According to the BCS theory, the superconducting transition temperature can also be referred to as the temperature at which Cooper electron pairs are disassembled.

explanation_cn: 见超细粉。
explanation_en: See ultrafine powder.

explanation_cn: 是用电场改变原为180°以上扭曲的液晶分子的排列从而改变旋光状态。外加电场通过逐行扫描的方式改变电场，在电场反复改变电压的过程中，每一点的恢复过程较慢，因而产生余辉。它的优点是功耗小，具有省电的最大优势。
explanation_en: It is the use of an electric field to change the arrangement of liquid crystal molecules that were originally twisted above 180 °, thereby changing the optical rotation state. The applied electric field changes the electric field by scanning line by line. In the process of changing the voltage repeatedly by the electric field, the recovery process at each point is slow, thus producing afterglow. Its advantage is low power consumption, which has the greatest advantage of saving electricity.

explanation_cn: 是一种具有高度支化拓扑结构和共轭主链的有机半导体材料。它们具有大量的支化节点和活性端基，倾向于形成表面上修饰有众多外围功能团的球状结构。相比于具有完美单分散结构的树枝状化合物，超支化聚合物的分子量和支化结构都存在一定的分布。但是，它们免除了复杂的合成和提纯，往往通过一步反应简易合成，因此可以实现工业上的大规模生产和应用。典型的超支化共轭聚合物包括超支化聚芳基、超支化聚芳乙烯、超支化聚芳乙炔、超支化聚二炔、超支化聚三唑等。A2+Bn(n≥3) 型单体组合或ABn(n≥3) 型单体通过现代有机反应，例如金属催化的偶联反应、环三聚反应、Diels-Alder 反应、点击聚合反应等可一步高效合成高分子量的超支化共轭聚合物产物。超支化共轭聚合物结合了超支化结构的固有特点和共轭聚合物的光电性质: 它们的三维刚性支化结构可以有效地抑制聚合物链的聚集和荧光的猝灭，而它们的共轭结构使得电子可以在三维空间内的共轭基团中离域。因此，它们表现出良好的溶解性、可加工性、热稳定性、形貌的稳定性、优异的光电性质和非线性光学性质等。此外，通过调控超支化共轭聚合物的活性端基结构，可对聚合物进行后修饰，从而实现对材料性质进行调节。超支化共轭聚合物可应用于荧光传感器、聚合物电致发光二极管、聚合物太阳能电池等领域。
explanation_en: It is a organic semiconductor materials with highly branched topological structure and conjugated main chain. They have a large number of branched nodes and active end groups, tending to form spherical structures with numerous peripheral functional groups on the surface. Compared with the dendritic compounds with perfect monodisperse structure, the molecular weight and branched structure of hyperbranched polymer have a certain distribution. However, they avoid complex synthesis and purification and are often easily synthesized through a one-step reaction, thus enabling large-scale industrial production and application. Typical hyperbranched conjugated polymer include hyperbranched polyaryl, hyperbranched polyarylethylene, hyperbranched polyarylacetylene, hyperbranched polydiyne, hyperbranched polytriazole, etc. The combination of A2+Bn (n ≥ 3) type monomer or ABn (n ≥ 3) type monomer can efficiently synthesize macromolecule weight hyperbranched conjugated polymer products in one step through modern organic reactions, such as metal catalyzed coupling reaction, cyclotrimerization reaction, Diels Alder reaction, click polymerization reaction, etc. Hyperbranched conjugated polymer combine the inherent characteristics of hyperbranched structures and the photoelectric properties of conjugated polymer: their three-dimensional rigid branched structures can effectively inhibit the aggregation of polymer chains and the quenching of fluorescence, and their conjugated structures enable electrons to be delocalized in the conjugated groups in three-dimensional space. Therefore, they exhibit good solubility, processability, thermal stability, morphology stability, excellent photoelectric properties and nonlinear optical properties. In addition, by regulating the active end group structure of hyperbranched conjugated polymer, polymer can be post modified, thus realizing the adjustment of materials properties. Hyperbranched conjugated polymer can be used in fluorescence sensors, polymer electroluminescence diodes, polymer solar cell and other fields.

explanation_cn: 超支化聚合物是一类高度支化的三维大分子，超支化聚合物支化点多，分子链不易缠结，黏度不随着分子量的增加而改变，且具有丰富的末端官能团，易对其进行修饰改性，有利于合成多样的功能性材料。
explanation_en: Hyperbranched polymer is a kind of highly branched three-dimensional macromolecule. hyperbranched polymer has many branching points, and the molecular chain is not easy to entangle. viscosity does not change with the increase of molecular weight, and it has rich end functional groups, which is easy to modify it, which is conducive to the synthesis of diverse functional materials.

explanation_cn: 物理上趋指两种不同组元以几个纳米到几十个纳米的薄层交叉并保持严格周期性的多层膜。20世纪初，通过X射线衍射发现了超晶格的现象。1970年美国IBM实验室提出了超晶格的概念。超晶格分为组分超晶格、掺杂超晶格、多维超晶格和应变超晶格等。纳米材料研究中，因为纳米颗粒的单分散性以及其表面活性剂稳定层提供的范德华力、静电引力等引起的向组装，导致纳米颗粒类似于晶体中晶胞原子的排列方式排列，形成单层、多层的有序结构，也被称为超晶格结构。在此情况下生长出的微米级或宏观量级的超晶格颗粒也叫超晶体。
explanation_en: Physically, it refers to a multilayer film where two different components intersect in thin layers ranging from a few nanometers to tens of nanometers and maintain strict periodicity. At the beginning of the 20th century, the phenomenon of superlattice was discovered by X-ray diffraction. In 1970, the IBM laboratory in the United States proposed the concept of superlattices. Superlattice can be divided into component superlattice, doping superlattice, multi-dimensional superlattice and strained superlattice. In the research of nanomaterials, because of the monodispersity of nanoparticle and the directional assembly caused by van der Waals force and electrostatic attraction provided by its surfactant stabilized layer, nanoparticle are arranged in a way similar to the arrangement of atoms in the cell of crystal, forming a single-layer, multi-layer ordered structure, also known as superlattice structure. In this case, the micron or macro superlattice particles grown are also called super crystal.

explanation_cn:
超晶格材料是一种人工周期性材料，它在原自然晶体的晶格结构上叠加了一个人工周期。这个周期结构的势阱区厚度通常小于电子的平均自由程，同时势垒区足够窄，以致相邻势阱中的电子波函数能够互相耦合。这种材料被称为超晶格材料。

超晶格材料可以分为两类：

组分超晶格：这类超晶格是由不同的半导体薄膜材料形成的周期性结构。通常使用"ABABAB..."来表示。其中，字母A代表一种半导体，如GaAs，而字母B代表另一种半导体，如AlGaAs。

掺杂超晶格：这种超晶格由同一种半导体材料组成，但掺杂类型不同的薄膜交替重复构成。例如，可以由n型Si（负载子掺杂）和p型Si（正载子掺杂）以及本征i层Si组成，形成"nipinipi..."的结构。

超晶格材料的制备方法包括分子束外延、有机金属化合物气相外延等。这些方法用于在薄膜材料上生长出所需的周期性结构，以实现超晶格的特定性质和应用。
explanation_en: Superlattice materials is an artificial periodic materials, which superimposes an artificial period on the lattice structure of the original natural crystal. The thickness of the potential well region in this periodic structure is usually smaller than the average free path of electrons, and the barrier region is narrow enough to couple the electron wave functions in adjacent potential wells. This materials is called superlattice materials. Superlattice materials can be divided into two categories: component superlattice: this kind of superlattice is a periodic structure formed by different semiconductor film materials. Usually represented by 'ABABAB...'. Among them, the letter A represents one type of semiconductor, such as GaAs, while the letter B represents another type of semiconductor, such as AlGaAs. Doping superlattice: This superlattice is composed of the same semiconductor materials, but the films with different doping types are alternately and repeatedly formed. For example, it can be composed of n-type Si (carrier doped), p-type Si (positive carrier doped), and intrinsic i-layer Si, forming a structure of "nipinipi...". The preparation methods of superlattice materials include molecular beam epitaxy, organic metal compound vapor phase epitaxy, etc. These methods are used to grow the required periodic structures on thin film materials to achieve the specific properties and applications of superlattice.

explanation_cn:
超材料是一类具有特殊性质的人造材料，特指那些具有负折射率的材料。这些材料是由具有新颖人工结构的复合材料组成，具有非同寻常的物理特性，这些特性通常在自然界的材料中是不存在的。超材料的性质主要取决于其特殊的人工结构，特别是精密的几何结构和尺寸大小。这些大面积、一致性的精确几何结构、尺寸、取向和组装方式可以让光和电磁波以一种天然材料无法实现的方式进行弯曲、散射或传输。目前已经研发出的超材料包括光子晶体、左手材料、负折射率材料和等离子体等。

超材料研究涉及多个领域，包括电子工程、电磁学、固体物理、微波和天线工程、光电子学、传统光学、材料科学、半导体工程以及纳米科学，是一门高度交叉的新兴学科。例如，光子晶体类超材料已经应用于光子晶体光纤、低阈值激光振荡器、高效率发光二极管、微波天线等领域。

理论学家预测超材料有潜力用于制造各种隐身装置，可以使物体周围的光和电磁波绕道而行，从而使物体变得难以察觉。
explanation_en: Metamaterials are a kind of artificial materials with special properties, especially those materials with negative refractive index. These materials are composed of composite materials with novel artificial structures, which have extraordinary physical properties, which are usually absent in materials in nature. The properties of metamaterials mainly depend on their special artificial structures, especially their precise geometric structures and size. These large-area, consistent and precise geometry, size, orientation and assembly methods can enable light and electromagnetic waves to bend, scatter or transmit in a way that natural materials cannot achieve. At present, metamaterials that have been developed include photonic crystal, left-handed materials, negative refractive index materials and plasmas. The research of metamaterials involves many fields, including electronic engineering, electromagnetics, solid state physics, microwave and antenna engineering, optoelectronics, traditional optics, materials science, semiconductor engineering, and nanoscience. It is a highly interdisciplinary emerging discipline. For example, photonic crystal like metamaterials have been used in photonic crystal fiber, low threshold laser oscillators, high-efficiency luminescence diodes, microwave antennas and other fields. Theorists predict that metamaterials have the potential to be used to manufacture various stealth devices, which can make light and electromagnetic waves around objects bypass, thus making objects difficult to detect.

explanation_cn: 在常规超导体内，电子运动不受阻碍。根据二流体模型的假设，导体处于超导态时，电子被分为两部分：一部分是正常电子，占总数的比例 1?ω，另一部分是超流电子，占总数的比例 ω。这两种电子占据相同的体积，彼此在空间中相互渗透，并以相对独立的方式运动。其中，ω和 1?ω 是与温度相关的参数。超流电子处于一种凝聚状态，即它们凝聚成某个低能态。根据这个模型，当温度低于超导临界温度 T c 时，电阻将立即消失。因为在低于 T c时出现了超流电子，它们的运动是无阻碍的。如果导体中存在电流，这个电流完全是由超流电子的运动所引起的。一旦出现了超流电子，导体内就不再存在电场，正常电子不参与电流传输，因此电阻效应消失。这个二流体模型有助于解释常规超导体的超导性质，其中电子对通过电阻产生的能量损失几乎没有贡献，因此电阻消失。这是超导材料的关键特性之一。
explanation_en: In a conventional superconducting body, the movement of electrons is not hindered. According to the assumption of the two-fluid model, when the conductor is in the superconducting state, the electrons are divided into two parts: one is normal electrons, accounting for 1 ? ω， The other part is superfluid electron, which accounts for the proportion of the total ω。 These two electrons occupy the same volume, penetrate each other in space, and move in a relatively independent manner. Among them, ω And 1 ? ω It is a temperature related parameter. Superfluid electron are in a condensed state, that is, they condense into a low-energy state. According to this model, when the temperature is lower than the superconductor critical temperature Tc, the resistance will disappear immediately. Because superfluid electron appear below Tc, their motion is unimpeded. If there is a current in the conductor, this current is completely caused by the movement of superfluid electron. Once superfluid electron appear, there is no electric field in the conductor, and normal electrons do not participate in current transmission, so the resistance effect disappears. This two fluid model helps to explain the superconductivity of conventional superconductors, in which electrons make almost no contribution to the energy loss generated by the resistance, so the resistance disappears. This is one of the key characteristics of superconducting materials.

explanation_cn:
超滤膜，又称分子筛膜，是一种微孔过滤膜，其额定孔径范围通常在1到20纳米之间。在适当的压力下（通常在345到689千帕），超滤膜允许水和体积小于膜表面微孔径的小分子物质通过，同时截留体积大于膜表面微孔径的物质。超滤膜能够截留分子量大于500的大粒径溶质分子和直径大于10纳米的颗粒。

超滤膜的分离过程是在一定的压力下，以膜两侧的压力差作为驱动力，通过超滤膜作为过滤介质来实现的。当原液流经膜表面时，水和小分子物质透过膜，成为透过液，而原液中体积大于膜表面微孔径的物质则被截留在膜的进液侧，形成浓缩液。这样可以实现对原液的净化、分离和浓缩。

超滤膜能够截留水中的微粒、胶体、细菌、大分子有机物和部分病毒，但无法截留无机离子和小分子物质。超滤膜的膜材料主要包括纤维素及其衍生物、聚碳酸酯、聚氯乙烯、聚偏氯乙烯、聚砜、聚丙烯腈、聚酰胺、聚砜酰胺、磺化聚砜、交联的聚乙烯醇、改性丙烯酸聚合物等。

超滤膜可以制成平面膜、卷式膜、管式膜或中空纤维膜等不同形式，广泛应用于医药工业、食品工业、环境工程等领域。
explanation_en: Ultrafiltration membrane, also known as molecular sieve membrane, is a kind of microporous filtration membrane, and its rated pore size range is usually between 1 and 20 nanometers. Under appropriate pressure (usually 345 to 689 kPa), ultrafiltration membrane allows water and small molecular substances with a volume smaller than the micropore of membrane surface to pass through, while retaining substances with a volume larger than the micropore of membrane surface. Ultrafiltration membrane can intercept large solute molecules with molecular weight greater than 500 and particles with diameter greater than 10 nm. The separation process of ultrafiltration membrane is realized by taking the pressure difference between the two sides of the membrane as the driving force and using ultrafiltration membrane as the filtering medium under a certain pressure. When the original solution flows through the membrane surface, water and small molecule substances pass through the membrane, becoming the permeate. However, substances in the original solution with a volume larger than the micropores on the membrane surface are intercepted on the inlet side of the membrane, forming a concentrated solution. This can achieve purification, separation, and concentration of the original solution. Ultrafiltration membrane can intercept particles, colloids, bacteria, macromolecule organics and some viruses in water, but cannot intercept inorganic ions and small molecular substances. The membrane materials of ultrafiltration membrane mainly include cellulose and its derivatives, polycarbonate, polyvinyl chloride, polyvinylidene chloride, polysulfone, polyacrylonitrile, polyamide, polysulfonamide, sulfonated polysulfone, crosslinking polyvinyl alcohol, modified acrylic polymer, etc. Ultrafiltration membrane can be made into flat facial mask, roll membrane, tubular membrane or hollow fiber membrane and other forms, which are widely used in the pharmaceutical industry, food industry, environmental engineering and other fields.

explanation_cn: 显微硬度超过10~30GPa范围，适合于加工硬质材料。主要有金刚石和立方氮化硼或以两种晶体材料为主成分的复合体。超硬晶体材料不仅用于硬质合金、陶瓷的磨削和切削以及砂轮的修正，而且可用于切割和加工石材、玻璃、混凝土和各种晶体及地质钻探、石油和气井的幵发、拉丝以及铜、铝金属、不锈钢的精密车削等。
explanation_en: The micro hardness exceeds the range of 10~30GPa, which is suitable for processing hard materials. There are mainly diamond and cubic boron nitride or a composite composed mainly of two crystalline materials. Super-hard cryslal materials is not only used for grinding and cutting of hardmetal and ceramics and correction of grinding wheel, but also for cutting and processing of stone, glass, concrete and various crystal and geological drilling, development and wire drawing of oil and gas wells, and precision turning of copper, aluminum metal, stainless steel, etc.

explanation_cn:
超离心沉降是一种用于测量聚合物的绝对分子量的方法，它利用沉降平衡中的浓度梯度和分子量依赖性原理。对于均相高分子溶液，不同分子量的高分子在超离心沉降过程中会受到离心力的作用，向容器底部移动，从而产生浓度梯度。与此同时，扩散作用会使高分子分子从高浓度区域扩散到低浓度区域，与离心作用的方向相反。经过足够长的时间，这两种作用将达到亚稳态或平衡状态，形成一定的宏观浓度梯度。

在超离心过程中，沉降速度与浓度之间的关系可以通过浓度梯度的分布函数来推导。其中，ρ是物体在溶剂中的偏摩尔体积，c是浓度。通过光学测定随浓度变化的折射率，可以获得聚合物的分子量。

然而，需要指出的是，对于多分散聚合物样品，较小分子的沉降平衡所需时间较长，通常需要1到2周的时间，因此这种方法在处理多分散聚合物时可能会非常耗时。
explanation_en: Supercentrifugal sedimentation is a method used to measure the absolute molecular weight of polymer, which uses the concentration gradient and molecular weight dependence principle in sedimentation equilibrium. For homogeneous macromolecule solution, macromolecule with different molecular weights will be subject to centrifugal force during ultracentrifugal sedimentation and move to the bottom of the container, resulting in concentration gradient. At the same time, diffusion will make macromolecule molecules diffusion from the high concentration area to the low concentration area, which is opposite to the direction of centrifugation. After a sufficient period of time, these two effects will reach a metastable or equilibrium state, forming a certain macroscopic concentration gradient. In the process of ultracentrifugation, the relationship between sedimentation velocity and concentration can be derived through the distribution function of concentration gradient. Among them, ρ Is the partial molar volume of an object in a solvent, and c is the concentration. The molecular weight of polymer can be obtained by optical measurement of refractive index varying with concentration. However, it should be noted that for polydisperse polymer samples, the settling equilibrium of smaller molecules takes a long time, usually 1 to 2 weeks, so this method may be very time-consuming when dealing with polydisperse polymer.

explanation_cn:
超速离心法是一种用于测量聚合物的绝对分子量的方法，它利用了物体在溶液中的沉降速度与分子量依赖性的原理。在这个方法中，物体被浸泡在密度为ρ的液体中，受到浮力g（其中V为物体体积）和摩擦力F（F为摩擦系数）的作用。物体沉降的速度逐渐增加，摩擦力也逐渐增大，最终达到沉降平衡，物体以匀速沉降。

如果物体是球形微粒，通过测定沉降速度v和物体在溶剂中的偏摩尔体积v0，可以得到球形高分子的平均分子量。然而，由于高分子的质量较小，需要使用超速离心，即在非常大的离心力场下才能观察到它们的沉降。离心力场的加速度通常由角速度ω和样品至离心中心的距离r表示，即a = ω2r。

大多数高分子在溶液中的构象是无规则的，而不是球形的，因此需要考虑扩散系数D，其中D是沉降速度稳定时的扩散系数。沉降作用与扩散作用（或摩擦力）方向相反，大小相等，因此在沉降平衡时满足Svedberg方程。

其中M是分子量，N是阿伏伽德罗常数，A是沉降系数，ρ是溶剂的密度，ρ_s是溶质的密度。

考虑到ρ、A和D均随浓度而变化，严格来说，需要将Svedberg方程外推至浓度为零才能得到准确的分子量。这种方法适用于分子量范围在10^4到2x10^6之间，可以获得各种不同类型的平均分子量。
explanation_en: The ultracentrifugation method is a method used to measure the absolute molecular weight of polymer, which makes use of the principle that the sedimentation rate of the object in the solution is dependent on the molecular weight. In this method, the object is immersed at a density of ρ In the liquid, it is subjected to buoyancy g (where V is the volume of the object) and friction F (where F is the coefficient of friction). The speed of object settlement gradually increases, and the friction force also gradually increases, ultimately reaching settlement equilibrium, and the object settles at a uniform speed. If the object is a spherical particle, the average molecular weight of the spherical macromolecule can be obtained by measuring the sedimentation velocity v and the partial molar volume v0 of the object in the solvent. However, because of the small mass of macromolecule, it is necessary to use ultracentrifugation, that is, to observe their sedimentation under a very large centrifugal force field. The acceleration of a centrifugal force field is usually determined by angular velocity ω The distance r from the sample to the center of centrifugation is denoted as a= ω2 R. The conformation of most macromolecule in solution is irregular rather than spherical, so diffusion coefficient D needs to be considered, where D is the diffusion coefficient when the settling speed is stable. The settlement action is opposite to the diffusion action (or friction force) in direction and equal in magnitude, so the Svedberg equation is satisfied when the settlement is balanced. Where M is the molecular weight, N is the Avogadro constant, and A is the settling coefficient, ρ Is the density of the solvent, ρ_ S is the density of the solute. Considering that ρ、 Both A and D vary with concentration, strictly speaking, the Svedberg equation needs to be extrapolated to zero concentration to obtain accurate molecular weight. This method is applicable to the molecular weight range from 10 ^ 4 to 2x10 ^ 6, and can obtain various types of average molecular weight.

explanation_cn:
在一个原子（分子或离子）的原子核带有非零磁矩时，原子核的磁矩会与这个原子的核外电子磁矩产生相互作用，这种相互作用被称为超精细相互作用。超精细相互作用的结果使得原子的能级结构变得更为精细复杂，这现象被称为超精细结构。

早在1881年，美国科学家阿尔伯特·迈克耳逊（Albert A. Michelson）在光谱测量中首次观察到了原子能级的超精细结构现象。瑞士科学家沃尔夫冈·泡利（Wolfgang Pauli）于1924年提出了有关原子核具有微小磁矩的假设，并基于这一观点，为超精细结构的形成提供了合理的量子力学理论解释。
explanation_en: When the nucleus of an atom (molecule or ion) has a non-zero magnetic moment, the magnetic moment of the nucleus will interact with the magnetic moment of the extranuclear electron of the atom, which is called hyperfine interaction. The result of hyperfine interaction makes the energy level structure of atoms more sophisticated, which is called hyperfine structure. As early as 1881, American scientist Albert A. Michelson first observed the hyperfine structure of atomic energy levels in spectroscopic measurements. Wolfgang Pauli, a Swiss scientist, put forward the hypothesis that atomic nuclei have tiny magnetic moment in 1924, and based on this view, it provided a reasonable theoretical explanation of quantum mechanics for the formation of hyperfine structures.

explanation_cn: 小于0.3微米的碳化钨（或其他碳化物）粉末与钴黏结相组成的硬质合金。随着碳化钨晶粒度的减小，超细晶硬质合金的韧性和硬度均能提高。基于碳化钨晶粒减小，增加了钴黏结相的高分散性，使碳化钨晶粒更均匀地分散在钴黏结相之间，硬度一般提高HRA 1.5-2.0，弯曲强度提高600-800MPa，高温硬度和常温压缩强度也相应增高。例如，YG6超细晶硬质合金的硬度可达HRA 92，弯曲强度达3500MPa，而一般硬质合金为2500MPa。超细碳化钨的制造方法，包括低温还原的碳化法；钨酸铵与硝酸钴多盐沉淀法和溶胶-凝胶法等。它的主要用途为加工高温合金、钛合金、不锈钢等难切削材料；用于低速切削、间断切削刀具，采矿凿岩工具和合成金刚石用的硬质合金顶锤。广泛应用于汽车制造、航空航天、模具制造、电子信息等行业的高效高精度切削加工领域，特别是集成电路板加工的微细钻头。
explanation_en: Hardmetal consisting of carbonization (or other carbide) powder less than 0.3 μ m and cobalt bonding phase. With the decrease of carbonization grain size, the toughness and hardness of ultra-fine grain carbide can be improved. Based on the reduction of carbonization grains, the high dispersion of cobalt bonded phase is increased, so that carbonization grains are more evenly dispersed among cobalt bonded phases. hardness is generally increased by HRA 1.5-2.0, bending strength is increased by 600-800MPa, and high-temperature hardness and normal temperature compressive strength are also increased accordingly. For example, the hardness of YG6 ultra-fine grain carbide can reach HRA 92, and the bending strength can reach 3500 MPa, while the general hardmetal is 2500 MPa. A manufacturing method of superfine carbonization comprises a low temperature reduction carbonization method; Ammonium tungstate and cobalt nitrate multi salt precipitation method and sol gel method, etc. It is mainly used for processing difficult to cut materials such as high temperature alloy, titanium alloy, stainless steel, etc; Hardmetal anvil for low-speed cutting, intermittent cutting tools, mining drilling tools and synthetic diamond. Widely used in industries such as automotive manufacturing, aerospace, mold manufacturing, electronic information, etc. for efficient and high-precision cutting and processing, especially for micro drill bits for integrated circuit board processing.

explanation_cn: 超细粉可分为粉碎法和合成法两大类。粉碎法是将大体积的熔体雾化或颗粒微细化（气流磨粉碎），合成法是通过原子或分子形核和长大过程而形成颗粒，其中蒸发气化一冷凝法是制备高纯度超细粉的主要方法，但其生产率低、成本高。利用粉末成型制造部件时，粉末达到超细的程度往往使部件具有很优良的特性。例如制造耐高温、有高的强度的陶瓷工具(如刀具、涡轮叶片)，需要采用超细粉进行成型后烧结。粉状商品染料的一种剂型。其粒子非常细小均匀。又称悬浮体轧染细粉。指可直接用于悬浮体轧染工艺的还原染料品种。超细粉体通常分为微米级、亚微米级及纳米级粉体。国际科技界通常将粒径大于1μm的超细粉体称为微米级粉体；粒径处于0.1—1μm（即100nm—1000nm）的粉体称为亚微米级粉体；粒径处于0.001—0.1μm（即1nm-100nm）的粉体称为纳米级粉体（又称之为纳米材料）。广义的纳米材料是指三维尺寸中至少有一维处于纳米尺寸。
explanation_en: Ultrafine powder can be divided into two categories: crushing method and synthesis method. The pulverization method is to atomize a large volume of melt or fine particles (jet mill pulverization). The synthesis method is to form particles through the nucleation and growth process of atoms or molecules. The evaporation gasification condensation method is the main method to prepare high-purity ultrafine powder, but its productivity is low and cost is high. When powder is used to form parts, powder reaches the ultra-fine degree, which often makes the parts have excellent characteristics. For example, to manufacture ceramics tools with high temperature resistance and high strength (such as tools and turbine blades), ultrafine powder needs to be used for sintering after molding. A form of powdered commercial dye or dyestuffc. Its particles are very small and uniform. It is also called suspension pad dyeing fine powder. It refers to the variety of vat dye or dyestuffc that can be directly used in the suspension pad dyeing process. Ultrafine powders are usually divided into micron, submicron, and nanoscale powders. The international scientific and technological community usually considers particle sizes greater than 1 μ The ultrafine powder of m is called micron level powder; Particle size between 0.1-1 μ The powder of m (i.e. 100nm to 1000nm) is called sub micron level powder; Particle size between 0.001 and 0.1 μ The powder of m (1nm-100nm) is called nanometer powder (also called nanomaterials). In a broad sense, nanomaterials means that at least one dimension of the three-dimensional dimension is in nanometer size.

explanation_cn: 国际上没有统一的说法，美国PET居委会将单丝细度为0.3～1.0 dtex的纤维定义成超细纤维，日本将单丝细度在0.55 dtex以下的纤维定义为超细纤维，意大利将单丝细度在0.5 dtex以下的纤维定义为超细纤维，但是大多数人认为单丝细度小于1 dtex的为超细纤维，而小于0.1 dtex的认为是极细纤维。我国的纺织行业认为单丝细度小于0. 44 dtex的纤维定义为超细纤维。大部分合成纤维均可制备超细纤维，如聚酰胺、聚酯、聚丙烯、聚丙烯腈等纤维。
explanation_en: There is no unified statement in the world. The American PET Neighborhood Committee defines a fiber with a monofilament fineness of 0.3~1.0 dtex as a superfine fiber, Japan defines a fiber with a monofilament fineness of less than 0.55 dtex as a superfine fiber, and Italy defines a fiber with a monofilament fineness of less than 0.5 dtex as a superfine fiber. However, most people believe that a fiber with a monofilament fineness of less than 1 dtex is a superfine fiber, while a fiber with a monofilament fineness of less than 0.1 dtex is considered as an extremely fine fiber. The textile industry in China believes that the fineness of monofilament is less than 0 44 dtex fiber is defined as superfine fiber. Most synthetic fiber can be used to prepare superfine fiber, such as polyamide, polyester, polypropylene, polyacrylonitrile and other fibers.

explanation_cn:
周期表中原子序数大于92（铀）的元素，也就是超铀元素，包括镎（Np）、钚（Pu）、镅（Am）、锔（Cm）、锫（Bk）、锎（Cf）、锿（Es）、镄（Fm）、钔（Md）、锘（No）、铹（Lr）、鈽（Bh）、鐨（Hs）等元素。这些元素的原子序数超过铀（92），并且它们的核特性随着原子序数的增加而发生变化，包括α衰变和自发裂变。制备这些元素通常需要用人工合成的方法，因为它们在自然界中存在的概率很小。

通常，制备超铀元素的方法包括两种：

1.通过在反应堆或核爆炸条件下，使铀的同位素235U多次俘获中子，生成新的富中子同位素，然后通过放射性衰变得到更重的超铀元素。
2.利用加速器将离子轰击原子序数更高的元素，形成中间复合核，然后蒸发出带电粒子和不带电粒子，形成新的重元素。

这些超铀元素在核物理研究和核工程领域具有广泛应用，但由于一些核素的半衰期很短，产量很小，因此在实际应用中有一定的挑战。
explanation_en: The elements with atomic numbers greater than 92 (uranium) in the periodic table are transuranium elements, including neptunium (Np), plutonium (Pu), americium (Am), curium (Cm), berkelium (Bk), californium (Cf), einium (Es), rare earth (Fm), rare earth (Md), nanometer (No), lawrencium (Lr), plutonium (Bh), rare earth (Hs) and other elements. The atomic number of these elements exceeds that of uranium (92), and their nuclear properties change with the increase of atomic number, including α Decay and spontaneous fission. The preparation of these elements usually requires artificial synthesis methods, as their probability of existence in nature is very low. Generally, there are two methods to prepare transuranium elements: 1. Under the conditions of reactor or nuclear explosion, the 235U isotope of uranium captures neutrons for many times, generates new neutron rich isotopes, and then obtains heavier transuranium elements through radioactive decay. 2. Use an accelerator to bombard ions with elements with higher atomic numbers, forming intermediate composite nuclei, and then evaporate charged and uncharged particles to form new heavy elements. These transuranium elements are widely used in the field of nuclear physics research and nuclear engineering. However, due to the short half life of some nuclides and the small output, they have certain challenges in practical application.

explanation_cn: 铁镁矿物（以橄榄石、辉石为主）含量超过90%的一类火成岩。大多数超镁铁质岩就是超基性岩，但二者不具有等同关系。超基性岩是按SiO2含量为标准分类的岩石，而超镁铁岩质是按镁铁矿物含量来确定的。如辉石岩类。铁镁矿物含在90%以上?但SiO2含量高于45%，故它是超镁铁质岩，而不是超基性岩；又如斜长岩，由钙的硅铝酸盐矿物组成，SiO2含?f低于45%，属于超基性岩，但不是超镁铁质岩。

SiO2 contains? F is lower than 45%, belonging to ultrabasic rock, but not ultramafic rock.
