explanation_cn: 如果磁性材料是一单畴颗粒的集合体，对于每一个颗粒而言，由于磁性原子或离子之间的交换作用很强，磁矩之间将平行取向，而且磁矩取向在由磁晶各向异性所决定的易磁化方向上，但是颗粒之间由于易磁化方向不同，磁矩的取向也就不同。现今，如果进一步减小颗粒的尺寸即体积，因为总的磁晶各向异性能正比于K1V，热扰动能正比于kT（K1是磁晶各向异性常数，V是颗粒体积，k是玻尔兹曼常数，T是样品的绝对温度），颗粒体积减小到某一数值时，热扰动能将与总的磁晶各向异性能相当，这样，颗粒内的磁矩方向就可能随着时间的推移，整体保持平行地在一个易磁化方向和另一个易磁化方向之间反复变化。从单畴颗粒集合体看，不同颗粒的磁矩取向每时每刻都在变换方向，这种磁性的特点和正常顺磁性的情况很相似，但是也不尽相同。因为在正常顺磁体中，每个原子或离子的磁矩只有几个玻尔磁子，但是对于直径5nm的特定球形颗粒集合体而言，每个颗粒可能包含了5000个以上的原子，颗粒的总磁矩有可能大于10000个玻尔磁子。所以把单畴颗粒集合体的这种磁性称为超顺磁性。
explanation_en: If the magnetic materials is a collection of single domain particles, for each particle, due to the strong exchange interaction between magnetic atoms or ions, the magnetic moment will be parallel to the orientation, and the magnetic moment orientation is in the easy magnetize direction determined by the magnetocrystalline anisotropy. However, due to the different easy magnetize directions between particles, the orientation of the magnetic moment will also be different. Nowadays, if the particle size is further reduced, that is, the volume, because the total magnetocrystalline anisotropy energy is proportional to K1V, and the thermal disturbance kinetic energy is proportional to kT (K1 is the magnetocrystalline anisotropy constant, V is the particle volume, k is the Boltzmann constant, and T is the absolute temperature of the sample), when the particle volume is reduced to a certain value, the thermal disturbance kinetic energy will be equivalent to the total magnetocrystalline anisotropy performance, so that the direction of the magnetic moment in the particle may be as time goes by, Keep the whole parallel and repeatedly change between one easy magnetize direction and the other easy magnetize direction. From the perspective of single domain particle aggregates, the magnetic moment orientation of different particles is changing every moment. The magnetic characteristics are similar to the normal paramagnetism, but also different. Because in a normal paramagnet, each atom or ion has only a few magnetic moment of Bohr magneton, but for a specific spherical particle aggregate with a diameter of 5nm, each particle may contain more than 5000 atoms, and the total magnetic moment of particles may be greater than 10000 Bohr magneton. So the magnetism of single domain particle aggregates is called superparamagnetism.

explanation_cn:
分子量极高（大于1.0x10^6）的一类乙烯的线型均聚物。其分子结构与高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）类似。分子链长度是标准等级HDPE的10到100倍，是一种热塑性工程塑料。工业生产采用Ziegler-Natta催化剂，由乙烯或乙烯与α-烯烃聚合而成。密度为0.936到0.964 g/cm3，熔点为130到136°C，热变形温度为85°C，最高使用温度一般不超过80到100°C。温度低于-150°C时，材料易变脆。力学性能高于高密度聚乙烯，具有突出的抗冲击性、耐应力开裂、耐蠕变性、耐磨和自润滑性，优异的耐化学腐蚀性、抗疲劳性、噪声阻尼性、耐紫外线等特点。

其熔体黏度高，难以流动，采用特殊方法加工成各种制品。通过凝胶纺丝法制得超高弹性模量和强度的纤维，其拉伸强度高达3.3到3.5 GPa，拉伸弹性模量高达100到125 GPa。其纤维比强度是迄今已商品化的所有纤维中最高的，比碳纤维大4倍，比钢丝大10倍，比芳纶纤维大50%。耐磨性超过碳钢，可代替钢材用于阀门、泵、密封填料、纺织机械齿轮、皮带、传动零件、蜗轮杆、轴承、轴瓦、导轨、设备衬里、滑雪板、人工关节等，用超高分子量聚乙烯生产的超高强度轻型聚乙烯纤维可用于制造防弹衣、绳索以及体育用品。
explanation_en: Linear homopolymer of ethylene with extremely high molecular weight (greater than 1.0x10 ^ 6). Its molecular structure is similar to high density polyethylene (HDPE). The molecular chain length is 10 to 100 times that of standard grade HDPE, which is a thermoplastic engineering plastics. Industrial production uses Ziegler Natta catalyst, which is composed of ethylene or ethylene and α- It is made by polymerization of olefins. Density 0.936 to 0.964 g/cm 3， The melting point is 130 to 136 ° C, the heat deflection temperature is 85 ° C, and the maximum operating temperature generally does not exceed 80 to 100 ° C. When the temperature is lower than -150 ° C, materials tends to become brittle. The mechanical properties are higher than that of high density polyethylene. It has outstanding impact resistance, stress cracking resistance, creep resistance, wear resistance and self-lubricating properties, excellent chemical corrosion resistance, fatigue resistance, noise damping, UV resistance and other characteristics. Its melt has high viscosity and is difficult to flow, so it is processed into various products by special methods. Ultra high elastic modulus and strength fibers were obtained by gel spinning, with tensile strength up to 3.3 to 3.5 GPa and tensile elastic modulus up to 100 to 125 GPa. Its fiber specific strength is the highest among all commercially available fibers so far, 4 times larger than carbon fiber, 10 times larger than wire, and 50% larger than aramid fiber. Wear resistance exceeds that of carbon steel, and can replace steel product for valves, pumps, sealing fillers, textile machinery gears, belts, transmission parts, worm gear rods, bearings, bearing pads, guide rails, equipment linings, skis, artificial joint, etc. The ultrahigh strength light polyethylene fiber produced with ultra high molecular weight polyethylene can be used to manufacture bulletproof clothing, ropes, and sporting goods.

name_cn: 超高分子量聚乙烯纤维
explanation_cn:
指平均分子量在100万以上的聚乙烯所制得的纤维。主要采用凝胶纺丝-超倍拉伸法制成。超高分子量聚乙烯（UHMWPE）溶解于溶剂中形成溶液后进行干法或湿法凝胶纺丝。由于凝胶纺丝时，纤维的结晶结构相对较自由，纤维在去除溶剂后可以进行超倍拉伸，容易使分子链拉直，从而形成超高强度纤维。

关键技术是在纺丝温度下使聚合物的稀溶液处于液态状态，纺丝挤出后通过1到2厘米的空气层，然后进入凝固浴进行快速冷却，制成凝胶纤维。一般而言，中等分子量的聚乙烯（40万到80万）可以制备高强度纤维，但实际采用的分子量一般在300万到500万之间。纺丝液的浓度通常控制在5%到10%之间。纺丝设备可以采用标准的溶液纺丝设备，也可以采用螺杆挤出机，纺丝孔直径控制在0.5到1.0毫米，流道长度与直径之比可达25。国外高强度聚乙烯纤维的品牌主要有Dyneema和Spectra系列。

这种纤维的密度为0.97 g/cm3，拉伸强度为2.8到4.0 GPa，弹性模量为80到140 GPa，延伸率为3%到5%，熔点大约在150°C左右。这种纤维可用于增强热固性树脂、聚酯、聚乙烯酯或低温热塑性酚醛树脂（约120°C）等复合材料，提供出色的冲击性能和能量吸收性能。由于高分子量聚乙烯纤维还具有良好的韧性、耐磨性、耐化学药品性能，以及不吸水和低密度等特性，除用于耐冲击轻质复合材料外，还可用于绳索、医疗方面的缝线、人造肌腱、防弹衣、光纤增强纤维等。不足之处是其熔点较低，可能产生蠕变，而且与聚合物的粘合能力较差。
explanation_en: It refers to the fiber made of polyethylene with a average molecular weight of more than 1 million. It is mainly made by gel spinning super drawing method. Ultra high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE) is dissolved in solvent to form solution, and then is spun by dry or wet gel spinning. Since the crystal structure of the fiber is relatively free during gel spinning, the fiber can be super stretched after solvent removal, which is easy to straighten the molecular chain, thus forming an ultra-high strength fiber. The key technology is to keep the dilute solution of polymer in liquid state at the spinning temperature. After spinning and extrusion, it passes through an air layer of 1-2 cm, and then enters the coagulation bath for rapid cooling to make gel fiber. Generally speaking, medium molecular weight polyethylene (400000-800000) can be used to prepare high-strength fibers, but the actual molecular weight is generally between 3 million and 5 million. The concentration of spinning solution is usually controlled between 5% and 10%. The spinning equipment can be standard solvent spinning equipment or screw extruder. The diameter of the spinning hole can be controlled within 0.5 to 1.0 mm, and the ratio of the length and diameter of the flow fields or flow channels can reach 25. The main brands of high-strength polyethylene fibers abroad include Dyneema and Spectra series. The density of this fiber is 0.97 g/cm 3， The tensile strength is 2.8 to 4.0 GPa, the elastic modulus is 80 to 140 GPa, the elongation is 3 to 5%, and the melting point is about 150 ° C. This fiber can be used to strengthen composite materials such as thermosetting resin, polyester, polyethylene ester or low-temperature thermoplastic phenolic resin (about 120 ° C), providing excellent impact performance and energy absorption performance. Because macromolecule polyethylene fiber also has good toughness, wear resistance, chemical resistance, non water absorption and low density, it can be used not only for impact resistant lightweight composite materials, but also for ropes, medical sutures, artificial tendons, bulletproof clothing, optical fiber reinforcing fiber, etc. The disadvantage is that its melting point is low, which may cause creep, and its adhesion to polymer is poor.

explanation_cn: 室温屈服强度高于1370MPa、抗拉强度高于1470MPa同时具有较高断裂韧性的合金结构钢。根据合金元素含量可分为低合金超高强度钢、中合金超高强度钢、高合金超高强度钢。而根据其组织和性能可分为一般超高强度钢、超高强度不锈钢、马氏体时效钢、基体钢等-大量应用于I机起落架、机身骨架和蒙皮、火箭外壳、高压容器、装甲及武器零部件等。
explanation_en: Alloy structural steel with room temperature yield strength higher than 1370MPa, tensile strength higher than 1470MPa and higher fracture toughness. According to the content of alloy elements, it can be divided into low alloy ultra-high strength steel, medium alloy ultra-high strength steel and high alloy ultra-high strength -steel. According to its structure and properties, it can be divided into general ultra-high strength steel, ultra-high strength stainless steel, maraging steel, matrix steel, etc. - a large number of which are used in aircraft I landing gear, fuselage framework and skin, rocket shell, high-pressure vessel, armor and weapon parts.

explanation_cn: 室温抗拉强度在1400MPa以上的钛合金。合金需要通过热处理，即固溶时效强化。目前这类合金还处于发展阶段，合金经固溶淬火、冷变形、再结晶退火和时效处理后，室温拉伸强度1400MPa，伸长率8%。
explanation_en: Titanium alloys with room temperature tensile strength above 1400MPa. Alloy needs to be strengthened by heat treatment, that is, solution aging. At present, this kind of alloy is still in the development stage. After solution quenching, cold deformation, recrystallization annealing and aging treatment, the alloy has a tensile strength of 1400MPa at room temperature and an elongation of 8%.

explanation_cn: 室温拉伸强度极限高于500MPa，同时兼有适当韧性（拉伸断裂伸长率大于3%)的镁合金。普通铸造和变形条件下制备的超高强镁合金均含有Y、Gd等稀土元素，通过适当的热加工工艺，在固溶强化、细晶强化和析出强化共同作用下获得超高强度。采用大塑性变形、超快速凝固和喷射沉积等特殊加工方法也可以获得超高强镁合金。
explanation_en: Magnesium alloys with room temperature tensile strength limit higher than 500MPa and appropriate toughness (tensile percentage elongation after fracture greater than 3%). Uhra-high strength magnesium alloy prepared by ordinary foundry and deformation conditions contains Y, Gd and other rare earth elements. Through appropriate hot working, ultra-high strength can be obtained under the combined action of solution strengthening, grain refinement strengthening and precipitation strengthening. Uhra-high strength magnesium alloy can also be obtained by special processing methods such as large plastic deformation, ultra rapid solidification and spray deposition.

explanation_cn: 将一些耐高温性能较好的金属氧化物，在金属基体表面上喷涂或刷镀，通过黏结剂的黏结作用在金属基体表面形成的一层粉料涂层。能有效防止基材在超高温（2000°C以上）条件下发生氧化降级的保护涂层，厚度一般在数十到几百微米。涂层材料为超高温相，如碳化物、硼化物等。碳化物在超高温条件下氧化后烧结形成致密的氧化物层、或硼化物与其他碳化物（如碳化硅）在高温氧化条件下形成氧化物玻璃相包覆在涂层表面，限制氧气进一步向基材内部扩散，从而提高基材的使用寿命。
explanation_en: Some metal oxides with good high temperature resistance are sprayed or brush plated on the surface of the metal matrix, and a layer of powder coating is formed on the surface of the metal matrix through the bonding effect of adhesive. A protective coating that can effectively prevent oxidation degradation of the substrate under ultra-high temperature (above 2000 ° C) conditions, with a thickness generally ranging from tens to hundreds of micrometers. The coating materials is ultra-high temperature phase, such as carbide, boride, etc. Carbide is oxidized at ultra-high temperature and then sintering to form a dense oxide layer, or boride and other carbide (such as silicon carbide) are oxidized at high temperalure oxidation to form oxide glass phase on the coating surface, which restricts the further diffusion of oxygen to the interior of the substrate, thus improving the service life of the substrate.

explanation_cn: 将淬火温度从正常的As+30-50摄氏度提高到As+300摄氏度左右的淬火工艺，可以明显改善机械结构钢的断裂韧性。
explanation_en: The fracture toughness of mechanical structural steel can be significantly improved by raising the quenching temperature from the normal As+30-50 ℃ to about As+300 ℃ in the quenching process.

name_cn: 超高温陶瓷基复合材料
name_en: ultra high temperature ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 陶瓷复合材料中的一种，是由超高温陶瓷基体和增强相经复合艺制备的多相材料。超高温陶瓷基体主要指能在高温范围内使用的过渡金属的硼化物、碳化物和氮化物。增强相可分为连续纤维、短纤维、晶须、纳米线和纳米管。增强相的引人能有效改善单相陶瓷的断裂韧性和强度，主要应用在航天飞机发动机、太空往返飞行器和高超音速运载工具的热防护系统，金属高温熔炼和连铸用电极、坩埚和相关部件。
explanation_en: One of the ceramics composite materials is a multi-phase materials prepared by the composite process of uhra high temperature ceramics matrix and reinforced phase. The matrix of uhra high temperature ceramics mainly refers to the borides, carbide and nitrides of transition metals that can be used in the high temperature range. The reinforced phase can be divided into continuous fiber, staple fiber, crystal whisker, nanowire and nanotube. The introduction of reinforcing phase can effectively improve the fracture toughness and strength of single-phase ceramics. It is mainly used in the thermal protection system of space shuttle engines, space shuttle aircraft and hypersonic vehicles, as well as electrodes, crucibles and related parts for metal high-temperature melting and continuous casting.

explanation_cn: 中国古代南方著名的青瓷。多以拉坯成型为主，也有采用捏塑成型。起源于东汉，发展于六朝时期鼎盛于唐宋。具有瓷质光泽，透光性较好，吸水率低，在1260-1310°C的高温下烧成，器表通体施釉。云灰岩参见白云质灰岩。
explanation_en: The famous celadon in southern China in ancient times. Most of them are mainly formed by drawing, and some also use pinch molding. Originating from the Eastern Han Dynasty and developing during the Six Dynasties period, it reached its peak in the Tang and Song dynasties. It has porcelain luster, good light transmittance, low water absorption, and is fired at 1260-1310 ° C, with glaze applied to the surface. See dolomitic limestone for dolomite.

explanation_cn: 电子在局域态之间跳跃引起电荷移动的导电机制。非晶态固体材料中电子运动存在着局域态，电子离开局域态运动需要吸收一定的能量，这种能量可以从晶格热振动的能量得到，即通过电子-晶格相互作用，吸收一个或几个声子获得能量，这是一个热激活的过程。
explanation_en: The conductive mechanism by which electrons jump between local states and cause charge movement. There are localized states in the movement of electrons in amorphous solid materials. When electrons leave the localized states, they need to absorb a certain amount of energy. This energy can be obtained from the energy of the thermal vibration of the lattice, that is, through the electron lattice interaction, they absorb one or several phonon to obtain energy, which is a process of thermal activation.

explanation_cn:
用于生产汽车车轮和铁路车轮的钢材分为汽车车轮钢和铁路车轮钢。这些钢材需要满足特定的要求，包括高强度、韧性、塑性、抗疲劳性能、耐磨性和抗热裂性。

汽车车轮钢通常是通过钢板成型后焊接得到的。根据标准YBT4151-2015，汽车车轮钢的标识在抗拉强度数值后加上"CL"，表示这是汽车车轮钢。这些钢材通常采用低碳锰钢，其抗拉强度级别从330MPa到590MPa不等。

铁路车轮分为轧制车轮和铸造车轮两种制造工艺。辗制车轮由整体钢坯辗制而成，在组织性能、金属利用率和使用寿命方面明显优于铸造车轮。根据标准GBT8601-88，铁路用辗制车轮的标识以字母"CL"表示车轮钢，后跟着成分钢号。这些车轮钢通常采用中碳优质非合金钢或低合金钢，其抗拉强度要求大于860MPa。这样的车轮钢在铁路运输中具有重要应用，确保了列车的安全和稳定性。
explanation_en: The steel product used to produce automobile wheels and railway wheels is divided into automobile wheel sl and railway wheel sl. These steel product need to meet specific requirements, including high strength, toughness, plasticity, fatigue resistance, wear resistance and hot cracking resistance. Automobile wheel sl is usually formed by steel plate and then weld. According to the standard YBT4151-2015, "CL" is added after the tensile strength value for the identification of automobile wheel sl, indicating that it is automobile wheel sl. These steel product usually use low-carbon manganese steel with tensile strength grades ranging from 330MPa to 590MPa. There are two manufacturing processes for railway wheels: rolling wheels and foundry wheels. The rolled wheel is rolled from the whole billet, which is obviously superior to the foundry wheel in terms of microstructure, performance, metal utilization rate and service life. According to the standard GBT8601-88, the identification of rolled wheels for railway use uses the letter "CL" to indicate wheel sl, followed by the composition steel designation. These wheel sl usually use medium carbon high-quality non-alloy steel or low alloy steel, whose tensile strength is required to be greater than 860MPa. Such wheel sl has an important application in railway transportation, ensuring the safety and stability of trains.

explanation_cn: 用于生产铁路机车和车辆车轴的钢车轴钢既要求有很高的拉伸强度，又要求有良好的韧性和仲氏率以及良好的抗疲劳性能。铁路机车和车辆车轴用钢（GB5068-1999)主要采用优质中碳结构钢，在成分钢号前加LZ表示车辆车轴钢、加JZ表示机车车轴钢。
explanation_en: The steel axle steel used for the production of railway locomotive and vehicle axles requires not only high tensile strength, but also good toughness, Jones ratio and good fatigue resistance. Steel (GB5068-1999) used for railway locomotives and vehicle axles is mainly high quality medium carbon structural steel. Adding LZ before the composition steel designation indicates vehicle axle steel, and adding JZ indicates locomotive axle steel.

explanation_cn: 金属材料通过具有旋转轧辊的轧机进行塑性变形加工称为。冶金生产厂最主要的金属塑性加工方法。按轧辊与轧件的相互位置、运动和延伸方向，可分为纵轧、横轧和斜轧。按温度是否在材料的再结晶温度以上，可分为热轧（温度在材料的再结晶温度以上）和冷轧（温度在材料的再结晶温度以下甚至室温）。按品种，可分为炸窄粘展张樟赵板带材轧制、管材轧制、棒线材轧制、型材轧制和周期断面轧制等。按轧制产品的工艺阶段可分为初轧、中轧和精轧等。
explanation_en: Plastic deformation processing of metallic materials through rolling mill with rotating roll is called. The most important plastic forming method for metals in metallurgical plants. According to the mutual position, movement and extension direction of roll and rolled piece, it can be divided into longitudinal rolling, cross rolling and skew rolling. According to whether the temperature is above the recrystallization temperature of materials, it can be divided into hot rolling (the temperature is above the recrystallization temperature of materials) and cold rolling (the temperature is below the recrystallization temperature of materials or even room temperature). According to variety, it can be divided into rolling of fried narrow adhesive stretched Zhangzhao plate and strip, rolling of tube, rolling of bar and wire rolling, rolling of section and periodic section rolling. According to the process stages of rolling products, it can be divided into blooming, intermediate rolling and finish rolling.

explanation_cn: 可塑性泥料通过一对辊子碾压形成片状素坯的成型工艺。
explanation_en: The molding process of forming sheet like billets using a pair of rollers to compact the plastic clay material.

explanation_cn: 从一种形式、状态或特点变为另一种形式、状态或特点。
explanation_en: To change from one form, state, or characteristic to another.

explanation_cn: 炉体可自由转动的圆筒形或近圆筒形的金属冶炼设备，炉形为正口梨形，炉壳;由钢板制成，内衬耐火材料。设备构成包括及倾动系统、供氧系统、供料系统和烟气处理系统。冶炼时炉内铁水或金属液与吹入的纯氧或空气中的氧发生化学反应，产生的化学热提供所需要的热能而无需外加热源，同时氧化液态金属中的杂质使之成渣上浮而脱除。根据炉衬的材质可将分为碱性和酸性，根据供气类塑吋分为空气和氧气，根据供气位置吋分为底吹、顶吹、侧吹和复吹。碱性氧气顶吹和顶底结合的复吹是目前世界上主要的炼钢设备。在有色金属冶炼中，常采用卧式吹炼冰铜或低冰镍，用氧气顶吹处理高品位铜精矿等。
explanation_en: A cylindrical or nearly cylindrical metal smelting equipment whose furnace body can rotate freely. The furnace is shaped like a pear with a straight mouth and a furnace shell; It is made of steel plate and lined with refractory. The equipment composition includes tilting system, oxygen supply system, feeding system, and flue gas treatment system. During smelting, molten iron or liquid metal in the furnace reacts with pure oxygen or oxygen in the air, and the generated chemical heat provides the required heat energy without external heat source. At the same time, impurities in the liquid metal are oxidized to make it become slag to float and remove. According to the material of the furnace lining, it can be divided into alkaline and acidic, air and oxygen according to the type of gas supply, and bottom blowing, top blowing, side blowing, and compound blowing according to the gas supply position. Basic oxygen top blowing and top bottom combined blowing are the main steelmaking equipment in the world at present. In smelting of non-ferrous metals, horizontal blowing of matte or low matte nickel is often used, and top blowing of oxygen is used to treat high-grade copper concentrates.

explanation_cn: 又称拉托拉实验，是一种测定金属粉末的耐磨性、成形性的方法。实验装置是由以青铜筛网的圆筒，驱动圆筒回转的电动机、变速箱和显示转动次数的计数器所组成。
explanation_en: Also known as latola experiment, it is a method to measure the wear resistance and formability of metal powder. The experimental device is composed of a cylinder with bronze screen, a motor driving the cylinder to rotate, a gearbox and a counter showing the number of turns.

explanation_cn: 即木栓或栓皮，是树皮中的组织。在树、树基或树根中的阽皮部中均有，木栓形成层，足成熟的、能重新恢复分生作用的一层细胞，同木质部的维管形成层一样，是一种分省组织.但一般几个月就死亡。
explanation_en: The cork or cork bark is the tissue in the bark of a tree. In the bark of trees, tree bases, or roots, there is a cork cambium, a mature layer of cells that can restore meristem function. Like the vascular cambium of the xylem, it is a provincial tissue, but usually dies within a few months.

explanation_cn: 晶格振动中频率较低的晶体中的某一横光学模，在温度趋于某一临界温度T时，其振动频率趋于零.此简正模称为软模。
explanation_en: When the temperature of a transverse optical mode in a low frequency crystal in lattice vibration approaches a critical temperature T, its vibration frequency tends to zero. This normal mode is called soft mode.

explanation_cn: 在略低于Fe-N-C系的共析温度进行的氮、碳共渗化学热处理工艺。对被处理材料无严格要求，可广泛应用于各种结构钢、工具钢、铸铁和不锈钢等。按共渗介质状态可分为固体、液体和气体软氮化。
explanation_en: The process of nitrocarburizing thermo-chemical treatment at the eutectoid temperature slightly lower than that of Fe-N-C system. There is no strict requirement for the processed materials, which can be widely used in various structural steel, tool steel, cast iron, stainless steel, etc. It can be divided into solid, liquid and gas soft nitriding according to the state of the penetrant medium.

explanation_cn: 也称和田玉、闪石玉。是地质作用过程中形成的、主要由透闪石-阳起石类质同象系列矿物组成的矿物集合体。按产出环境可分为原生矿、次生矿；按颜色分为A玉（包括羊脂玉）、青白玉、青玉、碧玉、墨玉、青花玉等；按产出状态分为山料、山流水、仔料和戈壁料。
explanation_en: Also known as hotan jade and Amphibole Jade. It is a mineral aggregate formed during geological processes, mainly composed of tremolite actinolite like isomorphic series minerals. According to the production environment, it can be divided into primary ore and secondary ore; It can be divided into A-jade (including Suet jade), blue white jade, sapphire, jasper, black jade, blue and white jade, etc. according to color; According to the output status, it is divided into mountain materials, mountain flowing water, sub materials, and Gobi materials.

explanation_cn: 由软磁性铁氧体和高聚物基体复合而成的具有软磁性功能的复合材料,，对于软磁性材料要求低矫顽力和高磁导率，尽量减少磁导率随频率的升高而迅速下降的效应。
explanation_en: The composite materials with soft magnetic function, which is composed of soft magnetic ferrite and polymer matrix composition, requires low coercive force and high permeability for soft magnetic materials, and tries to reduce the effect that the permeability decreases rapidly with the increase of frequency.

explanation_cn: 软磁材料是具有低矫顽力和高磁导率的磁性材料。它的磁滞回线窄而长，起始磁导率高，矫顽力小，易于磁化，也易于退磁，是极其重要的一类磁性材料。按电阻率的不同，软磁材料可以分为金属软磁材料和铁氧体软磁材料两大类。金属软磁材料由于其电阻率较低而主要应用于频率较低的场合；铁氧体软磁材料则在频率较高的场合被广泛采用。
explanation_en: Soft magnetic materials are magnetic materials with low coercive force and high permeability. Its magnetic hysteresis is narrow and long, its initial permeability is high, its coercive force is small, and it is easy to magnetize and demagnetize, so it is an extremely important class of magnetic materials. According to the difference of resistivity, soft magnetic materials can be divided into metal soft magnetic material and soft magnetic ferrites. Metal soft magnetic material are mainly used in low frequency occasions because of their low resistivity; Soft magnetic ferrites are widely used in high frequency applications.

explanation_cn: 一种容易磁化和退磁的铁氧体。其特点是起始的磁导率高，矫顽力小，损耗小，使用频率可达高频、超高频范闹。这类材料大都是两种或两种以上的铁氧体的间溶体。包括两大类：一类属于尖晶石型（如MnZn系，NiZn系），主要用于声频、中频和高频范围；一类属于磁铅石型，适用于超高频范闹。软磁铁氧体广泛应用于录音、录像记录磁头，变压器磁芯等在通信、广播、电视和其他无线电电子学技术中。
explanation_en: A ferrite that is easy to magnetize and demagnetize. It is characterized by high initial permeability, low coercive force, low loss, and high frequency and ultra-high frequency. Most of these materials are intersolution of two or more kinds of ferrite. It includes two categories: one belongs to spinel type (such as MnZn system and NiZn system), mainly used in audio frequency, intermediate frequency and high frequency range; One type belongs to the magnetic lead stone type, suitable for ultra-high frequency range noise. Soft magnetic ferrite is widely used in recording and recording heads, transformer cores, and other radio electronics technologies in communication, broadcasting, television, and other fields.

explanation_cn: 用以修复和替代机体中发生病变或者损伤的软组织，恢复或部分恢复原有组织形态和功能的一类生物医用材料，软组织修复材料中发展最快的是合成高分子医用材料，通过分子设计，可以获得很多具有良好物理机械性和生物相容性的生物材料。
explanation_en: It is a kind of biomedical materials used to repair and replace the diseased or damaged soft tissues in the body, and restore or partially restore the original tissue morphology and function. The fastest developing repairing materials of soft tissue are synthetic macromolecule medical materials. Through molecular design, many biological materials with good physical and mechanical properties and biocompatibility can be obtained.

explanation_cn: 指植入生物体内，占据软组织损伤或者病变造成的空腔和缺损部位，替代并行使或增强其原冇功能的一类生物医用材料。主要用于填充或修复因创伤、外科手术和先天的软组织畸形或缺损。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of biomedical materials that is implantation in the organism, occupies the cavity and defect caused by soft tissue injury or disease, and replaces and exercises or enhances its original function. Mainly used for filling or repairing soft tissue deformities or defects caused by trauma, surgery, and congenital conditions.

explanation_cn: 又称为增塑聚氯乙烯塑料。由于增塑剂的加入，提高了pvr的可塑性、流动性、柔软性和伸长率，改善了加工性能，降低了PVC的熔融黏度、玻璃化转变温度和制品的弹性模量。
explanation_en: Also known as plasticized polyvinyl chloride plastic. Due to the addition of plasticizer, the plasticity, flow ability, softness and elongation of pvr are improved, the processability is improved, and the melting viscosity, glass transition temperature and elastic modulus of products are reduced.

explanation_cn: 又名低火瓷.质地较软的瓷器。胎体中长石等溶剂含量较高，烧成温度在1300°C以下，半透明度高，化学稳定性.机械强度和电击穿强度均低多用于制作美术瓷，卫生用瓷.瓷砖及各种装饰瓷等
explanation_en: Also known as low fire porcelain, soft porcelain. The matrix contains a high content of feldspar and other solvents, and the firing temperature is below 1300 ° C, with high translucency, chemical stability, low mechanical strength and electrical breakdown strength. It is mainly used for making art porcelain, sanitary porcelain, ceramic tiles and various decorative ceramics

explanation_cn: 不进行热处理或表面硬化处理的低碳非合金工程结构钢。
explanation_en: Low carbon non alloy engineering structural steel without heat treatment or surface hardening treatment.

explanation_cn: 简单链状结构氧化物矿物。
explanation_en: Simple chain structured oxide minerals.

explanation_cn: 反极图的表示法。选取晶体标准取向的极射赤面投影图上的一个三角单元。以参照方向（如线的轴向）在角单元中的分布密度来表示，因此也称为轴分布图。
explanation_en: Representation of inverse pole figure. Select a triangle unit on the stereographic projection diagram of the standard orientation of crystal. It is expressed by the distribution density of the reference direction (such as the axial direction of the line) in the angle unit, so it is also called the axis distribution figure.

explanation_cn: 又称滚动。适合于制作滚动轴承的滚珠、滚柱、滚针和轴承内外套圈的合金结构钢。滚动轴承在工作时承受极大的周期性的应力载荷，滚动体和套圈表面往往会产生麻点、剥落等接触疲劳破坏：滚动和滑动摩擦会使其发生明显的磨损及应力集中造成的局部损伤。因此，应有较高的抗压强度和接触疲劳强度、高而均匀的硬度和耐磨性、高弹性极限、良好的尺寸稳定性及一定的韧性和耐蚀性。为此，通常的轴承钢一般采用1%左右的碳含量，加入适量铬（0.5%-1.65%)以获得较高的接触疲劳强度、抗压强度、耐磨性、弹性极限和耐蚀性，具有较高的纯净度以提高抗接触疲劳性能。在钢号前加G表示滚动轴承钢。根据轴承钢成分和用途的不同，通常可分为高碳铬轴承钢、渗碳轴承钢、不锈轴承钢以及高温轴承钢。
explanation_en: Also known as scrolling. Alloy structural steel suitable for making balls, rollers, needles and inner and outer rings of rolling bearings. Rolling bearings bear great periodic stress loads during operation, and contact fatigue damage such as pitting and spalling often occurs on the surface of rolling elements and rings. Rolling and sliding friction will cause obvious wear and local damage caused by stress concentration. Therefore, it should have high compressive strength and contact fatigue strength, high and uniform hardness and wear resistance, high elasticity limit, good dimensional stability, and certain toughness and corrosion resistance. For this reason, the normal bearing steel generally uses about 1% carbon content, and adds an appropriate amount of chromium (0.5% -1.65%) to obtain high contact fatigue strength, compressive strength, wear resistance, elasticity limit and corrosion resistance, and has high purity to improve the contact fatigue resistance. G is added before steel designation to indicate bearing steel. According to the different components and uses of bearing steel, it can generally be divided into high carbon chromium bearing steel, carburizing bearing steel, corrosion-resistam bearing steel and high temperature bearing steel.

explanation_cn: 见轴承合金。
explanation_en: See bearing alloy.

explanation_cn: 简称QK玻璃。折射率和密度较小。在组分中引入氟化物等，可得到折射率和色散更低的牌号另外，若干热膨胀系数较一般玻璃为低的光学玻璃如QK2。因光学常数和QK玻璃相近，也列入这一类。主要用作光学仪器中光学零件的材料。
explanation_en: It is called QK glass for short. The refractive index and density are small. In addition, some optical glass with lower thermal expansion coefficient than ordinary glass, such as QK2, can be obtained by introducing fluoride into the component. Because the optical constant is similar to QK glass, it is also included in this category. It is mainly used as materials of optical parts in optical instruments.

explanation_cn: 一种低定量、高松厚度的纸。以化学机械浆为主要原料生产，质地松厚，不透明度高，表面无光泽，用于印刷课本、教材、书籍、杂志等。
explanation_en: A type of paper with low weight and high bulk thickness. Produced using chemical mechanical pulp as the main raw material, it has a loose and thick texture, high opacity, and a dull surface. It is used for printing textbooks, textbooks, books, magazines, etc.

name_en: coatings for light industry and house electrical appliance
explanation_cn: 轻工常指自行车、缝纽机、保温瓶、罐头等轻工业产品，家电是指电视机、电冰箱、洗衣机、电风扇等家用电器。轻工业产品常用H06-2铁红环氧底漆、C06-1铁红醇酸底漆，以底I漆自配成中间涂层（自行车、保温瓶一般不用中间涂层），用氨基烘漆作为面漆，氨基清漆罩面（缝纫机、自行车有时也用沥青漆作为面漆）。家电所用涂料品种较多。金属零件常用氨基烘漆、粉末涂料等，塑料部件要使用塑料涂料，木质部件使用木质涂料。为提高装饰效果，在家电上开始使用绒面涂料。
explanation_en: Light industry often refers to light industrial products such as bicycles, sewing machines, thermos bottles, cans, etc. Household appliances refer to household appliances such as televisions, refrigerators, washing machines, and fans. H06-2 iron red epoxy primer and C06-1 iron red alkyd primer are commonly used for light industrial products. The primer I is used as the intermediate coating (bicycles and thermos bottles generally do not use the intermediate coating). Amino baking paint is used as the top coating, and amino varnish is used as the finishing (sewing machines and bicycles sometimes use pitch paint as the top coating). There are many kinds of coatings used in household appliances. Metal parts are commonly used with amino baking paint, powder coating, etc., plastics parts should use plastics coatings, and wood parts should use wood coatings. In order to improve the decorative effect, suede coatings has been used on household appliances.

explanation_cn: 天然水。或称普通水。分子量18，天然水慢化能力优越。是一种良好的慢化剂。由于它的热中子俘获截面相肖大。用水作慢化剂时。只有用加浓铀，才能得到临界系统。但它的慢化长度短，可以减小堆芯尺寸。水的热导率比液态金属小，但有很高的比热容。黏度低，容易抽送，义是一种良好的冷却剂。
explanation_en: Natural water. Also known as ordinary water. With a molecular weight of 18, natural water has superior moderating ability. It is a good moderator. Due to its relatively large thermal neutron capture cross-section. When using water as a moderator. Only by using enriched uranium can a critical system be obtained. But its slowing down length is short, which can reduce the core size. The thermal conductivity of water is smaller than that of liquid metal, but it has a high specific heat [capacity. Low viscosity, easy pumping, meaning it is a good coolant.

explanation_cn: 简称QF玻璃。折射率和密度较火石玻璃为小。PbO质量分数不超过40%。主要用作光学仪器中光学零件的材料。
explanation_en: It is called QF glass for short. The refractive index and density are smaller than those of flimingglass. The PbO mass fraction shall not exceed 40%. It is mainly used as materials of optical parts in optical instruments.

explanation_cn: 又称隔热耐火材料（heatinsulatingrefractory)。是气孔率高、体积密度低的耐火材料。热导率低、隔热性能好，但机械强度低。主要用作热工设备的保温隔热层。
explanation_en: It is also called insulating refractory materials. It is a refractory with high porosity and low bulk density. Low thermal conductivity, good thermal insulation performance, but low mechanical strength. Mainly used as insulation layer for thermal equipment.

explanation_cn: 用轻质耐火骨料，耐火粉料、结合剂和外加剂等配制成的，施工时加水或含结合剂的溶液调配成的可浇注成型的不定形耐火材料。一般用作热X设备的隔热衬。
explanation_en: It is a pouring molding unshaped refractory prepared with light refractory aggregate, refractory powder, binder and additive, and mixed with water or solution containing binder during construction. Generally used as an insulation lining for thermal X equipment.

explanation_cn: 在生产中基本不使用植物鞣剂而得到的密度比较低、手感比较柔软的一类皮革产品。一般用于鞋面、服装和手套等。市售的轻革大部分是铬鞣革，其原料皮为山羊皮、绵羊皮、猪皮、黄牛皮等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of leather product with low density and soft hand feeling, which is basically produced without vegetable tanning agent. Generally used for shoes, clothing, gloves, etc. Most of the light leather sold in the market is chrome tanned leather, and its raw hides are goat skin, sheep skin, pig skin, cattle skin, etc.

explanation_cn: 以天然多孔轻质材料或入造陶粒作粗骨料。以普通砂或轻砂作细骨料，用硅酸盐水泥、水和外加剂按配合比要求制成的干表观密度不大于1.9g/cm3的混凝土材料。具有轻质、高强、保温和耐火等特点。应用于工业和民用建筑及其他工程，可减轻结构自重、节约材料用量、提高构件运输和吊装效率、减少地基荷载及改善建筑物功能等。按用途分为保温轻骨料混凝土、结构保温轻骨料混凝土和结构轻骨料混凝土；按细骨料种类分为全轻混凝土和砂轻混凝土，全轻混凝土采用轻砂作细骨料-砂轻混凝土采用普通砂或部分轻砂作细骨料。
explanation_en: The coarse aggregate is made of natural porous light materials or ceramsite. Concrete materials with dry apparent density not more than 1.9g/cm3, which is made of ordinary sand or light sand as fine aggregate and Portland cement, water and additives according to the mix proportion requirements. It has the characteristics of lightweight, high-strength, insulation, and fire resistance. When applied to industrial and civil buildings and other projects, it can reduce the dead weight of the structure, save the consumption of materials, improve the efficiency of component transportation and hoisting, reduce the foundation load and improve the function of the building. It can be divided into thermal insulation light aggregate concrete, structural thermal insulation light aggregate concrete and structural light aggregate concrete according to the use; According to the type of fine aggregate, it can be divided into full light concrete and sand light concrete. Full light concrete uses light sand as fine aggregate - sand light concrete uses ordinary sand or part of light sand as fine aggregate.

explanation_cn: 金属中的载流子为电子，半导体中为电子和空穴。迁移率是指载流子（电子和空穴）在单位电场作用下的平均漂移速度，即载流子在电场作用下运动速度的快慢的量度。由某种原因产生的载流子处于无规则的热运动，当外加电压时.导体内部的载流子受到电场力作用，做定向运动形成电流，即漂移电流，带正电载流子漂移速度方向即电流方向，带负电载流子则相反。定向运动的速度为漂移速度，方向由载流子类型决定在电场下，载流子的平均漂移速度p与电场强度E成正比，系数为载流子的漂移迁移率。载流子迁移率是反映半导体中导电能力的重要参数，迁移率的大小不仅关系着导电能力的强弱。而且还直接决定着载流子运动的快慢。载流子在其热运动的过程中，不断地与晶格、杂质、缺陷等发生碰撞，无规则的改变其运动方向。即发生了散射。漂移速度实际上是一个由散射事件控制的统计平均量。
explanation_en: The charge carriers in metals are electrons, while in semiconductors they are electrons and holes. Mobility refers to the average drift velocity of charge carriers (electrons and holes) under the action of a unit electric field, which is a measure of the speed at which charge carriers move under the action of an electric field. Carriers generated for some reason are in irregular thermal motion. When an external voltage is applied, the carriers inside the conductor are subjected to electric field forces and undergo directional motion to form a current, known as drift current. The drift velocity direction of positively charged carriers is the current direction, while negatively charged carriers are the opposite. The speed of directional movement is the drift speed, and the direction is determined by the carrier type. Under the electric field, the average drift speed p of the carrier is proportional to the electric field intensity E, and the coefficient is the drift mobility of the carrier. The mobility of current carrier is an important parameter reflecting the conductivity in semiconductors. The mobility is not only related to the strength of the conductivity. And it directly determines the speed of carrier motion. During its thermal motion, charge carriers constantly collide with lattice, impurities, defects, etc., irregularly changing their direction of motion. Scattering occurs. Drift velocity is actually a statistical average controlled by scattering events.

explanation_cn: 是单位投射面积上的光强度。是发光强度的主观感受，或一个视感觉的属性。
explanation_en: Is the luminous intensity per unit projected area. It is the subjective perception of luminous intensity, or an attribute of visual perception.

explanation_cn: 单链结构硅酸盐矿物。
explanation_en: Silicate mineral with single chain structure.

explanation_cn: 一种超镁铁质火成岩。SO2含量在55.%-60%之间。矿物组成以辉石为主体（含量90%-100%)，其他为橄榄石、角闪石、 黑云母、铬铁矿、磁铁矿、钛铁矿等。
explanation_en: A type of ultramafic igneous rock. The SO2 content is between 55% -60%. The mineral composition is dominated by pyroxene (90% -100%), and the others are olivine, amphibole, biotite, chromite, magnetite, ilmenite, etc.

explanation_cn: 属链状硅酸盐的一类结构。根据所属晶系不间，可分为 两个亚族：斜方辉石亚族和单斜辉石亚族。
explanation_en: A type of structure belonging to chain like silicates. According to their respective crystal systems, they can be divided into two subgroups: orthopyroxene subgroup and monoclinic pyroxene subgroup.

explanation_cn: 一种浅成的甚性侵入岩。成分 勻辉长畀相当主要矿物为辉石和基性长石，含少量 橄榄行、黑云母、石英、磷灰石、磁铁矿、钛铁矿 等。坫性斜1<1石常浊变为钠K石、黝帘石、绿帘石和 卨岭心'；辉石常蚀变为绿泥石、角闪石和碳酸盐类矿 物。W绿泥厶的颜色导致荇石呈灰绿色。基件斜长石 的f!形稈度高于辉石.构成辉绿结构。块状构造。常 VV规校较小的浅成侵人体.如岩脉、岩墙或充填于火 山机构中，它是制备铸石、岩棉以及矿物纤维与鱗片 材料的主要原料。质地均匀、色泽美观者可用作建筑 装饰W枓也n]■用作高速公路路面沥青混凝土的fi?料
explanation_en: A type of shallow intrusive rock. The main minerals are pyroxene and basic feldspar, containing a small amount of olivine, biotite, quartze, apatite, magnetite, ilmenite, etc. Gravel inclined 1<1 stone often becomes turbid and transforms into sodium K stone, zoisite, green epidote, and high mountain core; Pyroxene is often altered into chlorite, amphibole and carbonate minerals. The color of W green mud causes the stone to appear grayish green. The f of the base plagioclase! The degree of culm is higher than that of pyroxene, forming a diabase structure. Massive structure. Usually VV is used to calibrate shallow intrusive bodies, such as veins, dikes or volcanic structures, which are the main raw materials for preparing caststone, rock wool, mineral fiber and scale materials. Those with uniform texture and beautiful color can be used as building decoration materials? material

explanation_cn: 简单链状结构硫化物矿物。很少形成独立的矿床。高温 热液矿床中和黑钨矿、锡石、黄铁矿、绿柱石、辉钼矿、石英、长石、白云母、锂云母、方解石等共生。为炼铋的主要矿物原料。
explanation_en: Simple chain structured sulfide minerals. Rarely form independent mineral deposits. The high-temperature hydrothermal deposit is associated with wolframite, cassiterite, pyrite, beryl, molybdenite, quartze, feldspar, muscovilte, lepidolite, caldte, etc. It is the main raw mineral material for bismuth smelting.

explanation_cn: 成分 Cu2S，是炼铜的主要矿物原料之一。
explanation_en: Cu2S is one of the main raw mineral material for copper smelting.

explanation_cn: 简单链状结构硫化物矿物，化学式为Sb2S3。斜方晶系。中国湖南冷水江市锑矿山是世 界著名产地。
explanation_en: A simple chain structured sulfide mineral with the chemical formula Sb2S3. Orthorhombic crystal system. The antimony mine in Lengshuijiang City, Hunan Province, China is a world-renowned production area.

explanation_cn: 一种基性侵入岩。主要矿物成分为单斜辉石（普通辉石和透辉石）和基性斜长石。两者含量接近。
explanation_en: A basic intrusive rock. The main mineral components are monoclinic pyroxene (ordinary pyroxene and diopside) and basic plagioclase. The content of both is close.

explanation_cn: 稀土永磁粉末和黏结剂组成，在成形过程中通过磁场的作用或者借助机械取向效应，具有辐向取向的稀土永磁。取向成型是烧结和粘接磁体的重要工序。
explanation_en: Rare earth permanent magnetic powder is composed of adhesive, which has radial orientation through the role of magnetic field or mechanical orientation effect in the forming process. Orientation molding is an important process for sintering and bonding magnets.

explanation_cn: 化合物因射线的照射而分解的现象。水及有机物作为反应堆冷却剂、慢化剂或屏蔽材料时，会出现辐射分解现象。影响辐射分解反应速度、逆反应速度和分解产物浓度的因素有射线的辐照剂量、射线种类、温度、溶质的形态和浓度等。有些杂质离子会加速辐射分解。为抑制水的辐射分解，可预先加入少量的氢，或者对冷却剂进行连续净化。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of compound decomposition due to radiation. When water and organics are used as reactor coolant, moderator or shielding materials, mdidysis will occur. The factors affecting the reaction rate, reverse reaction rate and the concentration of mdidysis products include the radiation dose, radiation type, temperature, solute morphology and concentration, etc. Some impurity ions will accelerate mdidysis. In order to inhibit the mdidysis of water, a small amount of hydrogen can be added in advance, or the coolant can be continuously purified.

explanation_cn: 用电离辐射作用于物质，使其品质和性能得以改善的一种技术。又称辐射处理。加工过程是把待加工的物质置于辐射源发出的射线场中，接收一定剂量的照射。影响辐射加工的主要因素是射线种类、能量、束流强度和剂量。
explanation_en: A technique in which ionizing radiation is applied to a substance to improve its quality and performance. Also known as radiation treatment. The processing process involves placing the substance to be processed in a radiation field emitted by a radiation source and receiving a certain dose of radiation. The main factors affecting radiation process are the type of radiation, energy, beam intensity and dose.

explanation_cn: 指以能量照射源为能源，引发具有化学活性的树脂体系产生化学反应，实现树脂体系由液态转化为三维网状结构（同态）的加工过程。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of taking energy irradiation source as energy source to initiate chemical reaction of chemically active resin system and realize the transformation of resin system from liquid to three-dimensional network structure (homomorphic).

explanation_cn: 半导体中以光辐射方式释放能量的电子和空穴的复合。对于直接禁带半导体，载流子的直接复合就是辐射复合，高亮度发光二极管和激光二极管就是基于这种复合方式。
explanation_en: Composition of electrons and holes in semiconductors that release energy in the form of light radiation. For direct bandgap semiconductor, direct recombination of carriers is radiative recombination, and high brightness luminescence diodes and laser diodes are based on this composition mode.

name_cn: 辐射屏蔽功能复合材料
explanation_cn: 由吸收放射性射线、粒子的材料与基体复合的或再用增强体与上述材料进行复合的复合材料。
explanation_en: A materials that absorbs radioactive rays and particles and composition with matrix, or a composite materials that composition with the above materials using reinforcement.

explanation_cn: 材料的物理化学性质因受电离辐射的照射而引起的有害变化，引起变化的原因是具有一定能量的入射粒子（γ射线，电子、质子、离子、中子等）和材料中的原子发生弹性碰撞、非弹性碰撞、核反应，产生空位和间隙原子、激发和电离及异种原子等。
explanation_en: Harmful changes in physical chemistry properties of materials caused by exposure to ionizing radiation are caused by incident particles with certain energy（ γ Ray, electron, proton, ion, neutron, etc.) and atoms in materials, elasticity collision, non elasticity collision, nuclear reaction, vacancy and interstitial atoms, excitation and ionization, heterogeneous atoms, etc.

explanation_cn: 表征材料在温度T下热辐射能力的物理量。材料在一定温度下、单位时间内、单位表面积的热辐射强度为热辐射功率。辐射率定义为在一定温度下该材料的热辐射功率与相同温度下黑体热辐射功率之比。
explanation_en: The physical quantity characterizing the thermal radiation ability of materials at temperature T. The thermal radiation intensity of materials in a certain temperature, unit time and unit surface area is the thermal radiation power. The emittance is defined as the ratio of the thermal radiation power of the materials at a certain temperature to the thermal radiation power of the blackbody at the same temperature.

explanation_cn: 为研究材料在粒子作用下发生的结构和性能变化及其变化规律而进行的。
explanation_en: It is conducted to study the structure and property changes of materials under the action of particles and their changing rules.

explanation_cn: 材料因辐照引起形状改变而无明显的体积改变的现象，常发生在核燃料的被覆材料和结构元件（如压力管和排管）中。辐照生长常发生在对称性低的晶体中，被中子等击出晶格节点的原子，在某一晶向上择优重新进入晶体的点阵节点，使晶体在该方向生长，而在其他晶向收缩。
explanation_en: The materials has no obvious volume change due to the shape change caused by irradiation, which often occurs in the nuclear fuel coating materials and structural elements (such as pressure tube and calandria). Irradiation growth often occurs in crystal with low symmetry. Atoms knocked out of lattice nodes by neutrons, etc., preferentially re-enter lattice nodes of crystal in a certain crystal direction, so that crystal grow in this direction and contract in other crystal directions.

explanation_cn: 材料在辐照条件下体积增加的现象。在燃料中，易裂变核裂变后，产生两个或两个以上的裂变碎片（原子），其体积大于易裂变原子的体积，引起燃料体积的增加。
explanation_en: The phenomenon that the volume of materials increases under irradiation. In the fuel, two or more fission fragments (atoms) are produced after the fissile nuclear fission, whose volume is larger than the volume of the fissile atoms, causing the increase of the fuel volume.

explanation_cn: 辐照引起金属材料伸长率和冲击韧性下降，脆-塑性转变温度提高的现象。中子辐照引起晶体点阵损伤，产生空位和间隙原子。
explanation_en: Irradiation causes the elongation and impact toughness of metallic materials to decrease, and the brittle plastic transformation temperature to increase. Neutron irradiation causes lattice damage of crystal, resulting in vacancy and interstitial atoms.

explanation_cn: 辐照引起的螺变速率增加的现象。外应力不变，材料的应变随时间增加的蠕变现象，但在辐照条件下，这一现象可以在低得多的温度下进行。其机制是辐照在材料中产生各种缺陷，如空位、间隙原子和原子团、位错等。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of increased spiral transformation rate caused by irradiation. The creep phenomenon that the strain of materials increases with time when the external stress is constant, but under the irradiation condition, this phenomenon can be carried out at a much lower temperature. The mechanism is that irradiation produces various defects in materials, such as vacancy, interstitial atoms and clusters, dislocation, etc.

explanation_cn: 聚合物在高能射线作用下发生的降解。
explanation_en: Degradation of polymer under the action of high-energy rays.

explanation_cn: 指在单位时间内输出能量数的能力。它在数值上等于输出电流和输出电压V的乘积;单位电池的内阻越小，输出功率越高。通常.电池的内阻应小于用电器的内阻,否则电池本身消耗的功率还要大于用电器消耗的功率，这是不经济的，而且可能损坏电池。在额定电压条件下电池的输出功率随电极表面积的增大和工作温度的上升而上升，反之亦然。
explanation_en: The ability to output energy per unit time. It is numerically equal to the product of output current and output voltage V; The smaller the internal resistance of the unit internal resistance of the battery, the higher the output power. Generally, the internal resistance of the internal resistance of the battery should be less than that of the electrical appliance, otherwise the power consumed by the battery itself will be greater than that consumed by the electrical appliance, which is uneconomical and may damage the battery. Under rated voltage, the output power of the battery increases with the increase of electrode surface area and operating temperature, and vice versa.

explanation_cn: 辽代生产的低温彩色釉陶制品。受唐三彩的影响，辽代也烧这类品种。辽三彩多用黄绿白三色釉。器形中的方碟、海棠花式长盘、鸡冠壶、筒式瓶等，富有契丹民族风格。装饰手法有印花、划花两种。大凡盘、碟采用阳文印花；琢器采用划花，与唐三彩的区别除胎质较粗糙外，主要是辽三彩无蓝色。釉不交融，釉面不平，表面常有突起的砂粒，釉面少流淌、光泽差，釉色不够鲜艳。
explanation_en: Low temperature colored glazed pottery produced in the Liao Dynasty. Under the influence of Tang sancai, the Liao Dynasty also burned such varieties. Liao sancai mostly uses yellow green white glaze. The square dishes, crabapple shaped long plates, cockscomb pots, and barrel shaped bottles in the shape of the vessel are rich in the Khitan ethnic style. There are two types of decorative techniques: printing and scratching. Da Fan Pan and Dish are printed in Japanese characters; The carving tool uses cut patterns. The difference between the Tang sancai and the Liao Sancai is that the Liao Sancai is not blue, except for its rough texture. The glaze does not blend, the glaze surface is uneven, the surface often has protruding sand particles, the glaze surface is less flowing, the gloss is poor, and the glaze color is not bright enough.

explanation_cn: 是MBE(分子朿外延）的一种衍生技术，其主要差别是参与外延生长的分子（原子）束。MEE的优点的是可实现低温外延和获得十分平整的表面和界面。以GaAs外延生长为例，吸附于GaAs衬底表面的镓原子在MEE时是以原子状态在表面迁移。而在MBE时是与同时到达的砷结合成GaAs分子在表面迁移，前者的迁移速率快得多，只需200-300°C的生长温度，Ga原子就能有足够的能量迁移到合适的生长位置上去，生长出高质量的GaAs薄膜材料和AlAs/GaAs量子阱材料。当在一个脉冲周期白到达GaAs表面的Ga原子数等于或接近于表面上的Ga格位数时，到达的Ga原子在表面展开形成一个单原子层Ga，下一个脉冲来的砷分子与其反应形成一个新的GaAs分子层，重复这样的过程则能实现一个分子层接一个分子层的外延生长，获得平整的表面。
explanation_en: It is a derivative technology of MBE (molecular beam epitaxy), the main difference is the molecular (atomic) beam involved in epitaxial growth. The advantage of MEE is that it can achieve low-temperature epitaxy and obtain very flat surfaces and interfaces. Taking epitaxial growth of GaAs as an example, gallium atoms adsorbed on the surface of GaAs substrate migrate on the surface as atoms during MEE. In MBE, GaAs molecules are migrated on the surface with the arsenic junction synthesized at the same time. The migration rate of the former is much faster. With the growth temperature of 200-300 ° C, Ga atoms can have enough energy to migrate to the appropriate growth position to grow high-quality GaAs film materials and AlAs/GaAs quantum well materials. When the number of Ga atoms arriving on the GaAs surface in a pulse period is equal to or close to the number of Ga lattice sites on the surface, the arriving Ga atoms expand on the surface to form a single atomic layer of Ga, and the arsenic molecules coming from the next pulse react with it to form a new GaAs molecular layer. Repeat this process to achieve epitaxial growth of one molecular layer after another to obtain a flat surface.

explanation_cn: 是载流子（电子和空穴）在单位电场作用下的平均漂移速度。迁移率与载流子的有效质量成反比。
explanation_en: It is the average drift velocity of charge carriers (electrons and holes) under the action of a unit electric field. The mobility is inversely proportional to the effective mass of the carrier.

explanation_cn: 化学成分超过共析成分的钢。非合金过共析钢为碳含量大于0.77%的钢。室温平衡组织为先共析渗碳体加珠光体。。
explanation_en: Steel whose chemical composition exceeds eutectoid composition. Non alloy hypereutectoid steel is a steel with a carbon content greater than 0.77%. The equilibrium structure at room temperature is proeutectoid carburizing plus pearlite..

explanation_cn: 熔融金属平衡状态下的相变温度与实际相变温度的差值。纯金属的过冷度等于其熔点与实际结晶温度的差值，合金的过冷度等于其相图中液相线温度与实际结晶温度的差值。
explanation_en: The difference between the phase transformation temperature of molten metal in equilibrium and the actual phase transformation temperature. The degree of under cooling of a pure metal is equal to the difference between its melting point and the actual crystallization temperature, and the degree of under cooling of a alloy is equal to the difference between the liquidus temperature in its phase diagram and the actual crystallization temperature.

explanation_cn: 淬冷时效过程中，对确定的合金系，在确定的温度下保温确定的时间可以获得最为细小弥散分布的沉淀相颗粒从而获得强度和硬度的峰值。当时效温度偏低或保温时间过短时，由于沉淀相过程不充分，强度和硬度尚未达到峰值，称为欠时效，由于尚未达到时效效果，其性能和工件尺寸均不稳定，故很少采用。当时效温度偏高或保温时间过长时，由于沉淀相颗粒尺寸增大，导致强度和硬度从峰值下降，则称为过时效。合适的过时效处理可在保证强度和硬度下降甚微的条件下使塑性和韧性明显回升，对性能稳定性要求较高时采用过时效处理。
explanation_en: In the process of quench aging, for the determined alloy system, the most fine precipitation phase particles with dispersion distribution can be obtained by holding at the determined temperature for the determined time, thus obtaining the peak values of strength and hardness. When the aging temperature is low or the holding time is too short, due to the insufficient precipitation phase process, the strength and hardness have not reached the peak value, it is called under aging. Since the aging effect has not been reached, its performance and workpiece size are unstable, so it is rarely used. When the aging temperature is too high or the holding time is too long, the strength and hardness decrease from the peak value due to the increase of precipitation phase particle size, which is called over aging. Appropriate over aging treatment can significantly increase the plasticity and toughness under the condition that the strength and hardness decrease slightly, and over aging treatment is adopted when the requirements for performance stability are high.

explanation_cn: 含有过氧基(-O-O-)的一类化合物，受热后过氧基键断裂，分裂成两个相应的自由基，用于引发自由基聚合的化合物。过氧化物引发剂分解属单分子一级反应。氧上取代基的结构、单体和溶剂种类直接影响引发剂的活性。过氧化物引发剂分无机过氧化合物和有机过氧化合物两类。无机过氧化物引发剂有过氧化氢、过硫酸铵、过硫酸钾等，可溶于水，用作水溶液聚合、乳液聚合；有机过氧化物引发剂有过氧化苯甲酰、过氧化苯甲酰叔丁酯、过氧化甲乙酮等，可溶于有机溶剂中.是油溶性过氧化物，可引发不饱和聚酯聚合、橡胶的硫化、氯乙稀、苯乙烯等婦类单体的聚合。
explanation_en: A class of compounds containing peroxy group (- O-O -). When heated, the peroxy bond fracture and splits into two corresponding free radicals, which are used to initiate free radical polymerization. The decomposition of peroxide initiator belongs to single molecule first order reaction. The structure of oxygen substituent, monomer and solvent type directly affect the activity of initiator. Peroxide initiators are divided into two categories: inorganic peroxides and organic peroxides. Inorganic peroxide initiator include hydrogen peroxide, ammonium persulfate, potassium persulfate, etc., which are soluble in water and used for aqueous polymerization and emulsion polymerization; Organic peroxide initiator include benzoyl peroxide, tert butyl benzoyl peroxide, methyl ethyl peroxide, etc., which are soluble in organic solvents. They are oil soluble peroxides, which can initiate polymerization of unsaturated polyester, vulcanization of rubber, polymerization of monomer such as vinyl chloride and styrene.

explanation_cn: 是聚氯乙烯在溶剂氯笨或四氯乙烷中经不同的工艺路线氯化而制得的。相对密度（20°C)为1.6。其碳链上每间隔6个碳原子的氢有一个被氯取代。溶于丙酮、醋酸酯类、二氯乙烷、氯笨等溶剂，但不溶于汽油和醇类。其黏度决定于所用聚氯乙烯的分子量.分子量愈大，氯化后的树脂黏度愈高。高黏度的过氯乙烯主要是供抽丝之用.即氯纶纤维。中低分子量的由于有良好的电绝缘性、热塑性和成膜性，化学性能极为稳定，耐腐蚀.耐水.不易燃烧，主要用来制造各种过氯乙烯漆。
explanation_en: It is prepared by chlorination of polyvinyl chloride in solvent chlorobenzene or tetrachloroethane through different process routes. The relative density (20 ° C) is 1.6. One hydrogen atom on its carbon chain with a spacing of 6 carbon atoms is replaced by chlorine. Soluble in solvents such as acetone, acetate, dichloroethane, and chlorobenzene, but insoluble in gasoline and alcohols. Its viscosity depends on the molecular weight of polyvinyl chloride used. The larger the molecular weight, the higher the viscosity of chlorinated resin. The high viscosity perchloroethylene is mainly used for spinning, namely, the chlorine fiber. Due to good electrical insulation, thermoplasticity and film-forming properties, the medium and low molecular weight ones have extremely stable chemical properties, corrosion resistance, water resistance and are difficult to combustion. They are mainly used to manufacture various perchloroethylene paints.

explanation_cn: 为了解决烟火药型主装药难以被点燃的问题，在引燃剂/点火药和主装药之间增加过渡药（用以可靠地传递、扩展引燃剂的火焰并引燃主装药）。过渡药一般由引燃剂与主装药按一定的比例均匀混合而成，二者的比例通常为1:1.
explanation_en: In order to solve the problem that the main charge of pyrotechnic charge is difficult to ignite, intermediate charge is added between the igniter/ignition composition and the main charge (to reliably transmit and expand the flame of the igniter and ignite the main charge). The intermediate charge is generally composed of the igniter and the main charge in a certain proportion, which is usually 1:1

explanation_cn: 由元素周期表的IV-VIII族的过渡金属化合物组成的催化剂。如齐格勒-纳塔型催化剂是定向聚合的特效催化剂。
explanation_en: A catalyst composed of transition metal compounds in the IV-VIII group of the periodic table. For example, Ziegler Natta catalyst is a special catalyst for directional polymerization.

name_cn: 过渡金属氧化物低温催化材料
explanation_cn: 过渡金属氧化物催化材料可用于CO和烃类的低温催化氧化，可分为负载型和非负载型过渡金属氧化物催化材料。
explanation_en: Transition metal oxide can be used for the low-temperature catalytic oxidation of CO and hydrocarbons, and can be divided into supported and unsupported transition metal oxide.

explanation_cn: 是指金属和陶瓷粉体在烧结过程中烧结温度过高或烧结时间过长致使产品最终性能恶化的现象。制品除了易变形、尺寸不符合要求，还会出现过热组织、晶粒粗大、晶界氧化等现象。所以烧结时应严格控制烧结温度和烧结时间；是指金属及合金在热加工及热处理过程中由于温度显著偏高接近其固相线温度而发生晶界硬化或部分熔化的现象。过烧首先发生在晶界处是由于晶界能量高于晶内因而易于发生硬化和熔化，过烧使金属及合金的性能严重恶化，且不能采用热加工方法恢复，故只能报废。
explanation_en: It refers to the phenomenon that the final performance of metal and ceramic powders deteriorates due to excessively high sintering temperature or excessively long sintering time during the sintering process. In addition to being easy to deform, the size of the product does not meet the requirements, overheating structure, coarse grains, grain boundary oxidation and other phenomena will also occur. So sintering should strictly control sintering temperature and sintering time; It refers to the phenomenon of grain boundary hardening or partial melting of metals and alloy during hot working and heat treatment because the temperature is significantly higher than its solidus temperature. Oversintering/over- burning first occurs at the grain boundary because the grain boundary energy is higher than that in the grain, which is easy to harden and melt. oversintering/over- burning seriously deteriorates the properties of metals and alloy, and cannot be recovered by hot working, so it can only be scrapped.

explanation_cn: 金属及合金在热加工及热处理过程中由于温度偏高致使晶粒过分长大的现象。过热将使金属材料的塑性降低、軔性显著下降，必须避免发生。对具有固态多形性相变的金属及合金发生过热后，可通过再次加热与冷却循环，使之发生重结晶而使晶粒细化。对于无固态多形性相变的金属及合金如铝、镁、铜基合金及高合金的奥氏体钢或铁素体钢，则只能通过冷变形后的再结晶来消除过热晶粒组织。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of excessive grain growth of metals and alloy due to high temperature during hot working and heat treatment. Overheating will reduce the plasticity and toughness of metallic materials, which must be avoided. After overheating occurs to metals and alloy with solid polymorphic phase transformation, recrystallization can occur through reheating and cooling cycles to refine the grains. For metals and alloy without solid polymorphic phase transformation, such as aluminum, magnesium, copper base alloy, and high alloy austenitic steel or ferritic steel, the overheating grain structure can only be eliminated through recrystallization after cold deformation.

explanation_cn: 通过分子中的过硫酸根受热分解生成阴离子自由基的水溶性A由基聚合的化合物。过硫酸盐引发剂因溶于水，多用于乳液和水溶液聚合反应，如过硫酸钾、过硫酸钠、过硫酸铵。
explanation_en: The water-soluble A of anion free radical is generated by thermal decomposition of persulfate radical in the molecule, which is a compound polymerized by radical. As persulfate initiator is soluble in water, it is often used for polymerization of lotion and aqueous solution, such as potassium persulfate, sodium persulfate, and ammonium persulfate.

explanation_cn: 过饱和溶液中实际溶质浓度和平衡溶质浓度的差值与溶解度的比值，亦即超过饱和度的那一部分溶质的质量与饱和度的比，表示了溶液的过饱和程度。
explanation_en: The ratio of the difference between the actual solute concentration and the equilibrium solute concentration in the supersaturated solution and the water solubility, that is, the ratio of the mass of the solute exceeding the saturation to the saturation, indicates the supersaturation degree of the solution.

explanation_cn: 迈斯纳效应描述的是超导体内部在超导状态下对于外部磁场的排斥现象。该效应由德国物理学家迈斯纳(W.Meissner)和奥森菲尔德(R.Ochsenfdd)于1933年在测量超导状态下金属锡和铅样品外部磁场分布情况时发现。迈斯纳等人的实验结果表明:对于第1类超导体来说，无论是先降温后加磁场还是先加磁场后降温，在超导状态下样品内部的磁通最后总是为零，实现完全的磁通排斥。迈斯纳效应表明超导体除了是理想导体外，还是完全抗磁体。迈斯纳效应的发现直接导致了超导体唯象理论的诞生。关于迈斯纳效应产生的原因可简单解释如下:在磁场环境中，处于超导状态下超导体表面会产生一个无损耗的感应电流。该感应电流产生的磁场正好与外部磁场大小相等、方向相反，从而导致超导体内部的磁场强度总合为零。因此，迈斯纳效应是在超导体表面一定厚度下出现的现象，该厚度称为磁场穿透厚度。零电阻现象和迈斯纳效应是超导体在超导状态下的两个相互独立又相互关联的基本属性，迈斯纳效应常被用来作为判别物质是否具有超导性的一个重要依据。
explanation_en: The Meissner effect describes the repulsion of the external magnetic field by the superconductor in the superconducting state. This effect was discovered by German physicists W. Meissner and R. Ochsenfdd in 1933 when they measured the external magnetic field distribution of metal tin and lead samples in the superconducting state. The experimental results of Meisner et al. show that for the first type of superconductor, whether it is cooling before applying a magnetic field or cooling after applying a magnetic field, the magnetic flux inside the sample always ends up zero in the superconducting state, achieving complete magnetic flux repulsion. The Meissner effect shows that superconductors are completely diamagnetic in addition to ideal conductors. The discovery of the Meissner effect directly led to the birth of the phenomenological theory of superconductors. The reason for the Meissner effect can be simply explained as follows: in the magnetic field environment, a lossless induced current will be generated on the surface of the superconductor in the superconducting state. The magnetic field generated by this induced current is exactly the same size and opposite direction as the external magnetic field, resulting in a total zero magnetic field intensity inside the superconductor. Therefore, the Meissner effect is a phenomenon that occurs at a certain thickness of the superconductor surface, which is called the magnetic field penetration thickness. The zero resisitivity effect and the Meissner effect are two independent and interrelated basic attributes of superconductors in the superconducting state. The Meissner effect is often used as an important basis for judging whether a substance has superconductivity.

explanation_cn: 沿分子链近距离（一般不超过10个化学键）的原子或基团之间的空间相互作用。
explanation_en: The spatial interaction between atoms or groups located close together along a molecular chain (usually no more than 10 chemical bonds).

explanation_cn: 又称短程结构或高分子的一级结构。主要指高分子结构单元的化学组成、分子构型、链的支化和交联结构以及共聚物的组成和序列分布。近程结构从根本上影响着高分子的物理性质和化学性质，对高分子性质的影响最直接。其中受影响较大的一些性质包括：反应性、溶解性、密度、黏度、黏附性、玻璃化温度等。
explanation_en: It is also called short range structure or the primary structure of the primary structure of polymers. It mainly refers to the chemical composition, molecular configuration, chain branching and crosslinking structure of the structural unit of macromolecule, and the composition and sequence distribution of copolymer. Short-range structure fundamentally affects the physical and chemical properties of macromolecule, and most directly affects the properties of macromolecule. Some properties that are greatly affected include reactivity, solubility, density, viscosity, adhesion, glass transition temperature, etc.

explanation_cn: 近终形加工是指以接近最终产品尺寸和形状进行加工的方式。以 近终形连铸为例.即是力求浇铸尽可能接近最终产品 尺寸的铸坯.以便减少中间加工工序.节省能源、减少储存和缩短生产时间。
explanation_en: Near net-shape forming refers to the processing method that is close to the size and shape of the final product. Take near net shape continuous casting as an example, that is, try to casting the billet as close as possible to the final product size, so as to reduce intermediate processing procedures, save energy, reduce storage and shorten production time.

explanation_cn: 近藤绝缘体是拥有强关联电子的小能带间隙半导体材料，这类材料能带间隙的形成是由于局域化的f电子能级与导带的微弱杂化。近藤绝缘体也称为近藤半导体（Kondo semi- conductors)或重费米子半导体（heavy fermion semiconductors) > 参见重费米子。
explanation_en: Kondo insulator is a small band gap semiconductor materials with strongly correlated electrons. The formation of band gap of this kind of materials is due to the weak hybridization of localized f electron energy level and conduction band. Kondo insulator is also called Kondo semi conductors or heavy fermion semiconductor>see heavy fermion.

explanation_cn: 利用还原剂还原氧化物及相应盐类获得金属粉末的粉末制取方法。还原法在制粉过程中用得最广，产品种类也最多，如铁粉、铜粉、镍粉等。
explanation_en: A method for preparing metal powder by reducing oxides and corresponding salts with reducing agents. The reduction method is most widely used in the powder making process and has the most types of products, such as iron powder, copper powder, nickel powder, etc.

explanation_cn: 通过还原剂还原金属氧化物及盐类等制备得到的粉末。工业上的还原常指还原剂夺取氧化物或盐类中的氧（或酸根），使阳离子 转变成金属元素或低价氧化物（低价盐）的过程。
explanation_en: Powder prepared by reducing metal oxides and salts with reducing agent. Industrial reduction often refers to the process in which reducing agents capture the oxygen (or acid radical) in oxides or salts, and make cations transformation into metal elements or low valent oxides (low valent salts).

explanation_cn: 用气、固体还原剂还原氧化铁所得的纯铁粉,还原铁粉的原料有铁精 矿、轧钢铁磷和含铁盐类等。还原法成本低，原料来源充分，适合于大型生产。
explanation_en: Pure iron powder obtained by reducing iron oxide with gas and solid reducing agent. Raw materials of reduced iron powder include iron concentrate, steel rolling iron phosphorus and iron salts. The reduction method has low cost and sufficient sources of raw materials, making it suitable for large-scale production.

explanation_cn: 因柔性高分子链弯曲所导致的沿分子链远距离的原子或基团之间的空间的相互作用。
explanation_en: The spatial interaction between atoms or groups at a distance along the molecular chain caused by the bending of flexible macromolecule chains.

explanation_cn: 又称长程结构或高分子的二级结构。主要指高分子单链或多链或更大尺度上的结构。研究的是整个高分子链的大小和形状。高分子链的大小一般用分子量来表示，高分子链形状一般有伸直链结构、折叠链结构、无规线团结构等。是高分子特有的结构（小分子不存在），高分子的影响着高分子链的柔性，致使高分子有高弹性。
explanation_en: Also called long-range order or the secondary structure of polymers. It mainly refers to the single chain or multi chain or larger scale structure of macromolecule. The size and shape of the entire macromolecule chain are studied. The size of macromolecule chain is generally expressed by molecular weight. The shape of macromolecule chain generally includes extended chain structure, folded chain structure, random coil structure, etc. It is a unique structure of macromolecule (small molecules do not exist). macromolecule affects the flexibility of macromolecule chain, resulting in high elasticity of macromolecule.

explanation_cn: 介入治疗前放于狭窄部位远端，由金属丝编制的固定在导丝上的过滤网。用于阻止脱落斑块通过，避免发生栓塞。远端保护装置首先运用于颈动脉支架术，一般血栓抽吸和是配套的、相辅相成的，从功能上可以分为远端滤过型、远端阻塞型、近端阻塞型和血栓抽吸型。①远端滤过型。包括一个非阻塞型过滤网，形似风向袋，套着一个镍钛诺圈，并固定在其导丝上，该装置可以通过3.2F释放鞘释放。镍钛诺圈可以根据血管直径自己膨胀到直径3.5-5.5mm，并且可以沿着导丝完成介入手术。最后，采用4F回收鞘回收装置。②远端阻塞型。由一根远端连接球囊的导丝和15F的抽吸管组成，导丝外径0.014in，与外径0.028in球囊相通。手术时，充盈阻塞球后，使用抽吸管由近到远抽吸6次，然后使用PCI球囊预扩张病变组织并植人支架，或者抽吸后直接植人支架。再次使用抽吸导管由远至近抽吸后去充盈阻塞球囊。③近端阻塞型。这个系统由在狭窄上游阻断血流以便进行介入手术的球囊构成。在任何器械通过病变区时该装置都可以起到保护的作用。④血栓抽吸型。在其保护腔内有一个1.5mm或者2.0mm的不锈钢螺旋切割刀，该保护连接到4.5mm或者5.5mm双孔导管上，其中一个为导丝孔，另一个为真空/抽吸孔。该导管连接到手提控制器和收集碎屑的真空瓶上。开动控制器即启动螺旋切割刀，后者伸出保护腔，开始切割并且启动真空抽吸。
explanation_en: A filter screen made of metal wire and fixed on the guide wire is placed at the distal end of the stenosis site before interventional treatment. Used to prevent the passage of detached plaques and prevent embolism. The distal protective device is first used in carotid artery stenting surgery, and generally thrombus aspiration is a matching and complementary device. It can be functionally divided into distal filtration type, distal obstruction type, proximal obstruction type, and thrombus aspiration type Distal filtration type. It includes a non blocking filter screen, which is shaped like a wind bag, is covered with a nickel titanium nore ring and fixed on its guide wire. The device can be released through the 3.2F release sheath. Nitinol ring can expand to 3.5-5.5mm according to the diameter of blood vessels, and can complete interventional surgery along the guide wire. Finally, use a 4F sheath recycling device. ② Distal obstruction type. It is composed of a guide wire connected to the balloon at the far end and a 15F suction tube. The outer diameter of the guide wire is 0.014in, which is connected to the balloon with an outer diameter of 0.028in. During surgery, after filling the obstruction ball, use a suction tube to aspirate from near to far for 6 times, and then use a PCI balloon to pre expand the lesion tissue and implant it into a stem, or directly implant it into a stem after suction. Use the suction catheter again to aspirate from far to near and then fill the blocked balloon. ③ Near end blockage type. This system consists of a balloon that blocks blood flow upstream of the stenosis for interventional surgery. This device can provide protection when any device passes through the lesion area. ④ Thrombotic suction type. There is a 1.5mm or 2.0mm stainless steel spiral cutter in its protection cavity, and the protection is connected to a 4.5mm or 5.5mm double hole catheter, one of which is a guide hole, and the other is a vacuum/suction hole. The catheter is connected to a hand-held controller and a vacuum bottle for collecting debris. Activate the controller to activate the spiral cutting knife, which extends out of the protective chamber to start cutting and initiate vacuum suction.

explanation_cn: 在金属基材上覆盖一层远红外辐射物质，加热时能辐射出远红外线的搪瓷。
explanation_en: The metal substrate is covered with a layer of far-infrared radiation material, which can radiate far-infrared enamel when heated.

explanation_en: The model has no intrinsic scale.

explanation_cn: 在沉淀相形核长大过程中，由基体中出现的成分梯度引起的扩散连续地降低过饱和固溶体中的溶质浓度，一直达到饱和，沉淀过程停止，固溶体的晶体结构与取向皆保持不变，只是成分由过饱和变为饱和。
explanation_en: During the nucleation and growth of the precipitation phase, the diffusion caused by the composition gradient in the matrix continuously reduces the solute concentration in the supersaturated solid solution until it reaches saturation, and the precipitation process stops. The crystal structure and orientation of the solid solution remain unchanged, but the composition changes from supersaturation to saturation.

explanation_cn: 不分炉次地将原料(铁水、废钢)从炉子一端不断地加入，将成品(钢水)从炉子的另一端不断地流出的炼钢方法。具有设备简单、工艺过程简单、生产质量稳定等潜在优点，很多国家进行了各种方法的试验研究，其中主要有槽式法、喷雾法和泡沫法等，但尚未投入工业化生产。
explanation_en: It is a steelmaking method that raw materials (molten iron, scrap steel) are continuously added from one end of the furnace and finished products (molten steel) are continuously discharged from the other end of the furnace, regardless of the number of heats. With the potential advantages of simple equipment, simple process and stable production quality, many countries have carried out experimental research on various methods, including trough method, spray method and foam method, but they have not yet been put into industrial production.

explanation_cn: 见二级相变。
explanation_en: See second-order transformation.

explanation_cn: 连续硫化法是一种动态硫化法，是指将未硫化的橡胶半成品从硫化装置的一端装入后，接着使之连续移动，最后从另一端顺次获得硫化制品的工艺方法。常见的连续硫化工艺包括热空气连续硫化法、硫化室硫化法、蒸汽管道连续硫化法、液体介质连续硫化法、沸腾床连续硫化法、硫化鼓连续硫化法、红外线硫化法以及高频和微波硫化法。大批量生产的各类密封条，胶管、电线电缆、胶带等制品，在其制造工艺过程中采取连续硫化的工艺。这种工艺的特点是随着制品的连续成形的同时对半成品进行连续硫化，优点是制品的成形和硫化不受制品长度的限制，无重复硫化，并且可对其进行连续化、自动化生产。因此，这种硫化工艺方法自动化程度高、生产效率高。
explanation_en: Continuous vulcanization is a dynamic vulcanization method, which refers to the process method of loading the non vulcanization rubber semi-finished products from one end of the vulcanization device, then making them move continuously, and finally obtaining vulcanization products from the other end in sequence. Common continuous vulcanization processes include hot air continuous vulcanization, vulcanization chamber vulcanization, steam pipe continuous vulcanization, liquid medium continuous vulcanization, fluidized bed continuous vulcanization, vulcanization drum continuous vulcanization, infrared vulcanization, and high-frequency and microwave vulcanization. Continuous vulcanization process is adopted in the manufacturing process of all kinds of sealing strips, rubber hoses, wires and cables, adhesive tapes and other products produced in large quantities. This process is characterized by continuous vulcanization of semi-finished products along with the continuous forming of products. Its advantages are that the forming and vulcanization of products are not limited by the length of products, there is no repeated vulcanization, and it can be continuously and automatically produced. Therefore, this vulcanization process method has a high degree of automation and production efficiency.

explanation_cn: 长径比足够大(一般大于1000)、能够实现沿长度方向起不间断增强效应的纤维材料，常用的有玻璃纤维和碳纤维。由于纤维连续，通过合理设计能够使纤维力学性能得到充分发挥。
explanation_en: Fiber materials with long diameter ratio large enough (generally greater than 1000) to achieve continuous reinforcement along the length direction are commonly used as glass fiber and carbon fiber. Due to the continuous nature of the fibers, reasonable design can fully utilize their mechanical properties.

name_cn: 连续纤维增强金属基复合材料
name_en: continuous fiber reinforced metal matrix composite
explanation_cn: 以连续长纤维增强的以金属或合金为基体的复合材料。常用的连续纤维有硼纤维、先驱体法碳化硅纤维、CVD碳化硅纤维、碳纤维、氧化铝纤维等。常用的基体有铝、锌、钛、镁、镍、铜及其合金、金属间化合物等。连续纤维大多数情况下作为承载组分，具有高强度、高模量、低密度的特点，而金属基体主要起黏结纤维、传递载荷、部分承载的作用，大都选用工艺性能(塑性、铸造性能)较好的合金，且一般不作热处理。由于性能优良的连续纤维加入，使得复合材料具有轻质，比强度、比模量高，耐磨性强，耐高温性能好，导电、导热性好，抗疲劳，抗老化等优良的综合性能。然而，连续纤维增强金属基复合材料性能的各向异性却是十分显著的，各向异性的程度取决于纤维的分布和方向。制造工艺主要有热压扩散结合、液态渗透，并常用喷涂的方法制成预制条带或用连续铸造的方法制成预制丝，供热压使用。由于工艺温度高，因此防止与减少纤维与基体之间的有害反应，以避免产生性能上的损失，是金属基复合材料复合工艺中的关键问题。应用对象主要是航空、航天飞行器和发动机、军工产品等某些受力与耐热构件等。由于原料昂贵、工艺复杂，成本较高，应用还不普遍。
explanation_en: A continuous long fiber reinforced composite materials based on metal or alloy. The commonly used continuous fibers include boron fibers, precursor silicon carbide fibers, CVD silicon carbide fibers, carbon fibers, alumina fibers, etc. The commonly used matrix are aluminum, zinc, titanium, magnesium, nickel, copper and their alloy, imermetallif compound, etc. In most cases, continuous fiber is used as a load-bearing component, which has the characteristics of high strength, high modulus and low density, while the metal matrix mainly plays the role of bonding fiber, load transfer and partial load-bearing. Most of them choose alloy with good process performance (plasticity, castability), and generally do not conduct heat treatment. Due to the addition of continuous fiber with excellent performance, composite materials has light weight, high specific strength and specific modulus, strong wear resistance, good high temperature resistance, good conductivity, good thermal conductivity, fatigue resistance, aging resistance and other excellent comprehensive properties. However, the anisotropy of continuous fiber reinforced metal matrix composite is very significant, and the degree of anisotropy depends on the distribution and direction of fibers. The manufacturing process mainly includes hot pressing diffusion bonding, liquid infiltration, and commonly used spraying method to make prefabricated strips or continuous casting method to make prefabricated wires for hot pressing. Due to the high process temperature, preventing and reducing the harmful reaction between fiber and matrix to avoid the loss of performance is a key issue in the metal matrix composite composition process. The main application objects are certain load-bearing and heat-resistant components such as aviation, aerospace vehicles, engines, and military products. Due to expensive raw materials, complex processes, and high costs, its application is not yet widespread.

name_cn: 连续纤维增强镁基复合材料
name_en: continuous fiber reinforced magnesium matrix composite
explanation_cn: 利用高强度、高模量、低密度的碳(石墨)纤维、硼纤维、碳化硅纤维、氧化铝纤维等增强镁合金基体，通过基体合金、纤维类型、纤维排布方向、复合方式、体积分数的优化设计组合，可获得各种高性能复合材料。这类复合材料因纤维排布有方向性，其性能具有明显的各向异性，在沿纤维轴向上具有高强度、高模量等性能，而横向性能较差。由于要考虑纤维的排布、体积分数等，这类复合材料制造工艺复杂、难度大、成本高。
explanation_en: The magnesium alloy matrix is reinforced with high-strength, high modulus, low-density carbon (graphite) fiber, boron fiber, silicon carbide fiber, aluminum oxide fiber, etc. Through the optimized design combination of matrix alloy, fiber type, fiber layout direction, composition mode, and volume fraction, various high-performance composite materials can be obtained. This kind of composite materials has obvious anisotropy due to the directionality of fiber arrangement. It has high strength, high modulus and other properties along the fiber axis, but poor transverse properties. Due to the consideration of fiber arrangement, volume fraction, etc., the manufacturing process of such composite materials is complex, difficult and costly.

explanation_cn: 又称液轧，曾称无锭轧制。直接将液态金属"轧制"成半成品或成品的工艺。在这种工艺中，轧辊主要是起液态金属的结晶器作用，又有轧压作用，金属熔体在辊缝间完成凝固和热轧两个过程。它不同于连铸连轧工艺，后者是金属在连铸机的结晶器中凝固、在轧机中完成变形的工艺。液轧多用于生产铝、铜等有色金属或合金的带材、线坯和型材。连续铸轧可大幅度节约能源，如生产铜带比传统方法节能达90%，生产铝带可节能30%-50%;可明显提高金属收得率，用传统方法生产铜带的收得率为70%,而用液轧法则高达90%;同时，产品性能非常均匀。辊式液轧机能生产宽1600-2000mm、厚6-8mm的招板。连续铸轧的缺点是轧制速度低，生产能力小。钢铁材料的连续铸轧尚未取得重大进展。
explanation_en: Also called liquid rolling, it was called ingot free rolling. The process of directly "rolling" liquid metal into semi-finished products or finished products. In this process, the roll is mainly used as the mold of liquid metal, and also has the function of rolling and pressing. The metal melt completes solidification and hot rolling between roll gaps. It is different from the continuous casting and rolling process, which is a process in which metal solidifies in the mold of the continuous caster and completes deformation in the rolling mill. Liquid rolling is mainly used to produce strips, billets and profiles of non-ferrous metals or alloy such as aluminum and copper. Continuous casting rolling can greatly save energy, for example, the production of copper strip can save 90% of energy than the traditional method, and the production of aluminum strip can save 30% -50% of energy; It can significantly improve the metal yield, with a yield of 70% using traditional methods to produce copper strips, and up to 90% using liquid rolling method; At the same time, the product performance is very uniform. The roll hydraulic mill can produce signboard with width of 1600-2000mm and thickness of 6-8mm. The disadvantages of continuous casting rolling are low rolling speed and small production capacity. Continuous casting rolling of steel materials has not made significant progress.

explanation_cn: 将液态金属不断绕入结晶器(水冷金属型)中，液态金属结壳凝固过程中不断地从结晶器另一端拉出，从而获得具有很长长度的铸锭或铸件的方法，简称连铸。可大批量生产具有固定截面的各种铸管、方坯、板坯等。与模铸相比，其优点是金属收得率明显提高(理论上可接近100%)、生产工艺简化、铸锭质量好且均匀、劳动条件明显改善、便于实现机械化和自动化控制。
explanation_en: The method of continuously winding the liquid metal into the mold (water-cooled metal mold), and constantly pulling the liquid metal crust from the other end of the mold during solidification, so as to obtain ingots or castings with long length, referred to as continuous casting. It can produce various cast pipes, billets, slabs, etc. with fixed cross-sections in large quantities. Compared with mold casting, its advantages are that the metal yield is significantly improved (theoretically close to 100%), the production process is simplified, the ingot quality is good and uniform, the labor conditions are significantly improved, and it is easy to realize mechanization and automatic control.

explanation_cn: 由连续铸造得到的热金属坯直接送入连轧机组(其间可经过均热炉)进行连续轧制的先进生产工艺。其特点是生产效率高、节约能源、减少辅助设备。
explanation_en: The hot metal billet obtained by continuous casting is directly sent to the continuous rolling mill (which can pass through the soaking pit) for continuous rolling. Its characteristics are high production efficiency, energy conservation, and reduced auxiliary equipment.

explanation_cn: 使材料组织平衡均匀并软化的热处理工艺。一般通过将合金加热到高温保温均匀化，然后使之缓慢冷却，得到平衡组织，消除残余应力。钢铁材料根据退火加热温度和退火的不同而分为两大类：①加热保温温度高于AH或Ae3的退火.包括扩散退火、完全退火和球化退火等；②加热保温温度低于Ad临界温度的退火，包括软化退火、再结晶退火及去应力退火等。
explanation_en: Heat treatment process to make materials structure balanced and even and bating. Generally, alloy is heated to high temperature for heat preservation and homogenization, and then cooled slowly to obtain balanced structure and eliminate residual stress. Iron and steel materials can be divided into two categories according to the difference of annealing heating temperature and annealing: ① annealing with heating and holding temperature higher than AH or Ae3, including diffusion annealing, full annealing and spheroidizing annealing annealing; ② Annealing with heating and holding temperature lower than the critical temperature of Ad, including bating annealing, recrystallization annealing and stress-relief annealing.

explanation_cn: 是材料科学和金属学中的一个术语，指的是一种晶体缺陷或结构特征，通常出现在晶体材料中，特别是金属晶体。退火孪生是由材料经历退火过程（热处理）引起的，它表现为材料中出现孪生晶体，即晶格结构存在一定程度的镜像对称性。
explanation_en: It is a term in materials science and physical metallurgy, which refers to a crystal defect or structural feature, usually appearing in crystalline materials, especially metal crystal. Annealing twin is caused by materials undergoing annealing process (heat treatment), which is manifested by the appearance of twin crystal in materials, that is, the lattice structure has a certain degree of mirror symmetry.

explanation_cn: 又称活化期。原始包装的胶黏剂或涂料在开罐后可以使用的最长时间，或多组分分装的涂料相互混合后可以使用的最长时间。此项指标对于胶黏剂、涂料的施工性能及最终的固化产物性能都有重要影响。对同一树脂来说，适用期的长短随同化剂的种类、用量及固化温度的不同而异。在实际应用中应视不同的作业环境而调整
explanation_en: It is also called activation stage. The longest time that the original adhesive or coatings can be used after opening the can, or the longest time that multi-component sub packaged coatings can be used after mixing with each other. This index has an important impact on the workability of adhesive and coatings and the performance of the final curing product. For the same resin, the length of pot life varies with the type and amount of assimilating agent and curing temperature. In practical applications, adjustments should be made according to different operating environments

name_cn: 选择分离高分子复合材料
explanation_cn: 是由聚合物或高分子复合材料制得的具有分离流体混合物功能的复合材料。依据膜的选择透过性，将分离膜作间隔层，在压力差、浓度差或电位差的推动力下，借流体混合物中各组分透过膜的速率不同，使之在膜的两侧分别富集，以达到分离、精制、浓缩及回收利用的目的。单位时间内流体通过膜的量（透过速度）、不同物质透过系数之比(分离系数）或对某种物质的截留率是衡量膜性能的重要指标。
explanation_en: It is a composite materials with the function of separating fluid mixture, which is made of polymer or macromolecule composite materials. According to the selected permeability of the membrane, the membrane separation materials is used as the spacer layer. Under the driving force of pressure difference, concentration difference or potential difference, each component in the fluid mixture is enriched on both sides of the membrane by virtue of the different rate of penetration of the membrane, so as to achieve the purpose of separation, refining, concentration and recycling.
