The amount of fluid passing through the membrane per unit time (transmission rate), the ratio of different substances' transmission coefficients (separation coefficient), or the retention rate of a certain substance are important indicators for measuring membrane performance.

name_cn: 选择吸收型有色光学玻璃
explanation_cn: 在光谱透过曲线上具有一个或几个特征透过峰的有色光学玻璃。是照相机、电影、电视、光学仪器等工业的重要光学材料般是在原料中加人过渡金属离子着色剂熔制而成。玻璃的光谱特性主要决定于离子的价态和配位状态，玻璃的基础组成、熔炼温度、时间、气氛等对离子着色有重要作用。品种有黑色、紫色、蓝色、绿色、黄色、茶黄色及透紫外、透红外、防护、钬镨钕玻璃等。选择吸收型有色光学玻璃一般存在多峰、带通宽、后截止性能差等缺陷。近年来发展了一类带通窄，只有一个透过峰，滤光性能好的新型带通有色光学玻璃。
explanation_en: A filter glass with one or more characteristic transmission peaks on the spectral transmission curve. It is an important optical materials for camera, film, television, optical instrument and other industries. It is generally melted by adding transition metal ion colorant into raw materials. The spectral characteristics of glass mainly depend on the valence and coordination states of ions. The basic composition of glass, melting temperature, time, atmosphere, etc. play an important role in ion coloring. Varieties include black, purple, blue, green, yellow, tea yellow, ultraviolet, infrared, protective, holmium praseodymium neodymium glass, etc. Generally, selective absorpted optical coloured glass has many defects, such as multi peak, band-pass width, poor rear cut-off performance, etc. In recent years, a new type of bandpass filter glass with narrow bandpass, only one transmission peak and good filtering performance has been developed.

explanation_cn: 仅在有选择的部位进行外延生长.以满足器件的要求。一般有两个实施方案：在掩膜的窗口进行选择生长或在衬底的沟槽选择生长。前者用绝缘材料作掩膜，后者则通过控制系统内的气体成分，使得表面生长速率为零.而在沟槽内因其气相成分不同可进行生长，当沟槽填满后，整个生长就终止而成平面。可使器件获得微细的良好的介电绝缘，用于制备较复杂的器件结构和光电集成电路等。
explanation_en: Epitaxial growth is only carried out at selected positions to meet the requirements of devices. There are generally two implementation schemes: selective growth in the window of the mask or selective growth in the groove of the substrate. The former uses insulating materials as mask, while the latter controls the gas composition in the system to make the surface growth rate zero. Growth can be carried out in the trench due to different gas composition. When the trench is filled, the entire growth will stop and become a plane. It can provide fine and good dielectric insulation for devices, and is used to prepare more complex device structures and optoelectronic integrated circuits.

explanation_cn: 选择性氧化是一种化学过程，其中某种物质在存在氧气或氧化剂的条件下，被部分或选择性地氧化，而其他物质不发生氧化反应。这个过程通常是通过精心设计催化剂或反应条件来实现的。选择性氧化在化工工业、有机合成和环境保护中有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: Preferential oxidation is a chemical process in which some substances are partially or selectively oxidized in the presence of oxygen or oxidizer, while other substances do not undergo oxidation reaction. This process is usually achieved by carefully designing catalysts or reaction conditions. Preferential oxidation is widely used in chemical industry, organic synthesis and environmental protection.

explanation_cn: 某些组成元素不按其在合金中所占的比例进行反应，被优先腐蚀的现象。
explanation_en: Some constituent elements do not react according to their proportion in alloy and are preferentially corrosion.

name_cn: 选择滤光功能复合材料
explanation_cn: 指以透明的高聚物、玻璃、单晶体及多晶陶瓷为基体，并将各种颜料均勻地分散在其中，形成的可见光波有选择吸收，从而达到滤光目的的功能复合材料。通常5pm以下的颜料颗粒如果能与基体较好地相容，即能使复合材料具有均匀的颜色，表明颜料分子吸收了该颜色的补色而使得反映出该颜色的光波透过。如需要滤去的光波波长与颗粒尺寸相当，则能被粒子所散射，所以波长小于粒子尺寸的光波不能透过大于粒子尺寸的光波，达到滤光的目的。选择滤光功能复合材料用于制造各种滤色片和光探测头的保护罩。
explanation_en: It refers to a functional composite materials with transparent polymer, glass, single crystal and polycrystalline ceramics as the matrix, and various pigment are evenly dispersed in it, forming visible light waves that are selectively absorbed, so as to achieve the purpose of light filtering. Generally, if the pigment particles below 5pm can be well compatible with the matrix, it can make the composite materials have a uniform color, which indicates that pigment molecules have absorbed the complementary color of the color to make the light wave reflecting the color penetrate. If the wavelength of the light wave that needs to be filtered is equivalent to the particle size, it can be scattered by the particles. Therefore, light waves with wavelengths smaller than the particle size cannot pass through light waves larger than the particle size, achieving the purpose of filtering light. Selective light filtering composite is selected for manufacturing various color filters and protective covers of light detector heads.

explanation_cn: 能透过X射线的功能复合材料。实验表明碳 纤维增强环氧树脂的复合材料对于X射线有很好的 透过性能。碳纤维/环氧复合材料单位厚度的X射线 吸收率为1.4%/mm,而铝则为7%/mm.所以该种 复合材料被用来制造医用X射线机的床体和底片暗盒。
explanation_en: Functional composite materials that can penetrate X-ray. The experiment shows that the composite materials of carbon fiber reinforced epoxy resin has good X-ray transmission performance. The X-ray absorptivity of carbon fiber/epoxy composite materials per unit thickness is 1.4%/mm, while that of aluminum is 7%/mm. Therefore, this kind of composite materials is used to manufacture the bed and negative cassette of medical X-ray machine.

explanation_cn: 主要指玻璃纤维增强透明基体的复合材料.其透明基体可以是透明的聚合物、玻璃、单晶或玻璃陶瓷等透明玻璃纤维增强塑料，俗称透明玻璃钢.是目前最常用的聚合物基透光复合材料.它是以玻璃纤维（直径6-10Mm)与不饱和聚酯或丙烯酸酯复合而成的一种新型的采光材料。透光复合材料的性能取决于树脂基体、玻璃纤维以及填料、纤维与树脂间界面的黏结性能以及光学参数的匹配。强度和刚度取决于纤维，纤维的光学性能一般较同定；而树脂在相当程度上与其化学、物理性能有关。其主要用于建筑物采光(窗、透光顶板）、农用暖房、工业设备防护罩和围墙以及照明灯具挡板和照明天棚等。
explanation_en: It mainly refers to the composite materials of glass fiber reinforced transparent matrix. Its transparent matrix can be transparent polymer, glass, single crystal or glass-ceramics and other transparent glass fiber reinforced plastics, commonly known as transparent glass steel. It is currently the most commonly used polymer based transparent composite materials. It is a new type of lighting materials made of glass fiber (6-10Mm in diameter) and unsaturated polyester or acrylate composition. The performance of transparent composition materials depends on the bonding performance of resin matrix, glass fiber and filler, the interface between fiber and resin, and the matching of optical parameters. The strength and stiffness depend on the fiber, and the optical properties of the fiber are generally relatively constant; Resin is related to its chemical and physical properties to a considerable extent. It is mainly used for building lighting (windows, transparent roofs), agricultural greenhouses, industrial equipment protective covers and walls, as well as lighting fixture baffles and ceilings.

explanation_cn: 在透射电子显微镜中利用高能电子束通过试样时产生的各种信息研究试样物质微观结构的分析技术。经加速的高能电子束通过试样时和物质原子发生交互作用.形成透射电子、衍射电子等，它们和物质的结构与成分密切相关。单独利用透射电子束或衍射电子朿成像.叫以获得反映物质内部微观组织和结构的明场像或暗场像。同时利用透射电子束和一束或多束衍射电子束成像.可以得到反映物质内部原子尺度微观结构的高分辨结构图像。明场像、暗场像、高分辨结构图像，都是反映物质内部不同层次的结构细节的图像。近代透射电子显微术包括分析衍射谱以获得衍射物质晶体结构和位向的信息，以及利用高能人射束照射试样微小区域产生的X射线进行成分分析等内容，它还包括对不同成像模式下所获得的各种图像进行分折以得到其他物质结构信息（例如晶体不完整性等）的有关技术。
explanation_en: An analytical technique for studying the microstructure of sample materials using various information generated by high-energy electron beams passing through the sample in a transmission electron microscope. The accelerated high-energy electron beam interacts with the material atoms when passing through the sample, forming transmitted electrons, diffracted electrons, etc., which are closely related to the structure and composition of the material. Using transmitted or diffracted electron beams alone for imaging is called obtaining a bright or dark field image that reflects the internal microstructure and structure of a substance. By simultaneously utilizing transmitted electron beams and one or more diffracted electron beams for imaging, high-resolution structural images can be obtained that reflect the atomic scale microstructure inside a substance. Bright field images, dark field images, and high-resolution structural images are all images that reflect the structural details of different levels within a substance. Modern transmission electron microscopy includes the analysis of diffraction spectrum to obtain the information of crystal structure and orientation of diffractive material, as well as the composition analysis of X-ray generated from the irradiation of high-energy human beam on the small area of the sample. It also includes the relevant technology of analyzing various images obtained under different imaging modes to obtain other material structure information (such as crystal imperfection, etc.).

explanation_cn: 是一种陶瓷材料，其名称代表了其主要成分，即铅镁铌酸铋（PbMg1/3Nb2/3O3，缩写为PMN）和铅锆钛酸钡（PbZr1-xTixO3，缩写为PZT）的复合物。这种陶瓷材料具有一些特殊的性质，使其在光学和电子领域中具有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: It is a ceramics materials whose name represents its main components, namely, the composite of lead magnesium bismuth niobate (PbMg1/3Nb2/3O3, abbreviated as PMN) and lead zirconium barium titanate (PbZr1-xTixO3, abbreviated as PZT). This ceramics materials has some special properties, which makes it widely used in optical and electronic fields.

name_cn: 透明偏铌酸铅钡镧陶瓷
name_en: transparent lanthanum modified lead-barium metaniobate ceramics
explanation_cn: 一种透明铁电陶瓷,简称透明PBLN陶瓷。具有高的电光效应。一般以高纯~氧化二镧、五氧化二铌、（碳酸钡为原料.在1300T:下通氧气氛热压烧结而成。主要用于电光源装置和用作原子能反应堆材料。
explanation_en: A transparent ferroelectric ceramics, referred to as transparent pbln ceramic. It has high electrophoto effect. It is generally made of high-purity lanthanum oxide, niobium pentoxide and barium carbonate by hot pressing sintering in oxygen atmosphere at 1300T. It is mainly used for electric light source devices and as materials for atomic energy reactors.

explanation_cn: 透明导电薄膜是一种既能导电又在可见光范围内具有高透过率的一种薄膜.主要有金属膜系、氧化物膜系、其他化合物膜系、高分子膜系、复合膜系等。金属膜系导电性能好，但是透过率差。半导体薄膜系列导电性差，透过率高。当前研究和应用最为广泛的是金属膜系和氧化物膜系。透明导电薄膜主要用于光电器件（如LED、薄膜太阳能电池等）的窗口材料。常见的透明导电薄膜为ITO(锡掺杂三氧化铟）、FTO(掺氟氧化锡）等，它们的禁带宽度大，只吸收紫外线，不吸收可见光，因此称之为"透明"。透明导电薄膜主要用作透明电极、仪器仪表的防静电及电磁屏蔽窗口、防霜玻璃以及电子记录材料等领域。
explanation_en: Transparent conductive thin films is a kind of film that can conduct electricity and has high transmittance in the visible light range. It mainly includes metal film system, oxide film system, other compound film system, macromolecule film system, composition film system, etc. The metallic film system has good conductivity, but poor transmittance. The semiconductor thin film series has poor conductivity and high transmittance. At present, metallic film system and oxide film system are the most widely studied and applied. Transparent conductive thin films is mainly used as window materials for photoelectric devices (such as LED, thin film materials for thin film solar cell, etc.). The common transparent conductive thin films are ITO (tin doped indium trioxide), FTO (fluorinated tin oxide), etc. They have a wide band gap, only absorb ultraviolet light, not visible light, so they are called "transparent". Transparent conductive thin films is mainly used as transparent electrode, anti-static and electromagnetic shielding window of instruments, frostproof glass, electronic recording materials and other fields.

explanation_cn: 具有高导电率、对可见光的高透过率和对红外光的高反射率的陶瓷薄膜材料，包括金属透明导电膜和氧化物透明导电膜两大类》
explanation_en: Ceramics film materials with high conductivity, high transmittance to visible light and high reflectivity to infrared light, including metal transparent conductive film and oxide transparent conductive film

explanation_cn: 既具有可见光范围高透过率，又具有良好的导电性，被广泛地应用于光电子器件领域的一种透明导电薄膜。目前应用比较广泛的透明电极有铟锡氧化物（ITO)、掺杂氧化锌、铜基氧化物、氧硫族化合物、氟硫化合物、石墨烯等材料。
explanation_en: It is a transparent conductive thin films widely used in the field of optoelectronic devices because of its high transmittance in the visible light range and good conductivity. At present, transparent electrode are widely used, such as indium tin oxide (ITO), doped zinc oxide, copper based oxide, oxysulfide, fluorosulfide, graphene and other materials.

explanation_cn: 无色或着色的清澈透明的袖.即通过釉层可以看见釉下坯体的颜色以及各种雕刻和彩饰的釉.透明釉大部分是由硅酸盐透明玻璃相组成.没冇气泡和结晶，光线可无阻碍地通过，但有时也存在少t的晶体和气泡。釉层较薄，釉面平整光亮。透明釉的种类很多，如长石釉、石灰釉、铅硼釉等。中国宋代以前的青釉和影青釉都属透明釉，陶器上用的透明釉。而瓷器上用的透明釉，成熟温度为1250°C以上。
explanation_en: Colorless or colored clear and transparent sleeves. That is, through the glaze layer, you can see the color of glaze bodies and various carved and colored glaze. transparent glaze is mostly composed of silicate transparent glass phase. There are no bubbles and crystals, and light can pass through unimpeded, but sometimes there are less than t crystal and bubbles. The glaze layer is relatively thin, and the glaze surface is flat and bright. There are many kinds of transparent glaze, such as feldspathic glaze, lime glaze, lead-borosilicate glaze, etc. The celadon glaze and shadow celadon glaze before the Song Dynasty in China belong to transparent glaze, and transparent glaze is used on pottery. The transparent glaze used on porcelain has a mature temperature of more than 1250 ° C.

explanation_cn: 又称半透明烧结，用Mg-Al氢氧化物的共沉淀物或Mg-Al的盐类热分解产物为原料，添加少量CaO以促进液相烧结.在真空中经湿氢中1700°C左右烧结成半透明状态。其烧结密度可达理论密度的99.7%-100%,在0.5-6.5fxm直线透过率大于10%,可见光范围的总透过率为67%-78%。可用于高温电弧密封外壳、天线窗、红外透射装置。
explanation_en: Also called semi transparent sintering, it uses the coprecipitate of Mg Al hydroxide or the thermal decomposition products of Mg Al salts as raw materials, and adds a small amount of CaO to promote liquid phase sintering. It is semi transparent after sintering in wet hydrogen at about 1700 ° C in vacuum. Its sintering density can reach 99.7% -100% of theoretical density, the linear transmittance is more than 10% at 0.5-6.5fxm, and the total transmittance in the visible light range is 67% -78%. Can be used for high-temperature arc sealing shells, antenna windows, and infrared transmission devices.

explanation_cn: 具有功函数高以及在可见光区域内透过率高的特点。透明阳极材料一般使用氧化物半导体材料。透明阳极材料一般可使用磁控溅射、离子镀膜等方法制备。
explanation_en: It has the characteristics of high work function and high transmittance in the visible light region. Transparent anode materials generally use oxide semiconductor materials. Generally, transparent anode materials can be prepared by magnetron sputtering, ion plating and other methods.

explanation_cn: 耐水材料中一个较重要的质S指标。在常温和一定压差下.空气通过多孔材料的能力。常用透气系数度量。即在压力差为9.8Pa下.每小时通过面积为lm2，厚为lm的制品的空气升数通过实验测定。材料的透气度取决于其本身的致密程度。特别是与其中贯通气孔存在的特征有直接关系。
explanation_en: An important quality S index of water resistant materials. The ability of air to pass through porous materials under normal temperature and certain pressure difference. Commonly used measure of air permeability coefficient. The air lift of a product with an area of 1m2 and a thickness of 1m per hour is measured experimentally under a pressure difference of 9.8Pa. The gas permeability of materials depends on its density. Especially directly related to the characteristics of the perforating pores.

explanation_cn: 向金属熔池中供气的末端气道及其耐火材料.可以提高冶炼效率和效果。耐火材料部分材质为刚玉-尖晶石质、镁碳质等。气道可以是浇注时预留的狭缝、透气性能较好的多孔陶瓷芯及细的不锈钢管。用于钢包、转炉、电弧炉、铁合金炉等》
explanation_en: The end air passage and its refractory that supply air to the metal bath can improve the smelting efficiency and effect. Some refractory materials are corundum spinel, magnesia carbon, etc. The air passage can be a slit reserved during pouring, a porous ceramics core with good air permeability and a thin stainless steel tube. For ladle, converter, electric arc furnace, ferroalloy furnace, etc

explanation_cn: 是一种模拟肺泡功能进行血气交换的气体渗透膜=该膜可用于膜式人工肺或氧合器中.使血液摄取氧，并排除二氧化碳。透氧膜必须具有良好的气体渗透性、高的气体通量、良好的血液相容性并能承受血侧压力。透氧膜可分有孔膜.无孔膜和混合膜三种。有孔膜常用聚丙烯、聚四氟乙烯和聚砜制成；无孔膜常用聚硅氧烷制成；混合膜由两种膜材制成.如在微孔聚丙烯膜的两面涂以聚硅氧烷组成，以兼具两者的优点。其形态有平板式、管式、液膜式和透析式等。
explanation_en: It is a gas permeable membrane that simulates alveolar function for blood gas exchange=the membrane can be used in membrane artificial lung or oxygenator to enable blood to absorb oxygen and eliminate carbon dioxide. The oxygen permeable membrane must have good gas permeability, high gas flux, good Wood compatibility and be able to withstand blood side pressure. Oxygen permeable membranes can be divided into three types: porous membranes, non porous membranes, and mixed membranes. Porous membranes are usually made of polypropylene, polylctrafluorocthylone and polysulfone; Porous membranes are usually made of polysiloxane; The mixed membrane is made of two kinds of membrane materials. For example, the two sides of microporous polypropylene membrane are coated with polysiloxane to combine the advantages of both. Its forms include plate type, tube type, liquid membrane type and dialysis type.

explanation_cn: 在规定湿度差下，单位面积皮革上所透过的水蒸气量。
explanation_en: The amount of water vapor transmitted through the unit area of leather under the specified humidity difference.

name_cn: 透电磁波功能复合材料
explanation_cn: 透波复合材料是保护航天飞行器及地面雷达站在恶劣环境条件下通信、遥测、制导、引爆等系统能正常工作的一种多功能复合材料。透波复合材料广泛应用于运载火箭、飞船、导弹及返冋式卫星等航天飞行器和各种陆地无线电系统中。按其结构形式，可分为天线窗和天线罩两大类。天线窗；一般位于飞行器的侧面，通常为平板或带弧面的板状；天线罩位于飞行器的头部，多为锥形或半球形，具有导流、防热、透波、承载等多种功能。
explanation_en: Wave transparent composite materials is a kind of multifunctional composite materials that can protect the communication, telemetry, guidance, detonation and other systems of spacecraft and ground radar station to work normally under adverse environmental conditions. Wave transmitting composite materials are widely used in launch vehicles, airships, missiles, recoverable satellites and other aerospace vehicles and various terrestrial radio systems. According to its structural form, it can be divided into two categories: antenna window and antenna cover. Antenna window; Usually located on the side of an aircraft, usually in the form of a flat or curved plate; The radome is located at the head of the aircraft, mostly in a conical or hemispherical shape, and has various functions such as diversion, heat prevention, wave transmission, and load-bearing.

explanation_cn: 主要以重金属氟化物为主要组分，透红外波长可达9微米。主要的氟化物玻璃包括氟锆酸盐玻璃和氟铝酸盐玻璃。典型的系统包括ZrF4-BaF2-LaF3-AlF3和ZrF4-BaF2-LaF3-AlF3-NaF等；以AlF3-RF-YF3（其中R为碱土金属元素）系统的氟铝酸盐玻璃，以及ThF4-BaF2-ZnF2-YbF3和InF4-BaF2-SrF2-ZnF2等氟化钍系玻璃和氟化铟系玻璃。这些玻璃的特点是它们具有宽广的透光范围，是唯一能够在紫外、可见光、一直到中红外波段都有高透过率的无机玻璃。根据不同的组成，其红外截止波长通常在7至9微米之间。其折射率低，色散小，这是它们的另一个光学特性。典型氟锆酸盐玻璃和氟铝酸盐玻璃的折射率分别为1.51和1.42，而阿贝数分别为76和97。然而，与透红外氧化物玻璃相比，氟化物玻璃的化学稳定性、热学和机械性质较差，因此它们的成玻璃性能也较差。通常，使用无水氟化物作为原料，在干燥的环境中直接熔化，然后将熔体冷却至适当温度，浇注后以较快的速率冷却至转变温度附近，然后进行退火，以制备玻璃毛坯。在原料中添加适量的卤化剂（如NH4HF2），或向炉内或熔体中通入反应气体（如NF3、H2等），可以帮助减少玻璃中的氧杂质和氢基团的含量。这些氟化物玻璃主要用于高功率激光器的窗口、导弹窗罩以及多光谱光学仪器元件，同时也可以用于拉制红外光纤。
explanation_en: Mainly composed of heavy metal fluoride, with a transmittance infrared wavelength of up to 9 microns. The main fluoride glass includes fluorozirconate glass and fluoroaluminate glass. Typical systems include ZrF4 BaF2 LaF3 AlF3 and ZrF4 BaF2 LaF3 AlF3 NaF; Fluoroaluminate glass with AlF3-RF-YF3 (where R is an alkaline earth metal element) system, and thorium fluoride glass and indium fluoride glass such as ThF4-BaF2-ZnF2-YbF3 and InF4-BaF2-SrF2-ZnF2. The characteristic of these glass is that they have a wide light transmission range, and they are the only inorganic glass that can have high transmittance in the ultraviolet, visible light, and even the mid infrared bands. According to different compositions, the infrared cutoff wavelength is usually between 7 and 9 microns. Their low refractive index and small dispersion are another optical characteristic of them. The refractive index of typical fluorozirconate glass and fluoroaluminate glass is 1.51 and 1.42 respectively, while the Abbe number is 76 and 97 respectively. However, compared with infrared transparent oxide glass, fluoride glass has poor chemical stability, thermal and mechanical properties, so their glass forming properties are also poor. Generally, anhydrous fluoride is used as raw material to melt directly in a dry environment, and then the melt is cooled to an appropriate temperature. After pouring, the melt is cooled at a faster rate to near the transformation temperature, and then annealing is carried out to prepare glass blanks. Adding an appropriate amount of halogenating agent (such as NH4HF2) to the raw material, or introducing reaction gas (such as NF3, H2, etc.) into the furnace or melt, can help reduce the content of oxygen impurities and hydrogen groups in glass. These fluoride glass are mainly used for windows of high-power lasers, missile window covers and multi spectral optical instrument elements, and can also be used for drawing infrared optical fiber.

name_cn: 透红外硫属化合物玻璃
explanation_cn: 由一种或几种硫属兀素与Ga、Si、Ge、P和As等HIA、WA和VA族元素组成的玻璃。硫属化合物玻璃的特点是透红外范围宽，成玻璃性能较好，但需用高纯原料，工艺要求苛刻，热学和机械性质不及其他透红外玻璃，折射率高，一般大于2.使用时要在玻璃上涂减反射膜，使透过率提高。制备方法是采用纯度为6N以上的超纯单质原料，在使用前采用蒸馏、酸洗等方法除去表面氧化物及吸附的其他杂质，原料的粉碎和称量需在干燥、洁净的惰性气氛下进行，然后放置在清洗过的石英管内，在高真空下进行封接后放人电炉中熔制。硫属化合物玻璃蒸气有剧毒，制备时必须有相应的防护措施。透红外硫属化合物玻璃用于红外摄影镜头、红外窗口。
explanation_en: Glass composed of one or more chalcogenides and HIA, WA and VA group elements such as Ga, Si, Ge, P and As. The chalcogenide glass is characterized by wide infrared transmission range and good glass forming performance, but it needs high-purity raw materials. The process requirements are harsh, the thermal and mechanical properties are inferior to other infrared glass, and the refractive index is high, generally greater than 2. When using, anti reflecting film should be coated on glass to improve the transmissivity. The preparation method is to use ultra pure raw materials with a purity of more than 6N. Before use, the surface oxides and other adsorbed impurities are removed by distillation, pickling and other methods. The raw materials are crushed and weighed in a dry and clean inert atmosphere, then placed in a cleaned quartze tube, sealed under high vacuum, and then put into a electric furnace for melting. Sulfur compound glass vapor is highly toxic, and corresponding protective measures must be taken during preparation. Infrared transmitting chalcogenide glass is used for infrared camera lens and infrared window.

explanation_cn: 是一种透明的红外玻璃。纯二氧化碲熔体无法形成玻璃状态，但微量的Al2O3（氧化铝）可以使TeO2成为玻璃，而Na2O-TeO2-K2O系统在一定条件下也能部分形成玻璃。典型的系统包括V2O5-BaO-TeO2和BaO-ZnO-TeO2等。碲酸盐玻璃具有高折射率（通常在2.1至2.3之间）、低阿贝数（通常在15至18之间）、低软化点（约150°C）、以及相对较低的熔化温度（800至820°C），但其化学稳定性较差，而且热膨胀系数较大。碲酸盐玻璃的最高使用温度一般不能超过250°C。在可见光和近红外光谱范围内，碲酸盐玻璃的透过率良好。然而，过高的熔化温度或过长的保温时间会导致TeO2大量挥发，从而减小红外透过率。通过脱水处理可以制备具有2.8微米波长高透过率的玻璃。此外，通过添加Al2O3可以制备吸收波长小于1.8微米的滤光片，这些滤光片可以良好地透过2.5至3.5微米的红外光线，可用于夜视仪的红外截止滤光片，同时也适用于InSb探测器的窗口材料。
explanation_en: It is a transparent infrared glass. Pure tellurium dioxide melt cannot form glass state, but trace Al2O3 (aluminum oxide) can make TeO2 become glass, and Na2O-TeO2-K2O system can also partially form glass under certain conditions. Typical systems include V2O5 BaO TeO2 and BaO ZnO TeO2. Tellurite glass has high refractive index (usually between 2.1 and 2.3), low Abbe number (usually between 15 and 18), low bating point (about 150 ° C), and relatively low melting temperature (800 to 820 ° C), but its chemical stability is poor and its coefficient of thermal expansion is large. The maximum operating temperature of tellurite glass should generally not exceed 250 ° C. The transmissivity of tellurite glass is good in the range of visible light and near infrared spectroscopy spectrum. However, excessively high melting temperature or prolonged holding time can cause a large amount of TeO2 to evaporate, thereby reducing the infrared transmittance. Glass with high transmittance of 2.8 μ m wavelength can be prepared by dehydration treatment. In addition, by adding Al2O3, filters with absorption wavelength less than 1.8 μ m can be prepared. These filters can well penetrate 2.5 to 3.5 μ m of infrared light, and can be used as infrared cut-off filters for night vision devices, as well as window materials for InSb detectors.

explanation_cn: 以氧化铝为主要组分的透红外光学玻璃。具有较好|的力学、热学、光学性质，透红外波长为5pm，软化温度可达800°C。铝酸盐玻璃熔炼温度高，容易失透，加人少量二氧化硅可以显著降低玻璃析晶倾向.但使红外透过性i能变差.应用很广，作窗口应用的有导航装置中的红外辐射计的半球罩、红外i引信装置的圆筒形全锥及锥缺形窗口，以及供研究喷气式飞机和火箭发动机排气特性的气门窗口、测高温应用中心窗口和透镜等。
explanation_en: Infrared optical glass with alumina as the main component. It has good mechanical, thermal and optical properties. The wavelength of infrared transmission is 5pm, and the bating temperature can reach 800 ° C. Aluminate glass is subject to high melting temperature and easy to lose its transparency. Adding a small amount of silica can significantly reduce the crystallization tendency of glass. However, the infrared permeability i energy becomes poor. It is widely used as a window, including the hemispherical cover of infrared radiometer in navigation device, cylindrical full cone and cone shaped missing windows of infrared i fuze device, and valve windows for studying exhaust characteristics of jet aircraft and rocket engines High temperature applications such as central windows and lenses.

explanation_cn: 一种富钙镁的单斜辉石。与钙铁辉石形成完全类质同象系列。单斜晶系，发育完好的晶体呈柱状、粗短柱状，通常呈粒状。颜色为蓝绿色至黄绿色、褐色、黄色、紫色、无色至白色。玻璃光泽，条痕无色至浅绿。硬度5.5-6，密度3.22-3.56g/crn3。在基性和超基性岩中是主要矿物之一》作为陶瓷原料具有助熔性，是制备日用陶瓷、建筑陶瓷、电陶瓷的原料之一。可作宝石原料，有时具猫眼效应。
explanation_en: A monoclinic pyroxene rich in calcium and magnesium. Formed a completely isomorphic series with calcium iron pyroxene. Monocline system: well-developed crystal are columnar, coarse and short columnar, usually granular. The colors are blue-green to yellow-green, brown, yellow, purple, colorless to white. Glass is glossy, and streaks are colorless to light green. Hardness 5.5-6, density 3.22-3.56g/crn3. It is one of the main minerals in basic and ultrabasic rock. As a raw material of ceramics, it has the ability of melting, and is one of the raw materials for preparing domestic porcelain, building ceramics, and electric ceramics. It can be used as gems raw material, sometimes with cat's eye effect.

explanation_cn: 粉末层或多孔体透过气体或液体的能力。例如松装烧结可以用来制取透过性大、净化精度要求不很高的多孔材料。
explanation_en: The ability of a powder layer or porous body to penetrate gases or liquids. For example, loose sintering can be used to produce porous materials with large permeability and low purification precision requirements.

explanation_cn: 用透过法测定的粉末比表面积。流体通过粉末床的透过率或所受阻力与粉末的粗细或比表面的大小有关。粉未愈细.比表面愈大，对流体的阻力也愈大.而单位时间内透过单位面积的流体量就愈小。换句话说.当粉末床的孔隙度不变时.流体通过粗粉末比通过细粉末的流速大。因为透过率或流速是容易测定的，所以只要找到它们与粉末比表面的关系，就可以知道粉米的比表面。透过法根据所用介质的不同.分为气体透过法和液体透过法。后者只适用于粗粉末或孔隙较大的多孔性同体（如金属过滤器），在粉末测试中用的很少。
explanation_en: Specific surface of powder measured by transmission method. The transmissivity or resistance of fluid through powder bed is related to the size of powder or specific surface. The finer the powder, the greater the specific surface area, the greater the resistance to the fluid, and the smaller the amount of fluid passing through the unit area per unit time. In other words, when the porosity of the powder bed is constant, the flow rate of the fluid through the coarse powder is greater than that through the fine powder. Since the transmissivity or flow rate are easy to measure, as long as we find their relationship with the powder specific surface, we can know the specific surface of powder rice. The permeation method is divided into gas permeation method and liquid permeation method according to the different media used. The latter is only applicable to coarse powder or porous bodies with large pores (such as metal filters), and is rarely used in powder testing.

explanation_cn: 架状结构硅酸盐矿物。通常呈块状。白色或黄色，偶见粉红色。玻璃光泽，两组解理交角为114°。贝壳状断口。莫氏硬度6-6.5,性脆，密度2.3-2.5g/cm3。主要产于花岗伟晶岩中，与锂辉石、铯榴石、彩色电气石等共生。量多时可作陶瓷和特种玻璃的原料。
explanation_en: Silicate mineral with shelf structure. Usually in block shape. White or yellow, occasionally pink. Glass luster, the intersection angle of two groups of cleavage is 114 °. Shell like fracture. Mohs hardness 6-6.5, brittle, density 2.3-2.5g/cm3. It mainly occurs in granitic pegmatite and coexists with spodumene, cesium garnet, colored tourmaline, etc. It can be used as raw material for ceramics and special glass in large quantities.

explanation_cn: 呈纤维状、丝状形态.呈白色.弱丝绢光泽。蛇纹石石棉相比.这类石棉的纤维较粗.性脆.易折断。可用于制备石棉水泥制品及石棉板、石棉纸及绝缘材料。
explanation_en: It is in a fibrous or filamentous form, appearing white with a weak silky luster. Compared with chrysctile asbestos, the fibers of this kind of asbestos are coarse, brittle and easy to break. It can be used to prepare asbestos cement products, asbestos board, asbestos paper and insulation materials.

explanation_cn: 单体与单体、单体与二聚体或多聚体及多聚体之间通过官能团之间发生化学反应而进行的聚合。聚合特征是低分子转变成高分子的过程中反应是逐步进行的，即每一步的反应速率常数和活化能大致相同。反应初期大部分单体很快聚合成二聚体、三聚体、四聚体等低聚物，低聚物间继续反应，分子量缓慢增加，直至反应程度很高时，分子量达到较高数值。因此反应单体转化率基本上不依赖于聚合时间的延长，但产物的分子量随聚合时间的延长逐渐增大。在过程中，体系由单体和分子量递增的一系列中间产物所组成，中间产物的任何两分子间都能反应。绝大多数缩聚反应是典型的，其他非缩聚型的逐步聚合有聚氨酯的合成、聚苯醚的合成、聚砜的合成等。由于缩聚反应是平衡反应，所以分子量将受反应程度、平衡常数、两单体的当量比等许多因素的影响，控制产品分子量是最关键的问题。通常可采用加入单官能团物质或某单体过量，设法排除低分子量副产物等方法来调节分子量。逐步聚合的聚合热不大，但其活化能却较大，一般需在较高温度下进行。逐步聚合可以采用熔融聚合、溶液聚合和界面聚合三种方法，可以根据不同的反应类型加以选择。
explanation_en: Polymerization between monomer and monomer, monomer and dimer or polymer and polymer through chemical reaction between functional groups. Polymerization is characterized by the gradual reaction in the process of transformation low molecules into macromolecule, that is, the reaction rate constant and activation or conditioning energy of each step are roughly the same. At the beginning of the reaction, most of the monomer quickly polymerized into dimers, trimers, tetramers and other oligomer. The oligomer continued to react, and the molecular weight slowly increased until the degree of reaction was very high, and the molecular weight reached a higher value. Therefore, the conversion of reaction monomer is basically independent of the extension of polymerization time, but the molecular weight of the product gradually increases with the extension of polymerization time. In the process, the system is composed of monomer and a series of intermediate products with increasing molecular weight, and any two molecules of intermediate products can react with each other. Most polycondensation reaction reactions are typical. Other non polycondensation stepwise (reaction) polymerization includes the synthesis of polyurethime, polyphenylene oxide, polysulfone, etc. Since polycondensation reaction is an equilibrium reaction, the molecular weight will be affected by many factors, such as reaction degree, equilibrium constant, equivalence ratio of two monomer and so on. Controlling the molecular weight of the product is the most critical issue. Usually, the molecular weight can be adjusted by adding mono functional group substances or excessive monomer and trying to eliminate low molecular weight by-products. The polymerization heat of stepwise (reaction) polymerization is not large, but its activation or conditioning energy is large, and generally needs to be carried out at a higher temperature. Stepwise (reaction) polymerization can adopt three methods: melt polymerization, solution polymerization and interfacial polymerization, which can be selected according to different reaction types.

explanation_cn: 光通信中用于传输光信息的光学纤维。又称光波导纤维、光纤。通信光纤通常由芯层和包层组成，芯的折射率略高于包层折射率。按芯、包层折射率分布可分为阶跃型和梯度（渐变）型光纤二种；按传输模式不同可分为多模光纤和单模光纤；按材料可分为多组分玻璃光纤、单组分石英光纤和氣化物光纤等。
explanation_en: Optical fibers used for transmitting optical information in optical communication. It is also called optical waveguide fiber and optical fiber. Optical fiber for communication usually consists of core and cladding, and the refractive index of core is slightly higher than that of cladding. According to the refractive index distribution of core and cladding, there are two types of optical fiber: step type and gradient (gradient) type; According to different transmission modes, it can be divided into multimode optical fiber and single mode optical filler; According to materials, it can be divided into multi-component glass optical fiber, single component silica fiber and gasification optical fiber.

explanation_cn: 一般来说，通用塑料指的是产量大、用途广泛、成型性好、价格相对便宜的塑料种类。通用塑料通常包括五大品种，即聚乙烯（PE)、聚丙烯（PP)、聚氯乙烯（PVC)、聚苯乙烯（PS)及丙烯腈-丁二烯-苯乙烯共聚合物（ABS)。具体各种通用塑料的特点和应用如下：聚乙烯（PE)：常用聚乙烯可以分为低密度聚乙烯（LDPE)、高密度聚乙烯（HDPE)和线型低密度聚乙烯（LLDPE)。聚乙烯主要用于各种包装薄膜、管材、注塑和中空吹塑制品等领域。聚丙烯（PP)：聚丙烯的品种更多，主要有均聚聚丙烯（homopolypropylene)、嵌段共聚聚丙烯（copolymerized polypropylene)和无规共聚聚丙烯（random copolymer polypropylene)。均聚聚丙烯主要用于拉丝、纤维、注射成型、BOPP膜等领域，而共聚聚丙烯主要应用于家电零部件等领域。聚氯乙烯（PVC)：由于其成本较低，且具有自熄灭的特性，聚氯乙烯在建筑领域得到广泛应用，用于制造下水管材、塑钢门窗、板材、人造皮革等产品。聚苯乙烯（PS)：聚苯乙烯广泛用作透明原材料，应用领域包括汽车灯罩、透明杯、容器等。ABS：具有出色的物理、机械和热性能，广泛应用于家用电器、仪器外壳、配件等领域，特别是在家用电器领域中，用量非常大。这些通用塑料种类在不同领域中发挥着重要的作用，满足了各种制品的需要。
explanation_en: Generally speaking, general purpose plastics refer to plastics with large output, wide use, good formability and relatively low price. General purpose plastics usually include five varieties, namely polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polyvinyl chloride (PVC), polystyrene (PS) and acrylonitrile butadiene styrene co polymer (ABS). The specific characteristics and applications of various general purpose plastics are as follows: polyethylene (PE): common polyethylene can be divided into low density polyethylene (LDPE), high density polyethylene (HDPE) and linear low density polyethylene (LLDPE). Polyethylene is mainly used in various packaging film, tube, injection molding, hollow blow molding products and other fields. Polypropylene: polypropylene has more varieties, mainly homopoly polypropylene, block copolymerized polypropylene and random copolymer polypropylene. Homopolymer polypropylene is mainly used in wire drawing, fiber, injection molding, BOPP film and other fields, while copolymer polypropylene is mainly used in home appliance parts and other fields. Polyvinyl chloride (PVC): due to its low cost and self extinguishing characteristics, polyvinyl chloride is widely used in the construction field to manufacture sewer tube, plastic steel doors and windows, plates, artificial leather and other products. Polystyrene (PS): polystyrene is widely used as transparent raw material, and its application fields include automobile lampshade, transparent cup, container, etc. ABS: With excellent physical, mechanical, and thermal properties, it is widely used in household appliances, instrument casings, accessories, and other fields, especially in the field of household appliances, with a very large amount of usage. These kinds of general purpose plastics play an important role in different fields and meet the needs of various products.

explanation_cn: 是指射入单晶体中的高能粒子与晶体原子发生近距离相互作用的概率在某些特殊的入射晶向上有大幅度下降的现象。
explanation_en: It refers to the phenomenon where the probability of high-energy particles entering a single crystal interacting closely with crystal atoms significantly decreases in certain special incident crystal directions.

explanation_cn: 指压装的高聚物黏结炸药（PBX),通常是以粉状高能炸药为主体另外加入黏结剂、增塑剂（少数种类含钝化剂）等附加成分的一类混合炸药。增塑剂的作用是使炸药更容易成型、赋予炸药一定的韧性以及对高聚物进行改性。目前已有20多种实验室制造造型药的方法，常用溶液水悬浮法、溶液沉淀法、直接法、共沉淀法、蒸发法等方法合成。用途广泛，其组成广泛，种类繁多，主要是压制成硬质药柱装填破甲弹战斗部或导弹战斗部、传爆药或震源药柱等。
explanation_en: It refers to pressed PBX (PBX), which is usually a kind of composite explosive with powder high performance explosives as the main body and additional ingredients such as adhesive, plasticizer (a few kinds contain passivator). The role of plasticizer is to make explosive easier to form, give explosive a certain degree of toughness and modify polymers. At present, there are more than 20 methods for laboratory manufacturing of molding drugs, which are commonly synthesized by solution water suspension method, solution precipitation method, direct method, co precipitation method, evaporation method and other methods. It has a wide range of uses, including a wide range of components and a wide range of types. It is mainly used to pressing hard grains to fill armour breaking warheads or missile warheads, booster explosive or seismic source charges.

explanation_cn: 添加于粉末混合料中的一种物质，烧结时依靠其挥发而在最终产品中形成所需类型和数量的孔隙。
explanation_en: A substance added to the powder mixture, which forms the required type and quantity of pores in the final product depending on its volatilization during sintering.

explanation_cn: ①炼钢过程中为形成炉渣所加入的材料。最主要的是石灰和蛮石。石灰的作用是用来脱磷和脱硫，加入萤石的目的是为了降低高碱度炉渣的熔点和黏度，提高炉渣的流动性，加快钢渣反应速率。转炉炼钢使用的还有白云石及合成造渣材料、高碱度烧结矿及球团矿等。②焊条中加入药皮或焊剂中的矿物材料。焊接时，形成熔渣对液体金属起保护作用和冶金反应。根据焊接熔渣的成分可分为三大类：第一类是盐型熔渣，氧化性很小，主要用于焊接铝、钛和其他活性金属及其合金。第二类是盐-氧化物型熔渣，主要用于焊接合金钢及高温合金。第三类是氧化物型熔渣，主要用于焊接低碳钢和低合金钢。
explanation_en: ① Materials added to form slag during steelmaking. The most important are lime and rough stone. Lime is used for dephosphorization and desulfurization, and fluorite is added to reduce the melting point and viscosity of slag with high alkalinity, improve the flow ability of slag, and accelerate the reaction rate of steel slag. Dolomite and synthetic slagging materials, high basicity sintering and pellets are also used in converter sleelmaking steelmaking. ② Mineral materials added to the coating or welding flux of electrode. During weld, molten slag is formed to protect liquid metal and metallurgical reaction. According to the composition of weld slag, it can be divided into three categories: the first category is salt slag, which has little oxidation and is mainly used for weld aluminum, titanium and other active metals and their alloy. The second type is salt oxide slag, which is mainly used for weld alloy steel and high temperature alloy. The third type is oxide slag, which is mainly used for weld low-cardon steel and low alloy steel.

explanation_cn: 制作义齿中人造牙、冠、桥的非金属部分以及个别缺失牙修复用的粉状材料。为商品名，分为热凝和自凝两大类。其组成与牙托粉基本一致.主要成分为聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯聚合体，粒度较牙托粉细，为120-200目。着色剂为金属氧化物.如镉黄、钛白等，配成天然牙色。为增加材料的硬度和抗磨性.可加人适量填料，如玻璃粉、二氧化硅等。应用时与相应的造牙水按一定比例阔和使用。
explanation_en: The non-metallic parts of artificial teeth, crowns and bridges in demure and powder materials for repairing individual missing teeth are made. It is a product name that can be divided into two categories: thermal setting and self setting. Its composition is basically the same as that of denture base polymer powder. The main component is polymethyl methacrylate polymer, whose particle size is 120-200 mesh, finer than that of denture base polymer powder. The colorant is metal oxide, such as cadmium yellow, titanium dioxide, etc., which is matched with natural tooth color. In order to increase the hardness and abrasion resistance of materials, appropriate fillers, such as glass powder and silica, can be added. When using it, use it in a certain proportion with the corresponding dental solution.

explanation_cn: 将很细的粉料经过加胶黏剂，制成流动性好、粒径约为0.1mm的较大团粒能使细粉具有好的流动性，提高填充模腔的均匀性，缩短填充时间。
explanation_en: The very fine powder is added with adhesive to make larger particles with good flow ability and particle size of about 0.1mm, which can make the fine powder have good flow ability, improve the uniformity of filling the mold cavity and shorten the filling time.

explanation_cn: 又称有效压力。修正实际气体非理想性的校正压力。在化学平衡计算中，是使理想气体的热力学公式适用于真实气体，用来代替真实压力的一种物理量，是组分的分压与系数的乘积，是有效压力，表示系统中组分的活泼程度。越大，其化学位越高.越易逸出。系数则表示组分在真实气体中的行为与在理想气体中的行为的偏差程度。在理想气体混合物中，每一组分的系数等于1，就等于它自身的分压。
explanation_en: Also called effective pressure. Correction pressure for correcting non ideality of actual gas. In chemical equilibrium calculation, it is a physical quantity that makes the thermodynamics formula of ideal gas applicable to real gas, and is used to replace the real pressure. It is the product of component partial pressure and coefficient, is the effective pressure, and represents the activity degree of components in the system. The larger the degree, the higher its degree and the easier it is to escape. The coefficient represents the degree of deviation between the behavior of a component in a real gas and its behavior in an ideal gas. In an ideal gas mixture, if the coefficient of each component is equal to 1, it is equal to its own partial pressure.

explanation_cn: 橡胶增靭塑料从低韧性转变为高韧性所需分散相的临界体积分数。
explanation_en: Critical volume fraction of dispersed phase required for rubber toughened plastics to change from low toughness transformation high toughness.

explanation_cn: 又叫马路划线漆。刷在路面的适当部位上以指示快慢车道、人行道、停车位置或停车场地等所有的涂料。其特点是耐用性好、干燥迅速、可见度高（具有鲜明的白色或黄色），为提高夜间可见度，常在涂料中添加玻璃珠，利用嵌于涂膜表面的玻璃珠定向反射车辆前灯的光线。帮助司机看清路面标志。这种加人玻璃珠的涂料称为定向反光路标涂料。由基料、着色颜料和体质颜料等组成，基料常用品种有聚氨酯、环氧树脂、氯化橡胶、乙烯类树脂和石油树脂。按照施条件可分三类：常温施工溶剂型涂料、加热施工溶剂型涂料和热熔施工粉末涂料。其中热熔粉末涂料的综合性能优异、干燥迅速、使用寿命长，主要用于交通干线的路面标志。
explanation_en: Also called road marking paint. Brush on appropriate parts of the road surface to indicate all coatings such as fast and slow lanes, sidewalks, parking places or parking lots. It is characterized by good durability, rapid drying, and high visibility (with bright white or yellow). In order to improve visibility at night, glass beads are often added to coatings, and glass beads embedded in the film surface are used to reflect the light of vehicle headlights directionally. Help drivers to see road markings clearly. This kind of coatings added with glass beads is called directional reflective road sign coatings. It is composed of base material, colored pigment, constitutional pigment, etc. base material is commonly used in polyurethime, epoxy resin, chlorinated rubber, vinyl resin and petroleum resin. According to the construction conditions, it can be divided into three categories: normal temperature construction solvent coatings, heated construction solvent coatings and hot-melt construction powder coating. The hot-melt powder coating has excellent comprehensive performance, rapid drying and long service life, and is mainly used for road signs of traffic trunk lines.

explanation_cn: 是指能引起基因突变、染色体结构畸变以及其他DNA或基因变化等不良反应的能力。如芳香胺就是典型的物质，其具有亲核性，会和DNA有稳固的共价键结，形成DNA和芳香胺的加合物，使得DNA无法准确地复制。若生殖细胞受到的影响，基因的变异会遗传给后代，即使后代未直接接触的因子也是如此。体外试验一般包括三个水平的效应：DNA损伤、基因突变和染色体畸变。体内试验包括微核试验、哺乳动物骨髓细胞遗传试验、啮齿动物显性致死试验、哺乳动物生殖细胞遗传分析、小鼠斑点试验以及小鼠遗传物质易位分析等。其中最常用的试验是啮齿动物微核试验。检测生物材料的遗传毒性时，一般采用材料浸提液或将材料溶于适当的介质中进行测试。
explanation_en: It refers to the ability to cause adverse reactions such as gene mutations, chromosomal structural aberrations, and other DNA or gene changes. For example, aromatic amine is a typical substance, which has nucleophilic property and will have a stable covalent bond bond with DNA, forming an adduct of DNA and aromatic amine, making DNA unable to replicate accurately. If germ cells are affected, genetic variations will be passed on to offspring, even if they are not directly exposed to factors. In vitro testing generally includes three levels of effects: DNA damage, gene mutations, and chromosomal aberrations. In vivo experiments include micronucleus testing, mammalian bone marrow cell genetic testing, rodent dominant lethality testing, mammalian germ cell genetic analysis, mouse spot testing, and mouse genetic material translocation analysis. The most commonly used test is the rodent micronucleus test. When testing genotoxicity of biological materials, generally use materials extract or dissolve materials in appropriate medium for testing.

explanation_cn: 高分子链的一端或两端带一个活性基闭的聚合物，分别称为单遥爪聚合物和双。它们在扩链剂、交联剂等助剂的存在下，能进一步反应形成类似硫化橡胶的弹性体。典型的有端羟基、端羧基聚丁二烯及端巯基、氨基、氮丙吡啶基、环氧基等不同主链结构的产品，如丁苯橡胶、丁腈橡胶、聚异丁烯、聚异戊二烯等的。可以直接应用.如作火箭燃料黏合剂。由于其分子量小，有流变性好的优点，易进一步加工成大分子。由于含有可反应的活性端基，也常用来制备嵌段共聚物、星形聚合物或树枝状聚合物等。
explanation_en: One or both ends of a macromolecule chain have a closed active group, which are called single telechelic polymer and double telechelic polymer respectively. In the presence of chain extender, crosslinking agent and other additive, they can further react to form an elastomer similar to vulcanized rubber. Typical products with different main chain structures, such as hydroxyl terminated, carboxyl terminated polybutadiene, mercapto terminated, amino, nitrogen propyl pyridinyl, epoxy, etc., such as styrene butadiene rubber, acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber, polyisobutene, polyisoprene, etc. It can be directly used, such as adhesive for rocket fuel. Due to its small molecular weight and good rheological properties, it is easy to further process into large molecules. Because it contains reactive active end groups, it is also commonly used to prepare block copolymer, star polymer or dendritic polymer.

explanation_cn: 又叫漆膜。色漆漆膜能遮盖住底材上的颜色或颜色差异的能力。用两种方式表示：即遮盖单位面积所需的最小用漆量，以g/m2表示;或遮盖住底面所需的最小漆膜厚度，;颜料和漆料反射系数之间的差别决定着遮盖力的大小。颜料颗粒的大小和它在漆料中的分散程度也是决定的重要因素。常用测试方法有种：①单位面积重量法，用漆刷将涂料均匀、快速地刷于黑白间隔的玻璃板上，至看不见黑白格为止，将所用涂料称重，即可得出g/m2。此法终点有时不易观察，产品的流平性和刷痕对其结果有影响，但操作简便、器材易得，仍被广泛使用。②最小漆膜厚度法，用两块黑、白瓷板，上面刻有凹槽和刻度，盖有一块透明玻璃滑板以形成楔形空间，使漆样在其间来冋移动，直到通过滑板及漆层看不见瓷板上凹槽的分界线为止，就可求出最小漆膜厚度。此法用漆量少，测试速度快，适于现代生产控制应用，但仍以目测为主。③对比率测定法，主要适用于白色漆和浅色漆，系把试样以不同厚度涂布于透明聚酯膜上，干燥之后置于黑、白玻璃板上，用仪器测定其反射率，从而得出对比率，当CR=0.98时，即认为全部覆盖，根据漆膜厚度可计算出。此法终点判断准确.但操作较繁杂。
explanation_en: Also known as paint film. The ability of paint film to cover the color or color difference on the substrate. Represented in two ways: the minimum amount of paint required to cover a unit area, expressed in g/m2; Or the minimum paint film thickness required to cover the bottom surface,; The difference between the reflection coefficient of pigment and paint determines the covering power. The size of pigment particles and their dispersion in the paint are also important factors. There are several common test methods: ① unit area weight method, use a paint brush to evenly and quickly brush coatings on the glass plate with black and white spacing until the black and white grids can not be seen. Weigh the used coatings to get g/m2. The endpoint of this method is sometimes difficult to observe, and the flatness and brush marks of the product have an impact on its results. However, it is still widely used due to its simple operation and easy availability of equipment The minimum paint film thickness method is to use two black and white porcelain plates, with grooves and scales engraved on them, and a transparent glass slide plate covered to form a wedge-shaped space, so that the paint sample can move back and forth between them until the dividing line of the grooves on the porcelain plate can not be seen through the slide plate and the paint layer, and then the minimum paint film thickness can be calculated. This method uses less paint and has a fast testing speed, making it suitable for modern production control applications, but still mainly relies on visual inspection The contrast ratio measurement method is mainly applicable to white and light colored paints. It involves coating the sample with different thicknesses on a transparent polyester film, drying it, and placing it on a black and white glass plate. The reflectance is measured using an instrument to obtain the contrast ratio. When CR=0.98, it is considered fully covered and can be calculated based on the thickness of the paint film. This method accurately determines the endpoint, but the operation is more complicated.

explanation_cn: 唐五代最著名的白窑瓷场，苻邢窑由瓷"天下尤贵贱而通用之"的美誉。窑址在今河北省邢台县，因唐时地属邢州，故名邢窑。邢窑除烧造白瓷外，还烧造黑、黄釉瓷等产品。邢窑瓷胎质坚实，胎质细洁纯，器内施满釉，器外釉不到足。在胎、釉之间有一层化妆土，作为护胎釉,其细内瓷袖面光滑，色泽焉白莹润，有"邢瓷类银""邢瓷类宵"的美誉。邢窑的梢细甶瓷，选用优质瓷土烧成，胎质坚实细腻.胎色洁白如雪，釉质莹润.有的薄如蛋壳，透明性能极佳.还原焰烧成。一般器物纯光亮，有些则内中微微泛青。
explanation_en: The most famous white kiln porcelain market of the Tang and Five Dynasties, Fuxing Kiln, is renowned for its "universal and precious" porcelain. The kiln site is located in Xingtai County, Hebei Province, and was named Xingyao due to its location in Xingzhou during the Tang Dynasty. In addition to firing white porcelain, Xing kiln also produces products such as black and yellow glazed porcelain. Xingyao porcelain body is solid, fine, clean and pure. glaze is applied inside the body, but glaze outside the body is not enough. There is a layer of engobe between the body and glaze. As the body protecting glaze, its thin inner porcelain sleeve surface is smooth, and its color is white and shiny. It has the reputation of "Xing porcelain silver" and "Xing porcelain night". Xingyao's finely woven porcelain is made of high-quality china clay, with a solid and delicate body, white as snow, and lustrous glaze. Some are as thin as eggshells, with excellent transparency. It is fired in a reducing flame. Generally, objects are pure and shiny, while some have a slight blueness inside.

explanation_cn: 一种钎焊管。钎焊方法用于钢管工业，可生产双层（或多层）钎焊管、双金属管以及螺旋管等。邦迪管就是指直径在4.6-10.6的细钢管。20世纪30年代初由美国底特律城福特汽车公司邦迪发明，故称邦迪管。主要用作汽车、冰箱的导液、导气管。邦迪管是用冷轧带钢薄板卷管、焊接、镀锌完成的。。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a brazed pipe. The soldering method is used in the steel pipe industry to produce double-layer (or multi-layer) soldering pipes, bimetal pipes and spiral pipes. Bundy tube refers to the thin steel pipe with a diameter of 4.6-10.6. In the early 1930s, it was invented by Ford Motor Company in Detroit, the United States, so it is called Bundy tube Tube. Mainly used as a liquid guide and air duct for cars and refrigerators. Bundy tube is made of cold-rolled strip steel steel sheet, weld and galvanized..

explanation_cn: 用来印刷邮票的纸。为了使图像鲜艳逼真，一般在印刷面进行涂布。在非印刷面涂有背胶，以水润湿即显黏性，便于粘贴。
explanation_en: Paper used for printing stamps. In order to make the image vivid and realistic, it is generally coated on the printed surface. Coated with adhesive on non printed surfaces, it becomes sticky when wet with water, making it easy to stick.

explanation_cn: 邵坡尔磨耗机，又叫旋转辊筒式磨耗机、I)1N磨耗试验机.1985年正式被采纳为国际标准试验。其测试方法是将圆柱形橡胶试样以一定的接触压力压在旋转的砂纸辊筒上，在旋转或无旋转的条件下，让试样在辊筒上作相对移动，测量一定行程后橡胶试样的磨耗体枳。
explanation_en: Shao Po Er wear machine, also known as rotary roller wear machine, I) 1N wear testing machine. It was officially adopted as an international standard test in 1985. The test method is to press a cylindrical rubber sample on a rotating sandpaper roller with a certain contact pressure. Under the condition of rotation or no rotation, let the sample move relative on the roller, and measure the wearing body of the rubber sample after a certain stroke.

explanation_cn: 用邵尔A型硬度计测定的硬度值，是邵氏硬度的一种。用邵氏硬度计i将规定形状的压针在标准的弹簧压力作用下，在规定时间内.把压针压入试样的深度转换为硬度值.是表示材料硬度的一种方法。邵氏硬度可分为A、C和D型，它们的测量原理完全相同，所不同的是测量针的尺寸不同，其中A型的针尖直径为0.79mm。邵氏A型适用于软质塑料和橡胶，其单位为HA。邵氏硬度A的测量范围为20-90之间.用邵氏A型硬度计测定材料硬度值超过90时应改用邵氏D型硬度计。
explanation_en: The hardness value measured by Shore A hardness tester is one of shore hardness. It is a method to express the hardness of materials by using Shore hardness tester i to convert the depth of the indenter pressed into the sample into the hardness value within the specified time under the action of standard spring pressure. Shore hardness can be divided into A, C and D types. Their measuring principles are identical, but the difference is that the size of the measuring needle is different. The tip diameter of A type is 0.79mm. Shore A is applicable to soft plastics and rubber, and its unit is HA. The measurement range of shore hardness A hardness is 20-90. When the hardness value of materials measured by Shore A hardness tester exceeds 90, Shore D hardness tester shall be used instead.

explanation_cn: 用邵氏D型硬度计测定的硬度值。其测定原理和测试方法与邵氏硬度A的一样，即在规定负荷的压痕器作用下，压规定时间.测定压痕器的压针压人硬质橡胶的深度.并以该深度表示硬度，与邵尔A型硬度计不同的是，D型的针尖直径为0.2mm，主要用于测量硬塑料和硬橡胶的硬度.其单位为HD。用D型硬度计测量硬度值低于20时应改测邵氏A,超过90时应改测洛氏硬度。
explanation_en: Hardness value measured with Shore D hardness tester. The measuring principle and method are the same as those of shore hardness A hardness tester, that is, under the action of the indenter with a specified load, press the indenter for a specified time. Measure the depth of the indenter's indenter into the hard rubber, and express the hardness with this depth. Unlike Shore A hardness tester, the diameter of the D type needle is 0.2mm, which is mainly used to measure the hardness of hard plastics and hard rubber. Its unit is HD. When the hardness value measured by D-type hardness meter is lower than 20, Shore A shall be measured again, and when it exceeds 90, Rockwell hardness shall be measured again.

explanation_cn: 氧气和碳氢化合物卞成氢气和一氧化碳的反应或过程。
explanation_en: The reaction or process of converting oxygen and hydrocarbons into hydrogen and carbon monoxide.

explanation_cn: 配位化合物简称配合物-有时又称络合物-是由配位离子（或配位分子〉所组成的化合物，而配位离子(或配位分子）是由一种中心离子（或原子）同几种离子和/或分子（称为配位体〉以配位键的方式结合起来形成具有一定特性的复杂化学质点。它是一类具有相对稳定性，分解后能够产生大量气体的固体配位化合物。其性能取决于构成配位化合物的中心离子、各种配体、外界离子的综合性能。配位化合物起爆药既有起爆药的特征又有猛炸药的特性，是一类"燃烧转爆轰"类起爆药。根据它的密度和外部约束强度的不同表现出不同的性能-在未加约束的粉末状态下-性能像猛炸药。对撞击、冲击钝感-同时火焰感度、静电感度比常规起爆药低。因此-在合成、勤务处理、产品制造中危险性相比于常规起爆药要小。然而当压入雷管管壳白，可用桥丝、火焰起爆-并且迅速转变为爆轰。能较好地完成起爆药的作用。配位化合物起爆药的另一性能特性是爆速比常规起爆药高，一般能够达到6000m/s以上，接近于猛炸药。同时产气量大、残渣少，使得它的爆热、爆容均较大，这些性能常规起爆药目前还无法达到。因此。有些配位化合物起爆药可以用作传爆药、输出装药，实现雷管的单一装药。
explanation_en: Coordination compounds, abbreviated as complexes - sometimes also known as complexes - are compounds composed of coordination ions (or molecules), which are composed of a central ion (or atom) and several ions and/or molecules (called ligand) is combined in the way of coordination bond to form complex chemical particles with certain characteristics. It is a kind of solid coordination compound with relative stability, which can produce a large amount of gas after decomposition. Its performance depends on the comprehensive performance of the central ions, various ligands and external ions constituting the coordination compound. complex primary explosive has the characteristics of both primary explosive and fierce explosive, and is a kind of "Combustion to detonation" type primary explosive. According to its different density and external constraint strength, it has different performance - in the state of unconstrained powder - like explosive. Insensitive to impact and shock - at the same time, flame sensitivity and electrostatic sensitivity are lower than conventional primary explosive. Therefore, compared with conventional primary explosive, it is less dangerous in synthesis, service handling and product manufacturing. However, when the pressed detonator shell is white, the bridge wire and flame can be used to detonate - and quickly transformation into detonation. The function of primary explosive can be well completed. Another performance characteristic of complex primary explosive is that its detonation velocity is higher than that of conventional primary explosive, which can generally reach more than 6000m/s, close to that of heavy explosives. At the same time, the gas production is large and the residue is small, which makes its explosion heat and explosion capacity are large. These properties of conventional primary explosive can not be achieved at present. Therefore. Some complex primary explosive can be used as booster explosive and output charges to achieve a single charge for detonators.

explanation_cn: 物质中一个原子或离子周围最近邻的等距的原子或离子数目。
explanation_en: The number of equidistant atoms or ions in a substance that are closest to each other.

explanation_cn: 配位氢化物是第一主族碱金属或者第二主族碱土金属和第三主族元素等轻金属与氢形成的化合物-例如LiBRi、NaAlH等。配位氢化物储氢一般是不可逆的，但是可以使用催化剂使反应逆转。其体积和质量储氢密度是现有储氢材料中最高的，储氢量高达5.5%-18.5%"。但该类储氢材料放氢动力学和可逆吸放氢性能差，且配位氢化物放氢一般分两步或者多步进行，实际储氢量和理论值有较大差别。可通过加入合适的催化剂改善其储氢性能。
explanation_en: Coordination hydrides are compounds formed by light metals such as the first main group alkali metal or the second main group alkali earth metal and the third main group element with hydrogen - such as LiBRi, NaAlH, etc. Coordination hydride hydrogen storage is generally irreversible, but the reaction can be reversed using a catalyst. Its volume and mass hydrogen storage density is the highest among the existing hydrogen storage materials, and the hydrogen storage capacity is up to 5.5% -18.5%. "However, this type of hydrogen storage materials has poor hydrogen release kinetics and reversible hydrogen absorption and release performance, and the coordinated hydride hydrogen release is generally carried out in two or more steps, and the actual hydrogen storage capacity is significantly different from the theoretical value. The hydrogen storage performance can be improved by adding appropriate catalysts.

explanation_cn: 配位聚合链增长方式是"插入增长"故常称插入聚合(insertionpolymerization)，它是指单体分子首先在活性中心金属原子的空轨道处配合，形成某种形式的配位络合键，随后该单体分子插入金属（M，)-碳（C)键中进行增长，形成大分子的聚合过程。选择不同的催化剂和聚合条件。可以制备特定立构规整的聚合物，常用配位聚合引发剂有：Ziegk、r-Naua(Z-N)催化剂；VT烯丙基过渡金属型催化剂：烷基锂引发剂；茂金属引发剂。高分子工业中的许多重要产品如高密度聚乙烯、等规聚丙烯、顺丁橡胶和异戊橡胶等都是用配位聚合反应制备的。由于聚合物立体结构规整，具有优异的力学性能。
explanation_en: The growth mode of coordination polymerization chain is "insertion growth", so it is often called insertion polymerization. It refers to the polymerization process in which the monomer molecule first cooperates at the empty orbital of the metal atom in the active center to form some form of coordination complex bond, and then the monomer molecule inserts into the metal (M,) - carbon (C) bond to grow, forming macromolecule. Choose different catalysts and polymerization conditions. It can prepare specific stereostructured polymer. Common coordination polymerization initiator include: Ziegk, r-Naua (Z-N) catalysts; VT allyl transition metal catalyst: alkyl lithium initiator; Metallocene initiator. Many important products in the macromolecule industry, such as high density polyethylene, isotactic polypropylene, cis-1,4-polybutadiene rubber and isoprene rubber, are prepared by coordination polymerization. Polymer has excellent mechanical properties due to its regular three-dimensional structure.

explanation_cn: 单体与引发剂经过配位方式进行聚合得到的聚合物。配位聚合链增长方式是插入聚合（insertionpolymerization)-它是指稀类单体的碳-碳双键首先在活性中心金属原子的空轨道处配位、活化，形成某种形式的配位络合键。随后该单体分子相继插入过渡金属（M，)-碳(C)键中进行链增长，形成大分子的聚合过程。最常用的配位聚合催化剂是山过渡金属化合物和金属有机化合物如金属烯丙基化合物（C'H2=CH-CH2)，此处多为过渡金属为价数。由于立体结构规整，具有优异的力学性能，高分子工业中的许多重要产品如高密度聚乙烯、等规聚丙烯、顺丁橡胶和异戊橡胶等都是用配位阴离子聚合反应制备的。
explanation_en: Monomer and initiator are polymerization through coordination to obtain polymer. The growth mode of coordination polymerization chain is insertion polymerization - it means that the carbon carbon double bond of dilute monomer first coordinates and activation or conditioning at the empty orbit of the active center metal atom to form some form of coordination complex bond. Subsequently, the monomer molecules are successively inserted into the transition metal (M,) - carbon (C) bond for chain growth to form the polymerization process of macromolecule. The most commonly used coordination polymerization catalysts are transition metal compounds and organometallic compounds such as metal allyl compounds (C'H2=CH-CH2), where most of them are transition metals. Due to the regular stereo structure and excellent mechanical properties, many important products in the macromolecule industry, such as high density polyethylene, isotactic polypropylene, cis-1,4-polybutadiene rubber and isoprene rubber, are prepared by coordination anion polymerization.

explanation_cn: 又称罗谢耳盐。晶体无色透明，易溶于水。可用水溶液降温法生长。可用作压电元件。
explanation_en: Also known as Rochelle salt. Crystal is colorless and transparent, easy to dissolve in water. Water solution cooling method can be used for growth. Can be used as a piezoelectric component.

explanation_cn: 用丁腈橡胶改性酚醛树脂制得。其组分包括酚醛树脂、丁腈橡胶、催化剂、硫化剂、填充剂、增塑剂、防老剂、偶联剂、溶剂等，兼具有酚醛树脂的耐热性和丁腈橡胶的高弹性，表现出优异的胶结性能，具有很高的黏结强度.尤其是剥离强度较高。耐油、耐水、耐溶剂、耐疲劳、耐盐雾、耐高低温、耐冷热交变、耐湿热老化、耐大气老化等性能良好，使用温度范围宽广（-55~260°C),是目前综合性能优异、用途广泛的一种重要的结构胶黏剂.可用于粘接金属、陶瓷、玻璃、皮革、木材、纸板、尼龙、聚氯乙烯、织物、酚醛树脂、玻璃钢、蜂窝结构、丁睛橡胶等多种材料。
explanation_en: The phenolic resin was modified by acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber. Its components include phenolic resin, acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber, catalyst, vulcanizing agent, filler, plasticizer, antiager, coupling agent, solvent, etc. It has both the heat resistance of phenolic resin and the high elasticity of acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber, showing excellent bonding performance and high bonding strength, especially high peel strength. Oil resistance, water resistance, solvent resistance, fatigue resistance, salt fog resistance, high and low temperature resistance, cold and hot alternation resistance, damp heat aging resistance, atmospheric aging resistance and other properties are good, and the use temperature range is wide (-55~260 ° C). It is an important structural adhesive with excellent comprehensive performance and wide applications. It can be used to bond metal, ceramics, glass, leather, wood, cardboard, nylon resin, polyvinyl chloride, fabric, phenolic resin, glass steel, honeycomb structure Dingjing rubber and other materials.

explanation_cn: 以酚醛树脂为基体的复合材料。酚醛树脂是由苯酚与甲醛缩合而形成的产物，也是世界上最早合成的聚合物。通常有热塑性与热固性两种类型，前者需要加固化剂才能固化，后者可自身反应固化。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on phenolic resin. Phenolic resin is the product formed by the condensation of phenol and formaldehyde, and it is also the first polymer synthesized in the world. There are usually two types of thermoplastics and thermosets. The former requires curing agent to curing, and the latter can react curing by itself.

explanation_cn: 酚酵树脂涂料。以酚醛树脂为主要成膜物质的涂料。可分为改性酚醛树脂涂料和纯酚醛树脂涂料两大类。
explanation_en: Phenolic fermentation resin coatings. Coatings with phenolic resin as main film-forming material. It can be divided into two categories: modified phenolic resin coatings and pure phenolic resin coatings.

name_cn: 酚醛环氧树脂基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以酚醛环氧树脂为基体的复合材料。酚醛环氧树脂是线型酚醛树脂与环氧丙烷缩聚而成，室温下一般呈高黏度或半固体状态，固化产物交联密度大、耐热性高、收缩率低、脆性较大。
explanation_en: Composite materials based on phenolic epoxy resin. Phenolic epoxy resin is the condensation of linear phenolic resin and epoxy propane. It is generally in a high viscosity or semi-solid state at room temperature. The curing product has high crosslinking density, high heat resistance, low shrinkage and high brittleness.

explanation_cn: 指由线型聚酚醛树脂熔融纺丝而成的纤维，经缩醛化或络合化而成的具有三维交联结构的阻燃有机纤维。
explanation_en: It refers to the flame retardant organic fiber with three-dimensional crosslinking structure, which is made of linear polyphenolic resin by melt spinning and acetalization or complexation.

explanation_cn: 以酚醛树脂为基料的胶黏剂，可分为钡酚醛树脂胶黏剂（游离酚含量高达20%)、醇溶性酚醛树脂胶黏剂（游离酚<5%)和水溶性酚醛树脂胶黏剂（游离酚<2.5%)。特点是胶结力强、耐高温、在300℃仍保持较高胶接强度，但性脆、剥离强度低。
explanation_en: Adhesive based on phenolic resin can be divided into barium phenolic resin adhesive (free phenol content up to 20%), alcohol soluble phenolic resin adhesive (free phenol<5%) and water-soluble phenolic resin adhesive (free phenol<2.5%). It is characterized by strong bonding force, high temperature resistance, high bonding strength at 300 ℃, but brittle and low peel strength.

explanation_cn: 指具有献菁结构的一类染料。它是由酞菁素在纤维上缩合.然后再与金属络合（铜或铬、锌、镍、锰等）而制成的，呈鲜艳的绿色至蓝色，具有着色力强和坚牢度高的优点。当酞素单体在织物上缩合成四聚体后，酞菁大分子中氮原子上的两个氢原子被加人的酞菁助剂中的铜离子取代，形成配位键.络合生成铜酞菁，使织物呈现蓝色。酞菁染料色光鲜艳，日晒牢度和湿处理牢度等都很高.是目前染料中罕见的品种之一，其印染产品广受国内外欢迎。
explanation_en: It refers to a class of dye or dyestuffc with cyanine donating structure. It is made by condensation of phthalocyanine on fibers and then complexing with metals (such as copper or chromium, zinc, nickel, manganese, etc.). It is bright green to blue and has the advantages of strong coloring power and high firmness. When the monomer of phthalocyanine shrinks onto the fabric to form a tetramer, the two hydrogen atoms on the nitrogen atom in the macromolecule of phthalocyanine are replaced by copper ions in the added phthalocyanine auxiliary, forming a coordination bond, complexing to form copper phthalocyanine, making the fabric appear blue. Phthalocyanine dye or dyestuffc have bright colors, high light fastness and wet treatment fastness, etc. It is one of the rare varieties of dye or dyestuffc at present, and its printing and dyeing products are widely welcomed at home and abroad.

explanation_cn: 干酪素又称酪朊或酪素，属含磷蛋白质，是动物乳汁提取物。酪素胶的一般制备方法是：将定量的水分成三份，一份用于浸泡酪素，使其溶胀；一份和氢氧化钙混合，调成石灰乳；另一份用于溶解氢氧化钠。在使用前将上述二种成分混合配制成胶液。为改善酪素胶黏剂的抗霉性，常常加人一些甲醛、苯酚等。为提高胶的耐水性，可以在配制的最后把耐水增强剂氯化铜或硫酸铜2-3g，用少量水溶解后加人胶液中。酪素胶耐热可达70°，但在潮湿条件下粘接强度降低，且易于发生生物破坏，加入氯代苯酚可减小破坏趋势。酪素胶是非结构性胶黏剂，可以用来粘接木材、陶瓷、玻璃、棉布和硬纸，在木器加工中，用于室内大型木结构件的层压，也用作一般的室内木器加工，包括家具。用酪素胶粘接的洋榆和水曲柳的标准试样，其剪切强度不低于lOMPa。把耐水性试样放在15-20°C的水中、浸泡24h后，其粘接强度不低于7MPa。
explanation_en: Casein, also known as casein or casein, is a phosphorus containing protein that is an extract of animal milk. The general preparation method of casein glue is: divide the quantitative water into three parts, and one part is used to soak casein to make it swelling; One part is mixed with calcium hydroxide to form lime milk; Another portion is used to dissolve sodium hydroxide. Mix the above two ingredients before use to prepare a gel solution. In order to improve the mildew resistance of casein adhesive, some formaldehyde and phenol are often added. In order to improve the water resistance of the glue, 2-3g of water resistant reinforcing agent copper chloride or copper sulfate can be added into the glue solution after being dissolved with a small amount of water at the end of preparation. The heat resistance of casein glue can reach 70 °, but the adhesive strength decreases under wet conditions, and it is prone to biological damage. The addition of chlorophenol can reduce the damage trend. Casein adhesive is a non structural adhesive, which can be used to bond wood, ceramics, glass, cotton cloth and hard paper. In wood processing, it is used for laminating large indoor wood structural parts, and also for general indoor wood processing, including furniture. The shear strength of the standard samples of Ulmus pumila and Fraxinus mandshurica bonded with casein glue is not less than lOMPa. Put the water resistance sample in 15-20 ° C water and soak it for 24h, its adhesive strength shall not be less than 7MPa.

explanation_cn: 是覆盖一层固定化酶膜的电极，是早期生物传感器的一种。自1962年Leland C.Clark报道第一个安培计量酶电极测量葡萄糖溶度以来得到快速发展。酶电极上的酶膜能催化许多底物如乙醇、氨基酸、葡萄糖、乳糖、胆固醇、青霉素等。反应中产生的电子从反应物转移到电极并由此产生电流形成信号。酶电极按照检测底物原理的不同一般分为三种类型:①安培计量酶电极，其电压为O,而直接测量酶催化底物发生反应过程中的电子转移形成的电流；②电势计量酶电极，主要测量电极上电势的变化，控制电流为0,酶催化反应产生的电子势能与该电极电势中和从而得到信号；③电导计量酶电极，通过测量酶催化反应过程中电导率的变化得到信号。因为电子从酶转移到电极上的效率不髙，通常需在电极表面覆盖一层介导化合物薄层(10-200mm)提高电子转移效率。由于酶的专一性强，酶电极具有选择性好、测量速度快、使用方便、不破坏样品等优点，特別是能用于生物溶液活体组织中某组分的连续监控，从而在生化研究、生物监测等方面可发挥重要的作用。
explanation_en: It is an electrode covered with a layer of immobilized enzyme membrane and is one of the early biosensor. Since Leland C. Clark reported the first amperometric enzyme electrode to measure glucose solubility in 1962, it has developed rapidly. The enzyme membrane on the enzyme electrode can catalyze many substrates such as ethanol, amino acid, glucose, lactose, cholesterol, penicillin, etc. The electrons generated in the reaction are transferred from the reactant to the electrode and generate a current to form a signal. The enzyme electrode is generally divided into three types according to the principle of substrate detection: ① amperometric enzyme electrode, whose voltage is O, directly measures the current formed by electron transfer during the reaction of enzyme catalyzed substrate; ② Potentiometric enzyme electrode is mainly used to measure the change of the potential on the electrode, control the current to 0, and neutralize the electronic potential energy generated by the enzyme catalytic reaction with the potential of the electrode to get the signal; ③ The conductance of enzyme electrode is measured, and the signal is obtained by measuring the change of electric conductivity in the process of enzyme catalytic reaction. Due to the low efficiency of electron transfer from the enzyme to the electrode, it is usually necessary to cover the surface of the electrode with a thin layer of mediating compound (10-200mm) to improve the electron transfer efficiency. Due to the strong specificity of enzyme, enzyme electrode has the advantages of good selectivity, fast measurement speed, convenient use, and non destruction of samples. Especially, it can be used for continuous monitoring of a component in living tissue of biological solution, thus playing an important role in biochemical research, biological monitoring, etc.

explanation_cn: 将酶固定在管状高分子材料上制成的固定化酶。临床诊断中用以检测血液或尿液中的双糖、乳糖、尿酸、肌酐等。将转化酶及葡萄糖氧化酶固定在尼龙管内壁，可以测定双糖如蔗糖的含量。同时，将相应的酶及葡萄糖氧化酶固定化后可测定麦芽糖和乳糖。上述各反应中均产生葡萄糖及H2O2，利用H202与KI的反应就可以定量测定双糖的含量，用固定化酶测定血清和尿中尿素的含量是研究最多的一个实例。将脲酶固定在尼龙管内制成酶管，可定量测定血清和尿中尿素的含量。同样的方法也可以测定肌酐等的含量。
explanation_en: Immobilized enzyme made by immobilizing enzyme on tubular macromolecule materials. Used in clinical diagnosis to detect disaccharides, lactose, uric acid, creatinine, etc. in blood or urine. Immobilizing invertase and glucose oxidase on the inner wall of nylon tubes can determine the content of disaccharides such as sucrose. Meanwhile, the corresponding enzymes and glucose oxidase can be immobilized to determine maltose and lactose. Glucose and H2O2 are produced in each of the above reactions. The reaction between H202 and KI can be used to quantitatively determine the content of disaccharides. The use of immobilized enzymes to determine the content of urea in serum and urine is the most studied example. Urease is fixed in a nylon resin tube to make an enzyme tube, which can quantitatively determine the content of urea in serum and urine. The same method can also determine the content of creatinine and other substances.

explanation_cn: 将酶固定化在试纸上制成的一种同定化酶。这种酶试纸用于临床分析时具有选择性强、灵敏度高、速度快、向动化程度高和无污染等优点。Free等人将葡萄糖氧化酶和过氧化氢酶固定在试纸上制成半定量的葡萄糖试纸，可测定体液和尿中的葡萄糖含量。染料的颜色与糖的浓度有关，反应如下:酶试纸还可用于半乳糖含量的测定，将半乳糖氧化酶固定化在试纸上(附带一个指示剂)，放在尿中就可以发生颜色变化，由颜色的深度吋以测出半乳糖的含量。
explanation_en: An isoenzyme made by immobilizing an enzyme on a test paper. The enzyme test paper has the advantages of strong selectivity, high sensitivity, fast speed, high degree of tropism and no pollution when used for clinical analysis. Free et al. fixed glucose oxidase and catalase on test strips to produce semi quantitative glucose test strips, which can measure glucose content in body fluids and urine. The color of dye or dyestuffc is related to the concentration of sugar, and the reaction is as follows: the enzyme test paper can also be used for the determination of galactose content. The galactose oxidase is immobilized on the test paper (with an indicator), and the color change can occur when it is put in the urine. The galactose content can be measured by the depth of the color.

explanation_cn: “SiO2‘’含量高于63%的一大类火成岩。以石英、酸性斜长石和碱性长石等浅色矿物为主，但含少量黑云母、白云母、角闪石等暗色矿物。岩石颜色一般较浅，多呈灰白色。常见的酸性侵人岩以花岗岩和花岗闪长岩最常见，喷出岩以流纹岩最多。与酸性岩有关的矿产非常丰富，有钨、锡、铍、铜、铅、锌、铁、金、铌、钽、稀土以及高岭土、膨润土、沸石、叶蜡石、明矾石、萤石等。
explanation_en: "A large class of igneous rocks with SiO2 '' content higher than 63%. It is mainly composed of light colored minerals such as quartze, acid plagioclase and alkaline feldspar, but contains a small amount of dark colored minerals such as biotite, muscovilte, hornblende, etc. rock are generally light in color, mostly grayish white. granite and granodiorite are the most common acidic intrusive rocks, and rhyolite is the most common eject rocks. acidic rock are very rich in minerals, including tungsten, tin, beryllium, copper, lead Zinc, iron, gold, niobium, tantalum, rare earth, kaolin, bentonite, zeolite, pyrophyllite, alunite, fluorite, etc.

explanation_cn: 药皮以酸性氧化物为主的焊条称酸性焊条。药皮主要组成物是硅酸盐或钛酸盐。在结构钢焊条中酸性焊条有钛型、钛钙型、钛铁矿型、氧化铁型以及纤维素型焊条。酸性药皮压涂性好.可用螺旋机制造。与强度级别相同的碱性焊条相比.酸性焊条的焊缝金属塑性和韧性稍差，扩散氢含量较高，但焊接工艺性较好，施焊时电弧稳定、飞溅少、脱渣容易、焊缝成形好。推荐用交流电源焊接，也可用直流电源焊接（焊条接负极）。酸性焊条的用途因药皮组成不同而异。在结构钢焊条中，钛型焊条适于薄板全位置焊接；钛钙型焊条用于较重要的结构焊接；钛铁矿型焊条适于中厚板全位置焊接，焊接效率较高；氧化铁型焊条的立焊与仰焊操作性较差，适于中厚板平焊；纤维素型焊条可进行立向下焊接.反面成型良好.常用于管接头的焊接。
explanation_en: The electrode whose coating is mainly acid oxide is called acidic electrode. The main component of the drug coating is silicate or titanate. In structural steel electrode, acidic electrode includes titanium type, titanium calcium type, ilmenite type, iron oxide type and cellulose type electrode. Acid drug skin has good pressure coating properties and can be manufactured using a screw machine. Compared with the basic welding rod with the same strength level, the weld metal of the acidic electrode is slightly less plastic and ductile, and the diffusion hydrogen content is higher, but the weld process is better, the arc is stable, the spatter is less, the slag is easy to be removed, and the weld formation is good. AC power supply is recommended for weld, and DC power supply can also be used for weld (electrode is connected to the negative pole). The use of acidic electrode varies with the composition of coating. Among structural steel electrode, titanium electrode is suitable for all position weld of thin plates; Titanium calcium type electrode is used for weld of more important structures; Ilmenite type electrode is suitable for all position weld of medium and thick plates, and weld efficiency is high; The iron oxide type electrode has poor operability for vertical welding and overhead welding, and is suitable for flat welding of medium and thick plates; Cellulose type electrode can be used for vertical down weld. The reverse side is well formed. It is commonly used for weld of pipe joints.

explanation_cn: 通常指SiO2含量较高的耐火材料。在高温下耐酸性渣侵蚀性能好。
explanation_en: It usually refers to refractory with high SiO2 content. At high temperature, the acid resistance of slag is good.

explanation_cn: 一种能在光的作用下，通过光化学反应释放出小分子酸性物质，进而引起材料内预加人的酸敏染料变色而成像的信息记录材料。这类材料由含卤共聚物（偏氯乙烯-丙烯酸酯）和酸敏染料（如三芳基甲烷染料）等组成，在光照、电子束和X射线等作用下，含卤共聚物受激释放出卤化氢，使酸敏染料形成醌式结构，导致颜色变化，从而可记录信息、显示图像。这类材料可用于作光阀介质、高能加速器和准分子激光器轨迹和强度的检测，也适于紫外线消毒等剂量的监测和控制。
explanation_en: A kind of information recording materials that can release small molecules of acid substances through photochemical reaction under the action of light, and then cause the color change of acid sensitive dyes pre added in materials to form images. This kind of materials consists of halogenated copolymer (vinylidene chloride acrylate) and acid sensitive dye or dyestuffc (such as triarylmethane dye or dyestuffc). Under the action of light, electron beam and X-ray, the halogenated copolymer is stimulated to release hydrogen halide, which makes the acid sensitive dye or dyestuffc form a quinone structure, resulting in color changes, so that information can be recorded and images can be displayed. This kind of materials can be used for the detection of light valve medium, high-energy accelerator and excimer laser track and intensity, and also suitable for the monitoring and control of ultraviolet disinfection dose.

explanation_cn: 动物皮经过脱毛、脱灰和软化等操作后再用盐和酸处理得到的在制品。可以进行储存和运输。
explanation_en: Animal skins are processed with salt and acid after unhairing, deliming and bating. It can be stored and transported.

explanation_cn: 通过物理吸附或化学反应对产生酸雨的硫化物及氮化物的排放量进行控制来减小其衍生物对自然界造成危害的材料。常用的酸雨控制材料有H2S吸收溶剂、H2S固体吸附剂、S02吸收溶剂、S02固体吸附剂、氮氧化物吸收溶剂、氮氧化物固体吸附剂、氮氧化物分解催化材料等。
explanation_en: Materials that reduce the harm of their derivatives to nature by controlling the emissions of sulfides and nitrides that generate acid rain through physical adsorption or chemical reaction. Common acid rain control materials include H2S absorption solvent, H2S solid adsorbent, S02 absorption solvent, S02 solid adsorbent, absorption solvents of nitrogen oxides, nitrogen oxide solid adsorbem, catalytic decomposition materials of nitrogen oxides, etc.

explanation_cn: 一类以多元醇与多元酸(酐）为主要原料.通过缩聚反应生成的具有不同支链结构和不同分子量的聚酯树脂，主要用于涂料T：业。其代表品种为邻苯二甲酸型醇酸树脂，通过邻苯二甲酸酐与多元醇（如丙三醇、季戊四醇等）共缩聚而得，性脆，D93溶解性差，易凝胶。工业中通常引人、元树脂酸（松香酸）、不饱和脂肪酸（桐油、蓖麻油酸）及饱和脂肪酸共缩聚改性，在醇酸树脂中形成支链结构，降低交联密度，提高其溶解性、与清漆中各组分的相容性和耐热性，增加制品的柔性与弹性。醇酸树脂基涂层、漆膜使用寿命长、光泽度好，具有良好的耐水性、耐挠性、耐热性、耐冲击性和尺寸稳定性，拉伸强度20.6~32.4MPa.冲击强度CWlSWm、体积电阻率lX1012n.cm,收缩率0.4%~0.7%醇酸树脂是一类使用最广的涂料树脂.主要应用于涂料领域,也可用作胶黏剂、增韧剂及油墨等
explanation_en: The first kind is polyester resin with different branch chain structure and molecular weight, which is produced through polycondensation reaction reaction with polyol and polyacid (anhydride) as main raw materials, and is mainly used in coatings industry. The representative variety is phthalic acid type alkyd resin, which is obtained by co condensation of phthalic anhydride and polyols (such as glycerol, pentaerythritol, etc.). It is brittle, D93 has poor solubility, and is easy to gel. In industry, it is often used to introduce the co condensation modification of human, meta resin acid (rosin acid), unsaturated fatty acid (tung oil, castor oil acid) and saturated fatty acid to form a branched chain structure in alkyd resin, reduce the crosslinking density, improve its solubility, compatibility and heat resistance with each component in varnish, and increase the flexibility and elasticity of products. Alkyd resin based coating and paint film have long service life, good glossiness, good water resistance, flexibility resistance, heat resistance, impact resistance and dimensional stability, tensile strength of 20.6~32.4MPa. impact strength CWlSWm, coefficient of volume resistance lX1012n. cm, shrinkage of 0.4%~0.7% alkyd resin is the most widely used coatings resin. It is mainly used in the field of coatings, and can also be used as adhesive, toughener, ink, etc

explanation_cn: 以醇酸树脂为主要成膜物质的涂料。醇酸树脂是由多元醇、多元酸和脂肪酸经缩聚而得到的一种特殊的聚酯树脂。用甘油（丙醇）和季戊四醇为多元醇；多元酸多用邻苯二甲酸酐，有时也用顺丁烯二酸酐；脂肪酸来源于各种植物油脂。植物油在配方中所占的比例，成为树脂的油丨度.以含油量的多少，分为短、中、长三种油度。不i含植物油的称为无油醇酸树脂。为改进醇酸涂料的性能.还用松香、酚醛、苯乙烯、丙烯酸、环氧、有机硅等树脂或单体进行改性。醇酸树脂涂料产量居首位，是使用面极广的品种.有清漆、磁漆、调和漆、底漆、二道底漆、烘干底漆、腻子、防锈漆、电泳漆、绝缘漆、抗弧漆、漆包线漆、电容器漆、电阻漆、耐热漆、隔热漆、烟囱漆、标志漆、水砂纸漆、半光漆、无光漆等。醇酸树脂涂料的性能：①涂层有良好的柔韧性、附着力和机械强度；②颜料、填料能i均匀分散，涂膜颜色均匀，遮盖力好，外观丰满；③涂层耐久性、保光性好；④耐溶剂、耐热性较好，i但耐水性较差
explanation_en: Coatings with alkyd resin as the main film-forming material. Alkyd resin is a special polyester resin obtained by polycondensation of polyols, polybasic acids and fatty acids. Using glycerol (propanol) and pentaerythritol as polyols; Polybasic acids often use phthalic anhydride and sometimes maleic anhydride; Fatty acids come from various plant oils. The proportion of vegetable oil in the formula is the oil content of resin. According to the oil content, it can be divided into short, medium and long oil content. Oil free alkyd resin resin is called if it does not contain vegetable oil. In order to improve the performance of alkyd coatings, rosin, phenolic, styrene, acrylic acid, epoxy, silicone and other resin or monomer are also used for modification. Alkyd resin coatings rank first in terms of output and are widely used, including varnish, enamel, ready-mixed paint, primer, second layer primer, drying primer, patty, antirust paint, electrophoretic paint, insulating paint, arc resistant paint, enamelled wire paint, capacitor paint, resistance paint, heat resistant paint, heat insulation paint, chimney paint, marking paint, water sand paper paint, semi-gloss paint, matte paint, etc. Performance of alkyd resin coatings: ① the coating has good flexibility, adhesion and mechanical strength; ② Pigment and fillers can be evenly dispersed, the film color is uniform, the hiding power is good, and the appearance is plump; ③ The coating has good durability and light retention; ④ Good solvent and heat resistance, but poor water resistance

explanation_cn: 在涂刷后形成硬度大、光泽高、平整光滑漆膜的油漆称之为瓷漆、瓷油按其成膜成分町分钙脂瓷漆、酯交瓷漆、酚醛瓷漆、醇酸瓷漆、氨基瓷漆、环氧瓷漆等。按其用途又可分为内用瓷漆、外用瓷漆。
explanation_en: The paint with high hardness, high gloss, flat and smooth paint film after brushing is called enamel. According to its film forming components, ceramic oil can be divided into calcium grease enamel, ester enamel, phenolic enamel, alkyd enamel, amino enamel, epoxy enamel, etc. According to its use, it can be divided into internal enamel and external enamel.

explanation_cn:
醋酯纤维，是由纤维素与醋酐发生反应，生成纤维素醋酸酯，经纺丝而成的纤维，是一种半合成纤维材料，按醋酯化程度不同，分为二醋酯和三醋酯两类。二醋酯纤维的酯化程度低，能溶解于丙酮。三醋酯纤维的酯化程度高，不溶于丙酮，但能溶于三氯甲烷或二氯甲烷。
与粘胶纤维有所不同，在醋酯纤维中，纤维素环上的羟基大部或全部被乙酰化。醋酯纤维的纵向为附有条纹的光滑圆柱形，横断面为椭圆形。由于其结晶度和侧序度低，醋酯纤维的断裂强度差，在湿态时更差，但断裂延伸率高，弹性回复性明显较粘胶纤维强。醋酯纤维的吸湿量在标准条件下为6%~7%，在水中的膨胀性较低。其制成品易于洗涤，甚至用热水洗时几乎不会收缩。醋酯纤维耐日晒能力好，超过锦纶、粘胶纤维及棉纤维，受热时先软化变形，后缓缓燃烧，并有助燃性。
explanation_en: Cellulose acetate fiber is a kind of semi synthetic fiber materials that is spun from cellulose and acetic anhydride to produce cellulose acetate. It can be divided into diacetate and triacetate according to the degree of esterification. Diacetate fibers have a low degree of esterification and can be dissolved in acetone. Triacetate fibers have a high degree of esterification and are insoluble in acetone, but can be soluble in chloroform or dichloromethane. Different from viscose fiber, in cellulose acetate fiber, most or all of the hydroxyl groups on the cellulose ring are acetylated. The longitudinal direction of cellulose acetate fiber is smooth cylindrical with stripes, and the cross section is elliptical. Due to its low crystallinity and lateral degree, cellulose acetate fiber has poor fracture strength, even worse in wet state, but it has high fracture elongation, and elasticity recovery is obviously stronger than viscose fiber. The moisture absorption of cellulose acetate fiber is 6%~7% under standard conditions, and its expansibility in water is low. The finished product is easy to wash, and even when washed with hot water, it hardly shrinks. Cellulose acetate fiber has good sun resistance, surpassing nylon, viscose fiber and cotton fiber. When heated, it first bating and deforms, then slowly combustion, and has combustion supporting properties.

explanation_cn: 用于制作高透明度、耐候性好的塑料片基、薄膜和各种涂料的流平剂、成膜物质等。丁酰基含量增加则使其密度降低，溶解范围扩大。含乙酰基12%～15%，丁酰基26%～29%。透明或不透明粒料，质坚韧，耐候及耐寒性好。
