explanation_en: It is used as leveling agent and film forming material for making plastic film base, film and various coatings with high transparency and good weather resistance. The increase of butyryl content will reduce its density and expand its dissolution range. Contains 12% to 15% acetyl groups and 26% to 29% butyryl groups. Transparent or opaque granular material, with tough texture, good weather and cold resistance.

explanation_cn: 利用天然矿物原料及某些化工原料按比例配合，在高温作用下熔融而覆盖在坯体表面的富有光泽的玻璃质层。其制法是将矿物原料（如长石、方解石、石英、滑石、高岭土等）和化工原料（如ZnO、BaCO3等，部分水溶性原料如KN03、Na2O3等可先制成熔块）按一定比例配合，经过细磨制成浆，用浸、喷、刷、荡、醮、淋等方法施于坯体上，再经高温熔融而成。层中主要以玻璃相为主，含少量晶体和气泡。可使陶瓷制品不透水，表面光润，不易沾污，并在一定程度上能提高制品的机械强度、电性能以及热稳定性等，颜色袖还有美观和装饰作用。的种类按组成可分为石灰袖、石灰-碱、长石袖、铅袖、铅硼、硼、盐、土等;按外观可分成透明、乳浊、颜色袖、结晶、半光、无光、碎纹等。料中部分原料为熔块时称为熔块袖;不用熔块称为生料.按照袖的熔融温度的高低还可分为高温、中温及低温.
explanation_en: Using natural raw mineral material and some chemical raw materials in proportion, it is a shiny glass layer that melts under high temperature and covers the surface of green body. The preparation method is to mix raw mineral material (such as feldspar, caldte, quartze, talc, kaolin, etc.) and chemical raw materials (such as ZnO, BaCO3, etc., and some water-soluble raw materials such as KN03, Na2O3, etc. can be made into frits first) in a certain proportion, and then fine grind them into slurry, apply them to the green body by dipping, spraying, brushing, swinging, dipping, leaching, etc., and then melt them at high temperature. The layer is mainly composed of glass phase, with a small amount of crystal and bubbles. It can make ceramics products watertight, smooth and not easy to stain, and to a certain extent, it can improve the mechanical strength, electrical performance and thermal stability of products. Color sleeves also have aesthetic and decorative functions. According to composition, it can be divided into lime sleeve, lime alkali, feldspar sleeve, lead sleeve, lead boron, boron, salt, soil, etc; According to the appearance, it can be divided into transparent, opaque, color sleeve, crystal, semi gloss, matte, broken grain, etc. When some of the raw materials in the material are frits, they are called frit sleeves; No frit is called raw material. It can also be divided into high temperature, medium temperature and low temperature according to the melting temperature of the sleeve

explanation_cn: 采用低温彩料在釉烧过的陶瓷釉上彩绘，然后在600-900°C温度下彩烤的瓷器。釉上彩彩料通常由颜料与熔剂配成，熔剂一般是一种低熔点铅硅酸盐玻璃料，降低彩料的熔化温度，使彩料牢固胶结在陶瓷釉上使釉料具有光泽和平滑性以及协助颜料发色，颜料可以用人工合成或天然矿物的颜料。釉上彩料使用时都需加入使彩料具有流动性的调料，调料有油和水两种油调料常用乳香油、樟脑油、煤油与广胶水。釉上彩用手触摸时有凸起感，其彩烧温度低，色彩丰富。但画面光泽度差，彩绘画面容易磨损脱落，受酸性物质侵蚀时会溶出铅、镉等毒性元素。釉彩包括釉上红彩、宋加彩、五彩、粉彩、袖彩、墨彩等。
explanation_en: The porcelain is painted on the glaze of ceramics that has been burned with low-temperature color materials, and then baked at 600-900 ° C. The color material on glaze is usually composed of pigment and flux. The flux is generally a low melting point lead silicate glass material, which can reduce the melting temperature of the color material, make the color material firmly bonded on the ceramic glaze, make the glaze shiny and smooth, and help pigment develop color. pigment can be synthetic or natural mineral pigment. When using glaze color materials, it is necessary to add seasonings that make the color materials have flow ability. The seasonings include oil and water. The common seasonings are frankincense oil, camphor oil, kerosene and glue water. The color on glaze has a sense of bulge when touched by hand, its color burning temperature is low, and the color is rich. However, the glossiness of the picture is poor, and the painted picture is easy to wear and fall off, and toxic elements such as lead and cadmium will be dissolved when eroded by acidic substances. Enamel decoration includes glaze red color, Song Jiacai, Wucai, famille rose decoration, sleeve color, ink color, etc.

explanation_cn: 在未烧或素烧的坯体上用陶瓷色料进行彩绘，然后施上透明釉后人窑经高温（1200-1400°C)烧成的瓷器品种。釉下彩的特点是彩在釉下，画面光亮柔和，不变色，耐腐蚀，永不磨损。用手触摸光滑平整，一次烧成，操作比釉上彩方便。发色鲜艳，无铅无毒。缺点是有些色料在高温下易于分解，故其画面与色调不如釉上彩丰富。釉下彩料由颜料、胶结剂和描绘剂组成，胶结剂是指能使颜料在高温烧成后能黏附在坯体上的材料.常用釉料、釉下熔剂或长石等。描绘剂是指在彩绘时使用陶瓷颜料能展开的材料，如茶汁，阿拉伯树胶、甘油与水、牛胶与水、棉汁与水，乳香油或松节油等。有青花、釉里红、釉下三彩、釉下五彩、釉下褐彩、褐绿彩、青花玲珑和青花釉里红等品种。
explanation_en: Porcelain that is painted with ceramics pigments on unburned or plain fired bodies, and then painted with transparent glaze. The characteristics of glaze color are that the color is under glaze, the picture is bright and soft, does not change color, is corrosion resistant, and never wear. It is smooth and smooth to touch with hands, and can be fired at one time. The operation is more convenient than glaze painting. Bright hair color, lead-free and non-toxic. The disadvantage is that some pigments are easy to decompose at high temperatures, so their pictures and colors are not as rich as those of glaze colors. The glaze color material consists of pigment, cementitious agent and paint. cementitious agent refers to materials that can make pigment stick to the body after firing at high temperature. Common glaze, glaze flux or feldspar. Painter refers to materials that can be unfolded when ceramics pigment are used in color painting, such as tea juice, gum arabic, glycerin and water, cow glue and water, cotton juice and water, mastic oil or turpentine, etc. There are blue and white, glaze red, glaze three color, glaze five color, glaze brown color, brown green color, blue and white exquisite and blue and white glaze red.

explanation_cn: 采用介于釉上和釉下的釉中彩颜料，加上釉上彩相似的装饰方法，近年来发展起来的一种高温快烧陶瓷。在高温快烧的条件下，制品釉面软化熔融，颜料的颗粒渗入釉内，当冷却后釉面封闭花色便沉浸在釉中使外观变得滋润恍月，细腻晶莹，呈现出类似釉下彩的效果。这种用高温快烧颜料装饰的"釉中彩"具有独特的风格，其色彩玉润柔和，制品耐机械磨损性能和抗腐蚀性能强，同时彻底解决了陶瓷器"铅毒"的危害。与釉下彩相比，工艺简便，烧成时间短，成品率高，劳动生产率高，且便于机械化连续化生产。
explanation_en: A kind of high temperature fast firing ceramics developed in recent years, which uses glaze mid color pigment between glaze and glaze, and uses decoration methods similar to overglaze color. Under the condition of high temperature and fast firing, the glaze surface of the product is bating and melted, and the particles of pigment penetrate into the glaze. When the glaze is cooled, the closed patterns and colors will be immersed in the glaze, making the appearance moist, delicate and crystal clear, presenting the effect similar to that of glaze color. This kind of "glaze mid color" decorated with high-temperature fast burning pigment has a unique style. Its color is smooth and soft, and its products have strong mechanical wear resistance and corrosion resistance. At the same time, it completely solves the harm of "lead poisoning" of ceramics. Compared with glaze color, the process is simple, the firing time is short, the yield is high, the labor productivity is high, and it is convenient for mechanized continuous production.

explanation_cn: 中国传统釉下彩瓷的名贵品种之一。用含铜的彩料在素胎上描绘纹饰，施透明釉后，在高温下还原烧成，在釉里透出红色的纹样.故称釉里红。红彩色阔有浓有淡.偶见绿斑。元代景德镇窑首先烧制成功。明洪武年间较为盛行，但大件器往往红色晕散而不太鲜艳。宣德时期官窑釉里红烧制最为成功，以红鱼耙杯最负盛名。但明朝中期以后一度没落，明末景德镇民窑虽也有少量生产，但均为小件器。清康熙时期才恢复明代前期水平。雍正时期是釉里红最成功的时期。特別是青花和釉里红施于同一器上的青花釉里红器更为名贵，这类产品既具有青花的雅致沉静.又增添釉里红的明丽浑厚。乾隆时期以后，釉里红技术一直没有达到雍正时期水平。釉淤余逾玉育预
explanation_en: One of the rare varieties of Chinese traditional glaze colored porcelain. Paints containing copper are used to paint patterns on the plain body. After transparent glaze is applied, it is reduced and fired at high temperature. The glaze shows red patterns, so it is called glaze red. Red is colorful, with thick and light colors. Green spots are occasionally seen. The Jingdezhen kiln of the Yuan Dynasty was the first to be successfully fired. During the Hongwu reign of the Ming Dynasty, it was relatively popular, but large items were often scattered in red and not very bright. During the Xuande period, the glaze braising in the official kiln was the most successful, and the red fish raking cup was the most famous. But after the middle of the Ming Dynasty, it declined for a while. Although there was also a small amount of production in Jingdezhen folk kilns at the end of the Ming Dynasty, they were all small artifacts. It was only during the Kangxi period of the Qing Dynasty that the level of the early Ming Dynasty was restored. Yongzheng period is the most successful period of glaze red. In particular, the blue and white glaze red ware with blue and white and glaze red applied on the same ware is more valuable. This kind of product not only has the elegance and quietness of blue and white, but also adds the brightness and richness of glaze red. After the Qianlong period, the glaze red technology has not reached the level of the Yongzheng period. The residual glaze is more than jade

explanation_cn: 上釉的陶器。有低温和高温两类。中国汉代的铅为低温，釉的主要成分是铅和石英砂，PbO含量高达50%以上，不能用于日用器皿。主要用于装饰、陪葬用的陶质器物和俑，有绿、蓝、黄、白等色。绿色的着色剂为铜，蓝色的为钴，黄色的为铁.白色的为含铅的低铁内色黏土。烧成温度在l000°C左右。中国唐宋时代的低温，其绿釉部分较易风化而形成银色，俗称"银釉"。高温的胎也属陶质，但釉则采用高温釉。可以先高温素烧，上釉后再低温釉烧。也可一次烧成。主要用于日用器皿、建筑、市政、工农业方面。
explanation_en: Glazed pottery. There are two types: low temperature and high temperature. The lead in the Han Dynasty of China was low temperature. The main components of glaze were lead and quartz sand. The content of PbO was more than 50%, so it could not be used for household utensils. Ceramic artifacts and figurines mainly used for decoration and burial, with colors such as green, blue, yellow, and white. The green colorant is copper, the blue one is cobalt, the yellow one is iron, and the white one is low iron clay containing lead. The firing temperature is around 1000 ° C. At the low temperature of Tang and Song Dynasties in China, the green glaze is easy to be weathered to form a silver color, commonly known as "silver glaze". The high temperature body is also ceramic, but the glaze is high-temperature glaze. It can be fired at high temperature, glazed, and then fired at low temperature. It can also be fired in one go. Mainly used in daily utensils, construction, municipal, industrial and agricultural fields.

explanation_cn: 简称ZK玻璃，折射率和密度较BaK玻璃大，基本上属于含钡、锌的硼硅酸盐玻璃。BaO与ZnO的质量分数之和大于40%,ZnO与BaO的比值影响平均色散的大小。此类玻璃化学稳定性较差。由于BaO含量高，在熔化时对一般黏土耐火材料侵蚀严重，因此大都采用铂容器熔炼，主要用作光学仪器中光学零件的材料。
explanation_en: It is called ZK glass for short. Its refractive index and density are larger than that of BaK glass. It is basically a borosilicate glass containing barium and zinc. The sum of the mass fractions of BaO and ZnO is more than 40%, and the ratio of ZnO to BaO affects the mean dispersion. Such glass has poor chemical stability. Due to the high content of BaO, it severely erodes the general clay refractory during melting. Therefore, most of them are melting in platinum containers, which are mainly used as materials for optical parts in optical instruments.

explanation_cn: 将重物放置在松装烧结粉未的烧结方法。由于松装烧结粉末是靠粉末颗粒之间接触面扩散来烧结，加上重物后，有利于颗粒重排随着收缩的增加，补充粉末到收缩孔隙处，避免出现大孔隙。重物重力作用于粉末层，粉末接触密集.原子流动加剧，表面扩散增加，促进烧结完成。有些制品烧结中容易变形，也采用重力烧结。重力烧结主要是静态重力外加在粉末层或压坯上。热则是采用高温下施外加动压力在粉末层上，其压制甩力远较重物重力大。前者多用于松装烧结，加速烧结完成;后者常是一种工艺选择，两者不能替换。
explanation_en: Sintering method of placing heavy objects on loosely packed sintering powder. As loose sintering powder is sintering by diffusion of the contact surface between powder particle, the addition of heavy objects is conducive to particle rearrangement with the increase of shrinkage, and powder is supplemented to the shrinkage pores to avoid large pores. The gravity of heavy matter acts on the powder layer, and the powder contacts intensively. The atomic flow intensifies, and the surface diffusion increases, promoting the completion of sintering. Some products are easy to deform during sintering, and gravity sintering is also used. Gravity sintering is mainly static gravity applied to the powder layer or compact. For heat, the applied dynamic pressure is applied on the powder layer at high temperature, and the pressing throw force is far greater than the weight weight. The former is mostly used for loose sintering to accelerate the completion of sintering; The latter is often a process choice and cannot be replaced.

explanation_cn: 简单岛状结构硫酸盐矿物。常有锶代替钡。斜方晶系，晶体呈板状或柱状;双晶少见;集合体呈粒状、板状、纤维状.有时呈结核状、钟乳状。纯者透明无色，一般呈白色、黄白色，含锶者带浅蓝色调。条痕内色透明至半透明。玻璃光泽.解理面呈珍珠光泽主要产于低温热液矿床中，与方铅矿、闪锌铁矿、辰砂等共生。在沉积型锰矿床和沉积岩中呈结核状、块状出现。是提取钡的主要矿物原料。广泛用于石油、化工、造纸、橡胶、陶瓷、玻璃、制革等工业领域。
explanation_en: Sulfate minerals with simple island like structures. Strontium often replaces barium. Orthorhombic crystal system, crystal is tabular or columnar; Twin crystal is rare; Aggregates are granular, tabular, and fibrous in shape. Sometimes they appear as nodules or stalactites. Pure ones are transparent and colorless, usually appearing in white or yellow white, while those containing strontium have a light blue hue. The inner color of the stripe is transparent to semi transparent. Glass luster and pearly luster cleavage surface are mainly produced in low-temperature hydrothermal deposits, coexisting with galena, zincite, cinnabar, etc. In sedimentary manganese deposits and sedimentary rock, it appears as nodules and blocks. It is the main raw mineral material for extracting barium. It is widely used in petroleum, chemical industry, paper making, rubber, ceramics, glass, leather and other industrial fields.

explanation_cn: 大角晶界系由两个原子直径厚的原子对排（点阵重合）区与铺排区构成，简称CSL模型。重合阵点数愈多，则晶界K结构的失配度就愈小，两个晶体相互匹配的程度，可以用普通阵点密度和重合位置阵点密度之比1；来描述，Z亦称CSL的多重性，显然，X=1吋意味莽两个晶体之间的精确重合。
explanation_en: The large angle grain boundary system is composed of two atom pair (lattice coincidence) regions and the stacking region, which are thick in atomic diameter, and is referred to as the CSL model for short. The more the number of coincidence array points, the smaller the mismatch of K structure at grain boundary. The degree of mutual matching of two crystal can be determined by the ratio of density of ordinary array points to density of coincidence position array points of 1; To describe the multiplicity of Z, also called CSL, it is obvious that X=1 inch means the exact coincidence between two crystal.

explanation_cn: 按Buerger对多型性（同素异构）转变分类相的结合键被拆开后重新组合成新相的相变。
explanation_en: According to Buerger's classification of polymorphism (allotropism) transformation, the phase transformation in which the phase's bonding bond is disassembled and reassembled into a new phase.

explanation_cn: 以重氮盐或重氮树脂作为光敏剂的感光材料。将光敏性的重氮盐或重氮树脂和偶合剂（通常是酚类化合物）混合，加人黏合剂，涂在支持体上即成为重氮感光材料。成像过程主要包括两个步骤：其一是重氮盐光敏剂在光照下分解成氮气和无色分解产物；其二是未分解的重氮盐和偶合剂在碱性条件下发生偶合反应形成染料图像，采用的偶合剂不同，影像颜色也不一样。上述重氮盐光敏材料大量被用于工程图复制、印刷、缩微、地质勘探、电子等领域重氮盐光敏材料的光谱感色范围一般为350~450nm.其分辨率可达1000线mm以上；这种光敏材料抗摩擦，操作使用十分方便，也可以是负性的重氮盐光敏材料ü前在非银感光材料中应用最广，影响最大，其品种有重氮复印纸、重氮复制胶片等。这类感光材料的分辨率极高.且能形成各种金属影像.故多用于缩微复制记彔。
explanation_en: Photographic materials with diazonium salt or diazo resin as photosensitizer. The photosensitive diazonium salt or diazo resin is mixed with a coupling agent (usually a phenolic compound), added with a adhesive, and coated on the support body to become a diazo photographic materials. The imaging process mainly includes two steps: one is that diazonium salt photosensitizer decomposes into nitrogen and colorless decomposition products under light; The other is that the undissolved diazonium salt and coupling agent react under alkaline conditions to form dye or dyestuffc images. The image color is different with different coupling agents. The above diazo salt photosensitive materials are widely used in engineering drawing reproduction, printing, microfilming, geological exploration, electronics and other fields. The spectral color sensitivity range of diazo salt photosensitive materials is generally 350~450 nm. Its resolution can reach more than 1000 line mm; This kind of photosensitive materials is friction resistant and easy to operate. It can also be a negative diazo salt photosensitive materials, which is the most widely used and most influential among non silver photosensitive materials. Its varieties include diazo copy paper, diazo copy film, etc. This kind of photographic materials has a very high resolution and can form various metal images, so it is mostly used for micro copying and recording.

explanation_cn: 氢的同位素氘和氧的化合物，分子量20。其物理及化学性能与普通水有微小差別，熔点3.82°C,沸点101.42°C，普通水中约占0.015%。生产是氢同位素的分离过程。其制备方法、核性能和用途参见氘。
explanation_en: Hydrogen isotope deuterium and oxygen compound, molecular weight 20. Its physical and chemical properties are slightly different from that of ordinary water, with a melting point of 3.82 ° C and a boiling point of 101.42 ° C. Ordinary water accounts for about 0.015%. Production is the separation process of hydrogen isotopes. See deuterium for its preparation method, nuclear performance and use.

explanation_cn: 简称ZF玻璃。具有高折射高色散的特征。密度很大。这类玻璃因铅含量大，除用作光学零件的材料外，还可用作防辐射玻璃。
explanation_en: It is called ZF glass for short. Having the characteristics of high refractive index and high dispersion. Density is very high. Because of the high lead content, this kind of glass can be used not only as materials for optical parts, but also as anti radiation glass.

explanation_cn: 含水的架状结构砷酸盐矿物。,常含铝。斜方晶系。晶体呈双锥状：集合体呈粒状、粉末状。绿白色、鲜绿或蓝绿色；水解后染成红褐色。条痕白色。解理{201}不完全。性脆，莫氏硬度3.5，密度3.3gcm3,易溶于盐酸和硝酸中。产于富砷硫化物矿床氧化带。用于制取中药和农药。
explanation_en: Aqueous frame like structure arsenate mineral., It often contains aluminum. Orthorhombic crystal system. The crystal is biconical; the aggregate is granular and powder. Green white, fresh green or blue-green; Dye red brown after hydrolysis. Stripe white. The cleavage {201} is incomplete. Brittle, Mohs hardness 3.5, density 3.3gcm3, easily soluble in hydrochloric acid and nitric acid. Produced in the oxidation zone of arsenic rich sulfide deposits. Used for the production of traditional Chinese medicine and pesticides.

explanation_cn: 义称残余线变化。耐火制品加热到规定温度和保温时间，再冷却至室温后长度方向所产牛的残余膨胀（或收缩）率。度为5.Omm、厚度为3_2mm的胶料中.不同埋人长度的试样所得到的试验结果没有可比性。
explanation_en: It means residual line change. The residual expansion (or shrinkage) rate in the length direction of refractory products after heating to the specified temperature and holding time, and then cooling to room temperature. Degree is 5.Omm, thickness is 3_ The test results obtained from samples with different burial lengths in a 2mm adhesive material are not comparable.

explanation_cn: 电子属于费米子，服从费米狄拉克统计规律。通常，将有效质量比常规电子静止质量大数至上千倍的准粒子称为重费米子。在固体物理中，重费米子材料主要是指包含镧系或锕系元素的一类特殊金属间化合物，这些元素具有未填满的4f或5f电子轨道。重费米子材料的低温比热容要比根据自由电子理论预测的数值高达23个数量级。这类材料中的那些部分填充f轨道的离子表现出局域化的磁矩。在其特征温度以下（典型情况为10K以下），局域化f电子与导带电子发生杂化并由此导致了准粒子有效质量的大幅度增加和杂化能带间隙的形成。从1978年人们发现CeCu2Si2是一种非常规超导体以来，已有30多种这类重费米子超导体得到实验确认。彻底理解重费米子系统的物理机理对于新塑高性能超导体的发现具有积极意义。1969年，曼斯等人发现非磁有序的化合物在温度0.35K以下会发生由金属到绝缘体的转变。由于这类材料在接近室温条件下展现出近藤晶格行为且随着温度的降低转变为具有很小能带间隙的半导体材料因此称它们为近藤半导体或近藤绝缘体。近藤绝缘体也是雨导带电子和f轨道电子杂化形成的重费米子系统。重费米子材料与氧化物高温度超导体同属强关联电f系统，都是当今凝聚态物理研究的前沿领域。
explanation_en: The electron belongs to fermion and obeys the statistical law of fermion dirac. Usually, the quasi particle whose effective mass is thousands of times larger than the rest mass of the conventional electron is called the heavy fermion. In solid state physics, heavy fermion materials mainly refer to a special class of imermetallif compound containing lanthanide or actinide elements, which have unfilled 4f or 5f electronic orbitals. The low temperature specific heat [capacity of heavy fermion materials is 23 orders of magnitude higher than that predicted by free electron theory. The ions partially filled with f orbitals in such materials exhibit localized magnetic moment. Below its characteristic temperature (typically below 10K), localized f electrons hybridize with conduction band electrons, resulting in a large increase in the effective mass of quasiparticles and the formation of hybrid band gaps. Since the discovery of CeCu2Si2 as an unconventional superconductor in 1978, more than 30 such heavy fermion superconductors have been experimentally confirmed. A thorough understanding of the physical mechanism of the heavy fermion system is of positive significance for the discovery of new plastic high-performance superconductors. In 1969, Mans et al. found that non-magnetic ordered compounds would undergo a transformation from metal to insulator at a temperature below 0.35K. Because these materials exhibit Kondo lattice behavior at near room temperature and transformation into semiconductor materials with small band gaps as the temperature decreases, they are called Kondo semiconductors or Kondo insulator. Kondo insulator is also a heavy fermion system formed by the hybridization of rain conduction band electrons and f orbital electrons. Both heavy fermion materials and oxide high temperature superconductors belong to the strong correlation electric f system, which are the frontier fields of condensed matter physics.

explanation_cn: 重费米子半导体又称作近藤半导体或近藤绝缘体。参见重费米子。
explanation_en: Heavy fermion semiconductor is also called Kondo insulator or Kondo semiconductor. See heavy fermions.

explanation_cn: 重费米子系统一般是指含有镧系元素或锕系元素的金属间化合物。在较低温度下，这些金属间化合物中传导电子的有效质培通常要比自由电子的质量大数百倍。因此，被称为重费米子系统。参见重费米子。
explanation_en: The heavy fermion system generally refers to the imermetallif compound containing lanthanides or actinides. At lower temperatures, the effective mass culture of conduction electrons in these imermetallif compound is usually hundreds of times greater than the mass of free electrons. Therefore, it is called the heavy fermion system. See heavy fermions.

explanation_cn: 具有超导特性的重费米子材料。重费米子体系主要包括一些含有稀土金属如铈、镱，锕族金属元素如铀的金属化合物。这类化合物在低温下表现为超导、反铁磁或铁磁，或荠费米液体的行为，但是有很高的比热容，通常认为准粒子有很高的质量，因此叫作重费米子材料。费米超导体虽然超导临界温度都很低，从实用的观点看，它们的重要性并不明显，但对凝聚态物理、特别是超导电性研究领域的发展具有十分重大的意义。
explanation_en: Heavy fermion materials with superconductivity. The heavy fermion system mainly includes some metal compounds containing rare earth metal such as cerium, ytterbium and actinide metal elements such as uranium. At low temperatures, such compounds behave as superconductivity, antiferromagnetism or ferromagnetism, or Shepherd Fermi liquid, but have a high specific heat [capacity. It is generally believed that quasi particle have high mass, so they are called heavy fermion materials. Although the superconductor critical temperature of Fermi superconductors is very low and their importance is not obvious from a practical point of view, they are of great significance to the development of condensed matter physics, especially the research field of superconductivity.

explanation_cn: 简称ZBaF玻璃。比钡火石玻璃折射率高。是在重火石玻璃中加人BaO、ZnO等组分或在重冕玻璃中加入PbO等组分而制得的。其色散亦介于这两类玻璃之间。色散随PbO与BaO比值增加而上升。主要用作光学仪器中光学零件的材料。
explanation_en: It is called ZBaF glass for short. It has higher refractive index than barium flint glass. It is made by adding BaO, ZnO and other components to dense flint glass or adding PbO and other components to heavy crown glass. Its dispersion is also between these two types of glass. The dispersion increases as the ratio of PbO to BaO increases. It is mainly used as materials of optical parts in optical instruments.

explanation_en: It is called ZLaF glass for short. Mainly used for high-quality M photography objectives,

explanation_cn: 主要使用植物賴剂进行生产而得到的密度比较高、革身比较坚硬的一类皮革产品。一般包括轮带革、打梭带革、护油圈革、鞋底革、装具革等。市售大部分是植鞣革，其原料皮为猪皮、黄牛皮、水牛皮等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of leather product with high density and hard leather body, which is mainly produced by using plant agents. Generally, it includes tire leather, shuttle belt leather, oil ring leather, shoe sole leather, clothing leather, etc. Most of the products sold in the market are vegetable-tanned leather, and the raw skins are pig skin, cattle skin, buffalo skin, etc.

explanation_cn: 适合于制作各种量具用的工具钢。量具是机械制造中的测量工具，如块规、塞规、千分尺等，在使用过程中经常与被测工件接触，受到磨损与碰撞，因而要求量具钢具有高的硬度和耐磨性、高的尺寸稳定性和足够的韧性。简单量具可使用非合金工具钢如T10A、T12A等，淬火加低温回火后得到高硬度和高耐磨性；而精密量具为保证尺寸稳定性，往往需采用含W、Mn、Cr的低合金工具钢如CrWMn、GCrl5等，同时所形成的合金碳化物还可进一步提高钢的耐磨性。
explanation_en: It is suitable for making tool steel for various measuring tools. Measuring tools are measuring tools in mechanical manufacturing, such as block gauge, plug gauge, micrometer, etc. They often contact with the measured workpiece during use and are subject to wear and collision. Therefore, gauge steel is required to have high hardness and wear resistance, high dimensional stability and sufficient toughness. For simple measuring tools, non alloy tool steel such as T10A and T12A can be used. High hardness and high wear resistance can be obtained after quenching and low temperature tempering; In order to ensure dimensional stability of precision measuring tools, low alloy tool steel containing W, Mn and Cr, such as CrWMn, GCrl5, etc., is often required. At the same time, the alloy carbide formed can further improve the wear resistance of steel.

explanation_cn: 指荧光材料每吸收一个大能量光子就会放出两个小能量光子的物理现象，其理论量子产率为200%。
explanation_en: It refers to the physical phenomenon that every time a fluorescence materials absorbs a large energy photon, it will emit two small energy photons, and its theoretical quantum yield is 200%.

explanation_cn: 研究微观粒子运动规律的近代物理基础理论。它于20世纪20年代发展建立，包括薛定谔的波动力学和海森堡(Heisenberg)的矩阵力学。经典力学描述物体运动用坐标和速度，其变化遵守牛顿第二定律。量子力学描述物体运动基于微观粒子(电子、原子、分子或其他基本粒子)的波动微粒二象性。首先波动力学用一种概率波描述微观粒子的状态。波函数的时空变化遵守薛定谔方程。其次量子力学用算符代表力学量(坐标、动量、能量等都引入相应的算符）。粒子处在某一状态的力学量一般没有确定值，而是具有一系列可能值，即算符的本征值；测量的结果具有统计性。量子力学主要是在给定条件下求解薛定谔方程，得出波函数，预测物理量的测量结果。量子力学不仅对简单问题有严格解(例如揭示原子中电子能级轨道的量子化，谐振子能级，隧道效应等)，还对复杂体系有近似解，后者是凝聚态物理、原子核物理，以及量子化学等的基础。
explanation_en: The basic theory of modern physics that studies the motion laws of microscopic particles. It was developed and established in the 1920s, including Schr ? dinger's wave mechanics and Heisenberg's matrix mechanics. Classical mechanics describes the motion of objects using coordinates and velocities, and their changes follow Newton's second law. Quantum mechanics describes the movement of objects based on the wave particle duality of microscopic particles (electrons, atoms, molecules or other basic particles). Firstly, wave dynamics uses a probability wave to describe the state of microscopic particles. The spatiotemporal variation of the wave function follows the Schr ? dinger equation. Secondly, quantum mechanics uses operators to represent mechanical quantities (coordinates, momentum, energy, etc. are all introduced with corresponding operators). The mechanical quantity of a particle in a certain state generally does not have a definite value, but rather has a series of possible values, namely the eigenvalues of the operator; The measurement results are statistically significant. Quantum mechanics is mainly to solve the Schrodinger equation under given conditions, obtain the wave function, and predict the measurement results of physical quantities. Quantum mechanics not only has strict solutions to simple problems (such as revealing the quantization of electronic energy level orbits in atoms, energy level of harmonic oscillators, tunneling effects, etc.), but also has approximate solutions to complex systems, the latter being the basis of condensed matter physics, nuclear physics, and quantum chemistry.

explanation_cn: 应用量子力学在分子层次上讨论物质结构、性质及其关系的化学分支学科。它提出一系列概念如:轨道、电子云、共振、杂化等奠定了分子结构与性质关系的理论基础，成为现代化学的重要理论基础之一。量子化学可分为三部分:①基础理论，核心是多体理论方法。量子力学处理的分子问题最重要的是三种化学键理论(价键理论、分子轨道理论和配位场理论）；其次有密度矩阵理论、密度泛函理论、多体微扰理论及处理动态问题的碰撞理论等。近年来还有相对论效应、相关能校正及绝热近似校正等。②计算方法，将多体理论原则上给出的计算方法加以改进，达到实用目的。通常与计算机相结合，编制成各种通用的标准程序。主要有从头计算方法和以它为基础的各种半经验自治场方法。还有将离域分子轨道转换为定域分子轨道的方法。③应用研究，即利用量子化学计算各类分子和固体(包括稳定和不稳定的、基态和激发态的)的结构、性能及相互关系，分子间的相互作用和化学反应等。其结果包括:新型分子的结构与化学键性质，分子激发态和谱学问题，化学反应和光化学的量子理论，固体表面结构和催化机理，生物化学和药物化学以及材料的量子化学研究等。
explanation_en: The branch of chemistry that applies quantum mechanics to discuss the structure, properties and relationships of substances at the molecular level. It proposes a series of concepts such as orbitals, electron clouds, resonance, hybridization, etc., laying the theoretical foundation for the relationship between molecular structure and properties, and becoming one of the important theoretical foundations of modern chemistry. Quantum chemistry can be divided into three parts: ① basic theory, the core of which is multi-body theory. The most important molecular problems dealt with by quantum mechanics are three kinds of chemical bond theories (valence bond theory, molecular orbital theory and coordination field theory); Secondly, there are density matrix theory, density functional theory, multi-body perturbation theory and collision theory dealing with dynamic problems. In recent years, there have been relativistic effects, correlation energy correction, and adiabatic approximation correction The calculation method is improved based on the principles of multi body theory to achieve practical purposes. Usually combined with computers, various universal standard programs are compiled. There are mainly ab initio calculation methods and various semi empirical autonomous field methods based on it. There are also methods for converting delocalized molecular orbitals into localized molecular orbitals Applied research, that is, quantum chemistry is used to calculate the structures, properties and interrelationships of various molecules and solids (including stable and unstable, ground state and excited state), as well as the interactions and chemical reactions between molecules. The results include: the structure and chemical bond properties of new molecules, molecular excited states and spectral problems, quantum theory of chemical reaction and photochemistry, solid surface structure and catalytic mechanism, biochemistry and pharmaceutical chemistry, and quantum chemical research of materials.

explanation_cn: 是指当粒子尺寸下降到某一数值时，费米能级附近的电子能级由准连续变为离散能级或者能隙变宽的现象。纳米半导体颗粒存在不连续的最高被占据分子轨道和最低未被占据的分子轨道能级，能隙变宽现象均称为量子尺寸效应。当能级的变化程度大于热能、光能、电磁能的变化时，导致了纳米微粒磁、光、声、热、电及超导特性与常规材料有显著的不同。处于分立的量子化能级中的电子的波动性给纳米粒子带来一系列特殊性质，如高的光学非线性、特异的催化和光催化性、强氧化性和还原性等。例如半导体材料或金属的尺寸降低到纳米尺寸时，特别是小于或者等于该材料的激子玻耳半径时，由大块金属中的能级组成的接近连续的能带此时转化为离散的能级。因此对于半导体材料来说，可以通过改变颗粒的尺度来调整其带隙的大小，从而改变了对某些成本很高的半导体材料的依赖。
explanation_en: It refers to the phenomenon that when the particle size drops to a certain value, the electronic energy level near the Fermi level changes from quasi continuous to discrete energy level or the energy gap widens. There are discontinuous highest occupied molecular orbital and lowest unoccupied molecular orbital energy level in semiconductor nanoparticles, and the energy gap broadening phenomenon is called quantum size effect. When the change of energy level is greater than that of thermal energy, light energy and electromagnetic energy, the magnetic, optical, acoustic, thermal, electrical and superconducting properties of nanoparticles are significantly different from those of conventional materials. The fluctuation of electrons in discrete quantized energy level brings a series of special properties to nanoparticles, such as high optical nonlinearity, specific catalysis and photocatalysis, strong oxidation and reduction, etc. For example, when the size of a semiconductor materials or metal is reduced to a nanometer size, especially when it is less than or equal to the exciton Bohr radius of the materials, the nearly continuous energy band composed of energy level in the bulk metal is converted into discrete energy level at this time. Therefore, for semiconductor materials, the size of the band gap can be adjusted by changing the size of the particles, thus changing the dependence on some high cost semiconductor materials.

explanation_cn: 发射的焚光光子数与被吸收的激发光子数之比。荧光粉的量子效率对了解荧光粉所达到的效率的极限是很重要的参考。
explanation_en: The ratio of the number of burned photons emitted to the number of excited photons absorbed. The quantum efficiency of phosphor is an important reference for understanding the efficiency limit of phosphor.

explanation_cn: 是一种小到足以展现量子限域效应的纳米晶。量子点是典型的零维纳米材料，载流子在三个空间方向上的运动都受到限制。由于电子和空穴被量子限域，连续的能带结构变成具有分子特性的分立能级结构，受激后可以发射荧光。量子点的合成方法主要包括化学溶液生长法、外延生长法、电场约束法等。化学溶液法是指将前驱物、表面活性剂和溶剂混合加热反应，生成相应的量子点材料。该法制备的量子点具有制作成本低、产率大、发光效率高等优点，但其电导率极低。外延生长法是指在一种衬底材料上长出新的晶体，如果结晶足够小，就会形成量子点。根据生长机理不同，该方法又可细分为化学气相沉积法和分子束外延法。电场约束法是指完全利用调控金属电极的电势使晶体内的能级发生扭曲，形成对载流子的约束，该法成本最高、产率最低，但由于极高的可控性，这种量子点最适合用作量子计算。量子点独特的性质基于它自身的量子限域效应，在非线性光学、磁介质、催化、医药及功能材料等方面具有极为广阔的应用。
explanation_en: It is a kind of nanocrystal small enough to show quantum confinemem effect. Quantum dots is a typical zero dimensional nano materials, and the movement of carriers in three spatial directions is limited. Because electrons and holes are quantum confined, the continuous band structure becomes a discrete energy level structure with molecular characteristics, which can emit fluorescence after being stimulated. The synthesis methods of quantum dots mainly include chemical solution growth method, epitaxial growth method, electric field constraint method, etc. Chemical solution method refers to the mixing and heating reaction of precursor, surfactant and solvent to generate corresponding quantum dots materials. The quantum dots prepared by this method have the advantages of low production cost, high yield and high luminescence efficiency, but their electric conductivity is extremely low. Epitaxial growth refers to the growth of new crystal on a backing materials. If the crystals are small enough, quantum dots will be formed. According to different growth mechanisms, this method can be subdivided into chemical vapor deposition and molecular beam epitaxy. The electric field constraint method means that the energy level in the crystal is distorted by fully using the electric potential of the metal electrode to form a constraint on the carrier. This method has the highest cost and lowest yield, but because of its high controllability, this quantum dots is most suitable for quantum computing. The unique properties of quantum dots are based on its own quantum confinemem effect, and it has extremely broad applications in nonlinear optics, magnetic media, catalysis, medicine and functional materials.

explanation_cn: 尺寸小于激子玻尔半径的零维纳米颗粒称为量子点。在太阳电池结构中引入量子点，且量子点参与到光电转换过程中的太阳电池称为量子点太阳电池。量子点在其中既可作为吸光材料，也可作为电子传输或空穴传输材料。量子点太阳电池具有如下优点:容易通过控制量子点尺寸调节太阳电池的吸收光谱，从而实现全光谱吸收；能够通过量子点材料的特殊物理性质在太阳电池中实现多光子吸收、多激子产生、热载流子注入、中间带及叠层等物理效应及结构，从而为太阳电池光电转换效率突破Shockley-QueissCT理论极限提供了潜在可能性。根据量子点材料的制备方法，可以分为物理法和化学法，如真空气相沉积、化学浴沉积、有机金属热注入法等。将量子点应用到太阳电池中有多种多样的方法:比如在晶硅太阳电池中通过物理沉积或者化学沉积引入相应量子点材料；或者将量子点作为敏化剂制备量子点敏化太阳电池；或者将量子点与聚合物杂化形成杂化太阳电池；或者将量子点与金属电极形成肖特基结太阳电池；或者将量子点与n型宽带氧化物形成耗尽异质结太阳电池。例如，在ITO玻璃上制备一层ZnO，然后在其上旋涂采用有机相热注入法合成的PbSe胶体量子点，最后热蒸发金电极，即获得ITO/ZnO/PbSe/Au结构的量子点太阳电池。
explanation_en: The zero dimensional nanoparticles whose size is smaller than the exciton Bohr radius are called quantum dots. The solar cell that introduces quantum dots into the structure of the solar cell and quantum dots participate in the photoelectric conversion process is called quantum dot solar cells. Quantum dots can be used as light absorbing materials, as well as electron transmission or hole transmission materials. The quantum dot solar cells has the following advantages: it is easy to adjust the absorption spectrum of the solar cell by controlling the size of the quantum dots, so as to achieve full spectrum absorption; Through the special physical properties of quantum dots materials, the physical effects and structures such as multiphoton absorption, multiple excitongeneration, hot carrier injection, intermediate band and stack can be realized in solar cell, thus providing a potential possibility for solar cell to break through the theoretical limit of Shockley QueissCT in photo-electric conversion efficiency. According to the preparation methods of quantum dots materials, they can be divided into physical and chemical methods, such as true air phase deposition, chemical bath deposition, organic metal thermal injection, etc. There are many ways to apply quantum dots to solar cell: for example, introducing corresponding quantum dots materials into crystalline silicon solar cell through physical or chemical deposition; Or use quantum dots as sensitizer to prepare quantum dots sensitized solar cell; Or hybridizing quantum dots and polymer to form hybrid solar cells; Or forming a Schottky junction solar cell with a quantum dots and a metal electrode; Or form depleted heterostructure solar cell by quantum dots and n-type broadband oxides. For example, a layer of ZnO is prepared on ITO glass, then the PbSe colloidal quantum dots synthesized by organic phase thermal injection method are spin coated on it, and finally the gold electrode is thermally evaporated, that is, the ITO/ZnO/PbSe/Au structure quantum dot solar cells is obtained.

name_cn: 量子点敏化太阳能电池
explanation_cn: 是以量子点为光吸收剂将太阳能转换成电能的太阳能电池。它是一种新型的第二代化合物半导体薄膜太阳能电池，是对有机染料敏化太阳能电池的改进。量子点敏化太阳能电池由光阳极、电解液、光阴极三部分组成。光阳极主要是在导电衬底上制备一层半导体薄膜，并吸附一层量子点光敏化剂；光阴极则是在导电衬底上沉积铂或碳等催化材料。量子点受光激发由基态跃迁到激发态，激发态量子点将电子注入到氧化物半导体的导带中，并经由纳米晶网络传输到后接触面后而流入到外电路中产生电流。由于量子点是三维尺寸都足够小的纳米材料，电子的运动在三维上都是量子化的，因此用量子点作为敏化剂主要有以下优点:①量子点敏化剂来源广泛、成本低廉，制备工艺相对简单；②量子点具有量子限域效应，可通过调节粒径改变能带宽度从而改变太阳光谱吸收范围；③充分利用量子点的热电子以及多激子产生特性。显著提高电池的转换效率；④量子点是无机材料，所以相对于有机染料具有非常好的光学稳定性；⑤量子点敏化剂不存在有机染料敏化剂由于厚度而降低光吸收的问题。常用的量子点有CdS、PbSe、PbS、Ag2S、InA、s、GaSh和S等。相比有机染料敏化太阳能电池，量子点敏化太阳能电池效率还比较低。
explanation_en: It is a solar cell that uses quantum dots as light absorbers to convert solar energy into electrical energy. It is a new type of second generation compound semiconductor thin film materials for thin film solar cell and an improvement of organic dye or dyestuffc sensitized solar cell. The quantum dot sensitized photovoltaic cell consists of three parts: photoanode, electrolyte and photocathode. The photoanode is mainly to prepare a layer of semiconductor film on the conductive substrate and adsorb a layer of quantum dots photosensitizer; The photocathode deposits catalytic materials such as platinum or carbon on the conductive substrate. The quantum dots transitions from the ground state to the excited state when excited by light. The excited state quantum dot injects electrons into the conduction band of the oxide semiconductor, and then transmits them to the rear contact surface via the nanocrystal network, and then flows into the external circuit to generate current. Since quantum dots are nanomaterials with small enough three-dimensional dimensions, and the movement of electrons is quantized in three dimensions, the use of quantum dots as sensitizer has the following advantages: ① quantum dots sensitizer has a wide range of sources, low cost, and relatively simple preparation process; ② The quantum dots has quantum confinemem effect, which can change the energy band width by adjusting the particle size to change the solar spectral absorption range; ③ Make full use of the hot electron and multiple excitongeneration characteristics of quantum dots. Significantly improve the conversion efficiency of batteries; ④ Quantum dots are inorganic materials, so they have very good optical stability compared with organic dye or dyestuffc; ⑤ Quantum dots sensitizer does not have the problem that organic dye or dyestuffc sensitizer reduces light absorption due to its thickness. Common quantum dots include CdS, PbSe, PbS, Ag2S, InA, s, GaSh and S. Compared with organic dye or dyestuffc sensitized solar cell, quantum dot sensitized photovoltaic cell have lower efficiency.

explanation_cn: "相干性"通常被广义地理解为相关在时间和空间的"整体性"。物理学中相干性(coherence)是指描述波与本身及波与其它波之间对于某种内禀物理量的关联特性。量子力学中概率幅的模决定了概率，概率幅同时还包含相位信息。因此，在量子叠加过程中，有可能出现干涉效应，如电磁场振幅的叠加产生干涉一样。这种量子世界所固有的干涉效应称为量子相干性。宏观量子相干效应会导致新颖奇异的物理现象，例如激光、超导和超流现象等，都是高度相干的量子系统，它们产生的效应可以在宏观尺度下观测到。例如超流体现象是玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚，所有组成凝聚的粒子都同相，可以用单独一个量子波函数来描述；2009年物理学家成功地在机械共振器(resonator)的运动中观测到了量子相干效应。
explanation_en: Coherence "is generally understood as the" entirety "of correlation in time and space. Coherence in physics refers to the characteristic correlation between waves and themselves, as well as between waves and other waves, regarding a certain intrinsic physical quantity. The mode of probability amplitude in quantum mechanics determines probability, and the probability amplitude also contains phase information. Therefore, in the process of quantum superposition, there is a possibility of interference effects, such as interference caused by the superposition of electromagnetic field amplitudes. The inherent interference effect in this quantum world is called quantum coherence. Macroscopic quantum coherence effect can lead to novel and strange physical phenomena, such as laser, superconductor and superfluid, which are highly coherent quantum systems, and their effects can be observed at a macro scale. For example, the superfluid phenomenon is Bose Einstein condensation. All particles constituting the condensation are in phase and can be described by a single quantum wave function; In 2009, physicists successfully observed the quantum coherence effect in the movement of the mechanical resonator.

explanation_cn: 是指具有离散能量值的势阱。一般由两种不同的半导体材料相间排列形成的、具有明显量子限域效应的电子或空穴的势阱。由于量子阱宽度(只有当阱宽尺度足够时能形成量子阱)的限制，导致载流子波函数在一维方向上的局域化，量子阱中因为有源层的厚度仅在电子平均自由程内，阱壁具有很强的限制作用，使得载流子只在与阱壁平行的平面内具有二维自由度。在垂直方向，使得导带和价带分裂成子带。为了形成量子化，可以把能够在三维空间A由运动的粒子束缚在一个平面区域。在具有二维自由度的量子阱中，电子和空穴的态密度与能量的关系为台阶形状，而不像三维体材料那样的拋物线形状。多量子阱是由两种不同半导体材料薄层交替生长形成的多层结构，如果势垒层足够厚，以致相邻势阱之间载流子波函数之间耦合很小.则多层结构将形成许多分离的量子阱，称为多量子阱(MQW)。量子阱的制备通常是通过将一种材料夹在两种材料(通常是宽禁带材料)之间而形成的，比如两层砷化铝之间夹着砷化镓。一般这种材料吋以通过MBE(分子束外延)或者MOCVD(化学气相沉积)方法来制备。
explanation_en: It refers to a potential well with discrete energy values. Generally, the potential well of electrons or holes with obvious quantum confinemem effect formed by the interphase arrangement of two different semiconductor materials. Due to the limitation of quantum well width (quantum well can be formed only when the well width scale is sufficient), the carrier wave function is localized in the one-dimensional direction. Because the thickness of the active layer in the quantum well is only within the mean free path of electrons, the well wall has a strong restriction effect, making the carrier only have two-dimensional degree of freedom in the plane parallel to the well wall. In the vertical direction, the conduction band and the valence band are split into subbands. To form quantization, particles that can move in three-dimensional space A can be bound to a planar region. In a quantum well with a two-dimensional degree of freedom, the relationship between the density of states of electrons and holes and energy is a step shape, unlike the parabolic shape of a three-dimensional materials. Multiple quantum well are multilayer structures formed by the alternate growth of two different semiconductor materials. If the barrier layer is thick enough, so that the coupling between the carrier wave functions between adjacent potential wells is very small, the multilayer structure will form many separate quantum well, called multiple quantum well (MQW). The preparation of quantum well is usually formed by clamping a materials between two materials (usually wide band gap materials), such as gallium arsenide sandwiched between two layers of aluminum arsenide. Generally, this materials is prepared by MBE (molecular beam epitaxy) or MOCVD (chemical vapor deposition).

explanation_cn: 在相同的两层厚度较大的半导体之间若生长一薄层不同的半导体夹层，只要夹层材料的导带边比两个边层的导带边低，或夹层的价带边比两个边层的价带边高，则一个以两个边层为势垒而夹层为势阱称为量子阱的三层结构。如果势阱层的厚度小到与电子德布罗意波长可比拟，则阱中的电子或者空穴在垂直于结面方向运动的能量被量子化为一系列决定于阱宽、阱深和粒子有效质量的分立值，这种材料称为单量子阱材料。用周期性重复单量子阱结构的方法得到的材料，若势垒层的厚度大到使两个相邻势阱中电子波函数不能相互耦合，称为多量子阱材料。
explanation_en: If a thin layer of different semiconductor interlayer is grown between the same two thicker semiconductors, as long as the conduction band edge of the interlayer materials is lower than the conduction band edge of the two edge layers, or the valence band edge of the interlayer is higher than the valence band edge of the two edge layers, a three-layer structure with two edge layers as potential barriers and the interlayer as potential wells is called a quantum well. If the thickness of the potential well layer is small enough to be comparable to the electron de Broglie wavelength, the energy of the electrons or holes in the well moving in the direction perpendicular to the junction plane is quantized into a series of discrete values determined by the well width, well depth and effective mass of particles. This materials is called a single quantum well materials. The materials obtained by periodically repeating the single quantum well structure is called multi quantum well materials if the thickness of the barrier layer is large enough that the electronic wave functions in two adjacent potential wells cannot be coupled with each other.

explanation_cn: 当粒子尺寸与电子的德布罗意波长、相干波长及激子波耳半径可比拟时，电子被局域在纳米尺度空间，电子输运受到限制，电子平均自由程显著缩短，其局域性和相干性增强，该现象称为量子限域效应。对于量子点或者纳米晶，当粒径与Wannier激子Bohr半径相当或更小时处于强限域区，易形成激子产生激子吸收带。随着粒径的减小，激子带的吸收系数增加并出现激子强吸收。由于量子限域效应，激子的最低能量向高能方向移动即蓝移。最新的报道表明，日本NEC已成功地制备了量子点阵，在基底上沉积纳米岛状量子点阵列。当用激光照射量子点使之激励时，量子点发出蓝光，表明量子点确实具有量子限域效应。
explanation_en: When the particle size is comparable to the de Broglie wavelength, the coherence wavelength and the exciton radius of the electron, the electron is localized in the nanoscale space, the electron transport is limited, the mean free path of electrons of the electron is significantly shortened, and its localization and coherence are enhanced, which is called the quantum confinemem effect. For quantum dots or nanocrystal, when the particle size is equal to or smaller than the Wannier exciton Bohr radius, it is in a strongly confined region, and it is easy to form exciton to generate exciton absorption bands. With the decrease of particle size, the absorption coefficient of exciton band increases and strong absorption of exciton appears. Due to the quantum confinemem effect, the lowest energy of the exciton moves towards the high energy direction, that is, blue shift. The latest report indicates that NEC in Japan has successfully prepared quantum dot arrays and deposited nano island like quantum dot arrays on the substrate. When the quantum dots is excited by laser irradiation, the quantum dots emits blue light, indicating that the quantum dots does have quantum confinemem effect.

explanation_cn: 一般广义理解将整数量子霍耳效应和分数量子霍尔效应的统称为量子霍尔效应。
explanation_en: Generally speaking, integer quantum Hall effect and fractional quantum Hall effect are collectively referred to as quantum Hall effect.
