explanation_cn: 一种碱性的超填性岩。最初见于非洲金伯利地方而得名。旧称角砾云母橄榄 岩.是产金刚石的最主要火成岩之一。矿物组成较为 复杂，原生矿物有橄榄石、金云母、镁铝榴石、钛铁 矿、磷灰石、金红石、金刚石等。
explanation_en: An alkaline overfill rock. Originally seen in the Kimberley region of Africa, it is named after it. Formerly known as breccia mica peridotite, it is one of the main igneous rocks producing diamonds. The mineral composition is relatively complex, and the primary minerals include olivine, phlogopite, magnesium aluminum garnet, ilmenite, apatite, rutile, diamond, etc.

explanation_cn: 由前苏联科学家金茨堡和朗道于1950年提出，是与超导现象相关的第一个宏观唯象理论。该理论基于朗道的二级相变理论，旨在解释超导现象的行为。后来，科学家戈尔柯夫的研究证实，金兹堡-朗道理论可以从微观的BCS（巴丁-库珀-斯瑞弗）超导理论直接推导出来。金兹堡-朗道理论不仅适用于第I类超导体，还适用于第II类超导体。而经典的BCS理论无法解释第II类超导现象。根据金兹堡和朗道的理论，超导体内的超导电子表现出某种有序性，它们的行为可以用一种类似于量子力学波函数的宏观场函数Φ来描述。这一场函数的变化描述了超导体的特定状态，其中超导电子以一种协同性的方式配对，并在零电阻状态下运动。金兹堡-朗道理论的一个著名结果是金兹堡-朗道方程，也被称为G-L方程。这个方程对超导体的宏观性质提供了重要的描述，包括超导体的临界温度、磁场依赖性以及其他关键参数。金兹堡-朗道理论对理解超导现象的本质和行为提供了有力的框架，对超导领域的研究产生了深远的影响。。
explanation_en: The first macroscopic phenomenological theory related to superconductivity was proposed by former Soviet scientists Ginzburg and Landau in 1950. This theory is based on Landau's second-order phase transition theory and aims to explain the behavior of superconductivity. Later, the research of scientist Gorkov confirmed that the Ginzburg-Landau theory can be directly derived from the microscopic BCS (Bardin Cooper Shriver) superconductivity theory. The Ginzburg-Landau theory is not only applicable to type I superconductors, but also to type II superconductors. The classical BCS theory cannot explain the type II superconductivity phenomenon. According to the theory of Ginzburg and Landau, the superconducting electrons in superconductors show some order, and their behavior can be used as a macroscopic field function similar to the wave function of quantum mechanics Φ To describe. The change in this field function describes the specific state of superconductors, where superconducting electrons pair in a synergistic manner and move in a zero resistance state. A famous result of the Ginzburg-Landau theory is the Ginzburg Landau equation, also known as the G-L equation. This equation provides an important description of the macroscopic properties of superconductors, including their critical temperature, magnetic field dependence, and other key parameters. The Ginzburg-Landau theory provides a powerful framework for understanding the nature and behavior of superconductivity, and has a profound impact on the research of superconductivity..

explanation_cn: 指以人造金刚石为磨料，以金属粉、树脂粉、陶瓷等 为黏合剂，制成的各种型号、规格、用途的割切工具。
explanation_en: It refers to cutting tools of various models, specifications and uses made of synthetic diamond as abrasive and metal powder, resin powder, ceramics, etc. as adhesive.

explanation_cn: 以铁、镍、钴为基添加铜、锌、碳化物而成的金刚石混合物。
explanation_en: A diamond mixture based on iron, nickel and cobalt and added with copper, zinc and carbide.

explanation_cn: 共价键晶体的典型结构之一。属立方晶系、面心立方空间点阵。
explanation_en: One of the typical structures of covalent bond crystal. It belongs to cubic crystal system and face centered cubic space lattice.

explanation_cn: 用低压或常压化学气相沉积（CVD)方法的人工合成金刚石膜。金刚石是碳的同素异构体之一，常见的为立方结构，但也有六方结构。硬度在固体材料中最高。
explanation_en: Synthetic diamond film by low pressure or atmospheric pressure chemical vapor deposition (CVD). Diamond is one of the allotropism of carbon, the common structure is cubic, but also has hexagonal structure. The hardness is the highest among solid materials.

explanation_cn: 以金为基体元素，加入一种或多种元素组成的合金，称为金基合金。Fe、Pd、 Ag等元素能显著提高其电阻率，可制备高性能的电 阻材料。Co、Ni、Ag等元素能强化基体.抗磨损及 有机气氛污染，可制备高性能的绕组材料。金基合金 除在货币、首饰、装饰品、工艺品、瓷器、牙科等方面有广泛应用之外。
explanation_en: The alloy with gold as the matrix element and one or more elements added is called gold alloy. Fe, Pd, Ag and other elements can significantly improve its resistivity, and can prepare high-performance resistance materials. Co, Ni, Ag and other elements can strengthen the matrix, resist abrasion and organic atmosphere pollution, and can prepare high-performance winding materials. Gold alloy is widely used in currency, jewelry, decorations, handicrafts, porcelain, dentistry, etc.

explanation_cn: 使用导电性好的金属与石墨烧结而成的假合金电刷。由于金属与石墨互不润湿，亦不固溶，也不能合金化，因此烧结成的电刷中金属与石墨各自独立存在于一个整体中。作为电刷，要求接触电阻低（即压降小）、自润滑性好和不易磨损等特性。金属材料中使用最多的是铜粉，按90%Cu-10%C的金属-石墨电刷，其电压降为0.20~0.25V。碳含量每增高10%，接触电压降低0.05~0.06V。50%Cu-50%C的电刷为0.5V。小于50%Cu的低金属含量电刷，接触电压降为0.6~0.8V。添加铁、钛、锡或磷酸铝碱性玻璃、SiO2所制成的金属-石墨电刷，有良好的耐磨损性。金属-石墨电刷综合性能大大优于纯石墨电刷，主要用于电动机、发电机导电或集电器上，也用作电车、电气机车的受电弓架的滑板。
explanation_en: The pseudo alloy electric brush made of sintering metal and graphite with good conductivity is used. Since the metal and graphite do not wet each other, do not solve each other, and cannot be alloy, the metal and graphite in the sintered brush exist independently in a whole. As an electric brush, it is required to have low contact resistance (i.e. low voltage drop), good self-lubricating property and resistance to wear. Copper powder is the most widely used metallic materials. The voltage drop of metal-graphite brush with 90% Cu-10% C is 0.20~0.25V. For every 10% increase in carbon content, the contact voltage decreases by 0.05-0.06V. The brush of 50% Cu-50% C is 0.5V. Low metal content brushes with less than 50% Cu have a contact voltage drop of 0.6-0.8V. The metal-graphite brush made by adding iron, titanium, tin or aluminum phosphate alkaline glass and SiO2 has good wear resistance. The comprehensive performance of the metal-graphite brush is much better than that of the pure graphite (carbon) brush. It is mainly used in the conduction or collector of motors and generators, and also used as the sliding plate of the pantograph frame of trams and electric locomotives.

explanation_cn: 粉末金属与玻璃粉压制并烧结而成的复合材料，常被用作触头材料、减摩材料和磁性材料。以铁/玻璃为例，当含有8%（质量分数）的玻璃粉末时，该复合材料的密度最大，接近6.0g/cm3。硬度随着玻璃含量的增加而提高，8%玻璃含量的材料硬度（HB）约为50，而10%玻璃含量的材料硬度为60。磨损量则随着玻璃含量的增加而降低，10%玻璃含量的材料摩擦系数为0.1。在金属/玻璃复合材料中，金属粉末在烧结过程中形成了骨架结构，并导致金属离子饱和在玻璃体中。烧结过程中，玻璃软化并渗入金属骨架中的孔隙。在高温下，金属离子迁移到玻璃体中，这有助于加速烧结。作为承受荷载的主要材料，综合性能最佳的金属/玻璃复合材料通常在玻璃含量为3%到8%之间。这种金属/玻璃复合材料在航空、汽车、纺织和冶金等工业领域有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: The composite materials made by pressing and sintering of powder metal and glass powder is often used as contact materials, antifriction materials and magnetic materials. Taking iron/glass as an example, when 8% (mass fraction) of glass powder is contained, the density of the composite materials is the largest, close to 6.0g/cm 3。 The hardness increases with the increase of glass content. The hardness (HB) of materials with 8% glass content is about 50, while the hardness of materials with 10% glass content is 60. Wear decreases with the increase of glass content, and the friction coefficient of materials with 10% glass content is 0.1. In metal/glass composite materials, metal powder form a skeleton structure during sintering, which leads to metal ions saturation in the glass. During sintering, glass is bating and infiltrates into the pores in the metal skeleton. At high temperature, metal ions migrate into the glass body, which helps to accelerate sintering. As the main materials bearing load, the metal/glass composite materials with the best comprehensive performance usually contains 3% to 8% glass. This metal/glass composite materials is widely used in aviation, automobile, textile, metallurgy and other industrial fields.

name_cn: 金属丝增强金属基复合材料
name_en: metal wire reinforced metal matrix composite
explanation_cn: 以相应的金属丝增强的以金属或合金为基体的复合材料。常用的金属丝有Ta、 Mo、W、Nb、Ni与不锈钢等制成的金属丝。常用的 基体有高温合金（镍基、钴基、铁基高温合金）、金属间化合物以及难熔金属。
explanation_en: A composite materials based on metal or alloy reinforced with corresponding metal wires. Common metal wires are made of Ta, Mo, W, Nb, Ni and stainless steel. Common matrix include high temperature alloy (nickel base, cobalt base, iron-base superalloy), imermetallif compound and refractory metals.

explanation_cn: 用金属粉末烧结成的微孔薄片。
explanation_en: Microporous sheet sintered with metal powder.

explanation_cn: 包括裂变材料235U、233U、239Pu和可转换材料238U、232Th，用作核燃料的金属或合金。金属核燃料一般用于石墨慢化堆和液态金属快中子增殖反应堆（如EBR-II）。金属型核燃料拥有最高的裂变原子密度，其热导率高，制造简单，但因为一般燃料本身熔点较低或晶体相变温度低，反应时温度不能太高。金属核燃料的使用历史较长，目前金属型核燃料一般皆为合金而不是金属单质。
explanation_en: It includes fission materials 235U, 233U, 239Pu and fertile materials 238U, 232Th, which are used as metal or alloy of nuclear fuel. Metal nuclear fuel is generally used in graphite moderated reactor and liquid metal fast breeder reactor (such as EBR-II). Metallic nuclear fuel has the highest density of fission atoms, high thermal conductivity and simple manufacturing. However, because of the low melting point of general fuel itself or the low phase transformation temperature of crystal, the reaction temperature cannot be too high. Metal nuclear fuel has a long history of use. At present, metal nuclear fuel is generally alloy rather than metal.

explanation_cn: 又称永久型铸造，采用金属制作铸型进行浇铸的方法，由于金属 铸型可重复多次使用（数百次到数万次）。金属铸型材料可选用导热性好、线胀系数小、耐热性良好、具有较高耐热疲劳性能的材料如铝合金、耐热钢、铸铁等。金属型铸造所得铸件的表面光洁、尺寸精度高、力学性能较高、铸件金属收得率高、显著降低造型材 料消耗。但其制作成本高、不透气且无退让性，对铸件的形状和尺寸（厚度）有较大限制。为提高铸型使用寿命，铸型可采用风冷或用水套进行冷却。金属型铸造适用于多种合金如AU Mg、Cu合金及铸铁中小型铸件的大批量生产。
explanation_en: Also known as permanent mold casting, it uses metal to make mold for casting, because the metal mold can be used repeatedly (hundreds to tens of thousands of times). Metal mold materials can be materials with good thermal conductivity, small linear expansion coefficient, good heat resistance and high heat resistant fatigue properties, such as aluminum alloy, heat resistant steel, cast iron, etc. The castings obtained by metallic mold casting have smooth surface, high dimensional accuracy, high mechanical properties, high metal yield of castings, and significantly reduce the consumption of molding materials. But its production cost is high, breathable, and non yielding, which has significant limitations on the shape and size (thickness) of the casting. To improve the service life of mold, air cooling or water jacket cooling can be used for mold. Metallic mold casting is suitable for mass production of various alloy such as AU Mg, Cu alloy and cast iron medium and small castings.

explanation_cn: 金属基复合材料是由金属或合金构成的基体，其中包含纤维、晶须、颗粒等增强体。与传统金属材料相比，金属基复合材料具有更高的比强度和比刚度。相较于树脂基复合材料，金属基复合材料具有更好的导电性和耐热性，而相对于陶瓷基复合材料，它们表现出更高的韧性和抗冲击性。根据增强体的类型，金属基复合材料可以分为纤维增强、晶须增强和颗粒增强等。另外，根据金属或合金的基体不同，可以分为铝基、镁基、铜基、钛基、高温合金基、金属间化合物基以及难熔金属基复合材料等。然而，金属基复合材料的加工温度较高，工艺复杂，难以控制界面反应，成本相对较高，且应用成熟度不如树脂基复合材料。尽管如此，近年来，随着制备技术和设备的不断发展，金属基复合材料已经取得了一定的突破。目前，它们的主要应用领域仍然包括航空和航天，逐渐扩展到汽车制造业等领域。
explanation_en: Metal matrix composite is a matrix composed of metal or alloy, which contains reinforcement such as fibers, crystal whisker, particles, etc. Compared with traditional metallic materials, metal matrix composite have higher specific strength and stiffness. Compared with resin based composite materials, metal matrix composite have better conductivity and heat resistance, while compared with ceramic matrix composite, they have higher toughness and impact resistance. According to the type of reinforcement, metal matrix composite can be divided into fiber reinforcement, crystal whisker reinforcement and particle reinforcement. In addition, according to the matrix of metal or alloy, it can be divided into aluminum base, magnesium base, copper base, titanium base, high temperature alloy base, imermetallif compound base and refractory metal matrix composite. However, the processing temperature of metal matrix composite is high, the process is complex, it is difficult to control the interface reaction, the cost is relatively high, and the application maturity is not as good as that of resin based composite materials. However, in recent years, with the continuous development of preparation technology and equipment, metal matrix composite have made some breakthroughs. At present, their main application areas still include aviation and aerospace, gradually expanding to fields such as automotive manufacturing.

explanation_cn: 在外加电场E作用下，金属中的电子在无规则运动的基础上叠加一 个有规则的运动，产生宏观电流的性质。
explanation_en: Under the action of an external electric field E, electrons in a metal undergo a regular motion superimposed on an irregular motion, resulting in a macroscopic current property.

explanation_cn: 金属导电材料是指电流容易通过的金属材料，通常用作电极、电刷、电线等。常用的金属导电材料可分为：金属元素、合金（铜合金、铝合金等）、复合金属以及不以导电为主要功能的其他特殊用途的导电 材料。
explanation_en: Metallic conductive material refer to metallic materials that are easy for current to pass through, usually used as electrodes, brushes, wires, etc. Commonly used metallic conductive material can be divided into: metal elements, alloy (copper alloy, aluminum alloy, etc.), composition metals, and other special conductive materials whose main function is not to conduct electricity.

explanation_cn: 是指封装用的金属材料，包含单一金属、合金和金属基复合材料（MMC)等。MMC是以金属（如Mg、A1、| Cu、Ti)或金属间化合物（如TiAl、NiAl)为基体，以颗粒、晶须、短纤维或连续纤维为增强体的一种复合材料。
explanation_en: It refers to metallic materials used for packaging, including single metal, alloy, metal matrix composite (MMC), etc. MMC is a composite materials with metal (such as Mg, A1, | Cu, Ti) or imermetallif compound (such as TiAl, NiAl) as the matrix and particles, crystal whisker, staple fiber or continuous fibers as the reinforcement.

name_cn: 金属性/半导体性碳纳米管
explanation_cn: 碳原子的排列方式不同，可使碳纳米管呈现出金属性或半导体性，以此可以将其分为金属性碳纳米管和半导体性碳纳米管。在碳纳米管的制备过程中，不同导电性能的碳纳米管通常混杂生长，导致碳纳米管的应用面临挑战。目前分离金属性和半导体性碳纳米管的方法主要有：①电泳分离法，利用金属性和半导体性碳纳米管的电场运动方向不同实现分离；②DNA识别法，利用DNA的识别特性分离不同类型的碳纳米管；③选择性氧化法，利用大电流烧蚀去除金属性碳纳米管，或者利用双氧水对金属性和半导体性单壁碳纳米管进行热处理来选择性氧化分离；④转化法，通过紫外线使碳纳米管发生氧化，导致金属性纳米管形成缺陷，使金属性碳纳米管转化为半导体性；⑤密度梯度分离法，利用不同类型碳纳米管吸附的表面活性剂量的不同而引起的密度变化进行离心分离。金属性碳纳米管膜有望替代ITO等透明导电薄膜，半导体性碳纳米管膜在大规模集成电路等领域具有应用前景。
explanation_en: Different arrangement of carbon atoms can make carbon nanotube appear metallic or semiconducting, which can be divided into metallic carbon nanotube and semiconducting carbon nanotube. In the preparation process of carbon nanotube, carbon nanotube with different conductivity are usually grown intermittently, which leads to the challenge of the application of carbon nanotube. At present, the main methods for separating metallic and semiconducting carbon nanotube are as follows: ① electrophoretic separation, which uses the different directions of electric field movement of metallic and semiconducting carbon nanotube to achieve separation; ② DNA recognition method, using the recognition characteristics of DNA to separate different types of carbon nanotube; ③ Preferential oxidation method, using high current ablation to remove metallic carbon nanotube, or using hydrogen peroxide to heat treatment metallic and semiconductor single-walled carbon nanotube to preferential oxidation and separate; ④ The conversion method is to oxidize the carbon nanotube through ultraviolet light, resulting in the formation of defects in the metallic nanotube, so that the metallic carbon nanotube can be converted into semiconductors; ⑤ The density gradient separation method uses the density change caused by the different surface active dosage adsorbed by different types of carbon nanotube for centrifugal separation. Metallic carbon nanotube films are expected to replace transparent conductive thin films such as ITO, and semiconductor carbon nanotube films have potential applications in large-scale integrated circuits and other fields.

name_cn: 金属有机化合物化学气相沉积
name_en: metal organic compound chemical vapour deposition MOCVD
explanation_cn: 用金属有机化合物热分解进行气相外延生长的方法，其基本原理是将含有外延材料组分的金属有机化合物气体通过载气输运到反应室.在一定温度下进行外延生长。
explanation_en: The basic principle of vapor phase epitaxy growth by thermal decomposition of organometallic compounds is that the gas of organometallic compounds containing components of epitaxial materials is transported to the reaction chamber through carrier gas for epitaxial growth at a certain temperature.

name_cn: 金属有机化学气相沉积
name_en: metal organic chemical vapor deposition method
explanation_cn: 又称有机金属化学气相沉积。在基板上生长薄膜的一种方法，常用于制备半导体或第二代高温超导涂层导体。
explanation_en: Also known as organic metal chemical vapor deposition. A method of growing thin films on a substrate, which is often used to prepare semiconductors or the second generation high-temperature superconducting coated conductor.

explanation_cn: 金属有机骨架是由金属离子或金属簇合物与刚性的多齿有机配体配位形成的骨架材料。它们大多是由含氧、氮等 多齿有机配体（如芳香多酸或多碱等）与过渡金属离 子自组装形成的配位聚合物。这类材料通常是多孔结 构.其孔隙具有各种形状和尺寸，且孔隙在客体分子 消除时依然是稳定存在的。通过含竣基有机阴离子配体与含氮杂环有机中性配体得到的金属有机骨架材料 具有较高的孔隙率和好的化学稳定性。金属有机骨架 材料具有不饱和配位的金属、大的比表面积和可调控 的孔隙结构.它们比传统多孔材料具有更广泛的应用 前景.例如用于气体吸附和分离、非均相催化剂、过滤、膜分离、磁性材料和光学材料等。另外，它们作 为一种超低密度的多孔材料，在存储大量的甲烷和氢气等燃料气方面有巨大的潜力，有望为下一代交通工 具提供轻便的能源。
explanation_en: The metal organic framework is a framework materials formed by the coordination of metal ions or metal clusters with rigid multidentate organic ligands. Most of them are coordination polymer formed by self-assembly of polydentate organic ligands (such as aromatic polyacids or polybases) containing oxygen, nitrogen and transition metal ions. Such materials usually have a porous structure. The pores have various shapes and sizes, and the pores are still stable when the guest molecules are eliminated. The metal organic framework materials obtained from organic anion ligand containing terminal group and organic neutral ligand containing nitrogen heterocycle has high porosity and good chemical stability. Metal organic framework materials have unsaturated coordination metals, large specific surface and controllable pore structure. They have more extensive application prospects than traditional porous materials, such as gas adsorption and separation, heterogeneous phase catalysts, filtration, membrane separation, magnetic materials and optical materials. In addition, as an ultra-low density porous materials, they have great potential in storing large amounts of methane, hydrogen and other fuel gases, and are expected to provide light energy for the next generation of transportation vehicles.

explanation_cn: 以金属有机骨架作为储氢材料的新型储氢方式。金属有机骨架（MOFs)是由含氧、氮等的多齿有机配体（大多是芳香多酸或多碱）与过渡金属离子自组装而成的多孔网状结构的配位聚合物。 具有孔隙率高、比表面积极大、结构丰富、化学性质稳定、制备过程简单等优点.在气体存储尤其是氢的存储方面展示出广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: Metal organic framework is a new type of hydrogen storage materials. Metal organic framework (MOFs) are porous and reticular coordination polymer, which are self-assembly by polydentate organic ligands (mostly aromatic polyacids or polybases) containing oxygen, nitrogen, etc. and transition metal ions. It has advantages such as high porosity, large specific surface area, rich structure, stable chemical properties, and simple preparation process. It has shown broad application prospects in gas storage, especially hydrogen storage.

explanation_cn: 主链上含有金属碳链或金属Π络合物的聚合物。
explanation_en: The main chain contains metal carbon chains or metals Π Polymer of complex.

explanation_cn: 以金属元素为基础的材料（包括纯金属与合金），可分为钢铁材料和有色金属材料两大类。金属材料一般具有优良的力学性能，特别是高强度和高塑性的配合，还具有优良的可加工性，包括冷、热塑性加工、焊接和铸造等，此外许多金属材料还具有优异的物理特性。
explanation_en: Materials based on metal elements (including pure metals and alloy) can be divided into two categories: steel materials and non-ferrous metallic materials. Metallic materials generally have excellent mechanical properties, especially the combination of high strength and high plasticity, and also have excellent workability, including cold and thermoplastic processing, weld and foundry. In addition, many metallic materials also have excellent physical properties.

explanation_cn: 医用金属材料植人体内后处于长期浸泡在含有机酸、碱金属或碱土金属离子（Na+、K+、Ca2+)、C1-等构成的恒温（37°C)电解质的环境中，加之蛋白质、酶和细胞的作用，材料的腐浊机制复杂。
explanation_en: Medical metallic materials are immersed in a constant temperature (37 ° C) electrolyte environment consisting of organic acid, alkali metal or alkaline earth metal ions (Na+, K+, Ca2+), C1-, etc. for a long time after being implanted in human body. In addition to the effects of protein, enzyme and cells, the decay mechanism of materials is complex.

explanation_cn: 金属氢是一种简并态物质，是双原子分子H2的同素异形体。当氢气被充分压缩，经过相变后便会产生金属氢。
explanation_en: Metallic hydrogen is a kind of degenerate substance, which is an allotrope of diatomic molecule H2. When hydrogen is fully compressed, metallic hydrogen will be produced after phase transformation.

explanation_cn: 金属氢化物储氢指的是金属与氢在一定温度和压强下发生反应生成金属氢化物从而将氢储存起来的储氢方式。其原理是金属与氢的反应具有很好的可逆性，适当升高温度和减小压强即可释放出氢气。其优点是较为安全，储氢容量较高。
explanation_en: Metal hydride hydrogen storage refers to the hydrogen storage mode in which metal and hydrogen react to generate metal hydride at a certain temperature and pressure to store hydrogen. The principle is that the reaction between metals and hydrogen has good reversibility, and hydrogen can be released by appropriately increasing temperature and reducing pressure. Its advantages are relatively safe and high hydrogen storage capacity.

explanation_cn: 可分为过渡金属氧化物催化材料（简称为氧化物催化材料）和非过渡金属氧化物催化材料（常简称为固体酸碱催化材料)。过渡金属氧化物催化材料常为复合氧化物，即多组分的氧化物，其中至少有一种为过渡金属氧化物，且组分间常存在相互作用。
explanation_en: It can be divided into transition metal oxide (referred to as oxide catalytic materials for short) and non transition metal oxide (often referred to as solid acid base catalytic materials for short). The transition metal oxide is usually a composite oxide, that is, a multi-component oxide, of which at least one is a transition metal oxide, and there are often interactions between components.

name_cn: 金属氧化物高温催化材料
name_en: high temperature metal oxide catalytic materials
explanation_cn: 金属氧化物作为高温催化材料，常采用的有钙钛矿型化合物、六铝酸盐、尖晶石型氧化物、萤石型复合氧化物、烧绿石型化合物五 种。
explanation_en: As high-temperature catalytic materials, metal oxides are commonly used in five types: perovskite type compounds, hexaaluminates, spinel type oxides, fluorite type composite oxides, and pyrochlore type compounds.

explanation_cn: 过渡金属与氮原子生成的间隙相化合物。是硬质（难熔）化合物的一大类。
explanation_en: A interstitial phase compound formed by transition metals and nitrogen atoms. It is a large category of hard (refractory) compounds.

explanation_cn: 永磁材料可分为金属永磁材料和铁氧体永磁材料两大类，其中金属永磁材料又可以按不同的分类方法划分为许多种。
explanation_en: Permanent magnet material can be divided into metal permanent magnetic rrmterial and ferrite permanent magnetic material, of which metal permanent magnetic rrmterial can be divided into many kinds according to different classification methods.

explanation_cn: 研究金属与合金的结构及其与性能关系的一门科学，和物理冶金学 (physical metallurgy)类同，但更侧重物理学和实验方法.包括金相、X射线衍射、电子显微术以及各种中子，离子束技术等；揭示金属的性能与其电子结构、原子排列、晶体缺陷、微区成分和相分布等的内在联系。
explanation_en: It is a science to study the structure of metals and alloy and their relationship with properties. It is similar to physical metallurgy, but it focuses more on physics and experimental methods, including metallography, X-ray diffraction, electron microscopy, and various neutron and ion beam technologies; The intrinsic relations between the properties of metals and their electronic structure, atomic arrangement, crystal defect, micro area composition and phase distribution are revealed.

explanation_cn: 见非晶态金属。
explanation_en: See amorphous metal.

explanation_cn: 又称金属的自由电子理论。该理论认为：金属中的价电子高度公有化，因而可近似看作它们在金属内部势场（点阵离子与其他电子平均势场之总和）中自由运动。
explanation_en: Also known as the free electron theory of metals. This theory suggests that the valence electrons in metals are highly public and can be approximated as free motion within the internal potential field of the metal (the sum of the average potential fields of lattice ions and other electrons).

explanation_cn: 过渡金属与硅生成的硬质化合物，由于硅原子的半径较大，不能与过渡金属生成间隙化合物，因而这类硬质化合物化学成分稳 定。金属桂化物具有好的抗氧化性。
explanation_en: The hard compounds formed by transition metals and silicon cannot form interstitial compound with transition metals due to the large radius of silicon atoms, so the chemical composition of these hard compounds is stable. Metal cinnamates have good antioxidant properties.

explanation_cn: 过渡金属与硼生成的硬质化合物。硼化物中钛、锆、铬的原子半径与硼原子半径的比<0.59,其他过渡金属均大于0.59,理论上不属间隙相。
explanation_en: A hard compound formed by transition metals and boron. The ratio of the atomic radius of titanium, zirconium and chromium to the atomic radius of boron in borides is less than 0.59, and other transition metals are more than 0.59. Theoretically, they are not interstitial phase.

explanation_cn: 过渡金属与碳生成的间隙相化合物，是硬质化合物（或称难熔化合物）的一类。
explanation_en: The interstitial phase compound formed by transition metal and carbon is a kind of hard compound (or refractory compound).

explanation_cn: 涂覆金属磁粉的磁带。超细金属铁粉有比铁氧体磁粉更好的磁性能，用它制作磁带.储存信号的密度大大高于铁氧体磁带。
explanation_en: Magnetic tape coated with metal magnetic powder. Ultrafine metal iron powder has better magnetic properties than ferrite magnetic powder. It can be used to make magnetic tapes. The density of stored signals is much higher than that of ferrite magnetic tapes.

explanation_cn: 以金属制成的无机纤维。广义的金属纤维包括外涂塑料的金属纤维、外涂金属的塑料纤维以及外包金属的芯线纤维。大多用物理方法和化学方法来制得，前者有熔融纺丝、超高压挤出、集束拉拔等，后者有还原法、蒸镀法、生长法等。一般采用金属蒸镀技术，在薄膜表面镀覆金属切割而成。
explanation_en: Inorganic fibers made of metal. In a broad sense, metal fibers include metal fibers coated with plastics, plastics fibers coated with metal, and core fibers coated with metal. Most of them are made by physical methods and chemical methods. The former includes melt spinning, ultra-high pressure extrusion, beam concentration drawing, etc., and the latter includes reduction method, evaporation method, growth method, etc. Generally, the film is cut by coating metal on the surface of the film with metal vapor exposition technology.

name_cn: 金属纤维增强生物活性玻璃陶瓷复合材料
name_en: bioactive glass ceramic composite reinforced by metal fiber
explanation_cn: 金属纤维与生物活性玻璃复合而成的一种生物医用复合材料。
explanation_en: A biomedical composite made of metal fiber and bioactive glass composition.

explanation_cn: 材质为纯金属或合金的薄膜。几乎所有的金属和合金都可制成薄膜。制备方法有电镀、化学镀、蒸镀、溅射、离子镀、化学气相沉积（CVD)等。
explanation_en: The film is made of pure metal or alloy. Almost all metals and alloy can be made into films. The preparation methods include electroplating, chemical plating, evaporation plating, sputtering, ion plating, chemical vapor deposition (CVD), etc.

explanation_cn: 指通过表面改性技术，赋予惰性的金属材料表面生物活性，从而促进诱导新生骨组织直接在金属材料表面沉积并形成化学键合。
explanation_en: It refers to endowing inert metallic materials with surface bioactivity through surface modification technology, so as to promote the induction of new bone tissue to deposit directly on the surface of metallic materials and form chemical bonding.

explanation_cn: 金属软磁材料性能好、种类多，是磁性材料中应用最广泛的一类，其磁性取决于它的成分和结构，制备工艺对金属软磁材料的性能有重要影响。常用的金属软磁 材料有工业纯铁、铁硅合金、铁镍合金、铁铝合金、铁铝硅合金等。
explanation_en: Metal soft magnetic material have good performance and many kinds, and are the most widely used type of magnetic materials. Their magnetism depends on their composition and structure. The preparation process has an important impact on the performance of metal soft magnetic material. Common metal soft magnetic materials include Armco-iron, iron silicon alloy, iron nickel alloy, iron aluminum alloy, iron aluminum silicon alloy, etc.

explanation_cn: 金属中价电子组成共用负电子云与晶格上正离子实之间的库仑吸引作用而形成的化学键，金属晶体主要靠金属键结合。金属键不具有方向性，所以在结构上可以密排（如面心立方、密 排六方和体心立方）使能量最低；它们可近似看作金属正离子等径球堆枳，空间利用率高。
explanation_en: The valence electrons in the metal share the chemical bond formed by the Coulomb attraction between the negative electron cloud and the positive ion particles on the lattice, and the metal crystal is mainly bound by the metal bond. Metal bonds do not have directionality, so they can be densely arranged in structure (such as face centered cubic, closely arranged hexagonal, and body centered cubic) to minimize energy; They can be approximated as metal ions with equal diameter spherical aggregates, and have high space utilization efficiency.

explanation_cn: 金属与金属或金属与类金属之间形成的化合物相。决定金属间化合物相结构的主要因素有电负性、尺寸因素和电子浓度等。金属间化合物品体结构虽然较复杂或有序，但从原子结合上讲仍具有金属特性，有金属光泽、导电及导热性等。
explanation_en: The phase of a compound formed between metals or between metals and metalloids. The main factors that determine the phase structure of imermetallif compound are electron-negativity, size factor and electron concentration. Although the structure of imermetallif compound is relatively complex or ordered, they still have metallic properties in terms of atomic combination, such as metallic luster, conductivity and thermal conductivity.

name_cn: 金属间化合物本征脆性
explanation_cn: 来源于晶体结构的长程有序 特性，以及其化学键为金属键和共键价的混合键结 合。普通金属以金属键为主，表现为良好塑性.但强 度特别是高温强度较低。而陶瓷材料通常以共价键为 主，表现出高的强度.但塑性几乎为零。而金属间化 合物两者皆有，塑性和强度介于两者之间。而且共价 键份额愈多，塑性愈差.例如金属间化合物NiAl， 用正电子湮没试验结果表明.其共价键比例为金属键 的两倍.所以等原子比NiAl很脆。不同金属间化合 物的本征脆性的强弱与其塑性变形方式、晶体结构的 对称性和化学计量比成分的偏离等因素密切相关。例 如，如果裂纹形核临界应力低于位错滑移所需的佩尔 斯力，穿晶脆性断裂就会发生；晶体的对称性将决定 可开动滑移系的数目和类型，多晶NiAl具有3个独 立滑移系，少于多晶体变形至少5个独立滑移系的要 求，所以很脆。多晶Ni3 A1在贫A1或富Ni和Ni3 A1 中.加人适量硼可使其拉伸伸长率达到40%,可见 化学计量成分偏差的影响也是很重要的。
explanation_en: It is derived from the long-range ordering characteristics of crystal structure, and its chemical bond is a mixed bond combination of metallic bond and covalent bond. Ordinary metals are mainly composed of metal bonds and exhibit good plasticity, but their strength, especially at high temperatures, is relatively low. Ceramics materials are usually covalent bond based, showing high strength, but the plasticity is almost zero. And intermetallic compounds have both, with plasticity and strength between the two. Moreover, the more the covalent bond share is, the worse the plasticity is. For example, the imermetallif compound NiAl, the positron annihilation test results show that its covalent bond ratio is twice that of the metal bond, so the equiatomic ratio NiAl is very brittle. The intrinsic brittleness of different intermetallics is closely related to the plastic deformation mode, the symmetry of crystal structure and the deviation of stoichiometric composition. For example, if the critical stress of crack nucleation is lower than the Peirce force required for dislocation slip, transgranular brittle fracture will occur; Symmetry of crystal will determine the number and type of movable slip system. polycrystal NiAl has three independent slip system, which is less than the requirement of polycrystalline deformation of at least five independent slip system, so it is very brittle. The tensile elongation of polycrystal Ni3A1 in poor A1 or rich Ni and Ni3A1 can reach 40% by adding appropriate boron. It can be seen that the influence of stoichiometric composition deviation is also very important.

name_cn: 金属间化合物的反常屈服行为
explanation_cn: 一般金属材料的屈服强度随温度的升高而降低，而一些金属间化合物的屈服强度随温度的升高而升高，直到达到峰值温度，而后随温度升高而降低.表现出一种反常的屈服行为。
explanation_en: The yield strength of general metallic materials decreases with the increase of temperature, while the yield strength of some imermetallif compound increases with the increase of temperature until reaching the peak temperature, and then decreases with the increase of temperature, showing an abnormal yield behavior.

name_cn: 金属间化合物的环境脆性
explanation_cn: 很多有序金属间化合物在室温空气中塑性很低并呈脆性断裂，同样的材料在真空中则具有较好塑性，这种与环境有关的脆性称为环境脆性。
explanation_en: Many ordered imermetallif compound have low plasticity and brittle fracture in room temperature and air, while the same materials has good plasticity in vacuum. This environment related brittleness is called environmental brittleness.

explanation_cn: 由金属或合金与一种或几种陶瓷相所组成非匀质的复合材料。金属与陶瓷相在制备温度下的固溶度应较小。其中陶瓷占15%-85% (体积分数）。金属几乎具备所有的理想性能：热导、强度和延展性等，但高温应用略显逊色。而陶瓷的高熔点，高强度，抗氧化和抗蠕变，恰好弥补了金属的不足。金属陶瓷的制备技术与陶瓷相似。将金属粉与陶瓷粉混合均匀后成型，再烧结致密，即制成金属陶瓷。也有采用陶瓷坯体浸渍金属等方法进行制备。
explanation_en: A heterogeneous composite materials consisting of metal or alloy and one or more ceramics phase. The solid solubility of metal and ceramics phase at the preparation temperature should be small. Among them, ceramics account for 15% -85% (volume fraction). Metals have almost all the ideal properties: thermal conductivity, strength, and ductility, but are slightly inferior in high-temperature applications. The high melting point, high strength, oxidation resistance and creep resistance of ceramics just make up for the lack of metal. The preparation technology of cermet is similar to that of ceramics. The cermet is made by mixing the metal powder and ceramics powder evenly, forming, and then sintering. It is also prepared by impregnating ceramics body with metal.

explanation_cn: 硬质化合物与金属烧结成的片状金属陶瓷。借助于电焊、氩(氮）弧焊、激光焊、co2保护焊等手工或自动焊接技术，将金属陶瓷堆焊片堆焊在钢制工件表面，形成冶金结合层。
explanation_en: A lamellar cermet sintered from a hard compound and metal. With the help of manual or automatic weld technologies such as electric welding, argon (nitrogen) arc welding, laser welding, co2 shielded welding, etc., cermet overlay plate overlaying is welded on the surface of steel workpiece to form a metallurgical bonding layer.

explanation_cn: 由金属或合金的颗粒或薄片经过磨细而制得的颜料。品种有铝粉、铜粉、锌粉、铅粉、钛粉和不锈钢粉等，其中以铝粉的 需求量最大。这类颜料具有金属的色相和光泽，大多 是极微细的粉末，颗粒形状常因制造方式而异。由于 金属具有延展性.很多品种呈细微的鱗片状粉末，有较强的光线反射能力.所配制成的涂料具有金属闪亮 点。金属颜料所具有的鳞片状结构可使其在涂层内多 层排列，阻断腐蚀介质和紫外线在涂膜中通向底材的 通道，产生屏蔽效应，防腐效果良好。除了真空沉淀法生产铝粉颜料外，几乎所有金属颜料都是通过机械 将圆形或不规则形状的金属粉体加工成薄片状粉体而 成.即将雾化法制得的金属粉末再经球磨而成。球磨 以后，再经筛分或旋风分级机进行分级，以控制产品的粒径范围。其他的后处理还包括抛光，改进片状粒 子的平整度.除去凝聚体，从而提高颜料成品的光亮度和分散性。金属颜料可应用表面包膜，以赋予颜料 抗失光和抗氧化性能，提高其在水或其他介质中的分 散性。金属颜料被广泛应用于粉末冶金、炼钢、合金 冶炼、焊接、化工建材、涂料、油墨、塑料等领域中。
explanation_en: Pigment made by grinding particles or flakes of metal or alloy. Varieties include aluminium powder, copper powder, zinc powder, lead powder, titanium powder and stainless steel powder, among which aluminium powder has the largest demand. This kind of pigment has a metallic hue and luster, most of which are extremely fine powder, and the shape of particles often varies according to the manufacturing method. Due to the malleability of metal, many varieties are fine flake powder with strong light reflection ability. The coatings prepared has metal shiny spots. The scale like structure of metallic pigmem can make it be arranged in multiple layers in the coating, blocking the passage of corrosion medium and ultraviolet ray to the substrate in the coating film, resulting in shielding effect and good anti-corrosion effect. In addition to the production of aluminium powder pigment by vacuum precipitation method, almost all metallic pigmem are made by mechanically processing round or irregular shaped metallic powders into thin flake shaped powders, that is, the atomized metallic powder is then ball milled. After ball milling, the product is classified through screening or cyclone classifier to control the particle size range. Other post-treatment also includes polishing, improving the flatness of flake particles, and removing agglomerates, so as to improve the brightness and dispersion of pigment finished products. Metallic pigmem can be coated on the surface to endow pigment with anti fading and anti-oxidation properties and improve their dispersibility in water or other media. Metallic pigmem are widely used in powder metallurgy, steelmaking, alloy smelting, weld, chemical building materials, coatings, inks, plastics and other fields.

explanation_cn: 含金属金的厚膜导体浆料主要有 A-2763、A-3319、A-3360、A-3362 四种牌号。金浆料性能好，但价格较贵，应用于微电路中。
explanation_en: The conductive paste for thick film containing metallic gold mainly includes A-2763, A-3319, A-3360 and A-3362. Gold slurry has good performance, but it is relatively expensive and is used in microcircuits.

explanation_cn: 含金及铂族金属的总含量>75%,熔化温度为745-780°C的合金，通 常用于铬镍不锈钢、钴铬合金及镍铬合金的焊接。可以加人适量的锌和锡以降低合金的熔点。
explanation_en: Alloy with total content of gold and platinum group metals>75% and melting temperature of 745-780 ° C is usually used for weld of chromium nickel stainless steel, cobalt chromium alloy and nickel chromium alloy. An appropriate amount of zinc and tin can be added to reduce the melting point of alloy.

explanation_cn: 主要依靠显微镜技术研究金属材料的宏观、微观组织形成和变化规律及其与成分和性能之间关系的实验学科，乃金属学的先导， 是金属学赖以形成和发展的基础，也是金属学的重要组成部分。
explanation_en: The experimental discipline, which mainly relies on microscope technology to study the formation and change laws of macro and micro structures of metallic materials and their relations with composition and properties, is the leader of physical metallurgy, the basis on which physical metallurgy is formed and developed, and also an important part of physical metallurgy.

explanation_cn: 简单链状结构氧化物矿物。化学式为 TiO2。成分中常含 Fe2+、Fe3+、Nb、Ta、Sn 等类质同象混入物。
explanation_en: Simple chain structured oxide minerals. The chemical formula is TiO2. The ingredients often contain isomorphic mixtures such as Fe2+, Fe3+, Nb, Ta, Sn, etc.

explanation_cn: 金红石为AB2型离子晶体，是由二氧化钛组成的三种矿物之一，另 外两个是锐钛矿和板钛矿。属四方晶系，简单四方点阵。
explanation_en: Rutile is an AB2 type ionic crystal, which is one of three minerals composed of titanium dioxide, and the other two are anatase and brookite. It belongs to the tetragonal crystal system and is a simple tetragonal lattice.

explanation_cn: 化学式TiO2。属于四方晶系。
explanation_en: Chemical formula TiO2. Belongs to the tetragonal crystal system.

explanation_cn: 主晶相为金红石的TiO2陶瓷。二氧化钛共有三种结晶型.即金红石、 锐钛矿和板钛矿。这三种结晶状态的物理电气性能以 金红石为最好，结晶状态比较稳定.属四方晶系结构。
explanation_en: TiO2 ceramics whose main crystal phase is rutile. There are three crystalline forms of titanium dioxide, namely rutile, anatase, and perovskite. The physical and electrical properties of the three crystal states are best in rutile, which is relatively stable and belongs to tetragonal crystal system structure.

explanation_cn: 一种铍铝氧化物。化学式为BeAl2O4，可含有Fe、Cr、Ti等元素。常呈板状、短柱状晶形。浅至中等黄、黄绿、灰绿、褐色至黄褐色、浅蓝色（稀少），有变色效应者又称变石。
explanation_en: A type of beryllium aluminum oxide. The chemical formula is BeAl2O4, which can contain elements such as Fe, Cr, Ti, etc. Often in the form of plate-shaped or short columnar crystals. Light to medium yellow, yellow green, gray green, brown to yellow brown, light blue (rare), also known as variable stone.

explanation_cn: 可直称为猫眼或猫眼石，是具有猫眼效应的宝石级金绿宝石品种,, 颜色从浅黄色到深黄渴色，以蜜黄色的为最佳。参见金绿宝石。
explanation_en: It can be directly called cat's eye or cats eye. It is a gems grade chrysoberyl variety with cat's eye effect. Its color ranges from light yellow to dark yellow, and honey yellow is the best. See gold green sapphire.

explanation_cn: 与YBCO类似的高温超导体，在磁场下的载流性能比YBCO更加优良.因此，在实用价值方面比YBCO更有潜力。
explanation_en: High-temperature superconductor similar to YBCO has better current carrying performance under magnetic field than YBCO. Therefore, it has more potential in practical value than YBCO.

explanation_cn: 化学式Gd3Ga5O12。简称GGG。属立方晶系。晶格常数12.376埃，熔点约1825℃,密度7.09g/cm3,呈无色透明。常用提拉法生长。用作磁泡存储元件的衬底材料。
explanation_en: The chemical formula Gd3Ga5O12. Abbreviated as GGG. It belongs to the cubic crystal system. The lattice constant is 12.376 angstrom, the melting point is about 1825 ℃, the density is 7.09g/cm3, and it is colorless and transparent. It is often grown by pulling method method. The backing materials is used as a magnetic bubble storage element.

explanation_cn: 见褐帘石。
explanation_en: See allanite.

explanation_cn: 它是首个发现的超导温度在77K以上的材料，属于第二类超导体，超导转变温度92K。利用沉积在金属基带上YBCO薄膜而制成的涂层导体，是目前最有前景的实用超导材料，在超导强电和超导电子学方面有着广泛的应用，如高温超导电缆、高温超导限流器、高温超导滤波器、高温超导电机等。利用粉末熔融法制备的YBCO大块单晶材料是目前高温超导磁悬浮列车最主要的应用材料。
explanation_en: It is the first materials with a superconducting temperature above 77K, belonging to type II superconductor with a superconducting transition temperature of 92K. The coated conductor made of YBCO thin film deposited on the metal substrate is the most promising practical superconducting materials at present. It has a wide range of applications in superconducting strong electricity and superconducting electronics, such as high-temperature superconducting power cable, high temperature superconclucling fault current limiter, high-temperature superconciucting wave-filter, high temperature superconducting motor, etc. YBCO bulk single crystal materials prepared by powder melting method is the main application materials of high-temperature superconducting maglev train at present.

explanation_cn: 由化学计量比为1:2:3的钇、钡、铜三种元素与氧原子组成的高温超导薄膜。其正交相时为超导相。几乎所有制备薄膜的方法，如电子束蒸发法、分子束外延法、离子束溅射法、磁控溅射法、脉冲激光沉积法、化学气相沉积（CVD）法等都可用来制备质量良好的薄膜。在许多单晶基片上以及一些有隔离层的复合基片上.都可以外延生长成轴取向的高质量的钇钡铜氧薄膜。
explanation_en: A high-temperature superconducting thin film composed of yttrium, barium, and copper with a stoichiometric ratio of 1:2:3 and oxygen atoms. The orthogonal phase is superconducting phase. Almost all methods for preparing thin films, such as electron beam evaporation, molecular beam epitaxy, ion beam sputtering, magnetron sputtering, pulsed laser deposition, chemical vapor deposition (CVD), can be used to prepare films with good quality. High quality YBa2Cu307 films with axial orientation can be epitaxial growth on many single crystal substrates and some composition substrates with isolation layers.

explanation_cn: 简称为YAC。属于立方晶系，石樹石型结构。与稀土离子的半径比较接近，在十二面体格位中可以掺入一定数目的三价稀土激活离子。振荡阈值低，转换效率高，物理、化学性能稳定性好，既可激发脉冲输出.亦可激发连续输出。采用提拉法生长的YAG是中小型间体激光器用的重要工作物质。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as YAC. It belongs to the cubic crystal system and has a stone tree stone structure. The radius of rare earth ions is relatively close, and a certain number of trivalent rare earth activated ions can be doped into the dodecahedral lattice. The oscillation threshold is low, the conversion efficiency is high, and the physical and chemical properties are stable. It can stimulate both pulse output and continuous output. YAG grown by pulling method method is an important working material for medium and small volume lasers.

explanation_cn: 简称YAG。它属于立方晶系，石榴石结构YAG多种氧化物构成，故阳离子之间构成较复杂的结构。氧四面体和氧八面体之间的空隙是十二面体。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as YAG. It belongs to cubic crystal system, and is composed of gamet structure, YAG and various oxides, so the cations form a more complex structure. The gap between oxygen tetrahedra and oxygen octahedra is a dodecahedron.

name_cn: 钇铝石榴石激光透明陶瓷
name_en: yttrium aluminum garnet laser transparent ceramics
explanation_cn: 简写为YAG。是一种由氧化铝和氧化钇反应烧结形成的透明陶瓷材料，通过掺杂激活离子实现激光输出的性能。YAG透明陶瓷的主要物理化学性质与YAG单晶材料基本相同，其优点为断裂韧度约为单晶的3倍，可以实现大尺寸制备和高达5%(原子分数）Nd的掺杂。制备工艺主要包括：同相反应法，即掺杂离子氧化物，在1700-1850T烧结形成YAG相透明陶瓷;液相法，即先制备钇铝和核杂离子均匀分布的YAG粉体，成型烧结得到透明陶瓷。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as YAG. It is a transparent ceramics materials formed by reactive sintering of aluminum oxide and yttrium oxide. It can achieve laser output performance by doping active ions. The main physical chemistry properties of YAG transparent ceramics are basically the same as those of YAG single crystal materials. Its advantage is that the fracture toughness is about three times that of single crystal, which can realize large-scale preparation and up to 5% (atomic fraction) Nd doping. The preparation process mainly includes: in phase reaction method, namely doping ion oxides, forming YAG phase transparent ceramics by sintering at 1700-1850T; Liquid phase method, that is to prepare YAG powder with uniform distribution of yttrium aluminum and nuclear hetero ions, and form sintering to obtain transparent ceramics.

explanation_cn: 简称YGG。属于立方晶系。是一种激光晶体。晶体主要适用于脉冲状态下工作。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as YGG. Belongs to the cubic crystal system. It is a laser crystal. Crystal is mainly suitable for working in pulse state.

explanation_cn: 外观上银灰色或有金属光泽的针状，热膨胀系数值低，具有很高各向异性的焦炭是生产超高功率电极、特种炭材料等的原料。根据初始原料不同，可分为油系和煤系两种。
explanation_en: The silver gray or metallic needle shaped coke with low coefficient of thermal expansion and high anisotropy is the raw material for producing ultra-high power electrodes and special carbon materials. According to different initial raw materials, it can be divided into oil series and coal series.

explanation_cn: 室温使用态组织为针状铁体或针状铁素体加少量等轴铁素体的低碳或超低碳钢。针状铁素体内部具有高密度的位错和位错组态，其强度比等轴铁素体明显要高，故在相同的碳含量下比等轴铁素体钢具有更高的强度，而在同样的强度级别下则比等轴铁素体钢的碳含量要低从而可明显提高钢的低温钿性和焊接性。采用较低的碳含量、添加抑制珠光体相变的合金元素如Nb、Mo、Mn并采用适当的控制冷却工艺，可得到。广泛用于对强度和韧性要求较高的管线钢。
explanation_en: Low carbon or ultra-low-carhon steel with acicular ferrite or acicular ferrite and a small amount of equiaxed ferrite as the structure at room temperature. The acicular iron has a high density dislocation and dislocation configuration inside, and its strength is significantly higher than that of equiaxed iron. Therefore, it has higher strength than equiaxed iron steel at the same carbon content, while at the same strength level, it has lower carbon content than equiaxed iron steel, which can significantly improve the low-temperature conductivity and weldability of steel. It can be obtained by using lower carbon content, adding alloy elements such as Nb, Mo, Mn that inhibit pearlite phase transformation and adopting appropriate controlled cooling process. It is widely used for pipe line steel with high requirements on strength and toughness.

explanation_cn: 化学组成稳定。斜晶系，晶体呈针状、柱状，通常呈放射状集合体;无色、白色、灰白色。玻璃光泽或丝絹光泽。硬度4.55,密度2.74-2.88g/cm3。富Mn的称锰针钠钙石。是热液作用的产物主要产于基性喷出岩的杏仁体中，与沸石和方解石共生。有时出现在钙质变质岩、碱性侵入岩和云母橄榄岩中。
explanation_en: Stable chemical composition. The crystal of the clinoptilolite system are needle shaped, columnar, and usually radial aggregates; Colorless, white, grayish white. Glass luster or silk luster. Hardness 4.55, density 2.74-2.88g/cm3. Mn rich pectolite. The product of hydrothermal process is mainly produced in the amygdale of basic extrusive rock, coexisting with zeolite and caldte. Sometimes it occurs in calcareous metamorphic rock, alkaline intrusive rocks and mica peridmite.

explanation_cn: 简单链状结构氢氧化物矿物。常有混入物Mn(可达5%)、A1等。斜方晶系。晶体平行Z轴呈针状、柱状并具纵纹，或成薄板状或鱗片状，集合体呈豆状、肾状、钟乳状，切面具平行或放射状、纤维状构造，也常见成致密块状或土状。红褐、暗褐至黑色，条痕红褐色。金刚至半金属光泽。断口参差状，性脆。主要形成于外生条件下，是组成褐铁矿的主要矿物成分。量多时可作炼铁的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Simple chain structured hydroxide minerals. There are often mixed substances such as Mn (up to 5%) and A1. Orthorhombic crystal system. The parallel Z axis of crystal is needle shaped, columnar and longitudinal, or lamellar or scaly. The aggregates are bean shaped, kidney shaped, and stalactite shaped. The cutting surface is parallel, radial, fibrous, and also commonly in dense block or soil shape. Red brown, dark brown to black, with streaks of reddish brown. Diamond to semi metallic luster. The fracture surface is uneven and brittle. It is mainly formed under exogenous conditions and is the main mineral component of limonite. It can be used as raw mineral material for ironmaking in large quantities.

explanation_cn: 钌系厚膜电阻浆料是使用最广泛的一种电阻浆料。具有阻值范围宽、电阻温度系数低、阻值重现性好、环境稳定性好等优点。浆料主要有二氧化钌电阻浆料、钉酸铋电阻浆料、钌酸铅电阻浆料等。钌系电阻浆料由导电相材料(二氧化钌、钌酸铋、钉酸铅等)、玻璃黏结剂、有机栽体等组成典型的钌系电阻浆料的组成为:导电相,无机黏结剂;溶剂;有机聚合物。钉系电阻浆料用于制作厚膜电阻，如DP17系钌系电阻浆料用于制作高性能电阻和高可靠精密电阻网络。
explanation_en: Ru based resistance paste for thick film is the most widely used resistor paste. It has the advantages of wide resistance range, low resistance temperature coefficient, good resistance reproducibility, and good environmental stability. The main types of slurries include ruthenium dioxide resistance slurries, bismuth nail acid resistance slurries, lead ruthenium acid resistance slurries, etc. The ruthenium series resistance paste is composed of conductive phase materials (ruthenium dioxide, bismuth ruthenium oxide, lead succinate, etc.), glass adhesive, organic carrier, etc. The typical ruthenium series resistance paste is composed of conductive phase, inorganic adhesive; Solvent; Organic polymer. Pin resistance paste is used to make thick film resistors, for example, DP17 series ruthenium series resistance paste is used to make high-performance resistors and highly reliable precision resistance networks.

explanation_cn: 元素周期表的中原子序数为90。.化学符号Th。有6种天然同位素和9种人工同位素。其中232Th可变为233U。钍-铀、钍钚-铀-锆是有希望的快堆燃料；钍-铀混合氧化物是高温气冷堆燃料。
explanation_en: The atomic number in the periodic table is 90 Chemical symbol Th. There are 6 natural isotopes and 9 artificial isotopes. 232Th can be changed to 233U. Thorium uranium and thorium plutonium uranium zirconium are promising fast reactor fuels; Thorium uranium mixed oxide is the fuel of high temperature gas cooled reactor.

explanation_cn: 镍基化合物超导体，也属于第二类超导体.超导临界温度为5.0K.上临界磁场为5.8T。这种超导体在凝聚态物理领域备受关注。
explanation_en: Nickel based compound superconductor also belongs to type II superconductor. The superconductor critical temperature is 5.0K, and the upper critical magnetic field is 5.8T. This type of superconductor has attracted much attention in the field of condensed matter physics.

explanation_cn: 又称钎焊熔剂，钎焊时使用的熔剂。钎焊时使用钎剂是为保证钎焊过程顺利进行并获得牢固的钎焊接头。除真空及保护气氛中钎焊或采用ft钎剂钎料外，大多数钎焊中均广泛采用钎剂。钎剂在钎焊过程中的功用主要有：清除母材及钎料表面氧化物-为液态钎料在钎焊母材表面润湿和铺展创造必要条件；以液态薄膜层覆盖钎焊母材和钎料表面。防止在加热过程中发生氧化；活化表面，增进钎料的润湿和流动。为此。钎剂必须满足以下几个基本要求：具有足够的去除母材及钎料表面氧化膜能力；钎剂熔化温度及最低活性温度低于钎料的熔化温度：在钎焊温度范围白具有足够的热稳定性；在钎焊温度下粘度小，流动性好；能很好润湿母材及钎料；密度小于液态钎料等。软钎焊时所用钎剂称软钎剂（solderingflux)，可分为有机系软钎剂和无机系软钎剂，有机系软钎剂主要用于电子工业。包括松香、酯类、胺类、有机卤化物等，腐蚀性很弱；无机系软轩剂主要有盐酸、氢氟酸、磷酸、氯化锌、氯化铵等，腐蚀性很强。硬钎焊时所用的钎剂称硬钎剂（brazingfkix)，主要包括硼砂、硼酸、碱金属和碱土金属的氟化物和氯化物等。
explanation_en: Also called soldering flux, the flux used in soldering. Brazing flux is used in soldering to ensure smooth soldering process and secure soldering joints. Brazing flux is widely used in most soldering, except for soldering in vacuum and protective atmosphere or using ft brazing flux brazing filler metal. The functions of brazing flux in soldering process mainly include: removing the surface oxides of base metal and brazing filler metal - creating necessary conditions for the wetting and spreading of liquid brazing filler metal on the surface of soldering base metal; The surface of soldering base metal and brazing filler metal is covered with a liquid film layer. Prevent oxidation during the heating process; Activation or conditioning the surface, improve the wetting and flow of brazing filler metal. For this reason. Brazing flux must meet the following basic requirements: it has sufficient ability to remove the oxide film on the surface of base metal and brazing filler metal; The melting temperature and minimum active temperature of brazing flux are lower than the melting temperature of brazing filler metal: it has sufficient thermal stability in the soldering temperature range; Low viscosity and good flow ability at soldering temperature; It can well wet the base metal and brazing filler metal; The density is less than that of liquid brazing filler metal. The brazing flux used in soft soldering is called soft brazing flux, which can be divided into organic soft brazing flux and inorganic soft brazing flux. The organic soft brazing flux is mainly used in the electronic industry. Including rosin, esters, amines, organic halides, etc., with weak corrosiveness; Inorganic soft agents mainly include hydrochloric acid, hydrofluoric acid, phosphoric acid, zinc chloride, ammonium chloride, etc., which have strong corrosiveness. The brazing flux used in brazing is called brazing flux, which mainly includes borax, boric acid, fluoride and chloride of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals.

explanation_cn: 在纤焊时采用的熔接材料。钎料主要采用金属材料，可以是纯金属，也可以是多元合金，而用于氧化铝陶瓷与铌合金封接时还采用氧化物钎料（俗称封接玻璃）。对用作钎料的材料应具有以下特性：合适的熔化温度，其液相线应低于被连接母材的同相线；在钎焊温度下能润湿母材，并能与母材之间发生相互溶解、扩散、界面冶金反应，填充接头形成样缝。根据熔化温度的不同。钎料可分为软钎料（液相线低于450°C)和硬钎料（液相线高于450°C)两种。软钎料主要有Sn-Pb钎料、Sn-Zn钎料、Cd-Zn钎料、Bi基钎料、In基钎料等。硬纤料主要Al基钎料、Ag-基钎料、Cu基钎料、Ni基轩料、Au基钎料、Pd基钎料等。软轩料熔化温度比较低，可使用烙铁、喷灯等普通热源进行钎焊，操作容易，价格低廉。在工业上应用广泛；但熔化温度及力学性能较低，限制了软钎焊接头只能在不太高的工作温度和受力较小的环境中使用。i当要求钎焊接头具有较高的综合性能时，必须采用硬钎料。
explanation_en: The fusion materials used in fiber welding. Brazing filler metal is mainly metallic materials, which can be pure metal or multi-component alloy. When used for sealing alumina ceramics and niobium alloy, oxide brazing filler metal (commonly known as sealing glass) is also used. The materials used as brazing filler metal shall have the following characteristics: suitable melting temperature, its liquidus shall be lower than that of the connected base metal; At the soldering temperature, the base metal can be wetted, and mutual dissolution, diffusion and interface metallurgical reaction can occur between the base metal and the base metal to fill the joints and form sample joints. Depending on the melting temperature. Brazing filler metal can be divided into soft brazing filler metal (liquidus below 450 ° C) and hard brazing filler metal (liquidus above 450 ° C). Soft brazing filler metal mainly includes Sn Pb brazing filler metal, Sn Zn brazing filler metal, Cd Zn brazing filler metal, Bi based brazing filler metal, In based brazing filler metal, etc. Hard fiber materials mainly include Al based brazing filler metal, Ag based brazing filler metal, Cu based brazing filler metal, Ni based solder, Au based brazing filler metal, Pd based brazing filler metal, etc. The melting temperature of soft solder is relatively low, and common heat sources such as soldering iron and blowtorch can be used for soldering, which is easy to operate and cheap. Widely used in industry; However, the low melting temperature and mechanical properties limit the use of soft soldering joints only in the environment of low working temperature and low stress. I When soldering joints are required to have high comprehensive properties, brazing filler metal must be used.

explanation_cn: 焊件母材加热到一定温度，利用钎料熔化使母材连接起来的焊接方法。焊接过程中母材不熔化-因而钎料的液相线应低于母材的固相线熔化的钎料依靠界面润湿和毛细作用填充母材连接处的缝隙。形成钎缝。钎焊过程中。钎料与母材还会发生相互溶解和扩散，从而形成牢固的冶金结合。钎料金属通常采用铜、银、金、锡等金属及其合金，钎料熔点高于450°C的称为硬钎焊（bmzing)，钎料熔点低于450°C的称为软钎焊（soldering)。工业上广泛采用的钎焊方法有火焰钎焊、炉中钎焊、感应钎焊、浸渍钎焊、烙铁钎焊、电阻钎焊、电弧钎焊、激光钎焊等。钎焊广泛应用于航空航天、电工电子、家电、仪表、汽车等制造业。
explanation_en: A weld method in which the base metal of the weldment is heated to a certain temperature and the base metal is connected by melting brazing filler metal. The base metal does not melt during weld - so the liquidus of brazing filler metal should be lower than the solidus of the base metal. The molten brazing filler metal fills the gap at the base metal connection by interface wetting and capillarity. Forming brazing seams. During soldering. Brazing filler metal and base metal will dissolve and diffusion each other, forming a solid metallurgical bond. Brazing filler metal metals usually use copper, silver, gold, tin and other metals and their alloy. brazing filler metal with a melting point higher than 450 ° C is called soldering, and brazing filler metal with a melting point lower than 450 ° C is called soft soldering. The widely used soldering methods in industry include flame soldering, furnace soldering, induction soldering, immersion soldering, soldering iron soldering, resistance soldering, arc soldering, laser soldering, etc. Soldering is widely used in aerospace, electrical and electronic, household appliances, instruments, automobiles and other manufacturing industries.

explanation_cn: 与YBCO类似的高温超导体.在实用超导性能方面也与YBCO类似。
explanation_en: High-temperature superconductor similar to YBCO is also similar to YBCO in practical superconductivity.

explanation_cn: 以SmCo5,或Sm2Co17金属间化合物相为基的永磁材料。主要分为高使用温度钐钴稀土永磁材料、正矫顽力温度系数钐钴稀土永磁、零剩磁温度系数钐钴稀土永磁、高电阻率钐钴稀土永磁、高力学性能钐钴稀土永磁等。
explanation_en: Permanent magnet material based on SmCo5 or Sm2Co17 imermetallif compound phase. It mainly includes high service temperature samarium cobalt the rare earth permanent magnetic material, positive coercive force temperature coefficient samarium cobalt rare earth permanent magnet, zero remanence temperature coefficient samarium cobalt rare earth permanent magnet, high resistivity samarium cobalt rare earth permanent magnet, high mechanical performance samarium cobalt rare earth permanent magnet, etc.

explanation_cn: 铁基超导体1111相中的一种，通常在O位上掺杂F或者使0缺位，可以获得超导电性。
explanation_en: Superconductivity is one of 1111 phases of iron-based superconductor. Usually, F is doped on the O position or 0 is absent.

explanation_cn: 金属间化合物超导体，晶体结构为A3B型A15结构。超导临界温度Tc=17.1K。
explanation_en: The crystal structure of imermetallif compound superconductor is A3B type A15 structure. Superconductor critical temperature Tc=17.1K.

explanation_cn: 金属间化合物超导体，晶体结构为A3B型A15结构。超导临界温度：Tc=16.5K,在4.2K下的上临界磁场Hc2=24.0T。
explanation_en: The crystal structure of imermetallif compound superconductor is A3B type A15 structure. Superconductor critical temperature: Tc=16.5K, and the upper critical magnetic field Hc2=24.0T at 4.2K.

explanation_cn: 以钒为基加入铬、钛、铁、锆、钽、钨、铌、碳等元素组成的固溶合金或复合强化合金。钒合金具有低活化性、高热导率、高蠕变强度、低热胀性，优良的力学性能和抗辐射肿胀性，可承受比不锈钢高4-7倍的热负荷。
explanation_en: A solution alloy or a composition strengthened alloy based on vanadium and composed of chromium, titanium, iron, zirconium, tantalum, tungsten, niobium, carbon and other elements. Vanadium alloy has low activation, high thermal conductivity, high creep strength, low thermal expansion, excellent mechanical properties and radiation swelling resistance, and can withstand 4-7 times higher heat load than stainless steel.

name_en: yttrium vanadate activated by ytterbium and holmium
explanation_cn: 化学式YVO4:Yb3+，Ho3+。白色粉末，四方晶系，a=7.123,c=6.291。相对密度4.242。960nm激光激发下.在545nm和549nm两处发射峰最强。
explanation_en: Chemical formula YVO4: Yb3+, Ho3+. White powder, tetragonal system, a=7.123, c=6.291. Relative density 4.242. Under 960nm laser excitation, the emission peaks are strongest at 545nm and 549nm.

explanation_cn: 主要用作合金添加剂的铁和钒的合金，钒含量通常为40%-80%。多用钼、硅还原五氧化二钒而得到钒铁，通常采用电硅热法和铝热法生产。
explanation_en: Iron and vanadium alloy, mainly used as additive for alloy, usually contain 40% -80% vanadium. Ferrovanadium is obtained by reducing V205 with molybdenum and silicon, which is usually produced by electro silicothermic method and aluminothermic method.

explanation_cn: 是分布在沉积岩层和黄土中的一些钙质组成的团块。其形状有卵形、球状和不规则状。主要矿物成分是方解石。
explanation_en: It is a block composed of some calcareous substances distributed in sedimentary rock strata and loess. Its shapes include oval, spherical, and irregular shapes. The main mineral composition is caldte.

explanation_cn: 是Fe基超导体相中的一种，超导转变温度可达50K。
explanation_en: It is one of the Fe based superconductor phases, and the superconducting transition temperature can reach 50K.

explanation_cn: 含水的层状结构磷酸盐矿物。化学式为Ca(H20)8[U02(P04)]2·nH2O。加热失水转变成变钙铀云母（metaautunite)。
explanation_en: A layered phosphate mineral with water content. The chemical formula is Ca (H20) 8 [U02 (P04)] 2 · nH2O. After heating and water loss, transformation is made into metauranite.

explanation_cn: 钚是一种放射性元素，原子序数为94，元素符号Pu，是原子能工业的一种重要原料，可作为核燃料和核武器的裂变剂。投于长崎市的原子弹，使用了钚制作内核部分。钚于1940年12月首次在美国加州大学伯克利分校及劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室被合成。参与合成者包括诺贝尔奖得主西博格和埃德温·麦克米伦等人。
explanation_en: Plutonium is a radioactive element with atomic number 94 and element symbol Pu. It is an important raw material for the atomic energy industry and can be used as a fissile agent for nuclear fuel and nuclear weapons. The atomic bomb dropped in Nagasaki used plutonium to make the core. Plutonium was first synthesized at the University of California, Berkeley and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory in December 1940. Participants in the synthesis include Nobel laureates Siberg and Edwin McMillen, among others.

explanation_cn: 参见坏。
explanation_en: See also bad.

explanation_cn: 钽膜电路中所用的薄膜导电材料，一般也是多层膜，其底层多为钛膜。若直接在钽膜上覆盖金膜，除了附着性不好以外，在较高的温度下，钽原子通过金晶界扩散一直到达金膜表面，形成高阻值的TaAu,使膜层阻值增大，影响稳定性和可靠性。Ti-Au膜的抗蚀性好，其耐潮性优于Ni-Cr-Au膜，不适宜用于功率较大的电路。
explanation_en: The thin film conductive material used in the tantalum film circuit is generally a multilayer, and the bottom layer is mostly titanium film. If the gold film is directly covered on the tantalum film, in addition to poor adhesion, at higher temperatures, tantalum atoms diffusion through the gold grain boundary to the gold film surface, forming high resistance TaAu, which increases the resistance of the film and affects stability and reliability. Ti Au film has good corrosion resistance and better moisture resistance than Ni Cr Au film, making it unsuitable for high-power circuits.

explanation_cn: 属于多层导电薄膜材料，在Ti-Au多层膜之间加人钯，即构成Ti-Pd-Au薄膜。Pd膜起阻挡层的作用，阻止钛和金间的相互扩散，从而可提高薄膜的稳定性。同时，由于Pd的化学稳定性很高，所以Pd还起抗蚀层的作用，阻止从Au膜针孔侵入的水汽和其他腐蚀性气体侵蚀下膜，从而增加了薄膜导电材料的抗腐蚀性能。Ti-Pd-Au的损耗比Cr-Au膜大，不宜用于高频电路中。
explanation_en: It is a multilayer conductive film materials. Add palladium between Ti Au multilayer films to form Ti Pd Au films. Pd film acts as a barrier layer to prevent the mutual diffusion between titanium and gold, thus improving the stability of the film. At the same time, due to the high chemical stability of Pd, Pd also acts as an anti-corrosion layer to prevent water vapor invaded from the pores of the Au film and other corrosion gases from eroding the lower film, thus increasing the corrosion resistance of thin film conductive material. Ti Pd Au has a greater loss than Cr Au film and is not suitable for use in high-frequency circuits.

explanation_cn: 属于多层导电薄膜:材料，在Ti-Au多层膜之间加入铂，即构成Ti-PtiAu薄膜。Pt膜起阻挡层的作用，阻止钛和金间的相互扩散，从而可提高薄膜的稳定性。同时，由于Pt的化学稳定性很高，所以Pt还起抗蚀层的作用，阻止从Au膜针孔侵人的水汽和其他腐蚀性气体侵蚀下膜，从而增加了薄膜导电材料的抗腐蚀性能。
explanation_en: It belongs to multilayer conductive film: materials. Platinum is added between Ti Au multilayer films to form Ti PtiAu film. Pt film acts as a barrier layer to prevent the mutual diffusion between titanium and gold, thus improving the stability of the film. At the same time, due to the high chemical stability of Pt, Pt also acts as an anti-corrosion layer to prevent the water vapor and other corrosion gases invading from the pores of the Au film from eroding the lower film, thus increasing the corrosion resistance of the thin film conductive material.

explanation_cn: 将模具和需要变形的钛合金坯料加热到同一最佳温度，进行恒温锻造的过程。由于模具及坯料温降甚微，允许用更慢的变形速率，可得到接近最终形状的锻件。
explanation_en: Heat the mold and the titanium alloy blank that needs to be deformed to the same optimal temperature for constant temperature forging. Due to the minimal temperature drop of the mold and billet, slower deformation rates are allowed to obtain forgings that are close to the final shape.

explanation_cn: 钙铁榴石如果富含钛，就成为富钛变种——钛榴石。
explanation_en: If almandine is rich in titanium, it will become a titanium rich variety - schorlomite.

explanation_cn: 简称TiF玻璃.又名低折射高色散玻璃。位于火石玻璃的右侧，色散较大。大都是含有氟化物和二氧化钛的火石玻璃，有时甚至全部PbO为Ti02所代替。Ti02除提高玻璃色散外，还能改善玻璃化学稳定性。含氟玻璃在熔制时容易失透并且挥发强烈，因此，这类玻璃的条纹和应力集中较一般光学玻璃严重。主要用作光学零件的材料。
explanation_en: It is referred to as TiF glass, also known as low refractive and high dispersion glass. It is located on the right side of flimingglass, with large dispersion. Most of them are flimingglass containing fluoride and titanium dioxide, and sometimes even all PbO is replaced by TiO2. In addition to improving the dispersion of glass, TiO2 can also improve the chemical stability of glass. Fluorine containing glass tends to lose its permeability and volatilize strongly during melting. Therefore, the stripes and stress concentration of this kind of glass are more serious than those of ordinary optical glass. Mainly used as materials for optical parts.

explanation_cn: 是一种陶瓷材料，其化学式为BaTiO3，属于ABO3型钙钛矿结构。钛酸钡具有多种晶相，根据温度不同，它可以存在不同的结构形式。主要的晶相包括：立方相（Cubic Phase）：在高于室温（约120°C以上）的温度下，钛酸钡呈立方结构，是一种顺电材料。四方相（Tetragonal Phase）：温度在5°C到120°C之间，钛酸钡呈四方铁电相。正交相（Orthorhombic Phase）：温度在-80°C到5°C之间，钛酸钡呈正交铁电相。三方相（Rhombohedral Phase）：温度低于-80°C时，呈三方铁电相。钛酸钡通常以BaCO3和TiO2等原料制备，先经过预合成，然后通过高温烧结制备成陶瓷。钛酸钡具有高介电性，因此广泛用于制造陶瓷电容器。此外，它还具有压电性，因此也用于制造压电器件。另外，通过对钛酸钡进行施主掺杂，可以制备出钛酸钡半导体陶瓷，这些材料通常用于制造正温度系数热敏电阻器，这意味着它们在升温时电阻增加，常用于温度感应器和控制系统。
explanation_en: It is a ceramics materials with the chemical formula of BaTiO3, which belongs to ABO3 type perovskite structure. Barium titanate has various crystal phases and can exist in different structural forms depending on temperature. The main crystalline phase include: Cubic phase: at a temperature higher than room temperature (about 120 ° C), barium titanate is a paraelectric materials with a cubic structure. Tetragonal phase: when the temperature is between 5 ° C and 120 ° C, barium titanate is a tetragonal ferroelectric phase. Orthogonal phase: the temperature is between -80 ° C and 5 ° C, and barium titanate is an orthogonal ferroelectric phase. Rhombohedral phase: when the temperature is lower than -80 ° C, it is a tripartite ferroelectric phase. Barium titanate is usually prepared from BaCO3, TiO2 and other raw materials. It is first pre synthesized and then prepared into ceramics through high-temperature sintering. Barium titanate is widely used to manufacture ceramics capacitors because of its high dielectric property. In addition, it also has piezoelectricity, so it is also used to manufacture piezoelectric devices. In addition, barium titanate semiconductive ceramics can be prepared by donor doping of barium titanate. These materials are usually used to manufacture positive temperature coefficient thermistors, which means that their resistance increases when the temperature rises. They are commonly used in temperature sensors and control systems.

explanation_cn: 钛酸铅（PbTiO3）是一种陶瓷材料，其化学式为PbTiO3，属于ABO3钙钛矿型结构。这种陶瓷具有高居里点（约490°C），其室温时四方晶胞的轴比c/a约为1.063。它还具有以下特性：低泊松比，约为0.20，表现出较小的变形。低相对介电常数，约为200，表现出电绝缘性。较高的机械强度，表现出强大的机械性能。由于其各向异性较强，纯PbTiO3难以成功烧结成瓷，并且不容易极化。通常，少量添加物如MnO2、Nb2O5、La2O3等会与主要配方一起进行预烧合成，然后经高温烧结而成。这些添加物有助于提高材料的加工性能和稳定性。钛酸铅陶瓷可用于各种应用，包括但不限于：高频压电陶瓷滤波器：由于其高机械强度和良好的电性能，钛酸铅用于制造高频压电滤波器，用于信号处理和通信设备。高温换能元件：它可用于制造高温下工作的传感器和换能器。热释电探测器：改性的PbTiO3陶瓷用于制造热释电探测器，可用于红外地平仪等应用。这些探测器具有辐射抗性、高稳定性和高工作温度的特点。热释电红外辐射温度计：这种温度计无需偏压电源和附加制冷器，适用于接近室温的情况下，能够高效测量温度，可用于精密温度测量和远距离温度测量等领域。
explanation_en: Lead titanate (PbTiO3) is a ceramics materials with the chemical formula of PbTiO3, which belongs to the ABO3 perovskite structure. This ceramics has a high Curie point (about 490 ° C), and the axial ratio c/a of the tetragonal unit cell of crystal at room temperature is about 1.063. It also has the following characteristics: low Poisson's ratio, about 0.20, showing small deformation. Low relative dielectric constant, about 200, shows electrical insulation. High mechanical strength, demonstrating strong mechanical performance. Due to its strong anisotropy, pure PbTiO3 is difficult to sintering into ceramics and is not easy to polarization. Generally, a small amount of additives, such as MnO2, Nb2O5, La2O3, etc., will be presintering synthesized together with the main formula and then sintering at high temperature. These additives help to improve the processability and stability of materials. PbTiO3 ceramics can be used in various applications, including but not limited to: high-frequency piezoelectric ceramics filters: because of its high mechanical strength and good electrical performance, lead titanate is used to manufacture high-frequency piezoelectric filters, signal processing and communication equipment. High temperature transducer: It can be used to manufacture sensors and transducers that work at high temperatures. Pyroelectric detector: The modified PbTiO3 ceramics is used to make pyroelectric detectors, which can be used in infrared horizon instruments and other applications. These detectors have the characteristics of radiation resistance, high stability, and high operating temperature. Pyroelectric infrared radiation thermometer: This thermometer does not require a bias power supply or an additional cooler, and is suitable for measuring temperature near room temperature. It can efficiently measure temperature and can be used in fields such as precision temperature measurement and remote temperature measurement.

explanation_cn: 含秘层状结构的铁电陶瓷，化学式是Bi4Ti3O12，它也可以表示为（Bi2O2）2+(Bi2Ti3O12)2-，相当于通式（Bi2O2）2+(A^n-1B^nO3n+1)2-的一个具体组成式（其中A=Bi，B=Ti，n=3）。它的晶胞结构包括两个（Bi2O2）层，中间夹着3层二钙钦矿结构A^n-1B^nO3n+1。制备这种材料通常使用Bi2O3和TiO2为原料。首先进行配料、混料，然后磨细并成型，最后在约1300°C左右的温度下进行烧结。这种材料的居里温度约为675°C，而相对介电常数约为180。由于具有高居里温度、低介电常数、高稳定性等特点，它适用于制造高温高频电子元器件。经极化后，钛酸铋陶瓷具有压电性，其压电常数约为20 pC/N。它的各向异性较强，适用于制造用于厚度振动的高频压电振子。
explanation_en: The chemical formula of ferroelectric ceramics containing secret layered structure is Bi4Ti3O12, which can also be expressed as (Bi2O2) 2+(Bi2Ti3O12) 2-, which is equivalent to a specific formula of the general formula (Bi2O2) 2+(A ^ n-1B ^ nO3n+1) 2- (where A=Bi, B=Ti, n=3). Its unit cell of crystal structure consists of two (Bi2O2) layers, sandwiched with three layers of dicalcine structure A ^ n-1B ^ nO3n+1. Bi2O3 and TiO2 are usually used as raw materials to prepare this materials. First, batching and mixing, then grinding and forming, and finally sintering at about 1300 ° C. The Curie temperature of this materials is about 675 ° C, and the relative dielectric constant is about 180. Due to its high Curie temperature, low dielectric constant, and high stability, it is suitable for manufacturing high-temperature and high-frequency electronic components. After polarization, bismuth titanate ceramics have piezoelectricity properties, and its piezoelectric constant is about 20 pC/N. It has strong anisotropy and is suitable for manufacturing high-frequency piezoelectric oscillators for thickness vibration.

explanation_cn: 一种含主要成分为铝酸铝的陶瓷材料。其化学式为Al2Ti3O9，由Al2O3（氧化铝）和TiO2（氧化钛）在高温下经固相反应制得。这种陶瓷具有高熔点（约1860°C），属于斜方晶系。钛酸铝在Al2O3-TiO2二元体系中是唯一的化合物，属于一致熔融合物，其中Al2O3和TiO2的质量分数分别占56%和44%。
explanation_en: A ceramics materials containing aluminum aluminate as the main component. Its chemical formula is Al2Ti3O9, which is prepared by solid-state reaction of Al2O3 (alumina) and TiO2 (titanium oxide) at high temperature. This ceramics has a high melting point (about 1860 ° C) and belongs to the orthorhombic system. Aluminum titanate is the only compound in the Al2O3-TiO2 binary system, belonging to a uniformly molten complex, with the mass fractions of Al2O3 and TiO2 accounting for 56% and 44%, respectively.

explanation_cn: 化学式为Li4Ti5O12，其外观为白色粉末，具有尖晶石A族结构。这种材料的晶格常数为8.3588埃，振实密度为0.7-1.7 g/cm3。它拥有锂离子扩散通道，电子电导率约为5.8 x 10^(-5) S/cm。Li4Ti5O12通常用作锂离子电池的负极材料。其理论充放电比容量为175 mA·h/g，实际首周容量通常大于165 mA·h/g。这种材料的锂脱嵌体积变化较小，因此被称为"零应变"材料。它具有出色的充放电倍率性能、循环寿命长以及良好的安全性能。不过，它的电池电压和比能量相对较低。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is Li4Ti5O12, its appearance is white powder, and it has spinel A group structure. The lattice constant of this materials is 8.3588 angstrom, and the tap density is 0.7-1.7 g/cm 3。 It has a lithium ion diffusion channel, and the electronic electric conductivity is about 5.8 x 10 ^ (-5) S/cm. Li4Ti5O12 is usually used as the negative materials of Li ion battery. The theoretical charge discharge specific capacity is 175 mA · h/g, while the actual first cycle capacity is usually greater than 165 mA · h/g. This kind of materials is called "zero strain" materials because its lithium de intercalation volume changes little. It has excellent charge discharge magnification performance, long cycle life and good safety performance. However, its voltage of bartter and specific energy are relatively low.

explanation_cn: 化学式为SrTiO3。属于钙钛矿型结构，室温下为立方晶系。降温到105K发生相变.由立方相转变为四方相。常用的晶体生长方法有火焰法、盐熔法以及溶剂提拉法。SrTiO3具有超导性、半导性、气敏性、热敏性及光敏性.介电损耗低、色散频率高，另外还有高介电常数、低电损耗等优点。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is SrTiO3. It belongs to a perovskite type structure and is a cubic crystal system at room temperature. When the temperature drops to 105K, phase transformation occurs, from cubic phase to tetragonal phase. Common crystal growth methods include flame method, salt melting method and solvent pulling method method. SrTiO3 has the advantages of superconductivity, semiconductivity, gas sensitivity, thermal sensitivity and photosensitivity, low diekctric loss, high dispersion frequency, high dielectric constant, low electrical loss, etc.

explanation_cn: 用作炼钢脱氧剂和合金兀素添加剂的铁和钛的合金.通常将钛含量为30%的称为低钛铁，钛含量40%的称为中钛铁，钛含量70%的称为高钛铁。低中钛铁通常以钛铁矿为原料采用铝热法生产，故一般铝含量较高，在8.0%-9.5%之间；高钛铁可采用铝热法生产，铝含量在3.0%-7.0%之间，也可以海绵钛、废钛为原料采用重熔法生产（称为废钛型高钛铁）。GB/T3282-2012对钛铁牌号和化学成分具有明确规定。钛与氧、氮、硫、碳具有较高的化学亲和力。钛铁在炼钢时用作脱氧剂和脱气剂.效果显著高于硅、锰。钛在固态钢中可形成氮化钛或碳化钛，前者可在高温下阻止晶粒长大并使钢中硫化物改性，广泛用于微钛处理钢和渗碳齿轮钢；后者可产生强烈的沉淀强化效果，广泛用于高强度工程结构钢。钛固定非金属元素的作用使其广泛应用于稳定化不锈钢和丨F钢。钛用于铸铁中有助于形成细晶石墨并明显提高铸铁的耐磨性。钛铁还是生产钛钙型电焊条涂料的原料。
explanation_en: Iron and alloy of titanium used as steelmaking deoxidizer and alloy additive are generally called low ferrotitanium if the titanium content is 30%, medium ferrotitanium if the titanium content is 40%, and high ferrotitanium if the titanium content is 70%. Low and medium ferrotitanium is usually produced by aluminothermic method with ilmenite as raw material, so the aluminum content is generally high, between 8.0% -9.5%; High ferrotitanium can be produced by aluminothermic method with aluminum content between 3.0% -7.0%, or by remelting titanium sponge and waste titanium (called waste titanium type high ferrotitanium). GB/T3282-2012 has clear regulations on the grade and chemical composition of titanium iron. Titanium has a high chemical affinity with oxygen, nitrogen, sulfur, and carbon. Ferrotitanium is used as deoxidizer and degasifier in steelmaking, and its effect is significantly higher than that of silicon and manganese. Titanium can form titanium nitride or titanium carbide in solid steel. The former can prevent grain growth at high temperature and modify sulfide in steel. It is widely used in micro titanium treated steel and carburizing gear steel; The latter can produce strong precipitation strengthening effect and is widely used in high-strength engineering structural steel. Titanium is widely used to stabilize stainless steel and steel due to its role in fixing non-metallic elements. Titanium used in cast iron helps to form fine grained graphite and significantly improves the wear resistance of cast iron. Ferrotitanium is also the raw material for the production of titanium calcium type welding electrode coatings.

explanation_cn: 复杂配位型氧化物矿物。常有Mn、Nh、Ta等类质同象混入物。三方晶系。刚玉型结构。晶体少见，常呈粒状、板状、鱗片状或片状于磁铁矿中。铁黑色或钢灰色。条痕钢灰或黑色，当含赤铁矿包体时.条痕呈褐色或带褐的红色。金属至半金属光泽。不透明。莫氏硬度5-6.5,性脆，密度4-5g/cm3。具弱磁性。主要产于超基性岩、基性岩、碱性岩及变质岩中。与钛磁铁矿、橄榄石、斜长石、钛普通辉石、磁黄铁矿等共生。是提炼钛的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Complex coordination type oxide minerals. There are often isomorphic mixtures such as Mn, Nh, Ta, etc. Tripartite crystal system. Corundum structure. Crystal are rare, often in granular, tabular, scaly or flaky form in magnetite. Iron black or steel grey. Striped steel is gray or black. When hematite inclusion is contained, the stripe is brown or brownish red. Metallic to semi metallic luster. Opaque. Mohs hardness is 5-6.5, brittle, and density is 4-5g/cm3. Has weak magnetism. It mainly occurs in super basic rock, basic rock, alkaline rock and metamorphic rock. It is associated with titanium magnetite, olivine, plagioclase, titanium ordinary pyroxene, pyrrhothe, etc. It is a raw mineral material for refining titanium.

explanation_cn: 使金属表面转化为不易被氧化的状态从而延缓金属腐蚀的方法。另外，一种活性金属或合金，其化学活性大大降低，成为贵金属状态的现象，也叫钝化。
explanation_en: It is a method to slow down the corrosion of metal by transforming the metal surface into a state that is not easy to be oxidized. In addition, the chemical activity of an active metal or alloy is greatly reduced and becomes a precious metals, also known as passivation.

explanation_cn: 单质炸药和钝感剂组成的低感度炸药。常用的钝感剂有蜡、硬脂酸、胶体石墨和高聚物。与未钝感的单质炸药相比，撞击和摩擦感度明显下降，成型性能改善，而对爆炸能量影响较小。一些高感度的炸药均制成钝化炸药使用，以保证安全。
explanation_en: Low sensitivity explosive composed of single explosive and deterrent. Common deterrent include wax, stearic acid, colloidal graphite and polymers. Compared with the insensitive single explosive, the impact and friction sensitivities are significantly reduced, the molding performance is improved, and the impact on explosion energy is less. Some highly sensitive explosive are made into desensitized explosive for use to ensure safety.

explanation_cn: 环境介质作用下，在材料表面形成能够抑制阳极溶解过程，而自身又难溶于介质的固态产物薄膜。
explanation_en: Under the action of environmental medium, the solid product film that can inhibit the anodic dissolution process is formed on the surface of materials and is difficult to dissolve in the medium itself.

explanation_cn: 由于黑索今的感度较高，影响其应用范闱，使用时一般加入其他物质制作成混合炸药。
explanation_en: Because of the high sensitivity of RDX, its application is affected, and other substances are usually added to make composite explosive.

explanation_cn: 一种与火药基体黏结剂具有相溶性的药剂，它渗入火药表面内使其燃烧速度随厚度而变化，以达到改善弹道性能的目的。常用的钝感剂有樟脑、中定剂、苯二甲酸二丁酯、二硝基甲苯等。
explanation_en: A kind of agent that is compatible with propellant matrix adhesive. It penetrates into the surface of propellant to make its combustion speed change with the thickness, so as to improve the ballistic performance. Common deterrent include camphor, stabilizer, dibutyl phthalate, dinitrotoluene, etc.

explanation_cn: 一种采用钝感剂渗入发射药表层的发射药。通过渗入钝感剂达到改变发射药局部区域的化学组分来改变发射药燃烧速度，从而形成在发射药燃烧方向上的燃速梯度，达到燃速的渐增性燃烧的发射药。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a gun propellant which uses deterrent to penetrate into the surface of gun propellant. The combustion speed of gun propellant is changed by infiltrating deterrent to change the chemical composition of local area of gun propellant, so as to form a burning rate gradient in the combustion direction of gun propellant, and to achieve an increasing burning rate of combustion gun propellant.

explanation_cn: 专门用于印制钞票的纸。以棉浆和木浆为主要原料。在抄制过程中同时加人彩色纤维，并印有水印。具有非常高的耐折性能、耐久性能和防伪性能。
explanation_en: Paper specifically used for printing banknotes. Using cotton pulp and wood pulp as the main raw materials. During the copying process, colored fibers are added and watermarks are printed. It has very high folding resistance, durability, and anti-counterfeiting performance.

explanation_cn: 又称石钟乳、石笋、石柱、石花等。呈钟乳状堆积的方解石。多见于石灰岩溶洞中。在石灰岩溶洞发育地区，富含Ca(HCO3)2的水从洞顶上渗出时，随着压力降低，水分蒸发，CO2逸出，水中的Ca(HCO3)2达到过饱和，CaCO3围绕水滴出口周围不断沉淀，天长日久便从洞顶向下沉积出一根根悬挂在洞顶下垂的长锥状钙质沉积物。若渗水量较多或在洞顶沉淀后未完全蒸发而滴落在洞底后又沉淀并向上增长，外形似竹笋，称为石笋。石钟乳和石笋不断增长最后连接起来，就称为石柱。民间也把钟乳石称为鹅管石。钟乳石除作为观赏奇石外，还是一种中药材，味甘、性温，有补气固精作用，并能明目。中国一些地区岩溶地形发育，石灰岩溶洞很多，形成不少钟乳石有些是很有名的旅游景点，如广西桂林、南宁、浙江杭州、贵州、北京等地都有十分壮观的溶洞和钟乳石景观。
explanation_en: Also known as stalactite, stalagmite, stone pillar, stone flower, etc. Caldte in the form of stalactite. It is mostly found in limestone caves. In the limestone karst cave development area, when water rich in Ca (HCO3) 2 seeps from the cave roof, with the pressure decreasing, water evaporates, CO2 escapes, and Ca (HCO3) 2 in the water reaches supersaturation. CaCO3 keeps precipitation around the water drop outlet, and long conical calcareous sediments hanging from the cave roof will be deposited from the cave roof. If there is a lot of seepage water or it is not completely evaporated after precipitation at the top of the cave but drops on the bottom of the cave and then precipitation and grows upward, it looks like a bamboo shoot, which is called stalagmite. Stalactite and stalagmite grow continuously and finally connect, which is called stone pillar. People also call stalactite goose tube stone. In addition to being an ornamental stone, stalactite is also a kind of traditional Chinese medicine. It is sweet in taste, warm in nature, has the function of supplementing qi and consolidating essence, and can brighten the eyes. In some areas of China, karst topography is developed. There are many limestone karst caves, forming many stalactite and some famous tourist attractions. For example, Guilin, Nanning, Hangzhou, Guizhou, Beijing and other places in Guangxi have very spectacular karst caves and stalactite landscapes.

explanation_cn: 一种高能蓄电池，其英文名称zebra，即为zeroemissionbatteryresearchactivity的缩写，表示其为一种零排放无污染的绿色电源，其负极和正极的活性物质分别是熔融的金属钠和Nie，该电池理论比能量为790Wh/kg，实际比能量为100Wh/kg，循环寿命1000次左右。具有高比能量、高转换效率、可快速充电、使用寿命较长等优点。
explanation_en: A high-energy accumulator, its English name zebra, is the abbreviation of zero emission battery research activity, which means it is a zero emission and pollution-free green power supply. The active substances of its negative pole and positive pole are respectively molten metal sodium and Nie. The theoretical specific energy of the battery is 790Wh/kg, the actual specific energy is 100Wh/kg, and the cycle life is about 1000 times. It has the advantages of high specific energy, high conversion efficiency, fast charging and long service life.

explanation_cn: 一种高温固体电解质二次电池，发明于1967年。其负极和正极的活性物质分别是熔融的金属钠和硫，电解质为卢-氧化铝，这是一种固态的钠离子导体。它同时兼作隔膜。钠-硫电池的工作温度为300-350°C，单体电池的开路电位为2.08V。理论比能量为750W-h/kg。由于钠-硫电池具打比能量和比功率高、充放电循环寿命长、原材料丰富、成本低廉等优点，已在储能电站中取得应用。
explanation_en: A high temperature solid electrolyte secondary cell was invented in 1967. The active materials of the negative electrode and positive electrode are molten metal sodium and sulfur respectively, and the electrolyte is Lu alumina, which is a solid sodium ion conductor. It also serves as a separator. The operating temperature of sodium-sulphur battery is 300-350 ° C, and the open circuit potential of monomer battery is 2.08V. The theoretical specific energy is 750W-h/kg. Sodium-sulphur battery has been applied in energy storage power plants due to its advantages of high specific energy and power, long charge discharge cycle life, abundant raw materials, low cost, etc.
