explanation_en: See alunite.

explanation_cn: 又称为智利硝石，是一种岛状结构的硼酸盐矿物。硝石的晶体呈现菱面体状，而集合体则呈粒状、块状、皮壳状或粉末状等不规则形状。硝石常呈白色，但由于杂质的影响，可以出现黄色或褐色的色调。硝石在条痕上表现为白色，同时具有玻璃光泽，通常是透明至半透明的。它有一些独特的化学性质，容易在空气中吸收水分并潮解，也容易溶解于水中。硝石主要分布在炎热干旱的沙漠地区，常与其他矿物如石膏、芒硝、食盐等一同共生。硝石是制造氮肥、硝酸、炸药和氮化物等化学品的重要矿物原料。
explanation_en: Also known as chilean saltpeter, it is a borate mineral with island structure. The crystal of saltpeter is rhombohedral, while the aggregate is irregular, such as granular, massive, crusty or powdery. Saltpeter is usually white, but due to the influence of impurities, it can appear yellow or brown tone. Saltpeter is white on streaks and has glass luster, usually transparent to translucent. It has some unique chemical properties, easy to absorb water in the air and deliquescence, and also easy to dissolve in water. Saltpeter is mainly distributed in hot and arid desert areas, and often coexists with other minerals such as gypsum, mirabilite, salt, etc. Saltpeter is an important raw mineral material for manufacturing chemicals such as nitrogen fertilizer, nitric acid, explosive and nitrides.

explanation_cn: 一种硼酸盐矿物，其化学式为Na2B4O7(OH)3，含有钠、硼和氧元素，并夹杂有氢氧根离子。这种矿物通常以单斜晶系结晶。硼酸钠的晶体呈针状，很少见到完整的晶体形态，有时还出现聚片双晶。它也可能以毛发状、针状、土状或结核状等形态聚集。硼酸钠通常呈透明状态，具有玻璃光泽或丝绢光泽。物理性质方面，硼酸钠的莫氏硬度约为2.5，表现出脆性。其密度大约为1.9g/cm3。硼酸钠不溶于冷水，但能够在热水中溶解，且容易溶解于酸性溶液中。当受热时，硼酸钠会膨胀。硼酸钠是典型的干旱地和内陆湖泊中的化学沉积物，常常与其他矿物一起共生，例如石盐、石膏、芒硝、天然碱、明矾、库水硼镁石和水方硼石等。硼酸钠是硼提取和硼化合物制备的主要矿物原料之一。
explanation_en: A borate mineral with the chemical formula Na2B4O7 (OH) 3, containing sodium, boron, and oxygen elements, mixed with hydroxide ions. This mineral is usually crystallized in a monoclinic system. The crystal of sodium borate is needle shaped, and the complete crystal shape is rarely seen, sometimes there are flake twin. It may also aggregate in the form of hairs, needles, soil, or nodules. Sodium borate is usually transparent, with glass luster or silk luster. In terms of physical properties, the Mohs hardness of sodium borate is about 2.5, showing brittleness. Its density is about 1.9g/cm 3。 Sodium borate is insoluble in cold water, but can dissolve in hot water and is easily soluble in acidic solutions. When heated, sodium borate will expand. Sodium borate is a typical chemical deposit in arid land and inland lakes, which is often associated with other minerals, such as halite, gypsum, mirabilite, trona, alum, reservoir water boromagnesite and aquaborax. Sodium borate is one of the main raw mineral material for boron extraction and preparation of boron compounds.

explanation_cn: 是一种能够传导钠离子的快离子导体。这类导体的代表性材料包括P-氧化铝和Nasicon等。β-氧化铝是一类铝酸盐的总称，通式为Sm2XA1203，其中M可以是一价、二价或三价阳离子，而X是通常为氧。在这些化合物中，当M是一价阳离子，例如钠离子时，β-氧化铝的电导率相对较高。特别是钠-β-氧化铝，其电导率最高，因为钠离子可以在层状结构中迁移，形成二维导体。在温度超过300°C时，钠-β-氧化铝的钠离子电导率可以达到10S/cm。这使得它成为高能量储能设备中，如钠硫电池的重要隔膜材料。此外，它还用于金属钠的提纯、电解制取碱金属以及钠离子传感器等领域。它具有骨架结构并被认为是离子导体。尽管它在高温下的电导率相对较低，约为β-氧化铝的四分之一，但由于它在高温下的抗腐蚀性，因此它主要用于制造钠离子传感器等应用。
explanation_en: It is a fast ion conductor capable of conducting sodium ions. Representative materials of such conductors include P-alumina, Nasicon, etc. β- Aluminum oxide is a general term for a type of aluminate, with the general formula Sm2XA1203, where M can be a monovalent, divalent, or trivalent cation, and X is typically oxygen. Especially sodium- β- Alumina has the highest electric conductivity because sodium ions can migrate in the layered structure to form two-dimensional conductors. When the temperature exceeds 300 ° C, sodium- β- The sodium ion electric conductivity of alumina can reach 10S/cm. This makes it an important separator materials for high-energy energy storage equipment, such as sodium sulfur battery. In addition, it is also used for the purification of metallic sodium, electrolytic production of alkali metals, and sodium ion sensors. It has skeleton structure and is considered as ion conductor. Although its electric conductivity at high temperature is relatively low, about β- One fourth of aluminum oxide, but due to its corrosion resistance at high temperatures, it is mainly used for manufacturing applications such as sodium ion sensors.

explanation_cn: 主要组成是71%左右的氧化硅，14%左右的稳定氧化物(包括氧化铝，氧化钙，氧化镁，氧化钡)以及15%左右的助熔剂(包括氧化钠，氧化钾，氧化硼。三氧化硫)。
explanation_en: The main composition is about 71% silicon oxide, about 14% stable oxides (including alumina, calcium oxide, magnesium oxide, barium oxide), and about 15% flux (including sodium oxide, potassium oxide, boron oxide, sulfur trioxide).

explanation_en: Because its crystal structure is similar to that of copper oxide high-temperature superconductor, and both belong to the strongly correlated electronic system, it is widely concerned. In addition, it is also the main materials for blut-and-white porcelain to prepare enamel decoration.

explanation_en: See asbestos.

explanation_cn: 简称BaK玻璃。折射率和密度介于K和ZK玻璃之间。基本上属于含钡、锌、钾、钠的硼硅酸盐玻璃。含钡较多，主要用作光学仪器中光学零件的材料。
explanation_en: It is called BaK glass for short. The refractive index and density are between K and ZK glass. Basically, it belongs to borosilicate glass containing barium, zinc, potassium and sodium. It contains much barium and is mainly used as materials of optical parts in optical instruments.

explanation_cn: 简称BaF玻璃是在QF和F玻璃中加人BaO、Zn等组分或在BaK玻璃中加入PW等组分而制成的。其色散介于这些玻璃的中间。
explanation_en: For short, BaF glass is made by adding BaO, Zn and other components to QF and F glass or PW and other components to BaK glass. Its dispersion lies in the middle of these glass.

explanation_cn: Fe基超导体中的一种，超导转变温度38K，与铜氧化物高温超导体以及其他Fe基超导体一样，存在晶界弱连接特性。由于各向异性较小，与其他Fe基超导体相比，临界电流密度和上临界场较大，因此是最有可能制备成线材的铁基超导体之一。
explanation_en: One of the Fe based superconductors, the superconducting transition temperature is 38K. Like the copper oxide high-temperature superconductor and other Fe based superconductors, it has the characteristics of grain boundary week connectivity. Since the anisotropy is small, compared with other Fe based superconductors, the critical current density and the upper critical field are large, so it is one of the iron based superconductors most likely to prepare wire rod.

explanation_cn: 铅酸盐超导体，晶体结构为钙钛矿型.载流子类型为电子型（n型）。采用熔盐法和溶胶凝胶法可以制备。
explanation_en: The lead salt superconductor has a crystal structure of perovskite type. The carrier type is electronic type (n type). It can be prepared by molten salt method method and sol gel method.

explanation_cn: 铋酸盐超导体，超导临界温度25-34K.晶体结构为钙钛矿型，载流子类型为电子型（n型），载流子密度为每立方厘米1021个电子。采用溶盐法和溶胶凝胶法可以制备。
explanation_en: Bismuth superconductor, superconductor critical temperature 25-34K. The crystal structure is perovskite type, the carrier type is electronic type (n-type), and the carrier density is 1021 electrons per cubic centimeter. It can be prepared by salt dissolving method and sol gel method.

explanation_en: See BaFe12O18 permanent magnetic ferrite.

explanation_cn: Bi系高温超导体家族的母相，也属于铜氧化物高温超导体。
explanation_en: Bi is the parent phase of the high-temperature superconductor family, and also belongs to the copper oxide high-temperature superconductor.

explanation_cn: 钡长石陶瓷是指以钡长石为主晶相的陶瓷材料。主要原料为高岭土和碳酸钡，在1370°C左右烧结。主要原料为碳酸钡和高岭土等，经成到后高温烧结而成。可用于一般装置瓷件、电阻瓷件，高热稳定的电感线圈骨架和小容量的中高压电容器。
explanation_en: Baryta feldspar ceramics refer to ceramics materials with barium feldspar as the main crystal phase. The main raw materials are kaolin and barium carbonate, which are sintering at about 1370 ° C. The main raw materials are barium carbonate and kaolin, which are sintered at high temperature. It can be used for general device porcelain parts, resistance porcelain parts, high thermal stability inductance coil framework, and small capacity medium and high voltage capacitors.

explanation_cn: 碳含量小于2.11%的铁-碳合金，通常的碳含量多在0-1.2%之间，一般还含有限量以内的常存元素如硅、锰、硫、磷、铜、氧、氮等。
explanation_en: Iron carbon alloys with a carbon content less than 2.11% usually have a carbon content of 0-1.2%, and generally contain common elements within the limit, such as silicon, manganese, sulfur, phosphorus, copper, oxygen, nitrogen, etc.

explanation_cn: 采用多根钢丝檐制成的挠性绳索（GB8706-2006)。钢丝绳中间的纤维绳称为绳芯，捻在绳芯周围的钢丝束称为绳股，钢丝多采用高碳非合金钢和低合金钢，钢丝截面多为圆形，也可采用Z型、V型、H型等异型，根据需要可在钢丝表面采用各种镀（涂）层。
explanation_en: Flexible rope made of wire eaves (GB8706-2006). The fiber rope in the middle of the steel wire rope is called the rope core, and the wire bundle twisted around the rope core is called the rope strand. The wire is mostly made of high carbon non alloy steel and low alloy steel. The wire section is mostly circular, and it can also be shaped like Z, V, H, etc. Various plating (coating) layers can be used on the surface of wire as required.

explanation_cn: 又称盛钢桶，是盛装冶炼合格的钢水或铁水准备进行浇铸操作的容器。由钢壳、耐火材料内衬和启闭控制系统组成。
explanation_en: Also known as ladle, it is a container for holding smelting qualified molten steel or molten iron ready for casting operation. It is composed of steel shell, refractory lining and hoist control system.

explanation_cn: 具有电弧加热和底吹氩气搅拌功能的钢包精炼炉。设备包括钢包、钢包车及包内底吹氩气系统、电源、电极、炉盖及电控系统以及除尘系统等。钢包炉具有钢包的功能同时还具有精炼功能。
explanation_en: Ladle refining furnace with electric arc heating and bottom blowing argon stirring function. The equipment includes ladle, ladle car and ladle bottom argon blowing system, power supply, electrode, furnace cover, electric control system and dust removal system. The ladle furnace has the function of ladle as well as refining.

explanation_cn: 又称强化玻璃。用物理的或化学的方法，在玻璃表面上形成一个压应力层，当玻璃受到外拉力作用时，这个压力层可将部分拉应力抵消，避免玻璃的碎裂，从而达到提高玻璃强度的目的。
explanation_en: Also known as reinforced glass. Use physical or chemical methods to form a compressive stress layer on the surface of glass. When glass is subject to external tension, this pressure layer can offset part of the tensile stress to avoid glass fragmentation, so as to improve the strength of glass.

explanation_cn: 钢铁生产厂提供销售的具有一定的形状、尺寸和力学、物理、化学性能的钢产品，便于用户直接使用、也可经用户进一步深加工后使用钢材大多以热轧状态或正火状态交货，也可以冷轧、冷拉、冷拔等状态交货，部分特殊钢材也以热锻状态、退火状态交货。钢材种类繁多，通常可分为板材、管材、型材和金属制品四大类。
explanation_en: Steel products with certain shape, size and mechanical, physical and chemical properties provided and sold by steel manufacturers are convenient for users to use directly, and can also be used after further processing by users. Most steel product products are delivered in hot rolled or normalizing state, or in cold rolled, cold drawing, cold drawn and other states. Some special steel product products are also delivered in hot forged or annealing state. There are many kinds of steel product, which can be generally divided into four categories: plate, tube, profile and metal products.

explanation_cn: 主要用于制作建筑用钢筋的工程结构钢。这类钢需要具有一定的强度、塑性、焊接性和冷弯性能，抗震钢筋钢还必须保证具有较高的强屈比，同时要求价格较为低廉。
explanation_en: It is mainly used to make engineering structural steel for building reinforcement. This kind of steel needs to have certain strength, plasticity, weldability and cold bending performance. Seismic concrete steel must also have a high strength yield ratio, and the price is required to be relatively low.

explanation_cn: 是指将混凝土填充入钢管内形成的材料。从材料学设计原理上来讲是一种复合材料，它是由金属钢与无机非金属的混凝土所复合而成的，是钢-混凝土组合结构的一种重要形式。
explanation_en: It refers to the materials formed by filling concrete into the steel pipe. From the design principle of materials, it is a kind of composite materials, which is composition by metal steel and inorganic non-metallic concrete, and is an important form of steel concrete composite structure.

explanation_cn: 用铁粉、低合金粉、不锈钢或高速钢粉黏结碳化物所制成的硬质合金。通常黏结成分最高可达75%，碳化物含量50%。将混合料经成形烧结、热加工和机加工，再经淬火、回火处理，即可获得硬度高于高速钢的钢结硬质合金。
explanation_en: Hardmetal made by bonding carbide with iron powder, low alloy powder, stainless steel or high speed steel powder. Generally, the maximum bonding composition is 75%, and the carbide content is 50%. Steel bond hard alloy with hardness higher than that of high speed steel can be obtained by forming sintering, hot working and machining the mixture, and then by quenching and tempering.

explanation_cn: 制作钢轨用的工程结构钢，是具有特定截面的型钢。单位长度的质量越大，钢轨的承载能力越强，小于或等于30kg/m的钢轨称为轻轨，大于30kg/m的称为重轨。
explanation_en: The engineering structural steel for rail production is a section steel with a specific section. The larger the mass per unit length, the stronger the load-bearing capacity of the steel rail. Steel rails less than or equal to 30kg/m are called light rails, while those greater than 30kg/m are called heavy rails.

explanation_cn: 中国宋代钧窑烧造的铜红釉。铜红的呈色对烧成温度和气氛变化极为敏感，技术性很强。中国早在唐代就已出现铜红，但其成功带有很大的偶然性。宋代时河南禹县钧窑真正地掌握了铜红的烧造技术，并创制出玫瑰紫、海棠红、骡肝马肺、红霞等一系列名贵品种。钧窑系釉都呈现深浅不同的乳光蓝色。钧紫红釉中也密布大量乳光蓝色斑点和流纹。这种乳光蓝色与釉层中出现的液液分相有关，钧釉中存在的大量液相小滴对光线散射的结果就出现乳光现象。钧红釉的釉层很厚，明显流淌，有细密纹片和蚯蚓走泥纹，钧红釉器的胎质地较粗.气孔率亦较高。均红釉器盛产于宋，在金元时期.除河南很多窑场都烧钧红釉器外，河北、山西的部分窑场都仿烧。清代雍正、乾隆年间景德镇仿烧钧红釉取得成功。现代景德镇生产的钧红（又称均红）是一种单色红釉，且以PbO作为助熔剂与宋、元时期的钧红釉完全不同。
explanation_en: Copper red glaze made in Jun kiln of Song Dynasty in China. The color of copper red is extremely sensitive to changes in firing temperature and atmosphere, and is highly technical. Copper red had already appeared in China as early as the Tang Dynasty, but its success was highly accidental. During the Song Dynasty, Jun Kiln in Yuxian County, Henan Province truly mastered the firing technology of copper red and created a series of precious varieties such as rose purple, begonia red, mule liver, horse lung, and Hongxia. The glaze of Jun kiln series all present milky blue with different shades. The Jun purple red glaze is also densely covered with numerous milky blue spots and flow patterns. This opalescent blue is related to the liquid-liquid phase separation in the glaze layer. The opalescent phenomenon occurs as a result of light scattering by a large number of liquid phase droplets in Jun glaze. The glaze layer of Jun red glaze is very thick and obviously flowing, with fine and dense patterns and earthworm walking mud patterns. The body of Jun red glaze is thicker and its porosity is higher. Jun red glaze wares were abundant in the Song Dynasty. During the Jin and Yuan Dynasties, Jun red glaze wares were burned in many kilns in Henan, and some kilns in Hebei and Shanxi were imitated. During the reign of Emperor Yongzheng and Emperor Qianlong in the Qing Dynasty, the imitation burning of Jun red glaze in Jingdezhen was successful. Jun red (also known as Jun red) produced in modern Jingdezhen is a kind of monochrome red glaze, and PbO as flux is completely different from Jun red glaze in the Song and Yuan dynasties.

explanation_cn: 是一种新型电子发射源材料.具有无晶界、结晶缺陷少以及各向同性等优异的物理化学及力学性能;其制备方法主要有电子束悬浮区域熔炼法、熔滴等离子弧熔炼法以及应变-退火法，它在电子、激光、全息技术、宇航高能物理、空间技术等领域有广泛应用。
explanation_en: It is a new type of electron emission source materials. It has excellent physical chemistry and mechanical properties such as no grain boundary, few crystal defects and isotropy; Its preparation methods mainly include electron beam suspension zone melting method, droplet plasma arc melting method and strain annealing method. It is widely used in electronics, laser, holographic technology, aerospace high-energy physics, space technology and other fields.

explanation_cn: 以钨为基，添加其他元素或化合物而形成的合金。主要采用粉末冶金工艺生产。
explanation_en: Alloy based on tungsten and added with other elements or compounds. It is mainly produced by powder metallurgy process.

explanation_cn: 又称为钨基重合金。以钨为基体，添加镍、铁、铜元素制成的高密度合金。其钨含量一般在90%(质量分数）以上，相对密度大于17。它们是由钨相（颗粒）和黏结相组成的两相结构材料。分为钨镍铜系、钨镍铁系两类。
explanation_en: It is also called tungsten based heavy alloy. A high density alloy is made of tungsten as the matrix and nickel, iron and copper elements are added. Its tungsten content is generally above 90% (mass fraction), and its relative density is greater than 17. They are two-phase structural materials composed of tungsten phase (particles) and bonding phase. It is divided into two categories: tungsten nickel copper system and tungsten nickel iron system.

explanation_cn: 以钨为主要可燃剂的延期药，是一种燃速较慢的微气体延期药，优点是低温燃烧性能较好，在-60~-70°C时不易熄灭。
explanation_en: The delay composition with tungsten as the main combustible agent is a kind of slow burning micro gas delay composition, which has the advantage of good low-temperature combustion performance and is not easy to extinguish at -60~-70 ° C.

explanation_cn: 白色粉末。相对密度6.0,正方晶系。它是一种自激活的荧光粉。
explanation_en: White powder. Relative density 6.0, square crystal system. It is a self-activation phosphor.

explanation_cn: 参见白钨矿。
explanation_en: See scheelite.

explanation_cn: 化学式为PbWO4，熔点1123°C。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is PbWO4, and the melting point is 1123 ° C.

explanation_cn: 钛酸铋是一种代表性的铁电材料，属于钛酸族中的一员。在钛酸族中，奇数层的钙钛矿层通常以B2cb结晶形式存在，而偶数层的化合物更多地以Miam结晶。这是由于钙钛矿层的畸变能影响了氧与氧化铋层之间的键，而不会影响到钙钛矿层内的氧八面体的畸变。
explanation_en: Bismuth titanate is a representative ferroelectric materials, which belongs to the titanate family. In the titanate family, odd numbered layers of perovskite usually exist in the form of B2cb crystals, while even numbered layers of compounds are more crystallized in Miam. This is because the distortion of the calcium titanium layer can affect the bond between oxygen and bismuth oxide layer, without affecting the distortion of the oxygen octahedron inside the calcium titanium layer.

explanation_cn: 白色粉末，正方晶系，相对密度6.6。
explanation_en: White powder, square crystal system, relative density 6.6.

explanation_cn: 由钨和二氧化钍所组成的钨合金，简称钍钨合金。常用合金的Th02含量在0.7%~2%之间。Th02热稳定性好，大大提高钨合金的高温强度、再结晶温度和高温蠕变性能，钍进一步降低钨的电子逸出功，增强合金的热电子发射能力。钨钍合金的制取类似于掺杂钨丝。钨钍合金丝作为高热电子发射性的灯丝和阴极广泛用于电子管中，钨钍合金棒则作为各种电弧焊接、切割和引发电弧的电极材料。钨钍合金的一个重要缺点是二氧化钍含有一定的放射性，在加工和使用时引起放射性污染。
explanation_en: Tungsten alloys consists of tungsten and thorium dioxide, which is called thorium tungsten alloys for short. Th02 content of common alloy is between 0.7% and 2%. Th02 has good thermal stability, which greatly improves the high temperature strength, recrystallization temperature and high temperature creep performance of tungsten alloys. thorium further reduces the electronic work of tungsten and enhances the thermal electron emission capability of alloy. The preparation of tungsten-thorium alloy is similar to that of doped tungsten wire. Tungsten thorium alloy wire is widely used in electron tubes as the filament and cathode with high hot electron emission, and tungsten-thorium alloy rod is used as the electrode materials for various arc weld, cutting and arc initiation. An important disadvantage of tungsten-thorium alloy is that thorium dioxide contains certain radioactivity, which causes radioactive pollution during processing and use.

explanation_cn: 乂称碳化钨-钴硬质合金。碳化钨和金属钴或微量的TiC制成的硬质合金。这类金属陶瓷可按通常特种陶瓷配料、成型等工艺制造。
explanation_en: It is called carbonization cobalt hardmetal. Hardmetal made of carbonization and metallic cobalt or trace TiC. This kind of cermet can be made by the usual special ceramics batching, molding and other processes.

explanation_cn: 是一种固溶合金，含钼量为2.5%~50%(质量分数），钨钥合金主要产品是丝材，用作测高温的热电偶、切割材料、宇航高温构件的异形件。可以粉未冶金法和电弧熔炼法制备锭坯.采用常规塑性加工方法成形。
explanation_en: It is a kind of solid solution alloy with molybdenum content of 2.5%~50% (mass fraction). The main product of tungsten key alloy is wire material, which is used as thermocouple for measuring high temperature, cutting materials, and special-shaped parts of aerospace high-temperature components. The ingots can be prepared by powder metallurgy method and arc melting method, and formed by conventional plastic forming method.

explanation_cn: 主要用作合金添加剂的铁和钨的合金，钨含量通常为70%~80%,主要生产方法为取铁法，以钨精矿为原料.沥青焦、硅铁为还原剂.在电炉中熔炼，用挖铁机将半熔态的从炉内取出。
explanation_en: Iron and alloy of tungsten, which are mainly used as alloy additive, usually contain 70%~80% of tungsten. The main production method is to take iron, with tungsten concentrate as raw material, pitch coke and ferrosilicon as reducing agent. They are melting in electric furnace, and the semi molten state is taken out of the furnace by iron digger.

explanation_cn: 作为一种非放射性钨电极来替代钍钨合金。通常铈钨电极里面含有2%的氧化铈。
explanation_en: As a non radioactive tungsten electrode to replace thorium tungsten alloy. Usually, cerium tungsten electrodes contain 2% cerium oxide.

explanation_cn: 常在捧杂钨丝中加入3%~5%的铼.称为钨铼丝。它可以使钨的延脆转变温度下降到室温或室温以下。这是一种很奇特的铼效应，至今还未发现一种元素能代替铼.在钨中产生同样效应。
explanation_en: Tungsten rhenium wire is often used to add 3%~5% rhenium to the impurity tungsten wire. It can make the ductile brittle transformation temperature of tungsten drop to or below room temperature. This is a very unique rhenium effect, and no element has yet been found to replace rhenium. It produces the same effect in tungsten.

explanation_cn: 钨铼合金是以钨为基体与铼元素组成的固溶强化型合金。合金中常用的铼含量（质量分数）为3%、5%、10%、25%和26%。当合金中的铼含量超过26%时.将析出脆性的δ相。
explanation_en: Tungsten-rhenium alloy is a solution strengthened alloy composed of tungsten matrix and rhenium element. Rhenium content (mass fraction) commonly used in alloy is 3%, 5%, 10%, 25% and 26%. When the rhenium content in alloy exceeds 26%, brittle δ Phase.

explanation_cn: 见黑钨矿。
explanation_en: See wolframite.

explanation_cn: 是一种重要的钨基高密度合金.是在钨中添加镍铁比（质量比）为7:3或1:1的合金元素制成的合金，是用量最大的钨基髙密度合金。这类合金的特点是烧结密度高、强度与塑性均较好，有一定的铁磁性。
explanation_en: It is an important tungsten high density alloy. It is a alloy made by adding alloy elements with a nickel iron ratio (mass ratio) of 7:3 or 1:1 to tungsten. It is the largest tungsten based high density alloy. This kind of alloy is characterized by high sintering density, good strength and plasticity, and certain ferromagnetism.

explanation_cn: 是一类重要的钨基高密度合金。是在钨中添加镍铜比（质量比）为3：2的合金元素制成的合金。和钨镍铁合金比较.由于铜不具有镍、铁活化烧结钨的作用，因此其烧结密度稍低，强度和塑性较差，一般不进行热处理和变形加工。
explanation_en: It is an important tungsten high density alloy. It is a alloy made by adding alloy elements with a nickel copper ratio (mass ratio) of 3:2 to tungsten. Compared with tungsten-nickel-iron alloy, copper does not have the function of nickel and iron to activate sintering tungsten, so its sintering density is slightly lower, strength and plasticity are poor, and heat treatment and deformation processing are generally not carried out.

explanation_cn: 含贵金属把、金的厚膜导体浆料，其特点是无银迁移，抗焊溶性好，可焊性好，可热压焊金丝，改善老化后的黏结性能并能与多种电阻材料相容。钯-金浆料用在各种微电路中，可用在烧成温度较高的厚膜电阻端接和厚膜电容器的电极等。
explanation_en: The conductive paste for thick film containing precious metal handle and gold is characterized by no silver migration, good solderability, good solderability, hot pressing of gold wire, improved bonding performance after aging, and compatibility with a variety of resistance materials. Palladium-gold paste is used in various microcircuits, such as thick film resistor termination with high firing temperature and electrode of thick film capacitor.

explanation_cn: 一种贵金属厚膜电阻浆料.是最早用于制造厚膜电阻的材料。钯银电阻浆料相于制作厚膜电路用电阻。
explanation_en: A precious metals resistance paste for thick film. It is the first materials used to manufacture thick film resistors. Palladium silver resistor slurry is used for making resistors for thick film circuits.

explanation_cn: 钯合金是以钯为基加入其他元素组成的合金。钯合金的重要性质是对氢有选择透过性。
explanation_en: Palladium alloy is a alloy based on palladium and added with other elements. The important property of palladium alloy is its selective permeability to hydrogen.

explanation_cn: 钴-60，核素符号60Co，半衰期为5.2713a，可用作制作γ放射源、β放射源和γ同位素热源等。
explanation_en: Cobalt-60, nuclide symbol 60Co, half life is 5.2713a, which can be used for production γ Radioactive sources β Radioactive sources and γ Isotope heat source, etc.

explanation_cn: 以钴为基体的可通过热加工或（和）冷加工变形制成型材或零件毛坯的高温合金。在钴基体中加人20%左右镍形成稳定的γ奥氏体基体；加入20%左右的Cr以改善抗氧化和抗腐蚀性能；加人15%左右的W作为主要固溶强化元素进行固溶强化。
explanation_en: Cobalt based high temperature alloy that can be deformed into profiles or parts blanks by overheating or (and) cold working. Adding about 20% nickel to the cobalt matrix to form a stable γ Austenite matrix; Add about 20% Cr to improve oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance; Add about 15% of W as the main solid solution strengthening element for solid solution strengthening.

explanation_cn: 指以钴为基体，钴含量一般在35%?70%之间，并加人5%?25%的镍以稳定y奥氏体.加入20%?25%Cr以改善抗氧化和抗腐蚀性能的高温合金.所以.钴基合金实际上是Co^Ni-Cr=元系为基的合金。钻基合金以钨为主要强化元素.无论是钴基变形合金还是钻基铸造高温合金，都含有7%?15%的钨.有些合金用钽或铌取代部分钨作为同溶强化元素。钴基合金中碳含fi较高.远高于镍基合金。钴基铸造合金的碳含量在0.25%?1.0%范围，是镍基铸造高温合金的5倍，钴基变形高温合金的碳含量也较高.在〇?1%?0.5%范围。碳在钻基合金中是不可缺少的关键元素.碳可以形成不同类型的碳化物进行沉淀强化.所以，钻基合金的强化机制是间溶强化和碳化物沉淀强化，而尤金属间化合物相强化。钴基高温合金由于熔点高，抗氧化、耐腐蚀性能优异，持久丨丨11线（L-JW曲线）变化平缓，抗热疲劳性能和焊接性能良好，尽管价格昂贵，但至今在西方国家仍广泛用作航空发动机和燃气轮机的涡轮导向叶片等零件》钴基合金是良好的生物医用材料，适合于制造体内负重的植人体，主要用于各种人_X关节、人工骨及骨科内外固定的制造；齿科修复中的义齿、各种铸造冠、嵌体积固定桥的制造；还吋用于心血管外科和整形外科等。用于生物医用材料的钴基合金有铸造CoCrMo合金、丨锻造CoCrMo合金、锻造CoNiCrMo合金、锻造Co-CrWNi合金、锻造（'oONiMoFe合金、锻造CoNi-CrMoWFe合金等。
explanation_en: Refers to the use of cobalt as the matrix, with a cobalt content generally of 35%? Between 70% and adding 5%? 25% nickel to stabilize y austenite. Add 20%? 25% Cr is a high temperature alloy to improve oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance. Therefore, cobalt based alloy is actually a Co ^ Ni Cr=element based alloy. The drill base alloy takes tungsten as the main strengthening element. Whether it is a cobalt base deformed alloy or a cobalt-basc cast superalloy, it contains 7%? 15% tungsten. Some alloy use tantalum or niobium to replace part of tungsten as the same solution strengthening element. The carbon content of cobalt based alloy is much higher than that of nickel based alloy. The carbon content of cobalt based foundry alloy is 0.25%? The range of 1.0% is 5 times that of nickel-base cast superalloy, and the carbon content of cobalt-base wrought superalloy is also high? 1%? 0.5% range. Carbon is an indispensable key element in drill base alloy. Carbon can form different types of carbide for precipitation strengthening. Therefore, the strengthening mechanism of drill base alloy is interstitial strengthening and carbide precipitation strengthening, especially intermetallic compound phase strengthening. Cobalt based high-temperature alloys, due to their high melting point, excellent oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance, gentle changes in the endurance curve (L-JW curve), good thermal fatigue resistance and welding performance, are still widely used in parts such as turbine guide blades in aviation engines and gas turbines in Western countries despite their high prices. Cobalt based alloys are excellent biomedical materials, suitable for manufacturing weight-bearing implants in the body, and mainly used for various people_ Manufacturing of X-joints, artificial bones, and orthopedic internal and external fixation; Manufacturing of demure, various foundry crowns and embedded volume fixed bridges in dental restoration; Also used in cardiovascular surgery and plastic surgery. Cobalt based alloy used for biomedical materials include foundry CoCrMo alloy, forged CoCrMo alloy, forged CoNiCrMo alloy, forged Co CrWNi alloy, forged ('oONIMoFe alloy, forged CoNi CrMoWFe alloy, etc.

explanation_en: Cobalt based quaternary system high-temperature thermal corrosion resistant coating containing chromium, aluminum and yttrium.

explanation_cn: 入工放射件同位素钷（wPm)是一种的辐射体。用作永久性发光材料的激发源。永久性发光材料除用于工业、仪表、军事外，在民用上如电灯开关、插头、电话号码盘、锁孔、门把手、楼梯阶线、门牌、影剧院座位号等等均可涂用。也可作非常标志：如入防工程、太平门、消防警报器、船舶救生圈、矿并通道、矿并尾部标志等。
explanation_en: The radioactive isotope promethium (wPm) is a type of radioactive material. Used as an excitation source for permanence luminescent materials. In addition to industrial, instrument and military applications, permanence luminescent materials can be applied in civilian applications, such as light switches, plugs, telephone number plates, keyholes, door handles, stair steps, door plates, theater seat numbers, etc. It can also be used as a special sign, such as entrance protection engineering, emergency exit, fire alarm, ship lifebuoy, mining passage, mining tail sign, etc.

explanation_cn: 宝石级的金刚石称为钻石。主要成分是C，质量分数可达99.95%,因含微量的氮和硼等杂质而呈色。钻石常呈无色-浅黄色，少数为黄、褐、红、粉红、蓝、绿、紫罗兰、黑色等。莫氏硬度为10,是自然界最硬的矿物，密度3.52g/cm3很稳定。具有特征的金刚光泽和极高折射率和色散值，所以抛光良好的钻石具有很强的光泽和火彩。有"宝石之王"的美称。钻石4C分级指的是从净度（clarity)、颜色（color)、克拉质H(caratweight)、切工(cut)4个方面对钻石进行综合评价.进而确定钻石的价值。钻石还具有导热性、热膨胀性和吋燃性。含B的钻石具有导电性.是优质的高温半导体材料。
explanation_en: Gems grade diamond is called diamond. The main component is C, with a mass fraction of up to 99.95%. It appears colored due to impurities such as trace amounts of nitrogen and boron. Diamond are usually colorless light yellow, and a few are yellow, brown, red, pink, blue, green, violet, black, etc. The Mohs hardness is 10, which is the hardest mineral in nature. The density is 3.52g/cm3, which is very stable. It has characteristic diamond luster and extremely high refractive index and dispersion value, so well polished diamond have strong luster and fire color. It is known as the "King of gems". The 4C classification of diamond refers to the comprehensive evaluation of diamond from four aspects: clarity, color, carat weight and cut to determine the value of diamond. Diamond also has thermal conductivity, thermal expansion and flammability. Diamond containing B has conductivity and is a high-quality high-temperature semiconductor materials.

explanation_cn: 这是用纯钼原料制成的，是单一晶体，具有单一晶向，无晶界，且结晶缺陷很少的材料。钼单晶具有各向同性，出色的物理、化学和力学性能。其制备方法主要包括电子束悬浮区熔炼法、熔滴等离子弧熔炼法以及固态-退火法。钼单晶在电子、激光、全息技术、宇航高能物理、太空技术等领域有广泛的应用。
explanation_en: This is a materials made of pure molybdenum, which is a single crystal with a single crystal orientation, no grain boundary, and few crystal defects. Molybdenum crystal has isotropic, excellent physical, chemical and mechanical properties. Its preparation methods mainly include electron beam suspension zone melting method, droplet plasma arc melting method and solid state annealing method. Molybdenum crystal is widely used in electronics, laser, holographic technology, aerospace high-energy physics, space technology and other fields.

explanation_cn: 这是以难熔金属钼为基础，添加氧化物后经烧结而成的材料。钼和钼合金与氧化锆、氧化铝等金属陶瓷材料混合制备而成。这种材料具有高熔点、良好的抗氧化性、耐腐蚀、耐热震和耐磨等优点。钼的熔点为2600°C，二氧化锆的熔点为2677°C。它们混合后可制成具有模具寿命明显提高的热挤压模具，比普通钢模具耐用。因此，在钢材挤压过程中，其性能非常稳定。这种材料通常用作热作模具材料。此外，由氧化锆和氧化铝制成的炼钢测温保护管具有薄壁、快速温度响应的特点。在氩气氛中，温度可以迅速从20°C急升至1600°C，然后在急冷条件下经受100次热循环，而在真空下，其使用寿命可超过120次。钼基金属陶瓷热电偶护管的最高使用温度在还原气氛和真空中可达1700°C，与钨铼热电偶相配，可以替代昂贵的铂铑热电偶。钼基热挤压模具通常采用粉末冶金制造，而钼基金属陶瓷热电偶保护管则使用粉浆浇铸法和保护气氛烧结工艺制造。
explanation_en: This is a materials based on refractory metal molybdenum, which is sintering after adding oxides. Molybdenum and molybdenum alloy are mixed with cermet materials such as zirconia and alumina. This materials has the advantages of high melting point, good oxidation resistance, corrosion resistance, heat shock resistance and wear resistance. The melting point of molybdenum is 2600 ° C, and the melting point of zirconia is 2677 ° C. They can be mixed to make a hot extrusion die with significantly improved die life, which is more durable than plain steel dies. Therefore, the performance of steel product is very stable during extrusion. This materials is usually used as a hot working die materials. In addition, the temperature measuring protection tube made of zirconia and alumina for steelmaking has the characteristics of thin wall and fast temperature response. In argon atmosphere, the temperature can rapidly rise from 20 ° C to 1600 ° C, and then undergo 100 thermal cycles under rapid cooling conditions, while under vacuum, its service life can exceed 120 times. The maximum operating temperature of molybdenum base cermet thermocouple protective tube can reach 1700 ° C in reducing atmosphere and vacuum. It can be used to replace expensive platinum rhodium thermocouples when matched with tungsten rhenium thermocouples. Molybdenum based hot extrusion dies are usually made by powder metallurgy, while molybdenum base cermet thermocouple protection tubes are made by slurry casting and protective atmosphere sintering process process.

explanation_cn: 化学式为PbMoO4，简称PM。属四方晶体系。用提拉法、水热法及凝胶法生长，得到无色透明或浅黄色的PM晶体。缺点是对激光光束有散射。原因在于:①存在片状脱溶相；②会有球状液相包裹物。PM分为富铅及富钼两类。形状各异，分别从富铅或富钼熔体中形成，具有巨粒子包裹的特征。主要采取控制PM熔体的化学计量及合适的生长速率来解决。PM晶体的另一个缺点是，由于Fe等杂质离子的存在，受自然光照射会变黑。应严格控制生长的原料、环境及有关的参数。目前，PM晶体已应用于声光调制器及偏振器中，有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is PbMoO4, abbreviated as PM. It belongs to the tetragonal crystal system. Colorless transparent or light yellow PM crystal was obtained by pulling method method, hydrothermal method and gel method. The disadvantage is that it scatters the laser beam. The reasons are as follows: ① there is a lamellar dissolved phase; ② There will be spherical liquid phase inclusions. PM is divided into two categories: lead rich and molybdenum rich. They have different shapes and are formed from lead rich or molybdenum rich melts, with the characteristic of being surrounded by giant particles. The main solution is to control the stoichiometry of PM melt and appropriate growth rate. Another disadvantage of PM crystal is that it will turn black when exposed to natural light due to the existence of impurity ions such as Fe. The raw materials, environment, and related parameters for growth should be strictly controlled. At present, PM crystal has been used in acousto-optic modulator and polarizer, and has broad application prospects.

explanation_cn: 这是由钼和钛组成的合金，其中最著名的是Mo-0.5Ti合金。添加钛可以对钼起到固溶强化的作用。同时，钛与合金中少量的碳（约0.02%）可以形成碳化物，从而实现弥散强化。钛还可以净化钼的晶界，降低合金的脆性。钼钛合金是最早开发的钼合金之一，大部分的钼钛合金通常采用粉末混合、压制、烧结的方法来制备合金锭，然后再通过加工制成成品。这个过程相对简单，且具有高的成品率。钼钛合金相对于纯钼来说具有更高的高温强度和晶界的稳定性。主要用途包括替代纯钼作为高温炉的加热元件和器件、电子管的支架和栅极，以及用于航空航天领域的高温结构件等。
explanation_en: This is a alloy composed of molybdenum and titanium, the most famous of which is Mo-0.5Ti alloy. Adding titanium can have a solid solution strengthening effect on molybdenum. At the same time, a small amount of carbon (about 0.02%) in titanium and alloy can form carbide, thus realizing dispersion strengthening. Titanium can also purify the grain boundary of molybdenum and reduce the brittleness of alloy. Raolybdenum titanium alloy is one of the earliest developed molybdenum alloy. Most raolybdenum titanium alloy are usually prepared by powder mixing, pressing and sintering, and then processed into finished products. This process is relatively simple and has a high yield. Compared with pure molybdenum, Mo Ti alloy has higher high temperature strength and grain boundary stability. Its main applications include replacing pure molybdenum as heating elements and devices of high-temperature furnaces, stem and grids of electronic tubes, and high-temperature structural parts used in aerospace fields.

explanation_cn: 这是由钼和钨制成的固溶型钼合金。合金的性质基本上会随着合金组成成分的不同呈现有规律的变化。通常使用的钼钨合金中，钨的含量在10%到40%之间变化。当钨含量过低时，合金的性能与纯钼相比变化不大；而当钨含量过高时，合金变得难以加工和变形。制备钼钨合金的方法与制备金属钼材料和其他钼合金的方法类似，包括粉末冶金烧结和熔炼加工两种方法，可以制成棒材、板材、丝材或其他形状的材料。例如，含有30%钨的钼钨合金通常用于锌冶炼工业中的搅拌器、管道和容器内衬。钼钨合金在高温条件下具有出色的强度，其性能与纯钨相似，但密度比纯钨小。因此，在高温条件下，钼钨合金常用于制造火箭、导弹中的高温构件、电子管的灯丝、零件以及其他高温应用的材料。
explanation_en: This is a solid solution molybdenum alloy made of molybdenum and tungsten. The properties of alloy basically change regularly with the different composition of alloy. The content of tungsten in commonly used molybdenum tungsten alloy varies from 10% to 40%. When the tungsten content is too low, the properties of alloy have little change compared with pure molybdenum; When tungsten content is too high, alloy becomes difficult to process and deform. The method of preparing molybdenum tungsten alloy is similar to that of preparing metal molybdenum materials and other molybdenum alloy, including powder metallurgy sintering and melting processing, which can be made into bar, plates, wires or materials of other shapes. For example, molybdenum tungsten alloy containing 30% tungsten is usually used for the lining of agitators, pipes and vessels in the zinc smelting industry. Molybdenum tungsten alloys alloy has excellent strength at high temperature. Its performance is similar to that of pure tungsten, but its density is smaller than that of pure tungsten. Therefore, under high temperature conditions, molybdenum tungsten alloy is often used to manufacture high-temperature components in rockets and missiles, filaments and parts of electronic tubes, and other materials for high-temperature applications.

explanation_cn: 这是铁和钼的合金，主要用作合金添加剂。通常，钼的含量在55%到70%之间。钼铁合金通常采用金属热法（也称炉外法）进行生产，以钼精矿和铁屑或废钢为原材料，通过焦炭、铝粒、含铝合金和硅铁粉等还原剂进行冶炼生产。钼铁合金具有较高的密度，高熔点，且随着钼含量的增加而升高。例如，含有60%钼的钼铁合金的熔点约为1800°C。GB/T3649-2008标准对钼铁的牌号和化学成分进行了明确规定。钼铁主要用作合金添加剂，广泛应用于高速钢中，以提高红硬性和耐磨性。在耐热钢、合金结构钢、工具钢中加入钼可以细化晶粒、提高淬透性、降低回火脆性，以及提高热强度。在高强度低合金钢中加入钼可以促进贝氏体的形成，而在不锈钢中加入钼可以提高抗点蚀性能。此外，将钼添加到合金铸铁中可以提高耐磨性并改善高温性能。
explanation_en: This is a alloy of iron and molybdenum, mainly used as additive for alloy. Usually, the content of molybdenum ranges from 55% to 70%. Ferromolybdenum alloy is usually produced by metal thermal method (also known as out of furnace method), which uses molybdenum concentrate and iron chips or scrap steel as raw materials, and smelting production is carried out by reducing agents such as coke, aluminum particles, aluminum containing alloy and ferrosilicon powder. Ferromolybdenum alloy has higher density, higher melting point, and increases with the increase of molybdenum content. For example, the melting point of ferromolybdenum alloy containing 60% molybdenum is about 1800 ° C. The trademark and chemical composition of ferromolybdenum are clearly specified in GB/T3649-2008. Ferromolybdenum is mainly used as alloy additive and is widely used in high speed steel to improve red hardness and wear resistance. Adding molybdenum to heat resistant steel, alloy structural steel and tool steel can refine grain, improve hardenabilhy, reduce temper brittleness, and improve thermal strength. Adding molybdenum to high-strength low alloy steel can promote the formation of bainite, while adding molybdenum to stainless steel can improve the pitting corrosion resistance. In addition, adding molybdenum to alloy cast iron can improve wear resistance and high temperature properties.

explanation_cn: 又称彩钼铅矿，是一种简单的岛状结构钼酸盐矿物。其中铅可以被钙和稀土元素代替，而钼可以被钨、钒或铀代替。这种矿物属于四方晶系。晶体呈板状或薄板状，有时会在(001)或(010)方向上形成双晶；而集合体呈粒状。这种矿物的颜色多种多样，可以是蜡黄色、橘红色、灰色、褐色等，其条痕呈白色或浅黄色。它具有金刚光泽，断口呈油脂光泽，通常呈半透明至透明状态。它的解理在(111)方向上完全，(101)方向上中等，而在(001)和(031)方向上不完全。莫氏硬度在2.5到3之间，密度在6.5到7.0 g/cm3之间。这种矿物主要产于铅锌矿床的氧化带，有时也是由铅矿物发生交代而成。它可以与钒铅矿、铬铅矿、白铅矿等矿物一同共生或伴生。这是提取铅和钼的重要矿物资源。
explanation_en: Also known as colored molybdenum lead ore, it is a simple island like structure molybdate mineral. Lead can be replaced by calcium and rare earth elements, while molybdenum can be replaced by tungsten, vanadium or uranium. This mineral belongs to the tetragonal crystal system. The crystal is tabular or lamellar, and sometimes twin is formed in the (001) or (010) direction; And the aggregates are granular. This mineral has a variety of colors, including wax yellow, orange red, gray, brown, etc. Its stripes are white or light yellow. It has a diamond luster, with a greasy luster on the fracture surface, usually in a semi transparent to transparent state. Its cleavage is complete in the (111) direction, moderate in the (101) direction, and incomplete in the (001) and (031) directions. Mohs hardness between 2.5 and 3, density between 6.5 and 7.0 g/cm 3 Between. This mineral mainly occurs in the oxidation zone of lead-zinc deposits, and sometimes it is also formed by the replacement of lead minerals. It can coexist or be associated with minerals such as vanadium lead ore, chromium lead ore, and white lead ore. This is an important mineral resource for extracting lead and molybdenum.

explanation_cn: 这是用铌强化钼的固溶型合金，拥有单一晶体取向，无晶界，且结晶缺陷很少。钼铌单晶具有各向同性，出色的物理、化学和力学性能。与钼单晶相比，钼铌单晶在高温强度和高温蠕变性能方面有显著的提高。其制备方法主要包括电子束悬浮区域熔炼法、熔滴等离子弧熔炼法以及应变-退火法。这种合金在电子、激光、全息技术、宇航高能物理、太空技术等领域有广泛应用。
explanation_en: This is a solid solution alloy with Nb strengthened molybdenum, which has a single crystal orientation, no grain boundary, and few crystal defects. Molybdenum niobium crystal single crystal is isotropic and has excellent physical, chemical and mechanical properties. Compared with molybdenum crystal, molybdenum niobium crystal has significant improvement in high-temperature strength and high-temperature creep properties. Its preparation methods mainly include electron beam suspension zone melting, droplet plasma arc melting and strain annealing. This alloy is widely used in electronics, laser, holographic technology, aerospace high-energy physics, space technology and other fields.

explanation_cn: 这是由金属钼和金属铼制成的合金，其中铼含量小于50%（质量分数）。钼铼合金和钨铼合金一样，属于固溶强化合金，具有铼效应，可以提高合金的塑性。通过添加铼，提高了钼合金的高温强度，显著地降低了钼合金的韧性-脆性转变温度，并提高了合金的室温塑性。制备钼铼合金的方法与制备钨铼合金相似，主要生产板材、棒材和丝材，大多数是低铼合金，含有约5%的铼。钼铼合金可用于制造旋转X射线管的靶材、微波通信用电子管的长寿命栅极、空间反应堆堆芯加热管以及高温炉的加热元件等应用。
explanation_en: This is a alloy made of metal molybdenum and metal rhenium, in which rhenium content is less than 50% (mass fraction). Like tungsten-rhenium alloy, molybdenum rhenium alloy is a solution strengthened alloy, which has rhenium effect and can improve the plasticity of alloy. By adding rhenium, the high temperature strength of molybdenum alloy was improved, the ductile-brittle transition temperature of molybdenum alloy was significantly reduced, and the room temperature plasticity of alloy was improved. The method of preparing molybdenum rhenium alloy is similar to that of preparing tungsten-rhenium alloy. It mainly produces plates, bar and wires, most of which are low rhenium alloy, containing about 5% rhenium. Molybdenum rhenium alloy can be used to manufacture targets for rotating X-ray tubes, long-life grids for electronic tubes for microwave communication, core heating tubes for space reactors and heating elements for high-temperature furnaces.

explanation_cn: 由较高含量的锆、铪和碳与钼组成的钼合金(ZHM)。锆含量为0.4%-0.72%，铪含量1.2%-2.1%。碳含量0.15%-0.27%。是一种新型钼合金，锆、铪既有同溶强化作用-又可以形成碳化物起弥散强化作用，其强化作用和高温稳定性远胜于钼钛锆合金-其标记为ZHM钼合金。它们的室温拉伸强度比TZM钼合金高出40%-50%，是强度最高的钼合金。
explanation_en: Molybdenum alloy (ZHM) consisting of high content of zirconium, hafnium, carbon and molybdenum. The zirconium content is 0.4% -0.72%, and the hafnium content is 1.2% -2.1%. Carbon content 0.15% -0.27%. It is a new type of molybdenum alloy. Zirconium and hafnium not only have the same solution strengthening effect but also can form carbide for dispersion strengthening. Its strengthening effect and high temperature stability are far better than that of molybdenum titanium zirconium alloy alloy, which is labeled as ZHM molybdenum alloy. Their room temperature tensile strength is 40% -50% higher than that of molybdenum titanium-zirconium alloy, which is the highest strength molybdenum alloy.

explanation_cn: 担的最好固溶强化元素是铼、钨、钼、锆和铪，复合强化相主要是铪的碳化物。钽合金具有高温拉伸强度和高温蠕变强度高，室温塑性、冲击韧性好.耐液态金属和无机酸（除氢氟酸外）的腐蚀性好。钽合金制备采用电子束熔炼、真空自耗电弧熔炼或粉末冶金方法制备锭坯，常规塑性加工方法制备各种形状的材料。
explanation_en: The best solid solution strengthening elements of the support are rhenium, tungsten, molybdenum, zirconium and hafnium. The composition strengthening phase is mainly the carbide of hafnium. Tantalum alloy has high tensile strength and creep strength at high temperature, good plasticity and impact toughness at room temperature, and good corrosion resistance to liquid metals and inorganic acids (except hydrofluoric acid). Tantalum alloy is prepared by electron beam melting, vacuum consumable arc melting or powder metallurgy, and materials of various shapes are prepared by conventional plastic forming.

explanation_cn: 化学式YTaO4Nb白色粉末，相对密度7.6,在X射线激发下发出蓝紫色荧光.峰值波长400nm,发射光谱从300-500nm。从300t起以每分钟1.0-1.5X：速度升温，在1250T：灼烧10-14h,冷却后水洗，过滤，干燥而制得荧光粉。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is YTaO4Nb white powder, with a relative density of 7.6, which emits blue purple fluorescence under X-ray excitation. The peak-emission wavelength is 400nm, and the emission spectrum ranges from 300-500nm. The phosphor is prepared by heating at the rate of 1.0-1.5X per minute from 300t, burning at 1250T for 10-14h, cooling, washing, filtering and drying.

explanation_cn: LiTaO3是一种属于兰方晶系的铁电晶体，具有钛铁矿结构，属于畸变钙钛矿型结构。它的点群对称性是C3v或R3m，晶格常数a=5.154 ?，c=13.783 ?，密度约为7.45 g/cm3。LiTaO3的熔点约为1650°C，莫氏硬度在5.5到6.0之间，折射率为 nE = 2.176 和 nO = 2.186（在波长为6328 ?的情况下）。其介电常数ε11=41，ε33=42，ε12=53，ε13=44，次光电系数γ12=γ23=7.0×10^-12 m/V，γ33=30×10^-12 m/V。机电耦合系数R15通常大于0.3。LiTaO3在665°C左右具有居里温度点，并且具有自发极化强度约为50×10^-6 C/cm^2。生长高纯度的LiTaO3晶体通常使用Li2CO3和Ta2O5作为原材料，采用拉晶法生长。通常需要对LiTaO3晶体进行热退火和极化处理，以改善光学均匀性和消光比。LiTaO3晶体具有卓越的光电、压电和热释电性能，而且具有较低的介电损耗角正切。它还具有良好的机械加工性能。在应用方面，LiTaO3广泛用于激光技术，作为调Q/模式锁定元件和电光调制器的材料。此外，在红外技术中，它可以用作热电探测器和热电摄像管的靶面材料。借助其压电性能，可以用于制造滤波器和谐振器等器件。
explanation_en: LiTaO3 is a ferroelectric crystal belonging to the blue square crystal system, with ilmenite structure and distorted perovskite structure. Its point group symmetry is C3v or R3m, the lattice constant a=5.154 ∨, c=13.783 ∨, and the density is about 7.45 g/cm 3。 The melting point of LiTaO3 is about 1650 ° C, the Mohs hardness is between 5.5 and 6.0, and the refractive index is nE=2.176 and nO=2.186 (at the wavelength of 6328 ∨). Its dielectric constant ε 11=41, ε 33=42, ε 12=53, ε 13=44, secondary photoelectric coefficient γ 12= γ 23=7.0 × 10 ^ -12 m/V, γ 33=30 × 10 ^ -12 m/V. The electromechanical coupling coefficient R15 is usually greater than 0.3. LiTaO3 has a Curie temperature point at about 665 ° C, and has a spontaneous polarization intensity of about 50 × 10 ^ -6 C/cm ^ 2. Li2CO3 and Ta2O5 are usually used as raw materials to grow high-purity LiTaO3 crystal, which are grown by pulling crystal method. Generally, LiTaO3 crystal needs to be thermally annealed and polarization to improve the optical uniformity and extinction ratio. LiTaO3 crystal has excellent photoelectric, piezoelectric and pyroelectric properties and low tangent of dielectric loss angle. It also has good mechanical processing performance. In terms of application, LiTaO3 is widely used in laser technology as a materials for Q-switching/mode locking elements and electro-optic modulators. In addition, in infrared technology, it can be used as the target surface materials of thermoelectric detectors and thermoelectric camera tubes. With its piezoelectric performance, it can be used to manufacture devices such as filters and resonators.

explanation_cn: 具有LiTaC)3g构的铁电陶瓷u属于点群3m。原材料为Ta205和Li20。室温时，LiTaO3的自发敏化强度Ps=50XKT2C/m2,相对介电常数为10-50。
explanation_en: The ferroelectric ceramics u with LiTaC) 3g structure belongs to point group 3m. The raw materials are Ta205 and Li20. At room temperature, the spontaneous sensitization intensity Ps of LiTaO3=50XKT2C/m2, and the relative dielectric constant is 10-50.

explanation_cn: 又称明矾。含水的复杂岛状结构硫酸盐矿物。化学式为KA1 (H2O)12 [SO4]2，K与Na、NH4可形成类质同象系列。
explanation_en: Also called alum. Sulfate minerals with complex island like structures containing water. The chemical formula is KA1 (H2O) 12 [SO4] 2, and K can form a isomorphic series with Na and NH4.

explanation_cn: 含水具有附加阴离子的复杂岛状结构硫酸盐矿物。化学式为KMg (H2O)1.5[SO4] Cl。单斜晶系。晶体呈粒状、致密块状。无色透明或染成蓝色、紫色、红色等。是化工和制取化肥的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Sulfate minerals with complex island like structures containing water and additional anions. The chemical formula is KMg (H2O) 1.5 [SO4] Cl. Monoclinic system. The crystal is granular and compact. Colorless transparent or dyed blue, purple, red, etc. It is a raw mineral material for chemical industry and fertilizer production.

explanation_cn: 又称钾盐。配位型氯化物矿物。化学式为KC1。常含微量铷、铯、溴类质同象混入物和Fe2O3、NaCl等机械混入物。等轴晶系。是制取钾肥和各种钾化合物的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Also known as potassium salt. Coordination type chloride minerals. The chemical formula is KC1. It often contains trace amounts of rubidium, cesium, bromine isomorphic mixtures, as well as mechanical mixtures such as Fe2O3 and NaCl. Equiaxed crystal system. It is a raw mineral material for producing potassium fertilizer and various potassium compounds.

explanation_cn: 含水的复杂岛状结构硫酸盐矿物"化学式为K2Ca(H20) [S04]。白色、浅黄或肉红色， 透明至半透明，玻璃光泽。莫氏硬度2. 5,密度2.58 g/cm3，是陆相盐湖里常见的含钾矿物，与硬石膏、杂卤石、无水芒硝、钙芒硝等共生，还发现于现代盐湖底部含盐的黏土层中。是化工和制取化肥的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Water bearing complex island structure sulfate mineral "chemical formula is K2Ca (H20) [S04]. White, light yellow or flesh red, transparent to translucent, glass luster. Mohs hardness 2 5. With a density of 2.58 g/cm3, it is a common potassium bearing mineral in continental salt lakes, coexisting with anhydrite, polyhalite, thenardite, calcium mirabilite, etc. It is also found in the salt bearing clay layer at the bottom of modern salt lakes. It is a raw mineral material for chemical industry and fertilizer production.

explanation_cn: 又称硝石，简单的岛状结构硝酸盐矿物。化学式为KNO3。斜方晶系。晶体呈针状、毛发状；集合体呈疏松的皮壳状、盐华状、束状等。白色，常因含杂质染成灰色等。是制取氮肥、钾肥的矿物原料。
explanation_en: Also known as saltpeter, a simple island structure nitrate mineral. The chemical formula is KNO3. Orthorhombic crystal system. The crystal are needle like and hair like; The aggregates are porosity crusts, salt blooms, bundles, etc. White, often dyed gray due to impurities. It is the raw mineral material for producing nitrogen fertilizer and potassium fertilizer.

explanation_cn: 是C60基有机物超导体，超导转变温度18K;采用Rb替代K元素，也具有超导电性，超导转变温度可以达到29K。
explanation_en: It is a C60 based organic superconductor with a superconducting transition temperature of 18K; Using Rb instead of K also has superconductivity, and the superconducting transition temperature can reach 29K.

explanation_cn: 复杂岛状结构硫酸盐矿物。化学式为K3Na [SO4]。三方晶系。无色、白色或染成灰色、褐红色等。透明至不透明，玻璃光泽。
explanation_en: Sulfate minerals with complex island like structures. The chemical formula is K3Na [SO4]. Tripartite crystal system. Colorless, white or dyed gray, maroon, etc. Transparent to opaque, glass luster.

explanation_cn: 是Fe基超导体的一种，是具有拓扑结构的超导体。
explanation_en: It is a type of Fe based superconductor with topological structure.

explanation_cn: 为银白色天然放射性金属，重要的核燃料。属锕系元素，符号U，原子序数92,原子量238.08，密度19.05g/cm3,熔点1402-1403K。a的物理和力学性能具有各向异性。元件经受热循环时生长，辐照作用下尺寸不稳定，主要原因是的辐照生长和肿胀。多晶的辐照行为强烈地依赖于晶粒尺寸、结构和织构。为了提高金属尺寸的稳定性，添加不同的元素制成合金。钚通常以两种方式生产利用，即随堆生产和裂变，几乎所有热中子反应堆都有一定份额的钚裂变，乏燃料中都有一定数量的钚。另一种是把贫化铀（主要是铀238)制成增殖元件放在堆芯周吸收从堆芯中泄漏出来的中子完成上述反应，待钚达到一定浓度后，从反应堆中卸出，经后处理提取出来，加以利用。这一循环大大地提高了铀的利用率。
explanation_en: It is a silvery white natural radioactive metal and an important nuclear fuel. It is an actinide element with symbol U, atomic number 92, atomic weight 238.08, density 19.05g/cm3, and melting point 1402-1403K. The physical and mechanical properties of a are anisotropic. The element grows during heating cycle, and its size is unstable under irradiation, mainly due to irradiation growth and swelling. The irradiation behavior of polycrystal strongly depends on grain size, structure and texture. In order to improve the stability of metal size, different elements are added to make alloy. Plutonium is usually produced and utilized in two ways, namely, reactor production and fission. Almost all thermal neutron reactors have a certain share of plutonium fission, and spent fuel (nuclear) has a certain amount of plutonium. The other is to make depleted uranium (mainly uranium 238) into proliferation elements and put them around the core to absorb the neutrons leaked from the core to complete the above reaction. When plutonium reaches a certain concentration, it is discharged from the reactor, extracted after post-processing and used. This cycle has greatly improved the utilization rate of uranium.

explanation_cn: UZrHx合金是一种含有铀（U）、氢（H）和锆（Zr）的混合合金，其化学式为UZrHx，其中x代表H/Zr原子比。不同的铀富集度、合金成分以及x值的不同选择将影响合金的性能。一般情况下，选择的铀富集度通常在20%以上，而x值一般在1.0到1.7之间。一种常见的UZrHx合金，含有8.5%的铀（质量分数），铀的富集度为20%，具有180°C的熔点，密度约为6 g/cm3。UZrHx合金中的氢化锆作为慢化剂，与铀均匀混合，这种合金燃料具有较大的瞬发负温度系数，使得反应堆具有可靠的固有安全性。这种合金适用于脉冲运行，可以获得较高的脉冲中子通量密度，通常在10^16到10^17 n/cm^2的范围内。此外，UZrHx合金具有良好的热学性能，在较大的温度范围内表现为单一相，并且能够保持强大的裂变气体容量，同时具有较好的抗腐蚀性能。制备UZrHx合金的方法通常有两种：冶炼成型和粉末冶金。冶炼成型的工艺流程包括将小铀块与海绵锆混合、压实制成自耗电极，然后通过电弧炉进行多次熔炼，随后进行热挤压或精密铸造，最后进行机加工和高温氢化处理。这种合金常用于脉冲堆（例如TRIGA）的燃料，也可用于材料试验堆等应用。
explanation_en: UZrHx alloy is a mixed alloy containing uranium (U), hydrogen (H) and zirconium (Zr). Its chemical formula is UZrHx, where x represents the atomic ratio of H/Zr. Different uranium enrichment, alloy composition and x value will affect the performance of alloy. Generally, the selected uranium enrichment is usually above 20%, and the x value is generally between 1.0 and 1.7. A common UZrHx alloy, containing 8.5% uranium (mass fraction), with 20% uranium enrichment, a melting point of 180 ° C, and a density of about 6 g/cm 3。 Zirconium hydride in UZrHx alloy, as a moderator, is evenly mixed with uranium. This alloy fuel has a large instantaneous negative temperature coefficient, which makes the reactor have reliable inherent safety. This alloy is suitable for pulse operation and can obtain high pulse neutron flux density, usually in the range of 10 ^ 16 to 10 ^ 17 n/cm ^ 2. In addition, UZrHx alloy has good thermal properties, shows a single phase in a large temperature range, can maintain a strong fission gas capacity, and has good corrosion resistance. There are usually two methods to prepare UZrHx alloy: smelting molding and powder metallurgy. The technological process of smelting molding includes mixing and compacting small uranium blocks with sponge zirconium to make consumable electrodes, then conducting multiple melting in electric arc furnace, followed by hot extrusion or precision casting, and finally machining and high-temperature hydrogenation. This alloy is commonly used as fuel for pulsed reactors (such as TRIGA), and can also be used in materials test reactors and other applications.

explanation_cn: 铀-钍燃料系统涉及了铀易裂变核素（如235U和233U）的燃耗、产生新核素（如232U）、后处理和再加工等一系列过程，这些过程共同组成了核燃料循环。在这个系统中，钍（如232Th）吸收中子后不能直接发生核裂变，但可以经过几步反应转变成铀的易裂变同位素铀233。铀233是一种优良的核燃料，在热中子区域，每次铀233的核裂变都会释放出大量核能，与铀235和钚239的核裂变相媲美。此外，铀233的核裂变会释放更多的中子，使其成为唯一可能实现热增殖（产生更多裂变材料比消耗）的核燃料之一。为了生产铀233，需要提供中子源，通常来自铀的易裂变核素的核裂变。这可以通过将钍和铀235装入反应堆堆芯一起使用，或者将钍放置在堆芯周围，以吸收铀的易裂变核素产生的中子，从而实现铀233的生产。生产的铀233可以留在堆内供进一步利用，也可以通过后处理提取出来，然后再次制造和使用。这种循环过程扩大了核燃料的可利用资源，有助于提高核能的可持续性。
explanation_en: The uranium thorium fuel system involves a series of processes such as burnup of uranium fissile nuclides (such as 235U and 233U), generation of new nuclides (such as 232U), post-processing and reprocessing, which together constitute the nuclear fuel cycle. In this system, thorium (such as 232Th) can not directly produce nuclear fission after absorbing neutrons, but can be transformed into uranium's fissile isotope uranium 233 after several steps of reaction. Uranium 233 is an excellent nuclear fuel. In the thermal neutron region, every nuclear fission of uranium 233 will release a lot of nuclear energy, which is comparable to the nuclear fission of uranium 235 and plutonium 239. In addition, the nuclear fission of uranium 233 will release more neutrons, making it one of the only nuclear fuels that can achieve thermal proliferation (producing more fissile materials than consuming). In order to produce uranium 233, it is necessary to provide a neutron source, usually the nuclear fission of fissile nuclides from uranium. This can be achieved by putting thorium and uranium 235 into the reactor core for use together, or placing thorium around the reactor core to absorb the neutrons produced by uranium's fissile nuclides, thus realizing the production of uranium 233. The produced uranium 233 can be left in the reactor for further utilization, or extracted through post-processing, and then manufactured and used again. This cycle process expands the available resources of nuclear fuel and helps to improve the sustainability of nuclear energy.

explanation_cn: 以铀为基体元素与一种或多种合金元素组成的合金。包括调质铀、元相铀合金、铝 - 铀合金、锆 - 铀合金等。铀合金主要用作核反应堆燃料，贫铀合金可用作穿甲弹及防辐射材料等。
explanation_en: Alloy consisting of uranium as the matrix element and one or more alloy elements. Including quenching and tempering uranium, elemental uranium alloy, aluminum uranium alloy, zirconium uranium alloy, etc. Uranium alloy is mainly used as fuel for nuclear reactor, and depleted uranium alloy can be used as armour piercing projectile and radiation materials.

explanation_cn: 见晶质铀矿。
explanation_en: See uraninite.

explanation_cn: 由不小于4%的铁元素和一种及一种以上其他金属或非金属元素组成的合金，这些元素大多是金属，也可包括一些非金属如硅、硼、磷等。在炼钢中作为脱氧剂、脱硫剂和合金元素添加剂加入，或荇在铸铁生产中作为孕育剂、变性剂和合金元素添加剂加入。铁合金品种很多，最主要有硅铁、锰铁和铬铁K个系列.其产量之和占铁合金总产量的95%以上.其次是钛铁、钨铁、钼铁、钒铁等。按生产炉型不同.合金还吋分为电炉铁合金、高炉铁合金、转炉铁合金、真空炉铁合金、热法熔炼炉铁合金等。主要牛.产方法有碳热法、金属热法、电硅热法、精炼法和电解法等。铁合金的品种、质量、价格等对钢铁生产的发展有重要影响，因此铁合金生产一直与钢铁生产相应地发展.且随着合金钢比和连铸比不断增加.铁合金产量与钢产量之比不断提高，铁合金的品种也不断增加。生产铁合金耗能高，且含有多种贵重金属元素.故降低能耗、提高金属收得率、降低生产成本是铁合金生产的关键。GB/T3650-2008对铁合金产品的必测元素和标记具有明确的规定》铁合金牌号采用铁元素符号和合金元素符号加百分含量的方法表示.必要时还加控制性杂质元素符号及百分含量.如FeCr65C1.0表示铬含量65%、碳含量小于1.0%的铬铁合金。
explanation_en: Alloy is composed of not less than 4% iron and one or more other metal or non-metallic elements, most of which are metals, but also some non-metallic elements such as silicon, boron, phosphorus, etc. It is added as deoxidizer, desulfurizer and alloy element additive in steelmaking, or not added as inoculant, modifier and alloy element additive in cast iron production. There are many varieties of ferroalloy, mainly ferrosilicon, ferromanganese and ferrochromium K series. The total output accounts for more than 95% of the total output of ferroalloy, followed by ferrotitanium, ferrotungsten, ferromolybdenum, ferrovanadium, etc. According to different production furnaces, alloy can be divided into electric furnace ferroalloy, blast furnace ferroalloy, converter ferroalloy, vacuum furnace ferroalloy, thermal melting furnace ferroalloy, etc. The main production methods include carbon thermal method, metal thermal method, electro silicon thermal method, refining method, and electrolysis method. The variety, quality and price of ferroalloy have an important impact on the development of steel production, so ferroalloy production has been developing correspondingly with steel production. And with the increasing ratio of alloy steel and continuous casting, the ratio of ferroalloy output to steel output has been increasing, and the variety of ferroalloy has also been increasing. The production of ferroalloy consumes high energy and contains a variety of precious metal elements. Therefore, the key to the production of ferroalloy is to reduce energy consumption, improve metal yield and reduce production costs. GB/T3650-2008 has clear provisions on the mandatory elements and marks of ferroalloy products. The ferroalloy grades are represented by iron element symbols and alloy element symbols plus percentage content. If necessary, control impurity element symbols and percentage content are also added. For example, FeCr65C1.0 represents ferrochromium alloy with 65% chromium content and less than 1.0% carbon content.

explanation_cn: 以铁为基体的可以通过热加工或（和）冷加：L变形制成型材或零件毛坯的高温合金。在铁基体中通常至少要加入25%左右的镍.形成稳定的奥氏体基体；加人15%左右的铬.保证合金有充分的抗氧化腐浊能力；加人W或Mo+W进行岡溶强化，加人Ti、A1或（和）Nb进行沉淀强化。铁基变形高温合金的热加工性能通常较镍基变形高温合金好，而且随着铁含量增多，可锻性愈来愈好。固溶强化型铁基变形高温合金主要用作早期生产的航空发动机燃烧室中的火焰筒等零部件，沉淀强化型铁基变形高温合金主要用作早期生产的航空发动机和燃气轮机的涡轮盘等零部件。
explanation_en: The high temperature alloy based on iron can be deformed into profiles or parts blanks through hot working or (and) cold processing. In general, about 25% nickel should be added to the iron matrix to form a stable austenite matrix; Add about 15% chromium to ensure that the alloy has sufficient oxidation and corrosion resistance; Add W or Mo+W for gang dissolution strengthening, and add Ti, A1 or (and) Nb for precipitation strengthening. The hot working of iron-base wrought superalloy is generally better than that of nickel-base wrought superalloy, and the malleability becomes better and better with the increase of iron content. The solution strengthened iron-base wrought superalloy is mainly used as the flame tube and other parts in the combustion chamber of the early production aeroengine, and the precipitation strengthened iron-base wrought superalloy is mainly used as the turbine disk and other parts of the early production aeroengine and gas turbine.

explanation_cn: 铁基引线框架材料主要是FVNi42合金和低碳钢材料。Fe-Ni42合金含42%镍，其余是铁，其特点是强度高（约为一般铜材的2倍）、軔性好，同时它的热膨胀系数小，接近于芯片的热膨胀系数，对后续封装比较有利。但它的热导率、电导率较低，不宜用于有功耗要求的产品。材料主要用于厚度为0.1?0.15mm的薄型精密引线框架上。低碳钢用作引线框架材料主要是从成本考虑，其机械加工特性均能满足引线框架的要求，但缺点是电导率及导热性较差，只能用于低功耗产品。另外.铁材的耐蚀性差，必须强化后续的表面防腐处理（一般是电镀）。低碳钢材料常用的是SPCC、SPCE,主要用于低端消费品。
explanation_en: Iron base lead frame materials is mainly FVNi42 alloy and low-carbon steel materials. Fe-Ni42 alloy contains 42% nickel, and the rest is iron. It is characterized by high strength (about twice that of common copper), good toughness, and its coefficient of thermcal expansion is small, close to the coefficient of thermcal expansion of the chip, which is favorable for subsequent packaging. But its thermal conductivity and electric conductivity are low, so it is not suitable for products with power consumption requirements. Materials is mainly used for thickness of 0.1? 0.15mm thin precision leads frame. Low carbon steel is mainly used as lead frame materials from the perspective of cost. Its machining characteristics can meet the requirements of leads frame, but its disadvantage is poor electric conductivity and thermal conductivity, which can only be used for low-power products. In addition, the corrosion resistance of iron materials is poor, and subsequent surface anti-corrosion treatment (usually electroplating) must be strengthened. Low carbon steel materials commonly used are SPCC and SPCE, which are mainly used for low-end consumer goods.

explanation_cn: 具有bct（体心立方）或hcp（六方最密堆积）晶体结构的铁基合金，它们在加热时发生逆转变为fcc（面心立方）结构的奥氏体，并表现出形状记忆效应。已知的具有bct-fcc相变的合金包括Fe-Pt和Fe-Ni-Ti等合金。这些合金的低温相主要是薄片状马氏体，通过形变过程形成自协作马氏体（钻石状马氏体）。这种马氏体在加热时转变为奥氏体，而这一过程是可逆的。具有hcp-fcc相变的合金包括Fe-Mn-Si系合金。这种合金的低温相是具有hcp晶体结构的马氏体，它们是由母相中的层错扩展重叠而形成的。在加热逆转变的过程中，通过层错的收缩，这些马氏体可以恢复到母相fcc。这些合金表现出形状记忆效应，其形状记忆应变通常在2%到3%之间。通过添加Cr和Ni，可以减少Mn和Si的含量，从而改善合金的加工性能并提高形状记忆性能。合金的熔炼和加工工艺与一般的铁基合金相似。
explanation_en: The fe based alloy with bct (body centered cubic) or hcp (hexagonal most closely packed) crystal structure are reversed to fcc (face centered cubic) austenite when heated, and show shape memory effect. The known alloy with bct fcc phase transformation include alloy such as Fe Pt and Fe Ni Ti. The low temperature phase of these alloy is mainly lamellar martensite, which forms self cooperating martensite (diamond martensite) through deformation. This martensite transforms into austenite during heating, and this process is reversible. Alloy with hcp fcc phase transformation include Fe Mn Si alloy. The low-temperature phase of this alloy is martensite with hcp crystal structure, which is formed by the expansion and overlap of stacking fault in the parent phase. During the heating reverse transformation, these martensites can recover to the parent phase fcc through the shrinkage of stacking faults. These alloy exhibit shape memory effect, and their shape memory strain is usually between 2% and 3%. By adding Cr and Ni, the contents of Mn and Si can be reduced, thus improving the processability and shape memory properties of alloy. The melting and processing technology of alloy is similar to that of common iron base alloy.

explanation_cn: 主要采用粉末冶金工艺制造的以铁及铁基合金为主要基体组元，在机械零件中主要承受对偶件的摩擦作用，要求材料具有良好的减摩性能和耐磨性能，而对力学性能要求较低。铁基摩擦材料在高温高载荷下摩擦性能良好，能承受较大压力。减摩零件烧结温度通常控制在1050-1080°C。而且减摩零件的石墨加人量较高，一般大于1%，烧结中有一部分石墨残留下来，并在后面冷却阶段的奥氏体分解过程中，最终获得珠光体+铁素体+孔隙+石墨的微观组织结构。其次，减摩零件中的孔隙要求呈连同孔隙，以便在浸渍处理作业中储存更多的润滑油。
explanation_en: It is mainly manufactured by powder metallurgy process and takes iron and iron base alloy as the main matrix component. It mainly bears the friction effect of the dual parts in the mechanical parts. materials are required to have good antifriction and wear resistance, but have low requirements for mechanical properties. Iron-based friction materials has good friction performance under high temperature and load, and can withstand greater pressure. The sintering temperature of antifriction parts is usually controlled at 1050-1080 ° C. In addition, the graphite addition of antifriction parts is high, generally more than 1%. A part of graphite remains in sintering, and the microstructure of pearlite+ferrite+pore+graphite is finally obtained during the austenite decomposition process in the later cooling stage. Secondly, the pores in antifriction parts are required to be present along with the pores in order to store more lubricating oil during impregnation operations.

explanation_cn: 指化合物中含有铁，在低温时具有超导现象，且铁扮演形成超导的主体的材料。2006年发现第一个以铁为超导主体的化合物LaFeOP.打破了以往普遍认定铁元素不利形成超导体的思想。铁基超导体的结构与高温超导的铜氧平面类似，超导电性发生在铁基平面上，属于二维的超导材料"现有的铁基超导体从结构上至少包括以下四类：（1111)、（122)、（111)和（11)。"1111"体系成员包括LnOFePn(Ln=La、Ce、Pr、Nd、Stn、Gd、Tb、Dy、Ho和Y等；Pn=P，As)以及DvFeAsF(Dv=Ca,Sr)等；"122"体系成员包括AFe2As2(A=Ba,Sr,K,Cs,Ca,Eu)等；"111"体系成员包括AFeAs(A=Li.Na)等；"11"体系成员包括Fe(Se,Te)等。铁基超导体具有非常高的上临界磁场和较高的超导临界温度，但是与铜氧化物高温超导体一样，存在显著的晶界弱连接特性，临界电流密度人.较低，因此实际应用上受到阻碍。
explanation_en: It refers to the compound containing iron, which has superconductivity at low temperature, and iron acts as the materials that forms the main body of superconductivity. In 2006, LaFeOP, the first compound with iron as the main superconductor, was discovered, which broke the previous thought that iron is not conducive to the formation of superconductors. The structure of iron-based superconductor is similar to the copper oxygen plane of high temperature superconductivity, and superconductivity occurs on the iron based plane, As a two-dimensional superconducting materials, "the existing iron-based superconductor structurally include at least the following four categories: (1111), (122), (111) and (11)." 1111 "system members include LnOFePn (Ln=La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Stn, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho and Y, etc.; Pn=P, As) and DvFeAsF (Dv=Ca, Sr), etc.;" 122 "system members include AFe2As2 (A=Ba, Sr, K, Cs, Ca, Eu), etc." 111 "System members include AFeAs (A=Li. Na), etc.;" 11 "System members include Fe (Se, Te) Etc. Iron-based superconductor have very high upper critical magnetic field and high superconductor critical temperature, but like copper oxide high-temperature superconductor, they have significant grain boundary week connectivity characteristics and low critical current density, so their practical applications are hindered.

explanation_cn: 以铁为基体的由合格母合金重熔后直接浇铸成零件或零件毛坯的高温合金。铁基体中加人15%?20%的铬，25%-45%的镍，形成一种抗氧化抗腐蚀性良好的稳定的Y奥氏体。加人适量的评和Mo进行固溶强化。强度水平低于镍基铸造髙温合金，使用温度在75CTC以下，主要用作早期航空发动机制作导向叶片、涡轮增压器转子叶片或整体涡轮转子部件，其优点是价格较低廉。
explanation_en: High temperature alloy with iron as the matrix, which is directly casting into parts or parts blanks after remelting from qualified parent alloy. Add 15% to the iron matrix? 20% chromium and 25% -45% nickel form a stable Y austenite with good oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance. Add an appropriate amount of evaluation and Mo for solid solution strengthening. The strength level is lower than that of the nickel base foundry high temperature alloy, and the service temperature is below 75CTC. It is mainly used for making guide vanes, turbocharger rotor blades or integral turbine rotor parts for early aeroengines, with the advantage of low price.

explanation_cn: 以铁素体为基的高阻尼合金。合金元素有Cr、Al、Mo、Ni、Co等。铁基高阻尼合金的阻尼机制是铁磁型。在交变应力作用下，由于磁致伸缩的逆过程，磁畴旋转和畴壁移动产生非弹性应变，应力-应变关系成滞后回线，回线面积代表机械振动能的损耗。此类合金价格低，易加工，铸态和变形态均可应用，但一般韧性较低，阻尼性能与应变幅有关，随应变幅增加有极大值，极大值的高度和位置受成分和热处理工艺影响，阻尼性能受磁场影响"
explanation_en: High damping alloy based on ferrite. Alloy elements include Cr, Al, Mo, Ni, Co, etc. The damping mechanism of Fe based high damping alloy is ferromagnetic. Under the action of alternating stress, due to the reverse process of magnetostriction, magnetic domain rotation and domain wall movement produce non elasticity strain. The stress-strain relationship is a hysteresis loop, and the loop area represents the loss of mechanical vibration energy. This kind of alloy is low in price, easy to process, and can be used both as cast and in variable shape. However, it is generally low in toughness. The damping property is related to the strain amplitude. With the increase of strain amplitude, there is a maximum value. The height and position of the maximum value are affected by the composition and heat treatment process, and the damping property is affected by the magnetic field“

explanation_cn: 通常至少要加人25%左右的Ni以稳定T奥氏体，加人15%左右的Cr保证合金具有足够的抗氧化腐蚀能力，所以铁基高温合金实际上以FHMi-O三元系为基体。当镍含量大于40%时，一般也称作铁镍基或镍铁基高温合金。铁基高温合金以Mo或Mo+W为固溶强化元素进行固溶强化，这类合金为固溶强化Fe基合金。此外，有些合金还加入一些微量有益元素以强化晶界。合金化元素含量较低者，可以通过热加工变形制成型材或零件毛坯的属于铁基变形高温合金.反之为铁基铸造高温合金。铁基高温合金由于中温力学性能良好，热加工性能佳，价格便宜，广泛用作650?750°C以下使用的不同类型航空发动机和燃气轮机的涡轮盘或火焰筒等零部件，此外，民用工业部门也有较多应用。
explanation_en: Generally, at least 25% Ni should be added to stabilize the T-austenite, and 15% Cr should be added to ensure that the alloy has sufficient oxidation resistance and corrosion capacity. Therefore, the iron base high temperature alloy actually uses the FHMi-O ternary system as the matrix. When the nickel content is greater than 40%, it is generally called iron nickel base or nickel iron base high temperature alloy. Iron-base superalloy are solution strengthened with Mo or Mo+W as the solution strengthening element, and these alloy are solution strengthened Fe base alloy. In addition, some trace beneficial elements are added to some alloy to strengthen the grain boundary. If the content of alloy elements is low, the profile or part blank can be deformed by hot working, which belongs to iron-base wrought superalloy. Otherwise, it belongs to iron-base cast superalloy. Iron-base superalloy is widely used as 650? Components such as turbine discs or flame tubes of different types of aviation engines and gas turbines used below 750 ° C are also widely used in civil industrial sectors.

explanation_cn: 某些电介质材料在一定温度范围内，应力与应变的关系曲线呈现与铁磁体的磁滞回线及铁电体的电滞回线相似特征的现象。许多铁电性材料也有铁弹性。与铁电体有铁电畴一样，铁弹体也有铁弹畴（ferroelasticdomain);在外力作用下，铁弹畴取向变化导致应力与应变的回线关系。
explanation_en: In certain temperature range of some dielectric materials, the relationship curve between stress and strain presents a phenomenon similar to the hysteresis loop of ferromagnets and the hysteresis loop of ferroelectric body. Many ferroelectricity materials also have ferroelasicity. Just as ferroelectric body have ferroelectric domain, iron elastomers also have iron elastic domains; Under the action of external force, the orientation change of iron elastic domain leads to the loop relationship between stress and strain.

explanation_cn: 由顺弹体变为铁弹体的相变。多数为二级相变。铁弹体是指在没有外力作用的情况下，晶体内存在着自发的应变区，应变区的应力张量具有一定的取向，取向相同的区域称为铁弹畴，含有两种或多种类型的自发应变区的晶体称为铁弹体。加热升温.铁弹体的自发应变逐渐消失，在某临界温度转变为顺弹体。顺弹体冷却低于此临界点，发生晶体对称性降低的相变，随此相变在结构上产生一定规律的畸变区，即在一定范围内造成一定取向的应变区。对这种具有自发应变的晶体施加外力时，取向畴可由一种状态变为另一种状态，应力反向达到某一数值时应变也反向.其应力应变关系曲线与电滞回线类似。
explanation_en: Phase transformation from a cis elastomer to a iron elastomer. Most of them are second-order transformation. Iron elastomers refer to crystal in which there is a spontaneous strain zone without external force. The stress tensor in the strain zone has a certain orientation. Areas with the same orientation are called iron elastodomains. crystal containing two or more types of spontaneous strain zones are called iron elastomers. When heated, the spontaneous strain of iron projectile gradually disappears and transformation into a cis elastomer at a critical temperature. When the cooling of the cis elastic body is lower than this critical point, the phase transformation with reduced symmetry of the crystal occurs. With this phase transformation, there is a regular distortion zone in the structure, that is, a strain zone with a certain orientation within a certain range. When an external force is applied to this crystal with spontaneous strain, the orientation domain can change from one state to another, and the strain is also reversed when the stress reverse reaches a certain value. The stress-strain curve is similar to the hysteresis loop.

explanation_cn: 具有铁弹效应的陶瓷。更确切的表述方法应是铁弹体或铁弹材料。所谓铁弹效应是指在外力作用下，材料的应力与应变之间的关系呈现类似于磁滞回线那样的滞后曲线现象。利用钼酸的铁电铁弹反转特性及其折射率，可以制备电光器件，如激光快门，色相调制元件等，陶瓷在高温相变时也具有铁弹效应，利用这种类们形状记忆特性，可用于相变增韧陶瓷。
explanation_en: Ceramics with ferroelastic effect. The more accurate expression method should be iron bullet body or iron bullet materials. The so-called ferroelastic effect refers to the hysteresis curve phenomenon that the relationship between the stress and strain of materials presents similar to the magnetic hysteresis under the external force. The ferroelectric ferroelastic inversion characteristics of molybdic acid and its refractive index can be used to prepare electro-optic devices, such as laser shutter, color modulation elements, etc. ceramics also have ferroelastic effect during high-temperature phase transformation. This kind of shape memory characteristics can be used for phase transformation toughening of ceramics.

explanation_cn: 又称铁淦氧，元素与氧化合形成的各种类型的化合物。有氯化钠型、尖晶石型、磁铁铅矿型、石榴石型等不同的结构类型，从而表现出不i同的磁有序，磁晶各向异性等磁性能以及高频特性。铁氧体的制备主要采取粉末冶金烧结的工艺。现广泛应用于永久磁体、高频铁芯、矩形磁回线铁芯材料等许多方面。其特点是价格低廉.加工工艺简单，应用面广泛。
explanation_en: Also known as iron oxide, various types of compounds formed by the combination of elements and oxidation. There are different structure types, such as sodium chloride type, spinel type, magnetite type, garnet type, etc., which show different magnetic order, magnetocrystalline anisotropy and other magnetic properties as well as high-frequency characteristics. The preparation of ferrite mainly adopts powder metallurgy sintering process. Now it is widely used in many aspects, such as permanent magnet, high-frequency core, rectangular magnetic loop core materials, etc. Its characteristics are low price, simple processing technology, and wide application range.

explanation_cn: 铁氧体是由铁和其他一种或多种金属组成的复合氧化物。如尖晶石型铁氧体的化学式为MeFe2Q4或Mrf.)?Fe2ü:1，其中Me是离子半径与二价铁离子（Fed)相近的二价金属离子（如Mn2+.、Zn2+、Cu21-、Ni2+、Mg2-、Co2+等）或平均化学价为二价的多种金属离子组。永磁铁氧体主要有钡铁氧体和锶铁氧体两者具有氧化铅铁氧体型六角晶体结构，其易磁化角为C轴。它们的磁性能相差不多，而后者的矫顽力略高于钡铁氧体。钡铁氧体永磁材料的最大磁能积的理论值为45.4kJ/m、锶铁氧体永磁材料为42.2kJ/m3。电阻率高，属于半导体类型.故涡流损耗小.矫顽力大，能有效地应用在大气隙的磁路中.特别适于作小型发电机和电动机的永磁体。它不含有贵金属镍、钴等，原材料来源丰富，工艺不复杂，成本低，可代替铝镍钴永磁体。最大磁能积（SH)m较低，因此在相等磁能的情况下，比金属磁体体积大。温度稳定性差，质地较脆、易碎，不耐冲击振动.不宜作测量仪表及有精密要求的磁性器件。永磁铁氧体可用于制作永磁点火电机、永磁电机、永磁选矿机、永磁吊头、磁推轴承、磁分离器、扬声器、微波器件、磁疗片、助听器等》
explanation_en: Iron is a composite oxide composed of iron and one or more other metals. For example, the chemical formula of spinel type ferrite is MeFe2Q4 or Mrf.)? Fe2 ü: 1, where Me is a divalent metal ion (such as Mn2+., Zn2+, Cu21-, Ni2+, Mg2-, Co2+, etc.) with a ionic radius similar to that of divalent iron ion (Fed) or a group of multiple metal ions with an average chemical valence of divalent. Permanent magnetic ferrite mainly includes barium ferrite and strontium ferrite, both of which have lead oxide ferrite hexagonal crystal structure, and their easy magnetization angle is C-axis. Their magnetic properties are similar, and the coercivity of the latter is slightly higher than that of Ba ferrite. The theoretical value of the maximum magnetic energy product of barium ferrite permanent magnetic material is 45.4kJ/m, and that of strontium ferrite permanent magnetic material is 42.2kJ/m3. Resistivity is high and belongs to semiconductor type, so eddy current loss is small and coercive force is large, which can be effectively used in the magnetic circuit of the air gap, especially suitable for the permanent magnet of small generators and motors. It does not contain precious metals, such as nickel and cobalt. It has abundant raw materials, uncomplicated process and low cost, and can replace aluminum nickel cobalt permanent magnets. The maximum magnetic energy product (SH) m is low, so it is larger than the metal magnet when the magnetic energy is equal. Poor temperature stability, brittle and fragile texture, not resistant to impact and vibration. Not suitable for use as measuring instruments or magnetic devices with precision requirements. Permanent magnetic ferrite can be used to make permanent magnet ignition motors, permanent magnet motors, permanent magnet separators, permanent magnet hanging heads, magnetic thrust bearings, magnetic separators, loudspeakers, microwave devices, magnetic therapy films, hearing aids, etc

explanation_cn: 主要包括钡铁氧体和锶铁氧体。它电阻率高，属于半导体类型，故涡流损耗小，矫顽力大.能有效地应用在大气隙的磁路中，特别适于作小型发电机和电动机的永磁体。它不含有贵金属镍、钴等，原材料来源丰富，工艺不复杂，成本低，可代替铝镍钻永磁体。它的最大磁能积（B+H)m较低，因此在相等磁能的情况下，比金属磁体体积大。它的温度稳定性差，质地较脆、易碎，不耐冲击震动，不宜作测量仪表及有精密要求的磁性器件。永磁铁氧体产品主要为各向异性系列。它们可用于制作永磁点火电机、永磁电机、永磁选矿机、永磁吊头、磁推轴承、磁分离器、扬声器、微波器件、磁疗片、助听器等。
explanation_en: It mainly includes barium ferrite and strontium ferrite. It has high resistivity and belongs to the semiconductor type, so it has small eddy current loss and large coercive force. It can be effectively applied in the magnetic circuit of the air gap, especially suitable for the permanent magnet of small generators and motors. It does not contain precious metals, such as nickel and cobalt. It has abundant raw materials, uncomplicated process and low cost, and can replace the aluminum nickel drill permanent magnet. Its maximum magnetic energy product (B+H) m is low, so it is larger than the metal magnet when the magnetic energy is equal. It has poor temperature stability, brittle and fragile texture, and is not resistant to impact and vibration. It is not suitable for measuring instruments and magnetic devices with precision requirements. Permanent magnetic ferrite products are mainly anisotropic series. They can be used to make permanent magnet ignition motors, permanent magnet motors, permanent magnet ore separators, permanent magnet suspension heads, magnetic thrust bearings, magnetic separators, loudspeakers, microwave devices, magnetic therapy films, hearing aids, etc.

explanation_cn: 铁氧体是铁和其他一种或多种适当的金属元素的复合氧化物。其磁性属于亚铁磁性，来源于被氧离子所分隔的磁性金属离子间的超交换作用，它使处于不同晶格位置上的金属离子磁矩反向排列.当相反排列的磁矩不相等时，表现出强磁性。因此，铁氧体的基本特性与晶体结构、化学键及离子云分布密切相关。铁氧体的晶体结构有三大类型：尖晶石型、磁铅石型和石榴型。其中软磁材料的尖晶石型、磁铅石型主要用作永磁材料，而石榴石型则大量用作旋磁材料。
explanation_en: Iron is a composite oxide of iron and one or more other appropriate metal elements. Its magnetism belongs to ferrimagnetism, which originates from the super exchange between magnetic metal ions separated by oxygen ions. It makes the magnetic moment of metal ions at different lattice positions reverse. When the magnetic moment of opposite arrangements are not equal, it shows strong magnetism. Therefore, the basic characteristics of ferrite are closely related to crystal structure, chemical bond and ion cloud distribution. There are three types of crystal structure of ferrite: spinel type, magnetite type and garnet type. Among them, spinel type and magnetite lead type of soft magnetic materials are mainly used as permanent magnet material, while garnet type is largely used as gyromagnetic material.

explanation_cn: 铁水装人炼钢炉前先去除某些有害杂质元素（如硫、磷等）或提取某些冇用成分（如钒、铌、钛、铬等）的处理过程。进行铁水预处理脱硅、脱硫、脱磷的目的是减轻转炉冶炼负担，提高炼钢生产率，冶炼低硫低磷钢甚至超纯净钢。而铁水中含有的有用金属元素可根据选择性氧化原理使之氧化富集于渣中，然后再进一步提炼成金属
explanation_en: The process of removing some harmful impurity elements (such as sulfur, phosphorus, etc.) or extracting some useless components (such as vanadium, niobium, titanium, chromium, etc.) before molten iron is loaded into the steelmaking furnace. The purpose of desilication, desulfurization and dephosphorization of hot metal pretreatment is to reduce the smelting burden of converter, improve steelmaking productivity, and smelting low sulfur and low phosphorus steel and even ultra pure steel. The useful metal elements contained in molten iron can be oxidized and enriched in slag according to the principle of preferential oxidation, and then further refined into metals

explanation_cn: 通常用来描述或指代赤铁矿的一种特定外观。赤铁矿是一种铁矿石，其化学式为Fe2O3，通常呈深红色到黑色。在某些情况下，赤铁矿晶体可以生长出独特的形状，类似于玫瑰花瓣的排列，因此被称为 "铁玫瑰"。
explanation_en: Usually used to describe or refer to a specific appearance of hematite. Hematite is a kind of iron ore, its chemical formula is Fe2O3, and it is usually dark red to black. In some cases, hematite crystal can grow into a unique shape, similar to the arrangement of rose petals, so it is called "ferrirose".

explanation_cn: 兼有铁电材料的高介电常数ε和铁磁材料的高磁导率μ，是一种理想的多功能电子材料，但制备条件却十分苛刻，目前--种探索途径是将同结构的铁氧体和铁磁体制成复合化合物
