At present, one of the ways to explore is to make composition compounds from ferrite and iron with the same structure

explanation_cn: 是某些晶体在一定的温度范围内具有自发极化，而且其自发极化方向可以因外电场方向的反向而反向，晶体的这种性质称为铁电性，具有铁电性的晶体称为铁电体。
explanation_en: Some crystal have spontaneous polarization within a certain temperature range, and their spontaneous polarization direction can be reversed due to the reverse direction of the external electric field. This property of crystal is called ferroelectricity, and crystal with ferroelectricity are called ferroelectric body.

explanation_cn: 一些属于铁电体的电光晶体，具体如下：BaTiO3晶体：钙钛矿结构，熔点1618°C。在温度低于120°C时，它具有铁电性。电光系数r13 = 802X10-12 m/V，r42 = 1640X10-12 m/V。它在可见光波长范围内具有很高的光折变灵敏度，为7X10-6 cm^2/J。虽然衍射效率高，但响应时间较慢，对于中等功率的激光（1W/cm2），响应时间在0.5秒数量级。该晶体只能在低于146°C的温度下生长，以确保单晶具有铁电性。通常使用顶部籽晶法来获得大块BaTiO3晶体毛坯。Fe:KNbO3晶体：具有优良的光折变性能，响应时间小于10毫秒。其灵敏波段为可见光波长。Sr0.5Ba0.5Nb2O6 (SBN)晶体：属于钨青铜矿型结构，是SBN系统的固溶体晶体，其中x = 0.5, 0.6和0.75，x = 0.6是该固溶体系统中唯一一种一致熔融的组分。可以通过引上法轻松制备大块晶体。其电光系数r33 = 420X10-12 m/V，响应时间约为1000毫秒，光折变灵敏度为3.2X10-8 cm^2/J。LiNbO3晶体：具有类似钛铁矿型结构，属于三方晶系。是最早发现具有光折变效应的材料之一。其电光系数为31X10-12 m/V，响应时间在秒数量级。它适用于光学放大器、相位共轭器和存储器等应用。
explanation_en: Some electro-optic crystal belonging to ferroelectric body are as follows: BaTiO3 crystal: perovskite structure, melting point 1618 ° C. It is ferroelectricity at temperatures below 120 ° C. The electro-optic coefficient r13=802X10-12 m/V, r42=1640X10-12 m/V. It has high photorefractive sensitivity within the visible light wavelength range, ranging from 7X10-6 cm ^ 2/J. Although the diffraction efficiency is high, the response time is slow. For medium power lasers (1W/cm2), the response time is in the order of 0.5 seconds. The crystal can only grow at a temperature lower than 146 ° C to ensure that the single crystal has ferroelectricity. The top seed method is usually used to obtain large BaTiO3 crystal blanks. Fe: KNbO3 crystal: It has excellent photorefractive properties, and the response time is less than 10 ms. Its sensitive wavelength is visible light wavelength. Sr0.5Ba0.5Nb2O6 (SBN) crystal: it belongs to tungsten bronze ore type structure, and is the solid solution crystal of SBN system, where x=0.5, 0.6 and 0.75, and x=0.6 is the only component with uniform melting in the solid solution system. Bulk crystal can be easily prepared by the pull-up method. Its electro-optic coefficient r33=420X10-12 m/V, response time is about 1000 milliseconds, and photorefractive sensitivity is 3.2X10-8 cm ^ 2/J. LiNbO3 crystal: It has a ilmenite like structure and belongs to the trigonal crystal system. It is one of the earliest materials with photorefractive effect. Its electro-optic coefficient is 31X10-12 m/V, and the response time is in the order of seconds. It is suitable for applications such as optical amplifiers, phase conjugators, and memories.

explanation_cn: 一些电介质晶体在外电场作用下.晶体出现自发极化的现象叫铁电性.这是由于晶体结构使正负电荷重心不重合，产生电偶极矩引起的。自发极化随外电场取向，极化强度与电场之间的关系呈现类似于磁滞回线那样的滞后曲线。具有铁电性的物体称铁电体；它具有电滞回线和居里点.在居里点以上服从居里-外斯定律，具有铁电畴等。铁电性材料种类有单晶、多晶、无机和有机等。钛酸钡、钛酸铅、铌酸钾等是典型的铁电体。铁电体在压电、介电、热释电和电致伸缩等方面有许多应用。
explanation_en: The spontaneous polarization of some dielectric crystal under the action of external electric field is called ferroelectricity. This is caused by the electric dipole moment produced by the crystal structure, which makes the gravity centers of positive and negative charges not coincide. The relationship between spontaneous polarization and electric field presents a hysteresis curve similar to that of magnetic hysteresis with orientation of external electric field, polarization and electric field. Objects with ferroelectricity are called ferroelectric body; It has a hysteresis loop and a curie point. Above the curie point, it obeys the Curie Weiss law and has ferroelectric domain. Ferroelectricity materials include single crystal, polycrystal, inorganic and organic materials. Barium titanate, lead titanate and potassium niobate are typical ferroelectric body. Ferroelectric body have many applications in piezoelectric, dielectric, pyroelectric and electrostrictive fields.

explanation_cn: 铁电材料是指在某一温度范围内，具有自发极化，并且自发极化方向能够被外电场所改变的一类晶体材料，又称为铁电体。在没有外电场的作用时，晶体中存在的自发极化，其方向相同的小区域称为电畴，电畴与电畴之间的交界称为畴壁。铁电体由于电偶极子的自发极化和电畴的存在，其极化强度P的变化滞后于外加电场E的变化，即具有电滞回线。铁电体随温度的变化可以由铁电相转变为顺电相，其相变温度称为居里温度（Tc）。当温度T大于居里温度Tc时，铁电现象消失，变为顺电相，极化强度P和外加电场E成线性关系。当温度T小于居里温度Tc时，为铁电相，极化强度P和外加电场E成滞后关系。铁电体具有介电反常现象，在居里温度Tc附近，随温度的升高，介电常数可迅速增大4-5个数量级。常见的铁电材料主要有两类：一类是以磷酸二氢钾（KH2PO4）为代表的含有氢键的水溶性软铁电体，其中顺电相到铁电相的转变是无序到有序的相变；另一类是以钛酸钡（BaTiO3）为代表的钙钛矿结构硬铁电体，其自发极化是由于正离子的子晶格与负离子的子晶格发生相对位移而引起的。
explanation_en: Ferroelectric materials is a kind of crystalline materials with spontaneous polarization in a certain temperature range, and the direction of spontaneous polarization can be changed by an external electric field, also known as ferroelectric body. When there is no external electric field, the spontaneous polarization exists in crystal. The small areas with the same direction are called domains, and the junction between domains is called domain walls. Because of the spontaneous polarization of the electric dipole and the existence of the electric domain, the change of the polarization strength P of ferroelectric body lags behind the change of the applied electric field E, that is, it has an electric hysteresis loop. Ferroelectric body can change from phase of ferroelectrics to paraelectric phase with temperature, and its phase transformation temperature is called Curie temperature (Tc). When the temperature T is greater than the Curie temperature Tc, the ferroelectric phenomenon disappears and becomes a paraelectric phase. The polarization strength P is linear with the applied electric field E. When the temperature T is less than the Curie temperature Tc, it is a ferroelectric phase, and the polarization strength P has a hysteresis relationship with the applied electric field E. Ferroelectric body have dielectric anomalies. Near the Curie temperature Tc, the dielectric constant can rapidly increase by 4-5 orders of magnitude with the increase of temperature. There are two main types of common ferroelectric materials: one is water-soluble soft iron electrics with hydrogen bond, represented by potassium dihydrogen phosphate (KH2PO4), in which the transformation from paraelectric phase to ferroelectric phase is from disorder to order; The other type is hard ferroelectrics with perovskite structure represented by barium titanate (BaTiO3), whose spontaneous polarization is caused by the relative displacement between the positive ion sublattice and the negative ion sublattice.

explanation_cn: 分子在排列的有序程度上和晶体相近的液晶，称为近晶型液品.又称作近晶相液晶。铁电液晶是近晶相的一种形态，其分子对近晶层的法线夹角不为零，且含有非外消旋的不对称碳原子，同时其分子偶极矩特別是垂直于分子长轴的偶极矩分量不为零。铁电液晶手性部分表现出很大的介电常数（>150),具有和铁电晶体类似的自发极化和电滞回线。铁电性液晶在电场施加时，其响应时间与铁电性液晶的发极化成反比，与黏性系数成正比。反铁电液晶是在电场的驱动下，由反铁电性液晶转换成铁电性液晶的一种物理现象。并与非对称性点在低分子液晶的AFLC中，核心构造的苯环和共轭之苯基结合碳原子邻接者?在非对称性中心将CH:,基结合的状况，要比将CF.(基结合来的有稳定的反铁电性，另外在高分子液晶的AFLC中核心构造的部分连接奇数的碳碳链.也可以获得反铁电性的配列。
explanation_en: Liquid crystals whose molecules are arranged in a similar order to crystal are called smectic liquid products, also called smectic liquid crystal. Ferroelectric liquid crystal is a form of the smectic phase. The normal angle of its molecule to the smectic layer is not zero, and it contains non racemic asymmetric carbon atoms. At the same time, its molecular dipole moment, especially the component perpendicular to the molecular long axis, is not zero. The chiral part of ferroelectric liquid crystal shows a large dielectric constant (>150), with spontaneous polarization and hysteresis loops similar to those of ferroelectric crystals. When the electric field is applied to ferroelectricity liquid crystal, its response time is inversely proportional to the polarization of ferroelectricity liquid crystal, and is proportional to the viscosity coefficient. Anti ferroelectric liquid crystal is a kind of physical phenomenon that amiferroelectricity liquid crystal transforms into ferroelectricity liquid crystal under the driving of electric field. And with asymmetric points in the AFLC of low molecular liquid crystals, the core structure of the benzene ring is adjacent to the conjugated phenyl bound carbon atom? The condition of combining CH: with the base at the center of asymmetry is better than that of combining CF (The base combination has stable amiferroelectricity. In addition, in the AFLC of macromolecule liquid crystal, the core structure is connected with odd carbon chains, which can also obtain amiferroelectricity alignment.

explanation_cn: 具有永久偶极矩，在外电场作用下，偶极矩可反转的高分子，突出特点是具有液晶显示功能.包括主链型和侧链型铁电液晶高分子。
explanation_en: The macromolecule with permanent dipole moment and reversible dipole moment under external electric field is characterized by liquid crystal display function, including main chain type and ferroelectric liquid crystal polymer in side chain.

explanation_cn: 铁电体中自发极化方向相同的微小区域。互成反平行排列者称180°电畴；首尾相接，互成90°排列者称90°电畴。180°电畴畴壁的壁厚约几个单胞，90°畴壁较180°畴壁厚。电畴类型与晶体对称性有关。例如钛酸钡晶体，当处于四方晶时，有90°和180°畴；处于正交相时，有60°，120°，90°和180°电畴；处于三方相时有71°，109°和180°电畴。铁电晶体通常是多畴的，以对应于较低的能量状态。通常可以用透射电子显微镜、光学显微镜、覆膜法、化学腐蚀法、热腐蚀法等来观察电畴。在电场作用下，畴壁可以移动。与电场方向基本一致的电畴通过针状新畴向前生长，最后趋向电场方向。电畴是与自发极化相联系的，因此它存在于居里点以下的温度范围内。当温度高于居里点时.电畴消失。透明铁电陶瓷的电畴具有"电控特性"，即可由电场控制电畴的取向状态；而电畴的取向又引起材料光学i性质的改变，利用材料这一特点可以制成光开关和光存储器件。
explanation_en: Small areas in ferroelectric body with the same direction of spontaneous polarization. Those arranged in an antiparallel manner are called 180 ° domains; A 90 ° electric domain is one that is arranged 90 ° from end to end. The wall thickness of the 180 ° domain wall is about a few units, and the 90 ° domain wall is thicker than the 180 ° domain wall. The type of domain is related to the symmetry of crystal. For example, barium titanate crystal has 90 ° and 180 ° domains when it is in tetragonal crystal; In the orthogonal phase, there are 60 °, 120 °, 90 ° and 180 ° domains; There are 71 °, 109 ° and 180 ° domains in the tripartite phase. Ferroelectric crystals are usually multi domain, corresponding to lower energy states. The domain can usually be observed by transmission electron microscope, optical microscope, coating method, chemical corrosion method, thermal corrosion method, etc. Under the action of an electric field, domain walls can move. Electric domains that are basically consistent with the direction of the electric field grow forward through needle like new domains and eventually tend towards the direction of the electric field. The domain is related to spontaneous polarization, so it exists in the temperature range below the curie point. When the temperature is higher than the curie point, the domain disappears. The domain of transparent ferroelectric ceramics has "electric control characteristics", that is, the orientation state of the domain is controlled by the electric field; However, the orientation of the electric domain changes the optical i properties of materials, which can be used to make optical switches and optical memory devices.

explanation_cn: 铁电体在冷却或加热过程中通过其居里点时发生的结构相变。在无外电场的作用下呈现电极化，变化外电场可使其极化向量逆转的材料称为铁电体。铁电相变是软模相变，原子发生自发位移后造成的结构状态（铁电相），为非铁电相（母相）中一种振动模式，在居里点处，这种振动模式的频率变得反常的低或趋于零，铁电相i便取代了非铁电相。
explanation_en: The structural transformation that occurs when ferroelectric body pass through their curie point during cooling or heating. The materials that shows polarization under the action of no external electric field and whose polarization vector can be reversed by changing the external electric field is called ferroelectric body. Ferroelectric phase transformation is a soft mode phase transformation. The structural state (ferroelectric phase) caused by the spontaneous displacement of atoms is a vibration mode in the non ferroelectric phase (parent phase). At the curie point, the frequency of this vibration mode becomes abnormally low or tends to zero, and the ferroelectric phase i replaces the non iron phase.

explanation_cn: 一类具有铁电性、介电性、压电性、热释电性以及电光效应、声光效应、光折变效应和非线性光学效应的厚度在数十纳米到几微米的薄膜材料。其应用广泛，可制作不同的功能器件或者机敏器件。
explanation_en: A kind of thin film materials with thickness of tens of nanometers to several microns, which has ferroelectricity, dielectric, piezoelectricity, pyroelectricity, electrophoto effect, acousto-optic effect, photorefractive effect and nonlinear optical effect. It has a wide range of applications and can be used to make different functional devices or smart devices.

explanation_cn: 具有铁电性的陶瓷。所谓铁电性是指材料在一定温度范围内具有自发极化，而且自发极化能随外电场取向的特性。BaTi03,PbTiC)3,SrTi()3等是典型的铁电陶瓷。此外有钨青铜型、含铋层状化合物、烧绿石型及铌酸锶型铁电陶瓷。利用铁电陶瓷的高介电常数可制作大容量的陶瓷电容器；利用其压电性可制作各种压电器件；利用其热释电性可制作红外探测器。通过适当工艺制成的透明铁电陶瓷具有电控光特性，利用它可制作存储、显示或开关用的电光器件。适当掺杂制成的铁电半导体陶瓷，可用于敏感元件，利用铁电陶瓷的介电常数随外电场呈非线性$化的特性可制作介质放大器和移相器等。通过物理或化学方法制备的PZT、PLZT等铁电陶瓷薄膜，在电光器件、非挥发性铁电存储器件等中有重要用途。
explanation_en: Ceramics with ferroelectricity. The so-called ferroelectricity means that materials have spontaneous polarization within a certain temperature range, and spontaneous polarization can be orientation with the external electric field. BaTi03, PbTiC) 3, SrTi() 3, etc. are typical ferroelectric ceramics. In addition, there are tungsten bronze type, bismuth containing layered compound, pyrochlore type and strontium niobate type ferroelectric ceramics. The high dielectric constant of ferroelectric ceramics can be used to make large capacity ceramics capacitors; Using its piezoelectricity, various piezoelectric devices can be made; Infrared detectors can be made using their pyroelectric properties. Transparent ferroelectric ceramics made by proper process have electric control optical characteristics, and can be used to make electro-optical devices for storage, display or switch. Properly doped ferroelectric semiconductive ceramics can be used for sensing elements. Using the dielectric constant of ferroelectric ceramics to be non-linear with the external electric field, dielectric amplifiers and phase shifters can be made. PZT, PLZT and other ferroelectric ceramics films prepared by physical or chemical methods have important applications in electro-optic devices, nonvolatile ferroelectric memory devices, etc.

explanation_en: Ferroalloy is added based on copper nickel alloy. The water solubility of iron in white copper is very small. At 300 ° C, a small amount of iron can improve the mechanical properties and corrosion resistance of copper nickel alloy, especially the corrosion resistance of impact corrosion under the action of seawater. Generally, the addition of iron shall not exceed 2%. Common iron white copper includes Cu-5Ni-lFe, Cu-30Ni-lFe, etc. The tensile strength of alloy in soft state is 255? 373MPa. Elongation 42%? 23%. Iron white copper has excellent corrosion resistance and medium strength, good elasticity, and is easy to cold and hot pressure processing. It is mainly used for condenser tubes, evaporators, heat exchangers, and various high-strength corrosion resistant parts.

explanation_cn: 在广义上是指那些可以形成永磁体或者能被磁体吸引的一类材料所具有的性质。表现出铁磁性的材料主要是铁、镍、钴以及含有这些元素的很大一部分合金。某些包含稀土元素的化合物和若干自然形成的矿物.例如天然磁石，也具有铁磁性。材料的磁性产生于其中离子磁矩的有序化排列。铁磁性材料是指在其中所有的离子磁矩都沿着同一方向排列?从而使得每个离子磁矩对材料宏观磁性的贡献都为正的物质。物质的磁性是一种量子力学现象，其本质是由于组成物质的元素中电子自旋行为和电子所须遵循的泡利不相容原理。由于自旋运动，每个电子都带有一个磁偶极矩，其行为类似一个微小的磁体。电子的自旋方向分为"向上"和"向下"两种类型。当自旋方向相反的电子配对在一起时，它们的磁偶极矩相互抵消因而对材料宏观磁性的贡献为零。当材料中存在大量同向自旋未配对电子时，这些电子磁偶极矩的磁场相互叠加增强使材料表现出可宏观测量的磁性。因此，铁磁性只能在一些含有部分填充电子壳层元素的材料中产生。近年来，人们在某些掺杂半导体氧化物材料中发现了因其中电子自旋规律性排列引起的周期性长程磁相互作用现象，这些新型材料被称为自旋电子材料（spintronicmaterials〉。材料的磁性是环境温度的函数。当温度升高到使材料中同向自旋电子排列遭到破坏的程度时，材料内部会发生二级相变使其磁性消失。该临界温度被称为居里温度(Curietemperature)0
explanation_en: In a broad sense, it refers to the properties of materials that can form permanent magnets or can be attracted by magnets. The materials showing ferromagnetism are mainly iron, nickel, cobalt and a large part of alloy containing these elements. Some compounds containing rare earth elements and some naturally formed minerals, such as natural magnets, also have ferromagnetism. The magnetism of materials results from the ordered arrangement of ion magnetic moment. Ferromagnetism materials means that all the magnetic moment of ions in it are arranged in the same direction? Thus, the contribution of each ion magnetic moment to the materials's macro magnetism is positive. The magnetism of matter is a quantum mechanical phenomenon, which is essentially due to the spin behavior of electrons in the constituent elements of matter and the Pauli exclusion principle that electrons must follow. Due to spin motion, each electron carries a magnetic dipole moment, which behaves like a tiny magnet. The spin direction of electrons can be divided into two types: "up" and "down". When the electrons with opposite spin directions are paired together, their magnetic dipole moments cancel each other and their contributions to the macro magnetism of materials are zero. When there are a large number of unpaired electrons with the same spin in the materials, the magnetic field of the magnetic dipole moments of these electrons are mutually superposed and strengthened, so that the materials shows the magnetic properties that can be measured macroscopically. Therefore, ferromagnetism can only be produced in some materials containing partially filled electron shell elements. In recent years, periodic long-range magnetic interactions caused by the regular arrangement of electron spins in some doped semiconductor semiconductor oxide materials have been found, These advanced materials are called spin electronic materials. The magnetism of materials is a function of the ambient temperature. When the temperature rises to the extent that the aligned spin electron arrangement in materials is destroyed, second-order transformation will occur in materials to make their magnetism disappear. This critical temperature is called Curie temperature 0

explanation_cn: 使用态组织为铁素体加部分珠光体的低碳钢.大部分工程结构钢均属于铁素体珠光体钢，其强度较低,随钢中碳含量或珠光体体积分数的减小而降低。铁素体-珠光体钢的使用态组织为平衡组织.故具有良好的韧性和焊接性。为提高铁素体-珠光体钢的强度，广泛采用细晶或超细晶控制轧制技术产生细晶强化以及添加适量微合金元素产生微合金碳氮化物的沉淀强化作用。为进一步提高铁素体-珠光体钢的靭性和焊接性，降低碳含量乃至珠光体分数是重要的发展方向.由此发展出低珠光体钢和无珠光体钢。
explanation_en: As used low-cardon steel with ferrite and partial pearlite structure. Most engineering structural steel belong to ferritic pearlite steel with low strength, which decreases with the decrease of carbon content or pearlite volume fraction in steel. The as used structure of ferrite-pearlite steel is a balanced structure, so it has good toughness and weldability. In order to improve the strength of ferrite-pearlite steel, fine-grained or ultra-fine grained controlled rolling technology is widely used to produce fine-grained strengthening and adding appropriate microalloying elements to produce microalloyed carbonitride precipitation strengthening. In order to further improve the toughness and weldability of ferrite-pearlite steel, it is an important development direction to reduce the carbon content and even the pearlite fraction, thus developing low pearlitic steel and non pearlitic steel.

explanation_cn: 铬含量较髙（含Crl2%-30%)、基体组织为单相铁素体组织的耐热钢。为提高高温抗氧化性能，可加人少量硅、铝和稀土元素。该类钢不存在基体的固态多型性相变，热导率较大而热膨胀系数较小，表面氧化皮不易剥离.故具有优异的高温抗氧化性；但无法通过热处理使之强化.故高温强度不如奥氏体耐热钢和马氏体耐热钢.此外，其焊接性能较差，室温脆性较大。一般的铁素体耐热钢多用于制造高温工作时需承受载荷较低但要求很高耐氧化性的工件（即主要作为抗氧化钢使用）。
explanation_en: Heat resistant steel with high chromium content (containing Crl2% -30%) and single-phase ferrite matrix. To improve high-temperature oxidation resistance, small amounts of silicon, aluminum, and rare earth elements can be added. This kind of steel does not have the solid polytype phase transformation of matrix, the thermal conductivity is large, the coefficient of thermal expansion is small, and the surface oxide skin is not easy to peel off, so it has excellent high-temperature oxidation resistance; However, it cannot be strengthened by heat treatment, so its high temperature strength is inferior to that of austenitic heat-resistant steel and martensitic heat resistant steel. In addition, its weld performance is poor, and its room temperature brittleness is large. General ferritic heat-resistant steel is mostly used to manufacture workpieces that need to bear low load but require high oxidation resistance when working at high temperature (that is, it is mainly used as oxidation resistant steel).

explanation_cn: 又称红结晶釉，结晶油品种之一。结晶形成大小不一的圆形花朵，由熔融物料经多次偏析而形成的橙红色Fe203晶体组成，在长石釉或钡釉配方中加人Fe203(约15%〉及含磷原料(如牛骨约15%),生坯施袖，高温烧成。铁红釉是一种实用价值很高的艺术釉，尤其是用于装饰墙地砖和曰用陶瓷丨:艺品，艺术效果更佳。

The crystals form round flowers of different sizes, which are composed of orange red Fe203 crystal formed by melting materials through multiple segregation. Fe203 (about 15%) and phosphorus containing materials (such as cow bone, about 15%) are added to the feldspathic glaze or barium glaze formula, and green compact is sleeved and fired at high temperature. Iron red glaze is a kind of artistic glaze with high practical value, especially for decoration of wall and floor tiles and Japanese ceramics.

explanation_cn: 一般是指铁路钢桥制造和维护用的涂料。钢铁桥梁在大气中经常遭受冷热循环、千湿交替的作用，以及水分、空气、风沙、灰尘、燃料、烟道气、盐类等物质的侵蚀而引起生锈。桥梁涂料应具有在金属表面附着力好.能抵抗大气中各种腐蚀介质的作用。它由多层底漆、面漆等涂料复合而成。桥梁使用的底漆品种很多，对底漆的要求是：①对金属有良好的附着力，对面漆有良好的结合力；②底漆所用的防锈颜料必须阻止金属的腐蚀;③具有很小的渗水性；④有良好的机械性.能承受钢铁的热胀冷缩、振动等作用而不脆不裂。桥梁面漆的作用除了装饰作用外.主要是保护防锈底漆不直接受到大气中各种介质的作用，使它与金属更好地附着，起到防锈作用。这就要求面漆具有：①与底漆结合力良好；②耐日光、紫外线照射.不易粉化和开裂；③对水汽和各种气体渗透性小：④耐酸、碱、盐等化学介质的腐蚀；⑤有良好的力学性能。桥梁常用的底漆有红丹防锈漆（酚醛型、醇酸型及环氧型等）、富锌底漆（有机及无机）。常用的面漆有各色醇酸磁漆、有机硅改性醇酸磁漆、氯化橡胶、丙烯酸改性醇酸漆。
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to coatings used for manufacturing and maintenance of railway steel bridges. Steel bridges are often subjected to the effects of cold and hot cycles, alternating humidity, and erosion by substances such as water, air, sandstorms, dust, fuel, flue gas, and salts in the atmosphere, leading to rusting. The bridge coatings shall have good adhesion on the metal surface and be able to resist various corrosion media in the atmosphere. It is composition by coatings such as multi-layer primer and top coating. There are many kinds of primer used for bridges. The requirements for primer are: ① good adhesion to metal and good adhesion to surface paint; ② The anticorrosive pigment used for primer must prevent corrosion of metal; ③ Has very low water permeability; ④ It has good mechanical properties and can withstand the thermal expansion, contraction, vibration and other effects of steel without brittleness or cracking. In addition to the decorative function, the role of the bridge top coating is mainly to protect the anti rust primer from being directly affected by various media in the atmosphere, so that it can better adhere to the metal and play the role of anti rust. This requires that top coating has: ① good adhesion with primer; ② Resistant to sunlight and ultraviolet radiation, resistant to powdering and cracking; ③ Low permeability to water vapor and various gases: ④ resistance to corrosion of acid, alkali, salt and other chemical media; ⑤ Has good mechanical properties. The commonly used primer for bridges include red lead antirust paint (phenolic, alkyd and epoxy) and zinc rich primer (organic and inorganic). The commonly used top coating includes alkyd enamel of various colors, silicone modified alkyd enamel, chlorinated rubber, acrylic modified alkyd paint.

explanation_cn: 又称钡铁氧体。一种硬磁（永磁）陶瓷，属磁铅石型结构。按一般电子陶瓷工艺制成。钡铁氧体的烧结温度比其他铁氧体低，在1100-1200T；一般各向同性的钡铁氧体的剩余磁感应强度队较小，BHc和也不可能很大。如在烧结过程中，使各晶粒易磁化方向排列一致.制成各向异性钡铁氧体。磁场成型也是制备各向异性钡铁氧体的方法。钡铁氧体和稀土钴(SmC%>等高级合金磁钢相比，其Br、BHe和还都较低.但由于钡铁氧体无需任何稀有金属，而又具有相当高的矫顽力。因此适宜在具有强退磁场的场合下使用.由于它是半导体型材料，电阻率很高，也可用于高频磁场。
explanation_en: It is also called Ba ferrite. The utility model relates to a hard magnetic (permanent magnetic) ceramics, which belongs to a magnetic lead stone structure. It is made by general electronic ceramics process. The sintering temperature of barium ferrite is lower than that of other ferrite, ranging from 1100-1200T; In general, the residual magnetic induction of isotropic Ba ferrite is small, and BHc and cannot be large. For example, in the process of sintering, each grain is easy to be magnetize in the same direction to make anisotropic Ba ferrite. Magnetic field forming is also a method for preparing anisotropic barium iron. Compared with advanced alloy magnet steel such as rare earth cobalt (SmC%>), Ba ferrite has lower Br, BHe and. However, since Ba ferrite does not need any rare metals, it also has quite high coercivity. Therefore, it is suitable for use in occasions with strong demagnetizing fields. Because it is a semiconducting materials with high resistivity, it can also be used in high-frequency magnetic fields.

explanation_cn: 以铁和铝为主要组成元素的软磁合金。合金的铝含量为6%-16%，余为铁。该合金有以下特点：① 电阻率高，含16%Al的铁铝合金的电阻率高达150 μΩ·cm，是金属软磁材料中的最高值。② 具有高的硬度和耐磨性。③ 在弱磁场下具有高的磁导率，且磁性对应力不太敏感。④ 加工性能较差，铝含量在6%以上的合金很难在室温下冷加工。⑤ 密度较小，如16%Al-Fe合金，初始磁导率为5.618 mH/m，最大磁导率为6294 mH/m，矫顽力为3.2 A/m，电阻率为150 μΩ·cm，密度为6.5 g/cm3。对含10%-16%Al的合金，热轧后需要温轧加工至成品尺寸，因为合金在600°C以下会产生无序至有序转变。因此，退火温度通常在950°C1200°C之间，接着要经过600°C700°C的再火处理。不同铝含量的合金适合于不同的用途。例如，16%Al合金由于耐磨性高，适于制作磁头铁芯；13%Al合金因具有较高的磁致伸缩效应，适于制作超声波换能器和磁致伸缩振子；12%Al合金适于制作微电动机、声频变压器和脉冲变压器。
explanation_en: Soft magnetic alloy with iron and aluminum as main components. The aluminum content of alloy is 6% -16%, and the rest is iron. The alloy has the following characteristics: ① The resistivity is high, and the resistivity of iron aluminum alloy containing 16% Al is as high as 150 μ Ω · cm, the highest value in metal soft magnetic material. ② It has high hardness and wear resistance. ③ It has high magnetic permeability under weak magnetic fields and is less sensitive to magnetic stress. ④ The processing performance is poor, and alloy with aluminum content above 6% is difficult to cold working at room temperature. ⑤ The density is small, such as 16% Al Fe alloy, the initial permeability is 5.618mH/m, the maximum permeability is 6294 mH/m, the coercivity is 3.2 A/m, and the resistivity is 150 μ Ω· cm, density is 6.5 g/cm 3。 For alloy containing 10% -16% Al, warm rolling is required to reach the finished product size after hot rolling, because alloy will produce disorder to order transformation below 600 ° C. Therefore, the annealing temperature is usually 950 ° C1200 ° C, followed by 600 ° C700 ° C reheating treatment. Alloy with different aluminum contents are suitable for different applications. For example, 16% Al alloy is suitable for making magnetic head cores due to its high wear resistance; 13% Al alloy is suitable for making ultrasonic transducers and magnetostriction oscillators because of its high magnetostriction effect; 12% Al alloy is suitable for making micromotors, audio frequency transformers and pulse transformers.

explanation_en: Iron chromium aluminum (FeCrAl) is a kind of resistance alloy with small resistance temperature coefficient and good stability. The adhesion of FeCrAl Cu Au film is better than that of NiCr Au film, and the average forward tensile strength can reach more than 19613.3kPa. explanation_cn: 以铅为基加入其他合金化元素组成的合金。根据性能和用途，铅合金可分为轴承合金、蓄电池合金、印刷合金、模具合金、焊料合金、电缆护套合金、化工耐蚀合金等。铅合金的主要合金化元素有Sb、Sn、Bi、Cu、Ag等。锑、锡可提高合金的强度和硬度。增加合金的流动性，铜可减少合金的偏析。加入少量的银、碲、砸、砷可细化组织。增加强度，消除杂质的有害影响。改善合金的耐蚀性铅合金在空气、硫酸、淡水和海水中都有很好的耐蚀性。铅合金熔点低、流动性好、凝固收缩率小、铸造性能好，可用于铸造形状复杂的器件，广泛用于铸造铅宇、铅版和制作塑料及机械工业用的模型。铅合金硬度不高，强度低。其拉伸强度仅为30-70MPa。比其他合金低很多。铅合金容易进行变形加工。不需加热即可进行轧制和挤压制成板、带、棒、线等材。
explanation_en: Alloy based on lead added with other alloy elements. According to performance and use, lead alloy can be divided into bearing alloy, accumulator alloy, printing alloy, mold alloy, solder alloy, cable sheath alloy, chemical corrosion resistant alloy, etc. The main alloy elements of lead alloy include Sb, Sn, Bi, Cu, Ag, etc. Antimony and tin can improve the strength and hardness of alloy. Increasing flow ability of alloy and copper can reduce segregation of alloy. Adding a small amount of silver, tellurium, smashing, and arsenic can refine the structure. Increase strength and eliminate harmful effects of impurities. Improve the corrosion resistance of alloy lead alloy has good corrosion resistance in air, sulfuric acid, fresh water and sea water. Lead alloy has low melting point, good flow ability, small solidification shrinkage, and good castability. It can be used for foundry devices with complex shapes, widely used for foundry lead, lead plates, and making model for plastics and mechanical industries. Lead alloy has low hardness and strength. Its tensile strength is only 30-70MPa. It is much lower than other alloy. Lead alloy is easy to deform. It can be rolling and extrusion into plates, strips, bars, wires and other materials without heating.

explanation_cn: 主晶相为反铁电体的含铅陶瓷。在居里温度232°C以上属立方晶系。在居里温度以下，每个子晶格白的Pb2+发生位移，因而有自发极化，但相邻的子晶格极化方向反平行。PbZrO3正交反铁电相的极化排列。一个正交晶胞包括原来立方相的8个晶胞。
explanation_en: Lead containing ceramics whose main crystal phase is anti ferroelectric body. It belongs to cubic crystal system when the Curie temperature is above 232 ° C. Below the Curie temperature, the white Pb2+of each sublattice shifts, so there is spontaneous polarization, but the polarization direction of adjacent sublattices is antiparallel. Polarization arrangement of PbZrO3 orthogonal antiferroelectric phase. An orthogonal unit cell of crystal includes eight unit cell of crystal of the original cubic phase.

explanation_cn: 见铅基轴承合金
explanation_en: See lead-base bearing alloy

explanation_cn: 复合钙钛矿结构的弛豫铁电陶瓷。这类材料具有频率色散、弥散相变、高介电常数、大电致伸缩系数和相对低的烧成温度等特征有代表性的材料组成。铅系弛被视为低温烧结多层陶瓷电容器最有潜在应用前景的介质材料。在电致伸缩陶瓷微位移器和制动器方面也有重要作用。
explanation_en: Relaxation ferroelectric ceramics with composition perovskite structure. Such materials are representative materials with characteristics of frequency dispersion, dispersion phase transition, high dielectric constant, large electrostriction coefficient and relatively low firing temperature. Lead based capacitors are regarded as the most promising dielectric materials for low-temperature sintering multilayer ceramics capacitors. It also plays an important role in electrostriction ceramics micro displacement and brake.

explanation_cn: 又称巴氏合金，它是以铅为基，加有Sb、Sn、Cu、Na等元素，一类是成分比较简单的铅锑铜合金和铅锑钙合金;另一类是在铅锑锡的基础上添加铜、镍、镉、砷等元素。铅基轴承合金的组织是在铅的软基体上均匀分布着硬相颗粒。与锡基轴承合金相比，铅基轴承合金较脆，易造成疲劳裂纹，合金的热导率、热膨胀系数、浇铸性能、耐蚀性能等均低于锡基合金。但强度性能却接近或稍高于锡基合金，而且价格低，得到广泛应用。主要用于制造中等载荷或高速低载荷、工作中冲击力不大、温度低于-150°C的轴承。
explanation_en: It is also called Babbitt metal alloy, which is based on lead and added with elements such as Sb, Sn, Cu, Na, etc. One is lead antimony copper alloy and lead antimony calcium alloy with simple composition; Another type is the addition of elements such as copper, nickel, cadmium, and arsenic on the basis of lead, antimony, and tin. The structure of lead-base bearing alloy is that hard particles are evenly distributed on the soft base of lead. Compared with tin-base bearing alloy, lead-base bearing alloy is brittle and easy to cause fatigue cracks. The thermal conductivity, coefficient of thermcal expansion, casting performance and corrosion resistance of alloy are lower than those of tin base alloy. However, the strength performance is close to or slightly higher than that of tin based alloy, and the price is low, so it is widely used. Mainly used for manufacturing bearings with medium or high-speed low loads, low impact force during operation, and temperatures below -150 ° C.

explanation_cn: 铅字合金是铅、锑、锡的合金，其中铅约占75%、锑20%、锡5%。铅字合金的特点是坚硬而容易熔化。供铸造印刷活卞和印刷版。铅字合金凝间时体积膨胀。能使印刷的宇迹和线条清晰。因此也叫活合金。可作铅字、轴承、电缆包皮等使用。
explanation_en: Type metal alloy is a alloy of lead, antimony and tin, of which lead accounts for about 75%, antimony 20% and tin 5%. The characteristic of lead alloy is its hardness and easy melting. For foundry printing and printing plate. The volume of lead alloy expands during solidification. It can make the printing marks and lines clear. Therefore, it is also called live alloy. Can be used for lead, bearings, cable sheaths, etc.

explanation_cn: 以铅为基的焊料合金，有铅锡，铅银两大类。铅锡焊料合金用于电器、电子工业及机械制造部门。铅银焊料是髙温焊料。
explanation_en: Lead based solder alloy include lead tin and lead silver. Lead tin solder alloy is used in electrical appliances, electronic industry and machinery manufacturing departments. Lead silver solder is a high-temperature solder.

explanation_cn: 一种含氧化铅的特种玻璃。主要成分为40%(质量分数）以上PbO、1%-2%Ce02和少量氧化钠等。铅玻璃中加入少量氧化铈可以减少y射线大照射量时的着色，称为不发黄玻璃。具有高折射率，能吸收X、7等射线，光泽好，软化温度低，密度大、成型性能好等特点。铅玻璃按照铅当量、密度、折射率、白光吸收系数、耐潮、耐酸、辐照稳定性、应力和气泡的直径与数量而分成不同的牌号和级别。铅玻璃的密度随PbO的含量不同而变化：密度为3。2-3。6g/cm:l的铅玻璃（含SiO2、卩1)O、1<20、他20和0O2)、密度为4。2-5。28/cm3的高铅玻璃（含CeC)2)、密度为6。2g/cm3的高铅玻璃和防X射线的铅玻璃（含BaO和CeO2)。铅玻璃用于y射线照射室、热室、加速器（电子回旋加速器、直线加速器）的窥视窗和X射线防护屏。含硼铅玻璃是一种理想的防中子和7射线的屏蔽窗材料。在实际使用中窥视窗通常由几块铅玻璃组合而成。具有与屏蔽室壁相同的屏蔽效果（等效屏蔽厚度）。铅玻璃使用中要保持干燥。长期接触潮气会发生化学反应产生霉斑。影响透光性。
explanation_en: A special glass containing lead oxide. The main components are over 40% (mass fraction) PbO, 1% -2% Ce02, and a small amount of sodium oxide. A small amount of cerium oxide added to lead glass can reduce the coloring of the glass under large y-ray exposure, which is called non yellowing glass. It has high refractive index, can absorb X, 7 and other rays, good gloss, low bating temperature, large density, good molding performance and other characteristics. Lead glass is divided into different grades and grades according to lead equivalent, density, refractive index, white light absorption coefficient, moisture resistance, acid resistance, irradiation stability, stress and bubble diameter and quantity. The density of lead glass varies with the content of PbO: the density is 3. 2-3. 6g/cm: l lead glass (containing SiO2, ± 1) O, 1<20, other 20 and 0O2), with a density of 4. 2-5. 28/cm3 high lead glass (including CeC) 2), with a density of 6. 2g/cm3 high lead glass and X-ray resistant lead glass (containing BaO and CeO2). Lead glass is used for the peeping window and X-ray protective screen of y-ray irradiation chamber, hot cell and accelerator (electron cyclotron, linear accelerator). Boron containing lead glass is an ideal shielding window materials against neutrons and 7 rays. In practical use, the peeping window is usually composed of several pieces of lead glass. Having the same shielding effect as the shielding chamber wall (equivalent shielding thickness). Lead glass shall be kept dry during use. Long term exposure to moisture can cause chemical reactions and produce mold spots. Light transmittance is affected.

explanation_cn: 又称白铅粉。是以碱性碳酸铅为主要成分的白色颜料，呈无定形粉末或团块状，不溶于水及乙醇，溶于醋酸、硝酸等。能与酸值高的油生成铅皂，加强漆膜。防止粉化。遇硫会变成黑色的硫化铅。所以不能与银朱、镉黄、群青等含硫颜料配用。其生产方法有电解法、熔融铅法、醋酸法。由于在生产和应用过程中可能会带来铅中毒，以及用铅白制备的涂料易增稠。与硫化氢长期接触白度降低，铅白吸收空气中二氧化碳逐渐变成中性的碳酸铅，热稳定性差等缺点，其使用受到很大限制。用铅白制备的涂料漆膜致密坚固，具有优良的耐光性、耐候性、防锈性与耐潮湿性。在涂料工业上仍作为生产厚浆漆、防锈漆和户外漆的白色颜料。在陶瓷工业上，铅白作为某些釉料的成分，用作助熔剂，改善釉料流动性和增加产品的光泽度。
explanation_en: Also known as white lead powder. It is a white pigment mainly composed of alkaline lead carbonate. It is amorphous powder or lump, insoluble in water and ethanol, and soluble in acetic acid, nitric acid, etc. It can form lead soap with high acid value oil to strengthen the paint film. Prevent pulverization. When encountering sulfur, it will become black lead sulfide. Therefore, it cannot be used with sulfur pigment such as silver vermilion, cadmium yellow and ultramarine blue. The production methods include electrolysis, molten lead method, and acetic acid method. Lead poisoning may occur in the production and application process, and the coatings prepared with lead white or lead carbonate is easy to thicken. The whiteness after long-term contact with hydrogen sulfide decreases, lead white or lead carbonate absorbs carbon dioxide in the air and gradually becomes neutral lead carbonate, and its use is greatly limited due to its poor thermal stability and other shortcomings. The coatings film prepared with lead white or lead carbonate is dense and firm, with excellent light resistance, weather resistance, rust resistance and moisture resistance. In the coatings industry, it is still used as a white pigment to produce thick paste paint, antirust paint and outdoor paint. In the ceramics industry, lead white or lead carbonate, as a component of some glazes, is used as a flux to improve the flow ability of glazes and increase the glossiness of products.

explanation_cn: 以氧化铅和氧化硼为助熔剂的易熔釉。成熟温度低于1230°C。具有良好的高温流动性、很高的光泽度和平滑度、较宽的烧成范围、良好的坯釉适应性。釉面光泽强。能使釉上彩呈色鲜绝，缺点是耐酸碱腐蚀性差。
explanation_en: Fusible glaze with lead oxide and boron oxide as flux. The maturity temperature is below 1230 ° C. It has good high temperature flow ability, high glossiness and smoothness, wide firing range, and good adaptability to body and glaze. The glaze has a strong luster. It can make glaze color fresh, but its disadvantage is poor acid and alkali corrosion resistance.

explanation_cn: 一种酸性二次电池，采用PbO2作为正极。海绵铅作为负极，硫酸溶液作为电解液，正极和负极间加隔板以防短路，发明于1859年。铅酸电池是各种电池中用途最广、用量最大的电池，已广泛用于各种车辆、仪器无间断供电电源、电动工具等。
explanation_en: An acid secondary cell uses PbO2 as the positive electrode. Sponge lead is used as the negative electrode, sulfuric acid solution is used as the electrolyte, and a partition is added between the positive and negative electrodes to prevent short circuits. It was invented in 1859. Lead-acid battery is the most widely used and used battery among all kinds of batteries. It has been widely used in all kinds of vehicles, instruments, uninterrupted power supply, electric tools, etc.

explanation_cn: 是由铅铬黄和铁蓝或钛菁蓝所组成的混合拼色颜料。其-性能由两种组成颜料的性能决定，铅铬绿的遮盖力强（高于铅铬黄和铁蓝），耐溶剂、油、水性佳，耐高温和耐候性好，但耐酸碱性差。是重要的绿色颜料。主要用于外用涂料和工业涂料、印刷油墨、搪瓷和玻璃等。
explanation_en: It is a mixed color pigment composed of chrome yellow and iron blue or titanium cyanine blue. Its performance is determined by the performance of two pigment. chrome green has strong hiding power (higher than lead chrome yellow and iron blue), good resistance to solvent, oil, water, high temperature and weather, but poor acid and alkali resistance. It is an important green pigment. It is mainly used for external coatings and industrial coatings, printing ink, enamel, glass, etc.

explanation_cn: 以铅为基，含有锑及其他合金元素的合金。铅锑合金的主要用途之一是制作铅蓄电池的极板和栅板。用作铅蓄电池的铅锑合金已有很长的历史。铅锑合金具有比纯铅更高的硬度。在栅板、极板制造过程中不易变形。铅锑合金的熔点比纯铅低，具有良好的铸造性能和较小的膨胀系数。浇铸时。较少出现气孔和缩孔。并使铸件保持良好的尺寸精度。用于铅蓄电池的铅锑合金有高锑铅合金和低锑铅合金。高铅锑栅板蓄电池已大部分被淘汰，主要使用的是低锑铅合金，把合金中的含梯量降到2.75%以下。为了改善合金的浇铸性能和力学性能。通常向合金中添加少量或微量的As、Sn、Cu、Ag、Se、S等元素。除用作蓄电池的栅板、极板外。铅锑合金还用作轴承合金(见铅基轴承合金）和印刷合金及模具合金。
explanation_en: Lead based alloy containing antimony and other alloy elements. One of the main uses of lead-antimony alloy is to make plate and grid plate of lead battery. Lead-antimony alloy has a long history as a lead-acid battery. Lead-antimony alloy has higher hardness than pure lead. It is not easy to deform in the manufacturing process of grid plate and plate. The melting point of lead-antimony alloy is lower than that of pure lead, which has good castability and small expansion coefficient. When casting. Porosity and shrinkage hole are rare. And maintain good dimensional accuracy of the casting. Lead-antimony alloy used for lead batteries include high antimony lead alloy and low antimony lead alloy. Most of the high lead antimony grid accumulator have been eliminated, and low antimony lead alloy is mainly used, which reduces the ladder content in alloy to below 2.75%. In order to improve the casting and mechanical properties of alloy. A small amount or trace of As, Sn, Cu, Ag, Se, S and other elements are usually added to alloy. Except for grid plate and plate used as accumulator. Lead-antimony alloy is also used as bearing alloy (see lead-base bearing alloy), printing alloy and die alloy.

explanation_cn: 在铜梓合金基础上。加入铅的黄铜。铅极少固溶于铜锌合金，在合金中以独立相存在，呈游离质点分布于基体，既有润滑作用，又使切屑呈崩碎状，从而改善了黄铜的切削性和耐磨性。切削用黄铜的最高含铅量为3%。
explanation_en: On the basis of copper catalpa alloy. Brass with lead added. Lead rarely dissolves in copper zinc alloy, but exists as an independent phase in alloy, distributed as free particles in the matrix, which not only has the lubrication effect, but also makes the chips appear crumbling, thus improving the machinability and wear resistance of brass. The maximum lead content of cutting brass is 3%.

explanation_cn: 铈褐帘石，又称为铈铁矿，是一种矿物，属于硅酸盐矿物，具体来说是钒铈铁硅酸盐矿物。它的化学式通常表示为(Ce,La,Ca)(Fe,Mg)Si2O6。
explanation_en: Magcerepidote, also known as cerite, is a mineral that belongs to silicate mineral, specifically vanadium cerium iron silicate mineral. Its chemical formula is usually expressed as (Ce, La, Ca) (Fe, Mg) Si2O6.

explanation_cn: 重费米子（Fermi)超导体.晶体结构为四方晶系.超导临界温度0.7K。
explanation_en: Heavy fermion superconductor. The crystal structure is a tetragonal system. The superconductor critical temperature is 0.7K.

explanation_cn: 铊系高温超导体家族的简称，超导临界温度Tr分别为20K、108K和125K。超导体的载流子密度为每立方厘米1021个电子.载流子类型为空穴型，即P型；德拜温度0为238-290K:晶体结构为氧缺位钙钛矿.T相。由于T1具有很强的毒性，这种材料制备闲难.在强电方面没有实用价值；在超导电子学方面有一定的应用。
explanation_en: Thallium is the abbreviation of the high-temperature superconductor family. The superconductor critical temperature Tr is 20K, 108K and 125K respectively. The density of superconductor is 1021 electrons per cubic centimeter. The carrier type is hole type, namely P type; Debey temperature 0 is 238-290K; the crystal structure is oxygen deficient perovskite. T phase. Due to the strong toxicity of T1, the preparation of this materials is difficult. It has no practical value in strong electricity; It has certain applications in superconducting electronics.

explanation_cn: 作钎焊料用的铋基易熔合金。
explanation_en: Bismuth based fusible alloy used as solder.

explanation_cn: 铋锶钙铜氧膜是指由铋锶钙铜四种或四种以上元素与氧原子组成的化合物超导薄膜。零电阻温度为110K，比钇钡铜氧膜高20K，有利于薄膜的应用。
explanation_en: BSCCO superconductor film is a compound superconducting film composed of four or more elements of bismuth strontium calcium copper and oxygen atoms. The zero resistance temperature is 110K, 20K higher than that of the YBa2Cu307 film, which is conducive to the application of the film.

explanation_cn: 化学式Nb3Al金属间化合物超导体，晶体结构为A:iB型A15结构。性能可达1000Amm2以上，因此。Nb:1Al超导材料在高场超导磁体应用上有着非常大的潜力。但是,与NhSn超导线材相比，Nb3Al超导线材的制备过程更加复杂，需要采用高温急热急冷方法进行热处理。
explanation_en: The imermetallif compound superconductor with the chemical formula Nb3Al has a crystal structure of A: iB type A15. The performance can reach over 1000Amm2, therefore. Nb: 1Al superconducting materials has great potential in the application of high field superconducting magnet. However, compared with the NhSn superconducting wire rod, the preparation process of Nb3Al superconducting wire rod is more complex, and the high temperature quenching and quenching method is needed for heat treatment.

explanation_cn: 化学式Nb3Ge金属间化合物超导体。是E-l前发现的超导转变温度最高的低温合金类超导体。超导体晶粒连接性较差，在较低磁场下。电流也不高。与Nb:1Al类似。高性能的超导线材制备困难，在超导电子学方面有一定的应用价值，如:约瑟夫森结等。
explanation_en: The chemical formula Nb3Ge imermetallif compound superconductor. It is a cryogenic alloy superconductor with the highest superconducting transition temperature found before E-l. Superconductor grains have poor connectivity under lower magnetic fields. The current is not high either. Similar to Nb: 1Al. High performance superconducting wire rod is difficult to prepare, and has certain application value in superconducting electronics, such as Josephson joint.

explanation_cn: 化学式Nb3Sn低温超导体，属A15型金属间化合物。立方晶系。铌三锡超导体质脆。其超导性能对应力应变非常敏感，一般采用先成型后扩散反应的方法制成Nb:lSn线材。Nh:lSn超导线材的制备方法分为青铜法和白锡法两种。Nh:lSn超导材料和其他材料一样。临界电流密度及临界电流均随磁场增加而急剧下降。目前Nb3Sn超导材料已实用化。主要用于高场超导磁体。
explanation_en: Low temperature superconductor with chemical formula Nb3Sn belongs to A15 type imermetallif compound. Cubic crystal system. Nb3Sn superconductors are brittle. Its superconductivity is very sensitive to stress and strain. Generally, Nb: lSn wire rod is made by forming first and then diffusion reaction. The preparation methods of the Nh: lSn superconducting wire rod can be divided into bronze method and white tin method. Nh: lSn superconducting materials is the same as other materials. Both critical current density and critical current decrease sharply with the increase of magnetic field. At present, Nb3Sn superconducting materials has been applied. It is mainly used for high field superconducting magnet.

explanation_cn: 化学式Nb3Ga金属间化合物超导体，晶体结构为A3B型A15结构。Nb3Ga的成相温度1705°C，均相区15.3%-23.5%Ga(原子分数)，与Nb:tA1类似,由于Nb和Ga的熔点相差太大，高性能的Nb3Ga超导材料制备比较困难。Nk:Ga超导体通常采用金属铌和镓直接反应或化学气相沉积法制取。
explanation_en: Imermetallif compound superconductor with chemical formula Nb3Ga, the crystal structure is A3B type A15 structure. The phase temperature of Nb3Ga is 1705 ° C, and the average phase region is 15.3% -23.5% Ga (atomic fraction), which is similar to Nb: tA1. Due to the large difference in melting point between Nb and Ga, it is difficult to prepare high-performance Nb3Ga superconducting materials. Nk: Ga superconductors are usually produced by direct reaction of metal niobium and gallium or chemical vapor deposition.

explanation_cn: 具有某一特定晶体取向、无晶界、结晶缺陷少以及各向同性等优异的物理化学及力学性能。其制备方法主要有电子束悬浮区域熔炼法、熔滴等离子弧熔炼法以及应变-退火法，它在电子、激光、全息技术等领域有广泛应用。
explanation_en: It has excellent physical chemistry and mechanical properties such as orientation of a specific crystal, no grain boundary, few crystal defects and isotropy. Its preparation methods mainly include electron beam suspension zone melting, droplet plasma arc melting and strain annealing. It is widely used in electronics, laser, holography and other fields.

explanation_cn: 以铌为基础，通过加入其他元素形成的合金，通常采用固溶体、碳、氮化物强化或硅化物强化等方式来提高其性能。相较于钨和钼合金，铌合金允许加入的元素种类更多，总量更大。在铌合金中，加入钨、钼、钽等元素可以起到固溶强化作用，加入钛、锆、铪、钇、钒、铬、铝等金属元素，以及一定比例的碳、氮、氧，可以形成分散的第二相，起到分散强化作用。这些强化机制可以显著提高合金的强度和性能。铌钛合金和铌-锡合金被广泛用作超导材料，而铌-钛-铝合金不仅可用作高强结构材料，还是无磁性和恒弹性材料。制备铌合金通常采用电子束熔炼或电子束感应熔炼等工艺，以确保合金元素充分合金化并提高纯度。粉末冶金方法也可用于制备形状复杂的部件。电子束熔炼通常用于提纯合金，而真空感应熔炼则用于调整成分，制备均匀的合金，并加入易挥发的元素。制备的铸锭可经过挤压、锻造、轧制等变形加工工艺制成各种形状的材料和异型材。
explanation_en: Based on niobium, alloy formed by adding other elements are usually strengthened by solid solution, carbon, nitride or silicide to improve their properties. Compared with tungsten and molybdenum alloy, niobium alloy allows more kinds of elements to be added, and the total amount is larger. In niobium alloy, the addition of tungsten, molybdenum, tantalum and other elements can play a solid solution strengthening role, and the addition of titanium, zirconium, hafnium, yttrium, vanadium, chromium, aluminum and other metal elements, as well as a certain proportion of carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, can form a dispersed second phase, playing a dispersion strengthening role. These strengthening mechanisms can significantly improve the strength and properties of alloy. Niobium titanium alloy and niobium tin alloy are widely used as superconducting materials, while niobium titanium aluminum alloy can be used not only as high-strength structural materials, but also as nonmagnetic and constant elastic materials. Niobium alloy is usually prepared by electron beam melting or electron beam induction melting to ensure that alloy elements are fully alloy and improve purity. The powder metallurgy method can also be used to prepare components with complex shapes. Electron beam melting is usually used to purify alloy, while vacuum induction melting is used to adjust the composition, prepare uniform alloy, and add volatile elements. The prepared ingots can be made into various shapes of materials and profiled materials through extrusion, forging, rolling and other deformation processes.

explanation_cn: 铌硅基复合材料是近二十年铌合金研究的热点，有望用于四代、五代飞机发动机的材料，可替代镍基合金，单晶用于推重比15-20的飞机发动机。该材料通常i在Nb-Ti-Si合金中添加W、Mo、Hf、V、Cr、Sn、B、Y等元素。形成以铌固溶体为连续的韧性相，以细小的铌硅化物或拉维斯相(Laves)作为强化相的金属基复合材料。研究者采用电弧熔炼后熔滴到陶瓷模具中、热压烧结、定向凝固等多种方法研究，带有热障涂层的这类材料的最好性能达到了短期(100h)应用的水平。
explanation_en: Niobium-silicide-based composite is a research hotspot of niobium alloy in the past 20 years. It is expected to be used as a materials for the fourth and fifth generation aircraft engines, and can replace nickel based alloy. single crystal is used for aircraft engines with a thrust weight ratio of 15-20. This materials usually adds W, Mo, Hf, V, Cr, Sn, B, Y and other elements to Nb Ti Si alloy. A metal matrix composite with niobium solid solution as the continuous ductile phase and fine niobium silicide or Laves phase as the strengthening phase is formed. The researchers used a variety of methods such as arc melting followed by droplet dropping into ceramics mold, hot pressing sintering, directional solidification, etc. The best performance of this kind of materials with thermal barrier coating reached the level of short-term (100h) application.

explanation_cn: 简称BNN，属于正交晶系，具有乌青铜结构。BNN晶体是所有非线性光学材料中最有效的倍频晶体，如用大的BNN晶体作倍频试验，输出光的功率可达2.5V。1.06μm激光倍频相位匹配温度为lOO°C左右。BNN晶体可以用提拉法生长。由于易出现生长条纹及各种缺陷，同时又极易开裂，要生长良好光学质量的BNN较难。开裂的原因是在560°C存在由非铁电相转化成铁电相的相变。260°C时，由四方晶系转变为斜方晶系。故一般采用C轴生长，同时在生长处理中，必须极其缓慢地通过相变点等。BNN主要用于激光倍频、光参量振荡、电光调制等器件。
explanation_en: BNN, abbreviated as BNN, belongs to the orthorhombic crystal system and has a black bronze structure. BNN crystal is the most effective frequency doubling crystal among all nonlinear optical materials. If large BNN crystal is used for frequency doubling test, the output light power can reach 2.5V. one point zero six μ The phase matching temperature for m laser frequency doubling is around lOO ° C. BNN crystal can be grown by pulling method method. It is difficult to grow BNN with good optical quality because it is easy to appear growth striation and various defects, and also easy to crack. The reason for cracking is that there is a phase transformation from non ferroelectric phase to ferroelectric phase at 560 ° C. At 260 ° C, the tetragonal system transformation into orthorhombic system. Therefore, C-axis growth is generally adopted, and during the growth treatment, the transformation point must be passed very slowly. BNN is mainly used for devices such as laser frequency doubling, optical parametric oscillation, and electro-optic modulation.

explanation_cn: 一种钨青铜结构的铁电陶瓷。化学式为BaNa2Nbl0O30，10个BU八面体组成2个AJ(四边形空隙)，4个A2(五边形空隙)和4个A3(三边形空隙)，其中4个Ba，2个Na分别占满A1和A2的6个空隙。是一种填满型的钨青铜铁电体。纯铌酸钡钠陶瓷极难烧结，通过离子置换和添加少量元素改性，可以烧成致密的陶瓷，也可以用热压的方法制备成陶瓷。有良好的频率温度稳定性，是一种用于窄带陶瓷滤波器的优良压电材料。
explanation_en: A ferroelectric ceramics with tungsten bronze structure. The chemical formula is BaNa2Nbl0O30, and 10 BU octahedra form 2 AJs (quadrilateral voids), 4 A2 (pentagonal voids), and 4 A3 (triangular voids), with 4 Ba and 2 Na occupying 6 voids of A1 and A2, respectively. It is a filled tungsten bronze ferroelectric body. Pure barium sodium niobate ceramics are extremely difficult to sintering. Through ion replacement and addition of a small amount of elements, dense ceramics can be sintered, or ceramics can be prepared by hot pressing. It has good frequency and temperature stability, and is an excellent piezoelectric materials for narrow band ceramics filters.

explanation_cn: 化学式为KNbO3，属正交晶系，具有畸变钙钛矿型结构。可用凯罗泡罗斯法生长。由于KNbO3晶体存在高、低温不同的相，故在进行退火、极化时易发生开裂。KNbO3主要用于激光倍频、电光调制及作为光折变材料。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is KNbO3, which belongs to the orthorhombic crystal system and has a distorted perovskite type structure. Growth can be achieved using the Carropoulos method. Because KNbO3 crystal has different phase at high and low temperatures, it is easy to crack during annealing and polarization. KNbO3 is mainly used for laser frequency doubling, electro-optic modulation and as photo-refractive materials.

explanation_cn: LiNbO3（锂铌酸盐）属于ABO3型化合物，具有钛铁矿型（畸变钙钛矿型）晶体结构。它属于气方晶系，其点群是Ch-3m，空间群是Ct.-R"。LiNbO3的晶体结构中，原子的堆积方式为ABAE堆积。在这个结构中，氧八面体形成了略微变形的空隙，其中约1/3的空隙被八价离子占据，1/3被五价离子（通常是Nb或Ta）占据，余下的1/3则是空位。这种类型的结构的主要特点是，其中的阳离子A和B离子具有接近的半径，并且都比氧离子的半径小很多。除LiNbO3外，钽酸锂（LiTaO3）也具有这种结构。这些晶体表现出铁电性质，是重要的声表面波材料，在现代通信技术中有重要的应用。
explanation_en: LiNbO3 (lithium niobate) is an ABO3 type compound with a ilmenite type (distorted perovskite type) crystal structure. It belongs to the gas square crystal system, its point group is Ch-3m, and its space group is Ct- R ". In the crystal structure of LiNbO3, the atomic stacking mode is ABAE stacking. In this structure, the oxygen octahedron forms slightly deformed voids, in which about 1/3 of the voids are occupied by octavalent ions, and 1/3 are occupied by pentavalent ions (usually Nb or Ta) The remaining 1/3 is vacancy. The main characteristic of this type of structure is that the cations A and B ions have similar radii, and both have much smaller radii than the oxygen ions. In addition to LiNbO3, lithium tantalate (LiTaO3) also has this structure. These crystal exhibit ferroelectric properties and are important SAW materials, which have important applications in modern communication technology.

explanation_cn: 化学式为LiNbO3，简称LN,属三方晶系,钛铁矿型(畸变钙钛矿型)结构。该晶体一般用提拉法生长。生长中主要问题有:开裂、气泡、胞状结构及生长条纹。优质的LN晶体是无色透明的。由于LN晶体在室温下会发生自发极化，故其多种应用均需要单畴化处理。经过处理的LN晶体是一种具有灰电、铁电、电光、非线性光学、热电等多性能的材料，同吋它还具有光折变效应。目前，在微声技术中用于调Q开关，电光调制，倍频，光参量振荡;掺入一定量的铁和其他金属杂质的LN晶体可用作全息记录介质材料。缺点是受强光照射时容易产生光损伤。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is LiNbO3, or LN for short, which belongs to the tripartite system and ilmenite type (distorted perovskite type) structure. The crystal is generally grown by pulling method method. The main problems in growth are: cracking, bubbles, cellular structure and growth striation. High quality LN crystal is colorless and transparent. Because LN crystal can undergo spontaneous polarization at room temperature, its various applications require single domain treatment. The treated LN crystal is a kind of materials with multiple properties such as gray electricity, ferroelectricity, electro-optic, nonlinear optics, thermoelectricity, etc. It also has photorefractive effect. Currently, in micro acoustic technology, it is used for Q-switching, electro-optic modulation, frequency doubling, and optical parametric oscillation; LN crystal doped with a certain amount of iron and other metal impurities can be used as a holographic recording medium materials. The disadvantage is that it is prone to light damage when exposed to strong light.

explanation_cn: LiNbO3（锂铌酸盐）是一种铁电陶瓷，具有LiNbO3结构。这种材料因其高居里温度（1140°C）而被称为高温铁电体。LiNbO3的基本结构由氧八面体组成，相邻的氧八面体共享顶点。氧八面体中填充着Li+和Nb5+离子，它们相互排布，环绕着Nb3+离子。这些离子的排列按照规律周期性地重复，形成了独特的结构。这个结构具有二方晶系。LiNbO3通常以单晶体的形式用作压电晶体，因为它比制成多晶陶瓷更为困难。单晶体可以通过电场烧结方法制备。LiNbO3具有出色的压电性能，机电耦合系数高，机械品质因素也很好。此外，它的声学传输损耗很低，因此在声学和电子领域有着广泛的应用。它常被用于制造微声学器件、高频高温换能器、红外探测器、激光调制器、高频宽通带滤波器、延迟线和光波导等应用。
explanation_en: LiNbO3 (lithium niobate) is a ferroelectric ceramics with LiNbO3 structure. This materials is called high temperature ferroelectric body because of its high Curie temperature (1140 ° C). The basic structure of LiNbO3 is composed of oxygen octahedra, with adjacent oxygen octahedra sharing vertices. The oxygen octahedron is filled with Li+and Nb5+ions, which are arranged mutually and surround Nb3+ions. The arrangement of these ions repeats periodically in a regular manner, forming a unique structure. This structure has a hexagonal crystal system. LiNbO3 is usually used as a piezoelectric crystal in the form of a single crystal, because it is more difficult to make polycrystal ceramics. Single crystals can be prepared by electric field sintering. LiNbO3 has excellent piezoelectric performance, high electromechanical coupling coefficient, and good mechanical quality factors. In addition, its acoustic transmission loss is very low, making it widely used in the fields of acoustics and electronics. It is often used in the manufacturing of micro acoustic devices, high-frequency and high-temperature transducers, infrared detectors, laser modulators, high-frequency wideband filters, delay lines, and optical waveguides.

explanation_cn: 是一种铌酸盐铁电体，具有乌青铜结构。它的化学式为sn-Ba, Nb2O6，常称为SBN。以下是有关SBN的一些主要特性和应用：晶格常数（a）：12.466 ?。晶格常数（c）：3.951 ?。密度：5.2-5.3 g/cm3。莫氏硬度：5.5。熔点：1470°C。折射率：2.30-2.3123电光系数：8.8-11.2 x 10^-12 m/V。居里温度：110-114°C。SBN晶体具有原塑对称性为4/mmm，只有一个4次轴，包括180°畴，不包括90°畴。Sr/Ba比例可在一定范围内连续变化，使得光学和电光性能可以满足不同要求。晶体的分布和点阵常数也会随组成的变化而变化。SBN晶体具有许多优点，包括良好的非线性效应、相当大的线性电光效应、热释电效应、高耦合系数以及快速的响应时间。此外，SBN还表现出光折变效应。它是唯一一种能够观察到自杲浦相位共轭现象的晶体，而且性能优于BaTiO3（BTO）。SBN以及它的掺杂晶体，如Ce:SBN和KNSBN，主要用于以下领域：非相干光/相干光学变换器。光学可寻址的光纤连接线。诱导相干光谱振荡器。多层光折变光栅和光学开关。全息存储介质。电光调制和热电探测领域。这些特性和应用使SBN成为一种重要的功能性材料，广泛用于光学和电子设备中。
explanation_en: It is a niobate ferroelectric with a black bronze structure. Its chemical formula is sn Ba, Nb2O6, often referred to as SBN. The following are some main characteristics and applications of SBN: lattice constant (a): 12.466 ?. Lattice constant (c): 3.951 ?. Density: 5.2-5.3 g/cm 3。 Mohs hardness: 5.5. Melting point: 1470 ° C. Refractive index: 2.30-2.3123, electro-optic coefficient: 8.8-11.2 x 10 ^ -12 m/V. Curie temperature: 110-114 ° C. The original plastic symmetry of SBN crystal is 4/mmm, and there is only one fourth axis, including 180 ° domains and not including 90 ° domains. The Sr/Ba ratio can continuously change within a certain range, allowing optical and electro-optical performance to meet different requirements. The distribution and lattice constant of crystal will also change with the change of composition. SBN crystal has many advantages, including good nonlinear effect, considerable linear electrophoto effect, pyroelectric effect, high coupling coefficient and fast response time. In addition, SBN also exhibits photorefractive effects. It is the only crystal that can observe self propagating phase conjugation, and its properties are better than BaTiO3 (BTO). SBN and its doped crystal, such as Ce: SBN and KNSBN, are mainly used in the following fields: incoherent light/coherent optical converters. Optically addressable optical fiber connector. Induced coherent spectral oscillator. Multilayer photorefractive gratings and optical switches. Holographic storage medium. The field of electro-optic modulation and thermoelectric detection. These characteristics and applications make SBN an important functional materials, which is widely used in optical and electronic equipment.

explanation_cn: 以铌为基加入5%的钨和2%钼、1%-1。7%锆元素形成的铌合金。铌和W、Mo形成置换固溶体。锆是一种活性元素，除固溶在Nb中外，还与铌中的氧和碳生成氧化锆和碳化铌第二相，起弥散强化作用。降低了间隙元素对晶界强度的不利影响;铌钨合金在航天l:程和技术中用量正在逐年增加。铌钨合金按强化方式分为两类:固溶强化合金和同溶强化与弥散强化相结合的合金。具有良好的力学性能、焊接性能。铌铪合金通常采用电子束熔炼和真空白耗电弧熔炼相结合的方法制备锭坯。然后在230t'以上的温度下进行挤压或锻造开坯，于500t以下的温度下进行札制和拉拔等加工，rtf制成板、带、棒、线和锻件等产品。通常采用硅化物抗氧化涂层。加涂这两种涂层的铌钨合金可在1300-1600°C使用;主耍用于液体火箭发动机辐射冷却喷管延伸段和推力室身部、喷气发动机高温结构部件等。
explanation_en: Add 5% tungsten and 2% molybdenum, 1% -1, based on niobium. Niobium alloy formed by 7% zirconium. Niobium forms displaced solid solution with W and Mo. Zirconium is an active element. In addition to its solid solution in Nb, it also forms the second phase of zirconia and carbonization with oxygen and carbon in niobium, playing a role of dispersion strengthening. The disadvantageous effect of interstitial elements on grain boundary strength is reduced; The amount of niobium-tungsten alloy in aerospace engineering and technology is increasing year by year. Niobium-tungsten alloy can be divided into two types according to the strengthening mode: solid solution strengthening alloy and alloy combining solution strengthening and dispersion strengthening. It has good mechanical properties and weld performance. Niobium-hafnium alloy ingots are usually prepared by electron beam melting and vacuum white loss arc melting. Then extrusion or forging blooming shall be carried out at a temperature above 230t ', and processing such as drawing and drawing shall be carried out at a temperature below 500t, and products such as plates, strips, bars, wires and forgings shall be made by rtf. Usually, silicide antioxidant coatings are used. Niobium-tungsten alloy coated with these two coatings can be used at 1300-1600 ° C; Mainly used for radiative cooling nozzle extensions and thrust chamber bodies of liquid rocket engines, as well as high-temperature structural components of jet engines.

explanation_en: Columnite tantalite complex chain structured oxide minerals. The chemical formula is (Fe. Mn) (NI>, TaM),; "Fe and Mn, Nl) and Ta are completely isomorphic, respectively. The crystal is granular, massive, radial, and cluster shaped. The crystal surface is smooth, sometimes with longitudinal lines. The crystal plane is sometimes rough like coke, iron black to brown black, and stripes are dark red to black,

explanation_cn: 主要用作合金添加剂的铁和铌的合金，铌加钽含量通常为50%-70%。铌铁通常采用硅热法或铝热法生产，故还含有1.0%-3.O%的硅和2.0%-3.8%的铝。GB/T7737-2007对铌铁牌号和化学成分有明确规定。铌加入钢中可显著改变热变形行为，铌与钢中的碳、氮形成碳氮化铌可阻止晶粒长大并产生沉淀强化效果，铌还能提高钢的高温强度。因此，银广泛应用于低合金高强度钢提高强度、韧性和焊接性，用于不锈钢和耐热钢提高高温强度和抗晶间腐蚀性能，用于高温合金提高高温性能。
explanation_en: Iron and niobium alloy, mainly used as additive for alloy, usually contain 50% -70% niobium plus tantalum. Ferroniobium is usually produced by silicothermic method or aluminothermic method, so it also contains 1.0% -3.0% silicon and 2.0% -3.8% aluminum. GB/T7737-2007 has clear regulations on the grade and chemical composition of ferroniobium. The addition of niobium to steel can significantly change the hot deformation behavior. Niobium carbonitride formed by niobium and carbon and nitrogen in steel can prevent grain growth and produce precipitation strengthening effect. Niobium can also improve the high temperature strength of steel. Therefore, silver is widely used in low alloy high strength steel to improve strength, toughness and weldability, stainless steel and heat resistant steel to improve high-temperature strength and intergranular corrosion resistance, and high temperature alloy to improve high-temperature performance.

explanation_cn: 在金属银中加入金属锆制成的固溶型铌锆合金;若合金中加入0.1%的碳，还会在合金中析出弥散的碳化物相。铌中加入锆后可显著提高合金的强度而不影响合金的可I加工性能，锆还可以改善合金的抗氧化性和抗碱金属腐蚀性能。先将铌粉、锆粉混合、灰型、烧结制成坯条。再采用自耗电弧熔炼、电子束熔炼或两者联合熔炼工艺制取铸锭。经过热挤压或热锻开坯，再锻造、轧制、退火制成各种型材。粉末烧结锭坯则可以直接加工成材。铌锆合金是应用最多最广的低强度铌合金。主要用于航天航空、原子能反应堆、新型电光源钠灯、低温超导等领域。
explanation_en: A solid solution niobium-zirconium alloy made by adding metallic zirconium into metallic silver; If 0.1% carbon is added to the alloy, the dispersed carbide phase will precipitate in the alloy. The addition of zirconium in niobium can significantly improve the strength of alloy without affecting the machinability of alloy. Zirconium can also improve the oxidation resistance and alkali metal corrosion resistance of alloy. First, niobium powder and zirconium powder are mixed, gray molded and sintering to make green bars. The ingots are then produced by consumable arc melting, electron beam melting or a combination of the two melting processes. After hot extrusion or hot forging blooming, forging, rolling and annealing, various profiles are made. Powder sintering ingots can be directly processed into lumber. Niobium-zirconium alloy is the most widely used low strength niobium alloy. Mainly used in fields such as aerospace, atomic reactors, new electric light source sodium lamps, and low-temperature superconductivity.

explanation_cn: 简称PMN。近年来新型的PMN基弛豫型铁电体PMN-PT或简称为PMNT材料广受瞩目。一般的生长方法为泡生法;高温溶液法;以PbO为助熔剂的高温溶液法或加PbO的Bridgman法。研究表明用改进的Bridgman法在生长大尺寸高质量的PMN-PT单晶方面更具优势。PMN-PT在相边界附近压电常数和机电耦合系数远大于目前常用的压电材料，其在医学成像设备、超声换能器、水声、压电驱动器等领域均已获得应用。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as PMN. In recent years, the new PMN based relaxor ferroelectrics PMN-PT, or PMNT materials for short, has attracted much attention. The general growth method is the soaking method; High temperature solution method method; High temperature solution method method with PbO as flux or Bridgman method with PbO added. The research shows that the improved Bridgman method has more advantages in growing large size and high-quality PMN-PT single crystal. PMN-PT's piezoelectric constant and electromechanical coupling coefficient near the phase boundary are far greater than those of the commonly used piezoelectric materials. PMN-PT has been applied in medical imaging equipment, ultrasonic transducers, underwater acoustics, piezoelectric drivers and other fields.

explanation_cn: 以铍为主要合金元素的铜合金，简称铍铜。铍铜除含铍外，一般还加镍或钴，以及Si、Al、Ti、Mg和Ag等元素。铍铜是铜合金中性能最好的高级弹性材料。有很高的强度、弹性、硬度、疲劳强度、弹性滞后小、耐蚀、耐磨、耐寒、高导电、无磁性、冲击不产生火花等一系列优良的物理、化学和力学性能。是工业中重要的材料之一。铸造铍铜含有较高的铍或钴。为改善合金的流动性。常加入少量硅，添加银吋提高导电性。其铸造性能极为优良。加入铍铜含铍量现在都控制在2%以下。镍与钴在合金中的作用都是抑制合金过早产生时效现象。加工铍铜主要用作各种高级弹性元件。特别是要求良好的传导性能、耐腐蚀、耐磨、耐寒、无磁的各种元件-大量用作膜盒、膜片、波纹管、微型开关等。铸造铍铜则用于防爆工具、各种磨具、凸轮、轴承、轴瓦、轴套、齿轮和各种电极等。铍的氧化物和粉尘对入体有害，生产和使用要注意防护。
explanation_en: Copper alloy with beryllium as the main alloy element is called beryllium copper for short. In addition to beryllium, beryllium copper generally contains nickel or cobalt, as well as elements such as Si, Al, Ti, Mg, and Ag. Beryllium copper is the best advanced elasticity materials among copper alloys. It has a series of excellent physical, chemical and mechanical properties, such as high strength, elasticity, hardness, fatigue strength, small elastic hysteresis, corrosion resistance, wear resistance, cold resistance, high conductivity, non-magnetic, impact without spark, etc. It is one of the important materials in industry. Foundry beryllium copper contains high beryllium or cobalt. To improve the flow ability of alloy. Add a small amount of silicon and silver to improve conductivity. Its castability is excellent. The addition of beryllium copper now controls the beryllium content below 2%. The role of nickel and cobalt in alloy is to inhibit premature aging of alloy. Beryllium copper is mainly used as various advanced elasticity components. Especially various components that require good conductivity, corrosion resistance, wear resistance, cold resistance, and no magnetism - widely used as bellows, diaphragms, bellows, microswitches, etc. Foundry beryllium copper is used for explosion-proof tools, various abrasives, cams, bearings, bearing shells, bearing sleeves, gears and various electrodes. The oxide and dust of beryllium are harmful to the body, and attention should be paid to protection during production and use.

explanation_cn: 以铑为基体元素，加入一种或多种元素组成的合金。常用的有：Rh-Pt系和Rh-lORu合金。Rh-10Ru为包晶组织合金，主要特点是硬度高（其铸态组织的硬度为HV136)、抗氧化、耐腐蚀、催化活性高。铑合金常用作爆鸣器的催化剂及电接触材料。
explanation_en: A alloy with rhodium as the base element and one or more elements added. The commonly used ones are Rh Pt system and Rh lORu alloy. Rh-10Ru is a peritectic alloy, which is characterized by high hardness (its as cast hardness is HV136), oxidation resistance, corrosion resistance and high catalytic activity. Rhodium alloy is commonly used as catalyst and electrical contact materials of detonator.

explanation_cn: 磷族稀土化合物超导体，超导临界温度6.0K;磁有序温度1.07K。
explanation_en: Phosphorus rare earth compound superconductor, superconductor critical temperature 6.0K; The magnetic ordering temperature is 1.07K.

explanation_cn: 铜基引线框架材料按合金元素可分为，通过固溶处理、时效处理等手段达到相应的材料性能。根据合金材料的性能特征及不同应用需求，铜基引线框架按强化类型可分为固溶型、析出型、折中型；按合金性能指标又可分为高导电铜合金、高强中导铜合金、高强高导铜合金。
explanation_en: Copper base lead frame materials can be divided into alloy elements, and the corresponding materials properties can be achieved through solution treatment, aging treatment and other means. According to the performance characteristics of alloy materials and different application requirements, copper based leads frames can be divided into solid solution type, precipitation type and folding type according to the strengthening type; According to the performance index of alloy, it can be divided into high conductive copper alloy, high strength and middle conductive copper alloy and high strength and high conduction copper alloy.

explanation_cn: 主要通过粉末冶金工艺制造的以铜或铜合金为主要基体组元，主要承受摩擦作用的一些制品，对零件的主要要求是它们的减摩性能，即表征减摩性能主要特征的摩擦系数低、磨合性好，卡轴、黏性、焊接的趋向性小?具有良好的耐磨性能。铜基摩擦材料工艺性较好，摩擦系数稳定，抗黏、抗卡性好，湿式工作条件下耐磨性优良，常用于油中工作。铜基烧结材料主要是烧结青铜、烧结黄铜和烧结锌白铜。铜基烧结材料耐大气腐蚀?与钢件组成摩擦副时，具有优异的减摩性、导电性与导热性，且无磁性。
explanation_en: Some products mainly manufactured by powder metallurgy process with copper or copper alloy as the main matrix component and mainly bearing the friction effect, the main requirement for the parts is their antifriction performance, that is, the main characteristics of the antifriction performance are low friction coefficient, good running in, and small tendency of shaft clamping, viscosity, and weld? Has good wear resistance. Copper-based friction materials has good processability, stable friction coefficient, good resistance to sticking and sticking, and excellent wear resistance under wet working conditions. It is commonly used in oil. Copper based sintering materials are mainly sintering bronze, sintering brass and sintering zinc white copper. Copper based sintering materials resistant to atmospheric corrosion? When forming a friction pair with steel parts, it has excellent friction reduction, conductivity, and thermal conductivity, and is non magnetic.

explanation_cn: 含金属铜粉的厚膜导体浆料。厚膜铜导体浆料有如下特性：①导电性好随着烧成温度的提高，它的方块电阻值下降。②黏结强度较高.使用200目丝网印刷获得的较厚膜层，有较高的黏结强度.③焊接性能好，可采用锡铅焊料，对多次焊接而言，铜导体的抗焊溶性优于含银或含金导体。经多次焊接后，进人熔融焊料中的铜量很少。铜导体浆料的制备是用有机载体把铜粉和作为黏结剂的玻璃粉以及其他固体材料混合分散成膏状浆料。铜浆料是比较便宜的一种浆料，但烧成温度较高，而且要求保护气氛。铜浆料已经获得应用，如用于制造金属化层，也可用于多层布线。
explanation_en: Conductive paste for thick film containing metallic copper powder. The thick film copper paste has the following characteristics: ① good conductivity. With the increase of firing temperature, its block resistance decreases. ② The bonding strength is high. The thicker film layer obtained by using 200 mesh screen printing has a higher bonding strength Weld performance is good, and tin-lead solder can be used. For multiple weld, the solderability of copper conductor is better than that of silver or gold containing conductor. After many times of weld, the amount of copper entering the molten solder is very small. The preparation of copper paste is to use organic carrier to mix and disperse copper powder, glass powder as adhesive and other solid materials into paste paste. Copper slurry is a relatively inexpensive type of slurry, but it has a higher firing temperature and requires a protective atmosphere. Copper slurry has been applied, such as for manufacturing metallized layers and also for multi-layer wiring.

explanation_cn: 又称高温超导体。以铜氧面为特征的化合物超导体。它们大多数具有派生的层状类钙钛矿型结构.具有单层或多层的二维Cu()2平面，故也有称层状结构氧化物超导体，而一般是以铜为主要元素的多元结构氧化物；具有典型的各向异性特征。典型的铜氧化物超导体家族分为La系、Y系、Bi系、T1系、Hg系等这些系的超导体的电荷载流子为空穴，称"空穴型超导体"。对Nd系，如钕铈铜氧体系(这里Nd可为一些镧系元素代替，其电荷载流子为电子，称"电子型超导体"。铜氧化物超导体是目前最具实用价值潜力的超导体系，其中，REBCO(RE代表稀土元素）、K2223和Bi2212等是被公认的实用超导材料。低成本高性能的第二代高温超导带材(REBCO)是目前实用超导材料领域研究的热点。
explanation_en: It is also called high-temperature superconductor. Compound superconductor characterized by copper oxide surface. Most of them have derived layered perovskite like structures. They have single-layer or multi-layer two-dimensional Cu () 2 planes, so they are also known as layered oxide superconductors. Generally, they are multi layered oxide structures with copper as the main element; It has typical anisotropic characteristics. The typical cuprate oxides superconductor family is divided into La system, Y system, Bi system, T1 system, Hg system, etc. The charge carriers of these superconductors are holes, which are called "hole type superconductors". For Nd systems, such as neodymium cerium copper oxide system (where Nd can be replaced by some lanthanide elements, whose charge carriers are electrons, called "electronic superconductors"), cuprate oxides superconductor are the most promising superconductors with practical value at present, among which REBCO (RE represents rare earth elements), K2223 and Bi2212 are recognized as practical superconducting materials. Low cost and high performance second generation high temperature superconducting tape (REBCO) is a research hotspot in the field of practical superconducting materials.

explanation_cn: 以铜为着色元素在还原气氛中烧成的红釉瓷器，是中国传统颜色釉名|贵品种之一。铜红釉对烧成过程中气氛的变化极为敏感。基础釉的化学组成、釉层厚度、烧成温度、着色剂的颗粒度等因素对色调也有较大影响。元末明初景德镇开始烧造通体一色的红釉器。永乐、宣德时铜红釉的烧制技术水平登峰造极。所出红釉色调纯正，不流釉，不开片，称为鲜红，又称宝石红或祭红；其器口脱釉，称为灯草边。明代中期技术失传，至清康熙时才得以恢复。除祭红外.清康熙时还烧制成郎窑红和豇豆红等新品种。郎窑红在欧洲又名牛血红，是铜红袖中最鲜绝的一种易流动，色调由上而下逐渐加深，相传是康熙年间江西巡抚郎廷极主持景德窑务时所烧，故得名。豇豆红酷似豇豆的红色，故得名。豇豆红也有好几个品种，色凋较淡的称为桃花片、美人醉或美人霁.粉红中有绿点的称苔点绿，色调晦暗浑浊的称为乳鼠皮，带红块的称孩儿脸。豇豆红器无大件，多见小型的瓶、尊、盂、印盒等文房用具，均为官窑产品。永乐、宣德的鲜红，康熙的祭红、郎窑红、豇豆红，其基础釉的配方、施釉方法烧成方法都不一样。
explanation_en: Red glaze porcelain, which is fired in a reducing atmosphere with copper as the coloring element, is one of the famous and valuable varieties of Chinese traditional colored glaze. Copper red glaze is very sensitive to the change of atmosphere during firing. The chemical composition of the basic glaze, the thickness of the glaze layer, the firing temperature, the particle size of the colorant and other factors also have a greater impact on the hue. At the end of the Yuan Dynasty and the beginning of the Ming Dynasty, Jingdezhen began to burn red glaze wares in one color. The firing technology of Yongle and Xuande copper red glaze reached the peak. The red glaze produced is pure in color, does not flow glaze, does not open, and is called bright red, also known as gems red or sacrificial red; Its mouth is off glaze, which is called lamp grass edge. In the mid Ming Dynasty, technology was lost and only recovered during the Kangxi reign of the Qing Dynasty. In addition to sacrificial infrared, new varieties such as Langyao Red and Cowpea Red were also fired during the Kangxi reign of the Qing Dynasty. Langyao Red, also known as Ox Blood Red in Europe, is the freshest and most easily flowing type of copper red sleeves. Its color tone gradually deepens from top to bottom. It is said that it was burned by Jiangxi Governor Lang Tingji during the Kangxi period when he presided over the Jingde kiln, hence its name. Cowpea red resembles the red color of cowpea, hence its name. There are also several varieties of cowpea red, with lighter shades called peach blossom flakes, beauty drunk or beauty ji. Those with green dots in pink are called moss green, those with dark and cloudy tones are called suckling rat skin, and those with red patches are called child face. Cowpea red ware has no large items, and small stationery items such as bottles, statues, bowls, and printing boxes are commonly seen, all of which are official kiln products. The bright red of Yongle and Xuande, the sacrificial red, Langyao red and cowpea red of Kangxi are different in the formula of basic glaze and the firing method of applying glaze.

explanation_cn: 用于衡量低温超导线材特征参数的指标。低温超导线材通常由超导材料、铜基体和其他阻挡层材料组成，铜超比指超导线材横截面中Cu的面积与超导体面积的比值.铜超比通常用于衡量超导体体积在超导线材中所占的比值。
explanation_en: The index used to measure the characteristic parameters of low-temperature superconducting wire rod. Low temperature superconducting wire rod is usually composed of superconducting materials, copper matrix and other barrier materials. The copper-superconductor ratio refers to the ratio of the area of copper in the cross section of the superconducting material to the area of the superconductor. The copper-superconductor ratio is usually used to measure the ratio of the volume of superconductor in the superconducting wire rod.

explanation_cn: 含水的层状结构磷酸盐矿物。加热失水后，变成不透明的变铜铀云母。四方晶系.空间群Clh-P4/n。晶体呈板状或短柱状；集合体呈鱗片状或被膜状。姜黄色、祖母绿或苹果绿色。条痕色比颜色浅。玻璃光泽.解理面呈珍珠光泽。具强放射性。紫外线下发黄绿色荧光。产于原生铀矿床氧化带，从较酸性溶液中结晶而成，与钙铀云母、翠砷铜铀矿、翠铀矿等次生铀矿物及褐铁矿、硬锰矿等共生。是提取铀的矿物原料和寻找原生铀矿的良好标志。
explanation_en: A layered phosphate mineral with water content. After heating and dehydration, it turns into opaque metatorbernite. Tetragonal crystal system. space group Clh-P4/n. The crystal is tabular or short columnar; Aggregates are in the form of scales or membranes. Ginger, emerald or apple green. The stripe color is lighter than the color. Glass luster. The cleavage surface is pearly luster. Highly radioactive. Yellow green fluorescence under ultraviolet light. It occurs in the oxidation zone of primary uranium deposits, crystallized from relatively acidic solutions, and coexists with autunite, emerald arsenopyrite, emerald uranium ore and other secondary uranium minerals, as well as limonite, xonotlite, etc. It is a good sign for extracting raw mineral material of uranium and searching for primary uranium ore.

explanation_cn: 不是一种独立矿物，是细分散多矿物集合体，由三水铝石、一水硬铝石、一水软铝石、赤铁矿、黏土矿物、SiO2胶体等多种矿物组成。此外成分中还有Ga、Nb、Ta、Ti、Zr等稀有元素。常呈致密块状、鲕状、豆状。颜色多变，灰色、黄灰、褐红、黑灰均可见。无光泽。是含铝较多的岩石在湿热条件下风化的产物，或经胶体沉淀而成。是提取铝的主要矿物原料，也是提取镓的主要原料。
explanation_en: It is not an independent mineral, but a collection of subdivided scattered minerals, consisting of gibbsite, diaspore, boehmite, hematite, clay mineral, SiO2 colloid and other minerals. In addition, rare elements such as Ga, Nb, Ta, Ti, Zr are also present in the composition. It is often in the form of dense blocks, oolites, or beans. The colors are variable, with gray, yellow gray, brownish red, and black gray visible. Matte. It is the product of weathering of rock with more aluminum under humid and hot conditions, or formed by colloid precipitation. It is the main raw mineral material for extracting aluminum and the main raw material for extracting gallium.

explanation_cn: 以Al2O3和C为主要成分的耐火制品。其耐火度高、化学稳定性好、耐侵蚀、热震稳定性好。主要用作滑动水口滑板、连铸中间包整体塞棒、浸入式水口、长水口、铁水预处理用包衬等。
explanation_en: Refractory products mainly composed of Al2O3 and C. It has high refractoriness, good chemical stability, corrosion resistance and thermal shock resistance. It is mainly used as sliding plate of slide nozzle, integral stopper of continuous casting tundish, submerged nozzle, long nozzle, ladle lining for hot metal pretreatment, etc.

explanation_cn: 铝热剂是把铝粉和三氧化二铁粉末按一定比例配成的呈粉红色的混合物。当用引燃剂点燃后，反应猛烈进行气体产物少，火焰小，得到反应产物氧化铝和单质铁，并放出大量的热，燃烧温度可达3000°C，反应生成的热熔渣对金属有较强的熔化能力。用某些金属氧化物代替氧化铁。也可以做铝热剂。铝粉跟这些金属氧化物反应时，产生足够的热量，使被还原的金属在较高温度下呈熔融状态，与形成的熔渣分离开来，从而获得较纯的金属。在工业上常用这种方法冶炼难熔的金属，如钒、铬、锰等。铝热剂除了焊轨、冶炼难熔金属以外，在军事上也有广泛的应用，如在炮弹头一端装进铝热剂成分，可极大地提高灼热杀伤力。
explanation_en: Thermite is a pink mixture of aluminium powder and ferric oxide powder in a certain proportion. When ignited with a pilot agent, the reaction proceeds violently with less gas products and small flame. The reaction product aluminum oxide and simple iron are obtained, and a large amount of heat is released. The combustion temperature can reach 3000 ° C. The hot slag generated by the reaction has a strong melting capacity for metals. Replace iron oxide with certain metal oxides. It can also be used as thermite. When aluminium powder reacts with these metal oxides, it generates enough heat to make the reduced metal melt at a higher temperature and separate from the formed slag, so as to obtain more pure metal. This method is commonly used in industry to smelting refractory metals, such as vanadium, chromium, manganese, etc. In addition to welding rails and smelting refractory metals, thermite has also been widely used in military affairs. For example, thermite can greatly improve the scorching lethality by filling one end of the gun warhead with thermite.

explanation_cn: 以铜镍合金为基加入铝形成的合金。在铜镍合金中，化合物Ni3Al从间溶体中析出，导致明显的沉淀硬化，从而提高合金的强度、硬度和耐蚀性。但使合金加工性能变坏。加人少量的锰(5%)可以提高合金的塑性，改善加工性能合金性能与合金中镍量和铝量的比例有关,Ni:Al=10:1时，合金性能最好，例如Cu-16Ni-5Mn-2Al-1Fe的合金，强度、塑性都好，耐蚀性和焊接性能优良。拉伸强度可达74OMPa，伸长率为2.5%。这种合金可用作舰船材料，经热加工空冷后，不需重新淬火，即可自行沉淀硬化。常用的铝白铜有Cu-6Ni-1.5Al，Cu-13Ni-3Al等，主要用于造船、电力、化工等工业部门中各种高强耐蚀件。
explanation_en: A alloy formed by adding aluminum to a copper nickel alloy. In Cu Ni alloy, compound Ni3Al precipitates from the interstitial solution, leading to obvious precipitation hardening, thus improving the strength, hardness and corrosion resistance of alloy. But the processing property of alloy deteriorates. Adding a small amount of manganese (5%) can improve the plasticity of alloy, and improve the workability. The performance of alloy is related to the proportion of nickel and aluminum in alloy. When Ni: Al=10:1, alloy has the best performance. For example, Cu-16Ni-5Mn-2Al-1Fe alloy has good strength and plasticity, corrosion resistance and weld performance. The tensile strength can reach 74OMPa and the elongation is 2.5%. This alloy can be used as a materials for ships. After hot working and air cooling, it can be precipitation hardened without re quenching. The commonly used aluminium white copper includes Cu-6Ni-1.5Al, Cu-13Ni-3Al, etc. It is mainly used for various high-strength corrosion resistant parts in shipbuilding, power, chemical and other industrial sectors.

explanation_cn: 即RO-AL2O3-SiO2系统玻璃。R是二价元素，通常在RO-A12O3-SiO2系统的共熔点状态，添加少量B2O3,Na2O，K2O等便成为铝硅酸盐玻璃。
explanation_en: That is, RO-AL2O3-SiO2 system glass. R is a divalent element. Usually, in the common melting point state of RO-A12O3-SiO2 system, a small amount of B2O3, Na2O, K2O, etc. is added to form aluminosilicate glass.

explanation_en: Paper made by pasting and bonding aluminum foil onto aluminum foil backing paper. Avoid light and moisture, used for packaging cigarettes, food, candies, etc.
