explanation_cn: 以铝为主要吋燃剂的点火药，具有耐高温性能。铝粉质轻，密度2.55g/cm3,燃烧热为30564J/g,金属铝表面的氧化膜膜透明且有很好的化学稳定性，氧化生成物三氧化二铝的熔点为2030°C，纯度99.5%的铝的熔点为685°C，沸点2065°C。铝系点火药的点火能力强，发火点较高，但需用引燃剂引燃。常见的铝系点火药为由70%铝和30%高氯酸钾组成的点火药。
explanation_en: Ignition composition with aluminum as the main igniting agent has high temperature resistance. The aluminum powder is light, with a density of 2.55g/cm3, a combustion heat of 30564J/g, and the oxide film on the metal aluminum surface is transparent and has good chemical stability. The melting point of the oxidation product aluminum oxide is 2030 ° C, and the melting point of the 99.5% purity aluminum is 685 ° C, and the boiling point is 2065 ° C. explanation_cn: 铝薄膜用作电容器的电极、电阻器的端头、电感器螺旋导电带、多层布线。其主要优点是:导电性好(lOOnm厚度时，方阻为0.33Ω)，成膜工艺简单，无需用别的金属"打底"，与硅铝丝、金丝的可焊性好，成本低。由于它表面易氧化，有利于提高多层布线的层间绝缘性。所以，目前在薄膜多层布线中，应用较多的薄膜导电材料还是铝膜。铝膜的缺点是:①抗电迁移能力较弱；②与金形成脆性的金属间化合物，造成焊点脱开，影响元件和电路的可靠性；③铝膜表面的氧化层给锡焊带来困难。
explanation_en: The aluminum film is used as the electrode of the capacitor, the end of the resistor, the spiral conductive belt of the inductor, and multi-layer wiring. Its main advantages are: good conductivity (with a square resistance of 0.33 Ω at a thickness of lOOnm), simple film forming process, no need for other metals to "base", good weldability with silicon aluminum wire and gold wire, and low cost. Due to its easy oxidation on the surface, it is beneficial to improve the interlayer insulation of multi-layer wiring. Therefore, aluminum film is the most widely used thin film conductive material in thin film multilayer wiring. The disadvantages of aluminum film are: ① weak resistance to electromigration; ② The imermetallif compound, which forms brittleness with gold, causes the disconnection of solder joints and affects the reliability of components and circuits; ③ The oxide layer on the surface of the aluminum film brings difficulties to soldering.

explanation_cn: 化学式为YAlO3。简称YAP。属于斜方晶系，具有畸变的钙钛矿型结构。点群bzh-mmm，空间群Pbnm。由于YAP晶体结构的各向异性，故不同轴向的晶体性能差异很大。c轴晶体储能高，适于脉冲激光工作，输出波长为1.064μm。b轴晶体增益高，适于连续激光工作，输出波长1.079μm。YAP晶体输出激光为线性偏振，其理化性能接近YAG，但是与YAG相比，其激光性能不太理想，应用也有限。这类晶体常用提拉法生长。
explanation_en: The chemical formula is YAlO3. Abbreviated as YAP. It belongs to the rhombic crystal system and has a distorted perovskite type structure. Point group bzh mm, spatial group Pbnm. Due to the anisotropy of YAP crystal structure, the properties of crystal with different axial directions vary greatly. C-axis crystal has high energy storage and is suitable for pulsed laser operation, with output wavelength of 1.064 μ M. High gain of b-axis crystal, suitable for continuous laser operation, output wavelength 1.079 μ M. The output laser of YAP crystal is linearly polarized, and its physical and chemical properties are close to that of YAG. However, compared with YAG, its laser performance is not ideal, and its application is limited. This kind of crystal is usually grown by pulling method method.

name_en: calcium activated by europium and neodymium
explanation_cn: 化学式CaAl2O4t:Eu2+，Nd3+白色粉末，单斜晶系。激发光谱为双峰宽带激发，其主峰在350nm左右，在265nm左右还有一个小的肩峰。在紫外线激发下，发射光谱为单峰宽带发射，最大发射峰值约为445mn。CaAl204:Eu2+，Nd3+是一种稳定、高效的蓝紫色长余辉发光材料，这种材料无放射性，使其在隐蔽照明、信息存储和高能探测等领域具有重要的应用价值。
explanation_en: Chemical formula: CaAl2O4t: Eu2+, Nd3+white powder, monoclinic system. The excitation spectrum is a double peak broadband excitation, with the main peak at about 350 nm and a small shoulder peak at about 265 nm. Under the excitation of ultraviolet ray, the emission spectrum is a single peak broadband emission, and the maximum emission peak is about 445mn. CaAl204: Eu2+, Nd3+is a stable and efficient blue purple long afterglow luminescent material. This materials is non radioactive, which makes it have important application value in the fields of covert lighting, information storage and high-energy detection.

name_en: barium calcium aluminate activated by terbium
explanation_cn: 化学式Ba5CaAI4O12:Tb3+，浅黄色粉末。其激发谱是一个峰值位于239nm的宽峰。相应的发射谱由位于489nm、543nm、550nm、587nm、623nm的窄带组成。最强发射峰位于5nm，从而呈现绿光发射。荧光粉的发光强度随着Tb:n浓度的增加，先增强后减弱。是一种适用于UVLED芯片激发的高效绿色荧光粉。
explanation_en: Chemical formula: Ba5CaAI4O12: Tb3+, light yellow powder. The excitation spectrum is a broad peak with a peak located at 239nm. The corresponding emission spectrum consists of narrow bands located at 489nm, 543nm, 550nm, 587nm, and 623nm. The strongest emission peak is located at 5nm, resulting in green emission. The luminous intensity of phosphor increases first and then decreases with the increase of Tb: n concentration. It is an efficient green phosphor suitable for UVLED chip excitation.

explanation_en: The chemical formula SrAl2O4: Eu2+. White powder, hexagonal system, excitation band at 200-450nm, a broadband excitation. The maximum excitation peak is around 254nm-364nm. Under UV excitation, it emits a broadband green light of approximately 523nm. The phosphor matches the excitation spectrum of the near ultraviolet InGaN chip phase, and has been applied to near ultraviolet white luminescence diodes.

name_en: strontium aluminate activated by europium and dysprosium
explanation_cn: 化学式SrAl2O4:Eu2+，Dy3+(SED)单斜晶系，激发带位于300-500nm，为一宽带激发，最大激发峰在365nm左右。在紫外线激发下。发射光谱的峰值约为520nm，余辉时间可达12h以上。SED这种发光材料的发光颜色和入眼视觉函数相近。是应用范围最广的夜光材料之一。

Under UV excitation. The peak value of the emission spectrum is about 520nm, and the afterglow time can reach more than 12h. The luminescence color of the luminescence materials SED is close to the visual function. It is one of the most widely used luminous materials.

name_en: lanthanum strontium aluminate activated by europium

explanation_en: The chemical formula LaSrAl3O7: Eu2+. White powder. The tetragonal crystal system has excitation bands at 300-450nm, with peaks at 360nm, 394nm, and 411nm, respectively. The emission spectrum consists of a broadband peak at 517nm. Present green light emission. It can be effectively excited by near ultraviolet (300-450nm) and is an excellent green phosphor for white light LED.

explanation_cn: 是以锂元素为主合金元素或含有锂元素的铝合金。锂(Li)是自然界最轻的金属,密度仅为O.534g/cm3。在铝合金中加入金属元素Li,在降低合金密度的同时，可大幅度提高合金的弹性模量。铝锂合金因其密度低、刚度高等特点，引起了材料工作者的极大兴趣，铝锂合金的研究和开发已有7O多年历史。其发展大致可分为三个阶段，相应出现的铝锂合金产品也可以划分为三代。第一阶段为初步发展阶段，在此阶段，美国Alcoa公司成功研制出2020合金，前苏联幵发出BA23合金。20世纪70年代，铝锂合金研制进人第二阶段，在此阶段研制成功的铝锂合金主要有前苏联的1420铝锂合金、美国Alcoa公司的2090合金、英国Alcan公司的8090和8091合金、法国Puchiney公司的2091合金等。由于第二代铝锂合金存在各向异性严重、塑轫性水平较低、热暴露后会严重损失韧性、大部分合金不可焊，综合性能难以与现有2000系、7000系铝合金竞争，除前苏联的1420合金外，大部分第二代铝锂合金未获得大量应用。进入20世纪90年代以后，美国、法国和俄罗斯总结过去铝锂合金研究的基础上，根据新的应用需求背景，开发出了一系列具有高综合性能的铝锂合金。近十年来在美国铝业协会注册的新型铝锂合金主要有2097,2197、2297、2397、2099、2199以及2195、2196、2098、2198和2050等牌号，这些新出现的铝锂合金可统称为第代铝锂合金。
explanation_en: It is an aluminum alloy with lithium as the main element of alloy or containing lithium. Lithium (Li) is the lightest metal in nature, with a density of only 0.534g/cm3. Adding metallic element Li to aluminum alloy can greatly increase elastic modulus of alloy while reducing density of alloy. Because of its low density and high stiffness, aluminum lithium alloy has aroused great interest of materials workers. The research and development of aluminum lithium alloy has a history of more than 70 years. Its development can be roughly divided into three stages, and the corresponding aluminum lithium alloy products can also be divided into three generations. The first stage is the preliminary development stage. In this stage, American Alcoa Company successfully developed 2020 alloy and the former Soviet Union developed BA23 alloy. In the 1970s, the development of aluminum lithium alloy entered the second stage. The aluminum lithium alloy successfully developed in this stage mainly included 1420 aluminum lithium alloy of the former Soviet Union, 2090 alloy of American Alcoa, 8090 and 8091 alloy of British Alcan, 2091 alloy of French Puchiney, etc. Because the second generation aluminum lithium alloy has serious anisotropy, low plastic toughness, severe loss of toughness after heat exposure, and most alloy are not weldable, it is difficult to compete with the existing 2000 series and 7000 series aluminum alloy in comprehensive performance. Except 1420 alloy in the former Soviet Union, most of the second generation aluminum lithium alloy have not been widely used. Since the 1990s, the United States, France and Russia have developed a series of aluminum lithium alloy with high comprehensive properties based on the past research of aluminum lithium alloy and the new application demand background. The new aluminum lithium alloy registered with the American Aluminum Association in the past decade mainly include 20972197, 2297, 2397, 2099, 2199, 2195, 2196, 2098, 2198 and 2050, and these new aluminum lithium alloy can be collectively referred to as the generation aluminum lithium alloy.

It is mainly used for ultra high power electric furnace and secondary refining furnace.

explanation_cn: 镓铝砷是一种化学物质。镓通常是作为从铝土矿中提取铝或从锌矿石中提取锌时的副产物得到的或在自然界中常以微量分散于铝于矿、闪锌矿等矿石中。由铝土矿中提取制得。工业炼铝的方法主要原理是霍尔-埃鲁铝电解法：以纯净的氧化铝为原料采用电解制铝 ，因纯净的氧化铝熔点高（约2045℃），很难熔化，所以工业上都用熔化的冰晶石(Na3AlF6)作熔剂,使氧化铝在1000℃左右溶解在液态的冰晶石中，成为冰晶石和氧化铝的熔融体，然后在电解槽中，用碳块作阴阳两极，进行电解。砷主要以硫化物矿形式存在，有雄黄（As4S4）、雌黄（As2S3）、砷黄铁矿（FeAsS）等。由三氧化二砷用碳还原而制得。
explanation_en: Gallium aluminum arsenic is a chemical substance. Gallium is usually obtained as a by-product of extracting aluminum from bauxite or zinc from zinc ore, or it is often dispersed in ores such as aluminum ore and sphalerite in trace amounts in nature. It is extracted from bauxite. The main principle of industrial aluminum smelting method is the Hall Elu aluminum electrolysis method: pure aluminum oxide is used as raw material to produce aluminum by electrolysis. Because pure aluminum oxide has a high melting point (about 2045 ℃), it is difficult to melt, so in industry, molten cryolite (Na3AlF6) is used as the flux, so that aluminum oxide can be dissolved in liquid cryolite at about 1000 ℃, becoming a molten body of cryolite and aluminum oxide, and then carbon blocks are used as the cathode and anode in the electrolytic cell, Conduct electrolysis. Arsenic mainly exists in the form of sulfide ore, including realgar (As4S4), orpiment (As2S3), arsenopyrite (FeAsS), etc. Made by reducing arsenic trioxide with carbon.

explanation_cn: 以铝为主要合金元素的铜合金。铝青铜又分为简单铝青铜和复杂铝铜。铜铝二元合金称为简单铝青铜，含有其他合金元素的铜铝合金为复杂铝青铜。铝青铜有好的力学件能、高的耐蚀性能、耐磨性能和耐寒性能。冲击时不产生火花、流动性好，偏析倾向小。主要用作各种弹性元件，高强度零件、耐磨零件、轴承、轴瓦、轴套、齿轮、涡轮、内衬、螺母、法兰盘等。铝青铜可以气焊、电焊，但不易钎焊。
explanation_en: Copper alloy with aluminum as the main alloy element. Aluminium bronze can be divided into simple aluminium bronze and complex aluminum bronze. The copper aluminum binary alloy is called simple aluminium bronze, and the copper aluminum alloy containing other alloy elements is called complex aluminium bronze. Aluminium bronze has good mechanical properties, high corrosion resistance, wear resistance and cold resistance. No spark, good flow ability and low segregation tendency during impact. Mainly used as various elastic components, high-strength parts, wear-resistant parts, bearings, bearing shells, shaft sleeves, gears, turbines, liners, nuts, flanges, etc. Aluminium bronze can be gas welded and electric welded, but it is not easy to soldering.

explanation_cn: 在铜锌合金基础上，加入铝的黄铜。锏锌合金中添加铝能显著缩小α相区，增大β相区，具有较强的强化效果。铝含量增高时，将出现γ相，虽能提高合金强度，但使塑性剧烈下降，一般将含铝量控制在3.5%以下。铝黄铜表面铝的离子化倾向比锌大，优先与腐蚀性气体或溶液中的氧结合，形成坚硬致密的氧化膜，提高了对气体、溶液，特别是高速海水的耐腐蚀性。按合金的含锌量而分有单相α铝黄铜和（α+β）两相铝黄铜。77Cu-21Zn-2Al为单相a铝黄铜，具有优良的冷加工性能，加入微量As、Sb、P、B、Si、Ni等元素，可进一步提高合金的耐蚀性，广泛用于舰船，海滨热电站用冷凝管及其他耐浊件。在这种合金中，镁与锡是有害杂质，导致合金耐浊性下降，故要求镁、锡含量各不大于0.01%。(a+β)铝黄铜的典型代表为60Cu-38Zn-lAl-lFe,具有较高的强度及耐蚀性，能承受热压力加工，用于制作齿轮、涡轮、衬套及要求耐蚀的零件，在海水中工作的高强度耐蚀零件。
explanation_en: Brass with aluminum added on the basis of copper zinc alloy. The addition of aluminum in zinc alloy can significantly reduce the α Phase area, increased β Phase region has a strong strengthening effect. When the aluminum content increases, there will be γ Although phase can improve the strength of alloy, it can sharply reduce the plasticity. Generally, the aluminum content is controlled below 3.5%. The ionization tendency of aluminum on the surface of aluminium brass is greater than that of zinc. It preferentially combines with the oxygen in corrosive gas or solution to form a hard and dense oxide film, which improves the corrosion resistance to gas and solution, especially high-speed seawater. Single phase according to the zinc content of alloy α Aluminium brass and（ α+β） Two phase aluminium brass. 77Cu-21Zn-2Al is a single-phase aluminium brass, which has excellent cold workability. Adding trace elements such as As, Sb, P, B, Si, Ni, etc., can further improve the corrosion resistance of alloy, and is widely used in condensing tubes and other turbidity resistant parts for ships, coastal thermal power stations. In this alloy, magnesium and tin are harmful impurities, which lead to the decrease of turbidity resistance of alloy. Therefore, the content of magnesium and tin is required to be no more than 0.01% respectively. (a)+ β) The typical representative of aluminium brass is 60Cu-38Zn-lAl-lFe, which has high strength and corrosion resistance, can withstand hot pressure processing, and is used to make gears, turbines, bushings and parts requiring corrosion resistance, as well as high-strength corrosion resistant parts working in seawater.

explanation_cn: 做焊料用的铟银易熔合金，银钎料的钎焊接头强度较大，主要用于连接强度要求较高的金属构件。
explanation_en: Indium silver fusible alloy used as solder, silver brazing filler metal soldering joint strength is larger, mainly used to connect metal components with higher strength requirements.

explanation_cn: 用原子能级铪制作的棒状控制元件。铪不仅对热中子和超热中子都有高的吸收截面，而且是长寿命的中子吸收体，特别适用于水冷堆。但铪稀缺、昂贵.因而使用受到限制。
explanation_en: A rod like control element made of atomic energy level hafnium. Hafnium not only has a high absorption cross-section for both thermal and epithermal neutrons, but also is a long-lived neutron absorber, particularly suitable for water-cooled reactors. However, hafnium is scarce and expensive, which limits its use.

explanation_cn: 参见锆石。
explanation_en: See zircon.

explanation_cn: 这是目前用得最多的多层薄膜。主要用作电阻的端头、可连线、微带线、单层薄膜电感器、薄膜电容上电极和焊区。在Cr-Au多层膜中，Cr膜主要起黏附作用，Au膜主要起导电和焊接作用。在高温下，Cr-Au两层薄膜间的互扩散现象严重。
explanation_en: This is currently the most commonly used multi-layer thin film. Mainly used as terminals for resistors, interconnects, microstrip lines, single-layer thin film inductors, electrodes on thin film capacitors, and solder joints. In Cr Au multilayers, Cr film mainly plays the role of adhesion, and Au film mainly plays the role of conduction and weld. At high temperature, the mutual diffusion between Cr Au films is serious.

explanation_cn: 采用多次蒸发工艺制得的Cr-Cu-Ni-Au(简称CCNA)薄膜，其性能与TCNA相似。TCNA和CCNA薄膜虽然性能好、成本低，但工艺复杂。
explanation_en: The performance of Cr Cu Ni Au (CCNA) thin films prepared by multiple evaporation processes is similar to that of TCNA. Although TCNA and CCNA thin films have good performance and low cost, their processes are complex.

explanation_cn: 主要矿物组成是αAl2O3和Cr203同溶体，次要组成是少量复合尖晶石或不含复合尖晶石的耐火砖。按生产工艺分,铬刚玉砖有三种：熔铸铬刚玉砖、烧结铬刚玉砖、浇注成型砖。
explanation_en: The main mineral composition is α Al2O3 and Cr203 are the same solution, and the secondary component is a small amount of composition spinel or refractory brick without composition spinel. According to the production process, there are three kinds of corundum-chrome brick: cast corundum-chrome brick, sintering corundum-chrome brick, and pouring molding bricks.

explanation_cn: 由铬矿制成的含Cr2O3>30%的耐火制品。高温下酸性和碱性熔渣对铬砖的作用很弱，主要用于有色冶炼炉。该制品在氧化气氛和碱性熔渣中会产生有毒Cr6+。
explanation_en: Refractory products made from chromium ore containing Cr2O3>30%. At high temperature, the acid and alkaline slag has a weak effect on chrome brick and is mainly used in non-ferrous smelting furnace. This product will produce toxic Cr6+in oxidizing atmosphere and alkaline slag.

name_cn: 铬离子敏化钕石榴石晶体
name_en: neodymium doped garnet crystal with chromium ion as a sensitizer
explanation_cn: 用Cr3+作为石榴石型结构晶体中Nd3+的敏化剂的激光晶体材料。
explanation_en: Cr3+is used as the sensitizer of Nd3+in garnet type crystal, which is a laser crystal materials.

explanation_cn: 主要用作合金兀素添加剂的铁和铬的合金，铬含量通常为55%-67%,质硬而脆。可分为高碳铬铁（碳含量6.0%-10.0%)、中碳铬铁（碳含量1.0%-4.0%)、低碳铬铁（碳含量0.25%-0.50%)和微碳铬铁（碳含量0.03%-0.15%)、真空法微碳铬铁（碳含量0.01%-0.10%),后四种又称为精炼铬铁。碳含量越低生产成本越高。铬铁采用铬铁矿石、硅石、焦炭、萤石等为原料在电炉中冶炼生产，精炼方法则有脱碳法和脱硅法，脱硅法中电硅热法主要用于生产微碳铬铁，而采用真空同态脱碳法可生产碳含量更低的真空法微碳铬铁。
explanation_en: Iron and alloy of chromium, mainly used as alloy additive, with chromium content of 55% -67%, which is hard and brittle. It can be divided into high carbon ferrochromium (carbon content 6.0% -10.0%), medium carbon ferrochromium (carbon content 1.0% -4.0%), low carbon ferrochromium (carbon content 0.25% -0.50%) and micro carbon ferrochromium (carbon content 0.03% -0.15%), vacuum micro carbon ferrochromium (carbon content 0.01% -0.10%), and the last four are also called refining ferrochromium. The lower the carbon content, the higher the production cost. Ferrochromium is smelting in electric furnace with ferrochromium ore, silica, coke, fluorite, etc. as raw materials. The refining methods include decarbonization and desilication. In the desilication method, the electro silicothermic method is mainly used to produce low-carbon ferrochromium, while the vacuum homomorphic decarbonization method can produce vacuum low-carbon ferrochromium with lower carbon content.

explanation_cn: 配位型氧化物矿物。化学式为(Mg,Fe)Cr2O4，含Mn、Ti、V、Zn的类质同象混入物。等轴晶系。正尖晶石型结构。多呈粒状集合体。黑色、褐黑色。条痕褐色至浅褐色，半金属光泽，无解理，有时可见到平行的裂开。
explanation_en: Coordination type oxide minerals. The chemical formula is (Mg, Fe) Cr2O4, a homogeneous mixture containing Mn, Ti, V, and Zn. Equiaxed crystal system. Ortho spinel structure. Mostly present as granular aggregates. Black, brown black. Striped brown to light brown, semi metallic luster, without cleavage, sometimes parallel cracks can be seen.

explanation_cn: 以铬为主要合金元素的铜合金。铬明显提高合金的力学性能，但使合金的导电性略有降低。所以铬青铜具有一定强度和硬度.和很好的导电性能，同时具有很好的耐热性和耐磨性。冷热加工性能优良，可以加工成各种规格的材料。多用于制造室温和高温下工作的弹性元件及耐磨耐热零件。由于高温性能优良，铬青铜大量用来制造电焊电极材料。
explanation_en: A copper alloy with chromium as the main alloy element. Chromium obviously improves the mechanical properties of alloy, but slightly reduces the electrical conductivity of alloy. Therefore, chromium bronze has certain strength and hardness, good electrical conductivity, and good heat resistance and wear resistance. With excellent cold and hot working performance, it can be processed into various materials. It is mainly used to manufacture elasticity components and wear-resistant and heat-resistant parts that work at room temperature and high temperature. Because of its excellent high temperature performance, chromium bronze is widely used to make materials for welding electrodes.

explanation_cn: 见绿柱石。
explanation_en: See beryl.

explanation_cn: 以依为基体元素，加入一种或多种元素组成的合金。铱合金的主要特点是具有优良的热电性能、高温抗氧化性能和耐腐浊性能。主要用作高温抗氧化热电偶及电接触材料。
explanation_en: A alloy that is composed of one or more elements added with the basis element as the matrix element. The main characteristics of iridium alloy are excellent thermoelectric properties, high-temperature oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance. It is mainly used as high-temperature oxidation resistance thermocouple and electrical contact materials.

explanation_cn: 铵油炸药，指由硝酸铵和燃料组成的一种粉状或粒状爆炸性混合物，主要适用于露天及无沼气和矿尘爆炸危险的爆破工程，包括粉状铵油炸药、多孔粒状铵油炸药、重铵油炸药、粒状粘性炸药、增粘粒状铵油炸药。
explanation_en: Ammounium nitrate fuel oil (ANFO) explosive refers to a kind of powdery or granular explosion mixture composed of ammonium nitrate and fuel, which is mainly applicable to blasting projects in the open air and without the danger of explosion of methane and mineral dust, including powdery ammounium nitrate fuel oil (ANFO) explosive, porous granular ammounium nitrate fuel oil (ANFO) explosive, heavy ammounium nitrate fuel oil (ANFO) explosive, granular viscous explosive, viscosified granular ammounium nitrate fuel oil (ANFO) explosive.

explanation_cn: 硝酸铵和燃料油及其他附加剂（固体可燃物、表面活性剂等）组成的混合炸药。
explanation_en: Composite explosive composed of ammonium nitrate, fuel oil and other additives (solid combustibles, surfactants, etc.).

explanation_cn: 银-钯厚膜导体浆料是一种含有贵金属银和钯的导电浆料，通常用于微电子制造。它常见的商用品牌有DP6120和DP6130，分别以2.5/1和6/1的银（Ag）与钯（Pd）比例制成。这种浆料具有以下性能特点：在25°C时的黏度约在145到225毫帕秒之间，印刷覆盖率在湿膜厚度为50微米时可达70到80平方厘米/克和60到70平方厘米/克。 经过烧结后，银-钯厚膜导体的性能包括：烧成温度通常介于690°C到850°C之间，表面电阻率约为0.4欧姆/□，线条分辨率可达150到200纳米，附着力在1.5到2.5千克力/平方毫米之间。此外，这种浆料还表现出优良的焊接性能以及与厚膜电阻的良好相容性。银-钯浆料的制备包括将钯、银金属粉（或银钯合金粉末）、玻璃粉末和其他介质粉末混合分散在有机载体中，然后用于微电路制造，例如用作厚膜电阻端子和厚膜电容器电极等。它具备良好的导电性能、工艺简单、可在空气中烧结、性能稳定等特点，是微电子领域的重要材料之一。
explanation_en: Silver palladium conductive paste for thick film is a kind of conductive paste containing precious metals silver and palladium, which is usually used in microelectronics manufacturing. Its common commercial brands are DP6120 and DP6130, made in silver (Ag) to palladium (Pd) ratios of 2.5/1 and 6/1, respectively. This slurry has the following performance characteristics: the viscosity at 25 ° C is about 145 to 225 millipascals, and the printing coverage can reach 70 to 80 square centimeters/g and 60 to 70 square centimeters/g when the wet film thickness is 50 microns. After sintering, the properties of silver palladium thick film conductors include: the sintering temperature is usually between 690 ° C and 850 ° C, the coefficient of surface resistance is about 0.4 ohm/□, the line resolution can reach 150 to 200 nm, and the adhesion is between 1.5 and 2.5 kgf/mm2. In addition, the slurry also shows excellent weld performance and good compatibility with thick film resistors. The preparation of silver-palladium paste includes mixing and dispersing palladium, silver metal powder (or silver palladium alloy powder), glass powder and other dielectric powder in organic carriers, and then using them in microcircuit manufacturing, such as as thick film resistor terminals and thick film capacitor electrodes. It has good conductivity, simple process, sintering in air, stable performance and other characteristics, and is one of the important materials in the field of microelectronics.

explanation_cn: 银、铟、镉的三元合金.中子吸收材料。铪是很有效的控制材料，但很昂贵，银-铟-镉合金是作为铪的替代物而发展出来的，银-15%铟-5%镉的控制效率与铪相当，广泛应用于压水堆的控制。从物理上看，控制材料应具有高的中子吸收性能，而且在其寿期内变化尽可能小，镉的热中子吸收截面很大，其子体的吸收截面很小，因而烧损很快。银和镉的热中子吸收截面不大，但在超热中子区具有强的共振吸收峰，而且这些吸收峰不重叠。这样就弥补了镉超热中子吸收能力低的不足，三种元素互补的结果，使得它具有和铪相当的控制能力。铟的加人改善了银-镉合金的抗腐蚀性能。成分的确定不仅要考虑制造时.而且要考虑到核转变引起的成分变化.如银转变为镉，铟转变为锡。此外，合金成分的选择还应考虑到机械强度和加工性能。银-15%铟-5%镉合金热导率高.对反应堆功率分布不均匀性引起的温度不均匀性不敏感。
explanation_en: A ternary alloy of silver, indium and cadmium. neutron absorbing material. Hafnium is a very effective control materials, but it is very expensive. silver-indium-cadmium alloy was developed as a substitute for hafnium. The control efficiency of silver -15% indium -5% cadmium is equivalent to that of hafnium, and it is widely used in the control of pressurized water reactors. Physically, the control materials should have high neutron absorption performance, and change as little as possible during its life. The thermal neutron absorption cross section of cadmium is very large, and the absorption cross section of its daughter is very small, so the burning loss is very fast. The thermal neutron absorption cross-sections of silver and cadmium are not large, but they have strong resonance absorption peaks in the superheat neutron region, and these absorption peaks do not overlap. This compensates for the low absorption capacity of cadmium for epithermal neutrons, and the complementary effect of the three elements gives it the same control ability as hafnium. The addition of indium improves the corrosion resistance of silver cadmium alloy. The determination of composition shall not only consider the manufacturing process, but also the composition change caused by nuclear transformation, such as silver transformation to cadmium, and indium transformation to tin. In addition, the selection of alloy composition should also take into account the mechanical strength and processing properties. Silver -15% Indium -5% Cadmium alloy has high thermal conductivity and is insensitive to temperature inhomogeneity caused by reactor power distribution inhomogeneity.

explanation_cn: 银离子导体和铜离子导体是一类使用银离子（Ag+）和铜离子（Cu+）作为传导离子的快离子导体。它们的主要特点是在室温下具有相对较高的离子电导率，有些材料甚至可以达到高达10^1 S/cm的电导率。不过，它们也存在一些限制，如较低的分解电压和银等贵金属的昂贵成本，这些因素限制了它们的应用范围。这些银离子导体的主要材料通常是以AgI（碘化银）为基础，通过离子置换法制备而成。AgI有两种变体，分别是α-AgI和β-AgI。α-AgI是低温相，具有很低的电导率，而在146°C时可逆地转变为高温相β-AgI，后者具有较高的离子电导率，但无法保持在室温下。为了在室温下稳定α-AgI的结构，从而获得室温下高电导率的银离子导体，可以采用多种离子置换方法。其中，以铷（Rb）取代银（Ag）制备的RbAg4I5是最有效的之一，它的室温电导率可高达2.7×10^1 S/cm。铜离子导体与银离子导体类似，通常也是通过卤化亚铜的离子置换法获得。例如，Rb4Cu16I7Cl13是一种具有较好电导率的铜离子导体，在室温下的电导率可达3.4×10^1 S/cm。这些材料在电化学器件等领域具有广泛的应用前景。
explanation_en: Silver ion conductors and copper ion conductors are a type of fast ion conductors that use silver ions (Ag+) and copper ions (Cu+) as carriers of ions. Their main feature is that they have relatively high ionic electric conductivity at room temperature, and some materials can even achieve electric conductivity as high as 10 ^ 1 S/cm. However, they also have some limitations, such as low decomposition voltage and the high cost of precious metals such as silver, which limit their application range. The main materials of these silver ionic conductors is usually prepared by ion replacement method based on AgI (silver iodide). There are two variants of AgI, namely α- AgI and β- AgI. α- AgI is a low temperature phase with very low electric conductivity, and can be reversibly transformation into a high temperature phase at 146 ° C β- AgI, which has high ionic electric conductivity, but cannot be kept at room temperature. To stabilize at room temperature α- AgI structure, so as to obtain silver ionic conductors with high electric conductivity at room temperature, and various ion replacement methods can be used. Among them, RbAg4I5 prepared by replacing silver (Ag) with rubidium (Rb) is one of the most effective, and its room temperature electric conductivity can be as high as 2.7 × 10 ^ 1 S/cm. Copper ion conductors, similar to silver ion conductors, are usually obtained through ion exchange of cuprous halides. For example, Rb4Cu16I7Cl13 is a copper ion conductor with good electric conductivity, and its electric conductivity can reach 3.4 at room temperature × 10 ^ 1 S/cm. These materials have broad application prospects in the field of electrochemical devices.

explanation_cn: 以银为基体元素，加人一种或多种元素组成的合金。在贵金属中价格最电器接点;银-氧化镉合金电导率高、抗电磨损性和抗熔焊性良好。接触电阻低而稳定，有灭弧作用;在中等功率和大功率接触材料中应用最为广泛;银镍合金具有良好的导电性和导热性，强度高，对金属转移、电弧侵蚀的抵抗能力强，耐磨性好，多用于低压电器中;③银基电阻材料，银锰锡合金的电阻率适中，电阻温度系数低，对铜热电势小，可用作标准电阻及电位器绕组材料;④银基电镀材料。⑤银基牙科材料，常用的为银未合金，又称汞齐。
explanation_en: A alloy with silver as the matrix element and one or more elements added. The most expensive electrical contact among precious metals; Silver cadmium oxide alloy has high electric conductivity, good resistance to electric abrasion and fusion welding. Low and stable contact resistance, with arc extinguishing effect; It is widely used in medium power and high power contact materials; Silver nickel alloy has good conductivity and thermal conductivity, high strength, strong resistance to metal transfer and arc erosion, good wear resistance, and is mostly used in low-voltage electrical appliances; ③ Silver based resistance materials, silver manganese tin alloy, with moderate resistivity, low resistance temperature coefficient and low thermal potential for copper, can be used as standard resistance and potentiometer winding materials; ④ Silver based electroplating materials. ⑤ Silver based dental materials is commonly used as silver alloy, also known as amalgam.

explanation_cn: 又称白焊合金.由银（30%-63%)、铜（16%-29%)和锌（10%-20%)组成的合金，熔化温度为740-820°C,润湿性及流动性好，耐腐蚀性差。通常用于焊接银合金、镍铬合金、镍铬不锈钢、钴铬合金和铜合金等。
explanation_en: Also known as white soldering alloy, alloy is composed of silver (30% -63%), copper (16% -29%) and zinc (10% -20%), with melting temperature of 740-820 ° C, good wettability and flow ability, and poor corrosion resistance. It is usually used for weld silver alloy, nickel chromium alloy, nickel chromium stainless steel, cobalt chromium alloy and copper alloy.

name_en: silver salt diffusion transfer presensitized plate
explanation_cn: 利用银盐扩散成像原理进行制版的胶印版。根据选用基材的不同，可分为银盐纸基版、聚酯片基版和铝基版三种。根据转移方式又分为不在同一基材上扩散转移、在同一基材上向上扩散转移和向下扩散转移型。制版原理：版材经原稿曝光、显影后.受光部分的卤化银还原成黑色金属银存在与感光层中，成为亲水性表面。未曝光部分即图文部分的卤化银被溶解.形成银络合物，向上扩散转移到接受层表面，经物理显影核的催化作用，形成银白色亲油性金属图像。它具有制版工艺简单、轻便、周期短等特点，广泛应用于轻印刷。
explanation_en: An offset plate that uses the principle of silver salt diffusion imaging for plate making. According to the different substrates used, it can be divided into three types: silver salt paper based version, polyester film based version, and aluminum based version. According to the transfer mode, it can be divided into three types: diffusion transfer not on the same substrate, upward diffusion transfer on the same substrate, and downward diffusion transfer. Plate making principle: After exposure and development of the original manuscript, the silver halide in the light receiving part of the plate is reduced to black metal silver, which exists in the photosensitive layer and becomes a hydrophilic surface. The silver halide in the unexposed part, that is, the graphic part, is dissolved to form a silver complex, which is diffusion upward and transferred to the surface of the receiving layer. Through the catalysis of the physical development nucleus, a silver white image of an oleophilic metal is formed. It has the characteristics of simple plate making process, lightweight, and short cycle, and is widely used in light printing.

explanation_cn: 高分子材料表面或者内部在应力或溶剂作用下出现的许多肉眼可见的有序或者无序的微细凹槽，在光线作用呈现银白色，是高分子特有的一种裂纹。只有在拉应力作用下才能形成.且面总是垂直于拉应力的方向。在拉应力作用下，高分子内微缺陷形成应力集中，引发产生微孔穴，进一步成核，在垂直于拉应力的平面上，形成扁平楔形的微纤束。由质和空洞组成，质是高度取向的高分子微纤。空洞是连通的。质具有一定的力学强度和黏弹性。因此能承受一定的负荷，而且在玻璃化转变温度以上质能解取向，使消失，称为自愈合。溶剂能加速的引发和生长，导致高分子加速破坏。研究的引发和生长机理对深入理解高分子的断裂、增韧、环境应力开裂以及疲劳破坏等都有十分重要的作用。
explanation_en: Many ordered or disordered micro grooves visible to the naked eye on the surface or inside of macromolecule surface of materials under the action of stress or solvent are silvery white under the action of light, which is a unique crack of macromolecule. It can only be formed under tensile stress, and the surface is always perpendicular to the direction of tensile stress. Under the action of tensile stress, microdefect in macromolecule form stress concentration, which leads to the formation of micropores and further nucleation. On the plane perpendicular to the tensile stress, flat wedge-shaped micro fiber bundles are formed. It is composed of substance and cavity. The substance is a highly orientation macromolecule microfiber. Voids are connected. Quality has a certain mechanical strength and viscoelasticity. Therefore, it can bear a certain load, and can disorientation and disappear above the glass transition temperature, which is called self healing. Solvents can accelerate initiation and growth, leading to accelerated destruction of macromolecule. The initiation and growth mechanism of the study is very important for understanding the fracture, toughening, environmental stress cracking and fatigue failure of macromolecule.

explanation_cn: 从银胶菊的叶子、树皮及根皮等植株组织中提取出来的一种天然高分子材料，分子结构为顺式-1,4-聚异戊二烯，与巴西三叶橡胶属于同一种物质，是一种顺式天然橡胶。银菊橡胶的物理化学性能与三叶橡胶基本相同。二者最大不同在于银菊橡胶颗粒结合蛋白不与免疫球蛋白IgE(I型乳液过敏反应）和三叶橡胶乳液蛋白IgG抗体发生交叉反应.因而不会引起乳胶过敏现象。这在普遍受到天然胶乳过敏反应困扰的欧美国家备受关注，银菊橡胶极有可能在未来医疗卫生等安全乳胶产品方面发挥主导作用。低.兼具贵金属诸多的优良特性.广泛应用于军工、电子、交通、冶金、化工等领域。银合金主要用作：①银基钎料.主要是以银铜锌合金为基础组成的合金，如：AgCuZn系、AgCuZnCd系、AgCuZnNi系;银铜合金及含铟、锡的银铜合金一般作为真空密封钎料使用;银锰合金具有较高的熔点和高温强度，常用于钎焊不锈钢和耐热合金;②银基接触材料，主要有银铜合金（AgCu3、AgCu7.5)，其具有较高的力学性能、耐磨性和抗熔焊性。
explanation_en: It is a natural polymer materials extracted from the leaves, bark, root bark and other plant tissues of Celosia angustifolia. Its molecular structure is cis-1,4-polyisoprene. It belongs to the same substance as Brazilian clover rubber and is a cis natural rubber. The physical chemistry properties of chamomile rubber are basically the same as those of clover rubber. The biggest difference between the two is that the inulin particle binding protein does not cross react with immunoglobulin IgE (type I lotion allergic reaction) and clover rubber lotion protein IgG antibody, so it will not cause latex allergy. This has attracted much attention in European and American countries which are generally troubled by allergic reactions of natural latex, and chamomile rubber is very likely to play a leading role in the future medical and health safety latex products. Low. It has many excellent characteristics of precious metals and is widely used in military industry, electronics, transportation, metallurgy, chemical industry and other fields. Silver alloy is mainly used as: ① silver based brazing filler metal. It is mainly a alloy based on silver copper zinc alloy, such as AgCuZn system, AgCuZnCd system, AgCuZnNi system; Silver copper alloy and silver copper alloy containing indium and tin are generally used as vacuum sealing brazing filler metal; Silver manganese alloy has high melting point and high temperature strength, and is commonly used for soldering stainless steel and heat resistant alloy; ② Silver based contact materials mainly include silver copper alloy (AgCu3, AgCu7.5), which have high mechanical properties, wear resistance and fusion welding resistance.

explanation_cn: 这是一种无机非金属材料，制备过程包括原料的熔化、成盘、结晶等步骤。通常，该材料的原料主要来自硅酸盐，包括玄武岩、辉绿岩等基性岩石，也可以使用页岩，以及一些固体废物如高炉矿渣、钢渣、铜渣、铬渣、铁合金渣等。制备工艺包括原料的混合、熔化、浇注和热处理等。该材料的主要成分通常是辉石类矿物，有时还会出现硅灰石、橄榄石、基性斜长石、磁铁矿等。这些矿物通常呈现为微细晶粒，显示出过冷结晶的特征，包括成分（非化学计量平衡）和晶体形态（雏晶和骸晶）特征。此外，还含有一定量的玻璃相。这类材料的主要性能特点包括高硬度（硬度范围为7到8），良好的耐磨性（耐磨系数为0.09到0.14 g/cm2），以及强大的抗腐蚀性能，除氢氟酸和热磷酸外，能够抵御其他酸碱的腐蚀（耐酸性大于96%，耐碱性大于98%）。然而，这类材料的韧性和抗冲击性较差，难以切割加工。主要制品包括管、复合管、板和料，广泛应用于电力、煤炭、矿山、冶金、化工、建筑等工业领域，用于防腐蚀部位和耐磨部位，如酸或碱储罐、反应罐、酸洗池（槽）的防腐蚀内衬，矿石、灰渣、尾矿的溜槽和输送管道，以及球磨机的耐磨衬板等。这种材料可以显著延长部件或设备的使用寿命。此外，浅色或彩色的铸石还可以作为室内外装饰材料和地面材料使用，如仓库地坪、公共建筑的过道、楼梯踏步，厂房的耐酸地坪和墙裙，以及水工工程的大坝贴面和排砂孔衬砌等。
explanation_en: This is a inorganic nonmetallic materials, and the preparation process includes the steps of melting, disking and crystallization of raw materials. Generally, the raw materials of this materials mainly come from silicate, including basic rock such as basalt and diahmse, shale can also be used, and some solid wastes such as blast furnace slag, steel slag, copper slag, chromium slag, ferroalloy slag, etc. The preparation process includes mixing, melting, pouring and heat treatment of raw materials. The main composition of the materials is usually pyroxene minerals, and sometimes wollastonite, olivine, basic plagioclase, magnetite, etc. These minerals usually appear as fine grains, showing the characteristics of supercooled crystallization, including composition (non stoichiometric balance) and crystal morphology (crystallite and skeleton). In addition, it also contains a certain amount of glass phase. The main performance characteristics of such materials include high hardness (hardness ranges from 7 to 8), good wear resistance (wear resistance coefficient is 0.09 to 0.14 g/cm2), and strong corrosion resistance. Except hydrofluoric acid and hot phosphoric acid, they can resist corrosion of other acids and bases (acid resistance is more than 96%, alkali resistance is more than 98%). However, such materials have poor toughness and impact resistance and are difficult to cut. The main products include pipes, clad pipe, plates and materials, which are widely used in electric power, coal, mining, metallurgy, chemical industry, construction and other industrial fields. They are used in anti-corrosion and wear-resistant parts, such as anti-corrosion lining of acid or alkali storage tanks, reaction tanks, pickling pools (troughs), chutes and transmission pipelines of ore, ash, tailings, and wear-resistant lining plates of ball mills. This materials can significantly extend the service life of components or equipment. In addition, light or colored caststone can also be used as indoor and outdoor decoration materials and ground materials, such as warehouse floor, passageway and stair step of public buildings, acid resistant floor and dado of plants, dam facing and sand hole lining of hydraulic engineering, etc.

explanation_cn: 是一种制备聚合物薄膜的成型方法，包括热压及溶液两种。热压铸膜是将聚合物加热至略高于试样的软化温度，待试样软化后立即移到油压机上加压，冷却后即可得到聚合物薄膜，适用于低软化温度且不易热降解的聚合物。溶液铸膜是将聚合物溶解于溶剂配制成液，然后将液通过刮刀置于基板上，先在室温下进行缓慢蒸发，以免在上留下气孔，当同化时再升高蒸发的温度，以去除残留的溶剂，最后冷却成膜。其中液中各组分的配比不同，制得的膜的各种件能和几何形状各不相同。
explanation_en: The invention relates to a molding method for preparing polymer films, including hot pressing and solution. Hot pressing casting film is to heat polymer to a temperature slightly higher than the bating temperature of the sample. After the sample is bating, it is immediately moved to the oil press for pressurization. After cooling, polymer film can be obtained. It is suitable for polymer with low bating temperature and not easy to thermal degradation. Solution casting is to dissolve polymer in solvent to prepare liquid, and then place the liquid on the substrate through a scraper. First, slowly evaporate at room temperature to avoid leaving pores on the substrate. When assimilating, increase the evaporation temperature again to remove the residual solvent, and finally cool to form a film. The ratio of each component in the liquid is different, and the various components and geometric shapes of the prepared membrane are different.

explanation_cn: 金属材料的液态成型工艺。将熔融金属浇注、压射或吸入铸型型腔，凝固后使之成为具有一定形状和性能的铸件。特点是使金属一次成形，工艺灵活性高，成本低廉。一般分砂型铸造和特种，可根据铸件的合金类型、大小、批量和质量要求予以选择。大批量生产时可采用机械化自动化设备。
explanation_en: Liquid forming process of metallic materials. The molten metal is poured, shot or sucked into the mold cavity, and after solidification, it becomes a casting with certain shape and properties. The characteristic is that the metal is formed in one go, with high process flexibility and low cost. Generally, sand foundry and special casting can be selected according to the type, size, batch and quality requirements of alloy castings. Mechanized automation equipment can be used for mass production.

explanation_cn: 利用浇铸、定向凝同等铸造的技术，在方形坩埚中制备的多晶硅。制备的方法主要有浇铸法和直熔法：浇铸法是原料在一个坩埚中熔化后浇铸在另一个坩埚中冷却得到多晶硅;而直熔法是在一个坩埚中熔化原料后，利用坩埚底部进行热交换来冷却熔体得到多晶硅。铸造多晶硅中通常含有大量的晶界、杂质和缺陷。相比于直拉单晶硅，具有工艺简单、生产成本低、高的材料利用率和易于大尺寸生长等优点，但其晶体质量较差。和单晶硅都是制造太阳能电池的主流硅原材料。
explanation_en: Polycrystalline silicon is prepared in a square crucible by using the same foundry technology as casting and directional solidification. The preparation methods mainly include casting method and direct melting method: casting method is that raw materials are melted in one crucible and then cooled in another crucible to obtain polycrystalline silicon after casting; The direct melting method is to melt the raw materials in a crucible, and then use heat exchange at the bottom of the crucible to cool the melt to obtain polycrystalline silicon. Casting multicrystalline silicon usually contains a lot of grain boundary, impurities and defects. Compared with Czochralski monocrystalline silicon, it has the advantages of simple process, low production cost, high utilization rate of materials and easy large-scale growth, but its crystal quality is poor. And monocrystalline silicon are mainstream silicon raw materials for manufacturing solar cell.

explanation_cn: 铸件在凝固和冷却过程中由于热收缩、冷速不一致以及相变比容变化所产生的各种应力的总称。将导致铸件发生变形甚至形成铸造裂纹。可通过调整铸件结构、改变浇帽口系统设计等方法减轻，部分在铸件打箱消除机械阻碍后得以释放，而残存的内应力则可通过退火处理消除。
explanation_en: The general term for various stresses generated by castings during solidification and cooling due to thermal shrinkage, inconsistent cooling rate, and changes in phase change specific volume. It will lead to deformation of castings and even formation of foundry cracks. It can be alleviated by adjusting the casting structure, changing the design of the gate mouth system, and some of them can be released after the casting is boxed to remove the mechanical obstacles, while the residual inner stress can be eliminated by annealing treatment.

explanation_cn: 金属和合金采用铸造方法制成尺寸形状正确、内在质量合乎要求的铸件的能力。主要包括液态金属的流动性、充型能力，与介质接触时的吸气和氧化程度、凝间时结晶温度范围和结晶特征、收缩率以及与造型材料的适应性等。铸造性能是衡量金属材料可采用铸造方法生产的综合指标，除受金属的化学成分的限制外，还与铸造工艺制度的选择密切相关。
explanation_en: The ability of metal and alloy to make castings with correct size and shape and qualified internal quality by foundry method. It mainly includes the flow ability and filling capacity of liquid metal, the degree of gas absorption and oxidation when contacting with the medium, the range of crystallization temperature and crystallization characteristics during solidification, shrinkage and adaptability to molding materials. Castability is a comprehensive index to measure metallic materials that can be produced by foundry method. In addition to being limited by the chemical composition of metal, it is also closely related to the selection of foundry process system.

explanation_cn: 泡沫铝材是利用固体表面特性产生特殊作用的新型金属功能材料。泡沫铝的孔隙率（体积分数）一般为40%-90%,具有一系列的优良性能，有很高的吸收冲击能的能力;泡沫铝的高阻尼特性高于其他阻尼合金;耐高温、防火性能强，是一种不可燃的材料，同时.在受热状态下不会释放有毒的气体：抗腐蚀、耐热性强;消声性能好、热导率低，电磁屏蔽性高、电阻大、有过滤能力与毛细管现象。易加工，可进行涂装表面处理等。但泡沫铝由于其高的铸造成本和低的成品率限制了它的使用。
explanation_en: Foam aluminum is a new type of metal functional materials that uses the characteristics of solid surface to produce special effects. The porosity (volume fraction) of aluminum foam is generally 40% -90%, which has a series of excellent properties and high ability to absorb impact energy; The high damping characteristic of aluminum foam is higher than that of other damping alloy; It is a non combustible materials with high temperature resistance and strong fire resistance. At the same time, it will not release toxic gas when heated: it has strong corrosion resistance and heat resistance; Good noise elimination performance, low thermal conductivity, high electromagnetic shielding, high resistance, filtering ability and capillary tube phenomenon. Easy to process, suitable for coating surface treatment, etc. However, the use of aluminum foam is limited by its high foundry cost and low yield.

explanation_cn: 浇铸生产过程中在铸坯或铸件表面和内部产生的各种不符合尺寸要求或技术质量规范的现象，其产生的原因、特征和程度各不相同。根据国际铸造技术协会委员会的规定，可将铸造缺陷分为七类：多肉类缺陷、孔洞类缺陷、裂纹冷隔类缺陷、表面类缺陷、残缺类缺陷、形状尺寸类缺陷及夹杂物和组织反常类缺陷。根据在随后的热加工或热处理过程中是否可能显著减轻甚至消除，可将铸造缺陷分为一般缺陷和严重缺陷。一般缺陷如疏松、分散缩孔、冷隔、偏析、枝晶组织等在一定程度上允许出现但必须通过合适的热加工或热处理工艺显著减轻或消除，而裂纹、缩孔、夹渣严重缺陷是不允许存在或必须通过表面修磨及机械切割方法去除。
explanation_en: In the process of casting production, the causes, characteristics and degrees of various phenomena that do not meet the dimensional requirements or technical quality specifications on the surface and inside of the casting blank or casting are different. According to the regulations of the International foundry Technology Association Committee, casting defect can be divided into seven categories: fleshy defects, hole defects, crack edd shut defects, surface defects, incomplete defects, shape and size defects, inclusions and abnormal structure defects. According to whether it is possible to significantly reduce or even eliminate casting defect during subsequent hot working or heat treatment, they can be divided into general defects and serious defects. General defects such as porosity, dispersed shrinkage pore, edd shut, segregation, dendrite structure, etc. are allowed to appear to a certain extent, but must be significantly reduced or eliminated through appropriate hot working or heat treatment processes, while serious defects such as cracks, shrinkage hole, slag inclusion inclusion are not allowed to exist or must be removed by surface grinding and mechanical cutting methods.

explanation_cn: 可以通过铸造方式制成特定形状铸件的钛合金。大部分变形钛合金具有出色的铸造性能，适合铸造应用。其中，Ti-6Al-4V合金是最广泛使用的一种。这种合金具有出色的铸造工艺性能，具有稳定的组织和性能。在350°C以下具有出色的强度（超过700MPa）和断裂韧性，因此可替代不锈钢，广泛应用于航空和化工等领域。钛铸件通常采用真空凝壳炉和石墨型熔铸。与相同成分的变形合金相比，它们的强度基本相等，但塑性和疲劳性能较低，差距约为40%到50%。然而，大多数钛铸件可以通过稳定化退火处理来改善性能。通过固溶处理和氢处理，还可以细化合金的铸造组织，将疲劳强度提高到锻件水平。此外，热等静压处理是生产高质量钛铸件的重要工序。这一处理后，铸件的尺寸不发生变化，但内部组织更加致密，力学性能的稳定性得到显著提高。目前，钛铸件的使用温度通常在300°C到400°C之间。它们主要用于铸造航空发动机的机匣、支承架、导向叶片等非转动部件，也可以用于铸造叶轮等转动零件。
explanation_en: Titanium alloys with specific shape castings can be made by foundry. Most deformed titanium alloy have excellent castability and are suitable for foundry applications. Among them, Ti-6Al-4V alloy is the most widely used one. This alloy has excellent foundry technological properties, stable structure and properties. It has excellent strength (over 700MPa) and fracture toughness below 350 ° C, so it can replace stainless steel and is widely used in aviation, chemical industry and other fields. Titanium castings are usually cast in vacuum shell furnace and graphite mould. Compared with deformed alloy with the same composition, their strength is basically the same, but their plastic and fatigue properties are lower, the difference is about 40% to 50%. However, most titanium castings can improve their properties by stabilizing annealing treatment. Through solution treatment and hydrogen treatment, the foundry structure of alloy can also be refined, and the fatigue strength can be improved to the level of forgings. In addition, hot isostatic pressing is an important process for producing high-quality titanium castings. After this treatment, the size of the casting does not change, but the internal structure is more dense, and the stability of mechanical properties is significantly improved. At present, the usage temperature of titanium castings is usually between 300 ° C and 400 ° C. They are mainly used for non rotating parts such as foundry aeroengine casing, support frame, guide vane, etc., and can also be used for rotating parts such as foundry impeller.

explanation_cn: 以铅为基的铸造用合金。铅合金熔点低（在327°C以下），流动性好,凝固收缩率小，熔损少，重熔时成分变化小，可铸造形状复杂、轮廓清晰的器件。铸造铅合金中所含的锑起提高硬度和强度、降低凝固收缩率的作用;所含的锡起提髙流动性和轮廓清晰度的作用。利用熔点低的铅合金作模型材料，制作工艺简便，且有一定的使用寿命。
explanation_en: Lead based alloy for foundry. Lead alloy has low melting point (below 327 ° C), good flow ability, small solidification shrinkage, less melting loss, small composition change during remelting, and can foundry devices with complex shape and clear outline. Antimony contained in cast lead alloy can improve hardness and strength, and reduce solidification shrinkage; The contained tin plays a role in improving flow ability and contour clarity. Using lead alloy with low melting point as model materials, the manufacturing process is simple and has a certain service life.

explanation_cn: 用于生产铸件的铜合金，多数不能进行压力加工。例如铸造铍青铜，含铍量较高，达到2.7%,并含有0.5Cu和0.3Si。这类合金塑性极差，不能进行压力加工。铸造锡青铜.例如Cu-5Sn-5Zn-5Pb，同样也不能进行压力加工。铸造铍青铜主要用作防爆工具、模具、海底电缆中继器的结构件、焊接电极等。铸造锡青铜.铸造铝青铜，铸造黄铜主要用作轴瓦、轴套、衬套、轴承、齿轮、管件等，用于机械制造、航空、汽车、建筑等工业部门。在工艺美术品方面得到广泛应用，古代青铜器，就是典型的例子。
explanation_en: Most copper alloys used to produce castings cannot be pressure processing. For example, foundry beryllium bronze has a high beryllium content of 2.7%, and contains 0.5Cu and 0.3Si. This kind of alloy has poor plasticity and cannot be pressure processing. Foundry tin bronze, such as Cu-5Sn-5Zn-5Pb, also cannot be pressure processing. Foundry beryllium bronze is mainly used as explosion-proof tools, molds, structural parts of submarine cable repeaters, weld electrodes, etc. Foundry tin bronze. foundry aluminium bronze. foundry brass is mainly used for bearing bush, bearing sleeve, bushing, bearing, gear, pipe fittings, etc., and is used in machinery manufacturing, aviation, automobile, construction and other industrial sectors. It has been widely used in arts and crafts, and ancient bronze ware is a typical example.

explanation_cn: 用来铸造工程机械用铸件或其他制品、器具的一类铝合金。铸造铝合金铸造成铸件后不需要压力加工，经过机加工、表面处理或仅经过清理后就可以装机使用。铸造合金中合金元素含量较高且种类较多，合金组织中的共晶体较多，具有良好的铸造工艺性能，适合于铸造零件;一般铸造铝合力学性能中等，大部分可通过热处理来增强其力学性能根据铝基体中加入的主要合金元素，分为Al-Si系、Al-Cu系、Al-Mg系和Al-Zn系铸造铝合金等。
explanation_en: A class of aluminum alloy used for foundry of construction machinery or other products and appliances. Cast aluminium alloy can be installed and used after machining, surface treatment or only cleaning without pressure processing after foundry. In foundry alloy, alloy element content is high and there are many kinds, and there are many eutectic in alloy structure. It has good foundry process performance and is suitable for foundry parts; Generally, the mechanical properties of foundry aluminum are moderate, and most of them can be enhanced by heat treatment. According to the main alloy elements added in the aluminum matrix, they can be divided into Al Si system, Al Cu system, Al Mg system and Al-Zn cast aluminium alloy.

explanation_cn: 锌合金按照加工方式可以分为铸造锌合金、变形锌合金和热镀锌合金。铸造锌合金的历史较长，主要适用于压力铸造或者重力铸造，用来浇铸汽车、拖拉机等机电部门的各种仪表壳体类铸件或#浇铸各种起重设备、机床、水泵等的轴承。铸造锌合金又分为压力铸造锌合金和重力铸造锌合金，可以直接铸造的锌合金是Zn-Al合金和Zn-Cu-Ti合金，其中Zn-Al合金具有生产周朗短、制造成本低、机械加工性能好等优点，Zn-Cu-Ti合金的抗蠕变性能很好，又称抗蠕变合金，近年来又发展了高铝的高硬度高耐磨性的铸造锌合金。铸造锌合金的缺点是耐蚀性差，在长期使用过程中，易发生老化。
explanation_en: Zinc alloy can be divided into cast zinc alloy, wrought zinc alloy and hot-dip galvanized alloy according to the processing method. Cast zinc alloy has a long history. It is mainly used for die-casting or gravity foundry. It is used to casting various instrument housing castings of mechanical and electrical departments such as automobiles and tractors or # casting bearings of various lifting equipment, machine tools, water pumps, etc. Cast zinc alloy is also divided into press cast zinc alloy and gravity cast zinc alloy. The zinc alloy that can be directly foundry is Zn Al alloy and Zn Cu Ti alloy, of which Zn Al alloy has the advantages of short production, low manufacturing cost, good machining performance, etc. Zn Cu Ti alloy has good creep resistance, also known as creep resistance alloy. In recent years, cast zinc alloy with high hardness and high wear resistance of high aluminum has been developed. The disadvantage of cast zinc alloy is its poor corrosion resistance, which is prone to aging during long-term use.

explanation_cn: 适合在液态状态下填充铸型，以制备接近最终使用形状和尺寸的毛坯。根据主要合金化元素的不同，镁合金可以分为Mg-Al系、Mg-Zn系、Mg-RE系和Mg-Th系。另外，根据合金成分中细化剂的不同，它们可以分为不含Zr的镁合金和含Zr的镁合金。前者以Mg-Al系合金为代表，后者以Mg-Zn系和Mg-RE系合金为代表。镁合金的组织主要以镁基固溶体为主，并含有一定数量的共晶体。这使得镁合金具有出色的填充性、小的收缩性和低的热裂性，因此适应于多种铸造工艺。镁合金可以通过砂型铸造、金属型铸造、熔模铸造、低压铸造、高压铸造、挤压铸造和半固态铸造等几乎所有铸造工艺进行成型。零件的外形尺寸可以从几厘米到1米以上，质量从几克到数百千克不等。镁合金的密度小，通常小于95g/cm3，同时其最高强度可以达到400MPa。镁合金具有出色的比强度和比刚度，具备良好的阻尼减振性能。此外，它在汽油、煤油和润滑油中的性能也很稳定。因此，镁合金在航空航天、汽车和电子产品等多个领域得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: It is suitable for filling the mold in the liquid state to prepare blanks close to the final use shape and size. According to the main alloy elements, magnesium alloy can be divided into Mg Al system, Mg Zn system, Mg RE system and Mg Th system. In addition, according to the different refiners in the composition of alloy, they can be divided into magnesium alloy without Zr and magnesium alloy with Zr. The former is represented by Mg Al system alloy, while the latter is represented by Mg Zn system and Mg RE system alloy. The microstructure of magnesium alloy is mainly magnesium based solid solution, and contains a certain amount of eutectic. This makes magnesium alloys have excellent filling, small shrinkage and low hot cracking, so they are suitable for a variety of foundry processes. Magnesium alloys can be formed by almost all foundry processes, such as sand foundry, metallic mold casting, expenable pattern casting, low pressure casting, high pressure foundry, squeeze castings liquid metal forging and semi-solid foundry. The external dimensions of the parts can range from a few centimeters to over 1 meter, and the mass can range from a few grams to hundreds of kilograms. The density of magnesium alloy is small, usually less than 95g/cm 3， At the same time, its maximum strength can reach 400MPa. Magnesium alloy has excellent specific strength and stiffness, and has good damping and vibration reduction performance. In addition, its performance in gasoline, kerosene, and lubricants is also very stable. Therefore, magnesium alloys are widely used in various fields such as aerospace, automotive, and electronic products.

name_en: heat treatment of cast magnesium alloy
explanation_cn: 通过溶解、时效或溶解时效处理来改善，从而提高合金的力学性能。不同类型的铸造镁合金通常需要不同的热处理方法：Mg-Al系合金：时效处理的效果通常不明显，因此通常使用铸态（F）或固溶态（T4）合金。对于固溶加时效态（T6）合金，尽管屈服强度有所提高，但伸长率明显下降，因此不太适合广泛应用。Mg-Zn系合金：一般直接采用人工时效（T1）进行处理。对于Mg-Zn-RE-Zr合金，可以通过氢化热处理获得高的力学性能。Mg-RE系合金：稀土元素对镁合金具有强烈的时效强化作用。通常采用高温固溶加低温时效（T6）的热处理工艺。由于镁合金在高温下容易氧化燃烧，固溶处理通常在保护气氛下进行，如SO2、SF6等气氛。这些热处理方法有助于提高铸造镁合金的强度和性能，但需要根据具体合金的成分和应用来选择适当的热处理工艺。
explanation_en: The mechanical properties of alloy can be improved by solution, aging or solution aging treatment. Different types of cast magnesium alloy usually require different heat treatment methods: Mg Al alloy: the effect of aging treatment is usually not obvious, so as cast (F) or solid solution (T4) alloy is usually used. For the (T6) alloy in the solution time-dependent effect, although the yield strength has increased, the elongation has decreased significantly, so it is not suitable for wide application. Mg Zn alloys: generally, artificial aging (T1) is directly used for treatment. For Mg Zn RE Zr alloy, high mechanical properties can be obtained through hydrogenation heat treatment. Mg RE alloys: rare earth elements have a strong aging strengthening effect on magnesium alloys. Generally, the heat treatment process of high temperature solution and low temperature aging (T6) is adopted. Because magnesium alloys are prone to oxidation and combustion at high temperatures, solution treatment is usually carried out in a protective atmosphere, such as SO2, SF6 and other atmospheres. These heat treatment methods are helpful to improve the strength and properties of cast magnesium alloy, but appropriate heat treatment process needs to be selected according to the composition and application of specific alloy.

explanation_cn: 是指由合格的母合金重熔后直接浇铸或定向凝同成零件毛坯或零件的高温合金。按合金基体可分为铁基、镍基和钻基。按凝固方法可分为常规精密铸造等轴晶高温合金、定向凝间柱晶高温合金和单晶高温合金。20世纪60年代定向凝固技术的发展，促进了定向柱晶和单晶高温合金的蓬勃发展，使航空发动机的使用温度达到2000K。相对于变形高温合金，铸造高温合金的特点主要有：形成粗大凝固组织引起高温强化：可以加入更多的合金元素进行强化发展新合金;可以铸造出冷却内腔非常复杂的涡轮叶片和导向叶片;高温强度优异，使用温度高。主要用于制作航空发动机和燃气轮机的涡轮叶片和导向叶片。
explanation_en: It refers to the high temperature alloy that can be directly casting or directionally solidified into parts blanks or parts after the qualified parent alloy is remelted. According to alloy matrix, it can be divided into iron base, nickel base and drill base. According to the solidification method, it can be divided into conventional precision casting equiaxed high temperature alloy, directionally solidified intergranular high temperature alloy and singlecrystal superalloy. The development of directional solidification technology in the 1960s promoted the vigorous development of directional columnar and singlecrystal superalloy, making the service temperature of aeroengine reach 2000K. Compared with wrought superalloy, raw superalloy has the following characteristics: forming coarse solidification structure to cause high-temperature strengthening; adding more alloy elements to strengthen and develop new alloy; It can foundry turbine blades and guide vanes with very complex cooling cavities; Excellent high-temperature strength and high operating temperature. Mainly used for making turbine blades and guide vanes for aviation engines and gas turbines.

explanation_cn: 采用铸造工艺方法生产成型的钢件。根据钢中合金元素含量可分为非合金、低合金（合金元素总量小于5%)、中合金(合金元素总量5%-10%)和高合金（合金元素总量大于10%)。根据性能与用途可分为普通铸钢、耐磨、耐蚀、耐热、无磁、铸造模具钢、特种用途等。铸钢的形状及尺寸可根据需要设计不同的铸型而得到，非常接近最终产品;但中存在冶金缺陷如气孔、疏松等对力学性能的影响不利，其性能介于铸铁和轧材与锻钢之间。当零件的形状较为复杂，不能经济地直接采用轧制型材或采用型材改锻时，可广泛采用铸钢件。工程与结构用非合金（GB/T 11352-2009)和低合金(GB/T 14408-2014）分别采用ZG和ZGD表示铸钢，后跟屈服强度值加拉伸强度值，特殊则在通常的成分钢号前面加ZG表示。
explanation_en: The shaped steel parts are produced by foundry process. According to the alloy element content in steel, it can be divided into non alloy, low alloy (the total amount of alloy elements is less than 5%), medium alloy (the total amount of alloy elements is 5% -10%) and high alloy (the total amount of alloy elements is more than 10%). It can be divided into ordinary cast steel, wear-resistant, corrosion-resistant, heat-resistant, nonmagnetic, foundry die steel, special purpose, etc. according to its performance and use. The shape and size of cast steel can be obtained by designing different mold as required, which is very close to the final product; However, there are metallurgical defects such as porosity and porosity, which have adverse effects on mechanical properties. Its properties are between cast iron, rolled products and forged steel. When the shape of the parts is complex, and it is not economical to directly use rolling profiles or use profiles to change forging, cast steel can be widely used. Non alloy (GB/T 11352-2009) and low alloy (GB/T 14408-2014) for engineering and structure use ZG and ZGD respectively to represent cast steel, followed by yield strength value plus tensile strength value, and in special cases, add ZG in front of the usual composition steel designation.

explanation_cn: 连锁聚合反应步骤之一。活性分子继续和单体分子作用生成长链活性分子。聚合反应中单体几乎全部消耗在这一过程中，并决定了生成的聚合物分子结构。由于单体上取代基的电子效应和空间结构，聚合物活性链与单体主要是“头--尾”相连。
explanation_en: One of the reaction steps of chain polymerization. Active molecules continue to interact with monomer molecules to form long-chain active molecules. In polymerization, almost all monomer is consumed in this process, and determines the molecular structure of the generated polymer. Due to the electronic effect and spatial structure of substituents on monomer, the active chain of polymer is mainly connected with monomer "head tail".

explanation_cn: 链式聚合的基元反应，是单体产生活性中心的过程。引发剂产生初级活性种如自由基、阳离子或阴离子，初级活性种加成到单体上形成单体自由基、单体阳离子或单体阴离子等单体活性种。根据活性种的类型，链式聚合分为不同类型。按照引发方式可分为热引发、光引发、辐射引发和引发剂引发等。
explanation_en: The elementary reaction of chain polymerization is the process of monomer producing active center. Initiator produces primary reactive species such as free radicals, cations or anions, and primary reactive species are added to monomer to form monomer free radicals, monomer cations or monomer anions and other monomer reactive species. According to the type of reactive species, chain polymerization can be divided into different types. According to the initiation mode, it can be divided into thermal initiation, photoinitiation, radiation initiation and initiator initiation.

explanation_cn: 因高分子链上单键内旋转所造成的高分子链组成原子或基团在空间的不同排布，是分子内非键合原子之间相互作用的表现。受温度、高分子聚集态的分子间相互作用以及外加力场的影响而改变。各种构象无需破坏化学键就可以相互转变。构象影响高分子的形态，而形态决定了高分子的物理、力学性能。
explanation_en: The different arrangement of atoms or groups in the macromolecule chain caused by the internal rotation of the single bond in the macromolecule chain is the manifestation of the interaction between non bonded atoms in the molecule. It is affected by temperature, intermolecular interaction of macromolecule aggregation state and external force field. Various conformations can transformation each other without breaking the chemical bond. Conformation affects the morphology of macromolecule, and morphology determines the physical and mechanical properties of macromolecule.

explanation_cn: 由于受阻内旋转，在高分子链中能够独立运动的最小单元(链长)。链段长度可用以表征链的柔顺性。
explanation_en: The smallest unit (chain length) that can move independently in a macromolecule chain due to blocked internal rotation. The chain segment length can be used to characterize the flexibility of the chain.

explanation_cn: 按照硅氧四面体在空间组合情况而划分的硅酸盐矿物的亚类之一，按硅氧四面体连接方式的不同分为单链和双链结构。其络阴离子中，各个硅氧四面体之间通过共用半数氧角顶的方式相互连接而组成一维无限延长的硅氧四面体单链',或者由两个平行的单链彼此再通过共用某些角顶联接成一维无限延伸的硅氧四面体双链,链与链之间则由金属离子相联系而结合的硅酸盐。在单链结构中，还可以按沿着链的发展方向不同的周期性而分为一、二、三、四、五及七节链。在陶瓷中较重要的链状硅酸盐有辉石族。本类矿物一般呈柱状或针状晶形，多为深色，平行于链方向的解理发育，硬度较高，密度低于岛状硅酸盐而高于其他构造的硅酸盐。此外，硅线石也可以看成是链状硅酸盐结构，但它的链是由铝氧八面体共边组成。
explanation_en: One of the subclasses of silicate mineral classified according to the spatial combination of silicon oxygen tetrahedron, which can be divided into single chain and double chain structures according to the different connection modes of silicon oxygen tetrahedron. In the complex anion, each silicon oxide tetrahedron is connected to each other by sharing half of the oxygen corner tops to form a one-dimensional infinitely extended silicon oxide tetrahedron single chain ', or two parallel single chains are connected to each other by sharing some corner tops to form a one-dimensional infinitely extended silicon oxide tetrahedron double chain, and the chains are phase by metal ions to form silicates. In a single chain structure, it can also be divided into one, two, three, four, five, and seven segment chains according to their different periodicity along the development direction of the chain. The more important chain silicate in ceramics is pyroxene group. This type of mineral is generally in columnar or acicular crystal form, mostly dark colored, with cleavage development parallel to the chain direction, high hardness, and density lower than island silicate and higher than silicate of other structures. In addition, sillimanite can also be regarded as chain silicate structure, but its chain is composed of aluminum oxide octahedron with common edges.

explanation_cn: 链式聚合反应中，增长链活性中心失活的过程。根据终止反应所涉及增长链的个数，链终止分为双分子终止和单分子终止。对于自由基链式聚合双分子终止可分为歧化终止和偶合终止。链增长自由基夺取另一个链自由基的氢原子或其他原子而终止聚合的方式，称作歧化终止。歧化终止的结果是两个活性链同时失去活性，聚合度和链自由基中结构单元数相同，每个大分子只有一端为引发剂残基，另一端为饱和或不饱和末端，两者各占一半。两个链自由基的独电子相互结合成共价键而终止聚合的方式，称作偶合终止。偶合终止的结果是两个活性链同时失去活性，大分子的聚合度为链自由基结构单元数的两倍。引发剂引发无链转移时，大分子两端均为引发剂残基。因此可以根据大分子链上的引发剂残基的数量区别偶合终止和歧化终止。链终止的方式与单体种类和聚合条件有关。链增长自由基与其他化合物反应而终止聚合的方式，称作单分子终止。例如链增长自由基和初级自由基偶合，链增长自由基与其他稳定自由基偶合、链增长自由基与链终止剂反应，从而使链式聚合终止。
explanation_en: In chain polymerization, the process of inactivating the active center of the growing chain. According to the number of growth chains involved in the termination reaction, chain termination can be divided into bimolecular termination and unimolecular termination. For radical chain polymerization, bimolecular termination can be divided into disproportionation termination termination and coupling termination. The method of chain growth radical seizing the hydrogen atom or other atoms of another chain radical to terminate polymerization is called disproportionation termination. The result of disproportionation termination is that two active chains lose their activity at the same time, the degree of polymerization and the number of structural units in the chain radical are the same, and only one end of each macromolecule is a initiator residue, and the other end is a saturated or unsaturated end, accounting for half of each. The way to terminate polymerization by combining the single electrons of two chain radicals to form covalent bond is called coupling termination. The result of coupling termination is that two active chains lose their activity at the same time, and the degree of polymerization of macromolecule is twice the number of structural units of chain free radicals. When initiator initiates without chain transfer, both ends of macromolecule are initiator residues. Therefore, coupling termination and disproportionation termination can be distinguished according to the number of initiator residues on the macromolecular chain. The way of chain termination is related to the type of monomer and polymerization conditions. The way that chain growth radicals react with other compounds to terminate polymerization is called unimolecular termination. For example, chain growth radicals are coupled with primary radicals, chain growth radicals are coupled with other stable radicals, and chain growth radicals react with chain termination agent to terminate chain polymerization.

explanation_cn: 能终止聚合反应的物质。这些物质能与初级與由基及链增长自由基反应，使它们失去活性从而终止链生长。例如乙醇是顺丁橡胶催化剂"二环烷酸镍/三异丁基铝/乙氧基合三氣化硼"的终止剂，当聚合完成后，加人乙醇，它可迅速与三异丁基铝或三氟化硼起反应，从而破坏了催化剂，使聚合反应不再进行。乳液丁苯橡胶合成中常用酚、木焦油或二硫化秋兰姆类作终止剂，其作用是使增K的A由基变成稳定的化合物，并破坏残余的引发剂，使之丧失引发能力。
explanation_en: A substance that can terminate the polymerization reaction. These substances can react with primary and free radicals, causing them to lose activity and thus terminate chain growth. For example, ethanol is the terminator of cis-1,4-polybutadiene rubber catalyst "nickel bicycloalkanoate/triisobutyl aluminum/ethoxytrihydrate boron". When ethanol is added after polymerization, it can quickly react with triisobutyl aluminum or boron trifluoride, thus destroying the catalyst and stopping the polymerization reaction. Phenol, wood tar or thiuram disulfide are commonly used as terminators in the synthesis of lotion styrene butadiene rubber, whose function is to change the base of K increased A into a stable compound, and to destroy the residual initiator, so that it loses the ability to initiate.

explanation_cn: 分子链缠绕、交叠、贯穿及由链段间动态相互作用形成的物理交联点的作用。是长链高分子之间特有的相互作用。
explanation_en: The action of molecular chain entanglement, overlap, penetration, and physical cross-linking points formed by dynamic interactions between chain segments. It is a unique interaction between long chain macromolecule.

explanation_cn: 在高分子亚浓溶液中，高分子链间相互拥挤、相互交叠。对于同一链上两个相邻缠结点之间的区域，其他链上的单元很难进入；该区域所构成的球体定义为"链节球(blob)"。在链节球内，单体单元的运动遵循无扰统计规律，而整个高分子链的运动可用很多链节球的运动所描述。
explanation_en: In the sub concentrated solution of macromolecule, the chains of macromolecule are crowded and overlapped with each other. For the area between two adjacent entangled nodes on the same chain, it is difficult for elements on other chains to enter; The sphere formed by this area is defined as "blob". In the blob, the movement of the monomer unit follows the undisturbed statistical law, while the movement of the entire macromolecule chain can be described by many blob movements.

explanation_cn: 链式聚合反应的活性链与其他物质作用，原活性中心终止，同时生成一个新活性中心的反应过程。活性链可以向单体、溶剂、引发剂、大分子链和链转移剂发生链转移。向单体转移的能力与单体结构、温度等因素有关。自由基向引发剂转移，导致诱导分解，使引发剂效率和聚合度降低。溶液聚合时，需考虑向溶剂的链转移反应。链转移反应对聚合物分子量有重大影响。在实际生产中，常利用链转移反应来控制聚合物分子量以及合成接枝共聚物。如通过温度来调节聚氯乙烯的分子量，通过异丙醇来调节聚丙烯睛的分子量。
explanation_en: The reaction process in which the active chain of chain polymerization reacts with other substances to terminate the original active center and generate a new active center at the same time. The active chain can chain transfer to monomer, solvent, initiator, macromolecule chain and chain transfer agent. The ability to transfer to monomer is related to monomer structure, temperature and other factors. The transfer of free radicals to initiator leads to induced decomposition, which reduces initiator efficiency and degree of polymerization. In solution polymerization, chain transfer reaction to solvent should be considered. Chain transfer reaction has a great influence on the molecular weight of polymer. In practical production, chain transfer reaction is often used to control the molecular weight of polymer and synthesize graft copolymer. For example, the molecular weight of polyvinyl chloride is adjusted by temperature, and the molecular weight of polypropylene eye is adjusted by isopropanol.

explanation_cn: 能与活性链发生链转移反应、且生成新活性中心的物质。链转移剂通过链转移作用，可以控制聚合物的链长度，从而达到对聚合物分子量调控的目的。通常链转移剂添加量越多，聚合物的链越短，黏度也越小。脂肪族硫醇和十二烷基硫醇常用作自由基聚合的链转移剂；水、醇、醚、酸、酯和醌是阳离子聚合的链转移剂；水、二氧化碳、氧、醇和有机酸为阴离子聚合的链转移剂。
explanation_en: A substance that can undergo chain transfer reaction with the active chain and generate a new active center. Chain transfer agent can control the chain length of polymer through chain transfer, so as to control the molecular weight of polymer. Generally, the more chain transfer agent is added, the shorter the polymer chain and the smaller the viscosity. Aliphatic mercaptans and dodecyl mercaptans are commonly used as chain transfer agent in free radical polymerization; Water, alcohol, ether, acid, ester and quinone are chain transfer agent of cationic polymerization; Water, carbon dioxide, oxygen, alcohol and organic acid are chain transfer agent for anion polymerization.

explanation_cn: 是链转移速率常数和增长速率常数之比，通常以C表示，是表示链转移反应与链增长反应两者竞争能力的参数。C值越大链转移反应越易发生。
explanation_en: Is the ratio of chain transfer rate constant and growth rate constant, usually expressed in C, and is a parameter indicating the competitiveness of chain transfer reaction and chain growth reaction. The higher the C value, the more likely the chain transfer reaction is to occur.

explanation_cn: 是Li和Pb的二元合金。其优点与液态锂相同。最常考虑的是锂-铅共晶合金（17%锂），熔点235°C。铅是出色的中子倍增元素和辐射防护材料，因而锂-铅合金具有较好的增殖能力，利用相当薄的增殖区便可达到适当的氚增殖和有效的防护。主要的缺点是铅的密度大。各种锂-铅合金与水的反应性试验研究表明：共晶锂-铅合金与水只发生适度的反应。液态锂-铅合金在500°C时对214Cr-lMo钢的焊接热影响区有显著的间浸蚀。在相同条件下，铌稳定的214Cr-lMo钢有较好的抗晶间浸蚀能力。
explanation_en: It is a binary alloy of Li and Pb. Its advantages are the same as liquid lithium. Lithium lead eutectic alloy (17% lithium) with melting point of 235 ° C is the most commonly considered. Lead is an excellent neutron multiplier element and radiation protection materials, so lithium lead alloy has a good proliferation ability, and appropriate tritium proliferation and effective protection can be achieved by using a relatively thin proliferation zone. The main disadvantage is the high density of lead. The experimental study on the reactivity of various lithium-lead alloy with water shows that the eutectic lithium-lead alloy only react moderately with water. The liquid lithium-lead alloy has significant intercorrosion on weld heat affected zone of 214Cr-lMo steel at 500 ° C. Under the same conditions, the niobium stabilized 214Cr-lMo steel has better resistance to intergranular etching.

explanation_cn: 一种高能化学原电池，其负极采用金属锂，正极采用金属氧化物或其他固体、液体氧化剂，电解质采用固体盐类或溶于有机溶剂的盐类。具有比能量高、寿命长、耐漏液等优点，但安全性较差。锂一次电池有很多系列，常见的有锂-二氧化锰、锂-亚硫酰氯、锂-硫化铜、锂-氟化碳和锂-二氧化硫等。由于具有不同的电解液和正极活性物质，其工作电压、能量密度不同，各自有其特点和应用范围，如锂-碘(Li-I2)电池主要应用于心脏起搏器电源，锂-二氧化锰电池主要应用于照相机以及电子仪器设备的记忆电源。
explanation_en: A high-energy chemical primary battery, in which the negative electrode is made of metallic lithium, the positive electrode is made of metallic oxide or other solid or liquid oxidizer, and the elonrolyte is made of solid salts or salts dissolved in organic solvents. It has advantages such as high specific energy, long service life, and resistance to leakage, but its safety is poor. There are many series of primary lithium battery, including lithium manganese dioxide, lithium thionyl chloride, lithium copper sulfide, lithium carbon fluoride and lithium sulfur dioxide. Due to different electrolytes and positive active substances, their working voltage and energy density are different, and each has its own characteristics and application range. For example, lithium iodine (Li-I2) batteries are mainly used for cardiac pacemaker power supply, and lithium manganese dioxide batteries are mainly used for memory power supply of cameras and electronic instruments.
