explanation_en: See mica.

explanation_cn: 参见电气石。
explanation_en: See tourmaline.

explanation_cn: 一种可充电电池，主要依靠锂存储在正极与负极之间的电位差来储存/释放电能。锂离子电池主要由正极、负极、隔膜、电解质构成。其中电极(包括正极与负极)是锂离子嵌入脱出的载体，一般由活性物质颗粒、导电添加剂、黏结剂复合而成，隔膜将正负极隔离，电解质填入隔膜孔隙起到传输锂离子的作用，其组成一般为锂盐溶解在有机溶剂中。锂离子电池的工作原理为:充电过程中，锂离子与电子分别通过电解质与外电路从能量较低的正极运动到能量较高的负极，同时消耗电能；放电过程则相反，锂离子与电子分别通过电解质与外电路从负极运动到正极，同时释放电能驱动外电路做功。锂离子电池的能量密度取决于其电极材料的电压和比容量。根据选取电极材料的不同，目前锂离子电池的工作电压可低至2.0V和高至4.5V。与其他二次电池体系相比，锂离子电池拥有高电压、高能量密度、循环寿命长、自放电率低、无记忆效应、环境友好等优点。锂离子电池已经广泛应用于手机、笔记本电脑消等费电子产品和各类电动车辆，未来锂离子电池在储能领域也有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: A rechargeable battery that primarily relies on the potential difference between the positive and negative electrodes of lithium to store/release electrical energy. Li ion battery is mainly composed of positive pole, negative pole, separator and electrolyte. The electrode (including positive electrode and negative electrode) is the carrier for lithium ion insertion and removal, which is generally composed of active material particles, conductive additive and adhesive composition. The separator isolates the positive and negative electrodes, and elonrolyte is filled into the pores of the separator to transfer lithium ions. Its composition is generally lithium salt dissolved in organic solvent. The working principle of the Li ion battery is that during the charging process, the lithium ion and the electron move from the lower energy positive pole to the higher energy negative pole through the electrolyte and the external circuit respectively, and consume electric energy at the same time; The discharge process is the opposite, where lithium ions and electrons move from the negative electrode to the positive electrode through an electrolyte and an external circuit, respectively, while releasing electrical energy to drive the external circuit to do work. The energy density of Li ion battery depends on the voltage and specific capacity of its electrode materials. According to the different electrode materials selected, the current operating voltage of Li ion battery can be as low as 2.0V and as high as 4.5V. Compared with other secondary cell systems, Li ion battery has the advantages of high voltage, high energy density, long cycle life, low self-discharge rate, no memory effect, and environmentally friendly. Li ion battery have been widely used in mobile phones, notebook computers, consumer electronics and various electric vehicles. In the future, Li ion battery also have broad application prospects in the field of energy storage.

explanation_cn: 以裡辉石为主晶相的陶瓷。其缺点是烧结范围太窄。可用于制造燃气轮机叶片及喷气式发动机的喷嘴、家用耐热炊具等。
explanation_en: Ceramics with pyroxene as the main crystalline phase. The disadvantage is that the range of sintering is too narrow. It can be used to manufacture nozzles for gas turbine blades and jet engines, as well as household heat-resistant cookware.

explanation_cn: 为Fe基超导体111相，通过使Li元素缺失产生超导电性，超导转变温度18K。
explanation_en: It is a Fe based superconductor 111 phase, which produces superconductivity by making Li element missing, and the superconducting transition temperature is 18K.

explanation_cn: 用于制造蒸汽锅炉的工程结构钢，包括汽包用钢和锅炉管用钢。汽包在中温(350°C以下）高压条件下工作，要求具有一定的热强性、韧性和组织稳定性使得在长期高压中温水蒸气的作用下不发生过大的塑性变形和断裂。
explanation_en: Engineering structural steel for manufacturing steam boiler, including steel for steam drum and steel for boiler tube. When the steam drum works under medium temperature (below 350 ° C) and high pressure, it is required to have certain thermal strength, toughness and structural stability so that under the action of long-term high-pressure and medium temperature steam, excessive plastic deformation and fracture will not occur.

explanation_cn: 组成（质量分数，％)为Zr-1.20~1.70、Sn-0.07~0.20、FeO.05~0.15、Cr-0.03~0.08、Ni的一种锆-锡合金，该合金采用真空自耗电弧熔炼制备铸锭.采用常规压力加工方法进行塑性加工，主要用做沸水堆的包壳材料和其他堆芯结构材料。
explanation_en: Zirconium tin alloy with composition (mass fraction,%) of Zr-1.20~1.70, Sn-0.07~0.20, FeO. 05~0.15, Cr-0.03~0.08, and Ni. The alloy is prepared by vacuum consumable arc melting. The plastic forming is carried out by conventional pressure processing method, which is mainly used as the materials for the cladding of boiling water reactor and other core structural materials.

explanation_cn: 常规锆-4合金组成（质量分数.％)为Zr-1.20~1.70、Sn-0.18~0.24.、Fer0.07~0.13、Cr的一种锆-锡合金，该合金采用真空自耗电弧熔炼制备铸锭，采用常规压力加工方法进行塑性加工.主要用做压水堆的包壳材料和其他堆芯结构材料。改进锆-4合金是对常规锆-4合金在标准成分范围内进行了成分调整和加工工艺改进之后的合金，其抗腐蚀性能和高温性能进一步提高。
explanation_en: The conventional zircaloy-4 is a zirconium tin alloy composed of Zr-1.20~1.70, Sn-0.18~0.24, Fer0.07~0.13, and Cr (mass fraction.%). The alloy is made of ingots by vacuum consumable arc melting, and plastic forming is carried out by conventional pressure processing. It is mainly used as the cladding materials of pressurized water reactor and other core structural materials. The improved zircaloy-4 is a alloy after the composition adjustment and processing technology improvement of the conventional zircaloy-4 within the standard composition range. Its corrosion resistance and high-temperature performance are further improved.

explanation_cn: 含ZrO2 33%-45%,主要矿物组成为刚玉及斜锆石和玻璃相的耐火砖。品种有熔铸锆刚玉砖（AZS熔铸砖），其导热性较好；烧结锆刚玉砖，其气孔率较高、组织结构均匀，导热性较低。
explanation_en: The refractory brick contains ZrO2 33% -45%, and the main mineral composition is corundum, zircon and glass phase. Varieties include fused cast zirconium corundum brick (AZS fused cast brick), which has good thermal conductivity; Sintering zirconium corundum brick has high porosity, uniform structure and low thermal conductivity.

explanation_cn: 以锆为基加入其他合金化元素组成的合金。锆合金有Zr-Nb系，Zr-Sn系等多种。锆合金对多种酸、碱、盐有良好的抗蚀性能，锆合金采用真空自耗电弧熔炼制备铸锭，采用常规压力加工方法进行塑性加工。工锆铝合金粉是吸气材料，合金中含铝15%-16.5%(质量分数），能有效吸收co2、N2、H2、〇2、CO、水蒸气和真空器件中的活性气体，锆铝粉采用海绵锆和铝棒经真空自耗电弧熔炼后，破碎、球磨成粉末。用于电子管、灯泡和其他真空器件能延长工作寿命，使器件性能稳定、工作可靠性提高；也用于惰性气体纯化、碱金属释放器的还原剂等。
explanation_en: Alloy based on zirconium added with other alloy elements. Zirconium alloy include Zr Nb system, Zr Sn system, etc. Zirconium alloy has good corrosion resistance to various acids, alkalis and salts. zirconium alloy is prepared by vacuum consumable arc melting, and plastic forming is carried out by conventional pressure processing. Zirconium aluminum alloy powder is a gas absorbing materials. alloy contains aluminum 15% -16.5% (mass fraction), which can effectively absorb CO2, N2, H2, O2, CO, water vapor and active gas in vacuum devices. Zirconium aluminium powder is broken and ground into powder by sponge zirconium and aluminum rod after vacuum consumable arc melting. Used for electronic tubes, light bulbs, and other vacuum devices, it can extend the working life, stabilize device performance, and improve working reliability; It is also used as a reducing agent for inert gas purification and alkali metal release devices.

explanation_cn: 基本元素为锆、铜、铝、镍、钛，主要有Zi-Cu-Al-Ni和Zr-Cu-Al-Ni-Ti两个基本合金系。为了调整锆基非晶合金的性能，通常在合金中加人少量过渡族元素，如Co、Pt、Fe、Mo、Ag、Nb、Pd、Hf等，以及其他一些合金元素如Be、Si、B、C等。锆基非晶合金具有高强度、超塑性、高弹性、高硬度、高耐磨性、高耐腐蚀性和优异的加工成型等性能。
explanation_en: The basic elements are zirconium, copper, aluminum, nickel and titanium, and there are mainly two basic alloy systems: Zi-Cu-Al-Ni and Zr Cu Al Ni Ti. In order to adjust the performance of zirconium-based amorphous alloy, a small amount of transition group elements, such as Co, Pt, Fe, Mo, Ag, Nb, Pd, Hf, and other alloy elements, such as Be, Si, B, C, are usually added to the alloy. Zirconium based amorphous alloy has high strength, superplasticity, high elasticity, high hardness, high wear resistance, high corrosion resistance and excellent processing and molding properties.

explanation_cn: 以稳定的ZrO2和鳞片状石墨为主要原料制成的耐火制品。
explanation_en: Refractory products made of stable ZrO2 and scaly graphite as main raw materials.

explanation_cn: 将锆粉与四氧化三铅等氧化剂混合而成的一类点火药，属于微烟点火药中的一种，其基本原理是：利用锆的燃烧热较高，其氧化产物为高熔点的金属氧化物的特点，锆系点火药发火点低，耐水性好。当锆点火药中锆粉过量时还能形成二次点火，从而具有很强的点火能力。锆系点火药广泛用于火焰点火和电点火的点火药或引燃药。成分为24%锆粉、76%四氧化三铅的锆系点火药能够在含水达10%时仍可靠点火，作为耐水点火药使用。由于锆对静电很敏感，极易着火，要放在水中保存.使用前需经钝化处理以保证使用安全。
explanation_en: The ignition composition is a kind of light smoke ignition composition, which is made by mixing zirconium powder with oxidizer such as lead tetroxide. Its basic principle is that: due to the high combustion heat of zirconium, its oxidation product is metal oxide with high melting point, zirconium type ignition composition has low ignition point and good water resistance. When the zirconium powder in the zirconium ignition propellant is excessive, it can also form a secondary ignition, so it has a strong ignition ability. Zirconium based ignition composition is widely used as ignition composition or pilot charge for flame ignition and electric ignition. Zirconium type ignition composition with 24% zirconium powder and 76% lead tetroxide can ignite reliably when the water content reaches 10%, and can be used as water resistant igniting powder. Zirconium is very sensitive to static electricity and easy to catch fire. It should be stored in water. Before use, it should be subject to passivation treatment to ensure safety.

explanation_cn: 见锆石。
explanation_en: See zircon.

explanation_cn: 以锆英石为主要成分的耐火制品。其热震稳定性好.有良好的化学稳定性、耐磨性和耐碱性渣侵蚀性。
explanation_en: Refractory products with zircon as the main component. It has good thermal shock resistance, good chemical stability, wear resistance and alkali resistance slag erosion.

explanation_cn: 以锆英石（ZrSiO4）为主要成分的陶瓷。四方晶系，空间群R3,密度为4.6g/cm3，熔点2450°C。锆英石陶瓷的热膨胀系数和热导率较低，抗热振性能和化学稳定性出色。要做好防护工作，它在1600°C以上会分解。主要用作火花塞、高强度高温电瓷、坩埚、瓷舟或其他实验室用窑器、熔制玻璃的炉衬及红外辐射陶瓷等。
explanation_en: Ceramics with zircon (ZrSiO4) as the main component. Tetragonal crystal system, spatial group R3, density 4.6g/cm3, melting point 2450 ° C. Zircon ceramics have low thermal expansion coefficient and thermal conductivity, excellent thermal shock resistance and chemical stability. To do a good job of protection, it will decompose above 1600 ° C. It is mainly used as spark plug, high-strength high temperature electric porcelain, crucible, porcelain boat or other laboratory kilns, furnace lining for melting glass, infrared radiation ceramics, etc.

explanation_cn: 由基体金属锆同合金元素铌、锡、铁组成的合金，具有优良的核性能和耐蚀性。该合金采用真空自耗电弧熔炼制备铸锭，采用常规压力加工方法进行塑性加工。
explanation_en: Alloy composed of matrix metal zirconium and alloy elements niobium, tin and iron has excellent nuclear properties and corrosion resistance. The alloy ingots were prepared by vacuum consumable arc melting, and plastic forming was performed by conventional pressure processing.

explanation_cn: 锆铝合金粉末与钛钛合金粉末按一定比例均匀混合后压制在镍带或镀镍带上制成的既含有吸气剂材料又含有释汞剂的复合材料。分为单面带即将两种混合粉压在带材一面上；双面带即带材的一面压制锆铝粉而另一面压制钛汞粉。单面带又分为留边型、分段型等。由于该种材料可以严格控制两种合金粉的比例，所以既可保证释汞量又可保证吸气性。
explanation_en: Zirconium aluminum alloy powder and titanium titanium alloy powder are uniformly mixed in a certain proportion and pressing on the nickel belt or nickel plated belt to make composite materials containing both getter materials and mercury releasing agent. Divided into single sided strips, where two types of mixed powder are pressed onto one side of the strip material; The double-sided tape means that one side of the tape pressing zirconium aluminum powder and the other side pressing titanium mercury powder. Single sided strips can be further divided into edge retaining and segmented types. Since this materials can strictly control the proportion of the two alloy powder, it can ensure both mercury release and gas absorption.

explanation_cn: 其标称成分为84%Zr-16%Al，合金由Zr5Al3、Zr3AL2、Zr2Al等多种金属间化合物组成，这些相扩散活化能低,经表面吸着的气体易于向体内扩散，因而具有较大的吸气速率和吸气容量。它能有效吸收H2、N2、O2、CO、co2、H2O等，最佳吸气温度在400°C左右。主要应用于各类电子管、特种灯泡和其他真空器件。典型的大量应用是将锆铝合金粉和钛汞齐（Ti3Hg)混合压制成带状吸气剂，广泛用于曰光灯和充汞灯中，取代传统的液态充汞方法，可大大减少汞害，提高灯管质量和寿命。
explanation_en: Its nominal composition is 84% Zr-16% Al. The alloy is composed of Zr5Al3, Zr3AL2, Zr2Al and other imermetallif compound. These phase have low diffusion activation or conditioning energy, and the gas adsorbed on the surface is easy to diffusion into the body, so it has a large gas absorption rate and capacity. It can effectively absorb H2, N2, O2, CO, CO2, H2O, etc., and the optimal suction temperature is around 400 ° C. Mainly used in various electronic tubes, special light bulbs, and other vacuum devices. A typical mass application is to mix and press zirconium aluminum alloy powder and titanium amalgam (Ti3Hg) to form a ribbon getter, which is widely used in sunlight lamps and mercury filled lamps, replacing the traditional liquid mercury filling method, which can greatly reduce mercury damage and improve the quality and life of the lamp tubes.

explanation_cn: 以锆为主要合金元素的铜合金。除锆外，有时还加有铬或砷。
explanation_en: Copper alloy with zirconium as the main alloy element. In addition to zirconium, sometimes chromium or arsenic is also added.

explanation_cn: 将锌、承、锡、铜等金属加热熔合.制得的具有金属特征的合金，是目前使用较多的补牙材料。的熔点比各成分的熔点低，硬度比各成分硬度大，比组成它的纯金属的性能优良。
explanation_en: The alloy with metal characteristics made by heating and fusing zinc, socket, tin, copper and other metals is a widely used materials for tooth filling. Its melting point is lower than the melting point of each component, its hardness is greater than the hardness of each component, and its performance is better than that of the pure metal.

explanation_cn: 又称德银，以铜镇合金为基加入锌配制的合金。锌能大量溶解于铜镍合金中，起固溶强化作用，可提高合金强度、硬度、弹性和耐蚀性。加入少量的铁或锰可进一步改善合金的性能，加入1.6%-2.0%Pb,可显著改善合金的切削性能。工业上应用最广的有Cu-15Ni-20Zn,Cu-17Ni-18Zn-1.8Pb等。具有良好的耐蚀性、较高的强度、优良的加工性及焊接性能，广泛用于制造耐蚀弹性结构件及其他耐蚀结构件。含铅的锌白铜主要用作钟表，光学仪器的精密零件。
explanation_en: Also known as deutsche bank, it is a alloy based on copper town alloy and zinc. Zinc can be dissolved in a large amount in copper nickel alloy, which plays a solid solution strengthening role, and can improve the strength, hardness, elasticity and corrosion resistance of alloy. Adding a small amount of iron or manganese can further improve the performance of alloy, and adding 1.6% -2.0% Pb can significantly improve the cutting performance of alloy. The most widely used in industry include Cu-15Ni-20Zn, Cu-17Ni-18Zn-1.8Pb, etc. With good corrosion resistance, high strength, excellent workability and weld performance, it is widely used to manufacture corrosion resistant elasticity structural parts and other corrosion resistant structural parts. Lead containing zinc white copper is mainly used as precision parts of clocks, watches and optical instruments.

explanation_cn: 简单架状结构氧化物矿物，与金红石、板钛矿成同质三象.化学式为TiO2，产于阿尔卑斯型脉、岩浆岩及变质岩中，也可见于砂矿，是提炼钛的矿物原料.
explanation_en: The oxide mineral with simple shelf structure is homogeneous with rutile and brookite. Its chemical formula is TiO2. It occurs in Alpine vein, magmatic rocks and metamorphic rock, and can also be seen in placer ores. It is the raw mineral material for extracting titanium

explanation_cn: Ⅲ-Ⅴ族化合物半导体单晶材料之一。室温下为银灰色固体；晶格结构为闪锌矿铟.品格常数为6.4796à,密度5.78g/cm3(固态）、6.dg/ctn3(熔点时液态），300K时禁带宽度0.为直接跃迁型。
explanation_en: One of the single crystal materials of Ⅲ - Ⅴ compound semiconductor. It is a silver gray solid at room temperature; The lattice structure is sphalerite indium. The character constant is 6.4796 à, the density is 5.78g/cm3 (solid), 6.dg/ctn3 (liquid at melting point), and the band gap width at 300K is 0. It is a direct transition type.

explanation_cn: 室温下呈银灰色光亮的固体单晶。为闪锌矿结构，晶格常数6.0954à，密度5613g/cm3(固态），6.03g/cm3，300K时能隙0.72eV.直接跃迁型。GaSb在其熔点（712t)离解压强很小（4X101Pa).其熔体表面极易产生氧化物浮渣.而妨码引晶和单晶生长。为了解决浮瘡问题.采用双坩埚法和氢气氛还原法，以及用等物质的的NaCl或KC1熔融混合物作覆盖剂的LEC法生长GaSb单晶。非
explanation_en: Solid single crystal with silver gray brightness at room temperature. It is a sphalerite structure with a lattice constant of 6.0954 à, a density of 5613g/cm3 (solid), and a energy gap of 0.72eV at 6.03g/cm3 and 3300K. GaSb has a very low pressure release strength (4X101Pa) at its melting point (712t), and its melt surface is prone to produce oxide scum, which hinders the introduction of crystals and the growth of single crystal. In order to solve the problem of scab, GaSb single crystal were grown by double crucible method, hydrogen atmosphere reduction method and LEC method with NaCl or KC1 molten mixture of other substances as covering agent. wrong

explanation_cn: 由锗（Ge）和硅（Si）以适当比例构成。这种合金具有半导体特性，可以通过掺杂不同族元素的原子来调制其导电性质。掺入V族元素原子（如磷或砷）可以使其成为n型半导体，而掺入ni族元素原子（如硼）可以使其成为P型半导体。GeSi合金在一种应用中是用于制作热偶对（thermocouples）。热偶对由n型和P型GeSi合金构成，一端暴露于高温环境，另一端暴露于低温环境。由于Seebeck效应，温度差引发了在热偶对回路中产生电流。这种现象被用于测量温度差和温度计，以及一些温差发电器。在材料性能方面，GeSi合金的关键参数包括Seebeck系数（S，用于测量塞贝克效应）、电阻率（ρ），和热导率（K）。这些参数取决于温度，因此通常会选择具有特定性能的n型和P型GeSi合金，以满足特定的应用需求。GeSi合金通常用于高温环境下的热电转换应用。它的制备方法包括重掺杂的n型和P型GeSi合金，电阻率通常在10^-2到10^-1 Ω·cm之间。制备GeSi合金的方法包括区域熔融法（用于单晶）和热压法（用于多晶）。热压法是一种常见的制备GeSi合金的方法。GeSi合金在多个领域有应用，包括太阳能聚光发电、利用工厂余热进行发电、使用同位素衰变作热源以及在卫星上用于温差发电器等应用。热电转换效率通常随着热端温度的升高而提高，当热端温度达到700°C时，其效率可以达到10%。
explanation_en: Composed of germanium (Ge) and silicon (Si) in appropriate proportions. This kind of alloy has semiconductor properties, which can be modulated by doping atoms of different groups of elements. Doping V-group element atoms (such as phosphorus or arsenic) can make them n-type semiconductors, while doping Ni group element atoms (such as boron) can make them P-type semiconductors. GeSi alloy is used to make thermocouples in one application. The thermal couple is composed of n-type and P-type GeSi alloy, one end is exposed to high temperature environment, and the other end is exposed to low temperature environment. Due to the Seebeck effect, the temperature difference triggers the generation of current in the thermal couple circuit. This phenomenon is used to measure temperature differences and thermometers, as well as some thermoelectric generators. In terms of materials performance, key parameters of GeSi alloy include Seebeck coefficient (S, used to measure Seebeck effect) and resistivity（ ρ）， And thermal conductivity (K). These parameters depend on temperature, so n-type and P-type GeSi alloy with specific properties are usually selected to meet specific application requirements. GeSi alloy are commonly used for thermoelectric conversion applications at high temperatures. Its preparation methods include heavily doped n-type and P-type GeSi alloy, and the resistivity is usually between 10 ^ -2 and 10 ^ -1 Ω· cm. Methods for preparing GeSi alloy include zone melting method (for single crystal) and hot pressing method (for polycrystal). Hot pressing is a common method for preparing GeSi alloy. GeSi alloy has been applied in many fields, including solar concentrating power generation, power generation by using waste heat from factories, isotope decay as heat source, and thermoelectric generators on satellites. The thermoelectric conversion efficiency usually increases with the increase of the hot end temperature, and when the hot end temperature reaches 700 ° C, its efficiency can reach 10%.

explanation_cn: 有多种同素异构体。是由于GeO2-Bi2O3体系中，氧化锗与氧化铋的配比量不同造成的。由于其发光机制是由于Bi离子的跃迁，故不存在因掺杂不均匀引起的发光强度的不均匀;对射线的吸收系数优;荧光衰减时间短，有利于快速计算;在核物理学研究领域有重大应用。
explanation_en: There are multiple allotropes. It is due to the different proportions of germanium oxide and bismuth oxide in the GeO2-Bi2O3 system. Because its luminescence mechanism is due to the transition of Bi ion, there is no luminous intensity nonuniformity caused by uneven doping; Excellent absorption coefficient for radiation; The fluorescence decay time is short, which is conducive to fast calculation; It has significant applications in the field of nuclear physics research.

explanation_cn: 用于制造船舶用电焊描链的热轧圆钢或锻制圆钢。船用锚链钢(GR/T18669-2012)采用性能钢号，首先用字母CM表示船用锚链钢，后面的数值为抗拉强度。船用锚链钢要求具有较高的强度和韧性，多采用优质的低碳或低中碳非合金结构钢(可含有一定量的锰)且一般均加人可细化晶粒的微合金元素。
explanation_en: Hot-rolled round steel or forged round steel used for manufacturing welding chains for ships. Marine anchor steel (GR/T18669-2012) adopts performance steel designation. First, the letter CM is used to represent marine anchor steel, and then the value is tensile strength. Marine anchor steel is required to have high strength and toughness. High quality low carbon or low medium carbon non alloy structural steel (which can contain a certain amount of manganese) is often used and micro alloy elements that can refine grains are generally added.

explanation_cn: 锡（元素符号Sn）是一种银白色金属，在室温下具有密度7.3g/cm3，熔点为231.9°C。锡在常温下会形成致密的氧化膜，以防止进一步氧化，但在高温下会快速氧化并挥发。锡存在同质异晶转变，在13.2°C以下属于α锡，也称为灰锡，其晶体结构为金刚石型。而在13.2°C至熔点温度之间，锡具有四方晶系的晶体结构，称为β锡，也叫白锡。当α锡转变成β锡时，它会呈现粉状，这种由金属锡块转变为金属锡粉末的现象称为"锡疫"。锡具有较高的抗大气腐蚀性，而且对弱有机酸几乎不敏感。因此，它常被用于制造镀锡薄板，又被称为"马口铁"，以作为食品包装材料。纯锡也用作某些机械零件的镀层。尽管锡的强度和硬度都相对较低，但锡具有良好的加工性能，可以制成管、箔、丝、条、板、棒等各种形状的材料。锡还可以被制成粉末，用于粉末冶金等应用。锡与一些低熔点金属，如铅、铋、镉等，可以形成一系列低熔点合金，例如锡铅合金，锡铋合金，锡镉合金等，还可以用于制造锡焊料。锡作为合金元素也被广泛应用，例如在钛合金、锆合金中。铌锡金属间化合物（Nb3Sn）是一种低温超导材料，而锡银汞合金则被用于牙科材料。
explanation_en: Tin (element symbol Sn) is a silver white metal with a density of 7.3 g/cm at room temperature 3， The melting point is 231.9 ° C. Tin will form a dense oxide film at room temperature to prevent further oxidation, but it will rapidly oxidize and volatilize at high temperature. Tin has isomorphic transformation, which belongs to α Tin, also known as gray tin, its crystal structure is diamond type. However, between 13.2 ° C and melting point, tin has a tetragonal crystal structure, called β Tin is also called white tin. When α Tin conversion β When tin is used, it will appear powder. This phenomenon of transformation from metal tin block to metal tin powder is called "tin plague". Tin has high resistance to atmospheric corrosion and is almost insensitive to weak organic acids. Therefore, it is often used to make tinplate, also known as "tinplate", as a food packaging materials. Pure tin is also used as a coating for certain mechanical parts. Although the strength and hardness of tin are relatively low, tin has good processing properties and can be made into materials of various shapes such as tubes, foils, wires, strips, plates, bars, etc. Tin can also be made into powder for powder metallurgy and other applications. Tin and some low melting point metals, such as lead, bismuth, cadmium, etc., can form a series of fusible alloy, such as tin lead alloy, tin bismuth alloy, tin cadmium alloy, etc., and can also be used to manufacture tin solder. As an alloy element, tin is also widely used, such as in titanium alloy and zirconium alloy. Niobium tin imermetallif compound (Nb3Sn) is a low temperature superconducting material, while tin silver amalgam is used as a dental materials.

explanation_cn: 是溶聚丁笨橡胶的一个品种，以有机锂为引发剂、四氯化锡为偶联剂、笨乙烯和丁二烯按一定比例经阴离子溶液聚合而成的含部分偶联结构的弹性体，包含线型和星形结构。相比较普通溶聚丁苯橡胶的加工性能好，能促进炭黑在橡胶的分散和提高两者相互作用力，可用于制备低滚动阻力且同时兼有抗湿滑性的轮胎。
explanation_en: It is a kind of solution polymerized styrene butadiene rubber. It is an elastomer with partial coupling structure, including linear and star structure, which is made by anionic solution polymerization of styrene and butadiene in a certain proportion with organic lithium as initiator, tin tetrachloride as coupling agent. Compared with ordinary solution polymerized styrene butadiene rubber, phase has better processability, can promote the dispersion of carbon black in rubber and improve the interaction between them, and can be used to prepare tires with low rolling resistance and wet skid resistance at the same time.

explanation_cn: 以锡为基的合金，具有以下特点：熔点低，强度和硬度相对较低，导热性良好，耐大气腐蚀，并易于与钢、铜、铝等材料焊接，因此是一种出色的焊料。此外，它还具有杰出的减摩性能，适用于制作轴承材料。由于其良好的抗腐蚀性能，锡合金还广泛用作涂层材料，应用领域广泛，包括但不限于以下方面：Sn-Pb系合金，如62%Sn，通常用于制备亮光抗腐蚀硬涂层。Sn-Ni系合金，如65%Sn，通常用于制备具有装饰性抗腐蚀涂层，广泛用于集成电路、钟表元件、家用电器和仪器仪表等领域。Sn-Zn系合金，如75%Sn，常用于电子元件以及电视、收音机等产品。Sn-Cd系合金涂层，具有抗海水腐蚀性能，因此在造船业中得到应用。另外，Sn-Pb合金是一种广泛应用的焊料，常含有38.1%铅的共晶合金，具有低熔点（183°C）和容易与其他金属焊合的特点。它在电气仪表工业中有广泛的应用，如汽车散热器、空调、热交换器的密封，家用电器电接触元件的焊接，以及电动机和电话线路的焊接等。锡还可以与其他金属（如锑、银、铟、镓等）组成合金焊料，具有高强度、无毒和抗腐蚀的特点。此外，锡还与铋、铅、镉、铟等金属组成低熔点合金，广泛用于电气设备、蒸汽设备和防火装置的保险材料，并用作中低温焊料。锡基轴承合金通常以Sn-Sb-Cu和Sn-Pb-Sb系列为主，通过添加铜和锑可以提高其强度和硬度。锡基轴承合金的成分大致相同，与铅基轴承合金一起被统称为巴氏合金。此外，Sn-13.5Pb-2.5Sb合金可轧制成片或箔，常用于制造电容器和电气、仪表零件。而Sn-5Sb合金通常用于制作子弹底火垫片和仪表零件，而Sn-18Sb-0.5-3.0Cu合金则常用于制造家用器皿，如茶具等。
explanation_en: The tin based alloy has the following characteristics: low melting point, relatively low strength and hardness, good thermal conductivity, atmospheric corrosion resistance, and easy weld with steel, copper, aluminum and other materials, so it is an excellent solder. In addition, it also has outstanding antifriction performance, suitable for making bearing materials. Due to its excellent corrosion resistance, tin alloys are also widely used as coating materials in various fields, including but not limited to the following: Sn-Pb based alloys, such as 62% Sn, are commonly used to prepare bright and corrosion-resistant hard coatings. Sn Ni series alloy, such as 65% Sn, are usually used to prepare decorative corrosion resistant coatings, which are widely used in integrated circuits, clock components, household appliances, instruments and meters and other fields. Sn Zn alloy, such as 75% Sn, is commonly used in electronic components, TV, radio and other products. Sn Cd series alloy coating, with seawater corrosion resistance, has been applied in the shipbuilding industry. In addition, Sn Pb alloy is a widely used solder, which often contains 38.1% lead eutectic alloy, with low melting point (183 ° C) and is easy to weld with other metals. It is widely used in the electrical instrument industry, such as the sealing of automotive radiators, air conditioners, heat exchangers, weld of electrical contact elements of household appliances, and weld of motors and telephone lines. Tin can also form alloy solder with other metals (such as antimony, silver, indium, gallium, etc.), which has the characteristics of high strength, non-toxic and corrosion resistance. In addition, tin also forms a fusible alloy with bismuth, lead, cadmium, indium and other metals, which is widely used as a safety materials for electrical equipment, steam equipment and fire protection devices, and as a medium and low temperature solder. Tin-base bearing alloy is usually dominated by Sn Sb Cu and Sn Pb Sb series, and its strength and hardness can be improved by adding copper and antimony. The composition of tin-base bearing alloy is roughly the same, and together with lead-base bearing alloy, it is collectively called Babbitt metal alloy. In addition, Sn-13.5Pb-2.5Sb alloy can be rolled into sheet or foil, which is commonly used to manufacture capacitors and electrical and instrument parts. While Sn-5Sb alloy is usually used to make bullet primer gaskets and instrument parts, Sn-18Sb-0.5-3.0Cu alloy is often used to make household utensils, such as tea sets.

explanation_cn: 又称锡基巴氏合金或锡基白合金，是一种工业上广泛应用的轴承材料。它是以锡为基础，加入锑、铜等元素形成的合金。一些常见的锡基轴承合金包括Sn-12Sb-4Cu-10Pb，Sn-11Sb-6Cu，Sn-8Sb-4Cu，以及Sn-4Sb-4Cu等。锡基轴承合金的典型组织结构是在α锡（alpha tin）溶体的基体上均匀分布着硬质相SnSb，这种硬质相具有出色的抗磨损性能。此外，金属间化合物Cu6Sn5可以防止凝固过程中的密度偏析。这种合金以锡为基础，具有较好的耐磨性能，良好的塑性，出色的磨合性能，能够有效地抵抗嵌镶和抗咬合，而且具备出色的耐热性和耐蚀性。因此，锡基轴承合金适用于制造那些需要承受高速度、大压力和冲击载荷的轴承。为了提高合金的强度并节省锡的使用，通常采用浇铸工艺，将其用作轴承壳材制成双金属轴瓦。这种设计结构可以有效地减少成本，同时保持合金的性能。
explanation_en: Also known as babbitt metal or tin based white alloy, it is a widely used bearing materials in industry. It is a alloy based on tin and added with antimony, copper and other elements. Some common tin-base bearing alloy include Sn-12Sb-4Cu-10Pb, Sn-11Sb-6Cu, Sn-8Sb-4Cu, and Sn-4Sb-4Cu. The typical structure of tin-base bearing alloy is α The matrix of tin (alpha tin) solution is evenly distributed with hard phase SnSb, which has excellent wear resistance. In addition, imermetallif compound Cu6Sn5 can prevent density segregation during solidification. Based on tin, this alloy has good wear resistance, good plasticity, excellent running in performance, can effectively resist inlay and anti seizure, and has excellent heat resistance and corrosion resistance. Therefore, tin-base bearing alloy is suitable for manufacturing bearings that need to withstand high speed, high pressure and impact load. In order to improve the strength of alloy and save the use of tin, the casting process is usually used as the bearing shell material to make bimetal bearing shells. This design structure can effectively reduce the cost while maintaining the performance of alloy.

explanation_cn: 简单链状结构的氧化物矿物，其化学式为SnO2。通常包含有混入的Fe、Nb、Ta等元素。这种矿物属于四方晶系，呈现出金红石型结构。其晶体形态可以是双锥状、锥柱状、针状，而集合体呈粒状。这种矿物的形成可以由胶体形成的纤维状物质，呈葡萄状或钟乳状，通常具有同心带状的结构。在热液偏胶体条件下，它可能呈现出隐晶致密块状的形态，而在(011)晶面上会形成肘状双晶。该矿物通常呈现出无色，但也有少见的无色样品。一般情况下，由于混入Fe、Nb、Ta等元素的存在，其颜色会呈黄棕色、深褐色甚至黑色，当含有较高量的Nb和Ta时，可能呈现出沥青黑色。其条痕颜色通常为白色至浅黄褐色。这种矿物表现出金刚光泽，其断口呈油脂光泽，具有从半透明到不透明的性质。断口呈不平坦至次贝壳状。莫氏硬度在6至7之间，密度范围为6.8至7g/cm3。该矿物通常表现出脆性，一般不具备磁性，但富铁的样品可能表现出电磁性。这种矿物通常在云英岩化花岗岩和热液型锡矿床中生成，与其他矿物如黄玉、电气石、黑钨矿、辉钼矿、绿柱石、石英等一同共生。它也可在砂矿中找到，而且通常是提取锡的主要矿物原料。此外，它也可用作洗漆剂和去漆剂。
explanation_en: A simple chain like oxide mineral with the chemical formula SnO2. Usually contains elements such as Fe, Nb, Ta, etc. mixed in. This mineral belongs to tetragonal system, showing a rutile structure. Its crystal morphology can be biconical, cone columnar, needle shaped, and the aggregate is granular. The formation of this mineral can be a fibrous substance formed by colloids, in the form of grapes or bell milk, usually with a concentric band structure. Under the condition of hydrothermal metasolid, it may take on the form of cryptocrystalline compact block, while on the (011) crystal plane, elbow twin will be formed. This mineral usually appears colorless, but there are also rare colorless samples. Generally, due to the presence of Fe, Nb, Ta and other elements, its color will be yellowish brown, dark brown or even black. When a high amount of Nb and Ta is contained, it may be pitch black. The stripe color is usually white to light yellow brown. This mineral exhibits a diamond luster, with a greasy luster on its fracture surface, exhibiting properties ranging from semi transparent to opaque. The fracture is uneven to sub shell like. Mohs hardness ranges from 6 to 7, and density ranges from 6.8 to 7g/cm 3。 This mineral usually shows brittleness and generally does not have magnetism, but iron rich samples may show electromagnetism. This mineral is usually generated in greisenized granite and hydrothermal tin deposits, and coexists with other minerals such as topaz, tourmaline, wolframite, molybdenite, beryl, quartze, etc. It can also be found in placer ores and is usually the main raw mineral material for extracting tin. In addition, it can also be used as a paint cleaner and coating remover.

explanation_cn: 以锡为主要合金元素的铜合金。除锡外，还加有P、Pb、Zn、Ni等合金元素。耐蚀、耐磨，有较好力学的性能和工艺性能，并能很好地焊接和钎焊，冲击时不产生火花。按加工工艺和用途可分为加工和铸造。加工锡青铜可以加工成各种规格的板、带、管、棒、线材。铸造锡青铜主要供应铸件。锡青铜主要用于各种弹性元件、轴承、轴瓦、轴套、管件、化工器械、摩擦片、齿轮、蜗轮蜗杆、抗磁元件、振动片、接触器等。
explanation_en: Copper alloy with tin as the main alloy element. In addition to tin, P, Pb, Zn, Ni and other alloy elements are added. Corrosion resistance, wear resistance, good mechanical and technological properties, good weld and soldering, no spark during impact. According to processing technology and use, it can be divided into processing and foundry. Processing tin bronze can be processed into plates, strips, tubes, rods and wire rod of various specifications. Foundry tin bronze mainly supplies castings. Tin bronze is mainly used for various elastic elements, bearings, bearing shells, bearing sleeves, pipe fittings, chemical equipment, friction plates, gears, worm gears, diamagnetic elements, vibration plates, contactors, etc.

explanation_cn: 锡黄铜是一种在铜锌合金基础上加入锡的合金。锡的主要作用是抑制锌的析出，从而改善黄铜的耐蚀性，使其在淡水和海水中都具备耐腐蚀的特性，因此被广泛称为海军黄铜。在合金中，少量锡可以溶解于α（alpha）和（alpha+beta）黄铜中，这可以提高黄铜的强度和硬度。通常，含锡量约为1%左右。然而，如果含锡量过高，可能会降低合金的塑性。根据合金中含锌的比例，锡黄铜可分为α型和（alpha+beta）型。常见的合金是70Cu-29Zn-1Sn，它属于单相α锡黄铜，具有出色的力学性能。在软态下，它的拉伸强度达到了350MPa，伸长率为60%。这种合金适合冷加工，可用于热轧和热挤压，但不适合热冲和热锻。此外，在70Cu-29Zn-1Sn合金中加入微量砷可以抑制脱锌腐蚀，进一步提高合金的耐蚀性。这种合金广泛用于船舶和热电厂的高强度耐蚀冷凝管。但需要注意的是，这种合金存在应力腐蚀断裂的倾向，因此在制造冷加工的管材时需要进行应力消除的低温退火处理。（alpha+beta）型锡黄铜的典型合金成分为62Cu-37Zn-1Sn，具有卓越的力学性能。在软态下，它的拉伸强度达到380MPa，伸长率为40%。这种合金适用于热加工和冷加工，易于切削，具有出色的焊接性能，并且在海水中表现出较高的耐腐蚀性。因此，它适用于制造船舶零件以及与海水、汽油等介质接触的零部件。
explanation_en: Tin brass is a kind of alloy added tin on the basis of copper zinc alloy. The main function of tin is to inhibit the precipitation of zinc, so as to improve the corrosion resistance of brass and make it corrosion resistant in both fresh water and sea water. Therefore, it is widely known as naval brass. In alloy, a small amount of tin can be dissolved in α (alpha) and (alpha+beta) brass, which can improve the strength and hardness of brass. Generally, the content of tin is about 1%. However, if the tin content is too high, it may reduce the plasticity of alloy. According to the proportion of zinc in alloy, tin brass can be divided into α Type and (alpha+beta) type. The common alloy is 70Cu-29Zn-1Sn, which belongs to single-phase α Tin bras has excellent mechanical properties. In the soft state, its tensile strength reaches 350MPa and elongation is 60%. This alloy is suitable for cold working, hot rolling and hot extrusion, but not for hot stamping and hot forging. In addition, the addition of trace arsenic in 70Cu-29Zn-1Sn alloy can inhibit dezincification corrosion and further improve the corrosion resistance of alloy. This alloy is widely used in high-strength corrosion resistant condenser tubes for ships and thermal power plants. However, it should be noted that this alloy has the tendency of stress corrosion fracture, so the low temperature annealing treatment of stress relief is required when manufacturing cold working tube. The typical alloy composition of (alpha+beta) tin bras is 62Cu-37Zn-1Sn, which has excellent mechanical properties. In the soft state, its tensile strength reaches 380MPa and elongation is 40%. This alloy is suitable for hot working and cold working. It is easy to cut, has excellent weld performance, and shows high corrosion resistance in seawater. Therefore, it is suitable for manufacturing ship parts and parts that come into contact with media such as seawater and gasoline.

explanation_cn: 采用锥板式黏度计测量液体表观黏度的实验方法。当黏度计工作时，如果位于转子轴下端的圆锥转子没有受到测量杯中液体的黏性阻力，则在转子与刻度盘以相同转速旋转的同时，游丝的偏转角为零，转子轴上固定安装的指针位于刻度盘的零点，保持原始状态。测量杯中放入需检测的液体后，转子受液体黏性阻力作用而产生扭转力矩，使游丝在扭转力矩作用下发生偏转，当游丝偏转一定角度后，所产生的变形力矩与转子的扭转力矩平衡.刻度盘与转子再次同步旋转，通过转子轴上的指针相对刻度盘零点的位置，就可以得到游丝的偏转角，这个偏转角与所测量液体的表观黏度成正比，使用光电传感器将偏转角转换成电信号，经电路处理及计算后，即可得到所测液体表观黏度的数值。
explanation_en: The experimental method of measuring liquid apparent viscosity with cone plate viscosity meter. When the viscosity works, if the conical rotor at the lower end of the rotor shaft is not subject to the viscous resistance of the liquid in the measuring cup, the deflection angle of the hairspring is zero while the rotor and the dial are rotating at the same speed, and the pointer fixed on the rotor shaft is located at the zero point of the dial, maintaining the original state. After the liquid to be tested is placed in the measuring cup, the rotor undergoes a torsional moment due to the viscous resistance of the liquid, causing the hairspring to deflect under the torsional moment. When the hairspring deflects at a certain angle, the deformation moment generated is balanced with the torsional moment of the rotor. The dial and rotor rotate synchronously again, and the deviation angle of the hairspring can be obtained by the position of the pointer on the rotor shaft relative to the zero point of the dial, The deflection angle is proportional to the apparent viscosity of the measured liquid. The photoelectric sensor is used to convert the deflection angle into an electrical signal. After circuit processing and calculation, the apparent viscosity of the measured liquid can be obtained.

explanation_cn: 又称马赛克或纸皮砖，是地砖的一种，主要用于铺地或内墙装饰，也可用于外墙饰面。采用干压或半干压成形，窑内焙烧而成。
explanation_en: Also known as mosaic or paper brick, it is a kind of floor tile, mainly used for floor paving or interior wall decoration, and can also be used for exterior wall decoration. It is formed by dry pressing or semi dry pressing and baked in the kiln.

explanation_cn: 一类用于改善和提高固体填料颗粒与黏合剂基体之间相互作用的多官能团物质。
explanation_en: A multifunctional group material used to improve and enhance the interaction between solid filler particles and adhesive matrix.

explanation_cn: 表征分子中结合键牢间程度的物理量，等于在标准状况下将分子拆散成单个原子所需的平均离解能键能越大结合键越牢固.
explanation_en: The physical quantity that characterizes the degree of bonding between molecules is equal to the average dissociation energy required to separate molecules into individual atoms under standard conditions. The larger the bond energy, the stronger the bonding bond

explanation_cn: 又称成材，指原木经过纵横锯解、刨光、截端、分等后所得到的具有一定规格尺寸、质量等级和明确用途的板材或方材，常根据树种、成材横断面形状、断面尺寸大小、加工特征和程度进行分类。
explanation_en: Also known as lumber, it refers to the boards or square timber with certain specifications, quality grades and clear purposes obtained from log through vertical and horizontal sawing, planing, end cutting and grading. It is often classified according to tree species, lumber cross section shape, cross section size, processing characteristics and degree.

explanation_cn: 以铜镍合金为基，加入锰配制成的合金。锰白铜含2%-44%Ni，0.1%-28%Mn，其余为铜。当合金中锰含量较高时，可借助化合物MnNi相的沉淀而强化，成为热处理强化型合金。锰能提高白铜的强度、弹性、耐蚀性和电阻率，降低白铜中过剩碳的不良影响，改善合金加工性能。在0-lOO℃范围内，电阻温度系数很小，阻值稳定，具有中等的电阻系数和低的对铜热电势，主要用作标准电阻，电桥，电位差计的精密电阻以及其他仪器仪表的电阻元件。Cu-20Ni-1.5Mn合金(康铜)具有低的电阻温度系数，可在较宽的温度范围内使用。其耐热，耐蚀性都优于Cu-12Mn-3Ni合金，并具有良好的可加工性能，但对铜热电势较大，只适宜做交流用精密电阻、滑动电阻、启动或调节变压器及电阻应变计等，也用于热电偶和热电偶补偿导线材料。Cu-40Ni-0.5Mn(考铜)具有高的热电势，而且热电势-温度曲线直线性好，用作热电偶负极材料。
explanation_en: The alloy is made of copper nickel alloy and manganese. Manganese white copper contains 2% -44% Ni, 0.1% -28% Mn, and the rest is copper. When the content of manganese in alloy is high, it can be strengthened by the precipitation of compound MnNi phase, and become a heat treatment strengthened alloy. Manganese can improve the strength, elasticity, corrosion resistance and resistivity of white copper, reduce the adverse effect of excess carbon in white copper, and improve the processability of alloy. In the range of 0-lOO ℃, the temperature coefficient of resistance is very small, and the resistance value is stable. It has a moderate resistance coefficient and low thermal potential to copper, and is mainly used as a precision resistor for standard resistors, bridges, potential difference meters, and other resistance components for instruments and meters. Cu-20Ni-1.5Mn alloy (constantan) has low resistance temperature coefficient and can be used in a wide temperature range. Its heat resistance and corrosion resistance are better than Cu-12Mn-3Ni alloy, and it has good machinability. However, for copper with large thermal potential, it is only suitable for AC precision resistance, sliding resistance, starting or regulating transformer, resistance strain gauge, etc., as well as thermocouple and thermocouple compensation wire materials. Cu-40Ni-0.5Mn (copper) has high thermoelectric potential and good linearity of thermoelectric potential temperature curve, so it is used as negative materials of thermocouple.

explanation_cn: 又称多金属结核。一种富含铁锰矿物的不规则状结核体。呈球状、楠圆状、马铃薯状、葡萄状、扁平状、炉渣状等形态。大小从几微米到数十厘米。颜色呈黑色和褐黑色，具纹层结构。锰矿物以水羟锰矿为主，含有石英、沸石、斜长石、方解石等碎屑矿物。主要分布在水深4000-6000m的大洋海底平原之上。富含锰(27%-30%)、镍(1.25%-1.5%)、铜(1%-1.4%)及钴(0.2%-0.25%)等，是极具开发前景的海底固体矿产。
explanation_en: Also called polymetallic nodules. An irregular nucleation body rich in iron and manganese minerals. It is spherical, round, potato, grape, flat, slag, etc. Sizes range from a few micrometers to tens of centimeters. The color is black and brownish black, with a layered structure. Manganese minerals are mainly hydroxymanganite, containing quartze, zeolite, plagioclase, caldte and other clastic minerals. Mainly distributed on the ocean floor plains with a depth of 4000-6000m. Rich in manganese (27% -30%), nickel (1.25% -1.5%), copper (1% -1.4%), and cobalt (0.2% -0.25%), it is a promising seabed solid mineral with great development prospects.

explanation_cn: 一种富含锰矿物的沉积岩。其化学成分主要是氧化锰，还可有较多的Fe2O3、SiO2、CaO、MgO、BaO及少量的Ti、Co、V、Ni、Cu、Pb、Zn、Mo、Sn等，主要矿物是软锰矿、硬锰矿、水锰矿、褐锰矿、荽锰矿等。杂质有黏土矿物、砂、玉髓、蛋白石等。一般为深褐色，也有较浅色的。岩石有的较软，呈土状，可染手，有的则较硬。常呈肾状、豆状和块状构造。可细分为锰质黏土岩、锰质碳酸盐岩、锰质晬屑岩和锰质硅质岩等类型。呈层状、透镜状或结核状。主要在海洋或湖泊盆地中沉积形成。在风化壳中也能形成次生锰质岩。含MnO达15%即可达到丁业锰矿石的要求，是提取锰的主要原料。结构构造特殊的锰质畀还可作工艺品或装饰材料。中国锰质岩资源丰富，其中海相沉枳的锰质岩为最主要类型。
explanation_en: A sedimentary rock rich in manganese minerals. Its chemical composition is mainly manganese oxide, and there can also be more Fe2O3, SiO2, CaO, MgO, BaO and a small amount of Ti, Co, V, Ni, Cu, Pb, Zn, Mo, Sn, etc. The main minerals are pyroIusite, xonotlite, brucite, limonite, coriander manganese, etc. Impurities include clay mineral, sand, chalcedony, opal, etc. It is generally dark brown, but there are also lighter colors. Some of the rock are soft, earthy, and can dye hands, while others are hard. It usually has kidney like, bean like and massive structure. It can be subdivided into manganese clay rock, manganese carbonatite, manganese clastic rock and manganese silicolite. It is layered, lenticular, or nodular in shape. Mainly formed by sedimentation in oceans or lake basins. Secondary manganese rock can also be formed in weathering crust. Containing up to 15% MnO can meet the requirements of Dingye manganese ore, which is the main raw material for extracting manganese. Manganese with special structure can also be used as handicrafts or decorative materials. China is rich in manganese rock resources, of which marine sedimentary trifoliate orange manganese rock is the most important type.

explanation_cn: 与金属锂相对应的锂离子脱出/嵌入电压为4.0V。一种尖晶石AB2X4结构的氧化物。外观呈黑色或褐色的粉末。它作为电池材料具有价格低、安全性能好等优点。
explanation_en: The stripping/embedding voltage of lithium ion corresponding to metallic lithium is 4.0V. An oxide with spinel AB2X4 structure. Powder with black or brown appearance. As a battery materials, it has the advantages of low price and good safety performance.

explanation_cn: 用作脱氧剂或合金元素添加剂的铁和锰的合金，锰含量通常为63%-88%。根据碳含量吋分为低碳锰铁(碳含量0.2%-0.7%)、中碳锰铁(碳含量1.0%-2.0%)和高碳锰铁(碳含量7.0%-8.0%),碳含量越低生产成本越高。根据生产方法可分为电炉锰铁和高炉锰铁(高炉仅能生产高碳锰铁)。GB/T 3795-2006对锰铁牌号和化学成分具有明确规定，每个牌号根据杂质元素硅、磷的含量又分为2个等级。锰系铁合金还包括金属锰(GB/T 2774-2006,锰含量大于93%)、锰硅合金和微碳锰铁(锰含量84%-90%,碳含量0.05%-0.15%，YB/T 4l40-2005)。锰铁广泛用作炼钢的脱氧剂、脱硫剂和合金添加剂，微碳锰铁主要用作高品质不锈钢的合金添加剂。锰铁产量占铁合金总产量的一半左右。
explanation_en: Iron and manganese alloy used as deoxidizer or alloy element additive usually contain 63% -88% manganese. According to the carbon content, it can be divided into low carbon ferromanganese (carbon content 0.2% -0.7%), medium carbon ferromanganese (carbon content 1.0% -2.0%) and high carbon ferromanganese (carbon content 7.0% -8.0%). The lower the carbon content, the higher the production cost. According to the production method, it can be divided into electric furnace ferromanganese and blast furnace ferromanganese (blast furnace can only produce high carbon ferromanganese). GB/T 3795-2006 clearly stipulates the grades and chemical composition of ferromanganese, and each grade is divided into two grades according to the content of impurity elements silicon and phosphorus. Manganese ferroalloy also include metallic manganese (GB/T 2774-2006, manganese content is more than 93%), ferrosilicomanganese and low-carbon ferromanganese (manganese content is 84% -90%, carbon content is 0.05% -0.15%, YB/T 4l40-2005). Ferromanganese is widely used as deoxidizer, desulfurizer and alloy additive for steelmaking, and low-carbon ferromanganese is mainly used as alloy additive for high-quality stainless steel. The output of ferromanganese accounts for about half of the total output of ferroalloy.

explanation_cn: 一种具有中等电阻和低电阻温度系数的锰铜精密电阻合金。Cu-Mn二元合金为γ固溶体，添加少量镍能使合金对铜的热电势降低，改善电阻温度系数并提高耐蚀性能。其典型合金成分为86Cu-12Mn-2Ni，最高容许工作温度300°C，但对局部氧化腐蚀很敏感。合金经过塑性变形制成线材和带材，在仪表和控制设备中用来测量和调节电特性，如用来制作绕线电阻器、分流电阻器和滑线电阻器等。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a manganese copper precision resistance alloy with medium resistance and low resistance temperature coefficient. Cu Mn binary alloy is γ Solid solution, adding a small amount of nickel can reduce the thermoelectric potential of alloy to copper, improve the resistance temperature coefficient and improve the corrosion resistance. Its typical alloy composition is 86Cu-12Mn-2Ni, the maximum allowable working temperature is 300 ° C, but it is sensitive to local oxidation corrosion. After plastic deformation, alloy is made into wire rod and strip, which are used to measure and adjust electrical characteristics in instruments and control equipment, such as making winding resistor, shunt resistor and sliding resistor.

explanation_cn: 在Mn-Cu合金中添加Al、Ni、Fe等元素的阻尼材料。铸态组织由韧性的亚稳相γ，强韧相β所组成，界面阻尼来源于孪晶界面和相界面的运动和反铁磁性磁矩(畴)转向运动。凝固速度对阻尼性能和力学性能有影响。对不同厚度的铸件有一个最佳的凝固速率。可焊性好，可作拼焊结构件，可进行冷、热加工、拉丝。在航海、航空、核工业、机械制造等领域已获得广泛应用。
explanation_en: A damping material in which Al, Ni, Fe and other elements are added to Mn Cu alloy. As cast microstructure consists of ductile metastable phase γ， Tough phase β The interface damping comes from the movement of the twin interface and the phase interface and the anti ferromagnetism magnetic moment (domain) turning movement. The solidification speed has an impact on damping and mechanical properties. There is an optimal solidification rate for castings with different thicknesses. With good weldability, it can be used as butt welded structural parts, and can be used for cold and hot working and wire drawing. It has been widely used in fields such as navigation, aviation, nuclear industry, and mechanical manufacturing.

explanation_cn: 一种软磁铁氧体。属尖晶石型结构,由Mn、Zn、Fe的氧化物及其盐类通过一般电子陶瓷工艺制成。为改善性能，有时采用通氧烧结成热压工艺。这种材料具有高起始磁导率，可达40000，磁导率与品质因素乘积在100kHz时，可达1.25X106高饱和磁感应强度，可达5000Gs，使用频率范围lkHz-10MHz,可制作电感器、变压器、脉冲变压器、滤波器的磁芯.天线棒及磁头等。
explanation_en: A soft magnetic ferrite. It has a spinel structure and is made of Mn, Zn, Fe oxides and their salts by general electronic ceramics process. In order to improve the properties, the hot pressing process is sometimes adopted by oxygen passing sintering. This materials has high initial permeability, up to 40000. When the product of permeability and quality factor is 100kHz, it can reach 1.25X106 high saturation magnetic induction, up to 5000Gs. The frequency range is lkHz-10MHz. It can be used to make magnetic cores, antenna rods and magnetic heads of inductors, transformers, pulse transformers and filters.

explanation_cn: 以猛为主要合金元素的铜合金。工业上常用的锰青铜有Cu-1.5Mn,Cu-5Mn合金。铜锰合金具有良好的力学性能、耐热、耐蚀，可以进行冷热加工。工业上用猛青铜制作高温工作零件、电子仪表零件、蒸汽锅炉管配件和各种接头、蒸汽管、蒸汽阀、火花塞、锅炉各种焊件。多元铜锰合金如Cu-35Mn-2Ni的高温焊料，Cu-35Mn-14Zn的弹性合金，Cu-20Ni-20Mn新型弹性材料，这几种合金都属于热处理强化型。后者的拉伸强度可达1274MPa,弹性模量E达到14700OMPa。而Cu-42Mn-2Al则是一种具有很好减振性能的减振合金，工业上已用来制造减振零件。
explanation_en: Copper alloy with Meng as the main alloy element. The commonly used manganese bronze in industry includes Cu-1.5Mn and Cu-5Mn alloy. Copper manganese alloy has good mechanical properties, heat resistance, corrosion resistance, and can be used for cold and hot processing. In industry, Meng bronze is used to make high-temperature working parts, electronic instrument parts, steam boiler pipe fittings and various joints, steam pipes, steam valves, spark plugs, and various welding parts of boilers. Multi element copper manganese alloy, such as Cu-35Mn-2Ni high-temperature solder, Cu-35Mn-14Zn elasticity alloy, Cu-20Ni-20Mn new elasticity materials, these alloy belong to heat treatment strengthening type. The tensile strength of the latter can reach 1274MPa, and the elastic modulus E can reach 14700OMPa. Cu-42Mn-2Al is a damping alloy with good damping performance, which has been used to manufacture damping parts in industry.

explanation_cn: 在铜锌合金基础上加入锰的黄铜。锰主要起固溶强化作用，能提高黄铜的强度、硬度，并显著提高黄铜在海水、氯化物和过热蒸汽中的耐蚀性。锰黄铜能承受热、冷压力加工，含锰量通常为1%-4%。58Cu-40Zn-2Mn合金具有良好的热冷加工性能，软态的拉伸强度为400MPa，伸长率为40%,适于制作耐磨的活塞头、阀杆、导杆等，在造船工业中大量用于耐蚀结构件。57Cu-39Zn-3Mn-lAl，55Cu-41Zn-3Mn-lFe等合金是分别加入少量铝、铁等元素的锰黄铜，具有较高的强度，软态的拉伸强度为500-55OMPa,伸长率15%-25%,能承受热压力加工，广泛用于造船及军工部门。
explanation_en: Brass with manganese added on the basis of copper zinc alloy. Manganese mainly plays a solid solution strengthening role, can improve the strength and hardness of brass, and significantly improve the corrosion resistance of brass in seawater, chloride and overheating steam. Manganese brass can withstand hot and cold pressure processing, and its manganese content is usually 1% -4%. 58Cu-40Zn-2Mn alloy has good hot and cold working properties. The soft tensile strength is 400MPa, and the elongation is 40%. It is suitable for making wear-resistant piston heads, valve stems, guide rods, etc. It is widely used in the shipbuilding industry for corrosion resistant structural parts. 57Cu-39Zn-3Mn-lAl, 55Cu-41Zn-3Mn-lFe and other alloy are manganese brass with a small amount of aluminum, iron and other elements added respectively. They have high strength, soft tensile strength of 500-55OMPa, elongation of 15% -25%, and can withstand hot pressure processing. They are widely used in shipbuilding and military industries.

explanation_cn: "Fe基"超导体中的122相是一种，其晶体结构类似于CaFe2As2和BaKFe2As2，而且其超导转变温度可达38K。
explanation_en: The 122 phase in the "Fe based" superconductor is one kind. Its crystal structure is similar to CaFe2As2 and BaKFe2As2, and its superconducting transition temperature can reach 38K.

explanation_cn: 利用锻压设备上的银头、砧块或模具对金属坯料施加外力，使其产生塑性变形，从而得到尺寸、形状及性能合格的锻件的成形加工方法。施力时间较短的称为锻，施力时间较长的称为压。在金属材料的塑性成型加工中，最早出现的方法就是锻造。用于锻造的主要设备有汽锤、电液锤、平锻机和快锻机等，用于压制的主要设备是压力机（水压机、油压机、曲柄压力机、摩擦压力机和螺旋压力机）。根据采用的锻压设备和模具可将锻压工艺分为自由锻、模锻、模压、冲压等；根据锻压时锻坯的温度可分为热锻、温锻和冷锻。
explanation_en: Use the silver head, anvil block or die on the forging and pressing equipment to apply external force on the metal billet to make it plastic deformation, so as to obtain the forming processing method of forgings with qualified size, shape and performance. The shorter the application time is called forging, and the longer the application time is called pressing. In the plastic forming of metallic materials, the earliest method is forging. The main equipment used for forging are steam hammer, electro-hydraulic hammer, flat forging machine and fast forging machine, etc. The main equipment used for pressing is press (hydraulic press, hydraulic press, crank press, friction press and screw press). According to the forging and pressing equipment and dies used, forging and pressing processes can be divided into hammer forging, die forging, die pressing, stamping, etc; According to the temperature of forging and pressing billet, it can be divided into hot forging, warm forging and cold forging.

explanation_cn: 在锻造温度范围内具有优良的塑性，可以制造复杂锻件的一种变形铝合金，属于可热处理强化类合金。工业锻铝合金主要包括三个系列：①Al-Mg-Si系合金，含有少量的铜，热处理后具有高的塑性，易锻造，而且具有高的抗疲劳性能，良好的耐腐蚀性能和焊接性能，易于点焊和氢原子焊，适宜在冷态和热态下制造形状复杂的型材和锻件，用于工艺塑性和耐腐蚀性要求高的飞机和发动机零件，直升机桨叶及焊接结构件；②Al-Cu-Mg-Si系合金，随着铜含量的增加，合金的拉伸强度增高，塑性降低，固溶处理加入工时效后具有中等强度，该系列锻铝合金的铸造性能和T艺塑性良好，适于制造形状复杂并承受中等载荷的各类大型锻件和模锻件，应用较广，但该系列锻铝合金有晶间腐蚀与应力腐蚀倾向，不宜用作薄壁零件；③Al-Cu-Mg-Fe-Ni系合金，含有较多的铁和镍元素，具有较高耐热性能，常称为耐热锻铝，温度在200-250℃时.其冷加工性能较好，焊接性能适中，合金中不含锰和铬，无挤压效应，在零件各个方向上具有一致的性能，用于制造航空发动机活塞、叶轮、轮盘、压气机叶片等级其他在较高温度下使用的零件。
explanation_en: It is a kind of wrought aluminium alloy with excellent plasticity in the forging temperature range, which can be used to manufacture complex forgings. It belongs to heat treatable strengthening alloy. Industrial forging aluminium alloy mainly includes three series: ① Al Mg Si series alloy, which contains a small amount of copper, has high plasticity after heat treatment, is easy to forge, and has high fatigue resistance, good corrosion resistance and weld performance, and is easy to sport welding and hydrogen atom welding. It is suitable for manufacturing sections and forgings with complex shapes in cold and hot states, and is used for aircraft and engine parts with high requirements for process plasticity and corrosion resistance, Helicopter blades and weld structural parts; ② Al Cu Mg Si series alloy, with the increase of copper content, the tensile strength of alloy increases and its plasticity decreases. After solution treatment is added to aging treatment, it has medium strength. This series of forging aluminium alloy has good castability and T process plasticity, and is suitable for manufacturing various types of large forgings and die forgings with complex shapes and medium load. It is widely used, but this series of forging aluminium alloy has intergranular corrosion and stress corrosion tendencies, and is not suitable for thin-walled parts; ③ Al Cu Mg Fe Ni series alloy contains more iron and nickel elements and has high heat resistance. It is often called heat-resistant forged aluminum. When the temperature is 200-250 ℃, it has good cold working performance and moderate weld performance. alloy does not contain manganese and chromium and has no extrusion effect. It has consistent performance in all directions of parts and is used to manufacture aeroengine pistons, impellers, discs, compressor blades and other parts used at higher temperatures.

explanation_cn: 一种将纯钥或含硅5%-10%的铝合金镀在碳钢板带上制成的涂层钢板。用热镀法、电泳法和真空蒸镀法均可生产镀铝钢板。
explanation_en: The invention relates to a coated sheet made by plating a pure key or an aluminum alloy containing 5% -10% silicon on a carbon steel plate strip. Aluminium coated sheet can be produced by hot plating, electrophoresis and vacuum evaporation.

explanation_cn: 在低碳钢板表面镀一层锌以增加耐蚀性而制成的涂层薄钢板（GB/T 2518-2008)。镀锌板的厚度一般为0.35-3mm。镀锌是一种经济而有效地防止钢材腐蚀的方法。镀锌板的主要生产方法有热镀法和电镀法两种。
explanation_en: A coated thin steel plate made by plating a layer of zinc on the surface of low-carbon steel plate to increase corrosion resistance (GB/T 2518-2008). The thickness of galvanized sheet is generally 0.35-3mm. Galvanizing is an economical and effective method to prevent corrosion of steel product. There are two main production methods for galvanized sheet: hot plating and electroplating.

explanation_cn: 有两种:氯化熔盐电解冶炼工艺技术和硅热还原工艺技术。氯化熔盐电解法包括氯化镁的生产及电解制镁两大过程。在镁工业中采用较多的热还原法是皮江法，这也是国内现行普遍应用的一种方法。皮江法炼镁是将煅烧后的内云石和硅铁按一定配比磨成细粉，压成团块后装在由耐热合金制成的蒸馏器内，在1423-1473K及13Pa条件下还原得到镁蒸气，通过冷凝结晶成固态镁，再熔成镁锭。皮江法工艺投资少，产品质量高，冶炼出来的镁质量等级略高于电解镁。
explanation_en: There are two kinds: chlorinated molten salt electrolysis smelting process technology and silicothermic reduction process technology. The chloride molten salt electrolysis method includes two major processes: the production of magnesium chloride and the electrolysis of magnesium. The commonly used thermal reduction method in the magnesium industry is the Pijiang method, which is also a widely used method in China. The Pidgeon process for magnesium smelting is to grind calcined dolomite and ferrosilicon into fine powder according to a certain proportion, press them into briquettes, put them into a distiller made of heat resistant alloy, reduce them under the conditions of 1423-1473K and 13Pa to obtain magnesium vapor, crystallize them into solid magnesium by condensation, and then melt them into magnesium ingots. Pidgeon process has low investment and high product quality. The quality grade of magnesium produced by smelting is slightly higher than that of electrolytic magnesium.

explanation_cn: 通常是指横断面有多个封闭的通孔，壁厚较小的镁合金型材。由于镁合金中空薄壁型材的结构复杂，目前常采用塑性较好的AZ31镁合金进行制备。镁合金中空薄壁型材主要通过分流组合模挤压方法获得，挤压时实心的镁合金锭坯首先被分流模分成多股金属流，随后金属流在焊合室进行汇聚，在高温高压条件下焊合后被挤压出模孔进而成形。镁合金中空薄壁型材挤压时，往往需要对模具结构进行调整，以使各股金属流的流出速度均匀，否则容易引起型材的翘曲、破裂，甚至不能充满模孔。镁合金中空薄壁型材往往具有多个封闭的通孔，结构复杂，其矫直仍然是一个技术难点。镁合金中空薄壁型材目前主要应用前景在于高速列车、地铁列车、轻轨列车、双层客车、豪华大巴以及货车、专用车等车辆的整体外形结构。
explanation_en: Usually refers to magnesium alloy profiles with multiple closed through-holes and smaller wall thickness in the cross-section. Due to the complex structure of magnesium alloy hollow thinwalled profile, AZ31 magnesium alloy with good plasticity is often used for preparation at present. The magnesium alloy hollow thinwalled profile is mainly obtained by extrusion method of shunt combined die. During extrusion, the solid magnesium alloy ingot is first divided into multiple streams of metal flow by the shunt die, and then the metal flow converges in the welding chamber. After welding under high temperature and high pressure, it is extrusion out of the mold hole for forming. When extrusion magnesium alloy hollow thinwalled profile, it is often necessary to adjust the die structure to make the outflow speed of each metal stream uniform, otherwise it is easy to cause warpage, fracture of the profile, or even can not fill the die hole. The straightening of magnesium alloy hollow thinwalled profile is still a technical difficulty because of their complex structure and multiple closed through holes. At present, the main application prospect of magnesium alloy hollow thinwalled profile is the overall shape structure of high-speed trains, subway trains, light rail trains, double deck passenger cars, luxury buses, freight cars, special vehicles and other vehicles.

name_en: micro arc composite treatment of magnesium alloy
explanation_cn: 是将不需前处理的微弧氧化以及满足产品在不同环境下而选定的后续涂装复合而成的一种短流程、低污染排放的环保型表面处理技术。微弧复合处理借助陶瓷层表面多孔结构，在镁合金表面制备高性能、多用途的陶瓷有机复合涂层，其优异的表面防护效果满足了产品于各种环境条件下的表面性能要求。同时其还具有工艺简单、环保、处理效率高以及膜层综合性能优异等优点，已成为业界认可的镁合金"环保型"表面处理技术。
explanation_en: It is an environmentally friendly surface treatment technology with short process and low pollution emission, which is made by combining micro arc oxidation without pretreatment and subsequent coating selected to meet the requirements of products in different environments. Micro arc composition treatment With the help of the porous structure of the surface of ceramics layer, a high-performance, multi-purpose ceramics organic composite coating is prepared on the surface of magnesium alloy. Its excellent surface protection effect meets the surface performance requirements of products under various environmental conditions. At the same time, it also has the advantages of simple process, environmental protection, high treatment efficiency, and excellent comprehensive performance of the film layer, and has become a recognized "environmentally friendly" surface treatment technology for magnesium alloys in the industry.

name_en: lost foam casting of magnesium alloy
explanation_cn: 采用泡沫塑料制成与产品部件结构和尺寸完全一致的实型模样，经浸涂耐火涂料烘干后进行干砂造型，然后浇入镁液使模样受热汽化消失，进而得到与模样形状和尺寸一致的镁合金部件的精密铸造方法。与其他铸造方法相比，它具有如下特点:铸件表面质量较好、尺寸精度高，铸件结构设计的适应性高，铸塑采用的千砂退让性好，可避免镁合金凝间收缩时的热烈倾向等。消失模铸造过程需在气氛保护下进行。消失模铸造已广泛应用于钢铁铸件，但镁合金消失模铸造技术发展缓慢。美国ECK公司于2002年率先成功浇注消失模AZ91镁合金铸件，而国内镁合金消失模铸造技术研究虽然取得许多进展，出现了诸如镁合金真空低压消失模铸造等新技术，并制备了电动机壳体、飞机导轮和排气管等多种镁合金铸件，但总体上仍处于实验阶段，还未能在工业中获得规模应用。
explanation_en: The foamed plastics is used to make a full mold pattern that is completely consistent with the structure and size of the product parts. After being dried with dipping coating fire-resistant coatings, the dry sand molding is carried out, and then the magnesium liquid is poured into the mold to make the pattern evaporate by heating, thus obtaining a precision casting method for magnesium alloy parts that are consistent with the shape and size of the mold. Compared with other foundry methods, it has the following characteristics: good surface quality of castings, high dimensional accuracy, high adaptability of casting structure design, good yield of thousand sand used for casting plastic, and can avoid the hot tendency of magnesium alloy during condensation shrinkage. The lost foam foundry process needs to be carried out under atmosphere protection. Lost foam casting (EPC) has been widely used in steel castings, but lost foam casting of magnesium alloy technology has developed slowly. In 2002, American ECK Corporation took the lead in successfully casting AZ91 magnesium alloy castings in lost foam casting. Although many advances have been made in the research of lost foam casting of magnesium alloy technology in China, such as new technologies such as magnesium alloy vacuum low-pressure lost foam foundry, and a variety of magnesium alloy castings such as motor shells, aircraft guide wheels, and exhaust pipes have been prepared, they are still in the experimental stage on the whole, and have not been applied in industry on a large scale.

name_en: melting and pouring furnace of magnesium alloy
explanation_cn: 能完成镁合金炉料溶化、温度调节、并定量定位供应给铸造成型设备(如:铸造机械、铸锭机、半连续铸机、扳坯连铸机等)的一类镁合金熔体制备供应设备。根据熔化工艺的连续性，镁合金熔化浇注炉分为间歇式熔化浇注炉和连续式熔化浇注炉；根据阻燃介质，镁合金熔化浇注炉分为熔剂保护熔化浇注炉和气体保护熔化浇注炉；根据能源形式和加热原理，镁合金熔化浇注炉分为燃气熔化浇注炉、电阻熔化浇注炉和感应熔化浇注炉；根据浇注定量方式，镁合金熔化浇注炉分为电磁浇注炉、气压浇注炉、活寒泵浇注炉和旋转罙浇注炉。通常，熔化率、熔体品质、浇注定量精度、阻燃方法、安全可靠性、能源成本、过程控制的智能化程度等是评价镁合金熔化炉的主要考量。常见的镁合金版铸用熔化浇注炉浇注炉体及加热系统、坩埚及炉盖、保护气体系统、定量浇注系统、三维定位系统、安全保障系统、集成控制系统等构成。匹配镁合金炉料预热和入炉机构后，就可以实现镁合金铸锭熔化浇注作业的自动化。
explanation_en: It is a kind of magnesium alloy melt preparation and supply equipment that can complete melting of magnesium alloy furnace charge, adjust temperature, and provide quantitative positioning to foundry molding equipment (such as foundry machinery, ingot casting machine, semi continuous casting machine, slab continuous caster, etc.). According to the continuity of melting process, melting and pouring furnace of magnesium alloy can be divided into intermittent melting pouring furnace and continuous melting pouring furnace; According to the flame retardant medium, melting and pouring furnace of magnesium alloy is divided into flux protected melting pouring furnace and gas protected melting pouring furnace; According to the energy form and heating principle, melting and pouring furnace of magnesium alloy is divided into gas melting pouring furnace, resistance melting pouring furnace and induction melting pouring furnace; According to the pouring quantitative method, melting and pouring furnace of magnesium alloy is divided into electromagnetic pouring furnace, pneumatic pouring furnace, cold pump pouring furnace and rotary pouring furnace. Usually, melting rate, melt quality, pouring quantitative accuracy, flame retardant method, safety and reliability, energy cost, and intelligent degree of process control are the main considerations for evaluating magnesium alloy melting furnaces. The commonly used melting and pouring furnace for magnesium alloy plate casting is composed of the furnace body and heating system, crucible and furnace cover, protective gas system, quantitative pouring system, three-dimensional positioning system, safety assurance system, integrated control system, etc. After matching the preheating and feeding mechanism of magnesium alloy furnace material, the automation of magnesium alloy ingot melting and pouring operation can be achieved.

name_en: gas protection of magnesium alloy smelting
explanation_cn: 就是在镁合金熔炼过程中采用能与镁及镁合金熔体反应生成高致密度氧化膜的混合保护气体，在镁合金熔池表面形成一层致密柔韧的氧化膜，将熔体与空气隔离开来，达到防止镁挥发和氧化燃烧的作用。通常，镁合金熔炼用混合保护气体由反应成膜气体和将反应成膜气体稀释、携带并均匀分布到熔池表面的载流气体。常见的成膜气体有SF6、BF3、SO2、氟利昂等。其中，SF6因其强烈的温室效应，已在欧美被立法禁用，而常见载流气体有N2、CO2、干燥空气、Ar等，其中，氮应用最广泛。出于保护膜只能在混合保护气氛中的反应成膜气体浓度超过临界值(如:SF6浓度大于0.1%)时才能保持致密和稳定，故需要不断向镁合金熔池表面通入混合保护气体才能获得稳定的保护效果。镁合金气体保护具有使用方便、可智能凋控、保护效果理想等优点；但也存在当熔体温度过高时保护效果变差甚至丧失、用量过大或反应成膜组分过浓会导致坩埚和炉具腐蚀等问题。
explanation_en: In the process of magnesium alloy melting, mixed shielding gas that can react with magnesium and magnesium alloy melt to form a high efficiency of spare filling oxide film is used to form a dense and flexible oxide film on the surface of magnesium alloy molten pool to isolate the melt from the air, so as to prevent magnesium volatilization and oxidation combustion. Generally, the mixed shielding gas for magnesium alloy melting consists of reaction film forming gas and current carrying gas that dilutes, carries and distributes the reaction film forming gas evenly on the surface of the molten pool. Common film-forming gases include SF6, BF3, SO2, Freon, etc. Among them, SF6 has been banned by legislation in Europe and the United States due to its strong warm cell (nuclear) effect. The common current carrying gases are N2, CO2, dry air, Ar, etc., of which nitrogen is the most widely used. Due to the fact that the protective film can only maintain density and stability when the concentration of reaction film forming gas in a mixed protective atmosphere exceeds the critical value (such as SF6 concentration greater than 0.1%), it is necessary to continuously introduce mixed protective gas to the surface of the magnesium alloy molten pool to achieve stable protective effect. Magnesium alloy gas protection has the advantages of convenient use, intelligent control, and ideal protection effect; However, when the melt temperature is too high, the protection effect becomes worse or even lost, and too much dosage or too rich reaction film forming components will lead to corrosion of crucible and furnace tools.

name_cn: 镁合金熔炼的熔剂保护
name_en: flux protection of magnesium alloy smelting
explanation_cn: 就是在镁合金熔炼过程中采用以低熔点氯盐为主的熔盐混合物(即熔剂)，在镁合金熔池表面形成一层致密熔融熔剂层，将镁熔池与空气隔离开来，达到阻碍镁挥发和氧化燃烧的目的。根据镁合金身特性，AZ和AM系列的镁合金熔炼常采用MgCl2、KC12为主的氯盐熔剂进行阻燃保护；也可在熔剂中添加一定比例的氯化锂，以降低熔剂密度、获得持续的阻燃效果；还可在熔剂中添加活泼金属氯化物，以降低熔剂与活泼合金化元素的反应能力。镁合金熔剂保护具有人工施用便利、保护效果良好的优势。但也存在为维持保护效果需不断补充、熔剂易于与空气中的水蒸气反应释放腐蚀性气体、残余熔剂难以环保排放、会与锆及稀土等活泼合金化元素反戍降低其收得率和含量不断变化、残留熔剂污染熔体并会与活泼合金化元素反应导致成分波动和二次污染、熔剂管理依赖人力等问题。
explanation_en: It is to use the molten salt mixture (i.e. flux) dominated by low melting point chloride in the melting process of magnesium alloy to form a layer of dense molten flux on the surface of the magnesium alloy molten pool, isolate the magnesium molten pool from the air, so as to prevent magnesium volatilization and oxidation combustion. According to the characteristics of magnesium alloy body, the magnesium alloy melting of AZ and AM series often uses chloride flux mainly composed of MgCl2 and KC12 for flame retardant protection; A certain proportion of lithium chloride can also be added to flux to reduce the density of flux and obtain a sustained flame retardant effect; Active metal chlorides can also be added to flux to reduce the reaction ability of flux and active alloy elements. Magnesium alloy flux protection has the advantages of convenient manual application and good protection effect. However, there are also problems that need to be constantly supplemented to maintain the protection effect, flux is easy to react with water vapor in the air to release corrosive gases, residual flux is difficult to discharge environmentally, it will fight with active alloy elements such as zirconium and rare earth to reduce its yield and content, the residual flux contaminates the melt and reacts with active alloy elements to cause composition fluctuations and secondary pollution, and flux management depends on human resources.

explanation_cn: 以镁为基体的具有较高放电电位的镁合金材料。按照化学成分可分为Mg-Li、Mg-Al-Pb、Mg-Hg-Ga、Mg-Mn等系列合金。通过合金元素的添加，可提高镁基体的放电电位，并控制镁合金腐蚀放电和自腐蚀之间的平衡。镁合金电池材料的使用形式主要是挤压板材和挤压棒材，可用于耗电量较低的民用产品，部分可用于对放电要求较高的军用产品。
explanation_en: Magnesium alloy materials with high discharge potential based on magnesium. According to chemical composition, it can be divided into Mg Li, Mg Al Pb, Mg Hg Ga, Mg Mn and other series of alloy. The addition of alloy elements can improve the discharge potential of magnesium matrix, and control the balance between corrosion discharge and self corrosion of magnesium alloy. Magnesium alloy battery are mainly extrusion plates and extrusion bar, which can be used for civilian products with low power consumption, and some can be used for military products with high discharge requirements.

explanation_cn: 通过胶黏剂与镁合金件之间的化学反应或物理凝同等作用将两个或多个镁合金件连接形成牢固接头。具有以下特点或优点:应力均匀分布、无变形，适于薄板连接，水/气密性好，可实现异种金属接合，电、热绝缘性好等。胶接工艺过程为:①设计出一定的接头形状，以保证有一定的胶接面积，将被黏物按所设计的尺寸进行加工；②进行预装配，修正配合间隙，并进行表面毛化处理以获得优良的胶接强度；③将配制好的胶黏剂涂布于被黏物表面上，搭接组装好后在一定的温度、压力和保温时间条件下进行固化。以板-板胶接的拉伸剪切强度为评估指标，通过加速湿热老化试验考核胶接结构的破坏模式和失效机理。被胶接件的表面状态、接头形式、温度、应力、胶层本身的强度和界面结合强度将影响胶接接头的强度和耐久性。镁合金易氧化，氧化膜的存在直接影响接头的胶接强度，因此镁合金胶接可采用微弧氧化在表面形成2-3μm微弧氧化膜层，膜层的微孔有利于黏结胶的渗入，该膜层与J-47中温固化胶粘剂的胶接强度为18.9MPa,远高于基体的5.8MPa。但镁合金胶接通常抗剥离强度低、耐热性差和胶层易老化，人们充分利用焊接和胶接在性能上的互补性,发展了激光胶接焊、胶接点焊等先进连接方式，扩大了应用领域。镁合金胶接可广泛应用于轨道交通、汽车、航空航天等领域。
explanation_en: Two or more magnesium alloy parts are connected to form a firm joint through the chemical reaction or physical coagulation between adhesive and magnesium alloy parts. It has the following characteristics or advantages: uniform stress distribution, no deformation, suitable for thin plate connection, good water/air tightness, can achieve dissimilar metal bonding, good electrical and thermal insulation, etc. The bonding process includes: ① designing a certain joint shape to ensure a certain bonding area, and processing the adhesive according to the designed size; ② Perform pre assembly, correct fit gaps, and perform surface texturing treatment to obtain excellent bonding strength; ③ Apply the prepared adhesive on the surface of the adherent, and conduct curing under certain temperature, pressure and holding time after lapping and assembling. Taking the lap shear strength of plate to plate bonding as an evaluation index, the failure mode and failure mechanism of bonded structures were examined by accelerated hot-humid aging test. The surface state, joint form, temperature, stress, strength of the adhesive layer itself, and interface bonding strength of the bonded component will affect the strength and durability of the bonded joint. Magnesium alloy is easy to oxidize, and the existence of oxide film directly affects the bonding strength of joints. Therefore, micro arc oxidation can be used to form 2-3 on the surface of adhesion of magnesium alloy μ M micro arc oxidation film, the micropore of the film is conducive to the penetration of adhesive, and the bonding strength between the film and J-47 medium temperature curing adhesive is 18.9 MPa, far higher than 5.8 MPa of the matrix. However, adhesion of magnesium alloy usually has low peel strength, poor heat resistance and easy aging of the adhesive layer. People have made full use of the complementarity of weld and bonding in performance, developed advanced bonding methods such as laser bonding and bonding sport welding, and expanded the application field. Magnesium alloy bonding can be widely used in fields such as rail transit, automobiles, aerospace, etc.

explanation_cn: 局部腐蚀是镁合金最重要的腐蚀破坏形态。根据腐蚀形貌，局部腐蚀又可分为点蚀、丝状腐蚀、电偶腐蚀、应力腐蚀、腐蚀疲劳和磨损腐蚀等。其中，点蚀、丝状腐蚀和电偶腐浊最为常见，点蚀总是从基相开始，析出相附近尤易发生，它集中在镁合金表面小范围内，并深人到合金内部，形成直径小且深的腐浊坑。丝状腐蚀则位于镁合金表层，镁基体和有涂层覆盖的表面都能发生。丝状腐蚀从基相萌生以后沿着一定路径向前延伸，最终在镁合金表面留下一条行迹可见的弯弯曲曲的小沟。电偶腐浊包括微观电偶腐蚀和宏观电偶腐蚀。微观电偶腐蚀一般是由析出相与基相间的电位差引起的，宏观电偶腐蚀是镁合金部件与其他金属连接使用时破坏性最强的腐蚀形态.在实际应用中要尤为注意。
explanation_en: Localized corrosion is the most important corrosion failure mode of magnesium alloys. According to the corrosion morphology, localized corrosion can be divided into pitting corrosion, filiform corrosion, galvanic corrosion, stress corrosion, corrosion fatigue and wear corrosion. Among them, pitting corrosion, filiform corrosion and galvanic corrosion are the most common. pitting corrosion always starts from the base phase, especially near the precipitated phase. It is concentrated in a small area of the surface of magnesium alloy, and deep into the interior of alloy, forming a small diameter and deep corrosion pit. The filiform corrosion is located on the surface of magnesium alloy, and both the magnesium matrix and the coated surface can occur. The filiform corrosion extends forward along a certain path after the initiation of the base phase, and finally leaves a visible zigzag groove on the surface of the magnesium alloy. Galvanic corrosion includes microscopic galvanic corrosion and macroscopic galvanic corrosion. Micro galvanic corrosion is generally caused by the potential difference between precipitated phase and base phase. Macro galvanic corrosion is the most destructive corrosion form when magnesium alloy parts are connected with other metals. Special attention should be paid in practical applications.

name_cn: 镁合金自封孔微弧氧化
name_en: self sealing hole micro arc oxidation of magnesium alloy
explanation_cn: 微弧氧化膜为多孔的陶瓷结构，通常需要封孔后处理以降低孔隙率，提高耐蚀性。自封孔微弧氧化膜是指膜中的微孔在成膜过程中自动被氧化物封闭，无需封孔后处理。目前，已在含氟钛酸盐和氟锆酸盐的电解液中获得了镁合金自封孔微弧氧化膜，膜层组分除了含氧化镁外，还含有大量化学稳定性更高的钛氧化物和锆氧化物，耐蚀性比普通微弧氧化膜提高5-6倍，表面无需涂覆有机涂层就可以为镁基体提供良好的防护。
explanation_en: The micro arc oxidation film is a porous ceramics structure, which usually requires post sealing treatment to reduce porosity and improve corrosion resistance. Self sealing micro arc oxidation film refers to the automatic sealing of micropores in the film by oxides during the film forming process, without the need for post sealing treatment. At present, magnesium alloy self sealing micro arc oxidation films have been obtained in electrolytes containing fluorotitanate and fluorozirconate. In addition to magnesium oxide, the film layer components also contain a large amount of titanium oxide and zirconium oxide with higher chemical stability. The corrosion resistance is 5-6 times higher than that of ordinary micro arc oxidation films, and the surface does not need to be coated with organic coatings to provide good protection for the magnesium substrate.

name_en: negative difference effect of magnesium alloy
explanation_cn: 将自腐蚀电位下的析氢速率I0与在一定外加阳极电位下测得到的析氢速率IH之差定为差数效应。
explanation_en: The difference between the hydrogen evolution rate I0 at corrosion potential and the hydrogen evolution rate IH measured at a certain external anode potential is defined as the difference effect.

explanation_cn: 阳极氧化是指在外加电所或电流作用下，将镁合金试件作为阳极，通过试件与处理液之间的电化学反应，形成保护性氧化膜的表面处理技术。根据外加电戊的大小不同，阳极氧化分为常规阳极氧化和等离子体微弧氧化两类。常规阳极氧化是在低电压下进行的，Dow17和HAE是最具有代表性的镁合金阳极氧化工艺。镁合金阳极氧化膜具有与基体金属结合力强、电绝缘性好、耐蚀耐磨等优点，同时，其具有的多孔结构吋以作为涂装底层，以增进涂层与合金基体的结合力。镁合金微弧氧化是在高压(通常200-600V)下进行的，目前其研究和使用比常规阳极氧化更广泛。与化学转化膜相比，镁合金阳极氧化膜耐蚀性、耐磨性更好，但成本略高，工艺也更复杂。
explanation_en: Anodizing refers to the surface treatment technology of forming protective oxide film by taking magnesium alloy specimen as anode under the action of external electric station or current through the electrochemical reaction between specimen and treatment solution. According to the size of the applied charge, anodizing can be divided into two types: conventional anodizing and plasma micro arc oxidation. Conventional anodizing is carried out under low voltage. Dow17 and HAE are the most representative magnesium alloy anodizing processes. The magnesium alloy anodic oxide film has the advantages of strong adhesion with the matrix metal, good electrical insulation, corrosion resistance and wear resistance. At the same time, its porous structure can be used as the coating substrate to improve the adhesion between the coating and the alloy matrix. Magnesium alloy micro arc oxidation is carried out under high pressure (usually 200-600V), and its research and use are more extensive than conventional anodic oxidation. Compared with chemical conversion coating, magnesium alloy anodic oxide coating has better corrosion resistance and wear resistance, but its cost is slightly higher and the process is more complex.

explanation_cn: 以镁为主要组成元素、能可逆地吸收和释放氢气的材料。具有储氢量大，资源丰富，价格低廉等优点。目前，镁基储氢材料主要有镁系储氢合金、镁基配位氢化物储氢材料和镁基复合储氢材料。
explanation_en: A materials with magnesium as the main constituent element that can absorb and release hydrogen reversibly. It has the advantages of large hydrogen storage capacity, abundant resources, and low prices. At present, Mg based hydrogen storage materials mainly include magnesium based hydrogen storage alloy, magnesium based coordination hydride hydrogen storage hydrogen storage materials and magnesium based composite hydrogen storage materials.

explanation_cn: 以镁或镁合金为基体，与各种高性能增强材料复合而制得的复合材料增强材料可为纤维状、颗粒状和晶须状的碳化物、硼化物、氧化物及石墨(碳)等，尺寸通常在纳米至微米量级，含量范围一般在5%-75%。镁基复合材料既保持了镁合金的特性，又具有复合材料的综合特性。通过镁合金和不同增强物的优化组合，可获得具有特殊性能和优异的综合性能的镁基复合材料。主要制造方法有粉末冶金法、熔体浸渗法、搅拌铸造法和喷射共沉积工艺等。
explanation_en: The composite materials reinforcement materials made from magnesium or magnesium alloy as the matrix and compounded with various high-performance reinforcement materials materials can be fibrous, granular and crystal whisker carbide, boride, oxide and graphite (carbon), with the size usually ranging from nanometer to micrometer, and the content generally ranging from 5% to 75%. Magnesium matrix composite not only maintain the characteristics of magnesium alloys, but also have the comprehensive characteristics of composite materials. By optimizing the combination of magnesium alloy and different reinforcements, magnesium matrix composite with special properties and excellent comprehensive properties can be obtained. The main manufacturing methods include powder metallurgy, melt infiltration, stirring casting method and spray codeposition.

explanation_cn: 以镁或镁合金为基体的生物材料，巧妙地利用镁合金在人体环境中易发生腐蚀(降解)的特性，来实现金属植人物在体内逐渐降解直至最终消失的医学临床目的。镁基生物材料包括纯镁、生物医用镁合金、生物医用镁基复合材料等。镁基生物材料发挥了镁作为生物材料特有的优点:具有优良的力学性能，其弹性模量、抗压屈服强度和密度比其他金属基生物材料更接近人骨；同时具有可降解性能，且降解产物于人体无害，以及生物相容性好等优点。目前的研究主要集中新型镁基生物材料的开发、改性和体内外降解.其潜在的应用为硬组织替换和修复、可降解的管腔内支架和和组织工程支架等方面。
explanation_en: The biomaterials based on magnesium or magnesium alloys skillfully make use of the characteristics of magnesium alloys that are prone to corrosion (degradation) in the human environment to achieve the medical and clinical purpose of metal implant gradually degradation in the body until the final disappearance. Mg based biomaterials include pure magnesium, biomedical magnesium alloy, biomedical magnesium matrix composite, etc. Mg based biomaterials play the unique advantages of magnesium as a biological materials: it has excellent mechanical properties, and its elastic modulus, compressive yield strength and density are closer to human bone than other metal based biological materials; At the same time, it has the advantages of degradation, harmless degradation products to human body, and good biocompatibility. The current research mainly focuses on the development, modification and degradation of new Mg based biomaterials in vivo and in vitro. Its potential applications include hard tissue replacement and repair, degradation intracavitary stem and tissue engineering scaffolds.

explanation_cn: 以方镁石和镁铝尖晶石为主要矿物组成的耐火制品。一般由镁砂和合成镁铝尖晶石为原料制成。
explanation_en: Refractory products mainly composed of periclase and magnesia alumina spinel. It is generally made of magnesia and synthetic magnesium aluminum spinel as raw materials.

explanation_cn: 见硅酸镁晶体。
explanation_en: See magnesium silicate crystal.

explanation_cn: 参见硅酸镁晶体。以化学式为Mg2SiO4硅酸镁晶体为代表的镁橄榄石结构属于斜方晶系，空间群为Pbam。硅氧四面体被镁氧八面体分割，形成孤岛状结构。属于同样结构的晶体还有:铝酸铍、锗酸钙、硅酸锌等，是重要的新铟激光晶体的基质材料。
explanation_en: See magnesium silicate crystal. The magnesium silicate crystal represented by the chemical formula of Mg2SiO4 magnesium silicate crystal belongs to the orthorhombic system, and the space group is Pbam. The silicon oxide tetrahedron is divided by the magnesium oxide octahedron, forming an island like structure. Other crystal with the same structure include: beryllium aluminate, calcium germanate, zinc silicate, etc., which are the matrix materials of important new indium laser crystal.

explanation_cn: 镁橄榄石陶瓷是镁质瓷的一种。它的主要特点足介质损耗低，且随频率变化小；体积电阻率高，在高温下仍有相当高的数值。电性能比滑石瓷优越，它的热膨胀系数也较高，缺点是热稳定性较差。镁橄榄石陶瓷的工艺性能良好，坯料的吋塑性高，便于成型。镁撖揽石广泛用于制造电真空零件，它作为电真空密封陶瓷是采用金属与陶瓷密封方法，还可利用它制造高功率电容器。
explanation_en: Forsterite ceramics is a kind of magnesia porcelain. Its main characteristic is low dielectric loss and small frequency variation; The coefficient of volume resistance is high and still has a fairly high value at high temperatures. Its electrical performance is superior to that of steatite porcelain, and its coefficient of thermal expansion is also high, but its disadvantage is that its thermal stability is poor. Forsterite ceramics have good processing properties, high plasticity and easy molding. Magnesite is widely used to manufacture electric vacuum parts. As an electric vacuum sealing ceramics, it uses metal and ceramics sealing methods. It can also be used to manufacture high-power capacitors.

explanation_cn: 电化学阴极保护技术中,为被保护金属提供阴极电流,实现阴极保护而不断溶解的一种牺牲阳极材料。镁牺牲阳极具有理论电容量大(2.2A_h/g)、电位负、电流效率较低(50%左右)等特点，适用于高电阻率的土壤和淡水中金属构件的保护，包括高纯镁、Mg-Mn、Mg-Al-Zn-Mn三大系列，通常采用铸造和挤甩的方法制备。根据使用环境的条件和被保护对象的不同，镁阳极可做成不同的形状和尺寸,如:对于埋地储油/水罐的保护常用铸造D形或梯形截面的棒状阳极；对于高电阻率土壤中管道的保护多采用挤压带状阳极；对于家用热水器内胆的保护多采用挤压或铸造的圆棒形阳极；对于电加热棒置于胆内水中的家用热水器，阳极的主要作用是抑制电加热棒水垢的形成。
explanation_en: In electrochemical cathodic protection technology, it is a sacrificial anode materials that provides cathodic current for the protected metal to realize cathodic protection and continuously dissolves. Magnesium alloy sacrificial anodes has the characteristics of large theoretical capacitance (2.2A_h/g), negative potential, low current efficiency (about 50%), and is suitable for the protection of metal components in soil and fresh water with high resistivity, including three series of high purity magnesium, Mg Mn, and Mg Al Zn Mn, which are usually prepared by foundry and extrusion. The magnesium anode can be made into different shapes and sizes according to the conditions of the use environment and the different objects to be protected.
