For example, for the protection of buried oil/water tanks, foundry D-shaped or trapezoidal bar shaped anodes are commonly used; Extrusion ribbon anode is often used to protect pipelines in high resistivity soil; For the protection of domestic water heater tank, extrusion or foundry round rod anode is often used; For household water heaters where the electric heating rod is placed in the water tank, the main function of the anode is to suppress the formation of scale on the electric heating rod.

explanation_cn: 参见电气石。
explanation_en: See tourmaline.

explanation_cn: 主要用镁白云石制成的耐火砖。一种氧化钙含量较高的碱性耐火材料。主要用于水泥窑等。
explanation_en: Refractory bricks mainly made of magnesium dolomite. A basic refractory with high calcium oxide content. It is mainly used in cement kilns.

explanation_cn: 是MgO含量90%以上、以方镁石为主晶相的碱性耐火制品。分为烧成镁砖和不烧镁砖。
explanation_en: It is an alkaline refractory product with more than 90% MgO content and peridase as the main crystal phase. It is divided into fired magnesite brick brick and unfired magnesite brick.

explanation_cn: 以镁砂和石墨为主要原料制成的耐火制品(碳含量一般为8%-20%)，显气孔率较低，具有优良的抗渣侵蚀性、抗熔渣渗透性、热震稳定性和导热性。主要用于炼钢转炉、电弧炉及钢包等作为内衬。
explanation_en: Refractory products made of magnesia and graphite as main raw materials (carbon content is generally 8% -20%) have low apparent porosity, excellent slag corrosion resistance, slag penetration resistance, thermal shock resistance and thermal conductivity. It is mainly used as lining for steelmaking converter, electric arc furnace and ladle.

explanation_cn: 单质镁的粉未状态。主要由电解熔融的氯化镁和电解熔融的去水光卤石制取。镁粉溶于矿物酸、浓氢氟酸、铵盐和热水中。粉末云燃点600°C，静电感度120mJ。镁粉具有易燃易爆、燃烧时产生高温和耀眼的白光的特征，在军工业和航天工业等科技领域中都有广泛应用。炼钢业及有色金属铸造中，用镁粉做脱硫剂、净化剂，在稀有金属生产中做还原剂。在化学工业中，镁粉在喷涂、防腐行业中用途越来越大，在单晶硅、多晶硅以及冶金粉末压铸方面用量也很大。
explanation_en: The powder state of elemental magnesium. Mainly produced from electrolytic molten magnesium chloride and electrolytic molten dehydrated carnallite. Magnesium powder is soluble in mineral acid, concentrated hydrofluoric acid, ammonium salt and hot water. The ignition point of powder cloud is 600 ° C, and the electrostatic sensitivity is 120mJ. Magnesium powder is flammable, explosive, and produces high temperature and dazzling white light when combustion. it is widely used in military industry, aerospace industry and other scientific and technological fields. Magnesium powder is used as desulfurizer and purifying agent in steelmaking and non-ferrous metal foundry, and as reducing agent in rare metal production. In the chemical industry, magnesium powder is used more and more in the spraying and anti-corrosion industries, as well as in monocrystalline silicon, polycrystalline silicon and metallurgical powder die-casting.

explanation_cn: 以镁粉为主要可燃剂的点火药。由于镁价格低、来源广,镁系点火药广泛用于点燃照明剂、曳光剂、燃烧剂、诱饵剂、信号剂以及发火点较高的推进剂等。镁是一种活泼金属,能与沸水反应放出氢气，受潮会产生自燃、自爆，粉末云燃点600°C，静电感度120mJ;镁容易燃烧.燃烧热为2512J/g。镁系点火药主要有由50%-70%镁、50%-30%聚四氟乙烯组成的点火药和由10%镁、75%硝酸钾、15%酚醛树脂组成的点火药,以及用镁与铈合金作可燃剂的点火药，如由40%铈-镁合金(80/20)、60%二氧化铅组成的点火药。
explanation_en: Ignition composition with magnesium powder as the main combustible. Due to the low price and wide source of magnesium, magnesium series ignition propellant is widely used to ignite illuminating composition, tracer, incendiary composition, bait, signal agent and propellant with high ignition point. Magnesium is a kind of active metal, which can react with boiling water to release hydrogen, and will produce spontaneous combustion and spontaneous explosion when exposed to moisture. The ignition point of the powder cloud is 600 ° C, and the electrostatic sensitivity is 120mJ; Magnesium is easy to combustion. The heat of combustion is 2512J/g. Magnesium type ignition composition mainly include ignition composition consisting of 50% -70% magnesium, 50% -30% polylctrafluorocthylone, ignition composition consisting of 10% magnesium, 75% potassium nitrate, 15% phenolic resin, and ignition composition using magnesium and cerium alloys as combustible agents, such as ignition composition consisting of 40% cerium magnesium alloy (80/20) and 60% lead dioxide.

explanation_cn: 一种抗氧化和抗金属间反应的镁基合金。命名起源于在镁中添加少量钙或铍形成的耐氧化合金，意为耐氧化的镁,即magnesium no oxidation,取其字头组成magnox(镁诺克斯)。广泛使用的是镁诺克斯AL80(A12),即在镁中添加0.80%(质量分数)的铝和0.01%的铍等形成的合金。镁中添加0.55%Zr或0.70%的Mn形成的合金分别称为镁诺克斯ZR55(ZA)和镁诺克斯MN70。镁诺克斯ZR55的强度在室温附近高于、在400°C以上低于镁诺克斯AL80的强度。用镁诺克斯ZR55作包壳材料，需在包壳和天然铀芯体之间加中间层(铝或碳)防止钚通过包壳向外扩散。镁诺克斯AL80和镁诺克斯ZR55,主要用作天然铀燃料、石墨慢化剂和二氧化碳冷却剂的生产、动力两用堆(镁诺克斯型反应堆)的燃料元件包壳和端塞等。为了增加热交换效率，包壳常制成带人字形或多头螺旋形散热片。镁诺克斯MN70,因其强度较高和抗蠕变性能较好，主要用作除包壳以外的燃料元件结构材料。
explanation_en: A magnesium based alloy that resists oxidation and reaction between metals. The name originates from the oxidation resistant alloy formed by adding a small amount of calcium or beryllium to magnesium, which means oxidation resistant magnesium, namely magnesium no oxidation. Magnox AL80 (A12) is widely used, which is a alloy formed by adding 0.80% (mass fraction) of aluminum and 0.01% of beryllium to magnesium. The alloy formed by adding 0.55% Zr or 0.70% Mn to magnesium is called Magnox ZR55 (ZA) and Magnox MN70 respectively. The strength of magnesium Knox ZR55 is higher near room temperature and lower than that of magnesium Knox AL80 at temperatures above 400 ° C. When Magnox ZR55 is used as cladding materials, an intermediate layer (aluminum or carbon) should be added between the cladding and the natural uranium core to prevent plutonium from diffusion outward through the cladding. Magnox AL80 and Magnox ZR55 are mainly used for the production of natural uranium fuel, graphite moderator and carbon dioxide coolant, fuel element cladding and end plug of dual purpose power reactor (Magnox type reactor), etc. In order to increase heat exchange efficiency, the cladding is often made into herringbone or multi head spiral heat dissipation fins. Magnox MN70 is mainly used as structural materials of fuel element except cladding due to its high strength and good creep resistance.

explanation_cn: 以含MgO的钥硅酸盐为主晶相的陶瓷，有米黄内和象牙白两种呈色。按主晶相不同，可分为原顽辉石瓷、镁橄榄石瓷、尖晶石瓷及堇青石瓷。瓷质细腻乳白、薄胎半透明、布脂肪光泽。可高频绝缘电瓷、高级日用瓷等。
explanation_en: The ceramics with MgO containing key silicate as the main crystal phase have two colors: beige interior and ivory white. According to the main crystal phase, it can be divided into protoenstatite ceramics, forsterite porcelain, spinel porcelain and cordierite porcelain. Porcelain is delicate and creamy white, with a thin translucent body and a glossy fabric. High frequency insulating electric porcelain, high-grade household porcelain, etc.

explanation_cn: 以白云石或高钙合成镁砂为主要原料，加入适量的炭黑和石墨等，以无水有机结合剂制成的耐火材料。具有优良的抗碱性渣侵蚀性、热震稳定性和导热性，也有净化钢水的作用。
explanation_en: The refractory is made of dolomite or high calcium synthetic sintered magnesia as the main raw material, with appropriate amount of carbon black and graphite added, and with anhydrous organic binder. It has excellent corrosion resistance to alkaline slag, thermal shock resistance and thermal conductivity, and also has the function of purifying molten steel.

explanation_cn: 又称高转镁砖。以镁钙砂为原料，经粉碎、配料、混炼、成型后，在1550-1600℃高温下烧成得到的以方镁石为主晶相、以硅酸二钙为次晶相的镁质耐火材料。
explanation_en: It is also called high rotation magnesite brick. Magnesia based refractory with periclase as the main crystal phase and dicalcium silicate as the secondary crystal phase is obtained by taking magnesium calcium sand as the raw material, crushing, batching, mixing and molding, and firing at 1550-1600 ℃.

explanation_cn: 是镁质瓷的一种，属面心立方结构。其介质损耗低于滑石瓷，介电常数稍高，化学稳定性好，热的稀酸或冷的浓酸长时间作用无侵蚀现象，甚至HF酸或熔融的苛性碱对它也没有显著影响。在无线电工业上，镁铝尖晶石瓷可被用来生产低压高频电容器、感应线圈骨架及电子管管座等。
explanation_en: It is a kind of magnesia porcelain with face-centered cubic structure. Its dielectric loss is lower than that of steatite porcelain, its dielectric constant is slightly higher, its chemical stability is good, and the hot dilute acid or cold concentrated acid has no erosion phenomenon after a long time of action, even HF acid or molten caustic soda has no significant effect on it. In the radio industry, magnesium aluminum spinel porcelain can be used to produce low voltage and high frequency capacitors, induction coil frameworks and electronic tube sockets.

explanation_cn: 方镁石为主晶相、镁铝尖晶石为主要结合相的碱性耐火制品。制品中A1203含量一般小于10%。镁铝砖的特点是抗热震性优于镁砖、荷重软化开始温度较高。
explanation_en: Basic refractories with peridase as the main crystalline phase and magnesium aluminum spinel as the main bonding phase. The content of A1203 in the product is generally less than 10%. The characteristics of magnesite alumina brick are that thermal shock resistance is better than magnesite brick, and the starting temperature of load bating is higher.

explanation_cn: 浇注前向钢水中加入足够数量的强脱氧剂（如硅、铝等）而制成的钢。这种钢脱氧良好，在钢锭模内凝固时不产生CO气体。所以钢水保持平静而不沸腾。所加脱氧剂优先与钢液中的氧化合，生成氧化物--二氧化硅和氧化铝，大部分氧化物进入渣中，也残留一部分在钢中，成为非金属夹杂物。钢锭心部可形成相当大的缩孔。经锻、轧成材后切头量较大，成材率较低，有时甚至低于50%(如质量要求严格的大锻件）。镇静钢的纯净度较高，化学成分偏析小，力学性能在钢锭各部位比较均匀稳定，特别是冲击初性、冷冲压性能良好。可作为锻造、渗碳及热处理用钢。含碳量在大约0.25%以上的碳钢及合金钢几乎全部是。镇静钢钢号后面不加符号。
explanation_en: Steel made by adding enough strong deoxidizer (such as silicon, aluminum, etc.) to the molten steel before pouring. This kind of steel is well deoxidation and does not produce CO gas when solidified in the ingot mold. Therefore, the molten steel remains calm without boiling. The added deoxidizer preferentially combines with the oxidation in the steel liquid to generate oxides -- silicon dioxide and aluminum oxide. Most of the oxides enter slag, and some of them remain in steel, becoming non-metallic inclusions. A considerable shrinkage hole can be formed in the center of the ingot. After forging and rolling, the cutting amount is large, and the yield rate is low, sometimes even lower than 50% (such as large forgings with strict quality requirements). The purity of killed steel is high, the chemical composition segregation is small, and the mechanical properties are relatively uniform and stable in all parts of the ingot, especially the initial impact and cold stamping properties are good. It can be used as steel for forging, carburizing and heat treatment. Almost all carbon steel and alloy steel with a carbon content of approximately 0.25% or more are. Killed steel steel designation is not marked.

explanation_cn: 镉与汞配成的合金。其电位稳定，多用于制作标准电池的负极。
explanation_en: A alloy of cadmium and mercury. Its potential is stable and is often used to make negative electrodes for standard batteries.

explanation_cn: 又称镉钎焊合金，镉焊料是指含82%镉，18%锌的合金，工业上广泛用于焊接工艺。一般采用熔融法制备。
explanation_en: Also known as cadmium brazing alloy, cadmium solder refers to alloy containing 82% cadmium and 18% zinc, which is widely used in weld process in industry. Generally prepared by melting method.

explanation_cn: 以镉为主要合金元素的铜合金。镉在铜中的溶解度可达5%。镉能明显地提高合金的力学性能，但使合金的导电性略有降低。镉元素对人体健康有害，在熔炼或电焊时必须严格防护。
explanation_en: Copper alloy with cadmium as the main alloy element. The water solubility of cadmium in copper can reach 5%. Cadmium can obviously improve the mechanical properties of alloy, but slightly reduce the conductivity of alloy. Cadmium is harmful to human health and must be strictly protected during melting or electric welding.

explanation_cn: 一种碱性二次电池，负极活性物质为海绵状镉，正极活性物质为沒-羟SS氢氧化镍。电解液为氢氧化钾水溶液。镍-镉电池具有循环寿命长、大电流性能好、耐过充能力强、经济耐用等优点。小型密封圆柱式和纽扣式镍-镉电池是最早应用于录音器、移动电话等各种便携式电子设备的二次电池。非密封型镍-镉电池的形状多为长方体，额定容量大(最大可达1000A-h)。主要应用于计算机不间断电源、电站控制系统电源以及电梯操作应急电源等。镍镉电池的主要缺点是存在严重的记忆效应，另外，在生产和使用过程中容易引起镍镉污染。不利于生态环境的保护。随着锂离子电池和镍氢电池应用领域的逐步扩展，镍镉电池的应用领域正在逐步缩小。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to an alkaline secondary cell, wherein the negative active material is spongy cadmium, and the positive active material is nickel hydroxide without hydroxySS. The electrolyte is a potassium hydroxide aqueous solution. Nickel cadmium battery has the advantages of long cycle life, good high current performance, strong overcharge resistance, economy and durability. Small sealed cylindrical and button nickel-cadmium battery are the first secondary cell used in various portable electronic devices such as recorders and mobile phones. The shape of the unsealed nickel-cadmium battery is mostly rectangular, and the rated capacity is large (up to 1000A-h). Mainly used in computer uninterrupted power supply, power supply for power station control systems, and emergency power supply for elevator operation. The main disadvantage of nickel cadmium battery is that it has serious memory effect. In addition, it is easy to cause nickel cadmium pollution in the production and use process. Not conducive to the protection of the ecological environment. With the gradual expansion of the application fields of Li ion battery and nickel hydrogen batteries, the application fields of nickel cadmium batteries are gradually shrinking.

explanation_cn: 以镍为基体的可以通过热加工或(和)冷加工变形制成型材或零件毛坯的高温合金。在镍基体中通常加入10%-25%的铬元素，以保证合金具有良好的高温抗氧化、抗腐蚀性能;加入Co、W、Mo、Ta、Nb、Hf、ReV等多种难熔金属元素进行固溶强化:加入较多的Al、Ti和Nb形成相或/相进行沉淀强化;此外，还加入C、B、Zr和多种微合金化元素进行晶界强韧化。固溶强化型镍基变形髙温合金，由于其热塑性良好，可生产板材制成航空发动机或燃气轮机的火焰筒、加力燃烧室等零部件，使用温度可达900-1000*C。沉淀强化型镍基变形高温合金可制成轮叶片、导向叶片和涡轮盘等零部件，使用温度一般在950°C以下。镍基变形高温合金一般采用电弧炉。常压感应炉或真空感应炉进行一次熔炼，用真空自耗炉或电渣炉重熔工艺生产。经适当的热加工和热处理后应用。
explanation_en: High temperature alloy based on nickel that can be deformed into profiles or parts blanks by hot working or (and) cold working. Generally, 10% -25% chromium is added to the nickel matrix to ensure that the alloy has good high-temperature oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance; Many refractory metal elements such as Co, W, Mo, Ta, Nb, Hf and ReV are added for solution strengthening: more Al, Ti and Nb are added to form phase or/and phase for precipitation strengthening; In addition, C, B, Zr and a variety of microalloying elements are added to strengthen and toughen the grain boundary. Solid solution reinforced nickel based deformation high temperature alloy, due to its good thermoplastic properties, can be used to produce sheet metal for components such as flame tubes and afterburners in aircraft engines or gas turbines, with temperatures up to 900-1000 * C. Precipitation strengthened nickel-base wrought superalloy can be made into wheel blade, guide blade, turbine disk and other parts, and the service temperature is generally below 950 ° C. Nickel-base wrought superalloy generally adopts electric arc furnace. The atmospheric induction furnace or vacuum induction furnace is used for primary melting, which is produced by vacuum consumable furnace or electroslag furnace remelting process. Apply after proper hot working and heat treatment.

explanation_cn: 以镍为基体的由合格母合金重熔后直接浇铸或定向凝固成零件毛坯或零件的高温合金。与镍基变形高温合金比较。镍基铸造高温合金具有粗大的凝固组织-高温强度高;可以加入更多的合金元素进行强化，其强化相数量可达65%以上，从而大幅提高使用温度;可以铸造出冷却白腔非常复杂的涡轮叶片和导向叶片以更大幅度提高发动机的涡轮入口温度。现代先进航空发动机和先进燃气轮机的高压涡轮叶片和导向叶片几乎毫无例外都是采用镍基铸造高温合金制成。而且大多带有形状复杂的冷却通道。
explanation_en: The nickel based high temperature alloy can be directly casting or directional solidification from the qualified parent alloy after remelting into the blank or part. Compared with nickel-base wrought superalloy. Nickel-base cast superalloy has coarse solidification structure and high high temperature strength; More alloy elements can be added for strengthening, and the number of strengthening phase can reach more than 65%, thus greatly increasing the service temperature; The turbine blades and guide vanes with very complex cooling cavity can be foundry to greatly increase the turbine inlet temperature of the engine. Almost without exception, the high-pressure turbine blades and guide vanes of modern advanced aeroengines and gas turbines are made of nickel-base cast superalloy. And most of them have complex shaped cooling channels.

explanation_cn: 以镍为基体的合金。镍具有面心立方结构的y奥氏体。从室温到高温没有同素异构转变》镍基合金通常加入10%-25%的铬元素，以保证合金具有良好的抗氧化、抗腐蚀性能。用Ta、Nb、Hf、Re、V等多种难熔金属元素进行固溶强化，只有固溶强化的合金称为镍基固溶强化合金。此外，镍基合金还加入少量C、B、Zr或多种微合金化元素进行晶界强化。具有固强强化和Y相或/相强化的镍基高温合金即镍基沉淀强化合金。镍基合金中合金元素含量较少且可以通过热加工变形制成型材和零件毛坯的合金属于镍基变形合金，合金元素含量较多的，不能热加工变形。只能通过重熔母合金浇铸或定向凝固成零件或零件毛坯的合金为镍基铸造合金。镍基合金由于高温力学性能良好，组织稳定性高，不易形成TCP相，广泛用于制作8001C以上高温使用的涡轮叶片等零件。
explanation_en: Alloy based on nickel. Nickel has y austenite with face-centered cubic structure. No allotropism transformation from room temperature to high temperature: usually 10% -25% chromium is added to nickel base alloy to ensure that alloy has good oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance. The alloy with solution strengthening is called nickel based solution strengthened alloy, which is made of Ta, Nb, Hf, Re, V and other refractory metal elements. In addition, a small amount of C, B, Zr or multiple microalloying elements are added to the nickel base alloy to strengthen the grain boundary. Nickel-base superalloy with solid strengthening and Y phase or/and phase strengthening is a nickel base precipitation strengthened alloy. Alloy with less element content in nickel base alloy and which can be deformed into profiles and parts blanks through hot working belongs to nickel base deformed alloy. alloy with more element content in alloy cannot be deformed by hot working. The alloy that can only be casting by remelting the parent alloy or directional solidification into parts or parts blanks is nickel base foundry alloy. Nickel base alloy is not easy to form TCP phase due to its good mechanical properties at high temperature and high organizational stability. It is widely used to make turbine blades and other parts used at high temperatures above 8001C.

White cast iron mainly composed of nickel and chromium, nickel hard No. 1 contains (%): C3.0-3.6, Si0.3-0.5, Mn0.3-0.7, Ni3.3~4.8, Crl_ 5-2.6; Nickel hard No. 2 contains (%>) C<2.9, Si0.3-0.5, Mn0.3-0.7, Ni3:3-5.0, Crl4-2.4; nickel hard No. 4 contains (%) C2, 6-3.2, Sil.8-2.0. MnO.4-0.6, Ni5.0-6.5, t'r8.0-9.0. They are mainly martensite, with some bainite and austenite.

explanation_cn: 含NiO的磁致伸缩铁氧体是指具有镍氧化物（NiO）的铁氧体材料，这些材料包括Ni-Zn、Ni-Cu、Ni-Fe、Ni-Zn-Co等不同的铁氧体。这类铁氧体材料具有优异的性能，尤其是在机电耦合方面。举例来说，对于含NiO的铁氧体，其机电耦合系数Kr通常在18%到20%之间，而品质因数Q可达4000以上。这使其成为一种性能卓越的磁致伸缩材料。高密度对于提高磁致伸缩效应至关重要，因此在制备工艺中，需要采取措施以增加材料的密度。此外，将少量CuO作为助熔剂加入材料中有助于提高密度和机电耦合系数Kr。此外，添加少量CoFe2O4的固溶体也可以提高在剩磁状态下的机电耦合系数。总的来说，这类含NiO的磁致伸缩铁氧体是具有卓越性能的材料，尤其在机电耦合方面表现出色。在制备和改进过程中，密度的提高以及添加特定助剂都可以改善其性能。
explanation_en: Magnetostriction ferrite containing NiO refers to ferrite materials with nickel oxide (NiO). These materials include different ferrite such as Ni Zn, Ni Cu, Ni Fe, Ni Zn Co, etc. This kind of ferrite materials has excellent performance, especially in electromechanical coupling. For example, for ferrite containing NiO, the electromechanical coupling coefficient Kr is usually between 18% and 20%, and the quality factor Q can reach more than 4000. This makes it a magnetostriction materials with excellent performance. High density is very important for improving magnetostriction effect, so in the preparation process, measures need to be taken to increase the density of materials. In addition, adding a small amount of CuO into materials as flux is helpful to improve density and electromechanical coupling coefficient Kr. In addition, the addition of a small amount of CoFe2O4 solid solution can also improve the electromechanical coupling coefficient in the remanence state. In general, this kind of magnetostriction ferrite containing NiO is a materials with excellent performance, especially in electromechanical coupling. In the process of preparation and improvement, the increase of density and the addition of specific additive can improve its performance.

explanation_cn: 有利于减小接触电阻、改善薄膜的热老化性能。NiCr-Pd-Au膜的热稳定性劣于Ti-Pd-Au膜。温度越高，两者的差别越明显。
explanation_en: It is beneficial to reduce the contact resistance and improve the thermal aging performance of the film. The thermal stability of NiCr Pd Au film is inferior to that of Ti Pd Au film. The higher the temperature, the more significant the difference between the two.

explanation_cn: 以镍为基，含铬、铝和钇元素的四元系抗高温热腐蚀涂层。合金元素含量范围，铬为10%-30%(质量分数)，铝为10%-20%，钇为0。5%-1。0%，为7+P的双相结构。其余见钴铬铝钇涂层。
explanation_en: Nickel based quaternary system high-temperature thermal corrosion resistant coating containing chromium, aluminum and yttrium. The element content range of alloy is 10% -30% (mass fraction) for chromium, 10% -20% for aluminum, and 0 for yttrium. 5% -1. 0% is a biphasic structure of 7+P. See Co-Cr-Al-Y coating for the rest.

explanation_cn: 在铜锌合金的基础上，加入镍可以制备黄铜合金。高锌黄铜中加入镍可以获得具有高强度特性的合金，其中65Cu-30Zn-5Ni是典型的一种镍黄铜合金。镍的添加能够提高合金的强度和韧性，并增强合金的抗脱锌和抗应力腐蚀性能。该合金在软态时的拉伸强度为400MPa，伸长率为65%，它可以经过冷加工和热加工成形成管、板、带、线等各种形状，同时具有良好的切削性和焊接性能。这种合金常被用于制造压力表管、造纸网、船用冷凝管以及其他要求耐腐蚀和耐压的零部件。
explanation_en: On the basis of copper zinc alloy, brass alloy can be prepared by adding nickel. High strength alloy can be obtained by adding nickel into high zinc brass, among which 65Cu-30Zn-5Ni is a typical nickel brass alloy. The addition of nickel can improve the strength and toughness of alloy, and enhance the dezincification resistance and stress corrosion resistance of alloy. The tensile strength of the alloy in soft state is 400MPa, and the elongation is 65%. It can be formed into various shapes such as tubes, plates, strips, wires, etc. through cold processing and hot working. At the same time, it has good machinability and weld performance. This kind of alloy is often used to manufacture pressure gauge tubes, paper mesh, marine condenser tubes and other parts that require corrosion resistance and pressure resistance.

explanation_cn: 白色粉未，是由 ZnO和Ga2O3组成的一种具有和尖晶石同型的晶体结构的复合氧化物具有很高的化学稳定性，是一种很好的发光材料，光学带隙约为4.4eV。被认为是一种新型n型半导体材料。
explanation_en: White powder is a composite oxide composed of ZnO and Ga2O3 with crystal structure of the same type as spinel. It has high chemical stability and is a good luminescence materials with an optical band gap of about 4.4eV. It is considered to be a new n-type semiconductor materials.

explanation_cn: 粉末，相对密度6.167。在其激发光谱图中，最强峰值位于295nm，属于Mn的电荷迁移带，在250nm附近有一属于基质的肩峰。发射光谱为双峰结构，最大发射峰位于504nm附近。在真空荧光显示器、薄膜电致发光显示器和场发射显示器中的应用得到了广泛的关注。
explanation_en: Powder, relative density 6.167. In its excitation spectrum, the strongest peak is located at 295nm, belonging to the charge transfer band of Mn, and there is a shoulder peak belonging to the matrix near 250nm. The emission spectrum has a double peak structure, and the maximum emission peak is near 504nm. Applications in vacuum fluorescence displays, thin film electroluminescence displays and field emission displays have received extensive attention.

explanation_cn: 参见赤铁矿。
explanation_en: See hematite.

explanation_cn: 光泽度指的是物体表面方向性选择反射的性质，这一性质决定了呈现在物体表面所能见到的强反射光或物体镜像的程度。镜面光泽度指的是试样表面以镜面反射角反射到规定孔径内的光通量与相同条件下标准镜面反射光通量之比，用百分数表示。测量原理是用光电检测器测定与法线成一定角度（20°、45°、75°)入射到试样表面，并从试样表面与法线成相应角度（20°、45°、75°)反射到规定孔径内的光。20°光泽度主要适用于高光泽度的材料，而75°光泽度主要适用于低光泽度材料。试样的颜色和漫反射比的差别对测定光泽度影响不大。
explanation_en: Glossiness refers to the directionally selected reflection property of the object surface, which determines the degree of strong reflection light or object image that can be seen on the object surface. Degree of specular gloss refers to the ratio of the luminous flux of the sample surface reflected into the specified aperture at the specular reflection angle to the standard specular reflective luminous flux under the same conditions, expressed in percentage. The measurement principle is to use a photodetector to measure the light that is incident at a certain angle (20 °, 45 °, 75 °) with the normal to the surface of the sample, and reflected from the surface of the sample at a corresponding angle (20 °, 45 °, 75 °) with the normal to the specified aperture. 20 ° glossiness is mainly applicable to materials with high glossiness, while 75 ° glossiness is mainly applicable to materials with low glossiness. The difference of color and diffuse reflectance of the sample has little effect on the determination of glossiness.

explanation_cn: 有机玻璃板材经溅射镀金属膜并在其上喷涂保护涂料，使其具有镜面反光效果。镀膜材料有铝、铜、不锈钢。由于铝膜使镜面产生的反光效果最好且价格便宜，通常被选作镀膜材料。生产工艺是将有机玻璃表面清洗、干燥、化学处理后用金属作靶材进行真空镀膜。涂膜方法一般有真空蒸发镀膜法和磁控溅射技术。后者操作简便，工艺完整成熟、沉积速度快、成品率高、有大面积沉积能力，适用于工业化生产。镜面有机玻璃主要用于广告标牌、室内吊顶和隔板装饰，其华丽、"扩大"空间的效果比较明显。
explanation_en: The organic glass plate is sputtering coated with metallic film and sprayed with protective coatings to make it have a mirror reflective effect. Coating materials include aluminum, copper and stainless steel. Aluminum film is usually selected as the coating materials because of its best reflective effect and low price. The production process is to clean, dry and chemically treat the surface of organic glass, and then use metal as the target for vacuum coating. The coating methods generally include vacuum evaporation coating method and magnetron sputtering technology. The latter is easy to operate, with complete and mature processes, fast deposition speed, high yield, and large area deposition capacity, suitable for industrial production. Mirror organic glass is mainly used for advertising signs, indoor ceiling and partition decoration. Its gorgeous and "expanding" space effect is obvious.

explanation_cn: 简称LaK玻璃。具有高折射低色散的光学特性，因此常与镧火石、重镧火石玻璃一起称为高折射率低色散光学玻璃。LaK玻璃是在重冕玻璃基础上加入La203、ThO2等发展起来的，折射率有很大提高。故又称超重冕玻璃。由于镉原料有污染问题,钍有弱放射性，已限制使用，为获得相同的光学常数，可代之以其他稀有元素如钇、礼、锆或铪的氧化物。LaK玻璃对设计高质量的照相物镜有重要意义。
explanation_en: It is called LaK glass for short. It has high refractive index and low dispersion optical characteristics, so it is often called high refractive index and low dispersion optical glass together with lanthanum flim and heavy lanthanum flimingglass. LaK glass is developed by adding La203, ThO2, etc. on the basis of dense barium crown glass, and its refractive index has been greatly improved. Therefore, it is also called super heavy crown glass. Due to the pollution of cadmium raw materials, thorium is weakly radioactive and its use has been restricted. In order to obtain the same optical constant, other rare elements such as yttrium, lithium, zirconium or hafnium oxides can be substituted. LaK glass is of great significance to the design of high-quality photographic objectives.

explanation_cn: 简称LaF玻璃。与镧冕、重镧火石玻璃一起形成高折射低色散无色光学玻璃系列。主要用于高质量照相物镜。
explanation_en: It is called LaF glass for short. Together with lanthanum crowns and heavy lanthanum flimingglass, it forms a series of high refractive and low dispersion colorless optical glass. Mainly used for high-quality photographic objectives.

explanation_cn: 高Tc氧化物超导体，镧系214相超导体中的一种。
explanation_en: High Tc oxide superconductor, one of the 214 phase lanthanide superconductors.

explanation_cn: 镧系214相.又称T相高Tc氧化物超导体，超导转变温度40K，晶体结构为氧缺位钙钛矿（CuO2)，载流子类型为空穴型 (P型）。
explanation_en: Lanthanide 214 phase, also known as t-phase high tc oxide superconductor, has a superconducting transition temperature of 40K, an oxygen deficient perovskite (CuO2) crystal structure, and a hole type carrier (P type).

explanation_cn: 铜氧化物高温超导体家族的一种。超导转变温度小于24K.载流子密度为每立方厘米1021个电子.载流子类型为电子型，即n型；德拜温度0为370-410K:晶体结构为氧缺位钙钛型，r相。
explanation_en: A member of the copper oxide high-temperature superconductor family. The superconducting transition temperature is less than 24K. The carrier density is 1021 electrons per cubic centimeter. The carrier type is electronic, i.e. n-type; Debey temperature 0 is 370-410K; the crystal structure is oxygen deficient calcium titanium type, r phase.

explanation_cn: 指连续长度很长的纤维，是相对于短纤维而言。在化学纤维制造过程中，纺丝流体经喷丝孔挤出。在纺丝流程中，经空气冷却或在凝固浴中凝固成形，形成连续不断的丝条。各纺丝部位所形成的丝条再经拉伸、加捻或假捻变形等后加工工序以供进一步应用。这样得到的长度为几千米、上万米的纤维称为合成长丝。丝绸则是一种天然长丝。长丝包括单丝和复丝。合成长丝广泛应用于制备各种服装、装饰用织物和其他产业领域。
explanation_en: Refers to a fiber with a very long continuous length, which is relative to staple fiber. In the process of chemical fiber manufacturing, the spinning fluid is extruded through the spinneret hole. In the spinning process, continuous filaments are formed by air cooling or solidification in a coagulation bath. The filaments formed by each spinning part are then processed by stretching, twisting, or false twisting deformation for further application. The fiber thus obtained has a length of several thousand meters and tens of thousands of meters, which is called synthetic filamem. Silk is a natural filamem. Filamem includes monofilament and multifilament. Synthetic filamem is widely used in the preparation of various garments, decorative fabrics and other industrial fields.

explanation_cn: 结晶高分子内相邻两晶区间的距离。
explanation_en: The distance between two adjacent crystal intervals in crystallinebolymer.

explanation_cn: 又称保护套管，安装于钢包下水口处，连接钢包和中间包，起着防止钢水氧化和飞溅、防止中间包渣卷人等多重作用。是进行保护浇注、提高钢的质量的重要功能耐火材料。长度一般在1000到1600mm。对抗热冲击性能要求很高。提高热处理稳定性的措施有两种：一种是在材料中添加较多石墨，并加入低热膨胀系数原材料，降低材料的热膨胀率；另一种是水口内外层选用不同材质，直接接触钢液层选取低碳或无碳材质，降低热导率以降低外层材料中的热应力。外层材质选择低SiO2含量的铝碳材质，以提高抗钢液侵蚀性。
explanation_en: Also known as protective sleeve, it is installed at the ladle water outlet to connect the ladle and tundish, which plays multiple roles in preventing oxidation and splashing of molten steel, preventing tundish slag entrapment, etc. It is an important functional refractory for protective casting and improving the quality of steel. The length is generally between 1000 and 1600mm. High requirements for thermal shock resistance performance. There are two measures to improve the stability of heat treatment: one is to add more graphite in materials and add raw materials with low coefficient of thermal expansion to reduce the thermal expansion rate of materials; The other is to select different materials for the inner and outer layers of the nozzle, and select low-carbon or carbon free materials for the layer directly contacting the steel liquid, so as to reduce the thermal conductivity to reduce the thermal stress in the outer materials. Choose aluminum carbon material with low SiO2 content for the outer layer to improve its resistance to steel corrosion.

explanation_cn: 醇酸树脂按油度多少分为短、中、长三种油度。长油醇酸树脂是指油度在60%以上的醇酸树脂。
explanation_en: Alkyd resin can be divided into short, medium and long oil content according to oil content. Long oil alkyd resin refers to alkyd resin with oil degree more than 60%.

explanation_cn:
长石是一种架状结构的硅酸盐矿物，主要有四种种类：钾长石、钠长石、钙长石和钡长石。钾长石和钠长石的分子混合通常被称为碱性长石，而钠长石和钙长石的分子混合则被称为斜长石。钡长石在自然界中相对较少见。天然长石中通常会存在第五种成分，但其含量通常不超过5%。如果含量超过5%，则会形成长石的变种。

碱性长石在高温时会形成完全类质同象，而在低温下会形成有限类质同象，并分解成钾长石和钠长石两相。这种过程会形成条带状的嵌晶结构。当钾长石占主导地位，而钠长石嵌于钾长石中时，被称为条纹长石。当钠长石占主导地位，而钾长石嵌于钠长石中时，被称为反条纹长石。长石晶体通常呈板状或柱状，双晶现象常见，主要遵循卡巴斯双晶定律，以Z轴为双晶轴。颜色可以从灰色到肉红色，具有玻璃光泽。长石有两组完全解理面，解理夹角接近于90°。莫氏硬度在6到6.5之间，密度在2.5到2.7 g/cm3之间。

当条纹长石在特定解理面上呈现浅蓝至乳白色的晕彩时，被称为月长石（或月光石）。这种现象是由于光线在钾长石和钠长石的两相界面上干涉引起的，微细的赤铁矿薄片定向排列或超微细的金属铜导致了光线的干涉，产生了令人眼花缭乱的光彩。长石中的月长石通常用作宝石材料。

这些长石矿物主要产于中性至酸性火成岩和片岩中。天河石是一种绿色微斜长石，含有Rb2O（1.4%到3.3%）和Cs2O（0.2%到0.6%），也可用作宝玉石材料。长石根据成分的不同可分为多种矿物，晶体结构和物理性质均不同，包括单斜钠长石、高钠长石和低钠长石。它们通常存在于花岗伟晶岩、钠质花岗岩中，也可见于片岩和一些热液矿脉中。钙长石中的Ah和（r分子通常占少于5%。钙长石主要产于基性岩和相应的火山岩中，也是各种火成岩的重要成分。其中富含钾的长石可用作陶瓷原料，而色泽美丽、带有光彩效应的长石可用作宝石材料。
explanation_en: Feldspar is a kind of silicate mineral with shelf structure. There are mainly four types: potassium feldspar, sodium feldspar, calcium feldspar and barium feldspar. The molecular mixture of potassium feldspar and sodium feldspar is usually called alkaline feldspar, while the molecular mixture of sodium feldspar and calcium feldspar is called plagioclase. Barium feldspar is relatively rare in nature. The fifth component usually exists in natural feldspar, but its content usually does not exceed 5%. If the content exceeds 5%, a variety of feldspar will be formed. Alkaline feldspar will form complete isomorphism at high temperature, but will form limited isomorphism at low temperature, and will be decomposed into two phases of potassium feldspar and sodium feldspar. This process will form a banded crystal structure. When potassium feldspar is dominant and sodium feldspar is embedded in potassium feldspar, it is called perthite. When sodium feldspar dominates, and potassium feldspar is embedded in sodium feldspar, it is called amiperthite. Feldspar crystal is usually in the form of plate or column, and twin phenomenon is common, which mainly follows the Karbas twin law, with the Z axis as the twin axis. The color can be from gray to flesh red, with glass luster. There are two sets of complete cleavage planes in feldspar, and the cleavage angle is close to 90 °. Mohs hardness between 6 and 6.5, density between 2.5 and 2.7 g/cm 3 Between. When perthite presents light blue to milky white halo on a specific cleavage surface, it is called belomorite (or moonstone). This phenomenon is caused by the interference of light on the two-phase interface of potassium feldspar and sodium feldspar. The directional arrangement of fine hematite flakes or the ultra fine copper lead to the interference of light, producing dazzling brilliance. Belomorite in feldspar is usually used as materials of gems. These feldspar minerals mainly occur in intermediate to acid igneous rocks and schist. Tianhe stone is a green microcline, which contains Rb2O (1.4% to 3.3%) and Cs2O (0.2% to 0.6%), and can also be used as materials for gemstone. Feldspar can be divided into a variety of minerals according to different compositions, with different crystal structure and physical properties, including monoclinic feldspar, high sodium feldspar and low sodium feldspar. They usually exist in granite pegmatite, sodium granite, schist and some hydrothermal veins. The Ah and (r molecules in feldspar usually account for less than 5%. feldspar mainly occurs in basic rocks and corresponding volcanic rock, and is also an important component of various igneous rocks. Among them, feldspar rich in potassium can be used as raw material for ceramics, while feldspar with beautiful color and luster effect can be used as materials for gems.

explanation_cn:
一种砂岩，其中长石的含量超过25%。长石的种类通常包括酸性斜长石和碱性长石。这种砂岩通常具有粗粒结构，其颜色可以从肉红色到灰色不等，颗粒的分选性和磨圆度有很大的变化。通常含有较多的杂基，而胶结物可能包括碳酸盐、硅质、铁质等成分。

当砂粒中的石英含量超过75%时，这种岩石被称为长石石英砂岩，又称为次长石砂岩。如果含有大量的杂质，可能会被称为长石杂砂岩。这种类型的岩石通常是由花岗岩、片麻岩等富含长石的母岩经过机械风化和在相对短的距离内的搬运堆积在山前或山间盆地中形成的。
explanation_en: A sandstone containing more than 25% feldspar. The types of feldspar usually include acid plagioclase and alkaline feldspar. This kind of sandstone usually has a coarse grain structure, and its color can vary from flesh red to gray. The sorting and roundness of particles vary greatly. Usually, it contains a large number of heterogroups, and the cement may include carbonate, siliceous, iron, and other components. When the quartze content in the sand exceeds 75%, this rock is called feldspar quartz sandstone, also called sub feldspar sandstone. If it contains a lot of impurities, it may be called feldspar greywacke sandstone. This type of rock is usually formed by the mechanical weathering and transportation of feldspar rich parent rocks such as granite and gneiss in front of mountains or intermountain basins over relatively short distances.

explanation_cn:
长石类硅酸盐的结构属于架状硅酸盐结构之一。在这种结构中，[(Si,Al)O4] 四面体会连接形成四方环，然后这些四方环会组成折线状链沿着c轴排列。四面体和双四面体会相互交替排列，形成平行于c轴的链，这些链之间形成了大的空隙。由于Al3+会替代Si4+，导致网络中存在额外的负电荷，因此通常会存在一些较大的阳离子，如K+、Na+、Ca2+、Ba2+等，它们的半径较大、电荷较低、配位数较高，用来平衡这些负电荷。

这些较大的阳离子，特别是Ba2+等，可以支撑[(Si,Al)O4] 四面体，从而使其具有规则的配位多面体结构。然而，室温下，较小的阳离子如Na+、Ca2+等的半径小于空隙尺寸，导致骨架结构折陷，配位多面体变得不规则。

此外，长石的结构在(001)和(010)方向上具有层状连接的特点，这会影响长石晶体的外部形态，包括[001]和[010]晶带的发育，以及(001)和(010)的解理发育。
explanation_en: The structure of feldspar silicate belongs to one of framework silicate structure. In this structure, the tetrahedrons of [(Si, Al) O4] are connected to form tetragonal rings, which then form a broken line chain arranged along the c-axis. The tetrahedron and double tetrahedron are arranged alternately, forming chains parallel to the c-axis, and large gaps are formed between these chains. Since Al3+will replace Si4+, resulting in additional negative charges in the network, there are usually some larger cations, such as K+, Na+, Ca2+, Ba2+, etc., with larger radius, lower charge, and higher coordination number, which are used to balance these negative charges. These larger cations, especially Ba2+, can support the tetrahedron of [(Si, Al) O4], thus giving it a regular coordination polyhedral structure. However, at room temperature, the radius of smaller cations such as Na+, Ca2+, etc. is smaller than the pore size, leading to the collapse of the skeleton structure and the irregularity of the coordination polyhedra. In addition, the structure of feldspar has the characteristics of layered connection in (001) and (010) directions, which will affect the external morphology of feldspar crystal, including the development of [001] and [010] crystal belts, and the cleavage development of (001) and (010).

explanation_cn:
以长石作为助培剂的高岭土-长石-石英组分系统瓷。其特点是：首先，其烧成温度范围相对较宽，而且根据组分比例和工艺因素的不同，变化范围也很广。这种瓷可以在1150°C到1450°C的温度范围内烧制，一般来说，烧成温度在1350°C以上的被称为高温瓷，而在1350°C以下的被称为低温瓷。在中国，长石质瓷的烧成温度一般在1250°C到1350°C之间。

一个典型的配方包括高岭土50%、长石25%、石英25%。这种瓷的显微结构由晶体相、玻璃相和封闭气孔组成。晶体相在瓷胎中起到骨架的作用，而玻璃相填充在骨架之间，起到结合作用。这种瓷的吸水率接近于零，未经釉上的试验条的弯曲强度通常在70到100MPa之间。这种瓷主要用于制造日用瓷、电瓷、化学瓷等产品。
explanation_en: Kaolin feldspar quartze system porcelain with feldspar as a training aid. Its characteristics are: firstly, its firing temperature range is relatively wide, and the variation range is also wide depending on the component ratio and process factors. This type of porcelain can be fired within the temperature range of 1150 ° C to 1450 ° C. Generally speaking, those fired above 1350 ° C are referred to as high-temperature porcelain, while those below 1350 ° C are referred to as low-temperature porcelain. In China, the firing temperature of feldspathic porcelain is generally between 1250 ° C and 1350 ° C. A typical formula includes 50% kaolin, 25% feldspar and 25% quartze. The microstructure of the porcelain consists of crystal phase, glass phase and closed pores. The crystal phase plays the role of skeleton in the porcelain body, while the glass phase fills between the skeletons, playing a binding role. The water absorption of this kind of porcelain is close to zero, and the bending strength of unglazed test strips is usually between 70 and 100 MPa. This kind of porcelain is mainly used to make daily porcelain, electric porcelain, chemical porcelain and other products.

explanation_cn:
长石釉是一种高温釉料，通常以长石或富含长石的矿物为主要助熔剂。釉中的助熔剂氧化物主要是K2O和Na2O，它们的总量通常大于或等于其他碱性氧化物的总量，但总量一般不超过0.6摩尔。K2O的含量在长石釉中通常较高，而碱性氧化物的含量较低。这种釉料在高于1250°C的温度下烧成。

长石釉的特点包括高温下的黏度较大、强烈的光泽度、宽范围的成熟温度，通常呈现略带乳白色，具有柔和的质感。这种釉料适合用于陶瓷装饰，特别适用于硬质瓷、卫生洁具、电瓷等制品。
explanation_en: Feldspathic glaze is a kind of high temperature glaze, usually with feldspar or minerals rich in feldspar as the main flux. The flux oxides in glaze are mainly K2O and Na2O, and their total amount is usually greater than or equal to the total amount of other alkaline oxides, but the total amount generally does not exceed 0.6 mole. The content of K2O is usually high in feldspathic glaze, while the content of alkaline oxide is low. This glaze is fired at temperatures above 1250 ° C. The characteristics of feldspar glaze include high viscosity under high temperature, strong glossiness, and a wide range of ripening temperatures. It usually appears slightly milky white, with a soft texture. This glaze is suitable for ceramics decoration, especially for hard porcelain, sanitary ware, electric porcelain and other products.

explanation_cn: 衡量有序固溶体点阵中原子长程有序化程度的参量。
explanation_en: A parameter that measures the degree of long-range ordering of atoms in the lattice of ordered solid solution.

explanation_cn: 在给定的温度下，采用大转子门尼黏度计测定胶料的门尼黏度下降至最小值后，再上升5个门尼值时所需的时间称为门尼焦烧时间，对于小转子门尼黏度计，门尼焦烧时间为由下降至最小值后再上升3个门尼值时所需的时间。可作为橡胶胶料初期硫化特性的一种评价。实验温度一般采用120°C、125°C或145°C,门尼焦烧时间的长短反映了胶料耐焦烧性能的好坏，从而得出胶料的加工安全性高低。
explanation_en: At a given temperature, the time required to measure the Mooney viscosity of the rubber compound with a large rotor Mooney viscosity meter when it drops to the minimum value and then rises by 5 more Mooney values is called the Mooney scorch time. For a small rotor Mooney viscosity meter, the Mooney scorch time is the time required to rise by 3 more Mooney values after dropping to the minimum value. It can be used as an evaluation of the initial vulcanization characteristics of rubber compound. The test temperature is generally 120 ° C, 125 ° C or 145 ° C. The length of Mooney scorching time reflects the resistance to scorching of the rubber compound, so the processing safety of the rubber compound can be obtained.

explanation_cn: 又称转动(门尼)黏度。用门尼黏度计测定的生胶或混炼胶对转子的反抗剪切转矩值，规定以0.083N.m的剪切力矩为1个门尼黏度值。门尼黏度值的测定是将试样放入门尼黏度计模腔内，合模并预热一定时间(标准为1min)后，转子对试样施加一定的剪切力矩，同时转子也受到橡胶的反抗剪切力矩，其力矩由精密负荷传感器指示出来，即为门尼黏度值。门尼黏度-时间曲线还能看出胶料硫化工艺性能。自1934年美国人M.Mooney发明门尼黏度计以来，门尼黏度成为合成橡胶的重要性能指标。橡胶工业中.普遍采用门尼黏度测定橡胶塑性的大小，以评价其加工性能和物理机械性能的差异、控制橡胶胶料的工艺性能。门尼黏度过低的胶料不易混炼，甩延易黏辊，胶浆黏附力低，成品的物理机械性能低；门尼黏度过大则胶料塑性低，不易混炼均匀及挤出加工，收缩性大，压延易掉皮、模压制品花纹棱角不清及制品表面粗糙等。
explanation_en: Also called rotational (Mooney) viscosity. The resistance shear torque value of crude rubber or rubber mixture to the rotor measured with a Mooney viscosity meter, and the shear torque of 0.083N. m is specified as one Mooney viscosity value. The measurement of Mooney viscosity value is to put the sample into the Mooney viscosity meter cavity, close the mold and preheat it for a certain time (standard is 1min), and then the rotor applies a certain shear torque to the sample. At the same time, the rotor is also subjected to the rubber resistance shear torque, and its torque is indicated by the precision load sensor, which is the Mooney viscosity value. Mooney viscosity time curve can also show the vulcanization process performance of rubber compound. Since American M. Mooney invented the Mooney viscosity meter in 1934, Mooney viscosity has become an important performance index of synthetic rubber. In the rubber industry, Mooney viscosity is commonly used to measure the plasticity of rubber to evaluate the difference between its processing properties and physical and mechanical properties, and to control the processing properties of rubber compound. The rubber with low Mooney viscosity is not easy to mixing, and it is easy to roll, so the adhesive force of the glue is low, and the physical and mechanical properties of the finished product are low; If the Mooney viscosity is too high, the plastic property of the rubber is low, it is difficult to mixing evenly and extrude, the shrinkage is large, the rolling is easy to peel off, the pattern edges and corners of the molded products are unclear, and the surface of the products is rough.

explanation_cn: 又称为蒸散型吸气剂。它是由化学元素周期表中IIA族金属钡、锶、钙、镁及其合金所组成的一类功能吸气材料。当该类金属或合金在真空中加热到850~1200°C，就会发生金属蒸散并形成镜面薄膜.达到吸气目的。由于，该类金属化学性质活泼.在空气中不稳定，易与活性气体反应而不便直接应用.故制成合金材料。
explanation_en: It is also called flash getter. It is a kind of functional gas absorbing materials composed of the IIA group metals barium, strontium, calcium, magnesium and their alloy in the periodic table of chemical elements. When this kind of metal or alloy is heated to 850~1200 ° C in vacuum, the metal will evaporate and form a mirror film to achieve the purpose of air absorption. Because of their active chemical properties and instability in air, they are easy to react with active gases and are not suitable for direct application, so they are made of alloy materials.

explanation_cn: 闪烁计数器的主要部件之当带电粒子通过闪烁体时.吸收辐射后产生闪烁光，由闪烁体内发出的光子被收集到光电倍增管的光敏阴极上时.在其表面放出光电子，经放大后在阴极产生一个负电压脉冲。再经放大器放大.又通过甄別器、计数器而被记录下来。
explanation_en: One of the main components of the scintillation counter: when charged particles pass through the scintillator, they absorb radiation and produce scintillation light. When the photons emitted from the scintillator are collected on the photosensitive cathode of the photomultiplier tube, they emit photoelectrons on its surface and produce a negative voltage pulse on the cathode after amplification. It is then amplified by an amplifier and recorded through a discriminator and counter.

explanation_cn: 是由无机物质制备的晶态闪烁体（闪烁体是指由放射线激发产生高效发光的一种荧光体.具有对人射线吸收系数大；荧光效率高和衰减快；发光强度和人射线的能量成良好的线性关系；光学均匀性及对产生的荧光透明性好等）。
explanation_en: It is a crystalline scintillator prepared from inorganic substances (scintillator refers to a kind of fluorescent body that is excited by radiation to produce efficient luminescence. It has large absorption coefficient for human rays, high fluorescence efficiency and fast attenuation, good linear relationship between luminous intensity and human ray energy, good optical uniformity and transparency for generated fluorescence, etc.).

explanation_cn: 简单配位型硫化物矿物。化学式为ZnS。常含有Fe、Mn、Cd、Ga、In、Gf、T1等类质同象混入物。高中温形成的闪锌矿颜色深.与毒砂、磁黄铁矿、黄铜矿、黄铁矿、石英等共生。中温热液成因的闪锌矿呈褐色、浅褐色.与方铅矿、黄铜矿、黄铁矿、石英、方解石等共生。低温热液形成的闪锌矿颜色浅.与不含或少含铁离子的矿物共生。是提炼锌的主要矿物原料。此外还可提取Cd、In、Ga、Ge等稀少元素。
explanation_en: Simple coordination type sulfide minerals. The chemical formula is ZnS. It often contains isomorphic mixtures such as Fe, Mn, Cd, Ga, In, Gf, T1, etc. Sphalerite formed at high and intermediate temperatures is dark in color and coexists with arsenojpyrite, pyrrhothe, chalcopyrite, pyrite, quartze, etc. The sphalerite of mesothermal origin is brown and light brown, coexisting with galena, chalcopyrite, pyrite, quartze, caldte, etc. The sphalerite formed by low-temperature hydrothermal solution is light in color and coexists with minerals without or less iron ions. It is the main raw mineral material for refining zinc. In addition, rare elements such as Cd, In, Ga, Ge can also be extracted.

explanation_cn: 一种中性侵入岩。SiO2含量在一般在53%~66%之间。矿物组成以中性斜长石为主（含量可达70%)，其次是角闪石，有时含辉石或黑云母，也可含少量的石英、钾长石、磷灰石、榍石和磁铁矿等。岩石常呈灰色、深灰、灰绿色。全晶质中细粒半自形粒状结构。按矿物类型和结构，可划分为角闪闪长岩、辉长闪长打、石英闪K岩、微晶闪长岩和闪长玢岩。结构均匀、弱风化的闪长岩是优质的建筑石材。闪长岩体与内生铁、铜矿床关系密切.尤其是闪长岩与碳酸盐岩的接触带上，常形成矽卡岩型铁、铜矿床。
explanation_en: A type of neutral intrusive rock. The SiO2 content is generally between 53% and 66%. The mineral composition is mainly composed of neutral plagioclase (up to 70%), followed by amphibole, sometimes containing pyroxene or biotite, and a small amount of quartze, potassium feldspar, apatite, sphene, magnetite, etc. Rock is often gray, dark gray or grayish green. Fine grained semi idiomorphic granular structure in whole crystalline texture. According to mineral type and texture, it can be divided into hornblende, gabbro diorite, quartze diorite K rock, microcrystalline diorite and diorite porphyrite. The diorite with uniform structure and weak weathering is a high-quality building stone. The diorite body is closely related to endogenic iron and copper deposits, especially the contact zone between diorite and carbonatite, where skarn type iron and copper deposits are often formed.

explanation_cn: 又称间规聚合物。见有规立构聚合物。
explanation_en: Also called syndiotactic polymer. See stereoregular polymer.

explanation_cn: 半导体导带中的电子先跃迁到禁带中的复合中心能级然后再跃迁到价带中与空穴复合，是间接禁带半导体中占支配地位的载流子复合方式。
explanation_en: The electrons in the semiconductor conduction band first transition to the composition center energy level in the band gap and then to the valence band and composition with holes, which is the dominant carrier composition mode in indirect bandgap semiconductor.

explanation_cn: 导带底和价带顶的波矢k不相同的半导体，电子在导带和价带之间跃迁时需要声子的参与。因此间接禁带半导体由载流子的带间跃迁引起的发光和光吸收的量子效率相当低。
explanation_en: For semiconductors with different wave vector k at the bottom of the conduction band and the top of the valence band, phonon is required to participate in the electron transition between the conduction band and the valence band. Therefore, the quantum efficiency of luminescence and light absorption of indirect bandgap semiconductor caused by the interband transition of carriers is quite low.

explanation_cn: 见聚丙烯。
explanation_en: See polypropylene.

explanation_cn: 间规聚苯乙烯（syndiotactic polystyrene）作为另一种具有规整结构的聚苯乙烯，其发展相对于等规聚苯乙烯（i-PS）而言较晚。这是因为高度规整的s-PS，即高间规度（>98%）的s-PS，直到1985年才被合成出来，使用了均相的钛配位催化剂体系。此后才有不断的合成方法报告，促进了对其晶体结构的研究。间规聚苯乙烯具有较高的熔点（高达270°C），并且具有出色的耐热性、耐化学性、耐水性和耐溶剂性。它的结晶速率范围较宽，因此适用于常规的加工方法，是一种具有广阔开发前景的新型工程塑料。对于间规聚苯乙烯的大分子链及其构象，存在复杂的多晶相现象。大多数观点认为，当s-PS从溶液中结晶时，大分子链呈螺旋构象。
explanation_en: As another kind of polystyrene with regular structure, syndiotactic polystyrene developed later than isotactic polystyrene (i-PS). This is because highly regular s-PS, that is, highly syndiotactic (>98%) s-PS, was not synthesized until 1985, and a homogeneous phase titanium coordination catalyst system was used. Since then, there have been continuous reports on synthesis methods, which has promoted the research on its crystal structure. Syndiotactic polystyrene has a high melting point (up to 270 ° C) and excellent heat resistance, chemical resistance, water resistance and solvent resistance. It has a wide range of crystallization rate, so it is suitable for conventional processing methods. It is a new type of engineering plastics with broad development prospects. For syndiotactic polystyrene macromolecule chain and its conformation, there is a complex polycrystalline phenomenon. Most people think that when s-PS crystallizes from solution, the macromolecule chain assumes a helical conformation.

explanation_cn: 参见间隙相。
explanation_en: See interstitial phase.

explanation_cn: 由原子半径较大的过渡金属M与原子半径较小的非金属X(X=C, N,H等）形成的化合物.非金属原子占据金属原子结 构的间隙位置。形成的化合物不符合化合价原则。间 隙相分为两类：当原子半径比rx/rM<0.59时，形 成具有简单结构（如面心立方结构、密排六方结构、 体心立方结构）的间隙相；当rx/rM>0.59时，大 多形成具有复杂结构（如正交结构、复杂立方结构） 的间隙相，习惯上称为间隙化合物。间隙相大多具有 明显的金属特性，且硬度和熔点较高，是应用很广的 合金强化相。
explanation_en: A compound formed by a transition metal M with a larger atomic radius and a non-metallic X (X=C, N, H, etc.) with a smaller atomic radius. The non-metallic atoms occupy the gap positions of the metal atomic structure. The formed compound does not conform to the valence principle. The interstitial phase can be divided into two types: when the atomic radius ratio rx/rM<0.59, interstitial phase with simple structure (such as face-centered cubic structure, hexagonal close packed structure, body-centered cubic structure) is formed; When rx/rM>0.59, most of them form interstitial phase with complex structure (such as orthogonal structure, complex cubic structure), which is customarily called interstitial compound. Most of the interstitial phase has obvious metal properties, and its hardness and melting point are high. It is a widely used alloy strengthening phase.

explanation_cn: 又称气阀钢，适合于制作内燃机中进、排气阀门用的耐热钢。阀门钢要求具有在很高的工作温度下足够的高温强度和籾性、高温硬度和耐磨性；良好的抗氧化性以及在工作介质中的耐蚀性；在冷热循环条件下组织和尺寸的稳定性；良好的加下性和焊接性。
explanation_en: Also called gas valve steel, it is suitable for making heat resistant steel for intake and exhaust valves in internal combustion engines. Valve steel is required to have sufficient high temperature strength and ductility, high temperature hardness and wear resistance at very high operating temperature; Good oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance in working media; Stability of structure and size under cold and hot cycling conditions; Good workability and weldability.

explanation_cn: 指防护中子辐射危害的复合材料。其作用就是要将快速中子减速并将慢速中子吸收。
explanation_en: It refers to composite materials that protects against neutron radiation hazards. Its function is to slow down fast neutrons and absorb slow neutrons.

explanation_cn: 阻挡氚渗透层的材料。通常采用低渗透率的材料作盛氚容器，如有机材料和金属材料。
explanation_en: Materials that blocks tritium permeation. Generally, materials with low permeability are used as tritium containers, such as organic materials and metallic materials.

explanation_cn: 能抑制含碳耐火材料中碳发生氧化的添加剂。高温下能优先与氧起反应而对碳起到保护作用，同时氧化产物堵塞氧气向砖内扩散的通道。
explanation_en: Additive that can inhibit the oxidation of carbon in carbon containing refractory. At high temperature, it can preferentially react with oxygen to protect carbon, and at the same time, oxidation products block the channel of oxygen diffusion to the brick.

explanation_cn: 总体而言，可以防止地下水、工业和民用的给排水、腐蚀性液体以及空气中的湿气、蒸气等侵入建筑物的材料统称为防水材料。
explanation_en: In general, materials that can prevent groundwater, industrial and civil water supply and drainage, corrosive liquids, moisture and steam in the air from invading buildings are collectively referred to as waterproof materials.

explanation_cn: 经固化后形成的防水薄膜具有一定的延伸性、弹塑性、抗裂性、抗渗性及耐候性，能起到防水、防渗和保护作用。防水涂料有良好的温度适应性，操作简便，易于维修与维护。
explanation_en: The waterproof film formed after curing has certain extensibility, elastoplasticity, crack resistance, impermeability and weather resistance, and can play the role of waterproof, seepage prevention and protection. Water-proof coating has good temperature adaptability, easy operation, and easy maintenance.

explanation_cn: 通过各种方法提高混凝土抗渗性能，以达到防水要求的一种混凝土。一般通过混凝土组成材料的质量改善，合理选择混凝土配合比和骨料级配，以及掺加适量外加剂（如加气型或密实型），达到混凝土内部密实或者堵塞混凝土内毛细孔等措施来实现。
explanation_en: It is a kind of concrete that can improve the impermeability of concrete through various methods to meet the waterproof requirements. Generally, it is achieved by improving the quality of concrete materials, reasonably selecting concrete mix proportion and aggregate gradation, and adding appropriate admixtures (such as aerated or dense) to achieve the internal compactness of concrete or blocking the internal pores of concrete.

explanation_cn: 在皮革生产中加入了防水材料，表面难以被水润湿而具有防水性能的皮革。
explanation_en: Waterproof materials is added in the production of leather. The surface of leather is difficult to be wetted by water and has waterproof performance.

explanation_cn: 一种防止海洋生物在船底附着滋生的涂料。防止海洋生物附着的机理是防污漆膜中的毒性物质氧化亚铜、有机锡（或有机铅等）与海水接触后，以Cu2+或分子（如三丁基氟化锡-S8)的形式，逐步被海水溶解，在漆膜表面形成有毒溶液的"薄层"，在该"薄层"内的有毒物质的离子或分子能排斥或杀死企图停留在漆膜上的海洋生物孢子或幼虫。
explanation_en: A coatings that prevents marine organisms from adhering to the bottom of a ship. The mechanism of preventing marine organisms from adhering is that the toxic substances cuprous oxide and organic tin (or organic lead, etc.) in the antifouling paint film are gradually dissolved by seawater in the form of Cu2+or molecules (such as tributyl tin fluoride - S8) after contacting with seawater, forming a "thin layer" of toxic solution on the surface of the paint film. The ions or molecules of toxic substances in the "thin layer" can repel or kill the spores or larvae of marine organisms attempting to stay on the paint film.

explanation_cn: 指能防止涂料在立面施工中因流动性过强而发生流坠现象的助剂。涂料黏度低，涂膜薄有助于防止流挂，但不易流平，而防流挂剂具有协调流平和流挂不能统一的作用。
explanation_en: It refers to additive that can prevent coatings from sagging due to strong flow ability during facade construction. Low viscosity of coatings and thin film help prevent sagging, but it is not easy to level, and anti-sagging agent has the function of coordinating leveling and sagging.

explanation_cn: 本身不会燃烧且能延缓、阻止火焰蔓延的涂层。防火涂层分为膨胀型和非膨胀型。前者防火性能更好，遇火时，涂层膨胀发泡形成阻燃、隔热层，起到隔离热源和氧气，阻燃的作用。
explanation_en: The coating itself will not combustion and can delay and prevent the spread of flame. Fire-resistant coating is divided into expansion type and non expansion type. The former has better fire resistance. When encountering fire, the coating expands and foams to form a flame retardant and insulation layer, which plays a role in isolating heat sources and oxygen, and is flame retardant.

explanation_cn: 又叫阻燃涂料。施用于可燃性基材表面，用以改变材料表面燃烧特性，阻滞火灾迅速蔓延；或施用于建筑构件上，用以提高构件的耐火极限的特种涂料。
explanation_en: Also called flame retardant coating. It is applied to the surface of flammability substrate to change the combustion characteristics of surface of materials and prevent the rapid spread of fire; Or special coatings applied to building components to improve the fire resistance limit of components.

explanation_cn: 一种在规定的耐火试验中能够保持其完整性和隔热性的特种玻璃，其作用是控制火势的蔓延或隔烟，具有隔音、隔热的优点。按耐火性能等级分为三类：A类--同时满足耐火完整性、耐火隔热性要求的防火玻璃，包括复合型防火玻璃和灌注型防火玻璃两种；B类--船用防火玻璃，外表面玻璃板是钢化安全玻璃，内表面玻璃板材料类型可任意选择；C类--只满足耐火完整性要求的单片防火玻璃。
explanation_en: A kind of special glass that can maintain its integrity and heat insulation in the specified fire resistance test. Its function is to control the spread of fire or smoke, and it has the advantages of sound insulation and heat insulation. According to the fire resistance rating, it can be divided into three categories: Class A - fire-resistant glass that meets the requirements of fire integrity and fire resistance and heat insulation, including composite fire-resistant glass and cast-in-place fire-resistant glass; Class B -- marine fire-resistant glass, the glass plate on the outer surface is tempered safety glass, and the materials type of glass plate on the inner surface can be selected arbitrarily; Class C - single piece fire-resistant glass that only meets the fire integrity requirements.

explanation_cn: 指通过热流作用发生多种物理和化学变化，利用材料质量消耗带走热量，从而阻止热流传入结构内部的一种复合材料。按其防热机制可分为升华型、熔化型和碳化型。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of composite materials that uses mass consumption of materials to take away heat through various physical and chemical changes caused by heat flow, thus preventing heat flow from entering the structure. According to its heat prevention mechanism, it can be divided into sublimation type, melting type, and carbonization type.

explanation_cn: 抵御波长在180-400nm之间的紫外线的复合材料。包括反射作用和选择吸收作用。以热能或其他无害低能的形式进行释放或消耗。
explanation_en: Composite materials resistant to ultraviolet ray with wavelength between 180-400nm. Including reflection and selective absorption. Release or consume in the form of thermal energy or other harmless low energy forms.

explanation_cn: 指橡胶工业中在橡胶配炼过程中加入，可防止制品因长时间使用发生氧化老化而延长制品使用寿命的物质。老化作用广泛存在于橡晈制品的加工、存放、使用过程中，所以防老剂需要在橡胶加工的早期加入。
explanation_en: It refers to the substances added in the rubber mixing process in the rubber industry, which can prevent the products from oxidizing aging due to long-term use and extend the service life of products. The aging effect widely exists in the processing, storage and use of Xiangkyu products, so antiager needs to be added in the early stage of rubber processing.

explanation_cn: 指有杀灭微生物繁殖体作用及有抑制芽孢发育为繁殖体作用的一类添加剂。防腐剂主要作用是抑制微生物的生长和繁殖，以延长食品的保存时间，抑制物质腐败的药剂。
explanation_en: It refers to a kind of additive that has the function of killing microbial propagules and inhibiting the development of spores into propagules. The main function of preservative is to inhibit the growth and reproduction of microorganisms, so as to extend the storage time of food and inhibit material corruption.

explanation_cn: 经过化学、物理或生物防腐处理，具有防止菌、虫、海生钻孔动物侵害和破坏的改性木材。防腐木一般经过防腐剂处理，也可以采用热处理。炭化木是热处理的一种，通过高温处理，切断腐朽菌生存的营养链来达到防腐的目的。
explanation_en: After chemical, physical or biological antiseptic treatment, the modified wood can prevent bacteria, insects and marine drilling animals from invading and damaging. Preservative wood is generally treated with preservative or heat treatment. Carbonized wood is a kind of heat treatment. Through high temperature treatment, it can cut off the nutrition chain of decaying bacteria to achieve the purpose of anti-corrosion.

explanation_cn: 在大气、水和油等介质中具有良好抗腐蚀性能的变形铝合金。主要包括不能热处理强化的Al-Mn和Al-Mg系合金。
explanation_en: Wrought aluminium alloy with good corrosion resistance in atmosphere, water and oil. It mainly includes Al Mn and Al Mg alloys that cannot be strengthened by heat treatment.

explanation_cn: 可防止或减缓金属发生腐蚀的一类颜料。防锈颜料需配制成防锈底漆后才能起到使金属表面防止锈蚀的作用。防锈颜料的作用可以分为两类：物理性防锈和化学性防镑，其中物理性防锈颜料是借助其细密的颗粒填充漆膜结构，提高漆膜致密性，起到屏蔽作用，降低漆膜渗透性，从而起到防锈作用，如氧化铁红、铝粉、玻璃鱗片等；化学性防锈颜料义可分为缓蚀性和电化学作用型两种。
explanation_en: A class of pigment that can prevent or slow down corrosion of metals. Anticorrosive pigment can prevent metal surface from rusting only after it is prepared into anti rust primer. The functions of anticorrosive pigment can be divided into two categories: physical antirust and chemical antirust. The physical anticorrosive pigment is used to fill the film structure with its fine particles, improve the film density, play a shielding role, reduce the permeability of the film, and thus play an antirust role, such as oxidized iron red, aluminum powder, glass flakes, etc; Chemical anticorrosive pigment can be divided into two types: corrosion inhibition and electrochemical action.

explanation_cn: 以降低表面电阻或体积电阻、消除静电积累为目的的复合材料。除炭黑、金属粉末等导电性物质作为导电剂，具有降低或消除静电功能外，抗静电剂多系表面活性剂。其机理是制品表面形成的抗静电剂分子层有吸湿作用，由此得到的电解质薄层溶液能消除静电荷，从而达到抗静电目的。
explanation_en: Composite materials with the purpose of reducing surface resistance or volume resistance and eliminating electrostatic accumulation. In addition to carbon black, metal powder and other conductive substances as conductive agents, which have the function of reducing or eliminating static electricity, antistatic agent is a series of surfactants. The mechanism is that the molecular layer of antistatic agent formed on the surface of the product has a moisture absorption effect, and the resulting thin electrolyte solution can eliminate static charges, so as to achieve the antistatic purpose.

explanation_cn: 具有轻度导电性从而防止表面静电荷积聚的有机玻璃。加入的抗静电剂有两类：一类是表面涂敷金属及金属盐、硅化合物和聚合物涂料及表面活性剂；另一类是在单体聚合或模塑料注塑、挤出时加入高级脂肪酸甘油酯、多亚烷基二醇、磺酸基化合物、磷酸酯和季铵盐表面活性剂和亲水性聚合物等。
explanation_en: Organic glass with light conductivity to prevent the accumulation of surface static charges. There are two kinds of antistatic agent added: one is surface coating metal and metal salt, silicon compound and polymer coatings and surfactant; The other is to add higher fatty acid glycerides, polyalkylene glycols, sulfonic compounds, phosphate esters, quaternary ammonium salt surfactants and hydrophilic polymer during the injection and extrusion of monomer polymerization or molding plastics.

explanation_cn: 将金属或合金制品作为阳极，采用电解的方法使其表面形成氧化物涂层。氧化物涂层改变了表面状态和性能，如使表面着色、提高耐腐蚀性、增强耐磨性及硬度、提高电绝缘性能等。广泛应用与机械零件、飞机汽车部件、精密仪器及无线电器材、日用品及建筑装饰等方面。
explanation_en: Metal or alloy products are used as anodes, and oxide coatings are formed on their surfaces by electrolysis. The oxide coating changes the surface state and properties, such as coloring the surface, improving corrosion resistance, enhancing wear resistance and hardness, and improving electrical insulation performance. Widely used in mechanical parts, aircraft and automotive components, precision instruments and radio equipment, daily necessities, and building decoration.

explanation_cn: 金属作为阳极发生氧化反应的电极过程。
explanation_en: The electrode process in which metal acts as an anode to undergo oxidation reactions.

explanation_cn: 带有酸性功能基与溶液中阳离子进行离子交换反应的离子交换树脂。大分子链上带有磺酸基的是强酸性阳离子交换树脂它在水中解离.酸性很强，相当于盐酸、硫酸等的酸性。在pH值0-14范围均适用。以苯乙烯二乙烯笨共聚物为母体的强酸性离子交换树脂是川途最广、产量最大的一种离子交换树脂。由聚笨乙烯交联珠体浓硫酸反应制得。这类强酸性阳离子交换剂除广泛应用于水处理外，还可替代无机酸作为催化剂，在化工生产中已经被应用。含羧酸基、磷酸基、酚基的离子交换树脂为弱酸性以含羧基的弱酸性用途最广。弱酸性树脂仅能在接近中性和碱性溶液中体现阳离子交换功能。广泛应用于水处理、医药湿法冶金等方面。在生化制药中也获得广泛应用。
explanation_en: Ion exchange resin with acidic functional group and cation in solution for ion exchange reaction. The strong acid cation exchange resin with sulfonic acid group on the macromolecule chain is dissociated in water. The acidity is very strong, equivalent to the acidity of hydrochloric acid, sulfuric acid, etc. Applicable in the pH range of 0-14. The strong acid ion exchange resin with styrene divinylbenzene copolymer as the parent is the ion exchange resin with the most extensive routes and the largest output in Sichuan. It is prepared by the reaction of polystyrene crosslinking beads with concentrated sulfuric acid. This type of strong acidic cation exchanger is not only widely used in water treatment, but also can replace inorganic acids as catalysts and has been applied in chemical production. The ion exchange resin containing carboxylic acid group, phosphoric acid group and phenol group is weak acid, and the weak acid resin containing carboxylic group is the most widely used. Weak acid resin can only perform cation exchange function in near neutral and alkaline solutions. It is widely used in water treatment, pharmaceutical hydrometallurgy, etc. It has also been widely used in biochemical pharmaceuticals.

explanation_cn: 由阳离子聚合光引发体系及有关单体组成。在无光照时，引发剂与单体共存，有很好的潜伏性。当光照时，该体系产生出具有引发单体聚合能力的阳离子活性物质，使单体聚合为高分子。光引发剂体系有各种不同类型.其中，碘锡盐、硫镎盐和铁芳烃配合物是近年来广泛使用的阳离子光敏引发剂。所谓阳离子聚合光引发体系是指一种能通过光辐照产生出具有引发单体聚合能力的阳离子活性物质的体系或化合物，最为著名的是各种不同锚盐类化合物如碘锚盐、硫镐盐等，即镎盐化合物在光照下生成激发态，后者分解为阳离子自由基，再通过提取氢反应，生成质子，引发单体聚合。常见的阳离子聚ê单体有各种烷基乙烯基醚及环氧化物等。阳离子光聚合材料广泛应用于光敏成像体系，如印刷版材及印制线路板的制作等方面。
explanation_en: It is composed of cationic polymerization photoinitiator system and related monomer. In the absence of light, initiator coexists with monomer and has good latency. When exposed to light, the system produces cationic active substances with the ability to initiate monomer polymerization, making monomer polymerization into macromolecule. There are various types of photo initiator systems. Among them, iodide tin salt, neptunium sulfide salt and iron arene complex are widely used cationic photoinitiator in recent years. The so-called cationic polymerization photoinitiator system refers to a system or compound that can produce cationic active substances with the ability to initiate monomer polymerization through light irradiation. The most famous is various anchor salt compounds, such as iodine anchor salt, sulfur pick salt, etc., that is, neptunium salt compounds generate excited states under light, the latter decomposes into cationic free radicals, and then generates protons through hydrogen extraction reaction to initiate monomer polymerization. Common cationic monomer include various alkyl vinyl ethers and epoxides. Cationic photopolymerization materials are widely used in photosensitive imaging systems, such as the production of printed plates and printed circuit boards.

name_cn: 阳离子型合成有机高分子絮凝剂
explanation_cn: 又称为阳离子高分子絮凝剂。一类山分子链，带有可离解带正电荷活性基，如氨基、亚氨基或季氨基等水溶性高分子聚电解质絮凝剂，絮凝机理主要有吸附交联和电荷中和作用。分子中非极性基团具疏水作用，过氢键和范德华力吸附两个或多个胶体颗粒，形成交联，在重力作用下脱稳沉降;絮凝剂电离得到的电荷才可以中和胶体颗粒表面的负电荷使电位降低。胶体颗粒相互吸引絮凝：还可以与带负电尙的溶解物进行反应，生成不溶件的盐，对有机物和尤机物都有很好的净化作根据制备方法分为聚合分子反应型、缩合型。聚合型制备主要是山含烯填的阳离子单体通过自由聚合制成，钉聚二甲基二烯内堪氣化铵、丙烯酰胺甲基丙烯酸二甲基氨填乙酯共聚物、丙烯酰胺闪烯酸乙酯基三甲堪化铵共聚物等;缩合型主要利用缩合反应制得有氨-环氧氯丙烷缩聚物。
explanation_en: It is also called cationic polymer flocculant. A kind of mountain molecular chain with detachable positively charged active groups, such as water soluble polymer polyelectrolyte coagulant such as amino, imino or quaternary amino. The flocculation mechanism mainly includes adsorption crosslinking and charge neutralization. The nonpolar group in the molecule has hydrophobic effect, and the hydrogen bond and van der Waals force absorb two or more colloidal particles to form crosslinking, which is destabilized and settled under gravity; Only the charge obtained by ionization of coagulant can neutralize the negative charge on the surface of colloidal particles to reduce the potential. Colloidal particles attract and flocculate each other: they can also react with the dissolved substances with negative ions to generate insoluble salts, which can purify organics and organic substances well. According to the preparation method, they can be divided into polymerization molecular reaction type and condensation type. The polymerization type preparation is mainly made of cationic monomer filled with alkenes through free polymerization, such as nailed dimethyl diene endocarbonylamine, acrylamide methacrylate dimethyl ammonium ester copolymer, acrylamide amphibole ethyl ester trimethyl ammonium chloride copolymer, etc; The condensation type mainly uses condensation reaction to prepare ammonia epichlorohydrin condensation polymer.

name_cn: 阳离子型天然有机高分子改性絮凝剂
name_en: cationic	natural organic polymeric modified flocculant
explanation_cn: 通过对天然高分子进行接枝共聚或官能闭衍生等改性处理，使得分子链带正电官能团的天然高分子絮凝剂。絮凝剂现主要行电中和及吸附交联作用。在溶液中，絮凝剂可以中和带负电的胶体颗粒，戍缩其双电层，降低电位。使颗粒相互吸引变为大的絮状颗粒，由于重力作用脱稳沉降，也可与带负电荷的溶解物进行反应，生成不溶性的盐：分子非极性堪闭具有疏水作用。通过氢键和范德华力吸附两个或多个胶体颗粒，形成交联，在重力作用下脱稳沉降。根裾原料来源分为改忭淀粉类、木质素类、纤维素类、壳聚糖产品等。应用于油田污水、造纸废水、食品废水、污泥脱水、回收重金属离子等。
explanation_en: The natural polymer is modified by graft copolymerization or functional block derivation to make the molecular chain of natural polymer flocculant with positive functional groups. Flocculants are mainly used for electric neutralization and adsorption crosslinking. In solution, coagulant can neutralize negatively charged colloidal particles, shrink their double electric layer and reduce potential. The particles attract each other and become large flocculent particles. Due to gravity, they can destabilize and settle, and can also react with negatively charged solutes to form insoluble salts. Molecular non polarity can cause hydrophobic interactions. Two or more colloidal particles are adsorbed by hydrogen bond and van der Waals force to form crosslinking, which is destabilized and settled under gravity. The raw materials of the roots can be divided into modified starch, lignin, cellulose and chitosan products. Applied to oilfield wastewater, papermaking wastewater, food wastewater, sludge dewatering, recovery of heavy metal ions, etc.

explanation_cn: 呈纤维状、丝状形态。呈深灰绿色，弱丝绢光泽。纤维中等粗细，性脆，易折断。用手搓成粉未。用于制备石棉水泥制品及石棉板、石棉纸及绝缘材料。
explanation_en: In a fibrous or filamentous form. It is dark gray green with a weak silk luster. The fiber is of medium thickness, brittle in nature, and easy to break. Rub it into powder by hand. It is used to prepare asbestos cement products, asbestos board, asbestos paper and insulation materials.

explanation_cn: 在阴极射线激发下能发光的材料。又称阴极射线荧光粉。具有实用价值作为显示用电子束管(CRT)用荧光粉，要具备：①有高的发光亮度和发光效率;②有一定的辐射光谱特性;③有一定余辉时间;④有一定的颗粒尺寸.通常要求平均颗粒尺寸在0.220pm范围内：⑤有良好的稳定性及对屏玻璃有良好的黏着性能。荧光粉均匀地涂在电子束管的底部，电子束经过聚焦，打在屏的某一点上，这个点就发光，控制电子束的电流束控制发光的亮度，电子束扫描整个屏面.屏上每个点的亮度随阁像的明暗部分而变化，并显示出图像。阴极射线发光按用途分成：黑白电视;彩色电视或彩色显示管：投影电视;飞点扫描示波管等用荧光粉。按余辉长短分成：极长余辉荧光粉,用于雷达显示;长余辉荧光粉，余辉时间（10%)100ms,用干雷达显示;中余辉荧光粉，余辉时间(10%)110ms,用于示波显示;中短余辉荧光粉，余辉时间（10%），用于飞点扫描管。阴极射线发光材料是发光材料中产量仅次于灯用荧光粉的一种产量较大的荧光粉。
explanation_en: A materials that emits luminescence under the excitation of cathode rays. Also known as cathode ray phosphor. It has practical value. As a phosphor for CRT, it should have: ① high luminescence brightness and luminescence efficiency; ② Having certain radiation spectral characteristics; ③ There is a certain afterglow time; ④ There is a certain particle size. Generally, the average particle size is required to be within 0.220pm: ⑤ There is good stability and good adhesion of the screen glass. Phosphor is evenly coated on the bottom of the electron beam tube. After focusing, the electron beam hits a certain point on the screen, and this point will luminescence. The current beam of the electron beam controls the brightness of the luminescence. The electron beam scans the entire screen. The brightness of each point on the screen changes with the light and dark parts of the pavilion image, and displays the image. Cathode ray luminescence can be divided into: black and white TV; Color television or color display tube: projection television; Phosphor for flying spot scanning oscilloscope tube, etc. According to the length of afterglow, it is divided into: very long afterglow phosphor for radar display; Long afterglow phosphor, afterglow time (10%) 100ms, displayed by dry radar; Medium afterglow phosphor, afterglow time (10%) 110ms, for oscillographic display; Medium and short afterglow phosphor, afterglow time (10%), used for flying spot scanning tube. Cathode ray luminescence materials is a kind of luminescence materials whose output is only second to that of phosphor for lamps, and phosphor with larger output.

explanation_cn: 在电解池中，作为阴极的材料发生均匀腐蚀。
explanation_en: In the electrolytic cell, general corrosion occurs to the materials as the cathode.

explanation_cn: 带有碱性功能基可与溶液中的阴离子进行交换反应的离子交换树脂。功能基的碱性强弱不同，粗略划分为强碱性及弱碱性两大类。带有季铵基的为强碱性阴离子交换树脂，季铵型中含三甲氨基的称为强碱型，含二甲基乙醇氨基的称为强碱型，含伯胺、仲胺、叔氨基的统称为弱碱性离子交换树脂。
explanation_en: Ion exchange resin with basic functional groups that can exchange with anions in solution. The alkalinity of functional groups varies and can be roughly divided into two categories: strong alkalinity and weak alkalinity. The strongly basic anion exchange resin with quaternary ammonium group, the strongly basic type containing trimethylamino group in the quaternary ammonium type, the strongly basic type containing dimethylethanol amino group, and the weakly basic ion exchange resin containing primary amine, secondary amine, and tertiary amino group.

name_cn: 阴离子型合成有机高分子絮凝剂
explanation_cn: 又称为阴离子高分子絮凝。溶液中带负电荷的基团中和溶液中带正电溶质，生成不溶物盐，使其絮凝沉降;分子中的非极性基团通过氢键和范德华力吸附两个或多个胶体颗粒，形成交联，吸附多个颗粒由于重力作用失稳沉降。根据制备工艺可分为聚合型和高分子反应型。聚合型有：聚丙烯酸、聚丙烯酸钠、丙烯酸-马来酸酐共聚物、丙烯酸-丙烯酰胺-2-甲基丙烯磺酸（钠）共聚物、丙烯酰胺丙烯酸钠共聚物、丙烯酰胺-乙烯基磺酸钠共聚物、丙烯酰胺-丙烯酰胺-2-甲基丙烯磺酸钠共聚物以及丙烯酰胺-甲基丙烯酸甲酯-丙烯酸钠三元共聚物;高分子反应型有水解聚丙烯酰胺、磺甲基化聚丙烯酰胺、聚丙乙烯磺酸钠和聚二膦酰基甲基丙烯酰胺等。适用的pH值为中性至强酸性（较高温度条件下仍苻效），可应用于选矿、电镀、机械洗煤、纸浆废水等的处理。
explanation_en: It is also called anionic macromolecule flocculation. The negatively charged groups in the solution neutralize the positively charged solute in the solution, generating insoluble salts that cause flocculation and sedimentation; The nonpolar group in the molecule absorbs two or more colloidal particles through hydrogen bond and van der Waals force to form crosslinking, and the adsorbed particles destabilize and settle due to gravity. According to the preparation process, it can be divided into polymerization type and macromolecule reaction type. Polymerization types include: polyacrylic acid, sodium polyacrylate, acrylic acid maleic anhydride copolymer, acrylic acid acrylamide 2-methacrylenesulfonic acid (sodium) copolymer, acrylamide sodium acrylate copolymer, acrylamide sodium vinyl sulfonate copolymer, acrylamide acrylamide 2-methacrylenesulfonic acid sodium copolymer and acrylamide methyl methacrylate sodium acrylate ternary copolymer; Macromolecule reaction types include hydrolyzed polyacrylamide, sulfonated and methylated polyacrylamide, sodium polypropylene sulfonate, polyphosphonyl methacrylamide, etc. The applicable pH value is neutral to strong acid (still effective at high temperature), which can be applied to the treatment of mineral processing, electroplating, mechanical coal washing, pulp wastewater, etc.

name_cn: 阴离子型天然有机高分子改性絮凝剂
name_en: anionic nm ural organic polymeric modified flocculant
explanation_cn: 对天然高分子进行接枝共聚或官能团衍生等改性处理，使其带有负电官能团的天然高分子絮凝剂，絮凝机理主要有电中和和吸附交联作用。在水溶液中，该絮凝剂可以中和带正电荷的溶质，生成不溶性物质;分子中非极性基团具有疏水作用，通过氢键和范德华力吸附两个或多个胶体颗粒，形成交联，在重力作用下脱稳沉降。根据原料来源可分为改性淀粉类、黄原胶及改性产品、改性纤维素、海藻酸钠、改性木质素类、改性植物单宁和F691粉改性产品等。改性淀粉类的制备方法有磷酸酯化、黄原酸酯化、羧甲基化、接枝共聚;黄原胶改性产品是与丙烯酰胺在氮气环境下通过水溶解聚合法接枝共聚可制得黄原胶及改性产品;改性纤维素由羧甲基纤维接素通过引发剂引发再与乙烯基类单体接枝共聚制备;海藻酸钠主要是通过对海带加碱提取;改性木质素类主要由木质素磺酸盐和丙烯酰胺或丙烯酸接枝共聚：植物单宁与丙烯酸钠接枝共聚可制得植物单宁改性产品;F691改性产品主要是将纤维素通过反应接上活化基团增加水溶性及分子链上的活性基团。应用于处理鱼类加工厂、屠宰场、发酵工厂染料的废水等，可作浮游选矿的沉降剂。
explanation_en: The natural polymer is modified by graft copolymerization or functional group derivation to make it have negative functional groups. The flocculation mechanism mainly includes electric neutralization and adsorption crosslinking. In the aqueous solution, the coagulant can neutralize the positively charged solute and generate insoluble substances; The non-polar group in the molecule has hydrophobic effect. Two or more colloidal particles are adsorbed through hydrogen bond and van der Waals force to form crosslinking, which is destabilized and settled under gravity. According to the source of raw materials, it can be divided into modified starch, xanthan gum and modified products, modified cellulose, sodium alginate, modified lignin, modified vegetable tannin and F691 powder modified products. The preparation methods of modified starch include phosphorylation, xanthate esterification, carboxymethylation, and graft copolymerization; Xanthan gum modified products are obtained by grafting and copolymerization with acrylamide in a nitrogen environment through water solution polymerization to obtain xanthan gum and modified products; The modified cellulose was prepared by grafting copolymerization of vinyl monomer onto carboxymethyl cellulose connector initiated by initiator; Sodium alginate is mainly extracted by adding alkali to kelp; The modified lignin is mainly graft copolymerized by lignin sulfonate and acrylamide or acrylic acid. The plant tannin can be grafted with sodium acrylate to produce a plant tannin modified product; F691 modified products mainly connect cellulose with activation or conditioning groups through reaction to increase water solubility and active groups on molecular chains. It is used to treat dye or dyestuffc wastewater from fish processing plants, slaughterhouses, fermentation plants, etc., and can be used as a settling agent for floating beneficiation.

explanation_cn: 在镁合金均匀化温度或较高温度下制坯（预成形），然后降低温度预成形，再在更低温度下精整成形，既解决了铸态镁合金强韧性低、难以塑性成形的难题，同时又大幅度提高产品的力学性能。
explanation_en: Making preforms (pre forming) at a homogenization temperature or higher temperature of magnesium alloys, then lowering the temperature for pre forming, and then finishing at lower temperatures not only solves the problem of low strength, toughness, and difficulty in plastic forming of as cast magnesium alloys, but also significantly improves the mechanical properties of the product.

explanation_cn: 折射率分布呈阶梯型的光纤。
explanation_en: Optical fiber with step index distribution.

explanation_cn: 是对某一波长或者某一段波长的光具有吸收或者反射作用的材料。阻光材料主要应用于屏蔽光照引起的劣化与损伤，常见的包括高分子（光刻胶等）、炭黑、黑陶瓷丨以及金属等。高分子材料、炭黑和黑陶瓷的阻光作用;是利用对光的吸收作用，高分子材料中碳碳键、碳氧键等组合不同会对不同波长的光具有强吸收。有色金属由于对光具有高反射率，也可用作。复合多根据某一波长的光设计材料的复合结构，利用相位差实现消光，达到阻光目的。
explanation_en: It is a materials that can absorb or reflect light of a certain wavelength or a certain section of wavelength. Light stop materials are mainly used to shield the deterioration and damage caused by light, including macromolecule (photoresist, etc.), carbon black, black ceramics and metals. Light blocking effect of macromolecule materials, carbon black and black ceramics; It is the absorption of light. Different combinations of carbon carbon bond and carbon oxygen bond in macromolecule materials will strongly absorb light of different wavelengths. Non ferrous metals, due to their high reflectivity towards light, can also be used as. Composition usually designs materials composition structure according to the light of a certain wavelength, and uses phase difference to realize extinction, so as to achieve the purpose of light blocking.

explanation_cn: 起到能把振动能吸收并转变成其他形式的能量（如热能）而耗散，从而减少机械振动和降低噪声的作用的一种复合材料基本上有两种形式，即高聚物基体型和金属板夹层型。前者系在橡胶、塑料等基体中加人各种适当的填料（颗粒、纤维）复合成型，在受到振动时，由于高聚物基体与填料之间的界面上发生摩擦以及高聚物基体内的分子内摩擦，耗散了振动能达到阻尼的目的。后者系在钢板或铝板间夹有很薄的黏弹性高聚物，这样的复合材料强度由金属夹板保证而阻尼性能则由黏弹性高聚物的高内耗和金属夹板的约束性来提供，因此即使在较高的温度下也能保证良好的阻尼减振作用。
explanation_en: A kind of composite materials that can absorb and transformation vibration energy into other forms of energy (such as heat energy) and dissipate it, thus reducing mechanical vibration and noise basically has two forms, namely polymer matrix type and metal plate sandwich type. The former is composition formed by adding various appropriate fillers (particles, fibers) into matrix such as rubber and plastics. When subjected to vibration, the vibration energy is dissipated to achieve the purpose of resistance due to the friction on the interface between the polymer matrix and the filler and the intramolecular friction in the polymer matrix. The latter is a very thin viscoelasticity polymer sandwiched between steel plate or aluminum plate. The strength of such composition materials is guaranteed by the metal splint, while the damping performance is provided by the high internal friction of viscoelasticity polymer and the restraint of the metal splint. Therefore, good damping and vibration reduction can be ensured even at high temperatures.

explanation_cn: 具有减振降噪功能的铜合金。其阻尼机制主要是合金经热处理，完成马氏体相变后，马氏体相内部的微孪晶界面及马氏体与母相之间的相界面在振动交变应力作用下产生移动，将振动能转化为热能，从而实现减振降噪效果。典型的有铜锰系的Cu-10Mn-2Al，Cu-53MrHAl-3Fe-2Ni，铜梓系的Cu-23Zn-4Al，及铜铝系的Cu-14Al-4Ni等合金。上述合金的阻尼系数均大于40%,但在较长的工作时间（如1年以上），以及较苛刻的工作温度下（如lOO℃以上），仅铜锰系的两种合金仍保持较高的阻尼特性，它们的力学性能相接近，拉伸强度500-600MPa,伸长率15%-30%。其中，Cu-40Mn-2Al属加工型阻尼合金，可以加工成齿轮、凿岩机杆、消声车轮、减振簧片等。Cu-53Mn-4Al-3Fe-2Ni为铸造型阻尼合金，可铸成船用螺旋桨，大齿轮轮辐，纺织机械等。
explanation_en: Copper alloy with vibration and noise reduction function. The damping mechanism is mainly that the micro twin interface in the phase of alloy and the phase interface between martensite and parent phase move under the action of vibration alternating stress after the martensitic transformation transformation is completed by heat treatment of the alloy, which converts the vibration energy into heat energy, so as to achieve the effect of vibration reduction and noise reduction. Typical alloy include Cu-10Mn-2Al, Cu-53MrHAL-3Fe-2Ni, Cu-23Zn-4Al, Cu-14Al-4Ni, etc. The damping coefficients of the above alloy are more than 40%, but only two copper manganese alloy still maintain high damping characteristics under long working time (such as more than 1 year) and harsh working temperature (such as more than lOO ℃). Their mechanical properties are phase, with tensile strength of 500-600MPa and elongation of 15% -30%. Among them, Cu-40Mn-2Al is a machining type damping alloy, which can be processed into gears, rock drill rods, silencing wheels, damping springs, etc. Cu-53Mn-4Al-3Fe-2Ni is a cast damping alloy, which can be cast into marine propellers, big gear spokes, textile machinery, etc.
