explanation_cn: 以Al-Zn合金为基添加Ti、Zr、稀土元素具有较髙阻尼特性的阻尼合金。它密度小，强度高，在微小的振动中就能保持高的减振能力，其比阻尼值≥17%,减振性较好，且不受应力应变振幅的影响。该合金中Zn含量的多少以及泮火温度对阻尼性能具有影响，其力学性能、阻尼性能随Zn含量的增加而提高。通过调节Al、Zn元素配比，可在300°C以下具有很好的高温阻尼性能。其阻尼性能与组织有很大的关系，当出现细小的等轴晶时，具有较好的阻尼性能;阻尼性能也与振动频率也有关，随频率的增大，阻尼降低。这种合金相界面的运动与原子扩散有关，随着温度的上升，界面原子扩散加剧，界面可动性提高，通过合金内部的第二相和晶界发生塑性流动或第二相变形吸收振动能产生高内耗。Al-Zn系阻尼合金已经使用在汽车发动机基座、陀螺安装架和火箭姿态控制盘等精密装置和仪器当中，也可用于高层建筑窗框和运输机械结构件，在航空航天等领域具有广泛的应用前景。
explanation_en: Damping alloy based on Al Zn alloy and added with Ti, Zr and rare earth elements, which has higher damping characteristics. It has low density and high strength. It can maintain high damping capacity in small vibration. Its specific damping value is ≥ 17%. It has good damping performance and is not affected by stress and strain amplitude. The amount of Zn content in the alloy and the pan fire temperature have an effect on the damping properties. The mechanical properties and damping properties of the alloy increase with the increase of Zn content. By adjusting the ratio of Al and Zn elements, good high-temperature damping performance can be achieved below 300 ° C. Its damping performance is closely related to the organization, and it has good damping performance when small equiaxed crystals appear; The damping performance is also related to the vibration frequency, and as the frequency increases, the damping decreases. The movement of the phase interface of this alloy is related to the atomic diffusion. With the increase of temperature, the diffusion of the interface atoms intensifies, and the interface mobility increases. High internal friction can be generated by plastic flow or deformation of the second phase and grain boundary in the alloy to absorb vibration energy. Al Zn series damping alloy has been used in precision devices and instruments such as automobile engine base, gyro mounting frame, rocket attitude control panel, etc. It can also be used in high-rise building window frames and transport machinery structures, and has a broad application prospect in aerospace and other fields.

explanation_cn: 在一定的条件下，通过吸收能量使其具有可以减振、降噪等阻尼效应的镁合金功能材料。的阻尼机制属于位错阻尼，其阻尼机制可分为两部分，低应变下位错在点缺陷（杂质原子或空位）间做弓出运动，高应变下合金中的位错会脱开沿线钉扎的点缺陷而进行运动，这个过程就会在弹性应变范围内产生附加的位错应变，从而产生内耗将外界振动能耗散。镁及镁合金是阻尼性能最高的金属材料，当前已开发及使用的镁基阻尼合金有Mg-Zr系.Mg-Ni系，Mg-Cu-Mn系等，其中最为成熟的Mg-Zr系阻尼合金，抗拉强度：150-180MPa,屈服强度48-80MPa,比阻尼系数S.D.C=48%-58%。阻尼镁合金的开发及应用能满足当前减振降噪的需求，可以有效地解决机械制造及相关工程领域中的振动和噪声问题。主要用于导弹指令系统的壳体、紧固件、控制盘、陀螺罗盘等，提高工作可靠性和飞行姿态准确性;也可用作飞机、鱼雷、火箭的结构件，降振防噪。
explanation_en: Under certain conditions, the magnesium alloy functional materials can absorb energy to make it have damping effects such as vibration reduction and noise reduction. The damping mechanism of is dislocation damping, and its damping mechanism can be divided into two parts. Under low strain, dislocations bow out between point defects (impurity atoms or vacancy). Under high strain, dislocation in the alloy will move away from the point defects pinned along the line. This process will generate additional dislocation strain in the elasticity strain range, thus generating internal friction to dissipate the external vibration energy. Magnesium and magnesium alloy are the metallic materials with the highest damping performance. The magnesium based damping alloy that have been developed and used at present include Mg Zr system, Mg Ni system, Mg Cu Mn system, etc. Among them, the most mature Mg Zr damping alloy have tensile strength of 150-180MPa, yield strength of 48-80MPa, and specific damping coefficient of S.D.C=48% -58%. The development and application of clamping magnesium alloys can meet the current demand for vibration and noise reduction, and can effectively solve the vibration and noise problems in machinery manufacturing and related engineering fields. Mainly used for shells, fasteners, control discs, gyrocompasses, etc. of missile command systems, to improve work reliability and flight attitude accuracy; It can also be used as a structural component for aircraft, torpedoes, and rockets to reduce vibration and noise.

explanation_cn: 指能够抑制或减缓材料燃烧反应进行的物质。根据有无卤素元素可分为卤系和无卤，而无卤中又包括磷系、氮系、磷-氮膨胀型、硅系、无机等;按使用方法一般可分为添加型和反应型两类;按组成可分为无机和有机的种类多样，多数阻燃剂是通过多种机理共同作用达到阻燃目的。一般阻燃机理可概括为：促进基材脱水炭化;分解后形成保护膜隔断氧气;分解产物捕捉自由基或终止自由基连锁反应，使火焰不能延续;其分解产物使可燃气体稀释并吸收能量。主要用于合成高分子材料或天然高分子材料的阻燃，包括塑料、橡胶、纤维、木材、纸张、涂料等，在建筑材料、航天航空材料、交通运输设施、电子电气、日用家电等领域应用广泛。
explanation_en: It refers to the substance that can inhibit or slow down the combustion reaction of materials. According to the presence or absence of halogen elements, they can be divided into halogen series and halogen-free series, which also include phosphorus series, nitrogen series, phosphorus nitrogen expansion type, silicon series, inorganic series, etc; According to the usage method, it can generally be divided into two types: additive type and reactive type; According to composition, there are various kinds of inorganic and organic flame retardants. Most flame retardant or fire retardant achieve flame retardancy through multiple mechanisms. The general flame retardant mechanism can be summarized as: promoting the dehydration and carbonization of the substrate; After decomposition, a protective film is formed to isolate oxygen; The decomposition products capture free radicals or terminate the chain reaction of free radicals, making the flame unable to continue; Its decomposition products dilute combustible gases and absorb energy. It is mainly used for flame retardancy of synthetic macromolecule materials or natural polymer materials, including plastics, rubber, fibers, wood, paper, coatings, etc., and is widely used in building materials, aerospace materials, transportation facilities, electronics and electrical, household appliances and other fields.

explanation_cn: 指具有阻燃功能的复合材料。材料阻燃性能评价主要包括材料的易点燃程度、自熄时间、火焰蔓延速度、生烟密度和燃烧产物的毒性等几方面。阻燃方法包括反应型阻燃方法和添加型阻燃方法。阻燃机理主要有气相阻燃机理、凝聚相（包括液相与同相）机理及中断热交换附燃机理。
explanation_en: It refers to composite materials with flame retardant function. The evaluation of flame retardancy of materials mainly includes the ease of ignition of materials, self extinguishing time, flame spread speed, density of smoke and toxicity of combustion products. Flame retardant methods include reactive flame retardant methods and additive flame retardant methods. The flame retarding mechanism mainly includes gas phase flame retarding mechanism, condensed phase (including liquid phase and in-phase) mechanism and interrupted heat exchange combustion mechanism.

name_cn: 阻燃性不饱和聚酯树脂
explanation_cn: 结构中含有阻燃性基团的不饱和聚酯树脂或添加有阻燃剂的不饱和聚酯树脂，分反应型和添加型两类。前者在分子中含有阻燃性基团，在缩聚反应时引入。常用的阻燃性单体有氯菌酸（酐）（简称HET酸酐）、四溴（氯）邻苯二甲酸酐、六氯环戊二烯、卤代环氧树脂、卤代二元醇、环氧氯丙烷、四溴（氯）双酚A等。后者使用添加型阻燃剂.常用含有卤、磷的有机阻燃剂或水合氧化铝、三氧化二锑、硼酸盐、磷酸盐等无机阻燃剂。常用的阻燃稀释剂为氯代苯乙烯、2,5-二溴苯乙烯。添加型阻燃聚酯自熄性好，但机械强度、耐热、耐候、耐蚀性低于反应型阻燃聚酯，其极限氧指数根据品种不同，在11-30以上，第一次点火的自熄时间可在3-4s以内。阻燃不饱和聚酯用于要求阻燃的用途。
explanation_en: Unsaturated polyester resin containing flame retardant group in structure or unsaturated polyester resin added with flame retardant or fire retardant can be divided into reactive type and additive type. The former contains flame retardant groups in the molecule and is introduced in polycondensation reaction. Common flame retardant monomer include chlorobacteria acid (anhydride) (HET anhydride for short), tetrabromo (chlorine) phthalic anhydride, hexachlorocyclopentadiene, halogenated epoxy resin, halogenated diol, epichlorohydrin, tetrabromo (chlorine) bisphenol A, etc. The latter uses additive flame retardant or fire retardant. Organic flame retardant or fire retardant containing halogen and phosphorus or inorganic flame retardant or fire retardant such as hydrated aluminum oxide, antimony trioxide, borate and phosphate are commonly used. Common flame retardant diluents are chlorostyrene and 2,5-dibromostyrene. The additive flame-retardant polyester has good self extinguishing property, but its mechanical strength, heat resistance, weather resistance and corrosion resistance are lower than those of reactive flame-retardant polyester. Its limiting oxygen index is above 11-30 according to different varieties, and the self extinguishing time of the first ignition can be within 3-4s. Flame retardant unsaturated polyester is used for applications that require flame retardancy.

explanation_cn: 是将阻燃剂加入单体甲基丙烯酸甲酯中加热预聚制成浆液，或直接加人已制得的预聚浆液中，铸型聚合而成的。遇火焰时不燃或燃烧速度缓慢且离开火焰即自行熄，属于环保型材料。其强度和冲击韧性优于有机玻璃。含卤和磷阻燃化合物的浇铸型有机玻璃，被广泛用作防火阻燃要求高的建筑窗玻璃、建筑、航空、地铁、车辆、广告装潢、电梯、电子电气等行业中照明灯具和安全玻璃等。
explanation_en: It is made by adding flame retardant or fire retardant into the monomer methyl methacrylate, heating and prepolymerizing to make slurry, or directly adding it into the prepared prepolymerization slurry, and mold polymerization. It will not burn when encountering the flame or the combustion speed is slow and will automatically extinguish when leaving the flame. It is an environmentally friendly materials. Its strength and impact toughness are better than those of organic glass. Casting type organic glass containing halogen and phosphorus flame retardant compounds is widely used as building window glass, lighting fixtures and safety glass in construction, aviation, subway, vehicles, advertising decoration, elevator, electronics and electrical industries with high requirements for fire resistance and flame retardancy.

explanation_cn: 在火焰中难燃、移开火焰后具有自熄性的纤维，亦称难燃纤维，其极限氧指数（LOI)大都在27-32之间。大体有四类：①含卤素的合成纤维，如含氯和含氟纤维，代表品种是聚氯乙烯、聚四氟乙烯和氯乙烯-丙烯腈共聚纤维，它们靠燃烧时释放出不可燃的气体如卤化氢等，而难以延燃，移开火焰时便自灭。②添加有阻燃剂的化学纤维，如阻燃涤纶、腈纶和黏胶纤维等?阻燃剂有磷、卤素或锑化物等，靠磷的促进碳化、卤素释放的不燃保护气和三氧化二锑燃烧时遇氯化氢能形成灭火的三氯化锑和三氯氧化锑而起到阻燃作用。③纤维或织物的表面阻燃处理，阻燃剂有磷、氮、硼、锑、卤素等的有机或无机化合物，硼的阻燃机理与磷类似，代表品种有阻燃化纤、防火棉和羊毛等。④某些耐高温特种合成纤维，如聚苯并咪唑、聚间苯二甲酰间苯二胺、聚芳酰胺-酰亚胺纤维和聚芳砜酰胺等。这些纤维在火焰中燃烧时表面能形成炭化层，从而阻止纤维内层进一步燃烧。有时把聚丙烯腈预氧化纤维、聚对苯二甲酰对苯二胺纤维、玻璃纤维和钢纤维也列入阻燃纤维行列，但聚丙烯腈预氧化纤维的LOI为40-60，应归属于抗燃纤维，Kevlar的LOI为25,主要归入高强度高模量纤维，后两者分别归类于无机和金属纤维。阻燃纤维主要用于制作室内装饰织物包括窗帘、毛毯、壁毯、帐篷、军服、车辆内装饰材料、罩布、玩具、假发和防护服等。
explanation_en: The fibers that are difficult to burn in the flame and have self extinguishing property after removing the flame are also called flame resistant fibers, and their limiting oxygen index (LOI) is mostly between 27-32. There are generally four categories: ① Halogen containing synthetic fiber, such as chlorine containing and fluorofibrc, represented by polyvinyl chloride, polylctrafluorocthylone and vinyl chloride acrylonitrile copolymer fibers, which are difficult to ignite due to the release of nonflammable gases such as hydrogen halide during combustion, and will self extinguish when the flame is removed. ② Man-made fiber with flame retardant or fire retardant added, such as flame retardant polyester, acrylic fiber and viscose fiber? Flame retardant or fire retardant include phosphorus, halogens or antimony compounds. They play the role of flame retardancy by promoting carbonization of phosphorus, the incombustible protective gas released by halogens, and antimony trioxide that can form fire extinguishing antimony trichloride and antimony trioxide when encountering hydrogen chloride in combustion. ③ Surface flame retardant treatment of fiber or fabric. flame retardant or fire retardant includes organic or inorganic compounds such as phosphorus, nitrogen, boron, antimony, halogen, etc. The flame retardant mechanism of boron is similar to that of phosphorus, and representative varieties include flame retardant chemical fiber, fire retardant cotton, wool, etc. ④ Some special high temperature resistant synthetic fiber, such as polyphenylimidazole, polyisophthalimide, polyarylamide imide fibers and polyarysulfone amide, etc. When these fibers combustion in the flame, the surface energy forms a carbonization layer, which prevents the inner layer of the fibers from further combustion. Sometimes polyacrylonitrile preoxidized fiber, poly (p-phenyleneterephthamide) fiber, glass fiber and steel fibre are also included in the list of flame retardant fiber, but the LOI of polyacrylonitrile preoxidized fiber is 40-60, which should be attributed to antiflame fiber, and the LOI of Kevlar is 25, which is mainly classified as high strength and high modules fiber, and the latter two are classified as inorganic and metal fibers respectively. Flame retardant fiber is mainly used to make interior decorative fabrics, including curtains, blankets, tapestries, tents, military uniforms, materials for interior decoration of vehicles, covers, toys, wigs and protective clothing.

explanation_cn: 通过向镁合金中添加合金元素，使其在熔炼的过程中自动生成保护性的氧化膜，从而提高合金燃点、阻止进;一步氧化燃烧的镁合金。主要的阻燃合金元素包括：Be、Ca、Ce、Y等。其中Ca在合金中的含量不宜加入太多，否则会使晶间化合物形成网状分布，增大了合金的脆性;Be在合金中的含量也不能太高，因为过量的Be会导致合金组织粗化和力学性能的下降。
explanation_en: By adding alloy elements to the magnesium alloy, the protective oxide film can be automatically formed during the melting process, so as to improve the ignition point of alloy and prevent the ingress; One step oxidation of combustion magnesium alloy. The main flame retardant alloy elements include: Be, Ca, Ce, Y, etc. The content of Ca in alloy should not be added too much, otherwise the intergranular compound will form a network distribution, increasing the brittleness of alloy; The content of Be in alloy should not be too high, because excessive Be will lead to coarsening of alloy structure and decline of mechanical properties.

explanation_cn: 自由基活性链与其他分子发生链转移反应，生成无聚合活性产物，使聚合反应速率迅速降为零的现象。阻聚的原理有两种，一是阻聚剂与链自由基反应，形成非自由基物质;二是形成不能引发的低活性自由基，这两种情况都抑制了聚合反应的正常进行。具有的物质称为阻聚剂。
explanation_en: The free radical active chain and other molecules undergo chain transfer reaction to generate polymerization free active products, which rapidly reduces the polymerization reaction rate to zero. There are two principles of polymerization inhibition. One is that polymerization inhibitors react with chain free radicals to form non free radical substances; The other is the formation of low active free radicals that cannot be initiated, which inhibit the normal progress of polymerization. The substances present are called polymerization inhibitors.

explanation_cn: 在超导实用材料中，为了防止超导层与基体材料之间发生反应而添加的材料。
explanation_en: In superconducting practical materials, materials are added to prevent the reaction between superconducting layer and matrix materials.

explanation_cn: 将厚3.2mm、宽12.7 mm的长条状橡胶试样粘在胶轮上，胶轮以15°偏斜角与砂轮接触进行滚动摩擦，经预磨和砂轮运行1.61km后，测定胶条的磨耗体积。
explanation_en: Stick a 3.2mm thick and 12.7mm wide strip shaped rubber sample onto a rubber wheel. The rubber wheel contacts the grinding wheel at a 15 ° inclination angle for rolling friction. After pre grinding and running the grinding wheel for 1.61km, measure the wear volume of the rubber strip.

explanation_cn: 包覆燃料颗粒的核芯由低温侧向高温侧迁移的现象。在温度梯度场中.燃料核芯在高温侧和包覆层反应，侵蚀热解碳.向前迁移.在其后面--低温侧.沉积析出石墨。它以温度梯度为必要条件，但只有在高温时.才能以显著速度进行。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of the core coated with fuel particles migrating from the low-temperature side to the high-temperature side. In the temperature gradient field, the fuel core reacts with the cladding layer at the high temperature side, eroding the pyrolytic carbon, moving forward, and depositing graphite at the low temperature side behind it. It takes a temperature gradient as a necessary condition, but can only proceed at a significant speed at high temperatures.

explanation_cn: 阿贝数是德国物理学家恩斯特·阿贝发明的物理量，也称”色散系数”，用来衡量透明介质的光线色散程度。阿贝数就是用以表示透明介质色散能力的指数。一般来说，介质的折射率越大，色散越严重，阿贝数越小；反之，介质的折射率越小，色散越轻微，阿贝数越大。阿贝数常用于镜片行业，是镜片的选购参考因素之一。眼用的光学镜片材料阿贝数一般在30到60之间。供人佩戴的镜片阿贝数不应该低于30，否则明显的色散现象会让佩戴者视觉模糊，进而可能产生不适现象。
explanation_en: Abbe number is a physical quantity invented by German physicist Ernst Abbe, also known as "dispersion coefficient", which is used to measure the dispersion of light in transparent media. Abbe number is the index used to express the dispersion ability of transparent media. In general, the larger the refractive index of the medium, the more serious the dispersion, and the smaller the Abbe number; On the contrary, the smaller the refractive index of the medium, the smaller the dispersion, and the larger the Abbe number. Abbe number is often used in the lens industry and is one of the reference factors for lens selection. The Abbe number of materials of optical lenses for eyes is generally between 30 and 60. The Abbe number of the lens for human wear should not be less than 30, otherwise the obvious dispersion will make the wearer's vision blurred, which may cause discomfort.

explanation_cn: 是硅酸盐水泥中最主要的矿物成分.对硅酸盐水泥性质有重要影响。遇水反应速率较快，水化热高.水化产物对水泥早期和后期强度起主要作用。
explanation_en: It is the main mineral component in Portland cement and has an important impact on the properties of Portland cement. The reaction rate is fast when encountering water, and the hydration heat is high. The hydration products play a major role in the early and late strength of cement.

explanation_cn: 通常由阴性和阳性两部分主要连接结构通过嵌合作用结合在一起的义齿固位装置。一部分位于固定义齿或种植义齿上，另一部分与活动义齿相连,或者与固定义齿的另一部分相连。
explanation_en: A demure retention device that is usually combined by the chimeric action of the main connecting structure of the negative and positive parts. One part is located on the fixed demure or implant demure, and the other part is connected with the movable demure or the other part of the fixed demure.

explanation_cn: 专供陈列观赏用的陶瓷艺术制品，如花瓶、花插、挂盘、瓷板、薄胎碗、龙舟、盆景、花篮、通花瓶、皮灯、大型装饰以及罗汉、观音、古典和现代人物、禽兽虫鱼等雕塑品。还包括历代名窑生产的古代陶瓷以及属于日用陶瓷范围的某些高级精细品种。中国各大产瓷区都有生产，品种繁多，并且都有各自的传统技艺和特点。
explanation_en: Ceramics art products specially used for display and appreciation, such as vases, flower arrangements, hanging plates, porcelain plates, thin embryo bowls, dragon boats, bonsai, flower baskets, through vases, leather lamps, large-scale decorations, and sculptures such as Arhat, Guanyin, classical and modern figures, animals, insects, fish, etc. It also includes ancient ceramics produced by famous kilns in past dynasties and some advanced fine varieties belonging to the scope of domestic porcelain. Each major porcelain producing area in China has production, a wide variety, and each has its own traditional skills and characteristics.

name_cn: 降冰片烯封端聚酰亚胺
explanation_cn: 又称纳特酰亚胺端基热固性树脂，其结构基于降冰片烯二甲酰亚胺，作为端基的预聚物。这个特性使得加工工艺相对较简单，而且预浸渍物的稳定性较高。制成的模压产品具有出色的热稳定性，能够在长期使用时承受高达260-300°C的温度，并且具有良好的力学性能。此类树脂制成的层压板具有较低的孔隙率（<2%），可以采用常规的层压成型工艺。然而，这些树脂的缺点包括其溶剂具有毒性，因此制成的产品可能带有毒性，而且这些树脂具有较高的吸水性和制备成本。降冰片烯封端聚酰亚胺树脂通常用于制造复合材料，例如层压板、结构部件和高温绝缘制品。在航空航天和电子领域，它们被用于制造喷气发动机部件、电路板、电机槽楔、定子和转子绝缘侧板等。此外，它们还可以用作胶黏剂。
explanation_en: Also known as naterimide end group thermosetting resin, its structure is based on norbornene diimide as a prepolymer of the end group. This characteristic makes the processing process relatively simple, and the stability of the pre impregnated material is high. The molded products have excellent thermal stability, can withstand temperatures up to 260-300 ° C in long-term use, and have good mechanical properties. The laminate made of this kind of resin has a low porosity (<2%), and can adopt the conventional laminating process. However, the disadvantages of these resin include that their solvents are toxic, so the products made may be toxic, and these resin have high water absorption and preparation costs. Norbornene-terminatcd polyimide resin is usually used to manufacture composite materials, such as laminates, structural parts and high-temperature insulation products. In the fields of aerospace and electronics, they are used to manufacture jet engine components, circuit boards, motor slot wedges, stator and rotor insulation side plates, etc. In addition, they can also be used as adhesive.

explanation_cn: 指在热、光、机械力、化学试剂、微生物等外界因素作用下，聚合物发生了分子链的无规断裂或解聚，导致聚合度或分子量下降的过程。聚合物的性能常与相对分子质量密切相关.因此降解会导致聚合物的性能下降。因降解使聚合物性能变坏的过程也称为老化。
explanation_en: It refers to the process of random fracture or depolymerization of molecular chain of polymer under the action of external factors such as heat, light, mechanical force, chemical reagent, microorganism, etc., leading to the decrease of degree of polymerization or molecular weight. The performance of polymer is often closely related to the relative molecular weight, so degradation will lead to the decline of the performance of polymer. The process of polymer performance deterioration due to degradation is also called aging.

name_cn: 降解型光敏高分子成像材料
explanation_cn: 经光照后可降解为小分子产物，使曝光区域溶解度增大，通过显影可得到正性图像的一类材料。具有实用价值的是辐照降解型高分子成像材料，如用于电子束、软X射线、远紫外线曝光的高分子材料。
explanation_en: It is a kind of materials that can be degradation into small molecular products after light irradiation, which increases the water solubility of the exposed area, and can obtain positive images through development. Irradiation degradation macromolecule imaging materials are of practical value, such as macromolecule materials for electron beam, soft X-ray and far ultraviolet exposure.

explanation_cn: 能防止散发、掩盖或除去臭味的一类物质。一般分为物理除臭剂、化学除臭剂、复合型除臭剂、微生物除臭剂和植物除臭剂五大类。①物理除臭剂指在消除恶臭气体时只发生物理作用的物质，包括挥发型除臭剂和吸附型除臭剂.其中前者是利用芳香类化学物、木醋酸、樟脑、桉油等植物精油以及各种植物的萃取液挥发到臭气中掩盖恶臭气味.达到感官上除臭的目的，而后者是利用沸石粉、活性氧化铝、活性炭等吸附型物质将恶臭物质吸附，达到除臭的目的。②化学除臭剂是指利用缩合、离子交换、氧化和还原等反应将产生的恶臭物质变成无臭物质，以达到除臭的目的，如双氧水、硫酸亚铁、氯化钙、磷酸氢钙和高锰酸钾等。③复合型除臭剂是将两种或两种以上具有除臭作用的物质进行混合、复配后用于除臭，在功能上实现不同除臭物质的除臭效果互补.以提高除臭效果。④微生物除臭剂是先从粪污等恶臭物体中分离出除臭菌，除臭菌经富集培养后再配成除臭菌稀释液，就4用于微生物除臭。这类除臭剂能将恶臭气体成分当作营养源吸收利用，从而将臭气去除。⑤植物除臭剂是提取植物中天然杀菌除臭因子精制而成的。不添加任何化学物质，对人体、牲畜无任何毒副作用?使用安全。具有抑菌、杀菌和除臭功效，对氨、硫化氢等恶臭有良好的分解去除效果。
explanation_en: A type of substance that can prevent, mask, or remove odors. It is generally divided into five categories: physical deodorant, chemical deodorant, compound deodorant, microbial deodorant and plant deodorant. ① Physical deodorant refers to substances that only have physical effects when eliminating odor gases, including volatile deodorant and adsorption deodorant. The former uses aromatic chemicals, wood acetic acid, camphor, eucalyptus oil and other plant essential oils as well as extracts of various plants to volatilize into odor to cover odor and achieve sensory deodorization, while the latter uses zeolite powder, active aluminium Activated carbon and other adsorptive substances adsorb malodorous substances to achieve the purpose of deodorization. ② Chemical deodorant refers to the use of condensation, ion exchange, oxidation, reduction and other reactions to turn the generated malodorous substances into odorless substances to achieve the purpose of deodorization, such as hydrogen peroxide, ferrous sulfate, calcium chloride, calcium hydrogen phosphate and potassium permanganate. ③ Composite deodorant is used for deodorization after mixing and compounding two or more substances with deodorization function, so as to realize the complementarity of deodorization effects of different deodorization substances in terms of function, so as to improve the deodorization effect. ④ Microbial deodorant is used to separate deodorizing bacteria from feces and other malodorous substances. The deodorizing bacteria are enriched and cultured and then prepared into deodorizing bacteria diluent, which is used for microbial deodorization. This kind of deodorant can absorb and utilize the odor gas component as a nutrient source to remove odor. ⑤ Plant deodorant is refined by extracting natural sterilization and deodorization factors from plants. Do not add any chemical substances and have no toxic or side effects on humans or livestock? Safe to use. It has antibacterial, bactericidal, and deodorizing effects, and has good decomposition and removal effects on odor such as ammonia and hydrogen sulfide.

explanation_cn: 去除某些金属在高温下形成的氧化皮的工艺操作，轧钢生产中在开轧前必须将钢坯表面的铁鱗去除以保证轧钢产品的表面质量，目前广泛采用高压水射流除鳞。
explanation_en: The process operation of removing oxide scales formed by certain metals at high temperatures requires the removal of iron scales on the surface of steel billets before rolling to ensure the surface quality of rolled products. Currently, high-pressure water jet descaling is widely used.

explanation_cn: 火药或炸药开始加速分解之前的保存时间。这是从化学安定件的角度出发对储存寿命的广义解释。而从使用的角度看，储存寿命可分別理解为使用寿命、安全寿命和有效使用期。它们在时间长短方面是有差别的。
explanation_en: The storage time of propellant or explosive before it starts to accelerate decomposition. This is a broad interpretation of storage life from the perspective of chemical stabilizers. From the perspective of use, storage life can be understood as service life, safe storage life and available life respectively. They differ in terms of duration.

explanation_cn: 以陶土或黏土为原料.经可塑成型后，在800-1000°C的温度下烧制而成的制品。一般含有较高的气孔率.有不同程度的渗水性，机械强度较差.断面粗糙无光泽。按制造工艺可分为粗陶、精陶，按用途可分为日用陶和建筑卫生陶。陶器在古代是人们日常生活的重要用品，在现代一般作为工艺品收藏。陶器的发展被认为是古代文明进步的标志，中国早在公元前六千年前就已经出现了陶器。中同古代制陶业中最有时代性的是黄河流域一带的仰韶文化、龙山文化、马家窑文化、齐家文化、大汶口文化等；长江流域一带的河姆渡文化、马家浜文化、大溪文化、屈家岭文化以及良渚文化等。中国古代陶器分为灰陶、红陶、黑陶、夹砂陶、彩陶等品种。著名的唐=彩和秦兵马俑都属陶器.至今仍令人叹服。
explanation_en: The product is made of clay or clay as raw material, after plastic molding, and fired at 800-1000 ° C. Generally, it contains high porosity, varying degrees of water permeability, poor mechanical strength, and a rough and matte cross-section. According to the manufacturing process, it can be divided into coarse pottery and fine pottery, and according to the use, it can be divided into daily pottery and building sanitary pottery. In ancient times, pottery was an important article in people's daily life. In modern times, it is generally collected as a handicraft. The development of pottery is regarded as a sign of the progress of ancient civilization. pottery has appeared in China as early as 6000 BC. The most contemporary pottery industry in ancient China is the Yangshao Culture, Longshan Culture, Majiayao Culture, Qijia Culture, Dawenkou Culture, etc. in the Yellow River Basin; The Hemudu Culture, Majiabang Culture, Daxi Culture, Qujialing Culture, and Liangzhu Culture in the Yangtze River Basin. Ancient Chinese pottery can be divided into grey pottery, red pottery, black pottery, sanded pottery, painted pottery and other varieties. The famous Tang=Cai and Qin Terra Cotta Warriors are both pottery, which is still impressive today.

explanation_cn: 以无机非金属天然矿物或化工产品为原料，经原料处理、成型、干燥、烧成等工序制成的产品。其显微结构由晶相、玻璃相和气相组成，三者的比例视不同品种而异。陶瓷具有耐高温、耐磨、耐腐蚀、抗氧化、电绝缘、强度大、硬度高等优良性能。陶瓷的传统概念是指所有以黏土等天然无机非金属矿物为原料加工制成的产品.主要有日用陶瓷、建筑卫生陶瓷、陈设艺术陶瓷、化工陶瓷、化学瓷、电瓷等。随着科学技术的进步.陶瓷的制造工艺和用途不断得到发展，出现各种具有特异性能的结构陶瓷、功能陶瓷及生物陶瓷等，统称先进陶瓷.也称高性能陶瓷、精细陶瓷、现代陶瓷、高新技术陶瓷或特种陶瓷等。这类陶瓷主要采用高纯人工合成的氧化物、碳化物、氮化物、硼化物、硅化物，硫化物等无机非金属物质为原料，采用先进的成型和烧结技术，有些产品再进一步通过精密加工.赋予陶瓷具备耐高温、耐磨、高强度、耐热冲击、高刚性、隔热以及电、磁、光、敏感、生物活性等性能，广泛应用于电子、计算机、激光、核反应、宇航、生物材料等现代尖端科学技术领域。
explanation_en: A product made from inorganic non-metallic natural minerals or chemical products through processes such as raw material treatment, molding, drying, and firing. Its microstructure consists of crystal phase, glass phase and gas phase, and the proportion of the three phases varies according to different varieties. Ceramics has excellent properties of high temperature resistance, abrasion resistance, corrosion resistance, oxidation resistance, electrical insulation, high strength, high hardness, etc. The traditional concept of ceramics refers to all products processed with clay and other natural inorganic no-metallic mineral as raw materials, mainly including domestic porcelain, architectural sanitary ceramics, display art ceramics, chemical ceramics, chemical ceramics, electric porcelain, etc. With the progress of science and technology, the manufacturing process and use of ceramics have been continuously developed, and various structural ceramics, functional ceramics and biological cemmics with special properties have emerged, collectively known as advanced ceramics, also known as high performance ceramics, fine ceramics, moden ceramics, high-tech ceramics or special ceramics. This kind of ceramics mainly uses high-purity artificial oxide, carbide, nitride, boride, silicide, sulfide and other inorganic non-metallic materials as raw materials, adopts advanced molding and sintering technology, and some products are further processed by precision machining. ceramics are endowed with high temperature resistance, wear resistance, high strength, heat shock resistance, high rigidity, heat insulation, and electrical, magnetic, optical, sensitive, bioactivity and other properties, and are widely used in electronics Computer, laser, nuclear reaction, aerospace, biological materials and other modern cutting-edge scientific and technological fields.

explanation_cn: 指采用传统切削金属的刀具对陶瓷材料或构件进行去除的一种机械加工方法。
explanation_en: It refers to a machining method that uses traditional metal cutting tools to remove ceramics materials or components.

explanation_cn: 由难培化合物（例如氧化物和碳化物）组成的核燃料。常用的陶瓷型燃料可分为三类。第一类包括氧化铀、氧化钚、氧化钍及其混合物，以及它们与非裂变材料的氧化物组成的混合物。第二类包括铀、钚、钍的碳化物、氮化物、硫化物、磷化物和其他化合物及其混合物.以及它们与非裂变材料的化合物组成的混合物。第三类包括弥散在石墨和其他基体中的陶瓷燃料.弥散相可以是铀、钚、钍的任何化合物及其混合物，陶瓷铟燃料具有熔点高、辐照稳定性好、一定的核燃料密度和热导率低等一系列特性。目前.二氧化铀陶瓷核燃料是陶瓷型核燃料中应用最广、研究最深的一种.被广泛用于压水式和沸水式反应堆中。
explanation_en: Nuclear fuel consisting of compounds that are difficult to grow, such as oxides and carbide. The commonly used ceramic (nuclear) fuel can be divided into three categories. The first category includes uranium oxide, plutonium oxide, thorium oxide and their mixtures, as well as their mixtures with the oxides of non fissile materials. The second category includes uranium, plutonium, thorium carbide, nitride, sulfide, phosphide and other compounds and their mixtures, as well as their mixtures with compounds of non fissile materials. The third category includes ceramics fuels dispersed in graphite and other matrix. The dispersed phase can be any compound of uranium, plutonium, thorium and its mixture. ceramics indium fuel has a series of characteristics such as high melting point, good irradiation stability, certain nuclear fuel density and low thermal conductivity. At present, uranium dioxide ceramics nuclear fuel is one of the most widely used and deeply researched ceramics nuclear fuel, which is widely used in pressurized water and boiling water reactors.

explanation_cn: 精密铸造的一种.采用陶瓷材料制造铸型。首先用水解硅酸乙酯(或磷酸盐〉、耐火材料、催化剂等混合制成陶瓷浆料，浇到母模周围，固化后起去母模.经喷烧和焙烧得到陶瓷铸型。陶瓷型铸件尺寸精度高，表面光洁,一般可不机加工。因此可缩短生产周期、节约金属材料、降低成本。适于制造各种锻造、拉丝、挤压用模具，金属型及金属模.大型汽轮机叶片和其他重要铸件
explanation_en: It is a kind of precision casting. It uses ceramics materials to make mold. First, hydrolyze ethyl silicate (or phosphate), refractory, catalyst, etc. are mixed to make ceramics slurry, poured around the master mold, removed from the master mold after curing, and then sprayed and baked to obtain ceramics mold. ceramics castings have high dimensional accuracy, smooth surface, and generally do not need machining. Therefore, it can shorten the production cycle, save metallic materials, and reduce costs. It is suitable for manufacturing various forging, wire drawing, extrusion molds, metal molds and metal molds, large turbine blades, and other Important castings

explanation_cn: 以陶瓷材料为基体，并以陶瓷、碳纤维和难熔金属的纤维、晶须、晶片和颗粒为增强体，通过适当的复合工艺所构成的复合材料。陶瓷材料具有很宽使用温度范围，特别是在高温下仍能保持很高的强度、模量、耐腐蚀和耐磨等性能，但由于其本征的脆性及强度分散性.使其应用受到很大的限制。当引人增强增韧材料而成为陶瓷基复合材料后，则很好地克服了陶瓷基低韧性高脆性的弱点.使其兼具很高的强度和钿性。由于陶瓷基复合材料发展历史短，在工艺过程中容易发生界面反应使增强体退化.工艺方法还不太成熟，尚在研究开发阶段。目前主要的应用目标是高温发动机的耐热部件、航天器的热防护和高温热交换器等方面。
explanation_en: The composite materials is made of ceramics materials as the matrix and ceramics, carbon fiber and refractory metal fiber, crystal whisker, wafer and particle as reinforcement through appropriate composition process. Ceramics materials have a wide range of service temperatures, especially at high temperatures, they can still maintain high strength, modulus, corrosion resistance, wear resistance and other properties, but their applications are greatly limited due to their inherent brittleness and strength dispersion. When ceramic matrix composite is made of reinforced and toughened materials, it can overcome the weakness of low toughness and high brittleness of ceramics matrix and make it have both high strength and high conductivity. Due to the short development history of ceramic matrix composite, the interface reaction is easy to occur in the process, which makes the reinforcement degenerate. The process method is not yet mature and is still in the research and development stage. At present, the main application targets are heat-resistant components of high-temperature engines, thermal protection of spacecraft, and high-temperature heat exchangers.

name_en: CVI process of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 化学气相渗透（CVI)工艺是化学气相沉积（CVD)工艺的改进，是制备纤维补强陶瓷基复合材料的主要工艺之一。同CVD工艺相比，CVI工艺的特点在于工作场中保持温度梯度和压力梯度。纤维预成型体一侧处于高温区沉积温度下.另一侧被冷却而保持较低温度。源气从低温侧进人，到达高温区一侧后，发生热分解或化学反应沉积出所需基质。随沉积时间延长，高温侧致密度提高，热导率增加，高温区向低温侧移动，直到各个预成型体中空穴被完全填满，最终获取高致密的复合材料。出口处保持低压，有利于源气穿过预成型体，提高材料致密度。CVI方法采用温度梯度和压力梯度，克服了CVD法易于填塞开口气孔，难于获取大尺寸、高致密材料的缺点。.由于温度梯度和压力梯度的存在，即便在较大流量时，也保持了进气侧开口气孔的畅通而能获得高沉积速度和高致密度。与传统方法相比，该方法可以制备复杂形状的烧结体，制备温度低，无外加压力，对纤维的化学和机械损伤小，有利于保持其高强特性，可获得高致密度、高强、高钿、高临界应变的复合材料，如Q/SiC、SiQ/SiC等，已成功应用于航空航天热结构部件。
explanation_en: Chemical vapor infiltration (CVI) process is an improvement of chemical vapor deposition (CVD) process and one of the main processes for preparing fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite. Compared with the CVD process, the characteristic of the CVI process is to maintain temperature and pressure gradients in the workplace. One side of the fiber preform is at a high-temperature deposition temperature, while the other side is cooled to maintain a lower temperature. The source gas enters from the low-temperature side and reaches the high-temperature area, where it undergoes thermal decomposition or chemical reaction to deposit the required matrix. With the increase of deposition time, the efficiency of spare filling and thermal conductivity at the high temperature side increase, and the high temperature zone moves to the low temperature side until the holes in each preform are completely filled, and finally a high density composite materials is obtained. The low pressure at the outlet is conducive to the source gas passing through the preform and improving the efficiency of spare filling of materials. CVI method adopts temperature gradient and pressure gradient, which overcomes the shortcomings of CVD method that it is easy to fill open pores and difficult to obtain large size and high density materials Due to the existence of temperature gradient and pressure gradient, even at a large flow rate, the air hole at the inlet side is kept unblocked to obtain high deposition rate and high efficiency of spare filling. Compared with the traditional method, this method can prepare sinters with complex shapes. The preparation temperature is low, there is no external pressure, and the chemical and mechanical damage to the fiber is small, which is conducive to maintaining its high strength characteristics. It can obtain composite materials with high efficiency of spare filling, high strength, high mother of pearl and high critical strain, such as Q/SiC, SiQ/SiC, etc., which have been successfully applied to aerospace thermal structural components.

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料压力渗滤成型工艺
name_en: press filtration of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 利用压滤原理，使料衆中水分在毛细管力和外加压力下通过微孔模具渗滤出来，而料浆中的颗粒在模具控制下，形成具有一定形状和密度的素坯。具体方法是将基体粉料、水（或有机溶剂）、表面活性剂、黏结剂制成一定浓度的料浆.将料浆倒人晶须或纤维预成型体中并加压渗滤得到素坯成型体。该工艺避免了晶须或纤维易团聚、难分散现象，黏结剂含量很低，素坯密度较高，在干燥、烧成过程中收缩变形小，易控制精度，且工艺简单，周期短，特别适合形状复杂（如薄壁、异形、大部件）材料的成型。
explanation_en: Using the filter press principle, the water in the material mass is filtered out through the microporous mold under the capillary tube force and external pressure, and the particles in the slurry are controlled by the mold to form a green billet with a certain shape and density. The specific method is to prepare a slurry with a certain concentration from the matrix powder, water (or organic solvent), surfactant and adhesive, pour the slurry into the crystal whisker or fiber preform and filter it under pressure to obtain the green preform. This process avoids the phenomenon that crystal whisker or fibers are easy to agglomeration and difficult to disperse. The content of adhesive is very low, the green body density is high, the shrinkage deformation is small during drying and firing, the precision is easy to control, and the process is simple and the cycle is short. It is especially suitable for the molding of materials with complex shapes (such as thin-walled, profiled, large parts).

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料原位生长工艺
name_en: in-situ growth process of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 在陶瓷基复合材料制备时，利用化学反应在原位生成补强组元--晶须、晶片或柱状晶来补强陶瓷基体的工艺过程。根据晶体生长热力学，陶瓷液相烧结时某些晶面生长激活能低易于生长的习性，在陶瓷基体中均匀加人某些元素（或化合物），控制其生成条件，使陶瓷基体致密化过程中在原位生长出晶须、晶片或柱状晶.形成陶瓷基自补强复合材料3如氮化硅陶瓷在高氮压气氛中烧结可生成长径比达10:1以上的P-SbN.,柱状晶自补强氮化硅陶瓷。这种工艺的优点是可使用低价原料，环境污染小.工艺简单；缺点是难以制备完全致密的复合材料。若采用预先在较低温度下热处理坯体生成一定量的晶须、晶片或柱状晶，然后再热压烧结可获得接近完全致密的复合材料》
explanation_en: During the preparation of ceramics based composite materials, the process of using chemical reaction to generate reinforcing components in situ - crystal whisker, wafers or columnar crystals to reinforce ceramics matrix. According to thermodynamics of crystal growth, when ceramics are liquid phase sintering, certain crystal plane have a habit of low activation energy for growth and easy growth. Some elements (or compounds) are added evenly to the matrix of ceramics, and their formation conditions are controlled, so that crystal whisker, wafers or columnar crystals can be grown in situ during the densification process of the matrix of ceramics. ceramics based self reinforcing composite materials are formed. 3 For example, silicon nitride ceramics can be sintering in a high nitrogen pressure atmosphere to produce P-SbN with a length diameter ratio of more than 10:1, Cylindrical crystal self reinforced silicon nitride ceramics. The advantage of this process is that low-cost raw materials can be used, environmental pollution is small, and the process is simple; The disadvantage is that it is difficult to prepare completely dense composite materials. If a certain amount of crystal whisker, wafers or columnar crystals are generated by pre heat treating the green body at a lower temperature, and then hot pressing and sintering can be used to obtain nearly completely dense composite materials

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料固相反应烧结
name_en: solid reaction sintering of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 通过同相化学反应，使反应物素坯直接得到复合材料烧结体的一种烧结工艺方法。固相反应烧结先将反应物粉末与增强体混合均匀成型得到素坯。在某一温度下使素坯中反应物通过固相反应生成新的化合物基体.同时素坯内发生物质传递、填补空隙、基体与增强体结合，从而得到复合材料烧结体。另外也有在固相反应时，同时生成基体和增强体，并形成复合材料。固相反应烧结一般需保持一定的气氛，反应物粉末需颗粒细、有较高的反应活性，也可添加一些催化剂加速固相反应的进行，并需注意控制素坯的气孔率。用SiC和Si粉为原料，在叫气氛下烧结而直接获得Sl3N4结合SiC复合材料。固相反应烧结的材料一般气孔率较大，如果反应烧结后再进行重烧结或热压烧结可进一步提高致密度，减少气孔率，提高材料的性能s应用固相反应烧结一方面可以在较低温度下制备出基体本身有较高熔点、较难烧结的复合材料，另一方面适合于制备出形状复杂、尺寸精度要求较高的陶瓷基复合材料部件。
explanation_en: It is a sintering process to directly obtain composite materials sintering body from reactant green by in-phase chemical reaction. Solid state reaction sintering first mixed the reactant powder and reinforcement to form a green body. At a certain temperature, the reactants in the green body can generate new compound matrix through solid phase reaction. At the same time, the material transfer, filling of voids, and the combination of matrix and reinforcement occur in the green body, thus obtaining the sintered body of composite materials. In addition, matrix and reinforcement are generated simultaneously during the solid phase reaction, and composite materials are formed. Solid phase reaction sintering generally needs to maintain a certain atmosphere. The reactant powder needs to be fine and have high reaction activity. Some catalysts can also be added to accelerate the solid phase reaction, and attention should be paid to controlling the porosity of the green body. The Sl3N4 bonded SiC composite materials is directly obtained by sintering in the so-called atmosphere with SiC and Si powder as raw materials. Generally, materials sintered by solid reaction sintering have large porosity. If reaction sintering is followed by re sintering or hot pressing sintering, the efficiency of spare filling can be further improved, porosity can be reduced, and the performance of materials can be improved. On the one hand, solid reaction sintering can be used to prepare composite materials with higher melting point in matrix and difficult sintering at lower temperatures, on the other hand, it is suitable for preparing complex shapes Ceramic matrix composite parts with high dimensional accuracy requirements.

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料料浆浸渍热压工艺
name_en: slurry maceration hot-press process of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 将纤维置于制备好的陶瓷粉体浆料里，使纤维黏附一层浆料，然后将其排布成一定结构的坯体?经干燥、排胶，热压烧结获得产品。为了使浆料能黏附于增强体表面，要求粉体悬浮于浆料中与增强体表面能很好地润湿。增强体要求易分散（对一束纤维来说捻度低）、表面清洁。制备连续纤维增强陶瓷基复合材料的主要设备是绕丝机，纤维从卷筒放出，浸人盛放浆料的容器，然后将黏附浆料的纤维引到绕丝机的卷杆上，开动绕丝机进行缠绕。纤维的缠绕走向按需要可垂直于卷杆，与卷杆成某一角度（S形），还可以缠绕几层以后铺一层与卷杆平行浸过浆料的纤维，交错进行。缠绕时需调节绕丝机的转速，使纤维与基体有恰当的比例，如有必要还可多次浸渍。该工艺较广泛地用于玻璃陶瓷基复合材料（如碳纤维增强石英、碳化硅纤维增强玻璃陶瓷等）的制造。
explanation_en: Place the fibers in the prepared ceramic powder slurry, make the fibers adhere to a layer of slurry, and then arrange them into a structured body? The product is obtained by drying, rubber discharging and hot pressing sintering. In order to make the slurry adhere to the surface of reinforcement, the powder should be suspended in the slurry and well wetted with the surface energy of reinforcement. Reinforcement requires easy dispersion (low twist for a bundle of fibers) and clean surface. The main equipment for the preparation of continuous fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite is the winding machine. The fibers are discharged from the drum, dipped into the container containing the slurry, and then the fibers adhering to the slurry are led to the winding rod of the winding machine, and the winding machine is started for winding. The winding direction of the fibers can be perpendicular to the winding rod and at a certain angle (S-shaped) with the winding rod as needed. After winding several layers, a layer of fibers soaked in slurry parallel to the winding rod can be laid and staggered. When winding, it is necessary to adjust the rotating speed of the winding machine so that the fiber has an appropriate proportion to the matrix. If necessary, it can also be dipped several times. This process is widely used in the manufacture of glass-ceramics matrix composite materials (such as carbon fiber reinforced quartze, silicon carbide fiber reinforced glass-ceramics, etc.).

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料无压烧结工艺
name_en: pressureless sintering process of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 将具有一定形状的陶瓷素坯在高温但没有外加驱动力情况下经过一系列物理化学过程变为体积稳定、具有一定性能的致密体的过程。此过程主要靠系统本身自由能变化.即粉末表面积减少，表面能下降来实现。由于第二相（粒子、晶须、纤维等）的存在，陶瓷基复合材料的无压烧结比单相陶瓷的无压烧结要困难得多，因此常采用添加少量烧结助剂来提高其致密度。无压烧结陶瓷基复合材料工艺和设备简单，成本低，并且易于制备复杂形状制品和批量生产。但其致密度、性能较热压、热等静压等工艺制得的材料低。
explanation_en: The process of transforming a ceramics green body with a certain shape into a compact body with stable volume and certain performance through a series of physical chemistry processes at high temperature without external driving force. This process is mainly realized by the change of free energy of the system itself, that is, the reduction of powder surface area and surface energy. Due to the existence of the second phase (particles, crystal whisker, fibers, etc.), pressureless sintering of ceramic matrix composite is much more difficult than pressureless sintering of single-phase ceramics, so a small amount of sintering additive are often added to improve its efficiency of spare filling. Pressureless sintering of ceramic matrix composite is simple in technology and equipment, low in cost, and easy to prepare complex shaped products and mass production. However, its efficiency of spare filling and properties are lower than those of materials made by hot pressing, hot isostatic pressing and other processes.

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料溶胶凝胶工艺
name_en: sol-gel process of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 将含有多种组分的溶液，通过物理或化学的方法，使分子或离子成核制成溶胶，然后经凝胶化处理，获得多组分复合相的凝胶体，再经烧结而获得所需组分的陶瓷基复合材料。该法制备陶瓷基复合材料需选择合适的前驱反应物、分散剂、胶溶剂.控制溶液的浓度、pH值，特别是控制凝胶体中溶剂的蒸发速度。溶胶凝胶法不仅使各组分能高纯、超细、均相地分子级或包裹式复合，而且所得陶瓷材料性能良好，可广泛地应用于颗粒每质相、颗粒-纤维-基质相等陶瓷基复合材料的制备，缺点是工艺过程比较复杂》
explanation_en: The solution containing a variety of components is nucleated by molecules or ions to make sol through physical or chemical methods, and then gelatinized to obtain the gel of multi-component composite phase, and then sintering to obtain the required component of ceramic matrix composite. The preparation of ceramic matrix composite by this method requires the selection of appropriate precursor reactants, dispersing agent, and glue solvents, and the control of the concentration and pH value of the solution, especially the control of the evaporation rate of the solvent in the gel. Sol-gel method not only enables each component to be high-purity, ultra-fine, phase molecular grade or wrapped composition, but also the ceramics materials obtained has good performance, which can be widely used in the preparation of ceramic matrix composite with particles of each phase, particles fiber matrix phase. The disadvantage is that the process is more complex

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料热压烧结
name_en: hot-press sintering of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 使用热压炉同时加热加压使松散的或成型的陶瓷基复合材料混合物致密化工艺。热压模具材料对结构陶瓷主要用高强石墨，对功能陶瓷则主要用氮化硅、碳化硅陶瓷或高温合金等。与无压烧结相比，热压烧结能降低烧结温度，缩短保温时间，使基体的晶粒较细；能获得接近理论密度的高性能陶瓷基复合材料；材料性能的重复性好，使用吋靠。其缺点是只能制造形状简单的零件；模具消耗大，一次只能单件或少件烧结，成本较高；材料性能有方向性，特别是用纤维或晶须作增强体的复合材料更明显。
explanation_en: The process of densification of loose or formed ceramic matrix composite mixture by heating and pressurizing in a hot pressing furnace at the same time. Hot pressing die materials mainly uses high-strength graphite for structural ceramics, and silicon nitride, silicon carbide ceramics or high temperature alloy for functional ceramics. Compared with pressureless sintering, hot pressing sintering can reduce the sintering temperature, shorten the holding time, and make the grains of matrix finer; High performance ceramics matrix composite materials with theoretical density can be obtained; The performance of materials is repeatable and reliable in use. Its disadvantage is that it can only manufacture parts with simple shapes; Die consumption is high, only one or a few pieces can be sintering at a time, and the cost is high; Materials properties have directionality, especially for composite materials with fibers or crystal whisker as reinforcement.

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料热等静压烧结工艺
name_en: hot isostatic pressing of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 通过气体介质将高温和高压同时均匀地作用于陶瓷基复合材料表面，使之固结。此工艺获得的陶瓷基复合材料可基本上消除内部气孔，接近理论密度.因而大大改善了制品的性能。此工艺有包封烧结和无包封烧结两种。包封烧结一般以石英玻璃或硼玻璃为包封材料.也可以用耐高温金属包封，包封之前先抽真空加热，排除内部空气及成型黏结剂，再升温加压，软化的玻璃包套会填充坯件周围空隙，传递压力。无包封烧结是指先将粉料成型和预烧封孔，使坯体成为基本无开口气孔的烧结体，然后再实施热等静压烧结。由于第二相(粒子、晶须、纤维等）的存在，特别是晶须的交联作用，阻碍了陶瓷基复合材料致密化过程，并且晶须、纤维在高温下比基体有更强烈的分解趋势，要求烧结在尽可能低的温度下进行。热等静压主要以均匀外加压力，而不是自由能变化为烧结驱动力，可以在较低烧结温度，使用少量添加剂甚至不使用添加剂的条件下获得致密材料，从而防止了第二相（主要是晶须和纤维）的分解及与基体或烧结助剂发生反应，因而能制备性能优良的陶瓷基复合材料。陶瓷基复合材料热等静压烧结与无压烧结相比，致密化速度和程度大大提高，材料性能更好。与热压烧结相比，由于热等静压是均匀地将压力作用于材料各个表面，因而材料各向同性，且韦伯模数要高得多。此工艺可以生产形状复杂、尺寸精密、性能优良的产品，是一种受到广泛关注的新的烧结工艺。但其设备制造困难，成本较高。
explanation_en: High temperature and high pressure are uniformly applied to the surface of ceramic matrix composite through gas medium to make it consolidated. The ceramic matrix composite obtained by this process can basically eliminate the internal pores and approach the theoretical density, thus greatly improving the properties of the products. This process can be divided into enveloped sintering and non enveloped sintering. Encapsulation sintering generally uses quzrtz glass or boron glass as encapsulation materials. It can also be encapsulated with high temperature resistant metal. Before encapsulation, vacuum heating is carried out to remove internal air and form adhesive, and then heating and pressurizing is carried out. bating glass can will fill the gap around the blank and transfer pressure. Non enveloping sintering means that the powder is formed and the presintering is sealed to make the green body become a sintering body with basically no open pores, and then the hot isostatic pressing sintering is carried out. The existence of the second phase (particles, crystal whisker, fibers, etc.), especially the crosslinking effect of crystal whisker, has hindered the densification process of ceramic matrix composite, and crystal whisker and fibers have a stronger decomposition trend than the matrix at high temperatures. sintering is required to be carried out at the lowest possible temperature. Hot isostatic pressing mainly uses uniform external pressure rather than free energy change as driving force of sintering, which can obtain dense materials at lower sintering temperature with a small amount of additive or even without additive, thus preventing the second phase (mainly crystal whisker and fibers) from dissociating and reacting with matrix or sintering additive, so it can prepare ceramic matrix composite with excellent performance. Compared with pressureless sintering, the hot isostatic pressing sintering of ceramic matrix composite greatly improves the speed and degree of densification, and the materials has better properties. Compared with hot pressing sintering, the hot isostatic pressing (HIP) uniformly applies the pressure on each surface of materials, so the materials is isotropic, and the Weber modulus is much higher. This process can produce products with complex shape, precise size and excellent performance. It is a new sintering process that has attracted wide attention. But its equipment manufacturing is difficult and the cost is high.

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料自蔓燃高温合成
name_en: self- propagating high temperature synthesis of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 具有较大生成热的化合物材料，其合成时均可在点火I后激烈反应放出热量以燃烧波形式蔓延完成，称为自蔓燃高温合成（SHS)。燃烧合成反应产生高温燃烧波的同时?把外加应力施加于燃烧合成（加热）的陶瓷粉末（或粉末-陶瓷纤维）。可使粉末合成和致密化两个步骤合为一步进行，具有快速和节能的特点。目前.用该方法已可制造碳化物基、氮化物基、硼化物基、硅化物基等复合材料达数百种，还可用来实现金!属基体表面涂覆陶瓷、两种材料之间焊接、梯度功能I材料的制备等。
explanation_en: The synthesis of compound materials with large heat of formation can be completed in the form of combustion wave after ignition I, which is called self propagating high-temperature synthesis (SHS). When combustion synthesis reaction produces high temperature combustion wave? The applied stress is applied to ceramics powder (or powder ceramics fiber) produced by combustion synthesis (heating). The two steps of powder synthesis and densification can be combined into one step, which is characterized by rapidity and energy saving. At present, hundreds of composite materials such as carbide based, nitride based, boride based, silicide based, etc. can be made by this method, which can also be used for cash! It belongs to coating ceramics on the surface of matrix, weld between two materials, preparation of functionally gradient I materials, etc.

name_cn: 陶瓷基复合材料高聚物先驱体热解工艺
name_en: polymer procusor thermolysis process of ceramic matrix composite
explanation_cn: 通过对含有所需陶瓷组分的高聚物先驱体进行热解.直接获取块体状陶瓷材料的方法。具有烧成温度低、成型容易、工艺重复性高等优点。常用来制备纤维增强陶瓷基复合材料：先将纤维编织成所需形状，然后浸渍高聚物先驱体、热解、再浸渍、热解......如此循环。另外也可用高聚物先驱体与陶瓷粉体直接混合.模压成型，再进行热解获得所需材料。通过混料时加人金属粉，高温热解时，金属粉反应生成碳化物或氧化物，成为复相陶瓷的一相，同时体积膨胀.解决了高聚物先驱体热解时收缩大、气孔率高的问题，具有较好应用前景。
explanation_en: A method for directly obtaining bulk ceramics materials by pyrolysis of polymer precursors containing the required ceramics components. It has the advantages of low firing temperature, easy molding, and high process repeatability. Commonly used to prepare fiber reinforced ceramic matrix composite: first weave the fiber into the desired shape, then impregnate the polymer precursor, pyrolysis, re impregnation, pyrolysis This cycle. In addition, the required materials can also be obtained by directly mixing the polymer precursor and ceramic powder, press molding and pyrolysis. By adding metal powder during mixing, the metal powder reacts to generate carbide or oxide during high-temperature pyrolysis, and becomes a phase of the composite phase ceramics. At the same time, the volume expands. This solves the problems of large shrinkage and high porosity during pyrolysis of polymer precursors, and has good application prospects.

explanation_cn: 氧化铝为陶瓷封装最常用的材料，其他的陶瓷封装材料有氮化铝、碳化硅、玻璃与玻璃陶瓷、蓝宝石等。具有以下特点：气密性好，封装体的可靠性高；优良的电性能，具有对复杂器件进行一体化封装的能力；导热性能好.化学性能稳定；多层布线.具有最高的布线密度；吋以达到100层高导热率.适合于需要散热能力强的器件。
explanation_en: Alumina is the most commonly used materials for ceramics packaging. Other ceramic packaging materials include aluminum nitride, silicon carbide, glass and glass-ceramics, sapphire, etc. It has the following characteristics: good airtightness, high reliability of the packaging body; Excellent electrical performance, with the ability to integrate and package complex devices; Good thermal conductivity and stable chemical properties; Multilayer wiring with the highest wiring density; Up to 100 layers of high thermal conductivity, suitable for devices that require strong heat dissipation.

explanation_cn: 一般足指借助于各种显微分析仪器所观察到的材料的内部组织结构。主要包括物相种类、组成及数量；物相的形状、大小、分布、取向关系及内部微细结构和缺陷：晶界结构及缺陷。陶瓷材料通常为多晶多相显微结构.物相种类包括结晶相、玻璃相和气相三大类。结晶相有同质多构和异质多构现象。结晶相内部微细结构和缺陷包括解理、滑移、孪晶、位错、畴结构、裂纹、包裹杂质及析出相等。显微结构取决于所采用的原料、制造工艺、相平衡关系以及相变动力学等。显微结构也直接影响材料的各种性能。通常采用的分析仪器包括各种光学显微镜，附有成分分析的扫描电子显微镜和透射电子显微镜.以及X射线衍射仪等,，
explanation_en: Generally, it refers to the internal organizational structure of materials observed with the help of various microscopic analysis instruments. It mainly includes species, composition and quantity of phase; The shape, size, distribution, orientation relationship, internal microstructure and defects of the phase: grain boundary structure and defects. Ceramics materials usually have polycrystal phase microstructure. The phase types include crystalline phase, glass phase and gas phase. The crystalline phase exhibits both homogeneous and heterogeneous polymorphisms. The microstructure and defects in the crystalline phase include cleavage, slip, twin, dislocation, domain structure, crack, inclusion of impurities and precipitation. The microstructure depends on the raw materials used, manufacturing process, phase equilibrium relationship and phase transformation kinetics. Microstructure also directly affects the various properties of materials. The commonly used analytical instruments include various optical microscopes, scanning electron microscopes with component analysis, transmission electron microscopes, and X-ray diffractometers,,

explanation_cn: 将聚合物注射成型方法与陶瓷制备工艺相结合而发展起来的一种制备陶瓷零部件的新工艺。①将粉末与有机黏结剂混合后，加热混练，压制成粒状粉料用注射成型机在130-300°C温度下注射人金属模内。冷却后黏结剂固化，取出毛坯，经脱脂就可以按常规工艺烧结。这种成型工艺简单，成本低.压坏密度均匀，适用于复杂零件的自动化大规模生产。②即注塑。也为制造短切纤维复合材料制品的成型方法。所用设备为注射机.浸渍树脂的短切纤维由加料漏斗定量加料，柱塞旋转将料推进加热室塑化，再推动柱塞用较高压力将其注人模腔.在模内以更高温度固化成型。材料在加料室要经充分塑化以得到较好流动性。塑化过程可能使树脂轻度固化.故应严格控制温度和时间；锁模力应保证注射过程模具的闭合。主要工艺参数为塑化温度和时间.注射压力、锁模力、固化温度和时间。如果是热塑性复合材料.制件在模具内冷却定型。该方法具有制件尺寸精确、生产效率高、适于大批量生产的特点，主要用于小型电气零件如航空电动机、仪表的绝缘件的生产。不适于大型的高承载结构件的生产。
explanation_en: A new process for preparing ceramics parts is developed by combining the polymer injection molding method with the ceramics preparation process. ① After mixing powder and organic adhesive, heating and mixing, pressing granulated powder is injected into the metal mold with an injection molding machine at 130-300 ° C. After cooling, the adhesive is curing, and the blank is taken out. After degreasing, it can be sintering according to the conventional process. This forming process is simple, low cost and uniform crushing density, which is suitable for automatic mass production of complex parts. ② Namely injection molding. It is also a forming method for manufacturing chopped fiber composite materials products. The equipment used is an injection machine. The chopped fiber impregnated with resin is fed quantitatively by the feeding funnel. The plunger rotates to push the material into the heating chamber for plasticization, and then pushes the plunger to inject it into the mold cavity with higher pressure. It is molded at a higher temperature in the mold. Materials shall be fully plasticized in the feeding room to obtain better flow ability. The plasticizing process may cause mild curing of resin, so the temperature and time should be strictly controlled; The locking force should ensure the closure of the mold during the injection process. The main process parameters are plasticizing temperature and time, injection pressure, clamping force, curing temperature and time. If it is thermoplastic resin matrix composite, the parts shall be cooled and shaped in the mold. This method has the characteristics of precise product size, high production efficiency, and is suitable for mass production. It is mainly used for the production of small electrical components such as insulation parts for aviation motors and instruments. Not suitable for the production of large high load-bearing structural components.

explanation_cn: 陶瓷电容器的用量占整个电容器的40%左右，相当于铝电解和钽电解电容器的总和。作为陶瓷电容器的介质称为"介电陶瓷"，其特点有四个：①介电常数值高且变化范围大。②串联电感小，介质损耗低，在相当高的频段仍具有优越的电容特性。当前电子技术向着高频、微波方向发展，通信卫星工作频率在10GHz以上，只有陶瓷电容器才能在1GHz以上的频率有效地工作，在微波通信中采用陶瓷电容器可使设备微小型化。③陶瓷电介质及高稳定导电电极Ag、PuPcJ等均经过高温烧结，具有高强度结构和高可靠性，耐高工作温度。本身不仅作为电介质，同时作为基体和支撑结构。④具有高电阻率，高耐电强度。
explanation_en: The consumption of ceramics capacitors accounts for about 40% of the total capacitors, which is equivalent to the sum of aluminum electrolytic capacitors and tantalum electrolytic capacitors. The dielectric used as ceramics capacitor is called "dielectric ceramics", which has four characteristics: ① high dielectric constant and large variation range. ② The series inductance is small, the dielectric loss is low, and it still has superior capacitance characteristics in a relatively high frequency band. At present, electronic technology is developing in the direction of high frequency and microwave. The working frequency of communication satellites is above 10GHz, and only ceramics capacitors can work effectively at a frequency above 1GHz. The use of ceramics capacitors in microwave communication can make equipment miniaturized. ③ Ceramics dielectric and highly stable conductive electrode Ag, PuPcJ, etc. are all sintering at high temperature, with high strength structure, high reliability and high working temperature resistance. It is not only a dielectric, but also a matrix and supporting structure. ④ It has high resistivity and high electrical strength.

name_en: electric discharge spark machining of ceramics
explanation_cn: 又称放电加工。利用工具电极和陶瓷材料或构件电极间脉冲放电时在局域形成的瞬时高温.将其微小区域内的物质熔化和汽化从而实现的一种机械加T.方法。陶瓷材料的电火花加工性能取决于其电学和热学性质，而与力学性能关系不大》
explanation_en: Also called discharge machining. It is a mechanical heating method that uses the instantaneous high temperature formed locally during the pulse discharge between the tool electrode and ceramics materials or component electrode to melt and vaporize the material in its small area. The electrical discharge machining performance of ceramics materials depends on their electrical and thermal properties, but has little to do with their mechanical properties

explanation_cn: 陶瓷材料常用的一种机械加工方式，采用硬度更高的磨具，如金刚石砂轮，对陶瓷构件进行机械加丁.的一种方式。
explanation_en: It is a common machining method for ceramics materials. It is a way to machine ceramics components by using abrasives with higher hardness, such as diamond grinding wheels.

name_cn: 陶瓷粉体机械制备方法
name_en: ceramic powder preparation by mechanical method
explanation_cn: 通过机械手段将用来制备陶瓷材料的固体块状原料粉碎成具有一定细度和4烧结的粉体的方法。首先把块状物质用颚式破碎机、轧滚机等捶缶、碰撞成粒状颗粒.然后再通过球磨、气流粉碎、砂磨和离心冲击等方式变成具有一定细度的粉末。球磨是把原料和球磨弹子按一定的球料比放人球磨罐中（有时加人一定的介质），通过球磨弹子在球磨罐中对原料进行不断地碰撞和打击.破碎颗粒或打碎团聚体.使其达到陶瓷粉体的要求。气流粉碎是用高压气流不断地快速冲击原料，对大颗粒原料进行撕裂和分割，使其变成细颗粒的陶瓷粉体。球磨一般需要很长时间.且会引进杂质.但方法简便，对进料没有具体要求，是广泛采用的方法。气流粉碎对进料有一定的细度要求，得到的粉体分布范围窄。由于进料较细.气流粉碎一般进行得很快。除了以上两种主要的方法，还有离心冲击、分级筛.以及撞击或粉碎和用砂磨机磨细等方法.都可用来制备陶瓷粉体。
explanation_en: The method of mechanically crushing the solid block raw materials used to prepare ceramics materials into powder with certain fineness and 4 sintering. First, the massive materials are crushed into granular particles by jaw crusher, roller mill, etc. Then, they are transformed into powder with certain fineness by ball milling, airflow crushing, sanding and centrifugal impact. Ball milling is the process of placing raw materials and ball milled marbles in a ball milling tank (sometimes with a certain medium added) at a certain ratio of ball to material. The ball milled marbles continuously collide and strike the raw materials in the tank, crushing particles or aggregates to meet the requirements of ceramic powder. Air flow pulverization is the process of rapidly impacting raw materials with high-pressure air flow, tearing and dividing large particles of raw materials into fine ceramic powders. Ball milling generally takes a long time and introduces impurities. However, the method is simple and has no specific requirements for feeding, and is widely used. Air flow pulverization requires a certain degree of fineness in the feed, resulting in a narrow range of powder distribution. Due to the finer feed, the airflow pulverization generally proceeds very quickly. In addition to the two main methods mentioned above, there are also methods such as centrifugal impact, grading screen, and impact or crushing, as well as grinding with a sand mill, which can be used to prepare ceramic powders.

explanation_cn: 构成陶瓷膜塑湿敏电阻器的感湿材料。这类感湿粉料通常是Cr2ü3、Al2()3、Sb2()3、Ti〇2、Sn02,或是这些粉料的混合体再添加一些碱金属氧化物以提高其湿敏特性。其中比较典型且性能较好的是Fe3ü4粉料。为保证粉料的纯度和化学计量比，常采用化学共沉淀法制备，如Fe:i()4,其主要原料为FeCl2?4H2ü和FeCl3.6H2()，加Na()H热解发生沉积，通过水洗、过滤，可制得纯净的黑色的胶粒，外形为无定型凝胶状，平均粒径约为20mm。由这类材料制作的测湿元件体积小、结构简单、工艺方便、价廉、长寿，适用于精度要求不高、测湿范围广、工作温度不高、无油气及其他污染的场合。主要缺点是响应速度较慢、阻值变化范围过大、不能通过高温去除污染以恢复性能。
explanation_en: A humidity sensing materials constituting a ceramic film plastic humidity sensitive resistor. This type of moisture sensitive powder is usually Cr2 ü 3, Al2 () 3, Sb2 () 3, Ti02, Sn02, or a mixture of these powders with some alkali metal oxides added to improve their moisture sensitive properties. One of the most typical and high-performance materials is Fe3 ü 4 powder. In order to ensure the purity and stoichiometric ratio of the powder, chemical coprecipitation method is often used, such as Fe: i() 4, whose main raw material is FeCl2? 4H2 ü and FeCl3.6H2() are pyrolyzed and deposited with NaH. Through water washing and filtration, pure black colloidal particles can be obtained, which are amorphous gel shaped, with an average particle size of about 20mm. The humidity measuring element made of this kind of materials has small volume, simple structure, convenient process, low price and long service life. It is suitable for occasions with low precision requirements, wide humidity measuring range, low operating temperature, no oil, gas and other pollution. The main drawbacks are slow response speed, large range of resistance changes, and inability to remove pollution through high temperature to restore performance.

explanation_cn: 习惯称为高岭土或高岭石黏土。是专门用于烧制陶瓷的黏土。矿物成分主要是高岭石。呈白色，含杂质时可呈灰白色、灰色、灰黄、黄褐、灰绿和灰黑色等。土状或致密块状，硬度在1-2.5,手触摸时有明显的滑腻感.密度2.2-2.6g/Cm3,干燥时用舌舔之有黏舌感。有强吸水性，但不膨胀，压碎成粉掺水后具可塑性、绝缘性和较高的耐火度。其化学性质比较稳定，耐酸性也较好。化学成分是评价高岭土质量的重要因素.Al2()3含量越高，耐火度越高，制品的坚罔性也越好。杂质多时会严重影响高岭土质量.，主要分布在东南沿海地区，四川南部、贵州北部、云南西部、湖北中部等地也有风化型高岭土矿床是主要矿床类型.沉积型次之.热液型高岭土矿床规模较小中闰著名瓷都景德镇的高岭土矿床属于风化残积型矿床。高岭土除用作陶瓷原料外.也是造纸、橡胶、塑料的填料。在医药中，高岭土称为白石脂.性平，治黄疽、泻痢和邪气痈肿等。
explanation_en: It is customarily called kaolin or kaolinite clay. It is clay specially used for firing ceramics. The mineral composition is mainly kadinite. It is white and can appear gray white, gray, gray yellow, yellow brown, gray green, and gray black when containing impurities. It is earthy or dense block, with a hardness of 1-2.5. It has a clear sense of smoothness when touched by hand. Its density is 2.2-2.6g/Cm3, and it feels sticky when licked with tongue when dry. It has strong water absorption, but does not expand. After being crushed into powder and mixed with water, it has plasticity, insulation and high refractoriness. Its chemical properties are relatively stable and its acid resistance is also good. Chemical composition is an important factor to evaluate the quality of kaolin. The higher the content of Al2 () 3, the higher the refractoriness, and the better the hardness of the product. Many impurities will seriously affect the quality of kaolin, Mainly distributed in the southeastern coastal areas, there are also weathering type kaolin deposits in southern Sichuan, northern Guizhou, western Yunnan, central Hubei, and other places. Sedimentary type is the main type of deposit, followed by hydrothermal type kaolin deposits. The kaolin deposit in Jingdezhen, a famous porcelain capital in China, is a weathering residual type deposit. In addition to being used as raw material for ceramics, kaolin is also a filler for paper making, rubber and plastics. In medicine, kaolin is called Baishizhi. It has a flat nature, and can cure jaundice, diarrhea, and pathogenic carbuncle.

explanation_cn: 轻骨料混凝土的一种。以人造轻骨料陶粒为粗骨料，以普通砂或轻砂为细骨料制成的混凝土材料。具有质量轻、保温性能好、抗渗性好、耐火性好、施工适应性强等特点。可用于房屋逮筑、桥梁、船及窑炉基础等。
explanation_en: A kind of light aggregate concrete. Concrete materials is made of artificial light aggregate ceramsite as coarse aggregate and ordinary sand or light sand as fine aggregate. It has the characteristics of light weight, good insulation performance, good impermeability, good fire resistance, and strong construction adaptability. It can be used for building houses, bridges, ships, and kiln foundations.

explanation_cn: 一类适宜烧制陶粒的沉积岩或浅变质岩的总称。包括页岩、泥岩、泥板岩和千枚岩等。它们的显著特点是锻烧时易产生熔体，且能释放较多的气体。一般颜色较深。以炭质页岩和深色页岩居多。化学成分较为复杂，变化范围较大。对这类岩石的技术性能要求主要是有足够的膨胀性，而对化学成分的要求不严格。影响膨胀的因素是多方面的.但主要的因素是CO2和结晶水的含量，两者愈高，膨胀性能就愈好。对粒度的要求是小于0.05mm的粒级应大于85%。
explanation_en: A general term for a class of sedimentary rock or low-grade metamorphic rock suitable for firing ceramsite. Including shale, mud rock, mud slate, phyllite, etc. Their notable feature is that they are prone to producing molten materials during forging and can release a large amount of gas. Generally, the color is darker. Carbonaceous shale and dark shale predominate. The chemical composition is relatively complex and varies widely. The technical performance of such rock is mainly required to have sufficient expansibility, while the requirements for chemical composition are not strict. There are various factors that affect expansion, but the main factors are the content of CO2 and crystalline water. The higher the two, the better the expansion performance. The requirement for particle size is that a particle size smaller than 0.05mm should be greater than 85%.

explanation_cn: 一种适宜烧制陶粒的黏土。对陶粒黏土的技术要求主要是：①有良好的膨胀性能，烧制后能形成封闭式多孔结构；②烧制温度不宜太高，最高不超过1300°C,且在1050-1200°C范II内具有良好的膨胀性.膨胀率>2;烧制过程应有较大的软化温度范围;③颗粒愈细愈好，化学成分要求不严格。主要用于烧制陶粒。
explanation_en: A clay suitable for firing ceramsite. The technical requirements for haydite day are: ① it has good expansion performance and can form a closed porous structure after firing; ② The firing temperature should not be too high, and the maximum should not exceed 1300 ° C, and it should have good expansibility within the range of 1050-1200 ° C range II. The expansion rate should be>2; The firing process should have a large range of bating temperature; ③ The finer the particle, the better, and the chemical composition requirements are not strict. Mainly used for firing ceramic particles.

explanation_cn: 应用概率函数描述研究对象的不确定性，对概率函数任意抽样，产生一系列样本，对大量样本的模拟情景进行归纳获得某种规律的模拟方法。
explanation_en: A simulation method that uses probability functions to describe the uncertainty of the research object, randomly sampling the probability function to generate a series of samples, and inducing a large number of simulated scenarios to obtain a certain pattern.

explanation_cn: 将能穿透材料的特定波长的激光束，通过透镜组聚焦材料内部点上，在工件内部材料形成变质层，通过扩膜分割晶粒的切割法。这种方式在焦点附近的定位范围内形成机械损伤层(应力层），实现了材料的"内部"切割。
explanation_en: The laser beam that can penetrate the specific wavelength of materials is focused on the internal point of materials through the lens group, and a metamorphic layer is formed on the internal materials of the workpiece, and the cutting method of separating the grains by expanding the film. In this way, a mechanical damage layer (stress layer) is formed in the positioning range near the focus, which realizes the "internal" cutting of materials.

explanation_cn: 一种玻璃质结构向显晶质结构过渡的结构。矿物颗粒很细（大多<0.1mm),肉眼无法分辨出矿物颗粒，在偏光显微镜下也难于分辨，但有光性反映。具有的岩石被称为隐晶岩。火山熔岩常具有这种结构。
explanation_en: A transition structure from glassy structure to phaneritic texture. Mineral particles are very fine (mostly<0.1mm), which can not be distinguished by the naked eye, and it is also difficult to distinguish under polarized light microscopy, but there is light reflection. The rock with is called cryptocrystalline rock. Volcanic lava often exhibits this structure.

explanation_cn: 又称伪装材料，用于减弱武器系统特征信号，达到隐身技术要求的特殊功能材料。根据针对的特征信号类别，隐身功能不同，分为雷达、红外、可见光隐身材料、紫外、激光、声纳隐身材料、多功能。应用方式有两种：将固定覆盖在武器系统结构上的，称为隐身涂层;做成活动式的伪装网或伪装罩，或将结构材料做成兼有隐身和承载双功能的材料，称为结构隐身材料。从材质上看，仅在早期用过单一材质的隐身材料，现用均是多种材质复合和多相结构的。深人研究微观结构对于隐身功能特性的影响，是隐身材料发展的重要特点。隐身技术主要是通过武器系统的结构设计改进和采用来减弱特征信号的。结构设计的改进常常会造成其他性能的恶化。使结构设计隐身的作用受到了一定限制，需要与其互补。在整个隐身技术中占有十分重要的地位。
explanation_en: Also known as camouflage material, it is a special functional materials used to weaken the characteristic signal of weapon system and meet the requirements of stealth technology. According to the type of characteristic signal, stealth functions are different, including radar, infrared, visible stealth materials, ultraviolet, laser, sonar stealth materials, and multi-function. There are two methods of application: fixed covering on the weapon system structure is called stealth coating; It is called structural stealth materials to make a movable camouflage net or camouflage cover, or to make structural materials into materials with both stealth and carrying functions. From the material point of view, stealth materials that only used a single material in the early days are now composition and multiphase structures of multiple materials. It is an important feature of the development of stealth materials to study the influence of microstructure on stealth functional characteristics. Stealth technology mainly weakens feature signals by improving and adopting the structural design of weapon systems. Improvements in structural design often lead to deterioration of other performance. The role of stealth in structural design is somewhat limited and needs to be complemented. It occupies a very important position in the entire stealth technology.

explanation_cn: 能使被涂目标与它所处背景有尽可能接近的反射、透过、吸收电磁波或声波特性的一类涂层。多数采用涂料涂覆工艺施工。涂料由黏结剂、填料、改性剂和稀释剂组成。填料是调节与电磁波或声波相互作用特性参数性粉末状原料，视不同的隐身对象而要求不同的特性参数：①为对抗紫外照相机摄影，要求涂层具有相应高的紫外反射率;②近红外侦察，要求涂层具有与其背景尽可能一致的近红外光谱反射率。并且还常将数种涂料按特定的图案涂布在同一目标上，实施变形迷彩，以扭曲标形象，提高隐身效果;③为提高热红外隐身效果，一般采用低发射率涂层，或结合隔热涂层等措施，以降低目标发射热红外辐射的强度，使之与其背景相适应;④为与雷达探测技术抗衡，要求涂层对雷达波有极高的吸收率。使用较多的方法之一是在涂料中引人易将雷达波能量转化为热能或其他能的填料方法之二是控制涂层厚度通过涂层表面层的反射波与底层反射波干涉相消原理实现隐身;⑤对吸声涂层，要求涂层尽可能减少目标对声呐冲击波的反射，隐身涂层主要用于军事伪装，并在向一种涂层具有两种以上隐身功能的多功能隐身涂层的方向发展。在高层建筑、微波炉等民用领域也可有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: A type of coating that allows the target to reflect, transmit, and absorb electromagnetic or acoustic waves as closely as possible to its background. Most of them are applied with coatings coating process. Coatings is composed of adhesive, filler, modifier and diluents. Filler is a kind of parametric powder raw material to adjust the interaction characteristics with electromagnetic wave or acoustic wave, and different characteristic parameters are required according to different stealth objects: ① in order to resist ultraviolet camera photography, the coating is required to have a corresponding high ultraviolet reflectance; ② Near infrared reconnaissance requires the coating to have near infrared spectroscopy reflectivity as consistent as possible with its background. In addition, several kinds of coatings are often coated on the same target according to specific patterns to implement deformation camouflage to distort the logo image and improve the stealth effect; ③ In order to improve the thermal infrared stealth effect, low emissivity coating or heat insulating coating is generally used to reduce the intensity of thermal infrared radiation emitted by the target and make it adapt to its background; ④ To compete with radar detection technology, coatings are required to have a high absorption rate of radar waves. One of the most frequently used methods is to introduce fillers in coatings that are easy to convert radar wave energy into heat energy or other energy. The second method is to control the coating thickness to achieve stealth through the interference cancellation principle of the reflection wave of the coating surface layer and the reflection wave of the bottom layer; ⑤ As for the sound absorption coating, it is required to reduce the reflection of the target on the sonar shock wave as much as possible. The stealth coating is mainly used for military camouflage and is developing towards a multi-functional stealth coating with more than two stealth functions. It can also have broad application prospects in civil fields such as high-rise buildings and microwave ovens.

explanation_cn: 用材料或结构降低声的传输过程的复合材料。隔声是以隔声量来评价。测试时分别在声源室及接收室内测出平均声压级，再根据试样面积与接收室等效吸收面积计算出隔声量。工程上常釆用重质密实材料（如钢板、混凝土、玻璃等）或铺设吸声材料隔声，或采用中间为空气层的双层、多层结构改善隔声性能。
explanation_en: Composite materials that uses materials or structures to reduce the sound transmission process. Sound insulation is evaluated based on the amount of sound insulation. During the testing, the average sound pressure level is measured in the sound source room and the receiving room, and the sound insulation is calculated based on the sample area and the equivalent absorption area of the receiving room. In engineering, heavy dense materials (such as steel plate, concrete, glass, etc.) or sound absorbing materials are often used for sound insulation, or double-layer and multi-layer structures with air layer in the middle are used to improve the sound insulation performance.

explanation_cn: 简称隔声墙，又称声屏障或消声墙。是一种为减轻行车噪声对环境影响而设置在铁路或公路侧旁的墙式构造物。按照隔声结构可分为单层墙、双层墙和复合墙三大类。隔声墙材料主要用于高速公路、高架复合道路、城市轻轨地铁等交通市政设施中的隔声降噪、控制交通噪声对附近城市区域的影响，也可用于工厂和其他噪声源的隔声降噪。
explanation_en: It is also called sound barrier or anechoic wall for short. It is a wall structure installed on the side of a railway or highway to reduce the impact of driving noise on the environment. According to the sound insulation structure, it can be divided into single wall, double wall and composition wall. Sound insulation wall materials are mainly used for sound insulation and noise reduction in transportation municipal facilities such as expressways, elevated composition roads, urban light rail subways, etc., to control the impact of traffic noise on nearby urban areas, and can also be used for sound insulation and noise reduction of factories and other noise sources.

explanation_cn: 简称隔声屏，利用声波的反射和衍射来遮挡声源和接收者之间的直达声而在二者之间插入的结构或屏障。当声波的波长小于障碍物尺寸时，声波就被障碍物表面反射回声源且在隔声板后形成声影区，声影区中的噪声得到衰减。隔声屏材料广泛应用于分隔办公室、加工车间，作为道路和轨道交通噪声、室外空调热泵机组、冷却塔、工厂设备固定声源、变电等的一种降噪技术措施。
explanation_en: Short for sound insulation screen, it is a structure or barrier inserted between the sound source and receiver by blocking the direct sound through the reflection and diffraction of sound waves. When the wavelength of the sound wave is smaller than the size of the obstacle, the sound wave is reflected back to the source by the surface of the obstacle and forms a sound shadow area behind the sound insulation board, and the noise in the sound shadow area is attenuated. Acoustic screen materials is widely used to separate offices and processing workshops as a noise reduction technical measure for road and rail transit noise, outdoor air conditioning heat pump units, cooling towers, fixed sound sources of factory equipment, power transformation, etc.

explanation_cn: 对声声起到一定屏蔽作用的玻璃及其制品。隔声玻璃按照制作工艺的不同，可分为以下三大类：中空玻璃、真空玻璃和夹层玻璃中空玻璃，是使用高强度高气密性复合黏结剂，将两片或两片以上玻璃与内含干燥剂的铝合金框黏结所制成的玻璃。
explanation_en: Glass and its products that play a certain role in shielding sound. Acoustic glass can be divided into the following three categories according to different manufacturing processes: insulating glass, vacuum glass and laminated glass insulating glass, which are glass made by bonding two or more pieces of glass with an aluminum alloy frame containing desiccant using a high-strength and air tight composition adhesive.

explanation_cn: 特点是热导率低。主要有两类：①高温隔热涂层，指在结构底材表面上采用等离子喷涂、火焰喷涂、熔烧或无机胶黏结等工艺制备的能起高温隔热作用的涂层，通常所用的原料为热导率低的耐高温氧化物，如Al2O3、ZrO2、TiO2等，以及其他耐火隔热材料，如空心小球、膨胀珍珠岩、泡沫熟料、石棉、钛酸钾纤维等。有时还用金属或高温无机纤维补强，广泛地运用于航空航天技术和其他高温隔热场合；②多层箔隔热涂层，加涂于金属箔或镀金属的薄膜上，用于组成多层超级隔热材料系统。涂层原料为Al2O3、ZrO2、TbO2、YO2等氧化物粒子。超级隔热材料系统中，金属表面起热反射屏作用，氧化物粒子起隔断热通路作用，因此这种超级隔热材料系统具有极低的真空热导率。使用温度范围可低至一270°C，高至1900°C广泛地用于空间技术和真空技术。
explanation_en: It is characterized by low thermal conductivity. There are two main types: ① High temperature heat insulating coating, which refers to the coating that can play the role of high temperature thermal insulation prepared by plasma spraying, flame spraying, melting or inorganic bonding processes on the surface of the structural substrate. The commonly used raw materials are high-temperature resistant oxides with low thermal conductivity, such as Al2O3, ZrO2, TiO2, and other fire-resistant thermal insulation materials, such as hollow spheres, expanded perlite, foam clinker, asbestos, potassium titanate fibers, etc. Sometimes metal or high-temperature inorganic fibers are used for reinforcement, widely used in aerospace technology and other high-temperature insulation applications; ② Multilayer foil heat insulating coating is applied to metal foil or metallized film to form a multi-layer super thermal insulation materials system. The coating raw materials are oxide particles such as Al2O3, ZrO2, TbO2, YO2, etc. In the super thermal insulation materials system, the metal surface acts as a heat reflection screen, and the oxide particles act as a barrier to the heat path. Therefore, this super thermal insulation materials system has an extremely low vacuum thermal conductivity. The temperature range can be as low as -270 ° C and as high as 1900 ° C, widely used in space technology and vacuum technology.

explanation_cn: 具有一定外形的、具有隔热保温作用的轻质耐火材料。体积密度小、热导率低。用于热工窑炉隔热层。
explanation_en: Light-weight refractory with certain shape and heat insulation function. Small bulk density and low thermal conductivity. Used for insulation layer of thermal kilns.

explanation_cn: 隔膜的主要作用是使电池的正、负极分隔开来，防止正负极接触导致短路，此外还具有能使电解质离子导通的功能。常用的隔膜材料有聚稀径多孔隔膜，如聚丙稀(polypropylene)和聚乙烯(polyethylene)多孔隔膜材料。隔膜的性能要求有：保证厚度的均匀性；在电池使用的温度范围内(-40-60°C)保持热稳定；孔隙率为40%左右；同时具有一定的抗拉伸强度和抗穿刺强度；有良好的润湿性和化学稳定性以及安全性。
explanation_en: The main function of the separator is to separate the positive and negative electrodes of the battery to prevent short circuit caused by the contact between the positive and negative electrodes. In addition, it also has the function of making the electrolyte ion conductive. Commonly used separator materials include polydilute porous separator, such as polypropylene and polyethylene porous separator materials. The performance requirements of separator include: ensuring the uniformity of thickness; Maintain thermal stability within the temperature range of battery use (-40-60 ° C); The porosity is about 40%; Simultaneously possessing certain tensile strength and puncture resistance; It has good wettability, chemical stability and safety.

explanation_cn: 见隔声材料。
explanation_en: See acoustic insulation materials.

explanation_cn: 指W、Mo、Ta、Nb、Zr等高熔点金属粉末。因熔点高，通常采用熔炼工艺制取，而多采用湿法冶金制成氧化物。这些金属粉末可以在氢气中还原得到金属粉末。多数粉末用作制取高熔点金属或合金的原料。钽、铌氧化物分离困难，因此纯度受到限制，还原后的金属钽粉和铌粉可成形、烧结和加工成材料。制备钽、铌粉末的方法包括使用金属还原剂（如钠、钙、镁），在抽空后充入惰性气体氩或氦的反应室内加热到700°C，借助于还原放热使还原反应持续进行，然后用水或酸洗处理还原产物，即可获得金属钽、铌粉末。钨的氧化物在氢气氛中600°C即可得到钨粉，900°C得到粗粒钨粉。钼粉的最终还原温度为1000~1100°C。这些难熔金属粉末中，钨粉用途最广泛，可用于制造烧结钨骨架、渗铜制品、高密度合金、钨合金丝、铈钨电极等，而碳化钨钴硬质合金是其中用途最广的应用之一。钼粉可烧结成各种合金制品，例如钼顶头、钼棒电极、钼坩埚等。
explanation_en: It refers to W, Mo, Ta, Nb, Zr and other high melting point metal powder. Because of the high melting point, it is usually made by melting process, and most oxides are made by hydrometallurgy. These metal powder can be reduced in hydrogen to obtain metal powder. Most powder are used as raw materials for making high melting point metals or alloy. It is difficult to separate tantalum and niobium oxides, so the purity is limited. The reduced metal tantalum powder and niobium powder can be formed, sintering and processed into materials.
