explanation_cn: 一类可转化为高分子量聚合物的低聚合度中间体，其分子量一般为几百到几千。通过端基或侧基的官能团反应，进行转化并与交联同时进行。按照中官能团的分布情况，可以将预聚物分成无规和结构两类。无规由于其中可反应的官能团无规分布，通过加热可进一步反应形成具有一定分子量的聚合物。属于这类反应的有碱催化线型酚醛、脲醛、醇酸等。结构具有特定的活性端基或侧基，在第二阶段反应时需加入催化剂或其他反应性物质，而本身一般不能进一步聚合或交联。结构的预聚阶段，交联阶段以及产品结构都容易控制。属于这类的有聚酯二元醇、聚醚二元醇，它们与二异氰酸酯反应可制得聚氨酯，其他如环氧、不饱和聚酯等。通过的进一步反应可制得各种热固性树脂，用于油漆、涂料、黏合剂、制造层压板材、泡沫材料等领域。具有耐热性、耐候性、耐水性、耐溶剂性及高硬度等性能。
explanation_en: A class of low degree of polymerization intermediates that can be converted into macromolecule weight polymer, and their molecular weights are generally hundreds to thousands. The conversion is carried out through the functional group reaction of the end group or the side group and is carried out simultaneously with the crosslinking. According to the distribution of intermediate functional groups, prepolymer can be divided into two categories: random and structural. Random Due to the random distribution of reactive functional groups, polymer with certain molecular weight can be further formed by heating. Belonging to this type of reaction are alkaline catalyzed linear phenolic aldehyde, urea formaldehyde, alkyd, etc. The structure has a specific active end group or side group, so it is necessary to add catalyst or other reactive substances in the second stage of reaction, and it is generally unable to further polymerization or crosslinking itself. The prepolymerization stage, crosslinking stage and product structure of the structure are easy to control. This category includes polyester diol and polyether diol, which can react with diisocyanate to produce polyurethane, and others such as epoxy, unsaturated polyester, etc. Through further reaction, various thermosetting resin can be prepared, which can be used in paint, coatings, adhesive, laminated plate manufacturing, foam materials and other fields. It has heat resistance, weather resistance, water resistance, solvent resistance, high hardness and other properties.

explanation_cn: 在马氏体相变点以上但距不远的温度下发生的具有马氏体特征的相变。
explanation_en: The phase transformation with martensitic characteristics occurs at the temperature above the martensitic phase transformation point but not far away.

explanation_cn: 又称人工须骨假体(artificialcranial graft)、顿骨板(cranial plate)。用于颅骨缺损治疗的医疗器件。形状多为弧形板状，对小尺寸圆形缺损孔也可用瓶塞形修复体。
explanation_en: It is also known as artificial fibrous prosthesis and bone plate. Medical devices for the treatment of skull defects. The shape is mostly arc-shaped plate, and bottle plug prosthesis can also be used for small round defect holes.

explanation_cn: 压电体的谐振频率与支配该频率的主振动方向的几何尺寸的乘积。它是一个常数。压电体的谐振频率不仅与材料性质有关，而且也与外形和尺寸有关，但频率常数却只与材料和振动模式有关。因此，压电振子由于材料和振动模式的不同，频率常数也有区别。频率常数本质上反映压电体基波谐振频率下材料的声波波速。它是确定某谐振频率下压电振子尺寸的重要参数。具体数值取决于材料组成及振动模式。
explanation_en: The product of the resonant frequency of a piezoelectric body and the geometric size of the main vibration direction that governs that frequency. It is a constant. The resonant frequency of piezoelectric body is not only related to the properties of materials, but also to the shape and size. However, the frequency constant is only related to materials and vibration mode. Therefore, the frequency constant of piezoelectric vibrator is different due to the different materials and vibration modes. The frequency constant essentially reflects the acoustic wave velocity of materials at the fundamental resonant frequency of piezoelectric body. It is an important parameter for determining the size of a piezoelectric oscillator at a certain resonant frequency. The specific value depends on the materials composition and vibration mode.

explanation_cn: 用以增强和改善基体材料性能的颗粒状材料。分为延性颗粒增强体和刚性颗粒增强体。在基体中引人第二相颗粒，使材料的力学性能得到改善。当材料受到破坏应力时，裂纹尖端与颗粒作用而引发两种可能的补强增韧机制：①相变增韧和微裂纹增韧，即裂纹尖端附近区域发生显著的物理变化，如晶型转变、体积效应、应力状态改变、微裂纹产生与增殖等，这都要消耗能量，从而提高材料钿性。②第二相颗粒使裂纹的扩展路径发生改变。如：裂纹偏转、弯曲、分叉或裂纹桥联、裂纹钉扎等，从而获得增韧效果。有时以上两类机制同时发生作用，即协同增韧效应。颗粒增强体自身的性质、形态、大小和体积分数是决定复合材料力学和物理性能的重要因素。
explanation_en: Granular materials used to strengthen and improve the performance of matrix materials. It is divided into ductile particle reinforcement and rigid particle reinforcement. The mechanical properties of materials are improved by introducing second phase particles into the matrix. When materials are subjected to failure stress, two possible strengthening and toughening mechanisms are triggered by the action of crack tip and particle: ① phase transformation toughening and microcrack toughening, that is, significant physical changes occur in the area near the crack tip, such as transformation of crystal form, volume effect, change of stress state, generation and proliferation of microcracks, which all consume energy, thus improving materials' luster. ② The second phase particles change the crack propagation path. For example, crack deflection, bending, bifurcation or crack bridging, crack pinning, etc., in order to achieve toughening effects. Sometimes both types of mechanisms act simultaneously, namely the synergistic toughening effect. The properties, morphology, size and volume fraction of particle reinforcement are important factors that determine the mechanical and physical properties of composite materials.

name_cn: 颗粒增强金属基复合材料
explanation_cn: 以碳化物、氮化物、石墨等颗粒增强的以金属或合金为基体的金属基复合材料。这是金属基复合材料中最容易批量制备、加工、成型的品种，也是研究发展最为成熟、应用最为广泛、成本最低的金属基复合材料，常选用的颗粒有碳化硅、碳化钛、碳化硼、碳化钨、氧化铝、氮化硅、硼化钛.氮化硼及石墨等。与其他类型金属基复合材料相比.该体系复合材料性能各向同性、颗粒的价格最低、来源也最广。复合制备工艺最多样、最灵活，最易于成型和加工，并且完全可利用常规设备进行制备及二次加工，增强体体积分数的可设计性最强。可选用的制备方法主要包括粉末冶金、搅拌复合、浸渗、喷射共沉积和原位复合等。二次加工方法主要包括铸造、挤压、轧制、模锻、旋压、半固态成型和焊接等热加工工艺，以及绝大部分机械加工工艺。
explanation_en: Metal matrix composite reinforced by particles such as carbide, nitride, graphite, etc. and based on metal or alloy. This is the most easily prepared, processed and shaped metal matrix composite in batch, and it is also the most mature, widely used and low-cost metal matrix composite. The commonly selected particles are silicon carbide, carbonization, carbonization, carbonization, aluminum oxide, silicon nitride, titanium boride, boron nitride and graphite. Compared with other types of metal matrix composite, this system of composite materials has isotropic properties, the lowest price of particles, and the most extensive sources. The composition preparation process is the most diverse, flexible, easy to form and process, and can be prepared and processed by conventional equipment. The volume fraction of reinforcement has the strongest designability. The available preparation methods mainly include powder metallurgy, stirring composition, infiltration, spray codeposition and in-situ composition. Secondary processing methods mainly include hot working processes such as foundry, extrusion, rolling, die forging, spinning, semi-solid forming and weld, as well as most of the machining processes.

name_cn: 颗粒增强金属基高导热复合材料
name_en: particle reinforced metal matrix high thermal conductivity composite
explanation_cn: 以低膨胀、高导热颗粒增强的以高导热金属或合金为基体的一类新型复合材料。常用的颗粒主要有SiC、A1N、BeO、金刚石等。常用的基体有Al、Cu、Ag。典型的颗粒增强金属基高导热复合材料有SiC/Al、AlN/Al、BeO/Al、金刚石/A1、金刚石/Cu、金刚石/Ag等。该体系复合材料中金属基体的髙导热性与增强体低膨胀、高导热、高模量、低密度的特性相结合，可大幅度提升材料的热导率及弹性模量，降低其热膨胀系数，还可以大大降低银基、铜基复合材料的密度。与其他类型的金属基高导热复合材料相比，颗粒增强金属基高导热复合材料最为常见，且性能各向同性，成本低，工艺简单，易于成型。制备方法主要有熔铸法、压力浸渗法、无压浸渗法、粉末冶金法、喷射沉积法、半固态复合铸造法等。颗粒增强金属基高导热复合材料是极具潜力的、理想的新型电子封装材料，在电子工业、航天航空、军事科技等领域有广泛的应用前景。
explanation_en: A new type of composite materials reinforced with low expansion and high thermal conductivity particles and based on high thermal conductivity metal or alloy. The commonly used particles mainly include SiC, A1N, BeO, diamond, etc. The commonly used matrix are Al, Cu and Ag. Typical particle reinforced metal matrix high thermal conductivity composite include SiC/Al, AlN/Al, BeO/Al, diamond/A1, diamond/Cu, diamond/Ag, etc. The combination of the high thermal conductivity of the metal matrix in the system composite materials and the characteristics of low expansion, high thermal conductivity, high modulus and low density of the reinforcement can significantly improve the thermal conductivity and elastic modulus of the materials, reduce its coefficient of thermcal expansion, and also greatly reduce the density of silver based and copper based composite materials. Compared with other types of metal matrix high thermal conductivity composites, particle reinforced metal matrix high thermal conductivity composite are the most common, with isotropic performance, low cost, simple process and easy molding. The preparation methods mainly include melting casting, pressure infiltration, pressureless infiltration, powder metallurgy, spray deposition, semi-solid composition casting, etc. Particle reinforced metal matrix high thermal conductivity composite is a new type of electronic packaging materials with great potential and ideal. It has a broad application prospect in electronic industry, aerospace, military science and technology and other fields.

explanation_cn: 色漆中颜料（包括体质颜料）与漆基的体积（或质量）的比值称为颜基比，是色漆生产中的一个重要参数。因它关系到涂料的弹性、光泽、硬度、耐候性、耐污性等。
explanation_en: The ratio of pigment (including constitutional pigment) in paint to the volume (or mass) of paint base is called pigment binder ratio, which is an important parameter in paint production. Because it relates to the elasticity, gloss, hardness, weather resistance, stain resistance, etc. of coatings.

explanation_cn: 一种可溶于水、油、树脂的白色、黑色或彩色的粉状物质。它属于着色剂的一类，通常以分散状态应用于涂料、油墨、塑料、橡胶、纺织、造纸等制品或领域中，使制品呈现要求的颜色或产生一些防锈、发光、示温等功能。按来源.可分为天然和合成两大类。按化学组成又可分为无机和有机两大类。在实际使用中，通常按颜色分为白色和彩色两大类，如钛白、锌钡白、大量低遮盖力的白色体、以炭黑为主的黑色颜料、以偶氮红及镉红为主的红色颜料、以酞菁蓝为主的蓝色颜料等。颜料还可按其功能分为着色颜料、防锈颜料、发光颜料、示温颜料等。颜料颗粒是尤定形或规则的结晶体其物理性质通常由颗粒的表面性能及组成决定;其化学性质由其化学组分决定。颜料通常以着色力、遮盖力、耐候性、吸油量等指标衡量其性能，合成颜料的生产工艺视品种而定。天然颜料的生产工艺较为简单，只需选矿、粉碎、分级等工序。对颜料颗粒进行表面处理，改善颜料的表面特性，使之更符合应用的需要.这是颜料制造过程中一个很重要的工艺步骤。作为着色剂，颜料具有独特的优点广泛用于各种类型的印刷油墨、建筑涂料、汽牟涂料、塑料、橡胶、织物印染及日用轻工业品中。
explanation_en: A white, black, or colored powdery substance that is soluble in water, oil, or resin. It belongs to a category of colorant, and is usually used in coatings, inks, plastics, rubber, textiles, paper making and other products or fields in a dispersed state to make the products present the required color or produce some rust prevention, luminescence, temperature indication and other functions. According to their sources, they can be divided into two categories: natural and synthetic. According to chemical composition, it can be further divided into two categories: inorganic and organic. In practical use, it is usually divided into two major categories by color: white and color, such as titanium white, lithophone, a large number of white bodies with low covering power, black pigment dominated by carbon black, red pigment dominated by azo red and cadmium red, and blue pigment dominated by phthalocyanine blue. Pigment can also be divided into coloring pigment, anticorrosive pigment, luminescence pigment, temperature indicating pigment, etc. according to their functions. Pigment particles are special shaped or regular crystals whose physical properties are usually determined by the surface properties and composition of particles; Its chemical properties are determined by its chemical composition. The performance of pigment is usually measured by tinting strength, covering power, weather resistance, oil absorption and other indicators. The production process of synthetic pigment depends on the variety. The production process of natural pigment is relatively simple, requiring only processes such as beneficiation, crushing and grading. The surface treatment of pigment particles to improve the surface characteristics of pigment and make it more suitable for application is a very important process step in the manufacturing process of pigment. As a colorant, pigment has unique advantages and is widely used in various types of printing ink, architectural coatings, Qimou coatings, plastics, rubber, textile printing and dyeing and light industrial products for daily use.

explanation_cn: 色漆中颜料、体质颜料和其他固体颗粒的体枳在全部不挥发物总体积中所占的比例。通常以百分数（％）表示。
explanation_en: The proportion of pigment, constitutional pigment and other solid particles in the total volume of nonvolatile matter in paint. Usually expressed as a percentage (%).

explanation_cn: 取100g颜料把亚麻油一滴滴逐渐加人其中，并用刮刀不断搅和尽，使其混合均匀。亚麻油刚滴入时，颜料还会保持松散状态，最后亚麻油会把颜料全部黏结在一起球状，如果再继续滴加亚麻油，体系就会变稀，人们把这时所用的亚麻油童叫作该颜料的吸油量。
explanation_en: Take 100g of pigment and gradually add a drop of linseed oil into it, and mix it with a scraper to make it evenly mixed. When the linseed oil is just dropped in, the pigment will remain loose. Finally, the linseed oil will bind all the pigment together in a ball shape. If the linseed oil is added continuously, the system will become thin. People call the flax oil used at this time the oil absorption of the pigment.

explanation_cn: 皮革的颜色在皮革产品使用过程中受到外界作用而发生变化的承受能力。包括日晒作用、热作用和洗涤作用等。
explanation_en: The tolerance of leather color to change due to external effects during the use of leather products. Including the effects of sunlight, heat, and washing.

explanation_cn: 简称色釉.是在无色透明釉或乳内釉料中引入适量的无机颜料，在不同的工艺条件下烧制成的各种不同色调的釉。常以自然界的景物、动植物命名，如天青、豆青、梅子青、孔雀绿、鹧鸪斑等：也有按用途、产地等命名的，如祭红、祭蓝、广钧、宜钧等;若器物通体一色者为单色柚，多色间者为花釉;按釉的成熟温度可分为低温色釉和高温色釉两大类：低温色釉是指在1000°C左右烧成的以硅酸铅为基础的易熔袖;传统的高温色釉是指大于1250°C烧成的石灰-碱袖为基础的釉，现代高温色釉多以长石袖为基础。按釉的呈色机理不同，可分成离子着色、胶体着色与晶体着色三大类。一般陶器用低温，而炻器瓷器则用高温颜色柚。它是陶瓷制品简便而廉价的装饰方法，在我国历代的色柚装饰占冇相当重要的地位。
explanation_en: It is called colored glaze for short. It is a kind of glaze with different colors, which is made by introducing an appropriate amount of inorganic pigment into the colorless transparent glaze or emulsion glaze under different technological conditions. Often named after natural scenery, animals and plants, such as Tianqing, Douqing, Meiziqing, Peacock Green, Partridge Spot, etc. Some are also named according to their purpose, origin, etc., such as Jihong, Jilan, Guangjun, Yijun, etc; If the object is all in one color, it is a monochromatic pomelo, and if there are multiple colors, it is a floral glaze; According to the mature temperature of glaze, it can be divided into two categories: low-temperature color glaze and high-temperature color glaze: low-temperature color glaze refers to the fusible sleeve based on lead silicate fired at about 1000 ° C; The traditional high temperature colored glaze refers to the glaze based on lime alkali sleeves fired at more than 1250 ° C. The modern high temperature colored glaze is mostly based on feldspar sleeves. According to the different coloration mechanism of glaze, it can be divided into three categories: ion coloration, colloid coloration and crystal coloration. Generally, pottery uses low temperature, while stoneware and porcelain use high temperature color pomelo. It is a simple and cheap decoration method for ceramics products, and has played a very important role in the color pomelo decoration of all previous dynasties in China.

explanation_cn: 以颜色釉装饰的瓷器称为颜色柚瓷。中国传统瓷主要品种之一。根据主要着色元素，分铁系、铜系、钴系。铁系起源最早品种最多，烧造地区最广，流传时间最氏。铜系和钴系都是在宋代以后发展起来的，品种相对较少。有些颜色釉瓷的胎，如青瓷、黑釉瓷等。可用含铁量较高的低品位原料制成，故各地都能烧造。元明时期，景德镇在历代名窑的基础上，继承和发展了一系列名贵的高温颜色釉品种，如祭红、郎窑红、桃花片、钧红、窑变花釉、仿官、仿哥、仿汝、仿龙泉、花叶末、铁锈花、祭蓝等。
explanation_en: Porcelain decorated with colored glaze is called colored teak porcelain. One of the main varieties of traditional Chinese porcelain. According to the main coloring elements, it can be divided into iron series, copper series and cobalt series. The earliest origin of the iron series has the most varieties, the widest firing area, and the longest spreading time. The copper and cobalt series were both developed after the Song Dynasty, with relatively few varieties. Some color-glazed porcelain bodies, such as celadon, black glazed porcelain, etc. It can be made from low-grade raw materials with high iron content, so it can be fired in various places. During the Yuan and Ming Dynasties, Jingdezhen inherited and developed a series of precious high-temperature colored glaze varieties on the basis of famous kilns in the past dynasties, such as sacrificial red, Langyao red, peach blossom pieces, Jun red, kiln transformed glaze, imitation official, imitation brother, imitation Ru, imitation Longquan, flower and leaf ends, rust flower, sacrificial blue, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称最大容量。额定容量是指存储、运输或者处理的最大容量例如电池充满电后，在一定放电条件下.电池放电至截止电压时所放出的电量为其额定容量，电池容量的单位有A·h,mA·h(lA·h=1000mA·h)。或者电气线路中主分接下视在功率的惯用值为额定容量，电气线路的额定容量一般以kV·A或MV·A表示。或者是通信电路可以同时处理最大通信电路数量。
explanation_en: Also called maximum capacity. Rated capacity refers to the maximum capacity capacity for storage, transportation or treatment. For example, under certain discharge conditions after the battery is fully charged, the electricity discharged when the battery discharges to the cut-off voltage is its rated capacity. The units of cell capacity are A · h, mA · h (lA · h=1000 mA · h). Or the conventional value of apparent power under main tapping in electrical lines is rated capacity, and the rated capacity of electrical lines is generally expressed in kV · A or MV · A. Alternatively, the communication circuit can simultaneously handle the maximum number of communication circuits.

name_cn: 飞秒激光用色散补偿薄膜
name_en: femtosecond laser with dispersion compensation film
explanation_cn: 对飞秒激光进行色散补偿的一类薄膜。飞秒激光是指激光脉冲宽度在飞秒量级的激光（1fs=l0^l5s)。由于飞秒激光是复色光，因此必须考虑色散造成的脉冲展宽。色散补偿薄膜首先需要满足在指定的带宽范围内提供较高的反射率（一般要大于99.5%)以保证激光输出，减小反射损耗。其次就是考虑色散的补偿，对于色散补偿薄膜来说，在保证高反射率一定的条件下，补偿带宽和平均补偿量是一对反比的关系。色散补偿薄膜可以分为啁啾镜和Gires-Tournois腔，GT腔更适用于在较小的带宽范围内对色散进行较大的补偿，而啁啾镜则是可以对较大的带宽范围内进行色散补偿，但其补偿量比GT腔要小，另外GT腔的大部分膜系为规整膜系，因此在制备难度上要小于啁啾镜。
explanation_en: A type of thin film used for dispersion compensation of femtosecond lasers. Femtosecond laser refers to a laser with a pulse width of femtosecond magnitude (1fs=l0 ^ l5s). Due to the fact that femtosecond lasers are polychromatic, it is necessary to consider the pulse broadening caused by dispersion. The dispersion compensation film first needs to provide a high reflectivity (generally greater than 99.5%) within the specified bandwidth range to ensure laser output and reduce reflection loss. Secondly, it is important to consider dispersion compensation. For dispersion compensation films, the compensation bandwidth and average compensation amount are inversely proportional under certain conditions of ensuring high reflectivity. Dispersion compensation thin films can be divided into chirped mirrors and Gires Tournois cavities. GT cavities are more suitable for compensating dispersion in a smaller bandwidth range, while chirped mirrors can compensate for dispersion in a larger bandwidth range, but their compensation amount is smaller than GT cavities. In addition, most of the film systems in GT cavities are regular film systems, so the preparation difficulty is smaller than that of chirped mirrors.

explanation_cn: 又称食品着色剂，是色素的一种，即能被人适量食用的可使食物在一定程度上改变色调和色泽的食品添加剂。现在常用的食品色素包括两类：天然色素与人工合成色素。天然色素来自天然物质，主要从植物组织中提取，也包括来自动物和微生物的一些色素。人工合成色素是指用人工化学合成方法所制得的有机色素.主要是以煤焦油中分离出来的苯胺染料为原料制成的。食品色素本身必须是无毒或毒性极低的，在食品进入生物体内的生理化学过程中，不会生成任何有毒物质。.要求能溶于水、乙醇、食用油以及其他食用介质中，不与食品中的碱类、酸类或防腐剂反应，不生成细菌，且对光和热是稳定的。许多国家包括中国，对食品色素的品种、质量指标及生产均有严格的规定。我国允许使用的化学合成色素包括苋菜红、胭脂红、赤藓红、新红、柠檬i黄、日落黄、靛蓝、亮蓝，以及为增强上述水溶性酸性色素在油脂中分散性的各种色素，我国允许使用的天然色素包括甜菜红、紫胶红、越橘红、辣椒红、红米红等45种。
explanation_en: Also known as food colorants, it is a kind of pigment, that is, a food additive that can be eaten properly and can change the color and hue of food to a certain extent. The commonly used food color now include two types: natural pigment and synthetic pigment. Natural pigment come from natural substances, mainly extracted from plant tissues, as well as some pigment from animals and microorganisms. Artificial pigment refers to the organic pigment produced by artificial chemical synthesis, which is mainly made from aniline dye or dyestuffc separated from coal tar. Food color itself must be non-toxic or extremely low toxic. During the physiological and chemical process of food entering the organism, no toxic substances will be generated It is required to be soluble in water, ethanol, edible oil and other edible media, not react with alkalis, acids or preservative in food, not generate bacteria, and stable to light and heat. Many countries, including China, have strict regulations on the variety, quality indicators and production of food color. The chemical synthetic pigment allowed to be used in China include amaranth, carmine, erythrin, new red, lemon i yellow, sunset yellow, indigo, brilliant blue, and various pigment to enhance the dispersibility of the above water-soluble acid pigment in oils, 45 natural pigment allowed to be used in China include beet red, lac red, blueberry red, chili red, red rice red, etc.

explanation_cn: 激光谐振腔内调技术中使用的一种开关晶体材料。饱和吸收体对激光的吸收系数随人射光强增大而减小，当达到饱和值时对激光出现透明，利用其这种饱和吸收特性对激光腔内的损耗进行调制，并发射脉冲。饱和吸收体主要有饱和吸收染料、饱和吸收晶体和半导体，染料由于自身的缺陷已经逐渐被淘汰，目前最常用的饱和吸收体材料是饱和吸收晶体和半导体。
explanation_en: A kind of switch crystalline materials used in laser resonator tuning technology. The absorption coefficient of the saturable absorber to the laser decreases with the increase of the human radiation intensity. When it reaches the saturation value, it becomes transparent to the laser. This saturated absorption characteristic is used to modulate the loss in the laser cavity and emit pulses. Saturable absorber mainly includes saturable absorption dye, saturated absorption crystal and semiconductor. dye or dyestuffc has been gradually eliminated due to its own defects. At present, the most commonly used saturable absorber materials are saturated absorption crystal and semiconductor.

explanation_cn: 实现突变技术中使用的一种开关材料。利用染料对激光的吸收系数随光强增大而减小，当达到饱和值时对激光呈透明的特性，使谐振腔的Q值增大，并发射一巨脉冲。染料的组分是含N、S、Se等的碳花菁，主要用于红宝石激光器、钕玻璃激光器和染料激光器被动锁模材料，激光器的输出波长必须与染料的吸收峰位置相匹配，且吸收峰宽度应尽量窄。
explanation_en: A switch materials used in realizing mutation technology. The absorption coefficient of dye or dyestuffc to laser decreases with the increase of light intensity. When it reaches the saturation value, it is transparent to the laser, which increases the Q value of the resonator and emits a giant pulse. The component of dye or dyestuffc is carbon cyanine containing N, S, Se, etc., which is mainly used in mby laser, neodymium glass laser and passive mode locking materials of dye or dyestuffc laser. The output wavelength of the laser must match the absorption peak position of dye or dyestuffc, and the absorption peak width should be as narrow as possible.

explanation_cn: 铁电体的极化强度随外加电场的增加而增加时所可能达到的最大值。铁电体的极化强度和电场强度存在电滞回线。当电场增至某饱和值时，所对应的极化强度称为饱和极化强度。饱和极化强度的大小取决于材料的性质。
explanation_en: The maximum value that can be reached when the polarization of ferroelectric body increases with the increase of applied electric field. There are hysteresis loops in polarization and electric field strength of ferroelectric body. When the electric field increases to a certain saturation value, the corresponding polarization is called saturated polarization. The saturated polarization depends on the nature of the materials.

explanation_cn: 铁磁材料和亚铁磁材料的磁化强度M(或磁感应强度B)随磁I场增加而增加至所能达到的最大值。此时的磁化强度称为饱和磁化强度。饱和磁化强度是温度的函数，0K时的饱和磁化强度称绝对饱和磁化强度。
explanation_en: The magnetization M (or magnetic induction B) of ferromagnetic materials and ferrimagnetic materials increases to the maximum value as the magnetic I field increases. The magnetization at this time is called the saturation magnetization. The saturation magnetization is a function of temperature. The saturation magnetization at 0K is called the absolute saturation magnetization.

explanation_cn: 在碳含量极低的高镍马氏体基体上弥散析出金属间化合物而强化的超髙强度钢。马氏体时效钢的特点为:马氏体基体不仅强度高而且具有良好的塑性和韧性；时效硬化前可进行各种形式的冷加工。且具有良好焊接性；固溶处理后仅需空冷就可得到马氏体组织，热处理变形和开裂倾向很低；成型加工后经过较低温度(400-500°C)的时效处理即可显著强化。马氏体吋效钢常用于制作飞机和火箭的结构件及壳体、高强度螺拴、发动机阀簧、石油化工的高压容器等。
explanation_en: Ultra high strength steel strengthened by imermetallif compound dispersed and precipitated on high nickel martensite matrix with extremely low carbon content. The characteristics of maraging steel are: the martensite matrix has not only high strength but also good plasticity and toughness; Various forms of cold working can be carried out before age hardening. It has good weldability; After solution treatment, martensite can be obtained only by air cooling, and the deformation and cracking tendency of heat treatment is very low; After forming, aging treatment at a lower temperature (400-500 ° C) can significantly strengthen. Martensitic time effective steel is often used to make structural parts and shells of aircraft and rockets, high-strength bolts, engine valve springs, petrochemical high-pressure containers, etc.

explanation_cn: 以马氏体为主要组成物的球墨铸铁，其石墨呈球状，不含共晶碳化物。淬火后获得马氏体，但总留下少量残留奥氏体。马氏体球铁的组织为:马氏体+残留奥氏体+球状石墨。由于淬透性不高，制造厚壁件时要加入一些合金元素如Mo、Cu等，不应采用冷却能力强的淬火介质。马氏体球铁的硬度可达HRC52-58,用于制作球磨机用磨球，抛丸机中的磨损件。
explanation_en: Spheroidal graphite cast iron with martensite as the main component has spherical graphite and no eutectic carbide. Martensite is obtained after quenching, but a small amount of retained austenite is always left. The structure of martensitic ductile cast iron is martensite+retained austenite+spherical graphite. Due to the low hardenabilhy, some alloy elements such as Mo, Cu, etc. should be added when manufacturing thick wall parts, and quenchant with strong cooling capacity should not be used. The hardness of martensitic ductile cast iron can reach HRC52-58, which is used to make grinding balls for ball mills and wear parts in shot blasting machines.

explanation_cn: 位移型非扩散相变的一类，相变以点阵切变方式进行，相变的总切变可分解为两部分。一是平行于惯习面的切变(引起相变区的形状变化)，一是垂直于惯习面的膨胀(引起体积的变化)。相变的位移性质产生表面浮凸，表面的基准线在相变区域折动但在界面上仍保持连续性，相变时马氏体品体内部发生保持点阵不变的切变:滑移或孪生。
explanation_en: It is a kind of displacement type diffusionless transformation. The phase transformation is carried out in the form of lattice shear, and the total shear of phase transformation can be divided into two parts. One is the shear parallel to the habitual surface (causing the shape change of the phase transformation zone), the other is the expansion perpendicular to the habitual surface (causing the volume change). The displacement property of phase transformation produces a surface bulge. The reference line of the surface twists in the phase transformation area but remains continuous on the interface. During phase transformation, there is a shear in the martensite that keeps the lattice unchanged: slip or twinning.

explanation_cn: 将钢加热奥氏体化后快冷到+20-30℃的温度保温到温度均匀，再空冷到室温，形成马氏体组织的一种热处理工艺。为保证冷却速度和保温温度的准确控制，多采用硝盐浴炉作为快冷冷却介质及保温介质。由于浴炉的冷却速度比较小，为防止奥氏体分解。对碳钢及低合金钢工件该工艺只适用于截面尺寸不大、形状较复杂的情况，而淬透性高的工件就不受形状、尺寸的限制了。采用这种淬火工艺可通过减少内应力来减少变形，防止开裂。
explanation_en: A heat treatment process in which steel is heated, austenitized and rapidly cooled to+20-30 ℃, and then air cooled to room temperature to form martensite. To ensure accurate control of cooling speed and insulation temperature, nitrate bath furnaces are often used as fast cooling and insulation media. Due to the relatively low cooling rate of the bath furnace, in order to prevent austenite decomposition. For carbon steel and low alloy steel workpieces, this process is only applicable to the case of small section size and complex shape, while workpieces with high hardenabilhy are not limited by shape and size. This quenching process can reduce deformation and prevent cracking by reducing internal stress.

explanation_cn: 热处理后基体组织主要为马氏体的耐热钢。淬火态马氏体组织的高温蠕变强度较低，需采取在比使用温度高50-100℃的温度进行回火，使得析出一定量的细小弥散且在高温下稳定的碳化物颗粒提高高温强度。该类钢比奥氏体耐热钢价格便宜、热膨胀系数较小，但在650°C以上温度使用时抗氧化性和高温强度会显著降低，故其使用温度一般限定在650℃以下。主要用于汽轮机叶片和喷嘴、发动机阀门、高温螺栓等。
explanation_en: After heat treatment, the matrix structure is mainly martensitic heat resistant steel. The high-temperature creep strength of quenching martensite structure is low, so tempering shall be carried out at a temperature 50-100 ℃ higher than the service temperature, so that a certain amount of fine and dispersed carbide particles that are stable at high temperature can be precipitated to improve the high-temperature strength. This type of steel is cheaper than austenitic heat-resistant steel and has a smaller coefficient of thermal expansion. However, its oxidation resistance and high temperature strength will be significantly reduced when used at temperatures above 650 ° C, so its use temperature is generally limited to below 650 ° C. Mainly used for steam turbine blades and nozzles, engine valves, high-temperature bolts, etc.

explanation_cn: 使用态组织为马氏体的钢，但一般特指加热奥氏体化后空冷即吋获得马氏体组织的合金钢，如马氏体不锈钢、马氏体耐热钢、高速钢等。为了在空冷条件下获得马氏体组织，要求钢中含有大量提高淬透性的合金元素，故马氏体钢均为高合金钢。马氏体组织具有较高的硬度和强度，广泛应用制作各种高强度零件。
explanation_en: As used steel with martensite structure, but generally refers to alloy steel with martensite structure immediately obtained by air cooling after heating and austenitizing, such as martensitic stainless steel, martensitic heat resistant steel, high speed steel, etc. In order to obtain martensite structure under air cooling condition, steel is required to contain a large number of alloy elements to improve hardenabilhy, so martensitic steel is high alloy steel. Martensite structure has high hardness and strength, and is widely used to make various high-strength parts.

explanation_cn: 又称闪燃温度，即在规定的试验条件下，从材料中释放出的可燃气体。能够被外火焰点燃时周围空气的最低温度，它是评价塑料着火性能的参数之一。测量时，样品需粉碎、过筛，制成粒度为0.5-1.0mm的试样.并装人控温的热空气炉中，将点火火焰置于热空气炉开口处上方2mm处晃动，如在10min内有燃烧发生或易燃气体轻微爆炸，则此温度为材料的骤燃温度，否则升高l0°C重复实验。参见GB/T 9343-2008。不直接反映材料的燃烧值或燃烧速率，也不代表材料安全使用的上限温度。它不能用于单独描述或评价实际火灾中材料、制品的危险性和风险。但可作为火灾危险性和风险评价中的一种因素，也可以用来对不同材料的着火性能和敏感性做相对的评价。
explanation_en: Also known as flash temperature, it refers to the combustible gas released from materials under specified test conditions. The lowest temperature of ambient air when it can be ignited by an external flame, which is one of the parameters to evaluate the ignition performance of plastics. During measurement, the sample needs to be crushed and sieved to make a sample with a particle size of 0.5-1.0mm. It is put into a temperature controlled hot air furnace, and the ignition flame is placed 2mm above the opening of the hot air furnace to shake. If combustion occurs within 10min or the flammable gas slightly explosion, this temperature is the flash ignition temperature of materials, otherwise the experiment will be repeated with an increase of 10 ° C. Refer to GB/T 9343-2008. It does not directly reflect the combustion value or combustion rate of materials, nor does it represent the upper limit temperature for safe use of materials. It cannot be used to separately describe or evaluate the danger and risk of materials and products in actual fire. However, it can be used as a factor in fire hazard and risk assessment, and can also be used to evaluate the ignition performance and sensitivity of different materials relatively.

explanation_cn: 骨组织从植人体-骨界面沿植人体表面或其内部孔隙、通道或管道攀附延伸的现象。骨传导描述了生物医学材料在骨环境中引起的一种积极的长期的宿主反应，其发生条件除与材料本身的性质和结构相关外.植入体还必须植人骨内或与骨原接触.植入体要有适量的血液流动，才能使存在于内外骨膜中骨生长所必须的成骨细胞、受体毛细血管及血管周围组织等向植入体迁移，以及新骨组织沿植人体爬行生长。植入体在骨传导中起着一种骨架或桥梁的作用。骨传导在一定程度上依赖于骨诱导。骨传导材料可以作为骨诱导因子的载体，将这些因子缓慢释放.在局部发挥生理功能。同时也能提供细胞爬行的条件，支持细胞黏附、扩散和分裂，因此骨传导材料是骨组织工程选择细胞外支架材料的主要对象。骨传导有利于加速骨缺损的愈合，并促进植入体和骨间的结合，生物活性陶瓷是典型的具有骨传导作用的骨替换材料。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of bone tissue climbing and extending along the surface or internal pores, channels, or pipelines of the implanted body from the interface between the implanted body and bone. Osteoconduction describes a positive long-term host response caused by biomedical materials in the bone environment. Its occurrence conditions are not only related to the nature and structure of materials themselves. implant must also be implanted in bone or in contact with osteogen. implant must have an appropriate amount of blood flow, so that osteoblasts, receptor capillaries and tissues around blood vessels necessary for bone growth in the inner and outer periosteum can migrate to the implant, And new bone tissue crawls and grows along the implanted human body. Implant plays a role of skeleton or bridge in bone conduction. Osteoconduction depends on osteoinduction to some extent. Osteoconduction materials can be used as the carrier of bone induction factors, which can release these factors slowly and exert physiological function locally. At the same time, it can also provide conditions for cells to crawl, supporting cell adhesion, diffusion and division. Therefore, osteoconduction materials is the main object for bone tissue engineering to select extracellular stem materials. Osteoconduction is conducive to accelerating the healing of bone defects and promoting the combination of implant and bones. bioactiw ceramics are typical bone replacement materials with osteoconduction.

explanation_cn: 用于骨肿瘤骨缺损等临床治疗的生物材料，主要分为自体骨、异体骨、人工合成材料等。理想的骨缺损填充材料应具备以下条件：①良好的组织相容性；②来源广泛；③安全可靠；④具有骨传导和骨诱导的双重活性；⑤无机材料应具有可塑性，可被加工成所需的形状，并有一定的机械强度，在植人体内后的一定时间内仍可保持其形状，使新形成的组织具有一定的外形，并具有生物可降解性，在组织形成过程中能逐渐分解，不影响新生组织的结构和功能。目前存在的各种骨填充材料在修复骨肿瘤、骨缺损中都有各自的优缺点。自体骨存在来源有限、取骨处不适及并发症等问题；异体骨则存在感染、排斥反应、传播疾病等问题。人工材料种类众多，主要分为骨水泥、天然衍生材料、无机材料、高分子材料。到目前为止，还没有发现一种理想的骨缺损填充材料，通过骨组织工程技术获得所需的骨填充材料是今后的发展方向之一。
explanation_en: Biological materials used for clinical treatment of bone tumors and bone defects are mainly divided into autologous bone, allograft bone, synthetic materials, etc. The ideal bone defect filling materials should have the following conditions: ① good histocompatibility; ② Widely sourced; ③ Safe and reliable; ④ It has dual activities of osteoconduction and osteoinduction; ⑤ Inorganic materials should be plastic, can be processed into the required shape, and have a certain mechanical strength. After being implanted in the human body, they can still maintain their shape for a certain period of time, so that the newly formed tissue has a certain shape, and has biodegradability. They can be gradually decomposed in the process of tissue formation, without affecting the structure and function of the newly formed tissue. At present, various bone filling materials have their own advantages and disadvantages in repairing bone tumors and bone defects. There are problems with limited sources of autologous bone, discomfort at the bone extraction site, and complications; Allogeneic bone has problems such as infection, rejection, and transmission of diseases. There are many kinds of artificial materials, mainly including bone cement, natural derived materials, inorganic materials and macromolecule materials. So far, no ideal materials has been found for filling bone defects. Obtaining the required bone filling materials through bone tissue engineering technology is one of the development directions in the future.

explanation_cn: 又称骨整合。在光学显微镜下.植入体与骨组织之间呈现的无纤维结缔组织界面层的直接有序的结构和功能连接。其重要特点是骨和材料之间没有软组织层介入，植入体可将其承受的应力直接向骨传递。骨性结合不一定是骨键合，两者是不等同的。
explanation_en: Also known as osseointegration. Under the light microscope, the direct and orderly structural and functional connection of the fibrous connective tissue interface layer between the implantation and the bone tissue is presented. Its important feature is that there is no soft tissue layer intervention between bone and materials, and implant can directly transmit the stress it bears to bone. Bone binding is not necessarily bone bonding, the two are not equal.

explanation_cn: 同骨性结合。
explanation_en: With bone binding.

explanation_cn: 为常用的骨折内固定器件之一，常与骨螺钉联合使用。按使用时加压与否分为普通接骨板和加压接骨板。加压接骨板又分为加压器型和自动加压型两类。按接骨板外形可分为条形、L形、钩形及鹅颈式、多孔形和三叉形等；按使用部位可分为股骨接骨板、股骨转子接骨板、肱骨下端接骨板、桡骨下端接骨板等。接骨板的制作材料主要有医用不锈钢、钛合金两类.也有用镍钛形状记忆合金。由于金属接骨板的刚性.用于骨折内固定时可能发生应力屏蔽效应，影响断骨修复.因此发展了碳纤维等生物增强可降解吸收高分子材料，如聚乳酸、聚羟基乙酸或其共聚物的复合材料接骨板，由于可降解高分子材料在体内被逐渐吸收，其刚性将随断骨修复而逐渐降低并最后消失，是一类正在持续发展的动态接骨板。
explanation_en: As one of the commonly used internal fixation devices for fracture, it is often used in combination with bone screw. It can be divided into ordinary internal fixation plate and pressurized internal fixation plate according to whether it is pressurized or not. The pressurized internal fixation plate can be divided into two types: the pressurizer type and the automatic pressurizer type. According to the shape of internal fixation plate, it can be divided into bar, L-shaped, hook shaped, gooseneck shaped, porous and trigonal shapes; It can be divided into femoral internal fixation plate, femoral trochanter internal fixation plate, lower humerus internal fixation plate, lower radius internal fixation plate, etc. The materials for making internal fixation plate mainly include medical stainless steel and titanium alloy, and nickel titanium shape memory alloy. Due to the rigidity of the metal internal fixation plate, the stress shielding effect may occur when it is used for internal fixation of fractures, affecting the repair of broken bones. Therefore, carbon fiber and other biologically enhanced degradation absorbable macromolecule materials, such as composite materials internal fixation plate of polylactic acid, polyglycolic acid or its copolymer, have been developed. Since degradation macromolecule materials are gradually absorbed in the body, their rigidity will gradually decrease and eventually disappear with the repair of broken bones, It is a kind of dynamic internal fixation plate that is developing continuously.

name_en: biomedical magnesium alloy for bone implant
explanation_cn: 用于制备骨损伤修复固定使用的器件的生物医用镁合金材料。作为骨固定材料，应能在骨折愈合初期提供稳定的力学环境，逐渐而不是突然降低应力遮挡作用，使骨折部位承受逐渐增大的应力刺激，从而加速愈合并防止骨质疏松和再骨折合金经塑性变形和机械加工后制备成所需要的骨植人器件.满足人体骨组织愈合至少要求植入材料固定12周的需求。器件主要包括骨钉、骨板、内髓钉等。
explanation_en: Biomedical magnesium alloy materials used to prepare devices for bone injury repair and fixation. As a bone fixation materials, it should be able to provide a stable mechanical environment at the initial stage of fracture healing, gradually rather than suddenly reduce the stress shielding effect, so that the fracture site can withstand gradually increased stress irritation, so as to accelerate the healing and prevent osteoporosis and refracture alloy from being prepared into the required bone implant devices after plastic deformation and mechanical processing. It can meet the requirements of human bone tissue healing that implantation materials is fixed for at least 12 weeks. The devices mainly include bone nail, bone plate, intramedullary nail, etc.

explanation_cn: 一种用于填充骨与植人物间隙或骨腔，并具有自凝特性的骨修复材料。PMMA骨水泥由粉、液两相组成，粉剂主要为聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯粉以及少量引发剂（过氧化物，如过氧化笨甲酰），液剂主要为甲基丙烯酸甲酯单体及适量促进剂，两种成分按适当比例调和后，在5-10mm内聚合而固化。因此，近年来研究人员不断对PMMA骨水泥进行改进。同时，研究开发了一些生物相容性好、固化过程放热少、组成与人体硬组织相近的磷酸钙生物活性骨水泥。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a bone repair materials which is used to fill the gap or bone cavity between bone and implant and has the characteristics of self coagulation. PMMA bone cemem consists of two phases: powder and liquid. The powder is mainly polymethyl methacrylate powder and a small amount of initiator (peroxide, such as benzoyl peroxide). The liquid agent is mainly methyl methacrylate monomer and appropriate accelerator. After the two components are mixed in proper proportion, they polymerization and curing within 5-10mm. Therefore, in recent years, researchers have continuously improved PMMA bone cemem. At the same time, some bioactive bone cement with good biocompatibility, less heat release during curing and similar composition to human hard tissues have been developed.

explanation_cn: 骨折内固定器件之一。常用的种类有松质骨螺钉、皮质骨螺钉、螺栓及加压螺钉等。可单独使用于骨突出部位，如股骨、胫骨内、外髁及内外踝、尺骨鹰嘴骨折、某些管状骨或手足部的长斜形或长螺旋形骨折。螺栓可单独应用于股骨髁间或胫骨上端骨折。骨螺钉也可和接骨丝和内接骨板联合使用于骨折内固定手术中。骨螺钉的制作材料多为AISI316类奥氏体不锈钢和精密铸造或锻造的钛合金。还有用聚丙烯等高分子材料、氧化铝陶瓷及镍钛形状记忆合金制作的骨螺钉。
explanation_en: One of the internal fixation devices for fractures. The commonly used types are cancellous bone screw, cortical bone screw, bolts and compression screws. It can be used separately for bone protrusions, such as fractures of the femur, tibia, external condyle, inner and outer malleolus, olecranon fractures of the ulna, and long oblique or long spiral fractures of certain tubular bones or hands and feet. Bolts can be used separately for femoral intercondylar or tibial upper end fractures. Bone screws can also be used in combination with bone wires and internal bone plates in fracture internal fixation surgery. The materials for bone screw are mostly AISI316 austenilic stainless steel and precision casting or forged titanium alloy. There are also bone screw made of macromolecule materials such as polypropylene, alumina ceramics and nickel titanium shape memory alloy.

explanation_cn: 在诱导因子或植入材料的作用下诱导来自宿主组织周边结缔组织中的可诱导成骨前体细胞分化为骨原细胞、成软骨细胞及成骨细胞，最后形成骨组织的现象。
explanation_en: The phenomenon of inducing osteoblast precursor cells from the surrounding connective tissue of host tissue to differentiate into osteoblasts, chondroblasts and osteoblasts under the effect of inducers or implantation materials, and finally forming bone tissue.

explanation_cn: 学名骨灰瓷，简称骨瓷。以长石、石英、黏土和动物的骨灰为主要原料，经过高温素烧和低温釉烧两次烧制而成的瓷器。素烧温度约1250°C，釉烧温度约1100°C。
explanation_en: The scientific name is bone ash porcelain, abbreviated as bone porcelain. The porcelain is made of feldspar, quartze, clay and animal ashes as the main raw materials, and is fired twice through high-temperature plain firing and low-temperature glaze firing. The plain firing temperature is about 1250 ° C, and the glaze firing temperature is about 1100 ° C.

explanation_cn: 又称骨钉，多为髓内针(钉)。常用的骨折内固定器件之一.外形如一根粗大的针。常见的多为髓内针，还包括三翼骨针和可屈针等。髓内针的构造有中空型与实体型两类。
explanation_en: Also known as bone nails, they are mostly intramedullary nails (nails). One of the commonly used internal fixation devices for fractures, resembling a thick needle in shape. Common types include intramedullary nails, as well as three winged bone nails and flexible needles. There are two types of intramedullary needles: hollow type and solid type.

explanation_cn: 见骨针。
explanation_en: See hone needle.

explanation_cn: 植入体和骨基质间通过物理-化学过程达到的无界面结合，即植入体和骨基质间在分子水平上实现的结合。
explanation_en: The interfacial bonding between implant and bone matrix is achieved through physical and chemical processes, that is, the bonding between implant and bone matrix at the molecular level.

explanation_cn: 医疗器械中长条针形骨折内固定器械.属骨钉的一种，是治疗管状骨骨折的首选器械之一，按其结构可分为中空型和实体型两大类。结构具有髓内钉杆，在髓内钉杆近端设有近端锁定螺钉孔，在髓内钉杆表面设有一条以上呈长条形的减压平面，减压平面可从髓内钉杆近端直至髓内钉杆远端。在髓内钉杆近端设置有锁紧螺杆定位螺孔、连接套定位槽
explanation_en: Medical device, a kind of bone nail, is the first choice for the treatment of tubular bone fractures. It can be divided into hollow type and solid type according to its structure. The structure has a intramedullary nail rod, a proximal locking screw hole is arranged at the proximal end of the intramedullary nail rod, and more than one long decompression plane is arranged on the surface of the intramedullary nail rod, which can be from the proximal end of the intramedullary nail rod to the distal end of the intramedullary nail rod. The proximal end of the intramedullary nail rod is equipped with a locking screw positioning screw hole and a connecting sleeve positioning groove

explanation_cn: 临界转变温度高于液氮温度的超导体薄膜。高温超导体是由多种元素按特定化学计量比组成的化合物。它常有几个不同的相.其中有超导的和非超导的。其晶体具有高度各向异性。控制各元素间的比例、形成正确的相、生长成所需的晶体方向.这三方面的要求使高温超导薄膜制备工艺具有相当大的难度。现有的高温超导体全部都是氧化物.氧的存在，使真空镀膜设备中处于高温的部件严重氧化.特别是使一些发热元件氧化，大大降低其寿命，给真空设备中材料的选择带来了相当大的闲难。现在发展最多的高温超导薄膜共有三种：钇系膜的可达90K,离液氮温度77K较远，这使它可在此温度下正常工作。
explanation_en: Superconductor films whose critical transformation temperature is higher than that of liquid nitrogen. High-temperature superconductor is a compound composed of a variety of elements in a specific stoichiometric ratio. It often has several different phase, including superconducting and non superconducting. Its crystal is highly anisotropic. Controlling the proportion of elements, forming the correct phase, and growing into the required crystal direction make the preparation process of high-temperature superconducting thin films quite difficult. The existing high-temperature superconductor are all oxides. The presence of oxygen causes serious oxidation of high-temperature parts in vacuum coating equipment. In particular, it causes oxidation of some heating elements, greatly reducing their service life, which brings considerable difficulties to the selection of materials in vacuum equipment. There are three types of high-temperature superconducting films that are currently the most developed: yttrium based films can reach up to 90K and are far away from the liquid nitrogen temperature of 77K, which allows them to work normally at this temperature.

explanation_cn: 采用介电常数很大的钛酸钡为基本介质的浆料。高介电常数介质浆料用于制作大容量的厚膜电容。
explanation_en: Barium titanate with high dielectric constant is used as the paste of basic medium. High dielectric constant paste is used to make high-capacity thick film capacitors.

explanation_cn: 又称超韧尼龙，一种以尼龙为主的聚合物合金，通常由尼龙与热塑性弹性体或聚烯烃共混制得。获得高冲击性能尼龙的关键在于提高共混组分间的相容性，降低各聚合物组分间的界面张力得到稳定且在基体中分散均匀的相。
explanation_en: Also known as super tough nylon, a polymer alloy mainly composed of nylon resin, is usually made by nylon resin polymer blending with thermoplastic elastomers or polyolefin. The key to obtain high impact nylon resin is to improve the compatibility between the polymer blending components, reduce the interfacial tension between the polymer components, and obtain a stable and uniform phase in the matrix.

explanation_cn: 见聚合物。
explanation_en: See polymer.

explanation_cn: 是指一类对化学反应具有催化作用的高分子。主要可分为天然高分子催化剂和合成高分子催化剂两大类。前者如酶，后者如间定化酶、模拟酶和高分子金属催化剂等。
explanation_en: It refers to a class of macromolecule that can catalysis chemical reactions. It can be mainly divided into two categories: natural polymer catalysts and synthetic polymeric catalyst. The former is like enzyme, and the latter is like metaenzyme, mimic enzyme and macromolecule metal catalyst.

explanation_cn: 两种或两种以上高分子的混合物。对于大多数高分子与高分子的混合，由于高分子的分子量很大，混合时熵的变化很小。混合过程一般又是吸热过程，所以，混合自由焓是正值，不能达到分子水平的混合，因此形成非均相混合物，即所谓多相体系。只有少数例外，如聚苯醚/聚苯乙烯和丁腈橡胶/聚氯乙烯共混体系。
explanation_en: A mixture of two or more macromolecule. For the mixing of most macromolecule and macromolecule, because the molecular weight of macromolecule is very large, the change of entropy during mixing is very small. The mixing process is generally an endothermic process, so the free enthalpy of mixing is positive and can not reach the molecular level of mixing, so a heterogeneous phase mixture is formed, which is the so-called multiphase system. There are only a few exceptions, such as polyphenylene oxide/polystyrene and acrylonitrilebutadiene rubber/polyvinyl chloride polymer blending systems.

explanation_cn: 冠醚指含有多个氧原子的大环化合物，高分子冠醚指的是键合有冠醚基团的高分子材料。
explanation_en: Crown ethers refer to macrocyclic compounds containing multiple oxygen atoms, and polymer with crown ether refer to macromolecule materials bonded with crown ether groups.

explanation_cn: 具有三维交联网络的高分子材料，网络中可固定水或其他有机溶剂，广泛应用于卫生、生物医学等领域。
explanation_en: Macromolecule materials with three-dimensional crosslinking network, which can fix water or other organic solvents, is widely used in health, biomedicine and other fields.

explanation_cn: 高分子分离膜是由聚合物或高分子复合材料制得的具有分离流体混合物功能的薄膜。膜分离是依据膜的选择透过性，将分离膜作间隔层，在压力差、浓度差或电位差的推动力下，借流体混合物中各组分透过膜的速率不同，使之在膜的两侧分别富集，以达到分离、精制、浓缩及回收利用的目的。
explanation_en: Polymeric separation membrane is a membrane made of polymer or macromolecule composite materials, which has the function of separating fluid mixture. Membrane separation is based on the permeability of membrane selection. membrane separation materials is used as the spacer layer. Under the driving force of pressure difference, concentration difference or potential difference, each component in the fluid mixture is enriched on both sides of the membrane by virtue of the different rate of penetration of the membrane, so as to achieve the purpose of separation, refining, concentration and recycling.

explanation_cn: 根据化学组成、相对分子质量、支化、立体规整度等结构特征，将具有多分散性的髙分子按照某一特征分离成若干级份的过程。主要包括：①沉淀分级一基于高分子在溶剂中溶解度的差别使高分子溶质按溶解度自小至大分离出若干级份的过程。②洗脱分级一基于高分子对色谱柱中介质材料吸附性的差别，通过逐渐改变淋洗溶剂的组成或沿色谱柱方向逐渐改变温度而将高分子溶质按溶解度的变化分离成若干级份的过程。
explanation_en: The process of separating highly dispersed molecules into several levels based on certain structural characteristics such as chemical composition, relative molecular weight, branching, and stereoregularity. It mainly includes: ① precipitation fractionation - the process of separating several fractions of macromolecule solute from small to large water solubility based on the difference of macromolecule's water solubility in solvent. ② Elution fractionation is a process of separating macromolecule solutes into several fractions according to the change of water solubility by gradually changing the composition of the eluent solvent or gradually changing the temperature along the direction of the chromatographic column based on the difference in the adsorption of macromolecule to the medium materials in the chromatographic column.

explanation_cn: 研究高分子合成、高分子化学反应和高分子物理化学的学科。它是高分子科学的一个分支，研究内容包括合成高分子的化学反应和高分子本身的化学反应等。其中.研究高分子合成化学反应的主要任务是由单体合成高分子及开发新型高分子材料，而研究高分子本身的化学反应则为高分子的改性、提高使用价值、扩大应用范围提供了依据。
explanation_en: Studies macromolecule synthesis, macromolecule chemical reaction and macromolecule physical chemistry. It is a branch of macromolecule science, whose research contents include the chemical reaction of macromolecule synthesis and the chemical reaction of macromolecule itself. Among them, the main task of studying the chemical reaction of macromolecule synthesis is to synthesize macromolecule from monomer and develop new macromolecule materials, while studying the chemical reaction of macromolecule itself provides a basis for modifying macromolecule, improving its use value and expanding its application range.

explanation_cn: 半透膜只允许某种分子或离子扩散进出的薄膜，即粒子的通过具有选择性。高分子半透膜是由高分子材料组成的半透膜，它们能过选择性地透过溶液或气体混合物的某种组分，因而用于分离和提纯，包括超滤膜、透析膜、反渗透膜等。
explanation_en: Semi permeable membrane A membrane that only allows certain molecules or ions to diffusion in and out, that is, the particles pass through selectively. Polymeric semipermeable membrane are semi permeable membranes composed of macromolecule materials. They can selectively penetrate certain components of solution or gas mixture, and are used for separation and purification, including ultrafiltration membrane, dialysis membrane, reverse osmosis membrane, etc.

explanation_cn: 只传导一种电荷的离子，而无反离子迁移的高分子导体。
explanation_en: A macromolecule conductor that conducts only one kind of charge ion without anti ion migration.

explanation_cn: 只允许溶剂分子透过，而不允许溶质通过的高分子半透膜。在浓溶液一侧施加足够大的压力，浓溶液中的溶剂分子将通过半透膜逆向扩散到稀溶液中。
explanation_en: A polymeric semipermeable membrane that only allows solvent molecules to pass through, but does not allow solutes to pass through. Apply enough pressure on one side of the concentrated solution, and solvent molecules in the concentrated solution will reverse diffusion into the dilute solution through the semipermeable membrane.

explanation_cn: 两种或两种以上热力学上不混溶但不分离的高分子共混物。
explanation_en: Two or more macromolecule blends that are immiscible but not separated in thermodynamics.

explanation_cn: 聚合物膜材料加热至其熔点以上形成的膜，通常表面光滑、透气性好、运行阻力低、过滤精度高、能水洗并可反复使用。
explanation_en: The polymer membrane materials is heated above its melting point to form a membrane with smooth surface, good air permeability, low running resistance, high filtration accuracy, and can be washed and reused.

explanation_cn: 具有高离子导电性的高分子，其离子电导率一般高于10^12S/cm，活化能低于0.5eV。
explanation_en: For macromolecule with high ionic conductivity, its ionic electric conductivity is generally higher than 10 ^ 12S/cm, and its activation or conditioning energy is lower than 0.5eV.

explanation_cn: 在分离膜中起支撑作用的多孔高分子膜。
explanation_en: Porous macromolecule membrane that plays a supporting role in the separation membrane.

explanation_cn: 由聚合物或高分子复合材料制得的具有分离流体混合物功能的薄膜。其分离原理主要是依据膜对混合物不同组分的选择透过性。在压力差、浓度差或电位差的推动下，由于各组分透过膜的速率不同，它们在膜的两侧在不同时间分别富集，从而实现纯化、分离、浓缩及回收利用的目的。
explanation_en: A thin film made of polymer or macromolecule composite materials with the function of separating fluid mixture. The separation principle is mainly based on the selective permeability of the membrane to different components of the mixture. Driven by pressure difference, concentration difference, or potential difference, due to the different rates of penetration of each component through the membrane, they are enriched on both sides of the membrane at different times, achieving the purpose of purification, separation, concentration, and recycling.

explanation_cn: 以固体材料为基体，在其表面形成一层高分子薄膜，以赋予材料表面不同于本体材料的特定性能。在生物医用材料领域，在保持基体材料特性的基础上，涂层材料通常阳于增进表面的生物学相关的性质。
explanation_en: With solid materials as the matrix, a layer of macromolecule film is formed on its surface to endow the surface of materials with specific properties different from the bulk materials. In the field of biomedical materials, on the basis of maintaining the characteristics of matrix materials, coating materials usually enhance the biological related properties of the surface.

explanation_cn: 研究髙分子结构与材料性能之间关系的一门科学。主要包括三部分：①高分子的结构，包括高分子链的近程结构、远程结构及高分子的聚集态结构；②高分子分子运动和热转变，它是联系高分子微观及亚微观结构与宏观性能的桥梁；③高分子的性能，包括力学性能、电学性能、耐热性和热稳定性、流变性能、溶液性能等。
explanation_en: It is a science to study the relationship between high molecular structure and materials properties. It mainly includes three parts: ① the structure of macromolecule, including the short-range structure, long-range structure of macromolecule chain and the aggregated structure of macromolecule; ② The movement and thermal transformation of macromolecule molecules are the bridge connecting the microscopic and submicroscopic structures and macroscopic properties of macromolecule; ③ The properties of macromolecule include mechanical properties, electrical properties, heat resistance and thermal stability, rheological properties, solution properties, etc.

explanation_cn: 具有电光效应的高分子材料，主要用于光通信宽带（>lOOGHz)电光调制器。
explanation_en: Macromolecule materials with electrophoto effect is mainly used for electro-optic modulator of optical communication broadband (>lOOGHz).

explanation_cn: 相转移催化剂能加速或者能使分别处于互不相溶的两种溶剂（液-液两相体系或固-液两相体系）中的物质发生反应。反应时，催化剂把一种实际参加反应的实体(如负离子）从一相转移到另一相中，以便使它与底物相遇而发生反应。
explanation_en: The phase transfer catalyst can accelerate or enable the reaction of substances in two solvents (liquid-liquid two-phase system or solid-liquid two-phase system) that are mutually insoluble. During reaction, the catalyst transfers an entity (such as negative ion) actually participating in the reaction from one phase to another so that it meets the substrate and reacts.

explanation_cn: 是指至少在某一维度上尺寸在1-lOOrnn范围的高分子基材料，具有较高的比表面积。由于高分子材料独特的结构和易改性、易加工等特点，该类纳米材料具有优于块体材料的诸多性能，如光、热、力、电、磁性能及浸润性等。
explanation_en: It refers to macromolecule based materials with dimensions in the range of 1-lOOrnn at least in a certain dimension and high specific surface. Due to the unique structure, easy modification, easy processing and other characteristics of macromolecule materials, this kind of nanomaterials has many properties superior to block materials, such as light, heat, force, electricity, magnetic properties and wettability.

explanation_cn: 高分子绝缘材料是由体积电阻率大于10^9Ω·cm的聚合物所构成的，又称高分子电介质，用来隔离带电的或不同电位的导体，使电流能按一定方向流动或者保证电容器有一定电容。绝缘性高分子材料具有禁带宽，电子离域性小等特征，高频绝缘的材料还要求介电常数和介电损耗小。
explanation_en: Polymeric insulating materials is composed of polymer with coefficient of volume resistance greater than 10 ^ 9 Ω· cm, also known as macromolecule dielectric, which is used to isolate charged or different potential conductors, so that the current can flow in a certain direction or ensure that the capacitor has a certain capacitance. Insulating macromolecule materials have the characteristics of bandgap, small electron delocalization, etc. High frequency insulating materials also require small dielectric constant and diekctric loss.

explanation_cn: 高分子是大量单体分子由共价键结合而形成的一维连接的巨大链状分子。高分子薄膜通常是晶态和非晶态的混合体，以及复杂的髙次结构。具有质量轻，易成形，柔软等优良特性。
explanation_en: Macromolecule is a large number of monomer molecules by covalent bond formed by the one-dimensional connection of the huge chain molecules. Macromolecule films are usually a mixture of crystalline and amorphous, as well as complex secondary structures. It has excellent characteristics such as light weight, easy forming, and softness.

explanation_cn: 由聚合物组成的孔径约在lnm以下，孔隙率小于10%的膜。
explanation_en: The membrane composed of polymer with pore size below lnm and porosity less than 10%.

explanation_cn: 高分子荧光传感器是指一类具有特殊荧光传感功能的荧光共轭聚合物。通过共轭聚合物与分析物之间的相互作用，包括能量转移、质子转移、配位络合、氢键作用、静电作用、疏水作用、化学反应等实现荧光发光波长和发光强度的变化，从而用于定性或半定量的检测。与小分子荧光传感器不同，激子可在共轭高分子刚性链间离域，能对荧光信号进行放大，因此表现出来极高的检测灵敏性。
explanation_en: Polymer-based fluorescent sensor is a kind of fluorescence conjugated polymer with special fluorescence sensing function. The fluorescence luminescence wavelength and luminous intensity can be changed through the interaction between the conjugated polymer and the analyte, including energy transfer, proton transfer, coordination complexation, hydrogen bond interaction, electrostatic interaction, hydrophobic interaction, chemical reaction, etc., which can be used for qualitative or semi quantitative detection. Different from small molecule fluorescence sensors, exciton can be delocalized between rigid chains of conjugated polymer, which can amplify fluorescence signals, so it shows high detection sensitivity.

explanation_cn: 是指能够显著降低液体表面张力的高分子化合物，包括天然高分子表面活性剂和合成高分子表面活性剂。与低分子表面活性剂一样，高分子表面活性剂由亲水部分和疏水部分组成。高分子表面活性剂可以分为阴离子型、阳离子型、两性型和非离子型等四类。
explanation_en: It refers to macromolecule compounds that can significantly reduce liquid surface tension, including natural polymer surfactants and synthetic polymer surfactant. Like low molecular surfactant, polymer surfactant consists of hydrophilic part and hydrophobic part. Polymer surfactant can be divided into four types: anionic, cationic, amphoteric and non-ionic.

explanation_cn: 是通过高分子官能团化或小分子高分子化的方法，使高分子骨架与化学反应活性官能团相连接，得到具有化学试剂功能的高分子化合物。高分子试剂在保持原有试剂的反应性能和反应能力的基础上，应具有更多新的性能。
explanation_en: It is the method of functionalization of macromolecule or small molecule macromolecule to connect the macromolecule skeleton with the phase of chemical reaction activity to obtain macromolecule compounds with chemical reagent function. Polymeric reagent should have more new properties on the basis of maintaining the reactivity and reaction ability of the original reagents.

explanation_cn: 高分子超滤膜是孔径在1-20nm的微孔的高分子过滤膜。在膜的一侧施以适当压力，以使小于孔径尺寸的溶质分子滤过。
explanation_en: Polymeric ultrafiltration membrane is a microporous macromolecule filtration membrane with a pore size of 1-20nm. Apply appropriate pressure on one side of the membrane to filter solute molecules smaller than the pore size.

explanation_cn: 以浓度差为推动力的多孔均质分子分离膜，其孔径一般在以下，所用高分子通常不带电荷。
explanation_en: Porous homogeneous molecular separation membrane driven by concentration difference has a pore diameter generally below, and the macromolecule used is usually uncharged.

explanation_cn: 高分子量聚氯乙烯（HM-WPVC)树脂通常是指平均聚合度在1700以上（黏数在154以上）的聚氯乙烯（PVC)树脂。这种新一代的PVC树脂所加工的软质制品除保持了PVC原有的特性之外，还具有强度高、压缩永久形变与热变形小、回弹性优异等橡胶的特性，具有广阔的应用前景。
explanation_en: High molecular weight polyvinylchloride (HM-WPVC) resin usually refers to polyvinyl chloride (PVC) resin with an average degree of polymerization above 1700 (viscosity number above 154). The soft products processed by this new generation of PVC resin not only maintain the original characteristics of PVC, but also have the characteristics of rubber such as high strength, low compression permanent deformation and thermal deformation, and excellent resilience, which has broad application prospects.

name_cn: 高分子量高密度聚乙烯
name_en: high molecular weight high density polyethylene
explanation_cn: 高密度聚乙烯的一种，重均分子量在20万-50万，分为共聚物和均聚物，共聚单体有卜丁烯、1-己烯和1-辛烯。
explanation_en: High density polyethylene, with a weight average molecular weight between 200000 and 500000, is divided into copolymer and homopolymer. Copolymer monomer includes butylene, 1-hexene and 1-octene.

name_cn: 高分子金属络合物催化剂
explanation_cn: 金属格合物通过物理或化学方法固定于高分子载体上形成的催化剂。
explanation_en: A catalyst formed by metal lattice compounds fixed on macromolecule supports by physical or chemical methods.

explanation_cn: 指高分子的分子内结构，分为两个层次。其结构单元的化学组成、分子构型、链的支化和交联结构以及共聚物的组成和序列分布等，称为高分子的近程结构；整个高分子链的结构，即高分子链的分子量和分子量分布以及构象两个方面，称为高分子远程结构。
explanation_en: Refers to the intramolecular structure of macromolecule, which is divided into two levels. The chemical composition, molecular configuration, chain branching and crosslinking structure of its structural unit, as well as the composition and sequence distribution of copolymer, are called the short-range structure of macromolecule; The structure of the whole macromolecule chain, that is, the molecular weight and molecular weight distribution of the macromolecule chain, as well as the conformation, is called macromolecule long-range structure.

explanation_cn: 由阳离子聚电解质和阴离子聚电解质相互交错，或由共混物有规律交错形成具有镶嵌图案形态的膜。
explanation_en: Cationic polyelectrolyte and anionic polyelectrolyte interlace each other, or polymer blending interlace regularly to form a membrane with mosaic patterns.

explanation_cn: 隐形技术实际是低可探测技术，即通过研究利用各种不同的技术手段来改变己方目标的可探测性信息特征，最大程度地降低对方探测系统发现的概率，使己方目标、己方的武器装备不被敌方的探测系统发现和探测到。具有隐身功能的高分子即为高分子隐身材料。
explanation_en: Invisible technology is actually a low detectability technology, which involves studying and utilizing various technical means to change the detectability information characteristics of our own targets, minimizing the probability of detection by the enemy's detection system, and preventing our own targets and weapons from being detected and detected by the enemy's detection system. Macromolecule with stealth function is polymeric stealth materials.

explanation_cn: 是通过一定的化合反应将颜料分子引入高分子的主链或侧链上而形成的一类新的有色高分子聚合物。将颜料分子高分子化，可以避免低分子颜料的溶解性、迁移性、挥发性等问题，并提高耐热性、耐光性等，克服了颜料在体内吸收、扩散的问题，用于食品、日用品、医药品的着色，可以提高安全性。此外，高分子颜料还可用于制备荧光材料、光致变色材料、光导电材料、光电转换材料等功能性材料中。
explanation_en: It is a new kind of colored macromolecule polymer formed by introducing pigment molecules into the main chain or side chain of macromolecule through a certain combination reaction. Polymerization of pigment molecules can avoid problems such as solubility, migration and volatility of low molecular pigment, improve heat resistance and light resistance, overcome problems of absorption and diffusion of pigment in the body, and can be used for coloring food, daily necessities and pharmaceuticals to improve safety. In addition, polymer pigment can also be used to prepare functional materials such as fluorescence materials, photochromie materials, photoconductive materials, photoelectric conversion materials, etc.

explanation_cn: 具有偶极取向并长期处于极化状态的聚合物电介质材料。在直流高压电场中.将聚合物通过加热至玻璃化转变温度以上乃至熔点，然后冷却凝固，或者通过光照、辐照、外加磁场以及有机溶液等方法凝固，使其在电场中形成的原子极化、分子偶极极化及注入空间电荷凝固，在除去电场后聚合物能半永久保持电极化状态，从而得到高分子驻极体。
explanation_en: Polymer dielectric materials with dipole orientation and long-term polarization. In the DC high-voltage electric field, the polymer is heated to above the glass transition temperature or even the melting point, then cooled and solidified, or solidified by light, irradiation, external magnetic field and organic solution, so that the atomic polarization, molecular dipole polarization and injected space charge formed in the electric field are solidified. After the electric field is removed, the polymer can semi permanently maintain the electrode state, thus obtaining polymer electrets.

explanation_cn: 利用透射电子显微镜将固体物质中原子排列直观投影成像的方法，其分辨能力接近或达到原子尺度（约O.lnm)。电子波经过试样时.其波振幅和相位均受到试样内原子集合体形成的电势场的调制，经电子透镜的放大作用后，接近光轴的电子波主要借助相位的干涉作用重构出试样电势场的投影像（又称高分辨像）。
explanation_en: The method of using a transmission electron microscope to visually project and image the arrangement of atoms in solid matter has a resolution close to or reaching atomic scale (approximately O.lnm). When an electron wave passes through the sample, its amplitude and phase are modulated by the potential field formed by the atomic assembly inside the sample. After being amplified by an electron lens, the electron wave near the optical axis is mainly reconstructed into a projection image of the sample's potential field (also known as a high-resolution image) through phase interference.

explanation_cn: 分为高一次成形性镁合金和高二次成形性镁I合金，利用现有工业技术和装备生产。这些材料具有弱/非基面织构特征，晶粒尺寸在lO微米左右。
explanation_en: It is divided into high primary formability magnesium alloy and high secondary formability magnesium I alloy, which are produced using existing industrial technology and equipment. These materials have weak/non base texture characteristics, and the grain size is about lO μ m.

explanation_cn: 指的是通过提高储存压力来增加氢气储存密度的储氢方式。高压气态储氢根据储氢容器的不同使用要求分为固定式高压储氢、车载轻质高压储氢和运输高压储氢。随着高压气态储氢压力的不断提高，储氢密度增加的速度越来越慢，氢系统面临的常温高压氢脆问题也日益突出。为突破这些制约因素，科学家提出了一些将高压储氢和其他储氢方式相结合的复合储氢方式，如金属氢化物高压储氢和绝热高压储氢等。
explanation_en: It refers to the hydrogen storage mode that increases the density of hydrogen storage by increasing the storage pressure. High-pressure gaseous hydrogen storage can be divided into fixed high-pressure hydrogen storage, vehicle mounted lightweight high-pressure hydrogen storage and transportation high-pressure hydrogen storage according to different use requirements of hydrogen storage containers. With the continuous increase of high-pressure gaseous hydrogen storage pressure, the increase rate of hydrogen storage density is becoming slower and slower, and the problem of hydrogen embrittlement faced by hydrogen systems at room temperature and high pressure is becoming increasingly prominent. In order to overcome these constraints, scientists have proposed some composition hydrogen storage methods that combine high-pressure hydrogen storage with other hydrogen storage methods, such as metal hydride high-pressure hydrogen storage and adiabatic high-pressure hydrogen storage.

explanation_cn: 用加速电压超过500kV电子显微镜对试样进行显微分析的技术。高压电镜由照明系统、试样室、成像系统、观察室、真空系统、高压缸和控制部分组成，与常规电子显微镜的主要区别在于其加速电压很高、透镜的励磁电流强。其试样室很大，可以安装各种试样台.如加热台和冷却台、各种温度条件下的拉伸台和低周疲劳台.研究气体与同体表面作用的环境室及观察畴壁运动的磁畴附件等。还可以进行动态观察及摄像记录。高压电子显微术的主要特点是：①分辨率高，点分辨率已达到0.1nm
explanation_en: A technique for conducting microscopic analysis of specimens using an electron microscope with an accelerated voltage exceeding 500kV. The high-voltage electron microscope consists of an illumination system, a sample chamber, an imaging system, an observation chamber, a vacuum system, a high-pressure cylinder, and a control part. The main difference from conventional electron microscopes is that their acceleration voltage is very high and the excitation current of the lens is strong. Its sample chamber is very large, and can be installed with various sample tables, such as heating table and cooling table, stretching table and low cycle fatigue table under various temperature conditions, environmental chamber for studying the interaction between gas and the same body surface, magnetic domain accessories for observing the movement of domain walls, etc. It can also perform dynamic observation and video recording. The main characteristics of high voilage electron microscopy are: ① High resolution, point resolution has reached 0.1 nm

explanation_cn: 用于交流350V以上的电瓷为高压电瓷。
explanation_en: The electric porcelain used for AC above 350V is high-vohage eltictric porcelain.

explanation_cn: 一种用于耐高压电容器的陶瓷材料。介电强度（击穿场强）是高压陶瓷的一个重要的指标。这类陶瓷材料主要包括以钛酸钡为基的改性的固溶体陶瓷。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a ceramics materials used for high-voltage resistant capacitors. Dielectric strength (breakdown field strength) is an important index of high voilage ceramics. Such ceramics materials mainly include modified solid solution ceramics based on barium titanate.

explanation_cn: 又称保偏光纤。HB光纤（或简称PM光纤）在光纤通信与光纤传感技术中有十分重要的应用。
explanation_en: It is also called polarization maintaining optical fiber. HB optical fiber (or PM optical fiber for short) has very important applications in optical fiber communication and optical fiber sensing technology.

explanation_cn: 具有增加反射功能的光学薄膜。一般分为两大类，金属反射膜和全电介质反射膜，或两者结合起来的金属电介质反射膜。金属反射膜利用一般金属具有较大的消光系数，进入金属内部的光振幅迅速衰减，光能相应减少而增加反射光能。
explanation_en: Optical coating with increased reflection function. Generally, it can be divided into two categories: metal optical reflection film and all dielectric optical reflection film, or metal dielectric optical reflection film combining the two. Metal reflective films utilize the large extinction coefficient of general metals, and the amplitude of light entering the metal rapidly decays, resulting in a corresponding decrease in light energy and an increase in reflected light energy.

explanation_cn: 高反射阳极材料一般是在顶发光有机发光器件中具有高反射率的像素电极材料，其主要是由高反射率的金属材料和高功函数的透明阳极材料组成，高反射率的金属材料一般使用银（Ag)、铝（Al)等材料，透明阳极材料一般使用氧化物半导体材料。
explanation_en: The high reflex anode materials is generally a pixel electrode materials with high reflectivity in the top luminescence organic luminescence devices, which is mainly composed of metallic materials with high reflectivity and transparent anode materials with high work function. The metallic materials with high reflectivity generally use materials such as silver (Ag), aluminum (Al), and the transparent anode materials generally use oxide semiconductor materials.

explanation_cn: 以反式结构为主（大于76%)的丁二烯和苯乙烯的共聚物。合成方法采用配位聚合和阴离子聚合。相比较而言，阴离子聚合体系在聚合过程和产品性能方面有优势。阴离子聚合引发剂体系有多金属体系，如Li/Mg/K体系；双金属体系，如Li/Ba体系。高反式丁苯橡胶拉伸强度大，抗湿滑性能优异，能够用于轮胎等领域。
explanation_en: Copolymer of butadiene and styrene with trans structure as the main structure (more than 76%). Coordination polymerization and anion polymerization were used for the synthesis. In comparison, anion polymerization system has advantages in polymerization process and product performance. The initiator system of anion polymerization includes polymetallic system, such as Li/Mg/K system; Bimetallic systems, such as Li/Ba systems. High trans styrene-butadiene rubber has high tensile strength and excellent wet skid resistance, and can be used in tire and other fields.

explanation_cn: 是一种新型的功能高分子材料，它能够在瞬间吸收水分并膨润成凝胶状的树脂，该凝胶在一定压力下仍能保持住水分而不分离出来。它的吸收能力吋达自重数百倍，甚至高达1000倍以上。高吸水性树脂通常是将水溶性高分子通过适度交联的方法制得的。
explanation_en: It is a new type of functional macromolecule materials, which can absorb water in an instant and swell into a gel like resin. The gel can still retain water without separation under certain pressure. Its absorption capacity can reach hundreds of times its own weight, or even over 1000 times. Supper absorbent polymer is usually made of water soluble polymer through moderate crosslinking.

explanation_cn: 指在标准状态下，在水中浸渍和离心脱水后，水分保持率在15%以上的，经物理改性或化学改性后的吸水性合成纤维。合成纤维吸水能力的提高的基本原理是：改变合成纤维的形貌结构，利用毛细效应，提高吸水能力；同时提高纤维表面的亲水性，使水能够浸润毛细结构的表面。
explanation_en: It refers to the water absorbent synthetic fiber that is physically or chemically modified and has a water retention rate of more than 15% after immersion in water and centrifugal dehydration under the standard state. The basic principles of improving the water absorption capacity of synthetic fiber are: changing the morphology and structure of synthetic fiber, using capillary effect to improve the water absorption capacity; Simultaneously improving the hydrophilicity of the fiber surface, allowing water to infiltrate the surface of the capillary structure.

explanation_cn: 见疲劳试验。
explanation_en: See fatigue test.

explanation_cn: 室温下具有较高塑性的铸造镁合金。镁为密排六方晶体结构，一般只能通过基面滑移和孪晶进行塑性变形，独立滑移系少，因而室温下变形困难，塑性、韧性差。一般的高强铸造镁合金由于合金元素含量增加，其塑性成形能力下降，因此高塑性铸造镁合金中合金元素含量一般较低。
explanation_en: Cast magnesium alloy with high plasticity at room temperature. Magnesium is a close packed hexagonal crystal structure. Generally, plastic deformation can only be carried out through base plane slip and twin. There are few independent slip systems, so it is difficult to deform at room temperature, and its plasticity and toughness are poor. The plastic forming ability of ordinary high-strength cast magnesium alloy decreases due to the increase of alloy element content, so the content of alloy element in high plasticity cast magnesium alloy is generally low.

explanation_cn: 指室温伸长率大于15%的铸造镁合金，室温伸长率大于30%的低合金化程度或室温伸长率大于25%的高合金化程度的变形镁合金。目前高塑性铸造镁合金主要有Mg-Sn系合金，并含有少量Al，Zn等合金元素，如Mg-3Sn-3Zn-1Al合金。
explanation_en: It refers to cast magnesium alloy with room temperature elongation greater than 15%, low alloy with room temperature elongation greater than 30%, or wrought magnesium alloy with high alloying degree with room temperature elongation greater than 25%. At present, high plasticity cast magnesium alloy mainly include Mg Sn series alloy, and contain a small amount of Al, Zn and other alloy elements, such as Mg-3Sn-3Zn-1Al alloy.

explanation_cn: 采用一定的方法在光伏玻璃表面镀制一层增透膜。其特性是降低玻璃反射率，有效地提高太阳能电池的光电转换效率。主要应用在太阳能光伏领域。
explanation_en: An antireflective film is coated on the surface of solar photovoltaic glass by a certain method. Its characteristic is to reduce the reflectivity of glass and effectively improve the photo-electric conversion efficiency of solar cell. Mainly used in the field of solar photovoltaic.

explanation_cn: 在静置的基板发热体上生成的热解炭，施以两段高温加压处理而得到，嵌镶度在0.4°以下，物性和单晶石墨相同。
explanation_en: The pyrolytic carbon generated on the stationary substrate heater is obtained by applying two stages of high temperature pressure treatment. The inlay degree is below 0.4 °, and its physical properties are the same as those of single crystal graphite.

name_cn: 高密度光信息记录材料
explanation_cn: 指存储密度达到或超过10^6bit/cm2的无机和有机材料体系，如光盘中用的基本材料。
explanation_en: It refers to the inorganic and organic materials systems with a storage density of 10 ^ 6bit/cm2 or more, such as the basic materials used in optical disks.

explanation_cn: 简称HDF。指密度大于850kg/m3的纤维板，是相对于中密度纤维板而言的。高密度纤维板广泛应用于室内外装潢、办公、高档家私、音响、高级轿车内部装饰，还可用作计算机室抗静电地板、护墙板、防盗门、墙板、隔板等的制作材料。近年来普遍用作强化地板、复合地板的基材。
explanation_en: It is abbreviated as HDF. Refers to fiberboard with a density greater than 850kg/m3, which is relative to medium density fiberboard. High-density fiberboard is widely used in indoor and outdoor decoration, office, high-end furniture, audio, interior decoration of luxury cars, and also can be used as the production materials of anti-static floor, dado, anti-theft door, wallboard, partition, etc. in computer rooms. In recent years, it is widely used as the base material of laminate flooring and composition flooring.

explanation_cn: 见聚乙稀。
explanation_en: See polyethylene.

explanation_cn: 一般含钨85%-98%。合金元素主要有镍、铁、铜。通常分为两大类：钨镍铜系合金和钨镍铁系合金。高密度钨合金通常通过混粉、压制和烧结制成。在烧结过程中，烧结温度高于合金中基体相的熔点而产生液相，加速了合金的烧结过程，使合金迅速致密化并接近于理论密度。高密度钨合金具有高密度、高强度、良好的塑性和切削加工性能、良好的导电性和导热性.膨胀系数低，耐蚀性和抗氧化性好，对射线具有极好的吸收能力。主要用作陀螺仪转子材料、平衡配重材料、穿甲弹弹芯材料、工模具夹具材料、屏蔽材料和仪器仪表材料等。
explanation_en: Generally, it contains 85% -98% tungsten. Alloy elements mainly include nickel, iron and copper. It is generally divided into two categories: tungsten nickel copper alloy and tungsten nickel iron alloy. High density tungsten alloys is usually made by powder mixing, pressing and sintering. In the sintering process, the sintering temperature is higher than the melting point of the phase of the matrix in the alloy to produce a liquid phase, which accelerates the sintering process of the alloy and makes the alloy densification rapidly and close to the theoretical density. High density tungsten alloys has high density, high strength, good plasticity and machinability, good conductivity and thermal conductivity. It has low expansion coefficient, good corrosion resistance and oxidation resistance, and excellent ray absorption ability. It is mainly used as materials of gyroscope rotor, materials of balance weight, materials of armour piercing bullet core, materials of tool and die fixture, shielding materials, materials of instruments and meters, etc.

explanation_cn: 利用石墨烯平面内沿两个方向均匀且超高导热性能而得到的具有良好热传导的石墨片或块体。
explanation_en: The graphite sheet or block with good heat conduction is obtained by using graphene that is uniform in both directions in the plane and has ultra-high thermal conductivity.

explanation_cn: 电阻率小于10Ω·cm的导电功能复合材料，典型材料为碳纤维和金属成分。属于导电功能复合材料的一种。
explanation_en: For electrical conducting functional composite with resistivity less than 10 Ω· cm, typical materials are carbon fiber and metal components. It belongs to electrical conducting functional composite.

explanation_cn: 高导电铜合金成分中铜含量大于99%，且强度中等偏低。最常用的是KFC-1/2H、C1220、C19210等。高导电铜合金一般用于对导电及散热要求高的场合。
explanation_en: The content of copper in high conductive copper alloy is more than 99%, and the strength is medium to low. The most commonly used ones are KFC-1/2H, C1220, C19210, etc. High conductive copper alloy is generally used in occasions with high requirements for conductivity and heat dissipation.

explanation_cn: 又称高岭石黏土、瓷土，是以高岭石为主要矿物成分的黏土。白色，含杂质时染成浅黄、浅褐、浅绿色。土状或致密块。手摸时有滑腻感.干燥时舌舔有黏舌感。有强吸水性，但不膨胀。粉末掺水后具有可塑性、绝缘性和较高的耐火度。化学性质稳定，耐酸性好。化学成分是评价高岭土质量的重要因素，A12O3含量越高.耐火度越高.质量越好。不同产地成分变化大。高岭土广泛用于陶瓷、橡胶、化学、造纸工业。在古代医药中，高岭土称为白石脂，性平，治黄疸、泻痢和邪气肿痛等。主要分布在东南沿海、四川南部、贵州北部、昆明西部、湖北中部等地。风化ü高岭土矿床为主要矿床类型，.沉积型次之，热液型矿床在中国规模较小。中国著名瓷都景德镇的高岭土矿床便属于风化残积型矿床。
explanation_en: Also known as kaolinite clay and china clay, it is clay with kadinite as the main mineral component. White, dyed light yellow, light brown, or light green when containing impurities. Earthy or dense blocks. When touching, there is a feeling of smoothness. When dry, there is a sticky sensation when licking the tongue. Has strong water absorption, but does not expand. The powder mixed with water has plasticity, insulation and higher refractoriness. Stable chemical properties and good acid resistance. Chemical composition is an important factor to evaluate the quality of kaolin. The higher the A12O3 content, the higher the refractoriness and the better the quality. The composition varies greatly among different regions. Kaolin is widely used in ceramics, rubber, chemistry and paper industry. In ancient medicine, kaolin is called white stone fat, which has a flat nature and can cure jaundice, diarrhea, evil qi, swelling and pain. Mainly distributed in the southeast coast, southern Sichuan, northern Guizhou, western Kunming, central Hubei, and other places. The weathered kaolin deposit is the main type of deposit, followed by the sedimentary type, and the hydrothermal type deposit is relatively small in China. The kaolin deposit in the famous porcelain capital of China, Jingdezhen, belongs to the weathering residual type deposit.

explanation_cn: 层状结构硅酸盐矿物。化学式为AL4[Si4O10](OH)8。常有少量Fe、Mg、Cr代替Al。中国江西景德镇的高岭石产于花岗岩风化壳。是优质陶瓷材料，并在橡胶、化学、造纸工业上作为填充剂。
explanation_en: Layered silicate mineral. The chemical formula is AL4 [Si4O10] (OH) 8. There are often small amounts of Fe, Mg, and Cr replacing Al. Kaolinite from Jingdezhen, Jiangxi, China is produced in weathered granite crust. It is a high-quality ceramics materials and serves as a filler in the rubber, chemical and paper industries.

name_en: laser crystal with high average power
explanation_cn: 能满足连续或平均激光输出功率在几百瓦到几千瓦的激光器需求的晶体工作物质。为了获得较高的输出功率，激光晶体不仅需要有较大的跃迁截面和较长的荧光寿命，而且工作物质应有足够大的尺寸和足够好的均匀性。
explanation_en: A crystal working material that can meet the requirements of lasers with continuous or average laser output power of hundreds to thousands of watts. In order to obtain high output power, laser crystal need not only large transition cross sections and long fluorescence lifetime, but also large enough size and good enough uniformity of working materials.

explanation_cn: 简称高弹丝，伸缩性变形丝的一种。一般采用一区加热的假捻法或加捻-定型-解捻法制成。而以前者方法所产质量较好，又较经济。经过假捻，原来平滑的丝变成细小弹簧状卷曲，卷曲伸长率可达170%-250%,可反复拉长到原长度的2-3倍。高弹变形丝用于本身要求高弹性的制品，一般用作针织加H成长筒丝袜、游泳衣等.成品有丰满厚实和贴身的特点。
explanation_en: Abbreviated as high elasticity wire, it is a type of stretchable deformation wire. Generally, a one zone heating method of false twisting or a twisting setting untwisting method is used. The former method produces better quality and is more economical. After false twisting, the originally smooth silk becomes small spring like curls, with a curl elongation of 170% -250%, which can be repeatedly stretched to 2-3 times the original length. High elasticity textured silk is used for products that require high elasticity, usually used for knitting and H long tube stockings, swimming suits, etc. The finished product has the characteristics of plump, thick, and close fitting.

explanation_cn: 具有弹性极限高、滞弹性效应低的一类弹性合金。对这类合金除要求高的弹性极限和低的滞弹性效应外，根据不同应用还要求有耐蚀性、耐高温、无磁性和高的导电性等。高弹性合金按强化类型可分为弥散强化型和变形强化型两种。合金采用真空感应炉熔炼，经过冷热塑性变形制成冷轧带材、冷拉棒材、冷拉线材或热轧材。弹性元件需经适当的时效处理。该类合金适于制作各类膜盒、膜片等弹性敏感元件；弹簧、发条等储能元件；轴尖、仪表轴承等元件和构件。
explanation_en: A kind of elasticity alloy with high elasticity limit and low anelasticity effect. In addition to high elasticity limit and low anelasticity effect, this kind of alloy also requires corrosion resistance, high temperature resistance, non-magnetic and high conductivity according to different applications. High elastic alloy can be divided into dispersion strengthening type and deformation strengthening type according to the strengthening type.
