The alloy is melting in a vacuum induction furnace and made into cold rolled strip, cold drawing bar, cold drawing wire rod or hot rolled steel through cold and hot plastic deformation. Elastic elements shall be subject to appropriate aging treatment. This kind of alloy is suitable for making elasticity sensing elements such as various bellows and diaphragms; Energy storage components such as springs and springs; Components and components such as shaft tips and instrument bearings.

name_en: high strength and middle conductive copper alloy
explanation_cn: 高强中导铜合金以A194合金最为常用。其主要特点是材料强度较高，抗拉强度大于400MPa,硬度大于120HV，中等电导率（大于10%ICAS)。常用的高强中导铜合金有A194、CAC92等。高强中导铜合金一般用于对材料强度要求较高而对导电及散热不是很高的场合，大多数的集成电路引线框架及较薄的分立器件引线框架都使用该材料。例如DIP、SOP、SOT等系列的引线框架。
explanation_en: A194 alloy is the most commonly used high strength and middle conductive copper alloy. Its main characteristics are high strength of materials, tensile strength greater than 400MPa, hardness greater than 120HV, medium electric conductivity (greater than 10% ICAS). The commonly used high strength and middle conductive copper alloy include A194, CAC92, etc. High strength and middle conductive copper alloy is generally used in situations where the strength of materials is required but the conductivity and heat dissipation are not very high. Most integrated circuit leads frames and thin discrete device leads frames use this materials. For example, leads frames of DIP, SOP, SOT and other series.

name_en: low expansion alloy wilh high strength
explanation_cn: 抗拉强度大于llOOMPa，典型成分为FeNi35Co5Ti3合金。
explanation_en: The tensile strength is greater than llOOMPa, and the typical composition is FeNi35Co5Ti3 alloy.

explanation_cn: 单颗粒的平均压缩强度在1.7*10^4kgf/cm2(1kgfcm2=98.0665kPa)以上的磨料级人造金刚石。其代号为JR-3。强度通常在金刚石计上测试。高强度的金刚石晶体比较完整，透明性较好。高强度金刚石除了强度要求外，还有等积形不低于80%(颗粒百分数），连晶体和多晶体不超过3%(颗粒百分数），粒度组成及杂质含量应符合标准规定等。在严格的工艺条件下合成。适用于制造地质砖头，石材加工工具和金属黏合剂砂轮等。
explanation_en: Abrasive grade synthetic diamond whose average compressive strength of single particle is more than 1.7 * 10 ^ 4kgf/cm2 (1kgfcm2=98.0665kPa). Its code name is JR-3. The strength is usually measured on a diamond meter. The high-strength diamond crystal is relatively complete and transparent. In addition to the strength requirements for high strength diamond, there are also isometric requirements of not less than 80% (particle percentage), connected crystal and multi crystal requirements of not more than 3% (particle percentage), particle size composition and impurity content should meet the standard requirements. Synthesized under strict process conditions. It is suitable for making geological bricks, stone processing tools and metal adhesive grinding wheels.

explanation_cn: 又称超硬铝合金。主要是Al-Zn-Mg-Cu系合金。其中锌和镁含量的比值及锌、镁、铜含量的总和不同，合金的性能也不同。锌和镁含量的比值增加，合金的热处理效果增大，强度提高，应力腐蚀敏感性则增大。当锌、镁、铜含量的总和大于9%(质量分数）时，合金的拉伸强度最高。这类合金同溶沉淀强化效果显著，屈服强度和拉伸强度值较为接近，塑性低，缺口敏感性较大，拉伸疲劳极限低，在承载状态下易腐蚀。所以多采用过时效处理，使晶内沉淀物以亚稳态沉淀相为主；改变晶间析出物的大小和分布密度，使晶内和晶界电位势接近，位错数量减少，以改善其抗应力腐蚀性能，减小缺口敏感性。可生产各种锻件和模锻件，广泛用于飞机结构中的主要受力构件。如大梁、桁条、隔框、蒙皮、翼肋、接头、起落架系统零件、液压系统作动筒等。
explanation_en: Also known as super-hard aluminium alloy. Mainly Al-Zn-Mg-Cu series alloys. The properties of alloy vary with the ratio of zinc and magnesium content and the sum of zinc, magnesium and copper content. With the increase of the ratio of zinc to magnesium content, the heat treatment effect, strength and stress corrosion cracking susceptibility of alloy increase. When the total content of zinc, magnesium and copper is more than 9% (mass fraction), the tensile strength of alloy is the highest. This kind of alloy has obvious solution precipitation strengthening effect. The yield strength and tensile strength are relatively close, with low plasticity, large notch sensitivity, low tensile fatigue limit, and easy to corrosion under load. Therefore, over aging treatment is often used to make the intragranular precipitates mainly metastable precipitation phase; Change the size and distribution density of intergranular precipitates to make the potential in the grain and grain boundary close, and reduce the number of dislocation, so as to improve its stress corrosion resistance and reduce the notch sensitivity. It can produce various forgings and die forgings, widely used as the main load-bearing components in aircraft structures. Such as beams, purlins, partitions, skins, wing ribs, joints, landing gear system components, hydraulic system actuators, etc.

explanation_cn: 用于承受较大载荷的机械结构零件的铸造镁合金。其特点是具有高的拉伸强度、高的屈服强度和低的壁厚效应。主要是Mg-Zn-Zr和Mg-Gd-Y-Zr系合金。对于Mg-Zn-Zr系合金，在时效状态下，随着Zn含量的增加，合金的拉伸强度提高。高强度铸造镁合金适用于制造承受高应力和高气密性的零件.特别是薄壁优质铸件。
explanation_en: Cast magnesium alloy used for mechanical structural parts bearing heavy loads. It is characterized by high tensile strength, high yield strength and low wall thickness effect. Mainly Mg Zn Zr and Mg Gd-Y-Zr alloy. For Mg Zn Zr alloy, the tensile strength of alloy increases with the increase of Zn content in aging state. High strength cast magnesium alloy is suitable for manufacturing parts with high stress and high air tightness, especially thin-walled high-quality castings.

name_en: high strength and high modules fiber
explanation_cn: 指拉伸强度大于15cN/dtex或2GPa、模量高于350cN/dtex或40GPa的纤维。但对于普通的线型聚合物纤维如聚乙烯醇和聚丙烯腈纤维来说，拉伸强度和模量分别高于9cN/dtex和180cN/dteX者，即为高强高模纤维，因此具有相对含义。高强度高模量纤维主要用于制备高性能轮胎帘子线及其他橡胶补强材料，树脂基、陶瓷基、碳基、金属基及混凝土的增强剂，缆绳类、帆布类、防护服、特种电机绝缘材料、防弹背心、防切割和穿刺的工作服等。
explanation_en: Fibers with tensile strength greater than 15cN/dtex or 2GPa and modulus greater than 350cN/dtex or 40GPa. But for ordinary linear polymer fibers such as polyvinyl alcohol and polyacrylonitrile fiber, those with tensile strength and modulus higher than 9cN/dtex and 180cN/dteX respectively are high-strength and high modulus fibers, so they have a relative meaning. High strength and high modules fiber is mainly used to prepare high-performance tire cord and other rubber reinforcing materials, resin based, ceramic based, carbon based, metal based and concrete reinforcing agent, cables, canvas, protective clothing, special motor insulation materials, bulletproof vests, cutting and puncture resistant overalls, etc.

explanation_cn: 采用水泥、砂、石、高效减水剂等外加剂和粉煤灰、超细矿渣、硅灰等矿物掺和料以常规工艺配制的C50-C80级混凝土。具有抗压强度高、抗变形能力强、密度大、孔隙率低等优点。其抗压强度一般为普通混凝土的4-6倍，因此可减小构件的截面，特别适宜于高层建筑；结构、大跨度桥梁结构以及某些特殊结构中应用。
explanation_en: C50-C80 grade concrete is prepared by using cement, sand, stone, superplasticizer and other admixtures and mineral admixtures such as fly ash, ultra-fine slag, silica fume and other conventional processes. It has the advantages of high compressive strength, strong deformation resistance, large density and low porosity. Its compressive strength is generally 4-6 times of that of ordinary concrete, so it can reduce the section of components, especially suitable for high-rise buildings; Applied in structures, large-span bridge structures, and certain special structures.

explanation_cn: 拉伸强度在1100-1400MPa之间的钛合金。它具有优异的锻造工艺性能，可以再760-800°C进行等温或热模锻造，主产精密或半精密模锻件。可在320°C以下长时间工作，已广泛用于制造飞机起落架和机身、机翼中的各种重要受力结构件。
explanation_en: Titanium alloy with tensile strength between 1100-1400MPa. It has excellent forging process performance and can be isothermal or hot die forged at 760-800 ° C, mainly producing precision or semi precision die forgings. It can work for a long time below 320 ° C and has been widely used in the manufacturing of various important load-bearing structural components in aircraft landing gears, fuselage, and wings.

explanation_cn: 室温拉伸强度在1100-1400MPa的铸造钛合金。
explanation_en: Cast titanium alloy with tensile strength of 1100-1400MPa at room temperature.

explanation_cn: 室温拉伸强度极限高于350MPa，同时兼有适当韧性(拉伸断裂伸长率大于4%)的镁合金。高强镁合金按照化学成分可分为Mg-Zn系高强镁合金、Mg-AI系高强镁合金和Mg-RE系高强镁合金。高强镁合金主要通过适当的热加工工艺处理，以固溶强化、细晶强化和析出强化为主要手段获得高强度。
explanation_en: Magnesium alloys with room temperature tensile strength limit higher than 350MPa and appropriate toughness (tensile percentage elongation after fracture greater than 4%). According to chemical composition, high-strength magnesium alloys can be divided into Mg-Zn series high-strength magnesium alloys, Mg-AI series high-strength magnesium alloys, and Mg-RE series high-strength magnesium alloys. High strength magnesium alloy is mainly treated by appropriate hot working process, with solution strengthening, grain refinement strengthening and precipitation strengthening as the main means to obtain high strength.

explanation_cn: 通常指强韧性非常好，广泛应用于航空、航天、兵器、船舶、电子等系统的铸造铝合金。
explanation_en: It usually refers to cast aluminium alloy with excellent strength and toughness, which is widely used in aviation, aerospace, weapons, ships, electronics and other systems.

name_en: high strength and high conduction copper alloy
explanation_cn: 具有高强度的同时还具有较高导电性的铜基合金。这类合金在具有优异导电性能的同时，还具有良好的强度，一般为沉淀强化型铜合金。Cu-Cr-Zr合金时效后拉伸强度达到700MPa时，其导电性能仍然可以保持80%IACS以上，在其导电性能达到90%IACS以上时，其抗拉强度仍然可以保持450MPa以上。主要用来制造集成电路引线框架、高速轨道交通用接触导线、真空开关及高压断路器用触头材料等。由于其价格比其他铜材高，多用于薄型材(材料厚度小于0.2mm)的场合，如多排TSSOP、MSOP框架及蚀刻框架。
explanation_en: Copper based alloy with high strength and high conductivity. This kind of alloy has excellent electrical conductivity and good strength. It is generally a precipitation strengthened copper alloy. When the tensile strength of Cu Cr Zr alloy reaches 700MPa after aging, its conductivity can still maintain above 80% IACS, and when its conductivity reaches above 90% IACS, its tensile strength can still maintain above 450MPa. It is mainly used to manufacture integrated circuit leads frames, contact wires for high-speed rail transit, contact materials for vacuum switches and high-voltage circuit breakers. Because its price is higher than other copper materials, it is mostly used for thin sections (materials thickness is less than 0.2mm), such as multi row TSSOP, MSOP frame and etching frame.

name_en: high strength and high elasticity copper alloy
explanation_cn: 具有高强度和高弹性的铜合金e可分为：①时效强化型Cu-Be系弹性合金；这类合金具有高的弹性极限和耐蚀性，无磁，高导电性和优良的加工性，可锻压和焊接，并且冲击时不产生火花，Cu-2%Be合金经淬火时效处理后，弹性模量为130GPa，拉伸强度为1200MPa;②不含铍的高强度沉淀强化铜合金，这类合金有Cu-Ni-Sn，Cu-Ni-Mn，Cu-Ni-Al等系，可部分作为Cu-Be合金的代用品。上述合金主要用来制造各种载流弹性元件，精密仪表弹性元件，各类继电器用导电弹簧，接触弹簧，各类插拔件，膜片，膜盒和弹簧管，在机械、航空、航天、核、仪器仪表工业以及电子计算机和微电子技术等方面广泛应用。
explanation_en: Copper alloy e with high strength and high elasticity can be divided into: ① aging strengthened Cu Be elasticity alloy; This kind of alloy has high elasticity limit and corrosion resistance, no magnetism, high conductivity and excellent workability, can be forging and pressing and weld, and does not produce sparks during impact. After quenching and aging treatment, Cu-2% Be alloy has a elastic modulus of 130GPa and a tensile strength of 1200MPa; ② High strength precipitation strengthened copper alloy without beryllium. This kind of alloy includes Cu Ni Sn, Cu Ni Mn, Cu Ni Al and other systems, which can be partially used as a substitute for Cu Be alloy. The above alloy are mainly used to manufacture various current carrying elasticity elements, precision instrument elasticity elements, conductive springs for various relays, contact springs, various plug and pull pieces, diaphragms, bellows and spring tubes, and are widely used in machinery, aviation, aerospace, nuclear, instrumentation industries, electronic computers and microelectronics.

explanation_cn: 一种新型高技术混凝土，是在大幅度提卨普通混凝土性能的基础上采用现代混凝土技术制作的混凝土。针对不同的用途要求，对下列性能有重点地予以保证：耐久性、工作性、适用性，强度、体积稳定性、经济性等。
explanation_en: A new type of high-tech concrete is concrete made by modern concrete technology on the basis of greatly improving the performance of ordinary concrete. For different usage requirements, the following performance should be guaranteed with emphasis: durability, workability, applicability, strength, volume stability, economy, etc.

explanation_cn: 主要指物理机械性能和热性能等十分突出的合成纤维，又称特种纤维。按性能可分为高强度高模量纤维、耐高温纤维、抗燃纤维、耐强腐蚀纤维等。高强度高模量纤维在拉伸强度和模量方面，为所有纤维之冠，比强度和比模量极高；而耐高温纤维在抗热老化性方面居化学纤维之首。这些纤维有些还具有一定的阻燃性、抗辐射性、抗酸碱、耐腐蚀性和有机溶剂性。有机高性能纤维大都采用低温溶液缩聚和干法、湿法或干喷-湿法纺丝制备；而无机高分子类的高性能纤维.大都采用有机前躯体（如聚丙烯腈原丝、沥青纤维、聚碳硅烷等）纤维经几步高温热处理而得。有些纤维先采用传统的纺丝技术纺出线型或分子量较低的纤维，然后再分别进行环化、交联、金属螯合、高温热处理、表面物理化学处理或等离子体处理等T.序制得成品纤维：还有的需要采用乳液纺丝、反应纺丝、液晶纺丝、相分离纺丝、高速气流熔融喷射和特殊的复合纺丝技术等新型纺丝工艺制备。其主要用于制备高性能复合材料、轮胎与橡胶骨架材料、缆绳类、石棉代用品、体育用品、防护服、气液体滤材、绝缘和绝热材料、摩擦与制动材料、光缆增强芯和新型建材等.应用领域十分广阔。
explanation_en: It mainly refers to synthetic fiber with outstanding physical, mechanical and thermal properties, also known as special fiber. According to performance, it can be divided into high strength and high modules fiber, high-temperature resistant fiber, antiflame fiber, strong corrosion resistant fiber, etc. High strength and high modules fiber is the top of all fibers in terms of tensile strength and modulus, and its specific strength and specific modulus are extremely high; High temperature resistant fiber ranks first in terms of thermal aging resistance of man-made fiber. Some of these fibers also have certain flame retardancy, radiation resistance, acid and alkali resistance, corrosion resistance and organic solvent resistance. Organic high-performance fibers are mostly prepared by low temperature solution polycondensation and dry, wet or dry jet wet spinning; The high performance fiher of inorganic polymer are mostly made of organic precursor fibers (such as polyacrylonitrile precursor, pitch fiber, polycarbosilane, etc.) after several steps of high temperature heat treatment. Some fibers use traditional spinning technology to spin linear or low molecular weight fibers first, and then cyclization, crosslinking, metal chelation, high temperature heat treatment, surface physical chemistry treatment or plasma treatment are respectively carried out to prepare finished fibers; others need to use new spinning processes such as lotion spinning, reactive spinning, liquid crystal spinning, phase separation spinning, high-speed airflow melting jet and special composition spinning technology. It is mainly used to prepare high-performance composite materials, tires and rubber framework materials, cables, asbestos substitutes, sporting goods, protective clothing, gas-liquid filter materials, insulation and thermal insulation materials, friction and braking materials, optical cable reinforcement cores and new building materials. Its application fields are very wide.

explanation_cn: 系高抗冲聚苯乙烯，又称接枝型高冲击强度聚苯乙烯，是由本体-悬浮聚合与本体聚合两种方法制得的。主要用于家电产品外壳、汽车及医疗器具零部件、排水管道、玩具等。
explanation_en: High impact polystyrene, also known as grafted high impact strength polystyrene, is prepared by two methods of bulk suspension polymerization and bulk polymerization. Mainly used for home appliance product casings, automotive and medical equipment components, drainage pipes, toys, etc.

explanation_cn: 沸水收缩率超过20%的化学纤维。高收缩纤维的收缩本质，是可回复的高弹形变，来于非晶区的熵形变。当非晶区中的大分子在较高温度下受力伸直取向后骤冷，链段运动被暂时"冻结"，大分子保持伸直状态，再在无张力下加热到较高温度，伸直取向大分子会自动回复成卷曲状态，使纤维产生收缩。高收缩聚酯纤维与其他纤维混纺或交织.可以制成各种皱、泡泡纱、凹凸提花织物，以及具有特殊风格的丰满致密织物。高收缩聚酰胺纤维可用作造纸毛毯。
explanation_en: Man-made fiber whose boiling water shrinkage exceeds 20%. The shrinkage essence of high shrinkage fiber is recovery high elastic deformation, which comes from the entropy deformation in the amorphous region. When the macromolecule in the amorphous region is forced to straighten the orientation at a higher temperature and then suddenly cools, the movement of chain segment is temporarily "frozen", and the macromolecule remains straightened, and then heated to a higher temperature under no tension, the straightened orientation macromolecule will automatically recovery to a crimped state, making the fiber shrink. High shrinkage polyester fiber fiber can be blended or interwoven with other fibers to make various wrinkled, seersucker, concave and convex jacquard fabrics, as well as full and dense fabrics with special styles. High shrinkage polyamide fiber can be used as papermaking blanket.

explanation_cn: 以Mn75Ni15Cu10或Mn72Ni10Cu18合金为主动层，以FeNi36合金为被动层组成的具有特高热敏性能的热双金属。
explanation_en: A thermal bimetal with extremely high thermal sensitivity is composed of Mn75Ni15Cu10 or Mn72Ni10Cu18 alloy as the active layer and FeNi36 alloy as the passive layer.

explanation_cn: 末端距的统计分布符合高斯分布函数的高分子链，并且满足以下假定的髙分子链：①可以划分为多个统计单元；②每个统计单元等长度且为刚性；③统计单元间为自由联结；④分子链不占有体积。
explanation_en: The statistical distribution of end toend clistanct conforms to the macromolecule chain with Gaussian distribution function and meets the following assumptions: ① it can be divided into multiple statistical units; ② Each statistical unit is of equal length and rigid; ③ Free connections between statistical units; ④ Molecular chains do not occupy volume.

name_en: tantalum power with high specific capacity
explanation_cn: 是针对片式电容器汗发的高电容量钽粉，其金属杂质元素含量<10X10^-6水平，其电容量一般在4000-15000μF·V/g。其制取方法有气相镁还原法、钠还原法、氧化钽碳还原钽粉烧结法等，用于生产笔记本电脑、收集、便携式消费类电器用电容器。
explanation_en: It is a high capacity tantalum powder for chip capacitors, with a metal impurity element content of<10X10 ^ -6, and a capacitance of generally 4000-15000 μ F · V/g. The production methods include gas-phase magnesium reduction method, sodium reduction method, tantalum oxide carbon reduction tantalum powder sintering method, etc., which are used for the production of laptops, collection, and portable consumer electrical capacitors.

explanation_cn: 气体发生剂的一种，是一种以烟火燃烧方法产生气体的烟火药剂，一般由富氮化合物、氧化剂及燃速调节剂等添加剂组成，富氮化合物一般有四唑类、四嗪类、呋喃类化合物，其含氮量大于70%。
explanation_en: One kind of gas generating composition is a pyrotechnic composition that produces gas by pyrotechnic combustion. It is generally composed of nitrogen rich compounds, oxidizer, burning rate regulator and other additive. Nitrogen rich compounds generally include tetrazole, tetrazine and furan compounds, and their nitrogen content is more than 70%.

explanation_cn: 高氮化合物（叠氮化合物、多氮化合物）是指分子结构中含有多个氮原子直接相连结构的化合物，其中全部由氮元素组成的多氮化合物为全氮化合物（包括氮簇化合物）。多氮化合物高氮低碳氢含量且分子内具有髙张力等特征，普遍具有正的生成热，易于实现氧平衡，分解产物无污染，是理想的高能量密度材料。
explanation_en: High-nitrogen compounds (azide compounds, multi nitrogen compounds) refer to compounds with multiple nitrogen atoms directly connected to each other in the molecular structure, of which the multi nitrogen compounds composed of all nitrogen elements are total nitrogen compounds (including nitrogen cluster compounds). Multi nitrogen compounds are characterized by high nitrogen and low hydrocarbon content and high tension within the molecule. They generally have positive heat of formation, are easy to achieve oxygen balance, and the decomposition products are pollution-free. They are ideal high energy density materials.

explanation_cn: 一种以聚甲醛树脂为基材，加入固体或液体润滑组分的改性聚甲醛。具有摩擦系数低、耐磨耗性优良、极限PV(峰压）值高等特点。产品主要用于制作耐磨部件，如齿轮、轴套、轴衬、滑块等，广泛用于汽车、机械、仪表、电气等行业。
explanation_en: The utility model relates to a modified polyoxymethylene with polyoxymethylene resin as the base material and solid or liquid lubricating components added. It has the characteristics of low friction coefficient, excellent wear resistance, and high ultimate PV (peak pressure) value. The product is mainly used for making wear-resistant components, such as gears, shaft sleeves, bushings, sliders, etc., and is widely used in industries such as automobiles, machinery, instruments, electrical, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称超合金。铁基、镍基和钴基高温合金的总称。是指能够在600°C以上高温下使用，能承受较大复杂应力，并具有表面稳定性的高合金化铁基或镍基、钴基奥氏体金属材料。高温合金在高温下有很高的持久、抗蠕变和疲劳强度，其使用温度达达到1100C。
explanation_en: Also called superaalloy. The general term of iron base, nickel base and cobalt-base superalloy. It refers to high alloy iron base or nickel base or cobalt base austenitic metallic materials that can be used at high temperature above 600 ° C, can withstand large complex stress and have surface stability. High temperature alloy has high endurance, creep resistance and fatigue strength at high temperature, and its service temperature reaches 1100C.

explanation_cn: 高温恒弹性合金使用温度在500°C以上范围，要求其弹性模量温度系数或频率温度系数很小。
explanation_en: The use temperature of high temperature constant modulus alloy is above 500 ° C, and its elastic modulus temperature coefficient or frequency temperature coefficient is required to be very small.

explanation_cn: 在抗氧化性能差的基体表面喷涂或刷镀一些耐高温、抗氧化性能好的材料，形成结合良好、具有高温抗氧化功能的表面改性涂层。
explanation_en: Spray or brush plating some materials with high temperature resistance and good oxidation resistance on the surface of matrix with poor oxidation resistance to form a surface modified coating with good bonding and high temperature oxidation resistance.

name_en: high temperature gas-cooled reactor fuel element
explanation_cn: 一种由包覆燃料颗粒和石墨基体材料制成的全陶瓷燃料元件。反应堆燃料元件的基本功能是有效地导出核裂变释放出来的能量，最大限度地包容燃料和核裂变产生的放射性产物，以保证工作人员和环境的安全。包覆燃料颗粒的主要功能是包容燃料和裂变产物。石墨基体材料弥散包覆燃料颗粒，以制成一定的尺寸和形状，有效地导出核裂变能。石墨也是燃料元件的结构材料和反应堆的慢化剂，此外还滞留一部分裂变产物。根据形状，可分为球形燃料元件和柱状燃料元件两大类。前者是直径为60mm的石墨球.其中间50mm为弥散包覆燃料颗粒的燃料区，外面5mm为石墨包壳；后者把包覆燃料颗粒弥散在石墨基体里制成小圆柱或短管，装到对边宽度为360mm、高500-800mm、打有燃料孔道和冷却剂孔道的正六边形石墨块中而成。高温堆燃料元件的主要特点是：组分是耐高温的陶瓷材料，可在1250°C下长期运行，反应堆冷却剂出口温度可达950°C以上，短期运行温度达1600°C,拓宽了核能应用领域，中子利用系数高，燃料燃耗深，提高了反应堆的经济性和安全性。

explanation_cn: 高温下金属与环境中的氧反应形成氧化物的过程。
explanation_en: The process of metal reacting with oxygen in the environment to form oxides at high temperatures.

explanation_cn: 涂覆在运动物体表面，可在700-1800°C高温减少互相接触的运动物体之间的摩擦力，从而满足某一要求的一类涂层。一个性能良好的高温润滑涂层应该是：①具有很低的剪切强度，从而可降低运动物体间的直接摩擦力；②具有在高温下保护运动物体的基材不被气氛介质腐蚀的能力，在大多情况下，气氛介质为氧气，因而抗氧化十分重要；③对运动物体起绝热作用.使运动物体获得较均匀的机械受力。高温润滑涂层一般有玻璃型和陶瓷型两大类。玻璃铟润滑涂层具有较好的高温润滑性但抗氧性较差；陶瓷型润滑涂层以氧化物、硫化物、硒化物、氟化物和石墨等具有可滑移晶面的晶体作为润滑介质加黏结剂组成，润滑性相对差一些但抗氧化保护性能较好。高温润滑涂层主要用于金属热加工，降低金属工件的加工压力，提高工件质量。按不同热加工要求，可分为热轧保护涂层、热挤压涂层以及高温模锻涂层等。
explanation_en: A type of coating applied to the surface of moving objects, which can reduce the friction between moving objects in contact at a high temperature of 700-1800 ° C, thereby meeting a certain requirement. A higli-temperatLire lubricating coating with good performance should be: ① it has very low shear strength, which can reduce the direct friction between moving objects; ② It has the ability to protect the substrate of moving objects from corrosion by the atmosphere medium at high temperature. In most cases, the atmosphere medium is oxygen, so oxidation resistance is very important; ③ Provide insulation to moving objects, allowing them to receive a more uniform mechanical force. Higli-temperatLire lubricating coating generally includes glass type and ceramics type. Glass indium lubricating coating has good high-temperature lubricity but poor oxygen resistance; The ceramics type lubricating coating is composed of oxide, sulfide, selenide, fluoride, graphite and other crystal with sliding crystal planes as the lubricating medium plus adhesive. The lubricating property is relatively poor but the anti-oxidation protection performance is good. Higli-temperatLire lubricating coating is mainly used for metal hot working to reduce the processing pressure of metal workpiece and improve the quality of workpiece. According to different hot working requirements, it can be divided into hot rolling protective coating, hot extrusion coating and high-temperature die forging coating.

explanation_cn: 工作温度在350°C以上的热敏陶瓷。主要有ZrO2系，Cr203-Al2O3系，PrFeO3系，SiC系陶瓷。主要特性：电阻-温度特性，电压-电流特性（静特性），电阻时间特性。用于温度监测与控制.电炉温度补偿，真空度、湿度及流速检测。
explanation_en: Thermosensitive ceramics with operating temperature above 350 ° C. There are mainly ZrO2 system, Cr203-Al2O3 system, PrFeO3 system and SiC system ceramics. Main characteristics: resistance temperature characteristics, voltage current characteristics (static characteristics), resistance time characteristics. It is used for temperature monitoring and control, electric furnace temperature compensation, vacuum degree, humidity and flow rate detection.

explanation_cn: 在高温下能对工件起绝缘作用的表面涂层。该涂层大致分为两类：①是由聚合物涂覆于导体表面构成绝缘膜，起到绝缘防护作用，在高温(250°C)下亦能保持良好的热态强度及介电性能，又称为高温绝缘漆，主要用于漆包线、线圈绕组、耐热电动机以及电器等方面。②无机高温电绝缘涂层，能耐更高的温度，如高温搪瓷到700°C；,磷酸盐为基的无机黏结剂涂层到1000°C，。
explanation_en: A surface coating that can provide insulation to the workpiece at high temperatures. The coating can be roughly divided into two categories: ① it is an insulating film formed by polymer coating on the surface of conductor, which plays an insulating and protective role. It can also maintain good thermal strength and dielectric properties at high temperature (250 ° C), also known as high-temperature insulating paint, and is mainly used for enameled wires, coil windings, heat-resistant motors, electrical appliances, etc. ② Inorganic high-temperature electrical insulating coating can withstand higher temperatures, such as high temperature enamel to 700 ° C;, Phosphate based inorganic adhesive coating to 1000 ° C,.

explanation_cn: 经加热方可硫化成弹性体的硅橡胶。分为通用型、低压缩永久变形型、低收缩型和耐溶剂型等品种。具有优异的耐高、低温性能，通用型可在-50-250°C下长期使用；耐臭氧、氧和紫外线照射，在室外可使用20年以上；具有卓越的电气性能，其介电强度、功率因数和绝缘性受温度和频率的变化影响很小，耐电弧寿命是氟橡胶的20倍；无毒、无味、耐生物老化。
explanation_en: Silicone rubber that can be vulcanization into elastomer after heating. It is divided into general type, low compression permanent deformation type, low shrinkage type, and solvent resistant type. With excellent high and low temperature resistance, the universal model can be used for a long time at -50-250 ° C; Resistant to ozone, oxygen, and ultraviolet radiation, can be used outdoors for more than 20 years; It has excellent electrical performance, its dielectric strength, power factor and insulation are little affected by changes in temperature and frequency, and its arc resistance life is 20 times that of fluorine rubber; Non toxic, tasteless, biological aging resistant.

explanation_cn: 又称热磨损。在摩擦过程中由于高温导致软化、熔化或蒸发使材料从表面上的去除过程。空间飞行器在大气层的飞行过程中其外层表面由于与空气摩擦而产生高温所引起的烧蚀磨损，也包括在高温磨损之中。高温时原子从一固体析出扩散至另一固体的磨损，有时也称为高温磨损。高温磨损并不都是严重磨损，例如材料熔化局限于很薄的界面层，反可使严重的黏着磨损转变为比较轻微缓慢的去除过程，工业生产中最常见到的是高温磨料磨损。此外，高温下材料的硬度降低而使耐磨性下降、氧化或硫化等反应有时将加速磨损过程。故为适应高温磨损工况，在选择耐磨材料时应注意其高温强度和抗氧化性能，同时还要考虑耐磨材料在高温下的变化。
explanation_en: Also called thermal wear. The removal of materials from the surface due to bating, melting or evaporation caused by high temperature during friction. The ablation wear caused by the high temperature of the outer surface of the spacecraft due to friction with the air during the flight in the atmosphere is also included in the high temperature wear. The wear that atoms precipitate from one solid and diffusion to another at high temperature is sometimes called high temperature wear. High temperature wear is not all serious wear. For example, materials melting is limited to a very thin interface layer, which can make serious adhesive wear transformation into a slightly slow removal process. High temperature abrasive wear is the most common in industrial production. In addition, the reduction of hardness of materials at high temperature will reduce wear resistance, and oxidation or vulcanization and other reactions will sometimes accelerate the wear process. Therefore, in order to adapt to high temperature wear conditions, attention should be paid to the high-temperature strength and oxidation resistance of wear resisting materials when selecting them, and the changes of wear resisting materials at high temperatures should also be considered.
