name_en: high-temperature wear-resistant corrosion-resistant metal silicide alloy
explanation_cn: 该合金材料主要由Cr、Ni、Si三种金属元素组成，其Ni的质量分数为30%-53%、Cr的质量分数为42%-65%、Si的质量分数为3.6%-10%。该合金材料可广泛应用于电力、能源、石油、化工、有色金属冶金、钢铁冶金等工业中大量存在的、在高温氧化及腐蚀等环境下承受摩擦磨损作用的机械运动副零部件。
explanation_en: The alloy materials is mainly composed of Cr, Ni and Si. The mass fraction of Ni, Cr and Si is 30% -53%, 42% -65% and 3.6% -10% respectively. The alloy materials can be widely used in the mechanical motion parts and components that exist in a large number of industries such as power, energy, petroleum, chemical industry, non-ferrous metal metallurgy, iron and steel metallurgy, and withstand friction and wear under high temperalure oxidation, corrosion and other environments.

explanation_cn: 在高温下含氢物质发生裂解生成氢气的过程。
explanation_en: The process of cracking hydrogen containing substances at high temperatures to produce hydrogen gas.

name_cn: 高温超导功能复合材料
explanation_cn: 以金属为基体，与YBa2Cu3O7等高温超导材料复合而制成的线材和带材。但高温超导体（陶瓷材料）是脆性的，不可能制成具有一定韧性的连续体。
explanation_en: Wire rod and strip made of metal as the matrix and composition with high temperature superconducting material such as YBa2Cu3O7. However, high-temperature superconductor (ceramics materials) is brittle and cannot be made into a continuum with certain toughness.

explanation_cn: 具有高临界转变温度，能在液氮温度条件下工作的超导材料。因主要是氧化物材料，故乂称高温氧化物超导材料。高温超导材料不但超导转变温度高，而且成分多是以铜为主要元素的多元金属氧化物。氧含量不确定，具有陶瓷性质。
explanation_en: Superconducting materials with high critical transformation temperature and can work at liquid nitrogen temperature. It is mainly oxide materials, so it is called high temperature oxide superconducting materials. High temperature superconducting material not only have high superconducting transition temperature, but also are mostly composed of multi metal oxides with copper as the main element. The oxygen content is uncertain and has ceramics properties.

explanation_cn: 采用高温超导线（或带）取代常规的铜导线绕制电机的励磁绕组或电枢绕组而制作成的电机。由于超导线的电流密度要比铜导线高约2个数量级而几乎无焦耳热损耗，因此具有一系列的技术和经济特性。
explanation_en: A motor made by using high-temperature superconductors (or tapes) instead of conventional copper wires to wound the excitation winding or armature winding of the motor. Since the current density of the super wire is about 2 orders of magnitude higher than that of the copper wire, and there is almost no joule heat loss, it has a series of technical and economic characteristics.

explanation_cn: 电流引线就是指导线，用来传输电流，至于高温超导电流引线，就是通过超导材料来代替普通的导线，如铜丝或银丝。
explanation_en: The current leads is the guide line, which is used to transmit current. As for the high temperature superconducting current leads, it uses superconducting materials to replace ordinary wires, such as copper wire or silver wire.

explanation_cn: 由多根高温超导线或带材作为主体绕制而成的超导缆线，称为高温超导电缆。由于高温超导线材通常需要工作在低温环境中，因此高温超导电缆通常也会包括冷却通道。
explanation_en: The superconducting cable, which is wound by multiple high-temperature superconductor wires or tapes as the main body, is called high-temperature superconducting power cable. Since the high-temperature superconducting wire rod usually needs to work in a low-temperature environment, the high-temperature superconducting power cable usually also includes cooling channels.

explanation_cn: 与高温合金相比，其最大的特点是晶体结构中组成元素的原子以长程有序方式排列，原子间结合力强，除金属键外，还有一部分共价键，兼有金属的较好塑性和陶瓷的良好高温强度，表现出一系列的优异性能，如高强度、高弹性模量、较低的蠕变速率、较高的形变硬化率、稳定的组织结构、较小的密度和良好的抗氧化腐蚀性能等，使用温度介于高温合金与高温结构陶瓷材料之间，是很有前途的高温结构材料。
explanation_en: Compared with high temperature alloy, its biggest feature is that the atoms of the constituent elements in the crystal structure are arranged in a long range order, and the bonding force between atoms is strong. In addition to metal bonds, there are also some covalent bond, which have both the better plasticity of metals and the good high-temperature strength of ceramics, showing a series of excellent properties, such as high strength, high elastic modulus, low creep rate, high deformation hardening rate, stable microstructure With small density and good oxidation resistance and corrosion performance, the service temperature is between high temperature alloy and high-temperature structural ceramics materials, which is a promising high-temperature structural materials.

explanation_cn: 在防腐蚀性能差的基体表面涂覆耐高温防腐蚀材料，经反应形成结合良好，且具有电化学保护和物理屏蔽作用的高温防腐蚀涂层。最高耐温可达1700°C,具有在高温下保护基体防腐蚀、抗氧化、封闭、耐磨等作用。广泛应用于航空航天、石油化工、冶金、电力等领域，如高温蒸汽管道、热交换器、高温炉、石油化工裂解装备、发动机部件及排气管防腐等。
explanation_en: The matrix surface with poor anti-corrosion performance is coated with high-temperature anti-corrosion materials, which is reacted to form a high-temperature corrosion resistant coating with good bonding, electrochemical protection and physical shielding. The maximum temperature resistance can reach 1700 ° C, which can protect the matrix from corrosion, oxidation, sealing, wear and other effects under high temperature. Widely used in aerospace, petrochemical, metallurgy, power and other fields, such as high-temperature steam pipelines, heat exchangers, high-temperature furnaces, petrochemical cracking equipment, engine components and exhaust pipe anti-corrosion.

explanation_cn: 一种SiO2含量为96%左右的玻璃。将钠硼硅玻璃经过分相、酸处理、干燥、烧结几步处理即可制得。
explanation_en: A glass with SiO2 content of about 96%. The sodium borosilicate glass can be prepared by phase separation, acid treatment, drying and sintering.

name_cn: 高硅氧玻璃纤维增强体
explanation_cn: 一种氧化物纤维，亦称硅石纤维。高硅氧纤维具有与石英纤维相似的耐高温性，低膨胀，高电阻和高耐久性，但与石英纤维相比强度偏低。熔点1628°C，可于900°C下长期使用，1200°C下短期使用。抗热震性、电绝缘性、绝热隔声性优越。纤维毡或织物可作耐烧蚀和防热复合材料。
explanation_en: A type of oxide fiber, also known as silica fiber. High silica fiber has high temperature resistance, low expansion, high resistance and high durability similar to quartze fiber, but its strength is lower than quartze fiber. The melting point is 1628 ° C, which can be used for a long time at 900 ° C and for a short time at 1200 ° C. Excellent thermal shock resistance, electrical insulation, and insulation and sound insulation. Fiber felt or fabric can be used as ablation resistant and heat resistant composite materials.

explanation_cn: 为Nd、Ta、Ti、Al等元素强化的高镍坡莫合金，Ni元素含量在90%以上，其硬度达到HV200,初始相对磁导率可达30000以上，应用频率髙达20?30kHz,在1kHz下可获得大于3000的有效磁导率。用于制作录音机和磁带机磁头芯片以及微特电机、变压器、传感器、磁放大器等各种高频电感元件铁芯等。
explanation_en: It is a high nickel permalloy strengthened by Nd, Ta, Ti, Al and other elements. The content of Ni element is more than 90%, its hardness is HV200, its initial relative permeability is more than 30000, and its application frequency is up to 20? At 30kHz, an effective magnetic permeability greater than 3000 can be obtained at 1kHz. Used for making magnetic head chips for recorders and tape recorders, as well as various high-frequency inductance components such as iron cores for micro and special motors, transformers, sensors, magnetic amplifiers, etc.

explanation_cn: 又称低碳高硼高温合金，简称BC合金。将适合制作涡轮叶片的一些镍基铸造高温合金的硼含量提高约1个数量，碳含量约降低一个数量级，就形成了一个新的高温合金系列，即BC合金。
explanation_en: Also known as low carbon high boron high-temperature alloy, BC alloy for short. A new high temperature alloy series, BC alloy, is formed by increasing the boron content of some nickel-base cast superalloy suitable for making turbine blades by about one amount and reducing the carbon content by about one order of magnitude.

explanation_cn: 碳含量大于0.6%的钢.常用碳含量为0.6%-1.2%。狭义的低碳钢则是指碳含量在0.6%以上的非合金钢。高碳钢都属于优质钢或特殊质钢。一般必须经过不同形式的热处理后使用。因为碳含量高，热处理后可得到高强度、高硬度及优良的耐磨性，并具有一定的塑性和韧性。高碳钢广泛用于制作工具、模具、弹簧等机械零件。
explanation_en: For steel with carbon content greater than 0.6%, the common carbon content is 0.6% -1.2%. In the narrow sense, low-cardon steel refers to non-alloy steel with a carbon content of more than 0.6%. High carbon steel belongs to high-quality steel or special steel. Generally, it must be used after different forms of heat treatment. Because of the high carbon content, high strength, high hardness, excellent wear resistance and certain plasticity and toughness can be obtained after heat treatment. High-carbon steel is widely used to make tools, molds, springs and other mechanical parts.

explanation_cn: 具有大的饱和磁致伸缩（λs)的合金，其λs-般大于30X10^6。
explanation_en: With large saturated magnetostriction（ λ s) Alloy of λ Generally greater than 30X10 ^ 6.

explanation_cn: 三级及三级以上的相变。系统的自由能函数对约束变量的三阶或三阶以上的导函数在相变点不连续的相变。
explanation_en: Third order and above phase transformation. Discontinuous phase transformation at the phase transformation point of the third or more order derivative of the free energy function of the system to the constraint variable.

explanation_cn: 纯度达到99.999%和99.9999%，记为5N和6N的纯钨。高纯或超纯钨最好选用铀和钍的仲钨酸铵作原料，通过多次再结晶去除其他杂质，后经锻烧得到三氧化钨，还原成钨粉；再压形、烧结和电子束悬浮区域熔炼和磁控溅射等方法制备高纯钨材。
explanation_en: Pure tungsten with purity of 99.999% and 99.9999%, denoted as 5N and 6N. The high-purity or ultrapure tungsten should preferably use ammonium paratungstate of uranium and thorium as raw materials, remove other impurities through multiple recrystallization, and then obtain tungsten trioxide through calcination, which is reduced to tungsten powder; The high-purity tungsten materials were prepared by means of recompressing, sintering, electron beam suspension zone melting and magnetron sputtering.

explanation_cn: 指纯度达到99.999%及99.9999%的、记为5N和6N的纯钼。其制取方法中关键的是钼中W、U、Th元素的分离、杂质元素含量的要求和分析方法等均与高纯钨相同(参见高纯钨）。
explanation_en: Pure molybdenum with purity of 99.999% and 99.9999%, denoted as 5N and 6N. The key of its preparation method is that the separation of W, U and Th elements in molybdenum, the requirements for impurity element content and the analysis method are the same as those of high-purity tungsten (see high-purity tungsten).

explanation_cn: 指除钼（含量在1X10^-6-100X10^-6)和气体元素外，其他杂质元素总含量小于20X10^-6的钽材。其制备方法，将钽烧结条经高真空电子束提纯，制成高纯钽铸锭，再塑性加工成需要的材料。
explanation_en: Refers to tantalum materials with a total content of impurities less than 20X10 ^ -6, except for molybdenum (with a content of 1X10-6-100X10 ^ -6) and gas elements. The preparation method includes purifying the tantalum sintering strip by high vacuum electron beam to make high-purity tantalum ingot, and then plastic forming to make the required materials.

explanation_cn: 杂质元素总含量<0.001%的铌称为高纯铌，其相对电阻率（RRR)值≥300,甚至达到了10^4。高纯铌材料采用多次高真空、电子束提纯，多向锻造和高真空下脱除气体杂质退火，保证材料的电阻率。
explanation_en: The niobium with the total content of impurity elements<0.001% is called high-purity niobium, and its relative resistivity (RRR) value is ≥ 300, even up to 10 ^ 4. High-purity niobium materials adopts multiple high vacuum, electron beam purification, multi-directional forging and annealing under high vacuum to remove gas impurities to ensure the resistivity of materials.

explanation_cn: 一般把镁含量99.98%以上的镁锭统称为高纯镁。镁中的杂质如铁、硅、铜、镍等含量有严格的限制，通过严格控制冶炼工艺，大幅降低其杂质含量，使镁的纯净度和耐蚀性大幅度提高，以满足工业需要。
explanation_en: Generally, the magnesium ingots containing more than 99.98% magnesium are collectively referred to as high purity magnesium. The content of impurities in magnesium, such as iron, silicon, copper and nickel, is strictly limited. By strictly controlling the smelting process, the content of impurities is greatly reduced, and the purity and corrosion resistance of magnesium are greatly improved to meet industrial needs.

explanation_cn: 以高聚物为黏结剂的混合炸药，又称塑料黏结炸药。以粉状高能单质炸药为主体，加人黏结剂、增塑剂及钝感剂组成。军事上用于反坦克导弹、水雷、鱼雷、航空炸弹和核战斗部起爆装置，工业上用于石油射孔弹、爆炸成型等。
explanation_en: Composite explosive with high polymer as adhesive is also called plastic bonded explosives. The powder high-energy single explosive is mainly composed of adhesive, plasticizer and deterrent. It is used militarily for anti tank missiles, mines, torpedoes, aviation bombs and nuclear warhead detonating devices, and industrially for oil perforating bombs, explosion molding, etc.

explanation_cn: 使用和勤务处理中安全性好，具有较高生存能力，能量又较高的一类发射药。是一种工作性能满足武器要求，在外界机械撞击、摩擦、热和火焰等作用下不易引起意外爆炸、不易烤燃、不易殉爆的安全性良好，同时其火药力能达到1190J/g的发射药。
explanation_en: It is a kind of gun propellant with good safety, high viability and high energy in use and service handling. It is a kind of gun propellant whose working performance meets the requirements of weapons, and is not easy to cause accidental explosion, bake out and martyrdom explosion under the action of external mechanical impact, friction, heat and flame. It has good safety, and its gunpowder power can reach 1190J/g.

explanation_cn: 主要指能量密度极高的单体炸药及混合炸药,主要以高氮化合物（具体可见相关条目如高能量密度材料、高氮化合物、高能量密度化合物）为其代表。主要用于核武器起爆装置、导弹战斗部、航空炸弹、水中兵器、聚能破甲弹等，也用于特殊情况下的工程爆破。
explanation_en: It mainly refers to monomer explosive and composite explosive with extremely high energy density, mainly represented by high-nitrogen compounds (see relevant items such as high energy density materials, high-nitrogen compounds, and high energy density compounds for details). Mainly used for nuclear weapon initiation devices, missile warheads, aviation bombs, underwater weapons, shaped charge armor piercing shells, and also for engineering blasting in special situations.

explanation_cn: 燃烧温度高、输出热量大的点火药。一般指燃烧热大于6280X10^3Kg的点火药。通常采用氧化能力强的氧化剂和热值较高的可燃剂，如由镁-铝合金、高氯酸钾和硝酸钡等组成.燃烧时产生较大量的高温残渣、一定量的气体，主要用于点燃发火点较高的复合火药。这类点火药的发火点较高，通常不易直接点燃，需要用其他发火点低的点火药来引燃。
explanation_en: Ignition composition with high combustion temperature and large heat output. Generally, it refers to ignition composition with burning heat greater than 6280X10 ^ 3Kg. Generally, oxidizer with strong oxidizing ability and combustible agent with high calorific value, such as magnesium aluminum alloy, potassium perchlorate, barium nitrate, etc., are used. During combustion, a large amount of high-temperature residues and a certain amount of gas are generated, which are mainly used to ignite composite gunpowder with high ignition point. This kind of ignition composition has a high ignition point and is usually not easy to ignite directly. It needs to be ignited with other ignition composition with a low ignition point.

explanation_cn: 利用明显高于滚动球磨的能量实现破碎的制粉方法，其破碎效率明显髙于常规滚动球磨。常用高能球磨设备是行星球磨、振动球磨、搅拌球磨等。髙能球磨过程中，粉体受到球磨介质反复碰撞、剪切、摩擦和压缩多种力的作用，被反复性挤压、变形、断裂、焊合及再挤压变形。甚至达到原子水平的混合，得到合金化的效果。
explanation_en: The pulverization method that utilizes significantly higher energy than rolling ball milling to achieve crushing has significantly higher crushing efficiency than conventional rolling ball milling. Commonly used high-energy ball milling equipment is planetary ball mill, vibration ball mill, stirring ball mill, etc. During high-energy ball milling, the powder is repeatedly extrusion, deformed, fracture, welded and re extrusion by the repeated impact, shear, friction and compression of the ball milling medium. It even reaches the atomic level of mixing to get the effect of alloy.

explanation_cn: 通常指密度大于1.9g/cm3、爆速大于9km/s、爆压大于40GPa的一类含有较高能量和具有较好爆炸性能的含能化合物。高能量密度化合物的能量密度主要和晶体密度、标准生成焓和氧平衡等有关。在高能量密度化合物中通过添加氧化剂、可燃剂、黏结剂及其他添加剂构成的高能量密度化合物的主要作用是添加其他物质形成高能量密度材料，也可直接应用于高能炸药、安全气囊、烟火剂、气体发生剂等方面。
explanation_en: It usually refers to a class of energetic compounds with higher energy and better explosion performance, whose density is greater than 1.9g/cm3, detonation velocity is greater than 9km/s, and detonation pressure is greater than 40GPa. Energy density of the high energy density compound is mainly related to crystal density, standard enthalpy of the formation and oxygen balance. The main function of high energy density compound formed by adding oxidizer, combustible agent, adhesive and other additive to high energy density compound is to add other substances to form high energy density materials, which can also be directly applied to high performance explosives, airbags, pyrotechnics, gas generators, etc.

explanation_cn: 高能量密度材料是20世纪80年代出现的一类新型含能材料，其不仅有较大的能量密度，而且具有可满足各种要求的特殊性能，一般是由高能量密度化合物、氧化剂、可燃剂、黏结剂及其他添加剂构成的高能组合物。高能量密度材料有极强的适用性，可用作各类武器的推进剂、发射药、战斗部装药及火工品药剂。它具有显著提高弹药的能量指标、降低弹药的使用危险性和易损性、增强使用可靠性、延长使用寿命，并减弱目标特征等优点。主要应用于高能钝感炸药、小型推进系统固体燃料、无烟烟火剂、气体发生剂、无焰低温灭火剂等。
explanation_en: High energy density materials is a new type of energetic materials that appeared in the 1980s. It not only has a large energy density, but also has special properties that can meet various requirements. Generally, it is a high-energy composition composed of high energy density compound, oxidizer, combustible agents, adhesive and other additive. High energy density materials have strong applicability and can be used as propellants, gun propellant, warhead charges and initiating explosive devices for various weapons. It has the advantages of significantly improving the energy index of ammunition, reducing the use risk and vulnerability of ammunition, enhancing the use reliability, extending the service life, and weakening the target characteristics. It is mainly used in high-energy insensitive explosive, small propulsion system solid fuel, smokeless pyrotechnic agent, gas generating composition, flameless low temperature extinguishing agent, etc.

name_cn: 高能钴配位化合物起爆药
name_en: high energy cobalt complex primary explosive
explanation_cn: 是配位化合物起爆药最具代表性的一类。
explanation_en: It is the most representative type of complex primary explosive.

explanation_cn: 热膨胀系数高于15*10^-6°C的合金，例如Mn72Ni18Cu和FeNi22Cr3等，主要用作热双金属主动层与低膨胀合金复合成热双金属,或单独作为测温控温器件。
explanation_en: Alloy with thermal expansion coefficient higher than 15 * 10 ^ -6 ° C, such as Mn72Ni18Cu and FeNi22Cr3, are mainly used as thermal bimetallic active layer composition with low expansion alloy to form thermal bimetallic, or as temperature measurement and control devices alone.

name_en: slyrene-butadiene rubber with high styrene content
explanation_cn: 是丁苯橡胶中的一个特殊品种，苯乙烯含量大于40%。苯乙烯含量越高，伸长率越小，多用作其他塑料或橡胶的改性剂，以增加树脂的韧性和橡胶的硬度以及耐磨性。
explanation_en: It is a special variety of styrene-butadiene rubber, with styrene content more than 40%. The higher the styrene content, the smaller the elongation. It is often used as a modifier for other plastics or rubber to increase the toughness of resin, hardness of rubber and wear resistance.

explanation_cn: 经乳液聚合制得的苯乙烯结构单元含量超过50%的丁二烯-苯乙烯共聚物胶乳，合成方法与普通乳聚丁苯橡胶类似。主要用于胶乳涂料、海绵、造纸加工、纺织纤维处理。
explanation_en: Butadiene styrene copolymer latex with more than 50% styrene structural unit content prepared by lotion polymerization is similar to ordinary emulsion polymerized styrene butadiene rubber. Mainly used for latex coatings, sponge, paper processing, textile fiber processing.

name_cn: 高迁移有机/聚合物材料
explanation_cn: 有机聚合物材料的载流子迁移率可以在很大范围内变化，一般将载流子迁移率达到或超过无定形硅的0.1-1cm2/(V·s)迁移率视为高迁移。有机聚合物材料的迁移率十分依赖有关的化学结构、分子排列的有序度、分子间的偶合能力和排列方向等。
explanation_en: The mobility of current carrier of organic polymer materials can vary in a large range. Generally, the mobility of current carrier that reaches or exceeds 0.1-1cm2/(V · s) mobility of amorphous silicon is regarded as high mobility. The mobility of organic polymer materials is very dependent on the relevant chemical structure, the degree of order of molecular arrangement, the coupling ability between molecules and the arrangement direction.

explanation_cn: 使用重锤产生强烈的冲击波，在0.02s内将能量通过压模传给粉末进行致密化，间隔0.3s的一个个附加的冲击波可将密度不断提高，使材料的性能更加优异，成本更加低廉，采用该技术可利用比传统压制小的设备生产超大零件。HVC技术通过强烈的冲击波进行压制，使P/M零件达到高密度，它不仅可以使零件高致密化，而且可以使其密度均匀化。HVC可能是粉末冶金工业寻求低成本高密度材料加工技术的又一次新突破。
explanation_en: Use the heavy hammer to generate a strong shock wave, and transmit the energy to powder for densification through the die within 0.02s. Additional shock waves every 0.3s can continuously improve the density, making materials more excellent in performance and cheaper in cost. Using this technology, oversize parts can be produced with equipment smaller than traditional pressing equipment. HVC technology makes P/M parts reach high density by pressing them with strong shock waves. It can not only make parts highly densification, but also make their density uniform. HVC may be another new breakthrough for powder metallurgy industry to seek low cost and high density materials processing technology.

explanation_cn: 用于高速切削金属的高合金工具钢。原则上属于合金工具钢，但因其性能与用途的特殊性，很多情况下将其分列为一类工具钢。高速钢具有很高的红硬性，当切削工作温度高达600C左右时，硬度仍无明显下降，因而可比低合金刃具钢采用更高的切削速度从而由此得名。通常可分为钨系和钼系两大类.有时还加上高碳高钒高速钢、钴高速钢、超硬高速钢而成为五种类型。近年来还广泛使用粉末高速钢。
explanation_en: High alloy tool steel for high-speed metal cutting. In principle, it belongs to alloy tool steel, but in many cases it is classified as a class of tool steel because of its special properties and uses. High speed steel has a very high red hardness. When the cutting temperature is up to about 600C, the hardness still does not drop significantly, so it can use a higher cutting speed than low alloy cutting tool steel, hence the name. Generally, it can be divided into tungsten system and molybdenum system. Sometimes, high vanadium high speed steel, cobalt high speed steel and super-hard high speed steel are added to form five types. In recent years, powder high speed steel has also been widely used.

explanation_cn: 一种合金白口铸铁。含12%-20%钨及2.5%-3.5%碳，以共晶碳化钨为硬质强化相的耐磨铸铁。由于碳化物硬度高而且孤立分散，高钨铸铁在碾碎性磨料磨损中显示出良好的抗磨性能。
explanation_en: A alloyed white cast iron. Wear resistance cast iron containing 12% -20% tungsten and 2.5% -3.5% carbon, with eutectic carbonization as the hard strengthening phase. Due to the high hardness of carbide and its isolated dispersion, high tungsten cast iron shows good wear resistance in the grinding abrasive wear.

explanation_cn: 主要成分为铁的六价化合物——高铁酸盐，主要用于水处理。其制备方法主要有：高温熔融氧化法、次氯酸盐氧化法、电解法等。
explanation_en: Ferrate, a hexavalent compound mainly composed of iron, is mainly used for water treatment. The main preparation methods include high-temperature melting oxidation method, hypochlorite oxidation method, electrolysis method, etc.

explanation_cn: 含有堇青石的高铝质耐火制品。由高铝原料、人工合成堇青石和结合剂制成。热震稳定性好，可用作陶瓷窑具、热交换器、净化废气的催化剂载体等。
explanation_en: High alumina refractory products containing cordierite. It is made of high alumina raw materials, synthetic cordierite and binder. With good thermal shock resistance, it can be used as ceramics kiln furniture, heat exchanger, catalyst support for purifying waste gas, etc.

explanation_cn: 锻烧后Al2O3>48%,氧化铁含量较低的天然铝土矿。是生产髙铝质耐火材料的主要原料。
explanation_en: Natural bauxite with Al2O3>48% and low iron oxide content after calcination. It is the main raw material for producing high alumina refractory.

explanation_cn: AL2O3含量大于48%的硅酸铝质耐火制品。以高铝矾土、合成莫来石等为主要原料，加人适量黏土等结合剂，混匀后干压成型，干燥后高温烧成。
explanation_en: Aluminum silicate refractory products with an AL2O3 content greater than 48%. High alumina bauxite, synthetic mullite, etc. are used as the main raw materials, and a proper amount of clay and other binders are added. After mixing, they are dry pressing, dried and fired at high temperature.

explanation_cn: 化学成分的特点是：其铬含量显著超过一般高温合金的最高铬含量（20%-25%),达到30%以上。铬含量高，抗氧化、抗腐蚀性能好，而且硬度非常高。高铬高温合金主要用于航空发动机和火箭、导弹发动机的主燃室材料。
explanation_en: The chemical composition is characterized by that its chromium content significantly exceeds the maximum chromium content of general high temperature alloy (20% -25%), reaching more than 30%. High chromium content, good oxidation resistance and corrosion resistance, and very high hardness. High chromium content superalloy is mainly used as main combustion chamber materials of aeroengine, rocket and missile engine.

explanation_cn: 具有高比弹性模量和高阻尼性能的钛合金。这类钛合金具有较低的密度，用于制造飞机发动机高压压气机叶片，从而改善发动机的气动性能和提高发动机的推重比。钛合金的弹性模量既受α相和β相组成的影响，又受晶体取向的影响。
explanation_en: Titanium alloy with high specific elastic modulus and high damping performance. This kind of titanium alloy has low density and is used to manufacture high-pressure compressor blades for aircraft engines, thus improving the aerodynamic performance of the engine and increasing the thrust weight ratio of the engine. The elastic modulus of titanium alloy is α Phase sum β The phase composition is also affected by the orientation of the crystal.

explanation_cn: 用于高压设备，制作高电阻厚膜电阻的材料。高压高阻钌系浆料要求形成的电阻膜内产牛结合形态相似的、均匀的玻璃导电微粒接粗点。当大电压加到这种膜上时，电压梯度将均匀分布，因而可得到很高的电压稳定度。主要用于高压高阻的厚膜电路。
explanation_en: Materials used for making high resistance thick film resistors in high-voltage equipment. High voltage high resistance ruthenium series paste requires that the resistance film formed should produce uniform glass conductive particles with similar bonding morphology. When a large voltage is applied to this type of film, the voltage gradient will be uniformly distributed, resulting in high voltage stability. Mainly used for thick film circuits with high voltage and high resistance.

explanation_cn: 又称顺丁橡胶，指顺式1，4-结构含量大于96%的聚丁二烯橡胶。由于其结构的规整性，与其他结构聚丁二烯比较，生胶有较好的力学：性能、耐磨耗性能及弹性。其硫化胶具有较好的耐氧化性能、耐寒性、耐屈挠性等特点。顺丁橡胶与其他通用橡胶混用，主要用于制造轮胎、胎面等，可显著改善轮胎的耐磨耗性能.提高其使用寿命，还可用于制造其他耐磨制品，如胶鞋、胶管、胶带、胶辊等以及其他耐寒性能要求较高的制品。
explanation_en: Also known as cis-1,4-polybutadiene rubber, it refers to polybutadiene rubber with cis 1,4-structure content greater than 96%. Due to its structural regularity, crude rubber has better mechanical properties, wear resistance and elasticity than polybutadiene with other structures. Its vulcanized rubher has good oxidation resistance, cold resistance, flexing resistance and other characteristics. Cis-1,4-polybutadiene rubber is mixed with other general rubber and mainly used to manufacture tires, tread, etc., which can significantly improve the wear resistance of tires and increase their service life. It can also be used to manufacture other wear resistant products, such as rubber shoes, rubber hoses, tapes, rubber rollers, and other products with high cold resistance requirements.

name_cn: 高顺式1,4-聚异戊二烯橡胶
explanation_cn: 是指含顺式1,4-结构大于96%以上的橡胶，简称异戊橡胶。主要采用溶液聚合方法生产，采用钛系催化剂、锂系催化剂以及稀土催化剂等在烷烃中聚合制得，可在轮胎等橡胶制品和电缆工业中代替天然橡胶。
explanation_en: It refers to rubber containing more than 96% of cis 1,4-structure, referred to as isoprene rubber for short. It is mainly produced by solution polymerization and polymerization in alkanes with titanium catalyst, lithium catalyst and rare earth catalyst. It can replace natural rubber in rubber products such as tires and cable industry.

name_cn: 高频温度稳定介质陶瓷
explanation_cn: 电子电路的主要功能之一是获得精确的谐振点，这便要求电容器介质材料的ε值高度稳定。
explanation_en: One of the main functions of electronic circuits is to obtain accurate resonance points, which requires that the capacitor dielectric materials ε The value is highly stable.

name_cn: 高频温度补偿介质陶瓷
explanation_cn: 在高频振荡回路中，由于电感器及电阻器通常具有正温度系数α，为了保持回路谐振频率的稳定性，则要求电容器介质具有负温度系数，但在其他场合应用中，有时也要求正温度常数。
explanation_en: In high-frequency oscillation circuits, inductors and resistors typically have a positive temperature coefficient α， In order to maintain the stability of the resonant frequency of the circuit, a negative temperature coefficient is required for the capacitor medium, but in other applications, a positive temperature constant is sometimes also required.

explanation_cn: 利用高频电流通过接头区域产生的电阻热进行焊接的方法，按接头配合方式可分为对接和搭接。高频对接缝焊主要用于金属焊管的生产，电流频率为200-500kHz，所需功率与材质、管径、壁厚及焊接速度有关。髙频搭接缝焊主要用于食品罐身及各种内压罐身的纵缝焊接。
explanation_en: The method of weld by using the resistance heat generated by high-frequency current through the joint area can be divided into butt joint and lap joint according to the joint matching mode. High frequency butt seam welding is mainly used for the production of metal welded pipes. The current frequency is 200-500kHz. The required power is related to the material, pipe diameter, wall thickness and weld speed. High frequency lap seam welding is mainly used for longitudinal seam weld of food cans and various internal pressure cans.

name_cn: 高饱和高磁感软磁合金
name_en: high saturation iruluction soft magnetic alloy
explanation_cn: 饱和磁感应强度约为2T的合金，包括电磁纯铁、电工钢、FeCo合金以及Fe16N2等。典型牌号为1J22，具有高的居里点，适于制造在较高温度下工作的铁芯。
explanation_en: Alloy with saturation magnetic induction of about 2T, including soft magnetic iron, electrical steel, FeCo alloy and Fe16N2, etc. The typical brand is 1J22, which has a high curie point and is suitable for manufacturing iron cores operating at higher temperatures.

explanation_cn: 同鲁克棒。
explanation_en: Same as Luke md.

explanation_cn: 又称鲁克杆，是一种植入脊柱矫形器件。为一末端为"L"形的棒与鲁克钢丝联合应用的脊柱矫形闹定器材，利用钢丝横向拉力矫正脊柱畸形。所用材料多为医用不锈钢，也有钴基合金和钛合金。另外，镍钛形状记忆合金也可作为脊柱矫形的材料。
explanation_en: Also known as Luke bar, it is a kind of implantation spinal orthopedic device. It is a spine orthopedic device that is jointly used by a rod with an end of "L" shape and a Luke wire, and uses the transverse tension of wire to correct the spinal deformity. Most of the materials used are medical stainless steel, as well as cobalt based alloy and titanium alloy. In addition, NiTi shape memory alloy can also be used as a materials for spinal orthopedics.

explanation_cn: 鲍林（Pauling)根据离子晶体的晶体化学原理以及当时已测定的晶体结构数据和晶格能公式所反映的关系，通过对一些较简单的离子晶体结构进行分析，提出了判断离子化合物结构稳定性的规则鲍林规则，共包括五条规则。①半径比规则：阳离子的配位数由阳离子和阴离子的半径比决定。②化合价规则：在一个稳定的晶体结构中，每一个阴离子电荷数近似等于相邻阳离子分配给这个阴离子的化合价总和。③共顶、共棱、共面规则：在一个晶体结构中，共用棱，尤其是共用面的存在会降低结构的稳定性。④不同配位多面体连接规则：若晶体结构中含有一种以上的阳离子，则高化合价、低配位的多面体之间尽可能互不连接。⑤简约规则：在同一晶体中，阳离子在给定的晶体结构中倾向于占据相同的局部环境。
explanation_en: According to the crystal chemistry principle of ionic crystal and the relationship reflected by the measured crystal structure data and lattice energy formula at that time, Pauling proposed the rules for judging the structural stability of ionic compounds by analyzing some relatively simple ionic crystal structure, including five rules Pauling's rule. ① Radius ratio rule: the coordination number of cation is determined by the radius ratio of cation and anion. ② Valence rule: in a stable crystal structure, the charge number of each anion is approximately equal to the total valence of the adjacent cations assigned to this anion. ③ Common top, common edge and coplanar rule: In a crystal structure, the existence of common edges, especially common planes, will reduce the stability of the structure. ④ Connection rules of different coordination polyhedra: if the crystal structure contains more than one cation, the polyhedra with high valence and low coordination should not be connected with each other as far as possible. ⑤ Simplicity rule: in the same crystal, cations tend to occupy the same local environment in a given crystal structure.

explanation_cn: 乂称鋪粒灰岩。一种以鲕粒为主要组分的石灰岩。主要组成为碳酸钙，同时还含有燧石、磷酸盐、白云石、赤铁矿或者铁矿。按鲕粒间填隙物成分可分为亮晶鲕灰岩和泥晶鲕灰岩。按鲕粒内部结构，可分为正常鲕灰岩、薄皮鲕灰岩、假鲕灰岩、变鲕灰岩、复鲕灰岩等。它是兼具化学和机械成因的石灰岩，形成于碳酸钙过饱和状态的海、湖波浪活动地带或潮汐通道水流活动地带。它是一种良好的储油岩。
explanation_en: It is called granular limestone. A limestone with oolite as the main component. It is mainly composed of calcium carbonate, and also contains flint, phosphate, dolomite, hematite or iron ore. According to the composition of interstitial materials between oolites, it can be divided into bright crystal oolitic limestone and muddy crystal oolitic limestone. According to the internal structure of oolites, they can be divided into normal oolitic limestone, thin skinned oolitic limestone, pseudo oolitic limestone, meta oolitic limestone, composite oolitic limestone, etc. It is a limestone of both chemical and mechanical origin, formed in the wave activity zone of sea and lake or the current activity zone of tidal channel in the supersaturated state of calcium carbonate. It is a good oil storage rock.

explanation_cn: 从屠宰后的动物身上剥离下来的未经过防腐处理直接用作制革或毛皮生产原料的动物皮。
explanation_en: Animal skins peeled from slaughtered animals and directly used as raw materials for leather making or fur production without preservative treatment.

explanation_cn: 是聚合物熔体不稳定流动的一种表现形式，特征为挤出物表面具有周期性的皱褶波纹，是在模口定型段或出口处形成的.与温度和挤出速度有关。在低剪切速率或应力范围内，挤出物表面光滑均匀，当模口温度较低，剪切速率或剪应力超过某一临界值时，挤出物通常具有粗糙的呈鲨鱼皮状的表面。
explanation_en: It is a manifestation of melt instability of polymer melt, characterized by periodic wrinkles and ripples on the surface of the extrudate, which are formed at the molding section or exit of the die mouth, and are related to temperature and extrusion speed. Within a low shear rate or stress range, the surface of the extruded product is smooth and uniform. When the die temperature is low and the shear rate or stress exceeds a certain critical value, the extruded product usually has a rough shark skin like surface.

explanation_cn: 含水的岛状结构磷酸盐矿物。化学式为NH4Mg(H2O)6[PO4]，有少量铁、锰替代镁。属于斜方晶系，空间群为C2/c。晶体形态变化大，呈短柱状、长柱状、楔状或薄板状。在(001)晶面上呈双晶。该矿物呈无色或白色，透明至半透明，具有玻璃光泽。其解理<001>为中等。莫氏硬度在2到3之间，密度为1.71 g/cm3。这种矿物通常产于鸟粪的硬块中，是由有机物在细菌作用下生成的。它与镁磷石、水磷铵镁石等矿物一起出现。这种矿物通常用作农业肥料。
explanation_en: Water-containing island structured phosphate minerals. The chemical formula is NH4Mg (H2O) 6 [PO4], and a small amount of iron and manganese replace magnesium. It belongs to orthorhombic system, and the space group is C2/c. The shape of crystal varies greatly, which is short columnar, long columnar, wedge-shaped or lamellar. It is twin on the (001) crystal plane. The mineral is colorless or white, transparent to translucent, with glass luster. Its cleavage<001>is considered moderate. Mohs hardness is between 2 and 3, and density is 1.71 g/cm 3。 This mineral is usually found in hard lumps of bird droppings and is generated by organic matter under the action of bacteria. It appears together with minerals such as magnesium phosphate stone and water phosphate ammonium magnesium stone. This mineral is commonly used as agricultural fertilizer.

explanation_cn: 昌化石最著名的品种。主要由迪开石、辰砂组成，并含高岭石、珍珠陶土、硬水铝石、明矾石、黄铁矿和石英等其他矿物。因其中的辰砂色泽艳丽，红色如鸡血，故得此名。
explanation_en: The most famous variety of Chang fossil. It is mainly composed of dickite and cinnabar, and contains kaolinite, pearl clay, diaspore, alunite, pyrite, quartze and other minerals. The cinnabar is named for its bright color and red color like chicken blood.

explanation_cn: 在一定工作压力范围内推进剂燃速压强指数n值小于零，燃速随压力增大而减少的燃烧现象为麦撒燃烧，此种推进剂称麦撒推进剂。当固体火箭发动机工作过程中由于某种原因压力突然增大或喷管受阻时，采用麦撒推进剂装药可使燃烧室力徒升现象减缓，从而起着"安全阀"的作用。麦撒推进剂的燃速温度系数及压力温度系数也较小，对无控火箭的射击密集度十分有利。麦撒推进剂是凋节固体发动机推力和间体燃气发生器流量的一种有效途径。麦撒燃烧多产生在双基推进剂中，是双基推进剂的一个重要分支。麦撒燃烧随推进剂组成不同，产生不同的压力区间，多在低压区(4-lOMPa)，近年来已扩展到9.81-19.6MPa。获得麦撒燃烧的主要方法是加燃速调节剂，例如苯二甲酸铅系复合催化剂可使低能双基推进剂在低压区产生负压力指数。
explanation_en: Within a certain working pressure range, the pressure exponent n-value of propellant burning rate is less than zero. The combustion phenomenon that the burning rate decreases with the increase of pressure is Mesa combustion. This propellant is called mesa propellant. When the pressure suddenly increases or the nozzle is obstructed during the operation of a solid rocket motor due to certain reasons, the use of MaiSa propellant charge can slow down the phenomenon of upward force in the combustion chamber, thus acting as a "safety valve". The burning rate temperature coefficient and pressure temperature coefficient of mesa propellant are also small, which is very beneficial to the fire dispersion of uncontrolled rockets. Mesa propellant is an effective way to reduce the thrust of solid rocket motor and the flow rate of inter body gas generator. Maisa combustion is mainly produced in double base propellant, which is an important branch of double base propellant. Maisa combustion produces different pressure ranges with different propellant compositions, mostly in the low-pressure area (4-lOMPa), which has expanded to 9.81-19.6MPa in recent years. The main method to obtain Maisa combustion is to add burning rate regulators, such as lead phthalate composition catalyst, which can make low-energy double base propellant produce negative pressure index in the low-pressure area.

explanation_cn: 一种被认为具有医疗保健作用的松散岩石。又称长寿石、健康石、矿泉药石、神石。麦饭石的名称是因其外貌而得名的。实际上它是一种中酸性或偏碱性的侵入岩，如二长岩、石英二长岩、二长花岗岩、二长斑岩、闪长玢岩风化的产物。主要矿物成分有斜长石、钾长石、石英、黑云母、角闪石和少量的磷灰石、锆英石等。这些岩石经过风化后，往往形成一些黏土矿物，如高岭石、多水高岭石、蒙脱石、绿泥石、绢云母、水云母、水铝石等。它的治疗保健作用可能与其含有较丰富且易于从岩石中浸出的微量元素有关。此外，原岩风化后形成的黏土矿物具有较强的吸附能力，可净化水体。麦饭石的质量主要取决于它的有益微量元素的含量以及原岩风化蚀变程度。还有，麦饭石可改善所在地地下水水质，增加水体中对人体健康以及植物和作物生长有益的微量元素的含量。
explanation_en: A loose rock considered to have medical and health benefits. It is also called longevity stone, health stone, mineral medicine stone and divine stone. The name of Maifanshi is derived from its appearance. In fact, it is a kind of intermediate acidic or slightly alkaline intrusive rocks, such as monzonite, quartze monzonite, monzonite granite, monzonite porphyry, diorite porphyrite weathering product. The main mineral components are plagioclase, potassium feldspar, quartze, biotite, amphibole and a small amount of apatite, zircon, etc. After weathering, these rock often form some clay mineral, such as kadinite, halloysile, montmorillonite, chlorite, seridte, hydromica, brucite, etc. Its therapeutic and health care effects may be related to its rich trace elements that are easy to leach from rock. In addition, clay mineral formed after weathering of original rocks have strong adsorption capacity, which can purify water. The quality of Maifanshi mainly depends on its beneficial trace element content and the degree of weathering and alteration of the original rock. Furthermore, Maifanshi can improve the groundwater quality in the area and increase the content of trace elements beneficial to human health and plant and crop growth in the water.

explanation_cn: 一种高级变质的区域变质岩石。典型者为细粒，有时为中粒。主要由长石、石英、辉石和石榴石等组成，缺乏含羟基的矿物。花岗变晶(粒状变晶)结构，块状至似片麻状构造。有的麻粒岩含有圆盘状石英或其集合体，被称为麻粒岩结构。按成分可分为基性、中性和酸性麻粒岩。压力超过lGPa的高压麻粒岩由石榴石、单斜辉石、斜长石和石英组成，不含同期的紫苏辉石。压力在0.7-1.0GPa之间的中压麻粒岩中，石英不与石榴石、单斜辉石共生，以石英+斜长石+两种辉石组合及石英+斜长石+石榴石+紫苏辉石的组合最为常见。压力低于O.7GPa的低压麻粒岩中不存在石榴石和单斜辉石的平衡共生组合。富铝者可有石榴石+堇青石+硅线石组合，又称孔兹岩。与石墨、硅线石、蓝宝石等成矿关系密切。
explanation_en: A high-grade metamorphosed regional metamorphic rock. Typically fine grained, sometimes medium grained. It is mainly composed of feldspar, quartze, pyroxene and garnet, and lacks hydroxyl bearing minerals. Granoblastic (granuloblastic) structure, massive to gneissose structure. Some granulite contain disc-shaped quartze or its aggregate, which is called granulite texture. According to composition, it can be divided into basic, neutral and acid granulite. High pressure granulite with pressure exceeding lGPa is composed of garnet, monoclinic pyroxene, plagioclase and quartze, without perilla pyroxene in the same period. In the medium pressure granulite with pressure between 0.7-1.0GPa, quartze is not associated with garnet and monoclinic pyroxene, and quartze+plagioclase+pyroxene combination and quartze+plagioclase+garnet+perilla pyroxene combination are the most common. There is no equilibrium association of garnet and monoclinic pyroxene in low-pressure granulite with pressure lower than 0.7 GPa. The aluminum rich can have garnet+cordierite+sillimanite combination, also known as khondalite. It is closely related to the mineralization of graphite, sillimanite, sapphire, etc.

explanation_cn: 从各种麻类植物的茎、叶片、叶鞘中获得吋供纺织用纤维的统称。麻纤维主要成分是纤维素，并含有一定数量的半纤维素、木质素和果胶等。麻纤维可分为茎纤维和叶纤维两大类。茎纤维又称韧皮纤维或软质纤维，由双子叶植物的茎部剥下的韧皮经微生物或化学脱胶成单纤维或束纤维，它是韧皮部内的一种狹长而厚壁的锐端细胞。韧皮纤维有苎麻、亚森、黄麻、槿麻、大麻、荷麻等多种该纤维的细胞壁木质化或不木质化，均具单纹孔。其中苎麻、亚麻等植物的韧皮纤维不木质化、强度高、湿强比干强高、伸长率小、刚性较大、吸湿和放湿较快、比较柔韧、可纺性能较好，可纯纺，也可与棉或其他化纤混纺，做成衣服后穿着挺括、吸汗、透气凉爽，是夏季服装的良好材料。叶纤维取自单子叶植物，是生长于叶片或叶鞘的维管束纤维，又称硬质纤维。其有剑麻、蕉麻、波罗麻等多种.其中，剑麻和蕉麻是工业生产资源。叶纤维大多分布在热带和亚热带地区，故称“热带麻”，具有坚轫、变形小、强力高、湿强更高、耐海水腐蚀、耐酸碱等特点。剑麻可制作绳缆、绳网、钢索绳芯、防护网等。
explanation_en: A general term for obtaining fibers for textile use from the stems, leaves, and leaf sheaths of various hemp plants. The main component of hemp fiber is cellulose, and contains a certain amount of semi cellulose, lignin and pectin. Bast fiber and leaf fiber can be divided into stem fiber and leaf fiber. Stem fiber is also called stem fiber fiber or soft fiber. The phloem peeled from the stem of dicotyledon plants is degummed into single fiber or bundle fiber through microbial or chemical degumming. It is a narrow, thick walled, sharp cell in the phloem. Stem fiber include ramie, yassen, jute, hibiscus, hemp, lotus, etc. The cell walls of these fibers are lignified or non lignified, and all have single pits. Among them, the phloem fibers of ramie, flax and other plants are non lignified, high in strength, wet strength is higher than dry strength, low in elongation, high in rigidity, fast in moisture absorption and desorption, relatively flexible, and good in spinnability. They can be pure spun, or blended with cotton or other chemical fibers. After being made into clothes, they are crisp, sweat absorption, breathable and cool, and are good materials for summer clothing. Leaf fibers are derived from monocotyledonous plants and are vascular bundle fibers that grow on leaves or leaf sheaths, also known as hard fibers. There are various types of sisal hemp, banana hemp, and balsam hemp, among which sisal hemp and banana hemp are industrial production resources. Most of the leaf fibers are distributed in tropical and subtropical regions, so they are called "tropical hemp", which is characterized by toughness, small deformation, high strength, higher wet strength, seawater corrosion resistance, acid and alkali resistance, etc. Sisal hemp can be used to make ropes, nets, steel rope cores, protective nets, etc.

explanation_cn: 一种第四纪陆相黄色黏土质粉砂沉积物。多呈黄灰色或棕黄色，质地均一，含多量钙 质或黄土结核，呈疏松或半固结状态，孔隙度一般 在40%-50%。垂直节理发育，极易渗水。
explanation_en: A Quaternary continental yellow clay silt deposit. It is mostly yellowish gray or brownish yellow, uniform in texture, containing a lot of calcium or loess nodules, porosity or semi consolidated, and porosity is generally 40% -50%. Vertical joints develop and are prone to water seepage.

explanation_cn: 即黄色蓝宝石。参见刚玉。
explanation_en: It is yellow sapphire. See corundum.

explanation_cn: 单色X射线入射到具有周期性排列的理想点阵晶体上时.在满足布拉格衍射条件的方向上会出现尖锐的衍射峰。
explanation_en: When monochromatic X-ray is incident on an ideal lattice crystal with periodic arrangement, sharp diffraction peaks will appear in the direction meeting Bragg diffraction conditions.

explanation_cn: 即黄水晶，是透明的黄色石英。成分中含有微量的铁和结构水，颜色变化范围可从淡金 黄色到浅橙黄色.由Fe3+致色。透明度较高。黄晶在自然界产出较少.常同紫晶及水晶晶簇伴生。参见石英。
explanation_en: That is, topaz, which is transparent yellow quartze. The composition contains trace iron and structural water, and the color can vary from light golden yellow to light orange yellow. It is colored by Fe3+. High transparency. Dtrhle is seldom found in nature and is often associated with amethyst and water crystal clusters. See quartze.

explanation_cn: 含氟和羟基的铝的硅酸盐矿物。产于花岗伟晶岩、云英岩、高温气化热液矿脉中.与黑钨矿、绿柱石、铌钽 铁矿共生。透明作宝石，即托帕石，亦可作研磨材料。
explanation_en: Silicate mineral containing fluorine and hydroxyl. It occurs in granite pegmatite, greisen, and high-temperature gasification hydrothermal veins. It is associated with wolframite, beryl, niobium tantalite. Transparent gems, namely Topaz, can also be used as grinding materials.

explanation_cn: 无色透明、半透明或近A色的高分子材料偏离白色的程度.或发黄的程度。黄色指数可用来分析某些产品质量或老化程度。测量时采用符合国际照明学会(CIE)规定的标准光源照射材料。测量三刺激值的仪器有测色计或色差计，也可用其他仪器如分光光度计。仪器光和观察的几何条件，必须符合国际照明学会(HE)的规定。颗粒状和粉末状试样由相应的试验盒装。对试样表面状态要求无污染和擦伤.粉状、颗粒状试样要压平。对透明和半透明材料，只有在同一厚度才可比较。
explanation_en: The degree of deviation from white or yellowing of colorless transparent, semi transparent or A-color macromolecule materials. The yellowness index can be used to analyze the quality or aging degree of some products. The materials shall be illuminated with standard light source conforming to the regulations of International Illumination Institute (CIE) during measurement. Instruments for measuring three irritation values include colorimeter or colorimeter, and other instruments such as spectrophotometer can also be used. The geometric conditions of instrument light and observation must comply with the regulations of the International Illumination Society (HE). Granular and powder samples are packed in corresponding test boxes. The surface condition of the sample should be free from contamination and scratches. Powder and granular samples should be flattened. Transparent and translucent materials can only be compared at the same thickness.

explanation_cn: 即黄色绿柱石，又称金色绿柱石。绿黄色、橙色、黄棕色、黄褐色、金黄色、 淡柠檬黄色，其黄色是由Fe3+致色而成的。参见绿 柱石。
explanation_en: That is, yellow beryl, also known as golden beryl. Green yellow, orange, yellow brown, yellow brown, golden yellow, and light lemon yellow, which are colored by Fe3+. See beryl.

explanation_cn: 含附加阴离子的复杂岛状结构硫酸盐矿物。。三方晶系。晶体呈板状或假立方体；集合体呈致密块状、土状、皮壳状。
explanation_en: Sulfate minerals with complex island like structures containing additional anions.. Tripartite crystal system. The crystal is tabular or pseudo cube; The aggregate is in a dense block like, soil like, and shell like shape.

explanation_cn: 岛状结构二硫化物矿物。化学式为FeS2。常有钴、镍成类质同象混入物代替铁。
explanation_en: Island structured disulfide minerals. The chemical formula is FeS2. Cobalt and nickel isomorphic mixtures often replace iron.

explanation_cn: 以锌为主要合金元素的铜基合金的总称，包括简单黄铜和复杂黄铜。
explanation_en: A general term for copper based alloy with zinc as the main alloy element, including simple brass and complex brass.

explanation_cn: 复杂配位型硫化物矿物。常和黄铁矿、磁黄铁矿、方铅矿、闪锌矿、石英、方 解石等共生。是炼铜的主要矿物原料。
explanation_en: Complex coordination type sulfide minerals. It is often associated with pyrite, pyrrhothe, galena, sphalerite, quartze, calcite, etc. It is the main raw mineral material for copper smelting.

explanation_cn: 铀浓缩物的一种，呈黄色，其中铀以重铀酸盐和铀酸盐的形式存在，常加工成饼状，因此得名。"黄饼"名称源于最初的生产工艺产 出的非纯净成品的颜色和形态，而通过现代先进科技手段生产的"黄饼"实际上呈褐色或黑色，而不是黄色。黄饼是制备核纯级铀、铀化合物的原料，是铀产量和铀价格的计量单位。
explanation_en: It is a kind of uranium concentrate, which is yellow. uranium exists in the form of heavy uranium and uranium, and is often processed into cakes, so it is named. The name "yellow cake" originates from the color and shape of the impure finished products produced by the original production process, while the "yellow cake" produced by modern advanced scientific and technological means is actually brown or black instead of yellow. Yellow cake is the raw material for preparing nuclear grade uranium and uranium compounds, and is the unit of measurement for uranium output and uranium price.

explanation_cn: 粘接强度，又称为粘结强度，是指单位面积或单位长度上加在粘接接头上直至破坏所需的力或能量。通常，粘接强度是从接头的破坏角度来考察粘接性能的。粘接强度受多种因素影响，包括材料的性质、粘合剂的强度、被粘合材料的强度、粘接界面的状态、粘接层的厚度、化学性质以及粘接条件等物理和化学因素。这些因素都对粘接强度产生影响。在粘接界面上，基本的粘附力是由分子间的相互作用力所产生的。然而，实际情况下，粘接强度通常仅从接头破坏的角度来考虑。破坏可以是真正的界面破坏，也可以是内聚破坏或弱界面（WBL）破坏。因此，单纯地考虑界面上的结合力并不足以解释粘接强度，因为破坏机制也需要考虑。影响粘接强度的因素众多，其中包括胶黏剂的强度、被粘合材料的强度、粘接层的厚度、界面点接触的密度、胶黏剂和被粘合材料的化学性质、粘接时的化学条件以及使用环境等物理化学因素。若粘接接头在特定环境条件下进行破坏试验，所需的破坏力被称为该粘接接头的环境强度，因为环境条件也可以对粘接性能产生显著影响。
explanation_en: Adhesive strength, also known as bonding strength, refers to the force or energy required to put on the bonding joint per unit area or length until it is destroyed. Generally, the adhesive strength is evaluated from the perspective of joint failure. Adhesive strength is affected by many factors, including physical and chemical factors such as the nature of materials, the strength of adhesive, the strength of bonded materials, the state of bonding interface, the thickness of bonding layer, chemical properties and bonding conditions. All these factors affect the adhesive strength. At the bonding interface, the basic adhesion force is generated by the intermolecular interactions. However, in practice, adhesive strength is usually considered only from the perspective of joint failure. The damage can be real interface damage, cohesive failure or weak interface (WBL) damage. Therefore, simply considering the bonding force on the interface is not enough to explain the adhesive strength, because the failure mechanism also needs to be considered. There are many factors that affect the adhesive strength, including the strength of adhesive, the strength of the bonded material, the thickness of the bonding layer, the density of the interface point contact, the chemical properties of adhesive and the bonded material, the chemical conditions when bonding, the use environment and other physical chemistry factors. If a bonded joint is subjected to failure testing under specific environmental conditions, the required failure force is called the environmental strength of the bonded joint, as environmental conditions can also have a significant impact on the bonding performance.

explanation_cn: 黏土是一种土状混合体，主要由黏土矿物组成，其粒径小于0.002毫米。它们可以形成于外生沉积作用、母岩经长期风化作用或受热液蚀变的影响。常见的黏土矿物包括高岭石、蒙脱石、水云母，以及坡缕石、海泡石、累托石等。此外，黏土还可能含有少量石英、长石、云母等矿物碎屑，以及构生矿物如菱铁矿和石膏等。黏土具有多种特性，包括黏结性、可塑性、吸附性、膨胀性、耐火性和烧结性。根据可塑性，黏土可以分为可塑性黏土（软质黏土）、半软质黏土和硬质黏土。根据耐火度，它们可以分为耐火黏土（耐火度大于1580°C）、易熔黏土（耐火度小于1350°C）和难熔黏土（耐火度为1350°C至1580°C）。根据成因，黏土可以分为热液蚀变型黏土、风化残积型黏土（残余黏土）和沉积型黏土。根据矿物成分，它们可以分为高岭石黏土、蒙脱石黏土、水云母黏土、坡缕石黏土、海泡石黏土、陶土等。根据用途或特征，它们可以分为耐火黏土、陶瓷黏土、陶粒黏土、砖瓦黏土、膨润土等。黏土在各种领域有广泛的用途，包括建筑、陶瓷制造、陶艺、砖瓦制作、土壤改良、地质工程、油田开采等。它们的多样性和特性使其成为重要的自然资源。
explanation_en: Clay is a soil like mixture, mainly composed of clay mineral, with a particle size of less than 0.002mm. They can be formed by exogenous sedimentation, long-term weathering of the parent rock, or the influence of hydrothermal alteration. Common clay minerals include kaolinite, montmorillonite, hydromica, as well as palygorskite, sepiolite, rectorite, etc. In addition, clay may also contain a small amount of quartze, feldspar, mica and other mineral fragments, as well as tectonic minerals such as siderite and gypsum. Clay has a variety of properties, including cohesiveness, plasticity, adsorption, expansion, fire resistance and sintering. According to plasticity, clay can be divided into plastic clay (soft clay), semi soft clay and flint clay. According to refractoriness, they can be divided into refractory clay (refractoriness is greater than 1580 ° C), fusible clay (refractoriness is less than 1350 ° C) and refractory clay (refractoriness is 1350 ° C to 1580 ° C). According to the origin, clay can be divided into hydrothermal altered clay, weathered residual clay (residual clay) and sedimentary clay. According to mineral composition, they can be divided into kaolinite clay, montmorillonite clay, hydromica clay, palygorskite clay, sepiolhe clay, clay, etc. According to the use or characteristics, they can be divided into refractory clay, ceramic clay, haydite day, brick and tile clay, bentonite, etc. Clay is widely used in various fields, including architecture, ceramics manufacturing, pottery, brick and tile manufacturing, soil improvement, geological engineering, oil field exploitation, etc. Their diversity and characteristics make them important natural resources.

explanation_cn: 以粒径<0.002mm的层状(链层状)结构硅酸盐矿物为主要组成的固结沉积岩的总称。黏土矿物包括高岭石类、伊利石类、蒙脱石类、海泡石类等;其他碎肩矿物有石英、长石、云母等。岩石类型及用途与同成分的黏土相对应。
explanation_en: The general name of consolidated sedimentary rock mainly composed of layered (chain layered) silicate mineral with grain size less than 0.002mm. Clay mineral include kadinite, illite, montmorillonite, sepiolite, etc; Other shoulder minerals include quartze, feldspar, mica, etc. The type and use of rock correspond to clay with the same composition.

explanation_cn: 是粒径小于0.002mm的层状(链层状)结构硅酸盐矿物的总称。包括高岭石类、伊利石类、蒙脱石类、海泡石类等矿物。肉眼无法观察其形态和颗粒大小，需采用电子显微镜等手段。大多具有良好的可塑性、烧结性、吸附性能和离子交换性能.可用作陶瓷、耐火材料的原料和造纸、油漆、涂料、钻探泥浆的填料。
explanation_en: It is the general name of layered (chain layered) silicate mineral with particle size less than 0.002mm. Including kadinite, illite, montmorillonite, sepiolite and other minerals. Its morphology and particle size cannot be observed with the naked eye, and electronic microscopy and other means are needed. Most of them have good plasticity, sintering, adsorption and ion exchange properties. They can be used as raw materials for ceramics and refractory, and as fillers for paper making, paint, coatings and drilling mud.

explanation_cn: 是Al2O3含量在30%-48%的硅酸铝质耐火制品。
explanation_en: It is a silicate aluminum refractory product with an Al2O3 content of 30% -48%.

explanation_cn: 属于层状构造的含铝硅酸盐结构，主要代表有高岭石、蒙脱石、伊利石等。其中，高岭石属于斜晶系，具有双层型结构，由一个硅氧四面体层和一个[Al2(OH)5]5-八面体层相互连接而成。各层之间通过氢键结合，不含其他阳离子和水分子。蒙脱石属于单斜晶系，具有三层型结构，由硅氧四面体双层和夹在其间的八面体层组成，同时含有层间水和层间吸附离子，如Na-、Ca2+等。八面体的中心离子为Al3+，有时四面体中的Si4+也可以部分被Al3+所取代，以维持电荷平衡。伊利石同样属于单斜晶系，具有三层型结构，其晶体结构类似于云母。其中，阳离子配位以二八面体为主。与白云母相比，四面体中的Si/Al比值大于4.3，因此需要吸附少量的K+、Na+、Ca2+或Mg2+等离子，以平衡电荷。在这些结构中，层与层之间存在水分子。
explanation_en: It belongs to aluminosilicate structure of layered structure, mainly representing kaolinite, montmorillonite, illite, etc. Among them, kadinite belongs to the clinolite system and has a double-layer structure, which is formed by the interconnection of a silicon oxygen tetrahedron layer and an [Al2 (OH) 5] 5-octahedron layer. Each layer is bound by hydrogen bond, without other cations and water molecules. Montmorillonite belongs to monoclinic system and has a three-layer structure, which is composed of two layers of silicon oxygen tetrahedron and octahedron layer sandwiched between them. It also contains interlayer water and interlayer adsorbed ions, such as Na -, Ca2+, etc. The central ion of the octahedron is Al3+, and sometimes the Si4+in the tetrahedron can also be partially replaced by Al3+to maintain charge balance. Illite also belongs to monoclinic system, with three-layer structure, and its crystal structure is similar to mica. Among them, the cationic coordination is mainly dioctahedral. Compared with muscovilte, the Si/Al ratio in the tetrahedron is greater than 4.3, so a small amount of K+, Na+, Ca2+or Mg2+plasma needs to be adsorbed to balance the charge. In these structures, there are water molecules between layers.

explanation_cn: 在稳态流动的流体中，剪切应力与剪切速率之比值称为黏度，用符号η表示。黏度是流体内部阻力的度量，通常用希腊字母η（eta）来表示。流体在受到剪切应力τ作用而流动时，在垂直于流动方向（流层方向）y处产生速度梯度（也就是剪切速率γ），剪切应力与剪切速率成正比，即τ = ηγ。η即为黏度或黏度系数，其单位可以是帕斯卢（Pa·s）或牛顿每平方米（N·s/m2）。黏度除以流体密度通常称为动力黏度，单位为平方米每秒（m2/s）。那些满足τ = ηγ关系且γ为常数的流体被称为牛顿型流体，可以通过(τ, γ)的图像表示为一条直线，其斜率即为η，因此γ也称为绝对黏度。水、一些低分子液体和气体都属于这一类型的流体。然而，一些流体，例如高分子溶液和熔体，其黏度不遵循上述规律，可以用τ = kγ^n来描述，其中n可能大于或小于1，而k是系数。这些流体被称为非牛顿型流体。对于这些流体，可以引入表观黏度ηA，即作为γ的函数的η，ηA = kγ^(n-1)，也就是表观黏度是γ的函数。在曲线上的任何点的切线斜率dη/dγ被称为微分黏度或稠度。如果受到的剪切力是正弦交变的，那么所得的黏度将成为复数黏度η'，由实部和虚部构成，其中实部η'称为动态黏度。高黏度流体在受到拉伸应力σ（T）作用时，其拉伸方向中的形变率s也会随时间变化。拉伸黏度或特鲁顿黏度 η_t 定义为η_t = σ/s，其中σ是应力，s是形变率。测量黏度的常用仪器包括毛细管黏度计（用于低黏度液体，范围为0.5-1600 mm2/s）、落球式黏度计（用于中等黏度液体，范围为0.5-106 mPa·s）、锐孔黏度计（常用于石油产品、涂料和油墨中，范围为1-1000 mPa·s）、加压式毛细管流变仪（用于高分子熔体，范围为100-100000 Pa·s），以及旋转式黏度计（有多种类型，用于不同范围，通常为2-109 mPa·s），有些用于常规测试和质量控制，有些供科研用的甚至可以同时测定动态复数黏度。
explanation_en: In a steady flowing fluid, the ratio of shear stress to shear rate is called viscosity η Represent. Viscosity is a measure of the internal resistance of a fluid, usually in Greek letters η (eta) to represent. Fluid under shear stress τ When acting on the flow, a velocity gradient (i.e. shear rate) is generated perpendicular to the flow direction (flow layer direction) y γ）， The shear stress is proportional to the shear rate, i.e τ = ηγ。η It is viscosity or viscosity coefficient, and its unit can be pashlu (Pa · s) or Newton per square meter (N · s/m 2）。 Viscosity divided by fluid density is usually called dynamic viscosity, and its unit is square meters per second (m 2/ s) . Those who satisfy τ = ηγ Relationship and γ A fluid that is a constant is called a Newtonian fluid and can be（ τ, γ) The image is represented as a straight line, with a slope of η， therefore γ Also called absolute viscosity. Water, some low molecular liquids, and gases all belong to this type of fluid. However, some fluids, such as macromolecule solutions and melts, whose viscosity does not follow the above rule, can be used τ = K γ^ N to describe, where n may be greater than or less than 1, and k is the coefficient. explanation_cn: 黏度法是在高分子工业和研究中最常用的测量聚合物相对分子质量的方法，适用于分子量范围在10^1 到 10^5 的聚合物，是一种相对的方法。在一定温度下，聚合物溶液的黏度通常依赖于浓度，常采用的公式包括哈金斯（Huggins）方程以及克拉默（Kraemer）方程。通过对 ln(η) 与 c (浓度) 或 ln(η) 与 c^(-1)（浓度的倒数）的图形外推，可以得到共同的截距，即特性黏度 [η]。通过测定聚合物的黏度，除了提供黏均分子质量 M，还可以获得聚合物的无扰链尺寸和膨胀因子。
explanation_en: Viscosity method is the most commonly used method to measure the relative molecular weight of polymer in macromolecule industry and research. It is a relative method applicable to polymer with molecular weight ranging from 10 ^ 1 to 10 ^ 5. At a certain temperature, the viscosity of polymer solution usually depends on the concentration. The commonly used formulas include Huggins equation and Kraemer equation. By comparing ln（ η) With c (concentration) or ln（ η) The graph extrapolation with c ^ (-1) (the reciprocal of concentration) can get the common intercept, that is, intrinsic viscosity[ η]。 By measuring the viscosity of polymer, in addition to providing the viscosity average molecular weight M, the undisturbed chain size and expansion factor of polymer can also be obtained.

explanation_cn: 非交联型高分子在较高温度下，受到很小的外力就会产生流动，其形变随时间不可逆的增长，但仍保持部分弹性的特殊状态，通常被称为黏流态。最常见的聚合物黏流态是聚合物的熔体状态，此时其表观黏度随温度升高而急剧下降。通常，黏流态的性质可以用阿累尼乌斯（Arrhenius）方程来描述，活化能E_a的大小取决于材料的特性，愈大的活化能意味着黏度对温度的变化更为敏感。因此，研究高分子材料的黏流态特性对高分子成型加工具有重要的意义。在高分子成型加工中，材料在黏流态下会发生形变，因此了解和控制黏流态特性可以帮助优化工艺和提高成型质量。
explanation_en: Non crosslinking macromolecule will flow under a small external force at a higher temperature. Its deformation increases irreversibly with time, but it still maintains a special state of partial elasticity, which is usually called viscous flow state. The most common viscous flow state of polymer is the melt state of polymer. At this time, its apparent viscosity drops sharply with the increase of temperature. Generally, the properties of viscous flow state state can be described by Arrhenius equation, and the activation or conditioning energy E_ The size of a depends on the characteristics of materials. The larger the activation or conditioning energy is, the more sensitive the viscosity is to temperature changes. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the viscous flow state characteristics of macromolecule materials for macromolecule molding. In the process of macromolecule molding, materials will undergo deformation under the viscous flow state, so understanding and controlling the viscous flow state characteristics can help optimize the process and improve the molding quality.

explanation_cn: 在高温下，大多数硅酸盐系统的烧结主要依靠黏滞液体的流动以实现致密化。除了在高温下黏性液体的牛顿型流动导致传质之外，在固相烧结中，晶体内的晶格空位在应力作用下也会发生流动，这被称为黏滞流动，是流动传质的一种方式。高温下物质的黏滞流动可以分为两个阶段：首先，相邻颗粒之间的接触表面增大，然后颗粒之间发生黏合作用，直至孔隙封闭；接下来，封闭的气孔发生黏性压实，残留的封闭孔逐渐缩小。随着烧结的进行，坯体中的小气孔会逐渐缩小，最终形成封闭的气孔。根据黏滞流动传质机理，影响烧结速率的主要参数包括颗粒的初始粒径、黏度和表面张力。
explanation_en: At high temperature, the sintering of most silicate systems mainly depends on the flow of viscous liquid to achieve densification. In addition to the Newtonian flow of viscous liquid at high temperature leading to mass transfer, in solid state sintering, the lattice vacancy in the crystal will also flow under the effect of stress, which is called viscous flow and is a way of flow and mass transfer. The viscous flow of substances at high temperatures can be divided into two stages: firstly, the contact surface between adjacent particles increases, and then adhesion occurs between particles until the pores are closed; Next, the closed pores undergo viscous compaction, and the remaining closed pores gradually shrink. With the progress of sintering, the small pores in the green body will gradually shrink and eventually form closed pores. According to the mass transfer by viscous flow, the main parameters affecting the sintering rate include the initial particle size, viscosity and surface tension of particles.

explanation_cn: 又称咬合磨损。材料接触的表面作相对运动时，由于产生同相焊合作用，使物质从一个表面迁移到另一个表面而造成的磨损。黏着磨损是一种常见的磨损形式。在各类磨损中，黏着磨损约占15%。汽车、拖拉机、机床、飞机、宇航器械等许多零件中都存在黏着磨损现象。
explanation_en: It is also called occlusal wear. Adhesive wear is a common form of wear. In all kinds of wear, adhesive wear accounts for about 15%. Adhesive wear exists in many parts such as automobiles, tractors, machine tools, aircraft, aerospace equipment and so on.

Dissolve it in a dilute NaOH solution to obtain the spinning solution, which is filtered, defoamed, and matured before being pressed out of the fine pores of the spinneret. The final fiber is obtained by introducing a coagulation bath consisting of sulfuric acid, sodium sulfate, zinc sulfate and other aqueous solutions to curing into silk, and then adding rx sequence after desulfurization, washing, shanking, drying, etc.

explanation_cn: 黏附增强材料的主要作用是增强材料之间的黏附性，通常在光刻工艺中应用。常见的材料之一是六甲基二硅氮烷（HMDS，hexamethyldisilazane），化学式为[(CH3)3Si]2NH。它是一种无色透明液体，属于易燃物品。虽然本身无毒，但与水接触时会分解成有毒的硅化物气体，而其燃烧会产生有毒的硅氧化合物烟雾。此外，HMDS在遇到酸性物质时也可能发生激烈反应。在存储时，HMDS需要保存在密封的环境中，通常在15°C到40°C的温度范围内，应避免暴露于雨水和阳光，保持干燥通风。HMDS可与一些材料表面（如硅、钼、玻璃等）发生反应，从而生成疏水性的物质，同时也能够与表面上的羟基发生反应，减少或消除羟基。因此，它广泛用作表面处理剂，以增强不同材料之间的黏附性。在使用HMDS进行表面处理前，涂在表面的薄膜通常会具有低接触角，接近或小于10°。而经过HMDS反应处理后，接触角可以显著增加，达到大约50°左右，从而大大提高了薄膜的黏附性。
explanation_en: The main function of adhesion materials is the adhesion between reinforcement materials, which is usually used in photolithography. One of the common materials is hexamethyldisilazane (HMDS, hexamethyldisilazane), whose chemical formula is [(CH3) 3Si] 2NH. It is a colorless transparent liquid and belongs to the category of flammable substances. Although it is non-toxic in itself, it will decompose into toxic silicide gas when contacting with water, and its combustion will produce toxic silicon oxide smoke. In addition, HMDS may also undergo intense reactions when encountering acidic substances. When storing, HMDS needs to be stored in a sealed environment, usually within the temperature range of 15 ° C to 40 ° C, avoiding exposure to rainwater and sunlight, and maintaining dry and ventilated conditions. HMDS can react with some surface of materials (such as silicon, molybdenum, glass, etc.) to generate hydrophobic substances, and can also react with hydroxyl groups on the surface to reduce or eliminate hydroxyl groups. Therefore, it is widely used as a surface treatment agent to enhance the adhesion between different materials. Before using HMDS for surface treatment, the film coated on the surface usually has a low contact angle, close to or less than 10 °. After HMDS reaction treatment, the contact angle can be significantly increased to about 50 °, thus greatly improving the adhesion of the film.

explanation_cn: 1,3,5-三硝基-1,3,5-三氮杂环己烷，通常用代号RDX表示。RDX是一种白色斜方结晶，不吸湿，室温下不挥发的化合物。它难溶于水和氯仿，微溶于乙醇、乙醚、苯、甲苯、氯仿、二硫化碳和乙酸乙酯，但易溶于丙酮、二甲基甲酰胺、环己酮、环戊酮和浓硝酸。具体性质包括：熔点约为204°C（伴随分解），工业品通常为200°C，密度约为1.8168 g/cm3，爆发点约为230°C（5秒），爆热为6.32 MJ/kg（在液态水中，密度1.70 g/cm3），爆速为8.64 km/s（密度1.767 g/cm3），爆压为33.8 GPa（密度1.767 g/cm3），爆温约为3700K（密度1.80 g/cm3），全爆容为890 L/kg，摩擦感度为80%（10 kg，25 cm）。通常用于制造雷管、传爆药柱、导爆索，特别是钝化黑索金。此外，RDX用于装填炮弹、导弹战斗部、鱼雷、水雷等武器，也作为火药的高能组分。制备RDX通常采用直接硝解法或醋酐法。因其可靠的性能和稳定的制造工艺，RDX成为了一种重要的高威力炸药，在军事和民用领域得到广泛应用。
explanation_en: 1,3,5-trinitro-1,3,5-triaazacyclohexane, usually represented by the code RDX. RDX is a white rhombic crystal, non hygroscopic, and non volatile compound at room temperature. It is insoluble in water and chloroform, slightly soluble in ethanol, ether, benzene, toluene, chloroform, carbon disulfide, and ethyl acetate, but easily soluble in acetone, dimethylformamide, cyclohexanone, cyclopentanone, and concentrated nitric acid. Specific properties include: melting point is about 204 ° C (accompanied by decomposition), industrial products are usually 200 ° C, and density is about 1.8168 g/cm 3， The explosion tcmperature is about 230 ° C (5 seconds), and the explosion heat is 6.32 MJ/kg (in liquid water, the density is 1.70 g/cm 3）， The detonation velocity is 8.64 km/s (density 1.767 g/cm 3）， The explosion pressure is 33.8 GPa (density 1.767 g/cm 3）， Explosion temperature is about 3700K (density 1.80 g/cm 3）， The total explosive capacity is 890 L/kg, and the friction sensitivity is 80% (10 kg, 25 cm). It is usually used to manufacture detonators, booster charge and detonating cord, especially passivation hexogen. In addition, RDX is used to load artillery shells, missile warheads, torpedoes, mines and other weapons, and is also a high-energy component of propellant. The preparation of RDX usually involves direct nitration or acetic anhydride method. Because of its reliable performance and stable manufacturing process, RDX has become an important high power explosive, which is widely used in military and civil fields.

explanation_cn: 硫化物矿物化学式为Cu12Sb4S13，通常称为黝铜矿（Tetrahedrite）。黝铜矿具有复杂的结构，是含铜和锑的硫化物矿物，经常含有其他元素的代替或掺杂。该矿物属于等轴晶系，具有TH43m的空间群。黝铜矿的晶体结构多呈四面体，形成致密块状或粒状的集合体。它的颜色通常为钢灰色至铁黑色，但含有铁较多的变种可能呈现较深的颜色。其条痕颜色通常为钢灰色至铁黑色，但有时会带有褐色，特别是当含有砷时，条痕可能呈现樱桃红色调。黝铜矿具有半金属至金属光泽，是不透明的，没有明显的解理。它的莫氏硬度在3到4.5之间，密度在4.6到5.1 g/cm3之间，通常比砷黝铜矿略高。黝铜矿是脆性的，具有一定的导电性。黝铜矿通常产于各种热液型矿床中，在高、中温热液矿床中通常是偏晚期形成的。它经常与黄铁矿和黄铜矿等矿物一起出现，是许多黄铁矿矿床中的典型矿物。此外，黝铜矿也可用作提取铜的矿物资源。
explanation_en: The chemical formula of sulfide minerals is Cu12Sb4S13, commonly known as tetrahedrite. Tetrahedrite has a complex structure and is a sulfide mineral containing copper and antimony, often containing substitution or doping of other elements. This mineral belongs to the equiaxed crystal system and has a TH43m spatial group. The crystal structure of tetrahedrite is mostly tetrahedral, forming compact massive or granular aggregates. Its color is usually steel gray to iron black, but variants with more iron may have a darker color. The streak color is usually steel gray to iron black, but sometimes it is brown. Especially when arsenic is contained, the streak may be cherry red. Tetrahedrite has a semi metallic to metallic luster, is opaque, and has no obvious cleavage. Its Mohs hardness is between 3 and 4.5, and its density is between 4.6 and 5.1 g/cm 3 Usually slightly higher than arsenopyrite. Tetrahedrite is brittle and has a certain degree of conductivity. Tetrahedrite usually occurs in various hydrothermal deposits, and is usually formed in late stages in high and medium temperature hydrothermal deposits. It often occurs together with minerals such as pyrite and chalcopyrite, and is a typical mineral in many pyrite deposits. In addition, tetrahedrite can also be used as a mineral resource for extracting copper.
