explanation_en: Generally, it refers to transition metal salts (such as titanium, vanadium, cobalt, nickel, etc.) in the IV - group of the periodic table of elements A catalyst for coordination polymerization of olefins consisting of 1-II group metal alkyl compounds, halogenated or oxidized alkyl compounds. It is used to synthesize non branched, highly stereoregular polyolefin. Typical Ziegler-Natta catalyst are titanium tetrachloride triethyl]. Karl Ziegler, a German chemist, applied this catalyst to the production of polyethylene. High density polyethylene with few branched chains was obtained; Italian chemist Curio Nata used this catalyst in the production of polypropylene and found that polypropylene with high degree of polymerization and high regularity was obtained. Currently. Zieglernatta initiator is the most abundant initiator in coordination polymerization. It can be used for directional polymerization of olefins, dienes and cycloolefins.

explanation_cn: 治疗龋齿时用于充填牙齿窝洞的材料。按组成可分为以银汞合金为代表的金属类、以复合树脂为代表的树脂类和以磷酸锌水门汀为代表的水门汀类。银汞合金是由银、锡和铜为主要成分的合金粉与汞发生汞齐反应形成的合金，硬化前具有良好的充填塑性，便于操作成型。银汞合金在硬化期有轻度的体积膨胀或少许的收缩，故与洞壁密合性好，硬化后具有较高的抗压强度和耐磨性能，化学稳定性好，是应用较为普遍的永久性充填材料。银汞合金是热、电的良导体，中度或深龋充填需用难于导热导电的材料垫底，并且无黏结性，充填时需制备一定的洞形，色泽为银灰色，仅适用于后牙充填，故对临床适应症有一定的限制。复合树脂是由特殊处理的无机填料与丙烯酸酯类树脂混合而成的高分子复合材料，固化后具有较好的力学性能，并可根据临床要求调配成各种与牙齿色泽相近的材料，适于作为前牙永久性充填材料和牙齿美容修复材料，其耐磨强度低于银汞合金。磷酸锌水门汀由氧化锌粉末和正磷酸水溶液调和而成，是热、电的不良导体，治疗深龋时用来作衬层材料，它的机械强度、耐磨性能以及在唾液中的化学稳定性均低于复合树脂和银汞合金，通常作为暂时性的充填材料。
explanation_en: A materials used to fill the cavities of teeth when treating caries. According to composition, it can be divided into metals represented by amalgam, resin represented by composition resin and cements represented by zinc phosphate cernent. Silver amalgam is a alloy formed by the amalgam reaction between alloy powder with silver, tin and copper as the main components and mercury. It has good filling plasticity before hardening and is convenient for operation and molding. The silver amalgam has slight volume expansion or slight shrinkage during the hardening period, so it has good compatibility with the tunnel wall. After hardening, it has high compressive strength and wear resistance, and good chemical stability. It is a commonly used permanent filling materials. The silver amalgam is a good conductor of heat and electricity. The filling of moderate or deep caries requires the use of materials that are difficult to conduct heat and electricity, and it is non cohesive. When filling, it needs to prepare a certain hole shape, silver gray color, which is only suitable for posterior teeth filling, so there are certain restrictions on clinical indications. Composite resin is a macromolecule composite materials mixed by specially treated inorganic filler and acrylate resin. After curing, it has good mechanical properties and can be formulated into various materials with similar tooth color according to clinical requirements. It is suitable for permanent filling materials of anterior teeth and dental beauty repair materials, and its wear resistance is lower than that of silver amalgam. Zinc phosphate cernent is made from powder and orthophosphoric acid aqueous solution. It is a poor conductor of heat and electricity. It is used as a lining materials when treating deep caries. Its mechanical strength, abrasion resistance and chemical stability in saliva are lower than those of composition resin and silver amalgam. It is usually used as a temporary filling materials.

explanation_cn: 口腔临床上主要用于颌支托、卡环.正畸矫治器的弓丝及结扎丝等的铬镍合金不锈钢丝，其制品有多种规格。铬镍不锈钢具有良好的生物相容性和力学性能.化学性能稳定，抗腐蚀性能良好。临床上修复用铬镍不锈钢丝的抗拉强度为1900MPa.硬度（HV5)493~500,弹性模量185~190GPa,延伸率1%,矫正用不锈钢丝的抗拉强度为：高强度1600~2000MPa,特高强度2000-2500MPa,超高强度2500~2900MPa。结扎丝的抗拉强度为588~882MPa。
explanation_en: Chromium nickel alloy stainless steel wire, which is mainly used for jaw support, clasp, arch wire of orthodontic appliance and ligation wire in oral clinic, has a variety of specifications. Cr Ni stainless steel has good biocompatibility and mechanical properties, stable chemical properties and good corrosion resistance. In clinic, the tensile strength of chromium nickel stainless steel wire for repair is 1900MPa. The hardness (HV5) is 493~500, the elastic modulus is 185~190GPa, and the elongation is 1%. The tensile strength of stainless steel wire for correction is 1600~2000MPa for high strength, 2000~2500MPa for ultra-high strength, and 2500~2900MPa for ultra-high strength. The tensile strength of the binding wire is 588-882MPa.

explanation_cn: 由金属盐或其氧化物作为粉剂.并与专用液体调和而成的无机非金属修复材料.使用时将粉剂和液剂按一定比例调和.凝间后冇一定的黏结强度，故又称黏固粉或黏同剂。牙科水1'1汀有很多种类.主要可以分为无机水门汀和打机水门汀两大类.其主要作用是用于牙科治疗中i各种修复体的粘接、乳牙和恒前牙的充填、暂封、衬i层、盖髓、保髓、根管充填等。
explanation_en: Inorganic non-metallic repair materials, which is made of metal salt or its oxide as powder and mixed with special liquid. When used, the powder and liquid are mixed in a certain proportion. After solidification, there is a certain bonding strength, so it is also called bonding powder or adhesive. There are many kinds of dental water 1'1 dentine, which can be mainly divided into two categories: inorganic cement and machine cement. Its main function is to be used for bonding various prosthesis, filling of deciduous teeth and permanent anterior teeth, temporary sealing, lining I, pulp capping, pulp preservation, root canal filling, etc. in dental treatment.

explanation_cn: 在口腔修复过程中用于铸造修复件时包埋铸型的材料?主要成分是耐高温的二氧化硅基质及将基质黏合在一起的结合剂一般分为以下三种：①中低熔合金铸造包埋材料（石膏类包埋材料），主要成分为二氧化硅（55%~75%)及硬质石膏（25%~45%),结合剂为石膏，适用于熔化温度在1000度以下的合金；②高熔合金铸造包埋材料（无石膏类包埋材料），主要成分为方石英和石英（占80%~90%),又分为磷酸盐包埋材料和硅胶包埋材料；磷酸盐包埋材料的结合剂为磷酸盐和氧化镁的混合物，硅胶包埋材料又可分为正硅酸乙酯包埋材料和硅溶胶包埋材料，前者所用结合剂为正硅酸乙酯.后者使用时以悬浊液形式的硅溶胶与磷酸盐包埋材料混合而成；适用于熔化温度在1000度以上的高熔点合金：③模型包埋材料，主要成分为方石英、石英，结合剂为硬质石膏、超硬质石膏及磷酸盐.兼有模型材料和铸造包埋材料二者的特点：用法是先在印模上用模型包埋材料制成模型，再在模型上制备修整蜡型.然后将模型和蜡塑一起包埋。还有一种含二氧化锆的新型高温包埋材料.耐火温度高达1600度以上.可用于钛合金种植体的铸造。
explanation_en: What is the materials for embedding the mold mold when it is used for foundry restorations in the oral cavity repair process? The main components are high-temperature resistant silicon dioxide matrix and the binders that bind the matrix together are generally divided into the following three types: ① medium low melting alloy foundry embedding materials (gypsum type embedding materials), the main components are silicon dioxide (55%~75%) and hard gypsum (25%~45%), the binder is gypsum, which is suitable for alloy with melting temperature below 1000 degrees; ② High melting alloy foundry embedding materials (no gypsum embedding materials), mainly composed of cristobalite and quartze (80%~90%), which can be divided into phosphate embedding materials and silicone gel embedding materials; The binder of phosphate embedding materials is a mixture of phosphate and magnesium oxide, and silicone gel embedding materials can be divided into tetraethyl orthosilicate embedding materials and silica sd embedding materials. The former uses tetraethyl orthosilicate as the binder, while the latter uses silica sd in the form of suspension mixed with phosphate embedding materials; It is suitable for alloy with high melting point whose melting temperature is above 1000 degrees: ③ model embedding materials, mainly composed of cristobalite and quartze, and the binder is hard gypsum, ultra hard gypsum and phosphate. It has the characteristics of model materials and foundry embedding materials: the usage is to first use model embedding materials on the impression mold to make model, then prepare the trimmed wax mold on the model, and then embed the model and wax mold together. There is also a new high temperature embedding materials containing zirconia. The fire resistance temperature is up to 1600 degrees Celsius. It can be used for foundry titanium alloy implants.

explanation_cn: 适合用礼、压、冲、滚、拉伸和锤击等机械加3：方法成型的牙科合金。锻造合金通过锻制过程产生塑性变形，成为所需的成品、半成品或便于进一步加工的原材料。经过锻制后合金内部结构和性能会产生变化，如发生应变硬化，材料的硬度、弹性、强度和磁性增加，延展性及抗腐蚀性降低。对需要进行热处理使原子重新排列而再结晶得以回复的合金，可根据材料的组成、性质和应用等方面的要求选择不同的热处理工艺热处理的方法主要有软化热处理、硬化热处理和消除应力等。锻制合金是最早应用于口腔医学的金属材料，主要有18-8铬镍不锈钢、钴铬合金、镍铬合金、金合金及钛合金等制品主要有合金丝（卡环、正畸用弓丝和结扎丝等）、杆（舌杆和腭杆等）、片（不锈钢成型片和镍铬合金片等）和冠套等。在临床制作锤造冠时.由于产生应变硬化必须进行热处理。
explanation_en: It is a dental alloy suitable for forming with gift, pressing, punching, rolling, stretching, hammering and other machines plus 3: method. Forged alloy produces plastic deformation through the forging process and becomes the required finished products, semi-finished products or raw materials for further processing. After forging, the internal structure and properties of alloy will change. If strain hardening occurs, the hardness, elasticity, strength and magnetism of materials will increase, and the ductility and corrosion resistance will decrease. For alloy that need heat treatment to rearrange the atoms and recrystallization can be recovery, different heat treatment processes can be selected according to the requirements of materials composition, property and application. The heat treatment methods mainly include bating heat treatment, hardening heat treatment and stress relief. Forged alloy is the first metallic materials used in stomatology, mainly including 18-8 chromium nickel stainless steel, cobalt chromium alloy, nickel chromium alloy, gold alloy, titanium alloy and other products, mainly including alloy wire (clasp, orthodontic arch wire, ligation wire, etc.), rod (tongue rod, palate rod, etc.), piece (stainless steel molding piece, nickel chromium alloy piece, etc.) and crown sleeve. When making hammered crowns in clinic, heat treatment must be carried out due to strain hardening.

explanation_cn: 乂称硬铅。是一种质地较硬.在牙科临床用于制作修复体锤造模型的铅合金。其主要成分为45%~55%的铋、22%~30%的铅、20%~30%的锡这种合金的熔点低.在95°C左右，属于低熔点合金.易亍溶化后成型，同时其硬度较高.能在适当冲忐力作用下无较大的变形.所以在牙科领域里通常被用于锤造冠、金属基托或固定修复体制作时使用的阴、阳模材料缺点是有引起铅释放导致铅中毒的可能性。
explanation_en: It is called hard lead. It is a hard lead alloy used in dental clinic to make restoration hammering models. Its main components are 45%~55% bismuth, 22%~30% lead, and 20%~30% tin. This alloy has a low melting point. At about 95 ° C, it belongs to fusible alloy alloy. It is easy to be formed after melting, and its hardness is high. It can not deform greatly under the action of appropriate impact force. Therefore, in the dental field, the female and male materials commonly used for hammering crowns, metal bases, or the production of fixed prosthesis have the disadvantage of causing lead release and lead poisoning.

explanation_cn: 用于釔制口腔软硬组织阴型的牙科材料。牙科印模材料分类T根据材料成型后有无弹性分为弹性和非弹忭印模材料.也可根据材料是否可以反复使用分为可逆及不可逆印模材料。根据这两种分类方法可组成四类印模材料：①不可逆弹性印模材料，如藻酸盐印模材料和弹性体印模材料（包括聚硫橡胶印模材料、硅橡胶印模材料、聚醚橡胶印模材料）；②不可逆非弹性印模材料.如印模石膏和氧化锌丁香酚印模糊剂；③可逆弹性印模材料?如琼脂基印模材料；④可逆非弹性印模材料.如印模膏和印模蜡等。印模材料应该具备良好的生物安全性和良好的流动性、弹性、可塑性和适当的凝固时间，复制的模型应准确、稳定、有足够的强度.同时还应具备与模型材料不发生化学反应、易脱模和操作方便等特性。
explanation_en: Dental materials used for the yin type of yttrium oral soft and hard tissues. The classification of dental impression materials T can be divided into elasticity and non elastic impression materials according to whether materials have elasticity after forming. It can also be divided into reversible and irreversible impression materials according to whether materials can be reused. According to the two classification methods, four types of impression materials can be formed: ① irreversible elasticity impression materials, such as alginate impression materials and elasticity impression materials (including polysulfide rubber impression materials, silicone rubber impression materials, polyether rubber impression materials); ② Irreversible non elasticity impression materials, such as impression gypsum and zinc oxide eugenol impression blurring agent; ③ Reversible elastic impression materials? For example, agar based impression materials; ④ Reversible non elasticity impression materials, such as impression paste and wax. The impression materials should have good biological safety, good flow ability, elasticity, plasticity and appropriate solidification time. The copied model should be accurate, stable and have sufficient strength. At the same time, it should also have the characteristics of no chemical reaction with the model materials, easy demoulding and easy operation.

explanation_cn: 专门用于牙科临床及其相关操作，将动物蜡（如蜂蜡）、植物蜡（如棕榈蛸）.矿物蜡（如石蜡、地蜡）按不同比例混合汴加人改性剂和色素制成的各种功能各异的蜡，按临床用途可分为嵌体蜡、铸造蜡、模型蜡和黏蜡。嵌体蜡又称嵌体铸造蜡.具有燃烧残渣少和尺寸变化可控制等特件.适用于制作精密铸造的蜡咽。直接口腔或间接从模型h制取所需蜡塯.并采用失蜡铸造下艺制作修复体。铸造蜡用以制作铸造金厲支架、荜托以及其他活动修复体的铸呦.具有类似嵌体蜡的件能。模(r)蜡4进一步分为基托蜡和颌堤蜡.适合制作街科修复体非金属部分的蜡黏蜡在宰温和口腔环境温度下呈僵硬状态，熔化吋具有黏性.能黏着石膏、金属及其他材料.在矫形修复中主要用于拼接石膏断片、固定焊件及折断义齿修补时的固定，使用时用热蜡刀取少许黏蜡，经轻微加热后即可流至需要黏着的部位
explanation_en: It is specially used in clinical dentistry and its related operations. Animal wax (such as beeswax), vegetable wax (such as octopus palmatum) and mineral wax (such as paraffin wax and paraffin wax) are mixed in different proportions with Bianjia human modifier and pigment to make waxes with different functions. According to clinical use, they can be divided into inlay wax, foundry wax, model wax and sticky wax. The inlay wax, also known as inlay foundry wax, has the characteristics of less combustion residue and controllable size change. It is suitable for making wax wax for precision casting. The wax spike needed was made directly from the mouth or indirectly from the model h, and the prosthesis was made by the lost wax foundry process. Foundry wax is used to make foundry gold sharp stem, bar graph holder and other movable prosthesis. It is similar to inlay wax. Mold (r) wax 4 is further divided into base wax and jaw wax. Wax glue wax suitable for making non-metallic parts of street prosthesis is stiff at slaughter temperature and oral environment temperature, and has viscosity when melting. It can stick gypsum, metal and other materials. In orthopedic repair, it is mainly used to splice gypsum fragments, fix weldments and fix broken dentures. When using, use a hot wax knife to take a small amount of glue wax, After slight heating, it can flow to the area that needs to be adhered

explanation_cn: 用于将口腔组织的阴模（印模）复制出口腔组织形态阳模所使用的材料。按临床使用目的将口腔组织阳模分为作模型和铸型。所用材料分别称为工作模咽材料和铸型材料，用作模型材料用作制作修复体和矫正器的下作模型（或研究模型）和代型.用其制作的模在长期保存下能准确反映口腔组织的解剖形态。因此这种材料应具有流动性好、与阴模材料匹配性能好、凝固时体积稳定、凝固时间适当、耐磨耗等特点。常用的T作模型材料有石膏、人造石、低熔合金、电镀代型用材料及环氧树脂代型材料等。铸型材料用于制作修复体的初制品，应具有体积稳定、易于雕塑、易于去除以及加热易挥发而不留残渣等特性。常用的铸型材料主要是铸造蜡，它由石蜡（60%)、棕榈蜡（25%)、地蜡（10%)、炼蜂蜡（5%)和微量色素组成，可从口腔直接或通过工作模型、代型间接制作铸型。
explanation_en: The materials used to copy the female mold (impression) of oral tissue into the male mold of oral tissue morphology. According to the purpose of clinical use, the male mold of oral tissue is divided into model and mold. The materials used are called working die pharynx materials and mold materials respectively. They are used as model materials for making prosthesis and lower model of orthotics (or studying model) and substitute. The mold made with them can accurately reflect the anatomy of oral tissue under long-term preservation. Therefore, this materials should have the characteristics of good flow ability, good matching performance with female mold materials, stable volume during solidification, proper solidification time, wear resistance, etc. The commonly used T materials for model include gypsum, artificial stone, low melting alloy, materials for electroplating and epoxy resin materials. Mold materials is used to make the initial product of prosthesis, which should have the characteristics of stable volume, easy sculpture, easy removal, and easy volatilization without residue when heated. The commonly used mold materials is mainly foundry wax, which is composed of paraffin wax (60%), palm wax (25%), paraffin wax (10%), refined beeswax (5%) and trace pigment. It can be used to make mold directly from the mouth or indirectly through working model and molds.

explanation_cn: 用于牙科修复件或牙科矫治器制作或修理过程中金属部件焊接的合金。通常牙科临床需要焊接的部件有金属制作的卡环、颌支托、支架及附件等。牙科焊接合金一般应具有以下的性能：①焊接合金的成分、强度、色泽等应尽量与被焊合金接近；②焊接合金的熔点必须低于被焊金属，约低l00°C为宜；③熔化后的焊接合金应具有较好的流动性.能均匀到达焊接而〗与被焊合金结合牢固；④有良好的抗腐蚀性和抗汚染怍根据焊接合金和被焊金属的性能.牙科焊接合金主要分为银焊合金、金焊合金和锡焊合金类。①银焊合金，主要由银（30%~63%)、铜（16.%~29%)和锌（10%~20%)约一成熔化温度为710度.可用于焊接银合金、镍铬合金、18-8铬镍不镑钢、钴铬合金和铜合金等。②金焊合金，基本组成与铸造金合金相似（参见牙科铸造金合金）为了降低熔点可加入锌和锡。金焊合金的熔化温度为715~870°C视被焊合金的种类不同选用熔点不同的金焊合金。金焊合金也可用于18-8铬镍不锈钢、钴铬合金及镍铬合金的焊接.③锡焊合金.主要由锡(66%)和铅（33%)组成，熔点为83°C,也叫选用熔点为232°C的纯锡。
explanation_en: Alloy used for weld metal parts during the manufacture or repair of dental restorations or dental appliances. Generally, the components that need to be weld in dental clinic include metal snap rings, jaw brackets, stem and accessories. Dental weld alloy should generally have the following properties: ① the composition, strength, color, etc. of weld alloy should be as close as possible to the alloy being welded; ② The melting point of weld alloy must be lower than the metal to be welded, about 100 ° C lower; ③ The melted weld alloy shall have good flow ability, reach weld uniformly and be firmly combined with the welded alloy; ④ It has good corrosion resistance and stain resistance. According to the performance of weld alloy and the metal to be welded, dental weld alloy are mainly divided into silver solder alloy, gold solder alloy and tin welding alloy. ① Silver solder alloy, mainly composed of silver (30%~63%), copper (16%~29%) and zinc (10%~20%), has a melting temperature of 710 ° C. It can be used for weld silver alloy, nickel chromium alloy, 18-8 chromium nickel pound steel, cobalt chromium alloy and copper alloy. ② The basic composition of gold solder alloy is similar to that of foundry gold alloy (see dental foundry gold alloy). To reduce the melting point, zinc and tin can be added. The melting temperature of gold solder alloy is 715~870 ° C, depending on the type of alloy to be welded, gold solder alloy with different melting point shall be selected. Gold solder alloy can also be used for weld 18-8 chromium nickel stainless steel, cobalt chromium alloy and nickel chromium alloy. ③ Tin welding alloy, mainly composed of tin (66%) and lead (33%), with a melting point of 83 ° C, is also called pure tin with a melting point of 232 ° C.

explanation_cn: 牙科治疗中进行窝洞制备或修复体切削时使用的旋转切削型消耗性材料牙科切削材料必须有以下特性：①外形尖锐：②硬度高于被切削的材料：③耐冲è强度高；④耐磨性高。常用的牙科切削材料主要有金刚石钻针及磨轮、金刚砂钻针及磨头、碳化钨钻针及钢钻针。金刚石钴针及磨轮利用金刚石颗粒具有极高的硬度和良好的热稳定性，通过电锻的方法将其固定在具有一定外形的金属切削端表而.适合于切削牙体硬组织，特别是牙釉质，但不宜加金属、塑料等韧性、塑性较大的材料,，金刚砂钻针及磨头是利用金刚砂与陶瓷结合剂按一定比例混合以制成不同形状、粒度、硬度的材料。碳化钨钻针采用碳化钨硬质合金制成，有低速和高速之分.适合于切削牙本质或金属。钢钻针采用T具钢制作.可用于切削牙本质，但使用寿命短，不耐磨.不适合于高速切削。
explanation_en: Rotary cutting consumable materials used in cavity preparation or prosthesis cutting in dental treatment Dental cutting materials must have the following characteristics: ① sharp shape: ② hardness higher than the materials being cut: ③ high impact strength; ④ High wear resistance. The commonly used dental cutting materials mainly include diamond drill needles and grinding wheels, diamond sand drill needles and grinding heads, carbonization drill needles and steel drill needles. Diamond cobalt needle and grinding wheel use diamond particles with high hardness and good thermal stability to fix them on the metal cutting end surface with a certain shape by electric forging. It is suitable for cutting hard tissues of teeth, especially enamel, but it is not suitable to add metal, plastics and other materials with greater toughness and plasticity. Diamond sand drill needle and grinding head use diamond sand and ceramics bond in a certain proportion to mix to make different shapes Materials with particle size and hardness. Carbonization drill needle is made of carbonization hardmetal, which can be divided into low speed and high speed. It is suitable for cutting dentin or metal. The steel drill needle is made of T tool steel. It can be used to cut dentin, but its service life is short and it is not wear-resistant. It is not suitable for high-speed cutting.

name_cn: 齿科铬镍合金不锈钢丝
name_en: dental chromium nikel alloy stainless steel wire
explanation_cn: 牙科铸造合金的一种，具有优良的力学性能和抗腐蚀性，1929年开始被用于口腔修复。牙科钻铬铸造合金的组成中.钴、铬和镍元素总量不应超过85%，若合金中含铍，其含量不能超过2%按其硬度通常分为硬质、中硬质和软质三类。牙科钴铬铸造合金的熔点在1290~1425C,密度约为8.3gcm3,铸造后线收缩为2.13%~2.24%。非正比例拉伸屈服强度的最小值为500MPa.断裂时伸长率最小值为1.5%。硬质钴铬合金的抗拉强度大于630MPa,伸长率大于3%，硬度大于HR30N57。中硬质钻铬合金的抗拉强度大于630MPa.伸长率大于3%.硬度为HR30N50~57。软质钴铬合金的抗拉强度大于400MPa,伸长率大于30%。硬质钴铬铸造合金可用于活动义齿大支架的整体铸造和种植体.中硬质钴铬铸造合金可用于卡环、合垫、基托、冠和固定桥等.软质钴铬铸造合金可用于各类固定修复。
explanation_en: It is a kind of dental foundry alloy, which has excellent mechanical properties and corrosion resistance. It has been used in dental restorations since 1929. In the composition of dental drill chromium foundry alloy, the total amount of cobalt, chromium and nickel elements should not exceed 85%. If alloy contains beryllium, its content should not exceed 2%. According to its hardness, it is generally divided into three categories: hard, medium hard and soft. The melting point of dental cobalt chromium foundry alloy is 1290~1425C, the density is about 8.3gcm3, and the linear shrinkage after foundry is 2.13%~2.24%. The minimum value of non proportional tensile yield strength is 500 MPa. The minimum value of elongation at fracture is 1.5%. The tensile strength of hard cobalt chromium alloy is more than 630MPa, the elongation is more than 3%, and the hardness is more than HR30N57. The tensile strength of medium hard drilling chromium alloy is more than 630MPa. The elongation is more than 3%. The hardness is HR30N50~57. The tensile strength of soft cobalt chromium alloy is more than 400MPa, and the elongation is more than 30%. Hard cobalt chromium foundry alloy can be used for integral foundry and implant of movable demure large stem. Medium hard cobalt chromium foundry alloy can be used for snap ring, cushion, base, crown and fixed bridge. Soft cobalt chromium foundry alloy can be used for various fixed restorations.

explanation_cn: 用于铸造牙科修复用铸件（或成品）的合金。牙科用铸造合金除需具备良好的力学性能、抗腐蚀性能等理化性能和生物性能外，还需具有铸造收缩率小、浇注时流动性好、铸件易打磨抛光等特点。牙科用铸造合金按其熔化温度的范围分为5类：高熔铸造合金（1100度以上）.中熔铸造合金（500~1100°C).低熔铸造合金(500°C以下）。按其组成的主要元素的成分分为贵金属和非贵金属铸造合金。用于牙科的铸造合金主要有金合金、18-8铬镍不锈钢丝、钻铬合金、镍铬合金、银合金、铜合金及钛合金等。使用方法是首先将拟制作的金属修复体用蜡通过直接法（口腔内成型）或间接法（口腔外模型上成型）制成蜡然后包埋.失蜡浇注成金属修复体
explanation_en: Alloy used for foundry castings (or finished products) for dental restorations. In addition to good mechanical properties, corrosion resistance and other physical and chemical properties and biological properties, foundry alloy for dentistry also need to have the characteristics of small shrinkage rate of foundry, good flow ability during pouring, and easy polishing of castings. Dental foundry alloy can be divided into five categories according to their melting temperature range: high melting foundry alloy (above 1100 ℃), medium melting foundry alloy (500~1100 ℃), and low melting foundry alloy (below 500 ℃). It can be divided into precious metals and non precious metals foundry alloy according to the composition of main elements. The foundry alloy used in dentistry mainly include gold alloy, 18-8 chromium nickel stainless steel wire, drill chromium alloy, nickel chromium alloy, silver alloy, copper alloy and titanium alloy. The method of use is that the metal prosthesis to be made is first made of wax by direct method (molding in the mouth) or indirect method (molding on the model outside the mouth) and then embedded. The lost wax is poured into the metal prosthesis

explanation_cn: 用于牙科铸造工艺的金合金。由于其具有良好的力学性能、理化性能、加工性能和生物学性能.适合于制作各类口腔金属修复体。牙科铸造金合金的含金量及铂族金属Pt、Pci等总含量应不少于75%。t型软质金合金适用于受力很小的修复体.如嵌体；n型中硬质金合金适用于中等受力的修复体,如34冠、固位体、桥体、全冠和末端游离鞍基；Q]型硬质金合金适用于受力较大的修复体，如薄的34冠、薄的铸造基托、桥体、全冠和末端游离鞍基；IV型超硬质金合金适用于受力很大的修复体.如末端游离鞍基、杆、卡环、冠、栓道、整体铸件和局部义齿的支架等。
explanation_en: Gold alloy used in dental foundry process. Because of its good mechanical properties, physical and chemical properties, processing properties and biological properties, it is suitable for making various dental metal prosthesis. The gold content of dental foundry gold alloy and the total content of platinum group metals such as Pt and Pci should not be less than 75%. T-type soft gold alloy is suitable for prosthesis with little stress, such as inlays; N-type medium hard metal alloy is suitable for moderately stressed prosthesis, such as 34 crowns, retainers, bridges, full crowns and end free saddle bases; Q] C-type cemented carbide is suitable for prosthesis with large stress, such as thin 34 crowns, thin foundry bases, bridge bodies, full crowns and free saddle bases at the end; Type IV super hard metal alloy is suitable for prosthesis with great stress, such as end free saddle base, rod, snap ring, crown, bolt channel, integral casting and stem of partial demure.

explanation_cn: 适合于制造各种街轮用的机械结构钢。齿轮足重要的机械零件.用途广泛.形状和性能要求各有不同，因而选材及热处理T艺也应随之变化。精度要求不高、负荷不大的W轮，可采用非合金钢；承受冲击载荷而形状又较为复杂的重要齿轮，以及精度要求较高的齿轮，可采圯合金结构钢。承受冲击载荷不高的中小模数齿轮可采用中碳调质钢，然后直接使用，或在对齿面耐磨性要求较高时对齿面进行高频感应淬火或表面氮化处理；而承受冲击载荷较大的大模数齿轮或螺旋齿轮多采用渗碳钢.经渗碳淬火后低温回火，齿面具有较高强度和硬度而心部保持较高韧性。
explanation_en: It is suitable for manufacturing mechanical structural steel for various street wheels. Gear is an important mechanical part. It has a wide range of applications. Its shape and performance requirements are different, so the selection of materials and heat treatment technology should also change accordingly. The W wheel with low precision requirements and low load can be made of non-alloy steel; The important gears bearing impact load and with complex shape, as well as the gears with high precision requirements, can be made of: 1 alloy structural steel. Medium and small module gears that do not bear high impact load can be made of medium carbon quenched and tempered steel, and then used directly, or the tooth surface is subject to high-frequency induction quenching or surface nitriding treatment when the requirements for wear resistance of the tooth surface are high; Carburized steel is mostly used for large module gear or spiral gear with large impact load. After carburizing and quenching, it is tempering at low temperature. The tooth surface has high strength and hardness while the center maintains high toughness.

explanation_cn: 牙科锻造合金的一种.其制品主要有合金片、无缝冠及正畸用锁糟等。镍铬合金具有良好的加工性、抗腐蚀性、力学性能和生物性能。
explanation_en: A kind of dental forged alloy. Its products mainly include alloy pieces, seamless crowns and orthodontic locks. Nickel chromium alloy has good workability, corrosion resistance, mechanical properties and biological properties.

explanation_cn: 牙科修复操作过程中常用的一种辅助材料。主要作用是在两种相同的或不同的材料之间，或材料与模具之间形成隔离膜.使二者间不发生粘连，完成操作后易于分离，牙科分离剂可分为四类：①石膏分离剂.用于分离与石膏，主要采用钾皂溶液、含2%,3%的藻酸钠水溶液和30%的水玻璃（硅酸钠）水溶液；②树脂分离剂.用于在石膏模塑中灌制树脂堪托时分离石#与树脂，主要采用含2%,3%的藻酸钠水溶液和聚乙烯醇水溶液；③蜡分离剂.用于包埋材料与蜡之间的分离，主要采用水、甘油和乙二醇：④其他分离剂，如硅油、凡士林等。有些分离剂需与被分离物质发生化学反应后才产生分离薄膜，故在使用中.除应根据不同的使用目的选用适当的分离剂外，还应注意恰当地选择涂布分离剂的时机。
explanation_en: It is an auxiliary materials commonly used in dental restorative operations. The main function is to form an isolation film between two identical or different materials, or between materials and molds, so that there is no adhesion between the two, and it is easy to separate after the operation. Dental separators can be divided into four categories: ① gypsum separators, which are used to separate gypsum, mainly potassium soap solution, 2%, 3% sodium alginate aqueous solution and 30% water glass aqueous solution; ② Resin separating agent. It is used to separate stone # and resin when pouring resin into gypsum molding. It mainly uses 2% and 3% sodium alginate aqueous solution and polyvinyl alcohol aqueous solution; ③ Wax separating agent. It is used to separate embedded materials from wax, mainly using water, glycerin and glycol; ④ Other separating agents, such as silicone oil, vaseline, etc. Some separators require chemical reactions with the separated substance before producing a separation film. Therefore, in use, in addition to selecting appropriate separators for different purposes, attention should also be paid to selecting the appropriate timing for coating the separators.

explanation_cn: 配位型氧化物矿物。化学式为FeSiO3,常含类质同象混人物Ti、Al、Mn、Fe2+、C'a、Mg;还含金红石、钛铁矿微包体。纤维状和土状者中含水。三方晶系.。刚玉型结构。完好晶体少见。常成板状、鱗片状、粒状、隐晶质块状、鲕状、豆状、肾状、粉末状等集合体。呈片状、具金属光泽者称镜铁矿；细小鱗片状苒称云母赤铁矿；依（0001)或近于（0001)连生的镜铁矿集合体称铁玫瑰；红色粉末状#称铁赭石；浑圆的球状或椭球形赤铁矿胶结成的块体称鲕状赤铁矿.鲕粒内部常具同心层状。鲕粒直径大于2mm的赤铁矿称豆状亦铁矿；半球状并彼此黏结的致密块状称肾状赤铁矿，其单肾内部常呈同心层状或放射状表面光滑明亮的红色钟乳状赤铁矿称红玻璃头，也可以看成是带放射状和同心层状的巨大肾状体。晶体呈钢灰色至铁黑色.常带浅蓝锖色。隐晶或粉末状者呈暗红至鲜红色。条痕为樱桃红或红棕色。半金属至金属光泽。细薄片或晶体碎片边缘透光呈血红色。无解理。双晶造成平行{0001}和U011}的裂开。氧化条件下形成，大规模的赤铁矿在沉积作用和热液作州条件下形成，与磁铁矿、石英.绿泥石、重晶石、菱铁矿等共生。赤铁矿是主要的铁矿石矿物。纯净的粉末状赤铁矿是天然的矿物颜料。
explanation_en: Coordination type oxide minerals. The chemical formula is FeSiO3, often containing isomorphic mixed characters Ti, Al, Mn, Fe2+, C'a, Mg; It also contains rutile and ilmenite micro inclusions. Fibrous and earthy materials contain water. Tripartite crystal system. Corundum structure. Intact crystal are rare. It is usually in plate, scale, granular, cryptocrystalline massive, oolitic, pisolitic, kidney, powder and other aggregates. It is called iron glance in sheet shape and with metallic luster; Fine scale like mica hematite; Ferrirose refers to iron glance aggregate with continuous growth of (0001) or close to (0001); Red powder is called iron ocher; The rounded spherical or ellipsoidal hematite cemented block is called oolitic hematite. There are often concentric layers inside the oolite. The hematite with oolite diameter greater than 2mm is called pisolitic hematite; The hemispherical and cohesive dense block is called reniform hematite. The inner part of a single kidney is usually concentric or radial, and the smooth and bright red stalactite hematite is called red glass head. It can also be seen as a huge reniform body with radial and concentric layers. Crystal is steel gray to iron black, often with light blue print color. Crystals or powders appear dark red to bright red. The stripes are cherry red or reddish brown. Semi metallic to metallic luster. The edge of thin slice or crystal fragment is blood red. No cleavage. The twin causes the splitting of parallel {0001} and U011}. It is formed under oxidation conditions, large-scale hematite is formed under sedimentation and hydrothermal conditions, and coexists with magnetite, quartze, chlorite, barite, siderite, etc. Hematite is the main iron ore mineral. Pure powdered hematite is a natural mineral pigment.

explanation_cn: 中闰宋代龙泉窑所烧制的青瓷。龙泉窑是中国历史上的一个名窑，因其烧制的瓷器主要产区在今浙江省龙泉市而得名。它开创于三国两晋，结束于清代，生产瓷器的历史长达1600多年。龙泉窑瓷釉色苍翠，北宋时多粉青色，南宋时呈葱青色，没有开片在器皿转折处，往往露胎呈现胎色，瓷釉厚润，装饰上很少刻花、划花，而流行用贴花、浮雕。
explanation_en: Celadon fired in the Longquan Kiln of the Song Dynasty. Longquan Kiln is a famous kiln in Chinese history, which is named after the main producing area of its porcelain in today's Longquan City, Zhejiang Province. It was founded in the Three Kingdoms, the Eastern and Western Jin Dynasties, and ended in the Qing Dynasty. It has produced porcelain for more than 1600 years. The glaze color of Longquan kiln porcelain is verdant, with a mostly pink blue color during the Northern Song Dynasty and a green green green color during the Southern Song Dynasty. It does not open at the turning point of the vessel, often revealing the color of the body. The porcelain glaze is thick and moist, and there are very few carved or scratched flowers on the decoration, but the popular use of stickers and reliefs.

explanation_cn: 施工后的涂料经过一段时间，漆膜出现的类似网状的细小裂纹。
explanation_en: After the construction of the coatings, after a period of time, the paint film appears small cracks similar to the network.

explanation_cn: 能够保证良好电绝缘行的薄膜。这种薄膜应当具有很高的电阻率、击穿场强和电子结构特点是禁带宽度大。为了用于高频绝缘，还要求材料具有低的介电损耗。绝缘膜有无机和有机两类。无机绝缘体通常称为电介质，常用的有氧化硅、氮化硅、氧化铝、氮化铝；常用的有机绝缘膜材料有聚酰亚胺、聚乙烯、聚偏二氟乙烯、聚四氟乙烯。不论是无机还是有机绝缘体，一般都具有在外电场作用下极化的能力。用作电绝缘膜时，希望其介电常数低，以减少介电损耗。从工程应用考虑，防止电击穿是绝缘膜的技术问题之一。
explanation_en: A thin film that can ensure good electrical insulation. The film should have high resistivity, breakdown field strength and electronic structure, which is characterized by wide band gap. In order to be used for high-frequency insulation, materials are also required to have low diekctric loss. There are two types of insulation films: inorganic and organic. Inorganic insulators are usually called dielectric, commonly used are silicon oxide, silicon nitride, aluminum oxide, aluminum nitride; Common organic insulating film materials include polyimide, polyethylene, polyvinylidene fluoride and polylctrafluorocthylone. Both inorganic and organic insulators generally have the ability to polarize under external electric fields. When used as an electrical insulating film, it is hoped that its dielectric constant is low to reduce diekctric loss. From the perspective of engineering applications, preventing electrical breakdown is one of the technical issues of insulation films.
